metadata.novel_title: Starting Sign-In from a Billionaire God

novel_info.title: Starting Sign-In from a Billionaire God
novel_info.author: Abyss Gazing
novel_info.summary: Lin Fan obtained an incredibly powerful sign-in system, and at the start, he was rewarded with a billion in cash!Lin Fan transformed from a delivery man into a divine level wealthy individual, buying companies, luxury homes, real estate, aircraft carriers...with the phrase “Money is not a problem” as he conquered the world!“Ding! Sign-in successful, obtained the world's most expensive top-tier supercar!”“Ding! Sign-in successful, obtained top-tier musical talent!”“Ding! Sign-in successful, obtained shares in a billion-dollar corporation!”“Ding! Sign-in successful, obtained a sister who combines beauty and intelligence, also the wealthiest person!”As long as he insisted on signing in every day, various divine level rewards would come pouring in!Thus, a universe-level invincible delivery man was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Starting with a 10 Billion Reward, Buying the Entire Street!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1: Chapter 1: Starting with a 10 Billion Reward, Buying the Entire Street!
"Can you afford it?"
A long-legged beauty with a pretty oval face pointed at a new L.v bag in front of her and looked at Lin Fan with disdain, delivering a soul-searching question.
The surrounding staff and customers watched the scene with schadenfreude.
It made Lin Fan, dressed in a delivery uniform, feel a bit embarrassed.
He had met Zhao Xin’er through a blind date and planned to formally confess to her today, but who knew she would drag him to this L.v boutique out of the blue?
"If you can immediately pay in full for one and buy it for me, I’ll agree to be with you."
Zhao Xin’er said arrogantly, her superior attitude full of humiliation towards Lin Fan.
In her eyes, Lin Fan was just one of many clinging admirers, and the most inconspicuous and poor among them.
Lin Fan was indeed very poor. Originally, he joined a decent company after graduating, but due to being framed by colleagues, he lost his job and could only deliver food.
His monthly salary had to support his family, leaving barely any money left.
Paying in full for an L.v bag was simply impossible.
"Look, a delivery guy doesn’t even have a sense of reality, yet he dreams about pursuing a goddess?"
"This is what they call a toad wishing to eat swan meat!"
"I think he’s not bad looking, but a handsome poor guy isn’t as good as a rich unattractive one!"
The people around discussed and snickered.
These words made Lin Fan feel even more embarrassed.
At this moment, a brand new BMW suddenly drove up and stopped at the entrance, instantly attracting everyone’s attention.
Zhao Xin’er’s eyes were already shining.
The car door opened, and a short, greasy fat man, holding flowers, got out of the car. Despite his unattractive appearance, in Zhao Xin’er’s eyes, he suddenly seemed incredibly cute.
Money truly is the best filter.
The fat man directly went up to Zhao Xin’er and knelt on one knee.
"My dear, I’ve liked you for a long time. Would you like to be with me? Here’s my bankbook, enough for you to buy a hundred new bags!"
The fat man spoke affectionately, taking out a bankbook from his arms along with the flowers and offering them to Zhao Xin’er.
Zhao Xin’er didn’t accept the flowers but snatched the bankbook, opened it, and saw the number 1 followed by six zeros—a million in savings!
Zhao Xin’er was overjoyed, but outwardly she said reservedly, "Considering your sincerity, I reluctantly agree to be with you."
"Ah, great!"
The fat man jumped up with happiness and excitedly grabbed Zhao Xin’er’s hand.
The people around looked enviously: "Wow, finding a rich boyfriend, how lucky!"
The victorious fat man immediately gave Lin Fan a disdainful look.
"You poor bastard, see that? With money comes love. These days, who talks about feelings if not money?"
Everyone burst into laughter.
"Sir, if you can’t afford our bags, please leave, so you don’t disturb our business!"
The shop assistant issued an eviction order to Lin Fan.
"Just leave, stop embarrassing yourself!" The fat man gloated.
Lin Fan couldn’t stay anymore, but as a teenager who had read many novels, he still wanted to make a passionate declaration before leaving.
"Fine, I’ll go. Zhao Xin’er, you’re missing out on the handsome me, don’t regret it in the future!"
"Thirty years east of the river, thirty years west, don’t look down on a poor young man!"
Everyone burst into laughter, some even laughed until their stomachs hurt.
"You poor bastard, you’re quite humorous. I’ll give you thirty years, and I guarantee you’ll still be a poor bastard by then." The fat man laughed heartily.
Zhao Xin’er said, "Lin Fan, rest assured, I definitely won’t regret it!"
Ding!
At this moment, Lin Fan heard a voice in his mind.
"System startup completed, binding in progress...
Host: Lin Fan.
Age: 21
Occupation: Deliveryman.
Assets: No house, no car, savings of 1,203 yuan.
Sign-in system binding complete!
First sign-in, get a gift of 100 billion cash. Would the host like to sign in?"
Lin Fan was shocked, feeling like he had received the protagonist’s golden finger from a novel?
What kind of overwhelming, cool, and bombastic system is this!
"Sign in, immediately sign in!" Lin Fan screamed inwardly.
"Congratulations, sign-in successful, 100 billion cash has been transferred, please check!"
The phone then received a text reminder, Lin Fan looked, and sure enough, it was a bank notification.
"Your account ending in 3245 has been transferred 100,000,000,000.00 Huaxia Coins, balance 100,000,001,203.00."
It’s real!
Lin Fan was wildly ecstatic inside, the first time seeing so much money in his life!
"Why haven’t you left yet, can’t afford a bag, still sticking around here for what?"
"If you keep refusing to leave, I’ll call the mall security guard to make you leave!"
The store assistant was getting impatient.
Lin Fan looked at the assistant and said domineeringly, "Who said I can’t afford your bags, I want all the bags in this store!"
The whole place went silent.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan as if watching a crazy person.
The fat man laughed loudly, "Hahaha, you poor bastard, what did you say? You want to buy all the bags here, do you have money?"
"I think he’s definitely gone mad from the shock, poor thing!"
"Still, better call security, his mental state is already abnormal!"
Lin Fan ignored everyone, calmly took out a bank card, and handed it to the assistant, "Whether I can afford it, just swipe and you’ll know. If I can’t pay, I’ll crawl out myself, quickly calculate the cost for me!"
The assistant was stunned, Lin Fan didn’t seem like he was joking at all, she didn’t know if she should accept it.
At that moment, the store manager walked over, took the card, and said, "No need to calculate, we just did an inventory last night. The store’s bag inventory is worth 2 million yuan, sir, if the card swipe fails, will you really crawl out?"
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right!"
The manager took the card and went to the front desk to swipe it.
Everyone held their breath, watching the scene.
No one believed the card swipe would succeed, after all, Lin Fan was just a delivery guy; they were already waiting to see a joke.
Beep!
A notification sound.
The manager raised his head, voice trembling slightly, "Card swipe successful."
It actually succeeded!
Lin Fan, a delivery guy, actually had 2 million in savings!
Everyone was stunned.
Zhao Xin’er’s eyes widened as she unknowingly loosened the fat man’s hand.
The fat man felt a bit awkward but was equally shocked by Lin Fan’s boldness.
As everyone was already sufficiently surprised, Lin Fan took back the card, walked to the store entrance, and shouted towards the entire street.
"Hear me, all the stores on this street, I want all your stock!"
With these words, the entire street was shaken.
This street was extraordinary, with thirteen shops selling clothes, bags, perfumes—all world-class luxury brands!
Their inventories in each store were at least a million, and Lin Fan took them all!
How much money would that be!
Apart from the L.v store that had already been purchased, the other twelve stores mobilized all their staff under the store manager’s leadership to start frantically counting their inventory.
Some keen individuals secretly took out their phones, taking pictures of this scene...

chapters.title: Chapter 2 Do You Want It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2: Chapter 2 Do You Want It?
"Dior Perfume Store, inventory 1.53 million!"
The store manager of Dior was the first to rush over to report.
Beep!
Card swipe successful!
"Ames Store, inventory 3.00 million!"
Beep!
Card swipe successful!
"Prada Store, inventory 4.00 million!"
Beep!
Card swipe successful!
As these stores one by one successfully swiped their cards, the entire street went crazy.
Oh my God, this delivery man actually has so much money. This is unbelievably extravagant. Never seen such a flamboyant move, this is what it means to be rich and reckless, too reckless! Just how much money does he have!
"He might be a billionaire!" someone speculated.
Only a billionaire can buy the whole street without even blinking!
This judgment left everyone in awe.
The chubby guy shivered, being the first to kneel. Could it be that Lin Fan is playing dumb to catch the tiger, this low-key billionaire is the first he’s ever seen.
Zhao Xin’er trembled with excitement, and recalling her earlier rejection of Lin Fan, she felt like falling into an icy abyss.
She had just said she wouldn’t regret it, but now she’s already regretting it deeply.
"Chanel, inventory 10 million!"
The last store reported.
Beep!
Card swipe successful!
Oh my God, 10 million swiped easily too!
Lin Fan is really a billionaire, isn’t he!
"He’s not a delivery man at all, he’s pretending to be poor on purpose to slap the gold digger in the face!"
"That must be it, no billionaire would be a delivery man!"
"The gold digger deserves it, only looking at money and not character, ended up being played by a tycoon. It’s so satisfying!"
The crowd started discussing.
Zhao Xin’er couldn’t hold back anymore, she ran frantically to Lin Fan, knelt down with a thud, and clung to Lin Fan’s leg.
"Lin Fan, I was wrong, please forgive me, I’ll accept your love proposal, I’m willing to be your girlfriend, please let me be your girlfriend!" Zhao Xin’er pleaded.
Her appearance was like a female dog.
The chubby guy got anxious: "Xin’er, didn’t you just agree to be my girlfriend?"
Zhao Xin’er disdainfully retorted: "Get lost, you ugly freak, who’s going to be your girlfriend, I’m Brother Fan’s woman now!"
Saying this, she threw the chubby guy’s passbook right at his face.
The chubby guy was so angry he was grinding his teeth, but there was nothing he could do.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Zhao Xin’er, you asked if I could buy a new bag for you. Now I bought the whole street, do you want it?"
Zhao Xin’er nodded madly: "I want it! Brother Fan, forgive my previous ignorance, I really like your low-key and not pretentious style, I’ve realized I’m in love with you."
Everyone was sweating, he bought the whole street, and that’s called low-key and not pretentious!
"Brother Fan, I know you love me too, right?" Zhao Xin’er looked at Lin Fan with great anticipation.
Since Lin Fan likes her, she’s confident that he will definitely agree to her.
"Sorry, I don’t like you anymore."
Lin Fan said lightly, gently moved her hand away, and pushed her aside.
Zhao Xin’er collapsed on the ground, almost going crazy, Lin Fan actually doesn’t want her anymore!
"I still have to deliver takeout, so I’ll be going now. My things will be stored here with you, I’ll pick them up later. Sorry, excuse me, this is my e-bike."
Lin Fan said as he walked towards the e-bike placed on the side.
The surrounding people were dumbfounded, what the heck, is he really a delivery man?
Under the shocked gazes of everyone, Lin Fan rode away on his e-bike.
As for Zhao Xin’er, Lin Fan didn’t spare her another glance.
He had seen through this money-loving woman, if he ever really liked her before, now he feels nothing at all.
"Lin Fan, don’t go, you can’t go, I want to be your girlfriend!"
Zhao Xin’er shouted, frantically chasing after Lin Fan’s e-bike.
But Lin Fan didn’t look back, leaving Zhao Xin’er far behind, and rode off into the distance.
Zhao Xin’er could only walk back dejectedly and came to that L.V store, her eyes fell on that new bag.
"This is what Lin Fan bought for me. Please pack it for me, I’m taking it away," Zhao Xin’er said to the store staff.
The shop assistant said coldly, "I’m sorry, all the bags here belong to Mr. Lin. Mr. Lin asked us to keep them safe, but didn’t say to give them to you."
The store manager said with a stern face, "Miss, please leave, or I’ll call security."
The people around pointed and whispered.
"The billionaire courted her before, and she was ungrateful and refused. Now she still wants his stuff, shameless!"
"Seen shameless people before, but not this shameless!"
Zhao Xin’er left the store in embarrassment, her eyes caught the chubby guy’s BMW beside her, and she hurried over.
"He Guang, you’re my boyfriend now, didn’t you say you’d buy me a bag? Give me your passbook!" Zhao Xin’er said.
The chubby guy, He Guang, was also very remorseful now. If he had known Lin Fan was a billionaire, he would have gusfhed over him, but because of this woman, he missed the chance to get in favor with Lin Fan.
He almost hated Zhao Xin’er to death.
He Guang sneered with a face full of contempt: "Didn’t you just dump me for Lin Fan? Now you’re the girlfriend of a billionaire, I don’t dare to have you."
Sarcasm, blatant sarcasm!
Zhao Xin’er’s face turned red with rage: "He Guang, you bastard, what right do you have to dump me? When I become Lin Fan’s girlfriend, you won’t even be qualified to shine my shoes!"
He Guang snickered, got into his BMW, and left in a cloud of dust, leaving a final jab: "Does Lin Fan want you?"
That was a real heartbreaker!
Zhao Xin’er screamed in frustration: "You’ll see, I will become Lin Fan’s girlfriend!"
Yesterday, Lin Fan would still ignore her, but now she can’t even reach for him, but she has made up her mind to pursue Lin Fan from now on!
Lin Fan, of course, didn’t know her decision. At this moment, he was already on his way delivering takeout.
Although he has a lot of money now, he hasn’t decided what to do in the future, so he continued delivering takeout for the time being, until he figures it out.
At this moment, he received a new order. Someone from Blue Moon Company ordered lunch, to be delivered within half an hour.
Lin Fan’s eyes lit up, Blue Moon Company, that’s the company that fired him before, what a coincidence.
If it was before, Lin Fan would have likely passed the order to a colleague, but this time, Lin Fan hesitated and accepted it.
Arriving at the pick-up point at Yun City Restaurant, it was lunchtime, and a large number of delivery drivers were already gathered at the entrance.
Apart from colleagues from the same platform as Lin Fan, there were delivery drivers from other platforms, and although they worked for different companies, they were all quite familiar with each other, chatting and laughing in groups.
The restaurant’s TV was broadcasting local news, and Lin Fan glanced at it out of boredom while waiting for the pick-up.
"According to reports, the local hand sanitizer brand Blue Moon Company is urgently seeking a transfer, priced at 100 million, with no buyers yet. If you are interested in acquiring it, please contact President Zhang of the company..."
Lin Fan was a little surprised, Blue Moon is actually for sale?
Selling for only 100 million, that doesn’t seem too expensive either...

chapters.title: Chapter 3: I bought this company
chapters.content:
Chapter 3: Chapter 3: I bought this company
Blue Moon Company.
Lin Fan walked to the company reception with his delivery bag and saw an unfamiliar pretty girl at the front desk.
"Hello, I have a delivery." Lin Fan said with a smile.
The receptionist, upon seeing it was a delivery man, showed no pleasant expression and said coldly, "Why are you telling me? Make the call yourself!"
This woman’s attitude is a bit off.
Lin Fan said "Oh" and dialed the number left with the order: "Hello, your ordered food has arrived, please come out to collect it."
It took a full ten minutes before a man slowly walked out.
Their eyes met, and both froze for a moment.
"You’re Lin Fan!" The man pointed at Lin Fan and burst into laughter, "I can’t believe it, you’re actually delivering food now!"
Lin Fan’s heart sank; Zhao Gang, the colleague who plotted against him and got him fired!
It’s really a small world, and it was Zhao Gang who placed the order.
Lin Fan kept a calm face and said, "This is your order, please take it."
However, Zhao Gang didn’t take it; instead, he pointed at Lin Fan and laughed, "Little Zhang, you probably don’t know since you’re new here, but this guy used to be our colleague and now he’s just a food deliverer. Isn’t that pathetic?"
The receptionist giggled, "No way, how could he have fallen this low and still have the face to come back here?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Miss, there’s no shame in any work; earning money with your own hands and feet, not stealing or robbing, what’s wrong with that?"
The receptionist pouted, seemingly unwilling to converse with Lin Fan.
Zhao Gang laughed, "You’re wrong. I think us company white-collars are more noble than you laboring runners. Little Zhang, what do you think?"
The receptionist seized the chance to flatter, "Manager Zhao is right."
Manager Zhao? Lin Fan frowned.
Zhao Gang beamed, "Oh right, I forgot to mention, since you got fired, I’ve been promoted to project manager."
Zhao Gang wore a proud expression. He had competed for the manager position against Lin Fan and set him up to win, leaving Lin Fan innocently without a chance to defend himself, resulting in his dismissal.
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh" and sneered, "Then congratulations."
Hearing the sarcasm in Lin Fan’s tone, Zhao Gang was instantly displeased and snatched the delivery box, giving it a feel: "Why is my meal cold? It must be that you took too long on the way!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Zhao Gang, that’s enough, don’t push it. I called you ten minutes ago; it was you who came late."
Zhao Gang got angry and cursed, "You damn delivery boy, how dare you talk back to me. I’ll call to complain about you! I’ve heard complaints lead to wage deductions!"
Lin Fan was someone who stood his ground. Even when he relied on this salary to support his family, he never worried about customer complaints. When it came to unreasonable customers, he’d stand his ground to the end.
Especially now, money was the least of his concerns!
Lin Fan looked at Zhao Gang as if looking at a fool.
Zhao Gang thought he had Lin Fan by the scruff, chuckled and said, "Lin Fan, I’ll give you a chance now, kneel and apologize to me, and I won’t complain."
By now, quite a few people had noticed the commotion and ran over to watch, chatting away.
"Isn’t that Lin Fan? So pitiful, why is he delivering food now?"
"They never got along well before; it’s really a small world, such bad luck."
"Delivery guys fear complaints, all it takes is one and it sticks. If Lin Fan doesn’t want a fine, he might need to kneel and apologize!"
Zhao Gang confidently looked down on Lin Fan, waiting for him to kneel.
Just as everyone was waiting to see Lin Fan make a fool of himself, he casually picked up his phone and dialed a number.
"Hello, is this President Zhang? It’s Lin Fan, yes, the one you fired recently. Since you fired me, I went back to inherit my billion-dollar wealth. I heard Blue Moon is up for sale, and I’ve decided to purchase it."
...
Lin Fan wants to buy Blue Moon!
Once the news broke, the entire company was in uproar, with everyone gathering to watch, crowding the area.
Zhang Dafu, the CEO of Blue Moon Company, was troubled recently by the urgent need to sell the company but couldn’t find a buyer, to the point where he was even advertising on television.
Upon receiving Lin Fan’s call, he jumped up excitedly and hustled out.
"Make way, make way!"
Zhang Dafu pushed through the onlookers and finally made it to the front, only to be dumbfounded upon seeing Lin Fan.
The Lin Fan who left a lingering impression was now dressed in a delivery outfit, carrying a delivery bag, evidently a delivery guy.
Zhang Dafu felt like a bucket of cold water had been poured over his head as his expression turned gloomy: "Lin Fan, didn’t you say you’d gone back to inherit a fortune?"
Zhao Gang rolled on the floor with laughter: "President Zhang, you’ve been fooled by this guy. He’s got no inheritance; he’s just a delivery guy now. How could he afford to buy the company!"
The crowd burst into laughter, as Lin Fan’s jest seemed too far-fetched.
Zhang Dafu was furious: "Lin Fan, if you’re here to cause trouble, you’d better leave at once!"
Lin Fan remained calm, smiling, "Who says a billionaire can’t deliver food? If President Zhang doesn’t believe I have the money, I can pay a deposit first. Name your price."
Zhang Dafu was taken aback by his calm demeanor, feeling hesitant but curious: "Do you really have money?"
Lin Fan said, "No one is willing to take over Blue Moon now; President Zhang must be worried. I could be your only chance. If you don’t give it a try, I’ll leave immediately."
Zhang Dafu was indeed anxious; he was waiting to cash out by selling Blue Moon.
Zhao Gang laughed even more arrogantly: "I’m dying of laughter. Lin Fan, stop fooling President Zhang. If you can buy Blue Moon, I’ll kneel and call you daddy!"
Lin Fan raised an eyebrow: "Everyone heard that, he wants to be my son."
Zhao Gang said, "President Zhang, you won’t believe this fool, right? I’d suggest reporting him and throwing him out with security!"
Zhang Dafu was not Zhao Gang; Zhao Gang had personal grudges against Lin Fan and naturally wanted to get rid of him, but Zhang Dafu needed money. Any chance of selling Blue Moon, no matter how slim, he would not pass up!
Zhang Dafu clenched his teeth and made up his mind: "Alright, I’ll give it a try. Lin Fan, transfer 30 million as a deposit first. If it’s successful, I’ll believe you!"
"No problem."
Lin Fan agreed readily, having hundreds of billions in cash now; 30 million was a drop in the ocean, he wouldn’t bat an eye if it were thrown into the sea.
Zhang Dafu immediately called his assistant to bring a computer for Lin Fan to transfer the funds.
Zhao Gang found it utterly absurd: "President Zhang, is it necessary to waste time with this guy? Just look at him, probably an 18th-generation farmer. Do you really believe he has a fortune at home?"
Zhang Dafu sternly replied, "Enough, stop talking. I’ve made my decision."
Zhang Dafu had his own plans; if Lin Fan couldn’t come up with the money, he wouldn’t need Zhao Gang to tell him. He’d deal with Lin Fan himself.
Zhao Gang stared at Lin Fan, sneering, "Lin Fan, if you want to make a fool of yourself, I won’t stop you; I’ll deal with you later!"
The computer had already been brought over, and the assistant swiftly set up the transfer page for Lin Fan to proceed with the transaction.
Everyone thought Lin Fan was just messing around and waited to see him make a fool of himself.
Because there’s no way Lin Fan’s appearance could match that of a wealthy person.
Lin Fan walked to the computer, quickly entering his bank account number and entering 30 million as the transfer amount.
Confirm!
With a simple operation, the transfer was completed.
Beep!
A notification sound rang out.
The assistant looked down, raised in shock, and said in a trembling voice, "30 million, received."

chapters.title: Chapter 4: You don’t allow me to trick you
chapters.content:
Chapter 4: Chapter 4: You don’t allow me to trick you
What?
Everyone was stunned, with expressions of disbelief.
Lin Fan really does have billions in assets!
Is he actually the legendary super Rich Second Generation?
It must be true!
Zhang Dafu excitedly grabbed the computer to look and was pleasantly surprised: "Lin Fan, is what you’re saying true!"
Zhao Gang’s jaw almost dropped, looking ashen: "Impossible, this can’t be true!"
Lin Fan smiled and said: "President Zhang, do you believe now that I can buy your Company?"
Zhang Dafu nodded vigorously, excitedly said: "I believe it, Lin Fan, no, Brother Fan, you really are my savior, thank you so much."
Zhang Dafu enthusiastically held onto Lin Fan’s hand, even changing the way he addressed him, as if Lin Fan was his second father.
Understandably so, as he was almost worried to death when the Company couldn’t be sold before.
"Impossible, this is too absurd, Lin Fan, you’re so rich, why are you still delivering food!" Zhao Gang shouted hoarsely, unable to accept the reality.
Zhang Dafu was not pleased: "Zhao Gang, what nonsense are you spouting, can’t someone as low-key as Brother Fan just want to experience life?"
Zhang Dafu made a valid point, leaving everyone speechless for a moment.
Zhao Gang was also rendered speechless by the retort, deeply affected, the blow too great for him to bear.
Lin Fan, half-smiling, said: "Zhao Gang, didn’t you say that if I could buy Blue Moon, you’d kneel and call me dad?"
Instantly, Zhao Gang flushed red and was unwilling to humble himself, as Lin Fan was someone he had always treaded on!
Seeing this, Lin Fan smiled slightly: "President Zhang, can I make a request now?"
Zhang Dafu respectfully smiled and said: "Of course, this Company will soon be Brother Fan’s, Brother Fan can do whatever he wishes."
Lin Fan nodded and pointed at Zhao Gang: "Alright then, fire Zhao Gang first!"
Zhao Gang trembled all over, as if struck by lightning. He had been with this Company for three years, finally becoming a project manager, and if he got fired, he’d have nothing left!
"President Zhang, I beg you, please don’t fire me! I’ve been with you for three years." Zhao Gang pleaded.
Zhang Dafu said indifferently: "Why beg me, beg Brother Fan."
Zhao Gang turned to Lin Fan, fell to his knees with a thud, and cried out: "Dad!"
Upon hearing this, everyone burst into laughter, Zhao Gang was willing to throw away his dignity just to keep his job.
Lin Fan looked disdainfully and said: "Forget it, I don’t have a dumbass son like you."
Zhao Gang quickly changed his tone: "Okay, Brother Fan, I realize my mistake, please don’t fire me, I’m begging you?"
He no longer had his previous arrogant demeanor; now he looked like a pathetic wretch.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "You still want to work here, right?"
Zhao Gang quickly nodded: "Yes."
Lin Fan said: "Okay then, I’ll give you a chance. Admit in front of everyone how you framed me, causing me to get fired, and I’ll let you go!"
"What" Zhang Dafu shouted angrily, "Zhao Gang, how dare you frame Brother Fan!"
Zhao Gang cried: "I didn’t want to, Brother Fan was so excellent, if I didn’t use some tricks, I’d never become the project manager."
Hearing this, everyone was shocked.
"No way, Zhao Gang is too shameless!"
"Couldn’t tell he was that kind of person!"
"What trash!"
Zhang Dafu was so furious he was trembling: "Zhao Gang, you’ve let me down, how exactly did you frame Brother Fan?"
Zhao Gang said: "I edited the figures in Brother Fan’s files without him noticing, causing the Company to lose tens of thousands."
Lin Fan sneered and said: "President Zhang mistakenly thought it was my fault and fired me without listening to my explanation."
Zhang Dafu was startled; Brother Fan seemed to blame him. If he changed his mind and didn’t buy the Company, that would be bad. He quickly said: "Brother Fan, I was misled by this guy, I’m very sorry, please forgive me?"
Lin Fan patted Zhang Dafu’s shoulder: "Of course, let’s let bygones be bygones."
Zhang Dafu let out a sigh of relief, smiling brightly: "Thank you, Brother Fan."
Zhao Gang also sighed in relief, Brother Fan’s "let bygones be bygones" sounded like celestial music.
However, before he could even laugh, Lin Fan suddenly changed his tone: "But I won’t forgive Zhao Gang, President Zhang, do what you think is right."
What? Zhao Gang’s face changed drastically, and he pleaded anxiously: "Brother Fan, didn’t you say you’d let me go if I confessed?"
Lin Fan smiled slyly and said: "What, I’m not allowed to fool you?"
Zhao Gang was dumbfounded.
Everyone else broke out in a sweat; Lin Fan is too cunning.
Zhang Dafu, however, was quick to respond and jumped in: "You guys don’t understand; Brother Fan was just using a little tactic to get Zhao Gang to confess. Brother Fan is too clever. Zhao Gang, I officially declare you are fired, and I’ll pursue you for damages. Now get out of my Company!"
Zhao Gang was terrified, being fired and having to pay compensation, it’s like losing on both fronts!
"President Zhang, please, I’m begging you, I can’t afford the compensation, I can’t lose this job!" Zhao Gang cried, crawling over to hug Zhang Dafu’s leg, pleading miserably.
Zhang Dafu, fearing that Lin Fan would mind, shouted: "Call security! Get him out of here!"
Soon, two tall and brawny security guards came and, without saying a word, grabbed Zhao Gang on either side and forcefully dragged him out.
From afar, Zhao Gang’s pig-like cries could still be heard.
Zhang Dafu, worried that Lin Fan was dissatisfied, said: "Brother Fan, I’ve already kicked out that guy. Is there anything else you need me to do?"
Lin Fan turned his gaze to the receptionist Little Zhang standing aside.
At this moment, Little Zhang’s face was already pale, trembling all over: "Brother Fan, I’m sorry, I underestimated you, I shouldn’t have mocked you, I was wrong, please don’t fire me."
Little Zhang put on a pitiful look, trying to soften Lin Fan’s heart.
Lin Fan, however, ignored him; this Little Zhang looked down on him for being a delivery man before, and now that she knew he was rich, she came to beg for mercy. Such a sycophant he wouldn’t keep.
Zhang Dafu, a seasoned operator, understood Lin Fan’s intentions just by looking at his expression, coldly said: "I don’t want to call security, just leave on your own."
Little Zhang, face red with shame, could only silently pack her things and leave in disgrace.
Lin Fan looked at everyone and said loudly: "If you don’t want to work here, you can voluntarily resign, but if you are willing to stay and work with me, I guarantee you’ll live a good life!"
"I’m willing to stay!"
"I’m willing to stay!"
"I’m willing to stay!"
Everyone expressed their willingness to stay.
Are you kidding me, Lin Fan is a billionaire, buying Blue Moon without batting an eye, they were eager to stay and bask in the glory, how could they bear to leave!
Zhang Dafu sheepishly sidled up to Lin Fan: "Um... Brother Fan, can I stay too and work for you?"
Lin Fan oh’d once and said: "Didn’t you sell the Company, why do you still want to stay?"
"To be honest, I sold the Company to pay off debts, and once they’re paid off, I have nothing left, please give me a chance, Brother Fan?"
Zhang Dafu said, thinking that Lin Fan must be a super Rich Second Generation, and if he didn’t latch onto this golden opportunity now, he’d never have another chance.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Most Expensive Mansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 5: Chapter 5: The Most Expensive Mansion
Lin Fan thought, no one knows Blue Moon better than Zhang Dafu, letting him manage Blue Moon is not a bad idea.
"Since you want to stay, then stay. I’ll make you the general manager to help me run the Company," Lin Fan said.
Zhang Dafu was extremely grateful: "Thank you, Brother Fan, no, thank you, Boss!"
Lin Fan then signed the transfer contract with Zhang Dafu, paid the remaining 70 million, and officially became the owner of Blue Moon, owning his first Company in life.
And this is just a starting point!
Everything settled, Lin Fan said: "That’s it for now, I have to go deliver some takeout, I’m leaving first."
Zhang Dafu broke out in cold sweat, the world of the rich is really incomprehensible, the boss, a genuine Rich Second Generation, actually still wants to deliver takeout, such a peculiar hobby.
Is it really to experience life?
After leaving Blue Moon, Lin Fan continued to deliver takeout.
Beep!
The platform prompted, a new order arrived.
Someone ordered ten takeouts to be delivered to Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan was momentarily stunned, Yunding Manor, isn’t that the most expensive and luxurious villa in Yun City, rumored to be worth over a billion!
The orders Lin Fan usually receives are mostly sent to the Company or ordinary residential areas, this is the first time he’s encountered an order from a super-rich area, and it’s the most luxurious, Yunding Manor.
Holding a mindset of getting a glimpse at a top-level luxury residence, Lin Fan took this order.
Cloud Mountain, located in the east of Yun City, the entire Half Mountain area is a wealthy district, luxurious houses abound, among which the highest position overlooking the entire city is Yunding Manor.
This manor has a large building area, looking like a royal garden, extremely luxurious.
Coming to the outside of Yunding Manor, he saw many cars parked outside the manor, people were going in one after another, and there were security guards at the door.
Seeing Lin Fan approaching, the security guard stopped him swiftly: "Buddy, this place isn’t somewhere you can enter, that’s right, everyone else can go in, just not you!"
Cannot enter!
Lin Fan gave a nod: "Why can’t I enter?"
The security guard glanced at Lin Fan: "Isn’t it shameful for you! Let me tell you straight, you are a takeout delivery person and lack qualification to enter, unless you have the money to buy this place, today there is an auction, the question is, do you have money?"
Auction!
Lin Fan was moved in his heart: "What if I say I want to participate in the auction, then can I enter?"
The security guard laughed: "No, you need to be at least a general manager of a Company to qualify to enter! Bro, it’s not that I look down on you, but take a mirror and look at yourself, you’re a delivery man, what are you using to bid?"
Superiority!
Although he himself cannot afford it, as the security guard of Yunding Manor, he seemingly regarded himself as superior, able to look down on a delivery man just like that.
The conversation between the two was heard by the surrounding people, who turned their heads towards Lin Fan and burst out in laughter.
"This delivery guy seems to want to buy this place!"
"Oh my, where did this fool come from?"
"What do you call this, a toad wanting to eat swan meat, with the heart to live in luxury homes, but the fate of delivering takeout!"
"Do you know what the starting bid for this auction is, 1 billion, how many lifetimes of delivering takeout would just barely earn enough for this money?"
Listening to these ridicules, Lin Fan remained calm.
These ignorant humans indeed!
Only 1 billion, making such a fuss.
It just so happens his money is so abundant now that he doesn’t know how to spend it, so let’s buy a luxury home for fun.
At least a general manager is needed to enter, right, he just happens to have one.
Lin Fan stepped aside and took out his phone: "Da Fu, it’s me, I need you to do something, head to Yunding Manor immediately and help me buy Yunding Manor!"
...
The news of the auction at Yunding Manor spread quickly, becoming a hot topic throughout the city, everyone speculating who the most expensive luxury home in the city would belong to.
The TV station even made a special report on this.
Zhang Dafu was sitting in his office, watching the report, with a face full of envy: "If I could stay at that house even for one night, I could laugh myself awake in sleep, but that’s impossible, it’s too expensive, I don’t even have the qualification to compete, only those super-rich have the qualification to participate in the auction!"
In the end, Zhang Dafu let out a sigh concerning his own poverty.
At this moment, Lin Fan’s call came through.
Zhang Dafu jumped up excitedly: "Boss, what did you say, you want to buy Yunding Manor?"
Lin Fan replied: "That’s right, I’m not convenient to show up, you help me participate in the auction, just be sure not to reveal my identity, let’s keep a low profile."
Those people don’t believe he can buy Yunding Manor, he could completely slap their faces in public, but he has a better idea.
An idea ten times harsher than slapping faces in public!
Zhang Dafu thought for a while, cautiously saying: "Boss, what is your budget, I’ll decide accordingly?"
Lin Fan said boldly: "Don’t decide accordingly, money is not a problem, only success is allowed, no failure!"
Lavish!
Too damn lavish!
Zhang Dafu trembled with excitement: "Understood, boss, I’ll go right away! Secretary, prepare a car for me, I’m heading to Yunding Manor!"
Lin Fan said: "Right, the first thing to do after buying it over, help me fire the security guards at the entrance."
Zhang Dafu didn’t understand why to fire security guards, but he did not ask Lin Fan’s orders, he just followed: "Got it, Boss!"
Lin Fan said: "I still have deliveries to make, hanging up for now."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan returned to the gate, called the customer to have them come out to pick up the meal.
The security guard saw Lin Fan coming back, still showing a disdainful attitude, wholly unaware that his fate had already been controlled by Lin Fan.
At three o’clock in the afternoon, the auction ceremony for Yunding Manor officially began.
The TV station broadcasted live, attracting countless eyes, every street and alley in Yun City had groups of people gathered around the TVs, discussing among themselves.
"I wonder who will buy this luxury house?"
"There aren’t many super-rich in Yun City, they can be counted on one hand, it must be one of them."
"Don’t be so sure, isn’t it possible that a dark horse could appear?"
The auction host announced: "The auction for Yunding Manor officially begins, the starting price is 1 billion, each increment must be no less than 50 million!"
"1 billion 50 million!"
"1 billion 100 million!"
"1 billion 200 million!"
"..."
"1 billion 500 million!"
Intense bidding began, soon the offer boosted to 1 billion 500 million!
The one who offered the high price of 1 billion 500 million was a corpulent, bald middle-aged man, many people in Yun City recognized him, he was Feng Wanshan, the president of Shengshi Group and a well-known billionaire!
Because he liked Yunding Manor very much, Feng Wanshan came in person to attend the auction.
The venue suddenly quieted down.
It seemed Yunding Manor was Feng Wanshan’s!
The host inquired: "1 billion 500 million, does anyone else want to offer a price?"
"I guess there should be no one, who else could be wealthier than Feng Wanshan?"
"As expected, indeed it is one of these billionaires."
"I heard Feng Wanshan was determined to win this, even if someone else wants to bid, they wouldn’t dare offend him!"
Feng Wanshan had a few smug expressions, appearing confident and calm.
Just when everyone thought Feng Wanshan had acquired Yunding Manor.
A hand slowly lifted up.
"1 billion 600 million!"
The whole city was shocked!
Someone still continued to bid!
All eyes instantly fell upon the person making the offer.
Zhang Dafu!

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Mysterious Buyer Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 6: Chapter 6: The Mysterious Buyer Mr. Lin
Not many people know Zhang Dafu, everyone is asking, who is this guy, daring to challenge Feng Wanshan!
Zhang Dafu stood up and said, "Let me introduce myself, my name is Zhang Dafu, and I am here representing my family’s young master, Mr. Lin, to participate in the auction."
Mr. Lin?!
Everyone was curious, who is this Mr. Lin?
No one knew the answer.
Feng Wanshan was furious; he thought Yunding Manor was already his, only to be blindsided by this unexpected competitor.
Who on earth is this Mr. Lin!
"1.7 billion!" Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth, deciding to fight for it.
Zhang Dafu was unwavering: "1.8 billion!"
No way he was giving face to Feng Wanshan; Lin Fan had instructed him to make sure he bought it!
Feng Wanshan shouted, "1.9 billion!"
"2 billion!"
"2.1 billion!"
"2.2 billion!"
Seeing Zhang Dafu keep up closely, Feng Wanshan finally lost his temper and yelled: "I am Feng Wanshan, are you looking for death, can you not compete with me?"
Zhang Dafu chuckled, "I speak for my young master, fair competition for everyone, Boss Feng, are you not convinced? If not, beat me with money!"
Lin Fan’s saying, "money is not an issue," was his confidence.
Feng Wanshan, in a fit of rage, roared, "2.5 billion!"
2.5 billion!
A grand sum, isn’t it!
Everyone was shocked; this was already a sky-high price and Zhang Dafu should surely give up!
Who knew!
"3 billion!"
Zhang Dafu said calmly.
As soon as he said this, the whole city went crazy!
"Damn!"
"3 billion for a mansion, that’s insane!"
"This is a truly astronomical price, absolutely!"
"What an astonishing dark horse!"
Feng Wanshan almost spat blood, pointing at Zhang Dafu and cursing, "Zhang Dafu, are you out of your mind!"
Zhang Dafu calmly replied, "My young master is just that rich and willful, seeing you so inexperienced, haven’t you seen anything like this?"
Feng Wanshan was left speechless, only able to fume.
The host was so excited his voice shook: "3 billion, does anyone want to raise the bid? Mr. Feng, do you want to bid more?"
Feng Wanshan was so angry he was gasping for breath, saying nothing.
The host then said, "3 billion once, 3 billion twice, sold!"
Bang!
The gavel fell!
The mysterious buyer, Mr. Lin, successfully purchased Yunding Manor for 3 billion!
The news spread, shaking the entire Yun City.
Every street and alley discussed it, everyone guessing madly, who exactly is this Mr. Lin?
Various media began frantically digging for information, tracing through every Lin family possible.
Many wealthy people were closely watching, speculating endlessly.
But not a single person could guess Mr. Lin’s true identity, as if he appeared out of nowhere, like a godsend!
Some speculated Mr. Lin might be a legendary hidden tycoon.
Others guessed Mr. Lin’s personal assets might have already exceeded billions!
All kinds of exaggerated speculations filled Yun City in no time.
Mr. Lin quickly gained a nickname recognized by the public.
God of Wealth!
God of Wealth Mr. Lin!
At this time, Feng Wanshan sat paralyzed in his chair, dejected, like a defeated rooster.
He was utterly downcast, who is this Mr. Lin?
"No way, I must find out who you are!" Feng Wanshan muttered through gritted teeth, secretly vowing.
Additionally, after Mr. Lin bought Yunding Manor, a minor thing happened.
The security guard at Yunding Manor was fired.
Upon learning of his dismissal, the guard’s face turned pale, his sense of dignity and high salary vanished in an instant.
The guard cried for mercy, but there was no room for redemption, rumored to be ordered by Mr. Lin himself.
For the rest of his days, he would likely wonder who this Mr. Lin was and how he had offended him.
Meanwhile, as the whole city speculated about Mr. Lin’s identity.
Lin Fan leisurely rode out of an inconspicuous alley on an electric scooter; he had just completed his last delivery of the day and was planning to go home.
"Did you hear? Yunding Manor was bought for 3 billion!"
A passerby exclaimed in surprise.
Immediately, a group of passersby gathered and began to discuss enthusiastically.
That person animatedly described what he saw on TV, so excited it was as if he had bought Yunding Manor himself.
Indeed, at this time, just mentioning Yunding Manor would instantly make you the center of attention, drawing a crowd and gaining a sense of presence you wouldn’t usually enjoy.
If you boasted about knowing Mr. Lin, it would be even more remarkable—your usual indifferent goddess would likely come over for a chat.
Of course, boasting is risky; when the goddess finds out you don’t know Mr. Lin at all, she may never heed you again.
Lin Fan overheard the discussion among passersby and thought to himself, 3 billion, not that much really...
Just then, a call came from Zhang Dafu, prompting Lin Fan to stop and take the call.
"Boss, I’ve already bought Yunding Manor, spent 3 billion; do you think it was too expensive?" Zhang Dafu asked cautiously, even though Lin Fan had said money was not an issue, he still feared Lin Fan might blame him for overspending.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "You worked hard, as long as it’s bought, 3 billion is not expensive at all."
The roadside crowd overheard this, all looking at Lin Fan as if he were crazy.
Then came a wave of ridicule.
Passerby A: "What’s that delivery guy saying, 3 billion isn’t expensive?"
Passerby B: "As if you could afford it, pretending out of your league!"
Passerby C: "Look at this clueless nobody, acting like he’s seen the world!"
"..."
Lin Fan smiled slightly; the mansion was indeed purchased by him, and 3 billion really wasn’t much to him.
Lin Fan saw no need to argue with these passersby, instructing Zhang Dafu: "Dafu, once the formalities are done, just tell me to wire the money."
After hanging up, Lin Fan drove off on his scooter.
At this moment, the roadside TV was still broadcasting live, the camera turned to Zhang Dafu, and the reporter prepared to interview him.
Immediately, the group of passersby was all drawn to it.
Reporter: "Mr. Zhang, would 3 billion for Mr. Lin also be an astronomical figure? Does it need to be paid in installments?"
Zhang Dafu chuckled: "You know nothing of my young master’s wealth, I just talked to him, he said once the formalities are done, just tell him to wire the money!"
The crowd paused for a moment, why did that sound so familiar?
Damn!
Wasn’t that what the delivery guy just said!
Damn!
That delivery guy is Mr. Lin!
All at once, the onlookers’ worldview was overturned, but unfortunately, it was too dark earlier, and most hadn’t even noticed what Lin Fan looked like.
By then, Lin Fan had already disappeared without a trace.
On Lin Fan’s way home, people were talking about Yunding Manor everywhere.
All these people speculated about who Mr. Lin was, without realizing Mr. Lin was riding past them on a scooter...
Lin Fan returned to the apartment he rented, seeing several elderly ladies chatting together, including his landlady, Aunt Li.
They were also discussing Yunding Manor.
Stopping his scooter in the corridor, Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, "Aunt Li, I might be moving out soon, just letting you know."
Aunt Li joked, "Little Fan, are you moving to Yunding Manor?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yes, Auntie, how did you know?"
His words were true, but they obviously didn’t believe him, and the group of elderly ladies burst out laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Group Chat Exploded
chapters.content:
Chapter 7: Chapter 7: The Group Chat Exploded
Right when the whole city was buzzing about Yunding Manor and the mysterious buyer Mr. Lin, another explosive piece of news started to go viral on the internet.
"Shocking! A delivery guy bought out an entire street’s worth of luxury goods in one go!"
An exaggeratedly titled short video quietly began to spread online, amassing tens of millions of views in just half a day.
In the video, a young man in delivery clothes is seen effortlessly swiping his card, emptying all the luxury shops on the street, with the highest single purchase amounting to 10 million!
Unfortunately, the video only captured the delivery guy’s back, so his face couldn’t be seen. It was clearly filmed secretly by someone at the scene.
Those who saw the video were all stirred up.
"Damn, a delivery guy with that much cash?"
"Is this some kind of performance art by a rich second generation?"
"I heard it was an act where a rich second generation pretended to be a delivery guy to woo someone, slapping a gold-digger in the face!"
"So fake, why would someone with that much money be a delivery guy, is this a staged act?"
Some were amazed, others skeptical. Netizens divided into two camps, sparking a heated debate with various speculations emerging.
In a rented room in a city village, Blue Moon receptionist Little Zhang, who was just laid off today, was busy job hunting online.
Her best friend suddenly sent her a short video: "Check out this delivery guy, isn’t he amazing!"
Little Zhang opened the video and blurted out, "It’s him!"
Her friend asked curiously, "You know who he is?"
Little Zhang nodded, her face a bit pale, "It can’t be wrong, he’s the one who spent a hundred million to buy out Blue Moon and got me fired today!"
She really regretted it now. If she had known Lin Fan was such a wealthy person, she wouldn’t have offended him today, and now it’s too late to regret.
Her friend said with deep regret, "How could you have offended him, you’ve made me lose a chance to change my fate, you know!"
Little Zhang broke into a sweat: "What does it have to do with you?"
Her friend replied, "You don’t understand, I’m your best friend. If your fate changes, so does mine. Now that you’ve lost the chance, so have I."
For a moment, it was as if the two had lost a jackpot lottery ticket, and they hugged each other and cried bitterly.
In another apartment complex.
Zhao Xin’er saw the short video and was instantly reminded of the day’s events.
She felt a pang of regret, thinking how wonderful it would have been if she had accepted Lin Fan’s affection today!
Just then, the TV reported on the news about Yunding Manor, saying that Yun City’s most expensive luxury residence, Yunding Manor, had been successfully bought by a mysterious Mr. Lin for a sky-high price of 3 billion!
Mr. Lin!
Zhao Xin’er trembled as if struck by electricity.
"Oh my god, could this Mr. Lin be Lin Fan?"
The thought thrilled her. She’d been nervous all day, not daring to contact Lin Fan; now, suddenly energized, she immediately opened WeChat and sent Lin Fan a message.
"Lin Fan, I really love you, can you forgive me?"
"Dear, I have something very important to tell you, please, can you reply to me?"
Lin Fan always replied to her messages in the blink of an eye before, but this time, after she sent out her messages, Lin Fan didn’t reply for quite a while.
Things really aren’t what they used to be!
She didn’t dare blame Lin Fan even a bit, so she just held onto her phone and started to wait anxiously.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan, who had just returned to his rented room, took a nice shower.
After washing, Lin Fan returned to his bed and half-lay down, noticing his phone constantly vibrating. Upon picking it up, he found out it was the delivery group blowing up.
His colleagues were fervently discussing a short video, and with a casual refresh, there were already 999+ new messages.
"Wow, there’s actually a hidden billionaire in our group! Who could it be?"
"Can anyone recognize him? This back looks so familiar, just can’t pinpoint it!"
"Seriously, even billionaires are competing with us for deliveries?"
"Come on, big shot, show yourself with a sound!"
"Calling the big shot!"
"Calling the big shot!"
"Calling the big shot!"
Lin Fan opened the short video and realized with a bit of sweat, isn’t this me.
He was only showing off today, and it caused such a big uproar!
Lin Fan casually typed a reply.
Send!
"Hi everyone, this person is me."
A brief silence followed in the group, and then a burst of laughter.
"Here he comes, let me see who’s pretending!"
"Hello, is this 110? Someone’s pretending!"
"Come on Lin Fan, give it up, who doesn’t know you’re the king of losers!"
"Bro, get lost, I didn’t even say it was me!"
No one believed Lin Fan.
They quipped about Lin Fan and then promptly forgot about him, continuing their frenzied refresh of 999+ new messages.
Lin Fan sighed helplessly and quietly exited the group chat.
Then Lin Fan noticed Zhao Xin’er had sent him a message.
Zhao Xin’er was asking for forgiveness and begging for his response.
Lin Fan found it a bit funny. Before Zhao Xin’er sent those two messages, it was the message he sent to Zhao Xin’er in the morning.
Coincidentally, he was asking Zhao Xin’er back then too.
"Xin’er, I’m downstairs at your place, I have something important to tell you, please, can you come down to meet me?"
After that, he met Zhao Xin’er and confessed his love, only to be humiliated and dragged to the L.V. store.
Little did he expect, not even a day later, their roles had reversed. Zhao Xin’er had become his puppy, pleading with him instead.
Lin Fan felt no affection for Zhao Xin’er anymore, but out of politeness, he still replied to her: "What’s the matter?"
On the other side, upon receiving Lin Fan’s reply, Zhao Xin’er jumped up in joy: "Oh my god, he replied, he still cares about me!"
She immediately replied: "Lin Fan, I knew you still love me!"
Lin Fan found it a bit speechless. Before, when he liked Zhao Xin’er, as long as Zhao Xin’er replied, he also thought she cared about him. In reality, she was just being polite.
So, this is what it means to be overconfident in a one-sided affection!
Lin Fan didn’t want to waste words with her, so he replied: "I am going to sleep."
Zhao Xin’er hastily replied: "I haven’t asked you yet, that Mr. Lin who spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor, is that you?"
Lin Fan made a sound of surprise; Zhao Xin’er actually guessed it was him!
"Is that all you wanted to ask? You can’t talk three sentences without mentioning money, a true gold-digger through and through. Why was I so blind not to see it before?"
Lin Fan sneered, didn’t reply to Zhao Xin’er, and didn’t even want to keep in touch with such a woman, quickly blocking and deleting her from his contacts.
Throwing the phone aside, he went to sleep.
Zhao Xin’er waited with bated breath for Lin Fan’s reply. If Lin Fan said he was Mr. Lin, she might just go crazy with happiness.
However, after waiting for a long time, Lin Fan didn’t reply. She was anxious to death, pacing around the room, eating and sleeping restlessly.
In the past, she too would wait for ages without replying to Lin Fan; now she somewhat understood how Lin Fan felt in the past, filled with some regret.
If she hadn’t been so cold to Lin Fan before, she could now be the girlfriend of a billionaire.
She couldn’t hold it in any longer and typed a message: "Hey, darling, why aren’t you answering me? Have you fallen asleep?"
Sending failed!
A big red exclamation mark!
"Please add the other party as a friend first."
Zhao Xin’er was petrified; something a thousand times worse than him falling asleep had happened. Lin Fan actually blocked her!
"No!"
Zhao Xin’er immediately let out an earth-shattering scream, shaking the entire building.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: New Reward: The World’s Most Expensive Luxury Car!
chapters.content:
Chapter 8: Chapter 8: New Reward: The World’s Most Expensive Luxury Car!
A new day arrives.
After a night’s sleep, Lin Fan recharged his spirit, finished washing up, had breakfast, and changed into his delivery uniform, ready to go out and deliver food.
Just at that moment.
"Ding!"
"System Reminder!"
"The host can check in for the new day. Today’s check-in reward is an internationally top-tier supercar, a Kosak global limited edition RS Rapid, worth 70 million. Would you like to check in?"
Lin Fan was overjoyed!
Today’s check-in reward is too cool!
Every man has a dream of owning a luxury car, and Lin Fan was no exception. He had obtained his driver’s license a few years ago and had longed for a luxury car for a while but never had the money to buy one. Even if the system didn’t reward him, he would eventually buy a car.
Now with the system’s reward, it’s all settled in one go, saving a lot of trouble!
"Check-in!"
Lin Fan chose to check in without hesitation.
At the same time, he was a bit curious, as the system always asked him whether he wanted to check in, and he wondered what the consequence would be if he chose not to?
There is no answer to that question for now because he couldn’t think of a reason not to check in when there are always rewards!
Just after Lin Fan checked in, there was a flash before his eyes, and a miniature Kosak supercar appeared before him, with exquisite craftsmanship, scientifically arranged buttons, comfortable handling, and it was a perfect piece of art.
This is the car key!
"System Reminder!"
"A Kosak global limited edition RS Rapid has been delivered, parked at a street parking spot near the host’s residence. Please collect it!"
Lin Fan was filled with excitement and quickly took out his phone to look it up.
Kosak, the world’s top luxury car brand, the global limited edition RS Rapid is its latest model, known as the most powerful upgrade in history, with only 3 units worldwide, and Lin Fan owns one of them!
Priced at 70 million, it is currently the most expensive luxury car in the world!
Lin Fan couldn’t wait to catch a glimpse of the car.
At the street parking spot, a large crowd had gathered, seemingly watching something, and it was bustling with excitement.
Unexpectedly, it was an incredibly cool luxury car!
"Whose car is this? It’s so awesome, so flashy!"
"I bet the owner must be a Super Rich Second Generation!"
"No kidding, this is a Kosak, an internationally top-tier supercar, costing at least tens of millions. The average person can’t afford it!"
"I wish I could just sit in it!"
"Everyone be careful, don’t touch or scratch it. If there’s a scratch, it might cost millions to repair!"
"Oh my god, don’t scare me, I can’t afford it even if I work my whole life!"
"Which Super Rich Second Generation got lost and drove the car here?"
At this moment, Lin Fan came over.
"Make way, this car is mine!" Lin Fan shouted.
The crowd immediately parted, looking at Lin Fan in astonishment.
What the heck?
In a blue work uniform, he’s actually a deliveryman?
"You’re kidding, this car is yours? Who are you trying to fool?"
"Young man, you’re so sneaky, just trying to squeeze up and see the luxury car, convincing us to move aside!"
"Watch yourself, don’t act all high and mighty, if you scratch it, you’ll have to pay millions!"
Lin Fan walked up to the Kosak and inspected it, liking it more and more. The futuristic, cool car body and bold color scheme offered a strong and flashy visual impact. He couldn’t resist reaching out to touch the smooth, mirror-like body, feeling very satisfied.
The crowd was worried for him, this delivery guy was too bold to not heed their warning and even dared to touch the car!
"Young man, that’s enough, if your family isn’t wealthy, quickly move on, the owner might come back and beat you up!"
An elderly man couldn’t help but kindly remind him.
Lin Fan smiled: "Don’t worry, no one will beat me up because I am the owner."
As he said this, Lin Fan took out the key and pressed the start button.
The Kosak immediately started up, its headlights shining with diamond-like brilliance, extremely dazzling!
Then, the car doors opened like mechanical wings to the sides, looking as if it was about to take flight, simply too cool!
The entire audience was dumbfounded.
This car actually belonged to this deliveryman right in front of them!
They watched, eyes wide, as Lin Fan bent down and got into the luxury car, which then sped away like a swift wind.
The crowd remained unable to recover for a long time as their minds were thoroughly shocked.
Delivering food in a supercar worth millions?
Do rich people nowadays all like to play like this!
The elderly man shook his head and sighed: "Is it that I’m old, or has this world gone mad?"
Lin Fan was sitting in the Kosak at this time, experiencing the top-tier luxury car for the first time.
Kosak, worthy of being the world’s top-tier supercar, drove like a dream, with its domineering and cool looks. Driving it on the street, the head-turning rate was practically a hundred percent.
Every passerby was almost bound to stop and watch wherever it passed, with continuous exclamations of praise, gasps, and screams.
The girls who saw it all without exception fell in love: "So handsome!"
Driving a good car was addictive, Lin Fan couldn’t bear to stop after driving for a while and planned to keep going until he’d looped around Yun City.
But this idea was quickly interrupted by a call from the station manager.
"Lin Fan, do you even know what time it is, why aren’t you at work yet?"
"You’re late every other day, are you trying to get fired!"
"Do you know someone complained about you again yesterday, saying you delayed and made their food go cold!"
"You get back here immediately!"
From the other end of the phone came the station owner’s wife’s shrewish roar.
"Complaint?"
Lin Fan acknowledged. It must be that Zhao Gang, who he kicked out of Blue Moon, and now tried to avenge by making a complaint.
This hurt Lin Fan essentially zero.
The Meituan delivery station where Lin Fan worked was run by a couple. The station manager was a good person and took good care of Lin Fan. When Lin Fan occasionally arrived late or was complained about, they didn’t make a big deal out of it.
But the boss’s wife was a real tigress, and if any delivery person under her made even a slight mistake, she’d definitely scold them badly if she found out.
The delivery guys were all pretty scared of her and secretly called her the tigress.
Only Lin Fan never took her seriously. She did her scolding; he did his own thing, so the boss’s wife particularly disliked Lin Fan.
If it weren’t for the manager’s numerous interventions, the boss’s wife would’ve fired Lin Fan long ago.
After hanging up, the boss’s wife wasn’t satisfied and continued to curse: "Today, I’m definitely going to fire this scoundrel, nobody should stop me!"
The manager sat nearby, silently taking a drag on his cigarette without saying a word.
This time Lin Fan was indeed a bit much. Customer service had said a customer complained that yesterday, when Lin Fan delivered an order to Blue Moon, not only was the food cold, but he also insulted the customer, and the headquarters demanded Lin Fan be fired and docked one month’s salary.
The station manager didn’t dare tell his wife about this; he wanted to help Lin Fan keep this month’s salary, knowing that the kid’s family situation wasn’t easy either.
The station’s delivery men didn’t dare speak up for Lin Fan; they also thought Lin Fan asked for it himself.
"Lin Fan is so naive, knowing the boss’s wife doesn’t like him, yet still dares to be late."
"I always said, he is so carefree, he won’t last!"
"Does he think his family owns a mine, to be so willful!"
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a pleasant engine roar outside drew everyone’s gaze, and they saw a wildly cool and stunning supercar roaring to a stop at the station’s entrance.
Under everyone’s astonished gaze, the Kosak’s wing-like doors opened, and Lin Fan stepped out of the car!

chapters.title: Chapter 9 Practice
chapters.content:
Chapter 9: Chapter 9 Practice
Everyone in the store was stunned, mouths agape, internally filled with: ???
"Is this Lin Fan? Lin Fan driving a supercar?"
"This supercar is a Kosak, I heard it’s one of the world’s top?"
"Could Lin Fan be a super rich second generation!"
"Am I awake, is this really not an illusion?"
The manager remained composed, being the first to react: "Lin Fan, is this car yours? How did you get to drive a supercar?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Looks like I can’t hide my identity anymore, so I’ll come clean with you all. I’m actually a rich second generation."
Everyone was shocked.
The store owner quivered: "What, Lin Fan, you’re really a rich second generation?"
The manager, curious: "You’re a rich second generation? Then why are you out delivering takeouts?"
Lin Fan sighed: "I originally didn’t want to inherit the family business, so I ran out to work. Recently, I’ve been forced by my family to take over the inheritance, sigh, I can’t help it, even though I strongly opposed, they still insisted on giving me billions and this car."
Everyone knelt in unison, their hearts roaring.
You gotta be kidding, we’re all dying of envy here, you’re not happy to inherit billions, driving luxury cars seems to aggrieve you?
Is this how the rich second generation world shows off!
"Brother Fan, how much did this car cost you?" one colleague curiously asked.
Lin Fan said, "Not expensive, just 70 million."
Hiss~
Everyone inhaled sharply.
Once again, neatly knelt on the ground.
Look at this understated demeanor, listen to this casual show-off.
If he’s not a rich second generation, who is!
No one questioned it anymore, Lin Fan really is a super rich second generation!
"Brother Fan, you’re so cool!"
"Brother Fan has always been cool, but today you’re extraordinarily cool!"
"Brother Fan, do you take on followers? Please accept my kneeling!"
A group of colleagues paid homage, seeming to have forgotten that before Lin Fan arrived, they were complaining about him.
The manager sighed inwardly; no wonder Lin Fan has always been rather unruly, everyone else fears the store owner, but Lin Fan never does, turns out he’s always had an escape plan.
Once thought the joke about falling back on billions was just that, didn’t expect it to be true for Lin Fan.
The manager sighed again, saying, "Lin Fan, this means you probably won’t work here anymore, right?"
Everyone thought the same, having inherited the family fortune, is there still need to work as a takeout delivery person!
Lin Fan said, "Not really, for one, I’m reluctant to leave everyone, and for another, I don’t have any other job now, so I want to continue doing this."
What?
Lin Fan still wants to continue working?
The manager said, "Personally, I’m very willing for you to continue, but the store owner just said, she’s already decided to fire you..."
"Nonsense!"
The store owner abruptly interrupted the manager, startling him.
The store owner then cheerfully smiled at Lin Fan: "Little Fan, don’t listen to his nonsense, I’ve never planned to fire you, I’ve always really admired you."
Everyone broke out in sweat.
Store owner, you were just scolding Lin Fan, how come you’ve turned into a sycophant now?
Sure enough, money makes the mare go!
Lin Fan said, "Store owner, you just called saying someone complained about me..."
The store owner quickly said, "That didn’t happen! It was that guy causing an uproar, how can you be blamed, Little Fan? Come in quickly, have a seat, the commute to work must have been tiring, I’ll pour you a cup of tea."
The store owner enthusiastically ushered Lin Fan into the store and personally poured him tea, respectfully, like a maid.
The scene amused everyone.
This is what you call changing from arrogance to subservience!
The manager felt a bit awkward and had to reveal the truth: "Ahem, well, yesterday a customer complained about Lin Fan, saying not only the food was cold, but Lin Fan also cursed at them, headquarters has decided to let Lin Fan go."
The store owner was momentarily stunned, then angrily said, "Look at the nonsense you’re spouting, what the hell does headquarters know, I don’t care, Lin Fan must not be fired, I don’t care what you have to do, sort it out with headquarters for me!"
"Alright then." The manager wiped his cold sweat, never imagined in his wildest dreams that the store owner would reverse to defend Lin Fan.
Of course, Lin Fan is now a super rich second generation, the owner isn’t foolish, there’s no reason not to cling onto such a big tree.
Sometimes, the opportunity to change fate only comes once; miss this chance, and it’s gone forever.
The store owner would love to tie Lin Fan to the store with a rope if she could.
"Little Fan, you should feel at ease working here in the future, work as long as you want, even not working is fine, as long as you’re here." The owner cheerfully said.
Lin Fan was speechless; the store owner, usually fierce and intimidating, suddenly became so nice, he really felt a bit unaccustomed.
"Ah!"
Suddenly, a buddy nearby shouted.
The store owner was instantly angry: "What are you shouting for?"
The buddy said, "I suddenly remembered, yesterday a video circulated in the group, showing a delivery person buying out an entire street’s luxury goods, could it possibly be Brother Fan?"
The store owner slapped her thigh: "Right, I forgot, Little Fan, was it you?"
Lin Fan sighed: "Who else could it be but me."
"Wow, it’s really Brother Fan!"
"I said last night, it looked like Brother Fan, only Brother Fan has such a handsome silhouette."
"Brother Fan, we finally found you, it was so exhausting searching for you!"
Lin Fan broke out in sweat; he had already mentioned in the group last night it was him, but these guys didn’t believe him yesterday, not his fault.
The store owner cheerfully said: "So, Little Fan, why did you buy the whole street, someone said it was to counter gold diggers, is it true?"
Lin Fan didn’t want to bring up Zhao Xin’er, so casually said: "No, I was just worried about not knowing how to spend money, so I practiced."
Everyone inhaled sharply!
Buying out an entire street’s luxury goods, just practice!
This is devastating!
The store owner was almost moved to tears, wishing those funds had been hers, smiled, and said: "Little Fan, where do you plan to practice next time, why don’t I give you a suggestion?"
She’s been wanting to expand this delivery station, just lacked funds, now seeing Lin Fan as a big tree, she instantly got a small scheme.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Well, I don’t know right now."
The store owner smiled: "No worries, Little Fan, take your time to think, as long as you continue working here."
She’s planned it out, to do everything possible to please Lin Fan, treat him like an ancestor, comfortable serving him, not worried about no return.
Lin Fan wasn’t foolish, the store owner’s little scheme he saw through at a glance, but he didn’t really mind.
While chatting between the owner and Lin Fan, the delivery workers all took out their phones, eagerly started taking photos, uploading to the group.
After last night’s excitement, the takeout group had calmed down, but instantly exploded again.
"Wow, why suddenly so many photos of luxury cars?"
"Isn’t this a Kosak! And it’s the latest model, seems to be 70 million!"
"Gosh, 70 million, scared me stupid!"
"Where did you guys get these photos?"
Seeing these exclamations, Lin Fan’s colleagues felt at ease.
"You’d never guess whose car this is."
"Remember the delivery guy who bought an entire street, we already know who it is!"
"That delivery guy is the owner of this car, right now he’s beside us!"
Their words immediately sparked the group’s infinite curiosity, the members all knelt.
"Bro, please, quickly tell us!"
"Begging, kneel to a few bros!"
"Bang bang bang, may good people live peacefully!"
Lin Fan’s colleagues, for a moment, felt like big shots, received countless flattery, seized a moment to show off.
Once they enjoyed enough, they revealed the mystery.
In an instant, the entire group became lively to near paralysis.
In just half an hour, all delivery workers in Yun City knew, the delivery guy who bought the entire street of luxury goods, named Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Infatuated Young Lady Chen Lingling
chapters.content:
Chapter 10: Chapter 10: Infatuated Young Lady Chen Lingling
Even though the boss’s wife treated Lin Fan like a god of wealth and didn’t care if he worked or not, for Lin Fan, not working would mean losing the reason to stay.
Lin Fan quickly received an order; someone in Lijing District had ordered a delivery with a rush request, and the note read: Struggling on the brink of starvation.
This customer seems a bit cute.
Lin Fan hadn’t taken his electric bike out today, and going back to get it would be too time-consuming, so he simply decided to deliver using the Kosak.
Delivering food with a world-class supercar!
His colleagues were stunned; if they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t have believed it.
The boss’s wife beamed with joy, "Little Fan, drive slowly, and call anytime if you need anything. I’m here for you!"
After Lin Fan left,
a group of employees were busy showing off online. They had just caused a stir in the delivery group and were planning to boast on their social media next.
The boss’s wife, seeing this, shouted loudly, "What are you guys standing around for? Get to work! Do you think you can be like Little Fan? Remember, my kindness is only for him!"
The group of employees, chastised harshly, scattered like birds.
The station manager, seeing this, smiled wryly. The boss’s wife now valued Lin Fan so much, it gave him a bit of a headache figuring out how to convince headquarters to keep Lin Fan.
Yun City Restaurant.
As usual, there was a group of delivery drivers waiting to pick up orders.
But unlike usual, they were all fervently discussing one person, Lin Fan.
"Is Lin Fan really a billionaire?"
"This guy really hid it well, you couldn’t tell at all normally!"
"Yeah, feels a bit unreal, maybe it’s just someone with the same name!"
"Sounds like bragging, seeing is believing, listening is misleading!"
Just then, the Kosak roared over and stopped in front of them, revealing Lin Fan.
The crowd exploded!
"Whoa, Lin Fan, it’s really you!"
"You can’t just call him Lin Fan, call him Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan, I’m sorry, I apologize!"
"Brother Fan, you look amazing today!"
Someone actually delivered food using a supercar!
Employees from the restaurant ran out to watch, all amazed by this sight.
Even a group of passersby came to join the fun.
In this situation, not showing off a bit wouldn’t suffice.
Lin Fan cleared his throat and said loud and clear, "Everyone, don’t mind my handsome appearance or my billion-dollar fortune. Right now, I’m just a delivery guy, whether I’m driving a supercar or an electric bike, my only principle is to serve the customer!"
The crowd applauded and praised him.
"Well said!"
"Good job, young man, such positivity!"
"He’s rich, humble, and really handsome!"
The restaurant’s young ladies instantly became fans of Lin Fan.
Amidst the praise, Lin Fan took his order, drove off like the wind, leaving behind a dashingly impressive figure.
Everyone watched the Kosak disappear into the distance, unable to calm down. Today’s scene was something they could brag about for a long time.
On the way to Lijing District, the weather took a turn for the worse, and a sudden heavy rain began.
Normally, if it were Lin Fan on his electric bike, he’d be scrambling to find shelter from the rain, but now, comfortably seated in the driver’s seat, he was unfazed by the storm, whizzing through the rain.
What a good feeling!
The security guard at Lijing District saw a flashy cool car approaching, opened the gate without asking, and ran out in the rain to salute Lin Fan.
Anyone driving such a car was obviously wealthy and noble; they dared not show any neglect.
This made Lin Fan recall how, in the past, he’d been given a hard time by security when riding his electric bike; what a world of difference.
Being rich feels great!
The car drove smoothly into the district and parked in an open-air parking space.
Lin Fan took the delivery, following the address on the delivery note, headed to building 4, and took the elevator straight to the 6th floor.
Room 603.
Lin Fan knocked on the door, "Hello, Miss Chen, your delivery is here!"
A girl’s voice answered from inside, "Coming!"
A patter of hurried footsteps approached, and the door opened.
A very cute girl, even cuter than Lin Fan imagined, probably around twenty, with a round face, a ponytail, wearing a light yellow dress, looking like she walked straight out of a comic book—a perfect ten in cuteness, overall a score above 90.
Lin Fan handed over the delivery, "Here’s your delivery, please take it."
The moment the girl saw Lin Fan, her face suddenly blushed, and her heart raced, wow, this delivery boy is so handsome, how could there be such a handsome delivery boy, it’s truly surprising.
Lin Fan was indeed handsome, and you have to admit, money is the greatest confidence; ever since he was rewarded with billions in cash, his confidence and composure naturally exuded, making his charm increase exponentially.
Sweeping countless girls off their feet, it’s not a dream.
The girl shyly took the delivery, "Thank you."
Lin Fan nodded, about to turn and leave.
"Um... handsome brother, can I ask you for a favor?" The girl suddenly called out to Lin Fan, her face flushed, as if she had mustered great courage.
Lin Fan asked curiously, "What is it?"
The girl bit her lip and said, "It’s like this, I just moved here and tried to assemble my bed but couldn’t manage after a long time. Could you help me?"
A delivery guy is a jack-of-all-trades; there’s no drain they can’t unclog, no bed they can’t assemble, and they usually try to meet customers’ additional requests.
But Lin Fan was an exception, he only delivered food, and he coolly refused, "I’m sorry, miss, you can call a handyman, I’m just a delivery guy, this isn’t within my service range."
The girl said dejectedly, "I did call them, but they said they can’t come until tomorrow because of the rain, but I’m so tired and really want to sleep, handsome brother, could you help me please?"
The girl had a very good attitude, always politely pleading; Lin Fan was someone who was moved by kindness, "Alright, let me take a look."
The girl immediately became happy, "Great, please come in, handsome brother."
Lin Fan followed the girl inside; the place was indeed newly set up, with little furniture and some unpacked luggage stacked on the floor.
The room was cluttered with disassembled bed parts, a mess of an attempt that showed she tried her best, just couldn’t assemble it right.
For Lin Fan, this was no difficult task; he picked up the tools and started assembling.
The girl watched Lin Fan’s nimble movements, stars in her eyes.
The focus of a boy is so charming, especially this handsome brother himself is a real stunner, oh my, he’s just so dashing!
The girl gathered her courage, "By the way, my name is Chen Lingling, what’s your name, handsome brother?"
"Lin Fan."
Chen Lingling sweetly smiled, "Brother Lin... Thank you for helping me."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "You’re welcome, it will be done soon, you can go eat now, weren’t you on the brink of starving?"
Chen Lingling blushed with embarrassment, "I just wrote that carelessly, um, I’ll go eat now, thank you, brother."
With that, Chen Lingling ran out to eat; she was indeed very hungry.
As a girl, she had a small appetite, and soon returned satisfied. Upon entering the room, she saw a fully assembled bed by Lin Fan!
Chen Lingling was delighted, "Brother, you’re amazing!"
Lin Fan, turning to look at her, asked, "Do you want to try it out?"

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Slapping the Face of the Audi Owner
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11: Slapping the Face of the Audi Owner
Lin Fan was worried that the bed might not be securely installed, so he casually asked Chen Lingling to try it out, considering he wasn’t a professional installer.
His words were unintended, but they were taken seriously; Chen Lingling thought Lin Fan had some ulterior motive, and her face instantly turned red.
Here comes the fun part.
Although Chen Lingling thought so, she surprisingly didn’t refuse and really climbed onto the bed!
She even rolled around on it a few times.
She couldn’t help it; a request from the incredibly handsome Brother Lin was hard to resist.
"Hmm, Brother, this bed is really well installed," Chen Lingling said shyly.
Lin Fan nodded with satisfaction: "That’s good, I can leave now."
Saying so, Lin Fan was about to head out.
Chen Lingling was stunned; just like that? Was Brother really just leaving?
Didn’t he have that kind of intention?
Suddenly, Chen Lingling realized she had misunderstood Lin Fan earlier, but somehow she felt a little disappointed. She wished Brother was a bit more mischievous...
"Brother!" Chen Lingling called out to Lin Fan once again.
Lin Fan asked, "Do you have something else you need me to install?"
Chen Lingling replied, "No... Brother, could you also come up here for a moment? I want to... test the weight of two people."
