Lin Fan was taken aback; was it because he’s too charming, or are girls these days just this bold? Are they sure they’re not trying to tempt him? His resistance is very low!
"Since you’ve made this request, sure, the bed I installed, I’ll be responsible until the end."
Lin Fan walked over and sat down at the edge of the bed.
The two of them on the bed, it was still very stable.
Lin Fan tried moving around a bit and smiled: "Looks like my craftsmanship is not bad; are you satisfied now?"
Beside him came the sound of peaceful slumber, and turning his head, he saw the young lady curled up, already asleep. Her loose dress couldn’t hide her perfect figure, and her sleeping face was as charming as a ripe apple, extremely adorable.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but praise; what a cartoonishly beautiful girl she is.
However, he had to tease, this girl really has nerve. With a strange man sharing the room, she falls asleep so easily. Isn’t she afraid he’d do something bad to her?
Maybe she was genuinely too tired.
Lin Fan felt a bit tender-hearted. On a rainy day, it’s easy to catch cold; he saw a blanket on the chair nearby, got off the bed, and went over to cover Chen Lingling with it.
Then, Lin Fan walked out, locked the door from the inside, turned and left, leaving a dashing silhouette behind.
The delivery guy is just like that, handsome and kind-hearted, charitable, accomplishing a task and departing with grace, hiding his merits and fame.
Delivery, after the rain, the sky clears, and the air is fresh.
Arriving downstairs, Lin Fan walked towards his car.
As he was walking, a beautiful woman came towards him; long hair cascading down her shoulders, with big sparkling eyes. She wore a shirt on top and a short skirt below, showcasing a pair of stunning long legs, exuding an intellectual charm, undoubtedly a 90-point beauty.
Under normal circumstances, no matter how beautiful a woman is, Lin Fan would at most take a couple more glances and move on.
But fate works in mysterious ways.
Just then, an Audi drove past the beauty, and since it had rained, there was a puddle by the roadside. The car wheels splashed water, covering those long, fair legs with mud spots.
An absolute waste of beauty!
The beauty was furious: "Get lost, driving without watching where you’re going!"
Screech!
The Audi stopped, and a man got out of the car, pointing at the beauty and cursing: "Bitch, who are you telling to get lost? Do you believe I’ll hit you?"
The beauty fumed, although she was splashed with muddy water, the driver didn’t apologize and even wanted to hit her. Driving an Audi and acting so arrogantly!
"What are you doing, want to hit a woman?"
Lin Fan stepped forward protectively in front of the beauty, coldly looking at the Audi guy.
Seeing him, the Audi guy laughed; he thought it was just a delivery person daring to stand up to him?
"You, a damned delivery guy, trying to be a hero to save the beauty? Ask yourself first, do you have the qualifications? Get lost!"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Why can’t a delivery guy help someone? Just because you drive an Audi, you can bully others?"
The Audi guy laughed arrogantly, pretending he was about to rush forward.
Lin Fan quickly kicked out, hitting the Audi guy in the belly, causing him to stagger back, and with a bang, crash into the Audi.
The car body immediately had a dent.
The Audi guy suffered a great loss; he was furious: "You damn pauper, how dare you kick me? Do you know who I am?"
Lin Fan said: "Yes, I do, you’re an idiot."
The Audi guy was livid: "Talking to me lowers my status; see this car? Brand new, first-hand 490,000; can you afford it? If not, you don’t have the qualification to talk to me, understand? You damn delivery person!"
Lin Fan heard this, and laughed lightly.
"I thought you had something impressive; isn’t it just a car? I also have one."
The Audi guy was momentarily stunned, then burst out laughing: "You damned delivery person, I bet you certainly have a car, an electric bike, right?"
The Audi guy laughed heartily.
This commotion attracted some nearby strolling residents to gather around; a courier and the Audi guy are having a conflict?
Not saying anything else, it looks like the Audi guy is wealthier than this delivery guy, right? In terms of money, the delivery guy loses badly.
"Bro, don’t waste words with this kind of person, let’s go."
The beauty advised, Lin Fan had already kicked the Audi guy once for her, and she felt quite relieved.
Regarding this handsome and kind delivery guy, the beauty’s affection level had skyrocketed. Comparing male charm, he outpaces the Audi guy by miles; in terms of looks, Lin Fan is ten thousand miles ahead, but now comparing him financially with the Audi guy, he definitely isn’t richer, and she doesn’t want him to lose.
"Cursing me and kicking me, now you want to run?"
The Audi guy sneered, blocking their path.
Lin Fan reassured the beauty: "It’s okay, I really do have a car."
The beauty thought Lin Fan was just being defiant; apart from this, he’s great, but he seems to have a bit too much pride, which could make him lose face.
"Where’s your car?" The beauty scoldingly questioned, as she reached out to take Lin Fan’s hand, wanting to drag him away.
The Audi guy saw this, feeling smug: "Run, why run? Delivery guy, don’t you have a car? Show me then, where’s your broken electric bike parked?"
Lin Fan smiled calmly: "Since you insist, I might as well show you."
The Audi guy laughed: "I’m waiting, hahaha..."
Everyone thought Lin Fan was going to be terribly embarrassed; comparing cars wasn’t something he should have done, it was asking for trouble!
The beauty couldn’t help but put her hand on her forehead; she was embarrassed for Lin Fan.
Just then, Lin Fan leisurely took out his car key and pressed start.
Beep beep!
A few meters away, the ultra-cool Kosak’s headlights instantly lit up.
With a futuristic sci-fi feel, the car doors opened like wings, exuding an aura of soaring high.
"Ah?"
A chorus of exclamations erupted, with everyone staring in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Being Tracked
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12: Being Tracked
Everyone inside was like, "What the hell!"
Is this not an illusion?
The delivery guy actually has a car, and it’s an expensive supercar!
They were just thinking of laughing at the delivery guy, and now the slap in the face comes quick and hard, it hurts!
The Audi guy’s jaw almost dropped in shock.
"Is... is this yours?"
The Audi guy stammered, completely incredulous.
The beautiful girl who noticed something was off removed her hand from her forehead and was also stunned.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "If it’s not mine, is it yours?"
While talking, Lin Fan walked towards the Kosak.
The Audi guy was petrified, utterly shocked. He felt like his world had been turned upside down. How could this be? A delivery guy actually owns a supercar.
He was quite knowledgeable about cars, and this Kosak is an internationally top-tier supercar brand, costing no less than 50 million!
His Audi was less than 500,000, a hundred times less!
But the beautiful girl was utterly delighted.
The little brother didn’t lie to her; he wasn’t just handsome and kind, but also really rich, mega-rich!
But why is the little brother still a delivery man?
No need to ask; the little brother must just be keeping a low profile. The little brother is simply a low-key, unpretentious billionaire!
An understated millionaire who is both dashing and righteous!
The beautiful girl’s affection for Lin Fan skyrocketed by 10,000+ points.
"Little brother, wait!"
The beautiful girl ran to the car, leaned on the window, and said, "What’s your name, little brother?"
Lin Fan replied, "Lin Fan."
The beautiful girl smiled, "My name is Liu Mengjie. Little brother, shall we add each other on WeChat?"
Lin Fan said, "Okay."
No choice, being too handsome means everyone adores you.
After adding Liu Mengjie on WeChat, Lin Fan started the Kosak, and with an eye-catching drift, the flashy supercar sped away like lightning.
Liu Mengjie hugged her phone, looking at Lin Fan’s WeChat profile picture, feeling like she found a treasure, as happy as a child.
The Audi guy snapped out of his shock, saw that Lin Fan had already driven away, and angrily kicked the car, worsening the dent it already had.
The Audi guy felt heartache and hatred for Lin Fan, gritting his teeth, "Darn kid, I won’t let this go!"
Block 4, Room 603.
Chen Lingling had a dream, dreaming that she and Lin Fan were having a grand wedding on the most beautiful island in the world, with Lin Fan putting a ring on her finger—her happiest moment in life.
She woke up laughing.
Upon waking, she found herself covered with a blanket, but Lin Fan was already gone.
Brother Lin actually covered her with a blanket; how gentle, how considerate.
She blushed deeply.
She couldn’t believe she fell asleep, would Brother Lin do anything embarrassing to her while she was asleep?
But she quickly realized that besides covering her with a blanket, Brother Lin did nothing else.
A conflicted feeling arose.
"What’s wrong with me? I’m a good girl who has always been careful, haven’t even held hands with a guy, so why am I completely undefended against Brother Lin, and why do I even hope Brother Lin would be a bad guy? It’s all Brother Lin’s fault for being too handsome, this damned charm almost makes me lost."
Remembering the dream wedding, Chen Lingling blushed again, lost in thought.
However, Brother Lin is just a delivery man, shouldn’t have so much money for such a grand wedding. But whatever, as long as she’s with Brother Lin, even a modest wedding would make her blissfully happy.
She’s just an easily satisfied person.
She suddenly realized that Brother Lin was the love at first sight she’d been searching for.
A strong impulse drove her out of bed, and she ran out; she had to find Brother Lin.
When she ran downstairs, she happened to see Lin Fan driving the flashy supercar and drifting away beautifully.
"Ah!"
Chen Lingling was utterly shocked.
So Brother Lin, who appeared to be a delivery man, was actually so wealthy!
She was wrong; it seems that the grand wedding in the dream is actually possible with Brother Lin!
In an instant, she felt like she had fallen into a whirlpool, unable to escape, a whirlpool called Lin Fan.
...
Lin Fan left the Lijing District, and didn’t continue taking orders, instead heading directly back home to switch back to the electric bike.
Driving a supercar for delivery is indeed showy, but deliveries often require weaving through streets and alleys, so an electric bike is more convenient.
Arriving near the apartment, parking the car, Lin Fan walked back to the apartment, intending to get his electric bike.
Underneath the apartment, Lin Fan ran into his landlady, Aunt Li, who mysteriously pulled him aside.
Aunt Li lowered her voice and asked, "Little Fan, have you recently owed money to someone?"
Lin Fan replied, "Auntie, why do you ask?"
Aunt Li said, "A stranger was sneaking around earlier, asking me for your information, like an investigation, but I just glossed over and sent him away."
Lin Fan murmured, someone is investigating me, who could it be?
The person most eager to know Lin Fan’s identity would be Shengshi Group’s boss, Feng Wanshan.
Yesterday, Feng Wanshan failed to bid for Yunding Manor, which was snatched away by a mysterious Mr. Lin at a sky-high price of 3 billion.
Feng Wanshan was bitter and swore to find out who this Mr. Lin was.
The subordinates sent for investigation returned to report.
"Mr. Feng, after two days of investigation, we’ve found this Mr. Lin!"
Feng Wanshan was thrilled, "Quick, tell me!"
The subordinate said, "We tracked down Zhang Dafu and found that his Blue Moon Company was bought by a super-rich second-generation named Lin Fan for 100 million in cash. This happened the same day at noon as the Yunding Manor auction, after which Zhang Dafu was appointed by Lin Fan as Blue Moon’s general manager. It’s reasonable to believe that Zhang Dafu was the one bidding for Yunding Manor on behalf of Lin Fan."
Feng Wanshan frowned, "Lin Fan? Super-rich second-generation? Why haven’t I heard of him, what’s his background?"
An unknown figure actually took his Yunding Manor!
The subordinate said, "Well... we only found out Lin Fan is a delivery man from a small place, renting a very ordinary apartment, but clearly, these are all facades. His true identity is still unclear."
"What?" Feng Wanshan was flabbergasted, "He’s actually a delivery guy, what’s he up to?"
The subordinate wiped sweat, "Maybe he’s experiencing life, with these super-rich second-generations, you never know what they’re thinking."
Feng Wanshan was speechless, pondering for a while, "How can you be sure Lin Fan is definitely that Mr. Lin?"
The subordinate said, "This Lin Fan recently has been quite high profile, spending money like water. Not only did he acquire Blue Moon, but he also reportedly lavishly bought out an entire street of luxury goods."
Feng Wanshan shook his head, "All of this only adds up to 200 million, not even in the same ballpark as 3 billion."
The subordinate asked, "What does Mr. Feng mean?"
Feng Wanshan said, "This Mr. Lin is so mysterious, he wouldn’t be so easily found by you. I’m sure this Lin Fan is just a decoy too. The real Mr. Lin must be someone else, someone with an astonishing identity!"
This conjecture from Feng Wanshan sent cold sweat dripping down the subordinate’s back.
Feng Wanshan thought for a moment and said, "Keep investigating, make sure to unmask this Mr. Lin, and inform me immediately when there’s news!"

chapters.title: Chapter 13 Hiring a Housekeeper
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13 Hiring a Housekeeper
How could Lin Fan know that Feng Wanshan had imagined his identity to be so extraordinary?
The day he bought Yunding Manor under the name "Mr. Lin" was just to maintain a low profile...
Lin Fan went home, changed to his electric scooter, planning to continue delivering food, when he suddenly received a call from Zhang Dafu.
"Boss, the handover procedures for Yunding Manor are completed. You just need to make the payment and sign. Do you have time to come over to Yunding Manor now?"
Lin Fan said, "Okay, I’ll head over."
Yunding Manor was very quiet today.
The outside of the manor was deserted, not a single car in sight. Since the manor changed hands, it had temporarily become an unoccupied residence.
The security guards at the gate had also been replaced.
Seeing Lin Fan coming on an electric scooter, the security guard didn’t dare slack off at all, immediately opened the gate, and respectfully welcomed Lin Fan, completely opposite to the last arrogant security guard.
This new security guard was temporarily hired by Zhang Dafu, who specifically instructed not to neglect Lin Fan.
Lin Fan finally smoothly entered Yunding Manor.
Although he was already the owner of Yunding Manor, it was still his first time entering the manor.
In front, a garden with artificial hills, ponds, pavilions, and terraces appeared, resembling a royal garden, with a meticulously arranged design. A mansion akin to a royal palace towered above, exuding two words, nobility!
Lin Fan was very satisfied with this place, 3 billion was absolutely worth it.
In front of the mansion, he finally saw two cars.
Zhang Dafu and a man in a suit stood at the mansion’s entrance, waiting to greet Lin Fan.
"Boss, you’re finally here." Zhang Dafu greeted with a full smile and respectfully approached him.
"Let me introduce, this is Mr. He Ming, the person in charge of the auction house. And this is my boss, Mr. Lin Fan."
He Ming was quite surprised that the one who spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor turned out to be a delivery guy, and so young?
This world is crazy!
However, being experienced, he calmly shook hands with Lin Fan and said, "Mr. Lin, hello, please follow me."
They then entered the house.
Inside, the mansion was wide and bright, glittering and luxurious, with all the furniture being top world brands, which were also part of the auction, now all belonging to Lin Fan.
Two words, comfortable!
The life of the rich, so unpretentiously lavish...
He Ming took out the contract for Lin Fan to look over.
After Lin Fan found no issues, he signed, and then paid the auction house 3 billion, officially becoming the owner of Yunding Manor.
Seeing Lin Fan pay 3 billion without batting an eye, He Ming was even more amazed, this young man is impressive, how rich is he really?
"Mr. Lin, congratulations on becoming the owner of Yunding Manor. Here’s the property deed, please keep it safe."
He Ming said with a smile, handing over the brand-new property deed to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan glanced at it, with his personal details on the deed.
Although it was expected, at the moment of formally owning Yunding Manor, Lin Fan still felt very excited.
Lin Fan then said, "Mr. He, I would like to keep a low profile, so I hope you can keep my identity a secret."
He Ming said solemnly, "Rest assured, Mr. Lin, without your permission, your information will be absolutely confidential."
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s good."
He Ming stood up, "If there’s nothing else, I won’t disturb you anymore, goodbye."
Lin Fan also stood up, "I’ll see you out, Mr. He."
Outside the house, He Ming got into a car and left.
Now that Yunding Manor was Lin Fan’s, he could use it as he pleased and could come to live there whenever he wanted.
Lin Fan had already begun planning to move into Yunding Manor.
However, before moving into Yunding Manor, some preparations were needed.
Lin Fan said, "Dafu, help me put out an announcement for recruiting a butler for Yunding Manor."
Zhang Dafu replied, "Okay, boss, do you have any requirements for this butler?"
Lin Fan said, "Just one requirement, the butler needs to manage Yunding Manor so I can live comfortably. No other requirements."
Zhang Dafu said, "Got it, boss, I’ll do it right away."
Later that day, a message spread across Yun City.
After Yunding Manor changed owners, it publicly recruited a butler!
As long as one could handle the butler’s duties, gender and age didn’t matter!
This announcement caused an uproar across Yun City.
The butler of Yunding Manor, it was a position so enviable that it could make one vomit blood from jealousy. Just being the butler would allow one to live in the most luxurious mansion in all of Yun City!
Who doesn’t want to live in Yunding Manor!
Not to mention the butler, even the people sweeping the floors in Yunding Manor would attract innumerable applicants!
What excited many was that this butler position had no specific requirements, meaning anyone could apply!
For a moment, countless people were eager to try.
Shengshi Group, Chairman’s Office.
Feng Wanshan, upon hearing this news, jumped up in excitement, "I must get this butler position!"
Of course, it’s not that he wanted to apply personally, but he intended to place someone inside Yunding Manor. As long as the butler was his person, finding out who the mysterious Mr. Lin was would be no problem!
Feng Wanshan thought his idea was brilliant and couldn’t help but burst into a fit of laughter in his office.
It was nightfall.
Lin Fan finished a day’s work and returned to his place.
At the entrance of the small shop at the street corner, a group of old men and women were chatting excitedly.
"I heard Yunding Manor is recruiting a butler. I’m thinking about applying, what do you all think?"
"What a coincidence, I want to go too!"
"Everyone probably wants to go, after all, just living in Yunding Manor, I’d even clean toilets to be there!"
Lin Fan realized with a simple ’oh’ that the recruitment ad had already gone out, Zhang Dafu’s efficiency was indeed quite good.
At this moment, the shop owner recognized Lin Fan since Lin Fan often came to buy things and everyone was familiar.
"Hey, young man, did you hear? Yunding Manor is hiring a butler." The shop owner said with a smile.
Lin Fan nodded, "I know, I’m the one hiring the butler."
He was telling the truth, but the old men and women didn’t believe him at all; they all looked at him and burst out laughing, "What a joke, young man!"
The shop owner said, "Jokes aside, young man, why not give it a shot? It’s so much better than delivering packages, right!"
Lin Fan said, "No, thanks, I still prefer delivering packages."
The old men and women shook their heads, thinking this young man really lacked ambition, everyone wants to go, but he doesn’t.
Lin Fan didn’t say more to them and went home directly.
Upon reaching the apartment building, he saw a familiar figure standing right at the entrance.
Zhao Xin’er!
Lin Fan frowned. He had deleted her from WeChat, yet here she was.
Seeing Lin Fan, Zhao Xin’er immediately beamed and came over, "Lin Fan, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time, you’re finally back!"
This girl showed no embarrassment facing Lin Fan, as if yesterday’s events hadn’t happened at all. Her thick skin even impressed Lin Fan a bit.
"There’s nothing to talk about with you, just go back." Lin Fan said coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Musical Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Musical Talent
Zhao Xin’er reached out and grabbed Lin Fan’s hand, pulling the cute card.
"Don’t be like this, I was wrong that day. I’ve already apologized to you. Are you still mad at me?"
Lin Fan felt like gagging. How did he not notice before that Zhao Xin’er’s skin is thicker than a wall?
He gently shook off Zhao Xin’er’s hand.
Lin Fan said, "Miss, you’re mistaken. I’m not mad at you; I just don’t want to deal with you."
Zhao Xin’er, seeing that her act of cuteness didn’t work, had to rein it in and said, "Actually, I wanted to ask you something. You didn’t reply to my WeChat last night. Are you the Mr. Lin who bought Yunding Manor?"
Lin Fan sneered inwardly, knowing she came to ask this. Seems like she won’t give up without an answer.
Lin Fan replied coldly, "No."
Denied!
Zhao Xin’er’s eyes couldn’t hide the surge of disappointment.
Lin Fan said, "You’re disappointed, right? You can scram now!"
Lin Fan’s indifference severely hurt Zhao Xin’er’s pride. You must know, Lin Fan used to be her lapdog. Such a contrast, Zhao Xin’er couldn’t accept it for a moment.
Although Lin Fan wasn’t that Mr. Lin, Lin Fan was still a billionaire. That Mr. Lin is out of reach, but Lin Fan is close at hand. She won’t give up on Lin Fan so easily.
Zhao Xin’er’s eyes turned red, and she looked pitiful: "Lin Fan, how can you treat me like this? You used to love me so much. Do you have no feelings for me at all?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You’re right, not a bit. Please don’t look for me in the future. Have some dignity."
After speaking, Lin Fan ignored Zhao Xin’er, took out his keys, opened the door, rolled his bike inside, and closed the door.
He was truly heartless!
Zhao Xin’er was provoked and got emotional, shouting, "Lin Fan, what are you bragging about, it’s just a bit of money! I’ve decided to apply to be Yunding Manor’s housekeeper. With my qualifications, I’m 100% sure of success. When I become Mr. Lin’s housekeeper, you won’t even have the right to polish my shoes!"
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh when he heard this.
"I can guarantee you won’t become the housekeeper of Yunding Manor."
Lin Fan responded through the door.
Zhao Xin’er was furious, "What are you guaranteeing, damn Lin Fan? You dare to look down on me, who do you think you are! When I succeed, don’t come begging to me then!"
She felt her words were powerful, but didn’t hear Lin Fan respond again.
Zhao Xin’er waited a while before realizing Lin Fan had already gone upstairs, made her stomp her feet in anger, and cursed a bit before leaving reluctantly.
Lin Fan didn’t want to listen to Zhao Xin’er’s nonsense at all, went upstairs early, closed the door, drowning out the noise.
After resting at home for a while, Lin Fan was just about to shower when a phone call came in.
When Lin Fan saw it, it was his younger sister Lin Shanshan calling from their hometown.
Lin Shanshan, Lin Fan’s only biological sister.
"Bro, I’m coming to Yun City for an interview tomorrow. Can you pick me up?" Lin Shanshan said.
Lin Fan remembered that his sister had told him a while back that she was applying to Yun City’s music conservatory for an interview. In Yun City, he was her only relative, so she could only come to rely on him.
Lin Fan said, "Sure, what time will you get to the station? Just let me know then."
Lin Shanshan replied with a hum, hesitated a bit, and then said, "Bro, if I pass the interview, my tuition fees..."
She felt a bit embarrassed, knowing music academy tuition is high, and her parents couldn’t support her, so she had to rely on Lin Fan. But she also knew her brother was a delivery guy in Yun City, not earning much...
Previously, talking about money would indeed make Lin Fan a bit vexed. Now, he was serene.
Lin Fan reassured her, "Don’t worry about the tuition fees. I have the money. Focus on preparing for the interview."
Hearing Lin Fan say this, Lin Shanshan felt relieved and laughed, "Bro, see you tomorrow then."
Lin Fan hung up, took a shower, and went to bed.
Before sleeping, he was a bit curious about what rewards the system would offer tomorrow. The previous days’ rewards had been really impressive.
A hundred billion in cash!
A top-level 70 million sports car!
Tomorrow, there should at least be a luxury house or something to match up.
Thinking about this, Lin Fan contentedly fell asleep.
The next day, Lin Fan got up well-rested, in a great mood, humming as he ran to the toilet to pee.
"Yesterday’s like flowing east water, gone from me cannot stay..."
From next door came a woman’s scolding: "Shut up, are you slaughtering a pig first thing in the morning, it’s awful!"
Lin Fan smiled wryly, his singing indeed wasn’t any good, very not any good. Heaven gave him a handsome face but left him tone-deaf.
But his sister Lin Shanshan had a sweet voice naturally, with a beautiful voice, which was why she applied to the music academy.
At every family gathering, relatives begged Lin Shanshan to sing.
But when Lin Fan offered to sing, they begged him, "For God’s sake, spare us."
The heavens are really unfair!
"Ding!"
"Reminder to the host, you can check in. Today’s reward is top-tier musical talent. Do you want to check in?"
Lin Fan was peeing and almost peed his pants.
"What the heck, musical talent?"
This reward was too bizarre, he thought it would be a luxury house, maybe the system couldn’t stand his singing either?
If he knew, he wouldn’t have hummed!
Honestly, Lin Fan was a bit disdainful of this reward.
But since it’s a reward and more is better, Lin Fan decided to check-in.
"Check in!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. You now possess top-tier musical talent, please verify."
Lin Fan was stunned. Just like that, he had musical talent?
"Yesterday’s like flowing east water, gone from me cannot stay..."
Lin Fan tried humming a line.
He was shocked himself, oh wow, it sounded amazing!
Indeed possessed musical talent, truly amazing.
He heard exclamations from next door, from the same woman: "Oh my gosh, what did I just hear, this wonderful singing, which Immortal is singing?"
"Immortal, please sing a few more lines, the trauma that pig-slaughter left me has been dispelled by you, I’m enchanted by your singing!"
Lin Fan sweated, this woman was quite the drama queen. If she knew the pig-slaughterer and Immortal were the same person, what would her reaction be?
He didn’t bother with it much, finished washing up, put on his delivery uniform, and went out to deliver food.
The first delivery he received had a familiar name, he had just been there yesterday, Lijing District.
Customer note: "In a bad mood, need a handsome delivery guy."
Handsome?
Ha, you found the right guy.
Order received, food picked up, delivery on the way!
Lin Fan rode his electric bike with the food to the entrance of Lijing District.
The security guard stopped him: "Delivery, come register before going in!"
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound. This person saluted him yesterday; today, with a different bike, he no longer recognized him. Seems like he recognized the vehicle, not the person.
Of course, that’s his business, everyone was just doing their job. Lin Fan cooperatively signed his name and smoothly entered the district.
Building 5, apartment 601.
Knock knock!
Lin Fan knocked on the door, "Hello, delivery!"
The door opened.
A stunning beauty in yoga attire with a killer figure opened the door. Right in front of him was a wave of whiteness from her full chest.
She was obviously working out, with fragrant sweat glistening, trickling down her snow-white neck into that mysterious deep valley...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Piano Genius
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Piano Genius
Lin Fan almost got a nosebleed, today was off to a red-hot start, so exciting.
He lowered his head, calmed his mind, and handed over the delivery: "Please take your delivery."
"Lin Fan!"
She exclaimed in surprise from the other side.
The voice sounded familiar, Lin Fan looked up and saw it was actually Liu Mengjie, whom he met yesterday!
No wonder she had such a great figure, wearing yoga clothes, he almost didn’t recognize her.
You can’t blame him, her figure was really too good, even more attention-grabbing than her face.
"Ahem, turns out it’s you, sis." Lin Fan said with a smile, still not daring to look directly at Liu Mengjie, the scene was too explosive, he was afraid he couldn’t handle it.
Liu Mengjie enthusiastically said: "We’re so fated, I didn’t expect you’d be delivering for me, come in quickly."
Lin Fan said: "This doesn’t seem quite right."
Liu Mengjie laughed and said: "What’s the big deal, you’re my hero, you helped me out with that jerk yesterday, and I didn’t even have time to thank you."
Saying this, Liu Mengjie grabbed Lin Fan by the hand and pulled him into the house, leading him to sit on the sofa.
Lin Fan sat down, placing the delivery on the coffee table.
Liu Mengjie went to pour a glass of water and brought it to Lin Fan: "Here, have a glass of water first, you’ve worked hard."
"Thank you."
Lin Fan took the water and looked up.
Poof!
He almost got a nosebleed, oh no, shouldn’t have looked, feeling a bit dizzy.
"Lin Fan, sit here for a bit, I’m all sweaty from a workout, going to take a shower and change clothes."
Liu Mengjie said, and then went straight to the bathroom.
Soon, the sound of running water came from inside.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but imagine how she looked while showering, almost couldn’t hold back the nosebleed again.
Alas, troublemaker!
Lin Fan quickly steadied his mind, looked around trying to divert his attention, the room was elegantly decorated, filled with various instruments, and shelves were stacked with records.
Clearly, Liu Mengjie is someone who loves music.
The piano near the balcony caught Lin Fan’s attention.
Lin Fan stood up and walked over.
Although he knew nothing about music, at this moment, a sense of familiarity flooded his mind.
Involuntarily, he sat down and his fingers started to dance.
A beautiful piano melody began to play.
The sound of the piano wafted from the balcony, heard by people in several surrounding buildings.
Everyone who heard it was shocked.
"Oh my god, who is that expert playing the piano, it sounds amazing!"
"What kind of divine music is this, such a pleasure!"
"I’ve never heard such beautiful piano sound, who could produce such wonderful sound, even the piano super star Lang Lang can’t compare!"
"Oh my god, I’m going crazy, even though I was woken up, I’m not mad, thank heaven for letting me hear such beautiful music!"
"This piece is simply perfect, but seems I’ve never heard it before, could it be an improvisation?"
"This is amazing, I can’t believe we have a piano genius living in our community!"
Of course, Lin Fan didn’t hear any of these praises, he was absorbed in his creation.
The piece ended, leaving him exhilarated!
Lin Fan’s fingers left the keys, and the whole world fell silent!
Those who heard the performance were stunned, lingering in the wonderful melody.
Lin Fan turned his head and saw Liu Mengjie standing in the living room looking astonished.
She had changed into a robe, with her hair still wet, she was too late to dry it, like a beauty stepping out of a bath, stunningly beautiful.
"Sorry, I shouldn’t have touched your piano without permission." Lin Fan apologized, thinking Liu Mengjie might be upset about him playing the piano.
Indeed, without her permission, he shouldn’t have touched it. Just now, he couldn’t explain why he lost control.
Blame the system for giving him some top-notch music talent reward.
Liu Mengjie snapped out of it, exclaiming dramatically: "Oh my god, what did I just hear, what was that piece?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said: "I don’t know either, just played whatever came to mind."
Liu Mengjie nearly stumbled.
Just casually played and created a masterpiece?
Not only did Lin Fan have top-tier piano skills, but also the ability for top-tier improvisation, what kind of Immortal is this!
Liu Mengjie really felt like she had hit a jackpot, and it was priceless!
"Lin Fan, who exactly are you?" Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan said: "Me? Just a delivery guy!"
Liu Mengjie shook her head: "No, you’re not, you are the most amazing person I’ve ever met, besides being wealthy, you possess top-notch musical talent, money can be earned, but no amount of money can buy musical genius!"
Lin Fan was a bit embarrassed: "Am I that great?"
Must admit, the system was overly generous, every reward was top-level!
Liu Mengjie said: "You are that amazing, Lin Fan, did you know I was in a bad mood today?"
Lin Fan said: "I knew, you mentioned it in the note."
Liu Mengjie said: "Do you know why I was in a bad mood? Because my best piano teacher resigned. But after seeing you play the piano, my mood completely changed."
Lin Fan joked: "I thought seeing handsome me would already cheer you up."
Liu Mengjie chuckled: "That’s true, seeing you did start to cheer me up, but seeing you play the piano wasn’t just cheering up, it was joy and excitement."
Lin Fan curiously asked: "Sis, when you mentioned your piano teacher, what do you mean, what do you do?"
Liu Mengjie laughed: "Sorry, I forgot to tell you, I’m the principal of Yun City Music Academy."
Lin Fan was momentarily stunned.
Liu Mengjie turned out to be the principal of Yun City Music Academy!
The school Lin Shanshan wanted to apply to was Yun City Music Academy.
This was such a coincidence!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but think, should he put in a good word for his sister, but soon dismissed the idea, he believed Lin Shanshan could pass the exams on her own merits, not by connections.
Liu Mengjie said: "Lin Fan, I’d like to extend an invitation to you, inviting you to be a piano teacher at our academy, what do you think?"
After hearing Lin Fan play, she had completely forgotten about the piano teacher who resigned, if she could recruit Lin Fan as a teacher, that would be fantastic.
Lin Fan was a bit sheepish and said: "I’d pass for now, moreover I don’t have a teaching certificate. Sis, I’ve been here a while, I need to deliver other orders, so I’ll take my leave."
Lin Fan’s refusal left Liu Mengjie somewhat disappointed.
However, she realized she might have been a bit abrupt.
Liu Mengjie thought to herself that this kind of thing couldn’t be rushed, it would have to happen gradually, looking for another opportunity to convince Lin Fan later.
Lin Fan left Liu Mengjie’s home and went downstairs.
There was a group of community residents gathered chatting.
"Did you all hear someone playing piano earlier?"
"Heard it, it was so amazing, wonder who that genius was?"
"Honestly, I didn’t expect our community to have such hidden talents, I really want to meet this piano master."
Just then, Lin Fan walked past them, nodded and smiled at them.
Residents saw a delivery guy, so didn’t pay him much attention, just cast a glance at Lin Fan, then turned around to keep chatting about the "piano master."
Little did they know, the piano master they admired was right in front of them.
Lin Fan took his e-bike and was about to leave Lijing District.
Just as he reached the gate, suddenly he saw a cute girl in a dress, struggling to drag a sofa.
They made eye contact.
"Chen Lingling!"
"Brother!"
They both recognized each other, the girl was Chen Lingling, the comic-like beautiful girl he met yesterday!

chapters.title: Chapter 16: A Chance Encounter with a University Classmate
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: A Chance Encounter with a University Classmate
Yesterday Lin Fan helped her assemble the bed, and Chen Lingling actually fell asleep on it. At the time, Lin Fan covered her with a blanket and then quietly left.
Chen Lingling was very happy to see Lin Fan again. She threw down the sofa and ran over, sweetly smiling, "Brother, what a coincidence!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yeah, what are you doing here, moving the sofa by yourself? Why not get someone to help you?"
Chen Lingling sighed, "I bought a new sofa. They said it wasn’t too big, so I could move it myself."
Lin Fan was a bit speechless. This girl was too kind and easily bullied. How long could she move the sofa on her own?
He felt a bit tender toward her, parked the car, and said, "Let me help you move it up."
Chen Lingling was very happy, "Thank you, Brother. You’re so good to me."
She recalled the dream she had of her wedding with Lin Fan from the previous day, and her face turned red with embarrassment.
What to do, I really want to confess to him!
But I’m also afraid of failing.
For a moment, she was filled with a mix of gains and losses.
Seeing her expression turn strange, Lin Fan asked curiously, "Are you alright?"
"No, no problem!"
Chen Lingling hurriedly replied, sighing inside for ultimately lacking the courage to confess.
With Lin Fan’s help, the sofa was moved back to Chen Lingling’s house without much effort.
Chen Lingling gratefully said, "Brother, sorry to trouble you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s no problem, no need to thank me. I’ll be heading off now."
Chen Lingling bit her lip, hesitated for a moment, then mustered up the courage to say, "Brother, can I ask you for another favor?"
Lin Fan said, "Go ahead, is there something else you need help assembling?"
Chen Lingling shook her head, "It’s like this, I have a class reunion tonight. Could you accompany me? I don’t want them to make fun of me."
Lin Fan asked curiously, "Who would make fun of you at a class reunion?"
Chen Lingling: "It’s that Sun Xiaona. Her family background is better than mine. She looked down on me when we were in school, and now that she has a boyfriend, she’s even more arrogant, mocking me for not having a boyfriend and saying I’ll never find one."
When mentioning Sun Xiaona, Chen Lingling became angry and aggrieved, her eyes turning red for a moment because Sun Xiaona was really too bullying.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "So, you want me to pretend to be your boyfriend to support you?"
Chen Lingling blushed and softly said, "Brother, can you? I’m begging you."
Lin Fan didn’t know why, but he seemed especially soft-hearted towards Chen Lingling, "No problem, what time tonight should I come to pick you up?"
Chen Lingling jumped up with joy, "Seven o’clock tonight, I’ll wait for you at the entrance of the district. Thank you so much, Brother, you’re really kind!"
She had gone from not wanting to attend the reunion to eagerly looking forward to it.
Lin Fan wondered to himself if this meant he was earning a "nice guy" card.
After saying goodbye to Chen Lingling, Lin Fan left Lijing District and continued delivering takeout.
After a busy day, by evening, Lin Fan received a call from Lin Shanshan, who was almost at Yuncheng Station.
Lin Fan went back to park his electric scooter and didn’t bother changing his clothes, just drove the Kosak and hurried to the bus station.
Yun City Airport.
Lin Fan parked the car by the side of the road, got out, and walked into the airport, ready to pick up Lin Shanshan.
As he walked.
"Lin Fan!"
Suddenly, he heard someone calling him from the side.
Lin Fan turned his head and saw a man in a floral shirt with slicked-back hair leaning against a jeep.
A familiar feeling.
But he couldn’t remember who it was for a moment.
However, the man was already laughing, "Lin Fan, it’s really you! I’m Qian Feng!"
Qian Feng!
Lin Fan suddenly remembered, his university classmate Qian Feng!
Qian Feng had changed so much. He was quiet and invisible during university, but now he seemed to be doing well.
"Oh, it’s Qian Feng." Lin Fan smiled. He was also quite happy to see an old classmate.
Qian Feng glanced at Lin Fan, a bit unsure, "Lin Fan, are you... delivering takeout?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m here to pick someone up, but yes, I’m currently working as a delivery person."
Qian Feng was stunned for a moment, still somewhat unable to believe it, that Lin Fan was actually a delivery person!
Instantly, a complex emotion flashed in Qian Feng’s eyes.
He used to be envious of Lin Fan, thinking that the handsome Lin Fan would definitely have a great future, and felt deeply inferior.
Never thought this would happen!
Campus heartthrob Lin Fan, delivering takeout!
While he, Qian Feng, seemed successful and well-off.
A sense of superiority!
Qian Feng’s heart was filled with the thrill of having surpassed Lin Fan.
But after two years in society, Qian Feng had become smooth and sophisticated. He immediately laughed and said, "Being a delivery person is great, free and easy. I heard the salary’s pretty high, right?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s alright."
Qian Feng slapped his thigh, "That’s it, unlike me stuck in drudgery, working hard every day, and only earning 30,000 monthly."
As he spoke, Qian Feng glanced at Lin Fan.
Though he was complaining, it was actually showing off.
He thought Lin Fan would be shocked by his high salary, but Lin Fan seemed pretty calm with no reaction.
Qian Feng was not satisfied, "Oh, I haven’t mentioned where I work yet. Jingdong Group, Lin Fan, have you heard of it?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course, I’ve heard of it, it’s a great company."
Qian Feng was showing off, and Lin Fan could easily see through it. Meant to be an old classmate, he was trying his best to play along.
Qian Feng was pleased inside, but acted nonchalant, "Psh, great my ass, it’s only ranked 400 in Huaxia’s top 500, not even in the top 100. Our boss is notoriously a workaholic, requiring us subordinates to be on call 24/7. Today he’s returning from abroad, so I have to pick him up, and I’m driving my private car, no less."
He purposely thumped the jeep, trying to draw Lin Fan’s attention to his car.
Lin Fan played along, chuckling, "Nice car."
Qian Feng sighed heavily, "What’s nice about it, just an old car worth only 300,000 from the market, merely a means of transportation. By the way, Lin Fan, have you bought a car?"
Lin Fan said, "You could say that."
Kosak, 7 million, the world’s most expensive luxury car, but it was a gift from the system, so it can only be "considered bought."
Qian Feng thought he was ashamed to say it and laughed, "Look at what I’m asking. You’re a delivery person, of course, you’d buy an electric scooter. Scooters are great too. I want to get one myself for eco-friendly travel. If not for work, I’d give this jeep to my mom."
Lin Fan just smiled without saying a word.
Qian Feng said, "By the way, Lin Fan, there’s a class reunion tomorrow night, did you hear about it?"
Lin Fan uttered an "oh," somewhat surprised, "I didn’t know?"
Qian Feng laughed, "The class president probably hasn’t notified you yet. You’re our campus heartthrob, will you come?"
Lin Fan was just about to speak when Qian Feng’s phone rang.
Qian Feng glanced at it and quickly said, "It’s my boss, he’s landed. Lin Fan, I’ll catch you later. Let’s chat more at the reunion tomorrow night."

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Only 1 Person Can Sit
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Only 1 Person Can Sit
Qian Feng hurried off, answering a call with a fawning smile: "Boss, I’m on my way, a lot of luggage you say, no problem..."
The way he was bowing and scraping along the way was completely different from the image of him just venting about his boss.
After Qian Feng left, Lin Fan received a phone call from an unfamiliar number.
"Lin Fan, it’s the class monitor!" a familiar voice came from the other end.
Class monitor Luo Tianming!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Haha, it’s the class monitor."
Luo Tianming said, "Just letting you know, tomorrow at 7 PM at Jindu Grand Hotel, we’re having a class reunion, you must come."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll be there."
Luo Tianming laughed, "That’s great, it’s been so long since we’ve all caught up. You’re the heartthrob of our school, all the girls have been saying how much they want to see you. You’re doing quite well for yourself now, aren’t you?"
Lin Fan said, "Not too bad, I’m delivering food, staying pretty busy every day."
Luo Tianming didn’t believe Lin Fan and laughed out loud: "Hahaha... I don’t buy it for a second, you’re pretty humorous, man. I’m already a deputy general manager at the company, you being so handsome, must be doing even better. I have to inform other classmates, we can talk more when we meet tomorrow!"
The call ended immediately after.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless, with Qian Feng working at a Fortune 500 company, and the class monitor now a deputy general manager, these old classmates all love to show off.
Speaking of showing off, they’re all small fries compared to him.
Arriving at the airport entrance, Lin Fan waited for a moment when suddenly, he saw two pretty young ladies walk out.
One of them was his sister, Lin Shanshan, and the other was Lin Shanshan’s best friend and classmate, Cheng Xiaolu, both there to apply to Yun City Music Academy.
The two girls were chatting as they walked.
Cheng Xiaolu asked, "Shanshan, my cousin will come to pick me up later. Do you have someone picking you up?"
Lin Shanshan said, "My brother said he’s driving to pick me up."
Cheng Xiaolu was curious, "Shanshan, you haven’t told me, what’s your brother doing?"
"He..."
Lin Shanshan bit her lip, a bit embarrassed. She naturally knew what her brother Lin Fan did, but admitting it felt a bit shameful.
"Shanshan!"
At this moment, Lin Shanshan saw Lin Fan and proactively called out to her, waving his hand.
Following Lin Shanshan’s gaze, Cheng Xiaolu saw Lin Fan in a delivery uniform.
"Shanshan, your brother is a delivery guy?" Cheng Xiaolu said, immediately showing disdain in her eyes.
No wonder Shanshan was being evasive, if her brother was a delivery man, she’d be too embarrassed to face anyone.
Lin Shanshan blushed, "Yeah..."
She felt a bit resentful towards Lin Fan, why didn’t he change his clothes before coming, at least make it a bit respectable, now that Little Lu knew he was a delivery guy, it was too embarrassing.
Lin Fan walked up to the two girls and took Lin Shanshan’s luggage.
"Bro, this is my best friend Cheng Xiaolu. Little Lu, this is my brother Lin Fan," Lin Shanshan introduced.
Lin Fan looked at Cheng Xiaolu and smiled, "My car is outside, but it only seats one."
Cheng Xiaolu replied coldly, "It’s alright, my cousin is coming to pick me up shortly."
Seeing Lin Fan was a delivery guy, she had no interest in talking to him at all. If Shanshan wasn’t her best friend, she wouldn’t even acknowledge Lin Fan.
The three of them exited the airport.
Parked by the roadside was a delivery e-bike.
Lin Shanshan immediately became a bit embarrassed, her brother came to pick her up on this delivery e-bike? In broad daylight, right in front of Little Lu, truly mortifying.
Her skin was thin, she really couldn’t bring herself to ride this bike.
Cheng Xiaolu looked at the e-bike and smirked, this pathetic e-bike, of course, it only seats one!
Thank goodness it only seats one, otherwise if asked to ride together, she couldn’t bear the embarrassment.
"Bro, with all this luggage, how could we ride this e-bike? How about I just take a taxi myself?"
Lin Shanshan suggested, praising her own wit in her heart for finding an excuse to avoid riding the e-bike.
Cheng Xiaolu said, "Shanshan, my cousin will come pick me up, and he’s driving an Audi. Let your brother take the luggage back on the e-bike while you ride in my cousin’s car."
As she spoke, Cheng Xiaolu gave Lin Fan a disdainful look, the contrast between a cousin and Lin Fan made her feel superior.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat, it seemed they misunderstood him. He said, "This e-bike isn’t mine. I swapped out for another vehicle to save time."
The two girls were taken aback, it’s not the e-bike?
Cheng Xiaolu said, "No way, you just said your car only seats one, if it’s not this e-bike, what is it?"
She grew even more disdainful towards Lin Fan, even if he drove a broken e-bike, he was still too proud to admit it.
Lin Shanshan’s face was crimson, she also felt Lin Fan was too embarrassed to admit the e-bike was his, making things even more shameful.
"Bro, enough, just take my luggage and go. I’ll ride with Little Lu’s cousin," Lin Shanshan said, wanting Lin Fan to just leave quickly.
Lin Fan sweated, "This e-bike really isn’t mine."
Just then, a delivery man walked over, carrying a delivery bag, and drove the e-bike away.
The two girls were momentarily stunned, this e-bike really wasn’t Lin Fan’s?
Lin Shanshan said, "Bro, where’s your car then?"
Cheng Xiaolu sneered inwardly, "Shanshan, even if that e-bike wasn’t your brother’s, his car is probably another e-bike. You should still ride in my cousin’s Audi."
Lin Shanshan was about to respond.
Then Lin Fan said, "Here’s my car."
As he spoke, Lin Fan pulled out his car key and pressed the start button.
BEEP BEEP!
The Kosak parked nearby lit up its headlights, and the futuristic doors opened like wings.
Passersby stopped to stare and exclaim in awe, everyone was amazed by this world’s most expensive top-tier supercar.
Many people took out their phones to take photos and quickly posted them on social media to show off.
This luxury car is one of only three in the world, most people never even have a chance to see it, seeing it once is enough to brag about for a long time.
At the moment the Kosak started, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were dumbstruck, their faces filled with astonishment.
Lin Shanshan’s voice trembled, "Bro, this car is yours?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s mine, hop in."
Lin Fan pressed the key again, opening the car’s trunk, and placed Lin Shanshan’s luggage inside.
"This car is so beautiful, I want to ride it so much too."
"This girl is so lucky, I’m so envious of her."
"If only I were her, why am I not her!"
Receiving envious glances from passersby, Lin Shanshan walked in front of the Kosak, gingerly got into the passenger seat, happiness came so suddenly, it felt dream-like, almost surreal.
Watching Lin Shanshan enter the supercar, Cheng Xiaolu was green with envy.
She also wanted to ride it badly, to bask in the envious glances of the onlookers.
She hurried over.
"Shanshan, can you scoot over, let me also get in?" Cheng Xiaolu asked, if it wasn’t for saving face, she’d have pulled Lin Shanshan out and gotten in herself.
Lin Shanshan was a bit embarrassed, squeezing two people into one seat didn’t seem feasible.
Lin Fan, having placed the luggage, got into the driver’s seat and heard Cheng Xiaolu’s request.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Sorry, as mentioned earlier, this car only seats one."
With that, Lin Fan pressed the car door button, leaving Cheng Xiaolu standing there as he drove away.
Cheng Xiaolu’s face burned with embarrassment, indeed, both the e-bike and the supercar only seated one, she thought Lin Fan was driving an e-bike, who knew his one-seater car was a top-tier supercar!

chapters.title: Chapter 18 Sister Doesn’t Believe
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18 Sister Doesn’t Believe
Cheng Xiaolu looked longingly at the departing Kosak, feeling extremely regretful. She never imagined that Lin Shanshan’s brother, a delivery guy, would have a supercar!
And it’s a top-tier one!
If she had known earlier, she wouldn’t have dared to look down on Lin Fan. What right did she have to look down on him?
Just then, an Audi pulled up beside Cheng Xiaolu. Inside, a man, with a look of envy, was gazing at the departing Kosak and exclaimed, "What a great car! I wouldn’t even dream of driving it. If I could just sit in the passenger seat once, I’d die without regrets."
This man was Cheng Xiaolu’s cousin, who came to pick her up and happened to see the Kosak leave.
Hearing this, Cheng Xiaolu wanted to cry but had no tears. She originally had the chance, but now she feared she wouldn’t even get to sit in it. She shouldn’t have offended Lin Fan.
Meanwhile, Lin Shanshan, sitting in the passenger seat of the Kosak, still felt like she was dreaming. She couldn’t believe she was actually sitting in a luxury car.
She knew her family was poor, and a luxury car was something she wouldn’t even dare to think about, let alone sit in.
"Brother, is this car really yours?" Lin Shanshan asked.
Lin Fan replied, "It’s mine."
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, don’t lie to me. You’re a delivery guy. Where did you get so much money to buy such a good car? I may not know much about cars, but I’ve heard this one starts at 10 million, right?"
Lin Fan said, "70 million."
"70 million?" Lin Shanshan was stunned.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "If I told you I have plenty of money now, would you believe me?"
Lin Shanshan shook her head and said, "I don’t believe it. Brother, you must have borrowed a friend’s car, right? You don’t want me to lose face in front of others."
The more she thought about it, the more she felt that this was the only reasonable explanation. But there was a flaw: how could her brother, a delivery guy, know someone with a 70 million luxury car? If he had such a friend, there’d be no need to deliver food for a living.
His sister refused to believe him. Lin Fan just smiled and didn’t mind. She would eventually come to believe him.
Lin Fan dropped Lin Shanshan off at his apartment.
Upon entering the apartment and seeing the cramped space, Lin Shanshan became even more convinced that her judgment was correct. That luxury car was not Lin Fan’s!
She couldn’t help but feel a little disappointed. If her brother really had money, that would be great!
Lin Fan saw that it was getting late. He had promised to accompany Chen Lingling to a class reunion tonight and would soon be late.
"I have to go out for a bit. I’ll be back later. Stay at home and don’t wander around."
Lin Fan instructed her before turning and leaving.
Lin Shanshan sat bored in the room and suddenly received a WeChat message from Cheng Xiaolu: "Shanshan, I didn’t know your brother was so rich. You tricked me so much. Why didn’t you say so earlier?"
Lin Shanshan hesitated. Should she expose her brother? He wasn’t truly rich but just borrowing someone else’s car to show off.
Cheng Xiaolu was her best friend, and they had no secrets between them. Lin Shanshan finally decided to tell Cheng Xiaolu the truth.
Lin Shanshan: "My brother really is a delivery guy."
Cheng Xiaolu immediately replied: "Shanshan, stop tricking me. Where in the world would a delivery guy drive a 10-million luxury car? My cousin told me this car seems to be worth 70 million!"
Lin Shanshan sent a sweating emoji: "The car is borrowed."
Cheng Xiaolu sent a surprised emoji: "Shanshan, are you sure?"
Lin Shanshan felt her judgment was not wrong and replied: "I’m sure, Little Lu, you know my family situation."
On the other side, sitting in the Audi, Cheng Xiaolu felt relieved upon receiving Lin Shanshan’s reply.
She then showed an even stronger expression of disdain: "I knew it. How could he possibly be rich? Turns out he borrowed the car. What’s a poor delivery guy showing off for? Next time, I’ll expose him publicly!"
Thinking about how Lin Fan successfully showed off in front of her today, she felt very unhappy. She regretted not exposing Lin Fan publicly and felt she should have realized it earlier!
How could Lin Fan possibly be a rich person?
At the entrance of Lijing District.
Chen Lingling, dressed in a pure and adorable outfit, stood at the entrance of the community waiting for Lin Fan. It was almost the agreed time, yet Lin Fan hadn’t appeared.
Chen Lingling couldn’t help but worry. Was Brother Lin Fan not coming?
Just then, the dashing figure of the Kosak appeared, racing towards her.
Chen Lingling showed a starstruck expression, as if she had seen her prince charming riding a white horse to marry her.
Brother Lin Fan didn’t break his promise!
He not only came but also drove his unmatched luxury car to pick her up!
It was such an honor.
Lin Fan stopped the car beside Chen Lingling, opened the door, and smiled, "Hop in."
"Mm." Chen Lingling excitedly got in the car, her heart fluttering like a fawn running wild.
With Brother Lin Fan accompanying her, she felt secure and wasn’t afraid to attend the class reunion, nor did she fear facing her nemesis Sun Xiaona.
Ginza KTV, this was the place for Chen Lingling’s class reunion tonight.
A group of young men and women gathered at the KTV entrance. They were Chen Lingling’s classmates, waiting to go in together once everyone arrived.
"Have you heard? Sun Xiaona recently got herself a rich boyfriend."
"I heard too. I’m so jealous of her. She’s beautiful and married a rich guy."
"Not surprising at all. Little Na said she’d only marry into a wealthy family. She has the capital!"
The classmates chatted animatedly, and the focus of their discussion was Sun Xiaona.
In their school, Sun Xiaona and Chen Lingling were known as the campus beauties, but they were completely different. Sun Xiaona was always the topic queen, while Chen Lingling kept a low profile and almost had no presence.
A big Benz drove up and parked nearby, and a tall, long-haired beauty with red lips stepped out of the car.
Though still quite young, her mature and flamboyant dress made it hard to discern her as a recent graduate.
Soon after, a youth dressed in flashy clothes emerged from the driver’s seat, with a big gold chain on his hand drawing attention.
"Little Na’s here!"
"Little Na looks stunning tonight. Truly worthy of being our campus beauty!"
"A goddess is a goddess. She stuns the entire venue with her entrance."
The classmates immediately gathered around, showering her with compliments.
Not only was Sun Xiaona indeed quite pretty, but more importantly, they were awed by the big Benz she arrived in.
The car was worth at least a million!
Looking at the youth’s big gold chain, it seemed the rumors were true. Sun Xiaona really did snag a Rich Second Generation!
They naturally wanted to cozy up to her, hoping for some benefits.
Receiving the flattery from her classmates, Sun Xiaona was very pleased. This was the effect she wanted. She always needed to be the focus, and no one could steal her thunder.
Anyone who could steal her spotlight was her enemy.
Chen Lingling was a thorn in her side. Chen Lingling’s pretty face was a nuisance to her.
Their viewpoints were completely different; she looked down on Chen Lingling for having a pretty face but not knowing how to use it, only burying herself in books—what a waste.
She despised Chen Lingling from the bottom of her heart, making Chen Lingling her favorite target for attacks.
Glancing at everyone, Sun Xiaona noticed that Chen Lingling wasn’t among them, feeling slightly displeased. Her grand entrance in the Benz hadn’t been witnessed by Chen Lingling. What a disappointment.

chapters.title: Chapter 19 I’m Her Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19 I’m Her Boyfriend
"This is my boyfriend, Zhao Jiahao, the third son of the Yun City Zhao Family."
Sun Xiaona introduced the well-dressed young man to her classmates.
The classmates, unsurprisingly, began complimenting Zhao Jiahao; the girls busy with praises, the boys busy offering cigarettes.
This was a rare opportunity.
The Yun City Zhao Family was considered a wealthy family. If it weren’t for Sun Xiaona, these classmates might never have the chance to cozy up to someone from the Zhao Family in their entire lives.
Yet, without Chen Lingling present, Sun Xiaona found pretending to be glamorous rather dull.
Only by stepping on Chen Lingling did she feel satisfied.
"Where’s Chen Lingling? Why hasn’t she come?" Sun Xiaona asked with a frown.
The classmates looked at each other.
"No idea, haven’t seen her since graduation."
"Heard she’s renting a place and still looking for a job."
"She doesn’t have a boyfriend either; she can’t compare to Little Na at all."
Knowing Sun Xiaona and Chen Lingling didn’t get along, some classmates took the chance to criticize Chen Lingling. What could they do? Sun Xiaona had more value than Chen Lingling. If they cozied up to Sun Xiaona’s rich second-generation boyfriend, they might have a chance to succeed.
Chen Lingling had nothing.
Hearing someone criticize Chen Lingling, Sun Xiaona felt delighted and sneered, "I’ve said it before, this Chen Lingling is outdated, a bookworm! What’s the use of being good at studying if she still can’t find a job?"
The classmates chimed in agreement.
"Little Na is so right. Out in the real world, who doesn’t deal with social relationships? People like Chen Lingling are destined to be eliminated by society."
"She doesn’t understand any social dynamics at all. How will she survive in society in the future? No wonder she can’t find a job or a boyfriend!"
"Little Na, on the other hand, found an excellent boyfriend. She won’t have to worry about her future at all."
The classmates discussed, starting to critique Chen Lingling, each showing a disdainful expression.
Sun Xiaona laughed happily, "Keep criticizing her; I like hearing it."
Someone said, "Why isn’t Chen Lingling here yet? I guess she’s too embarrassed to show her face, especially seeing Little Na being so outstanding."
The classmates broke into laughter.
Sun Xiaona chuckled, "She finally has some self-awareness."
Coldly smirking inside, wondering if that loser really was too ashamed to come?
She hoped Chen Lingling would come. Without being able to humiliate Chen Lingling face-to-face, it lacked excitement.
Just then, the sound of an enchanting engine revving caught their attention. In came an impressive and eye-catching supercar, immediately attracting everyone’s gaze.
"Oh my god, it’s a Kosak! It’s here!"
Sun Xiaona’s boyfriend blurted out in astonishment.
As a rich second-generation car enthusiast, he wasn’t unfamiliar with Kosak. He naturally knew the car’s value; only three of these supercars existed globally, and one was here—unbelievable.
He couldn’t wait to see who owned this car; owning such a supercar must surely mean they were an extraordinary person!
The Kosak stopped, and both doors opened like wings. A man and woman emerged from the car.
The man wore an delivery uniform but couldn’t hide his overflowing charm.
The woman wore a simple dress, a pure and cute style, like a beautiful young lady stepping out of a comic.
What a perfect couple!
Especially stepping out of this top-tier supercar, they carried an aura that was in the spotlight.
Passersby stopped to watch and praised, many took out their phones to take pictures, as if seeing stars.
It’s got to be said, this couple was more dazzling than many celebrities.
Chen Lingling’s classmates were dumbfounded.
They instantly recognized the girl exiting the Kosak—it was Chen Lingling!
Sun Xiaona was dumbfounded too, rubbing her eyes in disbelief.
Yes, it really was Chen Lingling!
Sun Xiaona’s face instantly turned pale.
"Hello, everyone."
Chen Lingling saw the classmates, waved smilingly, and walked over.
Lin Fan stylishly pressed a button on the car key, closing the car doors, then leisurely followed Chen Lingling.
Someone responded, stammering, "Lingling, this is... this car, and this is?"
Other classmates had the same question, all looking at Chen Lingling, waiting for her answer.
Sun Xiaona was very displeased; Chen Lingling stole all her thunder upon arrival, and she sneered, "Need you ask? With her ability, she must be hitching a ride!"
Chen Lingling heard this, blushed, feeling somewhat guilty, since she indeed wasn’t in a romantic relationship with Lin Fan.
Sun Xiaona had always been domineering towards her, and she habitually feared Sun Xiaona, worried Sun Xiaona would see through her relationship with Lin Fan.
"Sorry, everyone. Let me introduce myself. I’m Lin Fan, Lingling’s boyfriend."
Lin Fan said calmly, with a slight smile on his face.
Boyfriend!
Once again, the classmates were stunned!
Chen Lingling actually found a boyfriend who drove a top-tier supercar!
"I told you, Lingling’s the most promising among us, indeed!"
"Oh my god, Lingling, you’re so lucky, I’m so jealous!"
"It’s what Sister Lingling deserves! Why is Sister Lingling beautiful, studying well, and the unique beauty of our school, ranking first in academic performance!"
The classmates suddenly surrounded Chen Lingling, showering her with flattery.
They seemed to completely forget that before Chen Lingling arrived, they criticized her; now they all turned about-face.
Chen Lingling blushed, feeling embarrassed by all the praises from her classmates.
Seeing this, Sun Xiaona was about to explode with anger and jealousy.
Chen Lingling’s boyfriend was even wealthier than hers!
The gap between a Mercedes and a top-tier supercar was enormous!
Why was Chen Lingling able to find such an incredible boyfriend!
Suddenly, Sun Xiaona noticed Lin Fan’s delivery uniform.
"Wait!"
Sun Xiaona shouted loudly, "Chen Lingling, is he really your boyfriend?"
Chen Lingling felt a bit guilty, "Yeah."
At this point, Lin Fan came beside Chen Lingling, his warm, large hand holding Chen Lingling’s small hand.
Chen Lingling felt incredibly secure and warm, instantly calming herself, lifted her head, and said, "He is my boyfriend!"
Sun Xiaona chuckled, "Then can you tell everyone what your boyfriend does? Why is he wearing a delivery uniform?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s attention focused.
Just now captivated by the aura of the luxury car, they hadn’t noticed it. Indeed, Lin Fan wore a delivery uniform!
"Yeah, why is he wearing a delivery uniform?"
"A super-rich second-generation dressing like a delivery guy, that’s odd!"
"What’s the deal here?"
Everyone started to feel curious.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Lingling, just tell them the truth."
Chen Lingling initially worried Lin Fan might mind, but listening to him, she felt relieved and compliant with Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan is a delivery person."
Upon saying this, everyone froze.
What?
Lin Fan, driving a Kosak, was actually a delivery person?

chapters.title: Chapter 20: 1 million to book the KTV
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20: 1 million to book the KTV
Sun Xiaona burst into laughter, laughing so hard that tears were streaming down her face.
"Chen Lingling, what are you saying? You say your boyfriend is a food delivery guy?"
Chen Lingling replied, "That’s right, he’s a food delivery guy. So what, is being a delivery guy that funny?"
Sun Xiaona laughed even harder, "Of course it’s funny. I thought you had turned over a new leaf, but it turns out you just found a delivery guy to be your boyfriend. That’s so you!"
"This sports car must be borrowed too, what a disgrace. If you’re poor, just be poor with dignity. But borrowing a car to show off is really contemptible. I’m different. My boyfriend is a genuine Rich Second Generation!"
Thinking she had turned the tables, Sun Xiaona couldn’t resist stomping all over Chen Lingling.
The classmates started muttering among themselves, could it be true? Is this car really not Lin Fan’s and just borrowed?
It must be true since Chen Lingling admitted it herself, Lin Fan is just a delivery guy!
They had just been praising Chen Lingling, but now that they know her wealthy boyfriend is a sham, it’s awkward.
"Lingling, you were wrong about this. Why didn’t you say so from the start, making us misunderstand?"
Someone couldn’t help but complain.
This sparked agreement from others. If they had known Lin Fan was just a delivery guy, they wouldn’t have bothered to compliment Chen Lingling.
"Sister Xiaona still has sharp eyes, she saw things clearly at a glance!"
"Sister Xiaona has seen all kinds of people. How could a pretty vase slip past her keen eyes?"
"Chen Lingling is just a bookworm. It’s not surprising at all that she found a delivery guy to be her boyfriend!"
The classmates shifted their flattery to Sun Xiaona, while kicking Chen Lingling down a notch.
Chen Lingling frowned, a bit puzzled. How could they all be like this? They were just praising her, and now upon seeing Lin Fan as a delivery guy, they flipped their faces like changing masks in a Sichuan opera?
She didn’t find anything wrong with being a delivery guy, after all, Lin Fan is not an ordinary delivery guy!
Lin Fan looked at Sun Xiaona at this moment and smiled, "You’re Sun Xiaona, right? I’ve heard Lingling mention you."
Sun Xiaona, with disdain for speaking to a delivery guy, sneered, "What did she mention about me? She must have been envious, jealous, and hateful of my excellence!"
Lin Fan said, "No, she said you’re a dumb woman, and you certainly are."
Sun Xiaona’s face darkened, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan calmly said, "Who dictates that delivery guys can’t have money? Who dictates that delivery guys can’t own sports cars? You see I’m a delivery guy and assume the car isn’t mine, don’t you think you’re dumb?"
Sun Xiaona was almost beside herself with anger, how dare a delivery guy talk to her like this!
"What do you even think you are, a dead delivery boy? I insist you don’t have money, so what? Look in the mirror, could you be a rich person?"
"Look at my boyfriend, now that’s a real rich person. Just his bracelet alone could be worth your salary for several years!"
"You and Chen Lingling are really a perfect match, male loser and female loser, two poor fools!"
Sun Xiaona started cursing loudly, drawing stares from passersby.
Sun Xiaona could scold herself, but Chen Lingling was used to it, yet she couldn’t accept her cursing Brother Lin like that.
In her heart, Brother Lin is the best.
"Sun Xiaona, don’t go too far!"
Chen Lingling said, her face flushed. Usually, she would endure silently, but she finally stood up to confront Sun Xiaona to defend Lin Fan.
Sun Xiaona was taken aback for a moment, then she sneered, "You’re really something now, daring to talk back to me for a delivery guy boyfriend. Just go live with your poor boyfriend for the rest of your life!"
Chen Lingling sighed inside, I do wish to spend my life with Brother Lin, but unfortunately, Brother Lin is just a pretend boyfriend.
At this moment, a middle-aged man in a suit came out of Ginza KTV with two attendants.
"That’s Boss Zhou Yitian of the Ginza KTV. He rarely shows up. Why is he here today?"
Everyone was curious.
Sun Xiaona was delighted, "He must have come out to welcome my boyfriend!"
"Sister Xiaona has such influence!"
"Getting a personal reception from Boss Zhou is a privilege not everyone can enjoy!"
"Who doesn’t say Sister Xiaona is amazing, look at the boyfriend she found!"
The classmates started complimenting her all at once.
Zhao Jiahao, however, was a little puzzled. He knew that his family’s status in Yun City wasn’t enough for Zhou Yitian to give such face, let alone him being only the third son of the Zhao family.
He saw Zhou Yitian walk over, but he didn’t stop in front of Zhao Jiahao. Instead, he seemingly didn’t even notice Zhao Jiahao and walked past him.
He went directly to Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, you’re here, welcome, welcome!"
Zhou Yitian warmly extended his hand to Lin Fan, a broad smile on his face.
Lin Fan extended his hand to shake Zhou Yitian’s and smiled, "How could I trouble Boss Zhou to personally welcome me?"
Zhou Yitian laughed heartily, "Mr. Lin, it’s only appropriate that we welcome you."
Everyone was dumbfounded.
What?
Zhou Yitian was actually not welcoming Zhao Jiahao, but Lin Fan?
What’s going on here?
The classmates were suddenly very embarrassed, each breaking out in a cold sweat.
What the heck!
Turns out they flattered the wrong person again!
Being wishy-washy like them was really tough.
Sun Xiaona’s face turned pale again, this was a real slap in the face. She had just boasted that Zhou Yitian came to welcome her boyfriend, but turns out he didn’t care about her boyfriend at all.
Even more striking is that it wasn’t her boyfriend, but rather Lin Fan!
Where could she hide her face?
Sun Xiaona couldn’t help but say, "Boss Zhou, have you mistaken someone? This person, he’s just a dead delivery guy!"
Zhou Yitian heard that, glanced back at Sun Xiaona, and maintained his courtesy, "Miss, Mr. Lin Fan is my esteemed guest. Please show some respect in your words, otherwise, our venue reserves the right to refuse you service."
Sun Xiaona was surprised, apparently, Zhou Yitian hadn’t mistaken the person.
Sun Xiaona pointed at Lin Fan, "He’s your esteemed guest? For what reason?"
Zhou Yitian smiled, "Simply because Mr. Lin Fan spent a million tonight to reserve our entire venue, allowing everyone to enjoy themselves. Tonight, all rooms and drinks are complimentary to customers. If this lady wishes to do the same, she too can become an esteemed guest."
With these words, silence fell over the venue, and everyone was dumbstruck.
Reserving the KTV for a million!
That’s quite a move, isn’t it!
This is absolutely the act of a wealthy tycoon!
On the way to Ginza KTV, Lin Fan called the front desk to reserve the entire KTV.
This maneuver brought Boss Zhou Yitian out personally. It was the first time Ginza encountered such a lavish customer.
Zhou Yitian didn’t know why Lin Fan did this, but when he saw Lin Fan’s car, he felt the reason wasn’t important anymore. For someone who could drive that car, a million was nothing, possibly like ten bucks to an ordinary person. Do you need a reason to spend ten bucks on something?
Only Chen Lingling understood that Lin Fan did this to help her save face.
Chen Lingling was deeply touched, Brother Lin spent a million for her without blinking, he was really good to her.
"Sun Xiaona, you said this car wasn’t mine, you said I didn’t have money. Do you still think so?"
Lin Fan looked towards Sun Xiaona with a slight smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 Sun Xiaona Causes Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21 Sun Xiaona Causes Trouble
Sun Xiaona’s face was flushed red, the facts were right in front of her, and she had no room to argue anymore.
Sun Xiaona realized she had been played by Lin Fan and Chen Lingling. Lin Fan was not a delivery guy at all; he was really a super-rich second generation!
Lin Fan deliberately pretended to be a delivery guy just to confuse Sun Xiaona and embarrass her.
It must be this way!
Thinking about this, Sun Xiaona was furious. She always thought Chen Lingling was a naive and innocent girl, but who knew Chen Lingling would play her like this today.
Wait!
No, she understood Chen Lingling; Chen Lingling shouldn’t be so cunning.
It could only be Lin Fan!
Lin Fan was helping Chen Lingling vent her frustration by extravagantly spending a million to book Ginza!
There was nothing about Chen Lingling that was superior to her, so why could she attract someone like Lin Fan, a super-rich second generation!
An overwhelming jealousy surged in Sun Xiaona’s heart.
"Chen Lingling, I thought you were so simple, but it turns out you were just pretending. Aren’t you just like me, finding a rich man!"
Sun Xiaona sneered.
Chen Lingling quickly said, "I am not!"
She didn’t want others to misunderstand that she liked Lin Fan because he was rich.
Sun Xiaona said, "Stop making excuses. If you didn’t specifically go looking, with your family background, how would you have the chance to meet a super-rich second generation?"
The classmates thought Sun Xiaona made sense, but since Chen Lingling had a super-rich second-generation boyfriend, they didn’t dare offend her, only giving her somewhat ambiguous looks.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It looks like I need to explain a bit. Currently, I’m experiencing life, indeed working as a delivery guy. When Lingling and I fell in love, she didn’t know I was rich. Sun Xiaona, don’t drag Lingling into this; Lingling is very pure, unlike you who shamelessly admits to being money-driven."
As he spoke, Lin Fan glanced at Zhao Jiahao beside him.
Zhao Jiahao felt a bit awkward. Knowing Lin Fan was a super-rich second generation, although he didn’t know Lin Fan’s exact identity, he dared not easily offend him.
He could only give an awkward smile and gave Lin Fan a "you know" look, pleading for him to let him off.
Lin Fan understood. Zhao Jiahao and Sun Xiaona both knew in their hearts that one was greedy for money and the other for looks.
"You!" Sun Xiaona was choked with anger.
She never minded others saying she was money-driven because she indeed was.
But she couldn’t accept that Chen Lingling’s boyfriend was richer than hers, and worse, they were truly in love!
She couldn’t accept that Chen Lingling was doing better than her.
With Lin Fan’s words, the misunderstanding was cleared, revealing that Chen Lingling chose to be with Lin Fan in his delivery guy identity without knowing he was rich.
For a moment, everyone envied Chen Lingling immensely; she was so lucky.
"Lingling, congratulations on finding true love."
"Sister Lingling, it must be such a surprise to suddenly find out the person you like is rich!"
"Too envious of Lingling, why can’t I meet such a boyfriend!"
The classmates gathered around Chen Lingling, showering her with praises. This time, Lin Fan’s identity as a super-rich second generation was confirmed, and they finally felt safe enough to praise Chen Lingling.
Zhou Yitian also understood at this point that Lin Fan spent a million to please his girlfriend. Mr. Lin Fan is truly a good man.
Then, Zhou Yitian personally led Lin Fan and others to Ginza’s most luxurious Emperor’s Hall, which was extremely spacious and opulent.
Zhou Yitian respectfully said, "Mr. Lin Fan, this is your room for tonight. Are you satisfied?"
Lin Fan nodded, expressing satisfaction.
"Then I won’t disturb you. I hope everyone has a good time," Zhou Yitian said as he took his leave.
The classmates were overjoyed!
The rooms at Ginza are divided into Emperor’s Hall, Queen’s Hall, General Hall, and regular rooms, with Emperor’s Hall being the most top-tier. It’s said that just the room fee costs a hundred thousand a night, not affordable for the average person.
They originally only booked a regular room, but now by following Lin Fan, they’ve benefited and come to the legendary Emperor’s Hall, simply too amazing.
The classmates were even more eager to flatter Chen Lingling, desperately trying to get close to super-rich second generation Lin Fan, completely leaving Sun Xiaona and Zhao Jiahao out in the cold.
Sun Xiaona saw that the spotlight that was supposed to be hers was completely stolen by Chen Lingling, and she was almost driven mad with jealousy.
She wouldn’t accept losing to Chen Lingling like this.
"Recently, everyone found jobs, and I successfully got an offer from Jingdong. Chen Lingling, have you found a job yet?"
Sun Xiaona asked loudly.
Everyone suddenly quieted down, looking at Chen Lingling.
"I..." Chen Lingling blushed. She hadn’t found a job yet.
After all, Jingdong is a Huaxia top 500 company, and Sun Xiaona actually got into Jingdong.
This round, Sun Xiaona scored a complete victory.
Sun Xiaona laughed wantonly, "Chen Lingling, it looks like you haven’t found a job. Are you planning to rely on your boyfriend to support you? Those four years of college were a waste?"
Chen Lingling felt a bit embarrassed, not knowing how to reply to Sun Xiaona.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Lingling, what kind of job do you want?"
