Chen Lingling hesitated and said, "I... I like anime and always wanted to make my own anime, but I lack work experience. I interviewed with a few anime companies but haven’t heard back..."
Sun Xiaona laughed loudly, "That’s called overestimating yourself; of course, they wouldn’t want you."
But Lin Fan said, "Lingling, it’s okay. I’ll just buy an anime company, and you can be the boss. Wouldn’t that solve everything?"
Everyone was stunned.
Just to let Chen Lingling get a job at an anime company, Lin Fan was actually going to buy one!
What kind of move was that? It was insanely extravagant!
Being rich is truly remarkable; is this the world of the wealthy?
The classmates were about to cry from envy.
Chen Lingling was pleasantly surprised; she never expected Lin Fan to actually buy an anime company for her.
Sun Xiaona’s face turned ashen, and for a moment, she was speechless, like a beaten eggplant, she wilted.
Though she got into Jingdong, she was just a minor employee, while Chen Lingling was going to be the boss of an anime company!
She originally wanted to make things difficult for Chen Lingling but ended up making it hard for herself.
The classmates witnessed Lin Fan’s extravagance and were even more eager to get close, circling around Chen Lingling, trying to establish a good relationship.
Sun Xiaona became entirely marginalized.
Sun Xiaona finally recovered but was still unwilling to admit defeat to Chen Lingling. Her eyes rolled, and she came up with another plan.
Sun Xiaona picked up the mic, showed a smile, and said, "How could we come to karaoke tonight and not sing? Jiahao once won a city singing competition; let’s have him sing a song for everyone."
Without further ado, Sun Xiaona handed the mic to Zhao Jiahao.
Zhao Jiahao had been overshadowed by Lin Fan all night and felt quite displeased, so he took the opportunity to showcase his talent.
Then he happily took the mic and sang a song. Indeed, as a singing competition champion, his voice was excellent.
At the end of the song, the classmates couldn’t help but clap and cheer.
Sun Xiaona felt proud and looked at Chen Lingling. "Chen Lingling, why don’t you have Lin Fan sing a song too?"
Sun Xiaona sneered inwardly, thinking Lin Fan might be impressive, but could he be better than a singing competition champion? This time, she was determined to make Chen Lingling lose face!
Chen Lingling looked at Lin Fan with some hesitation; she didn’t know whether Lin Fan could sing. If Brother Lin was tone-deaf, it would be embarrassing.
But then Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Singing, huh? Okay, I’ll just give it a shot."

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Director’s Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22: Director’s Invitation
Zhao Jiahao finished a song and garnered waves of applause. There’s no denying that Zhao Jiahao sang well and truly deserved to be the champion of the Yun City singing competition.
Sun Xiaona had been embarrassed multiple times tonight and hoped to rely on Zhao Jiahao to turn the tables, confident of success.
She thought that even if Lin Fan could sing, there was no way he would be better than Zhao Jiahao. This time, Zhao Jiahao would definitely win completely.
She even believed that after Zhao Jiahao’s performance, Lin Fan wouldn’t even have the courage to sing, as Zhao Jiahao was just too excellent, making Lin Fan feel inferior.
However, Lin Fan agreed without hesitation.
Sun Xiaona sneered, "Since you want to disgrace yourself, I won’t stop you."
For a moment, everyone quieted down, waiting to hear Lin Fan sing.
Chen Lingling was sweating for Lin Fan. After all, Zhao Jiahao did sing quite well, and if Lin Fan sang poorly, Sun Xiaona would definitely mock him.
She didn’t want Brother Lin to be embarrassed.
Everyone thought that although Lin Fan was richer than Zhao Jiahao, he probably couldn’t sing better than him. Zhao Jiahao was, after all, a singing champion.
Zhao Jiahao himself was also looking forward to Lin Fan’s performance. He had been overshadowed by Lin Fan in every aspect tonight, and finally felt he could recover some superiority in singing.
Zhao Jiahao impatiently asked, "Brother Fan, what song do you want to sing?"
Lin Fan said, "I’ll just sing ’A New Dream of Butterflies and Lovers’
Zhao Jiahao immediately helped Lin Fan select the song.
The music started.
Lin Fan picked up the mic and began to sing.
"Yesterday flows like the eastward water, leaving me, unable to stay. Today my mind is troubled, with so many worries."
"Draw the sword to cut water, but it flows even more. Raise a glass to resolve sorrow, but sorrow only deepens. Tomorrow the fresh breeze drifts far and wide..."
The magnetic voice began to resonate gently.
In an instant.
Everyone was stunned.
Holy shit!
This is way too good, oh my God, someone can actually sing this well!
Such a charming voice, listening to it made you just get lost in it!
Everyone was on their knees.
Chen Lingling was completely intoxicated by Lin Fan’s singing. Brother Lin wasn’t just invincibly handsome, his singing was also so good, it was like an immortal singing, as if listening to celestial music! She had never heard someone sing so beautifully!
Lin Fan’s voice was even better than the "Song God" of the music industry.
Zhao Jiahao’s face was already pale. His voice, which he was so proud of, was nothing in front of Lin Fan. Lin Fan’s singing ability and vocal quality utterly surpassed him by miles!
Lin Fan was just too outstanding, he completely lost!
Even Sun Xiaona, who was waiting to find fault, looked utterly shocked, as if she was enchanted by Lin Fan’s singing and couldn’t snap out of it for a moment.
The time it took to sing a song flew by, and once Lin Fan finished, he put down the mic.
The whole room fell silent.
Everyone was momentarily unable to come back to their senses.
It was simply too beautiful.
The lingering sound left everyone speechless!
At this moment, someone knocked and entered. It was a middle-aged man who came directly to Lin Fan and handed him a business card with a big smile.
"Hello, sir. I’m Xu Cheng, the director from Wind Bird Music Company, and this is my business card."
"I unintentionally heard you singing in the hallway just now and was immediately captivated by your voice. I really want to know what kind of genius you are?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Just take a look at what I’m wearing. I’m a delivery guy."
Xu Cheng was stunned. It is said that masters walk among us, and indeed, a delivery guy could actually sing so beautifully. Plus, he’s so handsome. With just a bit of packaging, the future would be limitless; this time, I’ve truly found a gem.
"Sir, would you be interested in entering the entertainment industry as a pop star? I can provide you with all the help you need. As long as you sign with our Wind Bird Music, I can guarantee that you’ll become the hottest star in the future, even replacing the current Song God’s status! If you are willing, I can draft a contract for you immediately."
Xu Cheng spoke passionately.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Jiahao nearly went mad.
Wind Bird Music is one of the most powerful music companies in the industry right now!
Many people would do anything to get into Wind Bird, and Zhao Jiahao dreams of getting in, but even though he has won a city-level singing championship, he hasn’t caught Wind Bird’s attention.
Wind Bird is notoriously stringent in selecting talent, and ordinary people hardly get a second glance.
Now, the director of Wind Bird Music personally extended an invitation to Lin Fan. No, this wasn’t even an invitation; it was more like pleading with Lin Fan.
They even want to sign him immediately, fearing that Lin Fan might slip away.
Comparing oneself to others is truly infuriating.
Zhao Jiahao was utterly deflated.
He thought about how he wanted to compete with Lin Fan before, only now realizing that he didn’t even qualify to compete; Lin Fan was just too strong.
"Oh my God, the director of one of the top three music companies, Wind Bird Music, personally extending an invitation, that’s just too much prestige!"
"The director’s discerning eye must be right. If Lin Fan becomes a star, the Song God wouldn’t stand a chance."
"Lin Fan should accept this, right? After all, it’s Wind Bird, which has propelled many singers to fame. Who wouldn’t want to join Wind Bird?"
The classmates all began discussing, but this time, it wasn’t flattery; they were genuinely conquered by Lin Fan’s singing.
Just when everyone thought Lin Fan would gladly accept.
Lin Fan casually replied, "Becoming a pop star? Sorry, not interested. I’d rather continue delivering food."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan actually turned down Xu Cheng!
Zhao Jiahao felt like he was going to spit blood. Oh God, the opportunity he dreamed of, Lin Fan just rejected it as if it were nothing more than a cabbage.
Lin Fan, you really have to be so defiant!
Zhao Jiahao’s inner voice roared.
Xu Cheng was also stunned. He never imagined that his personal invitation would be rejected!
He wasn’t in the habit of inviting people lightly. Good talents were hard to find, and he hadn’t personally invited anyone in a long time.
This time was purely accidental; he happened to pass by and heard Lin Fan singing. As soon as Lin Fan opened his mouth, he was captivated, as if gaining a priceless treasure.
Without even thinking, he had the intention of signing Lin Fan and was determined to get Lin Fan at any cost.
He thought that with his standing in the music industry, a personal invitation would surely be accepted by Lin Fan.
Who knew that Lin Fan would reject it so offhandedly!
Xu Cheng was almost in tears. He really didn’t want to lose this treasure.
"Sir, won’t you reconsider? The music industry really needs your voice now; your presence would save the Chinese music industry. If you don’t accept, it would be the greatest loss in the last decade of the industry. Please, think it over?"
Xu Cheng pleaded, almost ready to kneel.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you, Director Xu, for your kind offer, but I really have no desire to become a pop star. I’m sorry."
Xu Cheng was very dejected; it seemed Lin Fan truly did not want to become a star. It was a huge pity.
Xu Cheng said, "Sir, please keep my business card. If you change your mind, feel free to contact me. By the way, I haven’t had the chance to ask for your distinguished name yet?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m just a nobody; Mr. Xu doesn’t need to press further."
Xu Cheng sighed inwardly. Lin Fan was unwilling to even disclose his name, showing he was determined not to debut.
Xu Cheng grudgingly took his leave.
That evening, Xu Cheng called a good friend to share his frustration: "Tonight, I met a musical genius. I wanted to invite him to our company, but he turned me down."
On the other end, Liu Mengjie’s voice came: "What a coincidence, I also met a piano genius today. I wanted to invite him to our school as a piano teacher, and he also turned me down."
Xu Cheng chuckled bitterly and said, "It seems we are indeed in the same boat."

chapters.title: Chapter 23 New Rewards and System Tasks
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23 New Rewards and System Tasks
Brother Fan refused the music director, which surprised everyone greatly, but for Brother Fan, it was nothing worth mentioning, as he truly had no interest in becoming a pop star.
He was originally tone deaf, but it was the system that rewarded him with top-level musical talent.
Tonight, he didn’t even plan to showcase his singing, but Sun Xiaona forced him. Sun Xiaona insisted on showing off in front of him, so he used his skills to shut her up.
After Xu Cheng left, Sun Xiaona really didn’t say another word. She seemed completely subdued by Brother Fan and remained silent until the party ended.
Once the gathering dispersed, Sun Xiaona and Zhao Jiahao hurriedly got into a Benz and left.
Sun Xiaona suddenly said, "Let’s break up."
Zhao Jiahao’s face changed: "You’re blaming me for not singing as well as Brother Fan?"
Sun Xiaona chuckled, "Brother Fan doesn’t just sing better than you, in what way are you better than him?"
Zhao Jiahao sneered, "I admit Brother Fan is better than me, but so what? Just because he’s better, you’re going to break up with me?"
Sun Xiaona said, "Exactly, I, Sun Xiaona, said before, I’ll marry only the best man."
Zhao Jiahao fumed, "So you mean, you’re planning to become Brother Fan’s woman?"
This is so freaking melodramatic!
Sun Xiaona snorted, "Why should Chen Lingling live better than me? She doesn’t deserve such an outstanding man like Brother Fan, only I do!"
Since hearing Brother Fan sing, Sun Xiaona has been completely captivated by him. It’s her first time encountering such an exceptional man.
She is determined to win this man over.
Brother Fan naturally didn’t know that Sun Xiaona was planning to chase after him.
After the party, Brother Fan drove the Kosak, taking Chen Lingling home.
"Lingling, did I perform well as your boyfriend tonight?" Brother Fan asked with a smile.
Chen Lingling’s face was bright red, and she nodded. This evening, Brother Fan gave her too many surprises, allowing her to truly bask in glory in front of Sun Xiaona.
"Brother Lin, I’m really grateful to you this time," Chen Lingling said.
Brother Fan replied, "You’re welcome. Since I promised to help you, I definitely wouldn’t let you suffer."
Chen Lingling was somewhat smitten; Brother Lin was so good to her. Could it be that Brother Lin also likes her?
Her face blushed, and her heart beat faster.
If Brother Lin really became her boyfriend, she would die of happiness.
She seemed to want to ask Brother Lin, Brother Lin, do you like me?
Brother Fan glanced at her, "Why is your face so red? What are you thinking?"
Chen Lingling panicked internally, afraid to ask directly, so she quickly changed the topic: "Brother Lin, I didn’t expect you to sing so wonderfully, even better than those pop stars."
Brother Fan said, "If you like listening, I’ll sing for you more often."
Chen Lingling was very happy, "Sure."
After a brief silence, Chen Lingling asked again, "By the way, Brother Lin, you said you want to buy an animation company and let me be the boss. You were just fooling Sun Xiaona, right?"
When Sun Xiaona laughed at her for not finding a job, Brother Fan, knowing she wanted to work in animation, said he would buy an animation company and make her the boss.
She thought Brother Fan surely wouldn’t actually do that.
Brother Fan said, "I’m not sure yet. Maybe I’ll really buy one."
Chen Lingling was stunned, no way, Brother Lin wasn’t joking, he really was considering buying an animation company!
In fact, Brother Fan was just unsure. Who knows, maybe the system will reward him with an animation company in the future.
If the system does give such a reward, there’d be no harm in letting Chen Lingling be the boss.
He quite liked this beautifully innocent young lady, that’s why he went out of his way to help her against Sun Xiaona tonight.
Of course, booking out the KTV for a million isn’t much for Brother Fan; he has a trillion in savings, and a million is just like a hundred dollars to an ordinary person.
As they talked, they had already arrived at the entrance of Lijing District.
Chen Lingling mustered the courage to ask, "Brother Lin, do you... want to come up to my place for a cup of tea?"
Brother Fan had his sister at home on his mind and replied without thinking, "It’s too late, I’ve got to hurry home."
"Alright then..." Chen Lingling got out of the car, slightly disappointed.
She had invited Brother Fan up, but he declined. Being thin-skinned, she dared not linger, and quickly left in embarrassment.
Brother Fan paused, suddenly realizing he might have missed a great opportunity.
"Damn it!"
Brother Fan regretted it endlessly and could only sigh deeply as he drove home.
He returned to the apartment late at night.
Lin Shanshan was just about to go to bed.
"Bro, I’m going for my interview at the music academy tomorrow, you have to take me," she said and went back to her room.
Brother Fan hastily took a shower and went to bed.
He slept deeply until dawn.
As Brother Fan woke up groggily, he heard the system’s inquiry.
"Ding!"
"Today you can receive a 30% share of the Golden Capital Group by signing in. Would you like to sign in?"
Brother Fan sat up straight in bed, wide awake.
He quickly checked his phone for information about the Golden Capital Group, a group mainly dealing in hotel and catering, it was actually a trillion-scale group!
This reward is indeed amazing!
Wait a minute!
Jindu Grand Hotel, wasn’t that where the class reunion was tonight? Brother Fan muttered.
Then Brother Fan had a big question—how would the system give him stock in the Golden Capital Group?
Never mind that for now, just sign in first.
"Sign in!"
"Congratulations, host, the 30% share of the Golden Capital Group has been transferred and is now your asset."
And it’s not over yet!
"Ding!"
"The system task has officially started. Would the host like to check?"
Brother Fan was taken aback, a system task?
This sign-in system actually has task releases?
Brother Fan quickly said, "Check."
Soon, an attribute page appeared in front of Brother Fan.
"System Main Task: Please build a trillion-dollar business empire."
"Progress: 0/100"
Brother Fan was shocked. No way, the system wants him to build a trillion-dollar business empire, this task is way too daunting!
Brother Fan chuckled bitterly, "How the heck am I supposed to build that?"
"As long as the host persists in signing in every day, the system will help complete the task."
Brother Fan laughed, "Now you’ve said it, that’s all I need."
Brother Fan pondered it over. The system just rewarded him with 30% of a trillion-dollar group, this must be related to building a trillion-dollar business empire...
Meanwhile.
At the headquarters of the Golden Capital Group, in the Chairman’s office.
Chairman Tang Jinhong’s expression was a bit solemn.
Tang Jinhong, as both the Chairman and the largest shareholder, is also the founder of the group.
He had spent his life’s work managing the Golden Capital.
Just now, he received shocking news: 30% of the Golden Capital Group’s shares had been transferred to one person’s name, second only to his 51% share, instantly making this person the second-largest shareholder of the Golden Capital.
This person’s name was Brother Fan!
Tang Jinhong knew nothing about this Brother Fan!
But regardless of who Brother Fan was, with his status as the second largest shareholder, he was already a significant figure in Golden Capital.
He called his most trusted subordinate, Li He, the person in charge of the Jindu Grand Hotel.
"Help me investigate this Brother Fan’s identity. Before we get to the bottom of him, under no circumstances are we to offend him. Make sure to treat him well," Tang Jinhong instructed.
Li He said, "Understood, Chairman, I’ll get right on it."
Brother Fan was still unaware that Tang Jinhong had taken notice of him.
After getting up, he drove the Kosak to take Lin Shanshan to the music academy.
Lin Shanshan was a bit curious, wondering when her brother made such a wealthy friend who lent him a supercar?
Lin Shanshan said, "Bro, aren’t you going to return the car?"
Brother Fan said, "Return it to whom? This car is mine."
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, you haven’t even returned the car to the owner yet? I already told Little Lu that your car was borrowed from someone, so if you don’t want to be looked down on, just return it after a while."
Brother Fan chuckled and took out the vehicle registration, handing it to Lin Shanshan.
She was stunned to see it was under Brother Fan’s name.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 Lin Fan’s Assistant
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24 Lin Fan’s Assistant
Yun City Music Academy, this is the only music academy in Yun City, with a large scale, having cultivated many outstanding musical talents.
Today is the new student interview day, and a crowd had gathered at the school entrance early in the morning.
Students attending the music academy generally come from well-off families; wealthy families are not in the minority.
At this time, a number of luxury cars were parked outside the school.
However, in front of the Kosak, these luxury cars paled in comparison. When the Kosak appeared, it immediately became the center of attention, drawing the gaze of the crowd.
"Which super family’s child is this?"
Everyone grew curious.
They watched as the car door of the Kosak opened, and Lin Fan and Lin Shanshan stepped out.
"This boy is so handsome, and the girl is stunning too!"
The crowd was amazed.
Despite Lin Fan and Lin Shanshan’s ordinary attire, it did not detract from their good looks in the slightest.
Today Lin Fan was not wearing his delivery uniform but regular clothes, which he had previously bought from a street stall for a few dozen bucks.
"So wealthy, yet so down-to-earth, this guy is really handsome!"
Several girls had starry eyes.
If a poor person wears stall-bought clothes, they are just poor. But if a wealthy person wears them, they are seen as down-to-earth.
Poverty is the original sin.
As long as you have money, you can get praised for anything.
Everyone assumed Lin Fan was rich, so even if he wore stall-bought clothes, he was considered low-key and approachable.
Only Cheng Xiaolu cast a disdainful glance at Lin Fan.
Yesterday Shanshan told her that this Kosak belonged to someone else and that Lin Fan was just a poor guy wearing stall-bought clothes!
Keep pretending, go on! I’ll expose you in public and embarrass you!
Cheng Xiaolu made up her mind. She was still holding a grudge because Lin Fan didn’t let her get in the car yesterday.
"Lin Fan, how long have you borrowed this supercar? Why haven’t you returned it yet?" Cheng Xiaolu deliberately said loudly.
Everyone was a bit surprised. What, this car doesn’t belong to this guy? It’s only borrowed?
Lin Shanshan quickly gave Cheng Xiaolu a look, signaling her to stop talking. She had just checked the vehicle registration and was still in shock.
Even though it seemed unbelievable why her brother had so much money, the car was indeed his!
Cheng Xiaolu didn’t notice Lin Shanshan’s gaze and thought Lin Fan’s silence was due to guilt, becoming even more pleased with herself.
"What’s wrong, cat got your tongue? See, your true face has been exposed, how are you going to show off now!" Cheng Xiaolu said triumphantly.
Lin Shanshan hurried to Cheng Xiaolu, lowered her voice, and said, "Little Lu, please stop, the car is indeed my brother’s. I got it wrong yesterday."
Cheng Xiaolu was taken aback and said incredulously, "Shanshan, don’t lie to me. Are you just trying to save your brother’s face?"
Lin Shanshan said, "No, I’m protecting your face."
If she didn’t stop Cheng Xiaolu, it would be Cheng Xiaolu who ended up embarrassed.
Cheng Xiaolu frowned, "Your brother is just a delivery guy, how could this car be his?"
Lin Shanshan said, "Although I don’t understand either, I’ve seen the car registration, and it does belong to my brother. Little Lu, you know I never lie to you."
"What?" Cheng Xiaolu was shocked.
Lin Shanshan was indeed her best friend. If there was anyone in this world who wouldn’t lie to her, it would definitely be Lin Shanshan.
At this moment, they suddenly saw a black Bentley driving over, stopping at the side. The car door opened, and a middle-aged man in a suit, carrying a briefcase, got out.
This man came directly in front of Lin Fan, bowed and greeted him with great respect.
"Mr. Lin Fan, hello. I am Li He, the general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel under Golden Capital Group. You have successfully acquired 30% of Golden Capital Group’s shares, becoming the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital. I’ve completed the formalities for you; you just need to sign, and here’s your equity certificate."
Li He took out a document from his briefcase and handed it to Lin Fan with both hands.
Upon hearing this, everyone present was stunned.
Golden Capital Group!
This is a hundred-billion group!
The young man in front of them actually owns 30% of Golden Capital’s shares!
What does that mean?
It means that the young man is at least a billionaire!
A billionaire driving a multi-million supercar is not surprising at all.
Lin Fan was taken aback. This morning, the system had rewarded him with 30% of Golden Capital’s shares, and he was curious about how he received this reward.
Turns out the system had already arranged everything for him.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Mr. Li, is it? Thank you for your trouble."
He then calmly took the document, quickly glanced through it, found no issues, and signed his name.
He officially owned 30% of Golden Capital Group’s shares!
Li He smiled flatteringly and said, "Mr. Lin Fan, as our second-largest shareholder, you can just call me Xiaoli. The chairman has instructed me that if you ever need anything, just let me know. I will be your exclusive assistant at Golden Capital Group from now on."
What?
The general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel being an assistant to Lin Fan?
This sounded a bit far-fetched, but now that Lin Fan was the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital, it was entirely plausible.
But Lin Fan wasn’t a fool either. Li He was personally appointed by the chairman Tang Jinhong, probably with some hidden agenda.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "You’re older than me. How could I call you Xiaoli? Let me call you Uncle Li. Uncle Li, please thank the chairman for me. I’ll visit the company to meet him when I have the chance."
Lin Fan didn’t know what Tang Jinhong’s intentions were, so he decided to keep Li He around and observe for now. As the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital, even Tang Jinhong wouldn’t dare to act rashly against him.
Li He respectfully said, "Alright, does Mr. Lin have any other instructions?"
Lin Fan said, "No, that’s all."
Li He said, "Then I won’t disturb you any longer. I’ll take my leave."
"Wait!"
Lin Fan suddenly remembered something and called out to Li He, "You said you’re the general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel?"
Li He said, "Yes."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Tonight, I have a class reunion at Jindu Grand Hotel."
Lin Fan didn’t elaborate further, but Li He understood.
"Got it, Mr. Lin. I know what to do." Li He said respectfully, bowed to Lin Fan once more, and then left.
Lin Fan turned to look for Lin Shanshan.
Only to find Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu already standing there in awe.
If there was any shred of doubt before, witnessing that scene just now left no room for doubt.
Lin Fan was really wealthy!
And not just wealthy—super wealthy!
Lin Fan walked over to Lin Shanshan and said, "What are you standing around for? Go in for your interview already."
As for Cheng Xiaolu, Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered. He didn’t like this gold-digging girl.
"Okay." Lin Shanshan snapped back to reality and responded instinctively.
Cheng Xiaolu also returned to her senses, embarrassed, and said, "Brother Fan, I was wrong; I shouldn’t have misunderstood you. Can you forgive me?"
Seeing this, those around began to talk.
"That girl just now said his car was borrowed, how embarrassing."
"You can’t judge a book by its cover; despite his stall-bought clothes, he’s actually a billionaire, talk about a face slap."
"I think she’s the real pauper. Look at her plain clothes—how does she even have the face to look down on others?"
Listening to these comments, Cheng Xiaolu felt her face burn and wished the ground would swallow her whole.
Lin Fan ignored Cheng Xiaolu and took Lin Shanshan by the arm, heading into the school.
Cheng Xiaolu hurriedly followed, saying insistently, "Brother Fan, I’m sorry, I shouldn’t have misunderstood you. Please forgive me."
"Shanshan, help me plead with him?" Cheng Xiaolu pleaded.
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, I was the one who told Little Lu that your car was borrowed last night, so she misunderstood you. For my sake, forgive her."
Lin Fan nodded, "Alright."
He didn’t say another word. In fact, he wasn’t angry with Cheng Xiaolu, because he understood that she wouldn’t get anything from him hereafter. Even if she tried hard to cling to him, he simply didn’t like her.
Cheng Xiaolu, however, thought Lin Fan had forgiven her, and, feeling as though she had secured a big advantage, beamed with hope.
Lin Shanshan still felt like she was dreaming and couldn’t help but ask, "Brother, how did you suddenly become so rich?"
"Is it because... Are you my real brother, or did you suddenly become rich somewhere?"
Lin Fan laughed awkwardly; this girl’s imagination was quite amusing: "Don’t be silly, I’m your real brother. You know you can’t marry me."

chapters.title: Chapter 25 Music Exam
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25 Music Exam
Shanshan’s face flushed; if Lin Fan weren’t her actual brother, she would have wanted to marry him—he is so wealthy, after all.
But it wasn’t too bad now; having a wealthy brother.
"So what’s going on with you, really?" Shanshan asked, still not giving up.
Lin Fan replied casually, "I can’t say right now, but I’ll tell you when there’s a chance."
The interview was held in a large hall, where parents could accompany the candidates. Several judges sat on the stage, and candidates went up one by one for their interviews.
The main focus of the test was impromptu singing or impromptu playing of instruments.
The judges would score based on the candidates’ performances.
"Cheng Xiaolu!"
One of the judges called her name.
Cheng Xiaolu confidently walked up, introduced herself, and then began to sing.
Her voice was quite sweet, and she sang well, causing the judges to nod frequently in approval.
Watching Cheng Xiaolu’s exam, Shanshan began to feel nervous, slightly trembling.
Lin Fan comforted her, "Don’t be nervous; it’s okay, I believe in your abilities."
He had watched his sister grow up and knew she had great musical talent. Singing was no problem for her. He could have used Liu Mengjie’s connections to get her an easy pass, but he chose not to take that shortcut because he believed in her.
Shanshan finally calmed down and smiled, "Brother, I’m so glad you came with me."
Cheng Xiaolu quickly finished her exam and walked off the stage with confidence.
"Lin Shanshan!"
Finally, it was Shanshan’s turn.
Shanshan took a deep breath and walked onto the stage.
Her beauty immediately caught the attention of everyone present; it had to be said that just by appearance alone, Shanshan had the potential to become a star.
The judges unanimously agreed that Shanshan had a good appearance.
Now, it all depended on her musical talent.
Shanshan introduced herself: "Hello, teachers, my name is Lin Shanshan, I’m seventeen this year, and I’m applying for the pop music program."
The judge asked, "Student Lin Shanshan, we need you to sing a pop song on the spot. You may begin."
Shanshan said, "I want to sing Jay Chou’s ’Fireworks Easily Cold.’"
The crowd was abuzz; this song was quite challenging, and it wasn’t easy to sing it well, especially given how the original was a masterpiece few could surpass.
Everyone was curious about Shanshan’s performance.
Shanshan took a deep breath and began to sing.
"The bustling sound fades into silence, shattering the world’s illusions."
"A dream grows cold, wandering through life, how many emotional debts are there..."
Shanshan’s rendition of the song was entirely different from the original, giving it a completely new feeling.
However, she was only halfway through when the judges abruptly stopped her.
Shanshan had to stop, looking bewildered at the judges.
Judge A: "Sorry, but I believe this song is entirely unsuitable for you; you’ve completely ruined the mood of this song."
Judge B: "You should listen more to the original version. Although the original singer slurs his words, it precisely creates that vague and mournful atmosphere."
Judge C: "But your singing completely lacks any mournfulness. We feel you don’t understand this song at all. If you insist on singing it this way, your score might not be ideal. We can give you a chance to change your song."
Shanshan frowned and said, "Teachers, I feel I didn’t have any issues with my singing. I’m interpreting it in my own way."
Judge A was a bit impatient: "Why are you being so stubborn? Your approach is wrong, understand?"
Shanshan bit her lip; she didn’t feel her approach was wrong, but the judges said she was, which made her wonder how to argue back.
Arguing might result in failing the interview.
But Shanshan wasn’t the type to give in easily.
For a moment, the scene became somewhat awkward.
Cheng Xiaolu was nearly frantic with worry.
She and Shanshan were good friends, having planned to study music together at this school. If Shanshan failed the interview, they wouldn’t be able to attend school together.
Cheng Xiaolu asked Lin Fan, "What should we do? Maybe we should convince Shanshan to change her song?"
Lin Fan shook his head and stepped forward, saying loudly, "Excuse me for interrupting, but I think she sang perfectly fine!"
As soon as he said this, the entire audience fell silent, with everyone turning to look at Lin Fan.
Thoughts ran through everyone’s minds.
Some females were smitten, thinking Lin Fan was so handsome.
Some people outside earlier knew Lin Fan was a billionaire, now curious if this billionaire also knew music?
Most people just wanted to see how Lin Fan would counter the judges.
The three judges exchanged glances.
Judge A stated seriously, "Please follow the examination rules; it’s not your turn yet, and you can’t interrupt."
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m not a candidate; I’m Lin Shanshan’s brother, here to accompany her for the exam."
The three judges immediately looked displeased.
Judge B: "What nonsense. You’re a parent, so you definitely can’t interrupt at will. It’s not your place to speak here; do you think you understand music better than us?"
"Brother..."
Shanshan’s emotions were complicated.
She knew her brother was tone-deaf, a complete music idiot. He was only standing up for her.
But by doing this, her brother was unable to help her and might even harm her.
Judge A: "Please, parent, step back a little and don’t disrupt the exam order."
Shanshan advised, "Brother, please stop. I can handle this. Teachers, I’ve decided not to change the song and to continue interpreting it my way."
The three judges shook their heads vigorously.
Judge A: "You’re really stubborn!"
Judge B: "If you insist on the wrong approach, then we can only regretfully tell you that you failed the interview."
Upon hearing this, Shanshan’s face turned pale.
How could she handle this alone? The relationship between her and the interview judges was not equal, with her fate entirely in their hands.
Cheng Xiaolu was also very disappointed, not expecting Shanshan to fail.
Just when everyone thought Shanshan had already failed.
Lin Fan spoke again, "Three judges, my sister’s singing does indeed have a problem."
Upon hearing this, everyone was stunned. What, this brother changed his stance so quickly and now was pointing the gun at his sister?
Judge A smiled, "You realized she had a problem?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, her problem is encountering three judges who don’t know how to appreciate her."
The room erupted in laughter.
Cheng Xiaolu couldn’t help but giggle. Brother Fan was too humorous; they thought he was changing his stance, but he was actually mocking the three judges.
Shanshan felt both sad and touched; her brother, although tone-deaf, was trying hard to defend her.
The three judges’ faces darkened.
Judge A angrily said, "Sir, are you here to cause trouble? Please leave immediately."
Lin Fan said, "I want to perform this song using my sister’s style; if you still think it doesn’t work, I’ll immediately take my sister away!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked that Lin Fan wanted to sing?
The three judges were amused; since the founding of the music academy, this was the first time a candidate’s parent wanted to sing in the interview hall!
After a bit of discussion, Judge A said, "Parent, if you’re seeking humiliation, we’ll give you a chance."
Lin Fan had already walked onto the stage, asking Shanshan to wait aside.
Cheng Xiaolu hurriedly went to Shanshan’s side and whispered, "Shanshan, didn’t you say your brother was tone-deaf? What is he doing?"
Shanshan was almost frantic with worry; her brother might have gone crazy in his attempt to defend her!
Just as she was about to advise Lin Fan not to sing.
Lin Fan had already started singing.
"The bustling sound fades into silence..."
As soon as Lin Fan began, the entire room fell silent, and everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 Kneeling to Listen to Music
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26 Kneeling to Listen to Music
Yun City Music Academy, Principal’s Office.
Liu Mengjie sat in front of her desk, one hand on the mouse, the other propping up her chin, but her eyes were not on the computer, she was lost in thought.
She was thinking about one person.
Lin Fan.
The scene of Lin Fan playing the piano at her house yesterday was still vividly lingering in her mind, refusing to fade away.
She couldn’t forget the piece Lin Fan improvised, it was the most beautiful piece she had ever heard, the most perfect piano performance. She had heard many world-class piano masters perform, but none could match Lin Fan.
She believed that Lin Fan’s piano skills had reached the realm of Beethoven!
Beethoven, a musical genius rare to encounter even in centuries.
And now, she had actually discovered someone who could stand shoulder to shoulder with Beethoven. Imagine her excitement.
She was eager to invite Lin Fan to teach at her music academy. That way, she could see him every day and discuss music with him.
As she thought about it, Liu Mengjie became somewhat infatuated.
At this moment, a middle-aged man knocked and entered.
It was her friend in the music industry, Wind Bird Music Director, Xu Cheng!
"Old Xu, you busy man, how come you have the time to see me?" Liu Mengjie stood up, curious.
Xu Cheng said, "It’s about what I told you last night, that genius refused me. I didn’t sleep well all night, so I came today to get your advice."
Liu Mengjie sighed, "What can I advise you on? I haven’t even solved my own problem."
Xu Cheng laughed, "Aren’t you just short of a piano teacher? As long as you help me find a way, I’ll get them for you. I know many piano experts, and they will surely give me face."
Liu Mengjie shook her head, "I don’t want anyone else, I just want him..."
Xu Cheng said, "That piano genius you’re talking about?"
Liu Mengjie said, "That’s right, other than him, I won’t consider anyone else. Although having him as a piano teacher here is a talent wasted on a small job, I can’t control the thought."
Xu Cheng observed Liu Mengjie’s expression, and in surprise, said, "Oh my, Old Liu, could it be that you’ve fallen in love with him? You’ve finally met someone who moves your heart?"
Liu Mengjie was already twenty-five, and many girls at this age are already mothers of young children. Still, Liu Mengjie had never dated, as she never met anyone who moved her heart.
Liu Mengjie blushed and scolded, "What nonsense are you talking about? I just admire him musically, he..."
As she said this, Lin Fan’s handsome face emerged in her mind, along with that scene of Lin Fan heroically saving her...
Her heart started to race, and her cheeks turned even redder.
No way, could it be that she really did have feelings for him?
Fortunately, Xu Cheng didn’t continue on the topic and added, "How about this, we help each other. You help me work out how to get that musical genius to sign with me, and I’ll figure out how to get your piano genius to be your teacher."
Liu Mengjie found it feasible and said, "Alright, tell me, who exactly is your musical genius?"
Xu Cheng sighed, "I don’t know. He wouldn’t tell me last night. You are the principal of the music school and have a wider network. I think you might be able to help me find out his identity."
Liu Mengjie said, "Then what does he look like?"
Xu Cheng said, "He looks to be around twenty years old, very handsome, extremely so, and he should be quite wealthy. Last night, he attended a gathering in the Emperor’s Hall at Ginza KTV. Oh, right, he seemed to be wearing a delivery uniform, which was quite inconsistent..."
Before Xu Cheng finished speaking, Liu Mengjie was already stunned, no way, could the person Xu Cheng mentioned be...
At this moment, a young teacher hurriedly came in, "Something’s wrong, Principal, something’s happened at the exam venue."
Liu Mengjie was taken aback. Today was the freshman interview day. The exam venue was always orderly, never had anything happened before.
Liu Mengjie quickly asked, "What happened?"
The young teacher said, "A candidate’s parent is causing trouble, causing the exam venue to come to a halt."
Liu Mengjie said angrily, "I’ll go check it out!"
Xu Cheng, afraid Liu Mengjie wouldn’t be able to handle it, followed her.
Soon the two arrived at the exam venue. The scene before them left both of them stunned.
The vast hall was crowded with people, yet not a sound was made. Everyone seemed to be entranced.
On stage, a young man was facing three examiners, his back to the crowd, singing "Fireworks Easily Cold," right at its climax.
"The rain drizzles, in the depths of the old hometown, I heard that you are still alone."
"The mottled city gates, the old tree roots linger, echoing on the stone slab is the long wait..."
The voice was so beautiful, the performance so unique, as if a master was using music to narrate a story, a poignant love story, captivating and engrossing. Everyone listened intently.
The three examiners were already on their knees.
Xu Cheng suddenly became excited, this voice, this silhouette...
And Liu Mengjie had already recognized the person on stage.
When the song ended, the entire venue remained silent, everyone still immersed in the song.
Liu Mengjie asked Xu Cheng, "Is the musical genius you encountered last night him?"
Xu Cheng instinctively replied, "It’s him. Old Liu, you seem to know him?"
Liu Mengjie nodded, "He is also the piano genius I told you about."
"My God!" Xu Cheng’s eyes widened, this was too much of a coincidence. They were talking about the same person!
Xu Cheng quickly asked, "Who exactly is he?"
Liu Mengjie said, "His name is Lin Fan, and he is a deliveryman."
By this time, on the stage.
After singing, Lin Fan put down the mic, looked at the three astonished examiners, and smiled, "I’ve finished singing, what do the three of you think?"
But the three examiners were muttering to themselves.
Examiner A: "Oh my, the voice is so beautiful, the singing technique is too advanced, some of the vocal techniques I don’t even understand, is it real, I feel like my ears are pregnant."
Examiner B: "I didn’t expect this song to be interpreted this way, it’s amazing, a completely different feel from the original, but in no way inferior to the original!"
Examiner C: "No one has ever surpassed the original, and his singing isn’t about surpassing because it’s about creating another kind of atmosphere, standing parallel as two peaks with the original!"
It seemed that the three examiners had all been conquered by Lin Fan.
Examiner A couldn’t help but ask, "Could you please explain what vocal technique you used for that high note earlier?"
He was completely in student mode, not realizing it himself, treating Lin Fan like a teacher.
Lin Fan calmly said, "I simply used my sister’s style to sing this song. The original singer puts themselves into the protagonist’s role, creating a beautiful, heartbreaking atmosphere. My sister’s singing is as an outsider telling the story. The fact is, this way of singing works perfectly. My sister’s only problem is her skills are still immature, which is why she wants to come to your music academy to learn. Yet you want to turn her away?"
These words made the three examiners blush.
They indeed wronged Lin Shanshan.
"Well said!"
A voice rang out, and Liu Mengjie walked towards the stage.
The principal had arrived!

chapters.title: Chapter 27 Substitute Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27 Substitute Teacher
"Oh my god, Brother Fan’s singing is actually so good!"
Cheng Xiaolu said, looking at Lin Fan with deep affection, already transformed into Lin Fan’s fangirl.
Shanshan used to complain to her that Brother Fan’s singing was terrible. Turns out she was lying.
Lin Shanshan was now in a state of excitement and bewilderment.
Just now, when Lin Fan started singing, she was directly dumbfounded. In her memory, her brother was tone-deaf, and his singing sounded like a pig being slaughtered. How could it be so good now?
Aside from bewilderment, she felt more moved; her brother was standing up for her and conquered the three judges with his music.
Even the principal was alarmed now.
Originally, Lin Shanshan had been turned down by the judges, but now she seemed to see hope again.
Liu Mengjie walked onto the stage.
The three judges were a bit flustered, sweating profusely. They were personally appointed by Liu Mengjie, but clearly, their handling of Lin Shanshan’s case didn’t satisfy Liu Mengjie.
"After hearing what Mr. Lin said, do all three of you understand where you went wrong?" Liu Mengjie asked coldly.
The three judges responded in unison, "Understood."
Of course, they understood. Lin Fan was simply a music master!
In front of Lin Fan, they were like elementary students, only there to listen to his teachings.
Liu Mengjie looked at Lin Fan and smiled pleasantly, "Lin Fan, how about I personally take your sister’s examination?"
Since Liu Mengjie was the principal here, Lin Fan wanted to keep a low profile, but unexpected events had alerted Liu Mengjie.
Lin Fan had no choice but to say, "Thank you, Principal, as long as you treat my sister fairly and justly, that’s enough."
Liu Mengjie understood Lin Fan’s meaning and sincerely replied, "I will."
So Lin Fan stepped off the stage, allowing Lin Shanshan to retake the exam.
Lin Shanshan then sang "Fireworks Easily Cold" again.
After finishing, Liu Mengjie gave an evaluation, listing both strengths and weaknesses, well-reasoned and convincing, truly fair and just. Liu Mengjie believed Lin Shanshan’s voice had great potential and talent, ultimately letting Lin Shanshan pass the interview.
Lin Shanshan was ecstatic, immediately running off the stage and jumping into Lin Fan’s arms.
"Brother, thank you," Lin Shanshan said gratefully, eyes reddening.
If it weren’t for her brother helping her today, she would have been turned down. The person she owed the most gratitude to was her brother.
Lin Fan said contentedly, "This is what you deserve."
Liu Mengjie then also stepped down and came next to Lin Fan, smiling, "Lin Fan, can I have a word with you?"
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, Shanshan, go wait for me outside first."
Lin Shanshan went off to celebrate her victory with Cheng Xiaolu.
Liu Mengjie smiled, "Lin Fan, were you satisfied with Shanshan’s exam just now? I truly didn’t show any favoritism; Shanshan is indeed an outstanding child."
Lin Fan smiled, "I know."
With his music talent now, if Liu Mengjie had shown favoritism, he wouldn’t have noticed it. Liu Mengjie’s evaluation of Lin Shanshan was indeed quite objective.
Liu Mengjie’s voice tinged with affection, "Lin Fan, why didn’t you tell me your sister was coming for the exam yesterday? Do you think I’m the type to show favoritism?"
She really hit the nail on the head.
Lin Fan was a bit embarrassed and rubbed his nose, "Sorry."
Liu Mengjie scoffed, "A simple apology isn’t enough, I have a request for you."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "What request?"
Liu Mengjie said, "Come to my office, and I’ll tell you there."
The beauty principal’s invitation to her office was something Lin Fan couldn’t easily turn down.
Just then, Xu Cheng came over, smiling, "Mr. Lin, didn’t expect to meet you again so soon."
Lin Fan thought to himself, oh, isn’t this the music director from Wind Bird he encountered last night?
Liu Mengjie introduced, "Lin Fan, Xu Cheng is my friend. I’ve heard about your refusal to sign a contract."
Xu Cheng chuckled, "I really didn’t realize, the piano prodigy Old Liu mentioned turns out to be the same music genius I met, Mr. Lin is truly a once-in-a-century music master!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Mr. Xu, if you’re still thinking of having me sign a contract, you can let that go. I made it clear last night, I don’t want to be a pop star."
Xu Cheng seemed like he’d been doused with cold water. He initially intended to persuade Lin Fan further, but now he was speechless, throwing a pleading look towards Liu Mengjie.
Liu Mengjie laughed, "Old Xu, let’s set your matter aside, you should head back now, I have something to discuss with Lin Fan."
As she spoke, Liu Mengjie gave Xu Cheng a wink, signaling she’d assist him.
Xu Cheng was somewhat comforted by this, smiled, "Then I won’t disturb you two, Mr. Lin, goodbye."
Xu Cheng said goodbye and left.
Liu Mengjie then led Lin Fan to her office, casually closing the door.
Looking at the intelligent beauty in front of him, Lin Fan felt a bit itchy inside, it seemed almost like a clandestine affair.
"Sister Mengjie, you said you have a request for me, what is it?" Lin Fan asked.
Liu Mengjie instead remarked, "I didn’t expect both you and your sister to have such outstanding music talent, especially you, you’re completely at genius level. Your family must be a musical family, right?"
Exceptional musical talent like Lin Fan and Shanshan typically comes from a musical family.
Lin Fan said, "No, my parents are from the village, our ancestors for three generations were farmers."
Liu Mengjie was momentarily stunned, thinking Lin Fan was joking and not believing him. If Lin Fan really came from such a background, how could he play Kosak?
"I’m being serious with you, can you be serious too?" Liu Mengjie bantered tenderly.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless and casually went along, "Alright, our ancestors for three generations were all musicians, my grandfather mastered eighteen instruments, my father was a tenor, and my mother was a composer."
Liu Mengjie looked impressed, nodding frequently, "No wonder then, you and your sister both inherited excellent musical genes."
Lin Fan found it amusing internally. Inheritance, what a joke! If not for the system rewarding music talent, he would be tone-deaf. As for Lin Shanshan’s music talent, it truly was innate and unrelated to inheritance.
But Liu Mengjie didn’t believe his truth, instead believing his falsehoods. There was nothing he could do.
Liu Mengjie said, "Lin Fan, after listening to you play the piano yesterday, I’ve been unable to forget it. I’m truly too impressed by your piano skills. You absolutely can’t refuse my upcoming request."
Lin Fan sweated, "You wouldn’t be asking me to be a piano teacher again, would you?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "No, I know you wouldn’t agree, so I want you to be a substitute teacher until I find a suitable piano teacher."
Liu Mengjie secretly praised herself for this clever idea. She couldn’t deny that the substitute teacher strategy was brilliant, it wouldn’t make Lin Fan uncomfortable and would achieve her goal.
It was a spur-of-the-moment idea she came up with.
Lin Fan could see through Liu Mengjie’s intentions, but he truly couldn’t outright reject her anymore.
Lin Fan said, "What if you can’t find a piano teacher for a long time?"
"I won’t let that happen, I will surely find one soon, just agree with me!" Liu Mengjie said, looking at Lin Fan expectantly.
Lin Fan sighed, this woman was even using her charming act. Looking at her, she definitely wasn’t a woman who often acted charming, really a struggle for her.
Lin Fan then said, "Fine, since I misunderstood you, I’ll take it as an apology."
Liu Mengjie was overjoyed, Lin Fan agreed!
"That’s great, Lin Fan!"
In her excitement, Liu Mengjie directly jumped into Lin Fan’s arms and gave him an enthusiastic hug.
Her body was so soft, the hug felt so comfortable.
Lin Fan found it quite enjoyable.
Just then, a young teacher pushed the door open, "Principal..."
Her words were choked off as she looked at the two hugging, eyes wide with surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: The Mysterious Black-Haired Straight-Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: The Mysterious Black-Haired Straight-Beauty
The young teacher was screaming inside, what am I seeing?
The principal is hugging a boy!
Oh my god!
This young teacher is actually Liu Mengjie’s assistant. Having been with Liu Mengjie for years, no one understands Liu Mengjie better.
Liu Mengjie would never proactively talk about men. Even if she does mention them occasionally, it’s only to criticize their lack of good qualities. Of course, there’s no way she has a boyfriend. Rumor has it she hasn’t even touched a man’s hand. Despite having countless suitors, she ignores them all.
Except for male friends related to music, she never interacts with men.
The assistant even once suspected her orientation...
Yet, here is this Liu Mengjie, passionately hugging a boy!
Wait a minute!
Isn’t this boy the one who just stunned the entire exam hall with his singing?
The assistant blinked, meow, meow, meow, what’s going on here?
Liu Mengjie, who was bear-hugging Lin Fan, was startled and quickly let go of Lin Fan, her face flushed.
This is so embarrassing to be caught like this, who knows what the assistant is thinking? She really lost her composure in her excitement.
Liu Mengjie forced herself to calm down and pretended nothing happened: "Little Wang, you came at the right time. Let me introduce you. This is Lin Fan, our substitute piano teacher. Help him with the onboarding process."
The assistant looked bewildered, a substitute teacher?
Since when did this guy become a substitute teacher, and why did the principal hug him?
Liu Mengjie turned to Lin Fan and said, "Mr. Lin, congratulations on joining our Yun City Music Academy. Little Wang will handle your onboarding process. I will notify you separately about the course schedule. You can leave for now."
Lin Fan felt a bit disappointed. The warm embrace of the beautiful principal, he hadn’t enjoyed it enough yet, and Little Wang came at the worst time.
"I’ll be going then," Lin Fan said.
After Lin Fan left.
Liu Mengjie angrily reprimanded Little Wang: "How many times do I have to tell you, make sure to knock before you enter. Did you knock just now?"
Little Wang quickly apologized: "I’m sorry, I’ll pay attention next time. Principal... was that handsome guy just now your boyfriend?"
"In your dreams!" Liu Mengjie chased Little Wang out of the office, but her face was burning red.
She even thought it’d be nice if Lin Fan were her boyfriend...
Lin Fan left the principal’s office, went to the school gate, and met up with Lin Shanshan, finding out that Cheng Xiaolu had already left due to some matters.
Lin Fan then drove Lin Shanshan home.
Lin Shanshan had already passed the music academy’s entrance interview and just had to wait for the admission notice, which should be coming in the next few days. By then, Lin Fan would also be going to work as a substitute teacher.
Meanwhile, a short video quietly started spreading online, about to cause a sensation.
The content of the video was Lin Fan singing "Fireworks Easily Cold" at the interview. However, it only captured his back and just a portion of the performance.
Nobody knows who recorded it on-site with their phone. The audio quality wasn’t great, but it didn’t affect Lin Fan’s charismatic voice.
Everyone who saw the video was amazed and couldn’t resist sharing it, causing it to spread virally.
Lin Fan was unaware of this. After taking his sister home, with nothing else to do, he changed into his delivery uniform, hopped on his e-bike, and went to deliver food.
Lin Shanshan was puzzled by this: "Brother, you’re so well-off, why do you still do food delivery? Isn’t it embarrassing?"
Lin Fan replied, "First of all, delivering food isn’t embarrassing. Secondly, your brother doesn’t have anything else to do at the moment; this is my job."
After Lin Fan said this, he went out.
It was around noon.
Lin Fan soon received an order from the platform, someone ordered food to be delivered to Shengshi Group.
Lin Fan exclaimed: "Shengshi Group, it seems to be a big company."
Lin Fan accepted the order and went to deliver to Shengshi Group.
Shengshi Group Mansion.
An imposing skyscraper. It’s said that Shengshi Group’s CEO, Feng Wanshan, personally designed it, aiming to develop Shengshi Group into a trillion-yuan enterprise.
Nowadays, Shengshi Group’s market value is hundreds of billions, and Feng Wanshan’s personal assets are in the tens of billions.
Lin Fan parked his e-bike at the entrance of Shengshi Mansion, carried the delivery bag into the mansion, and arrived at Shengshi Company’s reception. The receptionist was quite courteous, calling the diner for Lin Fan and asking him to wait.
Lin Fan stood by and waited. He accidentally glanced inside the company and saw a meeting room from this angle.
The meeting room door opened, and out came a middle-aged man and a long-haired beauty in black.
The long-haired beauty was in all black, with a stunning figure, curvy and attractive!
Her face was stunning, with an impressive aura.
She exuded a dominant presence!
Just one glance left a deep impression on someone.
Lin Fan didn’t know this long-haired beauty, but the middle-aged man he did recognize. He had seen him in magazines—Feng Wanshan, the CEO of Shengshi Group.
Lin Fan thought this long-haired beauty was either an employee of Feng Wanshan or had an affair with him. If it was the latter, Feng Wanshan was truly lucky, Lin Fan even felt a bit envious.
The two of them paused at the meeting room door. Feng Wanshan seemed to be giving some instructions, and the long-haired beauty kept nodding, her expression indifferent.
Just then, the ordering employee came out to pick up the food, so Lin Fan had no time to pay attention to them, delivering the food and then leaving.
Downstairs, as Lin Fan sat on his e-bike, he received a call from Zhang Dafu: "Boss, you instructed me to find a housekeeper for Yunding Manor. Over the past few days, I’ve received countless resumes. Without eating or sleeping, I’ve finally selected a few candidates. Would you like to review them?"
Lin Fan was also quite concerned about the housekeeper and said: "Alright, thank you for your effort. Send them to me to have a look."
Zhang Dafu then sent several candidate resumes to Lin Fan via WeChat.
Lin Fan looked at two resumes and couldn’t help but grin.
One of them was Zhao Xin’er!
Zhao Xin’er indeed applied for the housekeeper position at Yunding Manor, and Zhang Dafu even selected her.
Objectively speaking, Zhao Xin’er was indeed quite capable.
Lin Fan continued to browse through the resumes when he suddenly paused, his gaze landing on a resume photo.
A very pretty woman, exactly the long-haired beauty he had seen at Shengshi Group earlier!
Lin Fan glanced over the long-haired beauty’s resume.
Anna, Female, 27 years old, single and unmarried.
Graduated from the University of Cambridge, United Kingdom.
Once served in the military.
Has excellent skills.
After retiring, she worked at the internationally renowned Heng’an Security Company, once leading teams to protect the home of the richest Chinese, Li Changjia.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised. This long-haired beauty seemed quite extraordinary!
Why would someone so exceptional apply to be the housekeeper at Yunding Manor?
Moreover, why was she appearing at Shengshi Group? What’s her relationship with Feng Wanshan?
Just then, Lin Fan felt a presence approaching. It turned out to be the long-haired beauty. She walked out of the mansion, passing Lin Fan by!
Graceful and agile, walking with poise!
What a dominant woman.
Lin Fan was somewhat attracted.
However, the long-haired beauty didn’t pay any attention to this delivery person beside her. She didn’t even glance at Lin Fan but walked straight to a flashy motorcycle at the roadside, mounted it, and zoomed off.
Ding!
Suddenly, the system emitted a notification sound!

chapters.title: Chapter 29: System Task: Taming the Black Long Straight
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: System Task: Taming the Black Long Straight
"Ding!"
"System main mission initiated, would the host like to check?"
The system suddenly gave a notification.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but feel curious, why did the system suddenly issue a mission?
"Check!" Lin Fan said in his mind.
"Main mission, conquer Anna."
"Priority: Important."
"Completion: 0/100"
Lin Fan was shocked, the system wants him to conquer the long straight-haired beauty? And this is part of the main mission!
Today, the system has just initiated the main mission, requiring Lin Fan to build a trillion-dollar business empire.
Could this Anna be related to this main mission?
Lin Fan curiously asked, "System, why do I need to conquer this woman?"
System: "..."
The system was silent, like a cold machine, not communicating with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was helpless.
Thinking about it, Lin Fan had a question, this long straight-haired beauty is Feng Wanshan’s person, why would she apply to be the housekeeper of Yunding Manor?
Lin Fan called Zhang Dafu: "Da Fu, do you know what the relationship between Feng Wanshan and Yunding Manor is?"
Zhang Dafu replied, "Boss, you’ve asked the right person. The one who fought with us for Yunding Manor is Feng Wanshan."
Lin Fan oh-ed and frowned, Feng Wanshan failed to bid for Yunding Manor, but now wants to send his person to apply for Yunding Manor’s housekeeper, what is his purpose?
Simply put, Feng Wanshan actually wants to plant an undercover agent beside Lin Fan!
Lin Fan suddenly remembered something, that day, Aunt Li told him someone was inquiring about him.
Could it also be Feng Wanshan’s doing?
After some thought, Lin Fan had a plan, and said, "Da Fu, I’ve already chosen someone for Yunding Manor’s housekeeper. Inform all candidates to go to Blue Moon tomorrow for the final decision."
Zhang Dafu breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Okay, I’ll arrange it right away."
This task was too arduous for him, he’d been exhausted these past two days, it’s finally coming to an end.
While Lin Fan continued delivering food, a piece of news spread in Yun City.
The selection for Yunding Manor’s housekeeper has a preliminary result, ten candidates have been chosen, and the result will be out tomorrow.
At once, everyone became curious, who would be the lucky one to successfully apply for Yunding Manor’s housekeeper?
Everyone was expectant.
Among the ten candidates who received the interview notice, most were ecstatic, as if they had won the lottery.
Zhao Xin’er was very excited, suddenly filled with endless confidence, as if she had already been chosen.
Zhao Xin’er sneered and said, "Lin Fan, you can’t compare to Mr. Lin, I’m going to be Yunding Manor’s housekeeper soon, once I’m close to Mr. Lin, what are you?"
On the other side.
The long straight-haired beauty Anna, currently speeding in a car, received the interview notice, yet showed a confident smile on her face, as if everything was under her control.
After all, with her exceptional resume, how could she not be chosen!
But she didn’t know that Lin Fan was already aware of her relationship with Feng Wanshan.
Anna immediately sent a message to Feng Wanshan, indicating she has become a candidate for Yunding Manor’s housekeeper.
Feng Wanshan received Anna’s message and felt delighted.
He arranged for Anna to mix into Yunding Manor to find out the identity of the mysterious Mr. Lin. He trusts Anna; she never fails and will certainly uncover Mr. Lin.
If Lin Fan knew, Feng Wanshan painstakingly arranged Anna as an undercover simply to find out his identity, he’d probably laugh out loud.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan continued delivering food, and soon received an order, the customer requested the fast food be delivered to the entrance of Yida Square.
As Lin Fan arrived at the entrance of Yida Square, he saw a group of young men and women with banners, glow sticks, and other items gathering at the entrance, seemingly waiting for something, each with a hopeful expression.
It was clearly a group of star chasers, from the banners they held, the star they chased was Liu Sisi.
Lin Fan usually didn’t pay much attention to the entertainment circle, he had no impression of this star, nowadays stars are emerging one after another, most of them are not well-known, it’s not surprising he doesn’t know her.
Lin Fan then saw someone waving at him, calling him over.
This was a fat and ugly otaku, face full of acne, wearing a pink bunny ear headband, with three glowing characters on it: Liu Sisi.
This guy is pretty committed to star chasing, huh!
But that’s his freedom, Lin Fan didn’t care much, handed the box of food to the otaku.
The transaction was completed, Lin Fan turned his bike around to leave.
Then, a van drove over, stopped at the entrance, and a group of star chasers screamed astonishingly, ran towards the van, quickly surrounding the door, each extremely excited.
Then the van door opened, a fashionably dressed beauty came out with two security guards, her face full of an enchanting smile.
So beautiful!
A beauty score above 90, devilish curves, almost perfect!
Even Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat, even female celebrities rarely looked as good as her.
The group of fervent fans shouted Liu Sisi’s name as they rushed forward to try to ask Liu Sisi for an autograph.
Those two security guards guarded Liu Sisi from left to right, not letting fans get close; getting an autograph was practically impossible.
"Delivery guy, wait!"
The otaku suddenly called out to Lin Fan with a shrill voice.
He was too overweight, holding the food, hadn’t joined the others.
Lin Fan turned back: "What’s up? Is there an issue with the fast food?"
The otaku shook his head: "There’s no problem with the fast food, but I need you to do me a favor. Can you help me get an autograph from Sisi?"
Lin Fan sweat dropped: "Bro, I’m just a delivery guy, and as you see, she has security guards keeping people away."
The otaku said, "You don’t get it, Sisi isn’t popular now, but I believe one day she will be big and famous, by then her autograph will be valuable, so I have to get her autograph."
Lin Fan said, "Then you go ask her yourself."
The otaku said, "No way, I’d only scare the goddess with my looks. You look quite handsome, should be okay; Sisi has said she likes handsome guys."
Lin Fan quite liked hearing this; if the otaku had stopped here, Lin Fan would probably consider helping him.
But the otaku perhaps felt it wasn’t convincing enough, he continued, "You help me, I’ll give you a five-star rating, or else I’ll give you a bad rating!"
Threat!
Lin Fan’s heart sank, being a delivery man is really hard!
Some customers always ask the delivery men for bizarre requests, if unmet, they give bad ratings, don’t help with dumping trash, bad rating, don’t help with mails, bad rating, don’t help buy daily supplies, bad rating...
This otaku was just such a person!
Lin Fan chuckled, "Alright, I’ll give it a shot."
The otaku handed Lin Fan a pen and a photo of Liu Sisi, looking satisfied: "I knew you wouldn’t refuse, delivery guys fear bad ratings the most."
Judging by the tone, this guy probably has troubled delivery men before, Lin Fan coldly laughed inwardly.
Headed straight towards Liu Sisi.
Getting closer.
A loud shout: "Sisi!"

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Delivery Boy Shocks Meituan Group Headquarters
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: Delivery Boy Shocks Meituan Group Headquarters
This shout drowned out all the fans’ screams.
The whole place went quiet for a moment, and everyone turned to look at Lin Fan, including Liu Sisi.
The moment she saw Lin Fan, Liu Sisi’s eyes lit up. Oh my, what a handsome delivery guy!
She indeed liked handsome guys and knew many fresh-faced male celebrities, but none were as handsome as this delivery guy, and Lin Fan had that masculine charm, completely the opposite of the pretty-boy celebrities.
"I’m your loyal fan, could I ask for an autograph?"
Lin Fan smiled and walked towards Liu Sisi.
Perhaps those fans were intimidated by Lin Fan’s shout, and they all moved aside.
Two security guards reached out, trying to stop Lin Fan.
"It’s alright, let him come up," Liu Sisi said, her face blushing. This delivery guy was just too handsome; she was having a hard time controlling herself.
Moreover, Lin Fan’s identity was a delivery guy. If she wasn’t nice to him, and it got onto the internet, she would definitely be scolded for being a diva.
No way around it, the current internet environment, moral coercion is very common. Although many people in reality look down on delivery guys, online, respecting them is politically correct.
Lin Fan handed the pen and photo: "Thank you."
Liu Sisi took it, signed it flamboyantly, and asked softly: "What’s your name?"
Lin Fan replied: "Lin Fan."
Liu Sisi returned the photo to Lin Fan, smiling sweetly: "Thank you for liking me, Lin Fan."
In front of so many fans, she couldn’t say much more to Lin Fan, so she lowered her head and walked towards the door, and the fans flocked to her instantly.
Lin Fan, holding the signed photo, went back to the couch potato, showing the autograph: "Got it."
The couch potato was excited, face flushed, urging: "Quickly give it to me."
Hiss!
Lin Fan didn’t give it to him but instead tore the signed photo to pieces right in front of him!
"Ah!"
The couch potato cried out like he had lost his mother, shrieking in a high-pitched voice.
Lin Fan threw the torn signed photo into the nearby trash bin and turned to leave.
He went to get the autograph just for this moment; this kind of customer needed some handling!
The couch potato was so angry he cried loudly, his voice raising an octave: "You damned delivery guy, wait for my bad review! I’m going to complain about you!"
Lin Fan got on his electric scooter, shrugged: "Bad review? Complaint? Who cares?"
He sped away.
...
Delivery station.
The stationmaster was still worrying about how to explain to headquarters why Lin Fan hadn’t been fired yet. Another call from headquarters came.
"Why haven’t you fired Lin Fan yet? He has just been complained about again, saying he tore up the customer’s signed photo and made them cry!"
The stationmaster broke out in a cold sweat. How could this happen, making a customer cry? But Lin Fan doing such things didn’t seem surprising.
The stationmaster looked up and saw the fierce gaze of the manageress from across the room.
A shiver!
He had to keep Lin Fan, or the consequences would be serious.
"Ahem!"
The stationmaster cleared his throat and started passing the buck.
"Here’s the thing, Lin Fan is a super rich second generation. He drives a 70 million top-tier sportscar; we don’t know his background, so we don’t dare to fire him..."
"What?" The people at headquarters were dumbfounded.
Both sides fell into an awkward silence.
Finally, headquarters made a decision: "Hold on, keep Lin Fan for now, I’ll report this further up."
The stationmaster let out a sigh of relief: "Alright."
Meituan Group Headquarters.
That evening, a meeting was held regarding Lin Fan’s situation, with Meituan CEO Huang Qing and Meituan Delivery Manager Wang Peng personally attending.
"I’ve heard we have a delivery guy who’s a super rich second generation; is this true?" Huang Qing asked.
Wang Peng said: "It’s true, he’s an employee at a station in Yun City. The stationmaster reported he drives a 70 million sportscar."
million sportscar!
Everyone was shocked.
Even Huang Qing was moved. This was too wealthy; even he wouldn’t dare buy such an expensive car!
Wang Peng said: "According to reports, Lin Fan also made a grand move, buying all the luxury goods on a whole street, which went viral online, and all Yun City delivery guys know about him."
"The video that’s been going viral recently, it’s him?"
"I thought it was staged, but it turns out to be real!"
"That’s incredible!"
Huang Qing said excitedly: "A super rich second generation working as a delivery guy, that’s a great angle worth promoting."
Wang Peng said: "It does have buzz worth, but unfortunately, Lin Fan doesn’t have a good reputation. He frequently receives complaints from customers; we’ve been considering firing him. What do you think, President Huang?"
Huang Qing thought for a moment and said: "Rich second generation can be understood to have some temperament. Before clarifying his background, don’t act rashly. For now, don’t make any changes; observe him for a while. We might need him for something."
Wang Peng quickly nodded: "Alright."
Inwardly feeling lucky, good thing he sought President Huang’s opinion first; otherwise, rashly firing Lin Fan might have made President Huang blame him...
Lin Fan had no idea that he had already attracted Meituan’s highest level attention.
At nightfall, Lin Fan stopped delivering and rushed to attend the class reunion.
Due to an issue with an order, time was tight, so Lin Fan didn’t bother to change clothes and headed to the class reunion in his delivery uniform, riding his electric scooter.
p.m.
Jindu Grand Hotel.
A group of young men and women gathered at the entrance, showing off their lives to each other.
"I’m probably the least successful among our classmates, right? Can’t do anything, just talk a lot. Right now, I’m just barely making it as a sales manager. Ashamed, ashamed."
"Your salary must be high in sales, right? Really envious, someone like me, with an annual salary just over 200,000, should be called poor."
"Are any of you poorer than me? I’m considering changing my car recently; I only have a budget of about 500,000 and don’t know whether to choose a BMW or Audi."
Class monitor Luo Tianming sighed and said: "You guys better stop flaunting, none of you are worse off than me. I’ve worked tirelessly for two years in my current company, barely made it to vice-president, doing more and taking less, climbing upward is far off. It’s quite heartbreaking to say more!"
"Class monitor, you’re already the vice-president. What more could you be dissatisfied with? At your level, do we still need to live?"
"Exactly, the class monitor doesn’t know the hunger of the truly poor!"
"The class monitor’s a leader; we’re mere workers."
Everyone started "complaining."
Luo Tianming listened with great pleasure.
At this time, a Jeep drove up and Qian Feng stepped out.
Everyone’s eyes brightened; a Jeep Wrangler, imported car, costs around 500,000!
Qian Feng was doing well.
Seeing the slicked-back Qian Feng, Luo Tianming narrowed his eyes, a rival for showing off had arrived.
Qian Feng smiled amiably and said: "Sorry, the company had some matters, got a bit busy and was late, kept everyone waiting."
Classmates all expressed: "No worries."
"I heard Brother Feng is valued highly at Jingdong, quite the busy man."
"Among our class, the best off must be the class monitor and Brother Feng."
Classmates started complimenting.
Luo Tianming and Qian Feng both enjoyed it.
Luo Tianming humbly said: "Where, where, hasn’t Lin Fan come yet? He’s our campus crush. If you ask me, he must be the one doing the best. By the way, does anyone know what Lin Fan is doing now?"
The classmates all shook their heads. They hadn’t heard about Lin Fan for a long time and didn’t know what he was doing. But with the class monitor’s question, everyone became curious.
At this moment, they heard Qian Feng smiling and saying: "I know, I bumped into him yesterday, he’s delivering food."
What?
Everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Old Classmates Show Off to Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31: Old Classmates Show Off to Each Other
Lin Fan is delivering food?
The classmates looked incredulous.
Luo Tianming said, "Impossible, how could Lin Fan be delivering food, Qian Feng, you must have mistaken him for someone else?"
The classmates nodded, all thinking Qian Feng had probably mistaken someone else for Lin Fan. After all, Lin Fan was their school’s heartthrob, how could he be delivering food?
Qian Feng chuckled, "I’m not blind, how could I be mistaken? Besides, I even talked to him. He was wearing a delivery uniform and personally admitted to delivering food!"
Qian Feng was so sure that people couldn’t help but believe him, and the classmates were all amazed.
"Is Lin Fan really delivering food? But he was the school heartthrob."
"How did he end up like this? What a pity."
"I thought he would be doing well, being the school heartthrob and a star at school!"
The classmates sighed, but each of their eyes carried a strange sense of satisfaction.
The fact that the former school heartthrob was doing worse than them made them feel exceptionally good inside.
Luo Tianming was a bit worried and said, "Yesterday I called Lin Fan, and he also told me he was delivering food, but I thought he was joking and even laughed. Could I have hurt his self-esteem?"
Qian Feng said, "Actually, I think delivering food is quite good, it’s free and easy. I even told Lin Fan yesterday that I envied him riding an electric bike every day, going green."
Hearing this, the classmates all snickered. Luo Tianming and Qian Feng were both really taking jabs at him.
But it was indeed quite funny, the revered school heartthrob delivering food!
Just then, they saw a handsome guy in a delivery uniform, riding an electric bike, coming gracefully with the wind.
He suddenly stopped the bike right in front of the classmates.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sorry, I rushed an order and came late. Hello everyone."
The classmates looked at each other, having some doubts before, but now with the fact right in front of them, there was no doubt anymore. Lin Fan was indeed delivering food!
A disdainful feeling naturally rose in the hearts of the classmates.
The polite ones still smiled at Lin Fan, which counted as a greeting, but some were too lazy even to say hello, feeling Lin Fan didn’t deserve it.
Luo Tianming and Qian Feng, both being slick veterans, appeared very enthusiastic.
"Our school heartthrob finally arrived, Lin Fan, you really are delivering food, huh? When Qian Feng mentioned it earlier, I didn’t believe it," Luo Tianming said with a smile.
Qian Feng said, "Lin Fan, your electric bike is nice, worth 3,000 bucks, right?"
Lin Fan said, "To be precise, it’s 3,500 bucks. It’s indeed quite good, fast, and has a large capacity."
Lin Fan’s serious demeanor made the classmates unable to hold back another round of giggles, with someone even bursting out laughing.
The classmates were all driving cars, the expensive ones over half a million, the cheapest costing at least tens of thousands.
Lin Fan, driving a 3,500 bucks electric bike and treating it as a treasure, was indeed very funny.
The classmates found immense satisfaction in despising Lin Fan.
Lin Fan naturally saw everyone’s behavior in his eyes, indeed very realistic; a class reunion that outwardly was meant for old classmates to gather was in fact a comparison fest!
Those doing well were spirited and lively, while those doing poorly were looked down upon.
Lin Fan smiled without caring and parked his electric bike.
At this moment, Luo Tianming said, "By the way, it seems like our class belle isn’t here yet?"
Class belle Kang Min’er indeed was late.
Upon mentioning the class belle, a group of male classmates all shared knowing smiles, as Kang Min’er was the dream girl of most male classmates back in school.
Including Qian Feng.
Qian Feng back in school was an invisible existence, only able to secretly have a crush on Kang Min’er. Now being someone successful compared to before was different.
Qian Feng’s eyes moved, and he said, "Everyone, the table is reserved for 7 o’clock, we can’t delay, I’m most familiar with the Jindu rules. Time waits for no one, so how about I take everyone inside to get seated, and I’ll come out to wait for Kang Min’er."
