Seats at the Jindu Grand Hotel are not easy to book, it was heard that Qian Feng had to pull some strings to get them.
Hearing Qian Feng say so, the classmates wouldn’t dare to delay and followed Qian Feng inside the Jindu.
The Jindu Grand Hotel looked quite festive tonight, with colorful lanterns at the entrance, as if there was some happy event.
Listening to people nearby discussing, "Tonight, Miss Su is marrying Young Master Li, they booked the entire third floor of Jindu."
Hearing "Miss Su," Lin Fan’s eyes flickered with an unusual look, then he shook his head, regained his calmness, and followed the classmates to the dining table in the grand lobby on the first floor.
The entire Jindu hall was lavish in gold and jade!
The place was crowded with diners, lively as could be.
The classmates all clicked their tongues in praise.
"Jindu truly lives up to its name, it’s so luxurious, dining here gives a sense of nobility."
"I’ve always wanted to experience Jindu, but unfortunately, I could never book a table."
"Still, Qian Feng is something, has a wide network, even managed to book so hard-to-get a place like Jindu."
The classmates all praised Qian Feng.
As for Lin Fan, it was as if they had already forgotten about him.
Listening to the classmates’ compliments, Qian Feng felt a great sense of satisfaction, like a host, inviting everyone to take their seats.
Luo Tianming saw Qian Feng seizing the spotlight and felt a bit upset, saying, "Jindu is indeed hard to book and expensive too, everyone, it’s AA tonight, it’ll bleed our wallets, I’m lucky to have accompanied clients here a few times, most familiar with the dishes here, I’ll order, ensuring it’s affordable."
The classmates praised, "The class president is wise!"
Luo Tianming smiled coldly to himself, turning the tables!
Qian Feng remained calm and said with a chuckle, "No rush in ordering, not everyone is here yet, I’ll go out first to welcome Kang Min’er."
With that, Qian Feng went out.
Watching Qian Feng and Luo Tianming compete, Lin Fan found it amusing, thinking their pretensions were too childish.
Before long, Qian Feng returned with a heavily made-up beauty.
"The class belle is here!"
"Min Min is still so beautiful!"
"Min Min’s aura is even better than before!"
The classmates immediately cheered.
The class belle Kang Min’er!
Lin Fan glanced at her, mentally remarking, remembering Kang Min’er as an innocent next-door girl, whereas the Kang Min’er in front now carried an air of worldly dust.
In the old class, Kang Min’er was indeed a goddess, admired by all, but out in society, girls with her looks were a dime a dozen, not holding much advantage.
After facing setbacks, Kang Min’er had also become more realistic.
However, Qian Feng seemed to still treat Kang Min’er as a goddess, for no reason other than sentimentality. The former class belle, who wouldn’t even look at him, things were different now, he wanted to conquer the class belle on behalf of his past self.
Kang Min’er sat down next to Qian Feng, saw Lin Fan, and hesitated, "Lin Fan? Is that you...?"
Qian Feng quickly interjected, "Lin Fan is an errand delivery guy now."
Kang Min’er responded with an "Oh," her eyes immediately showing indifference, and no longer paid attention to Lin Fan.
She turned her head and sweetly smiled at Qian Feng, "Brother Feng, I heard you’re quite valued at Jingdong, you’ll help me with my company’s cooperation with Jingdong, right?"
Qian Feng felt proud inside and said, "Don’t worry, leave it to me!"
The former class belle who ignored him in the past was now seeking his help!
And not the school heartthrob Lin Fan!
Recalling the humiliation from before, Qian Feng couldn’t help wanting to vent a bit.
"By the way, Min’er, I heard back in school, you liked Lin Fan?"
Qian Feng suddenly turned the topic to Lin Fan.
The classmates were all looking at Kang Min’er, curious about her response.
Kang Min’er denied without hesitation, "No, absolutely not!"
Lin Fan is a delivery guy now, admitting she used to like Lin Fan would be so embarrassing.
Actually, Kang Miner’s past feelings for school heartthrob Lin Fan were well-known to everyone, seeing Kang Min’er firmly deny it, the classmates laughed.
You can’t blame Kang Min’er. Who wouldn’t want to keep their distance from someone poor like Lin Fan, exuding a sense of poverty?
Qian Feng was different, now successful, even the former class belle was eager to get close!
Just then.
"Lin Fan!"
Suddenly, a voice called out, and they saw an extremely stunning beauty, full of surprise, walking towards Lin Fan.
When everyone saw this stunning beauty, they were all dumbfounded.
Isn’t this Liu Sisi, a relatively popular actress recently!
She actually took the initiative to approach Lin Fan?

chapters.title: Chapter 32: It Must Be a Joke
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: It Must Be a Joke
Liu Sisi greeted Lin Fan proactively, leaving everyone stunned. What was going on?
Liu Sisi’s appearance was unexpected for Lin Fan too.
Today, pretending to be a fan asking Liu Sisi for an autograph was just a small episode, he didn’t expect to meet Liu Sisi.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "What a coincidence!"
Liu Sisi said, "Yes, I came with the brand people for dinner. I didn’t expect to run into you."
Today, Liu Sisi was invited to participate in a brand event at Yida Square, which is why a group of fans gathered.
Liu Sisi had a strong impression of Lin Fan, this handsome delivery guy, claiming to be her fan. Yet, for some unknown reason, she felt he wasn’t simple.
She just couldn’t figure out where his complexity lay at the moment.
In the eyes of the crowd, Liu Sisi couldn’t say much to Lin Fan and said, "The brand people are waiting for me. I’ll go ahead, and we’ll talk next time."
See you next time!
It seemed that Liu Sisi wanted to meet Lin Fan again.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Okay, bye-bye."
Liu Sisi walked away.
Luo Tianming couldn’t help asking, "Lin Fan, do you actually know Liu Sisi?"
Lin Fan said, "We’ve met once. I didn’t expect to meet her tonight."
Everyone felt their faces burn a little. They had just thought Lin Fan was all over with poverty vibes and had no charm with women.
But in the end, a new fire-like female star of unparalleled beauty, having only met Lin Fan once, took the initiative to greet him!
If this isn’t charm with women, what is?
Compared to Liu Sisi, what was Kang Min’er worth?
Kang Min’er felt offended, got angry, and sneered, "Lin Fan, I’m not saying anything, but the only reason she greeted you is because you’re handsome. But can being handsome fill your belly? You’re still delivering takeouts! Do you think a big star like her can be interested in a delivery guy like you?"
Such words were downright harsh.
But hearing it made the classmates feel a bit better. Knowing Lin Fan knew a celebrity had been hard on them.
Remembering Lin Fan’s poverty, their minds finally balanced out.
Qian Feng said, "Minmin’s words are a bit harsh, but she does have a point. Lin Fan, you’re not planning to deliver takeouts forever, are you? You’re a university graduate, our campus heartthrob; honestly, saying it out loud makes me feel a bit embarrassed."
The classmates nodded one after another.
"Yeah, a dignified university graduate doing anything but delivering takeouts!"
"I wouldn’t dare to mention you to others in the future, it would be too embarrassing."
Luo Tianming, kindly, said, "Lin Fan, if you really can’t find a job, my company has a vacancy for a general worker. Why don’t you come over? It’s better than delivering takeouts."
Lin Fan looked at these classmates’ true faces indifferently. Liu Sisi’s stimulation revealed them, all dumping their real thoughts out, as if they couldn’t wait to trample him.
Lin Fan was a little disappointed with them. His friendship with these classmates ended here.
"Lin Fan!"
Just then, Liu Sisi, who had just left, actually came back!
Liu Sisi looked at Lin Fan with an expectant face: "I just remembered, could you be that delivery guy who bought the entire street of luxury goods?"
Lin Fan was a little surprised, how could Liu Sisi guess?
Liu Sisi explained, "It’s like this, my uncle works at the Meituan Group Headquarters. He told me about the recently famous delivery guy named Lin Fan. When I saw you, I felt you were different, suddenly remembered, and couldn’t help but come and ask."
Lin Fan thought, oh, the Meituan Group Headquarters knows about me too?
Lin Fan smiled, "Yes, that’s me."
Liu Sisi was overjoyed, "Oh my god, it’s really you. You know, I’ve watched your video so many times, smacking gold diggers in the face, that’s awesome."
The classmates were all dumbfounded.
What?
The recently famous delivery guy was actually Lin Fan?
He’s a billionaire, buying a street of luxury goods, extravagantly wealthy!
Luo Tianming and Qian Feng looked a bit pale, no way, how could it be Lin Fan!
Kang Min’er’s expression was also quite splendid.
Liu Sisi added, "By the way, my uncle also said you drive a luxury car worth 70 million. Is that true?"
Lin Fan, feeling he had garnered attention from the Meituan Group Headquarters, said, "It’s true."
Liu Sisi marveled, a delivery-driving super rich second generation guy, so interesting, she wanted to know more about him.
If it weren’t for the situation, she would’ve loved to sit down and chat with Lin Fan.
Liu Sisi said, "I took some time out and can’t talk for long. How about we add each other on WeChat and chat when free?"
"Sure." Lin Fan readily agreed and exchanged WeChat contacts with Liu Sisi.
Liu Sisi walked away satisfied.
Meanwhile, the classmates were all astonished, with eyes flickering with uncertainty.
Goodness!
Could Lin Fan really be that rich delivery guy?
Driving a 70 million supercar?
"Lin Fan, hurry and tell us, you must be joking with Liu Sisi!" Qian Feng said, emotionally stirred, his voice a bit off.
He couldn’t accept it.
Luo Tianming was even more stirred, "Lin Fan, I know you’re from the countryside, how could you be a super-rich second generation, stop joking, it’s not funny."
Lin Fan didn’t argue, calmly saying, "If you think it’s fake, then it’s fake."
Hearing this, everyone sighed in relief; if it’s fake, that’s good.
Luo Tianming playfully scolded, "Lin Fan, don’t joke around next time!"
Kang Min’er scornfully added, "Pretending to be rich just to win over a celebrity, Lin Fan, your tactics are so outdated, careful you don’t bite off more than you can chew!"
Qian Feng, feeling relieved that Lin Fan was poor, was at ease.
"Everyone, stop joking around, we’ve talked so long, getting hungry, it’s time to order food," Qian Feng laughed.
Mentioning the ordering, Luo Tianming became spirited, ready to show off again: "Leave ordering to me, I guarantee it’s the most cost-effective!"
Qian Feng, confidently, said, "Cost-effective? Probably just ordering cheap dishes, saving money but missing the signature dishes, the three most famous and expensive dishes. Missing out means coming for nothing."
Luo Tianming felt a bit offended, cheerfully said, "I’m just thinking of everyone’s wallets."
Qian Feng said, "What if I say, we can taste these three dishes and save money?"
Kang Min’er joyfully asked, "Qian Feng, do you have a way?"
Qian Feng proudly said, "My boss and Jindu Grand Hotel’s General Manager, President Li, are close friends. I often dine here with my boss and am familiar with President Li. Without my boss showing up, just me, Jindu would offer me a 50% discount."
Fifty percent off!
That means spending half the money to taste the best three dishes at Jindu, truly a deal!
Everyone was amazed.
"Brother Feng, you’re awesome."
"I knew Brother Feng has a wide network, even Jindu’s General Manager is his friend!"
"Thanks to Brother Feng, we can finally taste Jindu’s best three dishes today."
Everyone praised Qian Feng one after another.
Qian Feng enjoyed the compliments, glancing at Luo Tianming.
Luo Tianming felt uncomfortable, losing face to Qian Feng, laughed awkwardly, "That’s really great."
Kang Min’er laughed, "Brother Feng, you’re so charming, how come I didn’t notice back in college? Otherwise..."
Kang Min’er spoke while throwing a flirtatious glance at Qian Feng.
Feeling light-headed, Qian Feng said, "I indeed kept a low profile in college, just didn’t want to be too extraordinary, unlike Lin Fan, the campus heartthrob, known across campus."
Kang Min’er laughed, "What heartthrob, a delivery heartthrob? I think Brother Feng deserves the title of campus heartthrob."
Looking at Kang Min’er, Lin Fan shook his head, "Kang Min’er, I remember you used to be the class flower, since when did you become a toady?"

chapters.title: Chapter 33: The Highest Realm of Showing Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: The Highest Realm of Showing Off
Kang Min’er’s face darkened: "What did you say? Say it again, I dare you."
She was furious. Lin Fan actually talked back to her, calling her a sycophant so directly.
Qian Feng was really annoyed by Lin Fan’s attitude; if you’re poor, you should stay silent and obediently accept being trampled upon.
Qian Feng laughed: "Lin Fan, I’m friends with the general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel, and you? Do you know him? Aren’t you bragging about driving a sports car worth 70 million? Can you get us the best food here for half price?"
Lin Fan smiled: "Are you talking about Li He? Yes, I know him. He’s my assistant."
Today, Li He personally delivered stock shares to Lin Fan, as Tang Jinhong, the owner of Jindu, had appointed Li He as Lin Fan’s assistant.
Li He is Lin Fan’s assistant!
Everyone paused, then burst into laughter.
Qian Feng laughed until his stomach hurt: "Lin Fan, there should be a limit to joking around. Are you trying to make me laugh to death?"
While the classmates were mocking Lin Fan.
Two impeccably dressed waiters came over, pushing a cart adorned with flowers.
Unexpectedly, they stopped at their table.
"Buddha Jumps Over the Wall, British Kobe Beef Pie, Iced Sugar Blood Bird’s Nest."
The waiter announced the dishes, placing the three dishes from the cart onto the table.
These three dishes were precisely the signature dishes of Jindu Grand Hotel!
Everyone was stunned; they hadn’t ordered any dishes, yet here they were being served?
Qian Feng asked: "What’s going on here?"
The waiter, with a very respectful attitude, said: "This is arranged by our general manager, President Li. These three signature dishes are sent for everyone to taste, and there’s also a bottle of ’82 Lafite, sent to everyone. If you find it not enough, feel free to order more. In short, whatever you eat or drink tonight, it’s all on President Li."
As the waiter spoke, he indeed took a bottle of Lafite from the cart!
Everyone was amazed. President Li is treating!
This meal is overly luxurious!
Three signature dishes free to eat!
’82 Lafite free to drink!
And you can order additional food and drinks at will!
Compared to this, half-priced signature dishes are nothing!
Lin Fan smiled slightly, feeling that Li He was being quite considerate this time; this meal is not cheap.
"No need to ask, it’s surely for Brother Feng’s sake that President Li is treating us to this meal!"
"That’s right, Brother Feng, you truly have influence!"
"Brother Feng, I admire you so much, you are my idol!"
Everyone started flattering him, besides Qian Feng, they couldn’t think of anyone else who could make President Li spend so lavishly.
Kang Min’er giggled: "Brother Feng, President Li indeed treats you as a friend, it’s so considerate, I always knew Brother Feng had charisma!"
Luo Tianming’s face turned pale. He had to admit, trying to show off tonight, he lost to Qian Feng, lost too miserably.
Qian Feng felt delighted, yet was slightly incredulous; did President Li learn about his class reunion and specifically treat them to dinner like this?
This kind of recognition is just too rewarding.
When did he become so important in President Li’s mind!
Could it be that President Li had an eye on him and wanted to poach him from Jingdong to Jindu?
Thinking this, Qian Feng felt immensely proud; he couldn’t help it, he was simply talented, hence appreciated, hence sought after.
Just then, a suit-clad Li He, with a beaming smile, approached.
All his classmates immediately noticed Li He had arrived.
Qian Feng smiled like a sycophant and said: "President Li, we’re old friends, how could I let you splurge like this?"
However, Li He seemed oblivious to Qian Feng’s presence, heading straight to Lin Fan.
He bowed respectfully.
"Mr. Lin, how does this arrangement suit you?"
Li He asked respectfully.
Lin Fan nodded: "Hmm, not bad. The most important thing is that everyone enjoys their meal."
Li He responded: "Of course, besides these signature dishes, there’s another dish our hotel is about to launch as the main dish, yet to appear on the market. I’ve already instructed the chef to prepare it, so that you and your friends can be the first to taste it."
Lin Fan smiled: "Alright, thank you for that."
Witnessing this, everyone was stunned.
Qian Feng’s smile became painfully stiff.
What?
Is this some sort of illusion?
Li He, the general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel, actually bowing and being respectful to Lin Fan!
Even inviting Lin Fan to taste the main dish not officially launched by the hotel!
What’s the deal?
Why Lin Fan?
Kang Min’er’s face changed as she was sharp enough to realize something, shaking uncontrollably.
After his shock, Luo Tianming found it amusing; tonight, in trying to show off, he was continuously overshadowed by Qian Feng, which had displeased him.
Luo Tianming feigned surprise and said: "Oh wow, so it’s not because of Qian Feng that President Li is treating us?"
Qian Feng blushed furiously, knowing Luo Tianming was being deliberate; how embarrassing!
Only now did Li He notice Qian Feng’s presence, slightly surprised: "Oh, Qian Feng is here too, turns out you’re Mr. Lin’s classmate; to be Mr. Lin’s classmate, you must be really envied."
Qian Feng couldn’t help but ask: "President Li, what’s all this about, why are you so respectful to Lin Fan?"
Li He smiled: "If you were the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group, I’d be just as respectful to you."
What?
Everyone was dumbfounded again.
Lin Fan turns out to be the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group?
This is too shocking!
Qian Feng asked shakily: "About Lin Fan saying you’re his assistant, can this be true?"
Li He replied: "It’s true; it was arranged by President Tang for me to be Mr. Lin’s assistant."
Qian Feng fell silent.
Holy...!
It’s actually true!
Everything about Lin Fan must be true!
He’s the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group!
He’s a super-rich second generation!
He bought a street of luxury goods!
He drives a 70-million sports car!
If previous claims were doubted, now Li He’s personal confirmation leaves nothing uncertain.
Qian Feng’s face turned ashen, slumping into the chair.
He had bragged the whole night, only to find out in the end he was a big fool.
Compared to Lin Fan, everything about him seemed trivial and insignificant.
Lin Fan, a super-rich second generation posing as a delivery guy, this is truly the pinnacle of showing off!
After discovering Lin Fan was a super-rich guy, all classmates went mad, regretting their previous disdain and mockery towards Lin Fan, wishing they could die from embarrassment.
They desperately wanted to salvage the situation, figuring out ways to ingratiate themselves with Lin Fan.
What a joke, if not to curry favor with a super-rich guy, who else? Plus, being classmates with Lin Fan, they had ready advantage!
Luo Tianming was first to change tack, laughing heartily: "Brother Fan, you kept us in the dark, dressing up as a delivery guy, I admit you fooled me."
Luo Tianming’s words offered the others a direction.
They all chimed in: "Yeah, Brother Fan’s really playful."
"You tricked us miserably, Brother Fan."
"What’s this, Brother Fan was just joking with us, haha, really amusing."
Lin Fan calmly replied: "I really am a delivery guy, it’s not pretend; who says rich people can’t be delivery guys?"
Everyone paused, what, really a delivery guy?
This made things awkward.

chapters.title: Chapter 34 Lin Fan’s First Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34 Lin Fan’s First Love
Luo Tianming chuckled, "Brother Fan is absolutely right; rich people can do whatever they want, and of course, they can also be delivery workers. Besides, Brother Fan is both wealthy and handsome, even the starlet Liu Sisi recognized him at first glance as extraordinary. I think Brother Fan just wants to experience life."
Everyone immediately agreed, the life of a rich person can be so dull. Experiencing life for some fun is easy to understand.
At this moment, the waiter brought a new dish.
Steaming hot, with perfect color, aroma, and flavor!
Just looking at it made everyone’s mouth water.
Li He enthusiastically introduced, "This secret recipe steamed eelpout is going to be our new signature dish. Eelpout is the finest of eel fish, with rare and precious ingredients that most people can’t enjoy. Even in this restaurant, it will be offered in limited quantities daily. Mr. Lin, as our second-largest shareholder in Jindu, would you like to be the first guest to taste it?"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan with envy.
Lin Fan was not shy, picking up his chopsticks to take a piece of fish, eating it, and smiling, "It’s indeed very good. Everyone must be hungry, don’t just watch, dig in."
Li He laughed, "I won’t disturb your meal then, I’ll take my leave. If Mr. Lin needs anything, please feel free to call me anytime."
Li He stepped aside.
His task was fulfilled, to spare no effort to give Lin Fan face.
The classmates started their meal, and the mood completely changed. Everyone was vying to curry favor with Lin Fan, and Qian Feng was already forgotten in the corner.
Qian Feng felt very downcast, who was previously high-spirited now felt like a wilted eggplant.
The blow was too great; Lin Fan was too strong, so strong it made him question life.
He thought he was quite good, working at a big company, driving a half million yuan car, he could walk tall among classmates.
It was only after meeting Lin Fan that he realized the comparison made him like a small witch before a great sorcerer.
In front of Lin Fan, his accomplishments were trivial!
Kang Min’er, who was just revolving around Qian Feng, had already tossed him aside. In her eyes, there was only Lin Fan.
She regretted it so much. Had she known Lin Fan was so wealthy, she wouldn’t have dared offend him no matter what; it was all her fault for not seeing it and trying to cozy up to Qian Feng. Compared to Lin Fan, Qian Feng was nothing.
"Brother Fan, I toast to you, my previous ignorance offended Brother Fan, can you forgive me?"
Kang Min’er smiled sweetly, in a coquettish manner.
She was ready to swallow her pride, or perhaps, how much is pride worth? Being on good terms with Lin Fan was most important.
Unfortunately, her beauty offensive had no effect on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan calmly said, "If I were still that penniless delivery worker, would you apologize to me? Of course, you wouldn’t!"
If his "super rich second generation" identity hadn’t been exposed, Kang Min’er wouldn’t be apologizing to him, she’d be stepping on him harder.
Lin Fan had no interest in such a woman.
Everyone felt embarrassed for Kang Min’er, have some dignity, after offending Brother Fan like that, and still wanting forgiveness?
When Lin Fan nailed it, Kang Min’er’s face turned red, and she awkwardly laughed, "Brother Fan, I truly know I was wrong, I’ll punish myself with a drink."
Gulping down a glass of Lafite.
Everyone felt a sting in their hearts, sister, take it easy, that wine is very expensive!
Kang Min’er put down the wine glass, smiling, "Brother Fan, I did have a crush on you back in university, you were my male god then, and you still are now."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, but you’re not my goddess."
Kang Min’er was the type of woman extremely practical, driven by money and connections, scheming to catch Lin Fan, but his words were a clear rejection. Stop dreaming of getting him.
These words greatly bruised Kang Min’er’s self-esteem; she was once the class beauty and even now the most attractive among her classmates.
But what does pride matter? She’s decided, even if Lin Fan hits or scolds her, she must cling to him.
Luo Tianming laughed, "Brother Fan’s goddess is indeed someone else; I know who she is..."
Lin Fan interrupted Luo Tianming, smiling, "Class Leader, is the food good? Eat more."
Luo Tianming immediately shut up, not daring to speak more. Clearly, Lin Fan didn’t want him to say it, he blamed himself silently, cursing his own big mouth, if he offends Lin Fan, he’d be in trouble.
Then, there was a loud discussion from the table next to them, so everyone could hear it here.
"Have you heard? Tonight, Young Master Li and Miss Su’s wedding banquet is taking over the third floor of Jindu."
"The Li Family really spared no expense this time; they must be very satisfied with this daughter-in-law."
"The Li Family is so wealthy, and Master Li has only one son, the daughter-in-law of the Li Family will be the future boss lady. I wonder which Miss Su is so lucky?"
"I heard it’s the third Miss, Su Jinjin."
"Such a beauty, truly blessed!"
Upon hearing the discussions, when the name "Su Jinjin" was mentioned, Lin Fan’s expression changed.
A flood of memories washed over his heart.
During university, his goddess was the campus belle Su Jinjin!
He confessed to Su Jinjin, and they fell in love, but this relationship was kept secret, known only to a few like Luo Tianming.
It appeared to be a romantic first love between the campus king and queen, but in reality, it was a bittersweet love story of a poor boy and a rich girl with an unsurprising ending.
The Su Family found out about the romance.
They intervened, sending Su Jinjin abroad for study, forcibly cutting off the relationship.
Since then, Lin Fan never saw Su Jinjin again.
Until now, hearing news of Su Jinjin again, yet it was about her getting married!
Right upstairs!
Lin Fan’s feelings were incredibly mixed.
What a damn cliché!
Even cheesy Korean dramas wouldn’t script such a scene!
Luo Tianming noticed the change in Lin Fan’s demeanor, sighed inwardly, and didn’t dare speak up more. Lin Fan didn’t even want to mention Su Jinjin’s name, let alone hearing about her marriage; his mood was imaginable.
Unaware classmates started discussing it.
"Su Jinjin? Isn’t she the campus belle from our year?"
"What a coincidence, she’s getting married tonight. It’s a pity she wasn’t in our class, or we’d be enjoying some wedding wine tonight."
"Su Jinjin is really a top-notch beauty, I’d say it’s Young Master Li who’s fortunate."
Kang Min’er, however, curled her lips in disdain, disliking women more beautiful than herself.
If Su Jinjin had been in their class back then, Kang Min’er wouldn’t even have a chance at being the class beauty. Class beauty and campus belle are not on the same level.
Kang Min’er, a bit tipsy from the 1982 Lafite, joked, "Brother Fan, do you have a girlfriend? If not, I could be your bride."
Lin Fan’s expression had returned to normal, smiling, "Sure."
Kang Min’er shivered, sobering up, "Really?"
Lin Fan said, "In the next life."
"..."
Kang Min’er wanted to smash her head against a wall.
Luo Tianming found the opportunity to compliment, immediately adding, "Brother Fan, being rich and handsome, there’s no worry about finding a bride. Any beauty, as pretty as can be, Brother Fan is just not in a hurry to marry."
Lin Fan shook his head, he had long since moved on from Su Jinjin, but deep inside, he still found it hard to accept Su Jinjin marrying someone else. Maybe only marrying himself could bring balance to his heart.
Lin Fan said, "Class Leader, you’re wrong. I actually wish the heavens would grant me a bride right now."
Just then.
"Lin Fan!"
A voice called out in surprise.
There was a commotion in the hall, and they saw an absolutely beautiful bride dressed in a shining white wedding gown running up to Lin Fan.
Everyone was stunned.
My gosh!
Is Lin Fan a lucky charm? Say you want a bride and here comes one!
"Give me some of that luck, I want ten million!" someone immediately started praying to Lin Fan.
And at this moment, Lin Fan, looking up at the bride in front of him, was dumbfounded.
She was, Su Jinjin!

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Runaway Bride
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: Runaway Bride
A bride dressed in her finery, as if she had stumbled into the wrong place, dashed into the first-floor lobby with some panic in her steps!
The previously bustling lobby suddenly quieted down as everyone turned to look, their faces filled with surprise.
What’s going on?
This bride in the wrong place is unbelievably beautiful!
An oval face, long hair draped over her shoulders, and a figure that couldn’t be hidden even by her wedding dress.
A goddess who is a 99 in her own right, with the addition of the pure white wedding dress and bridal makeup, makes a perfect 100, astonishing everyone!
No one knew why she ran here, but when she inadvertently saw Lin Fan, she blurted out Lin Fan’s name and quickly ran to him.
Lin Fan, upon seeing her, was also stunned.
Su Jinjin!
His first love.
The third daughter of the Su Family, who was supposed to be married upstairs tonight!
Lin Fan had no intention of meeting her, so her sudden appearance in front of him, and recognizing him, was entirely unexpected and unimaginable for him, even in his dreams.
Lin Fan was left speechless for a moment, unsure of how to react.
It was so difficult for him.
Behind Su Jinjin, there was another commotion, as if someone was running in this direction.
Su Jinjin heard the noise, showed a look of anxiety, and looked at Lin Fan, pleading, "Lin Fan, they’re coming after me, can you take me away from here?"
What?
Everyone exchanged looks, the bride was supposed to find her groom, yet she wanted a delivery guy to take her away?
Lin Fan finally came to his senses and curiously asked, "What’s going on?"
Su Jinjin said anxiously, "I don’t have time to explain, I don’t want to marry that person!"
"Alright!"
Lin Fan immediately jumped up.
That one sentence "I don’t want to marry" from Su Jinjin was worth a thousand explanations; for Lin Fan, it was enough.
Lin Fan grabbed Su Jinjin’s hand and walked towards the door.
Luo Tianming was dumbfounded; things happened so suddenly. For someone like him, who knew about Lin Fan and Su Jinjin’s relationship, it was almost magical.
Kang Min’er looked puzzled and bewildered, wondering why Su Jinjin had to find Lin Fan.
The two of them had just reached the door.
"Su Jinjin, stop right there!"
A loud shout came from behind.
A young man in a suit, along with a group of people, chased into the lobby.
He was the groom for the night.
Young Master Li, Li Jianxing!
Li Jianxing’s face was full of anger, especially when he saw Su Jinjin holding hands with a delivery man, his eyes nearly burned with rage.
Li Jianxing and Su Jinjin were having a Western-style wedding on the third floor. The pastor asked him if he was willing to take Su Jinjin as his wife.
Li Jianxing smiled like a lecherous pig and loudly said he was willing. Damn, who wouldn’t be? Su Jinjin was really too beautiful. The thought of spending the bridal chamber night with such a beauty had him practically drooling.
However!
When the pastor turned to ask Su Jinjin if she was willing to marry Li Jianxing, Su Jinjin fell silent.
The silence lasted only three seconds, but it was enough to make Li Jianxing anxious.
In the end, Su Jinjin threw down the flowers she was holding and ran off, saying, "I’m not willing," right in front of all the guests.
When the stunned guests finally reacted, Su Jinjin had already run out.
Li Jianxing immediately chased after her with his people.
His bride, unwilling to marry him, had run away.
This left Li Jianxing feeling utterly humiliated and almost furious, particularly because the bridal night he had long awaited might not happen; he had waited for this day for so long, and now that victory was snatched away, how could he not be angry!
Su Jinjin heard Li Jianxing’s angry shout, stopped, turned around, and said calmly, "I’m sorry, I can’t marry you."
Li Jianxing said, "Why? Whatever it is, come back upstairs with me and we’ll talk!"
It was too humiliating in front of so many strangers.
Su Jinjin replied, "I’m not going back with you. I’m leaving."
Li Jianxing pointed at Lin Fan and said angrily, "Who is he?"
Su Jinjin glanced at Lin Fan, unsure of how to introduce the relationship between her and Lin Fan, not wanting to embarrass anyone.
"His name is Lin Fan, Jinjin’s first love,"
Another voice interjected, and a middle-aged noblewoman walked over, her face gloomy.
Lin Fan would never forget this face; she was Su Jinjin’s mother, Zheng Xue’e.
The leading force that broke up Lin Fan and Su Jinjin back then!
Zheng Xue’e, now appearing in a fit of anger, seemed unwilling to spare her daughter any dignity, directly exposing the relationship between Lin Fan and Su Jinjin!
No wonder she was so furious. She believed that Su Jinjin’s runaway was Lin Fan’s doing, that this poor boy had shown up again!
Everyone was amazed!
Besides Luo Tianming, the classmates were all stunned!
Kang Min’er nearly shrieked; what, Lin Fan and Su Jinjin had dated?
So it turned out Lin Fan’s goddess was Su Jinjin, no wonder Su Jinjin sought him out earlier.
The bride’s first love actually helped the bride elope!
This plot is such a cliché!
Li Jianxing was nearly driven mad with rage, feeling utterly betrayed; his bride ran off with her ex-boyfriend. How could Li Jianxing hold his head up if this got out?
It must be the fault of this guy Lin Fan, who spirited away the bride!
For a moment, everyone thought Lin Fan had stirred up this trouble.
Lin Fan was speechless, he felt so wronged.
Su Jinjin quickly said, "Mom, this has nothing to do with Lin Fan. It’s because I don’t want to marry Li Jianxing that I happened to run into Lin Fan."
She spoke the truth, but Zheng Xue’e wasn’t going to believe her.
Zheng Xue’e retorted angrily, "Don’t tell me it was just a coincidence, eating here coincidentally, do you take me for a child!"
Su Jinjin, exasperated, said, "It really is like that, I’m not lying."
Zheng Xue’e shouted, "Enough, I don’t want to hear your lies! Three years, I thought sending you abroad to study would sever you two completely, but no, you’re back and immediately hooking up with him again!"
Su Jinjin’s face turned red, "Mom, what are you saying?"
Zheng Xue’e said furiously, "You don’t like what I’m saying? Look at the mess you’ve made! What’s so good about this Lin Fan that you have to be with him! Look at what he’s wearing, gosh, he’s working as a delivery man! I’ve always said he’s worthless! Su Jinjin, what’s your status, a daughter of the Su Family, you’d give up being the Li Family’s madam to be with this lowly delivery man? Are you trying to infuriate me?"
Su Jinjin found herself speechless, knowing that whatever she said, her mother would never believe her now.
Lin Fan finally spoke up calmly, "Auntie, what Jinjin said is the truth, concerning our innocence, I have to clarify, it was thanks to you that we have nothing between us now, today is really just a coincidence that I ran into her, and she asked me to take her away."
Back then, Lin Fan was filled with dread towards Zheng Xue’e, but facing her again now, he was indifferent.
Zheng Xue’e, anger unable to be contained after being called "Auntie" by Lin Fan, snapped, "Low-class people will always be low-class, no manners! If you want me to believe you, fine, let go of my daughter’s hand and scram, then I’ll believe you!"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’ve cleared things up, whether you believe it or not doesn’t matter to me. But since Jinjin asked for my help, I will help her."
Su Jinjin looked at Lin Fan gratefully and said, "Let’s go, I’ve nothing more to say."
Lin Fan nodded, and the two of them turned and left.
Zheng Xue’e, frustrated and livid, shouted, "Hurry and chase them, bring the lady back to me!"
A group of people immediately ran out to chase, with Li Jianxing leading the way.
Even though Lin Fan had explained, Li Jianxing didn’t believe it; he still thought Lin Fan had abducted Su Jinjin.
He wanted to catch Lin Fan and beat him up.
When they got outside.
They saw Lin Fan already riding away on an electric bike at full speed, with Su Jinjin, still in her wedding dress, sitting on it.
Before everyone’s eyes, the Su Family’s daughter, on her wedding night, ran off with a delivery man.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: You be the groom
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: You be the groom
Li Jianxing brought people in a small car to chase Lin Fan and Su Jinjin. He originally thought that Lin Fan was on an electric bike, so how could he outrun a car?
However, as a delivery rider, Lin Fan knew the streets and alleys of Yun City like the back of his hand. Plus, the electric bike could go into narrow alleys where the car couldn’t fit. With twists and turns, Lin Fan shook off Li Jianxing and his men.
Li Jianxing and his group were left dizzy, and by the time they realized, Lin Fan and Su Jinjin were long gone.
Li Jianxing flew into a rage, "Lin Fan, how dare you run off with my wife? I’ll kill you!"
Zheng Xue’e was also very angry and immediately ordered people to track down Lin Fan and Su Jinjin’s whereabouts: "We must bring Jinjin back. The marriage alliance between the Li and Su families must not be ruined by her!"
In a quiet alley, Lin Fan carried Su Jinjin, with no cars chasing them anymore.
Lin Fan had successfully shaken them off.
Su Jinjin was very happy and breathed a sigh of relief. She definitely didn’t want to be taken back.
"Lin Fan, thank you for helping me," Su Jinjin said gratefully. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she certainly wouldn’t have been able to escape.
Lin Fan said, "Do you have somewhere you want to go? I can take you there."
Su Jinjin said blankly, "No... I definitely can’t go home, and my best friend isn’t in the city... Lin Fan, if it’s inconvenient for you, just let me off here."
Lin Fan said, "It’s late at night, and you’re still wearing a wedding dress. I can’t just leave you here. Since I brought you out, I need to ensure your safety. How about this, I’ll take you to my place."
Lin Fan took Su Jinjin back to the apartment he rented.
Lin Shanshan had just finished showering, holding an apple and eating it while chatting with Cheng Xiaolu on WeChat.
Cheng Xiaolu had been asking about Lin Fan’s situation.
"Shanshan, tell me honestly, does your brother have a girlfriend?" Cheng Xiaolu finally asked the most pressing question.
Lin Shanshan said, "No, my brother’s been single for three years... Why do you ask? You’re not thinking of becoming my sister-in-law, are you?"
Cheng Xiaolu laughed, "Yes, do you think I have a chance?"
Just then, Lin Fan pushed the door open, followed by a stunning beauty in a wedding dress.
Lin Shanshan dropped her apple in shock and said to the other end of the WeChat, "Little Lu, I don’t think you have much hope."
She hung up the WeChat call and exclaimed, "Brother, what’s going on? Where did you abduct a bride from? Are you getting married today, and you didn’t even tell me?"
Lin Fan led Su Jinjin inside, closed the door, and said, "Let me introduce, she’s Su Jinjin, and she’s my sister Lin Shanshan."
Su Jinjin smiled and said, "Hello, Shanshan."
At first, when Lin Fan said he would take her home, Su Jinjin felt a bit awkward, as they were alone and their relationship was ambiguous. It could easily lead to rumors.
It wasn’t until she learned that Lin Fan had a sister living with him that she felt relieved.
Lin Shanshan was even more shocked, "Su Jinjin? You’re my brother’s ex... What is going on here?"
Although she hadn’t met Su Jinjin, she knew about Lin Fan and Su Jinjin’s past relationship, which was the most surprising part.
Lin Fan said, "Jinjin ran away from her wedding."
Lin Shanshan laughed, "Runaway bride? Brother, are you saying you took your ex-girlfriend from her wedding? That’s amazing, brother, I’m in awe."
Lin Fan sweated, "Stop saying that, I didn’t take her away. She wanted to run away herself."
Lin Shanshan curiously asked Su Jinjin, "Why did you run away yourself?"
Lin Fan also wanted to know why.
Su Jinjin sat on the sofa and said, "I have no feelings for Li Jianxing. I only met him for the first time a week ago. Our marriage is an alliance between the Li and Su families. The Su Family Company is not doing well, and only by attaching ourselves to the Li Family is there hope. If I don’t marry Li Jianxing, the Su Family might be finished. I’m just a pawn, and my family is forcing me to be that pawn, but I don’t want to be."
Lin Shanshan nodded, "I see! How did you find my brother, then?"
Lin Fan said, "Tonight I was at a class reunion, which coincidentally was at the same place as her wedding, and she recognized me..."
Lin Fan briefly explained what happened.
Lin Shanshan laughed, "You two are really meant to be. Brother, maybe you should just be the groom."
At her words, Su Jinjin couldn’t help but blush.
Lin Fan sweated, "Lin Shanshan, that’s enough. Tonight, you’ll share the room with Jinjin, I’ll continue sleeping on the sofa."
He only had one room, and since Lin Shanshan arrived, he had been sleeping on the sofa.
Lin Shanshan laughed, "Alright, I’m just joking. Sister Jinjin, I’ll take you to the room to change clothes first."
Su Jinjin said, "Thank you, Shanshan."
Then Su Jinjin went to the room with Lin Shanshan.
Lin Fan watched her go in and took one last look at her in the wedding dress, feeling a bit complicated.
Back then, in romantic moments, he swore to give Su Jinjin a perfect wedding, making her the most beautiful and happiest bride in the world.
He imagined countless times how Su Jinjin would look in a wedding dress, but he never thought it would be like this.
Su Jinjin in a wedding dress was indeed beautiful, stunning even, but it was a terrible, failed wedding, very embarrassing.
Embarrassing to the extreme.
Moreover, it had nothing to do with him.
Three years ago, the powerful Su Family shattered all his dreams.
Su Jinjin entered the room, removed her makeup, took off the wedding dress, and put on Lin Shanshan’s clothes. Their figures were similar, so it fit well enough.
The bare-faced Su Jinjin still amazed Lin Fan.
She looked so good, unchanged from three years ago, still full of youthful charm and beauty.
Memories of everything about Su Jinjin surged like a tide.
Su Jinjin sat down next to Lin Fan with a bit of nervousness.
Since leaving Lin Fan, she had imagined countless times reuniting with him, but never thought it would be like this.
"I need to apologize to you. Sorry for getting you misunderstood tonight," Su Jinjin said awkwardly.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "It’s nothing. I don’t care what they think."
Su Jinjin responded with a hmm, and knew that Lin Fan was still Lin Fan, so distinctive.
Su Jinjin changed the topic, "Lin Fan, have you been well in these three years? Are you working as a delivery rider now?"
She hadn’t expected Lin Fan to be a delivery rider and was indeed a bit surprised when she learned.
Thinking Su Jinjin looked down on her brother, Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but say, "My brother, he actually..."
She wanted to tell Su Jinjin that although her brother seemed to be a delivery rider, he was actually very wealthy, richer than everyone in the Su Family combined.
But Lin Fan’s look stopped Lin Shanshan.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, I’m working as a delivery rider."
Lin Shanshan explained, "My brother used to work in a company, but he was set up and lost his job, so he’s temporarily working as a delivery rider."
She was a bit puzzled why her brother didn’t want her to reveal he had money. Wasn’t he afraid Su Jinjin would look down on him?
Su Jinjin laughed, "Shanshan, don’t misunderstand. I don’t look down on delivery riders. Any legitimate job where you earn money through your own efforts deserves respect."
Lin Fan knew well that Su Jinjin wasn’t someone who looked down on the poor and favored the rich, or she wouldn’t have dated a poor guy like him back then.
He didn’t let Lin Shanshan say he was wealthy because he felt it unnecessary.
Lin Fan said, "Do you have any plans for the future, Jinjin?"
Su Jinjin said blankly, "I don’t know yet."
Lin Fan said, "You can stay here for now."
Even if Su Jinjin stayed at his place permanently, he wouldn’t mind.
Su Jinjin said, "Okay."
She just felt that meeting Lin Fan tonight was really great.
That night, Su Jinjin slept in the room with Lin Shanshan, and Lin Fan slept on the sofa.
The next morning, Lin Fan turned over on the sofa and sat up.
"Ding!"
"System notification: Today’s check-in is available. Signing in grants a piece of land in Daya Bay. Do you wish to sign in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 37: New Rewards, Prime Location Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37: New Rewards, Prime Location Island
"Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, you have successfully acquired an island in the golden zone of Daya Bay. Please check it!"
Lin Fan suddenly woke up.
Today’s reward is amazing, a whole island!
Wait!
Daya Bay is a national-level economic development new area, just south of Yun City!
A future golden zone filled with endless capital influx and hope.
A super economic circle where land is incredibly expensive!
Compared to ordinary islands, owning an island in the golden zone of Daya Bay is worth at least tenfold, or even hundredfold, and the potential for future appreciation is beyond measure!
Lin Fan checked the information on Daya Bay with his phone, a surge of excitement gradually rising in his heart.
This is truly a treasure trove.
The system task requires him to build a trillion-dollar commercial empire.
Decided!
The skyscrapers of this commercial empire will rise on this island in the future!
Using the island as a foundation, starting the grand endeavor belonging to Lin Fan!
"Ding!"
At this moment, the system notification sounded.
"Congratulations to the host, the main task, building a trillion-dollar commercial empire, has successfully taken the first step!"
"Task completion: 1/100"
Lin Fan sighed internally; the system is constantly monitoring the task completion.
"Brother, what are you doing looking at your phone so early?"
Lin Shanshan came out of the room, rubbing her sleepy eyes, puzzled.
The strangest thing was that her brother seemed a bit exhilarated, not knowing what good news he saw so early.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Nothing much, just couldn’t sleep well on the sofa, so I woke up early."
Lin Shanshan grinned, "Brother, you’re so rich, when are we going to move to a big house?"
She’s been longing to live in a big house. Since childhood, she fantasized about having a princess room, filled with plush bears she liked.
Of course, now that she’s grown, her wish has slightly changed, hoping her princess room is filled with brand-name shoes and bags.
Lin Fan said, "Soon."
Once Yunding Manor finds a butler and the house is set up, he and Lin Shanshan will move there.
Lin Shanshan exclaimed, "Really, brother, how big is the house you plan to buy? Best if it’s three bedrooms and one living room, one for you, one for me, and one reserved for Mom and Dad."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, his sister’s idea was a bit conservative. The rooms at Yunding Manor are so numerous that even several of her clones wouldn’t fill them, let alone telling her now and giving her a surprise later.
Lin Shanshan was already envisioning: "I want my room to be pink, with a big closet full of beautiful clothes, shoes, bags..."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, I got it."
Just shoes, clothes, bags? A whole street of luxury goods can be given to you, is it enough?
Lin Shanshan asked, "Brother, are you delivering food today?"
Lin Fan replied, "No, I’m busy today."
Today is the day to hire a butler, yesterday it was arranged; he would choose one from the ten candidates, and he already had someone in mind.
Su Jinjin then walked out, also rubbing her sleepy eyes, "What are you two siblings chatting about so early?"
Lin Fan looked at Su Jinjin, suddenly feeling a surreal moment; Su Jinjin waking up in his apartment was something he dared not dream of if he hadn’t personally brought her back last night.
Lin Shanshan knew her brother didn’t want her to reveal that he was rich, saying, "Nothing much, Sister Jinjin."
Lin Fan said, "Shanshan, take Jinjin to buy a few clothes today, I’ll transfer money to you shortly."
Lin Shanshan joyfully said, "Great, I love shopping."
Lin Fan then went to freshen up, changed into everyday clothes, and went out.
Su Jinjin curiously asked, "Shanshan, isn’t your brother delivering food today?"
Lin Fan didn’t ride the electric scooter but drove the Kosak out.
He was driving when he received a call.
"Hello, is this Mr. Lin Fan? I’m from the National Oceanic Administration Yun City Branch, congratulations on successfully purchasing the land of Chiba Island. You now have a 100-year usage right starting today."
Lin Fan oh’d, efficient work, and replied, "How much did I spend buying Chiba Island?"
Actually, the purchase of Chiba Island was done by the system, Lin Fan didn’t know how much was paid.
The other side found it strange that the buyer didn’t know how much they spent?
However, they had to answer Lin Fan’s question, "Hello, Mr. Lin, you spent 6 billion to purchase this island."
Lin Fan chuckled; buying an island in Daya Bay’s golden zone for 6 billion isn’t expensive.
Currently, the development of Daya Bay is in its initial stages, so it’s a bargain. The price will only get higher in the future, possibly doubling!
"Mr. Lin, the purchase-related procedures can be completed today. Would you prefer to come to the administration yourself, or should we deliver it to you?" the person asked.
Lin Fan thought for a moment, "Please deliver it to Yunding Manor for me, and for now, I’d prefer not to let it be known externally that I bought an island."
He’s been quite high-profile lately and wants to keep it low-key.
The person replied, "Okay, Mr. Lin, we will ensure confidentiality, your information will not be leaked."
...
Early in the morning, the CEO of Shengshi Group, Feng Wanshan returned to his office.
Today, there are two matters he values highly.
One is the recruitment of the butler at Yunding Manor. He trusts Anna considerably, given Anna’s résumé, no one is more exceptional.
Moreover, Mr. Lin cannot know about his relationship with Anna.
This Mr. Lin won’t suspect that he would arrange an undercover agent in Yunding Manor.
Once Mr. Lin’s identity is confirmed, Feng Wanshan will decide the next step.
The second matter concerns the future of Shengshi Group.
The company’s core members have arrived and Feng Wanshan immediately began the meeting.
Feng Wanshan said, "I, Feng Wanshan, founded Shengshi Group to become the world’s strongest company. My goal is for Shengshi to become a trillion-dollar group! The next step is for the country to focus on developing the Daya Bay economic zone, and we need to layout early. This is today’s meeting purpose."
Daya Bay, a national new economic development zone, endless wealth waiting to be created.
Feng Wanshan made a decision; he wants to grab land in Daya Bay!
Feng Wanshan said, "Now both domestic and foreign capital are ready to move, if we don’t buy land, it will be too late. These days, after careful study, I believe Chiba Island is great and want to buy it, what do you all think?"
Everyone agreed with Feng Wanshan’s decision.
"Chiba Island has an excellent geographical location, it’s a treasure trove!"
"Moreover, Chiba Island currently has no owner. We can completely buy it all and develop."
"The price of Chiba Island isn’t cheap and always increasing, but due to the high threshold, no one has bought it yet. If President Feng wants to buy it, he should hurry."
Seeing everyone’s agreement, Feng Wanshan was a bit excited, "Alright, I announce that the company will immediately start the island purchase plan and acquire Chiba Island at the fastest speed."
But at that moment, one of Feng Wanshan’s capable subordinates suddenly exclaimed, looking at the phone in shock.
Feng Wanshan frowned, "What’s wrong?"
The subordinate looked up, "Quick, turn on the TV!"
The TV in the meeting room was turned on.
It was playing the local news of Yun City.
"Daya Bay, as the nation’s next key economic development zone, is currently experiencing a rapid growth trend, with capital frantically flowing in. It is understood that early this morning, Chiba Island in Daya Bay has been bought by a mysterious buyer. Despite multiple interviews and inquiries, the reporters couldn’t find information about the buyer. A source from the Oceanic Administration who wishes to remain anonymous told the reporters that the buyer’s surname is Lin, likely the mysterious Mr. Lin who bought Yunding Manor..."
Feng Wanshan and his team were all dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: The Frustrated Feng Wanshan
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38: The Frustrated Feng Wanshan
After purchasing Yunding Manor for 3 billion, the mysterious buyer Mr. Lin has once again made a move, buying an island in Daya Bay for a whopping total of 6 billion!
This news caused a stir in Yun City once again.
"Damn it, who on earth is this Mr. Lin? He’s ridiculously wealthy!"
"Just in the past few days, he’s spent nearly 10 billion, just like us ordinary people spending a hundred. How rich is he exactly?"
"This Mr. Lin is buying houses and land like he’s planning something big. What is he really up to?"
The entire city was buzzing with discussions.
Within just a few days, this Mr. Lin seemed to have become a household name in Yun City.
Seeing the news report, Lin Fan couldn’t help but smile wryly.
He wanted to keep the purchase of Chiba Island low-key, but somehow the news still leaked. The only consolation is that they only revealed his surname, and for now, no one knows it’s him.
Upon learning that the mysterious "Mr. Lin" had bought Chiba Island, Feng Wanshan felt like crying but had no tears, limply slumping down.
Dammit!
So frustrating!
It’s Mr. Lin again!
He wanted to buy Yunding Manor, but Mr. Lin snatched it away with a lavish 3 billion.
He wanted to buy Chiba Island, but again, Mr. Lin was quicker and got it first!
Is this Mr. Lin his nemesis?
The subordinates began to chatter.
"Holy crap, someone actually has more foresight than President Feng, and what kind of speed is this? We’re still preparing, and they’ve already bought it!"
"Who exactly is this Mr. Lin, does he have connections everywhere?"
"Just found out, after Mr. Lin purchased Chiba Island, within less than a morning, the price of Chiba Island has increased to 6.5 billion! Which means, within one morning, Mr. Lin has already earned 500 million..."
Upon hearing this, everyone fell silent.
This speed of making money leaves no room for bitterness.
That’s just insanely fierce!
Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth, thinking to himself: "Mr. Lin, is it? I surely must find you, just you wait! Anna, it’s up to you next!"
Blue Moon Company.
The most important task today is hiring a butler.
Zhang Dafu returned to the company early to prepare.
He’s been exhausted over this matter the past few days, feeling drained and listless.
However, seeing the news of Mr. Lin buying Chiba Island for 6 billion, he instantly perked up as if injected with adrenaline.
"Holy crap, holy crap, holy crap! Boss, what kind of Divine Level move is this!"
Zhang Dafu was incredibly excited, though he didn’t know what Lin Fan was planning, he keenly sensed that something big was going to happen.
Lin Fan definitely doesn’t buy land randomly, what will his next move be?
Zhang Dafu realized he couldn’t keep up with Lin Fan’s pace anymore.
Now in retrospect, undoubtedly, when Lin Fan first joined Blue Moon, he was only pretending to be an ordinary person to train. This might be a test by the Lin Family for Lin Fan, in short, behind Lin Fan is possibly an unimaginably large super-family, and Lin Fan is likely an heir to that family!
Zhang Dafu decided, he must work harder for the boss, following Lin Fan, the future is bound to be exciting, and even if Zhang Dafu only gets a bit of the spotlight, he will benefit endlessly!
AM.
The interview time was approaching.
Ten candidates arrived at Blue Moon Company, one after another.
Additionally, there were many who love excitement, following this recruitment through various channels.
This might be the most sensational and attention-grabbing recruitment in Yun City in the past decade.
The ten candidates took seats one by one in a line of chairs prepared by the company, conveniently ten chairs.
Zhao Xin’er was the first to arrive, grabbing the first seat in the front row.
Zhao Xin’er had an arrogant expression, as if she had already seized the butler position.
This butler role was hers for the taking!
She saw the news about Mr. Lin buying the island and felt extremely excited. If she became Yunding Manor’s butler, she would be formidable in the future.
Other candidates arrived one after another, but Zhao Xin’er looked at them disdainfully. The image of Yunding Manor’s butler must be good, looks are crucial, just judging by looks alone, she outshines them all!
Until Anna arrived last, Zhao Xin’er finally changed her expression.
Anna still sported an all-black outfit, her long black hair was eye-catching, so beautiful, a sure high-scoring elegant lady, with a strong aura!
Zhao Xin’er pouted, thinking that woman must be just pretty but useless, she, Zhao Xin’er would beat her.
The interview process follows the order of seating, going in to talk with the interviewer, who is Zhang Dafu.
Zhao Xin’er went in first and had a delightful chat with Zhang Dafu.
Zhao Xin’er, a prestigious university graduate, previously worked at an international company as president’s assistant, has rich work experience, capable of managing Yunding Manor.
Zhao Xin’er was highly satisfied with the interview process, thinking she had it in the bag.
After Zhao Xin’er, others went in for the interview one by one, and Anna was the last.
Once Anna completed her interview, the first round was over. One person would be selected from the ten to meet Mr. Lin for the final interview conducted personally by him.
Zhang Dafu came out, smiling: "The interviews just now, Mr. Lin watched via remote live stream and has made a decision."
The candidates all got nervous, only Anna remained calm.
"Zhao Xin’er!" Zhang Dafu suddenly called.
Zhao Xin’er let out a scream, jumped up, ecstatically said: "Is it me? Really me!"
She succeeded, she became the butler of Yunding Manor, she could finally slap Lin Fan’s face.
Everyone turned their heads, displaying jealous expressions.
Even Anna furrowed her brows, really, Mr. Lin has such poor judgment to choose this dumb woman?
Zhao Xin’er proudly scanned everyone, especially Anna with an arrogant and mocking expression.
Seeing the proud Zhao Xin’er, Zhang Dafu slowly said: "Zhao Xin’er, first eliminated."
Silence.
The entire room went silent.
Zhao Xin’er’s smile froze instantly, her face changed from red to white, then white to red, her expression as ugly as someone who just swallowed a fly.
What?
Is this a joke, first eliminated?
This is nuts, Zhang Dafu must have done this on purpose, if it’s not me who got selected, why call my name and get my hopes up for nothing, crazy!
Seeing Zhao Xin’er’s expression, everyone couldn’t help but snicker.
Even Anna felt amused, maybe Mr. Lin has a vendetta against Zhao Xin’er, it’s intentional.
Interesting!
"Miss Zhao Xin’er, you may leave now." Zhang Dafu said indifferently.
Zhao Xin’er blushed, there’s no face left for her to stay, she walked away awkwardly.
Zhang Dafu turned to Anna, smiling: "Miss Anna, congratulations on standing out, you may now go to Yunding Manor to meet Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan had already decided yesterday to appoint Anna as the butler; today’s interview was merely to avoid raising Anna’s suspicions.
Anna remained calm, this result didn’t surprise her, she has always been confident, this confidence comes from her abilities, not blind confidence, it would be unusual if she hadn’t been chosen.
"Alright."
Anna finished speaking and left Blue Moon, riding her motorcycle heading to Yunding Manor.
Mr. Lin just waiting for her at Yunding Manor?
Could it be that the task her adoptive father Feng Wanshan gave her is about to be completed?
Before leaving, Anna sent Feng Wanshan a message: "I’m now going to Yunding Manor to meet Mr. Lin."
Upon receiving the message, Feng Wanshan was a bit excited, could it mean they’ll soon discover the mysterious Mr. Lin’s identity?

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Absolutely Unbelievable That He Is Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: Absolutely Unbelievable That He Is Mr. Lin
Yunding Manor.
Anna arrived at the mansion entrance and saw a flashy sports car parked out front.
Anna was very familiar with the tastes of high society people, this Kosak, valued at 70 million!
The person driving such a luxury car must be a super-wealthy individual.
Did Mr. Lin really come?
Anna began strolling around Yunding Manor, searching for Mr. Lin while admiring the opulent manor. Anna had seen many luxurious homes, yet she was still captivated by the architecture of Yunding Manor.
One must admit, this manor is quite impressive; staying here is indeed a pleasure.
Yunding Manor has a Scenic Pavilion, where one can take in the panoramic view of Yun City.
When Anna reached the Scenic Pavilion, she saw a person with their back to her, standing with hands behind their back, gazing at Yun City.
Anna was a bit dazed, feeling as if she was in the presence of a grandmaster.
This must be Mr. Lin!
"Mr. Lin," Anna called out.
Lin Fan turned around, glanced at her, and smiled, "You’re Anna, right? I’m Lin Fan, the owner of Yunding Manor."
What?
Anna was taken aback; the difference was like night and day. Before he turned around, she thought it was a grandmaster, and after turning, he was just a young man in his twenties?
You’re telling me this is Mr. Lin?
Although Lin Fan was handsome, he was simply too young, lacking the aura of a big boss. The Mr. Lin she imagined should be an elderly master figure, at least a middle-aged man who radiates authority without anger!
Anna was aware of Lin Fan; Feng Wanshan had already briefed her on the situation.
No wonder her foster father suspected that Lin Fan was just a smokescreen and that the real Mr. Lin was someone else. Now even Anna had her doubts.
Could this young man truly be the one who casually spends billions, buying mansions and estates, a super-wealthy tycoon!
Although Anna was well-informed and had met impressive young rich people, at the age of 21, she had never seen anyone with such audacity and such grand gestures. She couldn’t believe there was such an impressive young person in the world.
It seems finding the real Mr. Lin will take some time.
Anna maintained her composure and said, "Yes, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan examined the long straight-haired beauty before him, quite satisfied. Such a beautiful elegant woman, with such an impressive resume, was simply the perfect candidate.
It’s a pity though, Anna was Feng Wanshan’s undercover agent.
If it weren’t for the system’s mission to recruit Anna, regardless of how outstanding Anna was, he wouldn’t have chosen her.
Now he chose Anna, simply for the convenience of recruiting her.
A woman like Anna was definitely not someone easy to recruit; an ordinary man would find her impossible to handle, and Lin Fan could only take it step by step.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’ve seen your resume, you’re very impressive, more than capable of showcasing your talents in a larger place. Why apply for a small position like a housekeeper?"
Feigning ignorance!
Anna said, "I don’t consider being the housekeeper of Yunding Manor a small matter. If Mr. Lin thinks it is, there’s no need to hire me, right?"
Lin Fan laughed heartily, very satisfied with this answer. No wonder the system had selected her. The system asking him to recruit her indicated that this woman was indeed someone who would achieve great things.
"I’ve decided to formally hire you as the housekeeper of Yunding Manor. When can you start?" Lin Fan asked.
"Ding!"
The system suddenly prompted.
"Congratulations to the host, progress made on recruiting Anna mission."
"Mission completion: 1/100"
Anna said, "I can start now."
Lin Fan said, "Good, then I leave Yunding Manor in your hands. I plan to move in three days. Any issues?"
He also wanted to test if Anna truly had skills.
Anna remained calm, "No problem."
Lin Fan said, "By the way, someone from the Ocean Bureau will come later, please receive them for me."
After speaking, Lin Fan left.
Anna was surprised, Ocean Bureau?
After Lin Fan left, a representative from the Ocean Bureau indeed arrived, claiming to be looking for Mr. Lin Fan to handle the procedures for purchasing Chiba Island.
Anna took the island purchase contract and saw the buyer’s name unmistakably as Lin Fan!
Anna felt a bit bewildered, was there really another Mr. Lin? If Lin Fan was just a smokescreen, then it’s too extravagant, making Lin Fan the owner of Chiba Island?
No!
She absolutely refused to believe that this young man, Lin Fan, was Mr. Lin.
As they say, if you’re going to act, go all out. Since Mr. Lin wanted to stay hidden, appointing Lin Fan as the island owner wasn’t surprising. After all, to a super-wealthy man like Mr. Lin, a small island worth 6 billion might just be a trifle.
It must be like this.
Anna took the contract, sent off the representative from the Ocean Bureau, and immediately called Feng Wanshan: "I’ve successfully got the job at Yunding Manor."
Feng Wanshan asked, "Did you see Mr. Lin?"
Anna said, "No, I only saw Lin Fan."
Feng Wanshan was a bit exasperated, "This Mr. Lin is really good at hiding."
Anna said, "There’s something else, Chiba Island was bought by Mr. Lin, and now Lin Fan is the owner of Chiba Island."
Feng Wanshan was startled, "Are you sure?"
Anna said, "The Ocean Bureau just left, I have the island purchase contract in my hand. It’s authentic."
Feng Wanshan was exasperated, "What on earth is this Mr. Lin trying to do? Anna, keep a close watch on Lin Fan. I need to know his daily schedule!"
...
Lin Fan drove the Kosak out of Yunding Manor, planning to return to his apartment.
Before he went down the mountain, he received a call from Lin Shanshan, "Brother, something’s wrong, Sister Jinjin is in trouble."
Lin Fan quickly asked, "What happened?"
Lin Shanshan said, "I’m not sure how to explain, we’re at Yida Mall, come quickly."
Lin Fan said, "Okay, I’ll be there in ten minutes."
Lin Fan stepped on the accelerator, and the Kosak sped out like lightning.
Yida Mall.
Lin Fan found Lin Shanshan at the entrance. She was with Su Jinjin, who was sitting aside like a withdrawn young lady, her eyes red as if she had just cried, eliciting sympathy.
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Shanshan, what’s wrong with her?"
Lin Shanshan said, "We were buying clothes, and after receiving a phone call, Sister Jinjin became sullen and then started crying. I asked her, but she wouldn’t say."
Lin Fan then sat down next to Su Jinjin and said, "Jinjin, is there anything I can help with?"
Su Jinjin, seeing Lin Fan come over, lifted her head and gave a bitter smile, "Lin Fan, you can’t help me this time. It’s my mom’s call; she told me Grandma said if I don’t obediently go back and marry Li Jianxing, she will expel me from the Su Family."
Madam Su!
Lin Fan remembered her; three years ago, this Madam Su also opposed Su Jinjin being with him.
Back then, Madam Su sent someone to give Lin Fan 300,000 as a break-up fee with Su Jinjin, but Lin Fan firmly rejected it.
That was followed by the Su Family forcibly sending Su Jinjin abroad.
Lin Fan said, "You don’t want to leave the Su Family?"
Su Jinjin said, "It’s not that I don’t want to; they’re forcing me to marry someone I don’t love. I have no attachment. I’m just sad to be driven out like this; the people of the Su Family will only laugh at me."
Lin Fan said, "They shouldn’t bully you like this."
Su Jinjin gave a bitter smile, "But what can I do? In their eyes, I’m just a pawn. I have no power to resist."
Lin Fan became thoughtful, "I understand."
Later that day, a piece of news suddenly broke out.
The new owner of Yunding Manor, the mysterious buyer Mr. Lin, will be inviting a lady from the Su Family to Yunding Manor in three days.
This news caused a sensation in Yun City once more, and shook the entire Su family community!

chapters.title: Chapter 40: An Invitation, 2 Families Submit
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: An Invitation, 2 Families Submit
The Su Family in Yun City, a second-tier family, neither big nor small.
Usually, nobody pays much attention to them. Even the big news of the third Miss Su Jinjin eloping from her wedding last night didn’t cause much of a stir.
In recent years, due to poor management, the Su Family’s Company has been declining and is struggling to survive.
To save the family business, the Su Family decided to arrange a marriage with the Li Family, which is similarly just a second-tier family. First-tier families are not willing to associate with the Su Family.
Even though Su Jinjin is considered a renowned beauty.
However, beauties are the least scarce in high society, a world that values money above all. Earning money is the main focus; beauties are often just accessories.
Just like emperors in ancient times who would marry off princesses to local lords to stabilize their rule, the children of these families often share this fate.
On the surface, they are wealthy sons and daughters, of noble status. But their freedom in marriage and love often gives way to family interests. When two families need to unite for warmth, they become pawns.
Few pawns dare to rebel.
Su Jinjin is one of them.
Her sudden act of eloping at the wedding can be said to be a shocking move.
Yet, this action garnered widespread criticism in high society.
Why? If everyone followed Su Jinjin’s example, how could society function? High society has its own rules. Su Jinjin broke those rules, naturally causing displeasure.
The Su Family members, in particular, were displeased with Su Jinjin.
If Su Jinjin refuses to marry into the Li Family, how can the Su Family be saved? If the Su Family can’t be rescued, can they still have good days?
Everyone has their own calculations.
Madam Su is determined to save the Su Family. She doesn’t care who marries Li Jianxing. If Li Jianxing specifically wants Su Jinjin, then it’s Su Jinjin.
When Su Jinjin disobeyed, she threatened to cast Su Jinjin out of the family.
Zheng Xue’e, Su Jinjin’s own mother, thinks the Su Family has no future. If Su Jinjin can’t marry into a first-tier family, she might as well marry into the Li Family so she can become the mistress of the house. As her mother, she could also benefit.
As for the other daughters of the Su Family, none of them wanted to marry Li Jianxing.
In a group chat excluding Su Jinjin, she was criticized countless times.
"I’ve heard that Li Jianxing indulges in debauchery and flirts all the time, a complete playboy. Let Su Jinjin marry him!"
"If Su Jinjin won’t marry, does that mean I should marry him? That little bitch, she’s trying to ruin me!"
"Really, why did she elope? She doesn’t want to be a pawn; do we want to be?"
"That bitch! Grandma said she’d kick her out of the family. That would free her, but what about us?"
Just as the entire Su Family was condemning Su Jinjin.
A piece of news suddenly broke out.
The new owner of Yunding Manor, Mr. Lin, intends to invite a young lady from the Su Family to the manor as a guest!
The news caused an earthquake throughout the Su Family!
Mr. Lin is the big figure who recently shook Yun City. Naturally, the Su Family was aware of him.
Especially this morning, Mr. Lin made a huge move, spending 6 billion to buy Chiba Island.
This mega-rich person left the Su Family in awe. The family chat group buzzed with longing voices, as Mr. Lin, such a super-rich individual, seemed very distant from them.
Unexpectedly, in less than half a day, the Su Family unexpectedly had a connection with Mr. Lin!
It was simply unbelievable.
Madam Su immediately gathered the Su Family members for a family meeting: "I suppose everyone knows the reason for this meeting."
Someone asked, "Grandmother, is this news genuine? Could someone be playing a prank on us?"
Madam Su said, "There’s no mistake; this invitation was personally delivered by the new butler of Yunding Manor."
Madam Su took out an invitation, which was still sealed.
The news was confirmed, and everyone in the Su Family was excited.
"So it’s true that Mr. Lin has taken a liking to one of our Su Family daughters. What an enormous honor for our family!"
"We have over ten unmarried daughters in the Su Family. Which one has Mr. Lin taken a liking to?"
The Su Family members were filled with curiosity.
A very beautiful girl, full of confidence, said, "I think Mr. Lin must be interested in me!"
She is the second Miss Su Zixin of the Su Family, always confident in her looks, second only to Su Jinjin in beauty.
Her statement, however, displeased the other daughters of the Su Family.
"Why should it be you? I say it is me!"
"Exactly. Maybe Mr. Lin likes girls like me, who are a bit chubby."
"Stop arguing. Any of us could be chosen. The least likely is Su Jinjin, as she’s supposed to marry Li Jianxing."
Upon this comment, the Su Family daughters burst into laughter.
Madam Su then said, "Stop arguing, the person’s name should be inside this invitation."
Immediately, everyone quieted down, tensely watching the invitation. The daughters all prayed that Mr. Lin had chosen them.
Madam Su finally tore open the invitation and took a look.
Madam Su was dumbfounded: "Su Jinjin."
What?
The crowd was flabbergasted!
Mr. Lin wanted to invite Su Jinjin?
They had just said that Su Jinjin was the least likely candidate.
This turnaround was too swift!
The daughters were filled with envy, jealousy, and hatred towards Su Jinjin. Why was it Su Jinjin?
Even Madam Su was surprised. When did Su Jinjin get to know Mr. Lin?
Of course, that was not important. What mattered was that there must be a significant relationship between Mr. Lin and Su Jinjin. Otherwise, why would Mr. Lin invite only Su Jinjin as a guest?
What did this mean? Madam Su, of course, understood.
If the Su Family could use Su Jinjin to gain a connection with Mr. Lin, then saving the Su Family would be just the beginning; it’s possible the Su Family could even soar to become a first-tier family!
Zheng Xue’e was already overjoyed: "No wonder Jinjin refused to marry Li Jianxing. In front of Mr. Lin, the Li Family is nothing! Wonderful, wonderful, I never thought my daughter could be so accomplished!"
Her tone was full of pride, seemingly forgetting that just last night she was furious over Su Jinjin’s elopement.
Madam Su thought for a moment and made a decision: "Immediately cancel the marriage contract between Su Jinjin and the Li Family and welcome Su Jinjin back home!"
At this moment, Li Jianxing was still searching everywhere for Su Jinjin.
The prey that was almost his had escaped, and he was extremely unwilling. He vowed to find Su Jinjin and take her back, even if it meant using force.
Anyway, the Su Family now needed to rely on the Li Family, so they dared not say anything. The Su Family might even be eager for Su Jinjin to be with him.
Thinking of this, Li Jianxing gave a sinister smile. Little bitch, just dare to resist me!
Yet at this moment, the Su Family released news, unilaterally announcing the official dissolution of the marriage contract with the Li Family. The alliance between the Su and Li Families was annulled!
When this news reached Li Jianxing, he was both shocked and furious.
What?
The Su Family dared to be so arrogant, unilaterally canceling the marriage agreement?
That down-and-out Su Family, where did they get the nerve to so boldly offend the Li Family? Who gave the Su Family the courage?
Then another piece of news came to Li Jianxing’s attention.
The mysterious, buzzworthy buyer, Mr. Lin, invited a Su Family young lady to Yunding Manor as a guest!
Li Jianxing thought of something, his face drastically changing: "Could it be that Mr. Lin invited Su Jinjin?"
No wonder the Su Family dared to be so arrogant.
It was Mr. Lin who gave the Su Family the confidence!
Li Jianxing instantly lost his temper; as for Mr. Lin, this Li Family, a second-tier family, dared not offend him.
And those who understood the matter looked on, clicking their tongues in awe.
"Mr. Lin is incredibly powerful; with just a guest invitation, he managed to control both the Su and Li Families."
"Mr. Lin’s influence is that terrifying!"
"With money, one can do anything!"

chapters.title: Chapter 41 Please Call Me Breakup Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41 Please Call Me Breakup Master
Yida Mall, Lin Fan hid in a deserted corner and made a call to Anna.
In three days, he would be moving into Yunding Manor. For the housewarming, he needed to arrange a simple celebration party.
And the only guest for this party was Su Jinjin from the Su Family in Yun City.
Furthermore, Lin Fan didn’t want the Su Family to know his identity just yet, so the invitation should be under "Mr. Lin".
After giving these instructions, Lin Fan returned to Su Jinjin’s side.
Su Jinjin still looked sullen.
Lin Fan comforted her, "Jinjin, don’t worry. Everything will work out eventually. How about I take you to a movie to cheer you up?"
Su Jinjin gave a bitter smile, "Thank you for trying to cheer me up, but I don’t feel very hopeful."
Lin Fan asked, "Do you trust me?"
Su Jinjin said, "Hmm..."
Lin Fan was always the person she trusted the most, and even now, he was the one she was most willing to trust.
Lin Fan smiled, "If you trust me, then drop those worries and come watch a movie with me."
Su Jinjin realized her current situation wasn’t sustainable, so she agreed with Lin Fan.
So, they stopped shopping for clothes, and Lin Fan took the two ladies to the mall’s cinema to watch a movie.
In the cinema, it was mostly couples, with a few single guys scattered around.
Seeing Lin Fan with two stunning women made the guys green with envy.
The catch was, both women were exceptionally beautiful, absolute goddesses!
The single guys’ eyes turned red with jealousy. Damn, dude, you’re killing us!
Even those with girlfriends weren’t much better off. One guy glanced at his unattractive girlfriend, and lost all interest in the movie.
Comparing people can kill you with frustration.
The girlfriend was annoyed, and snapped, "Kneel!"
The guy shuddered and actually knelt down, quickly and perfectly. He seemed quite practiced, probably did it a lot.
Pfft!
Seeing this, the people around burst into laughter.
The guy’s face was flushed with embarrassment. Oh, it was so humiliating, but he couldn’t help it. Girlfriends aren’t easy to come by, and look at those single guys, watching a movie alone, how pitiful.
A few other guys with girlfriends gave him sympathetic looks, silently supporting him.
A look shared a world of understanding.
It seemed like they were all in the same pitiful boat.
The girlfriend scolded him, "Are you disgusted with me? Look at yourself in the mirror, do you deserve it? Are you thinking about breaking up?"
The guy quickly apologized, "I’m sorry, I was wrong. What can I do for you to forgive me?"
These days, women are so badass, threatening breakups at the drop of a hat. Guys struggle to find girlfriends and don’t want to be single, so they just grin and bear it.
Lin Fan observed and shook his head. Being a man was tough.
