This wasn’t even about looks; Lin Fan was quite handsome, but when he had no money, Zhao Xin’er still despised him.
Money is a man’s strongest weapon.
Most men, due to lack of money, even when with an unattractive girlfriend, have to tread carefully.
The girlfriend got more aggressive, "So you want me to forgive you, huh? Buy me that necklace I liked. I sent you the link last night, and you played dead all night."
The guy smiled bitterly, "That necklace is 10,000 yuan. I’ve already borrowed a lot and can’t get any more money."
The girlfriend snapped, "So you’re saying you won’t buy it?"
The guy said, "I truly can’t afford it."
The girlfriend shouted angrily, "Break up, watch the movie by yourself then!"
She stormed off.
The guy actually didn’t chase after her; instead, he felt a sudden relief.
Finally, he didn’t have to buy that necklace or take on another 10,000 yuan debt.
Lin Fan was embarrassed; he only brought Jinjin to watch a movie to lighten her mood. He hadn’t done or said anything, yet it caused a couple to argue and break up.
Could it be that he had an undiscovered skill, a breakup expert?
Just being present made couples split up, this is...
Call me the breakup master!
The guy who just joined the single crowd quietly got up, collected his movie ticket, and walked into the theater alone, his silhouette lonely yet heroic.
Lin Fan sighed, "Bro, better a short pain than a long one. You’ve grown, and, no need to thank me..."
Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but remark, "That’s how it is for men without money. If the guy were rich, it would be the girl worshipping him."
Lin Fan looked at Su Jinjin with a smile, "Jinjin, you wouldn’t do that to me, would you?"
Su Jinjin replied, "You think I’m like her... wait! I’m not your girlfriend now!"
Su Jinjin blushed furiously. What was Lin Fan doing, making her heart race like this!
She’d spent over a year convincing herself she’d let him go...
Lin Fan quickly skedaddled, "I’ll go get the tickets!"
The movie was a comedy, starring a recently popular comedian named Shen Teng, and it was hilarious.
After watching the movie, Su Jinjin felt much better and forgot about her troubles for a while. She couldn’t help but thank Lin Fan; his method was indeed effective.
When they left the theater, two hours had passed.
Just outside the cinema, they saw a middle-aged man being approached by an attendant, who respectfully bowed to Su Jinjin.
"Third Miss!"
Su Jinjin was surprised to see this middle-aged man, "Uncle Cai, how did you find me here?"
Uncle Cai, the steward of the Su Family Mansion, had served the Su Family for thirty years. Everyone in the Su Family knew him, and he was held in high regard.
Uncle Cai said, "The old lady issued a bounty last night to find you. Today we received a tip and learned you were here, so she sent me to invite you back."
Su Jinjin was stupefied. What tip?
She didn’t know that the tip came from Lin Fan. The invitation from "Mr. Lin" had been sent, so the Su Family was eager to find Su Jinjin.
Lin Fan allowed them to find her.
Su Jinjin said, "Uncle Cai, I won’t go back. I refuse to marry Li Jianxing, even if it kills me."
Uncle Cai said, "The Third Miss misunderstood. The old lady has already canceled your engagement to Li Jianxing. You don’t have to marry into the Li Family. The old lady said she rescinded her previous words and won’t expel you from the Su Family. This time, she sincerely wishes to invite you home."
Su Jinjin was stunned, did she hear that right? Her grandmother had always pressured her to marry Li Jianxing, how could she suddenly change her mind?
"Uncle Cai, is this a trick from Grandma to deceive me into going back? Do you think I’ll fall for it?" Su Jinjin said angrily.
Uncle Cai quickly said, "No, Third Miss. The old lady truly canceled the engagement. There’s a reason; it’s because of that Mr. Lin. He wants to invite you to Yunding Manor as a guest."
Su Jinjin was very surprised, "Yunding Manor, Mr. Lin? I don’t know him, why would he suddenly invite me as a guest?"
She knew of Mr. Lin, a mysterious super-rich man, but she had no connection to him.
Little did she know, Lin Fan was Mr. Lin, right beside her...
Lin Fan chuckled, "Jinjin makes a good point. You say this Mr. Lin invited Jinjin. Do you have proof?"
Uncle Cai said, "The proof is with the old lady."
Lin Fan said, "So keen to invite Jinjin back, but I don’t see your sincerity. Since the evidence is with the old lady, she should personally come to invite her back!"
Uncle Cai was stunned. What, have the old lady personally come to invite Su Jinjin back? That demand was too much!

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Looked Down Upon by a Snake Spirit Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: Looked Down Upon by a Snake Spirit Face
"What did you say, you want me to personally invite her back? Su Jinjin said that to you?"
Madam Su was furious, slamming the table with a loud bang.
The members of the Su Family present were all astonished.
With Madam Su’s status in the family, she was second only to the head, much like Empress Dowager Cixi; her word was law in the Su Family.
No one in the Su Family had ever dared to offend her authority.
Ordering Su Jinjin to leave the Su Family was just a matter of her saying so.
Since when was it a junior’s turn to ride over her? Forcing Madam Su to personally invite Su Jinjin was simply preposterous!
No wonder Madam Su was so outraged; Su Jinjin was challenging her authority!
Uncle Cai wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, "This was Lin Fan’s idea, but the third young lady didn’t object."
Madam Su’s face was icy as she looked at Zheng Xue’e, "Look at the daughter you raised!"
Zheng Xue’e dared not say anything, but a trace of smugness flashed in her eyes. Jinjin was someone Mr. Lin favored; given Jinjin’s current status, why shouldn’t this old hag have to personally invite her?
The Su Family members who envied, resented, and hated Su Jinjin seized the chance to attack.
"Su Jinjin is too arrogant, showing no respect for her elders. Such a person should be expelled from the Su Family!"
"Who does she think she is, asking Grandma to fetch her? Why doesn’t she just ascend to the heavens!"
"If Su Jinjin is already being excessive, who knows what she might do in the future? Such a person cannot stay!"
Amongst a chorus of criticisms, Madam Su remained silent.
Once everyone quieted down, Madam Su suddenly asked, "Where is Su Jinjin now?"
Uncle Cai replied, "They’re shopping at Yida Mall. They’ll be gone before dark, wait for no one. Madam, if you don’t personally fetch her, she might not meet Mr. Lin."
Uncle Cai wiped away the sweat again, feeling that Su Jinjin was overly arrogant, even though he was just delivering the message.
To be precise, it was Lin Fan who was overly arrogant, as it was all his idea.
Madam Su was taken aback; Su Jinjin must meet Mr. Lin. The Su Family still relied on Mr. Lin, and if Su Jinjin offended Mr. Lin, it would be bad news.
"Fine, I’ll go!" Madam Su gritted her teeth and said.
What?
Madam Su actually decided to invite Su Jinjin herself!
This was unimaginable. No junior in the Su Family had ever received such a privilege, nor dared to have such a privilege!
The Su Family members were speechless with shock, leaving the room utterly silent.
Zheng Xue’e’s eyes flashed with a cold smile, knowing this old hag would compromise, unless she didn’t care about the Su Family’s future.
Madam Su, of course, wasn’t compromising to Su Jinjin but to Mr. Lin!
Now, aligning with Mr. Lin was the only chance for the Su Family to change their fate. Madam Su, if she wasn’t foolish, had no reason to let it pass.
Meanwhile.
Lin Fan continued shopping at Yida Mall with the two girls.
After learning about Mr. Lin’s invitation, Su Jinjin couldn’t calm down for a long time.
Yunding Manor, Mr. Lin, this mysterious billionaire, why invite her as a guest?
But regardless of the reason, Mr. Lin’s move undoubtedly rescued her from her current predicament.
She wouldn’t have to marry Li Jianxing, nor would Grandma drive her out of the Su Family. Instead, her status in the Su Family skyrocketed; her Grandma had to invite her back, even personally.
Su Jinjin asked Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, should I accept the invitation?"
Lin Fan smiled, "With Mr. Lin’s status, he probably wouldn’t do anything to you. Why not meet him?"
Su Jinjin said, "Um... could you come with me?"
As a girl, she couldn’t fully reassure herself. Mr. Lin was a super rich man, and if he had any nefarious intentions, she wouldn’t be able to handle it alone.
Lin Fan found it amusing and replied straightforwardly, "Sure, I’ll go with you."
With Lin Fan agreeing to accompany her, Su Jinjin finally felt relieved.
Lin Fan said, "Looks like you won’t need to buy new clothes; you can go home soon."
Honestly, he wished Su Jinjin could stay at his place for a few more days, even indefinitely.
But to help her out of her troubles, it didn’t matter.
Lin Fan didn’t fully understand why he was helping Su Jinjin; maybe even though she was no longer his girlfriend, she still held an important place in his heart.
Instead of shopping for clothes, they started having fun in the mall.
The entertainment facilities here were quite ample—karaoke, arcades, claw machines... and girls could spend half a day just at the claw machines.
Su Jinjin and Lin Shanshan were happily competing to grab plush toys, laughing and talking, as if they had become good sisters.
Lin Fan stood at the entrance of the claw machine shop, watching the two girls with satisfaction. He brought them here to make them happy, and if they were happy, that was enough.
Su Jinjin called out, "Lin Fan, come play with us."
Lin Fan said, "No thanks, I’m afraid that once I join, you’ll lose and start crying."
Su Jinjin giggled, "You’re bragging, I don’t believe you, just come over!"
Lin Shanshan added, "Brother, come help me, I can’t compete with Sister Jinjin."
Lin Fan was about to go over when a heavily made-up coquettish woman, arm in arm with a middle-aged wealthy man, happened to walk by.
The makeup on the woman’s face was as thick as a wall, a typical snake-faced girl.
The middle-aged wealthy man’s hand was wrapped around the snake-face girl’s waist, constantly moving towards her bottom.
Attracted by the commotion, the snake-faced girl glanced at the claw shop and sneered, "Cheap amusement for poor people, look at them, poor people enjoying their poverty."
The middle-aged wealthy man gave Lin Fan a disdainful look; this guy was dressed in cheap clothes, clearly a poor man, although the two girls with him were quite pretty.
"Honey, if you want a plush toy, I’ll buy you a whole carful," the middle-aged wealthy man said with a sly smile, squeezing the snake face girl’s behind.
The snake-face girl acted coyly, "I don’t want these cheap plush toys. I’ve recently taken a liking to an L.V bag. It’s not expensive, just 30,000 yuan."
The middle-aged wealthy man gave a lecherous smile, "No problem, as long as you make me happy, you know what I mean..."
The snake-face girl understood perfectly, but pretended to be shy, "President Luo, you’re so naughty..."
With that, the two of them walked off with flirtatious laughter.
Lin Fan felt a bit speechless; there were really many gold-diggers who despised the poor and loved the rich. Even at a claw machine, he encountered one. He really couldn’t understand how these women, who traded their bodies to please rich men for some cash, had the gall to look down on others.
Fortunately, Lin Shanshan and Su Jinjin were absorbed in grabbing toys and hadn’t noticed the snake-face girl, sparing them an instance of mental pollution.
"Brother, why are you still not coming?" Lin Shanshan urged.
Lin Fan said, "I’m a little thirsty, I’ll go get a drink first, then I’ll play with you guys. Do you want a drink?"
Lin Shanshan: "I want bubble tea!"
Su Jinjin: "Just bring me a bottle of mineral water."
Lin Fan then walked out and headed to the convenience store on the mall’s first floor.
As he was entering the store, a man came face-to-face with him. They looked at each other, stunned, recognizing one another.
"Lin Fan!" the man said joyfully.
Lin Fan was also delighted, "Li Xiaoming!"
This man was his high school classmate Li Xiaoming; they had a good relationship in high school. What a coincidence, they hadn’t seen each other for years and they were meeting here now.
Li Xiaoming pulled Lin Fan aside for small talk, "Lin Fan, do you remember what we said in high school? That we’d find pretty girlfriends in the future. You’re getting more handsome; you must have a girlfriend, right?"
Lin Fan shook his head, "No girlfriend."
Li Xiaoming laughed, "Then you’re behind. I’ve already found one. Let me show you a picture."
It was clear Li Xiaoming really liked this girlfriend; he bragged about her to everyone he met.
Pulling out his phone, Li Xiaoming opened the photo album and zoomed in on a picture to show Lin Fan, "Isn’t she pretty?"
Lin Fan looked at the photo and was stunned, wasn’t this the snake-faced girl from earlier!
Seeing Li Xiaoming’s blissful smile, Lin Fan felt a bit sympathetic, "Brother, do you know where your girlfriend is now?"
Li Xiaoming said, "Hmm, she said she went to get her hair done."

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Live Stream, Furiously Slapping the Snake Spirit’s Face!
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Live Stream, Furiously Slapping the Snake Spirit’s Face!
"We met on a blind date. I was attracted by her charm at first sight, and she treated me well too. She said that she’s been struggling on her own for the past few years and is a bit tired, wanting to find a good person to rely on. She praised me for being honest and reliable, someone she could entrust her life to, and so we started dating. We planned to get married by the end of this year, and in a few days, I’ll take her to meet my parents."
Li Xiaoming spoke with a face full of happiness, dreaming about the future.
Lin Fan sighed in his heart. Love is a light, bro, your girlfriend has put a green light on your head, and you don’t even know it.
He really didn’t want to ruin his old classmate’s beautiful dream, but he couldn’t stand his friend being deceived by a snake-like woman.
Lin Fan asked, "Does your girlfriend come here to do her hair?"
Li Xiaoming asked in surprise, "No, why do you ask?"
Lin Fan said, "Because I think I just saw her."
Li Xiaoming said, "Impossible. The salon she often goes to isn’t here, you must have mistaken her for someone else!"
Lin Fan said, "Or you could call the salon and check."
So, Li Xiaoming called the salon: "Hello, is my girlfriend He Minmin there?"
The salon replied, "Sir, Miss He did not come today."
Li Xiaoming hung up the phone, looking a bit upset, realizing his girlfriend had lied to him and didn’t go to the salon!
But then he consoled himself, maybe she switched to another salon. However, this reason didn’t convince him; his girlfriend is a VIP at that salon and normally wouldn’t switch.
Li Xiaoming said, "Lin Fan, where did you see her?"
Lin Fan said, "At the third-floor claw machine arcade entrance, hugging a middle-aged man, looking like they were about to leave, although I could be mistaken."
Li Xiaoming was shocked: "What?"
He immediately turned around and ran towards the outdoor parking lot.
Lin Fan followed him.
As soon as they walked out the mall entrance, there stood He Minmin alone by the roadside, seemingly waiting for a car.
Indeed, she didn’t go to the salon!
Li Xiaoming’s face turned ashen, and he immediately wanted to rush over and confront her.
Lin Fan quickly grabbed Li Xiaoming: "Wait, you can test her first."
This snake-like woman is cunning, looking to marry an honest man while hooking up with wealthy guys. Lin Fan feared Li Xiaoming might be fooled by her sweet words. Besides, the wealthy middle-aged man wasn’t present now.
Li Xiaoming thought Lin Fan made sense, so he took out his phone and called He Minmin.
By the roadside, He Minmin picked up her phone and answered sweetly, "Darling, why are you calling me?"
Li Xiaoming asked, "Where are you now?"
He Minmin laughed, "Didn’t I tell you? I’m getting my hair done. I can’t talk now, it’s inconvenient."
He Minmin hung up hurriedly, as a BMW had pulled up in front of her, and the wealthy middle-aged man leaned out to talk to her.
Seeing this, Li Xiaoming turned green with rage.
He saw and heard with his own eyes and ears; the evidence was conclusive; He Minmin was cheating on him!
He could no longer hold back and rushed out, shouting angrily: "He Minmin, you bitch!"
This time, Lin Fan didn’t stop him.
He Minmin was flirting with the wealthy middle-aged man, preparing to get in the car and leave.
Suddenly hearing Li Xiaoming call her, He Minmin was startled, turned quickly, and saw Li Xiaoming, her face turning pale.
Meanwhile.
Nearby, a livestream host was streaming. Her name was Feng Xiaomo. Usually, her stream wasn’t very popular, with at most around a thousand viewers. She was struggling for interesting content and didn’t know how to boost viewership.
Today she was just wandering for fun, casually streaming while chatting with online friends.
As she was aimlessly chatting, she was suddenly drawn by Li Xiaoming’s shout.
Feng Xiaomo, seeing this, exclaimed with delight, "Wow, there’s something happening over there, it looks like a couple is having a fight, let me show you all."
Feng Xiaomo switched to the rear camera, and the scene of Li Xiaoming, He Minmin, and the wealthy middle-aged man appeared.
The previously dull comment section suddenly became lively.
"What’s this, a love triangle?"
"Looks like someone got caught cheating."
"666, a live breakup showdown?"
Caught red-handed, He Minmin was initially shocked and quickly pleaded, "Darling, it’s not what you think, let me explain."
Li Xiaoming angrily replied, "Explain what? Lin Fan told me about you and him hugging, you cheating pair!"
He Minmin frowned, "Lin Fan?"
At this moment, Lin Fan walked over, smiling, "You’re welcome."
He Minmin recognized Lin Fan, realizing it was the handsome guy she saw earlier at the claw machine entrance!
Handsome indeed, but dressed entirely in cheap clothes—a downright pauper that she had no interest in.
Meanwhile, Feng Xiaomo saw Lin Fan and became swooned, "Oh my, what a handsome guy!"
The comment section instantly flooded.
"Wow, he’s really handsome! As a guy, even I find him handsome!"
"Way more handsome than those pretty boys, manly and handsome, would love to know him!"
"Stop gawking at the handsome guy, isn’t the drama more interesting!"
The witness had appeared, and the evidence was irrefutable, leaving He Minmin with no room for denial.
Her face turned icy, "Since you already know, there’s nothing more to say, let’s break up!"
Li Xiaoming was heartbroken and furious, "You bitch, why did you do this? You claim to love me yet turn around and fool around with this old man!"
The wealthy middle-aged man felt annoyed, "Watch your mouth, kid! Minmin, can you handle this or not? Otherwise, I’m leaving."
He Minmin anxiously replied, "Wait, President Luo, he’s my boyfriend. Give me a moment to get rid of him."
The wealthy man gave an "Oh" in disdain, glancing at Li Xiaoming, "So he’s your boyfriend, huh? Looks like a poor loser!"
Li Xiaoming blushed in anger, "You bastard, if you dare, come down here and fight me!"
The wealthy man sneered, "Fight? Dirtying my hands with a pauper like you? No chance."
He Minmin scolded, "Enough, Li Xiaoming, is President Luo wrong? He has tens of millions in assets. What do you have? You’re just a pauper! If I don’t look for ways to earn money and plan for our future, are you planning to let me starve in the future!"
Li Xiaoming trembled in anger, unable to speak or refute her words.
Moreover, he was indeed poor.
Too poor to have any confidence.
The viewers felt sympathy.
"This guy is having a tough time!"
"Damn, this woman is shameless, cheating yet acting justified, she’s a bitch!"
"Someone from the Zaun province, please join in and curse this bitch!"
Because of this drama, Feng Xiaomo’s stream quickly flooded with viewers, rising from the usual thousand to over ten thousand, and still climbing.
Feng Xiaomo’s stream had never been this lively, making her elated inside, but outwardly she expressed sympathy, "Who knows what this guy will do, the shame of a man."
Just then, Lin Fan spoke up, "Who says Xiaoming is poor? He’s actually very wealthy; any claim of tens of millions is weak compared to him."
What’s going on?
Everyone was taken aback.
Even Li Xiaoming himself was baffled, wasn’t he poor?
Everyone turned to look at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "Years ago, Xiaoming invested in my business. Over the years, the company made a lot of money. I haven’t had the chance to give Xiaoming his dividends. Today it’s due. Xiaoming, give me an account number later, and I’ll transfer your billion dividend share to you."
The livestream exploded instantly.
"Wow, is this real, a billion in dividends!"
"My god, if true, that’s insane!"
"This is going to be a slap to the snake-like woman’s face, hopefully, he’s not bluffing."
The snake-like woman was momentarily stunned by Lin Fan, but then sneered, clearly not believing him: "Are you claiming to be a rich person?"

chapters.title: Chapter 44: A Man Worth Tens of Millions Fled in Panic
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: A Man Worth Tens of Millions Fled in Panic
Lin Fan said, "It’s true, that year Little Ming helped me with 100 bucks to start my business when I was struggling. As the company grew, it multiplied by a million times, coincidentally making it a hundred million."
Li Xiaoming: "???"
Lin Fan sounded so believable that he almost bought it. Excitedly, he thought, damn, do I really have a hundred million dividends with Lin Fan?
But the cheap clothes Lin Fan wore sobered him up.
Lin Fan was clearly pulling a fast one on He Minmin.
However, Lin Fan’s trick didn’t seem very clever. Pretending to be rich isn’t easy; you can tell if someone’s got money just by looking at them.
Sure enough, the snake-faced girl was briefly fooled, then sneered, "You shouldn’t use a mirror to check yourself; dressed so shabbily, how could you be wealthy?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Whether you have money or not isn’t shown by how you dress. Some people wear branded clothes just to bluff, eating instant noodles while in debt; others dress in cheap clothes simply to be low-key. I originally wanted to stay low-key, but now I don’t mind showing off a bit."
The snake-faced girl laughed loudly, "What are you pretending for? I want to see what exactly you’re showing off!"
The plump middle-aged man also sneered, "Show off wealth? You, you poor soul, can you even scrape together two hundred bucks from head to toe?"
The stream chat was filled with worry.
"Is the bro about to crash and burn?"
"Failed poser moment?"
"Bro, don’t disappoint everyone!"
"What now, I’m too afraid to watch."
Just then, Lin Fan calmly took out the Kosak key and pressed it lightly.
Beep beep!
The Kosak made two pleasant chirps, the headlights instantly shone, brilliant like diamonds.
Lin Fan said casually, "Is my car worth two hundred bucks?"
What?
Silence, dead quiet around the world!
The middle-aged plump man and the snake-faced girl were dumbfounded.
They thought they were seeing things, but Lin Fan’s car keys reminded them that yes, this car belonged to Lin Fan!
Li Xiaoming’s mind was filled with shock; this car was Lin Fan’s, Lin Fan was indeed wealthy, and extremely rich at that!
From his memories, Lin Fan was also a kid from a poor family; could he really have started a company and made big money?
The chat exploded.
"Holy moly! Kosak, a world-class supercar!"
"Wow, wow, too handsome, kill me ’cause I’m dead for it!"
"Ahhhhhhhh..."
"Too awesome, the bro really is loaded 6666..."
"Face slap to the snake-faced girl, she’s doomed!"
Feng Xiaomo had already turned into a starry-eyed fan girl, this bro was handsome and rich, so close at hand, she really wanted to get to know him.
Lin Fan looked at the plump middle-aged man then: "Your net worth is in the millions? My car alone is worth seventy million, seven times your net worth."
Crushing, straightforward crushing!
The chat was already bowing.
"Just remembered, this car is limited to 3 globally, top of the top!"
"He really is a billionaire!"
"Too rich, bowing to the tycoon!"
"Such a young, handsome billionaire, does he really exist?"
The middle-aged plump man was red-faced, truly a crazy face slap, just ridiculed the guy for not having two hundred bucks, turns out his car alone was seventy million, how much wealth is that!
He didn’t even dare to provoke Lin Fan.
A super tycoon like Lin Fan could probably wipe him out with a wave of his hand.
Leaving was the best option, the middle-aged man immediately started his car, left the snake-faced girl, fled in a panic, like a stray dog!
The snake-faced girl was still in shock, didn’t even realize the plump man had escaped.
Lin Fan looked at Li Xiaoming, smiled and said: "Little Ming, no need to get upset over worthless people, wait until you get your hundred-million dividends, then take your time finding a good girl."
Lin Fan’s words were aimed at provoking He Minmin.
Li Xiaoming, who just thought Lin Fan was pretending to be rich, found Lin Fan was simply flexing with real power; at this moment, even if Li Xiaoming was a fool, he knew what to do.
He needed to dump He Minmin, that bitch.
Li Xiaoming said: "Lin Fan, you’re right, I don’t want this bitch."
"Little Ming, I know I was wrong, forgive me this once, don’t leave me!"
Thunk!
He Minmin knelt down, grabbed Li Xiaoming’s leg, crying and begging.
He Minmin’s eyes were red, a hundred-million dividends, how could she go against that?
Smack!
Li Xiaoming slapped He Minmin’s face hard, cursed, "You bitch, you love money so much, didn’t you break up with me? Get lost!"
He Minmin said: "I won’t leave, even if you beat me to death, I won’t leave, I’m sticking with you, dear, forgive me, will you? Now you have so much money, I don’t need to earn a living anymore, I swear I’ll be faithful to you."
She looked like a pitiful dog wagging its tail.
Li Xiaoming was utterly disappointed with her: "He Minmin, you got your eyes on the prize, too bad I don’t have a hundred-million dividend."
He Minmin froze: "???"
The chat was flummoxed.
"Whoa, what’s going on?"
"???"
"???"
Li Xiaoming said: "I never invested in Lin Fan’s company, the hundred-million dividend was just a trick to fool you, but through this incident, I truly see you for what you are."
The chat erupted in laughter.
"Hahaha, all part of the plan!"
"The bro’s got deep game!"
"Laughed myself silly, gold digger got played."
He Minmin stood up with a furious face, almost losing her temper: "Li Xiaoming, I’m totally done with you!"
She didn’t dare curse at Lin Fan, only at Li Xiaoming, turned around and walked away swearing.
Li Xiaoming laughed coldly: "Good riddance, not sending you off!"
When He Minmin really left, Li Xiaoming felt a bit lost, after all, he really loved He Minmin before and was heartbroken this time.
Lin Fan walked up, patted his shoulder: "Don’t worry, this kind of woman isn’t worth your pain, find a good girl next time."
Li Xiaoming nodded: "Yeah, Lin Fan, you’re right, thanks a lot this time, let me treat you next time."
Lin Fan smiled: "Sure."
The two exchanged contact information, and Li Xiaoming took his leave.
Lin Fan originally just came down to buy a drink, didn’t expect to be delayed by such an incident, worried about the two girls, he headed back to the mall.
Feng Xiaomo really wanted to approach Lin Fan, she was captivated by this handsome, rich young bro, but since she had filmed secretly, she didn’t dare let Lin Fan know, afraid of his displeasure.
After all, Lin Fan was a billionaire, and she, a minor streamer, didn’t dare provoke him.
Feng Xiaomo could only watch Lin Fan leave wistfully but had already deeply remembered Lin Fan.
Her stream had only a thousand viewers initially, but because of Lin Fan, viewers rushed in, resulting in over 100,000 people!
Rising rapidly from obscurity, she quickly climbed the streaming platform ranks, gained a bit of fame, and felt quite satisfied.
And Lin Fan also gained countless new fans, the legend of the handsome young tycoon face-slapping the snake-faced girl began to spread...
Lin Fan was completely unaware, he returned to the mall’s convenience store, bought his drink, and planned to go find Lin Shanshan and Su Jinjin.
At that moment, a black sedan pulled up to the mall entrance.
The car stopped, from the black sedan stepped down a thin, small old lady.
Madam Su arrived!

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Still So Arrogant
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45: Still So Arrogant
The floors above the fifth floor of Yida Mall are under renovation and haven’t opened yet, so the elevator stops operating at the fifth floor.
Lin Fan and others are waiting on the seventh floor for Madam Su.
With the support of several Su Family members, Madam Su took the elevator to the fifth floor, then had to climb two flights of stairs. The mall’s stairs were long and steep, which really gave Madam Su’s old bones a hard time.
Some younger Su Family members started cursing.
"Damn it! Su Jinjin must have done this on purpose to make things difficult for Grandma!"
"Even if Grandma did threaten to kick her out of the Su Family, she shouldn’t need to go this far for revenge!"
"I think this rotten idea came from her ex-boyfriend Lin Fan, but the fact that Su Jinjin doesn’t oppose it says something too!"
Madam Su finally made it to the seventh floor.
Completely out of breath!
Back aching!
She stood for a moment before she could catch her breath.
She was a bit annoyed, thinking that after living such a glorious life, she had been pranked by a junior from her own family, and she couldn’t even get angry!
Su Jinjin is not who she used to be!
Frustrating, indeed.
"Take me to see them," the old lady said after calming herself.
They stood in front of a restaurant still under renovation and saw the Lin Fan and Lin Shanshan siblings, but Su Jinjin was nowhere to be seen.
She was probably hiding inside the restaurant.
"Where is Jinjin?"
Madam Su stared sharply at Lin Fan, asking coldly.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Jinjin is inside. She doesn’t want to see you, so she asked me to speak on her behalf."
Madam Su frowned, "She wanted me to personally come and invite her back, and now that I’m here, she won’t see me?"
The younger Su Family members were upset. Wasn’t this just playing with them? It wasn’t easy for Grandma to come all this way!
Lin Fan said, "You should know better than anyone why she doesn’t want to see you. Who threatened her to marry someone she didn’t love, nearly destroying her life’s happiness for the sake of family interests? And after she mustered up the courage to call off the wedding, who threatened to kick her out of the family? If someone treated you like that, would you be happy to see them?"
Madam Su said coldly, "So what does she want?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s simple—apologize. Apologize to her for the wrongs you’ve done."
What?
Several younger members of the Su Family were shocked.
Madam Su is actually expected to apologize to Su Jinjin!
Has Su Jinjin gone mad? No matter what, Madam Su is Su Jinjin’s grandmother—this is outrageous!
Madam Su glared at Lin Fan, her mind racing, and said, "From what I know of Jinjin, even if she resents me, she would never do something so out of line. Lin Fan, this is all your idea, isn’t it? You’re the one instigating Jinjin!"
Lin Fan smiled, "It was my idea, so what?"
Damn!
It really was Lin Fan’s idea!
The younger Su Family members could not hold back.
"Lin Fan, you have some nerve. Who do you think you are? You’re just a damn nobody!"
"You’re just Su Jinjin’s ex-boyfriend. What’s the point of this? Do you think Su Jinjin would still choose you?"
"Mind your own business! Su Jinjin has caught Mr. Lin’s eye. It’s no longer your turn!"
"Exactly. If Su Jinjin doesn’t choose Mr. Lin, would she choose a poor boy like you? Mr. Lin is a super tycoon. How can there be such a huge difference when both of you are named Lin!"
The Su Family members made scathing remarks at Lin Fan and laughed wantonly.
Lin Shanshan couldn’t stand hearing others speak of her brother like that because her brother wasn’t poor!
But her brother had instructed her not to mind it, so she stayed aside with her phone.
Lin Fan remained indifferent to the Su Family’s words and wasn’t bothered.
Their words couldn’t hurt him, but if they knew Mr. Lin was actually Lin Fan, it would be a critical blow.
Madam Su snorted, "I haven’t settled with you for abducting Jinjin last night—do you really plan to oppose me? Think it over first: no matter how much the Su Family falls, dealing with you would only take a finger!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh really? Three years ago, wasn’t your Su Family at the peak? Was I ever afraid of you? You personally took a check for 300,000 to negotiate with me to break up with Jinjin—did I ever care? Now your Su Family is already a sinking ship, and you’re still playing threats!"
Madam Su was trembling with anger. Lin Fan’s words had hit too close to home.
Back then, she indeed tried to leverage money against Lin Fan, thinking a poor boy like him would surely yield to such temptation. However, Lin Fan wasn’t moved at all, and later she had to forcibly send Su Jinjin abroad to break them up.
This steadfast Lin Fan left a deep impression on her, and she couldn’t believe that he hadn’t changed at all in three years.
Still so arrogant!
"Lin Fan, a mere poor boy dares to look down on the Su Family? Do you really think I don’t dare to take action against you?" Madam Su sneered.
Lin Fan calmly said, "You can try. Offending me is offending Jinjin, and offending Jinjin means offending Mr. Lin."
Madam Su’s face darkened, "Are you threatening me with Mr. Lin? Are you not afraid that I might just choose to offend Mr. Lin and, in turn, get rid of Su Jinjin and teach you a lesson?"
Lin Fan replied, "You certainly could do that, but by doing so, your Su Family would likely be beyond salvation. I don’t think you’d take that path."
Madam Su scoffed. Lin Fan really had her hemmed in. She was relying on association with Mr. Lin to pull the Su Family from its predicament, even hoping to elevate it to a top-tier family.
How could she possibly act to spite herself and ruin everything over something so petty!
Lin Fan smiled, "Madam Su, today you’ve indeed had a rough time, but my intention is simply for you to treat Jinjin better. The Su Family owes her too much, and if you respect her in the future, you will earn my respect as well."
Madam Su chuckled softly—a slap followed by a sweet. How well-played.
"Lin Fan, I actually quite admire your character, and you do have some smarts. It’s just a pity you’re a poor boy. From what I know, you’re delivering parcels, right? How unfortunate—you’re from a different class than the Su Family. Your respect? I don’t need it!" Madam Su scoffed openly.
With these words, the younger Su Family members laughed again.
"Lin Fan, you’re overestimating yourself. Who do you think you are?"
Lin Fan chuckled. He wasn’t going to say it yet, but soon enough, the Su Family would know just who he was.
With Lin Fan’s current financial power, it would take merely a lift of his hand for the Su Family to meet their end without even realizing it.
Feeling she’d put Lin Fan in his place, Madam Su felt a bit better. "I came here today entirely because of Mr. Lin. Have Jinjin come out, and I’ll apologize to her."
Lin Fan gave Lin Shanshan a glance.
Lin Shanshan picked up her phone and said, "Sister Jinjin, you can speak now."
It turned out she had been connected with Su Jinjin the whole time, and Su Jinjin had heard all the previous conversation.
Su Jinjin said, "Grandma, I went back home before you arrived. In three days, I’ll go see Mr. Lin."
Everyone was stunned—Su Jinjin hadn’t been there the whole time; they’d all been played by Lin Fan.
Madam Su was relieved; it was good that Su Jinjin was willing to see Mr. Lin. There was hope for the Su Family after all.
Madam Su, with a benevolent expression, said, "Jinjin, it’s good that you’re willing to come back. In the past, it was Grandma’s fault. From now on, you can do what you love, and Grandma will never force you again."
"Thank you, Grandma."
Madam Su coldly glared at Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, let’s leave today’s matters as they are. In the future, don’t provoke my Jinjin, and stop thinking about targeting the Su Family. If it happens again, I won’t be so courteous!"
With that, she turned and left.
At the staircase entrance.
Lin Fan suddenly called out, "Madam Su, be careful on the stairs. Don’t slip and fall; you’re not as steady on your feet at your age. I wouldn’t dream of targeting you."
Madam Su stumbled and almost slipped, luckily she was supported by the younger ones, which scared her into a cold sweat.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: 10 million can’t touch him, retreat quickly!
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Chapter 46: 10 million can’t touch him, retreat quickly!
Mr. Lin invited Su Jinjin to Yunding Manor, and this caused a sensation in Yun City that night.
This is not surprising. Recently, Mr. Lin, who spent nearly ten billion to buy luxury houses and islands, has become the center of public attention.
Being invited by the super-rich Mr. Lin is really something people envy and resent.
Su Jinjin even became the public enemy of many women for a time.
People are curious, why Su Jinjin?
This Su Jinjin, although indeed very beautiful, is only from a second-rate family. If she really climbs up to Mr. Lin, she will truly be soaring high!
Subsequently, news about Su Jinjin’s runaway marriage was also dug up, causing widespread discussion.
Many speculated that Su Jinjin’s runaway marriage might have something to do with Mr. Lin!
Su Jinjin is someone Mr. Lin has set his sights on, so naturally, there’s no need for her to marry into the second-rate Li Family. Everyone knows how to choose between a super-rich man and a second-rate family.
Thus, the rumor of Mr. Lin forcefully taking love away spread among the people.
Li Jianxing became a laughingstock for a time.
Lin Fan did not expect this; he somewhat underestimated the influence of "Mr. Lin".
Li Jianxing, upon hearing the rumors, was so angry his face turned green. He didn’t dare to trouble Su Jinjin, nor did he dare to trouble Mr. Lin.
After much thought, he finally decided to vent his anger on Lin Fan.
"If it weren’t for this kid helping Su Jinjin escape, I would have caught her last night and there would be nothing Mr. Lin could do about it! It’s all because of this Lin Fan, ruining my plans. Hire someone to teach Lin Fan a lesson immediately!"
Li Jianxing wanted to deal with Lin Fan!
After all, in his view, Lin Fan was just a powerless delivery guy, so what’s the big deal about bullying him? Lin Fan should just accept being bullied.
Unaware of this, Lin Fan, after settling matters with Madam Su, drove his Kosak to take Lin Shanshan back home.
"Brother, you’re trending!"
Lin Shanshan, looking at her phone, suddenly exclaimed in surprise.
Lin Fan was puzzled: "What’s going on?"
Lin Shanshan handed her phone to Lin Fan to see; it was a segment of a live video clip that had already gained tens of thousands of shares and million likes online!
Lin Fan sweated, wasn’t this the incident where he taught that snake-face a lesson today!
Dammit!
Apparently, it was secretly filmed and even garnered some attention online.
Glancing at the comments, netizens unanimously deemed Lin Fan as a low-key yet righteous super Rich Second Generation!
This super Rich Second Generation is not only brain-meltingly handsome but also possesses a strong sense of justice!
This garnered Lin Fan a slew of admirers within no time.
Female users in the comments basically expressed awe at Lin Fan’s looks, instantly becoming his face-fans.
"Ahhhhhhh... too handsome, I’m over it!"
"How can anyone be so handsome and rich? If only he were my boyfriend."
"I’m in love!"
"I’m unilaterally declaring that I am his wife!"
Apart from the face squad reaching a climax, some comments became curious about Lin Fan’s identity.
There are quite a few famous Rich Second Generations online, and their identities are well known, yet no one knows Lin Fan’s identity!
Which super family does he belong to?
After all, driving a Kosak, he surely isn’t an ordinary rich kid.
Some speculated that Lin Fan might belong to the Kyoto Lin Family!
The Kyoto Lin Family, a colossal wealthy super family!
But looking at publicly available information from the Kyoto Lin Family, there’s no such person named Lin Fan.
Lin Fan found this both funny and frustrating.
"I didn’t mean to be so high-profile, but my innate charm, captivating as it is, even I couldn’t control it; unintentionally, it spread."
Lin Fan was helpless.
He also accepted it, so what if he’s trending, surely no one can guess the truth, who would think he’s not a super Rich Second Generation at all, his wealth is all thanks to the system.
But Lin Shanshan was thrilled; she always thought her brother was a bit too low-key, clearly super wealthy, yet working as a delivery guy, led to being mocked.
Just like those from the Su Family today, they all looked down on her brother, which really frustrated Lin Shanshan.
If everyone knew her brother was wealthy, then who would dare look down on him in the future!
"Brother, why don’t you stop being a delivery guy and just be a bona fide rich person." Lin Shanshan suggested.
Lin Fan said: "What counts as a bona fide rich person?"
Lin Shanshan said: "That’s easy, live in a big house, drive luxury cars, wear designer brands, play with stocks, start a company, frequent high-end places. Also, find a famous girlfriend, like a rich heiress, influencer, model, celeb, and change monthly if need be."
Lin Fan almost spat his drink: "You little girl, where did you learn these from? Do you approve of your brother changing girlfriends monthly?"
Lin Shanshan said: "I saw this famous Rich Second Generation online doing this, changing girlfriends frequently, called something, I forgot for a moment."
Lin Fan sighed, with a mature face: "Your brother is a vagabond in love, even though as handsome as I am, countless beauties are willing to burn for me, while I juggle among them, unable to deal fairly with each one, I’m exhausted, just wanting to find my destined one and end my wandering."
Lin Shanshan laughed to death: "Brother, you’re so dramatic, okay, my vagabond brother, when are you getting me a sister-in-law?"
Lin Fan said: "I have no idea either."
Lin Shanshan wore a serious face: "What do you think of Sister Jinjin, is there still a chance with you two?"
Lin Fan was stunned, he hadn’t even thought about that question.
Is there still a chance between him and Su Jinjin?
Back then, they were forcibly separated by the Su Family, Lin Fan lost all contact with Su Jinjin, he was heartbroken.
At that time, he was powerless to resist, it took him a long time to finally let go of Su Jinjin.
Seeing Su Jinjin again now doesn’t give him the same feeling as before.
Maybe this feeling had already been buried by him; whether it will resurface, he didn’t know.
They talked as they had returned near the apartment, Lin Fan parked the car, and the two walked back to the apartment.
Meanwhile, near the apartment where Lin Fan lived, a few henchmen were hiding in the darkness, waiting for Lin Fan.
They were henchmen hired by Li Jianxing to teach Lin Fan a lesson!
It took Li Jianxing some time to locate Lin Fan’s apartment, planning to beat Lin Fan up right at the apartment building.
Lin Fan and Lin Shanshan appeared!
A few henchmen rubbed their fists, ready to rush out to pin down and beat Lin Fan.
Just then, the leading henchman’s phone rang.
It was a call from Li Jianxing.
"Did you see Lin Fan?" Li Jianxing asked somewhat anxiously.
The leading henchman said: "He just returned, we are about to act, don’t worry about our job, we will definitely give this kid a good beating, will send photos to you later."
But Li Jianxing said: "No, do not touch him, retreat immediately!"
The leading henchman was a bit puzzled, but they could only follow orders when instructed by Li Jianxing to do so, therefore, they did not rush out but quietly retreated instead.
The Li Family.
Li Jianxing was drenched in cold sweat, holding a phone, watching a clip from a live video. It was a video that went viral today; he stumbled upon it unintentionally.
The super Rich Second Generation in it turned out to be Lin Fan!
Lin Fan is actually the owner of a Kosak, a super Rich Second Generation?
Li Jianxing was drenched in cold sweat, fortunate to have timely stopped the henchmen, otherwise the consequences would be unimaginable!
"Wait a minute!"
Li Jianxing suddenly became curious, what was the relationship between Lin Fan and the Lin gentleman in Yunding Manor?
Lin Fan returned to the apartment downstairs, sensing something strange, as if there was some movement nearby, like being watched, but after checking, nothing seemed amiss, so he opened the door and went upstairs.
It was late at night.
Returning to the apartment, Lin Fan was lying on the couch asleep.
Meanwhile, Zhang Dafu was woken up at home by a sudden phone call.
It was a call from an employee under Zhang Dafu: "Manager Zhang, something’s wrong, there’s trouble at the company!"
Hearing the employee’s account, Zhang Dafu was startled: "It’s already late at night, I’ll report it to the boss tomorrow."

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Company Crisis, Delayed New Reward!
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: Company Crisis, Delayed New Reward!
The next day, Lin Fan woke up, but the system was silent.
Lin Fan found it a bit strange. Was there no sign-in reward today?
He asked the system in his mind, but the system didn’t answer, remaining completely silent.
This system was truly incredible, as if it could handle any reward, but sometimes it seemed a bit indifferent and arrogant.
Lin Fan could only feel helpless about this. After waiting for a while and seeing that the system remained silent, Lin Fan got up.
A new day, Lin Fan planned to do some food deliveries today; after all, he had nothing else to do.
But just then, Lin Fan received a call from Zhang Dafu.
"Boss, there’s an issue at the company. Our goods have been returned. Can you come to the company?" Zhang Dafu said.
Lin Fan had handed the Blue Moon to him to manage. Now that there was a problem, he was unable to handle it and could only report to the boss, with a bit of unease in his voice.
Lin Fan frowned, "Alright, I’ll come over now."
Blue Moon was a local hand soap brand in Yun City, co-founded by Zhang Dafu and several classmates a few years ago. Later, Zhang Dafu’s classmates gradually withdrew their shares, making Zhang Dafu the sole owner until Blue Moon was acquired by Lin Fan.
The primary market for Blue Moon Hand Soap was in Yun City, but they also had sales in other regions. As a company with assets worth hundreds of millions, it had become a fairly well-known brand, and its products sold quite well.
But this time, there was a large-scale return of goods, and products were unsellable!
Blue Moon warehouse.
Accompanied by Zhang Dafu, Lin Fan arrived at the warehouse, which was filled with returned products!
Zhang Dafu said, "The returns are a minor issue. The biggest problem is that all our orders have been canceled, and our production line is forced to shut down. If this continues, the company will have to close down..."
Lin Fan asked, "Why is this happening?"
Lin Fan didn’t really care if Blue Moon would shut down. He bought Blue Moon out of pure indulgence with money, so it wouldn’t matter if it collapsed. However, as the owner of Blue Moon, he needed to understand the cause and couldn’t let the company fail without knowing why.
Zhang Dafu felt somewhat guilty, "Well..."
Lin Fan frowned, "Is it possible that there’s a quality issue with our products?"
If it were truly a quality issue, Zhang Dafu would be responsible, and Lin Fan wouldn’t let him get away easily.
Zhang Dafu quickly said, "No, boss, I specialize in making hand soap and prioritize quality. Our quality is absolutely fine; it’s just... someone else’s products are better than ours, and they have better marketing strategies."
Lin Fan made a noise of acknowledgment, "Are you referring to Red Sun Hand Soap?"
Lin Fan once worked at Blue Moon and knew the hand soap market quite well. When Zhang Dafu said that, Lin Fan immediately thought of the competitor, Red Sun Hand Soap.
Red Sun Hand Soap was founded by Zhang Dafu’s classmate Chen Jianfeng.
Chen Jianfeng, who co-founded Blue Moon with Zhang Dafu, had a falling out with him and left with other partners to establish Red Sun.
Unexpectedly, Red Sun defeated Blue Moon in just a year or two!
Zhang Dafu nodded, "Yes, it’s Red Sun. Over the past two years, they’ve gradually eaten away at our market, leaving us with almost no room to survive."
Lin Fan said, "Red Sun Hand Soap is indeed good. Their products have a unique fragrance that’s quite pleasant."
Zhang Dafu sweated and said, "Their product formula includes a spice, which was actually my idea. I once got drunk and mentioned it, and by the time I realized it, Chen Jianfeng had registered it as a patent. I had no evidence and could only let it be."
Lin Fan sneered, "So, Chen Jianfeng stole your formula!"
Zhang Dafu replied, "Uh... and there’s nothing I can do about it."
Lin Fan said, "I won’t let Chen Jianfeng get away with it. Since he stole your formula, no matter how much it costs, I’ll hire the best lawyer to seek justice for you!"
Zhang Dafu was deeply moved. The boss was so good, and most importantly, he had no shortage of money!
Zhang Dafu said, "Boss, tomorrow is the product conference. Unless we can come up with a product better than Red Sun, the situation tomorrow won’t be optimistic. Also, Chen Jianfeng will definitely be there to mock us."
Lin Fan asked, "Do you have a better formula than theirs?"
Zhang Dafu smiled bitterly, "No, product research is very costly. After Red Sun emerged, I was unconvinced and invested a lot of money in research, but to no avail, and now it’s too late."
Lin Fan frowned, realizing the difficult nature of this problem.
While he wasn’t short on money, technology is sometimes not something money can buy.
Of course, he could also spend money to crush Red Sun, but such an approach wouldn’t have an immediate effect and would be a waste of money, not worth it.
"Ding!"
Just then, the system prompt sounded!
Lin Fan thought there were no sign-in rewards today, but to his surprise, it came at this moment.
"System Alert: Today’s sign-in is available. Sign-in reward is a mysterious hand soap formula. Do you want to sign in?"
Lin Fan was stunned for a moment and inwardly shouted furiously, "Sign me in immediately!"
What a pleasant surprise.
Just when he needed it most, the system provided a formula.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for completing the sign-in. A mysterious hand soap formula has been stored in the host’s memory. Please retrieve it."
Indeed, a hand soap formula appeared in Lin Fan’s mind!
Being well-versed in hand soap, Lin Fan read through the formula,
and was overjoyed!
This hand soap formula was incredibly powerful!
Not only did this hand soap possess powerful cleansing capabilities, but it also had skincare properties, which were even stronger than those of expensive skincare brands!
If this hand soap were to be produced, Lin Fan believed it would definitely become a hit; it was simply the Coca-Cola of hand soaps!
With the formula in hand, I own the world!
At this time, Zhang Dafu continued with a sorrowful and guilty look, "It’s all my fault, I shouldn’t have trusted Chen Jianfeng and shared the formula with him. Now, I don’t know what to do. If Blue Moon collapses, I’ll have let the boss down..."
Lin Fan remained completely calm, with a plan already forming in his mind.
"I have a hand soap formula," Lin Fan said.
Zhang Dafu was stunned, "What, boss, you have a hand soap formula?"
Lin Fan said, "That’s right. This formula needs to be kept as secret as the Coca-Cola recipe. I’ll tell you half of it, and I’ll keep the other half myself."
With Zhang Dafu’s previous experience, secrecy was absolutely necessary.
Lin Fan then shared half of the formula with Zhang Dafu. This half pertained to the cleansing capabilities, while the other half, related to skincare, Lin Fan kept to himself.
Though it was only half of the formula, the knowledgeable Zhang Dafu was already extremely excited upon hearing it.
He dropped to his knees.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Special Reward, 3rd Shareholder of the Best Law Firm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48: Special Reward, 3rd Shareholder of the Best Law Firm!
This formula is simply marvelous!
Zhang Dafu never dreamed that there could be such a great hand sanitizer formula in the world.
He couldn’t understand how Lin Fan came to have this formula, and such a good one at that!
However, the boss is a super Rich Second Generation; maybe he spent a lot of money on some top expert to research it but just never revealed it until now.
Zhang Dafu figured he had it all worked out. Lin Fan is so rich, anything is possible.
Zhang Dafu babbled, "Boss, with this formula, Blue Moon is saved!"
At that moment, a call came in.
Zhang Dafu looked and said, "Boss, it’s Chen Jianfeng calling."
Lin Fan said, "Answer it!"
Zhang Dafu answered the call and turned on the speakerphone.
"Boss Zhang, how’s everything? You received your products, right? Let me tell you a secret, I was the one who asked the distributors to return them. Surprised? Expecting it?" Chen Jianfeng laughed heartily, full of smugness.
Zhang Dafu was furious, "Chen Jianfeng, you scoundrel, don’t be too smug. Without stealing my formula, could you have achieved today’s success?"
Chen Jianfeng replied, "You can randomly eat things, but you can’t randomly say things. I didn’t steal your formula; I came up with it myself."
Zhang Dafu wanted to curse; Chen Jianfeng was too shameless!
Chen Jianfeng laughed again, "Boss Zhang, your cheap products have no market. I advise you not to attend the product conference tomorrow to avoid embarrassment. Now that your products aren’t selling and I’ve taken all the orders, why not just pack up and close down?"
Zhang Dafu sneered, "Even if Red Sun goes bankrupt, my Blue Moon won’t!"
The formula Lin Fan had just given him was his biggest confidence.
Chen Jianfeng laughed maniacally, "This is what you call the Ah Q spirit! I heard you bought Blue Moon, yet you stayed as the general manager. Why? Quickly advise your boss to shut down; don’t bring disgrace upon yourself!"
Lin Fan calmly said, "I am the current boss of Blue Moon, Boss Chen. Blue Moon won’t shut down. See you tomorrow."
Chen Jianfeng was taken aback, "You all really don’t believe until you see the coffin..."
The phone was already hung up.
Chen Jianfeng spat, "Tch, ignorant fool, daring to fight against me, Chen Jianfeng. You’ll see tomorrow!"
After hanging up on Chen Jianfeng,
Lin Fan instructed, "Produce a batch of samples by the end of today. Attend the product conference tomorrow."
Zhang Dafu was very enthusiastic and immediately said, "Okay, I’ll arrange it right away!"
He had a premonition that this brand-new hand sanitizer product would cause a massive reaction tomorrow!
The rest of the day was uneventful. Lin Fan dismissed the idea of delivering takeout and focused his energy on the product’s production.
By the evening of that day,
a new hand sanitizer sample had already been produced and delivered in front of Lin Fan and Zhang Dafu.
After testing this new product, Zhang Dafu knelt again.
Kneeling in complete submission!
He had only heard half of the formula before and already found it unbelievable. Now that the end product was produced, it far exceeded his expectations.
This product is incredible!
Besides cleaning, it also protects the skin!
Zhang Dafu never dreamed that the other half of the formula was for skincare, with a skin-protecting function stronger than any skincare product!
Moreover, its cost is much lower than those skincare products.
For the price of a bottle of hand sanitizer, you get a hand-care function worth thousands...
"Boss, our product is going to skyrocket."
Zhang Dafu cried excitedly on the spot.
Only Lin Fan knew that this was the power of the system, which seemed omnipotent; it always aimed for the top. Even this hand sanitizer is the best in the world.
"Ding!"
At this moment, the system surprisingly issued another notification!
Two notifications in one day!
"Congratulations to the host, the new hand sanitizer has been successfully produced, and the main task, to create a trillion-dollar business empire, has progressed one step. Please continue your efforts."
"Main task: Create a trillion-dollar business empire."
"Completion: 2/100"
Lin Fan was stunned, realizing that today’s system reward was also related to the main task.
The system wants Lin Fan to start with a small bottle of hand sanitizer and build a trillion-dollar business empire!
And that’s not all!
"Ding!"
"In view of the host’s successful production of the new hand sanitizer, a special reward is granted. Please collect it."
What!
An unexpected reward!
What a pleasant surprise.
Lin Fan immediately said, "Collect!"
"Congratulations to the host, you have acquired 20% of the shares of Xingquan Law Firm, becoming the third-largest shareholder of Xingquan!"
Lin Fan almost shouted out loud.
Xingquan Law Firm!
This is a top-tier law firm in Huaxia!
It has a powerful legal team that is almost invincible, instilling fear in its peers in the legal industry!
This time’s special reward turned out to be Xingquan’s third-largest shareholder—this is just too powerful!
With this identity, if Lin Fan ever needs to fight a lawsuit, he can mobilize Xingquan’s powerful legal team.
Lin Fan becoming the third-largest shareholder of Xingquan shocked Xingquan’s top management.
At evening, just as it was time to get off work, Xingquan’s founder, the largest shareholder Jin Hesheng, was startled by the sudden news, jumping up in his office.
"What? 20% of Xingquan’s shares have been assigned to a stranger’s name, and I didn’t know about it?"
Jin Hesheng’s expression was like he had seen a ghost.
Be aware that it’s very difficult for outsiders to acquire shares in a law firm. Even if it’s possible to buy, it requires a complicated process. A change of 20% in shares, and yet this Big Boss didn’t know—it’s utterly baffling.
Jin Hesheng himself was a lawyer by profession, well-versed in the law, and even he couldn’t figure it out. It’s truly mysterious.
However, upon repeatedly verifying, Jin Hesheng found that this 20% share transfer was entirely by the book, with not a single flaw.
In other words, although he doesn’t know why, it’s completely legal!
This is the power of the system, so to speak, omnipotent!
"Lin Fan!"
Jin Hesheng remembered this name; the person he had never even met became Xingquan’s third-largest shareholder.
This mysterious Lin Fan, what kind of extraordinary ability does he possess to bypass him and acquire Xingquan’s shares?
Jin Hesheng was immediately filled with curiosity about Lin Fan’s identity.
Jin Hesheng immediately ordered, "Everyone, investigate, I want Lin Fan’s complete profile within three minutes!"
He quickly received Lin Fan’s data.
Name: Lin Fan.
Age: 21.
Occupation: Deliveryman
Phone: 137...
"Wait!"
Jin Hesheng was dumbfounded, "A deliveryman? Are you freaking telling me that the guy who took over 20% of Xingquan’s shares is a deliveryman? Are you kidding me!"
"And he’s only 21? At 21, I was still a junior at a lawyer’s firm. This person is terrifying! Could he be some kind of super Rich Second Generation?"
"No way, I have to visit him personally to see what kind of exceptional person he is!"

chapters.title: Chapter 49: This Super Rich Second Generation is Definitely Not Simple
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49: This Super Rich Second Generation is Definitely Not Simple
As Lin Fan left the Blue Moon Company, night had already fallen.
Today had been a busy and fulfilling day, and Lin Fan planned to return home to rest for the night, so he could attend the product conference in person tomorrow.
The new hand sanitizer was linked to the main task of the system, and he had to take it seriously.
Besides the mysterious hand sanitizer formula, today’s special system reward was also a big surprise for Lin Fan, becoming the third largest shareholder of Xingquan Law Firm!
This reward could be described as awesome.
Lin Fan checked online, and found that this law firm’s shares couldn’t be bought even with money, because they simply weren’t for sale!
Lin Fan didn’t know how the system managed to get this share, and it wasn’t just any small stake — it was 20%, making him the third-largest shareholder. It could only be said that the system was incredibly powerful.
On his way home, driving his Kosak, Lin Fan suddenly received a call from an unknown number.
"Is this Mr. Lin Fan? I’m calling from Xingquan Law Firm, this is Big Boss Jin Hesheng." the caller said.
Lin Fan made a surprised noise, the big boss of Xingquan himself calling? The law firm’s efficiency was impressive, contacting him so quickly.
"This is Lin Fan. Boss Jin, is there any problem with my shares?" Lin Fan smiled.
Jin Hesheng responded, "Well... hehe, there’s no problem with the shares. I’m calling to congratulate Mr. Lin on becoming the third shareholder of our firm. By the way, I’d like to arrange a visit with Mr. Lin. Would that be convenient?"
Lin Fan replied, "No problem, I’ll be attending the Yun City daily necessities product conference tomorrow morning. Boss Jin, you can find me there."
Jin Hesheng seems to want to probe the situation by arranging a meeting. Coincidentally, Lin Fan also wanted to meet Jin Hesheng. He needed to build a trillion-dollar group, and he would definitely need legal assistance in the future. Xingquan would become his strong legal support.
Meanwhile, after hanging up, Jin Hesheng was a bit puzzled. Wasn’t Lin Fan a delivery man? How was he going to some daily necessities product conference?
At that moment, Jin Hesheng’s subordinates were still sending him the latest investigation findings on Lin Fan.
"Upon investigation, Lin Fan recently spent 100 million in cash to purchase the local hand sanitizer brand, Blue Moon Company. He is currently the owner of Blue Moon!"
"Under Lin Fan’s name, there’s a top luxury car Kosak worth 70 million."
"A few days ago, Lin Fan acquired 30% of Golden Capital Group stocks, making him the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital."
"Apart from the above, no other assets have been discovered for Lin Fan yet; the investigation continues..."
Jin Hesheng was dumbfounded: "What? This guy is a legit super rich dude!"
It turns out being a delivery man was just a pastime for Lin Fan. This rich second-generation’s hobby is quite peculiar, indeed.
What Jin Hesheng knew was only Lin Fan’s public assets. If he discovered Lin Fan’s undisclosed assets, like the 3 billion Yunding Manor, 6 billion Chiba Island, 100 billion in cash... Jin Hesheng would probably be stunned beyond belief.
But just these public assets were enough to shock Jin Hesheng, who immediately felt great respect for Lin Fan.
This super rich second-generation Lin Fan was certainly not simple!
To have taken away 20% of Xingquan’s shares without his knowledge, what Lin Fan possessed might not just be money, but perhaps also immense ability!
Such a person, Jin Hesheng dared not to neglect. Building a good relationship with Lin Fan was the primary task.
Lin Fan wasn’t aware of the drama in Jin Hesheng’s mind. After hanging up, he continued driving home.
Lin Fan parked his car nearby his apartment and walked back home.
As soon as he got downstairs, he saw his landlord, Aunt Li, sitting on a small stool, using a small fan to cool herself at the entrance.
Seeing Lin Fan return, Aunt Li immediately stood up and greeted with enthusiasm: "Little Fan, you’re finally back. I just went to your place looking for you, and your sister said you went out for deliveries and haven’t come back, so I waited here."
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled: "Aunt Li, is something the matter? Did I forget to pay the rent?"
Aunt Li laughed, "No, it’s like this. Recently, I’ve found you another good girl and wanted to introduce her to you."
Lin Fan, slightly sweating, appreciated Aunt Li’s kindness. Knowing that he was single, she was always eager to introduce potential matches to him. Though Lin Fan was grateful, none of the introductions had been successful yet.
Among these matches, some were reliable, some not, and most were just not reliable.
For instance, Zhao Xin’er, whom Aunt Li introduced to Lin Fan.
Initially, Zhao Xin’er seemed normal, and Lin Fan thought she was reliable; he boldly confessed to her, only to find out she was a gold digger with numerous backup suitors. She only liked wealthy men and looked down on Lin Fan, who was delivering food. She acted normal at first only because she wanted to keep Lin Fan as a backup.
When Lin Fan confessed to her, she exposed her true character.
"Aunt Li, thank you, but I’m a bit busy lately and may not have the time...," Lin Fan tried to refuse Aunt Li gently.
Aunt Li chuckled, "Little Fan, I understand your feelings. Repeated failed matchmaking hits you hard, right? It’s normal; you can’t find true love without enduring a thousand trials and tests. If this one doesn’t work, move on to the next one. It might be the right one. Auntie has rich experience; you can trust me."
Lin Fan: "..."
Aunt Li made so much sense that Lin Fan was left speechless.
Aunt Li went on, "Let me tell you, this girl I’m introducing this time is excellent. Ma Rongrong, in her early twenties, fair-skinned and beautiful, tall, and from a good family background; both parents are teachers..."
Lin Fan felt a bit of a headache coming on, but since Aunt Li meant well, he couldn’t refuse so directly.
Suddenly, Lin Fan thought of Chen Lingling, and a joyful thought came to him, "Aunt Li, actually I already have a girlfriend."
Chen Lingling had asked him to pretend to be her boyfriend that day, so now he was using her as a temporary excuse.
Unexpectedly, upon hearing this, Aunt Li burst into laughter: "Little Fan, you’re so funny, where did you get a girlfriend? You don’t even have an inflatable one."
Lin Fan: "???"
Auntie, you know too much.
Aunt Li continued, "Auntie told you, you shouldn’t be afraid of failure; you have to face it head-on, you know? Auntie has to hurry off to play mahjong, so I won’t say more. I’ve already arranged for you to meet at Starbucks at 12 noon tomorrow. Just go on time, meet the girl, and you won’t lose anything. Here’s her phone number."
Without giving Lin Fan a chance to refuse, Aunt Li handed him a piece of paper and hurried off to the village mahjong parlor.
Holding the paper with Ma Rongrong’s phone number written on it, Lin Fan gave a wry smile. Aunt Li was so enthusiastic, leaving him a bit helpless.
Lin Fan saved Ma Rongrong’s number in his phone. Just as he was about to head upstairs, a call came in.
It was Chen Lingling calling!
Lin Fan answered, "Lingling, what’s up?"
Chen Lingling’s voice was a bit shy, "Brother, can you go shopping with me tomorrow? I want to buy a new computer, but I’m not very knowledgeable..."
Lingling was a really nice girl, being around her felt comfortable. Since she took the initiative to invite him, Lin Fan couldn’t refuse.
Lin Fan responded readily, "No problem, though I’m busy in the morning. Is the afternoon okay?"
Chen Lingling was very happy. She missed Lin Fan a lot and had a hard time finding an excuse to ask him out, worried he might be unavailable.
"Alright, I’ll be working part-time at Starbucks in the afternoon. I’ll wait for you," Chen Lingling smiled.
Starbucks again?
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. Wasn’t that the place to meet Ma Rongrong tomorrow! If they ran into each other, it would be awkward.
Seeing Lin Fan remain silent, Chen Lingling curiously asked, "Brother, is there a problem?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "No problem at all. I’ll pick you up at Starbucks then."
Lin Fan planned it out: He’d just casually deal with Ma Rongrong tomorrow. He really wasn’t interested in blind dates; Aunt Li meant well, but he couldn’t refuse.
Lin Fan returned to the apartment, seeing that Shanshan had already gone to bed.
He quickly took a shower and lay on the sofa to sleep.
He slept until dawn.
Lin Fan got up, ready to head out for the daily necessities product conference.
"Ding!"
The system prompt sounded.
"Today’s check-in has started. Check-in now to receive 100% equity in an animation company. Does the host wish to sign in immediately?"

chapters.title: Chapter 50 Crafty Bestie: Don’t Contact Lin Fan!
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50 Crafty Bestie: Don’t Contact Lin Fan!
100% ownership of an animation company!
This reward is really generous, it’s like giving away a whole company!
100% ownership means that Lin Fan is the absolute and sole Big Boss, just like Blue Moon Company, fully owned by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan thought to himself, "Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, sign-in successful, the reward of 100% ownership of Tourist Animation Company has been delivered, please check!"
Tourist Animation Company!
Lin Fan checked online, this animation company is currently ranked among the top three domestic animation companies, mainly dealing with anime and manga, with the mission of leading the rise of national comics!
The system’s rewards have never disappointed Lin Fan, and the strength of Tourist is quite good. After understanding, Lin Fan was very satisfied.
However, Lin Fan didn’t have time to pay attention to this reward for now, he still had to hurry to the daily chemical products conference.
So Lin Fan got up, washed himself, changed clothes, and went out.
As soon as he reached downstairs, he ran into Landlady Aunt Li.
Aunt Li grabbed Lin Fan, "Little Fan, last night I gave you Ma Rongrong’s contact information, and you didn’t add her on WeChat? I just talked to Rongrong’s mom on the phone, and she’s doubting our sincerity."
Lin Fan, "Auntie, you didn’t say I should add her on WeChat!"
Aunt Li, sweating, said, "You kid, no wonder you’ve been single, guys need to be a bit more proactive, hurry up and add her, you two should communicate a bit before meeting."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll add her later."
Aunt Li sized Lin Fan up, "Little Fan, you haven’t been delivering food these past two days, have you?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Yeah, I’ve been busy with other things these days, there’s a billion-dollar project I need to handle."
Indeed, the billion he spent buying Blue Moon was a billion-dollar project.
Aunt Li thought he was joking and laughed, "Little Fan, you’re really humorous, but don’t blame Auntie for nagging, it’s best for you to buy some expensive clothes, it can increase your chances of success in dating, this street market stuff won’t cut it."
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, I got it."
Quickly slipped away.
Given his current financial strength, which brand can’t he afford? It’s just that he never really cared much about dressing up, whether it’s street market goods for a few dozen bucks or branded goods worth tens of thousands, they don’t feel much different on him.
Getting into the Kosak, Lin Fan casually opened WeChat, added Ma Rongrong as a friend, put the phone aside, and started driving.
Meanwhile, in a gym.
A young woman with fair skin and beautiful looks scoring an 80, dressed in workout attire, jogged on a treadmill, while swiping her phone.
Suddenly, she received a notification for a WeChat friend request, opened it, and saw the note, "I’m Lin Fan."
The young woman frowned slightly and muttered, "How annoying, here comes another one, the fifth one this month."
"Rongrong, the fifth what?"
On the neighboring treadmill, another beautiful woman curiously asked, she was Sun Xiaona! A college classmate of Chen Lingling.
Sun Xiaona and Ma Rongrong had been good friends for years, and today they arranged to work out together.
Ma Rongrong grumbled, "What else, a blind date candidate. These days my mom’s been frantically setting me up with guys, and I haven’t liked a single one. Little Na, you’re better off, you have a boyfriend, no worries."
Sun Xiaona replied softly, "Actually, I haven’t told you, I broke up with Zhao Jiahao."
Ma Rongrong was surprised, "Why?"
Sun Xiaona said, "No reason, just not a good fit, men are like shoes, if they don’t fit, you should change them."
Sun Xiaona had already found someone ten times better than Zhao Jiahao, Lin Fan, her next goal was Lin Fan.
Ma Rongrong agreed wholeheartedly, "Little Na, you’re right, nowadays finding a suitable man is just too hard. Obviously, my requirements aren’t high, I just want someone handsome, young, rich, who spoils me and is willing to spend money on me, that’s all, why is it so hard!"
Sun Xiaona comforted her, "Rongrong, don’t lose heart, maybe this one’s the one."
Ma Rongrong sighed, "Forget about this one, my mom said he’s a delivery guy, how worried is she that I might not find a boyfriend, to the extent that she won’t even spare a delivery guy."
Sun Xiaona uttered, "Oh, a delivery guy?"
Lin Fan was also a delivery guy. She had suffered for looking down on delivery guys, being a delivery guy didn’t mean anything, someone like Lin Fan, who wouldn’t want to marry him!
Ma Rongrong continued to complain, "My mom said he’s quite young and handsome, fitting my appearance requirement, but as soon as you hear ’delivery guy,’ you know he’s poor. Handsomeness can’t feed you, if he were rich, being a bit ugly wouldn’t matter."
Sun Xiaona thought to herself, "Meow meow meow, a young and handsome delivery guy? How does that sound so much like Lin Fan?"
Sun Xiaona said, "Rongrong, what’s this delivery guy’s name, let me help you have a look."
Ma Rongrong showed her phone to Sun Xiaona, "His name is Lin Fan, he just added me on WeChat, do you think I should accept his friend request?"
Sun Xiaona froze.
Damn!
Rongrong’s blind date candidate is really Lin Fan!
This world is so small, if Rongrong knew Lin Fan had money, it would be over, she’s making a play for Lin Fan herself, can’t let Rongrong become a competitor.
Sun Xiaona’s eyes turned, "Of course not, just ignore him, you said yourself, looking at him you can tell he’s poor, there’s no need to waste time on someone like that."
Ma Rongrong nodded, "Little Na, you’re right, but I’m having a hard time explaining to my mom."
Sun Xiaona laughed, "Isn’t that easy? Just turn around and say you’ve met him and didn’t think you were a good match, simple. Rongrong, this time you have to listen to me, don’t contact Lin Fan, there’s no need to waste a second on someone who’s not worth it, someday I’ll introduce you to a Rich Second Generation."
Ma Rongrong laughed, "Hmm, I’ll listen to you, Little Na, you’re really my good friend, you’re so good to me."
But little did Ma Rongrong know, her good friend was a scheming bitch.
The scheming bitch shamelessly laughed, "Of course, we’re good friends, can I harm you? It’s all for your own good!"
Ma Rongrong decided to forget about Lin Fan and continued scrolling her phone, opened a video, where a man was seen from the back singing "Fireworks Easily Cold."
"The sound of prosperity slips into the empty door, ruining the world..."
The singing was amazingly good!
Ma Rongrong showed a captivated expression, "I’ve watched this video hundreds of times, the singing is too good, I’d really like to know who the singer is, no matter who he is, he’s my number one male idol now!"
This video had been exploding in popularity these past few days, reportedly from a music academy exam scene, the man in the video stunned the audience with his voice, someone stealthily recorded this clip.
Sun Xiaona had a jolt, thinking, "Meow meow meow, this voice sounds so familiar!"
"Holy crap, isn’t this Lin Fan!"
If Rongrong found out Lin Fan was her number one male idol, that would be trouble!
Ma Rongrong continued to immerse herself, "If he were my boyfriend, that would be wonderful, pampering me every day, singing by my bedside, just the thought makes me so happy!"
Sun Xiaona said, "Rongrong, I have to leave now, remember not to waste even a second on this delivery guy, okay?"
Ma Rongrong said, "Hmm, got it, bye-bye."
Sun Xiaona hurriedly left, while Ma Rongrong continued to be enchanted by Lin Fan’s voice...
Lin Fan drove for an hour, arriving at the Yun City Convention and Exhibition Center, where today’s daily chemical products conference was being held.
Lin Fan parked his car, picked up his phone, and saw the WeChat notification, Ma Rongrong had already accepted his friend request.
Lin Fan initially planned to chat with Ma Rongrong on the way, but since she delayed, he didn’t have time to deal with her anymore.
Originally, Ma Rongrong, following Sun Xiaona’s advice, didn’t want to bother with Lin Fan, but later received a call from her mom urging her, so she reluctantly added Lin Fan.
Ma Rongrong was waiting for Lin Fan to speak first, but after waiting a long time, Lin Fan showed no response.
Ma Rongrong’s impression of Lin Fan plummeted, "This guy, does he expect me to contact him first? He’s definitely not someone I’d be interested in!"

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Don’t Be Too Excessive in Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: Don’t Be Too Excessive in Life
The daily chemical product conference took up the entire first floor of the Yun City Convention and Exhibition Center, with thousands of merchants showcasing their products here. At a glance, various daily chemical products were dazzling.
The place was bustling with merchants and customers alike.
Brands attended the exhibition mainly to promote their company’s products and recruit distributors on-site, while guests came to find their desired products. Through the exhibition, they could learn about the latest industry trends.
Blue Moon Company’s booth was buried among countless brands, not standing out at all.
Early in the morning, Zhang Dafu and a group of employees were busy setting up the booth. Except for Zhang Dafu, the employees seemed a bit listless.
Everyone was aware of Blue Moon’s massive product return incident yesterday!
Rumors spread internally within the company, and employees speculated that at this rate, Blue Moon might go bankrupt!
Even if their boss Lin Fan was a billionaire, he probably couldn’t save Blue Moon.
Although they heard the company was researching new products, the employees felt it was just a last-minute effort. Developing new products wasn’t easy. The company would most likely collapse before the new products were ready.
However, the biggest blow came from Red Sun Company.
Red Sun’s booth was set up right opposite Blue Moon’s!
It was intentionally done by Red Sun’s boss Chen Jianfeng to strike at Blue Moon.
Red Sun was now affluent, with a booth larger than Blue Moon’s, and they started decorating three days in advance. It was grandly decorated, with elegantly packaged products displayed on the shelves and employees in uniform—which looked classy and high-end.
By comparison, Blue Moon’s booth seemed a bit shabby.
Lin Fan left Blue Moon entirely in Zhang Dafu’s hands, and because Zhang Dafu didn’t have high expectations for the exhibition, he didn’t put in much effort.
A short, plump, middle-aged man in a suit, looking like a successful person, stood in front of Red Sun’s booth, mockingly looking at Blue Moon’s booth opposite.
He was none other than Red Sun’s boss, Chen Jianfeng.
"President Zhang, why are you setting up your booth so late? Is it because you couldn’t afford the decoration fees? Why not come to me for a loan?" Chen Jianfeng laughed.
