Upon hearing this, Red Sun’s employees all laughed indiscriminately.
Blue Moon’s employees all lowered their heads, having no confidence to retort, feeling utterly embarrassed.
Zhang Dafu coldly replied, "Chen Jianfeng, you don’t need to flaunt here. No matter how well you decorate your booth, what’s most important is the product!"
Chen Jianfeng laughed heartily, "Product? President Zhang is just being stubborn. Didn’t Blue Moon just have products returned? Do you even have the right to talk about products?"
Red Sun’s employees laughed even more wantonly.
Blue Moon’s employees held their heads in their hands, thinking that talking about products was self-humiliating!
Zhang Dafu said, "I admit our previous products were indeed not as good as yours, Red Sun, but Chen Jianfeng, you know best how your products came about!"
Chen Jianfeng chuckled, "Are you going to accuse me of stealing your formula again? Do you have evidence? If you do, sue me!"
Zhang Dafu was frustrated because Chen Jianfeng was arrogantly claiming he had no evidence.
"Don’t worry, we’ll sue you,"
A voice came from the side, and a handsome young man walked over.
So handsome!
The female employees had starry eyes, and even the men were impressed.
Lin Fan had arrived!
"Boss!" Zhang Dafu said happily. He couldn’t handle Chen Jianfeng, but he believed Lin Fan could!
Chen Jianfeng assessed Lin Fan, surprised. Could this young man be Blue Moon’s new boss?
A young guy, still wet behind the ears, wearing a set of street market clothes.
Chen Jianfeng immediately looked down on Lin Fan, thinking how could this kid be a match for an old fox like him.
"So you are Blue Moon’s new boss. No wonder you spent 100 million buying Blue Moon! Seeing how young you are, you probably got tricked by Zhang Dafu, right? If this money was invested in my Red Sun, I guarantee you’d earn a fortune. Even tossing it into the sea would be better than buying Blue Moon!" Chen Jianfeng laughed.
Lin Fan smiled, "My name is Lin Fan, Boss Chen. It’s better not to be too excessive as it’s easy to get a taste of your own medicine."
Chen Jianfeng laughed loudly, "Get a taste of my own medicine? Does Blue Moon qualify to face me?"
Lin Fan ignored Chen Jianfeng and turned to Zhang Dafu, "Da Fu, did we bring our new products? The show is about to start, let’s get them out."
Zhang Dafu smiled, "Yes, boss, the new products are here. I personally took care of them."
Zhang Dafu took out a safe with a combination lock and brought out three bottles of new hand soap samples, placing them in the most prominent position at the booth.
The hand soap only had simple packaging for now, looking nothing special.
Chen Jianfeng glanced and dismissively said, "New hand soap? Just playing tricks, can it be better than my Red Sun products!"
The exhibition had started, and guests began coming in one after another.
Most guests were attracted by Red Sun’s decoration, and along with Chen Jianfeng having employees promote loudly, guests flocked to Red Sun’s booth.
Chen Jianfeng was overjoyed, busy entertaining guests.
Meanwhile, Blue Moon’s booth was deserted, with only a few guests. Although Zhang Dafu had people promoting, guests shook their heads and walked away after seeing the new hand soap’s packaging.
"Blue Moon? I heard from a friend that they just returned a batch of their stuff yesterday and switched to Red Sun!"
"It must be poor product quality!"
"Anyway, it probably doesn’t sell as well as Red Sun! If it did, who would return it?"
"I heard Red Sun is doing pretty well. If the product experience is good, I might consider ordering some."
Guests discussed among themselves.
Hearing these remarks, other guests avoided Blue Moon even more and went to Red Sun instead.
All of Blue Moon’s employees felt dejected, especially seeing Red Sun bustling with activity, they felt even more downcast.
At this moment, a trendy female live-streaming influencer came to the venue, streaming as she walked.
"Today I’m invited to the exhibition to have a look around and show everyone what’s good and new. It’s quite lively up ahead, what’s this? Red Sun hand soap? Seems pretty hot. Opposite, Blue Moon hand soap looks so deserted. The contrast is clear, let’s interview Blue Moon. I like asking bosses awkward questions."
With that, the influencer, Sister Daihuo, walked over to Blue Moon’s booth.
"Hello everyone, I’m the streaming host Weiwei. May I ask, who is the boss here?" Sister Daihuo asked.
Lin Fan replied, "That’s me."
Sister Daihuo exclaimed dramatically, "Such a handsome and young boss!"
This host had a decent follower count, and the comment section of the live stream became lively immediately.
"Really handsome!"
"If I were there, I’d go to this stall just to see the handsome guy!"
"Yeah, why is there no one? Is it because of bad products?"
Sister Daihuo laughed, "Handsome guy, your store is quite deserted. Why is it that both are hand soaps, yet the one opposite is so popular?"

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Live Streaming Sales, New Product Goes Viral!
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: Live Streaming Sales, New Product Goes Viral!
Comments were filled with laughter.
"666, that’s what Sister Weiwei does best. She really put Boss in an awkward spot with that question!"
"Boss must be wanting to die now!"
"Handsome guy: It’s too hard for me."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Our new hand soap is definitely the best on the market right now. It’s just that we’re not as flashy as the others, and customers aren’t familiar with our product yet."
Sister Daihuo responded with an "Oh": "Handsome guy, the netizens are saying you’re trying to save face, right?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s not about saving face. If you don’t believe me, feel free to compare the products from both companies."
Sister Daihuo got excited: "I love comparisons! Everyone, make way, it’s time for Sister Weiwei’s drama show!"
Sister Daihuo walked to the aisle, took out a ballpoint pen, drew a few lines on her hand, and exclaimed, "Ah, what do I do, my hand accidentally got drawn on by a ballpoint pen, it’s one of the hardest things to wash off!"
Sister Daihuo’s cry for help drew everyone’s attention.
Including Chen Jianfeng.
Chen Jianfeng’s eyes lit up; is this sister live streaming?
Sister Daihuo approached Chen Jianfeng: "I’m a sales live streamer, I’m broadcasting live now, are you the boss here?"
Chen Jianfeng straightened his back and cleared his throat: "Ahem, yes, I’m the boss of Red Sun hand soap, Chen Jianfeng."
Sister Daihuo looked pitiful: "Boss Chen, my hand is dirty. Can I borrow your hand soap?"
Chen Jianfeng laughed: "Of course you can!"
This sister is live streaming, which is a great opportunity to promote the product. He wouldn’t let it pass. He was confident in his product.
So Chen Jianfeng called for the main product to let Sister Daihuo use it.
The guests quickly gathered to watch too; they wanted to see the product’s quality.
Sister Daihuo used Red Sun hand soap to wash her hands.
"Hmm, this hand soap smells nice, very pleasant to the nose, but it doesn’t clean well!"
Sister Daihuo said, and sure enough, there were still pen marks on the back of her hand!
This was a bit awkward.
Chen Jianfeng chuckled: "Ballpoint pen marks are indeed hard to wash off. Washing it once more should do, with a bit more force. You might not have used enough force."
Sister Daihuo asked, "The handsome boss from Blue Moon said their product is better than yours, is it true?"
Chen Jianfeng immediately showed disdain: "Blue Moon? Don’t listen to his bragging. I guarantee their product is way worse than ours! They’ve been having mass returns lately!"
Red Sun’s employees laughed.
Customers nodded along, indeed, Blue Moon was much worse than Red Sun.
Sister Daihuo said, "We’ll see which is better after trying. I’m going to try their product now. To be fair, I’ll redraw on my hand."
In front of everyone, she took out the pen again, drew a few lines on the back of her hand, and returned to Blue Moon’s side.
Zhang Dafu was already waiting with the new hand soap.
All eyes were on Blue Moon’s side at that moment, attracting many passersby to gather around, crowding the surrounding passage completely.
Everyone’s curiosity was piqued; which hand soap was better, Red Sun or Blue Moon?
Sister Daihuo squeezed some of the new hand soap and gently rinsed it with water.
Miraculously, just a gentle rinse with water, the newly drawn pen marks on Sister Daihuo’s hand, along with the residue from Red Sun, vanished instantly!
Sister Daihuo’s hand was as clean as a newborn baby.
The whole place fell silent.
If they hadn’t witnessed it, they wouldn’t have believed it, but it happened right before their eyes!
Chen Jianfeng’s expression changed.
Sister Daihuo burst out with exaggerated admiration: "Wow, this hand soap is amazing, it cleans so well, and my skin feels so smooth and soft. It’s like I’ve suddenly become younger, so magical!"
The live chat exploded with comments.
"No way, I wouldn’t believe it if I hadn’t seen it myself, so awesome!"
"Sister Weiwei, this is the most amazing product you’ve showcased ever."
"So the handsome boss wasn’t lying after all!"
"Oh my god, where can I buy this? I need to use it too!"
"I want to buy it too!"
"Link, please, I’m buying a crate!"
Besides the netizens, the guests were also instantly interested in the hand soap and rushed over to check it out. At once, everyone at Red Sun’s booth flocked to Blue Moon’s side.
Chen Jianfeng couldn’t stop them.
Chen Jianfeng was furious and shocked at the same time; was Blue Moon’s product really that good?
Zhang Dafu seized the chance to boast: "Dear friends, this is our new Blue Moon hand soap, not yet officially on the market. Feel free to order! Besides its powerful cleaning capabilities, it is gentle on the hands and even has skincare benefits. Regular use of this hand soap is ten times more effective than skincare products costing thousands!"
Everyone: "???"
Bragging, huh, ten times better than skincare products?
No need to buy skincare products then!
Sister Daihuo nodded: "I can confirm. He’s not boasting. I’m a sales live streamer, and out of the countless skincare products I’ve tried, none gave me as good an experience as this hand soap. If anyone here doesn’t believe it, they can try it themselves."
Popular sales live streamer Sister Weiwei tested it herself!
The guests became very intrigued and expressed their desire to see for themselves.
Zhang Dafu smiled: "No problem, everyone can queue to test it, there’s enough for everyone!"
So, the guests rushed to queue up to try it.
Those who used it couldn’t stop exclaiming!
You never know until you try it; this hand soap is indeed incredible. After using it, hands felt rejuvenated, such a comfortable feel!
The guests were all local dealers, and instinct told them this product would explode in popularity!
"I’ve decided, I’m ordering ten thousand bottles!" a guest declared first.
Soon, other guests followed suit.
"Give me thirty thousand bottles!"
"I want a hundred thousand bottles!"
"..."
Orders piled up like snowflakes landing at Blue Moon.
Blue Moon’s employees had been feeling down but now were completely stunned; the happiness came too suddenly!
Zhang Dafu laughed without being able to close his mouth, turning around: "Why are you all still standing there? Hurry up and serve the customers, process those orders!"
Blue Moon’s employees snapped out of it, each one overwhelmed with joy, and promptly attended to the customers, busy and bustling.
Red Sun’s people were all dumbstruck, each one stunned into silence, unable to laugh anymore.
Chen Jianfeng was anxious, rushing over to try and win back the customers.
Chen Jianfeng: "Boss Li, didn’t you say you wanted to sign an order with our Red Sun?"
Boss Li: "Sorry, the order is canceled. I’ve decided to cooperate with Blue Moon instead."
Chen Jianfeng: "Miss Wang, you already signed a preliminary agreement with us, you can only cooperate with me!"
Miss Wang: "Sorry, I’m breaching the contract. I’d rather pay you the breach compensation, but I must cooperate with Blue Moon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Xingquan Big Boss Personally Delivers Lawyer’s Letter
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: Xingquan Big Boss Personally Delivers Lawyer’s Letter
The guests decisively gave up on Red Sun one by one.
Zhang Dafu: "I’m sorry, this is Blue Moon’s booth. You are not welcome here, please get lost!"
Chen Jianfeng almost cried.
What’s going on here? How did Blue Moon suddenly come up with such an amazing product? How did everything change overnight?
At this moment, Lin Fan smiled slightly, took out his phone, and pressed a few buttons.
Ding dong!
Sister Daihuo’s phone chimed with a notification.
Sister Daihuo took a look.
One million, transfer successful!
Sister Daihuo looked at Lin Fan, flashed a bright smile, and then replied: "Thank you, handsome guy, happy cooperation!"
Turns out, Sister Daihuo was actually a plant arranged by Lin Fan!
To be precise, Lin Fan instructed Zhang Dafu to find her last night. She came specifically to stir things up today, all to create buzz for the new hand soap!
This was Lin Fan’s plan to promote the new hand soap!
A reward of a million after the event was accomplished!
Now that the goal was achieved, Lin Fan happily transferred the money to Sister Daihuo.
Sister Daihuo was also satisfied and once again praised the new hand soap in the live broadcast room.
The comments in the live broadcast room were in a frenzy, with a flood of newcomers rushing in, all eager to purchase the new hand soap immediately.
Sister Daihuo reassured: "Don’t worry everyone, the boss said this hand soap hasn’t officially launched yet. Sister Weiwei will be keeping an eye out and will share the purchase link as soon as it’s available!"
Meanwhile, a brand-new Audi A8 arrived outside the exhibition, from which three men in suits with top-grade leather briefcases disembarked, clearly looking like elite professionals.
Leading them was the middle-aged Big Boss of Xingquan Law Firm, Jin Hesheng!
The other two were Jin Hesheng’s most important partners, who were also top lawyers.
As per last night’s agreement, Jin Hesheng personally brought his two partners today to meet Lin Fan!
The three entered the exhibition and began looking for Blue Moon’s booth.
Inside the exhibition were countless booths and products, dazzling visitors and making it temporarily hard to find Blue Moon’s booth.
After wandering for a while, Jin Hesheng pulled a passerby aside and asked, "Excuse me, do you know where the Blue Moon booth is?"
The passerby said, "Blue Moon? Of course, it’s that one over there, the busiest one!"
Following the direction indicated, Jin Hesheng indeed saw a booth crowded to the brim.
Jin Hesheng was stunned, amazed at how popular Lin Fan’s product was.
The three of them finally managed to squeeze in, their expensive suits now wrinkled from the effort.
Jin Hesheng saw Lin Fan sitting to the side. Having seen Lin Fan’s photos before, he recognized him immediately.
"Mr. Lin, hello, I’m Jin Hesheng, and these are my partners Luo Jun and Zhan Yu," Jin Hesheng introduced himself proactively.
Lin Fan stood up and shook hands with each of the three, smiling and saying, "Nice to meet you."
Jin Hesheng marveled secretly, impressed by this young man’s handsomeness and his composure beyond his years—truly no ordinary person.
There was a reason he could obtain 20% of Xingquan’s shares.
Jin Hesheng smiled, "Mr. Lin, it seems your company’s product is very popular."
Lin Fan replied, "Today we launched a new product, hoping the guests would like it. My apologies for having to receive you here; let me host you at my home another time."
Little did Jin Hesheng know, when Lin Fan mentioned home, he meant Yunding Manor. He said, "Mr. Lin, you’re too kind. Just meeting you is enough for us. Congratulations on becoming Xingquan’s third shareholder, and I hope we have a pleasant cooperation in the future."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course, I’m also very fortunate to be a partner with everyone."
Jin Hesheng took out two documents, saying, "These are the equity certificate for Mr. Lin at Xingquan and a cooperation agreement. If Mr. Lin has no issues, just signing them will do."
Lin Fan picked up the documents, browsed through them, and finding no issues, he signed his name.
Jin Hesheng smiled, saying, "According to the cooperation agreement, Mr. Lin has speaking rights equivalent to his shares in Xingquan. If Mr. Lin needs anything in the future, feel free to contact me anytime."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "At the moment, I do have a request..."
A few minutes later, the Big Boss and star lawyer of Xingquan Law Firm, Jin Hesheng, personally headed towards the Red Sun booth with a lawsuit in hand.
Zhang Dafu was busy greeting customers, then took a moment and curiously asked, "Boss, who are they?"
Lin Fan said, "Xingquan Law Firm. Leading them is Big Boss Jin Hesheng. I’m having them sue Chen Jianfeng for stealing your formula, to seek justice!"
Zhang Dafu was shocked, "Whoa, the legendary Jin Hesheng! Star lawyer, I’ve heard he hasn’t personally taken a case in years, even high-ranking officials can’t get him to take a case, but the boss managed to invite him!"
The boss is too impressive; it takes immense clout to get Jin Hesheng here!
Lin Fan said calmly, "It’s no big deal because I’m Xingquan’s third-largest shareholder."
What?
Zhang Dafu was petrified.
The boss is actually Xingquan’s third-largest shareholder?
Oh my!
The boss is astonishingly powerful!
He was already filled with admiration for Lin Fan, now he kneeled once more.
Meanwhile, Chen Jianfeng across the way also knelt down.
The Big Boss of Xingquan Law Firm personally came with a lawyer’s letter!
Even though he was sure Zhang Dafu had no evidence, facing the formidable Xingquan Lawyers, his legs turned weak with fear.
This time he really cried. Today was truly unlucky for him, first his product suffered a complete defeat, and now he’s under Xingquan Lawyers’ scrutiny!
He hadn’t realized yet that this was merely the beginning of Red Sun Company’s collapse.
Simultaneously, it was also the beginning of Blue Moon’s rise.
This day was destined to be remembered in history.
The exhibition concluded with Blue Moon garnering a thick stack of orders.
In stark contrast, Red Sun across the way almost gained nothing!
With a reversal from how the exhibition started, Red Sun’s employees left in defeat like downtrodden roosters, while their luxurious booth stood as a glaring irony.
Blue Moon’s employees, on the other hand, walked out with heads held high and pride brimming!
This time, they all experienced their boss Lin Fan’s strength.
Lin Fan gathered all the employees and said, "Dafu, report today’s results."
Zhang Dafu said excitedly, "Today we received 310 orders in total, the largest was for 500,000 bottles, and the smallest was for 10,000 bottles, with a total order amount of 450 million Huaxia Coins, to be delivered within a month."
million!
The employees were all stunned and extremely excited; this was incredible, Blue Moon was experiencing a historic boom!
Lin Fan asked, "Can our current factory handle it?"
Zhang Dafu replied, "This... a bit challenging. We’re just considered a small factory, never had orders this large..."
Lin Fan said, "Then build more factories, money is not an issue."
Wealthy!
The employees knelt down, the boss was extravagantly wealthy, speaking of building factories as if it were child’s play.
Zhang Dafu trembled, the boss had so much money, working under such a wealthy boss felt so blissful.
They didn’t know Lin Fan was a man aiming to build a trillion-dollar group, and such investments were necessary, plus this kind of investment was trivial for Lin Fan, who had a trillion in cash.
Lin Fan bought a 3 billion mansion without batting an eye, spending tens of millions on building a factory was nothing.
Lin Fan said, "Additionally, I have an announcement. Starting today, Blue Moon will be renamed Mortal Group, with the Blue Moon Hand Soap brand name retained as a sub-brand under the group."

chapters.title: Chapter 54: 3 Requirements of the Unusual Blind Date Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: 3 Requirements of the Unusual Blind Date Woman
Mortal Group!
Announces its establishment!
This is the beginning of Lin Fan’s trillion-dollar business empire!
Zhang Dafu was incredibly excited. Though he wasn’t entirely clear, he had a keen sense that the boss was gearing up for something monumental!
On this day, the news reports in Yun City followed.
"This morning, Red Sun Hand Sanitizer Company’s owner, Chen Jianfeng, received a lawyer’s letter from Xingquan Law Firm. It is understood that the lawsuit’s reason is Chen Jianfeng’s theft of Blue Moon’s original hand sanitizer formula. The court has accepted the case..."
"The city’s hand sanitizer brand, Blue Moon, has announced its renaming to Mortal Group. Blue Moon becomes the first subsidiary brand under Mortal Group, launching its new hand sanitizer today, taking the market by storm..."
Both these news pieces were Lin Fan’s handiwork.
One was used to further hit Red Sun, the other to promote Blue Moon.
As expected, once the news was out, Red Sun’s reputation plummeted.
"No way, Red Sun Hand Sanitizer’s formula was stolen?"
"It’s Xingquan Law Firm, the letter they sent must be legit!"
"I’m never buying Red Sun again!"
At this time, Lin Fan had already left the exhibition, driving a Kosak, ready to attend the meeting.
He recalled this morning when Ma Rongrong accepted his friend request, but he had been too busy to respond. He picked up his phone and sent Ma Rongrong a message.
"Miss Ma, I’m Lin Fan. Heading to Starbucks now, see you shortly."
Ma Rongrong, at home, received Lin Fan’s message, pouting: "Only now contacting me, clearly not a good guy!"
She didn’t feel like meeting Lin Fan, but thinking about her mother’s nagging, she reluctantly went out.
Lin Fan arrived at Starbucks promptly at 12 o’clock, sending Ma Rongrong a message: "Miss Ma, I’m here. Are you here yet?"
After waiting for ten minutes, Ma Rongrong replied: "I’m rushing over, stop pushing me!"
Lin Fan: "..."
He felt he hadn’t pushed her, just asked if she’d arrived, and it was her who was late, yet she acted like she was in the right...
About half an hour passed.
Ma Rongrong finally arrived tardily.
As soon as Ma Rongrong arrived outside Starbucks, she was attracted by the Kosak parked nearby.
"This car is so cool, the owner must be loaded. If only he were my date..." Ma Rongrong momentarily indulged in fantasies.
But when she saw Lin Fan, dressed in street clothes, reality hit; her date was this poor guy.
Though admittedly young and handsome enough, outwardly no issues, it was unfortunate he was too poor.
"You’re Lin Fan, right? My mom, always introducing me to all sorts of people—not ugly, then poor. How could they possibly match up to such an outstanding girl like me! Let’s cut to the chase. I’ll lay out my three conditions. If you can’t meet them, there’s no need to waste time." Ma Rongrong said impatiently as soon as she sat down.
Lin Fan remained calm: "Alright, go ahead."
Ma Rongrong: "First, appearance check. Must be young and handsome. You... barely pass, I suppose!"
Lin Fan: "???"
Barely pass? I’m incredibly handsome, yet barely pass with you. Damn, it’s like getting charged extra for groceries...
Ma Rongrong: "Second, I’m so pretty, if you get me, it’s a blessing earned through several lifetimes. You must adore me, put me first. If I want the moon, you can’t give me just the stars. If I argue with your mom, you must support me. Think about it, can you do that?"
Lin Fan: "???"
This woman seems to have a serious princess syndrome, not a mild case!
Ma Rongrong: "Third, you must be wealthy. In the future, I won’t work. You’ll support me, give me money to spend. Not talking about meals, I eat simply but don’t cook; you’ll need to hire help for house chores. I must buy new clothes and bags monthly and travel at least three times a year, all on your dime. Judging by you... doesn’t seem like you’re wealthy!"
Lin Fan laughed bitterly; Aunt Li, where did you find this oddball? Treating men like what?
No princess fate, yet with a princess syndrome!
Lin Fan pointed: "Young lady, do you see that?"
Ma Rongrong followed his gesture, frowning: "See what?"
Lin Fan replied: "The door. You can hurry on out."
"You!"
Ma Rongrong was furious. She stood up abruptly, "You broke nobody, how dare you speak to me like that? You can’t even afford a girlfriend, you low-class jerk! Pah!"
Ma Rongrong cursed Lin Fan thoroughly and stormed off.
This blind date ended within ten minutes of meeting, in failure!
Lin Fan was exasperated, thinking that dating was truly unreliable. He’s had many dates, rarely any promising ones.
Luckily, Lin Fan didn’t mind, rather he was glad Ma Rongrong left.
He could focus on waiting for Chen Lingling to arrive.
Chen Lingling started work at one o’clock in the afternoon; just a few more minutes, and he could see her. Comparing Chen Lingling to Ma Rongrong, Lin Fan found Chen Lingling simply wonderful.
After waiting for a while, Lin Fan felt a little urgent, heading to the restroom. Suddenly, his phone rang.
Just as Lin Fan stepped away, a youthful beauty walked in through the door, wearing a dress with a Starbucks apron over it, sporting twin ponytails, like a girl stepped out from a manga.
Chen Lingling came to work.
She arranged to meet Lin Fan at Starbucks but wasn’t sure when Brother Lin would come, so she planned to work while waiting for him.
However, she saw Lin Fan’s luxury car at the entrance, realizing Brother Lin had arrived.
Feeling cheerful, Chen Lingling hastily entered but found no sight of Lin Fan.
Just as Chen Lingling was about to call Lin Fan for his whereabouts, the Starbucks door opened, and a long-haired, red-lipped beauty walked in.
Their eyes met, freezing briefly.
Sun Xiaona!
What a narrow escape indeed, unexpectedly running into Sun Xiaona.
Sun Xiaona didn’t anticipate seeing Chen Lingling here either. She rushed over after hearing Ma Rongrong was meeting Lin Fan at Starbucks to ruin things between Ma Rongrong and Lin Fan.
Ma Rongrong was told not to contact Lin Fan again!
Lin Fan was hers, Sun Xiaona claimed!
"Oh, isn’t it Boss Chen! Lin Fan said he’d buy an anime company for you to be the boss, but why are you still a coffee girl here!" Sun Xiaona taunted.
Chen Lingling blushed. That day, Sun Xiaona jeered about her unemployment; Lin Fan merely stepped in to save face for her.
Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t truly buy an anime company for her, nor did she have the slightest desire.
Now caught by Sun Xiaona, it was a bit awkward.
Seeing Chen Lingling’s flustered expression, Sun Xiaona was sure Lin Fan never bought an anime company for her, feeling ever more triumphant: "Lin Fan is so rich, he could easily buy a company, yet he won’t buy it for you, proving he doesn’t love you. Chen Lingling, I’d advise you not to delude yourself."

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Best Friends’ Intense Catfight
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: Best Friends’ Intense Catfight
Chen Lingling blushed and said, "It’s not like you said!"
Sun Xiaona didn’t know that she and Lin Fan were not a real couple; Brother Lin was just pretending to be her boyfriend.
However, Sun Xiaona’s words trying to drive a wedge between her and Lin Fan were honestly too scheming!
Sun Xiaona chuckled and said, "Not like I said? Then what is it like? Chen Lingling, keep deceiving yourself. I’m not saying you don’t qualify to be with Lin Fan!"
Chen Lingling was a bit angry, "Sun Xiaona, what do you want to do?"
Sun Xiaona said smugly, "Angry? You should be. It means you know I’m right. Lin Fan will never buy you a company!"
At this moment.
"Lingling, you’re here!"
Lin Fan walked over with a smile.
"Brother Lin!" Chen Lingling was happy to see Lin Fan and quickly ran to his side.
Lin Fan glanced at Sun Xiaona and frowned, "Sun Xiaona? Lingling, what did she just say to you?"
Chen Lingling was a bit embarrassed, "She said..."
Sun Xiaona sneered, "I said you don’t love her at all. Lin Fan, didn’t you say you’d buy a comic company for her? Why is she still here as a coffee assistant? You never planned to buy it, did you!"
Lin Fan’s face darkened, "This is between Lingling and me. None of your business! Besides, isn’t it just a comic company? I’ve already bought it!"
What?
Chen Lingling and Sun Xiaona were both stunned.
Lin Fan really bought a comic company?
Sun Xiaona’s face turned pale, "I don’t believe it. Lin Fan, you must be bluffing. You just want to embarrass me again with this trick, but unfortunately, I saw through it!"
At this moment, a woman dressed in business attire, carrying a briefcase, pushed the door open and entered.
She came directly in front of Lin Fan.
"Hello, Mr. Lin. I am Li Xue from Xingquan Law Firm. Boss Jin asked me to help you with the stock purchase procedures for Tourist Comics. The procedures are already completed. Please take a look, and if there are no issues, just sign." The woman said respectfully.
It turns out that today at the daily chemical products conference, Lin Fan also asked Jin Hesheng to help with the Tourist Comics stock purchase, and he just answered a call from Li Xue when he was in the restroom, saying she would come to see him.
Xingquan’s efficiency is indeed high.
Lin Fan took the documents, found no problems, and signed them.
Li Xue smiled and said, "Congratulations, Mr. Lin, on acquiring 100% of Tourist Comics’ stock."
Li Xue then took her leave.
Sun Xiaona, standing by, was already stunned.
With the facts laid out before her, she couldn’t refuse to believe it; Lin Fan really did acquire a comic company, and it’s one of the giants, Tourist Comics!
Lin Fan said, "Lingling, I said that when I bought a comic company, I’d let you be the boss. Are you ready to be the boss?"
Chen Lingling was already stunned; the happiness came too suddenly. Brother Lin really bought a comic company, and he really wanted her to be the boss?
Is she really not dreaming?
What followed was immense joy.
Tourist Comics, the company Brother bought is actually Tourist Comics, one of the top three in domestic comics, the company she had always dreamed of joining!
"Brother Lin, I’m crazy about you, thank you so much!"
Chen Lingling happily threw herself into Lin Fan’s arms and hugged him.
"Quickly go and resign. Let’s go shopping."
Lin Fan smiled, gently stroked Chen Lingling’s head. This girl, like a little cat, felt oddly comfortable in his arms.
Head pat!
Seeing this scene, Sun Xiaona looked ashen-faced and trembled all over.
She tried to destroy Lin Fan and Chen Lingling’s relationship, but they were still loving each other; she made herself look like a fool!
Chen Lingling said joyfully, "Okay, I’ll go do it now."
Chen Lingling went directly to the manager to resign, from now on she would be the boss of Tourist Comics, no more part-time jobs needed.
Lin Fan sat down on the side, waiting for Chen Lingling, as for Sun Xiaona, he couldn’t be bothered to look at her.
Sun Xiaona forcibly regained calm, she wasn’t someone who would easily admit defeat.
Sun Xiaona sat opposite Lin Fan and said, "Lin Fan, Chen Lingling doesn’t deserve your goodness. You must be deceived by her innocent appearance; she’s actually a scheming bitch!"
Lin Fan said, "Oh, she’s a scheming bitch?"
Sun Xiaona replied, "She only sought you because she couldn’t find a job. Now that her goal is achieved, you’re still in the dark."
"Is that so?"
Lin Fan felt slightly amused; Sun Xiaona didn’t know, he wasn’t Lingling’s boyfriend, and Lingling didn’t proactively ask him for a job.
Sun Xiaona said, "I know Chen Lingling the best. I can’t stand her. Lin Fan, you have to believe me, I’m a straightforward person, I never lie!"
"Little Na, why are you here?"
Suddenly, a surprised voice came from behind.
Hearing this voice, Sun Xiaona trembled all over.
Ma Rongrong!
Lin Fan was a bit curious why Ma Rongrong came back, and she seemed to know Sun Xiaona?
Sun Xiaona forced a smile and said, "Rongrong, you’re here. Why didn’t I see you earlier?"
Ma Rongrong looked at Sun Xiaona, then at Lin Fan, and said, "You two know each other?"
Sun Xiaona was a bit embarrassed, "Hehe, well... I do know him, but..."
Ma Rongrong realized Sun Xiaona had lied to her, her emotions turned a bit excited, "Did you know he’s very rich, that he owns a top sports car?"
Sun Xiaona was puzzled and blurted out, "Rongrong, how did you know?"
She realized she’d slipped up as soon as she said it.
Ma Rongrong was furious, "Sun Xiaona, to think I considered you my best friend, yet you deceived me! You clearly knew Lin Fan was a wealthy person but didn’t tell me; instead, you told me not to pay attention to him, then you turn around and come looking for him yourself? What are you up to?"
Lin Fan was amused, "So that’s the case, Sun Xiaona, you never lie, and your best friend is not a person?"
Sun Xiaona’s face flushed red, "Rongrong, let me explain..."
Ma Rongrong angrily said, "What is there to explain? I believed your nonsense, which led to my failed matchmaking with Lin Fan; it’s all your fault!"
Ma Rongrong was too angry. Had it not been for accidentally seeing a video of Lin Fan confronting a snake-faced girl, revealing he was a "Rich Second Generation," and that the Kosak in front of the building was his, she wouldn’t have come back to find Lin Fan.
Knowing the truth, she shed tears of regret and rushed back to find Lin Fan, only to run into Sun Xiaona.
"I get it, you sabotaged my matchmaking with Lin Fan because you want him for yourself, you scheming bitch!" Ma Rongrong screamed, getting angrier the more she thought about it.
At this point, Ma Rongrong had torn through all pretense, and Sun Xiaona couldn’t be bothered to fake it either, "That’s right, I did deceive you. Who asked your matchmaking partner to be Lin Fan. You’re a terminal princess syndrome patient, do you think someone like you deserves Lin Fan?"
Ma Rongrong was furious, "What did you call me?"
Sun Xiaona sneered, "Princess syndrome! Did I say anything wrong? You’ve failed at matchmaking repeatedly because men find you..."
Pah!
Sun Xiaona’s words were cut off by Ma Rongrong’s slap.
An enraged Ma Rongrong suddenly gave Sun Xiaona a slap in the face.
"How dare you hit me?"
Sun Xiaona was enraged too and fiercely returned a slap to Ma Rongrong, a loud slap left half of Ma Rongrong’s face red.
Ma Rongrong cried out in pain and shouted angrily, "Sun Xiaona, you bitch, I’m cutting you off!"
As she shouted, she grabbed Sun Xiaona’s hair, and the two women started to brawl immediately.
Pushing,
Hair pulling,
Clothes tearing...
Both fell to the floor, the nearby tables and chairs were knocked over.
People in the shop were stunned by this girlfriend catfight.
Lin Fan was also bewildered; a chick fight, rare to see, it was just so... dramatic!
Chen Lingling had finished processing her resignation and came out, startled by the scene before her, "Brother Lin, why is Sun Xiaona fighting someone?"

chapters.title: Chapter 56: I Am a Deliveryman
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: I Am a Deliveryman
Lin Fan said, "It seems Sun Xiaona tricked her best friend."
Chen Lingling let out an ’oh’: "Well, Sun Xiaona, really? Even tricking her own best friend?"
Lin Fan said, "Guard against fire, theft, and besties, there’s some truth to that. Lingling, let’s not bother with her, let’s go shopping."
Chen Lingling nodded happily: "Okay!"
Being able to go shopping with Brother Lin made her so happy, she couldn’t care less about Sun Xiaona anymore. She didn’t want to think about anything, just wanted to enjoy shopping with Brother Lin.
So, the two walked out, got into the Kosak, and left Starbucks.
The Kosak was already far away. Inside the coffee shop, Sun Xiaona and Ma Rongrong were still tussling...
Chen Lingling needed to buy a new computer, so Lin Fan took her to the computer mall.
Arriving at the parking lot of the computer mall, they saw it was full of cars, with very few vacant spaces left.
Lin Fan, with keen eyes, spotted an empty space and swiftly drove there, doing a smooth drift to park the car in the spot.
Because his view was blocked, he hadn’t noticed a Toyota next to him had already positioned itself intending to reverse into the spot.
The Toyota driver suddenly realized the spot was taken and got very angry, cursing as he got out of his car intending to confront Lin Fan.
"Dare to take my spot, you little..."
But as soon as he saw that the car taking the spot was a Kosak, a top-notch supercar!
He immediately went silent.
Lin Fan got out of the car and then noticed the Toyota guy wanted this spot, apologetically saying, "Sorry, brother, I didn’t see you just now. How about I give the spot back to you?"
The Toyota guy immediately showed a flattering smile: "No need, no need, the spot is yours. I’ll just find another one."
The before-and-after attitude was hugely different, and remarkably polite!
Of course, anyone driving a Kosak must be a super-rich tycoon; he wouldn’t dare offend him.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thanks a lot then."
"No problem!" The Toyota guy nodded and bowed back to his car, quickly driving away.
Lin Fan didn’t really mind this little incident and headed toward the computer mall with Chen Lingling.
As they were walking, an average-looking woman, scoring a 60, suddenly turned to glance at Chen Lingling.
"Chen Lingling?" the average-looking woman said with pleasant surprise.
Chen Lingling saw the average-looking woman and recognized her too, happily saying, "Little Mei! Didn’t expect to bump into you here."
Little Mei smiled and said, "I’m waiting for my boyfriend; he’s parking over there. He’s coming over now."
Little Mei looked towards a direction, seeing a sharply dressed man getting out of a BMW, walking their way, with Little Mei wearing a proud expression. She seemed quite satisfied with this boyfriend.
After all, she’s not from a wealthy family either, just like Lingling in the past. Finding a boyfriend with a BMW was something to be proud of.
Chen Lingling turned to Lin Fan and said, "Brother, Little Mei was my colleague part-timing at the restaurant before."
Lin Fan smiled, "Hello."
Little Mei looked at Lin Fan, stunned by his handsome, masculine face. So handsome! Is he really Chen Lingling’s boyfriend?
Little Mei asked, "Lingling, is this your boyfriend?"
Chen Lingling said, "He’s..."
She hesitated a bit, unsure if she should let Lin Fan pretend to be her boyfriend. After all, she previously asked Lin Fan to pretend to be her boyfriend just to deal with Sun Xiaona, and Little Mei wasn’t Sun Xiaona...
But Lin Fan had already taken the initiative, holding Chen Lingling’s little hand: "I’m Lin Fan, Lingling’s boyfriend."
Chen Lingling blushed; Brother Lin is so nice, afraid I’d lose face, he took the initiative to say he’s my boyfriend.
Little Mei felt a bit envious, didn’t expect Chen Lingling to find such a handsome boyfriend. Comparing him to her own boyfriend, he was far less attractive than Lin Fan.
But she took a closer look at Lin Fan’s attire.
Cheap clothes from a roadside stall!
Little Mei felt a bit consoled, at least her boyfriend was wealthier than Lin Fan, driving a BMW!
At that moment, the BMW guy had already walked over.
Little Mei pulled the BMW guy, confidently smiled, and said, "Let me introduce, Liu Ming, my boyfriend; Chen Lingling, my former colleague; Lin Fan, Lingling’s boyfriend."
The BMW guy saw Chen Lingling, his eyes lit up. What a beautiful girl, much prettier than Little Mei!
Given the scenario, it wasn’t appropriate for him to stare at Chen Lingling too long, so he shifted his gaze to Lin Fan.
This guy is lucky, he thought. Handsome too, but judging by his attire, could he be a poor guy?
"Lin Fan, what line of work are you in?" the BMW guy asked while taking out a box of cigarettes, preparing to offer one to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m a delivery guy."
What?
The BMW guy and Little Mei were both taken aback.
The cigarette that the BMW guy was about to hand out was retracted in silence, as if a delivery guy wasn’t worthy of receiving his offering.
"Heh heh, delivery work is good," the BMW guy said with false courtesy.
Little Mei’s eyes suddenly showed a hint of disdain, and the sourness she felt towards Chen Lingling vanished completely, replaced by a sense of superiority.
So what if Chen Lingling found a handsome boyfriend? He’s just a delivery guy from the societal lower rung. She’s different; she’s achieved a leap in social class, outperforming Chen Lingling!
Little Mei proudly said, "Liu Ming is in the accessories business. He owns a store in the computer mall, and he’s hiring now. Lingling, if you and your boyfriend need a job change, you can apply at his store."
Even Chen Lingling could sense Little Mei’s air of superiority. She was a bit speechless; Little Mei wasn’t like this before. How did she become so snobbish?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What a coincidence, Lingling is indeed looking for a job change recently."
He wasn’t wrong; Chen Lingling was about to go be the boss at Tourist Comics.
Liu Ming’s eyes lit up. No way, if Chen Lingling came to his store to work, wouldn’t he get to see her every day?
"That’s no problem at all. You’re Little Mei’s friend, working at my store, I won’t treat you poorly. Whenever you’re ready to join, just let Little Mei know," the BMW guy voluntarily said.
The expressions and thoughts of the BMW guy didn’t escape Lin Fan’s keen eyes.
Lin Fan sneered inwardly, judging by this, the BMW guy didn’t truly love Little Mei either. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be having inappropriate thoughts about Chen Lingling.
Little Mei smiled and said, "Lingling, that’s great! We can be together every day again, just like before."
Little Mei clearly did not notice her boyfriend’s inappropriate thoughts. She still believed her boyfriend was very devoted. The BMW guy indeed acted very devoted in front of her.
Chen Lingling felt a bit embarrassed: "Sorry, I won’t be going to your store. I’m going to Brother’s company."
The BMW guy felt a bit disappointed at her words, as if the meat to his mouth flew away.
Little Mei was surprised: "Lingling, no way, you’re going to deliver food too?"
Chen Lingling explained, "No, it’s not..."
Actually, Brother Lin just bought a comic company and was preparing to let her run it. She’s honest and intended to explain clearly to Little Mei.
Lin Fan said, "Lingling is indeed coming to my company, but not as a delivery person."
Little Mei said, "Well then, Lingling, if you’re not happy with your work, you’re always welcome to our store."
She didn’t ask further. Chen Lingling going to work in a delivery company mostly involved lower-level work, considering her boyfriend was just a delivery guy.
Seeing the conversation ended, Chen Lingling was also too lazy to explain further and said, "Okay."
Little Mei said, "Lingling, why are you guys heading to the computer mall today? Are you buying accessories? You can have a look at our store."
She intended to show off her boyfriend’s accessories store.
Chen Lingling said, "No, I’m here to buy a computer."
The BMW guy let out an ’oh’: "Buying a computer? Well, you’ve come to the right person. I’m familiar with all the stores here. Let me recommend one to you. What’s your budget? There are quite a few computers for 3,000 bucks."
Judging by their attire, with Lin Fan being a delivery guy, they obviously couldn’t afford an expensive computer. He assumed a 3,000 budget was the most they could manage.
Chen Lingling explained, "No, I need a computer for drawing. A 3,000 budget might not be enough, but I don’t really know much."
Lin Fan smiled, "If it’s for drawing, a 3,000 configuration definitely won’t do. I suggest getting an Apple computer."
Apple computer!
The currently top-performing computer brand on the market, a show-off accessory!
But it’s also incredibly expensive!
The BMW guy chuckled: "Apple computers are good, but they’re a bit pricey. Are you guys planning to pay in installments?"
He laughed internally; just an Apple computer, over a dozen thousand bucks, could they even afford it on installments!
Lin Fan was slightly embarrassed, was it just an Apple computer, only over ten grand, and he needed installments?
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Call Your Manager
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Call Your Manager
The BMW guy and Little Mei went back to open the shop first, saying they’d come to the Apple store later to find Lin Fan and Chen Lingling. The BMW guy claimed to be friends with the store manager and could help get a discount.
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling arrived at the Apple store.
The store employees glanced at their clothing and immediately lost interest, standing there motionless, as if they hadn’t seen the two of them.
Clearly, they’re poor!
Apple computers are very expensive. Can these two afford it? They’re probably just here to look around. Usually, there are quite a few people who come to the store just to browse and don’t buy.
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling wandered around the store.
Chen Lingling was attracted to a laptop: "Brother, this computer looks nice."
Lin Fan said: "You like it?"
Chen Lingling said: "Yes, but it’s too expensive. The minimum configuration costs 9,999. Brother, Apple’s products are too pricey. How about we check out other places?"
Lin Fan said: "No worries."
He waved to a nearby female employee: "Excuse me, could you come over here?"
The female employee reluctantly walked over, thinking that poor people can’t afford it yet still want customer service!
Lin Fan said: "My friend wants to buy this computer."
Chen Lingling said: "I’m using it for drawing. I’m not sure which configuration to choose?"
The female employee said impatiently, "For drawing? Then you’d better choose the high configuration. This is Apple’s latest model, with the highest configuration costing 16,999 yuan!"
Chen Lingling was shocked: "That’s too expensive! Can it be any cheaper?"
The female employee immediately showed a disdainful face: "Obviously, you’ve never bought Apple products before, have you? Have you ever heard of Apple having discounts? This isn’t a grocery market. We don’t haggle here. If you can’t afford it, feel free to go elsewhere!"
Feeling intimidated, Chen Lingling couldn’t help but tug on Lin Fan’s sleeve, wanting to leave. She didn’t have the confidence to argue, as she really couldn’t afford it.
Lin Fan frowned, a bit displeased. The employee’s attitude was terrible. Aren’t they just workers too? So what, selling a high-end computer makes her think she’s better than others and can look down on people?
Lin Fan said coldly: "She just asked a simple question, does that mean we can’t afford it?"
The female employee sneered, "Just looking at your clothes, I can tell you can’t afford it, dressed in cheap market goods. Did I say anything wrong?"
Lin Fan said: "As a store employee, it’s your duty to serve customers. If you don’t want to serve us, you can quit."
The female employee became furious: "Why should I quit? You poor guys come here with no money, wasting my time with endless questions! So what if I don’t like poor people?"
Other store employees also looked on with indifference, none stepping forward to stop the situation.
Lin Fan frowned, "Your store is open to all customers. Shouldn’t you treat everyone equally? Does your store only welcome rich people and not poor people? If so, perhaps you should put up a notice at the door. I guarantee you’d at least make it to the trending topics."
The female employee arrogantly said, "So what if we don’t welcome poor people? You can’t afford the computers here, so please leave immediately!"
Lin Fan didn’t bother to argue with her, pointed to the laptop Chen Lingling liked, and said: "I want one of this model with the highest configuration. Go get it for me."
The female employee sneered, "Who are you trying to impress? The highest configuration costs 16,999 yuan. Can you afford it?"
Chen Lingling said: "Uh... Can I pay in installments?"
She indeed had a limited budget, and Brother Lin wasn’t her boyfriend. She couldn’t expect him to pay for the computer.
Upon hearing this, the female employee immediately confirmed that the two were broke, saying: "Of course you can pay in installments. If you want to put on airs, I see no reason not to indulge you."
Lin Fan said: "No need for installments. I’ll pay the full amount now."
What?
Everyone in the store turned to look, a bit surprised that this guy wanted to pay 16,999 yuan in full for a computer?
Does he really have the money?
The female employee was shocked that Lin Fan was so bold as to pay in full. Could it be that he really does have money?
If Lin Fan really paid in full and then turned around to complain about her, she’d be in trouble.
But the flea market clothes Lin Fan wore reassured her. She was certain he was just bluffing!
"Alright, I’ll go get the computer. I bet you can’t pay for it. Don’t blame me for being rude if it turns out you can’t!" the female employee said coldly and ran to the warehouse.
Chen Lingling whispered: "Brother... I want to buy the computer myself. You’ve already spent a lot on me. I can’t let you pay for this too."
Lin Fan smiled: "No worries. Consider it a gift for your new job."
"Okay..." Chen Lingling said nothing more, now planning to work hard to repay Brother in the future.
Soon, the computer was retrieved, and the female employee prepared the invoice and handed it to Lin Fan: "There, go pay for it!"
She was sure Lin Fan couldn’t afford it, ready to expose his bluff and enjoy the show!
Lin Fan went to the counter and swiped his bank card.
Beep!
Payment successful!
The female employee was stunned; he actually paid in full! Lin Fan really paid 16,999 yuan all at once!
This was certainly a slap in the face!
However, the female employee quickly regained her composure, sarcastically saying: "Congratulations! You successfully bought the laptop. You must have spent all your savings. I told you, you just wanted to put on airs. Now you’ll have to eat instant noodles, right?"
Others in the store chuckled quietly, thinking the same. Although Lin Fan successfully paid, he must have spent all his long-saved money; putting on airs isn’t easy.
Lin Fan originally didn’t want to stoop to the female employee’s level, but hearing this, he sat down on a nearby chair.
"I have a business deal to discuss with your manager. Please ask him to come over." Lin Fan said calmly.
The employees exchanged looks. What’s this guy up to?
The female employee sneered: "If you have anything to say, tell me. We don’t need our manager to deal with someone like you."
Lin Fan replied: "If you don’t call the manager, I’ll wait here until he comes. But the consequences, I think, are beyond what you can handle."
At this moment, a man in a suit walked in, glanced at the store situation, and asked: "What’s going on?"
The employees saw the man and immediately showed a respectful demeanor, calling out: "Manager!"
The female employee pointed at Lin Fan and said: "Manager, this person wants to see you!"
The man looked at Lin Fan, stunned for a moment, and blurted out: "Is it you, sir?"
Lin Fan recognized the man, also surprised. Wasn’t this the Toyota guy he ran into at the parking lot earlier!
Lin Fan smiled, "What a coincidence! You’re the manager here?"
The man smiled respectfully: "Yes, my last name is Tan. May I know your name, sir?"
Lin Fan, owner of Kosak, was a super-rich person. Now presented with a chance to meet Lin Fan, he had to serve him carefully.
Lin Fan said: "My last name is Lin."
The man said: "Ah, Mr. Lin. Are you here to buy a computer?"
Lin Fan said: "Yes, I want to discuss a business deal with you. I plan to upgrade my company’s employees with your computers. I just saw one of your models, a 15,888 yuan desktop business computer, which I think is quite nice. I’m considering buying 200 units."

chapters.title: Chapter 58: The BMW Man Was Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: The BMW Man Was Shocked
What?
The store clerks were all stunned.
Manager Tan remained calm, thinking that it was nothing for a super-rich person to spend a little money.
The female employee was shocked. No way, Lin Fan actually wants to buy 200 computers priced at 15888 each? That’s 3177600 yuan!
Could this be a bluff?
The female employee felt uncertain and a bit nervous.
"Manager, this person must be causing trouble. He just bought one computer and spent all his savings. It’s impossible for him to afford so many computers. He’s wasting our time. Why don’t we call the security guard to escort them out!" the female employee said.
Manager Tan’s face changed drastically. Was this female employee crazy, talking to a super-rich person like that?
"You shut up right now, shut your filthy mouth, get out of here. Do you think you have the right to talk to Mr. Lin like that!"
Manager Tan immediately pointed at the female employee and yelled.
The female employee was startled. Why was Manager Tan reacting so strongly?
Lin Fan chuckled, "Manager Tan, your employees’ service attitude here is really bad. Just now..."
Lin Fan briefly explained what had just happened.
Manager Tan was petrified; this female employee was courting disaster!
Manager Tan scolded, "How can you treat a customer like this? Did you feed the employee code to the dogs?"
The female employee still didn’t realize her mistake and stubbornly said, "Manager, am I wrong? There are so many poor people like him every day, just looking but not buying. It’s so annoying. Although he bought a computer, he’s just pretending to be rich to scare me. He definitely can’t afford 200 computers!"
Lin Fan said, "Whether I can afford it or not can be determined by card swipe. I want 200 business desktop computers, Manager Tan, please process my card now."
Manager Tan hurriedly and respectfully said, "Okay, Mr. Lin."
Manager Tan took Lin Fan’s card and went to swipe it.
Beep!
yuan, the card was successfully charged!
Upon hearing this sound, the store clerks’ hearts all skipped a beat. Damn, it actually worked!
They all thought Lin Fan had spent all his savings, but he just easily swiped more than 3 million!
This was truly a slap in the face for them.
The female employee’s face turned pale, and her body couldn’t help but tremble. She realized she might have offended someone she shouldn’t have.
Manager Tan returned the card to Lin Fan with both hands, "Mr. Lin, please keep your card."
Lin Fan said, "Please send these 200 computers to Blue Moon Company, I’ll arrange someone to receive them."
Manager Tan said, "Okay, I’ll arrange it shortly."
Lin Fan said flatly, "Manager Tan, how do you plan to deal with this female employee? If you can’t handle it to my satisfaction, I might consider reporting this to your superior."
This was indeed a scare tactic aimed at Manager Tan. Although Lin Fan had money, he didn’t know Manager Tan’s superior, which might not escalate.
However, Manager Tan was startled. Lin Fan was a super-rich person, and he absolutely believed that with just one phone call from Lin Fan, he would lose his job!
Manager Tan immediately looked at the female employee, "Your work attitude is not suitable for this job. You’re fired, and you’ve violated the employee code. According to the code, your bonus will be deducted. Now go through the resignation procedures immediately!"
The female employee’s face turned ashen. Manager Tan was so ruthless, clearly, Lin Fan was someone she couldn’t afford to offend. She regretted it deeply, and without a word, she walked away dejectedly.
Manager Tan glanced at the other employees, "Who dares to be like her in the future, she is the best example."
The employees all lowered their heads in response.
Manager Tan then turned to Lin Fan with a flattering smile, "Mr. Lin, are you satisfied with this handling?"
Lin Fan nodded and prepared to leave.
At this moment, the BMW man and Little Mei came in. They had finished their work and came to see how Lin Fan and Chen Lingling were doing with the computer purchase.
The BMW man saw Manager Tan at a glance and laughed, "Old Tan, glad you’re here. They are my friends, and they don’t have much money. Can you give them a discount for my sake?"
Manager Tan was taken aback, wondering what nonsense Liu Ming was talking. Mr. Lin has no money? He just paid full price for 200 computers! Why would he need a discount for your sake?
Little Mei laughed, "Lingling, which computer did you like? The cheapest one here is 7999 yuan. Are you planning to buy on installments? I suggest 24 installments; the repayment pressure isn’t as big, though the interest might be a bit high."
Chen Lingling didn’t intend to discourage Little Mei, but she had to answer since Little Mei asked, "Well... I’ve already bought the computer."
Little Mei and the BMW man exclaimed in surprise. Bought it so quickly?
The BMW man reproached, "I told you I know Old Tan. I could have gotten you a discount. Why were you in such a hurry? Now there’s no discount."
Little Mei asked, "Did you buy the 7999 one? How many installments?"
Chen Lingling said, "No, we bought the latest model with the highest configuration for 16999 yuan. My brother paid it all in full, no installment."
What?
The BMW man and Little Mei were both stunned.
Manager Tan said, "Mr. Lin just bought 200 business desktops from me and paid in full, Old Liu, you came too late."
He did want to give Lin Fan a discount to please the super-rich, but he didn’t dare. Does someone like that need a discount? A mere three million, offering a discount would be an insult to a super-rich person!
The BMW man and Little Mei were dumbfounded.
Bought 200 business desktops in one go, that’s over 3 million!
Wasn’t Lin Fan a delivery worker, how could he be so wealthy?
"Sorry, Lingling and I have other places to go, so we’ll leave first."
Lin Fan said and left with Chen Lingling.
"Goodbye, Little Mei," Chen Lingling said to the stunned Little Mei, carrying the newly purchased computer and followed Lin Fan.
Manager Tan personally escorted them to the door, nodding and bowing, "Take care, Mr. Lin, I’ll personally ensure the computers are delivered to you later."
Manager Tan reluctantly watched them walk away, feeling excited. Today, he did big business with a super-rich person and could brag about it in the industry for a long time.
Seeing the dazed BMW man, Manager Tan walked over and patted his shoulder, "Old Liu, what’s going on? Missed the mark?"
The BMW man snapped back to reality, his face turning red, "He told me himself he was a delivery worker..."
Manager Tan laughed so hard, "Delivery worker? You’re joking, right? Have you ever seen a delivery worker driving a Kosak?"
The BMW man’s face changed dramatically, feeling cold all over, "Lin Fan drives a Kosak?"
Remembering all the things he said assuming Lin Fan had no money, he felt incredibly foolish and filled with regret.
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling walked out of the computer city and arrived at the parking lot outside.
"Lingling, do you still want to shop around, or should I take you home?" Lin Fan asked.
Chen Lingling’s heart fluttered, "Brother, can I still go shopping with you?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Of course, if you want, I’ll go shopping with you. I have nothing else to do today."
Chen Lingling was extremely happy, her face flushed, "Okay, I want to go shopping."
The two were about to get into the car.
"Mr. Lin, please wait a moment!" Suddenly someone called out.
Lin Fan turned around and saw the BMW man with Little Mei hurriedly coming over.
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling exchanged a glance, feeling slightly puzzled about why they were chasing after them.
The BMW man rushed over first, and at first sight of the Kosak nearby, confirmed what Manager Tan said—Lin Fan really is a super-rich person!
The BMW man immediately put on a flattering smile, "Mr. Lin, I apologize for any offense earlier. I didn’t recognize you for who you are. We’re here to apologize to you personally."

chapters.title: Chapter 59: The Green Tea Bitch’s Breakup Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: The Green Tea Bitch’s Breakup Game
The guy with the BMW regretted it so much. If he had known earlier that Lin Fan was so rich, he wouldn’t have had enough time to curry favor with him. How could he be negligent and say such stupid things!
Lin Fan said, "Haha, it’s nothing, you really don’t need to apologize."
During this time, Lin Fan had seen quite a few people who became obsequious after finding out he was wealthy.
Maybe it’s because he dresses modestly, which often leads to these misunderstandings. Lin Shanshan was right; he’s not an obvious rich guy. It seems he should wear some branded clothing in the future to reduce this kind of misunderstanding.
Lin Fan felt his thought was really thoughtful—forcing himself to wear branded clothes to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings from others!
Speaking of branded goods, Lin Fan remembered the day he bought out an entire street of luxury items.
The guy with the BMW eagerly pulled out a cigarette and enthusiastically offered one to Lin Fan: "Mr. Lin, have a smoke."
Lin Fan shook his head, "I’m sorry, I don’t smoke."
The guy with the BMW could only awkwardly take it back. Previously, when he thought Lin Fan was poor, he didn’t even want to offer him a cigarette. Now, eagerly offering it, it was refused!
"Not smoking is good, it’s healthy. I’m also thinking of quitting," the BMW guy said with an awkward laugh.
Actually, Lin Fan wasn’t disrespecting him. He really didn’t smoke.
However, since this BMW guy had previously had indecent intentions towards Chen Lingling, Lin Fan didn’t have much regard for him and had nothing good to say to him.
At this moment, Little Mei pulled Chen Lingling to the side.
"Lingling, you’re not being honest. Why didn’t you tell me earlier and even lied that your boyfriend was a delivery guy? Turns out he’s so rich!" Little Mei said, with a sour tone.
How could she not be sour? Besides being handsome, Lin Fan was so rich, a super wealthy guy, completely eclipsing her boyfriend in every manner. She was almost dying of jealousy!
Chen Lingling blushed and said, "He really is a delivery guy, I didn’t lie to you."
Little Mei was stunned. A delivery guy this rich?
Little Mei said, "Then you said you were going to work at his company. How come he’s so wealthy and you still need to deliver takeout?"
Chen Lingling said, "You misunderstood. I’m not going to deliver takeout. My brother just bought an anime company and asked me to be the boss."
What?
Little Mei was petrified.
Lin Fan bought Lingling an anime company!
What do they call a leap in social class? This is what they call a leap in social class!
This move utterly shocked her, and she was filled with jealousy, almost to the point of bursting.
Afterward, Lin Fan and Chen Lingling got in the car and left.
Little Mei glanced at the guy with the BMW who was there, grinning awkwardly, seeing them off. She suddenly felt a bit disdainful. If only her boyfriend were Lin Fan, but unfortunately, he was far from him.
However, Little Mei changed her thoughts and felt more at ease. Firstly, she was far inferior to Chen Lingling, who was a 90-point beauty, while she was at most 60 points. Someone like Lin Fan, a super-rich guy, certainly wouldn’t fancy her. Lin Fan was too far out of her reach.
Secondly, given her family background, having a boyfriend with a BMW was already pretty good. If she even lost the BMW guy, her situation would only get worse, falling back to the bottom!
So even if the BMW guy was far inferior to Lin Fan, she had to hold on tightly to him.
"Darling, let’s go back to the store."
Thinking this, Little Mei went up to hold the BMW guy’s hand and showed a warm smile.
The guy with the BMW said, "I need to step out for a bit, you go back to the store by yourself."
Little Mei frowned and said, "You’re going out again, you seem to have a lot going on recently?"
The guy with the BMW said, "I have to go socialize, right? No socializing, no business!"
Little Mei said, "Oh, okay."
The BMW guy said, "By the way, you should hang out with Chen Lingling more. Lin Fan is a super wealthy guy; we should try to get closer. Even if we don’t get any benefits, it certainly wouldn’t hurt."
Little Mei nodded, "Yeah, I know."
Lin Fan drove the Kosak, taking Chen Lingling to stroll around the nearby pedestrian street since they were free today.
While driving, Lin Fan sent a message to Anna, asking her to arrange a large truck to transport the luxury items he bought the other day to Yunding Manor.
He just remembered those luxury goods hadn’t been transported yet; they couldn’t be left in someone else’s warehouse forever.
Anna quickly replied, "Noted."
Lin Fan felt relieved and went off with Chen Lingling for shopping.
Chen Lingling was an easily satisfied girl. After shopping, she bought a few new skirts and some cute little accessories, which were all popular among young ladies and weren’t expensive, spending only a few hundred yuan. Chen Lingling was very satisfied.
In fact, with Brother Lin accompanying her, she would be satisfied even if she didn’t buy anything.
They were a bit thirsty after strolling to the neighborhood, so they went to a nearby convenience store to buy some water to drink.
At that moment, nearby, there was a green tea bitch live streamer doing a broadcast, dressed alluringly and provocatively, with a tiny waist exposed and a revealing chest, causing high turnaround rates on the street.
The streamer said, "Do I look sexy today? I have a reason for dressing like this. Today we’re going to play something exciting. I’m going to find those couples and try to seduce the guys to see if they can resist my charm in front of their girlfriends. I get a little excited just thinking about ruining someone else’s relationship!"
Streamers nowadays really dare to do anything to grab eyeballs. This move by the green tea bitch immediately made her live room more popular, with everyone wanting to see which guy would be the unlucky one.
The green tea bitch quickly locked her target on a young couple. Both the guy and the girl looked ordinary, and the girl’s figure was average too.
The green tea bitch walked up to the guy.
The guy wore glasses, his eyes glinting behind the lenses, already drawn to the sexy figure of the green tea bitch. Wow, she’s gorgeous! If only his girlfriend had a body like this.
The green tea bitch suddenly pretended to faint with a soft cry, falling into the arms of the glasses-wearing guy.
The guy immediately reached out to support her, and a burst of fragrance wafted into his nose, making him a bit tipsy. Looking down from above, he inadvertently noticed her exposed white chest, almost causing a nosebleed; it was so thrilling.
"I’m sorry, I have low blood sugar and feel dizzy. Could you help me over there to sit down?" the green tea bitch asked in a coquettish voice.
The glasses-wearing guy quickly replied, "No problem, I’ll help you over."
At this point, the girl’s eyes were almost shooting fire, glaring angrily at the glasses guy, trying to stop him with her gaze.
But the glasses guy was so mesmerized by the green tea bitch that he completely ignored his girlfriend’s fury, guiding the bitch to a bench on the roadside to sit down.
He practically wished he could sit down and accompany her, but as he really had no excuse to do so, he reluctantly returned to his girlfriend’s side.
The girl shouted angrily, "Why bother coming back; you might as well stay with that seductress!"
In public, the glasses guy felt awkward and softly persuaded, "I was just helping someone with good intentions, okay? Don’t make a scene. I said I’m sorry. I promise it won’t happen next time, okay?"
The girl snorted, "I see you’re clearly bewitched, enthralled by that vixen. If you want my forgiveness, then fine, buy me that bag I liked earlier!"
The glasses guy almost cried, "That bag costs 3,000 yuan!"
The girl said, "If you want my forgiveness, you have to show some sincerity. Will you buy it? If not, then you’re insincere, and we break up!"
The glasses guy smiled bitterly, "Fine, I’ll buy it..."
So the two of them walked into a nearby branded bag store.
The green tea bitch laughed so hard she nearly rocked back and forth, "Did you all see that? They almost broke up, which is so fun. Feelings are just so fragile. No man can withstand the temptation of a beauty. If anyone thinks I’m right, go ahead and send gifts."
The live stream room became lively, ushering in a small gift-giving peak.
The green tea bitch felt thrilled, "Next, let’s find the next target. Today I’ll aim to cause at least one more couple to break up."
The green tea bitch began looking for her next target, and suddenly, Lin Fan and Chen Lingling, who had just walked out of the convenience store, caught her attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Mr. Lin, you’re finally here!
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: Mr. Lin, you’re finally here!
The green tea girl said, "Look at this handsome guy and beautiful girl, the guy is so handsome, and the girl is so kawaii. But cuteness is worthless in the face of sexiness. Watch me conquer this handsome guy with charm!"
The green tea girl repeated her old trick, walked to Lin Fan’s side, pretended to faint, and with a soft exclamation, fell into Lin Fan’s arms.
Warm fragrance in full embrace!
Lin Fan was bewildered, walking on the street and suddenly having at least an 80-point beauty throw herself into his arms. Is there really such a good thing in the world?
Such opportunities are rare, better cherish it... Lin Fan reached out and hugged the green tea girl’s slender waist.
So soft, so comfortable...
"Handsome guy, my blood sugar is low, I’m a little dizzy. Can you help me over to that bench?" the green tea girl said in a sweet voice.
Lin Fan readily replied, "No problem."
Instead of supporting the green tea girl, he directly picked her up and walked towards the roadside bench.
"Beauty, you have a great body, and you’re dressed so seductively. It’s easy to tempt crime, you know? Fortunately, you met a gentleman like me."
Lin Fan laughed, placing the green tea girl on the bench.
The green tea girl: "..."
Inner thoughts: You’re a gentleman, really. I only intended for you to help me out a bit, but you straight up carried me. You took quite an advantage of me with this move, touching my waist and butt.
Lin Fan put down the green tea girl and returned to Chen Lingling’s side.
The green tea girl sneered, "I told you all men are lascivious. This guy dared to act so brazenly in front of his girlfriend. It looks like a breakup show is about to unfold, let’s enjoy the drama!"
Chen Lingling indeed looked jealous, "Brother, why did you carry her?"
She was so envious of the green tea girl. Her brother actually carried this green tea girl, and she’s never been carried by him!
Lin Fan said, "Because carrying her was a bit quicker."
Chen Lingling curiously asked, "Quicker for what?"
Lin Fan said, "Quicker to return to your side, of course. I don’t want to waste more time on her."
Chen Lingling’s cheeks flushed. So that’s what her brother was thinking? Her brother is so good; she misunderstood him.
Lin Fan went back to the convenience store, bought a lollipop, and handed it to Chen Lingling: "This is for you. I apologize for the time wasted on her."
As he spoke, he patted Chen Lingling gently on the head.
Chen Lingling’s jealousy instantly disappeared, and she responded with a bright smile, "Thank you, brother. You just wanted to help someone in need, it’s alright!"
What?
So easy to appease?
The people around and the viewers in the live streaming room were all dumbfounded.
"I’m so jealous of this handsome guy."
"Give me a dozen of such girlfriends!"
"This handsome guy is really stable!"
"666, the breakup failed, the broadcaster messed up this time!"
The green tea girl’s smile froze.
Dammit!
The story’s development is completely against her plan!
The breakup she anticipated didn’t happen at all. Lin Fan actually took advantage of her in front of his girlfriend!
And with just a lame cheesy line and a lollipop, he made it up to his girlfriend?
The green tea girl felt she lost big time with this move!
The guy with glasses who just spent 3,000 bucks on a bag to appease his girlfriend walked out of the store, saw this scene, and was filled with envy.
Lin Fan made things right with just a lollipop, but he had to bleed out a big sum. Plus, Lin Fan’s girlfriend is so kawaii while his own...
The guy with glasses suddenly felt his life was bleak.
Actually, when Lin Fan was in the convenience store, he noticed the green tea girl. He didn’t expect that after she messed with the guy with glasses, she’d target him!
Since the green tea girl came directly to him, he had no reason not to take advantage of the opportunity. Although the green tea girl wasn’t a good person, her figure was really nice, and holding her felt pretty good.
The green tea girl never dreamed that her plan to tease Lin Fan would end up with him playing her.
The green tea girl was unwilling, "No, I have to follow them. I must find a chance to get back at them!"
Lin Fan ignored the green tea girl and continued strolling with Chen Lingling. At this time, Lin Fan received a message from Anna.
Anna had already arranged for a large truck to deliver the luxury goods, but all those luxury stores required Lin Fan’s signature to release the items.
Lin Fan looked around and found that the luxury goods street wasn’t far away, so he decided to go there personally.
Luxury street.
A large truck stopped at the corner of the street, its purpose unknown, leaving pedestrians bewildered. Surely, this big fellow can carry a lot of goods. Could it be that the entire luxury street is moving?
At this moment, Lin Fan and Chen Lingling appeared on the luxury street.
Trailing behind them was a green tea bitch live streamer who suddenly felt she had found an opportunity, conceived a plan in her mind, and became delighted. This time, she was sure to teach Lin Fan a lesson.
Why would Lin Fan come here unless he wants to be humiliated?
The green tea bitch walked over and pretended to exclaim with surprise, "Wow, handsome guy and beautiful girl, what a coincidence! We meet again. I haven’t thanked the handsome guy for helping me earlier!"
Lin Fan thought with a sneer; this woman followed him all the way here and thinks he wouldn’t notice. What kind of scheme is she up to now?
"No need to be polite. Are you still dizzy? I don’t mind helping you again," Lin Fan said smiling, brazenly sizing up the green tea bitch.
The green tea bitch felt as if she were being scrutinized, quickly replied, "I’m fine now."
Internally: Damn, are you trying to take advantage of me!
The green tea bitch hurriedly got to the point and said with a smile, "Handsome guy, what brings you here? Surely you’re not buying luxury goods for your girlfriend, right? What are you planning to buy for her?"
The green tea bitch tried to embarrass Lin Fan!
Lin Fan dressed in market stall goods; he’s obviously poor and can’t afford luxury items!
Chen Lingling didn’t know why they came here either. The luxury goods were so expensive, and despite the price, she didn’t like them. She preferred a cute dress costing tens of dollars instead.
"We’re just passing by," Chen Lingling said.
The green tea bitch laughed, "Oh, just passing by? Sorry, my mistake, blame my eyesight. Actually, from the handsome guy’s attire, it’s clear he’s not someone who can afford these luxury items!"
The online viewers laughed.
"The streamer’s words are so cutting!"
"So ruthless!"
"Haha, the handsome guy must feel sad!"
Lin Fan spoke nonchalantly, "I’m indeed not here to buy luxury goods today."
Upon hearing this, the green tea bitch felt even more convinced that Lin Fan couldn’t afford luxury goods. Now she could severely humiliate Lin Fan and avenge the slight earlier.
The green tea bitch noticed that a pot-bellied middle-aged man was leaving the nearby L.V store, accompanied by a tall young beauty.
The green tea bitch hurried over to stop them.
"Sir, I’m doing a city topic program, can I interview you? Can you share what you just bought for your girlfriend?" the green tea bitch asked.
The pot-bellied middle-aged man was a nouveau riche, proudly replied, "No problem telling you, she’s not my girlfriend, she’s my Little Mi. I just spent 50,000 on her, bought two bags, but I have a fortune worth millions, that’s nothing!"
Having been poor for the first half of his life, he suddenly became wealthy, causing him to get a bit carried away and boast whenever he encountered someone.
The green tea bitch looked envious, "Wow, so rich! To spend 50,000 without batting an eye, truly magnanimous; that’s the right way to visit luxury streets, two words: spend money!"
The nouveau riche felt elated being praised, "That’s right, why visit luxury streets if you don’t spend money!"
The green tea bitch covered her mouth and laughed, "Then perhaps we should ask this handsome guy here, handsome guy, you can’t afford these luxury goods, why are you here?"
The nouveau riche glanced at Lin Fan, immediately showing contempt.
Dressed in market stall goods!
He seemed to forget that not long ago, he himself was a poor person with market stall goods, now that he’s wealthy, he immediately looks down on poor people.
"Tsk, what’s the point in asking? I know these poor kids well, they can’t afford it, just bringing a young girlfriend to feast their eyes!" the nouveau riche mocked.
The tall beauty beside him laughed, "Darling, luckily you’re not a poor kid."
The nouveau riche patted the tall beauty’s butt, "You little flirt, if I were a poor guy, would you get in my bed?"
The green tea bitch was very happy, feeling she had severely humiliated Lin Fan, but feigned goodwill by comforting him, "Handsome guy, although you’re poor, don’t lose heart!"
At this moment, the manager of the L.V store came out and immediately recognized Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, you are finally here! Your butler said you would personally come to sign. I was wondering when you would arrive; please sign this shipping order, the products you purchased from our store can be arranged for shipping immediately." The L.V manager smiled respectfully and presented a document to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said alright and signed the document.
Then, the nearby Ames Store, Chanel Store, Dior Store... all discovered Lin Fan was there and hurried to get the shipping orders for Lin Fan to sign.
Soon, each store started arranging shipments.
Clothes, shoes, bags, perfumes...
Boxes and boxes of various luxury items were moved out from the stores and loaded onto the big truck at the street corner.
Instantly, the whole luxury street became bustling with activity.
This scene stunned the passing pedestrians.
The green tea bitch, the nouveau riche, and his Little Mi were petrified.
What?
All these luxury items, bought by Lin Fan?

chapters.title: Chapter 61: 4 Hot Searches, Dominating Weibo
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: 4 Hot Searches, Dominating Weibo
A few small trolleys were coming out of various luxury stores, carrying goods and loading them onto the same large truck, as if moving house collectively. This bustling scene had never been seen before and shocked the passersby.
"Wait!"
Lin Fan suddenly called out to one of the small trolleys. It was carrying goods from a Rolex store. Lin Fan opened a packaging box and took a Rolex watch in his hand to examine it.
Everyone watched, and their hearts couldn’t help but race.
This was a Rolex Submariner, priced at over 150,000!
And Lin Fan had bought the entire store’s stock of such Rolex watches...
The entire store’s stock of Rolex!
This is what it means to be rich and capricious!
The premise of being capricious is having money; only with money can one be capricious.
