There aren’t many rich people as capricious as Lin Fan. While some rich people can afford this kind of expense, most are reluctant to be so capricious.
Lin Fan nodded with satisfaction, "This watch is nice!"
Although he’s not very interested in luxury clothes, watches are different, especially branded watches, which are indeed attractive.
Lin Fan put the Rolex Submariner on his wrist; it looked quite good, naturally exuding a sense of nobility.
As a company boss, this Rolex matched his identity quite well.
Lin Fan pondered that with this Rolex, he should be able to reduce some unnecessary misunderstandings in the future.
"Lingling, I bought all this stuff. Take a look and pick whatever you like at will," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Chen Lingling was so shocked she couldn’t speak. Her brother had bought the entire luxury street, and this operation left her stunned.
"Brother... I don’t need anything. I’ve bought a lot today, it’s already enough!" Chen Lingling finally came back to her senses and smiled.
"Hmm..." Lin Fan didn’t insist. Chen Lingling isn’t someone who pursues luxury. She’s satisfied with a dress costing a few dozen yuan, but even if it’s a luxury item worth tens of thousands, she won’t want it if she doesn’t like it.
The gold digger next to them was indescribably envious. Oh my god, this girl is so lucky, being able to choose from so many luxury goods!
However!
She actually refused!
The gold digger was about to lose her mind, screaming internally, "If you don’t want them, can you give them to me!"
The nouveau riche next to them fell silent, dead silent.
Lin Fan’s extravagance left him completely lost for words. It was like an ant seeing an elephant; compared to Lin Fan, he was just a small fry!
He came here spending a few thousand, arrogantly thinking he could act superior, and Lin Fan gave him a cold wake-up call.
Just the value of those Rolex store stocks exceeded his entire worth, and Rolex was only one of many luxury brands. Lin Fan had bought from as many as 13 luxury brands!
This value was already in the billions!
And Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t spend his entire fortune just to buy a bunch of luxury goods. Being able to buy this many so easily meant that these billions were just a drop in the bucket for Lin Fan!
It can be seen that Lin Fan’s fortune was likely in the tens of billions!
Maybe even hundreds of billions!
A billionaire tycoon!
A hundred-billionaire tycoon!
The nouveau riche was becoming arrogant because of his newfound wealth, showing off by flaunting luxury goods everywhere, and today he realized there was always someone better.
Lin Fan was like a Mount Tai standing in front of him; he couldn’t even see the top!
The nouveau riche dared not even breathe; this small fry could be annihilated with a flick of Lin Fan’s finger!
Lin Fan ignored the nouveau riche, looked at the "green tea bitch," and smiled, "I didn’t lie to you. I really didn’t come to shop today. I bought these things days ago, and today was just to pick them up."
The "green tea bitch" was still in shock, stunned!
Based on Lin Fan’s clothing, she judged him to be a poor person and tried to use that to humiliate him!
Who knew Lin Fan might actually be a billionaire tycoon!
It was like a big slap directly sending her soul flying from her body.
"You, you..."
The "green tea bitch’s" face twitched. She tried to speak but found herself too shocked to find her tongue.
In contrast.
Her live-streaming room had exploded.
Comments refreshed every second at 999+, with traffic flooding in, almost crashing the streaming platform’s servers!
"Awesome! Buying the entire street’s stock of luxury goods?"
"First time seeing such an extravagant move, utterly inhumane in wealth!"
"I’m going crazy; this is extravagantly outrageous!"
"This is too capricious!"
Most comments were shocked by Lin Fan’s actions.
As more people joined the live-streaming room, more and more became interested in Lin Fan’s identity.
The revelation of Lin Fan’s identity came quickly.
"Oh my god, it turns out the delivery guy who bought the whole street of luxury goods a while ago was him!"
"That video only showed a silhouette; now we finally see his true face!"
"So young, such a handsome tycoon!"
"Wait! He’s Lin Fan!"
"Lin Fan? Is he the young tycoon who ’slapped’ the snake-face beauty?"
"That’s right, it’s him!"
"So the person behind these two feats is actually the same individual!"
"What, Lin Fan is actually a delivery guy?"
"If that’s true, then he’s the richest and handsomest delivery guy in the world!"
"Wuwuwu, if a delivery guy can have this much money, maybe I should start delivering too..."
The topic around Lin Fan quickly fermented, directly exploding public opinion, and that very night, Lin Fan rapidly trended in searches!
"Identity of the delivery guy who bought the entire street of luxury goods exposed"
"Lin Fan, the richest delivery guy"
"Lin Fan, the most handsome delivery guy"
"Lin Fan’s inhumane wealth"
Four continuous trending topics dominated the platform’s trending searches!
Lin Fan became the most dazzling presence on social media that night, with discussions skyrocketing, surpassing the popularity of even celebrities who bought trending spots.
Most men were crazy for Lin Fan’s wealth, while most women were swooned by Lin Fan’s handsomeness. Overnight, the number of Lin Fan’s fanboys and fangirls grew exponentially...
Lin Fan rarely used social media, so he wasn’t aware of this.
After picking up the goods on the luxury street, Lin Fan left with Chen Lingling. No one knew that the destination of this truck full of luxury goods was Yunding Manor.
If Lin Fan’s identity as the mysterious buyer Mr. Lin were revealed, it would likely cause an even bigger sensation.
Until Lin Fan left, the "green tea bitch" live-streamer was still in a state of shock.
And the nouveau riche, suffocated by Lin Fan’s extravagance, breathed a long sigh of relief, feeling as if he had been granted amnesty. After today, he became honest and never dared to show off again.
Lin Fan dropped Chen Lingling off at the entrance of Lijing District, and it was already dark.
"Lingling, you should report to the comic company tomorrow. I’ll be handing this company over to you from now on. Do you have confidence?"
Lin Fan said. He had promised to make Chen Lingling the boss of the comic company, and he wouldn’t break his word. From now on, Chen Lingling would be the helm of Tourist Comics, though the actual owner of the company was still Lin Fan.
Chen Lingling was a bit excited, "Brother, I’ll try my best."
Working at Tourist Comics was her dream, and she would cherish this opportunity well.
Lin Fan smiled, "Good, then get some rest early tonight and recharge. I’ll come see you tomorrow if I’m free."
Chen Lingling thought of something, her cheeks flushed. She really wanted to tell Lin Fan, brother, maybe don’t go back tonight...
But as she was about to speak, Lin Fan’s phone rang, interrupting her.
Lin Fan took out his phone to see Zhang Dafu calling.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: The Appointment Between Mr. Lin and Su Jinjin
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62: The Appointment Between Mr. Lin and Su Jinjin
Blue Moon Company.
Apple business desktop computers were personally escorted by Manager Tan from the retail store and delivered to the company office.
The entire company was instantly abuzz.
Usually, companies provide their employees with ordinary assembly computers worth a few thousand bucks, but now, every employee at Blue Moon Company has their own Apple business computer!
This computer costs as much as 15,888 yuan!
Boss Lin Fan has certainly gone big this time!
Zhang Dafu excitedly said, "Today our new product triumphed at the product conference. The boss must have seen how hard everyone worked and specially bought these computers to reward us. Follow the boss, and you’ll be well-fed. Let’s work even harder in the future!"
The employees were all moved, sobbing. The boss is just too good to them; it’s such happiness to work with such a generous boss.
Moved, the employees didn’t forget to take out their phones, snap photos, and proudly post them on their social media.
"Today the boss got us new computers."
"The company looks brand new."
"Thank you, boss!"
In no time, they received countless envious replies, with likes soaring geometrically compared to usual. Even some old colleagues who hadn’t been in touch for a long time emerged.
"Whoa, all I see are Apple computers? Your boss is super generous, right!"
"Oh my god, is your company hiring?"
"An unbelievably generous boss!"
"Other people’s boss, I’m dying of envy!"
Seeing these comments, Blue Moon employees felt extremely proud. Previously, Blue Moon was struggling, and they had little confidence. Now they can finally hold their heads high, all because their boss is Lin Fan!
At the same time, upon learning that Blue Moon was going to expand its factory, Zhang Dafu’s phone was exploding with calls.
Zhang Dafu dealt with it all, busy until dark before he had the chance to call Lin Fan.
Zhang Dafu said, "Boss, my phone has been blowing up today. There’s someone selling land, construction materials, machinery... Just the ones selling land are several. I don’t know where you plan to build the factory?"
Lin Fan said, "You have more experience with this than me, pick some options first, and let me take a look."
Zhang Dafu said, "Alright, I have a few choices I’m interested in. I’ll send them to you to check out; you pick one."
Lin Fan said, "Okay, send them over; I’ll give you a reply tomorrow."
After hanging up Zhang Dafu’s call, Lin Fan turned to Chen Lingling, "Lingling, you seemed to want to say something to me earlier?"
Chen Lingling’s face turned red, "No, brother, drive safely and go to bed early when you get home. Goodnight."
Chen Lingling shyly got off the car and ran into the community. She originally planned to ask Lin Fan not to go home tonight, but after Zhang Dafu’s call interrupted, she was too shy to say it.
Watching Chen Lingling’s back, Lin Fan felt as if he had missed something...
Lin Fan then planned to drive home.
Just then, he saw a BMW driving up to the entrance of the community, and a man and a woman got out of the car, embraced each other intimately.
Lin Fan saw the man and was momentarily stunned.
Isn’t this the BMW guy Liu Ming who I met today, Little Mei’s boyfriend?
But the woman? She wasn’t Little Mei!
"You’d better go back now; if you don’t, your girlfriend will get suspicious." The woman laughed.
BMW guy said, "Don’t worry, she won’t suspect. She thinks I’m out for business socializing. Come on, one more kiss."
Lin Fan sweat-dropped. Damn, he accidentally caught BMW guy cheating!
But this BMW guy cheating wasn’t surprising to Lin Fan; this guy was even hitting on Chen Lingling today, superficially inviting her to work at his shop, but with ulterior motives.
Poor Little Mei.
Lin Fan wasn’t familiar with Little Mei and hadn’t decided whether to meddle, but since Little Mei is Lingling’s friend, Lin Fan left the decision to Lingling.
So Lin Fan snapped a photo of BMW guy and the woman being affectionate and sent it to Chen Lingling.
Just returning home, Chen Lingling saw the photo Lin Fan sent and replied with a string of surprised emojis.
"Brother, what should we do? Should we tell Little Mei?" Chen Lingling then asked Lin Fan.
Lin Fan replied, "That’s up to you."
Chen Lingling, "Hmm, I’ll think about it."
Lin Fan had already driven home by now; the BMW guy was too engrossed to notice Lin Fan...
While chatting with Chen Lingling on WeChat, Lin Fan received a call from Su Jinjin.
Lin Fan remembered; tomorrow is the day Su Jinjin visits Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan answered the call, "Jinjin."
Su Jinjin sounded a bit tense, "Lin Fan, can you accompany me to Yunding Manor tomorrow?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I promised you I would go with you."
Su Jinjin relaxed a bit, "That’s good, thank you, Lin Fan."
Lin Fan said, "No need to be nervous. Have a restful sleep tonight. See you tomorrow."
Su Jinjin said, "See you tomorrow."
Lin Fan returned to his rented apartment and found Lin Shanshan still awake, sitting on the couch and browsing her phone.
"Brother, you’re famous!"
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Lin Shanshan excitedly jumped up and hurried to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan sweat-dropped, "Wasn’t I already famous?"
Last time, he was told he’d become famous after his face-off with a snake-faced influencer got caught on video and went viral.
Lin Shanshan said excitedly, "This time it’s different; this time you’re super famous, more than last time, you’ve appeared on four trending topics. Look!"
Lin Shanshan showed the phone to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan saw that he really was on four trending topics, and the topics were highly engaging, mainly revolving around today’s livestream with the green tea influencer, capturing him picking up goods on luxury streets, and revealing his identity as a delivery guy.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but sweat; he’d never tried to deliberately hide or flaunt his identity as a delivery guy, but he’d unexpectedly become famous.
Lin Fan took it lightly, "Alright..."
Lin Shanshan broke into a cold sweat, wondering what kind of attitude her brother had; if she could get so famous, she’d laugh herself awake in her sleep, yet her brother was indifferent...
Lin Fan said, "Alright, go to bed early, stop playing with your phone. Tomorrow, come with me for an outing."
Lin Shanshan curiously asked, "Where are we going?"
Lin Fan said, "Yunding Manor."
An uneventful night passed, ushering in a new day.
Today is the day Mr. Lin meets Su Family’s third daughter, Su Jinjin!
Rumor has it that today Mr. Lin will also move into his new residence at Yunding Manor!
Su Jinjin is reportedly the only invited guest!
This honor has sparked countless envy and jealousy for Su Jinjin.
People are curious about why Mr. Lin invited Su Jinjin and whether Mr. Lin’s mysterious identity will be unveiled today.
Old Madam Su is filled with expectation for Su Jinjin’s meeting this time with Mr. Lin, having personally visited Su Jinjin’s home early in the morning to remind her.
"Jinjin, the importance of your date with Mr. Lin this time does not need repeating. You carry the family mission to reconcile with him." Old Madam Su said sternly.
Grandma’s words put considerable pressure on Su Jinjin.
Three days ago, an invitation from Mr. Lin rescued her from the nightmare of her family’s arranged marriage. Following Lin Fan’s suggestion, she eventually agreed to meet Mr. Lin.
Grandma decisively terminated the engagement with the Li Family, betting on Mr. Lin, hoping to gain benefits for the Su Family.
After all, for a super rich like Mr. Lin, just a flick of his fingers could resurrect the struggling Su Family or even elevate it from a second-rate to a first-rate family.
But Su Jinjin felt it wasn’t right; she doesn’t know Mr. Lin and was unwilling to exploit someone she barely knows, which troubled her.
"I understand, Grandma." Su Jinjin said, as she had no choice but to take it one step at a time now.
Old Madam Su expressed satisfaction, "Jinjin, good to see your understanding. The fate of the Su family rests on your shoulders; don’t let Grandma down. Also, it’s best not to have any further involvement with that Lin Fan, lest Mr. Lin gets upset, understand?"
"Oh." Su Jinjin said, feeling a bit guilty. She planned to have Lin Fan accompany her to Yunding Manor today; Grandma would probably be furious if she knew.
But she wouldn’t change her plan; she only trusts Lin Fan now, and only with him accompanying her could she feel at ease.
Old Madam Su sternly stated, "You must follow my instructions, break off contact with Lin Fan, lest Lin Fan messes up the big plan for the Su Family!"
Su Jinjin found it a bit ironic; in Grandma’s eyes, it’s only about the big plan for the Su Family!
She bleakly realized that Grandma continued to view her merely as a pawn, though the target transitioned from the Li Family to Mr. Lin.
She was unhappy being under Grandma’s control!
Everything would be decided after meeting Mr. Lin!

chapters.title: Chapter 63: It Must Be Staged
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: It Must Be Staged
Su Family Mansion.
The moment Madam Su returned home, she gathered all the members of the Su family for a meeting.
"I’ve already arranged for Jinjin to be sent to Yunding Manor. She’s about to meet Mr. Lin. If she can get Mr. Lin to support our family, then the Su family is saved," Madam Su said, her eyes full of anticipation.
"Grandma, forgive my bluntness, but I heard that Su Jinjin doesn’t even know Mr. Lin. Yet Mr. Lin is so high-profile about inviting her over. Who knows if it’s good or bad?" someone remarked.
Many members of the Su family nodded in agreement. They were envious that Mr. Lin had invited Su Jinjin over.
Madam Su smiled bitterly, "With the capabilities of this Mr. Lin, if he wanted to target our Su family, we’d be absolutely defenseless. So whether it’s good or bad, it’s not a decision for us to make. I can only place a bet; there’s no other choice."
Everyone fell silent.
Madam Su wasn’t wrong. Mr. Lin was probably a secret tycoon, the kind of person whose mere stomp could cause an earthquake.
In front of Mr. Lin, the entire Su family was like ants.
Because of this, Madam Su decisively annulled the engagement with the Li family, fearing they might accidentally offend Mr. Lin.
If Su Jinjin truly was the woman Mr. Lin favored, how could the Su family dare marry her off to someone else!
Madam Su sighed, "I hope Jinjin doesn’t disappoint me. Today could be the day that changes the Su family’s fate, whether we can resurrect or even transform, it all depends on today."
Someone sneered, "I doubt it. Others might not know, but Su Jinjin is too headstrong and reckless, otherwise she wouldn’t have run away from her wedding that night! Recently, she’s run into her ex-boyfriend Lin Fan again. Who knows if old feelings will rekindle? If she offends Mr. Lin because of Lin Fan, our Su family will suffer too."
Hearing this, the others’ faces changed. It seemed like something Su Jinjin might indeed do!
Madam Su said, "I’ve specifically reminded her not to associate with Lin Fan! On one side is a mega-rich; on the other, a poor delivery guy. As for how to choose, I believe Jinjin isn’t a fool!"
Only a fool would forsake a mega-rich to love a delivery guy!
"Lin Fan might not be just an ordinary delivery guy!"
A young descendant of the Su family suddenly spoke.
Everyone turned to him, looking skeptical.
Madam Su asked, "What do you mean by that?"
The young descendant said, "On the surface, Lin Fan is a delivery guy, but in reality, he’s a billionaire. The car he drives is a top-notch supercar, a Kosak. He spends lavishly, buying up the entire inventory of a luxury goods street just to spite a gold-digger!"
The Su family members looked at each other in disbelief.
"Kid, are you okay? What nonsense are you talking about?"
"Where did you hear such strange things?"
"This is hilarious, at least make sure it sounds credible!"
The young descendant said, "I’m not making it up. I saw it online. Lin Fan is trending online recently, with four hot searches in one night, and it hasn’t died down yet!"
He loves surfing the internet, constantly browsing Weibo and videos, knowing all the hot topics online.
The Su family members were stunned by his firm assertion. Could it be true? No way, Lin Fan a billionaire?
"I’ve heard of a delivery guy who bought up a street of luxury goods. Could it really be Lin Fan?"
"Impossible. If Lin Fan were a billionaire, we wouldn’t have broken up him and Su Jinjin back then."
"Exactly, you can’t trust things from the internet."
Madam Su looked at the young descendant, "You said it’s from the internet, let grandma see too?"
The young descendant took out his phone and showed Madam Su Lin Fan’s recently viral videos.
The members of the Su family also curiously took turns watching the videos.
After watching, everyone fell silent, or rather, they were enveloped in an indescribable shock.
They couldn’t accept this impact at once; it was simply too overwhelming.
Madam Su was silent for a moment, finally responding with a cold laugh.
"I don’t know where these videos came from, but I can assure you they’re fake! I thoroughly investigated Lin Fan’s background years ago. He couldn’t be a billionaire!" Madam Su laughed coldly.
The Su family members were relieved, feeling relaxed.
"I knew it, clearly staged, the acting was so fake!"
"So Lin Fan’s side gig is being a low-ranked actor, shooting low-class short videos to catch attention, how low can he go!"
"I think it’s just a marketing tactic by a delivery company!"
"What Kosak, it’s just a prop!"
"If Lin Fan’s a billionaire, I’ll screw my head off and make it a stool for him!"
The Su family members laughed recklessly.
The young descendant was confused, not knowing if what everyone said was right. Could those videos about Lin Fan really be staged?
Madam Su chuckled, "The truth is, someone like Lin Fan, a poor man, will never have his day. Even as an actor, he’s lackluster. Let’s not mention him anymore."
The Su family nodded in agreement.
A moment ago, someone said, "Not to mention Lin Fan, but isn’t it too risky to bet everything on Su Jinjin?"
Madam Su smiled, as if everything was under control, "The problem you’re concerned about, I’ve thought about it already and have a plan. If Mr. Lin truly can’t help us, we’ll have to save ourselves."
Someone asked, "How would we save ourselves?"
Madam Su said, "There’s a liquid soap company in the city, Blue Moon, currently expanding their factory. I’ve arranged for us to bid. If we can secure this large order, even without Mr. Lin, the Su family can still stand tall again!"
Blue Moon’s expansion requires a massive amount of building materials, and the Su family is in the construction material business.
Madam Su believed she had prepared two solutions; if just one succeeded, it would save the Su family.
What she didn’t know was that the big order she dreamed of, Blue Moon Company, belonged to Lin Fan.
At this moment, Lin Fan was driving a Kosak, with his sister Lin Shanshan, heading to Yunding Manor.
Lin Shanshan reluctantly said, "Brother, you’re accompanying Sister Jinjin to meet that Mr. Lin. Why did you have to bring me along? It’s so early, and I haven’t had enough sleep!"
Lin Fan replied, "Don’t you want to see Yunding Manor?"
Lin Shanshan pouted, "I’m not going to live there. No matter how beautiful it is, it has nothing to do with me, what’s there to see. I’d rather not look!"
Lin Fan chuckled and didn’t say much. He had a surprise prepared for Lin Shanshan today; speaking of it would ruin the surprise.
Shortly after, Lin Fan’s car arrived at the gate of Yunding Manor.
The gate was open, with two imposing security guards standing at the entrance, seemingly arranged by Anna.
Upon seeing Lin Fan’s Kosak, the two security guards showed a respectful expression and let the car enter.
Lin Fan drove straight in.
Lin Shanshan was stunned, "This Yunding Manor is so strange, why didn’t they stop us? Is this place open to outsiders?"
When the car entered the manor, the scene in front of her left Lin Shanshan amazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Taking My Sister to Tour the Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: Taking My Sister to Tour the Villa
Inside Yunding Manor, everything had been newly arranged, resembling a dreamlike castle, exceptionally grand and magnificent.
It all unmistakably screams of wealth!
In the garden, flowers were in full bloom, and the air was filled with their fragrance. The path to the mansion was laid with a red carpet, flanked by flowers, specially arranged to celebrate the move-in of the new residence.
It was Lin Shanshan’s first time seeing Yunding Manor, and she was stunned. Before coming in, she said there was nothing much to see, but now she was deeply captivated.
This place is truly luxurious.
Hmm, it really smells nice!
Although it wasn’t Lin Fan’s first time at Yunding Manor, this new arrangement was something he’d seen for the first time, and he was quite satisfied. It seems Anna, the housekeeper, is indeed capable. In just three days, she arranged the vast Yunding Manor so perfectly!
Lin Fan parked the Kosak in front of the mansion and got out of the car with Lin Shanshan.
They saw a stunning beauty with long black straight hair standing at the door, waiting for them.
Anna!
When Lin Shanshan saw Anna, she felt overpowered by her presence and instinctively a bit intimidated. She stuck close to Lin Fan, whispering, "Brother, what if we get into trouble for barging into Yunding Manor like this?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Don’t worry, we won’t."
Speaking, Lin Fan walked to the door.
Anna had a bit of a haughty nature, nodded at Lin Fan in greeting.
Lin Fan introduced, "This is my sister, Lin Shanshan, and she is the housekeeper here, Anna."
Anna glanced at Lin Shanshan and said nothing.
Lin Shanshan was a bit surprised, Lin Fan seemed familiar with this place, and even knew the housekeeper?
Lin Fan instructed, "It’s my sister’s first time here, take us around for a tour."
Anna turned around, opened the gate, and walked inside.
The inside had also been newly arranged, adding decorations. The lobby, while maintaining luxury, was full of warmth and comfort.
Lin Fan was very pleased, "Not bad."
Receiving Lin Fan’s praise, Anna’s face remained calm, but a trace of pride unconsciously flashed in her eyes.
She wanted to uncover Mr. Lin’s identity and to do that, she had to keep her position as housekeeper. Naturally, she wouldn’t let Lin Fan down. With her capability, this was a small feat.
Seeing the lobby’s arrangement, Lin Shanshan was already in love with it. The rich really have it good, this lobby alone is ten times the size of the apartment Lin Fan rents!
So spacious, luxurious, and comfortable, if only she could live here, Lin Shanshan was tempted.
Anna continued to show them around the rooms.
First, they arrived at the master bedroom.
The master bedroom was large, luxurious yet minimalistic, arranged to suit the taste and style of a young wealthy man. A comfy large bed seemed to possess a certain magic that could entice countless women to scramble onto it.
Opening the wardrobe, an exquisite glass cabinet housed dozens of Rolex watches neatly arranged!
Worth millions!
Lin Fan was satisfied with his room; Anna had high taste, and this arrangement perfectly suited his identity as the owner of Yunding Manor.
Lin Shanshan was already reverent, could this room be where the mysterious Mr. Lin lives!
"Brother, we should leave, what if Mr. Lin finds out we entered his room and blames us?" Lin Shanshan said, slightly scared.
Lin Fan said, "Okay, let’s check out another room."
Anna then led them to another room.
Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but ask, "Brother, can we really just wander around like this, what’s going on?"
Lin Fan said, "You’ll find out soon enough."
Soon, they arrived at another room.
As soon as the door opened, Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but scream, "Ah!"
A dreamy pink room, spacious and bright, filled with the aura of a young lady, yet exuding the elegance of a wealthy daughter!
It seemed like a place where a princess would reside!
A huge wardrobe, filled with luxury shoes, clothes, bags, and perfumes!
Hermès, L.V., Dior...
This is simply the wardrobe every woman dreams of, seeing such a wardrobe any woman would scream in delight.
The items in this wardrobe, just one bag starts at ten thousand, and there are dozens of such bags inside, all unique!
Lin Shanshan loved this room to death, it was exactly arranged according to her imagination, a room she dreamed of living in.
Lin Fan asked, "Do you like it?"
Lin Shanshan instinctively said, "I like it, this room is too good, bro, if I had a room like this, I’d laugh in my sleep, when you buy a house, I want it arranged like this too!"
Thinking that her brother would not likely buy a house as spacious as this, and certainly not replicate such a luxurious wardrobe, Lin Shanshan felt a bit downcast.
Lin Fan smiled, "Since you like it, from now on, this room is yours."
What?
Lin Shanshan was startled, thinking she misheard, "Bro, what did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "Didn’t you tell me the other day you wanted a room like this? This room was specially arranged as you described. From now on, it’s yours."
This was the surprise he prepared for his sister.
Lin Shanshan was shocked, "Bro, what does this mean, this room is for me?"
Wait a minute, isn’t this Yunding Manor?
The owner of Yunding Manor is Mr. Lin, right!
She didn’t know that Mr. Lin, so why would he give her a room?
Hold on, something’s off!
After a brief mental short-circuit, Lin Shanshan finally understood, blurting out in surprise, "Bro, you... you couldn’t be the owner of Yunding Manor, Mr. Lin is you?"
Lin Shanshan’s voice was already trembling.
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right, I am Mr. Lin, I bought Yunding Manor."
Lin Shanshan was stunned, her eyes wide open.
Her brother is the mysterious buyer, Mr. Lin?
Who spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor, 6 billion to buy an island, widely talked about and revered, Mr. Lin!
How could she have ever imagined it!
That day her brother told her he would soon buy a house, she thought it was just an ordinary commercial house, who knew it would be Yunding Manor!
No wonder, they moved through Yunding Manor without barriers, and the housekeeper of Yunding Manor personally greeted them, except for being the owner of the Manor, who else could receive such treatment, she should have thought of it earlier!
She just dared not imagine, that’s all.
Next to them, Anna, seeing Lin Fan admit to Lin Shanshan that he is Mr. Lin, sneered inwardly, Lin Fan was lying, there was someone else who was actually Mr. Lin, Lin Fan was just a front.
Of course, as the front for the mysterious Mr. Lin, Lin Fan had full authority over Yunding Manor, that was indeed true.
At this moment, Anna received a call, it was from the estate security guard.
After putting down the phone, Anna said to Lin Fan, "Mr. Lin, your guest Su Jinjin has arrived."

chapters.title: Chapter 65: I Am Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65: I Am Mr. Lin
A black sedan stopped outside the gates of Yunding Manor. Su Jinjin got out of the car, looking up at the gates, her expression a bit nervous.
She was about to enter the legendary Yunding Manor and meet the mysterious Mr. Lin soon. Who knows what might happen?
After she identified herself to the security guard, he made a phone call, then told her the butler was on their way to escort her.
Su Jinjin became even more nervous. She took out her phone and called Lin Fan: "Lin Fan, I’m at Yunding Manor now, where are you?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m inside the manor, you can come in."
Su Jinjin was taken aback; Lin Fan was already inside the manor?
"How did you manage to get in?" Su Jinjin asked in surprise.
Lin Fan replied, "I said I was your friend, and they let me in."
Su Jinjin let out a sound of acknowledgment. She couldn’t help thinking about her own influence—Mr. Lin was giving her quite a lot of face.
Su Jinjin asked, "Are you with Mr. Lin now?"
Lin Fan said, "You could say that."
At this moment, a stunning woman with long black hair stepped out and came directly to Su Jinjin: "I am Anna, the butler of Yunding Manor. Are you Miss Su Jinjin?"
Su Jinjin put down her phone and quickly replied, "Yes."
She was secretly amazed; this was the butler of Yunding Manor! Recently, the recruitment of a butler for Yunding Manor was the talk of Yun City, attracting countless applicants, yet no news came about who was chosen.
It turns out it was this stunning woman with long black hair!
Mr. Lin really knew how to pick people. Even Su Jinjin, a wealthy young lady, felt overshadowed by this woman.
Anna said, "Mr. Lin is waiting for you inside, please follow me."
Saying that, Anna turned and walked away.
Su Jinjin hurried to follow, entering Yunding Manor alongside Anna.
Finally, she saw the much-renowned Yunding Manor!
Su Jinjin was immediately captivated by the luxurious manor before her. Every plant and tree screamed "wealth." This was clearly a place only a super-rich person could afford—a grandeur beyond anything she had ever seen.
Born into the Su Family, Su Jinjin had been brought up in luxury and had seen her share of the world, but Yunding Manor gave her the feeling of a country bumpkin visiting a city for the first time.
Indeed, the world of the super-rich was beyond her experience; her family was merely a second-tier family and nowhere near the orbit of the ultra-wealthy.
As Su Jinjin entered the manor,
At the Su Family Mansion, Madam Su received a call from the driver: "Madam, the third miss has entered Yunding Manor."
Everyone in the Su Family perked up immediately.
Madam Su’s eyes were filled with anticipation, hoping Su Jinjin could bring her good news.
Meanwhile, Anna led Su Jinjin to the front of the mansion.
Su Jinjin immediately spotted the parked Kosak at the entrance.
She couldn’t help but marvel. As far as she knew, this supercar was worth tens of millions. It must be Mr. Lin’s. Only he could afford such an extravagant car.
When Anna reached the door, she stopped and said, "Mr. Lin is waiting for you in the hall."
Su Jinjin replied, "Okay, thank you."
She was somewhat nervous and took a deep breath to calm down, but it was only thinking about Lin Fan inside that steadied her a bit.
Then, Su Jinjin walked in.
In the splendidly decorated hall, a person was sitting on the couch with their back to her. Su Jinjin could only see their silhouette.
Just this silhouette exuded an aura of authority, radiating the majesty of a king.
This must be the halo of the super-rich.
This must be Mr. Lin.
Su Jinjin became nervous again.
She stood still.
Cautiously, Su Jinjin said, "Mr. Lin... I am Su Jinjin, you invited me over, and I’ve come."
She felt a bit helpless. Lin Fan said he was with Mr. Lin, but she couldn’t see him. If Lin Fan were here, she wouldn’t be this nervous.
Upon hearing Su Jinjin’s words, the person sitting on the couch stood up, turned around to face her, and smiled: "Jinjin, you’re here."
Su Jinjin was stunned.
Lin Fan!
She mistook Lin Fan’s silhouette to be Mr. Lin’s, but it was Lin Fan!
Su Jinjin broke into a cold sweat. This was quite a blunder. What happened? How could she not recognize Lin Fan?
It must have been because she was too nervous, seeing the silhouette and assuming it was Mr. Lin, which made her feel he had a commanding presence.
Yet, with a single turn, came the smiling face of Lin Fan, and the illusion of the super-rich aura vanished instantly.
"Lin Fan!" Su Jinjin wiped her cold sweat, let out a sigh of relief, and smiled, "It’s you! I thought you were Mr. Lin, I was so nervous. By the way, why are you alone here? Where is Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Why don’t you come and sit down first?"
Su Jinjin then walked over to the couch opposite Lin Fan. This set of couches was a high-end brand from Italy, so comfortable that once you sat down, you wouldn’t want to get up. Indeed, this was the hallmark of the super-rich, even a couch was so impressive.
Curious, Su Jinjin asked softly, "Lin Fan, you must have met Mr. Lin by now. What is he like?"
Lin Fan said, "You know very well what Mr. Lin looks like because you’re looking at him right now."
Su Jinjin was puzzled: "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and pointed to himself: "I am Mr. Lin."
What?
Lin Fan is Mr. Lin?
Su Jinjin was dumbfounded.
Then,
Su Jinjin couldn’t help but laugh, her laughter shaking her body. It took her a while to stop.
"Lin Fan, thanks for the joke. It worked; I’m not that nervous anymore," Su Jinjin said.
She thought Lin Fan was trying to make her laugh so she wouldn’t be nervous.
Lin Fan asked, "You don’t believe I’m Mr. Lin?"
Su Jinjin laughed, "Of course I believe. Your surname is Lin too, so you can certainly be called Mr. Lin, but this Mr. Lin isn’t that Mr. Lin."
This was precisely the punchline of Lin Fan’s joke.
At this moment, Anna personally came with a tea set, placing it on the coffee table. Anna poured two cups of brewed tea.
She handed one cup to Su Jinjin: "Miss Su, please have some tea."
The other cup was brought to Lin Fan: "Master, please have some tea."
Su Jinjin almost spat out the tea she was about to drink, astonished as she looked at Anna: "What did you call him?"
Anna calmly said, "Master."
Su Jinjin asked inquisitively, "Why do you call him Master?"
Anna glanced at Su Jinjin as if she were foolish and said, "He is the master of Yunding Manor, and I’m the butler of Yunding Manor. Naturally, I call him Master."
Su Jinjin was stunned. Lin Fan was the master of Yunding Manor?
If this were not Yunding Manor, and if Anna were not the manor’s butler, Su Jinjin would surely think they were playing a joke on her.
But she couldn’t fathom why Lin Fan and Anna would deceive her.
That could only mean it was true!
Just then, Lin Shanshan strolled out, saw Su Jinjin, and smiled: "Sister Jinjin, you’re here! Did you know? My brother is Mr. Lin, and this place belongs to him!"
Seeing Lin Shanshan, Su Jinjin had no more doubts. If Lin Fan wasn’t the owner here, how could Lin Shanshan be wandering around inside so freely?
Oh my god, Lin Fan was indeed the mysterious Mr. Lin!

chapters.title: Chapter 66 Lin Beixuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66 Lin Beixuan
Lin Shanshan dragged the bewildered Su Jinjin to her room.
"Sister Jinjin, look, this is my room!" Lin Shanshan said proudly.
She wasn’t trying to show off to Su Jinjin but was eager to share her happiness; this was a huge surprise for her.
Looking at the dreamlike room in front of her, Su Jinjin felt as if she were in a dream. She couldn’t understand how all of this could be real.
Could Lin Fan really be the master of Yunding Manor, the super-rich Mr. Lin?
Mr. Lin’s invitation had saved her from an arranged marriage, and she had always thought it was a coincidence. Now she finally understood that it was a deliberate arrangement!
But she didn’t even know Mr. Lin. Why would he help her?
Because Mr. Lin is Lin Fan!
Only then does it make sense.
Su Jinjin returned to the hall, filled with questions for Lin Fan: "Lin Fan, what exactly is your identity? You’re not a child from a poor family, are you? Did you lie to me before?"
Lin Fan hurriedly said, "I didn’t lie to you. I was indeed very poor before. When we were dating, I couldn’t even afford to take you to a restaurant; you know that."
Su Jinjin asked, "Then when did you become so wealthy?"
This question also intrigued Lin Shanshan and Anna, who both looked at Lin Fan, waiting for his answer.
Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t honestly tell them that he became a billionaire overnight thanks to a system. He never planned to reveal the system’s existence to anyone; the secret was too astonishing.
Lin Fan hadn’t seriously thought about how to answer Su Jinjin’s question. Telling the truth was an indiscretion, and lying wasn’t easy either.
Lin Fan thought quickly and casually made up a story: "Ahem, well, this question is both complicated and simple..."
The three women were puzzled. What does that mean?
Lin Fan awkwardly scratched his nose: "It’s like this. One day, I met an uncle I hadn’t seen in years. He’s a hidden billionaire, and when he parted, seeing that I was poor, he casually gave me some pocket money, saying it’s not much, so I should spend it sparingly. I glanced at the balance—it’s indeed not much, just 30 billion..."
What?
The three women broke out in a cold sweat.
Oh God!
Someone casually gave 30 billion as pocket money, and it’s not much! How rich must this uncle be?
Lin Shanshan exclaimed, "Brother, we have a long-lost uncle? How come I never knew?"
Lin Fan replied, "Indeed, you just didn’t know. You can ask Mom and Dad; they’ll tell you."
Lin Shanshan: "Okay... So what’s our uncle’s name?"
Lin Fan casually replied, "Lin Beixuan."
Lin Beixuan!
This name was something Lin Fan made up on the spot. This uncle was fictional, a nonexistent person.
But even Lin Fan couldn’t foresee that his casually made-up Lin Beixuan would one day stir up great waves in the business world!
Anna was the first to have thoughts.
This Lin Beixuan must be the real Mr. Lin!
This thought excited Anna internally. She had been ordered to investigate Mr. Lin’s identity, and now she finally had a breakthrough.
Lin Fan was indeed just a front; there was actually another person behind Mr. Lin!
Lin Beixuan!
Who in the world could he be, hiding behind the scenes while pushing Lin Fan to the forefront, and recently spending lavishly? What could be his purpose?
Su Jinjin said at the moment, "So that’s it, Lin Fan. Why didn’t you tell me earlier?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "If I revealed my identity too early, I wouldn’t have been able to intimidate the Su Family."
Su Jinjin thought for a moment, nodded unconsciously, and agreed. Grandma would never believe Lin Fan was Mr. Lin; in her eyes, Lin Fan was just a poor boy.
Only the mysterious and affluent Mr. Lin could intimidate the Su Family!
Lin Fan noticed that the three women seemed to believe him and felt pleased. Pretending to be mysterious, he added, "Yes, about my uncle Lin Beixuan, he is a low-key person, so there’s no need to tell others. Just keep it to ourselves."
The three women nodded in agreement.
However, Anna felt a bit anxious, eager to report to Feng Wanshan.
Lin Fan said, "Shanshan, Anna, please step aside for a moment. I have some words I’d like to say to Jinjin alone."
Lin Shanshan and Anna exited the room.
Lin Fan sat down and said, "Jinjin, I’m sorry for telling you the truth only now; these past few days must have worried you."
Su Jinjin had indeed been uneasy these days, not knowing what would happen when meeting Mr. Lin.
She never dreamed it would turn out like this.
"It’s okay. You were only trying to help me, Lin Fan. Thank you," Su Jinjin said sincerely. Without Lin Fan, she definitely wouldn’t have escaped the arranged marriage, and even if she did, the Su and Li Families would’ve never let her go.
Lin Fan said, "Between us, there’s no need for thanks. A thank you feels too distant."
"Sorry..."
Su Jinjin blushed. Indeed, back then, she and Lin Fan were inseparable lovers, but now they were no longer so, and the distance between them seemed to form naturally.
She hated this distance, but it was impossible to interact with Lin Fan the way she did three years ago.
Unless they started over.
Lin Fan said, "Back then, I was incapable and couldn’t keep you, could only watch the Su Family take you away. Now, I can finally protect you, keep you from being bullied!"
Hearing this, Su Jinjin’s heart filled with mixed emotions, her eyes turning red: "Fan..."
Lin Fan reached out, took Su Jinjin’s soft hand, and smiled: "I know we both need time, but as your boyfriend back then, I should have protected you but failed."
Su Jinjin could no longer hold back and fell into Lin Fan’s arms, hugging him tightly, tears flowing freely and soaking his chest.
"I know you did your best to protect me. I’ve never blamed you..." Su Jinjin said.
Lin Fan said, "But three years ago, it was ultimately a regret. Let me make up for that regret, okay?"
In his embrace, Su Jinjin nodded: "Yes!"
Lin Fan smiled and wrapped his arms around her as well.
Su Jinjin felt that Lin Fan’s chest was much broader than it was three years ago, much more secure, and all the grievances she suffered over these years disappeared in that embrace.
How she wished she could stay like this forever, lying in Lin Fan’s arms...
Lin Fan said, "If I’m not mistaken, Madam Su must have great expectations for your meeting with me. What does she want from me?"
Lin Fan’s words were right on the mark.
Su Jinjin said, "She wants the Su Family to rise again."
Lin Fan smiled slightly.
Learning that "Mr. Lin" invited Su Jinjin over, Madam Su decisively canceled the engagement with the Li Family, merely trying to please "Mr. Lin." Her real purpose, for the most part, is for the Su Family.
So it is!
Su Jinjin said, "Lin Fan, you don’t need to pay attention to Grandma. The Su Family is already on the brink of death, and hoping for a revival is just wishful thinking!"
Lin Fan, somewhat thoughtful, said blandly, "I understand."
Madam Su’s longing wasn’t a mere pipe dream. To save a dying second-rate family would be nothing more than a flick of a finger for Lin Fan’s current ability!

chapters.title: Chapter 67: New Reward, The Most Difficult Land Parcel to Obtain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: New Reward, The Most Difficult Land Parcel to Obtain!
Today marks the move into the new residence at Yunding Manor. There are no esteemed guests, no festive hustle and bustle, just Lin Shanshan and Su Jinjin accompanying Lin Fan for a simple meal.
Yet this simple meal has garnered the whole city’s attention, becoming one of Yun City’s hottest topics today. People are gossiping about the relationship between Mr. Lin and Su Jinjin, but no one knows the answer.
After the meal, Su Jinjin left Yunding Manor.
She had already met "Mr. Lin."
However, she didn’t expect Mr. Lin to be Lin Fan, nor did she know how to explain this to her grandmother once she got back.
After Su Jinjin left, Lin Fan asked Lin Shanshan, "I’ll temporarily keep the apartment in the city. Do you want to return there with me or stay here?"
Lin Shanshan didn’t hesitate: "Do you really need to ask? I’m staying here! Brother, you shouldn’t go back either. Why choose to stay in a rundown apartment when you have Yunding Manor?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s more convenient to have an apartment in the city since I work there."
Lin Shanshan couldn’t understand her brother. Why couldn’t he just be a proper rich person? Even with so much money, he still hasn’t quit his delivery job!
She didn’t know that Lin Fan’s job was not just being a delivery person; he was also the owner and major shareholder of several companies.
"Brother, I’m not going to bother with you anymore. I’m going back to my room." Lin Shanshan said and rushed eagerly back to her room.
"Ding!"
Suddenly, Lin Fan heard the sound of the system notification.
"Reminder for the host, today you can check in. Checking in will give you a plot of land. Do you want to check in now?"
Lin Fan was taken aback. Another land reward today?
The last time the system awarded him land, it was Chiba Island valued at 6 billion. I wonder what kind of land he’ll get this time?
"Check in!" Lin Fan thought to himself.
"Congratulations to the host for successfully checking in. You are awarded a 70,000 square meters plot of land at the Shendiao Old Factory in the western suburbs of Yun City. The reward has been delivered, please check it."
Lin Fan was stunned, 70,000 square meters of land!
This system really has a generous hand.
Shendiao laundry detergent, Lin Fan knows, was once one of Huaxia’s top-ranking daily chemical companies. Its entry into Yun City caused a sensation back in the day and provided many jobs for the people of Yun City.
Later, due to failed investments, the once-grand factory went bankrupt overnight, the premises were abandoned, and it became a wasteland!
No one would have thought that this piece of land would someday fall into Lin Fan’s hands, not even Lin Fan himself.
"Ring, ring, ring..."
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang. It was a call from Zhang Dafu.
"Boss, I sent you some candidate plots of land last night. Have you made a decision?" Zhang Dafu asked.
Blue Moon wants to expand the factory, and many land sellers approached Zhang Dafu. He couldn’t make the decision on his own, so he informed Lin Fan about a few promising plots last night for Lin Fan to choose from.
Lin Fan said, "I’ve seen what you sent, but they’re not very good."
Zhang Dafu was a bit troubled: "Boss, we’re in the hand sanitizer business, and there are many restrictions on site selection. It’s really hard to choose a good site, and these plots have already been carefully selected. If they don’t work, I don’t know where else to find one at the moment."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’ve already picked a plot of land."
Zhang Dafu was surprised. The boss has already picked a plot?
Zhang Dafu quickly asked, "Boss, where is it?"
Lin Fan said, "What do you think of the Shendiao Old Factory?"
Zhang Dafu was stunned for a moment and then smiled wryly, "Of course, that’s great, it’s simply the most ideal site. But we can’t get that piece of land. After Shendiao Company exited Yun City, it became government-planned land. You can’t buy it even if you have money, so many people covet it, but no one succeeds. It’s considered the hardest land to acquire in Yun City!"
Lin Fan said, "No need to buy, I already have that land."
"What?"
Zhang Dafu jumped three feet high in shock.
The boss actually acquired the Shendiao Old Factory land?
How could this be possible?
But the boss told him personally, it can’t be a joke, so it must be true!
This shocks his entire family!
"Boss, you really acquired the legendary hardest-to-get Shendiao Old Factory land?" Zhang Dafu’s voice was trembling.
Lin Fan said calmly, "Yes, the land issue is resolved, you can proceed with the next steps."
Zhang Dafu directly knelt down.
He worshipped!
The boss is simply incredible. Is there anything the boss cannot do?
What extraordinary means, following such a godly rich boss as Lin Fan, is exhilarating!
Zhang Dafu felt a little light-headed.
Meanwhile.
In a secluded corner of Yunding Manor.
Anna made a call to Feng Wanshan, "Godfather."
Feng Wanshan was sitting in his office, having a meeting with some company key figures. Upon receiving Anna’s call, he waved for the figures to leave.
Feng Wanshan asked, "Today Mr. Lin was to meet the Su Family’s third young lady, and now you’re calling, surely there’s some development, right? Did you meet Mr. Lin?"
Anna said, "No, but I already know who Mr. Lin is, and your guess was right, Mr. Lin indeed has another identity."
Feng Wanshan quickly said, "Who is he?"
Anna said, "This Mr. Lin is called Lin Beixuan."
"Lin Beixuan?" Feng Wanshan strained his memory, confirming it was his first time hearing this name, "How do you know it’s this Lin Beixuan?"
Anna explained how Lin Fan mentioned his long-lost uncle. Although Lin Fan did not explicitly say, it was not hard to deduce that Lin Beixuan was the mysterious Mr. Lin behind Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan slapped his thigh, laughing, "Good! It was wise to place you in Yunding Manor! However, I have absolutely no impression of this Lin Beixuan. Continue staying at Yunding Manor and see if you can dig up more information!"
Anna calmly said, "Okay."
Feng Wanshan inquired, "Has Lin Fan had any recent movements?"
Anna said, "No, he invited the Su Family’s third young lady today, but nothing special happened."
Feng Wanshan said, "Keep a close watch on him!"
Anna acknowledged softly and hung up the call.
After finishing the call with Anna, Feng Wanshan called the key figures back in.
"Yun City will develop rapidly in the future. Though we’ve suffered a setback in the Daya Bay island purchase, with Chiba Island being snatched away, we can’t let this stop us. We must still acquire good lands besides continuing in Daya Bay!" Feng Wanshan stated.
The key figures nodded in agreement.
Feng Wanshan said, "Recently, I’ve set my sights on the Shendiao Old Factory land. I had people sent to negotiate purchasing it. Though it’s notoriously difficult, with Shengshi Group’s reputation, acquiring it shouldn’t be a big problem."
Feng Wanshan was saying quite proudly.
Suddenly, a key figure raised his head, looking a bit oddly at Feng Wanshan, "Sir, haven’t you heard? The Shendiao Old Factory land has already been taken."
"What?"
Feng Wanshan, emotionally agitated, leaped from his seat, "Who took it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Great Minds Think Alike
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: Great Minds Think Alike
Bureau of Land and Resources, Director’s Office.
"What did you say? The land of Shendiao Old Factory has already been sold?"
Director Ma stood up abruptly, speaking in shock.
In his impression, he had not approved the sale of the Shendiao Old Factory land. This plot of land had been included in the city government’s planning land and had no plans for sale at the moment. Although many enterprises were eyeing this piece of land, no one had ever succeeded in acquiring it.
The person responsible for handling the land of Shendiao Old Factory was Director Ma’s capable deputy, Director Wan.
Director Wan was a bit apprehensive: "Director, do you not remember? It was you who personally approved it. Without your permission, how could I handle this matter? Look, your approval signature is on this land application."
Director Wan handed the land application document to Director Ma for review.
Director Ma took a look at it, and it was indeed his signature!
This signature was impossible to forge, and no one would dare to forge his signature.
"When did I sign this?" Director Ma asked in surprise.
Director Wan wiped the cold sweat from his brow: "Just last night at the dinner, someone handed you this application. After you heard about it, you praised the person and signed your name, agreeing to the sale of the Shendiao Old Factory land."
Director Ma was utterly taken aback; could it be that he drank too much last night and had no memory at all?
"Who was that person?" Director Ma asked.
Director Wan was drenched in cold sweat: "I’m sorry, Director, I was a bit drunk last night and can’t seem to recall who that person was."
Director Ma was utterly at a loss, damn it, seriously forgot?
Director Ma’s mind raced. He said, "Let’s leave the person aside for now. The Shendiao Old Factory land must not be sold to any enterprise. Who exactly is the buyer?"
Director Wan was about to speak when the phone in the director’s office rang.
Director Ma answered the phone and his expression changed: "Mayor!"
It was the mayor personally calling!
Director Ma felt uneasy, had the mayor already learned that he had sold the Shendiao Old Factory land? Was the mayor calling to hold him accountable?
The mayor said: "Old Ma, you did well this time. The Blue Moon Company is great! I personally am optimistic about this company. I was planning on having you give the Shendiao Old Factory land to Blue Moon for factory expansion, but you beat me to it. It seems great minds think alike!"
The mayor started by praising Director Ma.
Directly leaving Director Ma in a stupor from the praise.
What? The mayor didn’t come to blame him but praised him instead?
Naturally, he played along, awkwardly smiling: "Thank you, Director, it was my duty."
After hanging up the mayor’s call, Director Ma let out a long sigh of relief.
He then looked up at Director Wan, who was equally stunned: "Blue Moon Company? What’s their background?"
Director Wan said: "This is a local hand sanitizer brand company. I heard they launched a new hand sanitizer at a product conference yesterday, garnering huge success and raking in orders worth 450 million. So, they planned on expanding their factory, and perhaps this order volume was so astonishing that it even caught the attention of the city bureau."
Director Ma couldn’t help but exclaim: "Truly impressive!"
Director Wan said: "And that’s not all. I heard Blue Moon was on the verge of collapse, but this new product brought it back to life, showing signs of a meteoric rise. No wonder even the mayor is paying attention."
Director Ma asked curiously: "Who is the owner of this Blue Moon?"
Director Wan said: "The person is named Lin Fan, only 21 years old this year. He recently bought Blue Moon outright with 100 million in cash. I also heard that Lin Fan has an voracious appetite, buying several companies at once, both outright and with stakes. If the information is correct, he should be that famous Mr. Lin currently making the rounds."
Director Ma gasped: "Mr. Lin? You mean to say that the mysterious buyer, Mr. Lin, is actually just a 21-year-old young man?"
Director Wan said: "Though it seems unbelievable, it appears to be true. Yesterday, Lin Fan even announced the formation of a group company, indicating that Blue Moon is just the beginning, and there will be more to come."
Director Ma couldn’t help but sigh: "This world is just too crazy!"
At 21, he lavishly spends 3 billion to buy a mansion, 6 billion to buy an island, and now madly buys companies. This is indeed astonishing!
Director Ma finally calmed down and instructed: "This time we unintentionally did the right thing by giving the Shendiao Old Factory land to Mr. Lin. Now it has received the mayor’s approval. You must handle this properly. Do not slight this Mr. Lin. With my experience, this young man’s future is incalculable!"
Director Wan solemnly said: "Yes, Director, rest assured, I will handle it properly!"
Director Wan then exited the director’s office.
Suddenly, Director Wan was stopped by a colleague, who smiled awkwardly: "Brother Wan, I heard the land of Shendiao Old Factory has been sold, what’s going on?"
Director Wan said indifferently: "Yes, Old Li, I know you are old classmates with Shengshi Group’s boss Feng Wanshan. Is he trying to use your connection to acquire the Shendiao Old Factory land? No need to bother, the sale of this land has already received the mayor’s approval. Shengshi Group has no chance."
Old Li was taken aback, surprised that it received the mayor’s approval. Who really has such capability?
"Brother Wan, can you disclose who exactly this land was assigned to?" Old Li began to inquire...
Shengshi Group.
Feng Wanshan jumped up upon receiving Old Li’s call, filled with emotion.
"What? The one who got the Shendiao Old Factory land is Lin Fan, the owner of Blue Moon Company?"
Old Li said: "That’s right, Director Wan personally revealed it to me. This news will soon go public, it can’t be wrong. I also heard Lin Fan is that mysterious buyer, Mr. Lin. This time I can’t help you."
Feng Wanshan sneered: "Lin Fan is not Mr. Lin at all!"
Old Li asked curiously: "Old Feng, what are you saying?"
Feng Wanshan said: "Nothing, no matter what, thank you for the effort, I’ll treat you to a meal someday."
After hanging up the phone, Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth.
Damn it!
Seriously damn it!
It’s Lin Fan again!
This is the third time!
He wanted to buy Yunding Manor, and Lin Fan snatched it. He wanted to buy Chiba Island, and Lin Fan snagged it again. Now even the land of Shendiao Old Factory, Lin Fan grabbed it!
Feng Wanshan was furious, absolutely furious.
Of course, Lin Fan was just a pawn, the real opponent was Mr. Lin.
Lin Beixuan!
"Lin Beixuan, no matter how well you hide, I will definitely find you, just you wait, I refuse to believe that I, Feng Wanshan, can’t beat you!" muttered Feng Wanshan irritably to himself.
Lin Fan, unaware of any of this.
Anyway, the system rewarded him with a piece of land. No matter how complex the process was behind it, the system would handle it properly.
This is the strength of the system, he doesn’t even have to worry about the rewarded matters, just claim the rewards.
The system is so powerful that it could even blur people’s memories. Director Ma and Director Wan can’t remember who handed in the land application, yet the procedures are complete, with no issues at all!
As usual, Lin Fan only needs to wait for the Land Bureau to contact him for the land transfer.
With the land for the factory secured, next he could proceed with building the factory.
Lin Fan entrusted all this work to Zhang Dafu.
Lin Fan said over the phone: "Da Fu, it’ll be hard on you for a while, but don’t worry, I won’t let you suffer."
Zhang Dafu was very pleased, he knew the boss wouldn’t deceive him. Other bosses couldn’t be trusted, but Lin Fan, a wealthy genius, definitely wouldn’t.
If he said he wouldn’t let him suffer, he wouldn’t let him suffer.
"Following the boss means having a good meal!"
This has become Zhang Dafu’s motto.
"Rest assured, boss, I will do my utmost!" Zhang Dafu said excitedly.
Lin Fan smiled: "Great. By the way, in the documents you gave me last night, I noticed many building material suppliers have bid. What do you think?"
Zhang Dafu was taken aback, why was the boss paying particular attention to construction materials?
Zhang Dafu said: "Indeed there are many, including the city’s leading building materials company, Dawei Company. If the price is reasonable, I would suggest cooperating with Dawei for its guaranteed reputation."
Lin Fan, however, said: "No, I choose Su’s Building Materials Company."
Zhang Dafu thought he heard wrong, it couldn’t be, Su’s Building Materials Company, they indeed bid, but he had rejected them, thinking their strength was inadequate.
Why did the boss specifically choose them?
But this was Lin Fan’s decision, Zhang Dafu wouldn’t dare oppose it. Lin Fan must have his reasons for doing so, and Zhang Dafu, being a smart man, knew not to ask what he shouldn’t.
"Alright boss, then let’s award the contract to Su’s," Zhang Dafu immediately replied.
Lin Fan put down the phone, smiling faintly.
Madam Su of the Su Family asked Su Jinjin to meet him, hoping for the Su Family to rise. So, he would simply raise a hand and give them an opportunity.
Of course, he did this all for Su Jinjin.
From now on, he wanted everyone in the Su Family to look up to Su Jinjin.
The Su Family was abuzz with a swift, unexpected news that spread rapidly through the family.
Su’s Building Materials Company of the Su Family actually secured a substantial contract from Blue Moon!

chapters.title: Chapter 69: A Condition
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: A Condition
Su’s Building Materials Company has secured a major order from Blue Moon, becoming the sole supplier of building materials for Blue Moon’s factory construction project!
As soon as the news broke, the entire Su Family was in an uproar.
Madam Su was almost unable to sit still, had it not been for her frail old bones, she would have gotten up and danced.
This major order from Blue Moon was practically a lifeline for the Su Family!
With this lifeline, even if the Su Family couldn’t rise again, it could at least catch its breath.
But that wasn’t explosive enough!
The news that followed really set the Su Family ablaze.
The Blue Moon Company successfully acquired the land of the Shendiao Old Factory, which spans 70,000 square meters, and Blue Moon’s new factory will rise there.
"Oh my god! Blue Moon’s new factory covers 70,000 square meters!"
"It’s going to be massive. If this factory is built, it will be the largest in Yun City!"
"How much building material would that need!"
"The Su Family has secured this order; it’s not just about catching their breath, it’s on the way to the top!"
"The Su Family is about to rise!"
The entire Su Family turned into a scene of popping popcorn; everyone was bursting with excitement.
Each one was incredibly excited.
Madam Su was so thrilled that she almost fainted. Su’s Building Materials is something she and the late Elder Su built from nothing, and she witnessed its whole journey from emergence to prosperity, and from prosperity to decline.
And this time, it’s very likely that she will witness Su’s Building Materials rise from decline and reach an unprecedented peak!
The mere thought of this prospect made Madam Su extremely excited.
"Originally, I didn’t have much hope for this order. After all, even Dawei Company was bidding, and our chances were very low. I never thought we’d be the only ones to win!" Madam Su said, with a hint of pride in her voice.
The Su Family members immediately began to praise her.
"Madam is truly wise, being the founder of the Su family; her vision is miles above ours!"
"Without Grandma putting herself out there and bidding, we wouldn’t have today’s success!"
"We won the bid this time because Blue Moon must have taken Madam’s reputation into account!"
"Of course, Madam is a legendary figure in the building materials industry!"
"The older, the wiser; we should kneel to Madam!"
The praise from everyone was as flattering as it could be.
But Madam Su listened with satisfaction. She indeed felt that this was the wisest decision she made in her life, apart from founding Su’s.
This decision directly saved the ailing Su Family.
Even at her age, Madam Su remained the indispensable backbone of the Su Family!
As for why the Blue Moon Company would choose Su’s over an industry leader like Dawei Company, Madam Su didn’t think much about it.
Perhaps, just as her family said, Blue Moon was giving face to her, Madam Su!
"Madam, with this order from Blue Moon, our family’s rise is in sight, and it seems we no longer need Mr. Lin!"
Someone suddenly said.
As soon as this was said, everyone’s attention turned in that direction.
Those who were envious of Su Jinjin being invited by Mr. Lin seemed to have finally found an outlet.
"That’s right, even if Mr. Lin doesn’t help our family, we have the capital to rise. Mr. Lin is no longer important!"
"It was always a long shot, and I think Su Jinjin’s trip was in vain!"
"I never counted on Su Jinjin from the start."
But Madam Su said: "No, it can’t be said that way. Mr. Lin is an extraordinary man. If Jinjin can form a good rapport with him, it would surely benefit our family. Even if she can’t, we absolutely cannot offend him. Though, you all are right in one thing; with this order from Blue Moon, Mr. Lin is indeed less crucial to us."
Hearing Madam Su’s words, those who were jealous of Su Jinjin were secretly pleased.
Madam herself said that Mr. Lin was no longer so important, meaning Su Jinjin wasn’t that important either.
This balanced their minds quite a bit.
At this time, Su Jinjin walked into the Su Family Mansion. She had returned from Yunding Manor!
If this had been before the Su Family received the major order from Blue Moon, everyone in the Su Family would have been tense and anxious about the outcome of Su Jinjin’s meeting with Mr. Lin.
But now, many people appeared indifferent, and some even disdained to glance at Su Jinjin.
"Grandma, I’m back."
Su Jinjin walked into the house and said, still troubled about how to explain things to everyone.
Madam Su relaxedly responded, "Oh, you’re back. Did you meet Mr. Lin?"
Su Jinjin replied, "I did, well..."
But Madam Su interrupted her, "You didn’t offend Mr. Lin, did you?"
That was her biggest concern.
Su Jinjin frowned, "No, Grandma, actually..."
Madam Su assuredly said, "As long as you didn’t offend him! So, did you ask Mr. Lin for help with our family? What did he say?"
Su Jinjin said, "He said... he understood."
Indeed, Lin Fan only said those three words. Whether Lin Fan would help the Su Family, she didn’t know, especially since she also told Lin Fan not to bother with the Su Family.
Upon hearing this, the Su Family members immediately showed disdain.
"It’s over. Mr. Lin clearly perfunctorily responded to her!"
"Exactly, she’s not someone special to Mr. Lin. At most, he appreciates her looks. Why would he give her face and help our family?"
"I said we shouldn’t count on her, didn’t I?"
Everyone started jeering. The more envious they had been of Su Jinjin, the more they ridiculed her now.
Hearing these words, Su Jinjin’s heart sank. She hoped for respect within the Su Family, but that was easier said than done.
Madam Su’s face also turned cold. That morning, she treated Su Jinjin like a treasure, but now, in her eyes, Su Jinjin was nothing.
"Enough, you can go home. I’m no longer placing any hope on Mr. Lin. Fortunately, our family has just secured Blue Moon’s major order and doesn’t need to rely on Mr. Lin anymore," said Madam Su.
Su Jinjin’s heart raced. A major order from Blue Moon?
She had just learned that today. Isn’t Blue Moon Lin Fan’s company!
In the end, Lin Fan had acted to help the Su Family!
At this moment, a servant reported: "Madam, there’s a gentleman named Zhang Dafu outside, claiming to be the general manager of Blue Moon Company, seeking to see you."
The Su Family members were delighted; the general manager of Blue Moon had come?
"Quick, invite him in!"
Madam Su quickly stood up, planning to personally welcome Zhang Dafu.
"Manager Zhang must have long admired Madam’s great name and personally came to visit her."
"Indeed, it’s because of Madam’s prestige that Blue Moon chose us!"
"It’s not that we want to partner with Blue Moon; it’s that Blue Moon wants to partner with us."
The Su Family members chatted enthusiastically.
They saw a middle-aged man walk in, led by the servant.
Zhang Dafu!
Madam Su warmly said, "Manager Zhang, welcome. Please have a seat."
But Zhang Dafu did not sit down and said lightly, "You must be Madam Su. I have limited time, so let’s get straight to the point. This time, we at Blue Moon chose Su’s as the winning bidder, as you all know."
Madam Su smiled and said, "Your company has shown great respect to this old woman, giving us immense face. I assure you, Su’s will not disappoint your esteemed company."
Zhang Dafu chuckled, "Giving you face? I’m afraid you misunderstand. We chose Su’s not because of you, Madam."
What?
Everyone in the Su Family was stunned. Not because of Madam?
Then who was it because of?
Madam Su’s smile froze, and the atmosphere grew awkward.
Zhang Dafu said, "Actually, I came today to discuss a condition with you; Blue Moon requests that Ms. Su Jinjin be the project leader for this project."
What?
Everyone in the Su Family turned to look at Su Jinjin in unison, completely shocked.
Su Jinjin blushed; she knew, of course, this was all arranged by Lin Fan. Lin Fan was clearly helping her!

chapters.title: Chapter 70: How is this possible? It must be a joke.
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70: How is this possible? It must be a joke.
The entire Su Family was shocked that Zhang Dafu specifically named Su Jinjin as the project leader. Why Su Jinjin?
Even Madam Su was puzzled as she no longer considered Su Jinjin important. If not for Zhang Dafu’s request, she would never have considered Su Jinjin.
Unable to hold back, Madam Su asked, "Manager Zhang, may I ask why you want Jinjin to be the leader?"
Zhang Dafu looked at everyone, his expression a mix of surprise and anger, and said calmly, "Because this is Mr. Lin’s decision."
Mr. Lin!
The entire Su Family was dumbfounded.
This actually had something to do with Mr. Lin?
Zhang Dafu hadn’t been around long, but he could see that these Su Family members seemed to ignore Su Jinjin. Yet the boss wanted her as the project leader—clearly to upset the Su Family.
This is getting interesting, Zhang Dafu finally understood why the boss wanted Su Family to win the bid. The boss was helping Su Jinjin.
Madam Su was shocked and blurted out, "Could it be that Su Family’s bid success is Mr. Lin’s doing?"
Zhang Dafu said, "That’s right, to be honest, we originally planned to partner with Dawei Company, but the boss ultimately chose the Su family."
All Su Family members fell silent.
The atmosphere became awkward.
They all believed Blue Moon picked the Su Family out of respect for Madam Su, having just lavished her with cringey praise.
Now the truth was out—it had nothing to do with Madam Su!
It was entirely Mr. Lin’s decision!
Mr. Lin is actually the owner of Blue Moon!
If not for Mr. Lin, the Su Family could never have won the bid!
The only one who could have influenced Mr. Lin’s decision to pick the Su Family was Su Jinjin!
They thought Su Jinjin wasn’t important anymore, but this was a major slap in the face.
Suddenly, the Su Family members looked at Su Jinjin with a touch of awe, afraid they might inadvertently offend her.
Su Jinjin instantly transformed from someone they looked down upon into someone they dared not cross.
Zhang Dafu said, "Madam, have you considered Miss Su Jinjin as the project leader? Mr. Lin said if you wish to cooperate with us, you must meet this condition."
Madam Su chuckled awkwardly, "Since it’s Mr. Lin’s wish, I have no reason to oppose it."
Of course, she could oppose it, and simply refuse the deal, but that would definitely offend Mr. Lin.
Madam Su wasn’t foolish. It wasn’t worth ruining everything just because she didn’t want Su Jinjin to be the leader.
She wouldn’t miss this opportunity for the Su Family to rise, nor dare offend Mr. Lin lightly.
Zhang Dafu said, "That’s good, once we draft the agreement, we will negotiate and sign it with Miss Su Jinjin. Miss Su, is that alright?"
He finally looked at Su Jinjin.
Su Jinjin nodded, "No problem."
Zhang Dafu said, "Then I’ll take my leave."
Zhang Dafu left, leaving behind Su Jinjin and the Su Family members, and the scene became quite awkward for a while.
Madam Su cleared her throat, "Ahem, Jinjin, since Mr. Lin wants you as the project leader, you must do well. This project concerns the future of our Su Family, and the responsibility weighs on your shoulders. Grandma is counting on you."
Su Jinjin said, "Don’t worry, Grandma. I’ll try my best to be a good leader and will not disappoint you."
With Lin Fan helping her like this, she couldn’t falter.
Madam Su smiled, "As long as you think like that, Grandma will be at ease. Whatever you need, just let Grandma know, I will fully support you."
Su Jinjin’s status suddenly rose to become the most important person in the Su Family. Not to mention that others in the Su Family dared not provoke her, even Madam Su had to tolerate her.
After all, the one supporting Su Jinjin was Mr. Lin!
Mr. Lin’s power could elevate the Su Family to great heights with a wave of his hand or reduce it to ashes with a flick.
Su Jinjin said, "Grandma, I have no other requests, only that the entire Su Family works together to support my work."
Madam Su snickered silently. Su Jinjin has grown bold, daring to make demands of me, an old lady.
Outwardly, she sternly said, "Did you all hear that? From now on, you all have to follow Jinjin’s instructions. Anyone who dares go against Jinjin goes against me, and I will not forgive lightly!"
All the Su Family members nodded submissively, no one dared say anything. Although some still had grudges against Su Jinjin in their hearts, they didn’t dare utter a word.
All this was due to that mysterious Mr. Lin!
Madam Su thought for a moment, only one thing made her uneasy, "Jinjin, this time you went to see Mr. Lin, and he helped the Su Family. You’ve made a great contribution to the Su Family, and I am very pleased. This achievement didn’t come easy and we cannot lose it. Remember Grandma’s advice from the morning: there’s no need to mingle with unnecessary people, like Lin Fan!"
Su Jinjin almost wanted to laugh. Grandma couldn’t rest easy, afraid her mingling with Lin Fan would displease Mr. Lin.
This was simply because Grandma didn’t know the truth.
Su Jinjin said, "Grandma, there’s something I wanted to tell you earlier. I only found out today at the Yunding Manor that Mr. Lin is actually... Lin Fan."
Boom!
Su Jinjin’s words were like a bomb dropped into the water, stirring monstrous waves.
The entire Su Family exploded.
"What?"
"Lin Fan is Mr. Lin?"
"How is this possible? It must be a joke!"
"What kind of joke is this? Is Su Jinjin unhappy that the old lady doesn’t let her see Lin Fan, so she said this on purpose?"
"This joke isn’t funny, my heart can’t take it."
Madam Su was a bit upset. Her first reaction was to think Su Jinjin was playing her, that she was defying her control by doing this.
"Jinjin, don’t joke about such things. I know you’re unhappy being kept from Lin Fan. You might think Grandma is too harsh, but it’s all for your good, for the Su Family’s sake." Suppressing her irritation, Madam Su spoke like she was convincing her with reason.
She now dared not clash with Su Jinjin, only trying to "persuade with kind words."
Amused, Su Jinjin said, "Grandma, I’m really not joking. Lin Fan truly is Mr. Lin. I know it’s unbelievable; if I hadn’t seen it myself, I wouldn’t believe it either."
Madam Su hesitated, seeing Su Jinjin’s demeanor, it seemed she wasn’t joking. Could life really be so absurd?
"Check Blue Moon Company’s equity information for me," Madam Su instructed.
Someone immediately connected online to search.
Soon, that person looked up, face full of shock, "Recently, Blue Moon was fully acquired, the equity just transferred. The sole shareholder now is Lin Fan!"
What?
The entire Su Family was dumbstruck.
The owner of Blue Moon is really Lin Fan!
Lin Fan is indeed Mr. Lin?
Madam Su felt her legs go weak, almost stumbling as she quickly sat down, murmuring, "How can this be? Lin Fan, wasn’t he a villager, a deliveryman? How could this be possible?"
In her eyes, Lin Fan was always a poor boy she looked down upon like an ant. Discovering that Lin Fan was actually a towering mountain and she was nothing in front of him was a blow she couldn’t quite accept.
Save for Su Jinjin, no one else in the Su Family could accept this blow either, each showing pale faces as if grievously injured.
"It’s true! The videos about Lin Fan circulating online are true, not staged. Lin Fan really is a super tycoon!" A young member of the Su Family spoke up at this time.
Upon hearing this, the vast Su Family Mansion fell into silence.
Meanwhile, at Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan stood with his hands behind his back in the Scenic Pavilion, overlooking Yun City with a slight smile.
He knew well that once Su Jinjin returned to the Su Family, the members there would soon learn he was Mr. Lin.
Even if he wasn’t at the Su Family now, he could imagine their reactions, especially Madam Su’s expression.
Back then, he was the poor boy Madam Su thought she could dismiss with 300,000 yuan. Now, she likely started questioning her life’s judgment.
"Old lady, treat Jinjin well, otherwise, the Su Family will perish," Lin Fan said calmly, naturally exuding authority.
Indeed, with his current power, crushing the Su Family was as easy as crushing an ant.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: He Is My Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: He Is My Boss
When Lin Fan and Su Jinjin met at Yunding Manor, at the other end, Chen Lingling came alone to the Tourist Animation Company.
As the "new boss" of this company, Su Jinjin’s specific position is President. Besides Lin Fan, no one can shake her status, making her second in command at Tourist Comics.
Tourist Comics, one of the top three animation giants in the country, is a place Chen Lingling has long admired.
Chen Lingling has hit a wall several times at Tourist Comics. She interviewed but failed; she submitted many works but never got through. Her character is somewhat persistent, experiencing continuous failures but repeatedly trying, even the editors at Tourist are familiar with her.
Just like usual, Chen Lingling wore a dress, tied her hair in double ponytails, looking like a young lady stepped out of a manga. Although those female presidents on TV wear professional attire, she doesn’t like that style.
Yesterday, while shopping for clothes, Brother Lin also said that she can wear whatever she likes.
So she became a female president who looks nothing like a president.
As soon as she arrived at the Tourist company, upon entering, Chen Lingling encountered a familiar editor, a middle-aged uncle with the surname Bai. It was precisely this Editor Bai who repeatedly rejected Chen Lingling’s submissions, having just refused one again two days ago.
Upon seeing Chen Lingling, Editor Bai exclaimed, frowned, and said: "What are you doing here again? Didn’t I reply to your email saying your manuscript isn’t good enough!"
Chen Lingling hurriedly said: "You’ve misunderstood, Teacher Bai, I’m not here because of the manuscript."
Editor Bai said: "Oh, so you’ve come to interview again? I remember you were rejected once, weren’t you? You sure are persistent!"
Editor Bai’s tone carried a bit of sarcasm, clearly mocking Chen Lingling for her lack of self-awareness.
Chen Lingling said: "I’m not here for an interview either."
