Editor Bai was puzzled: "Not for an interview, not for your manuscript, then what are you here for? Do you know what kind of place this is? It’s not somewhere you can come at your leisure!"
Chen Lingling, gentle by nature, didn’t retort angrily but calmly said: "Actually, I’m here to work."
Editor Bai seemed to have heard a joke and couldn’t help but laugh: "Work? When did you pass the interview? How come I don’t know? I think you’re here to make trouble!"
Chen Lingling said: "I’m really here to work, sorry, Teacher Bai, I don’t have time to speak with you further."
Editor Bai blocked Chen Lingling, sneering: "You must be here to make trouble. I’m not trying to discourage you, but let me be frank: you have no talent in animation and are doomed to not develop here. You’d better give up and go think about doing something else!"
At this moment, a glasses lady in professional attire hurriedly ran out, directly coming before Chen Lingling, looking a bit flustered.
"I deeply apologize, President, I was delayed by something, I should have greeted you at the entrance." The glasses lady nervously apologized.
Upon seeing the glasses lady, Chen Lingling was delighted and smiled: "It’s okay, you must be Sister Xiaozhu."
Xiaozhu, her assistant, knew she would assume office today and had already added her on WeChat early on, agreeing to meet at the company.
Hearing the President call her "sister," the glasses lady was overwhelmed: "President, you can just call me Xiaozhu. Let me take you inside, the company executives are waiting for you."
The upper echelons of Tourist Company had already learned that Lin Fan acquired the company and a female President had been parachuted in, assuming office today!
This news was temporarily known only to the executives and hadn’t been communicated to the whole company yet.
"Alright." Chen Lingling smiled, turned to nod at Editor Bai, "I’ll head in first, talk later."
After speaking, she followed Xiaozhu inside.
As for Editor Bai, he was already dumbstruck.
Oh my!
Chen Lingling is actually the company’s new female President?
This leap is too big, how did she do it?
Wait!
Talk later!
Is she planning to settle old scores with him?
Editor Bai instantly shivered.
Tourist Company’s conference room.
The company’s upper management was all gathered, waiting for Chen Lingling.
Although everyone was mentally prepared when they saw Chen Lingling come in, they were still befuddled, the company’s new female President is actually a young girl?
Are we kidding here! How could such a young girl possibly lead the company well!
"Hello everyone, I am Chen Lingling. Please take care of me in the future, and may I ask everyone to introduce themselves so I can get to know you." Chen Lingling said very politely.
The senior executives then introduced themselves one by one.
Afterwards, a male executive said: "President, you came at a perfect time, we are currently locked in an argument over something, just right for you to make a decision."
Chen Lingling looked over and saw it was the company’s Project Director, Director Zhao.
Chen Lingling said: "Director Zhao, please speak."
Director Zhao said: "We are currently preparing to shoot an animation, aiming to set a new benchmark for domestic animation, with a starting box office of 1 billion! However, we have differences over the theme; currently, there are two main choices, one is Journey to the West, and the other is Nezha. Which do you think we should go for?"
Chen Lingling happily said: "Creating domestic animation, that’s great, this has always been my dream!"
Never expected to encounter such a project right when I joined the company. Chen Lingling was indeed very happy.
The higher-ups exchanged glances; this girl didn’t look like a CEO at all, more like a schoolgirl in the wrong place.
Director Zhao coughed twice, "Ahem, CEO, you haven’t answered my question yet."
Chen Lingling calmed down, thought seriously, and said, "In my opinion, when it comes to Journey to the West, it’s a popular theme with numerous works, some of which are excellent. If we do another one, it would be difficult to bring something new. I’m more optimistic about the Nezha theme; although it’s relatively niche, it has a lot of room for creativity. I happen to have drawn a piece about Nezha."
After hearing Chen Lingling, the higher-ups all showed disdainful expressions.
Clearly, Chen Lingling didn’t understand the market!
Director Zhao said, "The CEO has drawn Nezha? Where was your masterpiece published?"
Chen Lingling said, "Well... I submitted it to Tourist Comics before, but it was not accepted..."
Upon hearing this, the higher-ups began snickering, and some couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
A piece that wasn’t even accepted, and she dares to mention it!
Director Zhao said, "CEO, forgive my frankness, but you don’t understand the market! Although there are many works on the Journey to the West, it’s a super IP with national recognition and high traffic. If we carefully craft a good work, we won’t lack an audience. In contrast, Nezha is very niche. Even if we do something extraordinary, it would have little value!"
The executives all nodded, agreeing with Director Zhao’s viewpoint.
Chen Lingling felt a bit dejected. She didn’t expect to be given a hard time by Director Zhao as soon as she arrived. How could she succeed as CEO if she couldn’t win people over?
At this moment, Chen Lingling’s phone rang.
Seeing it was Lin Fan calling, she practically treated it as a lifesaver, quickly picking up.
"Lingling, have you started work yet? How’s it going?" Lin Fan asked.
Chen Lingling said, "Brother, I’ve started work and encountered a little problem..."
Chen Lingling explained the movie project issue.
Lin Fan said, "I’m on my way. We’ll talk when I get there."
By this time, Lin Fan had already driven down the hill. Since it was Chen Lingling’s first day at work, he was a bit worried and planned to check on her. He called Chen Lingling midway and found that she indeed encountered some problems.
When he arrived at Tourist Animation Company, Lin Fan parked his car and walked into the company.
A middle-aged man approached.
Editor Bai!
Editor Bai was holding a large stack of works. After seeing Lin Fan, he looked him up and down.
Head to toe in cheap clothes!
Editor Bai felt a bit disdainful and asked, "What are you doing here? You can’t just wander in!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I really can wander in here."
He owned 100% of Tourist Comics’ shares; no one was more qualified to enter than him.
Editor Bai frowned, annoyed, and said, "I think you’re here to cause trouble. Please leave, or I’ll call security!"
Just as Lin Fan was about to respond, his phone rang.
Lin Fan pulled out his phone to answer, "Lingling, I just arrived and was stopped. Yes, come out for a moment."
While Lin Fan was on the phone, his Rolex on his wrist was inadvertently exposed.
Editor Bai immediately noticed the Rolex and felt a jolt in his heart.
Damn, that’s a Rolex!
This guy, dressed in cheap clothes but wearing a Rolex worth tens of thousands! Did I misjudge him?
Editor Bai was sweating profusely. Damn, clearly a rich guy, so why wear cheap clothes? It easily leads to misunderstandings!
"Brother!"
At this moment, Chen Lingling happily ran out. Seeing Lin Fan, she breathed a sigh of relief. With Brother Lin around, she feared nothing.
Editor Bai felt a bit weak at the knees, as if he might collapse.
The CEO actually called this guy brother, could he be the CEO’s family member? Not only did he offend the CEO, but also the CEO’s family?
Editor Bai almost wanted to cry.
"Haha, CEO, who is this handsome guy to you?" Editor Bai forced a smile and asked.
Chen Lingling blushed and said, "He’s my... boss, yeah, he’s the boss here."
She wanted to say Brother Lin was her boyfriend, but felt too shy to say it. With a quick wit, she cleverly called him her boss.
Little did she know, her words almost scared Editor Bai out of his wits.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 Lin Fan Declares: Losing Money is Not a Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72 Lin Fan Declares: Losing Money is Not a Problem
The boss is here!
After Lin Fan acquired Tourist Comics entirely, it was his first time visiting the company, immediately causing a stir across the entire office.
The company’s executives quickly rushed out to greet him, not daring to slack off in the least.
They might not care about the president, but Lin Fan was the owner of the company, holding the power of life and death over them, and no one dared offend him in the slightest.
When they saw Lin Fan was just a young man of about 20 years old, they were all shocked. The boss is too young!
So young, yet he owns 100% of Tourist Comics!
And the boss is so handsome!
Boo hoo hoo, he’s so handsome!
The female employees of the company all had a crush on him.
At this moment, Lin Fan’s thrift shop clothes didn’t matter at all.
"The boss is so low-key!"
"So rich and dressed so plainly, really down-to-earth!"
"Low-key, not flashy about wealth, young, handsome, and of the highest caliber, the boss is truly full of positive energy!"
Everyone wished they could shower praise on Lin Fan, who’s head-to-toe in thrift shop clothing.
Even the executives finally understood why Chen Lingling, this young girl, could be their superior. It seemed like Chen Lingling was the boss’s girlfriend, which made sense now.
Editor Bai was already shaking like a sieve in the corner, his face pale.
Today was really unlucky, he had offended the boss’s girlfriend and the boss himself in quick succession, thinking you’re courting death!
If he didn’t remedy the situation quickly, things would end up very badly for him.
Editor Bai quickly sidled up to Chen Lingling with a fawning smile: "President, I’ve quickly reviewed your past submissions, and after my careful and professional examination, I’ve realized that your talent is outstanding, and these works are rare genius pieces! I have decided that the next issue of the comic will feature your work as the main highlight."
Chen Lingling curiously said: "Teacher Bai, didn’t you just say that I had no talent and should change careers as soon as possible? This is..."
This was awkward.
Editor Bai awkwardly smiled: "Before, I was the one who failed to recognize talent and saw you through the wrong lens. Now I realize that it was my lack of ability to understand your work properly. I sincerely ask for your forgiveness, President."
Editor Bai’s dog-like fawning appearance made everyone frown.
This suck-up behavior was way too obvious.
Earlier he was arrogant and rude to the President, but after learning her true identity, he became all sycophantic!
Regarding whether Chen Lingling’s work was good or bad, it suddenly became unimportant.
People like Editor Bai were not surprising to Lin Fan, who said lightly: "Whether Lingling’s work is good or not, it’s not up to you or me to decide. Since you’ve decided to publish it, why not let the readers judge it."
Editor Bai hastily said: "The boss is right, I will do my utmost to make this issue the best it can be."
Editor Bai wiped the cold sweat from his brow, luckily his ability to flatter saved his job.
Lin Fan glanced at the executives and said: "I heard from Lingling that the company plans to produce a film but hasn’t decided on the theme yet, what’s the situation with that?"
Director Zhao said: "Yes, most of us agree on filming a Journey to the West theme, but a minority, including the President, want to film Nezha. We think this theme is too niche and lacks value."
Lin Fan responded with an "oh" and said, "Lingling, share your thoughts."
Chen Lingling said: "Nezha is indeed quite niche, but I think as long as it’s done well, there will be a market for it. After all, Nezha is also a household mythological figure. The reason this theme seems niche is just due to a lack of good works. We might as well be the first ones to dare to venture into it."
Hearing this, Editor Bai quickly looked down and rummaged through his things, soon finding a notebook.
"President, this is your Nezha-themed work, ’The Birth of the Demon Child.’ I just reviewed it again, and it’s truly a masterpiece. Using this as a blueprint, we can surely produce an unprecedented Nezha movie, with a box office earning of 3 billion!" Editor Bai complimented.
Director Zhao was furious. Editor Bai, the bootlicker, only knows how to kneel and suck up, ruining things!
Talking about a 3 billion box office, no domestic animation has ever reached that. The most was 1 billion!
Not to mention such a niche theme like Nezha, it’s definitely impossible!
Director Zhao said: "Boss, the President makes a good point, being the first to take the plunge is commendable, but the reality is harsh. I’m afraid this ’crab’ will choke us. I believe focusing on a popular theme like Journey to the West is more stable."
This Director Zhao dared to challenge the President; he’s a bit arrogant. If Chen Lingling compromised this time, she’d be walked over in the future, making it hard to be a respectable president.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said: "My style is to take bold and pioneering steps, rather than just seeking stability. Go ahead and tackle this ’crab,’ even if it results in a loss, money is not an issue."
Money is not an issue!
Even if there’s a loss, it’s alright!
These words struck heavily at everyone’s heart.
The boss is truly too charming. Wealthy people speak with such calm yet overwhelming confidence.
With Lin Fan’s assurance, everyone felt reassured as if they took a calming pill.
Director Zhao dared to challenge Chen Lingling but didn’t dare to challenge Lin Fan, hurriedly saying: "Lesson learned from the boss, the President is right, I was too conservative."
This dispute was thus resolved by Lin Fan’s single statement, and Tourist Comics eventually decided to start filming the Nezha movie.
Afterwards, the executives held a meeting to discuss the Nezha movie, ultimately deciding to adapt the film using Chen Lingling’s ’The Birth of the Demon Child’ as a blueprint, with Chen Lingling personally responsible for writing the script.
After the meeting, it was already lunchtime.
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling left the company to eat out.
Seeing them get on a Kosak, the company staff were in awe.
A top-level supercar worth tens of millions, the boss is truly wealthy!
No wonder he says money isn’t an issue!
Boo hoo hoo, working for such a wealthy boss feels so blissful.
"Brother, thank you. If it weren’t for you helping me out, I definitely couldn’t handle Director Zhao and those people." Chen Lingling said, her face flushed.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Being President isn’t easy, you need to conquer them with strength. When you’re strong enough, they’ll naturally abide."
Chen Lingling felt her brother made too much sense. For instance, her brother’s strength is just two words: wealth.
Whenever brother speaks, who in the company dares to say a ’no’?!
But she couldn’t just use money like her brother to convince people.
"Brother, rest assured, I will certainly make this movie well, and surprise everyone!" Chen Lingling seriously said, her hot-blooded passionate girl spirit igniting.
The two then went to a restaurant to eat.
While eating, Chen Lingling suddenly received a WeChat message from Little Mei.
Chen Lingling said: "Brother, Little Mei says she wants to meet me."
Lin Fan let out an "oh": "Did you tell her about her boyfriend’s cheating?"
The previous night, Lin Fan inadvertently captured footage of the BMW guy cheating, so he informed Chen Lingling, letting her decide whether to tell Little Mei.
Chen Lingling nodded. She hadn’t hesitated long before telling Little Mei last night, as Little Mei was her friend, and she didn’t want her friend to be deceived by a scumbag.
But after sending the message, Little Mei seemingly disappeared without replying until now, suddenly saying she wanted to meet with Chen Lingling.
"Brother, I can’t stop worrying about her," Chen Lingling said.
Lin Fan said: "Alright, let’s go meet her."
The two hurriedly finished their meal and headed to Computer City.
Little Mei was waiting by the roadside, and upon seeing the Kosak and Lin Fan accompanying Chen Lingling, her eyes were full of jealousy, without any attempt to hide it.
Chen Lingling was just about to greet Little Mei.
But Little Mei rushed over and started scolding: "Chen Lingling, you bitch, to think I considered you a friend yet you’re doing this to me. You’re living so well yourself, but you want to ruin my happiness!"

chapters.title: Chapter 73: 1 Million, Taking Down the Opponent’s Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: 1 Million, Taking Down the Opponent’s Girlfriend
Chen Lingling was dumbfounded by the scolding.
Lin Fan also frowned and said coldly, "Watch what you say."
Chen Lingling said, "Little Mei, calm down. I’m not quite sure what you mean?"
Little Mei angrily said, "You’re pretending! Why did you have to tell me about Liu Ming’s cheating? I didn’t want to know at all. If I didn’t know, I could have been happy with him, but now you’ve ruined everything!"
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling both broke out in a sweat.
Chen Lingling said, "Little Mei, I just didn’t want you to get hurt by a jerk. The fact that he cheated is true. You can’t lie to yourself."
Little Mei angrily said, "Mind your own business. Who asked you to meddle? I’d rather be deceived by him than know!"
She finally found a wealthy boyfriend, the BMW guy. Even if he cheated, as long as she didn’t know, she could live as if nothing happened and continue to have good days.
Chen Lingling was dumbfounded. She didn’t expect that her well-intentioned reminder to her friend would result in being scolded. Did she really do something wrong?
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Lingling, you treat her as a friend, but she doesn’t see you as one. It seems we were wrong to get involved in their mess. Let’s go."
Chen Lingling nodded and planned to leave with Lin Fan.
Just then, they saw the BMW guy trotting over from a distance. He had seen Lin Fan’s Kosak from afar and quickly came over to flatter him.
"Mr. Lin, what a coincidence! You’re at the computer market again?" the BMW guy said with a flattering smile.
Suddenly, the BMW guy noticed the angry Little Mei next to him and paused, then smiled, "Little Mei is here too, what’s going on?"
If the BMW guy hadn’t showed up, it would have been fine, but he came to stick his neck out, so Lin Fan was not polite and smiled, "You don’t know yet, Little Mei already knows about your cheating."
The BMW guy’s face changed, his smile instantly froze, and his expression was quite spectacular.
Little Mei was almost furious; Lin Fan did it on purpose!
Because she scolded Chen Lingling, Lin Fan was retaliating!
If the BMW guy didn’t know, she could have acted as if nothing happened, but now Lin Fan had exposed everything in person, and she couldn’t even pretend not to know anymore.
The BMW guy reacted quickly, hurriedly moving to Little Mei’s side and smiling apologetically, "Little Mei, let me explain..."
Little Mei angrily said, "What’s there to explain? I’ve seen the photos of you with that woman!"
The BMW guy said, "I was just acting with her. You know the store’s finances have been tight recently. This woman has money; I approached her just for the money. It’s for our future plans!"
Little Mei was taken aback, "Really?"
The BMW guy said, "Of course it’s real; I only love you!"
At this moment, a woman walked over and slapped the BMW guy: "Bastard! I was even considering talking to your girlfriend, and you only love my money!"
This was the very woman the BMW guy had cheated with. After hitting him, she turned and left in a huff.
The fat chance slipped away, and the BMW guy was almost frantic. He wanted to chase after the woman but didn’t dare since Little Mei was there.
Since the woman had dumped him, if he chased after her, he would lose Little Mei too.
He could only pretend not to care, smiling awkwardly, "Little Mei, you see, I’ve broken up with this woman. You’re all I have left. I promise this won’t happen again."
Little Mei chose to believe the BMW guy and turned to Chen Lingling, sneering, "Bitch, you wanted to ruin my happiness. Are you disappointed? Liu Ming loves me!"
"..."
Chen Lingling was speechless. Her intention was to protect Little Mei, yet Little Mei saw her as the villain. Such good intentions taken as donkey liver and lungs!
Lin Fan suddenly said, "Really sorry, we shouldn’t have meddled in your affairs. To express my apology, I’ll cover your store’s turnover. May I ask how much you need?"
The BMW guy and Little Mei were stunned, then overjoyed.
Lin Fan wanted to help with the turnover?
Oh dear!
How straightforwardly generous the rich apologize!
The BMW guy’s eyes rolled as he frantically calculated how much he could gouge Lin Fan before finally gritting his teeth and saying, "Half a million!"
Lin Fan said, "Is half a million enough? It wouldn’t be good if it weren’t. Let’s say I’ll give a full million."
The BMW guy kneeled on the spot.
Damn!
This is way too generous!
Lin Fan must be that legendary fool with too much money!
Lin Fan looked at Little Mei, "Little Mei, do you think my apology is sincere? Will you forgive me and Lingling?"
Little Mei was already stunned by the million and quickly smiled awkwardly, "Lingling was just concerned about me. I don’t blame her anymore. Lingling, we’ll still be good friends."
Chen Lingling: "..."
Her heart was chilled. Little Mei must be saying that for the sake of the money!
Just when the BMW guy and Little Mei thought a windfall had come their way,
Lin Fan changed his tone, "But I have one condition. As long as you agree to it, I’ll give you the million right away."
The BMW guy curiously asked, "Mr. Lin, what is it?"
Lin Fan said, "The first time I met Little Mei, I was captivated. If you let her spend one night with me, the million is yours."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan actually made such an outrageous request. This is too excessive!
Little Mei was almost driven mad, having thought Lin Fan was genuinely apologizing, but it turned out to be a trap!
"You bastard! You dare to make such an outrageous demand. In your dreams! Liu Ming, he’s bullying us like this, we won’t let him get away with it!"
Little Mei looked angrily at Liu Ming, hoping for him to stand up.
Who would have guessed!
Liu Ming’s eyes dodged a bit, "Well..."
Little Mei was incredulous, "Liu Ming! What do you mean? You’re not really considering agreeing, are you?"
Liu Ming blushingly said, "Little Mei, think about it; it’s a million! Where else would we find that? With this money, our life will be much better, and the price is just one night with him. It’s worth it."
Lin Fan found it amusing. The power of money is truly terrifying. Just a mere million and the BMW guy’s true colors showed.
Back then, Madam Su tried to bribe Lin Fan with 300,000, only for him to flatly refuse. Unfortunately, not everyone can withstand the temptations of money.
Slap!
In her fury, Little Mei slapped the BMW guy across the face, "You bastard, you want to sell me for money? Die! I’m breaking up with you!"
The BMW guy’s cheek was red and swollen, but he still awkwardly said, "Little Mei, calm down. Our store really needs this money. The rich woman is gone; this is our only hope."
For the first time, Little Mei found the BMW guy so disgusting. Her heart was completely dead: "You want money so much? Fine, Lin Fan, I’ll agree to spend time with you for as long as you want, but I have a condition: the million belongs to me, and he won’t get a single cent!"
The BMW guy was shocked, "Little Mei, what are you doing? This money is mine!"
Little Mei said, "I’m the one who’d be with him, what does it have to do with you?"
The two of them started arguing, fiercely and almost breaking into a fight.
"You guys talk it out,"
Lin Fan took Chen Lingling by the arm and walked away.
By the time the two arguing people reacted, the Kosak had already driven away.
The two panicked and chased after the car.
"My million!" the BMW guy screamed, heartbroken.
But how could they possibly catch up to a top-level sports car?
The commotion had long drawn a crowd of onlookers, who witnessed the embarrassing scene between the two.
"This woman is really ungrateful. The friend helped her see a jerk, and she blames the friend instead, ungrateful as a wolf!"
"This guy’s the real piece of work. Selling out his girlfriend for money, what a jerk of the century!"
"I think he’s the Hulk!"
The onlookers buzzed with discussion, and some even took out their phones to capture the embarrassing scene of the two...

chapters.title: Chapter 74: The Life of the Rich Is Too Boring
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: The Life of the Rich Is Too Boring
Little Mei couldn’t stay any longer, she quickly covered her face and ran away dejectedly.
"Little Mei, wait for me!"
The BMW man was not willing to let both the person and the money slip away, so he wanted to chase after Little Mei.
The bystanders couldn’t bear to watch anymore.
A sturdy young man stopped the BMW man and said, "Scumbag, that’s enough. You still want to mess up the girl’s life? Let her go!"
The BMW man got anxious: "Get lost, it’s none of your damn business!"
In a fit of rage, he pushed the sturdy young man away.
The sturdy young man got furious: "You dare to push me, you bastard!"
Slap!
A big slap landed on the BMW man’s face, leaving him dizzy and staggering to the ground, with half of his face swollen.
The bystanders had put up with the BMW man for long enough, and immediately swarmed him, punching and kicking him...
By this time, Lin Fan had already driven far away.
He certainly didn’t actually want Little Mei to spend a night with him, let alone spend a million on it. To him, Little Mei wasn’t worth a penny.
He was just helping Chen Lingling to vent her frustration.
Afterwards, Lin Fan sent Chen Lingling back to Tourist Animation Company.
At the company entrance.
A security guard, an old man in his sixties, wearing slippers and crossing his legs, was sitting at the entrance smoking. He saw Lin Fan’s car approaching and stood up lazily to open the gate for them.
However, Lin Fan didn’t go inside, but stopped the car at the entrance and let Chen Lingling get out.
Chen Lingling said, "Brother, aren’t you coming in with me?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No, it’s fine for you to manage the company. Unless necessary, I won’t interfere."
Chen Lingling said, "Alright, then where are you going later?"
Lin Fan suddenly felt at a loss. Even he didn’t know where he was going next.
Now, he had billions in savings, wholly owned two companies, was the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group, the third largest shareholder of Xingquan Law Firm, owned a 3 billion mansion and a 6 billion island.
However, Blue Moon was managed by Zhang Dafu, Tourist Animation was managed by Chen Lingling, and Yunding Manor was managed by Anna.
Lin Fan suddenly realized he seemed to have nothing to do.
Feeling aimless!
A wave of emptiness surged in his heart.
Is this really how boring a wealthy person’s life is!
It’s really too boring.
Chen Lingling saw that he didn’t answer, thinking he didn’t want to say, so she didn’t ask further, saying, "Brother, I’ll go back to work then. Come see me when you have time."
With that, Chen Lingling went inside by herself.
Suddenly, someone knocked on Lin Fan’s car window.
"Young man, aren’t you going inside? If not, I’ll close the door," the old security guard said.
Lin Fan turned his head and was attracted by the watch casually exposed on the old man’s wrist.
Rolex!
This seemingly ordinary elderly man, dressed unassumingly and wearing a pair of worn-out slippers while working as a security guard, was actually a wealthy man?
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Sir, I see you’re not short of money, so why are you still working as a security guard?"
The old man, upon hearing this, took a puff of his cigarette, slowly exhaling rings of smoke, and with a look of experience, said, "Young man, you might not know, but I earned more money than I could spend in a lifetime by the time I was forty. By fifty, I had traveled the world, and got tired of women and luxury cars. After having too much fine food, it all tastes like wax. The leisurely life made me feel empty until I became a security guard, and I found fulfillment and meaning in life again."
Lin Fan sighed, "Sir, you really spoke to my heart."
The old man oh-ed, sizing up Lin Fan.
All his clothes were cheap! Yet on his wrist, casually resting on the steering wheel, was also a Rolex.
The old man squinted, "Young man, I didn’t expect someone of your age to be a kindred spirit!"
Lin Fan said, "Yes indeed, even though I’m only 21, I have more money than I can ever spend. To kill time and boredom, I work as a delivery guy, enjoying the sun and rain, and getting a sense of presence from the endless nagging of countless women. Sir, let’s leave it at that. I have deliveries to make."
Lin Fan finally knew what to do, so he bid farewell to the old man and drove away.
Watching Lin Fan’s back, the old man wiped the cold sweat from his brow, "There will always be a new cocky young man emerging, I’m getting old..."
He shook his head and turned back to the security office.
Lin Fan parked the car near his apartment, then walked back to it, changed into his delivery uniform, and prepared to head out for deliveries.
Just as he was stepping out, he was grabbed by his landlady Aunt Li.
"Little Fan, finally caught you. What happened on your blind date with Rongrong yesterday? Last night, Rongrong’s mom called, saying that after Rongrong went out for the blind date, she came home with a bruised face and locked herself in, claiming to have fought with her best friend? What actually happened?" Aunt Li asked curiously.
Imagining Ma Rongrong with a bruised face, Lin Fan found it amusing, saying, "I don’t know, we were having a good blind date when her friend came and fought with her. I was also scared."
Aunt Li apologized, "Sorry, Little Fan, I didn’t know the girl would be like that. Is there still any hope for you two?"
Lin Fan said, "No more."
Thinking of not having to go on a blind date with this princess syndrome girl anymore, Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh.
Aunt Li thought he was disappointed and patted him on the shoulder to comfort him, "It’s okay, Auntie found you a better one. Go meet her tonight."
Lin Fan gave a bitter smile, wasn’t Aunt Li working too fast!
Aunt Li didn’t give him a chance to refuse and stuffed a photo into Lin Fan’s hand, "This is the girl’s photo, her phone number is on the back, you should take the initiative."
After saying that, Aunt Li went off to the village entrance to play mahjong with a small fan.
Lin Fan glanced at the photo, it was a beautiful girl with a slim figure and fair skin, pretty at first glance.
Wait a minute!
Holy crap!
The floor next to the girl was photoshopped crooked, this wasn’t a photo, it was a trick!
Lin Fan immediately felt deflated, but couldn’t refuse Aunt Li’s enthusiasm, so he had to go tonight.
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang, and it was a call from the delivery station’s manager.
"Lin Fan, where are you now, can you come back to the station?" the manager said, sounding rather helpless.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I was just about to go deliver. Is there anything wrong, manager?"
The manager sighed, "I’ve heard that you got on four trending searches last night, you’re really popular now. People have even found out that you’re working at our station. Now there’s a huge crowd claiming to be your fans, wanting to see you, it’s about to squeeze my station to pieces. Please come back and handle it."
Lin Fan was surprised that such a thing happened.
He had heard from his sister the night before about being on the trending searches, but hadn’t paid much attention to it. Didn’t expect it to blow up this much.
"I’ll head back now," Lin Fan said.
Lin Fan quickly got on his e-bike and rushed back to the station.
Sure enough, from afar, he could see the station surrounded by people, most of them young girls, chatting, taking photos, very lively.
The station manager was sitting inside, smoking, frowning at the crowd of fans, at a loss about what to do.
"Hasn’t Lin Fan arrived at work yet? When will he be here?"
"This is where he works, taking a photo to check-in!"
"I really want to meet him, he’s my idol!"
"So young and handsome, filled with a sense of justice, he’s practically the perfect embodiment!"
Lin Fan was a bit overwhelmed, just from trending a few times, he suddenly got so many fans. These fans surrounding the station were affecting its normal operations.
Lin Fan was planning to go over and persuade the fans to leave.
"Hello everyone, I’ve arrived!" A voice came from across the way.
"Lin Fan has arrived!"
The crowd stirred, suddenly swooping towards the person across from Lin Fan.
Lin Fan looked over, only to see a tall and handsome delivery guy coming from the opposite direction, apparently being mistaken by the fans for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Competing with Lin Fan for fame, getting completely crushed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: Competing with Lin Fan for fame, getting completely crushed!
From across the street came a tall, handsome delivery guy, riding a brand new electric bike and wearing a brand new delivery uniform, but it wasn’t Meituan’s uniform, it was another delivery platform’s.
Surrounded by Lin Fan’s fans, this delivery guy flashed a confident smile: "Everyone, I’m really sorry, you’ve got the wrong person, I’m not Lin Fan, my name is Zhou Bufan. But I believe my handsomeness is in no way inferior to Lin Fan’s, and I could even say, I’m actually the most handsome delivery guy."
Seeing his confident yet slightly greasy smile, the fans who had mistaken his identity suddenly fell silent.
Thinking everyone was stunned by his looks, this delivery guy named Zhou Bufan became even more confident, with even his breathing oozing confidence.
It was as if he had already snatched away Lin Fan’s title of "most handsome delivery guy."
"Oh my god, we got the wrong person!"
"It’s not Lin Fan, why did you shout? You made me misunderstand!"
"Stop talking nonsense, Lin Fan is the most handsome!"
"You, daring to compare looks with Lin Fan?"
"Just leave, stop embarrassing yourself, we’re waiting for Lin Fan!"
The crowd came to their senses, but snorted at Zhou Bufan, and started to mock him.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless, so it turned out this delivery platform was jealous of Meituan producing a "most handsome delivery guy," so they arranged for their own delivery guy to come and try to steal Lin Fan’s thunder.
But it seemed like no one really bought it.
Upon hearing the crowd’s taunts, Zhou Bufan’s confidence finally stopped swelling, and he awkwardly laughed: "Hehe, being handsome is subjective, but money can be measured. I am actually the richest delivery guy!"
Lin Fan, the most handsome delivery guy!
Lin Fan, the richest delivery guy!
These two titles, because of last night’s four trending topics, became Lin Fan’s tags, and the Meituan delivery he was with got major exposure.
This made other delivery platforms green with envy.
Zhou Bufan was specifically sent to challenge that!
Seeing that trying to snatch the "most handsome delivery guy" title failed, he wanted to snag "the richest delivery guy" instead!
The fans weren’t happy.
"You’re the richest delivery guy? Lin Fan drives a 70 million limited edition top supercar, do you?"
Zhou Bufan sneered: "A 70 million luxury car? What’s there to brag about, I just inherited a 5% stake in the Golden Capital Group from my dad, becoming its fourth-largest shareholder, worth billions!"
What?
Billions!
The fans were immediately stunned by this shocking number, and the scene went quiet.
Golden Capital Group, a trillion-dollar group!
5% of a trillion-dollar group, that figure is just too overwhelming, it utterly crushes 70 million!
The fans were somewhat discouraged, it was over, Lin Fan lost!
Seeing this, Zhou Bufan became smug: "So, I am the richest delivery guy, no one has any objections to that, right?"
Zhou Bufan was delighted internally, successfully stealing the "richest delivery guy" title, thinking of getting a trending topic for himself and his platform, feeling great!
"Excuse me, are you the fourth-largest shareholder of Golden Capital?"
Just then, a voice spoke, and Lin Fan drove up.
Lin Fan arrived!
The fans were instantly excited, but thinking about the "richest delivery guy" title being snatched by Zhou Bufan, their enthusiasm dampened a bit.
Zhou Bufan sized up Lin Fan, and disdainfully said: "You’re Lin Fan! Yes, standing in front of you is indeed the fourth-largest shareholder of Golden Capital, worth billions, are you so scared that your legs are shaking?"
Zhou Bufan burst out laughing.
Lin Fan remained calm, casually saying: "Sorry to disappoint you, I’m actually also a shareholder of Golden Capital."
Zhou Bufan stopped laughing: "You’re also a shareholder of Golden Capital? How much stake do you have?"
Lin Fan said: "Uh, not much, only 30%."
Zhou Bufan’s face changed, blurting out in shock: "30%? You’re, you’re the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital?"
What?
Everyone was shocked, Zhou Bufan only had 5% shares, yet Lin Fan had 30% shares, making him the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital?
Zhou Bufan exclaimed hoarsely: "I don’t believe it, you must be lying!"
Lin Fan smiled: "If you don’t believe it, you can check."
Zhou Bufan immediately pulled out his phone and made a call: "Check for me, the current shareholder composition of Golden Capital!"
Soon, Zhou Bufan’s face turned pale, his hands trembling, and with a snap, he couldn’t hold his phone steady, dropping it to the ground.
"How can this be, you, you really are the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital!" Zhou Bufan muttered.
Second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital, worth tens of billions!
The fans were all astonished.
"Lin Fan is amazing!"
"Lin Fan is the rightful richest delivery guy!"
"Oh my god, a billionaire, so rich!"
"Ah ah ah..."
The fans then erupted into frenzied cheers, surging towards Lin Fan, leaving Zhou Bufan on the sidelines.
Zhou Bufan was unwilling and couldn’t help but scream, "Lin Fan, what’s the big deal about your billion-dollar fortune? My dad also has a net worth of over a billion, and he recently acquired a 30,000 square meter plot in Yun City. Are you as rich as my dad?"
Zhou Bufan’s rant was just like a frenzied mad dog.
The fans all thought that since Zhou Bufan couldn’t beat Lin Fan himself, he had to bring his dad into it. How shameless!
But words like "30,000 square meters of land" are definitely stinging.
Just then.
A black sedan drove up and stopped next to the delivery station.
At first glance, you could tell this car was a government vehicle!
A middle-aged man got out of the car holding a document.
The middle-aged man saw Lin Fan, looked delighted, and hurried over to him. The crowd quickly made way.
He went straight to Lin Fan and smiled, "Mr. Lin, you are so hard to find, but finally I’ve found you. I am Director Wan from the National Land and Resources Bureau. You just bought 70,000 square meters of land from the Shendiao Old Factory. Here is the purchase agreement for you to sign."
Saying this, Director Wan handed over the document. The transfer of the Shendiao Old Factory land to Lin Fan had the mayor’s approval, and Director Ma specifically instructed Director Wan to contact Lin Fan personally and treat him well.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Lin Fan actually bought 70,000 square meters of land!
How impressive!
And a section chief from the National Land Bureau personally delivered the agreement!
Oh my God, this is quite the honor!
Zhou Bufan’s face turned pale, and his legs went weak as he kneeled down.
70,000 square meters, more than double his dad’s 30,000!
From him to his dad, Lin Fan completely outclassed them!
Lin Fan calmly took the agreement, saw no issues, and signed it, officially owning the 70,000 square meters of Shenying Old Factory land.
Director Wan then chatted with Lin Fan a bit more before taking his leave.
The whole place was silent.
Lin Fan looked at Zhou Bufan, "So, do you want to bring your grandpa to compare with me too?"
Hearing this, everyone burst into laughter.
"Lin Fan is too hilarious!"
"Ah, the way he crushed the opponent was so cool!"
"If it were me, I wouldn’t have the face to stay!"
"Exactly, just leave already, stop embarrassing yourself!"
Zhou Bufan blushed, quickly started his electric scooter, and scurried away.
Not far away, a few people hiding in the shadows captured the entire scene. They were from the same delivery platform as Zhou Bufan!
This delivery platform, envious of Meituan, got Zhou Bufan to try and publicly humiliate Lin Fan and record the process to buy trending searches for publicity.
Who knew Zhou Bufan would fail miserably, getting beaten by Lin Fan!
The footage they captured couldn’t be used and instead became a record of shame for their platform!
This matter quickly spread in the delivery industry, becoming the biggest joke.
After learning from this lesson, no other delivery platforms dared challenge Lin Fan again, and those who initially planned to hit Lin Fan backed down immediately. After all, who wants to humiliate themselves?
After Zhou Bufan fled in shame.
The fans went wild, gathering around Lin Fan, screaming and clamoring for autographs, it was lively.
Lin Fan spoke loudly, "Dear fans, I am very grateful for your support, but your enthusiasm has disrupted the normal order of our delivery station, making it impossible for us to deliver properly. If this continues, I might have to resign to restore peace here. So, I hope everyone can leave orderly. If you want to support me, you can continue to do so online. Thank you!"
Lin Fan’s words moved the fans.
Some female fans even had tears in their eyes.
"Boo hoo, he’s so kind-hearted!"
"So positive, I didn’t like him wrong!"
"Decided, he’s my idol for life!"
"Some celebrity idols lost their voice, but he can talk down his fans. Love it!"
The fans followed Lin Fan’s advice and started to leave, quickly dispersing.
Lin Fan breathed a sigh of relief, thankful the fans listened to him. Sometimes fans really need a bit of guidance.
The boss lady came over at this time, grinning ear to ear, enthusiastically pulling Lin Fan, "Little Fan, haven’t seen you for days. You’re finally here to work, come in and sit."
The station chief relaxed his furrowed brows, "Thankfully Lin Fan came, or we wouldn’t have been able to handle these enthusiastic fans."
At this moment, a business Benz sedan drove up to the outside of the station and stopped.
The station chief and his wife looked a bit curious, wondering who had come this time.
They saw the car door open, and a middle-aged man in a suit, accompanied by two assistants, walked into the station.
The station chief and his wife were stunned.
This middle-aged man was actually Meituan’s CEO Huang Qing!
The CEO of Meituan actually came to their small station personally!
"Hello, I’m Huang Qing. I heard Lin Fan works here, so I came specifically to visit him," said Huang Qing with a kind smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Meituan Boss’s Recruitment, Lin Fan Doesn’t Play by the Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: Meituan Boss’s Recruitment, Lin Fan Doesn’t Play by the Rules
The couple who run the station never imagined that one day, the CEO of Meituan would personally visit their little station.
This is truly a tremendous honor. Meituan Delivery has tens of thousands of stations, and this situation is one in a million.
All of this is because of Lin Fan, Huang Qing came for Lin Fan!
The wife eagerly approached: "Hello, President Huang, I’m the manager’s wife, Hu Ajiao. It’s such an honor for us to have you here."
The wife warmly reached out, attempting to shake hands with Huang Qing.
But Huang Qing had already recognized Lin Fan standing nearby, and set aside the wife, directly reaching out his hand to Lin Fan: "Mr. Lin Fan, pleased to meet you."
The wife awkwardly smiled and withdrew her hand.
Lin Fan shook hands with Huang Qing and smiled: "Nice to meet you as well, you can just call me Lin Fan."
Huang Qing was secretly surprised. In Meituan, whoever saw him wasn’t like the manager’s wife, eager to flatter him. Not just a mere delivery worker, even the higher-ups of the company treated him like a father.
And yet, Lin Fan was so composed, as if he were on equal footing with this CEO!
If it were any other courier daring to be this way, Huang Qing would have already been upset, waving them away. But with Lin Fan, Huang Qing oddly didn’t find it strange, even found it justifiable.
Maybe it’s because Lin Fan drove a supercar worth 70 million, plus the four trending searches that made Lin Fan a viral hit last night. Huang Qing guessed Lin Fan must be a super-rich heir!
Lin Fan’s identity remains a mystery. Some speculate he’s an unseen tycoon; others suggest he’s from the Kyoto Lin Family.
If Lin Fan were really from the Kyoto Lin Family, Huang Qing would even have to curry favor with Lin Fan!
The Kyoto Lin Family is an entity even Huang Qing wouldn’t dare offend.
Before the truth comes out, Huang Qing believes that it’s absolutely right to maintain a good relationship with Lin Fan out of caution.
After last night’s four trending topics, Lin Fan earned the titles "The Handsomest Delivery Guy" and "The Wealthiest Delivery Guy," significantly boosting Meituan’s brand image thanks to the righteous super-rich heir.
Meituan has continuously spent vast amounts on brand promotion, but the work over past years doesn’t compare to the impact of Lin Fan’s one night of free publicity.
The industry mistakenly believed this was Meituan’s marketing strategy, even praising it as divine marketing. Various companies took it as a divine case study!
Only Huang Qing knew this was not marketing; it was a pleasant surprise. Lin Fan was this divine-level surprise.
Initially, Huang Qing intended to observe Lin Fan slowly, but due to the trending event, he couldn’t sit still, deciding to visit Yun City personally to meet Lin Fan.
He came here with two purposes: one, to learn a bit about Lin Fan’s background; two, to win over Lin Fan.
Huang Qing smiled: "Alright, Lin Fan, let’s sit and talk."
The wife quickly tidied up the tables and chairs, allowing the two to sit down.
Lin Fan said: "President Huang came over personally; I wonder what advice you have?"
Huang Qing replied: "Haha, I’ll be straightforward. Our company has the richest delivery guy who went viral online. I simply couldn’t sit still."
Lin Fan said: "Going viral was just an accident; I didn’t intend for it. Speaking of wealth, I’m nowhere near President Huang."
Huang Qing curiously asked: "Lin Fan, online speculation says you’re part of the Kyoto Lin Family. Is it true?"
Lin Fan thought, so President Huang is here to investigate his background, what a futile effort!
"What is the Kyoto Lin Family? I’m not part of that family," Lin Fan calmly said.
Lin Fan isn’t from the Kyoto Lin Family!
Lin Fan was telling the truth, but Huang Qing couldn’t discern whether he was truthful or deliberately hiding something.
Huang Qing chuckled: "I also thought, how could someone from the Kyoto Lin Family come to Yun City, and even work as a delivery guy. By the way, Lin Fan, with all your wealth, why work as a delivery guy for Meituan?"
Lin Fan sighed: "My family wants me to inherit the family business, but I don’t want to, so I ran away to find work. Who knew they’d still forcibly hand over the family wealth to me."
"..."
Cold sweat dripped from Huang Qing’s head, this... how does it sound like you’re the one aggrieved, I wish someone would hand over wealth to me too!
Huang Qing laughed: "I see, it’s rare for you to keep working as a delivery guy after inheriting the family wealth. This time you’ve earned Meituan a face, and considering your significant contributions, I’ve decided to promote you to Vice President of Meituan Delivery, with an annual salary in the millions, and invite you to work at the headquarters. What do you think?"
Promotion and a raise!
Huang Qing’s words shocked the station couple, leaving them wide-eyed and mouth agape.
At that moment, a few returning delivery workers hid nearby, watching in awe, drooling with envy.
From a delivery man, directly promoted to Vice President!
An annual salary of a million!
The leap in promotion is rather exaggerated.
They naturally didn’t understand Huang Qing’s intentions.
Huang Qing tried using promotion and a raise to win over Lin Fan, relocating him to headquarters to facilitate building a good relationship with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan remained calm. If it were before, he might have been ecstatic, but now, this level of promotion and raise had no lure for him.
Lin Fan smiled: "I appreciate President Huang’s regard, but I’ll pass. I just want to quietly continue delivering food."
Damn!
Lin Fan actually refused!
Those few delivery guys nearly lost it.
This is a chance they wouldn’t even dream of!
Huang Qing didn’t expect Lin Fan to refuse, feeling a bit awkward, he chuckled: "Lin Fan, do you really just want to be a delivery guy?"
Lin Fan said: "That’s right, although being Vice President comes with a million salary, I don’t lack money. To prevent much heartbreak from women losing their handsome guy, I wish to keep fighting on the service front."
Huang Qing wiped his cold sweat, that’s just too much showing off!
Huang Qing said: "Alright then, if you’re unwilling to be promoted, I won’t press. Lin Fan, your public-serving spirit is one all Meituan people should learn from. I will reward you as this month’s outstanding employee, how does that sound?"
Lin Fan laughed heartily: "President Huang, you could ask the station manager, I’m often late and frequently have customer complaints, are you sure you want to make me an outstanding employee?"
The station manager was sweating profusely; Lin Fan was indeed telling the truth.
"This..."
Huang Qing sweated, how does Lin Fan not play by regular rules.
A failed attempt at winning over!
Lin Fan found it amusing inside, this President Huang came all the way, inquired about his background, and offered various rewards, it seemed his aim was building rapport, alas, all efforts were misfocused.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "President Huang, if you truly want to reward someone, I recommend rewarding this station. The station manager has been conscientious and dedicated to running this place!"
Lin Fan said this, firstly to give Huang Qing a way out, secondly to offer a small compensation to the station manager for the disruption caused by fans.
Huang Qing heard it and agreed without hesitation: "Alright, this month’s outstanding site is here, with a bonus of 100,000!"
The entire station boiled over.
The station couple was overjoyed!
Outstanding station, a bonus of 100,000!
They never dared to think of such a thing before.
Just a word from Lin Fan, and they received this honor!
Lin Fan, you’re amazing!
The manager’s wife couldn’t stop smiling: "I just knew, with Lin Fan around, we were bound to get some benefits!"
Lin Fan stood up: "President Huang, it’s getting late. If there’s nothing else, I’ll head out to deliver now, goodbye."
With that said, Lin Fan coolly walked out.
The other delivery workers almost bowed down, saying goodbye so nonchalantly in front of President Huang - only Lin Fan among all Meituan employees dared do that.
Lin Fan left, and Huang Qing then also left the station.
"Unbelievable, this Lin Fan isn’t easy to win over. Did I come all this way for nothing today?" Huang Qing said, unwilling to give up.
His two assistants remained silent; it was their first time seeing someone not buy into President Huang’s offerings, it was rather impressive.
Huang Qing thought for a moment, then chuckled: "I refuse to believe Lin Fan is entirely immune to such advances, not interested in wealth, not tempted by power, and indifferent to rewards, but I bet he can’t resist beauty. I’ve thought of a plan. It seems that to catch a wolf, one must be willing to lose a child first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 77: The biggest trouble now is being too popular
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: The biggest trouble now is being too popular
Lin Fan naturally wasn’t aware of this; he was already on his way to deliver food.
The whole afternoon that followed, Lin Fan was busy delivering food.
Just after delivering a dozen orders, he was recognized 10 times, gathered a crowd 3 times, was hugged proactively by female fans 8 times, and took photos with female fans 9 times.
The few moments of peace only occurred because he ran fast enough to shake off the crazy female fans.
This made Lin Fan feel a bit exhausted; the female fans were just too enthusiastic.
One female fan even wanted to drag Lin Fan into her house, not letting him leave, claiming she wanted to have babies with him.
Another female fan chased after Lin Fan’s electric bike for three miles.
For the first time in his life, Lin Fan felt troubled because of his good looks.
It’s all his fault for being too handsome, making the female fans go so crazy.
Of course, his biggest worry now was being too popular; with so many female fans, all of whom were overly proactive, it was just too overwhelming.
After finally shaking off a female fan, Lin Fan received a new order; someone ordered a takeaway to be delivered to a small hotel.
Arriving at the small hotel entrance, Lin Fan made a call, intending for the customer to come get the food, and the other party, a woman, asked Lin Fan to bring the food to the room.
Lin Fan had no choice but to park his bike and carry the food into the small hotel.
This small hotel was in a secluded area, mostly frequented by male customers, each exuding a sleazy vibe.
One look, and it was clear it wasn’t a proper hotel.
A fat landlady was at the counter munching on seeds, and upon seeing Lin Fan enter, she showed an ambiguous smile, "Little handsome guy is here, huh?"
Lin Fan quickly said, "I’m just here to deliver food."
He hurriedly slipped away, quickly reaching the customer’s door.
Knock, knock!
Lin Fan knocked on the door, "Hello, your food is here."
A woman’s voice came from inside, "I’m putting on makeup, the door’s unlocked, just bring it in."
Lin Fan had no choice but to push the door open, and indeed saw a young woman sitting on the bed applying makeup, dolled up flamboyantly, with a face covered in thick, cheap makeup.
"Just leave it on the table," the young woman said, busy with her makeup, not sparing Lin Fan a glance.
Lin Fan let out a breath of relief; he’d been quite spooked by the enthusiastic fans today, and it was best that this woman didn’t recognize him.
Lin Fan just placed the food on the table and was planning to leave.
Who knew the young woman was looking in the mirror and caught sight of Lin Fan’s face in one glance.
The young woman froze for a moment, then jumped up in surprise, "Aren’t you that guy, yes, the most handsome delivery guy on the internet!"
Lin Fan chuckled bitterly in his heart.
Damn it!
To be recognized even in a place like this!
"Miss, you must have me mistaken with someone else," Lin Fan said.
The young woman laughed aloud, "It’s really you, and you’re delivering food to me, what a coincidence! Do you know, I really like you, let me see you, oh my, you’re even more handsome in person than in the videos, can I hug you? For free!"
The young woman reached out to grab Lin Fan and hugged him tightly.
Lin Fan quickly pushed her away and said, "Sorry, miss, I have another delivery to make, goodbye."
Saying this, Lin Fan was about to escape.
Just then, with a bang, the door was kicked open from the outside.
A few policemen burst in, with a beautiful policewoman in the lead shouting, "Nobody move, police raid!"
The young woman was so scared she screamed but then skillfully put her hands on her head and squatted down, as if this were a routine drill she’d practiced many times.
Lin Fan was attracted to the leading policewoman.
So pretty!
About twenty-five or six years old, angelic face, perfect figure, looking particularly charming in her dashing uniform, a solid 90 points police beauty!
Though she wasn’t like Anna with a powerful aura of a mature woman, nor like Chen Lingling, a manga-like girl, she had a special charm that was somewhere between the two.
The beautiful policewoman approached Lin Fan with handcuffs, trying to detain him.
Lin Fan quickly said, "Officer, don’t misunderstand, I’m just here to deliver food."
The beautiful policewoman sneered, "Don’t call me officer, who are you calling officer, you scum, caught in the act, still want to deny it!"
Without waiting for an explanation, she grabbed Lin Fan’s hand, trying to cuff him.
Lin Fan was a bit sweaty and instinctively broke free, saying, "You can’t arrest me; I’m really a delivery guy!"
The beautiful policewoman got angry, "Still resisting arrest, that’s an additional offense!"
She grabbed at Lin Fan, trying to pin him to the ground.
Then, as Lin Fan struggled and they wrestled, both toppled to the floor.
Nearby policeman: "..."
"Loli, need some help?"
Beautiful policewoman: "No need!"
One minute later...
Beautiful policewoman: "Someone, quick, help me pin this guy down!"
Her hair was all messed up, clearly not a match for Lin Fan’s strength.
Lin Fan, after all, was a guy; there was no way he’d be pinned down by a policewoman.
Two other policemen rushed over, finally subduing Lin Fan and putting handcuffs on him.
The beautiful policewoman sneered, "You’re quite cunning, disguising yourself as a delivery guy to facilitate escape when caught. If I hadn’t seen you hugging that woman, I might have believed your nonsense!"
Lin Fan: "..."
The beautiful policewoman tidied her hair and clothes, "I’m starting the interrogation now, be honest, name!"
"Lin Fan."
Lin Fan said irritably, this misunderstanding was way too grave.
"Lin Fan?"
The beautiful policewoman blinked, as if she remembered something, and examined Lin Fan closely, immediately showing a look of surprise.
Wasn’t this the popular "most handsome delivery guy" online?
Her new male idol!
Handsome and wealthy, driving a 70 million sports car!
Also had a strong sense of justice, slapping back at fake beauties in a satisfying way!
Besides, despite being so wealthy, he was still delivering food!
She saw full-on positive energy in Lin Fan.
A definite male idol!
After seeing the trending topics, she immediately decided to become Lin Fan’s fangirl.
She imagined, how could Lin Fan come to such a place to do shady things! There could only be one explanation; he definitely came to deliver food and was just unlucky to run into their raid, it must be like that.
Loli blushed and hurried over, helping Lin Fan unlock the handcuffs, "I’m sorry, brother, ah no, Lin Fan, I misunderstood you, I was just too focused on finishing the mission, you don’t blame me, right?"
She worried about leaving a bad impression on her male idol, and thinking of the rough tussle with him earlier, she felt so ashamed she wanted to dig a hole and hide.
Nearby policeman: "??? "
Why did this woman change so quickly; just a second ago, she was being fierce with Lin Fan, and upon hearing his name, she suddenly got shy?
Lin Fan said, "It’s fine, can I leave now?"
Loli said, "Yes, I’m really sorry about today, I’ll escort you out."
Under the peculiar eyes of a group of policemen, Loli personally escorted Lin Fan out of the small hotel.
"Who is this kid anyway, just stated his name, and you let him go?"
"He’s my male idol!"
"What, a delivery guy is your male idol?"
"What’s wrong with being a delivery guy, I just like him!"
The police beauty fell for a delivery guy!
This news caused a sensation in the police station; after the police young men found out, they were beating their chests in frustration.
"Who the heck is it that snatched away our police beauty sister?"
Lin Fan had already ridden away on his electric bike from the small hotel, ah-choo... sneezed.
"Damn it, someone’s talking behind my back about how handsome I am again!"
Lin Fan felt a bit troubled.
Being recognized everywhere today, and with the incident at the small hotel, made him somewhat hesitant to continue delivering food.
Fame and trouble go hand in hand; if it were like this every day, he’d be exhausted to death.
For the first time, Lin Fan had the thought of not delivering food anymore.
Seeing it was getting dark, Lin Fan decisively gave up continuing to deliver food; it was about time for him to head to his blind date.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Blind Dates Are a Trap, Encountering Another Exceptional Blind Date Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: Blind Dates Are a Trap, Encountering Another Exceptional Blind Date Woman
At the entrance of an ordinary restaurant, Lin Fan parked the e-bike next to the door, intending to go inside.
A cute-looking waitress ran out, smiling, "Hey there, little brother, you can’t park here, can you move it a bit?"
The girl smiled sweetly, and her attitude was friendly, without any arrogance because Lin Fan was wearing a delivery uniform.
Lin Fan smiled and asked, "Where should I move it to?"
The waitress said, "Are you here to pick up a delivery?"
Lin Fan replied, "No, I’m here to dine."
The waitress laughed, "Then you’re a customer, go ahead and eat, I’ll park your bike for you."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh" and handed the keys to the waitress, jokingly saying, "Be careful, miss, this is the Ferrari of e-bikes, lots of power, mind your speed."
The waitress chuckled and went to help Lin Fan move the bike.
Lin Fan walked straight into the restaurant, took out a photo of his blind date, and started looking around to match the people to the photo.
Before coming, Lin Fan had contacted the person by phone, who said they’d arrived and were waiting for him. He was in a rush and didn’t change out of his delivery uniform.
After looking around, he didn’t spot the person in the photo!
Lin Fan thought maybe the person had gone to the restroom, so he went in and planned to find an empty seat to wait.
At the nearby table, a disheveled woman, with shoes off revealing her feet, sat carelessly, without makeup, with a sallow complexion, quite plain, barely a 3 out of 10.
The woman was eating a durian pastry with terrible manners, and the durian smell made other guests wrinkle their noses in disgust.
Lin Fan was also repelled and hurried his steps, intending to distance himself from this woman.
To be honest, such a slovenly girl was rare to see.
Who knew, just as Lin Fan turned his back.
"You’re Lin Fan, right! I’m here, where are you going?" the slovenly woman suddenly said.
Lin Fan felt his body stiffen.
Dammit!
This isn’t funny!
He took a few steps back, looked at the sloppy girl in front of him, then looked at the photo in his hand, feeling a wave of dread.
Dammit, if you don’t look closely, you’d never believe they were the same person!
This is the legendary ’photo trap,’ beautiful in photos, horrible in person!
No wonder people say Photoshop is one of Asia’s four great evils. It’s too effective, completely transforming someone, like turning a sow into Diao Chan!
Blind dating truly is a pitfall.
"Cough, cough, sorry, didn’t recognize you for a moment." Lin Fan finally forced a smile and sat down across from the shabby girl.
The shabby girl glanced at Lin Fan and said, "What, surprised to see me in person? Big difference from the photo?"
Lin Fan coughed, "Cough, a bit."
Bang!
The shabby girl slapped the table, startling everyone around.
The shabby girl sneered, "Whatever quality you are, that’s the kind of attitude you’ll get from me. I’m just that straightforward."
Lin Fan: "..."
He’s met a lot of women on blind dates, and encountered quite a few oddballs, but this shabby girl could be called the oddest of them all.
The shabby girl gave Lin Fan a once-over with disdain, "Aunt Li said you’re a delivery guy, and you really are. Let’s cut to the chase, I require my partner to have three things: a house, a car, and savings. Do you have them?"
Lin Fan smiled, "What if I say I do?"
The shabby girl scornfully replied, "I know what you want to say. You have an apartment, renting from Aunt Li; a car, an e-bike; savings, on loan. Please, such a cliché, not funny at all!"
Lin Fan: "..."
The shabby girl continued, "I’ve seen many poor guys like you, full of poverty, yet still aiming too high. Don’t you ever ask yourself if you match up? If you can’t satisfy my three requirements, there’s no need for us to talk. Just wisely walk away. Oh, and pay for the meal before you go."
Lin Fan said, "I haven’t eaten anything?"
The shabby girl widened her eyes, raising her voice on purpose, "I’m a female, and you’re asking me to pay on a date? Are you even a man, have some decency?"
Everyone around looked over.
The guys cast sympathetic glances, feeling sorry for the dude, having to deal with such an extreme woman on a blind date.
Although Lin Fan was somewhat speechless from dealing with the extreme nature of the girl, he remained calm inside.
He had come to understand that this extreme woman was deliberately unkempt, showing disdain for his job as a delivery guy, wanting to irk him into leaving.
Such a girl, obviously herself a low-life, but feeling noble, despising poor men.
The worst part is, if she didn’t like it from the start, she could just not come. But she not only came, disgusts you, and also wants a free meal!
Isn’t this clearly deceitful behavior!
What normal man could put up with such a woman? An honest man would quickly leave some money for the meal and eagerly distance himself from such a woman.
Lin Fan chuckled softly, "I’ll be honest then, I do have a house, and I bought it, not rented."
As he spoke, Lin Fan placed his hand on the table, accidentally revealing his Rolex on his wrist.
The shabby girl sneered, "You have a house, who are you fooling..."
Before finishing her sentence, the shabby girl suddenly noticed Lin Fan’s Rolex, her expression changed abruptly, choking on her words.
Dammit!
A Rolex!
Lin Fan was actually wearing a Rolex worth tens of thousands!
No way, how could a delivery guy have such an expensive watch, unless he’s pretending to be a delivery guy and is actually wealthy?
The shabby girl became uncertain and couldn’t help but ask, "Is your watch real?"
Lin Fan replied, "Of course, it’s real, why?"
The shabby girl felt internally shaken, "So you really have a house too?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Yes, I not only have a house but also a car."
At this time, the waitress Lin Fan encountered earlier walked over with a bunch of keys, handed them to Lin Fan, and smiled, "Here you go, little brother, your Ferrari is parked."
"Alright, thank you," Lin Fan said.
The waitress put down the keys and walked away.
The waitress was kind and cheerful, so they quickly became familiar. Lin Fan had joked earlier that his e-bike was the ’Ferrari of e-bikes’, and the waitress played along with the joke.
Her comment was innocent, but the shabby girl heard it, and it struck a chord.
Upon hearing the word ’Ferrari,’ the shabby girl suddenly sat up straight.
She took the joke between Lin Fan and the waitress seriously, truly believing Lin Fan owned a Ferrari.
If Lin Fan had a Ferrari, then his watch must be real, and owning a house was likely as well.
Oh my, Lin Fan actually is a rich man!
The shabby girl hurriedly pulled her exposed feet back into her shoes and tidied her messy hair.
"Lin Fan, no, brother, why are you dressing as a delivery guy if you’re so rich? You’re too funny."
The shabby girl laughed to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Dismissing the Arrogant Woman, Random Encounter with Middle School Goddess
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: Dismissing the Arrogant Woman, Random Encounter with Middle School Goddess
Lin Fan looked at the other person with a playful expression. As he expected, once he revealed his wealth, this woman began to change her attitude. It was just too real.
"Are you still going to send me away now?" Lin Fan smiled.
The scruffy woman grinned awkwardly, "How could I? You’re different from those losers. Going on a date and dining with you is my honor."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Is that so? But with this face of yours, I don’t really feel like eating."
"Ah!"
The scruffy woman exclaimed, suddenly remembering that she hadn’t put on makeup. She quickly covered her face, "Brother, wait for me, I’ll go to the restroom."
The scruffy woman hurriedly picked up her fake L.V bag and rushed to the restroom.
Ten minutes later.
A woman with a thick layer of foundation on her face and cheap lipstick on her lips came out of the restroom, carrying a fake L.V bag and walking with what she assumed was a graceful gait, stopping in front of Lin Fan.
After a hurried makeover, she transformed from scruffy to about a five out of ten.
If she had appeared like this initially, Lin Fan wouldn’t have failed to recognize her from the photo.
The Four Great Supernatural Arts of Asia, aside from Photoshop, another one is the art of makeup!
"Brother, how does my outfit look?" The scruffy woman beamed with a confident smile, thinking that in this look, she would definitely enchant Lin Fan.
If he hadn’t seen her bare face, Lin Fan might have barely tolerated her, but after seeing her without makeup, he couldn’t bear to look straight at her.
The scruffy woman sat down and said in a caring manner, "Brother, you haven’t eaten yet. Why don’t you order something to eat first?"
Lin Fan said, "Forget it, I ate a lot at lunch, not hungry yet."
Out of politeness, Lin Fan didn’t directly say that he was full just seeing her.
The scruffy woman laughed, "Then how about we go shopping and watch a movie?"
Seeing her change from disdainful to enthusiastically proactive, Lin Fan found it a bit amusing and said, "Sure, then about this meal..."
The scruffy woman immediately said, "I’ll pay for this meal, Brother, you wait for me."
She seemed to have forgotten how she cursed at Lin Fan just now.
The scruffy woman quickly paid for the meal, then returned to Lin Fan’s side, actively linking arms with him, assuming the role of Lin Fan’s girlfriend.
The two of them left the restaurant.
The scruffy woman said, "The cinema is a bit far from here. Brother, why don’t you drive your Ferrari?"
Her eyes were filled with anticipation. Just the thought of soon sitting in the passenger seat of a luxury Ferrari, reaching the peak of her life, excited her immensely.
Lin Fan readily replied, "Okay."
Then he led the scruffy woman to his electric scooter.
"Brother, where’s your Ferrari?" The scruffy woman asked curiously, looking around but seeing no sign of a Ferrari.
Lin Fan took out the key and pointed to the scooter in front of him, "Here it is, the Ferrari of electric scooters."
What?
The scruffy woman was dumbfounded.
Damn!
I wanted a luxury Ferrari!
Who wants this lousy electric scooter,
the Ferrari of electric scooters?
Screw you!
"Brother, you’re joking with me, right..." the scruffy woman laughed.
But before she could finish speaking, Lin Fan had already inserted the key, and the scooter’s headlight instantly lit up.
The scruffy woman’s smile froze.
"Let’s go, let’s watch the movie. What are you standing there for? Get on." Lin Fan smiled.
The scruffy woman’s face darkened, suddenly roaring, "Screw your movie! Riding this lousy scooter, you damn liar, you’re not rich at all. I bet you don’t even have a house, and your watch is fake. I shouldn’t have trusted you, you broke jerk!"
She was always the one bullying honest people, but tonight, she got played by Lin Fan, wasted so much effort, and even paid for the meal!
The scruffy woman was so angry her face turned blue and she stomped away in a fury.
Lin Fan watched as she left, embarrassed and furious, feeling a bit of satisfaction. This kind of woman just needed to be put in her place.
She thought she could bully men casually, but unfortunately for her, she met Lin Fan tonight.
If she found out later that Lin Fan was really rich, like extremely rich, her reaction would have been even more priceless.
Lin Fan chuckled and was about to ride his scooter back.
Another failed blind date, but Lin Fan had no regrets. He wouldn’t mind failing with such a ridiculous blind date woman.
Lin Fan was just about to leave.
"Lin Fan?"
Suddenly, a well-dressed beauty approached.
She had just stepped out of an Audi and came over upon seeing Lin Fan.
Lin Fan glanced up, paused for a moment, and blurted out, "Little Fang?"
This beauty was actually his middle school crush, He Xiaofang!
She had naturally matured a lot since middle school, growing from a young beauty into a gorgeous lady!
However, Lin Fan no longer had those feelings he had in middle school. Those were childish emotions that had faded away as he grew up.
He Xiaofang laughed, "I almost didn’t recognize you. I was thinking you look like Lin Fan the more I looked, so I took a chance, and it really is you!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Of course it’s me."
He Xiaofang said, "It’s been years since we last met, didn’t expect to run into you here. Are you working as a food delivery guy now?"
Lin Fan said, "Yeah, I work as a food delivery guy."
In He Xiaofang’s eyes, there was a flicker of disdain, but it quickly disappeared.
It was clear that He Xiaofang had become adept at handling such situations. Even if she looked down on Lin Fan, she wouldn’t show it easily.
He Xiaofang smiled, "Being a delivery guy is good, earning money through hard work. Hey, can’t chat right now, I’m in a hurry to meet a client. How about coming to my place for lunch tomorrow, and we can catch up then? My boyfriend just bought a Tangchen Yipin apartment, we have some friends coming over tomorrow. Here’s my number."
He Xiaofang took out a business card and handed it to Lin Fan, then quickly walked away.
Lin Fan looked at the business card, seeing that He Xiaofang was currently a sales manager at an international company.
His middle school goddess was doing quite well now.
Tangchen Yipin, I’ve heard the houses there are incredibly expensive, a single apartment could cost over a hundred million. The cheaper ones still start at eighty million!
It’s said to be the most expensive residential area in Yun City.
Being able to afford Tangchen Yipin means her boyfriend must be a multimillionaire.
Unexpectedly, in just a few years, He Xiaofang had found such a wealthy boyfriend. If those middle school classmates of theirs knew, they’d definitely be envious to death.
Lin Fan wasn’t sure if he should see He Xiaofang tomorrow, after all, they hadn’t met in years, and there wasn’t really a reason to catch up.
So Lin Fan casually put away the business card and rode home.
Returning to his apartment, Lin Fan felt a bit tired and went to bed early.
Nothing happened overnight.
The next morning.
Lin Fan just slowly woke up.
"Ding!"
"System notification, a new day’s sign-in can begin now. Signing in today includes a property reward, would you like to sign in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Luxury Mansion Gift Pack, an Entire Building of Tangchen Yipin!
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80: Luxury Mansion Gift Pack, an Entire Building of Tangchen Yipin!
Today’s system check-in was quite early. As soon as Lin Fan woke up, he received a notification from the system.
"Check-in!" Lin Fan mumbled groggily.
*Ding!*
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. You’ve been rewarded with a luxury home package, a whole building at Tangchen Yipin. Please check it."
Lin Fan suddenly sat up, fully awake.
Damn!
The system’s reward today is amazing, it actually gave a luxury home at Tangchen Yipin, and it’s a whole building!
A house at Tangchen Yipin, one set of the cheaper kind costs 80 million, and they can easily reach over a hundred million, even several hundred million. A whole building at Tangchen Yipin is worth billions.
To someone like Lin Fan, who’s worth hundreds of billions, billions doesn’t mean much, but he wouldn’t just go out and buy a whole building at Tangchen Yipin.
The system’s rewards are different, whether it’s billions or millions, the more the better anyway.
Moreover, the system’s rewards are always top-tier, even the community luxury homes rewarded are of the Tangchen Yipin variety, the highest level in all of Huaxia.
Suddenly, Lin Fan noticed that the table beside him was piled high with red booklets, stacked several feet tall!
The property deeds for Tangchen Yipin!
A total of 40 property deeds, stacked high in a pile, were visually overwhelming.
Lin Fan felt a bit excited looking at them. Forty property deeds together — this scene is not something everyone has the chance to see. Moreover, these 40 Tangchen Yipin property deeds all belong to the same person, making it unique in the world.
Lin Fan checked the property deeds, and the owner’s information on them was all under Lin Fan’s name. The system’s service was especially impressive this time, providing the property deeds directly to Lin Fan.
However, although he had the property deeds, Lin Fan hadn’t received the keys to the properties yet.
According to the usual practice, Lin Fan believed someone would contact him a bit later.
So he didn’t pay much attention to it.
Having nothing else to do today, Lin Fan decided to continue delivering food, so he got up, washed up, and rode his e-bike out.
Just as he got downstairs, Lin Fan was once again caught by his landlady, Aunt Li.
"Little Fan, what happened with Little Ling on your date last night? Little Ling said you tricked her," Aunt Li asked.
That sloppy girl Little Ling, after thinking about it and getting angrier last night, called Aunt Li in the middle of the night to complain, saying Lin Fan pretended to be wealthy and deceived her feelings.
Lin Fan wiped his sweat and said, "Aunt Li, I didn’t pretend to be rich."
He is rich, so why would he need to pretend!
Aunt Li said, "That’s what I said too; I said Little Fan has always been honest. How could he trick you? Besides, I’ve told you, Little Fan is a delivery guy. If you were fooled, you must not be thinking straight."
Lin Fan laughed heartily, "Aunt Li pulls no punches; this lady indeed doesn’t seem too bright."
Aunt Li sighed, "Then she scolded me too, blaming me for introducing a liar to her. Truly a case of good intentions gone unrewarded, so exhausting."
Lin Fan felt happy; Aunt Li was exhausted, perhaps she wouldn’t introduce him to anyone else anymore.
However!
Aunt Li then patted Lin Fan’s shoulder, "But don’t worry, Little Fan; Auntie will definitely find a nice girl for you. Wait for Auntie’s good news."
After saying that, Aunt Li headed towards the village mahjong parlor.
Lin Fan: "..."
He was speechless.
The entire morning, Lin Fan spent delivering food.
Learning from yesterday’s experience, while delivering food, he kept his head down as much as possible and left immediately after delivery, greatly reducing the chances of getting recognized.
By the end of the morning, only a few female fans recognized him. These female fans were ecstatic, but thankfully, they didn’t make any excessive demands.
Nearing noon, after delivering one order, Lin Fan was about to accept another when he suddenly received a call from an unknown number.
"Is this Mr. Lin Fan?" asked a woman’s voice on the other end.
Lin Fan replied, "It’s me. Who’s this?"
The voice on the other end said, "Hello, Mr. Lin, I’m from Tangchen Yipin Property Management, surname Chen. Your property procedures at Tangchen Yipin have been completed. Are you available to come over and collect your keys?"
Lin Fan responded, "Sure, I’ll be over in a while."
The voice asked, "Around what time will Mr. Lin arrive, so I can wait for you at the entrance?"
Lin Fan estimated the time, "About half an hour or so."
