After hanging up, Lin Fan decided not to accept any more orders and wasn’t bothered to change clothes either — he rode his e-bike straight to Tangchen Yipin.
Coincidentally, last night He Xiaofang invited him over to Tangchen Yipin for a visit, so he took the opportunity to check it out.
By noon, Lin Fan arrived outside Tangchen Yipin District.
Indeed, the most expensive luxurious residential area in all of Huaxia, with towering buildings several dozen stories high standing, the entire community exuded extravagance and every brick seemed to radiate wealth.
It’s said that the houses here start at 160,000 per square meter; pricier ones go over 300,000 per square meter. Generally, rich people can’t afford it, and those who can are mostly billionaires.
Even renting here, the rent often goes up to 100,000 per month, which means you need to earn at least 100,000 a month to afford renting a place here.
It can be said that those who reside at Tangchen Yipin are mostly high-income wealthy individuals; naturally, their status is very prestigious.
Just as Lin Fan reached the gate of the community, he got stopped by a security guard.
"Buddy, this is an upscale residential area. You can’t deliver food here!" the security guard said.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m not here to deliver food."
The security guard said, "Not delivering food? Then you really can’t go in. You better leave quickly; don’t disrupt the residents. Everyone coming in and out are wealthy people! They’re not one to be messed with!"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, brother security guard. I won’t disturb others, nor will I make things difficult for you. I’m just here waiting for someone."
He arrived too early, and the property management personnel hadn’t come out yet.
At this moment, several luxury cars were heading towards Tangchen Yipin, leading the way was an Audi A8, driven by a beauty in the driver’s seat.
He Xiaofang!
In the back seat sat a handsome young man in a designer suit, with features mixing Eastern and Western characteristics, clearly a Central European mixed-race individual.
The person was He Xiaofang’s boyfriend who had just bought a house at Tangchen Yipin.
They were moving into their new residence today, and had invited a group of friends over to celebrate. Their friends were all wealthy, each driving luxury cars, forming a lavish scene on the road, attracting the attention of passersby.
He Xiaofang noticed the envious looks from passersby, feeling quite satisfied.
Having come from a poor family and reached where she was today, having a good job and a billionaire boyfriend, she can be quite proud.
"By the way, I bumped into a junior high school male classmate on the street last night. I also invited him over. He hasn’t called me yet, so I’m not sure if he’s coming," He Xiaofang said.
She was talking about Lin Fan.
The handsome young man responded, "Junior high school male classmate? What’s his job now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 81: The Billionaire Rich Handsome Boyfriend of the Junior High School Goddess
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: The Billionaire Rich Handsome Boyfriend of the Junior High School Goddess
"Delivery worker." He Xiaofang hesitated for a moment before saying it, because she felt that Lin Fan’s job was really nothing impressive.
The handsome young man was stunned for a moment, then chuckled and said, "You invited a delivery worker to visit my mansion?"
He Xiaofang heard it, and his tone obviously had a bit of displeasure. She quickly said, "If you don’t like it, I can send him away, but I probably don’t have to bother doing that. After all, for someone of his status, coming here also requires courage. He probably wouldn’t dare to come..."
He Xiaofang suddenly stopped speaking, looking embarrassed, because she suddenly saw that Lin Fan was actually right at the gate of the district!
She just said Lin Fan wouldn’t dare to come, and then she saw Lin Fan right in front of her. This was a bit of an face-slap at light speed.
The handsome young man followed her gaze and also saw Lin Fan, coldly said, "Is it him?"
He Xiaofang nodded: "Yes, I’ll send him away in a while."
The handsome young man took a look at Lin Fan. Although Lin Fan was wearing a cheap delivery uniform, he had to admit, Lin Fan was very handsome!
Lin Fan’s handsomeness was rare even in high society, it was a handsome with great charm, masculine and confident, as if he was born to rule.
"What is your relationship with him?" The handsome young man suddenly asked.
He seemed a bit skeptical of He Xiaofang’s words, so she hurriedly said, "There’s no relationship, he’s just my middle school classmate, and we haven’t seen each other for many years. We just had an unexpected meeting last night."
The handsome young man’s gaze was cold as he said, "Really no relationship at all, think about it carefully?"
He Xiaofang bit her lip and said, "If I have to say, he probably liked me in middle school, but rest assured, I’ve never liked him. In my eyes, he’s just an ordinary classmate."
The handsome young man responded with a sound, "Did he like you? You should bring him along now."
He Xiaofang was a bit surprised, "You plan to let him join us? You don’t really need to save face for me. If you don’t like it, I can send him away. He’s just an unimportant person."
The handsome young man chuckled and said, "Who said I was saving face for you? I want to invite him myself."
"Alright then..."
He Xiaofang was a bit embarrassed, stopped the car, and got out immediately.
When her car stopped, the luxury cars behind also stopped one after another, and the people in the cars curiously poked their heads out.
He Xiaofang called out to Lin Fan, "Lin Fan."
Lin Fan was waiting for someone from the property management at the gate, heard the call, turned his head and saw He Xiaofang.
He originally planned to call He Xiaofang after dealing with the property management, and then sit at her place for a while. Unexpectedly, they met here.
"Xiaofang, what a coincidence." Lin Fan smiled and said.
He Xiaofang smiled and said, "You are quite early, just in time, so I don’t have to come out to pick you up. Why don’t you just come in with us now."
Lin Fan saw that the property management hadn’t arrived, so he thought why not, and nodded, "Okay."
He Xiaofang originally wanted to call Lin Fan into the car, but she feared her boyfriend might not like it, so she swallowed her words and let Lin Fan follow the convoy with his electric bike.
With He Xiaofang leading, the security didn’t stop Lin Fan, and Lin Fan smoothly entered Tangchen Yipin District.
When they arrived in front of a building, everyone got out of the cars, and Lin Fan parked his electric bike to the side.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, curious.
"Xiaofang, did you order takeout?" someone asked.
He Xiaofang was a bit embarrassed and said, "Lin Fan is my friend."
All of He Xiaofang’s friends were stunned.
What?
This delivery worker is He Xiaofang’s friend? He Xiaofang actually has such a poor friend from the lower social class and even invited him to such a high-end district.
Everyone started snickering.
"Xiaofang, since when did you have a delivery worker friend, and how come we didn’t know?"
"He’s coming to your house for a visit, wearing a delivery uniform?"
"Does he have no other clothes to wear? There are people this poor in the world?"
Everyone jeered.
He Xiaofang smiled awkwardly, inwardly blaming Lin Fan. How could he come to visit still dressed in the delivery uniform! Couldn’t he have changed his clothes!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sorry, I just came from delivering, and haven’t changed clothes. But what clothes one wears isn’t important, as long as it’s not nothing."
Everyone laughed out loud.
"Listen to that, people from the lower social class have such an attitude, how would those brand names survive?"
"People rely on clothes, clothes are also a symbol of status. Look at us, and then look at him, a poor man!"
"A poor man can’t afford nice clothes, so they say clothes don’t matter, really!"
Lin Fan heard these words but wasn’t angry, calmly said, "Do you really judge people by their attire?"
Everyone was taken aback, surprised Lin Fan dared talk back!
Seeing the situation, He Xiaofang hurriedly intervened to mediate, "Time is getting late, let’s stop just talking, let’s all go upstairs."
So, He Xiaofang led everyone into the building and took the elevator up.
There were more than a dozen of them, and the elevator couldn’t fit everyone at once, so they divided into two groups, but no one wanted to ride with Lin Fan, the poor guy.
Finally, the guests went up first, and He Xiaofang, her boyfriend, and Lin Fan took the next elevator.
"Let me introduce, he is my middle school classmate Lin Fan. Lin Fan, this is my boyfriend Chen Sikai, a mix of Central Europe and Huaxia, from Yun City’s prestigious Chen Family. His mother is a PhD from the University of Cambridge in the United Kingdom, and Sikai is now the CEO of the Great Huaxia Region of Sile International Company."
He Xiaofang introduced, and when she talked about her boyfriend, she was obviously filled with pride.
One must admit, Chen Sikai is indeed very outstanding, with a super good family background, a typical rich and handsome man.
Sile International Company, a multinational company valued at hundreds of billions of Huaxia Coins. He Xiaofang is a sales manager in this company.
No wonder she seized the advantage of being close, snagging Chen Sikai, this rich second generation. She comes from an ordinary family, and marrying into the Chen Family in the future would mean a class leap.
Chen Sikai’s excellence was something Lin Fan looked up to. Ordinarily, Lin Fan couldn’t catch up with Chen Sikai even if he strived for ten lifetimes.
But Lin Fan, with the system, was just that awesome, and simply left Chen Sikai ten streets behind.
No matter how noble your birth is, Chen Sikai, or how important a CEO of a multinational company’s Great Huaxia Region might be, when it comes to wealth, Lin Fan still beats you.
However, both Chen Sikai and He Xiaofang were unaware of Lin Fan’s power, and still thought Lin Fan was feeling inferior after hearing Chen Sikai’s background.
Before long, they arrived at the house Chen Sikai bought.
Indeed, it was a mansion worth over a hundred million, luxurious decor, spacious, and with a great view.
Everyone marveled at it.
"Wow, this house is amazing, no wonder it’s the most luxurious district!"
"I would love to buy one too! Just not as rich as Sikai."
"Sikai is really too outstanding, so envious of Xiaofang for finding such a boyfriend as Sikai."
Everyone praised Chen Sikai.
Chen Sikai listened to the compliments, then suddenly said, "Lin Fan, I heard from Xiaofang that you had a crush on her in middle school?"
As soon as he said this, everyone immediately turned their eyes to Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 Lin Fan: I Still Love You
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82 Lin Fan: I Still Love You
Tangchen Yipin District entrance.
A young woman in work attire hurriedly ran to the entrance, looking around as if searching for something.
"Security guard brother, have you seen a handsome young man arrive?" the young woman promptly asked the security guard.
The security guard replied, "A handsome young man? Well, there was a delivery guy here earlier, quite handsome. At first, I thought he was here to deliver food and didn’t let him in, but he said he was waiting for someone."
The young woman laughed, "That’s him, Mr. Lin. The information says he’s a deliveryman. Where did he go?"
The security guard said, "He went inside. A group of people just came, including a property owner who’s apparently his friend, and they brought him in."
The young woman was surprised; so Mr. Lin actually has friends here.
"Do you know who his friend, the property owner, is?" the young woman asked.
The security guard said, "I do. I helped her deliver something upstairs before. She lives on the 10th floor of Building C, Miss He. Miss Chen, why are you looking for this delivery guy?"
The young woman said, "I’m the one he’s waiting for; he’s the property owner here."
The security guard’s expression changed, blurting out, "What, he’s the property owner?"
A delivery guy, actually an owner in Tangchen Yipin? That’s unbelievable.
The young woman revealed a mysterious smile, "He’s not just any property owner; he bought an entire building here."
"Huh?"
The security guard was petrified on the spot.
At this moment, the 10th floor of Building C.
Chen Sikai suddenly spoke, shifting everyone’s attention to Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan was Little Fang’s middle school classmate and had a crush on her. Lin Fan, is this true?" Chen Sikai looked at Lin Fan with an amused expression.
After hearing this from He Xiaofang, Chen Sikai immediately decided to meet Lin Fan.
Lin Fan, with a calm face, said, "It’s true."
He Xiaofang was indeed the idol of his middle school days. Everyone has a fondness for beauty, especially during such innocent times, so he didn’t feel ashamed and had no reason to hide it.
Everyone was initially surprised, but then started laughing.
"No way, he liked Little Fang?"
"This is hilarious, a deliveryman not weighing his worth!"
"What qualifications does he have compared to Sikai; they’re worlds apart!"
"He’s like a frog wanting to eat swan meat!"
Chen Sikai’s actions put He Xiaofang in an awkward position. She hadn’t anticipated Chen Sikai would bring this up publicly; had she known, she wouldn’t have told him.
"Lin Fan only liked me back in middle school; it’s nothing serious. We haven’t seen each other for years, and although I knew he secretly liked me, I only regarded him as an ordinary classmate and never had that kind of thought for him," He Xiaofang explained.
Her explanation seemed to defend Lin Fan, but the focus was on the latter part, emphasizing that it was purely a one-sided affection from Lin Fan.
Everyone laughed even more.
"I knew it, he was just deluding himself!"
"This poor guy could only crush on a great beauty!"
"Little Fang has such good taste, she’d never go for him."
"It’s right Little Fang doesn’t like him; she has such a perfect boyfriend like Sikai now, living in a billion-dollar mansion that makes others envious."
Listening to this, He Xiaofang quietly breathed a sigh of relief. Thankfully she clarified things in time; if people misunderstood her as liking Lin Fan too, it would be so embarrassing, especially since Lin Fan is a deliveryman she really looks down upon.
But Chen Sikai obviously didn’t plan to stop at this, saying, "Lin Fan, do you still like Little Fang now?"
His words turned everyone’s attention to Lin Fan, waiting for him to answer. He Xiaofang was also watching Lin Fan, a bit anxious, worried Lin Fan might say he still likes her.
If Lin Fan said he still liked her, the ridicule from everyone would surely intensify.
Considering He Xiaofang now has a boyfriend, none other than the incredible Chen Sikai, it’s clear Lin Fan can’t compete with Chen Sikai on any front, having no standing to challenge him for He Xiaofang.
"What are you thinking? Little Fang already has an excellent boyfriend like Sikai. If a deliveryman had any self-awareness, he’d know better than to try!" someone couldn’t resist saying.
Lin Fan looked at Chen Sikai, amused. Clearly, this person was upset learning about his old crush on He Xiaofang, eager to humiliate him publicly.
On the surface, Lin Fan did seem like someone easily suppressed by this situation.
Lin Fan smiled, "Do you want to hear the truth?"
Lin Fan’s attitude annoyed Chen Sikai, who did harbor resentment and even a hint of suspicion about Lin Fan and He Xiaofang’s relationship.
"Of course, go ahead and say it truthfully. There’s nothing wrong with liking someone, especially since you’re just a deliveryman and I’m the Great Huaxia Region’s president for Sile International. Surely, I wouldn’t fear you as a rival?" Chen Sikai chuckled.
Everyone laughed at Chen Sikai’s words.
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on He Xiaofang, "Then I’ll be honest. Despite all these years, I haven’t forgotten you. After seeing you again last night, I didn’t sleep well. I’ve realized how deeply I still love you."
That wasn’t true, though; the childish infatuation had long vanished. But Chen Sikai’s provocation made Lin Fan want to annoy him, knowing those words would surely upset him.
Sure enough, Chen Sikai’s face turned cold, feeling extremely disgruntled. Were it not for years of cultivated restraint, he might have wanted to hit Lin Fan.
Lin Fan still liking He Xiaofang!
A mere deliveryman liking his girlfriend felt offensive to him.
Lin Fan’s words also surprised the others.
He Xiaofang was especially shocked, "Lin Fan..."
She truly hadn’t expected Lin Fan to still like her after so many years; he was too sentimental!
If she’d known, she wouldn’t have invited Lin Fan over last night. The scene now was just too awkward.
"He’s really a frog wishing for swan meat!"
"No self-awareness at all; how dare he like Little Fang?"
"Social bottom-dweller through and through, utter lack of decorum, saying such things before her boyfriend!"
"Is he attempting to swoop in and steal her?"
"Laughable, as if he could! Sikai has a billion-dollar mansion, and what does he have, a beat-up e-bike?"
Everyone mocked without restraint.
Lin Fan seemed oblivious to the ridicule, merely observing Chen Sikai with amusement as his intent was fulfilled seeing Chen Sikai’s displeased face.
Chen Sikai contained his displeasure, outwardly acting indifferent, saying, "Haha, didn’t expect you to be so sentimental, but it’s unfortunate because Little Fang is my girlfriend now. You should give up. Little Fang, your thoughts?"
He Xiaofang, realizing Chen Sikai’s apparent irritation, was somewhat anxious. She couldn’t let Lin Fan ruin her relationship with Chen Sikai.
"Lin Fan, after so many years, why do you still like me? Why bother?" He Xiaofang said, a bit exasperated.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: The Whole Audience Shocked, Tomson 1st Product Ultimate Black Card!
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: The Whole Audience Shocked, Tomson 1st Product Ultimate Black Card!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Didn’t Brother Kai just say that there’s nothing wrong with liking someone? I like you, so what’s wrong with that?"
Little Fang was at a loss for words. It was Chen Sikai who said that, and she couldn’t exactly say Chen Sikai was wrong.
Chen Sikai chuckled and said, "Lin Fan, delivering food every day under the sun and rain must be quite tough, right?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, just a bit mentally exhausting."
Chen Sikai: "Mentally exhausting?"
Lin Fan said, "Yeah, every day I’m on the minds of many women, flitting between them. Sometimes when I’m tired and want to take a break from them, they call me nonstop, and recently they’ve become even more relentless."
Everyone: "..."
Everyone’s thoughts: "This is the first time I’ve heard someone describe delivering food in such a charming and unconventional way."
"He’s actually quite funny."
"Haha, how interesting!"
Chen Sikai chuckled and said, "You’ve made delivering food sound so entertaining; isn’t this what people like you in the lower social strata call finding joy in hardship?"
Little Fang laughed and said, "Lin Fan has always been quite humorous. Actually, there’s no need to ask; delivering food is of course hard work and doesn’t earn much."
Chen Sikai said, "Exactly, it doesn’t earn much! There’s nothing wrong with liking someone, but it’s wrong for a lazy toad to want to eat swan meat. Lin Fan, ask yourself, can you afford to take care of Little Fang? Without anything else, have you bought a house?"
Chen Sikai was taking a roundabout way to belittle Lin Fan.
Everyone laughed heartily.
"Young Master Kai’s question hits the mark; he clearly can’t afford a house!"
"Indeed, not only can’t he buy one, I bet he even rents in the urban village, not having enough for a residential estate!"
"Young Master Kai bought a unit in Tangchen Yipin, and he’s renting in the urban village; how can he compete with Young Master Kai?"
Listening to these humiliating words, Chen Sikai was very satisfied. He wanted to teach Lin Fan a lesson; the more uncomfortable Lin Fan was, the happier he was. Who told this kid to annoy him?
This punk, and he dares to like his girlfriend!
Just then, the doorbell suddenly rang.
Little Fang went over to open it and saw a young woman in business attire standing there. Little Fang recognized her as Miss Chen from the property management office.
"Miss Chen?" Little Fang asked in surprise. Why did someone from property management suddenly show up?
Miss Chen smiled and said, "Sorry to disturb you, but is Mr. Lin here?"
"Hmm..." Little Fang was even more surprised; the property management people were actually looking for Lin Fan?
Miss Chen came in, spotted Lin Fan immediately, and apologetically said, "I’m Miss Chen from the Tangchen Yipin property management office. I’m really sorry, Mr. Lin, there was a small issue that delayed me. I heard from the security guard that you were here, so I came to find you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s no problem."
Everyone looked at each other; why would someone from the Tangchen Yipin property management office come looking for Lin Fan?
Miss Chen then took out a black card and handed it to Lin Fan, "Mr. Lin, this is your access card. With this card, you can freely enter and exit Tangchen Yipin."
Seeing this black card, Chen Sikai realized something and his face changed drastically!
Then, Miss Chen handed Lind Fan a heavy tote bag, "These are the keys to the entire Building A; you can check them."
Lin Fan took it and saw that there were a total of 40 sets of keys, all strung together on a metal ring, heavy to hold.
Lin Fan lifted the ring; the dense collection of keys was quite visually striking.
Seeing this scene, everyone was astounded.
What on earth was going on?
The property management actually gave Lin Fan an access card!
And the keys to the entire Building A?
This time, Lin Fan had mainly come to the property management office to exchange the keys and visit Little Fang’s home. Now that he had the keys in hand and had caused a minor scene, he decided to take the chance to slip away.
"Little Fang, thanks a lot for inviting me over. Let’s leave it at this for today; I won’t disturb you any further. Miss Chen, I’ll head downstairs with you."
With that, Lin Fan walked out with the bag of keys.
Miss Chen was about to leave with Lin Fan when Little Fang grabbed her.
Little Fang couldn’t contain her curiosity, "Miss Chen, what on earth is going on?"
Miss Chen seemed a bit puzzled, "You’re Mr. Lin’s friend, and you didn’t know? Mr. Lin just bought an entire building at Tangchen Yipin."
Having said that, Miss Chen chased after Lin Fan.
Leaving behind a room full of slack-jawed people.
Everyone was so shocked they were practically petrified.
Lin Fan actually bought an entire Tangchen Yipin building?
If this hadn’t come from Miss Chen’s mouth from the property management, they certainly would have thought it was a joke.
But they had seen with their own eyes, Miss Chen handing over the access card and a bag of keys to Lin Fan, so it couldn’t be fake!
"Ultimate Card!" Chen Sikai suddenly exclaimed, so agitated his voice changed.
"Lin Fan’s access card is the legendary Ultimate Black Card of Tangchen Yipin, only given to those who buy 10 or more units here!"
"Lin Fan, he really bought an entire building at Tangchen Yipin!"
Chen Sikai’s face turned pale; this fact hit him like a ton of bricks.
Even though it’s hard to believe, in the presence of the Ultimate Black Card, they could only accept it.
Lin Fan, the delivery guy, is actually the owner of an entire Tangchen Yipin building!
Earlier he had ridiculed Lin Fan for not being able to buy a house, and it turned out the guy had 40 units at Tangchen Yipin, compared to his 1—a complete reversal!
In that moment, the entire room was silent as everyone was deeply shocked.
Reflecting on their earlier unbridled ridicule of Lin Fan, they not only felt ashamed, wanting to find a hole to crawl into, but also quite afraid, knowing that Lin Fan, the buyer of an entire Tangchen Yipin building, was not someone they could afford to mess with!
Little Fang even began to tremble. If she had known how powerful Lin Fan was, she would never have been so dismissive of him before, but now it was too late to regret.
Lin Fan could imagine the reactions of everyone once they knew his true identity.
But he had no interest in staying to watch them embarrass themselves.
To him, these people were all insignificant, including his junior high school goddess, Little Fang. Not to mention he had long lost interest in Little Fang, even if he hadn’t, her behavior today would have been enough to chill his heart.
Lin Fan and Miss Chen arrived downstairs, where Lin Fan retrieved his electric bike and casually tossed the bag of keys into the delivery box.
Seeing this, Miss Chen discreetly wiped some cold sweat from her brow; those were the keys to an entire Tangchen Yipin building, yet Lin Fan tossed them as if they were mere cabbage!
Just how wealthy is this Lin Fan? Could he be a super tycoon?
And this super tycoon is actually, as the records suggest, delivering food!
Is this some kind of rich person’s eccentricity, enjoying pretending to be poor?
"Mr. Lin, would you like to go over to Building A to check out its occupancy?" Miss Chen asked.
Lin Fan said, "Sure."
Lin Fan pushed his electric bike and followed Miss Chen to Building A.
According to Miss Chen’s introduction, Tangchen Yipin’s Building A has a total of 40 units, of which 3 have already been rented out, fetching a monthly rent of 100,000 each.
Miss Chen said, "These units were rented out by the previous owner. Now that Mr. Lin is the owner, if you don’t want to rent them out, you can reclaim them at any time."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay. I couldn’t possibly live in all those units by myself. Renting them out and collecting rent isn’t a bad idea."
Each unit rents for 100,000 a month. If he rented out all 40 units, he could earn at least 4 million each month!
Suddenly gaining 4 million!
Being a landlord collecting rent here is simply delightful!
At that moment, a Bentley Flying Spur worth nearly 3 million pulled up beneath Building A. A pot-bellied middle-aged man, accompanied by a long-legged Little Mi, intended to view the apartment with the agent’s guidance.
"I want to look at the place we saw yesterday again!" The middle-aged man displayed a demeanor full of money and influence.
The agent smiled apologetically, "Mr. Gu, that apartment has already been sold. We do have other units; shall I show you both something else?"
The middle-aged man’s face darkened, "What, sold already? I don’t care; I had my eye on that one. Even if it’s been sold, I want to buy it back. Take us in now and immediately call that buyer!"
The agent dared not offend this wealthy person and had to agree reluctantly.
Suddenly, Lin Fan pushed his electric bike to Building A and passed in front of the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man, seeing Lin Fan was a delivery guy, immediately showed a disdainful expression and scolded, "You poor idiot, you’re blocking my way!"

chapters.title: Chapter 84: The Arrogant Billionaire
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: The Arrogant Billionaire
Lin Fan paused his steps, turned his head to glance at the middle-aged man, and said, "Who are you calling a broke bastard?"
The middle-aged man arrogantly replied, "I’m calling you a broke bastard!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You called me a broke bastard. Turns out, you’re the broke bastard."
The middle-aged man was momentarily stunned, then realized that Lin Fan had trapped him with words, and sneered, "Poor kid, all you can do is boast with words. Whoever’s poor will be embarrassed!"
The young woman beside him giggled, "President Zhang, why bother wasting words on this lowlife? People like him don’t even know what wealth looks like."
The middle-aged man laughed heartily, "You’re right. Well, today I’ll show him! Hey pauper, we’re thirsty, go buy us a bottle of water!"
He spoke in a commanding tone, as if Lin Fan were his servant.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m thirsty too. How about you lend me your little plaything to quench my thirst?"
Everyone present were adults, and naturally, they immediately understood Lin Fan’s words.
The middle-aged man was furious, "What did you say?"
The young woman blushed with anger, "President Zhang, this guy is taking advantage of me, you have to stand up for me."
The middle-aged man reached into his pocket and pulled out a wad of red bills; at a glance, they totaled at least several thousand!
"Poor kid, there’s 30,000 in cash here. Help us buy drinks, and it’s yours!" the middle-aged man said, with a superior air.
The people around were amazed.
This President Zhang is really throwing money around—offering 30,000 just for buying drinks!
Though it obviously intended to humiliate Lin Fan, who wouldn’t welcome such ’humiliation’?
The young woman giggled, "I bet this pauper has never seen that much cash in his life. He should hurry up and thank President Zhang for the reward!"
She thought that in front of 30,000, Lin Fan would surely give in. After all, who could refuse money, especially a pauper like him, whose legs must have turned to jelly.
However, Lin Fan stood firm and chuckled, "You’re overthinking. You expect me to fetch drinks for just 30,000?"
What?
The nearby broker broke out in a cold sweat. This delivery guy actually refused!
Earning 30,000 just like that, this kid values pride too much. What does pride matter in the face of 30,000!
The broker couldn’t help but chuckle awkwardly, "President Zhang, how about I fetch the water for you, and you give the money to me?"
The broker eyed the wad of cash, greed gleaming in his eyes.
President Zhang ignored the broker, focused only on humiliating Lin Fan. He couldn’t believe Lin Fan wouldn’t submit to money!
He then pulled out another wad of cash from his pocket, stacking it with the 30,000.
"50,000!" President Zhang said smugly to Lin Fan. He had never encountered someone who wouldn’t yield to money. Everyone has a price, and once reached, they bow down. He had plenty of money and was sure he could smash Lin Fan down with it!
"Same conditions, get us the drinks, and the money is yours. If you kneel and call me grandpa, I’ll give you an extra 50,000, making it 100,000 in total!"
The broker’s eyes were fixed, internally screaming, I’m willing to kneel and call you ancestor, just give me the money now!
But the broker felt he had no chance. With the allure of 100,000, Lin Fan couldn’t possibly resist, right? What does dignity amount to!
But then Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Just 100,000, and you pretend to act tough in front of me? If you don’t have real skills, stop wasting my time."
What?
The broker froze. Is this kid crazy? Turning down 100,000, is pride worth more than 100,000?
Even the young woman was a bit surprised. She’d do anything for 100,000 from President Zhang, yet this delivery guy could resist the temptation of 100,000!
She saw something in Lin Fan she hadn’t seen in a long time.
Integrity!
This delivery guy might be poor, but he was poor with integrity. People like this were rare.
But what is integrity worth?
Dignity and integrity had long been discarded by her, money was more reliable and reassuring.
"President Zhang, I think he’s just face-saving, no wonder he’s stuck as a delivery boy! A true man knows when to yield; if it were me, I’d endure and take the 100,000 to start a small business, better than being a courier!" the young woman laughed.
The middle-aged man chuckled, "Broke bastard, you know nothing about my wealth. You think I’m here for no reason? I’ve come to buy luxuries here. Even the smallest set here starts from a hundred million, and I’ll buy one without batting an eye!"
The middle-aged man spoke with great pride, flaunting his wealth.
He wanted Lin Fan to realize he was a billionaire, that a mere delivery guy in front of a billionaire should kneel instantly.
But!
Lin Fan still stood firm, "Oh? You’re here to buy a house? Could it be you’re eyeing the property in Building A?"
The middle-aged man snorted arrogantly, "Correct, I’ve set my eyes on one of the houses inside and was planning to buy it today. Talking to you, this broke bastard, almost made me miss my opportunity. Broker, quickly, call the owner!"
The broker agreed and hastily pulled out his phone, ready to make a call.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need to call, the owner is right here."
The broker paused, "What?"
Miss Chen then smiled and said, "The owner is indeed here, it’s Mr. Lin right here."
Miss Chen gestured at Lin Fan.
Everyone paused in surprise, what, the owner of the house President Zhang wanted to buy was this delivery guy?
"Hahaha..." The middle-aged man suddenly burst into laughter.
The young woman laughed so hard she was trembling, "What a joke, this is hilarious, do you think we would believe that!"
Miss Chen was a bit speechless, "I’m Miss Chen from the property management office, there’s no need for me to joke with you."
The middle-aged man stopped laughing, "Miss Chen, is it? Are you really from the property management office? Your joke is too clumsy; this Building A has 40 units, and I haven’t told you which one I’m interested in, but you know the owner already?"
The young woman chuckled, "What, nothing to say now? Such a big loophole, let’s see how you smooth it over."
The middle-aged man sneered, "Forget the loophole. A deliveryman being the owner here? The joke is absurd enough."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, go ahead and make the call then."
The middle-aged man thought Lin Fan had nothing to refute, confidently said, "What are you pretending for, broke bastard? Broker, make the call!"
The broker nodded, "Got it."
He then dialed a number.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s pocket rang.
The middle-aged man, the young woman, and the broker all looked puzzled.
The broker had just made the call, and Lin Fan’s phone rang?
Coincidence!
It must be just a coincidence!
The three thought in unison.
Beep!
Lin Fan picked up the phone and casually pressed the speaker.
The broker found the call picked up on the other end, so he said, "Hello, is this Mr. Lin!"
Simultaneously, the broker’s voice came from Lin Fan’s phone, "Hello, is this Mr. Lin?"
Ah?
The middle-aged man, the young woman, and the broker were all shocked, as if they’d seen a ghost!

chapters.title: Chapter 85 Selling Luxury Homes Like Selling Cabbages
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85 Selling Luxury Homes Like Selling Cabbages
"You... you’re really the homeowner?" The agent looked at Lin Fan, his voice trembling.
He called the homeowner, but this delivery guy answered!
He could hardly believe it, too shocked.
How could the homeowner be a delivery guy?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "That’s right, I’m the homeowner."
The middle-aged man still refused to believe it, hissing, "That’s impossible, you were clearly lying earlier. How could you know who the homeowner is without knowing which house I was interested in?"
Miss Chen sweated and said, "You may not know, but I don’t need to know which one you’re interested in because this Building A, the entire building, belongs to Mr. Lin."
"What?"
"What?"
"Oh my God!"
The three were dumbfounded.
Lin Fan is the owner of the entire Tangchen Yipin building!
It’s truly shocking.
He’s just a delivery man!
The middle-aged man’s face turned pale: "How can this be, aren’t you a delivery man?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Indeed I am a delivery man. Who says delivery men can’t be rich?"
The middle-aged man was speechless.
No wonder this delivery man was unmoved by the offer of 100,000 bucks, he’s the owner of the entire Tangchen Yipin building, worth billions, perhaps even a billionaire!
Little Mi’s mouth also dropped open in shock.
He thought Lin Fan refused the 100,000 bucks because of integrity, but turns out Lin Fan simply didn’t care about it.
Looking back now, trying to shame Lin Fan with 100,000 bucks was truly embarrassing, a frog in a well, not knowing one’s limits!
As for the agent, he was so shocked he turned to stone.
As an agent, it’s not like he’s never seen a homeowner who owns a building, but this is Tangchen Yipin!
Owning a building elsewhere is not the same as owning one here!
So extravagant, really lavish, it’s the first time he’s seen such a wealthy homeowner like Lin Fan.
"So, billionaire, do you still want to buy this poor man’s house?" Lin Fan looked playfully at the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man blushed, Lin Fan’s sarcastic tone made him feel ashamed.
So ironic, he previously humiliated Lin Fan as a poor man, only to find out now that in front of Lin Fan, he is the one who is poor!
Even though he has millions worth of assets, in front of Lin Fan, he’s still a poor guy!
"Haha, um... my apologies for offending you earlier, I didn’t recognize the mountain you are, please forgive my ignorance." The middle-aged man chuckled apologetically.
He really had to chuckle apologetically!
Owning an entire Tangchen Yipin building, such a godly wealthy person, is certainly not someone he can afford to offend.
He continued, "I really like the place on the 10th floor; if Mr. Lin wants to sell, please sell it to me. Name your price."
His tone was very polite, completely different from his earlier domineering attitude.
Lin Fan said, "I originally didn’t intend to sell this building, I planned to collect rent as a landlord, but if you like it, I don’t mind selling."
The middle-aged man was overjoyed; he never expected Lin Fan to be so accommodating, not holding a grudge despite his earlier offense, even originally intending to rent it out, yet still willing to sell to him!
The middle-aged man praised, "Mr. Lin is so gracious, it makes me feel very ashamed, thank you so much."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Don’t rush to thank me, I haven’t finished speaking. I originally didn’t plan to sell, now I can sell, but I have a condition."
The middle-aged man quickly asked, "What condition?"
"Minimum sale of ten units!" Lin Fan said calmly.
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Damn!
He actually requires a minimum purchase of ten units!
That’d be at least 1 billion bucks!
The middle-aged man’s face turned green; Lin Fan set such a high threshold, clearly teasing him.
"Mr. Lin, I just need to buy one unit, can you sell just one to me?" the middle-aged man chuckled awkwardly.
Lin Fan glanced at him, "Do you ’just need’ one unit, or ’can only afford’ one unit? There’s a big difference."
The middle-aged man awkwardly said, "Haha, what difference does it make?"
Lin Fan leisurely said, "If it’s the former, I’ll give you a 10% discount, which is 900 million bucks, for ten units. If it’s the latter, it’s a different matter."
The middle-aged man wiped his cold sweat; damn, this guy treats buying luxury homes like selling cabbages, how much money does he have?
The problem is, he can’t come up with 900 million, even if he could, what would he do with ten units?
Not everyone can be as extravagant as Lin Fan, buying an entire Tangchen Yipin to rent out.
The middle-aged man’s face reddened and said, "Honestly, I... can only afford one unit."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, so you’re a poor guy who can only afford one unit, then sorry, not selling!"
The middle-aged man blushed again; damn, he, a billionaire, is being called a poor guy, yet he had no way to refute.
In front of Lin Fan, he truly is a poor man, too poor to lift his head.
Seeing the awkward situation, the agent quickly said, "Haha, well, since Mr. Lin wants to sell ten units minimum, that’s unfortunate, President Zhang, how about I show you elsewhere?"
The middle-aged man was fretting for an escape, quickly nodded.
"Mr. Lin, I’ll take my leave." The middle-aged man said politely, about to leave.
"Wait a second."
Lin Fan suddenly said.
The middle-aged man gleefully said, "Mr. Lin, did you change your mind, willing to sell the unit to me?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "No, I just feel a bit thirsty, could you do me a favor and get me a drink over there?"
Using his method against him!
This middle-aged man was so arrogant earlier, Lin Fan wouldn’t let him off so easily.
The middle-aged man’s smile stiffened, feeling extremely awkward: "Well..."
This was a blatant insult from Lin Fan; he’s a billionaire, how could he run errands for someone, especially in front of so many people, where’s his dignity?
But if he didn’t go, who knows how Lin Fan might retaliate!
Lin Fan was clearly exacting revenge for his earlier offense; if he didn’t let Lin Fan vent this anger, Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t let it go.
He didn’t want to be at odds with a billionaire!
"Haha, what kind of drink would Mr. Lin like?" the middle-aged man chuckled awkwardly.
"Mineral water will do." Lin Fan said.
The middle-aged man said, "Okay, Mr. Lin, please wait a moment."
He obediently went to the convenience store to buy water.
The remaining people didn’t dare speak, even the middle-aged man yielded; they dared not say anything.
"Miss, what’s your name?" Lin Fan suddenly looked at Little Mi, smiling.
Little Mi quickly said, "I am Duan Xiaowei."
Lin Fan said, "You’re young and beautiful, why are you with an old man? If it’s for money, there are plenty of rich young handsome guys!"
Little Mi: "..."
She’s with the middle-aged man, of course, for the money.
But Lin Fan saying it like that was a bit strange, was he implying something?
Little Mi’s heart started racing.
Lin Fan didn’t say anything else.
Soon, the middle-aged man returned with a bottle of mineral water, respectfully handing it to Lin Fan: "Mr. Lin, your water."
Lin Fan said, "Thank you, you may leave."
As he spoke, he fished two coins from his pocket and placed them in the middle-aged man’s hand.
The middle-aged man: "..."
Damn, treating me like a beggar!
The middle-aged man felt frustrated, then took his leave, accompanying Little Mi and following the agent out; he regretted it so much, had he known, he wouldn’t have provoked Lin Fan, resulting in a huge embarrassment.
Afterward, the middle-aged man found a unit in another building and bought it.
After buying the unit, the middle-aged man drove away in his 3 million Bentley, with Little Mi by his side.
"Little Wei, what’s wrong? You bought a house, aren’t you happy? Why do you seem preoccupied?" the middle-aged man frowned.
He didn’t know, Little Mi couldn’t stop thinking about what Lin Fan said to her.
"Let’s break up!" Little Mi suddenly said.
The middle-aged man’s expression changed: "What?"
He just spent 100 million to buy a luxury home, and Little Mi wanted to break up with him? What the heck is going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Encounter with Lin Fan’s Beautiful Tenant
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: Encounter with Lin Fan’s Beautiful Tenant
After sending away the middle-aged man, Lin Fan and Miss Chen entered Building A.
Miss Chen pulled up the detailed information of the current three tenants and sent it to Lin Fan. Lin Fan looked it over and discovered something interesting.
All three of the current tenants turned out to be single beauties!
Handsome landlord and charming tenants, nice, nice.
Lin Fan suddenly had a bold idea, if the entire building were rented to beauties... what a spectacular sight it would be!
Collecting rent would definitely be a joy.
Speaking of collecting rent, one of the three beautiful tenants needs to pay rent tomorrow. It looks like I’ll have to come by again tomorrow.
"Miss Chen, which is the best apartment here?" Lin Fan asked.
Miss Chen replied, "That must be the penthouse duplex. It’s 1200 square meters, spacious, with unbeatable views, includes a sky garden and a large swimming pool, luxuriously decorated, just the cost of decoration was 30 million, and the whole unit sells for over 400 million."
Lin Fan was a bit surprised as it seems the value of this building is even higher than he estimated. The penthouse alone is worth over 400 million!
Then, Lin Fan and Miss Chen went to the penthouse duplex.
This apartment was indeed extremely luxurious, beautifully decorated, with an additional 200-square-meter sky garden and sky pool. The view from the penthouse balcony was unbeatable, showcasing the most prosperous side of Yun City.
A top-notch mansion like this was something Lin Fan never dared to dream of before, but now he acquired it effortlessly.
Lin Fan fell in love with this duplex at first sight and immediately decided that he wouldn’t rent it out, but keep it for himself.
After viewing the apartment, Lin Fan was about to leave as he still had to deliver food.
The entrance of Tangchen Yipin.
A Maserati drove to the entrance, waiting for the security guard to let it pass.
The driver was a 9 out of 10 long-legged beauty, standing 170 cm tall, with a model’s figure, wearing short hot pants, showing off her long white legs.
The security guard recognized the long-legged beauty as a resident of Tangchen Yipin and quickly opened the door. The residents here are either rich or noble; he can’t afford to offend any of them.
Seeing the door open, the long-legged beauty was about to start the car.
But at this moment, the security guard seemed to notice something, his expression changed, and he immediately turned around, gesturing to the long-legged beauty to wait a moment.
The long-legged beauty frowned a bit, looking over curiously.
She saw the security guard turn around, nodding and bowing respectfully, acting extremely flattering, as if the person coming was a god holding his life and death in their hands.
The long-legged beauty grew even more curious, clearly, the security guard wanted her to make way for someone!
One must know she’s not someone easy to mess with, and the security guard knows this very well, yet, he’d rather offend her than the newcomer!
Just who is coming?
Under the curious gaze of the long-legged beauty, she saw Lin Fan riding out leisurely on an electric bike.
Seeing the security guard continuously nodding and bowing, Lin Fan nodded back and then rode out of the entrance, leaving swiftly.
The security guard even chased after Lin Fan, bowing and smiling ingratiatingly, "Mr. Lin, take care!"
Only after Lin Fan left did the security guard return to normal, turning back to nod at the long-legged beauty, indicating that she could go in now.
The long-legged beauty was dumbfounded.
What a shocker!
Who would have thought it was just a delivery guy!
Even though this delivery guy looks quite handsome, he is just a delivery guy after all!
The question arises.
Why is a security guard so respectful to a delivery guy?
Even going so far as to make her give way!
The long-legged beauty was really curious. She drove her car closer to the entrance, rolled down the window, and poked her head out.
"Security brother, why did you let that delivery guy go first?" the long-legged beauty asked.
The security guard didn’t dare look directly at the long-legged beauty, lowered his head, and said, "Miss Lu, I’m really sorry for making you wait earlier."
The long-legged beauty asked, "What’s the story with that delivery guy?"
The security guard said, "Mr. Lin is also an owner here. He has the Ultimate Black Card for Tangchen Yipin and has priority passage rights."
The long-legged beauty was shocked: "What did you say, that delivery guy has the Ultimate Black Card, that’s..."
That’s unbelievable, it’s a delivery guy, how could he have a black card representing the ultimate identity!
It’s like saying a beggar by the roadside is actually a king, full of absurdity.
"What’s going on?" the long-legged beauty asked in surprise.
The security guard cautiously said, "Miss Lu, please keep your voice down. Mr. Lin is not someone to mess with. He’s the owner of the entire Building A, a billionaire."
The long-legged beauty was petrified, utterly stunned.
That delivery guy actually owns the entire Tangchen Yipin Building A!
This world is just too crazy!
The long-legged beauty came back to her senses and asked, "Did you just say it was Building A?"
The security guard said, "Yes, Building A, the entire Building A is his."
The long-legged beauty’s eyes lit up. She was currently renting in Building A!
This means, that delivery guy is her landlord!
By this time, Lin Fan had already left Tangchen Yipin and started delivering food.
The platform indicated that he had a new order, someone ordered a delivery to a company.
Lin Fan saw that the order was a bit far away and planned to hand it to a colleague and take another order instead.
However, when he tried to take a new order, the platform assigned him the same order again!
Although Lin Fan found it a bit strange, he didn’t overthink it and just took the order since he was lazy to bother.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang, a call from the customer!
Lin Fan was a bit sweaty, this customer was really impatient, calling to rush the order when he had just taken it, wanting to see him so badly?
"Hello," Lin Fan answered the call lazily.
On the other end, a sweet feminine voice said, "Big brother, when can my delivery be expected to arrive at my company?"
Lin Fan said, "About half an hour."
The female voice replied coyly, "Okay, I’ll be back at the company in about half an hour. We’ll meet then. Make sure to come on time, and remember to call me when you arrive."
The call ended shortly after.
Lin Fan received at least a hundred rush calls a day and didn’t pay much attention to it, hanging up as he continued to deliver food.
Half an hour later.
Lin Fan, carrying the delivery, arrived at an intersection. Beyond this intersection was the building where the company was located.
At the red light, Lin Fan stopped the car and waited.
In front of the building, a luxury car pulled up and stopped. A beauty, with a medium height, fair skin, and well-made-up, about an 8, stepped out of the car.
After getting out, the beauty, with an LV bag in hand, kept her head down looking at her phone as she proceeded toward the building.
At that moment, an old lady pushing a small business cart happened to pass by the beauty, brushing against her.
The beauty was absorbed in her phone and didn’t notice the old lady, directly colliding with the small cart. By the time the old lady reacted and tried to evade, it was too late.
The beauty’s clothes brushed against the side of the cart.
The old lady was selling roasted chestnuts, and the cart was covered in thick soot. The beauty’s clothes instantly turned pitch black.
"Ah!"
The waking beauty exclaimed in shock when she saw the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: The Offensive Shrew Initiates Goodwill
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87: The Offensive Shrew Initiates Goodwill
妻子 quickly apologized: "I’m sorry, miss."
The beauty was furious, pointing at the wife and cursing: "I am so angry, you dead old lady, how do you walk, do you know how expensive my clothes are, can you afford to pay for them!"
The wife was a bit frightened and said: "I can help you clean them, miss."
The beauty cursed: "Let you clean them? With your dirty hands, don’t make my clothes dirty!"
Such insults from the beauty toward an old lady drew the attention of passersby, who began to point fingers.
The beauty grew increasingly angry, kicking out and sending the wife’s pot flying with a bang, the pot hit the ground, spilling sugar-roasted chestnuts everywhere.
"Dead old lady, consider this a lesson, watch where you’re walking next time!" The beauty sneered, turned around, and angrily stormed into the building.
"What’s wrong with that woman!"
"Bully the elderly, how low is her character!"
"I saw it, she was clearly looking down at her phone when she bumped into the wife’s cart, it’s her fault!"
"Evil people are the first to complain!"
The passersby scolded, but none stepped forward to help the wife.
Seeing her pot fallen and sugar-roasted chestnuts spilled on the ground, the wife was heartbroken, wiped tears, and didn’t dare argue with the beauty, hurriedly squatting down to pick up the sugar-roasted chestnuts from the ground.
"Old lady, let me help you."
A voice suddenly said.
Lin Fan parked the car, came directly to the wife’s side, and squatted down to help pick up the sugar-roasted chestnuts.
He saw the scene just now, that woman was really too much, as soon as the red light turned, he hurried over, unfortunately, the woman had left.
The wife gratefully said: "Young man, thank you, you’re really kind-hearted."
Lin Fan smiled: "It’s the right thing to do, unfortunately, that vicious woman got away, otherwise I’d definitely help you vent your anger."
The wife quickly said: "Please don’t, young man, I see that you’re a delivery person, that woman drives a car, don’t provoke her, we poor people can’t afford to provoke the rich."
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan sighed inwardly, poor, does it mean even living has to be lower than others!
The wife, knowing the vicious woman drives a car, couldn’t utter a word despite being bullied, and could only bear it silently.
Lin Fan could understand the wife, being of an older age and having to come out to do small business, being timid and fearful is normal.
If it were him, given his temper, he’d stand his ground even against a powerful opponent.
They finally managed to pick up all the sugar-roasted chestnuts for the wife.
But this pot of sugar-roasted chestnuts, probably couldn’t be sold to the customers now.
"Wife, how do you plan to handle these sugar-roasted chestnuts?" Lin Fan asked.
The wife said: "Though we do small business, we must pay attention to hygiene, I’ll just keep this pot for myself."
Lin Fan smiled: "Let’s do this, I’ll buy this pot."
The wife froze: "You want to buy them, young man? They’re already dirty."
Lin Fan took out a red bill: "It’s okay, is 100 bucks enough?"
The wife quickly said: "It’s enough, it’s even extra, I’ll give you change."
"No need." Lin Fan waved his hand, turning around and walking away.
The wife said: "Young man, you haven’t taken the chestnuts yet."
Lin Fan was already at the building entrance, looking back with a smile: "I gave them to you, wife."
Watching Lin Fan’s back, the wife sighed: "Such a good young man, he definitely won’t always be a delivery person, he’ll accomplish great things in the future."
Lin Fan bid farewell to the wife and arrived at the company front desk where he was to deliver the food.
"Hi, delivery." Lin Fan said.
The front desk girl smiled: "It’s ordered by our manager, you send it to her office, she’s waiting inside, I’ll take you there."
The front desk girl led Lin Fan inside, leaving him at the door of an office before returning to the front desk.
Lin Fan stepped forward and knocked on the door: "Hello, your delivery is here."
A voice came from inside: "Come in, big brother."
Lin Fan pushed the door open and entered.
Inside the office, a beauty was sitting at the desk, looking up at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan froze for a moment.
Damn!
This woman, isn’t she just the vicious woman who bullied the wife downstairs earlier!
Turns out she’s his client!
At this moment, the vicious woman had already changed her clothes, the dirty clothes were simply draped over a chair.
"Big brother, thank you for your hard work." The vicious woman said coquettishly, standing up and approaching Lin Fan.
Her harmless demeanor was completely different from the one that bullied the wife earlier, if not seen firsthand, it would be hard to believe that she was that spoiled vicious woman.
She pretended really well, Lin Fan sneered inwardly.
If he hadn’t run into her, it would be fine, but since he did, sorry about it.
"Big brother, could you help me put the delivery on the coffee table?" The vicious woman said.
"Oh." Lin Fan walked over to the coffee table and placed the delivery down.
The vicious woman followed along and sat on the sofa, eyes fixedly gazing at Lin Fan, looking a little obsessed.
Lin Fan said: "Miss, is everything okay?"
The vicious woman giggled: "Everything’s fine, I’m just mesmerized by you, Brother Lin, you’re really handsome, even more so in person than on screen."
"Oh, you recognized me." Lin Fan said.
Being recognized by female fans had become not much of a novelty for him in recent days.
The vicious woman said: "Of course, you’re so handsome, I recognized you at first glance."
Lin Fan found it odd, feeling something seemed off but couldn’t quite place it.
"By the way, my name is Li Ziwei, Brother Lin, could you sit and chat with me for a while? Eating alone is so lonely." The vicious woman said pitifully.
"Alright." Lin Fan said, promptly sitting next to Li Ziwei, he was just wondering how to find an excuse to stay longer.
Being so close, a burst of womanly fragrance filled Lin Fan’s nose, if he didn’t know she was the kind of spoiled vicious woman who bullied the wife, Lin Fan might’ve felt something, but now, all Lin Fan could think about was how to teach her a lesson.
Seeing Lin Fan sit promptly, Li Ziwei thought her coquettish charm had captivated him, feeling happy.
"Brother Lin, you’re a rich person who also delivers, praised online for being humble and grounded, in my eyes, you are full of positive energy, I truly admire you." Li Ziwei laughed.
Lin Fan smiled: "In fact, I’m still delivering, just to pass some boring time, does that count as positive energy?"
Li Ziwei froze for a moment, giggled: "That definitely counts, Brother Lin, you’re still so young, many rich second-generation around your age, spend their days womanizing, while Brother Lin chose to deliver and serve society, truly a refreshing current."
Lin Fan said: "How do you know I’m not womanizing?"
Li Ziwei blushed: "Brother Lin, you clearly seem like a gentleman, but I’m curious, what type of female do you like, what do you think of someone like me?"
This was an obvious flirtation, is Brother too handsome, running into another proactive female fan?
"Type doesn’t matter, if they’re a beauty, I like them all." Lin Fan chuckled, unfortunately you’re not a beauty, your heart is too ugly.
Li Ziwei giggled: "How about me?"
As she spoke, she started to untie the delivery bag.
But the bag was tied too tightly, she couldn’t undo it.
"Let me help you." Lin Fan said, standing up and reaching to tear open the outer packaging, casually opening the delivery box.
"Thank you, Brother Lin, you’re wonderful." Li Ziwei praised.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "I think you’re not at all beautiful, not only not beautiful, you’re ugly as hell."
What?
Li Ziwei’s smile froze, what did Lin Fan mean by that?
"What did you say?" Li Ziwei said angrily.
Lin Fan chuckled: "I saw you bully the wife downstairs earlier."
Li Ziwei froze and said: "I thought it was something serious, that dead old lady, she dirtied my clothes, can’t I teach her a lesson!"
Lin Fan said: "Seems like you were playing on your phone when you hit the wife’s cart, it’s your fault, yet you blamed the wife."
Li Ziwei snorted: "So what, my clothes were dirty after all, I didn’t ask her to pay, she should be grateful, otherwise she’d pay with her life!"
"Oh."
Lin Fan said, suddenly his hand shook, and the meal box in his hand tilted, food and sauce poured over Li Ziwei’s head.
"Oh, my bad, didn’t hold it steady." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Li Ziwei, covered in sauce, was a mess, raging and embarrassed, Lin Fan wasn’t being careless, he clearly did it on purpose, using food to pour over her head!
Li Ziwei jumped up angrily: "Lin Fan, what are you doing, do you know who I am!"

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Resigned, the lady boss cried and fainted
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: Resigned, the lady boss cried and fainted
Meituan’s Yun City branch office building.
Huang Qing was sitting in the branch manager’s office, suddenly stood up and exclaimed, "What did you say, Lin Fan is this formidable?"
Standing opposite him was Manager Li, the branch manager, who was also his brother-in-law and Li Ziwei’s father.
Because Manager Li was familiar with Yun City, Huang Qing instructed him to gather information about Lin Fan.
Just now, Manager Li had shared some news about Lin Fan that left him stunned.
Manager Li said, "According to my sources, it’s indeed the case. Lin Fan has been aggressively acquiring companies in Yun City. His acquisition, Blue Moon Hand Soap Company, recently secured orders exceeding 450 million, and the city government allocated a plot of government land for him to build a factory. There are also rumors that Lin Fan is actually that super-rich man who spent tens of billions buying Yunding Manor and Chiba Island, Mr. Lin!"
Anyone who mingles in the business world in Yun City cannot have missed the legend of Mr. Lin.
Huang Qing had naturally heard of it too.
Upon hearing this, Huang Qing was deeply shocked. If Lin Fan was truly that Mr. Lin, it would mean that Meituan Group had attracted a deity.
Mr. Lin working as a deliveryman for Meituan?
Huang Qing began to doubt reality. Could this be true? Was Lin Fan actually Mr. Lin?
He didn’t dare to believe it, yet he couldn’t deny it. Suddenly, Lin Fan’s identity became even more mysterious.
Li Ziwei’s Company.
Li Ziwei was almost driven mad with anger. It was one thing for Lin Fan to call her ugly, but he also poured vegetables over her!
All she did was bully a poor old lady selling sugar-roasted chestnuts, and this was Lin Fan’s response!
She had just been trying to be friendly towards him.
"Lin Fan, you have no idea who you’ve messed with!" Li Ziwei roared.
Lin Fan replied with an "Oh": "I was just about to ask, who exactly are you, and why do you want to get close to me?"
Li Ziwei said, "My uncle is Huang Qing, your boss. If he hadn’t asked me to get close to you, would I have bothered with you?"
Lin Fan was taken aback; it was actually the Meituan boss, Huang Qing, who had Li Ziwei get close to him?
When he received this order, he felt something was off, as if it had been set up.
If it was arranged by Huang Qing, it would make sense.
"Why did President Huang want you to approach me, what’s his purpose?" Lin Fan asked coldly.
Li Ziwei snorted, "The mission has failed anyway, so I’ll be straightforward: my uncle wanted me to win you over!"
Lin Fan was aware of Huang Qing’s attempt to win him over but didn’t expect him to resort to such tactics after failing yesterday.
Lin Fan’s heart sank; he didn’t like being manipulated.
"Lin Fan, if you dare treat me like this, I’ll tell my uncle the truth and have him fire you!" Li Ziwei threatened.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Fire me, huh? Then go ahead and tell him."
Li Ziwei yelled, "Do you think I won’t dare?"
That said, Li Ziwei immediately pulled out her phone and made a call, "Uncle, it’s Ziwei, Lin Fan is no good. You have to fire him for me!"
Huang Qing was surprised, "Weiwei, what exactly happened?"
He had thought that having Li Ziwei approach Lin Fan was foolproof.
Li Ziwei replied, "He bullied me, and I got so mad I told him about you asking me to get close to him."
Huang Qing was sweating profusely, "What, he knows I used a beauty trap?"
Huang Qing regretted it; if he’d known, he wouldn’t have let Li Ziwei handle this. She was like a pig teammate, exposing him instantly.
Li Ziwei said, "Uncle, he knows now. Regardless, you have to stand up for me and fire him!"
Huang Qing didn’t want to fire Lin Fan. Making such a decision would mean turning against Lin Fan. Until Lin Fan’s identity was clear, Huang Qing didn’t want to take that step.
"Weiwei, pass the phone to Lin Fan," Huang Qing said.
Li Ziwei switched to speakerphone, "Uncle, speak!"
Huang Qing chuckled, "Lin Fan, it’s President Huang. Ziwei can be a bit willful and stubborn, so please don’t take it to heart. I think there must be a misunderstanding between you two?"
"Uncle!" Li Ziwei was furious. Her uncle didn’t fire Lin Fan and was even trying to placate him!
Lin Fan said coolly, "We haven’t misunderstood anything; I simply don’t like your niece."
Li Ziwei shouted angrily, "Stupid Lin Fan, do you think I like you?"
Ignoring her, Lin Fan continued, "President Huang, why are you toying with me, having such an ’extraordinary person’ approach me?"
Huang Qing awkwardly laughed, "Heh, I just admire your young talent, so I used this method to introduce you two, with no ulterior motives. Since it’s not a good match, just consider it as me making a mistake with good intentions. Lin Fan, I hope you won’t mind."
Li Ziwei was so angry she couldn’t speak. Her uncle didn’t fire Lin Fan and even tried to curry favor with him!
This left her utterly humiliated; she repeatedly said she’d get Lin Fan fired, only for this to happen!
Lin Fan said calmly, "I don’t blame President Huang. However, after this incident, I feel there’s no need for me to stay; I resign."
What?
Both Li Ziwei and Huang Qing were shocked.
Lin Fan actually resigned on his own!
Huang Qing was anxious, "Lin Fan, please don’t act impulsively. This matter can be discussed. How about this: I’ll come to Ziwei’s company to find you now."
Li Ziwei said, "Uncle, he’s already left."
Apparently, after saying those words, Lin Fan turned and left, clearly not wanting to waste any more time with Huang Qing.
Huang Qing couldn’t help but stamp his foot. This really was a terrible move.
"Weiwei, what exactly happened? How did you end up at odds with Lin Fan?" Huang Qing asked sternly.
Li Ziwei snorted coldly, "This Lin Fan, thinking himself so righteous, went against me over a dead old lady..."
Li Ziwei recounted what happened.
Huang Qing was furious, "I’ve always told you to temper your temper. How could you bully the elderly like that? It’s one thing to bully, but why let Lin Fan see it? You’ve ruined my big plans, do you know?"
Li Ziwei felt wronged and started crying, "Uncle, I’m your family, aren’t I? Why are you scolding me for an outsider!"
She felt so wronged. Her uncle had never scolded her, treating her as his own, yet was yelling at her like this because of Lin Fan!
Huang Qing stomped his foot, "Because he’s no ordinary person. If something goes wrong, I wouldn’t dare offend him either!"
If Lin Fan was indeed Mr. Lin, he really couldn’t afford to offend him lightly.
A person who could spend tens of billions without blinking was likely a godlike tycoon worth hundreds of billions, and such people were few in all of Huaxia.
Li Ziwei was startled, "Uncle, who exactly is he?"
Huang Qing chuckled bitterly, "I also want to know who he is."
After announcing his resignation, Lin Fan left Li Ziwei’s company dashingly.
Downstairs, Lin Fan called the station manager, "Manager, it’s Lin Fan. I’ve decided to resign; I’ll come back to handle the resignation paperwork when I’m free."
Delivery Station.
The station manager hung up the phone, looking puzzled.
Lin Fan’s sudden resignation baffled him.
The lady boss next to him said, "What’s wrong? Why do you have that Sima face, whose call was it?"
The station manager said, "It was Lin Fan; he wants to resign."
"What?"
The lady boss was shocked, collapsing to the ground, her face pale, nearly fainting on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: The Female Celebrity Invites to Dinner
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89: The Female Celebrity Invites to Dinner
Lin Fan is resigning, the money tree is flying away!
Just yesterday, thanks to Lin Fan, their site unexpectedly received the honor of an excellent site with a reward of a 100,000, Lin Fan is simply their God of Wealth, a money tree!
The site manager lit a cigarette, looked at her, and shook his head: "You, always calling me sour-faced, aren’t you just the same..."
After calling to resign, Lin Fan left on his electric scooter.
Suddenly jobless, Lin Fan really felt a bit unaccustomed.
He stopped at a red light at the intersection.
There happened to be a delivery guy next to him, who, for some reason, seemed down, sighed, and said to Lin Fan enviously, "Bro, delivering food? You’re doing well, I’m so envious of you."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "What’s there to be envious about?"
The delivery guy said, "You can still deliver food, I can’t anymore, just quit my job, it’s really too miserable."
Lin Fan responded with an "oh": "Why did you quit?"
The delivery guy sighed, "You don’t know, my family is forcing me to go back and inherit billions in assets and arranged for me to marry a rich and beautiful woman, I have no choice."
Lin Fan broke out in a sweat, this guy, so he’s pretending here.
Pretending in front of me, what a rookie.
Lin Fan heaved a long sigh: "I’m in a worse situation, I just quit my job too!"
The delivery guy asked curiously: "Why did you quit your job?"
Lin Fan said, "My family just bought me a house in Tangchen Yipin, and they insist I become a landlord and collect rent, forcing me to leave the delivery world I love, it’s really annoying."
The delivery guy stood dumbfounded.
Damn!
This pretending is way too much!
A house in Tangchen Yipin? Isn’t it worth tens of billions!
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly Lin Fan’s phone rang.
Lin Fan answered the phone: "Who’s this?"
"Is this Mr. Lin, the owner of Building A in Tangchen Yipin? I’ve taken a liking to one of your apartments and would like to rent it, is it convenient to discuss?"
The person on the other end was a female, speaking in a soft voice.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sure, how do I address you?"
The other party said, "I’m Wu Zi’er, an artist, does Mr. Lin know me?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Sorry, I don’t know you."
He had heard Miss Chen mention that many celebrities lived in Tangchen Yipin, but he didn’t know this Wu Zi’er.
Wu Zi’er was a bit embarrassed: "Hehe, it’s okay if you don’t know me, you’ll know soon. I mainly want to assure you. By the way, I’ve taken a liking to the apartment on the 10th floor. Are you available tomorrow to come by and sign a contract with me?"
Lin Fan said, "Let’s talk about it tomorrow."
With that, Lin Fan hung up the phone.
When the green light came on, Lin Fan turned to the delivery guy and said, "I’m off."
He drove off on his electric scooter.
But the delivery guy next to him was already kneeling, looking dazed.
He had heard the call just now.
For crying out loud!
It’s actually true!
This kid really owns a house in Tangchen Yipin!
And it was Wu Zi’er who wanted to rent Lin Fan’s house?
He knew Wu Zi’er, she was a somewhat famous female celebrity, very beautiful!
There are always stronger hands among the strong ones, always a mountain higher than the other!
The delivery guy was instantly envious to death of Lin Fan, suddenly feeling that his billion-dollar inheritance and rich, beautiful fiancée were not so appealing anymore.
And nearby, the owner of a private car was crying in envy.
"For god’s sake, I painstakingly run a company, looking glamorous on the surface, but in reality, I don’t make much money all year round, and these two delivery guys are richer than the other. Are delivery guys all this rich nowadays? I should deliver food too!"
By this time, Lin Fan was already far away.
Who would’ve thought, he had just quit his job as a delivery person, intending to become a landlord, and so soon he got his first business deal.
And the tenant was a female artist, so since she’s an artist, she’s probably a beauty, right?
Back in the apartment, feeling bored, Lin Fan pulled out his phone and casually searched online.
Wu Zi’er, a somewhat famous female celebrity, really pretty.
Lin Fan felt quite pleased in his heart, yet another beautiful tenant.
Suddenly, a WeChat notification popped up.
"Lin Fan, do you remember me?"
Lin Fan looked, it was from Liu Sisi.
A few days ago, he met the female celebrity Liu Sisi, and she had proactively added him on WeChat, although they hadn’t been in touch since then.
Lin Fan didn’t expect Liu Sisi to contact him so out of the blue.
"I remember, you’re Sisi, what’s up?" Lin Fan immediately replied with a message.
Liu Sisi quickly replied with a surprised emoji: "Great, I thought you wouldn’t remember me! Actually, I’ve always wanted to find you, but I’ve been busy with company events and didn’t have the time."
Lin Fan was a bit surprised that Liu Sisi had been thinking about him, he really didn’t expect that.
Liu Sisi sent another message: "I want to see you, are you free tonight? How about we go out for a meal?"
A female celebrity inviting him to dinner!
It’s pretty much the first time in Lin Fan’s life.
Coincidentally, he had just resigned today and nothing was going on, so he was free anyway.
Lin Fan replied, "How could I refuse the invitation of a beauty."
Liu Sisi replied with a happy emoji: "Great, then let’s not see each other until tonight. I’ll send you the time and place in a bit."
Lin Fan replied, "Okay."
The conversation ended, and feeling a bit tired, Lin Fan tossed his phone aside and lay down on the sofa to nap.
He did not know, meanwhile, Liu Sisi was bouncing with joy.
Lin Fan agreed to have dinner with her!
Since she met Lin Fan that day, she couldn’t forget this handsome and macho delivery guy, Lin Fan was really too handsome, the most handsome guy she had ever seen, way more handsome than those pretty boy celebrities she knew.
Moreover, Lin Fan was rich, having bought a street of luxury goods, driving a 70 million supercar!
Young, handsome, and rich, he’s truly one in a million.
What she didn’t expect was that in just a few days, Lin Fan would become popular.
That night, Lin Fan was on four trending searches in one burst, she saw them all.
Even though Lin Fan wasn’t a celebrity, his level of viral fame far outshone hers as a female celebrity!
Besides being young, rich, and handsome, Lin Fan now had another trait—justice!
The way he disciplined that snake-like face was unbelievably handsome!
Many women were claiming to be Lin Fan’s fangirls, and Liu Sisi was no exception, she, a dignified female celebrity, had actually become Lin Fan’s fan!
She kept thinking about Lin Fan, finally had some free time today, and immediately sent him a WeChat message, wanting to have dinner with him.
Initially, she was worried, fearing that Lin Fan would refuse her, so she was overjoyed when he agreed, as you can imagine.
She immediately became incredibly excited with anticipation.
Lin Fan woke up from his nap, saw Liu Sisi’s message, and confirmed the time and place of the date.
Upon checking the time, realizing it was almost time, Lin Fan changed into some casual clothes and rode his electric scooter to the meeting.
He actually considered driving the Koenigsegg, but now everyone knew it was his, it was too ostentatious, going out on a date with a celebrity, better to keep a low profile.
As night fell, Lin Fan arrived at the restaurant where they were to meet.
At the restaurant entrance, a waitress was greeting guests, when she saw Lin Fan’s outfit from head to toe in bargain clothes, she was indifferent and looked at him with her nose up.
When Lin Fan unintentionally revealed his Rolex on his wrist, the waitress’s eyes lit up, and she immediately plastered on a smile and moved toward him.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: The Snide Actress
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: The Snide Actress
The waiter, who had been looking down her nose, immediately became respectful upon seeing Lin Fan wearing a Rolex, and hurriedly approached to greet him.
"Welcome, sir. Are you by yourself? Do you have a seat?" The waiter asked enthusiastically.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I have an appointment."
As he spoke, he had already entered the store, glanced around, and immediately spotted Liu Sisi.
"I see her." Lin Fan nodded, signaling the waiter not to bother him, and walked over to Liu Sisi.
The waiter was a bit reluctant to let him go. Lin Fan wearing a Rolex was clearly a rich man, and he was also very handsome. She really wanted to get to know him.
However, this handsome guy didn’t even glance at her, even though she was the most attractive waitress in the restaurant.
"Little Cui, why are you staring at him like that? Sure, he’s handsome, but he seems pretty poor, doesn’t he?" Another female waiter teased as she came over.
The waitress, called Little Cui, said dreamily, "What do you know? He has a Rolex, he’s a rich man!"
The other waiter exclaimed and curiously asked, "Do you think he’s single?"
Little Cui said, "That depends on who he’s having dinner with now."
The two of them watched Lin Fan, only to see him walk straight to Liu Sisi’s table.
When Liu Sisi saw Lin Fan, she beamed with joy, looking just like a schoolgirl in her first love, so sweet it was almost saccharine.
Little Cui sighed with disappointment; it seemed she had no chance, no wonder Lin Fan didn’t even glance at her. His girlfriend was so pretty!
The other female waiter was taken aback when she saw Liu Sisi: "This beauty looks familiar, like a female celebrity. But she’s not that famous, I can’t recall her name right now."
Little Cui felt a bit desperate; no way, the handsome guy’s girlfriend was a female celebrity! Compared to a celebrity, she had no competitiveness at all.
By this time, Liu Sisi and Lin Fan were already sitting across from each other.
Tonight, Liu Sisi wasn’t dressed up in any grand way, just her everyday attire, but it didn’t hide her beauty at all—she was the type of beauty that seemed to shine.
Yet this proper female celebrity, in Lin Fan’s presence, behaved like a brainless fan chasing her idol, staring at Lin Fan with infatuation.
She felt that Lin Fan looked even more handsome than he did a few days ago.
"Lin Fan, finally I get to see you. I was worried you wouldn’t come," Liu Sisi said with a smile.
Looking at the stunning female celebrity in front of him, Lin Fan naturally felt pleased. Compared to her heavily made-up look the other day, Liu Sisi’s casual attire today made her appear very pure and cute, and such a side probably could only be seen in private.
"How could I not come when a big celebrity invites me to dinner, especially since you’re my idol," Lin Fan smiled slightly.
That day, he had indeed pretended to be her fan to ask for her autograph.
Liu Sisi giggled: "Lin Fan, you don’t have to lie to me. I actually knew that day you were asking for someone else, pretending to be my fan. You didn’t even know who I was before, did you?"
Lin Fan awkwardly scratched his nose: "You knew I was pretending, but why did you still sign for me?"
Liu Sisi laughed: "Because you’re handsome, and since you’re a delivery guy, how dare I not sign for you? If it got online, people would definitely say I don’t respect delivery people."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, I see. Being a celebrity isn’t easy, huh."
Liu Sisi said, "That’s right. Like tonight, if people knew I was having dinner with you alone, they’d definitely spread rumors about us dating. For a small artist like me who’s on the rise, a single rumor could ruin my career."
Lin Fan sweatdropped: "That’s so exaggerated. But you still wanted to come out and eat with me?"
Liu Sisi smiled sweetly: "Because it’s you, it’s worth the risk. You’re a big celebrity now, way more famous than me. You’re the richest and the handsomest delivery guy who wouldn’t want to meet you?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "I’m not a delivery guy anymore."
Liu Sisi was a bit surprised: "Since when?"
Lin Fan said, "Just today, I quit."
Liu Sisi laughed: "You’re so rich, are you planning to focus on being a wealthy person since you’re not doing deliveries anymore?"
Lin Fan was about to tell her that he had inherited a unit at Tangchen Yipin and planned to be a landlord for a while.
Just then, a beautiful woman suddenly approached them.
"Oh, isn’t it Miss Liu? What a small world, running into you everywhere!" The woman glanced at Liu Sisi, speaking in a taunting tone.
Seeing this woman, Liu Sisi’s smile disappeared, as if her good mood had been spoiled.
Liu Sisi said coldly: "If you don’t want to see me, just go away. I don’t want to see you either, so can you please leave swiftly?"
The woman chuckled: "Oh, so the supposedly good-tempered Miss Liu has such a fiery temper. Is your good temper just a persona?"
