Liu Sisi was a bit angry and said, "Stop spouting nonsense here. Aren’t you bored? I don’t have the time to entertain you!"
Lin Fan glanced at the woman, feeling a sense of familiarity but couldn’t remember who she was.
The woman also seemed to notice Lin Fan for the first time, glanced at him up and down with disdain; just a poor guy in street market clothes!
Although Lin Fan seemed somewhat familiar, as if she’d seen him somewhere, the sight of his street market clothes made her lose interest in engaging with him.
"So, I’m disturbing a big celebrity’s meal. Which pretty boy did the star bring along, huh? Everyone knows you like handsome men, but I didn’t expect you’d stoop so low. Can’t believe you’d even go for such a poor one, are all your finances spent on keeping this pretty boy?" The woman mocked relentlessly.
Liu Sisi was so angry she turned red: "Wu Zi’er, enough!"
Wu Zi’er!
Lin Fan remembered. He had just seen this woman’s photo today; her name was Wu Zi’er, and she was also an artist!
And it was Wu Zi’er who had called him today, wanting to rent his place in Tangchen Yipin!
What a coincidence.
Lin Fan frowned slightly, having seen online that Wu Zi’er was quite pretty with a decent reputation. He didn’t expect her real-life persona to be so sharp-tongued, as if she had a grudge against Liu Sisi.
Wu Zi’er and Liu Sisi belonged to the same company, and the two had always been competitors, with Wu Zi’er seeing Liu Sisi as her biggest rival.
Seeing Liu Sisi angry only fueled Wu Zi’er’s energy, as if she was purposefully trying to annoy her.
"Did I say something wrong? Where did all your money go? Don’t you earn as much as I do? But look at yourself, still living in the small apartment the company rents for you, while I’m about to move into Tangchen Yipin!" Wu Zi’er said smugly.
Liu Sisi indeed still lived in a small apartment, not having enough money to rent a bigger place, something Wu Zi’er indeed had her beat in.
"Where my money goes, it’s not as you said. If you really want to know, I’ll tell you. I donated it to charity. My family was poor when I was young, couldn’t even afford schooling. I swore that once I had money, I’d change that situation, so I built a school for kids in mountain areas," Liu Sisi said blandly.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 Playing with a Female Celebrity, I Really Didn’t Lie to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91 Playing with a Female Celebrity, I Really Didn’t Lie to You
Liu Sisi said this not to show off but to counter Wu Zi’er’s slander with facts.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised; he hadn’t expected Liu Sisi to do such a good deed. She’s a very young actress, not very famous, and her earnings must be limited, yet she could contribute money to build schools in mountain areas. Truly remarkable.
Lin Fan suddenly found himself seeing her in a new light.
However, Wu Zi’er laughed coldly, "Well, you’re really a complete fool. With that money, you couldn’t find something better to do? Building schools—those poor mountain people aren’t your concern. It’s a waste of money! A fool like you deserves no mansion to live in, you brought this on yourself!"
Hearing such harsh words, Lin Fan couldn’t help but say, "Haha, Miss Actress, you’re wrong to say that. It’s Sisi’s money, she can spend it however she wants. It’s none of your business."
Wu Zi’er gave Lin Fan a contemptuous look; to her, someone dressed in cheap market goods like Lin Fan was exactly the type of person she despised.
Poor people!
Wu Zi’er sneered, "You pitiful poor man, do you even have the right to speak here? Look at yourself—what makes you think you can speak to me?"
Lin Fan was Liu Sisi’s idol, and being insulted by Wu Zi’er made Liu Sisi angry, "Wu Zi’er, shut your mouth! If you have something to say, deal with me directly, but don’t insult him!"
Wu Zi’er acted as if she’d discovered a new world, "Oh, little girl, you’re actually defending this pathetic man. Could it be that you’ve really hooked up? A star keeping a poor pretty boy—that’s major news."
Liu Sisi’s face turned crimson, "Stop talking nonsense! We’re just friends, having a meal together, not dating!"
Though she did want to date Lin Fan, she wasn’t.
Wu Zi’er sneered, "You better not, the company rules say we can’t date. If you dare break the rule, you’re finished."
Liu Sisi replied, "I don’t need you to tell me. Stop pretending to be a good person. Please go away, don’t disturb me while I’m having a meal with my friend."
Wu Zi’er scoffed, "As if I care. If I hadn’t bumped into you while eating, ruining my mood, I wouldn’t bother with you. Anyway, I’m soon moving to Tangchen Yipin, and you can go on being a fool, building useless schools, living in your little apartment, and making some pathetic friends!"
Liu Sisi felt a little embarrassed, her eyes reddened. She had spent her money to build schools in the mountains, but Wu Zi’er only mocked her for it. Wu Zi’er had no heart.
Seeing this, Lin Fan gave a slight smile, "Wu Zi’er, right? Who says Sisi lives in a small apartment? She’ll soon be moving to a mansion too."
Once he said this, both Wu Zi’er and Liu Sisi were stunned.
Liu Sisi: "???"
When did I plan to move to a mansion? Why didn’t I know about this?
Wu Zi’er mocked, "You pathetic man, stop bluffing me. She spent all her money building schools for poor kids; where would she get money to move into a mansion?"
Lin Fan gestured to Liu Sisi to hold off her questions and smiled, "It’s true, I’m not lying. Not only is Sisi moving to a mansion, coincidentally, she’s moving to Tangchen Yipin too."
Wu Zi’er froze for a moment, then burst into laughter, clutching her stomach, "Oh my, that’s hilarious! At least make your lies plausible. She’s moving to Tangchen Yipin? Where would she get the money?"
Liu Sisi understood that Lin Fan was trying to bluff Wu Zi’er, to help her stand up to her. But Lin Fan’s bluff seemed a bit exaggerated, quickly exposed by Wu Zi’er. Instead of helping, it only made Wu Zi’er ridicule her even more.
After all, she really couldn’t afford to live in Tangchen Yipin.
Yet Lin Fan remained calm, smiling, "Let me finish. Sisi really will move to Tangchen Yipin, and I know the unit you were interested in—you won’t be renting it."
Wu Zi’er frowned. This pathetic man actually said she couldn’t rent the unit at Tangchen Yipin, and he said it with such calm, it didn’t seem like he was bluffing.
"You’re talking nonsense!" Wu Zi’er couldn’t help but scold angrily.
The calmer Lin Fan was, the more annoyed she became.
This damned pauper, talking like he’s making sense, when it’s clearly absurd, yet he makes it sound all true. It really was infuriating.
Lin Fan said, "You don’t believe me? If you don’t believe, why not call the owner to check? I’m really not bluffing you."
Seeing Lin Fan "bluffing" Wu Zi’er so earnestly was amusing to Liu Sisi; she couldn’t help but snicker.
Wu Zi’er was furious, "You damned pauper, keep making things up! This is absurd, why should I check based on what you say? Who do you think you are?"
Lin Fan calmly replied, "You’re called Wu Zi’er, right? Today at noon, you called the owner saying you wanted to rent the 10th-floor unit in Block A at Tangchen Yipin, didn’t you?"
"Ah?"
Wu Zi’er was stunned, eyes widening in surprise at Lin Fan, "Who are you, and how do you know this?"
This pauper in front of her actually knew she’d called the owner and knew about the Block A unit she intended to rent. How was that possible?
Lin Fan didn’t answer Wu Zi’er’s question, only said, "Can you now verify it?"
Wu Zi’er, totally puzzled by Lin Fan, didn’t even need him to urge her. She already wanted to check it out thoroughly.
So, Wu Zi’er immediately took out her phone and made a call.
Ring, ring...
Just as Wu Zi’er called, Lin Fan’s phone suddenly rang.
Lin Fan picked up the phone to answer, simultaneously looking at Wu Zi’er, smiling, "Hello."
"Ah!"
Wu Zi’er reacted as if she’d seen a ghost, her phone dropping to the floor in shock.
After a while, she regained her composure, staring straight at Lin Fan, speaking with a tremble, "Mr. Lin?"
She’d called the owner, but Lin Fan picked up the call!
This pauper she’d looked down upon was actually the owner of Tangchen Yipin?
Lin Fan put away his phone, laughing lightly, "Now you’ve finally figured it out."
Wu Zi’er was already dumbfounded.
But Liu Sisi also felt puzzled, asking, "Lin Fan, what exactly is going on?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s simple. The Tangchen Yipin unit she wanted to rent, I happen to be the owner."
Liu Sisi paused, unable to suppress a laugh, "What a coincidence!"
She knew Lin Fan was super rich, so it wasn’t strange if he owned property at Tangchen Yipin.
But Wu Zi’er really got what she deserved. Lin Fan was the owner, and she’d just offended him thoroughly; naturally, as the owner, Lin Fan had every right to refuse renting to her.
It was so satisfying!
Lin Fan said, "I’ve already decided not to rent that unit to her, instead leasing it to you."
Liu Sisi was surprised, "Rent it to me?"
Lin Fan mentioned she would move to Tangchen Yipin, so that’s what he meant?
But she couldn’t afford such a pricey place like Tangchen Yipin.
When Lin Fan said he would lease the unit she wanted to Liu Sisi, Wu Zi’er almost exploded in fury.
This Lin Fan was truly infuriating!
Can’t really blame her—how could she have known that someone dressed in cheap clothes was the owner of Tangchen Yipin!
If she’d known earlier, she would never have provoked Lin Fan.
It’s all Lin Fan’s fault; being rich yet dressing in cheap clothes!
"Mr. Lin, I was wrong before, and I apologize. I was the one who saw that unit first; just keep renting it to me," Wu Zi’er bit her lip in frustration, softening her tone to almost begging; she really liked that unit.
But Lin Fan replied calmly with just two words, "Not renting."
Seeing that Lin Fan wouldn’t give her face even when she humbled herself, Wu Zi’er stomped her foot in anger, lost the appetite for her meal, and left in a huff.
However, not long after, Wu Zi’er quietly returned, too angry to let it go, stealthily pulling out her phone to take pictures of Liu Sisi and Lin Fan dining together.
Meanwhile, a waitress named Little Cui was hiding nearby, secretly recording Wu Zi’er’s actions on her phone...

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Wu Zi’er Secretly Takes Photos
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: Wu Zi’er Secretly Takes Photos
Lin Fan chased away Wu Zi’er, making Liu Sisi feel relieved. That Wu Zi’er was too hateful, even mocking her for donating money.
If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she would have been bullied by Wu Zi’er.
"Lin Fan, thank you for helping me." Liu Sisi said, blushing, genuinely grateful to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "No need to thank me. That Wu Zi’er is too annoying, interrupting my meal; I wanted to get rid of her too."
Liu Sisi giggled, "Did you see her face when you said you wouldn’t rent the house to her? I’ve never seen Wu Zi’er look so defeated; it was so satisfying!"
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Is Wu Zi’er usually very arrogant?"
Liu Sisi responded, "Yes, she’s a Rich Second Generation. Her family has shares in our Company, so nobody dares to offend her. She often bullies people, and no one in the Company hasn’t been scolded by her. We’re like water and fire; since I’m a bit more popular than her, she sees me as a thorn in her side."
Lin Fan sweated; it seems being a celebrity isn’t easy at all.
"Then after what happened tonight, won’t she hate you even more?" Lin Fan asked.
Liu Sisi replied, "It’s fine. I’m used to it. If she hates me a bit more, it’s nothing."
Lin Fan said, "Alright then."
Liu Sisi smiled charmingly, "Lin Fan, let’s not talk about her. Let’s talk about something happy. I’ll show you some photos. The school I funded in the mountainous area is almost complete."
Liu Sisi took out her phone and opened the album to show Lin Fan.
Photo after photo, there were pictures of the teaching buildings, the classrooms, and the innocent smiles of some mountain children.
"The school is about to be completed. These kids are so happy knowing they can attend school soon," Liu Sisi said happily. The mountain children’s happiness made her happy too.
Seeing her smile as beautiful as a flower, Lin Fan was also touched. What a beautiful and kind-hearted young lady.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I see these children are in tattered clothes. How about this: once the school is completed, I’ll send them a batch of new clothes."
Liu Sisi joyfully said, "Alright, I’ll thank you on their behalf."
Lin Fan is a person with a sense of justice, and he has a very kind heart. Liu Sisi liked Lin Fan even more, befitting the idol she admired so much.
Lin Fan said, "Also, when you’re free, you can move to Tangchen Yipin. I mentioned renting you the apartment Wu Zi’er wanted."
Liu Sisi, a bit embarrassed, said, "Well... I really don’t have the money. I’ve heard Tangchen Yipin is quite expensive."
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, it’s indeed expensive, 100,000 yuan a month."
Liu Sisi clicked her tongue, "That’s too expensive. How could I afford to live there?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It is expensive, but for you, I won’t charge rent."
Liu Sisi was shocked and quickly said, "I mustn’t. I can’t stay for free without contributing. Besides, you also need to make money."
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay. This amount of money is nothing. The whole building of Tangchen Yipin is mine. Giving you a unit still leaves me with 39 more."
What?
Liu Sisi was shocked. Just how wealthy is Lin Fan to own the entire Tangchen Yipin building!
No wonder he said she could live there for free without batting an eye.
Indeed, the 100,000 yuan she sees is a completely different concept for Lin Fan, perhaps like 10 yuan for an ordinary person.
However, even so, she still felt embarrassed to live in Lin Fan’s apartment for free.
After all, in her eyes, 100,000 yuan is a lot of money. Living rent-free would leave her feeling guilty.
"Lin Fan, I’ve already paid for the school construction. Soon, I’ll have money coming in. When I do, I’ll rent your apartment. Please reserve it for me," Liu Sisi said.
Lin Fan laughed heartily, "Alright, I’ll keep it for you."
If Liu Sisi really accepted living there rent-free, he would also let her stay, but her insistence on paying made Lin Fan admire her even more.
She’s not just beautiful but also very proud and self-reliant, just like Lin Fan himself.
They exchanged a knowing smile.
"Lin Fan, let’s order some food. I’m a bit hungry," Liu Sisi said with a smile.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sure, what do you feel like eating?"
The two started ordering food. Throughout the meal, they chatted and laughed, enjoying themselves immensely.
Liu Sisi found that she and Lin Fan had endless things to talk about and wanted to continue spending time with him and chatting.
But the meal eventually came to an end.
Liu Sisi went to the restroom, and Lin Fan beckoned the waitress to settle the bill.
The waitress, Little Cui, came over, "Sir, do you need anything?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Can you help us with the bill?"
"Um..." Little Cui hesitated, seemingly having more to say.
Lin Fan curiously asked, "You seem like you have something to tell me?"
Little Cui said, "Well, look."
Little Cui took out her phone and opened a video, "Earlier, I unintentionally saw Wu Zi’er sneaking around filming you two. After thinking about it, I decided to let you know."
Lin Fan looked, and sure enough, there was Wu Zi’er in the video, snapping secret pictures of them before immediately leaving the restaurant.
Who knows what Wu Zi’er was plotting?
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you. Can you send me this video?"
Little Cui smiled, "Sure, add me on WeChat."
Lin Fan readily took out his phone and added Little Cui as a friend.
Little Cui was overjoyed. She just wanted a reason to add Lin Fan on WeChat and finally succeeded!
Lin Fan received the video sent by Little Cui.
"By the way, how did you manage to catch Wu Zi’er on camera?" Lin Fan, suddenly curious, asked.
Little Cui blushed instantly, "I..."
At that moment, she was planning to secretly photograph Lin Fan. A rich and handsome man like Lin Fan was hard to resist.
"It was just a coincidence. Let me settle the bill for you." Little Cui said, blushing, before running away.
Lin Fan found it amusing. He could tell that this waitress initially looked down on him, but upon realizing he was wealthy, she immediately changed her attitude and became enthusiastic. She probably intended to secretly photograph him earlier.
But it doesn’t matter; she managed to capture Wu Zi’er’s actions, helping them out in the process.
Liu Sisi returned and curiously asked, "Lin Fan, do you know that waitress?"
Lin Fan said, "I’ll tell you about it later."
Subsequently, Lin Fan paid the bill and left the restaurant with Liu Sisi.
Lin Fan showed Liu Sisi the video of Wu Zi’er secretly filming them.
Liu Sisi’s expression changed, "What is Wu Zi’er up to?"
Lin Fan said, "She came back to secretly film us, definitely with some scheme in mind. What do you think it might be?"
Liu Sisi frowned, "You can see she’s very resentful of me tonight. She definitely wants to cause trouble and take revenge on me, but what she’s planning, I can’t figure out right now."
Lin Fan said, "In any case, just be careful. If anything happens, let me know. Whatever she’s planning, I won’t let her succeed."

chapters.title: Chapter 93: The Scandal That Shook the Entertainment Industry
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: The Scandal That Shook the Entertainment Industry
Hearing Lin Fan say this, Liu Sisi felt a bit more at ease and smiled sweetly, "With your words, I’m not afraid of anything."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Then you should go back and rest early, I have to go back too."
After speaking, Lin Fan walked towards his electric scooter.
Liu Sisi sighed in her heart, such a super-rich guy like Lin Fan is so down-to-earth, even riding an electric scooter—he’s truly a breath of fresh air among the wealthy.
She’s met plenty of rich people in the entertainment industry, but Lin Fan really is the most unique one. That’s also what she likes most about him.
Ah, how she wished she could ride on his electric scooter and go back with him.
But that idea is really too dangerous for a female celebrity.
The company rules state that she can’t date.
So, even though she really, really likes Lin Fan, she can only keep it at the level of friends. Despite having the urge to run off with him, she ultimately restrained herself.
She watched helplessly as Lin Fan walked away.
Lin Fan’s thoughts weren’t much different from Liu Sisi’s.
He originally thought Liu Sisi was just a pretty actress, beautiful and nothing more. But after tonight’s interaction, he learned a lot about her and gained a newfound appreciation for this actress.
Unfortunately, with the contractual restrictions on her, she’s not allowed to date, so he could only maintain his distance from her.
Lin Fan returned to his apartment, took a shower, and went to bed.
The night passed without incident.
The next day, Lin Fan was still asleep.
A piece of news, however, stirred up quite a storm in the entertainment circle.
"Actress Liu Sisi spotted dining with a mysterious man, suspected of being in a relationship!"
This news quickly made it to the top searches on Weibo, soon skyrocketing to number one.
A photo of Liu Sisi having dinner with a stranger spread like wildfire. In the photo, Liu Sisi’s face was clearly visible, while the mysterious man was only shown from the back.
Obviously, the photo was taken at a carefully chosen angle, perfectly capturing Liu Sisi, leaving no room for denial.
As the photo circulated, it was accompanied by exaggerated descriptions, rumors ran rampant.
Some even speculated that Liu Sisi was financially supporting the mysterious man in the photo, citing his simple attire as evidence of his lack of wealth.
These sensational rumors played right into people’s love for gossip and spread like crazy.
Liu Sisi, who wasn’t initially a hot celebrity, suddenly became headline news.
The comments were exploding.
"Liu Sisi keeps a young man!"
"Oh my god, I didn’t see her as that kind of person!"
"This is so explosive! A young idol caught doing such a thing!"
"Not a single decent person in the entertainment circle! I thought she was pure!"
"What a skank! Gets a bit of money and keeps a young man—what a terrible atmosphere in the entertainment circle!"
Most comments mocked Liu Sisi, with only a few voices questioning things. But those were drowned out by ridicule and abuse.
Liu Sisi’s fans were heartbroken, some of them desperately defended her, claiming it was all just rumors, while others expressed disappointment and left the fandom.
The internet was abuzz with chatter.
Feihu Entertainment Company.
This was, of course, the company Liu Sisi was a part of.
The incident with Liu Sisi sent shockwaves throughout the company.
The company quickly launched a PR campaign.
They denied the dating rumors using Liu Sisi’s Weibo account.
The company also came forward to clarify matters.
However, none of it worked; netizens didn’t believe it.
"The evidence is clear, there’s no washing this away; even if it’s not a sugar daddy situation, it’s at least dating!"
"Tsk tsk, a man and a woman dining together unless they’re related, must be dating!"
"She looked quite innocent, didn’t expect her to be like this, does it and doesn’t even dare to admit it!"
"So disappointed in her!"
This wave of clarifications backfired entirely, the online uproar got worse, and Liu Sisi’s fans were also leaving in droves.
Early in the morning, Liu Sisi had just returned to the company and upon learning of the matter, she was pale with fear, reading all sorts of vicious comments online, tears streaming down her face.
Seeing that the clarifications were ineffective, the senior management of Feihu Company was furious and immediately convened a meeting to hold Liu Sisi accountable.
"Liu Sisi, the company has rules against dating, why did you knowingly violate them!" the higher-ups interrogated angrily.
People in the company buzzed about it.
"Liu Sisi really is digging her own grave!"
"Her career was just starting to take off, she’s really asking for it!"
"Does she think she’s all that just because she’s gained some popularity, she’s become conceited!"
Liu Sisi hurriedly said, "I didn’t date, he’s just a friend, we just had a meal together, we really aren’t dating!"
The higher-ups roared, "Does anyone believe you? We’ve already denied it, but in the picture, you were smiling so happily, it really looks like someone in love, even I don’t believe you!"
Liu Sisi’s face flushed with embarrassment.
In that photo, she was indeed smiling happily because she was having a meal with Lin Fan. They got along well, and she was genuinely happy.
Who would have thought that this very smile would now become a point of attack!
Liu Sisi said, "I really didn’t date; you have to believe me. I’ve always adhered to the company’s rules, how could I knowingly violate them?"
Although she did have the impulsive urge to break the rules last night, she refrained from doing so because she didn’t want to implicate Lin Fan—after all, he was Lin Fan.
If she were really dating Lin Fan and it got exposed, not only would she be thrust into the spotlight, but Lin Fan would surely be dragged into it as well.
"Heh, that’s hard to say. Impulsiveness is a devil, who knows if you didn’t just get involved with him on an impulse?"
Wu Zi’er suddenly said, with a sarcastic and mocking tone!
Everyone thought Wu Zi’er’s words made complete sense.
If Liu Sisi couldn’t produce evidence of not being in a relationship, no one would believe her. People would just think she was trying to justify herself.
Hearing this, the higher-ups grew more irate: "Liu Sisi, you’ve really disappointed me. You’ve broken company rules, dated in secret, and the management has decided to shelve you starting today!"
Liu Sisi turned pale with fright: "You can’t shelve me, I’m being wronged, I really am being wronged, what do you need to believe me?"
The higher-ups sneered, "Even if what you say is true and you aren’t dating that guy, the netizens don’t believe you, your reputation has already suffered greatly, and next will be a decline in popularity, a reduction in commercial value, and our company’s reputation has been damaged. If we don’t shelve you, who do we shelve?"
Wu Zi’er laughed, "Liu Sisi, just accept it, who’s to blame for dining with a man for no reason? Say you don’t like him, yet no one believes you, serves you right to be banned!"
With Liu Sisi banned, Wu Zi’er would almost laugh herself awake in her sleep, as there would be no one in the company to compare to her.
Recalling something, Liu Sisi angrily pointed at Wu Zi’er: "Wu Zi’er, this is all your doing, isn’t it? You secretly photographed us and found people online to smear my name!"
Wu Zi’er’s face darkened: "Liu Sisi, you messed up, got caught by paparazzi accidentally, don’t falsely accuse me here, how could I do such a thing!"
The higher-ups sneered, "Liu Sisi, words cannot be said carelessly, take responsibility for yourself, don’t randomly shift the blame onto others!"
The crowd also began to sneer, thinking Liu Sisi was trying to shift blame onto Wu Zi’er, which was despicable.
Liu Sisi said, "I’m not shifting blame, I have evidence to prove that the photo was taken by Wu Zi’er!"
The crowd was suddenly taken aback, quieting down.
Wu Zi’er’s smile stiffened, could it be that Liu Sisi had evidence?
The higher-ups frowned, "If you have evidence, take it out for us to see."
Liu Sisi said, "The evidence is not with me, it’s with my friend."
Liu Sisi immediately took out her phone and called Lin Fan.
Lin Fan slept in today, although the internet was already buzzing, he was still oblivious to it all.
Until he was woken up by Liu Sisi’s call.
However, before he could pick up Liu Sisi’s call, a system prompt suddenly came.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, you can check in today. Checking in will reward you with entertainment company shares, would you like to check in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 94: New Rewards, Absolute Control of the Entertainment Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: New Rewards, Absolute Control of the Entertainment Company
Lin Fan was awakened by the sound of his phone ringing. As soon as he woke up, he received a notification from the system.
"Ding!"
"Today’s check-in is available. A reward of entertainment company shares is offered upon check-in. Would you like to check in?"
Entertainment company?
Lin Fan was a bit curious. He had no ties to the entertainment industry; the only connection could be knowing the female star Liu Sisi. The system rewarding him shares in an entertainment company, what’s the deal with that?
After observing for a period, Lin Fan discovered that the system’s rewards, which seemed chaotic and random, were actually perhaps intentional, as if an invisible hand was crafting a master plan.
What this plan was, Lin Fan couldn’t clearly see for now.
When it came to rewards, Lin Fan always took on the attitude that the more, the merrier.
"Check-in!" Lin Fan immediately said.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in complete! Reward: 100% ownership of Tianxue Entertainment Company, becoming the sole major shareholder in absolute control. Please collect your reward."
Lin Fan laughed. The system was working brilliantly! This was another 100% stock reward following Tourist Comics!
Lin Fan was just about to learn more about what kind of company Tianxue Entertainment was.
"Ding!"
"Tianxue Entertainment Company information, would you like to read it?"
The system suddenly prompted.
Lin Fan exclaimed softly, the system seemed to be getting more and more considerate. Previously, he had to search for information himself to understand what was going on. Now, the system directly provided the information about his rewards.
Lin Fan said, "Read!"
Instantly, it was as if a stream of memory flowed into Lin Fan’s mind...
Upon completing the reading of this information, Lin Fan already had a thorough understanding of Tianxue Entertainment.
Tianxue Entertainment Company, one of the top ten entertainment agencies in the entertainment industry, ranked among the top three leading entities!
It boasts superstars and first-tier stars, such as the current reigning TV queen Yang Mimi, and international film queen Zhang Xiaoyi, among others.
It’s truly a behemoth in the entertainment industry!
Lin Fan wasn’t very familiar with the entertainment industry, but just by looking at Tianxue Entertainment’s information, he knew it was impressive.
Tianxue Entertainment Company was in shock.
All shareholders of Tianxue Entertainment disappeared overnight, and all shares fell into the hands of one person.
Lin Fan!
Becoming the sole major shareholder of Tianxue Entertainment, in absolute control!
It meant that Lin Fan became the absolute master of Tianxue Entertainment.
This news, once released, stunned everyone from the president of Tianxue Entertainment down to the cleaning staff.
What the heck is going on here?
Who is this Lin Fan, and where did he come from?
This news quickly spread from inside Tianxue Entertainment to the outside world. No matter if they were entertainment moguls or a small artist on the ninety-eighth line, everyone was astounded.
This is a piece of news that could shake the entire entertainment industry.
Just as Liu Sisi’s scandal was occupying the entertainment headlines, this astonishing news began to quietly spread.
A mysterious rich man, seemingly unrelated to the entertainment industry and whose identity was unknown to anyone, forcefully intervened in the entertainment industry with a posture that shocked the world.
It’s as if a giant descended from the skies!
The current president of Tianxue Entertainment, Du Tao, made a decisive decision after being shocked for a full ten minutes.
"Prepare the car for me, I want to personally meet the Big Boss." Du Tao said.
No matter what Lin Fan’s background was, the fact that Lin Fan was able to acquire Tianxue Entertainment overnight meant he possessed sky-high means. Who, throughout the entire entertainment industry, had the audacity to say they could swallow Tianxue just like that!
Only Lin Fan!
In the face of such a powerful person, even though Du Tao was the president of Tianxue, he was nothing more than a small ant.
Du Tao didn’t even dare to probe into Lin Fan’s background. The only thing he needed to do now was to gain Lin Fan’s favor and leave a good impression, to keep his position secure.
Lin Fan himself didn’t realize how powerful he was.
After receiving the reward of Tianxue’s shares, he didn’t really pay too much attention to it since he wasn’t a part of the entertainment industry and had no plans to develop there.
Lin Fan then picked up his phone. He remembered that when he was in a daze earlier, he seemed to hear the phone ringing.
Upon checking, he realized it was Liu Sisi calling.
Liu Sisi had called three times in a row!
Lin Fan felt embarrassed. Liu Sisi seemed to have something urgent to discuss with him, and it was all because he slept too soundly and missed the calls.
Lin Fan quickly called Liu Sisi back.
Feihu Entertainment.
Liu Sisi had called Lin Fan three times, and Lin Fan hadn’t picked up!
Liu Sisi couldn’t help but become a bit anxious, wondering how Lin Fan was doing?
Seeing this, the others sneered.
Wu Zi’er said, "Liu Sisi, where’s the evidence? You’re not bluffing, are you? I don’t think you have any evidence!"
Executives said in a stern voice, "Sisi, it seems your calls aren’t getting through. You better not play any tricks, delaying won’t do you any good!"
Liu Sisi bit her lip and said, "I really have the evidence. My friend must be busy, I’ll call one more time."
Saying so, Liu Sisi picked up the phone and was about to make another call to Lin Fan.
Ring ring ring...
Just then, Lin Fan returned the call.
Liu Sisi quickly answered.
Lin Fan said, "Sisi, what’s up? You seem to be looking for me urgently."
Liu Sisi replied, "Yeah, I’m in trouble..."
Liu Sisi explained the situation to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan picked up his phone and checked the news, and indeed, the photo of him dining with Liu Sisi was spreading online like wildfire, becoming an entertainment headline.
Liu Sisi was rumored to be in a relationship with a mysterious man, and even accused of keeping a pretty boy, leading to her being attacked online by netizens.
Even when Liu Sisi personally came out to clarify, no one believed her.
The company Liu Sisi belonged to, Feihu Entertainment, decided to block her!
Lin Fan was speechless.
He had just lost his job and didn’t have to wake up early to deliver food, so he slept in a bit, but unknowingly missed such a big event.
"I’m sorry, Sisi, I overslept today and only found out about this now," Lin Fan apologized.
Liu Sisi broke out in a cold sweat, realizing that Lin Fan just overslept and that’s why he didn’t answer her calls.
"Lin Fan, this issue was caused by Wu Zi’er spreading rumors about us," Liu Sisi said.
Lin Fan’s eyes turned cold, "The photo online, did she take it sneakily last night?"
Wu Zi’er was incredibly vicious, the company had a no-dating policy, and Wu Zi’er spread rumors about Liu Sisi dating, really trying to ruin her!
Liu Sisi said, "Yeah, I need that video to prove to the executives it was her making things up about us. Could you send that video to me?"
Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, "That video can indeed prove Wu Zi’er took photos of us, but it’s not enough to clear your name. Also, didn’t you say Wu Zi’er’s family are shareholders of your company? They certainly wouldn’t want her scandal to be exposed."
Liu Sisi thought about it and found Lin Fan’s point to be valid, feeling a bit anxious: "Then what should we do?"
Lin Fan said, "Fight fire with fire. Leave it to me, wait for my call."
Lin Fan then hung up, quickly pondering a solution.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang again. It was an unfamiliar number.
Lin Fan answered the call.
"Mr. Lin, I am Du Tao, the president of Tianxue Entertainment. Congratulations on becoming the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment. I’m here to welcome you personally," a man on the other end said.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Repay one’s own way with their own conduct
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: Repay one’s own way with their own conduct
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh." Based on previously acquired information, Du Tao is indeed the current president of Tianxue Entertainment Company. Du Tao’s work abilities are also outstanding, and he is a prominent figure in the entertainment industry.
Yet, such a person now speaks to Lin Fan in a humble and cautious manner.
The Big Boss truly is different.
Lin Fan smiled and asked, "Okay, where are you now?"
Du Tao said, "I’ve already reached close to Mr. Lin’s apartment, I’ll be there soon."
Lin Fan replied, "I’ll wait for you to come over. By the way, I happen to have something at hand that you might be able to help me with."
Du Tao, in his heart, was delighted. He was worried that Mr. Lin thought he was of no use, but now with something assigned to him, it was a chance to perform and show Mr. Lin his ability to get things done.
"Mr. Lin, please tell me," Du Tao promptly replied.
Lin Fan slightly smiled, "I have a video. Help me spread it..."
Lin Fan conveyed his idea to Du Tao.
Du Tao laughed, "Don’t worry, Mr. Lin, leave this to me."
Feihu Entertainment.
Liu Sisi was anxiously waiting for Lin Fan’s call.
The higher-ups were obviously impatient.
"Liu Sisi, you don’t need to delay any longer. I think you have no evidence at all. The so-called evidence you mention is nothing but a waste of time!" a senior executive said coldly.
Wu Zi’er mocked sarcastically, "I know what you’re thinking. You just want to scare me, but unfortunately, you’ve miscalculated. I have nothing to fear!"
The senior executive snorted coldly, "Enough, my patience is limited, Liu Sisi. Let’s end this matter here!"
Liu Sisi quickly replied, "I beg you, give me a little more time. My friend will respond to me soon."
The senior executive hesitated for a moment, ultimately saying, "Fine, I’ll give you another 10 minutes!"
The higher-ups had always seen potential in Liu Sisi. However, this incident had made them very angry and disappointed, which is why they decided in a fit of anger to temporarily shelve Liu Sisi.
It’s really a pity. If Liu Sisi could prove her innocence, that would be best.
However, the higher-ups really couldn’t think of what evidence Liu Sisi might have. These ten minutes were a grace period.
After 10 minutes, Liu Sisi would officially be shelved!
But!
In just 3 minutes!
Liu Sisi’s phone rang.
It’s Lin Fan calling!
"Sisi, the issue has been dealt with. Check Weibo. Also, where are you now? I’ll come find you," Lin Fan said.
Liu Sisi replied, "I’m at the company."
"Alright," Lin Fan hung up the phone.
Liu Sisi immediately opened Weibo and was stunned.
The senior executive noticed this and frowned, asking, "Liu Sisi, did you get the evidence or not?"
Liu Sisi looked up and said, "I didn’t get the evidence..."
The senior executive’s face darkened, "So you don’t have any evidence at all!"
Wu Zi’er had been a bit worried all along. Although she had avoided the cameras when secretly filming last night, if Liu Sisi somehow had evidence, it would be bad news.
However, up until this point, Liu Sisi had failed to produce any evidence. She was now convinced that Liu Sisi was lying.
Wu Zi’er immediately became smug, "Liu Sisi, since you can’t produce any evidence, it means you’re slandering me. I want you to kneel down and apologize immediately!"
"Liu Sisi is so bad. She got into trouble herself and wants to blame Zi’er!"
"Exactly, Zi’er isn’t like that at all!"
"She deserves to be shelved. How did we not see how shameless she was before!"
Everyone started mocking her. Apparently, everyone wished they could step on her since, in their eyes, Liu Sisi was already a dead person, and they could trample on her at will.
Liu Sisi felt disappointed with these people. Before she got into trouble, they were all very friendly to her because she was a rising female star and a promising newcomer the company was promoting, with a bright future.
She didn’t expect that once she got into trouble, these people would completely change their tune.
Indeed, the cold of human relationships and the warmth of the world!
Liu Sisi laughed lightly and said, "I haven’t finished speaking. I may not have the evidence, but the evidence has already made it to the trending searches."
Upon hearing this, the entire room fell silent.
Then, everyone lowered their heads and frantically checked their phones.
Unbeknownst to them, a trending search suddenly shot to the top of Weibo’s trending list.
"Wu Zi’er secretly films and spreads rumors about Liu Sisi’s relationship."
The title was concise and direct, hitting the mark and filled with gossip appeal, highly alluring to the public.
In one video, Wu Zi’er was sneakily hiding in the corner with her phone, secretly filming Liu Sisi as the target!
This video immediately caused a huge sensation, spreading rapidly and quickly exploding as a trending topic.
"Oh my god, a shocking reversal, front row eating popcorn!"
"Damn, was Liu Sisi really being slandered?"
"Going from Wu Zi’er’s filming location, the photo from this morning must have been taken by her!"
"If it’s true, then we’ve wronged Liu Sisi!"
"This Wu Zi’er is too vicious, aren’t they from the same company?!"
"Of course, Wu Zi’er must be jealous of Liu Sisi."
The netizens started fervently discussing, with everyone’s attention turning towards Wu Zi’er. Public opinion began to overwhelmingly criticize Wu Zi’er.
However, this video alone wasn’t enough to prove that Wu Zi’er was spreading rumors.
Soon after, another trending search appeared.
"Paid commenters confess to being bribed by Wu Zi’er!"
Paid commenters presented evidence that Wu Zi’er provided them with photos and paid them to slander Liu Sisi and spread rumors!
The evidence was conclusive, and netizens erupted!
"This is solid proof; it really was Wu Zi’er spreading rumors!"
"Caught red-handed, Wu Zi’er is such a bitch!"
"Oh my god, Wu Zi’er is so low to harm people like this!"
"Liu Sisi, we’re sorry!"
"Ban Wu Zi’er, the disgraceful artist!"
A period of intense demand for an apology to Liu Sisi and calls to ban Wu Zi’er flooded the internet.
Feihu Entertainment Company.
A dead silence.
Everyone was in shock.
Wu Zi’er had actually done such a thing!
Faced with undeniable evidence, there was no way to clear her name.
Wu Zi’er was pale with fear and screamed at the executives, "What should I do? Think of something quickly!"
The executive was silent for a long time, finally saying, "There’s nothing we can do; just issue an apology statement."
Wu Zi’er’s apology statement quickly made it to trending searches.
Wu Zi’er admitted that she’d made a terrible mistake in a moment of confusion and pleaded for forgiveness from everyone.
However, like Liu Sisi’s clarification this morning, it was of no use.
Wu Zi’er’s actions had incited public outrage. This statement only solidified her guilt and incited even more outcry.
Calls to ban Wu Zi’er echoed across the web.
In a nondescript small apartment.
Lin Fan sat on the sofa, scrolling through his phone, wearing a satisfied smile.
This was using the same method against Wu Zi’er that she had used against him. She used the internet to spread rumors against Liu Sisi, and he used the internet to counterattack.
The difference is, Wu Zi’er was fabricating lies, while he was exposing the truth.
"That Du Tao is pretty capable; he managed to handle even the paid commenters so quickly and had them expose themselves. Very impressive."
Lin Fan looked forward to meeting the president of Tianxue Entertainment.
Du Tao was also eager to meet Lin Fan quickly, as this was the first task Mr. Lin assigned to him. He wondered if Mr. Lin would be satisfied.

chapters.title: Chapter 96 President of Tianxue: My Boss is Really Too Low-Key
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96 President of Tianxue: My Boss is Really Too Low-Key
"Are you sure it’s here?"
A BMW 7 Series stops at the outskirts of an urban village. Looking at the dense array of cheap apartments in front of him, a middle-aged man in a suit is bewildered.
He is Du Tao, the current President of Tianxue Entertainment.
Upon learning that the company was absolutely controlled by Lin Fan, he decided to personally welcome Lin Fan. But the Big Boss, Lin Fan, lives in this village?
Du Tao has a big question mark on his forehead.
The driver confidently said, "Yes, according to the navigation, it’s here."
Du Tao sweats. If it’s according to the navigation, it should be correct. He said, "Then drive in."
The driver looked at the narrow alley and said, "President, I’m afraid the car can’t get through, you’ll have to walk in."
Du Tao had no choice but to get out of the car and walk into the village. As a well-known figure in the entertainment industry, he usually mingles in the glamorous and upscale circles. He never expected there’d be a day he’d have to humble himself in such a place.
Lin Fan, who just took control of a giant entertainment company, actually lives here—is this real?
When he arrived at Lin Fan’s rented apartment, he doubted life even more.
No matter how you look at it, this doesn’t seem to match the image of the super-rich tycoon.
This extreme sense of incongruity made Du Tao seriously doubt whether the information was wrong.
Until Lin Fan appeared before him in market stall clothes, he couldn’t believe that Lin Fan actually lived here!
Du Tao was drenched in sweat and quickly came up with a reasonable explanation.
Low-Key!
He finally thought of a word—indeed, the Big Boss must be intentionally low-key and grounded to dress so casually and live so simply.
The Big Boss’s simple and unpretentious, low-key yet profound behavior truly makes one admire him to the core.
Having found the reason, Du Tao felt relieved and quickly leaned forward in front of Lin Fan, giving a deep bow.
"Mr. Lin, I am Du Tao," Du Tao said respectfully.
Lin Fan sized up Du Tao. Based on the system’s information, he confirmed it was indeed Du Tao.
Lin Fan smiled, "You handled Wu Zi’er’s matter nicely."
The Big Boss praised him right away, making Du Tao feel overwhelmed. He hurriedly said, "Thank you, Mr. Lin, for the affirmation. It is my duty."
After Lin Fan instructed him to deal with Wu Zi’er, he immediately utilized his network and dealt with Wu Zi’er harshly.
The Liu Sisi incident is already at the top of entertainment headlines, so he’s very aware. He doesn’t know why the Big Boss helped Liu Sisi, but that’s not something he should question—he just needs to do what Lin Fan wants.
Lin Fan said, "I need to go to Feihu Company; you can come along."
Du Tao said, "Okay, Mr. Lin, my car is just outside the alley, this way please."
The two were just about to head out.
Aunt Li came over from the side.
Lin Fan greeted, "Hello, Aunt Li."
"Oh, Little Fan, is this guy your boss?" Aunt Li looks at the branded suit-wearing Du Tao and asks.
This misunderstanding is enormous. Du Tao breaks out in cold sweat and quickly says, "This aunt, I am Du Tao; Mr. Lin is my boss."
Aunt Li is bewildered, "Little Fan is your boss? When did he become a boss?"
Du Tao said, "Yes, Mr. Lin just took over our Tianxue Entertainment Company today."
Aunt Li laughed, "Hahaha, enough, you guys are just joking with this old lady. Little Fan has lived here for so long, how could I not know the situation!"
Du Tao’s cold sweat keeps falling—Mr. Lin’s situation, you truly don’t know. It’s true the boss is extremely low-key, hiding his tycoon status so deeply.
Watching the sincere panic on Du Tao’s face, Lin Fan finds it a bit funny and smiles, "Aunt Li, we have to go handle some things; I’ll chat with you later."
Aunt Li didn’t take Du Tao’s words seriously, thinking they were a joke, and said, "Alright, by the way, Little Fan, I’m keeping an eye on the dating matter for you, so you can rest assured."
Aunt Li is truly enthusiastic; Lin Fan smiled and said, "Mm, thank you, Aunt Li."
Du Tao secretly wipes his cold sweat; Mr. Lin, such a masterful tycoon, really needs a blind date? If he wanted, there would definitely be countless women lining up for him!
Lin Fan and Du Tao then walk towards the outside of the alley.
At the street corner, a group of young people is discussing.
"Did you see the Liu Sisi incident, the truth is shocking!"
"Yeah, she’s so pitiful, being slandered by Wu Zi’er from the same company and cyberbullied by unaware netizens."
"Wu Zi’er is now being scolded terribly by netizens too, deservedly so, very satisfying!"
"Wu Zi’er brought this upon herself; this reversal is really powerful!"
"In my understanding of the entertainment industry, Liu Sisi must have had someone skilled backing her up this time; we just don’t know who it is," says a tall young man.
He’s a recently graduated art student with dreams of becoming a star in the entertainment industry, currently doing minor roles, so he’s more knowledgeable about the entertainment circle than the average person.
His words instantly sparked everyone’s curiosity—who rescued Liu Sisi?
At this moment, Lin Fan and Du Tao pass by them.
They have no idea that the person who saved Liu Sisi is right in front of them.
Only the tall young man notices them.
The middle-aged man in an expensive suit is so respectful to the young man in market stall clothes—isn’t that odd?
Wait, this middle-aged man looks familiar!
Suddenly, he realizes something, and his heart is in turmoil: isn’t that Du Tao, the President of Tianxue Entertainment? No, how could it be? Why would Du Tao be here? He must have mistaken the person.
The young man then opens WeChat and sees this post on his Moments.
"Big news, Tianxue Entertainment has been acquired by a mysterious tycoon! Internal reliable sources say this mysterious tycoon lives in an urban village, do you believe it? President Du Tao personally went to the urban village to greet the new boss."
This post was made by an assistant director he knows, which is the most influential person he can connect with in the entertainment industry. He knows this assistant director usually has accurate information, so this revelation shouldn’t be wrong.
The tall young man is petrified.
What the hell!
The person who passed by just now really was Du Tao!
So that means the young man in market stall clothes next to Du Tao is the new boss of Tianxue Entertainment!
And by this time, Lin Fan and Du Tao have already driven off.
Oh my!
The tall young man feels like he just missed out on making a billion.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan sits in Du Tao’s BMW 7 Series as they arrive at a nearby street.
Lin Fan suddenly receives a call from his younger sister, Lin Shanshan.
"Brother, I’m officially starting school tomorrow; are you coming back to Yunding Manor tonight to send me to school tomorrow?"
Lin Fan responds with an "oh", realizing Shanshan is about to start school.
"Mm, I’ll drive back tonight," Lin Fan says.
After hanging up, Lin Fan glances outside and says, "I’ll drive my own car over, let’s park over there."
Du Tao quickly responds, "Alright, Mr. Lin."
Then instructs the driver to park on the roadside.
Sitting in the passenger seat, Du Tao suddenly sees a top-tier luxury car parked by the roadside.
Kosak!
Only to see Lin Fan get out of the car and walk straight to the Kosak, take out a key, and press a button.
Beep beep!
Kosak’s dazzling headlights light up, and the doors open like the wings of a futuristic machine.
Lin Fan gets into the Kosak and drives away.
Both Du Tao and the driver are dumbfounded.
Du Tao admits that deep down, he harbored some doubts about Lin Fan’s identity—the Lin Fan who lived in an urban village and dressed in market stall clothes—is he really the tycoon who just acquired Tianxue?
Until he saw Lin Fan getting into the Kosak, he finally had no doubt that Lin Fan is indeed the Low-Key Tycoon!
"Quickly follow the boss’s car!" Du Tao immediately instructed.
But his BMW 7 Series was quickly left behind by the 70 million supercar.
Feihu Entertainment Company.
At this moment, the entire company is filled with a stifling atmosphere.
Wu Zi’er’s scandal was exposed. Despite the company’s immediate public relations response and Wu Zi’er herself issuing an apology statement, it didn’t help and even fueled more netizen outrage.
Voices demanding Wu Zi’er be banned flooded the internet.
The company’s higher-ups are discussing the next course of action.
Meanwhile, Wu Zi’er’s family, upon learning about Wu Zi’er’s trouble, also rushed to the company.
A senior executive says, "Zi’er has angered the public this time; it might not be easy to calm the situation. How about this, Zi’er, you apologize to Sisi. If Sisi publicly forgives you, it should calm the outrage. We believe this might be the only way."
Wu Zi’er, however, is unwilling "She’s the one who got me into this mess, and you want me to apologize to her? No way!"
She already hates Liu Sisi to the core, how could she possibly bow to Liu Sisi.
A fat middle-aged man, says condescendingly, "Liu Sisi, my daughter may have made mistakes, but she’s apologized. Now you should help her through this difficult time. Just tweet that this whole thing was a misunderstanding, you guys were just joking—then it’s done."
This middle-aged man is Wu Dagui, Wu Zi’er’s father, and a shareholder of Feihu Entertainment.
He doesn’t speak in a negotiating manner but in a commanding tone, making Liu Sisi very angry.
"Sorry, no way!" Liu Sisi replies coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 Lin Fan: I really can intervene
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97 Lin Fan: I really can intervene
Liu Sisi’s rejection made Wu Dagui feel that his dignity as a shareholder was offended.
Wu Dagui’s face darkened, "What did you say?"
Relying on her father’s backing, Wu Zi’er was also very arrogant, "Liu Sisi, I advise you not to push your luck. Who gave you the courage? Do you really think you can fight me?"
The executives saw the situation and advised, "Sisi, where possible, one should let things slide. We’re all part of the same company; let’s not make things ugly. Just do as Mr. Wu says, post a tweet to clear Zi’er’s name."
Liu Sisi trembled with anger, "Why should I help her clear her name? Aren’t you being too double-standard? When she spread rumors about me, you didn’t even wait for the truth before deciding to freeze me due to so-called company violations. Now that the truth is out, it’s clear her actions go beyond just breaking company rules; she’s broken the law! Yet you still protect her and want me to help cover it up? It’s disgusting to you, but it’s nauseating to me!"
The executives were a bit embarrassed, "Heh heh, you can’t put it like that. It was indeed our mistake to freeze you before, but that was only because we cared so much. The situation is different now; we’ve calmed down. Since there’s a better way to resolve this, we needn’t go to extremes."
Liu Sisi sneered coldly, "What’s different? It’s just because Wu Zi’er has connections. Even if she makes a monumental mistake, you still protect her. People like me without background, you just freeze without hesitation!"
Liu Sisi kept speaking the plain truth, making the executives very embarrassed and somewhat angry as well.
"Liu Sisi, since you’re aware, why bring it up? You’re fine now. Surely you understand the principle of peace through compromise?" one executive said with a chuckle.
Wu Dagui said flatly, "I’m a fair person. My daughter was in the wrong first, as long as you’re willing to help her, I won’t treat you poorly. Isn’t that all you were waiting to hear? Go ahead, name your terms!"
He thought he had seen through Liu Sisi, as no one in the entertainment industry is truly naive.
Liu Sisi replied coldly, "A stick for discipline, a sweet for comfort, huh? Sorry, I don’t want anything. I just want Wu Zi’er to pay the due price for her mistakes!"
The executive was annoyed, "Liu Sisi, don’t overstep. I advise you to stop while you’re ahead; tearing faces won’t be good for you!"
Wu Dagui was also furious, not expecting to have misjudged Liu Sisi. Clearly, Liu Sisi was determined to oppose him.
"You little fool, truly overestimating yourself," Wu Dagui sneered.
Wu Zi’er didn’t expect Liu Sisi to not even fear her father. The more Liu Sisi resisted, the angrier she became.
"Liu Sisi, what are you using to fight against us? Do you think stubbornness helps? I can’t stand people like you. You’ve never been willing to bow to me. If it weren’t for that, I wouldn’t bother with you. Ultimately, it’s your fault. If you don’t adapt, you’re on a dead-end road!"
Liu Sisi replied, "So, I should just let you bully me, and resisting is wrong? Wu Zi’er, do you really think just because your dad is a shareholder, you can do whatever you want? Everyone who makes a mistake should be punished!"
Wu Zi’er laughed angrily, "Fine, let’s see who ends up losing!"
An executive said, "Liu Sisi, don’t forget your Weibo account belongs to the company. Even if you don’t agree, we have the right to post content from it. So regardless of whether you consent, this cleansing post will be issued from your account."
Wu Dagui said coldly, "And due to your lack of cooperation with company decisions, you will once again face being frozen. I’ll give you one last chance; do you agree or not!"
Threats!
Seeing negotiations fail, the executives and Wu Dagui resorted to threats.
Wu Zi’er was very smug, "Liu Sisi, this is called avoiding a toast in favor of a penalty! Fighting me, you’re doomed to fail!"
If Liu Sisi didn’t want to face the fate of being frozen again, she had no choice but to help Wu Zi’er clear her name!
She had no background in this company and could only be slaughtered as desired.
Liu Sisi’s complexion turned pale, trembling in anger, but she was indeed weak and unable to resist.
Facing the company, facing shareholders, how could she, a minor artist, resist?
Liu Sisi shouted hoarsely, "You can’t do this; what you’re doing is illegal!"
Wu Dagui arrogantly declared, "Law? In this company, I am the law! All other shareholders are my friends; do you see anyone helping you?"
Wu Dagui was rampant with confidence. As a shareholder of Feihu, he had some say in Feihu Company; naturally, other shareholders wouldn’t turn against him for the sake of an artist.
Seeing Liu Sisi fighting alone, already exhausted, the pressure around her was like a mountain pressing down on her.
"Wu Dagui, is it? I see you don’t even care about your dignity to threaten a female,"
Suddenly, a voice came over.
They saw Lin Fan walk in.
Everyone immediately turned to look, puzzled as to who this young man was.
Wu Dagui narrowed his eyes; a poor kid in street clothes dares to call him by name?
"Lin Fan, you’re here!"
Only Liu Sisi said happily, quickly moving to Lin Fan’s side. She was lonely and helpless just moments ago, and Lin Fan’s appearance felt like a lifesaver. With Lin Fan present, she was no longer afraid of anything, and her body stopped shaking.
"Who are you? Is this a place for you?" An executive reprimanded coldly.
Wu Zi’er sneered, "He’s the one who dined with Liu Sisi last night!"
Ah?
Everyone was curious.
For a long time, they didn’t even know who the rumored person with Liu Sisi was. Was it this young guy?
Dressed in street clothes, he looked like a poor man.
Wu Dagui said sarcastically, "So it’s you. Judging by your outfit, you must be dirt poor. No wonder they say Liu Sisi was keeping you, I even believed it."
Everyone laughed uproariously.
Lin Fan paid no mind, another group of people who judge by appearance, how shallow.
The executive held back laughter, "How did you sneak into our company? This is internal company business, not your place to intervene. Get out!"
Lin Fan smiled, "I just made a call to come in. I can indeed intervene; your Feihu Company seems to be just a subsidiary of Tianxue Company."
Lin Fan’s random statement left everyone bewildered.
Feihu Company is indeed a subsidiary of Tianxue Entertainment, which holds absolute control over Feihu Company.
But what does it have to do with this poor guy?
Wu Dagui sneered, "So what do you mean by that?"
At this point, a middle-aged man in a suit hurried in.
Seeing this person, everyone at Feihu Company changed their expressions.
Du Tao!
The President of Tianxue Entertainment!
The executives at Feihu Entertainment quickly stood up, smiling apologetically, "President Du, what brings you here?"
Wu Dagui grinned, "Old Du, my daughter’s matter surely doesn’t need to trouble you, does it?"
Du Tao gave Wu Dagui a cold glance, clearly unaware of what was happening here.
Just earlier, because Lin Fan’s vehicle was fast, Lin Fan reached Feihu Company first but got stopped at the entrance. Lin Fan made a call to Du Tao, and Du Tao ordered the people at Feihu to let him in. Du Tao feared Feihu’s people would provoke Lin Fan, so he rushed over immediately.
Du Tao said coldly, "This matter is causing a negative impact, eventually affecting Tianxue’s reputation. Tianxue has already decided to intervene; the Big Boss will personally handle it."
Big Boss?
Everyone exchanged puzzled glances.
Then they saw Du Tao approaching Lin Fan, respectfully saying, "Big Boss, please decide how to deal with this matter."
What?
Lin Fan is the Big Boss of Tianxue?
Everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Permanent Ban!
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98: Permanent Ban!
Just when Feihu Company was overwhelmed with problems, its parent company, Tianxue Entertainment Company, dropped a bombshell in the entertainment industry.
All of Tianxue Entertainment Company’s shares now belong to Lin Fan!
Lin Fan has become the absolute ruler of Tianxue Entertainment, known as the "Big Boss".
When Lin Fan appeared at Feihu Company, no one at Feihu knew his identity.
It wasn’t until his identity was exposed by President of Tianxue, Du Tao.
Everyone at Feihu Company was astonished.
The Lin Fan they had just been mocking turned out to be the Big Boss of Tianxue Company, the ruler of all of them?
Wu Dagui’s face looked a little pale: "Old Du, you can’t joke like this, what’s going on, I don’t quite understand?"
Du Tao said indifferently: "You probably don’t know yet, Tianxue Company has been fully acquired by Mr. Lin, 100% owned."
"What?"
Wu Dagui was immensely surprised, "How is it possible, how can he have 100% ownership of Tianxue? Even if he has money, would those shareholders at Tianxue be willing to sell him their shares?"
Du Tao chuckled: "Are you doubting Mr. Lin’s capability? If you don’t believe me, you can check for yourself."
Wu Dagui immediately picked up his phone and made a few calls.
"What, Brother Li, you are no longer a shareholder of Tianxue?"
"What? Old Chen, you also sold your shares to Lin Fan?"
"Okay, I understand now..."
Wu Dagui’s face gradually turned pale, and finally, he powerlessly put down the phone, his whole face was as pale as paper.
After several inquiries, he finally confirmed it, Du Tao wasn’t lying, nor was he joking.
Lin Fan really is the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment!
The higher-ups at Feihu also began to tremble uncontrollably.
Last night, it was Lin Fan who dined with Liu Sisi, indicating the relationship between Liu Sisi and Lin Fan must be extraordinary. How they treated Liu Sisi before must have offended Lin Fan!
Even Liu Sisi was extremely shocked.
Today Lin Fan helped her retaliate against Wu Zi’er; she was secretly impressed by Lin Fan’s methods but didn’t expect Lin Fan was actually so powerful to be the Big Boss of Tianxue!
This identity is simply unbelievable!
Because Feihu is a subsidiary of Tianxue, Tianxue has absolute control over Feihu, which means Lin Fan holds the life-and-death power over all of Feihu!
Thinking of this, Liu Sisi couldn’t help but become excited, originally being forced to a dead-end by Feihu, Lin Fan’s appearance was simply a miraculous comeback!
Wu Zi’er was the one most frightened at this moment. Her photo evidence was exposed by Lin Fan; Lin Fan definitely wouldn’t let her go!
"How could this happen, how is it possible..." Wu Zi’er muttered to herself, trembling all over.
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on Wu Zi’er, with a slight smile: "What were you saying earlier, thinking you could walk sideways in this company, with no one able to do anything to you?"
Wu Zi’er’s body trembled like a sieve: "I..."
Earlier she dared to curse Lin Fan, now she was scared out of her wits.
Wu Dagui smiled embarrassedly: "Mr. Lin, my daughter indeed made a mistake, but she already knows her wrongs; she won’t do it again in the future, please Mr. Lin kindly let her off this time."
He was flattering, entirely different from his previous arrogance.
After confirming Lin Fan’s identity as Tianxue’s Big Boss, he was completely humbled.
Lin Fan said indifferently: "Shouldn’t you ask Sisi about this issue?"
Lin Fan’s suggestion was clear, asking them to seek Liu Sisi’s forgiveness.
Wu Dagui and others showed constipation expressions, earlier they were bossing Liu Sisi around, and now they have to plead with her, they couldn’t lower their faces.
Still, Wu Dagui had thick skin, quickly adjusted his emotions, and said: "Zi’er, hurry up and apologize to Sisi, what you did was really too much! Sisi, uncle apologizes to you first, it was uncle’s fault before, I hope you don’t take it to heart."
"...."
Facing Wu Dagui with an apologetic smile, Liu Sisi was somewhat speechless.
Wu Zi’er showed an ingratiating smile, saying: "Sister Sisi, I’m sorry, please let me go this time?"
Liu Sisi said coldly: "If it wasn’t for Lin Fan, would you let me go?"
She understood why Lin Fan wanted her to decide.
She must be strong; forgiving bad people with a saintly heart is going against herself. Only by making these petty people pay a price would they dare not easily provoke her in the future.
"This..."
Everyone’s faces were red with embarrassment, speechless. Earlier they were aggressive, indeed not taking Liu Sisi seriously.
Lin Fan said: "Since it’s like this, Wu Zi’er, you will be permanently put on ice during the contract period with Feihu until the contract ends, without termination allowed!"
"Ah!"
Wu Zi’er was stunned, cried out miserably, and collapsed to the ground.
Her contract period with Feihu is 20 years, meaning she’ll be put on ice for at least 20 years, 20 years, her best years, this is equivalent to sentencing her to death in the entertainment industry!
"No, it can’t be like this, you all please plead for me!"
Wu Zi’er was anxious, shouting at the higher-ups.
Feihu’s higher-ups all bowed their heads, they couldn’t even protect themselves now, wished she would disappear, how could they ask for leniency for her?
"We respect Mr. Lin’s decision." the higher-ups said.
Wu Dagui’s face twitched, Wu Zi’er is ultimately his daughter, he couldn’t help but thick-skinnedly smiled embarrassingly: "Mr. Lin, isn’t this punishment a tad too severe, please Mr. Lin consider my face and give some leniency."
Lin Fan coldly glanced at Wu Dagui: "Your face? What kind of bullshit face do you have!"
Wu Dagui was dumbfounded: "...."
Lin Fan said: "You used your identity as a shareholder to shield your daughter, oppress Sisi, your actions are just as vile as your daughter’s. I declare that from now on, you are kicked out of the board of directors, you no longer have any rights in Feihu matters!"
Kicked out of the board!
Wu Dagui was instantly ashen-faced, unexpectedly not only failing to save Wu Zi’er but also getting himself involved.
At this moment, suddenly two policemen walked in.
The leading pretty female cop, Lin Fan recognized, is the police officer Loli he encountered at the small motel!
Loli approached Wu Zi’er.
"Wu Zi’er, we’ve received a report, you are suspected of spreading false information online, hiring internet trolls to defame others, which is illegal, we will arrest you, please come with us!"
Without further ado, the other policeman took out handcuffs and handcuffed Wu Zi’er.
Wu Zi’er was terrified, only now did she really lose her nerve.
"I don’t want to go to jail, Sister Sisi, please let me go this time, I really know my wrongs, Lin Fan, no, Big Boss, I beg you..."
Thud!
Wu Zi’er kneeled on the ground, pleading.
Loli said coldly: "You’ve already broken the law; no one can save you except confession and acceptance of punishment, take her away!"
The other policeman dragged Wu Zi’er out, her legs were too weak to stand.
Loli, turning, discovered Lin Fan was also here, instantly delighted.
Male god!
Meow meow meow, how is the male god also here?
Really want to rush over and greet the male god.
But in this scene, she needed to control her fangirling.
So she pretended to be calm, nodded at Lin Fan, put on a serious face, and led Wu Zi’er out.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: This Plot, the Domineering CEO Steps in for Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: This Plot, the Domineering CEO Steps in for Love
Wu Zi’er was arrested by the police!
Throughout Feihu Company, there was dead silence.
The nature of this matter was serious. Even if Lin Fan didn’t blacklist Wu Zi’er, who in the entertainment industry would dare to use her in the future? The entertainment circle is sensitive about these things. Celebrities who have committed crimes are basically sentenced to death in their careers.
Wu Zi’er finally paid the price for her actions.
It even implicated her father, Wu Dagui. Wu Dagui was kicked out of the board of directors for using his position as a shareholder to shelter Wu Zi’er.
Facing Lin Fan, the Tianxue Big Boss, Wu Dagui didn’t dare to speak and left in disgrace.
The executives of Feihu were looking down, trembling.
Wu Dagui and his daughter were dealt with, and the next ones would be them!
Lin Fan said calmly, "As the company’s executives, you should treat company artists fairly and justly, but you chose to assist evil. Do you realize your mistakes?"
The executives blushed with shame, not daring to make a sound.
They didn’t even dare to beg for mercy, they could only obediently wait for a verdict.
Each of them groaned inwardly, it’s over, it’s over, this time we’re doomed.
Losing their jobs was a small matter, but it would be difficult to survive in this industry again, as no one would want to hire someone fired by the Tianxue Big Boss.
Then they heard Lin Fan say, "I could completely fire all of you, but since your actions haven’t resulted in major errors, I’ll give you a chance. This time, you’ll all have a one-month salary reduction as punishment. Let’s see your performance in the future."
What?
The executives were stunned.
The Big Boss actually let them off the hook, with just a one-month pay cut. This was an enormous surprise.
The executives suddenly were ecstatic.
"Thank you, Big Boss, for your grace!"
The executives said in unison, each one filled with gratitude.
Seeing this scene, Du Tao couldn’t help but feel a sense of admiration towards Lin Fan. The Big Boss’s method of using the carrot and stick was perfect, getting these executives to comply fully.
The Big Boss is so young, truly remarkable, no wonder he could acquire Tianxue!
Du Tao also felt proud of himself. As soon as he learned Lin Fan was the Big Boss, he decided to win Lin Fan over, and he helped Lin Fan achieve a victory. This decision was just too correct.
Lin Fan then said, "You all can leave now, I have something to say to Sisi."
So, everyone got up and left, quickly leaving the room.
In the conference room, only Lin Fan and Liu Sisi were left.
"Sisi, are you okay?" Lin Fan smiled and asked.
Liu Sisi smiled back, "I’m fine, Lin... um, Big Boss..."
With Lin Fan’s new identity, she felt a bit reserved. Tianxue’s Big Boss, who wouldn’t be tense around him in the entertainment industry?
Lin Fan laughed and said, "You don’t have to address me like them. Just think of me as the Lin Fan from last night. We’re friends."
Liu Sisi, a straightforward person, felt instantly relieved and smiled sweetly, "Well, Lin Fan, I still have to thank you for today. If not for you, I’d be doomed."
If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she would have been set up by the company, and Wu Zi’er would have had the last laugh.
It was Lin Fan who exposed the truth online, clearing her name and turning public opinion around.
It was Lin Fan who came to the company and dealt with Wu Dagui and his daughter.
It was Lin Fan who suggested she report to the police and bring Wu Zi’er to justice.
Previously, Liu Sisi secretly marveled at Lin Fan’s quick and brilliant online counterattack, but after knowing Lin Fan was Tianxue’s Big Boss, she felt it was no big deal. To Tianxue’s Big Boss, it was just a small matter.
Indeed, Lin Fan mobilized Tianxue President Du Tao, and with Du Tao’s connections and skills in the entertainment industry, the counterattack was executed effortlessly.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Having dinner with you last night was me, and since they said we’re dating, even saying you were keeping me, I naturally have the obligation to come forward to clarify."
Liu Sisi blushed and said, "This Wu Zi’er was too much, making up such rumors. Thankfully, she was brought to justice."
When Wu Zi’er was taken away by the police, Liu Sisi felt a great sense of relief.
Lin Fan said, "The reason she spread rumors about us dating was fundamentally because the company had a rule against dating, which could be used to attack you."
Liu Sisi nodded. Indeed, Wu Zi’er’s move was vicious, and it almost led to her being blacklisted by the company.
Lin Fan said, "The rule against dating is really inhumane. From now on, it’s abolished."
As Tianxue’s Big Boss, when he says it’s abolished, it’s abolished.
Liu Sisi’s heart raced and face turned red, thinking this abolishment means she could date Lin Fan in the future?
Oh my, that’s such a bold thought; Lin Fan is now Tianxue’s Big Boss, how would he look at her, a small-time actress?
But she couldn’t stop herself from thinking it, after today’s events, she admired Lin Fan even more.
Liu Sisi was shy beyond belief.
"What are you thinking about, why is your face so red?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Liu Sisi quickly replied, "N-nothing."
Her heart was fluttering like a little deer.
Lin Fan said, "I’ll head out first. If anyone in the company bullies you in the future, let me know."
She felt warm inside, nodding, "Okay."
The two then walked out of the conference room.
Outside, everyone was quietly waiting.
Seeing the two come out, everyone had a hint of an ambiguous look in their eyes. To them, Lin Fan and Liu Sisi’s relationship must be more than simple.
Last night, it was Lin Fan who had dinner with Liu Sisi.
Today, when Liu Sisi got into trouble, Lin Fan descended upon Feihu to rescue Liu Sisi.
This was just like the story of a domineering CEO stepping in for love!
Too romantic!
Of course, Lin Fan and Liu Sisi surely didn’t want to make their relationship public, Wu Zi’er’s mistake was secretly filming them and wildly spreading rumors online, even claiming Liu Sisi was keeping Lin Fan, wasn’t that a death wish! Self-inflicted wounds can’t be undone!
Lin Fan and Liu Sisi weren’t aware that everyone was over-imagining their story.
Lin Fan glanced at the crowd and said, "Everyone, go back to work. What’s happened today ends here."
With that, Lin Fan and Du Tao left Feihu.
"Sisi, Wu Zi’er said the person who had dinner with you last night was the Big Boss, right?" An executive smilingly came closer to probe for news.
Liu Sisi didn’t think much and said, "Yes, we are friends."
Friends!
The executives exchanged knowing glances.
Clearly boyfriend and girlfriend, reluctant to make it public!
But just being "friends" with the Big Boss was already significant, let alone being a girlfriend!
"Sister Sisi, I’m so sorry for earlier. Please forgive me."
"Sister Sisi, I have a great resource. I initially wanted to negotiate it for you."
"Sister Sisi, there’s a movie, and I think you’d be perfect for the lead role."
"Sister Sisi, are you thirsty? Let me get you a drink."
"..."
A group of executives surrounded Liu Sisi, showering her with flattery, leaving her quite bewildered...
Meanwhile, Lin Fan and Du Tao left Feihu Company.
Suddenly, they saw several luxury cars parked outside the company, each with a sharply dressed person standing beside them, each looking nervous, as if waiting for something.
Seeing the two come out, these people quickly gathered around, bowing and scraping to Du Tao.
"President Du, I’m He Hui, the boss of a new marketing company. I’ve come specifically to apologize to you. Please forgive us."
"President Du, I am Luo Jinfeng, the boss of Dashan Entertainment. I’ve come specifically to apologize. Please forgive us!"
"..."
These people turned out to be all marketing company heads!
Their companies previously took bribes from Wu Zi’er and participated in smearing Liu Sisi.
After learning that Du Tao got involved, these bosses were terrified and rushed to apologize in person.
Du Tao was a terrifying figure in the entertainment industry, with merely a gesture, their companies could go bankrupt.
However, Du Tao ignored these people and respectfully turned to Lin Fan, bowing slightly and asked, "Mr. Lin, how should we handle these people?"
What?
These marketing company bosses were completely baffled. Du Tao was so respectful in consulting this young man—who on earth was this young man?

chapters.title: Chapter 100 Policewoman: I Already Have a Boyfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100 Policewoman: I Already Have a Boyfriend
The few bosses were all stunned. Du Tao was actually asking a young man for instructions?
This young man was dressed in cheap street clothes, they originally thought he was Du Tao’s little sidekick. What’s going on?
"President Du, who is this?" One of the bosses couldn’t help but ask.
Du Tao calmly responded, "Let me introduce, this is our Big Boss at Tianxue Entertainment, Mr. Lin."
"What?"
The bosses were shocked and utterly astonished.
This young man is actually the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment?
No wonder even Du Tao had to bow his head.
"So it’s the Big Boss, my apologies for the disrespect."
"Hello, Mr. Lin, I’m He Hui. Please, Big Boss, be lenient."
"Big Boss, please show mercy, let us off just this once?"
The bosses all pleaded with Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan!"
Suddenly, a voice came from the side, and a beautiful police officer, Loli, walked over. It turned out she hadn’t left yet and was waiting outside for Lin Fan. Earlier, there were too many people at the company, and she was too embarrassed to greet him.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Officer Sis, you haven’t left yet. Great, I have a favor to ask you."
Loli was overjoyed in her heart. She had been wondering how to strike up a conversation with her idol, and now he needed something from her. It couldn’t be better.
Loli asked, "What is it?"
Lin Fan pointed at the few bosses in front of him, "These marketing company bosses admitted to taking bribes from Wu Zi’er to smear Liu Sisi. Could you please send them to jail for a while to reflect?"
Upon hearing this, the bosses were sweating profusely.
Lin Fan was being too ruthless.
Yet they lowered their heads, not daring to utter a word.
Loli responded, "Is what he said true?"
In front of Lin Fan and Du Tao, the bosses didn’t dare to deny it, all nodding timidly.
Loli coldly said, "Alright, report to the Yun City West District Police Station yourselves, don’t go to the wrong place. Hurry up, or I’ll shut down your companies too."
The bosses were shocked, and with panicked expressions, they quickly got into their cars, driving themselves to the police station.
After this incident, at the mention of Lin Fan, these people shivered and avoided Tianxue Entertainment’s celebrities, not daring to smear them anymore.
Du Tao, witnessing this, secretly admired Lin Fan. These marketing companies typically maintained a large group of paid commentators, specialized in manipulating public opinion. They smear rival celebrities for money or clean up images for money. Generally, entertainment companies give them face out of fear of retaliation, continually sending them money to prevent their celebrities from being smeared.
Even for Du Tao, he had to use connections and spend enough money to get the paid commentators to self-destruct this time.
But Lin Fan? He had no intention of appeasing these marketing companies with money but sent them to jail for reflection instead!
To others, this act would undoubtedly offend the paid commentators, but for Lin Fan, sending them to jail was already showing them mercy.
Du Tao believed if Lin Fan wanted, eradicating these marketing companies would be a mere wave of the hand!
In reality, Lin Fan wasn’t as formidable as Du Tao thought. He simply didn’t know the rules of the entertainment circle, so he sent these bosses to jail. If he knew how highly Du Tao regarded him, he’d surely be amused and exasperated.
At this moment, Loli asked, "By the way, Lin Fan, why are you here?"
Lin Fan replied, "I came to seek justice for Sisi."
Loli curiously asked, "Liu Sisi is a female celebrity, do you know her? No way, were you the one having dinner with Liu Sisi last night?"
Loli had seen Liu Sisi’s incident online, the photo only showed the back of Lin Fan’s head, and it felt so familiar.
Lin Fan admitted, "Yes, it was me."
Loli felt a bit jealous. Liu Sisi was so lucky to have dinner with her idol; she hadn’t even had dinner with him yet.
"Big Boss, are you going back to Tianxue later?" Du Tao respectfully asked at that moment.
Loli blinked, surprised, "Wait, Big Boss? Lin Fan, what kind of Big Boss are you?"
Du Tao explained, "Mr. Lin is our Big Boss at Tianxue Entertainment."
"What?" Loli was astonished. Her idol was so wealthy, and he was the Big Boss of an entertainment company.
Loli asked, "What connection does Tianxue Entertainment have with Feihu?"
