Du Tao continued, "Feihu is a subsidiary of our Tianxue."
Loli finally understood. With Lin Fan’s position as Tianxue’s Big Boss, seeking justice for Liu Sisi was a breeze. No wonder Wu Zi’er’s scandal broke out online swiftly!
Her idol was so impressive, she truly admired him!
Loli was momentarily infatuated.
"Lin Fan, since you’re responsible, please accompany me to the station to make a statement!" Loli seriously said.
Lin Fan felt a sweat. If he had known, he wouldn’t have disclosed his identity to her.
"I won’t be going to the company for now; I’ll visit another day when I’m free," Lin Fan told Du Tao.
"Alright, Mr. Lin."
Du Tao replied, then took his leave.
Lin Fan looked at Loli, "Officer Sis, can I drive myself, or do you want me to ride in your police car?"
Loli said, "My partner drove off with the police car. You drive yours, and I’ll ride along."
"Okay."
Lin Fan then brought Loli to his Kosak.
Loli’s eyes lit up. This car was so cool. She’d seen it in Lin Fan’s viral video slapping a wannabe model’s face. Now, she could finally see it in person.
The two soon got in the car, with Loli sitting in the passenger seat, blushing and heart racing. Finally alone with her idol, and in the same car, too. She felt so nervous.
"Officer Sis, where is your station?" Lin Fan asked.
Loli replied, "We’re not going to the station."
Lin Fan inquired curiously, "Didn’t you say we’ll make a statement?"
Loli chuckled, "Yes, a statement, but we don’t need to go to the station. I’m a bit hungry, how about we find a spot to eat, and do the statement there?"
Loli was giggling inside; she was so clever, finding an excuse to have a meal with her idol.
Lin Fan indifferently said, "Whatever Officer Sis decides."
And so, the two found a nearby restaurant and went in to eat.
People in the restaurant thought they were a couple, musing over whom to envy more as they admired the handsome man and the beautiful woman.
"Officer, are you having dinner with your boyfriend?" The owner greeted warmly.
Loli was secretly delighted, happy despite the misunderstanding.
Lin Fan didn’t know what Loli was thinking and worried she might be upset, intending to clarify.
"Lily, what a coincidence to run into you here!"
Suddenly, an auntie came over.
Loli’s expression turned a bit awkward upon seeing this auntie.
The auntie said, "How about that coal boss I introduced to you last time? Still in touch? Not to nag, but you’re not young anymore, time to find a man. That coal boss is so rich, didn’t go well again?"
Loli grabbed Lin Fan’s arm and laughed, "Last time didn’t go well, but no worries, Aunt Song, I already have a boyfriend now."

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Do you think I’m a failure?
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Do you think I’m a failure?
Auntie sized up Lin Fan skeptically, "Is he your boyfriend?"
Loli felt a bit guilty and brazenly replied, "Of course he is!"
Lin Fan gently held her small hand and said to the auntie, "Hello Auntie, I’m Lily’s boyfriend."
With Lin Fan’s hand holding hers, Loli felt a rush of warmth and a surge of safety. Wow, this dream guy is so warm.
The auntie initially wanted to criticize Loli a bit, but now all her words of criticism were swallowed back.
"Haha, alright then," the auntie was caught off guard and seemed a bit at a loss, so she just turned around and walked away.
Lin Fan and Loli then sat down at a nearby empty seat.
Loli sighed in relief and said with a sweet smile, "That was close. If she saw through me, she would have nagged me for ages."
Lin Fan asked, "Who is she to you?"
Loli replied, "She’s my mom’s best friend, quite the gossip. Doesn’t see herself as an outsider and always nags that I need a boyfriend and keeps trying to set me up, which is so annoying. But because of my mom, I can’t retort."
Lin Fan found it a bit amusing. No wonder even a police officer like Loli would feel a bit uneasy in front of such an auntie; she indeed was quite annoying.
"Lin Fan, I’m so glad you helped me out just now. Thank you," Loli said gratefully.
Lin Fan smiled and replied, "Just lending a hand."
Loli blushed, wanting to say, "Why don’t dream guy really become my boyfriend?" But she was a female after all, too shy to say it.
"Forget about her, let’s eat. What do you like to eat?" Loli smiled, changing the subject.
So, the two of them ordered food and ate.
While eating, Loli took a statement from Lin Fan.
Taking the statement was secondary; having a meal with the dream guy was the main point. Loli felt very satisfied. She finally had a meal with the dream guy. She was envious and jealous when she heard Liu Sisi had dinner with Lin Fan last night.
The two chatted and laughed, the atmosphere was pleasant.
This surprised Lin Fan a little. Last time at the small hotel, he was mistakenly arrested by Loli and felt a bit overshadowed by her, but after this meal, it all dissipated.
He found Loli didn’t have much of a police officer’s manner, more like a young girl, very likable.
After they finished eating, the statement was done, and they were about to check out and leave.
Suddenly, Loli’s phone rang.
Loli picked up the call, her face a bit serious, "Just got a report, someone nearby is going to jump off a building. Can you take me over to check it out?"
Lin Fan immediately agreed, "Sure."
So the two hurriedly paid the bill and left the restaurant.
Just as they stepped outside, the auntie they met earlier suddenly came over and grabbed Loli.
"Lily, I just called your mom. She said she doesn’t know anything about you having a boyfriend. What’s going on with this boyfriend of yours?" the auntie questioned.
Loli, in a hurry to rescue someone, said, "Aunt Song, I’ll explain to you later. I have an urgent matter now."
But the auntie wouldn’t let go, "Tell me clearly, when did you start hiding from us about dating? That coal boss is so rich, yet you don’t want him. This guy looks like he’s poor. Your taste can’t be that bad, right?"
Lin Fan quietly walked to the side, took out a car key, and pressed it.
The Kosak immediately started up.
Lin Fan sat in the driver’s seat and turned his head, "Officer Sister, saving lives is urgent. Hurry up."
The auntie was stunned on the spot.
Loli easily shook off the auntie’s hand this time, quickly getting into Lin Fan’s car.
Then, the Kosak sped away.
Aunt Song was almost petrified. Oh my god, this guy decked out in bargain bin clothes actually drives a luxury car. He’s so wealthy; turns out he’s a super rich second generation. I totally misjudged him!
In front of Lin Fan, that coal boss is just a poor guy, not worth mentioning.
Aunt Song muttered, "This girl, she’s doing well for herself..."
Now about Lin Fan, he drove Loli to a nearby community. Getting out of the car, Lin Fan noticed that the community next door was Tangchen Yipin!
What a coincidence, today a tenant needed to pay rent. He was planning to head back to Tangchen Yipin, just perfect, once this is dealt with, he can go there.
On the rooftop of a building in the community, there was a young man, looking utterly desperate, sitting on the railing. He was the one planning to jump.
This building was only ten stories high, although not comparable to the surrounding skyscrapers, jumping off it would still mean a thorough death.
A crowd was gathering below.
Some were sighing, some were jeering.
"Ugh, why are young people these days so unable to let go, wanting to commit suicide at the drop of a hat."
"Maybe he got dumped!"
"There are plenty of women out there, but only one life. Jumping for a woman is not worth it."
"Right, so pathetic."
Suddenly, someone yelled, "Hey, I think you’re a loser too! Hurry up and jump, end it all!"
"If you’re going to die, hurry up and die. I need to go back home and play PUBG!"
"Damn it, we’ve been waiting forever, why aren’t you jumping yet? Are you going to jump or not?"
Instantly, a few people started jeering.
Listening to these words, the young man looked utterly hopeless, almost about to jump.
"All of you shut up! If he jumps, I’ll hold you all accountable!"
Loli came running angrily.
The few who were jeering shivered in fear and immediately went silent, not daring to continue.
"Officer Sister, you’re here just in time. Please try to persuade this young man. I live in this building, and if he jumps and dies, I wouldn’t dare to live here anymore," a middle-aged man said anxiously.
Loli was a bit speechless. These people were either jeering or scared, but none of them cared about the young man. If things continued like this, the young man would only have one path to death.
This is why, when facing a jumper, you need professional personnel to persuade them, such as negotiators or police, because bystanders’ jeering often prompts suicides. Even if the suicidal person was just impulsive and didn’t truly want to jump, once provoked by the jeering, they might get emotional and actually jump.
Loli looked up and said, "Sir, don’t listen to them. Look at me and tell me why you’re feeling this way."
The young man saw someone finally cared, and burst into tears, "Officer Sister, don’t bother with me. Just let me die."
Loli patiently said, "Dying won’t solve the problem. What difficulty are you experiencing? Tell me, maybe I can help you?"
The young man shook his head in despair, "You can’t help me. I’m a failure. I lost all my capital in business, now I have nothing, can’t even pay my mortgage, and am deeply in debt. My wife left me for another man. Tell me what point is there in living?"
Loli secretly broke out in a cold sweat; this guy’s indeed a bit miserable, hearing it makes one want to die.
But she still had to persuade, "Don’t say that. Dying is better than living aimlessly. Maybe you can bounce back. If you die, there’s no hope left. Living, there’s always a chance to turn things around. Don’t you think?"
The young man replied, "No, you won’t understand. If there were even a glimmer of hope, I wouldn’t be jumping. Don’t try to persuade me, let me die."
After saying this, the young man made a move to jump off.
Loli was extremely anxious at heart. Seeing this, it seemed the man was determined to die, and her persuasion was ineffective.
"Buddy, what kind of failure is that? I’m more of a failure than you, but I’m still living well!"
Just then, Lin Fan spoke in a loud voice.
The young man couldn’t help but be curious. Someone worse off than him?
"What’s your failure?" the young man asked.
Lin Fan looked sorrowful and sighed, "I wanted to earn money with my own two hands, but I was born inheriting billions. Apart from spending, I can’t do anything else, I can’t even take care of myself, everything is managed by housekeepers. Wanted to get a wife, but there are so many beauties lining up for miles, all vying to marry me. I don’t know who to choose. I’m only 21 this year. Imagine, even if I live to be 100, there’s still 79 more years, and I won’t be able to spend all my money. Do you think I’m a failure? Yet even so, I live strongly on."
Young man: "..."
Jeez, don’t hit a person when they’re down. The young man felt a pang in his heart.
The people around had already ’surrendered’ in awe.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: A Phone Call Saves a Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: A Phone Call Saves a Life
The young man had made up his mind to jump off the building, but Lin Fan suddenly appeared and managed to hold him back temporarily.
However, what Lin Fan said was really piercing, and the young man felt a twinge in his heart.
Especially when he noticed that Lin Fan had arrived in a luxury car, it made his heart ache even more.
The rich get richer while the poor get poorer; comparing oneself to others is truly infuriating.
The crowd around had already kneeled in awe, Lin Fan’s ability to show off was truly unexpected. If Lin Fan had really failed, who in the world wouldn’t want to fail just like him!
"Oh heavens, why are you so unfair!" the young man lamented.
Lin Fan said, "That’s not quite right. I believe the heavens are fair; there is gain and loss. For example, I gained wealth, but I lost many worries."
Upon hearing this, the young man felt even more heartbroken and almost collapsed.
Yet Lin Fan continued, "And as for you, you lost everything but gained a chance at rebirth!"
The young man was taken aback: "A chance at rebirth?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I can tell that while you are in despair, there is a hint of defiance in it. You are not willing to accept the failure of your business, you want to make a comeback. You are unwilling to be abandoned by that woman. If you die, that woman will definitely call you a coward and feel justified in leaving you. You want to slap that spiteful woman’s face, am I right?"
The young man seemed to have his inner thoughts exposed, clenched his fists, trembling, with a surge of sorrow and anger in his eyes.
Lin Fan said, "Anyway, I have more money than I can spend. If you live, I’ll give you this opportunity!"
"What?"
The young man looked at Lin Fan in surprise, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said, "Why don’t you come down and we can discuss it. Of course, if you don’t want this opportunity, just go ahead and jump, end it all."
The young man hesitated almost not at all and quickly backed away, giving up on suicide.
Lin Fan’s words were too tempting for him.
A chance to rise again!
Hope suddenly dispelled despair.
Loli, seeing the man give up on suicide, was thrilled, and shouted, "No more show here, everyone disperse!"
The onlookers were reluctant. Who said there was no show to watch? They wanted to see what hope Lin Fan gave the man, but with the police’s order, they didn’t dare not listen and scattered.
Loli looked at Lin Fan and giggled, "Lin Fan, you are so clever, fooled this guy down. I’ll take over from here, I’ll take him back to the station to calm down later."
Lin Fan said, "What if he comes out and tries to commit suicide again?"
Loli said, "He shouldn’t. We have psychological experts for counseling."
Lin Fan said, "No amount of psychological counseling can replace giving him hope, Officer Sis, see how he is doing before deciding."
The young man soon came downstairs, looked at Lin Fan with anticipation, "What do you mean by what you just said?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Don’t be anxious. Tell me your name and your specific situation, and see if I can help you."
The young man said, "My name is Sun Xing. I run a film special effects company, but in recent years, the film industry has been sluggish. Our company isn’t large, and our connections aren’t extensive, so we gradually had no business. I invested all my money into the company and now can’t even pay the company rent. I could grit my teeth and endure, but that woman suddenly ran off with someone else, and in a moment of desperation, I just..."
Lin Fan laughed, "You really don’t need to commit suicide. As the saying goes, true character is revealed in adversity. You’ve seen her true character, you should be happy."
Sun Xing sighed, feeling aggrieved, "What’s the use of seeing her true character, I’m powerless. Besides being angry, I can’t do anything to her."
Lin Fan said, "What’s the name of your company?"
Sun Xing said, "Celestial Art Special Effects."
Lin Fan took out his phone and called Du Tao: "Old Du, help me check out this company Celestial Art Special Effects."
Du Tao said, "Celestial Art Special Effects? I know it, it’s a small-scale film special effects company. We had a small project which we gave to them, and the finished product was pretty good. The boss, Sun Xing, is a young man with ambitions."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Why didn’t you continue collaborating with them afterward?"
Du Tao said, "Although their skills are good, unfortunately, their scale is small and can only handle small projects, so we didn’t go to them again."
Lin Fan said, "If we collaborate with them again, will it have any negative effects on us?"
Du Tao said, "Not at all. Because we have a lot of projects, and the companies we collaborate with are overwhelmed. If we let Celestial Art participate and throw a couple of projects their way, they could probably manage."
This world truly operates on the principle of the rich getting richer while the poor get poorer.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, Sun Xing is my friend, please take care of him for me."
Du Tao immediately took it seriously; Mr. Lin’s friend must be well taken care of.
"Alright, Mr. Lin, I’ll arrange it right away," Du Tao said.
After hanging up, Lin Fan looked at Sun Xing and said, "Tianxue Entertainment will contact you soon to discuss cooperation, keep an eye on your phone."
Sun Xing’s eyes widened: "Tianxue Entertainment?"
Could Lin Fan really mobilize Tianxue to cooperate with him? Sun Xing found it hard to believe.
Ring Ring Ring...
Sun Xing’s phone rang. Looking at the caller, it was indeed from Tianxue Entertainment Company! He had worked with Tianxue before and kept the contact number.
Sun Xing was so surprised his hands trembled as he quickly grabbed the call: "Hello?"
The person on the other end said, "Is this Mr. Sun Xing?"
Sun Xing said, "Yes, it is."
"Hello, Mr. Sun, I am Du Tao, the President of Tianxue," the voice said.
My goodness, Tianxue’s President Du Tao, a renowned figure in the entertainment industry, personally called him!
Sun Xing immediately dropped to his knees.
"Mr. Du..." Sun Xing was too excited to speak coherently.
Du Tao said, "We have a few projects on our side that we’d like to discuss with you. Can you come to Tianxue at your convenience?"
Sun Xing was moved to tears and hurriedly said, "Yes, I’ll come right away."
After hanging up the phone, Sun Xing was already overcome with gratitude, kneeling before Lin Fan. "Thank you, thank you, benefactor, you are my lifesaver!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "This time, I hope you seize the opportunity. I look forward to seeing you slap that woman’s face, but if you mess up and still think about suicide, I won’t stop you again."
Sun Xing solemnly said, "Rest assured, benefactor, I won’t disappoint you! Oh, I still don’t know your name."
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan."
"Thank you, Mr. Lin!"
Sun Xing kowtowed in thanks to Lin Fan, then, filled with excitement, headed to Tianxue Company.
When he arrived at Tianxue Company, Du Tao personally came out to receive Sun Xing. This made Sun Xing feel honored and simultaneously amazed that one call from Lin Fan resulted in Tianxue collaborating with him, with the president of Tianxue personally receiving him!
Lin Fan’s status must not be simple!

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Beauty Strategy to Delay Rent
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: Beauty Strategy to Delay Rent
Sun Xing couldn’t help but ask, "Mr. Du, I have a question I’d like to ask, what’s the relationship between Mr. Lin and you?"
Du Tao found it odd, wasn’t Sun Xing a friend of Mr. Lin? How come he didn’t know?
"Mr. Lin is my boss," Du Tao replied.
What?
Sun Xing’s legs gave out, and he immediately knelt down.
Oh my God, Lin Fan is actually the boss of Tianxue Entertainment!
No wonder a single call dispatched Du Tao. Du Tao is already a heavyweight in the entertainment industry, and Lin Fan is the boss of the boss, what an esteemed identity!
Sun Xing never dreamed that when he was on the brink of despair, he would meet such a distinguished person, who, with a flick of his finger, pulled him back from the abyss...
Having saved Sun Xing with a single call, Lin Fan was also preparing to leave after seeing Sun Xing off.
Beside him, Loli was looking at Lin Fan with an expression of admiration.
Her idol, truly charismatic—young, handsome, wealthy, and full of a sense of justice—he used the power of money to save a life!
She had never met a man like this before, his damn allure made her heart race, she couldn’t look at him again, or else she’d be charmed to death.
"Officer sis, do you need a ride back to the station?" Lin Fan asked.
Loli really wanted to spend more time with Lin Fan, but she had matters to attend to, so she said, "No need, my partner is already coming to pick me up, there’s another case to handle."
Lin Fan replied, "Alright then, I’ll get going."
Lin Fan then said goodbye to Loli and got into the Kosak, heading towards the neighboring Tangchen Yipin.
Loli watched Lin Fan’s car leave with reluctance, if she could, she’d love to be with Lin Fan all the time.
A police car drove up.
Loli’s partner, Little Wang, stuck his head out, "Sister Lily, what are you staring at so intently, your boyfriend?"
A top-notch luxury car sped away, looking at Sister Li’s expression, could it be she’s got a Rich Second Generation boyfriend? This would be big news, telling the guys back at the station would surely make them wail.
Loli finally snapped out of it, giving Little Wang a sideways look, "Stop being nosy!"
Little Wang awkwardly scratched his head and changed the subject, "Hey, wasn’t there someone about to commit suicide here, where are they?"
Loli said, "He gave up on that idea."
Little Wang gave a thumbs up, "Sister Lily, you’re awesome, saving a lost youth’s life."
Loli said, "I wasn’t the one who saved him, someone else did."
Little Wang curiously asked, "Who was it?"
Loli, with an infatuated look in her eyes, said, "My idol, the person I admire most!"
Little Wang wiped the sweat off his brow, oh no, Sister Lily seems to have caught lovesickness, who on earth stole Sister Lily’s heart!?
Could it be the person in that luxury car just now?
Next door at Tangchen Yipin.
Lin Fan had already driven to the entrance.
Ah~choo!
Suddenly, he sneezed.
"Who’s thinking about handsome me again?"
The security guard suddenly saw a Kosak pulling up, and immediately perked up, the visitor mustn’t be simple!
Even at Tangchen Yipin, it was the first time they saw such a top-level supercar!
The security guard didn’t dare to slack off at all, opening the gate immediately; even if the visitor wasn’t a resident of Tangchen Yipin, they must be an honored guest not to be neglected.
The security guard ran over to Lin Fan’s car, nodding and bowing.
Lin Fan lowered the car window and flashed the Ultimate Black Card.
When the security guard saw it was Lin Fan, he knelt on the spot.
It was Mr. Lin!
Oh my God, no wonder he can drive such a high-level luxury car, it makes sense for it to be Mr. Lin, after all, Mr. Lin owns an entire building in Tangchen Yipin and has the sole Ultimate Black Card!
Yesterday Mr. Lin was dressed like a delivery guy, riding an electric scooter, today’s car is the proper way to arrive!
"Mr. Lin, welcome back, you may go in," the security guard respectfully said.
Lin Fan drove in.
Subsequently, a Maserati pulled up at the entrance.
The long-legged beauty car owner curiously looked around, "Who is the person in the car up front, I don’t think I’ve seen them before?"
The security guard said, "It’s Mr. Lin."
The long-legged beauty was shocked, "The owner of the whole A building?"
Today he’s not on an electric scooter, but driving a top-notch supercar, this car is simply awesome!
For some reason, the long-legged beauty wanted to say hello to Lin Fan, after all, Lin Fan was her landlord.
So, the long-legged beauty hurriedly drove in as well, arriving at the parking lot of Building A.
She saw Lin Fan already getting out of the car heading to the elevator.
The long-legged beauty quickly parked the car, got out, and chased after Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin wait for me..."
But by the time she reached the elevator, Lin Fan was already inside, and the elevator doors had just closed.
The long-legged beauty stomped her foot in frustration, just a little bit more, but she still hadn’t caught up with Lin Fan.
All the units in Tangchen Yipin are one suite per building, with security settings that only allow residents to their respective floors, so even if she knew where Lin Fan went, she couldn’t follow up.
The long-legged beauty shook her head, comforting herself, "Maybe we’re just not destined yet."
So she had to give up.
Lin Fan entered the elevator, frowning slightly, did he just hear someone calling out to him?
But the elevator doors had already closed, and he was too lazy to look back, maybe he heard wrong.
Today a tenant was supposed to pay rent, so he went up to collect the rent.
The elevator stopped on the 12th floor.
Lin Fan walked out of the elevator and went to the door of the 12th-floor resident, knocking on it, "Hello, are you home? I’m the landlord, here to collect the rent!"
Inside the 12th-floor apartment, a pure-looking beauty was snuggled up in the living room, live streaming on a phone.
It turned out she was a streamer, and quite a big one at that, her good looks and melodious singing had won her countless fans, with monthly earnings in the hundreds of thousands, sometimes even a million, so renting at Tangchen Yipin was not a problem for her at all.
"Sorry folks, my landlord is knocking, I’m so pitiful, I have to pay rent again, what do I do if I don’t have the money?" The beauty lamented to the camera, striking a pitiful appearance.
The comments started pouring in.
"What nonsense, Miao Miao, you not having money for rent, who are you kidding?"
"666, Miao Miao, honestly, where did all your money go?"
"You didn’t even keep me as a sugar baby!"
"Trying to scam me into sending rockets again."
Miao Miao jokingly cursed, "You bastards, I really am not pretending to be poor, I’m really out of money, what do I do, how should I deal with the landlord?"
"Use your feminine wiles!" one comment suggested.
"Great idea, Miao Miao’s so pretty, a little bit of charm and the landlord’s legs will surely give out."
"Are you sure it’s his legs that will give out?"
Miao Miao giggled, "Last time I saw the landlord, he did look at me lewdly, I should be able to get him to give me a few more days, just wait and see the show."
So, Miao Miao got up and responded, "Coming!"
She walked over and opened the door, instantly spotting Lin Fan standing outside.
Wow!
What a hottie!
The comments were full of exclaims.
"Oh my God, Miao Miao, your landlord is so young and handsome!"
"Tall, rich, and handsome!"
"Amazing!"
"Miao Miao is going to use her feminine wiles on him, this is going to be... exciting!"
Miao Miao was taken aback, "Who are you? Where’s the landlord?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You didn’t know? The owner has changed, I’m the landlord now, could you please pay your rent."
Miao Miao said, "I didn’t know, wait a moment, let me make a call to confirm."
Miao Miao called the previous owner and learned that indeed, the owner had changed, and it was the young man in front of her.
The previous landlord looked at her lustfully, but dealing with Lin Fan was different, the difficulty has risen!
However, Miao Miao was confident in herself, believing that her charms could ensnare Lin Fan as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Live Broadcast: Textbook-Level Straight Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Live Broadcast: Textbook-Level Straight Man
"The landlord said the house was indeed sold, sold to a young man named Lin Fan. Are you really Lin Fan?"
Zheng Miaomiao asked, somewhat skeptical. Although Lin Fan was handsome, he was dressed in cheap clothes and didn’t look like a rich person at all. You know, this house is worth over a hundred million—only billionaires could afford it!
Lin Fan was prepared, took out his ID card and a red booklet, and handed them to Miao Miao.
Miao Miao took them, first looking at the ID card. It was indeed named Lin Fan, but to confirm if he was the landlord still needed further verification.
Miao Miao opened the property certificate.
Property Owner: Lin Fan!
It seemed to be true, then—this young man was really the owner of this house.
Wait a minute!
Miao Miao noticed something and said, "You got it wrong. I’m on the 12th floor. This property certificate is for the 16th floor. Hey, aren’t you the landlord here?"
Lin Fan took the property certificate back for a look. Indeed, it was for the 16th floor, so he took out two more property certificates.
"Sorry, I grabbed the wrong one. This is the one for the 12th floor." Lin Fan found the property certificate for the 12th floor and handed it to Miao Miao for her to see.
At present, there were only three tenants in this building. He came today intending to meet all of them, so he brought all three property certificates.
Miao Miao’s eyes lit up when she saw his three red booklets.
Oh my!
He actually had three Tangchen Yipin property certificates!
"Well...do you really have three units here?" Miao Miao’s voice was trembling slightly.
Lin Fan said coolly, "No."
Miao Miao asked curiously, "No? Then how come you have three property certificates?"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t have three units—I have 40 units; this entire building is mine."
"What?"
Miao Miao was stunned. Having three units already made her excited—owning a whole building, what kind of concept was that?
Oh my god, could Lin Fan be a billionaire?
Her landlord turned out to be a billionaire?
Lin Fan put away the property certificates and said, "Now that you’ve confirmed my identity, you can pay the rent, right? The rent is 100,000 yuan, excluding utilities and management fees, totaling 105,800 yuan. Just transfer it to my bank account, thanks."
A rent of over 100,000 a month!
The comments section exploded instantly.
"Wow, Miao Miao actually lives in such an expensive house!"
"No wonder Miao Miao said she couldn’t afford the rent—this is too expensive!"
"Where is this place? How can it be so expensive!"
"Oh my, is the house gilded?"
"The landlord has a whole building with 40 units, so he earns at least 4 million in rent every month!"
"Wow, the landlord is super rich!"
"Kneeling for the tycoon!"
Miao Miao bit her lip, putting on a pitiful look, "Landlord, handsome brother, can I pay the rent a little later? I don’t have that much money right now."
Lin Fan responded with an "oh": "According to the information you registered, are you a streaming host?"
Miao Miao said, "Yes, I am a streaming host."
Lin Fan glanced inside and saw some streaming equipment in the living room, and it seemed like it was live streaming.
If it was live streaming, that meant someone was watching them.
Lin Fan said, "I’ve heard streaming hosts earn quite a bit, and you can afford to live here, so your income shouldn’t be low. How can you not afford the rent?"
Miao Miao said, "Actually, it’s not that profitable in this line of work, and I’ve had a lot of expenses recently, so I really have no money left. Handsome brother, feel sorry for me. You wouldn’t turn a blind eye, would you?"
Miao Miao looked at Lin Fan intently, with a flirtatious expression in her eyes.
Lin Fan admitted, Miao Miao was a real beauty; she scored above an 8, close to a 9.
He had always been a gentleman towards beautiful women, but the premise was that the other party should be honest with him. If she was calculating against him, that was a different matter.
According to the tenant registration information, Zheng Miaomiao was a major host on the Teasing Whiskers Livestream platform, earning a million a month, well capable of paying the monthly rent.
The possibility of her not having the money for rent was very small.
Now she was asking for a delay in paying rent and was intentionally live streaming—she either wanted to act pitiful in front of the audience to get gifts or was trying to fool him.
"How many days do you plan to delay?" Lin Fan asked calmly.
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Could I pay it next month?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Sorry, you can’t. According to the rental agreement, you have to pay the rent on time, otherwise, as the landlord, I can terminate the contract and ask you to move out immediately."
The comments section suddenly became lively.
"Wow, a ruthless rejection!"
"Miao Miao’s beauty trap didn’t work!"
"Awesome, the landlord must be a straight man, not caring about beauty at all."
"If it were me, I’d agree with Miao Miao!"
"Miao Miao, come live at my place, free for life!"
Miao Miao saw Lin Fan’s decisive rejection; she was unwilling. With so many people watching the livestream, it would be embarrassing if she fails.
If it were the previous landlord, she could have charmed him with just a smile.
It seemed dealing with Lin Fan needed more effort.
Miao Miao looked pitiful and said, "Landlord, handsome brother, you’re so heartless. I’m so sad."
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Not getting the rent makes me even sadder."
Miao Miao purposely sighed, "Alright then, brother, just come in and sit for a moment. Let me check how much money I have and transfer it to you."
Miao Miao stepped aside, letting Lin Fan enter the room.
Lin Fan entered and sat on the living room sofa.
Miao Miao enthusiastically went to the side, poured a glass of water, and walked up to Lin Fan, bending down and sweetly saying, "Brother, have some water."
She purposely bent over, making her neckline intriguingly deep.
Lin Fan naturally noticed, and he had to admit, it was pretty nice. Since it was offered willingly, Lin Fan saw no reason to be polite.
Miao Miao took the opportunity to sit in front of Lin Fan, a waft of warmth in the air.
"Landlord, handsome brother, I just checked, I really don’t have that much money. Either you delay the rent for a month or waive some of it. What do you think? I’d be really grateful."
Miao Miao said coquettishly, her hand brushing lightly over Lin Fan’s hand, seemingly hinting at something.
This approach was practically textbook flirtation, and she didn’t believe Lin Fan could remain unaffected; with her beauty, even a cold-hearted person would melt!
Lin Fan said, "How much do you need me to waive?"
Miao Miao secretly rejoiced, thinking Lin Fan had softened, and her plan was working: "Just waive the utilities and management fees, round it to a nice 100,000, okay? With so many properties, 5,000 is nothing to you. I think it’s doable!"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "5,000 isn’t much, but it’s not about the money. Waiving is impossible; if I set this precedent, everyone else will come and ask for exceptions—then what?"
Another failure!
Miao Miao was unwilling; why wouldn’t Lin Fan budge? Was it that her charm wasn’t enough?
Impossible!
Miao Miao smiled charmingly and asked, "Landlord, handsome brother, can I ask you a personal question? Do you have a girlfriend?"
Lin Fan said, "No."
Miao Miao said with affection, "Then what do you think of me?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "I think you should pay the rent immediately."
Pfft!
Viewers watching the livestream either sprayed their water or choked on their food.
"I’m laughing so hard; Miao Miao was implying to become his girlfriend, and he totally didn’t catch on."
"We’ve found the reason he’s single!"
"He’s the ultimate straightforward man!"
"Miao Miao, just give up and pay the rent!"
Miao Miao was frustrated, even a bit angry; her beauty trap had utterly failed. This Lin Fan was too infuriating!

chapters.title: Chapter 105: The Passionate Hospitality of the Stunningly Beautiful Tenant
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: The Passionate Hospitality of the Stunningly Beautiful Tenant
"Miss Zheng Miaomiao, I’ll give you two choices as well. Either you pay the rent immediately, or you terminate the contract and pack up to leave," Lin Fan chuckled.
Miao Miao snorted, stood up, and said angrily, "Fine, I’ll pay. You’re not cute at all!"
Miao Miao picked up her phone from the side and immediately transferred the money to Lin Fan.
Ding dong!
Lin Fan quickly received an SMS notification saying that 105,800 had been credited to his bank account!
Lin Fan was delighted deep inside; he had finally received his first rent payment, officially starting his new career as a landlord.
This amount, though not much, was enough to give his sister some pocket money.
Lin Fan laid his phone down with satisfaction and lifted his eyes to playfully appraise Miao Miao. The truth confirmed his speculation: this woman wasn’t unable to pay the rent—she was just trying to find ways not to. Lin Fan wouldn’t go easy on women like her.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Remember to pay the rent on time next month as well. Oh, only my girlfriend gets a rent discount, too bad you’re not my type."
After saying that, Lin Fan got up and walked out.
Miao Miao was fuming: "You!"
He actually dared to say she wasn’t his type! It was almost like saying she was ugly.
Miao Miao sat down, still indignant in front of the camera: "I’m so angry, I hate these straight guys the most!"
Comments came flooding in to console her.
"It’s okay, Miao Miao, you’re my type!"
"He doesn’t know how to appreciate beauty; serves him right for being single!"
"This straight guy is beyond hope; no wonder he’s so rich and still single!"
"Don’t be upset Miao Miao, I’ll give you a rent discount."
Seeing a fan send a virtual rocket, Miao Miao wasn’t as angry anymore.
She felt a bit regretful. In hindsight, she shouldn’t have done the live stream; she embarrassed herself in front of her fans and revealed she was living in a mansion with a 100,000 monthly rent.
Blame it on Lin Fan; who would’ve thought this guy could resist her charms and even say she’s not his type? It was simply humiliating.
Miao Miao felt unsettled. Her charm tactics usually worked flawlessly, yet Lin Fan was her first failure.
"You stubborn man, what type do you even like?" Miao Miao couldn’t help but wonder.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan had left the 12th floor and taken the elevator to the 16th floor, intending to greet his tenant.
He pressed the elevator button for the 16th floor.
Soon, he heard a female voice from inside saying, "Coming!"
The door opened, and Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.
The woman who answered the door was a stunning beauty!
Crucially, she dressed very casually at home...
Lin Fan nearly got a nosebleed.
"Miss Nie Qiao’er? Hello, I’m your new landlord," Lin Fan said, struggling to tear his eyes away from her and presented the property deed.
Nie Qiao’er took the property deed and looked at it, smiling. "I heard from the property management that there’s a new landlord here. I didn’t expect you to be so young and handsome!"
Her eyes curved into charming crescents as she smiled.
"Haha, just alright," Lin Fan said modestly.
Nie Qiao’er reached out and took Lin Fan’s hand, "Come in and have a seat. You came at the right time; I’m just cooking. Stay for a meal?"
"Oh, it’s embarrassing," Lin Fan said, but his body honestly walked inside.
The room was clean and tidy, indicating Nie Qiao’er was a neat person. However, there were many objects in the room, especially instruments—there were simply too many of them.
Lin Fan felt this was similar to Liu Mengjie’s home. Last time he visited Liu Mengjie, he also saw many instruments.
"Mr. Lin, please sit down and have some water. The food will be ready soon," Nie Qiao’er warmly invited Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need to be so polite. I’m just here to introduce myself. From your information, I see you’re a freelance musician?"
Nie Qiao’er replied, "Yes, I mainly create songs online."
Nie Qiao’er had a musical dream since childhood. Currently, she writes songs online, composing and writing lyrics herself, and performing by herself. Her daily work involves staying home and working on her creations.
Lin Fan smiled, "You renting here must mean your income is quite substantial. You must be quite the musical talent."
Nie Qiao’er blushed, "Mr. Lin, please don’t joke. I indeed love music passionately, but don’t dare claim to be a musical talent. I don’t make much money from music right now. Every month, I pay 1,000 for rent, and the rest is covered by my family."
Lin Fan broke into a sweat; it seemed Nie Qiao’er was a rich and beautiful woman, with her family being well off.
Nie Qiao’er continued, "I originally didn’t want to rent such an expensive place, but my dad didn’t want to see me settle, so he rented this for me. My wish is to earn money through songwriting and at least be able to pay my rent myself!"
"Then you have to work hard," Lin Fan encouraged her with a smile.
"Yes, Mr. Lin, you sit for a while. I’ll go and take care of things in the kitchen," Nie Qiao’er said, heading to the kitchen.
Soon, Lin Fan smelled a burnt odor wafting from the kitchen.
Lin Fan felt something bad might have happened. Without saying anything, he stood up and moved aside to avoid the smell.
Suddenly, he noticed a stack of papers filled with musical notes beside the electronic piano, a draft of a song!
Bored, Lin Fan picked it up for a look. With his current musical talent, he immediately saw it was a half-written new song that had gone off the rails.
The creator had run out of inspiration halfway through, making many alterations but ended up in a dead end.
Still, the melody of this song was catchy and innovative. If not for the mishaps, it would have been an excellent new song.
In the end, the creator had talent, but the level of songwriting wasn’t enough. At Nie Qiao’er’s current level, unless guided by a master, she was unlikely to turn things around.
Lin Fan, however, was just the master.
After receiving the reward of top-level musical talent, he hadn’t been using it much, and now, unable to resist the urge, he picked up a pen and swiftly wrote...
Everything done in one go!
Just after putting down the pen, he heard Nie Qiao’er say, "Mr. Lin, come eat."
Nie Qiao’er carried the dish from the kitchen.
"Okay," Lin Fan walked over to the table and his eyes darkened upon seeing the dish.
This plate, pitch black, emitting a burnt smell and resembling something unspeakable—what on earth was it?
"Mr. Lin, I get bored at home alone, so I’ve been learning to cook. Lately, I’ve really enjoyed cooking. This is my Coca-Cola chicken wings; would you try some?" Nie Qiao’er earnestly invited Lin Fan.
Lin Fan broke into a cold sweat; this thing is Coca-Cola chicken wings?
Are you sure eating it won’t kill someone?
Girl, you should give up cooking...
"Um... actually, I’m not very hungry, so you go ahead and eat," Lin Fan awkwardly smiled. He wouldn’t eat it even if you threatened him.
Nie Qiao’er giggled, "I’ve made too much to eat alone. Don’t be polite; come help me with some."
Unable to refuse such hospitality, Lin Fan reluctantly picked up the chopsticks, braving himself, and picked the smallest piece to put in his mouth.
Chewing.
My God, what am I chewing on? It feels like a blend of unspeakable elements—this taste really exists? Where am I, and what’s the meaning of life?
Lin Fan held his breath and turned into a soulless chewing machine.
Completely unaware, Nie Qiao’er smiled and asked, "How is it, delicious?"
Lin Fan forced a smile while giving a thumbs-up.
This is deadly. Lin Fan regretted it deeply, realizing he shouldn’t have let her casual attire lure him inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Awkward Encounter with a Long-legged Beautiful Female Tenant
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: Awkward Encounter with a Long-legged Beautiful Female Tenant
Lin Fan finally managed to swallow the dark cuisine, oh my, it was unbearably bitter, felt like he was suffocating.
"Hey cutie, if it’s delicious, eat more, come on." Qiao’er said enthusiastically, proactively picked a big piece, and put it in Lin Fan’s bowl.
Lin Fan was about to cry: "I’m really full, can’t eat anymore, oh, I just remembered I have something to do, I’ll leave first..."
"Oh my, just finished cooking, so hot."
Qiao’er didn’t pay attention to what Lin Fan said, and casually took off her outer shirt, leaving only a cool little camisole, revealing a pair of snow-white jade arms...
Lin Fan almost had a nosebleed.
"What did you just say?" Qiao’er asked.
"I said I’m a bit hungry." Lin Fan said, his body honestly sat opposite Qiao’er.
Qiao’er picked a piece of chicken wing to eat, frowned, "Brother, this chicken wing seems a bit strange, do you really find it tasty?"
Voice-over: A bit strange, my foot, it’s really strange, the fighter jet of dark cuisine!
But Lin Fan looked at the delectable beauty in front of him and said: "Mm, really fragrant."
After a full meal (visual feast), Lin Fan reluctantly bade farewell and left. During this meal, he ate 5 dark chicken wings.
This made Qiao’er very happy, thinking it was the greatest compliment to her cooking skills.
"Cutie likes to eat my dishes. Next time you come, I’ll cook for you again." Qiao’er said with a smile.
Lin Fan sweatdropped; next time, let’s not cook, let’s do something else.
This dark cuisine is a bit overpowering; when Lin Fan reached the elevator outside, he felt his stomach was acting up.
Then, Lin Fan took the elevator to the 23rd floor, where another tenant lived.
According to the information, this tenant is also a beauty named Lu Shiqing, profession model. Generally, models not only have good temperament but also a great figure.
Lin Fan was a bit looking forward to meeting her.
Lin Fan went forward and rang the doorbell, but no one answered.
Meanwhile, in Building A’s parking lot, long-legged beauty Lu Shiqing was sitting on her Maserati, waiting for something.
It turned out she planned to wait for Lin Fan to come down and greet him.
This landlord who owned the entire Building A intrigued her deeply, and she wanted to introduce herself proactively.
But she waited for ages, and Lin Fan didn’t come down!
Lu Shiqing finally got a bit disheartened; she just got off work, feeling a bit tired, and decided not to wait anymore, preparing to take the elevator upstairs.
And at this moment, Lin Fan thought Lu Shiqing was not at home, intending to go downstairs to leave, but suddenly he felt his stomach getting uncomfortable, like a storm inside.
"Damn, it must be the dark chicken wings acting up!"
Lin Fan smiled bitterly, blaming his lust for Qiao’er’s beauty, having eaten five dark chicken wings. If he didn’t find a toilet quickly, he’d do it in his pants.
Lin Fan quickly pressed the elevator button, intending to go upstairs to use the toilet, since the whole building was his, he could just find an empty room to use the toilet.
But the elevator was going down!
By the time it came up, he feared it would be too late.
Lin Fan had no choice but to take out his key, open the room behind him, and head straight for the toilet after entering.
A few minutes later.
The elevator stopped on the 23rd floor, Lu Shiyun came out of the elevator, not noticing anything unusual.
As usual, she opened the door with the key, entered, took off her shoes, socks, most of her clothes, poured a glass of water in the kitchen, and collapsed onto the sofa.
Letting out a long sigh.
Finally comfortable.
With only herself at home, naturally, she did as she pleased comfortably. After all, even if she wasn’t dressed, no one would see.
Suddenly, Lu Shiyun seemed to hear movement in the bathroom, she sat up abruptly.
And Lin Fan happened to come out of the bathroom.
Four eyes met.
"Ah!"
Both exclaimed at the same time.
Apparently, neither of them expected to see the other.
Lin Fan reacted quickly: "Miss, don’t be afraid, I’m the landlord!"
Lu Shiyun shouted: "I know you’re the landlord, but how did you get in?"
She really didn’t expect that after waiting for Lin Fan in the parking lot for so long, getting disappointed, finally Lin Fan appeared in her house. She didn’t know whether to be surprised or shocked.
Lin Fan said: "I originally came to visit you, but had a stomach upset and came in to borrow the toilet, I had no other intentions."
Lu Shiyun patted her chest, breathed a sigh of relief: "Scared me to death, so you came in to borrow the toilet!"
At this time, Lu Shiyun was wearing very little, as she pat her chest, Lin Fan only saw a swath of white shake in front of him, a pair of long slender legs...
She’s truly a model!
Lin Fan almost had a nosebleed.
It’s really fatal; these female tenants, one dresses cooler than the other. At this rate, my nutrition won’t keep up.
"Well, you..." Lin Fan gestured, kindly reminding Lu Shiyun.
Only then did Lu Shiyun suddenly remember that she was almost naked!
"Ah!"
Lu Shiyun exclaimed, her face turning red with shame, she quickly bowed her head to find clothes to put on.
It was truly embarrassing, thinking no one was home, so she did as she pleased comfortably, not expecting to give Lin Fan such a huge benefit.
"Ahem." Lin Fan coughed twice, turning around consciously, do not see evil, do not hear evil, Amitabha.
"Miss Lu, you weren’t home when I came just now, did you just finish work?" Lin Fan attempted to find a topic to ease the current awkwardness.
Lu Shiyun replied: "Mm."
Lin Fan said: "I saw from your information that you’re a model, if I’m not mistaken, you should be a supermodel?"
Lu Shiyun was a bit curious: "How did you guess?"
Lin Fan smiled and said: "It’s simple, you have top-notch temperament, an even better figure. Even among runway supermodels, you’re quite outstanding, plus you’re renting here, your income must be remarkable, unless you are a rich and beautiful woman, if not, then you can only be a supermodel."
Lu Shiyun had already got her clothes on, only then did she calm down a bit.
Hearing Lin Fan’s eloquent analysis, especially the praise about her looks, she felt very proud and couldn’t help but chuckle.
"Thank you for the compliments. You can turn around now." Lu Shiyun said.
Lin Fan turned around, facing Lu Shiyun.
Lu Shiyun dressed, looked even more distinguished, wearing a pair of hot shorts, showing off a pair of snow-white long legs, a tall and well-proportioned figure, with a proud curve...
Crying, it’s simply perfect.
The female tenants living here, what kind of immortal sisters are they!
Lin Fan had an urge to move in immediately.
"Miss Lu, you really are a supermodel, right?" Lin Fan said.
Lu Shiyun said charmingly: "Mm, I am, but I haven’t been in this line for long. Landlord brother, come and sit down. I’ll pour you a glass of water."
Lu Shiyun poured Lin Fan a glass of water, sat down opposite him, and finally had a proper meeting with this wealthy landlord.
"Landlord brother, I heard from the security guard that this whole building is yours, is that true?" Lu Shiyun asked, finally asking the question she most wanted to.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: The Tall and Handsome Male Model Is Deeply Hit
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: The Tall and Handsome Male Model Is Deeply Hit
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s true."
Lu Shiyun exclaimed, "Oh my god, you’re so rich! You must be a billionaire!"
Lin Fan said, "Pretty much."
In fact, he was a trillionaire, but he didn’t want to be too flashy. It’s better to stay low-key and appear as just a billionaire.
Lu Shiyun looked amazed. Lin Fan seemed to be just around 20 years old, and she had only ever seen one young billionaire in him!
What exactly was his background to be so young and already a billionaire?
Lu Shiyun was completely filled with curiosity about Lin Fan.
At this moment, Lu Shiyun’s phone suddenly rang.
"Sorry, let me take a call first."
Lu Shiyun picked up the phone, "Hello, what’s up? At home, sorry, I don’t have time. Don’t come over, I won’t meet you, I’ve told you many times, I’m not going to be your girlfriend, so that’s it!"
Lu Shiyun hung up the phone somewhat impatiently.
Lin Fan didn’t need to ask to know that it must be one of Lu Shiyun’s suitors calling, but Lu Shiyun obviously was not interested in this suitor.
"Landlord brother, let’s continue our chat." Lu Shiyun adjusted her mood and said with a smile.
Ring ring ring...
Her phone rang again.
Lu Shiyun frowned and looked a bit angry.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Was it that guy again?"
Lu Shiyun said in frustration, "Yes, it was him. I’ve clearly rejected him, but he still keeps pestering me."
Lin Fan said, "What does he do? He’s not a Rich Second Generation, is he?"
Lu Shiyun said, "No, he’s a male model, but even if he were a Rich Second Generation, I still wouldn’t like him. It’s so annoying, I don’t even know how to make him give up!"
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, let me take this call for you."
Lu Shiyun was a bit dumbfounded, "You’re going to answer it?"
Lin Fan had already picked up her phone and pressed the answer button, putting it on speaker.
"Hello, who is this?" Lin Fan said.
The person on the other end was stunned, "I should be asking you that. Who are you? Where’s Shiyun?"
Lin Fan said, "Shiyun went to the restroom. I’m Shiyun’s boyfriend. We’re busy right now. We’re house-hunting, and she fancies a luxury mansion worth 400 million, which I’m planning to buy for her. She also has her eye on a yacht, and we’re going to buy it later. By the way, after all this talk, who are you? Do you have something to discuss with Shiyun?"
The person on the other end was silent for several seconds, "No, no problem..."
Beep!
The person on the other end hung up the phone voluntarily.
In a high-end apartment, a tall and handsome male model, with a pale face, knelt on the ground, his phone silently slipping from his hand to the floor.
"Being good-looking is useless." The male model sighed.
No matter how good-looking, it can’t compete with money. The goddess loves money.
Lin Fan handed the phone back to Lu Shiyun, smiling, "He won’t bother you again."
Lu Shiyun was already surprised; she never expected such a maneuver!
Buying a 400-million-dollar luxury home and a yacht?
The key point is, she knows Lin Fan is a billionaire, so he can fully afford it.
"Landlord brother, are you for real? Are you really going to buy me a luxury house and a yacht?" Lu Shiyun said with a look of longing.
Lin Fan wiped his cold sweat, wondering how this girl got so into character.
Fortunately, Lu Shiyun quickly snapped out of it, couldn’t help but giggle while covering her forehead, and blushingly said, "Landlord brother, that was too ruthless! Thanks for helping me out of that situation."
Lin Fan waved his hand, "Just a small favor."
But little did he know, his words had left an impression on Lu Shiyun, stirring her heart. How nice it would be to have a boyfriend like Lin Fan!
Lu Shiyun’s feelings for Lin Fan skyrocketed.
A billionaire is indeed a billionaire, one sentence and that annoying pursuer was discouraged.
"Landlord brother, it’s getting dark, aren’t you hungry? How about I cook and you stay for dinner?" Lu Shiyun suggested with a smile.
As soon as Lin Fan heard about dinner, he reflexively shuddered, recalling the terrifying experience of eating dark cuisine at Nie Qiao’er’s place.
His stomach was still uncomfortable now. If Lu Shiyun’s cooking was on the same level as Nie Qiao’er’s, he was afraid he’d really die.
Today’s girls who can cook are really rare, especially beautiful ones, it seems the prettier they are, the less they can cook.
Considering that Lu Shiyun is such a beautiful supermodel, Lin Fan didn’t dare have high expectations for her culinary skills.
"I’m not really hungry right now, and I’ve made plans to have dinner with family tonight, so I won’t be eating here. Actually, I mainly came over today to get to know you better, we can eat next time. I should be going now."
Lin Fan quickly bid farewell.
Lu Shiyun was a bit disappointed. Having dinner with Lin Fan was a good chance to get closer to him and gather more information about his background.
Being such a young billionaire, she was keen to explore more.
"Alright, then let’s add each other on WeChat to stay in touch?" Lu Shiyun suggested.
Lin Fan readily added her on WeChat before leaving.
After going downstairs.
Lin Fan went to the parking lot to retrieve his car, planning to leave Tangchen Yipin and return to Yunding Manor.
Just as he reached the exit.
Suddenly, a pretty girl approached Lin Fan’s car, blocking his path.
The girl had an expression as if she had finally found Lin Fan.
Lin Fan saw this and was a bit surprised. He had seen this girl yesterday under Building A, when a middle-aged tycoon tried to humiliate Lin Fan. This girl was the sidekick of that middle-aged man.
Her name seemed to be Duan Xiaowei.
Why was Duan Xiaowei suddenly stopping his car?
Lin Fan rolled down the car window and asked, "Is there something you need?"
Duan Xiaowei bit her lip and said, "Mr. Lin, I listened to your words, and I decisively broke up with him yesterday!"
Lin Fan oh’d, remembering that he did say to Duan Xiaowei yesterday that she was young and pretty, so why follow that middle-aged man!
Duan Xiaowei said, "You’re right, there are plenty of young rich men in this world, so I, Duan Xiaowei, don’t need to serve an old man like him! And I’ve already found a young rich man – that’s you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan wiped his sweat, "So what you mean is, you left him to come and be my sidekick?"
Duan Xiaowei said, "Mr. Lin, let’s not beat around the bush. I appreciate your youth and wealth, and you like my youth and beauty, so we can be together and both get what we want."
Lin Fan wiped his cold sweat, "Miss Duan, you must be mistaken, I never said I liked you."
Duan Xiaowei was stunned, bit her lip, and said, "Weren’t you hinting at me with the things you said yesterday? I only broke up with that old man because I got your hint!"
Lin Fan laughed, "Then I can only tell you that you misunderstood. I was just seeing that you were young and moving for money towards that old man, so I kindly advised you. I didn’t expect you to misunderstand and assume I liked you. I’m sorry, I have other things to do, so I’ll be off now."
Having said this, Lin Fan didn’t speak any further with her and drove around Duan Xiaowei, leaving in style.
Duan Xiaowei was left standing there, on the verge of tears.
Darn it!
Trying to outsmart ended up backfiring on her. She thought Lin Fan was interested in her, young and handsome billionaire, versus an old ugly multimillionaire, of course, she’d choose Lin Fan. So, she decisively dumped the old man, but now she lost both Lin Fan and the old man!
At this time, the anchorwoman Zheng Miaomiao happened to come downstairs to take out the trash. She hid nearby and watched Lin Fan ditch Duan Xiaowei and leave.
Duan Xiaowei was no less than an 8 out of 10 beauty, and not the same type of beauty as her, yet Lin Fan decisively ditched her!
Zheng Miaomiao was taken aback. Geez, what type of beauty does Lin Fan like after all? Wait, could it be that he doesn’t like women?

chapters.title: Chapter 108 Sister: Brother, I’m holding onto this thigh for good
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108 Sister: Brother, I’m holding onto this thigh for good
Zheng Miaomiao thought Lin Fan didn’t like women, which was a big misunderstanding, and soon she would suffer because of it...
After getting rid of Duan Xiaowei, Lin Fan drove back to Yunding Manor.
On the way, Lin Fan suddenly received a call from Liu Mengjie.
"Lin Fan, the college starts tomorrow, can you come to school and substitute teach?" Liu Mengjie asked.
Lin Fan was no longer a delivery guy, with plenty of free time and nothing to do, so he said, "No problem."
Liu Mengjie said happily, "That’s great, see you tomorrow then."
Liu Mengjie was originally worried that Lin Fan would have to deliver food and wouldn’t have time to go to school. She didn’t expect him to agree so readily, Lin Fan is a music genius, and she was looking forward to Lin Fan’s performance as a teacher.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan continued driving and returned to Yunding Manor.
Not having seen her brother for several days, Lin Shanshan came out jumping and waving to greet him.
"Brother, you’re finally back!" Lin Shanshan said with a smile.
Lin Fan said, "How is it, do you find it comfortable living here?"
Lin Shanshan said, "Of course, it’s such a nice place you could live here your whole life and not get tired of it. It’s just a bit lonely being alone, and Little Lu doesn’t dare to come keep me company."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh": "Doesn’t dare to come?"
Lin Shanshan said, "I told her you’re that Mr. Lin and that I live at Yunding Manor, asked her to come play, she didn’t believe me and thought I was pulling her leg."
Lin Fan chuckled; probably Cheng Xiaolu was scared by the reputation of Mr. Lin.
Lin Fan said, "Isn’t Anna here to keep you company too?"
Lin Shanshan said with a wry smile, "Anna is so aloof, as you know. Other than managing my three meals a day, she doesn’t talk to me."
Lin Fan: "..."
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, I also called our parents and told them you’re a wealthy man, but they didn’t believe me. I also asked about our uncle."
"Uncle?"
Lin Fan was taken aback for a moment before he remembered. He had made up an uncle named Lin Beixuan on the spot to answer Su Jinjin’s question that day.
Lin Fan said, "What did they say?"
Lin Shanshan said, "They said we do have an uncle who disappeared when you were three years old and is still missing, but his name is not Lin Beixuan, it’s Lin Fugui. Maybe he changed his name later. I told them it was this uncle who gave you a sum of money, and they still didn’t believe it."
The reason Lin Fan made up an uncle was because he vaguely remembered his parents mentioning an uncle who went missing when he was a kid, but he didn’t know the uncle’s name, so he randomly made up Lin Beixuan.
As for this uncle Lin Fugui, he probably passed away a long time ago.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It doesn’t matter. Mom and Dad will believe it sooner or later. We’ll bring them over to live here someday."
Lin Shanshan said happily, "That would be great, then we can reunite as a family."
"Mm."
Lin Fan indeed had this idea. When he was broke in the past, he couldn’t fulfill his filial duties in front of his parents and had to work outside alone. Now that he was well off, he naturally wanted to bring his parents over to enjoy their later years.
Lin Shanshan said, "But brother, you don’t come back here to stay. Have you been delivering food in the city these past few days?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m not delivering food anymore."
Lin Shanshan said in surprise, "Brother, did you finally come to your senses? So what have you been doing in the city these days?"
Lin Fan, a bit sweaty, said, "These past few days, I bought a piece of land with 70,000 square meters, bought an entertainment company, and, oh, also bought a building in Tangchen Yipin."
Lin Shanshan: "..."
Stunned into silence.
What a grand gesture by brother! Isn’t this amazing? Buying all this must have cost hundreds of billions? It’s like he’s up to something big.
In fact, it was all part of the system’s rewards. Lin Fan hadn’t spent a single penny.
Lin Shanshan then patted Lin Fan’s shoulder, saying with relief, "Brother, you finally look like a rich person! Wait a minute, did you just say you bought an entertainment company? Which one?"
Lin Fan said, "Tianxue Entertainment."
Lin Shanshan jumped up high: "What, Tianxue Entertainment? Oh my god, that’s one of the top three companies in the entertainment industry! Brother, did you buy Tianxue?"
Lin Fan didn’t expect her to be so excited and said calmly, "Yes."
Lin Shanshan enthusiastically hugged her brother’s leg: "Brother, are you planning to enter the entertainment industry? Did you buy it to make me a big star?"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t flatter yourself. I just bought it for fun."
Lin Shanshan laughed and said, "I don’t care; I’m holding onto this big leg of yours, brother."
Lin Shanshan remembered something and said, "Right, the news about Liu Sisi is all over the internet today. The hot search says Wu Zi’er was arrested for spreading rumors. Liu Sisi and Wu Zi’er seem to be artists under Tianxue’s Feihu Entertainment. Brother, do you know about this?"
Young girls nowadays sure know their entertainment gossip well.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course, I was the one who sent Wu Zi’er to jail."
"I knew Liu Sisi had someone powerful helping her, and it turns out it was you, brother. You’re amazing, I’m so impressed with you!" Lin Shanshan exaggeratedly said, her admiration for her brother suddenly as vast as the river.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "That’s enough, stop being cheesy. Go to bed quickly; you have school tomorrow."
Lin Shanshan was sent off to sleep.
At this moment, Anna came up with a freshly brewed tea.
"Mr. Lin, have some tea," Anna said coolly.
She had overheard the conversation between Lin Shanshan and Lin Fan earlier, and inside she was as restless as Lin Shanshan.
First of all, regarding Lin Beixuan, she had overheard when Lin Shanshan was on the phone. It seemed that Lin Beixuan was a real person!
What shocked her was Lin Fan’s recent actions, buying an entertainment company, buying a luxury mansion in Tangchen Yipin, such grand moves, and Lin Fan had purchased not only these but also an island and several companies earlier.
She felt it was necessary to inform Feng Wanshan of this, as Lin Fan’s frequent spending surely indicated some big plan.
Of course, she had reason to believe these were all the mysterious Lin Beixuan’s instructions to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan picked up the tea and took a sip, praising, "Anna, your tea is truly delicious."
Anna said rather indifferently, "This is top-grade Huang Mountain’s Mao Feng Tea, which I specially arranged for someone to purchase from an old tea farmer in Huang Mountain. The tea from that farmer’s family is of excellent quality and exclusively provided to high officials and nobles, difficult for ordinary people to access."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re thoughtful."
He knew Anna was a spy sent by Feng Wanshan, and she was making such efforts just to gain his trust.
For the moment, he still didn’t know the purpose of Anna’s espionage.
Additionally, the system had tasked him to win over Anna, a task he hadn’t completed yet.
"By the way, Anna, you seem to know a lot about high society. There’s something I’d like to ask you," Lin Fan suddenly said.
Anna said, "Please go ahead, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan said, "Who do you think is the big boss in Yun City’s business world?"

chapters.title: Chapter 109: What, he wants to be the king of Jiangnan’s business world?
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: What, he wants to be the king of Jiangnan’s business world?
Anna was a bit puzzled why Lin Fan asked this question, so she could only reply, "The big figures in Yun City’s business world that I know of, there are three, and they all own billion-dollar corporations."
Lin Fan asked, "Which three?"
Anna replied, "The big boss of Zhongtong Express Company, He Chao, the big boss of Yida Mall, Wang Hailin, and... the big boss of Shengshi Group, Feng Wanshan."
Lin Fan laughed, "Feng Wanshan? I know him, he bid against me for Yunding Manor last time, but eventually lost to me. He’s also a big shot in Yun City’s business world? Haha, nothing much!"
While Lin Fan spoke in a disdainful tone, he paid attention to Anna’s expression.
Anna’s face remained calm, without any hint of abnormality, but she also didn’t respond to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan sneered inwardly, this Anna is truly talented, hiding so well. It seems winning her over won’t be an easy task.
He didn’t want to continue discussing Feng Wanshan, so he asked, "What about Jiangnan City, who are the business big shots there?"
In Eastern Huaxia, separated by the Yangtze River, there’s Jiangnan and the North of the River. Yun City is also part of Jiangnan City.
Anna said, "In Jiangnan, the business moguls are known as the ten kings. Besides the three major figures in Yun City just mentioned, there are seven others distributed in other cities of Jiangnan."
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment, "Who leads these ten kings?"
Anna replied, "The top seat among the business moguls in Jiangnan belongs to Wei Tiansheng of Wangu Group. The market value of Wangu Group has already broken through 350 billion, ranking 30th in Huaxia."
Wei Tiansheng!
This name, Lin Fan was hearing for the first time. Previously, he was a delivery worker and didn’t really know the business world.
"Did you know that I’ve recently established a group company?" Lin Fan said.
Anna replied, "This... I’m just your housekeeper, not very clear about it."
Lin Fan found it amusing; she was an undercover agent, how could she not be clear about his situation.
Lin Fan said, "My company is called Mortal Group, and I set a small target, which is to take the top seat in Jiangnan’s business world!"
Of course, Lin Fan deliberately said this to Anna. The task given by the system is to build a trillion-dollar group. Merely the top seat in Jiangnan’s business world, with just a few hundred billion in market value, can’t satisfy the system’s appetite.
Anna was secretly shocked, Lin Fan’s ambition was too big, could this be the reason for his recent spree of buying land and companies, to build a billion-dollar group?
Tonight was truly a harvest, Anna was already impatient to report to Feng Wanshan.
Lin Fan looked at Anna and said, "Sooner or later I will pull Wei Tiansheng down from the top seat, and my first step is to pull down those three big bosses in Yun City, He Chao, Wang Hailin, and Feng Wanshan! Of course, in my eyes, they are just nobodies. Anna, do you think I can do it?"
Anna said, "I don’t understand this, no need for Mr. Lin to ask me, it’s getting late, I need to go rest."
Anna found an excuse and left the living room.
In a secluded corner, Anna dialed Feng Wanshan’s number and reported everything she heard tonight to him.
Feng Wanshan was still in Shengshi Group’s office, and he stood up excitedly.
"What did you say, Lin Fan wants to become the king of Jiangnan’s business world?"
"What? He first wants to pull us three down?"
"He actually dares to look down on me, saying I’m a nobody, damn it!"
"This kid, he’s too arrogant!"
Feng Wanshan sneered, but for some reason, he felt a tinge of excitement, a thrill as if meeting a worthy adversary.
Anna said, "Godfather, he is practically declaring war on you, should we stop him?"
Feng Wanshan said, "No need, what Lin Fan is doing is all under Lin Beixuan’s instructions, we can’t alert the enemy and scare them off. Let’s first see what he does next, and strike at the right time. By then, I have my ways to force Lin Beixuan out!"
Anna said, "What do you want me to do then, godfather?"
Feng Wanshan said, "Just stay by Lin Fan’s side, help me gather information, you’re doing great!"
Meanwhile, in the living room.
Lin Fan sat calmly on the sofa, savoring tea.
The top-grade Huang Mountain’s Mao Feng Tea, exclusively for dignitaries, is indeed excellent.
If he’s guessing correctly, by now, Anna should have gone to report to Feng Wanshan.
He didn’t know what purpose Feng Wanshan had for sending Anna, so he deliberately leaked some information, as if declaring war on Feng Wanshan.
If Feng Wanshan takes actions against Mortal Group afterward, it would tantamount to exposing himself.
At this moment, Lin Fan looked every bit the master strategist.
However...
"Oh no!"
Lin Fan suddenly clutched his stomach, his powerful aura breaking instantly, as he scurried embarrassingly toward the toilet.
Nie Qiao’er’s dark chicken wings were truly inconceivable, they made his stomach upset again...
...
Meanwhile at Tangchen Yipin Building A, 12th floor, after seeing Lin Fan off, Nie Qiao’er was at home tidying up, suddenly sighed, seeming to be in low spirits.
She dreamed of becoming an outstanding singer-songwriter, so she stayed at home every day, diligently writing songs and posting her creations online, which gave her a bit of fame, but far from what she desired.
She still hadn’t managed to compose an outstanding, game-changing piece.
Lately, she had been working on a new song, hoping for it, but got stuck due to a lack of inspiration, leaving her puzzled.
In truth, she didn’t particularly enjoy cleaning or cooking, it was just to divert her attention, thinking that taking a break might spark some songwriting inspiration.
But she realized it hadn’t; she still didn’t know how to write the new song.
"Could it be that this song is doomed?" Nie Qiao’er sighed, feeling puzzled.
Approaching the electronic piano, she noticed a pile of paper a bit messy on the desk and decided to tidy it up.
Suddenly, Nie Qiao’er accidentally noticed some scribbles on the papers, she paused, then was immediately captivated.
Very quickly, Nie Qiao’er displayed a look of astonishment.
"Oh my god, is this song actually completed?"
"It can be written like this, the melody, the harmony, the key change, they’re wonderful!"
"Oh deity, this is exactly the form I wanted, how did I not realize it before, a sudden moment of clarity!"
In that instance, Nie Qiao’er was overjoyed and without thinking, sat in front of the electronic piano and began to play and sing.
The beautiful melody, catchy lyrics, along with her sweet voice, were just perfect.
Nie Qiao’er immersed herself in creation...
She stayed busy deep into the night, recorded a rough version, and couldn’t wait to upload it online, sharing her joy with her fans.
Each time she finished a song, she would typically go to a professional studio to record, then upload online. This was the only time she felt such an urgency to share, because she genuinely loved this song.
After finally uploading the song, she suddenly remembered an issue.
Who helped her revise the song?
She had been completely captivated by the song and forgot about this crucial question.
These past few days she had been home alone, without friends visiting, except one person, today her landlord brother came by!
And while she was busy in the kitchen, she seemed to remember seeing Lin Fan standing by the electronic piano, but didn’t pay much attention at the time.
"Oh my god, could it be that the landlord brother helped me revise the song? The landlord brother is unexpectedly a music genius?" Nie Qiao’er felt shocked by her own discovery.
If it weren’t so late at night, she would immediately call Lin Fan.
"I’ll find him tomorrow. I must properly thank him, and also seek his advice. A music genius like him isn’t easily encountered." Nie Qiao’er planned.
"Oh no, it’s already this late, I still have to go to Yun City Music Academy for classes tomorrow, I should hurry to bed..."
Nie Qiao’er quickly tidied up and went to sleep.
And at this moment.
Her newly uploaded song had already started to go viral online...
"Oh my god, this new song is so amazing!"
"King of melodies!"
"It’s so good, my ears are blessed."
"I feel like I’m in love."
"The youth of mine has returned."
"..."
For a while, countless accolades and the netizens began frantically sharing and spreading it...
Nie Qiao’er, overnight fame!

chapters.title: Chapter 110: School Starts, Principal Personally Welcomes?
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: School Starts, Principal Personally Welcomes?
Early the next morning, Lin Fan drove a luxury car to take Lin Shanshan to school.
Today is the opening day of Yun City Music Academy, also the most significant day for the academy. All faculty and students will gather at the school today.
It is even more lively than when Lin Shanshan came for her interview last time.
Most students in the music academy are from wealthy families, and today is also a day to show off, with various luxury cars competing for attention.
Just when the owner of the Audi A8 and the owner of the BMW 7 Series were mocking each other, a Maserati worth 3 million appeared, silencing them both.
And just when the owner of the Maserati was feeling smug, a Lamborghini worth tens of millions appeared, completely overshadowing the Maserati.
The owner of the Lamborghini felt a sense of triumph, as if having the last laugh.
While everyone was admiring the Lamborghini worth tens of millions.
Lin Fan drove the Kosak, arriving discreetly.
The entire venue fell silent.
The owner of the Lamborghini kneeled directly.
A Kosak worth 70 million!
Only three exist worldwide.
And one appeared in Yun City!
Lin Fan and Lin Shanshan got out of the car, meeting the admiring gazes of everyone.
Lin Fan was already accustomed to such scenes; with the Kosak, it’s normal for people to have such reactions.
Lin Fan ignored the crowd and prepared to enter the school gate with Lin Shanshan.
"Brother Fan, Sister Shanshan, you’re finally here!"
Lin Shanshan’s close friend, Cheng Xiaolu, had been waiting for a long time and greeted them warmly.
The siblings drew attention because of the luxury car, and she also wanted to bask in their glory, letting everyone know she knew these wealthy siblings, and thus envy her a little.
Sure enough, Cheng Xiaolu succeeded.
"So envious of her. I wish I knew this wealthy and handsome guy too."
Nearby, a female murmured.
Cheng Xiaolu felt very proud, her vanity satisfied.
Lin Fan wasn’t fond of Cheng Xiaolu and remained cold towards her.
Lin Shanshan held Cheng Xiaolu’s hand: "Little Lu, I’ve finally seen you. I’ve called you several times to come to Yun City Manor to hang out, yet you wouldn’t come."
Cheng Xiaolu said: "You’re still joking with me. I know Brother Fan is rich, but he can’t be that Mr. Lin; you know that Mr. Lin is a god of wealth!"
People in Yun City have basically heard of Mr. Lin from Yunding Manor.
Mr. Lin became a household name in Yun City for spending nearly 10 billion to buy a 3 billion luxury residence and a 6 billion island.
And because no one knows Mr. Lin’s identity, he has a layer of mystery that commands respect.
Cheng Xiaolu could not believe that Lin Fan was Mr. Lin.
Lin Shanshan was a bit speechless; Little Lu wouldn’t believe her. It seems like she could only believe after being taken to Yunding Manor one day.
At this moment, a Ferrari luxury car suddenly came to the school gate.
"It’s a Ferrari LaFerrari, rumored to be priced over 20 million Huaxia Coin!"
"The luxury cars today are really competing against each other!"
"But unfortunately, with the Kosak here, this LaFerrari can only be ranked second among the luxury cars present!"
From the car, a young lady and a well-maintained middle-aged man got out.
Their identities immediately sparked a heated discussion among the crowd.
"This is Jia Zuozhen, one of the top ten billionaires in Yun City, and his daughter, Jia Xueling!"
"The Jia family is an aristocratic family, and Jia Zuozhen is rumored to have political connections, his status is extremely high!"
"This is what a real noble family is!"
"Children of noble families are not comparable to ordinary wealthy people!"
The crowd praised, elevating the Jia father and daughter; indeed, in front of a noble family, ordinary wealthy people dim in comparison.
The Jia father and daughter both looked proud, seemingly unwilling to pay attention to others, but upon hearing the crowd’s praise, Jia Zuozhen did look a bit pleased.
Not long after the father and daughter got out of the car.
Someone suddenly said, "The principal’s here!"
Sure enough, Liu Mengjie, the principal of Yun City Music Academy, personally came to the school gate, seemingly to personally greet someone.
"Don’t ask, Principal Liu must be here to greet the Jia father and daughter!"
"Isn’t it obvious? Who else here has the caliber of Jia Zuozhen?"
"To have Principal Liu personally welcome, it surely must be Mr. Jia."
"It’s said that Jia Zuozhen donates a large sum to the school every year to ensure his daughter isn’t bullied, so it’s not surprising the principal comes out to greet him!"
The crowd discussed, all thinking that Liu Mengjie must be here to welcome the Jia father and daughter. Indeed, in terms of noble status, no one could rival Jia Zuozhen, especially as he is a famous donor to the school.
Jia Zuozhen thought the same.
"Daughter, see, the principal is personally here to greet us. In this world, wealth and power speak. At this school, Papa guarantees no one dares to go against you!" Jia Zuozhen said.
Jia Xueling arrogantly replied, "What does a principal count as? Even if Papa doesn’t throw money at them, no one dares to mess with me!"
She had the right to be arrogant. In Yun City, who would dare to go against the Jia family?
Even the three business magnates of Yun City scramble to befriend the Jia family, never daring to be at odds with them.
"To keep these people in check, a Ferrari LaFerrari is more than enough!" Jia Xueling said proudly.
Jia Zuozhen laughed, "Indeed, after all, the most expensive car here is our Ferrari. Anyone thinking of messing with the Jia family should first consider if they’re wealthier than us!"
