The father and daughter laughed in satisfaction.
Jia Zuozhen approached Liu Mengjie, modestly saying, "Haha, how could I trouble the principal to come out and welcome us personally!"
Everyone heard this, and it was clear that Jia Zuozhen was showing off, as having the principal give them such face was significant.
But no one said anything. With his capital, a bit of boasting was nothing.
Jia Zuozhen extended his hand, ready to shake hands with Liu Mengjie.
However!
Liu Mengjie seemed to obliviously ignore Jia Zuozhen’s presence.
She walked straight to Lin Fan, smiling happily, "Lin Fan, wonderful, I came out specially to see if you had arrived, and I’m thrilled to see you the moment I came out."
Liu Mengjie warmly held Lin Fan’s hand, "Let’s go inside quickly."
Lin Fan smiled, "Sister Mengjie, there’s no need for such formality. I promised to come back, and I wouldn’t break my word."
Liu Mengjie laughed, "Anyway, I don’t care, having you here is the best gift for me today. Let’s go inside quickly."
Lin Fan nodded and called back to Lin Shanshan, "Let’s go."
Lin Shanshan asked curiously, "Brother, you’re going in too? I thought you were just taking me to school, why are you going in?"
She was indeed curious, not only was her brother going in, but the principal personally came to welcome him, which was a bit odd.
Lin Fan replied, "I’ll tell you later."
So, Lin Fan, Lin Shanshan, and Cheng Xiaolu followed Liu Mengjie through the school gate.
From beginning to end, Liu Mengjie paid no attention to Jia Zuozhen, as all her attention was on Lin Fan, leaving no time for others.
As Lin Fan reached the school gate, he suddenly remembered something, "Sorry, I forgot to lock the car."
With that, Lin Fan casually took out the Kosak’s key and pressed it.
Doo doo!
The Kosak’s indicators flashed a few times, indicating the car was locked successfully.
Lin Fan then entered the school gate.
The whole scene fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: The Whole School Is Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: The Whole School Is Shocked
The principal was actually not welcoming Jia Zuozhen and his daughter?
It was Lin Fan!
They all guessed wrong.
The most embarrassed were the Jia father and daughter, who also thought Liu Mengjie was greeting them, and Jia Zuozhen even took the initiative to say hello.
Only to be completely ignored by Liu Mengjie!
In an instant, Jia Zuozhen’s face turned from white to red, and then from red to green, he was so embarrassed he could almost drip water.
What the hell!
This is so damn humiliating!
Jia Zuozhen had never been so embarrassed in his entire life!
And Lin Fan’s final car-locking move was like a slap, causing Jia Zuozhen’s heart to bleed.
Their Ferrari was not the most luxurious car in the crowd; it was Lin Fan’s Kosak. They hadn’t noticed it before, but now they did.
The onlookers also felt embarrassed for the Jia father and daughter, and many were second-hand embarrassed.
"We’re going to be late, hurry into the school!"
The parents urged their children, as if ignoring the Jia father and daughter.
"What the hell is this? Who is this Lin Fan?" Jia Zuozhen muttered, shaking with anger.
Jia Xueling felt utterly humiliated and shot a glare at Jia Zuozhen, "You have the nerve! Why did you go and greet the principal all by yourself? You’ve embarrassed me!"
Jia Xueling stormed into the school angrily.
Jia Zuozhen felt a bit helpless, this child had been spoiled since young—it was his own doing that she dared speak to him, her father, like this!
Nevertheless, Jia Zuozhen always saw his daughter as his little princess.
This time, it was all Lin Fan’s fault!
"Lin Fan, huh? You’ve offended me, Jia Zuozhen! I’ll find out what you’re up to!" A glint of determination flashed in Jia Zuozhen’s eyes as he returned to his Ferrari and left in humiliation.
Before leaving, Jia Zuozhen glanced at Lin Fan’s Kosak, feeling more and more indignant.
Lin Fan was, of course, oblivious to this. He hadn’t interacted with Jia Zuozhen, yet he had become his enemy. If he knew, he could only shrug helplessly.
It should be said that Liu Mengjie personally came out to greet Lin Fan, which showed her high regard for him.
There was no choice; Lin Fan was a musical genius!
Liu Mengjie was almost at a stage of worship towards Lin Fan. If she weren’t a few years older than him, she might have been just another fangirl.
In fact, that’s pretty much what she was now.
She couldn’t forget that hug in her office from Lin Fan; she would even dream about it at night, her heart racing every time she woke up blushing.
She didn’t deliberately neglect Jia Zuozhen; she genuinely didn’t notice his presence. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have ignored even saying hello since Jia Zuozhen was a notable figure.
Once she saw Lin Fan, she ignored the whole world, focusing all her attention on him.
"Lin Fan, there’s a piano class for the sophomores this morning. Do you need to prepare? Your desk isn’t set up yet. Why not come to my office to prepare?" Liu Mengjie said with a smile.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Prepare? There’s no need."
With his musical talents, there was naturally no need to prepare.
But after saying this, he felt a bit puzzled. It seemed Liu Mengjie was hinting at something, and he felt like he was missing something.
Liu Mengjie felt a bit disappointed; Lin Fan was really oblivious. She provided an opportunity for them to be alone, and he didn’t get it.
Fortunately, Lin Fan quickly realized he couldn’t waste the principal’s goodwill.
"Ahem, I’m not familiar with the sophomore curriculum, so I might need to prepare," Lin Fan smiled and said.
Liu Mengjie was immediately delighted, "Okay, then come to my office."
Their conversation left Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu completely baffled.
"Brother, what are you talking about? I don’t get it," Lin Shanshan asked curiously.
Lin Fan had come to the school to drop her off but ended up going inside and talking to the principal about strange things, like preparing lessons and coming to her office.
Lin Fan said, "A few days ago, I agreed with the principal to come here as a substitute teacher to teach piano."
Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were both surprised.
Lin Fan had actually become the piano teacher at this school. Even as a substitute teacher, it was impressive.
That day, Lin Fan’s performance of "Fireworks Easily Cold" shocked everyone, also winning over Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu. Cheng Xiaolu even came to admire Lin Fan greatly.
But Lin Fan becoming a substitute piano teacher at Yun City Music Academy was still unexpected, especially since he was the piano teacher.
The former piano teacher at Yun City Music Academy was very famous, even when Cheng Xiaolu was in high school, she knew of them.
Whether Lin Fan could handle this position remained uncertain.
"Shanshan, let’s go sit in on Brother Fan’s piano class later," Cheng Xiaolu suggested.
That was exactly what Lin Shanshan wanted; she was also concerned about whether her brother could handle the role of piano teacher.
Upon arriving at the teaching building, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu checked into their classroom, while Liu Mengjie led Lin Fan to the office.
Lin Fan wasn’t unfamiliar with Liu Mengjie’s office. It was here last time that Liu Mengjie begged him to be the piano teacher, and after he agreed, she gave him a passionate hug.
It seemed as if Liu Mengjie’s pleasant scent still lingered in his embrace.
"Little Fan, sit here," Liu Mengjie said, pointing Lin Fan to a desk, as if she had prepped it.
Lin Fan sat down, and on the desk were the sophomore piano class textbooks and lesson plans.
Lin Fan casually picked them up to glance through.
Top-notch musical talent engaged!
In just a brief moment, Lin Fan memorized all the books and lesson plans.
"Finished," Lin Fan said casually, closing the lesson plan.
Liu Mengjie was resting her chin on her hand, gazing at Lin Fan dreamily.
Liu Mengjie felt like she was about to go crazy.
She had deliberately left Lin Fan’s desk unprepared, deliberately called him to her office to prepare lessons, just to watch him prepare.
Guys who are serious are really captivating.
Upon hearing Lin Fan speak, Liu Mengjie snapped out of her daze, her cheeks flushed, and then she was a bit shocked, "You’re done?"
How much time had passed before Lin Fan finished looking through the books and lesson plan?
Lin Fan nodded, "Not only did I finish, I’ve memorized every word, and discovered 13 errors and 8 debatable points in the lesson plan. Of course, the lesson plan is generally okay; if I’m not mistaken, this must be from that top piano teacher you mentioned?"
Liu Mengjie felt like bowing to Lin Fan, "That’s right, it was made by Teacher Tao. Lin Fan, were there really that many errors in his lesson plan?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, for instance..."
Lin Fan pointed out one of the mistakes, and upon hearing it, Liu Mengjie was awestruck.
"Little Fan, when you start your class, I want to come listen personally," Liu Mengjie said with a smile, the dignified principal of the music academy, just like a student.
In the morning, before starting the official classes, Yun City Music Academy held an opening ceremony.
At the ceremony, Liu Mengjie announced that the school’s former top piano teacher had resigned, and Lin Fan would be taking over as the substitute piano teacher.
The announcement shocked all the students.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 Miao Miao: Who wrote this viral new song?
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112 Miao Miao: Who wrote this viral new song?
In the morning, Nie Qiao’er woke up, habitually opened her QQ Music backstage, and was surprised to find out that her page had exploded.
Countless messages almost made her phone lag.
They were all comments about yesterday’s new song.
"This is so good!"
"My ears are getting pregnant!"
"If this song doesn’t blow up, it’s against the heavens!"
"This song went viral overnight, I’m gonna cry, Qiao’er finally made it big!"
Nie Qiao’er was so excited that she jumped up.
"Oh my god, I’m famous, I’m really famous!"
Although she knew the new song was good, she had only uploaded a rough version last night, but she didn’t expect it to go viral so quickly, practically overnight.
Nie Qiao’er immediately opened WeChat, and her WeChat was also blown up, colleagues and friends sent congratulations, and her Moments feed was flooded with shared links to the song.
This level of viral success is usually only achieved by those superstar singers who have been famous for years.
But Nie Qiao’er, who was previously just a slightly renowned independent musician, also made it.
This could only mean one thing, the song was just too good!
And the reason why the song was so powerful was inseparable from Lin Fan’s editing.
Last night, Nie Qiao’er wanted to call Lin Fan, and now thinking of Lin Fan, she immediately picked up her phone to call him.
But Lin Fan might have been busy and didn’t answer her call.
Nie Qiao’er had to temporarily give up, planning to call again later.
Checking the time, Nie Qiao’er broke out in a cold sweat, oh no, she was going to be late for class, she got so excited that she forgot the time.
She quickly got out of bed, washed up, and prepared to go to school.
Currently, she is a sophomore at Yun City Music Academy, today is the first day of the semester, and she has classes in the morning, so she needs to get back for class.
Nie Qiao’er left her apartment with her backpack, taking the elevator down.
The elevator was descending and stopped at the 12th floor, where an 8-point beauty walked in, dressed cutely, listening to music through headphones, and humming along.
Nie Qiao’er heard that the beauty was humming her newly viral song!
She couldn’t have imagined that even the residents here knew about it so soon.
Nie Qiao’er didn’t know, this 8-point cute beauty was the online anchor Zheng Miaomiao who lived on the 12th floor. As a popular anchor, someone like Zheng Miaomiao naturally had to stay on top of online trends and follow up quickly.
Nie Qiao’er’s song had undoubtedly become a hot topic online.
Nie Qiao’er suddenly felt playful, pretending to be a passerby, she said with a smile, "Hey beauty, what song are you humming? It sounds so nice!"
Zheng Miaomiao took off her headphones and said, "You don’t know? This is a newly viral song, pretty nice."
Nie Qiao’er felt happy inside, saying, "Really? Can I listen?"
Zheng Miaomiao then turned on the speaker, and suddenly a piece of lovely music played.
Zheng Miaomiao, with a face full of admiration, said, "Isn’t it nice? I’ve liked it since I first heard it, the catchy melody, million-level lyrics, the singer’s voice is also nice, it’s truly a genius work, it’s a pity, nobody knows who composed or wrote the song, we only know the singer is Qiao’er."
It turned out that Nie Qiao’er hadn’t credited the composer or lyricist’s names, because strictly speaking, this song wasn’t solely her creation, without Lin Fan’s edits, this song wouldn’t exist. Before informing Lin Fan, she temporarily hid the creators’ identities.
This became a curious point for netizens, and many people left messages, curious why Nie Qiao’er didn’t release the creators’ information.
Nie Qiao’er felt delighted as if she’d eaten candy, feeling quite proud, "Really, do you like the singer’s voice?"
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Yeah, it’s quite pleasing, this Qiao’er is about to blow up, I’m so envious of her, if only I could have a good song like this, how great would it be to meet that genius who wrote it, I really want to know who it is."
Nie Qiao’er felt amused inside, of course, Zheng Miaomiao wouldn’t have thought that the person who created this song was standing right in front of her, and the other creator was their landlord, Lin Fan.
Nie Qiao’er laughed, saying, "Do you know our landlord?"
Just mentioning Lin Fan, Zheng Miaomiao started complaining.
"Yes, I know him, this guy even came to collect the rent yesterday, just urged me to pay rent, and threatened to make me move out, not cute at all, practically a tyrant! Watch out when you pay rent next time!" Zheng Miaomiao said.
Nie Qiao’er responded with an "oh," a bit surprised, was Lin Fan really like this? He visited her place yesterday too, seemed like a nice guy, not at all like what Zheng Miaomiao described.
Zheng Miaomiao then lowered her voice, "Let me tell you a secret, you must not say I told you this, I discovered the reason the landlord isn’t sympathetic to women is because of his preferences... he might not like women!"
Nie Qiao’er was stunned, what, the landlord doesn’t like women, no way?
This was something she had never anticipated.
Originally, she brought up Lin Fan intending to tell Zheng Miaomiao the new song was written by Lin Fan and her, but because of Zheng Miaomiao’s "scoop," she forgot what she wanted to say.
As they chatted, the two of them reached the parking lot.
Nie Qiao’er, in a rush to get to class, got into her car and prepared to leave.
Zheng Miaomiao approached her car, saying, "We live in the same building, you could say we’re neighbors. After talking for so long, I haven’t asked your name, I’m Zheng Miaomiao."
Nie Qiao’er said, "I’m Nie Qiao’er."
Zheng Miaomiao laughed, "Qiao’er? Your name is the same as that singer from the new song!"
Nie Qiao’er already started the car, "Yeah, actually, I am that Qiao’er."
After saying that, Nie Qiao’er quickly drove away.
Zheng Miaomiao was left stunned.
Although she knew the singer of the song was called Qiao’er, she hadn’t gotten around to checking it out, so she immediately went online to look it up.
Up popped a photo of the singer.
It was Nie Qiao’er!
Zheng Miaomiao was shocked.
The singer of the viral new song was living right above her, and she had just shared an elevator ride with her!
Soon after, Zheng Miaomiao thought of a question and suddenly became excited.
Nie Qiao’er surely knows who the creator of that new song is, and she just met Nie Qiao’er, so she could find out who the creator is!
If she could meet the genius creator, she could ask them to write a song for her too.
Although she’s currently a streamer, as a music streamer, her dream is to become a professional singer, making the transition from an internet celebrity to a professional singer, needing public recognition, a high-quality representative work is necessary.
Thinking of this, Zheng Miaomiao became thrilled, anxious to know who that creator is.
If she hadn’t started complaining upon hearing Lin Fan’s name, she would have already known.
Yun City Music Academy.
After learning that Lin Fan became a substitute teacher for the piano class.
Both teachers and students at the school were shocked.
They didn’t know what qualifications or merits Lin Fan had, to be able to replace Teacher Tao?

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Who is Lin Fan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Who is Lin Fan?
Tao Dacai, a famous pianist, a top-level piano teacher, was once the most outstanding piano teacher at Yun City Music Academy, deeply admired by students. Some students even applied to Yun City Music Academy just because of Tao Teacher’s great reputation.
But Tao Dacai suddenly resigned!
It wasn’t until the principal announced it at the opening ceremony that the entire school, both teachers and students, learned about it.
Immediately, there was a wail of despair, and everyone believed that no one could replace Tao Dacai!
Lin Fan certainly couldn’t either.
Moreover, this Lin Fan was unknown in the music circle, and nobody knew where he suddenly popped out from!
The sophomore piano class was about to start soon.
The large classroom was unexpectedly lively. Besides the sophomore students, many other teachers and students came to watch the spectacle, wanting to see how this Lin Fan teacher would embarrass himself.
Daring to replace Tao Dacai, it was simply overestimating himself!
"Who is Lin Fan? From which school did he teach before? Why have I never heard of him?"
"Who is he? Could he be someone the principal casually picked up from the street!"
"Regardless of who he is, he surely can’t be as good as Tao Teacher. I’m already disappointed."
"I applied here specifically because of Tao Teacher, I didn’t expect Tao Teacher to leave like this."
"Is this Lin Fan just a substitute teacher? Will Tao Teacher return?"
"No hope, Tao Teacher has resigned!"
"Luckily Lin Fan is just a substitute, he doesn’t have any reputation, and he seems unreliable. I hope the school finds a piano master who can replace Tao Teacher soon!"
The students were gossiping fervently.
Hearing these discussions, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu, who came to the scene, worried for Lin Fan.
"Sister Shanshan, it seems everyone doesn’t have much faith in Brother Fan. How is Brother Fan’s piano level?" Cheng Xiaolu asked.
Lin Shanshan replied with a bitter smile, "I don’t know either."
As far as she knew, her brother used to be tone-deaf, and she didn’t know when he started singing so well. But singing well doesn’t necessarily mean a high level of piano skills.
Cheng Xiaolu asked puzzledly, "Brother Fan sings so well, why doesn’t he teach pop music instead of teaching piano?"
At this time, Liu Mengjie also arrived at the scene, sitting beside her was a middle-aged man.
Xu Cheng, the director of Wind Bird Music!
Since he accidentally heard Lin Fan singing at a KTV last time, Xu Cheng had been obsessed. He just wanted to sign Lin Fan into the company and make him a professional singer.
He believed that with Lin Fan’s talent, he could become the next Song God, and not just any Song God, but an unprecedented one. By then, Xu Cheng would become the man who created a Song God, something that would be remembered in history.
Today was Lin Fan’s first class, and Xu Cheng rushed over immediately to attend.
"Mengjie, why don’t I see Mr. Lin?" Xu Cheng asked curiously.
Liu Mengjie replied, "I have no idea, he disappeared in a flash just now."
The class was about to start soon, but as the teacher for this class, Lin Fan still hadn’t shown up!
In fact, Lin Fan was mixed in among the students at that moment!
Lin Fan was only 21 this year, so no one would question him if he was said to be a student. Him blending in with the students went completely unnoticed.
Lin Fan just wanted to observe up close how these students viewed him.
He heard all the students’ complaints.
It seemed that most of the students missed the resigned Tao Teacher and didn’t have hope in him, the new substitute teacher.
Of course, some students didn’t care about the matter.
Beside Lin Fan, there were a few female students huddled together, passing around a short video.
It was a viral short video recently, showing a man with only his back visible, singing "Fireworks Easily Cold."
These girls looked infatuated.
"My God, it’s so good, my ears are really pregnant."
"I can’t even count how many times I’ve looped it. Ah-Wei has died a thousand times!"
"I declare him my male god."
"I also highly admire him, this is simply a Divine Level performance, who is he?"
"No idea, but I heard he was singing at our school, supposedly a parent at the freshman interview site."
"What, really? For the first time, I feel so close to my male god."
The girls were all shocked.
Lin Fan inadvertently saw it and was stunned. The person in the video was him!
He sang that song to help his sister deal with an examiner that day.
Unexpectedly, it went viral too?
These girls were indeed quite close to him; he was right by their side.
Additionally, some students were listening to music with headphones on, and someone was even humming a song softly.
Beside Lin Fan was such a male student, and Lin Fan exclaimed slightly. The song this student hummed had a very familiar melody.
Wasn’t this the song he helped Nie Qiao’er modify yesterday? How could this student sing it already?
Lin Fan was curious and asked in a low voice, "Bro, what song are you listening to? It sounds pretty nice."
The boy gave Lin Fan a slightly contemptuous look, "Looking at your cheap attire, it’s no surprise you’re out of touch. How could you not know this song? It’s Qiao’er’s new song, which went viral last night."
Lin Fan exclaimed slightly, went viral overnight?
He took out his phone and saw a missed call from Nie Qiao’er not long ago, but he hadn’t noticed it.
Right now, it wasn’t convenient to call back, so he looked it up online.
Sure enough!
Nie Qiao’er’s new song exploded and had started spreading crazily online!
Lin Fan smiled, although it was just a rough version, he had to admit, Nie Qiao’er was quite efficient, and she sang well. There was a reason it went viral.
The boy humming the song immersed himself: "I wonder which music genius wrote this song. It would be great to meet this great man."
Lin Fan noticed that Nie Qiao’er didn’t mark the creator’s name, so no one knew who wrote this song.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You want to know who the author of this song is? I happen to know."
The humming boy glanced disdainfully at Lin Fan, "Looking at your cheap attire, you know?"
Just then, the class bell rang.
Since Lin Fan hadn’t appeared all this time, everyone noticed and began to speculate.
"The teacher hasn’t come yet, could he have fled at the last minute? No way, no way..."
"That’s a joke!"
"Maybe he realized he couldn’t compare to Tao Teacher, at least he has some self-awareness."
Lin Shanshan wiped her cold sweat, could her brother have really fled at the last minute?
Liu Mengjie was also taken aback; Lin Fan didn’t seem like someone who would flee at the last minute!
When the class bell stopped ringing.
Lin Fan reached out and patted the shoulder of the humming boy, "Young man, don’t look down on anyone. Also, it’s class time, stop listening to music, and pay attention to the class."
With that, Lin Fan stood up and walked towards the podium.
Immediately, all eyes were on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan went to the podium, faced everyone, and smiled, "Hello everyone, my name is Lin Fan, the substitute piano class teacher."
Everyone was stunned, it was a slap in the face, they thought Lin Fan wouldn’t dare to show up, but he had been mingling with the students all along?
The boy who had been humming was shocked, his face turning pale. How could he have thought the bumpkin in the cheap clothes he looked down on would be the piano teacher?

chapters.title: Chapter 114 Divine Level Performance: Let me demonstrate for everyone
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114 Divine Level Performance: Let me demonstrate for everyone
Yun City Music Academy, Nie Qiao’er drove to the parking lot, intending to get out of her car and enter the campus.
Suddenly, she received a message from a friend: her new song had gone viral!
Nie Qiao’er quickly opened Weibo to check, and sure enough, her name was at the top of the trending searches.
"Oh my god, I actually have a day when I’m trending number one?"
Nie Qiao’er’s hands trembled with excitement. She had really become famous.
She was just an independent musician, not very well-known, without any publicity, and had never been on the trending searches before. Now for the first time, she was not only on it but right at the top!
She clicked on the trending topic, and it was filled with overwhelming praise for the new song.
Her own Weibo exploded too. Originally with only a few thousand followers, the number had surged to a hundred thousand and was still climbing.
Her latest Weibo post, which used to only have a dozen comments due to a lack of followers, now had over ten thousand comments!
"It’s so good!"
"We beg for the official version!"
"Excuse me, Qiao’er, are you the songwriter?"
Praise like this, Nie Qiao’er had seen too much of, but she was still very happy. She couldn’t help but look through each comment, tears welling in her eyes.
Besides the compliments, people online also cared about one question: who wrote this song?
This question also became a common curiosity among everyone.
Nie Qiao’er felt it necessary to respond.
So she casually sent out a Weibo post: "Regarding the author of the new song, it will be announced soon."
After sending this Weibo post, Nie Qiao’er put away her phone and went into the school.
Her response quickly sparked heated discussions online, rapidly climbing the trending searches: "Nie Qiao’er responds to the new song’s author."
In no time, the curiosity of people online reached unprecedented heights, and everyone eagerly awaited the answer.
Nie Qiao’er entered the school gate, noticing Lin Fan hadn’t returned her call yet. She thought Lin Fan must be busy with something.
Meanwhile.
In the piano classroom, after the bell rang, Lin Fan stepped onto the podium.
"Hello everyone, my name is Lin Fan, your interim piano teacher. From today, I’ll be teaching you piano until we find a permanent teacher. During this period, I hope for your cooperation. Without further ado, let’s start the class," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Then, Lin Fan began the lecture.
The material was based on the lesson plan left by Tao Dacai. Lin Fan was already familiar with the lesson plan and spoke without it, even correcting Tao Dacai’s mistakes.
The experienced teachers present were secretly amazed. This Lin Fan was unexpectedly impressive. Besides not needing the lesson plan, Lin Fan’s theoretical knowledge was remarkably innovative, some of which they had never known before.
However, the students obviously didn’t realize Lin Fan’s prowess, and with their preconceived notions, they were rather dismissive of him.
"This is so boring!"
"I’m going to fall asleep."
"When is this class over? The time feels so slow!"
"If only Teacher Tao were here, I love listening to his classes."
"I only listen to Teacher Tao, what’s he talking about?"
The students occasionally murmured.
For a moment, the class was mostly filled with the inattentive, the spiritless, and the bored.
Lin Fan was lecturing using Tao’s lesson plan and had even improved upon it with new theoretical insights. The content was better than what Tao had presented, but because it wasn’t Tao teaching, the students were dismissive.
Seeing this, Lin Fan was at a bit of a loss. It seemed that if he couldn’t gain the students’ respect, there was no point in continuing the lesson.
So, Lin Fan paused and walked to the piano at the side, sitting down.
Everyone exchanged glances, unsure of what Lin Fan intended to do.
Lin Fan said calmly, "According to the theory I just explained, let me demonstrate using Chopin’s ’Nocturne’."
With that, Lin Fan’s fingers moved, and he began to play.
Chopin’s ’Nocturne’ is one of his most famous works, a melody filled with deep melancholy, conveying longing. It speaks of Chopin being in a war-torn foreign land, unable to return home, missing his country deeply. The melody starts triumphantly, as if excited to return home, then turns wistful, expressing resignation to reality, and finally becomes resolute, signifying that even in a foreign land, longing cannot be stopped...
Lin Fan’s fingers seemed to have a magical quality, as the melodious piano notes flowed from between them.
The murmuring students gradually quieted down, drawn in by the music.
The previously disjointed and listless students suddenly straightened their posture, as if injected with energy.
For a moment, everyone was pulled into Lin Fan’s music. The large classroom was devoid of any other sound, leaving only Lin Fan’s piano playing.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Lin Fan’s extraordinary piano skills seemed to envelop everyone in the scene created by the piece, as if they had personally experienced Chopin’s sorrow.
Unknowingly, listeners to the piano piece silently shed tears.
The melodious sound of the piano drifted out of the classroom.
Teachers and students nearby, also enchanted by the music, gathered around as if under a spell.
The university was fairly free, so even students not from this class could enter to listen. Soon, the classroom, both inside and out, was packed, leaving no room to move.
Just returning to the school, Nie Qiao’er was also drawn by the sound of the piano.
"Oh my God, who is this divine being playing the piano? It’s amazing!"
Nie Qiao’er exclaimed, unable to resist coming over to see. She had heard countless renditions of this piano piece, including those by internationally renowned pianists, but this was the best she had ever heard!
Surprisingly, there was someone more skilled than international piano masters at the school. Who is this person?
At this point, the classroom was filled with people. Nie Qiao’er couldn’t get in, only able to see through a gap — a silhouette.
A man was sitting at the piano, playing.
"Oh, that silhouette is so handsome," Nie Qiao’er said dreamily, captivated by just his silhouette.
As the piece came to an end.
Lin Fan finally stopped, the music concluding in a serene melody.
Lin Fan turned to face the crowd and was startled.
Engrossed in playing, he hadn’t noticed that so many people had come into the classroom, blocking both doors.
The key was that everyone was kneeling on the ground, eyes brimming with tears.
The large classroom, inside and out, was silent.
It was as if everyone’s emotions were still immersed in his music.
Lin Fan’s intention was to give a demonstration to let the students intuitively understand his theoretical knowledge, but he hadn’t expected such a powerful effect. Even he was surprised.
"Clap, clap..."
At this moment, Liu Mengjie was the first to start clapping.
Soon, everyone in attendance started clapping.
Suddenly, the applause was thunderous, continuing unceasingly.
Everyone was overwhelmed with excitement.
"What did I just experience? I feel like my entire being has been elevated."
"Oh my god, can such piano skills really exist?"
"My goodness, I knelt while listening to the piano!"
"It’s truly amazing!"
"At this level, it’s the same as an international master, right?"
"What international master? In my opinion, no international master can compare to him. Whoever it is, even the world-famous pianist Yafugoni, would kneel before him!"
"His skill is truly world-class!"
Many of the students present had been practicing piano from a young age, with many already having reached the tenth level of piano. Naturally, they could tell if someone was good at playing the piano.
They unanimously felt that just now, it was an immortal playing the piano!
They, mere mortals, were utterly convinced.
Xu Cheng, the director of Wind Bird Music, excitedly wiped his red eyes and clapped.
Liu Mengjie was relatively calm, as it wasn’t her first time hearing Lin Fan play the piano. However, she was once again enchanted by Lin Fan, her emotions stirred.
Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were stunned, realizing their previous worries were unnecessary. Lin Fan’s level was beyond just being a piano teacher.
Outside the crowd, Nie Qiao’er peeked through a gap and saw Lin Fan’s profile, instantly petrified.
"Brother Dong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Please Save the Chinese Music Industry
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Please Save the Chinese Music Industry
The applause went on and on, and Lin Fan could only gesture for everyone to quiet down.
Looking at everyone, Lin Fan smiled and said, "Classmates, I know you’re not familiar with me, which is why you’re skeptical about my abilities. Moreover, Teacher Tao was excellent, and everyone misses him quite a bit. However, I still hope you will listen to my lectures seriously. What do you all think?"
The students all nodded in agreement.
Even if Lin Fan hadn’t said anything, they wouldn’t dare to underestimate him anymore.
With the piano skills Lin Fan just demonstrated, even if they learned just ten percent of it, they could walk proudly across the country.
If they learned twenty percent, they could walk proudly across the world.
If they learned thirty percent, they’d be able to compete with international piano masters.
They would have to be foolish to continue underestimating Lin Fan; now they wished they could kneel before him and beg him to impart his knowledge to them.
"Teacher Lin is so handsome, so young, and his piano skills are extraordinary. He’s a genius!"
"Is Teacher Lin really just a substitute teacher? I strongly suggest Teacher Lin be permanently appointed right here and now!"
"Teacher Lin is a treasure boy. I’m willing to learn from Teacher Lin for a lifetime!"
"Who’s Teacher Tao? I’ve already forgotten."
"Yeah, who’s Teacher Tao?"
The students were completely won over by Lin Fan and had long forgotten Tao Dacai.
Previously, they still missed Teacher Tao and lamented his departure; but from now on, no one mentioned him anymore.
So, Lin Fan continued with his lecture.
Unlike before, the students listened exceptionally attentively. No one was distracted; everyone focused intently, taking careful notes, afraid to miss a single word.
With this, everyone absorbed Lin Fan’s theories, becoming even more admiring of him.
Teacher Lin is absolutely amazing!
Unconsciously, the class quickly ended. The bell rang, but the students were still unsatisfied, each sitting in their seat, reluctant to leave.
"Oh, why did the class end so soon? I haven’t had enough yet!"
"I really wish I could continue listening to Teacher Lin’s class."
"That damned bell!"
"This is the first time I didn’t want the class to end. When is Teacher Lin’s next class?"
Hearing the class bell, Lin Fan stopped his lecture and said, "Alright, that’s all for today. Class dismissed!"
After speaking, Lin Fan stepped down from the podium, intending to leave the classroom.
Today, he only had one piano class, so he could go home.
The classroom, both inside and outside, was full of people, including students and teachers. For a moment, these students and teachers all surrounded Lin Fan. Many of the students had questions for him, while the teachers wanted to get to know him willingly.
On his first day of teaching, Lin Fan undoubtedly became famous overnight, becoming a superstar teacher at the school. Naturally, everyone wanted to build a good relationship with him.
Now they understood why Liu Mengjie came to personally greet Lin Fan at the school gates today. A genius like Lin Fan wouldn’t be treated casually.
Lin Fan answered many students’ questions, added a bunch of contacts on WeChat, and only then managed to leave the classroom. The contented teachers and students began to disperse one after another.
From this day forward, the news that a genius teacher had arrived at Yun City Music Academy spread, and Lin Fan became a star in the entire school.
"Landlord Brother!"
Just as Lin Fan managed to shake off the teachers and students, he suddenly heard someone calling beside him.
A familiar voice.
Lin Fan turned his head to see Nie Qiao’er.
Nie Qiao’er happily approached, "Landlord Brother, I didn’t expect you to be a teacher here. I just heard you playing the piano. You’re amazing!"
Lin Fan was momentarily stunned. He hadn’t expected to run into Nie Qiao’er here.
"Nie Qiao’er, what are you doing here?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Nie Qiao’er replied, "I didn’t tell you, did I? I’m a student here. I was late for school today, and happened to bump into you playing the piano."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," and smiled, "So you’re a student here. Shouldn’t you call me Teacher then?"
Nie Qiao’er giggled, "Yes, Teacher Lin. By the way, Teacher Lin, there’s something I actually wanted to talk to you about."
She had called Lin Fan earlier, and he didn’t return the call. Now the reason was clear; he was in class, so it was understandable.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Is it about that new song?"
It seemed Lin Fan already knew the new song had become popular.
Nie Qiao’er said, "Yes, Landlord Brother, was it you who helped me revise the song yesterday?"
Lin Fan replied, "When you were cooking, I happened to see your manuscript and couldn’t resist making some changes. You don’t blame me, do you?"
Nie Qiao’er said, "How could I blame you? Last night, I got excited after looking at it, tried playing and singing it myself, recorded it, and uploaded it online. I didn’t expect it to go viral overnight."
Lin Fan said, "I listened to it. You sang very well."
Nie Qiao’er said, "That’s all thanks to you, Landlord Brother. You’re truly a genius. Thank you for helping me revise it. Otherwise, this song would have been difficult to complete. Even if I could finish it one day, it would probably be delayed by at least a year or two."
Lin Fan nodded. Nie Qiao’er was certainly self-aware. Indeed, with her current music level, she might need to study at the academy for a year or two before she could complete this new song.
Nie Qiao’er said, "Landlord Brother, since this song was completed by both of us, I haven’t credited the author yet. I wanted to discuss it with you first. I’d like to include your name."
Lin Fan nonchalantly said, "You can decide that yourself. I just made a quick edit. It doesn’t matter to me whether my name is on it or not."
Indeed, he could write kilos of such songs a day, so he really didn’t mind.
Nie Qiao’er didn’t feel like Lin Fan was bragging. She had just listened to Lin Fan play the piano, and her admiration for his musical talent was immense.
"Mm, I know what to do," Nie Qiao’er said.
This song belonged to both her and Lin Fan!
It was like a culmination of her and Lin Fan’s efforts, so naturally, it should include the names of the parents.
Thinking of this analogy, Nie Qiao’er’s cheeks couldn’t help but redden.
Lin Fan asked curiously, "Why are you blushing?"
Nie Qiao’er quickly responded, "N-nothing... By the way, Landlord Brother, can I study with you in the future? I want to become as amazing as you, become a professional singer, and sign with a major company."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course you can. Actually, your talent is quite good. With a bit of guidance, you will definitely produce many outstanding pieces in the future."
As they were talking, Xu Cheng and Liu Mengjie approached.
Xu Cheng had a wide smile and enthusiastically said, "Mr. Lin, do you remember me? I’m Xu Cheng, the music director of Wind Bird. After hearing Mr. Lin’s piano performance just now, I’m absolutely in awe. Mr. Lin, have you really not considered joining us at Wind Bird?"
Wind Bird Music’s director!
Nie Qiao’er was stunned. Wind Bird Music was a top-tier music company in the country, and so many people dreamt of joining it!
Now the music director of Wind Bird personally came asking Lin Fan to sign up?
Such an opportunity would make many people laugh in their sleep.
But it’s understandable. With Landlord Brother’s musical talent, let alone Wind Bird, what music company in the world wouldn’t fight over him?
But Lin Fan casually said, "I’m sorry, Mr. Xu, but I don’t intend to become a pop star."
Lin Fan had to admire Xu Cheng’s persistence, and to prevent Xu Cheng from continuing to pester him, he had to think of a solution.
Indeed, Lin Fan declined again!
Xu Cheng almost kneeled before Lin Fan, "Mr. Lin, please consider it. The music industry can’t do without you. Please lend a hand and save the Chinese music scene!"
Lin Fan smiled and asked, "Mr. Xu, do you know Du Tao?"

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Could he be a Celestial God descended to the mortal world?
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: Could he be a Celestial God descended to the mortal world?
Xu Cheng was stunned for a moment and said, "President Du? I know him."
He was a bit puzzled as to why Lin Fan was asking him this question.
Lin Fan said, "Can you call Du Tao and ask if I might become one of your artists?"
Xu Cheng didn’t understand what Lin Fan meant, hesitated for a moment, but still took out his phone and called Du Tao.
"President Du, it’s Xu Cheng here. Here’s the situation: recently, I discovered a musical genius and plan to sign him at Wind Bird as a singer, but he refuses," Xu Cheng said.
On the other side, Du Tao asked curiously, "What does this have to do with me? Who is he?"
Xu Cheng said, "His name is Lin Fan. He’s the one who asked me to call you."
Du Tao broke into a sweat. Damn it, turns out it’s the Big Boss!
"Ahem, Old Xu, there’s no way he can be your artist. I see you don’t know his identity yet?" Du Tao said.
Xu Cheng asked anxiously, "Why not? What’s his identity?"
Du Tao replied, "He’s the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment."
The Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, how could he possibly become an artist at Wind Bird? Doesn’t the Big Boss care about face!
"What?"
Xu Cheng directly knelt, face full of shock, cold sweat dripping, trembling uncontrollably.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "So, Director Xu, do you still want me to be your artist?"
Xu Cheng wiped his cold sweat and quickly apologized, "Mr. Lin, I’m really sorry, I didn’t know before and have offended you greatly."
Oh my god, this musical genius in front of me is actually the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment!
Xu Cheng regretted it greatly. The Chinese Music Industry has been suffering from a lack of talent in recent years. He finally encountered Lin Fan, a genius. As long as he could get Lin Fan, he could dominate the world and save the Chinese Music Industry. Who knew Lin Fan was someone he could never claim!
Xu Cheng felt it was a great pity for the Chinese Music Industry, such a pity!
"If Lin Fan doesn’t emerge, the Chinese Music Industry might continue declining for another dozen years until another genius appears..." Xu Cheng lamented in his heart.
Seeing Xu Cheng a bit dejected, Lin Fan said, "Director Xu, if you want to save the Chinese Music Industry, I can recommend someone to you."
Xu Cheng looked up in surprise and excitement, "Mr. Lin, please tell me."
Getting a recommendation from Lin Fan, the person must be outstanding!
Lin Fan glanced at Nie Qiao’er beside him and said, "Let me introduce, Nie Qiao’er. She has excellent talent and is a promising individual. With proper guidance, she might not save the entire industry, but carrying half of it on her shoulders would be no problem."
With Lin Fan’s top-tier musical talent, it’s easy to spot who is a promising talent at a glance.
Nie Qiao’er has the qualities of a top singer, creative talent, excellent singing skills, superior vocal timbre, and stunning looks.
Xu Cheng looked at Nie Qiao’er in surprise and said, "Nie Qiao’er? Are you the independent musician Qiao’er? Was it you who sang that viral song last night?"
Nie Qiao’er felt a bit shy, "Well, actually, this song was created by Lin Fan and me."
Xu Cheng knelt again. No wonder this song was so good. He thought such an excellent song couldn’t have been written by such a young girl. Turns out Lin Fan was involved; that explains everything.
"Miss Nie, do you have time now? Could you come to the company to discuss signing the contract?" Xu Cheng immediately asked.
Nie Qiao’er herself is very outstanding, and she clearly has a connection with Lin Fan. This is the most important point; he would sign Nie Qiao’er at any cost. Especially now with Lin Fan’s recommendation, it’s like a treasure delivered to his door.
Nie Qiao’er was very excited. Before today, she wouldn’t have dared to dream she could sign with Wind Bird, a chance so many musicians yearn for!
"But I still have classes to attend today..." Nie Qiao’er said.
Liu Mengjie then said, "Nie Qiao’er, your future is important. I permit you to take a day off, go on ahead."
Nie Qiao’er beamed, "Thank you, Principal."
So, Nie Qiao’er followed Xu Cheng to Wind Bird Music Company to sign the contract, an event that would change Nie Qiao’er’s life and also change the Chinese Music Industry.
After the two left.
Liu Mengjie approached Lin Fan, smiling, "Little Fan, your lecture today was fantastic. Just as I expected, you impressed everyone."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Not bad. I was just casually playing just now, using only half of my strength."
Liu Mengjie broke out in a cold sweat. Oh my god, Lin Fan is just too strong! Was it really only half his strength? Half his strength was already surpassing international top piano masters. If he went all out, how incredible would that be? It’s unimaginable!
Liu Mengjie remembered something and said, "By the way, Little Fan, why did Xu Cheng give up after just a phone call?"
Lin Fan said, "Do you know Du Tao?"
Liu Mengjie replied, puzzled, "Yeah, though I haven’t met him, I know Du Tao. He’s the president of Tianxue Entertainment, a renowned figure in the entertainment industry. But what does that have to do with anything?"
Lin Fan said, "Because I am the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment. Xu Cheng found out my identity from Du Tao and naturally dared not pursue me for signing."
Liu Mengjie was stunned.
Lin Fan is actually the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment?
Even a big shot like Du Tao in the entertainment industry is merely his subordinate?
This is truly astonishing.
Tianxue Entertainment, one of the top entertainment companies in the country!
What does it mean to be the Boss of Tianxue?
It means Lin Fan is someone who can make or break the entertainment industry!
Most students attending the music academy dream of becoming singers and developing in the entertainment industry. And Lin Fan is the one who could easily determine their future.
Just like how Lin Fan recommended Nie Qiao’er just now. As the director of the top music company, Wind Bird Music, Xu Cheng didn’t hesitate at all to decide to sign Nie Qiao’er.
On one hand, this is naturally because Nie Qiao’er is excellent herself. But the main reason is still Lin Fan.
Liu Mengjie couldn’t understand Lin Fan. Is he a Celestial God in disguise?
He is so young, yet so outstanding, wealthy, with top-tier musical talent, and also the Boss of Tianxue!
Liu Mengjie was completely conquered by Lin Fan. This damn charm, who can resist!
"Little Fan, no... Mr. Lin, with your status, why did you agree to come and be just a small substitute teacher?" Liu Mengjie asked, and after knowing Lin Fan’s identity as the Big Boss of Tianxue, she naturally developed a sense of reverence.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sister Mengjie, you can call me like before, don’t be so formal."
Liu Mengjie’s cheeks turned rosy as she smiled sweetly, "Alright, Little Fan."
Lin Fan said, "I came to be a substitute teacher because you were too enthusiastic, Sister Mengjie. I couldn’t refuse."
Liu Mengjie giggled, "Then, would you consider becoming a full-time teacher? Currently, students really like you."
Liu Mengjie looked at Lin Fan with expectant eyes. If Lin Fan agreed, she could work with him every day in the future. Just the thought of it made her happy.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’ll think about it."
Liu Mengjie seemed to see hope and bit her lip, "Why don’t you come to the office, and we’ll discuss it in detail..."
But Lin Fan said, "No, let’s talk next time. I left home too early today, so I want to catch up on some sleep."
Liu Mengjie: "..."
Lin Fan is such a straight man. Asking him to the office, did she really intend to talk about business? Her intentions were beyond that...
"Alright," Liu Mengjie said, thinking maybe she was too hasty, good things come to those who wait. She had confidence, with her beauty, the heartthrob would eventually be hers.
Lin Fan then bid farewell to Liu Mengjie, preparing to leave the school.
"Ding!"
"System prompt: today’s check-in can begin, check-in now to receive shares in a live broadcasting company, would you like to check in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 117: New Reward, Teasing Whiskers Livestream Second Largest Shareholder
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 117: New Reward, Teasing Whiskers Livestream Second Largest Shareholder
Suddenly, a system notification echoed in his mind.
Lin Fan reacted with a "huh," today’s reward is company shares again.
"Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for successfully signing in, rewarding 30% shares of Teasing Whiskers Livestream company. Congratulations to the host for becoming the second largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers!"
But there’s more!
"Ding!"
"Information on Teasing Whiskers Livestream company has been collected. Would you like to read it?"
Lin Fan replied, "Read!"
A stream of information surged into Lin Fan’s mind. Through processing it, Lin Fan learned all about Teasing Whiskers Livestream.
Teasing Whiskers Livestream company, one of the top three premier live streaming platforms in Huaxia!
Becoming the second largest shareholder means that Lin Fan’s status in the live streaming world will be akin to that of a major influencer.
Meanwhile, at the headquarters of Teasing Whiskers Livestream company, in the chairman’s office.
"What, 30% shares of Teasing Whiskers got acquired by someone? Who is this buyer, Lin Fan?"
Teasing Whiskers’ largest shareholder, chairman Li Jianhua, stood up with an incredulous look.
"Lin Fan’s specific identity is still unclear, we’re investigating." His subordinate reported.
Li Jianhua pondered for a bit and said, "Regardless of his identity, this person seems formidable. Silently acquiring 30% shares to become the second largest shareholder indicates ominous intentions!"
Li Jianhua felt a sense of crisis.
He holds 45% of the shares, being the largest shareholder.
Lin Fan’s shareholding nearly rivals his own.
The subordinate asked, "Chairman, how should we deal with this person?"
Li Jianhua replied, "The situation is unclear, we should not act rashly. First, we should try to ingratiate ourselves and avoid offending him! Let’s connect his phone call, and I’ll personally extend my congratulations."
Lin Fan’s phone connected.
"Hello, Mr. Lin, this is Li Jianhua, chairman of Teasing Whiskers. I’m calling specifically to congratulate you on joining Teasing Whiskers," Li Jianhua said courteously.
The chairman calling so quickly surprised Lin Fan too, and he replied with a smile, "No need to be so formal, Mr. Li, I’m glad to join Teasing Whiskers."
Li Jianhua asked, "Mr. Lin, would you be available to visit the company someday? I’d be honored to have a face-to-face meeting with you."
Lin Fan yawned and said, "Let’s postpone the meeting, I’m too sleepy today and want to rest."
Honestly, being just the second largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers didn’t concern Lin Fan much; sleep was more important.
Li Jianhua broke into a sweat, thinking this Lin Fan is too audacious, even showing little regard for Teasing Whiskers!
This man isn’t simple at all.
Li Jianhua didn’t dare offend Lin Fan easily and though awkwardly, he said, "Alright, whenever you have time, you can call me back and we can arrange a meeting. By the way, I’ve just asked someone to set up an Emperor account for you; you can log in using your phone to watch and reward streams freely on Teasing Whiskers."
Lin Fan replied, "Okay, thank you."
Lin Fan felt a bit curious.
After hanging up, he downloaded the Teasing Whiskers livestream app and tried logging in with his phone number, successfully doing so.
Account Level: The Emperor!
This is the highest-level account on Teasing Whiskers, with numerous privileges, being a big shot among big shots — having immense prestige.
Lin Fan browsed through Teasing Whiskers’ stream rankings.
Suddenly, a familiar name caught his eye.
At this time.
Zheng Miaomiao, while live streaming, walked into the campus.
"Today I’m doing an outdoor stream; here is Yun City Music Academy, mainly here because it’s the first day of the academy’s term, to see what’s interesting."
"Beautiful campus, this was my dream to study here, but unfortunately, I didn’t get in. It’s so atmospheric here, makes me want to sing a song."
Zheng Miaomiao started humming a song, it was Nie Qiao’er’s new song she had just learned this morning.
The comments stirred up, beginning to discuss this song.
"This song, wow, Miao Miao learned it so quickly."
"Miao Miao sings really well, not inferior to the original singer."
"Miao Miao is amazing!"
"Can’t deny this song is great!"
"Because of this song, the singer Qiao’er became a sensation overnight."
Seeing comments praising her, and people starting to give rewards, Zheng Miaomiao felt very satisfied; she learned this song first to achieve this effect, the song’s really popular.
Zheng Miaomiao smiled and said, "I’ll tell you something exciting, don’t be skeptical; I know the original singer of this song, Qiao’er."
Comments exploded.
"Wow, so cool!"
"No way!"
"You’re kidding!"
"Miao Miao must be teasing us."
Zheng Miaomiao said, "I’m really not lying, I live in the same building as Qiao’er. I just bumped into her this morning. If you don’t believe it, next time I’ll take a picture with her and show you."
Comment: "If you really know Qiao’er, do you know who wrote this song?"
"Yeah, could you ask her for us?"
"Everyone’s curious."
Zheng Miaomiao replied, "I asked Qiao’er, but she didn’t tell."
Comments immediately expressed disbelief, thinking Zheng Miaomiao was bluffing.
Zheng Miaomiao felt exasperated, and said, "If you don’t believe me, fine, next time I’ll invite Qiao’er to stream with me and prove it! Now let’s not talk about this anymore, let’s interview some students."
Zheng Miaomiao quickly switched topics, then grabbed a student passing by, "Hey, can I interview you?"
Seeing a pretty girl, the student looked shy, "Um."
Zheng Miaomiao asked, "Is today the first day of the term? Is there anything new at your school?"
Upon hearing, the student became animated, "Yes, today a substitute piano teacher here amazed the whole school."
Zheng Miaomiao exclaimed, "Amazed the whole school? What happened?"
The student replied, "His piano playing is incredibly strong, simply genius level. Even world-class piano masters would have to bow to him."
Zheng Miaomiao was surprised, "No way, there’s such an amazing teacher here, and just a substitute? Where is he now?"
The student said, "I don’t know, maybe in the office."
Then, other students greeted the one being interviewed, and he ran off.
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Such an impressive piano teacher should be visited, let’s head to the office."
The comments showed curiosity.
"Is the teacher really that amazing?"
"Who could this instructor be? Could it be Lang Lang?"
"Huaxia’s best piano player is Lang Lang!"
"Is there anyone better than Lang Lang?"
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Let’s visit and find out. Let’s go."
With that, she headed towards the classroom office.
Suddenly, a familiar figure appeared.
Zheng Miaomiao turned on the rear camera; a handsome young man appeared, wearing regular clothes but masking none of his charm.
"Huh, isn’t that my landlord? How come he’s here too?" Zheng Miaomiao wondered.
Lin Fan!
Faithful fans of Zheng Miaomiao’s stream recognized Lin Fan too.
"He’s the landlord who disrespected her yesterday!"
"What a coincidence!"
"Such a steel-hearted guy, Miao Miao, don’t bother with him!"
Zheng Miaomiao wanted to tease Lin Fan, to get even for yesterday’s embarrassment.
"I’ll share a secret; I discovered my landlord doesn’t like women!" Zheng Miaomiao joked.
The comments erupted with laughter.
"No way, didn’t see that coming!"
"Really, that explains his behavior!"
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Seriously, watch this."
Then, she walked straight up to Lin Fan, blocking his path.
"Hey landlord, fancy meeting you here!" Zheng Miaomiao warmly said.
Lin Fan was glancing at his phone, lifted his head, and smiled lightly.
He had just received the Emperor account on Teasing Whiskers and had entered Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream room, so he’d seen everything she told the viewers.
This Zheng Miaomiao, audaciously claimed he doesn’t like women!
Lin Fan coldly smiled to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Tried to Set Up Lin Fan, but Got Outsmarted
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 118: Tried to Set Up Lin Fan, but Got Outsmarted
Lin Fan pretended to know nothing and asked curiously, "What about you, why are you here?"
Zheng Miaomiao said, "I’m doing an outdoor livestream today, Mr. Landlord, are you free at noon?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, I am."
Zheng Miaomiao bit her lip shyly, "What a coincidence, I’m free too. Mr. Landlord, how about we have lunch together?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Sorry, I don’t want to have lunch with you. Goodbye."
With that, Lin Fan walked away.
Zheng Miaomiao whispered to the camera, "I told you so!"
Comments started flooding in.
"He really seems to dislike women."
"They say the more handsome someone is, the more likely they are to be gay. It’s true!"
"Honestly, what a pity, he’s quite handsome."
Suddenly, a user named "Low-Key Tycoon" said, "Heh, your judgments are too hasty. Just refusing lunch doesn’t prove he doesn’t like women."
Everyone noticed that this "Low-Key Tycoon" had an Emperor-level account!
"Oh my god! The Emperor has spoken!"
"Tycoon bro is so low-key, when did he get here? We didn’t even notice."
"Miao Miao, Tycoon bro said you’re hasty, what do you think?"
Seeing that "Low-Key Tycoon" had an Emperor account, netizens immediately bowed down. Having an Emperor account meant being rich, and at a very wealthy level. It’s impossible to upgrade to Emperor level without spending hundreds or thousands of millions on the platform!
They naturally didn’t know that this "Low-Key Tycoon" was actually Lin Fan.
Lin Fan got this Emperor account without spending a single penny.
It was personally given by Li Jianhua, the chairman of Teasing Whiskers.
Zheng Miaomiao was taken aback by "Low-Key Tycoon’s" message. This was an unfamiliar Emperor, visiting her livestream for the first time!
As a streamer, there are two types of people she wouldn’t dare to offend: one is a moderator, and the other is an Emperor account.
An Emperor account is the biggest financial backer of a livestream. Random gifts start from tens of thousands. Streamers are eager to curry favor, let alone offend them.
Seeing the Emperor questioning her, Zheng Miaomiao had to treat it carefully.
"Tycoon brother, I’m not making rash judgments. Not only did he refuse me, but yesterday I also saw him refuse an 8 out of 10 beauty with my own eyes," Zheng Miaomiao said.
Yesterday?
Lin Fan frowned.
Yesterday at the entrance of Tangchen Yipin, he did reject Duan Xiaowei. But it wasn’t because he didn’t like women, he just didn’t like women like Duan Xiaowei who sell themselves for money.
He didn’t expect Zheng Miaomiao to see it, leading her to such a ridiculous conclusion. How amusing.
Low-Key Tycoon: "What if you were mistaken? Let’s make a bet. If you are right, I will tip you one million. If you’re wrong, you face the appropriate consequences."
One million!
The comment section erupted.
"Tycoon bro’s move is incredible!"
"As expected of an Emperor account, one disagreement leads to a million-dollar tip!"
"Can’t wait for Tycoon bro’s million-dollar tip!"
"Miao Miao, you should agree to it!"
Zheng Miaomiao was also very excited. According to the revenue share of Teasing Whiskers, a million-dollar tip would net her over 700,000!
This is equivalent to 7 months of rent, as long as she can prove that Lin Fan doesn’t like women!
"Alright, Tycoon brother, just wait!" Zheng Miaomiao immediately said, not even noticing the latter part of the message about facing consequences if she was wrong.
Zheng Miaomiao quickly caught up with Lin Fan.
"Mr. Landlord, don’t walk so fast. Wait for me," Zheng Miaomiao said in a coquettish voice.
Lin Fan stopped and said plainly, "Do you have something else to say?"
Zheng Miaomiao looked aggrieved, "Mr. Landlord, why did you refuse to have lunch with me? Am I really that annoying?"
Lin Fan remained silent.
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Mr. Landlord, why aren’t you saying anything? I realize I was wrong yesterday. Flirting with you was my mistake. Is it because you don’t like being flirted with?"
Lin Fan found it amusing. This Zheng Miaomiao was trying so hard to trap him. If he had orientation issues, he would surely fall into her trap.
Unfortunately, Zheng Miaomiao was doomed to fail from the start.
Lin Fan pretended to sigh and said, "Do I really have to say it?"
Zheng Miaomiao’s heart skipped a beat. Was Lin Fan about to confess?
Lin Fan looked at Zheng Miaomiao, biting his lip as if gathering great courage, "Actually, the moment I saw you yesterday, I fell in love with you!"
What?
Zheng Miaomiao was dumbfounded.
Netizens were also stunned.
Lin Fan’s words were truly unexpected.
Lin Fan said, "The first time I saw you, I was captivated by your pure aura. You’re like a shining goddess, deeply attracting me. It’s as if my soul was drawn to you, like I’ve fallen into a whirlpool of love, and that whirlpool is you."
Zheng Miaomiao stood there, half-laughing, half-crying. This script was all wrong. It wasn’t supposed to be like this!
"Mr. Landlord, haven’t you made a mistake? You were so harsh to me yesterday..."
Lin Fan interrupted her, "That’s because I was once hurt by love. I didn’t dare to reveal my feelings for you. I was afraid of repeating the past mistakes, so I had to pretend to be indifferent. Unfortunately, I couldn’t deceive myself. Ever since we parted yesterday, I’ve been thinking about you, even dreaming about you."
Zheng Miaomiao was a bit anxious, "It can’t be... you shouldn’t be like this!"
According to her predictions, he should not like women. How come he’s expressing such deep feelings for her?
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan said sadly, "Heh, I knew it. I shouldn’t have revealed my feelings. You really don’t like me, and I’m hurt again."
Zheng Miaomiao quickly said, "No... Mr. Landlord, that’s not what I meant!"
Lin Fan, heartbroken, said, "I know, you don’t have to say anything. Someone like me doesn’t deserve your favor. Goodbye!"
After speaking, Lin Fan walked around Zheng Miaomiao and left. With his back facing her, Lin Fan couldn’t help but chuckle.
Zheng Miaomiao tried to set him up, but he easily turned the tables on her.
Looking down at his phone, the comments were quite amusing.
"Wow, Miao Miao was really wrong!"
"Turns out he likes Miao Miao!"
"I get him because I’d do the same!"
"The more you like someone, the more you fear failure, so you pretend not to care!"
"Miao Miao, you misunderstood him. He doesn’t dislike women."
"Miao Miao is in for another fall."
Zheng Miaomiao’s expression at this moment was also quite notable, a mix of wanting to cry but having no tears. After all, the Emperor account "Low-Key Tycoon" had given her a million-dollar tip hope, and now that hope was shattered.
Lin Fan immediately used his "Low-Key Tycoon" identity to comment in Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream room.
"Miao Miao, you were wrong. A bet is a bet. The million-dollar tip won’t happen, and you must face the consequences."
Zheng Miaomiao still didn’t know what the consequence was, "What consequence?"
Low-Key Tycoon: "You casually claimed someone doesn’t like women. That kind of behavior is defamatory. I believe you’ve violated the rules of Teasing Whiskers. You should voluntarily apply for a three-day suspension."

chapters.title: Chapter 119: The Administrator Acts Cool for a Moment, Then Turns Around and Cries
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 119: The Administrator Acts Cool for a Moment, Then Turns Around and Cries
Zheng Miaomiao’s face changed: "What, you want me to suspend my livestream for three days?"
She relies on livestreaming to earn a living. A three-day suspension would mean a significant loss of income for her.
Low-Key Tycoon: "You have to accept your bet and its outcome. You’re not thinking of backing out, are you?"
Zheng Miaomiao chuckled, "You want me to suspend my stream for three days? That’s impossible. While I do accept my bets, if you tell me to die, do I have to actually die?"
Since she wouldn’t get any rewards from this Emperor account, Zheng Miaomiao was no longer afraid of offending him.
She was a top streamer at Teasing Whiskers, and the platform would definitely back her. An Emperor account was nothing she couldn’t handle.
Low-Key Tycoon: "Oh, not willing? Then, no choice, the suspension extends to a week!"
Zheng Miaomiao got a bit angry: "Are you crazy? You just extend it by saying so? Who do you think you are? You’re just here to cause trouble!"
Lin Fan was just about to reply when he suddenly saw a prompt pop up on the screen.
"You have been muted by room admin Fengliu Yidao."
Lin Fan frowned. Had he really caused a commotion to get muted by the admin?
Soon after, he saw Fengliu Yidao’s message: "Miaomiao, don’t be upset, I’ve already muted this guy!"
Lin Fan smirked. So, the admin was Zheng Miaomiao’s simp.
The comments started to pour in at that moment.
"Go room admin!"
"Damn, impressive, you muted the Emperor account!"
"Awesome, first time seeing an Emperor account getting muted!"
"Serves him right for bullying our Miaomiao!"
Zheng Miaomiao was quite pleased, giggling as she said, "Thank you, room admin guy, love you!"
Fengliu Yidao: "A tycoon is nothing, I want him to know who rules here!"
Lin Fan chuckled, it seemed this admin was a bit full of himself, thinking he was someone important just because he had a tiny bit of power, without knowing whom he was offending.
Lin Fan immediately made a call.
"Mr. Lin, are you calling to arrange a meeting?"
The person on the call was Chairman Li Jianhua of Teasing Whiskers. He had previously called Lin Fan, wanting to meet, but Lin Fan turned him down.
Lin Fan said, "Let’s arrange a meeting with Chairman Li later. Just now, my Emperor account got muted."
Li Jianhua was startled: "Who dared to mute you? What happened?"
Lin Fan briefly explained his bet with Zheng Miaomiao.
Li Jianhua was surprised: "Such a thing happened? Don’t worry, Mr. Lin, I’ll handle this personally."
In Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream room.
Because the room admin muted the Emperor account "Low-Key Tycoon," the room was filled with excitement, seeing a wealthy patron getting frustrated was so enjoyable.
Though they usually ingratiated themselves to wealthy patrons, they delighted in seeing them in trouble—such is human nature.
Amidst the excitement, a prompt popped up in the stream room: Emperor account "Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes" entered the room.
The room was immediately filled with exclamations.
"Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes!"
This was the ID of Li Jianhua, Chairman of Teasing Whiskers!
It was an open secret, not only known among Teasing Whiskers employees and streamers but also many fans.
Chairman Li Jianhua personally visiting Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream room was quite a prestigious matter, making her beam with joy.
"Welcome, Young Master Hua." Zheng Miaomiao said with delight.
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "I heard the room admin muted Mr. Lin’s ’Low-Key Tycoon’ account?"
The chairman came straight to the point, directly asking about the muting incident.
Zheng Miaomiao and Fengliu Yidao were both taken aback. Damn, muting just one Emperor account caused the chairman to get involved?
Mr. Lin?
Who exactly was this Low-Key Tycoon Mr. Lin?
They seemed to have offended someone they shouldn’t have.
Fengliu Yidao was no longer arrogant, trembling as he quickly responded: "Um, the account was deemed disruptive to the stream earlier, so it was muted, I’ll unmute it right away."
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Mr. Lin made a bet with Miaomiao, she lost, and bets should be honored. Mr. Lin only asked her to fulfill the agreement, which is reasonable. It wasn’t Mr. Lin stirring trouble, it was you!"
Fengliu Yidao was sweating profusely: "I’m sorry."
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Admins should be fair. You have seriously violated the rules, which cannot be forgiven. After unmuting Mr. Lin, you should go offline, collect this month’s salary, and know that you’ve been fired!"
Everyone was in shock.
Damn, immediately fired the admin!
What a decisive action.
Fengliu Yidao was devastated, crying loudly, deeply regretting being a simp. In an attempt to please his goddess, he had offended someone he shouldn’t have, thus destroying himself.
Soon after.
The screen prompted: Low-Key Tycoon has been unmuted.
Low-Key Tycoon: "Haha, finally unmuted, thanks, Chairman Li."
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Mr. Lin, no worries, it’s only right. I apologize for my subordinate’s mistake. Please forgive us, Mr. Lin."
Everyone’s inner thoughts: "Damn! Low-Key Tycoon knows Chairman Li and receives such respect from him! Who exactly is this Mr. Lin?"
Low-Key Tycoon: "I just made a bet with this streamer, but even though she lost, she seems unwilling to accept the punishment."
Zheng Miaomiao hurriedly responded: "I accept, I voluntarily apply for a three-day suspension. Tycoon brother, I’m sorry, I was wrong earlier, can you spare me?"
With the admin’s fate as a precedent, how could she dare go against this Low-Key Tycoon? If she didn’t concede, it wouldn’t be just a three-day suspension, but potentially a permanent one!
This time, she had indeed offended someone she shouldn’t have.
The chairman personally intervened! Who must this Low-Key Tycoon be to make the chairman intervene? He undoubtedly had a complicated identity!
Low-Key Tycoon: "I’m not unreasonable. Since you’re willing to accept the punishment, in light of Chairman Li’s considerations, I won’t pursue this further."
Zheng Miaomiao gratefully said: "Thank you, Tycoon brother."
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Let’s do it this way, after this stream, Miaomiao, you’ll be suspended for three days!"
"Yes, thank you, Young Master Hua, thank you, Tycoon brother."
Zheng Miaomiao said, secretly relieved, a three-day suspension was the lightest punishment, facing permanent suspension was not impossible, and she could only accept it.
Low-Key Tycoon: "Alright, I’m leaving."
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Mr. Lin, how about our meeting? I just remembered there’s a charity gala tonight, why don’t we meet there?"
Low-Key Tycoon: "Okay, please send me the address later, I’m really leaving now."
Lin Fan exited the livestream.
Being the second largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers was indeed convenient. Without this status, Li Jianhua wouldn’t have helped him deal with the admin and Zheng Miaomiao.
Indeed, on livestreaming platforms, admins could do whatever they wanted. Some admins were too arrogant and needed a lesson.
Fengliu Yidao, this time, had met his match.
After Lin Fan left the livestream room, he immediately locked his phone, mumbling, "Charity gala?"
Li Jianhua invited him to a charity gala, something he had only seen online before, an upper-class activity he had never attended.
Seems like tonight he would be encountering high society for the first time.
After Lin Fan exited the livestream, Li Jianhua remained in Zheng Miaomiao’s room.
Zheng Miaomiao couldn’t help but ask: "Young Master Hua, can I ask who this Tycoon brother really is?"
Young Master Hua Eating Potatoes: "Mr. Lin, he’s our second largest shareholder at Teasing Whiskers and, from what I understand, a billionaire tycoon."
What?
Everyone in the stream room was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 Teasing Whiskers Chairman Shivering
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 120 Teasing Whiskers Chairman Shivering
After discovering the identity of the "Low-Key Tycoon," the entire livestream room was stunned.
"He’s actually the second largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers!"
"He’s second only to the chairman."
"A hundred-billion tycoon, what a concept!"
"Impressive!"
"Miao Miao really hit a wall this time."
Zheng Miaomiao couldn’t help but smile bitterly. It was really unlucky. Had she known this Low-Key Tycoon’s identity was so impressive, she wouldn’t have dared to offend him no matter what.
Young Master Hua who loves potatoes: "Let’s leave it at that, I’m out."
Then, Li Jianhua exited the livestream.
Teasing Whiskers Chairman’s Office.
Subordinate: "Chairman, what happened?"
Li Jianhua said, "Nothing, just a streamer offended Lin Fan, and I dealt with them. By the way, I asked you to investigate Lin Fan. Do you have any results?"
The subordinate replied, "I’ve found something. This Lin Fan is a mysterious tycoon who recently emerged in Yun City. He’s only 21 years old but has been aggressively acquiring companies. He has fully acquired companies like Blue Moon Hand Soap, Tourist Comics, and Tianxue Entertainment, and there’s more..."
Li Jianhua’s expression changed, and he sat up straight: "Wait, are you talking about Tianxue Entertainment? The one I know?"
The subordinate said, "Yes, that Tianxue Entertainment."
Li Jianhua was incredibly surprised. The first two companies were nothing special, but Tianxue Entertainment, it’s a top company in the entertainment industry!
Lin Fan actually managed to acquire Tianxue just like that?
How did he do it?
Moreover, he’s only 21 and already the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, this is unbelievable!
Li Jianhua was shocked for a long time before he calmed down a bit and asked, "What else?"
The subordinate continued, "Other companies he has invested in include Golden Capital Group, Xingquan Lawyers, and our Teasing Whiskers. Basically, he’s become the second or third largest shareholder in all of them."
Li Jianhua fell silent.
Golden Capital Group, a giant in the restaurant and hotel industry.
Xingquan Law Firm is a top law firm, and it’s said that getting shares in it is nearly impossible for ordinary people!
Yet, Lin Fan managed to do it and even become a major shareholder!
Including Teasing Whiskers, as the chairman, Li Jianhua didn’t know how Lin Fan acquired 30% of Teasing Whiskers’ shares. It seems like magic.
Lin Fan’s abilities are truly extraordinary!
Li Jianhua started to tremble slightly. With Lin Fan’s incredible skills, if he decided to continue acquiring Teasing Whiskers’ shares, Li Jianhua, as the largest shareholder, might have no power to resist and before long, the entire Teasing Whiskers could fall into Lin Fan’s hands!
Thinking about this, Li Jianhua’s voice trembled, "What else?"
The subordinate, seeing the chairman was frightened, also broke out in a cold sweat. He had followed the chairman for so long and had never seen him this panicked before; it seemed this Lin Fan truly startled the chairman.
The subordinate hesitated, unsure whether to speak the next bit of information.
But he ultimately chose to say it: "There’s more... but it hasn’t been confirmed. It’s just a rumor that this Lin Fan might actually be the mysterious Mr. Lin who recently shocked Yun City."
"What? What did you say?"
Li Jianhua jumped up abruptly.
Cold sweat was dripping down.
Lin Fan is the Mr. Lin who spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor and 6 billion to purchase Chiba Island?
If that’s true, Lin Fan is far from just a hundred-billion tycoon.
He’s a thousand-billion tycoon for sure!
The subordinate said, "Chairman, please rest assured, this is purely speculation. No one can confirm it."
Li Jianhua murmured, "Even if he’s not Mr. Lin, simply his aggressive acquisition of companies is already astounding. If he is indeed Mr. Lin, then... In any case, he’s not someone we can afford to offend."
The subordinate asked, "Chairman, what do you plan to do?"
Li Jianhua said, "I’ve invited him to tonight’s charity gala. I’ll meet him and test the waters first. It seems my previous decision was correct; luckily, I didn’t offend him. I just helped him deal with that streamer who offended him, giving him a favor so he shouldn’t make things difficult for me."
Li Jianhua felt secretly relieved.
Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream room.
After the chairman left, Zheng Miaomiao felt a bit regretful; she wanted to ask what Mr. Lin’s name was, but the chairman had already left.
Zheng Miaomiao felt truly unlucky; how did she wind up offending the second-largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers!
Perhaps this Mr. Lin wandered into her livestream by chance and then acted after seeing something unjust?
In any case, all of this was because of Lin Fan!
Who asked Lin Fan to have a normal orientation and like her, causing her to lose to Mr. Lin and get a three-day ban!
Wait a minute!
It doesn’t quite seem that simple!
Zheng Miaomiao felt something was amiss but couldn’t put her finger on it. She looked up for Lin Fan and saw he had already walked a distance away.
At this time, comments were consoling Zheng Miaomiao.
"Miao Miao, don’t be sad. Three days will pass quickly."
"We’re all here, waiting for your return."
"You can stream for a bit longer today."
"We’re still waiting for you to interview that piano genius."
Some even began sending gifts voluntarily.
Zheng Miaomiao felt a bit better but dramatically said on the surface, "Sigh, no mood to stream, the thought of having to stop once I end this stream and not being able to stream again until three days later, unless you all send more gifts to comfort me."
Indeed, a wave of gift-sending frenzy was ignited, with rockets and yachts thrown at her...
Zheng Miaomiao was overjoyed inside, thinking how easy it was to fool these fans.
Zheng Miaomiao said, "Thank you all for the gifts. Okay, let’s continue to find that piano genius."
Zheng Miaomiao was about to turn around and head back to the office.
Suddenly, she saw her classmates gathering in one direction as if they had spotted a celebrity.
"Huh," Zheng Miaomiao exclaimed, looking up to see her classmates surrounding Lin Fan!
Zheng Miaomiao curiously grabbed a classmate: "Hey, what’s happening, why is everyone running?"
The classmate replied, "We’re going to see the piano teacher."
Saying this, the classmate hurried off eagerly.
"The piano teacher?" Zheng Miaomiao wondered aloud, "What does that have to do with the landlord?"
Zheng Miaomiao’s curiosity was piqued, and she joined the crowd.
By this time, Lin Fan was already surrounded by students.
It turned out Lin Fan was planning to leave, but the students recognized him. News spread quickly among them, inciting the curious students to gather around.
"Teacher Lin, your piano playing is incredible!"
"Wow, Teacher Lin is so handsome!"
"My God, he must be the piano prince!"
The students burst into a frenzy of screams, all bewitched by Lin Fan. Most of them were adoring females.
At this age, girls have little resistance to a handsome guy, let alone one like Lin Fan, who’s such an excellent piano teacher, capable of mesmerizing countless young ladies.
Lin Fan felt a bit helpless; being handsome surely attracts attention effortlessly.
