At this moment, Zheng Miaomiao, witnessing this from the periphery, was completely stunned.
Damn!
The landlord is that piano prodigy?

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Star Teacher, Too Popular
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 121: Star Teacher, Too Popular
Surrounded by a group of young female students, including some beautiful young ladies, Lin Fan felt like he was back on a college campus.
Back in the day, as the campus heartthrob, he was this popular too. Being handsome is just tough, huh.
The students enthusiastically encircled Lin Fan, each curious like a little baby, bombarding him with questions.
"Teacher Lin, why do you play the piano so well? How did you practice to get so good?" a student asked.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Practice? You all might need to practice diligently, but I never practiced—it’s mainly due to my talent!"
What he said wasn’t wrong; he received a music talent reward from the system.
"Never practiced? That’s awesome!"
"Teacher Lin is amazing!"
"Wow, he’s so cool and arrogant, I love it!"
The girls screamed excitedly.
Lin Fan understood these young ladies too well; they just loved the aloof and cool handsome guys.
At this moment, Zheng Miaomiao, standing on the outskirts, was already stunned.
Landlord Lin Fan is that genius piano teacher? A piano master even more impressive than Lang Lang?
Turns out Lin Fan is here to teach a class, huh?
Zheng Miaomiao looked at the camera, completely bewildered.
The comments were filled with "OMG."
"OMG, what’s going on?"
"OMG, Miaomiao, your landlord is this amazing?"
"OMG, what a treasure landlord is this?"
Zheng Miaomiao said, "I’m so shocked I can’t even speak. Looks like we don’t need to go to the office anymore."
My landlord is just too incredible!
Owning an entire building in Tangchen Yipin, with assets worth at least billions!
Having money is one thing, but being so talented, too.
A piano genius, teaching piano at Yun City Music Academy!
Oh my, he’s truly a treasure boy.
Suddenly recalling Lin Fan’s confession earlier, Zheng Miaomiao was moved. Such an outstanding guy like her landlord could only be matched by her, Zheng Miaomiao. Maybe she should just say yes to him!
At this moment, another student asked, "Teacher Lin, a junior sister said she saw you singing ’Fireworks Easily Cold’ at the exam hall the other day. Is it true?"
As soon as these words were spoken, it immediately caught everyone’s attention, and they were all amazed.
Recently, a short video has gone viral online, featuring a guy singing ’Fireworks Easily Cold,’ crowned as the Song God of the people. Unfortunately, the video only captured his back, and no one knows who he is.
There’s a rumor circulating within Yun City Music Academy that this video was shot in the academy, and the guy is a student’s parent who sang this song at the freshman interview site.
Many freshmen swear they saw it that day, claiming to have witnessed it firsthand.
But, since it’s just a rumor without verification, the senior students, who weren’t present that day, were skeptical.
Lin Fan, hearing the question, had nothing to hide, nodded casually: "Yeah, it was me singing."
"Ah!"
A wave of screams followed.
The students were going crazy.
That song ’Fireworks Easily Cold’ was sung so beautifully, many sealed the singer as their male god. Even though it was just a silhouette, Lin Fan’s voice captivated them all.
Now aware that the genius piano teacher, the invincibly handsome Teacher Lin Fan, was that singer—this double surprise was beyond thrilling.
"I’m losing my mind! He plays the piano so well, sings so well, and is so handsome. Is this real?"
"What an Immortal brother!"
"It’s him! I’m too excited, I’m dying!"
"My heart can’t take it! My male god was originally Teacher Lin!"
The screams from the female students made the place look like a celebrity chase scene, with Lin Fan as the dazzling superstar.
Zheng Miaomiao was already petrified.
Of course, she knew about the ’Fireworks Easily Cold’ video and was deeply attracted to the singer’s voice, looping it countless times.
In her judgment, this "Song God of the people" was a genius singer!
She was also curious, who exactly was this genius singer?
It turned out to be Lin Fan again?
A piano genius, a singing genius, Lin Fan was simply a music genius!
The live stream viewers were also on the verge of going crazy.
They all knew about that video and were always curious about who the Song God was.
Seriously!
It was Miaomiao’s landlord?
This is too incredible.
"Turns out Miaomiao’s landlord is a music genius, impressive!"
"Found the Song God, let me post it on my Moments first."
"Post it on Weibo, it will definitely cause a sensation!"
"Hot search guaranteed!"
The viewers had a heated discussion in the live stream room.
But Zheng Miaomiao couldn’t care less about responding to the viewers now; all she wanted was to squeeze in and talk to Lin Fan.
But surrounded by a group of enthusiastic female students, how could she possibly squeeze in?
"Landlord handsome guy!"
She called out, but her voice was quickly drowned out by the students’ clamor. Zheng Miaomiao was getting really anxious.
Seeing the commotion he caused, Lin Fan thought it wouldn’t be good if something unexpected happened, being too popular is such a hassle, so he decided to leave.
With the students flocking around him, Lin Fan left the campus gates.
"Classmates, go back to your classes, I’m leaving."
Lin Fan smiled and waved, quickly getting into the Kosak, driving away with style.
The students saw this and screamed again.
It turns out Lin Fan isn’t just a music genius but also a super-rich dude. This top-notch sports car must be worth tens of millions!
Handsome, young, rich, and a music genius!
Perfect, simply perfect!
By noon, Lin Fan’s name had spread throughout Yun City Music Academy, becoming a star teacher worshipped by almost everyone.
From a substitute teacher questioned by all to a star teacher admired by everyone, Lin Fan merely played a piano piece to make this transition.
Watching Lin Fan drive off, Zheng Miaomiao ultimately didn’t get to talk to him.
She felt a bit helpless; her landlord handsome guy was just too popular.
"Damn, these female students are too crazy, I just can’t squeeze in," Zheng Miaomiao said with a wry smile.
Just then, someone commented, "Miaomiao, go check Weibo quickly, Qiao’er revealed the new song’s composer, it’s trending again!"
Upon seeing the comment, Zheng Miaomiao went "Oh," then opened Weibo.
Sure enough, Nie Qiao’er posted a new Weibo, publicly revealing the composer of the new song, and it was instantly trending, after all, it’s a hot topic.
Lyrics & Music: Lin Fan, Nie Qiao’er.
This announcement left the netizens bewildered.
Who is Lin Fan?
The music industry has never heard of a Lin Fan, be it as a singer, lyricist, or composer.
Where did he come from? This unknown Lin Fan, wrote such an excellent song?
"What?"
Zheng Miaomiao was stunned for a moment, Lin Fan?
Isn’t that the name of the landlord handsome guy!
Considering Nie Qiao’er is also the landlord handsome guy’s tenant, it’s undoubtedly the same person!
The landlord handsome guy actually helped Nie Qiao’er write a song?
While she was excited, Zheng Miaomiao also felt a bit sour.
Even though she was a streamer, she also had dreams of becoming a professional singer, only lacking opportunities and good pieces.
After meeting Nie Qiao’er in the morning, she thought of using Nie Qiao’er’s connections to meet this composer. If she could get the composer to help write a song for her, her dream of becoming a professional singer might be realized easier.
Who knew!
This composer was Lin Fan!
Can you blame her for being excited, Lin Fan had just confessed to her!
Since Lin Fan liked her, she figured Lin Fan wouldn’t refuse if she asked him to help write a song!
Just thinking about it made her thrill.
As for feeling sour, it was about Nie Qiao’er, how did Nie Qiao’er get the landlord handsome guy to help write a song? And the annoying thing was, from the trending news and insider info, it seemed Nie Qiao’er was signing with Wind Bird!
Oh my God, Wind Bird, the top music company!
Nie Qiao’er, originally an indie singer with little fame, signed with Wind Bird just through one song!
It was envy-inducing enough to kill!
"Guys, today’s live stream ends here, I gotta chase my landlord!"
Zheng Miaomiao immediately made a decision, Lin Fan, he was hers!

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Identity Exposed, Shocking the Music World
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 122: Identity Exposed, Shocking the Music World
Zheng Miaomiao learned that Lin Fan helped Nie Qiao’er write a song and decided to chase after him; Lin Fan was someone who could change her destiny.
But by the time she got in the car, Lin Fan had already disappeared without a trace. Her car was an Audi R8 supercar, priced at nearly two million, although considered a good car, it couldn’t possibly catch up to Kosak.
Zheng Miaomiao didn’t know where Lin Fan went, so she returned to Tangchen Yipin and was pleasantly surprised to find Lin Fan’s Kosak parked in the garage.
Unfortunately, she was a step too late; Lin Fan had already gone upstairs.
Zheng Miaomiao didn’t know which floor Lin Fan lived on. After all, the whole building belonged to Lin Fan. Besides, even if she knew, she couldn’t go up; at Tangchen Yipin, each resident can only access their own floor.
Zheng Miaomiao made a firm decision; she would wait for Lin Fan in the garage. He was sure to come down again today!
Lin Fan was naturally unaware of this. He had already arrived at the top floor duplex.
Tangchen Yipin was not far from Yun City Music Academy, closer than the small apartment he rented, so he came here for a rest.
Just as he lay down, Lin Fan received a message from Li Jianhua: The charity gala would be held tonight at 7 pm on the third floor of Jindu Grand Hotel, with guests required to attend in formal attire.
Lin Fan owned 30% of Jindu Grand Hotel’s shares, making him the second-largest shareholder; it could be said it was his domain.
As the second-largest shareholder of Jindu, he naturally didn’t need to dress up like the other guests.
But Lin Fan thought since it was the gala’s rule, there was no need to go against the host.
Thinking it over, Lin Fan called Anna: "Anna, at 7 pm today, there’s a charity gala at Jindu Grand Hotel. I need to attend. Please prepare a suit and send it to me."
Anna replied, "Got it."
Knowing Anna’s work, Lin Fan was at ease; she was familiar with high society and had good taste.
Even though Anna worked for Feng Wanshan, she definitely wouldn’t plot anything in such a small matter. She should be eager for any opportunity to please him and gain his trust.
Having instructed Anna, Lin Fan finally lay down on the sofa without worries.
This sofa was a genuine leather sofa from Italy, worth over ten thousand, a luxury item in sofas; lying on it was supremely comfortable, far better than the bed in his shabby apartment.
Being wealthy really felt good, Lin Fan mused. When he had no money, he couldn’t indulge, but now that he’s affluent, he should enjoy it and not mistreat himself.
Lin Fan quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.
While Lin Fan was asleep, the internet became very lively.
First, Nie Qiao’er disclosed the creator of her new song, leading Lin Fan to capture everyone’s attention. Who exactly was this obscure writer, Lin Fan?
Then, someone uploaded a video of Zheng Miaomiao’s live stream online. In the video, Lin Fan was surrounded by a group of females, personally admitting he was the folk Song God who sang "Fireworks Easily Cold." The video soon caught public attention and quickly trended.
Lin Fan’s identity as a "folk Song God" was exposed.
Recently, the video of Lin Fan singing "Fireworks Easily Cold" went viral online. Even some celebrities shared it, expressing that they were captivated by Lin Fan’s singing.
Unfortunately, the video only showed a silhouette, and no one knew who the singer was, only affectionately calling him the "folk Song God".
Once this folk Song God was exposed, he immediately caused a sensation.
"Oh my God, so the folk Song God is him!"
"He’s so handsome, of course, great singers are all good-looking!"
"Isn’t he the recently popular most handsome delivery guy?"
"It’s him, it’s him, turns out he’s a music genius!"
"The Lin Fan who helped Nie Qiao’er write the song must be him too, right?"
"So amazing!"
"What an immortal brother!"
After being dubbed "the most handsome delivery guy" and "the richest delivery guy," Lin Fan now gained another title of "music genius."
This skyrocketed Lin Fan’s popularity, with the discussion soaring madly; even the most popular internet celebrities were outshone by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan’s fans rapidly increased in a geometric progression.
Besides fans, Lin Fan also attracted attention from the music industry, with many posting about him.
Famous music critic Ear King: "With Lin Fan’s outstanding singing skill and songwriting talent, once debuted, the Chinese Music Industry would be his."
Some renowned musician: "So excited, I feel the Chinese Music Industry is finally saved!"
A famous singer: "Today might very well be a momentous day for the Chinese Music Industry. History will remember this day. We’ve aged; it’s time for a new king to rise!"
A famous music company owner: "Does anyone know Mr. Lin Fan’s contact information? I want to sign him!"
Seeing these industry big shots expressing themselves, Wind Bird Music’s director Xu Cheng calmly smiled.
"Want to sign Mr. Lin? Wishful thinking; Mr. Lin is beyond your reach, even we at Wind Bird Music couldn’t invite him!"
As Xu Cheng, who first recognized Lin Fan’s musical talent, knew Lin Fan’s situation best, Lin Fan, is the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment!
Clearly, those in the entertainment world haven’t connected Lin Fan’s identity with that of this music genius Lin Fan.
What made Xu Cheng proud was that although they couldn’t sign Lin Fan, while everyone was buzzing about Lin Fan’s identity, Wind Bird had already quietly signed Nie Qiao’er.
Soon after, Nie Qiao’er’s signing with Wind Bird also trended.
This caused many music company bosses to beat their chests in frustration, as they too wanted to sign Nie Qiao’er, but Wind Bird beat them to it.
What frustrated them was, how did Wind Bird move so quickly?
Moreover, Nie Qiao’er and Lin Fan’s relationship attracted public attention and discussion.
What exactly was the relationship between Nie Qiao’er and the folk Song God "Lin Fan"? They collaborated on a song that became an overnight sensation; their relationship must be special!
"Are Qiao’er and Lin Fan a couple?"
"No way, please no, the brother is mine; he can’t be dating!"
"I think they’re quite a match, the golden couple of the music world."
In the Tangchen Yipin A Building Garage, Zheng Miaomiao, in her Audi R8 supercar, was angrily scrolling through Weibo, her jealousy written all over her face.
"Bah, you’re thinking too much. The landlord brother and Nie Qiao’er are not lovers; the landlord brother likes me!" Zheng Miaomiao snorted coldly.
Today, at Yun City Music Academy, the landlord brother had confessed to her in front of countless people in the live stream!
"I and the landlord brother are the true golden couple!"
Zheng Miaomiao’s face flushed as she daydreamed about becoming Lin Fan’s girlfriend, having him write songs for her, turning her into a popular singer.
Just thinking about it was exciting!
Suddenly, a car drove into the garage, and Zheng Miaomiao recognized it as Nie Qiao’er’s car; Nie Qiao’er had returned!
At the same time, in the top floor duplex, as night approached, Lin Fan finally awoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: The Scheming Female Anchor, Fails Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123: The Scheming Female Anchor, Fails Again
Nie Qiao’er was relatively low-key. Although she was a wealthy heiress, she drove an inexpensive car, just a Toyota Corolla worth about two hundred thousand.
Originally, her billionaire father wanted to buy her a supercar, but Nie Qiao’er refused. She came out to pursue her music dreams, so she didn’t care about material things. If her father hadn’t rented the apartment at Tangchen Yipin for her without telling her, she wouldn’t have lived there.
Of course, she now wanted to thank her father’s decision. If she hadn’t come to Tangchen Yipin to live, she wouldn’t have met her landlord brother, and wouldn’t have had that new song that became an overnight hit.
And she wouldn’t have signed with Wind Bird Music at lightning speed!
Her destiny changed overnight. Her originally unattainable dream was now within reach, all thanks to Lin Fan!
Without Lin Fan, she wouldn’t be standing in the spotlight right now.
Today, she completed her contract with Wind Bird, officially becoming a contracted singer under Wind Bird!
She was ecstatic, like a dream, she couldn’t believe it was real. Even when she returned to Tangchen Yipin, she still felt dreamy.
Lin Fan’s identity as a "Song God from the People" was exposed, and she saw it too. Lin Fan’s popularity instantly surpassed hers.
Nie Qiao’er was shocked. She also loved the song "Fireworks Easily Cold," and it turned out to be sung by Lin Fan!
What kind of immortal is this landlord brother? He must be an angel sent by heaven!
At this moment, Nie Qiao’er really wanted to see Lin Fan, she already missed him after only half a day without seeing him.
"What should I do? My heart has already flown to the landlord brother." Nie Qiao’er’s face flushed, eager to know where Lin Fan was.
She parked the car, just got out, planning to call Lin Fan.
She looked up and saw Zheng Miaomiao appear across from her.
Zheng Miaomiao had a smile on her face, but her eyes betrayed her; she seemed unfriendly.
"Miao Miao, what a coincidence, we met in the morning, and now we’re meeting again." Nie Qiao’er smiled and greeted proactively.
Zheng Miaomiao smiled sweetly, "It is a coincidence, Qiao’er sister, didn’t expect there to be a big pop star living in our building. Congratulations on signing with Wind Bird."
Nie Qiao’er said, "Thank you, so you knew too."
Zheng Miaomiao said, "It’s all over the internet, I couldn’t not know, and our landlord is also famous now."
Nie Qiao’er laughed, "The landlord brother is even more famous than I am."
Landlord brother!
That title really made people angry. Zheng Miaomiao felt a surge of jealousy. Nie Qiao’er was calling Lin Fan so warmly, could it be their relationship wasn’t simple?
How is that possible!
It was clear Lin Fan liked her, Zheng Miaomiao!
"Qiao’er, why didn’t you tell me this morning that your new song was written with the help of the landlord little brother?" Zheng Miaomiao said.
Nie Qiao’er said, "I intended to tell you, but as soon as I mentioned the landlord brother, you started criticizing him, and I just forgot to say it."
Zheng Miaomiao recalled that in the morning she indeed criticized Lin Fan to Nie Qiao’er and even told Nie Qiao’er that Lin Fan didn’t like women.
Zheng Miaomiao was speechless, it turned out she was to blame.
"Why did he help you write the song? What is your relationship? People online are guessing that you are a couple," Zheng Miaomiao asked, this was the question she was most concerned about.
Nie Qiao’er, who had little scheming, laughed at the words: "Don’t listen to the random talk of netizens, how could they know? Actually, the landlord brother came over yesterday to greet, I invited the landlord brother for a simple meal. The landlord brother unintentionally saw the draft of my new song and helped me revise it. Because I liked it so much, I recorded and uploaded it online, unexpectedly it went viral overnight."
Zheng Miaomiao was stunned: "Just like that? You’re really not a couple with the landlord little brother?"
Nie Qiao’er’s face turned red: "We only met yesterday, how could we be a couple, I do want to... cough cough, that... didn’t you say the landlord brother didn’t like women?"
Zheng Miaomiao sneered internally, seeing Nie Qiao’er’s appearance, she undoubtedly liked Lin Fan. She turned her eyes and said, "It’s true, he doesn’t like women, you must not have any thoughts about him, or you’ll only bring trouble to yourself."
"Oh." Nie Qiao’er indeed looked a little disappointed.
Zheng Miaomiao was secretly pleased, as long as Nie Qiao’er thought Lin Fan didn’t like women, she wouldn’t pursue him.
Even if Nie Qiao’er found out the truth later, Lin Fan would already belong to her by then.
Nie Qiao’er didn’t know that Zheng Miaomiao was a cunning person, successfully fooled by Zheng Miaomiao, she gave up the idea of calling Lin Fan.
"Enough, I’m going home." Nie Qiao’er said somewhat downhearted.
Zheng Miaomiao smiled, "Mm, go back."
Nie Qiao’er saw Zheng Miaomiao didn’t seem to intend to leave, curiously asked, "Miao Miao, why aren’t you leaving, what are you doing here?"
Zheng Miaomiao was secretly delighted, Lin Fan’s car was parked nearby. It seemed Nie Qiao’er didn’t know this was Lin Fan’s car. Apparently, Nie Qiao’er was telling the truth when she said she only met Lin Fan yesterday. Otherwise, how could she not recognize Lin Fan’s car?
"I have something else to do, I’ll go up later," Zheng Miaomiao said.
Nie Qiao’er didn’t suspect and went to press the elevator, planning to go up.
Only to see the elevator was descending!
Soon, the elevator stopped at the garage level, and when the doors opened, Lin Fan was inside!
Their eyes met.
Both of them were taken aback for a moment.
Nie Qiao’er was thrilled: "Landlord bro, I didn’t expect to see you here too!"
Lin Fan also smiled: "What a coincidence."
With that, Lin Fan stepped out, and saw that Zheng Miaomiao was also there, but he ignored Zheng Miaomiao and turned his attention back to Nie Qiao’er.
Nie Qiao’er said with delight, "Landlord bro, have you moved here? That would be great, we would be neighbors."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Not yet, just here for a nap."
"Alright." Nie Qiao’er said, hoping the landlord would move here soon, so she could see him often and ask him for advice on music.
Lin Fan asked, "Have you settled your contract with Wind Bird?"
Nie Qiao’er smiled and said, "Landlord bro, you probably don’t follow Weibo, but I’ve signed with Wind Bird, thanks to your recommendation. Director Xu was very easygoing, and the terms were quite satisfactory to me."
Lin Fan said, "That’s good."
With his influence, Xu Cheng wouldn’t dare mistreat Nie Qiao’er. The Big Boss’s reputation from Tianxue Entertainment can’t be overlooked.
At this moment, Zheng Miaomiao’s expression turned ugly.
What?
Nie Qiao’er signed with Wind Bird because of Lin Fan’s recommendation?
It made her green with envy!
Why wasn’t it her?
Nie Qiao’er laughed and said, "By the way, Landlord bro, you’ve also gone viral. You’re actually that legendary Song God!"
Nie Qiao’er looked with admiration.
Lin Fan was startled, what? He’s trending again.
He quickly took out his phone to check and, sure enough, Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream was recorded by someone. His singing of "Fireworks Easily Cold" was exposed.
The internet was buzzing with excitement as countless female netizens declared themselves fans.
Lin Fan, however, could only smile wryly; being too talented was truly a problem. What if he becomes famous worldwide? There’s no escaping fans anywhere, no freedom at all.
Just like when he used to deliver food, fans recognized him, and he couldn’t even deliver food properly. The biggest issue was being too popular.
Lin Fan looked at Zheng Miaomiao and chuckled, "Thanks to you."
If it weren’t for Zheng Miaomiao’s livestream, his identity wouldn’t have been exposed so quickly.
Zheng Miaomiao thought Lin Fan was praising her, so she quickly took credit: "No need to thank me, Landlord bro. I uploaded the recording myself."
Lin Fan’s fame was partly due to her efforts; Lin Fan should love her even more now!
Zheng Miaomiao secretly rejoiced, then said to Nie Qiao’er, "Qiao’er, don’t you need to go up? You go first, I have something to discuss with Landlord bro."
Nie Qiao’er replied, "Alright, I’ll head up first. Landlord bro, why don’t you come over for dinner later?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan recalled the cola chicken wings from yesterday and shuddered.
"No, I’m not free tonight, you go ahead." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Zheng Miaomiao was a little displeased. Why hasn’t Nie Qiao’er left yet? And she dared to invite Lin Fan for dinner, how audacious. Luckily, Lin Fan declined!
Nie Qiao’er said, "Actually, I wanted to discuss music with you. If you’re free, you can come over in the evening, or even late at night."
Going to her place late at night? Lin Fan couldn’t help but smile and said, "Aren’t you afraid of what people might say?"
Nie Qiao’er giggled and said, "Fear what? Miaomiao said you don’t like women."
Just then, the elevator doors closed and Nie Qiao’er went upstairs.
Lin Fan’s heart sank, and he turned to Zheng Miaomiao: "Did you tell Qiao’er that I don’t like women?"
This was awkward.
Zheng Miaomiao grinned sheepishly and said, "Well, it was all a misunderstanding."
Lin Fan sneered, "Zheng Miaomiao, it seems like your 3-day streaming ban wasn’t enough, how about I extend it for another month?"
Upon hearing this, Zheng Miaomiao’s face changed, surprised and said, "How did you know I was banned for 3 days?"
Lin Fan said, "Of course I know, because I requested it."
"What?" Zheng Miaomiao was shocked, blurting out, "You’re the Low-Key Tycoon?"
Oh my, is Lin Fan really the second-largest shareholder in Teasing Whiskers?

chapters.title: Chapter 124: This Dress Can’t Possibly Be Worth 1 Billion
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124: This Dress Can’t Possibly Be Worth 1 Billion
Lin Fan is the ’Low-Key Tycoon,’ the second largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers?
Zheng Miaomiao was stunned.
What kind of concept is this!
Just who is this landlord of hers? He owns an entire building of Tangchen Yipin, has a billion-dollar net worth, is the major shareholder of Teasing Whiskers, and is a musical genius?
How can one person have so many amazing attributes all at once?
Lin Fan didn’t bother with Zheng Miaomiao; he simply walked over, got into the Kosak, and drove away.
"Landlord darling, listen to my explanation."
Zheng Miaomiao snapped out of it and hurriedly chased after him, but Lin Fan was already gone.
Zheng Miaomiao was anxious; if Lin Fan really banned her for a month, the loss would be catastrophic; she’d cry to death.
Jindu Grand Hotel.
A charity gala was about to take place here.
Before 7 o’clock, the hotel parking lot was already packed with luxury cars. Besides inviting various tycoons, it’s said that some celebrities would also attend this gala.
The hotel entrance was laid with red carpet, and on both sides, journalists were taking photos. Stylishly dressed guests and glamorously dressed actresses paraded down the red carpet as camera flashes kept flickering, enveloping the venue in an air of the high aristocracy.
Generally speaking, attendees of the charity gala come not primarily for charity, but to show off wealth, get in the spotlight, and socialize; that’s the real intention.
Under the seemingly harmonious atmosphere, there was a lot of competition.
Face competition: if a businessman has an actress by their side, it naturally boosts face value, especially if their status is high.
Appearance competition: this mostly happened among women, seeing whose makeup and dressing stood out, overshadowing others.
Wealth competition: usually evident in the businessmen’s outfits and cars. An expensive suit or luxury car is an important weapon.
Businessmen are quite willing to invest in rides—Rolls-Royce, Lamborghini, Ferrari... the competition is equally matched.
Businessmen secretly competed, while outwardly complimenting each other.
"Old Chen, you got a new car again, huh? I heard this Bentley costs 3 million?"
"Heh, heh, how could it compare to your Mercedes S-class, it must be the highest spec, right?"
"Just joking, I don’t really know cars; it’s only thanks to heaven, the Company profited last year, so I picked the most expensive one, merely over 3 million or so."
"When it comes to enjoying life, Old Li’s the champ, getting into supercars; that’s a youthful mindset!"
"No, no, I don’t understand cars, my son bought it, said it’s a 5 million Ferrari, drives okay."
The wealthy bantered, simultaneously complimenting others and boasting a bit.
However, when Lin Fan’s supercar roared in, everyone quieted down, stunned, looking at the attention-grabbing Kosak.
Only 3 exist worldwide.
A top-tier supercar valued at an astonishing 70 million!
It crushed the whole scene upon its arrival.
The previous wealth flaunting became a childish joke in front of this flashy luxury car.
This car immediately triggered screams from the women.
These women, always mingling in the fame circle, actresses, or socialites, could all feel the aura this luxury car exuded.
The scent of money.
Precisely her favorite aroma.
The men fell silent, looking slightly awkward.
Who on earth could it be, driving such an extravagant supercar?
Inside the Kosak.
Lin Fan parked but didn’t get out right away; instead, he called Anna.
"Has my suit been delivered?" Lin Fan asked.
Anna replied, "It’s on the way. Since it’s tailored, there was a bit of a delay, please wait a moment."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, call me when it arrives. I’ll head inside and use the restroom first."
He rushed out without visiting the restroom before.
After hanging up, Lin Fan opened the car door.
Both car doors of the Kosak opened like sci-fi wings, full of futurism.
Lin Fan promptly stepped out, lightly pressed the key, and closed the car door.
Everyone exchanged glances.
The young man emerging from the car was in head-to-toe knock-offs!
"Tch, thought it would be some big shot, turns out it’s just a driver!"
"He must be here picking up his boss, right? Wonder who his boss is?"
"His boss must be impressive, but he’s just a pathetic broke driver."
Everyone shot Lin Fan contemptuous looks.
Because of Lin Fan’s attire, they assumed he was merely a chauffeur, a lackey for some wealthy person.
Lin Fan was in a rush to use the restroom, he didn’t have time for others, hurriedly making his way across the red carpet, and with his street-market outfit, photographers on both sides dodged him in time, naturally, no one took photos of him.
However, a female celebrity, busy striking various poses for photos, almost collided with Lin Fan while searching for the camera angle.
If they indeed collided, both might tumble over, resulting in a chaotic scene.
Fortunately, Lin Fan reacted quickly, side-stepping to dodge, but couldn’t avoid stepping on the train of the actress’s floor-length gown.
Leaving a prominent shoe print.
Lin Fan immediately said, "Sorry."
Although it was both their faults, the actress bore more responsibility, however, Lin Fan, as the man who stepped on the other’s dress, took the initiative to apologize.
But this C-list actress’s temper wasn’t small at all.
She immediately started scolding like mad, "How do you walk, no eyes? Didn’t see I was taking pictures? You stepped on my dress and stained it!"
Lin Fan apologized, "Really sorry, I apologize again. How much was your dress? I’ll pay you double the amount."
The actress looked at Lin Fan disdainfully, seeing his outfit!
"You compensate? You broke-ass, can you afford it? This dress is worth more than a year’s salary for you!" The actress jeered.
The crowd chuckled, enjoying the spectacle.
This broken-looking guy indeed didn’t seem capable of paying up; overlooking the poor was a favorite scene among the wealthy.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Impossible."
The actress squinted her eyes, "What do you mean impossible?"
Lin Fan calmly said, "Your dress can’t possibly be worth 100 million?"
The actress claimed her dress was worth more than his annual salary, but his annual salary was calculated in billions, and saying 100 million was quite modest. In reality, it’s trillions.
Of course, this dress couldn’t be more than his annual income.
What?
Everyone was stunned, this street-market dressed guy, annual income 100 million?
Impossible!
The actress, naturally disbelieving, thought Lin Fan was bragging, sneering, "A broke man with delusions! I can’t be bothered arguing with a pauper like you. Kneel and wipe my dress clean, and I’ll let it slide."
Lin Fan smiled, "Are you sure, you want me to kneel?"
The actress arrogantly said, "Yes, right now, immediately kneel for me, understand?"
Everyone was waiting to see Lin Fan embarrassed.
At that moment, a neatly dressed middle-aged man hurried out.
Many recognized him—it was Li He, the general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel!
It seemed this commotion had alarmed Li He, drawing him out to handle it personally.
The crowd felt this was even more exciting. Li He certainly wouldn’t go easy on this broke-looking guy.
However!
Li He quickly approached Lin Fan, deeply bowing, "Mr. Lin, I didn’t know you had arrived. I’m sorry for not welcoming you from afar."
Lin Fan smiled, "I was just about to call you. I ran into a bit of trouble here."
Li He smiled awkwardly, "I’ve seen it all, so I hurried over. Sorry about this unpleasant incident."
Lin Fan said, "I need to use the restroom urgently, you handle this person."
"Alright," Li He replied.
Lin Fan then casually went inside.
Li He turned to the actress, his expression instantly turning cold, "Miss, I will compensate you for your dress, but please leave now, you can’t go further."
The actress was dumbfounded.
Everyone was dumbfounded, what was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Master, Your Suit Has Arrived
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125: Master, Your Suit Has Arrived
Everyone thought Li He would drive Lin Fan away, but instead, Li He treated Lin Fan with utmost respect!
The one being kicked out was this arrogant minor celebrity.
Everyone looked at each other, utterly confused about what just happened.
The female star was dumbfounded too: "Did I hear you wrong? You want to kick me out, why?"
Li He’s face darkened: "You’ve offended someone you shouldn’t. As the person in charge of Jindu Hotel, I have the authority to ask you to leave."
The female star said, "Who did I offend, that pauper just now?"
Li He sneered: "Pauper? You mean the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group is a pauper?"
"What?"
Everyone was shocked.
The second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group?
The guy dressed in cheap clothes just now?
Is this real!
The female star was already pale with fear, damn it, who would have known that guy dressed so shabbily was the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group, boohoo, it’s just awful, clearly a rich guy, why pretend to be poor!
Li He said, "If you refuse to leave, I’ll have to call the security guard to escort you out."
The female star hurriedly said: "No need, I’ll leave, I’m leaving right now!"
The female star tucked her tail between her legs and left sheepishly, having caused trouble on someone else’s turf, offended the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group, and provoked the hotel’s general manager to personally intervene, she dared not stay!
After sending off the female star, Li He discreetly wiped off some cold sweat, thankfully he was nearby and could resolve the issue in time.
It wouldn’t be good to displease Mr. Lin.
The day Lin Fan obtained 30% of Golden Capital Group’s shares, becoming the second largest shareholder, the group’s chairman Tang Jinhong, out of caution, assigned Li He as Lin Fan’s assistant to both serve him well and probe into Lin Fan’s background.
Over the past few days, through his investigation, Li He learned more and more about Lin Fan, and precisely because of this, he respected Lin Fan even more than before.
This Mr. Lin, turns out to be not just the second largest shareholder of their Golden Capital Group...
At this moment, everyone around grew curious about Lin Fan’s identity; such a young man being the second largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group was utterly astonishing!
What exactly is this guy’s background?
Lin Fan had already entered Jindu Grand Hotel, headed to the restroom, saw an empty stall, and rushed in.
Lin Fan smiled wryly, no choice, yesterday he ate Nie Qiao’er’s infamous cooking, and he hasn’t completely recovered, still feeling a bit uncomfortable.
Lin Fan swore never to eat Nie Qiao’er’s cooking again, this beautiful woman’s cooking was downright lethal.
Soon, Lin Fan received a message from Nie Qiao’er.
"Dear landlord, tonight I’ve cooked Coca-Cola chicken wings again, you said you liked them, I’ve saved some for you, come over to eat tonight."
Attached to this message was a jet-black photo.
Clearly, another dark cuisine disaster.
Lin Fan chuckled ruefully, girl, spare me, please.
Lin Fan quickly replied: "I probably won’t go back to Tangchen Yipin tonight, you can eat by yourself, no need to save me any."
Nie Qiao’er sent a disappointed emoticon: "Alright then, landlord won’t get to enjoy this."
Lin Fan was both amused and frustrated, thinking: "Yeah, thanks a lot."
Suddenly, he heard footsteps outside, someone talking on the phone while entering the restroom, occupying the stall next to Lin Fan.
"Darling, don’t be mad, I’m not saying I won’t buy it for you, just that I don’t have that much money at the moment..."
A man’s voice, low and apologetic, came through.
"What, break up? Just because I can’t buy that diamond necklace right now?"
"I’m not lying to you, that diamond necklace is worth a million, it’s normal I can’t afford it right now."
"Can we not break up? I’ll have money soon."
"Seriously, at tonight’s charity gala, many wealthy people and celebrities are attending, we’ll surely collect a lot of money, then I’ll have money to buy it for you."
"Hehe, baby, don’t worry, I have my ways to handle this fund, it won’t be a problem."
"Be good, tonight wait for me to come back, don’t mention breaking up again..."
The man gently comforted his lover.
In the adjacent stall, Lin Fan frowned as he seemed to have accidentally overheard something incredible!
This guy plans to use the donated charity funds to buy his lover a diamond necklace?
Isn’t charity money supposed to help those in need, doing this is akin to stealing money!
The man was busy soothing his lover and hadn’t noticed Lin Fan next door, Lin Fan also temporarily wanted to keep quiet, and only came out of the restroom after the man had left.
Immediately after, Lin Fan received a call from Anna, she had already arrived.
Outside Jindu Grand Hotel.
The red carpet was as dazzling as ever, female stars and socialites competed under the flashing lights, none willing to be outdone, all vying to be the standout among beauties.
Some starlets even refused to leave the red carpet just to grab more attention.
In the midst of this bustling beauty contest.
The roaring sound of a motorcycle engine was heard, and a slick-looking motorcycle zoomed in like lightning.
The rider was a woman in black, with long straight black hair, exceptionally beautiful features, a cool and aloof demeanor, and strikingly gallant poses, overflowing with the aura of a true dominatrix.
Coupled with being atop the sleek motorcycle, it was simply too cool.
The arrival of this black-haired beauty immediately attracted everyone’s attention.
Men were transfixed, while women were stunned.
A multitude of flashlights enchantedly abandoned the mediocre crowd, focusing all on this black-haired beauty.
This was truly what it meant to stand out among all the beauties!
"Wow, she’s so gorgeous!"
"True dominatrix, this is what a real dominatrix is, she’s so cool!"
"I’m a woman and even my legs are going weak."
"Oh my, who is she, some wealthy heiress, a rich housewife, or a female star?"
"Though I don’t know who she is, she’s undeniably unmatched!"
This black-haired beauty was indeed Anna.
With Anna’s powerful aura, everyone on site couldn’t compare, easily overshadowed.
However, the stronger one is, the less they care about competing, Anna didn’t even think about outshining others or competing in beauty; she was simply here to deliver clothes to Lin Fan.
Suddenly faced with so many flashing lights, Anna frowned but didn’t pay much attention, she grabbed a brand-new suit from the back seat and headed into Jindu Grand Hotel.
She had already contacted Lin Fan earlier, and Lin Fan said he was inside the hotel and asked Anna to come in.
"Ah, what she’s holding seems to be a KITTEN suit, a world-class luxury brand!"
"Custom-made KITTEN suit, worth over a million, my gosh, who’s so luxurious!"
"Probably her husband’s, she might be some noble daughter-in-law?"
Just as Anna reached the hotel entrance, she saw Lin Fan coming to meet her.
Jindu Hotel is quite big; Lin Fan was worried Anna might not find him, so he came out to meet her.
Anna saw Lin Fan and walked straight to him, respectfully saying: "Master, I’ve brought your suit."
Master...
Everyone was utterly stunned.
"Holy crap!"
They speculated Anna was a wealthy socialite, an heiress, a noble daughter-in-law, yet never imagined Anna was merely Lin Fan’s servant?

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Suit Appearance, Handsome Domination Over Famous Movie Star
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 126: Suit Appearance, Handsome Domination Over Famous Movie Star
Under the surprised gazes of the crowd, Anna followed Lin Fan into the hotel.
Anna, whose presence overshadowed all the other female celebrities and socialites, was actually just Lin Fan’s servant?
This made the women present uncomfortable, as it implied that they were even less than someone’s servant.
Lin Fan needed to change clothes, and Li He quickly arranged a room for him.
At the door of the room, Lin Fan took the suit from Anna’s hands and said, "It’s my first time at an event like this, stay with me."
Anna nodded faintly.
Rather than saying she was the housekeeper of Yunding Manor, it would be more accurate to say she was Lin Fan’s personal assistant.
But this was what she was happy to do—having more contact with Lin Fan, doing more things for him, she could gradually win his trust.
"First time at a charity gala, it seems he really was a poor loser before. If not for Lin Beixuan, he couldn’t possibly have become wealthy overnight." Anna thought secretly.
A few minutes later.
The door opened, and Lin Fan, having changed out of his cheap clothes and into an internationally top-brand suit, walked out.
Anna was stunned, and her eyes involuntarily fixed on Lin Fan.
Oh my, too handsome!
Clothes make the man, and money adorns the monk. Even in cheap clothes, Lin Fan exuded charm, but in this custom suit worth millions, he was unbelievably dashing, his allure off the charts.
Always ice-cold Anna felt her heart race, a blush suddenly appearing on her cheeks.
Can’t keep looking.
Anna quickly lowered her head to avoid further losing composure.
Lin Fan himself didn’t feel much—he thought he looked handsome in anything.
"Anna, help me with the tie, I can’t do this," Lin Fan said, handing a tie to Anna.
"Okay."
Anna responded, taking the tie and stepping in front of Lin Fan to tie it for him.
This was a rare close proximity for the two, almost ambiguously so—Lin Fan could smell Anna’s perfume, a subtle, elegant scent.
If only this woman wasn’t a spy sent by Shen Wanshan... but, I’ll tame you eventually...
Lin Fan thought to himself. Taming Anna wasn’t just a system task; it was something he personally wanted to do.
"Look up," Lin Fan suddenly said.
Anna, being a head shorter, instinctively looked up at him when she heard that.
Lin Fan smiled, "Why’s your face red?"
Anna lowered her head, biting her lips, "It’s none of your business."
Lin Fan added, "You look so beautiful when you blush."
Anna remained silent, but her heart couldn’t stop racing.
This close, she could even hear Lin Fan’s heartbeat, the masculine charm almost irresistible, making her want to fall into his arms.
Damn it! How could I be attracted to this man!
Anna took a deep breath to calm herself, quickly tied Lin Fan’s tie, and retreated a few steps.
Being too close to this man was dangerous; his charm was truly overwhelming, but fortunately, she wasn’t an ordinary person.
"It’s about time, Mr. Lin should go in now," Anna glanced at her watch and said.
Lin Fan nodded, took a few steps, then stopped, turned to Anna and said, "Even when there’s no one around, you should call me master."
In the presence of others, Anna would usually call Lin Fan "master," but when no one was around, she typically addressed him as "Mr. Lin."
Anna wasn’t sure if Lin Fan was just showing off or had another motive, so she bit her lips and said, "Oh, got it, master."
Third floor of Jindu Hotel.
The charity gala was being held here that night; the scene was elegantly arranged, with a red carpet on the floor.
Guests were already entering one after another; standing on either side of the entrance were men in suits maintaining order.
There was a signature wall beside them; guests would sign and take pictures before entering.
Below the signature wall stood a man and a woman—the man in a branded suit, tall and handsome, the woman in a glamorous evening gown—a celebrity couple, the actress in her forties but maintaining an exceptional, radiant beauty.
They signed their names on the wall; the man was named Xue Wenhe, and the woman named Yao Bingyi.
Flashes continually went off, photographing them.
Some wealthy individuals and young actresses proactively went to greet them. By the looks of it, this couple were quite important figures.
"Brother He is so handsome, the ageless male god!"
"Brother He’s suit looks so high-class, must be several hundred thousand!"
"Sister Bingyi looks stunning today, truly radiant."
"They really are the model couple of the entertainment circle."
The two of them were pleased with the compliments of others; given their status in the entertainment industry, it was to be expected.
As they were enjoying the spotlight and the crowd’s adulation, suddenly they realized the atmosphere around them had quieted down.
Everyone’s gazes had turned towards a single direction.
The couple followed the crowd’s gaze and were taken aback.
There, a young man in a suit, arm-in-arm with a tall woman with long straight black hair, was approaching.
The young man was incredibly handsome, his body adorned with a custom suit from a top international brand—perfectly fitting, breathtakingly dashing. The woman, with a strong aura and an exceptionally beautiful face, matched with him perfectly—a combination with a magnetic allure.
It was, of course, Lin Fan and Anna.
Their entrance instantly drew the eyes of the entire crowd.
Those who had been praising the celebrity couple now seemed to have forgotten about them, and the photographers around also abandoned the couple, beginning to pursue Lin Fan and Anna.
"Oh my! So handsome and beautiful, can anyone be this good-looking in real life?"
"They’re a celestial couple!"
"Wow, what a tasteful pair! The man’s suit is from Italy’s top suit brand, Kiton, and starts at a million for custom pieces!"
"Who are they? So attractive and clearly wealthy!"
The crowd buzzed with exclamations.
With just their looks, Lin Fan and Anna dominated the scene.
The celebrity couple, Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi, felt a bit annoyed, as they had been the focus until this duo came and stole their spotlight!
"Who are they?" Xue Wenhe asked with a dark expression.
He was confident in his looks, and given his status, he was always at the center of attention. He was the dream man for countless young women. It was the first time his spotlight had been stolen like this.
Yao Bingyi shook her head, "I don’t know, never seen them before."
Xue Wenhe sneered, "Never seen them, then they’re insignificant."
The couple had wide connections; they knew almost all the wealthy in Yun City, who could be offended and who were irrelevant—they had it all figured out.
Lin Fan and Anna hadn’t been seen before, which only meant they had no name in high society!
Yao Bingyi held the same thought, chuckling, "Probably some nouveau riche’s son. Besides suddenly gaining some wealth, they’re nothing."
Lin Fan hadn’t expected that simply changing into a suit would garner such different treatment compared to when he was wearing cheap clothes.
When he wore cheap clothes, no one paid attention to him; now he was the center of admiration. It seemed upper society truly revolved around money.
Suddenly, Lin Fan noticed Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi, and made a sound of surprise—this couple were movie stars who had apparently won international film awards, quite famous.
This was probably the biggest celebrities Lin Fan had ever seen in person till now.
Not being too familiar with the entertainment industry, and unsure of his recognition, Lin Fan decided not to overthink it and planned to walk past the couple.
"Humph, do young people these days not understand first come, first served?" Yao Bingyi suddenly scoffed heavily.
This statement was clearly directed at Lin Fan, expressing her discontent.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Identity Revealed, Complete Silence
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127: Identity Revealed, Complete Silence
Lin Fan stopped in his tracks; he genuinely wasn’t aware that he’d entered through the wrong door. With so many people at the entrance, everyone was coming and going freely, and there was no rule about who couldn’t go in first.
However, Lin Fan wasn’t a petty person. Ultimately, he stepped aside and said, "Sorry, please go ahead."
The couple originally intended to make things difficult for Lin Fan, but his politeness left them unable to find fault immediately.
The couple was just about to go in.
Suddenly, Lin Fan said, "You both look familiar, but I can’t recall at the moment. Are you Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi?"
Upon hearing this, the couple immediately felt offended!
With their fame, this guy dared to be unsure if it was them, as if he needed to ask!
Xue Wenhe chuckled, "Yes, that’s us."
Yao Bingyi, with a cold face, said, "Are you a fan of ours? Want an autograph? Sorry, I didn’t bring a pen."
Yet, she was clearly holding an autograph pen in her hand.
Lin Fan frowned slightly. This couple had quite the temperament; he probably hadn’t offended them, right? Could this be the airs of a big star?
Lin Fan suddenly disliked the two a lot more. So what if you’re a celebrity, so what if you’re famous, we’re all human, there’s no need to be so overbearing.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No worries, you just look familiar to me, I asked casually, didn’t plan on asking for an autograph."
Hearing this, Yao Bingyi became even more displeased.
"You punk, what are you putting on airs for, just asking casually? Not recognizing us, trying to come off as impressive, aren’t you?" Yao Bingyi snorted coldly.
Lin Fan sighed, "Sorry, just pretend I didn’t ask."
Xue Wenhe chuckled, "Kid, let me tell you this, it’s not that we’re full of ourselves, but with the fame we have, there are hardly any people who don’t recognize us. But you, who knows you? Who are you?"
Yao Bingyi sarcastically added, "This charity banquet isn’t for nobodies. You weren’t uninvited, were you? Trying to crash your way in?"
Upon hearing this, the people around couldn’t help but giggle.
Indeed, judging by status and reputation, Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi were quite famous, while Lin Fan seemed like just a nobody.
In this vanity fair, good looks and money are a plus, but respect truly comes from status and identity, since resources are in the hands of the top dogs.
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi decided to give Lin Fan a hard time because he had stolen their spotlight.
Using their status to suppress Lin Fan was undoubtedly the most effective way.
How could a nobody in high society compare to them?
Just as the couple looked down at Lin Fan with a superior air...
The general manager of Jindu Grand Hotel, Li He, suddenly walked over quickly.
Seeing this, Yao Bingyi said, "Manager Li, you’re here just in time. Those attending this charity banquet are people with status like us. I’m suspicious this person might be trying to sneak in. Can you check his identity!"
But Li He cast a glance at Yao Bingyi as if looking at someone insane and ignored her, walking directly to Lin Fan.
Bowed.
"Mr. Lin, I was worried you might have trouble getting in without an invitation, so I came to let you know." Li He said respectfully.
Even though Yao Bingyi was a star, in Li He’s eyes, no star was more important than Lin Fan. Moreover, as the manager of Jindu Grand Hotel, he had no reason to be polite to celebrity guests.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you for that."
Manager Li then gestured to the two men in suits at the entrance, indicating they should not obstruct Lin Fan.
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi exchanged glances, what’s going on here?
Why is Manager Li being so courteous to this guy?
Yao Bingyi couldn’t help but ask, "Manager Li, who is he?"
Only then did Li He turn around and said calmly, "Miss Yao, please watch your words, this is our Golden Capital Group’s second-largest shareholder, Mr. Lin Fan."
"What?"
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi’s expressions immediately changed.
Oh my god!
This guy is actually the second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group?
The surrounding people were also stunned.
Previously, during the red carpet at the entrance, Li He had personally welcomed Lin Fan and revealed his identity, but the people present now were obviously a different crowd.
The Xue Wenhe couple had arrived later, with no insight into this. If they had known early on that Lin Fan was the second-largest shareholder of Jindu, they wouldn’t have dared to treat him so offhandedly.
The second-largest shareholder of Jindu, this is a billionaire indeed, definitely not the nouveau riche they assumed.
However, their shock was only just beginning.
Suddenly, three men in business suits walked over, going straight to Lin Fan.
The man at the front was none other than Jin Hesheng, the big boss of Xingquan Law Firm.
"Mr. Lin, you’re here too." Jin Hesheng greeted Lin Fan warmly, shaking his hand.
Lin Fan smiled, "Yes, Boss Jin is here too."
Jin Hesheng said, "Mr. Lin, when is a good time for you to visit the company? Ever since you became our third-largest shareholder, you haven’t been there, and everyone wants to meet you."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Alright, I’ll drop by when I have a chance."
They were so engaged in conversation that they didn’t notice everyone around was utterly dumbfounded.
What?
Lin Fan is the third-largest shareholder of Xingquan Law Firm?
What the hell!
Second-largest shareholder of Golden Capital Group, third-largest shareholder of Xingquan Law Firm!
Any one of these identities would be impressive on its own, let alone having both at the same time!
At this moment, another middle-aged man in a suit, accompanied by an assistant, approached.
He came up to Lin Fan and asked respectfully, "Are you Mr. Lin Fan?"
Everyone saw that this middle-aged man was Li Jianhua, the chairman of the largest livestream platform in the country, Teasing Whiskers Livestream!
Lin Fan replied, "I am Lin Fan, and you are?"
Li Jianhua eagerly extended his hand, "Pleasure to meet you, Mr. Lin, I’m Li Jianhua, chairman of Teasing Whiskers. It’s a honor to finally meet you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan nodded; turns out this was Li Jianhua. He had invited Lin Fan here today for a meeting.
Li Jianhua took a card from his assistant and handed it to Lin Fan, "First, congratulations, Mr. Lin, on joining Teasing Whiskers and becoming our second-largest shareholder. This is the company’s access card, please keep it safe."
"Alright." Lin Fan took the access card and casually handed it to Anna to keep.
Li Jianhua courteously suggested, "Mr. Lin, shall we go inside first and then have a chat?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Sure."
The surrounding people were already beyond shock, completely dumbfounded.
Oh my god, is this even real!
Lin Fan is also Teasing Whiskers’ second-largest shareholder!
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi were pale-faced; with each identity of Lin Fan uncovered, any one of them was enough to shake their family to its core, let alone having all three!
He’s a true god of wealth!
The way they behaved toward such a god of wealth earlier was indeed too disrespectful!
The couple was now full of regret.
But this wasn’t the end.
Another man in a suit walked over.
It was Du Tao, the president of Tianxue Entertainment!
Upon seeing Du Tao, both Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi lost a bit of composure. In the entertainment industry, it’s better to offend King Yama than Du Tao. That’s how influential Du Tao was.
The couple quickly went up to greet him, "Mr. Du, you’re here too?"
Yet, Du Tao seemed not to notice them, walking straight to Lin Fan.
He bent forward respectfully.
In a respectful tone, he said, "Big Boss, you’re here too. Why didn’t you let me know, so I could welcome you earlier?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "No worries, I’m just here to meet Mr. Li."
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi were so shocked their scalps tingled, unconsciously trembling.
Big Boss!
Du Tao actually called Lin Fan "Big Boss"!
Oh my god, Lin Fan is truly the big boss of Tianxue Entertainment?
The people around were all stunned, and silence descended all around.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Abandoned! The Consequences of Offending Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: Abandoned! The Consequences of Offending Lin Fan
Lin Fan’s identity was revealed one after another, shocking everyone in the room.
Especially the couple Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi, who turned pale with fear.
Lin Fan is actually the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment?
In the entertainment industry, there’s a saying: it’s better to offend King Yama than to offend Du Tao. Du Tao not only holds a high position but also has terrifying means.
Generally, Du Tao has a good temper and won’t get angry easily, but if you anger him, don’t expect to have a good time.
Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi, while significant figures in the film industry, always greeted Du Tao with bows and respect.
Imagine their shock when they found out that Lin Fan, whom they had just offended, was Du Tao’s boss.
"Mr. Lin, we’re sorry for not recognizing you. Please don’t hold it against us," Xue Wenhe quickly bowed and apologized to Lin Fan.
Yao Bingyi also bowed her head: "I’m sorry."
Lin Fan chuckled. He couldn’t stand people who judged others by appearances, who spoke arrogantly when they thought he was a nobody, only to apologize once his identity was revealed. If his identity hadn’t been revealed, do you think they would have apologized?
Lin Fan ignored the couple and said to Li Jianhua, "Chairman Li, let’s go inside and talk."
Li Jianhua quickly nodded. After learning that Lin Fan was the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, he felt a deep sense of awe.
He was also more apprehensive, knowing Tianxue Entertainment once had multiple shareholders, including major companies, but Lin Fan managed to absorb Tianxue!
Such skills were indescribably formidable.
If Lin Fan truly wanted to take over Teasing Whiskers Livestream, it might just be a matter of lifting his finger.
Seeing Lin Fan and Li Jianhua entering, Xue Wenhe and his wife were also very anxious.
Lin Fan only chuckled at their apology and said nothing, so they didn’t know whether he had forgiven them or was ignoring them.
The couple quickly approached Du Tao.
"Mr. Du, we’re really very sorry. Had we known Mr. Lin was the boss of Tianxue, we would never have dared to offend him," Yao Bingyi said.
Xue Wenhe added, "Please, Mr. Du, put in a good word for us with Mr. Lin, convey our apologies."
Du Tao chuckled and said, "Alright, I understand."
After saying that, he turned to leave.
Of all the people they could offend, they chose to offend the Big Boss. Isn’t that asking for trouble?
Too lazy to say more, he pulled out his phone and said calmly, "Hello, please help me check the movie Xue Wenhe and Yao Bingyi are negotiating, and inform the investors to drop them. Consider it a small lesson."
It wasn’t long.
Xue Wenhe and his wife received a call from a movie project group. Originally, they were set to be the lead actors, but now a decision had been made to change the leading roles.
The couple was nearly in tears.
No need to ask, this must be the consequence of offending Lin Fan!
In an instant, the couple regretted it deeply and probably won’t dare to look down on anyone ever again.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan and Li Jianhua entered the charity event site.
By now, the room was already filled with many people, all from the upper class: the wealthy, socialites, and actresses, holding champagne and chatting in groups. Coming to this charity gala, charity was secondary; networking was primary.
Waiters strolled among the guests with champagne.
Li Jianhua took two glasses of champagne and handed them to Lin Fan and Anna.
Li Jianhua was amazed by Anna’s aura.
"Mr. Lin, may I ask if this lady is your girlfriend or your wife?" Li Jianhua asked with a smile.
Anna rolled her eyes: "Don’t talk nonsense!"
Li Jianhua was startled, wow, this woman’s aura was too strong to handle.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Chairman Li, don’t misunderstand, she’s my housekeeper."
Housekeeper?
Li Jianhua broke into a cold sweat. Such a beautiful woman was merely Mr. Lin’s housekeeper.
"I’m sorry," Li Jianhua said, wiping his cold sweat.
Lin Fan said, "Chairman Li, let’s get straight to the point. Why did you invite me?"
This Li Jianhua seemed eager for a face-to-face conversation.
Li Jianhua hesitated for a moment, not knowing how to begin.
Lin Fan said, "Chairman Li, feel free to speak your mind."
Li Jianhua gritted his teeth and said, "Alright, Mr. Lin, you’ve acquired 30% of Teasing Whiskers’ shares, making you the second-largest shareholder. What are your plans?"
Lin Fan gave an "oh": "Plans, which aspect are you referring to, Chairman Li?"
Li Jianhua said, "I mean, do you have plans to further acquire Teasing Whiskers?"
Lin Fan understood what Li Jianhua meant. It seemed Li Jianhua was worried that he might further buy shares of Teasing Whiskers and strip him of the largest shareholder title.
Li Jianhua was truly overthinking. "Teasing Whiskers’ shares were system rewards. As for how the system did it, he didn’t know, so even if he wanted to continue acquiring Teasing Whiskers, it was likely not feasible.
Of course, these were not things he would discuss with Li Jianhua.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Rest assured, Chairman Li, I have no such plans. I invested in Teasing Whiskers because I see its potential and want to make money. I won’t touch the company’s operations; that’s entirely up to Chairman Li. I’m just waiting for my dividends."
Hearing this, Li Jianhua let out a long breath of relief, feeling as if a massive weight had been lifted from his heart.
With Lin Fan’s capacity, Lin Fan wouldn’t deceive him; if Lin Fan said he wouldn’t continue acquiring Teasing Whiskers, then he wouldn’t.
"Thank you, Mr. Lin," Li Jianhua said joyfully, sincerely grateful to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "Is this the only matter Chairman Li wanted to discuss with me?"
Li Jianhua replied, "Yes. By the way, Mr. Lin, do you plan to donate to the charity gala tonight?"
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan recalled overhearing something in the restroom and, after some thought, said, "I’m not donating."
Li Jianhua broke a sweat, finding Mr. Lin’s directness a bit overwhelming.
Lin Fan said, "I advise Chairman Li not to donate either, and as for why, you’ll know soon enough."
Li Jianhua was a bit curious, wondering what Lin Fan meant by that.
By this time, most of the guests had arrived, and the charity gala began.
The host took the stage, tapped on a glass to quiet everyone, and said, "Thank you all for attending. Our charity gala is officially starting. First, let’s welcome the organizer of this gala, Mr. He Dahong, to speak."
Applause thundered.
A middle-aged man in a suit and tie walked onto the stage, overweight and with slicked-back hair, looking slightly greasy.
The middle-aged man smiled and said, "I believe most of you here know me; I am He Dahong. I sincerely appreciate the support of new and old friends tonight. All the proceeds from tonight’s charity donations will be given to those in need in the mountainous areas. I hope everyone donates generously."
The crowd applauded again.
In the crowd, Lin Fan coldly watched this He Dahong. He Dahong’s voice was the same voice he heard in the restroom!

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Charity Auction, Playing with Yun City’s Wealthiest
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129: Charity Auction, Playing with Yun City’s Wealthiest
The charity gala’s organizer, He Dahong, delivered a speech, calling on those present to donate.
Objectively speaking, He Dahong is a veteran. His heartfelt words moved the wealthy attendees.
Of course, even without He Dahong’s speech, these wealthy individuals would donate. To them, donating a bit of money for a good reputation is very cost-effective. Whether they truly wish to help the poor, only they know.
For them, this money is a mere drop in the bucket, and once donated, they seldom pay further attention to it.
This often leads to donations’ destinations becoming a mystery, and no one investigates, which gives the receiving party considerable room to maneuver. One could say it’s deeply complicated.
Lin Fan previously didn’t understand these tactics, but unfortunately, tonight, he inadvertently overheard He Dahong’s conversation. He Dahong intended to use the donated funds to buy a diamond necklace for his lover!
If Lin Fan hadn’t become aware of this, he might have donated, but knowing this, the organizer can forget about getting a dime from him.
Once He Dahong finished speaking, he received thunderous applause.
The host seized the momentum and announced, "Without further ado, let’s begin tonight’s first segment, the charity auction! As President He said, the funds raised from the auction will be used for poverty relief in mountainous areas. The first auction item tonight is..."
Charity auction, as the name implies, is about raising funds through auctioning items, with the highest bidder winning.
Some rich young gentlemen spend money like water, buying luxury cars and boats without a blink. When they get bored, they either sell them or donate them to charity.
Charity organizations usually accept everything and then auction them to cash out.
In just over ten minutes, three items had already been successfully auctioned.
The atmosphere reached a peak.
"Next, we will auction a sailboat, donated by Mr. Chu Lin, the eldest son of the Chu Family, starting at 300,000, with increments of no less than 10,000," announced the host.
A sailboat, shown on the screen at the venue, appeared to be in about ninety percent new condition.
This type of sailboat, brand new, would be worth around a million.
Soon, someone bid, "310,000!"
"320,000!"
"330,000..."
Quickly, the price surged to 500,000.
With no further bids, it seemed the sailboat would be sold for 500,000.
"600,000!"
Suddenly, a voice exclaimed.
Everyone turned to look and saw a middle-aged man walk in.
"It’s Boss Feng!"
The newcomer was none other than Shengshi Group’s Feng Wanshan!
Although Feng Wanshan arrived late, his presence immediately attracted everyone’s attention, exuding wealth and power.
Lin Fan saw Feng Wanshan and was surprised; he didn’t expect this guy to be here.
Lin Fan glanced at Anna, who casually looked at Feng Wanshan then turned away.
Lin Fan smirked internally. Anna’s acting was quite good; she seemed like she didn’t know Feng Wanshan at all.
Feng Wanshan was also performing well; clearly seeing Lin Fan and Anna as he entered, he pretended not to notice them.
"I was just looking for a birthday gift for my nephew. Spending 600,000 on this boat should mean no one will contest me?" Feng Wanshan stated.
Feng Wanshan was considered the wealthiest man in Yun City, alongside He Chao, the president of Zhongtong Express, and Wang Hailin, the president of Yida Mall, known as the three giants of Yun City.
Today, He Chao and Wang Hailin weren’t present, making Feng Wanshan the sole bigwig, and nobody dared to compete with him.
Moreover, he mentioned it was a birthday gift, making it even less likely for anyone to challenge him.
"Boss Feng really is generous!"
"If Boss Feng likes it, it’s his."
"Who’d dare to compete with Boss Feng, wouldn’t you agree?"
Everybody laughed.
"700,000."
However, at that moment, a voice suddenly broke the silence.
The venue fell quiet, astonished looks directed towards the voice, which was a handsome young man.
Lin Fan!
Those who understood Lin Fan’s background became quiet as a mouse. Neither Feng Wanshan nor Lin Fan could be trifled with lightly.
Those unaware of Lin Fan’s identity exchanged puzzled looks; who was this young man challenging Feng Wanshan?
Anna glanced at Lin Fan, with a momentarily strange look in her eyes, that quickly faded away.
"Kid, are you trying to compete for this boat with me, didn’t you hear what I said?" Feng Wanshan glared at Lin Fan, his voice stern.
He instantly recognized Lin Fan, even without recognition, seeing Anna beside him made it clear this lad was definitely Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan was immediately displeased. Since the auction for Yunding Manor began, he had always lost to Lin Fan. Lin Fan snatched Yunding Manor away for 3 billion, bought Chiba Island first for 6 billion, and even grabbed the land of the Shendiao Old Factory before him.
He suspected that Lin Fan was his nemesis.
Unexpectedly, even for a small boat worth less than a million, Lin Fan wanted to snatch it from him!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’ve also taken a liking to this boat. I plan to give it to my housekeeper here."
Everyone looked at Anna.
My goodness, such a beautiful woman is actually just this kid’s housekeeper?
Anna was a bit surprised and couldn’t help but say, "Master, you..."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Since you joined, you’ve been quite capable. I was just wondering what to reward you with, so take this boat as a reward."
Anna: "..."
She didn’t know what to say for a moment.
But she felt a bit proud inside. Lin Fan giving her such an expensive reward indicated that he was very satisfied with her, which was exactly what she wanted to achieve.
She didn’t realize that thinking this played right into Lin Fan’s hands. This was exactly what Lin Fan wanted her to think.
Upon hearing this, everyone present was stunned by Lin Fan’s generosity.
To reward a servant with such an expensive sailboat, such largesse was beyond anyone here.
Lin Fan’s grandeur was even greater than that of Feng Wanshan. Feng Wanshan was giving it to a nephew, a family member, while Lin Fan was giving it to a servant. In comparison, Lin Fan naturally seemed more extravagant.
Feng Wanshan was conflicted. On one hand, Lin Fan giving the sailboat to Anna indicated that Anna had gained Lin Fan’s trust, which was worth celebrating. On the other hand, Lin Fan’s actions made him seem more generous, which displeased Feng Wanshan.
In front of so many people, if he lost to Lin Fan, how humiliating would it be for him, Feng Wanshan?
"Alright then, let’s compete fairly. I’ll offer 800,000!" said Feng Wanshan.
Lin Fan said calmly, "1 million."
Lin Fan found it amusing internally. He knew Feng Wanshan would definitely follow suit. He had just used a small trick to get both Feng Wanshan and Anna to play into his hands.
Feng Wanshan arrogantly yelled, "1.2 million!"
Everyone was shocked. 1.2 million was enough to buy a new boat!
"1.5 million." Lin Fan’s face remained calm, like still water.
Everyone was shocked once again.
This is crazy!
1.5 million for a second-hand boat, even though it’s for charity, it’s unnecessary!
Feng Wanshan was furious, as if he were back at the Yunding Manor auction again, where Zhang Dafu had nearly enraged him to death.
People fight for dignity like monks struggle for incense; this time, he absolutely couldn’t lose to Lin Fan!
"Boy, you really plan to compete with me?" Feng Wanshan asked in a deep voice.
Lin Fan said nothing, seemingly ignoring Feng Wanshan.
This infuriated Feng Wanshan further as he shouted, "2 million!"
A round of exclamations.
million, with a discount, could buy two new boats!
Lin Fan smiled and looked at Anna, "Do you think I should bid more?"
Anna shook her head.
Even she couldn’t bear to watch anymore. While she’s on Feng Wanshan’s side, no matter if he won or lost, Feng Wanshan wouldn’t benefit. He’d lose face if he lost, and lose money if he won.
Lin Fan then said loudly, "My housekeeper says she doesn’t like this boat anymore. Congratulations, Boss Feng, the boat is yours; your nephew will surely love this 2-million broken boat."
In the end, this boat was bought by Feng Wanshan for a high price of 2 million.
Upon hearing Lin Fan’s words, Feng Wanshan’s eyes blacked out. Damn, he felt like he got played by Lin Fan. It seemed like this kid deliberately drove up the price, making him spend money on nothing!
But he had no evidence and could only ponder this alone.
Everyone present thought that Feng Wanshan had taken a big loss this time. Buying a second-hand boat for 2 million was practically a laughing stock.
After auctioning a few more items, the charity bidding session ended. Lin Fan didn’t make another move; he was just toying with Feng Wanshan. As he said, this charity banquet would not get a penny from him.
After the auction, they moved into the free donation phase.
Feng Wanshan, wanting to appear generous, was the first to stand up: "I’ll donate 10 million!"
Then, Feng Wanshan looked at Lin Fan, "I wonder how much this young man plans to donate?"
This was clearly a challenge to Lin Fan, and everyone immediately looked at Lin Fan, waiting for his response.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: The Reason Lin Fan Didn’t Donate Money, The Audience Was Stunned!
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 130: The Reason Lin Fan Didn’t Donate Money, The Audience Was Stunned!
Feng Wanshan suffered a silent loss during the charity auction stage. On the surface, it looked like he won against Lin Fan, but in fact, he spent unnecessary money.
Although that little money was nothing to Feng Wanshan, he was still puzzled by being played by Lin Fan, thinking that he would make Lin Fan suffer no matter what.
So when it came to the free donation segment, Feng Wanshan took the lead, claiming that he would donate ten million!
Everyone present, although wealthy, mostly planned to donate tens of thousands or a couple of hundred thousand at most. A donation of a million was already considered generous, let alone ten million.
Feng Wanshan’s lavish ten-million donation shocked everyone.
How generous! No wonder he’s a business giant in Yun City!
"Boss Feng, you’re amazing!"
"That’s what you call filthy rich!"
"We are really nothing compared to him!"
The organizers were beaming with smiles. As the person in charge of this charity donation, Mr. He couldn’t help but almost laugh out loud.
"Boss Feng is truly generous and charitable. On behalf of the impoverished people in the mountain villages, I thank Boss Feng," Mr. He said solemnly, bowing.
In his heart, he was overjoyed. He really liked wealthy moguls like Feng Wanshan who spend lavishly; he could finally buy a diamond necklace for his lover.
Feng Wanshan was very pleased with everyone’s reaction. He wanted this effect, and he thoroughly enjoyed seeing everyone’s shocked faces.
Then, Feng Wanshan turned his gaze towards Lin Fan and said, "I wonder how much this young man is planning to donate?"
He had already donated 10 million, and if Lin Fan donated less, he would naturally be seen as lesser.
If Lin Fan wanted to grab the spotlight and donated more, then Lin Fan would need to fork out more than 10 million, which would also be Feng Wanshan’s revenge for the charity auction phase.
No matter what, Lin Fan couldn’t escape his calculation this time.
Feng Wanshan thought of this and felt a pang of pride.
He had suffered a lot under Lin Fan before, but this time he finally turned things around, right?
Everyone turned their eyes to Lin Fan in unison. Feng Wanshan was clearly challenging Lin Fan. How would Lin Fan respond?
Mr. He was particularly curious. He had heard that this young man was the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment and a shareholder in several big companies!
His suit alone was worth millions!
He must be very wealthy.
Rich people care a lot about face. Being provoked by Feng Wanshan like this, he might not donate less than Feng Wanshan!
The more fiercely these rich people compete, the better. When the snipe and the clam fight, the fisherman benefits.
Mr. He was almost laughing out loud.
Looking at Feng Wanshan’s mocking gaze, Lin Fan knew very well that no matter how much he donated, Feng Wanshan would feel he was invincible.
Lin Fan calmly said, "I’m not donating."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Not donating?
This was indeed an answer that nobody had expected.
They thought Lin Fan might donate a bit less than Feng Wanshan, but as long as it was more than the others present, it would be acceptable!
Or maybe he would outshine Feng Wanshan by donating even more.
But unexpectedly, Lin Fan chose not to donate at all!
Not a penny!
Even Du Tao couldn’t understand Lin Fan, with cold sweat appearing on his forehead. In front of so many people, the Big Boss didn’t donate a penny. This was a bit embarrassing, and people would definitely laugh at him.
"Come on, this is way too stingy, not donating a single penny!"
"Wow, isn’t he afraid of losing face?"
"It’s fine if no one knows, but in front of everyone, at least donate something."
Some shook their heads, some snickered, and some looked at Lin Fan with disdain.
Rich people care a lot about face!
While many rich people have done shameless things, they’ve done them secretly. On the surface, they’re all reputable figures. No one dares to be openly shameless.
For Lin Fan to openly say he wouldn’t donate, it’s quite disgraceful, and no one would do this.
So Lin Fan’s action seemed incomprehensible to everyone.
Mr. He, who was initially laughing, now had a stiff smile.
Dammit!
This young tycoon sure plays by his own rules!
If everyone behaved like him and didn’t donate, how could Mr. He buy a necklace for his lover?
"Hahaha..."
After a brief pause, Feng Wanshan couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
Lin Fan actually didn’t donate money, choosing the most embarrassing option, which Feng Wanshan hadn’t expected.
"Come on, young man, you can’t be so heartless, can you? You won’t even donate a little to the mountainous areas?"
Feng Wanshan mocked openly.
A round of snickers erupted from the surrounding crowd; indeed, Lin Fan was humiliated.
Anna found it a little amusing, as her godfather had always suffered in front of Lin Fan, and this time he finally redeemed himself.
However, she also found it puzzling why Lin Fan chose such an embarrassing way?
Not donating a single penny?
With Lin Fan’s financial ability to buy estates and islands, even donating one billion shouldn’t be a problem.
Lin Fan wasn’t a fool; on the contrary, he was sharper than anyone. Why would he choose to embarrass himself publicly?
Anna was a bit perplexed by Lin Fan.
Li Jianhua was also confused, recalling a previous conversation where Lin Fan clearly said he wouldn’t donate and advised against donating.
If done quietly, not donating wouldn’t matter because nobody would know. However, now that it was public, Lin Fan still chose not to donate, which was puzzling.
Regarding donations, whether it’s out of altruism is unimportant; it’s just about earning face.
Does Lin Fan not even understand this basic social courtesy?
It’s truly baffling.
Du Tao had already approached Lin Fan, whispering, "Big Boss, shouldn’t we just donate a bit under your name? I’ll provide the money?"
As President of Tianxue, he really didn’t want the Big Boss of Tianxue to become a laughingstock.
Lin Fan just gave a slight smile, signaling him not to speak further.
