Du Tao had to give up, wiping his cold sweat, and pondered in confusion, not knowing what the Big Boss was planning.
Lin Fan then looked at Mr. He and said, "Mr. He, is it okay if I don’t donate?"
Everyone was shocked. It was one thing for Lin Fan not to donate, but to ask Mr. He like that, it seemed a bit shameless.
Though naturally displeased, Mr. He maintained a friendly and gentle expression, "No problem, Mr. Lin. Offering charity is a matter of personal willingness, and whether to donate more or less depends on one’s kindness. Our organization won’t force anyone."
Inwardly, Mr. He sneered, as Lin Fan now carried the label of "uncharitable."
As expected, with Mr. He’s words, everyone held Lin Fan in even lower regard.
Seizing the moment, Feng Wanshan laughed, "Young man, you’re not donating money, so are you just here for free food and drinks?"
The room burst into laughter.
Lin Fan ignored Feng Wanshan, smiling, "Mr. He, I’m here today mainly to use your platform to announce something. Do you mind?"
Mr. He was curious and couldn’t help but ask, "What is it?"
Lin Fan looked around the audience and said, "The reason I’m not donating is because I’m planning to establish a foundation dedicated to helping the needy, with an initial fund of 1 billion Huaxia Coin!"
What?
At these words, the room fell silent in astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Translate for me, what does "rich" mean!
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 131: Translate for me, what does "rich" mean!
Originally, everyone was mocking Lin Fan.
But with just a few words, Lin Fan left everyone in shock.
Lin Fan actually announced in public that he was going to establish a foundation!
The initial funding would be as high as 1 billion Huaxia Coin.
"This foundation will be named after my group, called the Mortal Fund, and the 1 billion initial fund will be entirely paid by me!" Lin Fan added.
Everyone fell silent.
Lin Fan personally funding 1 billion as the initial capital for the foundation!
This was so damn extravagant!
Looking across Huaxia, people who can suddenly pull out 1 billion for charity aren’t nonexistent, but they generally do it in the name of their company, and usually, it’s groups with assets over 100 billion that can afford to do this.
A personal throw of 1 billion into charity is exceptionally rare!
The people who had earlier mocked Lin Fan for not donating money were now blushing; they had no grounds to laugh at him.
billion, what does that even mean!
In front of 1 billion, the mere 10 million donated by Feng Wanshan doesn’t even count!
Feng Wanshan’s smile froze, his expression was priceless.
He never imagined in a million years that things would turn out like this, Lin Fan’s move was more than just a slap in the face; it was like a steel palm swinging across!
Lin Fan continued, "Once the foundation is officially established, it will also open up for public donations, and at that time, I welcome all of you to enthusiastically donate. The original intention of the Mortal Fund is to ensure that every donation can truly help those in need, and Mortal Fund will publicly disclose the destination of every donation, even a pack of instant noodles will be made public, there will absolutely be no situation where the destination of donations is unclear, and no one will be able to use donations for inappropriate purposes!"
As he said this, Lin Fan gave a faint glance at He Dahong, implying the message was meant for him.
Since overhearing He Dahong in the restroom, Lin Fan had been brewing this plan.
For now, the plan is still in its infancy, but one thing is certain, the Mortal Fund would never be as shameless as He Dahong.
He Dahong felt a bit uneasy, Lin Fan’s remarks seemed to be targeting him!
He had something to hide and didn’t dare to speak.
Unbeknownst to Lin Fan, after his words, a stunning young woman in a corner of the banquet, who had been drinking with her head down, suddenly looked up, her eyes curious as she glanced at him.
"Bravo!"
Du Tao exclaimed loudly at this moment, feeling excited.
So, it turns out the big boss wasn’t donating because he had such a plan, this comeback was executed beautifully!
He felt a bit ashamed, earlier, like everyone else, he was puzzled by the big boss’s actions, but in fact, the big boss’s outlook was far greater, beyond his comprehension and that of everyone present!
Truly deserving of being the big boss who quietly acquired Tianxue!
In an instant, Du Tao’s admiration for Lin Fan was as endless as a flowing river.
"I, Du Tao, promise that once the foundation is established, I will donate 10 million on behalf of myself." Du Tao declared.
He was also a sly old fox, being the first to donate to leave a good impression on the big boss.
Lin Fan indeed cast an approving look at Du Tao.
Du Tao had already expressed his stance.
Li Jianhua followed closely, "Mr. Lin, I also promise, on behalf of Teasing Whiskers Livestream, to donate 10 million to the Mortal Fund."
He now finally understood why Lin Fan suggested he not donate to the charity banquet, it turned out Lin Fan had this plan!
So, his money should of course be donated to the Mortal Fund.
Mr. Lin is really something!
Jin Hesheng, the big boss of Xingquan Law Firm, slowly stepped forward and said, "Mr. Lin, Xingquan also promises to donate 5 million, furthermore, regarding the establishment of the foundation, Mr. Lin can leave it to Xingquan."
That was exactly what Lin Fan intended, the establishment of a foundation would undoubtedly have to go through many legal procedures, handing it over to Xingquan gave him peace of mind.
"Great, I’ll trouble you then, Mr. Jin." Lin Fan smiled.
Jin Hesheng said, "No need to be polite, Mr. Lin establishing this foundation can be considered a great philanthropy benefiting all living beings, Xingquan has no reason not to support."
Previously, Lin Fan was on the brink of being ridiculed because he expressed not donating money, but once he announced the establishment of the Mortal Fund, he instantly turned the whole situation around.
"Can you translate for me what lavish means, what charity is, this is what the f*** is called lavish, this is what charity is!"
"Oh my god, he’s amazing, and the key is, he’s so young!"
"Splurging 1 billion at such a young age, this boldness is truly divine!"
"I’ve never seen anyone doing charity so lavishly before!"
"Oh my god, I want to know what on earth his background is, why is he so extravagant?"
People began whispering to each other, amazed, they were all ready to kneel before Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan and Anna felt miserable inside.
Anna looked at Lin Fan with a complex expression, not knowing what to think, she felt she couldn’t see through Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan was utterly depressed.
Originally, his donation of 10 million had already made him stand out in the whole room, earning enough face, but the emergence of Lin Fan’s foundation stole all his thunder and showed a much bigger picture than his, completely outshining him, his 10 million was essentially wasted.
Damn it!
Lin Fan this lunatic!
He’s got so damn much money, spending it without even blinking!
The key is, completely acting outside conventional norms!
Everyone does charity, it’s all about saving face, just for show, who would like him, pull out 1 billion for charity!
Now, the only way for Feng Wanshan to regain the spotlight is to also establish a foundation and put more money than Lin Fan.
But the cost would be too high, it’s not worth it at all.
Not to mention, pulling out 1 billion for charity, the company’s shareholders would definitely oppose it.
Looks like once again, he lost to Lin Fan.
Completely defeated!
Feng Wanshan was furious with Lin Fan.
His eyes shifted, and Feng Wanshan said sarcastically, "Mr. Lin, promoting your own foundation at someone else’s charity event, isn’t that a bit unethical? I, Feng, find this behavior inappropriate, I’m sure Mr. He Dahong, the person in charge here, feels the same."
He Dahong indeed wasn’t pleased, Lin Fan was clearly undermining and stealing the limelight!
He Dahong dared not go against Lin Fan, he had to maintain a virtuous image.
But since Feng Wanshan directly involved him, he couldn’t afford to be negligent towards him, after all, Feng Wanshan was his biggest benefactor.
"Haha, I’m quite straightforward, there’s nothing wrong with Mr. Lin promoting his foundation a bit, everyone is doing good deeds after all. But... may I ask if Mr. Lin has finished his promotion, so our charity donation can continue?" He Dahong said.
These words were tactful, a master of balancing, offending neither side.
Feng Wanshan, however, wasn’t willing to let it go, saying, "Mr. He is truly honest and sincere, if it were me, I’d be mad, Mr. Lin keeps emphasizing that his foundation is open and transparent, it seems to imply something, is it insinuating that Mr. He’s charity event isn’t transparent?"
This was Feng Wanshan trying to stir up conflict, wanting Lin Fan and He Dahong to tear each other apart.
This concerned the reputation of his charity event, so He Dahong immediately said, "It seems necessary for me to clarify, the purpose of our charity is also to support and assist the needy, all the money we raise will be used to help those in need, this is something no one can slander, if Mr. Lin is really insinuating us, then it’s just being despicable, I can only ask Mr. Lin to leave!"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, sensing that He Dahong’s tone was a bit displeased, what would Lin Fan say in response?
Lin Fan, however, looked at Anna and smiled, "I said I was going to give you a joining gift, that yacht just got snatched by Boss Feng, how about I change it to a diamond necklace worth a million?"
Anna: "..."
Everyone looked at each other, confused as to what Lin Fan meant by suddenly changing the topic?
Yet He Dahong’s face changed, looking at Lin Fan with surprise, internally shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Rich and Beautiful Women Scoring Above 9, Chu Yufei
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 132: Rich and Beautiful Women Scoring Above 9, Chu Yufei
He Dahong was extremely shocked when Lin Fan mentioned the "diamond necklace worth a million."
He was planning to use tonight’s charity funds to buy a diamond necklace for his lover!
Is this a coincidence, or does Lin Fan know something?
Lin Fan spoke at this time, "Mr. He, what do you think of me rewarding her with a million-dollar diamond necklace? Is this a good idea?"
He Dahong laughed awkwardly, "Well... haha, I think it’s great. Mr. Lin really cares for his subordinates. Having a good boss like Mr. Lin is truly enviable."
Damn!
Lin Fan must know something!
He’s deliberately saying this to warn me!
He Dahong was bewildered. How did Lin Fan know about him wanting to buy a diamond necklace for his lover?
Lin Fan said, "By the way, Mr. He, you were saying something earlier, thinking that I criticized your charity event and wanted to kick me out, right?"
He Dahong quickly replied, "No! It’s just a misunderstanding. Mr. Lin was just borrowing my venue to promote his own foundation. I think doing charity is a good thing, and I have no objections! I was presumptuous earlier, and I apologize to Mr. Lin!"
As he spoke, He Dahong respectfully bowed to Lin Fan.
This scene left everyone exchanging glances.
Feng Wanshan was puzzled. He wanted to provoke a conflict between He Dahong and Lin Fan, but it was resolved so quickly?
Lin Fan said, "If that’s the case, then someone must have instigated trouble. This person is really acting like a petty villain. Boss Feng, wouldn’t you agree?"
Lin Fan smiled at Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan looked embarrassed, unable to refute for a moment.
He Dahong hurriedly said to smooth things over, "Mr. Lin, Boss Feng, it’s all a misunderstanding. Why don’t we leave it at that?"
He Dahong inwardly smiled wryly. He couldn’t afford to offend either Lin Fan or Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan snorted coldly, not saying anything.
Lin Fan smiled but didn’t say anything further. He didn’t plan on exposing He Dahong right now, as it wouldn’t benefit him. This world is full of darkness, and he wasn’t some beacon of justice unless He Dahong overstepped his bounds.
Following this, the charity fundraising continued, but it had nothing to do with Lin Fan anymore.
However, Lin Fan couldn’t leave easily because many people voluntarily came over to toast him and express goodwill.
Lin Fan’s extravagant donation of 1 billion for a charity fund was truly shocking, stunning these upper-class figures present.
This young man, around 20 years old, had such a vast perspective, it was unimaginable.
Who knew when Yun City had produced such a character!
Moreover, Lin Fan was the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment and a major shareholder in several groups, so befriending Lin Fan naturally held no downside.
Regarding everyone’s toasts, Lin Fan accepted them all. He just wanted to establish connections with Yun City’s high society.
But he had to drive later, so he couldn’t drink alcohol, leaving Anna to handle it for him.
After all, Anna was Feng Wanshan’s person, so Lin Fan didn’t mind at all.
"Sorry, I need to drive later. Can my housekeeper drink on my behalf—is that okay?"
The people toasting had no objections. In fact, they were already satisfied that Lin Fan accepted their toast.
Anna was a bit puzzled. Lin Fan asked her to drink, she couldn’t refuse, so she had no choice but to drink cup after cup.
Anna had served in the military, aside from being skilled, her tolerance for alcohol wasn’t bad.
But there were simply too many people toasting, and eventually, even with her tolerance, it was hard for her to keep up.
Feng Wanshan noticed this and felt annoyed, thinking Lin Fan was too heartless for making Anna drink so much. If Anna got drunk and said something she shouldn’t, that would be bad!
But he couldn’t interfere. He couldn’t let Lin Fan become suspicious, so he had to pretend not to see anything.
His hatred for Lin Fan grew stronger.
"You rascal, several times you’ve crossed me. Do you really think I, Feng Wanshan, can’t deal with you? Just wait and see!"
Feng Wanshan thought bitterly, wanting to teach Lin Fan a lesson.
Lin Fan intentionally wanted Feng Wanshan to see Anna drinking, hoping Anna would get drunk.
To win over Anna, the first thing he needed to do was create a rift between Anna and Feng Wanshan. He wanted Feng Wanshan to be suspicious of Anna.
Of course, everything Lin Fan did was without leaving a trace. On the surface, he chatted and laughed with the wealthy and glamorous, and before long, he had made quite a few acquaintances.
Anna was already overwhelmed, her face flushed, and she was in a drunken state.
Seeing this, Lin Fan said, "It’s getting late, let’s go."
Anna, as if granted amnesty, nodded quickly.
Lin Fan smiled, "You seem a bit drunk, don’t you?"
Anna shook her head and said, "I’m fine."
But before she could finish speaking, she stumbled, struggling even to walk steadily.
Lin Fan said, "Still saying you’re fine? Hold onto my arm, and I’ll take you out."
"Mm." Anna didn’t insist since she was really exhausted, so she went forward and held onto Lin Fan’s arm.
Lin Fan, however, withdrew his hand and, in a natural motion, held her waist, letting her rest her head on his shoulder.
The two looked less like master and servant and more like a couple.
Feng Wanshan, seeing this scene, frowned, feeling somewhat annoyed and increasingly worried. Damn it, this guy Lin Fan, he wouldn’t take advantage of Anna being drunk, would he?
Just as Lin Fan and Anna reached the door, they suddenly saw a young woman approach.
"Mr. Lin," the young woman called out.
Lin Fan’s eyes brightened, this woman was so beautiful, a score of over 9!
A simple and elegant long dress accentuated her exquisite figure, almond-shaped face, white skin—obviously a rich and beautiful woman. Lin Fan never had the chance to see such a high-score rich and beautiful woman before, let alone have her proactively greet him.
"Hello," Lin Fan responded politely.
The young woman smiled, "Hello, Mr. Lin. I am Chu Yufei from the Chu Family in Yun City. I just heard about Mr. Lin planning to invest 1 billion to establish a foundation, and I am very interested. I wonder if Mr. Lin is available to chat?"
Lin Fan felt an ’oh’ in his heart. She indeed turned out to be the offspring of a prominent family, definitely a rich and beautiful woman! The Chu Family in Yun City is a top-tier prominent family. Earlier, the sailboat he and Feng Wanshan were bidding on was donated by Chu Lin, the young master of the Chu Family in Yun City.
"What do you mean by interested?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Yufei said, "I want to collaborate with Mr. Lin and join Mr. Lin’s foundation!"
Lin Fan was a bit surprised. He knew nothing about Chu Yufei and naturally couldn’t give her an answer. Besides, his foundation didn’t need collaboration with others, so he said, "I’m not really convenient right now. You see, she’s drunk, and I need to take her away."
Yet Chu Yufei didn’t give up, "Then is Mr. Lin willing to leave some contact information so we can find a time to talk tomorrow?"
Lin Fan thought for a moment before giving Chu Yufei his phone number, "Add me on WeChat later."
Chu Yufei was delighted and smiled, "Alright, I’m looking forward to meeting with Mr. Lin."
As she spoke, Chu Yufei held out her hand to shake Lin Fan’s.
Lin Fan then politely shook her hand, amazed in his heart, thinking: Wow, what soft and smooth little hands. Holding them for a while wouldn’t be tiring.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: The Drunken Butler: Dad, Don’t Go
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 133: The Drunken Butler: Dad, Don’t Go
When it comes to beautiful women, Lin Fan never had much resistance, especially when it came to a 9 out of 10 beauty who came with kindness.
One must admit, beauties really make things easier. If it were a man, Lin Fan would have turned him down right away.
After shaking hands, Chu Yufei returned to the party.
It was just a minor episode, so Lin Fan didn’t dwell on it much and helped Anna out.
At the elevator, Lin Fan was waiting for it to arrive.
With no one around, all of a sudden, He Dahong caught up.
"Mr. Lin, please wait a moment," He Dahong said politely.
Lin Fan knew why he came but pretended not to, saying, "Mr. He, is something the matter?"
He Dahong chuckled awkwardly and said, "There’s something I don’t know how to start with Mr. Lin. I just want to say, regardless of any negative rumors about our charity event that Mr. Lin might hear, it’s all a big misunderstanding."
Lin Fan replied, "I’m not quite sure I understand what Mr. He means? Why not just speak plainly?"
He Dahong hesitated for a moment, then said, "It’s about the use of our charity funds. Has Mr. Lin heard any negative rumors?"
He Dahong was quite the old fox, trying to get a read on Lin Fan’s thoughts.
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," "No, I haven’t. Why would Mr. He say such a thing?"
He Dahong quickly replied, "Haha, I was just a bit worried, that’s all. If not, that’s great."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Then there’s nothing more, right?"
He Dahong laughed, "Nothing more."
By then, the elevator had arrived. Lin Fan helped Anna inside and said, "Since Mr. He mentioned the use of charity funds, I believe that we who engage in charity should strictly adhere to the bottom line and use the funds appropriately, never diverting them elsewhere. If such actions were exposed, it would surely ruin our reputations. What do you think, Mr. He?"
Upon hearing this, He Dahong couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat, forcing a smile, "Mr. Lin is absolutely right!"
"Goodbye," Lin Fan waved with a smile, and the elevator doors closed.
He Dahong wiped his cold sweat away; Lin Fan’s words were like warnings to him, whether it was deliberate or not was unclear!
He Dahong was left somewhat doubtful; Lin Fan denied hearing any rumors, so was Lin Fan’s earlier statement about gifting Anna a million-dollar diamond necklace just a coincidence?
In the end, Lin Fan didn’t expose He Dahong, opting instead to caution him because Lin Fan didn’t want to make a fuss. He also hoped He Dahong would correct his mistakes. If He Dahong could change, it would count as a good deed for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan and Anna left the Jindu Grand Hotel.
Anna was getting more drunk, but after a breeze from outside, she sobered up a bit and said, "Master, my motorcycle is over there. Can you help me over to it?"
Lin Fan remarked, sweating, "You’re so drunk, better not drive. I’ll take you home; you can pick up your bike tomorrow."
Anna wasn’t keen on riding in Lin Fan’s car, but since she could barely walk straight, she didn’t insist, letting Lin Fan help her into the passenger seat of the Kosak.
Once in the car, Anna leaned her head back and fell asleep.
Lin Fan looked at her flushed, drunk face and smiled, this level of drunkenness was just right.
He didn’t pity her at all. Instead, he found it rather amusing, enjoying the sight of this usually fierce lady who, when drunk, appeared as vulnerable as any other woman, teasing his imagination.
Lin Fan bent down, intending to fasten her seatbelt, when suddenly Anna reached out, wrapping her arms around his waist.
"Don’t go..." Anna mumbled.
This housekeeper sure lived up to her military training, her grip was surprisingly strong, pulling Lin Fan into her embrace in their first intimate hug.
Lin Fan felt her soft body, a mix of alcohol and her scent assaulting his senses, nearly overwhelming him.
"Could it be this woman was captivated by my charm, and now that she’s drunk, she’s finally confessing her feelings?" Lin Fan thought proudly.
But then Anna mumbled again, "Don’t go... dad."
What?
Lin Fan was at a loss.
Sis!
He was being delusional, wasn’t he? This woman took him for her dad!
Lin Fan coughed awkwardly and pushed Anna away, saying, "You can’t just call someone dad."
He then got into the car and drove back to Yunding Manor.
Charity banquet.
After Lin Fan and Anna left, Feng Wanshan found a secluded corner and made a phone call.
"Arrange something for me; I want to teach that kid Lin Fan a lesson!" Feng Wanshan said, a flash of malice in his eyes.
Ever since the failure at the Yunding Manor auction, Lin Fan has repeatedly made him uncomfortable. Tonight, Lin Fan embarrassed him again, stealing the limelight at the party and getting Anna drunk. Feng Wanshan couldn’t swallow his anger anymore.
This time, he must make Lin Fan fall hard so that he knows who Feng Wanshan is.
Lin Fan, of course, was unaware of all this.
He drove the car back to Yunding Manor.
Anna leaned her head again, seemingly lost in her drunken sleep.
Remembering the scene earlier, Lin Fan curiously asked, "Why did you ask your dad not to leave earlier? What happened?"
But Anna was already sound asleep, not answering his question.
Lin Fan didn’t press further, focusing on driving.
Soon, they returned to Yunding Manor; it was already late at night.
Lin Fan parked the car and helped Anna out, bringing her into the mansion.
Lin Shanshan, to make school easier, decided to stay at school today, leaving only Lin Fan and Anna in the house.
Entering the living room, Lin Fan helped Anna lie down on the sofa.
Anna’s face was still flushed, showing no sign of waking.
"Water..." a drunk Anna mumbled with a pained expression.
"You got drunk and need me to take care of you. Who’s the master here?" Lin Fan shook his head helplessly, walked over to make her a cup of hot tea.
Returning to the sofa, Lin Fan sat down, moved Anna’s head onto his lap, and fed her tea.
Watching the beautiful woman drink tea, Lin Fan felt his throat dry a bit. I have to admit, at this moment, Anna was so alluring, and their posture was somewhat intimate...
"I’m a gentleman, I can’t take advantage of the situation," Lin Fan reminded himself, resisting any temptation, knowing that once awake, she could kill him.
After feeding Anna the tea, Lin Fan wanted to leave. He feared if he stayed any longer, he might commit a crime.
He decided Anna would sleep on the sofa for the night.
But as he moved, Anna suddenly grabbed his hand and mumbled again, "Don’t go... dad, don’t leave me..."
She clung to Lin Fan’s hand tightly, as if it were a lifeline.
Lin Fan couldn’t break free, so he let her rest.
Anna finally quieted down, peacefully resting her head on Lin Fan’s lap, falling asleep again, yet still gripping Lin Fan tightly, as if to prevent him from leaving.
Perhaps because she addressed him as "dad" a few times, Lin Fan suddenly felt an inexplicable paternal love.
The initial urge he had towards Anna vanished completely.
"Sis, am I starting to feel protective towards this enemy?" Lin Fan sighed.
Time passed unknowingly, and Lin Fan got sleepy, eventually dozing off.
The next day.
Sunlight streamed through the windows, flooding the sofa with light.
Anna suddenly opened her eyes, now fully awake.
The first thing she saw was Lin Fan!
Lin Fan was asleep above her, head tilted and a hand resting on her, while her head lay on Lin Fan’s thigh, hands wrapped around his knee...
Anna suddenly remembered, she was drunk last night and came back with Lin Fan...
"Sis! Did we sleep like this all night?"
With that thought, Anna’s face flushed red with embarrassment. This posture was way too shameful!

chapters.title: Chapter 134: The Arrogant Maserati Girl
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 134: The Arrogant Maserati Girl
In a blur, Lin Fan felt like he was surrounded by something wonderfully soft. He reached out to touch, trying to figure out what it was, but he couldn’t. It just felt inexplicably pleasant.
At this moment, Anna awoke and found herself resting on Lin Fan’s lap, her arms tightly wrapped around his leg.
Lin Fan was asleep on the couch, his hand resting on Anna in a rather awkward position. If he weren’t in such a deep sleep, Anna would have thought he was doing it on purpose.
Anna quickly let go of him, then removed Lin Fan’s hand, sat up, and hastily checked herself over, relieved to find no signs of disturbance.
If Lin Fan had done anything inappropriate while she was drunk, she would definitely have killed him.
Her movements woke Lin Fan up, and he felt as if he’d been suddenly pulled away from that incredibly soft and comfortable place, waking up immediately.
Rubbing his sleepy eyes, Lin Fan asked, "Is it morning?"
Anna stood up, looking slightly embarrassed: "Master, last night..."
Lin Fan laughed and said, "You got drunk last night and insisted on holding onto me, not letting me leave. I had no choice but to stay with you. How do you feel now, has the alcohol worn off?"
Anna’s cheeks couldn’t help but flush and her heartbeat quickened. Was it really she who didn’t let him leave last night?
"Master, what did I say last night?" Anna asked.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "You don’t remember what you said?"
"I don’t remember," Anna replied, feeling a bit uneasy at Lin Fan’s words. Did she say something wrong while she was drunk?
Lin Fan said, "You kept repeating one thing: ’Dad, don’t go.’ You mistook me for your dad."
Anna broke into a cold sweat: "Sorry, I was drunk, I don’t know anything..."
Curious, Lin Fan asked, "Why did you keep saying ’Dad, don’t go’? Is your dad okay? Can you tell me about it?"
Anna flatly refused: "No! Master, did I say anything else?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What else do you think you would have said?"
Anna bit her lip and said, "How would I know?"
Lin Fan said, "No, you just kept saying ’Dad, don’t go.’
Anna sighed in relief. She hadn’t revealed her identity. Otherwise, Lin Fan wouldn’t be so calm.
"Master, I’ll prepare breakfast for you," Anna said, then walked out.
Lin Fan said, "Your motorcycle is still in the city. I’ll take you into town on my way to school later."
"Okay," Anna nodded.
Watching Anna’s graceful back, Lin Fan couldn’t help but reminisce about that soft, comfortable dream last night, wondering if it had something to do with Anna.
Once she woke up, this woman reverted to her cold, queen-like demeanor. She was actually cuter while drunk. She was so alluring last night that if he hadn’t been worried about how she’d act upon waking, he might have lost control.
"There’s always time, once I win her over... hehe." Lin Fan couldn’t help letting his imagination run wild.
Anna left the hall, reached a place where no one else was around, and took out her phone intending to call Feng Wanshan. Surely, Feng Wanshan saw how drunk she got last night. She felt the need to report her situation, but seeing that it was still early, she dismissed the idea.
Afterward, Anna prepared breakfast for Lin Fan.
After breakfast, Lin Fan drove his supercar and took Anna into the city.
Dropping Anna off at Jindu Grand Hotel, Lin Fan then headed straight to school.
Two blocks away from school, Lin Fan stopped at a red light.
Suddenly, Lin Fan watched as an accident happened right ahead. A girl riding a bicycle was trying to cross the road because the light had turned green. However, a Maserati Quattroporte seemed to want to run the red light, failed to control in time, and hit the bicycle. The bicycle flipped onto the ground, and the girl fell too, her clothes got dirty, but fortunately, she was mostly fine.
The Maserati’s body got scratched by the bicycle, leaving a mark.
The Maserati owner, also a girl, got out of the car in a rage and shouted at the girl on the bicycle.
"You bitch, how do you ride a bike, are you blind!" the Maserati girl pointed at the other’s nose and yelled.
The girl on the bicycle, not convinced, muttered, "It was obviously a green light. What’s wrong with me crossing the street? It’s your problem."
The Maserati girl shouted furiously, "What did you say? You dare to talk back? Didn’t you see my car coming? Couldn’t you fucking dodge?"
The girl on the bicycle said, "You’re in a car; how am I supposed to dodge?"
The Maserati girl said, "So you’re talking back, huh? Look at what you did to my car! Kneel down and apologize, or you’ll be sorry!"
This girl is a bit overbearing, demanding the bicycle girl kneel and apologize.
The girl on the bicycle blushed, "I won’t kneel for you—it’s just a scratch; I’ll compensate you."
The Maserati girl was momentarily stunned, then laughed, "You’ll compensate me? A poor girl riding a bicycle, speaking so grandly. Do you know how much this repair costs? 300,000! Do you have that kind of money?"
The girl on the bicycle was shocked, "300,000? How can that be? You’re just being greedy!"
The Maserati girl sneered, "Poor people are so ignorant. Do you know what my car is? This Maserati Quattroporte is worth 1.5 million. Given the damage, 300,000 for repairs is already low."
The girl on the bicycle’s face went pale, "I... I can’t pay that much. Even if I sold everything, I couldn’t pay it."
The Maserati girl said disdainfully, "Can’t pay? Then kneel and apologize obediently. Maybe if I’m in a good mood, I’ll forgive you!"
The girl on the bicycle said, "I can’t afford it, but I won’t kneel to you. Don’t be so overbearing."
"What did you say, you little bitch? Are you asking for trouble?" The Maserati girl, infuriated, raised her hand to hit the bicycle girl.
It was peak hour, with people focused on getting to work or school. Though there was some spectacle here, few stopped to watch; most just glanced and hurried on.
The Maserati girl, overbearing and ready to hit the bicycle girl, made the bicycle girl think no one would help her. She instinctively closed her eyes, bracing for the hit.
There was nothing she could do; she couldn’t afford the compensation, nor would she kneel. All she could do was let the other party vent by hitting her.
However, the Maserati owner’s hand didn’t fall!
The bicycle girl, curious, peeked open her eyes and saw the Maserati girl’s hand held back by a big hand.
The bicycle girl’s eyes brightened.
A young man!
A very handsome young man!
Lin Fan!
"Gentlemen use words, not hands. Are you a female thug?" Lin Fan said with a slight smile.
He had watched the whole dispute from his car and got out when he saw the Maserati girl bullying.
He actually recognized the Maserati girl; he’d seen her just yesterday.
Yesterday, this girl had arrived at school in her dad’s car. Her dad drove a Ferrari LaFerrari worth over 20 million. Lin Fan overheard others say her dad was a billionaire named Jia Zuozhen, and her name was Jia Xueling.
She was a true heiress. Today, she drove herself to school in a 1.5 million Maserati.
"Let go of me!"
Jia Xueling yelled, glaring at Lin Fan, an angry rich brat in her designer clothes, daring to stop her and calling her a female thug!

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Chu Xiaoxiao
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 135: Chu Xiaoxiao
Lin Fan smiled and said, "If you promise not to hit anyone, I’ll let you go."
Jia Xueling angrily said, "This bitch can’t afford to pay, and can’t even kneel down to apologize. Can’t I at least hit her?"
Lin Fan said, "You can’t hit her. I saw everything. It was you who ran the red light first, so you’re responsible for everything. Not only was she not at fault, but you also owe her a car and a set of clothes."
Jia Xueling was infuriated: "What nonsense are you talking about? Which eye did you see me run the red light with?"
Lin Fan pointed to a nearby camera: "I saw it with both eyes, and I believe the surveillance did too. Do you want me to accompany you to the traffic department?"
Jia Xueling: "..."
She knew she was in the wrong and was speechless for a moment.
At this moment, two traffic policemen appeared nearby. They hadn’t noticed the commotion here yet, but if they did, they’d definitely come over.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "See those two traffic policemen over there? Decide for yourself if you want to go to the traffic department."
After speaking, he let go of Jia Xueling.
Jia Xueling rubbed her wrist, damn it, this damned poor guy really hurt her.
She didn’t want the traffic police to come over. If it escalated to the traffic department, she wouldn’t have a good outcome.
"Bad luck for me!" Jia Xueling huffed angrily, returned to her car window, took out a wallet, and pulled out five red bills, throwing them in front of the bicycle girl.
"This money is for your bicycle and clothes! Little bitch, don’t let me run into you again! You damned poor people just know how to gang up. Next time, watch how I deal with you!"
Jia Xueling snorted coldly, glared at Lin Fan, got into her car, and quickly left.
Lin Fan squatted down, picked up the five hundred on the ground, handed it to the bicycle girl, and smiled, "Here."
The bicycle girl extended her hand to receive it, bowed her head shyly, her face blushing, and said, "Thank you, Teacher Lin."
Lin Fan was surprised: "You know me?"
The bicycle girl said, "Yes, I’m a student from Yun City Music Academy. I saw you yesterday, Teacher Lin."
Lin Fan glanced down at the girl, his heart stirred. He hadn’t paid attention before, but now he realized, this girl was so pure and cute!
She completely had the youthful vibe of the girl next door, almost like reliving those wonderful school days.
Seeing her face full of collagen, Lin Fan felt like youth had returned.
"What’s your name? Are you in my class?" Lin Fan asked.
The bicycle girl shook her head: "My name is Chu Xiaoxiao, I’m not your student. I just saw you surrounded by many students yesterday, so I knew it was you."
Lin Fan said, "I see. I noticed your bicycle can’t be ridden anymore. How about I give you a ride? After class, you can buy a new one."
Upon hearing this, Chu Xiaoxiao’s face turned even redder, her voice like a mosquito’s: "Yes, thank you, Teacher Lin."
Once in Lin Fan’s Kosak, sitting in the passenger seat, Chu Xiaoxiao felt like she was dreaming.
She had grown up in poverty and never dreamed she could sit in such a luxury car, and it was Teacher Lin’s car.
Teacher Lin was now a celebrity teacher at school. Who wouldn’t want to ride in Teacher Lin’s car? Because of an accident, she had unexpectedly gotten this chance.
For a moment, she didn’t know if she was unlucky or lucky.
Lin Fan, while driving, asked, "Was the girl earlier from our school too? Do you know her?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Yes, her name is Jia Xueling. She’s a rich girl and also one of our school’s beauties—almost everyone at our school knows her."
Lin Fan acknowledged with an "oh" and laughed: "One of the campus beauties? Do we have many campus beauties at our school?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Currently, there are four main campus beauties."
Lin Fan laughed: "Are you one of them?"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed: "Teacher Lin, don’t tease me. The four main campus beauties are all rich and beautiful women. I’m not; my family is poor."
Lin Fan said, "You need a background to be a campus beauty? Isn’t it enough to be pretty? I think you’re much prettier than Jia Xueling. If she can be a campus beauty, so can you!"
Hearing Lin Fan praise her beauty, Chu Xiaoxiao felt sweet inside. Indeed, some called her a campus beauty too, but she was just a "commoner beauty," differentiating from those four rich and beautiful women.
Soon, they arrived at Yun City Music Academy.
Lin Fan parked the car at the entrance and got out with Chu Xiaoxiao, ready to enter the school.
"Xiaoxiao!"
Suddenly, they heard someone calling.
They saw a Ferrari 488 parked nearby. The supercar’s price was probably four to five million. A well-dressed young man with slicked-back hair, holding a bouquet of flowers, leaned against the front of the car, wearing a confident smile.
He was the one calling Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao looked over, frowned, then lowered her head, pretending not to see the young man, and quickened her pace.
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled and asked, "Who is this guy?"
Chu Xiaoxiao, a bit helpless, replied, "He’s so annoying. I’ve already clearly rejected him, but he keeps looking for me. Teacher Lin, don’t mind him."
Seeing Chu Xiaoxiao not respond, the young man quickly followed with the flowers, blocking Chu Xiaoxiao’s path.
"Xiaoxiao, didn’t you hear me call you? This is for you." The young man said, holding out the bouquet to Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao bit her lip and said, "I don’t want it. Stop doing this."
The young man laughed, "What’s wrong, don’t you like flowers? Then how about having dinner with me tonight?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I won’t have dinner with you. I’ve told you many times, I won’t date you. Give up on this, and please don’t harass me anymore."
The young man stubbornly said, "Just one dinner, okay? I’ll pick you up tonight. If you don’t agree, I’ll come to the school to wait for you every day."
Chu Xiaoxiao was getting a bit angry, "No!"
Lin Fan couldn’t stand by any longer. This guy was trying to trap Chu Xiaoxiao. If she agreed to have dinner with him, he would definitely go further.
"Dude, that’s enough." Lin Fan said lightly.
The young man finally looked at Lin Fan, unhappily saying, "Who are you?"
Lin Fan replied, "I’m Chu Xiaoxiao’s teacher."
"Teacher?" The young man sized up Lin Fan, saw him in a bunch of cheap clothes, and immediately showed a disdainful look.
What a poor loser!
"So what if you’re a teacher? Do you know who I am? You’d better mind your own business!" The young man displayed an arrogant expression.
Lin Fan couldn’t stand these rich second-generation kids showing off, his face turned cold, "I don’t give a damn who you are. This is a school, you’re here harassing my student, so I can step in!"
The young man was furious, "You good-for-nothing teacher, you don’t even know who you’re messing with. Listen up, my name is Feng Tianming, my dad is Feng Wanshan, the richest man in Yun City. If you know what’s good for you, you’ll get lost!"
Lin Fan was taken aback for a moment, then laughed.
Of all the people’s sons, it had to be Feng Wanshan’s!
Now this is interesting.
Lin Fan might give other people’s fathers some face, but not Feng Wanshan’s son, he really wouldn’t be courteous.
Chu Xiaoxiao saw Feng Tianming cursing at Teacher Lin and got very angry. Teacher Lin helped her today, she respected Teacher Lin a lot, how could she let Feng Tianming talk to him like that.
"Feng Tianming, that’s enough, you can’t talk to Teacher Lin like that!" Chu Xiaoxiao said angrily.
Feng Tianming was a bit agitated, snorted coldly, "Why are you defending him? Have you taken a liking to this poor loser?"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed, "What nonsense are you talking about?"
She hadn’t... fallen for Teacher Lin, she just admired his talent...
Lin Fan said lightly, "You’re Feng Wanshan’s son, huh? Does Feng Wanshan know he has an idiot for a son? If you don’t get lost, I’ll have the security guards escort you out."
Feng Tianming arrogantly said, "You’re scaring me? What can the security guards do to me?"
"Then you’ll see."
Lin Fan took out his phone and called Liu Mengjie, "Sister Mengjie, I’m at the school gate, there’s a bit of trouble, can you help me call over a few security guards?"
Lin Fan was just a substitute teacher, not necessarily able to command the security, but the principal definitely could.
Sure enough, not long after he hung up, Liu Mengjie made a call to the security office.
Soon, several tall security guards came out from the security office.
Feng Tianming was shocked at the sight.
"Damn loser, this time I’ll give it to you, but you wait, I’ll be back with more people, guarantee you’ll get beat up once you step out of this school!" Feng Tianming said venomously, then slipped away before the security guards arrived.
The security guards walked over to Lin Fan and Feng Xiaoxiao.
"Teacher Lin, I’m the head of the security office, Old Li. The principal sent us over, are you all right?" a middle-aged security guard asked respectfully.
Lin Fan being able to have the principal dispatch security gave the guards a bit of awe for him.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s fine, fortunately, you came, that guy was scared off. Xiaoxiao, let’s go inside."
And so, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao entered the school.
Chu Xiaoxiao worriedly said, "Teacher Lin, that Feng Tianming is a madman, what if he really comes back to get someone to hit you?"
Lin Fan thought for a moment, "Don’t worry, it’s all right, I’ll handle it."
Chu Xiaoxiao looked apologetic, "Teacher Lin, it’s all my fault, I’ve caused trouble for you."
Lin Fan smiled, "Don’t say that, this guy was harassing you, I couldn’t just sit by."
Chu Xiaoxiao felt very grateful, "Mm, thank you, Teacher Lin, you’ve already helped me twice today, I don’t even know how to thank you. How about I treat you to dinner after school?"
To her surprise, Lin Fan readily said, "Sure."
Chu Xiaoxiao was delighted, she actually managed to invite Teacher Lin to eat. She casually suggested it, not expecting Teacher Lin would agree.
"Also, Teacher Lin, can I sit in on your class later?" Chu Xiaoxiao blushed as she asked.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sure."
"Then I’ll head back to the classroom first," Chu Xiaoxiao said, her face red with shyness, as she happily walked away.
Lin Fan watched her, felt like a breath of fresh air, ah, what a lovely young lady.
Such a lovely young lady mustn’t be ruined by that guy Feng Tianming. He had readily agreed to have dinner with Chu Xiaoxiao just to prevent Feng Tianming from harassing her again.
Lin Fan then took out his phone, "Hey Anna, are you back at the villa? Come by the school after I finish, okay?"

chapters.title: Chapter 136: The Prestigious School Beauty, Easily Conquered
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136: The Prestigious School Beauty, Easily Conquered
The piano classroom was about to start class, and it was already filled with students, not only those from the class but also many teachers and students who came because of the fame.
Yesterday, Lin Fan became an overnight sensation; his divine-level piano skills made him a star teacher. Almost the entire school’s teachers and students had heard of his name, but many knew the name without knowing the person.
A beautiful young lady, accompanied by two female companions, walked into the classroom, immediately drawing the attention of the students.
"It’s her!"
"Jia Xueling, one of the four school belles!"
"A rich and beautiful woman from a wealthy family!"
"She came to listen to Teacher Lin’s class too?"
The students gasped in amazement. Teacher Lin’s charm was so great that even the usually proud young lady from a wealthy family, Jia Xueling, was drawn in.
Jia Xueling, with a cold expression, ignored the crowd. As one of the four school belles, she was already used to being the focal point.
She indeed came because of his fame, curious about what this legendary piano genius looked like.
Jia Xueling had just sat down when suddenly the entire classroom fell silent. People around her immediately stopped discussing her, as if no one cared about her presence anymore.
Everyone’s focus shifted to the podium, their eyes filled with admiration.
Lin Fan had arrived!
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Jia Xueling was stunned.
Wasn’t this the poor-looking guy who helped Chu Xiaoxiao deal with her this morning!
She knew Chu Xiaoxiao, known as the "commoner belle" at Yun City Music Academy. Due to Chu Xiaoxiao’s poor family background, she looked down on her and never gave her a second glance. This morning, Chu Xiaoxiao had the bad luck to bump into her car, and she was planning to take the opportunity to teach her a lesson.
Who would have thought Lin Fan would intervene, leaving her with no choice but to pay up and leave.
She still held a grudge because of that.
Who would have thought, this person was actually the legendary piano genius, Teacher Lin!
Soon after, Jia Xueling remembered, yesterday morning at the school gate, the principal personally greeted this very Lin Fan!
Yesterday, she and her father happened to be at the school gate, thinking the principal was there to greet them, but they embarrassingly realized the principal was there for Lin Fan.
Because Lin Fan drove a top-tier sports car that completely stole their thunder, her father, Jia Zuozhen, held a grudge against him afterwards.
For a moment, Jia Xueling felt conflicted.
This Lin Fan, twice made her unhappy, yet he happened to be the piano genius she was very curious about. This contradictory feeling made her uncomfortable. If not exceedingly curious about Lin Fan’s talent, she would have left.
Lin Fan, however, did not notice Jia Xueling’s presence. Of course, even if he did, he wouldn’t have cared.
As soon as the class bell rang, Lin Fan commenced the lesson, teaching both theory and personally demonstrating techniques, captivating the students.
"Oh my god, Teacher Lin is amazing!"
"He deserves his reputation!"
"Boo hoo, he plays so well!"
The students were in awe of Lin Fan.
Jia Xueling was equally awed, intensely excited, as if she had forgotten all grievances with Lin Fan, leaving only admiration.
As a daughter from a wealthy family, she had enjoyed a life of luxury and the best education since childhood. Her parents spared no expense in hiring international masters to teach her music, and she was admitted to Yun City Music Academy purely on her excellent grades.
Despite having encountered many international divine-level instructors before, Jia Xueling was still in awe of Lin Fan. He was far superior to any master teacher she had ever encountered!
If a class from those master teachers was worth 1,000 Huaxia Coins, then a class from Lin Fan was at least worth 10,000 Huaxia Coins!
"Students, try practicing using the techniques I’ve taught you." Lin Fan assigned an exercise to be done during the break.
The piano classroom housed dozens of pianos, soon filled with the sound of students practicing.
Lin Fan stepped down from the podium and began giving individual guidance.
Before long, Lin Fan arrived beside Jia Xueling, who was diligently practicing piano.
Lin Fan nodded and smiled, saying, "You’re practicing well."
"Hmm..."
Being praised by Lin Fan, Jia Xueling felt quite proud, yet afraid of awkwardness, she didn’t dare look up and meet his gaze.
Lin Fan suddenly said, "Your fingering is a bit off, let me show you."
Lin Fan demonstrated once.
Jia Xueling tried it and, indeed, Lin Fan’s guidance enlightened her, resolving a technique problem that had long troubled her.
Jia Xueling was extremely excited, deeply impressed by Lin Fan. He was so strong, truly a piano genius.
Unknowingly, she already started admiring Lin Fan deeply like everyone else...
She mustered the courage to look up and intended to greet Lin Fan, but by then he had already moved on to guide other students.
Jia Xueling felt a bit lost; just before she had disliked Lin Fan, what was happening to her?
It was all because Lin Fan was so talented. Even someone like Jia Xueling, who looked down on everyone and stood aloof, began to fall for him.
The class ended quickly, and the students, eager for more, surrounded Lin Fan and bombarded him with questions before gradually dispersing.
Jia Xueling hadn’t left the classroom yet and watched Lin Fan interacting with the students.
The two girls beside her were puzzled, "Sister Xueling, aren’t we leaving?"
Jia Xueling said, "Don’t bother me, I have something to discuss with Teacher Lin later."
The two girls exchanged glances, surprised. Sister Xueling never cared about any teachers at school; she was just here for a degree. She had been taught by international masters since childhood, and her skill level had already surpassed any teacher here.
This was the first time Sister Xueling voluntarily wanted to talk to a teacher!
"This Teacher Lin is really something."
"He’s mainly so handsome!"
The two girls whispered to each other.
Jia Xueling felt a bit nervous, having decided to take the initiative to chat with Lin Fan; she didn’t know how to start since there was some unpleasantness this morning, and she feared Lin Fan might have a bad impression of her.
Finally, the crowd surrounding Lin Fan dispersed.
Lin Fan walked straight out of the classroom.
Jia Xueling quickly stood up, smiling, and headed towards Lin Fan.
However, Jia Xueling quickly froze in her tracks, the smile on her face stiffening.
She saw Lin Fan at the door being stopped by a girl approaching him.
Chu Xiaoxiao!
"Teacher Lin, I’m sorry, I intended to attend your class, but today I had an exam in another course, so I couldn’t make it." Chu Xiaoxiao said apologetically, her face blushing.
She had previously mentioned she would audit Lin Fan’s class but hadn’t shown up.
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s okay, are you free to leave now?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Yes, I’m free now."
Lin Fan said, "Let’s grab some food first, and then I’ll take you to buy a bicycle. That overbearing girl wrecked your bike this morning; how will you get to school without one?"
Chu Xiaoxiao felt Teacher Lin was really considerate, feeling both happy and shy, "Thank you, Teacher Lin."
And with that, Lin Fan left with Chu Xiaoxiao.
In the classroom, Jia Xueling’s face turned green with rage, her body trembling.
Lin Fan was so nice to Chu Xiaoxiao!
And he called her the overbearing girl!

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Anna Strikes for the First Time, Too Ruthless!
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: Anna Strikes for the First Time, Too Ruthless!
"I’m so angry, Lin Fan, you bastard! And Chu Xiaoxiao, that little bitch, just a broke nobody, but knows how to win men’s favor!" Jia Xueling gritted her teeth.
She decided to teach Chu Xiaoxiao a lesson.
Lin Fan was unaware of this. He had too many students in his class to notice Jia Xueling’s presence.
After leaving the classroom with Chu Xiaoxiao, the two went to the school gate.
A cool and stylish motorcycle was parked at the gate, with a stunning long-haired beauty standing beside it.
Anna!
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Anna walked over and said, "Master, you called me over. What are your orders?"
Lin Fan had asked her to wait for him at the school gate, so she had arrived early.
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned. Anna’s aura was so strong she didn’t dare to look straight at her. Could it be that this imposing sister called Lin Fan her master, making her possibly Teacher Lin’s servant?
At this moment.
Four burly men appeared with unfriendly expressions, followed closely by a young man with slicked-back hair.
Feng Tianming!
"Kid, I told you, unless you never leave the school, once you step out of this gate, I’ll have you beaten!" Feng Tianming said, laughing triumphantly.
Chu Xiaoxiao was shocked and instinctively hid behind Lin Fan, exclaiming in anger, "Feng Tianming, don’t do anything reckless!"
Seeing the closeness between Chu Xiaoxiao and Lin Fan, Feng Tianming became furious and said, "Beat him up, beat him to death!"
The four burly men clenched their fists and charged forward.
Lin Fan remained calm and said to Anna, "You know why I called you here."
Anna smiled bitterly inside.
The moment Feng Tianming appeared, she recognized him as Feng Wanshan’s son. Although Feng Tianming didn’t know her, she was very familiar with the Feng Family.
Unexpectedly, Feng Tianming had clashed with Lin Fan!
For the sake of her foster father, Feng Wanshan, she couldn’t hit Feng Tianming. But as Lin Fan’s housekeeper, she couldn’t disobey his orders, or she would risk exposure.
It was far from the time for her to reveal herself.
So she had no choice.
Anna stepped forward to shield Lin Fan.
Upon seeing this, Feng Tianming laughed loudly: "Kid, are you relying on a woman to fight for you?"
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled, thinking Feng Tianming seemed not to recognize Anna. Did Anna recognize Feng Tianming? Or were they pretending not to know each other?
But it didn’t matter, whether they pretended not to know each other or truly didn’t, Lin Fan intended to make them fight amongst themselves today.
"Are you looking down on women?" Lin Fan smiled and said.
Feng Tianming laughed: "What use is this woman..."
Crack!
Before Feng Tianming could finish his sentence, Anna swiftly kicked and knocked over one of the charging burly men, then followed up with a stomp, instantly breaking the man’s shinbone.
The crisp sound of bone breaking made everyone shudder.
Damn, she was ruthless!
Lin Fan was secretly delighted. Anna, having been in the military and worked for the top-ranked international security company, was more than capable of handling a few thugs.
"Ah!"
The man screamed in agony, clutching his broken leg in excruciating pain, drenched in sweat.
Feng Tianming could no longer smile. His eyes were about to pop out: "Shit!"
The other three burly men attacked Anna together but were completely outmatched. Soon, another man was put down by Anna, lying on the ground and wailing, unable to get up.
Feng Tianming broke out in a cold sweat, never dreaming Lin Fan would have such a formidable ally.
"Kid, what kind of skill is it to have a woman fight for you? Do you dare to do it yourself?" Feng Tianming said, unconvinced.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Aren’t you relying on some thugs to help you? I’m having my subordinate deal with yours, that’s fair, right? Of course, if you want to fight me, I’m always ready."
This guy being Feng Wanshan’s son, Lin Fan wasn’t going to be courteous.
With that, Lin Fan advanced toward Feng Tianming.
Feng Tianming immediately panicked, involuntarily retreating a step. If Lin Fan’s subordinates were this formidable, who knew if Lin Fan himself wasn’t even more so!
"What, are you scared?" Lin Fan chuckled.
Feng Tianming gritted his teeth and insisted, "I’m not afraid of you! Fight if you want, but before we start, don’t hit... ah!"
Before Feng Tianming could finish his sentence, Lin Fan punched him in the face, taking the initiative and not giving his opponent a chance.
Feng Tianming cried out in pain!
Half of his face swelled up instantly, blood gushing from his nose, in utter disarray.
Damn!
Lin Fan was too cunning, launching a sudden attack before he could finish speaking!
After landing the punch, Lin Fan asked, "What did you say? Not to hit where?"
Feng Tianming was furious: "Not the face! You bloody..."
"Okay." Lin Fan said, and in a swift move, kicked Feng Tianming’s groin.
"Ah!"
Feng Tianming screamed like a pig being slaughtered, kneeling on the ground, clutching his groin, face turning pale.
Lin Fan said, "Isn’t this fine now, not hitting your face."
Feng Tianming was on the verge of tears. Damn, this was worse than hitting his face. A kick that might end his lineage!
"You bastard..." Feng Tianming had always been arrogant, about to curse.
At this point, Anna had already taken down all four burly men. They were writhing on the ground, in great pain, seemingly severely punished by Anna.
Feng Tianming fell silent, not daring to curse.
Anna walked over, seeing Feng Tianming in his pitiful state, she couldn’t help but bitterly smile inside. He was, after all, her foster father’s son, and in terms of seniority, her foster brother.
Yet now she couldn’t help this foster brother, but had to assist Lin Fan in dealing with him instead.
"This guy harassed my female student and even tried to have someone beat me, utterly reckless. Anna, help me break his legs." Lin Fan said calmly.
Anna was taken aback, damn, Lin Fan was ruthless!
But she couldn’t show any reluctance, knowing she had to break her foster brother’s legs herself.
"Okay." Anna said coldly, stepping forward to make a move.
Feng Tianming was scared out of his wits, quickly begging for mercy: "No, no, don’t do it! Let’s talk it out, Teacher Lin, I know I was wrong, please forgive me?"
Lin Fan gestured for Anna to pause, saying coldly, "What did you realize was wrong?"
Feng Tianming looked pitiful: "I shouldn’t have sent people to beat you."
Lin Fan said, "What else?"
Feng Tianming glanced at Chu Xiaoxiao and said, "I... I won’t harass her anymore."
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound: "Alright then, I prefer reasoning over violence. Consider this a small lesson. Since you’ve admitted your mistake, I’ll let you go this time. But if it happens again, and I find out you’re still bothering Chu Xiaoxiao, I will not only break your legs, but all of them will be completely crippled."
Feng Tianming nodded quickly: "Understood, I won’t dare again!"
Lin Fan said coldly, "You have one minute to disappear before my eyes."
Feng Tianming hurriedly endured the pain, getting up, and the four burly men, supporting each other, managed to get up, fleeing in disarray.
Seeing Feng Tianming leave, Anna secretly breathed a sigh of relief. If Lin Fan had insisted on having her break Feng Tianming’s legs, she wouldn’t know how to explain it to her foster father.
Reflecting on this, she felt a bit grateful to Lin Fan for some reason.
Feng Xiaoxiao was already stunned by now. Though the scene seemed lengthy, it hadn’t taken long.
Anna taking down the four burly men was a brief moment’s work.
This sister was way too strong, no wonder Teacher Lin had remained unflustered when he learned Feng Tianming planned to have him beaten, having such a formidable subordinate!
"Xiaoxiao, let’s go." Lin Fan returned to Feng Xiaoxiao’s side, smiling.
Feng Xiaoxiao was about to agree.
At that moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
Lin Fan checked the phone, seeing it was Zhang Dafu calling.
"Boss, something’s not right, someone’s causing trouble at our construction site!" Zhang Dafu said anxiously.
Lin Fan furrowed his brows and turned to Anna: "Anna, hold on, come with me to the construction site."

chapters.title: Chapter 138: How much are they paying you? I’ll give 10 times more.
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138: How much are they paying you? I’ll give 10 times more.
Feng Tianming, leading four almost-crippled strongmen, fled in panic. It was only after they were far enough away that they dared to stop and catch their breath.
Too terrifying!
Just now was really too terrifying.
The four strongmen were no match for Anna, who rubbed them into the ground. One of the strongmen even had his shin bone broken by Anna.
At this moment, they all had expressions like they’d just seen a ghost, still in shock.
Feng Tianming himself got punched by Lin Fan and kicked, but fortunately, Lin Fan wasn’t a martial artist, so the injuries weren’t too serious.
Logically, Feng Tianming fighting Lin Fan was like two chickens pecking at each other since they were both ordinary people. Unfortunately, Lin Fan was slick as a ghost and struck first.
When Feng Tianming wanted to fight Lin Fan, Anna intervened, and Lin Fan ended up unharmed.
Feng Tianming was indignant, gritting his teeth in hatred: "Unbelievable, I’ve never suffered such a big loss in my life, there’s no way I can just swallow this!"
The four strongmen looked at each other.
"Young Master Feng, you still want to find trouble with him? Didn’t you say to let it go?"
"We can’t handle that woman."
Feng Tianming snorted coldly: "What are you afraid of, do you think I can rely on you useless lot?"
Just then, Feng Tianming’s phone rang.
"How did it go, Young Master Feng, did the four people I found for you teach that kid a lesson?"
A man on the other end of the phone said.
Feng Tianming smiled bitterly: "Brother Dashui, this time it went wrong, your guys got beaten up by a woman."
Feng Tianming explained the situation.
Brother Dashui was astonished: "No way, is there such a powerful woman!"
Feng Tianming said: "Yes, if I hadn’t swallowed my pride, my legs would have been broken too. Brother Dashui, what do you think we should do? I can’t just let this go!"
Brother Dashui thought for a moment and said: "Don’t worry, Young Master Feng, once I take someone’s money, I solve their problems. I’ll help you figure this out. I happen to know an expert who can definitely help you turn the tide!"
Feng Tianming asked: "What kind of expert?"
Brother Dashui said: "A Qi Gong Master, Master Liu. It’s said he can knock down an ox through a mountain, meaning he can strike people down with his Qi even through several others, impressive, right?"
Feng Tianming was overjoyed: "Is there really such a powerful person? Hurry and get him for me!"
With hope for revenge, Feng Tianming went home elated.
Shendiao Old Factory.
In recent days, the demolition and construction project was proceeding vigorously.
A few days ago, Lin Fan acquired the land of Shendiao Old Factory and instructed Zhang Dafu to take charge of the construction. Soon, the largest factory in Yun City would be erected here.
Everything was progressing smoothly, but this morning, suddenly a gang of thugs came to disrupt the construction, attacking people and smashing things on sight.
The thugs threatened to stop the work, saying if it continued, they would come daily to cause chaos.
Zhang Dafu immediately reported to the police. The police took notes but said it was not possible to deploy police force to help maintain order at the construction site, and asked Zhang Dafu to find ways to strengthen security himself.
Zhang Dafu then informed Lin Fan of the situation.
After receiving the news, Lin Fan, accompanied by Chu Xiaoxiao, headed to the site, with Anna following on her motorcycle.
Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao arrived first and spoke to Zhang Dafu to understand the situation.
"Do you know who they are?" Lin Fan asked.
Zhang Dafu smiled wryly: "I don’t know, I asked them, but they wouldn’t say."
At the moment, Zhang Dafu’s face was bruised and swollen, obviously beaten up. Many people on the site were in a similar condition to Zhang Dafu.
"Boss, everyone is panicking now. Some people are afraid to continue working and have resigned," Zhang Dafu said.
Lin Fan said: "It should be the underground thugs, could they be trying to extort money?"
There was nothing new about gangsters collecting protection money.
But Zhang Dafu shook his head and said: "I initially thought so too and planned to spend some money to solve the problem, but they don’t want money, they only want us to stop work."
Lin Fan frowned; if they don’t want money, then it’s not the usual protection racket, someone is directing them to deliberately cause trouble!
Perhaps expanding Blue Moon’s factory made someone jealous!
Lin Fan thought for a moment. He indeed had made a few enemies recently, such as Red Sun, who was competing with Blue Moon, or Feng Wanshan. He couldn’t be sure who was behind this.
"Oh no, they’re here again!"
Suddenly cries of alarm sounded.
A gang of thugs rushed into the construction site.
Zhang Dafu exclaimed: "Boss, it’s them!"
Lin Fan looked over. These thugs were mostly robust young men, with crazy hairstyles dyed yellow, wielding iron rods, looking ferocious and arrogant.
The leader had frizzy red-yellow hair and a scar on his face, looking menacing. He shouted out loud.
"Damn it, you don’t take me seriously, huh? Still daring to work! Beat them up, smash these bastards to death!"
The workers were so frightened they dropped their tools and fled in panic.
The thug gang received the order and began to smash and beat.
Lin Fan quickly called Anna: "Anna, have you arrived yet?"
Anna said: "Not yet, there’s a little problem. My bike got into an accident, still dealing with it."
Lin Fan had no choice but to say: "Alright, try to get here as soon as possible!"
Anna said: "I got it, Master."
On a street corner, Anna put down her phone with a cold smirk.
She intentionally caused the delay, ensuring she couldn’t get to the site.
Earlier, she received a call from Feng Wanshan, telling her today Feng Wanshan would send people to cause trouble at Lin Fan’s construction site. Knowing Lin Fan would definitely rely on Anna, Feng Wanshan informed her in advance to find an excuse to stay away.
Without Anna’s help, Lin Fan would definitely get beaten.
Lin Fan indeed relied on Anna, and at this crucial time, Anna was indisposed.
Lin Fan had no choice but to face this on his own.
"Hold it!"
Lin Fan said loudly, stepping forward.
The thug leader signaled the thugs to pause, his gaze landing on Lin Fan: "Who are you?"
Lin Fan said: "I’m the owner here."
The thug leader gave an "oh" and chuckled: "So you’re Lin Fan!"
Curious, Lin Fan asked: "You know me? Who sent you?"
The thug leader laughed: "Who sent us isn’t important. The important thing is someone doesn’t like you. You’re just in time, get ready for a beating. You’re not working today, and if you dare to reopen, we’ll come smash things every day!"
Lin Fan said: "How much did they give you? I’ll pay you double!"
The thug leader laughed out loud: "Kid, money isn’t everything. In this line of work, we have principles!"
Lin Fan said: "I’ll offer ten times as much."
The thug leader almost knelt hearing this, his face twitching: "K-kid, stop it, I said we have principles, don’t push me!"
"Twenty times." Lin Fan said calmly.
The thug leader’s legs went weak, and he knelt before Lin Fan: "Y-you’re really going to give us two million?"
Lin Fan noted silently, realizing the thugs had been hired for just 10,000 yuan to cause trouble.
Everyone present sweated coldly, seeing this thug leader, who firmly claimed to have principles, ultimately swayed by money.
Sometimes money truly is omnipotent!

chapters.title: Chapter 139 Lin Fan: I really am messing with you
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139 Lin Fan: I really am messing with you
Although Lin Fan couldn’t fight, he had money, and sometimes cash worked better than anything else.
These thugs were here for money, after all, it was all about making money. Even though they have a certain code among criminals, with enough money, those codes could be easily set aside.
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, but I have one condition. Tell me who sent you."
The scar-faced man looked around and said, "I can only tell you that alone."
Lin Fan then asked Zhang Dafu to bring over some paper and a pen for the scar-faced man to write down the name.
The scar-faced man scribbled a name, folded the paper, and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan opened the paper and saw the name: Feng Wanshan!
Lin Fan chuckled. So it was Feng Wanshan. No wonder Anna hadn’t come over yet—Feng Wanshan must have ordered her not to intervene.
The scar-faced man then said, "Mr. Lin, give me the money and this all will be over. I promise Hu Dahai won’t bother you anymore!"
Lin Fan replied, "Give you money? What do you mean by give you money?"
The scar-faced man was stunned and then shouted angrily, "Didn’t you just say you’d pay me twenty times the money? Are you playing with me?"
Everyone was drenched in sweat. Damn it, Lin Fan was being so shameless!
Lin Fan smiled, "Yes, I was playing you. You guys came to beat up my people and disrupt my project, and I still have to ask you for compensation. How could I possibly give you money? You’re dreaming."
The scar-faced man was furious, "You punk, you’re asking for it! I’ll ask you again, are you paying or not?"
"You’re extorting me?"
Lin Fan chuckled and then shouted, "Officer, you can come out now!"
Suddenly, Loli burst in with a gang of police officers, surrounding the thugs.
"Nobody move!" Loli shouted loudly.
It turned out they were already lying in ambush outside, just waiting for Lin Fan’s signal.
The gangsters were scared out of their wits.
The scar-faced Hu Dahai turned pale as he realized he had walked right into Lin Fan’s trap.
"You punk, you dared to set me up!" Hu Dahai roared in rage.
Lin Fan smiled slightly. On the way here, he considered that if the thugs came to cause trouble again, he would need help. Although Anna was strong, she wasn’t his person and he couldn’t fully trust her. To be safe, he made a second plan and called Loli for assistance.
This arrangement was wise because, indeed, the thugs had come back, and this time, they hit the muzzle.
Soon, Hu Dahai and the gang of thugs were all apprehended by the police.
Hu Dahai was filled with hatred and said viciously, "Lin Fan, just you wait. When I get out, I won’t let you off!"
Lin Fan turned and asked Zhang Dafu, "Did you get it all on record?"
He had previously instructed Zhang Dafu to film his negotiations with the scar-faced man.
Zhang Dafu nodded, "Yes, it’s all recorded."
Lin Fan nodded and then looked at Hu Dahai, smiling, "Don’t worry, I’ll have my lawyer sue you. For extorting a huge amount of money and causing damages to our personal and property rights, you won’t see me for at least ten years. Forgot to mention, my lawyer is from Xingquan Law Firm."
Hu Dahai was scared out of his wits when he heard that.
Xingquan Law Firm, notorious for never losing a case!
Hu Dahai suddenly realized he might really be doomed.
"Mr. Lin, I’m sorry, I was wrong, please spare me, be generous!" Hu Dahai’s legs went weak, and he quickly begged for mercy.
Lin Fan simply ignored him.
Loli snapped, "Stop wasting words. Even if Lin Fan spares you, I won’t. Take them away!"
Hu Dahai and the others were forcibly taken away by the police, and what awaited them was jail time.
Loli stayed behind, her face serious, "Lin Fan, may I speak with you privately?"
Lin Fan said, "Sure, come to my office."
So, the two went to the office and closed the door.
Loli immediately dropped her serious face, looking shy and looking at Lin Fan with starry eyes. Upon receiving the call for help from her idol, she came over immediately.
As a police officer, it was her duty to uphold justice, not to mention her idol was in trouble; it was a perfect opportunity to see him.
"Thank you today, I owe you one." Lin Fan smiled.
Loli’s eyes sparkled as she giggled, "Really? So how do you plan to repay me?"
Lin Fan replied, "How would you like me to repay you?"
Loli blushed and said, "Come have dinner at my place tonight. My mom said she wants to meet you... It’s all Aunt Song’s fault for being such a gossip, telling her about that day!"
Lin Fan laughed, "You still want me to pretend to be your boyfriend? It’s not right to deceive my future mother-in-law, is it?"
Loli sweat, you already consider her your mother-in-law, and you say it’s not right!
"I don’t care, you said you owe me, you can’t go back on your word!" Loli said, sounding rather justified.
Lin Fan sighed, "Alright, I’ll come over for dinner tonight."
Loli was thrilled; her mom had given her a political mission, and she hadn’t known how to broach the topic with Lin Fan before. She finally succeeded in completing the mission!
Loli remembered something and said seriously, "Oh, Lin Fan, that Hu Dahai just wrote you a note about who invited him to cause trouble. Who was it?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "That, I won’t say for now. Officer, you don’t need to ask about it either. I’ll handle it."
Lin Fan coldly laughed inside, knowing Anna should be arriving soon.
Outside the construction site.
Anna stopped her motorcycle, surprised seeing the police escorting the thugs into police cars!
What happened?
Anna was somewhat bewildered but soon saw Lin Fan walking out unharmed, accompanied by a beautiful policewoman.
Dang!
It turned out Lin Fan was unscathed, and the thugs got busted by the police!
Foster father initially wanted to take out his anger on Lin Fan, but it seemed they miscalculated this time.
After the police left.
Anna approached Lin Fan, "I’m sorry, master, I’m late. What happened? Are you alright?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m fine. That group came to cause trouble again, but fortunately, I reported it to the police and caught them. Also, I’ve found out who sent them."
Anna was taken aback, keeping a calm exterior, "Who was it?"
Lin Fan looked at her and said, "Feng Wanshan."
Anna was a bit surprised, "Him? Could it be because of last night’s incident that he held a grudge against you?"
Lin Fan said, "It seems so. Anna, I need you to do something. Teach Feng Wanshan a lesson for me."
Feng Family Mansion.
Feng Wanshan was leisurely sitting at home, sipping tea while waiting for good news.
In the morning, he had sent Hu Dahai to Lin Fan’s construction site to cause trouble. After Anna informed him, he found out Lin Fan was at the site, so he sent Hu Dahai there again and instructed Anna to find an excuse to leave.
This way, Lin Fan would have no one to help him, leaving him to take a beating.
He wouldn’t be satisfied until Lin Fan got beaten up.
But before he could hear back about Lin Fan, he saw his son, Feng Tianming, come in with a battered face!
Feng Wanshan’s face darkened, "You useless brat! Were you beaten by Lin Fan? Your disgrace has brought shame to your father’s face!"
Feng Tianming was stunned. How did his father know Lin Fan beat him?
"Dad, you know who beat me? How did you know?" Feng Tianming asked, surprised.
Feng Wanshan naturally heard it from Anna, who took the opportunity to tell him, explaining her helpless situation only allowed her to assist Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan couldn’t blame Anna, which only intensified his annoyance with Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan replied, "No need to concern yourself with how I know. Just know your father will get your revenge."
Feng Tianming was delighted, "Dad, you’re getting revenge for me?"
Feng Wanshan proudly said, "Yes, soon there’ll be good news."
At that moment, Feng Wanshan’s phone rang.
Feng Wanshan answered the call, his face changed instantly, and he jumped up from the sofa, his face twisted with anger.
"What? Hu Dahai and they were arrested? Lin Fan is perfectly fine?"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Convenience Store Robber
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 140: Convenience Store Robber
Feng Wanshan jumped up in anger.
According to his plan, after Lin Fan arrived at the construction site, he would be beaten up by Hu Dahai and his men. To ensure Lin Fan got properly beaten, he even specifically had Anna find an excuse to disappear.
Indeed, everything went according to his plan. Lin Fan was lured to the construction site, and Anna successfully vanished.
However, the outcome was that Hu Dahai’s gang was completely nabbed by the police, with Lin Fan unharmed!
And incredibly, Lin Fan managed to extract from Hu Dahai that Feng Wanshan was the mastermind pulling the strings!
Even worse, the most infuriating thing for Feng Wanshan was that Lin Fan actually wanted Anna to teach him a lesson!
"What exactly does he want you to do to me?" Feng Wanshan asked in a low voice.
Anna replied, "He wants one of your ears as a reminder for you."
"What?"
Feng Wanshan was almost furious to death, jumping up and down in rage, "How dare he!"
Anna said, "Godfather, what do you plan to do? I am currently his housekeeper, unless you want me to resign, otherwise, I must follow his orders. Do you want me to resign?"
Feng Wanshan said, "No! You are my trump card, I still need you to help me find Lin Beixuan, how can I give up halfway? Let me think about how to handle this, wait for my news!"
Feng Wanshan hung up the phone, sitting down angrily.
Upon seeing the injury on his son’s face, knowing that it was inflicted by Lin Fan, he got even angrier, "Useless thing, get out of here!"
Feng Tianming felt very aggrieved and said, "Dad, didn’t you just say you’d avenge me?"
Feng Wanshan snorted coldly, "Avenge my ass, my men were also dealt with by Lin Fan!"
Feng Tianming was shocked: "Really? Could it be that woman by Lin Fan’s side again, that woman is truly terrifying. Dad, we need to find an expert."
The woman he spoke of was Anna, but Feng Wanshan didn’t want to reveal Anna’s identity to Feng Tianming and pretended not to know, "The woman you mentioned, is she very formidable?"
Feng Tianming said, "Extremely formidable, the four strong men I brought along had almost no power to resist in front of her."
Feng Wanshan pondered, Lin Fan wanted Anna to take his ear, he definitely wouldn’t comply, but at the same time, he couldn’t expose Anna. The best solution was to find an expert to counter Anna.
Feng Tianming’s phone rang at this moment.
Feng Tianming answered the call, delightedly saying, "Really? That’s great, arrange for a meeting quickly!"
After hanging up, Feng Tianming said, "Dad, I’ve found an expert!"
Feng Wanshan curiously asked, "What expert?"
Feng Tianming said, "It’s a Qi Gong Master, reportedly very powerful. This time, we will definitely handle that woman!"
Feng Wanshan said, "A Qi Gong Master? He better be, bring him over for me to see. This time, I must teach Lin Fan a proper lesson!"
By this time, Lin Fan had already left the construction site with Chu Xiaoxiao.
Before leaving, Lin Fan instructed Zhang Dafu that the Company would cover medical expenses for all employees who were beaten today, and they would also receive double wages to stabilize the morale.
Furthermore, Lin Fan asked Zhang Dafu to find some security personnel to maintain order at the construction site and prevent any more troublemakers from showing up.
Zhang Dafu complied with all the instructions, and indeed, as soon as the news of medical expenses and double wages got out, the workers who had been scared off all returned.
Zhang Dafu couldn’t help but sigh that having money indeed made things easier. The boss taught him a lesson in the power of money today.
Lin Fan’s financial power was indeed impressive; for instance, he used twenty times the reward to move Hu Dahai, leading Hu Dahai to directly betray Feng Wanshan.
But financial power isn’t truly omnipotent. Feng Wanshan’s failure today probably wouldn’t make him stop at this.
He made Anna clash with Feng Wanshan, and Feng Wanshan would inevitably find a way to retaliate. The outcome was still uncertain.
In case Feng Wanshan, in a fit of rage, decided to expose Anna’s identity and make a move against him, he would be doomed.
He certainly wasn’t a match for Anna.
Lin Fan was gambling that Feng Wanshan wouldn’t want to expose Anna’s identity so soon.
But gambling involves risk and gain...
Lin Fan felt uncertain, pondering his next move.
"Teacher Lin, you were incredible at the construction site just now," Chu Xiaoxiao said with a smile at this time.
She had witnessed the whole process with her own eyes. Lin Fan toyed with Hu Dahai and then let the police in ambush arrest Hu Dahai and the others. Teacher Lin was like a wise commander, and she admired Teacher Lin greatly.
Lin Fan chuckled, "It was nothing. I can’t fight, otherwise, I wouldn’t have gone to such trouble and would have dealt with them directly."
Chu Xiaoxiao giggled, "Teacher Lin, you say you can’t fight, but you beat Feng Tianming pretty badly."
