Lin Fan said, "What happened between me and Feng Tianming was like amateurs pecking at each other. When dealing with someone like Hu Dahai, reasoning is required."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Alright, but Teacher Lin has Sister Anna, and Sister Anna is so formidable that no one can bully Teacher Lin."
Lin Fan smiled bitterly in his heart; naturally, he couldn’t tell Chu Xiaoxiao that Anna wasn’t on his side.
"Let’s not talk about this. You must be hungry. We’ll go eat first and then take you to buy a bicycle," Lin Fan changed the subject.
"Okay," Chu Xiaoxiao glanced out the car window and said, "Teacher Lin, I’m a little thirsty. There’s a convenience store over there. Could you drop me off to buy a bottle of water?"
Lin Fan then drove the car to the convenience store and let Chu Xiaoxiao get off.
Chu Xiaoxiao got out of the car and trotted into the convenience store.
Lin Fan waited for her in the car.
Suddenly, a man wearing a pair of stockings over his head with two holes cut out around the eyes appeared out of nowhere, sneakily entering the convenience store with a small knife in hand.
Lin Fan was taken aback. This was a robber!
Worried about Chu Xiaoxiao, Lin Fan didn’t think twice and hurriedly got out of the car, running into the convenience store.
Inside the convenience store, there was only Chu Xiaoxiao as a customer, besides a female store clerk.
The moment the robber entered, he immediately brandished the knife, threatening the female clerk and demanding that she hand over the money.
"Open the cash register, hand over the money obediently, and don’t entertain any thoughts of luck, or I won’t be polite!" the robber threatened menacingly.
The female clerk was so scared that her face turned pale, her whole body trembling, and she dared not resist, quickly opening the cash register.
Chu Xiaoxiao, who was beside her, was stunned in fright, and a bottle of mineral water in her hand dropped to the ground with a smack.
The robber glanced at Chu Xiaoxiao, his eyes lighting up, and he lewdly grinned, "Damn, there’s such a pretty little beauty in this place. Little beauty, don’t be scared. Come over and let me have a feel."
Chu Xiaoxiao was so petrified that she couldn’t move.
The robber glared, angrily saying, "You little slut, come over here at once, or believe it or not, I’ll slash that pretty face of yours with a knife."
The robber raised the knife, threatening Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s gaze fell on the robber’s back just then.
At this moment, before the robber could react, suddenly, a hand swiftly reached over from behind the robber and grabbed the robber’s knife-wielding hand, attempting to seize the knife.
Lin Fan!
The robber realized what was happening, struggled violently, and started wrestling with Lin Fan.
"You brat, are you looking for death!" the robber growled menacingly.
"You beast, robbing money is one thing, but you have the nerve to make plans for her?" Lin Fan snapped angrily.
In the scuffle, the two fell to the ground. The robber’s strength was evidently greater than Lin Fan’s, and it looked like he was about to regain the knife.
Suddenly, Lin Fan noticed several cases of bottled beer stacked nearby. He quickly grabbed one and smashed it forcefully onto the robber’s head.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: The Powerful New Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 141: The Powerful New Reward
Smack!
The beer bottle shattered instantly, drenching the robber from head to toe in beer.
The robber was briefly stunned by the smash.
Lin Fan struck out in anger, showing no mercy, grabbing another beer bottle and smashing it over the robber’s head before he could react.
With another smack, it shattered.
"Let’s see if you dare lay a finger on her again, I’ll smash you to pieces!" Lin Fan shouted angrily.
He picked up a third bottle...
A fourth...
In one breath, he smashed ten beer bottles, all aimed at the robber’s forehead.
By the time the tenth beer bottle shattered, the robber was already bloody-headed, covered in beer, and fainted on the spot.
With a smack, the knife dropped from his hand to the floor.
Lin Fan was also exhausted, climbing up from the ground, and kicked the knife away, gasping heavily.
Beside him, Chu Xiaoxiao and the shop assistant were stunned.
That was so brutal, Lin Fan couldn’t have been more ruthless, yet smashing those bottles felt so satisfying.
Immediately, the two of them were insanely happy.
"Teacher Lin is so handsome, he was protecting me just now, that’s why he was so fierce. What should I do? I’m so in awe of him!" Chu Xiaoxiao’s heart fluttered wildly, her cheeks reddened.
The shop assistant was also struck by Lin Fan’s handsomeness and planned to thank him.
Just then.
Lin Fan heard a voice sounding in his mind.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: You can check in today, and upon checking in, you will be rewarded with a dose of top-tier Strength Serum. Would you like to check in immediately?"
Lin Fan was taken aback internally; the system’s check-in was a bit delayed today, and what’s with the reward?
"Check in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations, host. Check-in successful, Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules have been delivered, please check your receipt."
Instantly, Lin Fan felt something extra in his pocket. He reached in and pulled out a small red capsule!
Is this the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules?
"Ding!"
"Information on the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules has been collected. Would you like to read it immediately?"
"Read!"
A stream of information surged into Lin Fan’s mind.
"Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, as the name implies, consuming this capsule will transform the host’s body, making it more powerful than ever. Not only will it enhance physical fitness, but also provide immense strength. The host is advised to practice mastering force to avoid unnecessary tragedies."
After understanding the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, Lin Fan was somewhat delighted. Having just finished fighting with the robber and being exhausted, the capsule was perfect to replenish his energy.
He tossed the capsule into his mouth and swallowed it.
The Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules immediately melted within Lin Fan’s body, transforming into a stream that flowed swiftly through his entire system.
Originally breathless, Lin Fan suddenly stopped gasping, feeling invigorated, with his physique turning formidable and his hands surging with strength.
This overwhelming feeling of power made Lin Fan eager to find a place to unleash it.
"What’s going on, old man, what’s wrong with you?"
At this moment, another burly man with a stocking over his head walked in from outside. When he saw the robber on the ground, he exclaimed in shock.
Another robber had actually shown up!
Chu Xiaoxiao and the shop assistant were frightened, their faces turning pale again.
Damn, could they be any more unlucky?
This time the robber was a burly man; Lin Fan was definitely no match. Lin Fan had already struggled considerably with the previous robber.
"Was it you who beat him like this?" The burly man glared angrily at Lin Fan and roared.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It was me."
He had just swallowed the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, his body filled with power, but nowhere to vent it. The burly man came just in time for him to test his strength.
The burly man cursed, "You brat, you’ve got guts, then feel the taste of my fist and see if you can take it!"
With that, the burly man lunged at Lin Fan, raising his fist to smash it towards Lin Fan’s face.
"Ah!"
Chu Xiaoxiao and the shop assistant screamed, shutting their eyes, too scared to watch.
Lin Fan was no match for this burly man; he was bound to be beaten badly this time.
However, before the burly man’s fist could reach Lin Fan, Lin Fan suddenly extended his hand and grabbed the burly man’s fist tightly.
Crack!
The sound of bones breaking.
"Ah!"
The burly man let out a heart-wrenching scream, suddenly finding his fist crushed by Lin Fan.
Yes, crushed. The bones in his entire hand were completely shattered.
The burly man was in so much pain his face twisted, cold sweat pouring out, and he involuntarily knelt on the ground.
Lin Fan was also startled, quickly releasing his grip, and said apologetically, "I’m really sorry, I didn’t control the force properly."
He certainly hadn’t controlled the force. Based on the system information, after consuming the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, you need to practice to control force levels properly. Lin Fan hadn’t practiced and was forced into a fight, which naturally led to these circumstances.
It seemed like he needed more practice to adapt to the immense power within his body.
Lin Fan consoled himself mentally.
Lin Fan’s words left the burly man both shocked and angered. Shocked because he wondered if this brat was truly human; how could a human possess such strength to crush his hand instantly? Angered because this kid obviously treated him like a joke.
The burly man reached to his waist with his other hand, drawing out a knife, and thrusting it viciously towards Lin Fan.
However, in the next moment, his hand was empty as the knife was already in Lin Fan’s hand. He lunged forward but lost his momentum and fell on the ground.
Lin Fan crouched down, drove the knife down, piercing it through the burly man’s palm and pinning his hand to the ground.
"Ah!"
The burly man let out another heart-wrenching scream.
An astonishing scene unfolded. Lin Fan gently twisted, bending the knife as easily as one might twist a plastic straw.
The burly man was in unbearable pain, his eyes rolling back, fainting on the spot.
This nightmare-inducing scene would haunt him for the rest of his life, making him tremble and shiver during midnight dreams.
Beside him, Chu Xiaoxiao and the shop assistant were already gawking.
If Lin Fan could win against the first robber because he put in all his effort and luck favored him, then this time, his fight against the burly man was simply overpowering.
What was going on?
How did Lin Fan suddenly become this powerful?
This shock was extraordinarily intense, almost disturbingly strong!
Lin Fan raised his eyes, looked at the shop assistant, and smiled, "I’ve subdued the criminals, you can call the police now."
The shop assistant snapped back to reality, nodding timidly; Lin Fan’s formidable prowess scared her too.
Lin Fan turned to Chu Xiaoxiao and said, "Let’s go."
"Okay." Chu Xiaoxiao came to her senses, hurriedly picked up the bottle of water and walked over, "Sister, check please."
The shop assistant quickly said, "No need, it’s on the house."
She dared not ask for money as Chu Xiaoxiao was with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you, then."
He turned and left with Chu Xiaoxiao.
As they departed, the shop assistant quickly picked up the phone to call the police.
Half an hour later.
Police sirens wailed.
Loli arrived with several officers.
They were all stunned by the scene before them.
Two robbers, one was beaten bloody with beer bottles, and the other was even worse, with one fist seemingly crushed by someone, the other hand pinned to the ground with a knife.
"What the heck happened here?" The crowd exclaimed. Since becoming officers, they had never seen such a brutal scene.
Loli looked at the shop assistant, "Who beat them up like this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Lin Fan was despised for being rich
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 142: Lin Fan was despised for being rich
"He’s a handsome guy, really good-looking!"
"He struggled with the robber for the knife and then smashed a beer bottle on the robber’s head..."
"And when the second robber came in, trying to hit him, he beat him up like this."
The female store attendant was recounting the incident.
The police officers were listening, completely baffled.
Loli asked, "Wait, it’s clear that the first robber got smashed with a few beer bottles; what about the second robber? His hand is completely crushed—what was used to do that?"
The female store attendant looked at Loli, her expression a bit odd: "He crushed it with his hand."
Loli was surprised: "Crushed it? Are you saying he crushed that big guy’s hand with his bare hand?"
Everyone else laughed: "How is that possible?"
"What a joke!"
But the female store attendant nodded: "Yes, I saw it with my own eyes. He crushed the guy’s fist with his hand, then took his knife and pinned him to the ground."
The police officers stopped laughing, looking at each other in disbelief; this store attendant didn’t seem to be joking!
Could there really be such formidable people in the world?
Loli thought for a moment and said, "Take these two men away and treat their injuries first. Get the surveillance from here; I want to see what really happened."
The convenience store’s surveillance footage was quickly pulled up.
Unfortunately, the surveillance was damaged, and the images inside couldn’t be seen clearly; it would need repairs to view it.
Loli had no choice but to keep asking the female store attendant, "What did that person look like? Can you describe him again?"
The female store attendant said, "He was around his twenties, extremely handsome, though his clothes were a bit plain. But he drove a supercar and was with a pretty girl."
The female store attendant described Lin Fan’s situation.
Loli was a bit surprised. Why does this young guy sound so much like someone she knew—Lin Fan?
No way!
Her heartthrob, she knew he was handsome and wealthy, but she hadn’t heard he could fight, let alone this fiercely?
Loli decided she would quickly repair the surveillance to see if this person really was Lin Fan.
After leaving the convenience store, Lin Fan drove back to the city with Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Teacher Lin, you lied to me!" As soon as Chu Xiaoxiao got in the car, she said.
Lin Fan replied, "How did I lie to you?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "You said you couldn’t fight, but you were obviously hiding your skills. In that emergency, you couldn’t hide it anymore!"
Lin Fan found it amusing. He hadn’t lied to Chu Xiaoxiao before; he was indeed just an ordinary person until the system rewarded him with a Strength Serum, which made him stronger.
But this wasn’t easy to explain to Chu Xiaoxiao, so he said, "Alright, I did keep it a secret before. To be honest, I’m a Martial Arts Master. Usually, I don’t reveal this. It’s my secret; will you help me keep it?"
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded: "Yes."
She was secretly delighted. Great, now she and Teacher Lin have a secret, and having a secret to keep means their relationship isn’t "simple."
"Teacher Lin, you say you’re a Martial Arts Master, but aren’t Martial Arts Masters only in Martial Arts Novels or TV shows? Do they really exist in real life?" Chu Xiaoxiao asked, curious.
Lin Fan replied seriously, "That’s something you don’t know. Martial Arts Masters do exist, but ordinary people rarely see them. Even if they do, most of them are frauds. True masters, like me, are very low-key."
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "Teacher Lin, when did you start practicing martial arts?"
Lin Fan cleared his throat: "That’s a long story. When I was a kid, I unintentionally apprenticed under an old man, learned martial arts from him, went through many hardships, and gained my current cultivation."
Chu Xiaoxiao exclaimed, "Wow, Teacher Lin, your experiences are just like something out of a Martial Arts Novel! I really envy you for having such an adventure. I wish I could learn martial arts too!"
Lin Fan found it amusing; he spouted nonsense, and Chu Xiaoxiao believed it.
All his strength was actually thanks to the system. At this moment, the power from the Strength Serum was still coursing through him. He needed practice to use it skillfully, so he was trying to suppress it for now to avoid losing control.
Soon, they were back in the city.
Lin Fan parked the car in front of a restaurant.
They got out, ready to go inside for a meal.
As soon as Chu Xiaoxiao got out of the car, she caught the attention of a burly man standing at the entrance.
This burly man, with bulging muscles, was wearing a tank top that showcased his strong arms and intimidating physique.
The burly man had just come out of the restaurant, with a toothpick in his mouth, looking at Chu Xiaoxiao mischievously. His eyes lit up as he pulled out his phone.
"Hey pretty girl, can I add you on WeChat?" the burly man chuckled, leering at Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit annoyed. Being good-looking really sucks sometimes; you keep running into people hitting on you, never-endingly annoying, especially like this burly man doing it on the street.
"Sorry." Chu Xiaoxiao politely shook her head, refusing, and tried to walk around him.
But the burly man wouldn’t let it go. He reached out to stop Chu Xiaoxiao, smiling, "Don’t be in such a hurry to leave, pretty girl. Can’t you give me some face?"
Meanwhile, a few more men came out of the restaurant, all wearing tank tops, obviously with this burly man.
Seeing this, the others gathered around to watch, laughing uproariously.
Chu Xiaoxiao frowned: "Please step aside!"
She had already politely refused, but the guy just wouldn’t take the hint—really annoying.
"Do you know him?"
Lin Fan walked over, asking Chu Xiaoxiao calmly.
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head: "No, I don’t."
Lin Fan nodded and looked at the burly man: "She doesn’t know you, so why should she give you face? You better leave; don’t cause trouble."
The burly man glanced at Lin Fan, then looked at the nearby Kosak: "Oh? Is this car yours?"
Lin Fan replied calmly: "Yes, so what?"
The burly man chuckled: "Rich guy, huh? Just by looking at you, I can tell you’re a Rich Second Generation! I can’t stand you privileged brats! That pretty girl must be your girlfriend, huh? Damn it, aren’t you all just wasting good girls with your daddy’s money!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "I’m not a Rich Second Generation."
If anything, he was the first generation of wealth. He really hadn’t relied on family money.
The burly man laughed: "Don’t tell me you made the money for this supercar all by yourself! You still say you’re not relying on daddy’s money?"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t need to explain anything to you. Let’s leave it here. Everyone go their separate ways."
With that, Lin Fan intended to go inside with Chu Xiaoxiao.
But the burly man blocked them, laughing, "I haven’t gotten the pretty girl’s WeChat yet, why the rush?"
Lin Fan said, "Stopping strangers on the street to ask for WeChat—do you think you’re really charming?"
In life, there are many people like this guy, who have an overinflated sense of self, radiating mysterious confidence, assuming they’re endlessly attractive, hitting on girls whenever they see them. In reality, they’re just unaware of how they’re perceived, looking foolish to others.
Clearly, this burly man was one of those people.
The burly man laughed: "Can’t you see these strong pecs of mine? No way I’m less charming than a puny Rich Second Generation like you!"
The other men around laughed loudly.
Indeed, no matter how you looked at it, Lin Fan didn’t seem as imposing as this burly man. In front of a gym buff, Lin Fan seemed like a frail scholar.
Lin Fan smiled: "Is that so? But she still rejected you, and it’s me having dinner with her."
The burly man’s smile froze.
Damn it!
That really hit where it hurts.
Lin Fan’s words were a real blow to his pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 Burly Man Cries Like a Woman Out of Fear
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 143 Burly Man Cries Like a Woman Out of Fear
The burly man was immediately a little enraged and snorted coldly, "I want to chat with the little beauty, get out of my way!"
Saying this, the burly man reached out to push Lin Fan’s shoulder, trying to push him aside.
With his arm strength, pushing aside Lin Fan should be an easy task, even throwing Lin Fan away wouldn’t be a problem.
The few men beside them thought the same. The burly man was the toughest among them, and none of them could match him, let alone Lin Fan, who looked weak.
This kid angered the burly man; he’s probably in for some bad luck!
It seemed like Lin Fan was going to end up like everyone expected, being pushed to the ground by the burly man.
However!
Under the burly man’s push, Lin Fan didn’t move at all!
Not even his shoulder twitched!
It was as if the burly man wasn’t pushing a person, but a wall — an iron wall!
What?
The men who were waiting to see the joke were frozen in their smiles, displaying looks of shock.
The burly man was also stunned, somewhat doubting reality. No way, he couldn’t push this kid?
It must be an illusion, right?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Trying to push me, huh? What, didn’t have lunch?"
This was truly a taunting remark.
Because the burly man just came out of a restaurant, full and content, how could he lack strength?
The burly man felt greatly humiliated, and couldn’t help but get furious: "Damn kid, I was just careless earlier. What are you so smug about? Watch me throw you out!"
With that, the burly man once again pushed Lin Fan vigorously.
This time he was serious, but still, Lin Fan didn’t budge an inch!
This was really awkward.
Unwilling to give up, the burly man grabbed Lin Fan’s shoulders with both hands, attempting to lift him and toss him out.
However, using all his strength, his face turned red, and he couldn’t lift Lin Fan at all!
Lin Fan stood like an iron pillar rooted to the ground!
Unmoved by the winds from any direction!
The burly man started sweating bullets, only then realizing that he might have messed with someone he shouldn’t have.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’ve tried for long enough, it’s my turn now."
Without any further ado, he lightly slapped the burly man’s shoulder.
An astonishing scene unfolded.
The burly man suddenly felt as if a mountain were pressing down on him, and he abruptly sat down on the ground, his backside heavily hitting the floor.
"Ah!"
The burly man let out a cry of agony, feeling like his rear had blossomed with pain, so piercing that he couldn’t even stand up for a moment.
Everyone around was dumbfounded.
If they hadn’t witnessed it themselves, they wouldn’t have believed it was real.
So awesome, how could such an incredible person exist!
"So, do you still want to hit on her? I don’t mind giving you another punch." Lin Fan said to the burly man.
The burly man burst into tears on the spot, crying like a girl: "I don’t dare anymore, big brother, please spare me!"
Lin Fan’s earlier slap nearly cost him half his life; if he received a punch, wouldn’t it take his life directly!
Lin Fan ignored the burly man further and said to Chu Xiaoxiao: "Let’s go in and eat, I’m starving to death, not even strong enough to hit people."
After saying that, Lin Fan led Chu Xiaoxiao around the burly man and walked into the restaurant.
Everyone knelt down, cold sweat running down.
Darn it, how could you call that lack of strength to hit people? If you were full, wouldn’t the burly man have been slapped to death?
What the hell kind of Immortal is this?
They must have been blind earlier, failing to see the true face of Mount Lu!
They hurriedly helped the burly man up, seeing him fall in such a miserable way, doing a complete split, his backside a bloody mess, he wouldn’t be getting out of bed for half a month.
Crying miserably, the burly man regretted bitterly inside; had he known Lin Fan was so powerful, he wouldn’t dare provoke Chu Xiaoxiao, even with ten guts.
Everyone was terrified from the bottom of their hearts, fearing Lin Fan, and quickly left with the burly man, not daring to linger a moment longer.
Inside the restaurant, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao found an empty seat to sit down.
Chu Xiaoxiao was thrilled inside, feeling immensely fortunate that if it weren’t for Lin Fan earlier, she would have been harassed by that burly man.
Someone like that, thinking they are charismatic, would surely persistently pester her.
If Lin Fan wasn’t so impressive, the scene earlier would have been uglier; Lin Fan would definitely have been pushed away and humiliated by the guy.
Fortunately, Teacher Lin is an expert.
Lin Fan’s performance earlier was truly handsome; it took her breath away, and she could barely hold herself together.
But then, a thought made her restrain her feelings, she wasn’t worthy of Teacher Lin!
She came from a poor background, while Teacher Lin was clearly a millionaire, not just driving a ten million luxury car, but also a boss, with even his assistant being someone as outstanding as Sister Anna.
Besides her beauty, how could she measure up to Lin Fan!
After struggling to reign in her feelings, Chu Xiaoxiao smiled and said, "Teacher Lin, thank you so much today, you’ve helped me a lot."
Lin Fan replied with a smile, "No need to be polite, it was a mere effort, let’s order food and eat."
Then Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao ate, and after the meal, Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao to buy a bicycle.
Meanwhile, at the Feng Family Mansion.
A black sedan drove to the mansion’s entrance, where the driver quickly got out and opened the rear door.
Waiting eagerly at the door for a long time, Feng Tianming beamed with delight and hurried forward.
A middle-aged man in traditional Chinese attire stepped out of the car, followed by a big fat man who respectfully followed him.
The middle-aged man was radiant, with a wisp of a beard on his chin and a strand of Buddhist beads in his hand, his demeanor dismissive, as if he looked down on everyone, like an Immortal with airs.
Feng Tianming was impressed by the middle-aged man’s aura, respectfully bowing and smiling obsequiously, "Master Liu, I’ve been looking forward to your arrival."
The middle-aged man didn’t even bother to look at Feng Tianming directly and said, "I heard someone here wants to witness my might?"
Feng Tianming smiled, "Yes, my father has been waiting inside for a long time, Master Liu, please come with me."
Feng Tianming then led the two people into the mansion.
In the hall, Feng Wanshan sat on the sofa with his legs crossed, waiting patiently.
Feng Tianming brought the middle-aged man and the big fat man in.
"Dad, Master Liu is here." Feng Tianming said excitedly.
Feng Wanshan didn’t stand up, nor did he change his sitting posture, he sized up the middle-aged man in Chinese attire, "Are you the Qi Gong Master Liu, my son mentioned?"
The middle-aged man seemed undisturbed by Feng Wanshan’s indifference, he was even more arrogant than Feng Wanshan, "That’s right, I’m Liu Guoping, a full-level Tai Chi Qi Gong master, my skills are unfathomable, especially good at hitting the bull through the mountain!"
Feng Wanshan squinted his eyes, "Full-level?"
Liu Guoping said, "If Mr. Feng doesn’t believe me, I can demonstrate for you. Little Fatty, get ready!"
The accompanying big fat man stepped forward and stood in the center.
Liu Guoping began to gather his energy and exert his power, waving his hands and feet like in a fit, actually quite intimidating.
Suddenly, Liu Guoping shouted sharply, as if he had completed the energy build-up, and struck his palms into the air.
The fat man’s belly suddenly shrank as if hit by an invisible force, he stumbled back three steps, spitting out a mouthful of blood, and ultimately couldn’t support himself, falling on his butt.
Feng Tianming was so surprised his eyes nearly popped out: "Damn, that’s incredible!"
Even Feng Wanshan was surprised and stood up.
Liu Guoping said coldly, "How about it, if it’s not enough, you can come up and try."
Feng Tianming hurriedly said, "Enough, more than enough, Master Liu, you’re truly remarkable, is this master alright?"
Liu Guoping said indifferently, "He’s thick-skinned, won’t matter, besides I just used less than 10% of my power."
Feng Tianming was shocked, merely 10% of his power, yet he made a fat guy vomit blood, if Master Liu used his full strength, who could withstand it!
Feng Wanshan also got excited, laughing, "Hahaha... nice, this time, I can really deal with Lin Fan!"
He immediately took out his phone, "Anna, I’ve found the expert, let’s proceed with the plan tonight!"

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Let Chu Xiaoxiao Pretend to Be a Girlfriend
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 144: Let Chu Xiaoxiao Pretend to Be a Girlfriend
Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao to buy a bicycle, and as they arrived near a bike shop, Lin Fan suddenly got a call from Aunt Li, his landlady.
"Little Fan, I found you a blind date. She saw your photo and wants to meet you. Where are you now?" Aunt Li asked.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. This Aunt Li was really enthusiastic, again setting him up with a blind date. He replied, "I’m busy right now, maybe another day. Thank you, Aunt Li."
Aunt Li said, "The girl is going on a business trip soon and wants to meet you before she leaves. Little Fan, this girl is great, she doesn’t mind that you’re a delivery guy. You should seize the opportunity, once it’s gone, it’s gone..."
Lin Fan didn’t want to listen to her long-winded speech and said helplessly, "Alright, I’m at Phoenix Bicycle Shop right now."
Lin Fan gave her the address.
Aunt Li was delighted and said, "That’s great, we’re nearby. I’ll let the girl come to find you now. Little Fan, this is a rare opportunity, you should seize it."
After hanging up, Lin Fan sighed lightly. He was grateful for Aunt Li’s enthusiasm, but none of her setups had ever been reliable. If this girl wasn’t reliable either, he’d have to ask Aunt Li to stop this fussing.
Lin Fan glanced at Chu Xiaoxiao beside him and had an idea.
"Xiaoxiao, could you do me a favor?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Sure, Teacher Lin. Is there something you need my help with?"
Lin Fan replied, "Hmm, I’m supposed to meet a blind date soon. If necessary, I may need you to pretend to be my girlfriend."
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned, her face turning red. No way, Teacher Lin wants her to pretend to be his girlfriend?
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Is this request too much? If you can’t do it, never mind."
Chu Xiaoxiao quickly said, "No... I can... I mean, Teacher Lin has helped me so much today, it’s only right for me to do this."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s heart started to race. How could she not be willing? She was more than happy to, even if she had to be his real girlfriend. She would be overjoyed!
Ah, why was she daydreaming again? She couldn’t match up to Teacher Lin. Just being able to pretend to be Teacher Lin’s girlfriend was enough to satisfy her.
Seeing Chu Xiaoxiao agree, Lin Fan was very pleased. Chu Xiaoxiao was his trump card. If this blind date was reliable, he wouldn’t need to use her. But if not, he’d have to play this card.
Soon, Lin Fan drove to the front of the bicycle shop.
Seeing a top-of-the-line luxury car parked at the entrance, the people inside the store immediately looked over, very curious—coming in a supercar to buy a bicycle?
Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao got out of the car and walked into the shop.
"Are you two looking to buy a bicycle?" The shop owner enthusiastically approached.
Those who drive such top-notch luxury cars are either wealthy or noble, no need to neglect them.
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, she wants to buy a bicycle for school. Any good recommendations?"
"For a girl to ride, huh, over here." The shop owner enthusiastically began to introduce, leading the two to a row of brand new bicycles.
They started looking around.
Suddenly, Chu Xiaoxiao was attracted to one of the bicycles, a pink one, which was very appealing to a young lady.
Lin Fan laughed and asked, "Do you like it?"
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, "Yes."
Lin Fan said, "Then this is the one. Boss, how much is this bicycle?"
The shop owner smiled and said, "You two have great taste. This bicycle is from a big brand, with speed-changing functions, making it smooth and effortless to pedal. The price is also quite fair, just 600 yuan."
Chu Xiaoxiao stuck out her tongue, "That’s too expensive, Teacher Lin. I won’t buy this one."
Just this morning, Jia Xueling compensated her only 500 yuan, which was already over budget. Although she really liked this bicycle, she couldn’t afford it. Even at 500 yuan, she wouldn’t buy it. To her, a poor family kid, 500 yuan was already a big sum.
Lin Fan said, "Boss, can you make it cheaper? I’ll help you get another customer."
The shop owner laughed and said, "Young man, you’re really funny. You two came in a supercar, what’s this small amount of money? We’re doing business fairly, it’s a fixed price, we won’t overcharge."
Chu Xiaoxiao tugged at Lin Fan’s sleeve and whispered, "Teacher Lin, forget it, let’s go. I’ll buy a second-hand bike, just about 100 yuan."
Lin Fan said, "Second-hand ones have many problems, they’re not safe to ride. It’s better to buy a new one."
Turning to the shop owner, "Boss, is there no way to make this bike cheaper?"
The shop owner said, "Normally, not really, but since it’s your first time here, let’s get familiar. How about this, you name a price you can accept?"
Lin Fan said, "How about 300?"
The shop owner broke into a sweat, thinking to himself, you’re kidding me, right? Slash the price in half, just like that?
The shop owner was puzzled, isn’t this guy driving a supercar? Why is he haggling over this small change? Are rich people really stingy?
The shop owner smiled ruefully, "300 yuan really won’t work, I’d be losing money. How about this, I’ll give you guys one for 500 yuan."
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head, indicating it was still too expensive.
Lin Fan then said, "Can it be made a bit cheaper, like 350 yuan?"
The shop owner was about to cry, starting to doubt whether Lin Fan was really a rich guy.
After a round of bargaining, they finally reached a price both sides could agree on, 400 yuan.
Lin Fan pulled out four red notes from his wallet and handed them to the shop owner.
Chu Xiaoxiao quickly said, "Teacher Lin, let me pay for it..."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No problem, it’s only 400 yuan. Later, you’ll need to pretend to be my girlfriend, consider this bicycle your payment."
"Hmm..." Chu Xiaoxiao said no more. 400 yuan was already a lot of money to her. She wouldn’t even think of spending so much money on a bicycle, she’d rather buy a second-hand one.
But to Lin Fan, 400 yuan wasn’t much, and she really liked this bike. It could be viewed as a moment of indulgence.
The shop owner took the money and quickly helped Chu Xiaoxiao set up the bike.
Chu Xiaoxiao went outside the store to test ride it.
Lin Fan followed her out to the entrance and sat on the backseat of a bicycle beside him, watching Chu Xiaoxiao test ride.
At this moment, an Audi Q3 arrived at the bicycle shop entrance and parked.
Immediately attracting the shop’s attention.
Why are so many people driving cars here to buy bicycles today?
This Audi Q3, about 300 thousand yuan, naturally can’t compare to Lin Fan’s Kosak, but to ordinary people, it’s still considered an expensive car.
The car owner was a woman, who looked at her phone. On her phone, there was a photo of Lin Fan. She looked up and immediately saw Lin Fan sitting on a bicycle.
"It’s him. He really seems poor, still using a bicycle to get around these days. But he is really handsome, even more handsome in person than in the photo!"
The woman got out of the car, smiling, and walked directly towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was watching Chu Xiaoxiao testing the bike and suddenly noticed someone walking over to him. He looked up and was startled.
A woman was approaching, looking about thirty years old, overweight, about 1.5 meters tall, and at least 150 pounds. Her steps seemed to make the ground shake.
She was smiling at him!
Lin Fan broke into a cold sweat. No way, could this be the blind date Aunt Li set him up with?
"Hey handsome, you must be Lin Fan?" the overweight woman said with a smile.
Lin Fan quickly said, "I’m not, you must have mistaken me for someone else."
Darn it, she really is the blind date! Better deny it quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: The Radical-Minded Blind Date Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 145: The Radical-Minded Blind Date Woman
The plump girl looked at her phone and laughed out loud, "It’s you! I have a picture of you. What, are you shy, handsome?"
Lin Fan laughed bitterly, realizing there was no escape. He could only comfort himself in his mind: Lin Fan, you can’t be like this, even though she’s a bit overweight, you can’t judge a book by its cover. That’s very impolite. Overweight girls deserve respect too. Who knows, she might be a great person, and even if you don’t like her, you should reject her tactfully.
Thinking of this, Lin Fan took a deep breath, showing a smile, "Alright, I was just joking earlier. I’m Lin Fan. What should I call you?"
The plump girl said, "My name is Zhu Jing."
Lin Fan blurted out, "Pig Spirit?"
This name was really too unique.
Zhu Jing said, "It’s Zhu as in Zhu Yuanzhang, and Jing as in quiet."
Lin Fan wiped his cold sweat, "I see, Miss Zhu. Let’s be straightforward. Did Aunt Li tell you about my situation?"
Zhu Jing said, "She did. You’re a delivery guy, you don’t have a car, a house, and probably no savings either, right?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, actually I recently lost my job too. I’m currently unemployed. Miss Zhu, your conditions are so good, you can completely find someone better. You probably wouldn’t fancy someone as poor as me."
He looked at Zhu Jing expectantly, thinking Zhu Jing would definitely look disgusted and then turn away and leave. Those previous blind date girls all disliked him for being poor, without exception.
Who would have thought!
Zhu Jing showed no intention of leaving, smiling, "If you’re worried that I might mind, you can rest assured. I’m different from those materialistic girls. I don’t mind you being poor, and it’s okay if you don’t have a job. I can support you."
Lin Fan almost fell over, "You support me?"
He laughed bitterly inside, not fearing if the other person was materialistic, but fearing the opposite.
Why is the world so unfair? Those previous blind date girls were all beautiful and had good figures, but they were all materialistic. Finally, encountering one who wasn’t materialistic, her appearance was hard to stomach.
Is it really that hard to find a beautiful, well-shaped blind date who isn’t materialistic?
Zhu Jing laughed, "I work as a manager in a medium-sized company, earning a salary of twenty thousand a month. I’ve already bought a house and have a car. It’s totally fine to support you. I have only one requirement for you: to be handsome. You meet my requirement very well."
Lin Fan said, "Looks alone aren’t enough for a partner. Someone like me, although handsome, with no house, no car, no savings, and unemployed, without ambition, will only be a burden to you in the future."
Zhu Jing said, "It’s fine. I just like you being a slacker, having no ambition is just right!"
Lin Fan wanted to cry; there really is all sorts of people in the world, someone actually likes a slacker.
Zhu Jing continued, "I’m a person with a strong career ambition. I’ll earn the money and support the family. After we get married, you just be a stay-at-home husband. When we have kids, you stay home and be a house dad to take care of the kids, and when they grow up, you take them to and from school."
Lin Fan was sweating, something sounded a bit wrong, "Miss Zhu, this sounds like the standards a man looks for in a wife, doesn’t it?"
Zhu Jing glared and said, "You’re right. If men can use these standards to find a wife, why can’t women use these standards to find a husband? As a woman of the new era, we should have long abandoned traditional domestic roles. In the future, women earning money and supporting the family will be the mainstream, you men can just be the pretty faces."
Lin Fan wiped his cold sweat, it seemed like this Zhu Jing was a feminist through and through, just like those extreme feminists online.
Lin Fan said, "Not really. Traditionally men work outside and women manage the home, this is still the mainstream of society. Also, there are many successful men, the majority of men have ambition. Wouldn’t it be better to find a successful man?"
Zhu Jing snorted coldly, "Successful man? Once men have some money, they all start looking for young, pretty women and flirt around. I don’t want such smelly men! I just like you slackers, handsome without ambition, relying on me is enough. Listen to me, and I’ll give you pocket money. If you dare to go out and fool around, I’ll cut off your pocket money!"
Lin Fan said, "So what you’re saying is, you fancy me only because I’m easy to control?"
Zhu Jing said, "You could say that. Handsome, for a man like you without ambition, there’s no reason to not take the easy way out, right?"
Lin Fan cleared his throat and said, "I’m really sorry, but I won’t take it."
Zhu Jing was taken aback, "Won’t take it? Handsome, what do you mean? I fancy you not just because you’re a slacker, but also because you’re handsome. You can improve the genes of our future kids. Weren’t you not ambitious? Unemployed? I can right now take you home and start supporting you."
Lin Fan waved his hand, "Forget it, I can support myself. Thank you for your kind offer!"
Zhu Jing chuckled, "Handsome, you’re not appreciating the good offer. Are you just like those stinky men, looking down on me? Because I’m fat?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Cough cough, well, I wouldn’t say it like that."
The implication being, some things are better left unsaid, saying them out loud would be impolite.
Zhu Jing sneered, "What’s wrong with being fat? As long as a fat girl is confident, she’s beautiful! Those pretty ones only know how to seduce rich men, each one is a fox spirit. What’s so good about that! Do you dare to disagree?"
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, what Zhu Jing said really matched that of a typical feminist activist.
Nowadays on the internet, feminism has become a kind of political correctness. You can’t speak about fat or ugly girls. If you do, you’ll be attacked by everyone.
These activists often despise beautiful girls and mock beautiful female celebrities whenever they can.
On the contrary, when they encounter a public figure who is ugly and fat, they swarm around, praising variously. The word they often use is confidence.
The activists often have very extreme views, despising and looking down on men, and having great malice towards beauties.
Just like this Zhu Jing, in her eyes, men are just tools for her. On the surface, she only wants a handsome man and doesn’t care if he’s a slacker. But deep down, she harbors hatred towards men, using them as her punching bag.
Lin Fan is indeed a straightforward man. He never hides the fact that he likes beautiful women and has no interest in ugly, fat women.
However, out of respect, he wouldn’t evaluate Zhu Jing’s appearance to her face.
Of course, that was before he knew Zhu Jing was a feminist. Now, knowing that Zhu Jing is such a feminist, Lin Fan didn’t have to be polite with her.
"There are indeed many gold-digging beautiful girls, but you can’t generalize. There are still many beautiful girls who aren’t gold diggers. Your views are too extreme. Similarly, not all ugly girls are confidently beautiful and sensible, like you."
Lin Fan smiled.
Zhu Jing was furious, "What did you say? Are you saying I’m not sensible?"
Lin Fan said, "How can a sensible person have your kind of thoughts?"
Zhu Jing snorted coldly, "Do I have a fault if I don’t mind you being a slacker? You’re being quite pretentious for a slacker. Haven’t you been on many blind dates before? None of them succeeded, didn’t those vixens all look down on your poverty? You should take a good look at yourself and think if you can satisfy those vixens. A slacker like you should feel lucky I’m willing to take you!"
Lin Fan wasn’t angry, "I’m really sorry. I’m not as extreme as you are. I have indeed always failed in blind dates, not because I’m poor, but because I also don’t like gold-digging girls. Besides, I don’t need you to support me. In fact, I already have a girlfriend."

chapters.title: Chapter 146 Young Lady’s Thoughts: If Only It Were True
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 146 Young Lady’s Thoughts: If Only It Were True
Lin Fan waved, and saw Chu Xiaoxiao riding over on a bicycle.
"Is this bike okay to ride?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Xiaoxiao smiled and said, "Yeah, it’s pretty good, not hard to ride at all."
Zhu Jing looked at Chu Xiaoxiao and her face twitched a bit. She had to admit that Chu Xiaoxiao was very pretty, too pretty.
Her figure was slim, her beauty was out of this world, and she had a pure and fresh aura like the girl next door full of youthful energy.
This was the kind of beauty that she deeply yearned for, she could lie to others, but she couldn’t lie to herself.
"Is she your girlfriend?" Zhu Jing asked.
Lin Fan said, "Strictly speaking, not yet. Xiaoxiao, would you like to be my girlfriend?"
Zhu Jing sneered in her heart, this penniless guy is just pretending, no way this little vixen would agree to him!
Chu Xiaoxiao’s face turned red, she lowered her head in embarrassment and said softly, "I... I’m willing."
Even though she knew Lin Fan wanted her to pretend, she wasn’t pretending, she truly wanted to be his girlfriend, oh how she did.
Lin Fan reached out and held Chu Xiaoxiao’s hand, looked at Zhu Jing, and smiled, "Miss Zhu, as you can see, I already have a girlfriend. We can end this blind date now."
Zhu Jing felt like she was slapped, her face twitched again, dammit, this little vixen actually agreed to Lin Fan!
She snorted with disbelief, "This young girl is clearly inexperienced, that’s why she’s captivated by your looks. Just wait, when she starts living in poverty with you, she’ll understand the importance of money, she’ll become realistic and snobbish, and naturally, she’ll abandon you, you poor loser!"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, the situation you’re describing won’t happen."
Zhu Jing said, "Won’t happen? You have no house, no car, no savings, not even a job or ambition, you’re practically a five-no person. She’s riding a bike, her family must not be well off either, you two are just a pair of poor losers, tough days ahead, she’ll regret it sooner or later!"
Hearing this, Chu Xiaoxiao got a little angry, "You’re talking nonsense, even if I live a tough life with him, I’d be happy, I would never regret it!"
After saying that, her face turned even redder, oh no, she accidentally voiced her true feelings.
Zhu Jing was very unhappy, how could Chu Xiaoxiao like Lin Fan so much!
"Young lady, don’t speak too soon, you’ll regret it one day. Don’t be silly, this loser isn’t worth your effort, are you planning to support him in the future? You might as well wake up early and find a rich boyfriend, so you won’t be so tired!" Zhu Jing said with a cold smile.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, Zhu Jing, stop trying to poison my girlfriend with your nonsense. I’m being honest now, do you think someone driving this car would turn into the kind of person you’re talking about?"
With that, Lin Fan took out the keys to the Kosak and lightly pressed them.
Beep beep!
The Kosak parked at the side lit up its headlights immediately.
Zhu Jing’s face changed drastically, and she blurted out, "This car is hers?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yes. You see, although I’m a five-no person, we guys who aren’t picky either like young and pretty Rich Ladies. Sorry, you lost."
Zhu Jing was furious, "Who the hell wants you!"
She felt very embarrassed, compared to Chu Xiaoxiao, she really was inferior in every way, had no face to stay, and turned away angrily, quickly getting into her Audi Q3 and leaving in a hurry.
Watching her finally leave, Lin Fan breathed a sigh of relief; dealing with such a woman, this is the way to go, treasure your life, stay away from such women.
Once again it proved how quirky blind dates could be, really not reliable at all.
"Teacher Lin, you don’t like her?" Chu Xiaoxiao asked curiously.
Lin Fan replied frankly, "No, I don’t."
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "Is it because she’s... not good-looking?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, that’s one reason. I do like beautiful women, but mainly, it’s because she doesn’t respect men, her thinking is too extreme, such a person is very unlikely to have a happy marriage."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "With someone like her, is there any chance she can change?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "It’s too hard. She carries a mindset of hating men, her future married life will undoubtedly be unhappy, and her unhappiness will make her even more extreme, hating men even more, basically hopeless. So just now, I was just getting rid of her, never intended to change her, I have no interest."
Chu Xiaoxiao let out a soft "Oh," somewhat understanding.
Lin Fan said, "Xiaoxiao, don’t be like her, there are good and bad men, just as there are good and bad women, don’t make rash generalizations and get stuck in a mental dead-end. Some females become extreme because they’ve been abandoned by scumbags and come to hate all men in the world, some become extreme because they’re unattractive and no guys like them, hating all men. All of this is wrong."
Chu Xiaoxiao pondered Lin Fan’s words carefully and smiled, "I got it, Teacher Lin, you want me to be someone with an optimistic mindset."
Lin Fan laughed heartily, "Pretty much."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Thank you for your guidance, Teacher Lin, I’ll remember it in my heart."
Lin Fan said, "It’s getting late, you should head home, I need to go too."
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, bid farewell to Lin Fan, "Goodbye, Teacher Lin."
"Goodbye!"
Lin Fan then got into the Kosak and drove away.
Chu Xiaoxiao watched Lin Fan’s car leave until it disappeared from view, thinking of pretending to be Lin Fan’s girlfriend just now, her cheeks couldn’t help turning red.
"If it were true, that would be nice..." The Young Lady sighed in her heart, gaining a secret she kept to herself.
Soon, Chu Xiaoxiao mounted her bike and headed home.
A rundown old district where most buildings were already dilapidated.
"Chu Xiaoxiao, come here!"
Chu Xiaoxiao was passing through a street, just about to go home, when suddenly, a middle-aged woman behind a barbecue stall at the roadside called her.
"Mom!" Chu Xiaoxiao pushed her bike and hurried over.
The weary-looking middle-aged woman before her was her mother, He Meifang, who had been selling barbecue for a living since losing her job a year ago.
He Meifang immediately noticed Chu Xiaoxiao’s new bike and frowned, "Weren’t you released from school early? Why are you just getting back now? What’s up with this bicycle?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I just bought it."
He Meifang glared, "Bought it new? Where did you get the money to buy a new bike? What happened to the old one?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "It was hit and broken in the morning, the person compensated me, and I went to buy a new one after school."
He Meifang scrutinized Chu Xiaoxiao, her uniform was a bit dirty, like she indeed had fallen.
"How much did the person pay you, and how much did you spend on this bike?" He Meifang immediately inquired.
Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit disappointed; her mom heard she was hit but didn’t care if she was hurt, most concerned instead about how much compensation she got.
Money!
It’s like a nightmare hanging over a poor family.
"They paid 500 yuan, this bike cost... 400 yuan," Chu Xiaoxiao answered truthfully.
He Meifang instantly stamped her foot in worry, "You silly child, how could you be so thoughtless, couldn’t you have bought a second-hand one? As I know, they’re just over 100 yuan, wouldn’t it be nice to save the remaining 400? Your brother’s medical expenses for next month still aren’t covered, do you think our family is rich?"

chapters.title: Chapter 147: A Shocking Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 147: A Shocking Decision
Chu Xiaoxiao bit her lip, feeling wronged. She did plan to buy a second-hand car, but this car was a gift from Lin Fan, and she really liked it, so she didn’t refuse.
But her mom didn’t care whether she liked it or not; she just worried about the money.
She didn’t blame her mom. Her mom was supporting the family alone, which was indeed very tough. Her dad refused to work and stayed at home all day, while her brother was sick and needed medical expenses every month.
"Mom, I actually didn’t spend money on this car. I’ll give you the 500 bucks." Chu Xiaoxiao said, taking out five red bills from her backpack.
He Meifang was stunned: "You really didn’t spend any money? Then where did you get this car?"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed and didn’t want to tell her mom that it was a gift from Lin Fan, so she said, "Just don’t ask, the money is all here."
Chu Xiaoxiao put down the 500 bucks and turned to go home.
"Wait a minute." He Meifang quickly put away the money and stopped Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao stopped in her tracks: "What’s up, mom?"
He Meifang waved her hand: "Forget it, let’s talk at home."
Chu Xiaoxiao frowned: "Mom, what’s going on?"
He Meifang said: "There’s something your dad and I have decided. We planned to tell you when you got home. This isn’t the place to talk. You’d better ask your dad when you’re home!"
"Oh." Chu Xiaoxiao walked home a bit puzzled, thinking her mom’s demeanor suggested it wasn’t anything good.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s home was an old house in the inner city. It was very rundown, with only two rooms and a cramped space.
Because her brother Chu Xiaoming was sick, he lay in one room all year long, and her dad was in there taking care of him. She and her mom lived in the other room.
As soon as she entered the house, she smelled the scent of herbal medicine brewed for her brother.
Alas, her brother’s illness had been treated with numerous medicines but never seemed to improve.
"Cough cough..."
The room echoed with the sound of a boy coughing.
"Xiaoxiao, you’re back?" A man heard the commotion and called from the room.
It was her dad Chu Yuanhang’s voice.
Chu Xiaoxiao replied: "Hmm, I’m back."
She placed her backpack down and walked into her brother’s room, where a frail-looking boy was lying on the bed, roughly thirteen or fourteen years old. He was emaciated from the illness and looked very haggard.
Beside the bed was a bald middle-aged man feeding him medicine, her dad Chu Yuanhang.
Every time Chu Xiaoxiao saw her brother, she couldn’t help but feel a pang of heartache, and it was hard to watch.
"Sister, you’re back." The boy said happily, clearly fond of his sister.
Chu Xiaoxiao smiled: "Yes, Mingming, are you feeling any better today?"
Chu Xiaoming shook his head: "Still the same."
Chu Xiaoxiao sighed inwardly and said: "Dad, mom said you both agreed on something. She asked me to come back and ask you. What is it?"
Chu Yuanhang said: "Hmm, let’s talk outside."
Chu Yuanhang put down the bowl, stood up, and walked into the living room with Chu Xiaoxiao, closing the door behind him.
"Dad, what’s so secretive?" Chu Xiaoxiao asked curiously.
Chu Yuanhang said: "It’s like this, Xiaoxiao. Our family is out of money because of your brother’s illness. We don’t know where to find the medical expenses for next month. We’ve thought about it and there’s only one way to save your brother—it’s you."
Chu Xiaoxiao was startled: "How do I save him?"
Chu Yuanhang said: "Your mom and I have arranged a marriage for you. The other party has agreed to give us 300,000 in gift money. For your brother’s sake, you should get married quickly and stop going to school. Your school fees are exorbitant; I’ve never supported you going there. Plus, it would save us a ton of money."
"What?"
Chu Xiaoxiao’s expression changed drastically, it was like a bolt from the blue!
Meanwhile, Lin Fan was driving back to Tangchen Yipin to rest. He needed to stay in the city as he had promised to have dinner at Loli’s house.
On the way, Lin Fan received a call from Aunt Li.
"Little Fan, what’s going on? Jingjing just came over and gave you quite a scolding." Aunt Li said.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Nothing much, just didn’t work out. Aunt Li, what did she say?"
Aunt Li said: "She called you a vile man and said you had a girlfriend. Little Fan, do you really have a girlfriend? How come Aunt doesn’t know?"
Lin Fan said: "Hmm, I was actually on a date with someone else today, and I succeeded in confessing. Zhu Jing may be mad about that. Aunt Li, you don’t need to put effort into finding dates for me anymore."
Aunt Li said: "Oh, so that’s how it is. Alright, I’m happy you’ve found a girlfriend. Bring her over to meet Aunt if you have time."
"Okay." Lin Fan replied with a smile.
After hanging up from Aunt Li’s call, Lin Fan breathed a sigh of relief. He had finally used his game plan as a shield, and Aunt Li wouldn’t need to introduce him to blind dates anymore.
Just as he put the phone down, it rang again. It was Loli calling.
"Officer sister?" Lin Fan answered the call.
Loli asked: "Where are you now? My mom says you should come over early for dinner today."
Lin Fan said: "I’m in the city."
Loli said: "Then why don’t you head to the entrance of Fumin District to wait for me? I’m about to finish work."
Lin Fan said: "Okay."
After ending the call, Lin Fan headed towards Fumin District.
Police station.
Loli had already reached the entrance of the police station, ready to leave, but she was still thinking about a case she had been working on today.
In a convenience store, two robbers were subdued by a customer. This customer was so fierce that one of the robbers was knocked out with ten beer bottles, and the other was in much worse shape. The female store clerk said the customer’s grip crushed his fists.
She wanted to look at the surveillance footage, but unfortunately, the cameras were broken.
"Little Wang, follow up for me. Send me the footage after it’s repaired," Loli instructed her partner, Little Wang, then left the police station.
She didn’t want to leave work so early, but her mother’s orders couldn’t be defied. When her mom heard Lin Fan was coming for dinner, she had already gone shopping for groceries.
Fumin District.
Loli’s family lived in this neighborhood.
Lin Fan arrived outside Fumin District and parked the car at the side, waiting for Loli.
Lin Fan got out of the car and leaned against the hood, quietly waiting. Passersby couldn’t help but be drawn to the luxury car, casting envious glances.
Especially the women, who couldn’t resist looking over, appearing quite intrigued.
Finally, a tall and self-assured beauty couldn’t help but approach Lin Fan.
"Handsome, this car is so beautiful. Is it yours?" The beauty teased, her eyes flirting.
Lin Fan hadn’t expected that even standing here waiting could attract women.
Being handsome and rich truly made a difference.
If he were leaning against an electric car rather than a Kosak, he’d likely go unnoticed. But a top-tier luxury car was different; it was a symbol of status and wealth, drawing women in automatically.
Lin Fan glanced at the beauty: "Yes, it’s mine."
The beauty was thrilled: "Can I take a photo with you?"
Without waiting for an answer, she took out her phone and leaned close to Lin Fan for a selfie.
Lin Fan smelled the fragrance from the beauty and felt her soft body, but he didn’t mind.
"Handsome, I think there’s something missing from your car." The beauty smiled.
Lin Fan asked: "What’s missing?"
The beauty giggled: "Missing me. Should I sit where I belong?"
Lin Fan sweated. Today’s women were so straightforward. Seeing a handsome guy with a luxury car, they skipped the formalities and wanted to get in directly.
Just then, two middle-aged women walked by carrying baskets.
One of the aunties spotted Lin Fan’s car and Lin Fan, exclaiming: "Isn’t this Loli’s boyfriend? Who’s that little vixen beside him? No way, could he be a jerk?"
That auntie was the same Aunt Song they met when Lin Fan and Loli went to eat.
The other middle-aged woman was Loli’s mom.
At this moment, Lin Fan saw them and recognized Aunt Song.
After Aunt Song pointed out Lin Fan’s identity, Loli’s mom’s expression turned sour.
Lin Fan smiled bitterly inwardly. This wasn’t good. She must have misunderstood.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: My Son-in-Law Is Not a Scumbag
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 148: My Son-in-Law Is Not a Scumbag
Aunt Song and Loli’s mom came back from grocery shopping and saw Lin Fan taking a photo with a beautiful woman at the entrance of the community, looking very close.
"Isn’t this Loli’s boyfriend? Who’s this foxy girl next to him? No way, could he be a scumbag?" Aunt Song exclaimed in surprise.
From her expression, you could tell she’s a typical gossip-loving old lady who likes to stir up trouble.
Upon hearing this, Loli’s mom indeed looked upset. No one could accept their daughter’s boyfriend being a scumbag.
However, Lin Fan had long noticed their presence but pretended not to see them. He put on a serious face and said to the beautiful woman beside him, "Miss, you’ve come up to take a photo with me because you’re drawn to my handsomeness and wealth. Out of politeness, I obliged. Now you want to get in my car too? Strictly speaking, I don’t really know you; you’re just a passerby to me. I’m sorry, I have a girlfriend whom I love very much, and I refuse your excessive request. Please leave!"
Seeing Lin Fan’s righteous demeanor, the woman felt ashamed and left covering her face.
Passersby around him gave Lin Fan a thumbs-up.
"Well done, young man!"
"Positive energy!"
"Handsome, rich, and has such upright values!"
"So envious of his girlfriend, she’s really lucky!"
Hearing the compliments from those around, Loli’s mom was very pleased, and Lin Fan’s words just now earned her praise as well.
"See, you misunderstood my son-in-law. My son-in-law is not a scumbag!" Loli’s mom chided Aunt Song.
Aunt Song nodded embarrassedly, her expression awkward.
She’s the type who likes to see others in trouble, so being proven wrong by Lin Fan made her feel quite uncomfortable.
Lin Fan found it amusing internally, grateful that he was clever enough to redeem his image in time. If he left a bad impression on Loli’s mom, he’d also have trouble explaining to the police officer sister.
He pretended to just notice the two of them and exclaimed in surprise, "Oh, isn’t this Aunt Song? This must be auntie, nice to meet you, I’m Lin Fan, Lily’s boyfriend."
Lin Fan walked over with a smile.
Loli’s mom smiled broadly, "Indeed, where’s Lily? Didn’t she come back with you?"
Lin Fan replied, "She asked me to wait for her here, she should be back soon."
"Alright," Loli’s mom said with a smile, sizing up Lin Fan. The young man was indeed handsome. The more she looked at her son-in-law, the more she liked him.
Aunt Song laughed, "The young man is really good. We both heard what you said, your values are upright. Sister Lian, I’m really envious of you. Where can you find such a good son-in-law?"
Lin Fan smiled without responding. Aunt Song was really just a gossip; earlier she took the opportunity to stir trouble. Now she’s praising, just going with the flow. If given the chance, she might play tricks again. Lin Fan really had no patience for such a person.
Loli’s mom, named Lu Meilian, was pleased with Aunt Song’s words and said, "Enough of that, Little Fan, quickly come to our place. We live in building 12. Drive to the bottom of the building and wait for us."
Lin Fan nodded, "Okay, I’ll head over now."
Then he returned to the car and drove into the community.
Watching the top-tier supercar, Lu Meilian felt delighted and clicked her tongue, "Old Song, where do you think Loli found such a young man? This girl used to have no luck with blind dates, and she ended up finding such a good one on her own!"
Handsome, wealthy, young, and loyal—a perfect catch!
Aunt Song said, "I don’t know. I had found a coal boss for her, which was pretty good too. Who knew she had already found someone."
Lu Meilian laughed, "How can your coal boss compare to Little Fan! Let’s go back quickly and cook something nice for my future son-in-law."
Seeing Lu Meilian’s cheerful look, Aunt Song rolled her eyes behind her back and felt quite upset.
She had painstakingly arranged so many blind dates for Loli, but none could compare to Lin Fan, making her feel her efforts were wasted.
The two chatted as they walked into the community, heading towards building 12.
Before reaching the bottom of the building, they suddenly noticed a group of people gathered under building 11, making a commotion and all looking up at something.
Out of curiosity, they went over, and following everyone’s gaze, they were both startled!
About ten floors up, from a window ledge, came the sound of a child crying. A small boy, about three or four years old, had his feet dangling out of the burglar-proof screen, his body stuck in it. If he wasn’t rescued quickly, he might fall!
Initially, the community residents, hearing the child’s cries, were puzzled, trying to locate the source until they discovered this alarming scene.
Some enthusiastic residents quickly went to the house, only to find the iron door tightly shut. Clearly, there were no adults at home!
The careless parents had left a three or four-year-old child at home alone!
The child must not understand anything and somehow climbed onto the ledge!
The situation was extremely dire, as the young boy could fall at any moment!
"What to do, we’ve reported to the fire department, but they won’t come that fast!"
"If he falls, it will be terrible. We can’t catch him!"
"How could the parents be so careless!"
The crowd buzzed with discussions, worrying about the boy and criticizing the parents, creating a noisy scene.
Lu Meilian, anxious, had red eyes, "The poor child, someone quickly save him!"
Aunt Song sighed, "Who can save him, unless Spider-Man comes."
She thought she was being funny and couldn’t help but chuckle, only to stop when she saw Lu Meilian genuinely looked distressed.
Though Aunt Song was quite tactless, she was right. To save the young boy, there were two ways. One was to break in, but this had been ruled out as the house installed an iron door for anti-theft, which couldn’t be easily broken by ordinary people. Besides, it might be too late to break in now.
The second way was to climb up!
However, the building was quite flat, and unless you were a superhero like Spider-Man or a professional climber with full equipment, climbing up was nearly impossible for most people.
While everyone was anxious, a young man walked over quickly from the side.
Some observant people noticed that the young man had just gotten out of a top-tier supercar under building 12 and immediately rushed over upon noticing the commotion here.
Lin Fan!
He glanced up at the boy’s situation and said solemnly, "There’s no time, we must save him now!"
Saying that, Lin Fan walked straight to the wall, grabbed a window edge, and started to climb up!
The situation was urgent!
Originally, Lin Fan intended to break in, which wasn’t difficult with the energy in his body now, but he judged there wasn’t enough time.
He feared that even before he could get up there, the child would have fallen.
Surprised that someone was attempting to climb up to rescue, everyone’s eyes turned to Lin Fan.
"Ah, isn’t that Little Fan?"
Lu Meilian exclaimed in shock.
Aunt Song was also stunned; it was Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Is This a Real Person!
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 149: Is This a Real Person!
Lin Fan is going to climb up and rescue the little boy!
Everyone was stunned.
"He’s so bold, is he really going to climb up?"
"Although his courage is commendable, this is impossible, he’s not afraid of dying!"
"The young man is a bit impulsive, without equipment, even a rock climbing expert can’t climb up this wall!"
"And the little boy is on the tenth floor, he has to climb up ten floors!"
"Oh my God, it’s too risky!"
Everyone became nervous, no one believed in Lin Fan, after all, this building is obviously difficult to climb, unless Spider-Man showed up.
But where is there a Spider-Man in reality? It’s just something made up in comics.
Lu Meilian was so nervous that she started crying, she was too worried about Lin Fan.
"Little Fan, don’t go up!" cried Lu Meilian, trying to stop Lin Fan; her daughter had finally found a boyfriend, she didn’t want him to fall to his death.
More cruel would be to see him fall to his death in front of her, how devastating would that be!
Aunt Song stomped her feet and started to scold, "This child, how can he be so reckless? Can’t he wait for the police to come? Who does he think he is! If I had a daughter, I wouldn’t trust him with her, he’s too impulsive and careless about consequences!"
Lu Meilian was worried enough, hearing Aunt Song’s words made her even more anxious, negative emotions surged.
Just when everyone was expressing their concerns, an astonishing scene began to play out.
Lin Fan grabbed the window and suddenly leapt up, his whole body bounced, reaching out and grabbing the top of the window, followed by a nimble and agile flip, and he was standing on top of the window.
The move was so beautiful!
Everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.
"Turns out this young man is a rock climbing expert!" someone said.
Lin Fan’s move was indeed very graceful, not losing at all to those rock climbing experts.
This was Lin Fan attempting to use the strength within him, controlling his body, under reasonable use of his strength, jumping onto this window wasn’t difficult.
However...
The real test was yet to come.
Between this window and the second-floor window was a straight, two-meter high wall!
There was almost nothing to cling to, except for a protruding load-bearing column on the side, but using this column to climb up was simply impossible.
"The young man may be agile, but there’s no way he can go further!"
"This building’s design is anti-theft, even thieves would shake their heads."
"Without tools, it’s impossible to climb up!"
Everyone was discussing, all thinking Lin Fan was at a loss.
The young man might have a good heart, but this was a failure, making people feel hopeless.
However!
The next second, everyone’s eyes nearly popped out.
Lin Fan suddenly leapt from the top of the window, throwing himself toward the adjacent load-bearing column, with both hands grabbing the sides of the column, his whole body clinging to the column like a gecko.
"Ah!"
Everyone exclaimed in surprise, nearly scared to death, fearful that Lin Fan might not hold on and fall.
But Lin Fan was steady, showing no intention of falling.
Moreover, he immediately began to climb upward, as fast as a hunting gecko, in the blink of an eye, he had climbed to the second floor, lightly pushing off with his feet, leaving the column to jump onto the top of the second-floor window!
Lo and behold, where Lin Fan’s hands had grabbed the column, there were rows of small shallow holes, as if poked out by fingers.
Lin Fan’s ten fingers had penetrated the reinforced concrete column, using it as a leverage point!
After reaching the top of the second-floor window, Lin Fan repeated the process and leapt to the load-bearing column leading to the third floor, continuing to climb up.
It may seem like a long story, but it took Lin Fan only a few seconds to climb the building.
In the blink of an eye, Lin Fan had reached the eighth floor.
Everyone was already dumbfounded.
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t believe it even if beaten to death, someone could actually climb up and do so quickly and steadily!
"Good heavens, is this even human?!"
"Am I dreaming? Is this a real person?!"
"Oh my God, this is amazing!"
"Even Spider-Man wouldn’t be any better than this!"
Everyone wore expressions of shock that echoed through their entire families.
Lu Meilian had already covered her mouth with her hand, unbelievably shocked. Lin Fan’s performance really took her by surprise, her future son-in-law was amazing!
Even Aunt Song was dumbfounded.
Holy crap!
Another slap in the face!
She had just criticized Lin Fan, thinking he was too reckless, but it turns out he wasn’t reckless, he was truly skilled!
At this moment, the sound of sirens was heard behind them.
A group of firefighters had finally arrived.
Following them in was Loli.
Loli had just returned to the entrance of the community when she noticed the firefighters entering, and curious, she followed them over.
A little boy had fallen out of a window and could fall down at any moment, immediate rescue was required!
As they arrived and prepared for rescue, the scene before them left them all stunned.
A man was actually climbing up with his bare hands!
The building in front of them, without any equipment, would be an absurdity for ordinary people to climb.
Even well-trained firefighters would need tool assistance!
But this man, under countless gazes, climbed up with his bare hands!
"Is that Lin Fan?"
Loli burst out in shock, the one climbing up to rescue the little boy was indeed Lin Fan!
Oh my god, is Lin Fan really that amazing?
Lin Fan had already reached the ninth-floor column!
Suddenly!
An accident happened.
With a snap!
When Lin Fan grabbed it, a piece of the column broke off!
Lin Fan nearly lost his grip and almost fell down.
"Ah!"
Everyone exclaimed in shrieks, breaking out in a cold sweat.
Luckily, Lin Fan reacted in time, his other hand penetrated into the column, stabilizing his body, and his loose hand quickly regained its grip on the column, steadying himself.
Boom!
The broken concrete piece fell down and shattered on the ground.
Lin Fan looked down and grinned at the crowd: "I’m okay."
But he couldn’t help but smile bitterly inside, he still hadn’t mastered the strength within, and just now he accidentally used too much strength, breaking apart a large chunk of the column!
He planned in his mind that he’d have to practice seriously afterward.
Seeing he was stable, everyone let out a long breath.
That was horrifying just now!
Loli frowned, how could a piece of the column break off, this wasn’t scientific?
Upon closer inspection, holy crap! Lin Fan’s fingers had actually penetrated into the column! Was it possible he just broke it by hand?
Loli was taken aback, his finger strength was insanely monstrous, how could there be someone so skilled in the world!
Just then, the crowd who had just relaxed exclaimed again.
As it turned out, the little boy on the tenth-floor window had half of his body already out of the burglar-proof net, seemingly about to fall down the next second!
The firefighters definitely wouldn’t make it in time, they had already arrived a step late!
"Ah!"
Suddenly, everyone shouted in unison, and in an instant, the little boy fell out of the window!

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Your Boyfriend is Truly Amazing
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 150: Your Boyfriend is Truly Amazing
Fumin District, a young woman carrying a vegetable basket was humming a song as she walked into the neighborhood.
She was quickly drawn to the commotion under Building 11. Rushing to the scene, she witnessed a young boy falling from the tenth-floor window.
"Ah!"
The young woman screamed, her vision went black, and she fainted. The vegetable basket dropped to the ground, and vegetables scattered everywhere.
She was the boy’s mother!
Today she was at home alone with the child. While the child was asleep, she went out to buy vegetables, not knowing that the child woke up, climbed onto the windowsill, and fell out of the window.
The young woman witnessing this scene fainted on the spot.
Those present were also shocked.
It was over; the boy ultimately fell!
At that moment, Lin Fan, who had not yet climbed to the tenth floor, suddenly leaped into the air, reached out, and caught the boy, then fell onto the top of the ninth-floor window.
Landed steadily!
"Wow!"
The boy in Lin Fan’s arms burst into tears, terrified.
Those below were overjoyed.
In the nick of time, Lin Fan managed to save the boy!
"Wonderful!"
"Amazing!"
"Oh my god, that was so close!"
"He is just so incredible!"
This was followed by thunderous applause. Everyone was so excited, as they could hardly believe what they saw; Lin Fan was simply amazing!
At this moment, firefighters began setting up the ladder to bring Lin Fan and the boy down.
In fact, Lin Fan could have jumped down safely using the energy within his body without any harm.
But he didn’t want to make a big scene. Jumping down from the ninth floor unscathed would definitely become big news.
In reality, if not for the urgent situation, he wouldn’t have climbed up there, exposing his skills. Sometimes, it’s better to keep one’s abilities hidden. Lin Fan preferred to keep a low profile.
Seeing the cheers and applause from the crowd, Lin Fan was already feeling a bit regretful, worrying about accidentally becoming a trending topic.
So, Lin Fan descended to the ground using the ladder.
Nonetheless, Lin Fan’s act of climbing up to rescue the boy still left everyone deeply shocked. They looked at Lin Fan with growing admiration.
Especially Loli, who gazed at him with adoration.
She was initially attracted to Lin Fan because of his looks and charisma. Now, knowing he was also so capable, she admired him even more.
Ring ring ring...
Loli suddenly received a call from her partner, Little Wang: "The convenience store’s surveillance video has been restored. Everyone was shocked after watching it. I’ll send you some screenshots."
"Okay," Loli replied absentmindedly. She had no interest in dealing with this now and only wanted to meet Lin Fan as soon as possible.
Ding dong!
After hanging up, Loli received Little Wang’s message and casually opened the images.
She was stunned.
In the surveillance video screenshot, a young man was seen grabbing the fist of a robber. That young man was Lin Fan!
Was it Lin Fan who took down the two robbers at the convenience store today?
Lin Fan actually crushed the robber’s fist with his bare hands!
Looking at the load-bearing pillar that Lin Fan had pierced with his finger, Loli was in shock. It was true; she had witnessed Lin Fan’s nearly freakish finger strength...
A hand capable of penetrating concrete and steel, crushing a fist was probably child’s play!
Loli felt her worldview had been refreshed. There was such an impressive master in the world, and that master was her idol, Lin Fan!
Lin Fan had already descended to the ground using the ladder, handing the boy over to the firefighters.
The fainted young woman was also revived. Thinking she had lost her child, she was crying hysterically, but upon hearing the child was still alive, she frantically ran over.
Learning Lin Fan had saved her child, the woman knelt on the spot, "Thank you, benefactor, great kindness and virtue!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re welcome."
He had parked his car in front of Building 12, noticed the boy’s situation, and rushed over to save him without much thought, solely focused on rescuing the child.
If he didn’t have the ability, there was nothing he could do, but since he did, Lin Fan would never stand by and watch someone die.
Afterward, the young woman, due to her negligence, was pulled aside by the firefighters for a lecture.
This thrilling rescue had come to an end.
Lin Fan had already noticed Loli. He walked up to her and said with a smile, "Officer sister, you’re back."
Loli snapped out of her shock, "Lin Fan, I didn’t realize you were so skilled!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Not really."
Loli said embarrassingly, "You call that ’not really’? Then what about us? With our mediocre skills! You were so ruthless handling those thieves at the convenience store today."
Lin Fan replied, "Oh, so Officer sister already knows it’s me?"
The convenience store had surveillance, and Lin Fan knew the police would eventually discover it was him. He wasn’t concerned, since he was merely defending himself, and the police shouldn’t give him any trouble.
At this moment, Lu Meilian and Aunt Song approached.
Loli blushed and said, "My mom’s here, and you’re still calling me Officer sister?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Lily."
"That’s better," Loli said shyly, hearing her idol call her by her nickname felt so strange, as though they were a real couple.
