Lu Meilian came over, took Lin Fan’s hand to examine it, tsked in amazement; after climbing so high, there wasn’t a single scratch on his hand. This boyfriend her daughter found was truly remarkable.
Aunt Song smiled in admiration, "Lily, your boyfriend is truly amazing!"
Loli proudly said, "Of course! My boyfriend couldn’t be anything but amazing!"
Aunt Song then asked, "By the way, I still don’t know how you two met. Little Fan is so wealthy, I wonder which family’s son he is?"
Lin Fan laughed, "It’s a long story. I’ll tell you some other time. I’m a bit hungry now."
He didn’t want to waste time with this woman.
Loli laughed, "Lin Fan just saved someone, he must be tired. Let’s talk about this later, Aunt Song. As long as you know I have a boyfriend now, you don’t have to set me up with anyone anymore."
Saying this, Loli boldly held Lin Fan’s hand. Showing a bit of intimacy would enhance credibility.
Indeed, Lu Meilian, seeing this, was overjoyed, "Let’s go home and cook."
Watching the three leave happily, Aunt Song muttered under her breath, "What’s there to show off about? These rich boys are often fickle, bound to leave you sooner or later!"
She naturally didn’t know Lin Fan and Loli were pretending to be a couple. There’s no question of who would leave whom. Her malicious curse was ineffective.
Lu Meilian didn’t know either. She was very satisfied with this son-in-law and had already accepted Lin Fan’s identity.
Once home, Lu Meilian smiled, "You two watch TV; I’ll go cook."
Lin Fan politely said, "Auntie, do you need help?"
Lu Meilian quickly replied, "No need, you’d only end up getting in the way. Just keep Lily company; you two just started dating, you should spend more time together."
Lu Meilian gave Lin Fan a knowing look and went into the kitchen.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat, wondering if Auntie was implying something.
With that settled, Lin Fan and Loli sat down in the living room, with Loli casually turning on the TV.
While Lin Fan was watching TV, he suddenly noticed that Loli wasn’t watching at all. Instead, she was gazing at him with starry eyes.
Lin Fan laughed and asked, "Lily, why are you looking at me like that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 151: You All Communicate More Tonight
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 151: You All Communicate More Tonight
Loli giggled sweetly, her cheeks red: "Because you’re handsome!"
After witnessing Lin Fan’s skills today, she was even more infatuated with him. As a police officer, she had been fond of martial arts since childhood and admired experts. Lin Fan was exactly the expert she aspired to.
Lin Fan said, "You don’t really like me, do you? Aren’t we just pretending?"
Loli said, "Why not? Do you like me?"
"Of course," Lin Fan replied without hesitation. Who wouldn’t like a beautiful policewoman like her?
Loli was overjoyed. She liked Lin Fan, and Lin Fan liked her. If they both liked each other, couldn’t they really be together?
Loli reminded herself not to rush things. She would spend more time with Lin Fan, make him like her more, and then their being together would be a natural progression.
"Thank you," Loli said with a sweet smile.
Lin Fan said, "Thank me for what?"
Loli said, "Thank you for coming here."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to be polite. I owe you this."
After that, the two chatted here and there. Loli asked why Lin Fan was so good with his hands, and he repeated the story he told Chu Xiaoxiao earlier. Loli was also just as amazed as Chu Xiaoxiao.
Soon, Lu Meilian finished cooking, and the three of them started eating. The meal was enjoyable, making them feel like a family.
Lin Fan hadn’t had a home-cooked meal in a long time, and he ate three bowls of rice in one go.
After dinner, the sky outside had already darkened.
As Lu Meilian tidied up the dishes, she said, "Little Fan, it’s getting late. How about not going back tonight and staying here overnight? You’ve just started dating, so you can spend more time together."
Lin Fan was drinking water, and upon hearing this, almost spat it out. Auntie was really pushing it!
Even Loli noticed and her face turned crimson immediately: "Mom, what are you saying... Lin Fan, do you want to stay?"
Lin Fan felt his heartbeat accelerate: "Do you want me to stay?"
Loli bit her lip: "Stay if you want..."
Lin Fan felt tempted. This request was hard to refuse. They were pretending to be a couple, but to keep the act intact, if he stayed, wouldn’t they share a room tonight?
Just thinking about it made him feel giddy...
But just then, Loli’s phone suddenly rang.
Loli answered the call and immediately stood up, her face turning serious: "Okay, I understand. I’ll head over immediately!"
Hanging up the phone, Loli said, "There’s been a homicide case in the city. I have to head out on a call. Lin Fan, if you stay, sleep in my room. I have to go now."
With that, Loli hurried out the door.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. It seemed the heavens were not on his side.
With Loli gone, there was no point in staying, so he said goodbye to Lu Meilian and left the Luo family house.
Outside, it was completely dark. Lin Fan didn’t feel like going back to Yunding Manor, so he decided to drive the Kosak back to his apartment.
It was the perfect time for an evening stroll, and the roads were still quite crowded.
As he approached a crossroad near a park, he saw a crowd gathered by the roadside, with an old man lying on the ground, face pale, motionless. A young woman crouched beside him, looking extremely anxious and quite pretty.
"Someone, please help my grandpa!" the young woman pleaded with the people around her.
But most of the passersby were just onlookers, hesitant to step forward, fearing it might be a scheme.
Someone suggested, "Miss, just call an ambulance!"
The young woman said, "There’s no time. He needs treatment now."
The crowd shook their heads, expressing they were unable to help.
The young woman grew more anxious, especially since the area was quite secluded, and no cars seemed to be passing by.
Just then, a top-tier sports car pulled up next to them.
Lin Fan got out of the car and said, "Do you need help here?"
The onlookers were taken aback by the luxury car—a sign of wealth.
The young woman, seeing the sports car, exclaimed joyfully, "Sir, please, can you give us a ride?"
Lin Fan said, "Alright, let’s get the elderly gentleman onto the car first."
And with that, he walked over and, with the young woman’s help, carried the old man onto the car.
In the past, during difficult times, Lin Fan wouldn’t have dared to help easily, fearing false accusations, but now it was different. Even if it was a scam, he could handle it; being wealthy surely had its perks.
Moreover, judging by the old man’s face, he wasn’t pretending. If he was acting, his skills would have been Oscar-worthy. Besides, both the elderly man and the young woman were well-dressed; the woman donned designer labels and exhibited the aura of a rich and beautiful woman—not the kind to scam.
Inside the car, Lin Fan quickly restarted the engine.
"Thank you, sir," came the voice of the young woman from the back seat.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re welcome. I was just on my way, so I’ll get you to the hospital."
The young woman said, "Sir, we don’t need a hospital. The hospital can’t save my grandpa."
Lin Fan responded, "Oh, where should we go then?"
The young woman said, "To my home."
Lin Fan frowned. Refusing to go to the hospital and wanting to return home for treatment seemed odd. Was this a trap?
The young woman seemed to notice Lin Fan’s suspicion and explained, "My grandpa’s condition can’t be treated at a hospital. We have specific medicine at home."
Lin Fan said, "I see. Where’s your home?"
The young woman said, "Peninsula Mansion on Chunxi Road."
Lin Fan thought inwardly, Peninsula Mansion—that’s one of the renowned upscale residences in Yun City, only the rich and high-status people reside there!
It seemed his doubts were unnecessary; they weren’t lying to him.
Peninsula Mansion was nearby, and with Lin Fan’s fast car, they arrived in about ten minutes.
Along the way, Lin Fan learned that the young woman was named Liu Bing’er and the elderly man was her grandpa, Liu Tingshan.
With Lin Fan’s limited knowledge, he recalled a few wealthy individuals with the last name Liu in Yun City, but none matched Liu Tingshan. He couldn’t figure out their background.
Liu Bing’er was still a student. She was home on a break today, and after dinner, she was out for a walk with her grandpa when he suddenly fell ill. She was extremely stressed; if anything happened to her grandpa, it would be too much for her to bear.
Peninsula Mansion.
Lin Fan’s car stopped in front of a large mansion.
"Brother Lin, could you help me bring grandpa inside? I’ll go fetch his medicine," Liu Bing’er said.
Lin Fan nodded, "No problem."
He got out of the car, carried Liu Tingshan on his back, and followed Liu Bing’er into the mansion.
The news of Liu Tingshan collapsing quickly spread through the Liu Family Mansion, and a few people hurriedly rushed into the living room, all dressed in fine clothing. Two burly men in suits also entered, likely bodyguards.
"What’s going on, who are you?"
A stern-looking middle-aged man asked Lin Fan, his tone somewhat harsh.
Lin Fan placed Liu Tingshan on the sofa and said, "The elderly gentleman fainted on the street. I happened to pass by and brought him back."
So it turns out he was helping.
The middle-aged man, however, grew even more upset and looked at the two bodyguards with anger: "What are you doing? Why didn’t you accompany and protect the old master when he went out?"
The two bodyguards seemed intimidated by the middle-aged man’s demeanor and lowered their heads, not daring to meet his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 A Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 152 A Game
"It was Grandpa who told them not to follow."
A voice came through, and then Liu Bing’er walked in, holding a medicine box.
The middle-aged man looked at Liu Bing’er, sneering, "Today you were with your father, how could you be so careless? If something happened to him, can you take responsibility?"
Liu Bing’er’s face was a bit cold, "I didn’t want Grandpa to fall ill. If you want him to be well, Third Uncle, stop wasting time with nonsense."
With that, Liu Bing’er ignored the middle-aged man, opened the medicine box, took out a dark elixir, had someone bring water, and fed it to Liu Tingshan.
This medicine was quite miraculous, as Liu Tingshan’s complexion fully recovered its rosiness, and his tightly furrowed brows relaxed, though he hadn’t regained consciousness.
Liu Bing’er let out a long sigh of relief. If something happened to Grandpa, Third Uncle would definitely not let her go.
Seeing Liu Tingshan was fine, the middle-aged man didn’t say much more to Liu Bing’er and called to the bodyguards, "Hurry up and help the old master into the room to rest!"
Lin Fan walked up to Liu Bing’er, smiled, and said, "Miss Liu, since the old master is okay, I’ll take my leave now."
Liu Bing’er gratefully said, "Thank you so much for today, Brother Lin. Why not leave a contact? When Grandpa wakes up, he’ll surely want to thank you in person."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It was just a small gesture, no need to be so polite."
Liu Bing’er bit her lip; she was Liu Tingshan’s granddaughter, someone many dreamed of getting contact with, yet now she was offering it to Lin Fan, and Lin Fan actually tactfully declined!
"If Grandpa wants to see you but can’t find you, he’ll be disappointed," Liu Bing’er said.
"Alright."
Lin Fan then exchanged phone numbers with Liu Bing’er.
Liu Bing’er said, "Then I won’t keep Brother Lin, I’ll see you out."
Liu Bing’er then escorted Lin Fan to the door, and Lin Fan got in his car and drove off.
Soon after, Lin Fan received a friend request from Liu Bing’er on WeChat, which he casually accepted.
"Brother Lin, thank you for tonight," Liu Bing’er sent a message with a playful emoji.
Lin Fan casually replied with "You’re welcome." Helping Liu Tingshan was just a coincidence and not something he took to heart.
But now he realized some time had passed, and night had deepened.
Lin Fan planned to hurry back to his apartment.
Suddenly, his phone rang.
It was Anna calling!
"Master, where are you? Can you come pick me up?" Anna sounded a bit anxious.
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled, "What happened?"
Anna said, "The master told me to cut off an ear of Feng Wanshan, but there are experts around him. I failed and lost the car. Now I’m being chased by them, but I’ve temporarily shaken them off."
Lin Fan frowned, "Give me an address."
Anna said, "I’ll send you a location on WeChat."
Lin Fan received Anna’s location and said, "Alright, hide there, I’m coming to find you."
Anna apologetically said, "Feng Wanshan might have recognized me. Sorry, Master, I let you down this time."
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay, I’m on my way."
Lin Fan hung up the phone and sped away following the location.
A hint of a cold smile appeared on his face.
There’s no need to ask, this is definitely a trap.
A trap set up by Feng Wanshan and Anna together, naturally aimed at him.
Feng Wanshan finally retaliated.
Lin Fan had Anna cut Feng Wanshan’s ear, to teach him a lesson, hoping they’d turn on each other and, if possible, sow discord between them.
He had anticipated that Feng Wanshan wouldn’t let Anna cut his ear. The task given to Anna was destined to fail.
Sure enough.
Now, Anna had indeed "failed" and was luring him over to pick her up. They must have set up a trap over there, waiting for him to show up.
If Lin Fan hadn’t gotten the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, he would have had a different countermeasure out of caution and wouldn’t have gone there.
But now Lin Fan had a better way to deal with it, decisively deciding to go and see.
Meanwhile, in an unfinished building in the city, surrounded by darkness and only a dim streetlamp nearby.
Under the streetlamp stood Anna.
"Godfather, Lin Fan took the bait, he’s on his way," Anna said into the phone, her expression indifferent.
On the other end, Feng Wanshan laughed heartily, "Very good. The kid doesn’t know you’re with me, he seems to trust you quite a bit!"
Anna said nothing, hung up the phone, and furrowed her brows.
Lin Fan had been deceived, but for some reason, she didn’t feel happy. She knew what fate awaited Lin Fan.
Getting beaten up would be fortunate; perhaps he’d even have an ear cut off by Feng Wanshan.
Anna recalled the scene from that morning, lying on Lin Fan’s lap, sleeping overnight...
Anna shook her head and spat, "Hmph, why should I sympathize with him!"
Sympathizing with an enemy is something that should never happen. She had been in the military and understood this better than anyone, but it just didn’t make sense. Thinking about Lin Fan’s fate made her uncomfortable...
This feeling left her in a bit of a dilemma.
Half an hour later.
Lin Fan drove to the base of the unfinished building.
Surveying the surroundings, Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh, this place was chosen well, even if he were killed, no one would know.
Of course, Feng Wanshan definitely wouldn’t kill him, but they certainly prepared some suffering for him.
Lin Fan sent a message to Anna, "I’m here."
Shortly after the message was sent, Anna emerged from a shadow, holding a hand over her shoulder, limping as she walked over, opened the car door, and got in.
Lin Fan glanced over to see Anna’s pale face. Blood was seeping through the fingers of the hand clutching her shoulder—she was injured!
"You’re hurt!" Lin Fan frowned.
He coldly smiled inside. To put on a show for him, they really went all out, even using the bitter trick.
Anna said in a deep voice, "Don’t worry about it, just drive."
Lin Fan responded with an "oh," thinking now was the time to play along with her performance. If his guess was correct, they’d soon be pursued and intercepted.
Though Anna had deceived him into coming, Anna didn’t want to blow her cover like this, a strategy to kill two birds with one stone.
Lin Fan started the car and planned to leave.
After driving a short distance, lights suddenly shone from behind. A glance in the rearview mirror revealed a suspicious car trailing behind his.
Lin Fan smiled coldly inside, here they came.
Suddenly, a vehicle rushed out from ahead, blocking Lin Fan’s path.
Lin Fan had no choice but to slam on the brakes, bringing the car to a halt, and the car tailing him also stopped, blocking his retreat.
Now Lin Fan was trapped front and back.
Lin Fan’s face changed as he looked at Anna and exclaimed, "What’s going on?"
Anna’s expression also changed as she grimaced, "It’s Feng Wanshan’s people. They must have tracked my movements. I’m sorry, Master, don’t worry, I’ll protect you."
Lin Fan found it amusing, wasn’t this the trap you set up!

chapters.title: Chapter 153: The Agreed Match
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 153: The Agreed Match
Two cars had their doors open, and several black-clad henchmen stepped out.
"Get out of the car!"
The leader barked fiercely at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan unbuckled his seatbelt, intending to step out.
Anna reached out to stop him, saying, "Let me go."
Anna got out of the car and faced the leader, speaking coldly, "He’s not involved in this. He was just here to pick me up; let him go, and I’ll go with you!"
The man inspected Lin Fan and sneered, "Let him go? What if he turns around and calls the police?"
Anna replied, "He won’t. Calling the police doesn’t benefit me. I’ll explain it to him. He definitely won’t call the police."
The man showed a hesitant expression.
At this moment, someone got out slowly from the car in front.
It was none other than Feng Wanshan!
Seeing Feng Wanshan, Anna’s face changed.
Feng Wanshan laughed heartily, "You’re truly loyal, still protecting your master at this time. My men may not recognize him, but do I not recognize him? Mr. Lin, please step out and talk!"
Lin Fan watched their performance coldly. He had to admit, their acting was quite good, worthy of top accolades.
If Lin Fan didn’t know their relationship, he would have been deceived, thinking Anna was truly loyal to her master.
Of course, Lin Fan also played along with them quite well.
So Lin Fan got out of the car with a shocked look, his voice trembling, "Feng Wanshan, what do you want to do? I have friends at the police department, don’t do anything rash!"
Feng Wanshan paused and then laughed loudly, "Trying to scare me with that? Don’t forget, it was your men who attacked me first. Go ahead, call the police and see what they say when they get here!"
Lin Fan said, "You hired people to cause trouble at my construction site, and I haven’t told the police yet."
Feng Wanshan laughed, "Why haven’t you told the police? Because you know I can clear my name. Hu Dahai can’t prove I hired them, so you didn’t inform the police, planning to seek personal revenge instead."
Lin Fan seemed to be hit with the truth, his expression turning grim.
Feng Wanshan grew even more complacent, "Mr. Lin, are you still planning to threaten me with the police? It seems to me our matter should be settled privately, without bothering the police, don’t you think?"
Lin Fan bit his lip, appearing forced to compromise, "What do you want?"
Lin Fan chuckled internally. Indeed, he hadn’t reported Feng Wanshan to the police because he anticipated Feng would wriggle out of it. With Feng Wanshan’s cunning, he would leave no evidence for Hu Dahai. At most, Hu’s statement would only cause Feng minor trouble, but ultimately nothing would happen to Feng.
Thus, he chose another approach, using this opportunity to set up Feng.
Since Feng went through so much trouble to place Anna by his side as an undercover agent, he naturally wouldn’t want this matter to reach the police either.
So it was a mutual decision to resolve this privately.
Feng Wanshan said, "You want to take personal revenge on me, and I want to teach you a lesson. I have a fun and fair proposal for you. I wonder if you’ll accept?"
Lin Fan said, "Go on."
Feng Wanshan said, "Let’s have a match. We’ll fight, and whoever wins can make a request of the loser, which cannot be refused. What do you say?"
Anna’s expression changed, "Master, don’t agree! He has experts with him; it’s not fair at all!"
Feng Wanshan sneered, "I doubt you have any other choice but to agree."
Lin Fan simply said, "Fine, I agree!"
Anna was surprised, "Master..."
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay, I have faith in you."
Anna fell silent.
Feng Wanshan laughed, "Good, straightforward, I like straightforward people! I noticed your subordinates are injured, I’ll give you some time to bandage them."
Lin Fan chuckled and signaled to Anna.
Anna returned to Lin Fan’s side and said seriously, "Master, we won’t come out of this well."
Lin Fan didn’t respond, instead saying calmly, "Let me see your wound."
Anna’s shoulder was grazed, blood oozing out, with some bruising around the wound—a genuine feat of her ploy.
Lin Fan, without hesitation, tore a piece of cloth from his own shirt to bandage Anna’s wound.
Seeing Lin Fan’s focus, Anna felt a sudden pang of guilt.
They were doomed to fail today, and Lin Fan was in for a rough time—something she found herself unwilling to feel.
Anna chuckled bitterly to herself, wondering what was wrong. Was she truly beginning to consider herself Lin Fan’s? Even though it was merely an act.
"All done." Lin Fan finished bandaging Anna and smiled slightly, saying gently, "If you can’t match him, just concede, it’s alright. I don’t want you getting hurt again."
Witnessing this unexpectedly tender scene, Feng Wanshan frowned, sneering to himself. Lin Fan was such a fool; he could never dream that Anna was actually on Feng Wanshan’s side!
"We can start now." Feng Wanshan said with a chuckle and signaled.
The leading henchman rushed forward and grabbed Lin Fan by the collar, lifting him up.
"Let him go."
Anna spoke calmly.
"Heh, you want to hit me?" the henchman said fiercely.
Anna said, "I won’t repeat myself."
The henchman was angry, "You have quite a temper, huh?"
He pushed Lin Fan aside and advanced towards Anna.
Lin Fan quickly said, "You bastard, she’s injured. If you have an issue, take it out on me. Bullying women, what kind of hero are you?"
The henchman chuckled, "She’s asking for it, can’t blame me."
Lin Fan was anxious, "Anna, he’s one of Feng Wanshan’s experts. If you can’t beat him, just concede. Don’t worry about me."
Anna didn’t respond or move, just coldly watched the henchman.
The henchman got right up to Anna’s face and arrogantly asked, "Woman, do you want to die?"
Anna said flatly, "Quit the chatter, get on with it if you’re going to make a move!"
"What did you say?" The henchman turned his head, laughing, "This woman is quite bold after all!"
Everyone laughed as if they’d heard a great joke.
The henchman wiped his smile, "You’ve got quite an attitude. Lucky for you, I’m not one to spare a lady. I’ll hit women too!"
As he spoke, he reached for Anna’s collar, intending to lift her as he did with Lin Fan.
Yet, before his hand touched Anna’s collar, there was a sudden scream.
Anna had caught his hand with lightning speed, so quickly that no one else could react in time.
The henchman’s hand was locked in Anna’s grip, agony coursing through him, numbing half his body. He couldn’t break free, his face pale with cold sweat dripping down.
Everyone around was stunned.
What was happening, Anna had subdued the henchman in an instant?
This... was too strong!
This henchman was a large, formidable man; Anna apparently shouldn’t stand a chance. Yet, Anna effortlessly subdued him!

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Master Liu of Qi Gong Forced to Take Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 154: Master Liu of Qi Gong Forced to Take Action
The large man was subdued by Anna, forced to kneel, unable to move, cold sweat pouring down.
"You’re no match for me."
Anna said coldly, pushing him, and the man fell to the ground.
The large man, red-faced, scrambled up and quickly retreated. Losing to a woman in front of so many people was truly humiliating.
Feng Wanshan clapped his hands, "Not bad, your subordinate is very capable. It seems I need to bring out my skilled experts. Tianming, bring out Master Liu!"
Two people emerged from the darkness nearby.
Lin Fan recognized one of them, Feng Wanshan’s son, Feng Tianming. The other was a middle-aged man, fat, wearing traditional Tang attire, with an arrogant demeanor, looking the part of a master.
Looking at the appearance of this middle-aged man in Tang attire, he seemed quite intimidating.
Feng Tianming looked at Lin Fan smugly, "Brat, I suffered at school today, you’ll pay double!"
Lin Fan sized up Master Liu and laughed, "Boss Feng, what’s this guy’s background?"
Before Feng Wanshan could speak, Feng Tianming said, "Master Liu is a Qi Gong master, proficient in striking with force from a distance. Even several meters away, one strike can make you vomit blood!"
Only then did Lin Fan glance at Feng Tianming, saying coldly, "I’m talking to Boss Feng, you useless loser, why are you interrupting?"
Feng Tianming was furious, "You!"
Feng Wanshan chuckled, "Tianming explained it well. Master Liu’s Qi Gong is truly astonishing; I’ve personally witnessed it today."
Feng Tianming snorted, "In a bit, I’ll deal with you slowly!"
Lin Fan was curious, a Qi Gong master who can strike with force from a distance? How unreliable it sounded; could anyone really harm others from afar?
Nowadays, many so-called Qi Gong masters are just charlatans, and only fools with more money than sense fall for it. Who knows if this Master Liu is also a fraud?
"Anna, engage with him, be careful," Lin Fan said, just as well to let Anna verify it. After all, Anna is Feng Wanshan’s person, so he didn’t care.
Feng Wanshan respectfully said to Master Liu, "Master Liu, please go easy on them later, just teach them a lesson. I don’t want any fatalities."
Master Liu snorted, "Sorry, traditional martial arts from Huaxia are killing techniques. When I strike, it’s hard to ensure no casualties, but I’ll do my best to avoid it."
Feng Wanshan wiped his cold sweat, "Alright, you heard him, Master Liu striking means life and death are uncertain. You better weigh this carefully."
Lin Fan chuckled, "What’s with all the talk? Whether you’re a master or not, we’ll only know after a fight!"
Feng Tianming was fuming, "This brat is too cocky! Master Liu, please, give this brat a proper beating so he knows his place!"
Master Liu was someone he found. Lin Fan’s disdain for Master Liu was like looking down on him, making him very angry.
Master Liu sized up Anna coldly, "I never fight women. Seeing you’re a woman, I’ll give you 10 seconds to surrender. Admit defeat, and you will avoid suffering."
Anna said coldly, "Stop the chatter, Master, right? Bring it on!"
Master Liu shook his head, "Truly clueless, it seems I need to show you some skills. Dali, come out!"
A fat man walked out from behind Master Liu, skillfully keeping a few meters’ distance from Master Liu.
Master Liu began to perform Qi Gong, each move oozing with the aura of a master.
Once his Qi Gong exercise was complete, Master Liu shouted, striking out with both palms at the air.
"Ah!"
The fat man groaned heavily, took a few staggering steps back, lost balance, and fell to the ground, vomiting blood, his face turning pale in an instant.
Striking with force from a distance, hitting without contact!
Everyone around was wide-eyed, they couldn’t believe it. That really could hurt someone from afar, this Qi Gong was immensely powerful!
"Oh my, is there really such a powerful Qi Gong master in the world?"
"I’ve opened my eyes!"
"Too strong, our side is sure to win this time!"
The crowd buzzed with discussion.
Feng Tianming felt quite proud, looking at Lin Fan, "Brat, frightened out of your wits? You should be, Master Liu was hired by me specifically for revenge!"
Master Liu glanced at Lin Fan and Anna, initially thinking that after showing a bit of skill, they would be scared into submission.
But Lin Fan and Anna showed no signs of kneeling.
Master Liu couldn’t help but coldly say, "You’ve seen my skills, are you still insisting on fighting me? That was only ten percent of my power just now. Thankfully, my disciple is robust and could barely take one strike. I doubt a woman like you could withstand it. If you don’t want to die, admitting defeat is your only option!"
Anna spat, "Enough with the nonsense. If you’re done talking, let’s get started!"
Feng Wanshan frowned slightly. Master Liu had already shown his strength, and Anna only needed to ’sensibly’ admit defeat to end this matter.
But Anna didn’t do so.
This made Feng Wanshan somewhat displeased, though he, of course, couldn’t point it out directly.
"Looks like you won’t stop until you see the coffin! Mr. Lin, will you just watch as your subordinate gets seriously injured? Master Liu has already said, once he strikes, life and death are uncertain!" Feng Wanshan said.
Lin Fan smiled, "Why, Boss Feng seems quite concerned about my subordinate?"
Feng Wanshan snorted, "I just don’t want any fatalities. Lin Fan, since you’re so ignorant, don’t blame me. Master Liu, please proceed!"
Master Liu nodded, maintaining an arrogant demeanor throughout, as if looking down on everything.
"In that case, I have to make my move." Master Liu said, taking a few steps forward and beginning to channel his energy.
Immediately, everyone’s attention was riveted on the battle. Everyone thought that Master Liu had already shown his strength and would easily defeat Anna.
No matter how skilled Anna was, she couldn’t compete with a Qi Gong master.
Anna, however, seemed to ignore the terrifying aura of Master Liu as he prepared, clenching her fist and advancing straight towards him.
She quickly closed the distance, and in no time was right in front of Master Liu.
Master Liu sneered, "The reason I strike with force from a distance is to reduce damage to my opponent. Now that you choose to fight up close, you’ll only get hurt worse!"
Anna coldly stared at him, "Have you finished preparing your power? Can I make a move now?"
Master Liu replied, "In such close combat, once I’m done channeling, you’re certain to die. You still have time to surrender now, but soon you won’t!"
Anna said, "Stop wasting words, let me know when you’re ready."
Seeing Anna showed no intention of surrendering, Master Liu sighed, "Alright, if you wish to seek death, I can’t help it."
He moved his hands for a moment, finally adopting a stance ready to engage, saying solemnly, "Come on!"
Anna gave a simple "oh," suddenly launching a lightning-fast punch.
Her fist struck squarely onto Master Liu’s face.
Receiving the punch, Liu fell back like a sack, collapsing to the ground with his head tilted, motionless, actually knocked unconscious with one hit.
Everyone was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: National Martial Arts Powerless, Muay Thai Expert Appears!
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 155: National Martial Arts Powerless, Muay Thai Expert Appears!
The entire crowd fell silent, everyone watching the scene before them in astonishment.
What the hell?
Anna KO’d Master Liu with a single punch?
Just a moment ago, Master Liu was putting on an impressive show, performing the legendary Qi Gong that hits through a mountain, leaving the audience utterly amazed.
They thought that once Master Liu made a move, Anna would either be dead or severely injured!
After all, Master Liu was supposed to be incredible!
Who could have known!
As soon as the fight started, Anna handled Master Liu with one punch.
Is this real?
Master Liu couldn’t withstand even one strike, how is this possible?
Moreover, Anna waited until Master Liu finished gathering his Qi to attack, not taking advantage with a mid-execution strike, which was quite fair.
There are only two possibilities: either Anna is stronger than the Qi Gong Master, or Master Liu is a fraud.
But clearly, he had just demonstrated some marvelous skills, how could he be a fraud?
Feng Tianming was the most agitated, shouting in a hoarse voice, "What the hell is going on?"
The Master Liu he hired turned out to be worse than the four strong men from earlier, making him lose face completely.
At this moment, a fat man ran over to support Master Liu. Master Liu took Anna’s punch, and his nose was crooked, bleeding profusely, his face bruised. It was a pitiful sight.
The fat man pressed his philtrum for a while, and Master Liu slowly came to consciousness. Upon opening his eyes and seeing Anna, he immediately showed a look of fear and instinctively tried to withdraw.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh, "No way, did this Qi Gong Master really lose just like that?"
Anna didn’t even bother with Master Liu, saying, "From the moment he started gathering Qi, I could tell this guy was just faking it. He knows nothing about Qi Gong!"
Lin Fan replied, "So you’re saying the stunt he pulled earlier was fake too!"
Anna said, "It was a poorly executed performance, as long as two people cooperate, it can be done. The blood that fat guy puked was just fake blood prepared in advance!"
Lin Fan laughed, "It seems they were very skilled at their act, they must have tricked quite a few people, huh?"
Anna snorted, "Only a fool would believe such a lousy performance!"
Lin Fan burst into laughter, "Boss Feng, did you hear that? It seems you and your son are complete fools for believing in this fake master, hahaha..."
Feng Tianming’s face was flushed red, terribly embarrassed and wanting to find a hole to crawl into. Damn it, he was utterly humiliated.
Feng Wanshan’s old face turned red too, but he remained calm. He suddenly looked stern and said, "I saw right through their trickery from the start, just didn’t expose them on the spot. I let you teach them a lesson, as I detest these fraudsters. They ruin the reputation of Huaxia’s traditional martial arts. Someone come, take these two con artists out, and give them a proper reception!"
Then, a group of big men rushed in, dragging Master Liu and the fat man away.
Soon, cries of pain echoed from the darkness not far away, suggesting the two fraudsters were about to get a tough beating and a lasting lesson.
Feng Wanshan was right; over the years, the reputation of Huaxia’s traditional martial arts had been tarnished by these Jianghu tricksters, with countless fraudsters posing as masters and being repeatedly exposed.
As a result, the mention of traditional martial arts has become somewhat of a joke.
Although there are many who clamor for the rectification of National Martial Arts’ name, facing Taekwondo or Sanda, they either lose miserably or simply make excuses and retreat.
In recent years, National Martial Arts has been nothing but a laughingstock; it has never won!
Some say it’s because National Martial Arts are lethal techniques unconstrained by rules, while modern martial arts competitions are held under strict regulations, which hampers their full potential, leading to their gradual disappearance.
This argument has some merit, but it seems somewhat like a face-saving excuse.
After all, a loss is a loss.
Furthermore, with so many fraudsters out to deceive people, the reputation of National Martial Arts has already become infamous.
Lin Fan said at this moment, "Boss Feng, your fake master has lost too, do you admit defeat?"
Feng Tianming was fuming, gritting his teeth. Dammit, after going through the trouble of finding a Qi Gong Master, it turns out he’s a fake. Does it really mean he has to lose to Lin Fan?
Feng Wanshan remained composed, smiling, "I knew long ago that Master Liu was a fraud, so of course, I have a backup plan! Li San, it’s your turn!"
From the darkness, a man emerged slowly.
In his early thirties, about six feet tall, with a strong build and fierce eyes that exuded authority despite his calm demeanor, there was a commanding aura about him.
Anna’s expression became serious!
With her skills, she could estimate someone’s ability level pretty much at a glance, and she had immediately seen through Liu Master’s fakery earlier. But this person in front of her gave her an unprecedented sense of pressure.
This is a master!
A true master!
Lin Fan scrutinized the man and asked, "Anna, is this the expert who injured you before?"
Anna solemnly nodded, "Yes."
In fact, to deceive Lin Fan earlier, she had injured herself and never actually fought this man; she only heard from Feng Wanshan that he had hired an expert.
Seeing the expressions of the two, Feng Wanshan became proud, saying, "His name is Li San, an expert in Muay Thai, renowned for its strength and agility, with immense destructive power. He is a real master, far superior to that fraud from earlier!"
Li San was his real trump card!
From what he knew, Li San was capable of defeating Anna!
Deploying Li San was both to stage a scene for Lin Fan, as he needed Anna to continue working undercover by Lin Fan’s side, ensuring no suspicion of Anna and to ultimately defeat Lin Fan.
Up to this point, his plan was proceeding smoothly, with Anna not exposed at all. After this battle, she’d further gain Lin Fan’s trust.
Next, as long as Li San defeated Anna, he would win.
Lin Fan said in a low voice, "Anna, are you confident you can defeat him?"
Anna’s face was somewhat grave, "I will do my best."
She felt conflicted; she did not know about Li San’s existence, which meant that her godfather had hidden this information from her!
This could only mean one thing: her godfather did not fully trust her, thus keeping an ace up his sleeve.
Lin Fan nodded, "Alright."
Li San had already stepped forward, removing his outer garment, revealing his upper body clad in eye-catching bronze-colored muscles, and then striking an aggressive Muay Thai stance.
"Huaxia woman, fists and feet don’t have eyes. Muay Thai is known for its fierce prowess, unmatched by your Huaxia Kung Fu. Admit defeat now while you still can," Li San said calmly.
Anna replied coldly, "Save your breath!"
With that, Anna lunged forward swiftly, taking the initiative with a punch!
The two exchanged a couple of moves.
Li San noticed her moves, uttering, "Is that Huaxia Wing Chun?"
Anna was using Wing Chun Fist, one of the traditional martial arts!
This battle was between National Martial Arts and Muay Thai!
Suddenly, it captured everyone’s attention. Whether National Martial Arts, long ridiculed, could regain its reputation, all hinged on this fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Wing Chun Defeated, Lin Fan Challenges
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 156: Wing Chun Defeated, Lin Fan Challenges
Anna used Wing Chun to fight against Muay Thai Li San, and this battle instantly drew everyone’s attention.
Wing Chun can be said to be a representative of National Martial Arts, and it is a form of boxing that Huaxia citizens are relatively familiar with. In the Yip Man series of movies, Yip Man, who could fight ten people at once, became an invincible figure.
But after all, those are movies. In reality, Wing Chun doesn’t seem to be as effective in combat. The real historical Yip Man rarely fought in his life, and the story of him punching Japanese officers and kicking American instructors are all fictional plots.
At this moment, most of the people present were witnessing Wing Chun for the first time.
Anna’s Wing Chun was fluid and graceful, and the speed of her punches was comparable to that of Yip Man in the movies!
However, Li San dealt with her casually. Muay Thai is indeed swift and domineering, and Anna’s series of attacks couldn’t cause substantial injury to Li San.
The two battled intensely for a while, but Anna was kicked by Li San and flew backward, landing on the ground with blood at the corner of her mouth!
Lin Fan could tell that Anna had done her best.
She wasn’t holding back on purpose.
This Li San was simply too powerful.
Anna, kicked to the ground, became agitated, clenched her teeth, and got up to fight Li San again, but after taking a step, she clutched her stomach and spat out a mouthful of blood, staggering and almost unable to stand.
Her face turned pale instantly.
Lin Fan stepped forward and supported her.
"How are you?" Lin Fan asked with concern.
Anna shook her head with a bitter smile; she could no longer fight.
She wasn’t pretending. In fact, Li San’s kick had stirred her fighting spirit, and she even forgot her task. She wanted to defeat Li San.
Unfortunately, she was already injured, and Li San’s kick was too domineering.
Anna was officially defeated!
"Huaxia Martial Arts, that’s all it is," Li San sneered contemptuously.
Everyone present, except for Li San, was Huaxia people, and their expressions were complex for a moment.
From a rival standpoint, Li San’s victory naturally pleased them, but from a national sentiment perspective, seeing National Martial Arts lose to Muay Thai left them a bit frustrated.
Huaxia National Martial Arts ultimately lost, yet another failure to prove itself!
Especially Li San’s contemptuous smile, it was rather heartbreaking.
It must be said that Huaxia people’s national sentiment is generally quite strong.
But the Feng Family father and son, they were laughing with joy.
Feng Tianming gloated, "Lin Fan, you guys lost. You were so proud just now; this time you’re done for!"
Feng Wanshan was also delighted and said, "Mr. Lin, your subordinate lost. As per our previous agreement, the winner can make a request that the other party cannot refuse. Can I make my request now?"
Anna frowned upon seeing Feng Wanshan so happy, thinking that despite her injuries, he seemed not to care, just busy being pleased.
Plus, Feng Wanshan had concealed Li San’s existence from her, which made her uncomfortable.
Anyway, Feng Wanshan had achieved his goal; he finally defeated Lin Fan.
Anna quietly said, "Sorry, Master, I lost..."
This apology was thirty percent insincere, seventy percent genuine.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay, you did your best. Leave it to me now, it’s my turn to fight."
Anna was taken aback, surprised, "What, you’re going to fight?"
Lin Fan did not answer her and had already looked at Feng Wanshan, chuckling, "Anna indeed lost, but that doesn’t mean we lost. I want to fight Li San!"
Everyone was stunned.
The Feng Family father and son burst into laughter.
Feng Wanshan even laughed until he held his stomach.
Others also joined in the laughter.
"What did you say? Did I hear wrong? You want to fight Li San? Your subordinate couldn’t defeat him, are you stronger than your subordinate?" Feng Wanshan laughed loudly.
Feng Tianming laughed until he rolled on the ground, "I’m really amused by this guy, with his physique, what does he have to fight Li San?"
Li San sized up Lin Fan, a look of disdain flashing in his eyes, "I don’t fight ordinary people. This Huaxia woman still had the qualifications to fight me, but you, do not!"
Feng Wanshan chuckled, "Lin Fan, did you hear? You don’t even have the qualification to fight him. I don’t know if something’s wrong with your head, wanting to seek death in this way!"
Feng Tianming said, "If you ask me, just let him fight; probably Li San can kill him with one finger."
Anna advised, "Master, don’t be impulsive. I know you’re very angry because Li San injured me, but going up there would just be a pointless sacrifice."
Lin Fan said, "You’re my caretaker. He hurt you; I’m indeed very angry. I want to avenge you!"
Anna sighed, "Master, he’s a Muay Thai expert, and you’re just an ordinary person. Even I couldn’t beat him. How could you possibly defeat him?"
She really didn’t expect Lin Fan to be so impulsive. He must be blinded by anger, but strangely, his being so furious because of her made her a bit touched.
Lin Fan smiled, "No worries, I’ve got this."
Lin Fan helped Anna to sit on the hood of Kosak’s car and walked towards Li San.
"Master..."
Anna wanted to stop Lin Fan, but moving proved painful, preventing her from stopping him. She could only smile bitterly, knowing that no one could save Lin Fan now.
Feng Wanshan thought Lin Fan was merely acting on impulse, maybe just putting on a show and would calm down soon. Who knew Lin Fan actually intended to fight Li San?
This guy must be out of his mind!
"Lin Fan, are you really going to fight?" Feng Wanshan sneered.
Feng Tianming was somewhat excited, "Let him fight; I can’t wait to see him get beaten up!"
Lin Fan stood in front of Li San, firmly.
"Sorry, you hurt my subordinate. I want to avenge her. I won’t hold back later, so watch out," Lin Fan said calmly.
His words stunned everyone, followed by uproarious laughter.
Good grief!
A bronze dared to boast in front of a king!
This is just too ridiculous!
Feng Tianming laughed until he rolled over, "Hahaha..."
Feng Wanshan laughed, "I never thought this kid would be such a joker!"
Li San felt insulted and was somewhat angry. Damn it, in the martial arts community, he was a fearsome presence known as King Li.
Which master knowing his prowess wouldn’t give him some respect!
Now he was being despised by an ordinary person!
Moreover, Lin Fan had witnessed his prowess yet dared to speak such arrogant words; it was truly infuriating.
"Fine, I usually don’t fight ordinary people, but I’ll make an exception for you. Rest assured, I’ll try not to kill you!"
Li San said coldly.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, you make the first move. I’m afraid that after I strike, you won’t get the chance to anymore."
Upon hearing this, everyone thought Lin Fan’s mind must be broken, not knowing where he got the nerve to make such bold claims.
Anna covered her forehead, almost unable to bear watching.
Li San was completely provoked; every word Lin Fan spoke made him boil with rage!
Li San snorted coldly, and swiftly delivered a hook punch to Lin Fan’s abdomen.
This punch should have sent Lin Fan to the ground, unable to get up for a while!
That’s what everyone thought, believing no ordinary person could withstand such a punch!
However, to everyone’s surprise, even after being punched, Lin Fan didn’t fall down.
Instead, he acted as if nothing happened!
"Is this Muay Thai? The force is a bit lacking, feels more like a tickle. Come on, let me give you another punch." Lin Fan smiled.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Li San was also stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: This Is Huaxia Martial Arts
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 157: This Is Huaxia Martial Arts
What the hell?
Lin Fan took a hook punch from Li San and didn’t fall down, and even mocked Li San as if it was just tickling?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
First of all, it’s impossible that Lin Fan is faking it!
Just now, Li San’s kick seriously injured Anna, preventing her from walking properly. Lin Fan taking that punch should have been twitching on the ground by now.
That’s what Li San thought too!
Moreover, he knew it himself, because he struck with anger, even harder than expected, Lin Fan should be in great pain from this punch.
If Lin Fan was enduring the pain and pretending to be fine, that’s simply impossible!
Coughing up blood and looking pale would be normal.
But Lin Fan indeed seemed unfazed!
That punch just now felt like it was thrown into cotton, having no effect at all!
How could that be possible?
Li San began to doubt reality.
Even more infuriating, Lin Fan actually said to let him punch one more time, as if looking down on him!
"Mr. Li, what’s going on?" asked Feng Wanshan, clearly thinking Li San wasn’t hitting hard enough, his tone somewhat reproachful.
Li San was even more irritated.
With a loud shout, Li San suddenly raised his fist and punched Lin Fan in the face. This time, he used eighty percent of his strength, and Lin Fan’s head might just fly off from the punch!
Even if his head didn’t fly off, picturing a bruised and battered face, with nosebleeds flowing like a river, could be imagined.
However, this punch again felt like it was thrown into a cloud of cotton!
Lin Fan’s face didn’t even have a scratch!
No bruises or swelling!
Not even a drop of nosebleed!
It was as if Li San’s mighty punch was like tickling again!
Li San’s face changed as he backed up two steps, suddenly kicked towards Lin Fan, using his special move!
Previously, this was the move he used to kick Anna away!
Yet, when dealing with Anna earlier, he didn’t use his full strength, only eighty percent.
But when he kicked Lin Fan, he used his full force!
A kick with full strength.
Logically speaking, such a kick, even a pebble would be cracked open, and Lin Fan’s mortal body would likely be sent flying and meet his end!
But there was nothing he could do, Li San was panicking a bit, subconsciously using his full strength.
Yet!
After finishing this kick, it felt like kicking into nothingness.
Lin Fan didn’t even move a bit, let alone be sent flying!
No change in expression!
"I said I would let you punch me one more time, but you punched and kicked me, that’s one extra kick, but it’s okay, I won’t hold it against you. Anyway, I’m just returning a punch now, it’s my turn to strike."
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said.
Before he finished speaking, Lin Fan already threw a punch.
"Muay Thai is indeed impressive, I’ve experienced it. But you think just because you defeated Anna, you can defeat Huaxia Martial Arts and thus look down on it, that’s quite naive. Huaxia Martial Arts is extensive and profound, sometimes a simple punch is enough to win."
Lin Fan shook his head and said, his fist already hitting Li San in an instant.
Crack!
Inside Li San’s body, it seemed like the sound of bones breaking echoed.
Li San’s eyes bulged, and his body immediately bent into a shrimp-like shape, his face turning crimson.
Thump!
Right after, Li San fell down, clutching his chest and abdomen, twitching on the ground.
Everyone was stunned!
Initially, Feng Tianming was laughing happily, but now his smile froze, his face twitching, as if he too had taken a hit from Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan was dumbfounded, unable to believe his eyes.
Is this for real, Lin Fan took two punches and a kick from Li San, unharmed, while Li San took one punch from Lin Fan and went down?
This should have been reversed to be normal, so what’s happening?
Anna was also dumbstruck, she originally thought Lin Fan was recklessly angry, impulsively wanting to fight Li San.
Who would have thought Lin Fan was so formidable!
How come she couldn’t see Lin Fan’s prowess before.
In fact, no one present knew Lin Fan was this powerful, they all thought Lin Fan was just an ordinary person, so when Lin Fan expressed his intent to fight Li San, everyone took it as a joke.
In the end, everyone was utterly surprised.
Lin Fan turned out to be terrifying!
If Lin Fan’s move represents martial arts, that martial art is too powerful, unbelievably strong, even more exaggerated than in movies!
Not even Yip Man in the movies could knock someone to the ground with one punch like a shrimp.
How much force must Lin Fan’s punch have.
Li San lay on the ground, unable to get up for a long time, but obviously being a keen learner, he endured the severe pain to ask, "What... what kind of boxing technique is this?"
Lin Fan said lightly, "It’s not convenient to tell, you just need to know, this is Huaxia Martial Arts!"
Actually, Lin Fan himself didn’t know if his strength could be considered martial arts, he acquired this power after taking the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules.
This power should be said to have no specific attribute, just pure strength.
But on second thought, since it’s just pure strength, and he’s a Huaxia person, saying it’s martial arts shouldn’t be a problem, it’s logically consistent.
This Muay Thai Li San was so arrogant, looking down on Huaxia Martial Arts, why not suppress Muay Thai a bit.
Li San said, "Well... today, I’ve witnessed Huaxia Martial Arts..."
His head tilted, and finally unable to hold on, he fainted.
Lin Fan looked at the shocked Feng Wanshan: "Boss Feng, quickly get someone to help him out, several of his ribs are broken by my punch, if not treated timely, though it won’t be fatal, it will leave long-term problems."
Feng Wanshan came back to his senses, looking quite displeased, nodded at two of his men to carry Li San away.
"Boss Feng, if you have more experts, feel free to bring them out, if not, I’ll take it as your admission of defeat," Lin Fan smiled and said.
Feng Wanshan’s face turned ashen, he didn’t respond.
He apparently had no more experts, but admitting defeat was really frustrating.
Dammit!
He calculated everything, how could he have predicted Lin Fan was an expert even more formidable than Li San!
The plan was to dig a pit for Lin Fan to jump into.
But in the end, it turned out the pit was for himself!
Feng Tianming was also very unwilling, shouting hoarsely, "Why are you all just standing there, go after him together, I don’t believe he can beat all of us alone!"
The surrounding mobsters exchanged glances, trembling in fear, cursing Feng Tianming in their hearts, "What an idiot, if you want to go, go yourself, even a Muay Thai expert couldn’t withstand Lin Fan’s punch, why would we just rush to our deaths!"
But since he was their boss, if he told them to go, they had to brace themselves and do it, for a moment, the thugs were on the verge of tears.
Fortunately, Feng Wanshan had some sense and said, "Nobody move!"
Feng Tianming anxiously said, "Dad, are we just going to give up like this?"
Feng Wanshan ignored Feng Tianming, this foolish son of his did nothing but bring shame.
"A wager lost is a wager paid, Lin Fan, make your demand!" Feng Wanshan said, looking at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan could defeat Li San with one punch, so Feng Wanshan completely gave up resisting, admitting defeat was the decision with the least loss.
Luckily, Anna had not exposed her identity, she could still be a spy next to Lin Fan in the future, he would eventually avenge today’s humiliation!
Lin Fan smiled, "I originally told Anna to cut off one of your ears, to teach you a lesson, but now it seems one ear is not enough."
Feng Wanshan shuddered.
What the heck!
Is Lin Fan going to cut off both his ears, that’s too ruthless, all of a sudden, Feng Wanshan felt so scared he was about to cry.

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Helping the Beautiful Female Housekeeper Heal
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 158: Helping the Beautiful Female Housekeeper Heal
Feng Wanshan admitted defeat, according to the previous agreement, Lin Fan could make a request of him, and he couldn’t refuse.
"I originally intended to have Anna cut off one of your ears, make you learn a bit of a lesson, but now it seems one ear isn’t enough." Lin Fan said.
This frighted Feng Wanshan quite a bit.
Could it be that Lin Fan wants to cut off both his ears?
"Mr. Lin, this time it’s my fault, I shouldn’t have had people cause trouble at your construction site, only because of what happened at the banquet last night, I held a grudge against Mr. Lin, in a moment of confusion, I did this foolish thing. I ask Mr. Lin to have mercy and forgive me this once!" Feng Wanshan smiled wryly, besides lowering his posture, he had no other choice.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "You’ve caused so much trouble for me, and just recognizing your mistake, you want me to forgive you?"
Feng Wanshan quickly said, "Of course not, I’m willing to compensate for all the losses caused by this incident, as long as Mr. Lin doesn’t cut my ears..."
Lin Fan hesitated for a moment and said, "Alright, Hu Dahai and the others injured my employees. The resulting medical expenses, lost work fees, wages, and of course, Anna’s medical expenses, I’ll send Boss Feng the bill later. This time you’ll have to spend quite a bit, Boss Feng."
Feng Wanshan forced a smile and said, "No problem, thank you, Mr. Lin."
Internally, he was secretly pleased. As long as Lin Fan didn’t cut off his ears, losing some money wasn’t a big deal.
Lin Fan didn’t intend to take his ears anyway; his ears weren’t worth a dime. Money is more practical. Earlier, he was intentionally scaring him, and the guy can’t handle fright, immediately offering financial compensation, right in line with Lin Fan’s wishes.
"There’s one more thing, I’d like to discuss it in private with Boss Feng."
Lin Fan smiled as he walked toward Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan immediately became tense, afraid that Lin Fan would come up and hit him, and for a moment didn’t know whether to retreat.
His subordinates also became vigilant, each looking nervous, damn it, if they really fight, none of them would be a match for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan walked up to Feng Wanshan’s side, leaned over to his ear, and said in a low voice, "Anna isn’t just my housekeeper, she’s also my woman. I’ll let go of tonight’s incident, but if you dare harm her by even a fraction in the future, I won’t forgive you!"
Lin Fan used a voice only Feng Wanshan could hear, and after speaking, he turned around and walked back to Kosak.
Feng Wanshan was already stunned.
"Let’s go," Lin Fan said, smiling at Anna, and helped her into the car.
Then he himself got into the driver’s seat.
Feng Wanshan’s men sensibly moved the cars blocking the road aside, allowing Lin Fan to pass, and soon Kosak drove away from the scene.
Feng Wanshan’s expression immediately became very complicated, showing a look of suspicion and uncertainty in his eyes.
Feng Tianming asked curiously, "Dad, what did that guy Lin Fan just say to you?"
Feng Wanshan scolded, "It’s none of your business!"
Feng Tianming said unwillingly, "Is this matter really going to end like this? Our Feng family has never been bullied like this before. At worst, we can spend a lot of money to find experts!"
Feng Wanshan was furious, "I have my own plans, you don’t get to interfere, get out of here!"
However, inside, Feng Wanshan was already filled with suspicion. What did Lin Fan just say? Anna is his woman? What does that mean?
Could it be...
Feng Wanshan thought of a possibility and couldn’t help but be shocked. Last night Anna was drunk and taken away by Lin Fan, could it be that something happened between them last night...
Since that had already happened, Anna must surely know about it too. Why didn’t Anna mention it to him?
Anna would never hide anything from him, yet this time she did. What does this mean?
This suggests that Anna might no longer be trustworthy. She had something with Lin Fan, and it’s uncertain if her heart might lean toward Lin Fan!
Can he still trust Anna in the future?
Indeed, tonight, Anna’s behavior was also a bit strange; she refused to admit defeat to Master Liu!
If it weren’t for having Li San as his backup plan, Anna would have helped Lin Fan win.
Could it be that Anna really has leaned towards Lin Fan?
Once suspicion is there, Feng Wanshan’s heart couldn’t calm down.
On the other side, in Kosak.
Anna asked, "Master, what did you just say to Feng Wanshan?"
Lin Fan said, "Nothing much, I just warned him not to play tricks again, next time I won’t be polite to him."
"Oh." Anna replied, feeling a bit complicated. If Lin Fan found out she was the undercover sent by Feng Wanshan, she wondered what Lin Fan would do to them.
Before she didn’t know Lin Fan was a master, it was nothing, but now knowing Lin Fan was even stronger than her, she had to be cautious.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Let’s not talk about him, you’ve had a hard night. I’m taking you to the hospital now."
Anna responded, "I don’t want to go to the hospital. Master, please take me back to the manor."
Lin Fan asked curiously, "You’re seriously hurt, why not go to the hospital?"
Anna insisted, "I have my own medicine, more effective than the hospital."
Lin Fan acknowledged and did not force her, so he took her back to Yunding Manor.
Returning to Yunding Manor, it was already late at night.
Lin Fan sent Anna back to her room.
Anna sat on the bed, her face still pale, and said, "Master, please help me retrieve a metal box from beneath the bed."
Lin Fan squatted down and searched, indeed found a metal box under the bed, and took it out.
Anna opened the metal box, inside were some medicine bottles.
Anna first poured out two pills from a bottle and swallowed them, then picked up a bottle of medicinal wine.
She tried to lift her clothes, but as soon as she moved, the pain made her break out in a cold sweat, and her face turned even paler.
Lin Fan took the medicinal wine and said, "Let me. You lie down."
Lin Fan helped Anna’s head, laying her on the bed, then proceeded to lift her clothes, revealing Anna’s abdomen.
Anna, with her slender waist, had a flat abdomen, without a hint of flab. Normally, Lin Fan might be aroused at the sight.
But now, what appeared was a shocking scene; Anna’s abdomen was bruised with a footprint, and the surrounding skin was already red.
Li San’s kick was truly fierce, no wonder Anna was so seriously injured.
Anna, seeing Lin Fan lift her clothes, felt a bit shy, placing her hand on her chest, afraid that Lin Fan might accidentally lift her clothes too far.
Seeing Lin Fan sensibly stopped at her chest, Anna secretly breathed a sigh of relief, realizing she was overthinking; Lin Fan wasn’t one to take advantage.
Indeed, last night when she was drunk beyond reason, Lin Fan didn’t do anything to her.
"How should I do it?" Lin Fan asked.
Anna said, "I’m injured both internally and externally. I just took the pills for internal injuries; this medicinal wine is trauma liniment for external injuries. You just need to apply it on the bruised area."
Lin Fan acknowledged and followed Anna’s instructions, first pouring some medicinal wine into his palm, then laid his hand gently on the bruised area and began to apply it.
Lin Fan’s warm hand, combined with the medicinal wine’s effect, Anna immediately felt a warmth covering the bruised area, spreading throughout her body.
A mix of pain and comfort, this feeling made Anna’s breathing somewhat heavy, she bit her lip hard to avoid making embarrassing sounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Chu Xiaoxiao Got into Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 159: Chu Xiaoxiao Got into Trouble
This was the first time Anna had been so intimately touched by an adult man since she grew up, only Lin Fan had touched her abdomen. If any man dared to covet her before, she would have chopped off their hands.
She was so shy for a moment that she lowered her head, not daring to meet Lin Fan’s gaze.
Lin Fan’s hand touching her snow-white skin was also somewhat stirred, if not for rational restraint, he would be happy for his hands to move elsewhere.
The words he whispered into Feng Wanshan’s ear before leaving tonight were naturally meant to deceive him; he and Anna hadn’t done such a thing. He said so to make Feng Wanshan suspicious of Anna.
This was his method of sowing discord between them.
He was eager to see what Feng Wanshan would do once he stopped trusting Anna.
Everything he did was just to win over Anna; this woman would be his sooner or later...
In this somewhat ambiguous atmosphere, Lin Fan had helped Anna apply the medicinal wine.
"How do you feel?" Lin Fan stopped his hand and asked.
Anna replied, "Hmm, after resting for a night, I should be able to get out of bed, thank you, Master. You don’t have to worry about me, you can go back to sleep."
Lin Fan laughed, "Don’t you need me to stay with you? I’m afraid you might need something."
Feeling his words had some ambiguity, Lin Fan added, "I mean, I’m worried about your injury acting up..."
Anna’s cheeks blushed, "No, you are kind. If necessary, I’ll call you."
Lin Fan laughed heartily, "Alright, I’ll leave then."
Lin Fan got up and walked to the door, intending to leave.
Anna suddenly said, "Master."
Lin Fan said, "Hmm?"
Anna said, "I’m sorry for today, for burdening you to save me. You’re my master, and I should be protecting you..."
She indeed felt somewhat apologetic because tonight was supposed to be a trap set by her and Feng Wanshan for Lin Fan. If not for Lin Fan being unexpectedly formidable, he would probably have been more seriously injured than her.
The better Lin Fan treated her, the more guilty she felt, and the worst was, Lin Fan was truly good to her.
From her drunken night last night to helping her treat her injuries tonight, Lin Fan was more like a friend, even displaying a boyfriend’s strength.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to apologize, none of us expected Feng Wanshan would have such an expert like Li San. Speaking of which, Feng Wanshan is ruthless enough to have you injured like this. I really wanted to cut off his ears tonight."
After saying that, Lin Fan went out.
Anna was a bit stunned, her mood somewhat complicated, Lin Fan’s words affected her; she indeed did not know of Li San’s existence, her foster father concealed him!
Perhaps her foster father was afraid she’d show her weakness, hence hid Li San, but for him to let Li San severely injure her, she felt uncomfortable.
The image of her foster father, who had always been loving towards her, was cracking. It seemed if necessary, her foster father could sacrifice her at any time.
Ensuring Lin Fan went far away, she took out her phone, initially intending to call Feng Wanshan, but hesitated for a moment and ultimately gave up.
At the Feng Family Mansion, it was late at night, and Feng Wanshan was back home but not asleep. He was watching the phone in front of him, waiting for Anna’s call.
Normally, Anna would call him to report once she was free.
But he waited for a long time and still didn’t receive the call. It could be confirmed Anna probably wouldn’t call.
Feng Wanshan’s face darkened, instantly becoming somewhat angry, "Unthinkable, has she already betrayed me? If she really sides with Lin Fan, then what use do I have for her?"
Feng Wanshan frowned, thought for a moment, then picked up the phone and made a call, "Hello, it’s me. I need you to deliver a message to Anna concerning her dad, An Jincheng..."
Meanwhile, in another room in the Feng Family Mansion.
Feng Tianming was also awake, making a phone call.
Thinking about being defeated by Lin Fan today made him frustrated.
"Brother Dashui, are you playing with me? The Qigong Master you asked for today was a fake, making me lose face! I don’t care, you must compensate me this time!" Feng Tianming said.
The voice of Brother Dashui came from the other side in surprise, "No way, Master Liu was a fake?"
Feng Tianming said, "He’s simply trash!"
Feng Tianming narrated how Master Liu was exposed.
Brother Dashui on the other side fell silent for a while and said, "Rest assured Young Master Feng, it was my fault, and I’ll take responsibility. I know another expert, wait for my good news."
Feng Tianming worriedly said, "What expert? Not another fake, right?"
Brother Dashui said, "Rest assured, definitely not a fake. This person once hunted in deep mountains and killed a black bear bare-handed, known in Jianghu as The Panther."
Feng Tianming rejoiced, "So formidable, quickly arrange it!"
The night passed without incident.
The next day, at Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan woke up from a sleep, it was already broad daylight outside.
Lin Fan got up and went to check on Anna.
Anna was also up, the medicine was indeed effective. After a night’s rest, she was able to get out of bed on her own, doing some simple activities.
Lin Fan was relieved, advising her not to walk around randomly, and to stay at the manor for the next few days to recuperate.
Afterward, Lin Fan drove into the city to attend classes at the music academy.
Before class, Liu Mengjie came to find Lin Fan, inviting him for lunch at noon, asking him to pick her up at the principal’s office after class.
Lin Fan agreed, heading to the principal’s office after class.
Before entering the principal’s office, he heard arguing from inside and hurried to the door to have a look.
Inside the principal’s office were a pair of middle-aged men and women in shabby clothes, arguing with Liu Mengjie.
"Mr. Chu, Mrs. Chu, without a reasonable reason, I won’t approve of Chu Xiaoxiao’s withdrawal!" Liu Mengjie said sternly.
Lin Fan was stunned; were these Chu Xiaoxiao’s parents? What on earth? They came to help Chu Xiaoxiao withdraw from school?
The middle-aged man said, "What more reason is needed? My daughter doesn’t want to study anymore. We’re voluntarily applying for withdrawal; isn’t that enough?"
Liu Mengjie said, "I asked Chu Xiaoxiao’s homeroom teacher, Teacher Chen. Teacher Chen said she was very diligent in her studies, so how could she suddenly want to withdraw? If you won’t tell, then let Chu Xiaoxiao personally explain it to me."
The middle-aged man became angry, "Isn’t this unreasonable? Our withdrawal is our family business, why care so much?"
The middle-aged woman also said, "Exactly, what’s with this nonsense? Whether you approve it or not, my daughter won’t come in the future!"
Lin Fan frowned, not expecting Chu Xiaoxiao’s parents to be like this. Their refusal to reveal the reason, coupled with Chu Xiaoxiao’s absence, hinted at unspoken issues.
Thinking about this, Lin Fan took out his phone, intending to call Chu Xiaoxiao, but her phone showed it was turned off!
This made Lin Fan even more certain; Chu Xiaoxiao was in trouble!
"Really, I can’t believe withdrawing isn’t possible!"
"Today we’re just notifying you that my daughter won’t be coming anymore!"
At this moment, Chu Xiaoxiao’s parents came out from the principal’s office.
They glanced at Lin Fan, not paying much attention, and left while swearing.
Lin Fan walked into the principal’s office and saw Liu Mengjie looking somewhat troubled.
Liu Mengjie smiled as Lin Fan came in, "Little Fan is here, let’s go have lunch."
But Lin Fan said, "Sister Mengjie, can you give me Chu Xiaoxiao’s home address?"
Liu Mengjie was surprised, realizing Lin Fan overheard the argument, and said, "Little Fan, do you know Chu Xiaoxiao? What are you going to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 160: The Little Boy on the Rooftop
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 160: The Little Boy on the Rooftop
In the dilapidated room, from one of the rooms, came the sound of a boy coughing, a boy as thin as a rake lay on the bed, his face full of sickness, looking very pitiful.
"Sister..."
The boy called out in a slightly hoarse voice.
In the adjacent room, the door was closed, Chu Xiaoxiao’s eyes were red, she was sitting on the bed wiping tears, hearing her brother Chu Xiaoming’s call, she wiped away her tears and walked out of the room.
Coming to Chu Xiaoming’s bedside, Chu Xiaoxiao said, "What’s wrong?"
Chu Xiaoming said, "Sister, I heard you crying, I’m sorry, I’m the one who dragged you down, I know you don’t want to get married. How about I talk to mom and dad about not making you get married, and letting you continue your studies?"
Chu Xiaoxiao tried hard not to cry, saying, "Fool, if I don’t marry, what will you do? Our family is poor, this is the only way to get money to save you."
Chu Xiaoming said, "But, sister, you’re not happy, I don’t want you to be unhappy because of me."
Chu Xiaoxiao forced a smile and said, "I’m okay."
Chu Xiaoming said, "Sister, it’s almost noon, mom and dad still haven’t come back, I’m a bit hungry."
Chu Xiaoxiao hurriedly said, "What do you want to eat, I’ll make it for you."
Chu Xiaoming said, "I want to eat a sandwich, do you remember, the last time you took me to that newly opened bakery on the street next door, their sandwiches were really delicious. I begged mom for a long time, but she wouldn’t buy it for me. Now that they’re not here, sister, will you buy me some?"
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded: "Alright, I’ll go and buy it for you."
Chu Xiaoxiao then left home, went downstairs, and found her new bicycle parked downstairs.
Seeing this new bicycle, she thought of school and Lin Fan, and Chu Xiaoxiao’s eyes reddened again, nearly breaking down emotionally.
She couldn’t accept the reality that to fund her brother’s treatment, her parents wanted her to drop out and get married; she didn’t want to drop out, she didn’t want to marry.
Thinking about not being able to go to school anymore, not being able to see her admired Teacher Lin anymore, she felt miserable.
"Teacher Lin..." Chu Xiaoxiao murmured, as scenes from yesterday with Lin Fan floated through her mind, tears couldn’t help but flow down.
After Chu Xiaoxiao left.
Chu Xiaoming struggled to climb out of bed, got out of bed with faltering steps, walked out of the room, and then opened the door and went out.
Outside the door, beside him was the staircase, Chu Xiaoming walked to the stairway, looked up, gritted his teeth, and walked over...
On the road, a Kosak sped towards the old town.
Lin Fan was driving, Liu Mengjie sat in the passenger seat.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s parents went to school today to help her drop out, the reason unknown, Lin Fan tried to contact Chu Xiaoxiao but couldn’t, so decided to visit her home.
As the principal, Liu Mengjie also tagged along.
Through conversation, she learned that Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao knew each other, and no wonder Lin Fan would intervene in this matter.
"Little Fan, when you saw Chu Xiaoxiao yesterday, did you notice anything unusual?" Liu Mengjie asked.
Lin Fan thought for a moment, then affirmed, "No, I even went with her to buy a bicycle, we agreed to meet at school before parting. If she didn’t want to go to school, why would she buy a bicycle?"
Liu Mengjie frowned, "It seems she did not voluntarily drop out."
Lin Fan sneered, "Seeing her parents, the problem must be with them. We strive to meet Xiaoxiao before they return home."
Liu Mengjie nodded and pointed ahead, "Passing this intersection, it’s not far ahead."
Before long, Lin Fan’s car had entered the old town.
Suddenly, Lin Fan received a phone call.
Lin Fan was parking when he casually answered it.
"Mr. Lin, do you remember me, Chu Yufei," the caller said.
The caller was Chu Yufei, whom he met at the charity gala the day before yesterday.
Lin Fan said, "I remember, Miss Chu."
Chu Yufei laughed, "Originally, I wanted to meet you yesterday, but something came up. Do you have time now, Mr. Lin? I want to meet you to discuss the charity foundation cooperation."
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, I have something to deal with now, let’s reschedule."
Chu Yufei thought Lin Fan was trying to turn her down, "Mr. Lin, I really sincerely want to join your foundation. How about I come to where you are now, I won’t take up much of your time?"
Lin Fan felt a bit helpless, saying, "Alright, I’m in Hongyun District, South Street Old Town. Find a place nearby to wait for me, I’ll come find you after I’m done."
Chu Yufei was surprised, "Oh."
Lin Fan asked, "What’s wrong?"
Chu Yufei said, "Nothing, okay, I’ll come over now."
The call ended shortly thereafter.
Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie got out of the car and walked into Hongyun District.
This neighborhood was already very old, the surrounding buildings seemed to be at the age of demolition, coupled with dense surrounding houses, the car could only be parked on the road outside.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s home was right in here.
Suddenly, some people were gathered below a six-story building ahead, making a noise, all looking up at the rooftop.
On the rooftop, there unexpectedly stood a boy, standing on the edge, intending to jump off.
This boy was as thin as a rake, his face full of sickness, clearly a sick person, yet for unknown reasons, such a small child actually wanted to end his life?
"Child, it’s too dangerous up there, what are you doing, hurry and go back!"
"What’s wrong with him?"
"Isn’t this the Chu family’s child, why is he so troubled?"
People were in a chaos, some were urging the child, others were asking questions.
Lin Fan heard someone mention the Chu family and was surprised, pulling that person to ask, "Uncle, do you mean the Chu Family as in Chu Yuanhang?"
When he came, he had learned from Liu Mengjie that Chu Xiaoxiao’s father’s name was Chu Yuanhang, and her mother’s name was He Meifang, also that Chu Xiaoxiao had a younger brother named Chu Xiaoming.
The person said, "Yes, exactly, Chu Yuanhang’s son!"
Lin Fan frowned; Chu Xiaoxiao wants to drop out, Chu Xiaoming wants to jump off. What happened?
"Uncle, do you know what’s going on with the Chu family?" Lin Fan asked.
The person shook his head, "I don’t know this, but I know the child has been sick for quite some time, staying home to recuperate, probably couldn’t take the pain and temporarily lost reason!"
At this moment, outside the district, a Toyota drove towards the area.
The driver was a man in his thirties with slicked-back hair, triangular eyes, and a slightly crooked mouth, truly not handsome, but rather sturdy.
In the back seat sat a pair of poorly dressed uncle and aunt, who were Chu Xiaoxiao’s parents, Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang.
At this moment, both had smiles on their faces, a satisfied kind of smile.
This driver was the man they found as a marriage match for Chu Xiaoxiao, named Li Jianlong, a fitness trainer with a relatively decent family background.
This Li Jianlong wasn’t young anymore, but hadn’t found a wife, and got introduced to Chu Yuanhang’s family. After seeing Chu Xiaoxiao’s photo, he was very pleased with her and expressed his desire to marry her, also agreeing to pay a bride price of 300,000.
Chu Yuanhang’s family immediately agreed to this marriage, and urgently went to school today to help Chu Xiaoxiao drop out.

chapters.title: Chapter 161 What’s the Difference from Selling a Daughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 161 What’s the Difference from Selling a Daughter
After Zhu Yuanhang and his wife left the school, they took a bus back. Just as they got off, they ran into Li Jianlong. Li was officially coming to propose today.
"Uncle, Aunt, there’s no problem with Xiaoxiao’s school, right?" Li Jianlong asked.
He was very satisfied with Chu Xiaoxiao. She was as beautiful as a fairy. In theory, she was at the prime of her youth and surely wouldn’t look at someone like him.
But the Chu Family desperately needed money. He only needed to spend three hundred thousand as a betrothal gift to marry Chu Xiaoxiao, his wife. It was like finding a treasure.
The only thing he wasn’t satisfied with about Chu Xiaoxiao was that she was still in college, which was bad news for him. With her looks, there were sure to be boys pursuing her at school, and he couldn’t let that happen.
Having her drop out was precisely his idea.
Once they got married, Chu Xiaoxiao not only had to leave school but also had to sever any contact with those male classmates.
"No problem, I should say, it’s no longer a problem," Zhu Yuanhang quickly assured, afraid that Li Jianlong would be dissatisfied.
They desperately needed that betrothal money; this marriage must not be messed up.
Li Jianlong nodded, "That’s good."
The thought of soon being able to see Chu Xiaoxiao made Li Jianlong a little excited. Previously, he’d only seen her photos and was already impressed. In person, she must be even prettier than in pictures.
"Today, I brought the dowry to propose. If there’s no problem when I meet Xiaoxiao, I’ll give you both one hundred and fifty thousand in cash as a dowry. When Xiaoxiao and I are married, I’ll give the remaining one hundred and fifty thousand," Li Jianlong said.
Upon hearing this, Zhu Yuanhang and his wife exchanged glances, joy evident in their eyes.
One hundred and fifty thousand was an enormous sum for them. Thinking about getting one hundred and fifty thousand in cash soon made them excited.
He Meifang laughed, "There won’t be any problems."
Li Jianlong said, "I know there won’t be any issues with you two, but I’m not sure how Xiaoxiao herself feels about it?"
He Meifang quickly said, "What could she think? She knows marrying you means a dowry of three hundred thousand to save her brother. There will be no problem."
Zhu Yuanhang smiled, "Yes, we’ve already worked on her mindset, don’t worry."
Li Jianlong said, "That’s good."
Zhu Yuanhang flattered, "Jianlong, you’re talented, and your family is well-off. It’s Xiaoxiao’s blessing to marry you."
Hearing this, Li Jianlong felt a bit proud; he indeed considered himself not bad.
