While talking, they arrived outside Hongyun District. Li Jianlong planned to park his car and caught sight of a Kosak parked by the roadside.
Originally feeling proud, Li Jianlong was instantly deflated. Damn, look at this car, worth tens of millions. What did he have to be proud of!
How strange, in this lousy place, why was there such an expensive luxury car parked here? It was discouraging.
Li Jianlong was a bit puzzled.
He parked the car, took the dowry with him, and followed Zhu Yuanhang and his wife into the district.
As they were walking, suddenly, He Meifang let out a scream, her face changing.
"Son!"
In response, Zhu Yuanhang also cried out. The couple hurriedly ran forward.
As it turned out, on top of a building, there was a little boy about to jump. The couple was scared out of their wits.
"Is this their son? What’s happening?" Li Jianlong frowned.
On the rooftop, Chu Xiaoming had already climbed to the edge. He was physically frail, so climbing to the rooftop was no easy feat. At this moment, his face was pale, clearly exhausted.
"Son, what are you doing? Come back!"
"Come back!"
The couple ran frantically, screaming, nearly hysterical.
Chu Xiaoming saw them, showing a pained expression.
"Dad, Mom, I don’t want to live anymore. Staying alive only drags you down, burdens Sis. If I die, it’ll be over. Sis won’t have to drop out or get married," Chu Xiaoming said.
He Meifang anxiously said, "What are you talking about? How could you be a burden to us?"
Zhu Yuanhang said, "Why would you think that? Where’s your sister?"
At this time, there was a clatter—something fell to the ground nearby.
Everyone looked around and saw a bicycle laying on the ground, a plastic bag hanging from the handlebars also broke, and a sandwich fell out.
Chu Xiaoxiao, her face pale with fright, ran over.
She had just bought a sandwich for Chu Xiaoming. Suddenly discovering him on the rooftop scared her so much she dropped her bicycle and came over.
Seeing Chu Xiaoxiao, Zhu Yuanhang was furious, pointing at her, he cursed, "Where the hell were you? Why weren’t you at home watching your brother, you useless girl!"
Fuming, Zhu Yuanhang stepped forward, raising his hand to hit Chu Xiaoxiao. If this slap landed, Chu Xiaoxiao’s face would definitely swell.
Seeing Zhu Yuanhang’s furious hand about to strike Chu Xiaoxiao.
Suddenly, a hand reached out from the side, grabbing Zhu Yuanhang’s hand.
Lin Fan!
"Let’s talk it out, why resort to violence?" Lin Fan said coldly.
"Who are you? I’m disciplining my daughter, mind your own business, let go!" Zhu Yuanhang shouted, trying to break free.
Lin Fan applied a little pressure.
"Ah!"
Zhu Yuanhang cried out. His hand felt like it was clamped by iron tongs, the pain making him grimace, cold sweat dripping down.
Damn!
This young man’s grip was too strong. If he wanted to, he could probably crush his hand.
"Alright, alright, I won’t hit her, just let me go," Zhu Yuanhang grinned and quickly backed down.
Lin Fan then released him.
"Teacher Lin..."
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned, not expecting Lin Fan to come. Besides Lin Fan, the principal was also there!
If Lin Fan hadn’t intervened in time, Zhu Yuanhang’s slap would have landed, and it’d be too unjust for her.
"I just went out to buy sandwiches for Xiaoming. I didn’t know he would get up there," Chu Xiaoxiao explained.
She then looked up at Chu Xiaoming, anxiously asking, "Xiaoming, what are you doing?"
Having witnessed the scene earlier, Chu Xiaoming appeared even more pained, "Dad, don’t blame sister, I tricked her into leaving. I don’t want to live. Sis, I’m sorry, I know you don’t want to marry. If I die, you won’t be troubled."
Chu Xiaoxiao wept, "Silly boy, Sis isn’t troubled. Sis is willing to do anything for you. Sis is doing it voluntarily!"
Chu Xiaoming shook his head, "You don’t have to lie. If you were willing, why did you cry in your room? You’ve been crying for a whole day and night. Didn’t you always tell me you wanted to be a composer? You wouldn’t want to drop out."
Chu Xiaoxiao cried uncontrollably, unable to deny it. Everything Chu Xiaoming said hit the mark.
Chu Xiaoming continued, "It’s all Mom and Dad forcing you, and they are forcing you because of me. If you marry, you can get the dowry to treat my illness. I don’t want to drag you down. The only solution I can think of is for me to die."
"What?"
Everyone was immensely shocked.
Liu Mengjie glared at Zhu Yuanhang and his wife, "That’s why you asked Chu Xiaoxiao to drop out? You’re too absurd!"
The actions of Zhu Yuanhang and his wife clearly incited public anger, and everyone began to criticize them.
"My God, forcing the daughter to drop out and get married to treat the son’s illness?"
"How is this different from selling off the daughter?"
"This is too much, why ruin your daughter’s life like that, it’s too selfish!"
Voices of rebuke filled the surroundings.
Listening to this, Zhu Yuanhang and his wife were red-faced. Family disgrace shouldn’t be spread outside. They knew this was shameful and kept it secret. Now, their family affairs were known to everyone.
"What do you know? Don’t just talk without understanding; it’s not your son who’s sick, of course, you can talk like that. My son has no money for medical treatment, have you thought about our plight? We wouldn’t have done this if it weren’t a last resort," Zhu Yuanhang shouted excitedly.
Since they lost face, might as well go all out.
Seeing Zhu Yuanhang about to argue with everyone.
"Xiaoming, I think your decision is right. If you want to save your sister, you should indeed die!"
Suddenly, Lin Fan shouted towards the rooftop.
Everyone was taken aback, and for a moment, everything went silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Teacher Lin, I Still Want to Go to School
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 162: Teacher Lin, I Still Want to Go to School
Lin Fan actually said that Chu Xiaoming deserved to die?
This statement was truly shocking, leaving everyone stunned, including Chu Xiaoming.
Originally intending to close his eyes and jump, Chu Xiaoming abruptly stopped and looked at Lin Fan, wanting to hear his explanation.
"Do you also think I deserve to die?" Chu Xiaoming asked.
Lin Fan nodded and said, "That’s right, because you’re sick and your parents don’t have the money to treat you, which has burdened your sister. If you die, your sister wouldn’t have to get married. For you, this is indeed the only way to save your sister, but..."
Lin Fan paused.
Chu Xiaoming asked curiously, "But what?"
Lin Fan said, "But doing so would cause your sister to feel guilty for a lifetime because you died for her. She would blame herself, feel sad, and perhaps wouldn’t be able to cope, ending up like you. Is that really what you want to see?"
Chu Xiaoming was stunned: "..."
He hadn’t considered this, and Lin Fan’s words terrified him.
Chu Xiaoxiao was already sobbing uncontrollably.
She naturally understood Lin Fan’s intention; his earlier words about Chu Xiaoming deserving to die were merely a method of persuasion.
"Is that what you want to see?" Lin Fan raised his voice.
Chu Xiaoming quickly shook his head: "I don’t want that..."
Chu Xiaoxiao cried and said, "Xiaoming, listen to Teacher Lin. Don’t do anything foolish, okay? If you die, your sister will die of guilt too."
Chu Xiaoming heavily nodded: "Sister, don’t cry. I won’t jump off the building! But... sister, do you really want to drop out of school and get married for me?"
Chu Xiaoxiao wiped her tears and forced a smile: "Sister is willing to do it. Actually, I’ve long stopped wanting to go to school."
Chu Xiaoming was stunned.
He Meifang laughed at this moment: "Did you hear that? Your sister is willing. Don’t make trouble, sweetheart. Come down quickly!"
Chu Yuanhang also laughed heartily: "Indeed! This is good now; everyone can be happy. Sword Dragon, you can come over!"
Chu Yuanhang turned back and beckoned.
Li Jianlong came over, carrying a bag of gifts, with a smiling face, constantly glancing at Chu Xiaoxiao.
He was quite satisfied with Chu Xiaoxiao; she was even prettier than in the photo, a true treasure. He couldn’t wait to take her home, the thought thrilled him.
"Xiaoxiao, hello, I’m Li Jianlong." Li Jianlong proactively greeted.
Chu Yuanhang laughed: "Xiaoxiao, he’s the man you’re going to marry; you’ll soon be husband and wife."
He Meifang stepped forward and pulled Chu Xiaoxiao: "You child, why are you shy? Hurry and greet the man! Sword Dragon, sorry, my daughter is timid, she’ll be fine once she gets familiar."
Li Jianlong kept looking at Chu Xiaoxiao, and said with a smile: "It’s okay."
Chu Xiaoxiao felt uneasy being stared at by Li Jianlong, her head lowered, her face already red, and she didn’t want to greet him.
Chu Yuanhang and his wife were quite satisfied with the situation, but they didn’t express any gratitude to Lin Fan, who with a few simple words saved their son.
Chu Yuanhang glanced at everyone and said a bit proudly: "You all saw. My daughter willingly dropped out to get married. Outsiders have no say. No more show here, disperse!"
He Meifang added: "Exactly, disperse now. We, the family, should go home."
They tried to disperse the crowd gathering to watch.
"Hold on."
Liu Mengjie suddenly spoke.
Everyone turned their gazes to her.
Liu Mengjie said, "I’m the principal of the school Xiaoxiao attends, and this is Teacher Lin from our school. We’re mainly here to understand Chu Xiaoxiao’s dropout situation today. Chu Xiaoxiao, are you really willing to drop out?"
Chu Xiaoxiao looked at Liu Mengjie, then at Lin Fan, and then lowered her head, murmuring, "Uh... I’m willing, Principal, Teacher Lin, please don’t worry about me. You can go back."
Chu Yuanhang said proudly: "Did you hear? I told you at school that my daughter would drop out, and you insisted on meddling. Now, hurry up and leave!"
He Meifang said: "Yes, leave quickly. You’re not welcome here!"
The couple’s attitude was quite nasty, wishing they could chase them away with a broom, since Liu Mengjie and Lin Fan were seen as enemies for attempting to disrupt their plan.
Liu Mengjie however refused to leave and said: "I don’t believe that Chu Xiaoxiao is willingly dropping out! Chu Xiaoxiao’s excellent academic performance and positive attitude are evident to all. Furthermore, Teacher Lin mentioned that he just accompanied you to buy a new bicycle yesterday, a bicycle you use to go to school!"
Li Jianlong, hearing this, couldn’t help but look at Lin Fan, feeling displeased!
Lin Fan actually accompanied Chu Xiaoxiao to buy a bicycle!
She really can’t go to school anymore!
This Lin Fan is quite handsome.
But with clothes from the market stalls, he’s clearly a poor guy!
Li Jianlong felt disdain.
Li Jianlong chuckled and said: "Why waste words? Xiaoxiao already said she’s willing. What else does she need a bicycle for? After marrying me, I’ll buy her a car!"
Liu Mengjie ignored Li Jianlong and looked at Chu Xiaoxiao: "Chu Xiaoxiao, please answer the teacher’s question."
Li Jianlong became angry: "Why the hell won’t you stop? Believe me, or I’ll throw you out!"
Chu Xiaoxiao frowned and couldn’t help but say: "Don’t talk to them like that!"
Li Jianlong, upset, was even more displeased now, feeling that Chu Xiaoxiao was defending Lin Fan, perhaps admiring this poor teacher!
"You’re about to be my wife. They’re meddling and ruining our affair. I’m just trying to send them away!" Li Jianlong said.
Chu Yuanhang then said: "Sword Dragon is right. Xiaoxiao, you shouldn’t be siding with outsiders!"
He Meifang impatiently said: "Principal Liu, Teacher Lin, I respect you as Xiaoxiao’s mentors, won’t chase you away with a broom, but don’t overstep, get out quickly!"
Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t want to see them quarrel.
She stepped in front of the two, and pleaded softly: "Principal, Teacher Lin, why not go back first, please."
Liu Mengjie said: "Answer my question and we’ll leave."
Chu Xiaoxiao bit her lip: "I..."
Lin Fan smiled and interrupted her: "Xiaoxiao, think clearly before speaking. If you truly want to marry this guy, we’ll turn around and leave, never asking again. We just want to hear a genuine word from you, or else we can’t help you."
Liu Mengjie said: "Exactly, Teacher Lin and I are here to help solve your difficulties. If you shut us out, we can’t do anything."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s eyes reddened: "I’m sorry, I don’t know how to say..."
Lin Fan gently said: "It’s okay, I know you’re concerned about your brother, but let me ask you, do you trust me?"
Chu Xiaoxiao looked up at Lin Fan, her face slightly red: "Yes."
She can distrust anyone, but she trusts Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said: "Then it’s fine, I can help you solve what you can’t."
Chu Xiaoxiao became a bit emotional: "Teacher Lin, I... I still want to go to school."
Hearing this, Chu Yuanhang and his wife, as well as Li Jianlong, became agitated.
Li Jianlong angrily said: "Alright, enough already! Xiaoxiao is my fiancée, you can’t ruin our wedding, get out!"
Then, Li Jianlong came over, reaching to grab Liu Mengjie, attempting to throw her out.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Kneeling to a Billionaire with 10 Billion
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 163: Kneeling to a Billionaire with 10 Billion
He was a gym coach, strong and burly, and Liu Mengjie really had no strength to fight back.
Everyone thought Liu Mengjie was in trouble.
Chu Yuanhang and his wife were overjoyed. Ah, this son-in-law is really reliable; it’s just right to get rid of these two annoying teachers!
Liu Mengjie was taken aback. She really didn’t expect Li Jianlong to make a move.
Li Jianlong’s hand was about to touch her.
Suddenly, Lin Fan kicked Li Jianlong, sending him flying and crashing to the ground.
"Ah!"
Li Jianlong screamed miserably, landing awkwardly, his face turning pale, incapable of getting up for a moment.
He prided himself on being strong, not taking the two seriously. How could he have known Lin Fan was so fierce? He was deeply shocked.
Everyone around was stunned.
On the rooftop, Chu Xiaoming’s eyes widened, "Damn, sister’s teacher is so cool!"
Lin Fan said calmly, "If we’re talking, we talk. Why do you have to get physical? Everyone saw it; he struck first, and I was just defending myself."
The bystanders, not liking Li Jianlong, couldn’t help but chuckle, chiming in.
"Yeah, this guy made the first move!"
"Teacher Lin was just forced to defend himself!"
"Teacher Lin, saving the beauty, did the right thing."
Hearing these comments made Chu Yuanhang, his wife, and Li Jianlong furious.
Li Jianlong cursed hoarsely, "You poor bastard! You think you’re helping Xiaoxiao, but you’re actually harming her, pushing her to be unfaithful and unfilial. I came with a 300,000 dowry to marry her. Without my money, how can she help her brother with his medical bills? Does she have to rely on you, poor bastard?"
A sly smile appeared on his face, thinking he had rendered Lin Fan speechless.
After all, this guy dressed head-to-toe in cheap clothes clearly had no money!
Chu Yuanhang and his wife hurried over and helped Li Jianlong up from both sides.
The couple was in a panic.
Chu Yuanhang pointed at Lin Fan and cursed, "How dare you kick my son-in-law, hurry and..."
He stopped mid-sentence, suddenly seeing a watch on Lin Fan’s wrist.
"Who are you calling a poor bastard?" Lin Fan smiled, casually lifting his wrist to check the time.
Chu Yuanhang’s word ’get lost’ got stuck in his throat as he stared at the Rolex, his eyes nearly popping out.
Li Jianlong’s expression changed, blurting out, "Rolex Green Submariner!"
This watch was worth over 150,000!
He brought 150,000 in cash today to propose, but that entire amount couldn’t buy even one of Lin Fan’s watches!
Liu Mengjie chuckled, "You call Teacher Lin poor, have you ever seen a poor man with a 70 million luxury car?"
Li Jianlong’s face changed dramatically: "That supercar outside, is it yours?"
Earlier, when he parked outside the neighborhood, he saw a Kosak parked nearby and wondered why such a rundown place would have a supercar parked there.
Is it actually Lin Fan’s?
Lin Fan nodded, "It’s mine."
Li Jianlong was dumbfounded.
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang exchanged a shocked glance, unwittingly letting go of Li Jianlong, causing him to fall to the ground with an ’ouch’ once more.
But the couple didn’t care about him anymore; their eyes were fixated on Lin Fan.
Xiaoxiao’s teacher actually drives a 70 million supercar?
My God, what kind of concept is this!
Li Jianlong came to marry Chu Xiaoxiao with just a 300,000 dowry. This means Lin Fan’s car alone could marry Chu Xiaoxiao hundreds of times!
This means a single hair from Lin Fan is worth more than Li Jianlong’s entire thigh.
This means for Lin Fan, covering Chu Xiaoming’s medical bills is just a trivial matter with a simple flick of his fingers!
"Teacher Lin... are you a billionaire?" Chu Yuanhang asked tremulously.
A billionaire!
Just hearing that term made He Meifang’s body shake. Damn, to her, a billionaire was just a legend, and now one stood before her?
Seeing them completely change their earlier hostile attitude, now so cautious and trembling, Lin Fan couldn’t help but find it amusing.
Sometimes money is indeed more intimidating than physical force, or rather, money is the strongest power.
Lin Fan smiled, "A billionaire, sort of. My worth isn’t much, only around a hundred billion."
Lin Fan toned it down a bit to not scare them. In reality, his worth was over a trillion, with just his cash deposits amounting to 100 billion!
But Lin Fan still shocked everyone; the people around him were almost petrified.
A hundred-billionaire!
Damn Mary next door!
Everyone’s mind was roaring.
This old neighborhood actually had a hundred-billionaire come visit!
Oh my God!
Good heavens!
People were about to lose their minds.
Chu Yuanhang and his wife were already kneeling submissively, truly weak in the knees.
"Teacher Lin, we didn’t recognize your greatness earlier; we offended you, Teacher Lin, please don’t mind."
"Teacher Lin, you and Principal Liu personally came for Xiaoxiao’s future, truly good teachers."
They took turns flattering Lin Fan.
Liu Mengjie shook her head, smiling wryly. This couple really portrayed the small townsfolk’s money-worshipping nature vividly.
Chu Xiaoxiao bowed her head, feeling ashamed for her parents, truly embarrassed.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need to flatter me. I did come to help Xiaoxiao. I’ll ask you a few questions; just answer me honestly."
Chu Yuanhang hurriedly said, "What does Teacher Lin want to ask?"
Lin Fan asked, "What illness does Chu Xiaoming have? How much do the monthly medical bills run?"
Chu Yuanhang responded, "He has leukemia, and the monthly medical bills are about five to six thousand. We plan to help him with a bone marrow transplant, and the doctor says it will cost around two to three hundred thousand."
He Meifang gave a bitter smile, "Xiaoxiao is still young. We didn’t want her to get married, but we really have no choice. If we don’t do it, we’ll have to watch Xiaoming die."
For a poor family, the economy is already tight, and encountering a major illness is a matter of losing everything.
Lin Fan, however, remained indifferent to their pity, asking, "May I ask what work you two do, and how much you earn monthly?"
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang exchanged glances, both blushing.
He Meifang said a bit hesitantly, "I’m currently running a barbecue stall. When business is good, I earn three to four thousand a month. He...he has no job."
Lin Fan gave a nod, looking at Chu Yuanhang, "As the family’s pillar, you have no job?"
Chu Yuanhang blushed, explaining, "I have no choice; someone has to stay home to take care of Xiaoming..."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Then why not let Aunt stay home while you go to work? A man, as long as he’s not afraid of hard work, should be able to earn five or six thousand monthly, right?"
Chu Yuanhang had no words.
Those around couldn’t help but point fingers at Chu Yuanhang, thinking what a failure of a father he was.
Lin Fan sneered, "Poor and unwilling to work, unwilling to change, yet you come up with such a lousy idea to sell your daughter for money? Such parents, aren’t you too outrageous! You’re going to ruin Xiaoxiao’s life; your son’s life is precious, but is Xiaoxiao’s life not precious?"
Lin Fan’s words hit home, every sentence piercing.
Chu Yuanhang and his wife bowed their heads in shame. If it was before, they would have exploded, but now knowing Lin Fan’s hundred-billionaire status, they dared not utter a word, just quietly enduring.
"Teacher Lin, what should we do then? Please guide us."
"Teacher Lin, you’re a billionaire; you can surely help us."
The couple begged.
Lin Fan said, "I can help you cover the surgery costs, but you’ll have to repay the money. I will arrange a job for Uncle, and it will be deducted monthly from his wages."
He Meifang quickly prodded Chu Yuanhang, "Aren’t you going to thank Teacher Lin?"
Having Lin Fan cover the surgery costs was indeed a huge surprise. This way, Xiaoxiao wouldn’t have to quit school and marry, and Chu Yuanhang could start working, something she had long grumbled about him not doing.
Chu Yuanhang, being a lazy person, felt a headache at the thought of working, but with so many eyes watching, he had no choice but to agree, or he’d have no face left.
"Thank you, Teacher Lin." Chu Yuanhang said reluctantly.
Lin Fan could see this guy was lazy, and since they could harm Xiaoxiao once, there might be a second time, so he needed to discipline them properly, ideally helping Xiaoxiao break free from these unreliable parents.
Lin Fan said coolly, "Alright then, starting tomorrow, Uncle will go to my construction site to move bricks. The wages are piece-rate; the more work, the more pay."
Lin Fan inwardly chuckled; making this money wouldn’t be easy, and this time he’d really teach this guy a lesson.
"Mr. Lin, I’ll help them cover the 300,000 surgery cost."
Suddenly, a voice was heard, and everyone curiously turned to find a stunningly beautiful 9 out of 10 rich and beautiful woman walking over.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: The Mystery of Chu Xiaoxiao’s Origin
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 164: The Mystery of Chu Xiaoxiao’s Origin
This 9-point rich and beautiful woman is Chu Yufei!
As soon as she arrived, she expressed her intention to help cover the surgery expenses for Chu Xiaoming, and everyone was curious about her identity.
Lin Fan knew she was the lady of the Chu family’s fortune in Yun City. She came mainly to discuss the charity fund with him, but Lin Fan couldn’t figure out the intention behind Chu Yufei’s actions.
"Miss Chu, you are going to cover for them?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Chu Yufei replied, "Yes, I can’t let Mr. Lin pay for this money."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh": "Then why do you have to pay?"
Chu Yufei looked at He Meifang: "You can ask her this question. She only came to our Chu family to make a scene a few days ago. Aunt He, perhaps you should explain to everyone?"
He Meifang lowered her head guiltily as soon as she saw Chu Yufei. When Chu Yufei addressed her directly, her eyes flickered, and her face turned red.
Chu Xiaoxiao asked in surprise, "Mom, what’s going on, who is this sister?"
He Meifang gritted her teeth and said, "She... she is the eldest daughter of the Chu family in Yun City, your half-sister Chu Yufei."
Chu Xiaoxiao: "???"
Everyone: "???"
A completely bewildered expression.
The Chu family in Yun City is indeed a prominent family, the Chu Clan owns a giant corporation worth billions, the Yun Chu Group, and the patriarch of the Chu family, Chu Haotian, is a well-known wealthy tycoon in Yun City.
The 9-point rich and beautiful woman in front of them is the eldest daughter of the Chu family, Chu Yufei, daughter of Chu Haotian!
This has really blown up the whole old district.
After all, this old neighborhood has become a place where the lower-tier people of Yun City reside. Suddenly there was a billionaire like Lin Fan, and now there’s an eldest daughter of the Chu family—something that hasn’t happened in years.
What’s more intriguing is that this eldest daughter of the Chu family seems to have brought some high-society gossip along.
Chu Xiaoxiao exclaimed, "Mom, what do you mean, I don’t understand?"
He Meifang sighed, "It’s a long story. I didn’t intend to say this in public, but since the eldest lady brought it up, I have to mention it. Xiaoxiao, you are actually the daughter of me and Chu Haotian."
Chu Xiaoxiao looked shocked: "Ah?"
He Meifang said, "That’s all I can tell you. If you want to know more, you can ask the eldest lady yourself."
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "Then... what about Xiaoming?"
He Meifang said, "Xiaoming isn’t, Xiaoming is the child of your father Yuanhang."
Chu Xiaoxiao let out a bitter smile: "Is this why you forced me to marry, to get money to save my brother, because I’m not his biological child?"
He Meifang became a bit emotional: "What could I do? I went to the Chu family to ask for money, but they didn’t acknowledge your existence, nor did they consider me important. Since they don’t recognize you as a member of the Chu family, I didn’t have to be polite with them!"
He Meifang went to the Chu family to ask for money for her son’s surgery, under the pretext of demanding support for Chu Xiaoxiao, but was kicked out by the Chu family.
After that, they planned for Chu Xiaoxiao to marry in return for engagement gifts.
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned, unable to accept this reality for a moment.
In an instant, she felt like the most unfortunate person in the world.
Her biological father is a well-known billionaire in Yun City but doesn’t acknowledge her existence.
Her biological mother and stepfather conspired to force her to quit school and marry for social climbing...
This truly is a case of parental neglect, incredibly tragic!
Lin Fan felt some sympathy and had to say, Xiaoxiao was indeed too unfortunate.
At this moment, Chu Yufei spoke, "The other day when Aunt He came to ask for money and was kicked out, it was I who brought her back. That’s how I found out I have a half-sister. Xiaoxiao, don’t worry, you are a member of the Chu family, and I will help you return to the Chu family."
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head as she recollected herself: "I don’t want to go back."
Chu Yufei frowned: "But..."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Thank you, sister, but since he doesn’t acknowledge my existence, why should I go back and be an eyesore?"
Towards the biological father she had never met, Chu Xiaoxiao harbored a sense of resentment.
Chu Yufei let out a light sigh. She understood Xiaoxiao’s feelings and knew this matter would take time.
Turning to Chu Yuanhang, Chu Yufei’s expression turned cold: "Even if Xiaoxiao cannot be recognized by the Chu family for a time, that doesn’t give you the right to act recklessly. If I hadn’t come today, who knows what ridiculous things you would have done!"
Chu Yuanhang lowered his head: "I’m sorry, Miss Chu, I had no choice, I need money for my son’s treatment..."
Chu Yufei angrily said, "And that justifies sacrificing Xiaoxiao’s life? Your son’s life is important, but Xiaoxiao’s life is not?"
With his head down, Chu Yuanhang found no words to respond.
Chu Yufei said, "For Xiaoxiao’s sake, I will cover your son’s medical expenses this time, but you must repay this money to me every month. If you don’t, I will let you taste the Chu family’s means!"
Chu Yuanhang’s expression changed. Earlier, when Lin Fan offered to pay the medical expenses, he was planning to default, thinking Lin Fan, being Xiaoxiao’s teacher, wouldn’t make things too difficult for him.
But now that Chu Yufei was involved, he didn’t dare to go against her.
"I understand, Miss Chu." Chu Yuanhang could only comply timidly.
He Meifang apologized with a smile: "Thank you very much, Miss Chu, we will definitely repay the money every month."
At this time, Li Jianlong edged closer with a sheepish grin: "Miss Chu... I plan to call off this engagement."
Upon finding out that Chu Xiaoxiao is Chu Haotian’s illegitimate daughter, Li Jianlong was quite frightened. Even though Chu Haotian didn’t acknowledge Chu Xiaoxiao, he dared not provoke them.
Chu Yufei gave him a cold look: "You have one minute to disappear from my sight."
The Chu family’s eldest daughter sure has authority!
The Yun Chu Group, with assets worth hundreds of billions behind her, is the reason why no one dares to provoke her.
Li Jianlong shivered and, without daring to say another word, hurried away.
He felt really unlucky; originally, he was attracted to Chu Xiaoxiao’s beauty and intended to show off, but who knew he would encounter both Lin Fan and Chu Yufei. Before them, he was nothing more than a small fry; instead of showing off, he ended up losing all face, and could only flee in humiliation.
After sending Li Jianlong away.
Chu Yufei said, "Xiaoxiao is a member of the Chu family, and I will eventually help her return to the Chu family. The two of you best wise up, if today’s event repeats itself, I won’t spare you!"
Chu Yuanhang and his wife smiled awkwardly: "We wouldn’t dare, we wouldn’t dare."
Chu Yuanhang had already shown a flattering smile to Chu Xiaoxiao: "Xiaoxiao, it was wrong of daddy before, daddy apologizes and asks for your forgiveness."
He Meifang smiled and said, "Alright, now that everything’s settled, Xiaoxiao, come home with mom and dad, I’ll cook something nice for you."
Now that Chu Yufei was backing Xiaoxiao, they dared not treat her lightly.
They wouldn’t dare to force Chu Xiaoxiao to marry even if given ten times the courage.
Chu Xiaoxiao wore a somewhat indifferent expression and said nothing.
This time, her heart had grown cold due to the events. She had no desire to go to the Chu family that didn’t recognize her, nor did she want to stay at her current home.
But where could she go?
"Teacher Lin, can I talk with you?" Chu Xiaoxiao looked at Lin Fan with a pitiful expression.
Lin Fan said, "Sure, let’s talk over there."
And the two of them walked to one side.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s eyes reddened as she said, "Teacher Lin, I don’t want to stay here, I feel life is too bleak. Can you tell me what I should do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Collaborating with a 9-point rich and beautiful woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 165: Collaborating with a 9-point rich and beautiful woman
Lin Fan comforted, "Don’t lose heart, life inevitably has some melodramatic moments, just push through them. Don’t you want to be a composer? Then work towards your goal. If you don’t want to stay here, you can temporarily move to the school."
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, Lin Fan’s words were very encouraging to her.
"Yes, I’ve decided, I’ll move to the dorm first. Teacher Lin, thank you." Chu Xiaoxiao blushed as she spoke, she really wanted to throw herself into Lin Fan’s arms, at this moment, she needed a warm embrace, and she could only think of Lin Fan.
But there were so many people around, she felt shy.
Liu Mengjie, upon hearing that Chu Xiaoxiao was going to live at school, decided to stay and take Chu Xiaoxiao to school.
This matter finally came to an end.
The onlookers gradually dispersed.
Princess Yu walked up to Lin Fan and smiled, "Mr. Lin, I didn’t expect you to be Xiaoxiao’s teacher."
Lin Fan, this mysterious super rich man, was actually a teacher at the music academy, which she hadn’t expected.
Since meeting Lin Fan at the charity gala that night, she learned about Lin Fan’s background, only to discover that Lin Fan had a very ordinary background, as if he was a billionaire who appeared out of thin air, with assets acquired crazily over the past few days.
She couldn’t help but be very curious about this young tycoon who started off with a 1 billion charity donation.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s just an interest. Miss Chu, you mentioned talking about cooperation, let’s find a place to talk."
A cafe near the old town.
Lin Fan and Princess Yu sat across from each other.
Lin Fan said, "Before we talk about cooperation, I’m curious, what’s Xiaoxiao’s background really about?"
Princess Yu chuckled, "Mr. Lin seems quite concerned about Xiaoxiao?"
She could tell that Xiaoxiao admired Lin Fan greatly, and that kind of gaze was hard to hide, but didn’t expect Lin Fan to also care about Xiaoxiao.
Lin Fan said, "Please don’t misunderstand, Miss Chu. I’m just caring for my student as a teacher, hoping to help her."
Princess Yu laughed gently, "I’m just joking. Regarding He Meifang and my dad’s affair, I’ve only heard about it, so it might not be accurate."
Apparently, He Meifang was an employee of Chu Haotian back in those days, seeking a promotion, one day she got Chu Haotian drunk...
Afterwards, He Meifang did not achieve the status she desired, instead she was regarded as a disgrace by the Chu Family and was kicked out.
She had hoped Chu Haotian would pity her, but Chu Haotian was even more disdainful of her than anyone else.
Later, He Meifang, pregnant for ten months, gave birth to Chu Xiaoxiao, initially thinking that for Xiaoxiao’s sake, the Chu Family would accept her.
But she was disappointed once again.
The Chu Family regarded Chu Xiaoxiao as an illegitimate child, like a beast, and did not accept He Meifang at all.
In a fit of anger, He Meifang never sought out the Chu Family again, and later when Chu Xiaoxiao was three, she married Chu Yuanhang and concealed Xiaoxiao’s background from her.
It wasn’t until recently, in order to find medical expenses for Chu Xiaoming, that she approached the Chu Family again, seeking money, only to be driven away once more.
"After learning about this, I just felt Xiaoxiao was too pitiful. No matter what, she’s a part of my Chu Family, she should return to the Chu Family," Princess Yu said.
Lin Fan felt a bit melancholic, it had to be said, Chu Xiaoxiao was indeed pitiful.
She was merely an unexpected result.
He Meifang initially got Chu Haotian drunk possibly without thinking about having Chu Xiaoxiao, and when Xiaoxiao was born, He Meifang tried to use her to enter the Chu Family.
It’s safe to say she was always a tool from an early age.
Including this time, when Chu Yuanhang forced her to marry for money, she was just a tool.
Such a girl indeed evokes sympathy.
Lin Fan asked, "What are the chances Xiaoxiao can return to the Chu Family?"
Princess Yu smiled bitterly and said, "Honestly, very little. Dad is relatively easy to speak to, but it’s Grandma and my Mommy..."
The Chu Family’s matriarch, Chu Haotian’s mother, held a high status in the family, and back then she was the one who strongly opposed He Meifang and her daughter entering the house.
Princess Yu’s mother, Chu Haotian’s wife, regarded Xiaoxiao as a scourge.
"Alright." Lin Fan said, he could understand why the Chu Family rejected Xiaoxiao, but no matter what, Xiaoxiao was Chu Haotian’s daughter, she had a right to go back.
If necessary, Lin Fan would help Xiaoxiao.
Princess Yu said, "Mr. Lin, rest assured, I will do my best. Even if Xiaoxiao can’t return, I will treat her as my own sister."
Princess Yu might be the only one in the Chu Family who had goodwill towards Xiaoxiao, and after learning about Lin Fan’s relationship with Xiaoxiao, she would only be better to her.
In fact, she voluntarily paid the medical expenses today, not so much for Xiaoxiao, but more accurately for Lin Fan.
She wanted to leave a good impression on Lin Fan.
She was indeed successful, Lin Fan thought well of her.
"Mr. Lin, why don’t we talk about the charity foundation collaboration?" Princess Yu said.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Well, Miss Chu, why are you so eager to join my charity foundation?"
Princess Yu said, "Mr. Lin’s words that night moved me, and our ideas coincide. The purpose of a charity foundation is to help those in need, but unfortunately the current situation is too chaotic, many people use charity for personal gain, I want to change the status quo but lack the funds and am powerless. Mr. Lin’s offer of 1 billion for charity, I greatly admire. I’ve always been engaged in charity work, I have experience and connections in the field, I think I can assist Mr. Lin."
Next, Princess Yu introduced her work experience, she had indeed led many charity projects.
Lin Fan, having decided to establish a charity foundation that night, did not have much in mind, it was more of a spur-of-the-moment decision, he didn’t know much about the operation of a charity foundation, and the people around him lacked talents in this area.
It could be said that Princess Yu was exactly the kind of talent he needed.
"Alright, since Miss Chu is interested, I’ll leave my charity foundation to Miss Chu to manage in the future," Lin Fan said.
Princess Yu was thrilled, "Thank you, Mr. Lin, I will not let you down! Mr. Lin, here’s to our successful cooperation."
Princess Yu extended her delicate hand.
Lin Fan shook hands with her, the soft, slender hand felt very comfortable.
It’s rare that this 9 out of 10 rich and beautiful woman is passionate about charity, she seems reliable, Lin Fan decided to give her a chance, if it doesn’t work out, he’ll reassess.
A mere 1 billion, Lin Fan didn’t care.
Princess Yu successfully joined Lin Fan’s charity foundation and was very happy. Her family didn’t support her doing charity work, hoping she would focus her energy on the family business, but she had no interest in the family business.
Without family financial support, she could only join some charity foundations, and thus witnessed the disorder in the industry, which she was powerless to change.
Her collaboration with Lin Fan was an attempt to undertake a meaningful endeavor, make some changes.
Now that she had successfully taken a step forward, she was naturally very pleased.
Suddenly, Princess Yu received a phone call.
"What, He Dahong is dead?" Princess Yu said in astonishment.
Lin Fan uttered a sound of surprise, He Dahong, wasn’t he the organizer of that charity gala the night before?
Lin Fan decided to create his own charity foundation because he happened to overhear that this guy was planning to embezzle charity funds to buy diamond necklaces for his lover.
He Dahong actually died?
A mansion.
There was a murder case here, the police had already put up the crime scene tape.
Loli had just arrived, lifted the tape, and entered the scene. As she walked into the living room, she gasped.
On the living room sofa, lay a dead person, covered in blood, with at least dozens of stab wounds.
It’s hard to say what kind of hatred or resentment, but it was truly ruthless, the deceased’s eyes were wide open, not resting in peace.
"He Dahong from Angel Foundation, this is the second case already..." Loli muttered.
Last night, she had planned to stay home with Lin Fan but was suddenly called away because of a murder case.
The deceased was another charity foundation leader, and the death was very similar to He Dahong’s.
The consecutive murders of two charity foundation leaders seemed somewhat mysterious...

chapters.title: Chapter 166: New Mission, Drive a Supercar to Apply for a Courier Job!
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 166: New Mission, Drive a Supercar to Apply for a Courier Job!
He Dahong is dead!
Last night, another charity leader also died.
Within a single day, the heads of two charity organizations died consecutively. According to the subsequent police report, both were murdered, and the killer is still being investigated with no clues found yet.
This news caused a public uproar, with everyone speculating about the killer’s motive.
And now, all the charity foundation leaders are on edge. The killer’s target is clearly them! No one knows if they’ll be the next target.
For a time, these foundation leaders began to strengthen their security and prayed for the police to solve the case soon.
As the owner of the newly established Mortal Fund, Lin Fan is also at risk and might become the killer’s target.
However, unlike others, Lin Fan isn’t worried at all. He hasn’t increased security; instead, he almost hopes the killer comes to him, so he can catch the murderer himself.
Thus, this matter hasn’t troubled Lin Fan at all.
After parting ways with Chu Yufei, Lin Fan drove his Kosak, planning to return to Yunding Manor.
He suddenly realized he was becoming idle again.
Although he now owns quite a few assets, none of these companies need his care. Even the newly established charity fund is managed by Chu Yufei, so he’s basically just lying back and counting money.
A wealthy person’s life is always prone to becoming dull.
Lin Fan even somewhat misses the days of delivering food when life, though poor, was fulfilling every day.
Now, with money, he feels rather empty.
In fact, Lin Fan hadn’t intended to quit his Meituan delivery job initially. If the CEO of Meituan hadn’t schemed against him, causing him to quit in anger, he would still be delivering food now.
"Ding!"
Suddenly, the system notification sounded.
Lin Fan uttered an "Oh," thinking today’s reward had arrived.
"System Task: Become a courier."
Lin Fan was stunned. It wasn’t a reward; it was a system task requiring him to become a courier?
Lin Fan accepted the task, took out his cellphone to search, and found a courier station nearby.
So, Lin Fan drove over to the courier station.
A station of Zhongtong Express.
Recently, due to an online shopping festival, a new batch of deliveries had arrived and piled up like a mountain.
The stationmaster, a middle-aged uncle, was busy sorting packages with a group of couriers, looking a bit overwhelmed.
"I told you to post a job ad. Did anyone come for an interview today?" the stationmaster shouted inside.
The lady boss inside responded, "No one!"
At this moment, Lin Fan drove his Kosak over.
Instantly, he caught everyone’s attention, and all were astounded.
Oh my god, this supercar is so flashy, isn’t it a multimillion-level supercar?
"Kosak, only 3 in the world, valued at 70 million!"
The stationmaster blurted out. He had a keen interest in supercars as his life’s goal was to buy one. He recognized this Kosak in a glance.
"What?"
Everyone was stunned.
A 70 million supercar!
Then the person driving it must be a billionaire!
While everyone was marveling, Lin Fan parked the car outside the station and got out.
Handsome!
Super incredibly handsome!
His wrist casually revealed a hundred-thousand-level Rolex!
This was enough to overlook his simple attire, a rich man, an absolute rich man, a legendary tall, rich, and handsome!
The stationmaster quickly approached with a beaming smile: "Sir, I’m the stationmaster here. Are you here to pick up or send a delivery?"
He decided to personally attend to Lin Fan, rarely encountering such a super Rich Second Generation, quickly trying to butter up.
The other couriers momentarily forgot about sorting deliveries, each stopping to spectate the tall, rich, and handsome.
"Tsk tsk, I wish I were that rich."
"Even without money, being as handsome as him wouldn’t be bad."
"Both handsome and rich, heaven really is unfair!"
Various murmurs spread around.
At this point, the lady boss also came out, stunned and her eyes shining. Oh my, what wind blew such a distinguished guest here today.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m not here to pick up or send a delivery. Do you need extra hands here? I’m here to apply as a courier."
What the heck?
Everyone was taken aback.
What the hell!
A person driving a 70 million luxury car is here to apply as a courier?
Didn’t hear it wrong, right?
What’s with the world, even billionaires are here competing for their jobs?
The stationmaster finally came to his senses: "Apply? Are you really here to apply? Sir, don’t joke with us."
Lin Fan looked earnest: "I’m not joking, I’m serious. I really need this job."
The stationmaster didn’t believe him: "Sir, please don’t tease us. We’re just a small business, can’t afford to mess around. I’m sorry if I offended you; I apologize."
Lin Fan sweat-dropped. The stationmaster was afraid of him. Being too wealthy can indeed be intimidating sometimes.
Money is like power; the richer you are, the less others dare to provoke you lightly.
Lin Fan felt a bit regretful; he should have driven an electric bike to blend in. Now, he seemed overly showy.
Now, he could only try to gain the stationmaster’s understanding.
Lin Fan said, "Stationmaster, I’m not messing with you. I’m sincerely here to apply. Please believe me."
Seeing his sincerity, the stationmaster was somewhat convinced: "Then tell me, why would a billionaire need to become a courier?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "It’s because I’m too wealthy that life has become dull and monotonous. I want a job to pass the time. Don’t worry, Stationmaster, I’ve worked as a deliveryman before, and I’m diligent and responsible, won’t slack off."
The stationmaster still found it hard to believe.
The lady boss couldn’t stand it anymore and approached with a friendly smile, grabbing Lin Fan’s arm: "Oh, that’s the case, then go ahead, we’re hiring you! By the way, I’m the lady boss here; just call me Sister Feng. What’s your name, handsome?"
The lady boss had better insight.
A super Rich Second Generation coming to be a courier!
For their tiny courier station, does it even need someone’s effort to take them down? Given Lin Fan’s power, just a finger snap and this place would be gone!
So Lin Fan must be here to experience life.
It’s like an Immortal descending from heaven, inadvertently granting their family incredible luck!
Why hesitate?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister Feng, I’m called Lin Fan."
The lady boss said, "Mr. Lin, you are now officially one of our employees, and you can start anytime."
Seeing this, the stationmaster accepted the reality and smiled: "Welcome, Mr. Lin, to our staff."
Leading the applause.
Everyone applauded.
"Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan!"
The couriers all greeted.
The opportunity has come, time to latch onto a big shot!

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Special Reward for Mission Completion: Top-Level Insight!
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 167: Special Reward for Mission Completion: Top-Level Insight!
Lin Fan felt a bit helpless. He was just applying for a delivery job, but they acted like a leader was parachuting in, even the station manager, who was his boss, seemed so humbled.
At this moment.
"Ding!"
The system suddenly sent a notification.
"System reminder: Today’s sign-in can begin. Sign in now to receive a luxury car. Would you like to sign in?"
"Sign in!" Lin Fan said in his heart.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, sign-in successful, reward: a Cullinan has been delivered, please check it out!"
Lin Fan felt something added to his pocket. He reached in and touched something, it was a car key!
"Mr. Lin, what do you plan to use for deliveries? Do you need me to find you a tricycle?" the landlady asked fawningly.
Lin Fan raised his eyes and smiled, "No need, I’ll use a car."
The landlady looked at the Kosak and said, "A supercar for deliveries? This supercar is cool, but it can’t hold much, right?"
Everyone was drenched in sweat.
Using a supercar for deliveries was somewhat sensational, and indeed, supercars can’t hold much. Just know that delivery workers have a significant volume to deliver every day.
Lin Fan said, "Not this one, I mean another car."
Saying that, Lin Fan took out a car key, a brand new key, and pressed it.
Beep!
Nearby, a pleasing sound was heard, and the headlights of a brand new SUV parked nearby lit up.
Rolls-Royce!
Cullinan!
Cool black body, noble design, ample space!
This is a top-tier luxury SUV!
The station manager exclaimed: "The latest Cullinan, worth 8 million!"
Oh my god!
Everyone was stunned, internally shouting "WTF".
"Truly eye-opening!"
"WTF, he brought two cars, one is a top supercar, the other a top SUV!"
"Together, the two cars are nearly 100 million!"
"Mom, he’s so rich!"
"Brother Fan, you’re awesome!"
Everyone kneeled, genuinely submissive.
They didn’t even know when this Cullinan appeared here.
Only Lin Fan knew that it was just delivered by the system.
The system naturally handled all the finer details, making the car his asset, ready for him to use.
"Sister Feng, please help me with the onboarding paperwork and give me a set of courier clothes. I can start delivering now," Lin Fan said.
The landlady happily said, "Alright, Mr. Lin, please follow me."
The landlady took Lin Fan inside, and it didn’t take long before she completed the onboarding process and issued him a set of courier attire.
When Lin Fan came out, the station manager had already prepared the parcels to be delivered for him.
"Mr. Lin, you only need to deliver these today," the station manager said with a fawning smile.
Lin Fan said, "Mm, there’s no need to be so formal in the future. Just call me Little Fan."
The station manager was a bit uneasy: "Li...Little Fan."
Then, the couriers came over, eager to help, and quickly loaded Lin Fan’s deliveries into the car.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thanks, brothers. Tonight at Ginza KTV, it’s on me!"
"Thank you, Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan is awesome!"
"Brother Fan is the coolest!"
The couriers cheered.
The Kosak was temporarily parked at the station entrance, and Lin Fan soon got into the Cullinan.
Two words, comfortable!
No wonder it’s a Cullinan, a top-of-the-million luxury car, providing an ultimate comfort experience with its spacious interior.
Driving a Rolls-Royce for deliveries!
Lin Fan was truly a one-of-a-kind courier.
As work began again, Lin Fan felt a sense of fulfillment. The boredom and emptiness that came with having too much money finally disappeared.
Watching the Cullinan leave, the people at the station felt as if they were dreaming.
Was there really a super-rich second generation applying just now?
Why did it feel like a collective dream?
If not for Lin Fan’s Kosak still parked nearby, they would really think it was an unreal dream.
The landlady was overjoyed.
In this tiny shrine, a mighty figure had come; no matter how you look at it, they were at an advantage, and in the future, as long as Lin Fan lent a hand, they could reach great heights!
A stark contrast to this landlady was the landlady from Lin Fan’s previous food delivery station.
At this moment, the landlady from the food delivery station was sitting at the entrance, sighing, "If only Little Fan were still here. Who knows which scoundrel offended Little Fan, causing him to resign."
At the Meituan Group headquarters, the boss Huang Qing shivered in his office: "Damn it, who’s cursing me?"
Meanwhile, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan, starting his delivery run.
"Ding!"
"Courier mission progress: 100/100, status: completed!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, for successfully completing the mission and earning a special reward: top-level Insight!"
Lin Fan was dumbfounded.
Triggered a special reward! The last special reward occurred when producing a new hand soap.
Turns out, completing system missions grants special rewards too!
Speaking of which, what is top-level Insight?
Lin Fan couldn’t help but feel curious.
The first delivery was to a residential area.
Upon arriving at the entrance, a security guard approached, grinning, bowing to Lin Fan.
"Sir, you look unfamiliar. Are you visiting?" the security guard asked.
Lin Fan glanced at the guard.
A sudden activation in his brain, a data stream computed rapidly.
"From the wrinkles on the guard’s face, his age can be determined to be around 50. Judging by his teeth, he likes drinking tea but doesn’t smoke. The guard’s hands are rough, with residue on them, indicating he didn’t wash hands after using the restroom!"
It felt as if he saw through the security guard instantly.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat.
Is this top-level Insight?
Indeed, it’s powerful.
"Haha, yes. Do I need to register?" Lin Fan casually asked.
The security guard smiled warmly, "No need, you look like a wealthy person. Can I shake your hand?"
If it were before, Lin Fan would have shaken hands, no big deal. However, with top-level Insight, he noticed the guard didn’t wash hands after using the restroom.
Lin Fan felt a bit speechless.
"Thanks, but forget the handshake, sir. Remember personal hygiene: wash hands after restroom visits. I recommend Blue Moon Hand Soap," Lin Fan smiled as he drove into the complex.
The security guard turned red and froze. How did this guy know he didn’t wash his hands?
If he hadn’t confirmed not meeting Lin Fan, he would have thought Lin Fan was stalking him.
He had indeed just left the restroom without washing hands because he didn’t have the habit. But how would anyone know he didn’t wash hands?
"Tsk tsk, this kid has extraordinary Insight!" the guard couldn’t help but marvel.
Lin Fan smoothly entered the complex, parking under a building.
He then took a parcel and went straight to the 10th floor.
At room 1001, he knocked, "Hello, delivery!"
He almost said "food delivery" out of habit.
After some rustling, someone came to the door.
When the door opened, Lin Fan’s eyes inadvertently glanced at the door handle. With top-level Insight, Lin Fan frowned, detecting something unusual!
Soon, the door opened, and a man peeked out, his demeanor indifferent. He glanced at Lin Fan and reached out to take the package.
Lin Fan’s gaze flicked over the man’s hand, and his heart skipped a beat. However, he remained calm outwardly as he handed over the parcel to the man.
Bang!
The man immediately shut the door.
Lin Fan silently moved to one side. In the past, he couldn’t have noticed anything odd about the man. But just now, with top-level Insight, he saw bloodstains on the door handle and on the man’s hand.
Human blood!
Though the man had washed up a bit, he was likely at home and let his guard down, failing to clean thoroughly, allowing Lin Fan to catch it.
From the man’s behavior, Lin Fan was sure there was something off about him.
Lin Fan then pulled out his phone and called Loli: "Officer, I might have found a murderer..."

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Seeing Through the Scene at a Glance, the Culprit Was Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 168: Seeing Through the Scene at a Glance, the Culprit Was Shocked
Bang, bang, bang!
After making a call, Lin Fan came back to the door of room 1001 and knocked again.
This time, the door quickly opened, and it was the same man from before.
The man peeked out and, seeing that it was Lin Fan, frowned and said, "Another delivery?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No, my stomach’s acting up. I was hoping to use your bathroom, is that okay?"
The man said coldly, "Sorry, it’s inconvenient."
After saying that, the man was about to close the door.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No problem. By the way, it seems like I noticed some blood stains on your door handle. What’s going on? Are you hurt, is it serious?"
The man’s expression subtly changed but then he calmly said, "I’m fine. You wanted to use the bathroom, right? Come in."
The man opened the door.
Lin Fan happily walked in, saying, "Thank you so much, Mr. Li. You are Mr. Li, right? The name on the delivery is Li Youcai."
The man responded nonchalantly, "Mm, I am."
But Lin Fan didn’t go to the bathroom. Instead, he took a look around the room. With top-notch insight, he quickly grasped the room’s details.
"Haha, Mr. Li, you live alone, don’t you?" Lin Fan asked. Based on his observations, it was clearly a house for a single person.
The man seemed a little impatient: "Weren’t you supposed to use the bathroom? I have things to do soon, so hurry up."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll go right now."
So, Lin Fan walked into the bathroom but didn’t stay long; he simply washed his hands and came out.
"So fast?" The man asked, surprised.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I suddenly feel better. Looks like it passed. Thank you, Mr. Li, you’re very kind."
The man replied, "You’re welcome."
Lin Fan said, "But it seems like I detected a bloody smell in your bathroom sink. Maybe my nose is sensitive. Mr. Li, are you sure you’re okay? I noticed blood on the handle earlier too, but you don’t seem injured."
The man’s eyes flickered with surprise, showing a hint of a smile: "I’m fine, you must be mistaken. Thanks for your concern. By the way, why don’t you sit down and have some water before you leave? From what I see, you delivery guys work hard."
Lin Fan said excitedly, "Really? Thank you so much, I am quite thirsty."
While speaking, Lin Fan walked over to the sofa in the living room and sat down, without any hesitation.
The man went into the kitchen and came out shortly but didn’t bring water for Lin Fan. His hands were held behind his back.
"Who are you, really, and what do you know?" The man’s face darkened as he asked.
Lin Fan looked puzzled, "I don’t quite understand what you mean, Mr. Li."
The man said coldly, "I just checked the delivery; the name on it is not Li Youcai, but Wang Youcai!"
Lin Fan let out an "oh" and smiled, "So you admit you’re not the homeowner. If I’m not mistaken, you must be a thief. Did you kill Wang Youcai?"
The man looked shocked, "How did you know?"
Lin Fan said, "I figured it out. Just now downstairs, I noticed that the building here is easy to climb, and the balcony of this apartment has no security bars. You climbed in through the balcony and accidentally knocked over a potted plant there."
The man couldn’t help but glance at the balcony, sure enough, there was an overturned potted plant.
Damn it!
This young man’s observation skills are too sharp, as if he had seen him climb in.
"What else?" The man couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan said, "And your clothes, they obviously don’t fit. After killing the homeowner, you had bloodstains on you, so you changed into the homeowner’s clothes, disposed of your bloody clothes when you went out, then came back trying to stage the crime scene. That’s why there are bloodstains on the doorknob."
The man’s voice began to tremble, "How did you know I was staging the crime scene?"
This guy, it’s as if he’s been watching me do everything!
Lin Fan said, "I noticed, when you first entered to steal, you must have ransacked the place, then tidied it up to make it seem like no burglary occurred. But once something is moved, it leaves traces, and I saw it right away."
The man said, "What else?"
"If I’m not mistaken, you plan to make it look like the homeowner committed suicide. There are only two rooms here, the homeowner’s body is in one of them?"
The man’s face twitched, and he said fiercely, "Why do you need to know so much? The more people who know, the more likely they are to die. Don’t you understand that?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You wouldn’t want to kill me too, would you?"
The man drew his hands from behind, revealing a kitchen knife!
"You can’t blame me, only yourself for sticking your nose in!" The man sneered.
He went into the kitchen just now to get a knife.
Lin Fan said, "I advise you not to struggle; you can’t escape now. I called the police before I came in. You might as well sit down and wait for them, and just confess."
The man was shocked and furious, "You damn called the police!"
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, I did. So even if you kill me now and escape, you won’t have time to get away. You should stop struggling, it’s no good for you."
The man shouted, "Of course it’s good! I’ll kill you to vent my anger. Who told you to meddle, you deserve to die!"
He then raised the knife and lunged at Lin Fan, trying to kill him.
But his knife didn’t touch Lin Fan; instead, his wrist was firmly grasped by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan applied a little force.
The man felt like his wrist was caught in a vice, causing cold sweat to drip down in pain, rendering him utterly powerless and forcing him to his knees.
Clang, the knife fell from his hand.
Only then did the man realize he had run into a brick wall.
He initially thought Lin Fan was a fool, daring to come in and expose him — wasn’t he courting death? Little did he know, Lin Fan was highly skilled and didn’t see him as a threat at all.
Too strong, how could there be such a strong delivery guy in the world!
The man was about to cry.
Lin Fan said coolly, "Are you going to behave now? If not, I’ll cripple your hand and break your leg."
The man hastily said, "Don’t, I don’t dare anymore."
Lin Fan said, "That’s good. Sit across from me and wait for the police."
As he spoke, he let go of his hand.
The man obediently sat across from Lin Fan, using his other hand to rub his wrist. It felt like Lin Fan almost shattered his bone with that grip, his hand strength was terrifyingly strong.
Lin Fan smiled, "I advised you not to struggle; you insisted on it. It’s fine, your hand will be fine after a few days of rest."
So they sat facing each other, waiting.
After experiencing Lin Fan’s grip, the man sat properly, not daring to make any trouble.
When Loli and her partner Little Wang burst in, seeing this scene, they looked at each other.
"What’s going on?"
Loli, curious, asked Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 The Policewoman’s Plea: Help me, Sherlock Holmes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 169 The Policewoman’s Plea: Help me, Sherlock Holmes!
This scene is really too bizarre.
Lin Fan said, "I came to deliver a package, noticed this guy was acting suspiciously, and judged he might be a murderer, so I came in to check the situation, and found out he really was."
Lin Fan recounted his observations.
Loli and Little Wang were dumbfounded, damn, his observational skills are too strong!
A regular delivery person would just leave after the delivery, but Lin Fan could deduce a murderer from tiny clues!
"Are you Sherlock Holmes!" Little Wang couldn’t help but say.
Loli immediately went up, handcuffed the man, and then went into the room to check. Indeed, in one of the rooms, they found a corpse.
The body was half-reclined on the bed, with the head drooping, hands holding a knife which was pierced into the heart, it looked like a suicide!
Loli immediately called for a coroner to come over.
Then, Loli returned to the living room, glaring coldly at the man, "Explain how you committed the crime, you’d better tell the truth!"
Lin Fan was beside him, so the man didn’t dare to lie and said, "It’s like this, I originally planned to steal something, didn’t intend to kill anyone. I was rummaging through the house when the owner came back, and we started fighting and I accidentally killed him..."
The man climbed the wall into the house, accidentally knocked over a potted plant on the balcony, then entered the house to search for things, and the owner Wang Youcai soon returned.
Wang Youcai tried to catch the thief and send him to the police station, and the two got into a scuffle.
The man ultimately killed the owner with a knife.
His clothes splattered with blood, so he changed into Wang Youcai’s clothes, then cleaned up the scene and faked it to look like Wang Youcai’s suicide.
Afterward, the man went out, disposed of the bloody clothes, and returned to the scene to tidy up the house, trying to erase traces of the theft.
While he was busy cleaning, Lin Fan showed up to deliver a package.
The man accepted the delivery and thought nothing of it, after all, it was just a delivery guy, he would leave after the delivery.
The man continued to tidy up, thinking once he cleaned up the house, he would leave here and escape to another place to avoid the heat.
The outcome of this matter had only two possibilities, he successfully disguised it, and Wang Youcai was processed by the police as a suicide, or the police saw through it, but by the time they realize Wang Youcai was murdered, the man would have long fled, and the police might not find him.
Who knew, just his luck, he encountered Lin Fan!
Lin Fan had just received a top-tier insight reward, and using this insight, he saw through the murder case.
Based on the man’s confession, Little Wang quickly found the bloody clothes in a neighborhood trash bin.
The coroner also arrived at the scene afterward.
The culprit was taken to the police station by Little Wang.
Loli stayed back and pulled Lin Fan aside, "Weren’t you delivering food before? Why are you delivering packages now?"
Lin Fan said, "Changed careers, experiencing life, changing things up."
Loli broke a sweat, the life of the wealthy is truly unpredictable, changing jobs as if it’s a game, such envy!
Loli got to the point, "By the way, it’s lucky you were here this time, I didn’t expect your observational skills to be so formidable!"
Lin Fan was already her idol, and she found the more she interacted with him, the more impressive he became. Who knows what else her idol is capable of?
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s nothing, just a coincidence."
Loli said, "No way, don’t be modest, your case-solving ability is really on par with Sherlock Holmes!"
Sherlock Holmes solved cases by discovering clues in the smallest details, nothing could escape Sherlock Holmes’ eyes. For instance, seeing a random person on the street, after observing Sherlock Holmes could generally analyze their living habits, occupation, personality, etc.
This kind of observation ability is very helpful in solving cases.
This thief disguised the suicide scene but wasn’t very clever. Through modern detective methods, by collecting and analyzing onsite evidence, it can still be seen through.
But this process might take some time, possibly even a few days.
By the time they realize, the murderer would have long fled far away. If the murderer hides in another area or country, catching him would be difficult.
And Lin Fan used his formidable observational skills, with simple reasoning, saw through the thief’s disguise, and successfully caught the thief on the spot!
To put it directly, this is simply outclassing modern case-solving techniques!
Lin Fan smiled, "You flatter me, officer. I still have to deliver packages, so I’ll be going now."
Loli said, "Wait!"
A thought just popped into her mind, and she got excited.
"Lin Fan, there’s a case, I want your help!"
She currently has a crucial case at hand, within a day and a night, two heads of charitable foundations were killed consecutively!
This murder case still has no leads!
The murderer might continue to commit crimes!
The bureau has already ordered Loli to solve the case within three days. There’s no way around it since the targets of this crime are prominent figures, drawing public attention, the case must be solved quickly, or it wouldn’t look good in terms of public opinion.
The bureau is under great pressure, and that pressure falls even harder on Loli.
Loli was worried about not knowing where to find clues, then Lin Fan, the "Sherlock Holmes," appeared!
Loli practically felt like she’d found a treasure.
Gotta trouble her idol again.
When Lin Fan heard Loli mention He Dahong’s case, he said, "I’ve heard about this case too, officer, what leads do you currently have?"
Loli shook her head, "Almost none, the murderer is very calm, very smart, leaving no traces."
Lin Fan said, "It’s impossible to have no traces at all. As long as the murderer appeared anywhere, there will inevitably be traces. Even if he wants to erase them, he can’t completely clean them up."
Loli said happily, "Could you help me take a look then?"
Lin Fan said with a wry smile, "I can’t, I still have to deliver packages. How about this, let me finish my deliveries first, then I’ll go with you."
Loli had no choice but to say, "Alright, then contact me when you’re free, remember!"
Lin Fan laughed, "No problem."
Immediately, Lin Fan got into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan and drove away.
People around saw a food delivery guy get into a Cullinan and were shocked, damn, delivering packages in a Rolls-Royce!
What kind of godly maneuver is this!
Loli wiped her cold sweat, her idol is truly capricious with his wealth, doesn’t he already have a supercar worth tens of millions!
Now there’s another Cullinan added!
Could he have bought a Rolls-Royce just for delivering packages!
The rich are truly unfathomable.
Lin Fan bid Loli farewell and went on the road to deliver packages.
Loli asked him to help with solving the case; this case originally had nothing to do with him, logically, he shouldn’t be worrying about it, but having received the top-tier insight reward, he unintentionally got involved in the case.
For Loli’s sake, he wouldn’t refuse this favor.
But he did need to finish delivering the packages he had first.
So Lin Fan prepared to make the next delivery.
He picked up a package and glanced at the address.
Lin Fan exclaimed, this package’s address is for Tourist Comics!
Isn’t that his company?
Lin Fan had left the company in the hands of Chen Lingling for several days now and didn’t know how things were going there.
Lin Fan had been busy these days, without contacting Chen Lingling, and Chen Lingling was probably busy with the movie, neither had contacted one another.
Just as well to go over and see how things are at the company.
Tourist Animation Company.
Lin Fan parked the Rolls-Royce outside and went inside the company holding the package.
As soon as he entered the company, a man in a suit came facing him, almost colliding with Lin Fan.
"You damn delivery boy, don’t you watch where you’re going!"
The man in the suit immediately pointed at Lin Fan, cursing him in anger.
To curse Lin Fan like this on his own turf, that’s a one-way ticket to disaster...

chapters.title: Chapter 170: The Arrogant Business Representative of the Opposing Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 170: The Arrogant Business Representative of the Opposing Company
Tourist Animation Company, meeting room.
There was a negotiation today regarding the animation film project, with Chen Lingling personally receiving the representative from the other company.
"President Zhang, according to our research data, your company’s asking price is indeed a bit high. I know your company is an industry leader, which is why I want to collaborate with your company, but can we further discuss the price?"
Chen Lingling spoke, her gaze falling on the middle-aged man in a suit across from her.
Tourist Animation has already initiated the Nezha animation film project, but relying solely on Tourist Animation is not enough to complete this project.
President Zhang, the representative from Wanguang Visual Effects Company, came over to discuss cooperation with Tourist Animation today, but both sides were stuck on the price.
Although Lin Fan had said that the film doesn’t have a cost limit and money isn’t an issue, Chen Lingling didn’t want to waste a penny and hoped every cent could be accounted for.
This was her first project since taking charge of Tourist Animation, and she wanted it to be perfect so as not to disappoint Brother Lin.
Therefore, before starting the negotiations, Chen Lingling had someone investigate the market.
Wanguang Company was being outrageous with their demands; their asking price was far beyond Chen Lingling’s expectations.
President Zhang chuckled and said, "I heard your company has a new decision-maker, but I didn’t think Miss Chen was so young. Miss Chen must be a Rich Second Generation, right? First time out working? First time dealing with our Wanguang? I don’t blame you. You might not know, our Wanguang never haggles with others."
President Zhang’s tone carried a hint of contempt.
No wonder he didn’t take Chen Lingling seriously. Chen Lingling indeed lacked the aura of a female president.
She wasn’t even in professional attire but wore a dress, looking like a young lady straight out of an anime.
At a glance, she was the daughter of a wealthy father sent to inherit the family business, a young lady who didn’t understand anything and was easily bullied.
Seeing the other’s disdain, Chen Lingling didn’t get angry. She calmly said, "It’s true this is my first time dealing with your company, but I’ve heard your company’s policies. However, I hope President Zhang can reconsider, because I have great confidence in this project. If President Zhang is willing to talk with us, you won’t be disappointed."
President Zhang chuckled, "Really, having confidence is good, but blind confidence is not. I’ve roughly understood your project just now, and I disagree with Miss Chen’s view. I believe your project is quite average, so to ensure our interests, our asking price is very reasonable."
Chen Lingling bit her lip and said, "President Zhang, there is no need to decide today. Maybe consider it a bit more?"
President Zhang stood up, "No problem, Miss Chen, you can also think it over. If you are willing to accept our price, we can discuss the next steps."
Chen Lingling also stood up, "Okay, I’ll see President Zhang out."
So Chen Lingling escorted President Zhang out of the meeting room.
They arrived in the lobby.
Hearing a commotion ahead, Chen Lingling looked over and was stunned for a moment.
Lin Fan, dressed as a courier, was having a conflict with a man in a suit.
The reason was that Lin Fan nearly collided with this person, and the man in the suit lost his temper, cursing Lin Fan, "You damn courier, walk without looking, huh!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Sorry about that, but I’m not a damn courier, I’m a delivery worker, and I hope you can show some respect and not attack my profession."
The man in the suit was enraged, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "You should have heard me clearly."
The man in the suit became even angrier, pointing at Lin Fan arrogantly, "So what if I curse you, you damn courier!"
Lin Fan said, "We almost bumped into each other mainly because you were sneak-peeking at the receptionist and didn’t watch where you were going. I’ve already apologized, shouldn’t you apologize to me too?"
Lin Fan’s insight naturally didn’t miss this; the man in the suit was indeed sneak-peeking at the receptionist just now.
The receptionist looked awkward when she heard this.
Exposed by Lin Fan, the man in the suit was even more furious and embarrassed, cursing, "You’re talking nonsense, believe it or not, I’ll hit you!"
With that, the man in the suit raised his hand, ready to hit Lin Fan.
"Hey, behave yourself!"
Suddenly a loud shout was heard, and a middle-aged uncle ran over with a thermos cup.
Lin Fan recognized this uncle as Editor Bai.
"Where are you from, daring to shout and cause a ruckus with our boss, what’s this about!" Editor Bai pointed at the man in the suit and chided.
He then turned to Lin Fan, immediately becoming incredibly respectful, bowing, "Boss, you’re back?"
Although he was a bit puzzled over why the boss was dressed like a courier, he wouldn’t mistake him; this was indeed the boss!
He had once failed to recognize the boss, offending him once, and he wouldn’t make that mistake again.
Someone actually dared to insult the boss, it was a perfect opportunity for him to stand up for the boss.
This Editor Bai, who used to look down on Chen Lingling, had now become the perfect sycophant. Lin Fan didn’t bother to be petty with him.
Lin Fan nodded slightly.
The man in the suit looked surprised and incredulous, "What did you say, he’s your boss? A courier?"
Editor Bai proudly said, "Of course, he is! But you haven’t told us who you are, daring to curse our boss, you’re courting death!"
"What’s going on, Little Sun?"
At this moment, President Zhang walked over, looking seriously at the man in the suit.
The man in the suit, Little Sun, was actually the assistant President Zhang brought along. After going to the restroom, he didn’t expect to get into a conflict here.
The man in the suit, Little Sun, became respectful upon seeing President Zhang, "It’s nothing, President Zhang, just nearly collided with this courier earlier, and he..."
He still couldn’t quite believe Lin Fan was the boss here.
"Brother!"
Chen Lingling had already approached with joy, coming to Lin Fan’s side, having not seen Brother Lin for a few days, she really missed him.
She had been busy these past few days with the film project, writing scripts, and negotiating collaborations, so busy that she hadn’t had time to contact Lin Fan, but she constantly missed him, longing for a chance to visit Brother Lin.
"Lingling." Lin Fan smiled in response, having not seen her for a few days, Chen Lingling looked a bit tired, probably due to the project’s workload, but she was still just as beautiful and charming.
"Miss Chen, who is this?" President Zhang curiously asked.
Chen Lingling replied, "Let me introduce you, this is Lin Fan, the actual owner of our company. President Zhang, this is the business representative from Wanguang Company; here today to discuss the film collaboration."
President Zhang looked Lin Fan up and down, a bit baffled that he was actually the boss of Tourist Animation, but why did he look like a courier?
"So you’re President Lin, my apologies, President Lin’s attire is certainly easy to misunderstand," President Zhang said politely, extending his hand to shake Lin Fan’s.
Lin Fan smiled, "I was bored and decided to do some courier work."
Everyone broke into a cold sweat. That seemed a bit too idle.
President Zhang laughed, "I see, President Lin has quite a unique hobby."
Lin Fan chuckled, then shifted his tone, "This assistant of yours, um, this Little Sun, works under you?"
President Zhang replied, "That’s right, he’s my assistant."
Editor Bai interjected, "President Zhang, right? This assistant of yours cursed our boss and hasn’t apologized yet!"
President Zhang said, "He shouldn’t have cursed, but it was just a misunderstanding. Mr. Lin, I think we should let this matter go, don’t you think?"
Cover-up!
This President Zhang was clearly protecting Little Sun.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 Lin Fan Passes the Phone: He Wants to Speak with You for a Moment
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 171 Lin Fan Passes the Phone: He Wants to Speak with You for a Moment
Although Lin Fan is the boss of Tourist Animation Company, President Zhang obviously didn’t take him seriously.
After all, since Tourist Animation is the one seeking cooperation with Wanguang Company, President Zhang naturally holds a higher stance.
President Zhang believes that Lin Fan wouldn’t dare oppose him unless Lin Fan doesn’t want this cooperation anymore.
With President Zhang backing him up, Little Sun immediately became arrogant again, sneering at Lin Fan: "I’m cursing a stinking delivery guy, not Boss Lin. Boss Lin dressed himself up like a delivery guy, has such a lowly hobby, is it my fault?"
Hearing this, everyone from Tourist Animation Company became enraged, and many people had come over to watch.
How could this little assistant from Wanguang Company dare to be so arrogant and bully the boss!
Just because Tourist Animation needs cooperation with Wanguang!
This really made everyone feel wronged!
"What are you saying?"
Chen Lingling angrily said at this moment, "My brother is just experiencing life out of boredom, and what’s so lowly about being a delivery person?"
Little Sun rolled his eyes and ignored Chen Lingling.
This was going too far.
Upset, Chen Lingling looked at President Zhang: "President Zhang, is this how impolite your company’s employees are? I hope he apologizes, both to my brother and to the job of a delivery person!"
Chen Lingling’s words made President Zhang’s face a bit embarrassed; she just slapped his face!
President Zhang chuckled: "Why make a big deal out of it, I think we should just drop it. We have other things to do and need to leave."
Chen Lingling firmly said: "No way!"
President Zhang’s face turned cold: "Miss Chen, I hope you won’t act on impulse, don’t forget, your company still needs to cooperate with us!"
A threat, this is a threat!
Chen Lingling snorted coldly: "I’d rather not cooperate, but you must apologize!"
She could compromise on other things, but she couldn’t swallow this insult to Brother Lin, no matter what.
Clearly, President Zhang’s temper flared up as well, sneering: "Oh, really, you’d rather not cooperate, is that it? Without cooperation with us at Wanguang, can your movie be completed? Miss Chen, you’re still too inexperienced. I advise you to think before you speak. But I don’t blame you, as your company handed over the management to a green girl, what can you expect?"
Upon hearing this, Little Sun burst out laughing.
