Chen Lingling was furious, her face flushed with anger.
Everyone from Tourist Animation felt indignant as well.
But those who understood the situation knew that Wanguang was indeed a top-notch special effects company, with some technologies only available domestically at Wanguang. Tourist Animation indeed needed cooperation with Wanguang and couldn’t afford to offend them.
President Zhang was so arrogant precisely because he had nothing to fear. As a mere business representative, he dared to disregard the boss and president of Tourist Animation.
The humiliation was too much to bear.
"I think Lingling is quite right, but President Zhang, you might be the brainless one here," Lin Fan suddenly said.
President Zhang angrily said: "What did you say?"
Lin Fan smiled: "First of all, this film is not just a plaything; our employees are very devoted to it. I have strong confidence in this project. Companies cooperating with us will benefit as well, so from a long-term perspective, it’s not us needing your cooperation, it should be you seeking our cooperation!"
"Secondly, based on my understanding of special effects technology, the most advanced technology is found abroad. Therefore, we don’t necessarily have to cooperate with you. Without you, we can even work with top foreign companies; it’s just a matter of spending more money, and fortunately, we have no shortage of money."
"So do you understand now? We don’t need to curry favor with you!"
Lin Fan’s words were powerful and satisfying in their rebuttal.
Everyone at Tourist Animation felt elated; the boss was indeed strong, arguing with reason and evidence, instantly reversing the dynamics between Tourist Animation and Wanguang.
It’s not Tourist that needs Wanguang.
It’s Wanguang that needs Tourist!
With the boss saying they aren’t short of money, Tourist really doesn’t need to humble themselves before Wanguang!
So satisfying, truly satisfying.
President Zhang was infuriated and exasperated, saying: "Since Boss Lin isn’t afraid of spending money and wants to cooperate with foreign companies, then spend more, farewell!"
With that, President Zhang planned to leave with Little Sun.
Lin Fan stopped them, calmly saying: "Before you go, apologize for what just happened."
President Zhang sneered: "And if I don’t apologize, what can you do to us? Do you plan to use force?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "You’re right, if you don’t apologize, I’ll make you apologize."
Little Sun arrogantly pointed at Lin Fan: "You brat, just you!"
His finger was almost poking Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said: "You can try touching me."
Little Sun’s finger poked Lin Fan’s shoulder, arrogantly saying: "So what, what can you do to me... ah!"
Before he could finish, he suddenly screamed in pain.
Lin Fan had grabbed his finger in an instant, as if it were caught in a vice, and his entire finger felt like it was about to be crushed, the pain was excruciating.
Everyone internally exclaimed wow, the boss was so strong, instantly pinning this guy down, leaving him powerless except to scream!
In an instant, everyone looked at Lin Fan with admiration.
"Now what? What do you say?" Lin Fan asked with a smiling face.
Little Sun was sweating from the pain, his face turning white. Although Lin Fan only grabbed one finger, his entire body felt numb and a sense of fear arose.
"President Zhang, help me," Little Sun pleaded in panic.
President Zhang was furious, his face alternating between blue and white, he hadn’t expected Lin Fan to actually use force!
"Lin Fan, as a company boss, what indecency is this, let him go immediately!" President Zhang demanded angrily.
Lin Fan chuckled: "That’s not quite right, everyone saw it was his first move, I’m just retaliating."
Everyone burst into laughter.
"Exactly, this guy is shameless, poking our boss with his finger!"
"He made the first move, we can all testify!"
"So shameless, biting back instead!"
Everyone started criticizing.
After all, in the domain of Tourist Animation, merely in terms of numbers, President Zhang lost.
President Zhang was furious, sneering: "Don’t get too cocky, Lin Fan, don’t blame me for not warning you, our Wanguang Company is not someone you can afford to offend. Offend Wanguang, and don’t think you can make it in the film industry in the future!"
Lin Fan said "Oh?" with interest: "Is that so, care to elaborate?"
President Zhang became arrogant: "Ever heard of Du Tao? He’s the president of Tianxue Entertainment, the top company in the entertainment industry, and we at Wanguang are backed by Tianxue Entertainment!"
As soon as he said this, everyone quieted down, their faces changing!
Tianxue Entertainment, Du Tao!
A behemoth company in the entertainment industry, and a prominent figure!
This is not someone a small animation company can afford to offend!
Oh my god, Wanguang actually has Tianxue Entertainment as a backer, the boss has really hit a wall this time, the entire company might be in crisis in the future!
For a moment, everyone at Tourist Animation was shocked.
Seeing everyone’s reaction, President Zhang felt smug, just mentioning Du Tao’s name had this effect, President Du’s power was truly impressive.
President Zhang looked at Lin Fan smugly: "What now, kid, I said you’re too green, you have no idea the kind of people you’ve crossed!"
Lin Fan released Little Sun.
President Zhang thought Lin Fan was scared, feeling even more smug.
Little Sun rubbed his finger, cursing: "Damn, President Zhang, we shouldn’t let him off!"
But Lin Fan released Little Sun and leisurely pulled out his phone, then dialed a number.
"Hello, it’s me, I just want to ask about Wanguang Company’s situation... oh, got it, it’s nothing, I’m at my animation company now, Wanguang Company’s business representative came over, and there was a bit of conflict..."
Lin Fan actually started chatting on the phone, simply recounting the situation here.
No one knew who he was talking to on the other end?
Everyone just looked at each other.
Lin Fan then handed the phone to President Zhang: "He wants to say a few words to you."
President Zhang asked curiously: "What, who is it?"
Lin Fan replied calmly: "Du Tao."
Ah?
Everyone was shocked beyond words.

chapters.title: Chapter 172 Kneel Down and Apologize to Me Immediately
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 172 Kneel Down and Apologize to Me Immediately
Lin Fan just had a call with Du Tao, the president of Tianxue Entertainment?
This surprised everyone a bit; clearly, Lin Fan knows Du Tao.
President Zhang had a sense of foreboding, took the phone with a bit of fear: "Mr. Du... I’m Zhang Can from Wan Guang, yes, we’re discussing a collaboration with Tourist Comics... What?"
Whatever Du Tao said, Zhang Can suddenly turned pale, began to tremble, and his voice started shaking.
"Okay, Mr. Du, I understand."
President Zhang turned pale and put down the phone.
Suddenly, he dropped to his knees and begged Lin Fan, tears and snot streaming.
"Mr. Lin, it’s my fault for not recognizing greatness and offending you. Please, spare me this time." President Zhang pleaded, no longer arrogant in the slightest.
This scene left everyone stunned.
What happened?
After the call with Du Tao, President Zhang ended up like this?
Wasn’t he relying on Du Tao’s backing, disregarding Lin Fan? How did he suddenly become such a coward?
Lin Fan knew Du Tao had revealed his identity to President Zhang, the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, Du Tao’s boss.
This identity was enough to scare President Zhang to his core.
Lin Fan said indifferently, "I’m not your boss. Whether to spare you is not for me to decide. I just want an apology. Give me my phone back."
Lin Fan took the phone from President Zhang’s hand.
President Zhang quickly said, "Sorry, Mr. Lin, I’m really sorry, a thousand apologies. Please forgive me, Mr. Lin!"
Lin Fan said, "And?"
President Zhang turned and said, "Miss Chen, I’m sorry. Everyone from Tourist Comics, I’m sorry!"
Lin Fan said, "And?"
President Zhang was a bit flustered: "What else? Oh, Little Sun, why are you still standing there? Get down and apologize quickly!"
Little Sun was already confused. What’s wrong with President Zhang? How could he be so scared after a phone call? Weren’t they backed by Du Tao?
"President Zhang, who is he?" Little Sun couldn’t resist asking out of curiosity.
President Zhang hurriedly said, "Don’t ask too much, just kneel and apologize!"
Little Sun was surprised but realized Lin Fan must be a big shot, someone even President Zhang couldn’t afford to offend. Naturally, he couldn’t either.
Thud.
Little Sun also knelt down, apologizing to Lin Fan and everyone, just like President Zhang.
After apologizing.
President Zhang suddenly said, "Little Sun, you’re fired. Go back to the company and handle your resignation now, leave!"
What?
Little Sun’s face changed drastically; he was being fired?
President Zhang feared he would talk too much, followed up with: "This is Mr. Du’s decision!"
Little Sun was scared and shivered. Since Du Tao wanted to fire him, he didn’t dare have any objections, so he got up and left dejectedly, feeling extremely frustrated.
He didn’t know which Immortal he had offended.
After sending Little Sun away, President Zhang said with a smile: "Mr. Lin, Mr. Du just said our boss is already on his way here, he wants to personally discuss this collaboration with Tourist Comics."
Lin Fan responded, "Oh really, then I’ll wait here for him. Lingling, come with me to the office."
Lin Fan went into the office with Chen Lingling, leaving President Zhang alone.
Entered the office and closed the door.
Chen Lingling curiously asked, "Brother Lin, why is President Zhang suddenly so afraid of you..."
Chen Lingling didn’t finish her sentence, when Lin Fan suddenly wrapped an arm around her waist, pulling her into his embrace.
"Been a few days, have you missed me?" Lin Fan said with a mischievous smile.
Not seeing her for a few days, upon seeing her outside earlier, Lin Fan felt a sudden urge to hug her. He didn’t know why, maybe somewhere deep inside, he had already considered this girl his woman?
Chen Lingling’s face turned bright red; she hadn’t expected Brother Lin to launch such an attack suddenly, but then her body softened, melting into Lin Fan’s arms.
"Yes, always thinking about it." Chen Lingling said shyly.
If it weren’t for being busy with the movie, she wished to be with Brother Lin every day.
She bravely lifted her head, "What about you, Brother Lin? Did you miss me?"
"What do you think?" Lin Fan smiled, looking at her plump cherry lips, truly wanting to kiss her...
But now was not the time.
"Brother Lin, can we have dinner together tonight?" Chen Lingling said, suddenly she didn’t want to do anything else but be with Brother Lin. With Brother Lin, nothing else mattered.
Of course, dinner meant more than just eating...
This was the reason Lin Fan couldn’t kiss her; he knew if he took this step, Chen Lingling would lose focus on the movie, and she would regret it afterward.
"No, I have things to do tonight." Lin Fan said.
Chen Lingling was startled, Brother Lin rejected her?
Lin Fan smiled: "For now, focus on your movie. I’ll wait for you until the day your movie is released..."
Chen Lingling responded with an "Mhmm," seemingly understanding Brother Lin’s good intentions a little.
But Brother Lin was so bad; if not now, why tease her earlier, leaving her mind wandering, so bad!
She didn’t know Lin Fan was momentarily impulsive, holding back had been tough enough.
"How about you report the movie’s progress to me?" Lin Fan changed the topic.
"Okay." Chen Lingling then began to report on the work of the past few days, finally pressing down the thoughts stirred up by Lin Fan.
In the past few days, the movie project has been steadily advancing. Chen Lingling was mainly polishing the script and starting various negotiations, such as today’s collaboration talks with Wan Guang.
"We need Wan Guang’s special effects technology. Domestically, Wan Guang is the only choice, that’s why they’re confident, but their price is too high. I think it’s unreasonable. They won’t compromise, so if we’re unwilling to pay this price, essentially the negotiations will fail." Chen Lingling said.
The hardest obstacle for her at the moment was tackling the hard bone of Wan Guang.
Lin Fan said, "What price do you plan to offer?"
Chen Lingling said, "Half of Wan Guang’s offer. I’ve researched the market; this price is more reasonable."
Lin Fan laughed, "This girl is helping me save money."
Chen Lingling’s face turned red: "Of course, I don’t want to waste Brother Lin’s money. Even though he says he doesn’t mind spending, saving is still better. Brother Lin’s money doesn’t grow on trees."
Lin Fan found it amusing; his money was indeed as if it grew on trees.
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, Wan Guang won’t dare ask for this price now."
Chen Lingling said with curiosity, "Ah right, Brother Lin, you still haven’t answered me, why is President Zhang suddenly so afraid of you?"
Lin Fan said, "Do you know Tianxue Entertainment, do you know Du Tao?"
Chen Lingling shook her head: "I don’t know. I usually like anime and rarely pay attention to entertainment gossip."
Lin Fan sweatdropped: "To put it simply, Tianxue Entertainment is one of the giants in the entertainment industry, and Du Tao is the president of Tianxue Entertainment, considered a big figure in the industry."
Chen Lingling responded with an "Oh," even more puzzled: "With such a strong backing, why would they be afraid of Brother Lin?"
Lin Fan smiled: "Because I am the boss of Tianxue Entertainment, Du Tao’s superior."
Chen Lingling let out an "Ah," surprised with her mouth wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 Who exactly is he?
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: 173 Who exactly is he?
"Brother, do you have such a powerful company?"
Lin Fan said, "Yeah, I recently acquired it."
Chen Lingling was shocked into silence, Brother Lin is too wealthy, having just bought an animation company for her to manage, and now acquiring an entertainment giant!
Just how rich is Brother Lin!
At this moment, someone knocked on the door.
Chen Lingling opened the door and saw her assistant Xiaozhu.
"Mr. Lin, President, the boss of Wanguang Company, Mr. Zhao, is here." Xiaozhu said.
Chen Lingling said, "Alright, let’s go."
Lin Fan and Chen Lingling went out to greet him.
As soon as they reached the lobby, they saw a short, stocky, bald middle-aged man scolding President Zhang, who was still kneeling on the ground, not daring to get up.
"You worthless scum, do you think you can afford to offend Mr. Lin? If you don’t need those dog eyes, donate them!" The middle-aged man cursed angrily.
President Zhang was already crying from being scolded.
"Get out of here right now!" The middle-aged man shouted.
President Zhang asked, "Boss, where should I go?"
The middle-aged man said, "Go to the Africa branch, handle the procedures immediately, and when I return to the company, I don’t want to see you again!"
"Yes, I’ll go right away." President Zhang got up with a tearful face and hurriedly left.
Regretting to the point his intestines turned green.
Goddamn!
If I had known, I would’ve never offended Lin Fan. Now being sent to Africa by the boss, it’s too miserable...
After sending President Zhang away.
The middle-aged man saw Lin Fan and Chen Lingling approaching, quickly stepped forward, the angry look vanished, replaced with a fawning smile.
"Mr. Lin, hello, I’m Zhao Jinjian, the boss of Wanguang. Two of my subordinates were ignorant and offended Mr. Lin, they have been punished. I apologize to Mr. Lin once again and hope for Mr. Lin’s forgiveness." The middle-aged man said humbly.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Boss Zhao, no need to be so formal, I have put this matter behind me."
Zhao Jinjian wiped his cold sweat and repeatedly said, "That’s good, that’s good. Thank you, Mr. Lin, for being so magnanimous."
The people from Tourist Comics were utterly surprised, this was the boss of Wanguang!
Wanguang, which holds high-end technology, has always been arrogant and looks down on others. This Wanguang boss, Zhao Jinjian, is known in the industry for being domineering.
Unexpectedly, in front of Lin Fan, he’s like a lapdog!
Why is this?
Lin Fan said, "Boss Zhao, since you’re here, we might as well take this opportunity to discuss the cooperation, since everyone is here?"
Zhao Jinjian quickly said, "Alright, that’s exactly why I’m here, firstly to apologize to Mr. Lin, and secondly hoping to reach a cooperation with Tourist Comics this time."
Lin Fan said, "Cooperation is no problem, we need Wanguang’s technology, but regarding the price, Lingling thinks you’re charging too much."
Chen Lingling said, "I think reducing it by half is more suitable, what do you think, Mr. Zhao?"
Zhao Jinjian said, "This..."
Chen Lingling replied, "Mr. Zhao thinks it’s too much reduction, this can be negotiable..."
Zhao Jinjian quickly said, "Miss Chen, that’s not what I meant, I meant that the reduction is too little, to show sincerity, I’ve decided to reduce it by seventy percent. If Mr. Lin is not satisfied, it can be reduced further."
What?
Everyone was sweating profusely.
Zhao Jinjian even thought reducing it was too little and slashed it by seventy percent in one go, and could even reduce it further?
Why does the boss have such a face, making Zhao Jinjian, an old hand in the industry, do a loss-making deal?
Everyone became increasingly curious.
Chen Lingling was speechless for a moment: "..."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "We originally just hoped to reduce it by half, since Boss Zhao is so sincere, that’s great, pleasant cooperation."
Lin Fan took the initiative to extend his hand.
Zhao Jinjian quickly shook hands with Lin Fan, his face immediately beamed with joy, "Mr. Lin, pleasant cooperation."
Feeling a huge weight lifted off his heart, he held back the pain, slashing the asking price by seventy percent, all to please Lin Fan, fearing Lin Fan would hold a grudge for previous events.
Lin Fan accepting this price meant that Lin Fan had already forgiven him.
He definitely didn’t want to be enemies with the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, Lin Fan forgiving him felt like a huge burden lifted, as if he had returned from the gates of hell.
Just like that, Zhao Jinjian personally visited, achieving cooperation with Tourist Comics at a price lower than expected.
This hard-to-bite bone of Wanguang Company was obediently dealt with by Lin Fan, not only easily handled but they also got a great bargain.
This made everyone in the company admire Lin Fan to the point of reverence.
The boss is incredible!
I can’t imagine why the boss is so amazing.
After seeing off Zhao Jinjian, Lin Fan casually said, "I’m leaving too, everyone work hard, I won’t treat everyone unfairly, I have to deliver packages, I’m off."
After saying that, Lin Fan also left the company.
Everyone watched Lin Fan get into a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, sweating profusely.
An 8-million luxury car!
Boss driving this to deliver packages?
Truly outrageously wealthy!
"President, why are Wanguang Company’s people so afraid of the boss, even Zhao Jinjian?"
Someone couldn’t help but ask Chen Lingling.
Chen Lingling casually said, "Oh, Brother Lin said he’s the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment, Du Tao is one of his subordinates, everyone go back to work."
After saying this, Chen Lingling returned to the office.
Leaving everyone kneeling, everyone turned to stone.
Their boss, Lin Fan, is also the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment?
Chen Lingling doesn’t know, but they all know what Tianxue Entertainment means.
Du Tao is a boss-level figure in the entertainment industry, a presence that causes the entire entertainment circle to tremble.
Lin Fan is actually Du Tao’s boss?
What kind of Immortal is their boss Lin Fan?
On the other side, Little Sun, who was dismissed, was extremely depressed, not knowing which Immortal he had offended to get fired, which made him very depressed.
He needed an answer.
So he summoned the courage to call President Zhang.
"President Zhang, who is this Lin Fan, why are you afraid of him?" Little Sun asked.
President Zhang said crying-like, "Don’t mention it, I’ve also been sent by the boss to Africa, this time we’ve offended someone we shouldn’t have!"
Little Sun was even more depressed, "Who is he?"
President Zhang, crying as he spoke, "He’s the Big Boss of Tianxue Entertainment."
"Ah?"
Little Sun was stunned.
This time, he finally died clear and understood.
After Lin Fan left Tourist Comics, he continued delivering takeout, which went smoothly, and by nightfall, the delivery was completed.
Lin Fan planned to fulfill his promise and take the guys from the delivery station to sing K.
The car drove to a remote corner of the street, with few pedestrians.
At the corner, Lin Fan slowed down, suddenly, a girl ran towards him in panic, followed by several men chasing her.
"Help!"
Seeing Lin Fan’s car, the girl said in panic.
But before she could reach the front of the car, she twisted her ankle, screamed, and fell to the ground.
The men behind saw this and showed smug smiles.
"Little girl, where do you think you’re running off to now!" the leading man said with a perverted smile.
The men were just about to pounce on the girl, she was in shock.
At that moment, suddenly, two strong beams of light shone from the front!
Accompanied by the roar of an engine.
The men looked up and saw a Rolls-Royce fully powered up, seeming like it was about to ram into them.
The men were taken aback, wondering if the driver was crazy.
"Let’s go!"
The leading man weighed the pros and cons and led the others to escape, not to mention the possibility of the car running them over, driving such a supercar, he must be a scion of a powerful family, not the kind of people these local ruffians could afford to provoke.
Lin Fan intelligently scared off the thugs, then drove the supercar beside the girl, opening the door to the co-pilot seat.
"Get in quickly." Lin Fan said to her.
The girl got up despite the pain and quickly got into the car.
Then Lin Fan started the car and drove away from the street.
It seemed like the girl, who was rushing towards him, was only sixteen or seventeen years old, looking like a high school student.
"What happened, do you need me to call the police for you?" Lin Fan asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Girl Group Trainee Ning Xiaoyue
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 174: Girl Group Trainee Ning Xiaoyue
The girl thought for a moment and said, "No need, it was my own carelessness. I got separated from my friends while shopping, lost my way, my phone died, and I ran into those hooligans. Thank you for saving me."
The girl was truly grateful. If Lin Fan hadn’t saved her, the consequences would have been unimaginable.
Lin Fan smiled, "It was nothing, by the way, my name is Lin Fan, I don’t know your name yet?"
The girl said, "My name is Ning Xiaoyue."
Lin Fan noticed her frowning, "Is your foot okay?"
Ning Xiaoyue said, "I twisted it while running just now."
Lin Fan parked the car by the roadside, "Let me take a look."
Letting a stranger see her foot, Ning Xiaoyue felt a bit shy, but since Lin Fan wasn’t a bad person and the pain was unbearable, she had no choice but to agree, she took off her shoe and revealed her foot.
Lin Fan leaned in for a look and sighed inwardly, her delicate foot was so beautiful, with tender and fair skin that could easily spark someone’s imagination.
Lin Fan, being a normal man, almost lost his composure. He quickly steadied himself, examined carefully, and found a red swelling on Ning Xiaoyue’s ankle, the spot where it was twisted.
"Shall I massage it for you?" Lin Fan suggested.
"This..."
Ning Xiaoyue’s face flushed with embarrassment, but the pain was too intense to bear.
"Then I’d trouble you," Ning Xiaoyue murmured so softly she could hardly hear herself.
With the young lady’s consent, Lin Fan didn’t hold back. He reached out, grasped her delicate foot, and gently lifted it. It felt incredibly smooth and soft, making his heart flutter. The allure of a beautiful girl truly was irresistible.
Ning Xiaoyue was too embarrassed to lift her head and look at Lin Fan. This was too shameful; it was the first time a guy touched her foot like this.
Fortunately, she trusted this big brother who saved her wouldn’t have inappropriate thoughts and was simply helping her out of kindness.
The atmosphere was a bit ambiguous.
Lin Fan took a deep breath secretly, focused his attention on the injury, placed his hand on the ankle, and began to massage it gently.
Lin Fan’s technique was quite good. It was so comfortable that Ning Xiaoyue almost wanted to cry out, but she was too shy. She bit her lip hard to suppress it, her face already as red as a ripe apple.
After a while, Lin Fan stopped his hand, "Try moving it around?"
Ning Xiaoyue tried moving her ankle and was pleasantly surprised to find it was much better.
"Brother Lin, I didn’t expect you to be so good at massaging?" Ning Xiaoyue said happily.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "We often had to go up the mountain to chop wood when I was young; sometimes we’d get hurt. This massage technique was something I picked up back then."
Ning Xiaoyue said unexpectedly, "Brother Lin, are you also from the countryside? I’m from there too."
Lin Fan laughed, "Is that so? Didn’t expect to meet a fellow townsfolk."
Ning Xiaoyue said, "But I’m not as skilled as Brother Lin. You are driving such a luxurious car; you must be a successful person."
Although she didn’t know much about cars, this Rolls-Royce was obviously very valuable, only someone very wealthy could afford it.
But this Brother Lin was dressed quite plainly, possibly related to his rural background.
"I just run a small business, what about you? Are you still studying?" Lin Fan asked.
Ning Xiaoyue shook her head, "No, I stopped after junior high school. Now I’m a trainee."
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound, "A trainee?"
Ning Xiaoyue said, "Yes, practicing singing and dancing to become an idol and a celebrity. Our company has a girl group, and I’m one of the members."
Lin Fan smiled, "So you’re a celebrity, no wonder you’re so beautiful."
Ning Xiaoyue blushed, "Brother Lin, don’t tease me. I’m just a trainee. Becoming a celebrity isn’t easy."
Lin Fan said, "Nothing is impossible. You have the potential to be a star. I believe you can become a big star in the future."
Listening to Lin Fan’s compliment, Ning Xiaoyue was very happy, "Thank you for your kind words."
Lin Fan said, "Where do you want to go? I’ll take you there."
Ning Xiaoyue said, "I want to go back to the company, my friend should have returned."
Ning Xiaoyue gave an address, and Lin Fan navigated his way there.
Along the way, through conversation, Lin Fan got to know Ning Xiaoyue better. Because of poverty, she stopped studying after junior high, came to Yun City to work alone, and later, due to her good looks, was recruited by an entertainment company, becoming a member of the company’s girl group.
Before long, they arrived at Ning Xiaoyue’s company location.
Suddenly, they saw a big crowd gathered noisily in front of a building, pointing at the rooftop.
Ning Xiaoyue was shocked, "That’s my company. What’s happening? Why are there so many people?"
Lin Fan parked the car aside, "Let’s get out and see what’s going on."
They got out of the car, looked up, and saw a short, plump man standing at the edge of the rooftop, crying and looking like he was about to jump off.
"Ah, that’s my boss!" Ning Xiaoyue exclaimed.
Frowning, Lin Fan questioned why Xiaoyue’s boss would be trying to commit suicide?
"Young Master Feng, you’re trying to force me to death!"
The man on the rooftop wailed, his gaze fixed on a young man below.
The young man had slicked-back hair and was well-dressed, clearly born into wealth and luxury.
Feng Tianming!
Lin Fan was somewhat surprised to encounter Feng Tianming here.
"Even if you jump, I can’t help you; we’ve decided to withdraw our investment," Feng Tianming shrugged.
The man on the rooftop, with tears and snot on his face, said, "You can’t withdraw, our company will collapse. If you don’t agree, I’ll jump down."
Feng Tianming’s face darkened, "Are you threatening me?"
The man on the rooftop said, "I’m not threatening you, I’m begging you. I have no other choice, this is my life’s work. Young Master Feng, I’m begging you?"
Feng Tianming sneered, "Do you think I’m a charity, giving you money whenever you ask? If you want to die, it’s your own business, what does it have to do with me!"
The man on the rooftop sobbed, seemingly in despair.
People around were chatting, and some onlookers heckled, unperturbed by the situation.
"If you want to jump, hurry up and jump already!"
"Such a coward, can’t even jump off a building. No wonder the company is failing!"
"Hurry up and jump, I’ve got places to be!"
Seeing that the boss might really jump, Ning Xiaoyue became anxious and quickly ran up.
"Boss, don’t be impulsive, come down first!" Ning Xiaoyue shouted.
The man on the rooftop saw Ning Xiaoyue, "Xiaoyue, please plead with Young Master Feng for me; I’m really at a dead end here."
Ning Xiaoyue felt a bit troubled; if even the boss’s plea didn’t work, what could she do?
With her heart in her mouth, Ning Xiaoyue walked up to Feng Tianming, "Young Master Feng, please help our boss?"
Seeing Ning Xiaoyue, Feng Tianming’s eyes lit up, "Old Wang, who is she to you?"
The man on the rooftop said, "She’s a trainee in our company."
Feng Tianming looked Ning Xiaoyue up and down, "Not bad potential. Here’s the deal, come with me, and I guarantee you’ll be a huge star."

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Saving a Company with 20 Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 175: Saving a Company with 20 Million
Ning Xiaoyue was taken aback.
The man on the rooftop quickly said, "Young Master Feng, I’m not selling this girl!"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "Who said I wanted to buy? I meant that when your company goes bankrupt, she can come to find me."
Upon hearing this, the man on the rooftop turned from despair to anger. It seemed that Feng Tianming definitely wouldn’t help him.
"Your Feng Family must really want to push me to death! Even as a ghost, I won’t let you go!" the man angrily said.
In his grief and despair, he looked ready to jump off the building.
"Hold on!"
At that moment, a voice rang out.
Everyone turned to look in the direction of the voice.
Lin Fan!
"Boss, I’m Xiaoyue’s friend. I want to say something: it’s better to live shamelessly than to die valiantly. Why seek a dead end?" Lin Fan said.
The man on the rooftop looked at Lin Fan and suddenly said, "Lin Fan, are you Lin Fan?"
Lin Fan was stunned. He hadn’t introduced himself yet, so how did this person recognize him?
Lin Fan said, "Do you know me?"
The man on the rooftop said joyfully, "Brother Fan, it’s me, Wang Xiangqian. Don’t you remember me?"
Wang Xiangqian!
Lin Fan’s best buddy from middle school!
Later, Wang Xiangqian moved away and never contacted Lin Fan again.
Unexpectedly, they would meet again here!
With the help of the lights, Lin Fan managed to recognize him.
"Old Wang, it’s really you. Come down and we’ll talk," Lin Fan said.
"Brother Fan, wait for me. I’ll come down immediately!"
Wang Xiangqian said, deciding he didn’t want to die anymore upon seeing Lin Fan, and he hurriedly turned back.
The onlookers, seeing that there was nothing more to watch, gradually dispersed. Some who wanted to see the jump left, cursing as they went.
Feng Tianming looked at Lin Fan with cold eyes: "Lin Fan!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What, are you still looking for a fight with me?"
Recalling Lin Fan’s ruthlessness from the previous night, when he crippled Muay Thai Li San with one kick, Feng Tianming shivered a bit and felt like slipping away.
Wang Xiangqian excitedly ran down and stood in front of Lin Fan.
"Brother Fan, it really is you. It’s so good to see you!" Wang Xiangqian exclaimed joyfully.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yes, we haven’t seen each other in many years, have we?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "Yes, that year my whole family moved, and I lost contact with you, Brother Fan. I never expected to see you again tonight, just before I was about to die!"
Lin Fan asked, "Old Wang, how did it get to the point where you wanted to commit suicide?"
Wang Xiangqian sighed deeply, "This is a long story..."
As it turned out, Wang Xiangqian was currently running an entertainment company, recruiting a group of girls to form a trainee girl group.
Unfortunately, the market was sluggish, and the company had been losing money, almost unable to operate any longer. He had to search everywhere for investment.
Initially, the Feng Family promised to invest. The Feng Family was a big player in Yun City, with a wide range of industries, including entertainment. With their investment, Wang Xiangqian’s company had hope of a turnaround.
However, today Feng Tianming suddenly came to say that the Feng Family had decided not to invest in his company anymore.
Wang Xiangqian became anxious and resorted to threatening with his own life.
He really didn’t want to lose, because if he lost again, he would be left with nothing. He couldn’t afford to lose.
But Feng Tianming didn’t care about him at all. If Lin Fan hadn’t appeared, Wang Xiangqian would have already jumped to his death.
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Young Master Feng, why is your Feng Family going back on its word?"
Feng Tianming snorted coldly, "Isn’t it simple? Why invest in a company with no future? Nobody’s money comes from thin air!"
Lin Fan uttered an ’oh’, "Really? Old Wang, how much did the Feng Family initially promise to invest?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "20 million."
Lin Fan uttered another ’oh’. This amount of money wasn’t much to him now.
"Old Wang, if you don’t mind me saying, do you really think it’s necessary to continue running this company?" Lin Fan asked.
Wang Xiangqian said, "This is my life’s work and my last chance to turn things around. I’ve poured all my assets into it, that’s one reason. Another reason I haven’t given up is because there’s still hope, and I want to give it a try. It’s not just for myself, but also for these girls under me."
Lin Fan uttered an ’oh’, "What hope?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "There’s a big national talent show coming up soon, and several girls from my company, including Xiaoyue, have been selected to participate. This is our last stand."
Lin Fan said, "If I’m not mistaken, the Feng Family initially agreed to invest because of this, right? Then why did they go back on it?"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "Because I’ve taken a liking to another more promising company and decided to switch our investment to them."
Wang Xiangqian said, "Without the investment, we’ll have to withdraw from the competition, and then there will be no hope."
Lin Fan looked at Ning Xiaoyue, seeing her head down and her emotions somewhat low.
"Xiaoyue, is there anything you want to say?" Lin Fan said.
Ning Xiaoyue said, "My family is poor. I went out to work right after I graduated from middle school. Without an education, all the jobs are mediocre. It took a lot of effort to get a chance to become a trainee. If the company goes bankrupt, I can only go back to doing odd jobs again."
Wang Xiangqian said, "Xiaoyue has great potential. During our group’s audition, she was the most popular. It would really be a shame to give up like this."
Lin Fan nodded, "I also have high hopes for Xiaoyue. Here’s what, I’ll provide the 20 million."
Wang Xiangqian couldn’t believe it, "Brother Fan, what did you say? You’re going to invest? Are you that well-off now?"
Lin Fan said, "That’s right. But this money isn’t for nothing. I need to see a return."
Wang Xiangqian was overjoyed and fell to his knees, tears of gratitude streaming down as he raised his head, "Brother Fan, you’re my savior!"
Lin Fan felt a bit embarrassed and quickly helped him up.
Wang Xiangqian said, "Brother Fan, since you’re willing to invest, the company will be yours from now on. You’ll be the major shareholder, and I’ll work under you."
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m not familiar with the business, so you’ll still need to manage the daily operations."
Wang Xiangqian laughed, "Of course, Brother Fan pitches in with the money, and I’ll handle the work! Xiaoyue, aren’t you going to thank Brother Fan?"
Ning Xiaoyue was also delighted, "Thank you, Brother Lin."
Lin Fan said, "Xiaoyue, do your best. I hope you perform well."
Ning Xiaoyue said, "I will try my best."
Lin Fan said, "Old Wang, after you’ve sorted out the paperwork and such, just let me know to transfer the money."
Wang Xiangqian said, "Okay."
He was too overwhelmed. Initially, he was so desperate he almost jumped off the building, but then he met his benefactor. Brother Fan truly was his great benefactor in this life.
Lin Fan felt a bit emotional. Twenty million saved a company and also saved Old Wang’s life. If he didn’t have the money, he might have just been able to drink with Old Wang to drown their sorrows.
To be honest, with his current wealth, 20 million was nothing. He spent 100 million buying Blue Moon and 3 billion buying Yunding Manor, a small amount compared to a huge one.
So even if this money was lost, Lin Fan wouldn’t be heartbroken.
One has to admit, having money feels great!
But Feng Tianming sneered from the side, "Lin Fan, your judgment is too poor. Their company is not worth investing in at all. You might as well use your money to find a few more girls."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Is that so? Then how about we make a bet? My girl group versus your girl group, let’s see which one is better."
Feng Tianming became interested, "Since you want to embarrass yourself, I have no reason not to oblige. A bet it is, then. What’s the wager?"

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Super Gamble, Invest 100 Million in Each Other!
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 176: Super Gamble, Invest 100 Million in Each Other!
Lin Fan invested 20 million, saving Wang Xiangqian’s company, and acquired a girl group, which was exactly what Feng Tianming had abandoned.
As a result, Feng Tianming mocked Lin Fan for having poor judgment.
Lin Fan calmly proposed a bet to see whose girl group would be more successful in the future, his or Feng Tianming’s.
Feng Tianming became intrigued: "Since you’re asking for humiliation, I’ve no reason not to oblige. A bet it is. What’s the wager?"
Lin Fan said coolly, "One hundred million."
It was like a thunderclap.
Everyone was startled. Lin Fan’s bet was too harsh, casually wagering a billion!
Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue were both taken aback. After all, they’d never seen that much money in their lives; to them, it was a number beyond imagination. Yet to Lin Fan, it was just a casual bet.
Feng Tianming’s face twitched. Although he was Feng Wanshan’s son, he was not Feng Wanshan, and coming up with one hundred million was not easy for him.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Well, Young Master Feng, do you think that’s too much? If it is, I can lower it a bit."
"No!"
Feng Tianming immediately replied. If it was lowered, he’d lose face. He couldn’t afford to lose face in front of Lin Fan.
"One hundred million it is! Who’s afraid of whom?"
Despite feeling a bit uneasy inside, Feng Tianming still maintained a calm demeanor.
Then he thought to himself that he was sure to beat Lin Fan, so he wasn’t anxious anymore and became happy.
"Lin Fan, don’t say I didn’t warn you. Your girl group is just the trash I discarded. You picked up my trash and still want to beat me? Just wait and see, prepare that hundred million for me!" Feng Tianming became even more smug.
Lin Fan replied: "Words alone don’t hold up. Why don’t we record a video to prevent either of us from going back on our word."
Feng Tianming nodded readily: "You know, I hadn’t thought of that, let’s do it!"
So, the two recorded a video, agreeing that whichever girl group had a better performance on the talent show would receive an investment of one hundred million from the other.
The bet was cruel, with the loser having to invest a hundred million in the winner, a double punishment indeed.
But for the victor, it was a dual happiness—winning the competition and getting an extra one-hundred-million investment.
Feng Tianming was brimming with confidence: "I’m bound to win this bet! Sweetheart, I’ll say it again, once your company goes bankrupt, come to me!"
This last comment was directed at Ning Xiaoyue.
Ning Xiaoyue retorted coldly: "Ugh, who’d want to be with you, you shameless scoundrel!"
To her, Feng Tianming was too detestable. If not for Brother Lin stepping in, her boss would have been driven to suicide by him.
Feng Tianming sneered: "You really don’t know what’s good for you! You’ll regret it sooner or later, hahaha..."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "There’s nothing for Young Master Feng here, shouldn’t you be leaving? Or do you want to fight me?"
Feng Tianming shivered and quickly slipped away.
When he passed by the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, he was stunned for a moment.
Damn it!
Lin Fan had a 70 million Kosak and another 8 million Cullinan!
This guy seemed more like the son of a billionaire than he did!
As the son of Yun City’s richest man, he was nothing compared to Lin Fan.
"Damn, wait till I win that one hundred million and buy an even more expensive car!"
Feng Tianming thought viciously as he got into his own car, which was worth only 2 million, and drove off angrily.
Soon after, Feng Tianming received a call from Brother Dashui.
"Young Master Feng, I have successfully contacted The Panther for you. When do you plan to invite him to Yun City?" Brother Dashui asked.
Last night, Lin Fan’s victory over Muay Thai Li San caused the Feng family to lose face, and Feng Tianming couldn’t swallow the insult, so he asked Brother Dashui to find a master to deal with Lin Fan.
Feng Tianming thought for a moment, then said: "Let’s put that aside for now. I’ve got a better way to deal with Lin Fan and earn a hundred million while I’m at it!"
Feng Tianming felt he was sure to win against Lin Fan, so he canceled the decision to bring in The Panther to handle Lin Fan, as the opportunity for big money was right in front of him.
After dismissing Feng Tianming,
Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue were still in shock.
"Brother Fan, is a hundred million too big of a risk? What if we lose..." Wang Xiangqian expressed his worries.
Lin Fan calmly said: "Don’t worry, that amount is just small change to me. There’s no need for you to feel any pressure. Besides, who says we’re destined to lose? I’m really optimistic about Xiaoyue."
Ning Xiaoyue blushed, not expecting Lin Fan to have such confidence in her.
"Brother Lin, what should I do?" Ning Xiaoyue asked.
Lin Fan replied: "Just focus on preparing for the competition."
Ning Xiaoyue nodded earnestly: "I will give it my very best!"
Wang Xiangqian furrowed his brow inadvertently, showing a bit of concern. Ning Xiaoyue was indeed very beautiful, like a doll, but the issue was her lack of singing and dancing skills, and with the competition approaching, he truly felt uncertain...
"Brother Fan, we haven’t seen each other for so many years, how about we have dinner together tonight?" Wang Xiangqian suggested.
Lin Fan checked his watch: "Let’s do it another day. Tonight, I’m meeting some brothers for KTV."
Wang Xiangqian caught a glimpse of Lin Fan’s Rolex, his eyes lighting up; Brother Fan was definitely wealthy, undeniably wealthy.
He couldn’t help but grow curious. In his memory, Lin Fan was just a rural kid, so how did he become so wealthy, driving an 8 million Rolls-Royce, investing 20 million at a whim, and casually betting a hundred million with Feng Tianming?
"Brother Fan, what kind of business are you in now?" Wang Xiangqian couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan replied: "Me? I’m delivering packages."
Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue were both taken aback, thinking they had misheard.
"What, delivering packages?" Wang Xiangqian stammered, then chuckled as he came to a realization, "I get it, Brother Fan owns a delivery company, right? No wonder, delivery companies are profitable; the CEO of Zhongtong Express is one of the three magnates in our Yun City."
Lin Fan smiled: "No, I’m really delivering packages, just a courier, really, working for Zhongtong."
Wang Xiangqian was dumbfounded again: "..."
What the hell!
Being a courier pays this well?
Lin Fan said: "If you don’t believe me, why not join me at the KTV."
Wang Xiangqian, truly curious, discussed with Ning Xiaoyue and decided to go to the KTV with Lin Fan.
So the three of them got into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan and headed to Ginza KTV.
On the way, Lin Fan suddenly received a phone call.
Lin Fan took out his phone and saw it was from Liu Bing’er. Last night, Lin Fan had accidentally saved Liu Tingshan, an elderly man who fell ill on the road, and met his granddaughter Liu Bing’er.
The two had exchanged contact details, but Lin Fan hadn’t thought much of it. He didn’t expect Liu Bing’er to remember.
Lin Fan answered the call, "Miss Liu?"
On the other end came Liu Bing’er’s voice: "Brother Lin, are you free tomorrow?"
Lin Fan replied: "Yes, what do you want?"
Liu Bing’er said: "My grandpa wants to meet you to thank you in person. Are you available to come to our house for lunch tomorrow?"

chapters.title: Chapter 177 Identity Revealed, A Super Wealthy Courier
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 177 Identity Revealed, A Super Wealthy Courier
Lin Fan laughed and said, "It’s just a small effort, you don’t need to thank me, just tell the old man."
Liu Bing’er said, "Grandpa insists on meeting you, Brother Lin. Can you make some time to visit, or should you give me an address and I’ll pick you up tomorrow?"
Lin Fan, helpless, had no choice but to say, "No need, I’ll go by myself."
Liu Bing’er was very happy, "That’s great, see you tomorrow then."
Ginza KTV.
It was Lin Fan’s second time here. Last time, it was Chen Lingling’s class reunion, and Lin Fan had impressively rented the entire KTV for a million, shocking everyone and giving Chen Lingling enough face.
Tonight, Lin Fan was much more low-key, only inviting the delivery station brothers.
A luxurious large room.
The delivery station brothers were all there, many didn’t even change out of their delivery uniforms, looking every bit the delivery guys, truly down-to-earth. The stationmaster and the lady boss also came, making the atmosphere lively and bustling.
Although Lin Fan claimed that he would cover everything tonight, allowing them to consume freely, they only booked a regular room and didn’t order anything expensive.
Lin Fan was somewhat moved, the delivery guys were truly simple and unpretentious, a really adorable bunch.
Seeing this scene, Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue were stunned.
They really are a bunch of delivery workers, it seems Lin Fan wasn’t lying to them.
Seeing Lin Fan arrive, the delivery workers gathered around.
"Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan is finally here!"
"Brother Fan, did you go to pick up your sister-in-law?"
"Sister-in-law is so good-looking, she and Brother Fan are a perfect match."
The delivery workers murmured, while also being enchanted by the stunning Ning Xiaoyue beside Lin Fan, wow, she’s too beautiful.
Ning Xiaoyue blushed red, feeling embarrassed to death, but for some reason, being mistaken for Lin Fan’s woman made her somewhat happy inside.
"She’s my friend, not your sister-in-law, don’t call her that!" Lin Fan chuckled and scolded.
Then, Lin Fan introduced Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue to everyone.
"Brother Wang!"
"Sister Yue!"
The delivery workers flattered them, after all, they are Lin Fan’s friends, and they were very sweet-mouthed.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "No need to be formal, everyone keep playing. Whatever food or drinks you want, order as you like, it’s all on me."
"Brother Fan is the best!"
"Brother Fan is mighty!"
"Brother Fan is number one in the world!"
The delivery workers cheered and the atmosphere was filled with lively excitement.
Lin Fan brought Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue to the stationmaster and the lady boss.
"This is the stationmaster, and this is Sister Feng, the lady boss." Lin Fan said.
Wang Xiangqian was surprised, "You’re really Brother Fan’s bosses, Brother Fan is one of your delivery workers?"
Sister Feng said proudly, "Of course!"
Wang Xiangqian was overwhelmed, Lin Fan wasn’t lying to them, he really is a delivery worker, "Wuwuwu, are you hiring, I’d also like to be a delivery worker."
Who wouldn’t want to be a super-rich delivery worker?
Next, everyone started having fun, singing, and guessing games...
Someone handed the mic to Lin Fan, "Brother Fan, sing a song!"
Lin Fan shook his head with a smile, "No, my singing is not good, I might gross you out."
The crowd teased, "Brother Fan, just sing one, we want to hear it."
Lin Fan, helpless, thought about it and said, "Alright, I don’t know many songs, I need someone to duet with me."
Next to him, Ning Xiaoyue said softly, "Brother Lin, shall I join you?"
Upon hearing this, the crowd egged them on and burst into laughter.
Ning Xiaoyue blushed as red as an apple.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll duet with Xiaoyue then."
Ning Xiaoyue was delighted, despite the teasing, she gathered the courage and said, "Brother Lin, what song do you want to sing?"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t know many songs and my playlist is quite old. I like the song ’Holding Hands’, do you know it?"
Ning Xiaoyue joyfully said, "What a coincidence, my playlist is also old, I know this song too!"
Lin Fan was a little surprised, Ning Xiaoyue, a young girl, also listens to such old songs.
While talking, Wang Xiangqian had already found the song, and the music began to play.
Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue started singing together.
Lin Fan didn’t know many songs, but his singing voice was passable. However, Ning Xiaoyue, being a member of a girl group, sang terribly, almost completely off-key, causing everyone to laugh as soon as she started singing.
Lin Fan found it amusing, not expecting to sing better than Ning Xiaoyue.
Although Ning Xiaoyue’s singing skills weren’t great, she was very earnest while dueting with Lin Fan. The song was a love song, and when they sang, there was a subtle ambiguous atmosphere, making Ning Xiaoyue blush and her heart race.
Despite being somewhat embarrassed, Ning Xiaoyue was very happy to sing with Lin Fan.
Amidst the laughter of those around them, the two finished singing, and Ning Xiaoyue was still somewhat reluctant, secretly wishing to duet another song with Brother Lin, though she was ultimately too shy to ask.
As soon as Lin Fan put down the mic, Wang Xiangqian came over with two glasses of wine, "Brother Fan, let’s drink together."
Lin Fan took the wine and smiled, "I’m not a heavy drinker, don’t push me too hard."
Wang Xiangqian laughed, "What are you saying, Brother Fan, we haven’t seen each other for years, let’s drink to our hearts’ content tonight, not going home until we’re drunk."
Lin Fan could see that Wang Xiangqian was genuinely happy, after all, with Lin Fan’s financial help, Wang Xiangqian’s company, once on the brink of bankruptcy, had come back to life.
Lin Fan didn’t want to dampen his spirit, so he sat down to drink with him.
The two of them drank and chatted, having a great time.
Although Lin Fan didn’t drink much usually, he drank a couple more glasses this time.
After a while, feeling a bit bloated, he decided to go to the restroom.
Exiting the room, Lin Fan headed toward the restroom.
Just as he was about to enter the restroom, a surprised voice behind him called out, "Brother Lin?"
At first, Lin Fan didn’t pay attention.
The voice called again, "Lin Fan!"
Only then did Lin Fan take notice. He turned his head and saw Liu Bing’er.
Unexpectedly, he ran into Liu Bing’er here.
"What a coincidence?" Lin Fan laughed.
Liu Bing’er approached excitedly, "Yes, I almost didn’t recognize you. Brother Lin, what are you doing here?"
Lin Fan said, "The company is having a gathering here, so I came to join in the fun. What about you?"
Liu Bing’er said, "Our class is also having a reunion tonight. Brother Lin, why don’t I introduce you to them?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m a bit inconvenienced right now..."
Liu Bing’er glanced at the restroom and couldn’t help but laugh, "Brother Lin, go ahead, which room are you in? I’ll find you later?"
Lin Fan couldn’t refuse, so he gave Liu Bing’er the room number.
"See you later then," Liu Bing’er laughed and walked off.
A few minutes later, Lin Fan came out of the restroom and returned to the KTV room.
Before he could return to the room, he saw someone making a commotion outside.
Lin Fan looked and saw a short and chubby middle-aged man causing trouble. The middle-aged man was obviously drunk and acting foolishly, grabbing Ning Xiaoyue’s hand, trying to pull her into his arms.
"Come on, cutie, you’re so beautiful, come have a drink with your uncle!" the middle-aged man said with a perverse smile.
Ning Xiaoyue was outside taking a call, still holding her phone in one hand, and suddenly having her other hand grabbed startled her into a scream, instinctively shaking off the man’s hand.
The middle-aged man wasn’t giving up and stepped closer, reaching out again to grab Ning Xiaoyue, "Cutie, don’t be shy, drink with me!"
"No!" Ning Xiaoyue quickly dodged.
Her cry caught the attention of those in the room, and Wang Xiangqian was the first to rush out, furious at the sight.
Ning Xiaoyue was his employee, so he naturally had the responsibility to protect her.
"What are you doing?" Wang Xiangqian shouted.
The middle-aged man, yelled at, didn’t sober up but went even crazier, angrily saying, "Who do you think you are? I’m talking to the girl, it’s none of your business!"

chapters.title: Chapter 178: KTV Conflict, Arrogant Prodigal Son
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 178: KTV Conflict, Arrogant Prodigal Son
"I don’t even know you!" Ning Xiaoyue said angrily, feeling harassed out of nowhere, who wouldn’t be upset?
The middle-aged man heard this and immediately flared up: "You little bitch, don’t refuse a toast only to be forced a drink, come here to grandpa!"
As he spoke, he reached out to grab Ning Xiaoyue’s hair.
Everyone was shocked, this guy was too crazy.
Wang Xiangqian rushed over, standing between the middle-aged man and Ning Xiaoyue, and slapped him hard.
Smack!
A heavy slap landed on the middle-aged man’s face.
"You bastard, you dare bully my employee too?" Wang Xiangqian cursed, "Get lost, or I’ll beat you to death!"
The middle-aged man sobered up a bit after the slap, holding his burning face, and said angrily, "You just wait!"
Then he turned and ran away.
Wang Xiangqian chuckled, "Turtle has the guts not to run, I’m waiting!"
The middle-aged man had already run far away.
Wang Xiangqian turned to Ning Xiaoyue and said, "Xiaoyue, are you okay?"
Ning Xiaoyue shook her head: "It’s nothing, he just grabbed my hand, it hurts a bit."
Wang Xiangqian said: "As long as you’re okay, next time you see such a crazy person, stay away, it’s alright now, everyone continue playing."
Lin Fan came back at this time.
"Old Wang, what’s going on?" Lin Fan frowned and asked, who was that guy just now?
Wang Xiangqian laughed, "It’s nothing, just a drunken, lecherous uncle, I beat him away, come on, let’s go back and keep drinking."
Saying so, Wang Xiangqian pulled Lin Fan back to the karaoke room.
Everyone thought it was just an unpleasant episode, that drunk uncle was beaten away by Wang Xiangqian, and that was that.
But after about ten minutes, the door of the karaoke room was suddenly kicked open from the outside, and several people rushed in, including the middle-aged man from before.
"It’s them!"
The middle-aged man pointed at Wang Xiangqian, his face still red and swollen from being hit by Wang Xiangqian.
"You’re the one who hit my uncle?" A young man glared at Wang Xiangqian and said sternly, "Even dare to bully my uncle, are you tired of living?"
Wang Xiangqian put down his glass and stood up: "I’m the one who hit him, so this idiot is your uncle, just perfect, he harassed my employee just now, you can apologize now."
Zhu Sikun’s face darkened: "What are you saying, do you know who I am, dare to be so presumptuous!"
Wang Xiangqian said: "I don’t care who the hell you are, now your uncle made a mistake, isn’t it right to apologize?"
Zhu Sikun got furious: "Damn it! You hit my uncle and want me to apologize? Let me tell you, I’m Zhu Sikun, my dad is Zhu Dagang, can you afford to mess with me!"
Wang Xiangqian was stunned, he happened to know about Zhu Dagang, it was said that his means of getting wealthy weren’t clean, a tough character who’s friends with both sides of the law, generally not to be messed with.
No wonder Zhu Sikun was so arrogant, relying on the notorious name of his father Zhu Dagang.
The Zhu family was indeed not easy to provoke, but as Ning Xiaoyue’s boss, Wang Xiangqian couldn’t back down, and since he had a few drinks, he had the courage with the liquor, not afraid at all.
"Zhu Dagang, huh, even if it’s him here, he’d have to apologize to me, let alone you, you little brat!" Wang Xiangqian said arrogantly.
Zhu Sikun got pissed: "You dare look down on me, hit him for me!"
The two men behind Zhu Sikun jumped out to beat Wang Xiangqian.
These two guys were quite sturdy, if they fought, Wang Xiangqian would definitely suffer, Wang Xiangqian got a bit scared but at this point, he couldn’t back down.
Seeing both sides about to get into a scuffle.
"Wait, listen to me first!"
Lin Fan spoke up at this time, stood up, and his gaze fell on Zhu Sikun.
Zhu Sikun saw Lin Fan dressed in cheap clothes and didn’t take him seriously: "Who are you?"
Lin Fan said: "I’m Lin Fan, a friend of theirs. Tonight, it’s your uncle who was wrong first, you refuse to apologize, yet come seeking revenge, that’s not right."
Zhu Sikun said angrily: "Do you have a say in this matter?"
Lin Fan laughed and said: "We live in a civilized society, if we can talk things over, let’s not resort to violence, I’m just reasoning with you."
Zhu Sikun said: "Reasoning? Then what do you call him hitting my uncle?"
Lin Fan said: "I saw it with my own eyes, at that time your uncle was drunk and harassed a female, couldn’t even speak properly, Old Wang had no choice."
Zhu Sikun sneered: "Alright, reasoning right, you kneel and kowtow three times for me now, I won’t bother with you, is that reasonable enough?"
Wang Xiangqian said angrily: "Absolutely not, what kind of bullshit reasoning is this, making Brother Fan kowtow to you?"
"Now it’s you who should apologize, not me." Lin Fan said calmly.
Wang Xiangqian said: "Brother Fan, no need to talk nonsense with them, get the boss here, don’t believe we can’t handle them!"
The boss of Ginza ktv, Zhou Yitian, is powerful and influential, people with face from all sides give him respect, as long as the manager here intervenes, who dares to make trouble here!
Hearing Wang Xiangqian wanted to call the boss, Zhu Sikun laughed: "I agree with that, then call the boss over!"
Saying that, Zhu Sikun took out his phone and quickly made a call.
"Uncle Zhou, this is Sikun, yes, I’m at your place, encountered a bit of trouble, could you please come over, thank you Uncle Zhou, I’m in room 311."
Zhu Sikun hung up the phone, and sat down cockily beside, looking smug: "You just wait for me!"
Everyone was a bit speechless, turns out Zhu Sikun knew the boss here, how can you reason with that!
Ning Xiaoyue said softly: "Brother Lin, boss, how about we just let it go, not dispute with them."
This matter started because of her, she was afraid of getting Lin Fan and Wang Xiangqian involved.
Wang Xiangqian refused to give in, said: "Don’t worry, I don’t believe that a big boss like him wouldn’t be reasonable!"
Knock! Knock!
At this moment, there were a few knocks on the door, and it was pushed open from the outside.
Everyone was a bit surprised, the boss came so quickly?
But it was a pretty girl who walked in.
"Sorry, I’m looking for Lin Fan." the girl said, she was a bit curious, why was this room so quiet, after all, this was KTV, and as soon as she came in everyone was looking at her, making her a bit embarrassed.
Lin Fan saw the girl, waved and said: "Bing’er, over here."
The newcomer was Liu Bing’er.
Liu Bing’er quickly jogged over to sit beside Lin Fan.
This pretty girl actually came to find Lin Fan!
Everyone was a bit curious.
Ning Xiaoyue also curiously sneaked a peek at Liu Bing’er, who is this beautiful sister, a friend of Brother Lin?
She suddenly realized, she didn’t know anything about Brother Lin, somehow she felt a bit lost inside.
Liu Bing’er saw the tense atmosphere, whispered: "Brother Lin, what happened here?"
Lin Fan lowered his voice too, briefly explaining the situation here.
Upon hearing Zhu Sikun had already called the boss here, Liu Bing’er gave an "oh", she originally came to take Lin Fan to meet her classmates, but it seemed Lin Fan was inconvenient to leave for now.
Lin Fan said: "Bing’er, I don’t know what will happen later, it might not be safe here, you better leave first, I don’t want to get you involved, I’ll contact you later."
Liu Bing’er smiled: "It’s okay, I’ll just wait here, just right to watch the show."
Liu Bing’er had a look of a bystander enjoying the show.
Lin Fan had to let her be.
Ning Xiaoyue was even more curious, what’s the relationship between Brother Lin and Liu Bing’er?
After a while, the door was pushed open again, a middle-aged man in a suit, with two security guards, walked in.
This middle-aged man was well-maintained, obviously living a luxuriously comfortable life.
Ginza KTV’s boss Zhou Yitian, previously when Lin Fan booked the entire KTV for a million, Zhou Yitian personally came to welcome Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: The Mysterious Liu Bing’er, More Influential than Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 179: The Mysterious Liu Bing’er, More Influential than Lin Fan
"Uncle Zhou is here!"
Seeing this middle-aged man, Zhu Sikun stood up happily.
Zhou Yitian nodded, speaking seriously, "Xiaokun, what happened here?"
Zhu Sikun said, "Tonight, I was here with a guest and my guest was beaten by them. When I confronted them, they asked me to apologize. Uncle Zhou, you must stand up for me!"
Seeing the middle-aged man’s swollen red face, Zhou Yitian’s expression darkened, "Such a thing happened, it’s too much!"
Wang Xiangqian quickly said, "Boss Zhou, my name is Wang Xiangqian, don’t get angry yet, don’t listen to this nonsense, it was this man who got drunk and harassed my female employee first, I had no choice but to drive him away."
Zhou Yitian frowned, staring at the middle-aged man, "You harassed someone?"
The middle-aged man’s face turned red, unsure how to respond.
Zhou Yitian already understood the situation, it did seem like the middle-aged man harassed first.
Zhu Sikun said, "Uncle Zhou, he had too much to drink and didn’t know what he was doing, but they shouldn’t have hit people!"
"Hmm," Zhou Yitian nodded, looked at Wang Xiangqian, and said in a deep voice, "Our store does not tolerate disturbances, we don’t welcome unruly customers, no matter what, fighting is wrong. Apologize to Young Master Zhu and leave. Don’t step into this establishment again. Security, register all of them into the blacklist later!"
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Zhou Yitian was too harsh, blacklisting them!
He was clearly siding with Zhu Sikun!
Zhu Sikun was happy, gloating, "A bunch of stupid fools, I told you not to mess with me, it won’t end well!"
Wang Xiangqian was furious, "Boss Zhou, you know it was this man who harassed first, why are you blaming us? Just because you know this kid, it’s unfair and I won’t accept it!"
Zhou Yitian’s eyes flashed with anger, "You won’t accept it? So what if I’m siding with him, who are you to challenge me?"
Zhou Yitian didn’t even regard Wang Xiangqian, hadn’t heard of his name, he wasn’t even considered a person of importance.
Wang Xiangqian was furious, "You’re a big boss, saying such things, aren’t you ashamed! No need to blacklist us, we won’t come to your crappy store again, but my female employee was harassed, this matter must be addressed!"
Zhou Yitian sneered, "What justice do you want?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "Have them apologize to my employee!"
Zhou Yitian was also angry, he didn’t expect Wang Xiangqian to be so stubborn, truly fearless due to ignorance.
"Security, these people are causing trouble, throw them out! Especially this guy, treat him well!" Zhou Yitian pointed at Wang Xiangqian coldly.
"Yes!"
The two security guards answered, ferociously came forward, removed the batons from their waists, and started towards Wang Xiangqian.
Expulsion!
Everyone was shocked, Zhou Yitian was too unreasonable, this was clearly a case of the big store bullying its customers.
In a blink, the two security guards had grabbed Wang Xiangqian from both sides, he tried to struggle, but with two strong security guards holding him, how could he break free?
"Let go of me, Zhou Yitian, I’m gonna curse you!" Wang Xiangqian shouted angrily, struggling desperately.
Seeing Wang Xiangqian about to be forcibly thrown out by security guards.
"Boss Zhou, hold on a moment!"
Just then, a voice said, and Lin Fan stood up.
Zhou Yitian saw Lin Fan and was stunned for a moment, "You are... Mr. Lin!"
The super VIP who spent a million to book a night at KTV, Zhou Yitian naturally wouldn’t forget, he had even personally welcomed Lin Fan with excitement that day.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan was also here, he hadn’t noticed earlier.
Lin Fan smiled, "Yes, it’s me, Boss Zhou, old Wang is my friend, what he said tonight is the truth, it indeed was that guy harassing them first, please investigate fairly, Boss Zhou."
"This..." Zhou Yitian instantly felt troubled.
Zhu Sikun was an old acquaintance’s son, he had no reason not to help, but Lin Fan was a super VIP, he didn’t want to offend him either, who would go against money anyway.
Zhou Yitian turned to the security, "Hurry up and let go of Mr. Wang!"
Saying so, he rushed over himself, personally helped Wang Xiangqian to sit down, and apologized with a smile, "Mr. Wang, I apologize for offending you earlier, Zhou Mou sincerely asks for forgiveness."
Wang Xiangqian was somewhat bewildered, Zhou Yitian’s attitude changed too quickly, he couldn’t believe it was real.
Equally bewildered was Zhu Sikun, Zhou Yitian’s sudden change of attitude left him caught off guard.
Zhu Sikun felt a bit anxious, he thought he had a hard backing with Zhou Yitian, but unexpectedly, Lin Fan also knew Zhou Yitian.
"Uncle Zhou, you can’t just let them off like that!" Zhu Sikun said angrily.
Zhou Yitian, being the boss, quickly weighed his options and said, "I’ve already understood from both sides, indeed, it was Xiaokun’s uncle harassing first, which is wrong. However, Mr. Wang also hit him. Why not, for my sake, let’s end it here. I retract the blacklisting, tonight’s expenses are on me. Mr. Lin, what do you think?"
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan’s presence was enormous, with just him stepping forward, Zhou Yitian’s attitude changed from siding with Zhu Sikun to acting as a mediator, offending neither side!
Lin Fan asked, "Old Wang, Xiaoyue, you decide on this."
Wang Xiangqian and Ning Xiaoyue discussed, this might be the best outcome, and it was because Lin Fan stepped forward that they got this result, not wanting to trouble Lin Fan further.
Wang Xiangqian then said, "I don’t mind."
Everyone looked at Zhu Sikun, waiting for his response.
Zhu Sikun snorted coldly, "I don’t agree, I won’t swallow this anger tonight! Uncle Zhou, just who is this guy?"
Zhu Sikun pointed at Lin Fan, his attitude arrogant.
Zhou Yitian broke into a sweat, "Mr. Lin is a distinguished guest of our store, Xiaokun, give uncle some face, let this matter go."
Zhu Sikun arrogantly said, "Since Uncle Zhou won’t stand up for me, fine, I won’t bother Uncle Zhou then, excuse yourself, Uncle Zhou, I’ll call someone over. If I don’t beat them up today, I’m not Zhu Sikun!"
Seeing Zhu Sikun not giving any face, Zhou Yitian couldn’t help but smile bitterly, this Zhu Sikun was really a spoiled brat, too arrogant. While he wouldn’t now trouble Wang Xiangqian, he didn’t want to go against Zhu Sikun either.
Just as Zhu Sikun picked up the phone, ready to call someone.
Liu Bing’er, who had been sitting quietly, suddenly spoke up, "Boss Zhou, you won’t let this rascal cause trouble in your store, will you?"
Zhou Yitian, hearing this, looked at Liu Bing’er, feeling she looked familiar but couldn’t quite place her.
Liu Bing’er smiled, "Boss Zhou, don’t you recognize me?"
As Liu Bing’er said this, Zhou Yitian seemed to remember, his complexion changed and he exclaimed, "You... you’re Miss Liu!"
Liu Bing’er said, "I am."
Zhou Yitian instantly became very excited, quickly approached, bent his body respectfully, "Miss Liu, if you were coming, why not inform me so I could personally greet you?"
Liu Bing’er said flatly, "I didn’t want to trouble you, so I didn’t disturb Boss Zhou, I’m just here to gather with some friends tonight."
"Friends?" Sun Hongchuan was stunned, realizing something, and cold sweat began to run down, "Miss Liu, they... they are your friends?"
Liu Bing’er nodded, "Yes, Lin Fan is my good friend, and these are also my friends."
Sun Hongchuan was immediately drenched in cold sweat, quickly smiling apologetically, "I see, I really have eyes that couldn’t recognize Mount Tai."
Everyone looked at each other, what was this about, that Zhou Yitian was so afraid of Liu Bing’er, this young girl?
Lin Fan guessed part of it, Liu Bing’er’s grandfather, Liu Tingshan, must have a complex identity, having been to the Liu Family, the grandeur of the Liu Family Mansion alone was not ordinary.
Zhu Sikun couldn’t help but ask, "Uncle Zhou, who is this woman, why are you..."
Zhou Yitian quickly interrupted, "Mr. Lin is an honored guest of my store, Xiaokun, please give your uncle some face, let’s drop this matter here."
Zhu Sikun arrogantly said, "Since Uncle Zhou won’t stand up for me, fine, I won’t trouble you anymore. Uncle Zhou, please go ahead, I’ll call someone over, if I don’t beat them up today, I’m not called Zhu Sikun!"
Seeing Zhu Sikun not give face, Zhou Yitian couldn’t help but give a small bitter smile, this Zhu Sikun was truly a spoiled child, too reckless, although Lin Fan was important, he also didn’t want to offend Zhu Sikun.
Then, as Zhu Sikun picked up his phone, planning to call someone.
While all this was happening, Liu Bing’er had been sitting quietly, watching.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Who Dare Offend That Immortal of the Liu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 180: Who Dare Offend That Immortal of the Liu Family
After Liu Bing’er stepped in, Zhou Yitian directly turned against Zhu Sikun, personally slapping Zhu Sikun and trying to drive him out with a stick.
Zhu Sikun clutched his swollen face, baffled: "Uncle Zhou, what’s going on? If you don’t explain, I’m not leaving."
Liu Bing’er said lightly, "Apologize before you leave."
Zhou Yitian immediately shouted angrily, "Did you hear that? Apologize to them quickly!"
The middle-aged man wasn’t an idiot; by now, he realized he had made a big mistake. Zhou Yitian’s outburst made it clear that Liu Bing’er was definitely not someone they could afford to provoke.
The middle-aged man, red with shame, walked up to Ning Xiaoyue and bowed: "I’m sorry, I was drunk earlier and offended you. Please forgive me."
Ning Xiaoyue, being kind-hearted, wasn’t inclined to hold onto grudges and nodded with her lips pursed, accepting the middle-aged man’s apology.
Liu Bing’er looked at Zhu Sikun: "Your turn."
Zhu Sikun retorted angrily, "We didn’t harass her, why should we apologize?"
Smack!
Zhou Yitian slapped Zhu Sikun again: "You little brat, apologize when you’re told to, or do you believe I won’t beat you to death!"
Two security guards eyed him fiercely, ready to step forward and strike Zhu Sikun.
Zhu Sikun had no backing now and didn’t dare to confront Zhou Yitian, forced by the pressure, he held back his anger: "I’m sorry."
He’s always been arrogant, except when his dad disciplines him at home; he’s never apologized to outsiders. Today, because of Miss Liu, he was forced to apologize, and it made him feel exceedingly aggrieved.
Fearing further trouble, Zhou Yitian immediately instructed the security guards: "Escort them out!"
The two security guards quickly rushed up, grabbing Zhu Sikun from both sides and dragging him towards the door.
The middle-aged man also quickly slipped away.
After driving Zhu Sikun and the others out.
Zhou Yitian turned to Liu Bing’er with a smile of apology: "Miss Liu, his words were inappropriate, I’ve punished him for you. Please, Miss Liu, don’t bother with someone like him?"
Liu Bing’er indeed didn’t want to bother with Zhu Sikun, so she nodded: "Thank you, Boss Zhou."
Zhou Yitian quickly said, "It’s my duty. Today I have offended you in many ways. Except for tonight’s expenses, which I’ll cover, any future visits from all of you to my shop will be 50% off."
Everyone was pleasantly surprised; Boss Zhou was sincere, and the previous scare instantly vanished.
Liu Bing’er smiled and said, "Well, that’s very generous of Boss Sun."
Zhou Yitian replied, "It’s my duty, it’s my duty."
He breathed a sigh of relief; Liu Bing’er smiled, at least no longer holding the matter of Zhu Sikun against anyone, so he felt he had saved his old friend’s son. This Miss Liu backed by the Liu Family, with that Immortal figure there, even if he had ten lives, he wouldn’t dare offend. If Zhu Sikun had caused more trouble earlier and angered Miss Liu, he wouldn’t even know how he died.
Not wanting to stay longer, he said, "Miss Liu, Mr. Lin, everyone, enjoy your time. If there are no other instructions, I won’t disturb you further. I’ll take my leave."
"Alright." Liu Bing’er nodded nonchalantly.
Zhou Yitian hurriedly exited the karaoke room.
Wang Xiangqian walked up to Liu Bing’er and said respectfully: "Thank you for what you did earlier, Miss Liu."
He wasn’t stupid; this Miss Liu, who could make Zhou Yitian obedient, was no ordinary person, let alone being Brother Fan’s friend, he dared not show any disrespect.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Let me introduce you: Liu Bing’er, my friend. Wang Xiangqian, my old classmate."
"Hello." Liu Bing’er responded politely. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she might never have crossed paths with someone like Wang Xiangqian given her past social circle.
Wang Xiangqian felt a bit flattered; although he was usually outgoing, he felt a bit restrained in front of Liu Bing’er.
Liu Bing’er didn’t engage Wang Xiangqian further and turned to Lin Fan, smiling: "Brother Lin, shall we go? I’ll take you to meet some of my classmates."
Liu Bing’er having helped, Lin Fan didn’t refuse and said, "Sure. Old Wang, I’ll be right back."
Wang Xiangqian smiled and said, "Alright, Brother Fan, as you wish."
His heart was full of envy; he couldn’t understand how Brother Fan had the luck of having such an impressive friend. Not only was she beautiful, but she also seemed to have an extraordinarily significant background...
After Zhou Yitian left the karaoke room, he returned to his office, and soon he received a call from Zhu Dagang.
"Lao Zhou, what on earth happened? I heard from Xiao Kun that you hit him?"
On the other end, Zhu Dagang expressed his puzzlement and a hint of displeasure, after all, his son had been hit.
Zhou Yitian gave a wry smile; today was truly unlucky for him. Just before he had been humbling himself like a grandson before Liu Bing’er, and now he had to apologize to Zhu Dagang.
"Brother Gang, I’m sorry, I didn’t mean it, but it’s complicated. Here’s what happened..." Zhou Yitian briefly explained the situation.
Zhu Dagang asked suspiciously, "When did Lao Zhou start fearing a little girl? Who is she?"
Zhou Yitian lowered his voice: "She’s from the Liu Family, the eldest daughter of that Immortal figure in the Liu Family."
"What?" Zhu Dagang was shocked on the other end of the line.
He immediately understood; Zhou Yitian hitting Zhu Sikun wasn’t harming him, it was clearly saving his life!
No one dared to offend that Immortal from the Liu Family, even if Zhu Dagang had ten lives, he wouldn’t dare!
"Old Sun, thank you so much for this, I’ll treat you to a meal another day!"
Just because he learned of Liu Bing’er’s identity, Zhu Dagang went from inquiring to expressing his gratitude...
At this time, Lin Fan followed Liu Bing’er into another karaoke room.
The room was full of young men and women, all classmates of Liu Bing’er. They were noisy and rowdy but quieted down when they saw Liu Bing’er bringing in a stranger, all turning to scrutinize Lin Fan.
"Let me introduce you to everyone, this is Lin Fan, my friend," Liu Bing’er said.
"Hello, everyone." Lin Fan waved his hand calmly and confidently.
"Hello, Brother Fan."
The classmates greeted him with smiles; their attitude was friendly enough. Although they had never heard of Lin Fan’s name, since Liu Bing’er introduced him, they all had to give her some face.
However, there was a male student, seeing Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er together, who didn’t seem very friendly.
This male student was well-dressed and handsome, and judging by his clothing style, came from a good family.
Liu Bing’er beckoned, "Brother Lin, make yourself comfortable, have a seat."
Lin Fan went over to sit down; initially, Liu Bing’er chatted with him here and there, but soon, she was pulled away by her classmates to play games.
Lin Fan didn’t know anyone, and the other classmates seemed a bit too shy to approach him, leaving him alone. He took a can of beer to drink quietly, watching Liu Bing’er and the others play.
Seeing all their lively smiling faces made Lin Fan a bit envious and nostalgic for his own school days.
Since graduating, he’s rarely been in touch with his university classmates and hasn’t had that carefree student life anymore.
After frolicking with her classmates for a while, Liu Bing’er remembered Lin Fan and approached him, smiling: "Brother Lin, come join us, we’re dancing."
Lin Fan shook his head, saying, "No, I can’t do that; I should be heading back."
It was too boring here; he’d rather go back and drink with Old Wang.
Liu Bing’er said, "Brother Lin, don’t go yet, we’re going to drink later, and I hope Brother Lin can look after me a bit, alright?"

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Brother Lin, Take Me to Get a Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 181: Brother Lin, Take Me to Get a Room
Tonight Liu Bing’er helped deal with Zhu Sikun, so Lin Fan couldn’t refuse.
"Alright, I’ll stay. Take care of yourself, don’t drink too much," Lin Fan said.
Liu Bing’er giggled, "Brother Lin, when you say that, you sound like my dad."
As she spoke, Liu Bing’er returned to play with her classmates.
Lin Fan was taken aback, he couldn’t help but smile wryly. How did he sound like her dad? They weren’t that many years apart. Nowadays, do young girls not accept caring anymore?
Lin Fan hadn’t felt it before, but now suddenly felt a generation gap with Liu Bing’er. However, this feeling... was quite amusing.
The university students were energetic, and their partying became quite wild, before they knew it, it was almost midnight.
At this time, in the corner of the room, several classmates were whispering, among them was the previously unfriendly-looking handsome guy.
"What exactly is Lin Fan’s background?" the handsome young man said in a deep voice.
The other classmates shook their heads in confusion, apparently, they hadn’t heard of this senior before.
The handsome youth said irritably, "I watched him all night; he seems quite close to Bingbing. He’s not leaving now, definitely waiting for Bingbing."
The other classmates realized this point too and were surprised.
"Young Master Yang, could it be that he’s Liu Bing’er’s boyfriend?"
"Could be! This guy is quite handsome!"
"Look at his outfit, he seems like a pauper. Bing’er would like him?"
