The classmates discussed it fervently.
The handsome young man’s face was ugly, he stood up abruptly, "I’ll go have a word with him."
With that, the handsome young man walked over to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was drinking alone and smiled, "Looking for me for something?"
The handsome youth chuckled, "Brother Fan, right? My name is Yang Wu. Seeing Brother Fan alone, I wanted to chat for a bit."
Lin Fan smiled, "Alright, have a seat."
Yang Wu sat down and said, "I’ll be direct, I want to know what kind of relationship Brother Fan has with Bingbing."
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound. He understood, this Yang Wu came with a confrontational attitude right from the start. There was no guessing needed, it was obvious he liked Liu Bing’er, hence he was curious about Lin Fan’s relationship with Liu Bing’er.
He guessed right, Yang Wu indeed liked Liu Bing’er, but was in the stage of a secret crush. Although Yang Wu was from a wealthy family—his father ran a clothing processing factory in Jiangnan City, worth tens of millions—Liu Bing’er’s family background was exceptionally good, so Yang Wu felt quite inferior, not daring to pursue her rashly.
"Just ordinary friends," Lin Fan smiled.
Yang Wu seemed doubtful, "Really? Then why is Brother Fan not leaving, still waiting for her?"
Lin Fan replied, "She asked me to look after her a bit, so I’m waiting."
Yang Wu bit his lip and chuckled, "If that’s the case, you can go back assured. We as a group of classmates will look after her, wouldn’t want to waste Brother Fan’s time."
Lin Fan smiled, "Dear student, are you her boyfriend?"
Yang Wu wanted to say yes, but the truth was he wasn’t; he could only say, "No."
Lin Fan said, "So there you go. If you’re not her boyfriend, then her matters aren’t your concern, and my matters aren’t for you to manage either. So, you can go about your business now."
Yang Wu was too rude. As for such impolite kids, Lin Fan wasn’t going to spare his feelings.
Yang Wu’s face turned bright red with anger, wanting to say some harsh words, but not knowing Lin Fan’s background, he didn’t dare act irrationally. He could only storm off reluctantly.
Lin Fan didn’t pay him any mind, continuing to drink.
Shortly after, Lin Fan received a call from Wang Xiangqian, saying they were ready to leave and asking Lin Fan if he wanted to go with them.
Lin Fan glanced at Liu Bing’er who was still having fun and said helplessly, "I can’t leave right now, you guys go ahead."
By two in the morning, Lin Fan was almost asleep in the corner. The group of university students were finally satisfied, ready to call it a night.
Liu Bing’er had just finished a drinking contest, her cheeks flushed, and was completely drunk, staggering as she walked.
Yang Wu nearby was eager to help her.
Lin Fan, acting like a father figure, rushed forward to support Liu Bing’er, not allowing this scoundrel to take advantage.
Seeing this, Yang Wu jumped with rage, but didn’t dare to battle Lin Fan for Liu Bing’er, having to watch helplessly.
"This damn pauper, dare to challenge me? I’ll find someone to teach you a lesson soon!" Yang Wu decided secretly.
The group exited the KTV, Lin Fan supporting Liu Bing’er, planning to head to his car.
Yang Wu said, "Brother Fan, where are you going? Bing’er’s car is here!"
Yang Wu pointed at a nearby red Porsche, which was Liu Bing’er’s car, priced over three million, known by the classmates.
Lin Fan chuckled, "No worries, I’ve got my own car to take her with."
With that, Lin Fan supported Liu Bing’er to the Cullinan, opened the door, helped Liu Bing’er onto the car, and drove away.
Everyone was stunned.
What?
Lin Fan was driving an eight-million Rolls-Royce Cullinan!
Oh my god, with such a shabby appearance, how is he this awesome?
Yang Wu’s face turned blue and white, as if he had been slapped several times. He just said Lin Fan was a pauper, and now it was a complete embarrassment.
"Who exactly is he?" Yang Wu felt extremely frustrated.
Inside the Cullinan.
"Brother Lin, thank you for seeing me home," Liu Bing’er mumbled.
Lin Fan smiled, "You’re welcome."
He then drove the luxury car towards the Liu Family.
Liu Bing’er sat in the passenger seat, head resting as she seemed pretty out of it. At this moment, even if Lin Fan did something to her, she probably wouldn’t realize.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless; a girl acting like this is too dangerous. Fortunately, it was him tonight—if those male classmates sent her, who knows what they might do.
"Do you often get drunk outside? You shouldn’t do this in the future," Lin Fan couldn’t help saying.
Liu Bing’er heard and mumbled, "Because tonight Brother Lin was looking after, I had a few more drinks. I don’t drink usually."
Lin Fan paused, inexplicably moved by her trust.
Liu Bing’er continued, "Brother Lin, I’m drunk like this; I don’t want to go home and let them see me. Could you get me a room?"
Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat. Really? We just met, this is progressing too fast.
Lin Fan said, "I can get you a room and let you sleep there yourself."
Liu Bing’er suddenly grabbed Lin Fan’s arm, "Don’t go, Brother Lin stay with me, I’m scared..."
She was very drunk, speaking unclearly, and then dozed off with her head tilted.
Lin Fan was somewhat troubled. Getting her a room wasn’t an issue, but he wasn’t comfortable leaving a drunk female alone in the hotel. However, staying at the hotel with her might cause unnecessary misunderstandings, which would harm Liu Bing’er’s reputation—this wouldn’t be good.
After thinking, Lin Fan made a decision to simply take Liu Bing’er to Yunding Manor.
Yunding Manor.
It was already almost three o’clock.
Anna hadn’t slept; she was waiting for Lin Fan to return.
A Rolls-Royce Cullinan drove into the manor, Lin Fan supporting the drunken Liu Bing’er out of the car.
Anna looked on, surprised. No way, this is the first time the master brought a pretty girl home for the night?

chapters.title: Chapter 182: The Luxuriousness That Even Liu Bing’er Admired
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 182: The Luxuriousness That Even Liu Bing’er Admired
Lin Fan brought Liu Bing’er back to Yunding Manor. Anna was a bit surprised, as this was the first time Lin Fan had brought home a female, and she was drunk. It was obvious what kind of situation it was.
"Ahem." Anna coughed twice, pretending not to see anything, and said, "Master, you’re back."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "You’re injured, why are you still up this late?"
Anna replied, "I was waiting for you to return. I have some personal matters to handle tomorrow and need to take a day off, leaving the manor for about half a day."
Lin Fan thought it was about her injury and didn’t think much of it, replying, "No problem, go get some rest. Next time you want to take a leave, just give me a call."
Anna nodded, but deep down, she couldn’t quite explain why. She just wanted to wait for Lin Fan to return and talk to him face to face.
Lin Fan already ignored Anna, helping Liu Bing’er into the house. Watching their backs, Anna bit her lip, her expression a bit complicated.
Lin Fan brought Liu Bing’er into the house, directly to Lin Shanshan’s room, and laid Liu Bing’er down on the bed.
The drunken Liu Bing’er had a red face like a ripe apple, very enticing. A young college girl was truly charming, making one want to take a bite. Lin Fan really had such an impulse.
But unfortunately, he wasn’t someone who would take advantage of others. Liu Bing’er sought his care because she trusted him, and Lin Fan didn’t want to ruin that trust, nor harm Liu Bing’er’s good impression of him.
"I often sigh because I’m not a beast."
Lin Fan sighed slightly, tucked Liu Bing’er in, and quickly left. He feared if he stayed longer, he wouldn’t be able to resist.
Lin Fan casually returned to his room, washed up, and went to sleep.
Nothing happened overnight.
The next morning.
Liu Bing’er woke up from a sweet dream. She drank too much the night before, slept soundly, and even had a beautiful dream.
Opening her eyes, Liu Bing’er found herself lying on a very comfortable large bed in a dreamy, castle-like pink room, so girlish it was overwhelming.
And the girlishness was nothing; more astonishing was the luxury in the room. A huge wardrobe occupying an entire wall, filled with a dazzling array of bags, shoes, clothes, all internationally renowned brands. Just this wardrobe alone was probably worth tens of millions.
The furniture in the room was also of top-notch luxury. Liu Bing’er, being someone from high society, understood this well. Just the bed she slept on cost over a million!
This was truly an ultimately luxurious boudoir!
It was clear that the owner of this room not only had a girlish heart but also was extremely wealthy.
Liu Bing’er came from an already impressive wealthy family, but this was her first time seeing such a room. No rich family’s daughter in Yun City had a room reaching this level.
"Where exactly is this?" Liu Bing’er was extremely curious.
She only remembered that she asked Lin Fan to take her to a hotel last night, then lost consciousness. She asked Lin Fan to care for her because Lin Fan had saved her grandfather that day, and after interacting with him, she trusted Lin Fan’s character.
She believed Lin Fan wouldn’t take advantage of her, and indeed, nothing on her body showed any signs of being tampered with.
But where exactly had Lin Fan brought her?
She couldn’t fathom this place.
This definitely wasn’t a hotel, because no hotel could be this luxurious, not even a presidential suite!
With her experience, she had never seen such a luxurious room.
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"Bing’er, are you awake?"
It was Lin Fan’s voice!
"Brother Lin, I’m awake, come in." Liu Bing’er said.
Lin Fan then pushed the door open and walked in.
"Did you sleep well last night?" Lin Fan politely asked.
Liu Bing’er nodded, "Mm, Brother Lin, where exactly are we?"
Lin Fan replied, "Last night you said you didn’t want to go home, and I wasn’t comfortable leaving you in a hotel, so I brought you back here. This is my home, and this is my sister’s room."
Liu Bing’er was stunned. So Lin Fan had brought her back home? Lin Fan’s home was so luxurious! She knew Lin Fan’s car was a 70 million Kosak, definitely a billionaire level. Now it seemed that Lin Fan’s family was not just a billionaire.
"I really envy your sister, this room is every girl’s dream," Liu Bing’er said enviously.
She herself found it hard to believe that, as the eldest daughter of the Liu family, she would one day envy others.
But she did envy.
This billion-dollar dream room required an enormous amount of money to create, and not everyone could come up with such a huge amount of money. Even the Liu family couldn’t do it.
The wealth of Lin Fan’s family must have reached an astonishing level!
Then, Liu Bing’er followed Lin Fan out of the room and went outside.
An extremely luxurious living room!
The lighting, furniture... all top-of-the-line!
The whole house could only be described as lavish; each brick exuded the words "rich."
To reach a level where even Liu Bing’er, from a wealthy family, was amazed, it was true they were wealthy.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You just woke up from a hangover, how about a cup of tea to recover a bit?"
Liu Bing’er replied, "Wait a moment."
She became immensely interested in this place and suddenly noticed a large garden from the window, so she couldn’t resist walking out.
Lin Fan had no choice but to accompany her on a walk.
Entering the garden, Liu Bing’er, as if a country bumpkin entering the city, exclaimed endlessly. It was so beautiful, so luxurious, every grass and tree screamed the words "rich."
Soon, they arrived at the Scenic Pavilion.
Looking out, Yun City’s scenery was in full view, with the morning sun shining, breathtakingly beautiful.
"Ah?"
Liu Bing’er was stunned, suddenly thinking of something, her voice trembling, "Brother Lin, where is this place?"
Lin Fan calmly replied, "Yunding Manor."
Liu Bing’er was petrified, eyes wide open.
It took her a long time to come back to her senses: "Yunding Manor? Brother Lin, are you saying Yunding Manor is your home? Could it be... could it be you are the legendary Mr. Lin?"
Liu Bing’er’s shock was beyond words. How could she have imagined being in Yunding Manor!
A few days ago, Yunding Manor was acquired by a mysterious tycoon named Mr. Lin for a staggering 3 billion, causing a sensation throughout the city, known to everyone in Yun City.
No one knew who this Mr. Lin was, but the 3 billion was truly shocking and awe-inspiring.
Anyone who heard about this was amazed by Mr. Lin’s lavish act.
Even Liu Bing’er had discussed it passionately with others, with quite a bit of admiration for this mysterious Mr. Lin, truly wanting to see Mr. Lin’s real appearance.
Now realizing that Lin Fan is Mr. Lin, her shock was naturally understandable.
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right, I am Mr. Lin."
This identity wasn’t a secret, but he didn’t go around proclaiming it, which created the mysterious effect.
Liu Bing’er’s heart was already overwhelmingly excited, looking at Lin Fan with admiring eyes, like a fangirl.
Oh my god, Brother Lin is the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin!
At this moment, Anna silently walked over.
Seeing Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er, her feelings were a bit complex, as they surely had...

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Earth-Shatteringly Flirting
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 183: Earth-Shatteringly Flirting
When a man has money, he will have women. Lin Fan is handsome, and when he uses "Mr. Lin’s" identity to flirt with women, which woman can resist that?
Actually, the real Mr. Lin is Lin Beixuan...
Anna naturally wouldn’t expose Lin Fan. She stepped forward and said, "Master, breakfast is ready."
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, got it. Aren’t you taking a leave? You can go."
Anna said, "No rush, I’ll leave after the master departs."
Liu Bing’er curiously asked, "Brother Lin, this sister..."
Lin Fan said, "Let me introduce her; she is my housekeeper, Anna."
Liu Bing’er was stunned. My goodness, this sister has such a powerful presence. Even if someone says she’s the CEO of a billion-dollar company, they’d believe it, but she’s actually a housekeeper!
Boohoo, Brother Lin’s housekeeper is so domineering, he’s really wealthy.
"Anna, she is Liu Bing’er, the eldest daughter of the Liu family in Yun City, my friend," Lin Fan said.
Liu Bing’er smiled proactively, "Hello, Sister Anna."
Anna was slightly surprised, "The Liu family in Yun City? How are you related to Liu Tingshan?"
Liu Bing’er smiled, "Do you know my grandfather?"
"I don’t," Anna said.
Surprised in her heart, she originally thought Lin Fan just brought back a random girl, but unexpectedly, this girl is from the Liu family in Yun City, Liu Tingshan’s granddaughter!
Lin Fan’s ability to woo women is truly astonishing; he even got the eldest daughter of the Liu family!
Afterwards, Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er went to the dining room to have breakfast.
After breakfast, Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce to send Liu Bing’er back to Yun City.
Leaving Yunding Manor, Liu Bing’er still felt like she was in a dream, questioning if she really spent the night in the legendary Yunding Manor.
Is Brother Lin really the mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin?
She felt a sense of unreality.
"Brother Lin, are you coming to my house at noon? Grandpa wants to see you. He has heard of you too. If he knew you are Mr. Lin, he would be really surprised," Liu Bing’er said.
Lin Fan replied, "I promised you yesterday. I have no reason to decline. However... there’s no need to tell the old man about me being the owner of Yunding Manor. I’d prefer to keep it low-key, alright?"
Liu Bing’er quickly said, "Okay, then I won’t mention it."
Indeed, if Lin Fan’s identity as "Mr. Lin" were exposed, it would cause a sensation. She understood Lin Fan’s desire to remain low-key.
Such an outstanding man like Lin Fan should indeed maintain a bit of mystery.
Liu Bing’er was also happy to keep this secret. Knowing a secret that most people didn’t, she even felt a bit proud.
Lin Fan dropped Liu Bing’er off outside Ginza KTV, where she retrieved her car, and they agreed on a time to meet at noon before parting ways.
Liu Bing’er drove her red Porsche back to the Liu Family Mansion at Peninsula Mansion.
Back at the Liu Family Mansion, the old man, Liu Tingshan, was exercising in the courtyard. Liu Bing’er crouched, trying to avoid her grandfather and slip back to her room.
But she was caught by Liu Tingshan.
"Bing’er, where did you go last night? Why didn’t you come home all night?" Liu Tingshan called out to Liu Bing’er.
Liu Bing’er stuck out her tongue and had to stop, acting coquettishly, "I went karaoke singing with some classmates last night and accidentally stayed out all night. Grandpa, I’m so tired, I can’t talk to you now, I need to catch up on sleep."
Liu Tingshan shook his head reluctantly, "You child, now that your parents aren’t around, you think I can’t control you? A girl from the Liu family, how can you play around like this? What if something happens, what a disgrace it would be!"
Liu Bing’er lowered her head, "Oh, Grandpa, I won’t do it again."
Liu Tingshan was overly doting on this granddaughter and couldn’t bear to scold her, his tone softening immediately, "Did you do what I asked you to do?"
Liu Bing’er said, "You mean inviting Brother Lin for lunch? I’ve already asked him, and he agreed to come."
Liu Tingshan smiled, "That’s good. Without this young man, Grandpa might not be alive anymore, so today we must treat him well!"
Liu Bing’er hesitated, really wanting to tell her grandfather about Lin Fan, but remembering Lin Fan’s words, she held her tongue.
At this time, Lin Fan had already returned to Yun City Music Academy.
He had a piano class scheduled as usual in the morning, and he planned to head to the Liu family for lunch after class, then deliver parcels in the afternoon—just another simple and fulfilling day.
The system hadn’t reminded him to check in today, and he wasn’t sure what reward might come, as system rewards had been delayed for the past few days.
Lin Fan wasn’t in a hurry. Although the system rewards were tardy, they would eventually come, so he waited patiently.
In the office, Lin Fan learned from Liu Mengjie that Chu Xiaoxiao was now living at the school. After the incident at her home yesterday, Chu Xiaoxiao had learned she was the illegitimate daughter of Yun City’s wealthy Chu Haotian, and couldn’t accept it, so she wanted to live at the school.
Liu Mengjie personally helped her arrange accommodation, and her accommodation fee was temporarily waived.
Liu Mengjie then asked Lin Fan to have lunch together at noon, as they had originally planned to dine yesterday but were delayed by Chu Xiaoxiao’s matters.
Lin Fan apologized and said, "I have an appointment at noon, I can’t have lunch with Sister Mengjie."
Liu Mengjie said, "How about dinner then?"
Lin Fan said, "Dinner should be fine."
Liu Mengjie happily replied, "Then let’s meet in the evening. I’ll choose a place and let you know."
After agreeing to meet for dinner, Lin Fan went to attend his class.
After the piano class, it was almost noon, and Lin Fan planned to leave the school to go to the Liu family.
While walking on the road, Lin Fan suddenly saw three girls tangled up in the distance at a corner. To be precise, two girls were pushing a third girl, who soon disappeared into the corner.
This scene was hard to notice because the two girls deliberately acted when the third girl walked to a secluded corner.
Luckily, Lin Fan had received a top-level Insight reward yesterday, making him incredibly sharp, and he immediately detected the anomaly.
He recognized the girl being pushed was Chu Xiaoxiao!
Clearly, Chu Xiaoxiao was in trouble, so Lin Fan immediately rushed over to see what was going on.
In the secluded corner.
Chu Xiaoxiao was being pushed along by two girls, both of whom looked like ruffian delinquents, wearing fierce expressions.
Chu Xiaoxiao was not as strong as them and couldn’t resist, so she had to comply. She didn’t know what they wanted, feeling both shocked and anxious, extremely scared.
In the corner, there was another girl waiting for them.
Seeing Chu Xiaoxiao arrive, this girl showed a look of disgust.
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned. It was Jia Xueling!
It turned out Jia Xueling had instructed the two girls to bring her here. She and Jia Xueling had a grudge, which definitely wasn’t a good thing.
"What do you want to do?" Chu Xiaoxiao asked tremblingly.
Jia Xueling sneered, "What do I want to do? Don’t you know? You know exactly what you’ve done!"
Chu Xiaoxiao was puzzled, "Wasn’t the matter that day already resolved? You bumped into me first, and Teacher Lin made you pay compensation..."
That morning, Chu Xiaoxiao’s bicycle had collided with Jia Xueling’s supercar. Jia Xueling wanted to bully Chu Xiaoxiao on the spot, but Lin Fan appeared and helped Chu Xiaoxiao get justice.
Jia Xueling snorted, "If it weren’t for Lin Fan, would I have compensated you?"
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "So you brought me here to make me give you the money back?"
Jia Xueling said, "What do you take me for? A mere few hundred bucks, I can spare that for a beggar like you."
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "Then why have you brought me here?"
Jia Xueling said, "It’s because..."
It’s because she was captivated by Lin Fan’s piano class that day, which changed her attitude towards him, but she found Chu Xiaoxiao and Lin Fan talking and laughing, which infuriated her.
This reason, of course, she wouldn’t tell Chu Xiaoxiao. She wouldn’t admit she was jealous of Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Do I need to give you a reason? I just can’t stand you and want to teach you a lesson, isn’t that enough?"
Jia Xueling shouted fiercely, raising her hand as if to strike Chu Xiaoxiao.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: School Bullying, Teaching a Rich Girl a Lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 184: School Bullying, Teaching a Rich Girl a Lesson
A spoiled rich girl like Jia Xueling inherently looks down on girls from poor families like Chu Xiaoxiao, thinking she can bully them at will.
Jealous of Chu Xiaoxiao’s good relationship with Lin Fan, Jia Xueling harbors resentment. Today, she found an opportunity to drag Chu Xiaoxiao to this corner, planning to give her a beating to vent her anger.
Jia Xueling raised her hand and swung a slap toward Chu Xiaoxiao’s face.
Chu Xiaoxiao wasn’t foolish, and naturally wouldn’t just let herself be hit, so she quickly dodged aside.
Jia Xueling’s slap missed, making her even angrier, and she yelled, "Hold her down!"
The two delinquent girls with her grabbed Chu Xiaoxiao from both sides.
Chu Xiaoxiao instinctively struggled, but being a frail young lady, she was no match for the two fierce delinquents. After struggling a bit, she was firmly pinned down.
Jia Xueling stepped forward, grabbed Chu Xiaoxiao’s hair, and lifted her face, then raised her hand again.
"Dodge, let’s see how you dodge this time!"
Jia Xueling sneered triumphantly.
Watching, her palm was about to slap Chu Xiaoxiao’s face.
Suddenly, Jia Xueling’s hand froze. A hand reached from behind and grabbed hers, preventing her hand from moving at all.
Jia Xueling was startled and instinctively turned to look.
Lin Fan!
It’s Lin Fan again!
The last time she and Chu Xiaoxiao had a car accident and she wanted to teach Chu Xiaoxiao a lesson, it was also Lin Fan who stopped her!
"What are you doing?" Lin Fan said coldly, his tone devoid of any warmth. It was clear Lin Fan was angry.
Lin Fan was angry for Chu Xiaoxiao!
Jia Xueling was getting increasingly upset, insane with jealousy. Why, why could this poor and miserable girl, Chu Xiaoxiao, receive Lin Fan’s favor and protection everywhere, while she, the wealthy heiress, couldn’t even earn a glance from Lin Fan?
"Let go of me!" Jia Xueling said furiously, trying to break free from Lin Fan’s grip, but Lin Fan’s hand was like an iron clamp, and she couldn’t break free at all.
"Let Xiaoxiao go first," Lin Fan said coldly.
Jia Xueling stubbornly replied, "I won’t let go. Today I’m going to hit her. Lin Fan, this is a private grudge between her and me. Get lost, it doesn’t concern you!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "How does it not concern me? I’m a teacher. How can I watch you bully your classmates? Let her go."
Jia Xueling screamed, "I won’t let go. Lin Fan, why are you always targeting me? Why do you always protect that little bitch? What is your relationship with her?"
Lin Fan said, "Because I’m a teacher. Let go now."
Lin Fan slightly increased his strength.
"Ah!" Jia Xueling cried out in pain, "You’re hurting me."
She had no choice but to let go, and the two delinquent students beside her released their grip as well.
Finally able to stand up, Chu Xiaoxiao looked shaken. If Lin Fan hadn’t arrived in time, she would have been beaten.
Once again, Teacher Lin had helped her. Her feelings became complicated; Teacher Lin’s kindness toward her was growing, and she didn’t know how to repay it.
"Can you let go of me now?" Jia Xueling said angrily.
Lin Fan smiled, "Stay away from Xiaoxiao in the future. I hope this is the last time. I’ve recorded your actions on my phone. If there’s a next time, I’ll report it to the school and have you punished. Understand?"
Jia Xueling sneered, "You’re threatening me? Do you think I’m afraid of you? My dad is Jia Zuozhen. Who in this school dares to touch me?"
Lin Fan replied, "Really? Do you want to test it? I can call the principal right now."
Jia Xueling remembered, the other day the principal personally went out of the school to greet Lin Fan. The principal must value Lin Fan highly, and he might actually side with Lin Fan.
Better to swallow this indignity for now.
Jia Xueling made a decision, "I’ll stop hitting her from now on. Can you let go now?"
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment and released her.
Jia Xueling felt her wrist was about to crack; Lin Fan’s grip was really strong, and he didn’t show any pity. He only cared about protecting Chu Xiaoxiao.
Jia Xueling was angry, jealous, and felt wronged.
She had clearly changed her impression of Lin Fan and wanted to befriend him, yet Lin Fan, siding with Chu Xiaoxiao, made her angry. Lin Fan was so annoying.
"Lin Fan, you’re always protecting her because you hate me, right? Do I really make you hate me that much?" Jia Xueling said, her eyes turning red.
Lin Fan calmly replied, "I don’t care about hating you. I’m just doing what I think is right. Why should I help you when you’re doing wrong?"
Jia Xueling huffed, "You don’t have to lie to me. You like Chu Xiaoxiao, don’t you?"
Upon hearing this, Chu Xiaoxiao’s face turned bright red, "Jia Xueling, what nonsense are you talking about!"
She looked at Lin Fan with embarrassment and nervousness, honestly hoping for Lin Fan’s response.
Lin Fan, without a thought, replied, "Xiaoxiao is kind-hearted and a good girl. I do like her. I hope you can be a kind person too."
Chu Xiaoxiao was stunned, her heart felt like it was filled with honey, sweet. Teacher Lin liked her, really liked her, was it that kind of like?
Jia Xueling, on the other hand, was furious, stomping her foot, "Lin Fan, I hate you, I hate you to death!"
With that, she turned and ran away.
The two delinquent classmates hurriedly ran after her.
Lin Fan was a bit perplexed, feeling that this Jia Xueling wasn’t thinking straight. If only he knew, that day in his piano class, Jia Xueling had been captivated by him, but because he protected Chu Xiaoxiao, Jia Xueling was heartbroken.
If Lin Fan knew the reason, he would probably find it amusing yet frustrating.
Lin Fan no longer concerned himself with Jia Xueling, and with care, asked, "Xiaoxiao, are you okay?"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed, "I’m fine, thankfully Teacher Lin arrived in time. Thank you, Teacher Lin."
Lin Fan smiled, "Lucky I noticed those two girls pulling you. Good thing you’re alright. If they bully you again, tell me, and I’ll deal with them."
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, "Okay."
Her heart was warm. Lin Teacher’s words were truly heartwarming, providing such a sense of security.
As a young college girl, she was completely absorbed in admiration for Lin Fan, that youthful, romantic feeling, a bit lovely, yet a bit painful.
Lin Fan asked, "I heard from Sister Mengjie that you’ve moved into the school. Are you used to living there?"
Chu Xiaoxiao replied, "It’s okay."
Lin Fan said, "Then stay at school for now. Go home whenever you feel like it."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I know. Teacher Lin, was what you said earlier true?"
Lin Fan asked curiously, "Which part?"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed, "It’s nothing."
She took out a pen and paper, wrote a sentence on it, folded the paper, and handed it to Lin Fan.
"Read it after I’ve left," Chu Xiaoxiao said, her face red like a shy little rabbit before turning and running away.
Curious, Lin Fan opened the paper and read the sentence on it.
"I like Teacher Lin too."
Lin Fan couldn’t help but chuckle. This little girl was so shy. There were plenty of students in this school who liked him...
Meanwhile, Jia Xueling left the school in a huff.
On the way home, the more Jia Xueling thought about it, the more wronged she felt, her eyes swollen from crying.
At home, her father, Jia Zuozhen, was there. Seeing Jia Xueling with a tear-streaked face, Jia Zuozhen was very surprised, "Darling daughter, what happened?"
Without being asked, Jia Xueling became even more upset, bursting into tears, squatting down as she cried.
Jia Zuozhen felt deeply pained; he treated her like the apple of his eye, afraid she’d melt in his palm. He always indulged her, never letting her suffer grievances. Now that she was crying so pitifully, something must have happened.
"Tell Daddy what’s going on?" Jia Zuozhen asked anxiously.
Jia Xueling lifted her tearful eyes, "It’s Lin Fan."
Jia Zuozhen’s complexion changed, "The same Lin Fan we met at the school gate? What did he do to you?"
Jia Xueling’s eyes shifted. Lin Fan treated her like this; it would be perfect to use her father’s hand to teach Lin Fan a lesson!
"There’s a girl at school, taking advantage of his favoritism, bullying me. I intended to fight back, but Lin Fan caught us. Lin Fan, without discerning right from wrong, helped that girl bully me. He...he hit me!" Jia Xueling sobbed out.
Her words were, of course, twisting the facts completely.
But Jia Zuozhen didn’t doubt it for a moment, jumping up in anger, "What? He actually dared to bully my daughter Jia Zuozhen. He must have a death wish!"

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Liu Family Visits as Guests, Lin Fan’s Assets Are Questioned
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 185: Liu Family Visits as Guests, Lin Fan’s Assets Are Questioned
Jia Xueling pleaded, "Daddy, you have to stand up for me this time. I’m too scared to even go to school now."
Jia Zuozhen comforted, "Don’t worry, my precious daughter; I won’t let him off!"
Jia Xueling said, "Daddy, I don’t want to escalate this issue. I don’t want the people at school to know he bullied me. It’s too embarrassing."
Jia Zuozhen sneered, "Daddy knows. Don’t worry, this bastard offended my precious daughter. Even he won’t know how he dies!"
Jia Xueling curiously asked, "How does daddy plan to deal with him?"
Jia Zuozhen replied, "I’ve already gathered information on this kid. Currently, he owns several companies and holds shares in some major firms. He’s a wealthy man, but wealth alone, such people are easy to handle."
That day at the school gate, Liu Mengjie came out to personally welcome the guests. Jia Zuozhen thought she was welcoming him, but it turned out Liu Mengjie welcomed Lin Fan, embarrassing Jia Zuozhen. Since that day, Jia Zuozhen held a grudge and sought out Lin Fan’s background.
Aside from being wealthy, Lin Fan has no political connections, while Jia Zuozhen’s family does have political ties. Trouble for Lin Fan is very easy to orchestrate.
Lin Fan didn’t know he’d already caught Jia Zuozhen’s attention, and the trouble was approaching soon.
At that moment, he had already left the school, heading to the Liu Family.
Noon at Peninsula Mansion.
Lin Fan drove to the Liu Family Mansion, where Liu Bing’er was already waiting outside.
Liu Bing’er wore casual attire and had a ponytail, looking very charming; truly a lively university female filled with youthful energy. Lin Fan couldn’t help but glance twice, recalling her drunken state from the previous night, which stirred his emotions.
As soon as Lin Fan parked the car, Liu Bing’er approached him, smiling warmly.
"Brother Lin, you’re here," Liu Bing’er said enthusiastically. "Grandfather has been waiting for you for a long time, let’s go in quickly."
Lin Fan got out of the car and followed Liu Bing’er into the mansion, arriving at the living room.
There, Liu Tingshan was sitting on the sofa with his eyes closed, supported by a cane, while two sturdy bodyguards stood on either side of the entrance.
If Liu Bing’er hadn’t been with him, Lin Fan would definitely have been stopped by the security guard.
"Grandfather, Brother Lin is here," Liu Bing’er said with a smile, approaching Liu Tingshan.
Liu Tingshan opened his eyes and saw Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, please have a seat," Liu Tingshan said with a smile.
Lin Fan sat across from Liu Tingshan and asked, "Is your health better, sir?"
Liu Tingshan replied, "Thank you; I’ve gotten much better. Thanks to Mr. Lin’s help yesterday, this old man got to keep his life."
Lin Fan quickly said, "You’ve flattered me, sir. I was just passing by and did what needed to be done."
Liu Tingshan, upon hearing this, couldn’t help but see Lin Fan in a better light. Many would wish for him to owe a favor, but Lin Fan, on the other hand, didn’t claim credit. This young man is quite remarkable!
Liu Tingshan smiled and said, "I specifically wanted to thank Mr. Lin today and hope you’ll join me for lunch."
Lin Fan smiled and replied, "I wouldn’t dare decline; your invite is an honor, sir."
"Grandfather, let me help you over," Liu Bing’er said, walking over to support Liu Tingshan.
They proceeded to a luxurious dining hall, elegantly decorated, befitting a wealthy household. This dining room is as large as an entire ordinary person’s house, featuring a very large luxurious dining table that could seat around twenty people.
The three of them took their seats, with Liu Tingshan at the head, and Liu Bing’er and Lin Fan across from each other at the lower end.
Liu Bing’er instructed the servant standing by, "You can serve the dishes now."
The servant acknowledged and departed, returning soon with numerous exquisite dishes. The tableware alone seemed so valuable that a set might cost as much as an ordinary person’s monthly salary.
Even ordinary wealthy families wouldn’t be this particular. Clearly, the Liu Family is not just wealthy but also truly upper-class.
"Mr. Lin, enjoy while it’s hot; don’t stand on ceremony," Liu Tingshan invited.
Lin Fan replied, "Thank you, sir, please enjoy."
The three of them began eating.
Liu Tingshan smiled and said, "I heard from Bing’er that Mr. Lin drives a top-notch sports car, which must mean you’re from a distinguished family. May I ask which family you’re from?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m from a simple background. My parents are farmers, and I currently work as a courier."
Liu Tingshan and Liu Bing’er exchanged puzzled glances.
Lin Fan’s background is this simple? It’s incredibly unbelievable.
The son of farmers, a courier... This doesn’t seem to connect with driving a supercar.
Liu Tingshan laughed, "Mr. Lin is very modest. According to my knowledge, courier work doesn’t afford top-notch luxury cars. Excuse my curiosity, but what kind of business do you run? If Mr. Lin is uncomfortable discussing it, we can let it go."
He obviously didn’t believe Lin Fan’s previous words, thinking Lin Fan was reluctant to disclose it.
He hadn’t deliberately probed Lin Fan’s background, considering it unnecessary.
Liu Bing’er was even more curious because she knew more than Liu Tingshan. Not only does Lin Fan drive a top-notch sports car, but he’s also the owner of Yunding Manor!
How could the mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin possibly be a farmer’s son working as a courier?
But Lin Fan didn’t lie; he merely concealed the experiences that led him to immense wealth.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What I said earlier is true, but I do own a few companies that help me earn money. When I have time, I work as a courier to keep occupied."
Liu Tingshan and Liu Bing’er were both taken aback. It’s just to kill time as a courier? That’s quite misleading, with several companies in his name, no wonder!
Liu Tingshan laughed and said, "It seems Mr. Lin is truly accomplished at a young age; since your parents are farmers, you must have built your companies yourself. It’s quite remarkable for someone so young to achieve this level!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You overpraise me, sir."
The three chatted and laughed, creating a very harmonious atmosphere during the meal.
Lin Fan’s confidence and ease impressed Liu Tingshan, coupled with Lin Fan being able to drive a top-notch luxury car, further solidifying Liu Tingshan’s impression of him as a promising youth.
As the meal was drawing to a close.
Liu Tingshan said, "By the way, Mr. Lin, my 70th birthday is in a few days, and I would like to invite you to attend the birthday banquet. Would you be kind enough to honor us with your presence?"
Upon hearing this, Liu Bing’er was already delighted, knowing that not just anyone could attend grandfather’s birthday banquet. Her grandfather personally inviting Lin Fan showed his appreciation for Lin Fan.
As long as her grandfather appreciated Lin Fan, she was pleased.
Lin Fan was about to respond.
Suddenly, a middle-aged man walked in from outside.
Lin Fan recognized the person; on the day he brought Liu Tingshan back, this man was also present. Appearing to be Liu Tingshan’s son and Liu Bing’er’s third uncle, his name is Liu Tianhao.
Liu Tingshan smiled and said, "Tianhao, you’re back just in time. Add Mr. Lin’s name to the guest list for my birthday banquet."
Liu Tianhao responded with an "oh," briefly scrutinizing Lin Fan, noticing his attire from the market.
He recognized Lin Fan; it was this young man who brought the old master back. But wasn’t it excessive inviting him to dinner and also to the birthday banquet?
"What’s your name?" Liu Tianhao asked coldly.
Lin Fan said, "Lin Fan."
Liu Tianhao coldly said, "Participants at the birthday banquet must be either wealthy or distinguished. I need to verify your background. Do you own a company, or have personal assets worth 1 billion? If you don’t meet the criteria, I advise you to have some self-awareness!"
Those words were rather harsh.
Liu Tingshan frowned slightly and said, "Tianhao, Mr. Lin is my guest personally invited. He doesn’t need any conditions!"
Liu Tianhao responded irritably, "But father, the birthday banquet is critically important, and guests are prominent figures. I don’t want to be embarrassed by him."
Liu Tingshan’s face darkened, "Nonsense, Mr. Lin is my distinguished guest!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "It’s alright, I can answer uncle’s question; I have several companies under my name."
Liu Tianhao said incredulously, "Several companies? Are your companies listed, and what’s their market value?"
Lin Fan owned companies like Tianxue Entertainment, Blue Moon, and Tourist Comics, none of which were listed companies, naturally having no market value. However, Lin Fan, as the second-largest shareholder of the listed Golden Capital Group, held shares worth hundreds of billions.
Lin Fan replied, "My companies have not been listed yet."
Liu Tianhao laughed disdainfully and said, "Sounds like they aren’t major companies at all!"
Lin Fan smiled, ready to respond.
Just then.
"Ding!"
"System reminder, today’s check-in can begin now. Check-in will reward you with a listed company. Would you like to check-in immediately?"

chapters.title: Chapter 186: New Reward, a $50 Billion Publicly Listed Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 186: New Reward, a $50 Billion Publicly Listed Company
Mr. Lin Fan was invited to Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet, but Liu Tianhao was somewhat reluctant, feeling Lin Fan was unqualified.
After all, those invited to attend Liu Tingshan’s banquet are either rich or noble, people of significance; ordinary people are not really qualified to be invited.
Lin Fan’s situation is a bit special; Lin Fan saved Liu Tingshan, earning his appreciation, so his background is no longer important, even if he’s just a poor nobody.
But Liu Tianhao doesn’t see it this way; he’s afraid Lin Fan’s appearance will disgrace the Liu Family.
This is arrogance from the upper class.
Having a publicly listed company with assets over a billion, only then wouldn’t he disgrace the Liu Family!
Just at Liu Tianhao’s words, Lin Fan could have simply walked away; to be honest, he wasn’t interested in attending this banquet.
But this is Liu Tingshan’s invitation; Liu Tingshan’s attitude is still good, and Lin Fan doesn’t want to reject the old man’s good intentions.
In fact, dealing with Liu Tianhao is quite simple; he only needs to casually throw out a figure regarding his assets, and his assets are far more than a billion!
As for publicly listed companies, Lin Fan currently does not own any directly; while his companies like Tianxue Entertainment, Blue Moon, and Tourist Comics have not been listed, being the second-largest shareholder of both Golden Capital Group and Teasing Whiskers’ Entertainment Group, Lin Fan’s status is already sufficient.
Of course, if Lin Fan were to own his own publicly listed company, it would be even better.
"Ding!"
"System Alert: Today’s check-in process can begin, and a publicly listed company will be rewarded upon signing in. Would you like to sign in now?"
The system’s voice timely sounded.
"Sign in!" Lin Fan promptly thought.
"Ding!"
"Sign-in successful. The reward is a publicly listed Celestial Aviation Company with a 41% controlling stake as the major stakeholder and becoming the chairman and CEO of Celestial Aviation."
"Ding!"
"Celestial Aviation information has been fully collected. Would you like to retrieve it?"
Upon Lin Fan’s request for retrieval, a stream of data surged into his mind.
"Celestial Aviation, one of the top private aviation companies domestically, has been publicly listed with a current market value of nearly 50 billion, annual revenue exceeding 20 billion last year, and profits near 10 billion, ranking first among private aviation companies..."
Lin Fan read the information about Celestial Aviation and was momentarily stunned.
The system unexpectedly rewarded him with a private aviation company, which was beyond imagination and completely unexpected!
An airline is not simple; it involves aviation technology, belonging to the hardcore category of technology.
The system’s motivation for this is unknown.
However, as of now, with this airline company, Lin Fan can confront Liu Tianhao directly.
Seeing Lin Fan remain silent, Liu Tianhao assumed Lin Fan was speechless and lacked confidence, a smirk appearing on his face.
"I guess the so-called companies you have are nothing more than small companies worth a few million. People must have self-awareness; it’s fine if you’re poor, but don’t embarrass my Liu Family!" Liu Tianhao mocked.
Liu Bing’er got anxious on the side.
She knew Lin Fan was the mysterious affluent Mr. Lin; his assets were definitely not low. Lin Fan merely needed to reveal himself as the owner of Yunding Manor to shut Liu Tianhao up.
She really wanted to unveil this secret to slap Liu Tianhao’s face, but Lin Fan had mentioned wanting to stay low-key, so she tried hard to hold back.
Liu Tingshan disliked Liu Tianhao’s words, intending to reprimand him. Lin Fan was personally invited by him; even if Lin Fan were a beggar, Liu Tianhao should respect him rather than question.
But Lin Fan had already spoken: "Regarding my assets, I haven’t calculated seriously before, but since you mentioned it, Uncle, I’ll do a rough calculation on the spot. I’m the second-largest shareholder in Golden Capital Group, holding 30% shares, valued at approximately 30 billion. Additionally, I’m the second-largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers with assets close to 9 billion. These are companies I’m invested in. My personal companies are mainly four; besides three non-listed ones, I just acquired a publicly listed company, Celestial Aviation Company, with a current market value of 50 billion. Not sure if this can meet Uncle’s requirements?"
Lin Fan systematically calculated his assets, and he was merely calculating company assets, excluding properties, cars, and cash assets, which combined may exceed 200 billion.
The condition Liu Tianhao set was simply a requirement of having 10 billion in assets and owning a publicly listed company, which as a billionaire with 200 billion total cash assets far exceeds such demands.
As Lin Fan casually counted, the people present were already stupefied.
Directly petrified.
billion!
billion!
billion!
Each number felt like a heavy punch, shaking everyone’s inner feelings.
What the heck!
What the heck!
What the heck!
Lin Fan is actually this wealthy?
This truly shocked the entire family.
He said he just acquired a listed company valued at 50 billion, and his tone was as if he had just bought a big cabbage.
That’s insanely impressive!
Liu Bing’er trembled slightly with excitement; Brother Lin had played the big card, and this move was beyond extraordinary. Though he hadn’t revealed his identity as the owner of Yunding Manor, the disclosed assets were more impactful than the Lin family stature.
He is a billionaire tycoon!
Liu Tingshan was also dumbfounded; he knew Lin Fan was modest before, being able to drive a car worth 70 million is far from ordinary, but didn’t expect Lin Fan to be at this level of awe-inspiring.
Just from company assets, he’s already a billionaire tycoon!
He must have more assets, though unknown.
A 21-year-old billionaire tycoon!
Just acquired a publicly listed company valued at 50 billion!
This exceeds the description of young and promising; it is a super extraordinary situation.
Liu Tianhao was utterly petrified.
Unable to recover for a long time; however, after a brief shock, he soon gathered himself, first to disbelieve.
"Hahaha..."
Liu Tianhao laughed heartily, "Lin Fan, right; you’ve really got a way with bragging, almost had me believe you!"
Lin Fan shrugged: "I can’t help it if you don’t believe."
Liu Tianhao sneered: "Believe your nonsense; I asked if you have a listed company, and you just happened to acquire Celestial Aviation today? You’re lying without a plan! Father, if this joker appeared at the birthday banquet, it would certainly become a big joke; he must not be allowed to attend!"
Liu Bing’er couldn’t hold it in; she retorted: "Third Uncle, how can you be so sure Brother Lin is lying? I think you have a prejudice against Brother Lin!"
Liu Tianhao snorted: "I have no reason to hold a grudge against a pauper; he’s just outlandish with his words. I happen to have a friend on the board of Celestial Aviation, and I haven’t heard about Celestial Aviation being acquired."
Liu Bing’er was surprised, surely not!
Liu Tianhao sneered: "Lin Fan, you lied on a whim, didn’t expect to be exposed this quickly, huh? You may be poor, but no need to puff yourself up in vain; it only makes it more embarrassing."
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
"Mr. Lin, congratulations on becoming the chairman of Celestial Aviation’s board. I’m your secretary, Zhao Jiayi, and I’ve arrived above Peninsula Mansion, ready to take you to our company. Is it convenient for Mr. Lin to step out for a moment?"
A female voice transmitted over, accompanied by deafening engine sounds.
Lin Fan said: "Alright."
Then, he put down the phone.
"Excuse me, my secretary from Celestial Aviation has come to pick me up. I need to step out for a moment," Lin Fan said and turned to walk outside.
The Liu family all followed outside.
Liu Tianhao sneered: "I’ll see what trick you’re playing!"
They hadn’t even stepped outside when they heard a roaring sound from above. Looking up, they found a brand new helicopter descending on Peninsula Mansion!
The helicopter’s body bore a huge logo, distinctly Celestial Aviation!
Everyone was completely stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: List Mr. Lin as the highest-level VIP
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 187: List Mr. Lin as the highest-level VIP
A civilian helicopter appeared above Peninsula Mansion, with the "Celestial Aviation" logo printed on its body, an asset belonging to Celestial Aviation.
Liu Tianhao exclaimed: "This is the chairman’s exclusive helicopter of Celestial Aviation, worth 15 million!"
He has a friend who is a director at Celestial Aviation, and once invited him to visit. He had seen this helicopter before, and according to his director friend, it’s a benefit dedicated to the chairman, virtually the chairman’s personal asset.
An exclusive helicopter worth 15 million can be considered quite impressive.
The helicopter then landed on the large lawn of Peninsula Mansion, the rotor blades created a strong gust, causing the clothes of nearby people to flutter, and their hair to dance wildly.
This caught the attention of the residents of Peninsula Mansion, many came out to watch, their eyes filled with admiration and envy.
Living in Peninsula Mansion, there are no poor people, but not just anyone can own a private aircraft. Witnessing one is rare enough; owning one is out of the question.
So this 15 million helicopter still amazed the wealthy residents living here.
After the helicopter stopped, the cabin door opened, and a beautiful woman in professional attire jumped out, quickly walking towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan’s eyes lit up, such a beautiful woman in uniform, with an oval face, light makeup, a stunning figure, truly pleasing to the eyes.
The professional-dressed woman approached Lin Fan respectfully: "Hello, Chairman."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "You must be Zhao Jiayi?"
The professional-attired beauty quickly replied: "Yes, Chairman, just call me Little Zhao. I am your private secretary, feel free to instruct me on anything in the future."
Lin Fan was very satisfied with this private secretary; regardless of her work abilities, she was at least very pleasing to the eyes. There’s no need to work if you have a secretary.
Lin Fan nodded: "Alright, where do I need to go now?"
Zhao Jiayi said: "The Chairman has just acquired the company, and the directors want to meet you. Do you have time to return to the company now and attend the board meeting?"
Lin Fan said: "Sure, I’ll let them know first."
With that, Lin Fan turned and approached Liu Tingshan, "Sir, I have matters to attend to, so I’ll take my leave first. Thank you for your hospitality."
Liu Tingshan said: "No problem, work is important, Mr. Lin. About this old man’s birthday banquet..."
Lin Fan smiled: "I will definitely attend on time."
Liu Tingshan was delighted: "That’s good, take care, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan nodded at Liu Bing’er and then turned around to board the helicopter with Zhao Jiayi.
The helicopter then took off and flew away.
Liu Tianhao snapped out of his daze, quickly pulling out his phone to make a call to his friend, a director at Celestial Aviation.
After the call, Liu Tianhao was a little stunned.
Liu Tingshan coldly asked: "Tianhao, what did you find out?"
Liu Tianhao murmured: "Lin Fan did indeed complete the acquisition of Celestial Aviation today. No one knew beforehand; he acquired 41% of the shares, becoming the largest shareholder, and assumed the positions of Chairman of the Board and CEO, becoming the top leader of Celestial Aviation."
Liu Tingshan was taken aback and couldn’t help but sigh: "This young man’s identity is probably not simple. It’s like a dragon among men; silently, he acquired a publicly listed company."
Liu Tianhao and Liu Bing’er were both astonished; they had never heard the old man describe someone like this before. Lin Fan was the first.
Liu Bing’er felt excited inside. For some reason, the more her grandfather admired Brother Lin, the happier she became and the prouder she felt, as if she were being complimented herself.
Liu Tianhao said in surprise: "What’s his background, really?"
At this point, he no longer dared to look down on Lin Fan, the simply dressed young man who had completely changed his view. If Lin Fan was poor, then there would be no rich people in the world.
This young man, at such a young age, must have an unusual background.
Liu Tingshan asked: "Bing’er, you have interacted more with Mr. Lin. Has he ever mentioned his background to you?"
At this moment, he no longer believed that Lin Fan was the son of farmers, as he had previously said.
Lin Fan was intentionally concealing his identity!
Liu Bing’er shook her head: "He never mentioned it. I only heard him say for the first time today that his parents are farmers."
Liu Tianhao couldn’t help but laugh: "Farmers? I would like to be such a farmer too!"
Liu Tingshan pondered: "For someone so young to control a billion-dollar fortune, the only match I can think of is the Kyoto Lin Family."
Liu Tianhao and Liu Bing’er were both shocked.
The Kyoto Lin Family!
This is a super family that has a network reaching the heavens!
Liu Tingshan said: "If he truly is from the Kyoto Lin Family, why would they allow him to come to Yun City and spend money lavishly? What could be their purpose?"
This was a question he couldn’t figure out.
"Regardless of the reason, we must not neglect Mr. Lin. Tianhao, make Mr. Lin the highest-ranking guest at the birthday banquet." Liu Tingshan instructed. He finally made the decision that Lin Fan was someone worth paying attention to.
No matter Lin Fan’s investment intentions in Yun City, at any rate, it’s never wrong not to offend him.
Liu Tianhao no longer dared to disagree at this point and immediately said: "Okay, father."
At this moment.
Lin Fan was already sitting on the helicopter, flying in the sky.
Looking outside, there were white clouds accompanying him; looking down, there was the bustling city in full view; and across from him, there was the pleasing-to-the-eye beautiful private secretary.
It must be said, the system’s reward this time is really powerful.
It’s only second to the trillion in cash reward.
Indeed, none of the rewards Lin Fan had received so far could compare to the initial trillion in cash.
A trillion in cash! In the entire Huaxia, or even the whole world, how many wealthy people can so easily pull out a trillion in cash like Lin Fan?
Many billionaires, though claiming to have hundreds of billions or even trillions, can often only take out a few billion in cash at most.
In terms of personal assets, Lin Fan might still be far down the list of the world’s billionaires, but in terms of cash wealth, Lin Fan is probably at the top.
Of course, a public company with a market value of 50 billion is also an impressive reward.
The system’s strength is that Lin Fan doesn’t have to worry about the rewards; the system has already taken care of everything, so he only needs to receive them.
Lin Fan believes that the system’s reward of this company is definitely not just to humiliate Liu Tianhao. The system is laying the groundwork for the mission of the trillion-dollar group.
The goal of building a trillion-dollar super business empire has just officially begun.
Starting with this privately-owned airline company valued at 50 billion.
A plan had already formed in Lin Fan’s mind.
Yun City, a building with magnificent architecture, this is the headquarters of Celestial Aviation.
The helicopter landed on the huge lawn in front of the building.
Lin Fan got off the helicopter and, guided by Zhao Jiayi, walked into the headquarters building.
Headquarters meeting room.
The representative directors of Celestial Aviation had all gathered, waiting for the arrival of the new chairman, Lin Fan, a name unfamiliar, a young man unknown.
Who, overnight, completed the acquisition of Celestial Aviation, becoming its largest shareholder!
No issues in any aspects!
The former chairman, also the previous largest shareholder and founder of Celestial Aviation, announced his retirement with no objections, leaving with empty hands.
No one knew how Lin Fan achieved this, how he managed to acquire all the shares of the former chairman?
No one dared to ask.
Some speculated that perhaps the former chairman encountered unsolvable difficulties, which led him to hand the company over to Lin Fan.
On this day, Lin Fan took the position of chairman of Celestial Aviation, attended the board meeting, and announced that Celestial Aviation would be renamed Mortal Airlines, becoming the main entity of Mortal Group.
Following the announcement, the stock price of Mortal Group soared, and its market value skyrocketed by billions!

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Old Classmate: Are You Here to Apply for a Janitor Position?
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 188: Old Classmate: Are You Here to Apply for a Janitor Position?
Lin Fan followed Zhao Jiayi and entered the headquarters building of Celestial Aviation.
"Chairman, the meeting starts in 10 minutes, shall I take you to the office first?" Zhao Jiayi said.
Lin Fan said, "Give me a moment, I need to go to the restroom."
Zhao Jiayi replied, "Sure, Chairman, the restroom is over there."
Zhao Jiayi pointed in a direction.
Lin Fan walked over, and soon found the restroom. As he was about to enter, a woman in professional attire came out of the women’s restroom, bumping right into Lin Fan.
The two looked at each other and felt that the other person seemed somewhat familiar.
Lin Fan didn’t think much of it and was about to enter the restroom.
But the woman suddenly said, "Lin Fan?"
Lin Fan stopped in his tracks, a bit curious: "You know me, and you are?"
The woman smiled and said, "It’s me, Liu Guixiang, back in high school, you sat behind me, remember?"
Lin Fan thought for a moment and finally remembered, couldn’t help but smile and said, "Liu Guixiang, I remember now, your math was not very good back then, you often asked me to help you with problems."
Liu Guixiang laughed, "Wasn’t that the case, my grades weren’t good, and yours were better than mine."
Lin Fan sighed, "We haven’t seen each other since high school, I never thought I’d run into you here."
Liu Guixiang said, "Yeah, I’m working here as the HR manager. You know my grades weren’t good back then, I got into a third-tier university, and after graduating, I managed to become an HR manager in this 50 billion company, not too bad, huh!"
Her tone carried a hint of pride. Indeed, considering her qualifications, graduating from a third-tier university and achieving the position of HR manager at Celestial Aviation, it was quite commendable.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "That’s really impressive."
Liu Guixiang, feeling proud, glanced over Lin Fan, finally noticing that he was dressed in cheap clothes.
Liu Guixiang asked curiously, "And you, what brings you here? Are you here for an interview? Our company doesn’t have many job openings recently, except for a handyman position. You wouldn’t be..."
She looked Lin Fan up and down, becoming more convinced that Lin Fan was actually here for the handyman position!
Lin Fan felt a sweat break out. It seemed Liu Guixiang misunderstood, he wasn’t here for a job interview.
Lin Fan was just about to explain.
But Liu Guixiang spoke up first, "Lin Fan, you made it to a first-tier university back then, didn’t you? No way, why would you interview for a handyman, that’s just too bad. Look at your clothes, are they even worth 100 bucks?"
Her tone had turned mocking, the initial joy of meeting an old classmate had vanished, replaced by a condescending disdain.
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, why so snobbish, even if I really was here for a handyman job, there’s no need to sneer, we’re old classmates after all.
Lin Fan smiled, "If I were here to interview as a handyman, as the HR manager, would you give me a chance for the sake of old classmates?"
He was just testing Liu Guixiang, hence using the hypothetical "if".
But Liu Guixiang ignored the "if", assuming Lin Fan was indeed here for a handyman position, thinking she guessed right.
Her mind filled with disdain for Lin Fan, while a sense of superiority surged.
Indeed, a third-tier graduate did better than a first-tier, this sense of superiority was hard to suppress.
"That would depend on your work abilities. I don’t play favorites, but as an old classmate, I’d give you an interview opportunity. Come to my office later, and I’ll personally interview you!" Liu Guixiang said.
Lin Fan replied, "Alright, I’ll go to the restroom first."
Liu Guixiang laughed, "Lin Fan, let me be frank, didn’t you go to a first-tier university? Why are you doing so poorly, even worse than me with a third-tier, where did all your time go, chasing girls?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Handsome guys can’t help it, beauties are always around, there’s no time to study. And you? You must have been a diligent student, did you ever date?"
Those words struck a nerve as if stepping on Liu Guixiang’s tail.
Liu Guixiang’s face instantly darkened, "Lin Fan, what do you mean, are you implying I’m ugly and no one chased me?"
She indeed had never dated, not even someone pursuing her, which was her deepest pain.
Lin Fan chuckled, "I didn’t say that, don’t overthink it, I’m heading to the restroom."
Liu Guixiang snorted, "You clearly meant it, so what if you’ve dated, you’re still here interviewing for a handyman position!"
Lin Fan heard her but ignored it and walked into the restroom.
"Hit where it hurts, infuriating! Filthy pauper, I’m not interested in you anyway!"
Liu Guixiang muttered as she walked away.
In the lobby, Liu Guixiang spotted Zhao Jiayi, who seemed to be waiting for someone.
"Secretary Zhao, waiting for someone? I heard you went to pick up the new chairman, did you?" Liu Guixiang greeted proactively.
Though Zhao Jiayi was just a secretary, being the chairman’s personal secretary, her status was no small matter, even as HR manager, Liu Guixiang needed to curry favor.
Zhao Jiayi replied, "Yes, I picked him up."
Liu Guixiang smiled, "I heard our new chairman is very young, can’t wait to meet him, but the higher-ups have kept it under wraps, and we still don’t know the chairman’s name."
Zhao Jiayi smiled, "The Chairman is here already, he’ll be present at the board meeting soon, you’ll know then."
After chatting with Zhao Jiayi for a bit, Liu Guixiang returned to her office.
Zhao Jiayi was waiting for Lin Fan to come out. Suddenly, she received a phone call and temporarily left as Lin Fan had not come out yet.
After a while, Lin Fan returned to the lobby.
Not seeing Zhao Jiayi.
Lin Fan assumed she went ahead inside, so he planned to go in by himself.
But at the front desk, he was stopped by the receptionist.
Seeing Lin Fan, the receptionist stood up and asked, "Sir, who are you looking for?"
Seeing Lin Fan with his shabby appearance, he didn’t look like he was there for an interview. Celestial Aviation wasn’t a small company; even for interviews, formal attire was expected.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s my first day at work."
The receptionist frowned, looking skeptical, "At work? May I ask which department and your name?"
Lin Fan replied, "Lin Fan."
"One moment." The receptionist searched the computer, "I’m sorry, sir, but I couldn’t find any employment information for you. You can’t enter."
Lin Fan said, "It’s normal not to find it. I’ve instructed to keep it low profile; I’m your chairman."
Indeed, there were rumors that the company had changed ownership, but Lin Fan didn’t seem like a chairman at all.
The receptionist didn’t believe him and warned, "Sir, please don’t make trouble, leave immediately, or I’ll call security."
Lin Fan said, "If you don’t believe me, you might as well call my secretary, Little Zhao."
The receptionist got a bit annoyed, "You better be sensible, just leave quickly. If you’re our new chairman, then I’m the chairman’s wife!"
At this moment, Zhao Jiayi came rushing over, somewhat hurriedly.
"Apologies, Chairman, there was an important document to handle, so I stepped away for a moment."

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Ask Liu Guixiang to come to my office
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 189: Ask Liu Guixiang to come to my office
Jiayi looked nervous, fearing that her negligence might anger Lin Fan.
Lin Fan naturally didn’t mind, smiled and said, "It’s okay."
Jiayi said, "Chairman, let me take you to your office."
"Sure," Lin Fan said.
The receptionist nearby froze, her face turning pale from shock.
Oh my god, the person in front of her was really their new chairman!
Her words earlier had clearly offended the new chairman; how could she not be afraid?
Lin Fan turned to the receptionist and smiled, "What’s your name?"
The receptionist stammered, "My name is Zhou Jingwen, Chairman. I really didn’t know... I’m sorry, please don’t fire me, I need this job to support my family."
The young girl was about to burst into tears from fear.
Lin Fan smiled warmly, "Don’t be afraid, I won’t fire you. You’re doing a great job not letting strangers into the company. Little Zhao, let’s go."
After speaking, Lin Fan and Jiayi went inside.
Zhou Jingwen breathed a huge sigh of relief, she was nearly scared to death. It’s true you can’t judge a book by its cover. Thinking back, although the chairman’s attire was simple, he was quite handsome and had a gentle demeanor.
Recalling her earlier claim of being the chairman’s wife, Zhou Jingwen’s face turned red with embarrassment, utterly mortified.
Jiayi led Lin Fan to a spacious and bright office. The furnishings were exquisite, indicating that the former chairman was a person of taste.
Lin Fan sat on the chairman’s chair, which was very comfortable. Owning a company valued at 50 billion felt quite nice.
"Chairman, I’ll get you a cup of coffee," Jiayi said.
Lin Fan replied, "Okay. By the way, does our company have an HR manager named Liu Guixiang?"
Jiayi replied, "Yes."
She was a little curious, how did the chairman know Liu Guixiang?
Lin Fan said, "Please ask her to come in while you’re at it."
Not daring to ask more questions, Jiayi said, "Okay, I’ll go immediately."
HR Manager’s office.
Liu Guixiang sat in her office chair, still a bit angry when she recalled bumping into Lin Fan in the restroom earlier. Lin Fan had offended her!
Once Lin Fan comes for the interview, she planned to give him a hard time. Of course, the cleaning job was definitely not going to Lin Fan!
The thought of humiliating Lin Fan and then sending him away, unable to get the job while being mistreated, brought her satisfaction.
After all, who told Lin Fan to mock her!
Suddenly, her phone rang; it was Jiayi calling.
"Manager Liu, the chairman wants you to go to his office," Jiayi said.
Liu Guixiang was stunned; no way, the chairman was asking for her!
Was it the new chairman? Why would he call her to the office? It was a bit strange!
"Secretary Zhao, do you know what it’s about?" Liu Guixiang asked, feeling a bit apprehensive.
Jiayi replied, "I don’t know, you’d better go. I still need to make coffee for the chairman."
The call ended right after.
Liu Guixiang reluctantly left her office and headed towards the chairman’s office.
Before long, she arrived outside the chairman’s office, knocked on the door, and walked in.
Inside, there was only one person, sitting in the chairman’s chair, facing away from her, seemingly admiring the view outside the window.
This must be the chairman!
Liu Guixiang was a little nervous, "Chairman, I heard you wanted to see me?"
Upon hearing this, the chair turned around.
Seeing the person sitting in the chair, Liu Guixiang was taken aback; wasn’t it Lin Fan!
"Lin Fan, what are you doing here?" Liu Guixiang asked in surprise, this was completely beyond her expectation.
Lin Fan smiled, "You came."
Liu Guixiang’s face immediately darkened in anger, "I asked what you’re doing here. You clueless guy, do you know this is our chairman’s office? Who do you think you are, sitting in the chairman’s chair? Get up!"
Lin Fan wasn’t angry, "I know, that’s why I’m sitting here."
Liu Guixiang scolded, "How did you sneak in? Aren’t you here to apply for the cleaning job? Did you get into the wrong place or sneak into the chairman’s office on purpose? I think you’re pretending to apply and actually here to steal something!"
Lin Fan smiled, "We’ve been schoolmates, do you have to speak so harshly?"
Liu Guixiang snorted coldly, "Who cares about being your schoolmate? You went to an ordinary university and ended up applying for a cleaning job. I haven’t even called you a disgrace yet! Are you going to get up or should I call security?"
Lin Fan said, "Alright, let’s stop joking. I’m not here to steal, nor am I here for the job application."
Liu Guixiang interrogated, "Then why did you sneak into the chairman’s office?"
"Chairman, here’s your coffee,"
At this moment, Jiayi walked in with a cup of coffee and placed it in front of Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you."
Liu Guixiang was stunned.
What? Secretary Zhao called Lin Fan chairman?
Wait a minute!
What the hell is going on?
Cold sweat covered Liu Guixiang’s forehead, "Secretary Zhao, what’s going on here?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Little Zhao, introduce my identity to her."
Jiayi said, "Yes, Manager Liu, he is our Celestial Aviation’s new chairman."
Liu Guixiang’s face turned pale, blurting out, "Impossible, this is absurd. He came to apply for a cleaning job; how could he possibly be the chairman..."
But she also knew that Secretary Zhao wouldn’t lie, and there was no reason to deceive her.
Oh my god, Lin Fan is the one who bought Celestial Aviation, the legendary new chairman, the CEO!
Jiayi frowned, "What are you talking about? Do you know what you’re saying?"
Thud!
Liu Guixiang’s knees gave way, and she knelt down to Lin Fan.
Crying her eyes out.
"Chairman, it’s my fault; I didn’t recognize you. Please forgive me, don’t fire me, I have an eighty-year-old mother to support. I can’t lose this job!"
Liu Guixiang, with tears and snot, began to beg.
She seemed to forget that she had just been hostile towards Lin Fan; now she was already humble as if she were a dog.
She couldn’t help it; she was terrified, realizing she had offended the new chairman, and her job might not be secure.
Lin Fan looked at the woman who had just appeared superior in front of him and was now groveling, and couldn’t help but show a playful smile.
What a snob, a former classmate. In high school, he repeatedly helped her with her studies. Mistaking him for someone applying for a cleaning job, she immediately assumed a superior attitude, belittling him for not succeeding.
If Lin Fan were really down on his luck, he would have to endure being mocked by her, silently suffering.
"Liu Guixiang, how long have you been with Celestial Aviation?" Lin Fan asked leisurely.
Liu Guixiang quickly said, "Three years. I joined the company before graduating, climbed my way up from an intern to HR manager. Chairman, for the sake of our past as classmates, please forgive me this once. I’ll even kowtow to you!"
She indeed began kowtowing.
Jiayi stood by, dumbfounded; what was going on?
Lin Fan said, "Sounds like a tough journey, but I see you haven’t learned to respect people after three years. What’s wrong with a cleaning job that you look down on?"
Liu Guixiang’s face was flushed, "I was wrong. I should respect people and not discriminate based on occupation."
Lin Fan smiled, "Alright, it’s good that you know your mistake. I won’t fire you."
Liu Guixiang was overjoyed, "Thank you, Chairman!"
Lin Fan said, "I’m not done yet. I won’t fire you, but you need to return to an intern position to relearn some things. Your salary and treatment will also be at intern level. Whether you can become HR manager again depends on your performance."
Liu Guixiang’s smile froze, as if she had swallowed a fly: "..."
Lin Fan no longer paid attention to her and stood up, "Little Zhao, is it time for the meeting?"
Jiayi replied, "Yes, the board members are all here, just waiting for the chairman."
Lin Fan said, "Let’s go to the meeting then."
With that, Lin Fan and Jiayi walked out.
Meeting room.
Celestial Aviation’s board members had already gathered, waiting for Lin Fan’s arrival.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Board Meeting, The Directors Were Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 190: Board Meeting, The Directors Were Shocked
The conference room, all the directors of Celestial Aviation had already gathered, waiting for the arrival of the new chairman.
Overnight, Celestial Aviation was acquired by 41% by Lin Fan, making him the largest shareholder and the new chairman and CEO, while the former chairman quietly stepped down.
The directors were very surprised by this.
They all tried to contact the former chairman to inquire about the reason, but the response was that the former chairman voluntarily sold the shares.
Lin Fan’s appointment as chairman was in line with the company’s rules, without any issues.
As for the reason behind the former chairman’s exit, no one knew.
Regarding Lin Fan, everyone heard he was a young man, but they knew nothing about such a young person emerging from Yun City.
Suddenly, the directors began to worry about the future of Celestial Aviation.
Celestial Aviation was founded single-handedly by the former chairman, and under his leadership, it became a top private airline with a market value of 50 billion, thanks to his strong leadership.
It can be said that the former chairman was the stabilizing force of Celestial Aviation.
Now that stabilizing force is gone, Celestial Aviation has changed hands!
It’s no wonder the directors are worried.
Can this young man Lin Fan lead Celestial Aviation well, is this a good beginning or a bad beginning?
No one had much confidence.
Some even pessimistically thought this might be the beginning of Celestial Aviation’s decline.
Currently, the news of Celestial Aviation’s change of ownership has not been made public, but once it is, the stock price is likely to drop!
Stock price drop!
This is the most pressing issue for the directors, after all, it’s the most practical issue, concerning the shrinkage of their wealth.
"I don’t like this change, why did the old chairman quit after all?"
"Could it be the old chairman sensed something amiss and left early?"
"Impossible, Celestial Aviation was still profitable last year, there shouldn’t be any upheaval!"
"Who exactly is this young man?"
All of a sudden, the directors were filled with doubt and uncertainty.
In the somewhat heavy atmosphere, Lin Fan entered the conference room with Zhao Jiayi.
Seeing Lin Fan in plain attire, the directors even thought he was an intern handling odd jobs.
"Little Zhao, hasn’t the chairman arrived yet?" Someone asked.
"Kid, come over and change my cup of coffee, this one’s cold." A fat middle-aged man said to Lin Fan.
Zhao Jiayi, sweating, said: "Let me introduce, Lin Fan, the new chairman of Celestial Aviation."
Everyone was stunned.
They heard Lin Fan was young, but didn’t expect him to be this young!
He looked about 20 years old, which was completely unexpected, my God, 20 years old and already chairman of Celestial Aviation!
The middle-aged man nearly fell over, cold sweat streaming down.
My god!
This is the new chairman!
Just now he asked the chairman to help change coffee, the middle-aged man quickly stood up and bowed in apology: "Sorry, Chairman, I was rude earlier."
He felt a bit nervous, surely he hadn’t offended the chairman, right? He certainly didn’t want to offend the chairman.
Lin Fan sat at the head of the table, smiled and said: "It’s okay, have a seat, you must be Director Wang Cai?"
The fat uncle was a bit surprised: "Chairman, you—you know me?"
Lin Fan said: "I’ve seen the information on everyone present, I recognize everyone."
The system gathered company information, including shareholder and director personal data, after reading the data stream, Lin Fan naturally understood clearly.
Upon hearing this, the directors began to look at Lin Fan in a different light, this young chairman had done his homework in advance, which was rather attentive.
But Lin Fan was too young after all, younger than they imagined, everyone was still unsure about Lin Fan’s capabilities.
Such an unknown young person, can he really lead Celestial Aviation well?
"Chairman, forgive my directness, everyone is very worried about the company’s future, can you tell us the reason you acquired Celestial Aviation? What happened to the former chairman?" An elderly man with gray hair asked.
Lin Fan took a look, this person was Li Hongting, the second-largest shareholder of Celestial Aviation, holding 13 percent.
As the second-largest shareholder, his voice carried substantial weight, and his standing in the company was also respected.
The questions from everyone, Li Hongting had the most qualification to present them as a representative, upon his speaking, the directors nodded in agreement, looking at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan thought to himself, so these people weren’t very convinced by him.
The acquisition of Celestial Aviation was done by the system, he certainly couldn’t reveal the truth.
"The transaction details between me and the former chairman are not convenient to disclose. I can only tell everyone, I acquired Celestial Aviation because I am optimistic about the company’s prospects and have confidence to make it better." Lin Fan calmly said.
Li Hongting chuckled: "Chairman, please be more practical, where does your confidence come from? Everyone only sees your youth, really not very reassuring, we believe the market will react similarly, everyone is worried once the news is announced, their stocks will shrink."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "According to the data I obtained, the company’s net profit last year was nearly 10 billion, which looks good, but it’s undeniable that growth rate fell by 5 percent compared to the previous year, and this year’s first-quarter net profit continues to decline year-on-year, with revenue growth consistently weak for two years. The urgent need for the company is to increase operating income and expand market share."
The directors remained silent.
Lin Fan’s remarks pointed directly to the crux, which was precisely the crisis Celestial Aviation faced!
This was a headache even for the former chairman.
Lin Fan, so young, yet upon taking charge, had already diagnosed the company’s issues, quite impressive.
In fact, Lin Fan’s conclusions all came from the information provided by the system, he took over this company, understanding management was certainly crucial.
Li Hongting said: "The chairman is quite right, what can the chairman do about it?"
Lin Fan said: "This time acquiring Celestial Aviation, I’ve brought over 10 billion in funds, I plan to use this money to purchase more aircraft, expand the fleet size, thereby increasing operating income, while also boosting investment in technology development, Celestial Aviation’s future is not just about simple transportation, but to become a top notch Technology Company!"
Lin Fan’s remarks were resounding.
The mere mention of the 10 billion in cash already excited everyone.
For a company, what’s most important? Of course, it’s capital.
Capital, it’s the lifeblood of a company.
Now it’s steady, once Lin Fan’s plan is announced, no fear of market instability!
What does the stock market love? Telling stories, painting big pictures, when the story is convincing, stocks surge.
Besides, Lin Fan wasn’t just telling stories, but making substantial investments!
"Good, good, good!"
Li Hongting repeatedly said three good words, showing his excitement.
The directors all nodded, each very excited.
The previous disregard and concern for Lin Fan had completely vanished, replaced by a feeling of joy.
