Seeing this, Lin Fan smiled slightly: "I plan to rename the company Mortal Airlines, my goal is to build Mortal Group into a trillion-dollar business empire in the future, first set a small goal, in the short term raise the market value to 100 billion!"
With this statement, everyone present was moved!
The chairman was indeed bold!
Celestial Aviation currently has a market value of only 50 billion, yet Lin Fan wants to raise it to a trillion! Such ambition cannot be underestimated, such vision cannot be called short-sighted.
Only one word could describe it.
Amazing!
Li Hongting, however, was a bit skeptical, having a goal was good, but this was too exaggerated, does Lin Fan have this capability, wasn’t it unrealistic and overreaching?

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Market Value Skyrockets by 10 Billion, Shocking the Nation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 191: Market Value Skyrockets by 10 Billion, Shocking the Nation!
On this day, a piece of news shook the business world: Celestial Aviation changed hands. The mysterious financial backer, Lin Fan, brought in ten billion in capital and crazily acquired 41% of Celestial Aviation’s shares, becoming its largest shareholder and taking over as chairman of the board.
Celestial Aviation was renamed Mortal Airlines, and they plan to expand the fleet size and invest in aviation technology research to boost company revenue.
Upon the news’s release, Celestial Aviation’s stock price soared on the same day, and its market value skyrocketed from 50 billion to break through 60 billion, an increase of 10 billion!
Yun City was shaken!
Jiangnan was shaken!
The entire nation was shaken!
At Celestial Aviation headquarters, the board members were kneeling all over the place.
They didn’t initially think highly of Lin Fan, but they couldn’t even imagine that on the first day the company changed hands, it would bring such shocking results.
The company’s second-largest shareholder, Li Hongting, even thought Lin Fan was being overly ambitious and unrealistic when Lin Fan proposed building a trillion-dollar group.
But when he saw the company’s soaring stock price, he too knelt down, completely conquered by this 21-year-old chairman.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan’s name spread wildly in the business world, with everyone curious about who this young man really was.
He virtually parachuted into the business world without warning, and as soon as he appeared, he owned a group with a market value of 60 billion.
Soon, Lin Fan’s companies were dug up.
The second-largest shareholder of the catering giant Golden Capital Group, owning 30% of the shares!
The second-largest shareholder of the livestreaming giant Teasing Whiskers Livestream, owning 30% of the shares!
The third-largest shareholder of the top law firm Xingquan Law Firm, holding 20% of the shares!
Acquired Tianxue Entertainment, becoming a giant in the entertainment industry!
Acquired Tourist Comics, becoming a giant in the anime industry!
Acquired Blue Moon Hand Soap, recently developed a new hand soap product that’s taking the market by storm, with orders skyrocketing!
These are only the assets that can be checked, and who knows how many are still out there.
Seeing all this, everyone was stunned!
Where did this super-rich come from, spending money like water in just a few days and investing so much in so many companies? This is simply too crazy!
People speculated about Lin Fan’s identity, unanimously believing that Lin Fan was likely a person from the Kyoto Lin Family!
Lin Fan was very likely the heir of the Kyoto Lin Family, and these investments were merely a practice for the Crown Prince!
Reporters tried to interview the mysterious Kyoto Lin Family but were refused. Eventually, reporters learned from sources that the Kyoto Lin Family denied Lin Fan’s identity.
However, no one believed this denial, and it was even perceived as a cover-up, further cementing Lin Fan’s identity as a young master of the Kyoto Lin Family.
Once Lin Fan was tied to the Kyoto Lin Family, a legendary aura surrounded him.
Market predictions suggest that when the market opens tomorrow, Mortal Group’s stock price will likely continue to soar!
This made Mortal Airlines’ stock the bull stock of recent years, driving the whole nation crazy.
Shengshi Group.
The CEO, Feng Wanshan, jumped up excitedly in his office upon seeing the news.
"Good for you, Lin Fan!"
Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth.
Perhaps only he knew that Lin Fan was not from the Kyoto Lin Family. Behind Lin Fan was a mysterious super-rich named Lin Beixuan!
This Lin Beixuan was regarded as an enemy by Feng Wanshan because Lin Beixuan had successively snatched the Yunding Manor, Chiba Island, and the Shendiao Old Factory site from him.
Lin Fan was nothing more than Lin Beixuan’s spokesperson, a puppet!
Lin Fan once boasted in front of Anna that he wanted to be the king of the Jiangnan business world and defeat the Jiangnan tycoon Wei Tiansheng, who held a controlling stake in the 350 billion-valued Wangu Group.
And Lin Fan’s first step was to surpass the three tycoons of Yun City.
He Chao, tycoon of Zhongtong Express Company!
Wang Hailin, tycoon of Yida Mall!
Feng Wanshan of Shengshi Group!
Feng Wanshan previously thought Lin Fan was biting off more than he could chew, but today, Lin Fan suddenly parachuted into Celestial Aviation. The market value of Celestial Aviation soared by ten billion in a day, reaching 60 billion, already approaching 100 billion!
Feng Wanshan immediately felt unprecedented pressure.
Lin Fan, this guy, came on too fiercely!
This was simply a big move that caught Feng Wanshan off guard.
Mortal Group surpassing Shengshi Group seemed imminent.
Bringing down the three tycoons of Yun City was only a matter of time!
Feng Wanshan was displeased. How could he let Lin Fan succeed!
He must stop Lin Fan!
"Lin Beixuan, I will find you, see how long you can hide. I, Feng Wanshan, formally declare war on Lin Fan today!"
Feng Wanshan would not watch Lin Fan overtake him; he was determined to snipe Lin Fan’s Mortal Group.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan had already left the Mortal Airlines headquarters.
His personal secretary, Zhao Jiayi, had called someone early in the morning to drive Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce Cullinan to the headquarters.
As Lin Fan left, he called Zhao Jiayi.
Sitting in the passenger seat, Zhao Jiayi was a bit curious: "Chairman, where are we going now?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I have another car. Help me drive it back home in a while."
Zhao Jiayi broke into a sweat, realizing the chairman wanted her to be the chauffeur, but she was Lin Fan’s personal secretary. Whatever Lin Fan asked her to do, she would comply.
They arrived at Lin Fan’s workplace, the Zhongtong Express station, and indeed saw a top luxury car, a Kosak.
Zhao Jiayi’s heart began racing; the chairman was too incredible.
Young, handsome,
and immensely wealthy!
The Rolls-Royce was already impressive, yet he had a 70 million top supercar, and he casually parked it at a courier station!
Zhao Jiayi’s heart began to race uncontrollably; her former chairman was a rigid old man, and as a secretary, she did her job step by step without other thoughts.
But in the face of this young, wealthy, and handsome chairman, Zhao Jiayi couldn’t help having some thoughts.
This left Zhao Jiayi blushing and her heart pounding.
Lin Fan handed the Kosak keys to Zhao Jiayi.
"Drive it back to Yunding Manor for me," Lin Fan said.
Zhao Jiayi was shocked: "Yu-Yunding Manor? Chairman, do you live in Yunding Manor?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes."
Zhao Jiayi blurted out, "Could you be the legendary mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, but keep it low-key. You’re my personal secretary, which is why I’m telling you."
Zhao Jiayi quickly nodded: "I understand."
Inside, her heart was already in turmoil. Oh my God, she should have realized sooner that the recently famous mysterious tycoon in Yun City, Mr. Lin, who acquired Celestial Aviation, is the same person as Lin Fan!
"I actually became the personal secretary of the legendary Mr. Lin?" Zhao Jiayi felt as if she were dreaming, as if overwhelmed by great luck.
"Go ahead, drive safely," Lin Fan instructed as he reached into the back seat of the car for a set of clothes.
Zhao Jiayi saw that Lin Fan had actually taken out courier attire.
Zhao Jiayi couldn’t help but curiously ask, "Chairman, what is this for?"
Lin Fan said, "Oh, I’m going to deliver packages. I haven’t told you yet, I’m a courier here."
Zhao Jiayi was dumbfounded, beads of cold sweat forming on her forehead.
What?
Did I hear wrong?
The chairman is a courier here?
He just presided over a board meeting of a company with a market value of 60 billion and then turned around to deliver packages?
This stark contrast...
Absurd.
Too absurd!
Zhao Jiayi found herself at a loss, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.
But Lin Fan really wasn’t joking. As soon as he got off the car, people at the courier station greeted him warmly.
"Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan’s back!"
Everyone was very enthusiastic.
"Little Fan, you’re back. I thought you weren’t coming today." The landlady, Sister Feng, was especially warm.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sorry, something came up. Sister Feng, please arrange it for me."
Soon, Lin Fan used the Cullinan to load up the packages he was to deliver and set off in his car to begin deliveries.
Lin Fan casually called Anna: "Anna, have you returned to the manor?"
Anna replied coldly, "Not yet."
Then she hung up the call.
Lin Fan wasn’t bothered and continued with the deliveries.
Suddenly, Lin Fan noticed a delivery address: Shengshi Group!
Previously, when Lin Fan was an express delivery guy, he delivered once to Shengshi Group. Unexpectedly, as a courier now, he had to make another trip to Shengshi Group.
Shengshi Group, Feng Wanshan’s company.
"No helping it, just have to make the trip," Lin Fan mumbled, and then drove towards Shengshi Group.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Anna’s Origins, Father’s Mysterious Disappearance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 192: Anna’s Origins, Father’s Mysterious Disappearance!
Shengshi Group Mansion.
Anna hurriedly walked into the meeting room. Despite still being injured and having difficulty moving, her footsteps seemed somewhat urgent.
In the meeting room sat Feng Wanshan and a thin man.
"Godfather, Qian Wu, is the news about my father true?" Anna asked directly.
The thin man, named Qian Wu, was the one who brought back the news about her father.
Feng Wanshan nodded solemnly, "I spent a fortune on this clue, it shouldn’t be false."
Qian Wu also nodded, "Based on the clues Mr. Feng provided, I investigated and found traces leading all the way to Southeast Asia. I am sure that your father appeared there."
Anna was emotionally agitated, "This means there’s a good chance my father is still alive, and we might be able to find him!"
Qian Wu said, "Yes, there is indeed hope, but..."
Anna pressed, "But what?"
Qian Wu sighed, "Now the price of information is getting more expensive. To get more news, we need more funds. I just discussed this with Mr. Feng, I got a lead, but the other party wants 5 million cash to provide the information."
million!
Anna frowned.
That’s too expensive!
She simply couldn’t afford that kind of money!
She felt a sudden sadness.
When she was still a little girl, 15 years ago, at the tender age of 10, her father An Jincheng disappeared.
Neither dead nor alive.
No one knew if An Jincheng was still alive.
She lost her mother when she was young and lived with her father. After his disappearance, she became an orphan.
Feng Wanshan, who was like a brother to An Jincheng, took Anna in as his goddaughter after An Jincheng disappeared and supported her education.
Ever since she learned of her father’s disappearance, Anna never stopped thinking about finding him. To search for her father’s whereabouts, she learned a variety of skills, later joining the military, becoming a mercenary, and working in a security company—all to make herself stronger.
But fifteen years passed, and she still hadn’t found An Jincheng.
Feng Wanshan had always supported her and even spent heavily to arrange for Qian Wu to pursue An Jincheng’s trail.
Just yesterday, Anna heard the news and hoped to find An Jincheng, so she arranged to meet here today.
Having news of her father, Anna was naturally happy, but hearing that she needed 5 million to buy the news left her troubled.
She couldn’t come up with that money herself!
Feng Wanshan said, "Isn’t it just 5 million? As long as we can find Brother Cheng, money isn’t a problem. Little Na, you don’t have to worry; I’ll provide the money. Qian Wu, I’ll write you a check right away!"
Qian Wu smiled, "Alright, thanks to Mr. Feng, this time we might find Mr. An."
Anna looked a bit conflicted and said, "Godfather, I want to follow this lead myself."
Feng Wanshan said, "You know I don’t want you to take risks. I’ve already lost a good brother; I don’t want to lose you too!"
Anna bit her lip, "I’ve been honing my skills all these years to protect myself. Godfather, I really want to go."
Feng Wanshan, although always providing funds to help find An Jincheng, had one request for Anna: he didn’t want her to get involved, arguing that he didn’t want her to risk herself.
This time, however, Anna really wanted to get involved.
Feng Wanshan said, "It’s not that I’m not letting you go, but you’re a girl, and I can’t be at ease. Besides, you have a task now; you need to help me find Lin Beixuan!"
Anna said, "This..."
Feng Wanshan smiled, "How about this? You know Qian Wu’s capabilities. Let him continue the investigation for now, and you keep helping me with Lin Fan. Once you complete this task, I’ll consider letting you follow up. How does that sound?"
With Feng Wanshan saying this much, Anna couldn’t say anything more.
After all, Feng Wanshan was providing the money!
She couldn’t go against him.
"Alright." Anna had to nod, suppressing her inner urgency.
Qian Wu smiled, "Miss Anna, don’t worry, I’ll do my best and inform both of you as soon as I have any news."
Feng Wanshan said, "Let’s settle it like this, Anna. You should hurry back so Lin Fan doesn’t get suspicious. By the way, has Lin Fan shown any signs of activity these past few days?"
Anna said, "He leaves in the morning and returns at night; I haven’t noticed anything suspicious for now."
Feng Wanshan said, "Think carefully; is there anything you haven’t told me? Don’t miss anything. I need to know his every move!"
Anna had indeed hidden a few things. Last night, Lin Fan brought Liu Bing’er home for the night, and Liu Bing’er was actually Liu Tingshan’s granddaughter!
Anna appeared to be in deep thought before decisively shaking her head, "No."
Feng Wanshan was visibly a bit dissatisfied but could only say, "Alright then, in any case, remember your task. I know your abilities; you won’t let me down. I’ll follow up on your father’s matter with Qian Wu."
Anna responded, "Godfather, I’ll leave now."
Anna turned and walked out, frowning slightly.
Feng Wanshan’s words earlier felt somewhat threatening. This meeting today didn’t seem so simple, but she couldn’t quite put her finger on it at the moment.
This meeting added a sense of pressure. She needed to quickly complete her undercover mission at Yunding Manor, find Lin Beixuan swiftly, and personally pursue her father’s whereabouts!
Anna walked out of Shengshi Group Mansion and immediately got on her motorcycle parked by the roadside and left.
Yet Anna didn’t notice a Rolls-Royce Cullinan not far off.
Lin Fan, dressed in a courier uniform, had just retrieved a package from the trunk and came around the car, catching a glimpse of Anna leaving.
Lin Fan frowned, "Anna? She took half a day off, so she did come to see Feng Wanshan? Could she be reporting on me?"
He was a bit curious; Anna could have easily reported to Feng Wanshan over the phone, especially since she was injured, so why did she need to come in person?
Things seemed more complicated than they appeared.
Lin Fan, carrying the package, arrived at Shengshi Company’s front desk.
"Delivery," Lin Fan said to the receptionist.
The receptionist said, "Whose phone is it? You call them yourself to come out and pick it up."
Lin Fan made the call and then waited at the front desk, stealing glances inside.
He saw Feng Wanshan standing at the meeting room door, talking to a thin man.
Since he was far away, Lin Fan couldn’t hear what they were saying. However, having gained top-notch insight, he was no ordinary person and could decipher their conversation through lip-reading!
The thin man said, "Rest assured, Mr. Feng, Anna won’t find out. I’m leaving now."
He actually mentioned Anna’s name!
The two exchanged a few brief words before parting, and the thin man walked towards the door.
Feng Wanshan also glanced over.
Lin Fan had already conspicuously turned his head to cover his face.
Feng Wanshan probably never dreamed that this delivery man was actually Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Transforming into a Mysterious Man, Forcing the Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 193: Transforming into a Mysterious Man, Forcing the Truth
The thin man quickly brushed past Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan then returned to his office, paying no attention to the courier at the front desk.
Seeing the thin man exit and the client not yet arrived, Lin Fan tossed out a sentence: "Miss, could you pass this on for me?"
Having said that, without further ado, he threw the package on the front desk and turned to leave.
The receptionist was furious: "What’s wrong with you?! I’m going to report you!"
Lin Fan didn’t care if she reported him, he was already out the door.
Meanwhile, Qian Wu left Shengshi Group Mansion and walked away, cautiously observing his surroundings. He took out his phone and made a call.
"Hello, it’s me," Qian Wu said in a low voice.
Anna’s voice came from the other end: "Have you left?"
Qian Wu replied: "Yes, I’ve got the 5 million check."
Anna said: "Good, let me know as soon as you have any news."
Qian Wu chuckled: "Rest assured, Miss Anna, I will."
Then, he hung up the phone.
Putting the phone back in his pocket, Qian Wu was about to leave quickly.
Suddenly, he felt a sharp pain in his waist and realized there was someone behind him, pressing a knife against him!
Damn, as vigilant as he was, someone got behind him without him noticing. Who was this person?
It was none other than Lin Fan.
"Don’t move if you don’t want to die!" Lin Fan said in a threatening tone.
Qian Wu’s expression changed: "Who are you? Are you trying to rob me in broad daylight?"
Lin Fan replied: "You guessed it. See that alley three hundred meters ahead? Walk over there slowly, don’t turn around, don’t do anything funny."
Qian Wu began to step forward, suddenly trying to speed up and shake off Lin Fan.
However, before he could accelerate, Lin Fan’s hand was already on his shoulder. The immense force felt like a giant boulder, paralyzing half of Qian Wu’s body, leaving him unable to escape.
Cold sweat broke out on Qian Wu.
Damn!
This guy is too strong!
"I told you, behave. Next time, I’ll cripple you," Lin Fan said coldly.
Not daring to act rashly anymore, Qian Wu nodded obediently and walked slowly ahead.
With one hand on Qian Wu’s shoulder and a knife pressed against his waist, onlookers might have thought the two were simply walking arm in arm.
Soon, they turned into the alley, arriving at a secluded corner.
Lin Fan told Qian Wu to stop.
"Who exactly are you, and what do you want?" Qian Wu asked. He still didn’t know who was holding him up.
Lin Fan deliberately lowered his voice. All Qian Wu knew was that Lin Fan was male; he couldn’t even guess his age.
"Why was Anna at Shengshi Group today?" Lin Fan asked.
The thin man mentioned Anna at Shengshi Group earlier, so Lin Fan was looking to gather some information from him.
Qian Wu was surprised: "You know Anna?"
Lin Fan said coldly: "Less talk, answer my question. Don’t try to lie; I’ll know. If I catch you lying, you’ll lose both ears."
Feeling a chill down his spine, Qian Wu was caught in a dilemma. He didn’t know who Lin Fan was or what he knew, and to save his ears, the safest bet was to tell the truth.
"She came for her father’s matter," Qian Wu said.
A surprised thought crossed Lin Fan’s mind. He recalled that night when Anna, drunk, mistook him for her father, holding his hand and saying, "Dad, don’t go."
At the time, Lin Fan was curious. However, Anna had been unwilling to talk.
Lin Fan asked: "What’s up with her father? Tell me the whole story from beginning to end."
Qian Wu replied: "Her father, An Jincheng, disappeared fifteen years ago..."
Fifteen years ago, An Jincheng disappeared.
Anna, left an orphan, was taken in as an adopted daughter by An Jincheng’s good friend, Feng Wanshan, who supported her through her education.
Anna was determined to find An Jincheng, and Feng Wanshan helped finance the search for his whereabouts.
Qian Wu was in charge of tracking down An Jincheng.
He also told Lin Fan about the meeting between the three of them today.
Lin Fan listened, pondered for a moment, and asked: "Why did you just call Anna?"
Qian Wu replied: "Years ago, when Feng Wanshan engaged me to trace An Jincheng, Anna knew about me. She privately found me, beat me up, and demanded that I inform her first whenever I had information."
Lin Fan broke out in a sweat; that sounded just like Anna. She did this to get firsthand information, probably because she feared Feng Wanshan would hide things from her.
Lin Fan asked: "Does Feng Wanshan know about this?"
Qian Wu said: "She warned me not to tell Feng Wanshan."
Lin Fan sneered: "Let me guess, you still told Feng Wanshan."
Qian Wu broke into a cold sweat: "Uh..."
Lin Fan said: "So, that old fox Feng Wanshan still controls the primary information. Is this news about An Jincheng true or false?"
Qian Wu, drenched in cold sweat, dared not answer.
Lin Fan said: "Speak, don’t waste my time."
Qian Wu gritted his teeth: "It’s false. It was Feng Wanshan who instructed me to tell Anna, but as for why, I don’t know."
That night, Feng Wanshan suddenly called Qian Wu, asking him to leak a piece of news about An Jincheng to Anna.
Qian Wu followed his instructions, deceiving Anna into thinking there was news about An Jincheng’s whereabouts.
Feng Wanshan then also informed Anna of the same lie, arranging a meeting at Shengshi Group today.
Qian Wu was unaware of Feng Wanshan’s purpose, but Lin Fan understood.
During the fight that night, Lin Fan attempted to drive a wedge between Feng Wanshan and Anna. Feng Wanshan suspected that Anna’s loyalties had shifted; this was his way to make Anna obediently counter Lin Fan.
You had to hand it to Feng Wanshan; he was deeply scheming. He navigated the situation without leaving any traces, arranging Anna’s actions thoroughly.
For her father’s sake, even if Anna genuinely had feelings for Lin Fan, she had no choice but to oppose him.
"Despicable," Lin Fan thought with some contempt for Feng Wanshan, using Anna’s father to pressure her, giving her false hope.
Lin Fan asked: "In reality, what’s the status of An Jincheng? Have you made any progress since you started investigating?"
Qian Wu shook his head with a bitter smile: "No, it was like he vanished into thin air. There’s no trace left, and back then, even the police failed to find anything, not even a single clue!"
Lin Fan mused: "So, telling you to investigate An Jincheng was merely a way for Feng Wanshan to dangle false hope in front of Anna."
Qian Wu replied: "You could say that."
Lin Fan’s voice turned cold: "Is An Jincheng still alive, or did Feng Wanshan kill him?"
Qian Wu was shocked: "I don’t know, isn’t that a bit too terrifying? Would Feng Wanshan be so fearsome, killing her father and then pretending to help find him? That would be devilish..."
Lin Fan continued to observe Qian Wu closely, employing top-tier insight, yet he found no signs that Qian Wu lied.
It seemed that Qian Wu indeed knew nothing about An Jincheng’s real situation.
Perhaps only Feng Wanshan knew.
Fifteen years ago, it’s possible that An Jincheng genuinely disappeared, never to be found again. He might be dead or even killed by Feng Wanshan.
These possibilities remain until proven otherwise.
Interest piqued, Lin Fan wanted to uncover what had happened to An Jincheng all those years ago. If he could help Anna find her father, winning her over would be straightforward.
"Our conversation remains secret between us. Don’t inform Feng Wanshan. You don’t know who I am, but I know who you are. If I find out you told Feng Wanshan, I’ll come for your life."
Lin Fan said nonchalantly, tapping Qian Wu’s crown.
Qian Wu immediately went limp, fainting.
A while later, when Qian Wu slowly regained consciousness, Lin Fan was long gone...

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Serial Cases Reoccur, Cooperative Investigation Solves the Case
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 194: Serial Cases Reoccur, Cooperative Investigation Solves the Case
The Rolls-Royce sped down the road, and Lin Fan frowned slightly.
Finding someone who mysteriously disappeared fifteen years ago, how could it be easy!
Although Lin Fan intended to help Anna, he had no idea where to start because his knowledge was limited.
He needed assistance.
The person Lin Fan thought of was Loli, Loli was a police officer and would surely be able to help him.
Lin Fan picked up his phone, intending to contact Loli and arrange a meeting.
But at this moment, a call came in; surprisingly, it was Loli calling. What a coincidence.
Lin Fan answered the phone.
Loli said, "Lin Fan, where are you now, are you free? You promised to help me solve a case!"
Lin Fan remembered that yesterday he did promise Loli to help her solve that serial killer case.
Lin Fan said, "Where are you, I’ll come find you?"
Loli said, "There’s been a third murder today, yet another leader of a charitable organization has been killed; I’m at the crime scene now, hurry over."
Loli gave an address.
Lin Fan then located the address and hurried over.
A secluded villa, with police lines already set up around it. Policemen were on guard, and the busy figures of police officers and forensic scientists could be seen.
Police cars, ambulances, and reporters’ cars were parked around.
A reporter was reporting live at the scene: "This afternoon, the head of the Wholeheartedly Charitable Organization, Li Chunjiao, was found dead in the villa’s hall. The police arrived at the scene immediately; we can see that the crime scene has been cordoned off. Our reporter tried to enter for an interview but was refused by the police. The police also refused to reveal details of the deceased, and it is unclear whether the same perpetrator is responsible as in the previous two cases. Earlier, two consecutive charity leaders were killed..."
Yet another leader of a charitable organization was killed!
The news report shocked Yun City.
For a while, people started discussing it.
"What the hell, what’s going on here?"
"Why is the killer targeting charity leaders, what kind of grudge do they have?"
"The police haven’t solved the case yet, those other leaders must be terrified."
"I heard the killer is very cunning, I wonder if the police can solve the case?"
Just as the whole city was abuzz.
A Rolls-Royce discreetly approached the villa.
Lin Fan, wearing a delivery uniform, got out of the car and approached the police line, where he was stopped by a police officer.
"What do you want? Didn’t you see the police line? You can’t go any further!" the officer shouted.
The officer was also puzzled, seeing Lin Fan step out of a Rolls-Royce, yet he dressed as a courier. Driving a Rolls-Royce to deliver packages?
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m here to meet someone; I have an appointment with Officer Loli."
The officer did not believe him, saying, "Do you know where this is, the crime scene? You’re meeting Captain Luo here?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes."
The officer sneered, "I think you’re causing trouble. Which media are you from, using such a lame excuse just to sneak in?"
Lin Fan felt a bit speechless: "I’m not a reporter, I really have an appointment with Loli, I’m here to help solve the case."
The officer scrutinized Lin Fan, his face turning stern: "Help solve the case? Who are you? I now severely doubt your identity, hand over your ID card!"
Lin Fan had no words.
At this moment, an excited voice came: "Lin Fan, you’re here!"
They saw Loli walking quickly over.
Lin Fan smiled, "Officer Sis, you came just in time."
The officer was surprised, "Captain Luo, he really is your guest?"
Loli said, "Of course, be polite. He’s here to help solve the case, let him through."
The officer quickly pulled up the police line to let Lin Fan in.
Loli smiled, "I was worried you wouldn’t come, come with me."
Therefore, Loli led Lin Fan into the villa.
The officer was stunned, extremely curious, who on earth is this guy? Luo, who always kept a cool distance from men, showed him such an admiring look and even invited him over for the case?
Lin Fan followed Loli into the villa.
On the floor of the hall lay a corpse, a middle-aged woman, slumped in a pool of blood, stabbed over a dozen times, almost every strike fatal.
The death was extremely tragic, hard to look at directly.
Forensic experts were already working at the scene.
Loli briefly introduced the situation to Lin Fan: "The deceased is Li Chunjiao, the head of the Wholeheartedly Charitable Organization. According to her assistant, she returned to the villa around noon today and then lost contact. The assistant arrived at the villa at 3 PM and discovered the body, then called the police. We arrived swiftly, and the deceased’s body was still warm; we estimated she died within an hour. The villa has surveillance, we checked it immediately, but found it was turned off. Upon checking, we learned the deceased ordered it turned off under duress from the killer, who then committed the crime and escaped. Lin Fan, should I have them leave so you can observe more easily?"
Lin Fan said, "No need, I’ll just take a look around."
Lin Fan’s eyes scanned the interior, and with the boost of top-notch insight, he began looking for clues.
Loli couldn’t really assist Lin Fan, so she could only wait for him to come up with results.
A dozen minutes later, Loli was getting a bit tired of waiting, and Lin Fan had already walked through the villa, returning to Loli’s side.
"Officer Sis, what have you guys found out these past couple of days, can you tell me?" Lin Fan asked.
Loli said, "What we know is limited. The killer is very cunning and didn’t leave any fingerprints. Comparing the knife wounds on the two victims, we found it was the same person, and the methods were very brutal. Lin Fan, did you find anything?"
Lin Fan said, "Regarding the surveillance, have you found anything?"
Loli said, "We checked it first thing; other areas’ surveillance was normal, but we reviewed the footage for half a day without finding anything suspicious. However, the camera in the living room was damaged, likely by the killer. As previously mentioned, the killer coerced the deceased to turn off the surveillance before committing the crime; the footage afterward is empty."
Lin Fan nodded, "What do you think?"
Loli said, "The killer is extremely cunning, sneaking into the villa while cleverly avoiding all cameras, using surveillance blind spots to hide, with first-rate counter-reconnaissance skills. I suspect the killer might have previously worked in a related field."
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan shook his head.
Loli was curious, "Am I wrong?"
Lin Fan said, "I just observed, and the villa’s surveillance layout is very tight; according to my calculations, the surveillance blind spots are zero. There’s no way to sneak in without being captured from any angle. Moreover, the design of this villa’s walls isn’t easy to climb over; I just walked around and confirmed where the killer entered. Officer Sis, follow me."
Lin Fan led Loli to a spot under a wall, where a tree grew outside the wall, its branches extending close to the top.
Lin Fan pointed, "The killer used this tree to jump onto the wall top, then into the compound. Look, when he jumped down, he left footprints on the grass, but he damaged the footprints himself."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Identifying the Culprit, A Bold Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 195: Identifying the Culprit, A Bold Decision
Loli took a look, and sure enough, as Lin Fan had said, there were obvious signs of destruction on the lawn.
Lin Fan then pointed to a nearby surveillance camera: "Check this camera, you should be able to see the killer."
Loli, surprised, said: "We’ve checked already, but there’s nothing!"
Lin Fan said: "You checked the wrong time, you need to go further back, look at the time frame between two and three a.m., there should be a surprise."
Loli excitedly said: "Alright, I’ll check right away."
So, Loli took Lin Fan to the monitoring room.
At this time, the police had not given up on checking the surveillance, but there were many cameras in the villa, and a long duration to cover. The workload was enormous, and so far, there were no results.
Loli instructed: "Bring up the surveillance from camera three in the northeast corner, starting from two a.m. last night."
This was exactly the camera Lin Fan had pointed out earlier.
The policeman responsible for checking the surveillance immediately followed suit.
It was like searching for a needle in a haystack, a massive workload, but Lin Fan had given a precise location.
"Found it!" the responsible policeman exclaimed in surprise.
In the surveillance, a man was seen jumping from a tree branch onto a wall, then into the villa. Afterwards, the man raised his head, facing the camera directly, then lowered his head and ran, quickly leaving the camera’s range.
Loli was utterly thrilled, finally having found the killer.
"Capture the suspect’s face and send it back to the station immediately, I need his identity!" Loli immediately instructed.
Now that they had the killer’s face, finding out the suspect’s identity only required facial recognition.
It seemed identifying the suspect posed no problem anymore.
Loli was very pleased: "Lin Fan, you’ve been a tremendous help this time!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "You’re welcome."
Loli curiously asked: "By the way, Lin Fan, how did you know to check between the hours of two and three?"
Lin Fan said: "I deduced it from the footprints that were destroyed. Those footprints have already dried and are not new ones. If you trace back, it roughly corresponds to that time."
Loli was amazed: "Lin Fan, you’re too awesome."
She knew Lin Fan’s observational skills were impressive, which was why she had invited him to help, but Lin Fan’s abilities had astonished her once again.
Loli suddenly thought of something and curiously asked: "But I’m still puzzled, the killer snuck in last night, why wait until today to commit the crime?"
Lin Fan said: "Well, if you check the deceased’s schedule, you might find the answer. I guess the deceased wasn’t home last night. The killer didn’t find the target, so he stayed hidden in the villa until noon today when the deceased returned. The killer found an opportunity to destroy the surveillance camera in the lobby, kidnapped the deceased, and had the deceased turn off all surveillance for an easy escape."
Loli wondered: "But the deceased already knew they were caught on last night’s camera, why bother with surveillance?"
Lin Fan said: "This is the cunning part of the deceased. The motive is twofold: one is to mislead the police into thinking he managed to evade all surveillance cleverly, the other is to buy time. If I’m not mistaken, the killer will accelerate his actions soon because he knows he’s exposed."
Loli was shocked: "He will keep committing crimes?"
Lin Fan said: "Yes, aside from the three charity organizations whose heads were killed, are there any other charity groups in Yun City?"
Loli said: "There are two more, initially one was One Heart, making three. After the first two incidents, we’ve strengthened monitoring and protection for these three heads. Unfortunately, Li Chunjiao didn’t care and refused police protection, resulting in an incident."
Lin Fan asked: "What about the other two?"
"One reportedly escaped from Yun City overnight to hide, and no one knows his whereabouts. The other is very scared and hired many bodyguards, urging us at the police station to assign him police protection," Loli said.
Lin Fan responded "Oh": "So, these two are hard to target. In that case, the killer might hide, even flee the city. It won’t be easy to catch him, he might even go elsewhere, choosing new targets."
Loli said: "Thus, the most important thing now is to find out this person’s identity."
Lin Fan shook his head: "Even if we know his identity, if he hides, it won’t be easy to find him. I do have an idea."
Later that day.
A piece of news was broadcast on Yun City TV Station’s evening news.
The chairman of Mortal Group, Lin Fan, has generously donated ten million to establish the Mortal Charity Fund to help those in need. Lin Fan personally takes charge and will attend the first fundraising event at Yida Square tomorrow morning.
This news, once released, caused a sensation across the city.
Lin Fan’s Celestial Aviation had just seen its stock price skyrocket today, its market value soared by hundreds of millions, causing a stir in the business world. Lin Fan’s name was already well-known.
No one expected Lin Fan to decide to donate ten million to charity in one day.
Moreover, in the context of charity organization heads being killed one after another, his courage is undeniably great.
"My goodness, ten million for charity, that’s truly impressive!"
"The company’s market value increased by hundreds of millions, he has plenty of money, ten million isn’t much for him now!"
"He’s so brave, doesn’t he know many charity heads have been killed recently? Yet he still dares to hold a public event?"
"Maybe he’s not afraid!"
People discussed fervently, some were amazed by Lin Fan’s wealth, others were moved by his bravery.
For a time, praises were endless.
Lin Fan also gave a reporter an interview.
Reporter: "Mr. Lin, why did you choose this time to establish the charity fund?"
Lin Fan said: "Actually, a few days ago at Mr. He Dahong’s charity event I announced this fund, but today is the official public announcement."
Reporter: "Recently, charity fund heads were killed successively, aren’t you afraid? Why do you still hold high-profile activities?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said: "There’s nothing to be afraid of. This event was scheduled long ago, and I see no need to postpone it. To me, this killer is nothing but trash, not worth fearing. But, I must admit, because of his brutal actions, Yun City’s charity industry is certainly affected, many might hesitate to do charity. This event of mine, let’s see it as encouragement."
Reporter: "Mr. Lin is so brave, but Mr. Lin, aren’t you afraid the killer might appear at the event?"
Lin Fan disdainfully said: "I’m not afraid! I said he’s nothing but trash in my eyes, he only dares to kill secretly, I hold events in broad daylight, he won’t dare come. Additionally, let me tell you, I have friends in the police, who told me they’ve got clues on the killer and will catch him soon, so I’m even less worried."
Reporter excitedly asked: "Is what Mr. Lin said true?"
Lin Fan said: "It’s true, completely true, so everyone relax, and feel free to come to Yida Square tomorrow for our fundraising event."
Reporter: "..."
While the TV station broadcasted Lin Fan’s conversation with the reporter.
In an urban village, within a rundown rental room.
A man sat on the bed, watching the news, his hands trembling in anger, staring at Lin Fan on the TV, his eyes radiating infinite murderous intent.
He was the man found on the villa’s surveillance!
Lin Fan’s words had completely enraged him.
And by this time, Lin Fan had already driven off for a date with Liu Mengjie. He chose to hold a high-profile fundraising event tomorrow to provoke the killer—this tactic was called luring the snake from its hole.
The killer knew he was already exposed, knew he was nearing a dead end, and was audaciously provoked by Lin Fan.
Tomorrow, there will surely be an exciting show to watch.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Dating Liu Mengjie and Encountering Another Weirdo
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 196: Dating Liu Mengjie and Encountering Another Weirdo
Lin Fan is hosting a donation event tomorrow, and this news has spread throughout the city via news reports.
Chu Yufei quickly found out as well and called Lin Fan immediately.
"Mr. Lin, our charity club is hosting an event tomorrow, why didn’t I know about it?" Chu Yufei exclaimed in surprise.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "I was just about to notify you. Can you help me arrange things? See if there are any issues?"
Chu Yufei said, "I can arrange personnel, the only issue is the venue — the venue needs to be booked in advance, and it’s too last-minute."
Lin Fan said, "The venue won’t be a problem, the police will help us coordinate it. You just need to arrange personnel to simply set up the event site."
Chu Yufei was surprised and asked, "The police? Mr. Lin, what exactly is this event for?"
Chu Yufei was quite curious; with a series of murders occurring recently, people in the charity were all on edge, but Lin Fan had boldly announced tomorrow’s event during an interview, even mocking the murderer — this was practically a provocation.
Initially, Chu Yufei thought Lin Fan was just overly confident, but now it seemed not that simple...
Lin Fan said, "You’ll find out tomorrow."
After ending the call, Lin Fan hurried to have lunch with Liu Mengjie, which was planned for today noon.
A high-end restaurant, parking lot in front.
A man in a suit was on the phone, looked up, and saw a Rolls-Royce Cullinan driving over and parking beside him.
The man’s eyes lit up and he blurted out, "Wow, a tycoon... No, just saw a luxury car, I wonder when I’ll be able to afford one..."
The man looked envious as he watched the door of the Rolls-Royce open, and Lin Fan, dressed plainly, stepped out, closed the door, pressed the lock, and inadvertently revealed a Rolex worth tens of thousands on his wrist.
The man sighed, "Nowadays, tycoons are into being down-to-earth? The world of the wealthy is incomprehensible."
Lin Fan was also on the phone with Liu Mengjie at this time and didn’t notice the man in the suit.
Upon learning that Liu Mengjie had arrived at the restaurant, Lin Fan headed straight into the restaurant.
Arrived at the restaurant’s entrance.
The waiter at the entrance stopped Lin Fan.
"Sir, may I ask what you’re here for?" the waiter asked.
Lin Fan replied, "This is a restaurant, right? I’m here to eat, unless I came to take a bath?"
The waiter glanced at Lin Fan, chuckled, "Sorry, sir, this is a high-end restaurant. Did you come to the wrong place? There’s a fast-food restaurant across the street, ten yuan for two meats and one veggie, you might want to check it out."
Lin Fan was exasperated and said, "I’m here to eat, is there a problem?"
The waiter chuckled, "Not blocking you, just a reminder to avoid embarrassment if you’re scared off by the menu prices later; we get customers like that every day."
Lin Fan said, "Do you think I can’t afford to eat here?"
The waiter surveyed Lin Fan, eyes full of disdain: "I don’t have to say more about that, you should know in your heart."
"What’s going on, what happened?"
At this moment, the man in the suit returned after finishing his call and noticed the waiter blocking Lin Fan.
As soon as the waiter saw the man in the suit, he became very respectful: "Manager, this person said he wants to dine inside, but he looks like he can’t afford it, so I advised him to leave..."
Slap!
Before the waiter could finish speaking, the man in the suit slapped the waiter’s face loudly.
Stunned the waiter.
"Manager..." the waiter covered his face, aggrieved and puzzled.
The man in the suit scolded, "Is this your service attitude? Hurry up and apologize to this gentleman!"
Though puzzled, the waiter rarely saw the manager this fierce and dared not dawdle.
"Sorry." The waiter bowed and apologized to Lin Fan.
The man in the suit then went over to Lin Fan, a big smile on his face, very respectful: "This is a temporary worker, unfamiliar with rules. Please forgive him, he’ll be fired immediately. Sir, you’re here to dine, right? This way, I’ll personally attend to you."
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled; this manager was so enthusiastic, completely opposite the waiter’s attitude.
The manager knew how to deal with people.
As the saying goes, one doesn’t hit someone who smiles. Lin Fan nodded, letting it go, and followed the manager inside.
He didn’t realize that the manager’s enthusiasm was entirely because he had witnessed Lin Fan getting out of the Rolls-Royce just now. Despite his plain attire, he was evidently a tycoon — how could the manager not be enthusiastic?
The waiter was about to cry; the manager said he’d be fired, and he realized he might have provoked someone he shouldn’t have — Lin Fan was certainly someone he shouldn’t provoke.
The manager personally led Lin Fan into the restaurant, his attitude warm: "Sir, are you dining alone or with someone? Do you have a reservation? Let me arrange a good seat for you..."
Lin Fan had already spotted Liu Mengjie and said casually, "I’ve arranged to meet someone. Please carry on."
With that said, he ignored the manager and walked straight to Liu Mengjie.
The manager quickly said, "Alright, sir, if you need anything, feel free to call."
Liu Mengjie was dressed in a red dress tonight, a change from her usual intellectual attire, and looked more charming. She had obviously prepared meticulously for this dinner.
It was not easy to have a meal with her crush, and since it was their first date, she valued it greatly and booked this high-end restaurant.
Seeing Lin Fan arrive, Liu Mengjie stood up to welcome him: "Little Fan is here."
Lin Fan was stunned by Liu Mengjie’s attire: "Sister Mengjie, you’re stunning tonight. Not saying you’re not beautiful normally, just tonight you’re exceptionally so."
Liu Mengjie felt a sweetness as if she’d eaten honey, and smiled: "You’re really sweet, have a seat, see what you like to eat. The food in this restaurant is good."
Lin Fan said, "I’m not particular about eating; Sister Mengjie, just order what you like."
Liu Mengjie laughed and said, "Then I won’t be polite. I’ll take charge."
Liu Mengjie quickly ordered and the two waited for the food while chatting.
Lin Fan was good at conversing, and the two talked and laughed, enjoying the atmosphere.
However, this pleasant atmosphere was soon disrupted.
From the side, a woman approached, whose appearance could only be described as plain, but she was dressed head-to-toe in high-end brands, wearing lipstick, looking quite wealthy, but somehow gave off a vulgar vibe — her branded attire looked full of tackiness.
Yet the High-End Lady herself was unaware, and proudly walked with a confident smile.
"Liu Mengjie!"
The High-End Lady pointed at Liu Mengjie with delight.
Liu Mengjie looked up, surveyed the woman, and recognized her: "Wang Ruhua! Is that you?"
The High-End Lady smiled: "Of course it’s me. Gosh, it’s been years since us old classmates met. I heard you’re now the principal of a music academy? You’ve really made something of yourself. Back in school, you were particularly hardworking, I knew you’d succeed."
The High-End Lady had nothing but praise for Liu Mengjie, after all, not everyone can become a principal. Being a principal of a music academy at a young age shows real capability.
Liu Mengjie modestly said, "It’s nothing, I’m just working hard, it’s quite tiring."
The High-End Lady blinked: "Don’t be modest. By the way, why don’t you ask how I’m doing now?"
As she spoke, the High-End Lady deliberately touched her gold necklace, and incidentally showed off the diamond ring on her finger, seemingly afraid Liu Mengjie wouldn’t see it.
Liu Mengjie found it amusing and suppressed her laughter: "I was just about to ask, how are you doing now? Where are you working?"
The High-End Lady was pleased: "I’m just an academic failure, can’t compare to you. After graduation, my family arranged a job at a small company, worked for two years and then quit. Lucky for me, I found a wealthy boyfriend, life’s decent now; whatever I want, I get. Look at my outfit, not much, just a few hundred thousand yuan."
It’s blatant showing off.
Liu Mengjie giggled and played along: "I’m so envious, Ruhua, found a good boyfriend."
The High-End Lady felt very satisfied, loving to show off and make others envy her.
"What about you, old classmate, are you only focused on work? Got a boyfriend yet? Who’s this..."
The High-End Lady seemed to just notice Lin Fan’s presence, glanced at him, and immediately showed disdain.
Clad in cheap attire!
Clearly not a wealthy person.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: No Choice But to Use Money to Slap the Face of the Gold-Digging High-End Lady
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 197: No Choice But to Use Money to Slap the Face of the Gold-Digging High-End Lady
Liu Mengjie laughed: "Let me introduce you, Wang Ruhua, my old classmate, Lin Fan, is my..."
Liu Mengjie wanted to say friend, after all, Lin Fan wasn’t her boyfriend, although she wished he was, but alas, he wasn’t.
The High-End Lady misunderstood: "Boyfriend?"
Liu Mengjie was dressed so beautifully, clearly like she was going on a date, no wonder the High-End Lady misunderstood.
Liu Mengjie blushed and was about to explain.
The High-End Lady’s eyes already showed disdain: "Old classmate, come on, let me be frank, you’re good at studying but your taste in men is quite bad, how could you pick someone like him?"
Liu Mengjie was stunned, the High-End Lady said this right in front of Lin Fan, which was so rude. How could her old classmate be like this?
Lin Fan calmly took a sip of tea: "Ms. Ruhua, why is her taste bad? I’d love to hear more."
The High-End Lady scoffed: "Does a poor loser dare to ask? Let me ask you, do you have a house? A car? Savings? Looking at your attire, none of those, right? Get lost, you poor loser, talking to you might make me catch a whiff of poverty. I say, my old classmate, you can’t just pick any man, it’s about your life’s happiness, just one word, money, with money comes happiness, look at me, I buy whatever I want, a man without money is useless, you aren’t planning on supporting this young charmer, are you? That would be foolish!"
The High-End Lady ranted on ridiculously, talking at length, then sat down next to Lin Fan, intending to give Liu Mengjie a good lecture.
Liu Mengjie listened and broke into a cold sweat.
Her old classmate was utterly belittling Lin Fan, completely offending him. One must know, firstly, Lin Fan wasn’t poor as she said, and secondly, Lin Fan was someone she cared about, how could she allow this kind of offense?
"Ruhua, I appreciate your kindness, but you misunderstood Little Fan. Besides, speaking this way is quite rude, so, why don’t you apologize to Little Fan, and then carry on, we still need to have our meal," Liu Mengjie said, clearly a bit upset.
She and Lin Fan were on a nice date, and the High-End Lady suddenly barged in, even saying such things about Lin Fan, truly ruining the mood.
The High-End Lady laughed: "Mengjie, why are you getting so worked up! Going against me for this young charmer, is it worth it! I’m doing this for your own good, a woman’s happiness has to be fought for, getting a wealthy boyfriend is the right path, throw away these poor young charmers quickly."
Now Liu Mengjie just wanted to quickly get rid of her, she said: "Actually, he’s not my boyfriend, he’s my coworker, we just happened to meet for a meal, Ruhua, you should go first, we’ll contact you when we can."
The High-End Lady froze for a moment, then burst out laughing, catching the attention of those around.
"Hahaha... Old classmate, you also think I’m right, don’t you? You don’t even dare to acknowledge your own boyfriend, how embarrassing, but it’s okay, you still have time, I hope you can dump him right away, then I’ll introduce you to some rich guy," the High-End Lady said laughing.
Liu Mengjie: "..."
She was speechless, the High-End Lady was completely self-centered, convinced Liu Mengjie picked a poor young charmer, with all sorts of ridicule and scorn, teaching her, Liu Mengjie, for a moment, didn’t know how to refute her.
"Ms. Ruhua, I disagree with your viewpoint," Lin Fan said at this time.
The High-End Lady glanced at Lin Fan, dismissively saying: "Poor loser, what do you want to say?"
Lin Fan said: "Happiness shouldn’t be measured by money. In this world, rich people are a minority, most people are just ordinary, getting by. If every woman worships money like you, the world would be in chaos. Luckily, in reality, many women look for men because of love, working hard with someone they love, such happiness is something you’re probably unable to experience as a gold-digger."
The High-End Lady spat: "To hell with you, I don’t care about experiencing the happiness you talk about, don’t mention these silly women to me, finding a rich boyfriend solves everything, no need to work hard."
Lin Fan said: "You can’t say that, you find a rich guy, can you guarantee he will be rich forever? When you’re old and he happens to be bankrupt, how will you maintain the relationship then? Without love, wouldn’t that be even more tragic? If there is love, even if one isn’t rich in old age, loving each other still means happiness."
The High-End Lady snorted: "You brat, cursing me? Don’t feed me your nonsense, I’d rather cry in a BMW than laugh on a bicycle!"
Lin Fan felt helpless, saying: "So in your eyes, wealth equals happiness, wearing brand names equals happiness, right?"
The High-End Lady said: "You’re right."
Lin Fan chuckled: "But you don’t look good in your brand name outfits, wearing a 30,000-dollar piece makes it look like it’s worth 30 dollars."
Upon hearing this, Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but burst into laughter, Lin Fan nailed it, that was exactly how she felt, she just didn’t dare to say it.
The High-End Lady’s face darkened: "What did you say? You poor loser, say it again!"
Lin Fan smiled: "If your ears aren’t deaf, you should’ve heard it clearly."
The High-End Lady was furious: "Poor loser! Do you dare mock me, do you even qualify? I wear a 30,000-dollar brand name, do you even have 30 bucks in your pocket? I bet you don’t even have 3 bucks!"
The words were full of contempt for Lin Fan, completely looking down on such poverty.
Lin Fan remained calm, saying: "I didn’t want to embarrass you, but since you’re asking for it, I can’t help it. What do you think my watch is worth?"
Lin Fan showed his wrist, revealing the Rolex.
The High-End Lady’s heart skipped a beat when she saw the Rolex, damn, am I seeing things, is this the Rolex Green Submariner?
This poor loser is actually wearing a tens of thousands worth Rolex?
Lin Fan said calmly: "I have about a hundred of such Rolex at home, not many, but enough to open a Rolex store."
He was telling the truth, he bought up a street worth of luxury goods’ inventory, including a Rolex store.
"Y-You’re bluffing!" The High-End Lady’s voice trembled a bit.
Lin Fan slightly smiled, took out the Rolls-Royce Cullinan keys: "What do you think my car is worth?"
The High-End Lady’s expression changed, Oh damn!
This is a Rolls-Royce!
An 8-million Cullinan!
Oh my, Lin Fan owns a Cullinan?
"Is this real, you-you have a Cullinan?" The High-End Lady asked in a trembling voice, her body involuntarily shaking.
At this moment.
A young woman came over, surprised: "Chairman, you’re here, what a coincidence!"
Lin Fan saw it was Zhao Jiayi, his personal secretary at Celestial Aviation.
Lin Fan smiled: "It really is a coincidence."
Zhao Jiayi handed over the Kosak keys to Lin Fan: "Chairman, you asked me to drive the car home today, I’ve done so, here are the keys."
"Okay." Lin Fan took the keys and placed them on the table, alongside the Cullinan keys.
Zhao Jiayi turned to the High-End Lady, curiously: "Cousin, do you know each other?"
The High-End Lady is Zhao Jiayi’s cousin!
Zhao Jiayi originally came to find her cousin, but unexpectedly bumped into Lin Fan, so she returned the keys in passing.
At this moment, the High-End Lady was already petrified.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: High-End Lady Turns Pale and Flees in Panic
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 198: High-End Lady Turns Pale and Flees in Panic
Looking at the car keys of the two luxury cars in front of her, the High-End Lady froze, realizing she had provoked someone she shouldn’t have. Her face gradually turned pale, and cold sweat dripped down.
"Cousin?"
Jiayi called out, waving her hand in front of the High-End Lady’s eyes, feeling puzzled. What’s wrong with her cousin? Why does she look like she’s been shocked?
To know her cousin found a rich boyfriend, she was so impressive, walking with a breeze, full of confidence, how could she be scared like this?
The High-End Lady trembled, "Jiayi, what did you just call him? Chairman? He’s your chairman?"
Zhao Jiayi said, "Yes."
After work today, she came out to have a meal with her cousin she hadn’t seen in a long time. Her cousin asked about her job, so she mentioned her new boss Lin Fan, astonishing her cousin.
After dinner, Zhao Jiayi went to pay the bill. When she came back, her cousin was gone, and she looked around, unexpectedly seeing Lin Fan sitting with her cousin.
The High-End Lady really wanted to find a hole to crawl into at this moment.
So embarrassing!
No place to hide.
Actually, when Lin Fan showcased the Rolex and Cullinan car keys, the High-End Lady was already hit hard. When Lin Fan’s identity as the chairman of Celestial Aviation was revealed, it was a critical blow.
Holy shit!
He’s actually Jiayi’s boss!
Celestial Aviation’s stock price soared today, with a market capitalization exceeding 60 billion!
As the boss of Celestial Aviation, Lin Fan holds a 60 billion listed company in his hands!
And just now, she actually called Lin Fan a poor, stinky brat!
If Lin Fan is called poor, then what does that make her!
In front of Lin Fan, her 30,000 in name-brand clothes suddenly lost their charm, really no different from 30 yuan cheap goods.
In contrast, even though Lin Fan dressed simply, the aura of being the chairman of a 60 billion listed company made him appear taller.
"Little Zhao, is this Ruhua your cousin?" Lin Fan asked with a slight smile.
"Yes," Zhao Jiayi replied cautiously, "Chairman, did my cousin say something wrong?"
Judging by the High-End Lady’s expression, Zhao Jiayi felt there was nothing good.
Lin Fan said, "It’s nothing, she called me poor, I just showed her what poor really means."
The High-End Lady blushed furiously.
Indeed, she realized how poor she was, in front of Lin Fan, she was a real pauper.
Zhao Jiayi felt cold sweat pour down, what, her cousin dared to call the chairman poor? Where did that confidence come from?
"Cousin, you can’t wear a bunch of name brands and think you’re on top of the world, there are always bigger fish! Chairman, sorry, my cousin momentarily lost sight, I’m apologizing on her behalf, hoping the chairman can forgive." Zhao Jiayi hurriedly apologized.
Her cousin offended the chairman, if she gets implicated, that wouldn’t be good. She still needs this job.
"Sorry, sorry..." The High-End Lady continuously apologized, not even daring to lift her eyes to look at Lin Fan, already frightened by Lin Fan’s status.
At this time, a waiter came to serve the dishes.
Lin Fan chuckled, "This isn’t your problem, we were about to eat. Little Zhao, have you eaten, why not sit down and join us?"
The chairman was obviously here on a date with a beauty, Zhao Jiayi quickly smiled and said, "No, we just ate, chairman, please enjoy your meal, we’ll head out."
Speaking, she quickly pulled the High-End Lady up and hurriedly fled.
Lin Fan smiled meaningfully, "Ruhua, let me give you some advice, don’t ruin name brands, those luxury brand companies might cry looking at you."
The High-End Lady staggered, almost falling but dared not make a sound, keeping her head down and running away. After learning Lin Fan’s identity, how could she dare to offend him? If Lin Fan so much as moved a finger, he might erase her existence.
Finally having sent off the High-End Lady, Liu Mengjie secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
"Little Fan, my old classmate is like that, always showing off. This time she finally ran into a brick wall and deserved it." Liu Mengjie said with a laugh.
The High-End Lady, really, who not to provoke, but Lin Fan. Isn’t that asking for trouble?
Lin Fan said, "Let’s not bother with her anymore, let’s eat."
The waiter placed a dish on the table.
Liu Mengjie smiled, "Yes, Little Fan, try this one, it’s really good."
Liu Mengjie actively served Lin Fan some food.
The two happily began their meal.
After eating, seeing the time was still early, Liu Mengjie suggested going out for a walk. Lin Fan agreed.
Liu Mengjie was very happy, paid the bill, and the two went out shopping.
In the evening, near a square by the restaurant, residents from surrounding communities came for walks, there were stalls, it was very lively.
The evening breeze blew gently, feeling very comfortable.
Liu Mengjie sneakily glanced at Lin Fan, feeling like she was dreaming. She was really on a date with Lin Fan!
What a wonderful evening.
From a corner of the square came singing; a girl was performing outdoors, surrounded by many onlookers, constantly attracting more people.
The girl looked ordinary, but she sang quite well, her voice was rather sweet.
"Little Fan, what do you think?" Liu Mengjie asked for Lin Fan’s opinion.
Lin Fan said, "She has innate talent in voice, her singing skill is a bit lacking, hasn’t had systematic learning, probably a self-taught music enthusiast, doing quite well for this level."
Liu Mengjie admired him, "That’s why you are who you are, seeing right through people at a glance."
Although the girl sang well enough to attract many passersby, it wasn’t at the level to attract the two of them. They were mostly passing by and commenting, about to move on.
At this moment, they heard the girl say, "Thanks everyone for coming tonight. To thank everyone for their support, I would like to invite a member of the audience to sing a song with me. Who wants to come up?"
A few in the audience raised their hands.
The girl was about to invite one of them up.
Suddenly, out came a brash shirtless man, boldly saying, "I’ll do it!"
The middle-aged uncle looked rather greasy and sleazy, shirtless, revealing a beer belly like a pregnant woman, with a face glowing red, looking like he recently had a drink.
Seeing this drunken middle-aged man, the singing girl felt a bit awkward, but with the surrounding audience egging her on, she was embarrassed to ask the drunken man to leave, so she handed the mic over.
The drunken man took the mic, grinning, and slyly grabbed the girl’s hand.
The girl got a big scare, immediately pulling her hand away, stepping back a few steps, and maintaining composure. "Uncle, what song do you want to sing?"
The drunken man laughed, "Singing with a beauty, of course, it’s a love song. I want to sing ’Experience Driver, Take Me’."
Upon hearing this, the surrounding crowd burst into laughter, some shouting loudly.
The girl’s face turned red, she didn’t want to sing that song with him.
The drunken man gave a wicked smile, "Come over here, I’m the experienced driver, I want to hug you while singing."
With that, the drunken man lunged at the girl, trying to embrace her.
The girl was startled, quickly dodging, "Uncle, don’t mess around, I’m canceling this duet, please step down!"
The drunken man wasn’t happy, "How can it be canceled? I don’t agree to canceling, come over, sing with me!"
The drunken man tried again to lunge at the girl.
The girl was really scared this time, screaming, quickly dodging.
The drunken man was about to continue bothering her.
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s figure blocked the drunken man’s path and snatched the mic out of his hand.
Lin Fan.
"Since you’re not interested in a proper duet, how about giving us a chance instead?" Lin Fan said with a chuckle.
Liu Mengjie walked up to the girl, smiled, "This man’s drunk. How about I sing with you? How does that sound?"
The girl felt like she was saved and immediately agreed, excitedly saying, "Yes, thank you, sister."
Lin Fan then handed the mic to Liu Mengjie.
The drunken man looked at Liu Mengjie, his eyes lighting up, grinning wickedly, "Big beauty, come over here."
With that, the drunken man lunged towards Liu Mengjie.
"Screw you!"
Lin Fan kicked the drunken man’s belly, sending him flying backwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Competing with Lin Fan for a Woman, Man with 10 Million Estate Woos
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 199: Competing with Lin Fan for a Woman, Man with 10 Million Estate Woos
The drunkard fell on his face, and the alcohol sobered him up. He was just causing trouble under the influence of alcohol, but now he was kicked to the ground, filled with anger and fury.
"You punk, just you wait!" The drunkard got up, cursing as he walked away. Lin Fan’s kick was too powerful, almost making him doubt his life. He didn’t dare to mess with Lin Fan alone.
Lin Fan didn’t take him seriously at all. He was just a drunken, sleazy uncle, a type not uncommon to Lin Fan. If he hadn’t encountered this situation, fine, but seeing the girl being harassed, Lin Fan naturally lent a helping hand.
The girl was very grateful and walked up to Lin Fan: "Thank you, big brother."
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "Just a small favor, no need to thank me. Go ahead and sing."
The girl happily said, "Okay."
Then, the girl and Liu Mengjie sang a song together.
Lin Fan watched from the side.
It was his first time hearing Liu Mengjie sing. As the head of a music academy, Liu Mengjie lived up to her title—her singing was excellent, her voice and skills on par with first-rate singers, completely outshining the busking girl.
As soon as Liu Mengjie started singing, she captivated the entire audience, even the girl was surprised—was this a professional singer?
When the song ended, applause thundered down.
The girl, full of admiration, said, "Sister, your singing is amazing. May I ask, are you a singer?"
She recognized many celebrities, but Liu Mengjie wasn’t one of them. However, her singing skills were superior to many of them.
Liu Mengjie laughed: "No, I’m just an ordinary person. Girl, can I make a request?"
The girl said, "Sure, what is it?"
Liu Mengjie said, "I’d like to invite my friend to sing a duet with me."
The girl laughed: "Of course, big brother, come over quickly."
Seeing that Liu Mengjie had named him, Lin Fan could only step up and take the microphone.
The two of them immediately sang a sweet love song together.
Liu Mengjie started first, and that wasn’t much since the audience had already heard her.
But when Lin Fan began singing, the entire venue fell silent. Everyone was instantly drawn to Lin Fan’s magnetic voice.
Inside everyone was a roar.
"Oh my God, isn’t this the voice of heaven!"
"Is this an Immortal singing?"
"How can a voice be so beautiful? I’m shocked!"
The busking girl was already stunned. She thought Liu Mengjie was impressive, but Lin Fan was even more so. She even felt Lin Fan sounded better than the Song God.
The busking girl searched hard but couldn’t find any singer that matched Lin Fan, although he seemed somewhat familiar, she couldn’t recall him at the moment.
Perhaps true masters really are hidden among the people. In such an ordinary square, they unexpectedly encountered an Immortal.
Meanwhile, a large number of passersby were attracted over from all directions, all drawn by Lin Fan’s heavenly singing. Lin Fan’s voice seemed to have a certain magic, which made them come over involuntarily.
Soon, the surroundings were packed with people, tightly crowded but everyone was very conscientiously quiet, listening to the song.
Because everyone was enchanted by Lin Fan’s singing.
Singing alongside Lin Fan, Liu Mengjie’s heart was sweet. She invited Lin Fan to sing together to satisfy a personal desire—she wanted to hear Lin Fan sing. Lin Fan did not let her down; it was so good, so good it brought tears.
As the proud head of a music academy, she couldn’t help but look at Lin Fan with adoration.
When the song ended, there was a thunderous round of applause and cheers all around.
"Encore!"
Someone shouted, and immediately it incited a chorus from everyone.
For the crowd, this was like a free world-class concert. How could it not be astonishing?
"Oh my, who are you two?" The busking girl knelt before Lin Fan, utterly convinced.
Liu Mengjie didn’t want to expose her identity, saying, "No, no, we’re just ordinary people. Girl, here’s your microphone back; we should be going."
They came over mainly to help the girl out of trouble; getting to sing a duet with Lin Fan was already satisfying for her.
With so many people around, it took a while for the two to squeeze out of the crowd. Lin Fan worried about Liu Mengjie being pushed away, so he naturally held her hand.
Liu Mengjie’s cheeks flushed, yet she didn’t pull away, feeling sweet inside.
Once they were outside the crowd, Lin Fan let go of Liu Mengjie’s hand.
"Little Fan, thank you for accompanying me tonight. I haven’t been on a date with a guy in a long time, and it was so much fun." Liu Mengjie smiled.
Lin Fan curiously asked, "With Sister Mengjie being so beautiful, there must be a lot of people pursuing you, right?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "Yes, but I don’t like any of them."
Lin Fan laughed, "Then what kind of guy does Sister Mengjie like?"
Liu Mengjie stole a glance at Lin Fan, her cheeks reddening, really wanting to say "someone like you," but too shy to say it out loud. She thought it was best for women to be a bit more reserved and subtle.
"Guess." Liu Mengjie teased, quickly walking ahead.
"How am I supposed to guess?" Lin Fan asked in confusion, following after her.
A little flower-selling girl came up with a basket of flowers, running in front of Lin Fan, cheerfully saying, "Brother, your girlfriend is really pretty. Why not buy a flower for her?"
Lin Fan clarified, "Um, sorry little sister, she’s not my girlfriend."
The little girl said incredulously, "I don’t believe it. Brother, you’re so handsome, and sister is so pretty. You must be a couple!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Such a sweet talker you are, little girl. Okay, I’ll buy a flower for this lady then."
The little girl was very happy, took out a rose: "One rose represents true devotion, just 9.9 yuan."
The little girl was quite experienced. Lin Fan felt as if he’d been tricked by a little girl, but didn’t mind and paid her.
"Thank you, big brother!" The little girl happily walked away.
"Sister Mengjie, this is for you." Lin Fan handed the rose to Liu Mengjie.
Liu Mengjie bit her lip, shyly saying, "I’m not even your girlfriend. Why are you giving me a rose?"
Lin Fan scratched his head: "Uh... should I just throw it away then?"
Liu Mengjie quickly took the rose: "No, can’t waste it if you bought it. I’ll graciously accept it then."
Suddenly, a man with slicked-back hair, dressed in fine clothes, came over holding a large bunch of roses and knelt on one knee in front of Liu Mengjie.
"Mengjie, I didn’t expect to meet you here. I just stopped that little girl and bought all the roses, 19 in total, for you. Now will you agree to be my girlfriend?" The man said expectantly.
Seeing the man, Liu Mengjie exclaimed: "Sun Liang, it’s you!"
The man said, "Yes, it is. You rejected my pursuit three years ago, but I’m back now, back with wealth. Meeting you here proves we’re truly destined."
Liu Mengjie was puzzled: "What do you mean, coming back with wealth?"
Sun Liang said, "Three years ago, after you refused me, I couldn’t figure it out for a long time. I’m handsome and have a good character; why would you refuse me?"
Suddenly!
Nearby, Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
At best, Sun Liang was not ugly, quite ordinary. Who gave him the confidence to think he was handsome?
Sun Liang glanced at Lin Fan but didn’t bother with him, continuing, "I thought long and hard and came up with only one reason—I was poor! So over these three years, I worked silently and finally outlived my dad. I’ve inherited his millions, now I’m finally rich. Surely you have no reason to refuse me now."
Lin Fan held back laughter, finding it challenging, as Sun Liang was undoubtedly amusing.
But Liu Mengjie was sweating: "Sun Liang, you’ve completely misunderstood. I’m not someone who despises the poor and loves the rich. I rejected you not because I thought you were poor, but because I felt we weren’t suitable."
Sun Liang was anxious: "In what way aren’t we suitable?"
Liu Mengjie said, "It’s hard to explain, but I just don’t like you. You should move on and find a girl worthy of your love."
Sun Liang said, "I only love you. Please say yes, or I’ll stay on my knees."
Liu Mengjie felt a bit embarrassed; Sun Liang was as persistent as ever—troublesome indeed.
Lin Fan couldn’t stand it: "Buddy, didn’t you see that Mengjie already accepted my rose? She’s my girlfriend now, give it a rest!"
"Really?"
Both Liu Mengjie and Sun Liang looked at Lin Fan simultaneously, one with joy, the other with surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: What did you just say? My savings are less than yours?
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 200: What did you just say? My savings are less than yours?
The scene was once awkward.
Liu Mengjie immediately realized that Lin Fan was trying to help her out of the situation, and her face turned red: "What I mean is, I’ve really accepted Little Fan."
Sun Liang looked at the rose in Liu Mengjie’s hand and said: "Mengjie, how can you accept him? He just gave you a single rose, that’s so stingy. Also, look at how he’s dressed; he’s clearly a pauper. I guess he drove an electric car here today, right? I, on the other hand, came in a BMW, which is much more dignified than an electric car. Don’t you think?"
Sun Liang encouraged Liu Mengjie to give up on Lin Fan and glanced contemptuously at Lin Fan.
Liu Mengjie didn’t answer because she really didn’t know how to respond to Sun Liang.
Lin Fan smiled: "Really, you came in a BMW? I don’t believe it, could you tell me where your BMW is?"
Sun Liang sneered: "It’s over there in the restaurant parking lot, kid. You know nothing about wealth; my tens of millions in assets are real!"
Right on point, Lin Fan said: "I still don’t believe it, why don’t you take us over to have a look? If your car truly is more expensive than mine, I’ll voluntarily withdraw from the competition. How does that sound?"
Sun Liang was delighted; Lin Fan was digging his own grave. With Lin Fan looking so shabby, he must be driving an electric car, definitely cheaper than his BMW.
Sun Liang stood up: "That’s what you said, don’t regret it. Let’s go!"
The three of them returned to the parking lot.
They arrived in front of a brand-new BMW.
Sun Liang proudly said: "This is my car."
Saying this, Sun Liang took out the key and lit up the BMW. Indeed, the BMW belonged to him.
"How about now, do you believe I have a BMW? I really inherited my dad’s tens of millions in assets!" Sun Liang said triumphantly.
Lin Fan nodded, smiling: "Looks like it’s true. Your BMW must be quite expensive, right?"
Sun Liang said: "Of course, my car cost 500 thousand upon landing, bought for the future family use, how could it be random? Mengjie, what do you say? Why don’t you sit in the passenger seat, it’s very comfortable. In the future, this seat will be exclusively yours."
Liu Mengjie waved her hand: "No need."
Sun Liang was frustrated, seriously sir, I’ve already shown my BMW, why isn’t she moved? Could it be she truly doesn’t love money!
"Mengjie, it seems you’re really not someone who despises poverty and loves wealth, otherwise you wouldn’t have chosen this pauper. Women like you are almost extinct in this world; I love you even more than before." Sun Liang said affectionately.
Liu Mengjie was about to cry: "Forget it, Sun Liang, please don’t love me more, tell me what you fancy about me, I’ll change!"
Sun Liang felt a bit defeated, on second thought, it must be because of Lin Fan. Though Lin Fan may look shabby, he had to admit, Lin Fan was younger and more handsome, Liu Mengjie must like his looks.
As long as Lin Fan withdraws, it will be fine.
Sun Liang stared at Lin Fan: "You’ve seen my car, now you can withdraw, right?"
Lin Fan blinked: "Why should I withdraw?"
Sun Liang said angrily: "Don’t play dumb, as agreed, if my car is more expensive than yours, you’ll withdraw from the competition."
Lin Fan said: "That’s indeed what was said, but how do you know your car is more expensive than mine?"
Sun Liang sneered: "By your look, you’re obviously driving an electric car. Could your electric car be more expensive than my BMW?"
Lin Fan shook his head and said: "I’m not driving an electric car, but this one."
Lin Fan pointed not far away to his Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
Sun Liang was stunned: "This latest model Cullinan, worth 8 million, is your car? I don’t believe it! You randomly pointed at a luxury car to fool me!"
"I have no choice now, but to show you."
Lin Fan was helpless, having to pull out the car key and press it towards the Rolls-Royce.
An unexpected thing happened.
No reaction!
Lin Fan pressed again, still no reaction!
Sun Liang saw and laughed, bending over with laughter: "You’re killing me with laughter, what are you bragging about, don’t you feel ashamed?"
Lin Fan frowned, glanced at the car key in his hand, and uttered: "Oops, wrong key."
He had taken the key of Kosak by mistake, quickly switched to the correct key, and pressed.
Beep!
The headlights of the Cullinan immediately lit up, emitting radiant light.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Got it right this time, had taken the Kosak key just now, no wonder there’s no response."
Sun Liang couldn’t laugh anymore, his smile instantly froze, replaced by shock.
Damn!
Lin Fan is truly the owner of this Cullinan!
Wait!
What, Lin Fan has a Kosak too? That’s a tens of million-level supercar!
"How could... how could this be, you’re clearly dressed like..." Sun Liang couldn’t believe it.
Turns out Lin Fan is a tycoon, a low-key tycoon dressed simply!
Lin Fan chuckled: "How about it, do you still think your car is more expensive than mine?"
Sun Liang’s face turned red, but he refused to concede: "Your car may be more expensive than mine, but I have more money than you. I have tens of millions in savings, do you?"
At this moment, a man in a suit ran over, bowing to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan looked, it was the manager from the restaurant earlier.
"Mr. Lin, it’s great to see you, earlier I heard from my coworkers, are you the chairman of Celestial Aviation?" the manager asked.
He had been sent away by Lin Fan earlier, got busy afterward, then happened to hear from coworkers that Lin Fan seemed to be the chairman of Celestial Aviation.
The manager was ecstatic, quickly came searching for Lin Fan, saw Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce still parked here, and came over to wait.
Lin Fan nodded: "I am."
The manager smiled: "Firstly, congratulations on Mr. Lin’s company market value exceeding 60 billion, this is it, my sister is now a flight attendant at Celestial Aviation, may I ask Mr. Lin to look after her. Oh yes, the meal tonight, I’ve told someone to cancel the bill, it’s on me, I’m treating both of you."
The manager took out the receipt and money, respectfully presented it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan uttered: "No need to cancel, I appreciate your sincerity. By the way, what’s your sister’s name?"
The manager said: "Li Jiaojiao, I’m called Li Dalong."
