Lin Fan nodded: "Li Jiaojiao, right, got it."
Li Dalong was delighted, even though Lin Fan didn’t accept the cancellation, his job was still done well, Lin Fan should have a good impression of his sister.
"Thank you, Mr. Lin." Li Dalong then happily walked away.
Lin Fan looked at Sun Liang: "What did you say earlier, my savings aren’t more than yours?"
Sun Liang: "..."
By this point, he was already stunned, his face turned ashen.
The conversation between Li Dalong and Lin Fan just now, he heard clearly.
Lin Fan is the chairman of Celestial Aviation?
How could he claim the chairman of a company with a market value of 60 billion has less savings than a mere inheritor of a million-dollar minor company?
Lin Fan chuckled: "Do you have anything else to say? If not, please go."
Sun Liang was deeply struck, looking at Liu Mengjie: "Mengjie, didn’t you say you weren’t someone who despises poverty and loves wealth? Why do you have such a wealthy boyfriend; this can’t be called not despising poverty and loving wealth?"

chapters.title: Chapter 201: 1 major accomplice approaches, a man with a $10 million fortune instantly loses courage
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 201: 1 major accomplice approaches, a man with a $10 million fortune instantly loses courage
Liu Mengjie gritted her teeth and said decisively, "That’s right, I am someone who despises the poor and loves the rich. I like Lin Fan, not you, because he’s richer, younger, and more handsome than you. What do you have to compare with him?"
Sun Liang’s face turned ashen, but his self-esteem was strong. Even near death, he wanted to grab a handful of sand: "I’m not as young, not as handsome, not as rich, but at least I’m stronger. I can protect you from bad guys. Can he?"
He hadn’t finished speaking.
"It’s him!"
Suddenly, a voice came, and a shirtless man, leading a group of people, charged towards them.
It was the drunkard who had previously harassed the singing girl in the square!
The drunkard was kicked over by Lin Fan, spoiling his plans, and he held a grudge. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became, so he gathered a group of people to seek revenge on Lin Fan.
Seeing this scene, Sun Liang was startled and exclaimed, "What’s going on?"
Lin Fan said, "These people are coming for Mengjie. Aren’t you strong? Why don’t you help Mengjie chase them away?"
Sun Liang was shocked, "Are you kidding me? There are so many of them. How could I possibly handle it alone?"
He chickened out, truly chickened out.
Lin Fan shook his head, "Looks like you’re going to lose everything, even your underwear."
Saying this, Lin Fan took a few steps forward to meet the gang.
The drunkard, seeing Lin Fan approaching, recalled the terrifying moment when Lin Fan kicked him and quickly shrank back, shouting, "Enough talk, everyone get him! Beat him up!"
The group then rushed in, surrounding Lin Fan, attempting to gang up on him.
Sun Liang immediately became a bit gleeful, "This guy wants to show off. Think about how he’ll be beaten like a pig, it makes me a bit excited."
Lin Fan then turned back and said, "Sun Liang, are you not coming to help? Don’t you want to protect Mengjie?"
Sun Liang laughed, "Didn’t she choose you? She has your protection, that’s enough. Guys, I have nothing to do with these two. Don’t come at me, okay? I’m just here to watch."
Liu Mengjie: "???"
She was really angry. They say tough times reveal true feelings, but this is ridiculous. Just a few bad guys, and Sun Liang chickened out, yet he claims he loves her?
Over there, the tough guys surrounded Lin Fan and tried to beat him up.
However, most of their punches missed, and even the few that hit Lin Fan did no damage. On the contrary, with Lin Fan’s counterattack,
all these aggressive men were lying on the ground in the blink of an eye, all of them writhing in pain and screaming.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Liu Mengjie was dumbfounded because she didn’t expect Lin Fan to be so fierce. Then Liu Mengjie looked starry-eyed. Little Fan was too amazing, so manly, so boyfriend-material.
Sun Liang was shocked and speechless.
The drunkard was scared pale. Damn, this guy is way too badass. His brothers were all taken down by him in the blink of an eye.
Lin Fan beckoned to the drunkard with a finger, "Come here."
The drunkard was trembling all over, "What, what do you want?"
"Come here!" Lin Fan’s face turned serious.
The drunkard shivered, not daring to resist, and timidly walked over to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan reached out and patted the drunkard on the shoulder, "After I say the word ’scram,’ you and your people better run as far as you can. If you dare to come again, I’ll twist your head off. Also, if I find out you’re still bothering that singing girl, I’ll twist your head off too. Understand?"
The drunkard, feeling half his body go numb from Lin Fan’s pat, was drenched in cold sweat. Damn, this guy is not even human. How could he be so strong? His grip was so powerful, he could probably twist his head off easily.
"Understood, understood." The drunkard quickly nodded.
"Scram."
The drunkard hurriedly pulled his men up from the ground, and they all helped each other out of there. Seeing them stumble and stagger, it seemed like it would take them at least a couple of weeks to recover.
Lin Fan walked back and looked at Sun Liang, "Man, that wasn’t cool. You said you were stronger and could protect Mengjie, but come crunch time, you chickened out?"
Sun Liang blushed red with embarrassment; this time, he had no excuse. He had indeed chickened out too much just now, he couldn’t deny it.
Moreover, he was truly intimidated by Lin Fan’s fearsome strength. Lin Fan was simply perfect, young, handsome, rich, and even formidable in fights.
Compared to Lin Fan, Sun Liang truly started to feel inferior from the bottom of his heart.
Liu Mengjie said coldly, "Sun Liang, do you understand now why I don’t like you?"
Sun Liang kept his head down, not daring to reply. He was already feeling utterly humiliated and quickly ran off to his BMW to leave.
From now on, he probably wouldn’t have the face to appear in front of Liu Mengjie again.
Seeing Sun Liang finally leave, Liu Mengjie breathed a sigh of relief. No matter what, as long as that guy didn’t pester her anymore, she could be at ease.
Lin Fan came up to her, "Not scared, are you?"
"Little Fan, I’m so glad you were here," Liu Mengjie said with a smile.
Lin Fan was really amazing. She still remembered the first time she met Lin Fan, it was when she encountered bad guys, and Lin Fan stepped in to help her drive them away. Tonight, Lin Fan fighting against ten people was just like Yip Man in the movies, so handsome.
In fact, she didn’t know that Lin Fan had taken the system-rewarded Strength Serum, making it a breeze to deal with ordinary people.
Lin Fan said, "No big deal. That Sun Liang probably won’t dare come again, right?"
Liu Mengjie nodded, "Yes, and I want to thank you more for that. I really didn’t expect him to show up tonight."
If Lin Fan hadn’t been there, she might have been harassed by him again. She didn’t like Sun Liang one bit.
Lin Fan said, "It’s all good now. Let’s go, I’ll take you home."
"Okay."
So, the two got into the Rolls-Royce and headed back to Lijing District.
After tonight’s date, Liu Mengjie liked Lin Fan even more. Her heart totally belonged to Lin Fan now; not even Sun Liang or anyone else could enter her heart again.
When they reached downstairs at her apartment.
"Little Fan, do you want to come up to my place for a cup of tea?" Liu Mengjie asked.
But Lin Fan was already thinking about Anna and casually replied, "It’s too late; maybe next time. I need to head back."
Liu Mengjie: "..."
Inside: No way, is he really that oblivious? Didn’t he get what I meant!
Or did he understand and just used this as a way to gently reject her?
Anyway, Liu Mengjie felt quite upset, "Alright, drive safe."
After saying that, Liu Mengjie got out of the car and quickly went into the building.
Watching her back, Lin Fan finally realized what Liu Mengjie had said earlier, and felt like he missed something.
Just then, a call came in, interrupting Lin Fan’s thoughts; it was Loli.
Lin Fan started the car while answering the phone.
"Officer Sis, what’s up?"
Loli said, "We’ve identified the suspect from the surveillance screenshots. His name is Wu Guicai, 30 years old. He applied for assistance from a charity last year when his daughter fell ill, but was denied due to failing to meet the criteria. As a result, his daughter died from lack of medical treatment, and his wife left him in grief."
Lin Fan responded, "So it seems he’s taking his daughter’s death out on the charity’s officials?"
Loli said, "Yes. He must have planned this for a long time. This happened last year, but he only started killing this year."
Lin Fan asked, "Can you find him?"
Loli answered, "We’re making every effort to capture him. Hopefully, we can catch him tonight. However, our clues are limited. We might still need to rely on your event tomorrow to lure him out."
Lin Fan said, "Sure, no problem. By the way, Officer Sis, after this is over, I’d like you to help me with something."
Loli was a bit thrilled; the guy she admired was asking for her help. She said, "What is it? Don’t worry, as long as it’s within my ability, consider it done."
Lin Fan said, "I’d like you to help me investigate someone named An Jincheng, who mysteriously disappeared 15 years ago..."

chapters.title: Chapter 202: New Reward, Commercial Building Worth 10 Billion
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 202: New Reward, Commercial Building Worth 10 Billion
It’s late at night, Liu Mengjie lies in bed, tossing and turning, reminiscing about tonight’s date with Lin Fan, such a beautiful memory, yet...
A trace of resentment appears in Liu Mengjie’s eyes. It’s all Little Fan’s fault for being too much of a straight man. She clearly hinted for him to come home, but he didn’t catch on. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be alone and sleepless now...
"Little darling, don’t you have any interest in me..." Liu Mengjie thinks softly.
Lin Fan is obviously interested in her; he was just a bit preoccupied with Anna at the time, missing a good opportunity.
On the way back to Yunding Manor, Lin Fan called Loli, asking her to investigate the case of An Jincheng’s disappearance.
Afterward, Lin Fan returned to Yunding Manor, where Anna, as usual, was still awake, waiting for him to return.
"When did you come back?" Lin Fan asked, pretending not to know. In fact, he saw Anna leave Shengshi Group this afternoon.
Anna replied, "Came back in the afternoon."
Lin Fan said, "Is everything taken care of? If you need help, you can ask me."
Anna replied, "Okay."
Of course, she couldn’t tell Lin Fan about her affairs; yet she didn’t know Lin Fan already knew and was helping her.
Afterwards, they said goodnight and each went to their rooms to sleep.
The next day.
Lin Fan just woke up in bed.
"Ding!"
"System reminder, today’s check-in can begin now. A commercial building will be rewarded upon check-in. Would you like to check-in now?"
The system’s voice fully awakened Lin Fan.
The system’s daily rewards are not fixed; sometimes they come in the afternoon, today, it came quite early.
An early morning surprise for Lin Fan.
A commercial building?
Great!
"Check-in!"
"Ding!"
"Check-in successful, reward is Yun City Commercial Center Zhou Tian Mansion, please take note."
Lin Fan immediately noticed an extra real estate certificate on the bedside table next to him. Picking it up, the certificate had his name, making him the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, the entire building, all the properties belonged to him.
Immediately.
"Ding!"
"Information on Zhou Tian Mansion has been fully collected, would you like to read it?"
"Read!"
A stream of information flowed into Lin Fan’s mind.
Zhou Tian Mansion, located in Yun City Commercial Center, a top-tier commercial building, 80 stories high, with a total height of 390 meters, one of the top three tallest buildings in Yun City, valued over ten billion, with annual rental income in the tens of millions.
Among the tenants are many well-known companies, including some Fortune 500 companies, such as HSBC, Volkswagen, Life Insurance...
They are now Lin Fan’s tenants, and Lin Fan is their landlord...
"Amazing."
Lin Fan couldn’t help but marvel at the surprises the system brings him daily. This time the reward is exceptionally great, directly gifting a commercial building!
This is even more impressive than a Tangchen Yipin.
"Ring ring ring..."
Lin Fan’s phone suddenly rang, it was an unfamiliar caller.
He answered the call.
On the other end was a strange male voice: "Mr. Lin, sorry to bother you early morning, my name is Mo Junliang, CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian Company, your subordinate, specifically calling to greet Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan had just read the information about Zhou Tian Mansion; this Mo Junliang is indeed the CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian Company.
Huaxia Zhou Tian Company was originally the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, its operator. Now Lin Fan has obtained Zhou Tian Mansion and concurrently owns Huaxia Zhou Tian Company.
Mo Junliang, as CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian, manages daily operations and reports to the chairman.
Currently, the chairman of Huaxia Zhou Tian is Lin Fan.
Mo Junliang, although he didn’t know how Lin Fan acquired Zhou Tian Mansion overnight, no matter the reason, Lin Fan is now his superior, so he wants to build a good relationship with Lin Fan as soon as possible.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Is it Mr. Mo? Hello."
Mo Junliang was startled, quickly said, "I wouldn’t dare, Chairman is too kind, you can call me Little Mo or Ah-Liang, my dad usually calls me that."
Mo Junliang, already over 50 years old, while Lin Fan is only 21...
Lin Fan was slightly sweaty: "Okay, since I’m younger, I’ll call you Brother Liang."
Mo Junliang dared not protest, nodding obediently. Even if the chairman called him ’son’, he would agree, considering he was the CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian, highly satisfied with this job, he wouldn’t want to lose it.
Building a good relationship with the chairman is his top priority.
"There will be a tenant meeting today; representatives of Zhou Tian Mansion’s tenants will attend. I plan to introduce you to the tenants during the meeting. Are you available to come by?" Mo Junliang asked cautiously.
Lin Fan made an ’oh’ sound: "What time?"
Mo Junliang said, "11 a.m., should I arrange for someone to pick you up?"
Lin Fan thought for a moment: "Shouldn’t be a problem, no need for pick-up, I’ll drive myself. You can meet me downstairs; I haven’t been to Zhou Tian Mansion yet."
Mo Junliang was shocked, no way, the chairman hasn’t been to Zhou Tian Mansion yet has become its owner!
So cool!
"Okay, then I’ll be at the entrance waiting for the chairman." Mo Junliang said respectfully.
He then hung up the call.
Lin Fan didn’t dwell much on it; after hanging up the call, he went to freshen up, preparing to head to Yida Square.
As Lin Fan was leaving, Princess Yu called.
"Mr. Lin, the donation event is being set up; it’s expected to be ready in an hour. We can start at around 9:30. Are you coming over now?" Princess Yu asked.
Lin Fan got into the Rolls-Royce: "Okay, I’m about to set off now."
9:30 a.m.
It’s also the stock market opening time.
As predicted yesterday, as soon as the market opened, Celestial Aviation’s stock prices started soaring.
Lin Fan’s mysterious identity as the scion of the Kyoto Lin Family became the strongest driving force.
Soon, Celestial Aviation stocks hit the limit!
Celestial Aviation’s market value surged another ten billion!
Total market value for Celestial Aviation is now 70 billion!
Two days, 20 billion market value skyrocketed!
This is simply a bomb, causing an explosion in the stock market. Major listed companies, securities companies, traders, shareholders... countless eyes are on Celestial Aviation, everyone is going crazy.
In the stock trading center.
People are kneeling all over.
A super bull stock is born!
At this rate, within days, a trillion-dollar group won’t be a dream!
While the stock market was in an uproar.
Lin Fan quietly looked at the Rolls-Royce, arriving at Yida Square, ready to attend today’s donation event.
This donation event had been covered by news reports yesterday, letting all of Yun City know, attracting lots of attention.
Many onlookers also gathered on site.
Lin Fan got out of the car and upon scanning the event site, he saw that a podium had already been set up.
Lin Fan expressed satisfaction with Princess Yu’s ability to organize; to gather people for an event in such short notice proved she indeed has the capacity for this.
"Mr. Lin, you’re here." Princess Yu approached with a charming smile.
Lin Fan said, "The site setup is decent; I’m assured leaving the charity to you in the future."
Princess Yu was very pleased to receive such praise.
Lin Fan added, "However, before announcing you as the head of Mortal Charity Association, one thing needs handling."
Curious Princess Yu asked, "What thing?"
Lin Fan said, "You’ll find out soon."
Then, as the founder of Mortal Charity Association, Lin Fan took the stage to give a speech.
While Lin Fan was speaking, a man wearing a mask quietly appeared on the scene, blending in the crowd, his eyes revealed a fierce look, staring at Lin Fan on stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Live Broadcast of Catching the Culprit
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 203: Live Broadcast of Catching the Culprit
Lin Fan had announced yesterday that he would be hosting a charity donation event today. This is the first public event since the establishment of the Mortal Charity Association, so it is very high-profile.
On the surface, Lin Fan seems to be trying to make the name of Mortal Charity Association known through this event.
But in reality, Lin Fan is clearly provoking the killer.
The background of this event is that the heads of three charity organizations have been killed, all charitable organizations have come to a halt, and are trying to lay low. The heads have either fled or are hiding.
Lin Fan, however, is openly active, high-profile announcing the establishment of the charity and, when asked by reporters, stated that he’s not afraid of the killer, not even considering the killer in his mind.
People had various reactions to this.
Some thought Lin Fan was too confident, even arrogant, and this could be somewhat dangerous.
Others admired Lin Fan’s courage and cheered for him.
This matter quickly became a hot topic, with television media even broadcasting it live, and the number of live viewers was quite large.
At nine-thirty in the morning, the event began, and Lin Fan took the stage to give a speech.
The site erupted into thunderous applause.
Comments in the live broadcast room also started flying.
"Wow, he’s so handsome!"
"And so young!"
"Tall, rich, and handsome little brother, I love him!"
"..."
Lin Fan then announced that he would invest 1 billion to establish the Mortal Charity Fund to help those in need.
"Awesome!"
"So wealthy!"
"Such a big spender!"
"Give me some, I really need money!"
The comments in the live broadcast room went wild.
Lin Fan subsequently said, "Our event today will accept on-site applications. Citizens in need at the venue can go to our staff to get an application form, register, and afterward, we will send someone to follow up. As long as approval is granted, we’ll directly transfer the money to you on the spot!"
"666"
"So straightforward!"
"This charity is interesting!"
"Some charities collect money under the guise of charity, but this one directly gives money, a tycoon is indeed a tycoon!"
"So amazing, I hereby declare Lin Fan as my male idol!"
After Lin Fan finished his speech.
Immediately there was a crowd of people rushing to the staff to get the application form.
This is the first segment of today’s event.
Lin Fan designed this segment precisely to deal with the killer, and Lin Fan’s gaze fell on the crowd of people getting application forms.
A masked man caught Lin Fan’s attention...
In less than half an hour, Lin Fan had collected quite a few application forms.
Lin Fan randomly picked up an application form, "Which one of you is Ms. Li Xiaojia, please come to the stage."
A girl came up on stage.
Lin Fan warmly shook hands with the girl and asked, "Li Xiaojia, I see on your application form that you’re an orphan, unable to go to university because you lack funds, is that correct?"
Li Xiaojia nodded, "Yes, my parents died in a car accident last month, and all savings were spent on the funeral. There is no source of income in the family, and I can’t even afford tuition fees. I initially wanted to borrow money, but relatives and friends avoided me like the plague. I saw yesterday that donations were available here, so I came to try."
Lin Fan said, "If your situation is true and you are indeed in financial difficulty, our Mortal Fund can help pay for your four years of university tuition, how do you feel about that?"
Li Xiaojia replied joyfully, "Really?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Certainly, as long as your situation is genuine."
Li Xiaojia said, "What I said is all true, no lies."’
Lin Fan said, "I understand, but we need to follow procedure, which means verification is required, this is a step all charities require. Once we verify your situation, we’ll transfer the money to you. Now, please follow our verifier over there for verification."
Li Xiaojia said worriedly, "Will the verification fail?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Don’t worry, as long as you’re truthful, you’ll definitely pass. But if you’re lying, then it’s a shame."
Watching their dialogue, among the crowd, the masked man seemed to be triggered by some memory, showing anger in his eyes.
"Verify, verify my ass, scammers, you’re all just showy con artists!" The masked man said venomously in a voice only he could hear.
He seemed to not believe Lin Fan was genuinely doing charity, only thinking Lin Fan was putting on a show.
Indeed, for businessmen, doing charity is a quick way to earn a good reputation.
Many wealthy people donate a little to be called philanthropists, but they do not genuinely care about charity, it’s as if they are buying a reputation with money.
After seeing off Li Xiaojia, Lin Fan then called up two more applicants successively, and without exception, he directed them to cooperate with the verifiers.
Only upon passing the verification can the charity money be claimed.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I will no longer call names. If anyone wishes to come up, please raise your hand voluntarily. Those who come on stage will be the first group to be verified and you will have a chance to receive our charity money first."
Once he said this, people eagerly raised their hands.
"Me!"
"Look at me!"
"Here!"
The crowd became noisy.
The masked man silently raised his hand, although he remained silent, he rushed to the front.
Lin Fan’s gaze swept over and fell on the masked man, seemingly casually saying, "It’s you then."
The masked man nodded and walked up to the stage.
Lin Fan smiled, "Brother, are you sick? Why are you wearing a mask? If possible, could you take off the mask?"
The masked man responded with an "oh", and quietly removed the mask.
Lin Fan had long recognized from his physique that he was Wu Guicai, the murderer of the three serial cases.
Lin Fan was waiting for this moment.
Meanwhile, the police had long been stationed at the event site; once Wu Guicai removed the mask, his face was immediately noticed by them.
"It’s him!" Loli exclaimed excitedly, immediately picking up the walkie-talkie, "All units pay attention, the suspect has appeared, take positions, prepare for capture!"
Her partner, Little Wang, asked, "Captain Luo, should we move in now to detain him?"
Loli kept her eyes on the monitor, "Wait a moment."
On stage, Lin Fan asked, "May I know your name, brother?"
Wu Guicai said, "Wu Guicai."
Lin Fan said, "Brother Wu, could you tell me what’s troubling you?"
Wu Guicai said coldly, "My daughter is ill with leukemia, no money to treat her."
Lin Fan said reassuringly, "No worries, our Mortal Charity Association can assist you, if the situation is genuine, we will immediately transfer money to you."
Wu Guicai sneered, "Really, immediately transfer money to me?"
Lin Fan said, "Absolutely, once verification is passed, we’ll immediately transfer the money to you. Considering your daughter’s condition, we’ll prioritize your verification and make sure her treatment is not delayed."
Wu Guicai let out a bitter laugh, "Good, sounds nice."
Lin Fan asked with a frown, "What does Mr. Wu mean by this?"
Wu Guicai’s emotions suddenly burst forth as he shouted, "Screw you, all you do is say nice things, all lies! Promised verification that gets delayed day by day, eventually telling me I failed, killing my daughter, isn’t this fooling someone?"
Wu Guicai suddenly snapped, scaring the people on site.
Even the live broadcast room was at a loss.
"What’s happening?"
"What’s happening?"
"What’s wrong with him?"
The comments were all questions.
Lin Fan pretended to be confused, "Brother Wu, do you mean you applied to another charity fund before? How’s your daughter now?"
This remark, although a bit cruel, hit the key point, causing Wu Guicai to lose control, his eyes shone fiercely, and he shouted, "She’s already dead, all because of you scam artists, I’m going to kill you all!"
Saying this, Wu Guicai suddenly pulled out a glittering knife from his waist!
Lin Fan chuckled, "So you are the serial killer, the heads of those three charity organizations were killed by you, right!"
Wu Guicai sneered coldly, "I killed them, and today I’m going to take you out too!"
What?
Wu Guicai is the serial killer?
Everyone was shocked.
The live broadcast room exploded.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Actually, I Bought It
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 204: Actually, I Bought It
The live stream exploded, with countless viewers flooding in, making it the focal point of Yun City.
"Damn, is this a live stream of catching a murderer?!"
"I heard the serial killer is here."
"Quick, join in the crowd!"
"I kinda feel sorry for this killer!"
The matter of Wu Guicai is indeed a tragedy. The charity he sought help from never processed his application, delaying his daughter’s treatment.
When his daughter’s condition worsened and required emergency treatment, the charity finally replied to Wu Guicai, stating that he did not meet the requirements and his application was denied.
Due to lack of money, the hospital refused to admit her, and his daughter ultimately died on the hospital bed.
Wu Guicai’s mental world collapsed then, but he appeared calm on the surface, quietly handling his daughter’s funeral.
Later, his wife, overtaken by grief, stated she could no longer be with him and left him a letter before leaving him.
Starting from that day, Wu Guicai began planning revenge.
He believed it was the charity that destroyed his family, branding them as swindlers. He wanted to kill the charity’s leader to avenge his daughter, but that would not calm his hatred. He wished to kill all those in charge of charities because, in his view, they were all the same damned liars.
Wu Guicai meticulously prepared for a year before finally acting on it.
The leaders of three charity organizations in a row died at the blade of his knife.
But while killing the third person, he realized he was exposed on the villa’s camera. Although he employed some methods to buy time, the police would soon figure out his identity.
He considered two options: one was to stop there and flee, the other was to speed up his revenge, aiming to kill as many as he could.
As he wavered in his decision, he saw the news interview with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan brazenly hosted a charity event and claimed to disconsider him, which evidently angered Wu Guicai.
Wu Guicai immediately decided to opt for the latter plan, and thus he came to the scene today. He knew very well that killing Lin Fan in broad daylight meant he couldn’t escape. Bearing the mindset of killing as many as he could, he wasn’t planning on leaving alive.
Under Lin Fan’s provocation, Wu Guicai finally revealed his knife.
The audience at the scene and the live stream viewers were all terrified by this scene.
"Oh my God, he’s the serial killer!"
"I said yesterday that I was worried he would come, and here he is!"
"That dude’s words yesterday were too provoking, it’s no wonder the killer is angry!"
"Run, dude, run!"
"Sigh, it’s not looking good..."
The comments were anxious.
After all, Lin Fan was now facing a heinous serial killer.
According to information disclosed by the police, this Wu Guicai belonged to a type of cathartic killer; his methods of killing the three charity leaders were extremely brutal.
At this moment, the nerves on the police side were also tense.
Lin Fan risked himself, luring out the killer, but now Lin Fan was too dangerous.
However, as the commander of this operation, Loli did not order action, still having the police on standby.
Everyone was quite frustrated, wondering what Captain Luo was waiting for.
Just when everyone was anxious.
Wu Guicai, holding the knife, advanced upon Lin Fan.
"Brother Wu, stop now. I sympathize with your situation, but murder is illegal. You’ve already killed three people, do you plan to kill me too?" said Lin Fan.
Wu Guicai, gritting his teeth, responded, "I wish I could kill all you swindlers, killing one is one less!"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t know about others, but I’m not a swindler. I indeed have put 1 billion into charity; we directly connect with those in need, without intermediaries earning a cut."
Wu Guicai cursed, "Swindlers! You only speak pretty words, but actually, you’re just bluffing people. Do you think I’ll believe you!"
Lin Fan said, "I’m telling the truth. Unfortunately, we were late; your beloved daughter didn’t wait for us, but we’ll take this as a lesson, preventing such instances like your daughter in the future, to genuinely help every person in need. I hope our Mortal Charity Fund can bring some solace to your daughter."
Lin Fan’s words could be considered deeply sincere and heartfelt.
Though furious before, after hearing this, Wu Guicai inexplicably began to calm down. Lin Fan’s words undoubtedly bestowed value upon his daughter’s death, making her death not in vain.
"Are you really not lying?" Wu Guicai asked, half doubtingly.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, if you kill me, the Mortal Charity Fund can’t continue. I believe your daughter was an angel; she wouldn’t want to see such things happen. Although she didn’t have this opportunity, she’d gladly see others have a chance to receive help."
Wu Guicai cried, "Yes, she was indeed kind, but why did she have to suffer this?"
Lin Fan said, "You’re a good father. I can see you love your daughter very much. I believe your daughter wouldn’t want to see you like this. Brother Wu, lay down the butcher’s knife."
Clang.
The knife in Wu Guicai’s hand fell to the ground.
Wu Guicai crouched down, holding his head and weeping painfully.
The scene and the live stream both fell silent.
What? Did Lin Fan just move the killer?
On the police side, Loli finally ordered, "Action!"
From all sides of the stage, ambushing officers acted, swiftly closing in on the stage.
Wu Guicai reacted, suddenly realizing the officers’ approach, and his emotions flared up again, "You called the police?!"
Lin Fan said, "You’ve killed three people, it’s normal for the police to catch you, right."
Wu Guicai shouted angrily, "This is your setup, you’re just acting, everything you said is fake, liar, damn liar!"
Wu Guicai grabbed the knife from the ground and lunged at Lin Fan.
"Ah!"
Everyone was taken aback.
This twist was too sudden, scaring everyone.
It’s over, why didn’t Lin Fan move slightly away earlier?
Then, Lin Fan raised his leg, kicking Wu Guicai’s wrist precisely, knocking the knife away.
Wu Guicai clutched his wrist, cold sweat streaming from the pain.
Despite Lin Fan using only a bit of force with that kick, Wu Guicai was already unable to stand it.
Right after, the officers had already rushed over and subdued Wu Guicai.
Seeing this, everyone was overjoyed.
"The guy is amazing."
"That kick was so cool!"
"No wonder he remained calm, turns out he had nothing to fear."
"We worried for nothing."
"Awesome!"
Comments in the live stream surged.
Wu Guicai, subdued by the police, was furiously turning back to curse at Lin Fan, saying, "Liar, you damn liar, everything you said was false!"
At this moment, Chu Yufei brought Li Xiaojia onto the stage, reporting to Lin Fan about the situation. After quick verification, Li Xiaojia’s situation was proven mostly true, and she presented evidence to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan announced on the spot, "After our review, Li’s situation is true, she’s indeed an orphan without income. We decided to sponsor her four years of tuition, with immediate payment."
Ping!
Li Xiaojia’s phone chimed with a notification.
Li Xiaojia checked her phone and exclaimed joyfully, "The donation is received!"
Thud!
Li Xiaojia then knelt before Lin Fan, with tears of gratitude, "Thank you, Mr. Lin, I can finally go to school!"
Witnessing this, Wu Guicai was dumbfounded. Was this real? The verification was too fast, and the transfer speed was too quick.
If the former charity had been this efficient, how could his daughter’s treatment have been delayed!
Lin Fan said, "Brother Wu, I told you, I wasn’t lying."
"..." Wu Guicai was speechless.
"Take him away!" Finally, Captain ordered, and Wu Guicai was taken away by the police.
Afterward, Lin Fan announced that the Mortal Charity Fund was officially established, with Chu Yufei in charge, assuring everyone that it’ll be managed wholeheartedly to help those in need more effectively.
The crowd started discussing.
Lin Fan stated, "Regarding the office space, I’ve already decided. We will be temporarily moving to the Zhou Tian Mansion."
Chu Yufei was taken aback, "The boss is just too generous, setting us up with such a prime office space, truly pulling out all the stops this time."
Lin Fan added with a smile, "Yes, actually, it’s just like this, I just bought the Zhou Tian Mansion today."
What?
Silence.
The scene and the live stream became completely silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: With some spare money, just buy a building for fun
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 205: With some spare money, just buy a building for fun
Lin Fan casually mentioned that he had already bought Zhou Tian Mansion.
As soon as he said this, everyone was stunned.
Buying Zhou Tian Mansion, well that’s Zhou Tian Mansion, one of the tallest commercial buildings in Yun City!
Lin Fan’s tone of buying it was as if he was buying a cabbage.
After a brief moment of being stunned.
The livestream chat exploded.
"???"
"Did he say he bought it?"
"Bought... it?"
"I think he said he bought Zhou Tian Mansion."
"666"
"Awesome!"
"Whoa, he’s insanely rich!"
"So wealthy, no wonder he casually donated 10 billion to charity!"
"Wow, his 10 billion is probably like our 10 yuan."
"Respect!"
Comments surged at a rate of 99+ per second.
Shengshi Group.
Feng Wanshan was also watching the livestream, and jumped up: "What the hell, this guy bought Zhou Tian Mansion!"
"This kid is too damn annoying!"
Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth; Lin Fan was so rich, rich enough to make him insanely jealous.
Yun Chu Group.
The patriarch of the Chu Family, Chu Yufei’s father Chu Haotian, fixed his gaze sharply, looking deeply at Lin Fan on the screen.
This person is the new boss of Princess Yu. Throwing 10 billion into charity was already enough to make people look up to him, and now he even bought Zhou Tian Mansion — such a grand gesture!
Moreover, many other giants in Yun City’s business world were shocked when they heard this news.
My God, Lin Fan bought Zhou Tian Mansion!
This mansion is worth billions!
Although Lin Fan’s Mortal Group market value soared 20 billion over the past two days, the ability to spend 10 billion to buy Zhou Tian Mansion is unprecedented.
Lin Fan never expected that his casual comment would silently spread and shock the business community of Yun City.
On site.
Chu Yufei was also dumbfounded upon hearing Lin Fan bought Zhou Tian Mansion: "Boss, what do you mean, did you buy an office suite or... the entire Zhou Tian Mansion?"
If he bought just an office suite, given Lin Fan’s wealth, it wouldn’t be too surprising.
Lin Fan said casually: "The whole Zhou Tian Mansion, you can check it out whenever you have time, feel free to choose any vacant office."
"..."
Chu Yufei was petrified.
Lin Fan is too lavish, what kind of existence is he, a super rich man?
"Boss, you really bought Zhou Tian Mansion, what kind of divine-level investment is this?" Chu Yufei was so excited, she was a bit incoherent.
Even though she is the young lady of the Chu Family in Yun City and accustomed to wealthy people, she was still shocked by Lin Fan’s extravagance.
Lin Fan said: "Nah, I just had some idle money, decided to buy a mansion for fun."
Everyone: "..."
Awesome!
This is what you call showing off!
"Buy a mansion to play with..."
"666..."
"I don’t understand the world of the rich!"
"Is this really the life of a rich man!"
"I give this show-off 100 points!"
"Brother Fan is awesome!"
The livestream chat continued to explode.
After Lin Fan announced that the head of the charity was Chu Yufei, the livestream ended shortly after, and so did the event.
This time, Lin Fan killed two birds with one stone: first, he successfully lured out the culprit of a serial case, and second, he took the opportunity to make the Mortal Charity Fund famous and earned some reputation.
People inadvertently learned about Lin Fan’s extravagant move to buy Zhou Tian Mansion, which further fueled the excitement.
The name of the rich Lin Fan began to be known by a wide audience.
Of course, with more attention, there inevitably came some unfriendly glances...
Like Feng Wanshan.
Upon learning that Lin Fan bought Zhou Tian Mansion, he was almost driven mad with jealousy.
During this period, Lin Fan’s continuous purchases, his immense wealth made people so envious they’d spit blood.
Lin Fan, although unaware of how many envious, jealous, and hateful eyes his casual words attracted, wouldn’t mind even if he knew.
Not provoking jealousy makes one mediocre!
The system’s task for Lin Fan was to create a trillion-dollar group, and the rise of such a group could not possibly go unnoticed!
If his strength prevented him from being low-key, then he would just keep moving forward boldly.
Leaving Chu Yufei to wrap up the event, Lin Fan planned to leave, as he had to go to Zhou Tian Mansion for a tenant meeting.
As Lin Fan was about to get in the car to leave, Loli came over.
Loli first thanked: "Thanks to you this time, your idea was great, and it helped us successfully capture Wu Guicai."
This event was a setup orchestrated by Lin Fan and the police to lure Wu Guicai, who actually fell into the trap.
Loli’s face was full of admiration, she just thought her male idol was so powerful, she was completely conquered by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled faintly: "I just had an improvisation, thought of this method of luring out the snake, plus I had a personal agenda, I wanted to take this chance to promote my charity fund."
Loli said: "Doing charity is good, if everyone had your kind of personal agenda, it would be great."
Lin Fan said: "Better not praise me, I fear I might become arrogant. Officer sister, you wouldn’t come to me just to thank me, would you?"
Loli laughed: "Really nothing escapes you, let’s talk in the car."
The two got in the car.
Loli said: "Here, this is the file on An Jincheng’s case, I found it for you."
Loli handed a case file to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan joyfully took the file and began flipping through it.
Loli said: "I’ve read through this file detailing An Jincheng’s disappearance case, everything is here, but I couldn’t find any clues, you help take a look."
Lin Fan nodded and continued to go through the file.
Just like that, Lin Fan carefully read through the file, pieced together testimonies from various parties after the incident, and a story took shape.
An Jincheng, a teacher with a very ordinary identity.
years ago, one day, he left home as usual to go to school for class, but he never arrived at school, and never returned home.
He just vanished into thin air.
No one knows where he went.
years ago, streets didn’t even have surveillance cameras, there’s no place to start investigating.
The police, through interviews, found everyone An Jincheng knew, with testimonies making a thick stack, yet no trace of An Jincheng was found.
Later, this case became a mystery.
It remains unsolved after many years.
Lin Fan finished the last page and closed the file.
"How about it, did you find anything?" Loli asked, "I’ve just received a task from the bureau to review old cases, I plan to start with this case."
Lin Fan said: "An Jincheng’s daughter, Anna, mentioned in her testimony that, for several days before An Jincheng disappeared, his state was anxious, why was that?"
Loli said: "I was curious about this too, so I specifically asked the veteran Officer Old Deng, who was in charge of this case back then, and learned that they didn’t know the reason either. Anna was very young at the time, in her memory, she just felt her usually loving father had become somewhat irritable. If An Jincheng really encountered some trouble, he probably wouldn’t have confided in a child."
Lin Fan nodded: "I noticed someone, it’s Zheng Yang, a teacher who was An Jincheng’s colleague at the time. His testimony mentioned that a few days before An Jincheng’s disappearance, they went to eat at a street stall, Officer Deng asked him if An Jincheng had said anything during the meal, and he said no. But from his testimony, I feel he might have lied, why not find this Zheng Yang and ask again."
Loli was a bit surprised, quickly flipped to Zheng Yang’s testimony and read it, puzzled: "I didn’t see anything wrong, you detected possible lying from Zheng Yang’s testimony?"
Too incredible!
Lin Fan said: "Yes."
He has top-notch insight, such a flaw in the testimony couldn’t escape his insight, although Zheng Yang fooled even the police, he couldn’t fool him.
Loli was amazed. If this Zheng Yang really had issues, Lin Fan’s insight was simply comparable to Sherlock Holmes.
"Okay, I’ll go find this Zheng Yang." Loli said.
Lin Fan reminded: "It’s better to conduct this investigation secretly, I’m worried someone else is watching this case, don’t let anyone know you’re investigating."
Loli nodded: "Got it."
Then, Loli got off the car, said farewell to Lin Fan, and returned to the police station.
Lin Fan was about to drive to Zhou Tian Mansion when he suddenly received a call from Wang Xiangqian.
"Brother Fan, where are you now? Can I borrow your Rolls-Royce for a while? I have a date with a goddess at noon, you know." Wang Xiangqian said.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat, Wang Xiangqian wanted to borrow his car to show off.
"Sure, come to my rented apartment and get the car." Lin Fan said, giving Wang Xiangqian a call.
Afterward, Lin Fan drove the car back to the vicinity of his rented apartment and handed the car over to Wang Xiangqian.
Without a car, Lin Fan just had to ride his electric scooter to Zhou Tian Mansion.
Upon arriving at Zhou Tian Mansion, unsurprisingly, Lin Fan was immediately stopped by the security guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Not Evoking Jealousy Means Mediocrity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 206: Not Evoking Jealousy Means Mediocrity!
Yida Square.
The livestream had concluded, and Chu Yufei was busy tidying up the scene with her team.
A black Mercedes S-Class arrived, stopping nearby. A middle-aged driver stepped out, opened the rear door, and a middle-aged man emerged from the car.
The middle-aged man glanced around, saw Chu Yufei, and walked toward her.
"Feifei." the middle-aged man called out.
Chu Yufei turned her head and was surprised: "Daddy, why are you here?"
The middle-aged man was indeed her father, Chu Haotian, the head of Yun Chu Group and the Patriarch of the Chu Family in Yun City.
"I saw your livestream, so I came over to see you," Chu Haotian smiled.
Chu Yufei seemed to be annoyed by something: "Daddy, if you’re here to persuade me to quit, then forget about it."
Chu Haotian had always disapproved of her career choice, wanting her to return to Yun Chu Group to help manage the family business, but Chu Yufei was rebellious and didn’t listen to him.
Chu Haotian said, "Don’t misunderstand, I’m not here to persuade you to come home this time, I’m here for your boss."
Chu Yufei paused, slightly surprised: "Mr. Lin? Daddy, why are you looking for Mr. Lin? You’re not asking him to fire me, are you?"
Chu Haotian smiled, "Don’t worry, I just greatly admire Lin Fan. Where is he, can you introduce me?"
Chu Yufei understood, it turned out that Chu Haotian wanted to use her connection to meet Lin Fan!
As the head of Yun Chu Group, Chu Haotian was a prominent figure in Yun City, usually receiving attention from others, yet this time, he actively sought to meet Lin Fan.
Mr. Lin is indeed impressive.
Chu Yufei asked, "Daddy, may I ask what your purpose is for meeting Mr. Lin?"
Chu Haotian chuckled, "How much do you know about this Mr. Lin?"
Chu Yufei replied, "I met him a few days ago at He Dahong’s party. That night, he announced a ten-billion charity investment, so I approached him for a collaboration. As for other things, I’m not very familiar, nor do I need to be."
Chu Haotian replied, "From what I know, he became the chairman of Celestial Aviation yesterday, and on the same day, Celestial Aviation’s market value skyrocketed by ten billion. Today, Celestial Aviation’s stock price opened with a surge and is now at the limit; its market value has increased by another ten billion. Besides, as mentioned in today’s livestream, he acquired Zhou Tian Mansion for a hundred billion."
Chu Yufei was stunned; she really didn’t know Lin Fan was so formidable. In addition to acquiring Zhou Tian Mansion, he also acquired Celestial Aviation?
Chu Haotian said, "There’s a rumor he’s the son of the Kyoto Lin Family, and this possibility is quite high."
Chu Yufei was astounded, "What, the Kyoto Lin Family?"
The Kyoto Lin Family, a family of monumental influence!
If Lin Fan really belongs to the Kyoto Lin Family, his identity would be quite impressive.
Chu Haotian said, "Now you understand why I want to meet him. If he truly is from the Kyoto Lin Family, forming an alliance with him would immensely benefit Yun Chu Group in the future. Even if he isn’t part of the Kyoto Lin Family, given his extravagant behavior, he must be a tycoon, and becoming friends with him wouldn’t have any drawbacks."
Chu Haotian’s plan was pretty shrewd.
Chu Yufei coldly replied, "I get it, this time you’re not opposing my charity work because of Mr. Lin."
Chu Haotian didn’t actually support her passion; he only allowed her to stay in the Mortal Charity Fund because he wanted to establish a connection with Lin Fan. Wasn’t he just using her?
Chu Haotian awkwardly smiled, "Feifei, Daddy was wrong in pressuring you before, and I will reflect on my actions. Regarding Mr. Lin, I hope you can facilitate an introduction."
Chu Yufei coldly said, "We’ll see, I have to get busy and can’t talk further. Do as you please."
Chu Yufei walked away.
However, Chu Haotian began to smile. He knew this daughter well; she was cold outside but warm inside, and she would definitely help because, after all, he was her father.
Thinking about the chance to meet Lin Fan soon put Chu Haotian at ease.
In Yun City’s business circles, there were quite a few people like Chu Haotian who wanted to connect with Lin Fan.
Yet, as the saying goes, absence of envy signifies mediocrity; similarly, many viewed Lin Fan with hostility, perceiving him as a threat.
Feng Wanshan topped that list.
Shengshi Group, chairman’s office.
Feng Wanshan sat in his chair, listening to his trusted subordinate’s report.
"Chairman, today in the charity event, Lin Fan revealed the acquisition of Zhou Tian Mansion for a hundred billion. Following this news, Celestial Aviation stocks continued their surge and are now at the limit, with another ten billion increase to its market value. Celestial Aviation’s current market value reaches seven hundred billion Huaxia Coins," the subordinate reported.
Feng Wanshan jumped up, gritting his teeth, "Damn it..."
If this continues, Mortal Group’s market value might soon surpass one trillion, approaching Shengshi Group.
In Yun City, the three trillion-dollar conglomerates are Yida Group, Zhongtong Group, and Shengshi Group, with market values of 1.8 trillion, 1.5 trillion, and 1.3 trillion respectively.
Lin Fan’s Mortal Group naturally had some distance from these three giants, but at this pace, catching up with Shengshi Group was only a six hundred billion gap away.
Feng Wanshan felt an unprecedented sense of crisis.
"Lin Fan’s identity is mysterious. Rumor has it he is the son of the Kyoto Lin Family, although some channels suggest the Lin Family has denied this. However, it seems ineffective, as it only makes people believe more in Lin Fan being of the Lin Family, which is also the reason for the surge in Celestial Aviation stocks today," the subordinate analyzed.
Feng Wanshan sneered, "Kyoto Lin Family? He’s nothing from there!"
The subordinate curiously asked, "Chairman, do you know his real identity?"
Feng Wanshan didn’t respond, just waved him off, "Go gather them for a meeting."
The subordinate responded, "Alright." and left.
Feng Wanshan then picked up his phone and called Anna, "Are you free to talk?"
Anna replied, "Go ahead."
Feng Wanshan asked, "What have you found out about Lin Beixuan?"
Anna said, "I’ve been observing Lin Fan’s actions recently but haven’t noticed any contact with Lin Beixuan."
Feng Wanshan suddenly got excited, "I need to know Lin Beixuan’s identity; so many days have passed without progress, what are you doing?"
Anna coldly replied, "I was injured that night by Muay Thai Li San, and I’m recuperating at Yunding Manor."
Feng Wanshan offered not a single word of concern, immediately demanding results. This upset Anna since she was his adopted daughter.
This was unlike Feng Wanshan’s past behavior; previously, he showed great care and affection towards her as his adopted daughter.
Feng Wanshan, upon hearing this, said nothing comforting, only, "Find out quickly. I’ve spent five million helping you trace your father’s whereabouts, so don’t let me down. That’s it!"
Feng Wanshan hung up the phone.
Soon afterward, his subordinate knocked and entered, bringing in several more people, all trusted aides of Feng Wanshan.
"Come and sit down, let’s discuss how to deal with Mortal Group. I want Mortal’s stock price to fall!" Feng Wanshan’s eyes showed a menacing look.
Yunding Manor.
After the call was abruptly ended, Anna tossed the phone aside in frustration.
Although her godfather’s attitude annoyed her, she also felt pressure. Regarding her father’s whereabouts, her godfather had always helped without seeking credit, and yet now he used this matter to pressure her for the first time!
All for dealing with Lin Fan!
Indeed, she owed her godfather a lot. The funds Feng Wanshan spent to find her father were far beyond five million.
Anna frowned, sinking into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: I am Your CEO’s Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 207: I am Your CEO’s Boss
Shengshi Group, Chairman’s Office.
Feng Wanshan gathered a group of trusted aides to discuss how to launch an attack on Mortal Group, to curb the upward trend of its stock price, or even make it plummet.
After some discussions.
One subordinate suggested that the key was to target Lin Fan. As long as Lin Fan’s reputation was ruined, regardless of whether he was from the Kyoto Lin Family or not, Mortal Group’s stock price would inevitably fall.
Feng Wanshan glanced at this subordinate, whose name was Xu Yiwen. Wearing glasses and appearing scholarly, he was one of his think tanks.
Feng Wanshan pursued further: "That guy just generously donated a billion to charity and assisted the police in capturing a serial killer, greatly boosting his reputation. Trying to ruin him might not be so easy."
Xu Yiwen smiled wickedly: "That’s not difficult. We just need to create a scandal. Coincidentally, I know a flight attendant at Celestial Aviation. I can spend some money to bribe her. If she can successfully falsely accuse Lin Fan of harassment..."
Xu Yiwen didn’t finish, assuming everyone understood his meaning.
Feng Wanshan was stunned for a moment and couldn’t help but laugh heartily, patting Xu Yiwen on the shoulder: "Old Xu, you’re quite something. You look innocent, but you’re so malicious. I like it!"
Xu Yiwen chuckled: "Chairman, then..."
Feng Wanshan nodded: "Carry it out as you see fit. As long as you can ruin Lin Fan’s reputation, money isn’t an issue!"
Xu Yiwen said: "Alright, I’ll get it arranged immediately."
Feng Wanshan thought of something and asked: "Does the flight attendant you know happen to know you’re with Shengshi Group?"
He didn’t want this matter eventually linked to Shengshi Group.
Xu Yiwen said: "Rest assured, we only met on the plane. I happen to know she’s currently in need of money."
Following that, Xu Yiwen went to contact the flight attendant from Celestial Aviation, preparing a vicious plan against Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was naturally oblivious to this.
He had lent his Rolls-Royce to Wang Xiangqian, so he drove an electric scooter to Zhou Tian Mansion to attend the tenant meeting.
Yun City, in the bustling commercial center, filled with high-rise buildings.
Among them, one building was particularly striking, with a unique architectural style that felt quite sci-fi, soaring over three hundred meters high, reaching 80 floors. In occasionally misty weather, it even seemed to pierce the sky.
This is one of the three tallest buildings in Yun City, Zhou Tian Mansion.
In this area, everyone is tailored in suits, with luxury cars visible everywhere.
Yet at this moment, Lin Fan drove up on a somewhat worn-out electric scooter to the front of the building.
Whether the shabby electric scooter or Lin Fan’s cheap stall-bought attire, they clashed with the money-driven atmosphere around him.
Lin Fan parked his vehicle, glanced at his Rolex, noting the agreed time as 11:00 AM, with just a minute to spare.
Lin Fan walked over, just approaching the building’s entrance when a security guard stopped him.
"What are you doing?" The tall, intimidating security guard harshly questioned, suspicion evident in his eyes.
He had noticed Lin Fan arriving in the rickety vehicle, clearly not one of the employees here. What kind of place was this? A premium commercial skyscraper; A-grade office space, upscale hotels, exclusive clubs, and headquarters to Fortune Global 500 companies!
Even the janitors here dressed more lavishly than Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled: "I’m here to see Mo Junliang, CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian."
"Mo..." The security guard’s demeanor changed, "You’re looking for President Mo?"
Mo Junliang, the CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian, an eminent figure in Yun City’s real estate sector, respected across the company for his strict leadership. Just hearing his name shook people to their cores.
The security guard instantly became a bit cautious: "May I ask who you are?"
Lin Fan replied: "I am the superior of your CEO."
Regardless of how capable Mo Junliang was, he was nothing more than the CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian, merely one of Lin Fan’s subordinates.
"What?" The security guard immediately grew furious, "I think you’re looking for trouble, daring to offend our President Mo!"
He had been a bit careful earlier, but hearing Lin Fan’s words, he was certain Lin Fan was causing trouble. Who did this audacious bum think he was, daring to take liberties with President Mo? Unthinkable!
Lin Fan said: "Call him out to meet me, and you’ll know if it’s true."
Lin Fan felt puzzled; it was already 11:00 AM, and Mo Junliang had agreed to meet him at the entrance. If Mo Junliang had appeared on time, he wouldn’t be troubled by a mere security guard.
The security guard roared: "Look into the mirror, can you really be President Mo’s superior? What a thing to come to my territory and act wild. Get out quickly, or else I won’t be polite!"
As he spoke, the security guard had already withdrawn his baton, prepared to drive Lin Fan away at any moment.
This audacious bum spewed nonsense, and if President Mo heard of it, he might hold the guard accountable. He absolutely couldn’t let Lin Fan get anywhere near President Mo.
Lin Fan felt speechless: "Fine, I’ll call him myself."
The security guard sneered: "Go ahead, keep pretending. I’ve seen all sorts of people. I’ve encountered plenty of nuts like you. I’ll count to three, and if you’re not gone, I’ll really hit you!"
The security guard pointed his baton at Lin Fan, ready to count.
"What’s going on?"
Suddenly, a voice rang out from behind, familiar enough to startle the security guard, changing his expression drastically.
A middle-aged man dressed in a tailored suit emerged briskly from the mansion, his head a bit bald, resembling a hot-tempered math teacher.
Huaxia Zhou Tian’s CEO, Mo Junliang.
"Pres... President!" The security guard, upon seeing Mo Junliang, started trembling slightly, his aura of authority and demeanor were overwhelmingly intimidating.
The security guard quickly explained: "President Mo, this person came to stir up trouble, I was just about to drive him away. Don’t worry, President Mo, I won’t let him near you."
"Put down the baton and get lost," Mo Junliang angrily retorted, walking directly to Lin Fan, immediately with a conciliatory smile, "I’m sorry, Mr. Lin, I should have personally come out to greet you earlier. I’m sorry for the delay due to a small matter, please forgive me."
He recognized Lin Fan at first glance, with Lin Fan’s attire not affecting him at all. Even if Lin Fan was dressed like a beggar, as long as he held the title of Zhou Tian’s Chairman, Mo Junliang would bow respectfully.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "It’s alright."
The security guard beside was already speechless, realizing he might have made a big mistake, dripping with cold sweat.
The security guard hurriedly explained: "President Mo, he just said he was your superior, but I didn’t believe him, so..."
Mo Junliang scolded: "Foolish imp, not only is he my superior, but he’s also the property owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, the highest authority here!"
"What?" The security guard was drenched in cold sweat.
The Chairman of Huaxia Zhou Tian was actually this scruffy-looking bum?
The security guard felt his world had turned upside down.
Mo Junliang glared at the security guard: "You dared offend the Chairman, apologize quickly, or do you not want this job?"
This was a sign of being laid off, the security guard, terrified, knowing this security company’s pay was high, twice that of other places, with countless people vying for it. He had fought hard to secure this job and didn’t want to lose it.
Thud!
The security guard knelt before Lin Fan, tears streaming, "I’m sorry, please forgive my ignorance, Mr. Chairman, I apologize sincerely. Please spare me, I have a large family to support, and cannot lose this job."
"Mr. Chairman, this person is at your disposal." Mo Junliang said.
Lin Fan didn’t bother with a security guard and replied calmly: "Forget it, he is just doing his job. Innocence due to ignorance."
The security guard rejoiced, grateful to tears: "Thank you for your clemency, Mr. Chairman."
Lin Fan ignored him and said to Mo Junliang: "Let’s go up."
"Yes, this way, Mr. Chairman." Mo Junliang respectfully led Lin Fan, entering the mansion.
Watching this scene, the security guard felt despondent. Zhou Tian Mansion’s Chairman dressed so down-to-earth, he dared not be rude to anyone again in his life; someone dressed in cheap stall items could very well be a big shot he couldn’t afford to provoke...
Heng’an Mansion’s top floor, a spacious and luxurious office, looking through the floor-to-ceiling windows, the stunning view of a bustling metropolis lay in full view.
The office of Huaxia Zhou Tian’s Chairman!
Lin Fan’s office.
Lin Fan stood by the window, gazing at the view outside, his heart filled with awe—this was quite impressive.
Mo Junliang served beside him, smiling awkwardly: "Mr. Chairman, this building includes upscale clubs, luxury hotels, Fortune 500 companies. All these tenants are now in the lobby meeting room, awaiting your arrival."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Elite Man Shows Off in Front of Lin Fan, Hits a Snag
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 208: The Elite Man Shows Off in Front of Lin Fan, Hits a Snag
Zhou Tian Mansion Conference Hall.
Today is the Tenant Meeting, every company in Zhou Tian Mansion has to send a representative, usually either the owner or the regional head, who are all business elites.
After all, the rent at Zhou Tian Mansion is not cheap, and there are restrictions on companies moving in. Generally, those who can enter Zhou Tian Mansion are powerful, large companies, even Fortune 500 companies.
The elites of these Fortune 500 companies all appear quite confident.
The tenant meeting is also an opportunity for these elites to network.
At this time, the elites gather in the conference hall, chatting in small groups.
And what they talked about the most was about Zhou Tian Mansion.
"Have you heard, Zhou Tian Mansion has changed hands!"
"No way, where did you hear that?"
"I don’t know either, I just got back from the United States today, just got off the plane."
"Then who is the new owner of Zhou Tian Mansion?"
"I heard it’s a young man named Lin Fan."
"Lin Fan? Never heard of him, is he really that impressive?"
As everyone discussed, Mo Junliang entered with Lin Fan.
Mo Junliang is the CEO of Huaxia Zhou Tian, responsible for the daily management of Zhou Tian Mansion, and everyone working there knows Mo Junliang.
Immediately, everyone went up to say hello and flattered him endlessly.
As for Lin Fan, no one knew him.
Seeing Lin Fan dressed in street vendor clothes, they thought he was a handyman brought by Mo Junliang.
"President Mo, I just reported to your staff that the air conditioner here is a bit broken, it’s really hot, is this the repairman? Please have him fix it quickly, you, go check out what’s wrong with the air conditioner!"
A young elite in a branded suit said, pointing at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan glanced at him indifferently and said nothing.
Mo Junliang originally smiled and exchanged pleasantries with everyone.
Upon hearing this, his expression changed.
Damn!
You’re really asking for it, this guy!
Mo Junliang quickly denied, "No."
The elite young man said, "Oh, is that so, then please have President Mo find someone to fix it, I just came back from a business trip in Iceland, you know, it’s very cold there, and I’m still not quite used to it here."
This show-off...
Mo Junliang chuckled, "I’ll find someone to repair it soon. The meeting is about to start. If you’re uncomfortable, you can leave and let someone else attend in your place."
The young elite could naturally sense that Mo Junliang was a bit unhappy and quickly smiled apologetically, "No problem, actually, it’s not that hot."
Mo Junliang ignored the young elite, turned to Lin Fan, bowed, and respectfully said, "Mr. Lin, this way please."
Lin Fan nodded and followed Mo Junliang onto the podium.
Seeing this, everyone around was stunned. What was going on, Mo Junliang actually showed such respect to a young man dressed so poorly!
This young man seems to have an unusual identity.
At once, everyone involuntarily quieted down, and their eyes fell on Lin Fan.
The elite young man who had just spoken to Lin Fan realized he might have offended someone and his expression changed.
Mo Junliang invited Lin Fan onto the podium and introduced him in public, "Everyone, before today’s meeting, I would like to formally introduce someone, Mr. Lin Fan, our new chairman of Huaxia Zhou Tian and the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion."
What?
The entire audience was stunned, everyone was shocked.
No way, this young man dressed in clothes from the street is the new owner of Zhou Tian Mansion?
Everyone was internally shouting in disbelief.
"No way, he’s too young!"
"Did I hear that right?"
"What’s going on?"
They are all elites, usually they wouldn’t even glance at someone dressed like Lin Fan, as elites, they feel superior.
When someone they deem shabby suddenly has a status completely out of their reach, they naturally feel very shocked and confused.
The elite young man from earlier was now as pale as a sheet, sweating profusely, damn, he just asked the new owner of Zhou Tian Mansion to fix the air conditioner?
Seeing their expressions, Lin Fan’s eyes held some amusement. These so-called elites usually judge people by their clothes, but too bad they encountered Lin Fan, for them, Lin Fan is their nemesis.
Mo Junliang respectfully said, "Mr. Lin, would you like to say a few words to everyone?"
Lin Fan nodded and said, "Hello everyone, I’m Lin Fan, I just bought Zhou Tian Mansion for ten billion today, and I’m lucky to become your landlord. However, Brother Liang will still be handling the specific operations of Zhou Tian Mansion, and I ask everyone to cooperate with Brother Liang in the future, that’s all."
A short speech, in a calm tone, as if talking about something very ordinary.
Yet everyone present was floored.
He bought Zhou Tian Mansion for ten billion, my god, he’s so wealthy!
How can someone be so rich!
Such a wealthy person dresses so down-to-earth, while these so-called elites dress extravagantly but can’t match up to Lin Fan at all.
Ahead bowed down automatically.
Some elites couldn’t help but blush, feeling ashamed in front of Lin Fan.
After Lin Fan finished speaking, he walked down from the podium and handed the meeting over to Mo Junliang.
Immediately, the elites from various companies came up to ingratiate themselves with Lin Fan, in front of Zhou Tian Mansion’s new owner identity, they all automatically ignored Lin Fan’s attire, which became completely irrelevant.
"Hello Mr. Lin, I am Jack, the president of HSBC’s Great Huaxia Region."
"Hello Mr. Lin, I am Li Yishan, the vice president of Volkswagen."
"Hello Mr. Lin, I am the Huaxia District head of Neon Country’s Songxia Group, nice to meet you."
"..."
Everyone introduced themselves, trying to shake hands with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan exchanged pleasantries with them.
"Mr. Lin, you are truly young and handsome, although I heard that Zhou Tian Mansion changed hands, I never imagined the new owner is so young."
"Mr. Lin is also especially approachable and grounded, nowadays the true tycoons prefer low-key, luxurious, meaningful style."
"Mr. Lin is truly a role model for the younger generation."
Flatteries kept coming from everyone.
The attire they once frowned upon has now become their words of praise.
Lin Fan found it somewhat amusing internally, these compliments, they’re just for listening. These people, whether they spew elegance or garbage, it all depends on who they’re facing, no need to take it seriously.
"Hello Mr. Lin, I am He Jinsheng, the marketing manager of Danmai International Company, I was very offensive just now, please don’t mind, Mr. Lin."
The elite young man who had asked Lin Fan to fix the air conditioner earlier finally found a chance to approach Lin Fan, with an apologetic smile on his face.
Inside, he was very uneasy.
If you offend the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, it’s really a piece of cake for them to mess with you, after all, they’re the landlord.
Lin Fan chuckled, "It’s fine, the air conditioner here malfunctioning is indeed our Zhou Tian’s responsibility, asking me to fix it is only natural."
He Jinsheng broke out in cold sweat, hurriedly smiling apologetically, "I had eyes but failed to see, it’s completely my fault, Mr. Lin, you’re overdoing it, actually, it’s just because I’m a bit unaccustomed after just returning to the country, it has nothing to do with the air conditioner."
He actually just wanted to show off a bit, letting people know he’d just returned from Iceland, not expecting to hit a wall.
Lin Fan said, "Seems like you’re very accustomed to Iceland’s climate, should I talk to your boss, so you can be stationed in Iceland permanently?"
He Jinsheng was shocked, he was only using "having been to Iceland" to show off, in reality, he was nearly frozen in Iceland and eagerly wanted to return home every day. Once bitten, twice shy, he didn’t want to go again, let alone reside there permanently, that would be killing him!
Thud.
In his fright, He Jinsheng directly knelt in front of Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: What’s wrong with the courier, does he deserve to be treated unfairly like this?
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 209: What’s wrong with the courier, does he deserve to be treated unfairly like this?
"Mr. Lin, please have mercy, you absolutely can’t do this. I don’t want to go to Iceland again; I’ve had enough of the cold there." He Jinsheng almost cried, pleading.
Seeing this, the people around couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
This He Jinsheng tried to act superior earlier, now he’s totally embarrassed himself.
Mr. Lin is incredible, specializes in dealing with such pretentious types.
What elite, in front of Lin Fan, aren’t they just going to kneel.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised. He mentioned sending He Jinsheng to Iceland as a joke, he didn’t even know He Jinsheng’s boss, how could he possibly suggest it to his boss.
Unexpectedly, his casual joke scared He Jinsheng so much that he knelt down, making Lin Fan feel both amused and helpless.
"Alright, I was just saying casually." Lin Fan replied blandly, "Everyone, please be seated; let’s continue the meeting."
After speaking, Lin Fan ignored He Jinsheng, found an empty seat nearby, and sat down.
Lin Fan spoke, and everyone quieted down, starting the meeting.
He Jinsheng felt relieved, grateful that he didn’t have to be stationed in Iceland, terrified; he really regretted it, knowing Lin Fan’s identity, he wouldn’t have offended Lin Fan, wishing he could give himself two big slaps.
In the following time, Mo Junliang chaired the tenant meeting.
After the tenant meeting ended, it was already an hour later, just in time to go for lunch.
Lin Fan returned to the chairman’s office, and Mo Junliang respectfully asked, "Chairman, are you hungry? There’s a Junyue Restaurant on the third floor; their manager Mr. Qian just begged me to make sure you go for a meal."
Knowing Lin Fan is the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion property, the tenants here all tried to please Lin Fan as much as possible, and for the Junyue Restaurant, it was relatively simple, just invite Lin Fan for a meal.
Lin Fan oh-ed, just about to answer when he suddenly received a phone call from Zhao Jiayi, his personal secretary at Celestial Aviation.
"No problem, Brother Liang, you go down first, I’ll take a call and come down later." Lin Fan said.
Mo Junliang replied, "Alright, I’ll go down to wait for Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan waved his hand and answered Zhao Jiayi’s call.
"Chairman, there’s an important meeting at three in the afternoon; the company needs you to attend. Are you available?"
Lin Fan replied, "No problem, I’ll head back."
Zhao Jiayi: "Chairman... there’s one more thing..."
Zhao Jiayi seemed hesitant, appearing shy.
Lin Fan asked, "What is it?"
Zhao Jiayi said, "About last night’s issue... it’s my cousin’s fault, Chairman, would you blame me?"
She worried about this the whole night.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh that, I don’t even remember it; you don’t need to worry."
Zhao Jiayi was delighted, "Thank you, Chairman, see you this afternoon."
Happily hung up the phone.
Lin Fan smiled helplessly; those of lower status always fear offending people, living cautiously and sometimes even humbly, it’s their trouble; but people of high status like Lin Fan also have troubles, such as being too revered, everyone bows and flatters you, they might not sincerely respect you, might just fear your power, which is actually quite boring, making it hard to make genuine friends.
So Lin Fan was often willing to hide his identity to receive others’ honest attitudes, whether good or bad.
Just like He Jinsheng, someone who loves to act superior, someone who points fingers at those beneath, if Lin Fan had revealed his identity early on, he wouldn’t see his true self.
Lin Fan smiled, put away his phone, left the company, and took an elevator to the third floor for lunch.
The elevator stopped on the 50th floor, and a courier came in.
Lin Fan saw this courier with a somewhat swollen face, looked like someone just hit him, the courier seemed down, head down, almost holding back tears.
"Little Meng?" Lin Fan called, recognizing this courier as his colleague at the same station.
Little Meng raised his head, saw Lin Fan, and exclaimed happily, "Brother Fan!"
Lin Fan smiled, "What a coincidence, are you responsible for delivering parcels here?"
Little Meng replied, "Yes, Brother Fan, why are you here, not wearing a courier uniform, not working today?"
Lin Fan did not want to explain too much, casually saying, "I’m here for some business. By the way, Little Meng, what’s with your face?"
Little Meng touched his swollen face, feeling somewhat aggrieved, sighed, "What else, encountered a demanding customer, got slapped for being a minute late, we dare not do anything to her, just had to swallow it, Brother Fan, you might not know, this kind of thing happens all the time in our line."
Lin Fan said, "Trust me, I know well."
When he was poor, he worked as a food delivery rider, suffered grievances every day, too many weird customers.
While saying this, he casually stopped the elevator.
Little Meng curiously asked, "Brother Fan, what are you doing..."
Lin Fan said, "Take me up to see, why must couriers suffer such grievances? If she’s wrong, this grievance need not be endured."
Little Meng hesitated, "Brother Fan, forget it, it’s not the first time this kind of thing happened, just endure... what if..."
He worried it might affect his job.
Lin Fan is rich; working as a courier is just for life experience, does not care about offending anyone; but unlike him, he must rely on this job to support his family, cannot lose it.
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, I’ve got it covered, if she wants to complain, I’ll talk to the boss lady."
Little Meng knew Sister Feng treated Lin Fan well, wanted to worship him like a lord.
With Lin Fan’s assurance, Little Meng felt at ease, agreed to take Lin Fan back to settle things with that customer.
They left the elevator, then switched to an ascending one, returning to the 50th floor.
Little Meng led Lin Fan to the door of a company.
Looking at the company, Lin Fan noticed it was Danmai International Company, the name sounded familiar, then realized it’s He Jinsheng’s company!
What a coincidence.
He Jinsheng is a market manager at Danmai International Company, and this company represents their Huaxia branch office.
The receptionist at the entrance saw them enter, stood up, recognizing Little Meng as the courier who just left, wondering why he returned with someone, seemed unfriendly.
"What do you want?" The receptionist asked warily.
Lin Fan asked, "What’s the name of that customer?"
Little Meng said, "Liu Xiaodan."
Lin Fan then looked at the receptionist, "Could you please call Liu Xiaodan out, she hit my colleague, I’d like to see what happened."
The receptionist rolled her eyes, "She just went out for lunch, anything else you need?"
Lin Fan chuckled; his top-level insight couldn’t be fooled by the receptionist’s lies.
"If you don’t call her out, we’ll barge in, you bear the consequences," Lin Fan said flatly.
Just then, laughter started, a group walked out from inside, seemingly heading to lunch.
Little Meng pointed to a woman, "Brother Fan, that’s her!"
"Liu Xiaodan!" Lin Fan called.
A hefty girl, not pretty but solid, was chatting and laughing, hearing the call, turned to look, seeing Little Meng, her face darkened.
"Why are you shouting, is my name for you to casually call? Why did you come back? Oh, went to get reinforcements?" The hefty girl sneered.
Little Meng said, "You hit me without reason; this can’t just end like this."
The hefty girl sneered, "Got reinforcements, talking tough now, what, want to fight? You two with your builds, come at me together, I’ll squash you beneath me!"
Her words made everyone burst into laughter; everyone knew Liu Xiaodan is a tough girl, most disregards men.
There were visitor seats nearby; Lin Fan leisurely sat, calmly saying, "We’re not here to fight; you hit Little Meng, now slap yourself, then apologize to Little Meng, and it’s over."
The laughter ceased; everyone looked at Lin Fan, wondering where he got such confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Starting next month, your rent will double.
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 210: Starting next month, your rent will double.
Lin Fan opened his mouth demanding Liu Xiaodan apologize, causing everyone at the Company to turn their eyes to Lin Fan.
"What did he just say?"
"He said he wants Xiaodan to apologize."
"Hahaha, what, making Xiaodan apologize, where’s the confidence coming from?"
"This guy dressed like this, clearly just a loser, truly fearless due to ignorance."
The crowd burst into laughter.
Liu Xiaodan looked coldly at Lin Fan: "I’m the one who hit him, so what, a stinky delivery guy arriving late, what’s wrong with scolding him or hitting him, and he dares to complain? Look at you acting all mighty!"
Liu Xiaodan was indeed arrogant.
Little Meng couldn’t help but speak up: "I was late by one minute because I was waiting for the elevator, and I’ve already apologized to you, but you insisted on hitting me to feel satisfied."
To restore the situation, Little Meng was late by one minute because he waited for the elevator. Liu Xiaodan scolded him and even threatened to report him. Little Meng apologized and almost begged, but still, he was hit by Liu Xiaodan, who finally let him go.
Liu Xiaodan said: "Who else should I hit? You wasted my one minute, do you know how precious my one minute is? Can someone of your low status compare?"
Little Meng’s face turned red, momentarily at a loss for how to refute; indeed, they were employed in a big company while he was just a delivery guy, feeling a bit inferior.
Seeing Little Meng at a loss for words, Liu Xiaodan became even more arrogant: "Dare to come mess with me, look at you acting all tough, hurry up and get out. If you don’t leave, I’ll report you for harassing customers and see if you can even deliver!"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Are you sure you want to do this?"
Liu Xiaodan replied: "Why, want to give it a try?"
Lin Fan said: "Reasonably speaking, Little Meng was indeed wrong by being late, and he apologized to you too. It’s okay if you don’t want to understand, scold him a bit, we delivery guys can endure grievances on our own, but hitting someone is not right, it’s an insult to personal dignity. You should apologize to Little Meng."
Liu Xiaodan coldly snorted: "What the hell does that have to do with you, who are you?"
Lin Fan replied: "Who I am is not important, the reasoning is what it is, it’s up to you how to handle it."
Liu Xiaodan retorted: "What, if I don’t apologize, you’re going to hit me?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "If I were to hit you, your head would fly off. I said I came to reason with you, if you are unwilling to apologize to Little Meng, you may face some consequences."
Liu Xiaodan angrily shouted: "Are you threatening me? Just you, what can you do to me?"
Lin Fan said: "You said Little Meng wasted your one minute by being late? I can make you waste more time."
Liu Xiaodan cursed: "I’d like to see what you can do to me!"
"Sister Dan, dominating!"
```
