"Sister Dan isn’t afraid, this pauper doesn’t even dare to hit, what can he do?"
"Scare who, my Sister Dan is raised fearless!"
Everyone burst into laughter.
"What’s going on, not going to eat, causing a ruckus here?"
At this point, a voice sternly said, then a young man in a suit came out, drawn by the commotion.
Seeing him, the crowd immediately quieted down.
This person was He Jinsheng, the manager of the marketing department, their superior!
"Got into an argument with a delivery guy." an employee said.
He Jinsheng chuckled: "What, why argue with a delivery guy, just send them out."
The tone was full of disdain.
Liu Xiaodan pointed at Lin Fan: "Manager, you came at the right time, these two are causing trouble and threatening me, Manager, you have to stand up for me."
He Jinsheng followed her indication, finally seeing Lin Fan, his expression changed, and his legs softened: "Mr. Lin?"
Quickly approached Lin Fan with a bow, showing utmost respect.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "Manager He, didn’t expect to meet again so soon."
He Jinsheng wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, forced a smile: "Yes, Mr. Lin, what brings you to visit our Company?"
He tentatively asked, fearing Lin Fan came to trouble him because of a previous meeting, his nerves tensed.
Lin Fan said: "Nothing else, it’s like this, my delivery guy brother was hit by your employee, I just came to seek justice."
Not here because of me, He Jinsheng suddenly felt a weight lifted from his heart, realizing he was safe, such a relief indeed.
But he dared not be careless.
"Such a thing happened!" He Jinsheng showed a serious face, turned back to scrutinize the employees, "who hit someone, stand up!"
The employees were all stunned.
They watched He Jinsheng nod and bow to Lin Fan, like a lapdog!
What the hell!
What’s going on?
Realizing Lin Fan’s identity wasn’t simple, everyone broke into cold sweat, especially Liu Xiaodan, whose complexion changed.
"It’s her!"
All employees pointed at Liu Xiaodan, eager to clear themselves, helplessly, seeing Manager He’s demeanor, they realized Lin Fan wasn’t someone to cross, naturally wanting to protect themselves.
He Jinsheng’s gaze fixed on Liu Xiaodan: "Liu Xiaodan, what’s the matter with you, why did you hit someone?"
Liu Xiaodan’s voice trembled: "He... was late..."
He Jinsheng responded: "Late?"
Little Meng said: "Because of a traffic jam, I was one minute late from the agreed time, I’ve apologized to her, but she wasn’t satisfied and hit me, even threatened to report me. I was going to endure it, Brother Fan decided to get me justice."
He Jinsheng listened, especially to the last sentence, immediately his face darkened, pointing at Liu Xiaodan and scolding: "Rascal, just because he’s late you can hit people? If you’re late to work, can I hit you?"
Liu Xiaodan turned red with embarrassment, dared not respond.
He Jinsheng shouted: "Answer me, have I hit you when you’re late to work?"
Liu Xiaodan shook her head: "No."
He Jinsheng said: "That’s it, delivery guys work hard come rain or shine, sometimes encounter traffic jams, elevators crowded, being a bit late is normal, we ought to understand, even if you don’t, hitting the delivery guy, do you have any humanity!"
He scolded with righteous fervor, completely forgetting his previous disdain for delivery personnel.
Lin Fan quietly shook his head, this He Jinsheng, truly a petty person, if Lin Fan weren’t here, he probably would have bullied the delivery guy too.
Liu Xiaodan being scolded by He Jinsheng felt aggrieved, couldn’t help but say: "A stinky delivery, hit him as I like, is it really that exaggerated?"
He Jinsheng became furious: "You dare say!"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Manager He, your subordinate is quite arrogant, treating even a manager like you with disdain, can you handle this, if not, starting next month, the rent here will double."
He Jinsheng was shocked, doubling the rent, too harsh!
He Jinsheng immediately pointed at Liu Xiaodan’s nose: "I announce, Liu Xiaodan you’re fired, pack your things and leave immediately!"

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Tolerating grievances is not the solution to problems
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 211: Tolerating grievances is not the solution to problems
Liu Xiaodan’s face changed dramatically: "Why are you dismissing me?"
He Jinsheng said, "The reason is that you hit someone. You’ve already violated the company’s regulations. Not only can I dismiss you, but I also don’t have to pay any compensation. If you disagree, you can sue the company!"
Liu Xiaodan was really scared now, because of Lin Fan, He Jinsheng actually wanted to fire her decisively!
He Jinsheng turned to Lin Fan, nodding and bowing: "Mr. Lin, are you satisfied with this handling?"
Lin Fan said, "I initially suggested that Miss Liu apologize and let it go. Since Miss Liu refused to apologize, this is also good, so there’s no need to waste time at the company."
Lin Fan agreed, He Jinsheng breathed a sigh of relief, it was all good now.
"Manager, who exactly is he?" Liu Xiaodan couldn’t help but ask.
He Jinsheng said, "Mr. Lin is the new owner of Zhou Tian Mansion. The entire Zhou Tian Mansion belongs to him!"
What?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Lin Fan actually owns the entire Zhou Tian Mansion?
Even though he’s dressed so plainly, all in cheap clothes, my god, he’s actually a super-rich landlord?
Everyone kneeled, remembering how they had offended the landlord earlier, trembling with fear.
Liu Xiaodan’s face turned pale.
Lin Fan being the landlord, no wonder He Jinsheng’s legs went weak when he saw him. As long as the landlord says to increase the rent, the company either needs to pay more rent or move out, which neither option the company is willing to do, so it’s best not to offend the landlord.
This time, it’s really backfired.
Thud!
Liu Xiaodan’s knees gave way, and she knelt on the ground: "Mr. Lin, I’m sorry, I was blind, I was wrong. Sir, I apologize to you."
Liu Xiaodan bowed her head and admitted her mistake to Little Meng.
Slap!
Then she gave herself a big slap on the face.
Just as Lin Fan had initially told her to do.
"Mr. Lin, I apologized as you said, can you not dismiss me?" Liu Xiaodan pleaded.
Lin Fan chuckled: "You apologized because of my identity, if I weren’t the landlord, would you have apologized? The job of a courier may not be as prestigious as you white-collar workers, but it also deserves respect. If a courier is wrong, you can defend your rights accordingly, but to beat and insult arrogantly, damaging personal respect, is absolutely inappropriate."
Liu Xiaodan nodded and said, "I remember, I’ll definitely learn to respect people in the future."
Lin Fan said coldly, "People like you wouldn’t remember the lesson unless you suffer a little. Now I’ll give you two options, one is to be dismissed, the second one, Manager He, do you still need people over in Iceland?"
He Jinsheng said, "Yes, we do."
Lin Fan said, "Then let Miss Liu choose for herself, anyway, I don’t want to see her in this building anymore."
After saying this, Lin Fan stood up, greeted Little Meng, and walked out.
"Take care, Mr. Lin," said He Jinsheng, wiping cold sweat away, damn, finally, he’s gone, how scared I was that it might involve me too.
He turned around and stared at Liu Xiaodan: "Of all the people to offend, you offend Mr. Lin, bad luck for you, tell me, are you leaving or going to Iceland?"
Liu Xiaodan collapsed on the ground, wanting to cry but unable to shed tears, she didn’t want either option.
For a moment, she regretted so much that her intestines turned blue, had she known, she would never have hit that courier. This lesson was truly severe.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan and Little Meng left Danmai Company and took the elevator downstairs.
Little Meng looked worshipful: "Brother Fan, thank you so much, that woman’s look just now was really ridiculous."
Lin Fan smiled: "Are you feeling better now?"
Little Meng nodded with a grin: "Yes, I feel great, Brother Fan, you’re amazing! Did they just say you’re the owner of this building?"
He knew Lin Fan was rich, owning two luxury cars, one worth 70 million and one worth 8 million. But he didn’t know Lin Fan was wealthy to this extent.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it’s mine."
Little Meng knelt: "Brother Fan, you’re awesome! Brother Fan, it’s great, being so rich, no one dares to bully you!"
Little Meng spoke with envy.
Lin Fan patted his shoulder: "Actually, when I had no money, I would also stand up for myself in situations like yours, suffering in silence is not the solution to the problem. For those who bully the soft and fear the hard, as couriers, we have to be tougher. I’ll see you later."
The elevator stopped on the 3rd floor.
Lin Fan walked out.
Little Meng nodded thoughtfully, Brother Fan made sense, as long as you’re right, you should stand your ground.
Lin Fan exited the elevator, going to find the Junyue Restaurant that Mo Junliang mentioned.
The floors below six at Zhou Tian Mansion are all commercial dining areas, and there’s a renowned high-end restaurant on the third floor called Junyue Restaurant.
Besides Junyue Restaurant, there is also a national chain supermarket on the third floor, Vanguard Mart.
Lin Fan exited the elevator and to get to Junyue Restaurant, he had to pass the entrance of this Vanguard Mart.
When Lin Fan passed by, he noticed there was trouble at the supermarket, with a few Blonde Hair individuals cursing at a middle-aged man, surrounded by some bystanders.
And the person being surrounded wasn’t anyone else but Zhang Dafu.
"What?" Lin Fan was stunned, why is Zhang Dafu here, and being bullied by a group of thugs?
Lin Fan walked over and stopped to watch.
It turned out that today at Vanguard Mart, a few Blonde Hair people suddenly came and smashed the railing at the supermarket entrance, claiming that their boss’ hands had ulcerated after using Blue Moon Hand Soap, demanding compensation from the supermarket.
The supermarket employees were terrified and quickly called the manager, who asked them to provide evidence.
The Blonde Hair people indeed took out a receipt and a bottle of Blue Moon Hand Soap, proving that this bottle of hand soap was indeed sold from this store.
The manager thought, this is not the supermarket’s responsibility, since it’s a quality issue with the hand soap, they had an agreement with Blue Moon, and could call someone from Blue Moon to resolve it.
So the manager immediately called Zhang Dafu.
The Blonde Hair individuals arrogantly occupied the supermarket entrance, only allowing customers to leave but not enter. Scared customers hurriedly left, some even dropping their intended purchases, which pained the manager greatly, what a huge loss.
And if it’s indeed a quality issue with Blue Moon Hand Soap, it could affect the supermarket’s reputation, this matter could be big or small!
For Zhang Dafu, this matter was also worth attention because recently Blue Moon supplied a new hand soap to Vanguard Mart, and if the new hand soap had quality issues, it would be a big problem.
Blue Moon is currently building a factory on the Shendiao Old Factory site to mass-produce new hand soap, and if the new hand soap indeed has problems leading to massive order cancellations, it would be disastrous.
So he rushed to the scene personally as soon as possible.
The scene was quite alarming for Zhang Dafu, as the Blonde Hair thugs didn’t seem like people to be trifled with.
"I’m Zhang Dafu, the person in charge of Blue Moon," Zhang Dafu introduced himself with a show of bravery.
The manager sighed with relief seeing Zhang Dafu arrive, finally able to pass the buck.
"President Zhang, I’m Manager Tan here, these people are making trouble, you should deal with them!"
Hearing Zhang Dafu’s name, the Blonde Hair individuals seemed to receive some kind of signal, exchanging glances, they jumped up, putting on a fierce and menacing display.
"So it’s your hand soap, huh, do you know our boss was harmed because of you?" a Blonde Hair roared.
"Bastards, pay up!"
"If you don’t pay, we’ll break your legs!"
Their menacing posture really scared Zhang Dafu, but with things as they were, he had no choice but to confront them.
"Don’t get excited, let me say something, first, are you sure this bottle of hand soap was bought here?" Zhang Dafu asked.
A Blonde Hair yelled, "Of course, we’ve shown the receipt, you can ask this damn fat woman!"
Manager Tan wiped her cold sweat, saying: "President Zhang, it’s been verified."

chapters.title: Chapter 212: The Other Party Demands 10,000 Times Compensation, Lin Fan Takes Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 212: The Other Party Demands 10,000 Times Compensation, Lin Fan Takes Action
Zhang Dafu frowned and said, "The quality of our family’s hand sanitizer is strictly controlled. I need proof that it was our hand sanitizer your boss used before the incident."
Blonde Hair shouted, "Do we really need proof? Didn’t I already tell you, if Brother Shan was all right, would we be here causing trouble?"
"Exactly, do you think we’re here because we have nothing better to do?"
"Shut the hell up and pay up already!"
Zhang Dafu wiped his sweat and said, "Everything requires evidence. If you can’t prove the problem is with us, we will not provide compensation and will not admit there’s an issue with our product."
Blonde Hair angrily said, "Then you’re just cheating us!"
"I think you’re tired of living. Do you know who Brother Shan is? Can you afford to mess with him?"
"We could just set this supermarket on fire, and no one could do anything to us!"
They began to intimidate him.
Manager Tan was clearly a bit scared and pulled Zhang Dafu aside, saying, "President Zhang, this group is crazy. Why don’t you ask them how much compensation they want and quickly get rid of them."
Zhang Dafu refused, saying, "No way, if we compensate them, we’re admitting there’s a problem with our product. I believe there’s nothing wrong with our product. Something is definitely off here."
He recalled the other day when a group of troublemakers had shown up at the construction site. Could someone be deliberately causing trouble again this time?
Who in the world could be so sinister, attacking their new hand sanitizer, attempting to defame it—it’s too malicious.
Manager Tan said in frustration, "I don’t care about that, I just focus on doing business, and now the supermarket’s regular operation is being affected!"
Ignoring Zhang Dafu’s objection, Manager Tan walked over with a forced smile and asked, "So, how much compensation are you looking for?"
One of the Blonde Hairs said, "Our boss said, just pay us 100 thousand yuan!"
thousand!
The crowd around gasped in disbelief, such a ridiculous demand!
Manager Tan broke into a cold sweat, "This hand sanitizer costs only 10 yuan, and you’re asking for 100 thousand, where’s the sense in paying a ten thousand fold compensation?"
Blonde Hair angrily said, "So what? You damaged our boss’s perfect hands. Aren’t our boss’s hands worth 100 thousand yuan!"
"100 thousand yuan is already too little. If you keep hemming and hawing, the price will go up!"
Manager Tan wanted to cry. Initially thinking compensation would solve the issue, but with such a big appetite, let alone President Zhang would agree, even she wouldn’t.
It seemed that paying to get rid of this pest was not the way to go.
Zhang Dafu suddenly said, "You keep saying your boss’s hands are rotting. I want to see it, do you have photos?"
Blonde Hair insulted, "You idiot, why all these questions? I said so, just pay up when told!"
"This guy’s not right in the head!"
The Blonde Hairs laughed boisterously again.
The crowd around started pointing and whispering, with many doubting whether Zhang Dafu was just making excuses.
Faced with the intimidation, Zhang Dafu wasn’t afraid anymore and said coldly, "I still stand by my words, unless you can prove it, we won’t pay any compensation! I’m now suspecting fraud, and if you don’t leave, I’ll call the police!"
Blonde Hair, furious, said, "Are you trying to scare us? We grew up being scared. Are we scared of the police?"
Zhang Dafu took out his phone, "Since you’re not afraid, I’ll call the police for justice!"
Blonde Hair gritted his teeth, "Damn it, you’re ruthless. We’ll leave for today, but as long as there’s no payment, we’ll come every day to smash things. Don’t even think about doing business!"
"Think about it and call this number if you decide to pay!"
Blonde Hair tossed a business card and seemed ready to leave triumphantly.
"No way, I won’t come back to this shop again."
"Does their hand sanitizer really make your hands rot? Better not buy it again."
The onlookers shook their heads and sighed as they dispersed.
Manager Tan stomped his foot and said, "What do we do now? If they come to smash the place every day, who would dare come in? We can’t have the police stationed here, President Zhang, this situation was caused by your hand sanitizer, you must resolve it!"
Zhang Dafu picked up the business card, frowned, and pondered a solution.
"Don’t leave yet."
A voice suddenly rang out, and Lin Fan came out, blocking the way for the Blonde Hairs.
Everyone looked and saw a young man, dressed simply but very handsome.
The Blonde Hairs, having been planning to leave due to Zhang Dafu’s threat to call the police, got angry seeing someone blocking their way.
"Kid, who are you? Mind your own business!"
"Get out of the way, you’re blocking us."
The Blonde Hairs said ferociously.
"Boss!" Zhang Dafu said with delight; Lin Fan had come.
He initially didn’t inform Lin Fan about this, thinking he could handle it himself, but it seemed he might not manage.
Zhang Dafu leaned close to Lin Fan and whispered, "Boss, we might be targeted again. Could it be the same as last time?"
Lin Fan said, "Probably not, asking these punks will confirm it."
The last time, it was Feng Wanshan who instigated troublemakers to the construction site. That night Lin Fan had already taught Feng Wanshan a lesson. He wouldn’t resort to such measures again.
On hearing, the Blonde Hairs were fuming, "What did you call us?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Punks, didn’t you hear me clearly? You group of punks, tell me, who is Brother Shan, and why did he send you to cause trouble?"
The Blonde Hairs exchanged glances at each other.
"What the hell are you saying? It’s very clear, our Brother Shan used your hand sanitizer, and his hands are rotting!"
"It’s your hand sanitizer’s problem, understand?"
"We’re here to defend our rights!"
The Blonde Hairs started clamoring, their voices high, catching the attention of passersby.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Having a point doesn’t mean raising your voice. Why do you need to shout so loud? Since you’re defending your rights, let’s talk sense. Everyone’s watching, and everyone can judge who has a point, no one’s a fool."
The onlookers all nodded in agreement; no one wants to admit being a fool who can’t distinguish right from wrong.
"This young brother is right; let’s talk sense!"
"If they’re unwilling to talk sense, are they just causing trouble?"
"Exactly..."
Hearing these comments, the Blonde Hairs were taken aback, how this guy managed to sway things just from his first words.
"What do you want?" one Blonde Hair asked.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You say Brother Shan used our hand sanitizer, resulting in his hands rotting. Show me the evidence. First, I need to confirm if Brother Shan’s hands are really rotting. Secondly, even if they are, I need proof that it was our hand sanitizer that caused it. We’ll need an authoritative report for that. If you can provide it, I’ll transfer the money immediately."
The Blonde Hairs looked at each other.
"No evidence, what we say is evidence!"
"Right, we showed you the receipt earlier, it was indeed your hand sanitizer!"
"Isn’t that enough?"
The Blonde Hairs started yelling again.
Lin Fan said, "Of course that’s not enough. First, you have to prove if Brother Shan’s hands are rotting. Either bring Brother Shan here, or have him send a photo—it won’t take even a minute. Isn’t that easy? Don’t you agree, everyone?"
The crowd nodded earnestly; indeed, Lin Fan made a lot of sense, and they can’t deny it.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Take Me to See Your Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 213: Take Me to See Your Boss
Lin Fan is different from Zhang Dafu. Although he made the same demands as Zhang Dafu, Lin Fan would also mobilize the masses to participate, creating public pressure.
Under the pressure of public opinion, these Blonde Hairs can’t get by with their unreasonable behavior.
The Blonde Hairs were momentarily at a loss for words.
Lin Fan said, "What’s wrong? Are you unwilling to do it because you have a guilty conscience, or are you just here to cause trouble?"
With no reason to offer, the Blonde Hairs had to slip away.
"It’s none of your damn business, get lost!"
"What we say is evidence!"
"That’s right, if we say it is, it is. It’s not your place to question us!"
"In short, get the compensation ready, or we’ll be here to smash things every day!"
They tried to leave, but Lin Fan had no intention of letting them go.
"You threw dirt on our hand soap; until this is clarified, you guys aren’t leaving." Lin Fan said calmly.
"Are you gonna let us go, or do you want a beating?"
"Looking for a fight, huh?"
The Blonde Hairs showed a fierce look and started threatening.
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, you guys can’t leave."
The Blonde Hairs were furious, and one jumped out, "Looks like we have to fight!"
A punch was aimed straight at Lin Fan’s face.
However, the next second, his fist stalled, caught by Lin Fan’s hand, unable to advance an inch.
Lin Fan exerted a gentle force.
"Ah!"
The Blonde Hair screamed miserably, feeling as though his hand was clamped by an iron vise, about to explode, pain bringing cold sweat streaming down, forcing him to kneel involuntarily.
"Let go, please, let go," the Blonde Hair begged.
The other Blonde Hairs were shocked by what they saw, not daring to step forward for the moment.
The onlookers were also astonished, not expecting Lin Fan to be so formidable, easily subduing the Blonde Hair.
Zhang Dafu was thrilled, also discovering for the first time that the boss was so strong, no wonder the boss wasn’t afraid of these vicious thugs at all.
Lin Fan said calmly, "Tell me, who sent you here to cause trouble? If you don’t tell the truth, your hand will be ruined."
The Blonde Hair cried, "Everything we said is true."
Crack.
Lin Fan chuckled slightly, exerting just a bit more pressure, causing a cracking sound from the Blonde Hair’s fist.
The Blonde Hair screamed in excruciating pain, terrified, and immediately shouted, "Brother Shan asked us to come, so we did."
Lin Fan’s face darkened, "So your boss’s hand wasn’t actually ruined?"
The Blonde Hair shook his head, "No."
At these words, the crowd erupted.
Turns out they really were sent to throw dirt; Blue Moon’s new hand soap was wrongfully accused!
Lin Fan said, "How did your boss instruct you?"
The Blonde Hair said, "He first told us to come and buy a bottle of Blue Moon hand soap as evidence, then to come today and cause a ruckus to frame and demand compensation."
Zhang Dafu couldn’t help but say angrily, "So you just want to extort money, right?"
Lin Fan furrowed his brows. Extorting money was probably secondary. The main goal was to throw dirt on Blue Moon. Once Blue Moon’s quality issues were confirmed, the subsequent financial loss would be immeasurable.
Lin Fan asked, "Why would he do this?"
This question left the Blonde Hairs looking at one another, unable to answer.
The surrounding people started discussing.
"Does that even need to be asked? Thugs like them rely on extortion to live!"
"I think it’s Blue Moon’s competitor doing this!"
"I think so too, who benefits from smearing Blue Moon? Of course, it’s the competitor!"
Hearing the discussions, Zhang Dafu said in a deep voice, "Boss, could it really be Red Sun..."
Blue Moon’s biggest competitor is Red Sun Hand Soap, and with Blue Moon’s recent ascent, it’s heavily impacted Red Sun, providing plenty of motive for Red Sun to do this.
Lin Fan is a cautious person and won’t easily jump to conclusions.
However, he was certain of one thing: this Brother Shan was definitely being instructed. This thug leader had no past grievances or recent vendettas with Blue Moon, so wouldn’t come here to cause trouble for no reason.
"Tell me about Brother Shan. Does he have any connection with Hu Dahai?" Lin Fan asked.
Lin Fan had recently sent Hu Dahai to prison. If Brother Shan was here seeking revenge for Hu Dahai, that would make sense.
The Blonde Hair hesitated, "Hu Dahai? He’s our mortal enemy..."
It turns out there are quite a few factions underground in Yun City, all not getting along, frequently fighting over territory. The gang led by Hu Dahai and the one led by Brother Shan are mortal enemies, both wishing the other would die.
So, it could be essentially ruled out that Brother Shan is seeking revenge for Hu Dahai. Logically, Brother Shan should be thanking Lin Fan for dealing with Hu Dahai for him.
Thus, it’s basically certain that Brother Shan, like Hu Dahai, has been bought off by someone.
"Call your boss," Lin Fan ordered.
The Blonde Hairs looked at each other, "For what?"
Lin Fan said, "Tell him about your situation and that I want to meet him."
A Blonde Hair quickly made the call, conveying Lin Fan’s message to Brother Shan.
After hanging up, the Blonde Hair said, "Our boss is currently dining at Junyue Restaurant and asked you to meet him in the private room..."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," thinking that it would be convenient as he was heading to Junyue Restaurant to eat too.
"Someone stay behind. Old Zhang, keep an eye on them. If they stir up trouble again, call the police and take me to him," Lin Fan instructed.
The subdued Blonde Hair went with Lin Fan to Junyue Restaurant.
On site, a curious crowd remained. Lin Fan showed up and immediately changed the situation; it was impressive.
"President Zhang, who is this young man?" Manager Tan couldn’t help but ask curiously.
Zhang Dafu proudly said, "He is Mr. Lin, our Blue Moon’s boss!"
The crowd was stunned, surprised that Blue Moon’s boss was so young and handled matters so adeptly.
At the restaurant entrance.
Mo Junliang had been waiting for Lin Fan for a while, alongside a middle-aged man in a suit, the restaurant manager, Manager Qian.
Seeing Lin Fan approaching with a Blonde Hair, Mo Junliang was a bit puzzled.
"Chairman, you finally arrived. Let me introduce you, this is Manager Qian of Junyue Restaurant," Mo Junliang said with a smile.
Manager Qian greeted courteously, "Mr. Lin, it’s truly an honor that you could come."
Lin Fan smiled, "Manager Qian, you’re too kind, with such a warm invitation, how could I not come."
Mo Junliang glanced at the Blonde Hair, curiously asking, "Chairman, who is this?"
Lin Fan said, "Just a scruffy little thug, don’t mind him."
Mo Junliang and Manager Qian exchanged glances, unsure of what it meant.
Manager Qian smiled, "Mr. Lin, the banquet is ready. This way, please."
Lin Fan said, "My apologies, I have an appointment before the meal, Scruffy Hair, take me to your boss."
The Blonde Hair nodded obediently. The hand Lin Fan had grasped still hurt terribly, so he dared not disobey.
Inside a private room at Junyue Restaurant.
A man with a Fat Head and Big Ears was drinking, his hand unscrupulously roaming around the buttocks of a heavily made-up woman he held.
The table was packed with dishes, chicken, duck, fish, and meat, a lavish spread.
Liu Jinshan, an underworld gang leader known as Brother Shan, dined at such a high-end establishment, having ordered so many dishes, seemingly living quite well recently.
Led by the Blonde Hair, Lin Fan entered the room.
"So, you’re Brother Shan? Hello, I am Blue Moon’s boss, Lin Fan," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Liu Jinshan glanced at Lin Fan, "The boss, right? Since you’re here, just pay the compensation."
Lin Fan responded lightly, "Why?"
Liu Jinshan sneered, "You don’t think you can take me on, do you? You might have some skills, but if you fight me, it won’t end well for you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 214: The Chairman is Really Low-Key
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 214: The Chairman is Really Low-Key
Liu Jinshan sat leisurely in his seat, and when Lin Fan came in, he didn’t even change his posture, showing that he didn’t take Lin Fan seriously.
He straight away asked Lin Fan for compensation money.
Lin Fan said, "Your subordinate claimed that you used my family’s hand sanitizer, which caused your hand to rot. If that’s true, I should compensate you, but I see your hand is perfectly fine. Isn’t this outright extortion?"
Liu Jinshan sneered, "I am openly extorting you, and you have to accept it, understand?"
Lin Fan pulled up a chair, sat down, and said, "I don’t quite understand, care to elaborate?"
Liu Jinshan laughed arrogantly, "You look young and naive! Go out and ask around who I, Liu Jinshan, am. Go against me, and I’ll trip you up every day. You have no other way but to give in obediently!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Really, you’re that arrogant? Aren’t you afraid of me beating you up?"
Liu Jinshan replied disdainfully, "Beat me? Let’s not even discuss whether you’re a match for me. Even if you beat me, so what? I’ll still mess with you every day. What can you do about it? In a society governed by law, are you going to kill me?"
Liu Jinshan was insolent and fearless.
Indeed, Lin Fan couldn’t kill him. Even if he beat him up, Liu Jinshan would continue causing small troubles every day — truly annoying.
Such hooligan scoundrels, even if reported to the police and arrested, are only locked up for a few days, not a permanent solution. Many people get harassed by these ruffians like a nightmare.
Some companies have had to shut down because they couldn’t take it anymore.
Lin Fan said, "I haven’t offended you, Brother Shan, before, right? Why target me? Did someone pay you? How much did they give you?"
Liu Jinshan didn’t answer, he took a sip of wine and said, "If you don’t want to pay, then feel free to leave."
It seems that whoever bribed Liu Jinshan is not simple. Liu Jinshan didn’t intend to negotiate with Lin Fan at all.
Last time, Lin Fan dealt with Hu Dahai using a counter-bribery method. Hu Dahai was swayed by money and betrayed his employer, Feng Wanshan.
But Liu Jinshan couldn’t be dealt with using this method.
"Mr. Lin, I know about Hu Dahai’s case. Don’t think about repeating the same trick. Besides, I might as well tell you, even if I didn’t know about Hu Dahai, your method wouldn’t work on me, because the person you offended this time is someone even if I had ten lives, I wouldn’t dare to turn against." Liu Jinshan said.
Lin Fan responded, "Who is this person?"
Liu Jinshan shut his mouth.
Ring ring ring...
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
Lin Fan answered the call, "Mm, I’m in Box 3."
After putting down the phone, Lin Fan said, "Since you don’t want to negotiate with me, let’s handle it in the most usual way. You’re bribed to falsely claim injury from using my product, sending people to smash and intimidate, at the very least, you’ll be locked up for a few days."
Liu Jinshan sneered, "Are you sure you want to do that?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Very sure, I know your threats, every day sending people to trip me up, right? Go ahead and try, I’ll play along."
"Nobody move!"
At this moment, Loli came in with two police officers.
It turned out Lin Fan had just called Loli, who was patrolling nearby, and agreed to come over.
Lin Fan smiled, "Officer, you came just in time. This Brother Shan took someone else’s money to extort and intimidate me. Please help me, officer."
Lin Fan briefly explained what happened today.
Loli looked at Liu Jinshan, face darkening, "Liu Jinshan, is what he says true?"
Liu Jinshan chuckled, "Officer Luo, don’t listen to him. I did use his hand sanitizer, my hands felt uncomfortable, so I came to claim my rights. My brothers felt sorry for me and got a bit emotional."
Loli coldly laughed, "You said your hands were rotten, but I see nothing wrong with them?"
Liu Jinshan said, "Haha, my hands were indeed uncomfortable before, but they are better now. I did exaggerate a bit. I apologize to Boss Lin. Boss Lin, please be magnanimous."
Liu Jinshan looked at Lin Fan smugly; he was blatantly clearing himself, what could Lin Fan do?
But by calling the police, Lin Fan had completely offended him; from now on, Lin Fan shouldn’t expect peace!
Lin Fan said, "Officer, he’s lying. Luckily, I recorded our conversation earlier."
With that, Lin Fan calmly played the recording on his phone.
It was his earlier conversation with Liu Jinshan!
Liu Jinshan’s expression changed, damn it, Lin Fan actually recorded it!
Loli listened to the recording and said angrily, "Liu Jinshan, the evidence is conclusive. What else do you have to say? Arrest him!"
The two police officers stepped forward, pulled Liu Jinshan to his feet, handcuffed him, and handcuffed Blonde Hair as well.
Loli then proceeded to take Lin Fan’s testimony.
"Officer, thank you for your hard work. You truly are good police for the people." Lin Fan smiled.
Loli said, "It’s our duty."
With that, Loli playfully winked at Lin Fan.
Turning, her expression became serious, "Take them away!"
The two police officers took Liu Jinshan and Blonde Hair outside.
Liu Jinshan’s face was dark as he glared at Lin Fan, "Brat, you don’t even know who you’ve offended. Just wait and see!"
Lin Fan smiled faintly, not responding, but his heart felt heavy.
In Lin Fan’s eyes, Liu Jinshan was nothing, it was the person behind Liu Jinshan who was the tricky one.
He still didn’t know who this person was, or when he had offended them?
These days, he had been a bit high-profile, maybe attracting trouble without realizing it.
He needed to find out who this person was to deal with them. Otherwise, with the enemy in the dark and him in the light, he’d be in a passive position.
He decisively called the police to take Liu Jinshan away, just not wanting Liu Jinshan to have it easy. He didn’t believe the police could get anything out of Liu Jinshan about the person behind it.
He had to find them himself.
If this person is really as formidable as Liu Jinshan claimed, sending Liu Jinshan to cause trouble might just be a minor issue, with possibly more severe methods to come.
"We’ll see when the time comes."
Lin Fan chuckled, turned around, and went to have dinner with Mo Junliang.
After eating, Lin Fan left Junyue Restaurant.
Mo Junliang and Manager Qian of Junyue Restaurant personally saw Lin Fan off downstairs.
Downstairs.
Lin Fan waved, "No need to see me off. Go back."
Then he walked to the side, got on his electric bike, and rode off.
Mo Junliang and Manager Qian looked at each other, sweating profusely.
Damn!
A grand owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, actually riding an electric bike?
"Brother Liang, forgive my frankness, but could there be a mistake? Is this Mr. Lin really the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion? If you hadn’t told me, I’d have thought he was a delivery man." Manager Qian wiped his sweat nervously.
Mo Junliang said, "No mistake, I think the chairman is just being low-key."
Manager Qian quickly said, "Sorry..."
Mo Junliang sighed, "It’s not your fault, the chairman is just too low-key."
Meanwhile, Lin Fan rode his bike back to his rented apartment. He had a meeting at Celestial Aviation at three in the afternoon. Seeing there was still time, he planned to take a nap.
Lin Fan was woken up by a call from Wang Xiangqian.
Wang Xiangqian came to return the car. Seeing it was about time, Lin Fan drove to Celestial Aviation.
Arriving at the Celestial Aviation Headquarters Building.
Just as Lin Fan arrived at the entrance, he saw a group of flight attendants coming from the side.
Each was slim and tall, beautiful, wearing flight attendant uniforms, chatting and laughing, with bell-like laughter.
Truly a lovely sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: The Flight Attendant Seeking Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 215: The Flight Attendant Seeking Help
A group of charming flight attendants, possibly just off a plane, returned to headquarters, chatting and laughing, each one smiling like a blossoming flower, each prettier than the last, truly pleasing to the eye, making it hard not to take a few extra glances.
Lin Fan was no exception, drawn to this group of vibrant and youthful flight attendants.
Every man dreams of dating a flight attendant; just thinking about it is delightful because flight attendants often represent beauty, height, good figure, and once they put on that uniform, who can resist?
Now, this group of flight attendants, all of them are Lin Fan’s subordinates...
The system rewarded him with an airline company, its market value rose to 70 billion, Lin Fan felt it was too big, but seeing this group of flight attendants, Lin Fan truly felt this reward was incredible.
Although he’s not a perverted boss and won’t target these flight attendants, having such a beautiful group of female subordinates is indeed a pleasant thing.
However, the flight attendants didn’t seem to know that the handsome young man in front of them was their highest boss, they passed by Lin Fan with laughter, not greeting him.
They were indeed attracted by Lin Fan’s handsomeness, stealing glances at him and quietly discussing.
"He’s so handsome!"
"Could he be here to apply as a male flight attendant?"
"Then we’re in luck. I wonder who he’ll fancy among us?"
"Little Na, what do you think?"
"Why ask Little Na? Although he’s handsome, he looks quite poor. Little Na only loves rich men..."
"Hahaha..."
The flight attendants laughed and walked away.
Lin Fan shook his head and walked into the building.
Zhao Jiayi hurriedly approached: "Chairman, you’re back!"
In the following time, Lin Fan entered the conference room for a meeting.
By three in the afternoon, the stock market had closed.
But Celestial Aviation’s stocks had hit the upper limit early today, once again soaring a hundred billion in market value, breaking through the 70 billion mark.
For Celestial Aviation, this was a historic moment, and the shareholders were all extremely excited.
And the one who brought all this, Lin Fan, naturally received unanimous praise from the shareholders, who had forgotten the old chairman and completely worshipped Lin Fan.
Mortal Group becoming a trillion-dollar group is within reach.
After all, for them, Celestial Aviation reaching a trillion-dollar market value was inconceivable.
Lin Fan himself was quite calm; just 70 billion in market value was nothing to be excited about. The system’s task was to become a trillion-dollar group, and there was still a long way to go.
After finishing the meeting, it was already five in the afternoon.
Lin Fan left the headquarters building alone and got into the Rolls-Royce.
With nothing much left for the day, Lin Fan planned to return to Yunding Manor.
Just as he was about to start the car, suddenly, a flight attendant passed in front of him, a very pretty one, but her face didn’t look good; she suddenly clutched her stomach and fell to the ground, showing a painful expression.
The flight attendant lifted her head, trying to seek help, instantly seeing Lin Fan in the driver’s seat, and with difficulty, said: "Help me."
Lin Fan frowned and opened the car door, getting out and walking to the flight attendant.
"Are you okay?" Lin Fan asked.
"My stomach hurts so much, maybe I ate something wrong, please, can you take me to the hospital?" the flight attendant pleaded, looking really uncomfortable.
"No problem, I’ll help you get in the car," Lin Fan said, reaching out to help the flight attendant and helping her sit in the passenger seat.
Then Lin Fan returned to the car and drove towards the hospital.
"Thank you, handsome guy, luckily I met you, otherwise I wouldn’t know what to do," the flight attendant said gratefully.
Lin Fan smiled: "No need to thank me."
The flight attendant asked: "Are you also an employee of Tian University?"
Lin Fan replied: "Sort of."
The flight attendant said: "I’m Li Jiaojiao, what’s your name, handsome guy?"
Li Jiaojiao?
Lin Fan felt this name was somewhat familiar, as if he had heard it somewhere before.
"I’m Lin Fan," Lin Fan said.
"Lin Fan... You look unfamiliar, like I haven’t seen you, what do you do at the company? I know you’re definitely not a male flight attendant; I know all our male flight attendants," Li Jiaojiao giggled.
Lin Fan replied: "I’m new, you haven’t seen me before, that’s normal. My job, well, how should I say, it’s considered management."
Lin Fan didn’t directly tell Li Jiaojiao that he was Celestial Aviation’s chairman, her boss.
Li Jiaojiao exclaimed: "Are you a leader? No wonder, driving such a nice car, your identity must be extraordinary, sigh."
Lin Fan curiously asked: "Why sigh?"
Li Jiaojiao replied: "I’m just lamenting that you look younger than me, yet you’ve become part of the management, while I’m still just a small flight attendant."
Lin Fan laughed: "What’s wrong with being a flight attendant? I see many girls want to become flight attendants and envy them."
Li Jiaojiao replied: "What’s to be envious of? It’s just superficial glamour; flight attendants are ultimately just attendants on planes, flying around all day, quite tiring, and not earning much money."
This flight attendant’s mindset seems a bit negative.
"Do you plan to change careers or what? I can help you ask around," Lin Fan smiled and said.
Li Jiaojiao quickly replied: "No need, changing careers is impossible for me; I can’t do other jobs, being a flight attendant suits me."
Lin Fan casually replied: "Alright then."
The two chatted amiably, mostly initiated by Li Jiaojiao, with Lin Fan responding casually.
Suddenly, Li Jiaojiao said: "Lin Fan, can you drop me off at the apartment?"
Lin Fan nodded: "Weren’t you having a stomachache and need to go to the hospital?"
Li Jiaojiao replied: "I feel less pain now, no need to go to the hospital, just going back to the apartment to take some medicine should be fine; I have stomach medicine there."
Lin Fan said: "Alright, where’s your apartment?"
Li Jiaojiao provided an address.
Lin Fan changed direction.
A moment later, they arrived at a hotel-style apartment where Li Jiaojiao lived.
Li Jiaojiao clutched her painful stomach, looking pitifully: "Lin Fan, can you help me up, please?"
Lin Fan agreed readily, got out of the car, and helped Li Jiaojiao out.
Afterwards, Lin Fan supported Li Jiaojiao, arriving at a room on the eighth floor.
Lin Fan helped Li Jiaojiao to sit on the bed, asking: "Where’s the stomach medicine?"
Li Jiaojiao replied: "In the drawer."
Lin Fan went and opened the drawer, indeed finding a box of stomach medicine, then poured a glass of water and brought it for Li Jiaojiao to take.
Li Jiaojiao took the water and medicine, saying: "Thank you. Since you’re already here, though I’m sick, I can’t even offer you a drink; how about you pour yourself some water?"
Lin Fan replied: "No need, I’m not thirsty."
Li Jiaojiao insisted: "It’s necessary, you’re the guest, a drink is a must. Sorry, I’ve had strict upbringing, if my parents saw me not offering a drink to guests, they’d scold me for being ill-mannered."
Lin Fan laughed: "Alright."
So Lin Fan went to the water dispenser, got a cup, and poured himself some water.
But before he could drink it.
Li Jiaojiao’s hand suddenly shook, and the cup tipped over, spilling water all over her.
"Sorry, my stomach hurts a bit, couldn’t hold it steady, Lin Fan, can you get me a towel from the bathroom?" Li Jiaojiao asked.
Lin Fan nodded, put down his cup, and went to the bathroom.
Soon, Lin Fan brought out a towel for Li Jiaojiao.
Li Jiaojiao took the towel, wiping herself, saying: "Thank you, you can continue drinking water now."
Lin Fan chuckled and walked towards his cup.
As his gaze fell on the cup, Lin Fan’s eyes turned sharp, with a hint of cold smile; someone had meddled with this cup!
There was no one else besides Li Jiaojiao; it was her who had tampered with the water.
Why would Li Jiaojiao tamper with his water?
Lin Fan had top-level Insight; in fact, from the beginning, Lin Fan had noticed Li Jiaojiao’s flaw, her claim of stomachache was deceitful.
Why pretend to have a stomachache and ask for his help?
Lin Fan wanted to see what she intended, so he pretended not to know and agreed to take her to the hospital.
Until this moment, Lin Fan discovered that his cup of water had been tampered with, Li Jiaojiao had added something!

chapters.title: Chapter 216 Someone Wants to Target the Mortal Group!
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 216 Someone Wants to Target the Mortal Group!
Flight attendant Li Jiaojiao pretended to be sick and asked Lin Fan for help. Although Lin Fan saw through her act, he still helped her and took her back to her apartment.
Lin Fan wanted to see what exactly she was up to.
It wasn’t until now that Lin Fan discovered that Li Jiaojiao had put something in his water.
What would happen if he drank that glass of water?
Li Jiaojiao watched secretly as Lin Fan picked up the glass, appearing as if he was about to drink, her eyes filled with anticipation.
Yet Lin Fan didn’t drink the water but put the glass back down instead.
He turned and walked to the side of Li Jiaojiao’s bed, took the towel, and smiled, saying, "Are you feeling any better now?"
Li Jiaojiao said, "It still hurts a bit, but I took some medicine and should be fine after resting for a while. Lin Fan, why aren’t you drinking the water?"
Lin Fan said, "Hold on a moment, let me put away the towel for you."
Lin Fan returned the towel to the bathroom, then walked out again, and said suddenly, "I just remembered, Li Jiaojiao, don’t you have a brother named Li Dalong, who’s a manager at a restaurant?"
Li Jiaojiao was taken aback: "You know my brother?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yes, I went to your brother’s restaurant for a meal that day, and after he learned about my identity, he asked me to look after you. I didn’t expect to run into you today."
Li Jiaojiao was a bit surprised and muttered, "My brother asked you to look after me?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it seems your brother is very concerned about you. After learning my identity, the first thing he thought of was you, and he even waived my bill. By the way, I didn’t actually tell you the truth before. My identity is the new chairman of Celestial Aviation."
Li Jiaojiao was stunned, but not because of Lin Fan’s identity, rather because of what Lin Fan had said about her brother.
Lin Fan observed her and smiled, "You don’t seem surprised. Could it be that you knew my identity all along?"
Li Jiaojiao snapped back to reality and immediately became a little flustered: "No, I only just found out now that you’re the chairman!"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Alright then, you’re not feeling well. Would you like me to contact your brother to come and look after you?"
Li Jiaojiao quickly said, "In fact, when I went to the bathroom earlier, I had already contacted your brother for you. Your brother said he’ll be here soon, he should arrive shortly, you don’t mind I took this upon myself, right?"
Li Jiaojiao was a bit surprised but tried hard to hide it: "It’s alright, let him come."
Lin Fan said, "Then you rest for a bit yourself. If there’s nothing else, I’ll be on my way. Oh, by the way, I am actually quite thirsty now."
Saying this, Lin Fan walked over, picked up the glass, and pretended he was about to take a sip.
Li Jiaojiao watched as Lin Fan was about to drink the water, bit her lip, and shouted, "Chairman, don’t drink it!"
Lin Fan wasn’t actually going to drink, he just wanted to make Li Jiaojiao expose herself, either by her own admission under pressure or he would expose her himself.
"What’s the matter?" Lin Fan asked.
Li Jiaojiao blushed, "This glass of water can’t be drunk, I... I added something to it."
Lin Fan nodded, "What did you add?"
Li Jiaojiao stammered, "A kind of drug... If you drink it, you’ll fall into a deep sleep, like being drunk."
Lin Fan’s expression remained calm, "Why did you do this?"
"Because..." Li Jiaojiao lowered her head, afraid to continue.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s alright, speak up. For your brother’s sake, as long as you tell the truth, I won’t pursue it. But if you refuse, I’ll have no choice but to call the police. After all, I’ve already recorded our conversation."
Li Jiaojiao was shocked and quickly said, "Don’t call the police!"
Lin Fan said, "Then you speak, I’m listening."
Li Jiaojiao hesitated for a moment before saying, "A while ago, I met a wealthy man on a plane. We chatted a bit, and when he learned my dad was sick and needed a sum of money, he offered my contact information, saying he could try to help me. I originally thought he was just trying to hit on me, as we flight attendants often meet such people, so I didn’t think much of it. Today he suddenly contacted me, asking me to do something for him. Upon success, he would give me half a million. I thought with that half a million, my dad’s illness could be treated, so..."
Lin Fan said, "What did he want to do?"
Li Jiaojiao said, "He wanted me to get close to you, find a way to lure you here, then drug you unconscious, creating the fake scene that you assaulted me and I knocked you out, and take photos for him... Chairman, when I first heard it was you he was targeting, I refused, but..."
Lin Fan chuckled, "But you couldn’t resist the temptation of money."
Li Jiaojiao’s face turned red with shame.
Lin Fan’s heart sank. Whoever was targeting him was really sinister, attempting to embroil him in a scandal.
If Li Jiaojiao had succeeded, those kinds of photos in the hands of others would surely become a big news story, and he would be ruined, unable to clear his name even if he jumped into the Yellow River.
If not for his top-level insight, he would indeed find it hard to defend!
Under normal circumstances, who would think a flight attendant from his own company, someone he’d never met, would plot against him in such a way!
If this vicious plan succeeded, the consequences would be unimaginable. The first to suffer would surely be Celestial Aviation’s stock price, which might face a catastrophic drop.
Lin Fan coldly laughed in his heart, suspecting this was aimed at Mortal Group.
Someone wanted to take down Mortal Group!
It seemed the Mortal Group’s market value skyrocketing by 20 billion over two days had made some people envious.
As for who it was, Lin Fan had already made up his mind to catch him.
Li Jiaojiao said shamefully, "Chairman, I’m sorry, I shouldn’t have done something so against my conscience for money. I’m really sorry..."
Lin Fan said, "If you’re really sorry, then help me with one thing, tell me who this person is?"
Li Jiaojiao said, "I don’t know his name, I only have his phone number. We agreed that once it was done, I’d give him the photos and he’d give me the money."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, contact him now, tell him you’ve succeeded, and arrange to meet him."
Li Jiaojiao made an "oh" sound, took out her phone, took a new breath, dialed a number, and said, "Hello, I’ve succeeded. Lin Fan is still unconscious, lying on my bed, the photos have been taken as you asked. I don’t want anything to go wrong later, let’s do the exchange now."
The other end was silent for a moment, and then a male voice said, "I need to verify. Send me a photo of him."
Li Jiaojiao said, "Sorry, once I see the money, I will send the photo to you. We agreed it would be cash before the goods."
The other end was silent for another moment before saying, "I’m having dinner at Starlight Restaurant, come over."
The call ended.
Li Jiaojiao looked up at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "Give me the phone, get ready, let’s go to Starlight Restaurant."
Li Jiaojiao said, "My brother is on his way, I’ll call him and tell him to head back."
Lin Fan said, "No need, I didn’t actually call your brother."
He didn’t have Li Dalong’s phone number at all; he was just deceiving Li Jiaojiao earlier to create psychological pressure.
As he spoke, Lin Fan took Li Jiaojiao’s phone to prevent her from tipping anyone off.
Li Jiaojiao broke into a cold sweat, realizing she had been played by Lin Fan. Damn, she initially plotted against Lin Fan, but who’d have thought Lin Fan would counter her at every turn. She simply couldn’t win against Lin Fan. After all, he was a chairman; their levels of intelligence simply weren’t on the same plane...

chapters.title: Chapter 217: The Other Party Is Frustrated, How Did They See Through Someone at a Glance?
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 217: The Other Party Is Frustrated, How Did They See Through Someone at a Glance?
Thinking of this, Li Jiaojiao felt deeply regretful. If she had known it would turn out like this, she wouldn’t have done it.
Inside the Rolls-Royce.
Li Jiaojiao was a bit anxious: "Chairman, I made this mistake. How are you going to punish me?"
Lin Fan said indifferently, "As long as you help me catch the other party, this matter will be wiped clean."
Li Jiaojiao asked, "Can I still continue working at Tian University in the future?"
Lin Fan was silent, not answering the question, but the answer was obvious. He wouldn’t keep Li Jiaojiao, after all, why keep such an employee?
Li Jiaojiao was very dejected, but she couldn’t blame Lin Fan. Anyone would have let her go, and even if Lin Fan was willing to keep her, she herself would struggle with her conscience and eventually be unable to continue.
Li Jiaojiao regretted it too much. Thinking of how her brother once asked Lin Fan to take care of her, she felt even more regretful. She had let Lin Fan down and betrayed her brother!
Inside the Starlight Restaurant.
A private box.
A man in a suit, looking scholarly with glasses, sat in the box enjoying a steak.
The glasses-wearing man moved with great elegance, carrying a scent of high society, appearing to be a well-educated and cultured intellectual.
Xu Yiwen.
A key figure of Feng Wanshan.
He was the one who paid Li Jiaojiao to frame Lin Fan.
Xu Yiwen considered himself very devoted to a faith—and that faith was money. He believed there was nothing money couldn’t solve, so he used it to bribe Li Jiaojiao. He gave Li Jiaojiao a very potent drug, instructing her to find a way to put it in water for Lin Fan to drink.
As long as Lin Fan drank it, he would certainly fall into a deep coma, allowing Li Jiaojiao to manipulate him at will.
Creating a scandal for Lin Fan was just that simple.
Now, Li Jiaojiao had already reported that the task was completed and was on her way to hand over.
Xu Yiwen waited calmly because he believed Li Jiaojiao, for the sake of that 500,000, wouldn’t dare fool him.
Once this was accomplished, he would have helped Feng Wanshan eliminate an enemy. By then, Feng Wanshan would certainly hold him in high regard. Thinking of this, Xu Yiwen felt a bit proud, unconsciously smiling as the steak tasted even better.
Suddenly, Li Jiaojiao hurried over and sat across from Xu Yiwen, looking somewhat wary.
Xu Yiwen swallowed the steak, took a sip of red wine, and smiled, "Don’t worry, there’s no one else here. Come, have a glass of wine to calm your nerves. This is fine French wine, something you probably don’t get to drink often."
Saying so, Xu Yiwen took an empty wine glass and poured Li Jiaojiao a glass of red wine.
Li Jiaojiao accepted the wine, took a big sip, and indeed seemed to calm down as a result.
Xu Yiwen asked, "Did you bring the photos? Let me see."
Li Jiaojiao replied, "I want to see the money first."
Xu Yiwen pulled out his phone, opened the bank account page, and showed it to Li Jiaojiao: "See? A balance of 500,000, prepared just for you. Give me the photos, and it’s yours immediately."
Seeing the balance was indeed 500,000, no more, no less, Li Jiaojiao said, "Transfer the money first, then I’ll give you the photos. I took a big risk with this, and I’ll surely lose my job. I need assurance in case I give you the photos and you default. I hope you understand."
Xu Yiwen chuckled, "There’s no need to worry. I, Mr. Xu, wouldn’t default over a mere 500,000. Alright, I understand your concerns as one of lesser means. Give me your bank account number."
Li Jiaojiao provided a bank account number.
Xu Yiwen made a transfer on his phone, showing Li Jiaojiao the transaction record.
"Now you can be at ease, right? Where are the photos?" Xu Yiwen asked.
After checking the transaction record and feeling reassured, Li Jiaojiao said, "I don’t have any photos."
Xu Yiwen frowned, "What did you say?"
"She said she has no photos, but that’s okay; I’m here in person," said a voice, as Lin Fan turned in from the front, standing across from Xu Yiwen.
Catching sight of Lin Fan suddenly, Xu Yiwen’s expression changed immensely with surprise: "You..."
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m Lin Fan, the one you wanted Li Jiaojiao to frame. This should be your first time seeing me in person, though I’m sure you’ve seen photos of me."
With that, Lin Fan came over and also sat down opposite Xu Yiwen.
Filled with shock and rage, Xu Yiwen glared at Li Jiaojiao, shouting angrily, "You betrayed me! You b****, I gave you 500,000, why did you do this?"
Li Jiaojiao bowed her head; indeed she had betrayed Xu Yiwen, with nothing more to say.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, don’t blame her. She was initially very proactive in your plan, but I saw right through her."
Xu Yiwen was furious, "Idiot, how could you let him see through you..."
Smack!
Before Xu Yiwen could finish speaking, Lin Fan suddenly slapped him across the face, knocking his glasses off, sending them flying to the ground, where they shattered.
Xu Yiwen was stunned by the hit, his face swelling on one side.
Embarrassed—utterly embarrassed, with no trace of his former elegance.
Lin Fan’s expression turned somber: "I told you enough. Why are you still fixating on her? Focus, I want to question you. Tell me, what is your name?"
Half of Xu Yiwen’s face burned with pain, his head in a daze. Damn it, Lin Fan’s slap was fierce. He even felt that if Lin Fan wanted, he could slap his head off.
A shiver ran down his spine.
"Xu, Xu Yiwen, my name is Xu Yiwen." Xu Yiwen replied instinctively, trying to avoid another slap.
Lin Fan said, "Xu Yiwen, I’m pretty sure we’ve never met, no grudges, absolutely no history. Why would you scheme against me?"
Xu Yiwen stuttered, "This..."
Lin Fan sneered, "I see you’re no big shot yourself. You wear a suit, eat steak, performing actions you think only upper-class people do, but your every move seems overly deliberate, as if telling me you’re nothing more than an errand runner. So, tell me, who is your master?"
Xu Yiwen froze.
Dammit!
Are you Sherlock Holmes? How did you see right through someone with just a glance!
Xu Yiwen felt like crying; Lin Fan was surprisingly sharp—this observation was divine. He understood Xu Yiwen’s social standing just from minor actions!
Though indeed, Xu Yiwen’s background wasn’t high, but ever since joining the Shengshi Group and becoming a favorite of Feng Wanshan, his salary and benefits had improved, giving him some wealth, leading him to mimic the lifestyle of high society.
He thought he had put on quite a show, yet Lin Fan saw through it all with one glance.
Yet Xu Yiwen didn’t want to admit it, saying, "I have no master. I planned this all myself. I’m just a person who cannot stand you."
Lin Fan made a sound of understanding: "Can’t stand?"
Xu Yiwen said, "Just think of it as jealousy. Seeing Celestial Aviation’s stock soar, I wanted to target you. Since I’ve been exposed, do what you want, call the police on me. It doesn’t matter."
He had resolved not to betray Feng Wanshan, bearing the burden himself.
Lin Fan shook his head, "You can’t lie, can you? I can tell at first glance you’re lying."
Xu Yiwen chuckled, "Mr. Lin, maybe your observational skills are impressive, but unfortunately, you can’t read the answer you want from my micro-expressions. How about this: I suggest you call the police on me. I haven’t even finished this steak, so I’ll keep eating while waiting for the police."
Xu Yiwen’s tone revealed a touch of pride. He was willing to take the fall, no longer fearing Lin Fan. As he spoke, Xu Yiwen picked up his knife and fork, intending to continue eating the steak calmly.
However, just as he touched the cutlery, in the next second, the fork was snatched by Lin Fan, who flipped it over, stabbing it fiercely into Xu Yiwen’s hand, pinning it to the table.
In extreme pain, Xu Yiwen had no time to scream before Lin Fan’s other hand clamped tightly over his mouth, preventing any sound from escaping.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: The Furious Boss
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 218: The Furious Boss
Xu Yiwen was drenched in cold sweat, his face turning blue from the pain, veins bulging, and in extreme discomfort.
Lin Fan’s action frightened Li Jiaojiao beside him, her face turning pale. Oh my, that was ruthless. The thought of having plotted against Lin Fan before made her shiver in fear. Thankfully, she had turned back in time, and Lin Fan didn’t treat her that way.
"I’ll say it again, tell me your boss’s name, or your hand will be crippled," Lin Fan said coldly, holding the fork handle and gently twisting it.
Xu Yiwen was in unbearable agony and couldn’t hold out any longer; he had to nod.
Lin Fan said, "Use your other hand to write down his name on the table."
Xu Yiwen nodded and then dipped his finger in the red wine to write a name on the table.
"Feng Wanshan!"
Lin Fan’s gaze turned cold.
Xu Yiwen belonged to Feng Wanshan!
"Were you also the ones who caused trouble for Liu Jinshan today?" Lin Fan asked in a deep voice.
Xu Yiwen shook his head, "Liu Jinshan? I don’t know."
Lin Fan could see Xu Yiwen wasn’t lying. It seemed likely that someone else was behind the trouble with Liu Jinshan.
For now, he wouldn’t worry about that.
That scoundrel Feng Wanshan dared to provoke him again, this time using such vicious means to fabricate a scandal, trying to ruin him completely.
With Mortal Group’s market value rising to 70 billion, Shengshi Group, one of the three major billion-dollar groups in Yun City, felt the pressure first.
Moreover, Feng Wanshan had past conflicts with Lin Fan, attempting to strike against Mortal Group was a very obvious motive.
Lin Fan instructed, "Call Feng Wanshan and put it on speaker."
Xu Yiwen, being coerced, had no choice but to obey. He unlocked his phone, dialed Feng Wanshan, and put it on speaker.
Feng Wanshan quickly answered the call, "Old Xu, I’m having dinner, so, any good news?"
Xu Yiwen, being subdued by Lin Fan, couldn’t speak at all.
Lin Fan spoke calmly, "Boss Feng, recognize my voice? What good news are you expecting to hear?"
A villa, Feng Wanshan’s residence.
Feng Wanshan was sitting at the dining table having soup. Upon hearing Lin Fan’s voice, he was startled so much that he spilled the soup, utterly shocked: "Lin, Lin Fan!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Boss Feng, good deeds you’ve done, huh? Last time I let you off without cutting off your ear; it seems that was a mistake. You really don’t learn, do you?"
Feng Wanshan’s face turned blue with anger.
Lin Fan said, "This time is even worse than last time. Trying to create a scandal for me? In comparison, hiring some thugs to cause trouble is just a small matter. Too bad your scheme was still seen through by me. Surprised? Caught off guard?"
Feng Wanshan suppressed his anger, "Where is Old Xu?"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, he’s fine. You’ll see him soon enough."
Xu Yiwen was sweating profusely. Fine my ass, with a fork in his hand, it hurt like hell.
Feng Wanshan said in a serious tone, "Lin Fan, it’s true that Old Xu is my subordinate, but whatever he did, I have no knowledge of, I don’t know what you’re talking about."
Lin Fan chuckled, "You’re bluffing. It’s something you guys planned, right? So if something goes wrong, you can wash your hands clean. But do you think you can wash them clean on this matter? Rest assured, I will slowly settle the score with you."
After speaking, Lin Fan pressed the hang-up button.
Feng Wanshan claimed ignorance, but Lin Fan certainly didn’t believe a word of it, nor did he bother to listen to his excuses.
Bang!
Feng Wanshan slammed the table in anger and jumped up. He was infuriated; Xu Yiwen’s plan had seemed perfect, yet it failed again!
How on earth did Lin Fan see through it?
The last thing Lin Fan said about settling the score made Feng Wanshan a bit uneasy, not knowing what Lin Fan planned to do.
He was indeed a little afraid of Lin Fan now; this guy was too difficult to deal with.
Feng Wanshan thought about it and made a call to Anna: "Listen, I don’t care what method you use, I want to know Lin Fan’s background by tonight, I need to know Lin Beixuan’s identity!"
Anna was a bit surprised, "Why?"
Feng Wanshan initially sent her to infiltrate Lin Fan’s side to find out Lin Fan’s background. This task had always been approached by Feng Wanshan with a gradual attitude, letting her slowly gather clues, waiting for Lin Fan to reveal it himself.
But this time, Feng Wanshan seemed eager to get the answer immediately, as if provoked by something?
Feng Wanshan said irritably, "Don’t ask so many questions. Just do what I say. Think about your father; don’t mess this up for me!"
After saying this, Feng Wanshan hung up the phone.
Anna was taken aback holding the phone.
Did she hear wrong? Feng Wanshan actually threatened her using her father, An Jincheng!
Anna felt like a deep wound had been torn open in her heart.
Starlight Restaurant.
After hanging up on Feng Wanshan, Lin Fan handed the phone back to Xu Yiwen, then promptly pulled the fork out of his hand.
Blood gushed from the back of Xu Yiwen’s hand.
Xu Yiwen’s face went pale with pain.
"What are you going to do with me?" Xu Yiwen asked. Lin Fan was a ruthless man; he had no idea what Lin Fan might do next.
Lin Fan smiled faintly and stood up, "Never mind, continue eating your steak. It’s getting cold, so finish it quickly and then go back to see your boss."
Xu Yiwen was somewhat surprised that Lin Fan just let him off like that?
Lin Fan and Li Jiaojiao were already leaving, but after a few steps, Lin Fan stopped, "Oh, right, about finding Li Jiaojiao to do such disgraceful things; those 500,000 can be considered her hardship fee. Don’t think of asking it back from her."
Xu Yiwen nearly cried. The 500,000 he had generously given Li Jiaojiao was clearly a scheme by Lin Fan.
It must have been Lin Fan who taught Li Jiaojiao to scam him out of his money!
Now that Lin Fan had a hold over him, with Lin Fan saying this, he naturally didn’t dare to trouble Li Jiaojiao.
Thus, with a small ploy, Lin Fan although failed in having Li Jiaojiao accomplish her task, still managed to acquire 500,000 from Xu Yiwen.
At this moment, Li Jiaojiao was ecstatic. She never even dared to think she would get that 500,000.
Following Lin Fan out of Starlight Restaurant, she got into the Rolls-Royce.
Li Jiaojiao gratefully said, "Thank you, Chairman, I didn’t expect you’d help me."
Lin Fan said, "That money should be enough for your dad’s treatment, right?"
Li Jiaojiao nodded, "Yes, it’s enough."
Lin Fan’s tone turned cold, "Well then, considering you turned back from the edge today, I won’t pursue this. But don’t let me see you again. Get out of the car!"
Li Jiaojiao was stunned, then turned beet red, not daring to say a word, silently opening the car door and getting out.
Bang!
Lin Fan closed the car door, then drove away.
Watching the Rolls-Royce depart, Li Jiaojiao felt as if something precious had left her. She was filled with regret, fearing this might be something she’d regret for a lifetime.
After leaving Li Jiaojiao behind, Lin Fan drove back to Yunding Manor.
On the way, Lin Fan made a call to Zhang Dafu: "Help me gather information on Shengshi Group, tomorrow."
Zhang Dafu curiously asked, "Shengshi Group, boss, what’s the plan?"
Lin Fan said calmly, "Shut it down!"
Zhang Dafu was a bit excited, was the boss planning to make trouble for Shengshi Group? He had long disdained Feng Wanshan.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 Anna’s Schemes
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 219 Anna’s Schemes
Lin Fan hadn’t arrived at Yunding Manor yet when he received a call from Anna.
"Master, I’m preparing dinner. Are you coming back to eat tonight?" Anna asked.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, I’m on my way back and haven’t eaten yet."
Anna replied, "Alright, I know."
When Lin Fan returned to Yunding Manor, Anna wasn’t waiting at the entrance as usual. She was in the kitchen, preparing dinner for him.
Since becoming the housekeeper of Yunding Manor, Anna had managed the place well, hiring the best gardeners to tend to the garden, hiring the best security guards, and even finding the best chef in Yun City to cook for Lin Fan.
Although Lin Fan rarely dined at the manor these days, whenever he did, the meals were always the best.
But tonight, Anna didn’t let the chef cook; instead, she chose to cook herself, perhaps on a whim.
On the dining table, there was wine and meat.
Lin Fan was a bit curious and asked, "Why the special mood tonight?"
Anna brought the food to the table and said, "I’m mostly healed now. Some activity helps with recovery, Master. There’s also soup coming."
Anna went back to the kitchen and quickly brought out a pot of soup.
"Master, may I sit down and eat with you for this meal?" Anna asked.
Lin Fan found it a bit strange but didn’t mind. "Of course, you worked hard cooking this meal, and with a beautiful lady accompanying me, who would refuse?"
Anna said, "Ultimately, you’re the master, and I’m the servant. In high society, servants aren’t qualified to dine with their masters."
Lin Fan laughed, "Though I’m your employer, I don’t see your status as inferior. To hell with high society, sit down."
"Okay." Anna was somewhat moved. In the world of the wealthy, Lin Fan was truly unconventional.
High society’s rules meant nothing to Lin Fan.
So, Anna sat down and ate with Lin Fan.
This was their first time dining together. Anna, usually reserved and aloof, hadn’t even cared to dine with Lin Fan before, but tonight she took the initiative.
She didn’t have to do it, but she wanted to.
"Anna, is everything alright?" Lin Fan noticed something amiss and asked.
Anna was behaving unusually tonight.
Anna paused and said, "Master, there’s something I want to tell you tonight. This might be my last night at Yunding Manor. After tonight, I plan to officially resign."
Lin Fan was taken aback, surprised: "Why?"
Anna said, "I can’t tell you the reason, and please don’t ask. Just know it."
Lin Fan sighed, "So this is why you cooked for me personally? Is this like a farewell dinner?"
Anna remained silent.
Lin Fan paused, then said, "What if I say I won’t accept your resignation?"
Anna smiled, "You should know, I don’t care if you accept it or not."
Lin Fan smiled wryly, indeed, what could he do if she wanted to leave? He couldn’t tie her down.
"Alright, though I admire your work, if you’ve decided to leave, I probably can’t persuade you to stay. But don’t worry, I’ll make sure your salary is settled. I’m not a boss who delays payment," Lin Fan smiled.
Anna said, "Thank you."
Anna picked up the pot of wine on the table, poured Lin Fan a glass, and then poured herself one.
"This wine is like a farewell for me. I toast to you," Anna picked up the glass and drank it in one go.
Lin Fan followed suit, finishing his wine in one gulp.
Anna watched him drink, a barely noticeable smile playing on her lips.
"Master, you don’t seem like a drinker. After one glass, your face turned a little red," Anna said.
Lin Fan replied, "I’m not fond of alcohol, but I think I handle it well enough not to pass out after one drink."
As he spoke, Lin Fan reached for the dishes, but his chopsticks trembled slightly, as if his hand lacked strength.
Anna said, "You claim you’re not drunk, but you can’t even hold onto your chopsticks."
Clatter.
Before he finished speaking, the chopsticks slipped from Lin Fan’s hand. His hands fell weakly, and he slumped in his chair, his whole body powerless, unable to move.
Lin Fan’s expression changed as he looked at Anna in shock, "What did you do to me?"
Anna calmly put down her chopsticks and looked at Lin Fan with a steady gaze, "The wine you just drank, I added a drug to it, making you temporarily unable to move."
Lin Fan angrily demanded, "Why did you do this to me?"
Anna said, "Because you’re stronger than me. If I didn’t do this, I wouldn’t be able to overpower you. I just want to ask you a few questions and hope you can answer me honestly."
Lin Fan regained his composure and said, "What do you want to know?"
Anna said, "Tell me about your background and the identity of Lin Beixuan. I want to hear the truth."
Lin Fan frowned, "You just want to know this?"
Anna said, "That’s right, you’d better not lie. If I find out you’re lying, I won’t hesitate to hurt you, so don’t hurt yourself."
Lin Fan laughed, "If that’s all you want to know, there’s no need to do this. If you asked directly, I would have told you."
Anna remained silent, waiting for Lin Fan to continue.
Lin Fan said, "If you’re so concerned about my background, you’ve probably investigated it already. Just as you know, for the past 21 years, I’ve been an ordinary nobody, with farmer parents and working as a deliveryman. Until I met my uncle Lin Beixuan, who gave me a fortune. I’ve mentioned this before, and you were there."
Of course, he couldn’t tell the "truth" about this matter, even if he did, it was because he obtained a system. Anna likely wouldn’t believe him; it was too far-fetched, and she’d assume he was mocking her.
Might as well stick with the fabricated "uncle."
After all, he did have an uncle who disappeared when he was young.
Anna said, "And Lin Beixuan, who is he really? Where is he now? How did he come to possess such a huge fortune?"
Lin Fan said, "I only met him once. He gave me a fortune and disappeared. I don’t know the answers to what you’re asking. I don’t know how my uncle gained such wealth after being missing for so long or where he is now."
Anna said, "Recently in Yun City, you’ve been spending lavishly, acquiring companies, buying mansions, luxury cars, and land, even establishing the Mortal Group, claiming you want to be the king of Jiangnan’s business world. Did Lin Beixuan instruct you to do this?"
Lin Fan said, "No, it was my own decision."
Anna’s face darkened, "You’re lying! You’re just a deliveryman. Without guidance, how could you possibly know how to do any of this?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Thank you for the compliment."
Anna was furious, stepping in front of Lin Fan, grabbing his collar, "Enough with the smiles, I said if you lie, I won’t be polite!"
Anna raised her hand, as if to hit Lin Fan.
Before her hand could fall.
Lin Fan suddenly said, "So, Feng Wanshan sent you undercover beside me, just to investigate my background?"
"What?"
Anna was shocked, her raised hand froze in midair.
Lin Fan, he actually knew she was sent by Feng Wanshan?

chapters.title: Chapter 220 Anna in Shock: How Did You Know?
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 220 Anna in Shock: How Did You Know?
Anna looked at Lin Fan in astonishment.
Lin Fan’s sudden words shocked her: "How did you..."
Lin Fan said, "I knew from the very beginning, even before you started applying for the position of a housekeeper at Yunding Manor."
Back when Lin Fan was still a delivery man, one day he delivered food to Shengshi Group and met Feng Wanshan and Anna. Afterward, Anna surprisingly appeared on the list of applicants for Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan knew then that Anna was an undercover sent by Feng Wanshan, but he never knew the purpose behind Feng Wanshan’s actions.
Until now.
Anna controlled him and interrogated his background.
So, Feng Wanshan’s elaborate plan was just to find out about his background?
On that day, Zhang Dafu represented Lin Fan to bid for Yunding Manor. To keep a low profile, he participated under the name "Mr. Lin," and thus the name of the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin shocked Yun City.
After Feng Wanshan failed, he was unwilling to give up and was determined to find out Mr. Lin’s identity. Later, learning that Yunding Manor was hiring a housekeeper, he sent Anna to apply. After entering Yunding Manor, Anna discovered that Lin Fan was the master of the manor.
However, Feng Wanshan, seeing Lin Fan’s young age, did not believe that Lin Fan was Mr. Lin, thinking Lin Fan was just a facade, and Mr. Lin was someone else.
Later, Su Jinjin asked Lin Fan where his wealth came from, and to deflect, Lin Fan fabricated an uncle named Lin Beixuan.
Upon learning of "Lin Beixuan’s" existence, Feng Wanshan concluded that Lin Beixuan was Mr. Lin, the person behind Lin Fan.
Feng Wanshan wanted to find Lin Beixuan to better deal with Lin Fan.
And Lin Beixuan was actually the system, and Feng Wanshan knew nothing about the power of the system. To deal with Lin Fan was to go against the system.
Anna was astonished: "You knew from the start that I was sent by my foster father, so why did you still let me succeed?"
Because the system gave Lin Fan a task to win over Anna, he had no choice but to let her succeed.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Because I wanted to know what Feng Wanshan really wanted, but that wasn’t the main reason. The main reason is that your resume was so outstanding, far surpassing others, that I found it hard to refuse."
Even someone as aloof as Anna couldn’t help but feel a bit proud at such straightforward praise.
Anna bit her lip: "Stop with the sweet talk, do you think I’ll let you go? Even if you knew my identity from the start, so what? You’re still under my control now, so we can speak freely."
Lin Fan sighed and said, "Everything I told you is true, there’s nothing I can do if you don’t believe me."
Anna said, "I’ll ask you one more time, what is Lin Beixuan’s identity and where is he now?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "I’ve already told you, I don’t know."
Anna clenched her teeth: "If you won’t tell, don’t blame me!"
Anna drew a small knife from her waist.
Lin Fan was taken aback: "What do you intend to do?"
Anna said, "If you don’t tell the truth, I’ll cut your leg, sever your artery, and let you bleed. If I don’t stop the bleeding, you’ll die within half an hour, so you’d better be prepared to reveal the truth quickly after I do it!"
Lin Fan sweated: "That’s too harsh, can you really bring yourself to do something so cruel?"
Anna coldly said, "Are you testing my patience?"
Lin Fan said, "I am your master after all, haven’t I treated you well since you arrived? Don’t you feel even a little moved? Besides, as handsome as I am, can you really bear to hurt me?"
Anna’s heart seemed to take a hit, her gaze became somewhat different.
Scenes of her interactions with Lin Fan flashed through her mind: that night at the charity ball when she got drunk and Lin Fan drove her back to the manor, sitting on the sofa with her all night, and the night of the challenge when she was hurt by Muay Thai Li San, and Lin Fan helped her heal... and again at the charity ball, when Lin Fan donned a custom top-tier suit, she instantly fell for him...
How could she forget, she even found it unbelievable herself, that she would have such shy feelings for Lin Fan.
But, at the thought of her father, at the thought of needing Feng Wanshan’s help to find her father...
The strange look in Anna’s eyes gradually disappeared.
"No, if you won’t speak, I won’t hesitate to hurt you!" Anna gritted her teeth, her eyes now only cold.
Seeing this, Lin Fan shook his head: "Is Feng Wanshan worth you doing this for him?"
Anna coldly said, "I’m not doing it for him."
Lin Fan said, "It’s for your father, right?"
Anna’s face changed as she stared at Lin Fan: "What did you say?"
Lin Fan actually knew about her father too?
Damn, how does Lin Fan seem to know everything, how does he do it?
