Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "15 years ago, your father, An Jincheng, mysteriously disappeared, and you’ve been looking for him with no leads. After your father’s disappearance, Feng Wanshan, a friend of your father, took you in as his adopted daughter, sponsored your education, and even spent a lot of money hiring private investigators to search for your father. Am I right?"
Bingo!
Anna couldn’t help but be surprised: "How do you know this?"
Lin Fan said, "By coincidence, on the day you took leave, I happened to go to Shengshi Mansion again, and I saw Feng Wanshan and Qian Wu. You went to see them that day, right? They told you they had a lead on your father."
Anna was stunned, Lin Fan really knew everything.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Not only do I know what you know, I also know things you don’t. Feng Wanshan and Qian Wu have been lying to you all along!"
Anna was shocked: "Stop trying to sow discord here, how could my foster father deceive me?"
Lin Fan said, "Qian Wu told me personally, believe it or not. Feng Wanshan has been pretending to help you find your father, but in reality, Qian Wu hasn’t done anything because there’s no lead on this matter, you’re the only one kept in the dark."
Anna angrily said, "You’re lying, my foster father wouldn’t treat me like this, Qian Wu recently traced my father to possibly being in Southeast Asia, and my foster father just gave him 5 million to buy information!"
Lin Fan said, "That’s fake."
Anna excitedly said, "Why would my foster father do this?"
Lin Fan said, "Because he needs you to work for him, and your father is your weakness. That’s the only way he can grasp your weakness, and for your father, you have no choice but to obey his commands. If I’m not mistaken, tonight’s action was something he forced you to do, right? I can tell you don’t want to hurt me."
Anna calmed down and coldly said, "Do you have any evidence for what you’re saying?"
Lin Fan said, "The evidence is on my phone, I recorded my entire conversation with Qian Wu."
Recording is a good habit, and Lin Fan is a master at it.
Anna then took Lin Fan’s phone, found a recording, and it was exactly the conversation when Lin Fan, in disguise, interrogated Qian Wu.
Anna naturally recognized Qian Wu’s voice.
After listening to their conversation, Anna collapsed weakly into a nearby chair.
Lin Fan’s words she could choose not to believe, but Qian Wu’s words in the recording, she had no choice but to believe!
All these years, her foster father had been seemingly spending money to help her find her father An Jincheng, but in reality, he hadn’t been searching at all, and he and Qian Wu had been deceiving her all along!
And she, like a fool, was played by them!

chapters.title: Chapter 221: The Mysterious Tycoon Mr. Lin, Exposed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 221: The Mysterious Tycoon Mr. Lin, Exposed!
After listening to the recording, Anna was completely stunned, collapsing weakly onto the chair, her hands falling powerlessly, the knife in her hand dropping to the floor.
The truth hit her with such force that it was hard for her to recover immediately.
The foster father she trusted and revered had deceived her about the matter she cared about the most!
How could she possibly accept this!
Anything else could be forgiven, but this was about her father. For the past 15 years, the most important thing in her life was searching for her father.
If someone understands her longing, how could they use this matter to deceive and exploit her!
But that’s exactly what happened!
Her respected foster father deceived her and used her search for her father to control her!
Over the years, because of gratitude to Feng Wanshan, she did whatever he asked without hesitation, like the undercover mission at Yunding Manor. With just one call from Feng Wanshan, she dropped her previous work and returned to Yun City.
Never expected, it was all fake!
Following her shock, Anna was consumed by boundless anger.
Why did Feng Wanshan do this?
Was it just to control her, making her willingly work for him?
Lin Fan said, "The disappearance of your father back then was quite odd. Due to the lack of surveillance at that time, it’s very difficult to find clues. I now suspect that Feng Wanshan might know something, that’s why he deceived you."
Anna’s expression turned grim.
Though Lin Fan didn’t say it directly, the implication was clear.
He suspects that An Jincheng’s disappearance is related to Feng Wanshan!
This speculation is truly shocking.
Anna became somewhat emotional, took out her phone, and intended to call Feng Wanshan. She wanted to ask him personally.
Lin Fan said, "If you ask him now, it will ruin our plans. If he really is involved in your father’s disappearance, he certainly won’t admit it. After all, he should be confident we have no evidence, and even if there is evidence, he will destroy it."
Anna’s hand already opened the contact list, but Lin Fan’s words made her hand freeze.
Lin Fan made a lot of sense; they couldn’t alert the snake!
Lin Fan said, "If you want to find your father, you need to continue gaining Feng Wanshan’s trust, return to his side and investigate secretly."
Anna nodded, agreeing with Lin Fan’s words.
Lin Fan said, "Besides, I’ll help you too. Actually, concerning your father’s disappearance, I have some clues already and I’m following up. It’s likely we might find something."
Anna’s eyes lit up, "What clue?"
Lin Fan said, "I looked over your father’s case file at the police and discovered that one of his colleagues might be hiding something. This is the only clue I found in the case files and might be the key to solving the case."
Anna frowned, "Who is my father’s colleague?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I won’t tell you for now, but if I make progress, I’ll let you know. It depends on whether you’re willing to cooperate with me."
Anna gritted her teeth, "What do you want to do?"
Lin Fan said, "I want you to leave Yunding Manor, return to Feng Wanshan’s side, and be my insider."
"What?" Anna was shocked.
She was originally sent by Feng Wanshan as a spy beside Lin Fan, but now it’s reversed; she has to be a spy beside Feng Wanshan!
This turn of events is truly absurd.
However, this all seems reasonable. Now that she knows Feng Wanshan deceived her, she needs to seek the truth, and Lin Fan can help her!
She has no other choice but to cooperate with Lin Fan.
Anna said, "What do you want me to do?"
Lin Fan said, "Isn’t Feng Wanshan forcing you to investigate my background? Then let’s play along, and you’ll deliver a message for me to him."
Then, Lin Fan instructed Anna accordingly.
After listening, Anna said, "Alright, I got it."
Lin Fan smiled, "There’s one more thing. Tomorrow, I plan to cause some trouble for Feng Wanshan. Do you have any suggestions?"
Anna thought for a moment, then told Lin Fan something.
Lin Fan pondered, "Interesting..."
Anna looked at Lin Fan, with a trace of guilt in her eyes, "I’m sorry, I was compelled by Feng Wanshan before, and that’s why I resorted to such means tonight. I’ll give you the antidote now."
They drank wine together, but she had taken the antidote in advance, so she was fine.
Lin Fan had no antidote, so he fell for it.
Lin Fan chuckled, "No need, I’ve already recovered my mobility."
Anna disbelievingly said, "Impossible, if you took my Soft Bone Powder, you couldn’t regain strength so quickly."
But suddenly Lin Fan sat up straight and leisurely picked up the chopsticks that fell on the table, taking a piece of meat.
"I’m really fine now; just haven’t eaten yet, feeling a bit hungry. Do you want to finish this meal with me before leaving?" Lin Fan smiled.
Anna was stunned, "How, how could this be?"
Oh my! Lin Fan actually regained his mobility!
She naturally didn’t know, ever since Lin Fan took the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, a mysterious power emerged in his body that initially succumbed to her Soft Bone Powder, but subsequently, as they talked, Lin Fan’s internal power moved, completely eliminating the powder’s effects.
So Anna’s earlier threat to cut Lin Fan’s femoral artery was never going to succeed!
Thinking of this, Anna couldn’t help but feel a bit scared; Lin Fan was simply as strong as a monster!
Anyways, since she started practicing martial arts, she had never seen someone as formidable as Lin Fan.
Of course, Lin Fan wouldn’t explain to her that he took the Strengthening Capsules; he simply said, "Maybe it’s my physique issue, but anyhow, I’m fine quickly."
Anna broke out in a cold sweat; she originally thought her plan succeeded, making Lin Fan fall, only to find out that Lin Fan had everything set clearly!
She was impressed by Lin Fan.
That night.
Anna left Yunding Manor overnight and called Feng Wanshan: "I’ve got the answer you wanted, but I can’t stay at Yunding Manor anymore; I’m coming to find you now."
Feng Wanshan’s villa.
Feng Wanshan received Anna in his study late at night.
"Tell me," Feng Wanshan said.
Anna said, "I subdued Lin Fan and forced him to tell the truth..."
The next day.
Early morning, before the market opened, an explosive news spread in the business community.
Lin Fan’s background was revealed!
Lin Fan turns out to not be a member of the Kyoto Lin Family but just a farmer’s son, inheriting his uncle Lin Beixuan’s billion-dollar estate, and Lin Beixuan left him the property because he had cancer and was dying without heirs.
After gaining Lin Beixuan’s estate, Lin Fan recklessly spent money, even bought Celestial Aviation and Zhou Tian Mansion, having squandered all the assets!
The news shocked the business world.
If the news is true, Celestial Aviation’s stock price will surely plummet, ushering in a disastrous scene once the market opens.
However.
Mortal Group rapidly issued a statement refuting the rumors, clarifying that the news was purely fabricated.
Lin Beixuan isn’t dead; he is the mysterious tycoon Lin Mr. Lin who recently spent billions, purchasing Yunding Manor and Chiba Island!
Mr. Lin not only isn’t dead, but he plans to come to Yun City soon, carrying billions to develop Chiba Island, and Lin Fan is indeed the nephew of Lin Beixuan Mr. Lin.
Everything Lin Fan did was upon Lin Beixuan’s instruction, whose goal is to build a trillion-dollar group in Yun City!
This refutation was like thunder from the clear sky.
The revelation of the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin in Yun City was astonishing!
At 9:30 am, the market opened.
Celestial Aviation stock prices soared again!
At the same time, at Yunding Manor, Lin Fan sat in the living room, looking at the information Zhang Dafu sent over about Shengshi Group, with a cold smile.
A bomb aimed at Shengshi Group was poised to explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 222: The Best Part is Yet to Come, Angering the Opponent
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 222: The Best Part is Yet to Come, Angering the Opponent
Shengshi Group.
Before the market opens.
Feng Wanshan returned to the company early, and a rumor about Lin Fan’s background, spread by his manipulation, instantly caused a huge sensation.
"According to reliable sources, Lin Fan is not a scion of the Kyoto Lin Family but comes from a rural background and originally was a deliveryman. Lin Fan inherited his uncle Lin Beixuan’s multi-billion fortune. Lin Beixuan was a hidden tycoon who, due to having cancer and no heir, left his estate to Lin Fan."
"After inheriting the billion-dollar fortune, Lin Fan spent lavishly, and has now used up all his wealth!"
As soon as the news came out, all sectors were filled with lively discussions.
"Damn, I thought he was a prince of the Kyoto Lin Family!"
"Turns out he’s not, just a sudden rich upstart!"
"So he’s a poor man suddenly rich, no wonder he’d spend money crazily and even squander it all away!"
"No way, he’s not a prince of the Kyoto Lin Family, what a disappointment."
"I said it a long time ago, how can a prince of the Kyoto Lin Family possibly come to Yun City."
Everyone started to mock, and the internet was flooded with voices ridiculing Lin Fan.
Seeing these comments, Feng Wanshan was overjoyed.
It could be expected that as soon as the market opened, the market value of Mortal Group would definitely plummet.
However, Feng Wanshan wasn’t happy for long before Mortal Group came out to debunk the rumors.
The statement from Mortal Group declared that Lin Beixuan is indeed the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin who has been making waves in Yun City lately!
Lin Beixuan does not have cancer and is not short of money, and he is about to bring billions in cash to Yun City to develop Chiba Island!
Lin Fan is Lin Beixuan’s representative, and the recent furious acquisition spree was at Lin Beixuan’s direction, with the aim of building a trillion-dollar group.
This statement shocked Yun City once again.
The identity of the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin was publicly revealed for the first time!
It turns out Mortal Group actually belongs to Mr. Lin!
"The identity of the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin has finally been unveiled!"
"Oh my, is he the Mr. Lin who bought Yunding Manor and Chiba Island!"
"Mr. Lin is amazing, buying so many assets, just how rich is he!"
"I’m really looking forward to Mr. Lin coming to Yun City!"
"Even if Lin Fan isn’t from the Kyoto Lin Family, Mr. Lin, with his wealth, what exactly is his identity?"
For a while, Mr. Lin became the hot topic among the crowd, with the market optimistic and anticipating that Mr. Lin would invest billions to develop the golden zone of Daya Bay Chiba Island, with limitless prospects.
At 9:30 in the morning, the market opened.
The stock price of Celestial Aviation soared again, climbing all the way up, surging nearly 200 million from a market value of 700 million, approaching 900 million!
"Ah!"
In Shengshi Group, sitting in the office and watching the stock market trends, Feng Wanshan let out a tragic cry, almost spitting blood.
It was only then he realized he had been played by Lin Fan!
Last night, Anna pressed Lin Fan about information on Lin Beixuan, and the news Anna finally brought back was that Lin Beixuan had cancer and left his estate to the poor boy Lin Fan at the end of his life.
Feng Wanshan was extremely happy and immediately instructed to spread the news, as long as the outside world knows that Lin Fan is not a prince of the Kyoto Lin Family, it would undoubtedly cause the market to be pessimistic, and the stock price of Celestial Aviation would certainly plummet!
Who knew!
The tables turned, and Mortal Group quickly debunked the rumor, as if they had already prepared for it from the start.
It was completely prepared.
This tactic of spreading rumors first and quickly debunking them was simply perfect hype!
Lin Fan deliberately told Anna false information!
Feng Wanshan thus inadvertently assisted Lin Fan in creating hype!
Realizing this, Feng Wanshan was almost so angry he could cough up blood.
Anna’s call came in right after.
"You still have the face to call me, your so-called good news!" Feng Wanshan scolded as soon as he picked up.
"Godfather, that was indeed what Lin Fan told me last night, you must believe me, we’ve all been deceived by him! Should I go find him to settle the score now?" Anna’s voice carried anger and apprehension.
Feng Wanshan sneered: "You want to settle the score with him, are you even his match?"
Anna said: "But he tricked me, I can’t swallow this anger!"
Feng Wanshan said: "Calm down, I’ll deal with him myself!"
Feng Wanshan hung up the phone.
On the other end of the call, Anna let out a cold laugh; calling this was naturally to dispel Feng Wanshan’s suspicions.
Then, Anna called Lin Fan: "Your plan succeeded, Feng Wanshan is going mad seeing Mortal Group’s stock price soar."
Lin Fan said lightly: "That’s enough to drive him crazy? The real show is yet to come."
Lin Fan went along with the ploy, using Feng Wanshan to promote Mortal Group, and created the Mr. Lin sensation, causing the stock price of Mortal Group to surge again.
But that wasn’t the main act.
Feng Wanshan actually dared to use underhanded means, bribing his flight attendant to try to create a scandal for him.
Lin Fan couldn’t just let it go without giving him a return gift!
Not long after that.
A scandal about Shengshi Group suddenly broke out.
It was an old story, a year ago in one of Shengshi Group’s real estate developments, a young woman ended her life by jumping.
At the time, Shengshi Group handled it discreetly without much fuss.
However, today it suddenly emerged that this woman who took her own life was actually Feng Wanshan’s mistress, who, after being abandoned by him, committed suicide at Shengshi Group’s property, trying to retaliate against Feng Wanshan.
The scandal broke out and instantly shocked the internet.
"No way, isn’t Feng Wanshan the head of Shengshi Group!"
"Turns out she was a mistress!"
"Truly a scandal from the wealthy!"
"Isn’t that Feng guy even human?"
"Scumbag, despicable man!"
The internet was filled with curses.
In Shengshi Group, in Feng Wanshan’s office, while he was still troubled by the Mortal Group matter, he suddenly saw this news and was taken aback.
The first thought that crossed Feng Wanshan’s mind was that someone had set him up.
"PR department, issue a clarification immediately!" Feng Wanshan ordered in anger and haste.
Following that, Shengshi Group issued a denial statement, refuting the rumors and threatening outsiders not to spread them further, or face warnings from their lawyers!
However, after Shengshi Group’s denial statement, a series of photos surfaced, showing Feng Wanshan in intimate situations with the woman who committed suicide!
These photos confirmed the close relationship between Feng Wanshan and the woman who committed suicide!
Solid evidence!
The internet exploded.
"The denial from Shengshi Group is a real slap in the face!"
"Is this what they call asking for concrete evidence?"
"Threatening us not to spread rumors, this isn’t even a rumor!"
"Who’s spreading rumors, isn’t this the truth!"
"This is killing me, solid evidence!"
Seeing the photos circulating on the internet, Feng Wanshan’s face turned pale, and he slumped into his chair.
"Who did this, who is targeting me?"
"Lin Fan!"
"It must be Lin Fan!"
Feng Wanshan roared; besides Lin Fan, he couldn’t think of anyone else, it was clear Lin Fan was retaliating against him!
"Lin Fan, you wait, I will never let you go!" Feng Wanshan was deeply hateful towards Lin Fan.
He was planning to find a way to take revenge on Lin Fan.
Two police officers walked into his office.
"Mr. Feng, regarding the jumping incident from a year ago, we would like to ask you to come with us to assist with the investigation!" the police said directly.
At the entrance of Shengshi Group.
Journalists gathered, flashbulbs consistently popping, and under the gaze of the public, Feng Wanshan was taken away in a police car.
Soon after, news spread of Feng Wanshan being taken away by police for investigation.
The stock price of Shengshi Group plummeted, losing 300 million in market value in just one day, nearly breaking the 1 billion mark.
Just after finishing his police statement, Feng Wanshan, sitting in his car, screamed when he heard the news, and fainted on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Is the new reward real, Sister Richest?
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 223: Is the new reward real, Sister Richest?
At the entrance of the police station, a black Bentley stopped, and Anna got out of the car. She had come specifically to pick up Feng Wanshan.
At this time, journalists gathered at the entrance of the police station, all waiting for Feng Wanshan to come out.
After the scandal about Feng Wanshan broke out, although Shengshi Group quickly denied it, a subsequent set of intimate photos confirmed it completely.
Feng Wanshan was then taken away by the police for investigation.
"He’s out!"
Someone shouted, and everyone looked to see Feng Wanshan walk out of the police station accompanied by a lawyer.
Instantly, the journalists surrounded him, trying to interview Feng Wanshan, causing a noisy commotion at the scene.
Face flushed with anger and shame, Feng Wanshan kept his head down and ignored the reporters. With Anna’s escort, he barely squeezed out of the crowd, quickly boarded the car that came to pick him up, and sped away, almost like a rat scurrying away in panic.
In the car.
Feng Wanshan immediately inquired about the company’s market value, knowing that his incident would certainly impact the company, which was precisely Lin Fan’s intention.
Anna reported: "As soon as the news of you being taken by the police came out, Shengshi’s stock price started to plummet. Its market value has now evaporated by over 20 billion and continues to fall."
"Ah!"
Feng Wanshan, struck by anger and excitement, let out a scream and fainted on the spot.
Anna didn’t want him to die yet, as she still needed to know her father’s whereabouts.
"Send him to the hospital quickly!" Anna instructed.
After sending Feng Wanshan to the hospital.
Anna took the opportunity to call Lin Fan: "Feng Wanshan was so furious that he’s in the hospital now."
Yunding Manor.
Lin Fan sat in the living room, where the television was broadcasting the stock market updates. The news of Shengshi Group’s market value evaporating at a mad rate had already spread across the internet.
Netizens applauded, saying that Feng Wanshan deserved it.
"I see," Lin Fan chuckled.
Anna said, "You’ve messed up Feng Wanshan so badly. Do you feel better now?"
Lin Fan smiled: "Feng Wanshan isn’t worth my anger. I’m just giving him a taste of his own medicine. By the way, thanks for the photos you provided."
The scandal of Feng Wanshan’s mistress’s suicide was revealed to Lin Fan by Anna, who also provided the photos.
As Feng Wanshan’s most trusted goddaughter, Anna knew many of his unspeakable secrets.
This was just one of them.
Anna said, "Consider it something I owe you. As for my father..."
Lin Fan seriously replied: "Rest assured, as soon as I have news, I’ll inform you. It should be soon."
Anna said, "Okay, I’ll wait for you."
And then she hung up the phone.
Lin Fan just put down the phone.
"Ding!"
The system’s voice suddenly echoed in his mind.
Joy surged through Lin Fan. Could today’s reward be arriving?
"System task data statistics completed. Do you want to read it?"
The system popped up with this question.
Feeling a bit curious, Lin Fan said: "Read!"
"Ding!"
"Main task: Build a trillion-dollar business empire."
"Level: Extremely Important."
"Task Progress: 9/100"
"Main task: Subdue Anna."
"Level: Important."
"Completion: 70/100"
"Reading completed."
Lin Fan read the statistics of the system task, feeling a bit complicated.
The market value of Mortal Group had already approached 90 billion, but according to the task progress, only nine percent of the progress was completed, still far from the trillion-dollar goal.
On the other hand, the task of subduing Anna had unknowingly reached seventy percent completion. It seemed that last night’s events greatly boosted the task’s progress.
Lin Fan had revealed to Anna the truth of Feng Wanshan deceiving her, successfully turning her against him. But now, they were in a cooperative relationship, and Anna had not yet submitted to him.
The key to completing this task was An Jincheng. Lin Fan needed to help Anna find out the truth behind An Jincheng’s disappearance.
If Lin Fan could solve this case, he could naturally win over Anna.
Lin Fan was eager to crack this case.
Suddenly, the phone rang; it was Zhang Dafu calling.
"Boss, bad news. There are thugs harassing our distributors again," Zhang Dafu said.
Earlier, a group of thugs rushed into one of Blue Moon’s distributors’ stores, vandalizing it. When the police arrived, the thugs were already gone but had left threats to continue causing trouble unless they canceled their cooperation with Blue Moon.
The distributor, frightened, had already informed Zhang Dafu they wanted to cancel Blue Moon’s orders and cease their cooperation.
Zhang Dafu was about to cry: "Boss, it’s definitely Liu Jinshan’s men again. They do this every day; how can we do business? All our customers are being scared away."
Lin Fan recalled what Liu Jinshan said yesterday—that if Lin Fan didn’t pay up, Liu would cause trouble for Blue Moon daily.
Liu Jinshan really was doing it. Although he was detained, his subordinates were still executing his orders.
These thugs were too hard to deal with. After vandalizing, they fled immediately, making it too late to catch them.
It seemed the only way was to strike at the leader, to subdue Liu Jinshan.
Lin Fan comforted Zhang Dafu: "Don’t worry, try to stabilize that distributor. I’ll handle Liu Jinshan, and I’ll make a trip to the police station."
Zhang Dafu said: "Boss, maybe you haven’t heard? Liu Jinshan was released this morning, after only spending one night in detention!"
Lin Fan exclaimed in surprise. In Liu Jinshan’s situation, a ten-day detention wouldn’t be too much—how did he get released after just one night?
Lin Fan then called Loli for confirmation.
Loli told Lin Fan that Liu Jinshan was indeed released by the command of the police chief. As to why even Loli didn’t know!
Lin Fan chuckled coldly. No need to ask—someone behind Liu Jinshan was pulling strings. That person must be quite formidable to utilize their relationship with the police chief. Could this person also be an official?
When did he offend such a person? Lin Fan felt a bit puzzled.
He thought it over and decided to confront Liu Jinshan.
He needed to uncover the identity of the person backing Liu Jinshan.
Lin Fan then left Yunding Manor and drove into the city.
Lin Fan’s destination was a KTV club run by Liu Jinshan. Going there, he should be able to find Liu Jinshan.
Yesterday at Zhou Tian Mansion wasn’t the right setting, but today Lin Fan was determined to make Liu Jinshan submit.
Suddenly, the system prompt arrived.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: Today’s signing-in bonus is available. Signing in grants you a rich sister. Would you like to sign in?"
Lin Fan was taken aback.
Did he hear it wrong?
"Grants what?"
It seemed the system just said it would grant him a person?
Rich sister?
Was this a real person? Lin Fan was a bit skeptical and chose to sign in.
"Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, successfully signed in, and awarded one rich sister. Relationship has been established. Please claim."
"Ding!"
"Information on the rich sister has been generated. Would you like to read it?"
"Read!"
A stream of data flooded into Lin Fan’s mind.
"Feng Ruolan, 23 years old, daughter of the Feng Family, a super family in Huaxia. CEO of Longheng Group, a financial mogul known as the ’Demoness of Finance.’ Has enormous wealth and is rumored to be the wealthiest woman in Yun City, hence known as Yun City’s Female Tycoon..."

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 214: I Am Her Younger Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 214: I Am Her Younger Brother
Ring ring ring...
Lin Fan’s phone started ringing, someone was calling.
Lin Fan glanced at it, it was an unknown number, and he casually answered it.
"Little Fan, where are you? Let’s have lunch together at noon?"
On the other end came a very pleasant female voice, yet it was unfamiliar, Lin Fan was sure it was the first time he had heard it.
However, the caller called him "Little Fan" in a familiar tone.
"Feng...Sister Ruolan?" Lin Fan tried to ask.
The voice on the other end laughed: "Come on, you can’t even recognize my voice? It’s only been ten days since we last saw each other."
Lin Fan, a bit embarrassed, quickly replied: "I recognize it."
Feng Ruolan said: "Then let’s have lunch together. You come to pick me up at my company later. We haven’t seen each other for a while, you’ve become quite accomplished. I can’t wait to see you. I have another call, talk later."
The person hung up the phone quickly.
Lin Fan was in a mix of laughter and tears, he had to pull over to the side of the road to take a moment and accept this magical reward.
The system’s reward today was actually a person, a billionaire sister!
According to the information provided by the system, Feng Ruolan is the daughter of the super wealthy Feng Family in Huaxia, the female president of the financial giant Longheng Group, supposedly the richest woman in Yun City, known as the financial she-devil.
Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan met during their university days. Once, by chance, Lin Fan encountered Feng Ruolan being harassed by a sleazy guy, so he drove the guy away, saving Feng Ruolan. The heroic rescue’s ending was Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan becoming sworn siblings.
Their relationship is as good as if they were real siblings.
Of course, these experiences are all orchestrated by the system, in reality, they never happened.
Lin Fan only met Feng Ruolan today.
And this isn’t even what Lin Fan finds astonishing, what’s amazing is that Feng Ruolan really considers him a sworn brother, she just called him.
It seems the system forcibly implanted a memory into Feng Ruolan, altering her memories.
In the transformed memory of Feng Ruolan, Lin Fan exists as the sworn brother!
"The system is too impressive, impressive enough to be frightening, the more I think about it, the scarier it gets." Lin Fan couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat.
The system seems capable of anything, today’s magical operation has renewed Lin Fan’s understanding.
Although unbelievable, Lin Fan just like that gained a billionaire sister.
Lin Fan finally accepted this fact, and casually saved Feng Ruolan’s phone number as "Sister Ruolan."
He originally planned to head out to find Liu Jinshan.
Now he changed his mind, going to have lunch with Feng Ruolan, he also wanted to meet this billionaire sister.
Longheng Mansion.
The headquarters of the financial giant Longheng Company.
Located in the commercial center of Yun City, surprisingly, not far from Lin Fan’s Circulation Mansion, they are separated only by a river.
Lin Fan parked his car and came to the entrance of Longheng Mansion.
Although Lin Fan dressed simply, he wasn’t stopped by the security guards here. Lin Fan entered the mansion smoothly, planning to take the elevator to the 30th floor according to the recollection, Feng Ruolan’s company is located there.
A man in a suit walked straight towards him, brushing past Lin Fan.
Normally, it would be nothing.
The suited man walked two steps, frowned, stopped in his tracks, and turned his head to call out to Lin Fan.
"Wait a second, I mean you, the one wearing the bargain clothes!" The suited man pointed at Lin Fan, speaking condescendingly.
Lin Fan turned back to see the suited man pointing at him.
"Is there something you need?" Lin Fan replied calmly.
The suited man said: "What are you doing here, what do you want to do entering this place?"
Lin Fan didn’t like the tone, chuckled: "What am I doing, what does it have to do with you, who are you?"
The suited man instantly displeased, a man in bargain clothes dared to talk back to him.
"Who am I? Are you kidding me! Do you know where this is? Longheng Mansion, looking at your outfit I can tell you’re not working here, neither are you a courier or delivery man, what exactly do you want?" The suited man questioned.
Lin Fan said: "First, I’m here to see someone, secondly, there’s no dress code at the door, why can’t I come in? Besides, what’s it to you?"
Their argument had already drawn the attention of those around; people started pointing and whispering.
"This guy can’t recognize Mount Tai when he sees it!"
"No way, who gave him the guts to talk back to Director Zhou."
"He looks like a poor guy, not recognizing Director Zhou is normal."
"I really don’t know what someone like him is doing here, this isn’t a place for such losers!"
People were mocking Lin Fan.
Hearing these words, the suited man looked proud, even more condescending: "Kid, since you keep asking who I am, let me introduce myself, I am Zhou Zihao, Longheng Group’s brand director! People like you completely lower the grade of our Longheng Mansion, should I do something about you?"
Lin Fan "oh"ed: "You’re from Longheng Company? What a coincidence, I’m here to find your boss, Feng Ruolan."
"Looking for President Feng?" The expression on the suited man Zhou Zihao turned stern.
Feng Ruolan, the beautiful president of Longheng Company, a legendary she-devil in Yun City’s financial sector, revered by everyone in the company, just hearing the name strikes awe.
Lin Fan said he’s here to find President Feng!
Zhou Zihao became a bit cautious: "What are you to President Feng, what do you want with President Feng?"
Lin Fan said: "I’m her brother."
"What?" Zhou Zihao felt he’s being toyed with, immediately furious, "I think you’re here to cause trouble, how dare you offend our President Feng!"
Earlier he was a bit cautious, upon hearing Lin Fan, he was sure Lin Fan was here to cause trouble, who does he think he is, taking advantage of a figure like President Feng!
Lin Fan said: "If you ask her to come see me, you’ll know whether it’s true or not."
Zhou Zihao angrily retorted: "Look in a mirror, would you be President Feng’s brother? I’m now suspecting you’re one of those crazy fans, I won’t let you have any chance to get close to President Feng! Security!"
Zhou Zihao called for security, if Lin Fan were indeed a fanatic, President Feng might blame it on him.
The security arrived quickly.
"There’s a psycho here trying to harass President Feng, get him out of here!" Zhou Zihao pointed at Lin Fan.
What the hell?
The security was alarmed, hurriedly taking out batons, planning to drive Lin Fan away.
Lin Fan was speechless: "Fine, I won’t go up, I’ll call her, tell her to come down."
Zhou Zihao sneered: "Keep pretending, keep acting, I’ve seen all kinds of people, crazies like you I’ve seen plenty of! Do it!"
It seemed the security was about to pounce on Lin Fan.
"What’s going on?"
Suddenly, a voice came from behind, a familiar voice that startled everyone.
A stunning lady quickly walked out from inside the mansion.
Feng Ruolan!

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 215: Overprotective Brother Maniac
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 215: Overprotective Brother Maniac
"President Feng!"
The security guard saw Feng Ruolan and his voice trembled slightly, her queen-like aura was so overwhelming it instilled fear in him instinctively.
The security guard immediately explained, "President Feng, it’s Director Zhou’s orders, this person came to make trouble, I’m planning to drive him away, rest assured, President Feng, I won’t let him near you."
"Get lost!" Feng Ruolan said coldly.
The security guard dared not say anything, hurriedly left without turning his head, didn’t dare to look back at all, taking even a moment longer could cost him his job.
Everyone was stunned.
Feng Ruolan actually dismissed the security guard, what was going on?
After driving away the security guard, Feng Ruolan walked towards Lin Fan, her demeanor instantly changed from a tyrant to showing a gentle smile.
As beautiful as a spring breeze.
Lin Fan had seen many beautiful women, but Feng Ruolan’s temperament was very unique, as if she embodied both an angel and a devil, her aura could adapt at any moment, perhaps it’s the ease of mastering a complex art!
Truly a financial she-devil!
To become the richest woman in Yun City, you can’t do it without some skills.
"Little Fan, you’ve come, come over and let sister take a look," Feng Ruolan affectionately held Lin Fan’s hand, her almond eyes sizing him up.
Even Lin Fan was a bit embarrassed by her gaze.
"Still so dashing, even more handsome than last time, seems like you’ve gained some kind of special aura," Feng Ruolan laughed.
Lin Fan said, "Sister, people are watching, it’s too mushy."
Feng Ruolan said, "Afraid of what, I’m just praising my brother, moreover everything I said is true."
Watching their conversation, people around were already dumbfounded.
What?
Are they actually siblings?
Zhou Zihao realized he might have made a grave mistake, couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat, his body trembling.
Damn!
This kid is really President Feng’s brother, and he just tried to drive away President Feng’s brother!
Zhou Zihao was almost crying.
"President Feng, I’m sorry, he just said he’s your brother, I didn’t see the resemblance, so..."
Zhou Zihao tried to explain, striving to gain Feng Ruolan’s understanding.
Better left unsaid, hearing this, Feng Ruolan’s face turned cold: "My brother’s clothes are just a bit down-to-earth, so what, did they offend you?"
This is not a financial she-devil, but clearly a protective demon sister!
Zhou Zihao broke into a cold sweat: "No, no, that’s not what I meant, everything I do is for President Feng’s good, I was worried someone might harm you, President Feng..."
Feng Ruolan said coldly, "That’s even more ridiculous, how could my brother harm me!"
Zhou Zihao said, "No, I didn’t know he’s your brother, thought he was a bad person, President Feng, please forgive me!"
Zhou Zihao almost kneeled.
Feng Ruolan said, "You are worried he would harm me? Your standard for judging whether someone is a bad person is based solely on their attire? Just because his clothing is simple, you suspect he’s up to no good? By that standard, if a bad person dressed neatly like you, would you let him through?"
Thud!
Zhou Zihao knelt down, gave up trying to explain.
He knew it’s impossible to win against Feng Ruolan in conversation, other than kneeling, he had no other choice.
Besides, Feng Ruolan’s words were too rational, he had no counterargument.
Judging Lin Fan as a bad person based on attire, indeed his snobbish view of people had no other explanation.
"I was wrong, President, don’t be angry," Zhou Zihao pleaded.
Feng Ruolan said, "Let me tell you, Little Fan is not only my brother, but also my benefactor."
Back then, Lin Fan heroically rescued her, driving away a sleazy man.
What? Zhou Zihao was terrified, President Feng’s benefactor?
It’s this guy dressed head to toe in cheap clothes?
Zhou Zihao felt he couldn’t understand this world anymore.
Feng Ruolan said coldly, "Aren’t you going to apologize to my brother now, don’t want to work anymore, do you?"
This was the rhythm of being fired, Zhou Zihao was shocked, he worked hard to get this job, didn’t want to lose it.
Zhou Zihao cried out, "I’m sorry, my snobbish eyes failed me, I apologize to you, please forgive me!"
People around looked at each other, some blushing and embarrassed.
Faced slapped indeed.
Previously they mocked Lin Fan, saying how he didn’t recognize Mount Tai, couldn’t even recognize Director Zhou.
Now...
They finally realized in front of Lin Fan, Director Zhou wasn’t even worth mentioning, the one who didn’t recognize Mount Tai was Director Zhou.
"Little Fan, you can deal with this person," Feng Ruolan said.
Lin Fan chuckled: "That wouldn’t be right, he’s sister’s subordinate, should be handled by sister."
Feng Ruolan thought for a moment, said, "Alright then, Zhou Zihao, coincidentally there’s a vacancy at our company’s Africa branch, pack up and head to Africa."
What?
Zhou Zihao felt as if struck by lightning, his whole body shuddered.
"President, please no, I don’t want to go to Africa, President, show mercy!" Zhou Zihao cried, cried terribly, he really wouldn’t go to Africa.
Feng Ruolan said casually: "If it were something else, I’d let it go, mainly I don’t want my brother to see you anymore, affecting his mood, so just get lost as far as you can."
Everyone broke a sweat.
Feng Ruolan really was a protective demon sister, sending Zhou Zihao to Africa simply because she didn’t want her brother to see him again, affecting his mood!
After handling Zhou Zihao, Feng Ruolan went to take the elevator with Lin Fan.
"Little Fan, see if you’re satisfied with how I handled things?" Feng Rulan said softly.
Lin Fan said: "I think it’s pretty good, this guy looks down on poor people, perfect opportunity to send him to Africa for some reform."
The siblings’ conversation as they entered the elevator.
Everyone’s heart roared, the President spoils her brother too much, it’s enviable to have such a good sister like Lin Fan!
Zhou Zihao was already crying and fainted on the ground.
30th floor of Longheng Mansion, Feng Ruolan’s office.
Feng Ruolan stood by the window gazing afar.
"Little Fan, is Zhou Tian Mansion yours now?" Feng Ruolan pointed across the river to Zhou Tian Mansion.
"Yes," Lin Fan nodded.
Feng Ruolan said, "What’s online is true then, you have an uncle Lin Beixuan, who gave you immense wealth."
Lin Fan said, "It’s true."
Feng Ruolan laughed: "Life is unpredictable, last time I saw you, you were still a poor courier, this time, you’re even wealthier than me."
Lin Fan was a bit speechless, this was actually his first meeting with Feng Ruolan... but according to Feng Ruolan’s altered memory, they’ve met countless times.
"However, I have one thing I’m unclear about," Feng Ruolan said.
Lin Fan said, "What is it?"
Feng Ruolan said: "Previously I offered to give you money to spend, introduce you to good jobs, and you refused, preferring to endure poverty to earn with your own hands, why did you accept your uncle’s fortune now?"
The words were quite piercing.
Lin Fan said mysteriously: "There’s a reason, I will tell sister in the future."
Feng Ruolan coquettishly said: "Keeping secrets from sister."
Then she laughed: "Anyway, aren’t you planning to create a trillion-dollar corporation, anytime you need sister’s assistance, feel free to ask for sister’s help."
Truly embodying the protective sibling image, as a finance she-devil, she could definitely assist Lin Fan in this field.
Lin Fan nodded: "Okay."
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang, it was Zhang Dafu calling: "Boss, not good, Liu Jinshan’s people are harassing our other distributor again! Now many have expressed wanting to end partnerships with us, boss, please come over!"
Lin Fan frowned: "Got it, I’ll head back now."
Ending the call, Lin Fan apologized, "Sister, I can’t have lunch with you."
Feng Ruolan curiously asked: "What happened?"
Lin Fan then explained about Liu Jinshan.
Feng Ruolan sneered: "Liu Jinshan dares to bully you, come on, sister will take you to settle the score with him!"
Lin Fan was stunned, wasn’t Feng Ruolan acquaintance of Liu Jinshan?

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Can I hit you across the street?
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 226: Can I hit you across the street?
Yue Mei Entertainment Club.
This club was established by Liu Jinshan and is the only one on this street. There’s no choice, this street is Liu Jinshan’s turf, and he wants to make money; there’s no room for competitors.
Because of the fear of Liu Jinshan, the two KTVs that were originally here have relocated. You can’t provoke the local kingpin.
At this moment, in a VIP room at Yue Mei Club, Liu Jinshan, who was just released from prison today, sat on the sofa with two flamboyantly dressed women on either side.
A group of henchmen accompanied him nearby.
Liu Jinshan was listening to his underling’s report.
"Boss, today we smashed up two distribution points of Blue Moon. We scared the people there pretty bad. I believe they won’t dare to work with Blue Moon again. At this rate, Blue Moon will soon be out of business." The subordinate said.
Liu Jinshan laughed heartily, "Good, well done. That kid Lin Fan dares to go against me; we can’t let this slide. We need to give him a proper welcome."
Upon hearing this,
the group of thugs burst out in laughter.
Liu Jinshan said, "Just thinking about how that kid called the cops, causing me to spend a night at the police station, infuriates me. Smashing two places isn’t enough; go and smash another one for me!"
The underling was a bit worried, "Boss, would that be a good idea? I’m concerned it will attract police attention."
Liu Jinshan sneered, "The police? The police are nothing. Even if they catch us, what can they do? Just like with me, they obediently released me after one night!"
The thugs all nodded, "Boss is mighty!"
"Boss, we’ve found a powerful backer this time!"
"Doesn’t that mean we can do whatever we want in the future?"
Liu Jinshan smiled triumphantly, "I have a good idea. This time, we’re going to smash the Blue Moon Company directly and teach Lin Fan a big lesson!"
The thugs got excited, rubbing their fists, ready to go all out.
Smashing the Blue Moon Company would be a direct slap to Lin Fan’s face.
Liu Jinshan boasted, "If I, Liu Jinshan, don’t ruin Blue Moon this time, I’ll call myself a fool!"
Bam!
Suddenly,
the VIP room’s door burst open, and a big man flew in, crashing into the coffee table in front of everyone and smashing it to pieces.
With a clatter, things scattered everywhere.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
The big man who flew in had a bruised and swollen face, twitching on the ground, unable to get up.
"Dazhuang!"
Liu Jinshan exclaimed without thinking.
This big man was Dazhuang, the security guard watching over the club for him. Liu Jinshan was well aware that Dazhuang was strong and skilled.
However, now he was like a dead dog!
After Dazhuang crashed in, Lin Fan leisurely followed him in.
Clearly, Dazhuang had been handled by Lin Fan.
"Brother Shan, sorry, your security guard was too annoying. I said I wanted to see you, but he insisted on stopping me, so I had to beat him up. Only then did he behave. Sigh, really deserved it," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Liu Jinshan nearly exploded with rage, jumping up furiously, "Lin Fan, you’ve got guts, daring to injure my man!"
Lin Fan said, "Today you smashed two of my distributors, and I haven’t even brought it up yet. I just hit one of your security guards, and you can’t take it?"
Liu Jinshan sneered, "Lin Fan, you’ve walked right into my trap! Do you think because you’re good at fighting that you can do as you please? This entire street is my turf; if I want, you won’t leave here alive!"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m not here to fight. I’m here to negotiate. I hope you can compensate for all the economic losses of my two distributors. Of course, you’ve also injured people, and I hope you can lead by example and apologize."
Liu Jinshan was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter, and a group of thugs laughed along with him.
Liu Jinshan laughed until he cried, "That’s hilarious, damn! This kid wants me to compensate and apologize!"
"Overestimating himself!"
"Doesn’t know the immensity of heaven and earth!"
"What a joke!"
The thugs all laughed together.
Lin Fan said, "I’m here to negotiate genuinely. I hope Brother Shan will consider it because if you don’t agree, the consequences will be severe, and I mean for you."
Liu Jinshan said, "Kid, threatening me? I, Liu Jinshan, was born fearless, and I’m not afraid of you!"
"Boss, this kid is so arrogant, looking down on us! Should we beat him up first?" one subordinate said.
Liu Jinshan laughed, "Lin Fan, do you think just because you took down Dazhuang, you can ignore everyone? There are so many of us here; can you really take all of us on?"
Lin Fan said calmly, "I’m not here to fight, but if it comes to that, even if your whole street comes at me, I think I can handle it."
Liu Jinshan’s smile faded, feeling a bit annoyed. Lin Fan was too arrogant, barging into his territory with such audacity and no fear, really getting under his skin.
"Such big words; since that’s the case, I might as well show you some real strength. Get him! Beat him to death!" Liu Jinshan ordered.
The thugs swarmed forward, attempting to gang up on Lin Fan. They had strength in numbers, while Lin Fan was alone. As they say, two fists can’t fight four hands, Lin Fan surely couldn’t take them all.
A few minutes later.
The entire room was in disarray.
A group of thugs who had just tried to mob Lin Fan all lay on the ground, writhing in pain, each with their heads bleeding, unable to get up, crying out in pain.
Bam!
Lin Fan was instantly in front of Liu Jinshan, landing a punch on Liu Jinshan’s face.
Liu Jinshan’s face immediately swelled and bled from the nose, falling back onto the sofa, seeing stars and unable to move.
The two flamboyantly dressed women huddled in the corner of the sofa trembling, afraid Lin Fan would hit them.
Lin Fan smiled, "So, can I take your whole street?"
Liu Jinshan was terrified; damn, this guy was so damn strong. Just now, before he could react, all his men had been put down by Lin Fan.
Defeating these thugs seemed effortless for Lin Fan!
My god, how can there be someone so skilled in this world!
Faced with the facts, Liu Jinshan had no choice but to believe.
But Liu Jinshan didn’t give in just like that, gritting his teeth, "You little punk, what if you’re good at fighting? Can you kill us? This grievance is made today; if I don’t kill you, I’m a fool!"
Lin Fan sighed, "Does it really have to be to the death? I don’t believe it."
Liu Jinshan sneered, "Don’t believe it? Before you came, I was planning to send people to trash your Company. Just you wait, there will be daily beatings until your Company shuts down."
Lin Fan sighed, "Then there’s no choice. If you dare to send someone again, I’ll take something from you each time. I want to see how long you can last."
Liu Jinshan asked, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said, "For example, you’ve trashed two of my distributors today, and with yesterday’s shopping mall, that’s three times. I’ll cut off three of your fingers now. If it happens again, another finger goes. After fingers are gone, there are toes, then eyes, ears, mouth, nose. Isn’t it fun?"
Liu Jinshan shuddered; damn, that’s too vicious.
"You dare!" Liu Jinshan exclaimed in shock and anger.
Lin Fan glanced around, found a fruit knife in the shattered coffee table, walked over, grabbed Liu Jinshan’s finger, and was about to chop it off.
Liu Jinshan was terrified, shouting, "Stop!"
Lin Fan’s expression darkened, "Tell me, who instructed you to go against me?"
Liu Jinshan broke out in cold sweat, "I can’t say."
"Won’t say, huh? Then there’s no choice," Lin Fan said and chopped down with the knife.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: With One Sentence from the Richest Sister, The Opponent Knelt Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 227: With One Sentence from the Richest Sister, The Opponent Knelt Down
"Ah!"
Liu Jinshan screamed like a pig being slaughtered, his face turning pale with fear.
However, Lin Fan’s knife didn’t actually chop off his finger; he was just playing a joke, a feigned attack.
To Liu Jinshan, this joke was far from funny; he was almost scared to death. It was quite embarrassing for a boss to be terrified to such an extent.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Look at you, I merely scared you a bit, and you’re already this frightened. If I really chopped off three of your fingers, wouldn’t you be crying to death? You might as well negotiate with me obediently."
Liu Jinshan’s eyes reddened; he was truly scared by Lin Fan, this guy is simply inhuman, too ruthless.
"Lin Fan, you have no idea who you’ve offended! It’s not that I won’t negotiate with you, but rather that I can’t!" Liu Jinshan said.
Lin Fan replied with a "Oh": "You just need to tell me the name of the other party."
Liu Jinshan hesitated, seemingly weighing the consequences.
"Little Fan, it seems your method is not going smoothly, huh?"
A voice chuckled, and a woman as pretty as a painting walked in.
Feng Ruolan!
Lin Fan looked up, smiling: "Sis, I was almost successful. I don’t believe that if I really chopped off some of his fingers, he wouldn’t talk."
As it turned out, Feng Ruolan decided to help Lin Fan deal with Liu Jinshan after learning about the matter, but Lin Fan claimed he could handle it himself, so they made a bet to see if Lin Fan could deal with Liu Jinshan.
Indeed, Liu Jinshan was quite afraid of dying. Lin Fan’s fake attack scared him badly, if it were real, it was easy to predict this guy would surely give in.
Feng Ruolan laughed, saying: "Your method is indeed straightforward and brutal, but I have a better method, no need for knives. Liu Jinshan, look over here!"
Seeing Feng Ruolan, Liu Jinshan’s face changed, he blurted out: "Miss Feng! Why are you here?"
Feng Ruolan said: "I heard you had some conflict with my brother, so I came to check things out."
Liu Jinshan was stunned, looked at Lin Fan: "Your brother? Miss Feng, are you saying he’s your brother?"
Feng Ruolan replied: "That’s right, Liu Jinshan, you have some nerve, daring to provoke my brother. As for your debt, you are to repay it in full today!"
Upon hearing this, Liu Jinshan was shocked: "Miss Feng, please, there’s no way I can repay it, you’re driving me to my death!"
Feng Ruolan said: "My decision is final, even if you die, you’ll have to die paying me the money, otherwise you know the consequences."
Thud!
Liu Jinshan actually knelt before Feng Ruolan: "Miss Feng, please spare me, I really didn’t know he was your brother, if I had known, even if given ten lives, I wouldn’t have dared to provoke him!"
Feng Ruolan, a finance diva in charge of Longheng Company, one of its businesses is loans.
Liu Jinshan opened Yue Mei Entertainment Club and, due to insufficient funds, borrowed a loan from Longheng Company, with an agreement to repay in full within half a year.
However, he wasn’t able to completely repay by the agreed date and could only plead with Feng Ruolan to allow monthly repayments.
Feng Ruolan could at any time change the terms and demand Liu Jinshan repay in full.
Moreover, Liu Jinshan didn’t dare go against Feng Ruolan at all.
Feng Ruolan, daughter of the Huaxia super family, the Feng Family, the richest woman in Yun City, while Liu Jinshan is merely a local hooligan leader, akin to a mayfly shaking a great tree, incapable of provoking her. With just a gesture, Liu Jinshan would be wiped out.
Now, Feng Ruolan required Liu Jinshan to repay the loan in full at once, Liu Jinshan couldn’t afford to, nor dared anger Feng Ruolan, thus he could only kneel.
Feng Ruolan said: "Whether you knew or not is none of my concern, anyway you’ve already provoked Little Fan, which means you’ve provoked me!"
Liu Jinshan was scared out of his wits; he never dreamt Lin Fan was actually Feng Ruolan’s brother, this was like a bolt from the blue.
"Miss Feng, I’m begging you, I still have a wife and kids to support, I don’t want to die." Liu Jinshan cried.
Faced with this Feng Family’s pride, Liu Jinshan completely lost his swagger as a gang leader, resembling a startled rabbit.
Feng Ruolan said: "Begging me is useless, you’ll have to beg my brother, if you want me to take back my decision, unless he spares you, there’s no other way."
Liu Jinshan felt a bit hopeless, Feng Ruolan actually had a brother, and she protected Lin Fan so fiercely, too protective of her brother.
Meeting such a brother-protecting fanatic, there really was no other way.
Liu Jinshan could only kneel to Lin Fan: "Mr. Lin, previously it was me being ignorant, offending you in many ways, please forgive me, I’m begging you."
Lin Fan was a bit surprised then; he hadn’t expected that with just a few words from Feng Ruolan, Liu Jinshan would be completely subdued, indeed her method was simpler.
But this method was only effective due to Feng Ruolan, as Liu Jinshan wouldn’t dare provoke her at all.
Lin Fan laughed and said: "I initially said I came to negotiate, you insisted on making a move, causing yourself to get beaten, what was the point?"
"I was clueless, made Mr. Lin laugh!" Liu Jinshan said, he could discern Lin Fan’s sarcasm but dared not get angry, only smiling awkwardly, contrary to his prior attitude towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said: "Then follow my instructions, compensate for losses, and apologize."
Liu Jinshan was inwardly joyous, this could be done, he immediately said: "Alright, Mr. Lin, I’ll personally go and apologize later."
Lin Fan said: "Now can you tell me, who instructed you?"
Liu Jinshan dared not delay any further and turned to shout: "Everyone, get out!"
The room quickly cleared out, leaving just Lin Fan, Feng Ruolan, and Liu Jinshan.
Finally, Liu Jinshan spoke in a deep voice: "Miss Feng, Mr. Lin, the person who entrusted me with this task was Jia Zuozhen."
Jia Zuozhen!
Feng Ruolan furrowed her brow: "Jia Zuozhen, billionaire, this Jia Family is a prestigious family with political connections. Little Fan, when did you provoke such a figure?"
No wonder Liu Jinshan was released from the cell after spending a night in jail, if Jia Zuozhen was behind it, this is not surprising.
Lin Fan understood, sweating slightly, "So it’s him, it must be because I offended his daughter."
That day, Jia Xueling, along with two troublemaker girls, attempted to bully Chu Xiaoxiao at the campus, which Lin Fan discovered and stopped.
Presumably, Jia Xueling informed Jia Zuozhen of the matter, and Jia Zuozhen started retaliating against Lin Fan.
This Jia Zuozhen is rather insidious, wanting to retaliate against Lin Fan but not confronting him directly, sneaking around, obviously meant to nauseate people!
As for Jia Zuozhen, Lin Fan really didn’t know how to handle him right away, his background is too strong.
But the good news is, they finally dragged Jia Zuozhen into the open, knowing the opponent is better than not knowing.
Lin Fan then left Yue Mei Entertainment Club with Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan laughed: "Little Fan, you lost, according to the bet, you owe me a request."
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan agreed to see whose method was more effective against Liu Jinshan, comparing them, Lin Fan’s method did indeed pale compared to Feng Ruolan’s.
Lin Fan cheerfully said: "Alright then, Sis, what do you want me to do?"
Feng Ruolan smiled charmingly: "Come to my place and have lunch with me."

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Thugs Come Knocking, This Style Is Off!
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 228: Thugs Come Knocking, This Style Is Off!
Blue Moon Company.
Zhang Dafu was worried sick because some thugs had vandalized two dealerships. After the news spread, several dealerships came to announce that they wanted to terminate their contracts with Blue Moon and dared not cooperate anymore.
Zhang Dafu’s persuasion was futile. Citing health issues, he locked himself in the office, avoiding everyone, but a few dealers were blocking the door, refusing to leave, insisting on discussing the termination with Zhang Dafu.
"I wonder how things are going on the boss’s side?" Zhang Dafu was a bit anxious.
This time, even if the boss got involved, it might not work. Blue Moon most likely offended some big shot. The boss sent Liu Jinshan to jail yesterday, but the next day he was released.
The boss, Lin Fan, may have money, but money can’t fight power. The one they offended this time must be someone with power!
If this issue isn’t resolved, and dealers demand to terminate contracts and cancel orders, Blue Moon will inevitably go bankrupt. Blue Moon is Zhang Dafu’s life’s work, and he naturally doesn’t want to see it go under.
Suddenly, there was a noise outside, a series of screams, as if something bad had happened.
Zhang Dafu was taken aback and quickly opened the office door and went out.
He saw a man with a fat head and big ears, leading a group of Blonde Hair thugs, barging into the company.
Liu Jinshan!
The employees at Blue Moon Company were terrified and quickly hid.
"Where is Zhang Dafu?" Liu Jinshan shouted, his appearance grotesque, startling everyone with his roar.
Zhang Dafu was frightened; Liu Jinshan actually came to the company.
But he still stood out: "I... I am!"
Liu Jinshan said, "Which ones are your Blue Moon dealers, tell them to step forward!"
Upon hearing this, those dealers were terrified, hiding behind. Damn, Liu Jinshan is notorious for attacking dealers and now he came to Blue Moon Company.
Zhang Dafu trembled and said, "What do you want, don’t act recklessly. If you dare assault people here, I’ll call the police!"
Liu Jinshan ignored Zhang Dafu. He had already identified the dealers; it was too obvious. He beckoned, "You guys, stop hiding and come over!"
The dealers were about to cry as they came over, trembling with fear.
"Hero, please don’t hit me, I’m already planning to terminate the contract with Blue Moon."
"Yeah, I’ve also terminated it."
"Your grudge with Blue Moon has nothing to do with me!"
The dealers all said, trying to distance themselves.
Seeing this scene, Zhang Dafu was afraid Liu Jinshan would order the thugs to start smashing things the next second, so he hurriedly shielded the dealers.
"Liu Jinshan, what do you want? I won’t let you act recklessly!" Zhang Dafu said, shaking with fear but still choosing to protect the dealers.
However.
Thump!
Liu Jinshan suddenly knelt down.
He actually knelt down.
Then, all the Blonde Hair thugs behind him knelt too.
"I’m sorry, I came here with my people to apologize to everyone. I was wrong before, and I deeply regret frightening you all, and I hope you can forgive me!" Liu Jinshan said sincerely.
Everyone was surprised, looking at each other.
Isn’t this a dream?
Liu Jinshan didn’t come to smash things; he actually came to apologize?
What is going on?
This is not right, completely unexpected!
The dealers were all dumbfounded, not knowing how to react.
Zhang Dafu said, "Liu Jinshan, what the hell are you doing?"
If Liu Jinshan was playing with them, it didn’t add up; they all knelt down, who kneels to play with others!
Could it be that Liu Jinshan really came to apologize? Why?
Liu Jinshan said, "Don’t doubt my sincerity. It was Mr. Lin who sent us over to apologize to you all, and I will compensate for all losses."
Apologize!
And pay damages?
This is simply unbelievable. Has the sun risen from the west?
Everyone then noticed that Liu Jinshan had a bruised face, and his Blonde Hair thugs didn’t look much better, each with blue and purple bruises, obviously having been beaten!
Ring ring ring...
Zhang Dafu got a call from Lin Fan: "Have Liu Jinshan and his people arrived at the company?"
Zhang Dafu said, "They’ve arrived, boss. They’re kneeling in apology. What’s going on?"
Lin Fan said, "They are no longer a problem. I sent them over to apologize and compensate. You can dismiss them. Also..."
The call ended.
Zhang Dafu’s heart soared with joy. The boss is amazing, actually managing to handle Liu Jinshan and even getting him to come and apologize!
"Ahem!"
Zhang Dafu cleared his throat, speaking more arrogantly now, "Liu Jinshan, weren’t you acting all high and mighty, threatening to cause trouble every day? How come you’re chickening out now?"
Liu Jinshan had no temper: "It won’t happen again, rest assured, even if I had ten times the guts, I wouldn’t dare to mess with you again."
Upon hearing this, the dealers finally believed it. Liu Jinshan really did come to apologize, turning their worries into relief, glad that they wouldn’t get beaten up.
Zhang Dafu said, "Liu Jinshan, my boss said that once you’ve apologized, you can get lost. As for the compensation, I will tally it up and send you the bill!"
"Alright, we’ll leave right away." Liu Jinshan had no objections, getting up and signaling the Blonde Hair thugs, then immediately exiting the Blue Moon Company.
He naturally didn’t dare have any objections. Rather than being ordered by Lin Fan to come and apologize, he was actually afraid of Feng Ruolan.
It was really unexpected. He originally intended to have his people smash Blue Moon, but it turned into coming to apologize!
He took this loss without daring to complain.
Once Liu Jinshan and his people left, the office was quiet, and everyone couldn’t believe it was real, unable to snap back to reality for a moment.
Zhang Dafu looked at the dealers and said, "Everyone, I said our boss Mr. Lin would personally handle it and surely resolve it. Now, do you still want to terminate your contracts with us?"
The dealers gave awkward smiles.
"Mr. Lin is indeed impressive!"
"Not terminating anymore, I really think highly of Blue Moon’s products!"
"Me neither, I’m not terminating either."
They each expressed.
Zhang Dafu chuckled, "You all really switch sides easily. When there’s trouble, you scream to terminate, now that the issue’s resolved, you backtrack."
Hearing the sarcasm, the dealers all blushed.
Zhang Dafu said, "Mr. Lin just said on the phone that Blue Moon needs partners who trust and support us, who can face difficulties together, not those like everyone here. So we have decided not to work with you anymore. You all are not allowed to sell Blue Moon products from now on!"
The dealers were taken aback.
One person said, "No way, President Zhang, others try hard to retain dealers, why is Blue Moon chasing customers away instead?"
Zhang Dafu said commandingly, "Because our products are good enough, there’s no worry about selling them, please leave!"
Blue Moon’s products are indeed good, especially the new hand sanitizer, it’s definitely a hot seller. The dealers couldn’t bear it, pleading with Zhang Dafu.
But this was Lin Fan’s decision, and Zhang Dafu would only listen to Lin Fan.
In the end, these dealers could only sigh and leave Blue Moon in disappointment, regretting their actions. If they had known, they would never have tried to terminate. Now that they had annoyed Mr. Lin, they lost a big business opportunity, truly a mistake.
And at this time, Lin Fan had already arrived at Feng Ruolan’s home, ready to have lunch with this richest sister.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Swimming with the Richest Sister in a 100,000,000 Villa
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 229: Swimming with the Richest Sister in a 100,000,000 Villa
A beautiful luxury villa with a backyard garden and a swimming pool, located in the well-known wealthy district of Yun City, is valued at no less than 100 million.
This is the home of Feng Ruolan.
Usually, only Feng Ruolan lives here, along with an old housekeeper responsible for managing the villa and Feng Ruolan’s daily needs.
According to the information provided by the system, the old housekeeper is called Aunt Cui, who has watched Feng Ruolan grow up and shares a deep bond with her. When Feng Ruolan moved out to live independently, she brought Aunt Cui along to help with the household chores.
When the two walked in, Aunt Cui greeted them with a smile.
"Miss, you’re back, and Young Master Fan is here too?" Aunt Cui said with a smile.
Young Master Fan, that’s what Aunt Cui calls Lin Fan because Lin Fan is Feng Ruolan’s brother. Although not biological, Feng Ruolan is famously protective of her brother, so Aunt Cui treats Lin Fan as the Feng Family’s own young master.
Lin Fan was sweating; the system is really powerful. It not only altered Feng Ruolan’s memory but also changed Aunt Cui’s memory, and probably many others too.
Feng Ruolan said, "Aunt Cui, Little Fan is here for dinner today, could you cook some of your specialties?"
Aunt Cui happily replied, "Sure, I’ll start preparing right away."
Aunt Cui went off to busy herself.
Feng Ruolan said, "Little Fan, it won’t be time to eat so soon. Why don’t you join me for a swim? You haven’t swum with me for a long time."
Swimming?
This wasn’t mentioned in the system’s information. Could it be a memory randomly set by the system for Feng Ruolan?
"It is indeed a bit hot, but I didn’t bring any swimwear..." Lin Fan said.
Feng Ruolan laughed, "No worries, you can sit by and watch me swim. I just bought a new swimsuit and haven’t worn it yet. Wait a moment."
Feng Ruolan ran into the room.
A few minutes later.
Feng Ruolan came out, already changed into her swimwear.
The swimwear was quite revealing, perfectly showcasing Feng Ruolan’s figure, revealing her white long legs, her white shoulders, and her white...
Lin Fan, who was sitting and drinking water, was suddenly taken aback by the sight and almost spat water out.
Oh my, Sister is so beautiful, her body is so hot, so sexy!
Lin Fan tried hard to hold back his nosebleed.
Gotta say, the system’s reward is incredible—a perfect sister.
"How is it, does it look good?" Feng Ruolan spun around slightly and asked with a smile.
Lin Fan replied, "It’s really beautiful. Sister, you should go swim now."
If he kept looking, he was afraid he couldn’t control his nosebleed.
So the two went to the backyard pool.
Feng Ruolan entered the pool and began swimming.
Lin Fan sat on a chair by the pool, watching her swim. In the water, Feng Ruolan’s white skin was faintly visible, like a mermaid.
Lin Fan sighed inwardly; his wealthiest sister is truly a beauty. He couldn’t imagine who would get to benefit from her in the future... What a pity, as the wealthiest sister only sees him as her brother, it’s unlikely for anything...
"Little Fan, the water is really refreshing, are you sure you don’t want to come in?" Feng Ruolan called out.
Lin Fan replied, "No, I don’t have swimwear."
Feng Ruolan chuckled, "You’re a guy, what do you need swimwear for? Just take off your outer clothes and swim in your shorts. Or are you shy in front of your sister?"
Lin Fan was indeed a bit embarrassed; he had never been alone in a pool with a girl.
But Feng Ruolan’s teasing wouldn’t let him back down.
"Alright, I’m coming."
Lin Fan said, stood up, walked to the edge of the pool, and took off his shirt.
Immediately, his sturdy muscles were revealed, exuding a masculine aura.
Feng Ruolan looked and couldn’t help but feel a slight stir in her heart. Little Fan’s build was too perfect, a perfect match with his handsome face.
"My Little Fan is so handsome, I really don’t know which girl would get lucky in the future," Feng Ruolan thought to herself.
Lin Fan, now just in his shorts, made a leap into the pool.
A wave of coolness, just one word, refreshing!
And the best part was, there was an unbelievably beautiful sister in the pool too. Lin Fan felt it was too delightful, he didn’t even want to get out. He could stay in the pool with Feng Ruolan the whole day.
Feng Ruolan spoke to Lin Fan while swimming.
"Little Fan, how do you plan to deal with Jia Zuozhen?" Feng Ruolan asked.
Lin Fan shook his head, "I don’t know yet."
Speaking of Jia Zuozhen, Lin Fan felt a bit of a headache. Indeed, this Jia Zuozhen was somewhat formidable.
Feng Ruolan said, "I’ve heard a bit about Jia Zuozhen. He’s a narrow-minded person. Although we’ve dealt with Liu Jinshan, he definitely won’t let it go. Why don’t I go talk to him?"
Lin Fan hurriedly said, "No need, Sister, I’ll handle this person myself."
Feng Ruolan was very fond of him, but he didn’t want to drag Feng Ruolan into this. If he couldn’t handle Jia Zuozhen, it might implicate Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan said, "Alright, but if you need anything, just tell me. I have some connections in the political circle, maybe I can help put in a word for you."
Lin Fan replied, "I know."
Feng Ruolan actually offered to use her political connections to plead on Lin Fan’s behalf?
It seems that Jia Zuozhen’s background is indeed significant.
However, Lin Fan wasn’t planning to plead with Jia Zuozhen. It was Jia Zuozhen who provoked him, how could he turn around to beg him? It would be more fitting for Jia Zuozhen to kneel and beg for his forgiveness.
This matter obviously exceeded Feng Ruolan’s capability; even the protective sister couldn’t help.
The two eventually got tired after playing in the water.
Feng Ruolan got out of the pool first.
"Come, Little Fan." Feng Ruolan leaned over by the pool, extending her hand to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan saw Feng Ruolan, her whole body wet, water-soaked swimwear clinging to her body, her figure was explosively good...
Lin Fan almost had a nosebleed again.
Reaching out to hold Feng Ruolan’s hand, Lin Fan also climbed ashore.
Suddenly, Feng Ruolan slipped with a startled cry and fell to the ground.
Lin Fan quickly reached out and caught Feng Ruolan around the waist.
They both fell to the ground.
Lin Fan was on the bottom, Feng Ruolan on top, Lin Fan held Feng Ruolan’s waist to prevent her from getting hurt.
Coming to her senses, Feng Ruolan found herself lying on Lin Fan’s strong chest. Lin Fan wasn’t wearing a shirt, and she was in her swimwear...
Feng Ruolan blushed, her heart racing. Oh, Little Fan was so warm, so comforting.
"Sister, are you okay?" Lin Fan asked.
Feng Ruolan replied, "I’m fine, thanks to you."
Lin Fan said, "It’s good that you’re okay."
Looking into each other’s eyes, both seemed to have a hint of something unusual, feeling each other’s accelerated heartbeats.
At the moment when the atmosphere was most ambiguous.
"Miss, Young Master Fan, dinner is ready." Aunt Cui came out, calling.
Aunt Cui seemed not to notice the suggestive position of the two.
They quickly separated and got up from the ground.
"I’ll go change my clothes, Little Fan, you go eat first." Feng Ruolan hurriedly went into the house.
Lin Fan watched her back, recalling the earlier scene with a feeling he couldn’t quite place. Then he picked up his clothes and put them on.
Aunt Cui, seeing this on the side, shook her head, murmuring, "This boy... really sees himself as a brother. When will he understand Miss’s feelings..."

chapters.title: Chapter 230 Fake Foreign Devil
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 230 Fake Foreign Devil
On the dining table, a few homemade dishes were placed, both meat and vegetables, all made exquisitely with full color, aroma, and taste.
Lin Fan sat by the dining table but didn’t move his chopsticks, waiting for Feng Ruolan, reminiscing about the wonderful scene by the pool, almost savoring it.
The so-called feast for the eyes was even more tempting than the delicious dishes before him.
"Little Fan, why aren’t you eating?"
Feng Ruolan walked over, having changed into casual clothes, filled with a charming femininity that was hard to look away from.
As a financial powerhouse, Feng Ruolan usually appeared in front of people dressed in professional attire, a definite strong woman.
This little feminine side of hers wasn’t really something everyone had the chance to see, but she didn’t mind at all letting Lin Fan see this side.
Lin Fan admitted he was a bit enchanted by this charming woman, but unfortunately, her identity was his sister, and she likely only saw him as a little brother.
"I’m waiting to eat with you, sister." Lin Fan said with a smile, standing up to pull a chair for Feng Ruolan.
"Thank you." Feng Ruolan sat down and smiled, "It’s been a long time since you tasted Aunt Cui’s cooking; try your favorite Mapo Tofu while it’s hot."
Feng Ruolan picked up her chopsticks, about to serve Lin Fan some food.
Suddenly, her phone rang, it was a call from her company’s assistant.
"Sorry, let me take this call." Feng Ruolan put down her chopsticks and answered the phone.
On the other side was her assistant’s somewhat anxious voice: "President Feng, at three in the afternoon, you have a meeting with Sile International Company, the guests have already arrived, when will you return?"
Feng Ruolan checked the time, it was already two-thirty. If she rushed back now, she could barely make it to the company at the appointed time, but if she ate with Lin Fan, she would definitely be late.
Feng Ruolan sighed in her heart, time flies when you’re having fun with Little Fan.
However, it was rare to have a meal with Lin Fan, and she really didn’t want to leave him to go back to the office.
"Inform the guests that I have something to attend to and will be delayed. Ask them to wait for me at the company and convey my apologies." Feng Ruolan instructed, ultimately choosing to stay and have lunch with Lin Fan.
Seeing Feng Ruolan hang up the phone, Lin Fan said, "Sister, if you’re busy, you should go. Don’t mind me."
Feng Ruolan casually said, "It’s fine, it’s rare for me to have a meal with you, no one should interrupt us. Come, try this Mapo Tofu."
Feng Ruolan picked up a piece of tofu for Lin Fan.
The richest woman in Yun City was just that willful!
Lin Fan was a bit moved, his sister was really spoiling him.
Lin Fan picked up the tofu to eat, it was indeed delicious, especially tasty because his sister had served it to him.
The two began to eat, chatting and laughing, the atmosphere very pleasant.
But just as they were eating, Feng Ruolan’s assistant called again.
More anxious than last time: "President Feng, I told the guests, but they are very angry, saying that being late is disrespectful and demanding you return immediately, or they will cancel the cooperation."
Feng Ruolan frowned: "Tell him if he’s unwilling to wait, he can leave. Either wait, or get lost, convey those exact words."
In Feng Ruolan’s eyes, nothing was more important than eating with Lin Fan, even if the sky were falling, she had to finish this meal with Lin Fan, let alone a cooperation she didn’t care much about.
Indeed, the financial industry’s heroine, with two words: domineering.
A domineering CEO!
Of course, Feng Ruolan was not unreasonable; she was very polite at first, helpless when the other party contradicted her, she was just unkind.
Feng Ruolan continued to eat with Lin Fan.
Finally, the assistant sent a message, Sile International’s representative considered and decided to wait for Feng Ruolan to return, obviously, Sile International wanted the cooperation more than Longheng, so they chose to compromise with Feng Ruolan.
When they finally finished eating, it was already past 3 PM.
Feng Ruolan said, "Little Fan, you can give me a ride to the company later."
Today, Lin Fan came to the company to pick her up, her car was still at the company.
Lin Fan readily agreed.
After the meal, Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce to take Feng Ruolan back to Longheng Mansion.
On the way, Feng Ruolan called her assistant, saying she was on her way back.
They arrived in front of Longheng Mansion, where a beautiful assistant in business attire and a man in a suit were waiting.
This man, probably in his thirties, dressed in a brand-name suit, appeared somewhat arrogant.
Seeing Feng Ruolan get out of the car, the beautiful assistant quickly approached: "President Feng, you’re back. The guest insisted on welcoming you personally. Let me introduce, this is Sile International’s representative, Mr. Xue Henry, Mr. Xue, this is our president, President Feng."
Feng Ruolan glanced at the other party, nodded in greeting.
Xue Henry chuckled, "Miss Feng, excuse my directness, you are half an hour late, such a sense of time is truly unbelievable!"
Feng Ruolan said, "Didn’t my assistant tell Mr. Xue that I had something and thus delayed? If I were late without any notice, it would be my fault, but I have my reasons, is there a problem?"
Xue Henry asked, "May I ask what could be more important than discussing a cooperation?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "It’s none of your business."
Xue Henry angrily said, "How could it not be? I wasted half an hour waiting for you!"
Feng Ruolan sighed, "I already said, if you weren’t willing to wait, you could leave, wasn’t it your choice to stay?"
Feng Ruolan truly had no problem; she valued eating with Lin Fan more, willing to give up this cooperation, so she gave Xue Henry a choice.
It was Xue Henry who chose to stay, which meant accepting Feng Ruolan’s terms, now criticizing here, it was Xue Henry’s problem.
Xue Henry shook his head, lamenting, "Huaxia people truly have no sense of time, after studying and working in the United States for many years, I have never encountered such a thing, the high quality of Americans is indeed good!"
Hearing this, Lin Fan couldn’t help but say, "Buddy, may I ask if you are a Huaxia person?"
Xue Henry glanced at Lin Fan, seeing him in cheap clothes, was a bit disdainful, but still pretended to have grace, "Yes."
Lin Fan chuckled, "You say Huaxia people have no sense of time, you are a Huaxia person, so you also have no sense of time?"
Feng Ruolan chuckled, Xue Henry had dug a hole for himself to jump into.
Xue Henry retorted, "I’m an exception, I’ve received western higher education, naturally different from you all!"
