Lin Fan nodded, "I also think you are different from us, we are all genuine Huaxia people, while you claim to have received western education, clearly brainwashed, even changed your name to something neither Huaxia nor American, you’re what used to be called a Fake Foreign Devil, now a Banana Man, yellow on the outside, white on the inside."
"You!" Xue Henry was furious, face turning red, pointing at Lin Fan.
Feng Ruolan and the beautiful assistant couldn’t help but laugh at Lin Fan’s words.
A Chinese is a Chinese, why conform to the western standards? Xue Henry was just pandering to foreigners.
Xue Henry, embarrassed and angry, pointed at Lin Fan, "Miss Feng, how can your driver be so rude, we are all people of status, does he, a lowly person, deserve to speak?"
Originally amused by Lin Fan, Feng Ruolan’s expression turned cold at his words: "What did you say?"

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Thank You, Mr. Lin, for Your Kindness
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 231: Thank You, Mr. Lin, for Your Kindness
After being mocked by Lin Fan, Xue Henry was furious and, in front of Feng Ruolan, cursed at Lin Fan.
His words were full of superiority; in his eyes, Lin Fan was an inferior person unworthy of speaking with him.
This Xue Henry studied abroad for his doctorate and stayed in the United States to work. He embraced Western ideas and practices as his own and even changed his name to sound more Westernized, seemingly wishing he could swap his yellow skin for white.
Upon returning to Huaxia, Xue Henry found fault with his compatriots, both here and there, as his sense of superiority overflowed.
Today, Xue Henry represented Sile International Company, coming over to negotiate cooperation with Longheng Group.
Originally, he had arranged to meet President Feng Ruolan at three in the afternoon, but then Feng Ruolan suddenly said it would be delayed, which irked Xue Henry.
By the Western standards he adhered to, the agreed time couldn’t be delayed; even if a leg were broken, one must crawl over on time.
He didn’t expect Feng Ruolan to be an assertive CEO, who, after being rebuffed, directly made him choose: either wait or leave.
This made Xue Henry even angrier.
Ultimately, he decided to stay and wait for Feng Ruolan to return, to confront her face-to-face.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan appeared midway, revealing his true nature of yellow skin and white heart.
Xue Henry was instantly furious.
Hearing Xue Henry’s words, the fiercely protective sibling Feng Ruolan’s face turned cold: "What did you say?"
Xue Henry replied: "I said your driver was rude. Am I wrong? He must not even have graduated from elementary school. He’s uncultured, truly scary!"
Feng Ruolan coldly said: "Firstly, he’s not my driver; secondly, your company is not something I can aspire to, so we don’t need to discuss cooperation. Please leave!"
Xue Henry should be thankful he’s not an employee of Feng Ruolan, otherwise, for cursing Lin Fan like this, he would surely be shipped off to Africa.
Xue Henry dismissively said: "Our Sile International Company is strong, headquartered in the United States, a true multinational enterprise. Companies lining up want to cooperate with us; what can your Longheng Group possibly count for?"
Feng Ruolan sneered: "Is that so? What does my Longheng Group count for? I think you’ve been brainwashed by Americans, and I really don’t know where your sense of superiority comes from. Do you know that your chance to speak with me about cooperation here is because your President Chen has pleaded many times?"
Xue Henry was taken aback; he truly didn’t know this.
He was only recently transferred from the U.S. headquarters to the Huaxia branch.
When leaving the United States, he was heartbroken, as if he had lost his parents. Upon returning to Huaxia, he still reminisced about the "fragrant" air of the U.S.
At this moment, an Audi drove up and stopped in front of Longheng Mansion. The car door opened, and a handsome young man walked over briskly.
This handsome young man was unexpectedly a mixed-race individual.
Lin Fan also recognized this person.
His name is Chen Sikai, President of the Great Huaxia Region for Sile International Company.
Boyfriend of He Xiaofang, Lin Fan’s junior high classmate.
That day, Lin Fan met his junior high crush, He Xiaofang, who invited him as a guest to her new home at Tangchen Yipin.
At the time, Lin Fan was still a delivery man, looked down upon by Chen Sikai, who ridiculed him.
As a result, Lin Fan, owning an entire building in Tangchen Yipin, strongly embarrassed Chen Sikai.
Lin Fan still remembers how ridiculous Chen Sikai’s expression was when he was embarrassed.
Unexpectedly, they met again here today.
Chen Sikai seemed not to notice Lin Fan’s presence; his focus was entirely on Feng Ruolan.
He walked over quickly, actively shook hands with Feng Ruolan, and said with a grin: "President Feng, pleasure to meet you."
Feng Ruolan smiled: "President Chen, you came at the right time. Is this Mr. Xue your subordinate? He just said your Sile International is a multinational company and looks down on cooperating with our small Huaxia company, so I must formally notify President Chen that the cooperation ends here."
Chen Sikai’s face changed dramatically: "President Feng, don’t be angry; there must be some misunderstanding. Allow me to talk to him."
Chen Sikai turned to Xue Henry: "Henry, I received your message and came over immediately. What on earth happened?"
Xue Henry said: "I arrived here on time as scheduled, but she was thirty minutes late..."
Listening to this, Chen Sikai broke into a cold sweat, crap!
Xue Henry just returned from abroad; he had no idea who Feng Ruolan was and dared to confront her. This is a big mess now!
Chen Sikai quickly apologized to Feng Ruolan: "President Feng, this Henry just transferred back from abroad and knows nothing, offending you. I sincerely apologize, and please, on my behalf, overlook this. I am here now; allow me to negotiate with you personally. What do you think, President Feng?"
Chen Sikai’s attitude was very humble.
This surprised Xue Henry a little. Chen Sikai is the President of the Great Huaxia Region for Sile International; does he need to be so respectful to one Feng Ruolan!
Feng Ruolan said calmly: "I did indeed propose a delay due to other matters. Mr. Xue resent me; I can understand, but Mr. Xue insulted my brother, which I cannot forgive."
Chen Sikai was taken aback: "President Feng, who is your brother?"
Feng Ruolan looked at Lin Fan: "He is my brother, Lin Fan."
Only then did Chen Sikai notice Lin Fan’s presence and suddenly recognized him, exclaiming in surprise: "It’s you!"
Good heavens, Lin Fan is actually Feng Ruolan’s brother?
This explains why Lin Fan could buy an entire building at Tangchen Yipin! Is Lin Fan actually part of the super-family Feng Family?
Thinking this way, Chen Sikai broke out in a cold sweat.
Unlike Xue Henry, although he too was transferred from abroad, he already has experience and knows Huaxia well. In Huaxia, some people can’t be provoked, like the super-family Feng Family!
"Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. Please forgive me!" Chen Sikai bowed to Lin Fan.
That day, when Lin Fan used the entire building at Tangchen Yipin to humiliate him, although his face hurt, he still hated Lin Fan in his heart.
At this moment, however, he no longer has time to hate, only fear.
Lin Fan smiled: "No need to panic, Brother Kai; for Little Fang’s sake, I won’t make things difficult for you."
That day, Chen Sikai ridiculed Lin Fan when he learned Lin Fan had a crush on his girlfriend He Xiaofang back in junior high.
Chen Sikai could tell Lin Fan was teasing him, yet grinned awkwardly: "Thank you, Mr. Lin, for your mercy."
Chen Sikai then attempted to persuade Feng Ruolan to continue negotiating cooperation with Sile International.
"President Feng, please calm down. You are a great person, and this cooperation is very important for our company. I am genuinely sincere; I ask you to reconsider."
Feng Ruolan said: "Then show me your sincerity. This Mr. Xue insulted my brother; I will definitely not forgive that. How does President Chen plan to handle it?"
Protective sibling mode, reactivated!
Chen Sikai was a bit troubled. Xue Henry was transferred from the U.S. headquarters; if he dealt with Xue Henry, the headquarters would surely inquire.
But for this cooperation, he couldn’t avoid dealing with it.
Chen Sikai gritted his teeth and said: "Henry, I announce you are fired."
"Ah?"
Xue Henry was shocked. In fact, when he saw Chen Sikai nodding and bowing to Feng Ruolan, he sensed things weren’t going well for him.
Unexpectedly, to appease Feng Ruolan, Chen Sikai directly fired him!

chapters.title: Chapter 232 Do you have a branch in Africa?
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 232 Do you have a branch in Africa?
Chen Sikai, in order to cooperate with Longheng Group, decisively fired Xue Henry.
Xue Henry was shocked; he didn’t want to lose his job over this, as it was a great job for him.
"President Chen, you can’t fire me, what did I do wrong?" Xue Henry couldn’t help but shout.
Chen Sikai chuckled, "Causing the company to lose this collaboration, that’s your fault!"
Xue Henry protested, "She was late, isn’t it okay for me to mention her tardiness?"
Chen Sikai said sternly, "Xue Henry, shut your mouth and get lost!"
He was a bit angry. This Xue Henry was a real blockhead, having no sense of the situation. It was Sile Company that needed to cooperate with Longheng; even if Feng Ruolan were half an hour late or rescheduled, Sile would have to accept it.
But Xue Henry insisted on his so-called Western standards, making an issue of Feng Ruolan’s tardiness and even insulting Lin Fan, angering Feng Ruolan.
If he wasn’t fired, this cooperation would truly fall through.
Xue Henry exclaimed, "I’m not convinced, I will complain to the head office about you!"
Chen Sikai sneered, "You can try. You probably don’t know, but the head office values this cooperation with Longheng greatly. If you ruin it, do you think the head office would let you go?"
Xue Henry’s face changed. He only just realized the severity of the issue!
Now Sile Company was at the mercy of Longheng Company, and he had offended them...
The head office forgiving him was a fantasy!
Having lost his only backing, Xue Henry was finally afraid.
Thud!
Xue Henry kneeled down, almost crying, "I was wrong. I apologize for what I said earlier. Can you not fire me?"
Chen Sikai coldly replied, "See if Miss Feng forgives you?"
Xue Henry quickly turned to Feng Ruolan, "Miss Feng, I was wrong. I shouldn’t have spoken to you like that. Can you forgive me?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "I’m sorry, but you insulted my brother. I won’t forgive you!"
Xue Henry cried, "I’m sorry, I didn’t know he was your brother. I thought he was your driver. If I knew he was your brother, I definitely wouldn’t have insulted him like that."
Lin Fan chuckled, "What’s wrong with being a driver? Do you think drivers deserve to be insulted? You fake foreigner, do you look down on drivers?"
"I..." Xue Henry blushed, speechless for a moment.
Lin Fan said, "Just because you studied abroad for a few years, you seem to have forgotten your own ancestors and look down on your own country?"
Xue Henry, his face red, said, "I need to argue this. I merely went overseas to broaden my horizons and see the problems. Huaxia indeed lags behind the United States in many aspects. The United States is the strongest. Do you have a problem with that?"
Lin Fan said, "Are you saying my vision is narrow?"
Xue Henry replied, "If you could study abroad, you would understand."
Lin Fan said, "I don’t need to study abroad. I just know you worship foreign things blindly. You see a wealthy person abroad and think your real father isn’t as wealthy, so you look down on your father, claiming the wealthy foreigner as your father. Do you still think there’s nothing wrong with yourself?"
Xue Henry: "..."
Lin Fan’s analogy was spot on, leaving Xue Henry speechless.
Lin Fan said, "Moreover, do you really think your real father is poor? You disloyal son, you probably have no idea how powerful your real father is!"
Xue Henry replied, "Is Huaxia strong? The gap with the United States is large. Don’t delude yourself."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Really, have you truly disowned your real father now? But even so, I forgive you."
What?
Xue Henry was overjoyed, "You’re willing to forgive me?"
Feng Ruolan, curious, asked, "Little Fan, he just insulted you, and you forgive him?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Yes, I hope President Chen doesn’t fire him."
Chen Sikai was a bit surprised. Lin Fan turned out to be so magnanimous.
Xue Henry was extremely happy, "Thank you, Mr. Lin. President Chen, since Mr. Lin said so, does that mean I won’t be fired?"
Chen Sikai looked at Feng Ruolan, only caring about her opinion.
Feng Ruolan said, "Since it’s Little Fan’s opinion, I have no objections."
Chen Sikai said, "Thank you, Miss Feng. Henry, you better thank Miss Feng!"
Xue Henry smiled, "Thank you, Miss Feng."
Lin Fan suddenly asked, "By the way, President Chen, I’d like to know if your Sile Company has a branch in Africa?"
Chen Sikai was taken aback, "Yes, why are you asking, Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "Then that’s good. I hope you can send this guy to Africa. Since he looks down on Huaxia, there’s no need for him to stay here. After spending some time in Africa, he might realize how strong his real father is."
Everyone was slightly stunned.
"Pfft!"
Feng Ruolan couldn’t help but laugh. Little Fan was ruthless. She was really fooled just now, thinking he had truly forgiven Xue Henry. Not so!
Feng Ruolan, suppressing laughter, said, "President Chen, if you want me to cooperate with your company, I definitely don’t want to see him in your company."
Chen Sikai wiped cold sweat, thinking in his heart that Lin Fan was someone not to be messed with. Last time he offended him, he ended up completely embarrassed.
This time Xue Henry offended Lin Fan; it was as if he had run straight into a trap!
Chen Sikai solemnly said, "Xue Henry, since you have won Mr. Lin’s forgiveness, I am rescinding the dismissal decision. However, I am deciding to assign you to the African branch for a long-term assignment. Don’t come back to Huaxia unless necessary. If you are unwilling to comply, you may submit your resignation letter to me."
Xue Henry’s smile froze, a look of shock on his face. Damn it, he was played by Lin Fan!
Lin Fan didn’t forgive him at all, rather dug a pit for him.
And he just foolishly jumped right in!
Xue Henry nearly cried himself unconscious.
Finally, Xue Henry was sent away. This fake foreigner who looked down on his own country was finally rolling abroad. Africa welcomes you.
Chen Sikai eagerly went up to Lin Fan, smiling ingratiatingly, "Mr. Lin, about last time at Tangchen Yipin, I offended you greatly. Please forgive me."
If Lin Fan weren’t Feng Ruolan’s brother, he wouldn’t care if Lin Fan forgave him, but since Lin Fan was her brother, he became someone he couldn’t afford to offend, and rather ought to curry favor with.
Lin Fan smiled, "President Chen, are you sincerely apologizing to me, or is it because of my sister?"
Chen Sikai’s face turned red with embarrassment after being seen through by Lin Fan, "I... I sincerely apologize..."
Lin Fan patted Chen Sikai’s shoulder, "Relax, I haven’t kept that trivial matter in my heart for a long time."
Indeed, since it wasn’t him who was embarrassed last time, but Chen Sikai.
Chen Sikai quickly said, "Thank you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan turned to Feng Ruolan, "Sister, you’re going to discuss business with President Chen. I’ll take my leave."
Feng Ruolan pulled Lin Fan aside, "Little Fan, when will you come see your sister again?"
Lin Fan replied, "Sister, when are you free?"
Feng Ruolan apologized, "I’d love to have dinner with you tonight, but I have an important event I must attend this evening."
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay, I have an event to attend tonight too, a birthday banquet."
Liu Tingshan had earnestly invited Lin Fan to tonight’s birthday banquet; it wouldn’t be appropriate not to go.
Feng Ruolan raised an eyebrow, "A birthday banquet? What a coincidence, I’m also invited to a birthday banquet tonight."
Lin Fan laughed, "Is that so? Could it be the same birthday banquet we’re attending?"
Feng Ruolan said, "Were you also invited by Mr. Liu?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yes!"
Feng Ruolan was delighted, "That’s great, Little Fan, then we’ll see each other tonight."
The two agreed to meet in the evening, then parted ways. Feng Ruolan and Chen Sikai went to the company to discuss cooperation, while Lin Fan drove away.
Tonight was Liu Tingshan’s birthday, and Lin Fan hadn’t prepared a gift yet, so he needed to go buy one.
Suddenly, Lin Fan received a call from Zhang Dafu.
"Boss, bad news, we just got notified that our construction site needs to stop work!" Zhang Dafu said anxiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Buying Antiques and Encountering Tricks, the Vendor Offers a Price of 1 Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 233: Buying Antiques and Encountering Tricks, the Vendor Offers a Price of 1 Million
Ever since Blue Moon Company introduced a new hand soap, it became an instant hit at the product launch conference, with orders pouring in like snowflakes.
To expand production capacity, after Lin Fan received the land reward from Shendiao Old Factory, he decided to build a new plant.
In recent days, the construction of the new plant has been proceeding rapidly.
Everything was going smoothly, as this piece of land was originally part of the government’s planned development, personally approved by the mayor to be allocated to Lin Fan for building a factory.
However, just now, Zhang Dafu received a notification that due to safety concerns at the new factory site, it was required to halt construction for rectification, otherwise it would be considered illegal construction.
This was undoubtedly a huge blow to the new plant. Once halted, it might never resume, turning into a nightmare for Blue Moon.
Zhang Dafu immediately called Lin Fan.
Lin Fan frowned and said, "Our construction site has safety hazards? Since when?"
Zhang Dafu said, "Someone did come for an inspection yesterday. I didn’t think it was a big deal, so I didn’t report it to you. After all, our site is very compliant and unafraid of checks. Who knew today would suddenly..."
Lin Fan said, "Do you guarantee there’s no problem with our site?"
Zhang Dafu said, "I dare to bet my life on it, boss. You have to trust me. Boss, I suspect we’re being targeted. What should we do now?"
Lin Fan’s gaze turned cold. He said, "I understand. Then let’s temporarily halt construction and cooperate with their requirements for rectification."
He hung up the phone.
Lin Fan coldly chuckled in his heart. He trusted Zhang Dafu; Zhang Dafu was more anxious about Blue Moon than he was, and would never do anything to harm the company.
The sudden notification to halt construction was quite suspicious.
Lin Fan had already thought of a person.
Jia Zuozhen.
It was very likely that this guy was behind the scenes causing trouble.
As for Jia Zuozhen, Lin Fan really couldn’t do anything about him at the moment, after all, he had both wealth and power, while Lin Fan only had wealth, which was still not enough.
It seemed that having money wasn’t enough; some connections were also needed. Lin Fan began to ponder.
Ring ring ring...
At this moment, a call came in. It was Liu Bing’er calling.
"Brother Lin, you’re coming to my grandfather’s birthday banquet tonight, right?" Liu Bing’er asked, seemingly wanting to confirm with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Yes, I was just planning to buy a birthday gift for the old gentleman. Your call came just in time; give me some advice. I really don’t know what to buy."
Liu Bing’er chuckled and said, "No need, Brother Lin, just your presence is enough. Grandpa was just talking about you, saying he hopes to see you tonight."
Lin Fan said, "How can I go empty-handed, that would be too rude."
Liu Bing’er thought for a while and said, "Then Brother Lin, you decide for yourself. Just buy a simple little gift; don’t spend too much, Grandpa doesn’t like overly expensive things."
Lin Fan said, "Okay, I understand."
Liu Bing’er laughed and said, "Then see you tonight."
At this moment, Lin Fan spotted a sign not far away with the three characters: Antique Street.
Lin Fan was delighted; for gifting an elder, antiques seemed the most suitable.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "See you tonight."
He hung up the phone and drove towards Antique Street...
This Antique Street was quite large, with various stalls displaying all kinds of antique items, paintings, vases, carvings...
They looked quite authentic.
However, Lin Fan had heard that most of the antiques seen on the street were fakes, with genuine ones being rarely seen.
If the gift for Elder Liu turned out to be a fake, wouldn’t that be insincere? Lin Fan also cared about his reputation.
"Handsome guy, see anything you like?"
At that moment, an uncle from a stall greeted Lin Fan.
Antique Street was bustling with people, most stalls had customers, but the uncle’s stall was somewhat deserted, probably because its location wasn’t prominent.
The uncle had to actively promote his goods.
Lin Fan, lacking any specific idea, walked over as the uncle greeted him.
The uncle warmly said, "Handsome guy, take a look at what you’d like. We have great stuff here."
Lin Fan glanced over the stall, his eyes landing on a stone. This stone had a warm hue and appeared quite ancient.
"What is this and how much is it?" Lin Fan asked.
The uncle said, "Handsome guy, you have a good eye. This is a top-quality jade stone, priced at one million."
One million...
Lin Fan put the stone down.
The uncle quickly said, "If it’s too expensive, feel free to negotiate a price!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "Never mind, it’s not that it’s too expensive, it’s too cheap."
Indeed, a one million gift felt a bit too low to give. Just the other day, he easily bought an entire luxury street for over a billion.
The uncle broke into a cold sweat.
Damn!
First time meeting someone who finds it cheap. Couldn’t tell this guy in bargain clothes might be rich?
Thinking about it, the uncle was delighted. He loved rich people—they were often foolish with money and easy to deceive. In the antiques business, the main trick was to fleece the wealthy.
If there weren’t so many fools, how else would the antiques business thrive!
The uncle regretted not asking for a higher price. If Lin Fan thought one million was cheap, would asking for ten million still seem cheap to him?
He might have even bought it!
The uncle felt regret, but luckily he still had a chance.
The uncle quickly said, "Handsome guy, you’ve got exquisite taste, I could tell at a glance. A noble person like you should buy antiques befitting your status. By the way, I have a top-quality jade piece here, please hold on."
The uncle started rummaging through his goods.
Lin Fan continued to browse. Suddenly, something caught his attention.
The uncle searched for a moment and took out a wooden box. Upon opening it, a greenish stone, about the size of a fist, lay inside.
Jade!
The uncle smiled and said, "Handsome guy, how about this jade? It’s the treasure of my booth—ah, I apologize, my stall’s treasure."
Lin Fan looked at it and asked, "How much?"
The uncle held up a single finger, "Fixed price, one million!"
This time, the uncle learned from the previous experience and asked for a higher price.
He realized Lin Fan was a rich man. What do rich people like most? Correct, face. So rich people dislike cheap things. The more expensive, the more they like it.
When rich people buy antiques, they aren’t buying the item itself; they’re buying the price. The more expensive it is, the prouder they feel.
So, even if this jade was worth only one million, asking for a hundred million wouldn’t be wrong. Maybe a foolish wealthy sucker would buy it, feeling extremely proud himself.
The uncle had been in the antique business for years and considered himself skilled in understanding the psyche of wealthy people. He only quoted one million initially because Lin Fan’s attire tricked him into thinking he was poor.
Once he knew Lin Fan was rich, the scheming naturally began.
Lin Fan, maintaining a calm expression, pointed to a nearby pile of jade bracelets, "How about these jade bracelets?"
The uncle said, "These are affordable items, 100 each, not suitable for someone of your status. Still, take a look at this jade piece."
Indeed, those jade bracelets were mass-produced fakes apparent even to fools, the uncle didn’t even bother trying to trick Lin Fan with them.
However, Lin Fan picked one from the pile and said, "I’ll take this one."
Then, Lin Fan pulled out a hundred-dollar bill and handed it to the uncle.
The uncle was a bit bewildered: wasn’t Lin Fan just saying things were too cheap, yet he bought a bracelet for only 100?
Having bought the bracelet, Lin Fan stood up, patted himself off, and prepared to leave.
"Handsome guy, about the jade..." the uncle said, unwilling to give up.
Lin Fan chuckled, "This so-called jade for one million is the same type as that one from just before for one million; it’s just been doctored. Uncle, you might have been scammed."
With that, Lin Fan shook his head and turned to leave.
Leaving the uncle in shock, damn, had he met an expert in treasure appraisal?
In truth, Lin Fan had top insight, and he simply saw through the uncle’s tricks, avoiding the con.
He was wealthy, but the uncle assumed he was foolish with money, wanting to scam his cash—it was wishful thinking.
As for that mere 100-yuan jade bracelet, it indeed was interesting...

chapters.title: Chapter 234: The stall owner is puzzled, feeling greatly disadvantaged.
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 234: The stall owner is puzzled, feeling greatly disadvantaged.
Lin Fan eventually picked a jade bracelet for only 100 yuan and left, which puzzled the stall owner.
At first, Lin Fan dismissed the jade as cheap, which led the stall owner to believe he was a wealthy customer, so he used the tactics he normally employed on rich people.
Little did he know, Lin Fan didn’t fall for it.
What a poser!
The stall owner finally "figured it out." Lin Fan didn’t fall for the trick because he was actually a poor person. He dismissed the jade’s value as a way of showing off.
If he was rich, he would definitely have bought expensive antiques—the more costly, the better. Most rich people are easily fooled when it comes to antiques. The stall owner’s extensive experience with wealthy customers never failed him in scamming them before.
"Damn it, broke loser, who are you trying to fool, wasting my enthusiasm like that!"
The stall owner got angry and cursed at Lin Fan’s departing figure, frustrated that he was the one who got tricked this time.
"I’ll never believe again that someone wearing cheap clothes could be rich..."
The stall owner’s words suddenly got stuck in his throat.
He watched with wide eyes as Lin Fan got into a Rolls-Royce by the roadside and drove away.
The stall owner was dumbfounded.
A wealthy person, could it be that this guy was really wealthy?
The stall owner was bewildered. If Lin Fan was indeed wealthy, why would he abandon the 1-million worth of jade and only buy a 100-yuan bracelet?
Where did all the "rich and easily fooled" people go?
Could Lin Fan be an exception?
The stall owner recalled Lin Fan’s words earlier; Lin Fan mentioned that his jade and that piece of stone were of the same material but faked.
A master!
The stall owner knew his own stock was fake because he was the one who forged it, but now the antique forgery techniques are so fine that most people can’t tell—they only obediently get scammed.
Lin Fan could tell at a glance that the jade was a fake?
This level of insight was simply astonishing.
He must be a master, an absolute master.
Wait a minute!
Lin Fan is a master, yet he specifically chose a roughly made jade bracelet. Why is that?
Could it be that the bracelet is actually a treasure?
If that’s the case, wouldn’t it mean Lin Fan bought a treasure for just 100 yuan?
Having this thought, the stall owner’s face turned pale, almost spitting out old blood, hitting his chest in frustration. He usually only took advantage of the rich, but today, Lin Fan, a rich guy, got the best of him.
The main issue is that he doesn’t even know how valuable that treasure actually is, leaving him quite upset.
By now, Lin Fan had driven far away, and even if the stall owner wanted to chase him, he couldn’t catch up, left only to sulk over the huge loss he had suffered.
Inside the Rolls-Royce, Lin Fan glanced at the jade bracelet placed beside him, smiling with satisfaction.
This jade bracelet was indeed nice. Among that pile of cheap bracelets, Lin Fan’s top-tier insight quickly spotted its uniqueness.
Initially, Lin Fan didn’t want any freebies, but since the stall owner tried to scam him, asking millions for a fake jade stone, Lin Fan didn’t mind taking a significant advantage in return.
Only 100 yuan, what a deal!
The gift was chosen, seeing the time it was getting late, Lin Fan decided to head back to Yunding Manor for a change of clothes.
Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet was not to be taken lightly. It would be best to dress decently. Fortunately, the suit from the last charity gala was kept at Yunding Manor.
Ring, ring, ring...
On the way back to Yunding Manor, Lin Fan suddenly received a call from his sister, Lin Shanshan.
Since Lin Shanshan started school and moved into the dormitory, Lin Fan hadn’t seen her.
"Shanshan, what’s up?" Lin Fan answered the call.
On the other end, Lin Shanshan’s voice came through, crying: "Brother, please come to school quickly, I’m so scared."
Lin Fan’s heart sank: "What happened?"
Lin Shanshan said, "There’s a girl at school, I don’t know what I did to upset her. Today, she slapped me as soon as she saw me and said she’d hit me every time she sees me. Just now, Little Lu and I were eating, we saw her again, and now I’m too afraid to leave, worried I’ll get hit."
Lin Fan was a bit furious. Who on Earth was so arrogant to bully his sister like that!
"Where are you? I’m heading over right now!" Lin Fan said.
Lin Shanshan replied, "At the street food stall in front of the school gate."
Lin Fan said, "Okay, stay in the shop and don’t leave. I’ll be there soon."
With that, Lin Fan had already turned his car around, heading towards Yun City Music Academy.
Yun City Music Academy.
The snack stall at the entrance.
Every time after school, many students come here for spicy soup, which is affordable and delicious, very popular among them.
Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were initially enjoying their spicy soup when suddenly they saw three female students arrive at the entrance, causing both of their expressions to change instantly.
Earlier that day, they had encountered these three girls. The leading girl, for unknown reasons, came up and slapped Lin Shanshan. Lin Shanshan, being quick-tempered, obviously didn’t let it slide and argued back.
However, the two tall delinquent girls beside the leader restrained both Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu.
The lead girl warned Lin Shanshan to stay out of her sight, or else she’d hit her every time.
So, running into these three girls again in the snack shop scared the wits out of Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu.
Lin Shanshan immediately sought out Lin Fan, not knowing who else to turn to. She felt safest with her brother.
After making the call, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu kept their heads down, terrified of being discovered by the three girls.
The three girls ordered their meal at the entrance and then walked into the store.
The leader of these girls was Jia Xueling.
At this time, the place was full, and seating inside the snack shop was limited; there were no empty seats left.
Jia Xueling scanned the room and noticed a corner where two girls’ pots were already empty, but they kept their heads down, not leaving.
Jia Xueling signaled to the delinquent girl next to her, who nodded knowingly, intending to make those people leave. The young lady of the Jia family needed a place to eat, after all.
At that moment, the shop owner cheerfully said, "Ladies, there are no spots inside, please take a seat by the entrance. I’ll set up a table for you."
The owner quickly set up a table outside and moved three chairs to it.
Jia Xueling shrugged and didn’t bother to make them leave. Instead, she took her seat at the newly set-up table.
Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu had been extremely anxious, afraid of being recognized. With quick glances, they found relief seeing the three head to the entrance and sit down, temporarily safe.
As long as they don’t step outside that door, they won’t be discovered. They could endure until those three leave before making their exit.
And so about ten minutes passed.
Jia Xueling continued eating, showing no intention of leaving.
Though finished long ago, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu’s lingering presence eventually caught the shop owner’s attention.
The shop owner came over with a smile, "Ladies, have you finished eating? The shop has limited seating, so if you’re done, please give up your table. Thank you."

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 245: You Try
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 245: You Try
Lin Shanshan quickly said, "We haven’t had enough to eat yet."
The shop owner looked at their pot: "But your pot is already empty. If you’re still hungry, you can order at the front."
Lin Shanshan said, "Can we wait a bit?"
The shop owner frowned, "Are you guys alright? Is there something wrong?"
Lin Shanshan replied, "No, we just want to wait a little."
The shop owner said, "I really apologize, but we have limited seating. If you’re not ordering, I’d appreciate it if you could give up your seats."
At this point, a girl next to them impatiently said, "Exactly, you’ve eaten your fill and still refuse to leave, hogging the spot without using it!"
Everyone around burst into laughter.
This made Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu feel very embarrassed.
Cheng Xiaolu, being hot-tempered, couldn’t help but retort, "Who said we’re full? If you want to sit, you can keep waiting!"
The commotion attracted Jia Xueling’s attention. When Jia Xueling looked inside, she immediately recognized Cheng Xiaolu, and without saying, the other person was certainly Lin Shanshan.
Jia Xueling sneered, "What a small world."
This morning at school, she passed by the place where Lin Fan had taught her a lesson and the more she thought about it, the angrier she became. And now fate had her run into Lin Shanshan.
She didn’t know Lin Shanshan’s name but recognized her as Lin Fan’s sister. She instantly got furious and went up to hit Lin Shanshan.
She didn’t expect to run into her again here.
Jia Xueling stood up and walked into the shop, followed swiftly by two of her lackey student gangsters.
"It’s so uncomfortable sitting outside. I heard there are seats inside?" Jia Xueling chuckled.
Everyone was a bit surprised to see Jia Xueling.
"It’s her!"
"Miss Jia, the flower of our school!"
"The daughter of the wealthy family."
The students started whispering to each other.
Upon hearing Jia Xueling speak, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were startled and quickly lowered their heads, fearing they would be recognized by Jia Xueling.
Jia Xueling sneered, "Don’t hide, I’ve already recognized you. I said this before, every time I see you, I’ll hit you!"
Realizing they had been recognized, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu had no choice but to reluctantly raise their heads.
"I don’t know you at all, and I have no grievance against you. Why are you doing this?" Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but ask.
Jia Xueling scoffed, "No grievance? You can ask your brother, then you’ll know why you’re getting hit."
Lin Shanshan was stunned, this has to do with her brother?
Jia Xueling signaled her two gangsters to go and hit Lin Shanshan.
The shop owner quickly intervened: "What’s going on? We’re all university students, let’s talk this out, please don’t start anything, my shop doesn’t welcome troublemakers!"
Jia Xueling retorted, "Get lost, do you know who I am? I’m Jia Xueling, my dad is Jia Zuozhen!"
"Ah?"
The shop owner’s face changed, the words he wanted to say were stuck in his throat, and he obediently stepped back. He was indeed intimidated by Jia Xueling’s background.
The billionaire daughter of Jia Zuozhen!
The crucial point is, this Jia Zuozhen indeed has a strong background. He, just a mala soup shop owner, couldn’t afford to provoke her at all!
If the shop owner didn’t dare to intervene, then other students dared even less to stop this.
"Got on the wrong side of Miss Jia, just consider yourself unlucky."
"Would anyone really dare to oppose her?"
"Of all people, why provoke her? It’s like asking for death!"
"Tsk tsk..."
The crowd started discussing in low voices.
They were all scared by Jia Xueling’s background, and no one would help Lin Shanshan.
The two gangster girls stepped forward and quickly overpowered Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu.
Only then did Jia Xueling approach the two girls.
"Don’t hit people, or I’ll tell the teacher. I don’t believe the school can’t deal with you!" Cheng Xiaolu threatened.
Jia Xueling glared at her, "Shut up, or you’ll get hit too!"
With that, Jia Xueling raised her hand, preparing to slap Lin Shanshan.
"You try it."
Suddenly, a voice came from behind, icy cold like the coldest ice.
Upon hearing the voice, Jia Xueling couldn’t help but shiver, her hand froze, and she turned to see Lin Fan walk in.
"Ah, it’s Teacher Lin!"
"Teacher Lin is here!"
"So handsome!"
The students all recognized Lin Fan and exclaimed in surprise. After all, Lin Fan was a star teacher at the Music Academy, hardly anyone didn’t know him.
The sudden appearance of Teacher Lin indeed took everyone by surprise.
"Brother!" Lin Shanshan got excited, finally her brother had come.
What?
The students were stunned, many didn’t know Lin Fan had a sister who also attended Music Academy.
Lin Fan’s face was a bit chilly at the moment, since Lin Shanshan had mentioned on the phone that she was hit by Jia Xueling today. As an older brother, how could he not be angry?
"Jia Xueling, aren’t you going to let your two lackeys release them! Are you ignoring a teacher’s words?" Lin Fan said sternly.
Lin Fan applied pressure using his status as a teacher.
Jia Xueling replied unhappily, "You’re just a part-time teacher, what are you conceited about? Do you believe I could make you lose your job at any moment?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Everyone heard it, this student Jia Xueling is indeed arrogant, caught bullying at school, yet doesn’t repent and even threatens me, the teacher! I really don’t believe you can make me lose my job."
Jia Xueling’s bluff, if it couldn’t be realized in front of so many people, would definitely ruin her reputation.
Jia Xueling sneered, "You probably don’t know, do you? This school receives a lot of sponsorship every year. Without these sponsorships, the school can’t even operate! A portion of these funds are provided by my dad, and other sponsors are also acquainted with my dad! Just one call from my dad can cut off most of the school’s sponsorships!"
Lin Fan laughed, "So what?"
Jia Xueling smiled, "Really ignorant, do you think the principal would allow conflict with the sponsors? To keep these sponsorships, she’d have no choice but to fire you, now do you understand?"
Lin Fan responded lightly, "I understand, you’re threatening the principal too, everyone heard it, this student Jia Xueling thinks she can do whatever she wants just because her father has some power."
Indeed, Jia Xueling was overly arrogant, especially targeting someone like the admired music prodigy Teacher Lin, which made the students indignant.
However, due to fear of Jia Xueling’s status, no one dared to speak up.
Jia Xueling sneered, "You have no idea what kind of person you’ve messed with, do you want to try?"
Lin Fan smiled, "No need for you to bother, why don’t I ask myself?"
With that, Lin Fan took out his phone and called Liu Mengjie: "Sister Mengjie, can I ask you a few questions?"
Liu Mengjie was a little surprised, wondering why Lin Fan suddenly called with these questions: "Hmm, what’s up?"
Lin Fan said, "Now there’s a choice, if you continue to let me be a teacher, the school’s sponsorships will be withdrawn. Would you choose to fire me or keep the sponsorships?"
Liu Mengjie replied without hesitation, "I would choose you, I can secure sponsorships again, but you... where else can I find someone like you?"
"Thank you, Sister Mengjie," Lin Fan smiled, looking at Jia Xueling.
Jia Xueling’s expression had become ugly, the taste of defeat wasn’t pleasant.
Lin Fan said, "One more question, if there are students bullying classmates at school, can I, as a teacher, step in to discipline them?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "Of course you can."
Lin Fan asked, "What kind of punishment would these students face?"
Liu Mengjie said, "If such students exist, depending on the situation, they could be warned or expelled. Little Fan, why are you asking me this, did you encounter such students? Let me know, I’ll make sure to deal with it seriously!"
Upon hearing this, Jia Xueling panicked slightly.
But Lin Fan smiled softly: "It’s nothing, just asking casually, I’ll hang up for now."
Finished speaking, Lin Fan hung up the phone.
Silence.
The little shop suddenly fell into a quiet state.

chapters.title: Chapter 236: The Arrogant Young Lady Tearfully Slaps Herself 3 Times
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 236: The Arrogant Young Lady Tearfully Slaps Herself 3 Times
The crowd’s hearts were all stirred up.
"What the hell!"
"Got slapped in the face!"
"This slap is too vicious!"
"This Jia family’s princess is too arrogant, deserves it!"
Lin Fan looked at Jia Xueling: "You heard it, the principal won’t kick me out because of sponsorship, so there’s no need to trouble your dad. Besides, if your dad really cuts off the school’s sponsorship, I’ll cover the cost myself."
Lin Fan is wealthy, even wealthier than her dad Jia Zuozhen. Jia Xueling knew this; she had no way to refute.
Lin Fan continued, "I haven’t told the principal about your actions yet. Do you want me to inform the principal and have you expelled, or should we settle this here?"
Jia Xueling bit her silver tooth: "Let them go!"
The two rogue students finally released Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu.
The two girls quickly ran behind Lin Fan, instantly feeling a great sense of security with him there.
Lin Fan said, "I heard from my sister that you hit her today, correct? That’s wrong; school bullying is a very vicious act. How about this, you apologize to her and then slap yourself three times to settle this matter."
What?
Just apologizing is one thing, but slapping herself three times?
Jia Xueling felt massively insulted and angrily said, "Dream on!"
She couldn’t possibly apologize to Lin Shanshan, let alone slap her own face. Consider her status, the eldest daughter of the Jia family, Jia Zuozhen’s daughter. Doing such a thing, where’s her face going to be?
Lin Fan chuckled, "You won’t do it, right? Then there’s no other way; we’ll handle this officially. I’ll report your behavior to the principal and let him deal with it. Record the wrongdoing if needed, expel where necessary."
Jia Xueling was furious, knowing the relationship between Lin Fan and the principal was quite intricate; the principal greatly admired Lin Fan. On the first day of school, the principal even personally greeted Lin Fan at the entrance, showing how much he was valued.
If Lin Fan reports to the principal, who she has struck is Lin Fan’s own sister, the principal will likely punish her severely, and expulsion is not impossible!
Moreover, even if her dad Jia Zuozhen intervenes, it wouldn’t work; the principal might be willing to offend Jia Zuozhen for Lin Fan!
She didn’t want to be expelled; she’s the school beauty, admired by everyone. If it’s spread that she’s expelled, she’d become the school’s joke.
Thinking of this, Jia Xueling bit her lip and said, "I can apologize to her for hitting her, but I won’t slap myself in the face!"
Lin Fan laughed, "Apologizing is necessary, but if apologies worked, why would we need the police? You’ve made a mistake; apologizing is basic, but you must pay a necessary price."
Jia Xueling angrily said, "Lin Fan, don’t push me too far. My dad is Jia Zuozhen; you can’t afford to provoke him. Think about the consequences, can you handle it?"
Lin Fan responded, "Oh, is your dad that powerful?"
Jia Xueling sneered, "You have no idea about my dad’s capabilities. His network is beyond your imagination. I’ve already told him about that day; he’s very angry. If I tell him about today, just wait, you definitely won’t have a good outcome!"
Lin Fan sneered, realizing that indeed, Jia Xueling had spoken to Jia Zuozhen, which led to him targeting Lin Fan repeatedly.
Seeing Lin Fan silent, Jia Xueling thought he was intimidated and secretly rejoiced, thinking Lin Fan, what are you fighting me with?
Jia Xueling chuckled, "I’ve already explained his power to you. I hope today’s matter ends here. I guarantee I won’t tell my dad about this!"
Jia Xueling was threatening and promising; as long as Lin Fan didn’t embarrass her publicly, her goal was achieved. After the matter is over, she could still deal with Lin Fan later.
Knocking one stick, giving one candy, but Lin Fan didn’t fall for it. The truth is, Jia Zuozhen was already taking action against him, and even though he didn’t yet know how to handle it, there’s no way he’d bow down to Jia Zuozhen.
Lin Fan calmly said, "Stop struggling, I’ll give you one last chance to decide yourself in three seconds."
While speaking, he picked up his phone, pretending to call Liu Mengjie.
Jia Xueling was both anxious and angry--her threat had failed!
Her only leverage against Lin Fan was her dad, but Lin Fan seemed unafraid of her dad, leaving her helpless.
Three seconds quickly passed.
Seeing Jia Xueling unresponsive, Lin Fan reached out to press the call button, ready to call Liu Mengjie.
"Wait!"
Jia Xueling finally spoke, her face flushed.
Lin Fan’s hand paused.
Jia Xueling lowered her head to Lin Shanshan: "I’m sorry."
Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu exchanged glances, both happily realizing they’d succeeded; Lin Fan had subdued this unreasonable Jia family’s eldest daughter.
Lin Shanshan giggled, "What did you say, can you say it louder? I can’t hear clearly."
Jia Xueling was angry at heart but didn’t dare continue stubbornly. Her voice grew louder, and through clenched teeth, said, "I’m sorry!"
Lin Shanshan replied, "That’s better; I heard it clearly."
Cheng Xiaolu said, "Now that she’s apologized, it’s time for the face slapping. I’m really looking forward to it."
Everyone was watching Jia Xueling, waiting for her next step.
Slap!
Jia Xueling slapped her own face, following with left and right blows, slapping each cheek twice, fulfilling Lin Fan’s request—three slaps in total.
Cheng Xiaolu laughed until she bent over: "This face-slapping is great; it would be even better with a few more slaps."
Though the people around didn’t dare show it, they secretly enjoyed seeing the Jia family’s eldest daughter humiliated, pleased indeed. Many had been bullied by Jia Xueling’s arrogance and Lin Fan avenged them all.
Jia Xueling felt utterly humiliated, her eyes turning red, desperately holding back tears from falling.
"Let’s go!"
Jia Xueling angrily glanced at Lin Fan, then turned and left, followed closely by her two rogue companions.
"Well done, Teacher Lin!"
"Really satisfying!"
Someone unknown cheered, leading the applause.
Instantly, the snack bar echoed with applause and laughter.
Walking out of the snack bar, Jia Xueling heard the cheers, staggered, almost falling in anger, stomped her foot in frustration, and couldn’t hold back anymore, starting to cry.
Jia Xueling immediately called her dad, Jia Zuozhen.
"Dad, Lin Fan bullied me again; you must defend me!"
Jia Zuozhen angrily asked, "What happened?"
Jia Xueling said, "I don’t know, he threatened me as a teacher, forcing me to apologize and... and slap myself three times. I brought you up, but that bastard wasn’t afraid of you; under his coercion, I had to... wah wah wah... Dad, you must help me!"
Jia Zuozhen jumped up angrily, "How dare he, that guy is simply too much! Looks like the lesson he’s received isn’t enough; see how I’ll deal with him next!"

chapters.title: Chapter 237: He Is a Distinguished Guest Personally Invited by Grandfather
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 237: He Is a Distinguished Guest Personally Invited by Grandfather
Finally having dealt with the spoiled Miss Jia from the Jia Family, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu were both relieved and happy.
"Thank you, brother!" Lin Shanshan threw herself into Lin Fan’s arms, holding her brother tightly. Luckily, her brother was there; otherwise, she wouldn’t know what to do.
She really didn’t dare provoke someone like Jia Xueling, who was rich and powerful, but fortunately, Lin Fan was even harder to mess with.
Cheng Xiaolu looked up at Lin Fan with admiration, her respect for him flowing like a river... He’s such a handsome man-god!
"If only he were my boyfriend, ah, just thinking about it makes my heart melt," Cheng Xiaolu shouted inwardly. Although she was Lin Shanshan’s best friend, she would not hesitate if she could become Lin Shanshan’s sister-in-law.
The nearby students also looked at Lin Fan with admiration. Teacher Lin was so handsome, today was truly an iconic moment. Once this gets out, it’s bound to become a classic school tale.
Lin Fan himself didn’t think much of it, dealing with Jia Xueling was no big deal at all; the real challenge was Jia Zuozhen behind her.
After today’s incident, Jia Zuozhen would likely take even more severe revenge on him.
And he still didn’t have a plan to deal with Jia Zuozhen.
But, when soldiers come, a general will stand against them, and when water arrives, soil will counter it—Lin Fan was never afraid of troubles, and that’s why he decisively taught Jia Xueling a lesson today.
"Have you eaten yet? I’ll drive you both back to school," Lin Fan smiled.
So, the three of them left the snack shop and returned to school.
"Brother, why did this Miss Jia hit me? She seemed to say it was related to you?" Lin Shanshan remembered and asked curiously.
Lin Fan replied, "Yeah, I have a little grudge with her, I’ll tell you when I have time. I have a birthday banquet to attend later."
"Okay then."
Lin Shanshan didn’t ask more. Back at the school gate, the three parted ways, Lin Shanshan and Cheng Xiaolu returned to the dormitory, while Lin Fan left on his own.
Just as he got into the car, Lin Fan received a call from Liu Bing’er.
"Brother Lin, the birthday banquet starts at six, when are you coming? I’ll greet you," Liu Bing’er asked.
Tonight is Grandpa’s birthday banquet, inviting many notable people, but among all the distinguished guests, Liu Bing’er seemed to only care about Lin Fan.
Lin Fan checked the time, and said, "I’m heading there now."
He originally planned to return to Yunding Manor to change, as there was a top-tier custom suit Anna helped him make last time still at Yunding Manor.
However, delayed by Lin Shanshan’s matter, it’s too late to go back to Yunding Manor now, he would definitely be late.
Lin Fan weighed it, whether it was harder to accept going to a birthday banquet wearing cheap clothes or being late.
Lin Fan felt it was the latter. If one is late at someone’s birthday banquet, it might upset the host!
Lin Fan had great respect for Liu Tingshan, and he did not want such a thing to happen.
So, Lin Fan ultimately gave up going back to change clothes at Yunding Manor and directly headed to the Liu Family.
Then Lin Fan couldn’t help but think of Anna, if Anna were there, it’d be great. He could have Anna bring the clothes, as his housekeeper, Anna indeed made him very worry-free in these aspects.
Lin Fan decided to win over Anna as soon as possible.
Peninsula Mansion.
The biggest thing today was the birthday banquet of Liu Tingshan, Elder Liu’s birthday, with many distinguished figures attending, from politics to business, truly a gathering of the elite.
Luxury cars jammed the community roads completely.
Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce arrived at the Peninsula Mansion entrance, yet couldn’t get inside for the time being, as a sign at the entrance indicated parking was full.
Helpless, Lin Fan had to find a place to park outside the neighborhood and then walked into Peninsula Mansion.
Liu Family Mansion, bustling at the entrance, guests overflowing, quite lively.
Two young Liu family members welcomed guests at the entrance, each guest would present an invitation before signing in; the Liu Family was not a place anyone could enter, only those invited had the privilege to go in.
When Lin Fan arrived at the door, he was stopped by the two young Liu family members.
"What are you doing here?"
The two young Liu family members sized up Lin Fan. Seeing him dressed in cheap attire, their attitude turned sour immediately.
Any guest arriving here was splendidly dressed, women in elegant gowns and men in suits, all brand names like Gucci, Armani, Dolce & Gabbana... Wearing slightly lower-end brands would be embarrassing.
But Lin Fan was wearing cheap street clothes, without any brand, just costing a few dozen bucks.
It was clear as day he was not a guest.
But Lin Fan said, "I’m here to attend Mr. Liu’s birthday banquet."
"You, attend the banquet?"
"Kid, don’t come here to cause trouble!"
The two young Liu family members said with frosty faces, not polite at all.
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan, I really am invited by Mr. Liu to the banquet."
"Lin Fan?"
"Never heard of you, do you have an invitation? Show us!"
Lin Fan, sweating, said, "I left in a hurry that day, didn’t bring an invitation."
"No invitation, no entry!"
"You’re not on the guest list either. I think you’re here to make trouble; you’d better wise up and scram, or we’ll have someone throw you out!"
After confirming Lin Fan had no invitation, coupled with his attire, the two young Liu family members were convinced he wasn’t a guest, thus increasingly hostile in their attitude.
The people around glanced over with disdain for Lin Fan, finding it ridiculous he pretended to be a guest.
"Brother Lin!"
Just then, a joyful voice rang, and Liu Bing’er came over delightedly to Lin Fan.
"Brother Lin, you finally came, I’ve been waiting so long for you. I planned to come out to greet you but got held up for a bit; glad to see you now," Liu Bing’er said, genuinely excited about Lin Fan’s arrival.
Lin Fan smiled, "I just got here, but I have no invitation and was stopped."
"Sister Bing’er, who is he?"
The two young Liu family members broke into a cold sweat; Liu Bing’er showed such enthusiasm for this guy in cheap clothes, which was truly bewildering.
Liu Bing’er turned coldly and said, "He’s a valued guest invited personally by Grandpa; you all move aside!"
"Sorry, we didn’t know."
The two young Liu family members quickly apologized, stepping aside. Just Liu Bing’er personally welcoming him was enough to kneel, let alone him being personally invited by Elder Liu, an extraordinary matter.
Liu Bing’er led Lin Fan into the inner residence.
The two young Liu family members exchanged glances, curious to death about this guy in cheap clothes with no invitation and not on the list, wondering who he really was.
Entering the inner residence.
The guests had already gathered around, chatting in groups. This wasn’t just Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet but also a rare social opportunity where notable guests could meet some seen less frequently, offering a chance to socialize.
At a prominent place in the hall, as guests entered, they offered gifts, all meant for Liu Tingshan.
These notable figures loved saving face, so the gifts couldn’t be shabby; otherwise, the embarrassment wouldn’t be on the host but themselves.
Thus, even though Liu Tingshan had stressed not to bring expensive gifts, he couldn’t stop the guests’ face-saving instinct, turning gift-giving into a covert competition.
"Mr. and Mrs. He, presenting a pair of Dragon and Phoenix Jade Bracelets," the disciple in charge of receiving gifts said loudly.
The guests looked over, all captivated by the Dragon and Phoenix Jade Bracelets, praising them. A pair of exquisite bracelets that looked precious, even the box holding them was a finely crafted artwork, worth tens of thousands.
The He couple, seeing such a reaction, naturally felt immensely proud and delighted.
Seeing everyone presenting gifts as they came in, Lin Fan also went over and fished out a jade bracelet from his pocket.
"This is my gift, wishing Mr. Liu happiness as vast as the Eastern Sea, and longevity like the southern mountains," Lin Fan said, smiling, as he handed over the jade bracelet.
What?
Everyone almost burst out laughing. This jade bracelet clearly looked rough in craftsmanship and wasn’t even packaged, just like that?
Seeing Lin Fan dressed in such cheap clothes, everyone couldn’t help but look down on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 The Antique Master: This Jade Bracelet Starts at 100 Million!
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 238 The Antique Master: This Jade Bracelet Starts at 100 Million!
Lin Fan, in a rush, didn’t even wrap the gift; he just brought it along.
If he had more time, he would at least buy a gift box to dress it up, making it look more like a present.
Now Lin Fan pulled the jade bracelet straight out of his pants pocket, and everyone saw what his gift was.
A rather rough jade bracelet, looking just like the kind of cheap craftwork you could buy for a few yuan by the roadside.
This made those present look on with disdain.
"Come on sir, you’re really giving this away?"
"He looks poor and shabby; what he’s wearing is probably cheaper than that jade bracelet!"
"I’m dying of laughter!"
"How did this pauper even get in here!"
"All gifting jade bracelets, but there’s a world of difference! The jade bracelet given by Mr. and Mrs. He — now that’s a bracelet!"
Everyone laughed uproariously.
These words were meant to provoke, and if Mr. and Mrs. He had high emotional intelligence, they would seize the opportunity to be humble, both defusing the situation and gaining some goodwill.
But hearing these remarks, Mr. and Mrs. He grew exceedingly proud and arrogant, as they inherently despised someone like Lin Fan.
"Our bracelet is top quality nephrite imported from Myanmar, crafted by Yun City’s finest jade artisan, Master Tan. Comparing his with ours is simply insulting!"
"Indeed, how could he even compare?"
In their speech, Mr. and Mrs. He conveyed total disdain for Lin Fan.
The Liu family member responsible for collecting gifts sneered at Lin Fan’s gift as well, muttering, "Might as well not have given anything!"
The atmosphere became a bit awkward.
Liu Bing’er noticed the situation and smiled, "Thank you, Brother Lin!"
Without saying much more, she accepted the jade bracelet and handed it to the responsible member, "Put it away!"
Liu Bing’er spoke up, so the responsible member dared not refuse and took it.
Liu Bing’er apologized, "Sorry, Brother Lin."
She truly didn’t care what gift Lin Fan gave, but she didn’t want Lin Fan to be ridiculed.
Lin Fan chuckled indifferently, "No worries, they’re just short-sighted."
He casually spoke to Liu Bing’er, but Mr. and Mrs. He overheard and were instantly displeased.
"What did you say, we have poor taste? Hearing that from you is just ridiculous."
"Our jade bracelet cost thirty million, may I ask how much yours cost?"
Mr. and Mrs. He sneered.
Lin Fan replied honestly, "Not much, found it for 100 yuan on Antique Street."
Laughs erupted.
The laughter shook the heavens!
"Hahaha, I’m dying here, 100 yuan, and he still has the nerve to speak!"
"He must be a fool!"
"Giving away a cheap piece and saying it’s poor taste to give top-quality jade; surely he’s an idiot!"
"Really clueless!"
"Who is this pauper anyway, how is he qualified to be a guest with us?"
"He’s dragging down the whole tone of the birthday banquet!"
Everyone mocked incessantly.
Seeing everyone speak like this, Mr. and Mrs. He grew even more conceited, casting lofty looks at Lin Fan, their sense of superiority overflowing.
Liu Bing’er couldn’t bear to watch anymore; she wouldn’t tolerate anyone humiliating Brother Lin this way!
Besides, what they said was wrong; Brother Lin wasn’t as they described.
As for the gift Lin Fan gave, if it truly was a cheap item, it wasn’t Lin Fan’s fault; she relayed her grandfather’s words not to send expensive gifts. Surely, these people wouldn’t blame her grandfather?
However, before Liu Bing’er could speak, an elderly gentleman entered from outside—a man nearing sixty, dressed in a Tang suit, hands behind his back, exuding an aura of a master.
The elder’s eyes fell upon the jade bracelet in the Liu family’s hands, paused momentarily, then showed surprise.
That Liu family member, hearing everyone’s words, looked down on Lin Fan in their heart; this jade bracelet was nothing but worthless trash.
The Liu family member was just about to casually toss the jade bracelet aside.
"Wait!"
The master-like elder quickly stopped them.
The Liu family member’s hand froze.
Seeing this elder, many present were caught by surprise.
"It’s Master Zhang!"
"What? Isn’t he the renowned Zhang Baishi of the antique world?"
"Indeed! The most famous master in today’s antique world, rumored to have an innate sharp eye, able to appraise treasures with 100% accuracy!"
"In the antique world, Master Zhang is truly an authority among authorities—his presence is truly a mark of great esteem!"
Discussions broke out among the crowd.
The elder walked briskly closer, snatched the jade bracelet from the Liu family’s hands, examined it closely, and displayed a look of delighted excitement.
"Where did this jade bracelet come from?" the elder asked joyfully.
The Liu family member looked bewildered.
Lin Fan smiled, "I picked it up for 100 yuan on Antique Street, it looked nice, so I bought it."
The elder paused, then laughed heartily, "100 yuan, remarkable! Young man, do you know what this jade bracelet is?"
Lin Fan said, "I’d love to hear more."
The elder seemed quite impressive, and he might gain some insight, although Lin Fan, using his top-notch insight, knew the jade bracelet wasn’t ordinary. He wasn’t sure of its specifics.
Zhang Baishi said, "This jade bracelet comes from the Western Han Dynasty. Don’t be misled by its rough work; it’s because it’s a half-finished piece. Legend has it as part of Zhaojun’s dowry, top-quality nephrite jade from Huaxia, one of the four great jades of ancient times, once called Kunshan Jade. This jade bracelet is the jewel of all jewels, extremely rare."
Upon hearing this, the place went silent, astounding everyone.
If someone else uttered these words, surely some would question.
But coming from Zhang Baishi, the most reputable figure in today’s antiques, no one dared to question his words, nor were they qualified!
Oh my, this jade bracelet, really that precious?
This...
Wasn’t it like slapping everyone’s faces!
A moment ago, they openly mocked!
Lin Fan smiled, "Master, hearing me get this for 100 yuan, you claim it remarkable, surely this nephrite jade bracelet must be worth quite a fortune."
Zhang Baishi said, "Treasure like this is priceless. If auctioned at current market prices, it would start at at least 1 billion."
What?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Oh my, this shoddy jade bracelet starts at 1 billion?
This certainly is a sky-high jade bracelet!
If the one saying this wasn’t Zhang Baishi, most people probably wouldn’t believe it, but Zhang Baishi is the authority—if he says so, it must be true!
Zhang Baishi laughed, "For 100 yuan, you acquired this priceless treasure. Isn’t that remarkable? Young man, your judgment in buying this is quite impressive!"
Master Zhang recognizes his impressive judgment!
Liu Bing’er couldn’t help but feel happy and said, "Brother Lin, the jade bracelet you gave is truly valuable, probably the most precious in the entire venue!"
While this compliment was sincere, it was clearly mocking everyone else.
Those who had mocked Lin Fan earlier blushed with embarrassment, their faces burning as if slapped with several heavy slaps.
The "cheap piece" they scorned turned out to be a priceless jewel, vastly more precious than any gift anyone else had given!
"Brother Lin, this jade bracelet is too valuable to accept, why don’t you take it back?" Liu Bing’er said.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Identity Exposed, Slap in the Face Couple Flee in Panic
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 239: Identity Exposed, Slap in the Face Couple Flee in Panic
Lin Fan smiled faintly and said, "Although it is a priceless treasure, for me, it’s just a gift I spent 100 yuan on. Besides, a gift once given can’t be taken back."
Zhang Baishi laughed heartily, giving a thumbs up: "Young man, your outlook is impressive. I admire you! Hahaha, may I ask the young man’s name?"
Lin Fan said, "Hello Master, I am Lin Fan."
At this moment, Mr. and Mrs. He turned pale. They were the most arrogant just now, and now they are the most ridiculed.
Lin Fan’s Jade Bracelet is a priceless treasure, a heavy blow to them, as it far exceeds their own Jade Bracelet.
Mr. and Mrs. He felt a bit unwilling. Could they really be defeated by someone wearing street stall clothes? It’s too embarrassing!
"Master Zhang, hello. We gifted a pair of Jade Dragon and Phoenix Bracelets. Could you help us appraise their worth?"
"I believe ours are also priceless treasures, and there are two of them."
Mr. and Mrs. He said, harboring a lucky hope that if theirs were also priceless treasures, they would regain some face.
Since Lin Fan’s broken bracelet could be an object from the Western Han Dynasty, why couldn’t their Dragon and Phoenix Bracelets be?
Mr. and Mrs. He took the gift back and handed it to Zhang Baishi for appraisal.
Zhang Baishi took a glance and chuckled: "Congratulations to you both."
Mr. and Mrs. He were pleasantly surprised: "How is it, Master Zhang? Could it be that ours are also priceless treasures?"
Zhang Baishi shook his head, chuckling: "No, I congratulate you both for falling for a scam. You have bought fake jade; these worthless stones aren’t worth a penny."
What?
Mr. and Mrs. He were shocked, their faces turned ashen, staggering and almost losing their balance.
"Pfft!"
Seeing this, Lin Fan couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
Mr. and Mrs. He were furious, it was so embarrassing, yet they were being mocked by such a pauper.
"You just got lucky, a blind cat catching a dead mouse. After all, you’re poor, that’s why you spent 100 yuan buying antiques!"
"Exactly, we at least spent tens of thousands, showing our sincerity!"
Mr. and Mrs. He shouted angrily.
Hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Earlier, they were embarrassed by Lin Fan, and now they finally found a reason to mock him. Yes, he’s just poor.
"Poor people are like this, they rely on luck to buy treasures, look at how smug he looks!"
"It’s really funny, spending 100 yuan on a gift; is that something to boast about?"
"Isn’t it embarrassing!"
Everyone chimed in.
Mr. and Mrs. He sneered: "What, cat got your tongue, pauper? Aren’t you skilled with words, why aren’t you speaking now?"
Their faces were full of sarcasm and bitterness. Anyway, Lin Fan was wearing street stall clothes, clearly a pauper with no chance for a turnaround, right?
At this moment, a white-haired old man walked in, caught sight of Lin Fan, and hurriedly ran over.
He bowed respectfully to Lin Fan: "Chairman."
Lin Fan recognized him; he was Li Hongting, the second largest shareholder of Celestial Aviation.
When Li Hongting first took over Celestial Aviation, he didn’t think much of Lin Fan, but when Celestial Aviation’s stock continued to soar for three consecutive days, rising from a market value of 50 billion to 90 billion, Li Hongting was already submissively obedient.
In his eyes, Lin Fan now was nothing less than a deity.
So when he saw Lin Fan, he immediately came over to greet the chairman respectfully.
Lin Fan said, "Elder Li, you’re here too?"
Li Hongting said, "Yes, I’m friends with the third son of the Liu Family, Liu Tianhao, and was invited over."
Lin Fan acknowledged: "So you’re his friend."
That day, Lin Fan claimed he had already bought Celestial Aviation, but Liu Tianhao didn’t believe it and called a high-ranking friend at Celestial Aviation to verify it, though Lin Fan didn’t know that friend was Li Hongting.
At this moment, everyone present exchanged glances.
What’s going on?
Li Hongting was actually so respectful to this guy and called him "Chairman"?
"Ah, could he be the chairman of Celestial Aviation?"
"No way, the recent surge in Celestial Aviation’s stock is rumored to be because a new chairman was appointed!"
"Wait, what’s his name again, Lin Fan?"
"The new chairman of Celestial Aviation is named Lin Fan!"
In no time, everyone was incredibly shocked.
This guy in street stall clothes was actually the recently rising tycoon Lin Fan!
Recently, a tycoon named Lin Fan has emerged rapidly in Yun City, spending money wildly, investing in top-tier companies, buying land, buildings, and companies.
He spent 6 billion to purchase Chiba Island in the golden region of Daya Bay!
Spent 10 billion to acquire the Zhou Tian Mansion.
He became the chairman and largest shareholder of the 50 billion airline company, Celestial Aviation, and within three days, Celestial Aviation’s market value approached 90 billion!
These are Lin Fan’s most astounding feats, and there are even more substantial ones, which are quite remarkable for others, but seem trivial for Lin Fan.
The hall fell silent, and for a moment, it was immersed in astonishment.
Mr. and Mrs. He were already completely petrified.
The "pauper" they looked down upon was actually the largest shareholder of a company valued at 90 billion!
The blow was indeed too severe.
"Miss Liu, we’re suddenly feeling unwell and should leave. Please apologize to Mr. Liu on our behalf."
Mr. and Mrs. He left a message and fled in disarray; gifting fake items, and mocking a billionaire tycoon for poverty was a complete loss of face, not to mention staying!
Although Lin Fan was dressed in street stall clothes, he seemed to have more wealth than most present!
Poor people wear street stall clothes, which means poverty, while wealthy people wear them, which means being humble and down-to-earth; the wealthier one is, the higher the class appears.
For a moment, in everyone’s eyes, Lin Fan’s street stall clothes seemed incredibly classy.
After this interlude, guests continued to enter. Many who had learned Lin Fan’s identity actively came forward to connect with him.
Once they knew Lin Fan’s identity, many in the business world sought to build ties with him.
Lin Fan had emerged recently, knowing little about the Yun City business circle. He met some people at a charity event last time, and this time made new acquaintances, including some political figures.
Fortunately, Liu Bing’er was by his side, introducing Lin Fan to her uncles and aunts who came to attend Elder Liu’s birthday banquet, most of whom Liu Bing’er recognized.
A wealthy-looking elderly man actively approached.
His face was rosy, despite his age, his spirit was great.
The old man introduced himself: "Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m Song Rongmao, the president of the Yun City Chamber of Commerce. I’ve long admired your reputation. Mr. Lin, you’re truly a fearsome young prodigy!"
The president of the Yun City Chamber of Commerce?
That’s quite impressive.
Lin Fan shook hands with Song Rongmao and smiled: "You’re flattering me, elder."
Song Rongmao said, "Mr. Lin, it’s rare for someone as remarkable as you to be so humble and courteous. It’s truly admirable. By the way, Mr. Lin, in three days, we are holding the Yun City Business Conference, where all the business tycoons of Yun City will attend. I would like to invite Mr. Lin. I wonder if you’d honor us with your presence?"
Liu Bing’er leaned to Lin Fan’s ear: "Elder Song is held in high regard in the Yun City business circle. Elder Song’s personal invitation carries great significance; Brother Lin, you should agree quickly."
Lin Fan nodded, good business decisions don’t involve offending people, especially when it’s a good thing.
"I will certainly be there," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Song Rongmao was very pleased: "That’s wonderful, I’ll have someone send a formal invitation to Mr. Lin tomorrow."
At this moment, a tall, thin middle-aged man entered the hall, holding a cigar, looking smug.
Upon entering, he presented a gift and said, "Sun Dajin from Zhongtai Securities, a small token of goodwill, wishing Elder Liu a long life."
After giving the gift, Sun Dajin turned and said loudly, "Waiter, get me some wine. Yes, you, hurry up!"
His gaze fell on Lin Fan, pointing with an arrogant manner.
Seeing Lin Fan in cheap attire, he assumed he was a waiter.
Having just sent off Song Rongmao, Lin Fan was suddenly shouted at by someone. He frowned but ignored Sun Dajin.
Sun Dajin, seeing Lin Fan not responding, became angry: "Are you deaf, a lousy waiter, showing off!"
Sun Dajin’s arrogant words instantly drew everyone’s attention.
Those who knew Lin Fan’s identity were amused; they saw this Sun Dajin mistaking Lin Fan for a waiter—he was heading straight for trouble!

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Get out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 240: Get out!
Sun Dajin demanded Lin Fan to serve him wine, treating Lin Fan as a waiter and with a very arrogant attitude, completely bossing him around.
This made those who knew Lin Fan’s identity feel that Sun Dajin probably hit a brick wall this time.
However, Lin Fan remained calm, chuckling and saying, "Sorry, you’ve got the wrong person, I’m not a waiter."
Attending such an occasion, Lin Fan had originally planned to wear that top-notch suit but got delayed by his sister’s issue and didn’t have time to go back to the villa to change. So he accepted being mistaken due to his attire, as long as the other party wasn’t excessive, he couldn’t be bothered to fuss over it.
But Sun Dajin said, "Not a waiter? Even if you’re not a waiter, you’re a servant. What’s wrong with ordering you around? Isn’t that what servants are for? Now quickly serve me some wine!"
As he spoke, Sun Dajin took a vicious drag on his cigar, looking unbearably arrogant.
Lin Fan furrowed his brows, this idiot was way too disrespectful. Even a servant has dignity; they’re just doing their job, there’s no need for such humiliation.
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, I’m not a servant either; I’m a guest here just like you."
"What?" Sun Dajin sized up Lin Fan, his face full of disbelief, "You a guest?"
"Sun Dajin, what are you yelling about that I can hear you from outside?"
A very pleasant woman’s voice.
Just then, an extraordinarily beautiful woman walked in.
The woman was very young, with an angelic, stunning face, but with a powerful aura. In her evening dress, she was like a queen, astonishing everyone present.
"It’s her!"
"Feng Ruolan!"
"My God, the richest woman in Yun City, the financial empress!"
"She’s here!"
The crowd burst into exclamations. As soon as Feng Ruolan appeared, she became the focal point of the entire room, drawing everyone’s eyes.
She was truly too beautiful. As both Yun City’s richest woman and such an outstanding beauty, she was simply the epitome of perfection.
Lin Fan was also amazed by his wealthy sister. Just today, he had seen Feng Ruolan in three ways: as a career woman in a business suit, as a graceful lady in casual wear, and now, as a radiant beauty in an evening dress, overshadowing all the female stars.
Sun Dajin, upon seeing Feng Ruolan, was startled but forced himself to calm down.
"Hello, President Feng." Sun Dajin hurriedly walked up to Feng Ruolan and greeted her respectfully, without a trace of his earlier arrogance, completely turning into a lapdog.
Feng Ruolan said, "You haven’t answered my question yet."
Sun Dajin smiled awkwardly, "It’s nothing, just instructing a servant to help bring wine, but this guy didn’t cooperate. Small matter, small matter, not worth bothering President Feng."
Feng Ruolan pointed at Lin Fan: "Are you saying my brother is a servant?"
Sun Dajin shivered in fright, dropping his cigar: "Brother?"
The surrounding people were also dumbfounded.
What?
Lin Fan is Feng Ruolan’s brother?
With a smile, Feng Ruolan said, "Let me introduce, this is Lin Fan, I am his sister. Sun Dajin, you’re quite something, ordering my brother to fetch wine for you?"
Thud!
Sun Dajin’s legs went soft, and he directly kneeled down.
Damn!
This guy dressed in cheap clothes is actually Feng Ruolan’s brother! And he had the nerve to speak disrespectfully to Feng Ruolan’s brother!
This was akin to a courtier in ancient times being disrespectful to the queen’s princely brother, a crime punishable by death.
His Zhongtai Securities Company, in front of Feng Ruolan’s Longheng Group, was insignificant. With a flick of her fingers, his company could turn to ashes.
"I’m sorry, I really didn’t know he was your brother. If I knew, I wouldn’t have dared even with ten times the guts. I’m really despicable, President Feng, please forgive me!" Sun Dajin pleaded for mercy, almost crying in fear.
Feng Ruolan glanced around, then waved to a nearby waiter.
The waiter hurried over.
Feng Ruolan picked up a glass of wine from the tray.
"You want wine, right? Let me get it for you personally, drink up."
As she spoke, Feng Ruolan poured the wine from her glass over Sun Dajin’s head, the red wine drenched him, making him look extremely pathetic.
Sun Dajin trembled uncontrollably, not daring to utter a single word.
After pouring the wine, Feng Ruolan placed the glass back on the tray and said coldly, "If it happens again, your company might as well shut down. Leave."
"It won’t happen again, I’ll leave immediately." Sun Dajin, like someone granted amnesty, hurriedly got up and slinked away.
The people exchanged looks; too domineering. This scene was truly awe-inspiring. Feng Ruolan protecting her brother like this was too powerful. Witnessing this firsthand, who would dare disrespect Lin Fan in the future? With such a sister, Lin Fan could practically walk sideways in Yun City.
Moreover, Lin Fan himself was not simple, being the chairman of a company with a 90 billion market value, an identity enough to earn respect.
Already so outstanding, he is also the brother of Feng Ruolan from the super family Feng Family, which, once spread, will definitely further boost Lin Fan’s reputation and even Celestial Aviation’s stock prices will rise.
Although the people didn’t know the richest woman in Yun City actually had a brother, this was confirmed by Feng Ruolan herself, right in front of everyone, handling someone who spoke rudely to Lin Fan, leaving no room for disbelief.
After dealing with Sun Dajin, Feng Ruolan leaned over to Lin Fan and smiled: "Little Fan, don’t let that idiot Sun Dajin affect your mood. If you’re still unsatisfied, I’ll just acquire Zhongtai Securities tomorrow and send Sun Dajin off to Africa."
Lin Fan wiped his forehead, his sister was so ruthless, deporting people to Africa at the drop of a hat.
"It’s nothing, that idiot couldn’t possibly affect my mood, but sister, you did affect it." Lin Fan smiled, continuing, "Seeing you so beautiful tonight, seeing my sister, my mood just got better."
Feng Ruolan chuckled, "Since when did your sweet talk get so smooth?"
Her words were indeed full of joy, like she had eaten sugar, sweet.
