Lin Fan was a bit mesmerized; he now understood what it means when a woman smiles, she captivates the world. Even though his sister wasn’t smiling back, with just a smile, she could make the palace beauties pale in comparison.
"Haha, President Feng, you were just so imposing."
Suddenly, a man in a suit holding a champagne flute walked over, speaking in a snarky tone.
The suit-wearing man was in his fifties, slim and tall with ordinary looks, but dressed in a designer suit and well-maintained skin, clearly indicating he was a well-off man.
Lin Fan frowned, who was this now?
There were just too many idiots causing trouble tonight, it exceeded the limit.
Seeing this middle-aged man, Feng Ruolan’s face turned cold: "What’s it to you? Can’t you see I’m talking to my brother, and you want to butt in?"
The middle-aged man laughed heartily: "Brother? How come I’ve never heard you had a brother? Could he be your sugar boy, and you rejected me because of him?"
Feng Ruolan angrily said, "Don’t talk nonsense!"
The middle-aged man smiled, looking at Lin Fan: "Kid, what’s your relationship with President Feng? Oh right, let me introduce myself, I’m Zhang Jing, chairman of Huaxin Company, a suitor of President Feng. Sadly, despite chasing her for a year, she cruelly rejected me. If you’re my rival, I advise you to wisely back off."

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Why Look Down on Young People
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 241: Why Look Down on Young People
The middle-aged man stepped forward, immediately identifying himself as Feng Ruolan’s suitor!
Huaxin International?
This is a top domestic chip manufacturing company!
As the chairman of Huaxin Company, Zhang Jing is also considered an impressive figure, truly a dragon among men.
In Huaxia, there are three major semiconductor companies, with Taiwan Province’s TSMC being the first. This TSMC is even the world’s number one, while Huaxin International, despite the huge gap with TSMC, ranks second in Huaxia and is still considered a top-tier chip company.
Zhang Jing’s control over Huaxin Company is proof of his excellence.
Yet, despite being such an outstanding person, Feng Ruolan didn’t even consider Zhang Jing, rejecting him outright even though he has been pursuing her relentlessly for a year. Feng Ruolan has never been moved.
This left the normally confident Zhang Jing puzzled. Why would Feng Ruolan reject him when he was such a good match for her?
Seeing Feng Ruolan defending Lin Fan so adamantly tonight, he seemed to have found the answer that had been troubling him.
Lin Fan must be kept by Feng Ruolan as a pretty boy.
Objectively speaking, Lin Fan is very young and handsome. Just from their appearances, Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan are a perfect match, one is dashingly handsome, and the other is stunningly beautiful.
However, in Zhang Jing’s eyes, a man’s good looks are useless. Only money is a man’s greatest capital; without money, no matter how handsome the man is, he’s nothing. As long as there’s money, being old and ugly isn’t a problem; there will still be plenty of women throwing themselves at you.
Therefore, Zhang Jing didn’t really pay attention to Lin Fan at all.
Lin Fan didn’t like Zhang Jing; this inexplicable confidence of this greasy middle-aged man was truly unpleasant.
"President Zhang, is it? I hope you show some respect; she is indeed my sister. I don’t know why my sister rejected you, but it’s definitely not because of me. Maybe it’s because you’re a stupid idiot, after all, in my sister’s eyes, you’re just a toad." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Feng Ruolan, initially angered by Zhang Jing, couldn’t help but smile at his words: "Brother, you’re right, he certainly is an annoying toad."
Lin Fan said: "A toad implies someone who lacks self-awareness. My sister is young, beautiful, and wealthy; she doesn’t need to rely on a man. She can choose whatever man she wants, why would she neglect someone young and handsome and choose you, a greasy old man?"
Being rebuffed by Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan consecutively, Zhang Jing couldn’t help but become angry out of humiliation: "You, a gigolo, what right do you have to ridicule me, a greasy old man? In this society, we, the successful greasy old men, are the backbone, and you young people are just working for us, we are the ones spending money to support you!"
Lin Fan said: "There’s no need to make yourself sound so noble; essentially, you’re just businessmen, a bunch of capitalists driven by profit. I can assure you that you greasy old men would sacrifice anything for money, including the young people you claim to support."
Zhang Jing sneered: "What do you mean by that?"
Lin Fan said: "I just want to ask you, is it not your kind who promote the 996 work culture, claiming that 996 is a blessing, but in reality, it’s just exploiting young people to work themselves to death."
Zhang Jing said: "So what? Is it wrong to ask young people to be a bit more diligent? Haven’t we all emerged victorious through hard work?"
Lin Fan said: "Of course, you can work yourself to death, it’s your business even if you die at your desk, but you can’t demand that of others, promoting young people to work themselves to death, isn’t that shameless?"
Zhang Jing: "..."
He was at a loss for words.
Lin Fan continued: "Besides, why do you dismiss young people? If the youth are strong, the country is strong. There are many outstanding young people; even if they’re temporarily down and out, as long as they’re young, they’re full of hope, and the future holds endless possibilities. The East is not the same as the West for thirty years, don’t underestimate young people who are temporarily poor!"
Zhang Jing was rendered speechless by these words.
Feng Ruolan chuckled: "Zhang Jing, you might look down on many young people, but you shouldn’t underestimate my brother. He’s only 21 years old, already the largest shareholder of Celestial Aviation and owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, do you still look down upon him?"
Zhang Jing’s expression changed: "What?"
He had arrived late, missing the earlier events and was unaware of Lin Fan’s identity. Seeing Lin Fan’s youthful and handsome appearance, he had prejudicially dismissed him as a mere pretty boy.
"You’re Lin Fan?" Zhang Jing blurted out.
Lin Fan’s name had been the talk of the business world these past few days, with many discussing this rising young star, Lin Fan.
At 21, commanding the business world!
Truly intimidating for the older generation, a fact that left many already "greasy old men" entrepreneurs lagging behind.
Zhang Jing also remembered this name, Lin Fan.
Now being told that this young "pretty boy" he looked down on was the legendary Lin Fan?
No wonder he was a bit excited.
Given Lin Fan’s impressive status, Lin Fan’s earlier rebuttal to Zhang Jing seemed even more impactful.
Don’t underestimate young people who are temporarily poor!
If the youth are strong, the country is strong!
As the great man said: "The world is yours as well as ours, but in the end, it is yours. You young people are full of vigor, like the sun at eight or nine in the morning."
The showdown between Lin Fan and Zhang Jing, between the greasy old men and the youth, ultimately saw the morning sun triumph.
Zhang Jing, though discontented, had to face the reality of Lin Fan’s excellence, with the 90 billion Celestial Aviation right in front of him, he was left speechless.
"You’re Lin Fan?"
Suddenly, a cold voice came from the side.
A middle-aged man approached.
Lin Fan turned to look and recognized him.
A billionaire, the patriarch of the Jia Family, Jia Zuozhen!
As soon as Jia Zuozhen arrived, he attracted considerable attention, with many people immediately approaching to greet and compliment him.
Jia Zuozhen held considerable renown in Yun City, fortified by not only wealth but significant background, belonging to the realm of both wealth and influence.
As for how strong Jia Zuozhen’s background was, few could say for certain, and due to that nebulous mystery, nobody dared to provoke him lightly.
Jia Zuozhen, initially exchanging pleasantries with others, inadvertently spotted Lin Fan, catching him off guard.
He had not expected to encounter Lin Fan at Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet!
To know, attending Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet wasn’t something anyone could do. Lin Fan’s participation indicated one thing—he had some significance.
Nevertheless, Jia Zuozhen didn’t give it much thought, seeing Lin Fan only reminded him of how his daughter had been "bullied" by Lin Fan, reigniting his anger.
This truly was a case of enemies meeting face to face with intense animosity.
Jia Zuozhen immediately approached with a cold, clipped tone.
He had seen Lin Fan at the school gate that day, and Lin Fan had embarrassed him, leaving a lasting impression, so he recognized Lin Fan instantly.
Due to Jia Xueling, Lin Fan also had an impression of Jia Zuozhen, thus recognizing him at a glance.
Coincidentally, Zhang Jing and Jia Zuozhen were friends, leading to clearly defined camps.
Zhang Jing was curious: "Brother Jia, you know this guy?"
Jia Zuozhen, staring at Lin Fan, replied sarcastically: "Indeed, isn’t it? Mr. Lin is already illustrious at such a young age, how could I not know him?"
Lin Fan smiled: "It’s more than recognition between Mr. Jia and me. Mr. Jia has been quite attentive to me lately, Mr. Jia, thank you for your efforts!"
Though they seemed to be conversing with smiles, the tension between them was palpable to even the dullest onlookers.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Tit for Tat, An Unexpected Surprise Prepared for Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 242: Tit for Tat, An Unexpected Surprise Prepared for Lin Fan
Jia Zuozhen, in order to avenge his daughter, carried out a series of retaliatory actions against Lin Fan over the past couple of days, including getting Liu Jinshan to harass the distributors, and even forcing a construction site to stop work today.
He originally intended to remain hidden, not letting Lin Fan know his identity for the moment, making Lin Fan suffer in silence, feeling frustrated and uncomfortable, and only then would Lin Fan realize who was behind it and dare not provoke him.
Jia Zuozhen felt quite pleased with his plan.
Unexpectedly, Liu Jinshan was taken care of by Lin Fan after just one day.
Today, Liu Jinshan called to apologize, stating that he couldn’t help deal with Lin Fan anymore because Lin Fan is Feng Ruolan’s brother, and Feng Ruolan is Liu Jinshan’s creditor.
Under pressure, Liu Jinshan also sold out Jia Zuozhen.
Lin Fan already knows that the mastermind is Jia Zuozhen.
Lin Fan should be able to guess that the construction site halt was also Jia Zuozhen’s doing.
Jia Zuozhen’s plan to remain hidden failed, but he didn’t care. Since Lin Fan already knows, he might as well know. Anyway, he would find out sooner or later. Jia Zuozhen believed Lin Fan couldn’t do anything against him and would have no choice but to endure it.
Jia Zuozhen thought that Lin Fan knowing he’s the opponent but being helpless against him was even more satisfying.
"Mr. Lin, you seem to think I’m not taking care of you enough. I’ve heard about the events of this evening. It seems I need to continue ’taking care’ of you."
Jia Zuozhen chuckled, with a hint of coldness in his smile.
Earlier this evening, Lin Fan forced Jia Xueling to slap her own face in public, which enraged Jia Zuozhen, who decided to destroy Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "Mr. Jia, you’re really going out of your way. I suggest you not overexert yourself, or you might end up overworking yourself to death."
Neither of them said it outright, but their words were pointed, the tension palpable, as if swords about to clash.
This left Zhang Jing, who was listening nearby, completely puzzled.
"Brother Jia, what’s going on here?" Zhang Jing asked, pulling Jia Zuozhen aside and speaking in a low voice.
Jia Zuozhen sneered, "To put it plainly, this kid has some beef with me. I gave him a warning, yet instead of taking the hint, he escalated things."
Zhang Jing responded, "Oh, Brother Jia, I also can’t stand that kid. What exactly did he do to offend you?"
Jia Zuozhen said, "He bullied Xueling."
Zhang Jing was shocked, "What, this guy’s got some nerve, daring to bully Xueling. No wonder Brother Jia is so upset."
Zhang Jing thought Lin Fan was too arrogant. To provoke Jia Xueling, knowing Jia Zuozhen dotes on his daughter immensely—almost as if she was a precious gem—and who would dare mess with her?
As Zhang Jing knew, Lin Fan was the first person who dared to bully Jia Xueling. This guy was really gutsy.
"He bullied Xueling more than once. I caught him the first time and warned him, but tonight, he did it again!" Jia Zuozhen said, gritting his teeth.
Jia Zuozhen was frank about this with Zhang Jing, as they were close friends.
Zhang Jing was sweating profusely. Bullying Jia Xueling repeatedly—Lin Fan was way too wild; it’s as if he doesn’t know what death is!
Moreover, it was evident Lin Fan knew Jia Xueling was Jia Zuozhen’s daughter yet continued pestering her, which was even more unbelievable.
What gave Lin Fan the nerve to offend even Jia Zuozhen?
Lin Fan was indeed a remarkable young man, owning a company valued at 90 billion by the age of 21, truly a leader among his peers.
But Lin Fan was at most a young millionaire, whereas Jia Zuozhen was powerful and influential—a genuine local despot, and as the saying goes, ’a powerful dragon does not press a local snake.’ Lin Fan didn’t seem to have any advantage against Jia Zuozhen.
So, why wasn’t Lin Fan afraid of offending Jia Zuozhen?
There was only one explanation: Lin Fan’s ignorance made him fearless!
"This guy probably has no idea about Brother Jia’s capabilities. Brother Jia, how do you plan to deal with him this time?" Zhang Jing asked eagerly.
He was just rendered speechless by Lin Fan, feeling quite dissatisfied, and was looking forward to seeing Jia Zuozhen strike Lin Fan down.
Jia Zuozhen sneered, "I’ve already made the necessary arrangements. Tomorrow morning, I’ll give him a surprise. His group’s Blue Moon Company will be shut down, which will surely impact his company’s market value. This time, I want him to feel it to the bone!"
Zhang Jing couldn’t help but laugh, "Brilliant, Brother Jia is truly impressive. I’m looking forward to watching the show tomorrow!"
While they were talking, on the other side, Feng Ruolan was also pulling Lin Fan aside, inquiring about what happened.
Lin Fan recounted the events of the evening to Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan furrowed her brows. What Lin Fan did was not wrong, but it would likely provoke Jia Zuozhen to further retaliate against him, and more severe repercussions might follow.
Feng Ruolan was determined to try her best to help Lin Fan, though she wasn’t confident, but for Lin Fan’s sake, she had to try.
"Little Fan, leave this to me. I’ll try my best to mediate tonight," Feng Ruolan said.
Lin Fan knew it was unlikely Feng Ruolan could assist him with Jia Zuozhen, but he still expressed his thanks.
This Jia Zuozhen was indeed a tough nut to crack, but Lin Fan wasn’t afraid.
There’s always a way.
People around them, sensing the tension between Lin Fan and Jia Zuozhen, were somewhat curious.
Everyone thought Lin Fan was a pretty remarkable young man, but it wasn’t wise to go up against Jia Zuozhen.
"Of all people, why provoke Jia Zuozhen?"
"This kid really doesn’t know his limits!"
"Is Jia Zuozhen someone he can afford to provoke?"
Some people shook their heads and sighed.
At this time, Jia Zuozhen approached Lin Fan again, chuckling, "Where were we? Oh right, Mr. Lin, do you think I’m paying you too much attention? Why would that be? If you really thought so, why did the events of this evening happen?"
Lin Fan said, "Do you really understand what happened this evening, Mr. Jia? Of course, you don’t need to understand, really; it’s just a matter of bias."
Being Jia Xueling’s father, Jia Zuozhen would naturally side with her—even if he knew she was in the wrong, he would still favor her. Moreover, Jia Xueling might have deceived him, too.
Jia Zuozhen said, "All I know is that Mr. Lin needs my attention too much. Just a heads up—I have a surprise for you tomorrow morning, be sure to check it out."
Lin Fan thought to himself, what is Jia Zuozhen planning now?
It certainly wouldn’t be a pleasant surprise, just a shock.
Just then, Liu Tianhao announced that the birthday banquet was about to begin.
"At tonight’s banquet, a few guests will sit as VIPs at the table with the birthday celebrant. We will soon reveal the names of these guests," Liu Tianhao said.
This statement caused a commotion, drawing everyone’s attention.
Highest privilege for guests!
Dining with Elder Liu!
Who will be the lucky ones?
"I think Mr. Jia should be one of them!"
Some people trying to flatter Jia Zuozhen chimed in.
Hearing this, Jia Zuozhen showed a look of supreme confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: The Final Highest-Level Guest
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 243: The Final Highest-Level Guest
The guests with the highest honor at the birthday banquet received everyone’s attention. For a moment, everyone’s focus was on this matter.
Before the announcement, everyone began to speculate.
Which individuals would become the highest-specification guests and dine at the same table with Elder Liu?
"Mr. Jia Zuozhen from the Jia Family must be one of them!"
Someone said.
This comment drew nods from those around, everyone agreeing that Jia Zuozhen was qualified. Jia Zuozhen could be described as a local tyrant, wealthy and influential. Such a person becoming a guest of the highest specification was quite normal.
Jia Zuozhen, seeing that someone speculated it was him, was very pleased. He was confident himself, believing that he was one of them!
"Now, let me announce the first highest-specification guest!" Liu Tianhao said.
Liu Tianhao is Liu Tingshan’s third son. As someone who had been by Liu Tingshan’s side for many years, he was responsible for this birthday banquet.
And the list of the highest-specification guests was determined by Elder Liu.
Liu Tianhao said, "The first highest-specification guest is Elder Yu, Yu Xuecheng. Elder Yu is my father’s war buddy who traveled afar this year to celebrate my father’s grand birthday. He is accompanying my father now. For juniors like myself, I express my gratitude to Elder Yu!"
Applause erupted at the scene.
This Elder Yu, being Liu Tingshan’s war buddy, naturally had the qualifications to be a guest of the highest specification. No one would object.
Lin Fan was quite curious, muttering, "War buddy? Sounds like Mr. Liu was in the military?"
Lin Fan had sensed early on that Liu Tingshan must not be simple, but he never inquired further because he had never intended to seek any favor from Liu Tingshan, so naturally, there was no need.
No matter how extraordinary Liu Tingshan was, Lin Fan was merely a passerby who had helped Liu Tingshan by chance.
If it wasn’t for Liu Tingshan’s enthusiastic invitation, he wouldn’t have appeared at this birthday banquet tonight.
Feng Ruolan, hearing this, was surprised, "Little Fan, you can’t be finding out just now, right?"
Lin Fan said, "I really just found out now."
Feng Ruolan was curious; Lin Fan seemed unfamiliar with Elder Liu. How did he become a guest at Elder Liu’s table?
Who at the scene wouldn’t know Liu Tingshan’s identity? He’s not just a simple military figure; he’s the head of a certain military district in Huaxia...
Yet, Lin Fan was completely unaware of this.
This was the reason for Feng Ruolan’s surprise.
But Lin Fan indeed did not know.
If it weren’t for acquiring the system, the business world or political realm would have been very distant to Lin Fan. He wouldn’t even have the necessity to understand them because he would hardly have any chance to be involved in his lifetime.
The series of rewards from the system allowed Lin Fan to rise rapidly, becoming a young super-rich individual, causing a sensation in the business world and even attracting attention in the political realm.
For example, the land of the Shendiao Old Factory Lin Fan acquired was originally government planning land, but through the system’s operation, it became part of Lin Fan’s property, directly alerting the National Land Bureau and the City Government.
Development through industry!
Lin Fan’s Blue Moon Hand Soap is a solid enterprise. Its rise caught the mayor’s attention, naturally making sense.
Lin Fan wanted to explain the situation to Feng Ruolan; it was because he inadvertently saved Liu Tingshan that Liu Tingshan invited him to this birthday banquet, while he knew almost nothing about Liu Tingshan and had never inquired.
However, this moment was not suitable for whispering.
Liu Tianhao quickly announced the second highest-specification guest, which was Director Ma from the National Land Bureau!
The subsequent announcements of several highest-specification guests were essentially figures at the top of the military and political spheres, including representatives from the city government and the military district...
Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet was truly a gathering of prominent figures, with a scale unmatched throughout Yun City.
Besides the military and political realms, it was the turn of the business sector.
Similarly, the business figures present tonight were mostly top-tier personalities, all well-known figures in Yun City. Their invitations were, to some extent, based on certain connections with the Liu Family.
Liu Tianhao, while announcing the highest-specification guests, did so in the order of military, political, then business sectors.
After announcing the guests from the military and political realms, it was the turn of the business realm.
"The next highest-specification guest, Chairman Zhang Jing of Huaxin Company!" Liu Tianhao announced.
Instantly, envious glances followed.
Zhang Jing was both surprised and delighted, "Is it me?"
He was somewhat incredulous that he was included as a highest-specification guest because his ties with the Liu Family weren’t very deep. Being invited to attend Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet as a guest had already thrilled Zhang Jing.
Now, being listed among the highest-specification guests and dining with Liu Tingshan surprised Zhang Jing.
Jia Zuozhen also found it unexpected; why was Zhang Jing allowed to be a highest-specification guest? This privilege was indeed astonishing.
Jia Zuozhen was curious on one hand, but on the other hand felt increasingly confident.
If even Zhang Jing could be a highest-specification guest, then Jia Zuozhen surely must be included, especially since Zhang Jing had to address him as Brother Jia. If Zhang Jing qualified, he certainly did too, or it would be disgraceful.
"The next highest-specification guest, Feng Family’s eldest daughter, Feng Ruolan!" Liu Tianhao announced.
Feng Ruolan became a highest-specification guest, which everyone found reasonable.
Feng Ruolan was part of the notable Feng Family, a super family’s eldest daughter. The Feng Family’s various industries were extensive, and its patriarch, Elder Feng, was a highly revered figure in Jiangnan City, a super bigwig well-connected on all sides. Feng Ruolan deeply rooted herself in Yun City, becoming the city’s richest woman, a renowned financial mogul.
Feng Ruolan being valued by the Liu Family was truly deserved.
The crowd could only offer applause without objections.
Only Jia Zuozhen was somewhat displeased, primarily due to Feng Ruolan’s association with Lin Fan.
Feng Ruolan helped Lin Fan deal with Liu Jinshan, making Jia Zuozhen unhappy.
Jia Zuozhen learned today that it was Feng Ruolan who helped Lin Fan, so he didn’t blame Liu Jinshan since he knew Liu Jinshan couldn’t handle Feng Ruolan, which was understandable.
Even he couldn’t deal with Feng Ruolan.
However, although he couldn’t handle Feng Ruolan, neither could Feng Ruolan handle him. They were two individuals who couldn’t subdue each other.
Therefore, Jia Zuozhen didn’t take Feng Ruolan seriously and intended to sort out Lin Fan as he planned.
Liu Tianhao then announced, "The next, and last highest-specification guest tonight."
So soon, it was the last one.
Who would be the final guest announced?
For a moment, everyone’s attention was focused on this matter.
"It must be Jia Zuozhen!"
Someone murmured.
This comment gained wide agreement.
Since Zhang Jing and Feng Ruolan were both highest-specification guests, there was no reason for Jia Zuozhen not to be. Jia Zuozhen was roughly on par with them.
Moreover, the Jia Family in Yun City was composed of billionaires, with political connections, undeniable wealth and influence, stronger political ties than both Zhang Jing and Feng Ruolan.
Jia Zuozhen was already pleasantly surprised; being the last highest-specification guest meant he’d make the grand entrance. This was an honor!
Heaven, this honor was bestowed upon Jia Zuozhen, how thrilling.
Jia Zuozhen couldn’t help but already have a face full of smiles, with his words of gratitude ready, so confident that he seemed to be reaching new heights.
Right at the moment when everyone thought it was Jia Zuozhen.
Liu Tianhao slowly spoke, "The last highest-specification guest, Lin Fan."
What?
Everyone present was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: United States Sanctions Incident
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 244: United States Sanctions Incident
When Liu Tianhao announced that the last guest of the highest caliber was Lin Fan, the whole room was stunned.
Nobody present would have thought of it.
"It’s actually him!"
"How could it be him!"
"No way, could there have been a mistake? Does he even have this qualification?"
"Although he is indeed young and promising, there’s no need for him to be the guest of the highest caliber, is there?"
"It shouldn’t be him, it was supposed to be Jia Zuozhen!"
The crowd buzzed with discussion, clearly very surprised by this result.
Jia Zuozhen’s face turned from white to red, and then from red back to white, quite a spectacle.
He was full of confidence before, thinking that the last guest of the highest caliber must be him. He even had his thank-you speech prepared, just waiting to step forward and bask in everyone’s envious eyes.
The worst thing was that people around him also thought so, and they all saw his smug look.
The official announcement turned out to not be him!
This was practically a public humiliation, so embarrassing, he was utterly shamed, feeling like he had become a joke.
Jia Zuozhen was so mortified he wanted to find a hole to crawl into.
At the same time, he was in a rage inside!
It wasn’t him, fine, but the highest caliber guest turned out to be Lin Fan!
Lin Fan again!
Something similar happened last time, at the school gate, when the principal came out to greet somebody, Jia Zuozhen thought the principal was there to welcome him, but it was actually Lin Fan.
Back then, Jia Zuozhen also lost face.
But this time, it was even more embarrassing, because this time it was in front of all the bigwigs from various industries, people from Jia Zuozhen’s circle.
How was he going to mix in this circle after such humiliation!
Lin Fan!
It’s all Lin Fan’s fault!
If it weren’t for Lin Fan, this last spot would certainly be his, Jia Zuozhen’s, but Lin Fan took it, shaming him completely!
Jia Zuozhen was filled with hate, clenching his fists and grinding his teeth.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised when he found out that he was listed as the highest caliber guest, having dinner at the same table as Elder Liu, but it was just a bit of surprise. Lin Fan didn’t think much of it, what was it but having dinner at the same table? He had already been invited by Elder Liu for a private dinner before.
What Lin Fan didn’t know was that, while he thought that the position meant nothing, outsiders were green with envy, especially Jia Zuozhen, who was almost driven mad with envy.
Who was Liu Tingshan? The former commander of the Southeast Military Region. Just getting invited to attend his birthday banquet was enough for bragging, and being able to dine at the same table could be bragged about for a lifetime by many people.
"I’ve had dinner with Elder Liu, the commander of the Southeast Military Region!"
Anyone boasting like this would surely attract countless envious glances.
If people knew Lin Fan didn’t think much of this, they might just faint from excitement.
At this moment, Liu Tianhao said, "The above guests will dine with my father tonight, while the other guests will be seated according to arrangement. Please proceed to the banquet hall, the evening feast is about to start."
So, everyone went to the banquet and sat down.
The guests of the highest caliber, personally greeted by Liu Tianhao, came to take their seats at the main table.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan also sat at the main table.
Instantly, they were met with countless envious gazes from around, as well as doubtful and confused ones, and even jealous looks.
Seated nearby, Jia Zuozhen kept staring at Lin Fan, green with envy, wishing he could take Lin Fan’s place.
The birthday banquet finally began.
Liu Tingshan, assisted by Liu Bing’er, came to the banquet, and there was thunderous applause as everyone stood up.
Liu Tingshan smiled and said, "Thank you all for coming, please be seated."
Then Liu Tingshan sat down at the main seat at the main table.
Liu Bing’er quickly ran over to sit next to Lin Fan, having just gone back to support her grandfather. She only wanted to sit with Lin Fan.
Feng Ruolan had been curious why Lin Fan was invited to the birthday banquet. After Lin Fan was announced as the highest caliber guest, Feng Ruolan was astonished and even more curious.
At this moment, Feng Ruolan seemed to have found the answer.
To any observer, it was clear that the daughter of the Liu Family, Liu Bing’er, was very good to Lin Fan. Could it be that Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er were... dating?
If Lin Fan were indeed the grandson-in-law of the Liu Family, sitting at the main table would make sense.
Realizing that Liu Bing’er was Lin Fan’s girlfriend, Feng Ruolan felt an inexplicable melancholy, but she was not an ordinary woman and quickly came to terms, even feeling happy for Lin Fan.
She knew that during college, Lin Fan had dated the third Miss of the Su Family, Su Jinjin, but that relationship was forcibly broken up by Madam Su, and Lin Fan had been single since.
He must have been hurt then, and if Liu Bing’er could heal his inner wounds, it would certainly be a good thing.
Lin Fan had no idea that Feng Ruolan would misunderstand him and Liu Bing’er as dating.
The reason he was listed as the highest caliber guest was entirely for other reasons, unrelated to Liu Bing’er.
At this point, Liu Tingshan said, "Today is my 70th birthday, and I am very grateful for your presence. All those who came to my birthday banquet are honored guests. However, I have specially set up this group of highest caliber guests for a reason. I would like to introduce each of them to you."
As soon as Liu Tingshan’s words came out, the entire room fell silent, captivated by his words.
Indeed, Liu Tingshan’s birthday attracted bigwigs from various sectors, and each of these patriarchs could easily cause ripples. But there were only a few seats among the highest caliber guests who could dine with Liu Tingshan.
Before the banquet, everyone speculated on these highest caliber guests. Some of them they could understand, but some they couldn’t.
For example, why was Lin Fan made a highest caliber guest?
At that moment, everyone waited to hear what Liu Tingshan would say next.
Liu Tingshan said, "Let’s start with Mr. Zhang Jing, who can be said to be one of the people I am most concerned about tonight."
Everyone was taken aback. From Huaxin Company, Zhang Jing?
At first, everyone didn’t understand why Zhang Jing became the highest caliber guest.
Liu Tingshan said, "As everyone knows, recently, Zhongwei Company has encountered some trouble."
This was common knowledge among the bigwigs present.
Zhongwei Company is a high-tech enterprise, with some of its technology leading globally.
Recently, they encountered difficulties with chip production.
Previously, high-end chips for Zhongwei Phones were all produced by the world’s leading semiconductor company, TSMC, and only TSMC had the capability to produce them.
However, recently TSMC decided to stop producing chips for Zhongwei Phones.
The news caused a stir online.
For a time, Zhongwei Phones faced a situation of having no chips available.
Zhongwei must resolve this predicament.
Liu Tingshan said, "With TSMC no longer an option, we had no choice but to turn our hope to another company, second only to TSMC, which is Huaxin Company."
As he spoke, Liu Tingshan looked at Huaxin Company’s President Zhang Jing at the same table.
All eyes turned to Zhang Jing.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Where did you get the face to whine here?
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 245: Where did you get the face to whine here?
Now everyone understood why Zhang Jing from Huaxin Company was able to become the highest-tier guest and dine at the same table with Elder Liu.
It seemed that Zhang Jing was indeed the focal point of tonight.
Huaxin Company, the second-largest semiconductor company in Huaxia, second only to TSMC.
After TSMC decided to stop producing chips for Zhongwei Company, the greatest hope fell on Huaxin Company.
TSMC possesses the world’s most advanced chip production technology and equipment and is a top semiconductor production company capable of mass-producing 5nm chips.
As for Huaxin Company, ranking in the second tier, can only mass-produce 14nm chips and cannot yet mass-produce 5nm chips.
But even so, as long as Huaxin Company is willing to support Zhongwei Company, it can provide a temporary lifeline for Zhongwei Phone, and with the advancement of technology, Huaxin Company will inevitably be able to mass-produce 5nm in time.
So the key is, will Huaxin Company support Zhongwei Company?
As for this question, the general opinion online is that Huaxin Company will definitely support Zhongwei.
There’s no other reason; after all, Huaxin Company is a Huaxia company. What reason is there not to support one’s own country?
However, Huaxin Company has never made a statement about this, leaving people a bit confused.
Tonight, Liu Tingshan specifically invited Zhang Jing to the birthday banquet, just to ask Zhang Jing his views on the matter.
"Mr. Zhang, what are your thoughts on this?" Liu Tingshan asked.
For a moment, everyone’s eyes were focused on Zhang Jing.
"Isn’t it obvious? Huaxin will definitely support Zhongwei Company."
"What reason could there be not to support?"
"Exactly, it would be strange not to support."
The crowd murmured.
The expectations of Liu Tingshan, combined with the crowd’s words, invisibly placed enormous public pressure on Zhang Jing.
Zhang Jing’s face turned red, but he couldn’t speak immediately.
People were surprised at this, they had expected Zhang Jing to passionately promise support for Zhongwei Company, which would certainly have excited everyone present and stirred national pride.
But Zhang Jing didn’t do so; his expression suggested he was troubled, as if he couldn’t get out of it.
Liu Tingshan chuckled and said, "Mr. Zhang, feel free to speak; I’m only interested in hearing your perspective."
Zhang Jing had to respond, "Firstly, thank you, Elder Liu, for valuing this so much, I’m truly ashamed. This matter...our company’s internal discussions are ongoing, and there’s no resolution yet, so I don’t know how to comment. Once we have a decision, we will announce it immediately."
This left everyone looking at each other.
Someone couldn’t help but angrily say, "This concerns national dignity, what is there to hesitate about? Could it be that you won’t support it?"
Zhang Jing’s face reddened, uncertain how to respond, as if he hadn’t heard the remark.
Liu Tingshan smiled, "Mr. Zhang, there’s no need to feel pressured. I’m not trying to press you, just expressing concern, everything is up to your company to decide."
Zhang Jing felt relieved, "Thank you, Elder Liu."
Feng Ruolan then said, "Mr. Zhang, even if your company hasn’t decided, you should have your own opinion as an individual, right? Could you share it with everyone?"
Upon hearing this, everyone agreed, thinking Feng Ruolan’s question was well asked.
Zhang Jing felt vexed; just when he had dodged the issue, Feng Ruolan’s question had put him in a difficult position again.
Feng Ruolan must have done it on purpose!
Because before the banquet, he had said Lin Fan was a pretty boy, and Feng Ruolan took the opportunity to trip him up!
Zhang Jing was furious.
"My personal opinion is unimportant; I represent the company’s interests, so before a company decision, I’m not in a position to express an opinion. I ask for everyone’s understanding," Zhang Jing maintained his calm.
Liu Tingshan smiled, "Since Mr. Zhang says so, let’s not make things difficult for him. This matter ends here, Mr. Zhang, I look forward to your company’s final decision."
"Thank you, Elder Liu." Zhang Jing breathed a sigh of relief, holding a grudge against Feng Ruolan in his heart.
Liu Tingshan turned to Feng Ruolan, "Next, let me talk about Miss Feng. Miss Feng is the richest woman in Yun City, known as the female financial wizard. I know that Longheng Group, under Miss Feng, has invested in many technology companies. I inadvertently saw an interview of Miss Feng, where she said her reason for investment was her belief in technological advancement benefiting the country. Miss Feng is young yet has such insight and breadth of mind, I am truly touched."
Feng Ruolan modestly replied, "Thank you for your praise, Elder Liu. I hope our country gets better and better. There’s not much I can do; I can only invest some money."
This statement made everyone chuckle.
Elder Liu also laughed, "Miss Feng is indeed a heroine among women, worthy of being the richest woman in Yun City."
Seeing Liu Tingshan constantly praise Feng Ruolan, Zhang Jing felt a bit displeased.
Zhang Jing couldn’t help but say, "The richest woman in Yun City? With all due respect, Miss Feng is essentially a Rich Second Generation. Without the Feng Family, would she have her current status? Rather than saying it’s investing money, I think it’s more like borrowing the flowers to offer to Buddha."
The crowd exchanged glances; Zhang Jing’s comments seemed a bit unreasonable, as if he were being needlessly argumentative.
Feng Ruolan didn’t get angry, smiling, "You’re right about one thing; without the Feng Family, I wouldn’t be here, but I am a part of the Feng Family, and spending the Feng Family’s money doesn’t seem illegal, does it? Moreover, the investment money I use now is from what I’ve later earned myself, so saying I borrowed flowers to offer to Buddha isn’t accurate."
Zhang Jing sneered, "You say that yourself, but who can prove it?"
Lin Fan, who had been quietly observing, couldn’t stand it anymore.
"Mr. Zhang, why do you have to be so sour about my sister? You haven’t even cleared up your own company’s issues yet. I suspect you’re most likely not supporting Zhongwei; otherwise, why are you being so evasive? My sister is honestly supporting the country, and what face do you have to be nitpicking here?" Lin Fan retorted.
Zhang Jing: "..."
Speechless.
He found that he couldn’t contend verbally against Lin Fan; previously, he had been unable to counter Lin Fan’s arguments as well.
Feng Ruolan gave Lin Fan a big thumbs up, feeling that Lin Fan’s words hit the mark perfectly.
"Little Fan is right, I have the same concern. Mr. Zhang, I wonder if you’ve already made a decision?" Feng Ruolan said.
Zhang Jing coldly snorted, "Whether there’s a decision or not, what difference does it make? Right now, only our company can save Zhongwei Phone. If we decide to save it, that’s our company’s mercy. If we choose not to save it, it won’t affect our company. Even if we exclude Zhongwei, with the technology we possess, there will still be new clients to fill the gap!"
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was stunned. Was Zhang Jing in a hurry, revealing his true thoughts?
These words were certainly hate-provoking.
As expected, capitalists are indeed capitalists, seeing only business, with no thought of patriotism or unpatriotism.
If the Zhongwei incident would affect Huaxin’s business, Huaxin would presumably kick Zhongwei aside without hesitation!
Zhang Jing stood up, "Elder Liu, I’m sorry, I suddenly feel a bit unwell and will take my leave!"
Zhang Jing left in a hurry.
As expected, Lin Fan’s guess was correct. The next day, Huaxin made a public announcement that shook the internet.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: This Network of Relationships Terrified the Other Party
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 246: This Network of Relationships Terrified the Other Party
With excitement, Zhang Jing inadvertently voiced his inner thoughts. Realizing that what he said was out of place, he quickly found an excuse to slip away.
Everyone shook their heads and sighed. From Zhang Jing’s words, it seemed that the situation might not be promising, and Huaxin Company might end up disappointing everyone.
The atmosphere on the scene suddenly became a bit gloomy.
Liu Tingshan smiled and said, "Everyone, there’s no need to worry too much. Mr. Zhang hasn’t made a final decision yet. Let’s give him some time. I believe he will make the right choice."
The crowd nodded, showing expressions of hope.
This matter was put aside for the moment. Next, Liu Tingshan continued to introduce the highest-ranking guests, including Secretary Jin, the representative from the city government who came on behalf of the mayor to wish Liu Tingshan a happy birthday.
Additionally, there was also Director Ma from the Land Bureau.
With these two individuals’ statuses as the highest-ranking guests, no one had any objections.
Feng Ruolan proactively raised her glass and smiled, "Director Ma, Secretary Jin, Miss Feng offers a toast to both of you."
Director Ma and Secretary Jin raised their glasses in response.
"I’ve heard of Miss Feng’s reputation for a long time. Meeting you today, you are indeed a stunning beauty, haha..." Director Ma laughed heartily.
Secretary Jin maintained a calm demeanor and said, "Please, Miss Feng."
Feng Ruolan’s proactive toast had a purpose behind it.
"Let me introduce, this is my brother, Lin Fan, currently the chairman of Celestial Aviation." Feng Ruolan said.
Director Ma and Secretary Jin sized up Lin Fan with some surprise.
"Lin Fan? Could he be the young magnate who recently rose to fame in Yun City?" Secretary Jin asked.
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s too generous. I’m merely making some small investments."
Director Ma laughed, "Mr. Lin, you are too modest. I know you, Mr. Lin. Aren’t you also the boss of Blue Moon? I still remember the land of Shendiao Old Factory!"
The land of Shendiao Old Factory was originally planned for governmental use, yet Lin Fan acquired it. As the director of the Land Bureau, Director Ma signed the leasing contract, bewildered himself.
Back then, it was the mayor who personally called and stated that this piece of land could be approved for Lin Fan, which eased Director Ma’s mind.
"Oh?" Secretary Jin exclaimed, "I know about this too. The mayor supports the industry. I heard Blue Moon received a four-billion-yuan order in one day and had the demand to build a factory. The mayor specially convened a meeting with us and decided to allocate the land of Shendiao Old Factory to Blue Moon."
Upon hearing this, everyone present was surprised.
The mayor personally approved the transfer of government-planned land to Lin Fan?
This is a privilege no one else has!
Few people knew about this until today, when Director Ma and Secretary Jin brought it up.
Jia Zuozhen didn’t know either. Knowing Lin Fan acquired the Shendiao Old Factory land, he suddenly felt an ominous sensation.
Director Ma praised, "Mr. Lin is really an impressive young man, achieving such remarkable accomplishments at a young age."
Secretary Jin said, "It seems Blue Moon has the prospect of becoming a renowned local brand. By the way, Mr. Lin, I wonder how your new factory is progressing? If you encounter any difficulties, feel free to let us know."
Feng Ruolan was delighted; this was exactly what she wanted. Now, it depended on Lin Fan’s response.
Lin Fan naturally understood Feng Ruolan’s intentions and said, "Initially, everything was progressing smoothly, with the factory under intense construction, but we encountered a small issue. Today, we were inexplicably ordered to halt construction for rectification."
Director Ma and Secretary Jin glanced at each other, both frowning.
"There’s such a thing? What’s the reason?" Secretary Jin asked.
Lin Fan said, "The inspectors believe we have safety issues, but I am quite certain that we have been complying with regulations. I have been pondering over it, unable to figure out the reason, so I temporarily halted construction as required."
Lin Fan’s response was smart. Should he point out any wrongdoing, Secretary Jin would certainly inquire about evidence.
By not making a direct accusation, Lin Fan cleverly led the pace, letting Secretary Jin make his own assumptions—Lin Fan’s certainty implied issues with the inspectors?
"Rest assured, Mr. Lin. I will look into the matter tomorrow to see if there is any misunderstanding. Hopefully, it is a misunderstanding, allowing you to resume construction soon." Secretary Jin promised.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you for your efforts, Secretary Jin."
At this moment, Jia Zuozhen was shocked, sweat breaking out on his forehead.
My goodness, he merely intended to teach Lin Fan a lesson. How could he have known that Lin Fan’s Blue Moon was connected to the city government!
With Secretary Jin personally intervening, this was not good at all!
With Secretary Jin’s words, Lin Fan knew that the issue of the factory’s halting had been resolved because Jia Zuozhen, seated next door, naturally heard all of this.
No matter how powerful Jia Zuozhen was, would he dare to challenge the city government!
Liu Tingshan then said, "I believe there must be some misunderstanding. I have great confidence in Mr. Lin’s integrity."
Lin Fan said, "Thank you, Mr. Liu."
Everyone was a bit surprised. Liu Tingshan spoke for Lin Fan!
To speak of it, why was Lin Fan considered a top-tier guest?
Liu Tingshan smiled, "Perhaps not everyone here knows, Mr. Lin is actually my lifesaver. Without Mr. Lin, I wouldn’t be sitting here today celebrating my birthday."
What?
Everyone was shocked. Lin Fan saved Liu Tingshan’s life?
No wonder, as Liu Tingshan’s lifesaver, being a top-tier guest seemed reasonable and understandable!
Jia Zuozhen turned pale; oh no, was Lin Fan actually Liu Tingshan’s lifesaver?
Liu Tingshan regarded Lin Fan as a top-tier guest, showing great appreciation for him.
He never imagined that besides connections with the city government and the Land Bureau, Lin Fan was also Liu Tingshan’s lifesaver. What a formidable background.
Liu Tingshan said, "The old man is of advanced age and suffers from a deficiency of vitality. I need medication to maintain my health. That day, I went out without taking my medication, collapsed from the illness, and the passersby simply watched, perhaps fearing a scam. Fortunately, Mr. Lin was passing by and without hesitation took me back. I took my medication and narrowly escaped death."
Liu Bing’er laughed, "In these times, there have been too many instances of elderly people extorting money, yet Brother Lin helped without hesitation—it’s truly commendable."
Her words were full of admiration.
Feng Ruolan was slightly surprised. She initially thought Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er were in a romantic relationship, which was why Lin Fan became a top-tier guest. It seemed she had misunderstood.
Lin Fan became a top-tier guest because he saved Liu Tingshan.
Lin Fan and Liu Bing’er were not in a romantic relationship.
However, she probably wasn’t wrong about one thing—Liu Bing’er indeed had a good impression of Lin Fan!
Oh, her brother being so outstanding, there surely are many admirers. Liu Bing’er must have numerous rivals.
At this point, everyone understood why Lin Fan could be a top-tier guest. No one dared question it anymore. After all, Lin Fan was Liu Tingshan’s lifesaver. If he didn’t qualify, who would?
Jia Zuozhen’s expression was unpleasant, as if sitting on pins and needles. He even lost his appetite. He finally realized that Lin Fan was someone he couldn’t afford to provoke.
Shortly after, Jia Zuozhen excused himself to the restroom and slipped away.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Shocking the Divine Doctor, This Gift is Too Awesome
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 247: Shocking the Divine Doctor, This Gift is Too Awesome
Jia Zuozhen hurriedly ran to a corner of the restroom, seeing that there was no one around, he quickly took out his phone and made two calls.
One call was about the factory’s suspension for rectification. Jia Zuozhen instructed the person on the other end not to expose him. If Secretary Jin inquires about it tomorrow, just say it was a misunderstanding and immediately lift the penalty on Blue Moon.
The other call was about his plan to shut down Blue Moon tomorrow. He originally intended to use the same old trick, find an excuse to shut down Blue Moon. Once this is implemented, the stock price of Mortal Group will inevitably fall, which would be a heavy blow to Lin Fan.
Originally, Jia Zuozhen was quite pleased with this plan. Lin Fan dared to bully his daughter Jia Xueling, he wanted to teach Lin Fan a heavy lesson.
However, at this moment, when Jia Zuozhen thought about the plan, he broke into a cold sweat.
Blue Moon is actually a company that has the attention of the city government!
If Blue Moon is mysteriously shut down, the city government would probably personally inquire about it. By then, things could get out of hand, and Jia Zuozhen would definitely be held accountable.
Besides, Lin Fan is the savior of Liu Tingshan. If Lin Fan seeks Liu Tingshan’s help to deal with Jia Zuozhen...
Jia Zuozhen, breaking out in a cold sweat, quickly made a call to cancel the plan, fortunately just in time.
After the call, Jia Zuozhen let out a big sigh of relief.
He was truly unnerved by Lin Fan’s powerful connections. Had he known Lin Fan was so formidable, he would never have dared to provoke him.
Now he finally understood why Lin Fan wasn’t afraid of him despite his repeated provocations. With such strong connections, why would he fear someone like Jia Zuozhen?
This point, however, Jia Zuozhen was overthinking.
Lin Fan truly wasn’t afraid of him, but not for the reasons Jia Zuozhen assumed. Lin Fan himself hadn’t realized he had such a network.
In fact, he had previously been helpless against Jia Zuozhen.
By coincidence, both Lin Fan and Jia Zuozhen attended the birthday banquet of Liu Tingshan. Lin Fan’s network, which he wasn’t even aware of, scared Jia Zuozhen out of his wits, inadvertently resolving the issue and forcing Jia Zuozhen to cancel his plan against Lin Fan.
To say he was unwilling was true; Jia Zuozhen was indeed unwilling. He wanted to avenge his daughter, yet now he could only swallow this anger and even felt relieved to have canceled the plan.
Lin Fan, he simply couldn’t afford to provoke him.
At this time, the birthday banquet continued, everyone began dining, and the atmosphere was lively and pleasant.
As it neared the end, Liu Tingshan felt a bit tired and decided to take his leave.
"I once again thank everyone for coming; unfortunately, my health is not good, and I cannot continue to accompany you. By the way, Tianhao, please arrange to return all the gifts brought this evening to the guests. I’m very happy just to have everyone here at the birthday banquet; I really can’t accept any gifts," said Liu Tingshan.
Upon hearing this, everyone was moved by Liu Tingshan’s noble character, and for a moment, they all held him in even greater respect.
Liu Tianhao quickly said, "I will arrange it immediately."
Soon, the members of the Liu Family brought out all the gifts received and returned them to each guest one by one.
"This jade bracelet, does anyone know who sent it?"
Liu Tianhao suddenly picked up a crudely made jade bracelet.
If it weren’t in the pile of gifts, Liu Tianhao would certainly have thrown it away as trash.
No one knew who actually dared to give such a cheap thing; giving something like this left people speechless.
Lin Fan raised his hand, "I gave it!"
Liu Tianhao sweated, seriously? Lin Fan, the chairman of a 90-billion company, and he actually gave this trash as a gift?
Lin Fan said, "Old sir, I found this at the Antique Street for 100 bucks, it’s so cheap, just accept it!"
Liu Tingshan shook his head, smiling, "A light gift with deep affection, Mr. Lin’s kind intentions have been received, but everything must be treated equally; whether one million or one hundred, I cannot accept."
Liu Bing’er couldn’t help but interject, "Grandpa, although Brother Lin’s gift only cost 100 bucks, it’s worth over a billion!"
Liu Tingshan was stunned, "Bing’er, don’t talk nonsense."
Liu Bing’er said, "I’m not talking nonsense, Master Zhang said so. Master Zhang said this is an antique from the Western Han Dynasty!"
Liu Tianhao sweated, this thing is a Western Han Dynasty antique worth 1 billion?
This girl was really giving Lin Fan too much credit.
Liu Tianhao and Liu Bing’er have never seen eye to eye, and Liu Tianhao couldn’t help but sneer, "Bing’er, stop exaggerating. Just this thing, you can find a handful on the street, and you say it’s a Western Han Dynasty antique?"
Liu Bing’er chuckled, "That’s what Master Zhang said; if third uncle doesn’t believe it, you can ask him yourself."
Zhang Baishi stood up then and said, "Elder Liu, it is indeed an antique from the Western Han Dynasty, top-grade nephrite jade, belonging to Zhaojun of the Western Han. According to legend, after Zhaojun decided on a marriage alliance, the other party sent a piece of nephrite jade, ordering craftsmen to create a pair of Dragon and Phoenix Jade Bracelets. However, before the wedding, the Dragon and Phoenix Jade Bracelets were not completed, so the unfinished ones were given as dowry. This jade bracelet is one of the dragon bracelets. If auctioned, it would start at over 1 billion. And if it were a pair of Dragon and Phoenix Jade Bracelets, it could even double."
Liu Tianhao: "..."
Liu Bing’er’s words he might not believe, but this was personally confirmed by Zhang Baishi, so it couldn’t be wrong!
Lin Fan really hit the jackpot, managing to casually find a treasure worth over 1 billion on Antique Street!
Liu Tingshan was also a little shocked at this point. He originally thought Lin Fan had given a cheap gift, but it turned out Lin Fan’s gift was more valuable than all the other gifts combined by quite a stretch!
"Mr. Lin’s generous gift is of such high value, I especially cannot accept it," said Liu Tingshan.
If he accepted Lin Fan’s gift, and then it was said he received a gift worth over 1 billion for his birthday, how inappropriate that would be!
"Oh my, is this the legendary top-grade nephrite jade?" Suddenly, a voice said, and an old man with white hair stood up.
Everyone looked and immediately showed respect, "It’s Divine Doctor Li!"
Divine Doctor Li was a very famous traditional Chinese medicine doctor, reputed to have miraculous medical skills, with no disease he couldn’t cure, holding very high prestige, equivalent to a medical version of Zhang Baishi, authoritative among the authoritative.
Elder Liu suffered from a deficiency of qi and blood and had been taking an elixir for restoration, which was crafted by Divine Doctor Li.
Liu Tingshan saw Divine Doctor Li was so excited and curiously asked, "Divine Doctor Li, is there something about this jade bracelet?"
Divine Doctor Li said, "This nephrite jade is warm and gentle, the essence of jade, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. If worn long-term, it nourishes the body, and the deficiency of qi and blood can gradually disappear, even be cured."
Everyone was shocked, this small jade bracelet is actually so powerful?
Divine Doctor Li said, "I might not understand the antique market like Mr. Zhang, but I do know that this piece of nephrite jade is priceless. I suggest Elder Liu might consider wearing it; it will surely be beneficial to your ailment."
Liu Bing’er couldn’t help but persuade, "Grandpa, why not just accept it?"
"This..." Liu Tingshan was momentarily hesitant, indeed, the gift Lin Fan gave was truly incredible.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: This Time Daddy Was Miserably Hurt by You
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 248: This Time Daddy Was Miserably Hurt by You
Divine Doctor Li stated that the Jade Bracelet Lin Fan gave actually has a miraculous effect on healing illnesses and suggested Liu Tingshan accept it.
But Liu Tingshan had already said that all gifts would be returned tonight, regardless of what they were, he wouldn’t accept them.
Moreover, the Jade Bracelet Lin Fan gave, certified by Zhang Baishi, is an astronomically-priced Nephrite Jade, starting at 100 million, making it more impossible for Liu Tingshan to accept.
Upon hearing that this Jade Bracelet could be effective for her grandfather’s blood deficiency, Liu Bing’er said, "Grandpa, why don’t you accept it?"
Everyone was in agreement; since it was beneficial for his illness, there was no harm in accepting it.
Liu Tingshan was a bit hesitant. If this Jade Bracelet was merely precious, he definitely wouldn’t hesitate and wouldn’t accept it. But since it was useful for him, he was truly tempted. His illness had never improved, even with Divine Doctor Li’s intervention. If this Jade Bracelet was really effective, that would be ideal.
"Absolutely not, I said no gifts, and especially not such an expensive one!" Liu Tingshan finally decided firmly.
If he accepted this gift, he would give others something to talk about, so even if he really wanted to accept it, he could only refuse.
Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, "It’s truly admirable that the elder refuses gifts. However, if this item is beneficial for the elder’s illness, it would be too wasteful if it can’t be used by the elder. I have an idea: how about I lend this item to the elder, and once the elder has recovered, he can return it to me."
Feng Ruolan clapped her hands and laughed, "Little Fan is too clever. This idea is brilliant!"
Everyone nodded in agreement. Indeed, this way, Liu Tingshan wouldn’t have to accept a gift and give others something to talk about, yet the Jade Bracelet could still be used by him, making it a perfect solution.
There’d be no issue with Lin Fan lending the Jade Bracelet to Liu Tingshan, and outsiders couldn’t say anything.
Liu Bing’er smiled and said, "Grandpa, is this okay now?"
Saying this, Liu Bing’er stood up, walked to Liu Tianhao, grabbed the Jade Bracelet from him, and handed it to Liu Tingshan with both hands.
Liu Tingshan felt joyful in his heart, thinking Lin Fan was indeed very clever, and laughed, "Since that’s the case, this old man will temporarily borrow Mr. Lin’s Jade Bracelet. Thank you very much, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re welcome, elder."
Liu Tingshan accepted the Jade Bracelet and put it on his hand. Immediately, he felt a gentle warmth permeating his heart, profound comfort beyond words.
Liu Tingshan was both surprised and delighted. This item indeed seemed to help regulate his body and treat his blood deficiency, as Divine Doctor Li said!
"Mr. Lin, you saved my life before, and now you lend this treasure to me. This great kindness—I don’t know how to repay it. In the future, if there is anything I can help with, just say the word." Liu Tingshan said happily.
With these words, it was like announcing to everyone that Lin Fan was his benefactor. In the future, he would support and help Lin Fan. If anyone dared to oppose Lin Fan, they’d have to think twice first.
At this moment, Jia Zuozhen happened to return, witnessed this scene, and couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat.
Lin Fan had climbed up the high branch of Liu Tingshan. If Lin Fan wanted to deal with him and sought Liu Tingshan’s help, just a word from Liu Tingshan could lead to his utter destruction!
Now, he could only pray that Lin Fan wouldn’t take action against him.
Jia Zuozhen looked at Lin Fan nervously.
Coincidentally, Lin Fan also saw Jia Zuozhen.
Jia Zuozhen hurriedly lowered his head, not daring to meet Lin Fan’s gaze, cold sweat already pouring down.
Hearing Lin Fan say, "Okay, elder, if necessary, I will definitely trouble you."
Liu Tingshan laughed, "We soldiers are straightforward; I just like people as straightforward as Mr. Lin. No fuss! Everyone, please continue eating. I will excuse myself first."
Liu Bing’er reluctantly glanced at Lin Fan. She wanted to dine with Brother Lin, but she couldn’t disregard her grandfather and had to go over to support Liu Tingshan and leave the banquet.
After Liu Tingshan left, the banquet quickly ended.
The birthday banquet concluded, and everyone gradually took their leave.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan were about to leave when Jia Zuozhen came over.
"Mr. Lin, please wait a moment," Jia Zuozhen called out to Lin Fan.
Both of them stopped and looked at Jia Zuozhen.
"Jia Zuozhen, what do you want to do?" Feng Ruolan said coldly.
Jia Zuozhen quickly said, "I’m here specifically to speak to Mr. Lin. Previously, there might have been some misunderstandings between Mr. Lin and me, leading to some unpleasant incidents. But rest assured, Mr. Lin, there won’t be any more unpleasantness."
Considering thoroughly, he decided that it was best to proactively approach Lin Fan and extend an olive branch; otherwise, Lin Fan might stab him in the back, catching him utterly off guard.
Feng Ruolan let out a sound, "Is the sun rising in the west? What made Mr. Jia change his mind?"
Jia Zuozhen blushed deeply. The reason was clear to Feng Ruolan, and she was just teasing him.
Lin Fan’s expression was cold. Jia Zuozhen must have changed his attitude because of Liu Tingshan. It seemed that even with Jia Zuozhen’s connections in the political circle, he couldn’t afford to offend Liu Tingshan.
Lin Fan said, "Mr. Jia, may I ask what unpleasantness was there between us before?"
Jia Zuozhen broke into a sweat. Lin Fan was also asking knowingly, but he had to answer, "It was Liu Jinshan whom I sent to make things difficult for Mr. Lin. Of course, this person has already been dealt with by Miss Feng. As for another matter... Mr. Lin can rest assured, it is no longer a problem."
What he referred to was the suspension of the construction site.
Lin Fan intentionally said, "What was it? Besides Liu Jinshan, what else did Mr. Jia do to show concern for me?"
Jia Zuozhen said, "It was... the suspension of Mr. Lin’s construction site..."
Lin Fan said, "So it was indeed you causing trouble behind the scenes!"
Jia Zuozhen quickly said, "I’m sorry, please forgive me, Mr. Lin. I did it all for my daughter’s sake and was momentarily confused..."
Lin Fan said, "You also mentioned preparing a surprise for me tomorrow. What is it?"
Jia Zuozhen said, "This... Mr. Lin, there’s no need to ask. It won’t happen anymore."
Lin Fan said, "Tell me about it."
Jia Zuozhen hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said, "Originally, Mr. Lin’s Blue Moon Company would have been sealed off tomorrow..."
Lin Fan’s complexion changed; if this indeed happened tomorrow, the consequences would be unfathomable!
Feng Ruolan was already furious, "Good for you, Jia Zuozhen, you really have some tricks! Sealing off Little Fan’s company would certainly affect Mortal Group’s reputation, and Mortal’s stock price would definitely drop!"
Jia Zuozhen quickly said, "Although I’ve called off this plan, I still want to apologize to Mr. Lin and hope for Mr. Lin’s forgiveness."
Lin Fan said, "If apologies were useful, what would the police be for? Everyone should pay for their mistakes. Tomorrow, Secretary Jin will launch an investigation into the construction site issue. You should voluntarily accept your punishment. I have recorded our conversation just now. If you don’t, I’ll give you a push."
Jia Zuozhen’s face turned pale. Voluntarily confessing this time would be devastating, even if it didn’t kill him.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan ignored him, bypassed him, and walked out.
After taking a few steps, Lin Fan paused, turned around, and said, "Regarding your daughter’s matter, I don’t know how she told you, but I want to tell you the truth. I did not bully your daughter. It was your daughter bullying her classmates, and I only educated her. After all, I am somewhat her teacher."
After speaking, Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan left.
Jia Zuozhen was a little dazed.
That night, Jia Zuozhen returned home.
Jia Xueling came forward, "Daddy, did you help me teach that Lin Fan a lesson? He bullied me, you must stand up for me!"
Jia Zuozhen, emotionally charged, slapped Jia Xueling hard, "Teach what? You actually dared to deceive your dad, and you got me into serious trouble this time!"
Jia Xueling clutched her reddened face, falling into tremendous shock...

chapters.title: Chapter 249: My sister told you to get lost. Do you not understand Mandarin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 249: My sister told you to get lost. Do you not understand Mandarin?
Walking out of the Liu Family Mansion, Feng Ruolan asked Lin Fan, "Little Fan, where are you going?"
Lin Fan said, "Back to Yunding Manor."
Feng Ruolan said, "It’s already very late, and it’s a bit far for you to go back. Why not stay at my place for the night?"
Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat, the richest sister was inviting him to stay at her place? This feels a bit lucky...
Seeing Lin Fan remain silent, Feng Rulan bit her lip, "What, do you despise my place?"
Lin Fan quickly smiled and said, "No way, I also think going back to Yunding Manor is a bit far. Alright, I’ll go to your place tonight."
Feng Ruolan was delighted and grabbed Lin Fan, "Let’s go, I’ll take you for a late-night snack before heading home."
Lin Fan was puzzled, "A late-night snack?"
Didn’t we just finish the birthday feast?
Feng Ruolan said, "In that kind of setting, one must act like a lady, be reserved, how could one eat enough? Let me take you to a great place."
Lin Fan broke into a sweat, so she wasn’t full, huh? At the feast, he noticed she was eating very reservedly and thought she wasn’t hungry.
Lin Fan, on the other hand, didn’t have this issue. No matter the occasion, Lin Fan always prioritized eating his fill, so he was quite satisfied from the feast.
But since his sister wasn’t full, he naturally had to accompany her to grab a bite.
An old district.
It’s already late-night snack time, the streets of the old district turned into a street food lane, lined with food stalls, filled with tables and chairs, mostly occupied, bustling with activity.
The customers at these stalls were mostly locals, and most of them were common folks, the whole street was filled with a lively local charm.
Lin Fan was a bit curious, "Sister, you are the daughter of the Feng Family and the richest woman in Yun City, how do you know about this place for late-night snacks?"
Feng Ruolan laughed, "Even a daughter of the Feng Family needs to eat, right? Everything on this street tastes great. I discovered it recently when my assistant brought me here. I fell in love with it after trying it once."
Later, they found a food stall to sit at and ordered a table full of snacks and two bottles of beer.
They were a handsome man and a beautiful woman, and Feng Ruolan was still wearing the evening dress she wore to the Liu Family’s birthday banquet, immediately attracting everyone’s attention. The handsome couple stunned the crowd.
"This guy is so handsome!"
"The woman is also so pretty!"
"They are such a great match, why do they look so good together!"
Envious eyes were cast their way.
Some of the men became jealous of Lin Fan after being amazed by Feng Ruolan, and started to find faults with their own girlfriends.
"Look at you, also born of a mother, why are you not as beautiful as her..." The guys sighed, shaking their heads.
The girlfriends were annoyed and retorted, "What are you saying, have you looked at yourself in the mirror, do you deserve such a beautiful girlfriend, are you as handsome as that guy!"
After snapping at their clueless boyfriends, the girls looked at Lin Fan, somewhat infatuated. Sigh, if only their boyfriend were as handsome.
"Little Fan, try this fried noodles, it’s super delicious." Feng Ruolan served a bowl of fried noodles for Lin Fan.
She was already used to the amazed stares from the people around.
When she usually came here to eat, she tried to dress low-key, but she would still become the center of attention. Not to mention tonight, she was in an evening gown, just coming from an upper-class party...
Lin Fan took a bite of the fried noodles, indeed it wasn’t bad, but he didn’t find it particularly astonishing. After all, in the past 21 years, he had been living at the bottom tier, he would eat this kind of street food almost daily.
Feng Ruolan found it delicious probably because she was used to gourmet food, occasionally eating such down-to-earth street food gave her a fresh experience.
For the poor, eating street food signifies true poverty, while for the rich, it’s about getting grounded and having a unique taste.
If you asked the common folks around here if they would like to switch places with Feng Ruolan, to eat gourmet food every day, most of them would probably agree. Who wouldn’t want to live a luxurious life?
"Little Fan, go find a bottle opener to open the beer, let’s have a drink." Feng Ruolan said.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need."
He reached out, pinched the bottle cap, and effortlessly popped it off, as if peeling a sticker.
Feng Ruolan was surprised, "Little Fan, how did your hand strength get so strong?"
Lin Fan naturally wouldn’t tell her he had taken Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, giving him an extraordinary strength.
"I’ve done it a lot, practice makes perfect." Lin Fan casually said.
Feng Ruolan nodded, not paying much attention, and then poured two glasses of beer to toast with Lin Fan.
She took the glass and downed it in one gulp.
Lin Fan was somewhat charmed by her, this drinking style was like a bold man, making one even forget she is the richest woman in Yun City.
Eating late-night snacks in such a street setting had a special atmosphere and feeling, Feng Ruolan really liked this lively, life-filled vibe, so different from the cold, upper-class society she usually dealt with. Here was the closest to life environment, giving people a sense of grounded happiness.
However, in such a common place, with all sorts of people around, there’s good and bad. Sometimes a beautiful girl like Feng Ruolan would inevitably encounter some clueless people trying to chat her up.
They had just started eating when several guys came over, attempting to ask for Feng Ruolan’s phone number.
These guys seemed not to take Lin Fan seriously at all.
However, after Feng Ruolan coldly told them to scram, they all immediately backed off.
Lin Fan found it somewhat amusing, having mingled with common folks for years, he was naturally familiar with these kinds of guys. These guys had a mysterious self-confidence, thinking beautiful girls would take a liking to them. If fortunate, they’ll flirt with nice ones. Even if unsuccessful, they could at least have some verbal fun. But if encountering someone with a bad temperament, they’d chicken out fast.
Feng Ruolan was the latter; she’d never give these sleazy guys a chance to flirt.
Most of the time, just one word, "scram," was enough to drive those guys away, but there were exceptions too.
Tonight, they met an exception.
Suddenly, two drunk men approached them. Upon closer look, they were foreigners, amidst the mix in this common street, even foreigners were around.
The two foreigners were about thirty, big and tall, with faces flushed from drinking.
"Beauty, my bro thinks you’re gorgeous!" One of the foreigners said in broken Huaxia language.
The other foreigner seemed not to understand Huaxia, jabbering in a foreign language, roughly understandable as compliments about Feng Ruolan’s appearance, though the words were a bit frivolous.
Judging by the accent, these two foreigners seemed to be from the United States!
Feng Ruolan chuckled and said "scram" in a foreign language.
For anyone coming over with indecent intentions, regardless of who they were, she would always say this one word.
But these two foreigners didn’t back down, instead, they were even more encouraged.
"She’s a feisty one, I like that..." The foreigner gave a sleazy smile.
"Beauty, come to a room with us, it will be amazing, don’t you Huaxia women all love handsome foreigners like us!"
What these two said was truly unpleasant.
Although there are indeed quite a few Huaxia girls crazy about foreigners, these foreigners seemed to consider all Huaxia women to be like that.
Lin Fan frowned, "My sister told you to scram, don’t you understand Huaxia language?"
The two foreigners seemed to only then notice Lin Fan.
"Kid, don’t meddle in others’ business!"
"Do you know who we are, Americans, you Huaxia are not a match for us in the United States, Zhongwei Phone was even crushed by us, what are you?"
The two foreigners arrogantly stated.
This immediately drew the attention of the people around them. This statement clearly stirred public anger, and everyone started to feel a bit indignant.

chapters.title: Chapter 250 What Use is Keeping This Dog’s Paw!
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 250 What Use is Keeping This Dog’s Paw!
Foreigners in Huaxia territory, yet they act arrogantly, recklessly, even harassing women in the streets. Such news isn’t uncommon. These foreign trash have a mysterious sense of superiority, thinking they’re so noble just because they’re foreigners.
But they don’t realize that as Huaxia grows stronger, the mindset of Huaxia people has changed. In Huaxia, if these foreign trash don’t keep a low profile, they are just asking for trouble.
These two foreigners came to tease Feng Ruolan, already drawing the attention of bystanders. After Lin Fan spoke up, these two foreigners became even more arrogant.
"Do you know who we are? Who do you think you are?"
The foreigner said smugly.
This made the surrounding people grind their teeth. These two Americans are too arrogant, saying such things in Huaxia, it’s like they don’t see Huaxia people as human!
Lin Fan was a bit speechless. Going out for a late-night snack with his sister and running into people like this really kills the mood.
"You might be celebrating too early. Are all Americans as shallow as you?" Lin Fan said flatly.
Then he continued, "Moreover, I want you to apologize to my sister. You offended her."
The two foreigners exchanged a glance and burst into laughter.
"You want us to apologize?"
"Kid, is this a joke? You’re hilarious!"
The two foreigners stared intently, showing off their strong arms. It must be said, these two foreigners were tall and muscular, making Lin Fan seem weak by comparison.
But Lin Fan remained calm, saying, "That’s right, apologize, and only after my sister forgives you can you get the hell out."
The two foreigners exchanged another glance, slightly infuriated. This kid showed no fear, which really pissed them off.
"We’re not apologizing, so what?!" said one foreigner, blocking Lin Fan with his sturdy body.
The other one babbled in a foreign language, implying that Feng Ruolan should go with them, and even reached out, trying to forcibly drag Feng Ruolan away.
Feng Ruolan quickly dodged and said angrily, "Don’t mess around, or I’ll call the police!"
The foreigner wasn’t afraid of her threat at all. After missing, he closed in again, trying to grab Feng Ruolan once more.
Seeing Feng Ruolan couldn’t avoid it and was about to be grabbed, suddenly, Lin Fan caught her hand and pulled her behind him.
The foreigner chuckled twice, advancing towards Lin Fan, reaching to grab his collar. According to his plan, he intended to lift Lin Fan completely and throw him aside.
However, before his hand could touch Lin Fan...
Smack!
Lin Fan had already launched a flying kick, hitting the foreigner’s groin.
"Ah!"
The foreigner screamed in agony, his face twisting in pain, turning green, and he automatically knelt on the ground, cold sweat pouring down.
Lin Fan’s kick was brutal, but he went easy. Otherwise, that kick could have killed him. Of course, this foreign trash was already crippled for life.
Smack!
The foreigner grappled with the nearby table, trying to stand up.
Lin Fan chuckled, "You used this filthy paw to touch my sister, right? No point keeping it!"
As he spoke, Lin Fan grabbed a chopstick, stabbing it down fiercely. The chopstick pierced through the foreigner’s hand, embedding into the solid wood table, nailing his hand onto the table, with blood gushing from the wound.
"Ah!"
The foreigner let out a heart-wrenching scream, but the pain was so intense he couldn’t move. Any movement brought searing pain.
The other foreigner was scared sober, but his mysterious confidence remained as he swung his fist, aiming a punch at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan gently twisted his body, avoiding the punch, followed by a kick that hit the foreigner’s lower leg.
Smack!
The foreigner’s momentum was unstoppable, and he fell, collapsing to the ground, stars spinning in his vision.
Lin Fan didn’t let him get up, walked over, crouched down, grabbed the foreigner’s hair, lifted his head slightly, then smashed it down to the ground with force.
Old town area, hard concrete pavement.
The foreigner’s nose immediately began to bleed profusely.
Lin Fan repeated the process, smashing the opponent’s head back into the ground.
The opponent’s face was swollen and bruised, nose crooked, utterly wretched.
"Mercy, mercy!"
This foreigner cried in pain, finally pleading for his life, utterly terrified. Lin Fan was too strong. Despite his large size, the foreigner had no power to resist before Lin Fan!
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "And what else?"
The foreigner sobbed, "I’m sorry, we were wrong, we shouldn’t have harassed the lady."
Only then did Lin Fan let go, stood up, and stepped on the foreigner’s head, taking out his phone to call the police.
"Hello, police officer, I want to report an incident. We were bullied by foreigners..."
The two foreigners were about to cry themselves to death. They call this being bullied by foreigners? Clearly, they were the ones bullied...
Around them, silence reigned.
Everyone was stunned.
Someone was pouring tea and didn’t notice even as it overflowed, someone was eating and dropped their chopsticks in shock, someone picked up a stool intending to help but quietly put it down.
Oh my god!
This guy is so fucking strong!
But...
How satisfying!
These two foreign trash deserved this treatment!
After receiving the report, the police swiftly arrived at the scene.
The police were dumbfounded.
Heard someone was bullied by foreigners here?
Why does it look like the foreigners were the ones bullied?
These two foreigners were so miserable!
After understanding the situation, the police decisively handcuffed the two foreign trash. The one whose hand was nailed to the table by a chopstick took a lot of effort from the officer to remove the chopstick, and the foreigner immediately fainted from the pain.
As for Lin Fan, the police deliberately put on a stern face and criticized him a bit.
"Young man, you were a bit heavy-handed. Be more careful next time."
After saying this, suppressing the urge to laugh, the police took the two pieces of foreign trash back to lock them up.
Clap clap!
