Someone at the scene started clapping, and then applause thundered, cheers erupting.
"Awesome!"
"So damn satisfying!"
"Super cool, how can someone be this strong? I can only say that’s fucking awesome!"
"I bow to this bro!"
The scene was almost frenzied with excitement.
Lin Fan asked Feng Ruolan, "Sister, do you still want to eat?"
Feng Ruolan said, "No, let’s go!"
After such a commotion by the two foreigners, she had no appetite left.
So the two settled their bill and left the snack stall.
Returning to Feng Ruolan’s villa.
Feng Ruolan finally couldn’t hold back, asking, "Little Fan, when did you become so powerful, handling two tall, burly foreigners like it’s nothing?"
She was truly surprised.
Lin Fan mentally noted that the system altered her memory, but did not include the part about him taking Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules.
"Well... I specifically found a master to train me, learned some martial arts, to protect my girlfriend." Lin Fan said offhandedly, naturally not mentioning the Strengthening Capsules.
Feng Ruolan couldn’t help but laugh, "Seems like being your girlfriend is really fortunate."
Lin Fan said, "Sister, the foods at the street stalls are tasty, but it’s a mixed crowd. It’s better to go there less often."
Feng Ruolan laughed, "I can just take you with me next time, and I can protect myself too."
As she said this, Feng Ruolan took out her phone, "Hey, do a background check on two foreigners for me, I want to send them to Africa."
These pieces of foreign trash don’t need to stay in Huaxia anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 251: You must have been very tired last night, take a good rest.
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 251: You must have been very tired last night, take a good rest.
Lin Fan broke out in a cold sweat; this tycoon sister was quite ruthless.
Actually, there was no need for him to make a move tonight; those two foreigners would be dealt with by Feng Ruolan. He could tell that when Feng Ruolan was dodging them, her moves were agile, clearly a Martial Artist. According to the system’s information, Feng Ruolan is a Taekwondo eighth-degree black belt...
Those two foreign trash, who thought they were superior just because they were tall, were no match for her at all.
Moreover, with Feng Ruolan’s penchant for sending people to Africa at the slightest provocation, those two foreign trash were practically asking for it.
The reason Lin Fan decided to act tonight was that he really wanted to personally deal with the two foreign trash; he just felt itchy-handed for a moment.
"Little Fan, let’s call it a night. It’s getting late; let’s go to bed," Feng Ruolan suggested.
"You go take a shower first; I’ll make your bed. Aunt Cui took off for the night," Feng Ruolan said.
"Hmm..."
After Lin Fan finished his shower, Feng Ruolan had already made the bed in the guest room for him.
While Lin Fan was showering, he accidentally got his shirt wet, leaving him no choice but to come out shirtless.
When Feng Ruolan turned her head and saw Lin Fan’s well-built muscles, her heart started racing. Wow... so handsome, and he looks so reassuring.
Apparently, Lin Fan really did train with a master; otherwise, how could he have such an exceptional physique!
Feng Ruolan blushed and said, "The bed is made. You should get some early rest."
She quickly made her escape, unable to keep looking as she feared losing control.
Lin Fan scratched his head, wondering why his sister seemed to be blushing. Could it be...
He looked down at his abs, and it seemed he understood.
The night passed without incident.
The next morning.
Aunt Cui returned from outside to Feng Ruolan’s villa. She had taken off the night before and came back early to prepare breakfast for the young lady.
Entering the living room.
Aunt Cui suddenly saw Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan emerge from the hallway, with Feng Ruolan still in her pajamas...
This...
Aunt Cui misunderstood. Since she wasn’t there last night, Lin Fan stayed over? And they both came out of the room together!
Could it be that the young lady finally confronted Lin Fan?
Aunt Cui couldn’t help but show an ambiguous smile.
Seeing Aunt Cui, Feng Ruolan said, "You’re back, Aunt Cui."
She showed no signs of panic from being caught.
The young lady was acting very calm. Aunt Cui smiled and said, "Yes, I just got back. Planning to make breakfast. I won’t say more; I’ll go make breakfast for you two. Must have been a tiring night; you need a good replenishing."
Aunt Cui chuckled and slipped into the kitchen.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan exchanged glances, unsure of what Aunt Cui meant.
"Sis, what’s up with Aunt Cui?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Feng Ruolan replied, "Who knows. Breakfast won’t be ready for a while. Little Fan, how about joining me for a run?"
So, the two of them left the villa and headed to the neighborhood path for some morning exercise.
Early in the morning, the garden had quite a crowd of people doing morning exercises, young and old, making it quite lively.
An old man, looking to be in his seventies, was doing one-handed pull-ups, drawing cheers from the crowd.
A few young fellows, unwilling to admit defeat, rushed over, trying to challenge the old man, only to leave with red faces after failing to complete a single one-handed pull-up, stepping down one by one.
The crowd burst into laughter, saying, "Your uncle is still your uncle!"
The old man was gleefully proud, chuckling, "Young people these days aren’t up to it; very few like to work out. All weak scholars unable to even catch a chicken, wobbly on their feet. With these bodies, how can our country be built? It’s us middle-aged and elderly folks who have the energy!"
His words left the surrounding young people feeling embarrassed.
Getting beaten by an old man was indeed quite shameful.
"Grandpa, mind if I give it a try?" Feng Ruolan said with a smile, approaching.
The old man, seeing it was a girl, scoffed, "You’re a girl challenging me?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "Yes."
Without further ado, she walked over and did a few one-handed pull-ups.
Being a Martial Artist and someone who exercises regularly, one-handed pull-ups were no big deal for Feng Ruolan.
The old man was embarrassed, finding his face somewhat hard to maintain.
Feng Ruolan smiled, "Grandpa, see, young people can do it too. It’s just that they have a lot of work pressure, spending all their time on jobs, leaving little time for exercise. But it’s not an absolute."
The nearby young men applauded, appreciating Feng Ruolan for regaining some face for them.
The old man sneered, "What are you clapping for? You youngsters can’t even beat a girl, have some face?"
The young men’s smiles froze, left speechless.
Just then, Lin Fan silently walked to the horizontal bar, hooked it with one finger, and lifted his body.
With one finger, he completed a pull-up!
"Grandpa, how about this?" Lin Fan smiled, looking at the old man.
Everyone was stunned, and soon, the cheers erupted all around.
"Bro, you’re amazing!"
"Kneeling!"
"The old man can’t argue now!"
The young men were incredibly excited, feeling vindicated by Lin Fan.
The old man was initially shocked and then gave a thumbs-up: "You’re pretty good, young man. I’m convinced and take back what I said!"
At this moment, someone shouted, "Whoa, big news! Huaxin just released a statement; they’ve decided not to support Zhongwei Phone!"
What?
The people around were momentarily stunned, aware of the recent situation. Everyone knew that the United States forbade semiconductor companies from assisting Zhongwei Phone with chip production, and TSMC subsequently halted Zhongwei’s orders.
Without TSMC’s support, Zhongwei Phone faced a crisis with no chips available, leading to a production halt.
At this point, only Huaxin Company could support Zhongwei, being Zhongwei’s last hope. Moreover, the nation had high expectations for Huaxin, believing there was no reason for them not to help Zhongwei.
Against this backdrop, Huaxin suddenly announced they wouldn’t support Zhongwei, foreshadowing the substantial emotional impact this disparity would bring.
Everyone quickly pulled out their phones to verify this news.
It was true!
Huaxin had indeed decided not to support Zhongwei!
The reason was exactly what Zhang Jing mentioned last night; Huaxin held the technology and wasn’t afraid of lacking orders. They could completely abandon Zhongwei and wouldn’t sacrifice the United States market for Zhongwei.
Essentially, Huaxin approached this issue purely from a business perspective.
Lin Fan looked at the old man, "Grandpa, you were just talking about the vigor of the middle and older generations. Is this it?"
The old man sighed up towards the sky, "Shameful, truly shameful!"
At the same time.
Zhongwei Company Headquarters.
Upon learning of Huaxin’s announcement, Zhongwei immediately convened an emergency meeting.
Huaxin’s refusal meant Zhongwei’s last lifeline was gone—requiring immediate measures to address this new situation.
They needed to stabilize morale and at the same time find a way to crack this predicament.
However, cracking this predicament seemed hopeless because Huaxin was their last hope.
That day, Huaxin’s announcement not to support Zhongwei sent shockwaves all around, and Huaxin’s stock price plummeted dramatically.
And at that moment.
Ding!
Lin Fan received a system notification—a new day’s reward had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Super New Reward, 150 Billion Shares
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 252: Super New Reward, 150 Billion Shares
"Ding!"
"System alert, a new day has begun, you can sign in and receive equity in a chip company. Sign in?"
The system’s voice echoed in Lin Fan’s mind.
Lin Fan was stunned. The system was rewarding him with a chip company today?
This...
Is it a coincidence?
Lin Fan immediately thought, "Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, sign-in successful, rewarded with 30% shares of Huaxin Company, becoming the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company!"
What?
Lin Fan was taken aback; he actually became the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company?
"Ding!"
"Huaxin Company data has been fully collected, would you like to read it?"
"Read!"
"Importing the information stream..."
The information stream about Huaxin Company flooded into Lin Fan’s mind.
Huaxin Company currently has a market value of 500 billion!
Lin Fan received 30% of the shares, that’s 150 billion!
This reward is simply too powerful, Lin Fan’s personal assets skyrocketed by 150 billion in an instant, becoming the most impressive reward after the billion in cash.
But Lin Fan was a bit curious, why did the system reward him with shares of Huaxin Company?
It’s worth noting that as of last night, Lin Fan and the Huaxin Company chairman, Zhang Jing, were at odds...
"Ding!"
"System task issued: Take over Huaxin Company, change Huaxin Company’s decision, and support Zhongwei Phone."
The system suddenly prompted again.
It is issuing a system task?
Lin Fan furrowed his brows. Huaxin Company just decided not to help Zhongwei Phone manufacture chips, and now the system wants him to change this strategy. It’s easier said than done!
Even though he is the largest shareholder, it’s a challenge.
According to the information stream, Huaxin Company requires at least 40% shareholding for major decisions to pass.
Though Lin Fan is the largest shareholder, he only has 30% of the shares, so he needs to pull in another 10%!
"Little Fan, what’s wrong with you?"
Feng Ruolan, who was next to Lin Fan, noticed his sudden trance and asked with concern.
Lin Fan said, "Sister, let me tell you something, stay calm."
Feng Ruolan asked curiously, "Seems serious, what’s it about?"
Lin Fan lowered his voice, "I just acquired 30% of Huaxin Company’s shares, becoming the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company..."
"What?" Feng Ruolan exclaimed.
Attracting curious glances from people nearby.
Realizing her overreaction, Feng Ruolan quickly calmed down and lowered her voice, "Little Fan, are you kidding?"
Lin Fan’s words were indeed shocking, acquiring 30% of Huaxin Company becoming the largest shareholder?
Huaxin Company’s market value is 500 billion!
How is this possible?
How could Lin Fan manage to do this?
Lin Fan seriously said, "Sister, I’m not joking, it’s true, I’m now the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company."
Seeing that Lin Fan wasn’t joking, Feng Ruolan couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat: "Little Fan, never mind how you did it, what’s your purpose in doing this?"
Lin Fan’s eyes shifted, "I knew last night that Huaxin Company would definitely not support Zhongwei, so I planned to acquire Huaxin last night. If I become the absolute majority, I can make decisions to support Zhongwei."
Feng Ruolan broke out in a sweat.
Brutal!
Too brutal!
Lin Fan intended to buy out the company because he didn’t see eye to eye with Zhang Jing!
Although such things have happened before and are not new, Feng Ruolan has done it herself.
Back then, the general manager of a company offended Feng Ruolan. She asked that company to fire the manager, but the company refused. The manager boasted in front of Feng Ruolan.
In a fit of anger, Feng Ruolan bought the company, sending everyone from the chairman to the general manager to Africa.
However, Feng Ruolan spent only 100 million on that acquisition.
Lin Fan acquiring 30% of a 500 billion company cost a lot more than 100 million or even a billion.
It’s a hundred billion!
Just to vent, spending a hundred billion to buy a company’s shares, this... is way too willful!
No, way too rich!
Who in this world could be so willful, so extravagantly rich!
Feng Ruolan finally calmed down, thought carefully, and said: "Little Fan, even though you are the largest shareholder, 30% is not enough for absolute control."
Generally, exceeding half, that is 51% of the shares, allows for absolute control, 30% indeed is not enough.
Lin Fan said, "No need for 51%, according to Huaxin Company’s regulations, as long as there are 40% shares, decisions can be made. Before my acquisition, Huaxin Company’s top three shareholders together held exactly 40% of the shares. This rule actually means that when the top three shareholders join forces, they can control the company. Now I’ve acquired 30% shares, becoming the largest shareholder, and the current second-largest shareholder holds 11%."
Feng Ruolan said, "So, as long as you get the second-largest shareholder on board, you can control Huaxin Company."
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right."
This was precisely the task the system gave Lin Fan.
To complete this task, Lin Fan needs to get the second-largest shareholder on his side.
Feng Ruolan said, "For Huaxin Company to defy the opposition and refuse to support Zhongwei, it must be a well-thought decision by their leadership, which naturally includes the second-largest shareholder. Tying down this shareholder might not be easy. By the way, who is the second-largest shareholder?"
Lin Fan said, "The second-largest shareholder is a company based in Yun City, Yunxin Company."
Upon hearing this, Feng Ruolan laughed, "Yunxin Company? What a coincidence, I happen to know Yunxin Company’s boss, President Zheng. Little Fan, leave the task of securing Yunxin Company to me. I’ll go persuade President Zheng for you."
Lin Fan asked, "Sister, are you confident?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "Don’t worry, President Zheng owes me a favor, he definitely won’t refuse this request."
Lin Fan was delighted, "Then I’ll leave it to you, Sister."
At this moment, a black Bentley drove over from the distance.
The Bentley stopped, and a middle-aged man in a suit got out of the car, approached Lin Fan, and bowed.
"Mr. Lin, I am He Xini, the board secretary of Huaxin Company. I’ve come on behalf of the board to ask if there’s anything you need, Sir, you can instruct me to do." The middle-aged man said respectfully.
Lin Fan replied, "Secretary He, you’re just in time. Please arrange for me to convene a shareholders’ meeting, arrange it immediately."
He Xini agreed without any objections, "Alright, I’ll arrange it right away. Mr. Lin, do you want to go to the company now?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Let’s go."
Lin Fan bid farewell to Feng Ruolan and got into the Bentley, heading to Huaxin Company.
After Lin Fan left, Feng Ruolan pulled out her phone, dialed a number, and said: "President Zheng, it’s me. Did I wake you up this early? There’s something I want to discuss with you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Oh my God, is that Lin Fan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 253: Oh my God, is that Lin Fan?
Early in the morning, Huaxin Company released an announcement, addressing recent concerns about whether to support Zhongwei Company. Huaxin Company decided it would not produce chips for Zhongwei.
The news caused an uproar as soon as it came out.
There was an outcry online.
"What the hell, isn’t Huaxin Company a Huaxia company? Why are they doing this?"
"I can’t understand!"
"What is Huaxin doing? It’s disgusting!"
"Huaxin is forever blacklisted!"
"Not even helping their own people, heh."
The criticism against Huaxin Company spread like a tidal wave threatening to drown it.
AM.
The stock market opened.
Huaxin Company’s stock price plummeted dramatically.
The headquarters of Huaxin Company, Chairman’s office.
Zhang Jing sat in his office chair, frowning and deep in thought.
Based on recent public opinion, he could already foresee that once the news got out, it would certainly draw criticism and affect the company’s stock price.
But this decision was not his alone; it was made after careful consideration by the company’s decision-makers.
It’s essentially irreversible now.
How to manage the next step in public relations in the face of negative opinions was Zhang Jing’s current headache because it involved a matter of principle, and no matter how it was explained, it was hard to recover.
After this battle, Huaxin Company must experience a long period of darkness.
Unless the company changes its decision to support Zhongwei.
But that’s impossible.
Zhang Jing himself would not agree either.
However, just as Zhang Jing was troubled by this matter, a shocking piece of news suddenly came from within the company.
Just now.
The company’s share structure had unexpectedly changed; the original first and second largest shareholders had exited Huaxin.
The shares of these two major shareholders, totaling 30%, were transferred to one person.
Lin Fan!
When he learned that the person who had acquired 30% of Huaxin’s shares was named Lin Fan, Zhang Jing jumped up from his seat.
Utterly shocked!
Lin Fan?
Heavens, could it be that Lin Fan he knows?
The young man who fiercely debated with him at Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet last night and left him speechless?
How could it be?
How could this kid have acquired 30% of Huaxin’s shares overnight? How did he do it?
Subsequently, Zhang Jing received a notification from the board secretary, He Xini, that the company’s largest shareholder, Lin Fan, requested a shareholder meeting, and all major shareholders of the company must attend.
The company’s largest shareholder, Lin Fan, was on his way to the company!
Zhang Jing couldn’t be sure at that moment if this Lin Fan, the company’s largest shareholder, was really the same Lin Fan from last night.
If it really was that Lin Fan, why did he do this?
Was Lin Fan targeting him?
Was it because he offended Lin Fan last night?
At this thought, Zhang Jing broke out in a cold sweat. If Lin Fan bought 30% of Huaxin’s shares just because he didn’t see eye to eye with him last night, then Lin Fan was acting way too brashly.
More accurately, he was way too rich.
Who exactly is this Lin Fan, casually acquiring 30% of Huaxin’s shares, a billion-dollar astronomical figure?
Could Lin Fan casually put forth billions?
What’s more frightening is that money wasn’t even the biggest issue; the problem was that, ordinarily, even if Lin Fan had that much money, it should have been impossible to complete the acquisition of 30% of Huaxin’s shares overnight!
Just ask why the previous largest and second-largest shareholders were willing to transfer their shares to Lin Fan?
As far as he knew, the first and second-largest shareholders wouldn’t have done so; Huaxin Company is one of Huaxia’s leading chip companies, with enormous potential, currently valued at 500 billion. Who would turn away from such money?
Zhang Jing immediately decided to contact the first and second-largest shareholders to find out if they really ceded their shares, and why.
However, Zhang Jing was unable to reach the representatives of the first and second-largest shareholders, only receiving a terse response.
"No more relations with Huaxin Company!"
Such a decisive statement!
No explanation, no attachment.
It was as if these top two shareholders couldn’t wait to distance themselves from Huaxin.
Zhang Jing was left powerless, realizing it would be difficult to clear up his doubts for a while.
Now, he could only wait for Lin Fan to arrive and see the situation.
Zhang Jing personally went to the company entrance to welcome Lin Fan.
AM.
A black Bentley came to the front of Huaxin Company headquarters.
The first to get out of the car was Board Secretary He Xini; He Xini opened the rear door, and a simply dressed young man stepped out.
Zhang Jing’s face turned pale.
It was Lin Fan!
It really was that young Lin Fan from last night!
Oh my god, what he least wanted to happen had indeed happened; it was truly the Lin Fan he knew, who had acquired 30% of Huaxin’s shares and become the company’s largest shareholder!
Lin Fan approached the company entrance and immediately spotted Zhang Jing.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "Chairman, we meet again. I didn’t expect you’d leave in a hurry last night, and here we are meeting again so soon."
Zhang Jing’s face was ashen. He struggled to calm himself and said, "Lin Fan, what are you doing?"
Lin Fan replied: "Oh, didn’t Old He notify you? I want to hold a board meeting, Old He, did you notify him?"
He Xini quickly responded: "I did notify him."
He Xini wiped his cold sweat, thinking he had notified Zhang Jing while sitting in the same car as Lin Fan. Lin Fan was clearly asking him deliberately, indicating there was some friction between Mr. Lin and Chairman Zhang Jing.
Lin Fan said: "That’s good. Chairman, get ready. We’re going to have a shareholder meeting."
With that, Lin Fan ignored Zhang Jing and walked into the company entrance.
Zhang Jing was furious; Lin Fan had become the largest shareholder, essentially putting him under. How could he tolerate this?
Moreover, he had a hunch that Lin Fan was hastily convening a shareholder meeting for a reason, and certainly not for anything good. This guy!
This guy was aiming for him?
Zhang Jing changed his perspective, fearing that Lin Fan was not just coming for him but for the entire company.
He was not coming with good intentions!
Shareholder Meeting.
The shareholder representatives of Huaxin Company had all arrived.
The shareholders were all incredibly shocked by the change in the company’s shareholders; the original largest and second-largest shareholders had mysteriously disappeared.
Currently, the first shareholder had become this unfamiliar young man named Lin Fan.
Of course, although they hadn’t met Lin Fan, they had somewhat heard of him; Lin Fan had recently acquired Celestial Aviation, causing its market value to soar by 40 billion in three days, a sensation in the business world.
No one knew just how rich this Lin Fan was, who had been crazily spending money to buy, buy, buy—not luxury goods or cabbages, but acquiring companies and land!
For Lin Fan, buying companies and land seemed as frequent as Auntie buying cabbages, as if he treated companies and land as if they were cabbages.
A wealth god!
Incredibly rich.
As the largest shareholder, Lin Fan took the chief seat at the shareholder meeting. Glancing at everyone, Lin Fan slowly spoke: "I called everyone here today to announce a change in decision; I want the company to support Zhongwei and produce chips for them."
What?
Upon these words, all the shareholders’ expressions changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Business People Should Not Only Focus on Business
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 254: Business People Should Not Only Focus on Business
Lin Fan wants to change Huaxin Company’s decision to support Zhongwei instead.
As soon as this statement was made, the shareholders present immediately changed their expressions.
Zhang Jing angrily said, "Lin Fan, do you know what you’re saying? Don’t think that just because you’re the largest shareholder, you can do whatever you want and disregard the company’s interests!"
Everyone chimed in agreement.
"Not supporting Zhongwei is a decision made after careful consideration by the company; how can it be changed just like that!"
"Exactly, even an announcement has been made!"
"Not supporting is the right choice, we can’t be reckless!"
Everyone unanimously opposed Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said calmly, "I know why you’re against it, but as the largest shareholder, I have the right to propose a decision change."
Zhang Jing excitedly said, "If you really knew the reason, you wouldn’t be talking about changing the decision! I know what you’re thinking; you think our decision damages our image, shows a lack of backbone, and even led to a drop in stock price. You want to meet everyone’s expectations, you’re full of youthful passion, you want them to praise you, right?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s not as you say."
In fact, what decision Huaxin Company makes originally had nothing to do with Lin Fan, but Lin Fan obtained Huaxin shares as a system reward, suddenly becoming the largest shareholder, and there is a system task requiring him to change the decision.
So, what he is doing now is mainly to complete the system task.
He knows there must be a reason for the system to assign such a task.
Zhang Jing sneered, "No need to hide it, I already knew what you were thinking last night. You people, it’s easy to talk, you want passion, you want to vent your anger, but you don’t even consider Huaxin’s difficulties!"
"It’s not that Huaxin doesn’t want to help Zhongwei, but it can’t. The technology and equipment we use also need to be imported. If we support Zhongwei, we will be cut off from supplies, and then the fate the company will face is bankruptcy!"
"Supporting Zhongwei may feel good, but the cost is company bankruptcy. Now, do you understand?"
Lin Fan nodded: "I know the situation you mentioned."
According to the information provided by the system, Huaxin indeed needs to import equipment and technology, which is like Huaxin being choked at the throat.
Knowing this reason, the decision Huaxin made is indeed the optimal solution for the company.
Even if the company’s stock price falls as a result, a temporary drop in stock price is better than dying.
Zhang Jing was furious: "You know the reason, yet you still want to change the decision? Lin Fan, are you here to doom Huaxin?"
The more he thought, the more it seemed like it!
Last night he offended Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan, and it’s very possible that Lin Fan came for revenge.
However, for Lin Fan to take revenge, he bought 30% of Huaxin’s shares, becoming the largest shareholder; that’s ruthless.
It could even be called extreme.
Because he was offended by someone, he bought their company and ruined them; this kind of story is usually only seen online, but it actually happened.
And it happened to a company like Huaxin with a market value of 500 billion!
Zhang Jing was truly at a loss for words.
This Lin Fan, he’s too wealthy.
Everyone was shocked. What, didn’t Lin Fan just become Huaxin’s largest shareholder? Why would he want to ruin Huaxin?
Lin Fan chuckled: "Chairman Zhang, you’re exaggerating a bit. How could I possibly ruin the company? What I’m doing is the right decision."
Zhang Jing was a bit angry: "Right? Tell me, how is it right?"
Lin Fan cleared his throat and said, "I clearly understand everyone’s concerns. If we support Zhongwei, it may lead to supply disruption, so even if we bear the infamy, we still have to compromise and strive for survival. As the saying goes, a good death is better than a bad life. Am I right?"
Zhang Jing said with a cold hum: "You only know part of the story. When the company was first established, our technology couldn’t catch up, and only by great effort did we find equipment and technology to grow stronger. This is the foundation of the company’s survival. Why should Huaxin be sacrificed for Zhongwei?"
Indeed, if Huaxin acts on impulse and claims to support Zhongwei, it may feel good for a moment, but if Huaxin goes bankrupt due to supply cut, Zhongwei will die as well. Then both will perish.
So, it’s better for Huaxin to compromise, at least Huaxin can survive.
Lin Fan said, "This is the core issue; we are controlled by others, so we can only compromise. There is only one solution: we improve our own technology, no longer needing to buy equipment and technology from others."
Zhang Jing sneered: "You say it lightly, can technology be improved overnight? Even if we could improve technology, we don’t have enough time; the company would go bankrupt long before that day arrives. This path simply won’t work!"
Lin Fan said, "That’s too pessimistic; although there will be difficulties, how will we know the result without trying our best? A businessman should not only see business but also have some courage, better to stand and die than live on one’s knees."
Zhang Jing said, "Your words sound nice, but I can only say you’re too young. A businessman should only see business. Only a fool talks about some bullshit courage, and such fools have long perished, but Huaxin has lived until today. Lin Fan, I will not let you destroy the hard-earned glory of Huaxin!"
Lin Fan sighed and said, "It seems we can’t reach an agreement."
Zhang Jing sneered: "Fortunately, you only have 30% of the shares. Although you are the largest shareholder, you are not the absolute controller. We can still vote against it. Lin Fan, by ignoring the interests of all company shareholders and unilaterally deciding to change the decision, you cannot succeed!"
Lin Fan said, "According to company regulations, as long as 40% agree, the decision can pass. Am I right?"
Zhang Jing sneered: "That’s right, but you only have 30%. Do you think you can get another 10% of the votes? For those present, who agrees with his decision change, please raise your hand!"
No one raised their hand!
No one agreed with Lin Fan. His approach of trying to improve technology was too risky, with an extremely low success rate, almost zero.
No one would go against money.
Zhang Jing began to feel triumphant: "Lin Fan, you see, you don’t have support!"
At this moment, Lin Fan received a message from Feng Ruolan.
The message was brief: Done.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "The company’s second-largest shareholder, Yunxin Company, is not present, is it? Yunxin holds 11%, and if they support me, the decision can pass."
Zhang Jing confidently said, "That’s the logic, but do you think Yunxin Company will support you? You’re dreaming!"
"I support Mr. Lin!"
At this moment, a voice said, as a middle-aged man walked in.
Everyone looked and saw it was Zheng Fugui, the head of Yunxin Company, and was surprised.
Yunxin Company actually supports Lin Fan; has Zheng Fugui lost his mind?

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Lin Fan must be bragging, right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 255: Lin Fan must be bragging, right?
Zheng Fugui, in his fifties, dressed in everyday attire, looked plain and ordinary. On the street, he would just be an average middle-aged man.
However, Zheng Fugui was known for his love of dressing well, usually sporting designer brands when he stepped out. His current appearance could only mean he rushed here in a hurry without time to dress up!
Who knows what happened to him, but as soon as he arrived, he directly expressed his support for Lin Fan!
It’s important to note that Yunxin Company, controlled by Zheng Fugui, is currently the second-largest shareholder of Huaxin, holding 11% of the shares. His stance directly determines the direction of the current issue.
According to Zhang Jing’s understanding of Zheng Fugui, Zheng Fugui should not be supporting Lin Fan!
What on earth is going on?
Zhang Jing couldn’t help but say, "Old Zheng, what are you talking about? Do you know what Lin Fan plans to do? He’s going to ruin the company!"
Zheng Fugui gave Zhang Jing a cold glance and said, "I vote how I please. Whatever Mr. Lin decides, I stand with Mr. Lin."
He didn’t explain the reason or rather had no desire to explain it.
Zhang Jing, both angry and anxious, said, "Zheng Fugui, you’re out of your mind! How can you support him like this? You’ll ruin the company!"
Zheng Fugui said indifferently, "My mind is made up, Chairman Zhang. Save your breath."
Zheng Fugui’s attitude was so resolute that nothing seemed to be able to shake him.
Even Lin Fan was curious about how Feng Ruolan managed to win over Zheng Fugui. He’d have to ask his sister later.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I now have 41% support. The decision is made to change from not supporting Zhongwei to publicly backing Zhongwei!"
Zhang Jing’s face turned white, and he stammered, "Lin Fan, why are you doing this? If this is because of what happened last night and you want revenge on me, you can just come at me, but you can’t damage the company’s interests this way!"
All the shareholders became despondent, and they all began to urge Lin Fan to retract his decision.
Now that Lin Fan had Zheng Fugui’s backing, he essentially controlled 41% of the decision-making power of the company, which was almost absolute control. As long as Lin Fan maintained 41% support with Zheng Fugui, he could pass any decision!
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for completing the task to change the decision!"
"Task: Change Huaxin Company’s decision.
Importance: Ordinary.
Progress: 100/100.
Status: Completed."
At this point, the system sent out a notice.
Lin Fan successfully took control of Huaxin Company by teaming up with Zheng Fugui.
The system task was declared complete!
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, task completed, special reward granted: Top-level chip manufacturing technology, please accept."
A stream of information flooded into Lin Fan’s mind.
Information about top-level chip manufacturing technology was absorbed by Lin Fan!
Lin Fan was elated inside.
This reward is incredible! Top-level chip manufacturing technology, this is skyrocketing!
In fact, during the debate with Zhang Jing earlier, Lin Fan felt very uncertain, even somewhat guilty, speaking of trying hard to improve their own technology to replace the supply from the United States was indeed passionate but also a bit naive.
Because if chip technology could be improved that easily, there wouldn’t have been a need to rely on foreign imports for so many years.
Lin Fan forcibly passed the decision in order to complete the system task.
He had long anticipated that no shareholder would support him, and to pass the decision, he had to win over Yunxin Company, the second-largest shareholder.
Fortunately, Feng Ruolan helped him secure the support of Yunxin Company’s boss, Zheng Fugui.
Now that the system rewarded top-level chip manufacturing technology, Lin Fan could finally relax.
With this technology, Huaxin wouldn’t have to be constrained by the United States anymore and could freely pursue major achievements. Lin Fan went from feeling guilty to feeling justified in an instant.
The others didn’t know about Lin Fan’s extraordinary reward, and there were groans all around, with everyone feeling downhearted.
"It’s over. Huaxin is doomed this time!"
"Once the new announcement is out, it’s sure to anger the US and cut off our supply!"
"Everyone pack up and get ready to sleep under the bridge!"
"This is going to kill us!"
People repeatedly muttered pessimistic remarks.
Zhang Jing still couldn’t accept the reality, he even considered kneeling before Lin Fan, begging Lin Fan to change his mind.
"Mr. Lin, please, I’m begging you, I apologize for last night’s events. I can kneel and admit my mistakes if you want, but can you retract your decision?"
Zhang Jing tried his best to lower his stance.
With Lin Fan holding all the power, he had no choice but to swallow his pride.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m sorry, I’ve decided to do this, and there’s no changing it. Zhang Jing, if you don’t support my decision, you might consider resigning as chairman."
Zhang Jing shuddered, it was happening, Lin Fan was finally going after him!
He knew it, Lin Fan was coming for him specifically!
Thump!
Zhang Jing knelt down: "Mr. Lin, I admit my mistakes, okay? I know I was wrong, I shouldn’t have insulted you and Miss Feng last night. I won’t ever do it again. Please, show some mercy, spare Huaxin Company! Once your decision is made public, Huaxin will be doomed!"
Lin Fan was a bit taken aback and said, "I’m really not targeting you. Last night, you indeed offended my sister, but I’m not going to go to great lengths just to teach you a lesson."
The implication was that Zhang Jing wasn’t worth such an effort.
But Zhang Jing wouldn’t believe it: "Mr. Lin, you’re targeting me. How about this, you can deal with me however you want, do whatever you like, fire me from being chairman, I don’t mind, but please spare Huaxin Company."
Apart from Zheng Fugui, all the shareholders knelt down, begging.
"Mr. Lin, please retract your decision!"
"Mr. Lin, you can’t do this!"
"Mr. Lin, this will ruin Huaxin!"
The scene brought sweat to Lin Fan’s forehead. He only intended to lighten the mood after obtaining the top chip manufacturing technology, unaware it would terrify all the shareholders.
"Alright, let me say something serious!"
Lin Fan cleared his throat and continued, "I understand everyone’s concerns. You’re all afraid of offending the US and having them stop supplying us with equipment, but as I just said, we shouldn’t be so beholden to the US, watching their every move. That’s why we need to improve our technology."
Zhang Jing was on the verge of tears: "Mr. Lin, as I’ve said, improving technology isn’t something that can be done overnight, plus research requires a vast amount of funding. The company doesn’t have that kind of money, nor that much time!"
Lin Fan gave a slight smile, "What if I say I have the technology?"
Everyone looked at each other in bewilderment.
Zhang Jing asked, "Mr. Lin, what do you mean by that? You have the technology?"
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right, I have high-end chip manufacturing technology. Based on this technology, we can develop our own production equipment, no longer needing to buy from others, and henceforth, we don’t have to be wary of others’ perceptions. Furthermore, this technology will propel Huaxin to the forefront of the world."
Everyone was stunned, looking at Lin Fan as if he were a lunatic. This had to be bragging, right?
Right?
He must be bragging!

chapters.title: Chapter 256: With This Technology, Everyone Must Kneel!
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 256: With This Technology, Everyone Must Kneel!
No one believed Lin Fan’s words at all.
Currently, the company with the most advanced chip manufacturing technology is TSMC, capable of mass-producing 5nm chips, achieved with over ten thousand research personnel, making it unrivaled among chip companies worldwide.
Huaxin is even further behind.
Huaxin currently has only 1,000 research personnel and can only mass-produce 14nm chips, relying on imported equipment and technology from the United States.
Even so, Huaxin is currently the most top-notch chip manufacturing company in Huaxia, apart from TSMC.
This shows how backward Huaxia’s chip manufacturing technology is.
Even with significant national financial and human resource investment, catching up to the world’s advanced level is extremely difficult; the process of catching up is very long and even quite uncertain.
Currently, there is only one company in the world that can compete with TSMC, but it is not in Huaxia, nor is it Huaxin.
In this context, Lin Fan claimed that he had chip manufacturing technology that could replace U.S. suppliers and even surpass TSMC, leading the world, so naturally, no one would believe it.
Because those familiar with the situation know this is simply impossible.
This boast has truly reached the sky.
"Mr. Lin, do you believe what you just said?" Zhang Jing wiped his cold sweat and asked.
Everyone else was also sweating, not expecting Huaxin Company’s largest shareholder to be such a person. With such a person in control of the company, the company was probably doomed.
Zhang Jing became more convinced that Lin Fan was here to destroy Huaxin.
Lin Fan is too terrifying. To destroy Huaxin, he even became the largest shareholder. Even if he has money, there’s no need to be this capricious, right?
Lin Fan remained calm and said, "If I really have the technology, who in the company understands technology the best? Invite them over, and I’ll discuss it with them."
Everyone looked at each other, wondering why Lin Fan was so calm if he was just bragging. Did he really mean to confront a technical expert? Wouldn’t that cause him to crash?
Zhang Jing said, "No need to look for someone else. I am the chief engineer. Mr. Lin can talk to me about technology."
Zhang Jing spoke with a hint of sarcasm, feeling that Lin Fan, trying to show off, would soon be unable to keep it up.
Although Zhang Jing was the chairman, he came from a technical background and was indeed Huaxin’s chief engineer. He fully represented Huaxin’s highest technical level, and only he was qualified to talk with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan responded, "Okay then, I’ll talk to you about 5nm chip technology..."
Lin Fan began to talk about the top-tier chip manufacturing technology he had just acquired, using all professional terminology and complex technical data.
Those present who did not understand technology listened in confusion, unable to follow along, each displaying a look of subconscious awe.
At first, Zhang Jing listened with disdain, ready to hear Lin Fan’s nonsense. As he listened, Zhang Jing straightened his posture and became engrossed.
As it continued, Zhang Jing was drenched in cold sweat.
By the end of Lin Fan’s talk, the crowd suddenly realized that Zhang Jing had knelt.
He was truly kneeling, filled with excitement.
What?
Everyone was shocked; they all wondered what Lin Fan had said to make Zhang Jing kneel?
"Lin Fan must be outrageous; the chairman couldn’t take it anymore, pleading for him to stop talking."
Everyone thought so.
"Mr. Lin, you truly possess top-tier chip technology. Please accept my reverence!" Zhang Jing excitedly bowed to Lin Fan.
Everyone was dumbfounded, puzzled at what was happening here.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Do you believe me now?"
Zhang Jing nodded, "Mr. Lin, your technology is absolutely world-leading. My God, how did you come to possess such advanced technology?"
Zhang Jing was simultaneously in indescribable admiration and growing curiosity.
The chip manufacturing technology that Lin Fan had just described to him, he could affirm, was absolutely world-leading. Even TSMC’s technology would be slightly inferior!
In fact, chip manufacturing is an intricate technology that relies on a precision device called a lithography machine, a piece of equipment currently unavailable in Huaxia and instead must be imported.
The more intricate the chip, the more it depends on a lithography machine. A 5nm chip is currently utterly dependent on it, even for TSMC, which possesses the most advanced technology.
However, the 5nm chip technology Lin Fan just described could do away with the lithography machine!
With this technology, there is no need to import equipment from abroad, and mass production of 5nm chips can be realized.
No wonder Zhang Jing knelt down.
With this technology, anyone would kneel!
What Zhang Jing did not know was that the technology Lin Fan had just described was not even the most advanced. The system had rewarded Lin Fan with top-tier chip manufacturing technology, and this 5nm technology was just the lowest level among them...
And this lowest level was already the most advanced in the world...
Lin Fan was not fully aware of the world chip technology and, hearing Zhang Jing speak like this, he curiously asked, "Oh, is this already world-leading? Can it defeat the top-ranked company?"
Zhang Jing, sweating, said, "Of course it can, Mr. Lin. Did you not know this was world-leading?"
Lin Fan replied, "I didn’t know. I just picked the simplest one to tell you. I have even more powerful technologies..."
Zhang Jing was astonished.
What?
Lin Fan had even more advanced technology than the one he just mentioned?
This shock was truly significant.
What kind of existence was Lin Fan? An alien, possessing technology that surpassed the Earth?
Now Zhang Jing no longer thought Lin Fan was bluffing, for Lin Fan had already proven himself. Just the technology he had just mentioned was already world-leading!
Zhang Jing had every reason to believe that Lin Fan possessed even more advanced technology.
What is a technology more advanced than 5nm?
4nm.
3nm.
2nm.
1nm.
Even science fiction-like quantum chips...
Upon thinking of this, Zhang Jing knelt thoroughly, kneeling obediently.
"Mr. Lin, please accept my knees. Earlier, I was blind to your greatness and offended you. I hope you can forgive me. As long as you allow me to stay by your side, I’m willing to do anything." Zhang Jing implored.
His only wish now was to stay and work for Lin Fan. He had realized that as long as he followed Lin Fan, unlimited potential awaited, and he would learn things he couldn’t elsewhere.
In his judgment, Huaxin Company was destined to become the strongest chip company in the world, surpassing TSMC, with the only question being time, and it wouldn’t be long.
This was previously unthinkable; now it was certain.
Lin Fan felt a bit of a chill. Zhang Jing was too exaggerative, and besides, what could he do with a middle-aged man?
However, this new fanboy of his was somewhat useful for Huaxin Company. From his earlier arguments with Lin Fan, it could be seen that Zhang Jing was indeed very loyal to the company.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I said from the beginning, I’m not here for you; I’m here to change the company’s decisions. Do you agree with my decision now?"
Zhang Jing immediately said, "I agree. Mr. Lin’s decision was so right; we were foolish before!"
At this point, everyone could be sure that Lin Fan truly possessed the most advanced chip technology in the world!
Huaxin had indeed freed itself from the constraints of the United States!
Subsequently, Huaxin Company swiftly issued an announcement, strongly declaring that it would support Zhongwei Company in manufacturing high-end chips!
The news shook the entire nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Worldwide Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 257: Worldwide Shock
Zhongwei Phone Company.
After Huaxin Company’s announcement was released in the morning, Zhongwei Company quickly convened a high-level meeting to discuss countermeasures.
Zhongwei Company had reached out to Huaxin Company in the past, attempting to seek help from Huaxin, but had never received a reply.
This announcement from Huaxin served as a response to Zhongwei, which also meant that Zhongwei’s only hope was dashed.
Without the support of Huaxin Company, Zhongwei Company completely lost hope.
The atmosphere of the meeting was extremely heavy, with all the senior executives of Zhongwei Company bowing their heads in silence.
Sitting at the head of the table, Xu Guojun, the Chairman of Zhongwei Phone, said, "The situation is clear to everyone. Huaxin has clearly stated that they will not support us. Our chip supply will be completely cut off. The priority now is how to deal with this crisis?"
After some whispering among the attendees.
Someone suggested, "Why don’t we talk to Huaxin Company again, perhaps plead with them?"
Xu Guojun shook his head, "It’s useless. I actually anticipated that Huaxin Company would refuse to support us. Huaxin’s technology requires imports. They’re definitely afraid to help us."
Once again, everyone fell into silence. Xu Guojun’s words effectively blocked the last glimmer of hope.
Xu Guojun continued, "Right now, we need to explain to the outside world and stabilize morale, but more importantly, solve the company’s predicament. There are essentially two paths. One is to deplete our chip inventory, leading to the company’s closure, where we wait for doom together. The other is self-reliance, finding a way to produce chips ourselves."
Making chips on our own, how easy is that!
Zhongwei simply didn’t possess the technology. Starting from scratch was mostly a pipe dream.
Subsequently, Zhongwei Company issued a statement explaining Zhongwei’s current predicament and announcing that Zhongwei would not give up hope and would continue to seek solutions.
The announcement drew widespread sighs online.
Simultaneously, netizens grew increasingly furious with Huaxin Company, initiating a wave of criticism against Huaxin.
"Zhongwei is having it too hard, Huaxin, you are heartless!"
"Huaxin Company might as well shut down!"
"Why is Huaxin doing this? Can’t it help Zhongwei?"
Amidst the jeers, Huaxin Company’s stock continued to drop. Not even by noon, and in just one morning, 20% of its market value had evaporated!
This incident quickly trended online.
"Serves them right!"
"That’s what you get for not helping Zhongwei!"
"Hurry up and go bankrupt, Huaxin!"
"Keep falling, let them feel the pain!"
Seeing Huaxin’s stock price plummet, the internet was abuzz with glee.
However, it wasn’t long before.
Huaxin Company’s second announcement came unexpectedly.
Huaxin Company stated that the morning’s announcement was a mistake. After careful consideration, Huaxin Company had decided to fully support Zhongwei and help Zhongwei overcome the difficulties.
Once again, the announcement exploded online.
It drew the attention and discussion of all sectors of society.
People were bewildered.
Why did Huaxin Company change its mind?
"Am I seeing things? Huaxin decided to support Zhongwei again? Such a big company acting like a joke?"
"Isn’t this fake? But it is from the official account, I can’t understand."
"Haha, must be terrified of the plummeting stock price, so they’re trying to make it up!"
"This Huaxin is funny, but at least they made the right decision!"
"No matter what, Huaxin did well this time, I won’t criticize anymore."
There were various discussions online, some were skeptical, some made fun of, and some ridiculed, but gradually, the tone shifted.
Regardless of the reason, Huaxin supporting Zhongwei could win people’s hearts.
After the second announcement, Huaxin Company’s stock price began to crawl upwards.
However, some had different opinions.
A blogger named "Technology Emperor" stated, "In my view, Huaxin is courting disaster. Huaxin previously rejected Zhongwei for a reason. Huaxin’s technology relies on imports, changing their mind now is bound to offend people!"
Upon seeing this evaluation, netizens began a heated discussion.
"Is that really the case!"
"Oh, you know it all!"
"Are you some expert?"
"Then why was Huaxin afraid before, and now they’re not?"
Technology Emperor responded, "Huaxin’s decision makers aren’t clear-headed anymore. Seeing the stock price fall, they panicked, but this is simply drinking poison to quench thirst!"
Netizens were half convinced by the words of Technology Emperor.
Like Technology Emperor, Huawei chairman Xu Guojun was also puzzled.
Upon learning of Huaxin’s change of mind, Xu Guojun was immensely surprised, "What’s going on? Is Huaxin courting disaster?"
Xu Guojun immediately decided to personally visit Huaxin Company to understand the situation.
It wasn’t long before, in response to Huaxin’s second announcement, the suppliers issued a response.
The decision was to stop providing equipment and technology to Huaxin Company.
Lacking the imported equipment and technology, Huaxin Company would lose the ability to produce chips, equating to having their legs cut off, unable to walk.
The opposing party stated that Huaxin Company still had an opportunity to correct their mistake. As long as they corrected it, the other party would resume supplies to Huaxin. But if Huaxin insisted on going their own way, it would completely anger the other party.
Technology Emperor’s words were confirmed, and there was an uproar online.
"Oh my god, it turns out Huaxin Company’s technology really requires imports, no wonder they previously rejected Zhongwei."
"I feel a bit sorry for Huaxin now!"
"If Huaxin upsets the other party, isn’t it a dead end for them!"
"Huaxin knows they’ll face death and still chooses to stand firm, suddenly it feels touching, what’s going on?"
At this moment, Huaxin Company rapidly released their third announcement of the day, boldly responding.
The announcement stated that Huaxin has already achieved technological breakthroughs and no longer needs to import equipment and technology, hence the threat from the other party is of no use, and the other party can play on their own.
Huaxin will soon begin construction on a 5nm chip factory, and will accept orders from customers worldwide, including Zhongwei.
With this third announcement, the trending topics exploded again, and it was an unprecedented explosion.
It instantly became a national sensation.
The whole country was shaken!
And soon, the news spread worldwide, shocking the world!
"What? Huaxin Company is going to build a 5nm chip factory? Did I hear that right?"
"Isn’t TSMC currently the only one capable of mass-producing 5nm?"
"When did Huaxin become so formidable?"
"Overtaking in a corner? What’s going on, is Huaxin silent and then explosively spectacular?"
For a time, Huaxin Company became the focus of the world.
At this time, Zhongwei Company Chairman Xu Guojun stepped into the doors of Huaxin Company to personally visit Huaxin.
Subsequently, Xu Guojun met Lin Fan, the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company.
Xu Guojun was stunned, "Mr. Lin, could he be the recently rising young tycoon? Gosh, Mr. Lin actually made a move on Huaxin? Could Huaxin’s change of mind be related to Mr. Lin?"
The changes in Huaxin Company’s ownership quickly attracted external attention, and Lin Fan became the focus immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Mr. Lin Has Probably Already Reached the Realm of Returning to Simplicity
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 258: Mr. Lin Has Probably Already Reached the Realm of Returning to Simplicity
Chairman of Zhongwei, Xu Guojun, personally came to Huaxin Company, and was received personally by Huaxin’s Chairman, Zhang Jing.
"Mr. Zhang, Huaxin is willing to lend a hand. On behalf of Zhongwei Company, I thank you, Mr. Zhang!" Xu Guojun sincerely said.
Zhang Jing smiled and said, "How can we not help one of our own? Our Huaxin has this capability, and it’s our duty."
Xu Guojun hesitated for a moment and said, "Regarding this... forgive my frankness, your company’s third announcement stated that your company can now mass-produce 5nm chips. Is this true?"
Xu Guojun’s concern was not unfounded. He knew Huaxin’s technology needed imports. Now Huaxin claims to have achieved a technological breakthrough and no longer relies on foreign imports.
This leap forward is simply astonishing, making it hard not to suspect it’s false.
Perhaps Huaxin is doing this to salvage the downtrend in the stock market and boost the stock price?
If that’s the case, then Zhongwei is celebrating too early.
This is precisely why Xu Guojun came over personally to understand the situation.
Zhang Jing chuckled and said, "I understand Mr. Xu’s concerns, but I can assure Mr. Xu that we are not making false claims. Our technology has truly broken through, and we are soon going to set up a 5nm chip factory."
Xu Guojun curiously asked, "Based on my knowledge of chip technology, the most advanced technology is at TSMC. But even TSMC still needs to import lithography machines, yet your company’s chip technology claims to not depend on imports?"
Zhang Jing proudly said, "That’s right, our chip technology does not require a lithography machine to produce 5nm chips. We can say that our technology has surpassed TSMC’s."
Xu Guojun was greatly shocked, "What? Surpassed TSMC? How is that possible?"
It’s almost unbelievable. There is a huge gap between Huaxin and TSMC. Huaxin only holds a 5% market share, whereas TSMC has over 50%, ten times that of Huaxin.
TSMC’s R&D strength is also ten times that of Huaxin.
No matter how you look at it, it’s hard to believe that Huaxin could overtake TSMC because, under normal circumstances, it’s simply impossible.
Zhang Jing must be boasting!
Zhang Jing said, "Mr. Xu, you may not know, initially, our Huaxin indeed could not surpass TSMC. Under normal circumstances, even given ten years, we couldn’t. But this time, our Huaxin met a benefactor who brought a world-leading technology."
Xu Guojun curiously asked, "A benefactor?"
Zhang Jing smiled and said, "That’s right. Soon, we will announce externally that there is a change in our company’s equity structure. Currently, our company’s largest shareholder has changed, and this largest shareholder is our benefactor."
Xu Guojun asked, "Which company could develop chip technology that leads TSMC’s? Could it be..."
This new largest shareholder of Huaxin Company, Xu Guojun speculated, should be a company, and a high-tech company at that. In this world, the only company that can compete with TSMC head-to-head is a foreign company...
Zhang Jing shook his head, "It’s not a company; it’s a person. Perhaps Mr. Xu has heard of him, Lin Fan, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan!
Xu Guojun was stunned for a moment, then thought of something, and said in surprise, "Could it be that recently arisen young billionaire, Mr. Lin? My God, Mr. Lin actually took action on Huaxin?"
The wealth of Lin Fan has already spread in the business world. Anyone mixed in the business circle more or less has heard about Lin Fan’s deeds.
This 21-year-old young man has recently been investing crazily in Yun City, buying companies, land, and buildings as if buying cabbages.
How many people in the world can be as wealthy as Lin Fan? Anyone who hears of him would be amazed.
Lin Fan acquired Celestial Aviation, and within a few days, its market value soared from 50 billion to 90 billion!
Lin Fan bought Zhou Tian Mansion, which cannot be bought without hundreds of billions...
Now, this Mr. Lin actually set his sights on the 500 billion enterprise Huaxin Company?
And in one move, became Huaxin’s largest shareholder?
My God!
Xu Guojun felt like his whole family was shocked.
Subsequently, Xu Guojun learned that although Lin Fan is the largest shareholder, he is not the controlling shareholder, only holding 30% of the shares, which allowed him to breathe a little easier.
If Lin Fan had controlled Huaxin, it would be terrifying.
Xu Guojun thought about it and had a doubt.
He knew Lin Fan was rich, but Lin Fan was not just rich, he also brought the world’s leading chip technology!
Where did Lin Fan’s technology come from?
"Mr. Zhang, may I visit Mr. Lin?" Xu Guojun asked, his demeanor becoming very respectful.
Although Zhongwei is a super company in Huaxia, at this moment, Zhongwei places its hopes on Huaxin, and Lin Fan is the key of keys, so he naturally dare not slight him.
Zhang Jing smiled and said, "Mr. Xu is in good timing. Mr. Lin personally crossed the river today and came to the company. He is currently still in the company, chatting and laughing with the shareholders."
Huaxin Company is not in Yun City, nor does it belong to Jiangnan City, but is in North of the River, Jiang City.
Jiang City is just across the river from Yun City.
Today, after Lin Fan became the largest shareholder of Huaxin, Huaxin’s board secretary He Xini personally went to Yun City and brought Lin Fan over the river.
Lin Fan is simply like a dragon descending from the heavens, saving Huaxin from fire and water, and also saved Zhongwei.
A dragon crossing a river!
Xu Guojun thought of this phrase, which is just perfect for Lin Fan.
Introduced by Zhang Jing, Xu Guojun met Lin Fan.
Although Xu Guojun had already heard that Lin Fan was just a 21-year-old young man, he was still surprised when he met Lin Fan in person.
Lin Fan was really too young and extremely handsome. If he were said to be a rising star, it would be entirely believable.
However, Lin Fan’s attire was really simple, all market stall goods!
"This Mr. Lin must have reached the realm of returning to simplicity!"
Seeing Lin Fan’s market stall goods, Xu Guojun was filled with respect, imagining that only those beyond mundane concerns reach such heights, unfettered by appearances.
Lin Fan wearing market stall goods is precisely a manifestation of the highest realm!
If Lin Fan knew what others thought, he might burst out laughing.
"Mr. Lin, hello, I am the Chairman of Zhongwei, Xu Guojun. Nice to meet you." Xu Guojun took the initiative to shake hands with Lin Fan. He, as a chairman, was somewhat nervous.
There was no other way; Lin Fan’s "realm" was too high.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Hello, Mr. Xu."
Xu Guojun said, "Mr. Lin, I heard from Mr. Zhang that you became the largest shareholder of Huaxin and brought the most advanced chip technology. Furthermore, it was you who took the lead in insisting on helping our Zhongwei. Here, on behalf of Zhongwei, I extend the highest respect and gratitude to you, Mr. Lin."
Xu Guojun bowed to Lin Fan in thanks.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Super Invisible Company?
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 259: Super Invisible Company?
This attitude, Lin Fan found very satisfying. Xu Guojun truly lived up to being the chairman of Zhongwei, quite adept at handling people.
In fact, Lin Fan had to ensure that Huaxin changed its decision to assist Zhongwei due to a system task.
Of course, Lin Fan also personally wanted to help Zhongwei. With Xu Guojun having such an attitude, Lin Fan felt it was worth assisting Zhongwei.
"Mr. Xu, you flatter me. It was just a small effort, not worth mentioning," Lin Fan chuckled.
Lin Fan wasn’t deliberately showing off. For him, helping Zhongwei truly was just a minor effort since such advanced chip technology was provided by the system. Importing a data stream into his mind was just a matter of seconds.
The people around all kneeled down.
Even Xu Guojun kneeled.
A small effort!
Lin Fan spoke so nonchalantly.
One should know, this task was extremely difficult. Zhongwei almost had to prepare for the fate of their phone business going bust.
And this difficult challenge, to Lin Fan, was just a small effort?
Xu Guojun couldn’t help but speculate further. What background did Lin Fan have? Owning world-leading chip technology meant there had to be a high-tech company backing him!
What company could this be?
This question, Xu Guojun dared not ask Lin Fan because Lin Fan, this time, invested in Huaxin Company in a personal capacity rather than in the name of the backing company, indicating Lin Fan intended to conceal this company.
Given this, Xu Guojun wisely chose not to ask too much. Asking might even offend Lin Fan.
He couldn’t ask, but this couldn’t stop Xu Guojun from speculating.
There’s only one known company in the world that could rival TSMC!
But this company is also a competitor of Zhongwei, with no reason to assist Zhongwei, so it can be ruled out.
If it’s not this company, could it be that there’s an unknown high-tech company in the world?
Such a thing is not impossible, just like how there are invisible tycoons in the world. If there’s an invisible super company, it’s understandable.
Heavens, could it be that Lin Fan is from this mysterious invisible company?
Xu Guojun kneeled, becoming increasingly respectful toward Lin Fan.
After all, there were rumors outside that Lin Fan’s identity was very mysterious. It was even said before that Lin Fan was from the Kyoto Lin Family. Recently, Mortal Group stated that Lin Fan had an uncle named Lin Beixuan.
This mysterious Mr. Lin Beixuan must represent the forces behind Lin Fan.
That is the mysterious super invisible company!
Lin Fan never imagined that his casual humble remark would cause Xu Guojun to weave such an elaborate story, even involving an invisible company.
Luckily Lin Fan couldn’t read minds, or else he might burst out laughing on the spot.
Xu Guojun said, "Mr. Lin, I heard from Mr. Zhang that your company has already begun preparations to build a 5nm chip factory?"
Lin Fan nodded and said, "That’s correct."
Concerning this 5nm chip factory, Lin Fan had a plan. This factory would not belong to Huaxin but to Mortal Group, entirely under Lin Fan’s control and in partnership with Huaxin.
Once this plan is made public, it’s anticipated that Mortal Group’s stock price would increase even further...
Xu Guojun smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, I wonder when it will be convenient for us to discuss signing a contract. If Zhongwei could become your company’s first client, it would be a great honor."
He initially still doubted the authenticity of this chip technology, but after meeting Lin Fan, he was eager to cooperate.
Lin Fan replied, "As for discussing cooperation, Mr. Xu can talk to Old Zhang. He is more experienced. I just need to review it."
"Alright, Mr. Lin," Xu Guojun said.
Zhang Jing and a group from Huaxin were all internally delighted. The 5nm chip factory hadn’t even started building, yet it had already secured a major client. Truly a cause for celebration!
Everyone was immensely impressed with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan seemed to possess some sort of magic. After just a brief conversation with him, Xu Guojun was already won over.
Having concluded matters there, Lin Fan planned to leave.
"It’s not early anymore. This dragon crossing the river should head back across," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Afterwards, Lin Fan bade farewell to everyone and left Huaxin Company.
The crowd respectfully escorted Lin Fan off.
Xu Guojun watched Lin Fan’s dashing silhouette, secretly wiping cold sweat. This Mr. Lin was truly astonishingly capable. He was only 21; who knows what great achievements he would make in the future.
Incalculable!
Thinking of the "super invisible company" behind Lin Fan, Xu Guojun bowed in respect, feeling a bit of awe.
Lin Fan walked out of Huaxin Company’s headquarters and was about to take the Bentley back to Yun City.
"Mr. Lin, please wait!"
Suddenly, someone called out to Lin Fan from behind.
Lin Fan turned to see that the caller was Zheng Fugui from Yunxin Company, Huaxin’s second-largest shareholder.
Today, Lin Fan was able to change Huaxin’s decision and successfully complete the system task thanks to the assistance of Zheng Fugui.
"Mr. Zheng," Lin Fan smiled and said, "I haven’t yet thanked you."
Zheng Fugui approached Lin Fan and respectfully said, "Please don’t say that, Mr. Lin. I don’t deserve it. Today, I only did my best. Actually, I have a favor to ask."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "What is it?"
Zheng Fugui smiled wryly and said, "Miss Feng found me today and asked me to cooperate with you. I’ve done that, so I hope when you return, you could speak a good word for me with Miss Feng and let me off."
Lin Fan was surprised and couldn’t help but feel curious. How on earth did the richest lady deal with Zheng Fugui? Zheng Fugui seemed to be in a rather miserable position...
Lin Fan wasn’t sure what was going on and could only respond with casual promises.
Afterwards, Lin Fan bid farewell to Zheng Fugui, then got into the Bentley, crossed the river, and returned to Yun City.
Lin Fan called Feng Ruolan: "Sister, where are you? I’m ready to return to Yun City, shall I come and find you?"
Feng Ruolan said, "I’m still at home waiting for you. I just want to see you too, come over."
Feng Ruolan’s billion-dollar mansion.
Feng Ruolan was still dressed in the clothes from the morning, sitting on the living room sofa.
Since Lin Fan was picked up by Huaxin Company’s car, Feng Ruolan’s attention was focused on this event.
Huaxin had changed its decision and decided to support Zhongwei.
Huaxin issued multiple announcements, declaring it had broken through 5nm technology and would build a chip factory...
These news left Feng Ruolan very shocked, especially the latter one.
In fact, this latter piece of news had even shocked the world.
How could Huaxin possibly break through 5nm technology?
Feng Ruolan thought of one possibility. It must be Lin Fan’s work. As for the truth of it, she would have to ask Lin Fan to know.
When Lin Fan met Feng Ruolan, it was already the afternoon.
Feng Ruolan came forward to meet him.
"You finally made it. I asked Aunt Cui to heat up the meal a bit. You surely haven’t eaten yet, and neither have I. Come on, let’s eat and talk," Feng Ruolan said, holding Lin Fan’s hand.
Lin Fan nodded and followed Feng Ruolan to the dining table.
Feng Ruolan looked Lin Fan over and smiled, "Little Fan, have you noticed? This morning when we parted, we were dressed like this. Meeting again, we’re still dressed like this. But in those few hours apart, you’ve changed the world."
Lin Fan paused, then couldn’t help but laugh. It did seem like that was the case.
Feng Ruolan said, "Little Fan, this is truly astonishing. What exactly happened? Can you tell me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Darling, Are You Dating Someone?
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 260: Darling, Are You Dating Someone?
Ever since learning that Lin Fan had acquired 30% of Huaxin’s shares, becoming its largest shareholder, Feng Ruolan made a point of understanding chip technology.
Currently, the most advanced chip technology in the world is TSMC’s 5nm technology.
And Lin Fan, surprisingly owns technology that surpasses TSMC?
How could that be possible?
Feng Ruolan even thought, could it be Lin Fan’s bluff to fool people?
"Little Fan, what exactly is going on? Can you tell me?" Feng Ruolan asked.
Lin Fan said, "To be honest, sister, I do have world-leading chip technology, but it wasn’t developed by me, it was given to me by my uncle."
He couldn’t mention the system, so he had to bring up that fictitious uncle again.
Feng Ruolan was surprised: "Your uncle Lin Beixuan?"
Lin Fan had only recently announced that his wealth came from a mysterious tycoon, Mr. Lin, also known as Lin Beixuan.
Lin Fan didn’t reveal Lin Beixuan’s exact identity, only saying that the mysterious "Mr. Lin" would be coming to Yun City soon.
Lin Fan nodded: "Yes."
Feng Ruolan couldn’t help but be curious: "Little Fan, what kind of immortal is this uncle of yours? Besides being super rich, he even has such high-end technology, yet the business world has never heard of him. I consider myself well-acquainted with the business world, but I’ve never heard of him either? Could he be from Samsung Company?"
Samsung Company, a super company from Han Country, is the only one in the world that can rival TSMC in chip technology, and that’s this Samsung Company.
Lin Beixuan being able to come up with such impressive chip technology, Feng Ruolan’s first thought was, could Lin Beixuan be associated with Samsung Company?
Lin Fan said, "I don’t know about that, uncle just gives me money to spend and orders me to do things, he never told me anything else."
Feng Ruolan, however, denied her own guess: "But that can’t be right, if it were Samsung, there’d be no reason to give such advanced technology to Huaxin, why not use it themselves! But if it’s not Samsung, then what..."
Feng Ruolan thought, could it be a secret underground company?
This guess felt a bit far-fetched to Feng Ruolan, so she didn’t say it out loud.
Lin Fan said, "I don’t know any of this, I’ll ask my uncle next time I see him."
Lin Fan was secretly sweating, he certainly wouldn’t reveal the existence of the system, but with his sister’s questioning, he didn’t know how to answer, he could only evade.
Seeing Lin Fan at a loss, Feng Ruolan didn’t press further.
No matter what, she was at least sure of one thing, Lin Fan wasn’t lying, he truly had chip technology.
As long as this point was certain, Feng Ruolan was relieved, with technology in hand, the world was hers!
With this technology, Lin Fan could absolutely change the world.
Afraid she’d keep asking, Lin Fan changed the subject, saying, "By the way, sister, I haven’t asked you yet, how did you deal with Zheng Fugui?"
When he left Huaxin, Zheng Fugui came seeking help, he has always been curious about this matter.
Feng Ruolan smiled and said, "It’s simple, I have dirt on him that would make him restless, if he didn’t agree with me, I’d expose him."
Lin Fan sweated, his wealthy sister was really a bit ruthless, the system gave him this wealthy sister as a reward, she was definitely his lucky star.
Lin Fan’s feelings for Feng Ruolan were very complex.
Only he knew, Feng Ruolan’s identity as a sister was a system reward, he was just playing the role of a brother.
From the role perspective, he should consider Feng Ruolan as a real sister, but deep down, Lin Fan admired Feng Ruolan, she was really beautiful, irresistibly charming, Lin Fan found it hard not to be moved...
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, pulling himself together, he said, "When I left, Zheng Fugui approached me, asking me to speak well of him to you."
Feng Ruolan laughed: "Alright, since he helped you, I’ll let him off, after all, he’s now a major shareholder of Huaxin just like you, for your sake."
Feng Ruolan was indeed a brother-protecting maniac, always thinking of Lin Fan.
The two chatted while eating, and with matters discussed, they were about done eating too.
Feng Ruolan asked: "Little Fan, do you have other things to do this afternoon? If not, stay and keep me company, I’m off today."
Because of the Huaxin matter, Feng Ruolan specifically canceled all her appointments for the day.
Lin Fan knew his sister was usually very busy, but today she was at home all day entirely for him.
Touched, Lin Fan couldn’t let her down, so he smiled and said, "Sure."
Feng Ruolan was very pleased, having so much time with Lin Fan was truly rare. But then she was slightly troubled.
What should they do?
They can’t just stay home all day, they need to find something to do.
As Feng Ruolan pondered, suddenly, the doorbell rang, someone was here.
Answering the door was usually Aunt Cui’s job, but she wasn’t around, so Feng Ruolan had to go herself.
Outside the door stood a stylishly dressed pretty female, her face lit up with a bright smile, as soon as she saw Feng Ruolan, she screamed: "Surprise!"
She said it in English, meaning surprise.
Feng Ruolan was a bit stunned, truly surprised: "Xiaoxue! When did you get back?"
The two embraced each other in delight.
The fashionable girl said, "Just got back today, came straight to see you..."
The fashionable girl suddenly stopped because she saw Lin Fan in the room.
"Who’s he? Dear, have you started dating?" the fashionable girl blurted out.
At this, Feng Ruolan blushed and quickly clarified: "No, let me introduce you, he’s my younger brother, Lin Fan, Little Fan, she’s my childhood friend, Fan Xiaoxue."
Lin Fan thought to himself, a childhood friend? Why is there no memory of her at all, the system didn’t provide any information about this Fan Xiaoxue.
Fan Xiaoxue was intrigued and suspiciously said: "A brother? But he doesn’t share your last name? Could he be the Feng Family’s illegitimate child?"
Feng Ruolan awkwardly responded: "No, there’s no blood relation, he’s my sworn brother."
"A sworn brother?" Fan Xiaoxue looked at Lin Fan, who was indeed handsome, but his attire... clearly looked poor.
Fan Xiaoxue instantly lost interest in Lin Fan.
"Why did you make him your brother? He looks so poor, are you doing charity?" Fan Xiaoxue said, amusing herself and laughing.
Feng Ruolan was about to explain.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Sister, you never mentioned you had such a good friend?"
This Fan Xiaoxue offended people right off, Lin Fan wasn’t fond of it.
Feng Rulan said, "It’s like this, Xiaoxue went abroad to study a few years ago, before I knew you, so I never mentioned her to you."
Lin Fan acknowledged: "Oh, a repatriated student, no wonder she mixes her sentences with English words, very chic."
Anyone could hear that Lin Fan was mocking, ridiculing Fan Xiaoxue as neither here nor there.
Fan Xiaoxue huffed: "Lanlan, your sworn brother is such a country bumpkin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 261: The Richest Sister’s Quirky Green Tea Bestie
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 261: The Richest Sister’s Quirky Green Tea Bestie
Fan Xiaoxue initially suspected Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan had that sort of relationship, but now she had no doubts. How poor must Lanlan’s taste be to have a country bumpkin as her boyfriend.
Feng Ruolan was at a loss for whether to laugh or cry. It seemed these two didn’t quite see eye to eye. One was her little brother, the other her best friend, leaving her feeling a bit caught in the middle.
Fan Xiaoxue, linking her arm with Feng Ruolan’s, said, "Lanlan, we haven’t seen each other for ages. How about you accompany me for a shopping spree!"
Feng Ruolan replied, "Sure!"
She suddenly felt delighted. She was just fretting over having no plans to pass the time; shopping and eating sounds perfect.
"Little Fan, you come along too," Feng Ruolan added.
Lin Fan internally chuckled bitterly. He didn’t really want to accompany Fan Xiaoxue and was looking for an excuse to escape, but he also didn’t want to spoil Feng Ruolan’s mood.
"Alright," Lin Fan agreed readily.
Fan Xiaoxue cast a disdainful glance at Lin Fan. Originally, she planned to ditch Lin Fan, but on seeing he looked fit and sturdy, she changed her mind.
"He can come along too; he can help us carry things. This is my first day back in the country, and I must go on a shopping frenzy," Fan Xiaoxue said.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. "Go to hell with that, using your grandfather as a laborer!"
Feng Ruolan retreated to change into a set of everyday clothing, looking stunning beyond belief. She was like the pure and lovely next-door neighbor girl; one would never guess she was a domineering CEO.
Lin Fan’s heart raced at the sight; this woman was truly something else, too charming.
Fan Xiaoxue was also a pretty girl, but compared to Feng Ruolan, it was like heaven and earth, utterly incomparable.
Fan Xiaoxue was from the Fan Family in Yun City, which was quite a wealthy family, but still, compared to Feng Ruolan, she seemed extremely vulgar, while Feng Ruolan was like an otherworldly fairy.
The three of them then stepped out the door.
They reached outside the villa.
There they noticed an additional red Porsche, clearly driven by Fan Xiaoxue, a Porsche 718, which costs about 900,000.
Not expensive.
For Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan, it was not expensive at all.
Fan Xiaoxue seemed concerned about others thinking she was poor and proactively explained, "This car was given to me by my daddy as a homecoming gift. He told me to use it for the time being and said he’d buy me an even pricier one later."
Fan Xiaoxue, looking envious, said, "Lanlan, you are so lucky; I heard you’re already the richest woman in Yun City. You can buy any car you want. This Rolls-Royce Cullinan is stunning; I heard it costs 8 million? I’m so envious, really rich!"
Fan Xiaoxue’s gaze landed on the Rolls-Royce beside her, filled with envy. She liked it a lot.
This was Lin Fan’s car!
Fan Xiaoxue didn’t know that; she assumed it belonged to Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan was about to explain.
But Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister, why don’t we take this Cullinan out, then? I’ll drive; I happen to have the keys."
Feng Ruolan chuckled inwardly; Little Fan seemed to be planning to hide his wealthy identity, perhaps wanting to antagonize her best friend.
