Fan Xiaoxue saw Lin Fan take out the car keys and get into the Cullinan. She snorted, "This guy has such dumb luck; if it weren’t for Lanlan, would he ever get the chance to touch such a good car!"
The Rolls-Royce Cullinan carried Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan on its way.
Fan Xiaoxue, feeling a bit puzzled, drove her Porsche, following behind.
They arrived at a high-end mall.
The three of them went inside to start their shopping spree.
Fan Xiaoxue reminded Lin Fan, "Stay behind us, and don’t go into stores. Make yourself look like our servant; dressed like this, Lanlan might not be embarrassed, but I am."
The words were full of disdain towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan just gave an ’oh,’ not bothering to argue with the woman, out of consideration for Feng Ruolan.
Over the following time, the three shopped through the mall, buying things along the way. Lin Fan indeed couldn’t be bothered to enter the stores; he was not interested anyway.
Fan Xiaoxue, the wealthy girl, spent money without even blinking, clearly used to living lavishly, buying whatever she liked without bargaining.
Every time she bought something, Fan Xiaoxue would toss it to Lin Fan to carry, truly treating him as a servant. Lin Fan, again out of consideration for Feng Ruolan, temporarily put up with it. For someone who had taken the Strengthening Capsules, these things weren’t heavy, though he really didn’t want to carry Fan Xiaoxue’s things.
Lin Fan wasn’t the type to take a loss for nothing...
Just then, they arrived at the entrance of a branded women’s clothing store.
The two girls were drawn inside by the clothes.
Fan Xiaoxue excitedly said, "These clothes look so nice, Lanlan, let’s go in and have a look."
The two girls were about to enter.
From the side, a man and a woman appeared, both dressed fashionably. The man was average-looking, and the woman had an Internet Celebrity Face. They also wanted to enter the store, and the two sides almost bumped into each other.
"Oh, isn’t this Feng Ruolan and Fan Xiaoxue!" the man blurted out, pleasantly surprised.
The two girls also recognized the other party, both exclaiming, "Chen Yu!"
This Chen Yu was their university classmate!
In addition, Chen Yu was a rich family’s young master, from the Yun City Chen Family!
Chen Yu smiled and said, "Long time no see, what a coincidence to meet you here. You both came to buy clothes too?"
Chen Yu noticed Lin Fan standing behind the two girls, but seeing his shabby appearance, he assumed he was just a follower, so he paid him no mind.
Feng Ruolan smiled, "Yes."
Her manner was very appropriate, as Chen Yu was obviously there with his girlfriend, and she had no interest in him at all, considering him just an old classmate.
Fan Xiaoxue was much more enthusiastic, giggling and saying, "Yun City Chen Family’s young master, I remember how many girls chased after you in college. Even I had a crush on you for a while. I’m so envious of your girlfriend."
She giggled to herself.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. This Fan Xiaoxue really was something else.
Green Tea!
Absolutely a green tea girl.
Chen Yu’s Internet Celebrity Face girlfriend now had a slightly dark expression, quickly identifying Fan Xiaoxue as a green tea girl she found extremely irritating.
"Darling, let’s go in quickly; I’m afraid that dress will be bought by someone else," the Internet Celebrity Face pulled Chen Yu inside.
Feng Ruolan and Fan Xiaoxue also followed suit and went inside.
Lin Fan, seeing a bench outside the store, went over and sat down, watching them shop.
Once inside, Fan Xiaoxue still clung to Chen Yu, reminiscing about their university days and how he was popular with the girls.
Chen Yu and Feng Ruolan listened, feeling a bit awkward.
The Internet Celebrity Face was about to explode in anger, wishing she could kick Fan Xiaoxue away but held back for the sake of her dignity.
Lin Fan shook his head in resignation. How did the richest woman end up with such a bizarre best friend?
Quickly, the Internet Celebrity Face found a dress she liked, exclaiming, "Luckily, it’s still here."
She had brought Chen Yu specifically to buy this dress that caught her eye.
"Wow, this dress is so beautiful; I want one too," Fan Xiaoxue approached, reaching out to touch the dress, looking obsessed with it.
The Internet Celebrity Face grumpily said, "Sorry, I asked the staff; there’s only this one left."
Fan Xiaoxue lamented, "No way, a dress this nice, and there’s only one left. What to do, I want it so bad. If I can’t get it, I might lose my appetite and can’t sleep well; can you let me have it?"
Internet Celebrity Face: "..."
Thousands of grass mud horses galloped through her mind.
Fan Xiaoxue coquettishly pleaded, "Please let me have it. I really like it, Chen Yu, can’t you persuade your girlfriend?"

chapters.title: Chapter 262 Little Fan Might Have Misunderstood
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 262 Little Fan Might Have Misunderstood
Fan Xiaoxue’s green tea skills were already superb; she infuriated Chen Yu’s girlfriend, the Internet Celebrity Face, to the point of exploding, and Fan Xiaoxue actually demanded she hand over her skirt.
This skirt was first eyed by the Internet Celebrity Face, and she came specially to buy it today. How could she possibly give it to Fan Xiaoxue!
However, Fan Xiaoxue seemed to anticipate her refusal and actually went to whine to Chen Yu.
Chen Yu, reluctant to look bad in front of an old classmate, couldn’t say no and advised the Internet Celebrity Face, "Just give it to her, I’ll buy you an even better one later."
The Internet Celebrity Face was infuriated, but when Chen Yu said that, she couldn’t argue with him. After all, Chen Yu was a Rich Second Generation, and she wouldn’t want to ruin that, otherwise she’d play right into Fan Xiaoxue’s scheming hands!
The Internet Celebrity Face, puffing with anger, turned her head without speaking, clearly resigning herself to let Chen Yu handle it.
Fan Xiaoxue smiled and said, "Thanks a lot, you two are so kind."
With that, Fan Xiaoxue bluntly grabbed the skirt and went to check out.
The store clerk said, "Hello, that’s 6,800 yuan. Cash or card?"
Fan Xiaoxue pulled out a credit card and said with a warm smile, "Card, please."
Beep!
The card payment was completed, and the clerk immediately packed the skirt into a bag for Fan Xiaoxue to carry.
Seeing this, the Internet Celebrity Face, still fuming, said, "I’m a bit tired, let’s head back."
Chen Yu responded with an "Oh."
Fan Xiaoxue said with a smile, "Perfect timing, we’ve bought almost everything we need, let’s leave together."
The Internet Celebrity Face snorted unhappily and turned to walk out.
They left the store.
Fan Xiaoxue shoved the shopping bag into Lin Fan’s hands, saying, "Hold this, the skirt is expensive, it was the last one in the store, and I managed to buy it, so don’t lose it!"
She spoke as if Lin Fan were her servant.
Lin Fan, though he hadn’t entered the store moments ago, had seen Fan Xiaoxue use her green tea skills to snatch the skirt from the Internet Celebrity Face.
One must admit, shamelessness is invincible, and Fan Xiaoxue is a real piece of work.
Feng Ruolan, seeing how Fan Xiaoxue ordered Lin Fan around, quietly said apologetically to Lin Fan, "Little Fan, Xiaoxue is just like that, with her princess attitude, just put up with her, but if you really can’t, I won’t mind."
Lin Fan was delighted; even Feng Ruolan couldn’t overlook Fan Xiaoxue. He had tolerated Fan Xiaoxue because of Feng Ruolan, but now that she said it, she was implying Lin Fan needn’t bother with her anymore!
The sister is really protective, she’s too good to her brother.
Since he didn’t need to keep up appearances for Feng Ruolan, Lin Fan decided not to be courteous to Fan Xiaoxue.
They were just outside the mall.
Suddenly, they saw a mother and daughter kneeling by the roadside, begging. The mother was around forty, and the daughter was a young lady. In front of them was a piece of paper detailing their pitiful plight.
Apparently, the woman’s husband had a terminal illness, they had spent all their savings, and without money for treatment, they couldn’t even afford food anymore, so they had to beg.
The mother and daughter were in tattered clothes, looking truly pitiable.
Fan Xiaoxue’s eyes turned red upon seeing this, "How pitiful, how can there be such miserable people in the world, their clothes are even torn, makes one want to help them."
She intentionally showed her kind-hearted side in front of Chen Yu, wanting to project an image of herself as compassionate.
Chen Yu, touched, nodded, "Yeah, it’s too pitiful."
Fan Xiaoxue wiped her tears, "You think so too, oh, they are really pitiful, it makes one want to help them."
Chen Yu praised, "Xiaoxue, you have such a kind heart."
Beside them, the Internet Celebrity Face rolled her eyes; they nearly turned to the heavens. This green tea, what’s she playing at? Saying she wants to help them but not moving a muscle!
Suddenly, Lin Fan darted forward to the mother and daughter and placed the shopping bags he held in front of them.
"Auntie, Little Sister, I don’t have much to offer, seeing your clothes are torn, these clothes are for you," Lin Fan said with a smile.
The mother and daughter saw the bags full of branded clothes, each piece worth thousands.
"Thank you, benevolent sir." The woman, full of gratitude, pulled her daughter to kowtow to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need to thank me. If you want to thank someone, thank that sister over there; she’s the one who wanted to help you two."
Lin Fan pointed to Fan Xiaoxue.
The mother and daughter quickly went to Fan Xiaoxue, kneeled, and said, "Thank you kind sister, you are truly wonderful."
Fan Xiaoxue was stunned, her face twitching and her heart bleeding.
Damn it!
My Gucci...
My Miu Miu...
My Chanel...
Lin Fan just gave them all away to this mother and daughter!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister Xiaoxue, what’s wrong? They’re thanking you, after all, you’re the one who said you wanted to help them, surely you’re not having second thoughts?"
Everyone was watching Fan Xiaoxue.
Fan Xiaoxue came to her senses, forced a smile despite the pain, "Of course not, no need to thank me, please get up, I hope these things help you."
She had to maintain her facade, even if it meant putting on a brave face.
The mother and daughter, delighted, thanked her profusely and left with a pile of luxury goods. Watching their backs, Fan Xiaoxue’s heart was bleeding.
Pfft!
The Internet Celebrity Face, watching this scene, was absolutely thrilled, unable to stop her laughter, Lin Fan was too brilliant, even if it was unintentional, he gave Fan Xiaoxue a hard time, and seeing her frustrated face, the Internet Celebrity Face was overjoyed, all the prior frustration over the snatched skirt was gone.
Chen Yu praised, "Xiaoxue, you are so kind; I didn’t realize you were this good-hearted before. Thumbs up!"
Chen Yu gave Fan Xiaoxue a big thumbs-up.
"Right, we have some business to attend to, so we’ll be off, see you next time," Chen Yu said, leading the Internet Celebrity Face away.
After they left.
Fan Xiaoxue no longer needed to pretend, her face darkened, and she clenched her fists, turning to Lin Fan and roared, "Lin Fan, look what you’ve done!"
Lin Fan looked puzzled, "Sister Xiaoxue, what’s the matter, what did I do wrong?"
Fan Xiaoxue was about to cry from anger, "You damn well gave away all my things to those beggars! You clearly did it on purpose!"
Lin Fan said, "How unfair, isn’t that what you said you wanted, I just went along with what you meant, or were you just saying it for the sake of it?"
Of course, Fan Xiaoxue was just mouthing off, otherwise how would she be considered green tea.
Fan Xiaoxue turned to Feng Ruolan, "Lanlan, you judge, wasn’t he over the line!"
Feng Ruolan was secretly laughing, Little Fan was so cheeky, he really taught Fan Xiaoxue a lesson.
Feng Ruolan stifled her laughter and said, "Well, perhaps Little Fan misunderstood, Little Fan, apologize to Xiaoxue!"
Lin Fan then said, "Yes, yes, I apologize to Sister Xiaoxue, Sister Xiaoxue is magnanimous and rich too, surely this little stuff is nothing for Sister Xiaoxue, surely she wouldn’t expect me to compensate for such a trifling amount, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 263: I Really Have Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 263: I Really Have Money
Lin Fan’s apology was fake; giving Fan Xiaoxue a high hat was real.
Saying this meant if Fan Xiaoxue still asked Lin Fan for compensation, wouldn’t she seem too stingy?
Fan Xiaoxue was so angry that there was no way to argue with Lin Fan; this high hat was truly poisonous.
"Money is small change, but you’re a poor bastard. Can you even afford to pay?"
Fan Xiaoxue cursed, stomping her foot, "I’ll go buy it again!"
Turning around towards the mall, she was actually going to shop again.
Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan followed behind, Feng Ruolan shook her head, and said with a wry smile, "Little Fan, forget it, I see Xiaoxue has already had her share of suffering because of you."
Lin Fan nodded seriously, "Alright, I’ll listen to you, sis."
He wouldn’t give Fan Xiaoxue face, but he’d give Feng Ruolan face.
They entered the mall again.
The three of them walked into a Chanel store.
They had been to this store before, where Fan Xiaoxue bought a blouse. She was familiar with it now.
Approaching a clothing rack, Fan Xiaoxue pointed at a blouse and said to the clerk, "Pack this one for me."
The clerk was a bit curious, she remembered Fan Xiaoxue, hadn’t she just bought one before? Why was she buying again?
But she didn’t ask, as long as there was business to do, with a bright smile: "Okay, I’ll pack it for you right away, miss."
Soon, the blouse was packed and placed into a special shopping bag.
The clerk said, "Thank you, it totals to 18,000."
Fan Xiaoxue took out a bank card and handed it to the clerk, impatiently saying, "Hurry up."
She still had a few stores to visit.
Beep!
The clerk exclaimed, "Miss, sorry, the card transaction failed, your card has insufficient balance, could it be that you took the wrong card?"
Fan Xiaoxue’s face changed: "What? Impossible, try it again!"
The clerk had to swipe it again, but it still had insufficient balance.
Fan Xiaoxue quickly took out her phone, made a call, but couldn’t get through, becoming incredibly anxious. To have insufficient balance, in Fan Xiaoxue’s view, was simply a great humiliation, too embarrassing.
There were other customers in the store at this time.
Upon discovering Fan Xiaoxue’s insufficient balance, they began to murmur.
"Look at this person, coming to buy luxury goods with no money, hilarious."
"Pretending to be a rich person."
"Does she really not feel embarrassed."
There was a burst of snickering.
Fan Xiaoxue’s face turned red, wishing she could find a hole to crawl into, it was so shameful.
Feng Ruolan asked, "Xiaoxue, what happened?"
Fan Xiaoxue hurriedly said, "I also don’t know, this is the card my dad gave me, it has a million limit, why isn’t it working, I just tried to contact my dad, too, but couldn’t reach him."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Sister Xiaoxue, does your card really have a million limit? It doesn’t seem like it, are you just saving face?"
With these words, there was an uproar of laughter.
The clerk also suddenly looked at Fan Xiaoxue with a disdainful look, previously Fan Xiaoxue hadn’t treated the clerk as human, with an arrogant attitude.
Turns out she was just pretending!
Even though Fan Xiaoxue successfully bought a blouse before, that was probably all the money Fan Xiaoxue had, wanting to pretend again but found herself short of balance, exposed.
Thinking of this, the clerk became even more contemptuous of Fan Xiaoxue, chuckling, "Miss, do you really have money to buy? If you don’t, there’s no need to force it."
Fan Xiaoxue almost cried, she had never been so humiliated in her life.
"Sister Xiaoxue, don’t you have enough money, how about I lend you some, but I’ll have to charge interest." Lin Fan smiled.
Feng Ruolan whispered, "Xiaoxue, how about you use mine first."
Fan Xiaoxue was furious, borrowing money to buy clothes in front of so many people?
Wouldn’t that be even more humiliating?
Fan Xiaoxue threw the clothes to the clerk: "I’m not buying it!"
The clerk muttered, "Not buying, or can’t afford to buy?"
Those words were a critical hit, Fan Xiaoxue almost couldn’t stand still.
The more she thought about it, the angrier she got, unable to help but point at Lin Fan and curse, "You stingy bastard, lousy loser, it’s all your fault, you donated my clothes and now you kick me when I’m down! You lend me money? Do you even have money to lend me?"
Lin Fan nodded seriously, "I really do have money, Sister Xiaoxue, why are you so mad, I’m just trying to help you."
Fan Xiaoxue sneered, "Help me? If you have 18,000 in your bank card, I’ll give you my head! I’m afraid you don’t even have 180!"
Lin Fan’s clothes were simple, indeed looking like he didn’t even have 180.
Fan Xiaoxue tried to shift the blame, directing the focus onto Lin Fan, it was quite a ruthless move.
Sure enough, seeing Lin Fan’s outfit, everyone thought Fan Xiaoxue was right, and instantly looked at Lin Fan with a bit of disdain.
"Wow, why are there so many poor people in Chanel today!"
"Chanel’s level has been dragged down by them."
"Really, inside and outside the store, there’s a waft of poverty."
Everyone began to mock.
Lin Fan, however, didn’t pay much attention to the disdain from the crowd, leisurely taking out his bank card, handing it to the clerk: "I’ll buy this piece of clothing."
The clerk was half convinced, this guy really had money?
The clerk took the bank card, anyway, if the card didn’t swipe, the one embarrassed would be this guy, no rush to deal with it if it didn’t work.
So the clerk tried to swipe it.
Beep!
Successful transaction!
"What?"
The people around were a bit stunned, 18,000, it went through?
This guy in bargain-bin clothes, looking like he doesn’t even have 180, casually swiped a transaction of 18,000!
The clerk was also a bit surprised, but she recognized money, as long as the transaction succeeded, he was her god.
"Thank you for shopping with us, sir, please keep your card and merchandise." The clerk smiled, becoming more enthusiastic, returning the card to Lin Fan with both hands, then tidying up and handing over the packaged clothes to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took the clothes, turned, and handed them to Feng Ruolan: "Sister, this is a gift from me to you. We’ve known each other for so long, and I’ve never given you a gift, just a small token."
Feng Ruolan was a bit pleasantly surprised; indeed, Little Fan had never given her gifts before, this was the first time, her first gift from Lin Fan, truly hard to refuse, irresistible.
"Thank you, Little Fan, I like it very much." Feng Ruolan accepted the shopping bag, without even caring about Fan Xiaoxue’s feelings.
Fan Xiaoxue’s face twitched, as if she was slapped hard.
Damn, she actually got face-slapped by Lin Fan, who would have thought Lin Fan, so poor, casually swiping 18,000!
"Sister Xiaoxue, now do you believe it, hey, Sister Xiaoxue, what’s wrong with your face, are you cramping?" Lin Fan said.
Fan Xiaoxue wanted to die.
At this point, only displaying a green tea b*tch behavior could salvage the situation.
Fan Xiaoxue smiled sweetly: "Lanlan, really envy you for having such a brother, even giving you gifts, so thoughtful. But, isn’t this probably all his money, all spent on clothes, how’s he going to live next?"
This was truly green tea-like, seemingly caring about Lin Fan, but actually mocking Lin Fan for putting on airs.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Sister Xiaoxue overthinks it, I still have money for living."
If having hundreds of billions in cash in the bank wasn’t enough to live on, then how much would be?
Fan Xiaoxue snorted, "Don’t say I look down on you, if I guessed right, the money on your card probably comes from Lanlan!"
Feng Ruolan was Yun City’s richest woman, giving Lin Fan some money was just a small thing.
The more she thought about it, the more it seemed like it, Fan Xiaoxue was convinced Lin Fan was spending Feng Ruolan’s money.
Feng Ruolan clarified: "Xiaoxue, you really have it wrong this time, actually Little Fan he..."
Just then, a middle-aged woman walked in from outside, wearing a Chanel store uniform.
"The manager is back." The clerk said happily, and the one who entered was indeed the store manager.
The manager approached Lin Fan directly, excitedly, bowing: "Mr. Lin, it’s really you! Last time you spent a billion to buy out the luxury shopping street, at that time I was the Chanel store manager there, just transferred here recently, do you still remember?"
What?
Spent 1 billion to buy out a luxury shopping street?
Everyone was shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Lin Fan, the Ultimate Freeloader
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 264: Lin Fan, the Ultimate Freeloader
Fan Xiaoxue thought Lin Fan was a freeloader, spending Feng Ruolan’s money to show off. After all, Lin Fan looked like a poor guy, and his money could only be Feng Ruolan’s pocket money for him.
At this moment, the store manager returned and immediately recognized Lin Fan, the young tycoon who bought the entire luxury shopping street that day.
It was said that Lin Fan spent 100 million to buy the whole luxury street, and everyone was shocked.
"I heard about it too; oh my, it’s really him?"
"I didn’t know he’s this wealthy!"
"I remember seeing him on trending news; he is Lin Fan!"
The people around started discussing, and upon learning that Lin Fan was a tycoon, their gazes at him changed.
Fan Xiaoxue was stunned. Did Lin Fan actually have such an impressive record?
For shopaholics, who wouldn’t want to buy the whole street, but it’s just wishful thinking! Who would actually buy an entire street, and even if they wanted to, who could actually afford it!
And Lin Fan, he actually achieved this dream?
A whole street of luxury goods!
Goodness, this is an absolute spectacle. Just the thought of it quickens Fan Xiaoxue’s heartbeat and makes her breath heavier...
"Lin Fan, did you really buy an entire street of luxury goods?" Fan Xiaoxue asked in a trembling voice.
Lin Fan sighed and said, "Don’t mention it, it was an impulse buy, an impulse buy."
In fact, Lin Fan did regret it afterward. Spending 100 million in a fit of pique to buy a whole street was indeed impulsive. There’s no way he could use all those luxury goods, so he could only give them as gifts to others.
Feng Ruolan laughed and said, "Xiaoxue, you might not know about it overseas, but it’s true. Little Fan was a bit willful that time, but of course, that small amount of money is nothing to him."
Upon hearing this, the crowd broke into a cold sweat.
Holy shit!
That small amount of money?
That’s 100 million!
Most people couldn’t earn 100 million in their lifetimes, but to Lin Fan, it’s just pocket change!
Fan Xiaoxue was dumbfounded and momentarily too shocked to speak.
Lin Fan said, "Sisters, are you two still shopping, or should we leave?"
Feng Ruolan said, "I don’t have anything else to buy."
Fan Xiaoxue naturally wouldn’t buy anything either; her credit card was maxed out.
So the three of them left the mall.
Outside, Fan Xiaoxue finally snapped out of it, pulled Feng Ruolan aside, and asked seriously, "Lanlan, what’s your relationship with Lin Fan? He’s like a super freeloader; why do you give him so much money?"
Feng Ruolan was stunned and couldn’t help but laugh, realizing that Fan Xiaoxue thought Lin Fan’s money came from her.
Feng Ruolan said, "You misunderstood..."
She was about to explain when a phone rang; someone was calling Fan Xiaoxue.
Fan Xiaoxue took out her phone and answered, "Hello, dear... I’m with my bestie right now, just like I said, it’s Lanlan... Hmm, dinner together, right, I’ll tell her."
After hanging up, Fan Xiaoxue said, "It’s my boyfriend, Lanlan. Let’s have dinner together today."
Feng Ruolan said happily, "Xiaoxue, you have a boyfriend now, how come you didn’t mention it?"
Fan Xiaoxue replied with a happy face, "We recently started dating. I was planning to introduce him to you when I returned home."
Feng Ruolan gossiped, "What’s your boyfriend like?"
Fan Xiaoxue said, "You’ll know when you see him."
Feng Ruolan laughed and said, "Alright, keeping it a secret, seems like I can’t escape this dinner. So, where are we eating?"
Fan Xiaoxue said, "Junyue Restaurant."
Feng Ruolan turned to Lin Fan and said, "Little Fan, are you coming too?"
Lin Fan said happily, "Sure, I’m more than happy to join a free meal."
Junyue Restaurant has good food; he went there once, courtesy of Junyue Restaurant.
Fan Xiaoxue gave Lin Fan a disdainful look; as expected of a super freeloader, he’s so thrilled about a free meal...
Zhou Tian Mansion.
As night fell, the entire building was brightly lit, bustling with activity from the first to sixth floors during the night market hours.
Junyue Restaurant always had good business, and one needed to book a seat in advance to dine there; otherwise, one might have to wait a long time for a table.
As they entered the restaurant, Fan Xiaoxue started bragging, "My boyfriend is a senior VIP here. Booking a table is just a phone call away, and he can get a great table anytime. We’ll be dining in a private room later."
Lin Fan laughed, "Private room sounds good, it’s quiet."
Fan Xiaoxue gave Lin Fan a disdainful look; does a freeloader even have the right to speak!
At the entrance, a waiter greeted them and asked, "Welcome, how many of you are there, and do you have a reservation?"
Fan Xiaoxue said proudly, "It’s under Mr. Robinson."
The waiter immediately became respectful, "Oh, so it’s for Mr. Robinson, please wait a moment, miss."
The waiter ran off, and soon, a middle-aged man in a suit hurried over to Fan Xiaoxue.
"Hello, I am Manager Qian here. May I know your surname, miss, and your relation to Mr. Robinson?" the middle-aged man asked politely.
Fan Xiaoxue said proudly, "My surname is Fan, and I’m his girlfriend."
Manager Qian smiled, "So, Miss Fan, and these two are..."
Manager Qian looked at Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan, and his expression suddenly changed.
Oh my god, is this real!
This beauty is Yun City’s female tycoon, Feng Ruolan!
He didn’t know who Fan Xiaoxue was, but Feng Ruolan was Yun City’s female tycoon, very famous, and many people knew her. Although Junyue Restaurant is a high-end place, it’s Feng Ruolan’s first time here, truly an honor.
And the other person, in Manager Qian’s eyes, was even more impressive, perhaps more so than Feng Ruolan.
Lin Fan!
It’s Lin Fan!
This Zhou Tian Mansion belongs to him...
A few days ago, to build a relationship with Lin Fan, Manager Qian personally invited Lin Fan to dine at Junyue...
In front of Lin Fan, Manager Qian felt a bit respectful, ready to bow and greet Lin Fan.
Lin Fan shook his head slightly, signaling not to acknowledge him.
Manager Qian understood, not sure why, but since Lin Fan signaled so, he had to act accordingly, pretending not to recognize Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan as he discreetly wiped cold sweat off his brow,
"This way, please," Manager Qian said respectfully, and although he couldn’t openly say it, his respect was entirely because of Lin Fan.
He figured Mr. Lin must want to keep a low profile, hence the silence.
Fan Xiaoxue thought it was out of respect for her, raised her head high, and proudly walked ahead.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan followed her, soon arriving at a private room.
Fan Xiaoxue’s boyfriend hadn’t arrived yet, so the three of them sat down first.
Manager Qian busily arranged things personally before leaving.
"Xiaoxue, your boyfriend’s name is Robinson? Sounds like a foreigner?" Feng Ruolan asked.
Lin Fan said, "Not necessarily, he could be a fake foreigner, surname Luo, first name Binxun; sister, did you forget Xue Henry?"

chapters.title: Chapter 265: You’re such a joker, this building belongs to him?
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 265: You’re such a joker, this building belongs to him?
Xue Henry, a fake foreigner, is clearly a Huaxia person, yet he gave himself such a Westernized name, and even his thoughts have Westernized.
Feng Ruolan couldn’t help but smile: "Indeed."
Fan Xiaoxue was not pleased and snorted: "Lin Fan, what nonsense are you talking about, Robinson is not a fake foreigner, he is a genuine white American."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, he’s a pure white person, you seem quite proud of that?"
Fan Xiaoxue replied, "So what if I’m proud, because my boyfriend is excellent! Unlike you, a freeloader, you don’t even have the qualifications to tie his shoes!"
"What freeloader?"
At this moment, a foreigner in a suit, led by Manager Qian, walked in from outside, smiling as he asked.
The foreigner’s Huaxia language, though not very standard, was quite fluent. He was tall and handsome, and the high-end suit he wore highlighted him as a tasteful and successful person, with an elegant aura in his demeanor.
Seeing this foreigner, Fan Xiaoxue couldn’t be bothered to bicker with Lin Fan anymore, happily stood up, and walked over to take the foreigner’s hand.
"Let me introduce, my boyfriend, Robinson, president of Tesla China District. Darling, this is the best friend I told you about, who I’ve played with since childhood, Feng Ruolan." Fan Xiaoxue said sweetly, evidently very attentive to her boyfriend.
Robinson extended his hand to shake hands with Feng Ruolan, smiling: "Hello Miss Feng, I’ve heard a lot about you, I’ve heard you’re the richest woman in Yun City, Xiaoxue has mentioned you to me many times, I’ve long wanted to meet you, it’s an honor today."
Robinson gave the impression of being articulate and indeed quite outstanding.
Feng Ruolan, somewhat surprised, said: "Is Mr. Robinson really the president of Tesla China District?"
Fan Xiaoxue has really achieved something, finding such an outstanding boyfriend.
Tesla, a super company from the United States, mainly dealing in electric cars and energy, Robinson, as the president of the China district, clearly holds a high position.
Robinson modestly said: "I’m just doing a job, how could I compare to Miss Feng, who owns the Longheng Group, a prominent entity in Huaxia’s financial sector."
Feng Ruolan smiled: "Mr. Robinson is too modest."
Robinson turned his gaze to Lin Fan: "And this gentleman? Xiaoxue, why don’t you introduce us?"
Fan Xiaoxue pouted and said: "Him, never mind introducing, he’s Lanlan’s brother, but not a biological brother, just a freeloader."
"Freeloader, meaning someone who lives off a woman?" Robinson asked.
Fan Xiaoxue giggled: "That’s exactly what it means."
Robinson sized him up, dressed in cheap clothes, and immediately showed a bit of disdain.
Manager Qian standing by was already sweating.
Oh my!
They actually said Mr. Lin is a freeloader living off a woman!
However, this was the first time Manager Qian knew that Lin Fan and Yun City’s richest woman, Feng Ruolan, had such a relationship.
The world of the wealthy is truly surprising.
Fan Xiaoxue looked contemptuously at Lin Fan and said: "Lin Fan, now you know why I said you don’t even have the qualifications to tie Robinson’s shoes, right? Robinson is the president of Tesla China District, and because of his distinguished status, he’s already a Junyue VIP, so he doesn’t need to book a table to eat. Just a phone call gets it done. Contrastingly, can you do that? You’re just a freeloader, if not for my Lanlan, you wouldn’t even be able to enter the restaurant’s door!"
While belittling Lin Fan, Fan Xiaoxue praised her own boyfriend, feeling a sense of superiority, almost like a queen looking down from above in front of Lin Fan.
Feng Ruolan couldn’t stand it any longer. Even though Fan Xiaoxue was her best friend, she couldn’t belittle Lin Fan like that, especially since she was known for fiercely protecting her brother.
"Xiaoxue, I need to clarify something here, you’ve misunderstood, Little Fan is not the freeloader you mentioned." Feng Ruolan said.
Fan Xiaoxue said: "Lanlan, you don’t need to protect him, I don’t even know what’s the deal between you two, is he worth your protection? He’s squandered your 100 million!"
Lin Fan made her lose face in the mall today, so she disliked him. Given the chance, she wouldn’t miss the opportunity to stomp on Lin Fan.
Stomping on Lin Fan made her feel good.
However, what frustrated her was that Feng Ruolan was actually defending Lin Fan, she couldn’t understand why. What did Lin Fan do to deserve Feng Ruolan’s protection?
Robinson was surprised: "Could it be that this guy blew through Miss Feng’s 100 million? That’s too outrageous, really not right."
Feng Ruolan said: "I’m telling the truth, I didn’t give him money, it’s all his own money, I’ve been meaning to tell you, you might misunderstand him because he dresses down-to-earth, but actually, he’s a hidden tycoon, way richer than me in minutes."
Fan Xiaoxue was a bit surprised and said: "What? Richer than you?"
Feng Ruolan is Yun City’s richest woman, richer than the richest woman, what kind of concept is that!
Feng Ruolan said: "It’s true, Little Fan is very wealthy. For example, this Zhou Tian Mansion is Little Fan’s property."
Fan Xiaoxue paused, then burst into laughter: "Lanlan, you’re such a jokester, Zhou Tian Mansion is his?"
She pointed at Lin Fan, laughing to the point of crowing.
Lin Fan, dressed in cheap clothes, being the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion?
She wouldn’t believe it, not even in her wildest dreams.
Feng Ruolan must have been joking.
"Lanlan, I must say, even if you want to defend him, you should come up with a more credible story, this doesn’t sound plausible at all, this Zhou Tian Mansion, as I knew before, is an asset of Zhou Tian Company, and the founder of Zhou Tian Company is friends with my dad, no one knows better than me, how could it be his!" Fan Xiaoxue laughed heartily.
Feng Ruolan was a bit speechless. If Fan Xiaoxue didn’t want to believe it, there was no way around it, even long-time friendships couldn’t make a difference now.
What’s it like to slap your childhood best friend’s face?
Looks like after today, she could answer this question on a forum.
Feng Ruolan said: "Zhou Tian Mansion is indeed Little Fan’s asset, he bought it just these past few days, and for proof, you only need to check online, or you can directly ask the previous owner, isn’t he said to be Uncle Fan’s friend?"
Fan Xiaoxue saw Feng Ruolan being serious, not looking like she was joking or lying, and couldn’t help but feel a bit odd.
No way, could it be true?
Has the world gone mad?
Feng Ruolan said: "There’s also a quicker way, I believe everyone doing business in Zhou Tian Mansion should know about this, right, Manager Qian?"
"Uh..."
Manager Qian looked at Lin Fan, feeling a bit awkward; Lin Fan had previously indicated to him not to make it public, and he wouldn’t dare speak out without Lin Fan’s approval, what if he offended Lin Fan?
Even if the opposing party was Feng Ruolan, he couldn’t afford to say anything, here, Lin Fan was the foremost.
Lin Fan nodded at this moment, casually saying: "Manager Qian, it’s okay."
Previously, he didn’t let Manager Qian say anything because he felt it unnecessary to argue with Fan Xiaoxue. Despite Fan Xiaoxue having some misunderstandings about him, he long felt it unnecessary to bother with someone like her, it was pretty pointless.
But since the richest sister had spoken up, Lin Fan had no need to stay low-key, after all, the richest sister was defending him.
Manager Qian, upon receiving Lin Fan’s approval, felt relieved as if a heavy burden had been lifted.
"Okay." Manager Qian looked at Fan Xiaoxue, "Miss Fan, Mr. Lin is indeed the current owner of this Zhou Tian Mansion, which means he is our Junyue Restaurant’s landlord."
"Ah?"
Fan Xiaoxue was stunned, she could dismiss Feng Ruolan’s words as protection of Lin Fan, but for Manager Qian to say the same?
Manager Qian had no reason to protect Lin Fan, right!
Oh my god, Lin Fan really is the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion?
"Lin Fan!" Robinson thought of something and blurted out, "Could you be the legendary Lin Fan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Battle with the Green Tea Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 266: Battle with the Green Tea Woman
These days, Lin Fan’s name has become almost universally known in the business world; everyone is talking about this newly risen young tycoon.
Because of this, Robinson also heard about Lin Fan, who has been lavishly spending money in Yun City recently, buying companies like buying cabbages. Moreover, his actions are impressive—Celestial Aviation is one of the top private airlines, and Zhou Tian Mansion is one of Yun City’s tallest buildings, which truly amazes people.
How rich is Lin Fan, exactly?
Upon learning that Lin Fan is the owner of Zhou Tian Mansion, Fan Xiaoxue was dumbfounded.
If Feng Ruolan gave Lin Fan a hundred million, Fan Xiaoxue would still believe it, but giving Lin Fan a whole Zhou Tian Mansion?
Even Fan Xiaoxue herself doesn’t buy it.
Besides...
Lin Fan’s assets aren’t limited to just a Zhou Tian Mansion.
"You recognize me?"
After Robinson’s inquiry, Lin Fan asked.
Robinson said, "Although I’m American, I run businesses in Huaxia and keep quite a close eye on the Huaxia business world. Mr. Lin caught my attention mainly because he bought Celestial Aviation."
"What?"
Fan Xiaoxue blurted out in shock, "He bought Celestial Aviation?"
Robinson said, "Mr. Lin is the chairman and CEO of Celestial Aviation, and since he acquired it, Celestial Aviation’s stock price has been rising for days, with its market value soaring from 50 billion to 90 billion."
Fan Xiaoxue: "..."
Kneeling.
Bought Zhou Tian Mansion, bought Celestial Aviation!
This...
Is too much wealth!
Lin Fan is so wealthy, why does he still wear flea market clothes?
Low-key!
Fan Xiaoxue could only think of this word; indeed, Lin Fan must be low-key!
Lin Fan then chuckled and said, "Mr. Robinson seems to know me quite well."
Robinson said, "Yes, that’s because my boss is also in the aviation industry. Mr. Lin must have heard of my boss, Mr. Maslow, right?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Heard of him."
Maslow, an American, besides making Tesla electric cars, also runs an airline company. But it’s not a typical airline; it deals with space transportation, developing rockets and spacecraft!
Even in Huaxia, Maslow’s name is very prominent and widely followed.
Lin Fan had heard of him too.
Robinson smiled and invited, "We’ve talked for so long, Mr. Lin, why don’t we sit down, enjoy some food while we chat?"
So, the four of them took their seats and ordered some dishes, with Manager Qian personally arranging it.
While Lin Fan and Robinson were chatting, Fan Xiaoxue made an excuse to freshen up and pulled Feng Ruolan to the restroom.
"Lanlan, since he’s so wealthy, why didn’t you tell me earlier?" Fan Xiaoxue accused, thinking that if she had known Lin Fan was so rich, she definitely wouldn’t have mocked him. Looking back now, it’s too embarrassing.
Feng Ruolan sweatily said, "I’ve been wanting to explain to you, just didn’t get the chance..."
Fan Xiaoxue said, "Lanlan, be honest, where did you pick up such an outstanding brother?"
Feng Ruolan smiled, "What, you want one too?"
Fan Xiaoxue straightforwardly said, "Having a dozen like him wouldn’t be an issue for me. By the way, Lanlan, what’s your relationship with him exactly? Are you really siblings, or could it be..."
Feng Ruolan’s face turned red, "Don’t say nonsense!"
Fan Xiaoxue giggled and said, "I get it. So, does he have a girlfriend?"
Feng Ruolan said, "As far as I know, no. Xiaoxue, what are you planning? Aren’t you with Robinson already, you better not have designs on my brother!"
Feng Ruolan said warily.
Fan Xiaoxue chuckled, "Of course not, I’m not that kind of person..."
But her eyes began to reveal some thoughtfulness.
Back to the private room.
Seeing Robinson and Lin Fan chatting, Fan Xiaoxue walked over to Robinson, charmingly said, "Honey, I’m feeling a bit cold. I remember leaving my jacket in your car this morning, could you go get it for me?"
Robinson said, "No problem, Mr. Lin, excuse me for a moment."
Robinson got up and left.
Fan Xiaoxue tricked Robinson into leaving, then sat down next to Lin Fan, sweetly smiled, "Little Fan, earlier I misunderstood you, you won’t take it to heart, will you?"
Fan Xiaoxue used to despise him in various ways; suddenly being so agreeable made Lin Fan feel a bit uncomfortable.
This woman was once haughty and now humble—it must be because she learned he had money and changed her attitude. Lin Fan would rather she disliked him than cling to him.
Lin Fan seriously nodded, "I’m quite petty, I’ll keep it in mind."
Fan Xiaoxue pouted, "Oh dear, I’ve apologized already, what do you want me to do to forgive me?"
While speaking, Fan Xiaoxue’s hand mistakenly or deliberately rested on Lin Fan’s arm.
Flirting too obviously!
Even Feng Ruolan, nearby, felt embarrassed.
This Fan Xiaoxue was so shameless.
Lin Fan said, "Does it mean I can ask you to do anything?"
Fan Xiaoxue said, "Whatever you say, as long as you forgive me, and I can do it, I will."
Lin Fan calmly said, "Please sit across from me, I don’t want to sit with you."
Fan Xiaoxue said, "No way, I want to sit with you."
Lin Fan said, "Please be respectful; you have a boyfriend. If he sees, I don’t want him to misunderstand."
Lin Fan truly kept a distance from this green tea woman, as green tea women excel at creating trouble!
A talented green tea, with just a few words, can start a war.
Fan Xiaoxue said, "What about having a boyfriend? I’m just sitting with you, don’t worry, Robinson is quite open-minded; he won’t stop me from making friends."
Lin Fan said, "But I don’t want to make friends with you."
Fan Xiaoxue laughed, "Who said I want to be your friend? You are Lanlan’s brother, and I’m Lanlan’s good friend; by rank, you’re also my brother. What’s the problem with a sister sitting with her brother?"
She seemed determined to cling to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan: "..."
Then, a waiter came in to serve the dishes, placing them on the table one by one.
Fan Xiaoxue picked up some chicken and ate it, praising, "This white-cut chicken is so good, Little Fan, try some."
Fan Xiaoxue then picked up a piece of meat, intending to place it in Lin Fan’s bowl.
But the next second, the bowl disappeared—it had been taken by Lin Fan. He simply stood up and quickly went to the opposite side, sitting next to Feng Ruolan. Since Fan Xiaoxue refused to move, he moved himself.
Value life, stay away from green tea.
Fan Xiaoxue felt a bit awkward but quickly resolved it herself, smiling, "So Little Fan doesn’t like chicken, no worries, I’ll eat it myself."
"What were you all talking about? Xiaoxue, why are you sitting in my seat?"
Robinson walked in.
Before Fan Xiaoxue could speak, Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister Xiaoxue said she wanted to sit with you, so I ceded the spot. Mr. Robinson, you and Sister Xiaoxue are so loving; it’s truly enviable."

chapters.title: Chapter 267: New System Task, Aiming for the Starry Sea
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 267: New System Task, Aiming for the Starry Sea
Lin Fan’s single remark effectively shut Fan Xiaoxue up, after all, if she kept talking, who knows what other green tea nonsense she might spew.
Robinson was quite pleased to hear it: "Thank you, Mr. Lin, indeed, I really like Xiaoxue."
Fan Xiaoxue was just about to say some green tea words, expressing her admiration for Lin Fan and wanting to sit with him, but Lin Fan wasn’t playing along.
But with Lin Fan cutting her off, she couldn’t say that anymore.
With a quick shift, Fan Xiaoxue said, "Dear, I like you too, come sit down."
As she pulled Robinson down to sit, Fan Xiaoxue suddenly let out a sigh.
Curiously, Robinson asked, "Honey, what’s wrong, why are you sighing all of a sudden?"
Fan Xiaoxue responded, "I really like you and wish you could be as outstanding as Little Fan; not to say you’re not excellent, I just hope you can be better."
Upon hearing this, Robinson felt a bit awkward and forced a smile: "Mr. Lin is indeed very outstanding, more so than I am."
Fan Xiaoxue looked at Lin Fan with admiration: "I misunderstood before, and only after getting to know him, I realized that Little Fan is simply the most outstanding man in the world. Is there anyone more excellent than him, so young and handsome, truly a model of a man. Robinson, do you think I’m right?"
Lin Fan broke into a sweat, wow, this is so green tea, this is obviously sarcastic praise, too annoying.
As expected, seeing Fan Xiaoxue praising Lin Fan so highly, like a fangirl, Robinson couldn’t help but feel a little displeased.
She is Robinson’s girlfriend, worshipping Lin Fan like that, he might as well have green pastures on his head soon.
Moreover, Robinson didn’t agree with Fan Xiaoxue’s words.
"Ha ha, I admit, Mr. Lin is indeed very outstanding. So young, yet with so many assets, he probably has no equal among his peers. But to say he’s the most outstanding in the world, I think not. Frankly, in my mind, the truly godlike person is only my boss, Mr. Maslow." Robinson said seriously.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat; this foreigner Robinson doesn’t understand the green tea tactic at all, easily falling into the trap set by the green tea girl.
Fan Xiaoxue dismissed it, "What’s so special about your boss, just launched a few rockets, Little Fan also has an aviation company, and he isn’t as young and handsome as Little Fan!"
Feng Ruolan found it a bit too much and said, "Xiaoxue, that’s enough, stop sarcastically praising Little Fan."
However, Robinson was already a bit provoked by Fan Xiaoxue.
"It’s just a few rockets? Your words are too childish. Mr. Maslow has also formulated a spaceship plan, launching rockets is just his first step. He will lead humanity in achieving manned space travel. Frankly, this is not even in the same league as Mr. Lin’s aviation, as you Huaxia people say, this is probably the difference between clouds and mud. Mr. Maslow’s goal is the stars and the sea!" Robinson exclaimed with some excitement.
In boasting about his boss, he naturally belittled Lin Fan.
This made Feng Ruolan slightly displeased.
"Mr. Robinson, there’s no need to be so harsh. Mr. Maslow is indeed impressive, but what he does is too far for humanity right now and it might not even succeed. What my brother is doing is something tangible for the present. If we talk about who’s more useful to humanity right now, it’s clearly not your boss."
Feng Ruolan chuckled, her overly protective sister mode activated.
Seeing them argue, Fan Xiaoxue secretly enjoyed it; it was too entertaining that with just a few words, they started bickering.
"Oh dear, don’t argue, I was just expressing my admiration for Little Fan, after all, in my eyes, Little Fan is the most outstanding person," Fan Xiaoxue said, feigning to mediate.
Of course, her words didn’t calm things down; instead, they added fuel to the fire.
Truly the green tea girl.
Robinson became increasingly displeased: "I believe Mr. Maslow’s work is of extraordinary contribution to humanity, and Mr. Lin’s vision is far from as great as Mr. Maslow’s. If Mr. Lin wants to be like Mr. Maslow, he needs to surpass him in space ventures. So I have to ask Mr. Lin, do you have any plans for space? If not, then I’m sorry, you’ll never be more outstanding than Mr. Maslow."
These words were openly belittling Lin Fan.
Even though Lin Fan knew Robinson was led astray by Fan Xiaoxue’s green tea remarks, falling into the trap, regardless of how it happened, Maslow was a slap in the face.
If Lin Fan didn’t hit back, he’d suffer a great loss.
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, having to admit, Fan Xiaoxue’s tea art was truly top-notch, a model among green tea girls.
Robinson, as a foreigner, was completely led by the green tea girl.
However, it had come to this point, how should Lin Fan refute Robinson?
Lin Fan had never considered entering space ventures; it was indeed too distant for him, something he never thought about.
In terms of vision, naturally, space was vast, and how could anything be greater than space!
At this moment.
"Ding!"
"System task released, Celestial Aviation to establish a space department and develop rockets!"
The system suddenly rang in his mind.
A space plan was actually released?
Lin Fan was taken aback, did he hear that right? The system requested his Celestial Aviation to establish a space department and step into rocket research!
This... is a bit awesome!
Using civilian flights to transport passengers is achievable, as long as there’s enough money, one can buy ready-made planes.
But rockets aren’t something just anyone can make, and manned space flight is more like a science fiction plot.
Yet!
The system is omnipotent!
Now the system wants him to establish a space department and develop rockets, could it be that in the future, manned space travel could really be achieved?!
Just thinking about it got him excited.
Seeing Lin Fan not speaking, the three present assumed Lin Fan was stunned by Robinson’s words.
Indeed, there’s no one who wouldn’t be stunned; Robinson’s boss Maslow is indeed so impressive, anyone who sees it would have to say it’s an amazing existence, worthy of admiration.
Comparing Lin Fan to Maslow is simply bullying Lin Fan.
Robinson thought Lin Fan was left speechless by his words and felt a bit smug, increasingly proud of his boss Maslow.
"See? Mr. Lin doesn’t even dare to speak, Xiaoxue, do you still hold your view that Mr. Lin is the most outstanding man in the world?" Robinson asked.
Fan Xiaoxue found it amusing, finally, sweet revenge. Earlier at the mall, Lin Fan embarrassed her, and later Lin Fan was proven to be a godly tycoon, giving her a severe slap to the face.
She naturally wouldn’t really fall for Lin Fan because he was rich; she just wanted a chance to make Lin Fan suffer, to regain her pride.
Finally, with her unstoppable tongue, she led her boyfriend Robinson into the trap.
Robinson brought out his boss Maslow to heavily suppress Lin Fan.
"Hehe, Lin Fan, let’s see you show off now, how will you continue to brag!"
Lin Fan snapped back to reality; he was "dazed" and "speechless" because the system released a task.
Then, Lin Fan smiled slightly, calmly said: "What a coincidence, Mr. Robinson, since you asked, I’ll mention it. My Celestial Aviation does plan to establish a space department, investing in rocket research. As for whether I can surpass Mr. Maslow, let’s wait and see."
What?
With these words, all three were stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: A Strange Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 268: A Strange Reward
Upon hearing Lin Fan’s words, the three were stunned.
Really? Lin Fan’s playing such a big game?
Feng Ruolan said, "Little Fan, is this for real?"
She was a bit incredulous.
Fan Xiaoxue chuckled and said, "How can there be such a coincidence in this world? Robinson asks about it, and Little Fan just happens to have this plan. Little Fan must be joking with Robinson."
Robinson sneered, "Mr. Lin, there’s no need to lie or joke for self-respect. We’re talking about building rockets, even spacecraft, which is not something just anyone can do."
Robinson simply didn’t believe Lin Fan was serious.
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m not joking, I’m serious. Of course, if you don’t believe me, no worries. Once my space venture department is set up, you can be invited to visit."
Lin Fan is serious!
Robinson was a bit surprised, "Mr. Lin, are you really planning to set up a space venture department to develop rockets? Do you know how rockets are built?"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t know, but I have money, I can hire people to build them."
If you have money, you can really do anything.
Robinson couldn’t help but laugh, "It seems Mr. Lin knows nothing about building rockets. My boss builds rockets, and besides money, he’s gathered the world’s top experts. Mr. Lin certainly has no shortage of money, but I doubt Mr. Lin can find top talent."
Lin Fan casually said, "Why do you say that, Mr. Robinson?"
Robinson proudly said, "Because the world’s top rocket experts are all in my country and have been recruited by my boss. Even if Mr. Lin wants to poach them, the possibility is nearly zero. Besides, even if Mr. Lin poaches them and relies on them to build rockets, it would prove my country’s technological prowess. So from any angle, challenging Mr. Maslow is a losing battle for Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan was silent.
Robinson thought he had rendered Lin Fan speechless and laughed, "I advise Mr. Lin to think again, a space venture department isn’t child’s play, Mr. Lin shouldn’t waste his money. Come, Mr. Lin, have a glass of red wine and calm down."
His words were full of mockery; Lin Fan was biting off more than he could chew.
Lin Fan smiled, "Mr. Robinson is very considerate of me, I’m touched, but it’s a pity Mr. Robinson’s words aren’t correct."
Robinson felt a bit annoyed that Lin Fan dared to retort.
"Which part is wrong?" Robinson said.
Lin Fan said, "Firstly, you said the top rocket experts are in your country. That’s not right; I believe Huaxia’s aerospace talent isn’t inferior to yours."
Robinson sneered, "What else?"
Lin Fan said, "Also, I don’t plan to use your country’s people, so you don’t have to worry about me poaching them or relying on your technology. Just hope that, when the time comes, your talent won’t be begging to join my company."
Robinson was taken aback and laughed heartily, "Mr. Lin, judging by your words, I can guarantee that you absolutely cannot build rockets!"
Lin Fan said, "And if I do, how about you kneel and call me grandpa then?"
Robinson didn’t expect Lin Fan to set such a wager and sneered, "What if you fail?"
Lin Fan said, "If I fail, I’ll call you grandpa."
Robinson laughed, "Fine, it’s a deal. Seems like I’ve got myself a grandson. Oh, and if you fail, you’ll have to apologize to Mr. Maslow for your audacity!"
Fan Xiaoxue chuckled, "Dear, if Little Fan accidentally succeeds, am I not at a loss, having to become Little Fan’s granddaughter-in-law?"
Robinson laughed, "Don’t worry, it’s impossible!"
Saying this, Robinson raised his glass and took a sip of red wine.
Lin Fan also raised his glass, "Grandson, grandpa toasts you in advance."
Lin Fan downed it in one gulp.
Pfft!
Robinson, suddenly called grandson, almost choked on his wine in embarrassment.
"Mr. Lin, don’t get cocky too early; there’s still a chance you’ll be calling me grandpa someday. I’ll be waiting! Sorry, I just remembered that I have some things to take care of, I’ll be leaving now. This meal is on me, Xiaoxue, come with me," Robinson said, annoyed.
Robinson left with Fan Xiaoxue, and this dinner ended unpleasantly.
It was all thanks to Fan Xiaoxue, the instigator, who stirred up the conflict between Robinson and Lin Fan.
Feng Ruolan was also helpless about the scene.
"Little Fan, you played too big this time," Feng Ruolan said with a wry smile.
Lin Fan wants to build rockets?
He’s aiming for the skies!
Feng Ruolan felt it a bit unrealistic, mainly because she didn’t want Lin Fan to lose to Robinson.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sister, do you believe in me?"
Feng Ruolan nodded, "I believe."
Lin Fan said, "Then that’s enough, I won’t let you down."
Feng Ruolan sighed, "Alright, since you chose to do this, I will unconditionally support you. Whatever you need from me, just say the word."
Lin Fan said, "Got it."
Despite saying this, Lin Fan felt uncertain inside!
The system suddenly gave him this task, but Lin Fan had no experience in completing such tasks.
A task attribute table appeared in his mind.
A new task was added.
"Task Name: Establish a Space Venture Department and develop rockets.
Task Level: Important
Task Progress: 0/100"
Apart from that, there were no other instructions.
Building rockets, easier said than done, Lin Fan bitterly smiled, though he made a wager with Robinson, he wasn’t confident about winning.
The dinner ended just like that.
Lin Fan drove back to Feng Ruolan’s villa with her and stayed another night.
An uneventful night.
The next morning.
Lin Fan got up, feeling a bit thirsty, planning to go to the kitchen to pour some water.
At this moment.
"Ding!"
"System reminder, today’s sign-in can begin. Sign-in immediately grants a super skill; would you like to sign in?"
Lin Fan felt a bit puzzled, super skill?
"Sign in!" Lin Fan said in his mind.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, sign-in successful, awarded top-level handcrafted skill!"
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled, what is this?
Top-level handcrafted skill?
Quite a strange reward.
What’s this supposed to be used for? What’s the system’s intention in rewarding this? Or is it just a random reward and happened to be this?
Lin Fan bitterly smiled, what do I need this skill for?
Feng Ruolan then walked out in her pajamas, she had also gotten up.
"Morning." Feng Ruolan greeted Lin Fan.
Lin Fan instinctively said, "Morning."
Feng Ruolan looked around and said, "Aunt Cui hasn’t returned yet. I really want her handcrafted orange juice, it’s so delicious. Too bad she’s been busy with family matters the past couple of days. Oh well, I’ll just order takeout."
Feng Ruolan picked up her phone, planning to order takeout.
Suddenly, Lin Fan felt a surge of data flow in his mind.
"Sister, no need to order takeout, it’s just juice, I’ll make it for you," Lin Fan said with a slight smile.
Feng Ruolan exclaimed, "You can make juice? How come I never heard you say this before?"
Lin Fan said, "I just learned, sister, please wait a moment."
Lin Fan went into the kitchen and started working. The top-level handcrafted skill activated, and his movements were swift, almost magically skilled.
It’s a pity Feng Ruolan didn’t see this, as she sat on the sofa waiting, without much expectation. Upon hearing Lin Fan say he just learned it, she held no expectations.
Soon, Lin Fan held a glass of fresh orange juice in front of Feng Ruolan, smiled, and said, "Sister, want to try?"
Feng Ruolan casually said, took the glass of orange juice, and took a random sip.
At once, Feng Ruolan was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Lin Fan Enters the Factory?
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 269: Lin Fan Enters the Factory?
Feng Ruolan took a sip of orange juice and was stunned.
"Oh my god! How can there be such delicious orange juice! This feeling is like flying in the sky, floating, enchanting, that tangy taste, it feels like my taste buds are exploding, even my breaths are filled with the sweet scent of fresh oranges. In this moment, it’s like I’ve traveled to the kingdom of orange juice and understood the supreme laws of orange juice, the path of orange juice!"
Feng Ruolan’s mind was blown.
So delicious!
It’s really so delicious!
Just one sip of Lin Fan’s orange juice, it was like achieving enlightenment, the whole person was elevated, Feng Ruolan was initially a bit grumpy from waking up, but suddenly she was wide awake.
The world felt incredibly beautiful.
Gulp, gulp...
Feng Ruolan had completely forgotten her restraint, and drank the entire glass of orange juice in one go, looking utterly satisfied.
So satisfied she wanted another glass.
"Little Fan, did you just make this orange juice?" Feng Ruolan asked in surprise.
Lin Fan replied, "Yes."
Feng Ruolan said, "So delicious, my god, Little Fan, you managed to make it so tasty, Aunt Cui’s already tasted good, but yours is ten times better, no, a hundred times better! If you turned this orange juice into a brand, it would certainly sell like hotcakes!"
Feng Ruolan expressed her high praise for Lin Fan’s orange juice, having personally tasted it, she naturally had the authority to say so.
Lin Fan modestly said, "Sister, you’re exaggerating, I just made it casually, didn’t even try my best."
Feng Ruolan was stunned, such delicious orange juice without trying his best, then if Lin Fan gave it his all, wouldn’t drinking it truly grant immortality?
She was increasingly feeling that her brother was really amazing, giving her new surprises every day.
At this moment.
"Ding!"
"System temporary task: Enter Pengyu Toy Factory, recruit He Chen.
Task Level: Important
Task Progress: 0/100"
The system’s voice echoed in Lin Fan’s mind.
Lin Fan was stunned, what does this mean?
Fortunately, the system soon provided an explanation.
"Task Description: He Chen, Huaxia’s top rocket talent, founded the first private rocket company in the country early on, but after some unfortunate incidents, he has assumed a hidden identity, currently working on the assembly line at Pengyu Toy Factory. The task is to take He Chen away and let him serve as the head of the space department in the future."
After reading this explanation, Lin Fan was overjoyed!
The system gave him a task last night to establish a space department and develop rockets.
He was completely clueless, not knowing where to start.
Though he had made a bet with Robinson and seemed calm, he was actually unsure.
Now, this temporary task from the system was clearly to help him take the first step.
The system is truly powerful!
Lin Fan finally understood why the system had given him a top-tier craft skill.
It surely had something to do with Pengyu Toy Factory.
"Pengyu Toy Factory..." Lin Fan murmured.
Feng Ruolan heard it, curiously asked, "Little Fan, what are you talking about, what’s up with Pengyu Toy Factory?"
Lin Fan snapped out of it, and broke into a cold sweat, almost forgetting Feng Ruolan was right in front of him and let her hear it.
Lin Fan had to explain, "Nothing, I just feel a bit bored lately and plan to find a job. I happened to see that Pengyu Toy Factory is recruiting just now."
Feng Ruolan broke into a sweat, "Little Fan, you’re a billionaire tycoon, are you really so bored that you want to work in a factory?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’ve never worked in a factory, I want to experience it."
Having money lets you do whatever you want, and the life of the rich can sometimes be too dull, so it’s understandable to go experience life a bit.
Feng Ruolan wiped her cold sweat and said, "Alright, but take care, I’ve heard the work in factories can be quite dangerous."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I will, sister, I’m off then, going for the interview today."
Lin Fan went to change clothes and left.
Feng Ruolan suddenly felt a bit envious of Lin Fan, he was simply playing the game of life.
As Yun City’s richest woman, she hadn’t lived as freely and easily as Lin Fan.
But Feng Ruolan was still a bit worried about Lin Fan, thought for a moment, then took out her phone: "Good morning, President Wang, it’s like this, my brother plans to visit your toy factory, yes, please keep an eye on him, I don’t want to see him get hurt."
On the other end of the line, the boss of Pengyu Toy Factory, Wang Pengyu, just woke up and was still a bit sleepy, but was startled awake by this call.
The financial witch calling!
Wang Pengyu’s cold sweat drenched him, and he quickly said, "Yes, President Feng, I understand..."
Pengyu Toy Factory, located in the eastern suburbs of Yun City.
This factory is fairly large, considered quite well-known in Yun City, with a significant labor demand.
Lin Fan arrived at the factory gate and found there was a recruitment office set up, with people arriving for the job interviews one after another.
"Recruiting production workers, those confident in their speed, come along. Piece-rate wages, the more you do, the more you earn."
The recruitment ad at the gate very directly stated the requirements.
To keep a low profile, Lin Fan went back to change into an electric scooter and some street market clothes, looking every bit like a destitute laborer coming to earn his keep.
An old woman sat at the recruitment office, wearing a sour face, as if everyone owed her money, handling inquiries from job seekers.
"Our factory has many orders, we’re only accepting workers who can start immediately. If you can’t do that, don’t bother asking!" the old woman coldly announced.
Lin Fan heard it, what a coincidence, he would start immediately.
"I want to apply as a production worker," Lin Fan said to the old woman.
The old woman took a look at Lin Fan, handsome, young, with nice skin, as someone who had seen many people, she could tell at a glance that Lin Fan was a rookie.
The old woman sneered, "Kid, are you sure you can handle this job? If you fail the assessment, you can be dismissed, and you won’t receive any wages."
Lin Fan said, "You’ll know once I try, if I can’t, I don’t want the wages, and I’ll leave."
The old woman got interested, "Really, okay, you’re hired, take the factory badge and head to Building 3, someone will guide you, trial work for one day."
She added, with a smirk, "Looking at your delicate skin and tender flesh, I’m just waiting to see you leave."
Lin Fan didn’t argue with her, she’s hoping to see him leave, but she’d be disappointed.
Soon after, Lin Fan smoothly obtained a factory badge and entered the factory.
Building 3, the location of the production workshop.
A man received Lin Fan, this man was the production line leader, claiming his surname was Ma, and Lin Fan followed him.
"Our production line is responsible for only one process, the work is very simple, it just requires simple bonding. We calculate wages by piece, the more you do, the higher the wage," Group Leader Ma explained.
"As a beginner, you’ll surely work slowly, but it’s okay, I’ll have the experienced workers guide you. Whether you can stay depends on how quickly you adapt."
Group Leader Ma said, guiding Lin Fan to the production line.
The entire production line had dozens of people.
Group Leader Ma handed Lin Fan over to a young guy, "Little Yang, this newcomer is up to you to guide."
After speaking, Group Leader Ma walked away.
The young guy was enthusiastic, "Bro, what’s your name?"
Lin Fan said, "Lin Fan."
The young guy said, "Lin Fan, I’ll teach you how to do it, it’s very simple."
The young guy demonstrated it once, and indeed it was very simple, easily understood at a glance.
The young guy reminded, "Here, you have to be diligent, you have one day of testing, if you work slowly, you’ll be eliminated."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "How many can you make in a minute?"
The young guy said, "Generally speaking, making ten in one minute is passing, and the fastest is twenty a minute, this record was created by our Group Leader Ma, and no one has broken it yet..."
Lin Fan didn’t pay attention to the young guy’s words, at this moment, his gaze landed on a person in the corner, a middle-aged uncle.
This was the person.
Once Huaxia’s top rocket talent, now reduced to working on the assembly line, He Chen!

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Oh my God, you’ve dazzled me to the point my scalp is tingling
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 270: Oh my God, you’ve dazzled me to the point my scalp is tingling
A middle-aged man, wearing glasses and looking scholarly and refined, is working with his head down on the assembly line.
He Chen!
Once a prodigy, admired by millions of young ladies for his demeanor and worshipped by countless people for his talents, the first in Huaxia to establish a private rocket company. Now, he looks haggard, thin, hunched over, and clumsily busy, appearing very pitiful.
"Not like this. You’re doing it too slowly. I’ve taught you many times; how come you can’t remember it?"
Next to him, a young man with dyed yellow hair impatiently shouted at He Chen.
He Chen lifted his head, glanced at the young man who could be his son, and showed a hint of timidity in his eyes.
"Sorry, I’ll keep learning," He Chen nodded and bowed.
This yellow-haired guy probably didn’t even graduate middle school, yet He Chen, once a rocket genius, was now being scolded with a finger to his forehead by him, not daring to retort and obediently taking it.
This is what they call the fall of a great man.
"Use your brain a bit. I don’t have that much time to teach you. You’re wasting my time! Watching you being clumsy, if you can’t do it, you’d better leave soon." The yellow-haired guy impatiently said.
A flash of humiliation passed through He Chen’s eyes, but it quickly disappeared, and he smiled apologetically, "Yes, I’ll figure it out myself."
Then He Chen bowed his head and practiced, but he was clumsy and made little progress, causing the yellow-haired guy to constantly roll his eyes.
On the other side.
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on He Chen.
The target has appeared. He came to the factory today specifically for He Chen.
The young man noticed Lin Fan looking at He Chen and smiled, "This uncle is slow, isn’t he? He, like you, just joined today, but I don’t see him passing the assessment."
Lin Fan kept silent.
The young man reminded, "Stop looking at him, try it yourself."
Lin Fan nodded, focused on the assembly line in front of him, and reached out his hands...
Top-level craftsmanship skills activated!
Lin Fan’s hands flew, as fast as a phantom...
A minute went by...
Lin Fan completed 60 bonded parts...
Lin Fan looked at the number and said to the young man beside him, who was already stunned, "What did you say was the highest record again?"
The young man was dumbstruck.
What just happened? Did that really happen?
It took him a moment to come to his senses, his voice slightly trembling, "20 pieces..."
If he hadn’t seen Lin Fan operate with his own eyes, the young man would have definitely suspected the counter was broken.
Oh my god!
Lin Fan made 60 pieces in one minute!
That’s three times the top record held by Group Leader Ma!
This operation is simply astonishing!
Lin Fan smiled, "Looks like I can pass the assessment."
The young man exclaimed, "Buddy, how do you do it so fast? Oh my god, you’ve made my scalp tingle."
Despite being a young man, he was quite cute and had a gentle temperament, completely different from the yellow-haired guy.
Lin Fan was willing to chat with him, "It’s okay. I haven’t tried my best yet."
What?
The young man was awestruck, are you kidding? You haven’t even tried your best? If you did, how terrifying would that be?
Normally, people could make about a dozen pieces a minute; if Lin Fan tried his best, he might make ten times the usual amount!
Here, they pay by piece rate, so the more work, the more pay, meaning Lin Fan’s salary would be ten times that of an average person; others might earn 5000, but he’d earn 50 thousand.
The young man admired Lin Fan sincerely.
The news of the speedy hands in the workshop quickly caught the attention of the workers.
Gradually, people came over to watch Lin Fan operate.
Soon, a group of people neatly admired him on the ground.
They were all awed by Lin Fan’s godlike speed. How could someone be so fast?
"My mom asked me why I was kneeling, I said I couldn’t help it!"
"This is incredible; I used to think Group Leader Ma was amazing; now it seems he’s nothing."
"I feel like a cripple in front of him."
"Me too. I truly am clumsy."
Everyone’s hearts were full of amazement.
Not far away, He Chen lifted his head, looking towards Lin Fan’s direction, though he didn’t come over, he was aware of this matter; a newcomer with incredible speed had shocked the entire workshop.
He Chen couldn’t help but look admirably at Lin Fan, wishing he could be as fast, even half as fast as Lin Fan would be great.
This young man will definitely pass the assessment, He Chen thought, feeling somewhat down when thinking about himself...
Seeing the crowd gather to watch, Lin Fan noticed He Chen didn’t come over, but he had clearly caught He Chen’s attention.
His goal reached, Lin Fan didn’t want so many people gathering around him, so he stopped and made an excuse to go to the bathroom.
The crowd finally dispersed, each still in disbelief and shocked by Lin Fan’s speed.
Lin Fan returned from the bathroom, glancing at He Chen.
Only to find that He Chen was being scolded by the yellow-haired guy again.
"How many times have I told you, you’re doing it wrong; why can’t you get it? You’re so slow!"
The yellow-haired guy scolded He Chen unceremoniously.
He Chen replied, "Sorry, I’ll practice more."
The yellow-haired guy sneered, "Stop practicing; I think you’d better leave soon. Wasting time, damn it, looking at your age, why are you so slow!"
Because he disliked studying, performed poorly in exams, and didn’t graduate from middle school, the yellow-haired guy went out to work. Lacking knowledge or education, his only option was factory work on the assembly line.
He used to be scolded by teachers for being slow, but now he’s found his chance to scold others for being slow, and he’s relishing it.
He Chen always acted subservient and silently endured the various rudeness from the yellow-haired guy, but at this moment, a flash of anger appeared in He Chen’s turbid eyes.
"You can scold me, but don’t scold my mom," He Chen said.
The yellow-haired guy was momentarily stunned, then coldly said, "What did you say?"
He Chen said, "I said, don’t scold my mom."
The yellow-haired guy laughed, "I’ll scold her, so what can you do about it? Damn it, you’re a fool, what can you do to me?"
He Chen angrily shouted, "Shut up!"
Due to his emotional outburst, his face reddened.
The yellow-haired guy chuckled, "Oh, you’re getting angry? I thought you were a deadbeat, but you dare to get angry with me? You’re done!"
The yellow-haired guy shoved He Chen.
Being strong, He Chen was pushed back several steps due to his weak physique, ultimately nearly falling to the ground while his glasses dropped.
With a snap.
A lens cracked.
The yellow-haired guy laughed aloud, "With your build, you dare to cross me?"
Seeing this, the people around started laughing along.
Indeed, to everyone, this middle-aged uncle was too easy to bully; no one would sympathize with a weakling; instead, they’d find him ridiculous, especially since He Chen came across as a middle-aged fallen man—a failure in life.
His glasses fell, and He Chen’s vision became blurry. He reached out for his glasses, but in his haze, saw the yellow-haired guy sneering as he kicked his glasses further away.
"Go pick up your glasses! No one helps him, let’s see how he retrieves something even he can’t see," the yellow-haired guy mocked.
Everyone exchanged glances, feeling the yellow-haired guy might be a bit excessive but not daring to assist He Chen, considering the yellow-haired guy seemed hard to deal with.
At this moment, Lin Fan leisurely walked over, crouched down, and picked up He Chen’s glasses.
"Here," Lin Fan handed the glasses to He Chen.
Everyone was stunned; Lin Fan actually dared to help He Chen retrieve his glasses!
The yellow-haired guy turned to Lin Fan, instantly displeased.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: I don’t want to hit anyone unless you strike first
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 271: I don’t want to hit anyone unless you strike first
He Chen took the glasses from Lin Fan’s hand and put them on. Although one of the lenses was already cracked, it was still better than no glasses at all.
Through the lenses, He Chen could see Lin Fan clearly. So it was this young man who helped him pick up his glasses. This young man was the one who just amazed everyone with his phenomenal speed.
No one else in the entire place helped him, yet this young man did.
"Thanks," He Chen said, feeling very grateful to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan extended his hand to He Chen and pulled him up.
"Didn’t it hurt?" Lin Fan asked.
He Chen replied, "No, it’s just the glasses are broken."
Lin Fan nodded and looked at Blondie, speaking calmly, "You’ve gone too far. The uncle did nothing wrong. Insulting him is already wrong, hitting him is even worse. You should apologize to him and compensate him with a new pair of glasses."
Blondie laughed angrily, "Kid, I did hit him and insult him. So what? Mind your own business!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "We’re all colleagues here. Watching a colleague being bullied, how can you call that meddling? It’s the right thing to do; it’s called collegial friendship."
Blondie arrogantly said, "What, you want to stand up for him, huh? Do you want to hit me or something?"
Lin Fan replied, "I won’t hit you unless you strike first. Let’s be reasonable here. Why not let Group Leader Ma come and judge the matter?"
Blondie laughed loudly, "You must be new here, completely clueless. Do you know what my relationship with Group Leader Ma is? I’m his little brother-in-law! Go ahead, go complain about me and see who my brother-in-law sides with! You’re a newbie, and you dare to act tough with me without shutting up?"
Lin Fan made a sound of realization, so Blondie was related to Group Leader Ma, huh? No wonder Blondie was so arrogant, daring to openly lay hands on He Chen.
This Group Leader Ma was in charge of their workshop. In this workshop, it’s all up to Group Leader Ma. As someone new, life and death are in the hands of Group Leader Ma.
So generally, newcomers keep their heads down; even if they are cursed, they can only obediently endure it.
There are very few like Lin Fan who stand firm.
He Chen initially accepted it grudgingly, until Blondie mentioned his elderly mother, which ignited his emotions. The result was tragic, with Blondie pushing him to the ground.
Lin Fan said, "I hope Group Leader Ma can prioritize justice over family ties. That way, the problem can be resolved. But if Group Leader Ma is biased, I won’t hesitate to keep appealing and escalate to the Company leadership."
Lin Fan said this courteously.
In this matter, it was Blondie who was in the wrong, and reason was on their side. As long as they had justification, Lin Fan could guarantee they would remain undefeated.
Blondie, hearing this, was furious. This kid actually wasn’t afraid of his threats and wouldn’t submit, instead turning the table on him!
If this kid really makes a big scene up there, the situation might turn unfavorable for him.
"You little punk! I see you’re looking for trouble! Do you think you’ll get to see the leadership? You won’t because you’ll soon be kicked out!" Blondie sneered.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Is that so? If I get kicked out, I’ll call the police or contact the labor bureau. I refuse to believe I can’t get justice."
Blondie was furious. Why was this kid so stubborn? It was really frustrating!
He Chen saw how Lin Fan did not give Blondie an inch and felt a bit of admiration, a bit of gratitude, but mostly worry. He didn’t want Lin Fan to be implicated because of his matters.
"Young man, forget it. I’m okay. I think we should let it go. I don’t need him to apologize, nor do I need compensation. I’ll just consider it unlucky," He Chen advised.
Lin Fan said, "You don’t have to be afraid, uncle. He’s just a small punk. He’s wrong for bullying you, and you deserve compensation."
He Chen replied, "Well...I don’t mind anymore. I just don’t want to drag you down."
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s fine."
Blondie, at this point, was very displeased, "Who are you calling a small punk? Say it again if you dare?"
Blondie used to be a delinquent, dropping out of school, loafing around all day, and hanging out with other punks doing petty theft. Later, during one theft, he got caught and beaten up badly.
His family worried he might end up dead on the streets, so they asked Group Leader Ma to bring him here to work.
Though Blondie was a punk, he hated being called one because it hit his sore spot, reminding him of the humiliation he suffered being beaten.
Lin Fan said, "I’m saying it, so what, small punk, small punk..."
Lin Fan mimicked Blondie, with a hint of mockery.
Everyone broke out in a cold sweat, this kid was way too bold, offending the group leader’s brother-in-law like this, he probably couldn’t keep his job.
Blondie’s anger was successfully roused, and he cursed, "Little brat asking for a beating!"
Blondie reached out to push Lin Fan, intending to push him down as he did with He Chen.
However, before he could touch Lin Fan, Lin Fan’s leg flew up.
Landing right in Blondie’s abdomen.
Blondie staggered back, ultimately failing to keep his balance, falling flat on his butt, very embarrassed, causing him to grimace in pain.
