Lin Fan calmly said, "I said I wouldn’t hit unless you struck first."
Everyone was stunned, at this moment only thinking, awesome!
Lin Fan kicked the group leader’s brother-in-law without blinking.
Blondie felt like his insides were churning; the abdomen Lin Fan kicked felt like his organs had been shattered, it was indescribably uncomfortable.
Blondie realized Lin Fan was a tough character; he was no match for Lin Fan.
No wonder Lin Fan dared to stand up for He Chen; he simply didn’t take Blondie seriously!
Blondie, crying from the pain, crawled up, pointed at Lin Fan, "You wait for me!"
He didn’t dare fight Lin Fan anymore, his only option now was to get reinforcements.
Group Leader Ma!
He believed as long as he brought his brother-in-law Group Leader Ma over, he would be able to deal with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan wasn’t worried at all, chuckling, "Son, Grandpa will be waiting for you to come back."
Blondie was running off when he heard this, staggered, and nearly fell on his face.
While Blondie went to get reinforcements, Lin Fan and He Chen started talking.
He Chen sighed and said dejectedly, "Young man, it’s all my fault. Now even you’ve got to lose your job."
Lin Fan said, "Don’t worry, uncle. We have justification. We won’t lose our job because of this. As long as we can pass the assessments, that’s all."
He Chen bitterly smiled, "You’ll surely pass; I won’t. This is already my seventh job this month. If this goes on, I won’t be able to support my parents, let alone myself."
Lin Fan said, "If your speed is slow, just speed up a bit."
He Chen glanced at Lin Fan, thought of something, and embarrassedly said, "Young man, could I ask you for something? I saw you work really fast earlier. Could you teach me how to do it?"
Lin Fan replied enthusiastically, "No problem!"
He had a system task to rope in He Chen, just pitying he hadn’t had the chance yet.
So Lin Fan started to teach He Chen...
About half an hour later, Group Leader Ma hurried in with Blondie.
"Who the hell is causing trouble in my workshop? Stand forward and see how I deal with you!" Group Leader Ma yelled angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Uncle, You Try
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 272: Uncle, You Try
The yellow-haired man pointed at Lin Fan and He Chen: "It’s those two newcomers!"
Group Leader Ma’s face darkened: "You two have some nerve, causing trouble in my workshop. Do you not want to work here? If not, get out immediately!"
He Chen lowered his head, seemingly a bit fearful of Group Leader Ma. Indeed, Group Leader Ma looked quite fierce and had some authority, so the employees below didn’t dare provoke him.
Lin Fan, however, remained composed and said, "We weren’t causing trouble; it was this yellow-haired guy who started it. Group Leader Ma, as the leader, you should be fair and just. It’s right to hold him accountable."
Lin Fan put a flattering hat on Group Leader Ma’s head, and in front of everyone, Group Leader Ma couldn’t just ignore the facts.
"Cough, cough!"
Group Leader Ma cleared his throat, turned to the yellow-haired guy, and said, "What’s really going on?"
The yellow-haired guy said, "This He Chen works too slowly. I only scolded him a few times, and he got defiant, even talking back to me!"
Group Leader Ma stared at He Chen, coldly laughing: "Is that so? You’re working too slowly?"
Everyone was looking at him. He Chen, somewhat intimidated, nodded: "I am a bit slow, but..."
Group Leader Ma didn’t let him finish: "Slow in work, and you have the nerve to argue? I ordered him to take care of you; he’s like your teacher. If a student doesn’t perform well, is there anything wrong with the teacher scolding a few words? You can’t take it, and you’re defiant?"
"I..." He Chen was at a loss for words, his mouth clumsy with fear, and his face turning red.
Lin Fan chuckled: "That’s where you’re wrong. Although the uncle works slowly, he’s been practicing very hard. The uncle doesn’t refuse guidance, but this yellow-haired guy went too far, verbally insulting and crossing the uncle’s line. That’s why the uncle talked back, and then this yellow-haired guy pushed the uncle to the ground. Group Leader Ma, don’t you think the yellow-haired guy’s actions were wrong? That would make your company inhumane."
Group Leader Ma’s face darkened, sweeping a glance over everyone, saying: "Is what he said true? Did anyone see?"
The fierce glance swept past, and everyone lowered their heads.
No one spoke.
Even if Lin Fan was telling the truth, no one dared to stand up for him. It seemed they all cherished their jobs and didn’t want to risk losing them for someone unrelated, as offending Group Leader Ma could mean walking out the door at any moment.
Seeing this, a flash of disappointment crossed He Chen’s eyes, yet he became increasingly grateful to Lin Fan. The only person willing to help him in the entire room was Lin Fan.
Lin Fan wasn’t afraid of offending Group Leader Ma, constantly defending him, which was truly remarkable. He Chen was very touched.
Group Leader Ma saw no one answering and coldly laughed: "You see, no one saw it. Are you falsely accusing people?"
Lin Fan smiled: "They are just afraid of offending you, but facts are facts. They won’t change just because they’re afraid to step forward."
Group Leader Ma snorted: "Without evidence, you’re slandering good people! I’ll deal with He Chen first, and then I’ll get to you!"
Group Leader Ma asked the yellow-haired guy: "How many can He Chen make in a minute?"
The yellow-haired guy said: "About seven or so."
Group Leader Ma shook his head: "Damn, that’s too slow, not even passing! Most people do ten or more! He Chen, with such slow work and a bad attitude, do you still want to work here?"
He Chen said: "I’m sorry, I was indeed a bit slow before..."
Group Leader Ma wasn’t listening, raising his voice and laughing: "Everyone might not know who He Chen is; I happened to know he graduated as a doctor from the best university in Huaxia. You heard right, he’s a doctor..."
Everyone was surprised.
"Damn, he’s a doctor?"
"A doctor from the best university?"
"How is it possible? Must be a mistake, what does a doctor need to do working on an assembly line with us?"
"Exactly, shouldn’t a doctor have a much more decent job?"
The crowd chattered, not believing Group Leader Ma’s words. After all, it was truly unbelievable for a doctor to work on an assembly line.
Listening to these words, He Chen lowered his head, feeling extremely embarrassed and uncomfortable, his face turning even redder, wishing he could find a hole to hide in.
Group Leader Ma laughed: "Yes, Dr. He, why did you come and mix with us? You as a doctor, aren’t you too much of a failure? So what happened to you? Would you like to tell everyone?"
He Chen: "..."
Kept his head down, not responding.
Group Leader Ma got bolder: "Is it hard to say? Then let me say it for you. This Dr. He used to work on rockets, and due to his mistake, the rocket launch failed. He even got into a fight, ruined his life, the company closed down, he got caught and jailed for a year for fighting, no job, no income, and no one dared to hire him, so he came to work as a factory hand. Dr. He, am I right?"
He Chen still kept his head down, but his fist was tightly clenched, seemingly enduring an unspeakable agony.
Suddenly, he seemed to muster up the courage, lifted his head abruptly, and said word by word: "I didn’t hit anyone!"
Group Leader Ma laughed: "Didn’t hit? The court already ruled, are you saying they wronged you? I saw the whole process of your case back then."
He Chen seemed unable to respond, lowering his head again.
Everyone looked at each other.
"So that’s what happened, no wonder!"
"So he’s that kind of guy!"
"It seems he has a temper, no wonder he talked back today."
Group Leader Ma added: "Dr. He, don’t forget, you asked me to give you a chance. I gave you a chance, but you didn’t cherish it, so I’m sorry."
Lin Fan chuckled: "So, Group Leader Ma is planning to eliminate him on the grounds of his slow work, is that it? What if he passes the assessment?"
Group Leader Ma coldly laughed: "You have an issue again? It’s not that I don’t give chances; he can only do seven a minute. How can he pass the assessment?"
Lin Fan said: "He was slow before, maybe it’s not his fault, and maybe it’s because the yellow-haired guy can’t teach."
Hearing this, the yellow-haired guy got angry, shouting: "He’s stupid, can you blame me?"
If he didn’t know he couldn’t beat Lin Fan, he would have rushed to hit him.
Lin Fan said: "Group Leader Ma, why not give He Chen a chance to be assessed by you directly? If He Chen is still slow, then fire him, and no one will object."
Group Leader Ma said: "I’m not an unreasonable person, fine, I’ll convince you to accept it. He Chen, if you can do ten or more in a minute, I’ll keep you temporarily. If not, you’ll leave yourself!"
Lin Fan nodded at He Chen, encouraging: "Uncle, give it a try."
He Chen responded and walked to the assembly line.
The timing started!
He Chen’s hands moved skillfully.
After one minute.
The number on the counter was surprisingly 25!
The entire room went silent.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Lin Fan looked at He Chen and smiled slightly: "How about that? I heard the previous record of 20 was held by Group Leader Ma, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Excuse Me, Which One is Mr. Lin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 273: Excuse Me, Which One is Mr. Lin?
Satire, pure satire.
The numbers on the counter pierced Group Leader Ma’s heart like a sharp blade.
He Chen actually did 25 in a minute? 5 more than Group Leader Ma?
Something must be wrong!
Group Leader Ma thought, it must be so, otherwise, how could He Chen suddenly become so good? Huang Mao wouldn’t dare to lie to him, saying He Chen did 7 before; that’s 7. To suddenly jump from 7 to 25, that’s simply impossible!
"What good is it to do fast? You also have to look at the quality. If the quality isn’t up to par, no matter how fast you do it, it’s useless!" Group Leader Ma sneered.
He walked forward, trying to find fault in He Chen’s work.
The result!
All 25 parts were done well, even reaching a high-quality standard, simply fast and good, with no defects at all.
Group Leader Ma couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat.
Even if he didn’t want to admit it, under everyone’s watch, He Chen did indeed do very well!
Impeccably well!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "So, Group Leader Ma, can He Chen pass your evaluation? I said it was because Huang Mao couldn’t teach."
Huang Mao was extremely shocked at this moment, dumbfounded, watching with his own eyes how fast He Chen was working — it was so unbelievable.
"How could this be... He was clearly very slow before. Was he pretending?" Huang Mao couldn’t help but hiss.
Lin Fan said, "He wasn’t pretending. He was indeed very slow when learning from you. After my guidance, he got faster. This shows you truly can’t teach."
It was logical and well-reasoned, hard to refute.
Huang Mao was momentarily at a loss for words, his face turning red, even doubting himself — was it really because I couldn’t teach?
Group Leader Ma was a bit surprised and said, "You mean it’s you who taught him to be so fast?"
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s right, I taught him."
Group Leader Ma asked, "How many can you do in a minute?"
Lin Fan calmly said, "If I just do it casually, about 60, but if I go fast, I might break 100."
Group Leader Ma’s face turned cold, "Stop bragging, I’m talking about one minute, not one hour!"
Lin Fan said, "I’m talking about one minute. Many people here know this. If you don’t believe, you can ask Huang Mao."
Group Leader Ma looked at the young man responsible for guiding Lin Fan, "Little Yang, tell me, how many can he do in a minute?"
The young man was initially hiding on the side, not wanting to get involved, but when asked by Group Leader Ma, he had to muster his courage and said, "He indeed did 60 in a minute, I saw it with my own eyes, and many others here know it too..."
Seeing the young man speak up, everyone else nodded in agreement.
Group Leader Ma still didn’t believe it and turned to ask Huang Mao, "You tell me, is it true?"
Huang Mao wanted to deny it but couldn’t, since everyone saw it, and if Lin Fan decided to display his skills, any lies would be exposed, so lying was meaningless.
Huang Mao could only nod, "Yes, it’s true."
Group Leader Ma was stunned.
Even Huang Mao confirmed it, so it must be true. Lin Fan really did 60 in a minute!
Group Leader Ma’s record was 20, a full three times less!
Could there really be someone this fast in the world?
This was practically light speed, terrifying.
One thing Group Leader Ma had always been proud of was the record he set that no one had been able to break. He was like an unsurpassable peak, basking in admiration and praise as the leader of this workshop. Everyone strove to catch up with him, and he was the eternal god!
Now, Lin Fan emerged out of nowhere, stealing the limelight that was supposed to belong to him.
And it wasn’t just any ordinary spotlight theft; it was three times, even five times overwhelming!
The tallest tree catches the wind!
Group Leader Ma instantly formed an idea — Lin Fan couldn’t stay!
He Chen couldn’t stay either!
Their presence robbed him of all his glory.
He, Group Leader Ma, was supposed to be the god worshipped by everyone in this workshop. He couldn’t allow anyone to surpass him, much less tolerate being crushed.
Otherwise, with two newcomers beating him down, how could he hold his head up as the leader?
Lin Fan naturally understood the principle of the tallest tree catching the wind. As a newcomer, no matter how capable you are, you should hide your light. If you show off too much, it will slap the leader in the face, leaving him disgraced. Such a job becomes very risky.
Lin Fan wasn’t a workplace novice, but rather somewhat of an old hand. If he were truly here to work, he would try to keep a low profile.
But he wasn’t truly here for the job; he didn’t care about it at all. His only goal was to win over He Chen, the rest was just supporting tactics, and he didn’t need to follow these so-called workplace rules.
"No matter how capable you both are, so what? Here, besides personal ability, we also look at character and attitude. You two, causing trouble on a trial job, have a problematic attitude. It’s a pity, but both of you cannot stay!" Group Leader Ma said coldly.
Lin Fan said, "Is that so? The evaluation wasn’t the problem, so now you’re focusing on attitude. I believe our attitudes are just fine."
Group Leader Ma angrily said, "I see that your attitude now is problematic. I am your superior, so can you speak to me in such a manner, with no respect?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m just reasoning with you, how is that a bad attitude? Just because you say it’s bad, it is?"
Group Leader Ma said, "That’s right; I call the shots here. In this workshop, everything must listen to me. I now announce that you both didn’t pass the evaluation, so you can leave!"
Lin Fan said, "You’re just a small group leader, wielding petty authority. Since we can’t clear this up here, I’ll take it up with your direct superior."
Group Leader Ma was very angry, "I make the decisions here. Going to my superior won’t help you. Not to mention whether they have time to deal with you, even if you tell them, it won’t work. If you don’t believe me, go ahead and try!"
The workshop was under Group Leader Ma’s management, and he truly didn’t believe his superior would side against him for two newcomers.
Group Leader Ma was confident.
Everyone else also felt that Lin Fan and He Chen were definitely going to be kicked out. Being defiant on someone else’s turf — wasn’t that looking for trouble!
"What’s going on here, why so lively?"
Suddenly, a voice came through, and a potbellied middle-aged man approached, dressed in fine clothes, his skin well-kept and fair, clearly accustomed to a life of comfort and luxury.
Seeing this middle-aged man, everyone’s expressions changed, and even Group Leader Ma shivered and quickly approached to greet him.
"President Wang, why have you come?" Group Leader Ma asked with a sycophantic smile.
This middle-aged man was none other than the president of this toy factory, Wang Pengyu!
He founded Pengyu Toy Factory single-handedly and held significant power within Pengyu. As president, Wang Pengyu had a great deal of authority, able to make decisions on all matters.
Therefore, everyone in the factory respected Wang Pengyu immensely, not daring to offend him in the slightest.
Wang Pengyu, however, ignored Group Leader Ma, looking around at everyone, and said, "I heard Mr. Lin, Lin Fan, is here. May I ask who Mr. Lin is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Do You Know Whom You Have Offended This Time?
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 274: Do You Know Whom You Have Offended This Time?
Lin Fan was a bit puzzled. He was sure he didn’t know Wang Pengyu, yet Wang Pengyu came looking for him?
"I am Lin Fan," Lin Fan said.
Wang Pengyu immediately put on a friendly smile, "Mr. Lin, could we have a word in private?"
Lin Fan nodded and followed Wang Pengyu out.
Leaving everyone looking at each other in confusion.
Group Leader Ma was immediately a bit anxious. The look on President Wang’s face just now seemed quite respectful towards Lin Fan. This was not a good sign.
Wang Pengyu led Lin Fan outside, and seeing no one around, quickly put on a pleasing smile: "Mr. Lin, I am the CEO here, my name is Wang Pengyu. It’s an honor to meet you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan asked curiously, "Do you know me?"
Wang Pengyu said, "Mr. Lin’s name is well-known in the Yun City business community—it’s truly renowned. Miss Feng told me you’re working at my factory, which gave me quite a scare."
Lin Fan finally understood. It must be his super-rich sister who instructed Wang Pengyu to look after him; she’s always protective, worried he might suffer here.
It was indeed so.
Wang Pengyu had suddenly received a call from Feng Ruolan today, saying her younger brother would be working at his toy factory, causing Wang Pengyu to break out in a cold sweat.
Feng Ruolan, the financial powerhouse, who always oversaw the loans for Wang Pengyu’s company.
Wang Pengyu practically worshipped Feng Ruolan like a great aunt.
The great aunt’s brother wanted to work at his factory?
Wang Pengyu was quite frightened. What are these super-rich tycoons doing? Do they enjoy experiencing normal life? Please don’t make me your plaything!
Without saying anything, Wang Pengyu quickly agreed. Judging by Feng Ruolan’s tone, if Lin Fan even lost a hair at his factory, he might not even be able to keep it. How could he dare to have any negligence!
Just the identity of being "Feng Ruolan’s brother" made Wang Pengyu treat Lin Fan like an ancestor.
Later, Wang Pengyu discovered that Lin Fan turned out to be the recently rising young tycoon!
Though shocked, Wang Pengyu was quite puzzled.
Why would someone like Lin Fan need to work at his factory? Could it really be just to experience life?
Wang Pengyu felt uneasy for a while, unsure of Lin Fan’s intentions. He thought it was likely that he might offend Lin Fan, so after much contemplation, he decided to personally seek Lin Fan and ask directly.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "President Wang, don’t be nervous. My presence here is without malice and won’t interfere with your business."
Wang Pengyu said cautiously, "May I ask why Mr. Lin is here? If you need my assistance, please don’t hesitate to ask."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "President Wang can indeed help me..."
Back in the workshop.
Everyone waited for Wang Pengyu and Lin Fan, curious about what Wang Pengyu wanted to discuss with Lin Fan.
At this moment, Lin Fan and Wang Pengyu came in.
Wang Pengyu cleared his throat and his gaze fell on Group Leader Ma: "I’ve heard the situation from Mr. Lin. Xiao Ma, what’s going on? You want to dismiss these two?"
Group Leader Ma was taken aback and said stiffly, "It’s like this, President Wang, they both had an attitude problem..."
Wang Pengyu’s expression darkened, "An attitude problem? I think it’s you who has an attitude problem! Mr. Lin has already told me everything. It was Huang Mao who insulted He Chen first and pushed him down. Mr. Lin was just standing up for him. Such behavior should be commended. Why is it, in your perspective, an attitude problem?"
Group Leader Ma broke out in a cold sweat: "..."
Unable to respond.
Wang Pengyu continued, "Huang Mao is your brother-in-law, right? To protect your brother-in-law, you are twisting the facts and unable to distinguish right from wrong, firstly. I’ve heard your intention to dismiss Mr. Lin and He Chen due to jealousy of their speed and the use of trumped-up charges, infringing on the company’s interests and almost causing us to lose outstanding talent, secondly. Your attitude has a problem, I see!"
Group Leader Ma was so shocked that his face turned white, and he kneeled to the floor.
"President Wang, I lost my senses. After President Wang’s guidance, I’ve realized my mistake. I hope President Wang gives me another chance," Group Leader Ma pleaded.
Wang Pengyu snorted coldly, "You’ve greatly disappointed me. Your actions are utterly unforgivable. If everyone in the Company were like you, the Company wouldn’t last long. I cannot allow you to stay. I announce that you are dismissed."
Group Leader Ma was left aghast and cried in fear, "President Wang, I’ve realized my mistake, please spare me this time. I won’t dare ever again."
But Wang Pengyu wouldn’t allow him to say more, saying coldly, "You can handle your resignation now. Also, take your brother-in-law with you. I don’t want to see you again."
Group Leader Ma continued to beg for mercy.
But Wang Pengyu called two security guards and had Group Leader Ma and Huang Mao removed.
Everyone stood in shock.
President Wang was too ruthless, directly dismissing the group leader!
No need to ask: this is all because of Lin Fan. Just who is this Lin Fan that even President Wang has to show him face?
No one could think of Lin Fan’s identity because the reality was unimaginable—a billionaire on a production line job?
At most, they could only guess that Lin Fan might be related to President Wang.
Group Leader Ma thought he was doing pretty well but ended up provoking someone he couldn’t, as Lin Fan’s backer was President Wang. Group Leader Ma walked right into the trap!
After dealing with Group Leader Ma and Huang Mao, Wang Pengyu said, "Both Mr. Lin and Mr. He have done well. I announce they have passed the evaluation and become full-time employees of our factory. Everyone, give them a round of applause!"
The workshop resounded with thunderous applause.
Regardless of their willingness, no one dared to not applaud when President Wang did. Of course, most were willing because Lin Fan and He Chen were indeed impressive, which had to be respected.
Wang Pengyu continued, "Mr. Lin is a miracle of speed. After his guidance, He Chen’s speed has greatly improved. I plan to invite Mr. Lin to serve as a training instructor for everyone to help improve speed. Do you all agree?"
"We agree!"
Everyone responded in unison, getting very excited. Lin Fan was truly remarkable, and if they could learn his methods, efficiency would surely increase, meaning so would their wages.
No one would oppose higher wages, so naturally, no one objected.
Thus, Lin Fan became a workshop trainer and stayed on.
President Wang soon said he had some matters to attend to and left.
Once outside the workshop, Wang Pengyu breathed a long sigh of relief.
The task Lin Fan had entrusted him with earlier was to ensure that both Lin Fan and He Chen stayed, and he also asked Wang Pengyu not to reveal his identity for the time being.
Wang Pengyu did exactly that and, to ensure Lin Fan’s satisfaction, took strong actions against Group Leader Ma and Huang Mao.
Although he still didn’t know what Lin Fan was up to, Wang Pengyu was relieved as long as he could help.
Wang Pengyu then returned to the office building and ran into Group Leader Ma, who was handling his resignation.
Group Leader Ma approached, crying, to plead with Wang Pengyu for forgiveness. He had worked hard to become a group leader and didn’t want to lose the good job.
Wang Pengyu pulled him aside and coldly said, "Do you know whom you offended this time?"
When Wang Pengyu revealed Lin Fan’s identity.
"What?"
Group Leader Ma’s expression drastically changed, his face pale as death, as if he had suffered a great blow, feeling even a bit terrified.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: I Am Your Only Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 275: I Am Your Only Chance
Lin Fan, a person he could never afford to provoke!
After that, Group Leader Ma bowed his head, said no more, and didn’t plead for mercy. He hastily processed his resignation, took Blonde Hair with him, and left in disgrace.
Workshop, by this time Lin Fan had already begun training the employees.
He had the reward of top-notch craftsmanship skills. As long as it involved craftsmanship, inspiration flowed like a fountain, and he could do everything quickly and well.
This kind of skill could be taught to others.
Under Lin Fan’s guidance, by the end of the morning, even the slowest employee had managed to surpass 20 pieces.
Originally, because no one could exceed making 20 pieces in a minute, Group Leader Ma, who was extremely proud, had now fallen to the bottom...
The employees were all very happy, everyone knelt before Lin Fan, completely convinced and obedient.
He Chen was also very grateful to Lin Fan. If not for Lin Fan, he surely wouldn’t have kept his job; it was Lin Fan who helped him turn the tide!
Today, he was bullied by Group Leader Ma and Blonde Hair, and everyone else stood by as bystanders, only Lin Fan extended a helping hand.
He Chen held Lin Fan in high esteem.
Unknowingly, the morning passed, and it was time for lunch.
He Chen went to the cafeteria, ordered a meal, and sat alone in a corner to eat.
"May I sit here?" a voice asked.
He Chen looked up to see Lin Fan smiling and standing across from him with his meal.
He Chen hurriedly said, "Please, sit."
Lin Fan sat down across from He Chen.
"So, how is it? Do you think this job is okay?" Lin Fan asked.
He Chen showed a rare hint of a smile, "Not bad, thank you. If it weren’t for your help, I wouldn’t have gotten this job opportunity either."
Lin Fan said, "Mr. He, no need to be polite, it was just a small effort."
He Chen felt a bit embarrassed, "Please don’t call me that, if you don’t mind, you can just call me Old He."
Lin Fan smiled and nodded, "Sure, Old He."
He Chen said, "Maybe it doesn’t mean much to you, but this job is very important to me. Finally, I can make a living with this job."
Lin Fan responded, "Oh, Old He, it seems you really need a job. If I told you there’s an even better job available, would you be interested?"
He Chen asked curiously, "What job?"
Lin Fan casually said three words, "Building rockets."
At this moment, He Chen had just taken a bite of rice; upon hearing this, he spat out the rice with a puff, coughed vigorously, and his face turned red.
This reaction caused those nearby to look over, thinking something was wrong with He Chen.
Lin Fan, sweating, hadn’t expected such a strong reaction from He Chen upon hearing the words "building rockets." He hurriedly handed He Chen some water.
He Chen took a few sips, finally stopped coughing, calmed down, and smiled bitterly, "Why make such a joke?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m not joking; I’m serious. To be honest, I came here today specifically for you; I hope you can help me."
He Chen looked at Lin Fan in surprise, seeing that Lin Fan didn’t seem to be joking at all, which only left him more astonished.
He took some time to realize Lin Fan was serious and genuinely planning to build rockets!
He Chen’s expression changed again, this time becoming icy, a look Lin Fan hadn’t seen before.
"Sorry, Mr. Lin, I’m afraid I can’t help you. I once swore I wouldn’t touch this again in my life. I’m sorry to disappoint you," He Chen said coldly.
Only someone truly disheartened would react in this way.
Although Lin Fan had helped him today, it was far from enough to change his mind.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, as if he had anticipated this, and said, "Old He, I know what happened to you. Three years ago, the transport rocket you led the development of failed at launch and exploded before it could lift off. It was your life’s work, and you were devastated. But that wasn’t even the hardest blow. You faced disdain from all sides after your failure; your investors insulted you and clamored for withdrawal of funds. Unwilling to accept failure, you clashed with them in the heat of the moment and were subsequently besieged. In the chaos, someone fell and got a fracture. The injured person counter-accused you of assault, and others testified against you, leading to your arrest and a year-long sentence. You were released just a week ago."
He Chen looked at Lin Fan, surprised, as Lin Fan spoke vividly, as if he had witnessed it personally, yet everything he said was true.
However, the truth was only known to the people involved back then, as He Chen had been wrongfully imprisoned.
"You know I was wronged?" He Chen got a bit emotional.
The incident had hit him so hard that it broke him completely; the former rocket genius had fallen, becoming haggard, disillusioned, and slow, as if aging ten years overnight.
Lin Fan said, "Not only do I know you were wronged, but I also know deep down, you are still unwilling to accept that failure; you still want to prove yourself, don’t you?"
He Chen remained silent.
His silence was because Lin Fan had struck a chord with him.
After a long while, He Chen slowly spoke.
"Mr. Lin, you don’t have to say anything more. Knowing that you understand I’ve been wronged, I’m already deeply grateful. But I’ve really sworn not to touch rockets again. Whether willing or unwilling, I’m a failure with no right to start over."
Lin Fan replied, "I completely understand your feelings; you’re afraid of failure again, of repeating the past; otherwise, you’d truly be finished. So you’re resisting the possibility of it happening. Besides, even if you wanted to start over, there’s no opportunity for you, being someone with a record; in this country, at least, no one would give you a chance."
He Chen remained silent; Lin Fan’s words pierced straight to the heart.
Lin Fan smiled and continued, "But I can see you’re not willing; some people are destined for greatness, and you’re one of them. A dragon trapped in shallow waters is only because of circumstances. How could you truly be content working on a toy assembly line for the rest of your life? Deep down, you still long for the vast sea where you can sail against the wind and waves. If you come, I will use my most powerful legal team to help overturn your case. I’ll provide you ample funds and freedom to develop rockets. I’ll help you leave the shallow waters and return to the sea. I’m your only chance. Here’s my number; if you change your mind, feel free to contact me."
Lin Fan placed a note in front of He Chen.
Then he stood up and left without looking back.
He Chen stared at the note on the table, Lin Fan’s words echoing in his ears, stunned.
At the entrance of the toy factory.
Lin Fan walked out.
At the recruitment office at the entrance, the old woman in charge of hiring was still sitting there and saw Lin Fan walking towards the electric scooter parked nearby. She couldn’t help but laugh coldly.
"I told you, with that delicate skin, you couldn’t handle it. See, you’ve been driven away!"
The old woman mocked Lin Fan mercilessly.
"Shut up!"
Suddenly, a voice scolded angrily as Wang Pengyu came over from the side, reprimanding with a stern face, "How dare you speak to Mr. Lin like this? You’re fired!"
After scolding the old woman, Wang Pengyu scurried over to Lin Fan with an ingratiating smile, "Mr. Lin, you’re leaving?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’ve done what I needed to do; today has truly been a disruption for President Wang. I owe President Wang a favor."
Wang Pengyu was overjoyed inside; to have Mr. Lin owe a favor, it was fantastic, like having a life-saving talisman!
"Thank you, Mr. Lin; have a safe journey," Wang Pengyu said happily.
Lin Fan then rode his small electric scooter away.
Wang Pengyu respectfully watched Lin Fan depart.
Behind him, witnessing this scene, the old woman had turned to stone.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: How Awesome the Su Family Is, No Need for Me to Say More Right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 276: How Awesome the Su Family Is, No Need for Me to Say More Right?
Lin Fan rode the electric scooter, leaving the toy factory with Wang Pengyu seeing him off.
This time he came to win over He Chen, he had done all he could, and next, it was up to He Chen.
Lin Fan opened the Inner Vision System interface.
"Task: Win over He Chen.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 80/100"
Lin Fan was quite satisfied with the progress, which was also the reason he felt assured leaving. He couldn’t push He Chen too hard, giving him some time, he’d come around.
Lin Fan was driving when he suddenly received a call from Feng Ruolan.
"Little Fan, did you have fun at the toy factory?" Feng Ruolan asked with a smile.
Lin Fan laughed, "It was okay, but I’ve already left. By the way, thank you, sis."
Feng Ruolan said, "Why thank me?"
Lin Fan said, "Wasn’t it you who asked Wang Pengyu to look after me?"
Feng Ruolan giggled, "I just gave him a heads-up. I don’t want any blind fools messing with my brother."
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, his wealthy sister was so good to him. Although this should be a system setting, Lin Fan was still very moved. He didn’t have a sister, but a brother, and he had always doted on his younger sister. Being pampered by a sister felt nice.
Feng Ruolan said, "I have a very important meeting later, so I won’t chat with you for now. Little Fan, if you have time, come to sister’s house. Sister’s house is your home."
"Alright," Lin Fan said.
After hanging up the call, just as Lin Fan was about to get back on the scooter, another call came in. Lin Fan saw that it was from Su Jinjin.
It’s been a few days since he last saw Su Jinjin.
Since Lin Fan helped Su Jinjin establish her position in the Su family, she’d been busy with family affairs, only occasionally finding time to chat with Lin Fan quickly on WeChat.
Lin Fan answered the call with a smile, "Jinjin? How do you have time to call me today?"
Su Jinjin apologetically said, "Sorry Lin Fan, I’ve been busy these days. Today I’m feeling a bit unwell, so I took half a day off and wanted to ask if you’re available?"
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, what’s bothering you? I’ll come pick you up to see a doctor?"
Su Jinjin said, "No need to go to the hospital, it’s nothing serious, I just wanted... to have lunch with you."
Turns out, she wanted to have a date with Lin Fan.
It just so happened that Lin Fan was free, he said, "Alright, I’ll come pick you up. Where are you?"
Su Jinjin said, "I’m at the Su Corporation."
The Su Corporation is the Su family’s main business. The Su family had made their fortune from factory business starting from Elder Su.
Since Elder Su passed away, the power of the Su family fell into the hands of Madam Su, but she wasn’t good at management, and the Su Corporation gradually declined.
Until Lin Fan brought a big order to the Su family, its revival seemed possible.
To curry favor with Lin Fan, Madam Su promoted Su Jinjin and let her manage company affairs, opening up the possibility for Su Jinjin to become the next generation inheritor of the Su family.
Therefore, Su Jinjin had been busy with the transfer of company affairs and had been extremely busy, having long wanted to see Lin Fan but couldn’t find the time.
Finally, she was free today.
Thinking of the imminent meeting with Lin Fan, Su Jinjin’s heart raced a bit, as though returning to their university days and their first date.
As each other’s first love, back then Lin Fan pursued Su Jinjin, and she agreed without hesitation.
If it weren’t for the opposition from the Su family, perhaps they’d already be married by now, maybe even have kids.
Thinking of this, Su Jinjin felt a pang of regret.
At the time, Lin Fan was just a poor guy, and the Su family fiercely opposed Su Jinjin dating Lin Fan, with Madam Su personally intervening to forcibly break them apart.
No one expected that three years later, Lin Fan would become someone the Su family couldn’t hope to reach.
The Su family even needed Lin Fan’s charity order to barely survive.
Thirty years up the east river, thirty years down the west river, so true indeed!
Noon, at the entrance of the Su Corporation.
Lin Fan arrived on the electric scooter, parked, and called Su Jinjin as he walked to the entrance.
Su Jinjin said she’d be out soon.
Lin Fan just hung up the phone when a security guard came over, looking at Lin Fan suspiciously.
"What are you here for?" the security guard asked gruffly. Seeing Lin Fan in cheap market clothes riding a broken electric scooter, the guard was sure Lin Fan was just a poor guy and didn’t need to be polite at all.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m waiting for someone."
The security guard said, "You need to step aside if you’re waiting for someone. This is the entrance of the Su Corporation."
Lin Fan said, "I’m waiting for someone from the Su Corporation."
The security guard said, "You must be a boyfriend of a female employee here, sorry, but you still need to stand aside and not block us."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "How am I blocking you?"
The guard sneered, "Look at you, just a pathetic loser, right? With you standing at our company’s entrance, it drags down our image, doesn’t it? Our clients will have a bad impression, doesn’t that count as blocking us?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh really, does your Su Corporation have any clients to show besides the Blue Moon order?"
Just then, two young men walked out, hearing what Lin Fan said, instantly displeased.
"Kid, what nonsense are you talking?"
"How dare you mock our Su family?"
Turns out these two were from the Su family.
Lin Fan smiled lightly, "Did I say anything wrong?"
The two young men were indeed from the Su family, which had declined in recent years, making the Su family descendants unable to hold their heads high, hence becoming psychologically fragile and sensitive.
Recently, due to the big order from Blue Moon, the Su family showed signs of resurgence, allowing their descendants to lift their heads slightly.
So faced with Lin Fan’s words, the two Su family members had some confidence to retort.
"You know about our big order from Blue Moon, right? It’s not a random company that can have it. Behind Blue Moon is the renowned Mr. Lin!"
"That’s right, throughout Yun City, only our Su family secured this order. We beat out much stronger competitors, you don’t need me to say how amazing our Su family is!"
The two Su family youths began bragging, making the Blue Moon deal sound spectacular, almost like a blossoming flower.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but find it amusing. Who would know better than him why the Blue Moon order landed in the Su family’s lap?
It was entirely because of Su Jinjin.
Yet, these Su family members were now bragging about this order as proof of the Su family’s prowess, an utterly laughable and tear-jerking sight.
Moreover, they had no clue about Lin Fan, who gave them this big order...
"Hey security, who is this guy?" A Su family member pointed at Lin Fan and asked the guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 Identity Exposed, Su Family Disciples Scared to Tears
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 277 Identity Exposed, Su Family Disciples Scared to Tears
The security guard said, "He said he’s waiting for someone, probably a boyfriend of one of our company’s female employees!"
The two Su family members laughed upon hearing this.
"Haha, so he’s our employee’s boyfriend."
"Who’s your girlfriend? Tell us."
"To have the nerve to mock our Su family, your girlfriend better not think she can stay in our company!"
"Say it, and I’ll fire her right in front of you!"
The two Su family members continued arrogantly, taking turns to speak, clearly enjoying the rare chance to show off and not willing to let it pass.
The Su family was merely a second-rate family, and in recent years, they’d fallen on hard times, making it more common for Su family members to be ridiculed in elite circles.
Now, due to the Blue Moon deal, the Su family members could hold their heads high again, yet Madam Su had specifically instructed the entire Su family to stay low-key, be discreet, knowing the big order would invite jealousy; caution was necessary.
Constrained by Madam Su, the Su family members dared not flaunt too much among the elite and still kept a low profile.
But this Lin Fan in front of them, dressed in cheap market clothes, was evidently not from the elite circles, a perfect target for them to show off.
A boyfriend of a female employee, haha, no harm in bullying him a bit.
So the two Su family members put on airs as if they were dealing with millions.
They claimed they’d fire Lin Fan’s girlfriend right before his eyes, feeling quite satisfied with their act, giving themselves full marks.
Lin Fan must be scared shitless.
After all, Lin Fan surely wouldn’t want his girlfriend to lose her job, so he’d bow and scrape before them, offer apologies, and play the fool to keep her employed.
This feeling of toying with someone at their mercy, the Su family members hadn’t experienced it for a long time and found it immensely pleasurable.
They’d never imagine that showing off in front of Lin Fan would be courting death.
Lin Fan smiled, "She’s not quite my girlfriend, just a former one."
The two Su family members shared a glance and laughed.
"Not bad, kid, lying to protect your girlfriend’s job."
"Even if you lie, it won’t work. Even if she’s your ex, we’ll still fire her!"
"Kid, are you scared? If you are, get on your knees and apologize to us!"
The two Su family members boasted arrogantly, and the security guard nearby also laughed, waiting to see Lin Fan make a fool of himself.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Really? You want me to kneel and apologize?"
The two Su family members remained arrogant.
"Exactly, for having the audacity to mock our Su family."
"Who do you think you are to mock our Su family!"
Lin Fan uttered an ’oh’ and looked in a direction, "Jinjin, they said they want to fire you, what do you think? What’s the status of these two guys in the Su family, do they have the power to sack you?"
At this point, Su Jinjin had already walked out.
Su Jinjin heard Lin Fan’s words and was a bit confused: "What do you mean? Fire me? I told you two to go with a shipment, why are you still here dawdling?"
Su Jinjin looked at the two Su family members, frowning, clearly dissatisfied with them.
The two Su family members were stunned.
"Th-Third sister..."
"Third sister, he’s waiting for you?"
Su Jinjin said, "Is there a problem?"
The two realized something, their faces changed dramatically.
Lin Fan was waiting for Su Jinjin!
Lin Fan just referred to Su Jinjin as his ex-girlfriend!
Su Jinjin’s ex-boyfriend, wasn’t he the legendary Mr. Lin!
Could this kid in cheap clothes actually be Mr. Lin?
The two Su family members turned pale.
Lin Fan then said, "Nothing major happened, just a small dispute. Earlier, this security guard didn’t let me stand at the entrance, said I was affecting your company’s image, and these two show-offs claimed they’d fire my ex-girlfriend in front of me."
Upon hearing this, Su Jinjin broke into a cold sweat, damn, these three were really blind as bats, failing to recognize Mount Tai, daring to offend Lin Fan like this!
"Third sister, who... who is he?" one of the Su family members asked tremblingly.
Su Jinjin said, "He is Lin Fan."
Lin Fan!
The two Su family members’ legs gave out, both kneeling.
Lin Fan, the legendary mysterious billionaire Mr. Lin, who bought Yunding Manor for 3 billion yuan!
Su Jinjin’s ex-boyfriend, currently the CEO of the Su family!
To help Su Jinjin establish herself in the Su family, Mr. Lin gave the Su family the big Blue Moon order, giving the sinking ship of the Su family a chance to rise again.
Mr. Lin was so powerful that just lifting a finger could decide the Su family’s fate.
Mr. Lin raising a finger, means a life-saving order for the family.
Mr. Lin lowering his hand, and the Su family might not even have food to eat.
Such a formidable person was standing right before them!
Yet, they had the nerve to show off before Mr. Lin! They even claimed they’d fire Mr. Lin’s ex-girlfriend, who is now their CEO, someone they couldn’t possibly provoke!
Even worse, they arrogantly demanded that Lin Fan kneel before them, which was utterly suicidal!
The two Su family members were scared shitless, trembling uncontrollably, utterly at a loss.
If Mr. Lin got angry, canceled the order, or even wiped out the Su family, they’d become the eternal sinners of the Su family, and Madam Su would certainly not spare them first.
The security guard, seeing the two Su family members kneel merely upon hearing Lin Fan’s name, stood there dumbfounded.
Both dumbfounded and anxious, damn it, sensing something bad was going down here.
"We didn’t know you were Mr. Lin, we deeply apologize, please forgive us this time, Mr. Lin!"
"It was our fault for being blind, we didn’t recognize you, please, Mr. Lin, don’t hold a grudge, forgive us."
The two Su family members pleaded piteously.
Lin Fan said calmly, "It was indeed a misunderstanding, but it does highlight some issues. Jinjin, they’re your people, handle it as you see fit."
Su Jinjin was really angry, she had finally managed to free her schedule today, invited Lin Fan over for a meeting, initially in a great mood, looking forward to seeing Lin Fan.
She never expected these three blind fools would offend Lin Fan.
Moreover, as Lin Fan said, it did reveal some issues.
Lin Fan was merely waiting out front, yet the security guard wanted to chase him away, lacked human decency. The Su family, a declining company, was so arrogant, no wonder it had fallen.
This attitude cannot continue any longer.
"You two don’t bother with the shipment, I told you to arrange it, yet you created trouble, just go home!" Su Jinjin said coldly.
Upon hearing this, the two Su family members were on the verge of tears, it looked like they didn’t fire Lin Fan’s ex-girlfriend, but instead got themselves fired by her.
"CEO, can you give us another chance?" one Su family member pleaded.
"CEO, for the sake of my father and Madam Su, please spare us!" the other one said.
Now the Su family company was under Su Jinjin’s control, they dared not confront her, having no choice but to invoke their elders, especially Madam Su, to press her.
Su Jinjin sneered, "Even if you bring gods here, it won’t help, leave now, and you!"
She turned to the security guard: "Who told you our company doesn’t allow even waiting for someone here? You leave too, we want security guards, not big shots."
The security guard looked ashen.
The two Su family members hung their heads, not daring to utter a word.
Lin Fan watched from the side, somewhat gratified. Su Jinjin handling it this way showed she was indeed capable of holding the CEO position of the Su family, and he was reassured.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Why Did You Have to Provoke Lin Fan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 278: Why Did You Have to Provoke Lin Fan?
Su Family Mansion.
Madam Su was chatting leisurely with a group of elders from the family. Ever since handing over the company affairs to Su Jinjin, she had much more free time.
The Su Family had been like a sinking ship, so they arranged a marriage with the Li Family to have Su Jinjin marry into them, attempting to save the Su Family.
But Su Jinjin staged a shocking act of running away from the wedding, rendering the Su Family’s plan a failure.
Madam Su was furious and threatened to banish Su Jinjin from the family.
Suddenly, Su Jinjin was invited by the mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin, and soon the Su Family received a major contract from Blue Moon, giving them a chance for revival.
However, Mr. Lin’s identity was revealed to be Lin Fan!
Madam Su’s feelings were quite complicated.
Years ago, she forced Su Jinjin to go abroad to separate her from Lin Fan, never expecting that just three years later, the Su Family would have to rely on Lin Fan’s generosity.
If Madam Su had the resolve, she could refuse Lin Fan’s contract, but doing so would mean the Su Family was truly beyond salvation.
Between dignity and survival, Madam Su had no choice but to choose survival.
Lin Fan appointed Su Jinjin as the project leader, and Madam Su had no choice but to comply. Later, she even promoted Su Jinjin to company president.
There was no other reason; Madam Su was not foolish. Through Su Jinjin’s connections, the Su Family could cling to Lin Fan, and she dared not treat Su Jinjin poorly!
Madam Su was not adept at running the company. She was happy to temporarily leave the company in Su Jinjin’s hands and wait until she made it bigger and stronger before taking things slowly.
At that moment, two younger members of the Su Family came in with their heads hanging in dejection.
"Why are you back instead of helping Jinjin at the company?" a middle-aged woman frowned.
This middle-aged woman was the mother of the two younger members of the Su Family.
The two looked at each other.
"Third Sister sent us back."
"Third Sister was furious at us and wouldn’t let us work at the company anymore."
The two younger members had an aggrieved expression on their faces.
The middle-aged woman’s face darkened as she heard this.
"Madam, you see, Su Jinjin is truly out of control. What did my sons do to offend her!" the middle-aged woman said angrily.
The other elders had much to say about Su Jinjin as well.
Not many agreed with Su Jinjin becoming the company president; they were secretly holding grudges, waiting for an opportunity to speak out against her.
"Does Su Jinjin realize how she became president? And now she’s already throwing her weight around?"
"Isn’t it said that these two kids are quite diligent? Why is Su Jinjin doing this?"
"It’s outrageous, Madam, you must control her!"
Everyone started to "vent" their frustrations.
The middle-aged woman cried pitifully: "Madam, with Mr. Lin backing Su Jinjin, she bullies us so, but only you can help us, please stand up for us!"
Both younger members knelt down, crying.
"Grandmother, please speak for us and let us return to work!"
"We’ve begged Third Sister, but she wouldn’t agree and insists on driving us out."
The middle-aged woman was both angry and anxious: "It’s outrageous, we never expected to be bullied by this girl!"
They had never regarded Su Jinjin highly before, and now, they were envious of her but couldn’t provoke her, which led to their frustration and resentment.
In the past, Madam Su would have been the first to get angry.
But now her expression was somewhat unpleasant. If Su Jinjin was truly using her authority to act tyrannically at the company and oppress the younger members, it would be difficult for her.
After all, Su Jinjin did have Lin Fan’s backing, and Madam Su dared not offend Lin Fan now.
Lately, Madam Su mostly hid in the mansion, fearing an encounter with Lin Fan that would leave her awkward and embarrassed.
She dared not provoke Lin Fan, and naturally, she dared not do anything to Su Jinjin either.
Madam Su cleared her throat and said: "You two stop crying. Let me ask you, why did Su Jinjin fire you? Did you do something to offend her?"
Everyone had taken the opportunity to criticize Su Jinjin, indifferent to reason and driven only to slander.
Finally, Madam Su asked the crucial question.
The two younger members exchanged a glance and then recounted the incident with Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan was wearing cheap clothes from a street market; we didn’t recognize him and thought he was just a nobody."
"We were worried he’d affect the company’s image, so we just wanted him to leave. Our tone was a bit harsh, but we were protecting the company. Who knew it would upset Third Sister."
"Because of such a small matter, Third Sister wants to drive us out. We really had no choice but to come and plead with Grandmother."
"Grandmother, you must stand up for us!"
The two younger members spoke one after the other.
The surrounding crowd, upon hearing Lin Fan’s name, all fell silent, as if they had been slapped in the face, making the atmosphere rather awkward.
Bam!
Madam Su suddenly slammed her walking stick on the ground with a furious expression: "You two fools!"
The two younger members shut their mouths, momentarily stunned.
Why did Madam suddenly scold them?
Madam Su was even angrier: "Of all people, you chose to provoke Lin Fan. Now, tell me clearly how this incident happened, and don’t leave out a single word!"
Madam Su was furious, practically beside herself. These past few days, she tried to keep a low profile, hiding in the mansion to avoid Lin Fan, and now these two had provoked him, forcing her to face him!
By this time, Lin Fan was already driving with Su Jinjin away from the Su Corporation.
"Lin Fan, I hope those three clueless guys haven’t affected your mood," Su Jinjin said.
She decisively fired the three not to please Lin Fan, but because she was genuinely angry. They had disrespected Lin Fan too much and had crossed her line. Lin Fan was her first love.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "It’s nothing that can affect my mood, and besides, you fired them, which helped vent my anger."
Su Jinjin blushed. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she wouldn’t even have the authority to fire them.
Her current position in the Su Family was all due to Lin Fan.
This gave her a complicated feeling that she couldn’t quite describe.
She couldn’t fully accept all of this because Lin Fan wasn’t her boyfriend. She always felt the need to do something to repay Lin Fan, as if that would give her balance.
However, she still didn’t know what she should do.
"Let’s not talk about this. Why don’t we decide where to eat later?" Su Jinjin changed the subject, a smile appearing on her face.
Lin Fan said: "There’s no rush for food. I noticed you sound a bit off, like you mentioned you’re feeling unwell over the phone. What’s wrong? Are you catching a cold?"
Su Jinjin responded: "Yes, maybe I didn’t cover myself at night and caught a bit of a chill."
Lin Fan chuckled lightly: "You always do that, kicking off the covers while sleeping. Back then..."
Lin Fan suddenly stopped speaking, realizing he had unintentionally talked about the past. But why even bring it up...
Su Jinjin blushed, biting her lip, her thoughts pulled back to those days with Lin Fan when they were in love.
They used to stay overnight in a hotel, with Lin Fan getting up several times at night to cover her with a quilt, teasing her about it the next morning.
Those times were truly simple and beautiful, and for a moment, Su Jinjin felt a bit lost in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Lin Fan is so warm, his warmth almost melted her heart
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 279: Lin Fan is so warm, his warmth almost melted her heart
Ever since they were torn apart by Madam Su, Su Jinjin dared not recall the past, sealing these memories deep in her heart. Now, it seemed as if the seal had suddenly burst, with memories rushing forth uncontrollably...
The two sat in silence for a while, in an atmosphere that was a bit awkward yet somewhat ambiguous.
Suddenly, Lin Fan received a phone call.
Lin Fan looked and saw it was his mother calling from the countryside!
Why is Mom calling him all of a sudden?
Mrs. Lin typically wouldn’t initiate calls to Lin Fan; usually, Lin Fan would call back periodically to send his regards. If Mrs. Lin called, it usually meant something was up.
Lin Fan hurriedly answered: "Mom, what’s up?"
Mrs. Lin first went through the usual routine of asking about his job and health before getting to the main point.
"Here’s the thing, Little Fan, I’m calling because your third uncle is planning to seek medical treatment in Yun City. Can you help him book a hospital bed?" Mrs. Lin said.
Lin Fan’s third uncle, Lin Dawei, had a good relationship with Lin Fan and had taken care of him quite a bit when he was young.
Lin Fan asked with concern, "What’s wrong with Uncle? Has he contacted a doctor?"
Mrs. Lin said, "He has liver disease. The doctor in the county suggested he be hospitalized in a big city. He’s already made an appointment with Dr. Guo Yu, a liver disease expert at Yun City People’s Hospital. He will arrive in Yun City tomorrow."
Lin Fan said, "Okay, I’ll arrange it at the hospital right now."
Lin Fan then hung up the phone.
Su Jinjin, curious, asked, "What’s going on?"
Lin Fan replied, "An uncle of mine is ill and coming to Yun City for hospitalization. I’m going to book a room for him. Why don’t you come along and see the doctor too? A cold can be serious or minor."
Su Jinjin said, "Alright."
So they headed to Yun City People’s Hospital.
Since it was the hospital’s lunch break, the two decided to grab a bite to eat nearby first.
They picked a busy restaurant to go into.
This was a little tacit understanding between them; when they were dating, they would choose busy restaurants for their outings. Lin Fan had told Su Jinjin that quiet restaurants didn’t seem to taste good, whereas busy ones were likely not bad.
Once inside, they found a seat and ordered their meal.
"Wow!"
Suddenly, they heard a little boy crying nearby.
It turned out that a child at the next table was crying while playing with a toy.
The child was accompanied by an elderly person. The elderly had bought the toy for the grandson, hoping to make him happy. The boy initially loved this toy, but it was a complex building block toy, and the child couldn’t play with it, asking the elder for help.
The elder couldn’t quite figure it out either and ended up ruining what the child had assembled.
The child grew anxious and started crying.
The elder tried to console him but to no avail, much to his distress.
The boy’s cries drew curious glances from those around them; encountering a crying child while eating is indeed quite bothersome.
The elder looked apologetic and helpless.
"Little friend, why don’t you let your brother help you build it?" Lin Fan suddenly approached with a smile.
He then turned to the elder and said, "Mind if I help?"
The elderly, at a loss, saw Lin Fan’s friendliness and smiled, saying, "Not at all, young man. I appreciate your help."
Lin Fan sat down in front of the child and asked with a smile, "Little friend, what do you want to build?"
The little boy, still in tears, said, "I want to build a dinosaur."
Lin Fan replied, "Alright, brother will help you build a dinosaur."
Lin Fan glanced at the messy pile of blocks.
His top-notch craftsmanship kicked in.
With his swift hands, the scattered blocks quickly came together, and soon, a lifelike dinosaur was assembled.
The little boy was stunned, momentarily forgetting to cry.
The elderly beside them was also quite surprised; this young man was impressive.
"Do you like it, little buddy?" Lin Fan asked with a smile.
The little boy broke into a smile through his tears: "I like it!"
He was captivated by the dinosaur in front of him.
The elderly, seeing this, was overjoyed: "Xiaotian, aren’t you going to thank your big brother?"
The little boy said sweetly, "Thank you, big brother."
Lin Fan said with a smile, "You’re welcome. Would you like me to teach you how to build it? That way, you can do it yourself next time."
The little boy was delighted: "Okay."
Lin Fan patiently taught the little boy how to assemble the pieces. With his top-notch craftsmanship, he could pass his skills on to others easily, and the learner could quickly get the hang of it, even becoming quite adept.
The little boy soon learned to build on his own, elated.
The elderly watched as the grandson finally showed a bright smile he had been longing for, immensely grateful to Lin Fan.
"Young man, thank you so much. I didn’t know how to console him. Thank you." The elder expressed gratitude.
Lin Fan replied, "It’s nothing, just lending a hand. I shall return to my meal now."
The elderly glanced at Su Jinjin and said hurriedly, "Alright, sorry for interrupting your time with your girlfriend."
Lin Fan smiled but didn’t correct him, then returned to sit opposite Su Jinjin.
Su Jinjin had been watching the whole time, seeing Lin Fan patiently teaching the little boy. She found herself a bit captivated by the scene.
She didn’t know what she was thinking, but her cheeks gradually reddened.
"Jinjin, are you alright? Your cheeks are a bit red, are you feeling unwell?" Lin Fan asked.
"N-nothing... Let’s eat." Su Jinjin’s heart fluttered as she quickly resumed eating.
Suddenly, a large hand reached over and touched her forehead. Lin Fan murmured, "No fever either!"
Feeling the warmth from Lin Fan’s palm, Su Jinjin felt a bit dizzy. Lin Fan was so warm, warming her heart...
After the hospital’s lunch break.
The two arrived at the hospital.
Su Jinjin went directly to register for her check-up.
Lin Fan went to meet the doctor with whom he had arranged an appointment, explained his uncle’s condition, got the admission notice, and then went to the in-patient department to queue up for payment.
This hospital was renowned, with many patients usually. Lin Fan had to queue for quite some time before it was finally his turn.
The billing nurse asked, "What type of room would you like? We have standard rooms and VIP rooms."
Lin Fan asked, "What are the differences between standard rooms and VIP rooms?"
The nurse explained, "Standard rooms are usually triple occupancy, VIP rooms are single occupancy, and there’s also the most expensive VIP suite."
"How much is the VIP suite?" Lin Fan asked directly. He wasn’t short of money now, and since his uncle was a nice person, he wanted him to stay comfortably.
The nurse glanced at his plain clothing, wondering if he could actually afford a suite.
The middle-aged couple waiting behind him grew impatient, with the aunt grumbling, "He looks like a poor soul; why waste time asking about the VIP suite? There are still many people in the queue."
"Exactly..."
The people behind also seemed dissatisfied.
Lin Fan, pretending not to hear, continued to smile at the nurse, waiting for her response.
The nurse replied, "The suite is 200 per day. There’s currently one left. Would you like it?"
Lin Fan nodded, "I’ll take it."
A month’s stay would only be 6000, a small amount.
What?
The people around were taken aback, not believing that this young man actually wanted the VIP suite. Could it be that despite his modest attire, he was actually wealthy?
The aunt who had grumbled earlier now felt embarrassed, having been so quickly proven wrong.
Seeing that Lin Fan indeed wanted the suite, the nurse’s attitude immediately warmed up, and she quickly completed the admission procedures for him.
The VIP suite service was indeed different, and soon a pretty nurse came over to show Lin Fan the room.
According to the nurse’s introduction, the hospital only had five VIP suites in total, which were in high demand and usually fully booked. Coincidentally, a wealthy businessman had just checked out, allowing Lin Fan to book one.
The suite was indeed luxurious, equipped with a living room, bathroom, even a kitchen, with all appliances and furniture perfectly arranged, cozy like a home.
Lin Fan was quite satisfied, signed the papers, and officially booked the room.
Just as he was about to leave, the nurse called out to him.
"Mr. Lin, sorry, but we just received notice that this VIP room cannot be given to you. We need you to go through the checkout procedures." said the nurse.
Lin Fan frowned; he had just booked the room, and now they wanted him to vacate it?
He was about to question why when three people, a man and two women, stopped by, laughing and chatting as they walked in.
The man was a middle-aged fellow, balding and with a protruding belly, accompanied by a nurse with another woman, about thirty years old. The man seemed overly ingratiating, saying, "Not a problem, I’m the vice dean here. It’s easy to arrange, especially for my cousin calling me directly."

chapters.title: Chapter 280: The Exasperated Vice Dean
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 280: The Exasperated Vice Dean
The bald man spoke in a way that both pleased the other party and flaunted his own power. It was obvious that he cared very much about this woman.
As they talked, the two had already walked in and immediately saw Lin Fan.
"Who is he?" The woman frowned and asked. This person in front of her was dressed in cheap clothes, clearly a poor man. How could he be in a VIP suite?
The middle-aged man’s face sank as he stared at the nurse: "Didn’t I ask you to tell him to switch rooms? Why is he still here?"
The nurse was a bit flustered: "Dean Chen, I was just about to ask him to check out, and then you came."
This bald man was the hospital’s vice president, named Chen Zhenfeng.
"This room was reserved by me. May I ask where you want me to move to?" Lin Fan chuckled and said.
If Chen Zhenfeng had a better attitude, Lin Fan might agree to switch rooms. But seeing Chen Zhenfeng acting so arrogantly, Lin Fan really didn’t intend to change.
Chen Zhenfeng asked the nurse, "Are there any more VIP rooms available? Arrange one for him, please."
The nurse said, "I’m sorry, all VIP rooms are fully booked. There are only regular rooms left."
Chen Zhenfeng responded, "Oh, then there’s no option. You’ll have to move to a regular room."
Making Lin Fan switch rooms was one thing, but moving to a regular room seemed unfair.
Ring ring ring...
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang. It was Su Jinjin calling.
"Lin Fan, where are you? I’ve finished my checkup and can’t find you," Su Jinjin said.
Lin Fan replied, "I’m in the VIP suite, having a bit of trouble..."
Lin Fan gave the address to Su Jinjin, and then hung up the phone.
Lin Fan turned to Chen Zhenfeng and calmly said, "I’m sorry, but this room was reserved by me. I don’t plan to change it. Do as you please."
The woman glanced at Chen Zhenfeng, frowning, "Cousin, what’s going on?"
Chen Zhenfeng wanted to show off in front of his cousin, but Lin Fan was ruining it, making him furious.
"This room was originally reserved by me; it’s just that the nurse made a mistake. It’s reasonable to ask you to check out now," Chen Zhenfeng said.
Lin Fan replied, "Proof?"
Chen Zhenfeng scoffed, "I am the vice president. My word is the proof. Do you have any doubts?"
Lin Fan said, "Even if what you say is true, it would still be your hospital’s mistake. Why should I bear the consequences? This room was reserved by me, and I will not change it."
Chen Zhenfeng was infuriated. Initially, to please his cousin, he planned to arrange a VIP suite for her, but there were only five suites in total at the hospital, all occupied. The patients in the other four rooms either were wealthy or had status, and he couldn’t afford to offend them. He thought this room, supposedly reserved by a rural person, would be easy to deal with, so he demanded a switch. However, it turned out to be a tough nut like Lin Fan, who wouldn’t give him, a vice president, any face.
"Kid, don’t refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. I’ve seen Lin Dawei’s medical records. His liver disease is severe. Only Dr. Guo, our hospital’s liver disease expert, can save him. With just one word from me, he won’t even get into this hospital. You better think it over!" Chen Zhenfeng said coldly.
Threats, blatant threats!
Lin Fan sneered, "Dean Chen, do you realize that your words just now have violated your ethics as a doctor? Does your director agree with what you’re saying?"
Chen Zhenfeng snorted, "The director doesn’t have time to deal with such small matters. I am in charge here. You can try and see if the director bothers with you! You can also go through the complaint channels, but that would delay Lin Dawei’s illness. Weigh the pros and cons yourself."
With a sense of assuredness of authority, Chen Zhenfeng was not afraid to make direct threats, confident that Lin Fan couldn’t do anything to him.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Fine, I’ll go talk to your director about it!"
Everyone broke into a sweat; this kid was really stubborn!
Chen Zhenfeng shouted sternly, "You ungrateful kid, it’s not your place to be arrogant! I’ll say it again: vacate the room immediately, or I’ll call security and kick you out for disrupting hospital order!"
Chen Zhenfeng was truly exasperated. If he couldn’t handle this kid in front of his cousin, it would be extremely embarrassing.
Lin Fan simply sat down and said, "Alright, let’s see if your security can get me out."
Chen Zhenfeng was fuming and turned to the nurse, yelling, "Call security for me!"
The situation was getting out of hand.
"What’s happening here? This is a hospital ward; why all the noise and chaos?"
A voice came from behind, and an elderly man with his hands behind his back walked in from outside.
The elder, who was in his sixties, had white hair slicked back and looked quite vigorous and well-maintained.
Alongside the elder was Su Jinjin.
Seeing this elder, Chen Zhenfeng immediately put on a flattering smile, "Director, what brings you here?"
Lin Fan was taken aback. Wasn’t this elder the one from the restaurant earlier who couldn’t pacify his grandson?
Was he actually the hospital’s director?
Su Jinjin said, "I ran into the gentleman in the hallway earlier, and he said he wanted to come thank you more formally. I had no idea he was the director here."
The elder was delighted to see Lin Fan and smiled, "Mr. Lin, if it weren’t for you this afternoon, I wouldn’t have known what to do. I am Zhou Nanhua, the director here."
Zhou Nanhua’s grandson lived far away with his parents, and Zhou Nanhua finally got to see him. He had even prepared gifts for his grandson, but the situation almost got out of control.
Lin Fan had salvaged the situation, helping calm the grandson and even teaching him to build with blocks. Later, they ended up having a great time, creating a precious yet short-lived happy moment.
If it hadn’t been for Lin Fan, the rare meeting could have turned disastrous. Hence, upon accidentally bumping into Su Jinjin, Zhou Nanhua insisted on personally thanking Lin Fan once more.
Lin Fan smiled, "Oh, you’re too polite, sir. So you’re the director. I was actually looking for you. This room was reserved by me, yet this vice president is forcefully trying to make us vacate it."
Zhou Nanhua acknowledged the situation, glancing at Chen Zhenfeng with seriousness in his tone, "Is there such a thing?"
Chen Zhenfeng defended himself, "Director, here’s the situation. I initially reserved this room, but the nurse made a mistake and gave it to him. But they refuse to switch."
Zhou Nanhua said, "Old Chen, Mr. Lin here is my friend. As a favor to me, please yield this room to Mr. Lin."
Chen Zhenfeng quickly responded, "But, it was me who reserved it first..."
Hearing this, Lin Fan was displeased. Zhou Nanhua wanted to thank him, so he was trying to help him secure the VIP room, but it sounded like he was taking advantage of Chen Zhenfeng.
Lin Fan said, "Sir, I don’t need him to yield the room. When I booked it, the nurse didn’t indicate it was already reserved. Thus, I question the vice president’s claim and hope you can help verify it. If it turns out he reserved it first, I will vacate the room."
Zhou Nanhua nodded, secretly applauding Lin Fan’s integrity.
"Alright then. Let’s conduct an internal investigation promptly to see if Old Chen pre-booked this suite," Zhou Nanhua instructed the nurse.
However, Chen Zhenfeng’s expression changed. Anxiously, he managed a contrived smile, "No need. Since he’s the director’s friend, let’s just give him the room."
Zhou Nanhua’s face darkened, "Did you have a reservation or not?"

chapters.title: Chapter 281: One day, she will leave him because of money
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 281: One day, she will leave him because of money
Chen Zhenfeng was startled. When the director gets angry, he’s really hard to handle. After all, with the director’s status, he wouldn’t care about things like this at all.
Who would have thought, the director is actually friends with Lin Fan. Chen Zhenfeng was bewildered, how did this flea market kid know the director, and the director even favors him!
Chen Zhenfeng broke into a cold sweat: "N-no."
Zhou Nanhua angrily said, "Scoundrel, you didn’t have an appointment, yet you used your authority for personal gain, trying to snatch a room from the guests. You’ve completely disgraced our hospital!"
Zhou Nanhua scolded Chen Zhenfeng harshly.
Chen Zhenfeng could only silently endure.
After admonishing Chen Zhenfeng, Zhou Nanhua smiled at Lin Fan, "Young man, may I ask who in your family is ill and how is their condition?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s my uncle, liver disease."
Zhou Nanhua turned his head to Chen Zhenfeng and said, "Our hospital’s best liver disease expert is Doctor Guo Yu. You personally arrange for Doctor Guo Yu to prioritize treating Mr. Lin’s uncle, no mistakes allowed!"
The director gave instructions, and Chen Zhenfeng could only mutter a consent.
Zhou Nanhua smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, are you satisfied with this arrangement?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you, sir."
"That’s good. My grandson is about to go home, I need to see him off. Mr. Lin, apologies, I’ll visit you next time." Zhou Nanhua said, hurriedly said goodbye and left.
"Cousin, what about my mom, where will she stay?" At this time, the young woman asked anxiously.
Chen Zhenfeng felt quite helpless and said, "Currently, the hospital is short on beds. You heard it just now, all the VIP rooms are fully occupied. We’ll have to let your mom temporarily stay in a regular ward for now..."
"You’re going to drive me crazy!" The young lady stomped her foot and ran off angrily.
"Cousin, wait for me!"
Chen Zhenfeng panicked and rushed out after her, not forgetting to glare back at Lin Fan. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, his cousin wouldn’t be mad, this account will be settled later!
Su Jinjin felt a bit speechless, "That man is really bullying, good thing we know the director. Lin Fan, you even helped the director before, otherwise, where could we go to reason?"
Lin Fan furrowed his brows and said, "I fear Chen Zhenfeng might have some tricks up his sleeve. When my uncle comes, we’ll need to stay alert."
Lin Fan coldly chuckled to himself, it would be best for Chen Zhenfeng not to provoke him again, or Lin Fan wouldn’t be courteous with him.
Although Zhou Nanhua scolded Chen Zhenfeng just now, he didn’t actually punish him. Lin Fan couldn’t rely on Zhou Nanhua, since for Zhou Nanhua, he was just a minor benefactor from outside, and Chen Zhenfeng was ultimately his colleague.
It’s still best to rely on oneself.
Lin Fan said, "Let’s not talk about this. Jinjin, you’ve seen the doctor, is there any serious problem?"
Su Jinjin said, "Hmm, just a small issue, I’m feeling energetic. Lin Fan, do you have time this afternoon?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, where do you want to go?"
Su Jinjin blushed and said, "If you have time, accompany me to walk around, if not..."
Lin Fan said, "Sure thing."
Su Jinjin was very pleased, "Then let’s go."
The two of them left the hospital and started strolling along the nearby streets.
They seemed to have returned to their university days, back then, they would often stroll hand-in-hand, or Lin Fan would carry Su Jinjin on his bicycle.
It’s a pity...
Even though she’s now sitting on Lin Fan’s electric scooter, she’s not his girlfriend anymore, which made her inexplicably feel a bit down.
However, passersby misunderstood their relationship, thinking they were a couple.
The guys were envious of Lin Fan, having found such a beautiful girlfriend, and the key point is, Lin Fan was clearly so poor!
What happened to the notion that beautiful women are all gold diggers?
Many people turned their heads, expressing confusion.
"That beauty is so pretty, she could totally be sitting in the passenger seat of a supercar, yet she’s sitting on an electric scooter!"
"The guy is quite handsome too, just really poor, this girl will definitely become frustrated with him. Handsomeness doesn’t put food on the table!"
"She’s young, give her some time, when she gets beaten by society, she’ll realize nothing’s more important than money."
"You’re right, one day, she’ll leave him for money. That’s just reality..."
The passersby murmured as they gossiped.
Upon hearing these remarks, Su Jinjin felt a bit upset. She had never disliked Lin Fan because of his poverty. Many gold-digging women are afraid of poverty, so they only want to find a wealthy man, but she was the third young lady of Su Family, she didn’t need that, even though Su Family had declined in recent years, she still didn’t need that.
Yet, back then, she was still forced to break up with Lin Fan because of his poverty.
She doesn’t despise the poor and favor the rich, but Madam Su does, her mother does, most of Su Family do, they couldn’t accept that poor lad.
Su Family is just a small reflection of this society.
From the gossip of these passersby, this society favors the rich and disdains the poor, in the end, even the purest will bow to money.
Lin Fan saw the somewhat gloomy Su Jinjin in the rearview mirror of the electric scooter.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Don’t pay attention to these rumors, you’re not like them."
A brave young lady defying a family-arranged marriage, just wanting to marry for love, decisively ditched the wealthy Li Family. Such a lady, how could she be compared to common folks!
"I’m fine." Su Jinjin forced a smile, trying not to let outsiders’ comments affect her.
She sighed inwardly, "Lin Fan, if I had been a bit braver back then, could I have stayed with you?"
Thinking this, an indiscernible impulse suddenly surged through her heart.
At this moment, they passed by a roadside stall.
The stall owner was a man in his thirties, selling wooden carvings, clearly a craftsman, also providing services on the spot.
"Young man, your girlfriend is really pretty, make a wooden carving for her as a gift, today’s my opening day, I’ll give you a 20% discount!" the stall owner smiled to attract customers.
Lin Fan looked at the wooden carvings he made. This guy had done many famous anime figures, but the craftsmanship was only so-so.
"No need." Lin Fan replied politely.
The stall owner was still trying to persuade, "Why not make one, I have ancestral craftsmanship, both quick and good, it’ll be done soon."
Lin Fan asked Su Jinjin, "Do you like wooden carvings?"
Su Jinjin replied, "They’re okay, I don’t know much about them, but they seem pretty fun."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "If you want one, I’ll make one personally for you."
Su Jinjin was pleasantly surprised, "You can make wooden carvings?"
Lin Fan seemed to be quite handy, this noon he helped a little boy build with blocks and did it so well, it had surprised Su Jinjin back then.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan could even carve wood?
Lin Fan said, "Yes."
He has top-notch craftsmanship skills, such handiwork is too simple.
The stall owner was a bit surprised too and said, "Ah? Young man, you can carve wood? Turns out I’ve met a fellow craftsman! But I bet your skills aren’t better than mine, mine is ancestral skills passed down for generations, my family’s been relying on this for livelihood. Miss, if you really like wooden carvings, help me out, your boyfriend definitely can’t make one as beautiful as mine."
Su Jinjin didn’t care, regardless of how good or bad it was, as long as Lin Fan made it, to her it’s the best.
Lin Fan noticed the stall owner’s boasting and him subtly putting him down, he smiled and said, "I didn’t want to be honest, but your carvings look just mediocre to me."
