The stall owner wasn’t pleased with this, his expression changed, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "You heard it."
The stall owner snorted unhappily, "You’re doubting my skills, kid, do you dare to compete with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Just One Breath Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 282: Just One Breath Away
The vendor wanted to challenge Lin Fan’s craftsmanship, but Lin Fan was not very interested. He didn’t need to defeat this vendor to prove himself, nor did he rely on this for a living.
"Forget it, I have no interest in competing with you," Lin Fan said blandly, and just wanted to ride away.
The vendor sneered, "What, kid, are you feeling guilty? I bet you don’t even understand wood carving. You’re just showing off in front of me. The moment I suggest a competition, you chicken out."
Lin Fan said, "You can say whatever you like."
Upon hearing this, the vendor became increasingly convinced that Lin Fan knew nothing about wood carving and grew even more arrogant. He began to shout, "Ladies and gentlemen, don’t miss out, come judge for yourselves! My wood carving skills are passed down through the generations, and I consider myself quite good. Yet this kid claims my skills are mediocre and says he knows how to carve wood. But when I propose a competition, he flatly refuses. Doesn’t this show he’s guilty?"
This call drew quite a crowd.
Among them were people jealous of Lin Fan. How could this poor dude on an electric bike have such a beautiful girlfriend!
Why not them!
"Oh please, this kid looks like he has no real skills at all!"
"Needless to say, he’s definitely guilty!"
"He’s just all looks, completely useless. He’s only good at deceiving little girls with his face."
The crowd pointed and whispered, many making snarky remarks.
Why did Lin Fan get such a beautiful girlfriend while being so poor? It’s just not fair.
Lin Fan couldn’t care less. Sure, he could show off a little and shut these people up, but he felt it wasn’t necessary. A true master doesn’t need to pay attention to such petty challenges. The best response to an opponent as insignificant as an ant is to ignore them completely.
Indeed, even though Lin Fan refused to compete, the vendor thought less of him for his reluctance but felt quite unsatisfied and almost wanted to grab Lin Fan to compete right there and then. This agonizing feeling was far more intense than being proven wrong by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was just about to start his electric bike to leave.
Suddenly, Su Jinjin said, "Fan, I suddenly want a wood carving. Why don’t you carve one for me now?"
Su Jinjin couldn’t stand it anymore. This vendor was too despicable, trying to publicly humiliate Lin Fan.
Lin Fan could endure it, but she couldn’t!
She trusted Lin Fan’s character. Lin Fan was never the type to boast. If he said he could carve wood, he could definitely do it. If he judged the vendor’s work as average, he surely had his reasons.
Lin Fan said lightly, "You want it now?"
Su Jinjin said, "Yes, Master, could you give him a piece of wood?"
The vendor said, "No problem, I will provide both materials and tools!"
The vendor handed a set of tools to Su Jinjin.
Su Jinjin said, "Thank you. Fan, make a wood carving by my likeness, let’s see how close you can get?"
The vendor was delighted and quickly fetched a piece of wood and tools, saying, "Everyone watch closely, I’ll make a carving by the likeness of this lady too, let’s see who finishes faster, who gets a closer resemblance!"
As he spoke, the vendor eagerly picked up his tools and began carving, with clearly practiced movements.
It didn’t take long before the outline of the carving had emerged.
On the other side, Lin Fan took the tools and wood but instead of starting immediately, he studied them.
Lin Fan’s progress was clearly slower than the vendor’s.
While the vendor continued to work, he glanced at Lin Fan and snickered, "Clearly, you don’t know what you’re doing, stunned aren’t you!"
The crowd also pointed and commented.
"It’s hilarious, he clearly doesn’t know how to carve!"
"He was ready to bail, his girlfriend is practically his wingwoman! Making him embarrass himself publicly!"
"Hahaha... got betrayed by his girlfriend!"
"He shouldn’t have shown off."
Lin Fan seemed oblivious to the comments, suddenly smiled slightly as if he had a plan, and unexpectedly, his hands began to move, the knife touched the wood, swiftly chiseling away. Wood shavings flew everywhere.
Top-notch craftsmanship unleashed!
Upon seeing this, the vendor laughed, "And you call that carving? Not even drafting, randomly cutting away, clearly you don’t know what you’re doing. Keep pretending, you won’t be able to hold it for long anyway."
The vendor believed Lin Fan was just putting on a show trying to scare people because Lin Fan’s technique seemed downright wrong.
The vendor felt assured and no longer concerned with Lin Fan, focusing wholeheartedly on his own carving. He wanted to finish his carving to show Lin Fan what true wood-carving skills looked like.
Unbeknownst to him, ten minutes went by.
The vendor had carved the outline of a figure, resembling Su Jinjin’s physique quite well.
Seeing this, the crowd started praising.
"The master’s skills are impressive!"
"Really amazing, no wonder it’s a family heritage skill!"
"It must look great, I want to carve one as well."
Just then, Lin Fan, who had been swiftly cutting away with the knife, suddenly said, "I’m done."
He then stopped working.
At this sudden announcement, the vendor’s hand shook, nearly chopping off the head of his own sculpture.
What the heck!
Lin Fan must be deliberately trying to scare him!
The vendor was a bit ticked off, he looked up at Lin Fan, ready to curse him, but when he saw Lin Fan’s carving, he froze.
Lin Fan declared he was finished, yet his carving was a jumbled mess, not resembling a person at all. The cuts were exceptionally rough, as if it’d been randomly hacked, leaving a desolate mess.
The vendor nearly died laughing, holding his belly, "What? You call this done? You carved something like this, what is it?"
The surrounding people burst into laughter.
"It’s too funny, is this supposed to be a wood carving?"
"I could do better than that!"
"He clearly doesn’t understand wood carving, just a clown!"
"It’s hilarious, how embarrassing!"
"Vendor wins effortlessly!"
The crowd unrestrainedly ridiculed Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh, just missing a finishing touch."
Then, Lin Fan looked down and blew a breath at the statue before him.
Poof!
A swirl of wood shavings was blown away, revealing a sculpture.
A lifelike sculpture emerged from the scattering and falling wood shavings, with looks and posture identical to Su Jinjin, practically like a miniature version of Su Jinjin herself!
It seemed as though Lin Fan’s extraordinary craftsmanship had given it life. If not known to be a wood carving, one might even feel that in the next moment, the sculpture would move!
Amazing indeed!
Seeing this scene, the entire place suddenly fell silent.
As though bewitched, everyone was drawn to the sculpture.
All those who had ridiculed Lin Fan silenced themselves, replaced by expressions of shock.
The vendor was directly dumbfounded, with a clang the carving tools in his hand involuntarily fell to the ground, unnoticed by him, as all his attention was now fixated on the sculpture before him.
Oh my God, someone can actually carve wood to such an extraordinary level!
Inside, the vendor’s mind was already blown.
Lin Fan casually picked up the sculpture, handed it to Su Jinjin: "Here, it’s for you. Do you like it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Master, please forgive my ignorance
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 283: Master, please forgive my ignorance
Su Jinjin took the wood carving, examined it, and happily said, "Hmm, I love it so much, it looks just like me!"
The statue seemed like her miniature version—a youthful and vivid young lady, so lifelike it seemed as though she might move the next second.
Lin Fan’s masterful craftsmanship is hard not to like.
Although Su Jinjin does not understand wood carving, Lin Fan made the carving so exquisite that it surely must be excellent. Furthermore, comparing with the stall owner made it clear—though the stall owner started earlier, he only made a prototype, while Lin Fan had already completed his work.
It was apparent that, at least in terms of speed, Lin Fan had won over this stall owner. As for the finished product, it would have to be seen how it compared once the stall owner completed his work.
Thud!
Suddenly, the stall owner knelt in front of Lin Fan.
"Master, please forgive my ignorance!"
The stall owner shouted loudly.
Lin Fan’s remarkable skill left him no choice but to kneel in admiration; how could he dare to continue competing with Lin Fan? It would be an utter humiliation.
Among those present, perhaps no one understood wood carving better than this stall owner. Naturally, no one knew better than him how formidable Lin Fan was.
If wood carving skills were graded, the stall owner believed he had achieved some success, but Lin Fan’s realm was already divine and transcendent!
He reached a supreme realm!
The stall owner simply couldn’t discern Lin Fan’s technique!
How on earth did he make the statue so lifelike—the mere technique of covering the statue with wood shavings in the end was beyond what the stall owner could ever imagine in his dreams.
Simply too formidable; the stall owner was deeply impressed.
He couldn’t help but kneel, as naturally as a monk seeing the Buddha or a Taoist seeing an Immortal.
Seeing the stall owner kneel, Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Get up quickly, there’s no need for such a grand gesture."
The stall owner said, "Master, your skill is simply breathtaking. Could you possibly guide me a little? It would surely benefit me for a lifetime. Please, Master?"
This guy had mocked Lin Fan so arrogantly earlier and called over so many passersby, trying to make Lin Fan lose face in public.
Lin Fan had no interest in guiding such a person.
"I previously said your skills were average; are you willing to accept this fact now?" Lin Fan calmly said.
The stall owner nodded continuously, "Yes, I am indeed average and don’t dare to compare with the Master. I was so ignorant."
The stall owner regretted it deeply; had he known Lin Fan was a master, he wouldn’t have dared to compare even if he had ten times the courage.
Before, he even said Lin Fan was overestimating his abilities; little did he know it was really him who was overestimating himself!
Lin Fan said, "Alright then, as for guiding you, sorry, not interested. Jinjin, let’s go."
Upon saying this, Lin Fan returned to the electric scooter. Amidst the crowd watching, he left with Su Jinjin, leaving behind a carefree figure.
"So handsome!"
"A true master hidden among the people; he’s so amazing! A master-level figure!"
"Now I understand why he can have such a beautiful girlfriend; he’s incredible!"
"Suddenly I’m so jealous of his girlfriend; she found such an amazing boyfriend!"
The crowd marveled and praised Lin Fan unanimously, having already forgotten they were mocking him a moment ago.
Seeing Lin Fan leave, the stall owner slumped to the ground powerlessly, his face pale, as if he had missed the lottery jackpot.
He regretted it so much; it must have been because he offended the Master. That’s why the Master was unwilling to guide him. Had he known, he should have flattered the Master from the start. Lin Fan’s skills are unmatched, the very best.
The stall owner always prided himself on his ancestral skills, never failing to mention them.
However, compared to Lin Fan’s profound craftsmanship, his ancestral skills instantly turned to trash.
Thinking of this, the stall owner, in his agitation, picked up the wood carving in front of him and heavily smashed it onto the ground, breaking the carving.
"Having witnessed the Master’s divine craftsmanship, how can I have the face to call myself an artisan? Enough, I will never carve again in this life!" The stall owner lamented to the sky. Missing the chance for Lin Fan’s guidance would be his lifelong regret.
The onlookers sighed at this scene, but it was the stall owner’s own doing, not Lin Fan’s fault.
By this time, Lin Fan had already gone far.
Though he wasn’t interested in competing with the stall owner, the final outcome still felt a bit satisfying to him. These people insisted on him proving them wrong, so he obliged.
The stall owner had no chance of defeating him because he possessed the top-notch craftsmanship skill rewarded by the system.
This reward had proven its might time and time again. Just casually mixing an orange juice could make Feng Ruolan’s taste buds explode in praise; casually doing something on the production line could leave the fastest person ten streets behind...
Sitting in the back seat, Su Jinjin was toying with the wood carving in her hands, liking it more and more.
This wood carving was crafted so well, and it was a gift Lin Fan personally made for her—exceptionally meaningful. She decided to treasure it properly after returning home.
"Lin Fan, when did you learn to carve, and how are you so good? I never knew before," Su Jinjin curiously asked.
In the afternoon, watching Lin Fan play with building blocks had already piqued her curiosity. Lin Fan’s hands were simply amazing.
Lin Fan replied casually, "I was really bored for a while and just learned randomly online."
Upon hearing this, Su Jinjin felt a bit melancholy; when Lin Fan said he was really bored for a while, it was naturally the time after they broke up.
Perhaps Lin Fan learned the craft to escape reality during that time.
Thinking of this, she felt a bit guilty, wondering how Lin Fan had managed over the past three years.
Suddenly, she realized something. Yes, she had an inherent sense of guilt towards Lin Fan.
This guilt had always been there, she just never wanted to confront it.
If she had been determined enough back then, she could have cut ties with the Su Family and stayed with Lin Fan, but she couldn’t do it. In the end, her grandmother sent her abroad.
She felt she had let Lin Fan down; it was her weakness that ultimately drove them apart.
Three years later, Lin Fan came back to her side; not only did he not blame her, but he also helped her out of her predicament. Without Lin Fan, she wouldn’t have the current status in the Su Family.
This made her unable to accept everything calmly. She always felt she needed to do something to balance her inner feelings, to make herself feel better.
She had never known what she should do.
However, after spending time with Lin Fan today, at this moment, listening to Lin Fan’s seemingly casual talk and looking at the wood carving in her hand, she suddenly knew what she had to do.
She, Su Jinjin, wants to become Lin Fan’s girlfriend again!
She wants to become Lin Fan’s girlfriend once more, start loving him all over again, love him passionately to make up for those lost three years!
This thought suddenly made everything clear for her, filled her with energy.
Her heart surged like a wave, unstoppable in its excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: I’ve bought this film city.
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 284: I’ve bought this film city.
Su Jinjin made a decision in her heart; she wanted to become Lin Fan’s girlfriend again. This decision made her extremely excited, her heart surging all at once, and her cheeks blushing.
"Jinjin, what are you thinking about? Why are you spacing out?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Su Jinjin felt her heart fluttering: "Nothing, nothing. Where are we going now?"
Lin Fan said: "Where do you want to go?"
Su Jinjin said: "It’s rare to have free time. Why don’t you accompany me to watch a movie? There’s a film with good reviews recently, and there happens to be a show at 5 PM."
Su Jinjin looked up cinema schedules on her phone.
Lin Fan readily agreed: "Sure."
Therefore, the electric scooter headed towards the cinema.
The wind brushed across their faces, blowing past their temples, hair fluttering, clothes billowing, as if back to three years ago, when Lin Fan rode a bicycle and carried her around the campus, youth soaring, surrounded by envious glances from classmates.
What a perfect couple.
The man was incredibly handsome, the woman was stunningly beautiful.
Though they sat on an electric scooter, looking a bit shabby, they still attracted countless looks of envy and jealousy.
At the cinema.
As Lin Fan just parked the scooter, a BMW drove by, nearly hitting them, scaring Su Jinjin so much that she turned pale. But Lin Fan was quick-eyed and pulled her over, wrapping an arm around her waist, avoiding the BMW.
In the BMW, the male driver was on the phone, and he temporarily braked, knocking Lin Fan’s electric scooter to the ground.
"Damn it, are you blind? Do you want to die?" the BMW man shouted from the car window.
Lin Fan frowned: "Seems like you were busy on the phone, nearly hitting us, and knocking my scooter down."
The BMW man, seeing the fallen electric scooter, sneered. Just a loser riding an electric scooter!
Lin Fan looked down to check on Su Jinjin: "Are you alright?"
Su Jinjin was initially quite frightened, but being held by Lin Fan, she already forgot her fear, her heart racing.
Earlier, Lin Fan’s boyfriend power was off the charts, saving her so promptly and holding her close. They hadn’t been this intimately close for a while, she missed his embrace so much, it felt so safe...
Lin Fan had no idea about Su Jinjin’s inner drama and thought her silence meant she was scared stiff, feeling a bit annoyed.
The BMW man got out and came to the front of his car, seeing a scratch because of the collision with Lin Fan’s scooter.
The BMW man felt heartache.
"Damn it, how did you park your lousy scooter to scratch my BMW? Can you afford to pay for it?" the BMW man cursed, pointing at Lin Fan.
The wicked accuses first!
If the BMW man had a better attitude and admitted fault, Lin Fan might not have minded, but with this attitude, Lin Fan was no longer polite.
"My scooter was parked in a parking space. What’s the problem? My scooter was already parked; you were the one who collided. If your car is scratched, that’s your own problem. I haven’t even blamed you for knocking over my scooter." Lin Fan said with a chuckle.
The BMW man knew he was in the wrong, but still huffed: "What, you want me to compensate you?"
Lin Fan said: "If I find out my scooter is damaged, you should compensate. Also, you scared her just now, you should apologize to her."
The BMW man glanced at Su Jinjin in Lin Fan’s arms, just as a gust of wind blew, lifting her hair and revealing her stunning profile.
The BMW man felt a surge of jealousy.
Damn!
This loser actually has such a beautiful girlfriend, while he can’t even find one as pretty while driving a BMW!
What right does this poor electric scooter rider have, it’s so infuriating.
"Did I hear wrong? You want me to compensate and apologize? You poor fool, do you even know who I am!" the BMW man arrogantly said.
Lin Fan calmly replied: "I really don’t know who you are."
The BMW man said: "Listen up, I’m the manager of this cinema! I see you two lovers are here to watch a movie, without my permission, you can’t even get in the door! Unless you apologize and pay for my car repairs!"
The BMW man was actually the manager here!
Lin Fan said lightly: "You’re overthinking, what about being the manager?"
The BMW man chuckled: "What about being the manager? Kid, you really don’t know your place. This place doesn’t welcome you, please leave immediately, or I’ll call security."
Lin Fan ignored the BMW man, took out his phone, and called Feng Ruolan: "Sister, I want to buy the Jinyi Cinema on Chunxi Road. There’s a 5 PM show; can you buy it before then?"
Feng Ruolan curiously asked: "Why suddenly buy a cinema?"
Lin Fan said: "I originally wanted to watch a movie here but ended up offending the manager."
Feng Ruolan laughed: "Got it, wait a moment, I’ll make a call."
Feng Ruolan hung up Lin Fan’s call.
The BMW man listened to Lin Fan’s phone call, stunned, then burst into laughter.
"You loser, putting on airs, claiming you’re buying this place. If it wasn’t for your cheap clothes, riding a crappy scooter, I almost believed you! Hahaha..."
The BMW man almost laughed uncontrollably.
It’s too funny; a poor loser acting like a tycoon, claiming to buy Jinyi Cinema, like it’s buying cabbage!
Su Jinjin was also a bit surprised, but she didn’t doubt Lin Fan’s ability to buy Jinyi Cinema. With Lin Fan’s wealth, buying a cinema is nothing.
She was surprised that Lin Fan would buy the cinema just to make the manager apologize to her?
So touched!
Su Jinjin’s heart raced; Lin Fan was too good to her, hard to say it wasn’t love!
Lin Fan smiled faintly: "You can still apologize and compensate now; once I buy this place, the first thing I’ll do is fire you."
The BMW man was both amused and angry: "This loser pretending is ridiculous; let’s see if you can keep pretending when the security throws you out!"
The BMW man took out his phone and made a call, notifying security.
Soon, two tall and burly security guards rushed over.
The BMW man said: "These two are causing trouble here; throw them out!"
The two security guards approached Lin Fan aggressively, saying: "Hurry up and leave!"
Seeing this, Su Jinjin became a little worried. Although Lin Fan was wealthy, Lin Fan likely wouldn’t be able to defeat these two security guards, right?
Lin Fan remained unflustered: "Two security brothers, wait a moment. If you still want this job, you’d better not act against us."
The two security guards were puzzled, glancing at each other, what did Lin Fan mean by this?
The BMW man said: "Ignore him, this kid drives a crappy scooter, pretending here, claiming he’s buying this cinema."
The two security guards were stunned for a moment, then couldn’t help but burst into laughter, not believing it; this kid looks like a loser, pretending here, probably has brain issues, right?
Then, Lin Fan received a text notification, looked down; it was from Feng Ruolan: "Transaction completed, I helped you with the money."
Lin Fan was thrilled; his super rich sister is the best.
"Sorry to say, I’ve already bought this Jinyi Cinema, I’m now the owner here." Lin Fan smiled.
No way they’re believing him, laughing even louder.
The BMW man was about to speak, suddenly his phone rang.
The BMW man checked the caller ID and quickly answered: "Hello, boss... What? Boss, what did you say? You just sold this cinema?"
Upon hearing this, the two security guards were shocked, no longer able to laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: I Announce, You’re Fired
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 285: I Announce, You’re Fired
The BMW guy received a call from his boss, learning that Jinyi Cinema had just been sold by his boss.
The BMW guy was very surprised.
"Boss, what happened? You sold the cinema? You’re not the owner anymore? Who did you sell it to?"
Listening to his boss talk, the BMW guy suddenly looked shocked and let out a cry of surprise, glancing at Lin Fan across from him.
Clang!
The phone dropped from his startled hand and shattered on the ground.
The BMW guy, however, couldn’t care less about the phone now; his face had turned pale when he just heard from his former boss that the cinema was sold to Lin Fan, the very shabby-looking guy in front of him!
"You... you really bought this cinema?" the BMW guy asked in a shaky voice, his legs trembling.
On the ground, the shattered phone was still connected.
The former boss’s voice came through: "Old Wang, the new owner of the cinema is something else. You absolutely must not offend him. Have you heard of Lin Fan? The one who bought Yunding Manor, Celestial Aviation, and Zhou Tian Mansion. I don’t even know why he took a liking to my little cinema. Working for him surely ensures a bright future. I’ll hang up now."
Beep!
The call was disconnected.
The BMW guy’s face turned ashen as he collapsed to his knees.
Heavens!
This young man in front of him is actually Lin Fan, the recently risen tycoon in Yun City!
Because he offended Lin Fan, Lin Fan directly bought out the cinema where he was the manager!
This truly is the style of a tycoon!
"Mr. Lin, I was blind and didn’t recognize you. I apologize. I was wrong. I want to apologize to you and your girlfriend. I almost hit her just now. I’m really despicable!" The BMW guy said, frightened to tears.
Lin Fan remained silent.
The BMW guy thought for a moment, hurriedly got up, went over to help Lin Fan pick up the electric scooter, checked it, and found no damage. He said, "Don’t worry, Mr. Lin. I blindly hit your vehicle. I will compensate you with a new electric scooter. I’ll buy the best one for you, just to ask for your forgiveness. It’s all my fault!"
The BMW guy slapped himself hard, leaving a handprint on his face.
Only then did Lin Fan speak: "The scooter is fine, forget the compensation. But what about your BMW? Weren’t you asking me for compensation earlier?"
The BMW guy replied, sweating profusely, "I wouldn’t dare. How could I ask Mr. Lin for compensation? It was entirely my fault for being distracted while on the phone."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, it’s good you know."
It was a bit amusing; the BMW guy had just been twisting the truth, insisting it was Lin Fan’s fault for scratching his car, but now he was meekly accepting responsibility.
Thinking it was all over, the BMW guy forced a laugh: "Mr. Lin, you’re generous and forgiving."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Generous and forgiving? What qualifications do you, a petty person, have for me to be generous and forgiving? You are really successful as a manager, treating customers like this?"
The BMW guy’s smile froze, making him very embarrassed.
Lin Fan continued, "I gave you a chance to apologize, but not only did you not apologize, you also called security to kick us out. Your chance is gone. I announce that you’re fired!"
The BMW guy fell to his knees again: "Mr. Lin, I’m begging you, please show mercy. I know I was wrong. I won’t dare do it again. Give me a chance. I can’t lose this job."
The BMW guy regretted it deeply; had he known Lin Fan was the young tycoon, he would have knelt and licked his boots rather than offend him.
Just like the former boss mentioned on the phone, who is Mr. Lin anyway? Being able to work under Mr. Lin promises a bright future. Being a manager is not important; what’s important is working for Mr. Lin, which offers endless possibilities.
Lin Fan said calmly, "I said your chance is gone. You are no longer the manager here. You’re not welcome here anymore. Please leave. Security guard, please escort him out!"
While speaking, Lin Fan’s stern gaze swept over the two security guards.
The two security guards had been petrified and remained frozen like statues.
Oh my!
This shabby-looking guy actually bought Jinyi Cinema!
He is Lin Fan, the recently hottest tycoon in Yun City!
This fact left the two security guards dumbstruck.
Hearing Lin Fan’s words and being swept with his stern gaze, the two security guards finally came to their senses.
"Yes, boss!"
The two security guards responded in unison. How could they not? They didn’t want to end up like the BMW guy, losing their jobs. Right now, a single word from Lin Fan could get them fired.
The two security guards immediately approached the BMW guy, exuding an intimidating aura, resembling two wolves.
"Get lost!"
"Don’t dawdle, hurry up and go!"
"We don’t want to get physical!"
The BMW guy sobbed, never imagining that the two security guards he had called to evict Lin Fan would now turn on him!
This world is insane!
Tycoons are overly rich, simple and direct, with money to burn. Who else could buy out someone’s company, leaving them with nowhere to go?
Only a tycoon could!
Although money might not be everything, having money truly lets you do as you please, turning the tables.
When wealth reaches a certain level, buying a cinema is really no different than buying a cabbage.
If a regular person makes a call to buy a cabbage, you wouldn’t find it unusual or astonishing.
So for a tycoon, buying a cinema is just like buying cabbage; it’s not something to be astonished by.
Of course, in the eyes of ordinary people, such acts by tycoons are naturally astonishing, the kind that makes jaws drop.
If ordinary people knew about this matter, it’s likely there would be a field of kneeling people.
Looking dejected, the BMW guy got into his BMW and left in defeat, escorted by the two towering security guards.
The BMW guy was extremely dejected and filled with regret. Missing the opportunity to work under Lin Fan was like missing out on a hundred million. For the rest of his life, it would be his greatest regret.
After driving away the BMW guy, the two security guards returned trembling to Lin Fan, waiting for his instructions, unsure of how Lin Fan would deal with them for mocking him earlier.
For a moment, the two security guards were drenched in cold sweat, as if awaiting sentencing.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "It’s fine now, you can go. You did well earlier, keep up the good work."
Lin Fan didn’t mention their earlier ridicule, instead giving them praise. He’s not someone who’s petty; rather than firing them, he preferred to win their loyalty.
As expected, this moved the two security guards to tears as they left.
Lin Fan glanced at his watch; it was ten minutes to 5 o’clock.
"Jinjin, the movie is about to start. We need to hurry in and buy tickets," Lin Fan called out.
"Hmm... Lin Fan, did you really buy this place?"
Su Jinjin responded, feeling very conflicted.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Why not? That guy offended you and wouldn’t apologize. For you, buying a cinema is nothing."
Oh my god, Lin Fan actually bought this cinema, making the BMW guy apologize to her obediently!
"Lin Fan, you must still love me, right?" Su Jinjin shouted in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Enemies on a Narrow Road
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 286: Enemies on a Narrow Road
Su Jinjin was in a great mood. Lin Fan accompanied her shopping today, watching a movie, and even having dinner with her, as if they had gone back to the past.
Moreover, she had made a decision to become Lin Fan’s girlfriend again, which made her feel enlightened and goal-oriented.
What made her happiest was that she felt Lin Fan still had love for her. Lin Fan actually bought the cinema just to make the manager apologize to her!
It was so sweet that Su Jinjin’s heart was melting, but Lin Fan didn’t bring up getting back together. Out of modesty, she wouldn’t mention it either, and this ambiguous state seemed quite beautiful.
After all, for two people in love, from meeting to falling in love, there’s a process, and the most beautiful part of it is undoubtedly the ambiguity.
Before Lin Fan and Su Jinjin started dating previously, there was also an ambiguous period which, in retrospect, was full of all kinds of sweetness, even more interesting than dating itself.
Because during the ambiguous period, both would show their best side and care for each other infinitely.
Su Jinjin and Lin Fan had been apart for three years, with no contact. She really wanted Lin Fan’s care once again.
"Jinjin, what are you thinking about? The movie is about to start, let’s go buy the tickets?" Lin Fan reminded.
Su Jinjin blushed, "Nothing, nothing, um, let’s go in quickly."
Su Jinjin reached out to pull Lin Fan’s coat tail; if she could, she really wanted to hold Lin Fan’s hand.
But Lin Fan turned his hand around and grabbed her small hand, then ran towards the cinema, "Hurry."
Lin Fan actively held her hand!
The two of them holding hands were just like a couple.
Su Jinjin was almost overwhelmed with happiness!
The two of them jogged into the cinema.
The movie they wanted to see was about to start, and there was still time to buy the tickets.
The cinema was already crowded with people waiting for the movie to start, mostly couples, occasionally mixed with some singles. The singles, seeing others paired up, couldn’t help but look somewhat forlorn.
As Lin Fan and Su Jinjin walked in hand in hand, they immediately attracted a lot of attention.
Whoa!
Handsome guy and beautiful girl!
The handsome guy was unbelievably good-looking, and the beautiful girl was incredibly pretty too.
The single guys’ eyes lit up, looking at Lin Fan with envy and hate, wishing they could cut off Lin Fan’s hand and replace it with their own.
Even those with girlfriends looked envious and jealous, comparing their girlfriends to Su Jinjin, feeling a wave of frustration.
Comparisons are really infuriating—why is Lin Fan’s girlfriend so beautiful?
Some of those girlfriends too had emotions, casting unfriendly looks at Su Jinjin, who had caught all their boyfriends’ attention with her beauty.
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin, eager to buy tickets, didn’t notice the glances around them.
"Two tickets for the 5 o’clock show." Lin Fan said to the staff at the counter.
The staff responded, "Sorry, sir, tickets for this show can’t be sold."
Lin Fan frowned, "Is this movie so popular that there are no tickets left?"
Su Jinjin said, "No, I just checked online and saw there were many empty seats, how come suddenly there are none?"
The staff replied, "There are seats, but due to special circumstances, the screening is locked. Sorry for the inconvenience."
Being the owner of the cinema, Lin Fan needed to understand the situation, "What’s the special circumstance? Why are tickets not being sold if there are seats?"
The staff member was about to explain.
Another female staff member rolled her eyes and impatiently said, "Why are you asking so much? When I say no tickets, it means no tickets. Honestly!"
This female staff member, seeing Lin Fan and Su Jinjin hand in hand clearly as a couple, was reminded of her own single status and no love, feeling jealous and naturally treating them with disregard.
Su Jinjin was a bit angry, "What’s wrong with asking? Can’t a customer find out the situation? What’s with your attitude?"
The female staff member rolled her eyes and ignored Su Jinjin, wearing a face of indifference.
Lin Fan chuckled, "This cinema’s staff isn’t quite up to par; looks like we’ll need some fresh blood."
At this moment, an announcement was made over the hall’s broadcast: "Dear audience, we regret to inform you that the five o’clock screening of ’Legend of Wang Duoyu’ cannot be shown due to unforeseen reasons. Please proceed to the service desk for a refund."
As soon as this announcement dropped, it caused an uproar.
Everyone had bought tickets waiting to see the movie, and now they were suddenly informed it couldn’t be shown. It was quite the buzzkill.
Everyone was wondering what issue had arisen to prevent the movie from being shown.
People gathered around the service desk, inquiring from the staff, but the staff didn’t have any answers to this issue.
Suddenly, a voice called out, "Step aside, let our young master through!"
It turned out two bodyguards in black suits were making way.
Pushing the crowd aside, they created a path, and a smartly dressed young man with slicked-back hair walked in, holding the hand of an Internet Celebrity Face.
"Sorry to trouble everyone, but today is my girlfriend’s birthday, and I booked the entire screening, so you’ll have to get a refund for your tickets."
The young man smiled cheekily.
The Internet Celebrity Face wore a blissful expression, "Thank you, darling, love you."
As she spoke, she gave the young man a peck on the cheek, leaving a big lipstick mark.
Watching the couple display their affection, the onlookers were displeased. It’s fine if this person wanted to book the screening to please his girlfriend, but why book their session and ask them to refund their tickets?
So annoying!
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound; he recognized this young man.
Feng Tianming!
The son of Yun City’s richest man, Feng Wanshan.
Lin Fan had had some run-ins with him before.
The reason this movie’s tickets were couldn’t be sold was because Feng Tianming had booked the screening.
The problem was, this was clearly against the rules—an already sold-out screening should not be allowed to be booked as it inconveniences all these ticket-buying patrons. Asking everyone to refund their tickets and book another time is quite troublesome.
Naturally, everyone was unhappy.
"This screening already sold so many tickets; I don’t agree with refunding them. The cinema’s actions are clearly unreasonable!"
Lin Fan spoke loudly.
Lin Fan’s words instantly garnered the crowd’s support.
No one expected this handsome guy to be not just good-looking but also righteous, as he was the first to stand up against Feng Tianming.
Everyone may have been dissatisfied, but upon seeing Feng Tianming with two bodyguards, it was clear he was a wealthy heir, so few dared to easily step forward.
That Lin Fan dared to stand out took real courage.
"This handsome man is right, why should we refund the tickets we’ve bought!"
"I won’t refund either!"
"This is simply outrageous!"
The crowd started complaining, and suddenly, the sounds of protest filled the room.
Feng Tianming’s gaze fell upon Lin Fan, and his expression changed.
Damn!
Talk about a narrow escape, bumping into Lin Fan here!
Feng Tianming had booked the screening to show off in front of his new Internet Celebrity girlfriend.
Unexpectedly, he ran into Lin Fan here—what rotten luck! Lin Fan was not an easy one to deal with.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Mr. Lin, if you need anything, just let me know
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 287: Mr. Lin, if you need anything, just let me know
However, Feng Tianming thought otherwise. As long as there was no fighting, what was there to fear? Sure, Lin Fan was quite skilled; that night, he even took down Muay Thai Li San. But as long as it wasn’t a fight, Feng Tianming was confident he could outwit Lin Fan.
On that day, he made a 100 million bet with Lin Fan. As the son of the richest man, Feng Tianming had no shortage of money.
Feng Tianming sneered, "How do I keep running into you everywhere? What, did you buy a ticket to this show too? Well, you’re out of luck. You’ll have to get a refund because I’ve booked the entire theater."
Lin Fan replied, "Oh? Who allowed you to book the theater? This show has already sold so many tickets, and yet you still managed to book it out?"
Feng Tianming proudly said, "That’s my skill. Are you unsatisfied? If you are, too bad for you!"
Feng Tianming felt delighted inside, finally gaining an upper hand against Lin Fan. What could Lin Fan do about it!
This cinema wasn’t his, and even if he had money, it was useless because Feng Tianming had already booked the show. Lin Fan couldn’t possibly compete with him.
Just then, a lanky man in a suit ran over, bowed respectfully in front of Feng Tianming, and said, "Young Master Feng, you’re here. The theater has been cleaned; you can enter now."
Feng Tianming patted the man on the shoulder and said, "Manager Sun, well done. I’ve got something else to ask of you."
The suited man quickly replied, "What is it, Young Master Feng?"
Feng Tianming arrogantly pointed at Lin Fan, "I don’t want to see this guy. Get rid of him!"
The suited man noticed Lin Fan, made an "oh" sound, and said, "Please wait, Young Master Feng."
The suited man walked up to Lin Fan, smiling, "Sir, did you buy a ticket? Sorry, Young Master Feng has already booked this show. Let us handle a refund for you, so you can leave. Is that okay?"
Without waiting for Lin Fan’s response, he told the service desk, "Refund his ticket."
The previously eye-rolling female clerk sneered, "Manager, no need to refund. This guy didn’t even buy a ticket. They wanted to, but we had already locked the booking."
What?
Feng Tianming burst into laughter, "What the hell, you didn’t even buy a ticket, and here you are putting on a show? Just get lost. Manager Sun, hurry and kick him out!"
The suited man, sweating, said, "Sir, since you haven’t bought a ticket, there’s no need for a refund. You can leave."
Lin Fan scrutinized the suited man, "Are you the manager here? If I’m not mistaken, you’re the one who allowed Feng Tianming to book the theater. You must know this is against the rules; it seems like you’ve taken some benefit from Feng Tianming!"
The suited man’s face turned a bit sour and replied, "Sir, don’t accuse without evidence. You know he’s Young Master Feng, right? I advise you to leave quietly to avoid trouble!"
Feng Tianming!
The son of Yun City’s richest man, Feng Wanshan!
An ultimate Rich Second Generation!
Ordinary people wouldn’t dare provoke him.
Upon learning Feng Tianming’s identity, everyone quieted down, not daring to stir up trouble. This was Feng Tianming, not just any rich heir, with his family’s wealth in the billions; it was enough to silence them all.
Although Lin Fan had bravely stepped forward, now knowing Feng Tianming’s identity, he probably wouldn’t dare anymore, especially since Lin Fan didn’t even have a ticket.
It seemed everyone would just have to get refunds. You couldn’t provoke the son of the richest man, but you could at least avoid him!
However, Lin Fan showed no intention of leaving.
"I indeed didn’t buy a ticket earlier, but that was because you locked the booking first. If not for that, I would have bought one, so in essence, I deserve an explanation." Lin Fan said calmly.
Bold!
Very bold!
Daring to stand up to Feng Tianming!
The crowd secretly admired Lin Fan while also worrying for him.
After all, Lin Fan looked like someone wearing cheap clothes, obviously not wealthy, challenging the son of the richest man, the difference in strength was too great.
The suited man was not pleased; Feng Tianming was watching, and Lin Fan’s refusal to leave was a headache!
"Kid, you didn’t even buy a ticket. You’re just causing trouble here. I have the right to ask you to leave. It’s best if you cooperate, so I can save you some dignity; otherwise, I won’t be polite!" the suited man said sternly.
Threats!
Blatant threats!
It seemed the suited man was eager to drive Lin Fan away to avoid Feng Tianming’s wrath.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Manager Sun, is it? Do you realize your actions will bring a lot of negative impact to this cinema? Will these spectators want to come here in the future? You still have a chance to correct your mistake: cancel Feng Tianming’s booking, resume the showtimes, and apologize to everyone."
Though the crowd was filled with silent anger, hearing Lin Fan speak up, they nodded in agreement.
If Manager Sun could do this, it would be wonderful.
Feng Tianming was annoyed at Lin Fan for trying to ruin his moment of showing off to the Internet Celebrity Face. How dare he spoil his show!
The Internet Celebrity Face was also displeased, "Honey, what’s going on? Why are these people still here? When can we watch the movie?"
Feng Tianming reassured her, "They’ll be gone soon!"
Feng Tianming was angry, turned to Manager Sun, and with a cold stare said, "Manager Sun, can you handle this or not?"
Manager Sun was startled; Young Master Feng’s anger was no small thing, and he definitely couldn’t afford to offend him.
Manager Sun was somewhat flustered; this was all Lin Fan’s fault!
Normally, theater-goers were nobodies, and even if Feng Tianming overtly disrespected them, they would have to endure it.
It was this very sense of impunity that led Manager Sun to allow Feng Tianming to book the theater last minute.
The patrons didn’t like it, but they had to accept it; they dared not cross Feng Tianming.
Except!
Along came Lin Fan!
This guy was a troublemaker, daring to directly confront Young Master Feng!
Fortunately, Lin Fan was the only troublemaker, and he was just a poor pauper, easy to deal with. If they could just get rid of him, all would be well.
So, Manager Sun waved to the female clerk, "Go get security!"
The female clerk hurried off, seemingly eager to see Lin Fan and Su Jinjin gone because of jealousy, despising their relationship.
After ordering the female clerk to get security, Manager Sun said coldly, "Kid, since you won’t cooperate and want to cause trouble, don’t blame me for being rude. I’ve given you the chance to save face, but you refused it!"
Lin Fan leisurely replied, "Oh, you’re calling security to kick me out? Fine, I’ll wait."
Feng Tianming was a bit worried since Lin Fan was notorious for his cunning. Even Muay Thai Li San was no match for him, and Manager Sun’s two security guards probably couldn’t handle him either.
It was uncertain whether, in front of everyone, Lin Fan would dare to fight the security guards.
The crowd was curious too; with the female clerk off getting security, could Lin Fan continue standing up to them?
It didn’t seem likely, as security was coming, and ordinary people couldn’t stand up to security guards.
Especially someone as broke as Lin Fan!
Lin Fan was bold, but the gap in strength was evident; surely he couldn’t contend against security guards with his hands tied!
Soon, the female clerk returned with two burly security guards.
She looked at Lin Fan with glee and disdain, as if he was bound to be doomed.
Seeing the security guards, Manager Sun pointed at Lin Fan, "This guy is causing trouble, throw him out."
The two security guards, initially eager to showcase their work, froze upon seeing Lin Fan, their souls nearly leaving their bodies.
Their faces turned pale.
No way!
The person Manager Sun wanted them to expel was Lin Fan!
The new owner of the cinema!
Thud!
Thud!
The two security guards’ legs buckled, and they knelt immediately.
"Mr. Lin, if there’s anything you need us to do, please let us know," they said anxiously.
What?
The security guards actually knelt before Lin Fan?
Everyone was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Don’t you know? Mr. Lin is our new boss.
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 288: Don’t you know? Mr. Lin is our new boss.
The security guard saw Lin Fan and actually knelt down; what was going on?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Especially Manager Sun, who was both shocked and angry: "I asked you to kick him out, what are you doing?"
The security guard looked at Manager Sun as if he were an idiot. No way, Lin Fan was their new boss; Manager Sun must have gone crazy.
Feng Tianming frowned at the sight. The people at this cinema were truly so damn strange; why would the security guard kneel for Lin Fan?
"Manager Sun, what’s going on?" Feng Tianming said, feeling a bit displeased.
Manager Sun had been unable to handle Lin Fan for so long that he was growing impatient.
Manager Sun was furious, yelling at the two security guards: "Get up and kick him out for me, did you hear?"
The two security guards exchanged a glance, finally convinced that Manager Sun was either crazy or didn’t know Lin Fan’s identity, the latter being more likely.
"Manager Sun, don’t you know? Mr. Lin... is our new boss."
"Mr. Lin just bought this cinema."
The two security guards reminded him kindly.
What?
Manager Sun was stunned, looking at Lin Fan, then the security guards: "Are you saying he’s our new boss?"
One of the security guards said, "Indeed!"
Manager Sun realized something; his forehead broke out in cold sweat, but he still refused to believe: "I don’t believe it; you must be joking. Where’s the manager? I need to see the manager."
The two security guards exchanged glances and shook their heads, feeling a bit sympathetic.
"No need to find the manager, the manager got fired for offending Mr. Lin."
"What?" Manager Sun jumped in shock, his body starting to tremble, "I don’t believe it; I want to find the boss."
He said as he pulled out his phone, dialing the former boss.
The former boss, once he answered, said: "Little Sun, you’re asking about the new boss, right? I was planning to inform you; I’ve sold the cinema to Mr. Lin, help me with one last thing, do an internal notification and announcement."
Manager Sun’s face turned ashen, and his phone slipped to the ground.
This young man in front of him was actually the new boss of the cinema!
Thud.
Manager Sun followed suit and knelt down: "Mr. Lin, so you are our new boss, I originally didn’t know, my apologies, but those who are unaware are not at fault, please forgive me."
He changed his attitude quickly, immediately beginning to flatter Lin Fan, nothing was more important than preserving himself.
By this time, everyone around was slack-jawed.
This young man dressed in cheap street clothes actually bought this cinema?
This was something they couldn’t even dream of.
No wonder Lin Fan showed no fear towards Manager Sun, no wonder the security guard knelt for Lin Fan!
Feng Tianming was already cursing inwardly, damn, Lin Fan actually bought this cinema, now that’s truly showboating!
His booking a whole film screening was nothing compared to Lin Fan, truly insignificant.
Lin Fan saw his identity revealed, chuckled, as it was within his expectations, the security guards knew him, and upon their arrival, his identity was naturally exposed.
"So, you’re Manager Sun," Lin Fan said coolly.
Manager Sun wiped his cold sweat: "Yes, Mr. Lin, my name is Sun Jiujiang."
Lin Fan said, "Who permitted you to allow Feng Tianming to book this screening? Although I’ve just taken over the cinema and haven’t grasped everything, I know screenings with so many tickets sold shouldn’t be booked by anyone, what you did is clearly against the rules."
Manager Sun was sweating profusely: "It was... it was my decision, Young Master Feng paid quite a bit... I, being momentarily confused, agreed. Mr. Lin, I realize my mistake, I’ll cancel this booking immediately!"
Lin Fan said coldly, "How much did Feng Tianming pay you?"
Manager Sun stammered: "This..."
Lin Fan said, "You had better answer honestly."
Manager Sun said, "Originally, I didn’t agree, but Young Master Feng insisted on booking this screening, so he gave me 30 thousand yuan, besides the booking fee, everything else was mine... I was momentarily confused, please forgive me, Mr. Lin."
Manager Sun spoke, turning to Feng Tianming: "Young Master Feng, sorry, this booking is canceled, I’ll refund you in full."
Feng Tianming’s face was unpleasant; the original intention of booking the screening was for showboating, and he specifically chose this screening to buy, aiming to show off his capability, that even with sold-out tickets, as long as he, Feng Tianming, wanted, he could still book.
This gave him considerable face in front of the Internet Celebrity Face.
The Internet Celebrity Face indeed initially praised his prowess, satisfying Feng Tianming greatly.
However, right now, this screening booking was mercilessly canceled, and Feng Tianming’s face was utterly lost!
The Internet Celebrity Face was somewhat irritated: "What happened? Just booking a screening to watch a movie, and it’s such a hassle, Feng Tianming, can you do it or not!"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Of course, he can’t, it ended before even starting."
The words immediately provoked a burst of laughter.
"That was unexpected driving!"
"I suspect Mr. Lin is driving, and I have evidence!"
"Dying of laughter, ended before starting, brilliant!"
"Mr. Lin wasn’t wrong, they hadn’t even entered before the booking was canceled."
Feng Tianming, hearing the mockery around him, got furious, and slapped the Internet Celebrity Face.
Smack!
Leaving a mark of five fingers on the Internet Celebrity Face.
"You dead bitch, wasn’t I doing this for you, you lowly woman, get lost!" Feng Tianming scolded.
The Internet Celebrity Face was slapped into tears on the spot yet didn’t dare confront Feng Tianming, covering her face and running away.
Feng Tianming, unable to stand it, looked at Lin Fan: "Lin Fan, consider this my bad luck, I didn’t know you bought the cinema, next time don’t let me find a chance, I definitely won’t spare you! Let’s go!"
How could he still have the face to stay, taking his two bodyguards, he left in dismay.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Young Master Feng, take care, by the way, I announce this cinema will permanently blacklist Young Master Feng, Young Master Feng, don’t bother coming next time."
Feng Tianming stumbled at the words, nearly falling over in anger, hastened his steps, and left.
Feng Tianming was furious, gritting his teeth: "Okay, Lin Fan, I will never swallow this insult, just wait!"
After dealing with Feng Tianming, Lin Fan announced on the spot: "This screening will resume as normal; due to Manager Sun’s inappropriate actions causing distress, I sincerely apologize, to make up for everyone’s inconvenience, this screening is on me, after the movie ends, you can refund at the counter with your ticket, additionally, all audience members can watch movies at half price in this cinema for a year."
This announcement caused great excitement all around!
Originally, the audience affected by Manager Sun’s idiocy were extremely disgruntled against the cinema, swearing never to return and were planning negative reviews.
Now Lin Fan offered such generous compensation, not only resolving the cinema’s crisis but also winning the hearts, the audience’s negative emotions turning into delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Su Jinjin’s blessings are truly great
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 289: Su Jinjin’s blessings are truly great
The audience happily went in to watch the movie.
Manager Sun wiped his cold sweat, knowing he was in big trouble this time. The most important thing now was to save himself.
"Mr. Lin, your approach is really brilliant, I genuinely admire you to the ground," Manager Sun chuckled awkwardly, "but this trouble was caused by me. I can’t let Mr. Lin bear the cost. I’ll take responsibility for my losses, just please give me another chance."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, do you think I can’t afford this little money?"
Manager Sun was so scared he broke out in a cold sweat: "That’s not what I meant. I meant, the trouble was caused by me, and I should bear the consequences, and make up for it..."
Lin Fan coldly said, "You think you can just pay money to settle this? You want to bear the consequences, right? Fine, pack your things and leave!"
Manager Sun’s face went pale, almost crying: "Mr. Lin, please give me another chance."
The two security guards exchanged a glance, understanding each other without words. Without a word, they stepped forward and lifted Manager Sun from both sides.
"The boss told you to get lost, why are you talking nonsense!"
The two security guards dragged Manager Sun out like a dead dog. They didn’t want to trouble the boss. If they were blamed, it would be a big deal. So, this was for the best.
All around was silence.
The employees of the cinema watched the scene, shivering in fear.
Especially the girl at the service counter, who was shaking uncontrollably like a leaf.
Ever since she learned that Lin Fan was the new boss, she had started trembling because she had once given Lin Fan a hard time.
And not only that, she had also cursed the boss’s girlfriend.
Now, she only hoped the boss could forget about her, a mere nobody.
However, a cold glance suddenly landed on her.
It was Lin Fan.
The girl at the service counter turned pale with fear, her body shaking even more. She stammered, "Sorry... I’m sorry, boss, I’m sorry, miss boss."
Upon hearing this, Su Jinjin couldn’t help but blush. This girl actually called her the miss boss!
Not to mention, this title secretly pleased her.
Lin Fan said blandly, "You can leave too. If I wasn’t the boss, would you have apologized? What did ordinary customers do wrong to suffer your attitude? With your service attitude, you’re not fit to stay here. Leave on your own, I don’t want to call security."
The girl didn’t dare to say anything, her face flushed red, she lowered her head silently and turned to leave.
She regretted it, oh how she regretted it. If she had known Lin Fan was the boss and Su Jinjin was the miss boss, even if she had ten times the courage, she wouldn’t dare to give them attitude.
After firing those who needed to be let go, the matter was finally resolved.
Lin Fan glanced at the remaining employees.
"I hope you take them as a lesson and don’t let this happen again in the future," Lin Fan said.
The employees all nodded in agreement. After what happened today, how would they dare in the future?
Su Jinjin looked at Lin Fan with a bit of admiration. Witnessing Lin Fan handle the entire matter personally, Lin Fan was calm and collected, acted decisively, and commanded her admiration. She felt she had learned something from it, something she could apply to management in the future...
Lin Fan was so amazing, so handsome. He was much more outstanding than he was three years ago; he was practically perfect...
Thinking of this, Su Jinjin’s heart began to race again.
Lin Fan turned to Su Jinjin: "Jinjin, let’s go in. The movie is about to start."
"Mm." Su Jinjin agreed softly and followed Lin Fan to watch the movie.
The employees all looked at Su Jinjin with envy. Su Jinjin was so fortunate to have found such an outstanding boyfriend as the boss.
At first, when they thought Lin Fan was a loser, they all felt Lin Fan was lucky to have found such a beautiful girlfriend like Su Jinjin.
Now their mindset had changed; they all felt it was Su Jinjin who was lucky...
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin entered the theater. The movie had already started, so they found a spot and sat down.
This movie, "Legend of Wang Duoyu," is a comedy, and the protagonist Wang Duoyu’s experience is somewhat similar to Lin Fan’s—they both had unexpected windfalls.
However, Wang Duoyu needs to complete a task to inherit his uncle’s fortune, having to spend a billion in a month.
So Wang Duoyu starts spending money like crazy, investing in various bizarre and funny projects.
"This project, I, Wang Duoyu, am investing," became a classic line.
Lin Fan thought this movie was pretty good, quite funny. He felt a strong resonance with Wang Duoyu’s experience. Ever since he got the system, he had also been spending money like crazy...
Moreover, to conceal the system, he also fabricated an uncle, Lin Beixuan.
Ni ma!
Wang Duoyu was practically him, Lin Fan!
After finishing the movie, they left the cinema. It was already past 7 PM and it was dark outside.
"Jinjin, I’m a bit hungry, shall we go eat?" Lin Fan suggested.
Su Jinjin couldn’t be more pleased: "Sure, what do you want to eat?"
Lin Fan said: "I don’t know either, you decide."
Su Jinjin thought for a moment and smiled sweetly: "I thought of a place."
A simply furnished little diner.
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin stood in front of the store.
Su Jinjin laughed: "I didn’t expect this place to still be open after all these years!"
Lin Fan laughed. This small diner was actually one of the four major chain diners in Huaxia, Shaxian Snacks!
It sounded high-end and classy, but in fact, it was an affordable roadside diner seen everywhere.
This Shaxian Snacks before them was near their university. Lin Fan and Su Jinjin used to come here often to eat.
Back then, Lin Fan was poor, very poor, and he didn’t want to spend Su Jinjin’s money, so when they went out on dates, they would often come here to eat. Just spending about ten yuan, they could fill themselves up.
Three years had passed, Lin Fan had become a billionaire tycoon, but this small diner was still here, looking more dilapidated than before.
"Jinjin, why did you think of bringing me here to eat?" Lin Fan asked.
Su Jinjin blushed. She brought Lin Fan here with a little motive in mind; she wanted Lin Fan to remember the experiences they once had. It was part of their shared memories.
Su Jinjin blushingly said: "It’s just that I haven’t had it in a long time and suddenly craved it."
Lin Fan said: "Alright, I haven’t had it in a long time either."
So the two of them stepped forward to push the door open and went in.
The shop wasn’t large, with only a few tables.
The guests were few: two single bachelor men and one single woman, occupying three tables.
When they saw Lin Fan and Su Jinjin come in, all three were somewhat amazed.
No wonder, Lin Fan was too handsome, and Su Jinjin was too beautiful. Wherever they went together, they were bound to become the center of attention.
"What would you two like to eat?"
A cheerful, smiling lady boss came up to them, asking.
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin exchanged a glance and smiled knowingly. They still recognized the lady boss, but it seemed the lady boss didn’t remember them.
"I’ll have a char siu rice with an extra egg," Lin Fan said, a meal he used to have often.
Su Jinjin couldn’t help but laugh, saying: "I won’t have rice, just a bowl of pork rib noodles."
"Alright then, please wait a moment," the lady boss smiled and went to the kitchen to prepare, muttering to herself, feeling that these two looked familiar but couldn’t recall why.
Not long after, the char siu rice and pork rib noodles were ready. The lady boss brought them over: "Enjoy your meal."
Looking at them, the lady boss wanted to say something but hesitated, feeling they were familiar yet not daring to recognize them.
"Mom, something’s wrong!"
Just then, a little girl ran in, looking anxious, and said to the lady boss.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Arrogant Young Master Feng: Can’t afford to pay? Then kneel and apologize to me
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 290: Arrogant Young Master Feng: Can’t afford to pay? Then kneel and apologize to me
The night had already fallen, and the old neighborhood near the school was very lively, filled with the bustling air of the market, with many students among the crowd.
University students generally don’t have much money and can’t afford high expenses, and the things in this neighborhood are generally cheap and accessible, so everyone likes to visit.
At this moment, a black Bentley appeared on the street. Normally, such a luxury car is rarely seen in this neighborhood, and it instantly attracted many glances of curiosity.
Sitting in the back seat of the Bentley were a middle-aged man and a young man with slicked-back hair.
"Dad, why did you bring me to this godforsaken place?" the young man with slicked-back hair frowned, expressing disdain for this place filled with an atmosphere of poverty.
The middle-aged man said, "What do you know, don’t just look at how it is now. After redevelopment, it will be different. I’m planning for you. This burden of the Feng Family will sooner or later be yours. Consider this neighborhood practice for you. How do you feel about it?"
This father and son were none other than Feng Wanshan and Feng Tianming.
Upon hearing this, Feng Tianming, said with surprise: "Dad, are you serious? You want to give me this neighborhood?"
Feng Wanshan said: "What do you think would be a good use for this neighborhood in the future?"
Feng Tianming smiled and said: "If it’s up to me, I want to build a large entertainment center here!"
Feng Wanshan frowned: "Foolish!"
Feng Tianming’s smile faded: "Dad... what do you think?"
Feng Wanshan said: "All you think about is play. Who will spend money at an entertainment center built in a place like this? Moreover, it’s close to a university. Do you think they will allow you to build a chaotic entertainment center here? This is only suitable for residential development."
Feng Tianming quickly said: "Yes, I don’t understand this area. I still need Dad to make the decision."
Feng Wanshan began to imagine: "Turning this place into a high-end residential area has a lot of potential. I’ve already laid out plans for you, but there’s still a lot to do. Do you see all the people around here? We need to clear them out first."
Feng Tianming disdainfully said: "Isn’t that easy? These are just poor nobodies. If we don’t let them come, where will they dare to come!"
As he spoke, Feng Tianming picked up a bottle of water to drink.
Suddenly, the driver made an emergency brake, and the car stopped.
Feng Tianming was jolted, spilling water all over himself, and he was furious: "Damn it, what’s going on?"
It turned out a tricycle had lost control in front and almost collided with the Bentley. The tricycle driver was terrified, knowing that if he damaged the Bentley, even selling everything he owned wouldn’t be enough to cover the repair costs.
In a panic, the tricycle driver made a sharp turn, causing the whole tricycle to flip over and fall to the ground.
The contents of the tricycle’s rear compartment spilled everywhere, mostly vegetables, noodles, and other ingredients, leaving a mess on the ground.
People around were frightened and quickly dodged away, fortunately without injuring any pedestrians.
The driver fell to the ground and sustained some minor injuries but managed to get up on his own, still in shock.
Feng Tianming jumped out of the car and pointed at the tricycle driver, cursing: "How the hell are you driving, blind dog eyes? Do you know who we are? Can you afford to compensate if you damage our car?"
The tricycle driver’s face turned pale, and he quickly apologized: "I’m sorry, just now there was a child playing on the street, suddenly ran into the street. I swerved to avoid him, almost hitting your car. I’m really sorry."
Feng Tianming scoffed: "I don’t care what the reason is, move your broken vehicle away quickly, you’re blocking our way! And you made me spill water all over myself, you’ll have to pay for my clothes!"
The tricycle driver saw that Feng Tianming was indeed soaked and looking rather disheveled, and he apologized very sincerely: "I’m really sorry, how much are the clothes? I’ll compensate you."
Feng Tianming sneered: "It’s not that I look down on your poor self. This outfit of mine is a Harold Tenune brand, 100,000, can you afford it?"
The tricycle driver was taken aback: "100,000, that’s too expensive, I can’t afford it."
He was so scared that he almost cried.
Feng Tianming said: "Can’t afford it, huh? If you can’t afford it, then kneel down and apologize to me! I am generous and might forgive you."
What?
The tricycle driver’s face changed, asking him to kneel and apologize, isn’t this humiliating him! A man’s dignity is like gold, how can he kneel so easily!
This commotion had already attracted the crowd nearby.
The onlookers, seeing Feng Tianming’s arrogance, all felt some resentment.
"The uncle was trying to avoid the child, that’s understandable, right!"
"And to avoid his car, the uncle was willing to topple his own vehicle and didn’t even hit his car!"
"Who is this rich guy, bullying people with his wealth?"
"This guy is too arrogant, so what if he’s rich!"
The crowd started to complain.
Unhappy with the murmuring around him, Feng Tianming said loudly: "Everyone shut up! Let me take this opportunity to tell you something, this neighborhood already belongs to the Feng Family. I can make you all leave anytime!"
Upon hearing this, the crowd was surprised.
"The Feng Family, Yun City’s richest Feng Wanshan!"
"I’ve heard this place is about to be demolished soon!"
"So the developer is the Feng Family!"
"Isn’t the Feng Family’s Shengshi Group untouchable!"
"No way, they are really going to demolish, where will we go shopping afterward, it’s so inconvenient!"
Realizing that this car was from the Feng Family, the onlookers felt some awe. The Feng Family is a family worth tens of billions, and these people dare not provoke them.
Meanwhile, as the accident happened here.
In a nearby Shaxian County stall, Lin Fan and Su Jinjin were having a meal.
This Shaxian County stall was where they used to come often. After watching a movie today, Su Jinjin specifically brought Lin Fan back here for dinner.
Lin Fan ordered a plate of barbecued pork rice, specially asking the owner to add an extra fried egg, while Su Jinjin ordered a bowl of spare rib noodles.
Su Jinjin, the third young lady of Su Family who grew up indulged in luxury, had never eaten in such a cheap eatery before. It was only after dating Lin Fan that she started eating here.
At first, Su Jinjin wasn’t used to it, but she gradually grew fond of it, especially liking the spare rib noodles of the Shaxian County stall, which she ate the most.
Soon, the owner brought over the meals they ordered.
"Enjoy your meal, you two." the owner said warmly.
While speaking, the owner looked them over, wanting to say something but hesitating. Since they entered the shop, she felt they looked familiar, but she couldn’t be sure.
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin noticed this and couldn’t help but exchange a smile.
"Do you remember us, owner? We used to come here often when we were in college." Lin Fan smiled and said.
Upon hearing Lin Fan, the owner immediately remembered and smiled: "It’s you two, Little Fan! What is the girl’s name again?"
She recalled Lin Fan’s name but couldn’t immediately remember Su Jinjin’s.
Su Jinjin said: "Auntie, I’m Su Jinjin."
The owner suddenly understood: "Right, Jinjin! It’s really you two. How long has it been since you last came, over three years!"

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Lin Fan Invested in This Project
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 291: Lin Fan Invested in This Project
Lin Fan smiled, "Hmm, it’s been over three years now."
Three years ago, Lin Fan and Su Jinjin were forcibly separated by Madam Su. Su Jinjin was sent abroad for studies, and since then, Lin Fan hadn’t returned to this shop. He tried to avoid places he had visited with Su Jinjin to prevent himself from getting emotional.
The landlady naturally didn’t know what had happened between them and thought they were still together all along.
The landlady smiled and said, "I didn’t expect to see you two again. You must be married by now, right?"
Su Jinjin’s cheeks flushed. If she were married to Lin Fan, it would be wonderful, but unfortunately, they weren’t.
"No, we’re not!" Su Jinjin denied.
The landlady laughed, "If you ask me, you should get married and have kids soon. In my eyes, you two are a perfect match, and you’ve been together for so many years. An auntie can tell you really love each other."
Su Jinjin’s face turned even redder, but her heart felt sweet. The landlady had a way with words, saying she and Lin Fan were made for each other. If only the auntie could go on talking.
Lin Fan let out a hearty laugh but didn’t clarify anything.
There was really no need to explain their situation to the landlady.
Lin Fan looked down, took a bite of a fried egg, and deliberately changed the subject, "Auntie, your fried eggs are still as delicious as ever. There was a time when I couldn’t afford them, and you wouldn’t charge me. Later, I was too embarrassed, so I stopped ordering them, but you’d still give me one."
The landlady was indeed a good person, and Lin Fan had never forgotten her kindness in giving him fried eggs.
The landlady chuckled, "I only did that because you looked so skinny, I pitied you."
All three of them couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
The landlady asked, "By the way, what brought you back all of a sudden today?"
Su Jinjin replied, "We just happened to be nearby and suddenly remembered we hadn’t been here in ages, so we thought we’d stop by for a bite. If we have the time, we’ll come back often."
Upon hearing this, the landlady’s expression darkened, "In the future... there might not be a chance."
Lin Fan and Su Jinjin were a bit curious.
"Auntie, do you not want to continue the business?" Su Jinjin asked.
The landlady said, "It’s not that; it’s because I heard that this neighborhood might be redeveloped soon. Small businesses are hard to run nowadays. I’ve held on because the rent here is cheap. If it really is slated for redevelopment, I probably won’t continue running the shop and plan to return to the countryside."
Lin Fan gave an understanding nod, "Really? Is this whole neighborhood being redeveloped?"
The landlady said, "That’s what I’ve heard, but I don’t know for sure."
Su Jinjin regrettably commented, "This neighborhood is quite nice, why would they redevelop it? It won’t even be possible to come back here for nostalgia."
The landlady said, "Luckily, you came tonight. If you came a month later, the redevelopment might be underway."
While they were talking.
Suddenly, a little girl ran in from outside.
"It’s bad, Mom, something happened!"
The little girl, looking anxious, told the landlady.
The landlady asked, "Why are you so panicked? What’s happened?"
The little girl said, "It’s Dad, Dad’s car overturned!"
The landlady was shocked, "I’m so sorry, I need to check on it."
Lin Fan stood up, "Auntie, wait, we’ll come along to see if we can help."
And with that, they all left the shop and went out onto the street.
On the street.
A tricycle had flipped over, with food supplies scattered everywhere, making a mess.
Feng Tianming was aggressively demanding the tricycle driver kneel and apologize, or otherwise pay him 10 million.
The tricycle driver didn’t want to kneel; it was too humiliating, but he couldn’t afford that kind of money.
"What are you hesitating for? Hurry up and kneel to apologize, and move your wreck of a vehicle, we want to get through!" Feng Tianming said impatiently.
In the car, Feng Wanshan didn’t stop Feng Tianming. Feng Wanshan’s thought was to have Feng Tianming set an example of authority to deter anyone thinking of defying the Feng Family when the redevelopment happened.
In Feng Wanshan’s eyes, these people were nothing but ants.
The tricycle driver, under pressure, gritted his teeth and finally decided to kneel before Feng Tianming.
Kneeling in exchange for 10 million, although humiliating, seemed worthwhile.
Just as the tricycle driver was bending his knees, ready to kneel.
Suddenly, a large hand reached out, supporting the tricycle driver’s elbow, pulling him back up.
"Why should you kneel for him? You haven’t done anything wrong."
A calm voice spoke.
Lin Fan!
Immediately, all eyes were on Lin Fan.
Everyone present had been intimidated by the Feng Family; no one dared to stand up, even though they were displeased with Feng Tianming’s arrogance. No one dared to speak up for the tricycle driver.
Lin Fan stepping forward naturally drew attention.
Onlookers saw Lin Fan wearing thrift store clothes, clearly a poor man, yet he dared to oppose the Feng Family. They couldn’t help but admire Lin Fan; the young man was so brave.
And despite his humble attire, the young man was quite handsome!
The tricycle driver looked at Lin Fan in surprise, then noticed Su Jinjin, the landlady, and the little girl behind him.
The tricycle driver was the landlady’s husband, the little girl’s father, and the owner of the Shaxian County eats!
He had been returning from a supply run, driving his vehicle, when kids suddenly ran in front of him, forcing him to swerve. By sheer bad luck, he almost collided with a Bentley.
The repairs for the luxury car led him to sacrifice his own vehicle.
He hadn’t expected that Feng Tianming would still not let it go even without colliding with the Bentley.
Feng Tianming saw Lin Fan and blurted out, "Damn it, why do I see you everywhere!"
It was unexpected to run into Lin Fan here again!
Just a few hours earlier, he had had a clash with Lin Fan at the cinema, which ended with him losing because Lin Fan owned the cinema. He had to leave, feeling humiliated.
What a case of enemies meeting again so soon.
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m also curious, why are you everywhere? Why are you driving a Bentley here?"
Feng Tianming laughed smugly, "Oh, you don’t know, do you? This neighborhood belongs to the Feng Family now. I was just here to inspect."
Lin Fan frowned, "Are you the ones redeveloping this place?"
Feng Tianming proudly declared, "Exactly! Lin Fan, today I lost to you at the cinema because it was yours. Now you’re on my turf; you don’t get to argue here. You either stay aside and watch or get out of my turf."
Feng Tianming held a grudge over the cinema incident and vowed to retaliate against Lin Fan.
Unexpectedly, the opportunity had come so quickly. Lin Fan stepping onto his turf now meant it was time for him to show off.
He wanted to teach Lin Fan a harsh lesson in front of everyone.
This was his turf, and Lin Fan had no say here!
Just then, Lin Fan’s phone suddenly rang.
Lin Fan looked at the caller ID—it was He Chen.
Earlier that day, Lin Fan had tried to persuade He Chen to join his Company, leaving his contact for He Chen to call anytime he had made up his mind.
This was an important call Lin Fan couldn’t afford to ignore.
"Mr. Lin, are you really sincere about building rockets?" He Chen’s voice earnestly inquired over the phone.
Lin Fan smiled, "Absolutely, I guarantee Mr. He won’t be disappointed."
He Chen paused for a moment, then replied, "Alright, I’ll join."
Lin Fan was overjoyed, "Great, Mr. He, I’ll give you a call soon to arrange a meeting."
The call ended.
Suddenly, a voice rang in his mind.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for successfully recruiting rocket genius He Chen!"
"Ding!"
"Mission complete, reward granted: the host is awarded a block. The block the host is currently in now belongs to the host, please check and receive."
What?
Lin Fan was both surprised and delighted; the system’s reward was quite generous!
Lin Fan looked up at Feng Tianming, who was arrogantly smug on the other side, and smiled slightly.
"You say this block belongs to the Feng Family? I don’t think so. I now announce, I’ll invest in this project."
What?
Isn’t that a classic line from "Legend of Wang Duoyu?"
This project, I’ll invest in it.
Upon hearing this, everyone present was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: This Lin Fan, probably possesses extraordinary means.
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 292: This Lin Fan, probably possesses extraordinary means.
Lin Fan wants to invest in this neighborhood?
Everyone was stunned.
Naturally, no one believed Lin Fan. After all, Lin Fan looked like he was dressed in cheap clothes. How could he possibly be a wealthy person capable of investing in this neighborhood?
Although this neighborhood is a civilian area, it’s still a neighborhood, valued in the billions. To invest in a neighborhood, unless you’re a trillion-dollar company like Shengshi Group, it’s simply not feasible.
So everyone thought Lin Fan was joking.
Feng Tianming also didn’t believe that Lin Fan wanted to invest in this neighborhood.
Although he knew Lin Fan had the financial capability, Lin Fan wouldn’t need to spend that kind of money just to make a point, right?
Besides, this neighborhood becoming the Feng Family’s was already a foregone conclusion, and Lin Fan stepping in now would be useless!
"Lin Fan, what are you saying? You want to compete with our Feng Family for this land? You really don’t know your limits! I don’t even know why you’re meddling!" Feng Tianming snorted coldly.
Lin Fan said, "I heard from the lady boss that your Feng Family wants to demolish this neighborhood. Is that true?"
Feng Tianming said, "So what if it is? Our Feng Family wants to make money with this land. We certainly won’t let it remain as it is. Otherwise, why would we acquire it? Of course, it would be demolished to build commercial housing. What, do you have a different opinion?"
Lin Fan said, "That’s exactly why I want to get involved. If this place gets demolished, the lady boss will have to go back to the countryside. I hope this place can stay the same. I want to still be able to come here for her barbecued pork and fried eggs when I feel like it."
Hearing this, the lady boss was quite touched: "Little Fan, you have a good heart, but..."
Although Lin Fan had good intentions, where would Lin Fan get enough money to compete with the Feng Family? It’s known that back then, Lin Fan couldn’t even afford a fried egg.
Lin Fan continued, "I believe that most people here share my sentiment. I want to ask everyone present, do you want this place to be demolished for the Feng Family to build commercial housing, or do you want it to remain the same?"
"Of course, we want it to remain the same!"
"If this place gets demolished, where will we go for shopping? Things are so cheap here!"
"If it doesn’t have to be demolished, of course, we don’t want it to be demolished!"
