Everyone chimed in, almost nobody wanted it to be demolished.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Did you hear that? Your Feng Family’s plan to demolish this place is unpopular."
Feng Tianming sneered, "Who cares what these poor folks think? Who do they think they are? Just because they don’t want it to be demolished doesn’t mean it won’t be. Lin Fan, if you’re determined to cross our Feng Family, fine, but you’ll be disappointed this time. This land is already ours. You’re too late to intervene now."
Lin Fan said, "Is that so? You could ask your dad."
At this moment, the door of the Bentley behind Feng Tianming opened, and Feng Wanshan, holding a phone, walked out with a sullen face.
"Dad, this Lin Fan wants to take this neighborhood from us. You should let him know he should give up!" Feng Tianming laughed.
Previously, Feng Wanshan had told him this neighborhood was essentially theirs, even guaranteed 100%, because no one was competing with them, and no one had the financial capacity to do so.
Shengshi Group’s current status is inseparable from Feng Wanshan’s strategic investment foresight.
Feng Wanshan always managed to stay a step ahead, securing potential real estate and creating massive wealth through various maneuvers.
After research and analysis, Feng Wanshan decided to acquire this neighborhood and, once again, was ahead of the curve with no competition.
So Feng Wanshan was very confident that this neighborhood would be the Feng Family’s.
However, at this moment, Feng Wanshan seemed to have just finished a call, his face sullen and looking quite distressed.
"Tianming, get in the car, we’re leaving." Feng Wanshan said sternly.
Feng Tianming was dumbfounded. What did his father mean?
With such a perfect opportunity to deal with Lin Fan, why was his father asking him to leave?
"Dad..." Feng Tianming asked, confused.
Feng Wanshan was slightly angry: "I told you to leave, so leave!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Feng Tianming, spare your dad some dignity. If I’m not mistaken, Boss Feng already knows that this neighborhood is mine now."
What?
Everyone looked at each other.
They all thought Lin Fan was joking.
Wasn’t he?
Feng Tianming was also shocked: "Dad, tell me this isn’t true. How could this neighborhood belong to Lin Fan? Didn’t you say we were guaranteed to get it?"
Feng Wanshan was nearly enraged. He hadn’t intended to lose face in public, but his foolish son insisted on asking.
Feng Wanshan glared at Lin Fan, saying with resentment, "Lin Fan, why must you always oppose me?"
He felt frustrated. Lin Fan always beat him to the punch, taking away everything he wanted.
Yunding Manor was like this, Chiba Island was like this, and the Shendiao Old Factory land was like this.
Now, this neighborhood was also snatched by Lin Fan first!
He’d just received a call. Originally, this neighborhood was the Feng Family’s, a sure thing, but for some unknown reason, it had become Lin Fan’s asset just moments ago!
Lin Fan, he feared, had extraordinary means, capable of getting whatever he wanted immediately?
Feng Wanshan naturally didn’t believe Lin Fan could just get whatever he wanted. He leaned towards the idea that Lin Fan, like him, had his eye on this land early on.
But Lin Fan made his move quietly, stealthily acquiring the land. This was a classic case of "concealed approach" or "tower stealing."
Feng Wanshan even suspected that there were moles within Shengshi Group, planted by Lin Fan, leaking commercial secrets to him, and that was why Lin Fan could get ahead of him.
Lin Fan hadn’t expected Feng Wanshan to think so much and said, "Sorry, Boss Feng, I didn’t know it was you who wanted to demolish this place. I didn’t target you specifically."
Feng Wanshan snorted, "Don’t be so pretentious. You must have known I wanted this place beforehand, so you quietly took it first! You’re clearly going against me, Feng Wanshan!"
What?
Everyone was shocked.
Feng Wanshan personally confirmed it? Lin Fan actually acquired this neighborhood?
Oh my god, how is that possible!
Lin Fan, with his bargain-bin attire, turned out to be a super tycoon?
"Lin Fan, he’s Lin Fan, the recently ascended young tycoon!"
"It’s him, oh my god, he actually came here!"
"What? That mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin who acquired Yunding Manor?"
"I heard the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin is Lin Fan’s uncle!"
"No way, it’s really him!"
Gradually, people started to recognize Lin Fan’s identity, and the surroundings grew uproarious.
Lin Fan’s fame was no longer confined to the business world. Clearly, even ordinary civilians had heard of him.
The lady boss, with a face full of disbelief, grabbed Su Jinjin and asked, "Jinjin, what’s going on? Is Little Fan really a tycoon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 293: The Feng Family Father and Son Get Out of This Street
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 293: The Feng Family Father and Son Get Out of This Street
The crowd recognized Lin Fan’s identity, and for a moment, the whole street was in an uproar!
The young tycoon who had recently risen in Yun City had come to their neighborhood, and had even taken this area from the Feng Family!
This was simply astonishing.
At first, the crowd was informed by Feng Tianming that this area would soon be demolished, which was quite a blow. Most people did not want this area to be demolished.
For the residents here, this was the place where they grew up and lived, and they did not want to give it up. For many shop owners, the rent here was cheap, and they could make a living by doing small businesses here. Once they left, the costs would increase. For example, the owner of the Shaxian snacks restaurant would have to return to the countryside if she couldn’t open her shop here.
For students from the nearby university, this was a good place to shop and eat. Things were cheap and suited the budget of young couples with little money.
However, it was the Feng Family, the billion-dollar Shengshi Group, who intended to demolish this area.
The Feng Family had already acquired this land, and even if they didn’t want it, there was no way to stop it. They could only silently endure it, secretly hoping for a miracle to happen.
A miracle really did happen!
Suddenly, Lin Fan appeared out of nowhere and managed to acquire this area before the Feng Family!
Moreover, Lin Fan claimed that he would maintain the current state of this area.
Naturally, everyone was overjoyed. For a moment, smiles spread across their faces, and they were extremely grateful to Lin Fan.
"Wonderful!"
"Mr. Lin, you’re amazing!"
"Fantastic, Mr. Lin is truly a benevolent tycoon!"
The crowd praised Lin Fan unanimously, and the street was filled with an air of joy.
Only the father and son of the Feng Family were about to explode with anger.
Feng Wanshan insisted that Lin Fan was targeting the Feng Family. Otherwise, how could he have gotten this land before them!
Moreover, how could it be such a coincidence that Lin Fan came here tonight? It must be because he took over this area that he came here.
As a result, enemies meet on a narrow road.
It must be like this!
Feng Wanshan was furious.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless and said, "Boss Feng, I did decide to acquire this area on a whim. I didn’t do it to target the Feng Family."
Feng Wanshan snorted coldly and said, "Do you think I will believe your words? Lin Fan, you’d better not let me find evidence!"
Lin Fan shrugged, "If you don’t believe it, there’s nothing I can do. If you think I’m targeting the Feng Family, then so be it. I don’t care. After all, the Feng Family isn’t such good people. Don’t forget what you’ve done?"
Feng Wanshan naturally knew what Lin Fan was referring to.
Feng Wanshan had tried to create a scandal for Lin Fan in an attempt to bring down the stock price of Celestial Aviation, only to be seen through by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan did not continue to entangle with Feng Wanshan over this matter, but it didn’t mean that Lin Fan would let it slide. He would settle this score with Feng Wanshan sooner or later.
However, for Lin Fan, the more important thing was to win over Anna. For Anna, Lin Fan temporarily put this matter aside.
Feng Wanshan’s face twitched, "Fine, let’s consider it my oversight this time. But you can’t always be so smug, Lin Fan. I guarantee you’ll fall into my hands sooner or later!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Is that so, I’ll be more than happy to accompany you to the end!"
At this point, Feng Tianming was almost in tears. Originally, he was still brooding over the cinema incident and wanted to take revenge on Lin Fan.
Just in time, Lin Fan showed up in this area, which belonged to the Feng Family. It was as if Lin Fan had stepped onto the Feng Family’s territory, giving Feng Tianming the perfect opportunity to show off.
Who would have thought!
In the blink of an eye, this area had also become Lin Fan’s!
The situation reversed, and he was once again on Lin Fan’s turf!
"Lin Fan, my dad is right. Since you’re going against our Feng Family, you’d better be prepared for the Feng Family to deal with you!" Feng Tianming said hatefully.
Lin Fan chuckled, "With such dastardly things, I never doubted your Feng Family for a second. I’ll be waiting. But sorry, this area is mine. Please leave; you’re not welcome here!"
A burst of laughter erupted around them.
"Hurry up and leave!"
"The Feng Family is really despicable, wanting to tear down our area. They should have left long ago!"
"A rat crossing the street, everyone yells to beat it!"
"Feng Family father and son, get out of this street!"
Voices of scorn filled the air as people laughed and drove the Feng family father and son away.
Feng Wanshan and Feng Tianming’s faces alternated between green and white, almost losing their minds with anger. But in the face of such a surging tide of voices, they were like a small boat in a storm, daring not to stay any longer.
Moreover, the more embarrassing it was, the more shame they would endure if they continued to stay.
The father and son gloomily got into the Bentley, closing the door.
Bam!
Suddenly, an egg flew out from somewhere and hit the door of the Bentley, breaking into pieces.
If the Feng Family father and son hadn’t closed the door quickly, they would have been covered in eggs.
"Hahaha..."
A burst of laughter erupted around them.
Following that, many things were thrown at the Bentley: vegetable leaves, eggs, slippers...
They all hit the Bentley with a clatter.
The million-dollar luxury car suddenly looked quite pathetic.
Originally, no one dared to provoke the Feng family father and son, and they certainly wouldn’t dare to touch the million-dollar car. If it got scratched, they might not even be able to afford the repair costs.
The tricycle driver didn’t dare to collide with the Bentley and was willing to overturn his own vehicle.
But at this moment, in the tide of public anger, who cared about rich people and luxury cars.
"Reverse quickly!"
Feng Wanshan was heartbroken, his face livid, and quickly gave the order.
The driver hurriedly reversed the car, and soon they were out of the street, fleeing like rats crossing the street.
Seeing the Feng Family’s car escape, the crowd cheered as if celebrating a victory.
Seeing off the Feng family father and son, Lin Fan turned back to Su Jinjin and the others.
"Are you okay, sir?" Lin Fan asked the tricycle driver.
This tricycle driver was the owner of the Shaxian snacks restaurant.
The owner quickly said, "I’m not badly hurt, just a minor injury. I’ll go back and bandage it. Thank you so much, Mr. Lin, for your help, otherwise..."
Earlier, he was forced by Feng Tianming to kneel and apologize, which he felt was humiliating, but he chose to bow his head to avoid paying 100,000 yuan.
It was Lin Fan’s sudden appearance that saved him from this humiliation.
The owner was very grateful to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to thank me. I did this because of the lady boss."
Saying this, Lin Fan looked at the lady boss.
At this moment, the lady boss had learned from Su Jinjin that Lin Fan was indeed a wealthy person, and she was quite amazed. In just three years, Lin Fan had transformed from a poor student who couldn’t afford a fried egg into a super-rich man who didn’t bat an eye when acquiring this area!
How could he have done it?
"Little Fan, did you really do this for me?" the lady boss, somewhat flattered, asked.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Absolutely, didn’t you once waive the cost of the fried egg for me? Where else can I find such a great lady boss? I hope you continue your business here, so I can come back and have a meal in the future."
The lady boss was moved to tears and laughed while saying, "Thank you, Little Fan, you’re welcome any time. I’ll still give you free fried eggs."
Upon hearing this, everyone laughed.
Beside them, Su Jinjin looked at Lin Fan with deep affection. This man had won her over completely, and it was clear he wasn’t doing it just for the lady boss’s fried egg.
He had spent millions to acquire this area, evidently to preserve the memories they shared!

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Su Jinjin Hugged Lin Fan from Behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 294: Su Jinjin Hugged Lin Fan from Behind
Su Jinjin naturally misunderstood the situation. Lin Fan didn’t invest in this neighborhood to preserve the old place in their memories, nor to continue eating the landlady’s fried eggs.
Indeed, Lin Fan hoped to keep this neighborhood, but he wouldn’t invest so much money just to preserve it. Lin Fan has the financial capability now, but he wouldn’t waste money like that.
Buying a cinema is as easy as buying a cabbage for him, without even blinking. However, buying this neighborhood would cost him an amount that would make him feel the pinch, unless it can create value. Otherwise, he wouldn’t invest this money, and this neighborhood doesn’t seem to offer him much value.
But this is a system reward, which makes it different.
A system reward is free, so there’s no reason not to take it!
Lin Fan couldn’t tell others that this was a reward from the system.
So he casually found an excuse, saying he wanted to preserve the neighborhood and continue eating the landlady’s fried eggs.
As a result, Lin Fan won everyone’s praise. Lin Fan spent millions to preserve the prosperity of one place, truly a great philanthropist.
The news spread, and it was sure to bring Lin Fan immense reputation.
The landlady was moved to tears. When Lin Fan was a poor boy, she gave him free fried eggs, and now Lin Fan repaid her kindness tenfold. She was very gratified.
As for Su Jinjin, she filled in the rest of the story herself, believing Lin Fan preserved their old place out of love for her, making her feel sweet inside.
Lin Fan never imagined that his casual excuse would achieve multiple goals!
Anyway, this neighborhood was now under Lin Fan’s assets.
Lin Fan had no plans to make any changes to the neighborhood for now, so he simply let it retain its current state.
He understood now that every system reward has a purpose.
The reward for this neighborhood might have benefits he doesn’t know yet.
This reward made Feng Family father and son suffer under Lin Fan again, which could be seen as a benefit.
The Feng Family father and son were essentially Lin Fan’s sworn enemies.
Feng Wanshan had challenged Lin Fan multiple times, but each time he was embarrassed by Lin Fan. This time, Feng Wanshan was humiliated in public again.
No doubt, Feng Wanshan would not let this rest, and he would surely have plans.
But what Feng Wanshan didn’t know was that Lin Fan also had plans.
Currently, Lin Fan was secretly investigating An Jincheng’s disappearance...
"This case needs to be solved quickly," Lin Fan thought.
Meanwhile, at the police station.
Officer Loli was hard at work under the lamp, diligently reviewing An Jincheng’s case files...
She got involved in this case initially because Lin Fan asked her to, as Lin Fan was her idol... But now, she seemed genuinely invested in the case herself.
The neighborhood turmoil finally ended with Feng Wanshan and his son leaving embarrassedly; afterward, Lin Fan and Su Jinjin also left.
Watching Lin Fan ride a broken electric bike with Su Jinjin and leave, everyone couldn’t help but break a sweat. This man, who casually purchased the neighborhood, was extraordinarily low-key. He wore cheap clothes and rode a broken electric bike—who would guess he’s a billionaire...
"Jinjin, it’s getting late, shall I take you home?"
On the electric bike, Lin Fan said.
Su Jinjin replied, "Okay."
She was still immersed in sweetness.
Reflecting on the day she ran away from the wedding was surely the right decision; she refused to be a pawn of her family, marrying someone she didn’t love.
On that night, she reunited with Lin Fan.
Since their reunion, everything Lin Fan did for her was nothing short of amazing—it was Lin Fan who helped her flee the wedding, and Lin Fan who dealt with Madam Su.
Today during their date, Lin Fan bought her a cinema and a neighborhood.
If this isn’t love...
But why is Lin Fan so reserved and won’t express his love clearly?
It must be because three years ago, Lin Fan was hurt so deeply. Even though he loves her and has done so much for her, he doesn’t dare to voice his love.
That’s right, it must be so.
Thinking of this, Su Jinjin couldn’t help but feel very sorry for Lin Fan. Over these three years, Lin Fan had suffered.
Suddenly, she gathered enormous courage, reached out from behind, embraced Lin Fan’s waist, and pressed her face against his back.
When they dated before, she loved doing this while sitting on Lin Fan’s bicycle.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised by Su Jinjin’s embrace, wanted to say something but ultimately remained silent, allowing her to hold him.
The two seemed to share a silent mutual understanding, neither speaking a word, yet there was a vague, sweet, youthful affection lingering around them, carried by the wind.
Just like the past...
The Su Family, in Su Jinjin’s home.
Su Jinjin’s mother, Zheng Xue’e, felt a bit anxious at the moment.
Today, Madam Su suddenly came with people to her house, saying she was looking for Su Jinjin. After learning Su Jinjin was not home, Madam Su and her people decided to stay and wait for her.
Zheng Xue’e offered to call Su Jinjin and ask her to come home but was stopped by Madam Su.
Who knew what Madam Su was up to this time?
Previously, because Su Jinjin’s father was not successful, the three of them were marginalized in the Su Family. Zheng Xue’e had no voice in the Su Family. Even when Madam Su wanted to use Su Jinjin as a pawn for marriage into the Li Family, concerning her own daughter’s marriage, Zheng Xue’e, as the mother, wasn’t even in on the decision.
Of course, Zheng Xue’e didn’t oppose Su Jinjin marrying into the Li Family, considering it an opportunity to change their status.
It’s known that Zheng Xue’e pinned all her hopes on Su Jinjin. Since Su Jinjin was young, Zheng Xue’e hoped Su Jinjin could marry into a wealthy family, soar high, and slap the Su Family members who looked down on them.
Therefore, Zheng Xue’e strongly opposed Su Jinjin dating Lin Fan back then, even though she was the main force in breaking them up.
In the matter of breaking up Lin Fan and Su Jinjin, Zheng Xue’e and Madam Su stood on the same front for the first time.
Back then, Zheng Xue’e believed Su Jinjin marrying Lin Fan would ruin her life, not only Su Jinjin’s but also Zheng Xue’e’s life, as she counted on Su Jinjin marrying into a wealthy family to change her fate.
Zheng Xue’e never dreamed.
Three years later, Lin Fan, who reappeared, had become a famed tycoon in Yun City.
With a wave of his hand, he revived the Su Family and made Su Jinjin the president of Su Corporation!
Her dream of changing fate was ultimately realized by Lin Fan, whom she drove away three years ago.
In recent days, Zheng Xue’e couldn’t describe the feeling in her heart.
Both she and Madam Su felt similarly, a little afraid to see Lin Fan.
Today, Madam Su suddenly showed up with people, surely something happened, causing Zheng Xue’e’s heart to feel anxious and uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Your grandson has already knelt, why don’t you kneel?
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 295: Your grandson has already knelt, why don’t you kneel?
Is it related to Lin Fan?
Bear in mind, Madam Su is now supporting Su Jinjin entirely because of Lin Fan; Lin Fan’s big contract is extending the life of the Su family.
But what if Madam Su falls out with Lin Fan?
Su Jinjin would certainly be the first to suffer, and Zheng Xue’e wouldn’t be spared either.
Madam Su has been waiting here all day.
Su Jinjin hasn’t returned.
Zheng Xue’e is becoming restless.
"Madam, should I call Jinjin?" Zheng Xue’e cautiously suggested.
Madam Su shook her head: "No need, I want to wait here until they return."
Zheng Xue’e asked in surprise: "They? Could it be..."
Madam Su glanced at her and snorted: "How do you fulfill your duties as a mother? Don’t you know Jinjin is on a date with Lin Fan now?"
Zheng Xue’e broke out in a cold sweat; she really didn’t know this.
Madam Su is waiting for Su Jinjin but won’t let her be notified, which is truly bewildering.
Suddenly.
Laughter could be heard from outside the door.
Tinkling laughter.
It’s Su Jinjin’s voice.
Su Jinjin is back!
Madam Su was the first to stand up and said to Zheng Xue’e: "They are back, quickly open the door!"
Zheng Xue’e acknowledged without hesitation and hurried to open the door.
Su Jinjin and Lin Fan were talking and laughing as they approached the door.
"Mom? Eh? Grandma... why are you all here?"
As soon as the door opened, Su Jinjin saw the large group of family members inside. Everyone was staring at them, making her feel somewhat surprised.
Lin Fan hadn’t expected so many people inside; he originally intended to drop Su Jinjin at the doorstep and leave. Now, seeing so many people, it would be improper to leave like that.
Zheng Xue’e didn’t dare to meet Lin Fan’s gaze and lowered her head, saying, "Jinjin, your grandma has been waiting for you all day."
Su Jinjin entered the house and exclaimed, "Really, you’ve waited all day? Grandma, what’s going on? Do you need me for something? Why didn’t you call me?"
Madam Su glanced at Su Jinjin, then at Lin Fan, and smiled with a complex expression: "It’s nothing, even if it takes two days, I’ll wait. I didn’t want to disturb your dating!"
These words were like a thunderclap on flat ground.
Zheng Xue’e was the first to be struck, breaking into a cold sweat.
It was astonishingly funny, even absurd, that such words came from Madam Su.
Years ago, Madam Su tried desperately to break up Su Jinjin and Lin Fan. It was rumored that Madam Su personally brought 300 thousand yuan in cash to give to Lin Fan as a breakup fee.
thousand yuan, certainly appealing to Lin Fan, who was then just a poor kid!
After Lin Fan coldly rejected the offer.
Madam Su forcibly sent Su Jinjin abroad to study, finally succeeding in breaking them apart.
It showed how much Madam Su despised Lin Fan.
Yet, three years later, today.
Madam Su brings people to their home, waiting for Su Jinjin to return, daring not to disturb her, even waiting a whole day for it!
Just because Su Jinjin is on a date with Lin Fan!
Has Madam Su really become so humble?
Stunned for a moment, Zheng Xue’e smirked inwardly, old witch, you have your day!
It seems that Lin Fan’s big contract is just too crucial to the Su family, crucial enough to make Madam Su compromise.
Zheng Xue’e had been worried earlier that Madam Su might just let it all go and fall out with Lin Fan, putting Su Jinjin’s status at risk. Turns out, she was worrying too much; Madam Su wouldn’t dare at all!
Madam Su is now a nobody in front of Lin Fan!
Having understood this, Zheng Xue’e gradually straightened her back, her gaze changing as if the Madam she once feared suddenly appeared insignificant.
As long as Lin Fan is there, Madam Su won’t dare to touch Su Jinjin, so why should she, as Su Jinjin’s mother, fear this old witch?
Madam Su’s words also sounded a bit ludicrous to Lin Fan.
"Madam, do you not oppose me and Jinjin dating?" Lin Fan said with a faint smile.
Those words were clearly teasing Madam Su; even a fool could tell.
Madam Su looked embarrassed, her old face blushing; the reverence for Lin Fan had her momentarily at a loss for how to respond.
Su Jinjin helped ease her awkwardness: "Grandma, what do you need me for? Could it be because of them? Are you here to plead for them, Grandma?"
The ones accompanying Madam Su were the two Su family members dismissed by Su Jinjin today.
They offended Lin Fan, leading Su Jinjin to decisively fire them.
It appears they went to Madam Su to ask for help.
Madam Su quickly said: "Jinjin, don’t misunderstand. I’m not here to plead. You two bastards, what did I say? Kneel down!"
Thud!
The two Su family members knelt before Lin Fan, tearfully.
"Mr. Lin, we offended you today; it was our blindness, not recognizing Mount Tai. We’re here to apologize, sorry!"
The two Su family members said, bowing their heads in apology to Lin Fan.
It was Madam Su who instructed them.
They had offended Lin Fan, and Madam Su was thunderously angry, immediately deciding to personally bring them to apologize to Lin Fan.
They came here, saying they were waiting for Jinjin to return, but in fact, they were waiting for Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, it’s my lack of strict discipline. I’ve brought them to apologize, and I personally apologize to you as well," said Madam Su.
Although she didn’t kneel like the two family members, her spirit had long since kneeled to Lin Fan.
Zheng Xue’e, standing beside, looked down on Madam Su even more.
"So you came all the way here to beg for forgiveness? Madam, did you have to hide it from me all day long?" Zheng Xue’e sneered.
Her tone was starkly different from her previous fearful image of the Madam.
Earlier, when Su Jinjin became the president of the Su family, Zheng Xue’e didn’t feel that their family had risen. At this moment, she truly felt their family had risen.
Madam Su’s face twitched; Zheng Xue’e dared to speak to her like this!
But she didn’t dare to do anything to Zheng Xue’e.
After all, Zheng Xue’e is Su Jinjin’s mother, and Su Jinjin has Lin Fan to back her up!
Lin Fan, the one Madam Su truly reveres, is Lin Fan indeed.
Lin Fan was somewhat surprised; those two Su family members did indeed offend him, but since they were already fired by Su Jinjin, he didn’t care much anymore.
Unexpectedly, Madam Su brought them here so solemnly to apologize.
This Madam Su is not simple at all.
Lin Fan snickered inwardly.
Saying Madam Su reveres Lin Fan, Lin Fan believes; now, Lin Fan can lift the Su family up while he can destroy them with a flick of his hand. Madam Su reveres him for sure.
But a leopard doesn’t change its spots!
Once the Su family truly rises and no longer relies on Lin Fan someday, she would probably show another side.
You, Madam Su, must think you’re enduring humiliation now, right? I’ll make sure you keep enduring humiliation!
Lin Fan chuckled: "Madam, are you looking to apologize to me?"
Madam Su said: "Yes."
Lin Fan said: "Then you have a lot more to apologize for; your mistakes are much more serious than your two grandsons. They’ve knelt; why don’t you kneel?"
Ah?!
Lin Fan wants Madam Su to kneel in apology?
Everyone was shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: I’m Not Like You, I Won’t Bully Others Too Much
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 296: I’m Not Like You, I Won’t Bully Others Too Much
Lin Fan actually wants Madam Su to kneel and apologize!
Everyone was shocked because Madam Su is an elder, in terms of seniority she is Lin Fan’s superior, and if one day Lin Fan and Su Jinjin get married, Madam Su would be Lin Fan’s grandmother.
To have an elder kneel and apologize to him?
This is truly astonishing.
Madam Su’s face turned from green to white. In her whole life, she had never been so humiliated, and by a junior she never took seriously, Lin Fan, this was a double humiliation!
Two of the Su family members were furious.
"Lin Fan, aren’t you going too far with this?"
"No matter what, Grandma is your elder, how can you ask your elder to kneel for you?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "My elder? When I was dating Jinjin, she was my elder. After she broke up Jinjin and me, was she still considered my elder? Does she have any connection to me?"
The two Su family members looked at each other.
One argued, "But... even if you don’t acknowledge Grandma as an elder, isn’t she older than you? Don’t you understand respecting the elderly and cherishing the young?"
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, people should respect the old and love the young, but if this elder goes to all lengths to make you leave your true love, even forcing her to go abroad, finally succeeding in breaking you up, not because of your bad character or criminal acts, just because she despises you for being poor, does such an elder deserve respect?"
"This..." Two Su family members were speechless for a moment.
Madam Su’s old face turned red, feeling very awkward.
Zheng Xue’e also lowered her head, not daring to look at Lin Fan. Although Lin Fan was talking to Madam Su, he was also speaking about her.
Back then, her effort to separate Lin Fan and Su Jinjin wasn’t any less than Madam Su’s.
Lin Fan’s words evoked those unbearable memories for Su Jinjin, her eyes couldn’t help but redden.
The two Su family members racked their brains and finally came up with a reason to counter Lin Fan.
"Grandma was indeed wrong about this matter, but her intention was to protect Third Sister and not want her to marry into a poor family and suffer. Ultimately, it was for Third Sister’s good!"
The two Su family members thought their argument was impeccable, and Lin Fan would have nothing to say!
Lin Fan laughed, "Really? For Jinjin’s good? Would someone who wants the best for you disregard your wishes, force you to marry into the Li Family, and treat you as a pawn in their alliance? Would someone who wants your good sacrifice your happiness to fulfill their family interests? You call this being good to Jinjin? Then I wish she treats you well like this every day."
The two Su family members were dumbfounded.
They couldn’t refute Lin Fan’s words at all.
"But..."
The two Su family members were still unwilling, desperately thinking of ways to counter Lin Fan.
"Enough!"
Suddenly Madam Su spoke, "You two, shut up!"
The two Su family members quickly fell silent, not daring to say another word. They initially spoke up for Madam Su, but instead got reprimanded by her.
Madam Su looked at Lin Fan and said, "You are right. I was indeed wrong back then, terribly wrong. I understand why you hate me because I indeed hurt you. Fine, I am willing to kneel and apologize to you. The evil I’ve done is the consequence I deserve."
As she spoke, Madam Su, leaning on her crutches, attempted to kneel down. Being old and with inconvenient legs and back, it was truly difficult to kneel.
The two Su family members, seeing this, wanted to go help her.
"Don’t move, let me kneel properly, I can do it myself!" Madam Su stopped them.
Zheng Xue’e watched on the side, a hint of a cold smile in her eyes. This old hag, being so domineering all her life, has finally met her match, truly evil begets evil!
Su Jinjin’s eyes were somewhat complex. On one hand, Madam Su is her grandmother, but on the other, her hatred for Madam Su is no less than Lin Fan’s. Madam Su is the culprit who caused her to leave Lin Fan and forced her to marry into the Li Family.
Madam Su almost ruined her happiness twice. The first time, she was too young to resist, the second time, she mustered the courage to carry out a shocking runaway marriage and fell out with the old lady.
If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she might have already been driven out of the Su Family.
Therefore, Lin Fan asking Madam Su to kneel and apologize, she wouldn’t approve, but she also wouldn’t oppose it.
She just watched coldly as the once assertive domineering old lady was humble and submissive to Lin Fan, as if finally releasing a repressed breath she had for years.
Madam Su, trembling, supported by her crutches, tried hard to kneel, after much effort, finally bent her knees, ready to kneel.
But Lin Fan waved his hand, and a force lifted her up.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You kneeling to me, I can accept it, but I am not like you, I won’t bully excessively, considering your age, I’ll let this kneel pass."
Everyone was stunned.
In the end, Lin Fan still generously stopped Madam Su from kneeling, this measure of spirit is far greater than Madam Su!
However, Lin Fan’s generosity made Madam Su feel doubly humiliated.
Lin Fan was no longer the Lin Fan of the past, the poor guy unable to counter Madam Su, now so strong he didn’t even bother to haggle with her.
The greatest humiliation an opponent can give is not fighting with you over trivialities, but that you are no longer worthy of their time.
Madam Su felt suffocated inside, but on the surface, she dared not show it.
"Thank you," Madam Su said, her hands trembling uncontrollably.
Lin Fan so humiliated her, yet she still had to thank him!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Madam, it’s already late, you should go home and get some rest, older folk need to sleep early and wake early."
This was telling her to get lost.
Madam Su said, "Hmm, I should be going back now, I wonder if my two grandsons could return to the Company?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m not from your Su Corporation, you don’t need to ask me, you should ask Jinjin."
Madam Su then turned to Su Jinjin, humble in her attitude: "Jinjin, you see they’ve realized their mistakes, for grandma’s sake, won’t you give them another chance?"
Su Jinjin said, "Hmm, I will consider it."
Madam Su’s face twitched.
Consider!
Su Jinjin actually didn’t agree immediately, but said she’ll consider!
Madam Su almost fainted from anger.
Managed to control her emotions.
"Fine, I understand." Madam Su said, and with the help of the two Su family members, left Su Jinjin’s home.
Outside.
The two Su family members were worried about their future.
"What did Third Sister mean just now, does she want us back or not?"
"Grandma went herself, yet Third Sister didn’t even give face to Grandma, she’s too high and mighty, what should we do now?"
Madam Su snorted heavily, paused her steps, and suddenly slammed her cane on the ground with a bang, startling the two Su family members.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Rocket Genius: I Am Willing to Devote Myself Entirely in Gratitude to Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 297: Rocket Genius: I Am Willing to Devote Myself Entirely in Gratitude to Mr. Lin
"Good for you, Lin Fan, good for you, Su Jinjin!"
"Let’s see how long you can stay arrogant!"
"Now I endure humiliation, all for the Su Family!"
"One day, when my Su Family rises, I swear to avenge today’s shame!"
Madam Su’s face was full of anger.
In Su Jinjin’s home.
Finally seeing off Madam Su, Su Jinjin secretly breathed a sigh of relief. When she looked up, she saw Lin Fan’s gaze had fallen on her mother, Zheng Xue’e.
Su Jinjin couldn’t help but smile bitterly inside.
She knew that Lin Fan’s dislike for her mother was no less than for Madam Su.
Zheng Xue’e felt Lin Fan’s gaze, incredibly ashamed, but she was thick-skinned, soon reacting and lifting her head to show an awkward smile.
"Little Fan, Auntie wronged you back then, I’m apologizing to you now, hoping to get your forgiveness." Zheng Xue’e proactively said.
This Zheng Xue’e is Su Jinjin’s mom, and for the sake of Su Jinjin, Lin Fan wouldn’t hold it against her too much.
Lin Fan said indifferently, "You’re apologizing not because you realize your mistake, but because I have money now. If I became poor again, you’d still treat me the same as before."
Lin Fan’s blunt truth made Zheng Xue’e embarrassed, her face red with shame.
Lin Fan continued, "However, I will accept your apology because I will make sure you never have the chance to treat me like that again."
He would never become poor again, thus Zheng Xue’e would no longer have the chance to look down on him. She would always bow her head to him like now!
Although Lin Fan’s words weren’t pleasant, they secretly made Zheng Xue’e happy.
She didn’t wish for Lin Fan to return to how he was; if Lin Fan remained wealthy, she couldn’t wish for more.
As long as Lin Fan was there as their strong backing, their position in the Su Family would be unshakable, not even needing to pay attention to Madam Su!
Another reason was, indeed, her thick skin.
"Little Fan, it’s good that you’re willing to forgive Auntie. By the way, have you had dinner yet? Auntie made dumplings this morning; how about I cook some for you?" Zheng Xue’e laughed awkwardly.
With her mother being so thick-skinned, Su Jinjin felt a bit embarrassed.
The way she used to treat Lin Fan, did she really think everyone had forgotten?
But seeing Zheng Xue’e like this, as long as she wasn’t embarrassed, others would be.
Lin Fan chuckled, "No need, Jinjin and I already had dinner. It’s getting late; I should get going."
Zheng Xue’e said, "You’re leaving? So late, why not stay over for the night?"
"Mom!" Su Jinjin blushed with embarrassment.
Their house wasn’t big, just two rooms: one for Zheng Xue’e and her husband, and one for Su Jinjin.
Lin Fan staying over for the night had obvious implications, needing no further clarification.
Su Jinjin stole a glance at Lin Fan, feeling both shy and inexplicably a bit expectant.
But Lin Fan naturally said, "No, I have things to do. You should rest early."
Ultimately, Lin Fan bid farewell and left.
Seeing this, Su Jinjin felt inexplicably disappointed. Lin Fan not staying for the night must mean he hasn’t completely moved on from the past, so he excused himself with work.
"Fan, it’s okay. After all these years, it’s fine. I can wait. I will definitely wait until the day you completely let go inside."
Su Jinjin cheered herself on inside.
In fact, Lin Fan really hadn’t thought that much.
He indeed had something to do.
As for his feelings toward Su Jinjin, Lin Fan was very calm now. In his eyes, Su Jinjin was like family, and maybe one day, he would reignite his love for her, or maybe it would always be like this, leaving it to fate.
But no matter what, he would treat Su Jinjin as family.
Riding an electric bike, Lin Fan left Su Jinjin’s residential area.
A corner cafe.
Riding the bike, Lin Fan arrived to see a middle-aged man standing at the cafe door, waiting.
He Chen!
The once rocket prodigy!
Because of one failure, He Chen was betrayed and, after getting involved in a lawsuit, was wrongfully imprisoned for a year. After his release, he was totally broken, only able to work on a factory production line, only to discover he couldn’t even do that well.
Today at Pengyu Toy Factory, the former rocket prodigy was bullied by a drop-out just because he was slow and facing elimination.
Fallen this low, how could He Chen be willing!
In the factory canteen, Lin Fan’s words struck like thunder in He Chen’s heart, churning inside him.
Lin Fan, a young mega wealthy man, capable of casually buying a $3 billion mansion, a $6 billion island, a $10 billion skyscraper, and a $50 billion aviation company.
He didn’t know the extent of Lin Fan’s wealth, but he was undoubtedly a super wealthy individual!
This super wealthy individual told He Chen he wanted to establish a space division at Celestial Aviation to enter the space field and develop rockets!
This super wealthy individual also told He Chen that he had hired the country’s top legal team to overturn He Chen’s case and clear his name!
Most importantly, this super wealthy individual wanted He Chen to make a comeback, giving him a chance to reconnect with his life’s passion, the rockets he loved!
Although He Chen didn’t immediately agree to Lin Fan, his heart was already tumultuous.
He didn’t immediately agree mainly because the last failure hit him too hard, almost completely breaking him. He couldn’t bear another such blow.
However, after a day of internal struggle, his inner desire finally won.
So he called Lin Fan.
Afterward, Lin Fan arranged to meet him at this cafe via a message.
Lin Fan said he had something and left the Su Family to meet with He Chen.
"Mr. Lin." Seeing Lin Fan, He Chen greeted him excitedly.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sorry, something came up and caused a delay. Have you been waiting long, Mr. He?"
He Chen said, "It’s fine, no matter how long, I would wait for Mr. Lin to arrive."
Lin Fan laughed, "Looks like you’re really ready to come and help me."
With a thud!
He Chen knelt on the ground and said, "Thank you, Mr. Lin, for giving me the opportunity. I won’t let you down. From now on, I’m willing to give my all to repay Mr. Lin!"
He Chen was truly determined to follow Lin Fan, as it was his only chance to turn things around.
Lin Fan felt joyful, recruiting He Chen was part of the system’s task. The system saw potential in He Chen, which meant he must be valuable.
Lin Fan said, "Alright then, I look forward to your future performance. How about this, come to Celestial Aviation tomorrow, and I’ll announce it then."
The next day.
In the morning.
The board of Celestial Aviation suddenly received a notice from Lin Fan that he wanted to hold a board meeting!
During this meeting, Lin Fan introduced He Chen to everyone and announced on the spot the formation of a space division to advance into the space field.
As soon as the news came out, the board meeting immediately erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: New Reward, Top-Level Aircraft Gift Package?
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 298: New Reward, Top-Level Aircraft Gift Package?
Celestial Aviation Company.
At nine in the morning, just as work was starting, He Chen rode a bicycle to the entrance of Celestial Aviation Company headquarters.
He Chen wore a slightly shabby shirt, appearing somewhat destitute. Once a rocket genius, he had now fallen into poverty; this was his most presentable outfit.
"What’s your business here?"
The company security guard stopped He Chen, suspicious of this scruffy middle-aged man still riding a battered bicycle, surely not a company employee, quickly dismiss him.
He Chen smiled awkwardly and said, "Hello, my name is He Chen, Mr. Lin asked me to come here."
The security guard frowned and said, "Mr. Lin? Which Mr. Lin?"
He Chen said, "Lin Fan, Mr. Lin."
The security guard’s expression changed.
Lin Fan!
That was the boss of Celestial Aviation!
This scruffy middle-aged man was truly summoned by Mr. Lin?
The security guard immediately became cautious. If it was true, he couldn’t afford to offend him.
Just then, a beautiful woman in professional attire walked out, Lin Fan’s personal secretary, Zhao Jiayi!
"You must be Mr. He, right? Hello, I’m Lin’s secretary, Zhao Jiayi." Zhao Jiayi walked up to He Chen, greeting him warmly.
He Chen quickly said, "Hello, Secretary Zhao, I am He Chen."
Zhao Jiayi smiled and said, "The Chairman specifically asked me to welcome you. Please follow me, Mr. He."
He Chen pushed his bicycle and followed Zhao Jiayi into the company.
Behind him, the security guard was sweating with fear, relieved that he hadn’t offended this scruffy middle-aged man, who turned out to be invited by the Chairman, and judging by Secretary Zhao’s attitude, seemed quite respectful toward him!
That’s the Chairman, someone the entire company looks up to!
Fortunately, he did not offend He Chen, otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable!
The security guard wiped his cold sweat in relief, also becoming very curious about who exactly this scruffy middle-aged man, who received an invitation from the Chairman, was.
He Chen followed Zhao Jiayi, into the company’s main entrance.
Zhao Jiayi asked him to park his bicycle next to the security room, then led him to the headquarters building.
"Secretary Zhao, where is Mr. Lin now?" He Chen asked, surrounded by unfamiliar people and an unfamiliar environment, feeling a bit restrained and tense.
He only knew Lin Fan, and meeting Lin Fan would relieve his tension.
Zhao Jiayi said, "Mr. Lin is in a board meeting, I will take you in afterward."
Headquarters building meeting room.
The board meeting was in progress.
This morning, Lin Fan intended to notify Zhao Jiayi to convene a company-wide board meeting, but before Lin Fan could speak, Zhao Jiayi told him there was a board meeting today, and as Chairman, Lin Fan needed to attend.
It turns out today was the day Celestial Aviation’s quarterly performance report was to be published.
For a listed company, performance reports are very important as they directly affect the company’s stock price.
If there’s a decline in performance, the company’s stock price often plummets.
As Chairman, Lin Fan had already been informed about the performance situation; in the past quarter, Celestial Aviation’s performance was relatively good, better than the previous year.
Many directors felt that this performance report would benefit the company’s stock price.
"Thanks to the Chairman, our stock price has been rising consecutively, now nearing 90 billion. Once this report is released, it will definitely rise further!"
"We are one step closer to becoming a hundred-billion group!"
"Though reaching a hundred billion might be difficult, getting close to 95 billion is already quite remarkable!"
However, some held different views.
The second-largest shareholder, Li Hongting, said, "I’m not very optimistic about this report, even though our performance has consistently grown, we must pay attention to the slowing growth rate. This indicates our business is approaching saturation, and we need to find new profit growth points."
Hearing this, the directors fell silent.
Li Hongting indeed pointed out a crucial issue; the slowing profit growth is an unavoidable problem.
Li Hongting looked at Lin Fan, "Chairman, what do you think about this issue?"
Everyone turned to look at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan had recently taken over Celestial Aviation, and instantly raised its market value from 50 billion to 90 billion.
This made everyone in the company worship Lin Fan; they believed Lin Fan was practically a divine existence.
Lin Fan said, "Elder Li raised a good point. The slowing profit growth is indeed a wake-up call for us. If we cannot address this problem in the next phase, it could become troublesome. And the solution to this problem boils down to two approaches: one is expanding the business, the other is developing new businesses."
Li Hongting nodded, "The Chairman is right. Currently, developing new businesses is quite difficult for us, and expanding the business requires large capital investment, which needs careful consideration. I believe..."
Li Hongting continued speaking.
"Ding!"
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s mind echoed with a system prompt.
"System reminder: Today’s sign-in can commence. Would the host like to sign in immediately?"
The system came with rewards at such a time while he was holding a meeting.
However, he couldn’t let the system wait, so he responded internally, "Sign in!"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations, host. Sign-in successful. Awarded with a super airplane package: 10 premium Boeing 747 aircraft bundled reward. Please check your goods."
What?
Lin Fan was stunned; this reward was impressive!
To know, Boeing is the world’s top civil aviation aircraft, and a Boeing 747’s construction costs up to 2 billion Huaxia Coin.
The system awarded 10 Boeing 747 aircraft at once!
Total worth: 20 billion!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but marvel at how generous the system was!
Meanwhile, the directors were discussing the issue raised by Li Hongting on how the company could expand its business.
Li Hongting noticed the Chairman, Lin Fan, seemed to be zoning out?
"Ahem!"
Li Hongting cleared his throat and said, "Chairman? We’ve discussed quite a lot, I’d like to hear the Chairman’s opinion?"
Lin Fan had just received his new reward and, hearing this, smiled slightly and said, "Yes, expanding business requires significant investment, but this is an urgent matter, necessary spending should be executed. Hence, I have decided to fulfill my earlier promise to purchase 10 additional aircraft for the company."
This statement left everyone gasping!
Whoa!
Purchasing 10 additional aircraft!
This gesture was indeed colossal!
Aircraft are not cabbages, but Lin Fan’s tone was as if buying ten cabbages effortlessly.
Li Hongting couldn’t help but say, "Chairman, do you understand the price of airplanes?"
Though Lin Fan’s presence greatly boosted Celestial Aviation’s value, Li Hongting was convinced of Lin Fan’s capability but was skeptical about Lin Fan on specific business matters related to aviation.
Lin Fan was too young and lacked aviation company employment background, he might be unfamiliar with aviation business issues!
So he casually mentioned purchasing ten aircraft.
Such enormous investment, thinking it’s as simple as buying cabbages!
If Lin Fan truly knew the price of the planes, he wouldn’t have spoken so lightly!
The company people all knew Lin Fan was a novice; Li Hongting’s question made everyone curious, wondering how the Chairman would respond?
Lin Fan, very calm, said, "I am certainly aware airplanes are pricey, but given the need to expand the business, it is a must-do investment, and if we buy, we only buy the best planes, therefore, our additional planes will be Boeing 747s!"
At this statement, the entire room was shocked; the meeting room instantly fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 Spectacular! 10 Boeing 747s Land Simultaneously
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 299 Spectacular! 10 Boeing 747s Land Simultaneously
Oh my God!
Chairman Lin Fan not only wants to buy airplanes, he wants to buy Boeing 747s!
Not only does he want to buy Boeing 747s, he wants to buy 10 of them at once!
The Boeing 747, the largest commercial aircraft on Earth, has monopolized the civilian large transport aircraft market for decades. Moreover, it’s the most expensive civilian airliner on Earth, with each costing as much as 2 billion Huaxia Coin!
Ten Boeing 747s, totaling 20 billion Huaxia Coin!
This is the largest investment in the history of civil aviation.
And such a huge investment was casually announced by Lin Fan just now.
It left everyone present utterly flabbergasted.
Li Hongting almost fell out of his seat.
Too extravagant!
Lin Fan’s decision is simply too extravagant.
Even if the market value of Celestial Aviation has recently surged to 90 billion, spending 20 billion in cash to buy airplanes is extremely exaggerated.
After recovering from his shock, Li Hongting’s first reaction was disbelief.
Either Lin Fan really doesn’t know how expensive airplanes are or he’s joking with everyone.
Judging by Lin Fan’s demeanor, he seems to know the price of airplanes, so it can only be said that Lin Fan is joking with everyone.
After all, he’s too young, and this isn’t an appropriate occasion for jokes, especially for this kind of joke.
Li Hongting said, "Chairman, you can’t joke around like that. The price of ten Boeing 747s is as high as 20 billion. Our company simply can’t afford it. However, the chairman’s direction is correct. The so-called cost-saving and revenue-increasing; if we can indeed purchase more airplanes, it can indeed resolve the issue of slowing profit growth."
Upon Li Hongting’s words, the directors came back to their senses, realizing that the chairman was joking with them!
"You scared me, I almost thought we were really buying ten Boeings!"
"So it was a joke!"
"The chairman is really humorous!"
"Haha..."
Everyone started laughing.
All present were seasoned professionals in the workplace and, realizing the chairman was joking, naturally played along and chuckled.
Lin Fan was slightly sweaty; he’d been telling the truth, yet no one believed him.
"I’m not joking. I do plan to purchase 10 Boeing 747s, yes, indeed it requires a 20 billion investment, which is a bit much, but it’s okay, the money is my personal investment. In fact, I’ve already bought the airplanes." Lin Fan said calmly.
"Haha..."
The conference room burst into loud laughter, with everyone laughing heartily.
They thought Lin Fan was continuing his joke, so the whole team was very entertained and laughed along cooperatively.
The punchline of this joke was in the last sentence.
"I’ve already bought the airplanes, hahaha..."
"It’s just too funny!"
"The chairman is indeed so humorous!"
"I’m laughing so hard I’m gonna crap myself!"
"I’m laughing so much my stomach hurts! I can’t take it; I’m gonna laugh until I faint!"
Li Hongting laughed until tears ran down his face, saying, "Chairman, please stop joking, everyone’s gone crazy with laughter. The chairman said he’s bought the airplanes, where would they be? They couldn’t possibly be stored at home, right? Oh, the chairman must be talking about ten airplane models."
"Hahaha..."
The room erupted in laughter.
Lin Fan felt a bit helpless; he’d been speaking the truth. The system rewarded him with ten Boeing 747s, there’s no falsity. He couldn’t reveal they were system rewards, so he phrased it as if he’d bought them.
But, no one believed him; perhaps they thought he couldn’t possibly have the capability to buy ten Boeing 747s.
At this moment, someone knocked on the door, and the secretary Zhao Jiayi walked in.
"Chairman, there are three foreigners outside requesting to see you. The leader claims to be Mr. Roosevelt, the president of Boeing Company, and wishes to meet with you personally regarding the airplane purchase," Zhao Jiayi said.
Zhao Jiayi wore an utterly dumbfounded expression.
Suddenly, foreigners claiming to be the president of Boeing Company requested to see him without prior appointment—completely unexpected.
Lin Fan gave an "oh" and said, "Please let them in."
Zhao Jiayi said, "Alright."
Then she turned and left.
The laughter quieted down for a moment, and everyone looked at each other—what was going on?
The president of Boeing Company requested a meeting?
Soon, Zhao Jiayi led in three foreigners in suits, led by a tall middle-aged man.
Zhao Jiayi introduced, "Chairman, this is Mr. Roosevelt, the president of Boeing Company. Mr. Roosevelt, this is our chairman, Mr. Lin Fan."
Roosevelt was somewhat surprised to see Lin Fan because Lin Fan was much younger than he’d imagined.
"Mr. Lin Fan, hello, I’m Roosevelt, president of Boeing Company," Roosevelt said while proactively extending his hand.
Lin Fan also extended his hand and shook hands with Roosevelt, "Nice to meet you."
Roosevelt said, "Mr. Lin, I noticed you were in a meeting, so I’ll get straight to the point. Mr. Lin has purchased 10 Boeing 747s from our Boeing Company, which have now arrived over the airport. I specifically came to confirm receipt with Mr. Lin."
Roosevelt signaled to his two assistants, who got busy—one operating a laptop, and the other handing Roosevelt a document.
Roosevelt took the document and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan saw it was a purchase contract, and with just his signature, the ten Boeing 747s would belong to him.
Without hesitation, Lin Fan signed his name.
He officially owned 10 Boeing 747s.
Roosevelt then pulled out his phone and made a call, "Mr. Lin has confirmed; you may proceed with landing."
At the airport.
A spectacular scene unfolded.
Ten brand new Boeing 747 planes descended from the sky, landing one after another at the airport. This scene attracted countless onlookers.
Everyone was astonished.
This was simply spectacular; such a magnificent scene hadn’t been seen in years, 10 Boeing 747s appearing at the same time!
Incredible!
People started discussing fervently—what on earth was going on?
"Oh my God, amazing!"
"10 Boeings landing simultaneously; what a magical event!"
"Don’t tell me someone bought ten Boeing 747s!"
"What a joke, who could possibly buy 10 Boeing 747s at once!"
"Blatant bragging!"
No one believed that someone would actually purchase 10 Boeing 747s!
In the Celestial Aviation Headquarters conference room.
One of Roosevelt’s assistants connected to the airport live scene, and through aerial footage, the directors saw the magnificent scene.
There truly were ten Boeing 747s landing!
Roosevelt once again shook hands with Lin Fan, smiling, "Mr. Lin, congratulations, the ten Boeing 747s were delivered successfully. This is the largest deal our Boeing Company has had in recent years. Our headquarters attached great importance to it, so they sent me personally to complete the handover with Mr. Lin. Mr. Lin, your gesture has shocked everyone at our headquarters."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Congratulations to you too, Mr. Roosevelt, and Boeing Company. This purchase of ten Boeing 747s is just a small plan of mine. I believe Boeing planes won’t disappoint me. If there’s a need later, we’ll meet again."
Roosevelt almost kneeled before Lin Fan!
Damn!
Ten Boeing planes were only a small plan?
Even the dignified president of Boeing Company was almost shocked to the point of trembling by Lin Fan.
And at this moment, the entire conference room was deathly silent, with all the directors already petrified.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: What Business is More Powerful Than Military Industry?
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 300: What Business is More Powerful Than Military Industry?
The president of Boeing Company, Roosevelt, personally came to Lin Fan for the delivery, and the directors of Celestial Aviation witnessed the landing of ten Boeing 747s.
The directors were all stunned, each one of them was speechless.
When Lin Fan first said he had purchased ten Boeing planes, the directors thought he was joking. Now with the reality right in front of them, it’s actually true!
This shock directly petrified them.
For a moment, the entire conference room was silent.
They eagerly watched as Lin Fan and Roosevelt completed the handover, after which Roosevelt bid farewell and left.
"Mr. Lin, I’ll take my leave now. I look forward to seeing you again," Roosevelt said.
Lin Fan said that buying ten Boeing 747s was just a small plan, which greatly surprised Roosevelt, making him look forward even more.
Lin Fan said, "I hope to see Mr. Roosevelt again soon. Jiayi, please see Mr. Roosevelt out."
Zhao Jiayi then escorted Roosevelt and the others out.
The president of Boeing Company, Roosevelt, is also a well-known figure internationally; everyone present is in the aviation industry and nobody didn’t recognize him.
Having Roosevelt personally come for the handover shows how much Boeing Company values this business deal.
After Roosevelt left, the conference room remained silent, and everyone was still in shock.
Lin Fan said, "Everybody, it seems I wasn’t joking after all."
Upon hearing this, everyone felt a bit embarrassed; they hadn’t believed the chairman before.
"Chairman, please forgive our ignorance," Li Hongting was the first to speak, completely submitting to Lin Fan.
"The chairman’s immortal work, and we ordinary folks didn’t believe it, alas!"
"The chairman’s level is too high!"
"We were too naive to think the chairman was joking."
Everyone chimed in, all wanting to kneel for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "In company management, there’s no joking around. When I came to the company, I already intended to expand the business, and now it’s just being realized."
Upon hearing this, everyone admired him greatly, thinking the chairman was simply like an immortal.
Who said the chairman was unfamiliar with the aviation industry? The chairman clearly had it all figured out, already knowing the company’s issues and even acting ahead of them.
The chairman is indeed worthy of being the chairman!
Li Hongting couldn’t help but sigh in his heart, "With Mr. Lin, Celestial Aviation’s future is limitless. We can just follow Mr. Lin and benefit from him in the future!"
Lin Fan said, "Now that the ten planes are in place, we can discuss their utilization later. At the moment, there’s something else I’d like to share with everyone."
Everyone was a little curious, wondering what else Lin Fan had to say.
Lin Fan said, "Purchasing ten planes is just expanding our existing aviation business; I have another, more important plan, which is to open a new business line."
"What?"
Everyone looked at each other in surprise!
No way, is the chairman going to start a new venture?
In the aviation industry, apart from passenger transport, there’s cargo transport, both of which Celestial Aviation has been involved in. What new venture could there be?
Li Hongting thought of something and excitedly said, "Chairman, does the new business you’re talking about have to do with the military? Are we going to enter the military industry?"
Li Hongting and Liu Tianhao are friends, and Liu Tianhao is the son of the former commander Liu Tingshan!
Li Hongting attended Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet that night and personally witnessed Lin Fan as the highest guest eating at the same table as Liu Tingshan.
Lin Fan was the youngest highest-level guest that night, which shows how much Liu Tingshan values Lin Fan.
If Liu Tingshan were to help Lin Fan make connections for Celestial Aviation to enter military production, it wouldn’t be impossible.
And if this business successfully launched, Celestial Aviation would really be solid.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Elder Li’s mention of military industry is indeed a good idea, and we might consider it in the future. However, my plan isn’t military, but it might be even more powerful than the military."
More powerful than the military?
Everyone once again looked at each other, not knowing what could be more powerful than the military.
Li Hongting was already a bit eager, "Chairman, please stop keeping us in suspense, I’m about to die of anxiety."
Everyone laughed heartily.
Lin Fan said, "Okay, before discussing this further, let me introduce someone to you all."
Saying that, Lin Fan picked up the phone and called Zhao Jiayi, "Bring him over."
Soon, Zhao Jiayi led He Chen in.
He Chen was wearing an ill-fitting shirt, and seeing the elegantly dressed executives, He Chen immediately became a bit nervous. Gone was the old rocket genius’ spirit, leaving only a timid middle-aged uncle.
Seeing He Chen, everyone was curious; who is this person?
Just this one person, the chairman specifically wanted to introduce to them?
Li Hongting’s sharp eyes studied He Chen, feeling like he had seen him somewhere before, but couldn’t remember for a moment.
Lin Fan said, "Let me introduce, this is Mr. He Chen."
"He Chen?"
Li Hongting exclaimed, "You are really He Chen?"
Lin Fan said, "Elder Li, you know Mr. He?"
Li Hongting said, "I haven’t seen him in person, but He Chen is a big figure, and anyone in aviation should know him. However, the He Chen I remember was a talented young man just over forty, this gentleman..."
The He Chen before them, at least in his fifties, had a weathered appearance.
The directors all started discussing.
"He Chen? Could it be the rocket genius?"
"Didn’t he go to jail because his company went bankrupt and he got into trouble?"
"I think I heard he was recently released."
"No way, this is He Chen, can’t tell!"
Upon hearing their murmurs, He Chen became even more nervous and somewhat wanted to leave; the blow from his previous failure had already eroded his confidence.
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, standing before everyone is indeed the rocket genius who once founded Huaxia’s first private rocket company, Mr. He Chen."
Everyone was deeply surprised; it really was the He Chen they knew. Oh my, how did He Chen become like this? What does the chairman intend to do by bringing He Chen back?
Li Hongting, who is relatively well-informed, said, "I know a little about Mr. He’s situation. After his release, Mr. He tried to seek help from old friends and sought employment with our competitor Xianghe Airlines, but was mercilessly rejected and humiliated before being expelled. Since then, he hasn’t been heard from until now..."
Li Hongting’s information was accurate.
He Chen’s old classmates, including the founder of Xianghe Airlines, were once close buddies.
After He Chen’s downfall, the ties with friends were severed, only this close buddy hadn’t publicly broken off.
So after He Chen’s release, he held onto the fantasy of approaching this good buddy, hoping to secure a job at Xianghe Airlines.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Witnessed Nationwide, the Birth of a 100-Billion Group!
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 301: Witnessed Nationwide, the Birth of a 100-Billion Group!
Who knew, this former friend actually publicly humiliated Mr. He and kicked him out of the Company.
When Li Hongting mentioned this, He Chen couldn’t help but feel a mix of sadness and anger; being insulted by a former friend was something he had never anticipated.
It was Lin Fan’s first time hearing of this, realizing He Chen had such an experience. No wonder He Chen lacked confidence, what could be worse than betrayal and desertion by friends and family?
So, as a person, you still need to be strong. Only when you’re strong, will others look up to you.
Li Hongting curiously asked: "Chairman, did you bring Mr. He back related to the new business venture you mentioned?"
"Oh my!"
"Chairman, is the new business venture you mentioned related to rockets?"
Li Hongting speculated in surprise.
Upon hearing this, everyone was astonished.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Indeed, Elder Li is sharp; his guess is correct. I plan to establish a Space Business Division to develop rockets and engage in space exploration in the future. Mr. He is here to help us, and I’ll entrust the Space Business Division to him."
These words caused an uproar among the board members, each astonished beyond measure.
Establishing a Space Business Division!
No wonder Lin Fan said this new business venture would surpass even military-industrial projects. Indeed, exploring the universe, this vision is extraordinarily grand.
However, such a grand undertaking inevitably comes with high risks and high investments; it’s rather adventurous.
After their shock, the board members began to worry.
"Chairman, are you really planning to establish a Space Business Division? Rocket development requires immense investment, and the failure rate is high, almost akin to self-destruction!"
"Our Celestial Aviation might not be able to bear it!"
"He Chen’s own Company went bankrupt; he ended up like this, we must avoid repeating the same mistakes!"
"Chairman, think twice!"
Everyone discussed incessantly.
"Elder Li, please advise the Chairman!" A board member turned to Li Hongting, who lowered his head, seemingly lost in thought.
After a moment’s silence, Li Hongting said, "Everyone, please calm down. Establishing a Space Business Division is indeed a risky move, but I support the Chairman."
What?
Li Hongting actually agrees with Lin Fan?
Li Hongting is the second largest shareholder, renowned for his conservative stance. Rationally, he should be the first to oppose Lin Fan’s aggressive approach.
Yet, Li Hongting agrees with Lin Fan!
Li Hongting explained: "Despite his young age, ever since the Chairman joined the Company, he has repeatedly accomplished miracles. First, Celestial Aviation’s market value soared, then he purchased ten Boeing planes. Isn’t this enough to prove the Chairman is right? Since the Chairman decided to establish the Space Business Division, he must have his considerations, and we only need to follow his lead."
It turns out, Li Hongting has long been an admiring fan of Lin Fan, especially after witnessing Lin Fan purchasing ten Boeing planes today, he practically became an ardent admirer.
In his mind, Lin Fan has already attained godlike status, so he agrees with whatever decision Lin Fan makes.
Li Hongting continued: "Speaking of private rockets, there are successful examples in the world, the United States’ Maslow, their rockets have been successfully launched. I believe under the Chairman’s leadership, our Space Business Division will catch up and even surpass Maslow!"
Li Hongting, being the second largest shareholder and having a long history with the Company, was originally a co-founder of Celestial Aviation alongside its founder, and he held great prestige within the Company.
After Li Hongting spoke, the board members who initially opposed quieted down.
In fact, under Lin Fan’s control of Celestial Aviation, even if the board members opposed, Lin Fan held the decision-making power.
Establishing the Space Business Division is a system task, and Lin Fan would not back down merely because of opposition.
Now with Li Hongting, a loyal supporter, speaking up, it’s naturally for the best.
Lin Fan gave a slight smile and said, "Thank you for your support, Elder Li. Elder Li mentioned Maslow earlier, and indeed my decision to establish the Space Business Division is somewhat related to him. Two days ago, I had dinner with Robinson, the president of Tesla China District, and this fellow praised his boss Maslow while mocking us as falling behind. Tell me, can we stand that, can we willingly be looked down upon, can we not strive and work hard?"
Lin Fan’s words were resolute and forceful.
His speech ignited the passion within everyone.
"Foreigners look down upon us? Damn them!"
"I support the Chairman!"
"Following the Chairman means benefits are guaranteed; Elder Li even expressed confidence in the Chairman, and we’ve no reason to object, let’s just follow his lead!"
Everyone chimed in.
Seeing this, Lin Fan was secretly pleased and said, "I understand everyone’s concerns well, but I can assure you that the Space Business Division won’t pose a threat to our existing business. Moreover, in the initial phase, we won’t disclose this plan publicly. It will remain a confidential plan for now, and only be made public at an appropriate time."
Li Hongting chuckled and said, "The Chairman is wise! Therefore, even if the plan fails, it won’t negatively impact Celestial Aviation. And if we succeed, it will be nothing short of groundbreaking, shocking the world!"
Everyone nodded in agreement, thinking this was the most reasonable course.
Lin Fan looked at He Chen and said, "Mr. He, the Space Business Division will be led by you. I officially appoint you as the Chief Engineer of the Space Business Division. If there’s anything you want to say, feel free to communicate with everyone, as we’re colleagues now, don’t be formal."
Lin Fan encouraged He Chen to speak.
He Chen mustered the courage to speak; he was initially a bit nervous, but as rockets were his familiar domain, once he started speaking, he became eloquent and fluent. Gradually, the vanished confidence began to reappear on his face...
On that day.
Celestial Aviation’s quarterly performance report was released, profits showed growth, pleasing the market, and the stock price rose in response.
Meanwhile, the news about ten Boeing 747s landing simultaneously flooded the internet, with videos of the ten Boeing 747s descending from the sky becoming a hot topic online.
Netizens speculated passionately, wondering what this was all about?
No one believed these planes were purchased because the magnitude of the purchase was too astonishing.
Who could possibly have made such a large purchase of ten Boeing 747s?
Just as people were fervently discussing, Celestial Aviation issued a press release, openly claiming these ten Boeing 747s, stating that purchasing them was a strategic move for business expansion.
The news shocked the nation.
"Oh my!"
"Incredible!"
"Embarrassing, I said these planes weren’t purchased. Turns out, Celestial Aviation bought them!"
"Is it the same Celestial Aviation whose market value skyrocketed?"
"Amazing, this move is absolutely astonishing, but it’s 20 billion!"
"Celestial Aviation seems ready to soar into the sky!"
Exclamations surged like tidal waves, overwhelming the internet.
Subsequently, Celestial Aviation’s stock price skyrocketed in response, continually surging, breaking through one trillion!
On this day, the entire nation witnessed the birth of a trillion-dollar conglomerate in Yun City.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 Mr. Lin is Indeed a Dragon and Phoenix Among Men
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 302 Mr. Lin is Indeed a Dragon and Phoenix Among Men
Yun City, another billion-dollar group has been born!
In just a few days, the market value of Celestial Aviation soared from 50 billion to 100 billion, creating a miracle. Meanwhile, Celestial Aviation has become the only billion-dollar privately-owned airline company in Huaxia.
Celestial Aviation’s one-time purchase of 10 Boeing 747 planes shocked the world, such a big move, too rich.
Suddenly, Celestial Aviation and its new owner, Lin Fan, drew attention from all sides.
"Ever since Lin Fan became the majority shareholder, Celestial Aviation’s growth momentum has never stopped, truly incredible!"
"This Lin Fan is only 21 years old, truly a young prodigy!"
"Lin Fan must be a business genius!"
"What genius, he’s just filthy rich, makes people die of envy, just how much money does he have?!"
"He might be the youngest super-rich in history!"
"This guy’s future is immeasurable, getting close now might still be in time, later he’d leave us in the dust!"
People marveled at Lin Fan’s capabilities, and many wanted to associate with him. Failing to do so now could mean losing the chance to even carry his shoes in the future.
Liu Family Mansion.
In the courtyard, Liu Tingshan was sitting on a rattan chair sipping tea.
Liu Tianhao was accompanying him.
"Is there any news in Yun City today?" Liu Tingshan asked casually.
Liu Tianhao replied: "The biggest news in Yun City today should be Mortal Group. Due to Celestial Aviation’s soaring stock price, Mortal Group has now entered the ranks of billion-dollar groups, becoming the fourth billion-dollar group in Yun City."
Liu Tingshan was taken aback and then burst into laughter: "What did I say? Mr. Lin is indeed a dragon and phoenix among men, his future achievements are immeasurable, and there will be more surprises in the future. Tianhao, send a congratulatory message to Mr. Lin on my behalf."
"Yes."
Liu Tianhao responded, secretly surprised. His father rarely valued someone this much, but now he highly regards Lin Fan. Clearly, it’s wiser not to provoke him in the future.
Mortal Group became the fourth billion-dollar group in Yun City, after Zhongtong, Yida, and Shengshi Group, closely trailing behind these three, and most closely behind Shengshi Group.
Surpassing Shengshi Group is just a matter of time.
Zhongtong and Yida are aware of this news too.
Zhongtong and Yida’s attitudes were rather normal, like most people, they wanted to foster good relations with Lin Fan.
But Shengshi Group was quite the opposite.
Feng Wanshan was furious, jumping in his office.
Last night, Lin Fan just took a block away from him, and today, Lin Fan’s group broke through to billions, nearing Shengshi Group!
It’s simply a double blow, especially the latter, which is a critical hit.
Once Mortal Group’s market value surpasses Shengshi Group, where would Feng Wanshan’s face go?
It’s a pity that Feng Wanshan once tried to thwart Mortal Group but failed. Now he can no longer stop Mortal Group, only watch helplessly as Mortal’s market value skyrockets.
Feng Wanshan was resentful, very unwilling.
"Damn you, Lin Fan... this guy must be removed to relieve my hatred!" Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth and said.
Feng Wanshan quickly gathered his key personnel again to discuss another attack on Mortal Group.
At this time, Lin Fan was at Celestial Aviation.
Celestial Aviation entered the billion-dollar group, and the entire company was boiling, everyone was celebrating.
As the boss, Lin Fan immediately announced a collective salary raise for the employees, driving everyone in the company crazy.
"The boss is great!"
"Following the boss means good food!"
"Bowing to the boss, boss, I love you!"
The employees all revered Lin Fan.
The executives of the company admired Lin Fan even more, especially as they knew about Lin Fan’s plan to establish a space division, they were full of expectations for the future.
Lin Fan was also very happy, after all, this was the system’s main task, a billion-dollar group was a small goal, and this small goal was achieved.
"Ding!"
"System reminder, congratulations to the host, the main task is 10% complete, please keep it up!"
The system also sent congratulatory messages.
Lin Fan checked the system interface.
"Main task: Build a trillion-dollar business empire.
Task Level: Important.
Task progress: 10/100"
Breaking through billions was certainly worth celebrating, but a trillion was still far away.
Relying solely on the current business of Celestial Aviation to become a trillion-dollar group is basically impossible, Lin Fan has high hopes for rocket R&D.
Lin Fan called He Chen into the office alone.
At this time, He Chen’s position was already the chief engineer of the space division.
"Old He, your speech at the meeting was wonderful, worthy of being the genius who founded Huaxia’s first private rocket company. From now on, I leave the space division to you to manage. Initial funding of 10 billion will be allocated to the space division," Lin Fan said.
billion!
He Chen was a bit excited, only hours ago, he was just a poor man, and in the blink of an eye, he could manage 10 billion!
"Thank you, Mr. Lin, I won’t let you down," He Chen said.
Lin Fan said: "According to your suggestion, should our first step be to build a rocket base?"
He Chen replied: "Yes, but the location is an issue, that might take some time."
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "No need, I already have an ideal place, Chiba Island in Daya Bay, I bought it not long ago, perfect for you to build the rocket base."
He Chen was very delighted: "Great, in this case, everything is ready."
Afterward, He Chen took his leave. Soon, a rocket base would secretly rise on Chiba Island!
Lin Fan had just seen off He Chen when Secretary Zhao Jiayi came to him and said: "Chairman, Mr. Song, the chairman of Yun City Chamber of Commerce, called."
Lin Fan had met Song Rongmao once, that night at Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet, Song Rongmao had invited Lin Fan to attend the Yun City business conference.
Song Rongmao expressed his appreciation for Lin Fan that night, he was a kindly elder, leaving a good impression on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan then returned to the office and took the call.
Song Rongmao laughed: "First of all, congratulations to Mr. Lin, your company’s market value broke through to billions, truly a cause for celebration!"
Lin Fan politely said: "Thank you, Chairman Song."
Song Rongmao said: "Mr. Lin, besides congratulating you, my call is mainly to remind you that our business conference starts at 3 p.m. today, I’m looking forward to your attendance."
Lin Fan had agreed to Song Rongmao that night, and, having no other plans for the afternoon, said: "No problem, I will definitely attend!"
Song Rongmao was delighted: "That’s great, I believe Mr. Lin will surely be the focus of this conference, Mr. Lin, see you then."
The call then ended.
Zhao Jiayi said: "Chairman, we have also received many congratulatory messages, the Yun City business community is sending their congratulations, how does the chairman plan to respond?"
Lin Fan glanced at the list of congratulatory messages, indeed, there were many, including powerful companies like Zhongtong and Yida, proactively showing friendship!
In addition, Elder Liu, Liu Tingshan, also sent congratulations.
Lin Fan said: "I will personally thank each one."

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Lin Dawei Enters the City
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 303: Lin Dawei Enters the City
The first priority in doing business is to maintain good relationships. Lin Fan certainly understands this principle. When these business tycoons voluntarily make friendly gestures, he’d naturally not miss the opportunity.
By the time Lin Fan finished socializing, it was already two o’clock in the afternoon.
Today could be considered Lin Fan’s busiest day since he became wealthy.
