As his business keeps growing, such busyness is likely to become Lin Fan’s daily routine.
Lin Fan then left the company with his secretary, Jiayi, to attend the Yun City business convention.
Shortly after they departed from the Celestial Aviation Headquarters, Lin Fan received a call. When he saw it was his mom, he quickly answered.
"Little Fan, your third uncle’s flight is at two-thirty in the afternoon. If you have time, please pick him up; he’s traveling alone," said Mrs. Lin.
Lin Fan sweated a bit; he was so busy today that he nearly forgot about his third uncle. Fortunately, his mom reminded him.
"Okay, I’ll go right now," Lin Fan replied.
Then he hung up the phone.
"Let’s head to Yun City Airport," Lin Fan instructed Jiayi, who was driving.
Jiayi was a bit curious, "Chairman, we need to attend the business convention. Going to the airport now might make us late..."
Lin Fan responded, "No problem, I’ll just tell Mr. Song later."
He couldn’t possibly leave his family hanging at the airport for the business convention. Lin Fan was a person who valued relationships, and no one was more important than family.
Jiayi dared not say much else and had no choice but to turn around and head to the airport.
Yun City Airport.
A middle-aged farmer in simple clothing, carrying a rustic bundle, walked out of the airport. Looking at the bustling metropolis before him, he showed a timid expression.
Lin Dawei!
Lin Fan’s third uncle.
Because of years of hard work and illness, Lin Dawei, who was in his fifties, looked as old as someone in their sixties. His face was sallow, and he was skinny like a stick.
Carrying his bundle, Lin Dawei arrived at a bus stop outside the airport because, besides buses, many cars were also waiting to pick up people there.
Lin Dawei knew Lin Fan would come to get him, so he waited for Lin Fan there.
Lin Dawei’s appearance occasionally received disdainful glances from those nearby.
"Another migrant worker from the countryside, huh?"
"It looks so rustic, and it seems he even has a stench on him!"
"I guess he’s also waiting for the bus. Keep a distance from him when you get on."
People whispered, avoiding Lin Dawei.
Lin Dawei didn’t notice the disdain around him. All his attention was on the crowd, looking for Lin Fan’s figure.
According to his guess, Lin Fan would either come by bus or ride an e-bike to pick him up, as he heard from Lin Fan’s mom that Lin Fan worked as a courier in Yun City, and couriers typically ride e-bikes.
But after looking for a long time, he still hadn’t spotted Lin Fan on an e-bike.
A bus drove up and stopped at the sign.
Afraid Lin Fan would arrive by bus and miss him, Lin Dawei moved closer to the bus door.
A crowd of people stepped off the bus, causing a temporary crowding.
A man got off the bus, slightly swaying, and in the congestion, bumped into Lin Dawei’s shoulder.
The man glanced at Lin Dawei and immediately got angry.
"You damned smelly farmer, you bumped into me!" The man cursed at Lin Dawei.
"I’m sorry," Lin Dawei quickly apologized, somewhat startled.
He was an honest farmer. Even though he hadn’t intentionally bumped into the man, and rather the man had bumped into him. He still proactively apologized.
Yet seeing him as easy to bully, instead of letting it go, the man got even more aggressive.
"You filthy like an old dog, dirtying my clothes, think a sorry will settle it? Who the hell gave you that courage!" The man fumed.
Lin Dawei, sick and unfamiliar with the place, combined with his naturally non-aggressive personality, was frightened pale by the man’s curse.
"I’m sorry, what should I do?" Lin Dawei asked timidly, just wanting the man to calm down.
The man responded, "Pay for my clothes. This outfit I just bought a few days ago has been dirtied by you, this stinky old dog!"
Lin Dawei replied, "Okay, I’ll compensate you. How much do you want?"
Lin Dawei trembled as he reached into his pocket, searching for a moment, finally pulling out a well-hidden plastic bag. Inside the bag, there was money wrapped in layers.
The man said, "These clothes are a brand name, just give me 1000 yuan!"
Lin Dawei was shocked, "1000?"
He hardly ever bought new clothes throughout the year. Even if he did, he chose the cheapest, usually just tens of yuan at the market stalls.
yuan for clothes, he had never heard of such a thing.
Yet this man immediately demanded 1000 for compensation!
Lin Dawei was scared pale, "Why are clothes so expensive?"
The man sneered, "Clearly, you’re an ignorant country bumpkin, huh? Ever heard of brand names, like Fan Sizhe? Anyway, I told you to pay, just pay, stop babbling!"
Lin Dawei said, "I only have this much money, and I brought it for treatment. If I give you 1000, I might not have enough to pay the hospital bill. Can you accept a bit less?"
The man angrily said, "No way, you stupid country bumpkin, stop babbling and hand over the money!"
Lin Dawei gripped the plastic bag tightly in his hands, pleading, "Please, reduce the amount. Plus, your clothes aren’t torn; you can wear them if you wash them."
The man’s face darkened, "Damn, my clothes got dirty by you, a smelly old dog, and you think I’d dare wear them again? If you don’t pay up, I’ll beat you, understand?"
Lin Dawei was extremely scared, but he was really unwilling to just hand over 1000 yuan to the other man.
Being a farmer back home growing corn, corn sold for just one yuan per pound. 1000 yuan meant 1000 pounds of corn.
pounds of corn; how hard do you have to work to harvest 1000 pounds?
To pay that much just for a mere bump?
He really didn’t understand the tricks of the city.
Suddenly, he thought of Lin Fan and said, "How about this, my nephew will be here soon. Can I talk to him?"
Little Fan was struggling in the big city, he surely understood more than him. Whether to compensate 1000 yuan or not, Little Fan would definitely know the right decision.
The man, hearing this, lost patience and angrily spat, "To hell with that!"
With a reach, he shoved Lin Dawei.
Lin Dawei stumbled back, ultimately losing his balance, and was knocked to the ground.
"You smelly old dog country bumpkin deserve a beating! You won’t know your place without getting hit." The man cursed, approaching Lin Dawei.
"I’ll ask you one more time, paying up or not?" The man shouted.
Lin Dawei’s hands gripped the plastic bag tightly, unwilling to release it, pleading, "Please, leave me be!"
The man cursed, "Leave you? You don’t even know who I am. I’m from the underground, understand? Dare to mess with me and I’ll beat you to death!"
He raised his hand, aiming a slap at Lin Dawei.
The man actually assaulted the old man in public!
At this moment, everyone around was watching but no one stepped forward to intervene. Firstly, they somewhat disdain Lin Dawei, and secondly, the man seemed drunk and very menacing; who would dare to confront him.
Seeing the man’s hand about to slap Lin Dawei’s head.
Suddenly, a foot came flying from the side, kicking the man, sending him airborne with a thud, landing heavily, dazed.
"You’re asking for it!"
A cold voice came from a handsome young man, his face icy.
Lin Fan!
This sudden action left everyone stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: I Hope You Can Withstand the Scare This Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 304: I Hope You Can Withstand the Scare This Time
Rolls-Royce Cullinan, Zhao Jiayi driving, Lin Fan sitting in the back seat, arrived outside Yun City Airport.
Lin Fan was on the phone with the president of HSBC, a Fortune 500 company, congratulating Mortal Group on breaking a market value of a hundred billion. HSBC is located in Zhou Tian Mansion, and Lin Fan is their landlord.
With such a good opportunity to curry favor with the landlord, the president of HSBC naturally wouldn’t miss it.
Suddenly, Lin Fan noticed a crowd gathered up ahead.
To his surprise, a sturdy man was berating an elderly person.
Isn’t that his third uncle, Lin Dawei!
Lin Fan’s expression changed, and he said: "President Chen, sorry, I have something to deal with. Let’s continue next time."
Lin Fan hung up the phone and said: "Stop the car, call the police."
Zhao Jiayi quickly parked the car.
Lin Fan then got out of the car and walked straight towards the bus stop sign. The sturdy man was about to slap Lin Dawei, but Lin Fan had already kicked him, sending the sturdy man flying and crashing heavily to the ground.
Zhao Jiayi was so frightened that cold sweat poured down, and she quickly picked up her phone to call the police.
Lin Fan’s kick that sent the sturdy man flying also shocked everyone present. He was too strong; he really sent someone flying with one kick. How strong must he be!
The sturdy man fell to the ground, looking like a dead dog, and started wailing miserably, unable to get up for a while.
The sturdy man, after bumping into Lin Dawei, used the excuse that Lin Dawei had soiled his clothes to demand 1000 yuan for compensation. When Lin Dawei refused, the sturdy man started to push Lin Dawei down and intended to beat him.
Beating an elderly person in broad daylight was indeed arrogant. Yet, none of the surrounding people dared to intervene because the sturdy man claimed to be from the underworld, intimidating everyone.
Lin Fan acted decisively, earning some admiration from the crowd for his bravery and fierceness!
After kicking the sturdy man, Lin Fan bent down to help Lin Dawei up and asked with concern: "Third Uncle, are you okay?"
Seeing it was Lin Fan, Lin Dawei was pleasantly surprised: "Little Fan, you finally came! I’m alright, just got pushed down by him, and my lower back hurts a bit."
Luckily Lin Fan arrived in time, Lin Dawei was almost beaten by the guy, and he didn’t stand a chance.
Seeing Lin Dawei unable to stand straight, Lin Fan’s anger flared up, and in a deep voice, he asked: "What happened?"
Lin Dawei briefly explained the situation: "He wanted me to compensate him 1000 yuan. I only brought 3000 yuan for my medical treatment, Little Fan. Please help me keep this money safe."
Lin Dawei handed a plastic-wrapped bundle to Lin Fan, which he’d held tightly even when pushed down, stubbornly refusing to let go, thus injuring his waist.
For a farmer, a few thousand yuan is already a lot of money because every cent is hard-earned through sweat, making it extremely precious.
For Lin Fan now, a few thousand yuan is naturally not much of a deal. Lin Fan said: "Third Uncle, you should keep this money safe yourself. I’ll take care of your medical expenses."
Lin Dawei said: "How could I let that happen? You’re working here as a courier and not earning much. I can’t let you spend unnecessarily."
Third Uncle has always been honest and sincere. Lin Fan didn’t want to explain everything about his wealth here, so he temporarily pocketed the money.
"Damn it, who was the bastard that kicked me!"
At this time, the sturdy man started shouting from the ground, having caught his breath and struggled to get up, ready to settle accounts with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan’s face chilled, having heard Third Uncle’s account, he’d already sentenced this guy in his mind.
Daring to treat an elderly person like that, it’s even worse than being a beast, and even if Lin Dawei wasn’t his relative, this would be infuriating for everyone.
Lin Fan said: "It was your grandpa here who kicked you. So what? Bullying the elderly, should I stand by?"
The sturdy man got up, his eyes landing on Lin Fan. After sizing him up, he angrily said: "You brat, dare to meddle in my affairs and don’t even bother to find out who I am. I’m from the underworld!"
Lin Fan merely said: "Oh, from the underworld, are you? Good to admit to it. Assaulting the elderly in public, that’s a serious crime."
The sturdy man laughed: "You’re trying to scare me, I’m raised without fear! You know this lousy old dog here, then you must be a poor sap too. What can you do to me!"
At this moment, Zhao Jiayi approached Lin Fan, respectfully saying: "Chairman, I’ve already called the police, and officers nearby are on their way."
Chairman?
The crowd was taken aback.
This young man is the Chairman?
Lin Fan nodded and said: "Take my Third Uncle to the car first. I’ll follow shortly."
Zhao Jiayi nodded, extended her hand to support Lin Dawei, and smiled: "Uncle, please come with me, be careful."
Lin Dawei is Lin Fan’s third uncle. Zhao Jiayi wouldn’t dare to neglect him, and having grown up in a rural area with her grandmother, she didn’t find Lin Dawei dirty, recognizing that farmers typically have tanned skin due to long-term exposure to the elements.
The crowd watched wide-eyed as Zhao Jiayi helped Lin Dawei into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
Everyone was astounded.
This is a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, an 8 million luxury car!
Good heavens!
How could this be?
Previously, everyone thought Lin Dawei was a farm laborer, looked down on him, but now he’s getting into an 8 million luxury car!
Most of them hadn’t even touched an 8 million luxury car, let alone sat in one!
Turns out this seemingly dirty and poor farmer is actually a relative of a wealthy person!
Their blessings surely surpass theirs?
Many people could feel their cheeks burning.
Lin Fan looked at the sturdy man and coldly said: "Who did you call a poor sap just now?"
The sturdy man was stumped. Damn it, if the chairman of an 8 million car is a poor sap, then what does that make him, who has neither car nor house and takes the bus?
However, he was more concerned about what Zhao Jiayi just mentioned, they’ve already called the police!
The sturdy man was instantly humbled, wanting to flee, he said: "Is money such a big deal! Do you think I’ll be scared because you called the police, huh? I’m raised fearless! If it weren’t that I have things to attend to, I’d have to beat you up a bit. But now I’ll be magnanimous and let you off!"
The sturdy man wanted to leave, but at this moment, two officers approached.
The sturdy man was startled and dared not run away.
After understanding the incident, the officers decided to take the sturdy man away.
The sturdy man was furious, pointing at Lin Fan and cursing: "You little brat, just wait and see, I won’t let you off!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said: "Really? That sentence should be mine. You hurt my third uncle, do you think being just detained for a few days will be the end of it? You can rest assured; I’ll have my legal team sue you. Get ready to clean your butt for jail time."
The sturdy man was shocked, saying: "Don’t scare me, I..."
Lin Fan said: "I know you’re raised fearless, but I hope you can withstand the fear this time."
Speaking, Lin Fan picked up his phone and dialed Jin Hesheng’s number: "Mr. Jin, it’s me."

chapters.title: Chapter 305: It Seems That Being a Delivery Person is a Promising Career
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 305: It Seems That Being a Delivery Person is a Promising Career
Jin Hesheng, the largest shareholder of the top law firm Xingquan Law Firm, a gold-medal lawyer, undefeated in his career, renowned far and wide.
Jin Hesheng smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, upon hearing that your Mortal Group’s market value has surpassed a billion, I just finished my case and was planning to call and congratulate you."
Lin Fan is the third largest shareholder of Xingquan. Jin Hesheng has always held a bit of awe towards Lin Fan because he still can’t understand what extraordinary means Lin Fan used to acquire shares in their law firm.
As for this mysterious tycoon, Jin Hesheng’s attitude is to avoid offending him and to foster a good relationship.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you. I called you this time mainly because of a case..."
Lin Fan explained the situation.
Jin Hesheng quickly said, "Alright, I’ll personally go to the police station and immediately draft the complaint!"
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan looked at the muscular man and said, "I’ve entrusted Lawyer Jin Hesheng from Xingquan Law Firm to sue you. You’ll see each other soon at the police station."
The muscular man’s face changed drastically.
Xingquan Law Firm, its reputation is legendary!
Jin Hesheng is the supreme figure of Xingquan Law Firm.
Lin Fan actually managed to mobilize Jin Hesheng!
"You little brat!"
The muscular man, agitated, wanted to rush forward to hit Lin Fan. However, as soon as he moved, he felt a fierce pain in the place where Lin Fan had kicked him earlier, and suddenly his whole body was powerless, leaving him with no strength to hit Lin Fan.
Two policemen took the opportunity to arrest him and had him taken away.
The muscular man excitedly said, "Officer, he just kicked me; you should arrest him too!"
The policeman coldly said, "He acted in self-defense, stop shouting nonsense."
Without further ado, they shoved the muscular man into the police car.
Lin Fan chuckled in his heart. With Jin Hesheng taking action, this guy would have to stay in jail for a few years. His earlier kick, though not very apparent, had already caused irreversible internal injuries to the other party, leading to an inevitable demise over time.
This scumbag no longer had any chance to take revenge on Lin Fan because the day he was released from prison would be the day he suddenly died!
And so the muscular man was taken away by the police.
Lin Fan turned and got into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
Everyone watched the Cullinan drive away, dumbfounded; the whole process from Lin Fan’s arrival to the resolution of the matter was so cool.
One couldn’t help but sigh, having money is great. The muscular man really made a mistake provoking Lin Fan, this tycoon; it was truly a path to self-destruction.
No one would sympathize with the muscular man. He was simply scum, and everyone felt he deserved it. If he really went to jail, it would be immensely satisfying.
Inside the Cullinan.
Lin Dawei was utterly bewildered, feeling as if he was dreaming, an unreal dream.
He found himself inside a car, such a luxurious car. Even though he didn’t know much about cars, he could tell it must be worth a lot.
"Little Fan, is this car yours?" Lin Dawei swallowed hard, asking in disbelief.
He initially thought Lin Fan would come to pick him up on an electric scooter or by bus, but it turned out to be such a small car!
Lin Fan was pondering how to explain it to Lin Dawei.
"If it’s someone else’s car, wouldn’t it be bad if we made it dirty," Lin Dagui added a bit awkwardly, "It must belong to someone else, right? Little Fan, where would you get the money to buy such a car, this car doesn’t look cheap at all."
Zhao Jiayi was a bit puzzled; isn’t this uncle a relative of the chairman? Why does he seem unaware that the chairman is rich?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Rest assured, uncle, this car is mine."
Lin Dawei was surprised and said, "You bought a car? It seems being a food delivery worker is quite profitable. How much did this car cost, does it cost ten million?"
Zhao Jiayi broke out in a cold sweat. This car, ten million, could probably buy one wheel... Surely not, could the chairman’s uncle really think the chairman is working as a food delivery guy? What a joke, a food delivery guy couldn’t afford a Rolls-Royce Cullinan costing eighty million even in several lifetimes.
Lin Fan said, "Well, roughly, this car isn’t very expensive."
He didn’t plan to explain too much to Lin Dawei for now. In Lin Dawei’s eyes, buying a ten million car was already remarkable. If he were to tell him he had multi-billion assets, he might scare him into fainting.
Lin Fan bought a "ten million" car, Lin Dawei felt genuinely happy for Lin Fan; it looked like Little Fan was making progress. When he gets back to the village and tells the villagers, he’d feel proud, and Lin Fan’s parents would have even more face.
There weren’t many people in the village who could afford to own a car.
Lin Dawei looked at Zhao Jiayi then and said, "And this young lady... is she your girlfriend? Not bad, very pretty. Little Fan, seems like being a delivery guy has really paid off, you bought a car and even found a girlfriend."
Hearing this, Zhao Jiayi’s hand shook, nearly causing a crash, she broke out in a cold sweat, quickly saying, "I’m not, I don’t dare..."
Her face blushed, her heart racing.
Lin Dawei actually mistook her for the chairman’s girlfriend; this was too embarrassing. Although everyone would want to be Lin Fan’s girlfriend, she wasn’t, especially in front of the chairman...
Lin Fan felt amused in his heart and said, "Uncle, you misunderstood. Jiayi is not my girlfriend, just... an ordinary friend."
Zhao Jiayi’s heart fluttered; she was just his secretary, the chairman gave her too much credit, boohoo, even if she couldn’t be the chairman’s girlfriend, being a friend was satisfying!
She now understood that Lin Dawei really didn’t know the chairman was rich, and apparently, the chairman didn’t plan on explaining it.
She needed to cooperate with the chairman.
"Yes, uncle, Lin...Fan and I are just good friends," Zhao Jiayi said, her face deeply flushed, but her heart was delighted.
Lin Dawei was a bit disappointed; he thought Little Fan had found such a beautiful girlfriend. If that had been true, his parents would have been overjoyed, as they had long wanted to have grandchildren.
"Sorry, young lady, I misunderstood you," Lin Dawei said, a bit apologetically.
Zhao Jiayi said, "It’s alright..."
Lin Dawei said to Lin Fan, "Little Fan, seriously, you should really find yourself a proper girlfriend, your parents are eager to have grandchildren."
Upon hearing that, Zhao Jiayi couldn’t help but chuckle, and then she thought how wonderful it would be if she really were the chairman’s girlfriend. The thought made her blush down to the roots of her neck.
Lin Fan was a bit sweaty: "I know, I’ll try my best. Uncle, how’s your back injury? Once we reach the hospital, I’ll find a surgeon to have a look at it?"
Lin Dawei said, "It’s nothing serious, resting should suffice. Little Fan, you booked a hospital bed for me, right?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it’s been booked."
Yun City People’s Hospital.
Lin Fan took Lin Dawei to the inpatient department. As they passed by the regular wards, Lin Dawei thought Lin Fan had booked a regular ward for him; he didn’t know there were other wards.
But Lin Fan didn’t stop at those regular wards; instead, he took him to the reserved VIP suite.
Opening the door, Lin Dawei was stunned.
The inside was so luxurious, just like what he saw on TV, where rich people lived in star-rated hotels.
"Little Fan, why did you bring me here?" Lin Dawei asked curiously.
Lin Fan said, "Uncle, you’ll stay here."
Lin Fan entered, placing Lin Dawei’s bags on a chair.
Lin Dawei was dumbfounded: "Little Fan, did I hear you right? You mean, this is my ward?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Yes, Uncle, come in quickly, you’ll stay here during your hospital admission."
"Is this really a ward?" Lin Dawei still couldn’t believe it, if it weren’t for the medical equipment around; he’d think he was in a hotel.
Lin Fan said, "It’s indeed a ward, a VIP suite, exclusively for you."
Lin Dawei said, "Such a nice ward, it must be costly, right? Little Fan, is it necessary? Why not switch to something cheaper?"
The elderly always tended to worry about money.
Lin Fan said, "I want you to stay comfortable, Uncle don’t worry, this only costs a bit more than regular wards; I can afford it."
Only then did Lin Dawei dare to come in, looking around with admiration: "This ward is so much more luxurious than a home. It’d be nice if our home could be this beautiful someday."
Lin Fan laughed and said, "The next time I go back to the countryside, I’ll build a villa that’s ten times more beautiful than this. Uncle, how’s your back after the journey?"
Lin Dawei said, "Not too bad, a rest should do. Little Fan, have you arranged a bed for me here?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it’s all arranged."
By 3 pm.
The Yun City Business Conference was held, gathering business moguls from all sectors, all of whom are industry elites.
The central topic of conversation: Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 306: The Center of Attention, The Fastest Rising Tycoon with a 100 Billion Net Worth
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 306: The Center of Attention, The Fastest Rising Tycoon with a 100 Billion Net Worth
Yun City Expo Center.
This year’s business conference in Yun City is being held here. At the entrance of the venue, luxury cars gathered, and prominent figures from the political and business circles arrived one after another.
As the president of the business association, Song Rongmao personally greeted the guests at the door. All the heavyweights had already been welcomed in, but the guest Song Rongmao valued the most today, Lin Fan, had yet to arrive.
The gathered tycoons at the venue were chatting in groups, and most of their discussions revolved around the owner of the newly minted trillion-yuan group, Lin Fan.
Lin Fan became the focal point of this business conference.
"The speed at which Mr. Lin has risen is simply unbelievable!"
"Yun City’s fourth trillion-yuan group and the fastest to rise in history, indeed remarkable!"
"What’s most impressive is the amount of disposable funds Lin Fan has at his disposal for expenditure, truly enviable."
"The entire business world is abuzz today!"
"I’ve only heard of this Lin Fan but have never seen him. I wonder if I’ll have the chance to meet him today?"
"I’ve also never seen him, but I’ve heard he’s quite young, only 21 years old. Truly impressive!"
Everyone envied Lin Fan’s rapid rise. After all, Mortal Group rose so quickly, Lin Fan was so young, and he was extremely wealthy, a true cash magnate.
Many present were worth billions or even trillions, yet their actual available funds were limited. Some even owed vast sums to banks, shining as wealthy figures but being heavily indebted inside.
Mortal Group’s rise came with frenzied acquisitions, buying buildings, land, and planes, each with deals starting from billions, buying Zhou Tian Mansion for 10 billion, buying an airplane for 20 billion... a seemingly endless stream of funds, truly enviable.
Envy to the point of bleeding.
While everyone envied, their curiosity about Lin Fan’s background grew. According to Lin Fan’s own disclosure, he had an uncle, Lin Beixuan, from whom all his wealth came.
As for who Lin Beixuan is, no one knows.
However, Lin Fan mentioned that Lin Beixuan would soon bring hundreds of billions to Yun City to develop Chiba Island.
Many speculate that Lin Beixuan might have something to do with the Kyoto Lin Family.
Anyhow, Lin Beixuan is certainly a formidable super-wealthy individual to provide Lin Fan with such a vast sum.
Noticing everyone discussing Lin Fan, Song Rongmao increasingly realized Lin Fan’s importance. This business conference must have Lin Fan in attendance.
"Elder Song, do you think Mr. Lin will attend today? Could you kindly introduce us?" A middle-aged man moved closer to Song Rongmao and asked.
This person was none other than He Chao, the head of Zhongtong Express, one of the three trillion-yuan tycoons in Yun City!
Song Rongmao replied, "I have invited Mr. Lin, but he has yet to appear. If he arrives, I’ll certainly introduce him to Boss He."
It was only then that He Chao left satisfied.
"Welcome the guests for me; I’m going to make a call."
Song Rongmao instructed his subordinates and then stepped aside to personally call Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, our business conference is about to start. Could Mr. Lin attend?" Song Rongmao politely asked.
Lin Fan said, "I’m sorry, Elder Song. I was delayed by some personal matters and am rushing over now. I might be late."
Song Rongmao breathed a sigh of relief, as long as Lin Fan was coming, he stated, "No worries, Mr. Lin. Take your time. Please be safe on the road."
At this moment, Lin Fan was sitting in a Rolls-Royce, having just left the hospital.
After hanging up with Song Rongmao, Lin Fan said, "That was Elder Song’s call. Let’s hurry over."
Zhao Jiayi nodded, increasing the car’s speed.
At 3 PM, the business conference started on time, with the guests entering one after another and taking their designated seats.
Sitting at the forefront were the top figures in Yun City’s political and business realms.
It was noted that among Yun City’s three major tycoons, the heads of Zhongtong Express, He Chao, and Yida Mall, Wang Hailin, were seated, but the seat for Shengshi Group’s head, Feng Wanshan, was notably replaced by Lin Fan.
There was immediate chatter among the crowd.
"I’ve heard Feng Wanshan declined Elder Song’s invitation, citing poor health!"
"I suspect it’s an excuse; it’s definitely related to recent events."
"Feng Wanshan has been ensnared by scandals and should lay low."
"I never expected Yun City’s three titans to face a shift so soon. Shengshi’s stock has plummeted recently, while Mortal has risen swiftly. Lin Fan replacing Feng Wanshan is inevitable."
Everyone sighed.
Feng Wanshan had failed to stop Lin Fan and was instead exposed by Lin Fan in a scandal, which led the police to question him. Shengshi’s stock price plummeted, wiping 30 billion off its market value.
This was quite the sensation in the business world. However, not many knew it was Lin Fan’s doing.
It’s said Feng Wanshan fainted from shock after learning about the 30 billion market value evaporation and was sent to the hospital for rescue.
It became a laughingstock in circles.
Feng Wanshan certainly had no face to attend this business conference.
In reality, Feng Wanshan was plotting with his core team on revenge strategies against Mortal Group.
It was expected that Feng Wanshan would not come, but with Lin Fan’s extended absence, curiosity grew among the guests.
They speculated that perhaps Lin Fan was too busy to attend, but it seemed disrespectful to Song Rongmao, as all present took time from their busy schedules to show up for him.
Lin Fan was half an hour late before appearing at the conference venue.
Guided by staff, Lin Fan, accompanied by his secretary Zhao Jiayi, sat in his designated seat.
In an instant, all eyes were on Lin Fan.
At that moment, He Chao, the head of Zhongtong Express, was giving a speech on stage, but everyone’s attention was drawn to Lin Fan.
As rumors suggested, Lin Fan, only 21 years old, was a humble-dressed young wealth magnate and exceptionally handsome.
Most of the tycoons present were middle-aged, having spent half their lives to reach their current status.
Yet Lin Fan’s rise, seemingly within half a month, was considered a miracle.
Everyone’s curiosity about Lin Fan was thoroughly understandable.
Even He Chao from Zhongtong Express, seeing Lin Fan’s presence, lost interest in his speech and quickly concluded it, stepping down from the stage.
Their seats were arranged together, prompting He Chao to head directly to Lin Fan’s side and sit down.
"You must be Mr. Lin Fan. I’m He Chao. Pleased to meet you." He Chao took the initiative to greet Lin Fan.
Lin Fan shook hands with He Chao, courteously stating, "I’ve also long admired President He’s reputation."
Lin Fan had an identity as a courier for Zhongtong Express, meaning He Chao was technically his boss...
Of course, He Chao was unaware of this, and Lin Fan did not mention it.
At this moment, Song Rongmao, realizing Lin Fan’s arrival, went on stage smiling, "Thanks for President He’s speech. I’ve noticed that Mr. Lin Fan is here. Mortal Group just crossed the trillion-yuan market value today. On behalf of the business association, I congratulate Mr. Lin and would like to invite him up for a few words. Shall we welcome him?"
"Welcome!"
Everyone responded, and applause thundered.
Lin Fan was a bit bewildered; he wasn’t prepared to give a speech at this conference.
However, with everyone’s enthusiasm, he couldn’t refuse, so he mustered the courage and went on stage.
Instantly, the room fell silent, awaiting Lin Fan’s speech.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Buy, buy, and then breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 307: Buy, buy, and then breakthrough
Lin Fan was invited by Song Rongmao to speak on stage. With enthusiastic applause from the crowd, Lin Fan had no choice but to step up, though he was unprepared and just started speaking off the cuff.
"Hello everyone, I am Lin Fan. I am delighted to be invited by Elder Song to attend this business conference and to meet all of you esteemed business leaders. It’s truly an honor."
The room was filled with applause.
Lin Fan continued, "I’d like to first apologize to Elder Song and everyone here. In such a serious business conference, I was late today because my uncle was hospitalized, which delayed me."
Upon hearing this, everyone realized why Lin Fan was delayed in his appearance.
Lin Fan’s uncle was hospitalized?
Could it be that the uncle Lin Fan mentioned is Lin Beixuan?
It must be!
Lin Fan would prefer to be late just to visit his uncle. This uncle must be very important to Lin Fan, which has to be the mysterious wealthy man, Lin Beixuan.
It seems what Lin Fan said is true, Lin Beixuan has indeed come to Yun City!
As everyone thought of this, they couldn’t help but feel a bit excited.
Is the legendary Lin Beixuan finally going to make an appearance!
Little did Lin Fan know, his casual mention led everyone to mistakenly think that his third uncle, Lin Dawei, was Lin Beixuan.
If he knew, Lin Fan would probably be both amused and exasperated.
Lin Fan then said a few polite phrases and concluded his speech. Although his words were not long, they left an impression of humility and politeness.
For a moment, the business leaders all had a good impression of Lin Fan.
This young billionaire seemed rare for not being arrogant at all and instead being very low-key, almost like a legend among people. No wonder Lin Beixuan chose him; his future achievements are boundless.
The desire to befriend Lin Fan grew stronger among everyone.
After finishing his speech, Lin Fan was about to step off the stage when he was stopped by Song Rongmao.
Song Rongmao smiled, "Mr. Lin, don’t rush to leave the stage just yet. Mr. Lin and his Mortal Group are relatively unfamiliar to everyone. I think everyone here is very interested, including myself. We would love for you to satisfy our curiosity about Yun City’s fourth billion-dollar group!"
Everyone immediately applauded; indeed, they were full of curiosity about Lin Fan and the Mortal Group.
This young group, with a young president, had risen to prominence in such a short time, truly sparking curiosity.
Lin Fan smiled, "What would everyone like to know? I’ll do my best to answer."
Song Rongmao said, "Then I’ll start with a question for Mr. Lin. You previously released a statement about your background. I wonder if that’s true?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, it’s true. There’s nothing special about my background. I grew up in a rural area, attended university in Yun City, and had a few jobs after graduation before becoming a delivery worker."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan’s statement only mentioned his wealth coming from Lin Beixuan.
But Lin Fan actually used to be a delivery worker?
This was the first time they knew!
It seems Lin Fan’s journey is indeed quite remarkable.
From a farmer’s son, from a delivery worker to a billionaire!
Song Rongmao wiped away sweat, thinking he must have misheard, "Mr. Lin, did you really work as a delivery person?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, before inheriting my uncle’s wealth, I was a delivery worker. There’s nothing to hide about it; it’s a respectable job and I enjoyed it quite a bit."
Song Rongmao expressed, "It’s truly incredible that Mr. Lin could go from delivery work to becoming a billionaire. I wonder how Mr. Lin managed to do it?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "It’s simple, really; you just need money. I had money, then bought and bought, and that’s how I broke through."
Everyone broke out in a cold sweat.
Lin Fan’s words were casual, as if buying cabbage.
But everyone knew that when Lin Fan said "bought and bought," we are talking tens of billions, even hundreds of billions!
Buying and buying, then breaking through!
How many people in this world can buy and buy like Lin Fan? Having money truly allows you to do whatever you want!
Bear in mind that all present were business leaders in Yun City, and even they couldn’t be as carefree as Lin Fan.
Lin Fan’s words shocked even them.
Lin Fan didn’t realize his casual comment was so astonishing. In his eyes, it truly seemed too easy.
Most of his so-called buying was all gifted by the system.
Chiba Island was given by the system.
Zhou Tian Mansion was given by the system.
Celestial Aviation was given by the system.
Ten Boeings 747 were also given by the system.
Lin Fan himself spent almost no money, with his account still holding billions of cash.
If the attendees knew he had billions of disposable cash, they would envy him to the point of vomiting blood, replenish their blood, and vomit again, repeating dozens of times.
My goodness, how many billionaires in the world have billions of disposable cash?
If ranked by cash, Lin Fan would be a top figure on the global scale.
Amid their envy, their curiosity about Lin Fan’s Mortal Group grew even stronger.
The head of Zhongtong Express, He Chao, couldn’t help but ask, "Mr. Lin, if I may ask, what’s in store for Mortal Group in the future?"
He Chao was always looking for profitable opportunities and approached Lin Fan to see if there were potential collaboration opportunities in the future.
Since he’s in the courier business and Celestial Aviation is in the airline business, there are areas where collaboration is possible.
Lin Fan indeed had plans; his next biggest plan was to establish a space division and develop rockets!
But these plans were confidential and not yet announced publicly, so Lin Fan naturally wouldn’t disclose them.
Lin Fan said, "We have quite a few plans. For instance, the 10 newly acquired Boeings 747 will expand our transportation business, including both passenger and cargo services."
He Chao was very pleased to hear this, as an expansion in cargo business for Celestial Aviation could mean collaboration with Zhongtong Express.
He Chao saw great potential in the Mortal Group. If Zhongtong could establish a partnership with Mortal, it would bode well for Zhongtong’s prospects.
At this moment, an elder asked, "Mr. Lin, I heard that you’ve recently acquired shares in Huaxin, becoming the largest shareholder. Is this true?"
Lin Fan looked and saw it was Wang Hailin, the head of Yida Mall.
The top billionaire leader in Yun City!
Lin Fan originally didn’t intend to mention Huaxin, but since Wang Hailin asked, there was no need to conceal it.
Lin Fan nodded, smiling, "President Wang is very well-informed. Yes, I have just become the largest shareholder of Huaxin."
Wang Hailin said, "I heard it by chance, and I’m fortunate that Mr. Lin is here to confirm it. I’ve also heard that Mr. Lin plans to invest in building a high-end chip factory and has already signed a contract with Zhongwei Phone to produce chips for it?"
What?
Everyone present was shocked.
Lin Fan became the largest shareholder of Huaxin and plans to build a high-end chip factory? How is that even possible?
Does Lin Fan have the technology for high-end chips?

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Yun City Led by Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 308: Yun City Led by Mr. Lin
The CEO of Yida Mall, Wang Hailin, the leading figure among the three billion-dollar moguls in Yun City, is, in fact, the true richest man in Yun City, with Yida’s market value reaching 180 billion.
Wang Hailin is extremely attentive to the business world in Yun City. In fact, as Lin Fan was just rising, he already caught Wang Hailin’s attention.
Regarding news about Lin Fan, Wang Hailin always collects it at the first moment. Although Lin Fan and Zhongwei’s cooperation has not yet been publicly announced, Wang Hailin has already obtained the information through his sources.
Today, seeing this legendary young magnate in person, Wang Hailin sought confirmation face to face.
Because he didn’t really believe this news, after all, Lin Fan building a high-end chip factory? High-end chips aren’t something just anyone can make; it’s the world’s top technology.
He didn’t quite believe that Lin Fan would possess this technology.
When Wang Hailin asked, the others were equally astonished, and all eyes turned to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan cleared his throat and said, "This matter hasn’t been officially announced, but it’s not a secret. Since President Wang asked, I’ll explain the situation."
"That’s right, I recently acquired shares in Huaxin, becoming Huaxin’s largest shareholder, and passed a resolution to assist Zhongwei in Huaxin Company. Because I brought high-end chip technology, next, Mortal Group will cooperate with Huaxin to build a high-end chip factory, with Zhongwei as our first client."
"We are not solely serving Zhongwei; the reason Zhongwei is the first client is simply because they recently encountered difficulties... In the future, our chip factory will accept orders from all parties."
After Lin Fan finished speaking, the entire venue fell silent.
Everyone had a look of shock.
Unbelievable, Lin Fan came with high-end chip technology and became Huaxin’s largest shareholder?
And that’s Huaxin!
Huaxin Company is not in Yun City but is in another city across the river from Yun City, Jiang City.
In Eastern Huaxia, the great river divides the North of the River from Jiangnan.
Huaxin Company is based in Jiang City, North of the River, a super company with a market value of 500 billion, ranking foremost in the whole North of the River.
Unexpected!
Lin Fan’s influence has already crossed the river, reaching the North of the River!
He even became the largest shareholder of the largest company North of the River!
This shock was enough to make one’s jaw drop!
What’s even more surprising is that Lin Fan actually possesses high-end chip technology?
"Mr. Lin, may I ask how advanced your chip technology is? How does it compare with the current world’s leading 5nm chip technology by TSMC?" Wang Hailin asked.
Lin Fan mentally noted, it seems this Wang Hailin did his homework, though what he plans to do with such detailed inquiries is unknown?
However, Lin Fan had no need to hide, saying, "My chip technology is also 5nm chips, but we can manufacture them without a lithography machine, which is the difference from TSMC. Let me put it this way, it’s not arrogance, but once our chips are released, TSMC will be out of the picture."
"What?"
The entire audience was stunned!
Lin Fan’s words were like a bomb, a thunderclap out of the blue!
You must understand, the current world’s leading 5nm chip technology requires the most precise lithography machines in existence to manufacture.
Yet Lin Fan’s 5nm chip has already freed itself from needing a lithography machine!
If this is true, it means Lin Fan’s chip technology leads the world!
Wang Hailin was also in shock, unable to believe, saying, "Mr. Lin, are you serious, not joking? Such things must not be joked about."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I have no need to joke. Just look forward to it, once our chips are out, they’ll definitely be a surprise for everyone, showing the whole world that Huaxia’s chip technology is the most impressive!"
Seeing everyone’s shocked expressions, Lin Fan chuckled inwardly. The chip technology he mentioned now was merely the weakest among those he mastered, as the system’s rewarded top-tier chip technology included something even more impressive...
If he were to reveal the more advanced technology, wouldn’t these people be bowing?
Moreover, Lin Fan wasn’t too focused on chip technology right now, leaving the task of building the factory to Huaxin’s chairman, Zhang Jing.
He was more interested in rocket building.
And compared to the rocket-building plan, what is a chip factory...
However, just the weakest chip technology Lin Fan mastered was enough to shock the entire venue.
Everyone appeared excited.
"If Mr. Lin wasn’t joking, then this is incredible."
"If Huaxin really builds such a chip factory, its market value would surge upward; the wealth it creates, my god, unimaginable!"
"At that time, Mr. Lin will become the richest man in Jiangnan with just Huaxin, let alone having Celestial Aviation..."
"Impressive!"
"Yun City actually produced someone like Mr. Lin; I foresee him contending for the richest man in Huaxia, or even Asia, or the world!"
"Mr. Lin might still be a CEO of a billion-dollar group right now, but who knows what the future holds?"
"I believe, at the least, Yun City will come to be led by Mr. Lin!"
This statement made the whole venue fall silent for a moment.
Yun City led by Lin Fan!
This...
Isn’t that a bit too arrogant?
Moreover, the current rightful richest man in Yun City, Wang Hailin, was right there!
Wang Hailin’s expression seemed a bit awkward, indeed, the speaker gave him too little face, Yun City’s billion-dollar mogul was still him, Wang Hailin, not yet Lin Fan.
Lin Fan modestly said, "Please don’t overpraise me; I don’t deserve it. If anyone has no further questions, I’ll step down and leave the floor to Elder Song."
The topic ended with Lin Fan’s modesty, but in many people’s eyes, Lin Fan was already regarded as the head of Yun City.
With Lin Fan holding the two trump cards of Celestial Aviation and Huaxin Company, becoming the leader of Yun City was only a matter of time.
He might even be likely to become the leader of Jiangnan in the future.
Surpassing today’s richest man in Jiangnan, Wei Tiansheng of the Wangu Group.
For a while, Lin Fan seemed like a coveted treasure, everyone wanting to get closer.
This business convention, Lin Fan undeniably stole the spotlight, becoming the focal point of the entire audience.
Lin Fan’s revelation about chip technology soon spread, shocking the entire Huaxia business community.
Zhongwei Company then released a statement, officially announcing that Zhongwei had partnered with Huaxin to have Huaxin manufacture chips in the future.
A joint statement by Huaxin and Mortal Group was also released, announcing Mortal Group’s possession of world-leading 5nm chip technology, starting its cooperation with Huaxin to build a high-end chip factory.
These two statements quickly hit the hot search list, going viral instantly.
Especially Huaxin’s statement, which stunned the entire nation.
"Good heavens, Mortal Group is so impressive?"
"What kind of Immortal is Mortal Group? Never heard of them before they suddenly rose to fame?"
"So amazing!"
"Bowed down to Mortal Group!"
And there’s more, as the information brewed, news quickly spread worldwide, astonishing the world. Everyone’s attention globally was focused on Mortal Group.
With the news breaking out, this young billion-dollar group saw its stock price once again soaring wildly.
billion!
billion!
billion!
billion!
Within a day, the market value of Mortal Group surged past the 200 billion barrier, surpassing Yida Mall, making Lin Fan the undisputed leader of Yun City, as the entire stock market went crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: A Bet Between 2 Billionaires
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 309: A Bet Between 2 Billionaires
The Yun City Business Conference has ended, and this is just the beginning of today’s madness.
During the subsequent networking session, Lin Fan was surrounded by a tight crowd. These bigwigs from the Yun City political and business circles flocked around Lin Fan like fanboys, all hoping to shake hands with him and establish some connection.
Even though at this time, the stock market value of Mortal Group hadn’t surpassed Yida, in everyone’s eyes, Lin Fan was already the richest man in Yun City.
Seeing this, Wang Hailin couldn’t help but feel a little despondent. Lin Fan was the absolute star of the conference, and compared to him, even Wang Hailin as the richest man seemed diminished.
He Chao, the CEO of Zhongtong Express, sidled up to Wang Hailin with a smile, saying, "Old Wang, with Mr. Lin around, it seems we have to concede to the young. Anyway, my Zhongtong Express is soon to be surpassed by Mortal, let’s see how long you can hold on."
Wang Hailin replied, "Although Mortal’s current market value is still rising, the momentum has slowed, having just broken 100 billion. My Yida Mall’s market value is 180 billion, it looks like it can hold on for some time."
He Chao shook his head and said, "I wouldn’t be so sure."
Wang Hailin was a bit displeased: "Old He, what do you mean by that?"
He Chao smiled and said, "Mr. Lin just announced the chip technology. Once this news is confirmed, what do you think?"
Wang Hailin’s heart skipped a beat and he said, "How can you be sure that Mr. Lin is not exaggerating? A chip technology ahead of TSMC doesn’t seem very reliable to me."
He Chao gave a mysterious smile and said, "We’re all seasoned investors here. In my judgment, Mr. Lin is definitely not wrong. Anyway, I’ve already bought stock in Celestial Aviation, soon you’ll be afraid you can’t buy any."
While Wang Hailin was inclined to buy Celestial Aviation’s stock, he still had some hesitations about it, hence he was indecisive.
What worried him the most was the possibility that Celestial Aviation could be a massive bubble.
Especially after he discovered through his own sources the relationship between Lin Fan and Huaxin, the uncertainty only grew.
If Lin Fan’s so-called 5nm chip technology was fake, the Mortal bubble might burst overnight.
Today, he asked Lin Fan with the intention of clarifying this point.
But Lin Fan’s answer didn’t reassure him; instead, it deepened his concern.
"No worries, I’ll keep watching," said Wang Hailin.
He Chao laughed, "Old Wang, why don’t we take a gamble? Don’t blame me for not reminding you, you might miss the chance. By then, not only might you lose your position as Yun City’s richest, but even your second position could be taken by me."
Wang Hailin smiled without giving a definite answer.
While Wang Hailin and He Chao were discussing the purchase of Celestial Aviation stock, Lin Fan was busy dealing with the crowd’s admiration.
With great effort, Lin Fan managed to free himself, only to be pulled aside by Song Rongmao.
Song Rongmao smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, you are very popular. In all these years of hosting business meetings, this is the first time such a situation has occurred."
Lin Fan sighed slightly and said, "I didn’t expect such enthusiasm. I’m not that great, truly feel ashamed."
Song Rongmao said, "Mr. Lin, there’s no need for modesty. In my opinion, you are absolutely deserving."
Lin Fan said, "Elder Song, you flatter me."
Song Rongmao said, "Mr. Lin, there’s something I’d like to discuss with you. I wonder if you’re free to talk with me privately?"
Lin Fan had planned to visit Lin Dawei in the hospital after the business conference.
However, since Song Rongmao invited him, he couldn’t refuse and said, "No problem."
Then instructed Zhao Jiayi, "Wait for me in the car."
Yun City People’s Hospital.
Lin Dawei was alone in the room. After Lin Fan left, he wandered around the room for a long time. This VIP suite was too luxurious, and it was his first time staying in such a place, he couldn’t bear to close his eyes.
Eventually tired, he lay on the hospital bed and fell asleep.
After an unknown amount of time, Lin Dawei was awakened by a knock on the door. He got up and saw a bald middle-aged man come in, wearing a white coat, appearing to be a doctor.
Lin Dawei immediately became a little nervous, "Hello, doctor."
This bald middle-aged man was the deputy dean, Chen Zhenfeng.
Last time, Chen Zhenfeng tried to compete with Lin Fan for this VIP suite, but with Dean Zhou Nanhua backing Lin Fan, Chen Zhenfeng failed.
Chen Zhenfeng held a grudge about this, and when he heard that a patient had already moved into the VIP suite, he came to take a look.
Seeing Lin Dawei, Chen Zhenfeng frowned; Lin Dawei looked just like a country bumpkin, a farmer!
Yet such a person was staying in this VIP suite!
In Chen Zhenfeng’s impression, Lin Fan was nothing more than someone who dressed in cheap clothes, a poor man!
If it weren’t for the dean’s help, Lin Fan couldn’t have competed with him at all.
After probing a bit later, Chen Zhenfeng found out about the relationship between Lin Fan and the dean, discovering that the only reason the dean helped Lin Fan was because Lin Fan amused his grandson.
Upon learning this, Chen Zhenfeng was delighted.
The dean had no real tie with Lin Fan, which put his mind at ease.
This meant the dean couldn’t always and everywhere protect Lin Fan; he could help once, but not a second time!
And today, with the dean away, Chen Zhenfeng saw his chance and decided to come and demand Lin Fan and Lin Dawei to leave again.
"Do you know who I am?" said Chen Zhenfeng condescendingly.
Lin Dawei smiled politely, "I don’t know, doctor, may I know your surname?"
Chen Zhenfeng replied, "I am Chen Zhenfeng, the deputy dean here. Where’s your nephew today? Not here?"
Lin Dawei replied, "He’s away on business. Dean Chen, are you here to help with my treatment? Wonderful, to have the deputy dean check on me, Little Fan must have arranged this specially for me!"
Chen Zhenfeng sneered, "Wishful thinking. Me treat you? I am here to inform you that you cannot stay in this room and need to leave immediately."
Lin Dawei was taken aback, "Can’t stay?"
Chen Zhenfeng nodded, "That’s right, this room wasn’t meant for you. Look at yourself, just a farmer. Don’t you think staying in a room like this is a waste?"
Lin Dawei was stunned; the deputy dean was actually telling him such things!
Already timid by nature, he couldn’t help feeling scared, cautiously saying, "Deputy Dean, it was Little Fan who booked this room for me. Could there be some misunderstanding?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "There’s no misunderstanding. I am the deputy dean here, and I call the shots. You should pack up now and move to a regular room. I will have a nurse take you there."
Lin Fan was a tough opponent, but Lin Dawei seemed easy to bully. Taking advantage of Lin Fan’s absence to throw Lin Dawei out.
Once settled, even if Lin Fan complained to the dean, the dean would only be able to persuade Lin Fan to comply.
He didn’t believe the dean would turn against his deputy dean for this.
Lin Dawei indeed dared not go against Chen Zhenfeng, unfamiliar as he was with the place, he thought Chen Zhenfeng might be right.
"Alright, I’ll move out,"
Lin Dawei said, then began to pack his things, ready to leave the VIP suite.
Just at that moment,
there was a sudden knock on the door.
A well-dressed person came in.
"Excuse me, are you Mr. Lin, Lin Fan’s uncle?" this person asked respectfully to Lin Dawei.
Lin Dawei replied, "I am. Who might you be?"
This person said, "Mr. Lin, finally I have met you. I am Chen Ming, the president of HSBC, and I came specially to visit Mr. Lin."
Following which, surprisingly, a group of people trickled in, all of them heavyweight figures in the business world!
One after another, they entered, showing great respect for Lin Dawei, each taking turns to bow.
"I am Xiao Jian, the general manager for Huaxia District at Volkswagen, greetings to Mr. Lin!"
"I am Li Dachun, the chairman of Life Insurance, greetings to Mr. Lin!"
"I am..."
The corporate leaders each introduced themselves.
Nearby, Chen Zhenfeng was dumbfounded at the sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Lin Dawei’s Confused Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 310: Lin Dawei’s Confused Face
Song Rongmao’s office.
Song Rongmao and Lin Fan finished their conversation, and both stood up.
"Mr. Lin, welcome to the Billionaires’ Club. We will host meetings irregularly, and we hope Mr. Lin will participate and engage in discussions." Song Rongmao said with a smile, shaking hands with Lin Fan.
As it turned out, he called Lin Fan for a private conversation to invite Lin Fan to join the Billionaires’ Club.
The Billionaires’ Club, as the name implies, only grants eligibility to billionaires whose company valuation exceeds one billion.
By becoming a member of the Billionaires’ Club, one will enjoy corresponding member rights, but also bear certain member obligations. For the members, these billionaires will have opportunities for collaboration and communication.
Lin Fan didn’t hesitate much before deciding to join the Billionaires’ Club, as it posed no downside for him. Plus, since Song Rongmao personally invited him, Lin Fan wished to show him respect.
Song Rongmao truly admired Lin Fan. Despite his young age, Lin Fan already owned a billion-dollar group, an extraordinary achievement.
Originally, Billionaires’ Club members needed some time of assessment before meeting the criteria to join. For instance, the valuation of Lin Fan’s Mortal Group had just broken one billion, and typically it would require a period of review to ensure the valuation remains above one billion before they could join.
Similarly, if a member of the Billionaires’ Club experiences a valuation drop below one billion, a review period would ensue. If the valuation doesn’t recover beyond one billion after the period, they would be kicked out of the club.
But Song Rongmao omitted this review period, eagerly inviting Lin Fan, showing great confidence in him.
Lin Fan is said to be the first to receive such treatment.
Lin Fan is also the youngest member of the Billionaires’ Club.
Typically, those able to achieve a company valuation above one billion are middle-aged individuals who’ve worked half their lives or even elderly, but Lin Fan, a mere 21-year-old young man, owns a billion-dollar group, a rarity in all of Huaxia.
Song Rongmao was very pleased, then took out a Golden Card, saying: "Mr. Lin, this is the exclusive Golden Card for the Billionaires’ Club, a symbol of identity. Please keep it safe."
Lin Fan accepted the Golden Card and said: "Thank you."
The two then left the office.
"Mr. Lin, I heard your uncle is ill. I wish to visit him if it’s convenient." Song Rongmao expressed his concern.
Lin Fan replied: "Elder Song, it’s very kind of you. Of course, it’s convenient. Elder Song can accompany me."
Song Rongmao, hardly able to contain his joy, said: "Alright."
Song Rongmao was joyful, finally getting to see the legendary Lin Beixuan!
Lin Fan never imagined that Song Rongmao mistook Lin Dawei for Lin Beixuan, nor did he dwell on it. Arriving outside the Expo Center, Lin Fan boarded a Rolls-Royce headed to Yun City People’s Hospital.
Song Rongmao’s car followed behind.
Upon arriving at Yun City People’s Hospital, Lin Fan and Zhao Jiayi brought Song Rongmao to the VIP suite entrance, only to find the VIP suite was surrounded tightly!
And the people gathered at the door were all business elite big shots...
Lin Fan was stunned. What the hell was going on?
Why were all these people congregating here at his third uncle’s hospital room? It’s not a tourist spot. What’s happening here?
Lin Fan looked at Zhao Jiayi: "How did they know my third uncle was here?"
Zhao Jiayi, slightly panicked, replied: "I’m sorry, Chairman. Perhaps it’s because I divulged... When you and Mr. Song were discussing business, I was outside and someone inquired about Uncle Lin’s condition. I carelessly mentioned Uncle Lin was here. I didn’t expect them to actually come over..."
Lin Fan sighed: "Alright then..."
These people came spontaneously to visit, clearly intending to fish for information from Zhao Jiayi, who unintentionally disclosed it, hence they came.
They didn’t expect such a gesture of respect.
At this point, the visitors gathered at the VIP suite were greeting Lin Dawei, introducing themselves.
Each was surprisingly respectful, somewhat ingratiating, as if Lin Dawei were some significant figure.
These were all prominent individuals, introducing themselves one by one, none without weight in their names, starting from manager, presidents galore, not lacking directors and chairmen...
These people left Lin Dawei bewildered.
What kind of scenario is this?
Why suddenly so many people came to greet him? And they all seemed rather significant, each either a president or a general manager of some kind.
Chen Zhenfeng, beside him, was also dumbfounded at the sight.
Damn!
So many big shots greeting one person simultaneously!
This scene isn’t easily encountered!
Initially here to drive Lin Dawei away, the spectacle left Chen Zhenfeng flustered, as Lin Dawei seemed not so simple after all. Just what identity could draw so many business elites to visit?
Chen Zhenfeng couldn’t help but say: "Everyone, I’m the deputy dean here, are you sure you are in the right room, are you certain you’re visiting him?"
He just couldn’t believe it, as Lin Dawei was merely a farmer from the countryside, here for an illness. He’s reviewed Lin Dawei’s medical records, confidently ascertaining Lin Dawei was nobody, definitely not likely to attract such business elite visits.
Upon hearing this, everyone exchanged glances. The deputy dean said this, could it be they actually made a mistake?
Lin Dawei said: "I was just about to transfer rooms, please let me pass."
Saying this, Lin Dawei picked up his shabby bag.
Chen Zhenfeng breathed a sigh of relief, appears these people truly made a mistake. Clearly, none of them recognized Lin Dawei, a misunderstanding is understandable.
"Everyone, please move aside and let him leave. If you’re looking for someone, I can help you find them." Chen Zhenfeng said.
Everyone duly stepped aside, allowing Lin Dawei to exit.
However, before Lin Dawei could leave, Lin Fan entered.
"Transfer rooms, why transfer?" Lin Fan asked coldly, glancing at Chen Zhenfeng, "Dean Chen, was this your idea?"
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Chen Zhenfeng’s mood soured. He intended to move Lin Dawei away while Lin Fan wasn’t present, but the sudden appearance of Lin Fan made things difficult.
Nevertheless, Chen Zhenfeng wasn’t afraid of Lin Fan being troublesome; he intended to drive them away regardless of today’s circumstances.
"Hehe, last time you had the dean backing you, I let it pass. Today I’m here to reclaim what’s yours, you ought to scram." Chen Zhenfeng sneered.
However, Chen Zhenfeng hadn’t finished speaking.
Seeing Lin Fan arrive, the gathered people promptly, respectfully greeted him.
"Mr. Lin!"
"Mr. Lin, We’ve specially come to visit Mr. Lin."
"We learned from you that Mr. Lin is hospitalized, and we are deeply concerned, so we came to visit voluntarily."
Lin Fan smiled: "Thank you all for your concern. You’ve been very thoughtful."
Someone asked: "Mr. Lin, is this Mr. Lin? The dean here said we’ve mistaken him."
Lin Fan replied: "You haven’t mistaken. This is indeed my uncle."
Chen Zhenfeng was bewildered; what the hell was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 311: Golden Card of the 100 Billion Club
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 311: Golden Card of the 100 Billion Club
The crowd breathed a sigh of relief and became cheerful again, glad that they hadn’t mistaken the person.
Lin Dawei looked like an old farmer, which didn’t really match the image of the invisible super-rich Lin Beixuan, so Chen Zhenfeng’s words made them doubt.
Now that Lin Fan had personally identified him, there was naturally no mistake.
Although Lin Dawei looked like a farmer, this just reflected his low profile, much like Lin Fan, who often dressed in street-market clothes, extremely low-key. Those who didn’t know, who could tell he was a billionaire?
It was confirmed that the person in front of him was indeed Lin Fan’s uncle.
Song Rongmao also stepped forward, cupping his hands towards Lin Dawei with a smile, "Hello Mr. Lin, let me introduce myself, I’m Song Rongmao, the Chairman of Yun City Chamber of Commerce. I’ve heard a lot about you, it’s an honor to finally meet you."
Song Rongmao proactively shook hands with Lin Dawei.
Lin Dawei was once again bewildered. Wasn’t this a mistake? Were they really here to see him? How was he deserving of such respect from them?
Lin Fan was also a bit bewildered. Did Song Rongmao just say he had long admired Third Uncle’s name?
"Elder Song is right, it’s a great honor for the junior to witness the style of Mr. Lin."
"Mr. Lin’s name resounds like thunder, we’ve all been looking forward to this day."
"Back then, Mr. Lin boldly spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor, and 6 billion on Chiba Island. The name of the mysterious tycoon resounded throughout Yun City. I longed to meet Mr. Lin someday!"
"I too was impressed by Mr. Lin’s grand gesture!"
The crowd followed Song Rongmao and showered Lin Dawei with flattery.
Lin Fan was stunned for a moment, then couldn’t help but laugh.
He finally understood why everyone was so enthusiastic about Lin Dawei. They had mistaken Lin Dawei for Lin Beixuan!
For a moment, Lin Fan wanted to laugh out loud. Lin Beixuan was a fictional character he created, a nonexistent person, and unexpectedly, Third Uncle was benefiting from it.
Lin Dawei continued to look bewildered, feeling that the world had gone crazy, with a crowd of strangers flattering him and saying things he couldn’t understand.
What thirty billion, sixty billion.
Mad, his entire worth was only 3000!
Lin Fan didn’t want to clarify; a misunderstanding was just a misunderstanding. It wasn’t a big deal, and clarifying might make everyone feel awkward.
To avoid embarrassment, Lin Fan said, "Thank you all for caring about my uncle, but my uncle’s health is poor and needs rest, so it’s inconvenient to host everyone. Please forgive us."
Everyone naturally understood Lin Fan’s meaning. Indeed, having so many people crowded here might not be good for a patient.
"Since Mr. Lin needs rest, then I won’t disturb him. I’ll visit Mr. Lin again next time."
"Mr. Lin, take care!"
"Wishing Mr. Lin a speedy recovery!"
"Mr. Lin, I’ll take my leave now."
The crowd exchanged polite words before leaving one after another.
Lin Fan seized the moment to turn his head toward Chen Zhenfeng and said coldly, "Dean Chen, what did you say before? You wanted to kick us out?"
Chen Zhenfeng was already drenched in sweat by now.
He had witnessed the entire process and couldn’t believe his eyes at all.
Was this for real?
These business tycoons showed such respect to Lin Fan, referring to him as Mr. Lin, and it was clear they all knew Lin Fan, so there was no question of mistaken identity!
Moreover, the elder standing next to Lin Fan was none other than the Chairman of Yun City Chamber of Commerce, Song Rongmao!
Then, the scene of everyone praising and groveling to Lin Dawei made Chen Zhenfeng break out in more cold sweat.
The person these tycoons were looking for really turned out to be Lin Dawei!
What? Lin Dawei spent 3 billion to buy Yunding Manor, and 6 billion to buy Chiba Island?
Lin Dawei is the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin who caused a sensation in Yun City?
Chen Zhenfeng’s face turned a bit pale. Is this Lin Fan the same Lin Fan from Mortal Group, whose market value just surpassed a trillion?
Song Rongmao’s expression darkened, "Dean Chen, isn’t it? Did you ask Mr. Lin to move rooms? You really have a lot of authority! Perhaps you don’t know yet, but Mr. Lin just became a member of our Trillion Club, holding a Golden Card, which grants him priority arrangements in medical care. Shall I ask Dean Zhou what’s going on?"
Chen Zhenfeng was startled.
The Trillion Club Golden Card!
That’s an extraordinary thing. Holding a Trillion Golden Card indeed allows one to walk unchallenged in this hospital; it’s one of the card’s privileges.
If Song Rongmao really asked Zhou Nanhua to intervene, Chen Zhenfeng would be in big trouble and might end up packing his bags and leaving at any moment.
Chen Zhenfeng hurriedly offered a flattering smile, "No need, Elder Song, it’s all a misunderstanding. I was mistaken!"
Song Rongmao responded with an "oh," "Really, you’re sure it was your mistake?"
Chen Zhenfeng replied, "I’m sure, absolutely sure! Mr. Lin, I’m truly sorry, it was my mistake, please be magnanimous and forgive me."
Chen Zhenfeng quickly nodded and bowed to Lin Dawei, apologizing like a dog wagging its tail in supplication.
Then he apologized to Lin Fan, "Mr. Lin, I offended you before, it was my fault, I promise it won’t happen again in the future. Please be forgiving and pardon me this time?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m reasonable, and since you realize your mistake, I won’t do anything extreme to you. I just have a small request."
Dealing with Chen Zhenfeng was a wave of a hand thing for Lin Fan.
But there’s no practical benefit to kicking Chen Zhenfeng out, so it’s better to have him do something useful.
Chen Zhenfeng quickly said, "Mr. Lin, please tell me?"
Lin Fan said, "My uncle’s illness can’t wait. Last time, Dean Zhou seemed to ask you to arrange a doctor. I hope you can do it soon."
Chen Zhenfeng breathed a sigh of relief, thinking Lin Fan might request something excessive, but it was just this request.
That’s very simple, he laughed, "No problem, I’ll immediately call our hospital’s best liver disease expert, Dr. Guo, over."
Chen Zhenfeng quickly took out his phone, planning to call the doctor over.
But just then, a chubby middle-aged doctor walked in from outside.
This middle-aged doctor saw Chen Zhenfeng there too, was a bit surprised, but didn’t say anything.
"I am Dr. Guo Yu," the middle-aged doctor introduced himself, seeming quite enthusiastic.
Lin Fan internally acknowledged, this Dr. Guo Yu was indeed the best liver disease expert here.
Unexpectedly, even before Chen Zhenfeng called, he himself came over.
"Dr. Guo, I heard you’re the best liver disease expert here, I’ll leave my uncle’s illness to you." Lin Fan chuckled.
Guo Yu replied, "Not really, I have limited skills, but I’ll do my best. How about you show me the test reports first?"
Lin Dawei found the test reports from his bag and handed them to Guo Yu.
Guo Yu seriously looked over them and said, "The report is somewhat incomplete, so I’ll write up a form for a comprehensive check-up, and once the report is out, contact me."
As he spoke, he wrote out a bunch of check-up forms.
Lin Fan furrowed his brow. Despite how Dr. Guo Yu seemed to be acting responsible, it looked like he was stalling them.
Lin Fan directly said, "Doctor, my uncle has recently had these tests, isn’t it a bit unnecessary?"
Guo Yu chuckled, "It’s necessary, listen to me, I’m the doctor; you can’t go wrong."
As he spoke, Guo Yu gave a wink to Chen Zhenfeng beside him.
Lin Fan internally laughed coldly. Hadn’t Chen Zhenfeng said that Guo Yu was his close friend? Could it be that Chen Zhenfeng wanted Guo Yu to give them a hard time?
"Dean Chen, is it appropriate for Dr. Guo to treat patients like this?" Lin Fan turned coldly to Chen Zhenfeng.
Chen Zhenfeng felt like crying. He had indeed hinted to Guo Yu to intentionally make things difficult for Lin Fan and them.
Who knew the situation would change, and before he had time to inform Guo Yu, Guo Yu himself came over.
Slap!
Chen Zhenfeng swung around and gave Guo Yu a slap, cursing, "You fool, who told you to see patients this way? Mr. Lin’s illness can’t be delayed, stop wasting time, and quickly treat him!"
Guo Yu’s half face turned red, utterly puzzled. Wasn’t it you who asked me to give them a hard time!

chapters.title: Chapter 312: If he is a farmer, then we are beggars.
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 312: If he is a farmer, then we are beggars.
Guo Yu was puzzled. Wasn’t it Chen Zhenfeng who asked him to deliberately make things difficult for Lin Dawei? He did as Chen Zhenfeng said, so why did Chen Zhenfeng slap him instead?
But when Chen Zhenfeng asked him to do something, he didn’t dare not do it.
Guo Yu had no choice but to put on a forced smile and say, "I just wanted to be a bit thorough with the examination, but the current report is actually sufficient."
Chen Zhenfeng said sternly, "Dr. Guo, you must examine Mr. Lin carefully, don’t hold anything back, and do your best to cure Mr. Lin!"
Guo Yu wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said, "I understand."
Afterward, Guo Yu attended to Lin Dawei, prescribed him medication, and dared not hold anything back, offering the best treatment plan.
"Mr. Lin, you need to make sure to get plenty of rest and take your medication on time. I’ll come back to see you tomorrow." Guo Yu advised before taking his leave.
"Mr. Lin, Mr. Lin, if there’s nothing else, I’ll also take my leave." Chen Zhenfeng said with a sheepish smile.
Chen Zhenfeng and Guo Yu walked outside.
Guo Yu, with a silent swollen face, said gloomily, "Old Chen, what exactly is going on? Didn’t you tell me to make things difficult for them?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "I meant to notify you in advance, but who knew you’d come over on your own before I had the chance. These people, we can’t afford to provoke them!"
Guo Yu asked curiously, "Can’t afford to provoke them? Aren’t they from the countryside?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "That’s what I thought too... until just now. Do you know who that other old man was?"
Guo Yu recalled that besides Lin Fan and Lin Dawei, there was another person in the ward.
"I don’t know." Guo Yu shook his head.
Chen Zhenfeng said, "That man is Song Rongmao, the president of the Yun City Chamber of Commerce!"
Guo Yu was taken aback, "The Chamber of Commerce President! Why would he be here?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "That’s not all. If you had arrived earlier, you would have seen many elite leaders from the Yun City business community coming to visit this Lin Dawei."
Guo Yu was even more surprised, "What? So impressive? I heard from a colleague earlier that a bunch of big shots from the business world came to the hospital today to visit a patient, but I thought it was a joke. Turns out it was true?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "It’s absolutely true, I witnessed it myself.
Guo Yu asked in surprise, "Why would so many big shots come to visit him? Isn’t he just a farmer?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "If he’s just a farmer, then we are beggars."
"So impressive, who is he really?" Guo Yu asked.
Chen Zhenfeng said, "Have you heard of Lin Beixuan?"
Guo Yu thought for a moment, "Lin Beixuan? I know, the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin, who’s been quite the sensation in Yun City recently, is named Lin Beixuan."
Chen Zhenfeng said mysteriously, "This Lin Dawei is Lin Beixuan."
"What?"
Guo Yu was utterly shocked, "He’s Lin Beixuan? How is that possible? Old Chen, are you joking?"
Chen Zhenfeng said, "It’s absolutely true. Besides Lin Beixuan, who else could have so many big shots come to visit? Who else could have the Chamber of Commerce President accompany them?"
Guo Yu was extremely startled and suddenly thought of something. His voice trembled as he said, "If that’s the case, then that young man is the young wealthy tycoon Lin Fan?"
Chen Zhenfeng replied, "Yes, Lin Fan’s company has already surpassed a market value of one trillion today, joining the Trillion-Club and owning a Trillion-Club Golden Card. Tell me, can we afford to provoke them?"
Guo Yu broke into a cold sweat and repeatedly said, "We absolutely can’t, absolutely can’t."
The Trillion-Club Golden Card grants priority medical treatment in this hospital, enjoying the best medical services, even the hospital director bows down to them!
No way around it, the Trillion-Club consists entirely of big shots with companies valued at over a trillion!
It’s said that the Trillion-Club has an agreement with the Health Department, where the Trillion-Club invests a huge sum annually as a medical fund.
One could say that the Trillion-Club is the hospital’s financial backer.
As financial backers, receiving the best services is only fair.
Offending a member of the Trillion-Club is tantamount to offending the hospital’s financial backer, jeopardizing your own job, and possibly facing industry-wide banishment in minutes.
No doctor in their right mind would dare do such a thing.
Thinking of this, Guo Yu felt a bit lucky. Luckily, Chen Zhenfeng stopped him, and he ceased making things difficult for Lin Fan, or the consequences would be unimaginable.
Thinking about it made Guo Yu break out in a cold sweat: "Old Chen, thank you for that slap."
Chen Zhenfeng felt bitter within. His slap helped Guo Yu avoid a disaster, but now he was in a precarious position himself. Having offended Lin Fan, thinking of this made Chen Zhenfeng regret it to his core.
In the VIP suite.
After Song Rongmao finished greeting Lin Dawei, he also took his leave.
The room was left with Lin Fan, Lin Dawei, and Zhao Jiayi.
Lin Dawei couldn’t hold back any longer, "Little Fan, what exactly is going on? Why did so many people come to visit me today, and they all claimed to be presidents and such, like they’re all big bosses?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yeah, they’re all my friends."
Lin Dawei asked, "How do you have so many big bosses as friends?"
Lin Fan replied, "Well... it seems I can’t hide it anymore. Alright, I’ll come clean. Third Uncle, actually, I’m doing business, and they’re all business friends."
Lin Dawei was pleasantly surprised, "What, Little Fan, you’re doing business? Why didn’t you say so earlier? I thought you were a delivery guy."
Lin Fan said, "I didn’t want Third Uncle to worry, so I didn’t tell you. I was planning to tell the family once I made it bigger."
Lin Dawei laughed, "Little Fan, you shouldn’t do that. Third Uncle has always had faith in you. You’re the first university student in our Lin family, sharp and clever since childhood. Whatever business you’re doing, Third Uncle will absolutely support you. By the way, Little Fan, what kind of business are you doing? Is it big?"
Lin Fan said, "Related to transportation, small scale I guess."
On the side, Zhao Jiayi broke into a cold sweat. Celestial Aviation had already surpassed a trillion, creating a miracle in private aviation. If that’s small scale, what is considered large scale?
Actually, Lin Fan didn’t want to scare the elderly and chose to keep it low-key.
Lin Dawei said, "Transportation? Could it be selling electric bikes? Not bad, rural folks love buying electric bikes these days, almost every household buys them, lots of potential."
Lin Fan sweat-dropped, Third Uncle’s guess was a bit off the mark, but he didn’t correct him.
Lin Dawei then praised, "Little Fan, you’ve just started the business and already made so many big boss friends, that’s impressive. Keep up the good work, Third Uncle believes in you."
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you, Third Uncle."
At this time, Lin Fan received a call from Zhang Jing, the chairman of Huaxin.
Lin Fan hung up; he didn’t want to be disturbed by the call while talking to Third Uncle.
But just after he hung up, Zhang Jing called again.
Lin Dawei said, "Little Fan, is it a business call? Don’t worry about me, business comes first."
Lin Fan had no choice but to say, "Okay, I’ll step out to take it."
Lin Fan walked outside the room and answered the call from Zhang Jing.
Zhang Jing said, "Mr. Lin, today at the Yun City business conference, you revealed our collaboration with Zhongwei and that we have the world’s leading 5nm chip technology. There are now a lot of reactions externally, many of them skeptical. Chairman Xu from Zhongwei just talked to me on the phone about how to handle this situation. Mr. Lin, do you have any suggestions?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s not a secret we can’t talk about. Since there are doubts from outside, dispel them. Everyone should issue a statement in response. By the way, Huaxin and Mortal should issue a joint statement."
Zhang Jing said, "Got it, I understand. I’ll handle it right away."
Soon after, Zhongwei’s statement, along with the joint statement from Huaxin and Mortal, was released, trending widely.
It shocked the entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: 200 Billion! The Unprecedented Richest Man in Yun City is Born
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 313: 200 Billion! The Unprecedented Richest Man in Yun City is Born
On the second trading day, the market value of Zhongwei, Huaxin, and Mortal Group soared.
Especially Mortal Group, which actually possessed the core 5nm technology, saw its market value skyrocket from 100 billion to over 200 billion in just one day!
