Yun City witnessed the birth of its first company with a market value of 200 billion!
It surpassed Yida Mall, which had a market value of 180 billion, and Lin Fan replaced Wang Hailin, becoming the richest man in Yun City in one leap!
The entire city was in an uproar.
From Lin Fan’s rise to becoming the richest man in Yun City, it had taken less than half a month.
Truly a miracle among miracles.
The reactions from all sides were quite interesting.
The majority of Yun City’s citizens were in admiration, practically bowing to Lin Fan.
Most people in the business world were also bowing; thinking of how they were just trying to connect with Lin Fan yesterday, they felt they had great foresight. It’s best to flatter early; Mortal Group is going to become more awesome, and in the future, they might not even have the chance to curry favor anymore.
The president of the business association, Song Rongmao, was especially pleased, even a bit proud. He had invited Lin Fan to join the Billion Club without hesitation yesterday because he was optimistic about Lin Fan; his insight has always been good.
The head of Zhongtong Express, He Chao, was also exceptionally excited.
For good reason; He Chao, as an experienced stock investor, had invested in Celestial Aviation early because he saw its potential, and today he made a fortune.
His personal assets skyrocketed!
Some were happy, while others were troubled.
Wang Hailin was almost fainted when he learned that Mortal’s market value had exceeded 200 billion.
He had made a bet with He Chao yesterday, refusing to listen to He Chao’s advice and choosing to wait because he was worried that Mortal Group was just a bubble, so he hadn’t invested in Mortal.
As a result, the company’s market value skyrocketed by 100 billion in just one day!
If he had bought it in advance, he would have made a fortune.
However, he didn’t.
His profit was zero; it had nothing to do with him.
Wang Hailin regretted so much that it turned his intestines green. As a big shot in the billion club, he was hitting his chest in front of the company employees, who were scared, thinking the company was going bankrupt.
The worst was yet to come; Wang Hailin didn’t make any money, while He Chao did.
Although the outside world was unaware, Wang Hailin knew clearly that after being replaced by Lin Fan as the richest man, it was likely that he would also be surpassed by He Chao for the second position...
Wang Hailin wasn’t the most pitiful person.
At least among Yun City’s three billion club members, another person was worse off—Feng Wanshan.
Upon hearing that Mortal Group’s market value had exceeded 200 billion and Lin Fan had become Yun City’s richest man, Feng Wanshan spat three mouthfuls of blood and almost fainted.
This blow was so severe; he hadn’t even figured out how to counter Mortal Group, yet their market value had reached 200 billion!
What could he do now?
There was no playing field left; Lin Fan was so formidable, leaving him no room to survive.
For a company reaching a size of 200 billion, the difficulty of counteraction compared to 100 billion increased geometrically.
To make matters worse, Feng Wanshan faced another blow today.
Due to previous scandals, Shengshi Group’s stock market hadn’t been doing well recently, and today it hit a new low, falling below 100 billion!
This was truly a heavy blow, like cutting flesh.
Feng Wanshan was nearly driven to madness.
Shortly after, Feng Wanshan received a warning from the Billion Club; Shengshi Group’s market value had fallen below 100 billion. Feng Wanshan entered the observation period, and if he couldn’t bring Shengshi Group’s market value back above 100 billion during this period, he would be kicked out of the Billion Club!
Feng Wanshan immediately fell into anxiety.
He no longer had the time or energy to counter Mortal Group; he needed to urgently raise Shengshi Group’s market value.
On this day, as Mortal Group created a miraculous rise in the stock market, the three billionaires of Yun City changed hands within a day.
Lin Fan, as the newly joined billionaire, leaped to become the new richest man in Yun City. The original richest man Wang Hailin fell to third, and He Chao, having surpassed Wang Hailin, remained second.
Feng Wanshan was out.
This was practically a major reshuffling, which Yun City’s business world hadn’t seen in a long time; the entire business world was discussing this event.
As Yun City suddenly rose to prominence with a 200 billion company, Lin Fan’s name was noticed by a significant figure for the first time.
The richest man in Jiangnan, Wei Tiansheng, CEO of Wangu Group!
Wangu Group, a large company with a market value of 350 billion.
As the richest man in Jiangnan, Wei Tiansheng always had his eyes on the domestic market, intending to take it further. He didn’t care much for Yun City’s business world.
This time was different; the name Lin Fan caught Wei Tiansheng’s attention.
In Jiangnan’s capital, South City.
A super skyscraper rose from the ground, the Wangu Mansion.
At the top floor.
Wei Tiansheng sat in his spacious office, his gaze fixed on his phone’s screen, where a handsome face was displayed.
His eyes showed a hint of surprise, a bit of curiosity, as he muttered, "Lin Fan... just 21 years old... there’s such a figure in Yun City?"
Meanwhile.
In a village within Yun City, inside a modest apartment building.
"Achoo!"
Lin Fan had just woken up from his sleep, sneezed, and instantly became alert.
"Who’s thinking about me?" Lin Fan murmured as he got up.
These past two days, he was exhausted.
After visiting Lin Dawei in the hospital yesterday, Lin Fan left and busied himself with company matters, finishing very late. Too tired to go back to Yunding Manor, he stayed at this small apartment for the night.
Upon waking, Lin Fan found his phone exploding with numerous calls and messages.
Checking, it turned out the market value of Celestial Aviation had surpassed 200 billion!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but rejoice and checked the task progress.
"Main Task: Build a trillion-dollar group
Task Level: Important
Task Progress: 20/100"
Not bad, this progress is quite good. At this rate, it shouldn’t take long to complete the main task.
At this moment, a call came in from his sister, Feng Ruolan.
Lin Fan answered.
"Little Fan, what’s that saying... ’missing you is different every three days’? It’s so true. I’ve been away on business for the past few days, and I didn’t expect your company’s market value to exceed 200 billion. You’re now Yun City’s richest man; congratulations," Feng Ruolan said with a smile.
Due to a business trip, she hadn’t attended the recent business conference. It was only upon her return today that she realized Lin Fan had stolen the show at the conference.
Lin Fan replied with a smile, "Thank you, sister. Have you returned to Yun City?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "Yes, I’m back. So, what about it, now that you’re Yun City’s richest man, do you have time for lunch with me?"
Lin Fan checked the time; it was about lunchtime. He said, "Sure, where are you? I’ll pick you up."
Feng Ruolan said, "I’m at the company; come over."
Longheng Group.
Lin Fan drove his Rolls-Royce to the building of Longheng Company.
Feng Ruolan was already waiting for him downstairs and immediately got into his car, sitting in the passenger seat.
Every time Lin Fan saw Feng Ruolan, his heart couldn’t help but race. The richest sister was so beautiful, it was not an exaggeration to describe her as a national beauty.
"Sister, where should we have lunch?" Lin Fan asked.
Feng Ruolan said, "A good friend of mine recently opened a specialty restaurant; she’s been telling me the food is great. Why don’t we give it a try?"
The mention of her good friend reminded Lin Fan of Feng Tolan’s scheming friend Fan Xiaoxue, and he felt a bit wary of good friends.
However, Lin Fan didn’t want to spoil the mood, so he said, "Sure."
Their destination was a restaurant with quite a unique architectural style on the street.
Lin Fan parked the car on the street side, and he and Feng Ruolan headed towards the restaurant. However, as they approached the entrance, they heard a commotion.
A group of people had gathered there, seemingly involved in some dispute.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Encountering Strange Things on the Road, Compensation of 5,000 Yuan All in 1 Cent Coins
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 314: Encountering Strange Things on the Road, Compensation of 5,000 Yuan All in 1 Cent Coins
At the entrance of a specialty restaurant, a crowd of onlookers had gathered to watch a commotion, as a dispute was unfolding between two women.
One woman was dressed as a server, presumably an employee of the restaurant, while the other, in her thirties with a fierce expression, looked like an aggressive type.
"I’ve brought the money, a full 5000 yuan, stop dawdling and take it!" the fierce-looking woman urged.
The waitress frowned, "How am I supposed to accept this?"
Before her, a metal bucket was filled to the brim with coins, all in 1-cent denominations.
The fierce-looking woman said, "What’s the problem? Isn’t this money? As long as it’s money, it’s okay!"
The waitress was a bit agitated, "But these are all one-cent coins, how am I supposed to accept this, and I don’t even know if it adds up!"
The fierce-looking woman chuckled, "I told you, it’s a full 5000 yuan, not a single jiao short. If you don’t believe me, count it yourself."
The waitress was a bit overwhelmed, "So many coins, how am I supposed to count them? Are you crazy? Couldn’t you just transfer the money to me, or use hundred-yuan bills? These are all one-cent coins, how am I supposed to count them all? You’re clearly mocking me; doing this is so trivial, so shameless, don’t you know?"
The fierce-looking woman sneered, "The judge didn’t specify how to pay; I can pay however I want. Whether you accept it or not is your problem!"
The two of them quarreled endlessly, neither willing to back down.
A tall, beautiful woman emerged from the shop, saying, "Stop arguing; you’re arguing at the entrance of my restaurant, how can I keep doing business?"
The waitress saw the woman and quickly said, "Sorry, boss, I didn’t want to argue, but they’re really bullying me."
The beautiful woman glanced at the bucket of coins, frowned, and looked at the fierce-looking woman, "Hello, I’m Ah-Ying’s boss, my surname is Ye. May I know your surname, Miss?"
The fierce-looking woman replied, "Surname is Xie, Miss Ye, you’re here just in time. Please advise your employee that I’ve brought the money and ask her to quickly count it. I have to go back and shouldn’t waste each other’s time, so as not to affect your business."
The beautiful woman said, "May I know what position Miss Xie holds in your company?"
The fierce-looking woman said, "I’m in finance."
The beautiful woman said, "I’m well aware of Ah-Ying’s situation; what you’re doing is indeed a bit excessive, Miss Xie. I hope you can discuss this with your boss, and not make things difficult for Ah-Ying. Ah-Ying is now my employee, so please do me this favor."
The fierce-looking woman chuckled, "No need, we’ve spent so much effort, ran all around Yun City’s banks, gathering these coins, specifically for her."
Upon hearing this, the waitress Ah-Ying was nearly brought to tears with anger, "Is this really necessary? It’s so humiliating!"
The fierce-looking woman said, "If you’re not kind, don’t blame us for being unrighteous!"
The two of them pointed at each other’s noses and started arguing again.
The beautiful woman shook her head with a wry smile, truly at a loss with them.
Suddenly, the beautiful woman noticed something, her eyes lit up, and she hurried over to see Feng Ruolan and Lin Fan were coming over.
"Sister, how come you didn’t tell me you were coming?" The beautiful woman ran over to Feng Ruolan, hugged her tightly, very happy.
Feng Ruolan laughed, "Isn’t this to surprise you? You always invite me over and I’ve been too busy, today I’m here to finally give it a try."
The beautiful woman said, "I’m so happy you’re here."
She noticed Lin Fan, who was beside Feng Ruolan, and curiously asked, "Sister, who is this... could it be...?"
The beautiful woman gave an ambiguous smile.
She guessed that Lin Fan was Feng Ruolan’s boyfriend.
Feng Ruolan quickly said, "Don’t overthink it, it’s not what you think. Let me introduce you, Ye Qingmei, the eldest lady of the Ye Family in Yun City, my good sister, and Lin Fan, my godbrother; you can call him Little Fan."
The beautiful woman eyed him, blinking her pretty big eyes, "Godbother? I get it."
She chuckled softly; the Lin Fan in front of her was handsome but dressed quite plainly, evidently not a rich person. Feng Ruolan was the wealthiest woman in Yun City; how could she have such a godbrother? Probably the godbrother thing was a ruse...
Feng Ruolan knew she still misunderstood, but did not explain further.
Ye Qingmei shook hands with Lin Fan, smiling sweetly, "Hello Little Fan, you’re quite handsome."
Lin Fan smiled, "Sister Ye, you’re also very beautiful."
Ye Qingmei couldn’t help but laugh softly; although Lin Fan was poor, he had a clever tongue, which no doubt delighted Feng Ruolan.
At this point, the argument at the entrance grew even more intense.
Feng Ruolan curiously asked, "What’s happening?"
Ye Qingmei said, "It’s one of my female employees, in a dispute with her former company. The company unjustly fired her but refused to compensate her. She took it to court, and recently the court ruled that the company should compensate her 5000 yuan. Today, she arranged to receive the money, but the company brought a bucket of coins, all in one-cent denominations, for her to accept, which she refuses, so they’re arguing."
Feng Ruolan sweated, "This company is quite overboard, the boss is just too petty, clearly picking a fight, and intentionally making things difficult!"
The waitress and the fierce-looking woman argued ceaselessly.
The waitress refused to accept the coins, feeling humiliated.
The fierce-looking woman wouldn’t back down either.
"Let me ask you one last time, will you take it or not? If not, I’ll consider it as you voluntarily forgoing this compensation!" The fierce-looking woman chuckled sinisterly.
The waitress cried out in anger, "You all are too shameless!"
The fierce-looking woman said, "Shameless? I wonder who’s shameless here, you couldn’t perform your job well, got fired by the company, and still had the face to sue the company for compensation. Alright, since the court ruled for compensation, we’re compensating you; now, why are you refusing it, have a bit of dignity!"
The waitress said, "The court mandated compensation, but it didn’t tell you to compensate with coins!"
The fierce-looking woman said, "The court didn’t say we can’t use coins, either. We’ll pay however we want, dare you say coins aren’t money?"
The waitress was momentarily at a loss for words.
The fierce-looking woman grew smug, "No more to say, huh? Since coins are also money, you can only accept them. If you refuse, it’s considered abandoning the claim."
The waitress said angrily, "I didn’t say coins aren’t money, but what you’re doing is disgustingly mean, is it really necessary!"
The fierce-looking woman said, "We are doing it to disgust you, so what?"
The surrounding onlookers started chattering.
"Using one-cent coins, that’s indeed a bit too much!"
"If this isn’t humiliation, then what is?"
"What kind of company is this, bullying people like that!"
"What era is this, and still such bizarre companies, oppressing employees!"
"However, she seems to have no choice but to accept it, right?"
Everyone sympathized with the waitress’s plight, but seemed to have no good way to deal with this shameless company. After all, they did compensate, although in one-cent coins, the court didn’t specify that these coins couldn’t be used for compensation.
This situation was indeed tricky.
Someone suggested a lousy idea, "Why not do this, take it to the bank and ask the teller to count it, wouldn’t that sort it out?"
This idea was immediately ridiculed, "Don’t do that; just thinking about it gives me a headache; what did the bank tellers do wrong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 315: You Can Start Counting Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 315: You Can Start Counting Now
In a moment of difficulty.
"Little Ying? Is it really you!"
Suddenly, a voice came from the side, and Lin Fan appeared.
The waitress was taken aback and then said happily, "Brother Fan, it’s you. What are you doing here?"
Lin Fan replied, "I was just planning to come here for a meal. What a coincidence."
Lin Fan recognized this waitress; it turned out to be Huang Xiaoying from his neighboring village. They had attended elementary school together. Although they didn’t keep in touch regularly, they gathered with other childhood classmates during festivals.
Huang Xiaoying said, "Brother Fan, I’m so happy to see you. You go in and sit for a while. I have something to handle here, I’ll come find you in a bit."
Lin Fan asked, "Need any help?"
Huang Xiaoying sighed, "I’m afraid even you can’t help this time."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What’s the name of this company?"
Huang Xiaoying replied, "It’s called Linglong Fitness Center. I worked there before, but was later fired. I went to ask for compensation, and they gave me these coins."
Lin Fan nodded, took out his phone, and searched for Linglong Fitness. He wanted to see the company’s connection network and check if there was a way to deal with them.
As a result of his search, Lin Fan laughed.
"This Linglong Fitness is in Chunxi Old District, right?" Lin Fan asked.
Huang Xiaoying responded, "Yes, that’s the one."
Chunxi Old District was precisely the street where Lin Fan and Su Jinjin had dinner the night before. That district had already been rewarded to Lin Fan.
The entire district belonged to Lin Fan, which meant Lin Fan was the landlord of Linglong Fitness!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Little Ying, it seems there’s no better way. You should just accept these coins."
Huang Xiaoying felt a chill and couldn’t help but sweat a bit, thinking Lin Fan might have a way to help her, but instead asked her to accept the coins?
"But they are insulting me too much. I can’t accept their disgusting behavior!" Huang Xiaoying said indignantly.
Lin Fan comforted her, "Don’t worry, let me handle it."
Lin Fan looked at the woman with a surly face and said, "You’re the finance officer at Linglong Fitness, right? Are you sure you want to use these coins for compensation, no other method?"
The surly-faced woman replied, "That’s right, we only have this! Handsome guy, I see you’re sensible; don’t waste time and advise her to accept it."
Lin Fan nodded and said, "Understood. I represent her in agreeing to your payment method, and we can accept these coins. But first, make sure these coins are counted accurately."
The surly-faced woman laughed, "Smart guy, unlike some people. Now that you’ve agreed, it’s easy. Here are 50,000 coins, exactly 5,000 yuan. If you’re afraid it’s not enough, feel free to count."
Huang Xiaoying exclaimed, "What kind of joke is this, 50 thousand coins? How do you expect us to count them, isn’t this a deliberate hassle!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Counting 50 thousand coins sure takes time, do you have the time?"
The surly-faced woman chuckled, "Our boss told me that today I only have this task, plenty of time to play with you, take your time counting, I’m waiting."
Huang Xiaoying was furious; this wicked woman was shameless, she wanted to strangle her but couldn’t resort to violence and was left with anger.
Lin Fan wasn’t angry at all; he glanced at the iron bucket and said, "I roughly checked, and based on my judgment, it’s not worth 5,000 yuan, so we can’t accept it. You need to prove to us these coins indeed amount to 5,000 yuan before we accept them."
The surly-faced woman was taken aback, "How do I prove it?"
Lin Fan said, "You can count them in front of us, as long as there are 50,000, we’ll accept it."
The surly-faced woman laughed in anger, "Damn... I asked you to count, and now you’re asking me to count instead?"
The people around couldn’t help but laugh at the witty move.
Huang Xiaoying understood and couldn’t help but laugh, "Brother Fan, you’re really something. That’s right, these coins don’t add up, I can’t sign for them!"
The surly-faced woman’s face twitched, "We’ve already counted the money, not a penny more, not a penny less, exactly 5,000 yuan. If you don’t believe it, count it yourself!"
Huang Xiaoying: "..."
Lin Fan said, "I just counted, and it’s not enough. You said you counted earlier, but we’ve not seen it; who knows if you’re lying. You need to show us the proof, so you need to count it in front of us now."
The crowd burst into laughter.
"The young man is right; the responsibility to prove is on them. They need to provide reliable proof!"
"The young man’s counterattack was brilliant!"
"Awesome!"
"Respect to the young man."
The surly-faced woman was a bit confused; damn, can you play it like this!
Now, evidently, she was in the wrong; they said it wasn’t enough, so naturally, they couldn’t sign for it. This reason was indisputable, so she needed to provide proof.
She didn’t want to suffer such a loss, so she quickly took out her phone and called her boss for advice.
The boss of Linglong Fitness picked up the phone.
Upon hearing finance’s narrative, the boss furrowed his brows, snorted coldly, and said, "Prove what? Just tell them it’s sufficient, if they don’t believe it, either they count themselves or consider it as forfeiting!"
Following instructions, the surly-faced woman said, "My boss says it’s exactly 5,000 yuan; believe it or not, if you believe it, take it; if not, forget it, we’ll consider you’ve voluntarily given up the compensation and take these coins back."
The other party resorted to being unreasonable.
It seemed that Lin Fan’s approach couldn’t deal with them either.
Huang Xiaoying was a bit anxious; she really wanted to rush over and beat them a bit. Now, there’s truly no way to vent other than beating them.
But then Lin Fan picked up his phone and dialed a number.
At Chunxi Old District, in the Linglong Fitness Center office, the boss of Linglong Fitness had just finished a call with finance.
He was a bald middle-aged man, his face stern, and sneered, "Little wench daring to ask me for compensation, see how I won’t make life hard for you this time!"
He was quite pleased with himself, feeling exceptionally clever in his actions to disgust Huang Xiaoying using coins.
He wasn’t unable to pay the 5,000 yuan; he was simply annoyed by Huang Xiaoying’s complaint. A little wench not willing to accept his oppression and exploitation dared to file a complaint against him; he was out for revenge!
Ring... ring...
Suddenly, the phone on the desk rang.
The boss looked at it and his expression changed, seeing the caller ID: Mr. Lin!
The people in this district knew it belonged to Lin Fan; Mr. Lin was their landlord, and the boss of Linglong Fitness had, through connections, obtained Lin Fan’s phone number and saved it.
Now Lin Fan was actually calling him, he almost thought he was mistaken, but indeed it was Lin Fan calling him!
Not knowing what it was about, the boss wiped the sweat off his brow and answered the call, "Mr. Lin, are you Mr. Lin Fan?"
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment, somewhat surprised, "I’m Lin Fan, you have my phone?"
The boss chuckled awkwardly, "I got it through a friend’s connection. Mr. Lin, why are you calling me?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m right by Huang Xiaoying, she’s my old acquaintance."
The boss was shocked, his face changed. What? Huang Xiaoying is Lin Fan’s old acquaintance?

chapters.title: Chapter 316: This Person Cannot Be Offended
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 316: This Person Cannot Be Offended
Lin Fan, the newly risen young tycoon of Yun City, today saw the market value of his Mortal Group surpass 200 billion, making him the new richest man in Yun City!
This news had already shaken the Yun City business world, and anyone remotely interested in this field would not miss it.
Old Gou, the owner of Linglong Fitness Center, was no exception.
Upon hearing that Lin Fan bought the old district, Old Gou was eager to meet Lin Fan, as it would be wonderful to cozy up to such a tycoon.
So, Old Gou asked around and finally got Lin Fan’s phone number through a friend, and saved it.
Today, upon learning Lin Fan had become the new richest man in Yun City, Old Gou was even more eager to curry favor with him, but he was at a loss for opportunity. After all, he was just a small fitness center owner, and reaching Lin Fan seemed beyond his grasp.
What Old Gou could never have imagined was that when he was fretting over not having the chance to meet Lin Fan, Lin Fan proactively called him!
Old Gou instantly got nervous: "Mr. Lin, why are you calling me?"
Lin Fan said directly, "I’m right next to Huang Xiaoying; she’s my hometown friend."
Old Gou was shocked, as he knew what was happening with Huang Xiaoying—it was he who instructed the finance team to take a bucket of coins to her.
He did it to deliberately disgust Huang Xiaoying.
Now Lin Fan was calling about this matter, obviously to hold him accountable.
"Mr. Lin, I don’t quite understand what you mean?" Old Gou pretended to be confused.
Lin Fan chuckled, "What I mean is that your store’s rent will double from this month on; does that make sense to you?"
Cold sweat poured from Old Gou, damn, that’s ruthless!
Old Gou hurriedly said, "Mr. Lin, let me explain. I was just momentarily angry about Xiaoying’s issue. If she finds the coins inconvenient, I can transfer the money to her immediately."
Lin Fan smiled, "No need, I think coins are quite fine, but I now need your staff to prove that the coins add up, although she doesn’t seem quite cooperative."
Old Gou wiped his cold sweat and quickly said, "I understand, I’ll call her right away."
"That’s good." Lin Fan hung up the phone.
The woman with a face full of fat impatiently said, "Are you going to accept them or not? If not, I’ll assume you’ve given up and take these coins away!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Of course we’ll accept, but you need to prove that these coins add up first."
The woman with a face full of fat snorted, "Boy, do you really expect me to count them in front of you? You’re dreaming too much!"
Just then, the woman’s phone suddenly rang.
Seeing it was a call from her boss, Old Gou, she quickly answered it, "Boss?"
Old Gou said, "Little Xie, are they asking you to count the coins? Just count them for them."
The woman with a face full of fat hesitated, "So many coins, how am I supposed to count them?"
Old Gou scolded, "Just count them as you’re told, no nonsense. Do you not want to work anymore? Let me remind you, this time we’ve hit a snag. Do whatever they say. If you upset him, I’ll hold you responsible!"
Now he feared offending Lin Fan, knowing if Lin Fan decided to double his store’s rent, the store wouldn’t survive—it would either have to relocate or shut down. Even relocating would be a hassle, incurring significant costs, meaning it might be better to close down straight away.
The woman with a face full of fat curiously asked, "What snag did we hit?"
Old Gou said, "I can’t explain it to you now, just don’t offend anyone, or I won’t let you off!"
The woman with a face full of fat oh-ed, swallowing her anger.
Old Gou then hung up the phone.
Reluctantly, the woman with a face full of fat walked over to the bucket of coins, squatted down, and said, "I’ll count them for you, look carefully!"
She began counting, picking out the coins one by one, and soon there was a pile of coins at her feet.
Everyone looked at each other, puzzled—why was this woman willing to count the coins after receiving a phone call?
"101, 102..."
The woman had just reached 100 coins.
"Wait!" Lin Fan suddenly interrupted her.
The woman annoyedly said, "What? I’m counting, aren’t I!"
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, I got distracted just now and wasn’t watching you, nor do I know if you counted wrong. How about you start over again?"
"What?" The woman with a face full of fat was furious, she had painstakingly counted to 100, and Lin Fan wanted her to start over!
But remembering her boss’s warning, she dared not confront Lin Fan, suppressing her anger, she said, "Alright, I’ll start over, please make sure to watch carefully this time!"
The woman with a face full of fat put all the coins back into the iron bucket, starting again from the beginning.
Everyone was intrigued—why was the woman willing to start over again? How did she suddenly become so agreeable? It was strange indeed.
Huang Xiaoying was also curious, knowing better than anyone how much of a shrew this woman was, and yet this shrew was now yielding. Something was definitely odd.
Huang Xiaoying looked at Lin Fan, curious about how he managed to make this shrew submit?
With time ticking by, everyone watched as the woman counted the coins.
"999, 1000..."
The woman finally managed to count to 1000 coins, completely exhausted, her back and waist aching, her legs numb from squatting, and had to sit on the ground, filled with resentment—damn, this time she came to play a trick on someone, and ended up being played instead.
Lin Fan yawned at this moment and said, "Xiaoying, keep an eye here, I’m going to the bathroom. Make sure to watch closely."
Huang Xiaoying nodded, assuring she wouldn’t miss a thing.
Lin Fan turned to Ye Qingmei and said, "Sister Ye, can I use the bathroom?"
Ye Qingmei smiled, "Of course you can, go straight on the left."
"Thank you." Lin Fan walked into the store.
Ye Qingmei giggled to Feng Ruolan, "Sister, your little brother is quite interesting. I’m curious about how she handled that woman."
Feng Ruolan was also curious about how Lin Fan handled it. Did he just make a call?
A while later.
Lin Fan returned from the bathroom.
The woman with a face full of fat was still diligently counting, "1120, 1121..."
Lin Fan frowned and said, "Wait a minute!"
The woman with a face full of fat paused, "Now what?"
Lin Fan smiled, "All I did was go take a leak and you’re already at over 1100? Could you have counted wrong?"
The woman was furious, "Huang Xiaoying has been watching the whole time, I couldn’t have counted wrong!"
Lin Fan said, "Xiaoying, maybe you got distracted. If you let her count an extra one, you’ll lose out."
As he spoke, Lin Fan winked at Huang Xiaoying.
Huang Xiaoying, catching on and amused, said, "I think I really did get distracted for a moment."
Lin Fan slapped his thigh, "I knew it. See, I went to the bathroom and Xiaoying got distracted. This count can’t be trusted. How about you start over again?"
"What?" The woman with a face full of fat nearly collapsed, damn it, she had to start all over again!

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Sister, who exactly is this brother of yours?
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 317: Sister, who exactly is this brother of yours?
The people around couldn’t help but snicker.
"Damn, that’s brutal!"
"If I’m not mistaken, this was on purpose, right?"
"Serves her right, that’s karma for doing something so unethical!"
"This guy’s trick is just perfect, I love it!"
At this moment, Huang Xiaoying also realized that Lin Fan was deliberately making things difficult for the woman, returning the favor in kind. Watching the woman’s breakdown, Huang Xiaoying felt ecstatic inside.
Earlier, she felt insulted and furious when the woman compensated her with coins. But now she wasn’t angry at all, as the person who caused the trouble brought it upon herself. She was more than happy to watch her misfortune.
The woman with a face full of flesh was almost in tears, saying, "I won’t count anymore, you’re clearly making it difficult on purpose!"
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh": "You know about making things difficult on purpose, huh? Then why did you deliberately make it difficult for Little Ying with these coins?"
Woman: "..."
Speechless.
Causing trouble for others eventually leads to trouble for oneself; this is what it means to lift a stone only to drop it on one’s own foot.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "You can start counting now."
The woman with a face full of flesh couldn’t take it any longer and began to plead, "Can’t I stop counting? How about this, I’ll take the coins back and transfer her the money."
Lin Fan shook his head, saying, "No, you forgot, I said we would accept these coins, and now we’ll only accept these coins, no other forms of payment."
The woman felt furious inside, thinking that he was out to ruin her!
She was about to explode.
"Mr. Lin told you to count, so just count, why so much nonsense!"
A voice said, and Old Gou stepped out of a small car, walking over with a serious expression.
"Boss..." The woman with a face full of flesh was startled; the boss actually came over.
The crowd was curious; so this is the stingy boss, huh, he actually showed up?
Old Gou quickly walked up to Lin Fan, looking respectful, and bowed, saying, "Mr. Lin, I am Gou Zhixiang, the owner of Linglong Fitness, it’s an honor to meet you."
As he said this, Old Gou extended his hand, attempting to shake hands with Lin Fan.
After Lin Fan called him, he rushed over immediately. Such a good opportunity to meet Lin Fan, he certainly didn’t want to miss it.
But Lin Fan did not shake his hand and said plainly, "You came at a good time, you can be a witness."
Old Gou awkwardly withdrew his hand and nodded, saying, "Alright, Mr. Lin."
The crowd was baffled; the boss was actually trying to ingratiate himself with Lin Fan?
Lin Fan looked toward the woman with a face full of flesh: "Begin."
"Start counting!" Old Gou ordered.
The woman with a face full of flesh had no choice but to continue counting coins with a bitter expression. It was truly exhausting, and she was close to tears as she counted.
"15000, 15001..."
After a while, she finally counted up to 15000, and a pile of coins accumulated on the floor.
This was an extremely tedious task, but everyone around was watching her count coins, none willing to leave, as they all wanted to see how Lin Fan would further tease this woman.
Old Gou watched from the side, so bored he started to doze off.
Lin Fan nudged him, and he woke up immediately, forcing himself to stay alert.
"Boss Gou, don’t fall asleep," Lin Fan smiled.
Old Gou forced himself to open his eyes wide, saying, "I’m fine, I can do this."
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "I don’t think so, please pause."
The woman with a face full of flesh stopped, her soul trembling, and she asked quiveringly, "What now?"
Lin Fan sighed and said, "It’s all your boss’s fault; he was dozing off, so he probably can’t confirm whether you counted correctly or not. In case he refuses to acknowledge it later, you’ll have to count again from the start. Boss Gou, make sure to watch carefully this time; your finance counting isn’t easy."
Starting over again!
This was already the third time!
The woman with a face full of flesh completely broke down and started crying on the spot, "No, I don’t want to count again, boss, I’m begging you?"
She begged Old Gou for help.
Old Gou smiled bitterly inside. Of course, he knew that Lin Fan was deliberately making things difficult, but how could he dare to offend Lin Fan?
"Mr. Lin asked you to count, just do it, don’t talk nonsense!" Old Gou said with a stern face.
The woman with a face full of flesh was furious; the boss not only didn’t help her but also forced her to obey Lin Fan!
The woman couldn’t help but scream in excitement, "I’m not doing this anymore, if you want to count, do it yourself!"
Old Gou angrily said, "You’re not counting? Do you not want the job?"
The woman got up and shouted, "I don’t want the job anymore, I’m quitting, alright!"
This finance employee dared to drop everything and leave; Old Gou’s expression immediately changed as he snorted coldly, "This is you quitting voluntarily, I’m not paying you any severance!"
The woman said, "I don’t want any severance, just give me my monthly salary!"
Old Gou was fuming, and upon spotting the coins on the ground, he had an idea and smiled slyly, "No problem settling your salary; I’ll calculate a full month for you, which is 4000, take 40,000 coins from here and leave!"
The woman was stunned, "What, you’re paying my salary with these coins?"
Old Gou said, "Aren’t coins money? If you want it, take it; if not, I’ll assume you’ve forfeited it. Also, you’d better not take more, or I’ll accuse you of embezzling company funds."
The woman was extremely angry, she’d rather die than count these coins again. Now just seeing these coins triggered a physiological fear.
"I don’t want the salary, okay!" the woman with a face full of flesh screamed, turning to run away.
She wished these coins would disappear immediately, so she simply made herself scarce.
Old Gou chuckled, "You said it yourself!"
The crowd watching burst into laughter; this is what they say about evil meeting its match, and Lin Fan certainly knew how to make these wicked people hurt each other.
How did he manage to do that?
Seeing the finance girl leave, Old Gou turned to Lin Fan and awkwardly smiled, "Mr. Lin, how about this, I will transfer the money to Little Ying now, and these coins won’t count."
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "No, I’ve already said, we want these coins, now that your finance person has left, the honorable task of counting the coins falls to you."
What?
Old Gou broke out in a cold sweat.
Plop!
He kneeled before Lin Fan, having witnessed firsthand how Lin Fan tortured the finance girl; he didn’t want to suffer the same fate, so he surrendered immediately.
"Mr. Lin, please, have mercy on me, I really know I was wrong." Old Gou cried with snot and tears.
Lin Fan said coldly, "Apologizing to me is useless, ask Little Ying if she can forgive you?"
Old Gou hurriedly knelt to Little Ying, crying, "Little Ying, I’m sorry, I was stupid to disgust you with coins; it’s all my fault for being narrow-minded, I deserve to die, but now I realize my mistake, can you forgive me? Please forgive me!"
Old Gou almost kowtowed to Huang Xiaoying.
Huang Xiaoying eventually softened, having already vented her anger. Seeing Old Gou crying so miserably, her heart softened, and she said, "Since you know you’re wrong, fine, transfer the money to me, and this matter will be over."
Old Gou was overjoyed and said, "Sure, I’ll transfer it to you immediately."
Old Gou took out his phone and quickly transferred 5000 yuan to Huang Xiaoying.
Huang Xiaoying finally received her due money and was very happy, saying, "Let’s leave it at that, you can take these coins back with you."
Old Gou nodded, "Okay."
Old Gou picked up a bucket of coins, awkwardly smiled, "Mr. Lin, I’ll take my leave then."
Old Gou carried the bucket of coins and walked toward his car.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan called after him, "Boss Gou, starting next month, your store’s rent will increase by 20%, as a slight punishment for you. If you’re unwilling, you can move out."
Upon hearing this, Old Gou staggered, losing balance, and both he and the bucket fell to the ground, scattering coins everywhere.
Crying without tears!
He regretted it so much he could cry; if he had known earlier that Huang Xiaoying was Lin Fan’s acquaintance, he would never have done such a mean thing, as causing harm to others ultimately harms oneself!
Lin Fan ignored Old Gou and said to Huang Xiaoying, "Let’s go, take me inside for a meal."
Huang Xiaoying cheerfully said, "Okay."
Beside them, Ye Qingmei looked at Lin Fan, filled with curiosity, and grabbed Feng Ruolan, saying, "Sister, quickly tell me, who exactly is this sworn brother of yours?"
Feng Ruolan smiled faintly and said, "Him? Do you know the Mortal Group?"

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Ye Qingmei’s Schemes, The City is Full of Intrigues
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 318: Ye Qingmei’s Schemes, The City is Full of Intrigues
Lin Fan managed the gym owner so well that he was obedient, which made Ye Qingmei very curious. Lin Fan clearly looked like a poor guy.
Ye Qingmei couldn’t help but ask Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan asked her back, "Do you know the Mortal Group?"
Ye Qingmei said, "Mortal Group? I know, but how is it related to him?"
Feng Ruolan smiled slightly and said, "Little Fan is the owner of the Mortal Group."
Ye Qingmei’s eyes widened in shock: "What? He’s the owner of the Mortal Group? Sister, you must be joking, the owner of Mortal Group is now the new richest person in Yun City!"
Feng Ruolan said, "Yes, Yun City’s new richest person is right in front of you now."
Ye Qingmei was stunned.
She didn’t think Feng Ruolan would joke with her like this, so the Lin Fan in front of her really was Yun City’s richest person!
She previously thought Lin Fan was poor, but he turned out to be the richest; if Lin Fan is called poor, then what is she?
The Ye Family in Yun City is just a small family, and their business isn’t large. Ye Qingmei didn’t pay much attention to the family business and went out to open her own restaurant. Her dream is to turn this restaurant into a chain and create a super dining brand. However, as the eldest daughter of the Ye Family, she lacks funds, and the family can’t help.
Ye Qingmei couldn’t help but blush, she judged Lin Fan by his appearance, thinking he was poor because he dressed simply, which was really superficial of her.
So now, the richest man and woman of Yun City were both in her restaurant, Ye Qingmei had an idea, and she couldn’t help but become a bit excited.
In the restaurant, Huang Xiaoying was enthusiastically attending to Lin Fan. The two of them were chatting and laughing.
Huang Xiaoying and Lin Fan are hometown acquaintances, and since Lin Fan helped her, she was naturally very happy and also very curious.
"Brother Fan, Gou Zhixiang seems to be afraid of you, you even want to raise his rent, what’s going on? What are you doing now?" Huang Xiaoying asked.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "To be honest, I’m now the richest person in Yun City."
Huang Xiaoying was momentarily stunned, and then giggled: "Brother Fan, you’re so humorous, I guess you’re in the rent collection business?"
Lin Fan was telling the truth, but how could Huang Xiaoying believe him? They are hometown acquaintances, know each other’s backgrounds, and she heard that Lin Fan was still a deliveryman at New Year’s, so how could he become the richest person? He must be joking.
Lin Fan nodded: "Collecting rent, you could say that."
That whole old district belongs to him, he indeed is the landlord of everyone there.
"Little Ying, I heard you’re from the same hometown as Little Fan?"
Ye Qingmei and Feng Ruolan came over.
Huang Xiaoying blinked, a bit curious: "Yes, boss, you know Brother Fan?"
Ye Qingmei said, "I met Little Fan today, he came with his sister for dinner, his sister is my good friend."
Huang Xiaoying looked at Feng Ruolan and was stunned, Feng Ruolan was so beautiful, and her aura was so strong that ordinary people wouldn’t dare to look directly at her.
"Brother Fan, when did you have such a pretty sister?" Huang Xiaoying asked Lin Fan in surprise.
Feng Ruolan smiled and said, "Hello, Little Ying, I’m Feng Ruolan, Little Fan’s god-sister."
Huang Xiaoying blushed a little and quickly responded, "Hello."
She felt the name Feng Ruolan sounded familiar, but couldn’t recall where she had heard it.
Ye Qingmei invited Feng Ruolan to sit down, grabbed the menu, and smiled, "Sister, Little Fan, first take a look at what you want to eat. Not to brag, but every dish here is worth trying. Little Ying, come with me for a moment."
Ye Qingmei pulled Huang Xiaoying to the back.
"Little Ying, are you on good terms with Lin Fan?" Ye Qingmei asked seriously.
Huang Xiaoying said, "Yes, I live in the neighboring village. We went to elementary school together, everyone knows each other well, and we gather during festivals."
Ye Qingmei was relieved: "That’s good, looks like there is hope now."
Huang Xiaoying asked, "What do you mean, boss?"
Ye Qingmei cleared her throat and said, "Little Ying, you’ve been at my store for a month now, right?"
Huang Xiaoying said, "Yes, it’s exactly one month after today."
Ye Qingmei said, "I see your work ability is good, you’ve performed well, and I’m very satisfied. Just that our store lacks a manager, and I’ve decided that this manager will be you, what do you think?"
Huang Xiaoying was both surprised and delighted, her voice trembling: "Boss, you really want to promote me to manager?"
Ye Qingmei said, "Of course."
Huang Xiaoying was overjoyed: "Thank you, boss!"
She was initially furious with her former company today, but unexpectedly, her luck turned around, first with Lin Fan helping her settle things with the previous company, and now she received Ye Qingmei’s promotion, making her feel like the happiest person in the world.
Ye Qingmei said, "It’s decided then, today we have two distinguished guests in the store, make sure to take good care of them."
Huang Xiaoying said, "Boss, do you mean Brother Fan and that Miss Feng?"
Ye Qingmei said, "Correct."
The two of them then went out.
"So, have you decided what to eat?" Ye Qingmei asked with a smile.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan had already decided, so they ordered, and Ye Qingmei had Huang Xiaoying arrange it, while she sat down and chatted with the two of them.
Ye Qingmei smiled and said, "Little Fan, I haven’t thanked you enough for helping Little Ying today."
Lin Fan said, "Little Ying and I are from the same hometown, it’s the right thing to do, but I hope it didn’t affect Sister Ye’s business because of her."
Ye Qingmei said, "Not at all, Little Ying is indeed very capable, she’s only been with us for a month and has already become the manager here."
Lin Fan replied with a small "oh," smiled and said, "That’s great, then I’ll leave Little Ying in Sister Ye’s care from now on."
Not long after, the dishes they ordered were served.
Ye Qingmei smiled and said, "Go ahead, try it while it’s hot."
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan both tasted the food; it was really delicious.
"Really tasty," Feng Ruolan gave a thumbs up.
Ye Qingmei laughed and said, "How is it? Do you two richest people think my restaurant has potential?"
Feng Ruolan said, "I think it does."
Ye Qingmei asked Lin Fan, "What about you, Little Fan?"
Lin Fan nodded, "I also think it’s quite good, Sister Ye should open a few more branches, let more people taste it."
Ye Qingmei sighed and said, "I want to, but unfortunately, I don’t have enough funds. I’ve tried to attract investment several times but failed. Although the food is good, capital isn’t very optimistic about the dining industry."
Ye Qingmei glanced at both of them and joked, "If you two were interested, it would be great, after all, you are the two wealthiest people in Yun City."
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan exchanged a look, how could they not understand that Ye Qingmei was looking for them to invest?
No wonder Ye Qingmei kept inviting Feng Ruolan to come and taste the food here, it seems her intention was not about the food but about attracting investment.
Moreover, Lin Fan heard from Huang Xiaoying earlier that she had just started working as a waitress and wasn’t doing particularly well. Perhaps Ye Qingmei quickly promoted Huang Xiaoying because she is Lin Fan’s hometown acquaintance and wanted to gain his favor?
The city is full of tricks indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: What’s Wrong with the System? No Rewards Yet Today!
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 319: What’s Wrong with the System? No Rewards Yet Today!
"Sister, what do you think?" Lin Fan asked Feng Ruolan.
Feng Ruolan smiled slightly, "Qing Mei, I really think your stuff here is delicious and has great potential, but investing is no small matter. Little Fan and I are not very familiar with the catering industry, so it’s hard to give you an answer right away. How about this, you first prepare a proposal for us."
Ye Qingmei was delighted, "No problem, I’ll turn around and give you the proposal. I am confident that you won’t be disappointed."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I do have some connections in the catering industry. If possible, I might be able to help Sister Ye pull in some investment."
Ye Qingmei was both excited and surprised, "Really?"
Feng Ruolan laughed, "You probably don’t know this, but Little Fan is the second-largest shareholder of the Golden Capital Group."
What? Ye Qingmei was floored.
Oh my god, Lin Fan was actually a shareholder in the giant Golden Capital Group in the hotel and catering industry, and the second-largest at that.
Ye Qingmei was trembling with excitement; she saw hope now. If the Golden Capital Group was willing to invest in her, her restaurant brand was bound to succeed!
The wealthiest people are indeed the wealthiest; just a lift of a finger can help someone realize their dreams. All the effort she previously put into finding investment might be just a word from Lin Fan.
After the meal.
Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan left the restaurant.
Ye Qingmei personally escorted them out, seeing them off until they got into the car.
In the car.
Feng Ruolan said, "Little Fan, I’m sorry. I didn’t expect Qing Mei to work us over. I just came out to have a meal with you."
Lin Fan sighed and said, "The city is full of tricks, I want to go back to the countryside."
Feng Ruolan chuckled, and then said, "Qing Mei is my good sister. She needs money right now, I can’t not help her. Let me handle this, you don’t need to get involved."
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Sister, I’m with you on this. If you really think the project is viable, just let me know."
Upon hearing this, Feng Ruolan was very touched. She hadn’t misjudged Lin Fan. Lin Fan was loyal and righteous, which was the reason she became brother and sister with Lin Fan in the first place.
Lin Fan indeed decided to be of one mind with Feng Ruolan. Although he knew Ye Qingmei’s tactics, it also showed that Ye Qingmei was smart and capable of big things. As long as the project was viable, investing was no problem. Besides, for Lin Fan, it was indeed just a lift of his finger.
At this moment, neither Lin Fan, Feng Ruolan, nor Ye Qingmei realized that the seed of a future restaurant empire had already been sown...
Afterwards, Lin Fan dropped off Feng Ruolan at the Longheng Company, and then left on his own.
It was already afternoon by this time, and Lin Fan suddenly remembered something.
Had he not received a check-in reward today?
Ever since obtaining the system, the check-in reward usually never exceeded the morning, often prompting him as soon as he woke up.
But today it was already afternoon, and the system hadn’t made a peep?
Lin Fan couldn’t help but check the system internally.
Besides the task interface of the system displaying tasks normally, the system was very quiet, with no other movement.
Lin Fan couldn’t ask the system because it was like a cold, uncommunicative machine that wouldn’t interact with him.
Lin Fan could only passively wait for the system prompt.
"Maybe there’s a delay today," Lin Fan thought, and didn’t pay much attention to it.
Suddenly, Lin Fan received a call from his close friend Wang Xiangqian.
Lin Fan gave a wry smile, guessing Wang Xiangqian might be asking to borrow his car to pick up girls again. Last time Wang Xiangqian asked him, he borrowed his Rolls-Royce for a date and apparently scared the girl he was meeting for a blind date.
Lin Fan answered the call, "Old Wang, what’s up?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "Brother Fan, do you have time? If you’re free, come over to the company. Today we are seeing off the girls."
Lin Fan gave an "oh" sound, momentarily not recalling what the matter was, "Seeing off?"
Wang Xiangqian sweatily said, "Brother Fan forgot, our company’s girls are going to participate in a talent show, leaving tomorrow. So today we’re seeing them off."
Lin Fan suddenly understood. He had saved Ning Xiaoyue accidentally before, and later learned that his old friend Wang Xiangqian was Ning Xiaoyue’s boss.
On that day, Wang Xiangqian wanted to jump off a building due to Feng Tianming withdrawing his investment. Lin Fan saved him and promised to invest in his company.
Wang Xiangqian had opened an entertainment company and trained a group of girl group members. Among them, Ning Xiaoyue and a few others got the opportunity to participate in a talent show. They might become famous or might remain obscure, but at least they saw hope.
However, by then, Wang Xiangqian’s company was on the brink of collapse, and he couldn’t even afford the travel expenses to send the girls to the competition.
When the roof leaks during a rainy night, at that time, the Shengshi Group, who had originally agreed to invest, suddenly decided to withdraw their investment.
The reason was Feng Tianming had taken a liking to another girl group, believing it had more potential, so he decided to change his investment direction.
At the scene of Wang Xiangqian’s intended jump, Feng Tianming also appeared.
After Lin Fan saved Wang Xiangqian, Feng Tianming even mocked Lin Fan, leading Lin Fan to set a sky-high bet of 100 million yuan with Feng Tianming.
The bet was on whose girl group would win in the talent show.
Now, the girls were finally about to set off for the competition, which pertained to the bet between Lin Fan and Feng Tianming.
Lin Fan couldn’t ignore it, because he didn’t want to lose to that guy Feng Tianming.
"Alright, I’m heading over," Lin Fan said.
Wenyue Company.
This is the entertainment brokerage company opened by Wang Xiangqian.
Today, the company was newly decorated, with a festive atmosphere, indeed to see off the four girls going to the talent show.
Ning Xiaoyue was one of them.
She was just about to leave, and this departure would last more than three months, as it was said that during the recording of the show, contestants couldn’t leave.
So they had to stay there to compete unless they were eliminated early and could leave.
Of course, no one wanted to be eliminated. They all hoped to make it to the end, and if they reached the finals, they would at least leave for three months.
Ning Xiaoyue was very reluctant to leave, and before leaving, there was one person she especially wanted to see.
Lin Fan.
If it hadn’t been for Lin Fan, the company would have gone belly-up, and she would have had to give up this opportunity that could make her famous.
For Lin Fan, she felt not only gratitude but also an indescribable sentiment... Before leaving, she really wanted to see Lin Fan.
During the lively moment, Wang Xiangqian suddenly said with a smile, "Brother Fan is here!"
He quickly walked to the company’s entrance and pulled Lin Fan inside.
Seeing Lin Fan, Ning Xiaoyue was overjoyed; her face instantly broke into a brilliant smile, but her face blushed involuntarily.
"Let me introduce everyone, Brother Fan, my close friend, dear brother. If it weren’t for Brother Fan’s investment, our company would have already been bankrupt," Wang Xiangqian said emotionally.
Everyone in the company was stunned. So the well-dressed, handsome man in front of them was actually their company’s financial backer!
"Brother Fan!"
"Brother Fan!"
"Hello, Brother Fan!"
Flattering voices rang out instantly.
"Is Lin Fan here? If Lin Fan is here, great. You’ll soon be competing. I came specifically to tell you, are you ready to face failure?"
Suddenly, an arrogant voice came, and Feng Tianming, with a group of people, barged in.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: If I lose, it’s just losing 1 billion.
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 320: If I lose, it’s just losing 1 billion.
Lin Fan came to Wang Xiangqian’s company for a farewell party. Not long after he arrived, Feng Tianming barged in with a group of people, clamoring to see Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "What are you yelling for in someone else’s company? I’m right here."
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Feng Tianming sneered, "Lin Fan, do you remember our one billion wager?"
Lin Fan said, "What do you want to say?"
Feng Tianming turned to Wang Xiangqian, "Wang Xiangqian, which of your contestants are attending the competition this time? These four?"
Feng Tianming looked at Ning Xiaoyue and the three other girls beside her. They all dressed up deliberately today.
Wang Xiangqian got angry upon seeing Feng Tianming, recalling how the Feng Family had forced him into despair before.
"So what if they are, what does it have to do with you?" Wang Xiangqian said with a stern face.
Feng Tianming laughed, "That’s right. Lin Fan, look at these people from your company. Their qualifications are average. Only Ning Xiaoyue is slightly better, but it doesn’t matter since she’s utterly penniless and has no popularity. Your people will just end up as cannon fodder in the competition!"
Feng Tianming’s words immediately sparked the anger of everyone in the company.
"What’s this guy talking nonsense!"
"With such a filthy mouth, did he eat shit for lunch?"
"How can there be such a person, really so lacking in quality!"
Everyone was standing up for their colleagues.
Ning Xiaoyue and the others were offended, their eyes reddening with anger.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Feng Tianming, the competition hasn’t even started. What bullshit are you spewing here?"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "I’m just here to tell you all a harsh truth, so you won’t be delusional with unnecessary fantasies. I advise you to give up as soon as possible!"
Lin Fan said, "I think you’re just scared of losing. That’s why you rushed over here to step on others."
Feng Tianming laughed loudly, "What a joke, me being afraid of losing? Let me show you who my contestants are. Step forward!"
From the people behind Feng Tianming, five girls stepped forward. Each was dressed refreshingly and attractively, and though none could match Ning Xiaoyue’s beauty, they exuded confidence and presence.
Feng Tianming laughed, "See, I gave up on your company because I saw potential in them. They are now a moderately popular girl group, each with their own fan base. With this competition, they’re bound to soar! What do your contestants, with no fan base, have to compete with them?"
Feng Tianming was brimming with confidence.
Today, he was also giving his contestants a send-off, and after a few drinks at the gathering, he impulsively brought them here to intimidate Lin Fan.
He was extremely confident in his contestants.
"Lin Fan, you’re bound to lose this time!" Feng Tianming shouted arrogantly.
Recently, he had been repeatedly losing to Lin Fan, which left him feeling very frustrated. The other day at the cinema, he tried to flex by booking the entire place, only to have the cinema bought by Lin Fan, forcing him to leave in embarrassment. In the old district, he thought Feng Wanshan had secured the area and tried to drive Lin Fan away, only to have Lin Fan buy the old district, leaving him and Feng Wanshan to flee in disarray.
Moreover, today Lin Fan became the richest man in Yun City, while his Shengshi Group faced consecutive stock declines.
Having suffered one defeat after another, he desperately needed an outlet to vent his frustration.
Seeing his girl group gave him confidence, he was convinced that with their qualifications, they would easily defeat Lin Fan with absolute certainty.
Everyone turned to Lin Fan, waiting for his response.
This time, Feng Tianming indeed had the audacity to be arrogant, because in comparison, Ning Xiaoyue and the others were all pure rookies without any fan base, considerably inferior to Feng Wanshan’s people.
Even Wang Xiangqian lacked the confidence to rebut Feng Tianming.
No one knew how Lin Fan would respond.
Lin Fan was silent for a moment and then said, "You’re right, my contestants are indeed at a disadvantage now and can’t compete with yours. But this doesn’t mean my contestants will always be like this. It’s too early to say anything now. Only after the competition, in the real arena, will the truth come out. Feng Tianming, aren’t you afraid of facing a slap in the face by speaking so boldly?"
Everyone nodded in agreement. Lin Fan made a very valid point.
Feng Tianming snorted, "Looks like you’re still clinging to fantasies, truly ignorant of reality. I think you’re overthinking it. On the arena, your people won’t stand a chance!"
Lin Fan said, "If that’s the case, see you on the field. You can take your people and get out."
Feng Tianming laughed, "What, lost the argument and got angry? You also feel that what I’m saying is right, but you just won’t admit it, too proud to back down!"
Lin Fan said, "Apart from thinking you’re right about one thing, yes, I’m angry. I’m bidding farewell to my contestants, and you come here blabbering nonsense, really annoying. Old Wang, call the security guards. If they don’t leave, lock the door and beat the dog!"
Wang Xiangqian had long wanted to do this. He immediately ran to the door and shouted, "Guards, where are you!"
Soon, two security guards came in armed with sticks.
"These people are causing trouble, beat them away with sticks!" Wang Xiangqian pointed at Feng Tianming and his group.
The two security guards came over to chase them out.
Feng Tianming and his group held their heads and scampered away quickly.
"Get lost!"
Everyone in the company burst into laughter. This scene was so satisfying, so supporting. Brother Fan was mighty!
"Lin Fan, just wait and prepare one billion for me!" Feng Tianming’s arrogant voice came from outside.
Hearing this, the laughter gradually subsided.
Although chasing out Feng Tianming felt great, what he said couldn’t be ignored. Indeed, as far as the contestants go, their side was at a significant disadvantage.
They might lose miserably.
Ning Xiaoyue felt somewhat dejected. If her performance really couldn’t surpass the other side, causing Brother Lin to lose one billion, she would feel very guilty.
Lin Fan glanced at everyone, smiled slightly, and said, "Indeed, I made a bet with Feng Tianming, but I hope this wager won’t affect you. Let’s put it this way, if I win, I can certainly slap Feng Tianming in the face, but if I lose, it’s just losing one billion to him."
Everyone was taken aback, just one billion!
How could Lin Fan speak as if one billion was only a hundred bucks? That’s a billion!
Lin Fan must be pretending to be relaxed to comfort them.
Suddenly, a middle-aged man in a suit appeared at the door, glanced at Lin Fan and exclaimed in surprise, "Mr. Lin, it’s really you!"
"I’m Chen Ming, president of HSBC. We spoke on the phone a few days ago to congratulate your company for exceeding a valuation of 100 billion."
Lin Fan remembered and smiled, "Oh, it’s President Chen. What a coincidence."
Chen Ming said, "Yes, I happened to have business nearby today and heard Mr. Lin’s voice at the door. I was curious and came to take a look. I didn’t expect Mr. Lin to really be here. It’s truly an honor!"
Lin Fan and Chen Ming shook hands.
"Congratulations, Mr. Lin, today your company’s valuation exceeded 200 billion. Mr. Lin, you’ve become Yun City’s new richest man. It’s truly something to celebrate!" Chen Ming said with a smile.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank you."
After some pleasantries, Chen Ming left to attend to his business.
Inside the company, there was dead silence, everyone was stunned, you could even hear a pin drop.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 231: Be True to Yourself, and Someone Will Like You
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 231: Be True to Yourself, and Someone Will Like You
What did they just hear?
Lin Fan is actually the new richest person in Yun City?
The company’s market value surpassed 200 billion?
My God, this is astronomical!
Everyone here is essentially a young person, and they don’t usually pay much attention to the business world, so they really didn’t know before that Lin Fan is the richest person in Yun City!
Even Wang Xiangqian didn’t know. He’s been busy with the competition these days, where does he have time to care about anything else? The business world is a bit distant for him too.
Upon learning that his best buddy Lin Fan is actually the new richest person in Yun City, Wang Xiangqian was stunned, dumbfounded.
They finally understood that when Lin Fan said it didn’t matter even if he lost 100 million, it was not false ease to comfort people, but rather, it really didn’t matter to him.
To a tycoon worth billions, losing 100 million is no different from a regular person losing 100 bucks!
Lin Fan genuinely doesn’t have to care!
"We really haven’t seen the world."
"We thought Brother Fan was just pretending to be cool, who knew Brother Fan is really amazing!"
"Bow down to Brother Fan!"
Everyone wiped the cold sweat from their brows, feeling ashamed of their youthful ignorance.
"Bro-Brother Fan, are you really the richest?" Wang Xiangqian swallowed dryly with a gulp.
Lin Fan is generally quite low-key and doesn’t proactively boast about being the richest. This time, his identity was accidentally exposed by Chen Ming.
Since it was exposed, Lin Fan was not hesitant, and generously said: "I suppose so, I just found out myself when I woke up around noon."
Everyone bowed down, cold sweat streamed down, becoming the new richest and yet so calm, Brother Fan is impressive...
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Now that everyone knows, you should believe what I said, right? Even if I lose 100 million, it’s nothing, so I hope you won’t be restrained by this bet, and don’t have any psychological pressure."
Lin Fan saying this indeed comforted everyone a lot; after all, losing 100 million is really nothing for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan continued: "Moreover, who says we will definitely lose? You all have seen the contestants Feng Tianming brought, they are indeed pretty ladies. But I think the five of them combined can’t match a single strand of Xiaoyue’s hair in beauty."
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
Ning Xiaoyue blushed deeply but simultaneously felt elated, receiving such a high appraisal from Brother Lin made her really happy.
Lin Fan said: "The reason I dared to make this bet with Feng Tianming is that I am very confident in our contestants. Therefore, I hope you don’t have any psychological pressure; just show your true self on stage, work hard, and live up to your own conscience."
Lin Fan’s words were very inspiring, everyone was moved and applauded one after another.
Ning Xiaoyue and the other four contestants couldn’t help but tear up; Brother Fan is really great.
Wang Xiangqian’s admiration for Lin Fan was as boundless as a river, Brother Fan merely spoke a few words and boosted everyone’s morale.
To sum it up, it’s because Brother Fan has the confidence; being the richest in Yun City, such confidence is not something everyone has.
The gathering ended in an enthusiastic atmosphere.
Thinking of being backed by the richest person in Yun City, everyone in the small company felt a sense of pride and fighting spirit.
"Brother Fan, you’re really amazing, my admiration for you is as endless as a river, you are our savior, please accept my bow as your little brother." Wang Xiangqian took Lin Fan into the office, ready to kneel for him.
Lin Fan helped him up with a chuckle: "Old Wang, we’re bros, no need to be so sentimental."
Wang Xiangqian laughed awkwardly: "Okay, Brother Fan."
Lin Fan patted his shoulder: "If there’s nothing else, that’s it for now. I’ll be heading back. You are the boss of the company; you need to protect the girls. If there’s anything you need help with, just reach out to me anytime."
Wang Xiangqian nodded quickly: "I will take good care of them, Brother Fan rest assured."
Lin Fan nodded and then said goodbye and left.
Wang Xiangqian and the company folks escorted Lin Fan out, only Ning Xiaoyue wasn’t seen.
Lin Fan glanced around, indeed didn’t see Ning Xiaoyue, and just let it go.
When Lin Fan returned to his Rolls-Royce and was about to drive away, he suddenly saw Ning Xiaoyue walking alone up ahead.
Lin Fan drove up, opened the car window.
"Xiaoyue, where are you going?" Lin Fan asked.
Ning Xiaoyue turned her head, saw Lin Fan, felt very happy, and a little shy. Her face flushed as she said: "We are leaving tomorrow, I just remembered my suitcase was broken, so I need to buy a new one. Brother Lin, are you leaving so soon?"
Lin Fan said: "Yeah, I don’t have much to do right now. Hop in, I’ll take you to buy one."
Ning Xiaoyue felt delighted inside, said: "Okay."
She then got into Lin Fan’s car, sitting in the passenger seat.
Being alone with Brother Lin, Ning Xiaoyue felt a bit nervous, her face flushed and her heart raced, momentarily unsure of what to say.
Lin Fan glanced at her, said: "How about it, participating in the competition this time, do you have confidence?"
Ning Xiaoyue said: "Does Brother Lin want to hear the truth?"
Lin Fan said: "The truth is always best."
Ning Xiaoyue said: "Brother Lin’s words at the company were so inspiring, but... my singing and dancing fundamentals are really poor. I don’t know if anyone will like me..."
Lin Fan had sung together with Ning Xiaoyue at karaoke before; indeed, her singing skills were quite lacking, this much had to be admitted.
Lin Fan laughed: "I heard from Old Wang that your competition mainly looks at popularity rather than singing or dancing. So, regardless of how bad your singing and dancing are, as long as you attract people’s liking, you can still stand out."
Ning Xiaoyue seemed puzzled: "But... my singing and dancing are so poor, how can I attract people to like me?"
This question has a bit of a philosophical nature!
But it didn’t stump Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said: "You’re pretty and adorable, with a good personality, how could no one like you? As long as you are the truest version of yourself on stage, authentic without pretense, people will naturally like you."
Ning Xiaoyue seemed to ponder: "Be the true self..."
After a while, she seemed to understand, showing a bright smile: "I got it, thank you, Brother Lin."
She suddenly thought of something, her face reddened, Brother Lin said once she is her true self, people will like her, does Brother Lin... like her?
Thinking about this question, she couldn’t help but be a little dazed.
Arriving at a nearby street market, Lin Fan parked the car and they both got out, preparing to browse around to buy a suitcase for Ning Xiaoyue.
While walking, they suddenly saw a man nearby who looked decent, with a very confident and arrogant demeanor, doing a street livestream, and the content of this livestream was actually street flirting.
"Hey folks, today let’s do some street flirting, to test my flirting skills. Not to brag, but as long as they’re female, there’s no one I can’t flirt with! If you all think it’s good, send some gifts!" the confident guy boasted.
"Come on, let’s see what ladies are on the street. How about this, you guys point someone out for me."
The confident guy turned on the rear camera.
Immediately, street-goers all saw a cleaning aunt entering the frame.
Comments started encouraging immediately: "Let’s pick this cleaning lady!"
The confident guy laughed: "Folks sure know how to pick, alright then, I’ll go hit on this cleaning lady. Gifts, roll in!"
Saying this, the confident guy walked forward, stretching his hand out to stop the cleaning lady passing by.
"What are you doing?" The cleaning lady jumped in fright, giving the confident guy a glare.
Beside them, Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue both noticed the confident guy, exchanging glances, wondering what he was up to?
Come on, even hitting on a cleaning lady? This guy is creepy!

chapters.title: Chapter 322: The Handsomest Delivery Guy Has Already Become the Richest Man?
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 322: The Handsomest Delivery Guy Has Already Become the Richest Man?
The overconfident guy, egged on by his fans, stopped a passing cleaning auntie, actually planning to chat her up.
He gave the cleaning auntie a fright.
With a greasy grin, the overconfident guy said, "Auntie, may I ask how old you are today?"
The cleaning auntie, unhappy, said, "Are you crazy? Don’t you know a woman’s age is a secret?"
The overconfident guy said, "The auntie won’t tell, but I think you must be around 50, must have been a long time since any man delighted you, right? Auntie, do you need a man now?"
The cleaning auntie was furious: "Get lost!"
The overconfident guy, with a playful smile: "Auntie, don’t get upset, look at me, I’m so young and handsome, what if I decide to date you?"
The overconfident guy was truly full of confidence, thinking that with his charm, he could definitely woo the cleaning auntie.
However, the cleaning auntie was so enraged, she picked up her broom and started hitting: "Trash, get out!"
Luckily, the overconfident guy left quickly, otherwise, he would’ve eaten a broom from the cleaning auntie.
The overconfident guy’s hair was all messed up, looking utterly pathetic.
The comment section was filled with laughter.
"Epic fail!"
"The auntie is fierce!"
"Strong auntie!"
Beside watching this, Ning Xiaoyue couldn’t help but chuckle.
The overconfident guy failed to hit on the cleaning auntie and was chased away by her broom, truly embarrassing. Seeing the comments mocking and teasing him, the overconfident guy felt utterly humiliated.
"Hey folks, there was just a little mishap, actually it was pre-arranged with the auntie, just for effect. You lose if you take it seriously. Now let me find something truly exciting for you, I’m going to kiss ten girls on this street. Just relying on my charisma, as long as I speak, there’s nothing I can’t handle. Those who want to see me perform, send some gifts," the overconfident guy arrogantly said.
The comment section again roared with laughter.
To salvage the situation, the overconfident guy decided to start a second wave of reckless acts, he first stopped a passing girl.
"Beautiful lady, you are so gorgeous, can I give you a kiss?" The overconfident guy smiled confidently, feeling like a warm man who can make girls fall in love at first sight.
Yet the girl looked terrified, not daring to speak, and ran away hastily.
The overconfident guy kept harassing a few more girls, without exception, they all refused him, some scared, some angry.
The overconfident guy met with setbacks one after another but wasn’t discouraged in the least, and walked straight toward Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue.
Seeing Ning Xiaoyue, the overconfident guy’s eyes immediately lit up, Ning Xiaoyue was so beautiful.
"This lovely lady, may I ask what’s your relation with this dude?" the overconfident guy asked.
The comment section exploded.
Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue were indeed eye-catching, Lin Fan was astonishingly handsome, Ning Xiaoyue so pretty and cute.
"I don’t see the streamer having any luck!"
"Is the streamer crazy?"
"The streamer isn’t half as handsome as this guy, he’s going to fail again!"
Seeing these comments, the streamer was a bit annoyed: "You all will be slapped in the face soon!"
Ning Xiaoyue, seeing this guy approaching her, couldn’t help but feel scared, she instinctively hid behind Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled: "What’s it got to do with you?"
The overconfident guy glanced at Lin Fan and said: "Because I think I’m more handsome than you. If you’re this lady’s boyfriend, I suggest you back out of the competition because I’m about to kiss her now."
Ning Xiaoyue hurriedly buried her face in Lin Fan’s shoulder: "Brother Lin, this guy is a pervert."
Lin Fan gave an "oh": "Really? You can give it a try."
The overconfident guy chuckled: "Beauty, don’t you think I’m more handsome than your boyfriend? Come over and let me kiss you."
As he spoke, the overconfident guy reached out to pull Ning Xiaoyue.
However, the next second, his hand was already caught by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan applied a bit of force.
The overconfident guy immediately grimaced in pain, cold sweat pouring down: "Hurts, hurts, let go!"
Only then did he realize, he’d hit a brick wall.
Lin Fan coldly asked: "Which live platform are you with?"
The overconfident guy angrily said: "Why should I tell you?"
He initially thought that with his handsome and charming traits, he could defeat Lin Fan and charm Ning Xiaoyue away from him.
Who knew he’d hit a brick wall, losing face under the watchful eyes of so many people in the livestream naturally made him furious.
Lin Fan applied a bit more pressure, a little bit indeed, because ever since he took the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, the force within his body could even crush iron, not to mention just a bit more strength, making the overconfident guy feel as if caught by iron tongs.
"Feeling like talking now?" Lin Fan chuckled.
The overconfident guy, face pale from the pain, thought this guy’s grip was way too strong, definitely not like a normal person.
"Teasing Whiskers Livestream, id Earth’s Greatest Handsome Guy," the overconfident guy could only admit, no choice. If not, his hand would crush, seemed like it already was.
His ID was indeed confident.
Lin Fan sneered, being a streamer at Teasing Whiskers, this was easy, for he happened to be the second-largest shareholder of Teasing Whiskers.
Lin Fan took out his phone with the other hand, quickly dialing a number: "President Li, it’s me, Lin Fan."
On the other end, was indeed Li Jianhua, the Big Boss of Teasing Whiskers Livestream.
Back when Lin Fan obtained 30% shares of Teasing Whiskers, it astonished Li Jianhua, after pondering, Li Jianhua decided not to offend Lin Fan, maintaining a polite demeanor toward him.
Now, Lin Fan was already the new richest man in Yun City, Li Jianhua naturally knew, he felt his earlier decision was truly wise.
Now hearing Lin Fan suddenly calling him, Li Jianhua was both pleasantly surprised and a bit anxious: "Mr. Lin, what brings you to call? By the way, congratulations on becoming the new richest man of Yun City."
Lin Fan said: "Thank you, President Li. Here’s the thing, we have a broadcaster from Teasing Whiskers acting indecently on the street and I caught him red-handed, his ID is Earth’s Greatest Handsome Guy, how does President Li think we should handle this?"
Li Jianhua frowned, promptly said: "Such a thing, I’ll handle it right away, if true, a permanent ban!"
Lin Fan smiled: "Alright, I’ll leave it in your capable hands, President Li."
The call ended there.
Li Jianhua’s handling speed was remarkable, not long after, the decision was made, the overconfident guy’s livestream room was permanently banned by the platform, and he was blacklisted in livestream circles, banished from the industry!
The overconfident guy, holding his phone, watched his now blacked-out livestream room, face ashen, collapsing to the ground.
He never dreamed, Lin Fan had not only a frighteningly strong grip but also, with a single phone call, severed all his ties with livestreaming.
Who the hell did he mess with?
Soon after that day, the video of the overconfident guy harassing women on the street spread online, and he faced a torrent of criticism.
Netizens all thought the overconfident guy was stupid.
Meanwhile, the scene in the video where Lin Fan subdued the overconfident guy pleased the netizens, thinking Lin Fan was incredibly handsome.
"Go, little brother!"
"Little brother, slap him for me!"
"Wah, little brother is too handsome, a million times more so than this fool!"
While praising Lin Fan, some sharp-eyed netizens recognized him.
"Ahh... isn’t he the most handsome delivery guy?"
"No, no, he’s Lin Fan, Yun City’s new richest man!"
"What, the most handsome delivery guy is now the richest man?"
"Forget Earth’s Greatest Handsome Guy, Mr. Lin is the universe’s first handsome!"
The netizens exploded in discussion, focus entirely shifting to Lin Fan from the overconfident guy.
Clang!
Learning Lin Fan was the new richest man of Yun City, the overconfident guy was so shocked his phone fell to the ground, left with no tears to cry, why did he have to offend anyone but ended up offending Yun City’s richest man, wasn’t he courting death!

chapters.title: Chapter 323 I almost bought this mall and raised your rent
