chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 323 I almost bought this mall and raised your rent
After sending off the confident man, Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue continued shopping to buy a suitcase.
It didn’t take long for them to find a specialty store selling bags and suitcases.
The clerk greeted them with a smile, but upon seeing their plain attire, her enthusiasm deflated like a balloon and her smile quickly faded.
These two look like poor people, not worth the effort. Most poor people just browse and don’t buy because they can’t afford it.
Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue wandered around the store, and Ning Xiaoyue took a liking to a pink suitcase, which was very cute and just what she fancied.
"Do you like this one?" Lin Fan asked.
Ning Xiaoyue nodded, "I do like it, but... all the suitcases here are so expensive. Brother Lin, why don’t we look somewhere else?"
Hearing this, the clerk gave them a disdainful look. Just as she thought, these two paupers couldn’t afford it.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay. As long as you like it, consider it my parting gift to you. I wish you success in your journey."
Ning Xiaoyue quickly replied, "No way, no way, how could I let Brother Lin spend so much?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m an investor in the company. Since you’re representing the company in a competition, it’s fitting that I equip you with some gear as encouragement. How about I buy one for the other three girls as well? Call them over."
Upon hearing this, Ning Xiaoyue reconsidered—since Lin Fan was rewarding on behalf of the company, she could accept it. Delighted, she took out her phone and called over her three sisters.
Lin Fan turned to the clerk, "Excuse me, how much is this suitcase?"
The clerk, a bit impatient, thought ’Those who can’t afford it ask so many questions, why bother!’
"Can’t you read the price tag yourself?" the clerk rolled her eyes.
Lin Fan frowned, thinking the service attitude of this clerk was really poor.
Lin Fan didn’t bother with her, glanced at the price tag. The suitcase was priced at 3999.
Lin Fan was a bit taken aback. Though it’s not much money for him, it was a bit expensive for a suitcase.
"It’s a bit pricey, is there a discount?" Lin Fan asked casually.
The clerk rolled her eyes up high, "If you can’t afford it, go somewhere else. There’s a wholesale market nearby, perfect for people like you."
Ning Xiaoyue, having just finished her call, got a little angry hearing the clerk’s words, "Even if we can’t afford it, you don’t have to have this attitude, right?"
The clerk got angry, "What attitude? A pair of deadbeat paupers like you, what kind of attitude do you deserve? Ask yourselves if you’re even worth it!"
Ning Xiaoyue was also very upset. She might be poor now, but even poor people deserve respect, not insults.
"Brother Lin, let’s not buy here, let’s go!" Ning Xiaoyue said, although she really liked the pink suitcase, with the clerk’s attitude, she’d rather not buy it anymore.
The clerk sneered, "Oh, acting like you can afford it. Not to belittle you, but you probably can’t even buy a suitcase wheel."
Lin Fan wasn’t going to bother with her, but seeing the clerk keep provoking Ning Xiaoyue, he couldn’t hold back any longer.
"Enough, she is right. As a clerk, you’re supposed to serve customers and be polite to every customer, not treat them based on your judgment. You’re clearly failing at your job," Lin Fan chuckled.
The clerk rolled her eyes again, sneered, "I fail? Fire me if you can. Oh, sorry, you’re not my boss, you’re just a poor nobody."
Lin Fan smiled, "Although I’m not your boss, it’s actually quite easy for me to get you fired."
The clerk sneered, "You poor bum, bragging like that. Ask yourself if you’re even worth it. Don’t say I look down on you, but if you can get me fired, I’ll roll out of here!"
Lin Fan said, "You said it. In fact, there are many ways I can get you fired. First, I could buy this store and become your boss, then naturally, you can be sacked. The second way is a bit costly; I could buy this mall and become the landlord of your boss’s boss. I think the second way is more fun. What do you think, Xiaoyue?"
Ning Xiaoyue couldn’t help but giggle. She knew Lin Fan’s true identity. He wasn’t bluffing; he indeed had the financial power to buy the entire mall without blinking.
For Lin Fan, buying a mall might just be like an ordinary person buying a head of cabbage.
The clerk had no idea and thought Lin Fan was just bluffing.
Unable to hold back, the clerk laughed while holding her stomach, "This is killing me, you poor show-off, you can’t even afford a suitcase, and you’re talking about buying the mall?"
"What’s going on here, what’s all this commotion about?"
At this moment, a woman in business attire walked in, frowned, and asked.
Seeing the woman, the clerk hurriedly approached her with a grin, "Boss lady, you’re back!"
The boss lady said, "What’s going on, Little Yu? I told you to watch the store, not to argue with people."
The clerk quickly replied, "Nothing really, just a couple who couldn’t afford anything, so I told them to browse elsewhere."
The boss lady made a sound of acknowledgment, then looked up at Lin Fan and Ning Xiaoyue.
Suddenly, the boss lady noticed Lin Fan’s face and was instantly stunned, her face changed.
"Mr. Lin?" the boss lady exclaimed.
The clerk frowned, what Mr. Lin?
But the boss lady had already approached Lin Fan and asked with a bit of reverence, "Excuse me, are you Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan, do you know me, boss lady?"
The boss lady knelt down, "Oh my god, it’s really you, Mr. Lin. Having you visit my little store is truly an honor!"
The boss lady warmly shook hands with Lin Fan.
It turned out that the boss lady was an investor, and she always paid close attention to the business world. When Lin Fan became the new richest person in Yun City, she was the first to know that Lin Fan was only 21 years old and extremely handsome. The boss lady remembered Lin Fan’s face very well.
Recognizing Lin Fan at first sight, she got so excited.
The clerk was dumbfounded—why was the boss lady so respectful to a poor nobody?
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m just accompanying a friend to buy a suitcase, but the shopping experience in your store wasn’t very pleasant."
On hearing this, the boss lady hurriedly said, "I was out for a bit, and I didn’t know what happened just now."
Lin Fan briefly explained what had happened earlier.
Cold sweat broke out on the boss lady’s face, and she turned to point at the clerk, "Little Yu, how could you treat customers like this? Mr. Lin is right, you’re not a qualified clerk!"
The clerk was very aggrieved, "But they really couldn’t afford it!"
"Couldn’t afford it?" The boss lady glared at her, "Do you even know what you’re saying? I don’t think you even know who Mr. Lin is, do you?"
The clerk said, "Him? Who could he be?"
The boss lady said, "He’s the richest person in Yun City, you fool!"
The clerk was stunned, what, Yun City’s richest person, this flea market-looking guy, how is that possible?
The boss lady snorted, "With such a service attitude, you’re not fit to be a clerk. I declare, you’re fired!"
The clerk was shocked—the boss lady had actually fired her decisively!
Lin Fan smiled, "The boss lady is so decisive, luckily you intervened, or I would have had to spend money to buy this mall just to increase your rent and pressure you to fire her. You’ve saved me some money."
The boss lady broke out in a cold sweat again; holy crap, Mr. Lin was indeed ruthless, planning to use such a tactic! Damn, he’s truly a godly tycoon; this kind of strategy is beyond the reach of ordinary people, but for Lin Fan, it’s like buying a cabbage.
The clerk’s face turned pale, and her body trembled uncontrollably. At this point, she finally understood that she had really offended the richest person in Yun City, the true richest person ever!
Lin Fan looked at the clerk at this moment and said, "What did you say earlier? Now you can roll out of here."

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Winning ¥5 million every day for 109 years
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 324: Winning ¥5 million every day for 109 years
Although the shop assistant didn’t actually roll out, he was red-faced with embarrassment and quickly left, too ashamed to stay.
The shop owner hurriedly apologized to Lin Fan: "Mr. Lin, I’m really sorry, it’s my fault for not keeping a strict eye. That fool has already been fired by me, I hope you can forgive us."
Lin Fan said calmly: "No need to be nervous, Shop Owner, we’re not here to cause trouble, we just wanted to buy a suitcase."
The shop owner chuckled awkwardly: "Mr. Lin, which suitcase did you like? I’ll give it to you, as a token of apology."
Lin Fan said: "No need for it to be free, you run a business after all, I wouldn’t have you take a loss. But if you’re willing to give me a discount, that would be great."
The shop owner laughed: "No problem, I’ll give you 50% off!"
The shop owner felt great admiration for Lin Fan, he was so considerate, truly deserving of the title of the youngest richest man in Yun City, definitely not someone ordinary can compare to.
The suitcase Ning Xiaoyue had her eye on, even at 50% off, still cost about 2000 bucks, but it was within Lin Fan’s acceptable range, so he paid promptly.
Ning Xiaoyue was very happy to get the suitcase she loved.
Soon, the three other girls who came for the competition also arrived.
When Lin Fan told them that the company was giving each of them a suitcase as a going-away gift,
the girls were ecstatic, and soon each picked out a suitcase they liked.
After buying the suitcases, they left the shop and hit the street. Four lovely young ladies each dragging a suitcase, following a handsome guy, it was quite a scene, drawing envious glances from passersby.
The four young ladies couldn’t help but feel a bit proud, they were with the richest man in Yun City!
The gifts in their hands were given by the richest man in Yun City!
Lin Fan was approachable, and soon the girls weren’t shy anymore, chatting and laughing with him.
A young lady curiously asked: "Brother Lin, does your company really have a market value of 200 billion?"
Lin Fan smiled: "Yes."
The young lady looked shocked: "200 billion, my god, I don’t even have 10,000 bucks, what’s the concept of 200 billion!"
"Brother Lin is so rich!"
"The amount of wealth is simply unimaginable."
Ning Xiaoyue suddenly thought of something and laughed: "How much is 200 billion, if you won the lottery jackpot of 5 million every day, how many days would it take to reach 200 billion?"
This question immediately caught the girls’ interest, and they quickly pulled out their phones, opened the calculator, and started calculating.
"200 billion, if we won 5 million every day, we would need to win for 40,000 days. A year has 365 days, which means, winning 5 million every day, continuously for 109 years!"
This conclusion left the girls dumbfounded.
"My god, that’s insane!"
"Winning a jackpot once in a lifetime is already a rare luck!"
"And Brother Lin, winning continuously for 109 years..."
"Oh my god, winning jackpot for so many years, wouldn’t you get tired?"
All the girls were overwhelmed.
Lin Fan hadn’t actually calculated this before, but after what they said, he realized that 200 billion is indeed a lot.
But a market value of 200 billion is still far from enough for him.
The task given to him by the system is to build a trillion-dollar business empire.
The girls got excited from the calculation of 200 billion. After all, that’s the allure of money.
Who doesn’t love money?
Especially this much money.
At this point, they happened to be walking past a lottery shop.
A young lady suggested: "How about we go in and buy a lottery ticket, see if we can win something?"
This proposal received unanimous agreement from the girls, the thought of possibly winning made them even more excited.
Ning Xiaoyue asked Lin Fan: "Brother Lin, do you want to buy a ticket too?"
Lin Fan wanted to say that lottery is mostly a scam, the odds of an ordinary person winning the jackpot are one in ten million, but that’s just theoretical, in reality, the chances might be zero.
However, seeing the girls so enthusiastic, Lin Fan didn’t want to dampen their spirits.
"Sure, count me in for a ticket too." Lin Fan said with a smile.
So they entered the lottery shop.
The lottery shop was quite busy, well, lottery shops are usually doing well, most of the customers are middle-aged men.
The dream of getting rich overnight holds a deadly allure for people, especially middle-aged men, who have experienced setbacks in reality and feel powerless in life, they pin their hopes on this game to change their lives.
But how many actually win, more people not only don’t win but also spend a lot of their own money making their already not well-off lives even harder.
Yet that one in a million chance continues to attract people tirelessly, charging forward...
Ning Xiaoyue went to the counter and bought five lottery tickets, one for each of them.
Ning Xiaoyue distributed the lottery tickets to everyone.
"Brother Lin, this one’s yours." Ning Xiaoyue handed a ticket to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took it and casually put it in his pocket since he didn’t believe he would win.
The four girls, however, held their tickets like treasures, with a face of reverence.
"Please bless us, if only we could win the 5 million it’d be great."
"I’m not asking for the jackpot, just the second prize with tens of thousands would be very satisfying."
"Hey, what would you do if you really won 5 million?"
This question intrigued the girls.
"First, I’d take out a hundred thousand for my parents, let them build a house in our hometown."
"Same here, first I’d give it to my parents. My dad’s not well, but he won’t spend money on hospitals. If there’s money, I’ll get him the best doctors!"
"I don’t particularly want anything, but 5 million feels like a lot, I’d save it in the bank and count the zeros every day, just thinking about it feels amazing."
The three girls all looked at Ning Xiaoyue, she was the only one who hadn’t said.
Ning Xiaoyue said without hesitation: "I want to buy a house, a big house, that’s my dream."
Ning Xiaoyue’s dream is simple, to buy herself a house in a big city.
But...
Nowadays, property prices are really expensive, often several million per square meter, a hundred-meter apartment could cost millions.
With their current income, it’s as difficult as reaching the sky.
Even if they hit the jackpot of 5 million, they could only buy a regular apartment, wanting anything better would cost millions more.
Ning Xiaoyue was a bit embarrassed, asking Lin Fan: "Brother Lin, do you think my dream is particularly vulgar?"
Lin Fan said: "Not at all, I think your dream is especially real."
Ning Xiaoyue’s dream of buying a house may not seem like a lofty ideal, but it is the most practical dream for ordinary people, one that they may spend their whole lives trying to achieve.
Ning Xiaoyue was comforted that Lin Fan didn’t think her dream was vulgar. She actually thought it was a bit vulgar herself, but she couldn’t help it, it was her dream, and she wouldn’t lie about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 235: Not Good, There’s a Bug in the System!
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 235: Not Good, There’s a Bug in the System!
Ning Xiaoyue also knew that the chances of winning the lottery were very slim, but they were all willing to indulge in a little fantasy.
At this moment, the girls fantasized about winning the lottery to change their destinies, seemingly unaware that the competition they were about to participate in was indeed a chance to change their fate.
Perhaps they would seize this opportunity to soar high, just like hitting the jackpot.
After buying the lottery tickets, they left the lottery shop, and soon after, Lin Fan parted ways with the four girls and drove off in a Rolls-Royce.
Lin Fan first made a trip to the hospital to visit his third uncle, Lin Dawei, and then returned to his rented apartment in the urban village.
He hadn’t returned to Yunding Manor for the past two days, choosing instead to stay in the city. Although he could have stayed at Tangchen Yipin, he found it too spacious and felt a bit lonely being there alone.
The small apartment in the urban village felt more comforting to him.
Returning to the apartment, night had already fallen, and the day was drawing to a close.
Lin Fan suddenly remembered that the system hadn’t prompted him to check-in today!
No check-in, no reward!
The system usually reminded Lin Fan to check-in daily, and upon doing so, rewards would follow. Normally, check-ins occurred in the morning, but now night had fallen, and still no check-in!
"What happened? Did the system break down?"
Lin Fan was surprised and began to speculate.
There were several possibilities for why the system hadn’t prompted a check-in today.
One was that today’s prompt was merely delayed, but the system was okay and would definitely prompt a check-in before the day ended.
Another possibility was that the system paused today’s check-in rewards, which might be a pattern where it pauses occasionally, and this was the first pause Lin Fan encountered.
This assumption was imaginative, but lacked convincing power.
Then there was the possibility that the system truly had a malfunction, and if that were the case, it would be quite a predicament.
Because this isn’t an ordinary malfunction that just anyone could fix.
Lin Fan waited all night without receiving a system prompt.
Night fell, and he lay in bed, drowsy, continuing to wait.
Eventually, he fell asleep as the last second ticked by, entering a new day in the next second.
However, the system remained silent.
The first possibility was ruled out, as there was indeed no prompt before the day ended, indicating no delay from the system.
The other two possibilities remained, but it was difficult to determine which was accurate.
Lin Fan slept until daylight.
The next day, sunlight streamed through the window, warming his back, and Lin Fan suddenly woke up, glancing outside.
He couldn’t help but chuckle wryly: "It’s already the second day, huh? So there really was no check-in reward yesterday. What exactly is going on?"
Ever since gaining the system, Lin Fan had received check-in prompts daily, followed by top-tier rewards upon successful check-in.
Sometimes, by completing system-issued tasks, he would earn an extra reward, which was truly generous.
But yesterday, the entire day passed with the system asleep—it didn’t issue any check-in rewards or new tasks.
This was the first time such an occurrence happened, and it was genuinely bizarre!
Lin Fan was dumbfounded.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: Today’s system can be checked in. Checking in grants top-tier Koi Carp Luck as a reward. Would you like to check in?"
Lin Fan was delighted; the system finally responded!
It seemed it wasn’t broken!
Lin Fan was about to check in.
However!
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. Top-tier Koi Carp Luck has been delivered. Please check your rewards."
Lin Fan was stunned as he hadn’t even confirmed the check-in, yet it had already completed.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: Today’s system can be checked in. Checking in grants top-tier Koi Carp Luck as a reward. Would you like to check in?"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. Top-tier Koi Carp Luck has been delivered. Please check your rewards..."
What the heck!
Lin Fan was frozen as the system began to endlessly repeat these prompts...
Lin Fan couldn’t get the system to quiet down.
As a result, these system prompt sounds played repeatedly in his mind and ears.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: Today’s system can be checked in. Checking in grants top-tier Koi Carp Luck as a reward. Would you like to check in?"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. Top-tier luck has been delivered. Please check your rewards..."
After who knows how many loops.
"Ding!"
"System promxxxxxx..."
Suddenly, the system’s voice changed, as if a tape had malfunctioned. The sound twisted and became unintelligible as though it were heavily distorted and lagged.
After a while, the sound gradually quieted until it abruptly vanished.
The whole world seemed to fall silent.
Lin Fan was frustrated. This... could only mean the system had undoubtedly encountered a bug.
As for what exactly went wrong, he had no idea, let alone how to fix it.
It seemed he could only wait for the system to repair itself; he had no other options.
Now the question was, did the previously mentioned reward of top-tier luck for Lin Fan before the system bug still count?
Due to the system glitch, Lin Fan wasn’t in the mood and, besides a visit to the hospital to see his third uncle, he stayed in the apartment all day.
During that time, Wang Xiangqian sent Lin Fan a WeChat message saying he’d taken the four girls to the train station for them to head to their talent show recording.
Wang Xiangqian sent Lin Fan a photo of the four girls’ backs, each accompanied by a suitcase.
These were the suitcases Lin Fan had gifted them last night.
Lin Fan replied to Wang Xiangqian: "Wish them good luck."
A day passed, and night fell again.
It was time for the lottery draw.
The lottery shop where Lin Fan and the four girls had bought tickets the day before erupted with excitement after the draw.
"Oh my God, a first prize has been won here!" The owner jumped up, nearly ecstatic with joy.
It was the first time since opening this shop that a first prize had been won, a clear indication of future profits flooding in.
The news spread rapidly, and both inside and outside of the shop buzzed with excitement.
Once people learned that someone had won a first prize at this shop, a flood of people arrived, eager to tap into the luck.
Many people wanted to share in the luck and spent money at the shop, so the owner was delighted, earning to the point of laughing in his sleep.
"Who won the grand prize?" someone couldn’t help but ask.
The owner tried to recall, saying, "I don’t know who exactly, but I vaguely remember it was a young man.
As the lottery draw happened, Lin Fan, however, had fallen asleep. After a day of doing nothing, the wealthy lifestyle was dull, so sleep overtook him easily.
The lottery ticket purchased yesterday was casually tossed aside by him, yet the numbers on the ticket were exactly the same as the first prize numbers...
Was this... the top-tier Koi Carp Luck at work?
Lin Fan had no awareness of this.
He never believed in winning the lottery, so the ticket was casually discarded, and he didn’t follow the draw results.
Thus, despite having already won the 5 million first prize, he remained unaware.
The next day, upon waking, Lin Fan was still intent on checking if the system had returned to normal.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. A reward of 5 million has been delivered. Please check your account."
Lin Fan was taken aback, "What? A direct check-in success, and an award of 5 million?"
Ding-dong!
A notification from the bank indicated freshly credited 5 million to Lin Fan’s account!
And it wasn’t just once!
The next day.
The same thing happened.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, check-in successful. A reward of 5 million has been delivered. Please check your account."
On the third day, the fourth day...
In the days that followed.
Lin Fan received 5 million in his account every day...

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Winning ¥5 million is such a hassle, still need to claim the prize
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 326: Winning ¥5 million is such a hassle, still need to claim the prize
After that, every day Lin Fan received a system reward of 5 million yuan. A week went by just like that, and Lin Fan’s bank account had already increased by 35 million yuan in cash.
Lin Fan didn’t know whether to laugh or cry about this.
This bug in the system was really something else. At this rate, in 10 days, he’d have 50 million yuan, and in 100 days, he’d have 500 million yuan.
It’s like hitting the lottery jackpot every day.
But even 500 million yuan isn’t considered much to Lin Fan now.
So even though this bug is quite something, Lin Fan would still prefer the system to return to normal. For him, who doesn’t lack money, getting 5 million yuan every day doesn’t mean much anymore.
However, he had no way to fix this bug.
He could only wait for the system to automatically repair itself.
A week passed, and there were no signs of the system being repaired, which left Lin Fan not knowing whether to laugh or cry and unsure of what to do.
Receiving 5 million yuan every day, hearing the bank notification message, Lin Fan was becoming a bit numb.
In this week, Lin Fan didn’t have much to do. Besides being busy with company matters, he lived the boring life of a wealthy person.
Meanwhile, the lottery shop where Lin Fan bought his ticket that night was still looking for the winner. A week had passed since the jackpot was won, yet the winner still hadn’t appeared.
Everyone speculated about the reason.
"Maybe the person doesn’t even know they won!"
"Maybe they lost the ticket."
"No way, leaving 5 million behind unclaimed, if it were me, that would be great."
Everyone sighed and lamented, pounding their chests, wishing they were the winner.
More and more people flocked to the lottery shop to catch some luck, and the shop’s business was booming. The shop owner was overjoyed and didn’t have the time to look for the winner.
At this time, Ning Xiaoyue and her three friends had just finished a week of recording, and their phones had been taken away for the whole week.
Now they finally had a break and got their phones back.
The first thing they did was to check their lottery tickets.
All four girls were still thinking about buying the lottery that night.
Naturally, they all dreamed about winning.
The three were a bit nervous. The winning numbers for that draw had already been announced, and each of them pulled out their tickets to check.
Then, one by one, they were disappointed.
None of the four girls won anything, let alone a first or second prize; they didn’t even win 5 yuan.
The four girls let out a chorus of sighs.
"The dream of getting rich overnight is shattered!"
"My 5 million!"
"Oh my God, why not me!"
"Seems like we still need to work hard to earn money ourselves, but the thing is, I’m too tired, I don’t want to work hard!"
The girls were pounding their chests and lamenting.
Ning Xiaoyue thought of something and said, "Oh right, I wonder if Brother Lin claimed his prize yet?"
The other three girls immediately got interested: "Right, I wonder if Brother Lin won anything!"
"I don’t think it’s likely though. After all, none of us four won, why would he win?"
"Yeah, the odds are too low. Brother Lin couldn’t have won, right?"
They all felt that Lin Fan probably wouldn’t win.
Ning Xiaoyue said, "Let me call Brother Lin and ask!"
So, Ning Xiaoyue called Lin Fan.
The call got through, Ning Xiaoyue laughed and said, "Brother Lin!"
Lin Fan was a bit surprised, "Oh, it’s Xiaoyue. What brings you to call me; how’s the recording going over there, are you getting used to it?"
Ning Xiaoyue said, "It’s okay, just a bit tired because we have to rehearse every day, and we couldn’t use our phones. They took them away, and we only got them back today during the break, but tomorrow we have to start recording again."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Keep it up, remember what I told you, just be your real self."
Ning Xiaoyue said, "Okay, I got it. By the way, Brother Lin, about the lottery tickets we bought together that night, did you check yours yet? We just checked ours, and none of us won. I was wondering if you did?"
Lin Fan said, "Oh that... I forgot all about it until you mentioned it. I haven’t checked yet, and I don’t even know where I threw the ticket. Hold on, let me look."
Ning Xiaoyue was a bit sweat-dropped, thinking Brother Lin must indeed be a wealthy person, being so unconcerned about lottery tickets. No wonder, even 5 million isn’t much to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan, who had just woken up, found his room a bit messy. After some effort, he finally found the lottery ticket beside the trash can, where it had gathered some dust over the days.
"Found it, it’s next to the trash can," Lin Fan said.
Ning Xiaoyue wiped her cold sweat and said, "Alright, Brother Lin, read it out loud, and I’ll check for you."
Lin Fan then started reading the numbers aloud.
The four girls gathered together, helping Lin Fan check the ticket.
With each number Lin Fan read, the girls’ hearts beat faster.
The first number matched.
The second number matched.
The third number matched.
The fourth number matched...
With four numbers matching, the girls were already so nervous they were nearly having heart attacks. Excited, they thought, gosh, could it be that Brother Lin really won?
The fifth number matched...
The sixth number matched...
The four girls looked at each other, all shocked.
All six red numbers matched for Lin Fan!
Only the last blue number was left, and if it matched too, Lin Fan would win the jackpot!
Even if the blue number didn’t match, Lin Fan would still win second prize, which comes with hundreds of thousands in prize money.
The girls’ tension reached unprecedented heights.
Then, Lin Fan reported the blue number.
Incredibly...
It matched too!
"Ah!"
The four girls let out screams of excitement.
The jackpot was won!
Lin Fan hit the lottery jackpot!
"Oh my God, Brother Lin is way too lucky!"
"Brother Lin is already so rich, and he wins another 5 million. I’m dying of envy!"
"Boohoo, how can he be so lucky, could he be the lucky koi?"
"If only I had even one percent of Brother Lin’s luck."
The girls all exclaimed enviously.
On the other end of the phone, Lin Fan found out he won the jackpot, but he felt indifferent, lacking any excitement. After all, with the system giving him 5 million every day, it’s like hitting the lottery jackpot every day.
If you had an income of 5 million yuan every day, finding out you won a 5 million lottery jackpot once would feel just as underwhelming as it did for Lin Fan.
However, Lin Fan did think of something else. The reason he won the jackpot might be related to the top-tier Koi Carp Luck from the system’s bug reward.
This top-tier Koi Carp Luck was issued during the system bug and, unexpectedly, it worked.
That was somewhat interesting.
"Brother Lin, congratulations. You’re really too lucky. We bought those tickets together that night, and none of us won, but you hit the jackpot," Ning Xiaoyue said with a smile, not hiding her envy at all.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It is a bit lucky, but don’t be discouraged. Your luck in this program, perform well, and be your own lucky koi."
Ning Xiaoyue was very encouraged and said, "Yes, I understand, I will work hard."
After hanging up the call, Lin Fan looked at the lottery ticket in his hand, feeling a bit disdainful: "What a hassle, I still have to go claim the prize."

chapters.title: Chapter 327: At the Prize Redemption Event, Lin Fan is Despised by a Lucky Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 327: At the Prize Redemption Event, Lin Fan is Despised by a Lucky Man
Ring ring ring...
Lin Fan’s phone suddenly rang again.
It was Liu Mengjie calling: "Little Fan, are you free to come to school for class today?"
Lin Fan worked as a substitute piano teacher at Yun City Music Academy, but he’d been a bit busy lately, not attending classes every day, so Liu Mengjie would call every day to ask, to better arrange the schedule.
Lin Fan couldn’t possibly teach every day, but he was a musical genius; both teachers and students were happy to accommodate Lin Fan’s schedule.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, I can go today. I’ll head over in a bit."
Liu Mengjie was delighted: "Shall we schedule the class for 10 a.m.?"
"No problem," Lin Fan agreed cheerfully.
After hanging up, Lin Fan tidied up a bit and went out, preparing to head to the school.
Passing through a neighborhood, Lin Fan felt it was familiar, recalling it was near the place where he’d bought a lottery ticket that night, so he decided to redeem it along the way, saving himself a trip later.
So Lin Fan drove to the entrance of that lottery shop.
The lottery store’s business was booming, customers were coming in non-stop, and the entrance was almost worn out.
Everyone was busy buying lottery tickets, and no one noticed Lin Fan’s arrival.
The entrance was jam-packed, and as he entered, Lin Fan was jostled from behind, bumping into an uncle in front. The uncle turned his head and angrily scolded, "Are you blind?"
Lin Fan didn’t bother arguing, and just said, "Sorry!"
The uncle cursed as he walked away.
Lin Fan entered the store and saw people queuing at the counter, so he got in line to wait.
"Ah, I won, I won!"
Suddenly, a burst of delighted shouting came from the side, instantly drawing everyone’s attention.
It turned out that someone was playing a type of instant lottery where you just scratch off the coating to see whether you win.
The man who shouted in excitement was in his thirties, and he had just won 100,000 yuan.
It quickly drew the envy of the crowd.
"Wow, so envious!"
"Someone actually won 100,000 yuan!"
"Another winner, it seems this place is truly blessed with good luck! All thanks to the person who hit the five million jackpot!"
"This guy successfully rode the wave of luck; we don’t know when we’ll succeed!"
Voices of envy echoed among the crowd.
The man who had won the prize was not pleased to hear this.
"What are you all saying? My win has nothing to do with anyone else. I won because of my own good luck, not because I piggybacked on someone else’s luck!" the lucky man said proudly.
"I’m different from you guys; I’m not here to ride on someone else’s fortune. Luck resides with me personally! Let’s be honest, my luck is absolutely better than the person who won 5 million!"
"Compared to me, the guy with the 5-million jackpot is just a weakling!"
The lucky man proclaimed.
On hearing this, people around him shook their heads and sighed.
This guy might be a bit too arrogant.
He only won 100,000, while others hit a 5-million jackpot. Where does he find the nerve to call others weaklings!
The lucky man saw the disbelief in people’s faces and continued to boast: "Don’t doubt me, I guarantee none of you riding on that guy’s luck will win. Tell me, did any of you win?"
Everyone fell silent.
Indeed, no one riding on that luck had won anything this past week.
Therefore, the lucky man concluded: "You’re all here to piggyback on that person’s luck, yet no one won, but I, who did not rely on his luck, won instead. This proves that person’s luck is used up. Now I’m the one with great fortune!"
People glanced at each other, starting to doubt and consider his words.
What he said made sense, maybe the person who hit the jackpot really had run out of luck, and they couldn’t benefit from it after all.
The lucky man added: "Don’t doubt me, have you seen that jackpot winner come to claim their prize? No, right? What does that mean? It means his luck is depleted, he encountered obstacles, preventing him from claiming the prize, hence the saying ’joy at its peak turns to sorrow.’"
On hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but nod. The lucky man’s analysis was so convincing, it was hard not to believe him.
Only Lin Fan knew that the so-called lucky man was talking nonsense.
Lin Fan hadn’t claimed his prize yet simply because he never took the lottery ticket seriously, and besides, wasn’t he here now?
"Hey bro, you say you’re currently blessed with great fortune, right? So you’re the luckiest one here?" Lin Fan smiled and asked.
The lucky man glanced at Lin Fan, dressed in market-stall clothing!
Another poor guy trying to change his fate through lottery tickets!
The lucky man sneered, "Little brother, you’re right, I am the luckiest person here. Do you have any objections?"
Lin Fan said, "I actually do have a different opinion. I don’t think you’re the luckiest one here. You’ve only won 100,000; it’s best to be humble."
The lucky man chuckled, "Only 100,000, you say? Who are you to say that? How much have you won? I see you in market-stall clothes; you probably can’t even afford proper clothing. I’ve seen plenty of people like you, the most miserable in the world, yearning to change their fate through lottery tickets — keep dreaming!"
The crowd burst into laughter.
Indeed, Lin Fan didn’t look like a lucky person at all.
Lin Fan ignored the lucky man as it was his turn now.
"Shop owner, I’d like a scratch-off ticket," Lin Fan said.
The shop owner said, "Alright, 10 yuan per ticket."
The shop owner didn’t care about the argument; as long as they were spending money, the more noise the better.
Lin Fan paid 10 yuan for an instant lottery ticket.
Immediately, everyone’s attention turned to the lottery ticket, waiting to see Lin Fan’s result.
Lin Fan used his fingernail to scratch off the coating.
The lucky man sneered, "You really think you can win? Keep dreaming; you’re going to get slapped by reality soon. If you scratch off more than 100,000, I’ll give you my 100,000! Otherwise, you kneel and call me daddy, how about that?"
That was a fresh play, and everyone suddenly got interested.
Lin Fan smiled, "Is that so? Everyone’s listening, and they can serve as witnesses. If I scratch off more than 100,000, your 100,000 will be mine, no backing out."
The lucky man chuckled, "Why would I back out? Just make sure you don’t back out, prepare to kneel and call me daddy. I’ll show you who’s the daddy!"
Lin Fan didn’t respond, he focused on scratching it carefully.
In the meantime.
Ultimate Koi Carp Luck, activated!
Finally, the coating was completely scratched off, and everyone eagerly leaned in, curious about Lin Fan’s result.
Lin Fan picked up the lottery ticket, displayed it to everyone, and then placed it in front of the shop owner.
"Ah!"
The shop owner exclaimed.
"A prize of 250,000, the highest prize level!" the shop owner said excitedly.
What?
Everyone was stunned.
The lucky man was completely dumbfounded.
"Wait a minute!" the shop owner added.
Kidding, everyone’s heart skipped a beat.
The lucky man laughed, "Must be a mistake, right? I told you, how could this guy have better luck than me!"
The shop owner, voice trembling, said, "He scratched off a sequence that doubled the prize, the final prize is 500,000."
"Ah!"
The entire place erupted, the whole store was in an uproar, goodness, an instant lottery ticket, Lin Fan had scratched off a sky-high prize of 500,000!
The lucky man was frozen, his face turned pale, as if he’d been struck by lightning.
Lin Fan just smiled, then pulled out the lottery ticket from his pocket, placed it in front of the shop owner, and said, "Actually, I’m here to claim my prize today."
What?
The shop owner wiped cold sweat from his brow, seeing the numbers on the ticket, his whole body trembled with excitement, his trembling hand cradled the ticket.
It was him, it was him, it was really him!
"Are you, you’re the one who won the five million..." the shop owner stammered.
What?
With those words, the store fell silent, deathly quiet, everyone was already shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Everyone Reverently Bids Farewell to the Emperor of Europe
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 328: Everyone Reverently Bids Farewell to the Emperor of Europe
Lin Fan revealed the winning lottery ticket, and the whole place fell silent.
It turns out Lin Fan was the winner, and these people were here to leech off his luck.
Just now, Lin Fan used a 500,000 yuan instant lottery ticket to tell everyone present that he is the Emperor of Europe, his luck hasn’t run out but has instead exploded with abundance. He casually bought an instant lottery ticket and won 500,000!
Lin Fan won a total of 5.5 million at this store!
The lucky guy who boasted about being the Luck King for winning 100,000 was now on his knees, his face swollen from the metaphorical slap, turning pale.
Faced with Lin Fan’s 5.5 million, his mere 100,000 seemed truly pathetic.
"He’s the lucky koi!"
"Truly blessed with extreme good luck!"
"He’s so lucky, I want to worship him!"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan with adoring expressions.
The uncle who got bumped by Lin Fan earlier was angry before, but now he was on his knees.
"I got bumped by the King of Luck, I must’ve caught some of it, I’ve decided not to bathe for the next three months!" announced the uncle.
Upon hearing this, everyone cast envious glances his way.
They themselves wished to be bumped by Lin Fan, even if Lin Fan kicked them, they’d be thrilled, as it meant they could catch some luck.
Lin Fan was both laughable and helpless, thinking these people were either fools or mad, after all, those who hang out at lottery stores all day dreaming of getting rich overnight are somewhat fanatical, they’re a bunch of gambling fanatics.
After redeeming his prize, Lin Fan left the lottery store.
With 5.5 million in winnings, minus taxes, he’d still have several million left. This amount meant nothing to him, especially since he now received 5 million in rewards daily.
Many chased after Lin Fan as he left the store, watching the holy Emperor of Europe in their minds drive away.
When everyone saw Lin Fan getting into an 8 million yuan Rolls-Royce, they all dropped to their knees.
Damn!
Lin Fan was really a wealthy person, driving a car more expensive than the lottery jackpot...
Having so much money was one thing, but luckier than ever, buying a lottery ticket and immediately winning, and winning the jackpot, what lottery veteran wouldn’t envy this luck!
The boastful lucky guy was now thoroughly humbled, unable even to have touched a car worth 8 million yuan. Compared to Lin Fan, he truly seemed like nothing...
Under the worshipful gazes of everyone, Lin Fan drove away from the lottery store, heading towards the school.
Yun City Music Academy.
Lin Fan parked outside the school and walked onto the campus.
In the campus, came the sound of cheerful noise. It turned out there was a group playing basketball on the court beside the path, with many students watching.
Lin Fan wasn’t interested in basketball, glanced over, and didn’t bother to look again. However, he noticed that the people playing basketball seemed unfamiliar, as if they weren’t from the school.
Suddenly, amid the fierce contention among those people, the basketball was thrown away, flying towards the path briskly.
A female student passing by in front screamed in fright, as the basketball was about to hit her directly.
Lin Fan reacted quickly, reached out, and grabbed the girl’s elbow, pulling her back to avoid the basketball.
The girl, still shaken, turned to look at Lin Fan, her face instantly flushed: "Teacher Lin."
This girl turned out to be Chu Xiaoxiao!
Because of matters at home, Chu Xiaoxiao had been staying at the school for the past few days. She had just finished gym class and was planning to return to her dorm when out of nowhere, a basketball flew her way.
If it weren’t for Lin Fan, she would have been hit by the basketball, and that would have been unpleasant.
What Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t expect was that the one saving her again this time, was Teacher Lin.
Since knowing Lin Fan, Chu Xiaoxiao had been helped by him numerous times, including her family matters and disputes with Jia Xueling. Jia Xueling had bullied her many times, but recently, for some unknown reason, Jia Xueling would try to avoid her whenever they met. She guessed it mostly has to do with Teacher Lin.
Even though she was frightened just now, after seeing Teacher Lin, she wasn’t scared of anything, only left with a shy and sweet feeling.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, were you scared?"
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head: "No, thank you, Teacher Lin."
Lin Fan said, "No need to thank me. Be careful when walking in the future and look around more; danger is everywhere."
Chu Xiaoxiao felt very warm inside; Teacher Lin was so warm-hearted, and Lin Fan was also very handsome and talented, simply the most perfect boy in the world.
Thinking of this, Chu Xiaoxiao blushed again.
"Hey, throw the ball back for us!" someone shouted from the basketball court.
Just now, the basketball had bounced off the roadside curb and stopped beside Chu Xiaoxiao.
At this moment, Chu Xiaoxiao only had eyes for Lin Fan, she had no time to pay attention to them, moreover, the ball almost hit her just now, and they didn’t come to apologize but rather ordered her to throw the ball back with such an imperious tone. She wasn’t going to do it.
Seeing that Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t respond.
The basketball-playing youngsters were immediately displeased.
"Hey, we’re talking to you, are you deaf?"
"Hurry up, we need to keep playing!"
"Don’t talk to the pretty girl like that; I think she’s quite pretty, perfect to be my girlfriend. Pretty girl, I’ll give you a choice: be my girlfriend or toss the ball back to us?" A young man with dyed blonde hair said, eyeing Chu Xiaoxiao lewdly.
The group burst into laughter.
The surrounding students watching also laughed along.
Chu Xiaoxiao felt offended, both angry and scared.
Lin Fan gave her a reassuring look and walked over, picked up the basketball and held it without throwing it back.
Suddenly, all eyes were on Lin Fan.
Some students from Yun City Music Academy recognized Lin Fan.
"It’s Teacher Lin!" the students said excitedly.
Lin Fan is a piano genius; which student or teacher at the school doesn’t admire Lin Fan?
But the young men playing basketball clearly didn’t know Lin Fan.
"Hey, kid, what are you standing there for? Throw the ball over!" the blonde-haired guy yelled, clapping his hands.
Lin Fan said calmly, "If you want the ball, can’t you just come over and get it yourself?"
This remark instantly angered the young men, the blonde guy’s face darkened as he said, "We’re telling you to throw it here, will you or won’t you?"
"Looking at him, he probably can’t even throw the ball with enough strength, throwing it over might be an issue!"
"Stop giving him a hard time; he obviously can’t play basketball."
The young men laughed uproariously.
The students present felt somewhat embarrassed; Teacher Lin is a piano genius, but maybe he’s really not good at basketball, getting laughed at, well, there’s nothing to be done.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "I can throw it to you, but you almost hit this student just now, so you should come over and apologize first."
The young men burst into laughter.
The blonde-haired guy chuckled and said, "What did you say, did I hear it right? You want us to apologize to this little girl?"

chapters.title: Chapter 329: One Ball Seals the Divine, Everyone Knelt
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 329: One Ball Seals the Divine, Everyone Knelt
This Blonde Hair seems to be the leader of the group, and his attitude represents the attitude of these punks.
Lin Fan said, "Not only should you apologize, but your tone should also be more respectful. If there’s any more offense, I’ll confiscate this ball."
Blonde Hair got angry, "Where did this punk come from? Do you know who we are? You’re courting death by daring to mess with us!"
Chu Xiaoxiao was a bit scared and softly advised, "Teacher Lin, maybe let it be. These people are punks from outside the school; it’s best not to mess with them."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s fine."
He really didn’t take these punks seriously.
Seeing Lin Fan still unwilling to throw the ball over, a group of young guys grew furious, and Blonde Hair led the charge toward Lin Fan.
The students started to worry upon seeing this. Teacher Lin was very tough, but these punks were troublemakers. Anyone who messed with them would get bullied. Although Teacher Lin was a teacher, without background, he would still be bullied by these punks.
Blonde Hair soon led his group to corner Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Hand over the ball!" Blonde Hair shouted.
Lin Fan said, "Apologize first."
"Apologize my ass!" Blonde Hair cursed, lunging to grab the ball.
Lin Fan lightly dodged, letting Blonde Hair lunge into empty space.
Blonde Hair got angry and simply threw a punch, aiming for Lin Fan’s face.
Everyone was shocked at the sight. This punk actually went for physical assault, and it seemed Teacher Lin was about to be beaten up.
But, as Blonde Hair approached, Lin Fan lifted his knee, hitting Blonde Hair right in the belly.
Blonde Hair winced in pain, almost popping out his eyeballs, his face turning blue, and his body curling up like a shrimp, falling to the ground.
The other young guys had intended to swarm him but were now frightened and changed their expressions, not daring to come closer and get beaten.
Lin Fan was too strong; he practically wiped out Blonde Hair instantly.
Everyone was astonished; Teacher Lin’s moves were too cool. They didn’t expect Teacher Lin to be so impressive!
Lin Fan stepped on Blonde Hair’s head, pinning him to the ground, and smiled, "How about it, want to consider an apology?"
Blonde Hair’s dignity was wiped out, but facing Lin Fan, he couldn’t even struggle, pinned under Lin Fan’s foot, unable to move, his stomach still hurting.
Blonde Hair was shocked, realizing he had messed with someone he shouldn’t have.
"Apologize, we’ll apologize, okay?" Blonde Hair hastily begged for mercy. Lin Fan’s foot felt as heavy as a mountain. If he didn’t comply, his head might be crushed.
Only then did Lin Fan lift his foot, allowing Blonde Hair to get up.
With the help of his companions, Blonde Hair got up.
"Sorry, student, we almost hit you earlier and spoke rudely. We deeply regret it, we’re really sorry, please forgive us." Blonde Hair lowered his head to Chu Xiaoxiao.
The other young guys also quickly apologized.
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed a little, but felt sweetness inside. Thanks to Teacher Lin, if it weren’t for him, these punks wouldn’t have bowed to her; they wouldn’t just refuse to apologize, they would bully her.
She nodded, indicating she wouldn’t hold it against them.
The group of young guys breathed a sigh of relief, glad that Chu Xiaoxiao was willing to forgive them.
They then looked at Lin Fan, ready to see how he would deal with them.
Since Chu Xiaoxiao forgave them, Lin Fan should return the ball to them, right?
Lin Fan said, "That’s how it should be. If you did something wrong, you should apologize. By the way, what were you saying earlier? Saying I don’t have the strength and can’t play ball?"
Blonde Hair and his crew broke out in a cold sweat. Yes, earlier they had also spoken rudely to Lin Fan.
Blonde Hair quickly said, "I’m sorry."
Lin Fan chuckled and casually tossed the ball. Having taken Strengthening Capsules, his power was immense; the ball soared out, cutting through the air with a whistling sound.
At the same time.
Top-level Koi Carp Luck activated!
The ball headed towards the basket opposite and miraculously scored.
Everyone was stunned.
Tossing it that far was crazy impressive, but to actually score...
Thud.
Blonde Hair and his crew fell to their knees, awestruck. What kind of person had they provoked? A god, surely!
Lin Fan’s throw just now was simply too strong. Even the world’s best basketball stars might not be able to do it!
Even if Lin Fan was just lucky to score, that kind of luck was unparalleled.
"Let’s go." Lin Fan turned to Chu Xiaoxiao and said, then led her towards the academic building under the worshipful gazes of the crowd.
"So cool, Teacher Lin is really so cool!"
A group of female students was swooning over Lin Fan’s departing figure; for a moment, they were all envious of Chu Xiaoxiao. They almost wished they’d been the ones nearly hit by the ball so Lin Fan could rescue them heroically.
"Who exactly is he?" Blonde Hair was sweating profusely.
From then on, stories about this earth-shattering shot spread in school. Lin Fan became a god in the students’ minds.
Only Lin Fan knew that this amazing shot was thanks to top-level Koi Carp Luck.
Shooting hoops inherently involves some luck, especially with long-distance shots. Even the world’s best players can’t guarantee hitting every time.
In sports, there’s a term ’hit rate,’ referring to how many shots are made, for example, making 10 out of 100 means a hit rate of ten percent.
A fifty-percent hit rate is already world-class for top players.
So, shooting is both a technical skill and involves luck.
With top-level Koi Carp Luck, Lin Fan’s shots, compared to top basketball stars, could easily crush them.
Even names like Jordan, Curry, LeBron... would all seem inferior.
Facing top-level Koi Carp Luck, anything relying on luck, Lin Fan was unbeatable.
Deserving of the title ’Emperor of Europe.’
Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao away, arriving at the bottom of the academic building.
"Xiaoxiao, have you been doing well at school lately? Have you thought about going home?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Xiaoxiao had moved to live at school due to family issues. She was disappointed with her mother and stepfather; they tried to force her out of school to marry, which she couldn’t forgive.
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I don’t want to go home. I’m doing fine living at school."
Lin Fan understood and said, "Alright then, keep living at school."
Lin Fan didn’t have any good solution for this because if it were him, he wouldn’t forgive his parents either.
"But..." Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I want to go see my brother. I heard from the principal he’s already in the hospital."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s brother, Chu Xiaoming, had leukemia. Earlier, there were no funds for treatment, so her parents came up with misguided ideas to marry off Chu Xiaoxiao and use the bride-price money for treatment.
Later, Chu Xiaoxiao’s half-sister, Chu Yufei, agreed to cover the medical expenses, resolving the matter.
With the money, Chu Xiaoming was soon arranged to enter the hospital, preparing for a bone marrow transplant surgery.
Lin Fan asked, "Which hospital?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Yun City People’s Hospital, Teacher Lin, can you accompany me? I don’t really want to meet them alone."
’Them’ meant her mother, He Meifang, and stepfather, Chu Yuanhang.
Lin Fan understood her feelings and said, "Okay, once I finish teaching, I’ll take you to the hospital."
He intended to visit his third uncle Lin Dawei as well.
So, the two temporarily parted, agreeing to meet at the school gate, and Lin Fan went off to teach.
After finishing teaching, which was just before lunch, Lin Fan arrived at the school gate where Chu Xiaoxiao was already waiting for him.
Lin Fan went over, met with Chu Xiaoxiao, and was about to get in the car.
Suddenly, not far away, they saw a group of young guys pushing around a male student, led by a Blonde Hair.
It was the same group of punks that Lin Fan dealt with on the basketball court today.
These guys were still bullying people?

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Seeing Lin Fan is Like Seeing a Ghost
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 330: Seeing Lin Fan is Like Seeing a Ghost
Seeing a boy being pushed around by a group of hoodlums, Chu Xiaoxiao frowned and said, "It’s him. What’s going on? He seems to be bullied?"
Lin Fan said, "Do you know this boy?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Yeah, his name is Li Qixing. He’s in the same class as me. He’s quite good at studying, always focused and hardly talks to us. Everyone secretly calls him a bookworm. I don’t know why he would provoke these hooligans."
Lin Fan said, "Maybe it’s because these hooligans prefer to bully the honest ones. Xiaoxiao, let’s go and take a look."
"Okay." Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, she knew Teacher Lin was quite capable, and Lin Fan had dealt with these hooligans before.
The group of hooligans dragged Li Qixing into a corner.
There were actually a few male students waiting there.
Seeing Li Qixing brought over, the leading skinny tall guy laughed, "Li Qixing, you finally made it. Thanks, Brother Jin."
Blonde Hair said, "I brought him to you. Whatever business between you, settle it yourself. We’ll just watch the fun."
Skinny Tall Guy said, "Okay, Brother Jin."
Li Qixing looked terrified and said, "Ou Hao, I don’t want to fight with you. Don’t force me!"
Skinny Tall Guy sneered, "It’s not up to you now. Ever since you dared to defy me that day, this was bound to happen."
Li Qixing said fearfully, "Can’t I just apologize? Let’s just say it was my fault, and we’ll mind our own business from now on!"
Skinny Tall Guy said, "You think it’s up to you to decide? You defy me whenever you want and expect nothing to happen? Do you think you get to decide how this is handled? I call the shots!"
Li Qixing said, "Ou Hao, I warn you, my uncle is coming soon. Don’t do anything rash! I’m not talking to you anymore, I’m leaving!"
After saying this, Li Qixing turned to leave.
However, Blonde Hair and the hooligans blocked his way.
Blonde Hair laughed, "Kid, the matter isn’t resolved yet, don’t be in such a rush to leave. Did Brother Hao say you could go?"
Li Qixing involuntarily stepped back a few steps; he was really afraid of these hooligans.
Skinny Tall Guy Ou Hao gestured to the students next to him, "Beat him!"
A few students rushed forward, punching and kicking Li Qixing.
Li Qixing was forced to fight back, but being alone, how could he be a match for these people? Soon, he was only a target for their blows, desperately trying to defend himself, looking very miserable.
Blonde Hair and the others watched the spectacle, laughing loudly.
Not far away, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao were hiding nearby, watching the scene unfold.
"Teacher Lin, they’re fighting, what should we do?" Chu Xiaoxiao asked anxiously.
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay, I’m watching. This Ou Hao, is he from the school too?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Yeah, this guy is named Ou Hao, he’s a well-known little bully in the school. It’s said that his family has connections, so he knows the hooligans outside school. Many students have been bullied by him. I didn’t expect it to be Li Qixing’s turn this time."
Over there, Li Qixing was being beaten by Ou Hao and his gang, and soon got injured, his face bruised and swollen.
Li Qixing really wasn’t a match for them. In his panic, he suddenly reached into his coat and pulled out a fruit knife.
Ou Hao was just pouncing on him, fist raised to strike.
Li Qixing swung the fruit knife, stabbing towards Ou Hao.
Everything happened so suddenly that Ou Hao couldn’t dodge at all.
Seeing the knife about to pierce Ou Hao’s chest, even Blonde Hair and the others were shocked. They didn’t expect the fight to escalate so violently, but it was too late for them to save Ou Hao.
Just then.
Whoosh!
A small stone suddenly flew from the side, cutting through the air like a bullet.
In an instant, the stone struck the fruit knife in Li Qixing’s hand.
"Ah!"
Li Qixing screamed, and the fruit knife clattered to the ground as it fell from his hand, his wrist numbed and trembling.
The sight left everyone dumbfounded.
For a moment, everyone stopped and looked towards where the stone came from.
There they saw Lin Fan playing with a stone, walking over with Chu Xiaoxiao. It was evident that Lin Fan had just knocked the fruit knife out of Li Qixing’s hand.
Damn!
So impressive!
Blonde Hair and the hooligans, upon suddenly seeing Lin Fan, looked as if they had seen a ghost, their faces turning white.
That Lin Fan had knocked the fruit knife away was not surprising at all. Lin Fan was too strong; earlier in the morning, his shot was so precise it made people bow in awe.
Now that Lin Fan had precisely knocked away the fruit knife with a stone, it wasn’t surprising at all.
They naturally didn’t know, Lin Fan knocking away the fruit knife with a stone was also thanks to his top-level Koi Carp Luck, making it hit the mark every time.
What the hooligans feared most was that they had just done something bad again and coincidentally ran into Lin Fan; this time, they were in trouble.
But they didn’t even dare to run away, each of them trembling. The fear of being stomped by Lin Fan earlier in the morning surged again in their hearts.
Ou Hao and the other students’ faces also turned white.
"Teacher Lin!" Ou Hao blurted out.
Lin Fan was a substitute piano teacher at the school, a piano genius, and a prominent figure whom basically every student knew.
Being caught bullying a peer by a teacher made them instinctively fearful.
However, Ou Hao quickly regained his composure and said, "Teacher Lin, you’ve come at the right time. You see, this Li Qixing was about to stab me with a knife. Teacher Lin, you have to help us!"
Li Qixing’s face turned pale at this, his entire body trembling with fear. He had almost stabbed Ou Hao just now, and if that knife had hit, Ou Hao would surely have died, making him a murderer.
Lin Fan, seeing Ou Hao playing the victim first, was a bit speechless, "Why did I see you all ganging up on Li then?"
Ou Hao’s expression changed, and he chuckled, "Teacher Lin, I know you play the piano well, and everyone in school respects you, but you shouldn’t say things carelessly. Some things said could have serious consequences, and I’m afraid Teacher Lin might not be able to bear them."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, should I interpret this as a threat?"
Ou Hao laughed, "There’s no need to say everything so plainly. As long as Teacher Lin understands. I might as well tell Teacher Lin that my dad runs a nightclub."
This was undoubtedly a threat, a blatant threat.
Relying on his father running a nightclub and knowing many people, especially some tough guys, Ou Hao didn’t really regard Lin Fan as a teacher.
What if Lin Fan was a teacher? If Ou Hao was displeased, he would still deal with him without hesitation!
Lin Fan smiled, "So what if your dad runs a nightclub? Does that give you the right to bully classmates here?"
Ou Hao was furious, "Lin Fan, stop putting on airs here. You’re just a lousy teacher. I respect you a little, so you should know when to back off. Don’t be foolish!"
This was too arrogant.
This Ou Hao was a student and dared to confront a teacher like this.
But Blonde Hair and the hooligans didn’t think Ou Hao was impressive. If it had been another teacher, they might have thought Ou Hao was cool and even joined in egging him on.
But now that it was Lin Fan, Blonde Hair and the hooligans all looked at Ou Hao with sympathetic eyes, knowing he might be in trouble for crossing Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: These slaps are on behalf of your parents.
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 331: These slaps are on behalf of your parents.
Ou Hao, relying on his father running a nightclub and knowing many shady characters, became a notorious delinquent at school.
Many students had been bullied by Ou Hao, but most of them chose to endure silently, not daring to cross him.
Because of this, Ou Hao became even more arrogant, and now he’s even bold enough to bully teachers.
After all, just like students, teachers without any backing are just weaklings, how could they stand up to Ou Hao’s nightclub-owning father?
Initially, Ou Hao only hinted to Lin Fan not to meddle, but after Lin Fan "failed to appreciate his kindness," Ou Hao outright threatened him.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "What, are you guys even going to hit a teacher now? Ou Hao, no matter how you threaten me, I’m going to say that you guys are ganging up on Li."
Ou Hao arrogantly said, "You’re just as ignorant as Li Qixing, refusing a toast only to drink a forfeit. Don’t think that just because you’re a teacher, I won’t dare to hit you!"
Lin Fan replied, "You can try."
Ou Hao was really going to hit a teacher, Blonde Hair felt uneasy, signaled to a few thugs, planning to sneak away. They didn’t want to stay there, lest they get caught up in trouble."
"Did I say you could leave?" Lin Fan said calmly, glancing at Blonde Hair.
Blonde Hair shivered, quickly signaling the group of thugs not to leave. Without Lin Fan’s permission, they really didn’t dare to leave, or else if the stone in Lin Fan’s hand hit, he feared his head would burst.
Ou Hao felt a bit strange, why did it seem like Blonde Hair was very afraid of Lin Fan?
However, he didn’t pay much attention, looking at Lin Fan: "Lin Fan, do you think I really don’t dare to hit you? I’m giving you one last chance, just act like you haven’t seen anything here, and you’ll be safe!"
Lin Fan asked, "What if I refuse?"
Ou Hao sneered, "If you refuse, you’ll find out how serious the consequences are! Do you refuse?"
Lin Fan shook his head, "I refuse."
Ou Hao was furious and said, "You’re really asking for it, Brother Jin, help me show him some consequences!"
Blonde Hair shivered, feeling bitter inside, truly getting caught up in wild trouble. Ou Hao asking him to deal with Lin Fan was just asking for trouble, wasn’t it? How dare he go against Lin Fan, that would really be asking for death!
"Brother Hao, I think we should just drop it. After all, Lin Teacher is your teacher, let’s give him some face." Blonde Hair grinned awkwardly, trying to play peacemaker.
Ou Hao was stunned: "Brother Jin, did I hear you wrong, what did you just say?"
Being a peacemaker, was this still the Blonde Hair he knew?
Blonde Hair grinned awkwardly, "I mean it, let’s not go against Lin Teacher, how about this, Brother Hao, you apologize to Lin Teacher, and this matter will be over."
As he spoke, Blonde Hair kept signaling to Ou Hao.
But Ou Hao didn’t get it, laughing angrily: "Apologize my ass, Brother Jin, don’t butt into this, I’ll handle it myself!"
With that, Ou Hao called over a few students, approaching Lin Fan threateningly.
Blonde Hair shook his head with a bitter smile, he had already given a warning, but if Ou Hao insisted on courting death, there was nothing he could do.
Watching as Ou Hao and others moved to confront Lin Fan.
Li Qixing suddenly intervened, blocking Ou Hao and his group, and said, "Don’t hit Teacher Lin, I’m the one who caused this, if you want to hit someone, hit me!"
In his heart, Lin Fan acknowledged this, thinking that Li Qixing still had some guts.
Ou Hao shouted angrily, "Li Qixing, don’t fucking meddle, get out of my way! We’ll deal with you later, right now I want to teach this ignorant teacher a lesson, make him behave!"
But Li Qixing refused to move, saying, "No way, I won’t let you hit Teacher Lin unless you knock me down first!"
Ou Hao angrily commanded, "Take him down!"
Two students lunged from the left and right, grabbing Li Qixing and pinning him down.
Li Qixing was a skinny boy, he wasn’t originally a match for these students. Having been surrounded and beaten earlier, he was already exhausted, and only in desperation did he pull out a fruit knife.
Later, due to fright, his hands and feet turned weak, he hadn’t yet recovered, so he was easily subdued by the two students.
After subduing Li Qixing, Ou Hao, along with his remaining students, continued advancing towards Lin Fan.
"Teacher Lin, run quickly, don’t worry about me!" Li Qixing shouted, not wanting Lin Fan to be beaten because of him.
"Too late!"
Ou Hao chuckled sinisterly, already looming over Lin Fan, about to start a round of punches and kicks on Lin Fan, to teach him a lesson.
They, of course, didn’t succeed. Not only did they fail, they ended up being slapped in the face.
Literally slapped in the face.
Smack!
Smack!
Smack!
Smack!
They didn’t even manage to touch a hair on Lin Fan’s head, yet series of loud, crisp slaps rang out on their faces.
Their cheeks instantly swelled and turned red, one by one, becoming dizzy, seeing stars. Weaker ones spun around in a daze, eventually losing balance and plopping to the ground.
They were all thoroughly dumbfounded.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "These slaps are on behalf of your parents. It’s the parents’ fault for not teaching their children, you all deserve a good punishment for ending up like this today."
Blonde Hair and the thugs were dumbfounded, utterly astonished. Teacher Lin was incredible; they just saw Lin Fan effortlessly slapping these students, his movements fluid like flowing water, his strikes as fast as lightning.
It was practically something no normal person could achieve.
If Lin Fan wanted to, he could slap these students’ heads off, and they would believe it.
It was clear Lin Fan had held back in this beating.
With that thought, cold sweat dripped from Blonde Hair’s forehead.
Ou Hao covered his swollen red cheek, a mix of anger and frustration: "You dared to hit me, do you know who my dad..."
Smack!
Lin Fan slapped Ou Hao’s face again: "This slap is specifically for your nightclub-running dad, for letting you become a campus bully, it’s deserved!"
Ou Hao’s other cheek immediately swelled, and he was totally out of sorts, the world spinning, stumbling, and started crying with a wail.
Oh my, this Teacher Lin, his hand strength was too great, and the most impressive part was that they couldn’t fight back at all. They talked about teaching Teacher Lin a lesson, yet they didn’t even have a chance to touch Lin Fan, instead being slapped around like sandbags by him.
"Attempting to assault a teacher, an additional crime, deserves a third slap."
Lin Fan continued, raising his hand, about to slap Ou Hao again.
Thunk!
Ou Hao trembled and knelt before Lin Fan, crying and begging for mercy: "Stop, stop, Teacher Lin, I’m begging you."
Another slap, and he feared he might pass out on the spot. The two slaps Lin Fan landed earlier almost blew his mind away.
Lin Fan didn’t continue hitting him and instead walked towards Li Qixing.
The two students holding down Li Qixing turned pale with fear at his approach, quickly releasing him and stepping aside.
There was nothing they could do, Lin Fan’s slaps were too terrifying. They didn’t want to get slapped like that.
Smack!
Smack!
However, reality was harsh, they couldn’t escape society’s punishment, and each received a slap from Lin Fan, nearly crying from the pain.
Lin Fan walked over, helping Li Qixing up, "Li, tell the teacher, what exactly happened?"
Li Qixing had initially worried about Lin Fan getting hurt by these people, but now he was shocked and delighted to see Lin Fan easily dealing with them. Teacher Lin was so strong!
With newfound courage, Li Qixing pointed to Ou Hao, "It all started because of him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Facing the Bully, the Stubborn Li Qixing
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 332: Facing the Bully, the Stubborn Li Qixing
Yun City Music Academy, cafeteria.
On this day, during lunch time, Li Qixing, like usual, went to the cafeteria to line up for food. As a model student, Li Qixing followed a strict routine every day: going to the classroom to study, returning to the dormitory to sleep, and eating at the cafeteria. He was a person who adhered to rules.
A person who adheres to rules naturally finds it hard to tolerate any nonsense. While Li Qixing was lining up, Ou Hao cut in line with two other students. The three of them were laughing and joking, completely ignoring the other students in line, as if cutting in line was the most normal thing in the world.
Li Qixing frowned and couldn’t help but say, "Can’t you just line up properly? Why are you cutting in line?"
Suddenly, the whole room went silent.
Everyone was shocked to look at Li Qixing.
Li Qixing dared to reprimand Ou Hao?
Who didn’t know who Ou Hao was in the school? He was a well-known bully, relying on his nightclub-owning dad to frequently bully fellow students. Everyone avoided him, fearing trouble; accidentally provoking Ou Hao was something everyone wanted to avoid.
The students around had indeed seen Ou Hao cut in line, but no one dared to say anything, pretending not to notice. After all, he was a bully, and to accuse a bully was akin to seeking death!
Li Qixing was actually seeking death!
Everyone was surprised. Could it be that Li Qixing was not afraid of death?
Li Qixing was not unafraid of death; he simply wasn’t afraid of Ou Hao. Because he believed he was right, and as long as he was right, he would stick to it.
Ou Hao was also taken aback; someone actually dared to defy him. Who was he? The school’s notorious bully. He could do whatever he wanted and cut in line if he wanted to. Who dared interfere with his affairs?
Li Qixing dared to interfere!
"Why can’t I cut in line?" Ou Hao stared fiercely at Li Qixing, arrogantly said.
"Kid, who are you? You even dare to interfere with our Young Master Ou," a lackey beside Ou Hao said.
Another lackey simply pushed Li Qixing, his expression fierce: "You must be tired of living!"
Li Qixing’s neck flushed red and he said, "You’re too much, cutting in line is wrong in the first place. I just asked you to line up properly, is there anything wrong with that?"
A lackey angrily said, "You must be out of your mind. Do you know who Young Master Ou is? What’s the big deal if he cuts in line?"
Li Qixing stubbornly said, "I don’t care who you are, cutting in line is wrong!"
Ou Hao laughed out of anger. He had always roamed the school bullying as he pleased and had never encountered anyone like Li Qixing who dared defy him. Li Qixing was the first.
"I’ll keep cutting in line, what can you do? Come here and push me away if you dare!" Ou Hao said.
Li Qixing wasn’t stupid; he knew he was no match for the three of them, so he couldn’t physically confront them.
Li Qixing said, "A gentleman uses words, not hands. Are you barbarians that you always resort to violence?"
Ou Hao laughed, "Gentleman, who’s a gentleman with you? I’m going to hit you, how about that?"
Saying this, Ou Hao advanced forward.
A crisp slap sounded.
He gave Li Qixing a hard slap.
Li Qixing was stunned, not expecting to be hit just for pointing out the uncivil act of cutting in line.
Seeing Ou Hao start hitting, the other two lackeys also came up and started pushing and hitting Li Qixing.
The surrounding students watched, none dared step forward to stop them. Li Qixing was so upright, and being beaten by Ou Hao and others was almost expected. If they stepped forward to stop it, they’d only get themselves involved. No one wanted to invite trouble, even if Li Qixing was right, it was useless as their fists were smaller, only ending up getting beaten.
In the end, it was the cafeteria aunt who couldn’t bear to watch any longer and came out to persuade Ou Hao and his group to stop beating Li Qixing.
Li Qixing was battered, his mouth was bloody, his mouth corner injured, eating alone in frustration, really not understanding why stopping line-cutting was wrong?
No one spoke up for him, leaving him beaten needlessly. He was somewhat angry and wanted to fight back, but he couldn’t match the four of them alone.
While Li Qixing was eating, Ou Hao laughed sinisterly, suddenly approaching and knocking on his head, saying, "You punk, are you giving up or not?"
Li Qixing raised his head, shot Ou Hao a sidelong glance, and didn’t speak. But obviously, Li Qixing was still stubborn, not scared of Ou Hao. Ou Hao felt very displeased. He refused to believe Li Qixing wasn’t afraid. If he wasn’t, he’d keep hitting until he was. If he didn’t submit, he’d beat him until he did. This was Ou Hao’s bullying way.
Ou Hao reached out and knocked Li Qixing’s lunchbox to the ground, spilling the food everywhere.
"Hahahahaha..." Ou Hao laughed loudly as he walked away.
"Kid, daring to cross Young Master Ou, you’re dead!" The two lackeys also laughed and left.
Li Qixing clenched his fists, only hating himself for not being strong enough to hit back, otherwise he would have done so long ago.
The matter didn’t end here. That afternoon, Ou Hao with two lackeys ambushed Li Qixing outside the classroom, pulled him into a corner when he was unguarded, beat him up, and even threatened to beat him every time they saw him, until he begged for mercy.
In the subsequent days, Li Qixing was ambushed by Ou Hao numerous times, but Li Qixing was truly stubborn, refusing to submit, which made Ou Hao incredibly angry. In this school, everyone regarded him as a plague, and he enjoyed the fear he instilled in people. Others feared his power, making him feel accomplished, a sense of conquest.
But there was Li Qixing, who refused to submit, making him feel thwarted and displeased. Every beating increased his displeasure because he couldn’t believe that despite beating Li Qixing so many times, he couldn’t make him fear himself. Li Qixing’s existence threatened to crumble the arrogance he had built.
Ou Hao was fuming, this ordinary boy from a poor family actually made him, the son of a nightclub owner, feel unprecedented defeat.
Unable to hold back after yet another beating of Li Qixing, Ou Hao announced that next time he sees Li Qixing, they will duel to the death. He would bring a knife for a one-on-one confrontation until one falls.
Ou Hao wasn’t just speaking in anger, he truly planned this and even brought in the outside thug, Blonde Hair, fearing Li Qixing might call for reinforcements. With Blonde Hair present, foolproof was guaranteed.
Thus, today, Blonde Hair and the thugs were waiting for Li Qixing outside the school, capturing him and bringing him here, while Ou Hao had called in a few lackeys, having waited for a long time.
As soon as Li Qixing arrived, Ou Hao gathered people to beat Li Qixing, seemingly leaving behind the agreed one-on-one fight to the death. Remembering Ou Hao’s previous words, and to protect himself, Li Qixing carried a fruit knife today, believing Ou Hao might really kill him, thus in desperation pulled out the knife for self-defense, almost injuring Ou Hao.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: The Homeroom Teacher’s Quote: Why Is It You and Not Someone Else?
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 333: The Homeroom Teacher’s Quote: Why Is It You and Not Someone Else?
Fortunately, Lin Fan intervened in time and prevented this tragedy from happening.
At this point, Li Qixing’s eyes were already red. Speaking of almost stabbing Ou Hao just now, he couldn’t help but feel a wave of fear. His whole body trembled. He wasn’t someone who liked to fight, but rather an honest person, a diligent student, yet he was pushed to the point of pulling out a knife to protect himself due to campus bullies. Campus bullying is truly despicable.
Hearing this, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao exchanged a glance and were both speechless.
The shock of campus violence is overwhelming. Such things, which sound like they would only happen in the underworld, actually occurred in the seemingly innocent and beautiful campus.
And sadly, this tragedy is not an isolated case. In fact, incidents related to campus violence occur from time to time, and there’s simply no way to eradicate it.
No one knows why, but it’s impossible to prevent campus violence from happening.
"After this happened, you’ve been beaten by them multiple times. Didn’t you tell anyone?" Lin Fan asked.
Li Qixing replied, "Most of the classmates know what happened to me, but they didn’t say anything, let alone stand up for me."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I’m sorry, Li Qixing, I didn’t know about this."
Chu Xiaoxiao was also someone who was focused, and she indeed didn’t know about these matters unrelated to her studies.
If she had known about it, she would have helped Li Qixing, instead of being indifferent like the other classmates.
Li Qixing looked at Chu Xiaoxiao but said nothing. To him, Chu Xiaoxiao was like a goddess who was difficult to approach. How could he even hope for the goddess to help him?
Lin Fan said, "If the classmates didn’t help you, did you tell the teachers, the principal, or the school authorities?"
Li Qixing: "I told the homeroom teacher, but he didn’t help me. He just asked me why I was involved with those people. Why didn’t others get involved with them, but I did? Shouldn’t I reflect on myself? Isn’t it my problem? The homeroom teacher wanted me to find the problem within myself, but he didn’t help me deal with those who beat me. I went to see the school leadership, but they basically ignored me. Some were just like the homeroom teacher.
