One school leader went to talk to Ou Hao, asking him not to hit me anymore, but Ou Hao didn’t listen to the school leader at all and continued to beat me, and then that school leader didn’t care about me anymore either."
Lin Fan said, "Did you tell your parents?"
Li Qixing said, "I didn’t want them to worry about me, so I didn’t tell them about this. However, I did tell this to one of my uncles. My uncle comforted me and said he would come to pick me up from school. I guess he didn’t want me to get into a fight with them, so he promised to come see me, but before I could meet him, they caught me and beat me up."
Lin Fan furrowed his brows. Listening to what Li Qixing said, it seems the crux of the problem has been found. It’s the school’s inaction that caused campus violence to run rampant. In the face of violence, Li Qixing’s homeroom teacher not only didn’t help him but also questioned if it was his problem, which is rather shameful.
If the school could handle the situation promptly, support Li Qixing, and punish the violent students, then campus violence could be curbed, instead of being condoned, persisting, and occurring without any means of stopping. Students being bullied and deeply hurt could also be avoided.
Lin Fan suddenly thought, does the principal, Liu Mengjie, know about this?
So, Lin Fan took out his phone and called Liu Mengjie to tell her about the situation. Liu Mengjie was shocked when she heard about it from Lin Fan.
"I heard feedback about this from those below, and assigned someone to handle it. Then those below told me that it had been resolved. Well, today it seems they lied to me. Where are you now? I’ll come over and handle it myself immediately," said Liu Mengjie.
Lin Fan told Liu Mengjie where they were, and she soon called the police and brought them over.
The police came and first rounded up Blonde Hair and his gang of thugs, shoving them into the police car.
Liu Mengjie asked the police how this should be handled. The police suggested to Liu Mengjie that they bring both sets of parents in to discuss how to resolve the matter and come up with a solution through discussion.
So, Liu Mengjie notified the parents of both Ou Hao and Li Qixing, asking them to come together to discuss how to resolve the matter.
Liu Mengjie walked over to Lin Fan and said gratefully, "Little Fan, thanks to you, if it weren’t for you, Li Qixing would have stabbed Ou Hao, and such a tragedy would have happened, which would have been irreparable. Luckily, you intervened and stopped the tragedy from happening."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I just happened to come across this incident and intervened. I couldn’t just stand by and watch Li Qixing hurt someone. If he had really stabbed Ou Hao, he likely would have faced jail time. But I still have to say, Ou Hao wants others to suffer, and if he gets stabbed, it’s his own fault, not to be blamed on others. Such a troublemaker needs to be properly punished and severely so, because only in this way can we suppress this kind of campus violence."
"Okay, I understand. I know what to do now," said Liu Mengjie.
Afterward, all the students were brought back to the school.
As they reached the school gate, a middle-aged man hurriedly ran over and grabbed Li Qixing.
"Qixing, are you alright? Sorry I’m late, what happened?"
This middle-aged man was Li Qixing’s uncle. He had promised to pick Li Qixing up after school, but he was delayed because something came up. If he had arrived on time, the tragedy could have been avoided, but he was late, nearly leading to dire consequences, fostering such a tragedy.
After learning the details of the situation, the middle-aged uncle broke out in a cold sweat and ran over to repeatedly bow and thank Lin Fan. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, Li Qixing might have ended up in jail.
The uncle quickly notified Li Qixing’s parents. Li Qing’s parents soon came over and, like the uncle, inquired about what happened. After finding out the details, they, too, repeatedly thanked Lin Fan.
Ou Hao’s father, however, took a long time before he came.
This was a middle-aged man wearing a leather jacket and a large gold chain. As he walked in, he was smoking a cigar, adopting an air of bravado.
This situation attracted a lot of onlookers. When they saw Ou Hao’s father like this, everyone couldn’t help but shake their heads in disapproval. With such a father, it’s no wonder that someone like Ou Hao would turn out to be such a nasty bully.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 Bully Father and Son, The Villain Sues First
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 334 Bully Father and Son, The Villain Sues First
Liu Mengjie decided to publicly handle this incident after consulting with the police. She could not allow school violence to occur in her school, especially since this incident almost resulted in tragedy. It was a very serious matter that required full attention.
So Liu Mengjie called in the parents of both Ou Hao and Li Qixing, along with their respective head teachers and the school leaders responsible for handling this matter.
A large group of students also came to watch after hearing about the incident, discussing animatedly.
"I heard Li Qixing almost hurt Ou Hao with a knife!"
"Really? Is it that serious?"
"It’s true. Fortunately, Teacher Lin intervened to stop it."
"Teacher Lin is incredible, not only good at playing the piano but also with such impressive skills!"
"Of course, Teacher Lin is amazing. I heard he knocked the knife out of Li Qixing’s hand with just a pebble."
The students’ admiration for Lin Fan grew even stronger. Lin Fan indeed handled the situation brilliantly.
Li Qixing’s parents arrived first. After understanding the situation, they bowed repeatedly to Lin Fan, expressing their gratitude.
"Teacher Lin, thank you so much. You saved my son," Li Qixing’s father said gratefully.
Li Qixing’s mother added, "I have a friend who studies law. I just asked him, and he said if Qixing really hurt someone, he might have faced imprisonment. Teacher Lin, you truly saved our son. We are extremely grateful."
Lin Fan smiled and replied, "You’re too kind. It was just helping out."
Li Qixing’s parents pulled him over and said, "Qixing, quickly thank Teacher Lin."
Li Qixing said, "Thank you, Teacher Lin."
In stark contrast to Li Qixing’s parents was Ou Hao’s father.
After the incident, Ou Hao’s father arrived late. He was dressed very fashionably, with slicked-back hair, sunglasses, a large gold chain around his neck, and a cigar in his mouth, clearly looking like a big shot in the underworld.
"Dad, come here and get me justice!" Ou Hao first started to complain, "They’re all bullying me!"
Ou Hao pointed at Li Qixing, as well as Liu Mengjie, Lin Fan, and others.
Ou Hao’s father was immediately displeased, "Who the hell dares to bully my son, Ou Mingliang?"
Liu Mengjie coldly replied, "No one is bullying your son. It’s your son who is bullying others now."
Ou Mingliang laughed, "Son, are you the one doing the bullying?"
Ou Hao was initially reluctant to speak out, stammering, "I..."
Ou Mingliang cursed, "Coward, just speak up. With me here, what are you afraid of?"
Ou Hao finally said, "That day I cut the line, and he insulted me. I just cut the line; what does it matter to him? So, I hit him. But he didn’t give in, so every time I saw him, I beat him."
Ou Mingliang paused, then burst into laughter, "Hahaha, that’s more like my son! My son can’t be wronged. That’s right, what’s the problem with my son cutting the line? He did cut the line, but why is it their business?"
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat. This father was indeed bizarre. Like father, like son; with such a father, it’s no wonder Ou Hao would be a school bully.
Liu Mengjie was a bit angry, "You think your son cutting the line is normal, and others can’t stop him? What if your son wants to kill someone, is that normal too?"
Liu Mengjie rarely spoke in such a heavy tone, indicating she was truly angry this time.
Ou Mingliang responded, "Oh, Ou Hao, be honest. Do you want to kill someone?"
Ou Hao hesitated again, not daring to speak.
Ou Mingliang shouted, "Speak the truth, did you really intend to kill?"
Ou Hao had to say, "I hit him several times, and he wouldn’t give in, so I decided today to settle it once and for all. But I was just saying it; I didn’t really intend to kill him. So although I arranged to meet him, I didn’t plan to duel, just to beat him again. Essentially, I wanted to scare him a bit. Who knew he’d take my words seriously, and bring a fruit knife, almost killing me."
Ou Mingliang froze, then became furious and glared at Li Qixing, "Did you almost kill my son?"
Li Qixing was a bit afraid of Ou Mingliang, because he was genuinely intimidating. As a nightclub owner, he looked menacing and was not someone easy to approach.
Li Qixing’s father unhappily said, "Your son beat Qixing first and then wanted to duel him. My son brought the fruit knife for self-defense. What’s wrong with that? If they hadn’t bullied him too much, my son wouldn’t have taken out a fruit knife to defend himself. So ultimately, it’s your son’s fault."
Ou Mingliang glanced at Li Qixing’s father, "What nonsense are you saying? Can you hear yourself? Now your son tried to kill mine, almost succeeding. You dare touch my son, Ou Mingliang’s son, do you believe I’ll beat you to death right here?"
Ou Mingliang acted as if he was about to hit Li Qixing’s father. Li Qixing’s father involuntarily stepped back; Ou Mingliang was indeed intimidating. He was just an ordinary person, fine in a verbal spar, but he hardly dared to fight Ou Mingliang physically.
Feeling justified, Ou Mingliang spared no mercy, glaring at Liu Mengjie and shouting, "The principal also heard it. It’s this little punk who tried to kill my son, almost succeeding. Now, let’s see what you have to say. I’m saying this punk should be expelled, isn’t that fair?"
Li Qixing’s parents were furious, seeing how the culprit was falsely accusing and forcing the principal to expel their son. The one who was wrong was Ou Hao, so why should Li Qixing be expelled?
Everyone around felt that Ou Mingliang and Ou Hao were really tyrannical.
They all sympathized with Li Qixing but did not dare to offend the father and son. After all, Ou Mingliang indeed ran a nightclub and knew many people from the underworld. Moreover, Ou Mingliang himself looked intimidating, and indeed quite threatening.
Liu Mengjie calmly said, "Reasons do not lie in loud voices. Parent of Ou Hao, don’t be agitated. Things will definitely be clarified, and I will handle it fairly. Let’s have both sides be quiet while I investigate thoroughly."
Liu Mengjie then turned to Li Qixing and asked, "Li Qixing, please recount the incident from beginning to end in front of everyone."
Li Qixing then recounted the entire incident, just as he had told Lin Fan before. How he was cut in line in the cafeteria by Ou Hao, bullied by Ou Hao and his group multiple times, and ultimately, how Ou Hao challenged him to a deadly duel, leading to today’s events.
After listening to Li Qixing recount the whole incident, everyone was shocked. If Li Qixing’s account was true, Ou Hao’s behavior was truly atrocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: The Bigger Fist Holds the Greater Reason
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 335: The Bigger Fist Holds the Greater Reason
"Ou Hao is such a bully!"
"That sounds like something Ou Hao would do."
"Li Qixing is a good student, he wouldn’t lie. It seems that’s how it is."
The crowd started discussing, feeling that there should be no mistake in what Li Qixing said.
Liu Mengjie turned to Ou Hao: "Is what Li Qixing said true?"
Ou Hao said: "So what if it is? I said it, I cut in line, isn’t that right? What’s it to him? If he hadn’t meddled, nothing would have happened. Look at others, they’re fine, because they didn’t meddle, they’re fine. He meddled, who else should I beat if not him, then he got beaten by me, he should just accept it, but he wasn’t convinced, I could only keep hitting him, ultimately it’s his fault!"
Liu Mengjie laughed in anger: "Ou Hao, you cut in line first, that’s wrong behavior. Li Qixing stopped you, yet you showed no remorse and instead wanted to hit him, continuously bullying him. Do you really think you did nothing wrong?"
Ou Hao said: "I said I was indeed not wrong."
Liu Mengjie asked Ou Mingliang: "Mr. Ou, do you still think your son did nothing wrong?"
Ou Mingliang said: "Of course he’s not wrong. What did my son do wrong?"
Liu Mengjie was so angry she couldn’t speak. This father and son were truly bizarre; to this moment they still hadn’t realized their mistakes. It seems their values simply didn’t align with the school’s. There’s no saving them.
"Let me tell you what’s wrong with your son."
Lin Fan spoke up at this moment.
Everyone’s gaze turned to Lin Fan.
Ou Mingliang assessed Lin Fan: "Who the hell are you?"
Lin Fan said: "My name is Lin Fan, I’m the piano teacher here."
Liu Mengjie said: "It was Teacher Lin who knocked the knife out of Li Qixing’s hand today and saved your son’s life. If not for Teacher Lin, your son would be dead. I hope you show some respect."
Ou Mingliang was taken aback: "Didn’t expect you, young man, to have such skills. You saved my son, fine, then I’ll listen to your rationale."
Lin Fan said: "I don’t have any grand theories, just some common human decency. Following your logic, you think your son cutting in line was not wrong. Then what’s wrong with Li Qixing stopping your son?"
Ou Mingliang arrogantly said: "Because he’s my son. My son can do whatever he wants, who else should care?"
Lin Fan smiled: "You must think you’re something special, but really, who do you think you are, Ou Mingliang?"
Ou Mingliang narrowed his eyes: "What did you say? Who do I think I am?"
Lin Fan said: "That’s right, maybe you think because you run nightclubs and know a few underground figures, you and your son can act lawlessly. But in my eyes, you’re nothing special."
Ou Mingliang sneered: "Kid, you’ve got big words. You think I’m nothing? And who are you?"
Lin Fan smiled silently.
He didn’t like to reveal his identity readily.
"You must truly believe in the law of the jungle. In that case, your son almost got killed by Li Qixing, which only proves one thing — your son was outmatched. So, you can’t blame Li Qixing; you can only blame your son."
Ou Mingliang was momentarily at a loss for words.
Lin Fan’s words left him with no rebuttal. Indeed, in his heart, the world was survival of the fittest, and whoever’s fists were the biggest had the right.
Believers in such a simple principle were now defeated by that same principle.
Ou Mingliang adhered to this principle, so Lin Fan left him without options, as to people like him, showing weakness meant you were useless.
Now Jiang Ziya was at a loss for words, and what Lin Fan did was using one’s own method against them.
Seeing Lin Fan render them speechless, the crowd couldn’t help but secretly admire him. Teacher Lin was indeed brilliant. To defeat a thug, one must use the thug’s own methods.
Liu Mengjie immediately asked: "Liang, after being bullied by Ou Hao, did you tell your class teacher?"
Li Qixing said: "I told him."
Liu Mengjie then turned to Li Qixing’s class teacher: "Teacher Jin, what did you say when Li Qixing came to you for help?"
Li Qixing’s class teacher, Teacher Jin, a middle-aged woman in her 40s, quickly replied: "When Qixing came to me, I took this matter very seriously, and I also expressed my concern."
Liu Mengjie asked: "Li Qixing, is that true?"
Teacher Jin eyed Li Qixing, signaling him not to speak recklessly.
Li Qixing ignored it and said: "After I went to the class teacher, she just asked me why it was me and not someone else, then told me to find the problem within myself."
This statement caused quite a stir.
Liu Mengjie snorted coldly: "Teacher Jin, besides asking Li Qixing to reflect on himself, what else did you do?"
Teacher Jin, exposed on the spot by Li Qixing, blushed and was speechless, stammering.
Liu Mengjie then asked Ou Hao’s class teacher: "Teacher Cui, do you know that there’s a student named Ou Hao in your class who is involved in campus violence against other students?"
Ou Hao’s class teacher, a bald middle-aged man, wiped his cold sweat: "I..."
Liu Mengjie coldly snorted: "You know, don’t you? But you didn’t do anything about Ou Hao, and allowed him to do as he pleased. Why?"
Teacher Cui, wiping his sweat, said: "I have no way. I’m just a teacher, I have no background, and the other side runs a nightclub. How dare I provoke him? Aside from turning a blind eye, what other choice do I have? I don’t want to end up like Li Qixing, beaten up."
Liu Mengjie slammed the table angrily: "Nonsense, you’re the class teacher. If you dare not intervene, then who will?"
Teacher Cui was speechless.
Liu Mengjie then shifted her gaze to the school leader responsible for this matter: "And you, Teacher Wei. Didn’t you tell me this issue was already resolved? Why is it still happening?"
Teacher Wei, the school’s dean, was sweating profusely. He had no choice; he clearly hid the truth from Liu Mengjie, and now he had no way to keep covering it up, naturally feeling very anxious.
"I talked with Ou Hao and asked him not to bully Li Qixing anymore. Ou Hao agreed on the spot, so I thought he’d obey. Who knew he continued bullying Li Qixing? I was mistaken. I’m sorry," Teacher Wei apologized.
Liu Mengjie said: "The current situation is due to the opportunity you all provided. If it wasn’t for your indulgence, this matter should have been resolved long ago, not worsened. Teacher Jin, Teacher Cui, as class teachers, you should have addressed this matter sternly and immediately. But because you didn’t take it seriously, your responsibility is the greatest, and you must bear the consequences. From today, you are both removed from your positions as class teachers. Recorded with a major demerit. I hope you’ll reflect on this, and if such an issue arises again, take it seriously. Teacher Wei, as the dean, you assumed the matter was resolved before it truly was. You clearly neglected your duty. I find you unfit as a dean. Temporarily suspended.
Liu Mengjie then announced: "Ou Hao’s campus bullying of classmates is egregious. Expulsion enforced."
As for Li Qixing, he is the victim of this campus violence, with no fault, yet has suffered significant psychological harm and needs the school to hire a counselor to help him.
Liu Mengjie’s public handling of this matter aims to show all teachers and students how terrifying campus violence is. And if those around do not promptly and fairly handle it, the violence will inflict further harm on the victim.
For a moment, the entire school was silent.
Learning that his son was expelled, Ou Mingliang was the first to protest, jumping out and shouting: "Liu Mengjie, you damned woman, how dare you expel my son? Watch me beat you to death!"
He moved to hit Liu Mengjie.
Lin Fan stepped out, standing in front of Liu Mengjie, saying calmly: "You’re welcome to try."
"You’re right, I do believe in the law of the jungle — whoever’s fists are bigger has the right. Now I’ll see just how big your rights are!"
With that, Ou Mingliang swung a punch toward Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Teacher Lin is simply the embodiment of perfection!
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 336: Teacher Lin is simply the embodiment of perfection!
Liu Mengjie wanted to expel Ou Hao, and when Ou Mingliang heard this, he was infuriated and wanted to rush up and hit Liu Mengjie. He was used to being arrogant and condescending.
But Lin Fan stopped him.
Ou Mingliang wanted to knock Lin Fan down. In his view, Lin Fan was just like an ant trying to stop a chariot.
Everyone was taken aback by this. Ou Mingliang was strong, and they didn’t know if Lin Fan could be his match.
Yet, Lin Fan slightly smiled, suddenly kicked up, and knocked Ou Mingliang to the ground.
"Ah!"
Ou Mingliang let out a miserable cry and fell to the ground, unable to get up for a moment.
Everyone was stunned. Lin Fan was simply too incredible!
Soon after, the police came forward and apprehended Ou Mingliang. He was suspected of provoking trouble and was taken back to the police station, likely to be held for a few days.
The incident ended with Ou Hao and several other students involved in campus violence being expelled. They had paid the price for their wrongful actions. Additionally, the irresponsible teachers and the dean of students each faced penalties.
Liu Mengjie addressed the entire faculty and students: "In my school, I absolutely do not allow the existence of campus violence. Once discovered, it will be handled strictly without leniency. The incident today is an example. I hope everyone can learn from it and never participate in campus violence. In the future, reports of campus violence will be rewarded with extra points. I hope everyone can supervise each other. If campus violence occurs, please respond promptly and positively, to prevent unnecessary tragedies."
Liu Mengjie’s action was clearly meant to serve as a warning to others. This really did intimidate the entire faculty and students. In the following period, campus violence incidents at Yun City Music Academy were resolved and almost vanished.
Those students who once had tendencies towards campus violence behaved themselves from then on.
After the incident, Liu Mengjie came over to thank Lin Fan. If it weren’t for Lin Fan’s intervention, an irreversible tragedy might have occurred today.
Liu Mengjie originally wanted to invite Lin Fan to her office to thank him properly.
But seeing Chu Xiaoxiao beside her, she decided against it.
After this incident, the faculty and students all learned that besides being a piano genius, Lin Fan also had extraordinary skills. Instantly, everyone admired Lin Fan even more.
"Teacher Lin is simply the embodiment of perfection!"
"I really admire Teacher Lin!"
"Teacher Lin, the eternal god!"
No one held back their praise.
Only Lin Fan himself knew that the two things he did at school today were thanks to the latest reward, top-level Koi Carp Luck.
The long-distance shot and hitting Li Qixing’s fruit knife with a stone were all because he activated top-level luck. It could be said that this top-level luck could make him win every gamble.
After the matter was over, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao left the school and continued to the hospital.
The two got into the Rolls-Royce and drove to the hospital.
On the way, Lin Fan suddenly received a phone call, and it was from Chu Yufei.
Chu Yufei, Chu Xiaoxiao’s half-sister, is currently helping Lin Fan manage the Mortal Charity Fund.
"Mr. Lin, where are you now?" Chu Yufei asked.
Lin Fan said, "I’m driving. Is there something going on with the charity?"
He entrusted the charity to Chu Yufei with confidence, so he hadn’t paid much attention to it.
Chu Yufei said, "It’s not about the charity. The charity is going smoothly with no issues. I called you for another reason."
Lin Fan was curious, "What is it you’re saying?"
Chu Yufei said, "It’s like this. My father wants to meet with Mr. Lin, but he hasn’t had the opportunity. So, he asked me to introduce you to each other. I wonder if Mr. Lin has time to meet with my father?"
Lin Fan made a sound, "He wants to meet me. I wonder what for?"
Chu Yufei said, "It shouldn’t be anything major. He has just always admired Mr. Lin and hopes to get acquainted with you."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’m at Yun City People’s Hospital. Let him come find me here."
Chu Yufei said, "Okay, Mr. Lin, thank you."
Lin Fan was about to hang up the phone.
Chu Yufei said, "Wait a minute, there’s one more thing. It’s about Xiaoxiao. I’m not sure how to tell Xiaoxiao, so I wonder if Mr. Lin could relay it if he sees her?"
Lin Fan said, "Go ahead."
Chu Yufei said, "It’s like this. I tried to persuade our father to take Xiaoxiao back home, but he refused me and wouldn’t agree. I know this might hurt Xiaoxiao, so I don’t dare to tell her in person."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Really? What’s his reason for refusing?"
Chu Yufei said, "Father said that if he brought Xiaoxiao back home, grandma and my mom wouldn’t agree."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I understand. If there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up."
Chu Yufei said, "Mr. Lin, please tell Xiaoxiao I’m sorry, and when I have time, I’ll visit her myself."
"Okay." Lin Fan ended the call.
Lin Fan glanced at Chu Xiaoxiao in the passenger seat. She didn’t know that the call was from Chu Yufei. Her mind was already on the hospital as she was worried about Chu Xiaoming’s condition.
Lin Fan didn’t know how to bring it up for the moment, so he decided not to say anything immediately.
Soon, they arrived at the hospital.
They went straight to the ward.
Chu Xiaoming had already undergone a bone marrow transplant. Lying in the hospital bed, he looked better than before; his parents, Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang, were by his side.
Seeing the two enter, Xiaoming immediately saw Chu Xiaoxiao and was overjoyed, exclaiming, "Sister!"
If he could, he would have jumped up.
Chu Xiaoxiao ran to Chu Xiaoming’s bedside, full of concern.
"Xiaoming, are you feeling better now?"
Xiaoming smiled and nodded, "Yeah, after the surgery, I feel much better. Sister, where have you been? I haven’t seen you in a long time."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s eyes reddened, "Sister moved to live at the school. I heard you had surgery, so I came to see you today."
Chu Xiaoming said, "Sister, can you come back home? When you’re not there, I really miss you. Without you, it feels so boring at home."
Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t know how to answer him. She hadn’t forgiven her parents yet, so she didn’t want to go back home.
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang looked awkward.
He Meifang awkwardly laughed, "Xiaoxiao, why don’t you both move back home? Teacher Lin, could you help persuade Xiaoxiao?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "When Xiaoxiao will return home is up to her. If she forgives you, she’ll naturally come back home. If she doesn’t want to, it means she hasn’t forgiven you yet."
He Meifang blushed. Previously, to raise medical expenses for her son, she asked Chu Xiaoxiao to drop out of school and get married. That indeed was excessive.
He Meifang said, "Mom was also thinking of your brother. Mom knows you love him a lot, so you should understand how much Mom loves you both. So, we were really desperate, hoping you could forgive Mom. Mom knows she was wrong."
Chu Yuanhang also said ingratiatingly, "Yes, Xiaoxiao, please forgive us."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s face turned cold, speaking coldly, "I’m here to see my brother today. I don’t want to talk about other things. Whether to forgive you or not is up to me, not you."
The couple’s expressions turned awkward, rendering them speechless for a moment.
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang. Seeing it was an unfamiliar number.
"Mr. Lin, hello, I’m Chu Haotian, Chu Yufei’s father. It’s an honor that Mr. Lin is willing to meet me. I’m already at the entrance of Yun City People’s Hospital. Where is Mr. Lin? I’ll come and find you."
Lin Fan heartily responded, Oh, Chu Haotian sure came at the right time. This seems kind of interesting.
"I’m in the ward visiting a patient. Could Mr. Chu come here, please?"

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Chu Haotian’s Calculations, The Wealthiest Son-in-Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 337: Chu Haotian’s Calculations, The Wealthiest Son-in-Law
Chu Haotian appeared at the entrance of the People’s Hospital and, after calling Lin Fan, followed the address given by Lin Fan to find Chu Xiaoming’s ward.
Chu Haotian knocked on the door and smiled, "Is Mr. Lin here?"
Everyone turned to look at Chu Haotian.
Suddenly seeing Chu Haotian, both Chu Yuanhang and He Meisu’s expressions were quite remarkable.
Chu Yuanhang blurted out, "It’s you!"
None of them expected that Chu Haotian would actually appear here.
Chu Haotian also immediately recognized He Meifang, feeling a bit bewildered.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Hello, Mr. Chu, I am Lin Fan. Please come in."
Chu Haotian felt his feet a bit heavy, unsure if he should come in, but in the end, he forced himself to enter.
He never imagined that Lin Fan would be with He Meifang.
Lin Fan laughed aloud, "Mr. Chu, sorry, I am visiting a patient. These two should not need an introduction, right? You are old acquaintances?"
Chu Haotian smiled awkwardly, "Mr. Lin, what’s going on here?"
Chu Yuanhang caught on, his face turning cold, "What are you doing here? You’re not welcome here."
He Meifang, however, did not speak; she just lowered her head in embarrassment.
Chu Haotian felt entirely uncomfortable and chuckled, "I came to visit Mr. Lin. Mr. Lin, could I have a word with you?"
"Mr. Chu, do you recognize her?"
Lin Fan pointed at Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Haotian looked at Chu Xiaoxiao and seemed to have guessed who she was but was unwilling to admit it.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "She is Chu Xiaoxiao. Mr. Chu, do you have an impression?"
Chu Xiaoxiao asked, "Teacher Lin, who is he?"
Lin Fan replied, "He is Chu Haotian, your biological father."
"Ah?"
Chu Xiaoxiao was completely stunned, staring in surprise at Chu Haotian in front of her.
From the last incident, she already knew that she was not Chu Yuanhang’s biological daughter, and she and Chu Yufei were half-sisters. Her biological father was Chu Haotian.
She had never seen Chu Haotian before; she had only heard his name, not even knowing what he looked like.
For this father who refused to acknowledge her as his daughter, she had no interest in understanding him.
Now, with Chu Haotian suddenly appearing before her, she was very surprised; she was not prepared at all to see her father, her biological father. But to her, this biological father was no different from a stranger, completely just a stranger.
Lin Fan did it on purpose.
Chu Yufei had told him that Chu Haotian could never accept Chu Xiaoxiao.
He refused to acknowledge Chu Xiaoxiao, unwilling to admit that this girl existed in the world.
The atmosphere suddenly became indescribably awkward.
The ward went silent all of a sudden, and everyone’s expressions were quite remarkable.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Mr. Chu, do you have anything you want to say to me? Let’s go out and talk."
"Alright," Chu Haotian said relieved, secretly letting out a breath.
He quickly followed Lin Fan outside.
In the corridor outside, Lin Fan stood by the railing, hands behind his back.
"Mr. Chu, I heard from Princess Yu that you wanted to see me. What is the matter?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Haotian smiled awkwardly, "I wanted to say it face to face. Thank you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment, "Thank you? Why thank me?"
Chu Haotian said, "I came to thank Mr. Lin for taking care of Princess Yu. I have always opposed her doing this job, thinking she was wasting time. But as I found out yesterday, it’s her hobby, and I have no reason to oppose it. Moreover, knowing she works under Mr. Lin, I feel assured. So, many thanks, Mr. Lin, for giving her such an opportunity.
Lin Fan smiled, "Really, you don’t need to thank me. Princess Yu is very capable at work. Actually, the reason I value her is that she is outstanding and capable of helping me, so I use her heavily."
Chu Haotian said, "Thank you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan smiled, "So, Mr. Chu sought me out just to thank me? Is there nothing else?"
Chu Haotian said, "To be honest, I have admired Mr. Lin for a long time and hope to get to know you. Mr. Lin has become the new richest person in Yun City. If there is an opportunity, my Yun Chu Group would love to collaborate with you in the future."
As he spoke, he handed Lin Fan a business card.
Lin Fan took the card and looked at it, "Yun Chu Group, I didn’t know. So, that’s what it is, a mechanical production enterprise."
Chu Haotian said, "That’s right, our group specializes in mechanical parts. We have been deeply focused on this for decades, so we can say we are experienced. If there’s an opportunity, we hope to collaborate with Mr. Lin."
Lin Feng thought for a moment and said, "Mechanical parts production, I will consider it. Speaking of which, we have a project coming up that might allow us to collaborate with Mr. Chu, involving a starting amount of a trillion."
Lin Fan’s main plan is to engage in rocket research and development. Making rockets involves producing many parts.
Perhaps Yun Chu Group can indeed be considered for collaboration.
Chu Haotian became excited upon hearing this. Although he didn’t know what the trillion-starting project Lin Fan mentioned was, it sounded like a very impressive project. If Yun Chu Group could grab a share, they would certainly make a fortune.
"Mr. Lin, if you have any needs, please feel free to call me. If we’re fortunate enough to participate in Mr. Lin’s project, it would be an honor for Yun Chu Group." Chu Haotian smiled awkwardly.
Lin Fan paused but then shook his head, "Forget it, I don’t think I will cooperate with Yun Chu Group."
Chu Haotian was taken aback, "Mr. Lin, is there something about our company you are not satisfied with?"
Lin Fan said, "I will not cooperate with someone who doesn’t dare to acknowledge his own biological daughter."
Chu Haotian immediately understood his meaning; Chu Xiaoxiao is his biological daughter, and he refused to acknowledge her identity.
"Mr. Lin, may I ask what your relationship with Xiaoxiao is?" Chu Haotian inquired tentatively.
Lin Fan said, "I am Xiaoxiao’s teacher."
Chu Haotian was a bit curious; isn’t Lin Fan Yun City’s richest man? How could he be Xiaoxiao’s teacher? He immediately thought that Lin Fan was making an excuse. More likely, he might have affection for Xiaoxiao.
With this thought, he became excited. If Lin Fan and Xiaoxiao were truly in love, then wouldn’t Lin Fan be his son-in-law!
The richest man in Yun City as Chu Haotian’s son-in-law, and a trillion-project. If Lin Fan were really his son-in-law, then the project would undoubtedly be his.
Chu Haotian cleared his throat and patted his chest, "Mr. Lin really cares about Xiaoxiao. Actually, it’s not that I don’t want Xiaoxiao. It’s just that my old mother and wife at home are a bit tricky. But don’t worry; I have decided. I will find a way, overcome the difficulties, and bring Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family!"

chapters.title: Chapter 338: From Disdain to Scrambling
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 338: From Disdain to Scrambling
In the hospital room, Chu Xiaoxiao’s emotions were incredibly complex. She had just met her biological father, whom she had never seen before.
But this father was very cold towards her, not even wanting to acknowledge her as his biological daughter.
Although she had no impression or feelings for this biological father since childhood, her mood was still a bit down. For a child, the feeling of not being acknowledged by their biological father is indeed very distressing.
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang had not given up on persuading Xiaoxiao to come home.
They had no choice; to them, Xiaoxiao is undoubtedly a money tree now. The decision they made back then to have Xiaoxiao leave school and get married was to raise medical expenses for their son. Although Xiaoxiao neither got married nor left school, they still obtained a considerable amount of medical expenses.
This made them realize that only with Chu Xiaoxiao by their side could they continue to use her to get money in the future.
"Xiaoxiao, you also saw how indifferent your biological father is to you. He simply won’t acknowledge you, so drop this idea," said He Meifang.
Chu Yuanhang added, "I know what you’re thinking, meeting your biological father makes you want to go to the Chu Family, thinking we’re too poor, right? But I still advise you to drop that idea, Chu Haotian absolutely will not let you return to the Chu Family."
He Meifang said, "Besides us, no one will take you in; you won’t have a home."
"You can’t just live in school forever, can you? We’ve already apologized for our previous actions. I hope you don’t go too far. Unless you want to be homeless forever!" Chu Yuanhang said.
Chu Xiaoxiao stared at them as they exchanged words back and forth.
"Are you finished? Now it’s my turn. Do you think I’ll forgive you just like that? Not so easily! You forced me to drop out of school, forced me to marry someone I don’t like. You’re unworthy of being my parents!"
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang exchanged a glance, both showing a bit of displeasure.
"You ungrateful child, just listen to what you’re saying. At the end of the day, I am your mother. I naturally have the right to decide important matters like your marriage," He Meifang said.
Chu Yuanhang snorted coldly, "Exactly, if it weren’t for that teacher interfering, you would have been married off, and you wouldn’t have had the right to refuse. If you continue to be stubborn and refuse to come home, then we won’t recognize you as our daughter in the future!"
He Meifang added, "If you don’t want to come back to this home, then don’t come at all; your brother won’t have you as a sister."
Chu Xiaoxiao’s face changed. She was utterly disappointed with her parents, even if it meant severing ties with them; she wouldn’t miss it. However, she could not abandon her sibling relationship with Chu Xiaoming. In this matter, Chu Xiaoming was innocent, and their sibling relationship had always been very close.
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang knew the bond between her and Chu Xiaoming was strong, so using this to threaten Chu Xiaoxiao was somewhat shameless.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s body shook with anger. They had indeed hit her weak spot.
Seeing Chu Xiaoxiao remain silent, Zhu Yuanhang chuckled, thinking they had succeeded, and Chu Xiaoxiao would have no choice but to go back with them, becoming their money tree.
He Meifang smiled and said, "That’s the way, isn’t it? You’re not going back to school, stay with Xiaoming, accompany Xiaoming, and then we’ll all go home together."
Chu Yuanhang smiled triumphantly. He was convinced that Chu Xiaoxiao would eventually go back with them because, firstly, she had nowhere else to go, and secondly, she couldn’t bear to leave Chu Xiaoming.
"Sister, come home with me, be with me, okay?" Chu Xiaoming pleaded.
For Chu Xiaoming, nothing else mattered; he just wanted his sister to come home.
"I..."
Chu Xiaoxiao was also struggling internally. She didn’t want to return to that house because it hurt her too deeply, and she couldn’t find it in her heart to forgive. No matter what, she didn’t want to go back.
What they said, however, was partly true—if she gave up on that home, she would be truly homeless. Moreover, if they wouldn’t let her see her brother in the future, she couldn’t accept that either.
Chu Xiaoxiao was wrestling with these thoughts.
"How dare you shamefully ask her to go back and be your servant after what you’ve done to her!"
Suddenly, a voice spoke, and Chu Haotian walked in with his hands behind his back. His face was sullen, full of displeasure, and he glanced angrily at Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang.
Everyone turned their eyes towards Chu Haotian, somewhat surprised, as they didn’t expect him to say such things—was Chu Haotian speaking up for Chu Xiaoxiao?
Chu Haotian glared coldly at Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang, snorting, "I already know the kind of people you are. That day Princess Yu already told me everything. How dare you treat my daughter like this? You must be tired of living!"
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang were shocked by these words too—what on earth had gotten into Chu Haotian?
Chu Haotian quickly moved to Chu Xiaoxiao’s side. His expression softened instantly, and in a gentle voice, he said, "Xiaoxiao, I’m sorry for treating you unfairly. It’s all my fault, and I haven’t been there for you all these years. Honestly, I’ve always thought of you, just couldn’t come see you. Now, I know I was wrong. You’re my daughter, so please give me a chance to make up for the grievances you’ve suffered."
Chu Xiaoxiao looked at Chu Haotian in surprise; she never expected such words to come from him. She thought Chu Haotian didn’t care at all about having this biological daughter.
The fact is, this was the first time she had ever seen her biological father in her entire life; if Chu Haotian had cared even a little about her, he wouldn’t have avoided seeing her all these years.
"Wh-what are you saying?" Chu Xiaoxiao curiously asked.
Chu Haotian said, "I mean, Xiaoxiao, I’ve made up my mind; I want to bring you back to the Chu Family. You’re my daughter, and I won’t let you suffer anymore."
"Wh-why?" Chu Xiaoxiao’s voice quivered slightly as she asked.
The fact that Chu Haotian wanted to bring Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family stunned Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang.
He Meifang couldn’t help but ask, "Chu Haotian, what exactly is your plan?"
They certainly didn’t know how much Chu Haotian wanted Xiaoxiao to come home, considering she might be in a relationship with Lin Fan, Yun City’s new richest man. The richest son-in-law was something he couldn’t miss.
As for whether he actually felt any genuine affection for Chu Xiaoxiao, that was no longer important—Chu Xiaoxiao was merely a tool to him.
Chu Haotian said, "What plan could I have other than bringing Xiaoxiao, my daughter, home? It’s only right."
He Meifang said, "No, something’s off. All these years, you didn’t care for this daughter at all, and now you want to take her back home? I’ve raised her this far without you doing a thing, and now you want to jump in and take her away from me?"
Chu Haotian laughed coldly, "I’m here to take her, so what? Xiaoxiao is now utterly fed up with you; do you think you can really keep her?"

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Chu Xiaoxiao’s Final Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 339: Chu Xiaoxiao’s Final Choice
In Chu Xiaoxiao’s memory, she has always been a dispensable person from childhood to adulthood.
At home, Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang treated her like a servant. They scolded and hit her at will. In contrast, they were extremely fond of her younger brother.
Chu Xiaoxiao always envied her brother. She also wanted to be loved by her parents like him, but she never received such affection.
Until recently. When they asked her to drop out of school and get married, she realized that they never cared about her. She didn’t dare to hope for their love anymore.
Since then, she had no more expectations. Her heart had died.
She didn’t want to return to this home because she felt it never belonged to her. The only attachment she had there was her relationship with Chu Xiaoming, who truly loved her as his sister.
So Chu Xiaoxiao never dreamed that one day, she would become the object of her parents’ contention, as if suddenly, she had become a hot commodity, something everyone adored.
Not only did Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang try their hardest to bring her back home, but even her biological father, Chu Haotian, whom she had never met, suddenly claimed he wanted to take her back.
The two sides quarreled over who would have her.
He Meifang refused to let Chu Xiaoxiao return to the Chu Family; she wanted to keep her by her side. Her reason was that she had raised Chu Xiaoxiao, and Chu Haotian had nothing to do with it, so he had no right to take her away.
But Chu Tian’s reasoning was also simple: Chu Xiaoxiao was his biological daughter, a member of the Chu Family, and he had the right to take his own daughter home.
As the two sides were arguing fiercely, Lin Fan beckoned. He called out Chu Xiaoxiao.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What are you thinking now?"
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head in distress and said, "I don’t know. Teacher Lin, can you tell me what I should do?"
Lin Fan said, "That depends on what you want to choose. First of all, do you want to go back to your mother’s home?"
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head, "I don’t want to. But I can’t bear to leave my brother. They said if I don’t return, they won’t let me see him in the future."
Lin Fan said, "Then do you want to return to the Chu Family?"
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head again, "I don’t want to go back either. I’ve never been there. I don’t belong there; I have no sense of belonging there. I just met my biological father today for the first time. As for that family, the only one I have is Princess Yu, who sincerely treats me well."
Lin Fan nodded, "I see. So it doesn’t matter if you go to your mother or your biological father’s place. Let me analyze it for you. Going back to your mother’s place won’t bring you any benefits. Instead, they’ll continue to take advantage of you. Do you know why your stepfather and mother are so eager to bring you back? They think they can benefit from you! Last time, Chu Yufei covered your brother’s medical expenses. Even if you don’t return to the Chu Family, you have Chu Yufei’s support.
Hearing this, Xiaoxiao trembled with anger.
She knew what was being said was true. In fact, Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang were motivated by self-interest. If she had nothing they could exploit, they wouldn’t be so keen to bring her back. From childhood to adulthood, she was always a dispensable person. How could they suddenly care so much about her?
Lin Fan said, "Then there’s the Chu Family. In Yun City, the Chu Family is a prominent family with Yun Chu Group, a hundred-billion-dollar enterprise. If you return to the Chu Family, you can leverage these resources, and as Chu Haotian’s biological daughter, you should have the right to some of this. With these resources, you can change your life. Many common people wish to change their destiny and achieve social mobility, but lack the opportunity, spending a lifetime in mediocrity. Yet, you have such an opportunity; the question is whether you can seize it. You’ve probably experienced the plight of poverty firsthand. Your stepfather and mother couldn’t even afford tens of thousands in medical fees, forcing you to drop out and marry for some medical costs. If you had money, your life wouldn’t be so miserable and bitter. I’ve said enough; it’s up to you to decide how to choose.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s body trembled slightly. Lin Fan’s words were like a wake-up call. Her life, previously shrouded in mist, became clearer and more focused.
Lin Fan’s words helped her grasp the key point.
"Teacher Lin, your words were clear. I know what choice to make now," Chu Xiaoxiao said, finally making up her mind.
She decided to return to the Chu Family as Chu Haotian’s youngest daughter.
She wanted to claim her share of the inheritance that she deserved.
This decision was not about her feelings for Chu Haotian or the Chu Family, but about claiming what was rightfully hers. That’s Lin Fan’s message.
Lin Fan felt relieved seeing Chu Xiaoxiao finally make her decision. Lin Fan was a practical person who wished for Xiaoxiao to get the maximum benefit at this time.
For these people, emotions were secondary, while interests determined their relationships. Given this, Lin Fan wanted to help Xiaoxiao maximize her benefits.
Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang never took Xiaoxiao seriously, treating her merely as a cash cow.
The reason why Chu Haotian wanted to take Chu Xiaoxiao home was also because of Lin Fan. He desired Lin Fan’s lucrative project and wanted him as a son-in-law. He didn’t really care about Chu Xiaoxiao. Until Lin Fan intervened, Chu Haotian didn’t even want to be present.
Alas, for Chu Xiaoxiao, she had been disappointed by her adoptive mother and felt no affection for her biological father, Chu Haotian.
Given this, returning to the Chu Family was her best choice.
In the hospital room, Chu Haotian and He Meifang were arguing fiercely, almost on the verge of physical conflict over Chu Xiaoxiao.
Just then, Chu Xiaoxiao and Lin Fan walked in.
Chu Xiaoxiao’s face was calm, and she said, "There’s no need to argue, I’ve already made my decision."
Both Chu Haotian and He Meifang fell silent, looking at Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Xiaoxiao, have you decided? Are you going to come home with Mom?" He Meifang asked hopefully.
Chu Yuanhang sneered, "Is there any need to ask? Xiaoxiao has no feelings for him. Of course, Xiaoxiao will come home with us."
He Meifang smiled, "Is that so, Xiaoxiao?"
Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t respond, but it seemed she had already made her choice.
Realizing something was wrong, Chu Yuanhang and He Meifang’s smiles froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 Angry Madam Chu
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 340 Angry Madam Chu
The Yuncheng Chu Family is a big family, and the current head of the Chu Family is Chu Haotian.
Chu Haotian is also the chairman of the Yun Chu Group, overseeing the main family business.
In the Chu Family, one could say he is the most powerful figure.
Of course, this is only on the surface.
The true power behind the scenes in the Chu Family is the family matriarch, Madam Chu.
Madam Chu is akin to Empress Dowager Cixi.
However, she is not Chu Haotian’s biological mother. Chu Haotian’s father had three wives in total, with two having already passed away, leaving the current Madam Chu.
Chu Haotian treats her like his birth mother.
Back then, it was this matriarch who personally helped Chu Haotian become the chairman of Yun Chu Group. The matriarch did have her own sons and daughters, but considering the future of Yun Chu Group, she ultimately chose the most capable Chu Haotian, even if it offended her own son.
Thus, Chu Haotian holds this matriarch in high regard; without her, he wouldn’t have what he has today.
On this day, in the Chu Family mansion.
Madam Chu was leisurely sitting at home. Most company matters were now managed by Chu Haotian, and the matriarch rarely involved herself, enjoying the relaxation.
A middle-aged, beautiful woman was keeping her company, chatting with her.
This middle-aged beauty was Chu Haotian’s wife, Madam Chu, and also the biological mother of Chu Yufei.
Chu Yufei walked in from outside, seeing her mother and grandmother chatting. She approached and greeted them.
"Yufei, you’re back just in time. Come over. Mom is thinking of buying a dress for Madam Chu, help me pick one," Madam Chu waved to Chu Yufei upon seeing her.
Chu Yufei came over and took the phone from her mother’s hand to look.
"I think this one looks nice, it suits Grandma’s temperament perfectly," Chu Yufei pointed to a picture and said.
Madam Chu laughed, "My dear Yufei always understands me. I also like this one, but your mother had a different opinion."
The matriarch’s tone revealed her deep affection for Chu Yufei, a sense of indulgence. In fact, she was very fond of this granddaughter.
Madam Chu laughed, "Since Madam Chu likes it and Yufei agrees, this will be the one. It’s most important that Madam Chu is happy. I’ll purchase it then."
Seeing that her mother and grandmother seemed to be in a good mood, Chu Yufei suddenly had a thought she wanted to express, but hesitated, unsure how to begin.
The matriarch noticed and asked, "Yufei, do you have something on your mind? Is there something you’re worrying about? Please, tell us."
Chu Yufei said, "No, it’s nothing, I’d better not talk about it."
Madam Chu said, "How could you not tell us? You’ve piqued my interest. Come on, what’s the matter?"
Madam Chu urged, "If Grandma asks you to say it, you should say it. Quickly, what’s the matter?"
Chu Yufei said, "Then I’ll say it, but please don’t get upset."
With a bit of hesitation, she finally gathered her courage, "I want to bring Xiaoxiao home."
The matriarch frowned, "Xiaoxiao, who is that?"
Madam Chu said, "Yufei, you didn’t bring in another pet, did you? You know Madam Chu doesn’t like puppies, I warn you, don’t bring a puppy home."
Chu Yufei was amused and exasperated, "It’s not a pet. Xiaoxiao is a person, she... she is also Dad’s daughter.
What?
Both the matriarch and Madam Chu’s expressions changed.
"Yufei, what do you mean?" Chu Tianren asked with a furrowed brow.
Seeing her mother’s expression, Chu Yufei felt a wave of fear, but she bravely continued, "It’s like this, I recently found out that Dad has another daughter outside, born to that woman named He Meifang. Her name is Chu Xiaoxiao. I want to bring her back to our Chu Family."
Chu Yufei wanted to bring Chu Xiaoxiao back because she felt Xiaoxiao was too pitiful. She grew up in a poor family, and her stepfather and mother never treated her well, even forcing her to drop out of school to marry for money.
Her half-sister, Zhang Cuifei, is a kind-hearted person. Chu Yufei couldn’t bear to see Xiaoxiao in such a predicament. As someone who often did charitable work, it might have been her occupational habit to want to help.
Hearing the name He Meifang, both the matriarch and Chu Tianren’s expressions turned grim, as if they had just swallowed a fly.
"No, absolutely not," Madam Chu shouted, her tone leaving no room for argument.
The matriarch scoffed, "So, this is the bastard child of that woman. Our Chu Family cannot bring such a child in, absolutely not!"
Madam Chu was a bit angry, "Where did you hear this from? Who told you about this person in the north? Was it your father?"
Chu Yufei did not expect such a strong reaction from her mother and grandmother. They didn’t just refuse, they seemed to regard Xiaoxiao as a dangerous beast, showing extreme aversion.
Chu Yufei said, "Why can’t she? Xiaoxiao is a good girl, she’s also Dad’s daughter, she ought to come back to our family instead of suffering outside."
The matriarch said coldly, "You need not mention this again, as long as I’m alive, I won’t allow that vile woman to step into our Chu Family!"
Chu Yufei was rendered speechless; their derogatory language towards He Meifang and Xiaoxiao indicated deep-rooted dislike.
Changing the matriarch’s opinion would be an incredibly difficult, if not impossible, task.
"Enough, Yufei, listen to your grandmother. Don’t think about it anymore. I don’t care where you met this contemptible person, but she cannot join our family, understood? Don’t bring this up again, or I’ll pretend I didn’t hear it," Madam Chu said.
Chu Yufei sighed, feeling very downcast, unsure of what to do next.
Neither her mother, nor her father, nor grandmother wanted to discuss Xiaoxiao. She had failed to persuade Chu Haotian, so she came back early to seek help from her mother and grandmother, but they were even more opposed to Chu Xiaoxiao.
Back then, Chu Haotian had an unintended relationship with He Meifang. Due to He Meifang’s low status, the Chu Family regarded the matter with disdain, and it had become a family disgrace in the matriarch’s eyes. No wonder mentioning He Meifang or Xiaoxiao roused such ire.
At that moment, Chu Haotian walked in from outside.
As soon as Chu Haotian appeared, the atmosphere changed sharply, "Chu Haotian, did you do something good again?"
Chu Haotian looked puzzled, "What is it?"
Madam Chu sneered, "Don’t pretend you don’t know. You want to bring Chu Xiaoxiao home? You think I don’t know? You even got Yufei involved to stir our feelings. You’re quite something!"
Chu Yufei didn’t want her parents to argue and quickly said, "This matter has nothing to do with Dad. I accidentally discovered the past myself. The idea of bringing Xiaoxiao back is mine, I talked to Dad, and he refused."
Madam Chu stared at Chu Haotian, "Is that true?"
Chu Haotian’s expression grew complex, eventually calming down to speak plainly, "I’ve made my decision. I will bring Xiaoxiao back.
What?
Madam Chu, Madam Chu, and even the ever-present Chu Yufei were all shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: The Entire Clan is Shocked, a Distinguished Guest Will Visit the Chu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 341: The Entire Clan is Shocked, a Distinguished Guest Will Visit the Chu Family
Chu Haotian actually wants to bring Xiaoxiao home!
These words coming from Chu Haotian’s mouth surprised everyone present.
"What did you say? Say it again." Madam Chu said angrily.
Madam Chu said, "Haotian, are you crazy?"
Chu Yufei was also puzzled. She had previously begged Chu Haotian to bring Chu Xiaoxiao home, but Chu Haotian always refused. His attitude was very firm, and it was obvious that Chu Yufei was heartbroken. She could no longer persuade her father.
So she came back to try to persuade her mother and grandmother...
Unexpectedly, she was not fully asleep, and neither her mother nor grandmother expected that her father had changed his mind.
She wanted to ask Chu Haotian what kind of change of mind led to his decision.
Chu Haotian said: "I thought about it. Xiaoxiao is my daughter. She is having a hard time now, and if I don’t bring her back, her situation outside will be difficult. No matter what, I can’t let her suffer outside, I must bring her back."
Madam Chu angrily said: "No way, I think you want to make me angry to death."
Chu Tianren said: "Apart from sounding nice, if you bring that bastard back, I’m not done with you."
Chu Haotian said: "Anyway, I’ve already decided. I hope you can think about it. Of course, I will respect your wishes. I will withdraw the decision until you agree. If you disagree, anyway, she cannot enter this house."
Madam Chu sneered: "Chu Haofeng. You should know, Madame Chu and I will never agree, I really don’t understand what you’re thinking, where do you get your confidence? Do you think we’ll agree? We’ll agree?"
Chu Haotian said: "I don’t know either. Yufei, come with me, I need to talk to you."
Chu Yufei responded, stood up, and followed her father out.
Madam Chu was furious: "Chu Haotian, don’t you walk away today without explaining things clearly."
Chu Haotian ignored her and left with Chu Yufei. At the door, he turned his head and said: "Oh, one more thing, tomorrow our Chu Family will have a distinguished guest. I hope everyone in the Chu Family should come to welcome the guest."
Madam Chu frowned, a little confused: "What kind of guest requires such a big reception?"
Chu Haotian said: "Yun City’s new richest person."
Madam Chu’s face changed: "Yun City’s new richest person, could it be that young man named Lin Fan?"
Madam Chu said: "Haotian, what did you say? Mr. Lin is coming to our Chu Family?"
The mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin is extremely famous. In Yun City, almost everyone knows about him.
In just under half a month, he went from being an unknown delivery man to Yun City’s new richest person. It’s practically a legend, a story that is incredibly curious and surprising.
Throughout the streets and alleys of Yun City, legends of Lin Fan have spread, with countless versions, but none has been able to truly explain how Lin Fan rose so quickly?
These speculations made Lin Fan’s identity even more mysterious, enveloping him in an aura that seemed unfathomably profound.
It is this inexplicable sense of awe and respect that people have for Lin Fan.
Chu Haotian said: "That’s right. Mr. Lin. Tomorrow will be back."
Chu Haotian didn’t explain further and then left with Chu Yufei.
Lin Fan is coming to the Chu Family!
As soon as the news came out, it shocked the entire clan.
In Chu Haotian’s study.
Chu Yufei couldn’t help but say: "Dad. Is what you said true? Is Mr. Lin really going to visit our home?"
She hadn’t thought that Lin Fan would come; she had just bravely connected her father to him. She never thought her father could reach out to Mr. Lin.
Chu Haotian said: "How can I joke about this? Mr. Lin is indeed coming tomorrow, and he will bring Xiaoxiao with him."
Chu Yufei froze for a moment.
Suddenly, she seemed to understand something.
"I understand now, Dad. If I’m not mistaken, you changed your mind about bringing Xiaoxiao back because of Mr. Lin, right?" Chu Yufei said.
Chu Haotian smiled bitterly: "Personally, I really don’t want to bring Xiaoxiao back. You’ve seen your mother’s and grandmother’s reactions. I’m afraid there will be no peace at home once Xiaoxiao returns. However, I can’t refuse to bring her back because it’s Xiaoxiao’s own choice."
Next, he told Chu Yufei about what happened in the hospital.
He fought with He Meifang for Xiaoxiao at the hospital. Xiaoxiao finally chose to return to the Chu Family, and this idea was supported by Lin Fan.
Chu Haotian knows he wants to connect with Lin Fan. To get that project worth supposedly billions, he must bring Xiaoxiao back.
When leaving the hospital, Lin Fan agreed that he would personally bring Xiaoxiao to the Chu Family tomorrow.
It seems that Lin Fan is determined to help Chu Xiaoxiao return to the Chu Family. If he doesn’t agree, he doesn’t know how Lin Fan might retaliate.
Chu Haotian’s current worry is that he can’t handle his wife and Madam Chu. If these two women oppose Mr. Lin and prefer offending him rather than accepting Xiaoxiao, things will become difficult.
Chu Yufei said: "Father, I think you’re overthinking it. I’ve interacted with Mr. Lin, and I don’t think he’s that kind of person."
Chu Haotian sighed: "Hopefully so. Anyway, tomorrow there’s going to be a good show."
Chu Yufei had already tried her best, and she couldn’t do anything now. Xiaoxiao wants to return to the Chu Family. Maybe what she couldn’t accomplish, Lin Fan can achieve.
At this thought, she also became extremely excited about tomorrow.
At this moment, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao had just walked out of the hospital. They had just visited Lin Dawei, and afterward, Lin Fan was about to drive Xiaoxiao back to school.
"Teacher Lin. Can you accompany me for a walk, to unwind a bit?"
Chu Xiaoxiao was in a bad mood. Today, she realized she was a tragedy. Her biological parents didn’t care about her.
No matter what decision she ends up making, returning to the Chu Family would not be an easy path, and there will likely be many troubles in the future.
Lin Fan said: "No problem, let’s find a place to stroll around."
They then went to an amusement park. The plaza was bustling, with people coming and going, bustling with excitement.
There were many stalls on the plaza, offering various games.
Lin Fan brought Xiaoxiao there, hoping she could have fun and forget about her worries.
"Handsome and beautiful, want to try a challenge? Hit it and take it home."
A stall owner came over, touting his game to Lin Fan and Xiaoxiao.
At the stall, many items were laid out on the ground. Customers could throw a ring, and whatever it landed on, they could take. However, this was not easy, and most people couldn’t manage it.
"Teacher Lin, I want to play this." Chu Xiaoxiao said.
The stall owner was delighted. It was always good for such games to have players; it was a very easy way to earn money, akin to getting money for free.
He wondered how much he could make from them this time, thinking gleefully to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: It’s Too Hard for the Unlucky Child, Pass Some Luck to Xiaoxiao
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 342: It’s Too Hard for the Unlucky Child, Pass Some Luck to Xiaoxiao
Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao to the amusement park for some relaxation. They were stopped by a booth owner at a ring toss game.
Chu Xiaoxiao was interested in the ring toss and wanted to play.
Lin Fan asked the booth owner, "How do you play this?"
The booth owner said, "One yuan per ring, minimum of 10 rings per play. Toss the rings, whatever you successfully loop belongs to you. If you miss, you get nothing."
Ten yuan, it’s nothing really.
Lin Fan said, "Give us 10 rings first."
Lin Fan paid with his phone.
The booth owner handed them 10 rings.
The rings were quite small, while the ground was covered with various items. There were toys, shoes, and even antiques like vases. The largest antiques were placed the furthest away and seemed to be the most valuable.
In booths like these, the owners basically make easy money because the rings are small, and most people can’t easily loop anything. Typically, if someone can loop even one out of 10 rings, it’s already quite good. Some people spend dozens of yuan and don’t loop a single thing, effectively giving the booth owner free money.
It’s usually difficult to make the booth owner lose money unless you can hit every single time or manage to loop the most valuable item.
Lin Fan handed the rings to Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao started tossing the rings; the first one missed, the second one missed too.
In a blink of an eye, she tossed 5 rings, all missed, not one hit.
Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit frustrated, thinking it’s just too hard.
The booth owner smiled contentedly. Missing was expected. He had already pocketed 5 yuan effortlessly.
Soon, Chu Xiaoxiao finished tossing all ten rings, all missed, giving the booth owner an easy 10 yuan.
"Ten more," Lin Fan said and paid another 10 yuan to the booth owner.
"Alright," the booth owner quickly handed them 10 more rings.
Chu Xiaoxiao lost her confidence, "Teacher Lin, why don’t you try?"
Lin Fan comforted her, "It’s okay, just focus on what you like and aim all your tosses at that target."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I like that unicorn plush toy."
So she concentrated all her tosses on the pink unicorn toy.
Another round of 10 rings, and the unlucky kid hit none.
Another 10 rings wasted, the booth owner easily earned 20 yuan.
The booth owner almost burst into laughter; he loves unlucky kids like Chu Xiaoxiao. Earning 20 yuan was way too easy. At a factory, many people work hard for an hour for just 15 yuan, while he made 20 yuan in a few minutes.
"Look, this girl is so dumb, can’t even hit one,"
A mocking voice from a nearby girl rang out.
This girl was quite average-looking, even could be said to be ugly. Accompanied by her boyfriend, she passed by and mocked seeing Chu Xiaoxiao’s failed attempts.
Meanwhile, quite a few idle people gathered to watch.
Upon hearing this, everyone laughed, indeed Chu Xiaoxiao was quite unlucky. Even by sheer luck, one should hit something, but she hit none.
Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit dejected, yet a bit unconvinced. She was already in a bad mood, and now she felt even worse.
"I want to play too, I’ll show her what a real expert is," the ugly girl came over with confidence.
Her boyfriend was a regular guy with glasses.
The glasses guy protested, "Let’s not. This kind of thing is just giving people free money, wasting money."
The ugly girl snapped, "Won’t you even spend 10 yuan on me? You better not even think about kissing me today."
Puff!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh. With a face like that, he wouldn’t kiss her even if she paid him 10 yuan.
The ugly girl noticed Lin Fan laughing and gave him an angry glare, "What’s so funny? Do you want to kiss me too, you pervert!"
Lin Fan hurriedly said, "Stop, stop misunderstanding. I wouldn’t kiss you even if you paid me."
The ugly girl got angry and pulled glasses guy, "Look, this jerk is bullying me. You’re just standing there like you’re dead. Aren’t you going to stand up for me? Stand up for me!"
Glasses guy blushed, looked at Lin Fan but couldn’t curse back, clearly an honest person.
Lin Fan smiled, "Brother, sorry to trouble you."
Glasses guy glanced at Chu Xiaoxiao beside Lin Fan. Comparing her with his girlfriend, Chu Xiaoxiao was flawlessly beautiful, really breathtaking by any measure.
Glasses guy got a bit angry, why? Why does Lin Fan have such a beautiful girlfriend, while his girlfriend...
"I’ll buy you 10 rings, do your best."
Glasses guy took out 10 yuan and handed it to the booth owner, who gave them 10 rings.
The ugly girl approached the booth and began tossing.
After missing three times in a row, the fourth toss, she managed to loop a pair of shoes.
The ugly girl jumped with joy, "Great, I hit something."
The ugly girl then took the shoes into her hands.
The booth owner looked unwilling. Though the shoes weren’t expensive, just cheap goods, losing them looked bad.
The ugly girl glanced smugly at Xiaoxiao, smirking, "See? This is how you toss rings, unlike some people who tossed 20 and didn’t hit a single thing. So embarrassing."
The crowd roared with laughter.
Xiaoxiao didn’t argue; she couldn’t refute. She just felt there was no need for this girl to pick a fight with her; she had no quarrel with her.
Xiaoxiao, feeling unconvinced, told Lin Fan, "I want to try one more time."
Lin Fan didn’t hesitate and gave another 10 yuan, taking ten rings.
"Missy, fancy a competition? Dare you?" the ugly girl challenged, "I only have 6 rings left, you have 10. I’ll give you four, let’s see who hits more in the end. If you win, I’ll give you these shoes. But if you lose, you compensate me 100 yuan. Dare you?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I’m not interested in competing with you."
The ugly girl laughed, "Seems like you’re a coward, not daring to compete because you know you’re bound to lose."
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "It’s not that I’m afraid to lose; I’m just not interested in competing. Honestly, I’m not interested."
The ugly girl laughed loudly, "You’re just afraid to lose. Everyone’s seen it; your luck is really bad. You tossed 20 and hit none, shows your luck is bad, and your skill is poor too."
The surrounding people started gossiping, all mocking Chu Xiaoxiao.
Usually gentle, Chu Xiaoxiao also had her temper.
On a whim, fine, challenge accepted, who fears who?
"Looks like I’ll take that 100 yuan today. You go first," the ugly girl said.
Chu Xiaoxiao still stuck to her previous strategy, aiming at the pink unicorn.
Standing by, Lin Fan thought, "I really wish I could share some top-tier Koi Carp Luck with Xiaoxiao."
He had this wish because he also found Xiaoxiao to be quite unlucky, really low on good luck.
After Lin Fan finished wishing...
Chu Xiaoxiao tossed the ring in her hand.
Everyone thought Xiaoxiao would miss for sure.
Generally, a clear situation, something unexpected happened. The loop suddenly became a sleeve, boxing the pink unicorn.
She hit it! Everyone paused in surprise.
Lin Fan was especially stunned, exclaimed internally. Did I really share luck with Xiaoxiao?
Could luck possibly be shared with someone?

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Luck Overflows, Completely Crushes the Ugly Woman, The Vendor is About to Cry
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 343: Luck Overflows, Completely Crushes the Ugly Woman, The Vendor is About to Cry
Chu Xiaoxiao hit the target with her first toss.
Even she was a little surprised and extremely delighted. She turned back to Lin Fan with a bright smile.
Lin Fan was somewhat dazed. When this girl smiles, she truly looks beautiful. She seems just like a little fairy.
The ugly girl saw Xiaoxiao hit the target and looked displeased: "This is just a case of a blind cat stumbling upon a dead rat! Watch me."
The ugly girl threw out the ring she held.
However, she missed.
The ugly girl stomped her feet, very angry.
It was Xiaoxiao’s turn again.
Xiaoxiao tossed the second ring.
She scored again and won a toy car.
Two successful hits in a row!
Chu Xiaoxiao was overjoyed. Before, she threw 20 in a row without hitting anything, and now she hit two in quick succession, it was truly delightful.
Could it be that her luck had turned?
After Xiaoxiao scored twice, the ugly girl watched with envy. Reluctantly, she tossed another ring.
It silently missed.
"I’m so mad, why did I miss again?"
The ugly girl was very angry.
Next, they took turns tossing.
Quickly, the ugly girl used up all 6 of her rings.
Every single one missed.
Chu Xiaoxiao hit all six with her tosses.
Chu Xiaoxiao still had 4 rings left, but the outcome of the match was already clear.
Chu Xiaoxiao: six hits, six throws. Ugly girl: six misses, six throws.
"I’m so mad!" the ugly girl said angrily, throwing her shoes to Chu Xiaoxiao, "Here, take them yourself."
The ugly girl was vexed. Originally she was going to win 100 yuan from Xiaoxiao, but now she lost a pair of shoes instead, although just now Xiaoxiao had thrown 20 without hitting any, how could she now hit all 6? If she hadn’t seen it with her own eyes, she wouldn’t have believed Xiaoxiao’s luck had suddenly gotten so good.
Even Chu Xiaoxiao couldn’t believe it herself. She actually managed to hit all 6 at once. She knew she didn’t have the skill, it was purely luck.
The stall owner was almost in tears. Xiaoxiao hit six times in succession, plus the pair of shoes taken by the ugly girl. He had instantly lost tens of yuan. The money he had previously earned was all given away. Basically, he hadn’t made a penny.
The worst part was, Chu Xiaoxiao still had 4 rings left in her hand.
He was depressed, upset, wondering how Xiaoxiao’s luck had suddenly become so good? Earlier she hadn’t hit any of the 20 she threw, how could this be?
The people surrounding them, who had just wanted to laugh, were now all amazed, indeed Xiaoxiao’s luck was incredibly good. In the last moment, her luck had become so favorable.
Lin Fan looked calm on the surface, but inside he was surprised.
After watching Xiaoxiao toss 6 and hit them all, he finally came to a definite conclusion.
His top-level Koi Carp luck could really be passed on to others.
Earlier he had silently prayed, hoping his luck could be transferred to Xiaoxiao.
Xiaoxiao’s luck indeed improved.
That’s not all. As Xiaoxiao’s luck improved, the ugly girl’s luck worsened.
She missed all of her 6 tosses consecutively.
Actually, Lin Fan had initially seen that the ugly girl had mastered certain skills. Based on her method, if she tossed 10 times, she should at least hit 3 to 4 targets."
But after throwing 6, all missed, as if her luck had suddenly turned bad.
Lin Fan was amazed that his own luck not only could be transferred to others but could also affect opponents, causing their luck to worsen. This was incredibly impressive.
Xiaoxiao still had 4 rings left, to further verify his conclusion.
Lin Fan said, "Don’t waste the remaining 4 rings. Throw them toward those antiques in the back."
He actually wanted them to throw at the farthest antiques.
The antiques were not only far away but also difficult to hit because the circle was too small, the antiques were smooth, almost impossible to hit.
That’s what those around thought as well.
"You want to toss them onto the antiques, that’s impossible!"
"If you can hit those antiques, then that’s remarkable!"
"I bet it won’t happen."
"This is purely about luck, I don’t believe she’s that lucky."
"Yeah, she’s already hit 6 in a row, however lucky she is, her luck should have run out."
People debated furiously.
The ugly girl sneered, "She really thinks her luck is that good, truly self-important, let’s see if she can hit any."
The ugly girl was ready to mock, hoping Xiaoxiao wouldn’t hit any.
Naturally, the stall owner also hoped Xiaoxiao wouldn’t hit any. Although those antiques were replicas, they were indeed the most valuable items there, each worth tens or even hundreds of yuan. If they were hit, his losses would be significant, practically catastrophic.
However, the stall owner was still quite confident that Chu Xiaoxiao wouldn’t hit them. He had been running this stall for half a year. No one had ever managed to hit those antiques. For a whole six months, no one managed to hit them."
It could be said that the probability of hitting these antiques was virtually zero.
Chu Xiaoxiao wasn’t very sure herself. She asked Lin Fan: "Teacher Lin, these antiques seem pretty hard to toss, perhaps I should try for something else, the success rate might be higher, but tossing for the antiques might fail."
Lin Fan encouraged, "It’s okay, even if you fail, you’ll only lose 4 yuan. But if you succeed, you’ll win big."
"Okay, I’ll listen to you." she ultimately decided to listen to Lin Fan and decided to compete.
She had 4 rings left.
Under everyone’s curious gaze, she released the first ring.
The ring flew out, tracing a parabolic path in the air, heading toward the farthest antique.
She hit!
The ring landed steadily on an antique vase. It had two handles, very small handles, and the small ring happened to circle the handle.
Ah!
A chorus of astonished gasps erupted throughout the venue.
No one could believe their eyes. Chu Xiaoxiao actually hit it, she really did.
"Oh my goodness, she really hit it."
"That’s incredibly impressive."
"I’m stunned!"
"Amazing!"
The crowd burst out with exclamations.
The ugly girl had been ready to mock, but now her smile turned awkward, a fire burning within her that couldn’t be vented, with a look as if she’d swallowed a dead fly.
The stall owner beat his chest and stamped his feet, almost in tears.
News spread about the ring-tossing expert here, drawing even more people to gather and watch.
Everyone held their breath, waiting for the result.
Chu Xiaoxiao tossed the second ring.
Another parabolic arc, the ring once again landed steadily on an antique.
This time the antique was a wine pot, with a small spout. The ring settled firmly around the spout. The success rate of this is extremely low, but it hit.
Her luck was just too good!
The square erupted in enthusiastic cheers.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: She is the legendary Emperor of Europe
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 344: She is the legendary Emperor of Europe
A loud cheer erupted in the square. Chu Xiaoxiao was incredible; she actually hit the target again.
So far, Chu Xiaoxiao has successfully tossed eight rings in a row.
Especially the last two, hitting the furthest and hardest-to-target antiques!
The crowd watching couldn’t help but cheer for her. They used to ridicule Chu Xiaoxiao, but now they’re left awestruck, completely impressed by her.
"Awesome, truly awesome!"
"I’ve seen many ring tosses, but she’s the best of all, hands down!"
"Two rings left; if she hits both, that would be godlike!"
"Could her luck have run out already?"
The crowd was abuzz with chatter, and more people came to watch, forming layers upon layers around her.
Chu Xiaoxiao took a deep breath. Suddenly being the center of attention was a first for her, making her a bit nervous and her cheeks turning red.
She couldn’t figure out why her luck suddenly changed; she had missed 20 times consecutively before and was ridiculed for it. Suddenly, her fortunes turned around.
Even she wasn’t sure about her luck; if she failed with the remaining two rings, she’d face ridicule once again.
Under everyone’s gaze, Chu Xiaoxiao tossed the third ring, aiming again at the furthest antique.
A parabolic arc followed.
The third ring landed securely on an antique.
"Ah!"
The crowd erupted with applause and cheers again.
This was amazing; she hit the target again, making it nine consecutive hits!
Only one remained; if she hit this one too, she would achieve the feat of ten consecutive hits. Not everyone could achieve this, and it could be said no one ever has.
If she succeeded, Chu Xiaoxiao would become the queen of ring toss.
Chu Xiaoxiao was about to toss the final ring. Instantly, the whole place fell silent; everyone was tense, holding their breath, all eyes fixed on the last ring in Chu Xiaoxiao’s hand.
The ugly woman felt pale due to Chu Xiaoxiao’s nine consecutive hits; she was completely outmatched by Chu Xiaoxiao. If the last one hit, she’d have nothing to say. If it missed, she could get a chance to mock.
So the ugly woman fervently hoped Chu Xiaoxiao would fail the last toss, silently cursing.
The stall owner shared the same sentiment.
The stall owner was on the verge of tears; Chu Xiaoxiao’s nine consecutive hits were too much. While the first six items weren’t worth much, the latter three were antiques.
Although these antiques were just cheap fakes he picked up, each could cost dozens, even hundreds of bucks.
He bought these fake antiques to attract customers. Without spending a bit, it’s hard to showcase something impressive and draw people to play.
Through careful selection and placement at the furthest points, these antiques were almost impossible to hit.
This achieved the goal of attracting players without losing a profit.
However, now Chu Xiaoxiao had managed to secure three!
Counting the value, it was worth several hundreds of bucks, and Chu Xiaoxiao only spent 30 bucks in total.
It was a bloodbath!
The stall owner’s heart bled.
In his heart, he desperately hoped Chu Xiaoxiao would fail the last toss, in order to stop further losses.
However, as the stall owner and the ugly woman secretly cursed,
