```
Lin Fan discreetly decided to give Chu Xiaoxiao a little more luck.
Amidst everyone’s anticipation, Chu Xiaoxiao’s final ring flew out, aiming for the most distant and off-corner bronze Buddha statue.
This so-called bronze Buddha statue was actually of unknown material, simply made to appear bronze. The Buddha’s head was larger than the ring, making it almost impossible to hit; the ring was likely to bounce off.
However, this time was an exception!
The ring landed perfectly on the Buddha’s head without bouncing off; the force dissipated just right, and the ring snugly fit on the Buddha’s head, appearing like it gained a halo.
"Hit!"
"Oh my god!"
"It’s a miracle!"
"Amazing!"
The scene immediately exploded, erupting with applause, cheering, and clapping.
The crowd seemed even happier than Chu Xiaoxiao herself.
Chu Xiaoxiao hit ten in a row!
The last performance was simply perfect!
The crowd couldn’t help but clap and cheer, completely captivated by Chu Xiaoxiao. If Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t have some impressive technique, then her luck was just phenomenal.
"I’m envious of this luck!"
"She must be the legendary Emperor of Europe!"
"Such luck is unmatched!"
The crowd was full of envy.
Lin Fan, on the other hand, smiled without a word. He just gave Chu Xiaoxiao a bit of luck, and they already worshipped her like this. If they knew his luck, wouldn’t they be floored?
The ugly woman turned pale as paper; she was completely out of temper. Chu Xiaoxiao hit all ten; she couldn’t even afford to sourly remark.
The stall owner’s heart bled; his curse had no effect; Chu Xiaoxiao still hit the target.
This bronze Buddha statue was the most expensive item in the entire stall; he spent over a hundred bucks on it, now taken by Chu Xiaoxiao. It surely was an unlucky day; such a financial loss!
"Teacher Lin, I hit all of them, I actually hit all of them." Chu Xiaoxiao excitedly said a little.
From childhood, she had been a jinx, considering herself unlucky. Judging by recent events, she was burdened with such a mom and stepfather, nearly forced to drop out and get married.
Just at the start, when she missed 20 consecutive tosses, that reaffirmed her status as a jinx, hopelessly unlucky.
So she couldn’t believe hitting all ten.
Lin Fan naturally wouldn’t reveal the truth to her and smiled, "Congratulations, now who dares say you’re unlucky, I’ll be the first to disagree."
Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit embarrassed, "Mm."
Lin Fan turned to the stall owner and said, "Boss, all these items are ours now, right?"
Although his heart bled, the stall owner couldn’t deny in front of the crowd, reluctantly nodding, "Yes, if you hit them, they’re yours."
Lin Fan laughed, "Then we won’t hold back."
Though these items weren’t expensive, since they were won as prizes, he let Chu Xiaoxiao take them all.
At that moment, an old man passed by and noticed the bronze Buddha statue amidst the stall’s goods, unable to resist letting out a sound of surprise, he quickly approached.
The old man picked up the bronze Buddha statue and inspected it carefully, suddenly displaying an expression of immense surprise.
"Sir, this statue is ours," Lin Fan reminded.
Seemingly not hearing, the old man mumbled excitedly, "My goodness, I found it here, amazing, amazing."
Then the old man turned to Lin Fan, "Young man, would you sell this statue? I’m interested in buying it, rest assured, I won’t take advantage of you. How about a one-time offer of 300,000? If you think it’s too low, we can negotiate further."
What?
Wanting to buy this junk statue for 300,000?
The crowd was instantly stupefied.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Earned 400,000 by Luck
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 345: Earned 400,000 by Luck
Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao were completely stunned.
The old man actually made an offer of 300,000 yuan to buy this Buddha statue?
It makes no sense; the vendor isn’t a fool. How could they possibly display such a valuable Buddha statue here for people to pick up?
Besides, if the vendor had such a valuable Buddha statue, there wouldn’t be any need to come out and do this kind of business.
Everyone actually knows in their hearts that the stuff at these booths are cheap wholesale goods. They claim to be antiques, but they’re really just fake items selling for tens of yuan.
So the vendor must have thought it was fake too, that’s why they displayed it.
If this Buddha statue really is worth 300,000 yuan, then there’s only one possibility: none of them recognize the value.
Lin Fan, who has a top-notch insight ability, also couldn’t see anything special about this Buddha statue. Could it be that something on the surface of the Buddha statue was obscuring Lin Fan’s judgment?
Lin Fan couldn’t help but ask: "Sir, what is so special about this Buddha statue?"
The old man replied: "It’s not an artifact or anything; it’s just that this Buddha statue was made by a very important old acquaintance of mine. It was lost later, and I never thought I would find it here. My acquaintance is a master sculptor whose works are quite famous in modern times. I estimate it’s worth just about 300,000 yuan now, so that’s what I’m offering. I don’t know if the young man is willing to part with it?"
Lin Fan said: "Strictly speaking, this Buddha statue isn’t mine; it’s hers."
Lin Fan pointed at Chu Xiaoxiao.
If it were his, he’d even consider giving it to the old man outright; to him, a mere 300,000 yuan is nothing.
But the item was won by Chu Xiaoxiao, and 300,000 yuan is definitely not a small amount for her.
The old man then turned to Chu Xiaoxiao: "Young lady, can you sell the Buddha statue to me? If you’re not satisfied with the price, we can negotiate."
Chu Xiaoxiao was too shocked to speak.
The old man assumed she was reluctant and said through gritted teeth and with determination: "Alright, how about this, 400,000 yuan! I’m very sincere. Consider it as doing me a favor..."
"No, no problem." Chu Xiaoxiao nodded repeatedly, finally calming down enough to speak.
The old man, very pleased, took out his phone from his pants pocket: "Young lady, give me your payment code, I’ll scan it for you."
Chu Xiaoxiao instinctively took out her phone and opened the payment code.
The old man scanned the payment code with his phone and quickly completed the transfer operation.
"Beep!"
Chu Xiaoxiao’s phone emitted a female voice, "Your wallet has received 400,000 yuan."
The old man said happily: "Alright, young lady, thank you very much."
The old man held the Buddha statue contentedly and left.
There was silence all around.
Even the sound of a pin dropping could be heard.
In their minds, the phrase "Your wallet has received 400,000 yuan" kept echoing.
The old man truly didn’t hesitate at all and gave Chu Xiaoxiao 400,000 yuan!
Which means Chu Xiaoxiao earned 400,000 yuan simply by using a circle that cost 1 yuan!
How many coincidences does it take to make this happen? She happened to pick this Buddha statue, the old man happened to pass by, the Buddha statue happened to be the long-lost work of his acquaintance, his acquaintance happened to be a master sculptor, and the work is valuable.
Luck!
This is clearly luck!
The luck is so overwhelmingly good, it’s no wonder everyone was left dumbfounded.
Chu Xiaoxiao herself was dumbfounded, shocked: "Did I just earn 400,000 yuan? Am I dreaming? Do I really have a 400,000 yuan balance now?"
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh and cry. It’s all because he unintentionally gave Xiaoxiao too much luck. He was just supposed to give her enough luck to win, but it turned out he overdid it, and she accidentally earned 400,000 yuan.
But it’s good; Xiaoxiao hasn’t had many good days since she was young, and now she has this money, at least she can live better.
What Lin Fan wants to earn for her isn’t just 400,000 yuan; he wants to help her return to the Chu Family, where she will have a share of the family’s assets worth billions.
The ugly girl at this moment had a face ashen as death.
"Take me away quickly, I’m not feeling well." The ugly girl said to her boyfriend, a boy with glasses next to her.
The boy with glasses quickly supported the ugly girl to leave, her steps were unsteady, as if she had no strength left in her body.
Emotions of envy, jealousy, and hatred erupted, leaving her weakly limp.
The vendor was stunned on the spot, speechless. This broken Buddha statue bought for a hundred yuan was sold by Chu Xiaoxiao for 400,000 yuan?
Suddenly, his vision went dark, and he fell to the ground, losing consciousness.
Others quickly rushed to help, causing chaos at the scene.
"Who has instant heart-saving pills?"
"Press the acupuncture point..."
"It’s not a big deal, he probably fainted from being too emotional. He’ll be fine after resting for a bit," someone said.
Everyone was filled with emotions.
"I’d faint too; a Buddha statue worth 400,000 yuan ended up in someone else’s hands!"
"It’s so unfortunate. If the old man had come a bit earlier, this Buddha statue would have been his."
"I can only say the young lady had amazing luck."
"Yeah, my god, this luck, pure Emperor of Europe luck!"
"Kneel before the Emperor of Europe!"
"Let us also get some European luck!"
The crowd was completely conquered by Chu Xiaoxiao’s luck, almost kneeling to worship her, crowning her the queen of luck.
"Xiaoxiao, shall we go now? Do you want to keep these things?" Lin Fan asked.
Chu Xiaoxiao said: "Forget it, let’s leave these for the vendor."
Walking away with 400,000 yuan and leaving the vendor crying on the ground, she felt a bit embarrassed.
So, they left behind the items they had previously won and promptly left the plaza.
Soon, they got into the Rolls-Royce and drove away from the amusement park. They didn’t want to stay there any longer; it was too conspicuous.
Inside the car, Chu Xiaoxiao was still not completely back to her senses, staring at the 400,000 yuan balance displayed on her phone in a daze.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Tomorrow we’re going to the Chu Family, so let’s buy some new clothes. You’re a Rich Lady now; you won’t miss this little bit of money."
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed: "Teacher Lin, I can’t believe it myself. My luck is so good. I used to be so unlucky; a day would be lucky if it wasn’t unlucky. Just now my luck suddenly changed for the better, and it turned out to be so good it’s unbelievable."
Lin Fan chuckled: "As the saying goes, when things reach an extreme, they start to rebound. You may have been down for so long that you’ve hit bottom and started bouncing back, so you’re beginning to get lucky."
"Really?" Chu Xiaoxiao was a bit incredulous. "I almost thought some Immortal was secretly helping me. Besides an Immortal, who else could suddenly change someone’s luck like this?"
Lin Fan nodded; whether it’s an Immortal is uncertain, but the system is extensive like an Immortal, which he can acknowledge. Xiaoxiao saying an Immortal is blessing her isn’t far from reality.
Chu Xiaoxiao was immersed in the shock and joy brought by the 400,000 yuan. For a child who is terribly afraid of poverty, suddenly having so much money, that kind of happiness, really isn’t understood by everyone.
Afterward, Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao to a mall to buy her some new clothes, preparing to wear them to the Chu Family tomorrow.
Arriving at the mall, they started strolling around the clothing store.
While choosing clothes, Chu Xiaoxiao almost bumped into a female shop assistant.
"Hey, aren’t you Chu Xiaoxiao?" the female shop assistant recognized Chu Xiaoxiao and smiled.
"Little Li!" Chu Xiaoxiao also recognized her. This female shop assistant actually used to be her upperclassman.
This Little Li knew about Chu Xiaoxiao’s family situation and became a bit curious: "Xiaoxiao, you’re here to buy clothes? You must be at the wrong place; the clothes here are quite expensive, you probably can’t afford them."

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Miss, your two pieces of clothing cost a total of 29,999 yuan.
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 346: Miss, your two pieces of clothing cost a total of 29,999 yuan.
In the past, Chu Xiaoxiao and Little Li had a pretty good relationship. Little Li was an upperclassman from her high school, but after she got into college, Little Li graduated and went straight to work, so they lost contact.
Unexpectedly, they ran into each other here, and Little Li was now working as a sales assistant in a mall.
Little Li was aware of Chu Xiaoxiao’s family situation, and she directly asked Chu Xiaoxiao why she came to buy clothes here.
Little Li remembered that Chu Xiaoxiao used to buy clothes from street vendors, which cost only about ten bucks.
But the clothes in this mall could easily cost several hundred.
Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t know how to respond to Little Li, she couldn’t exactly tell her she had just made 400,000 yuan.
Lin Fan said nonchalantly, "We might have come to the wrong place."
Little Li said, "I thought so, hey, Xiaoxiao, who is this, could he be your boyfriend?"
"No, he’s not!"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed and quickly denied it. She was shy; she did want Lin Fan to be her boyfriend, but in fact, he wasn’t.
Little Li laughed, "What’s the big deal about dating? You’re in college now, after all. But..."
She scrutinized Lin Fan, dressed in cheap clothes from head to toe, and couldn’t help but look down on him. Lin Fan was handsome, but he obviously looked poor. Handsomeness doesn’t feed you, having money is more important.
She believed Lin Fan was Chu Xiaoxiao’s boyfriend, but she looked down on poor people like him.
Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered to explain and smiled, "Xiaoxiao, how about we check out other places? The clothes here are too cheap; I’m afraid it won’t give you enough face wearing them tomorrow."
"What?"
Little Li was stunned.
Lin Fan just said they might have come to the wrong place—not because it was expensive, but because he thought the clothes here were too cheap?
Chu Xiaoxiao, used to living a frugal life, had no idea about fashion. Hearing Lin Fan, she was left without a clue, "So where should we buy clothes then?"
Lin Fan replied, "At least we should look at world-famous brands, like Ancient Words or Chanel."
"Alright, sorry, Little Li, we have to go," Chu Xiaoxiao told Little Li.
Saying this, the two of them were about to leave.
Little Li, puzzled, grabbed Chu Xiaoxiao, "Wait a second, did I hear that right? You’re going to buy Ancient Words or Chanel?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I don’t know either, I’m just following his lead."
Little Li exclaimed, "What a joke! Xiaoxiao, it’s one thing if you don’t know, but do you have any idea how expensive clothes from Ancient Words or Chanel are? I work here, earn almost 10,000 yuan a month, and I don’t even dare to buy them. I know your situation, how much money do you have on you? Can you afford them?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "What does this have to do with you?"
Little Li instantly felt annoyed, "What are you acting all high and mighty for! It’s obvious you’re poor. Talking about Ancient Words and Chanel—stop pretending in front of me! I’m just saying, Xiaoxiao, if you find a boyfriend, find someone reliable. What’s the use in someone who just pretends to be something they’re not!"
Chu Xiaoxiao blushed, "Little Li, please don’t talk like that. He’s really not my boyfriend."
Little Li added, "He’s not your boyfriend? Then you should stay away from people like that, too flashy, not realistic at all. I have some discounted old-style clothes here. A few years old, but really cheap, just about a hundred yuan each. How much money do you have? Can you buy one?"
For the old Chu Xiaoxiao, clothes around a hundred yuan were indeed quite expensive; she couldn’t afford them.
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Thanks, but there’s no need, Little Li."
She was only listening to Lin Fan, if Lin Fan said not to buy here, then she wouldn’t.
Little Li thought she probably found them too pricey, so she said, "A hundred yuan is very cheap, but since we’re old classmates, I can make it even cheaper. You have fifty yuan on you, right? Don’t tell me you don’t even have fifty yuan? Then sorry, you’ll have to try the street stalls."
This Little Li seemed all helpful, but in reality, looked down on Chu Xiaoxiao, with that haughty posture.
Even as naive as Chu Xiaoxiao was, she realized Little Li was clearly looking down on her.
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I need to go somewhere tomorrow and need to dress a bit nicer, so street stall goods are out. Little Li, I’ll be going now."
With that said, Chu Xiaoxiao no longer wanted to converse with Little Li, and left with Lin Fan.
Little Li pursed her lips, disdainfully muttering, "Pretending, never thought Xiaoxiao learned to pretend too; she used to be so pure. Must’ve learned it from this poor boyfriend of hers. Birds of a feather flock together. But she has no choice, poor people like her can only be with other poor people, not like me."
Compared to Chu Xiaoxiao, Little Li suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of superiority.
She came out to work right after high school, found this sales job, and worked for two years, earning 10,000 yuan a month.
Though not comparable to the wealthy, she felt she was heads above Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t even carry fifty yuan!
For kids from poor backgrounds like Chu Xiaoxiao, compared to her, Little Li considered herself rich, an upstart.
Little Li figured Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao were pretending they couldn’t afford clothes here, so they said they would go to Ancient Words or Chanel to save face. She was sure once they left, they would head out of the mall to buy street clothes outside.
Little Li smirked, watching their backs, feeling everything was under her control.
Yet she saw Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao didn’t leave the mall; instead, they actually walked into the luxury Chanel store across from them.
Seeing this, Little Li was stunned—no way, they really went into Chanel? They can’t be pretending that much.
"Tsk, those deadbeat poor folks must be faking it, going in just to browse, and then they’ll leave," Little Li thought, feeling reassured that she was right, Little Li felt better.
However, after a while, Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao still hadn’t come out of the Chanel store!
"Those two deadbeats dare to stay inside for so long? Pretending to be rich, must be tiring to keep up the act!" Little Li sneered.
"You pretend to be rich while being poor, I’m going over to expose you!"
Harboring ill thoughts, Little Li walked toward the Chanel store across the way.
Upon reaching the Chanel store entrance, Little Li was about to go in, she already prepared her words to expose them as poor and make them lose face publicly.
But she looked up to see Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao standing by the cashier counter.
The Chanel store clerk, holding ready-packed bags, smiled, "Miss, your two pieces of clothing come to 29,999 yuan. Will you be paying by credit card or cash?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I’ll use WeChat Pay."
Saying thus, Chu Xiaoxiao took out her phone and scanned to pay.
"Beep!"
"Payment successful!"
The Chanel clerk beamed, "Miss, here is your clothing, please take it."
Handing the clothes over to Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Thank you." Chu Xiaoxiao accepted the bag.
Witnessing this scene, Little Li was dumbstruck.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: How could you possibly be richer than me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 347: How could you possibly be richer than me?
Oh my god!
Chu Xiaoxiao actually bought clothes worth 29,999 yuan!
If she hadn’t seen it with her own eyes, Little Li wouldn’t believe it even if you beat her to death! That Chu Xiaoxiao who couldn’t afford clothes for a year.
Now she can actually buy clothes worth 29,999 yuan!
That’s quite an expenditure, Little Li wouldn’t dare to buy like that!
Could it be that Chu Xiaoxiao really has money, is she rich now? Little Li couldn’t help thinking, but quickly dismissed the thought.
No way, how could someone from Chu Xiaoxiao’s family suddenly become wealthy!
Little Li muttered, as if comforting herself.
She absolutely cannot tolerate Chu Xiaoxiao having more money than her, how could Chu Xiaoxiao be richer than her, she needs to show off her superiority in front of Chu Xiaoxiao.
But, how to explain Chu Xiaoxiao paying for it without blinking an eye!
She did pay successfully, meaning she has at least 30,000 on her!
Little Li racked her brains but couldn’t understand how Chu Xiaoxiao could have that amount of money.
At this moment, Chu Xiaoxiao finished buying clothes and walked out of the Chanel Store with Lin Fan, happy to have bought new clothes, even though 29,999 was too expensive for her, who wouldn’t spend even 20 yuan before, it was astronomical.
But she now had 400,000, and on Teacher Lin’s suggestion, she spent the huge sum without hesitation.
The saying goes ’raise sons sparingly and daughters lavishly’, Lin Fan had the mentality of an old father, and tomorrow Xiaoxiao was going to the Chu Family; he wouldn’t let anyone from the Chu Family have the chance to belittle Xiaoxiao.
The two walked out of the store.
Little Li approached, directly grabbed Chu Xiaoxiao: "Xiaoxiao, you really bought Chanel, where did you get so much money?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Little Li, you really want to know? Then I’ll be honest with you, today I went to play hoopla, hooked a piece of antique, unexpectedly, this antique turned out to be a treasure, someone spent 400,000 to buy it from me."
She spoke nothing but the truth, not a single word fabricated.
Little Li froze, but didn’t believe Chu Xiaoxiao for a second.
"Xiaoxiao, you think I’m a three-year-old child, these childish lies you’ve made up." Little Li said.
She had reason to believe Xiaoxiao made up this ridiculous excuse because she didn’t want to reveal the real reason.
Chu Xiaoxiao was distressed, she had told the truth but Little Li didn’t believe it, she was at a loss.
"Little Li, I’m really not lying to you." Chu Xiaoxiao said, "But whether you believe it or not, it doesn’t matter. We’ll be leaving first."
After saying this, Chu Xiaoxiao planned to leave with Lin Fan.
Little Li felt her self-esteem was being trampled on.
"Chu Xiaoxiao, stay right there!" Little Li said coldly, stopping Chu Xiaoxiao.
Chu Xiaoxiao frowned, turned to look at Little Li: "Little Li, what’s the matter?"
Little Li sneered: "Do you really have 400,000? I don’t believe it! How is that possible! Back then, I didn’t get into college, started working, my initial salary was only slightly over 3000, only gradually increased over a year, now it’s barely 10,000 a month! But my savings don’t even reach 50,000 because the expenses are too high! You, I heard you got into music school, but you’re still a student, how could you possibly have more money than me!"
Little Li was not willing to accept it, initially, she felt overwhelmingly superior in front of Chu Xiaoxiao, unable to accept that Chu Xiaoxiao was richer than her, so she wanted to get to the bottom of it.
"Well..." Chu Xiaoxiao was momentarily speechless, she rarely argued with people, feeling a bit unaccustomed.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, said: "You have less than 50,000 in savings, while Xiaoxiao has 400,000, what does it matter? Everyone has their own life experiences, you haven’t gone through Xiaoxiao’s life, what grounds do you have to say she couldn’t have 400,000 in savings?"
Little Li got a bit angry, Lin Fan’s words struck her heart, she was exasperated, shouted: "Because you are all paupers! How can you have more money than me!"
Little Li was genuinely a bit shattered.
Previously, she mocked Chu Xiaoxiao, thinking she didn’t even have 50 yuan and could only buy street goods.
As a result, Chu Xiaoxiao bought clothes worth 29,999 yuan, fiercely slapped her in the face, it was truly too provocative.
Little Li’s anger instantly attracted the attention of many bystanders.
"What’s happening?"
"Seems like this saleswoman thinks she’s richer."
"Uh, judging by the clothes, it does seem she’s richer!"
"Can’t be sure of that, you can’t judge a book by its cover!"
People pointed and whispered.
Chu Xiaoxiao was speechless, she didn’t like to be ostentatious, but Little Li wanted to blow things up.
"Little Li, why are you so agitated? Me having money bothers you?" Chu Xiaoxiao frowned, her gentle nature seldom showing a hint of anger.
Her wealth did indeed bother Little Li, because if she were richer and better off than Little Li, Little Li’s sense of superiority would immediately crumble.
At this moment, her emotions were indeed getting excessively intense.
Little Li sneered: "I don’t believe you have 400,000 in savings, I earn 10,000 a month, not eating or drinking, it would still take several years to save up 100,000, and that’s just you, where do you get 400,000?"
Chu Xiaoxiao shook her head: "Looks like I can only show you."
Chu Xiaoxiao opened her phone, showing Little Li her account balance.
Sure enough, after deducting the 29,999 yuan spent on clothes just now, Chu Xiaoxiao’s account balance showed 370,000!
Chu Xiaoxiao indeed has 400,000 in savings!
Little Li was stunned.
She saw it with her own eyes, couldn’t be wrong.
Just at this moment.
A beautiful woman walked over: "Mr. Lin, Xiaoxiao, so here you are."
Chu Yufei!
When Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao were at the Chanel Store, Chu Yufei already said she would come looking for them, at the time Lin Fan provided her the address.
Today Chu Haotian returned home, and unexpectedly changed his attitude, openly supporting Xiaoxiao returning to the Chu Family, even at the risk of clashing with Madam Chu and Madam Chu.
Furthermore, Chu Haotian announced that tomorrow Lin Fan would visit the Chu Family, which stirred up the Chu Family.
The new richest man in Yun City was personally visiting the Chu Family, could it be to discuss business with them?
People began to watch closely, on the same day, the Yun Chu Group of the Chu Family, whose stock price was originally steadily rising, suddenly started to soar.
Just from the news of Lin Fan visiting the Chu Family being announced!
The new richest man in Yun City, truly this title holds some influence.
Chu Yufei was very excited upon hearing this news because she knew Lin Fan was definitely going to bring Chu Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family tomorrow.
She and Chu Haotian couldn’t persuade Madam Chu and Madam Chu to agree to let Xiaoxiao come home, she thought maybe Lin Fan could.
So after leaving Chu Haotian’s study, she wanted to contact Lin Fan, upon hearing Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao were getting clothes here, she hurried over.
"Miss Chu?" Little Li was stunned, she recognized Chu Yufei, Chu Yufei had come to this mall before for charity events, she had witnessed it, Chu Yufei was the distinguished lady of Yun City’s Chu family, how come she’s here?
But Chu Xiaoxiao greeted her, smiling: "Sister, you’re here."
What?
Chu Xiaoxiao called Chu Yufei sister?
Wait a minute, they’re both named Chu, could it be...
Little Li thought of a possibility, her whole body was stunned, could it be, could it be, Chu Xiaoxiao is from the Yun City Chu Family?

chapters.title: Chapter 348: The Chu Family Awaits Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 348: The Chu Family Awaits Mr. Lin
"Xiaoxiao, you just called Miss Chu your sister, what’s your relationship?" Little Li said with a trembling voice.
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "She’s my sister."
Little Li said, "Are you from the Chu Family? What’s your relationship with Chu Haotian?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "Chu Haotian is my biological father."
Little Li was shocked: "How is that possible? If you’re Chu Haotian’s daughter, why were you so poor before?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "I only recently found out about my background."
Seeing Little Li wouldn’t stop asking Chu Xiaoxiao questions, Chu Yufei frowned: "Xiaoxiao, who is she?"
Chu Xiaoxiao said, "She’s a senior of mine. Sorry, Senior Little Li, we have to go now."
Little Li was shocked to the core. No wonder Chu Xiaoxiao had 400,000 in savings; it turns out she’s Chu Haotian’s daughter, and Chu Yufei is her sister!
Little Li’s sense of superiority completely collapsed. Never in her dreams did she think Chu Xiaoxiao had a long-lost father, and he’s a billionaire!
Why don’t I have one? Little Li instantly became envious and jealous. She also wished for a long-lost billionaire father.
At this moment, Chu Yufei, Chu Xiaoxiao, and Lin Fan turned around and left.
Chu Yufei said, "Mr. Lin, I haven’t congratulated you yet. Congratulations on becoming the new richest person in Yun City."
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Thank you."
Talking and walking, they gradually moved away.
Little Li stood frozen, petrified.
What? The new richest person in Yun City?
Oh my god, the man walking around in cheap clothes is actually the legendary young tycoon Mr. Lin?
She had, in front of the new richest person in Yun City, called him a pauper! Thinking of this, her face flushed with embarrassment; it was too humiliating.
Wait!
So, Chu Xiaoxiao’s boyfriend is actually the legendary Mr. Lin?
Little Li was utterly shocked; her body trembled with excitement, her face went from red to pale. The Chu Xiaoxiao she once looked down upon has a father that’s Chu Haotian, but more astonishing is her boyfriend is the billion-dollar legend Lin Fan!
The billion-dollar legend Lin Fan, the man countless women dream of!
Little Li suddenly realized the gap between her and Chu Xiaoxiao has widened too much; Chu Xiaoxiao has become an unattainable existence.
Little Li wanted to slap herself a few times. If she had known this earlier, she would never have offended Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao. She would have eagerly befriended them, but now she’s already offended them, and there’s no chance to make amends.
It’s as if she missed out on billions, and she regretted it so much her intestines turned green...
In fact, Lin Fan never regarded Little Li seriously; she was just another snobbish shop assistant among many he had encountered before.
At this time, Lin Fan and the Chu sisters were walking towards the mall exit.
"Mr. Lin, I heard from my dad that you’re coming to our Chu Family tomorrow. You should be bringing Xiaoxiao, right?" Chu Yufei asked.
Lin Fan said, "Did you come just to ask me that?"
Chu Yufei said, "Well... I’m a bit worried. Mr. Lin might not know, but my mom and grandma firmly oppose Xiaoxiao coming back home. They’re not easy to deal with. I’m wondering if Mr. Lin can persuade them?"
Chu Yufei couldn’t let it go. She wanted to probe the situation a bit and find some peace of mind.
Lin Fan said, "I’ve heard about them from Mr. Chu, but I haven’t met them yet, so it’s hard to say if I can persuade them. But one thing is certain, Xiaoxiao will definitely return to the Chu Family."
Lin Fan meant he would assist Xiaoxiao’s return to the Chu Family, regardless of whether Madam Chu and Old Madam Chu agreed.
If not friends, then foes.
Hearing Lin Fan say this, Chu Yufei felt a bit more at ease. She knew Lin Fan’s capabilities; in her mind, Lin Fan was like Superman.
Lin Fan said it would work, so it will definitely work.
She couldn’t help but look forward to tomorrow even more.
The news that the new richest man in Yun City, the billion-dollar legend Lin Fan, was visiting the Chu Family quickly spread.
First, it startled the entire Chu Family, everyone was thrilled and excited, but also a bit curious — what’s Mr. Lin’s purpose in coming to the Chu Family?
The business community heard the rumors too, and discussions began. Was Lin Fan’s visit a prelude to a possible business cooperation with the Chu Family?
The industries Lin Fan was involved in were leaders in their fields.
As the largest shareholder of Huaxin Company, they lead the world in chip technology, and Celestial Aviation is a giant among domestic private airlines.
Lin Fan’s hand sanitizer brand, Blue Moon, has a new product that’s a market hit, and it’s poised to become a leading brand in the daily chemical industry.
His stake in Jindu Grand Hotel makes it a top player in the hospitality industry.
Tianxue Entertainment Company, which he owns, dominates the entertainment industry!
These are just a few examples.
Now, Lin Fan connecting with the Chu Family leads the business community to believe he’s planning to cooperate with them.
The Yun Chu Group, the Chu Family’s main business, specializes in manufacturing mechanical parts and is the most powerful manufacturer in Jiangnan.
No one knows what Lin Fan’s exact plans are.
But this doesn’t stop the market’s optimistic view of Yun Chu Group, and their stock price responded positively.
Before this news, Yun Chu Group’s stock had been in a prolonged slump.
The Chu Family couldn’t believe that just the news of Mr. Lin’s visit had uplifted Yun Chu’s stock price.
Mr. Lin’s influence is simply enormous.
Realizing Lin Fan’s value, the Chu Family became even more excited and eagerly awaited his arrival.
Old Madam Chu ordered everyone in the Chu Family to be on their best behavior and not offend Mr. Lin!
Anyone who disobeys the order will face the family’s punishments!
Bringing up family laws wasn’t trivial — any Chu Family member who carelessly offended Lin Fan would face severe repercussions.
The Chu Family began to discuss it.
"Did you hear that? Better not say anything tomorrow!"
"Relax, who’s going to dare offend Mr. Lin?"
"Yeah, unless they’re stupid, who would want to cross Mr. Lin?"
"I don’t think there’ll be any fools getting themselves in trouble!"
The Chu Family became lively, almost like it was New Year’s Eve.
With the Chu Family eagerly awaiting, the next day finally arrived.
The whole Chu Family was waiting in anticipation for Lin Fan’s arrival.
Old Madam Chu got up early, meticulously dressed, ready to greet Lin Fan in the living room.
However, they waited from morning until almost noon, yet Lin Fan still hadn’t shown up.
Old Madam Chu couldn’t help but worry, "Haotian, what’s going on? When exactly is Mr. Lin coming?"
Chu Haotian wiped his cold sweat, "I don’t know either, Mr. Lin just said he’d visit today, but didn’t specify a time. Should I give him a call?"
Old Madam Chu thought for a moment and said, "No need, we’ll keep waiting. Since Mr. Lin said he would come, he won’t let us down. If he’s not here, there must be something going on. Let’s just wait."
Meanwhile.
Lin Fan woke up in his rented room, stretched lazily; he had slept so well, all the way till noon.
Lin Fan looked at his phone to check the time, murmuring, "I should give Xiaoxiao a call, she should be done with her classes by now."
It turns out he had made plans with Chu Xiaoxiao to visit the Chu Family after her morning classes.
Poor Chu Family, obediently waiting for them the whole morning...

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Who am I? My name is Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 349: Who am I? My name is Lin Fan
Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce to the school, picked up Chu Xiaoxiao, and then headed for the Chu Family.
The Chu Family mansion was built in the wealthy district, the environment was excellent.
In this wealthy district, luxury cars were everywhere, and the people who frequently came and went here were either rich or noble, driving sports cars and luxury vehicles. It would be a rare sight to come across an ordinary sedan.
Those driving ordinary cars were most likely taxi drivers, couriers, or food delivery workers.
Lin Fan was driving the Rolls-Royce along the road, and at a crossroads ahead, he saw with his own eyes a Ferrari sports car speeding, so Lin Fan slammed on the brakes and stopped the car.
It was most likely a Rich Second Generation, and Lin Fan didn’t want to risk his life with such a spoiled brat.
However, a food delivery electric scooter turned out from the side intersection and wasn’t so lucky.
The delivery rider didn’t anticipate the sports car moving so fast, and quickly tried to swerve, but was still a step too late.
The electric scooter brushed past the Ferrari sports car, flipping over on site.
The Ferrari sports car then parked sideways at the roadside, with visible scratch marks on one side of the car door and a peeling patch of paint.
Beside it, the electric scooter lay on its side, its delivery box overturned, a food container shattered, with food and sauce splattered everywhere.
The delivery rider was thrown off, landing on the ground. He struggled to get up, limping heavily, possibly having hurt his foot and unable to walk properly for now.
"Are you freaking blind!"
The young man in the Ferrari driver’s seat stuck his head out, shouting and cursing at the delivery rider.
He then opened the car door and got out.
This young man was dressed fashionably, with dyed yellow hair like a punk, but different from punks because he was covered head to toe in luxury brands, each outfit costing several thousands. This isn’t something any ordinary punk could afford to wear.
This was definitely a Rich Second Generation.
The Rich Second Generation saw the scratch on his car door, instantly agitated, clutching his head: "Damn it...damn it to hell...just look at what you did to my car!"
The Rich Second Generation pointed at the delivery rider, swearing furiously.
The delivery rider noticed the scratch on the Ferrari sports car, his legs went weak, almost falling over, pale-faced, damn it, he was screwed. This one scratch would cost him tens of thousands, how many deliveries would it take to earn tens of thousands!
He absolutely couldn’t afford it!
Damn it, he shouldn’t have been delivering food in this damned rich district. His colleagues had warned him that in a wealthy area, being extremely careful was necessary to avoid damaging a rich person’s car; one scratch could cost you your life.
Unexpectedly, he was so unlucky today, encountering the situation he feared most.
The delivery rider didn’t want to bear this responsibility.
The delivery rider said, "It’s not my fault, you were driving too fast, you shouldn’t be speeding in a place like this."
"What?" The Rich Second Generation got angry, "You damaged my car and now you want to shirk responsibility?"
The delivery rider said, "I’m not shirking responsibility, I’m speaking reason, it’s not my fault to begin with. I was driving properly, you were the one speeding."
He couldn’t admit fault no matter what. Admitting fault would entail compensating the Ferrari’s scratch, something he certainly couldn’t afford.
The Rich Second Generation fumed: "You’re saying it’s not shirking responsibility? Have the guts not to leave!"
The Rich Second Generation pulled out his phone and made a call, aiming to call for reinforcements.
Comparing himself to the delivery rider, the Rich Second Generation found himself losing out on physical strength, fearing he’d suffer if it came to blows.
Seeing the other party calling for people, the delivery rider dared not stay, quickly enduring the pain to scramble up his electric scooter, planning to escape.
Unfortunately, the electric scooter was so damaged it couldn’t start, and the delivery rider broke out in a cold sweat with urgency.
Seeing this, the Rich Second Generation sneered, "Don’t even think of escaping, give it up, you can’t get away!"
The commotion had already attracted the nearby crowd’s attention.
Soon, a patrol electric car drove over, the kind usually seen on golf courses.
From the car, four sturdy men jumped out, all muscular.
The Rich Second Generation saw this and immediately cheered up, pointing at the delivery rider: "This guy crashed my car and wants to escape, catch him for me!"
The four sturdy men surged forward, surrounding the delivery rider.
One of the sturdy men reached out and grabbed the delivery rider, pulling him off the electric scooter.
"Damn it, kneel down for me!"
One of the men kicked at the delivery rider’s knee, causing him to kneel uncontrollably, and then was held down by the men, unable to move.
The delivery rider was terrified, went pale, and trembled all over, damn it, he’d provoked someone he shouldn’t have.
"Spare me, it’s really not my fault," the delivery rider cried in fear.
"You little punk, damaged my car. You’re not leaving without paying today, I’ll beat you to death!" The Rich Second Generation roared angrily.
This Rich Second Generation had just bought the Ferrari sports car today, planning to take his new girlfriend for a ride, but unexpectedly got into this accident. No wonder he was furious.
With the intention of showing off, who would have expected to lose control, colliding with the delivery rider’s scooter.
The Rich Second Generation felt both humiliated and livid, raging on the spot, demanding compensation from the delivery rider.
The delivery rider decided firmly not to admit fault: "If you want me to pay you, then you’d better come and rob me first. Besides, you were the one driving recklessly, I haven’t even asked you to compensate for my scooter yet! At most, I’ll pay you a few hundred bucks, do you want it?"
The Rich Second Generation grew ever angrier: "Do you know how much my car costs, 4 million! A few hundred bucks, do you think I’m driving your kind of junk car? At least 200 thousand, charging you 200 thousand for repair is already being generous. If you don’t pay, see if I don’t beat you to death!"
The delivery rider got scared to death: "Even if you beat me to death, I don’t have that much money. You might as well kill me."
The Rich Second Generation got infuriated: "Beat him up, beat him to death!"
Seeing the several men about to beat the delivery rider.
"Hold on!"
Suddenly a loud shout.
Lin Fan got out of the Rolls-Royce and stopped them.
No choice, this incident blocked the intersection, he couldn’t pass through and had to resolve it before moving ahead.
Having previously worked as a delivery rider himself, Lin Fan felt a kinship with the delivery rider, especially having personally witnessed the accident and had no reason for the delivery rider to get hit unjustly.
Instantly, the crowd’s gaze turned to Lin Fan.
The Rich Second Generation looked Lin Fan up and down, saying arrogantly, "Who the hell are you?"
Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce was worth 8 million, but such luxury cars weren’t very eye-catching in this wealthy district.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m just a passerby who witnessed your collision, and I think I have something to say about it."
The Rich Second Generation said, "I asked who the hell you are, what gives you the right to meddle here?"
Lin Fan said, "Who am I? Okay, my name is Lin Fan."

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Arrogant Rich Second Generation, 4 Strong Men Surround and Beat Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 350: Arrogant Rich Second Generation, 4 Strong Men Surround and Beat Lin Fan
Chu Family.
It was almost noon, and Lin Fan still hadn’t arrived at the Chu Family. Everyone in the Chu Family was waiting, and gradually, the atmosphere became a bit anxious. They were all worried, could it be that Mr. Lin had canceled his visit to the Chu Family?
If that’s the case, once the news spreads, it’s uncertain what the outside world will think, but it’s certain that it will be detrimental to the Chu Family.
Mr. Lin canceling the visit to the Chu Family means that whatever cooperation he had planned with the Chu Family before would also be canceled.
"Where’s Chu Lin?"
Suddenly, Chu Haotian spoke. He realized that he didn’t see his eldest son, Chu Lin, among the crowd.
Chu Lin, Chu Haotian’s eldest son, was also the eldest young master of the Chu Family, viewed as the future heir to take over the Chu Family’s business.
However, Chu Haotian never thought highly of Chu Lin, just like when Madam Chu defied all opposition to hand over the business to Chu Haotian instead of her biological eldest son, Chu Haotian also had no intention of passing the business to Chu Lin.
The reason is simple, Chu Lin is a playboy, an idle rich second generation, who only knows how to indulge in pleasure all day long, with no interest in family affairs.
Back then, Madam Chu handed the business to Chu Haotian because her eldest son was incompetent.
Chu Haotian has not given up on Chu Lin, but if Chu Lin continues like this, Chu Haotian won’t hand the business over to him. His ideal candidate for now is his daughter, Chu Yufei.
Unfortunately, Chu Yufei is also uninterested in the family business and is fully devoted to charity work.
As expected, the eldest young master Chu Lin was not present.
Chu Haotian instructed the servants, "Go find Chu Lin!"
The servant wiped the cold sweat away and said, "Master, it seems the eldest young master went out."
Chu Haotian’s face darkened, "What? Went out? Today, Mr. Lin is coming, didn’t I instruct everyone to wait at home? Where has Chu Lin gone?"
The servant said, "I don’t know, the eldest young master left with his newly bought Ferrari, maybe he went racing."
Chu Haotian stomped his feet, "Do I even need to ask? He must have gone out to have fun, showing off his new car to those random women! How many cars has he bought this year? Last time he bought a yacht, played with it for a few days, then abandoned it. Princess Yu used it for charity in his name. This prodigal son!"
Chu Haotian angrily scolded Chu Lin in front of everyone.
Madam Chu couldn’t stand it, intentionally coughed twice, "That’s enough, let him go if he wants to. It’s not necessary for him to receive Mr. Lin. We are enough."
Chu Haotian retorted angrily, "It’s all you, you’re too indulgent as a mother, spoiling him. I’ve always said to reduce his allowance, but you obstructed me in every way. Spoiling him like this will only cause trouble sooner or later!"
Madam Chu was also unhappy, "Chu Haotian, don’t take it out on me. Your son, you can’t manage him, and you blame me? Do you have to argue with me in front of so many people?"
Madam Chu was famously strong-willed and also came from wealth. If it really came to an argument, Chu Haotian might not be her match. He had always been somewhat intimidated by this wife.
"Alright, stop quarreling. Haotian, why don’t you call Lin’er and tell him to come back," Madam Chu interjected.
Everyone had an ambiguous expression.
In the Chu Family, it was well known that the person who spoiled eldest young master Chu Lin the most was Madam Chu. If anyone was to be blamed, it should be Madam Chu. But naturally, Chu Haotian dared not blame Madam Chu, so at most, he vented on Madam Chu, which was why Madam Chu was displeased.
Chu Haotian was just about to take out his phone.
Ring ring ring...
His phone rang at that moment.
It was a call from Lin Fan. "Be quiet, it’s Mr. Lin," he announced.
With a call from Mr. Lin, everyone immediately quieted down. They had waited the whole morning and finally got news from Mr. Lin.
"Mr. Chu, I’m almost at your house, but there’s a small issue here. It will take a little while before I can come over, I’m sorry," Lin Fan said.
Chu Haotian hurriedly replied, "It’s alright. By the way, did Mr. Lin encounter any trouble? Do you need me to come over and take a look?"
Lin Fan smiled, "No need, it should be resolved soon."
Chu Haotian said, "Okay, then I’ll wait for you at home, Mr. Lin."
The call ended shortly after.
Madam Chu asked, "So, is Mr. Lin coming over?"
Chu Haotian replied, "He’s nearby, but it seems he ran into trouble. We need to wait a bit more."
Madam Chu frowned, "Haotian, maybe you should go and check."
In the Rolls-Royce, Lin Fan had just called Chu Haotian and put his phone down, saying to Chu Xiaoxiao in the back seat, "Wait for me a moment."
Then he opened the car door and got out.
At that moment, four muscular men surrounded a deliveryman. On the command of a rich second generation, they were about to beat up the deliveryman.
"Don’t make a move yet!" Lin Fan shouted to stop them.
Instantly, everyone’s gaze fell on Lin Fan.
The rich second generation sized up Lin Fan. Lin Fan was driving an 8 million Rolls-Royce, so he should be someone wealthy, but in this rich neighborhood, that didn’t mean much.
The rich second generation arrogantly said, "Who the hell are you?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m just passing by, and I witnessed your car accident just now."
The rich second generation angrily retorted, "I asked who you are, how dare you meddle in my business?"
Lin Fan replied, "Who am I? Well, I’m Lin Fan."
"Lin Fan?" The rich second generation furrowed his brow. The name seemed familiar, but he couldn’t recall where he’d heard it. His mind was constantly occupied with having fun, so he didn’t pay attention to unrelated matters.
Lin Fan said, "Now you know my name, can I speak?"
The rich second generation sneered, "Kid, whatever you want to say, you’d better think it over carefully before speaking, or you might bring trouble upon yourself!"
This was a threat!
Lin Fan, however, wasn’t afraid of the threat and said, "I just saw that the delivery guy was driving normally without breaking any traffic rules. There’s no issue on his part. However, this blond guy was speeding, which led to the accident. You shouldn’t race on this kind of road, any reasonable person knows that, so the responsible person should be you."
Lin Fan smiled at the rich second generation.
The rich second generation was furious, "You think whatever you say is true, huh? Are you looking for trouble?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m just stating what I saw, and what I said is factual. My dashcam recorded the incident. If you refuse to admit it, I can call the traffic police and show them the footage. You were speeding beforehand and then trying to threaten the delivery guy afterward. You should know the consequences, right?"
The rich second generation was not willing to give in so easily.
"Kid, you think you can threaten me? Call the traffic police? Do I look like someone who’s afraid of the traffic police?" The rich second generation was arrogantly defiant.
Lin Fan shook his head. This idle rich kid was truly an idiot.
"Alright, since you’re not afraid of the traffic police, I’ll call them now." Lin Fan took out his phone.
The rich second generation was a little flustered. If what Lin Fan said was true and the dashcam really recorded the accident, then he wouldn’t benefit from the traffic police getting involved.
Although he indeed wasn’t afraid of the traffic police, coming from a wealthy family meant that even if the police caught him, it would be a minor issue.
But it would be bothersome, delaying his time to have fun with girls, and that was what he dreaded the most.
"Brat, do you not know who I am? How dare you oppose me! Forget that deliveryman, teach this kid a lesson!" The rich second generation pointed at Lin Fan and instructed.
Following the order, the four muscular men abandoned the deliveryman and moved toward Lin Fan.
"Stop!"
Suddenly, a voice boomed with anger, and it was Chu Haotian, appearing with a look of shock and fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 This is Really a Huge Disaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 351 This is Really a Huge Disaster
The rich second generation, furious and humiliated, planned to have Lin Fan beaten up and take Lin Fan’s dashcam footage. After all, there were no surveillance cameras around this section of the road, and Lin Fan’s dashcam was the only evidence. As long as he got the evidence, the traffic police wouldn’t be able to convict him.
This rich second generation was truly fearless due to ignorance, or perhaps he was excessively indulgent and oblivious to whom he had provoked.
When the rich second generation gave the order, and four burly men were about to go and beat up Lin Fan.
Chu Haotian arrived.
Chu Haotian received a call from Lin Fan, saying there was a small problem. On the advice of Madam Chu, Chu Haotian decided to come and take a look.
Before leaving, Chu Haotian learned from the servants that his eldest son, Chu Lin, had just called away four bodyguards.
Chu Haotian immediately had a bad feeling but was in a hurry to find Lin Fan, so he had no time to attend to it for the moment.
Subsequently, Chu Haotian had Chu Yufei drive him out, intending to find Lin Fan.
Upon arriving at the intersection, he suddenly saw a chaotic scene in front of him: a Ferrari sports car stopped in the middle of the road, with an electric scooter fallen to the side.
A delivery guy was kneeling on the ground.
Under the instruction of the rich second generation, four burly men were planning to beat someone up, and their target was none other than Lin Fan.
This rich second generation was exactly his eldest son, Chu Lin!
Chu Haotian was scared out of his wits and quickly ordered Chu Yufei to stop the car. He immediately got out and shouted, "Stop!"
The four burly men stopped in their tracks. When they turned around and saw that it was Chu Haotian, their expressions changed, and they dared not move.
"Get back!" Chu Haotian said angrily.
The four burly men quickly retreated to one side.
Seeing his father and sister arrive, Chu Lin was a bit puzzled, "Dad, why are you here?"
Chu Haotian said angrily, "If I hadn’t come, you would have caused a colossal disaster!"
Chu Lin retorted, "What colossal disaster? My car was scratched by this damn delivery guy. I was just asking for compensation. This kid is meddling, so I decided to teach him a lesson. It’s perfect that you’re here, Dad. Show this fool who dared to provoke us who you are!"
Smack!
A crisp sound rang out.
Before Chu Lin could finish speaking, Chu Haotian rushed up and gave him a hard slap. Every word Chu Lin had said was offensive to Lin Fan, and Chu Haotian, now eager to ingratiate himself with Lin Fan, wouldn’t let Chu Lin ruin this. In his rage, he slapped Chu Lin.
Chu Yufei raised her hand to her forehead. Chu Lin speaking such words was indeed courting death; no one could save him now.
Chu Lin’s face turned red from being slapped, and he was dumbfounded.
"Dad, why did you hit me?" Chu Lin reacted, exclaiming in agitation, just like a child throwing a tantrum.
This Chu Lin had been pampered since childhood, with Madam Chu and Madam Chu both doting on him and reluctant to punish him. Out of respect for the two ladies, Chu Haotian also didn’t dare to strictly discipline Chu Lin.
This was the first time Chu Lin had been hit like this by his father, so it was no wonder he was dazed.
Chu Haotian had no time to deal with him.
After the slap, Chu Haotian hurried to Lin Fan, smiling awkwardly, "Mr. Lin, my son was discourteous and has offended you. I hope you won’t take it to heart."
Lin Fan responded with an ’oh’; now he realized that this brainless rich second generation was actually Chu Haotian’s son.
"So he is the young master of the Chu Family. Mr. Chu, to avoid misunderstanding, I need to explain the situation. Earlier, your son was racing at the intersection, which led to the accident. He is fully responsible. However, he insisted on the delivery guy compensating him, and I couldn’t stand by, so I spoke up. It’s all recorded on my dashcam. I can show you, Mr. Chu, or call the traffic police." Lin Fan said calmly.
Chu Haotian quickly replied, "No need to look. I trust Mr. Lin; it’s all my son’s fault. He should take responsibility. How about this, Mr. Lin, will you be satisfied with how I handle it?"
With that, Chu Haotian approached the delivery guy, offering a hand to help him up, and apologetically said, "I’m very sorry, young man. It’s my son’s fault. Are you hurt? I’ll compensate you for medical expenses."
The delivery guy never expected things to turn out this way.
Initially, he was desperate, being a penniless and powerless person. How could he fight a rich second generation? Ultimately, he feared being forced to compensate 200,000 yuan for repair fees.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan’s presence turned the situation around.
Chu Haotian didn’t even want him to compensate. Instead, he wanted to compensate him?
Such a pleasant surprise came so suddenly.
The delivery guy blushed, "I’m not really hurt, just sprained my ankle a bit. However, my electric scooter seems to be broken and can’t be ridden anymore."
Chu Haotian said, "How about this, I’ll compensate you 100,000 yuan to buy a new vehicle and seek treatment at the hospital. Will that settle the matter?"
The delivery guy was thrilled and became a little shaky. In fact, as long as they didn’t make him pay 200,000 yuan in repair fees, he would have been content. He would never be able to come up with that amount of money.
To his surprise, not only did he not have to pay, but he was also getting compensation instead, and it was 100,000 yuan!
For the wealthy, 100,000 yuan is nothing, but for the delivery guy, it was a huge sum.
The delivery guy agreed immediately and promised not to pursue the matter further.
In the end, the delivery guy received the 100,000-yuan compensation and left happily.
Before departing, the delivery guy ran up to Lin Fan, bowed, and said, "Thank you, big brother, for helping me."
He was very clear that if it weren’t for Lin Fan, Chu Haotian wouldn’t have been so easy to talk to. He didn’t know why, but Chu Haotian seemed to be very respectful of Lin Fan. Who was this young man?
The delivery guy became curious in his heart.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Brother, go and have your foot checked. Running around outside is not easy; be more careful in the future."
The delivery guy was very touched, feeling that Lin Fan was very kind, just like the buddies who deliver food together.
After sending off the delivery guy.
Chu Haotian returned to Lin Fan’s side and said with a smile, "Mr. Lin, I have compensated the delivery guy. As for the car repair, Chu Lin will handle it himself. What do you think?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Since the delivery guy has no objections, let’s leave it at that."
Chu Haotian was very pleased, then turned to Chu Lin and said, "Hurry up and come over here to thank Mr. Lin!"
Chu Lin was very perplexed. Why was his father being so respectful to this guy and even compensating the delivery guy 100,000 yuan? This was truly a case of losing both the chicken and the rice used to lure it.
"Dad, who is he?" Chu Lin couldn’t help but ask.
Chu Haotian was slightly speechless. His son truly had no interest in family affairs, only knowing how to play all day; he was very disappointed.
"He is our family’s honored guest today, Lin Fan, Mr. Lin!" Chu Haotian said.
Chu Lin’s expression changed: "Lin, Mr. Lin?"
He finally remembered. No wonder Lin Fan’s name sounded so familiar. He had indeed heard it, the honored guest of the Chu family coming today, the new richest man in Yun City, Lin Fan!
Oh my god, he was going to hit the new richest guy in Yun City just now?
Chu Lin broke out in a cold sweat immediately.
Although he was disinterested in family affairs and had ignored the old madam’s instructions trying to sneak out today, it didn’t mean he didn’t know the consequences of offending Lin Fan.
This indeed was a monumental disaster!

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Mr. Lin’s move is brilliant, truly brilliant.
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 352: Mr. Lin’s move is brilliant, truly brilliant.
After learning about Lin Fan’s identity, Chu Lin broke out in a cold sweat. The person he wanted to call someone to beat up just now was actually the new richest man in Yun City, the esteemed guest the entire Chu Family had been eagerly anticipating today!
If Lin Fan were really beaten, the consequences would be unimaginable. Not to mention how Lin Fan would retaliate, even Madam Chu wouldn’t let him go.
Chu Lin was so scared that his face turned a bit pale, and he was stunned, completely at a loss for what to do.
Chu Haotian shouted coldly, "What are you standing there for, hurry over and apologize to Mr. Lin!"
Chu Lin quickly bowed his head and came to stand in front of Lin Fan, nervously saying, "Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. I didn’t know it was you. Otherwise, even if I had ten times the courage, I wouldn’t dare to offend you."
Chu Haotian smiled apologetically on the side, "Mr. Lin, my son failed to recognize greatness when it was before him and offended you. Please deal with him as you see fit."
Lin Fan chuckled, "If I wasn’t Lin Fan and just an ordinary passerby, would you apologize to me? I suspect I would have already been beaten up by you, right?"
Chu Haotian looked embarrassed. He thought that having Chu Lin apologize and then saying something nice himself would make Lin Fan consider his face and not hold a grudge against Chu Lin, but obviously, Lin Fan didn’t care about giving him face.
Indeed, in front of Lin Fan, what face did Chu Haotian have?
Did Lin Fan need to give him face at all!
Faced with Lin Fan’s question, Chu Lin was at a loss for words. Indeed, if the other party wasn’t Lin Fan, and if his father hadn’t stopped him, the other party would have been beaten a long time ago, and he wouldn’t have apologized at all.
Lin Fan said, "Your apology to me is merely submitting to my status, not a recognition of your own wrongdoing. If there’s a next time, you will still act recklessly."
Slap!
Chu Haotian gritted his teeth and slapped Chu Lin again.
Since Lin Fan wasn’t willing to let Chu Lin off the hook like that, he didn’t dare to plead. He had to please Lin Fan until Lin Fan was satisfied.
"You brat, Mr. Lin is educating you. Do you realize your mistakes?" Chu Haotian yelled.
Chu Lin, hit by another slap, saw stars, feeling very uncomfortable, but didn’t dare to act out. In the presence of the richest person’s aura, he couldn’t even lift his head.
"I realize my mistake. I shouldn’t have been speeding through the intersection. The accident was all my responsibility. I won’t speed through intersections again. Mr. Lin, is that right?" Chu Lin said.
Lin Fan said, "And what else?"
Chu Lin was stunned, "What else?"
He really didn’t know what other mistake he had made.
Chu Haotian raged, "Mr. Lin is asking what else, quickly speak!"
Saying that, Chu Haotian motioned as if to hit Chu Lin again.
"And..." Chu Lin was on the verge of tears, not knowing what other mistake he had, wasn’t his promise not to speed again enough?
Chu Haotian was anxious, "You brat, haven’t you been hit enough?"
Chu Lin cried out in fright, "I really don’t know what other mistake I have, Mr. Lin, please point it out to me?"
Lin Fan said, "When something happened just now, you called in your thugs immediately, attempting to use force and intimidation tactics to make the delivery guy comply. What makes this any different from underground thugs? Such a bullying act, and you hadn’t even realized it yourself. I think you should spend a few days in jail reflecting."
Chu Haotian was dripping with cold sweat. No way, Lin Fan wanted Chu Lin to go to jail, this was too harsh, not giving him any face at all!
But he didn’t dare voice any objections.
Chu Lin was so frightened that his legs gave out, and he fell to his knees, crying and sniffling, "Mr. Lin, please forgive me. I can’t go to jail, I don’t want to be locked up with those criminals, I’ll die in there. I know my mistakes, I’ll never dare again."
Chu Haotian was anxious, this was a disaster. If Lin Fan insisted on sending Chu Lin to jail, Madam Chu would certainly not allow it, and then both sides would break off. He didn’t want to offend Lin Fan at all.
At this moment, Chu Yufei spoke, "I think Mr. Lin is right, it’s time for big brother to pay for what he has done. In my opinion, sitting in jail for a few days as a lesson is also good."
Chu Haotian began to sweat. Even Chu Yufei was saying this, fanning the flames. Lin Fan would probably be more determined to send Chu Lin in.
Chu Lin glared at Chu Yufei, gritting his teeth in hatred.
He had never been on good terms with this sister; Chu Yufei looked down on him for being idle and often scolded him to his face, resulting in mutual ill feelings.
Now, Chu Yufei was really hitting him when he was down.
Lin Fan smiled, "Princess Yu also agrees with me, that’s good. But today, I am a guest, and considering Madam Chu’s high status, after all, let’s wait until I’ve visited Madam Chu to make a decision."
Hearing this, Chu Haotian and Chu Lin both breathed a sigh of relief and became happy.
Chu Haotian was happy because Lin Fan hadn’t completely ignored the face of the Chu family. By saying this, he gave Chu Lin an out. This is good!
Chu Lin was happy because he knew Madam Chu would definitely protect him. Would Madam Chu let Lin Fan send him to jail when they stood in front of her!
Chu Yufei secretly admired this. Mr. Lin’s tactics were indeed high. This was like a blow with a stick followed by a sweet treat. Mr. Lin would definitely let Chu Lin go, but in doing so, Madam Chu would owe Lin Fan a favor.
When Lin Fan brought Chu Xiaoxiao back to the Chu family, could Madam Chu not give him this favor!
Brilliant, absolutely brilliant!
Chu Yufei guessed correctly. Lin Fan indeed planned to take this opportunity to get a bargaining chip for Chu Xiaoxiao.
This opportunity had presented itself; there was no reason for him to miss it.
As for whether Chu Lin was truly repentant or would continue to make mistakes in the future, Lin Fan didn’t care at all. He wasn’t Chu Lin’s father, so he wouldn’t worry about that.
At this time, Chu Haotian laughed, "Since this is the case, we shouldn’t delay. Please come with me, Mr. Lin. I’ve heard that you are visiting today, and my mother has been waiting at home for you for quite some time."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," and said, "Mr. Chu, you should have said so earlier. If you had, I would have come sooner. In that case, let’s hurry and go."
Lin Fan planned to return to the car when he glanced at the four big men standing obediently by the side.
These four had been quite fierce just now, ready to pounce and beat him up. But after Chu Haotian arrived, they all stood trembling.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Young Master Chu, next time, don’t act so hastily. Not only might you incriminate yourself, but you might also get them hurt."
Chu Lin nodded repeatedly, but he was somewhat puzzled. What did Lin Fan mean by saying his bodyguards might get hurt?
The four bodyguards were also curious. What did Lin Fan mean by that, was he suggesting the four of them couldn’t handle him?
Immediately, neither Chu Lin nor the four big men felt convinced. Lin Fan was the richest man, yes, they dared not cross him, but when it came to force, surely the four of them had no problem subduing Lin Fan!
"Robbery!"
At this moment, they suddenly heard a woman’s scream from not far away.
They saw a sturdy man holding a sharp knife, snatching the woman’s handbag, making a run for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Let me introduce her to everyone, her name is Chu Xiaoxiao.
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 353: Let me introduce her to everyone, her name is Chu Xiaoxiao.
This robber came to this place to rob, he might indeed get quite a few valuable things.
The woman was dressed very fashionably, wearing all high-end brands, obviously a resident of this wealthy area. After having her bag snatched, she screamed while chasing behind.
Both of them are running towards this side.
The strong robber, seeing someone in front of him, raised the knife and shouted, "Get out of the way!"
The onlookers screamed in fear and quickly avoided him. Who would dare provoke this robber, especially since he’s holding a knife!
Lin Fan looked at the four big guys and said, "Do you want to be heroes?"
The four big guys were a bit hesitant. It’s not that they couldn’t step in, but the opponent had a knife. If they accidentally got hurt, it wouldn’t be worth it.
Just as the four big guys were hesitating, they saw a figure already leaping out.
It was Lin Fan!
Lin Fan directly blocked the robber’s path.
Everyone was shocked to see this, thinking Lin Fan was asking for trouble!
The robber’s eyes turned red. He had just stolen many good things from the high-end lady, including a gold ring, a diamond necklace, a luxury watch, and a large pile of cash in the handbag. Today, he was determined, and no one could stop him!
"Get out of the way, or I’ll kill you!" the robber threatened viciously, the sharp knife gleaming towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Brother, it’s not good to snatch women in broad daylight. You shouldn’t live like this; you should earn money legitimately."
Everyone broke into a sweat, thinking, damn, is Lin Fan trying to lecture the robber on life principles?
Chu Lin secretly rejoiced. Although Lin Fan was the richest man, he’s acting a bit foolish, thinking that everyone cared about his status. The robber didn’t know his identity!
However, it was good this way. Chu Lin wanted to beat Lin Fan earlier but failed, so it’s good to let the robber teach Lin Fan a lesson. Hopefully, it’ll leave Lin Fan badly injured, as repayment for sending him to jail!
Chu Lin thought maliciously.
Of course, the robber wouldn’t show Lin Fan any respect; instead, he got furious, "You’re asking for it!"
He thrust the knife towards Lin Fan.
Seeing Lin Fan about to be stabbed by the robber, everyone was terrified. The timid ones even closed their eyes, not daring to watch.
However, in the next second.
"Ah!"
The robber suddenly let out a miserable cry.
Lin Fan had grabbed the robber’s knife-wielding hand, and with a crack, he broke the robber’s wrist. With a clink, the sharp knife fell to the ground.
Then, Lin Fan kicked up, hitting the robber’s calf and knocking him to the ground, bruising his backside.
To prevent the robber from resisting, Lin Fan followed up with a punch to the robber’s chest, with a crack, breaking a few ribs, leaving him completely incapable of resistance.
The robber could only writhe on the ground, letting out endless cries.
Snatching the knife, flooring him, and striking in one fluid motion, in the blink of an eye, the aggressive robber was incapacitated.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
The whole scene fell silent, cold sweat dripping down people’s temples.
Damn!
How powerful!
The robber whom everybody, including the four bodyguards, avoided provoking, was taken down by Lin Fan in a second.
Lin Fan shook his head and sighed, "I advised you to go the right way, but you didn’t listen. Now there’s nothing I can do."
He then bent down, picked up the handbag that fell aside, and approached the high-end lady, "Miss, here’s your bag, check if anything’s missing?"
The high-end lady had just caught up, panting, and was a bit dazed by how quickly everything developed. The robber was done just like that?
The guy who helped her was so handsome, strong and handsome, so attractive.
The high-end lady’s eyes gradually sparkled.
"Miss?" Lin Fan prompted.
The high-end lady then realized, hurriedly took the handbag, looked inside quickly, and smiled, "Nothing’s missing. Thank you, handsome guy, you’re really amazing."
Lin Fan smiled, "It was just a small act, Miss. He’s no longer capable of resisting, you should call the police."
The high-end lady nodded, blushing, "Handsome guy, what’s your name? Can I buy you a coffee? I want to thank you."
She wasn’t just looking to thank Lin Fan; she wanted to get to know him.
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan. It’s just a small matter, no need to thank me. I have other things to handle."
Just then, Lin Fan was about to leave.
The high-end lady quickly took out a business card and handed it to Lin Fan, "Handsome, here’s my card. My name is Lu Sisi. You can add my WeChat later."
"Alright." Lin Fan casually put the card into his pants pocket.
Then he parted ways with Lu Sisi and returned.
"Mr. Chu, let’s go." Lin Fan said to Chu Haotian and then got into the Rolls-Royce.
Except for Chu Yufei, all the Chu Family members were sweating. Chu Yufei had seen Lin Fan subdue a serial killer before, and knew Lin Fan had great skills, so she wasn’t surprised.
The others, seeing it for the first time, were understandably shocked.
Chu Lin’s face even turned a bit pale. He finally understood why Lin Fan dared to block the robber.
Lin Fan wasn’t foolish as he had thought; he was genuinely formidable.
At the same time, he understood what Lin Fan meant by his earlier words. If those four bodyguards had really fought Lin Fan, they would’ve been injured. They were no match for Lin Fan!
The four bodyguards also realized this, each breaking out in a cold sweat. The fate of the robber, probably bedridden for half a month, made them shiver, imagining the same fate if they had confronted Lin Fan; it scared them to death.
Of course, to Lin Fan, this indeed was a trivial matter. After taking the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, dealing with such robbers was indeed just a matter of lifting a finger.
Afterwards, Lin Fan drove off together with Chu Haotian and the others, heading to the Chu Family’s mansion.
Finally arriving at the Chu Family mansion.
The news quickly spread inside, and Madam Chu, along with Madam Chu and some elders of the Chu Family, personally came out to greet Lin Fan.
Madam Chu noticed Chu Lin also returned but didn’t notice anything unusual since her mind was on Lin Fan.
Chu Haotian led Lin Fan to Madam Chu and smiled, "Let me introduce you, Lin Fan, Mr. Lin. Mr. Lin, this is my mother, and this is my wife."
Lin Fan smiled politely, "Hello Madam Chu, Madam."
Madam Chu smiled warmly and said, "Mr. Lin, I have long admired your name. Mr. Lin, you are young and promising, truly a dragon among men."
Lin Fan laughed, "Madam, you overpraise me."
Madam Chu said, "Please, please come inside and have a seat, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan said, "Madam, please wait a moment. I have a companion who hasn’t gotten out of the car yet."
Madam Chu exclaimed and couldn’t help looking towards Lin Fan’s car. Everyone also looked towards Lin Fan’s car.
Everyone was curious about who Lin Fan’s companion was.
There was another person in the Rolls-Royce.
Chu Xiaoxiao.
Yesterday, Lin Fan took Chu Xiaoxiao to buy new clothes, and today they were wearing them. But earlier at school, she was embarrassed to wear new clothes, so she was changing in the car.
After a while, Chu Xiaoxiao changed into her new clothes, opened the car door, and got out.
Everyone was stunned, truly amazed by the beauty in front of them.
Chu Xiaoxiao was wearing Chanel’s latest dress, stunningly beautiful, like an exquisite little princess, dazzling everyone.
Indeed, clothes make the person. Chu Xiaoxiao was already a beauty even in cheap clothes, and now in a name-brand dress, her aura transformed, turning into a noble young lady.
"So beautiful!"
Everyone secretly marveled.
Chu Lin’s eyes nearly popped out, such a beautiful girl. Lin Fan actually brought along such a pretty girl.
Madam Chu laughed, "Such a beauty!"
She said with genuine admiration.
Chu Lin’s eyes almost popped out, absolutely stunning, Lin Fan brought such a pretty girl here.
Madam Chu with a smile said, "This young lady is truly beautiful, Mr. Lin, you have excellent taste."
Madam Chu also praised, "So beautiful, her temperament is extraordinary. I’m so envious. Mr. Lin, you have such good taste. If only my son could find such a beautiful girlfriend in the future."
They all thought Chu Xiaoxiao was Lin Fan’s girlfriend and couldn’t stop praising her.
Lin Fan smiled, "Let me introduce her to everyone. This is Chu Xiaoxiao."
Madam Chu and Madam’s faces both changed dramatically. The girl they were just praising was actually the one they had a grudge against, Chu Xiaoxiao?
For a moment, the expressions of Madam Chu and Madam were quite colorful.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 354: I indeed have another matter to attend to
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 354: I indeed have another matter to attend to
Chu Xiaoxiao’s appearance drew a wave of admiration.
Madam Chu and Madam Chu were full of praise for her.
Next to them, Chu Haotian and Chu Yufei were somewhat embarrassed. Apparently, neither Madam Chu nor Madam Chu knew that the person in front of them was Chu Xiaoxiao.
"Let me introduce you all, this is Chu Xiaoxiao."
Lin Fan introduced promptly.
What?
Madam Chu and Madam Chu’s smiles froze. Chu Xiaoxiao? Isn’t she the troublesome child born to Chu Haotian and He Meifang?
They actually just praised someone they dislike the most?
They wanted to shout angrily, but in front of Lin Fan, they didn’t dare to, resulting in a very remarkable expression.
Chu Xiaoxiao was a bit shy. It was her first time coming to the Chu Family, the first time meeting so many unfamiliar family members, which made her nervous. She didn’t expect them to compliment her upon meeting, which made her feel quite embarrassed.
Chu Yufei, sensing the mood, smiled and walked over, taking Chu Xiaoxiao’s hand to Madam Chu.
"Xiaoxiao, since it’s your first time back home, let me introduce you. This is our grandmother," Chu Yufei said.
Chu Xiaoxiao, blushing, said, "Hello, Grandma."
Madam Chu looked awkward, reluctant to respond but unable to ignore it because of Lin Fan.
Chu Yufei continued, "This is my mom. You can call her mom with me or call her aunt."
Chu Xiaoxiao was genuinely too embarrassed to call her mom, so she said, "Hello, Aunt."
Madam Chu’s face twitched; she was frustrated and angry but dared not show it.
Chu Yufei continued to introduce, "This is my brother, Chu Lin. I believe you know him."
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded, having witnessed Chu Lin on the car earlier, and politely said, "Hello, Brother."
Chu Lin, bewildered by the sudden arrival of a younger sister, instinctively responded, "Hello."
Chu Yufei said, "Everyone here is part of the Chu Family, so there’s no need for introductions. Now that you’re back home, you’ll get to know them gradually."
Chu Xiaoxiao bowed to everyone, "Hello, everyone."
The Chu Family members exchanged glances and started whispering among themselves.
"Who is she?"
"Could she be the rumored illegitimate child of the Patriarch?"
"What? Oh my, she’s actually back, and she came with Mr. Lin."
"I heard the Madam was against her coming back. This is awkward..."
The Chu Family members were all astonished and curious, with gossipy expressions watching the scene unfold.
Lin Fan smiled at this moment and said, "Introductions are done, Madam. May we go in now?"
If Madam Chu allowed Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao to enter, it meant that she accepted Chu Xiaoxiao’s return home.
Everyone looked at Madam Chu, waiting for her response.
Madam Chu looked at her with a sincere gaze, hoping Madam Chu would oppose Chu Xiaoxiao entering, as she did not want this little troublemaker stepping into the Chu Family home.
Being an experienced person, Madam Chu quickly responded with a chuckle, "Mr. Lin, please."
Madam Chu welcomed Lin Fan and Chu Xiaoxiao inside.
Although she strongly opposed Chu Xiaoxiao’s return, Chu Xiaoxiao’s special status now made it difficult for her to easily offend Lin Fan, and she let them enter, adapting to the situation.
Everyone entered the living room and sat down in their respective places.
Family members came forward to serve tea.
Madam Chu smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, please have some tea."
Lin Fan picked up the teacup, took a sip, and praised, "Very nice. It’s one of the best two teas I’ve had this year."
Madam Chu made an "oh" sound, "This tea is a specialty Ancient Tree Pu’er from Southwest Huaxia, a treasured excellent tea of mine, specially brought out today to entertain Mr. Lin. I didn’t expect you to have tasted another great tea? You are indeed quite knowledgeable, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you very much, Madam. Next time, I’ll bring some Huang Mountain’s Mao Feng Tea for you, which a friend brought me. There’s still some left at home."
The Huang Mountain’s Mao Feng Tea he drank was specially sought out by Anna, said to be supplied exclusively to dignitaries, and talking about this made Lin Fan somewhat miss Anna.
Madam Chu said happily, "Then I’ll thank Mr. Lin in advance. Your visit has already brought great honor to the Chu Family. Hearing about your visit, everyone in the Chu Family was looking forward to it."
Lin Fan said, "Thank you very much for the warm hospitality of the Chu Family."
Madam Chu paused and said, "Mr. Lin, please forgive my directness. Is there anything you need during your visit to the Chu Family this time?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Madam knows that Princess Yu is now helping me manage the charity association, right?"
