Madam Chu said, "I know. Thank you very much for trusting Princess Yu. This child is still young and will need more guidance from you in the future."
Lin Fan said, "Of course, because of Princess Yu, I got acquainted with Mr. Chu. I learned that the Chu Family’s business is in mechanical parts. Coincidentally, I have a billion-dollar project that might require cooperation with the Chu Family, so I wanted to pay a visit today."
A billion-dollar project!
Everyone in the Chu Family gasped.
Lin Fan truly is the wealthiest man in Yun City. Projects of his scale are in the billions!
If the Chu Family can truly cooperate with Lin Fan on a billion-dollar project, the Chu Family would soar to unimaginable heights.
Thinking of this, everyone grew excited.
Madam Chu was also quite excited, but outwardly maintained calm and asked, "What kind of project might that be?"
Lin Fan said, "For now, it’s not convenient to disclose. When the right time comes, I’ll discuss it in detail with Mr. Chu."
Although Lin Fan didn’t reveal the project’s details, he undoubtedly gave the Chu Family hope—a hope from the wealthiest man, which seemed quite reliable. Everyone in the Chu Family grew highly expectant.
Madam Chu said, "Okay, whatever Mr. Lin needs from the Chu Family, just let us know. We’ll do our best to cooperate. Haotian, find a time, and personally take Mr. Lin to our factory for an inspection."
Chu Haotian said, "Sure, just let me know when Mr. Lin is available, and I’ll arrange it at any time."
Lin Fan said, "I’ll arrange the time with Mr. Chu."
Madam Chu smiled and said, "I’m looking forward to cooperating with Mr. Lin."
Madam Chu then said, "Mr. Lin, besides this matter, there must be something else you wanted to discuss today, right?"
Madam Chu was growing restless. She had constantly been thinking about Chu Xiaoxiao, but they had been talking about the project, and Madam might accept Chu Xiaoxiao because of it, which she feared the most.
Madam Chu didn’t care about the billion-dollar project. To her, preventing Chu Xiaoxiao from returning home was the top priority.
Lin Fan glanced at Madam Chu and chuckled, "Indeed, there’s another matter that concerns Chu Lin."
What?
Madam Chu’s expression changed. She thought Lin Fan was going to talk about Chu Xiaoxiao, but why was it about Chu Lin instead?
Everyone in the Chu Family exchanged puzzled looks, growing curious.
Chu Lin himself blushed and lowered his head. Lin Fan was finally going to talk about his matter.
Madam Chu curiously asked, "Mr. Lin, what happened with Lin’er?"
Lin Fan said, "Well, on the way here, I happened to see that Young Master Chu had a car accident..."
Lin Fan briefly explained what had happened.
The entire Chu Family was shocked, not expecting such an incident to happen to Chu Lin. He had actually wanted his bodyguards to attack Mr. Lin?

chapters.title: Chapter 355: A Battle Without Smoke
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 355: A Battle Without Smoke
Madam Chu’s face turned pale.
Madam Chu was both shocked and angry, staring at Chu Lin: "Chu Lin, look at what you’ve done!"
Chu Lin cried, "I’m sorry, Grandma, I’ve realized my mistake. Please ask Mr. Lin to spare me this once!"
Before Madam Chu could speak, Madam Chu interjected, "Lin’er can’t go to jail, he can’t have a criminal record. We beg Mr. Lin to show mercy."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Everyone must pay for the mistakes they make. Personally, I think Young Master Chu should go in for some self-reflection. What do you think, Madam Chu?"
Madam Chu was speechless, unsure how to respond to Lin Fan.
Madam Chu was already angry: "Chu Lin, you worthless brat, kneel down!"
Chu Lin cried and knelt down; he didn’t dare disobey his grandmother’s command.
Madam Chu scolded, "I instructed everyone to stay home today and wait for Mr. Lin, yet you went out on your own and caused such a disaster. You really are blind as a bat!"
Madam Chu publicly scolded Chu Lin harshly in front of everyone.
Chu Lin was so frightened that his face turned white, kneeling on the ground, not daring to say a word.
Everyone lowered their heads, not daring to look at Madam Chu; it’s a frightening thing when she’s angry.
Even Madam Chu didn’t dare speak, despite being very worried her son might end up in jail.
After scolding, Madam Chu’s expression softened as she looked at Lin Fan, apologetically smiling, "Mr. Lin, my grandson was foolish and offended you. I apologize on his behalf."
Lin Fan said, "There’s no need for an apology, Madam. This isn’t your fault; the mistake is his alone."
Madam Chu forced a smile, "Mr. Lin is right. This time, I will certainly punish him to make sure he learns his lesson! But...he is indeed still young. Having a criminal record could be troublesome for him in the future. I wonder if Mr. Lin could spare him this once, for my sake?"
Eventually, she pleaded for mercy. She always spoiled Chu Lin and couldn’t really send him to jail. Scolding him was more for Lin Fan’s sake.
Lin Fan saw through it but didn’t say it, smiling, "If I truly intended to send him in, I would have called the police long ago. I actually came to consult Madam. Since Madam has said this, alright, I won’t pursue it this time."
Madam Chu was delighted, "Thank you, Mr. Lin. Chu Lin, quickly thank Mr. Lin!"
Chu Lin was overjoyed inside and hurriedly bowed to thank him, "Thank you, Mr. Lin, thank you, Mr. Lin!"
Madam Chu also breathed a sigh of relief, stepping forward to thank, "Thank you for your kindness, Mr. Lin."
Madam Chu yelled, "You worthless brat, get back to your room! Do not leave your room for a single step today; reflect carefully! Haotian, assign two bodyguards to watch over him. If anyone lets him step out of the room, they will be fired immediately!"
Chu Lin went back dejectedly; though punished by his grandma, it’s far better than going to jail.
After sending Chu Lin away, the atmosphere was somewhat awkward. Chu Lin’s incident was indeed embarrassing, and in front of Mr. Lin, the Chu family felt a little disrespectful.
Lin Fan smiled, "By the way, Madam Chu reminded me of something earlier. I actually came for another reason. I unintentionally learned about Xiaoxiao’s background and discovered that she is Mr. Chu’s daughter, so I specifically brought her back home. I wonder what Madam Chu thinks about this?"
Lin Fan’s primary purpose today was to bring Chu Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family, and now the main event had finally come.
Madam Chu and Madam Chu exchanged glances, both looking a bit awkward.
They had just pleaded with Lin Fan to forgive Chu Lin, and now, talking about Chu Xiaoxiao, they were too embarrassed to oppose.
But they really didn’t want Chu Xiaoxiao to come back.
Madam Chu didn’t dare speak because she feared that if they fell out with Lin Fan, he might seize Chu Lin’s weakness again.
This matter could only be handled by Madam Chu.
Nearby, Chu Haotian and Chu Yufei exchanged amused looks, finding Lin Fan’s move particularly clever.
Madam Chu cleared her throat, "I’ve heard about Xiaoxiao’s situation from Haotian. Frankly, Mr. Lin, it’s a misfortune for our Chu household, a family disgrace, so it’s uncomfortable to mention in front of you. Back then, Haotian’s relationship with that woman was a mistake."
Upon hearing this, Chu Xiaoxiao’s expression darkened, her eyes reddening. Is this how the Chu family viewed her mother?
Seeing this, Madam Chu continued, "Of course, the child is innocent. Years ago, it was that woman who took Xiaoxiao and raised her. After so many years, saying she is returning is sudden. Not to mention, this would expose our family’s disgrace, has Xiaoxiao herself thought about coming back?"
Chu Haotian quickly said, "Mother, I’ve already spoken with Xiaoxiao about bringing her home."
Chu Yufei also added, "Yes, Grandma, I’ve also constantly said Xiaoxiao should return home. After all, she is one of us in the Chu family."
Seeing them speak, Madam Chu grew irritated; now she finally understood why Chu Haotian, who originally refused to accept Chu Xiaoxiao, changed his mind yesterday—it was all because of Lin Fan!
Madam Chu chuckled, "I’d like to hear the child’s own thoughts."
Saying this, Madam Chu looked at Chu Xiaoxiao, her gaze exerting subtle pressure.
Facing Madam Chu for the first time, Chu Xiaoxiao inexplicably felt afraid; this old lady seemed hard to deal with. She had heard since learning about her background that it was this old lady along with Madam Chu who had driven her and her mother out of the Chu family.
Chu Xiaoxiao admitted her mother, He Meifang, wasn’t a good person either; she deliberately approached Chu Haotian with ulterior motives back then.
This left Chu Xiaoxiao feeling uncertain, under Madam Chu’s intense gaze, she felt overwhelmed and couldn’t speak. "I..."
Madam Chu said, "The child seems not quite willing to return either, and if she does, our family’s past scandal will inevitably come to light. For everyone’s sake, I think there should be a proper way to handle this."
Madam Chu finally got a chance to speak, "Madam Chu is right; it’s not that we don’t let her come back, but this needs careful consideration."
Hearing this, Chu Xiaoxiao became even more anxious, her body visibly trembling.
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s big hand reached over and gently rested on her shoulder.
"Don’t be nervous, take your time to speak." Lin Fan comforted softly.
Teacher Lin’s comfort felt like a warm current flowing through her body, immediately calming her down. Ah, with Teacher Lin here, it’s really comforting.
Chu Xiaoxiao regained her composure, lifted her head, and looked directly at Madam Chu, "Grandma, I want to come back."
This was a decision she made after talking with Lin Fan. Originally, she didn’t want to go back to the stepfather’s house, nor to return to the Chu family. But after weighing the options, she decided she should come back to the Chu family to claim what rightfully belonged to her!
After she said this, the faces of the Chu family members changed.
Especially Madam Chu and Madam Chu, their faces looked somewhat unpleasant as they worked hard to control their emotions.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Even though I’m an outsider in this matter, I would like to say a few words for Xiaoxiao. Regardless of whose fault it was back then, Xiaoxiao is innocent. She shouldn’t have to bear the consequences of adults’ mistakes. No matter what, she is Mr. Chu’s daughter, and a descendant of the Chu family. I think her return to her own home is reasonable and logical. Madam Chu, don’t you agree?"
Everyone’s attention turned to Madam Chu, waiting for her response; this was a smoke-free confrontation. Just wondering if Madam Chu, cunning like a fox, would admit defeat.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 The Schemes of Madam Chu
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 356 The Schemes of Madam Chu
After Lin Fan spoke, everyone waited for Madam Chu’s response.
Madam Chu quickly gave her response: "Mr. Lin makes a good point. Since the child herself wants to come home, I have no reason to oppose it. Yufei, have someone prepare a room for her later."
Chu Yufei was overjoyed: "Yes, Grandma."
The members of the Chu Family fell silent, each displaying subtle expressions.
In the end, Madam Chu accepted Chu Xiaoxiao back home!
Chu Xiaoxiao’s identity was too special; she was never acknowledged by the Chu Family, especially by Madam Chu and Madam Chu. Now, Madam Chu had easily accepted her.
Madam Chu’s face was somewhat difficult to maintain, and she wanted to explode, but since the old lady had spoken, she couldn’t very well go against her.
"I’m sorry, I’m not feeling well. I’ll excuse myself, Mr. Lin, I apologize."
Madam Chu stood up and left in a huff.
Her husband had a daughter with a shameless woman, and now the daughter was to return to the Chu Family. From Madam Chu’s perspective, it was indeed hard to accept.
Seeing this, Chu Xiaoxiao bit her lip. She could tell that Madam Chu didn’t like her and feared she would rarely see a good face from her in the future.
Madam Chu said to Chu Xiaoxiao, "Child, you’re back now. From now on, this will be your home. If you need anything, just tell Yufei."
Chu Xiaoxiao quickly said, "I understand, thank you, Grandma."
Chu Yufei happily approached and took Chu Xiaoxiao’s hand: "Xiaoxiao, come, I’ll show you your room."
Chu Xiaoxiao looked back at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Go ahead, it’s about time for me to leave too. Call me if you need anything."
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded. Fortunately, Yufei truly cared for her; otherwise, she wouldn’t bear Lin Fan’s departure.
But Lin Fan wasn’t part of the Chu Family. He came today specifically to bring her home. The path ahead was for her to walk on her own.
Chu Xiaoxiao nodded and followed Chu Yufei away.
Thus, Lin Fan eventually managed to get Chu Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family.
In Lin Fan’s view, Chu Xiaoxiao was a poor little girl. Her background was a tragedy. Her mother, He Meifang, was genuinely not a good person.
But people can’t choose their parents, and He Meifang’s mistakes shouldn’t be borne by the innocent Chu Xiaoxiao.
That’s why Lin Fan was willing to help Chu Xiaoxiao return to the Chu Family.
She was still a student, without the ability to live independently. Returning to the Chu Family was her best option.
With the task completed, Lin Fan no longer needed to stay with the Chu Family.
Afterward, Lin Fan exchanged a few parting words with Madam Chu and then took his leave.
Chu Haotian personally saw Lin Fan out.
"Mr. Lin, regarding the cooperation, when do you have the time to visit our factory for a tour?" Chu Haotian smiled awkwardly, eagerly anticipating the project worth hundreds of billions Lin Fan mentioned.
This was also the reason he agreed to have Xiaoxiao come home so decisively. Initially, like Madam Chu and Madam Chu, he refused to acknowledge Chu Xiaoxiao.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "No rush, this project is still in its infancy. Mr. Chu, wait for my news."
The billion-dollar project he mentioned referred to rocket development. Based on what he knew about the Yun Chu Group, they could indeed be useful in the future.
But Lin Fan naturally wouldn’t hand over this project to the Chu Family easily; this would depend on their attitude towards Chu Xiaoxiao.
If the Chu Family treated Chu Xiaoxiao well, he could allow them to "have a bite of the meat." Otherwise, they wouldn’t even "drink the soup."
"Mr. Chu, Xiaoxiao has returned home, and this child has suffered a lot in the past. Please take care of her from now on," Lin Fan said.
Chu Haotian smiled, "Of course, Mr. Lin, rest assured. Xiaoxiao is my daughter, and I will take good care of her."
"That’s good." Lin Fan smiled, then drove away.
With Chu Xiaoxiao returning to the Chu Family, the most displeased person was none other than Madam Chu.
Madam Chu struggled to accept this reality. The next day, she finally couldn’t hold back and went to find Madam Chu alone.
"Madam, there’s something I can’t understand, like a bone stuck in my throat, keeping me awake all night. Why did you so readily agree to let Chu Xiaoxiao return?" Madam Chu asked.
Madam Chu replied coldly, "You think I wanted this? You should know, more than you, I didn’t want her back. It’s simply a disgrace to my Chu Family! But I have no choice!"
Madam Chu said, "Are you concerned about Lin Fan? He does have evidence of Lin’er hitting people, but I’d rather have Lin’er spend a few days in jail than have the little wench back!"
Madam Chu said, "The incident with Lin’er, we were indeed outmaneuvered by Lin Fan, but that’s not the main reason."
Madam Chu said, "Is it about the cooperation? At worst, we don’t cooperate with him, it’s not like the Chu Family can’t survive without him. After all, Yun Chu is also a billion-dollar group; why do we need to endure this?"
Madam Chu sighed and said, "You’re right, Yun Chu is indeed still doing fine now, but what you don’t know is, when my husband and I founded Yun Chu, our goal was to build a billion-dollar group. But until the day he passed away, we never reached that goal. He died unsatisfied until I promised him I’d grow Yun Chu into a billion-dollar group; only then did he rest in peace. You could say it’s my husband’s dying wish. However, to make Yun Chu into a billion-dollar group is no easy feat, and Yun Chu’s development has long reached a bottleneck. To advance further is very difficult! Until yesterday, Lin Fan’s appearance gave me hope. He is Yun City’s new richest man, and I believe he can help the Chu Family."
Madam Chu was stunned.
I didn’t expect Madam Chu to have such considerations.
Madam Chu said, "More than you, I can’t tolerate Chu Xiaoxiao, but she is Lin Fan’s girlfriend. How could we dare offend her, offending her equals offending Lin Fan, and offending Lin Fan means the only hope for Yun Chu to become a billion-dollar group is lost. I can’t allow that to happen. Zhenwei, do you understand my concerns?"
Madam Chu nodded and said resentfully, "I understand. I can only blame the little wench for being too lucky, having found Lin Fan as her boyfriend!"
Madam Chu said, "As long as you understand. In the time to come, we need to endure. Once the Chu Family achieves its billion-dollar ambitions, we won’t need Lin Fan and naturally can kick Chu Xiaoxiao out then. It will not be too late to sweep the little wench out by then."
Madam Chu felt somewhat comforted upon hearing this. She began looking forward to that day.
Afterward, Madam Chu bid farewell to Madam Chu and headed outside.
Suddenly, she saw Chu Yufei and Chu Xiaoxiao approaching from the opposite side.
Upon seeing Chu Xiaoxiao, Madam Chu felt a surge of anger but couldn’t curse her. Instead, she wanted to turn away and avoid them.
However, Chu Yufei had already seen her and called out, "Mommy."
Madam Chu had no choice but to stop and put on a smile: "Hmm, where are you two going?"
Chu Yufei said, "I’m planning to go to the company, and I’ll take Xiaoxiao to school on the way."
Facing Madam Chu, Chu Xiaoxiao felt a bit nervous and timidly said, "Hello, Auntie."

chapters.title: Chapter 357: The Talent Show Finally Premieres, but the Results Are a Bit Awkward
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 357: The Talent Show Finally Premieres, but the Results Are a Bit Awkward
Madam Chu smiled: "Alright, Xiaoxiao, where do you go to school?"
Chu Xiaoxiao was a bit surprised, Madam Chu actually showed a good face?
"At Yun City Music Academy," Chu Xiaoxiao replied.
Chu Yufei said: "Mommy, I plan to let Xiaoxiao learn to drive, and we’re thinking about buying her a car to make it easier for her to get to school, what do you think?"
Madam Chu’s heart sank, buying a car for Chu Xiaoxiao? That’s a hefty expense, and she doesn’t want to spend a dime on this little brat!
But remembering Madam Chu’s warning, she held back her anger, smiling: "Alright, buying a car would be convenient, it’s necessary."
Chu Yufei laughed: "Thank you, Mommy."
She hadn’t expected Madam Chu to be so agreeable. Didn’t she used to dislike Chu Xiaoxiao? Has she changed?
"Thank you, Auntie," Chu Xiaoxiao also said.
Then, the two sisters went out.
Watching their backs, Madam Chu’s face immediately turned sour, and she snorted heavily.
She felt like sooner or later she’d die of anger. No, even if she couldn’t openly show dislike for Chu Xiaoxiao, she could still trip her up secretly.
Madam Chu’s eyes immediately flashed with a venomous light.
After Lin Fan visited the Chu Family, a rumor spread quickly — supposedly Mr. Lin, the richest man in Yun City, was planning a trillion-dollar project, and there was a possibility of partnering with the Chu Family!
As soon as this news broke, it stirred quite the commotion in the business world.
Everyone was speculating, what exactly was Lin Fan’s project?
Putting forth a trillion-dollar project, truly worthy of the richest man in Yun City!
At the same time, the news was favorable to the Chu Family, and Yun Chu Group’s stock price hit its limit within a short period, something that hadn’t happened since Yun Chu went public.
This result strengthened Madam Chu’s resolve to curry favor with Lin Fan. Lin Fan was indeed Yun Chu Group’s hope of becoming a trillion-dollar group!
Not to mention, ever since Lin Fan escorted Chu Xiaoxiao back to the Chu Family, he resumed his monotonous life of a rich person.
A few more days passed, and the system bug still wasn’t fixed, persistently delivering him a cash reward of 500 million daily, akin to winning the lottery jackpot every day, and tax-free at that.
It was really too dull!
Apart from dealing with company affairs, Lin Fan had plenty of free time, during which he continued teaching at Yun City Music Academy.
Or he’d go deliver packages.
Life was dull yet fulfilling.
On this day, while Lin Fan was delivering packages, he received a call from Wang Xiangqian.
Wang Xiangqian informed Lin Fan that the talent show Ning Xiaoyue was participating in was airing tonight.
This signaled the official start of Lin Fan and Feng Tianming’s billion-dollar bet.
Wang Xiangqian invited Lin Fan to the company to watch the show, and Lin Fan agreed. After delivering packages, he went to Wenyue Company.
At Wenyue Company, Wang Xiangqian, along with a group of employees and their female group members, had drinks and snacks ready, gathered around the TV, ready to watch the show.
"Brother Fan is here, Brother Fan, come sit!"
Seeing Lin Fan enter, Wang Xiangqian quickly stood up and, with a grin, pulled Lin Fan over to sit on the sofa.
Lin Fan said: "Old Wang, I don’t usually watch TV, can you explain to me what this show is about?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "I’m not entirely clear on the specific rules; I only have a basic understanding. The show is called Creation Star, with a total of 99 female contestants, and in the end, 9 will be selected to debut as a group."
Lin Fan exclaimed: "99 to select 9? That sounds a bit brutal."
Wang Xiangqian said: "It is indeed brutal. From our company, if one of the four girls can debut, I’ll be satisfied, but I’m afraid none might make it."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Well, let’s wait and see."
Soon, the show began.
The first segment of the show was the appearance of the 99 contestants, most of whom were members of different companies’ female groups, some as few as one or two, while others had as many as seven representatives. Wenyue Company had Ning Xiaoyue and three others.
Lin Fan took a look — these females were mostly beauties, and a few looked particularly outstanding, appearing to be strong competitors.
"Xiaoyue and the others are coming on stage!"
Someone suddenly exclaimed with excitement.
Sure enough, on TV, Ning Xiaoyue and her three companions appeared.
Watching Ning Xiaoyue on TV, Lin Fan was somewhat amazed — so adorable, so beautiful, and very photogenic. Compared to the standout contestants he saw a moment ago, they all paled in comparison to Ning Xiaoyue.
However, Ning Xiaoyue clearly lacked experience and looked somewhat nervous.
After Ning Xiaoyue and her group took the stage, another company’s contestants appeared, a total of five females.
Lin Fan recognized them as Feng Tianming’s female group; Feng Tianming had brought these five girls by the company previously.
These five girls, though not as beautiful as Ning Xiaoyue, appeared mature and confident.
Seeing this, Wang Xiangqian beside him started getting nervous. Ever since Feng Tianming abandoned his company, opting to invest in these five girls, if these five girls won against Ning Xiaoyue and her group in this competition, it would prove Feng Tianming’s choice right.
Before long, all 99 females had appeared.
Next was the second segment, the initial performance.
Female group members from various companies took the stage one by one, performing group songs and dances, and their performances were used to assign levels.
The show’s mentors would score each person based on their performance, from A-level to F-level. A-level would have 9 slots, allowing entry into the debut positions.
Of course, this was just the beginning and not the final result.
The show was divided into ten episodes, spanning over two months. After the initial performance in the first episode, the show would open voting to the nationwide audience, and ultimately, the rankings would be decided based on the contestants’ votes. In the grand finale, the top nine contestants by votes would debut as a group.
This meant that the contestants had to rely on their talent to attract fans; the more fans they had, the higher their votes would naturally be. In simple terms, this was a popularity-driven system.
After successive performances by contestants from each company, it was time for Feng Tianming’s female group to take the stage.
It’s worth noting that these five girls were indeed very confident, and their singing and dancing skills were quite impressive — precise choreography and decent singing.
In the end, among the five, four were rated as B-level, and one as A-level, entering the debut positions!
Seeing this, Wang Xiangqian’s face turned a bit grim. Feng Tianming’s female group was pretty formidable — if this A-level girl maintained her position, it was entirely possible for her to debut as a group!
After a few more performances, it was finally Ning Xiaoyue and her group’s turn!
Everyone immediately became nervous, a bit worried, since they were all well aware of Ning Xiaoyue’s abilities. Even though she had undergone rigorous training for a period, there was still concern she might make a mistake.
The worry was proven correct.
All eyes watched as Ning Xiaoyue and her group offered a disastrous stage performance.
Singing was off-key, the dance was not in sync, and especially Ning Xiaoyue, she made a wrong move, causing laughter throughout the venue.
The mentor looked at Ning Xiaoyue and said: "Ning Xiaoyue, don’t count beats while dancing."
The room erupted in laughter.
Ultimately, Ning Xiaoyue was rated as C-level, while the other three girls were rated as D-level — arguably a rather poor performance.
In Wenyue Company’s office, everyone fell silent, each person holding their head in their hands, faces full of embarrassment.
It’s over, their performance was so poor, debut is hopeless!
"Hahaha..."
Suddenly, there was laughter from outside the company.
Feng Tianming walked in; this guy seemed lurking around Wenyue Company, ready to pop up whenever an opportunity arose.
"How did it go? You’ve watched the show, right? Lin Fan, can you admit defeat now?" Feng Tianming taunted.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 Lin Fan’s Hesitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 358 Lin Fan’s Hesitation
After Ning Xiaoyue and her team’s disastrous performance, everyone at Wenyue Company fell silent. The situation didn’t look good!
At this moment, Feng Tianming barged in, demanding Lin Fan concede.
It turned out that Feng Tianming had already obtained the results of the initial performance through some channels. He came to Wenyue Company while the program was airing. He couldn’t resist; he really wanted to embarrass Lin Fan and gloat.
In the past, he’d always been humiliated in front of Lin Fan, but this time Lin Fan finally lost!
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, and their faces showed some embarrassment. This time it was truly humiliating, and there was no way to refute it.
Lin Fan, however, was not embarrassed. He smiled and said, "Why should I concede? Is the result out yet, have you already won?"
Feng Tianming laughed heartily, "Lin Fan, you’re just putting on a brave face. I’m embarrassed for you. My girl group has one member rated A-level, entering the debut position, and the other four are B-level. What about your group? They’re simply rubbish!"
Lin Fan was silent, seemingly unable to argue.
Indeed, Ning Xiaoyue and the others didn’t perform well at all.
Feng Tianming got increasingly smug: "The facts are right in front of you. You’ve got nothing to say now, have you? It proves my original decision was right. Luckily, I gave up on this group, and you, Lin Fan, have such poor judgment, picking up the rubbish I discarded. Hahaha..."
Wang Xiangqian angrily said, "Feng Tianming, don’t go too far!"
Feng Tianming snorted, "What, I was just stating the truth. Can’t handle it? Wang Xiangqian, you should’ve jumped off a building back then; then you wouldn’t be this embarrassed today. Hahaha..."
Feng Tianming’s words were excessive, angering everyone at Wenyue Company, but they had no courage to refute it, due to Ning Xiaoyue and her team’s poor performance!
"Young Master Feng, you might be celebrating too early. I admit your group performed well tonight, better than Xiaoyue and the others, but that doesn’t mean you’ll laugh last," Lin Fan said calmly.
Feng Tianming burst out laughing, "Lin Fan, you go on deceiving yourself!"
Lin Fan said, "We’ll see tomorrow if I’m deceiving myself. According to the rules, the result of the initial performance is only temporary. Tomorrow the show will open for voting, and debut positions are determined by vote rankings. You know this, don’t you, Young Master Feng?"
Feng Tianming said, "Of course I know. Lin Fan, where does your confidence come from? With that trashy group and such a bad performance, can you really have fans who like them? Once voting opens tomorrow, I bet your team will be at the bottom! And my team is so outstanding; their votes will surely be at the top!"
Lin Fan said, "Well, we shall see tomorrow when the results are out. You can gloat then; you’re free to leave now!"
Feng Tianming scoffed, "Lin Fan, besides arguing, you can’t do anything else. Cherish tonight, for tomorrow the vote count will teach you a lesson, and we’ll see what you have to say then!"
After saying this, Feng Tianming left laughing.
Wang Xiangqian grumbled, "Feng Tianming runs faster than a dog; the show just ended, and he’s already here to provoke us?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "He probably knew the result of the initial performance early on."
Wang Xiangqian said, "True, the show is recorded. It’s a pity our company is small and lacks information channels. Feng Tianming surely has his sources."
Lin Fan said, "Building information channels is simple, but I think it’s unnecessary."
Wang Xiangqian sighed, "True, Xiaoyue and the others did so poorly; they’ll likely be eliminated in the first round. It’s pointless. Brother Fan, I’m sorry. Our company was poor before, couldn’t afford good teachers for singing and dancing, leading to their skill level never improving. Plus, Xiaoyue’s singing and dancing talent is mediocre. She’s likely to drag Brother Fan into losing the bet."
Wang Xiangqian looked guilty.
Upon hearing this, everyone in the company felt sorry and lowered their heads, feeling sorry for Lin Fan.
Previously, their company was on the verge of collapse, and Feng Tianming’s withdrawal almost drove Wang Xiangqian to suicide. Lin Fan lent a helping hand and invested 20 million to save the company.
But Ning Xiaoyue and her team’s performance is really a letdown for Lin Fan’s investment.
Seeing everyone’s disappointment, Lin Fan smiled and said, "There’s no need to be so down. After all, the result isn’t out yet; the real test hasn’t begun. Let’s wait for tomorrow."
Wang Xiangqian said gloomily, "Actually, Feng Tianming is right; Xiaoyue’s performance was so bad. How can anyone like her?"
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Not necessarily."
Then, Lin Fan said goodbye and left. Given everyone’s current mood, he couldn’t comfort them, so he decided to leave.
Back in the Rolls-Royce, Lin Fan fell into deep thought.
Though he wouldn’t admit it, Lin Fan shared the same concern as them; Ning Xiaoyue and her team’s performance was so bad. Can they really attract fans?
If they can’t attract fans, no one will vote for them, and if the votes are low, they lose.
Maybe Ning Xiaoyue needs some help.
Lin Fan hesitated for a moment, wondering if he should give Ning Xiaoyue some top-tier Koi Carp Luck.
His top-tier Koi Carp Luck can be gifted. That night he gave top-tier Koi Carp Luck to Chu Xiaoxiao, and she managed to hit her targets every time and even gained an unexpected fortune of 400,000.
If he gives top-tier Koi Carp Luck to Ning Xiaoyue now, her fate would surely change.
Lin Fan hesitated for a moment, then smiled slightly and drove away.
The night went by uneventfully.
Next day, while Lin Fan was still asleep, he was suddenly awakened by a ringing phone.
It was Wang Xiangqian calling.
"Brother Fan, the voting for the show is open. At noon, the initial vote results will be announced. Also, Xiaoyue is trending now on social media," Wang Xiangqian said.
Lin Fan said, "What’s going on? Did you buy the trending spot?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "Brother Fan, don’t joke. After Xiaoyue’s performance last night, would I buy a trending spot for humiliation? It’s probably the high discussion rate online; anyway, the video of Xiaoyue’s performance last night went viral."
Lin Fan said, "I don’t use Weibo. What are the netizens saying?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "Netizens are saying all sorts of things. Most criticize her poor performance, but some think she’s cute despite that. Brother Fan, honestly, I feel the situation isn’t promising."
Lin Fan nodded, "I got it."
Most people criticize Ning Xiaoyue; it indeed doesn’t sound promising.
Time quickly passed, and noon was approaching fast.
At Wenyue Company, Wang Xiangqian sat in his office, anxiously awaiting the results, feeling restless.
Meanwhile, at another entertainment company, Feng Tianming and a group of employees were also waiting for the results.
Unlike Wang Xiangqian, Feng Tianming was very optimistic about the outcome. He was confident that his girl group would get high votes, especially the one rated A-level, who might even receive the most votes!
"I think we can start preparing for the celebration. As long as our group’s votes make it to the top nine, I’ll treat everyone to a seafood feast tonight," Feng Tianming said happily.
The employees immediately smiled brightly and said, "Thank you, Young Master Feng!"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "With our group’s performance last night, we attracted countless fans; it’s a given. As for Lin Fan’s broken group, they can’t even dance properly. How can they compete with us!"
Everyone laughed aloud.
"That Ning Xiaoyue, she even became a trending topic, getting criticized by netizens!"
"Ridiculous, can that even be called dancing!"
"Counting beats while dancing, so embarrassing."
The employees heartlessly ridiculed Ning Xiaoyue.
Noon finally arrived, and the voting results were announced!
Feng Tianming said, "Everyone quiet down. Someone, put the voting results on the public screen!"
On a large screen, the initial vote results for the Creation Star show were displayed, and everyone’s eyes were fixed on it.
Suddenly, everyone’s faces changed, their laughter replaced by shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Did Ning Xiaoyue Cheat?
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 359: Did Ning Xiaoyue Cheat?
Feng Tianming, along with a group of employees, gathered around the big screen and saw the latest announced initial voting results.
They were all stunned.
They originally thought that the five girls in their group would definitely receive a high number of votes, and that A-level girl might even take the highest votes, securing the initial C-position.
If she took the initial C-position and maintained it until the end of the competition, she could achieve the highest C-position debut success.
However, while dreams are bountiful, reality is quite stark.
The voting results showed that the five girls in their group all fell outside the top 20, with the lowest even ranking at 90!
The top ten were missing, but they did have spots in the bottom ten.
Even the A-level girl with the highest votes ranked only 21st!
This was simply a bucket of cold water on Feng Tianming and his team.
Where’s the promised high vote count, the promised C-position?
Yet, this wasn’t the biggest blow.
The biggest blow was Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking.
Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking was shockingly third place!
"Oh my God! Ning Xiaoyue in third place!"
"No way, how is this possible!"
"She clearly dances so poorly and sings so badly, why would so many people vote for her? Are these people blind?"
The employees were all confused and almost going crazy.
Feng Tianming’s face turned pale, and he slumped down, screaming: "Impossible, how could she possibly be third, this must be fake!"
He couldn’t accept this reality. He was about to go laugh at Lin Fan, but this result was a slap in the face.
At the same time.
The entire Wenyue Company was already boiling over.
Initially, everyone at Wenyue Company was feeling very down because many people online were criticizing Ning Xiaoyue, and her performance was indeed poor, so it looked like her votes would be very low.
However, as soon as the results came out, Ning Xiaoyue was third place!
Even though the other three had low votes, ranking outside the top 30, Ning Xiaoyue’s high count made nobody care about the other three anymore.
"Xiaoyue is amazing!"
"Oh my God, Xiaoyue’s vote count is so high? What a surprise!"
"This was beyond everyone’s expectations, is Xiaoyue blessed by an immortal?"
Everyone was overjoyed and ecstatic.
For a moment, all attention focused on Ning Xiaoyue.
Wang Xiangqian jumped high in his office in excitement, feeling immensely thrilled. Ning Xiaoyue’s result was too unexpected, too delightful, even miraculous!
Just from Xiaoyue’s lousy performance last night, she could attract so many fans and rise to third place?
It’s just unbelievable, Ning Xiaoyue seemed like she was cheating!
The show Creation Star had quite high attention, and as soon as the first voting rank was announced, it immediately stirred a commotion online.
Especially Ning Xiaoyue’s votes became the focal point, and in a short time, Ning Xiaoyue’s votes topped the trending search.
Netizens gasped in disbelief.
"Is this voting real? Ning Xiaoyue actually got third?"
"No way, does Ning Xiaoyue have so many fans?"
"With such a pathetic performance, how could she attract fans?"
"Who would like Ning Xiaoyue?"
"How is this possible, did Ning Xiaoyue cheat?"
The doubts from netizens flooded the internet.
Despite this, everyone at Wenyue Company was in high spirits. Wang Xiangqian even said he would reward everyone by treating all employees to a meal.
Wang Xiangqian then shared this news with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan had just finished his class and left Yun City Music Academy.
Upon learning that Ning Xiaoyue had secured third place, Lin Fan smiled with satisfaction and said, "Xiaoyue did well. I’ll treat you all to lunch; I’ll head to the company right now."
Lin Fan drove to Wenyue Company, where the employees were already waiting for him.
The company had a festive atmosphere, like celebrating a New Year.
After all, Ning Xiaoyue’s result was really good, completely exceeding everyone’s expectations. They initially thought that Ning Xiaoyue would lag behind, but she ended up in third place.
"Brother Fan, you were right last night; we shouldn’t have been down before the results were out," Wang Xiangqian said a bit sheepishly.
He had too many negative emotions last night.
Lin Fan said, "Now you’re happy."
Wang Xiangqian laughed, "Of course, Xiaoyue makes us proud."
Lin Fan said, "Let’s go, let’s have a meal."
They were about to go out for a meal to celebrate Ning Xiaoyue’s good start.
At this moment, Feng Tianming came over with a group of people.
"Lin Fan, it’s good that you’re here. I was just looking for you!" Feng Tianming said with a stern face.
Wang Xiangqian sneered and said, "Feng Tianming, how dare you come over. Do you think your face hasn’t swollen enough from our slaps?"
Feng Tianming said coldly, "I now seriously suspect this voting result. I don’t acknowledge it at all; how is it a slap in the face! Lin Fan, what trick did you use to cheat, you’d better explain it to me clearly!"
Feng Tianming couldn’t accept the voting result. After much thought, he finally came up with a suspicion: he suspected Lin Fan of cheating!
So he came over immediately to confront him.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan. Ning Xiaoyue’s result was indeed beyond everyone’s expectations because it was just too extraordinary. Could there really be vote manipulation?
Lin Fan remained calm and said, "I expected someone would question Xiaoyue’s votes, so after learning the results, I asked someone to conduct a data investigation. We should have the results soon."
Ring ring ring...
Lin Fan’s phone rang.
He looked at it; it was Du Tao calling.
Du Tao is a big name in the entertainment industry, the president of Tianxue Entertainment. Conducting this data investigation was a small task for him.
"Mr. Lin, the investigation results are out. I’ll send them to you now," Du Tao said.
Lin Fan said, "Great."
Soon after, Lin Fan received the file sent by Du Tao.
Lin Fan checked the investigation report, then handed it to Wang Xiangqian and said, "Old Wang, put the investigation report on the big screen for Young Master Feng to see."
The investigation report appeared on the big screen.
Lin Fan said, "Young Master Feng, take a look yourself. After the program was broadcast last night, the contestants started gaining followers. Fans voluntarily organized data voting groups, and the data shows that Xiaoyue’s Weibo followers increased by 100,000 overnight, just behind the first and second places. The number of participants in the data voting group has now exceeded 3000, also just behind the first and second places. By the way, I also investigated on behalf of Young Master Feng’s girl; your A-Class player’s fan base is around 400, which aligns with her ranking. Data doesn’t lie."
Faced with the objective data, Feng Tianming was lost for words.
But he still couldn’t concede: "How can this be? Most netizens are clearly criticizing Ning Xiaoyue. How could she attract so many followers?"
Lin Fan said, "It seems like a lot of people are criticizing her, but that’s just the surface. Amid the criticism, many supportive voices are drowned out. These fans don’t make much noise, but they responded with their votes; they’re supporting Xiaoyue."
Lin Fan paused and smiled, "Moreover, doesn’t Young Master Feng know that the program team has anti-cheating measures? If I were faking votes, the program team would have found out long ago. If Young Master Feng is so distrustful of the program team, you could always withdraw from the competition."
Feng Tianming was completely lost for words.
Lin Fan presented numerous pieces of evidence, slapping him hard in the face.
Everyone at Wenyue Company also breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that Ning Xiaoyue’s result was genuine, and her third place was well-deserved!
So the question arose, with Ning Xiaoyue’s poor singing and dancing, what on earth drew so many fans?
Was she really cheating?
Did Lin Fan indeed bestow Ning Xiaoyue with top-tier Koi Carp Luck?

chapters.title: Chapter 360: The Frustrated Young Master Feng, Is There Any Justice Left?
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 360: The Frustrated Young Master Feng, Is There Any Justice Left?
Lin Fan used data to prove that Ning Xiaoyue’s votes were genuine, not fabricated, and the program team had anti-cheating measures in place. It would be easy to detect any attempt to manipulate the results.
In the face of objective data, Feng Tianming was left speechless.
Although it was unclear why, Ning Xiaoyue indeed attracted many fans.
Ning Xiaoyue’s performance was so poor, yet she still drew numerous fans and ranked third. It was truly baffling, as if she had a cheat code.
Knowing he was in the wrong, Feng Tianming left in a huff, feeling frustrated.
Subsequently, the data investigation was also made public online, quelling the numerous doubts. Regardless of the reason, Ning Xiaoyue’s third-place position was well-deserved, beyond question.
People began to wonder how Ning Xiaoyue, with such poor singing and dancing skills, managed to attract fans. What did her fans like about her?
This question also troubled Feng Tianming.
Clearly, all the members of his girl group had talent, so why couldn’t they defeat someone with such poor skills like Ning Xiaoyue?
Following Lin Fan’s example, Feng Tianming conducted a survey on Ning Xiaoyue’s fan base.
The survey showed that fans liked Ning Xiaoyue firstly because she was beautiful and cute, with top-notch looks. Secondly, her personality was amusing. Although her initial performance was bad, it was very funny, making fans feel happy when they saw her.
Feng Tianming broke into a cold sweat, feeling like his entire worldview had been overturned.
Initially, he abandoned Wenyue Company because he noticed that their girl group was lacking talent, so he decisively withdrew his investment and switched to the current group.
He thought the competition focused on singing and dancing skills and that the audience was there to watch those performances. As long as the singing and dancing skills were strong enough, people would like them and they would win.
Now he realized the program’s format was based on popularity rankings. Ning Xiaoyue could gain fans solely through her looks and personality, without relying on singing and dancing skills!
Because if this program truly judged by singing and dancing skills, Ning Xiaoyue would definitely be at the bottom.
Is there any justice or fairness left?
Ning Xiaoyue was the only contestant in the program who could win purely based on appearance and personality despite having zero talent. She was originally obscure but overnight, she stood out among 99 girls to seize the third place. Isn’t this like a cheat code?
It’s practically a cheat-like life!
Feng Tianming had to admit that Ning Xiaoyue was indeed very pretty. In terms of looks, none of the five members of his group could compete with Ning Xiaoyue.
Feng Tianming realized he had miscalculated. He never imagined that the program could attract fans based on appearance and personality rather than talent, but now it was too late to turn back.
In his bet with Lin Fan, if he lost, he would have to pay Lin Fan 100 million.
He dared to make that bet with Lin Fan because he was overly confident, thinking he would definitely beat Lin Fan.
Now, realizing he might lose, Feng Tianming began to grow anxious.
Feng Tianming then made a malicious decision to target Ning Xiaoyue, ensuring she could not continue to rise in fame!
As long as Ning Xiaoyue was eliminated, the other three members of her group wouldn’t pose a threat, and Lin Fan would be doomed to lose.
Before targeting Ning Xiaoyue, Feng Tianming also made an attempt to promote his own talent.
So Feng Tianming spent a large sum to get that A-level female on trending searches and bought a lot of Internet trolls to praise her skills.
However, the effect was minimal!
"The talent is okay, but the looks seem a bit lacking!"
"I think she’s pretty good, but I wouldn’t become her fan, maybe she’s not my type!"
"I still find Ning Xiaoyue adorable; I’m a fan of Ning Xiaoyue!"
"The girl has good abilities, but I choose Ning Xiaoyue."
The evaluations from netizens generally acknowledged the A-level girl’s talent, but she just didn’t gain any fans!
Seeing these genuine comments infuriated Feng Tianming, especially when he saw Ning Xiaoyue’s fans’ messages, it made him even angrier.
It seemed he had no other choice but to target Ning Xiaoyue and bring her down!
At the Creation Star’s filming base.
After the first round of vote rankings was announced, the 99 participating girls got a chance to contact the outside world. Over the past few days, they had been in closed training, recording the program, their phones were taken away, and they were almost entirely cut off from the outside world.
Ning Xiaoyue was extremely surprised to learn that she ranked third initially, completely beyond her own expectations.
Because during the initial performance recording, she knew her performance was too poor. After the program aired, her results would definitely be bad; no one would like someone who sang and danced so poorly.
To her utter surprise, she actually got third place, and she heard that she had already become a hot topic online, with many people criticizing her but also many who liked her.
Her first action was to contact Lin Fan.
When Lin Fan saw the call from Ning Xiaoyue, he answered the phone: "Xiaoyue, how come you have time to call me?"
Ning Xiaoyue replied: "The program team gave us half a day’s break, and I just got my phone back and learned about my vote count."
Lin Fan laughed and said: "Congratulations, your results are great; you got third place."
Ning Xiaoyue said: "I really didn’t expect to have such good results. I thought I would be among the last ones. Even those questioning my votes thought the company must have rigged them for me."
Lin Fan said: "There was no vote rigging, the count is real."
Ning Xiaoyue said: "Then I don’t get it."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Do you remember what I said to you before you set off? Just be your true self, and there will definitely be people who like you. You were true to yourself, and indeed, there are quite a few who like you."
Ning Xiaoyue was stunned; she hadn’t forgotten what Lin Fan told her. She also followed Lin Fan’s advice, being herself openly, taking it seriously even if her skills were poor.
Who would have thought there would be so many who liked her?
She even doubted if she somehow had a cheat code or if someone secretly gave her a boost.
Only Lin Fan knew he didn’t help Ning Xiaoyue cheat.
He did hesitate about giving Ning Xiaoyue top-tier Koi Carp Luck, ensuring her an unbeatable position.
But after hesitating, he ultimately abandoned that idea.
The reason being he had said, just be true to yourself, and some people will like you. Lin Fan also wanted to see how many would like Ning Xiaoyue.
To Lin Fan’s surprise, Ning Xiaoyue didn’t need the crutch, winning on her own.
Looking at Ning Xiaoyue’s start, Lin Fan was confident that as long as nothing unexpected happened, Ning Xiaoyue could debut with a group.
The only concern was, being in such a standout position with such poor skills was sure to draw attention and jealousy from other contestants’ teams.
Especially Feng Tianming, he certainly wouldn’t let Ning Xiaoyue succeed smoothly.
What follows is bound to be a stormy battle.
"Xiaoyue, from now on, don’t go online. Just focus on recording the program." Lin Fan advised.
Lin Fan was not mistaken; soon, a wave of online harassment targeted at Ning Xiaoyue came crashing in.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: At the Entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau, Lin Fan Encounters the Divorced Man Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 361: At the Entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau, Lin Fan Encounters the Divorced Man Again
Lin Fan speculated that Ning Xiaoyue would probably face attacks from multiple sides in the future, after all, Ning Xiaoyue was too conspicuous.
At the end of the day, this program was a competition. Behind every contestant, there was a company. On the surface, these contestants were competing, but in fact, the companies behind them were also competing.
As long as they weren’t contestants from one’s own company, they were enemies who needed to be taken down.
Taking down contestants from other companies naturally creates more opportunities for one’s own people to stand out.
You could say this was a brutal war. Although there was no visible gunpowder smoke, it was no less intense than the battlefield, even somewhat cruel, like raising worms in a container, throwing 99 into a dish, letting them fight each other, with only 9 achieving victory.
Ning Xiaoyue didn’t have much strength, yet she secured third place, which surely incited envy. And her weaknesses were too obvious; opponents only needed to attack her prowess to leave her utterly defenseless.
Hence, Lin Fan instructed Ning Xiaoyue not to go online in the near future to avoid being hurt by the online commentary.
The company wars should be left to the companies to resolve.
If necessary, Lin Fan would step in to help Ning Xiaoyue.
However, now was not the time.
Lin Fan’s life was not affected by Ning Xiaoyue. He continued his tedious wealthy lifestyle, usually visiting various companies, handling business affairs, or attending classes at school. When bored, he would deliver packages to enrich his life.
On this day, Lin Fan, feeling bored, donned his delivery outfit and went out to deliver packages. One package was for the Civil Affairs Bureau.
Just as Lin Fan arrived at the Civil Affairs Bureau entrance, he heard an uproar; someone was arguing at the entrance.
Could they be divorcing? Lin Fan thought.
The people who come to this place are either getting married or divorced. Generally speaking, weddings are joyful events; only divorces cause arguments.
Previously, when Lin Fan was a delivery person, he delivered fast food to people at the Civil Affairs Bureau. Once, he witnessed a husband assaulting his wife at the entrance because the wife insisted on divorcing, but the husband refused, eventually resorting to violence in anger.
At that time, Lin Fan couldn’t stand it, went up to stop it, but got beaten too. Lin Fan was enraged and fought back, eventually being separated by the arriving police, leaving Lin Fan injured for a month before recovering.
During that incident, Lin Fan suffered quite a bit, as the opponent was quite large, and Lin Fan was just an ordinary person back then.
Lin Fan parked his electric bike, picked up the package, and planned to enter the Civil Affairs Bureau.
He looked up and saw a man and a woman arguing at the entrance.
"Divorce, I want to divorce you!" the woman shouted.
The man firmly said, "I won’t divorce you, you’re coming home with me now!"
Seeing this man, Lin Fan was stunned.
Damn, wasn’t this the guy he fought with last time!
Big and burly, definitely unmistakable!
Lin Fan was deeply impressed, having been beaten to the bone during that incident; he’d recognize him even if he turned to ash.
But as for the woman, Lin Fan didn’t know her; she wasn’t the woman from last time. This man had remarried, and even this second marriage was ending in divorce!
Coincidentally, Lin Fan encountered them again.
The woman was very emotional: "I can’t live like this anymore; divorce is inevitable. I’ve brought the divorce agreement; just sign it and it’s over!"
The man anxiously said, "Can’t you be reasonable? I said I don’t want a divorce; why must you push for it?"
The woman cursed, "You have some nerve saying that! Don’t you know what you’ve done? You cheated while I was pregnant. Had I not accidentally seen your phone, I wouldn’t have known. Now that I know, if I don’t divorce you, am I waiting for the New Year?"
The man’s face was indeed thick-skinned: "I cheated, but what can I do? You were pregnant. How could I bear ten months without?"
The woman looked incredulous: "Saying that, are you even human? Shameless. I don’t want to say anything more to you; divorce!"
The man said, "I won’t agree. Don’t make a scene in public; come home with me!"
As he spoke, the man reached out to tug the woman, trying to take her away.
There were people watching around; such a disgraceful matter, the man didn’t want to embarrass himself publicly.
"Let go of me, don’t touch me with your filthy hands!" The woman shook off the man’s hand, disgustedly cursing.
The man suddenly got angry: "You’re defying me, looking for trouble, huh?!"
He raised his hand, ready to give the woman a slap.
"Wait!"
A voice came from behind, stopping the man.
The man turned his head and saw a deliveryman walking up.
"We meet again. You’re going through another divorce?" Lin Fan chuckled.
The man paused, looked over Lin Fan carefully, and immediately recognized him: "It’s you!"
He recognized him; this deliveryman was the young guy who intervened last time during his divorce squabble; except, last time he was a food delivery guy, now he had switched to delivering packages.
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it’s me."
The man sneered, "Kid, didn’t you get enough beating last time? Dare to meddle in my affair again? Want to avoid getting beaten; better stay out of it!"
Lin Fan smiled: "Last time, you publicly beat your ex-wife, I couldn’t bear it, so I intervened to stop you. This time, I can’t bear it too. How is beating your wife a display of manhood?"
Upon hearing this, the woman was shocked: "Oh, was I blind? You have a history; you used to beat your ex-wife, now want to beat me?"
The man angrily said, "Let me deal with this kid, and then I’ll deal with you slowly. Want a divorce? Keep dreaming!"
Then he turned to Lin Fan: "Kid, you want to meddle? Come get beaten!"
Seeing this, the woman quickly said: "Young man, you better leave. You’re not his match; he’s a fitness coach, you definitely can’t beat him. Thank you for your good intention, but I can’t let him harm the innocent."
Lin Fan smiled: "It’s okay, last time I tried to stop him and got injured. This battle isn’t for you; it’s for myself."
The woman chuckled bitterly: "Young man, why put yourself through this; you’ll only get hurt again."
The surrounding crowd murmured, thinking Lin Fan was asking for trouble. Just looking at their builds, it was clear Lin Fan was not this man’s match.
Last time, when this man publicly assaulted his wife, Lin Fan rushed in to wrestle with him. Although he saved the wife, he got seriously beaten.
This experience, Lin Fan had never forgotten.
Today the chance for revenge came, and Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t miss it.
The man chuckled coldly: "I’ll settle you in three minutes. You meddlesome kid, how long did it take for your injuries to heal last time? This time I’ll make you recover even longer!"
As he spoke, the man clenched his fists and advanced toward Lin Fan.
Frightened, the woman quickly took out her phone, prepared to call the police.
Just as the man approached Lin Fan, raising his fist intending to punch Lin Fan’s face, Lin Fan swung a swift kick, striking directly at the man’s abdomen.
Ah!
A miserable cry, and the man’s body curled up like a shrimp, kneeling down with his face contorted in pain.
The woman had just dialed the three-digit emergency number, intending to press call, but stopped abruptly at the spectacle.
Simultaneously, nearby a female saw this moment, and immediately looked at Lin Fan in astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Track and Field Athlete, Can You Still Run Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 362: Track and Field Athlete, Can You Still Run Now?
The divorced man has a temper, priding himself on being a fitness coach, he never pays attention to outsiders. In his previous marriage, because he refused to divorce his ex-wife, he violently beat her on the street, but was stopped by Lin Fan, who then got beaten up by the divorced man.
Later, the police arrived and dragged the divorced man away. He went through a lawsuit with his ex-wife, and due to the assault, the judge decisively granted the divorce.
The divorced man remarried later, and today he’s getting divorced again, still because of the divorced man’s own doing. In a fit of rage, he is about to beat his wife in the street again.
Unexpectedly, he bumps into Lin Fan again. This kid hasn’t had enough of a lesson last time, and he’s running in to meddle again.
"If the police hadn’t arrived in time last time, I would have beaten you crippled!" the divorced man arrogantly said, not putting Lin Fan in his eye at all.
Lin Fan didn’t get frightened by him, which made the divorced man very upset. This kid really isn’t afraid of getting beaten up; it’s infuriating.
The divorced man is in a bad mood, and with Lin Fan approaching, he decides to beat up Lin Fan first.
The crowd saw this and was a bit worried for Lin Fan. Isn’t this inviting trouble? How could he be a match for the other guy?
However, the crowd also quite admired Lin Fan’s bravery. Knowing he’s no match for the divorced man, he still stepped forward. Such spirited youths are increasingly rare in today’s society.
See these onlookers, none of them dare to step in and stop it, fearing they’ll get beaten too. After all, this divorced man is really stout.
The divorced man raised his fist and approached Lin Fan, sneering: "I’m a fitness coach now, but I used to be a track and field athlete. How dare you challenge me with that frail body?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Track and field athlete? I hope you run fast later."
The divorced man didn’t take Lin Fan’s words seriously.
He already reached Lin Fan and delivered a punch towards him.
"I’ll settle you within three minutes!"
The divorced man threatened.
In the last fight with Lin Fan, Lin Fan mostly took the hits. He was fighting back purely out of determination.
Now, the divorced man has undergone long-term fitness training and is more confident and stronger. Settling Lin Fan won’t take more than three minutes.
However...
Before the divorced man’s fist could touch Lin Fan, Lin Fan already kicked and hit the divorced man’s abdomen.
With a light kick, Lin Fan didn’t even seem to use much force.
Yet the divorced man’s eyes almost popped out with pain. He plopped down to his knees, his body curling up like a shrimp, as if Lin Fan’s kick had evicted his very soul.
The crowd stared dumbfounded.
What just happened?
The woman had already taken out her phone to call the police, but paused, seeing she didn’t need to call anymore. Her bear-like strong husband was actually defeated by Lin Fan in an instant!
The divorced man himself was incredibly shocked, unable to believe this was real. Damn it, how could he be put down by one kick from Lin Fan?
This surely isn’t real, it must be an illusion!
He wants to get up and batter Lin Fan.
But it feels impossible to move; the insides seem shattered, the pain is tearing at his heart!
"Damn it, what is going on? How could this kid defeat me?" The divorced man really doesn’t understand, trying to stand up.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "If you still want to continue fighting, it might be better to stay kneeling."
Saying this, Lin Fan lightly placed a hand on the divorced man’s shoulder.
The divorced man immediately felt as if a mountain was weighing down on him.
Cold sweat poured down the divorced man, finally realizing Lin Fan was strong, terrifyingly strong. He looked at Lin Fan in fright.
He felt like he had seen a ghost, wanting to crawl to escape, but couldn’t stand up.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "How about it, track and field athlete, can you still run?"
The divorced man finally understood what Lin Fan meant earlier, but it was too late. Though he used to be a track and field athlete, now he couldn’t run, escaping wasn’t an option.
The divorced man shook his head in terror; he really didn’t understand how Lin Fan had become so formidable.
Lin Fan said, "Your wife wants to divorce you because you cheated while she was pregnant. Is this true?"
The divorced man replied, "It’s true."
Lin Fan looked at the woman: "He can’t hit you now, you can reason with him."
The woman took out the divorce agreement and handed it to the divorced man: "This is the divorce agreement. I have no other demands; I just want custody of the child. If you agree, sign it. If not, see you in court."
The divorced man couldn’t possibly sign. He only wanted to beat the woman, but with Lin Fan present, he didn’t dare act out.
Glancing up at Lin Fan, the divorced man didn’t know how to react; he was unwilling yet scared to get angry.
Lin Fan said, "You have violent tendencies. If you get custody of the kid, in future displeasure, you might even hit your own child. If you really love your kid, I think it’s safer to let your wife have custody. What do you think?"
The divorced man wouldn’t dare disagree with Lin Fan, fearing another kick from him would ruin him. Forget about custody; he might not even live long.
"You’re right, I might hit the kid. Fine, I’ll sign." The divorced man said, gritting his teeth, picking up the pen to sign his name.
The woman seeing this was very pleased, but also a bit worried.
"Thank you so much, young man. I have another favor to ask. I’m about to go with him to get the divorce certificate, could you wait for me for a bit?" she asked.
She feared once Lin Fan left, the man might turn hostile.
Going the extra mile, Lin Fan nodded and said, "Alright, I’ll just deliver some takeout first."
The woman went inside with the divorced man.
After Lin Fan delivered the food and waited a while, he saw the two come out. They successfully got divorced and obtained the divorce certificate.
The man looked unwilling. He indeed planned to turn hostile once Lin Fan left, but seeing Lin Fan still there, he dared not act up and obediently divorced the woman.
"Did you get the divorce formalities done?" Lin Fan asked with a smile.
The woman happily replied, "Yes, we’ve got the divorce certificate."
The woman showed the divorce certificate to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan nodded, looked at the divorced man and said, "If you dare hit women again and I find out, it won’t be as light as today, I’ll make it so you can’t live independently for the rest of your life. Leave now; I’ll give you three minutes to disappear from my sight."
Previously, the divorced man claimed he could handle Lin Fan in three minutes. Lin Fan returned the words to him.
The divorced man didn’t dare utter a word, turned, and ran as fast as possible, wanting to vanish from Lin Fan’s sight immediately, fearing even a second delay would upset Lin Fan.
He indeed disappeared completely within three minutes.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Truly living up to a track and field athlete, he really runs fast."
The woman was unprecedentedly happy, successfully divorcing the domestic abuser and adulterer, gaining custody of her child. She was now a winner in life.
"Thank you, young man. Without you, it wouldn’t have gone so smoothly." The woman approached to thank Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and replied, "No problem, just a lift of the hand."
The woman thanked him profoundly before leaving.
Seeing the matter settled, Lin Fan planned to leave and continue delivering food.
At this moment, a pretty girl approached directly and said, "Young man, you’re really good; I saw everything just now. I also have a favor to ask, can you help me?"
Lin Fan glanced at the girl, really pretty, dressed well, definitely not an ordinary girl.
"How can I help you?" Lin Fan asked.
The girl grabbed Lin Fan and said, "I want to marry you."

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Encountered a Psychopath? Miss, what’s your doctor’s phone number?
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 363: Encountered a Psychopath? Miss, what’s your doctor’s phone number?
What?
Marriage?
Lin Fan thought he had misheard. He was a complete stranger to this beautiful girl, meeting her for the first time, and it had been less than three minutes since they met. He didn’t even know her name.
And the girl actually suggested marriage right off the bat?
"Miss, did I hear you right? You said you want to marry me? That’s not a funny joke," Lin Fan chuckled.
The beautiful girl said, "You didn’t hear wrong. I just want to marry you. I’ve made up my mind; I think you’re the perfect candidate."
Lin Fan shook his head, "Miss, you’re quite good-looking, but unfortunately, your mind seems a bit off. Who’s your doctor? How could they allow you to leave the hospital?"
Normally, no girl would randomly come up to a stranger and propose marriage, unless she was mentally unstable.
Lin Fan really thought that this beauty might have sneaked out of a mental hospital.
The beautiful girl wiped her sweat and said, "Big brother, I’m really not an idiot. Let me tell you, it’s like this. I originally had someone lined up to marry me today, but that guy backed out at the last minute. I have no choice—I must get married today. Seeing you are so kind-hearted, I approached you."
Lin Fan sighed, took out his phone, and said, "Miss, what’s your doctor’s phone number? I’ll give them a call to take you back to the hospital. If not, I could take you back myself."
The beautiful girl wiped her cold sweat and said, "Looks like I’ll have to start from the beginning and explain clearly. Let’s get to know each other first. Hello, my name is Wei Qingxue."
Lin Fan said, "Hello, I’m Lin Fan."
The beautiful girl had a fleeting thought that Lin Fan’s name seemed special, but his delivery uniform dispelled it.
"Lin Fan, it’s like this, I urgently need someone to marry me right now. Don’t worry, it’s not a real marriage, just a fake one. I’m trying to resist the marriage my family has arranged for me. Once I’m married, they can’t force me to marry someone I dislike," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan made a sound of understanding. So he was to be a shield.
"Why choose me? We don’t even know each other," Lin Fan asked.
Wei Qingxue said, "I had no choice. I initially asked an old classmate to fake marry me. We agreed to meet at the civil affairs office today, but I’ve been waiting here for half a day, and the guy called saying he’s sick and can’t come. He’s clearly chickening out—a useless fellow."
Lin Fan said, "Maybe it’s because he thinks it’s a demanding task, so you’re offering this ’deal’ to me?"
Wei Qingxue laughed, "Don’t make it sound so bad. What do you mean by ’deal’? If you help me, I won’t treat you unfairly."
Lin Fan said, "What do you mean? Can we turn fake into real?"
Such a sudden question, and yet Wei Qingxue understood it, blushing as she quickly said, "Wait, we’re only fake-married, of course, we can’t act like real couples. After marriage, we won’t sleep together or do what real couples do. At most, we’ll just hold hands and play lovey-dovey in front of others. That’s it. It’s just a marriage in name, nothing real!"
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "That’s not a good deal. Marrying you but living like a widower, hanging on a tree I can’t touch and giving up a whole forest? No wonder your old classmate got sick. I think I’m feeling sick too. Sorry, I’m leaving."
Lin Fan decisively refused and intended to slip away.
He’s still single and unmarried with countless beautiful girls waiting for him to choose from. If he married Wei Qingxue, all those beautiful girls would be off-limits, and he couldn’t even touch Wei Qingxue. It would be like being a monk, nothing more.
Seeing Lin Fan about to leave, Wei Qingxue quickly said, "1 million!"
Lin Fan paused, "What?"
Wei Qingxue said, "As long as you help me, after the deal is done, I’ll pay you 1 million as a reward. To show my sincerity, I’ll give you 200,000 as a deposit first. When we divorce, I’ll give you the remaining 800,000."
Lin Fan said, "Goodbye."
Perhaps in the past, Lin Fan might have considered it, but now 1 million meant nothing to him.
Not to mention the system gave him billions at the start, even if there was a bug recently causing it to deposit 5 million in his account daily. In just over half a month, his account balance was nearing 100 million in cash...
million is hardly considered money to him; thinking he could be bought with 1 million was too naive.
Damn!
million couldn’t sway Lin Fan?
Wei Qingxue was anxious. Lin Fan was clearly a delivery guy, who at most earns 10,000 a month. 1 million was equivalent to 100 months’ salary for him.
"Think about it, being a delivery guy, you earn 10,000 a month. Without eating or drinking, it would take 100 months to earn that, over 8 years. If you agree to help me, you could save 8 years of effort," Wei Qingxue argued to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Thanks, but I don’t need that money."
Wei Qingxue said, "You must think it’s too little, right? How about you name a price? We can negotiate on the amount."
Lin Fan said, "Miss, let me put it this way, it’s not a matter of money."
Wei Qingxue grew anxious, "Then what would make you willing to help me? Name your conditions. I really need your help."
Lin Fan said, "Why are you so set on choosing me? You’re so beautiful and can readily come up with over a million. Your family must be rich. Surely many men would want to take advantage of that."
Wei Qingxue said, "If it were that easy, I’d have found someone already. The person I need must have reliable character to ensure they won’t betray me, and also won’t be seen through by my family. People like that are hard to find. Those I know, my family knows well; they’d immediately see through the ruse."
Lin Fan said, "We don’t even know each other. How do you know I have reliable character?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I saw you helping that divorced woman just now. In today’s world, very few people stand up for others, especially when even helping elders might get you scammed. It shows your integrity is rare. Though this is our first meeting, you’ve earned my trust in that regard. That’s the first reason."
Lin Fan said, "And the second?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Second, you’re incredibly strong. That divorced guy was so burly and yet you took him down with one kick. If you help me, you can easily handle any threats from my family. I won’t have to worry about you being coerced and betraying me."
Wei Qingxue continued, "Also, thirdly, you’re a complete stranger to my family. They have no knowledge of you and can’t determine if we’re pretending. In every way, you’re my perfect choice. Handsome, will you please help me?"
Lin Fan said, "Thank you for considering me, but I’m really not interested in this matter."
Wei Qingxue said, "My family has lined up a blind date for me tomorrow. If we don’t get married today, I won’t be able to escape tomorrow. Even 1 million can’t move you—what could possibly move you?"
Lin Fan truly wasn’t moved. No matter how he looked at it, this thing did him no good, and he didn’t need to fake a marriage for a mere 1 million.
But just then—
Ding!
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s mind was filled with a system alert.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Too Sudden! New System Task: Marry a Rich and Beautiful Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 364: Too Sudden! New System Task: Marry a Rich and Beautiful Woman!
Lin Fan had no intention at all of agreeing to Wei Qingxue’s proposition, even though he sympathized with her situation. Marriage is not something to be taken lightly.
Just as Lin Fan was about to leave, the system notification suddenly chimed.
"Ding!"
"System task announcement!"
"Main task: Marry the rich and beautiful Wei Qingxue."
"Task Level: Important."
"Task Progress: 0/100"
Lin Fan stopped in his tracks and was dumbfounded.
What?
The system is asking him to marry Wei Qingxue?
Isn’t the system malfunctioning? How can it still issue tasks?
It looks like the bug is with the reward function, while the task issuing function is still working? This is excessive.
But Lin Fan dared not take system tasks lightly. Every task the system issued had its purpose. It’s just unclear what the purpose of marrying Wei Qingxue is.
Today was the first time he met Wei Qingxue. Could she be an important figure or something, that the system requires him to marry her?
Seeing that Lin Fan was unmoved, Wei Qingxue decisively turned around to leave, feeling a bit downcast.
The person she originally found for a fake marriage stood her up, and Lin Fan was unwilling too. She had no idea where to find someone to marry her on such short notice.
If she didn’t get married today, she would have to go on a blind date with someone she dislikes tomorrow. Once that match was settled, she wouldn’t be able to refuse.
Just as Wei Qingxue was in a panic, Lin Fan suddenly stopped and turned around.
"Aren’t you going to try persuading me one more time?" Lin Fan asked.
Wei Qingxue was delighted at the renewed hope and quickly said, "I understand your concerns, but rest assured that although we will be married, it’s only in name. You’ll be free to find a girlfriend, and I won’t interfere. When the time is right, we can divorce, and I will pay you in full, no delays. Here’s the marriage agreement I’ve drafted, take a look."
Wei Qingxue took a document from her handbag and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan glanced at it and couldn’t help but chuckle. Wei Qingxue had clearly put a lot of thought into this document—it was practically a set of three conditions.
"So, any issues?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Lin Fan cleared his throat: "Ahem, there are a few issues."
Wei Qingxue immediately asked, "What issues?"
"This marriage agreement, it’s just making three demands of me: first, I’m not allowed to touch you; second, I can’t interfere in your private life; third, I’m not allowed to initiate a divorce. Isn’t this all demanding things from me? This isn’t fair, right?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I wrote it this way to target my old classmate; it’s purely a business deal. Of course, I have to think about protecting myself. He doesn’t need protection; he’s just in it for the money."
Lin Fan said, "So, it can be modified?"
Wei Qingxue bit her lip: "I think it suits you just fine as well."
Lin Fan sweated: "This won’t do."
Wei Qingxue was puzzled: "What do you mean it won’t do?"
Lin Fan said, "Let me analyze it one by one. Not allowed to touch you, that’s understandable, but if you want to touch me, won’t I suffer a loss?"
Wei Qingxue blushed: "You’re overthinking it; I won’t want to touch you."
Besides, if she wanted to touch Lin Fan, how would Lin Fan be at a loss? He’d be scoring a great deal—she’s a stunning beauty.
Lin Fan said, "And second, not interfering in your private life—what does that even mean? Does it mean you’re allowed to date? As a man, I can wear any hat except a green hat."
Wei Qingxue said, "Isn’t it mutual non-interference? You can date too. If you chase after women, I’d be wearing the green hat too."
Lin Fan said, "Although it’s a fake marriage, legally I would be your husband. Wearing a green hat is absolutely out of the question. If this doesn’t change, then I’ll have to take my leave."
Seeing that he was serious, Wei Qingxue had to say, "Alright then, I’ll modify the agreement. During our marriage, I won’t get emotionally or physically involved with any other man, but you can still find a girlfriend. Are you satisfied now?"
Lin Fan nodded: "Now that’s more like it."
Wei Qingxue said, "Is there anything else?"
Lin Fan said, "There’s one last point. I can’t initiate a divorce. What if I meet someone I like and want to marry her, but can’t divorce you?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Of course, I’m faking marriage to deal with my family. If the timing isn’t right and you propose a divorce, what will happen to my plan? So, only I can propose a divorce."
To protect herself, she had to be meticulous.
Lin Fan said, "But, what if one day you like me and refuse to divorce me for life? Wouldn’t I be hanging myself on a single tree?"
Wei Qingxue burst into laughter: "Don’t worry, me liking you is impossible. Once the matter is resolved, we’ll immediately divorce, with no delays."
What a joke; how could she ever like a delivery guy? Although Lin Fan was indeed quite handsome and righteous, she didn’t think she would fall for him because they were not from the same world at all.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, there’s one more thing I want to add."
Wei Qingxue said, "Go ahead."
Lin Fan said, "After we get married, each of our properties remains our own, without any financial ties to the other person."
He didn’t want his billion-dollar assets to become shared assets with Wei Qingxue, and then have to give half to her in a divorce. Wouldn’t he be at a big loss?
Wei Qingxue laughed; how much property could a delivery guy have? Lin Fan was being too cautious.
But it also reminded her that her assets were definitely more substantial than Lin Fan’s, and this point would protect her own assets.
"You almost reminded me; fine, we’ll add this clause. Each of our properties remains under our own management, and upon divorce, no one gets a single cent from the other, except for the million-dollar fee I will give you," Wei Qingxue said.
Then, Wei Qingxue revised the marriage agreement according to Lin Fan’s requests until both parties were satisfied.
Wei Qingxue said, "Now can you go register our marriage with me?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes."
