Wei Qingxue said, "Don’t worry, I’ll keep my word. The million won’t be short by a cent. I’ll transfer you a 200,000 deposit right now."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need. After the matter is settled, you can give it to me all at once."
A mere million, Lin Fan didn’t even care about it. He would only have Wei Qingxue donate the money to charity later on.
Wei Qingxue was somewhat surprised. This delivery guy, Lin Fan, seemed not to care about the money?
Did he agree to help her not for the money?
Lin Fan really wasn’t in it for the money. If the system hadn’t given him this task, he would’ve stayed uninvolved.
After signing the marriage agreement, the two proceeded to the civil affairs bureau, where they quickly completed the marriage proceedings and received their marriage certificate.
"Ding!"
The system notification chimed in Lin Fan’s mind once again.
Lin Fan was delighted. This was the task completion notification. Generally, completing a task would earn a reward. Could it be that the reward system has been fixed?

chapters.title: Chapter 365 Slapping the Proud Fatty in the Face, You Are the Honest One
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 365 Slapping the Proud Fatty in the Face, You Are the Honest One
The wedding process was quite simple. The two of them signed a marriage agreement and then entered the civil affairs bureau, first lining up in the hall to take their wedding photos.
Lin Fan was still wearing his delivery uniform. He originally planned to change, but Wei Qingxue was afraid that Lin Fan might run away like her old classmate did. To avoid such possibilities, she simply didn’t let Lin Fan change clothes and pulled him into the civil affairs bureau.
There were quite a few couples coming to get married today.
At the entrance, Wei Qingxue said, "We’ll take our wedding photos soon. I’ll go to the restroom and quickly put on some makeup. You line up first, and don’t you dare run away."
Lin Fan replied, "Don’t worry, since I have agreed to marry you, how could I change my mind?"
So, Wei Qingxue hurried to the restroom.
Lin Fan lined up alone.
Soon several couples followed suit.
Standing behind Lin Fan was a chubby man, dressed quite fashionably, suggesting that his family might be well-off. The chubby man was holding a flashily dressed girl with an Internet Celebrity Face, who, with makeup, could barely be rated a 7.
The chubby man looked proud and scanned the room. Among the girls getting married today, his girlfriend was undoubtedly the most beautiful, unparalleled!
The chubby man couldn’t help but feel extremely proud, thinking he was really gaining face.
The chubby man noticed Lin Fan, the courier guy ahead, standing alone in line.
The chubby man frowned and patted Lin Fan on the shoulder, "Bro, you’re here to get married too?"
Lin Fan casually answered, "Yeah."
The chubby man teased, "Where’s your partner? Don’t tell me you’re here to marry yourself, with your right hand?"
Hearing this, people couldn’t help but laugh out loud. It was indeed strange for Lin Fan to be lining up alone.
The Internet Celebrity Face chuckled, covering her mouth dramatically, "Oh dear, you’re so funny."
Lin Fan said calmly, "She went to the restroom."
The chubby man chuckled, "Looking at you, a delivery guy, you must be really poor, yet someone is willing to marry you? Which girl is so blind?"
The Internet Celebrity Face giggled, "I guess those marrying him must either be very ugly and unable to find a partner, settling with such a poor guy, or they just want to find an honest man to marry after they’ve played around enough."
The chubby man sneered and asked Lin Fan, "Bro, which category do you fall into?"
Lin Fan frowned, thinking about how he seems to run into a few brainless folks everywhere. This chubby guy felt superior because of his little money.
Lin Fan said, "This seems to have nothing to do with you. We’re all strangers with no grudges against each other, minding our own business."
Lin Fan was too lazy to argue with such people.
Unexpectedly, after hearing Lin Fan say this, the chubby man became even more enthusiastic, "Looks like we’ve hit the mark, huh? Bro, you’re really pathetic, but there’s nothing you can do. You people at the bottom, being able to find a wife is already good enough; what qualifications do you have to be picky?"
The two laughed recklessly.
Lin Fan originally didn’t intend to pay them any mind. He had seen many such small-minded people over the years. But since they were so excessive, Lin Fan didn’t mind striking back a bit.
"The title of ’honest man,’ I think suits you better." Lin Fan smiled.
The chubby man’s smile froze. He didn’t expect Lin Fan to rebuke him.
After all, in the chubby man’s mind, Lin Fan either married an ugly woman or was an honest man. Lin Fan, knowing his place, would surely act like a Ninja Turtle, silently enduring their ridicule.
People like the chubby man had poor upbringing, bullying the weak and fearing the strong. Seeing Lin Fan as a courier, they figured he was easy to bully, so they humiliated him at will, thinking he wouldn’t dare do anything.
Who would have thought Lin Fan would talk back!
The chubby man was displeased, his face darkened, as he said harshly, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "You’re so arrogant just because you think you married a beauty, believing no one here is better looking than her, right?"
The chubby man said proudly, "So what if I did? Isn’t it true? Who here is better looking than my girlfriend? Step up!"
No one dared step up.
Indeed, no girl present had the confidence to claim to be more beautiful than the Internet Celebrity Face.
And the men also lowered their heads, not daring to make eye contact with the chubby man, feeling ashamed, as their girlfriends couldn’t compare in looks. How could they have the confidence?
Seeing this, the chubby man and the Internet Celebrity Face became even more smug.
"It’s a pity, though, looking beautiful but actually fake." Lin Fan suddenly said.
What?
Fake?
Everyone immediately looked up, glancing at the Internet Celebrity Face.
The Internet Celebrity Face was furious, her voice raised, "Who are you calling fake? Make yourself clear, don’t slander me!"
The chubby man also angrily said, "You brat, watch your mouth, seeking a beating, huh? Do you believe I’ll make you crawl out of here?"
Threatening Lin Fan? Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Indeed it’s fake. Her face has had at least three surgeries: a nose implant, facial bone shaving, and double eyelids, along with heavy foundation to achieve this look. Imagine if, after removing her makeup, her nose bridge is half as flat, her cheekbones twice as high, and she has monolid triangular eyes. Wouldn’t she be Zhong Wuyan reborn?"
Lin Fan had top-notch insight ability. Whether this Internet Celebrity Face had plastic surgery, he could tell at a glance with it activated.
Originally, he didn’t intend to attack her, but she was too much, so he wasn’t polite.
The Internet Celebrity Face was agitated, shrieking, "You’re slandering me! Dear, don’t believe him; he’s making it all up! Damn delivery guy, damn poor guy, I’ll sue you for defamation!"
The Internet Celebrity Face was so agitated because Lin Fan was right, dead right!
How could she not be agitated!
The chubby man was also angry, "You brat, you really are seeking a beating, daring to insult my girlfriend like that!"
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay if you don’t believe me. In fact, it’s normal that you don’t believe, or how else could you be called ’honest man’? You’re the world’s number one honest person!"
The chubby man was infuriated, "You’re really asking for it, get out of here!"
Lin Fan said, "Why should I get out? I’m just speaking the truth, kindly reminding you. If you wait until your child is born and it turns out to be an ugly duckling, you’ll be crying too late."
Such cases do exist, especially in a neighboring country of Huaxia known for plastic surgery. Couples, originally very ugly, become handsome guys and pretty girls after surgery and get married.
However, plastic surgery can only change their own features, not their genes. So, the children they give birth to become evidence of their surgeries... quite comical.
The chubby man couldn’t believe Lin Fan’s words. He was so angry that he was about to drive Lin Fan away.
"Sorry for keeping you waiting!"
Right at this moment, a voice came, and everyone saw a stunningly beautiful woman walking over.
Everyone’s eyes widened in amazement. She was incredibly beautiful, with long fluttering hair, an almond-shaped face, dressed in designer wear, exuding a fragrant aroma, unmistakably a rich and beautiful woman!
Everyone watched eagerly as this stunning rich woman walked quickly to Lin Fan.
"It’s almost our turn, let me tell you, you can’t regret it. We’re definitely getting married today." Wei Qingxue said with a smile, holding Lin Fan’s hand, as if afraid Lin Fan might back out.
What?
This delivery guy’s marriage partner is actually this stunning rich woman?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
The chubby man’s eyes almost popped out.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: I Will Find an Opportunity to Slap Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 366: I Will Find an Opportunity to Slap Her
Wei Qingxue hurried back from the restroom. To take wedding photos, she had to quickly tidy up her makeup but was also afraid Lin Fan might run away.
So as soon as she returned, she rushed to Lin Fan’s side.
Wei Qingxue was already a stunning beauty, and with light makeup, she looked unbelievably pretty, a definite 9-point goddess. Moreover, her outfit was outstanding, exuding the aura of a rich and beautiful woman.
Previously, the internet celebrity face was the most beautiful female at the venue, but now, in front of Wei Qingxue, she was like a sparrow meeting a phoenix, losing all her luster.
This showed just how beautiful Wei Qingxue was.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan was dressed in a cheap delivery outfit, just a delivery guy!
A rich and beautiful woman wants to marry a delivery man?
Everyone was stunned, unable to believe this was happening.
What on earth does Lin Fan have to marry a rich and beautiful woman?
Even more incredible was that this rich and beautiful woman was the one eager to marry Lin Fan, afraid he would leave...
The crowd was speechless, with the men expressing jealousy and envy towards Lin Fan. How could such a good thing happen?
A rich and beautiful woman pursuing him — this delivery guy is practically at the peak of his life, living the life every man dreams of.
"Wei, Miss Wei, are you Miss Wei!"
Suddenly, the fat man beside them blurted out in surprise, as he recognized Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue, the young lady of the Yun City Wei Family!
The young lady of the Wei Family is actually marrying a delivery guy?
Wei Qingxue glanced at the fat man and said, "Do you know me?"
The fat man quickly chuckled awkwardly: "Miss Wei, I had the honor to follow my father and attend a cocktail party of your company, and I met you once."
Wei Qingxue made a sound of understanding: "Who is your father?"
The fat man said: "My father is Xie Jin, the president of Daxie Company. I wonder if Miss Wei remembers?"
Wei Qingxue thought for a moment, recalling: "Oh, I remember now, so you’re Young Master Xie. Are you here to register today too?"
The fat man replied: "Exactly, let me introduce my fiancée to Miss Wei."
Wei Qingxue looked at the internet celebrity face, expressing surprise: "I think I’ve seen you somewhere before, but I can’t quite recall?"
The internet celebrity face said bashfully: "Miss Wei, you must have mistaken me for someone else."
But Wei Qingxue remembered: "Oh right, you’re called Little Wei, aren’t you? You had cosmetic surgery at my friend’s hospital. It was a successful case. Indeed, plastic surgery can change fate. Congratulations on finding Young Master Xie, the golden catch."
The internet celebrity face wanted to cry. Damn it, she never dreamed she would run into Wei Qingxue here!
The fat man’s face changed. Earlier, when Lin Fan said his fiancée had undergone plastic surgery, he didn’t believe it, thinking Lin Fan was just talking nonsense.
Now that Wei Qingxue said it, it was hard not to believe.
"Did you really have plastic surgery?" the fat man looked at the internet celebrity face, asking in a deep voice.
The internet celebrity face wanted to deny it but didn’t dare to, because denying would mean challenging Wei Qingxue, and it would only take a phone call for Wei Qingxue to prove the plastic surgery.
The fat man saw the internet celebrity face didn’t deny it and realized the situation was bad. His fiancée really had plastic surgery and deceived him!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh: "Of course it’s true, honest man."
The term "honest man" carried a teasing tone, making the fat man’s self-esteem feel greatly insulted. In a fit of anger, he raised his hand and slapped her.
Slap!
A heavy slap landed on the fiancée’s face.
An amazing thing happened. The fat man used too much force, and this slap struck the internet celebrity face’s nose.
The internet celebrity’s nose instantly became crooked!
It really went crooked. The internet celebrity face had undergone rhinoplasty, and the slap dislodged the implant.
In turn, the internet celebrity face’s face became distorted.
Everyone was shocked, with timider individuals stepping back a few paces.
"Ah!"
The fat man was also startled and screamed as if he had seen a ghost. The current appearance of the internet celebrity face did indeed resemble that of a ghost, extremely terrifying.
The internet celebrity face was initially stunned by the hit. When she came to her senses and realized her nose was crooked, her expression paled.
"Ah!"
The internet celebrity face let out a scream, quickly covered her nose with her hands, turned around, and fled out of the civil affairs bureau. For someone who pursued beauty through surgery, the most unacceptable thing was naturally becoming ugly.
Lin Fan patted the fat man’s shoulder: "Honest man, you’re welcome."
The fat man’s face turned red with embarrassment. This was incredibly humiliating, embarrassing to an extreme. He had no face left to stay and hurriedly fled as well.
He didn’t even dare to respond to Lin Fan, since Lin Fan was Miss Wei’s fiancé, and he didn’t dare to provoke him.
He already regretted provoking Lin Fan earlier. If they hadn’t been so arrogant and offended Lin Fan, they wouldn’t have ended up like this. It was indeed a case of trying to show off and getting humiliated instead.
Having dealt with the fat man, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue went for the photo shoot.
"How was my performance just now?" Wei Qingxue asked with a smile.
It turned out that when she returned, she noticed the confrontation between Lin Fan and the fat man. She deliberately let everyone know that she was going to marry Lin Fan, which was undoubtedly a resounding slap in the face for the fat man.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Luckily, you recognized the internet celebrity face, helping authenticate that she had plastic surgery."
Wei Qingxue, curious, asked: "If I hadn’t helped you just now, what would you have done?"
Lin Fan said, "I would have found an opportunity to slap her and bring out the implant."
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but giggle. Lin Fan was quite harsh, but she found him interesting. Lin Fan was just the kind of tough person she needed to deal with her family, so a bit of harshness was good.
Lin Fan, looking at her smile, found himself slightly dazed. This little wife was so beautiful, and even if it was a fake wife, who couldn’t be touched, she was still pleasant to look at.
Marrying her was worthwhile, especially since it was a system task.
Then, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue took their wedding photos. The two looked surprisingly well-matched as a handsome man and a beautiful woman, even though Lin Fan’s delivery outfit was somewhat eye-catching.
After receiving the certificate photos, the two followed the process to complete the marriage registration and successfully received their marriage certificates.
Outside the civil affairs bureau.
Wei Qingxue said, "We are now legally married. Tomorrow there’s a family gathering, and they’re arranging a match for me, so come help me."
Lin Fan readily agreed: "Sure, give me the time and place, I’ll be there on time."
"Tomorrow at ten in the morning, at the Fengming Grand Hotel."
Wei Qingxue said, "I have to get back to the company now, so I won’t say more. See you tomorrow."
Wei Qingxue walked a few steps, paused, turned back, and gave a sweet smile: "Lin Fan, thank you."
Then she hurried off.
Lin Fan, watching her back, felt a sense of unreality. He had merely come to deliver a package and ended up getting a wife. What exactly was the system’s intention in requiring him to marry Wei Qingxue?
At this moment, the system displayed:
"Task: Marry Wei Qingxue.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 100/100"
"Ding!"
The system’s voice rang out.
"Congratulations to the host for completing the task of marrying the rich and beautiful Wei Qingxue and receiving a special reward."

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Wei Family Gathering, Son-in-law Makes an Appearance
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 367: Wei Family Gathering, Son-in-law Makes an Appearance
Lin Fan heard the system prompt, completed the marriage task, and received a special reward, which made him extremely happy.
It seems the system bug has finally been fixed. Not only are the task functions working, but the reward functions are too! This means that starting tomorrow, he can resume receiving the system’s daily sign-in rewards.
"Ding!"
"A special reward has been issued. Please check your account."
The system’s voice sounded and then went silent.
Lin Fan was puzzled. What on earth did the system reward him with?
Ding dong!
Then, Lin Fan received a text message notification. He took out his phone to take a look.
"Your account ending in 3245 has received a deposit of 5,000,000.00 Huaxia Coins..."
Lin Fan broke into a cold sweat: "What the heck, still 5 million! This is not how you play the game!"
Clearly, the system’s reward function is still bugged, because there’s no way a special reward from the system should be 5 million in cash. However, due to the bug, all rewards, including the daily sign-in reward and the special reward, are uniformly turned into a 5 million cash reward...
Who knows when this bug will be fixed.
Lin Fan is now tired of receiving money. 5 million every day; it’s really boring. He wishes for some other kind of reward.
Lin Fan smirked, then went on to continue delivering packages.
Nobody knew that the new riches-to-riches tycoon of Yun City, while on the way to deliver packages, happened to get married and found himself a rich and beautiful wife.
And this rich and beautiful wife never knew he was the richest man in Yun City; she only knew of him as a courier.
Lin Fan did not want to reveal his true identity in front of the Wei Family, so the next day, Lin Fan still dressed like a courier to attend the Wei Family gathering at the Fengming Grand Hotel.
Fengming Grand Hotel.
A five-star hotel where every guest is either wealthy or noble. The Yun City Wei Family, while not very large, is a decently powerful second-tier family.
The Wei Family chose to gather at the Fengming Grand Hotel, likely not for a simple reason but rather for something important.
As the time approached ten o’clock, members of the Wei Family had begun arriving one after another. The hotel’s parking lot was momentarily filled with many luxury cars.
Although the Wei Family is a second-tier family, they have a thriving number of members. Unfortunately, most of them are good-for-nothings and cannot be relied upon.
Wei Qingxue, among the young generation of the family, is considered an outstanding talent, chosen to become the CEO of the family company at a young age.
At this time, other members of the Wei Family gathered at the hotel entrance. There were men and women, young and old, each dressed glamorously.
However, neither Elder Wei nor Wei Qingxue, the CEO of the Wei Family company, had arrived yet, so they needed to wait there to greet them.
"They’re here!"
At this moment, someone said.
A black luxury car came driving up, and everyone in the Wei Family recognized it as Elder Wei’s special car.
As the car stopped, the first person to get out was an exceptionally beautiful woman with fair skin.
With long hair flowing over her shoulders, an oval face, a tall and slender figure, with curves in all the right places, wearing a slightly mature professional outfit, she exuded an allure men found hard to resist.
Wei Qingxue, the young CEO of the Wei Family company, and the outstanding figure among the young generation of the Wei Family!
Everyone was instantly captivated by Wei Qingxue, but among them, there were some unfriendly gazes, particularly from a young man with triangular eyes.
After getting out of the car, Wei Qingxue walked to the back seat, helped open the door, and assisted an old man in getting out.
The old man had white hair, looked in his seventies or eighties but was in great spirits, with bright eyes and a rosy complexion, clearly showing he was a decisive and bold person when young.
This was Elder Wei, named Wei Daxun, who single-handedly founded the Wei Family Company back then, leading the Wei Family to rise to a second-tier family. Until today, Elder Wei still controlled the major affairs of the Wei Family Company.
"Grandpa’s here!"
The members of the Wei Family all showed a respectful demeanor, stepping forward to greet him, bowing to Elder Wei and offering their respects.
Supported by Wei Qingxue, Elder Wei made his way up.
Elder Wei glanced at everyone, asking, "Have any distinguished guests of the Ma Family arrived?"
A middle-aged lady answered, "They have not yet arrived."
This middle-aged lady was none other than Wei Qingxue’s mother, named Li Xueyan.
Li Xueyan said, "Elder, the room is ready. Shall I assist you in getting inside first?"
Elder Wei glanced at her: "Do you think I’m too old to stand steady or unable to walk?"
Li Xueyan’s face turned pale with fright, lowering her head without daring to make a sound, it’s clear Elder Wei was not very pleased with her.
Elder Wei said, "Distinguished guests must not be neglected; I’ll wait here in person!"
At this time, the young man with triangular eyes eagerly brought over a chair.
"Grandpa, I just asked for a chair; you can sit here while waiting," the young man said flatteringly. He was the one who had earlier given Wei Qingxue unfriendly looks.
Elder Wei reached out to touch the young man’s head, smiling lovingly: "You’re always so thoughtful, Little Tang."
This young man was named Wei Tang, Wei Qingxue’s cousin, who had competed with Wei Qingxue for the CEO position in the past but had lost. He was eloquent and quite favored by Elder Wei.
Just after Elder Wei sat down, suddenly, a roaring sound of an engine came from not too far away.
It immediately attracted everyone’s attention.
They saw a flashy sports car speeding over, quickly stopping at the entrance of the hotel.
Everyone was amazed; this car was just too cool!
"Someone actually bought this car!"
Wei Tang exclaimed. He was a rich kid who played with cars and was quite familiar with luxury cars. This Ferrari sports car was valued at 20 million!
Of course, this price alone wasn’t necessarily shocking, but owning this sports car carried a unique prestige.
There are rumors that to buy this Ferrari sports car, one must meet three criteria: first, a net worth of over 100 million, second, this must be their first Ferrari purchase, and third, they must be able to prove they have the funds to buy five of the same Ferrari.
These three requirements were enough to filter out many buyers, and anyone who could get this car was undoubtedly a wealthy individual with cash assets exceeding hundreds of millions.
Now, this car appeared right in front of them, like something out of a dream.
Which wealthy individual had bought it?
In the anticipating eyes of the crowd, the sports car’s doors lifted up, and a person stepped out from the car.
A handsome young man!
"It’s Ma Family’s young master, Ma Jialiang!"
"Oh my gosh, he’s so handsome!"
"I heard he’s here to meet Sister Qingxue for a date; I’m so envious of Sister Qingxue!"
"If only I could marry him. Sister Qingxue is so lucky, why isn’t it me?"
The members of the Wei Family began to discuss, all captivated by this rich young man, especially the young women of the Wei Family, envying and feeling jealous of Wei Qingxue.
This Mr. Ma Jialiang from the Ma Family certainly made an impressive entrance.
However, Wei Qingxue remained indifferent.
What is meant to happen will happen. Today, her family arranged for her to meet this Ma Jialiang. Her grandpa’s intention was for the Wei and Ma families to form an alliance through marriage.
But she had no interest whatsoever in this Ma Jialiang.
She was only hoping for Lin Fan to come over. Looking at her watch, it was almost ten o’clock; Lin Fan should be arriving.
Lin Fan could be seen, dressed in his courier uniform, riding a worn-out electric scooter, leisurely making his way over.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: Because I Am Already Married
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 368: Because I Am Already Married
The Yun City Wei Family is having a dinner at Fengming Grand Hotel, but today’s gathering isn’t the main purpose; Elder Wei is here to welcome distinguished guests.
Young Master Ma from the Ma Family, Ma Jialiang, has arrived, making quite an entrance with a sports car worth 20 million, leaving the Wei Family in awe.
The Wei Family was quite impressed with Ma Jialiang; many of the young female members had flushed faces, wishing they could marry him.
Only Wei Qingxue didn’t spare Ma Jialiang a glance.
Logically, Ma Jialiang is a Rich Second Generation, handsome and should be very popular among females, but Wei Qingxue doesn’t like him?
To avoid the arranged marriage with Ma Jialiang, Wei Qingxue even came up with the idea of a fake marriage with Lin Fan, leaving everyone baffled about her plight.
Elder Wei, however, seems oblivious to Wei Qingxue’s thoughts. He was quite satisfied with Ma Jialiang, but his satisfaction wasn’t with Ma Jialiang’s looks or his car, but with the Ma Family behind him.
The Ma Family, a billion-worth family in Yun City, though currently a second-rate family, has been rapidly growing and has a good chance of becoming a top-tier family.
Elder Wei is optimistic about the Ma Family’s prospects, clearly seen from Ma Jialiang’s luxury car. The Ma Family indeed flaunts great wealth.
Elder Wei is keen on a marriage alliance with the Ma Family, hoping that with their support, the Wei Family can also become a top-tier family.
At this moment, another black luxury car arrives, stopping outside the hotel.
Two people step out.
A stout middle-aged man, in a full suit, with an authoritative gaze, obviously no ordinary person, is accompanied by a middle-aged man who seems to be his assistant.
Seeing this elderly man, the Wei family was immediately delighted, and Elder Wei stood up at once.
This stout middle-aged man is the current Patriarch of the Ma Family, Ma Yunde.
"Finally, Nephew Ma is here," Elder Wei said, smiling and approaching.
Ma Yunde chuckled, "I wouldn’t dare trouble Elder Wei to welcome me personally; I’m humbled and unworthy."
Elder Wei said, "There’s nothing unworthy about it. Our Wei Family is looking forward to becoming in-laws with the Ma Family."
Upon hearing this, everyone laughed.
Only Wei Qingxue did not smile.
Elder Wei laughed, "Nephew Ma, shall we go inside and talk?"
"Alright." Ma Yunde said, then extended his hand to assist Elder Wei as they headed inside the hotel.
Elder Wei turned back and said to Wei Qingxue, "Qingxue, accompany Jia Liang inside. Do you remember Jia Liang? You had a good relationship when you were children."
Wei Qingxue responded with an indifferent "Oh."
Ma Jialiang looked at Wei Qingxue, his eyes sparkling, stepping closer he said with a smile, "Indeed, Little Sister Qingxue and I had a great connection; not having seen each other for years, she’s grown more beautiful."
The Wei Family and Ma Family have been family friends, and Wei Qingxue and Ma Jialiang have known each other since childhood, their bond almost like siblings back then.
Wei Qingxue used to see Ma Jialiang as an elder brother, but at some point, she began to resent him...
After Ma Jialiang got a bit older, he was sent abroad for studies and has recently graduated and returned.
His first significant task upon returning was to marry Wei Qingxue.
For both the Wei and Ma Families, this was a crucial matter.
Elder Wei wanted Wei Qingxue to accompany Ma Jialiang, to get to know each other better and build rapport.
Wei Qingxue dared not go against her grandfather’s wishes, and reluctantly agreed to give Ma Yunde face as well.
From the moment Ma Jialiang arrived, his gaze was fixed on Wei Qingxue, and undeniably, among the young members of the Wei Family, Wei Qingxue was the most stunning, able to capture attention wherever she stood.
Seeing this, the young females of the Wei Family couldn’t help feeling displeased; Ma Jialiang hadn’t glanced at them at all, and they blamed Wei Qingxue for stealing the limelight!
For a moment, they were quite envious of Wei Qingxue, but given the situation, they didn’t dare show their discontent.
Ma Yunde looked at Ma Jialiang, noticing that his son was quite pleased with Wei Qingxue.
Ma Yunde laughed, "Niece Qingxue, don’t be shy. You’ll soon be the Ma Family’s daughter-in-law. You haven’t met for so many years, have a chat with Jia Liang to reconnect."
Elder Wei laughed heartily, "Qingxue, your Uncle Ma is right, I think so too."
Ma Jialiang, feeling joyful about being able to marry Wei Qingxue, was very content and eagerly wanted the marriage to happen soon, so he could claim Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue found Ma Jialiang’s gaze unbearable, the intensity of it was as if he wished to devour her immediately.
Originally, Wei Qingxue planned to wait until Lin Fan arrived to make her announcement.
But she couldn’t hold back now.
"Sorry, Grandpa, Uncle Ma, I can’t possibly marry him," Wei Qingxue said, without hesitation.
What?
Her words left everyone shocked.
Wei Qingxue outright rejected the proposed marriage?
Elder Wei and the Ma father and son, who had been smiling, were taken aback, their smiles freezing, making the Ma father and son appear somewhat embarrassed.
"Qingxue, what are you saying? How did Grandpa talk to you this morning?" Elder Wei said angrily.
This morning, Elder Wei had already called Wei Qingxue over to explain the benefits and persuade her to accept the marriage proposal with the Ma Family.
Elder Wei thought he had convinced Wei Qingxue, so he confidently brought her along, not expecting that even before entering the hotel, Wei Qingxue would reject the proposal flatly!
Ma Yunde’s expression turned somewhat sour, "Elder Wei, what is happening here?"
Elder Wei hurriedly replied, "Nephew Ma, don’t mind her, Qingxue is just momentarily confused."
Ma Jialiang became worried, "Little Sister Qingxue, why can’t you marry me?"
The Wei Family members began to talk among themselves.
"No way, she rejected the proposal!"
"Even Young Master Ma was turned down? What is she thinking!"
"If she doesn’t want him, let me have him."
"Exactly, I’d love to marry Young Master Ma."
The discussions continued, and the young female members of the Wei Family couldn’t help but mock, thinking Wei Qingxue was irrational.
Wei Qingxue said, "Sorry, Grandpa, I understand your concern, and I remember everything you said, but I truly can’t marry him."
Ma Yunde’s expression worsened as it was clear Wei Qingxue was resolute.
Elder Wei, enraged, said, "Qingxue, give a reason!"
Wei Qingxue said, "I can’t marry him because I’m already married!"
Ah?
Her words left everyone astounded.
Could it be that Wei Qingxue is married?
Wei Qingxue’s mother, Li Xueyan, grew anxious and said, "Qingxue, what are you talking about? Food can be eaten recklessly, but words must be chosen wisely! How did you get married, when did you get married, who did you marry?"
At this moment, Lin Fan was seen driving slowly towards them on an electric scooter.
Wei Qingxue immediately pointed and said, "I married him."
Everyone then looked at Lin Fan, all of them stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: Wife, I’m Not Late
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 369: Wife, I’m Not Late
Wei Qingxue pointed at Lin Fan, claiming she was married to him.
But to everyone’s eyes, Lin Fan was just a passing delivery guy.
"Qingxue, do you know what you’re saying? You’re married to this delivery man?" Li Xueyan said sweaty, clearly disbelieving Wei Qingxue and thinking Wei Qingxue was lying.
"Little Sister Qingxue, even if you don’t want to marry me, find a more reliable excuse. You randomly point at a delivery guy and call him your husband?" Ma Jialiang laughed angrily.
The Wei Family members all snickered. Naturally, none of them believed it, thinking Wei Qingxue was too ridiculous.
"Doesn’t Wei Qingxue have something wrong with her brain?"
"Does she think we’ll believe she married a delivery guy?"
"Does she really not want to marry Young Master Ma?"
Ma Yunde sneered, "Niece Qingxue, what’s really going on? If you won’t marry Jia Liang, just say so rather than using such a poor excuse, embarrassing us all."
Elder Wei was livid, feeling so ashamed that Wei Qingxue behaved so disrespectfully in front of Ma Family members!
He had forcefully made Wei Qingxue the Company’s CEO against opposition, and she was once his pride, but now he’s extremely disappointed in her.
The triangular eyes of Wei Tang saw this and immediately stirred trouble: "Grandfather, Wei Qingxue’s actions make one wonder about her intentions. I reckon she doesn’t want to work anymore."
Wei Qingxue said coldly, "Wei Tang, stop stirring trouble here. I’ll explain myself to Grandfather. Do I need you to butt in?"
Wei Tang chuckled, "Go ahead and talk. I want to see what you’re up to."
Wei Qingxue said, "I’m not lying to you. I didn’t randomly point to someone to lie. I invited him here—he’s my husband. Lin Fan, over here!"
Wei Qingxue waved to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan parked his bike at the time, saw Wei Qingxue wave, and walked over.
"Dear Wife, I’m here, right at ten o’clock, not late." Lin Fan said with a smile as he walked to Wei Qingxue.
Everyone froze.
This delivery guy actually knew Wei Qingxue and called her "Dear Wife" right away?
Wei Qingxue heard Lin Fan call her that, also feeling embarrassed. Although she was married to Lin Fan, they had no feelings for each other, and this was the first time she heard this address.
"Lin Fan, come over here. Tell everyone we’re married." Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan knew today’s task was to be Wei Qingxue’s shield.
Lin Fan tried his best to be a dutiful shield, glanced at everyone, and smiled: "Hello everyone, I am Qingxue’s husband, my name is Lin Fan."
Everyone exchanged confused looks—what the heck? Wei Qingxue really got married to a delivery guy?
"No, this can’t be true!" Li Xueyan couldn’t help but cry out.
If this was true, it would be a huge shock she couldn’t accept. Based on "mother by her daughter," Wei Qingxue being the Company’s CEO also raised her status in the Wei Family.
If Wei Qingxue openly opposed the familial marriage, it was undoubtedly a challenge to Elder Wei. It was uncertain if she could keep the CEO position.
Li Xueyan couldn’t accept this as true, nor did she believe it was true.
Similarly disbelieving was Ma Jialiang: "Impossible, Little Sister Qingxue, how could you marry a delivery man?"
Lin Fan corrected him, "Sorry, it’s delivery. I don’t deliver food anymore."
Ma Jialiang glanced at Lin Fan, not even bothering to talk to him, and said, "Little Sister Qingxue, even if you’re lying, find a reliable one. You picked a random smelly delivery... messengering person, it’s clearly fake!"
Elder Wei knocked his cane: "Enough, Qingxue, you are simply making a fuss! Stop this nonsense, even joking should have limits, how rude in front of Uncle Ma!"
Elder Wei, with wisdom from countless experiences, didn’t believe Wei Qingxue truly married a delivery guy, likely she found someone to cope temporarily, but Elder Wei’s words suggested Qin Xue was joking, trying to downplay the situation without offending Ma Yunde.
He only hoped Wei Qingxue would come to her senses, taking the way out.
Seeing everyone still disbelieving her marriage to Lin Fan, Wei Qingxue couldn’t be bothered to say more.
She instantly took the marriage certificate from her bag and said, "I’m not lying. Here is our marriage certificate."
Oh god, there’s even a marriage certificate!
Elder Wei took the marriage certificate, verified it, and threw it on the ground shaking with anger: "Nonsense, absurd, Wei Qingxue, you are simply absurd!"
It seemed the marriage certificate was real.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
"Oh! I’m fainting." Li Xueyan’s vision went black, nearly passed out, luckily someone beside her caught her.
Ma Jialiang was flabbergasted: "Married, really married?"
Lin Fan quickly stepped forward, bent over to pick up the marriage certificate, smiled, and said, "Such a precious thing as a marriage certificate shouldn’t be thrown around, it’s bad if it gets dirty."
Then Lin Fan returned the marriage certificate to Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue said, "Everyone should believe me now. I am married to Lin Fan, already a married woman, so I can’t marry anyone else. Grandfather, if our Wei Family really wants a marriage alliance with the Ma Family, perhaps consider others in the clan. I must take my leave now, Lin Fan, let’s go."
Elder Wei was a man experienced with big scenes.
He knew well that once Wei Qingxue left today, the marital alliance with the Ma Family would essentially be over.
Even if Wei Qingxue was truly married, she couldn’t be allowed to leave.
"Hold on!"
Elder Wei quickly composed himself and stopped Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue had to pause.
Elder Wei then turned to Ma Yunde, smiling apologetically: "Dear nephew, today is really too rude, but I hope for my sake, dear nephew, don’t be upset yet, whatever it is we can discuss inside, can we?"
Ma Yunde was indeed angry; Wei Qingxue was simply absurd, not only losing face for the Wei Family but also for Ma Yunde.
But considering Elder Wei’s face, he temporarily didn’t want to turn harsh: "Fine, let’s talk inside."
Elder Wei laughed: "Great, dear nephew, please. Qingxue, you come in too."
Having exposed her relationship with Lin Fan, Wei Qingxue had nothing left to fear. She bit her lip and said, "Alright."
Thus everyone gradually entered the hotel.
Ma Jialiang approached Wei Qingxue.
"Little Sister Qingxue, though you’re married, I won’t give up on you. I’ve prepared a gift for you today—get ready to be surprised." Ma Jialiang said with a smile.
This fellow adjusted quickly, already accepting Wei Qingxue’s marriage as reality.
Wei Qingxue coldly replied with an "oh," without speaking more.
Seeing him openly wooing Wei Qingxue in front of him as if Lin Fan didn’t exist, Lin Fan chuckled quietly.
"You’re Young Master Ma, right? What gift did you prepare for my wife? Can I see?" Lin Fan said with a chuckle.
Ma Jialiang sneered: "What’s it got to do with you?"
Lin Fan said, "Of course it matters, she’s my wife."

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Wei Qingxue’s Dilemma, Huge Financial Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 370: Wei Qingxue’s Dilemma, Huge Financial Crisis
"She’s my wife."
This sentence made Ma Jialiang feel a wave of heart palpitations.
Ma Jialiang really couldn’t understand why Wei Qingxue would marry Lin Fan, someone from the lower rungs of society, a delivery person; is Wei Qingxue out of her mind!
Ma Jialiang looked down on Lin Fan from the bottom of his heart. He believed that Wei Qingxue would eventually divorce Lin Fan because they were mismatched in social status, destined not to last long, so he wouldn’t give up pursuing Wei Qingxue.
He, a distinguished Ma Family son, defeating a delivery person, should be as easy as pie.
Ma Jialiang sneered, "Kid, don’t get too full of yourself..."
Wei Qingxue interrupted Ma Jialiang, "I have something to say to my husband, you head inside first."
My husband!
These words really grated on the ears of Ma Jialiang; his words were choked up, and he glared at Lin Fan before walking away sulkily.
Lin Fan smiled, "Dear wife, did I do okay just now?"
Wei Qingxue blushed, "Don’t call me that, it’s so embarrassing."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, dear wife."
Wei Qingxue broke into a sweat, truly helpless against Lin Fan, she had no choice but to let it go, saying, "Grandpa kept me here; this is likely a trap; we absolutely can’t let anything slip."
Lin Fan seriously said, "Don’t worry, dear wife, I’ve got it covered."
A private room in the hotel.
Several tables were set, and the Wei family members gradually seated themselves, Elder Wei accompanied the Ma family father and son at the main table, along with some of the Wei family’s elder members.
The other younger generations were scattered at different tables.
Between Ma Jialiang and Li Xueyan, only one seat was left empty.
Seeing Wei Qingxue come in, Li Xueyan immediately beckoned to Wei Qingxue, "Qingxue, come sit here."
Ma Jialiang smiled happily.
Wei Qingxue hesitated for a moment but still walked over.
Lin Fan saw this and followed suit.
"Haha, everyone move a bit, make space for me." Lin Fan said.
No one moved.
"Do you have any manners, this is all elders, the seats are full, go sit elsewhere." Li Xueyan said with a stern face, in her view, Lin Fan’s actions were very disgraceful.
Moreover, she really disliked this live-in son-in-law; how could a delivery person be worthy of Wei Qingxue!
Lin Fan chuckled, "Ma Jialiang is not my elder; he is an outsider sitting here, I am Qingxue’s husband, why can’t I sit?"
"Rascal!" Li Xueyan got angry, "Jialiang is today’s honored guest, what sort of thing are you!"
Upon hearing this, those around burst into covert laughter.
Elder Wei wasn’t too pleased, "Everyone quiet down, there’s a distinguished guest here, don’t embarrass us, Lin Fan, right, why don’t you sit at the table next door."
Ma Yunde laughed lightly, "Elder Wei, what’s the deal here, Qingxue niece kept everyone in the dark, and married this delivery man?"
There was a hint of disdain in Ma Yunde’s words; in his eyes, Lin Fan, a delivery man, was indeed like an ant.
Elder Wei felt a bit awkward, "Pardon me, dear nephew, I will certainly provide an explanation for you."
Wei Qingxue said at this point, "Lin Fan, it’s alright, go sit next to them."
Ma Jialiang looked at Lin Fan proudly; so what if Lin Fan was Wei Qingxue’s husband, wasn’t he still the one sitting with her.
Since Wei Qingxue spoke, Lin Fan didn’t say much more.
"Alright, I will do as you say." Lin Fan said, then walked over to sit at the neighboring table; though he couldn’t sit with Wei Qingxue, this spot was still close to her.
Next to Lin Fan sat a little beauty, probably Wei Qingxue’s cousin, who looked at Lin Fan with disdain, wanting very much to change seats, but since Elder Wei had spoken, she dared not act rashly and just kept rolling her eyes at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "Little sister-in-law, do you have an eye condition, should you see a doctor?"
The little beauty almost got enraged but, concerned about the situation, dared not retort, simply turned her face away, ignoring Lin Fan.
Wei Tang was sitting opposite Lin Fan, looked at him with schadenfreude.
At this point, the server had already brought the dishes.
Over at the main table, Ma Jialiang proactively served Wei Qingxue dishes, showing great diligence.
Wei Qingxue remained cold throughout, showing no reaction.
Lin Fan observed this, but acted as if he hadn’t noticed, focusing on eating his meal.
"Delivery trash, your wife is sitting with another man, you must be feeling humiliated, right?" Wei Tang suddenly chuckled.
Whoosh!
Lin Fan was eating, but a mouthful of rice sprayed out, covering Wei Tang.
"You!"
Wei Tang jumped up, almost furious.
"Sorry, your joke was so funny, it literally made me spit rice," Lin Fan laughed, apologizing.
Wei Tang was about to burst into curses.
Elder Wei spoke up from across, "What’s going on, there’s a guest here, what’s all this noise?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Elder Wei, this brother was telling jokes, too funny, I couldn’t help myself for a moment."
Elder Wei glared at Lin Fan, given his status, it wasn’t appropriate to reprimand Lin Fan over such a trivial matter on the spot, helpless he said, "Little Tang, hurry and clean yourself up."
"Yes, grandpa." Wei Tang refrained from shouting at Lin Fan, swallowed his anger, glared fiercely at Lin Fan, then ran out.
Lin Fan continued to eat and drink as if nobody was there.
The little beauty beside him rolled eyes to the heavens; this waste, how could he be so presumptuous, simply brazenly arrogant.
"Really courting death, do you know who you’ve offended, what good does it do for you?" The little beauty couldn’t help but mutter.
Lin Fan said, "Who is he?"
The little beauty replied, "He’s called Wei Tang, the Crown Prince of our Wei Family, grandpa’s favorite grandson. He always clashes with your wife, as they competed for the CEO of the company, and he lost. You’ve offended him, just wait to be dealt with!"
Lin Fan oh-ed, so Wei Tang always had a conflict with Wei Qingxue, then spraying him with rice was just perfect.
Lin Fan laughed, "Thank you little sister-in-law for reminding me; by the way, what’s your name, little sister-in-law?"
The little beauty glared at him, "You think you are worthy of knowing my name?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Little sister-in-law, your jokes are funny too, aren’t you afraid I’ll spray rice on you?"
"Crazy!" The little beauty huffed, truly fearing Lin Fan would spray rice on her, she shut up.
"Everyone quiet down," Elder Wei spoke up, "Today I gathered you all here to announce something important."
The main issue has come!
Everyone paused their chopsticks, and the room quieted down immediately.
Elder Wei said, "Here’s the thing, our Wei Family faced a business project failure last year, resulting in financial difficulties for the company, urgently needing capital injection. I’m announcing this to you all for the first time, even Qingxue wasn’t informed."
What?
The Wei family members upon hearing this news changed expressions.
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but say, "Grandpa, what project failed, why am I unaware?"
Elder Wei said, "Our Hang City project failed, and incurred huge losses. The company’s board has already been informed, I deliberately kept it from you, originally thought of sparing you the concern, I planned to solve it myself, but after utilizing many connections, I still can’t fill this financial hole."
Wei Qingxue turned pale, "The Hang City project... failed?"
The news was too shocking for her, because the Hang City project was initially spearheaded by her.

chapters.title: Chapter 371: Who Said I Agreed?
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 371: Who Said I Agreed?
Elder Wei chuckled, "Don’t worry, I’ve found a way to solve the funding issue."
Wei Qingxue exclaimed in surprise, "Really?"
Elder Wei glanced at Ma Yunde, "Thankfully, Uncle Ma agreed to lend a hand."
The Ma Family!
Wei Qingxue’s smile froze; it was the Ma Family helping the Wei Family!
Elder Wei said, "Yunde is a benefactor to our Wei Family. On behalf of the Wei Family, I’d like to toast Yunde, my virtuous nephew."
As he spoke, Elder Wei raised his wine glass.
Ma Yunde smiled, "Our Ma Family and the Wei Family have been family friends. Back when I first started my business, Elder Wei offered guidance. Today, I consider this as repaying the favor to the elder."
Elder Wei laughed, "I remember saying at our first meeting, Yunde, that you would accomplish great things, and you have exceeded my expectations."
For the funds, Elder Wei was even flattering a younger generation.
Ma Yunde replied, "Elder Wei, you overpraise me. Let’s skip the pleasantries. The money to aid the Wei Family is ready and can be given at any time. I don’t intend to take it back; consider it a gift. However, the current situation is a bit awkward, and I trust you understand my meaning."
Elder Wei said, "I understand. We are grateful for Jia Liang’s affection for our Qingxue. Her marrying into the Ma Family is indeed her fortune. Of course, I fully support it, though I’m worried your family might mind her previous marriage."
Ma Yunde chuckled, "I am quite open-minded. It doesn’t matter if a woman was married before. What’s important is that my son likes her. I know Qingxue is an exceptional talent. If she marries into the Ma Family, she would undoubtedly become a virtuous wife. This 1 billion is worth spending!"
Elder Wei said, "With you saying this, Yunde, I am relieved."
Ma Yunde looked at Wei Qingxue, "Niece Qingxue, even though you are married, I hope you consider remarrying into the Ma Family. The Ma Family will certainly not mistreat you."
Ma Yunde’s meaning was clear; he could invest in the Wei Family, but the money was a bridal gift that would be forfeited if Wei Qingxue did not marry into the Ma Family.
Wei Qingxue remained silent, her face expressionless, as if she hadn’t recovered from the blow of the project’s failure.
So much so that she barely paid attention when they mentioned her remarrying.
Elder Wei looked at Wei Qingxue, saying, "Qingxue, thank your Uncle Ma quickly. You understand our Wei Family’s predicament now, and you should know what the right thing to do is. Fortunately, your Uncle Ma doesn’t mind your previous marriage. I don’t care why you married this delivery man before; it’s time to end this absurd marriage."
Elder Wei’s words cornered Wei Qingxue into a position with no retreat.
As the saying goes, experience comes with age. Elder Wei was indeed furious upon learning of Wei Qingxue’s marriage, but Qingxue was key to today, and he needed to turn the tide.
He had already decided immediately to force Wei Qingxue to remarry.
The burden of saving the company now rested on Wei Qingxue’s shoulders. Combined with Hang City’s project, which was her responsibility, she had little choice but to carry the consequences.
Wei Qingxue was under immense pressure.
On one hand, she didn’t want to marry Ma Jialiang, having gone as far as marrying Lin Fan to avoid it, which shows her genuine aversion to the matter.
On the other hand, her sense of responsibility made her unable to refuse; she had to help the company overcome its difficulties.
Everyone looked at Wei Qingxue, waiting for her response.
Some people were already getting impatient.
"She wouldn’t refuse to remarry, would she?"
"Not remarry? That would be too selfish,"
"Hurry up and agree. If not for yourself, think about us; if the company goes under, we’re all affected!"
"What’s she hesitating for?"
The crowd began voicing their discontent.
Ma Yunde’s eyes flashed with a different color, "Elder Wei, there won’t be any issues with Qingxue’s remarriage, will there?"
Elder Wei hurriedly said, "No issue, Yunde, don’t be offended. My granddaughter is not typically one for pleasantries; she has been that way since she was young. But rest assured, she’s sensible and will make the right decision."
Ma Yunde nodded, "That’s good. By the way, do Qingxue’s parents agree to this matter?"
Li Xueyan quickly said, "We are very happy about it."
Ma Yunde nodded contentedly, "That’s good. After niece Qingxue divorces, we’ll select an auspicious day for her to enter the Ma Family and become my daughter-in-law."
"Who said I agree?"
Suddenly, a voice said, and Lin Fan stood up.
All eyes instantly focused on Lin Fan.
Li Xueyan was furious, almost jumping up as she couldn’t help but angrily say, "Lin Fan, what gives you the right to speak here!"
Lin Fan laughed, "I’m Qingxue’s husband. You want her to remarry, so how am I not allowed to speak?"
His reason for speaking up was because he saw the difficulty Wei Qingxue was in, caught in a dilemma, unable to agree yet unable to refuse.
It was time for him, the human shield, to step in.
Li Xueyan fumed, "You’re just a food delivery guy. Do you think you can match up to our Qingxue? You’re told to divorce. What gives you the right to oppose?"
Elder Wei said, "Enough. Lin Fan, Xueyan’s words may be harsh, but they are factual. This is not a place for you to speak."
Li Xueyan said, "Lin Fan, you’re a toad chasing after a swan. What makes you worthy of my daughter Qingxue? Quickly speak up and let this useless person give up!"
Elder Wei said, "Exactly, Qingxue, make your decision. Grandpa knows you are a sensible child and have never let grandpa down."
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, silent for a moment, as if she was making up her mind.
At this moment, Ma Jialiang smiled and took out a brocade box from his pocket.
"Little Sister Qingxue, I mentioned outside just now that I prepared a surprise gift for you. I think it’s time to give it to you." Ma Jialiang smiled and opened the box, revealing a dazzling light.
Inside the box lay a diamond ring, the large blue diamond dazzling enough to blind someone’s eyes.
Everyone in the Wei Family looked on with wide eyes, all shocked by the brilliant diamond.
Even Wei Qingxue was drawn to it.
Women are naturally resistant to diamonds, and Wei Qingxue especially loved them.
"Is this... the Blue of the Sea? How did you find it?" Wei Qingxue asked in surprise.
Seeing he had captured Wei Qingxue’s attention, Ma Jialiang was pleased, "I told you it was a surprise. I heard Little Sister Qingxue likes diamonds, so I had someone search for it. After a lot of effort and through special information channels, I learned about an underground auction where this Blue of the Sea was up for auction. This diamond is from South Africa, weighing 20 carats, with a rare blue glow. It’s said it once sparked tribal wars over it and was once possessed by the British Royal Family but mysteriously lost, vanishing from known records, only to reappear in recent years. Does that sound right?"
Apparently, Ma Jialiang had done his homework. Wei Qingxue nodded, "Yes, but its appearance at an underground auction was always just a rumor, unverified. So it’s true?"
Ma Jialiang smiled, "Indeed! I had an expert verify it. This is the legendary Blue of the Sea. Would you like to take a look, Little Sister Qingxue?"
Ma Jialiang handed the diamond ring to Wei Qingxue, and she took it and began to examine it.
Li Xueyan smiled, "Jia Liang, this diamond must have cost quite a bit, huh?"
She loved it so much that if it were her, she would have agreed to Ma Jialiang immediately.
Ma Jialiang smiled, "It’s not cheap, indeed, but for a gift to Little Sister Qingxue, it’s not too expensive, around 10 million or so."
million!
Everyone present gasped. That was incredibly expensive!

chapters.title: Chapter 372: The answer is simple, because my wife loves me
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 372: The answer is simple, because my wife loves me
Ma Jialiang thoroughly enjoyed the shocked reactions of all around him; this was exactly the effect he wanted.
"Little Sister Qingxue, I’ve specifically shaped it into a diamond ring. Once you wear it, you’ll become the most dazzling bride in the city. Why don’t I help you try it on?" Ma Jialiang smiled.
He was very confident that no woman could possibly refuse this diamond ring, especially since he was catering to Wei Qingxue’s preferences.
"Qingxue, quickly agree with him!" Li Xueyan exclaimed excitedly.
"Agree with him!"
The surrounding Wei Family members began to cheer.
Li Xueyan was already smiling so broadly she couldn’t close her mouth; she was too fond of this wealthy son-in-law.
Wei Tang had just returned from the bathroom and, upon seeing the scene, a cold smile flashed in his eyes.
Back then, he had failed in the competition against Wei Qingxue to become the president, and he had since been hoping for Wei Qingxue’s downfall. He originally thought this time Wei Qingxue would lose her power, yet who would have anticipated Wei Qingxue was about to remarry Ma Jialiang, and with the Ma Family’s backing in the future, he would have no chance at all.
Lin Fan stood nearby, watching the spectacle unfold. He was just a bystander in this matter, and if it hadn’t been for the system task that made him agree to help Wei Qingxue, he wouldn’t have even appeared here.
If Wei Qingxue really put on this diamond ring, his task would end there.
"This diamond is very precious, I can’t accept it."
Wei Qingxue said, her expression had already returned to its usual coolness, as she gently placed the diamond ring in front of Ma Jialiang.
Ma Jialiang, who was smiling like nothing else, was suddenly stifled: "Little Sister Qingxue, don’t you like this diamond?"
"I do like it, but I can’t accept it. Since it’s a wedding ring, you should give it to your bride, yet I already have a husband." Wei Qingxue said calmly.
With this statement, the entire venue fell silent.
Lin Fan was smiling slightly instead, it seemed like Wei Qingxue was indeed determined not to marry Ma Jialiang.
Even though the Wei Family would face losing the investment opportunity from the Ma Family because of this.
He certainly had considered earlier that Wei Qingxue might, under family pressure, sacrifice herself to secure the Ma Family’s investment.
Yet Wei Qingxue did not yield!
"I already have a husband!"
These words pierced into Ma Jialiang’s heart like a knife.
"Little Sister Qingxue, weren’t you planning to divorce this delivery guy?" Ma Jialiang was about to cry.
Li Xueyan snapped out of her shock and angrily said, "Qingxue, do you know what you’re saying?"
She thought Wei Qingxue had figured it all out, but who knew...
Chu Mengyu remained silent.
"What are you thinking?" Li Xueyan stomped her foot, not understanding why her daughter wouldn’t agree to remarry. If it were her, she would certainly agree. What was there to miss about Lin Fan, this good-for-nothing?
Wei Tang, however, showed a gloating expression. Chu Mengyu’s refusal to agree to remarry was certainly amusing.
The scene became awkward for a moment.
Ma Yunde was immediately displeased and looked at Elder Wei: "Elder, it seems your niece Qingxue doesn’t want to marry into our Ma Family."
Elder Wei hurriedly gave a conciliatory smile: "Calm down, dear nephew, let me speak to the child."
Internally, Elder Wei was enraged. He too thought Wei Qingxue, for the sake of the family, would not refuse, yet who would have thought, Wei Qingxue ultimately rejected!
"Wei Qingxue, do you know what the current situation is? Is Grandpa not clear enough, or is it beyond your understanding?" Elder Wei said sternly.
Wei Qingxue responded: "I understand."
Elder Wei said: "You are a smart child, Grandpa has always been very assured of you. He firmly supported you as President against everyone back then, you should not disappoint Grandpa. But what did you just do?"
Wei Qingxue said: "Please forgive me, Grandpa. I know that by doing this, I may endanger the family, but I simply cannot agree to it."
Elder Wei angrily said: "Why? Isn’t Jialiang good enough?"
Wei Qingxue said: "It’s not a matter of whether he’s good or not. I already have a husband. If I were to remarry for money, what would outsiders think? I would end up a joke."
Elder Wei truly lost his temper: "Is your personal reputation more important, or is the family’s future more important? As a president, you must be prepared to sacrifice for the family at any time, especially as this act is to save the Company. Marrying into a good family is an absolute duty; why would outsiders have anything to criticize?"
Li Xueyan said: "Qingxue, Elder Wei is right; being married to this delivery guy is the real joke!"
Wei Qingxue shook her head: "I understand Grandpa’s intentions. It’s my fault; I have not lived up to Grandpa’s expectations."
Wei Tang then spoke: "Wei Qingxue, even Grandpa’s words you don’t listen to? You put personal interest above family interests. What qualifies you to be President!"
He was eager for Wei Qingxue’s downfall, and naturally wouldn’t miss the chance to fan the flames at such a moment.
The Wei Family members had long bore a grudge against Wei Qingxue, especially the younger generation of females, who were envious of Wei Qingxue.
Now that Wei Qingxue was in trouble, they couldn’t resist kicking her when she was down.
"Wei Qingxue is indeed ungrateful, who does she think she is? She has a chance to marry into the Ma Family, yet she refuses!"
"Ignoring family interests, she really doesn’t deserve to be President."
"If she doesn’t marry Young Master Ma, doesn’t that mean I have a chance?"
The crowd began to criticize her in a cacophony.
Elder Wei said: "Qingxue, what’s going on with you? Why are you so fixated on this delivery guy, that you would rather ignore family interests and refuse to divorce him?"
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan, her face somewhat flushed. She had invited Lin Fan to act as her decoy but hadn’t thought through the implications, not knowing what to say for the moment.
Lin Fan said with a smile: "How about I answer that question? The answer is simple: because my dear wife loves me, and I love her. We love each other. Is that answer sufficient?"
Wei Qingxue blushed deeply, finding Lin Fan’s words extremely embarrassing.
These words hit like a knife, causing Ma Jialiang’s face to whiten; did Wei Qingxue really love Lin Fan!
Wei Tang burst out laughing: "Too funny, Wei Qingxue, you don’t treasure yourself at all; how could you run off to love a delivery guy!"
Elder Wei was already beside himself with anger: "You really disappointed Grandpa this time. You’ve always been sensible, and Grandpa has never had to intervene, but today I must. This matter concerns the family’s destiny; you cannot just follow your whims. You must remarry!"
Li Xueyan was frantic, advising: "Qingxue, listen to Grandpa; don’t be willful."
Wei Qingxue’s refusal to remarry would risk her position in the Company, and upsetting Elder Wei would mean no good days ahead for their family.
Wei Qingxue stood up, her face icy, and said: "I’m sorry, Grandpa, I cannot agree!"
Bang!
Elder Wei slapped the table, startling everyone.
"It’s not for you to refuse! You are the President; this is your responsibility, you must agree whether you want to or not!" Elder Wei said angrily.
Wei Qingxue bit her lip: "Forgive me, I cannot shoulder this responsibility. I resign as President!"
What?
Was Wei Qingxue really going to resign!
Li Xueyan was almost frightened into fainting; her daughter’s actions undoubtedly pushed their family into the abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Just 1 Billion, Is It Necessary?
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 373: Just 1 Billion, Is It Necessary?
"Why is this child so stubborn!" Li Xueyan’s eyes turned red with anger.
"No!" Elder Wei shouted angrily, "I do not approve of your resignation, you must take on this responsibility!"
Wei Qingxue said nothing, pushed back her chair, and intended to leave on her own.
Elder Wei said, "If you walk out of this door, you will no longer be a part of the Wei Family. Do you know the consequences?"
The consequences were severe!
If Wei Qingxue were expelled from the family, she could no longer be the CEO, and her parents would be implicated, unable to hold their heads high in the family in the future.
"If not for yourself, think about your parents!" Elder Wei said coldly.
Wei Qingxue paused in her steps.
"Grandpa, why do you have to force me?" Wei Qingxue’s body began to tremble.
Seeing this, Lin Fan couldn’t help but feel uneasy. Although they were a fake couple, Lin Fan couldn’t stand seeing a beauty being forced into such a predicament.
"Elder Wei, is it worth putting so much pressure on my wife over a mere 1 billion?" Lin Fan chuckled.
A mere 1 billion!
Everyone was stunned, this delivery guy had quite the mouth!
What followed was a burst of laughter and ridicule.
"Damn, what a pretentious delivery guy!"
"A mere billion, do you even have a hundred bucks on you!"
"I can’t breathe from laughter, this delivery guy has no sense of reality!"
Hearing these ridicules, Lin Fan shrugged. To him, 1 billion really wasn’t much money.
Elder Wei couldn’t even be bothered to deal with Lin Fan and said, "Qingxue, it’s not that I want to force you, but it’s about the fate of the family, I have no choice."
Wei Qingxue laughed bitterly, "Grandpa keeps talking about the family’s fate, but why should I sacrifice for it? Do as you please, I won’t agree. Lin Fan, let’s go."
After saying this, Wei Qingxue was about to walk out.
"Alright." Lin Fan stood up.
Elder Wei was thoroughly enraged: "If you don’t agree today, don’t even think about leaving. Someone, stop her!"
Two uncles at the same table stood up, trying to stop Wei Qingxue.
"Don’t touch my wife!"
Lin Fan said coldly.
Woosh!
At that moment, a plate of food flew across, startling the two uncles, who instinctively dodged to the side.
With a crash, the plate shattered on the ground, splattering food everywhere.
"Let’s go!"
Lin Fan reached out and grabbed Wei Qingxue’s hand. It was his first time being this close to her, her small hand felt soft and smooth, very comfortable.
Wei Qingxue was seized by Lin Fan’s large hand, yet she felt a warm current envelop her, inexplicably providing a sense of security, so she instinctively followed Lin Fan and ran out.
The two smoothly escaped the private room, leaving behind a room full of shocked people.
Lin Fan dared to pull off an attack, was this live-in son-in-law rebelling?
"Chase them!" Elder Wei reacted, shouting angrily.
A few young people quickly chased after them.
"Elder Wei, what kind of situation is this? If she wasn’t willing, you should have said so sooner, I wouldn’t have wasted my time here," Ma Yunde could no longer contain himself, speaking with a stern face. With things turning out this way, he felt utterly humiliated.
Elder Wei dared not respond, unsure of how to reply either. Wei Qingxue’s actions had caused him to lose face as well.
Li Xueyan said, "Please don’t be angry, Qingxue is just confused for a moment. Give her a little more time and I’ll do my best to persuade her, or if Young Master Ma is willing, you could consider Sisi instead. Sisi, come here!"
"Oh." The young beauty who had been sitting beside Lin Fan previously walked over, a bit embarrassed.
Li Xueyan continued, "In terms of looks, Sisi is not inferior to Mengyu, and in terms of personality, much better. What do you think, Young Master Ma?"
Ma Jialiang sighed, "Auntie, please don’t do this."
Li Xueyan’s actions had put him in an awkward spot as well.
"Enough!" Elder Wei thundered, "Isn’t this shameful enough? Qingxue is your daughter, how did you raise her? And that Lin Fan, your daughter married a delivery guy, and you didn’t know?"
"I’m sorry." Li Xueyan lowered her head, filled with hatred for Lin Fan. If not for Lin Fan’s intervention earlier, Qingxue would’ve never escaped successfully.
Could Wei Qingxue be caught and brought back?
Lin Fan held onto Wei Qingxue, running swiftly, and within no time they were out of the hotel.
"They’re catching up," Wei Qingxue suddenly said.
Lin Fan looked back and saw that several people from the Wei Family were indeed giving chase.
"Get on, I’ll take you away from here," Lin Fan said, pulling Wei Qingxue, running toward his electric scooter.
Wei Qingxue had never sat on an electric scooter before, hesitated for a moment, but seeing the people pursuing, she no longer hesitated and quickly got on.
The scooter sped away from the hotel like the wind.
The few pursuers could only watch with disappointment, unable to catch up.
They could only return helplessly to report back.
A group of people was still waiting in the private room, upon learning Lin Fan had successfully escaped with Wei Qingxue, Elder Wei was furious with embarrassment.
Wei Tang was pleased, with Wei Qingxue causing such a huge mess, his opportunity had arrived.
"Grandpa, Wei Qingxue’s actions are utterly rebellious. If not punished, it will be hard to satisfy everyone," Wei Tang said.
Elder Wei slammed the table in anger, "Wei Qingxue disregarded the family’s interests, and is no longer qualified to be CEO. Effective immediately, she is removed from office!"
Upon hearing this, Wei Tang was overjoyed inside.
Li Xueyan’s face went pale, now their family could never hold their heads up within the clan again.
"Jialiang, let’s go," Ma Jialiang stood up then, speaking coldly.
Ma Jialiang had no choice but to stand up too.
Elder Wei said, "Nephew, I’m really sorry about today, I didn’t expect Qingxue would behave this way. Originally, I didn’t think I could bring up the investment again, but since it’s about the Wei Family’s survival, I’ll shamelessly ask if there’s still room for negotiation on this matter?"
Ma Yunde said, "Apart from Wei Qingxue, is there anything else worth investing in the Wei Family?"
"This..." Elder Wei was momentarily speechless.
Ma Yunde didn’t bother with him further, and simply left with Ma Jialiang.
"Dad, is that the end of this?" Ma Jialiang asked, feeling unreconciled to end things in such failure.
Ma Yunde glared at him, "Aren’t you embarrassed enough? Weren’t you saying you and Wei Qingxue had a great relationship, and now look at the mess you’re in!"
Ma Jialiang smiled bitterly, "I didn’t think she would be into a delivery guy, a bottom-feeding loser."
Ma Yunde sneered, "But the fact is, she was taken away by this loser."
Ma Jialiang had no words to counter, his heart full of hatred for Lin Fan.
"Damn loser, if I, Ma Jialiang, don’t teach you a lesson, my anger will never be appeased!" Ma Jialiang plotted in his mind.
Once outside the hotel, Feng Yishan said, "I’m heading back to the Company, you go home by yourself."
Then he and his assistant drove away.
Ma Jialiang immediately took out his phone, dialed a number, "It’s me, I’m planning to teach someone a lesson, help me set it up..."
At this point, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue had already gone far.
Wei Qingxue was still panting, having run too fast earlier, coupled with emotional turmoil, unable to calm down for a moment.
On the scooter, the two sat very close, Lin Fan could feel her soft chest rising and falling with her breaths, he could even smell her delicate fragrance, causing his heartbeat to quicken.
The feeling of holding her hand just now was too wonderful.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but smile with reminiscence.
"My dear wife, where should we go?" Lin Fan asked.
Wei Qingxue replied, "I don’t know."
She didn’t know where to go, and with the situation at home now, she couldn’t return.
Lin Fan smiled, "Then let me take you to my place first."
Wei Qingxue hesitated for a moment but ultimately nodded. She really had nowhere else to go.
So Lin Fan brought Wei Qingxue back to his apartment in the urban village.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Daughter Truly Has Good Taste, Little Fan Is a Very Good Young Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 374: Daughter Truly Has Good Taste, Little Fan Is a Very Good Young Man
Wei Qingxue had escaped, and suddenly had nowhere to go. Lin Fan suggested taking her home to stay temporarily.
Lin Fan took her back to his apartment located in a city village.
When they arrived at the city village, Wei Qingxue was sitting on the back seat of the electric scooter. She looked up and saw the dense, low-rise buildings in front of her. The environment was dirty and messy, and she couldn’t help but frown.
"Do you live here?" Wei Qingxue asked. She regretted coming with Lin Fan, as she had never been to such a poor place before. Could anyone actually live here?
Well, she was a rich family’s heiress, the CEO of the family company, accustomed to high-end places; she would usually avoid such places, let alone live in them.
Lin Fan said, "Yeah, don’t be fooled; though it looks behind the times, it’s actually got everything. Shopping and eating out are convenient."
The nearby street market was indeed bustling, full of people coming and going, with a strong street atmosphere. However, most residents in this area were city workers with low wages who couldn’t afford high-end neighborhoods, only the relatively cheaper city villages.
Every day, these workers would leave the village, endure one or two hours of crowded buses or subways to go to work, and do the same on their way back.
The pressure of work and life weighed down on these workers, each of them carrying an air of fatigue and poverty.
Wei Qingxue felt a little frustrated. Logically, people living here should be working for her, yet she found herself living here too.
Tiger fallen to the plains, a phoenix in distress, a princess down on her luck... these phrases flashed through her mind.
But she quickly consoled herself.
The reason she was here was entirely because of Lin Fan. Since Lin Fan was a courier, he could only live in such a place, but she was merely following him temporarily and could leave soon.
With this thought, Wei Qingxue felt a bit more relaxed.
Just then, Wei Qingxue suddenly noticed a luxury car parked by the roadside and exclaimed, "Is that a Rolls-Royce Cullinan?"
Oh my God, this car is worth 8 million!
How could there be an 8-million luxury car in such a city village?
It seems there’s a wealthy local here in this village. Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but be curious about what kind of tycoon would live here. Quite an oddity!
"There’s a Cullinan here... Lin Fan, do you know who it belongs to?" Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan didn’t even look. "It’s mine," he said.
Wei Qingxue thought he was joking and laughed, "Yeah, right, like I’d believe that."
Lin Fan chuckled, not bothering to explain further. The car really was his.
They soon arrived at the apartment building.
Lin Fan was about to push the scooter into the building when he saw Aunt Li, the landlord, coming down the stairs, on her way to play mahjong at the village entrance.
Aunt Li saw Wei Qingxue beside Lin Fan and her eyes lit up. This girl was so pretty, with an air of nobility—not like an ordinary girl.
"Little Fan, who is this?" Aunt Li asked curiously.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Let me introduce you. This is Aunt Li, my landlord. Aunt Li, her name is Xiaoxue."
Wei Qingxue said politely, "Hello, Aunt Li."
Aunt Li smiled and said, "Hello, you’re such a beautiful girl. Are you Little Fan’s girlfriend?"
Aunt Li had been trying to introduce potential partners to Lin Fan, but recently she heard he had a girlfriend, so she stopped. Seeing Wei Qingxue today, she naturally assumed she was Lin Fan’s girlfriend.
Wei Qingxue was about to deny it, thinking there was no need to pretend in front of Aunt Li.
But Lin Fan had already reached over, grasped her hand, and smiled, "Yes, she is my girlfriend."
Aunt Li looked envious, "Little Fan, what good fortune you have to have such a wonderful girl, cherish her."
Lin Fan grinned, "I will."
"The girl has good taste; Little Fan is a really great guy..." Aunt Li went on praising Lin Fan to Wei Qingxue before heading off to play mahjong.
As she left, she gave Lin Fan a knowing look, indicating that she had done her part to help.
Lin Fan called out, "Take care, Aunt Li!"
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, "She’s gone already, and you still won’t let go!"
Lin Fan was still holding her hand. This guy really thought he was her man. Was he intentionally taking advantage?
Lin Fan had already violated the first term of their agreement—not to touch her.
Lin Fan let go of her hand, a bit apologetically, and said, "Sorry, Aunt Li was so enthusiastic. If she knew I was single, she would definitely start introducing girls to me again."
Wei Qingxue was taken aback. So Lin Fan wasn’t taking advantage but using her as a shield?
"Let’s head upstairs," Lin Fan said as he pushed the scooter inside. After parking it in the hallway, he led Wei Qingxue upstairs.
Upon entering the apartment, Wei Qingxue was stunned.
The apartment had only one bedroom and one living room; it was too small. She couldn’t imagine anyone living here.
Thankfully, although the place was small, Lin Fan kept it tidy, with essential items like a sofa, fridge, and washing machine.
"Come in, the place is a bit small, please bear with it, Miss," Lin Fan smiled.
Wei Qingxue walked in and sat on the sofa.
For the first time, she found herself alone in a room with Lin Fan, a man, in such a cramped space, making her a bit uneasy.
"I’ll pour you a glass of water," Lin Fan said and went to pour some water.
He handed a glass to Wei Qingxue when suddenly her stomach growled.
Wei Qingxue’s face turned instantly red with embarrassment; she wanted to disappear.
She hadn’t felt like eating today and had been on an empty stomach.
"Are you hungry?" Lin Fan laughed.
"Yes," Wei Qingxue replied, her face flushed.
Lin Fan said, "I’ll make you some noodles."
Wei Qingxue misunderstood, and her face reddened even more.
"Oh, is there a water heater here? I broke into a sweat earlier, and I’d like to take a shower," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, let me get you a new towel and some clean clothes."
Lin Fan went to the room and quickly came back with a new towel and a set of pajamas.
Seeing the pink pajamas, which were for females, Wei Qingxue frowned, "How do you have female pajamas?"
Could it be that Lin Fan had a girlfriend?
Lin Fan explained, "These are my sister’s. She stayed with me for a few days when she came to study."
"Alright." Wei Qingxue took the clothes and, for some reason, felt relieved hearing that.
Wei Qingxue went to take a shower.
Lin Fan turned to the kitchen to cook noodles.
When the noodles were ready, there was still no sign of Wei Qingxue. All he could hear was the sound of water from the bathroom, indicating she was still showering.
Lin Fan felt a warmth in his heart, his thoughts wandering, imagining how nice it would be to have a woman at home. If only Wei Qingxue were really his wife, that wouldn’t be bad.
Before long, a freshly showered Wei Qingxue emerged.
Lin Fan looked up and was a bit taken aback.
Wei Qingxue was stunning after her bath, wearing the pink pajamas, with her hair tied up high and her cheeks flushed from the hot water, looking like a ripe apple.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: You don’t need to worry, I’ll help you solve the money issue
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 375: You don’t need to worry, I’ll help you solve the money issue
It looks so good, Lin Fan really wanted to take a bite of this rosy apple.
"The noodles are ready, you should eat them while they’re hot." Lin Fan chuckled.
"Okay." Wei Qingxue said, walking out, "By the way, I just found something dirty inside. I found it offensive, so I threw it in the trash for you. No need to thank me."
"What?"
Lin Fan looked into the trash can, wasn’t that his cherished photo album of a famous actress from another country? Normally, since he was the only one around, he didn’t bother hiding it, but Wei Qingxue found it...
Lin Fan felt a pang of heartache, those were all rare editions, how could he bear to throw them away...
When he returned to the living room, Wei Qingxue was already sitting down to eat the noodles.
The atmosphere was a bit awkward.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Are the noodles I cooked good?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Not bad, I didn’t expect you to have cooking skills."
Lin Fan said, "That... that book was given to me by someone on the street, I was just about to throw it away..."
Wei Qingxue said, "You don’t need to explain. Lin Fan, thank you."
Lin Fan said, "Thank me?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Thank you for helping me out today. If it weren’t for you, I don’t know if I could have gotten away."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s my duty. Earlier downstairs, you acted as my shield once too, so we’re even now."
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but smile.
As they were talking, suddenly, a phone call came in.
Wei Qingxue looked and saw it was her mother, Li Xueyan, calling. She hesitated for a moment but still picked up the phone.
