The conversation on the other end lasted a long time.
"I understand." Wei Qingxue responded lightly, then hung up the phone.
Wei Qingxue put down her chopsticks, seeming to have lost her appetite.
Lin Fan asked, "Is everything okay?"
Wei Qingxue’s eyes reddened, "Mom said grandpa has decided to fire me. I’m no longer the president of the company, and grandpa no longer acknowledges me as his granddaughter."
Lin Fan responded, "Being removed from a position can be understood, but cutting ties is too much!"
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Grandpa kicked me out of the house just to threaten me to agree to remarry Ma Jialiang."
Lin Fan said, "You won’t compromise, will you?"
"If I were going to compromise, I would have done so a long time ago." Wei Qingxue gave a bitter smile, "I’m afraid I have to face reality now."
Her mood was so low, she really seemed heartbroken.
"It’s so unfair for Elder Wei to treat you like this, you shouldn’t have any attachment, should you?" Lin Fan said.
Chu Mengyu shook her head, "You don’t know, that failed project in Hang City was led by me back then, I should be responsible. I just don’t want to remarry Ma Jialiang, but I do want to solve this problem."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Actually, I’ve always wanted to ask, why do you dislike Ma Jialiang so much?"
Wei Qingxue and Ma Jialiang have known each other since they were little, they could be considered childhood sweethearts. Plus, this time the Ma Family offered a lavish 1 billion gift for marrying Wei Qingxue. If Wei Qingxue agreed to marry Ma Jialiang, the company’s financial crisis could be resolved.
Wei Qingxue said, "I never had those kinds of feelings for him. When I was young, I only saw him as a brother. Later on, as I grew older, I gradually distanced myself. I never intended to marry him, and with his misdeeds, it’s even more impossible."
Lin Fan said, "Misdeeds?"
Wei Qingxue said, "This Ma Jialiang is a complete playboy. He once got a girl’s belly big, forced her to get an abortion. The girl refused, and in heartbreak, she jumped off a building — a life lost! The Ma Family spent a fortune to cover it up, but I found out through some channels. Do you think I should marry such a person?"
Lin Fan responded, if it’s true, she certainly shouldn’t marry him. No wonder Wei Qingxue would rather fake a marriage with him to avoid this family alliance.
Wei Qingxue gave a bitter smile, "I’ve protected myself, but by doing so, I can’t help the Wei Family out of their troubles, now everyone at home must really hate me."
Lin Fan was just about to speak.
Suddenly.
"Ding!"
"System Task Issued: Help Wei Qingxue Resolve Financial Crisis.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 0/100"
The system’s voice suddenly echoed in his mind.
Lin Fan was surprised, the system issued another task, and this time, it required him to help Wei Qingxue resolve the 1 billion financial crisis!
Lin Fan grew more curious, first, the system wanted him to marry Wei Qingxue, and now it wanted him to help fill a huge financial gap.
What exactly was the system trying to achieve with this?
Confused or not, this was a system task, and Lin Fan could only comply.
"Don’t worry, I’ll help with the financial issue." Lin Fan said directly.
Wei Qingxue glanced at him and said, "Are you trying to make me laugh? It’s not funny at all."
Lin Fan, a courier living in a cramped shanty apartment in an urban village, claiming he could solve a 1 billion issue.
If that’s not a joke, what is?
Wei Qingxue was a bit irritated, Lin Fan’s joke totally missed the mark.
Lin Fan gave a slight smile, it’s okay that Wei Qingxue didn’t believe him now, after all, it’s a system task, and he would complete it.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
Lin Fan saw it was a call from Wang Xiangqian and answered it.
"Brother Fan, something’s wrong, Xiaoyue got into trouble, can you come to the company?" Wang Xiangqian said anxiously.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll come over right away."
Ning Xiaoyue got into trouble?
He needed to go check it out.
After hanging up, Lin Fan said, "You can stay here for now. If you’re tired, you can take a nap in the room. I have to go out to make a delivery, so I’m leaving now."
Lin Fan found an excuse and left.
Wei Qingxue didn’t try to stop him, after all, Lin Fan was off to work, he relied on deliveries to earn his hard-earned money; she couldn’t delay his earnings.
Wei Qingxue thought of herself, now that she was unemployed, and without solving the financial issue, she couldn’t return to the Wei Family. She didn’t know what she could do in the future; maybe she’d muddle through even worse than Lin Fan.
Thinking of this, Wei Qingxue felt a wave of sadness, she really wished Lin Fan’s joke earlier was true, that he could actually help her resolve the financial matter, but that was simply fairytale...
Meanwhile, in a private room at Fengming Grand Hotel.
With Wei Qingxue leaving, the dinner party ended as well. Elder Wei sent the rest of the Wei Family away, leaving only a few elders from the clan and Wei Tang.
They were discussing how the Wei Family would survive the impending crisis.
Wei Tang was excited inside, Grandpa had driven Wei Qingxue out, his chance had finally come, the stumbling block had been cleared, it was his turn to shine, out of so many juniors, Grandpa had only kept him, indicating that Grandpa wanted to promote him.
Elder Wei had a serious expression, "Now, the Wei Family faces a life or death crisis. With Wei Qingxue unwilling to remarry, the massive financial hole is hard to fill. You are all respected elders of the Wei Family, I want to discuss with everyone, is there any way to save the Wei Family?"
The elders looked at each other, for a moment no one spoke, even Elder Wei couldn’t solve it, what solution could they possibly have?
An elder with white hair pondered for a moment and said, "Patriarch, I do have an idea, why don’t we ask that person for help..."
Though he didn’t specify who, Elder Wei obviously understood who he meant, his face changed, and he looked a bit angry, decisively saying, "No way, I would rather die than ask him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Lin Fan, have you prepared your ¥100 million?
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 376: Lin Fan, have you prepared your ¥100 million?
Lin Fan left the apartment, got into the Rolls-Royce parked on the street, changed into casual clothes in the car, and then drove to Wenyue Company.
While driving, Lin Fan returned a call to Wang Xiangqian, inquiring about Ning Xiaoyue’s situation. Just now, Wang Xiangqian had mentioned that something happened to Ning Xiaoyue, but Lin Fan couldn’t ask in detail with Wei Qingxue present.
Wang Xiangqian told Lin Fan that Ning Xiaoyue had been attacked online.
Unknowingly, the "Creation Star" show had aired its third episode. When the first episode ended, Ning Xiaoyue ranked third in votes, shocking the internet.
Discussion about Ning Xiaoyue was raging online.
Ning Xiaoyue became famous.
A girl from a rural background came to the big city to fight for her dreams. Initially, she did basic jobs, but an occasional opportunity led her to Wenyue Company, where she became a girl group member. Even though her singing and dancing skills were poor, her looks and personality made her shine on the show, transforming her from a grassroots girl to the most popular idol contestant.
On one hand, Ning Xiaoyue gained countless fans; on the other hand, due to her weak singing and dancing skills, many people disliked her and felt she didn’t deserve such a high ranking.
Thus, two opposing forces emerged online, one mainly composed of Ning Xiaoyue’s fans supporting her, while the other angrily argued against them.
As Lin Fan expected, behind the 99 contestants, each had their own company, and these companies couldn’t tolerate Ning Xiaoyue occupying a debut spot. They took turns attacking her for her lack of skill.
A dark tide on the internet gradually formed.
This dark tide flooded the opposing force, and the fans’ voices were gradually drowned out, as if the entire world was berating Ning Xiaoyue.
Following the guidance of the internet trolls, netizens increasingly became filled with hostility. It started as criticism but escalated into all sorts of foul and abusive remarks, as if Ning Xiaoyue were an unforgivable villain. They were so furious it seemed they wished to tear Ning Xiaoyue apart.
This dark tide shocked some rational bystanders, who almost thought Ning Xiaoyue had committed murder or arson, only to find out she was just a bit lacking in skills. Was it really necessary to abuse a young girl like this?
Fortunately, Lin Fan instructed Ning Xiaoyue not to go online, so she, being with the show’s team, didn’t see the rampant abuse, avoiding harm.
If she had seen this terrifying online violence, a young girl would likely find it unbearable.
Ning Xiaoyue didn’t collapse, but the people at Wenyue Company were about to. Wang Xiangqian watched these insults online every day, feeling helpless.
Today’s third episode was about to air, and Wang Xiangqian could no longer withstand the pressure, so he had to call Lin Fan.
It turned out that this third episode would feature the first elimination round!
With so many people insulting Ning Xiaoyue now, she was very likely to be eliminated.
Elimination meant Ning Xiaoyue would have to leave the show and come back, where she would eventually see the online dark tide, and Wang Xiangqian didn’t know how to face Ning Xiaoyue then.
He felt guilty, as a boss who failed to protect Ning Xiaoyue.
Lin Fan frowned. He anticipated that other companies would attack Ning Xiaoyue, but he didn’t expect the situation to be this severe. It seemed he had to take action himself.
After all, Wenyue was just an obscure small company, which others didn’t take seriously and thought could be bullied at will.
Lin Fan hung up the phone and immediately called Du Tao.
Wenyue Company.
Wang Xiangqian paced back and forth in the office, looking a bit anxious.
The third episode was about to air, and the atmosphere inside the company was a bit tense.
Before participating in this program, Wenyue Company was already on the verge of bankruptcy, with the girl group facing disbandment. Wang Xiangqian decided to make a last-ditch effort, sending four girl group members to join "Creation Star." If anyone could debut, the company could continue to run. If they failed, the company would truly go under.
Lin Fan’s 20 million investment in Wenyue Company would also go down the drain.
Wang Xiangqian didn’t want to fail, didn’t want the company to close down, and didn’t want to let down Lin Fan’s investment.
However, the overwhelming dark tide online left him lacking confidence.
Suddenly, he heard noise from outside.
Wang Xiangqian hurried out of the office and saw Feng Tianming barging in with people.
Wang Xiangqian said angrily, "Feng Tianming, don’t you have your own company? Why do you keep coming to mine every few days?"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "The third episode is about to air. Unexpectedly, Ning Xiaoyue will be eliminated, and the other three even more so. Your company faces total elimination! How could I miss such an exciting moment?"
Wang Xiangqian said, "You’re not welcome here, please leave!"
Feng Tianming sat down on the sofa and said, "I’d like to see how you’re going to kick me out!"
Feng Tianming brought two hulking guys today; they weren’t easy to deal with.
Wang Xiangqian said excitedly, "If you don’t leave, I’m going to call the police!"
Wang Xiangqian took out his phone.
"No need to call the police, if Young Master Feng wants to stay, let him stay." A calm voice arrived as Lin Fan walked in.
"Brother Fan!"
Seeing Lin Fan, Wang Xiangqian calmed down a bit.
Feng Tianming laughed, "Still, Millionaire Lin has a broad perspective. Lin Fan, are you ready to face defeat? Have you prepared the 100 million? I’ll be collecting soon."
Lin Fan chuckled, "The show hasn’t aired yet, and you already know I’ll fail? Old Wang, serve Young Master Feng some tea, since he’s so interested, let’s watch the show together."
Saying that, Lin Fan also sat down on a sofa.
Feng Tianming coldly snorted, "Lin Fan, don’t you go online? Have you seen what’s being said about Ning Xiaoyue online? Where does your confidence come from?"
Lin Fan said, "Those online insults, I think Young Master Feng contributed a lot, didn’t you? It must have cost you."
Feng Tianming said, "Are you implying I spent money to hire trolls to insult Ning Xiaoyue? With Ning Xiaoyue’s lack of skill, I don’t need to bother. The netizens curse her on their own. Lin Fan, I warn you, don’t make baseless accusations, or I’ll sue you for defamation."
Lin Fan smiled, "You know what’s in your heart."
Feng Tianming sneered inwardly.
After the first episode, learning Ning Xiaoyue ranked third, Feng Tianming indeed decided to snipe at Ning Xiaoyue and spent money to hire trolls to attack her online.
But Ning Xiaoyue was clearly a target for many. Feng Tianming found out that not just he, but other companies were also doing it.
The "Creation Star" show featured contestants performing publicly three times, with eliminations after each performance. The final debut spot was decided in the third grand finale elimination.
The so-called public performance involves open performances for the audience. Contestants have three opportunities to showcase their stage presence and attract fans.
The second episode was the first public performance. In this performance, Ning Xiaoyue’s performance was passable, showing she had put in hard work in practice.
But this led to even more intense attacks from other companies, ultimately forming the dark tide.
Once the dark tide formed, even if Ning Xiaoyue suddenly became Michael Jackson, she’d still be beyond saving.
It was like a cruise ship sailing into massive waves, facing nothing but drowning.
The third episode was to announce the first elimination list, and the show’s crew maintained the strictest confidentiality, sealing off all information channels. Even with information channels, Feng Tianming didn’t know the elimination results.
But Feng Tianming was confident that Ning Xiaoyue would definitely be on the elimination list this time.
No one could survive such a furious dark tide.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: I’m really sorry to disappoint you
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 377: I’m really sorry to disappoint you
The third episode of Creation Star has finally been broadcast.
Even before the broadcast, discussions were already raging online, and most of them were centered around Ning Xiaoyue.
Will Ning Xiaoyue be eliminated?
On this matter, netizens are arguing fiercely.
One could say that Ning Xiaoyue single-handedly made this show popular, attracting countless eyes.
Countless people are curious, how far can this loser of a young lady go in the show?
"Do we even need to ask? She’s definitely going to be eliminated!"
"Haven’t you seen all the online criticism against her? Surely no one will vote for her!"
"Just waiting for Ning Xiaoyue to be eliminated!"
The overwhelming opinion among netizens is that Ning Xiaoyue will definitely be eliminated.
This one-sided opinion also gave confidence to companies outside of Wenyue. Everyone believes that this time, their attempt to snipe Ning Xiaoyue has succeeded.
These companies became jubilant, each preparing to celebrate.
As long as Ning Xiaoyue is knocked down, their contestants will have another opportunity. There’s no way Ning Xiaoyue should occupy a debut spot!
Feng Tianming was also buoyed by the online voices, confidently visiting Wenyue Company once again to witness Wenyue Company welcoming defeat firsthand, imagining how satisfying it would be.
The most satisfying part is Ning Xiaoyue’s elimination, which means he has won against Lin Fan, whose investment of 20 million in Wenyue Company goes down the drain, and he also loses 100 million to Feng Tianming!
Thinking about winning 100 million soon, Feng Tianming grinned broadly.
Although 120 million might not be much to Lin Fan’s wealth, Feng Tianming wants Lin Fan to be embarrassed.
He’s had many confrontations with Lin Fan before, always getting slapped in the face, always ending up embarrassed. He won’t accept it!
This time he’s finally going to embarrass Lin Fan, so of course he won’t miss it.
Eight o’clock at night.
The third episode of Creation Star begins, and everyone gathers around the TV to watch.
Wang Xiangqian is extremely tense, the elimination list is about to be announced, success or failure depends on this!
Wang Xiangqian is pessimistic, not that he’s to blame, all signs pointed to Ning Xiaoyue being eliminated.
"Buddha, bless them all to advance," Wang Xiangqian prayed.
Feng Tianming ridiculed, "What’s the point of praying to Buddha? No one can save her!"
Lin Fan chuckled, Feng Tianming is wrong. Maybe Buddha indeed won’t protect Ning Xiaoyue, after all, countless people are praying every day, Buddha is very busy, but Lin Fan could indeed protect Ning Xiaoyue.
Lin Fan just needs to send some top-tier Koi Carp Luck to Ning Xiaoyue, enough for her to survive this elimination.
But Lin Fan didn’t do that.
Previously he might have hesitated, but now he wasn’t even thinking about it.
Lin Fan wants to see if Ning Xiaoyue can rely on herself to continue, rather than relying on Koi Carp Luck cheats. If Ning Xiaoyue can make it to the end, it would confirm she is destiny’s chosen girl.
Out of 99 contestants, the first round of elimination will eliminate 50, leaving 49.
The second round will again eliminate 30, leaving 19.
The third-round finals will have the remaining 19 contestants competing for the final 9 debut spots.
In the show, the mentors began announcing the 50 elimination names.
Only half of the names were announced.
With the exception of Ning Xiaoyue, the other three from Wenyue Company were all eliminated.
The company fell into a state of depression.
Wang Xiangqian approached Lin Fan, face flushed, and said, "Brother Fan, I’m sorry, my people were too weak, disappointing your expectations, and causing you to lose to that scoundrel Feng Tianming!"
Lin Fan calmly said, "Don’t be downcast, Xiaoyue hasn’t been eliminated yet, and besides, Young Master Feng isn’t doing any better."
Two of Feng Tianming’s company’s five people were also eliminated!
Feng Tianming didn’t mind at all, laughing slyly, "I still have 5 people, eliminating 2 leaves me with 3, while you all eliminated 3 out of 4, leaving only Ning Xiaoyue, and just wait, soon you’ll all be wiped out!"
The mentors continued announcing the remaining elimination names.
Surprisingly, Feng Tianming lost two more people!
Only that A-level player was left.
The slaps came too quickly.
Feng Tianming, who had been laughing, froze in his smile.
What the...?
He had 5 people eliminated to 4, leaving only one!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Young Master Feng, your luck isn’t too good either, there’s one last elimination spot left, it might be you who ends up with a complete wipeout."
Feng Tianming snorted, "No way, the last elimination spot is definitely Ning Xiaoyue, if not, I’ll crawl out of here!"
Lin Fan replied, "You said it yourself."
For a moment, everyone tensed up, waiting for the announcement of the last elimination spot.
The mentor finally announced.
The last elimination wasn’t Ning Xiaoyue, nor Feng Tianming’s A-level player!
Both of them advanced.
Instantly, the entire company erupted in jubilation, everyone was joyously ecstatic.
Ning Xiaoyue advanced; she was not eliminated!
"Great!" Wang Xiangqian jumped up in excitement.
Feng Tianming’s face turned sullen, and he was quite displeased. His A-level player advanced as expected, no big deal, but the fact that Wenyue Company wasn’t wiped out, and Ning Xiaoyue wasn’t eliminated!
The bet with Lin Fan will now be determined in the second elimination round, he had assumed he’d win 100 million today, only for his plans to fail.
In the face of such fierce negativity online, Ning Xiaoyue still managed to advance, truly aggravating!
"Young Master Feng, really sorry to disappoint you," Lin Fan said with a smile, but secretly relaxed.
He hadn’t given Ning Xiaoyue Koi Carp Luck. To be honest, he was a little worried.
Feng Tianming sneered, "Don’t celebrate too soon, even if Ning Xiaoyue luckily advanced, her ranking won’t be high. She might not be eliminated this time, but next time she’ll be gone!"
Ning Xiaoyue surviving amid the negativity can only mean she has thick skin, but Feng Tianming believes she’s running low on luck.
Meanwhile, Ning Xiaoyue’s situation caused an explosion online.
"No way, Ning Xiaoyue didn’t get eliminated?"
"Got slapped in the face! This Ning Xiaoyue is so stubborn!"
"Why isn’t she eliminated yet, oh my!"
"Well, she was third place, dropping straight to below 50 is kind of difficult!"
"Since she didn’t get eliminated this time, I bet she will next time!"
"I think so too, her ranking must be low now."
With Ning Xiaoyue not being eliminated, netizens faced a reality check, comforting themselves that Ning Xiaoyue will definitely be eliminated next time.
After announcing the elimination list, the mentors began the second segment of this episode, revealing the latest rankings!
In everyone’s view, under the impact of online negativity, even without elimination, Ning Xiaoyue’s rank must have dropped, nowhere near the high rank of third place.
Even Wang Xiangqian thought so. Wang Xiangqian even hoped Ning Xiaoyue’s rank would drop a bit; being third place before, she attracted too much attention and caused Wenyue Company to be sniped by other companies.
As everyone was thinking this way.
The mentor announced, "Second place, Ning Xiaoyue!"
What?
Ning Xiaoyue’s rank not only didn’t drop but rose, from third to second place?
The company went silent.
Feng Tianming’s face paled instantly.
Simultaneously, news spread and had the entire internet in an uproar, because there were too many people discussing, causing the Weibo server to crash.
Ring ring ring...
Just then, Lin Fan received a call from Du Tao.

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Crawl Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 378: Crawl Out!
Ning Xiaoyue, ranked second!
As soon as this news came out, the internet was shaken, and netizens were all astonished.
"Why? Shouldn’t she have dropped? How did she actually rise in rank?"
"Oh my God, what’s going on?"
"Who’s voting for her?"
"I’m so angry at this result!"
The netizens exploded.
"Ning Xiaoyue second place" quickly shot to the top of the Weibo trending searches, causing a massive uproar, and because of the sheer number of people, even the Weibo servers crashed.
The internet was filled with anger and confusion; people could not understand why Ning Xiaoyue had made it to second place. In the midst of such a massive backlash, not only did her rank not fall, it actually rose, which was beyond their comprehension!
Wenyue Company.
Upon learning this result, Feng Tianming’s face turned pale.
Initially, he was full of confidence, thinking Ning Xiaoyue would definitely be eliminated, but he got slapped in the face. Then he thought her rank would certainly drop, but again, he got slapped in the face, and each time, it was harsher than before.
Feng Tianming’s face was thoroughly swollen from being slapped.
What made Feng Tianming feel even worse was that soon, the mentor announced the ranking of his top female, A-grade, 20th place!
This rank was significantly different from Ning Xiaoyue’s. Not to mention Ning Xiaoyue, it was even far from the ninth debut position, and at this rate, he was bound to lose to Lin Fan!
Feng Tianming nearly cried from frustration—why was it that, despite Xiaoyue’s lack of talent, so many people liked her and voted for her? Meanwhile, his talented performer couldn’t climb the ranks?
Feng Tianming had come to witness Lin Fan’s failure, only to end up witnessing his own.
He had no face to stay there any longer.
Silently, he got up, intending to sneak away.
Lin Fan suddenly said, "Young Master Feng, what did you say earlier about crawling out if Xiaoyue wasn’t eliminated?"
How could Feng Tianming crawl out? He was, after all, Young Master Feng, and there was no way he’d do something so humiliating.
Feng Tianming quickened his pace, planning to flee the scene, with the two large men he brought along protecting him on either side.
Lin Fan shook his head, "Young Master Feng, it’s better to have some integrity as a person. Are you too embarrassed to crawl? No problem, I’ll help you."
Before Lin Fan finished his sentence, he had already taken a step forward and kicked Feng Tianming on the butt.
The two large men tried to stop him but were too late; Lin Fan moved too quickly, and Feng Tianming was already kicked onto the ground, scrambling like a dog eating feces.
Feng Tianming couldn’t stop himself for a moment and truly crawled out of the company’s entrance.
The two large men were dumbfounded.
Realizing Lin Fan was a formidable figure, they dared not provoke him and hurriedly followed Feng Tianming out.
The crowd at Wenyue Company burst into laughter at the scene; Feng Tianming looked truly pathetic earlier, and Mr. Lin was amazing!
After being kicked down by Lin Fan, Feng Tianming crawled out the company’s door, finally stopping his momentum and getting up. His butt still hurt, and his hands were scraped and stinging from crawling, bringing tears to his eyes.
Feng Tianming was beside himself with rage.
But he was well aware of Lin Fan’s strength. His two subordinates weren’t Lin Fan’s match; if he tried to seek trouble with Lin Fan later, he’d only be bringing trouble upon himself.
"I’ll get you, Lin Fan! Just you wait, I won’t let this go!" Feng Tianming could only shout such harsh words before walking away dejectedly.
At Wenyue Company, everyone was delighted, sweeping away their earlier despondency.
Not only had Ning Xiaoyue not been eliminated, but her rank had also risen by one, which was pleasantly surprising. If this trend continued, Ning Xiaoyue should have no issues debuting, since surviving such a harsh wave of criticism itself was amazing.
In their happiness, everyone was a bit curious about how Ning Xiaoyue’s second-place rank had come about.
Wang Xiangqian said, "Xiaoyue’s trending on Weibo has gone viral, and netizens are questioning her ranking. Xiaoyue is being criticized again. Brother Fan, what should we do?"
Wenyue was just a small, struggling company without any experience, and Ning Xiaoyue’s unexpected popularity left Wang Xiangqian feeling overwhelmed, unsure of how to handle things.
Lin Fan replied, "Have you heard of fan management?"
Wang Xiangqian paused, "Fan management?"
Lin Fan continued, "I learned this term from Du Tao. Xiaoyue now has many fans, but they’re currently organizing themselves spontaneously. As Xiaoyue’s company, we should play an official role, actively connecting with fan organizations, understanding fan dynamics. Du Tao suggests establishing an officially certified fan club."
"Fan club..." Wang Xiangqian muttered, suddenly thinking of something, "Wait, Du Tao? Brother Fan, you’re talking about that Du Tao...?"
Du Tao, the president of Tianxue Entertainment, a big shot in the entertainment industry who could make waves with a single move!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "That’s right."
Wang Xiangqian was taken aback; Brother Fan actually knew the entertainment mogul Du Tao!
Lin Fan didn’t tell Wang Xiangqian that he not only knew Du Tao, but he was also Du Tao’s boss.
If Wang Xiangqian knew, he’d probably be petrified on the spot.
Lin Fan said, "Back to the main issue, Xiaoyue’s current ranking is the result of her fans working tirelessly. She has a large fanbase that’s actively voting, so naturally, her rank goes up. Even though she’s being criticized online, it’s like the fans’ voices are silent; in reality, they’re channeling their anger into diligent voting. Meanwhile, those criticizing her, although numerous, can’t organize voting, so it doesn’t affect the ranking."
Lin Fan’s words might very well be the truth.
The crowd finally understood why Ning Xiaoyue’s rank had risen.
Wang Xiangqian gratefully said, "Good thing Brother Fan is here, or I’d still be in the dark. Alright, let’s do as Brother Fan suggested. Next, our company will connect with fan organizations, set up an official fan club, and focus on supporting Xiaoyue, working together to help her debut."
Lin Fan said, "Besides that, in response to the online questioning, the company should make a statement. It’s time to let them hear the fans’ voices."
At that moment, Lin Fan received a call from Du Tao.
"Mr. Lin, I’ve used some connections and found out that this wave against Ning Xiaoyue indeed involves some contestants’ companies taking action, including Feng Tianming," Du Tao said.
On his way to the company, Lin Fan had tasked Du Tao with finding out who was targeting Ning Xiaoyue.
Lin Fan asked, "Any ways to counter this?"
Du Tao replied, "Yes..."
Following Lin Fan’s instructions, Wenyue Company’s statement was soon released.
The statement emphasized the fans’ efforts and requested netizens to stop making false statements about Ning Xiaoyue.
This statement effectively silenced the netizens’ doubts.
Meanwhile.
Several contestants’ companies suddenly received an email on the same day.
The email contained evidence showing these companies had hired trolls to attack Ning Xiaoyue.
The email came from Tianxue Entertainment, with the signature of President Du Tao!
The recipients of the email were all covered in cold sweat.
This email was clearly a warning that Ning Xiaoyue had caught the attention of Tianxue Entertainment President Du Tao! If they continued attacking Ning Xiaoyue, they might face retaliation from Du Tao!
These companies knew well they were no match for Tianxue Entertainment!
Suddenly, all these companies ceased their actions and sought opportunities to apologize to Du Tao in person.
What they didn’t know was that the person who could have Du Tao personally step in to protect Ning Xiaoyue was Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: The Richest Man in Jiangnan? Didn’t Expect to Encounter Him So Soon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Chapter 379: The Richest Man in Jiangnan? Didn’t Expect to Encounter Him So Soon!
Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce away from Wenyue Company.
As he drove, he was also on a call with Du Tao.
"Mr. Lin, I have already warned those companies. I don’t think they’ll dare to cause trouble again. You can rest assured, Mr. Lin. If I can’t handle these small fry after all these years in the entertainment industry, then I’ve been wasting my time," Du Tao chuckled.
Lin Fan laughed heartily, "Thanks for the trouble."
Du Tao said, "Mr. Lin, please don’t say that. It’s my honor to work for you."
Though Du Tao was a big shot in the entertainment circle, feared by no one, he held Lin Fan in high regard. The last time he saw Lin Fan, Lin was just a mysterious upstart in Yun City. Now, Lin Fan has become the new richest man in Yun City.
This rapid rise was nothing short of a miracle.
In Du Tao’s eyes, Mr. Lin was a god-like figure now.
The big shot of the entertainment circle took pride in being a follower of Lin Fan...
"Mr. Lin, there’s another matter I need to mention," Du Tao added.
Lin Fan said, "Go ahead."
Du Tao said, "From what I understand, the entertainment company Feng Tianming invested in has now been acquired by Cherry Entertainment. Cherry Entertainment is one of the top three companies in the entertainment industry and a competitor of our Tianxue. So this time, I didn’t send a warning email to Feng Tianming."
Lin Fan furrowed his brows, "Cherry Entertainment?"
Du Tao said, "To deal with Cherry Entertainment, we’ll need a different strategy. The boss of Cherry, Wei Jiansheng, is not simple. Have you heard of the Wangu Group, Mr. Lin?"
Wangu Group!
Lin Fan indeed had heard of it.
He had heard Anna mention it.
The head of Wangu Group, Wei Tiansheng, is the richest man in Jiangnan!
Currently, Lin Fan is merely the richest man in Yun City, whereas Wei Tiansheng is known as the richest man in Jiangnan. Wangu Group is a giant based in Hang City, Jiangnan, with a market value of 350 billion. It’s a behemoth.
Du Tao said, "This Wei Jiansheng is the third son of Wei Tiansheng. He got involved in the entertainment industry early on, and his status now can rival mine. Mr. Lin, this person is not to be trifled with, mainly because he’s Wei Tiansheng’s son."
"Wei Tiansheng, huh..."
Lin Fan’s eyes flashed with a hint of coldness.
He had once told Anna that he wanted to become the king of Jiangnan, and Wei Tiansheng was the one he intended to defeat.
However, Lin Fan was in Yun City, while Wei Tiansheng’s Wangu Group was far away in Hang City, so Lin Fan thought he wouldn’t encounter Wei Tiansheng so soon.
Unexpectedly, due to Ning Xiaoyue, he would soon have to contend with the Wei Family.
Lin Fan said, "I understand. Let’s just wait and see. If the other side makes another move, then it will mean war!"
Lin Fan’s mindset was that he wouldn’t provoke trouble, but he also wasn’t afraid of it. If the other side dared to act foolishly, whether it was Wei Tiansheng’s son or the emperor’s son, Lin Fan would not be lenient.
Just as Du Tao mentioned, the entertainment company Feng Tianming invested in was indeed acquired by Cherry Entertainment shortly after Feng Tianming’s investment.
With Cherry Entertainment as a powerful backing, Feng Tianming gained great confidence.
However, today he suffered embarrassment at Wenyue Company and left dejectedly, growing more furious the more he thought about it.
He was unwilling to let it go and couldn’t swallow his anger. He wanted to continue to target Ning Xiaoyue.
Before long, Feng Tianming figured out that the reason Ning Xiaoyue could rank second was due to Ning Xiaoyue’s massive fanbase.
Despite the online backlash against Ning Xiaoyue, these fans were fiercely voting for her. In fact, the harsher the online criticism, the more it fueled their rebellious spirit. They voted tirelessly, determined to get Ning Xiaoyue to debut.
Upon understanding this reason, Feng Tianming was nearly consumed with jealousy.
With such poor singing and dancing skills, how could Ning Xiaoyue attract so many fans? It was truly something to envy, loathe, and hate.
It seemed that to take Ning Xiaoyue down, he needed a targeted approach, namely, to strike at her fanbase!
If he could stop Ning Xiaoyue’s fans from voting, her ranking would naturally drop.
How to dampen the enthusiasm of the fans’ voting?
Feng Tianming thought of a malicious idea...
Lin Fan was unaware at this moment that Feng Tianming was already preparing his next move against Ning Xiaoyue.
He drove the Rolls-Royce back to the apartment in the urban village.
The night was already deep.
When Lin Fan entered, he found that Wei Qingxue had already fallen asleep on the bed, with the door open.
Clearly, Wei Qingxue didn’t intend to go to sleep so early. She planned to wait for Lin Fan to return, but as she waited, she fell asleep on the bed, not even closing the door.
Fast asleep, Wei Qingxue’s face was flushed, and her features were delicate and exquisite. Her figure under the pajamas was exquisite, truly a sleeping beauty. Lin Fan could hardly resist wanting to sneak a kiss.
This woman was now his legitimate wife.
But in the end, Lin Fan didn’t do it. The first clause of the marriage agreement he signed with Wei Qingxue was not to touch her.
Lin Fan pulled the quilt over her and quietly left the room, closing the door softly as he did.
He couldn’t help it; he feared that if he looked at her a bit longer, he wouldn’t be able to resist. After all, he was a normal man, not Liu Xia Hui.
Lin Fan then went to take a shower and slept on the sofa in the living room.
Nothing happened during the night.
The next morning, Lin Fan was awakened by a scream and quickly stood up.
It turned out that Wei Qingxue had just woken up, realizing she had accidentally fallen asleep last night with a quilt over her. She instinctively screamed in surprise.
Wei Qingxue hastily checked herself and found no signs of being disturbed, finally breathing a sigh of relief.
Then she heard a knock on the door. Lin Fan said, "Are you okay?"
Wei Qingxue saw that the door was closed, thinking for a moment, she replied, "I’m fine. You can come in."
Lin Fan then pushed the door open.
Wei Qingxue said, "Was it you who covered me with the quilt and closed the door last night?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Who else but me?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I had been planning to wait for you to come back last night, but as you took so long, I accidentally fell asleep."
Otherwise, she would have locked the door securely. How could she possibly give Lin Fan such an opportunity, despite their agreement of three conditions, she was a great beauty, after all, and it was hard to guarantee Lin Fan wouldn’t be tempted.
Lin Fan chuckled, "You can rest assured now."
Wei Qingxue said, "Well, yesterday was just an unexpected test, and you passed. By the way, why did you deliver packages so late yesterday?"
Lin Fan casually replied, "Yeah, there were a lot of orders."
Wei Qingxue asked, "Are you going out to deliver packages again today?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Do you have something in mind?"
He certainly didn’t expect Wei Qingxue to care about his job. In her eyes, he was just a deliveryman. As a daughter of a wealthy family, how could she possibly care? She must have something to ask.
Sure enough, Wei Qingxue blushed, "I wanted you to accompany me somewhere."
Lin Fan asked, "Where to?"
Ning Xiaoyue said, "My home."
The Wei Family of three lived in a residential complex. After escaping the banquet yesterday, Wei Qingxue didn’t dare return home, spending the night at Lin Fan’s place instead.
She hadn’t brought anything with her, so she needed to go back home. Also, she heard that her mother, Li Xueyan, was quite upset, and she wanted to check on her.
She didn’t dare to go home alone, feeling more at ease if Lin Fan accompanied her. Last night, she wanted to talk to Lin Fan about this but accidentally fell asleep.
Lin Fan agreed with a simple "Oh".
Soon, Lin Fan was riding his beloved little electric scooter, taking Wei Qingxue home.
At the entrance of the complex, the two were stopped by the security guard.
Meanwhile, Li Xueyan was chatting with a neighbor at the doorway. Upon seeing Lin Fan riding a shabby electric scooter, her face immediately fell.
"Hey, isn’t that Xiaoxue? Why is she coming back on an electric scooter?" the curious neighbor asked.
At these words, Li Xueyan felt utterly embarrassed, wishing to disappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Mother-in-law, do you want to ride in my car
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 380: Mother-in-law, do you want to ride in my car
Yujing District, Wei Qingxue and her parents live here.
Wei Qingxue’s father, Wei Dazong, is the second son of Elder Wei. Elder Wei had a rule that apart from the eldest son, the rest of the Wei Family children must move out of the Wei Family Mansion after marriage.
Lin Fan rode his little electric scooter, carrying Wei Qingxue, and arrived at the entrance of Yujing District.
The two were stopped by the security guard.
"What are you doing?" The security guard, seeing Lin Fan’s unfamiliar face, snapped impatiently.
After all, Lin Fan was riding a shabby electric scooter, clearly a poor chap, so why bother being polite to a pauper?
This was a high-end neighborhood, mostly frequented by luxury cars. The security guard had seen many, so he was used to it, as if he were superior as well.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "I’m here visiting relatives."
He wasn’t wrong. Wei Qingxue’s home was inside; he was her husband, indeed visiting his in-laws.
The security guard scrutinized Lin Fan, looking incredulous: "Visiting relatives? You have relatives inside? Kid, do you know everyone living there is wealthy? How could they have a poor relative like you?"
At this moment, Wei Qingxue lifted her head and said, "He’s with me."
The security guard recognized Wei Qingxue, and immediately nodded and bowed, respectfully saying, "Miss Wei! Sorry, I didn’t notice you earlier, you are...?"
Wei Qingxue usually came in a car, but today, why was she on a shabby electric scooter, making him fail to notice at first?
For someone like the security guard, the first thing to look at was the car. If someone was in a luxury car, they must not be offended; if on a scooter, they must be poor, not even worth another glance.
The commotion here attracted the attention of a pair of middle-aged aunties nearby.
One of the aunties was, surprisingly, Wei Qingxue’s mother, Li Xueyan, and the other was a neighbor living in the district.
Li Xueyan was out for her usual morning exercise and had been chatting with the neighbor auntie.
While talking, the neighbor auntie noticed the voices at the entrance and saw Wei Qingxue at a glance.
"Hey, isn’t that Xiaoxue? Why is she on a scooter? Who’s that man?" the neighbor auntie asked curiously.
Hearing this, Li Xueyan looked over and was almost livid with anger.
Sure enough, Wei Qingxue was seated on a shabby scooter, the driver being her deliveryman son-in-law, Lin Fan.
How embarrassing, Li Xueyan felt she could die from the shame.
"Heh, I don’t know him," Li Xueyan said, not willing to tell the neighbor auntie that this was her son-in-law, a deliveryman pauper. Where would she place her face then!
The neighbor auntie said, "They seem to be stopped by the security guard, let’s go over and see what’s happening."
Saying this, the neighbor auntie moved towards the entrance.
Li Xueyan didn’t want to go over but couldn’t stop the neighbor auntie, so she grudgingly followed.
Just in time, the security guard, due to Wei Qingxue, had decided to let them through.
The security guard curiously asked, "Miss Wei, who is this guy, your relative?"
Miss Wei from the prestigious Yun City Wei Family having such a poor relative was indeed curious.
Wei Qingxue said mildly, "He’s my husband, and this is his home now, security brother, please don’t stop him in the future."
Husband?
The security guard was dumbfounded.
The neighbor auntie was also taken aback, turning to Li Xueyan: "Husband? Xiaoxue married this guy?"
Lin Fan started the scooter, drove into the district, and immediately saw Li Xueyan.
He scooted over, grinning: "Mother-in-law, good morning!"
No more doubt, this poor chap on a scooter was indeed Wei Qingxue’s husband!
The neighbor auntie was stunned.
Li Xueyan was both angry and embarrassed, her face flushed red, utterly losing face in front of the neighbor!
Li Xueyan glared angrily at Lin Fan, then shot a look at Wei Qingxue: "Come home with me!"
She turned to leave, not daring to stay any longer lest she lost even more face.
Lin Fan shouted from behind, "Mother-in-law, do you want to ride with me? It might be cramped, but there’s space."
People around curiously looked over.
Li Xueyan stumbled, almost falling, and hurried away even faster.
Wei Qingxue shook her head in exasperation, convinced Lin Fan did it on purpose, knowing her mother found him embarrassing, yet he seemed eager for the world to know.
Lin Fan watched Li Xueyan’s awkward retreat, sneering internally.
Such were wealthy families, looking down on poor sons-in-law.
As they say, mismatched households cannot be aligned, a rich man’s daughter and a delivery rural boy, completely incompatible. Wealthy family parents generally can’t accept a poor son-in-law.
Li Xueyan was no exception.
In fact, even in poor families now, who would want their daughter to marry a poor man?
Many desperately poor households dreamed of marrying into wealth, while being poor to the core, they too looked down on poor prospective sons-in-law.
Mothers looking for partners for their daughters at matchmaking events had a host of strict conditions for the man: high education, good job, wealth...
Wealth was the most crucial. Wealth meant generous dowries, affluent life, a house, a car...
As long as the financial condition was met, education, age, looks could be ignored.
People nowadays are just this realistic!
Lin Fan had gone on many dates and was used to this.
He harbored a somewhat carefree attitude; since Li Xueyan felt his existence embarrassed her, he might as well embarrass her more, something he long wanted to do to such snobbish aunties.
Due to her embarrassment, Li Xueyan fled back home quickly, mortified and indignant.
In the living room, a middle-aged man was drinking tea and reading the newspaper.
This was Wei Qingxue’s father, Wei Dazong.
Seeing Li Xueyan come in fuming, Wei Dazong curiously asked, "What happened?"
Li Xueyan said angrily, "Qingxue brought her husband back, riding a shabby scooter. I ran into them downstairs, all the neighbors saw, my face was utterly disgraced, I’m furious!"
Wei Dazong made an "oh" sound, his expression turning somewhat displeased.
Yesterday, he was busy with the company’s affairs and didn’t attend the gathering. Later learning about Wei Qingxue’s situation, he was quite shocked. Originally, he planned to plead with Elder Wei today on Wei Qingxue’s behalf.
"Qingxue is quite bold, daring to bring this man home, but it’s just as well, I wanted to meet him." Wei Dazong said.
Li Xueyan said, "I don’t care, I can’t accept this son-in-law, a delivery guy as our daughter’s husband, if word gets out, won’t it make the whole community laugh their teeth off! You must find a way to make them divorce!"
Wei Dazong nodded: "I understand, let me meet him first and then we’ll see."
As they were speaking, Lin Fan followed Wei Qingxue up, and the two pushed the door open and entered.
At the sight of Lin Fan, Li Xueyan angrily glared at him, wanting to chase this poor son-in-law out with a broom.
Wei Dazong looked at Lin Fan, frowning. Lin Fan seemed familiar, as if he’d seen him somewhere, but couldn’t recall at the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: This Son-in-Law, Cannot Be Accepted!
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 381: This Son-in-Law, Cannot Be Accepted!
Probably haven’t met before!
Wei Dazong comforted himself, seeing Lin Fan dressed in clothes from street stalls, an obvious poor person, so there was no need to think much of it.
However, although Lin Fan was a poor boy, at least he looked decent, which made Wei Dazong gain some impression of him.
"Dad, Mom, we’re back. Let me introduce, this is Lin Fan, my husband. Lin Fan, this is my dad." Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Hello, father-in-law. It’s our first meeting and I came in a hurry, so I didn’t bring any presents. I’ll make up for it next time. I hope you two don’t mind."
Li Xueyan rolled her eyes and muttered, "Who cares about your gift? A useless courier, what could you even possibly give."
Wei Dazong said flatly, "No need, come and sit."
Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue came to sit on the living room sofa.
Wei Dazong said, "Qingxue, I’ve already heard about you two from your mom, but I still have some questions. I hope you answer truthfully, my daughter."
Wei Qingxue said, "Dad, what do you want to ask?"
Wei Dazong said, "How did you two meet, when did you get married, and why did you keep it from us?"
Wei Qingxue said, "He delivered express packages to me a few times, so we got to know each other and then fell in love. I feared you wouldn’t allow us to marry, so we simply eloped. This time, Grandpa arranged a match for me with the Ma Family, so I couldn’t hide it any longer, and that’s why you found out. I’m sorry."
Li Xueyan stamped her foot and said, "You foolish child, how could you just marry someone like that, giving me the heartache of an elopement, this is so infuriating!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "She didn’t marry just anyone. We truly love each other, right dear wife?"
Saying this, Lin Fan reached out and wrapped his arm around Wei Qingxue’s waist. Hmm, this slender waist is really soft.
"Mm..."
Wei Qingxue bit her lip. Lin Fan was taking advantage, but she couldn’t push his hand away, otherwise, the truth would come out, so she just let him hold her. It was really embarrassing.
Li Xueyan, extremely angry, pointed at Lin Fan and said, "Shut up! Is it your turn to speak here? And take your hands off, what propriety!"
Wei Dazong looked at Lin Fan with some displeasure. It was one thing for the courier to be poor, but he seemed somewhat frivolous, not like a dependable person.
His impression of Lin Fan instantly dropped to zero.
"Lin Fan, is it? I don’t know anything about you yet. Where are you from, and what’s your background?" Wei Dazong asked.
Lin Fan said, "Simply put, I’m from a mountain village, a remote small countryside. My parents are farmers, and I’m currently working as a courier, renting a house in the urban village."
"Oh my God!"
Li Xueyan’s eyes turned dark. What kind of person did Wei Qingxue marry? A country bumpkin from a remote mountain village!
This meant no house, no car, no money—a complete nobody!
The type of person Li Xueyan despised the most.
What a disaster!
The precious daughter of the Wei Family, Wei Qingxue, really must be blind!
Wei Dazong’s heart sank. Lin Fan’s family background wasn’t even good enough to lift the Wei Family’s shoes. Even the servants hired by the Wei Family weren’t countryside people, and now the Wei Family’s son-in-law turned out to be one!
In Wei Dazong’s mind, Lin Fan’s impression instantly turned negative.
No need to say anything more; this son-in-law, Lin Fan, is unacceptable!
Wei Dazong made up his mind and said, "Since you’re here, stay for lunch. The family hasn’t bought groceries today. Qingxue, go and buy some."
This was obviously an attempt to send Wei Qingxue away.
Wei Qingxue said, "Then I’ll go with Lin Fan to buy the groceries."
Wei Dazong said, "No need. It’s our first meeting, and we’ll have a chat. Qingxue, you go ahead."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, dear wife, you go ahead. I’ll be here on my own and take the opportunity to get to know my father-in-law better."
"Okay." Wei Qingxue had no choice but to leave. Lin Fan’s words implied that he could handle it, so she didn’t say much more.
After Wei Qingxue left.
"Lin Fan, would you like something to drink?" Wei Dazong asked.
Lin Fan said, "You know, I walked all the way and got a bit thirsty, though I rarely drink beverages. Tea would be fine."
Wei Dazong happened to be making tea, so he poured a cup for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took a sip from the teacup and thought the tea wasn’t bad. Although not as good as the Huang Mountain’s Mao Feng Anna gave him, nor the Ancient Tree Pu’er Tea he drank at the Chu Family, it was still a good tea that only wealthy families could afford.
"I won’t beat around the bush. Let’s get straight to the point. I want you to divorce Qingxue!" Wei Dazong suddenly said.
Lin Fan was sipping tea at the moment. Anyone else might have spat it out, but Lin Fan didn’t panic at all. He calmly put down the cup and swallowed the tea.
"Father-in-law, this tea is really good. When I leave, may I take some back with me?" Lin Fan smiled and said.
Li Xueyan was furious: "Don’t pretend you didn’t hear. We want you to divorce Qingxue, did you hear?"
Lin Fan acknowledged with an "Oh," put on a serious face, and said, "May I ask what the reason is for this request?"
Li Xueyan sneered, "Does it even need a reason? You, a useless fool, aren’t worthy of my daughter. Your marriage is wrong, and divorce is right!"
Her words were harsh indeed. Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered with her; she had never shown him any friendliness anyway.
Lin Fan said, "If you don’t provide a reasonable reason, I’m afraid I can’t comply."
"Lin Fan, who do you think you are? When you’re told to do something, you just do it. Why so much nonsense?" Li Xueyan angrily jumped up, pointing her finger at Lin Fan’s nose.
Wei Dazong calmed the furious Li Xueyan and said calmly, "Lin Fan, you should know by now that our Wei Family’s business recently encountered a problem that requires urgent financial assistance. We’ve done all we can, and only the Ma Family is willing to provide financial aid to help us through the crisis. Their only condition is that Young Master Ma marries Qingxue, and the Wei and Ma Families form an alliance."
Lin Fan said, "I know about this. It’s supposed to be 1 billion, right? Not that much."
Li Xueyan snorted, "I don’t know where you get your confidence from, saying such things. You’re a country bumpkin and a poor man; I bet you can’t even come up with 1,000 yuan. And you say 1 billion isn’t much?"
She was genuinely disdainful of Lin Fan, her words full of venom and spite.
Lin Fan chuckled at Li Xueyan’s ignorance. If 1 billion was considered a lot, he had 100 billion in cash in his bank account. How about that?
Wei Dazong didn’t stoop to Li Xueyan’s level of insults. He considered himself a person of quality and grace.
"Lin Fan, I’m telling you to divorce Qingxue not as a discussion but as a notification, because this is something that must be done. What will it take for you to leave Qingxue? Name your conditions, and let’s get this done straightforwardly." Wei Dazong said.
This was a notification, not a negotiation. Lin Fan held no value for negotiation in his eyes.
Li Xueyan sneered, "This broke wretch tricked Qingxue into marriage just to extort us. Fine, let’s throw some money at you, as one would to get rid of a beggar!"
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, I had no intention of negotiating any terms with you, and I certainly don’t need money. The only reason I would consider divorcing is if Qingxue herself asked for it."
What?
Li Xueyan’s face changed. This broke wretch didn’t want money? That wasn’t logical!
Lin Fan continued, "Moreover, I promised Qingxue that I would help her find a way to raise the money and solve the company’s difficulties."
The couple was amused listening to this. Lin Fan helping to raise money? Did they hear wrong? That was 1 billion, where did this courier get the confidence from?

chapters.title: Chapter 382: I Enjoy Being a Kept Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 382: I Enjoy Being a Kept Man
When Lin Fan said he wanted to help solve the Wei Family Company’s difficulties, Wei Dazong and his wife couldn’t help but laugh.
"You’re going to help? Did I hear that right? Where do you get the confidence to say such a thing?" Li Xueyan laughed loudly.
Wei Dazong said, "That’s the funniest joke I’ve ever heard, Lin Fan. It’s important for a person to have self-awareness, and I hope you do too."
Li Xueyan said, "I think he’s shameless and boastful! If this bumpkin can come up with a billion, I’ll kneel and knock my head on the ground for him!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Mother-in-law, you can’t just say anything. After all, you are my elder. How can I let you kneel?"
Li Xueyan was furious: "Stop grinning here, you useless waste. It’s not that I’m looking down on you, but people like you are just unworthy! If you have any sense, divorce Qingxue immediately! Otherwise, don’t blame me for being rude to you!"
A bare-faced threat indeed.
Lin Fan was very calm: "Mother-in-law, there’s no need to scare me. You’re already being rude to me right now, what more can you do? I’ve made it very clear, unless Qingxue asks for a divorce, I will not divorce."
"You!" Li Xueyan was infuriated.
Lin Fan wouldn’t divorce, and she couldn’t just chop him off, could she?
While Wei Dazong was also angry, he was more composed than Li Xueyan and chuckled, "Lin Fan, I haven’t asked you yet, how many brothers and sisters do you have in your family?"
Lin Fan didn’t know why he was asking this and replied honestly, "Just me and a sister."
Wei Dazong was slightly pleased when he heard this and said, "I might as well tell you, I only have one daughter, Qingxue. My requirement for a son-in-law is that he marries into our Wei Family. Are you willing? If not, then you can only divorce."
Marry in!
That’s being a live-in son-in-law, which is equivalent to the wife joining the husband’s family, and any sons born will also carry the wife’s surname, continuing the wife’s family line!
Lin Fan was also the only male in his family, responsible for continuing the Lin Family line. How could he possibly become a son-in-law!
Wei Dazong said, "Think about it carefully. You’re the only one in your family to carry on the lineage. Marrying into my Wei Family means the Lin Family’s legacy ends, which can be considered unfaithful and unfilial, outrageous! That’s one. The second is, being a live-in son-in-law is viewed as a freeloader by outsiders, inviting ridicule, and a man’s dignity is lost. What do you think?"
Lin Fan said, "I think everything you said is right."
Wei Dazong chuckled, "You agree, right? Then it’s easy. If you don’t want to be a live-in son-in-law, then divorce Qingxue!"
Lin Fan, however, laughed and said, "You said it all right, but I’m willing."
Wei Dazong’s smile froze: "What, you’re willing to be a live-in son-in-law?"
Lin Fan said, "What’s wrong with that? I don’t have much family commitment, and what’s the issue with whose surname the child carries? Furthermore, our country now allows two children. By then, we can have two; one surnamed Lin, the other Wei, won’t that resolve the lineage issue? At the worst, don’t I have a sister? She can also find a freeloader to continue our Lin Family name. As for being mocked for freeloading, it doesn’t matter, many men are just envious. They want to freeload but can’t. I just like freeloading, so what? I’m happy freeloading. With freeloading, I don’t want to work hard."
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were dumbfounded, cold sweat pouring down.
Damn!
They’ve seen shameless people before, but none so shameless as this.
Lin Fan’s face is just too thick!
Lin Fan grinned, "So, in a nutshell, I’m very willing to be a live-in son-in-law!"
In reality, Lin Fan didn’t really want to be a live-in son-in-law. But since they tried to force him into divorce with this, he couldn’t just succumb. Plus, his marriage with Wei Qingxue was just a sham, and they would eventually divorce, so becoming a live-in son-in-law temporarily was no big deal!
Wei Dazong was speechless. Lin Fan took pride in freeloading; being so shameless, what could he do?
Li Xueyan was enraged, pointing at Lin Fan and cursing: "You... you... you’re a disgrace to men!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Mother-in-law, don’t get too worked up, being angry is bad for your health. Qingxue and I’s child can’t be without a grandma."
Upon hearing this, thinking that Lin Fan would have a child with Wei Qingxue, Li Xueyan nearly spat blood.
Lin Fan’s face was thicker than a wall; taking pride in freeloading, such a person was too difficult to deal with.
Wei Dazong gritted his teeth and said, "Lin Fan, if you agree to leave Qingxue, I’ll give you a million. If you think it’s too little, we can negotiate."
Everyone has a price. Faced with a sudden fortune of a million, someone like Lin Fan from society’s bottom was sure to be tempted.
Wei Dazong believed that Lin Fan married Wei Qingxue for money, in the end.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "A million is indeed a bit low. How about this, give me a billion, and I might consider."
A billion!
Wei Dazong’s face darkened, unable to hold back his anger: "Lin Fan, that’s exorbitant!"
If he had a billion, he wouldn’t need to fuss over Qingxue’s marriage, he would have used it to fill the company’s gaps.
Lin Fan laughed, "You’re trying to use money to buy a divorce, thinking I can be bought. And I can be, but starting at a billion, which isn’t much. Think about it, marrying into your wealthy Wei Family is a long-term meal ticket. Divorce means losing that, so I definitely need more compensation to make up for my loss."
Wei Dazong was also exasperated: "..."
Struck silent for a moment.
It seemed that forcing Lin Fan to take the initiative to divorce Wei Qingxue was nearly impossible.
This Lin Fan was too steady, impermeable, and shameless. There was no way to tackle him.
It seemed their only strategy for them to divorce was to work on Wei Qingxue.
Soon, Wei Qingxue returned with groceries.
Seeing the strange expressions of the three, Wei Qingxue curiously asked, "What are you talking about?"
Failing to persuade, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were too ashamed to bring it up, especially since they had sent Wei Qingxue away to avoid embarrassing their daughter.
Lin Fan said, "Nothing, just chatting casually."
Lin Fan didn’t want Wei Qingxue to know what just happened either; knowing would only make her unhappy.
Wei Qingxue was a bit curious, could it be that Lin Fan actually got along with her parents?
"Qingxue, let me join you in the kitchen!" Li Xueyan said. She couldn’t stay any longer; she feared if she looked at Lin Fan any longer, she’d die from anger.
They sat down to eat, and it was nearly noon already.
The four sat together for a meal.
Wei Qingxue said, "Dad, Mom, I actually came back today intending to pack and temporarily move to live with Lin Fan."
Li Xueyan was the first to oppose: "How is that possible, doesn’t he live in a city village? How could you possibly get used to a place like that!"
Wei Dazong agreed, "Your mom is right. As the precious daughter of the Wei Family, how could you live in such a place!"
Wei Qingxue said, "It’s uncomfortable, but there’s no choice. I’ve been kicked out of the Wei Family by grandpa, and you won’t accept Lin Fan, so that’s all I can do."
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan exchanged a helpless glance.
"Daughter, come home and live, mom can’t let you suffer!" Li Xueyan said.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What about me, can I move in too?"

chapters.title: Chapter 383: This Lin Fan, Particularly Unambitious
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 383: This Lin Fan, Particularly Unambitious
Lin Fan is now the live-in son-in-law of the Wei Family. Theoretically, this is his home, so naturally, he can come back to live here.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan couldn’t stop him; after all, they couldn’t bear to let Wei Qingxue live in the urban village. If they stopped Lin Fan, Wei Qingxue might leave with him.
In fact, on one hand, Wei Qingxue didn’t want to live in the urban village. On the other hand, she also didn’t want Lin Fan to move into the house.
She and Lin Fan are a fake couple; how could they live together? It’s so inconvenient.
But Lin Fan proposed it, and she couldn’t say no. Otherwise, the truth would be exposed, so she had to live with Lin Fan.
This way, her parents definitely wouldn’t doubt their relationship and would think they are truly in love.
Thinking of sleeping in the same room with Lin Fan made Wei Qingxue blush and her heart race. She had never shared a room with a man before.
For Wei Dazong and his wife, letting Lin Fan stay at home didn’t mean they accepted him as the live-in son-in-law. They would still find ways to make them divorce.
Wei Dazong’s original plan was to negotiate privately with Lin Fan. As long as they divorced, he could plead for Wei Qingxue in front of Elder Wei, thus likely gaining the old man’s forgiveness.
But it has been proven that they cannot handle Lin Fan.
So they could only find another way.
"Qingxue, tomorrow is your grandpa’s birthday banquet. You also need to go and apologize to him in person to seek his forgiveness," Wei Dazong said.
Wei Qingxue bitterly smiled and said, "Will Grandpa really forgive me?"
Wei Dazong said, "You are his favorite granddaughter, and he has always had high hopes for you. It was he who insisted on you becoming the president back then. You are still the best candidate for the company president, and he will definitely forgive you."
Wei Dazong had already decided to use a second method: first, make Elder Wei forgive Wei Qingxue. Today, he would personally go to plead with Elder Wei.
Wei Qingxue said, "For Grandpa to forgive me, I must solve the company’s difficulties. But I will never remarry Ma Jialiang."
Li Xueyan said, "Silly child, what can you do? Can you be more capable than your grandpa? Your grandpa has tried every possible way, but he can’t fill this 1 billion-dollar hole. In the end, he only found the Ma Family, and you refuse to remarry..."
Lin Fan laughed, "Mother-in-law, there’s no way Qingxue and I will divorce, so don’t think about breaking us up."
Li Xueyan rolled her eyes, unwilling to deal with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "As for the company’s difficulties, I’ve already said I’ll help solve them."
Li Xueyan couldn’t bear it anymore and said, "No one would think you’re mute if you don’t speak. Is this the time for jokes? And your joke isn’t funny at all, it’s really annoying!"
Wei Qingxue sighed and said, "Lin Fan, don’t joke like that."
She thought Lin Fan was trying to lighten the mood, but the joke wasn’t funny at all. Lin Fan, a courier, couldn’t possibly help.
Lin Fan smiled and said no more, but he already had a plan in his mind.
This was a task given by the system, and he had to complete it.
Ring ring ring...
Just then, Lin Fan’s phone rang. It was Zhao Jiayi calling.
"Chairman, there is a board meeting at 1 pm today. Can you attend?" Zhao Jiayi asked.
Lin Fan said, "I can."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan stood up and said, "You guys continue eating, I have to go to work."
This place is a bit far from the airline company’s headquarters. If he rides his e-bike now, he should arrive just in time for the meeting.
Lin Fan turned to leave.
"Lin Fan!" Wei Qingxue called out to him from behind.
Lin Fan turned his head, "Hmm?"
Wei Qingxue bit her lip and said, "Come back early tonight..."
Lin Fan grinned, "I will."
Then he went out.
After Lin Fan left, Li Xueyan put down her chopsticks, feeling depressed.
"Daughter, I really don’t get it. How could you fall for a courier? Look at him going out to deliver parcels again. Aren’t you ashamed of this low-class job? You may not be embarrassed, but I am. How can I face the neighbors anymore, I can’t show my face," Li Xueyan said, wishing Wei Qingxue would immediately divorce Lin Fan.
What she didn’t know was that Lin Fan was going out, not to deliver parcels, but to attend a board meeting of a company with a market value of 200 billion as its chairman.
If she knew, she’d probably be shocked.
Wei Qingxue said, "Mom, stop talking. If you keep talking about me and Lin Fan, I can only move out."
Li Xueyan was suffocating and said, "I’m full, I’m going back to my room for a nap!"
Wei Qingxue knew her mom wasn’t satisfied with Lin Fan, but she had no choice. She had her plan. Once she solved the company’s difficulties and Grandpa agreed she wouldn’t have to marry Ma Jialiang, she would naturally divorce Lin Fan.
Not yet.
Wei Dazong said, "Qingxue, don’t blame your mom. She’s only thinking of you. Marrying a courier won’t bring you happiness, and Lin Fan particularly lacks ambition!"
Wei Qingxue curiously asked, "Dad, why do you say that about Lin Fan?"
Wei Dazong said, "You were out buying groceries just now, so you didn’t know. I chatted with Lin Fan a bit. The guy is quite content to be our live-in son-in-law and takes pride in living off someone else. How can such a person have ambition?"
Wei Qingxue was taken aback and didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. She couldn’t be sure if Lin Fan was joking with her dad. If it was true, then Lin Fan indeed lacked ambition. Who would respect a man who lived off others?
Luckily, whether Lin Fan was serious or not, their relationship was fake. She wouldn’t really fall in love with Lin Fan.
She was confident she wouldn’t fall in love with Lin Fan. She was just asking for his help. A wealthy heiress and a courier at the bottom of society are simply not people who belong in the same world.
Wei Dazong said, "I won’t say more, lest you threaten to move out again. Just think it through yourself. I have to go out too."
He was going to find Elder Wei to secure an opportunity for Wei Qingxue.
The day passed like this.
By evening, Lin Fan came back from the company. As the live-in son-in-law, he was going to spend his first night in this new home.
After they had dinner, the two went into the room.
Seeing them enter the room and close the door, both Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan felt uncomfortable. They always harbored a fantasy that Wei Qingxue didn’t really like Lin Fan and was just using him as a shield.
But now, even that final fantasy had shattered.
Inside Wei Qingxue’s room.
Wei Qingxue had already climbed into bed, and Lin Fan also came to sit by the bed.
Wei Qingxue was immediately wary and said, "What are you doing?"
Lin Fan said, "Sleeping."
Wei Qingxue blushed and said, "You think you can sleep in the same bed as me? Dream on. You sleep on the floor; there’s a mat in the wardrobe!"
Saying that, Wei Qingxue tossed a pillow at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound and had no choice but to obediently sleep on the floor.
Wei Qingxue was uneasy. She lay there, unable to sleep, and after holding it in for a while, she finally reminded him, "Lin Fan, I’m warning you, don’t do anything bad while I’m asleep. We have a contract. If you..."
The sound of snoring...
Only then did Wei Qingxue realize that this guy Lin Fan had actually fallen asleep.
Wei Qingxue was happy and finally relaxed, falling asleep shortly after.
After she fell asleep, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes and smiled slightly. He knew that she wasn’t at ease, so he had pretended to sleep earlier to let her rest assured.
Probably for a while in the future, he’ll have to play this little trick. Sigh, being a fake husband is often so plain and dull!

chapters.title: Chapter 384: Sorry, I embarrassed you
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Chapter 384: Sorry, I embarrassed you
Seeing Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue enter the room and close the door, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were both seething with anger.
Previously, they still had a glimmer of hope that Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue were in a fake marriage. Now, with a man and a woman alone in one room, it was a done deal. Their daughter was indeed with a deliveryman!
The couple returned to their room, both looking frustrated. Their daughter had married someone from the lower social strata, and they were really not willing to accept it.
"What kind of bad luck have we had to deserve this? Our only daughter, how did she end up liking a deliveryman!" Li Xueyan stomped her foot and said.
Wei Dazong said, "We absolutely cannot let them continue. Lin Fan is clinging to our Wei Family, only wanting to freeload, so we can only work on changing Qingxue’s mind."
Li Xueyan said, "I think this girl is just out of her mind. Otherwise, how could she fancy a deliveryman? Just talking it out won’t work, in my opinion. We need to think of a way to break them up!"
Wei Dazong said, "What way?"
Li Xueyan said, "That’s why I’m discussing it with you, think it through!"
So the couple racked their brains, discussing strategies through the night...
On the other side, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue were in the same room, but Wei Qingxue wouldn’t let Lin Fan on the bed and had him sleep on the floor.
Wei Qingxue was still uneasy, fearing Lin Fan might do something bad while she was asleep, so she didn’t dare to fall asleep.
Later, realizing Lin Fan had fallen asleep, she finally felt at ease and quickly drifted off to sleep.
Unbeknownst to her, Lin Fan was pretending to sleep. Sensing that she was tossing and turning, unable to sleep, he feigned slumber to reassure her.
Seeing Wei Qingxue already asleep, Lin Fan soon fell asleep as well.
The night passed without incident.
The next morning, Wei Qingxue woke up, abruptly sat up, checked herself, and discovered that she hadn’t been disturbed, which was a relief. Glancing around, she noticed Lin Fan was still asleep, covered with a blanket, leaving only his face visible.
Wei Qingxue stared for a moment, and the thought involuntarily popped into her head: So handsome!
Ignoring Lin Fan’s cheap outfit, just looking at this face, it was absolutely striking, that kind of refreshing masculinity, almost exuding the scent of fresh grass.
For the first time, Wei Qingxue noticed how handsome Lin Fan was. Before, she was desperately seeking a solution and brought Lin Fan as a shield.
Unfortunately...
What good is being handsome? Lin Fan is still just a deliveryman, not someone from the same world as her... She could never truly be with a deliveryman.
Once everything is over, she’ll divorce Lin Fan.
"Why are you staring at me?"
Suddenly, Lin Fan spoke. It turned out he was already awake and, upon opening his eyes, saw Wei Qingxue staring at him in a daze.
Wei Qingxue quickly averted her gaze, blushing and unwilling to admit: "Who’s staring at you?"
Lin Fan said, "You were definitely looking. You weren’t mesmerized by my good looks, were you? I’m telling you, there’s no chance for us!"
Wei Qingxue spat: "Stop being so full of yourself; who would be mesmerized by you, seriously."
Lin Fan found it amusing. He was deliberately speaking that way, so she wouldn’t be wary of him.
Sure enough, Lin Fan’s words made Wei Qingxue a bit less guarded, seeing that Lin Fan knew his place, he wouldn’t do anything excessive to her.
In just a few days, Wei Qingxue had no guard left against Lin Fan. She didn’t even wait for him to pretend to sleep before comfortably drifting off herself.
"Are you going out to make deliveries today?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Lin Fan said, "Yeah."
Wei Qingxue said, "Tonight is Grandpa’s birthday banquet. I’ll transfer money to you in a bit, and you buy a birthday gift and we’ll go together tonight."
Yesterday, Wei Dazong had personally pleaded with Elder Wei, and Elder Wei had agreed to give Wei Qingxue an opportunity, allowing her to attend his birthday banquet tonight.
Lin Fan readily agreed, "Sure."
He was Wei Qingxue’s shield. Since she wanted him to go to the birthday banquet with her, it was natural for him not to decline.
Moreover, the banquet would surely be no simple affair. Elder Wei might even try to pressure Wei Qingxue, and he needed to protect her.
Why else would the system give him this task? He had to complete it...
The two then left the room.
Wei Qingxue immediately noticed Li Xueyan sitting in the living room watching TV, while Wei Dazong had already left for work.
"Mom, what’s for breakfast?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Li Xueyan glanced at the two of them, thinking about them sleeping together last night, and couldn’t help but feel her eyes were aflame.
"There’s no breakfast; your dad went out hungry too. How could I have the face to go out and buy groceries now? The whole community knows we’ve taken in a live-in son-in-law. What, aren’t the neighbors laughing their heads off whenever they see me!" Li Xueyan said with displeasure.
She was so embarrassed by Lin Fan that she didn’t even dare leave the house.
Wei Qingxue sighed, "Alright, I’ll go buy some. Mom, what do you want to eat?"
Li Xueyan said, "Anything, no appetite!"
Lin Fan said, "I’ll go down with you. I need to head out."
So, the two went downstairs together.
In the elevator, Wei Qingxue awkwardly said, "Lin Fan, I’m sorry, I apologize on my mother’s behalf."
Lin Fan was just hired by her as a shield, and he was subjected to her mother’s coldness, which made her feel guilty.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s alright. We delivery folks get the cold shoulder a lot every day. I’m used to it."
Wei Qingxue bit her lip; she didn’t know what to say for a moment.
Early in the morning, there were already quite a few residents moving about downstairs. As soon as they appeared, they immediately caught the attention of those around them.
Everyone started to point at them.
"The daughter of the Yun City Wei Family actually married a poor guy, tsk tsk!"
"I heard he’s a deliveryman. I really don’t understand why she wouldn’t think it through."
"Such good conditions, what a waste!"
"Now the whole neighborhood knows about this, and everyone is treating it as a joke."
"So funny, I wonder what she sees in him. Maybe it’s his worn-out electric bike!"
The crowd snickered.
Wei Qingxue heard all these mockeries, but she acted as if she didn’t. She then got on Lin Fan’s electric bike, letting him take her to a breakfast shop along the way.
Behind them, laughter continued, mocking her.
"Sorry for causing you embarrassment," Lin Fan said with a slight smile.
Wei Qingxue defiantly said, "Let them be."
Despite her words, she felt hurt inside. Others only knew she married a deliveryman, not realizing that she had orchestrated everything just to avoid a family-arranged marriage.
With Lin Fan’s capabilities, he could easily make these people kneel and turn it into a fawning spectacle, but Lin Fan had no intention of revealing his true identity to Wei Qingxue.
After dropping Wei Qingxue at the breakfast shop, Lin Fan rode his bike out of the community on his own.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for successfully signing in, rewarded with 5 million in cash!"
The system’s voice echoed in his mind.
Lin Fan smiled wryly; the system was still bugged and had just awarded him another 5 million in cash.
Shortly after, Lin Fan received a transfer from Wei Qingxue of 30,000 yuan. This was for buying a gift for Elder Wei.
30,000 yuan wasn’t much; what kind of gift should he buy?
Lin Fan was a bit troubled, and after thinking it over, he decided to call Zhang Dafu: "Old Zhang, it’s me. I have a favor to ask you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 385: The Richest Man Gets Scolded: Truly Poor, Exuding a Stingy Aura
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Chapter 385: The Richest Man Gets Scolded: Truly Poor, Exuding a Stingy Aura
On this day, Lin Fan was busy outside, teaching at the music academy in the morning and attending a company meeting in the afternoon.
By the time Lin Fan finished his work, it was already evening.
Lin Fan suddenly received a call from Wei Qingxue: "Lin Fan, are you back? It’s about time to head over."
Lin Fan replied, "I’m a bit busy today. I need to make a trip to the gift shop. Why don’t you go first? I’ll drive over myself."
Lin Fan picked up a gift box from the gift shop and rode his small electric scooter towards the Wei Family Mansion.
Usually, only Elder Wei and his eldest son Wei Dagang’s family lived in the Wei Family Mansion. The other children had moved out after getting married.
But today, the mansion was unusually lively. Luxury cars gathered outside; all the descendants of the Wei family were present, each dressed glamorously.
Although the Wei Family in Yun City could barely be considered as a second-tier family, the younger generation lived lavishly, and the internal comparisons and conflicts were as dramatic as palace intrigues.
Wei Qingxue drove a red Porsche, bringing Li Xueyan to the scene.
Li Xueyan felt embarrassed because of her son-in-law Lin Fan, and she didn’t dare to go out all day. When she finally did, she wrapped herself tightly, fearing others would recognize her.
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but laugh, "Mom, is it really necessary?"
Li Xueyan replied unhappily, "Of course it’s necessary! Who told you to marry a deliveryman? If you’re not ashamed, I am! If you had married into the Ma Family, I’d be bragging to every household!"
Wei Qingxue felt uncomfortable and speechless.
Once in the car, Li Xueyan removed her disguise, revealing her evening dress. Since tonight was Elder Wei’s birthday, she certainly couldn’t be disrespectful.
As soon as they arrived, people around started pointing and whispering.
"Wasn’t Wei Qingxue expelled from the family? How does she have the nerve to come?"
"Why don’t we see her deliveryman husband? Is she too ashamed to bring him?"
"Of course! Anyone would be embarrassed, right?"
"Had the chance to marry into the Ma Family, but chose a deliveryman instead. Isn’t she asking for humiliation?"
Hearing the ridicule, Li Xueyan quickly left Wei Qingxue and went to find her husband Wei Dazong.
Wei Qingxue didn’t go inside immediately. She was waiting for Lin Fan. Regarding the surrounding remarks, Wei Qingxue put on a cold expression, trying not to care.
After waiting for a while.
"Honey, I’m here!"
Lin Fan came over riding his small scooter, carrying a gift box in one hand.
Upon seeing him, laughter erupted around them.
