"Look at what this freeloader is wearing. Didn’t the boss give him money to buy clothes?"
"Am I seeing this right? This guy rides a broken electric scooter; he’s not afraid of losing a wheel halfway?"
"The boss isn’t kind; she drives a Porsche while her husband rides an electric scooter."
"You don’t understand. In my opinion, this freeloader just isn’t worthy!"
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, pretending not to hear.
At this moment, a brand-new Mercedes-Benz attracted everyone’s attention.
A man and a woman got out of the car; the man looked handsome and was dressed in designer clothes, while the woman had a tall figure and striking looks.
Everyone showed expressions of envy.
"Isn’t this the rumored new boyfriend of Sister Zihan? He’s so wealthy and handsome."
"Young Master Zhu just returned from studying abroad, working for a Fortune 500 company with an annual salary of a million, and, crucially, he’s the Crown Prince of the Zhu Family with no shortage of money!"
"Only Sister Zihan is worthy of Young Master Zhu. Compared to our boss, their choice is worlds apart, picking trash after countless tries!"
Another burst of laughter followed.
Wei Qingxue glanced over with a cold smirk.
Wei Zihan, Wei Tang’s biological sister, like Wei Tang, has always been at odds with Wei Qingxue.
At this time, Wei Zihan was basking in the praise, enjoying her new boyfriend which brought her plenty of pride.
Since she has a bad relationship with Wei Qingxue, she confidently looked at Wei Qingxue, thinking she’s prettier and her boyfriend is miles ahead of Lin Fan. What does Wei Qingxue have to compare?
Pulling her boyfriend, Wei Zihan approached Wei Qingxue.
"Little Sister Qingxue, we haven’t seen in a while. I didn’t expect you’d be married. Why didn’t you tell sister and invite me to your wedding?" Wei Zihan said with a smile.
Wei Qingxue replied, "Sorry, we didn’t have a banquet."
Wei Zihan exclaimed in surprise, "No banquet? How could you not have a banquet for a wedding? Is it because your husband is a deliveryman and too poor?"
The surrounding crowd laughed openly.
Wei Zihan glanced at Lin Fan, "This is your husband? Truly poverty-stricken. Oh, he has a shabby smell all over him. Only Little Sister Qingxue could have such a unique taste to stomach this."
Wei Qingxue responded coldly, "I’m here to attend grandfather’s birthday banquet, not to listen to your nonsense. Lin Fan, let’s go inside."
With that, Wei Qingxue grabbed Lin Fan, leaving Wei Zihan behind, and went inside.
Wei Zihan sneered, "Marrying a deliveryman and not letting people talk. The Wei family’s face is lost because of this little girl!"
In the villa’s living room, Elder Wei sat high upon the throne.
Holding the power of the Wei Family, the members of the family tried to butter him up, lining up to offer blessings and gifts, each more precious than the last.
When it came to Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue’s turn, everyone was waiting to see a joke.
Lin Fan presented the gift box, maintaining a composed attitude: "Elder, happy birthday."
Naturally, Elder Wei was not fond of this grandson-in-law, not even sparing them a glance, merely acknowledging with an indifferent oh.
"Lin Fan, what did you bring? Judging by the packaging, it seems quite cheap." Wei Zihan asked curiously from the side.
"I picked it at the gift shop; it’s worth 30 thousand." Lin Fan said earnestly, speaking the truth as he didn’t skimp a penny from the money Wei Qingxue gave him.
However, his words sparked uproarious laughter.
"What, a 30-thousand gift and isn’t ashamed to present it? This guy truly is a waste!"
"Could it be the idea of the boss? Doesn’t the boss make enough money at the company? Is she even sincere?"
"They’re pretending to be frugal; let’s not expose them."
Hearing these discussions, Wei Qingxue was genuinely upset, but before Elder Wei, she restrained the urge to retaliate.
Elder Wei looked coldly without stopping the crowd, clearly not impressed with Wei Qingxue’s gift either.
"Grandmother, happy birthday! May I introduce my new boyfriend Zhu Xiaolong, the Young Boss of Zhu Family Group." Wei Zihan, pulling her boyfriend, approached at the right time.
Elder Wei’s eyes lit up, his face breaking into a wide smile: "Zihan has an excellent eye, Xiaolong is an honored guest, please sit!"
Zhu Xiaolong smiled, "It’s Elder’s birthday today, I’ve specially prepared a big gift: a Ming Dynasty vase worth 500 thousand. Please accept it."
thousand!
Everyone was astounded; such an expensive gift.
"Wow, look at this gesture; it’s extravagantly generous, unlike some people."
Snickers echoed.
This was clearly targeting Wei Qingxue and her husband.
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, pretending not to notice. She indeed couldn’t afford such an expensive gift. Although she was a Wei Family princess, her current savings were limited, and she had reserved 1 million as Lin Fan’s fee.
Therefore, on her grandfather’s gift, she had to be thrifty.
Elder Wei’s smile grew brighter: "Thank you, Xiaolong! How can I accept such an expensive vase?"
Wei Zihan said with a smile: "It’s our token of appreciation, grandpa, don’t be polite. Why not bring it over for everyone to see?"
Elder Wei nodded: "Okay, let everyone have a look."
Wei Zihan said, "But the vase is a bit heavy, I can’t move it. Someone will have to bring it over."
Elder Wei said, "That’s simple, call a servant to bring it."
"No need to trouble the servants, there’s ready-made labor here. Lin Fan, why don’t you help bring it?" Wei Zihan said, looking at Lin Fan with a faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 Partiality
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Chapter 386 Partiality
Everyone’s eyes immediately focused on Lin Fan, and snickering sounds erupted one after another. In their eyes, Lin Fan was indeed inferior to even the servants.
Now that the eldest daughter, Wei Zihan, asked him to move a vase, would he dare not to move it?
Wei Qingxue wasn’t pleased. Lin Fan’s current status was her husband, not Wei Zihan’s servant. Wei Zihan pretended to ask Lin Fan to move the vase, but in reality, she was just trying to humiliate her.
"Wei Zihan, don’t go too far. Lin Fan is beyond your command!" Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but angrily say.
As soon as she spoke, the room fell silent.
Wei Zihan laughed and said, "What’s the matter? I’m just asking him to move a vase. Little Sister Qingxue, you truly pity your useless husband. You really love a deliveryman, don’t you?"
Everyone burst into laughter.
Wei Qingxue gritted her teeth, "Mind your own damn business!"
Elder Wei coughed twice, a bit displeased, and said, "Zihan is right. Is your husband so precious that he can’t even move a vase?"
"Grandfather..."
Wei Qingxue knew her grandfather also intended to make things difficult for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "I’m okay with moving it, but I haven’t eaten yet, so I’m not strong. If Elder Wei agrees not to hold me accountable even if I accidentally break the vase, I’ll go immediately."
Elder Wei wasn’t a fool. If he really agreed not to blame Lin Fan, the vase would most likely be intentionally broken by Lin Fan.
Elder Wei didn’t want to take that risk, so he snorted coldly, "Let a servant move it."
Having been outsmarted by Lin Fan, he became even more resentful of him. Yet he had to admit that Lin Fan cleverly managed to avoid humiliation with just a sentence.
"Lin Fan, you may not know much, but you’re quite good at being lazy, aren’t you?" Wei Zihan sarcastically remarked.
Lin Fan thwarted her scheme with one sentence, leaving her very upset. A mere deliveryman dared to defy her?
A servant quickly brought up the vase. The crowd gathered around, whispering praises, some complimenting Wei Zihan, others sucking up to Zhu Xiaolong, as sycophantic as they could be.
Some also took the opportunity to mock Lin Fan and his wife.
"A gift worth half a million, really different from one worth thirty thousand!"
Hearing this, Wei Qingxue wished the ground would swallow her up.
Lin Fan originally didn’t care, but when they offended Wei Qingxue, he felt differently.
Activating Top Insight!
With a glance at the vase, Lin Fan immediately realized it was a fake.
"Fake." Lin Fan blurted out.
Everyone heard him.
Wei Zihan was the first to explode, "Useless, what nonsense are you spouting? What the hell do you know!"
Zhu Xiaolong’s face turned red, somewhat agitated, and said, "Buddy, this is a token of my heart for the old man, don’t slander me!"
"He’s just jealous!"
"Talking nonsense like that, how low-class can you get?"
The crowd started to berate Lin Fan one after another.
Wei Qingxue frowned. She wasn’t aware of Lin Fan’s top insight and also thought Lin Fan spoke carelessly, so she said sternly, "Don’t speak recklessly."
Lin Fan chuckled. He didn’t know whether Zhu Xiaolong had intentionally presented a fake gift or had been deceived. Since Wei Qingxue didn’t want him to continue talking, he lost interest in saying more.
This matter ended with Lin Fan being coldly ridiculed.
The gifting ceremony soon came to a close, and Elder Wei suddenly said, "Why hasn’t Little Tang arrived yet? Has anyone seen him?"
Everyone exchanged looks; Wei Tang, Elder Wei’s most doted-on eldest grandson, hadn’t appeared yet.
"Grandfather, I’m here."
Suddenly, they saw Wei Tang rushing in with messy hair, hurriedly tidying his disheveled clothes as he walked.
Elder Wei seemed a bit displeased, "Little Tang, why so late?"
Wei Tang replied with a sheepish smile, "Sorry, Grandpa, I went out to meet a client and only managed to return now."
Sweat broke out on everyone’s forehead; it was clear Wei Tang had just woken up.
But no one dared point it out, knowing that Elder Wei spoiled Wei Tang and they all preferred not to offend him.
"Grandpa, I came in a rush this time and didn’t buy a gift, but I’ll make it up to you later, is that okay?" Wei Tang grinned cheekily.
Wei Zihan chimed in, "Wei Tang, you’ll have to make it up with a grand gift, unlike some people who only give something worth thirty thousand."
Wei Tang nodded with an "Oh" and laughed, "Who would be so shameless? Let me guess, it must be our dear CEO, right?"
"Who else could it be?" Chu Zihan sneered sarcastically.
Wei Tang continued, "Oh, sorry, I almost forgot, she’s no longer the CEO, being kicked out by Grandpa."
As he spoke, Wei Tang looked at Wei Qingxue with a taunting expression.
Everyone followed with laughter.
Wei Qingxue was filled with anger but couldn’t refute.
Right then, Lin Fan suddenly stepped forward, "Wei Tang, you must have been meeting clients in your dreams. I think you overslept and didn’t plan to buy a gift for Elder Wei at all!"
The whole room fell silent; everyone looked at each other with knowing expressions. Lin Fan said what they didn’t dare to say out loud. However, speaking the truth comes with consequences—would Wei Tang let this slide?
Wei Tang immediately became furious, "What did you say? Say it again if you dare!"
Lin Fan calmly stated, "I’m saying it’s obvious you just woke up. By deceiving Elder Wei like this, are you taking him for a fool or thinking he’s blind? Surely you don’t believe Elder Wei cannot see through this, right, Elder Wei?"
Elder Wei was momentarily speechless, feeling quite displeased. Could he really deny Lin Fan’s words?
Wei Tang was embarrassed and enraged, cursing, "Mind your own damn business! You lazy mail carrier. Wei Qingxue, can’t you control your husband? Tell him to stop meddling!"
Wei Qingxue found it slightly amusing; she had been angry, but Lin Fan spoke up on her behalf, giving vent to her frustrations.
"Do you have no sense of yourself?" Wei Qingxue replied with a chuckle.
Wei Tang was fuming, but on the surface, he looked aggrieved and said, "Grandfather, you have to believe me, I’m not lying to you, don’t listen to this useless person’s provocations."
Elder Wei snorted coldly, "Qingxue, I trust Little Tang wouldn’t deceive me. You need to properly discipline your husband!"
This was blatant favoritism!
Everyone could tell Wei Tang had just woken up. Elder Wei was neither a fool nor blind, so how could he not realize it?
Wei Qingxue felt aggrieved, but she still sought her grandfather’s forgiveness, so she dared not confront him. She could only say, "I will. I’ll reprimand him later."
Wei Tang wasn’t satisfied, "You wouldn’t dare trick Grandfather, would you? How do we know you would reprimand him later and not praise him instead?"
Wei Zihan chimed in, saying, "He should apologize to Wei Tang publicly!"
Everyone joined in agreement: "Yes, discipline him and have him apologize publicly!"
Elder Wei watched coldly, as if waiting for Wei Qingxue to act.
Wei Qingxue clenched her fists. She was resentful. Why was her grandfather so biased towards Wei Tang? Lin Fan did nothing wrong, yet she had to discipline him!
Elder Wei coldly retorted, "Wei Qingxue, I’ve already expelled you from the Wei Family. If your father hadn’t come pleading, you wouldn’t even have the right to stand here today. Do you want me to expel you again?"
Wei Qingxue’s body trembled. So, this was his intention all along? It wasn’t Lin Fan that needed to be disciplined; it was a warning for her!

chapters.title: Chapter 387 Impossible Task
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Chapter 387 Impossible Task
Elder Wei actually threatened to expel her, forcing Wei Qingxue to publicly reprimand Lin Fan.
It seemed that Elder Wei was still angry with Wei Qingxue over what happened that day. He wanted to punish not Lin Fan, but Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue’s body trembled slightly, her grandfather always targeting her, made her very sad.
Over the years, she has served as the company president, working harder than any employee, giving everything for the Wei Family, even being too busy for a relationship.
She wouldn’t say she made a huge contribution, but at least she had a clear conscience towards the Wei Family.
Elder Wei, controlling the company, surely knows this!
Now, just because she went against his wishes, refusing to marry into the Ma Family, her past efforts seemed to vanish, and she was still being targeted!
Family members mocked her in various ways; indirect scolding was one thing, even her grandfather did!
Wei Qingxue felt somewhat heartbroken.
She had a stubborn character too; her grandfather wanted to force her, she simply wouldn’t budge.
At this moment, everyone was waiting for Wei Qingxue’s reaction.
Li Xueyan anxiously said, "Qingxue, why don’t you take action, is there any need to protect him?"
Wei Dazong was also anxious; he had worked hard to plead for Wei Qingxue, and he came today to seek Elder Wei’s forgiveness.
"Xiaoxue, go ahead!" Wei Dazong said in a deep voice.
Seeing this, everyone present was somewhat gloating, thinking Wei Qingxue had no retreat; if she didn’t punish Lin Fan right away, she couldn’t end the matter.
Wei Tang was very pleased, waiting for the show to start.
But Wei Qingxue shook her head and said mildly, "I will not punish Lin Fan; he did nothing wrong. Why should I punish him? Grandpa, you don’t need to expel me; I will leave by myself."
These words fell, and the whole room was silent.
Everyone was astonished.
Wei Qingxue actually refused!
After refusing to marry into the Ma Family, she defied Elder again!
Wei Tang was dumbfounded; he didn’t expect Wei Qingxue to have such courage, originally planning to enjoy her embarrassment, but failed.
Wei Tang was upset, saying indignantly, "Grandpa, Wei Qingxue doesn’t even listen to you, repeatedly confronting you; she obviously doesn’t respect you!"
Elder Wei was already furious. Wei Qingxue’s refusal to remarry into the Ma Family and her escape that day made him lose face before the Ma Family, prompting him to dismiss Wei Qingxue from the president position and expel her from the Wei Family.
He later cooled down, still having some expectation for Wei Qingxue, allowing her to attend his birthday banquet today.
If only Wei Qingxue would meekly admit her mistake and show a good attitude, he might largely forgive her and acknowledge her as a member of the Wei Family.
Unexpectedly, Wei Qingxue defied him again!
"Wei Qingxue, you came today just to seek my forgiveness, wanting to stay in the Wei Family, didn’t you? I’ll give you one opportunity; you’ve been president for three years, and it is largely your responsibility that the company is currently struggling financially. Three years and the company has reached this state, you have a large responsibility and the task of solving the funding difficulties falls on you. I will give you a week to raise 1 billion, and if you can’t, you will be permanently expelled from the Wei Family, with no extra chances!"
What?
Wei Qingxue’s complexion changed.
Raising 1 billion in a week is an impossible task; Elder Wei clearly wanted to make things difficult for her!
Everyone was also a bit surprised; Elder Wei was too harsh.
Li Xueyan’s vision darkened, almost fainting. Elder Wei’s condition was undoubtedly a death sentence for Qingxue!
"Father, wouldn’t a week be too tight?" Wei Dazong couldn’t help saying, being the only one able to speak for Wei Qingxue.
Elder Wei coldly replied, "Do you think I want to? You wish it were less tight, but the company can’t afford to wait; it’s all because of your good daughter! Refusing to marry into the Ma Family for some courier, leading to the current situation!"
Wei Dazong was speechless.
Elder Wei sneered, "I believe she can complete it because she still has one path to follow; as long as she remarries into the Ma Family..."
Wei Qingxue’s body shook uncontrollably, her whole body feeling cold.
If she could find 1 billion within a week, she’d become a legend; it was completely impossible!
Suddenly, a hand reached over and held Wei Qingxue’s hand.
It was Lin Fan’s warm hand.
"Honey, it’s okay," Lin Fan smiled, comforting her.
For some reason, Wei Qingxue felt a warmth flowing from her palm into her body, calming her instantly, and she stopped shaking.
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan strangely; he was clearly just a courier, yet seemed to have some kind of magic.
"Thank you," Wei Qingxue whispered.
Lin Fan raised his head, looking at Elder Wei: "One week to raise 1 billion, right? Fine, we’ll take this task!"
These words from Lin Fan immediately drew disdain.
"Pompous!"
"Ridiculous, a courier dare say such words; who gave him the courage!"
"Just ask if you are qualified?"
Everyone mocked him.
Elder Wei was also displeased: "What qualification do you have to agree on behalf of Qingxue? Don’t forget your identity; I heard from Dazong that you are just a live-in son-in-law, to put it plainly, eating from the Wei family’s offerings!"
These words brought forth raucous laughter, unscrupulously mocking.
Lin Fan was not the least bit angry, smiling: "Elder, how many in your Wei Family are capable? As far as I know, Xiaoxue is one. So most of you are merely freeloading waste here."
These words stirred anger among those present.
Lin Fan’s words were harsh, hitting them where it hurt.
Most of them were indeed pampered heirs who were nothing outside the family.
"What did you say?"
"This waste has a venomous mouth!"
"We are not freeloaders!"
The group was furious, appearing quite ridiculous.
Lin Fan ignored them, saying, "Elder, you merely try to break up my wife and me, destined to be disappointed. We love each other wholeheartedly; Qingxue will never marry into the Ma Family."
Wei Qingxue bit her lip and said, "What Lin Fan said is exactly what I would say!"
Lin Fan offended everyone speaking for her; she would naturally stand by Lin Fan without hesitation.
Elder Wei snorted heavily, "Let’s see how strong your ’one heart’ is, as long as you don’t marry into the Ma Family, what other ways do you have!"
Wei Tang sarcastically said, "Wei Qingxue, instead of wasting a week, why not retreat willingly? What’s the point of making things difficult for yourself? Anyway, you are a failure as a president!"
Wei Zihan added, "Little Tang is right, it’s like occupying a pit without using it."
Wei Tang laughed, "Rude words, but true reasoning, Wei Qingxue, why not go home and accompany your waste husband, you’re a perfect match!"
The crowd laughed uproariously.
At this moment, a servant came in, saying the meal was ready and they could now have dinner.
Wei Qingxue had no appetite, planning to leave.
Lin Fan pulled her, smiling, "Just hungry, since freeloading is available, why not eat? Eating is gaining; dear wife, join me?"
Hearing this, everyone was speechless, thinking this guy really had thick skin.
Wei Qingxue saw Lin Fan wanted to eat, nodded, and agreed to stay.
The banquet started, and according to order, everyone sat for the meal. Wei Qingxue was placed with the elders in the family’s forefront.
Lin Fan, the least ranked live-in son-in-law, sat in the farthest corner, surrounded by mocking glances.
Lin Fan paid no mind, focusing on eating and drinking, having already come, it was a shame not to fill his stomach.
"Wow!"
The girls suddenly exclaimed; it turned out Wei Zihan was showing off the engagement ring that Zhu Xiaolong gave her, the huge diamond was blindingly dazzling.
"Sister Zihan, this diamond ring must be heavy and expensive, right?" someone enviously asked.
Wei Zihan pretended to smile casually, "Not too heavy, just 8 carats, worth around 1 million!"

chapters.title: Chapter 388: How Can You Falsely Accuse Someone of Being Guilty?
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Chapter 388: How Can You Falsely Accuse Someone of Being Guilty?
The dinner begins.
Lin Fan, as the live-in son-in-law, was placed in the back corner, but he didn’t mind at all, eating his meal happily.
Why not enjoy the free meal?
Wei Qingxue ate without any appetite, troubled by financial issues.
The Wei family’s relatives all felt that Wei Qingxue could not accomplish this task; in their eyes, she was no longer part of the Wei family.
As for the vacant CEO position, it would definitely be snatched by Wei Tang.
For the moment, everyone went to toast Wei Tang and tried to cozy up to him.
"Once I become CEO, I promise everyone will have good days ahead!" Wei Tang said confidently after a few drinks, as if he were already CEO.
Wei Qingxue was speechless, but inside she grew increasingly anxious.
The girls in the family surrounded Wei Zihan, treating Wei Qingxue as invisible and leaving her aside.
"Wow!"
The girls suddenly exclaimed as Wei Zihan flaunted the engagement ring that Zhu Xiaolong had given her, with its huge diamond shining so brightly it was blinding.
"Sister Zihan, this engagement ring must be very heavy and expensive, right?" someone asked enviously.
Wei Zihan laughed pretentiously and said, "Not too heavy, just 8 carats, worth around a million."
This statement triggered a wave of amazement.
"Young Master Zhu is so generous, it’s enviable!"
"Young Master Zhu treats Sister Zihan so well, she’s truly fortunate."
"This is real engagement. I heard that as for Lin Fan, the loser hasn’t given Wei Qingxue anything, and she had to spend on him."
All the women burst into laughter.
Wei Qingxue felt uncomfortable, wanting to get up and leave immediately.
Lin Fan, who initially planned to eat quietly, looked over upon hearing people talk about him and saw the ring.
"What a beautiful ring, where did Young Master Zhu buy it? I’d like to get one myself in the future," Lin Fan said cheerfully, activating his top-tier insight, immediately realizing the ring, like the vase, was fake.
Zhu Xiaolong’s face showed a trace of unease as he said, "I had this custom-made with a family heirloom diamond; it’s not available on the market."
Wei Zihan mocked, "Lin Fan, why are you asking? Can you even afford it?"
This comment elicited another round of laughter.
Lin Fan sneered internally as he previously wasn’t sure, but now he could confirm that Zhu Xiaolong was a fraud!
Lin Fan said, "I can afford it."
Wei Zihan sneered, "Ridiculous, if you could afford it, would you still be a live-in son-in-law!"
Lin Fan said, "If I can afford it, what will you do? Will you kneel down and call me dad?"
Wei Zihan’s face darkened as she cursed, "You courier-delivering pauper, look in the mirror, what part of you is worth?"
Lin Fan said, "Ever since online payments, I rarely carry cash. I probably have about 100 bucks on me now, enough to buy your ring with some leftover."
Wei Zihan was furious, "What nonsense are you talking about? You say my ring isn’t worth 100 bucks, you’re spouting nonsense!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course, because it’s a fake."
Wei Zihan was livid; Lin Fan had previously said her vase was fake, and now her ring too, worth less than 100 bucks!
"Claiming others’ things are fake, this guy is just spouting nonsense!"
"It’s envy, isn’t it!"
"He’s so bitter! He can’t afford it himself, so he slanders others’ belongings!"
Everyone began mocking him.
Zhu Xiaolong’s face turned red with excitement, pointing at Lin Fan and said, "How can you unjustly accuse and tarnish someone’s reputation? How could I possibly give fake items!"
Wei Zihan became increasingly angry and said, "Grandfather, look at Lin Fan, he’s publicly defaming me, grandfather, you must support me!"
Elder Wei was very displeased; this Lin Fan was truly annoying. As a live-in son-in-law, he felt no shame and instead took pride, yet ruined the atmosphere everywhere.
"Lin Fan, you can eat whatever you like, but words cannot be spoken irresponsibly. Apologize to Zihan!" Elder Wei said coldly.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "I’m just speaking the truth, why should I apologize? If Elder Wei doesn’t believe it, you can certainly get someone to authenticate it."
"Why not let me authenticate it?"
Suddenly, an elderly voice said.
The crowd saw an old man with his hands behind his back walking in from outside.
The group exchanged confused glances; who was this old man? They hadn’t seen him before.
To everyone’s surprise, Elder Wei quickly stood up and said excitedly, "Mr. Zhang, you’ve finally come, please take a seat! Let me introduce everyone, Mr. Zhang Mingshi, younger brother of the antique grandmaster Zhang Baishi, and also an authentication grandmaster himself!"
It turned out Elder Wei was very fond of antiques, with his greatest hobby being collecting them. Over the years, he had amassed quite a collection.
However, Elder Wei didn’t know how to authenticate treasures; he always wanted to find a grandmaster to guide him, willing to spend generously for it. Initially, he aimed to invite the grandmaster Zhang Baishi, but Zhang Baishi’s standing was too high; given Elder Wei’s status, he couldn’t invite Zhang Baishi.
He had to settle for the next best thing by inviting Zhang Baishi’s younger brother, Zhang Mingshi, who was also an authentication grandmaster.
Zhang Mingshi would be staying at the Wei family for two days to exchange ideas with Elder Wei about treasure collection.
Unexpectedly, upon arrival, he encountered an amusing situation and volunteered to authenticate the items!
Lin Fan had met Zhang Baishi before, at Liu Tingshan’s birthday banquet, when Lin Fan gifted a jade bracelet he’d purchased for 100 bucks to Liu Tingshan; Zhang Baishi was surprised to discover the bracelet was nephrite jade, worth over a billion!
Lin Fan was very impressed with Zhang Baishi’s authentication skills.
This Zhang Mingshi resembled Zhang Baishi slightly in appearance, but his authentication skills were unknown.
Upon hearing Zhang Mingshi was an authentication grandmaster, Zhu Xiaolong’s complexion changed, but he chuckled awkwardly and said, "No need to authenticate; everything I give is genuine!"
Zhang Mingshi ignored him and walked straight to Wei Zihan, reaching out to take the ring.
Zhang Mingshi scrutinized it carefully.
Suddenly, Zhang Mingshi threw the ring he held onto the ground.
With a snap, the ring fell to the floor, causing Wei Zihan’s heart to skip a beat, her face pale with worry; seeing the ring thrown like that made her heartsick.
Zhang Mingshi chuckled and said, "Fake goods, though carefully counterfeited, not worth more than a hundred bucks."
Wei Zihan trembled and said, "Fake? How is that possible?"
She looked towards Zhu Xiaolong.
Zhu Xiaolong’s face flushed, he remained silent, dare not look at Wei Zihan.
Zhang Mingshi regarded the ring with contempt and said, "Anything else?"
Lin Fan pointed out and said, "There’s the vase over there that they gave Elder Wei as a gift."
Zhang Mingshi then went over, circled the vase once, his expression darkened, feeling displeased, saying, "Ridiculous, such a careless counterfeit, simply insulting intelligence, utterly worthless!"
What?
The whole room went silent.
Air filled with awkwardness.
At this point, two servants were seen carrying a box into the room, wrapped in red cloth, obviously a congratulatory gift.
"Elder Wei, someone just delivered this gift from outside," a servant said.
Everyone’s attention was drawn.
"Who was it?" Elder Wei asked curiously.
"It was me!"
An adult voice said, as a middle-aged man walked in from outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Shocked All Around! An Unexpected 10-Million Betrothal Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Chapter 389: Shocked All Around! An Unexpected 10-Million Betrothal Gift
The appraisal master, Zhang Mingshi, proceeded to assess both the diamond ring and the vase.
The diamond ring received Zhang Mingshi’s affirmation, not because it was real, but because the forgery was done with a considerable degree of effort.
Therefore, Zhang Mingshi valued this ring at 100 yuan.
As for the vase, the forgery was so badly done that Zhang Mingshi angrily deemed it worthless.
Yet, this diamond ring was claimed to be worth a million!
And this vase, claimed to be worth 500,000!
The disparity was quite overwhelming.
Wei Zihan’s face turned pale, while Zhu Xiaolong’s face was flushed.
Elder Wei couldn’t help but ask, "Master Zhang, is there any possibility it’s real? Could you please carefully appraise it again?"
This question irked Zhang Mingshi: "Such trash, and you want me to appraise it again? Brother Wei, are you looking down on me?"
Elder Wei hurriedly replied, "I wouldn’t dare, it was presumptuous of me. Please, Master Zhang, calm your anger."
Elder Wei truly didn’t dare offend Zhang Mingshi; his circle in the antiques world was full of rich and influential people.
Since Zhang Mingshi said it was fake, then it must be fake!
He didn’t believe Lin Fan, but he couldn’t not believe Zhang Mingshi.
Seeing Elder Wei apologize, Zhang Mingshi chose not to pursue the matter.
"Zihan, what on earth is going on?" Elder Wei’s expression darkened as he looked at Wei Zihan.
It was all because Wei Zihan’s items were fake, leading to such public embarrassment!
All the members of the Wei family fell silent, with a touch of awkwardness on everyone’s face. They had all been praising Wei Zihan and Zhu Xiaolong before, and now it was a slap in the face.
Wei Zihan’s face was ashen as she trembled and said, "I... I don’t know what happened either. Darling, please explain this!"
Wei Zihan looked toward Zhu Xiaolong.
Zhu Xiaolong’s face was flushed red: "It’s impossible for them to be fake. I spent a lot of money on these. I must have been deceived."
Wei Zihan’s eyes reddened as she pleaded tearfully: "Grandpa, we’re innocent, Xiaolong was deceived, we didn’t mean to gift you fake items."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Deceived? Young Master Zhu, didn’t you just claim that this diamond ring was an heirloom of yours? What, your heirloom is fake, and several generations didn’t realize it? How foolish can you be?"
Zhu Xiaolong, angrily, "You..."
Wei Zihan snapped, "Lin Fan, can you shut up!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You really believe he didn’t know? Such a fool?"
Wei Zihan replied, "So what if I believe it!"
Lin Fan laughed, wondering how else he could respond. If Wei Zihan chose to believe Zhu Xiaolong, surely she’d suffer more consequences, but she brought it on herself. Lin Fan found entertainment in seeing her face setbacks.
At this moment, Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but burst into laughter: "Wei Zihan, looks like your precious vase, along with your engagement diamond ring, are no match for my 30,000 yuan gift."
Wei Zihan was livid: "Wei Qingxue, what right do you have to mock me? Even if this diamond ring is fake, Master Zhang still said it’s worth 100 yuan. And you, what has your deliveryman husband ever given you, not even a dime!"
Everyone burst out laughing.
Indeed, it’s embarrassing enough for Wei Zihan’s items to be fake, but Wei Qingxue was even more so, having received nothing upon marriage!
Just then, a servant brought in a box wrapped in red silk, clearly a dowry gift.
Soon after, a middle-aged man entered.
The dowry was brought by this middle-aged man.
Elder Wei asked curiously, "Who might you be, and what does this mean?"
The middle-aged man replied, "My name is Zhang Dafu, and my boss, Mr. Lin, sent me. These are dowry gifts for a young lady from the Wei family, with wishes for a happy union between Mr. Lin and Miss Wei!"
The moment these words were said, everyone was stunned.
Elder Wei asked, "Mr. Lin? May I ask which Mr. Lin, and which young lady from the Wei family is it for?"
Zhang Dafu replied, "Mr. Lin, the new richest man in Yun City, as for which young lady, Mr. Lin did not specify. My task here is done, goodbye!"
Zhang Dafu gave a small bow and turned to leave. As he left, he caught a glimpse of Lin Fan sitting in the corner.
Lin Fan was casually munching on a chicken leg.
Zhang Dafu was puzzled, wondering what kind of plan his boss was devising.
Today, Lin Fan contacted Zhang Dafu, asking him to prepare this dowry. What Zhang Dafu just said was according to Lin Fan’s instructions.
He had no idea what Lin Fan’s intention was.
Zhang Dafu couldn’t be detained and hurried off. By the time everyone reacted, he was already out of sight.
Elder Wei still had questions to ask but had to drop it. He then instructed, "Quickly, open it and see what’s inside."
The servant removed the red cloth, opened the box, and everyone was astonished at what they saw inside.
"A pair of perfectly matching jade bangles!"
"Blooming flowers, a pair of diamond necklaces!"
"A golden lock symbolizing a perfect union!"
"..."
"500,000 in cash!"
"Oh my god!"
Listening to the servant announce the dowry items one by one, everyone was left in a state of shock, especially upon hearing about the 500,000 cash; they were practically green with envy!
These dowry items, just one of them, starts at a million, and added together, they’re worth over ten million!
Everyone gasped in disbelief, wondering who could be this generous, and which young lady of the Wei family was the fortunate recipient?
Elder Wei’s eyes lit up: "Mr. Lin, indeed the richest man in Yun City, such generosity, yet which of our Wei family is fortunate enough to catch Mr. Lin’s eye!"
Mr. Lin, their Wei family, could never dream of associating with someone of such status!
But this question had no answer.
Wei Tang laughed and said, "Let me handle this, we can use the process of elimination. Firstly, rule out our dear president, since it’s dowry gifts, naturally it must be for someone unmarried, and our president already has her good-for-nothing husband."
"Both having the surname Lin, but such a vast difference. One receives dowries worth millions, and he requires the president to compensate!"
This remark caused uproarious laughter.
Indeed, the Wei family does have a son-in-law with the surname Lin, Lin Fan, though this guy is just a deliveryman from the bottom rung, a poor sap from the countryside!
Wei Qingxue had no comeback. The harshest reality wasn’t the ridicule, but the fact that the mockery was true. Looking at the abundant dowries, how could she not be envious, yet thinking of her own circumstances, she realized how truly unfortunate she was!
Wei Tang continued, "Secondly, we can rule out Sister Zihan, since she already has Young Master Zhu."
Wei Zihan looked at the million-worth dowries, filled with jealousy towards the recipient, not knowing which little vixen it belonged to!
The unmarried girls of the Wei family were all excited at this moment, for if it wasn’t Wei Qingxue or Wei Zihan, it could be one of them!
"I think it’s for me!" said a rather attractive girl, her face full of confidence.
Wei Zihan retorted, "You think? I’m not married either, can’t I have another suitor?"
This left Zhu Xiaolong standing awkwardly beside them.
Wei Tang laughed, "Sister Zihan makes a good point, that’s also a possibility!"
Wei Zihan glanced at Chu Mengyu: "Anyway, all the girls here are possibilities, except for Wei Qingxue!"
Hearing this, everyone burst into laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: Slap Your Face, One Strike Is Enough
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Chapter 390: Slap Your Face, One Strike Is Enough
Everyone was mocking Wei Qingxue.
Because Wei Qingxue was already married, and that million in dowry definitely had nothing to do with her.
"Who told you to marry a useless delivery guy as your husband? Not only did you not get a penny in dowry, but you also have to pay out of your pocket. To be a woman like you, it’s just too much of a failure."
Wei Zihan mocked recklessly.
Everyone laughed because, in their eyes, Wei Qingxue indeed seemed too much of a failure.
Wei Qingxue knew her own situation. No matter how poor Lin Fan was, she didn’t care because it had nothing to do with her, but she couldn’t stand these endless humiliations.
Besides, this million in dowry would make anyone feel a bit envious, even her.
This Mr. Lin, truly worthy of being the richest man in Yun City, his gesture was indeed grand!
Which girl wouldn’t be moved by such a generous dowry? Wei Qingxue was no exception.
But she had never even seen Mr. Lin, so Mr. Lin was definitely not interested in her.
Being ridiculed by everyone, she had no room to retaliate.
Wei Qingxue suddenly stood up: "Grandpa, sorry, I’m really not feeling well, I have to go back now."
Without waiting for Elder Wei’s approval, Wei Qingxue ran out.
"Hey darling, wait for me!" Lin Fan jumped up, tossed the chicken leg in his hand aside, and dashed after her.
When Lin Fan chased after her, Wei Qingxue had already gotten into a Porsche.
Lin Fan walked up to the car window, bent down, and said with a smile: "Are you okay? Don’t let those people affect your mood."
Wei Qingxue said stubbornly: "I’m fine."
Lin Fan smiled: "You really don’t need to mind them. I’m sure those gifts don’t belong to any of them."
Wei Qingxue scoffed: "What are you talking about, they don’t belong to any of them? Are you saying they belong to me?"
Lin Fan replied: "That’s right, it belongs to you!"
Wei Qingxue gave a bitter smile: "Don’t joke around, what do I have that would catch Mr. Lin’s eye."
She didn’t take Lin Fan’s words seriously and then sighed, "It’s not the first time they’ve ridiculed me, I can brush it off. My biggest worry right now is that fund!"
Lin Fan asked: "What do you plan to do about it?"
Wei Qingxue shook her head: "I don’t know. As you’ve seen, the weak are bullied. I have no status in the Wei Family at all, and if I can’t solve the funding issue, I’ll be completely kicked out. I’ve done so much for the Wei Family, I... I’m not willing to accept this!"
Her eyes were full of bitterness and helplessness.
Lin Fan said seriously: "You still have me, I’ll help you."
The system required him to help Wei Qingxue solve her difficulties. Initially, he was just fulfilling a task from the system, but at that moment, Lin Fan suddenly realized that he genuinely wanted to help this girl from his heart.
He understood the loneliness of Wei Qingxue facing her entire family alone, and he felt a sense of compassion towards her.
Wei Qingxue, however, didn’t take Lin Fan’s words seriously, she bitterly smiled and shook her head: "Let’s not talk about it, I’ll head home first."
She then started the Porsche and drove away.
Lin Fan also decided to get on his little electric scooter and head back.
"You useless piece of trash, stop right there!"
Suddenly, a yelling voice came from behind.
It was Wei Tang leading a few Wei family descendants towards him, with mocking and arrogant expressions on their faces.
Lin Fan was in a hurry to get home and said impatiently: "What, got something to say, spit it out, I’m busy."
Wei Tang laughed angrily: "Damn, this useless guy still has a temper. Do you think I’ll just let tonight’s incident slide like that? Who do you take Young Master Wei for?"
Tonight, Lin Fan pointed out publicly that he was late because he overslept, which got him really angry. He tried to use Elder Wei’s favoritism to teach Lin Fan a lesson in front of everyone.
But Wei Qingxue didn’t play along, resulting in the endeavor to teach Lin Fan a lesson being for naught.
But this Lin Fan guy continued to overstep bounds, publicly pointing out that Wei Zihan’s diamond ring was fake, making Wei Zihan lose face in front of relatives.
Wei Zihan was his dear sister; how could he swallow that anger?
So just now, seeing Lin Fan run off, he immediately gathered some Wei family descendants to come after Lin Fan for a lesson.
Lin Fan was alone, while they had several people, they definitely needed to fix Lin Fan up good.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Oh, didn’t manage to force my wife to hit me on your behalf by using Elder Wei’s favoritism, now you want to do it yourself, huh? Do you think you’re worthy?"
Arrogant!
This delivery guy is ridiculously arrogant.
Wei Tang was furious. As a Rich Second Generation, in his world, he could act high and mighty over the poor. Those bottom-tier people from society could only be scared when they saw him!
He really couldn’t figure out where a dead delivery guy got the nerve to be this arrogant!
Lin Fan indeed had the gall. Even before he got the system and was just a downright broke guy, he never bowed his head to anyone; if the emperor was wrong, he wouldn’t give face either.
Back then, he didn’t have strong power either, but if he saw some guy committing domestic violence on the street, he would also unhesitatingly rush in and fight the abuser.
Let alone someone like Wei Tang, this idiot Rich Second Generation.
Wei Tang sneered: "You guessed right, I am indeed going to beat you up. If I don’t, you grow disobedient. Come on, hold him, I want to slap him until his face is swollen!"
The few Wei family descendants beside him also sneered and started to close in on Lin Fan.
They believed it was easy to subdue Lin Fan given their numbers!
They thought so, but...
They didn’t even touch Lin Fan’s clothes; Lin Fan didn’t even need to move much. Like kicking a ball, within the blink of an eye, these guys were kicked to the ground, each curled up like shrimps, faces turned blue, wailing painfully, too weak to get up at the moment.
It’s not that Lin Fan was vicious, but they were too weak. Lin Fan didn’t even use much force, and half of their souls already flew away, each beginning to question their life!
Wei Tang, who was at the side, was dumbfounded.
What the hell...
Is this real?
If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn’t believe it. Lin Fan was too strong!
Lin Fan looked over at this point, smiling: "Oh, there’s still you."
Wei Tang trembled in fear, instinctively turning to try and run away.
But how could he escape, hardly two steps away, when Lin Fan grabbed him by the collar from behind like picking up a chicken, lifting him up.
Wei Tang was shocked and scared: "What do you want to do, you piece of trash? I advise you not to act recklessly. In this Wei Family, you are nothing more than a lowly son-in-law; I’m not someone you can afford to mess with!"
Lin Fan’s face turned stern: "So much nonsense! What did you say just now, about slapping my face until it’s swollen?"
Smack!
Lin Fan flipped Wei Tang around and slapped him on the face.
Immediately, Wei Tang’s face swelled up like a pig’s head.
Wei Tang was in so much pain, stars danced before his eyes, and tears streamed down.
"No need for one slap after another to swell your face, one slap is enough." Lin Fan said, throwing Wei Tang on the ground.
Wei Tang flopped like a dead fish on the ground, feeling as though his bones were shattered, his vision dimming with pain.
Strong, too strong, how can there be someone so strong in this world!
Wei Tang almost wanted to cry, no wonder Lin Fan wasn’t afraid of them. Had they known Lin Fan was so strong, they wouldn’t have dared to provoke him even if given ten guts.
This damned delivery guy, terribly strong!
"I give you ten seconds to disappear from my sight, or else I’ll send each one of you flying with another kick." Lin Fan said casually.
Lin Fan was just playing around, speaking offhandedly, but to Wei Tang and his crew, it sounded like a devil’s whisper, scaring them senseless.
They hurriedly endured the pain, scrambled to their feet, helped one another flee back to the Wei Family Mansion, running fast to avoid another round from Lin Fan.
Meanwhile.
Outside the Wei Family Mansion, hiding behind a flowerbed, were a group of men who had witnessed the scene earlier; their faces didn’t look good.
"Can’t afford to mess with him, let’s scram!"

chapters.title: Chapter 391: Fortunately, I Still Have You Tonight
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Chapter 391: Fortunately, I Still Have You Tonight
The leading man lowered his voice and said, "Young Master Ma wants us to teach a lesson to this delivery guy. Better not mess with him, let’s scram!"
He waved his hand and quickly left with his men.
It turns out that Ma Jialiang was jealous of Wei Qingxue marrying Lin Fan and found people to look for an opportunity to beat up Lin Fan.
However, Lin Fan, being a delivery guy, was always elusive. They found out that it was Elder Wei’s birthday tonight, and Lin Fan would definitely attend, so they came to ambush here.
After Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue separated, they wanted to rush over, but Wei Tang and his people were a step ahead, so they decided to wait for a bit.
Who would have thought they’d witness Lin Fan teach Wei Tang and his group a lesson?
They didn’t want to end up like Wei Tang, so they decided to retreat!
Lin Fan, however, didn’t notice the presence of this group and rode his electric bike back home.
Wei Tang and the others hurriedly fled back to the Wei Family Mansion, looking utterly disheveled, even struggling to walk steadily. Anyone who saw them would feel pity.
"Damn it! That damn delivery guy actually dared to hit us. Let’s report this to Grandfather!"
"That’s right, let Grandfather stand up for us!"
"We can’t let him off just like that; he’s such a bastard!"
The few of them chimed in angrily.
Wei Tang scolded, "Shut up, all of you! When we go in, we absolutely cannot say that Lin Fan hit us!"
The few didn’t understand, "Why?"
Wei Tang said, "I’m already embarrassed enough tonight, being hit by this delivery guy. If people found out and it spread, do I still have any face left to show in society? Ah, it hurts so much!"
Hearing this, they reluctantly agreed.
Once inside.
Elder Wei was having dinner, and upon seeing their disheveled state, particularly Wei Tang with his swollen face, he was shocked.
"What happened?" Elder Wei asked in surprise.
Wei Zihan was also anxious and asked, "Did you guys get beaten up? Who did it?"
To think someone dared to beat the eldest young master of the Wei family like this was simply audacious.
Wei Tang quickly said, "We didn’t get beaten up; we accidentally fell by ourselves..."
By this time, Lin Fan was already on his way home, not at all worried that Wei Tang would tattle to Elder Wei.
In his eyes, Elder Wei was nothing to be concerned about!
When Lin Fan got home, he found that Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan had already returned. Though they left later, they drove, so they were faster than Lin Fan.
At this moment, Li Xueyan was very emotional, blaming Wei Qingxue for standing up to Elder Wei today; now Elder Wei was deliberately picking on Wei Qingxue by giving her such a big task.
At the banquet, Li Xueyan was practically in a state of retreat all night. Now back home, it seemed she was on her home turf.
Seeing Lin Fan enter, Li Xueyan grew even more agitated, pointing at Lin Fan’s nose and scolding, "You useless thing, you embarrassed us entirely tonight, don’t you know?"
"Who did you think you were provoking? Wei Zihan and Wei Tang are not people you can mess with. You probably got humiliated and mocked, right? Dragging my name through the mud, ungrateful and overestimating yourself!"
"That’s not all, Elder Wei asked you to move a vase, and you wouldn’t even do it. How could you be so stupid, offending Elder Wei? Will we ever have good days in the future? Are you deliberately trying to ruin us?"
The more Li Xueyan scolded, the angrier she became.
Lin Fan chuckled lightly, "Elder Wei is already biased towards Wei Tang; compromising himself won’t help, will it?"
Li Xueyan was furious, "How dare you talk back while I’m scolding you! No wonder you dared to be so presumptuous at Elder Wei’s birthday banquet. Are you brain dead?"
Mother’s scolding was too harsh, prompting Wei Qingxue to speak, "Mom, Lin Fan isn’t wrong. They are targeting us."
Li Xueyan replied, "Don’t defend this good-for-nothing. If it weren’t for you marrying this loser, would we be in this situation?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I’m just stating the facts. I don’t want to argue with you. Solving the funding issue is our top priority now."
Li Xueyan turned to look at Wei Dazong, "What do you think about this?"
"If even the old man is at a loss, what can I do?" Wei Dazong spread his hands helplessly.
Li Xueyan stomped her foot, exclaiming in frustration, "Why am I so unfortunate!"
"Qingxue, if only you married a rich man, you wouldn’t have to worry about money! I say, you should divorce this loser while you’re young and find a good family again!"
Wei Qingxue unhappily said, "Mom, why do you still want me to remarry? Haven’t I made myself clear?"
Li Xueyan glared, "What’s wrong with remarrying? Any man off the street is better than this loser! If it weren’t for me being old, I’d remarry too!"
Wei Dazong: "..."
Wei Qingxue said testily, "Mom, what’s the point of saying all this? Why not let me have some peace!"
Li Xueyan said, "Silly girl, I’m doing this for your own good. Why waste your youth on this good-for-nothing!"
She then turned to Lin Fan, continuing to scold, "You loser, if you had any consideration for my daughter, you’d get out of here voluntarily. You’re not fit to be my son-in-law!"
"Enough!" Wei Qingxue got emotional, "I’m telling you clearly, I won’t divorce Lin Fan! Tonight, everyone else mocked me, yet he alone stood by me, willing to speak up for me!"
As she spoke, her eyes started to redden with grievance.
At the same time, she suddenly realized that Lin Fan’s actions warmed her heart. Despite Lin Fan being brought in as her shield, tonight, he was indeed the only one by her side.
For someone isolated like her, this was incredibly rare.
Li Xueyan was rendered speechless. During the banquet, she and her husband were indeed afraid to speak much for fear of offending Elder Wei.
"I can’t even look at you!" In frustration, Li Xueyan stormed off to her room.
"I’ll go check on your mother. Xiaoxue, don’t worry too much about this matter; let’s think it over and rest early," Wei Dazong also exited.
Wei Qingxue silently turned and went into her room.
Lin Fan followed her in. He saw Wei Qingxue sitting on the bed, head down, lost in thought.
Lin Fan walked to the bed, took a cushion, and placed it on the floor along with a pillow and a thin blanket.
Knowing Wei Qingxue was upset, he decided not to disturb her.
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue looked up at Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, thank you. I’m really lucky to have you tonight."
Lin Fan waved it off with a smile, "It’s no big deal. Don’t forget, you hired me as a shield. I took your money; it’s my duty."
"Mm..." Wei Qingxue didn’t know what to say; she felt Lin Fan had already gone beyond his duty.
Two lines of silent tears rolled down her cheeks.
"Lin Fan, you jokingly said you’d help me. If only you really could, I wouldn’t know what to do now. I’m unwilling, I don’t want to be kicked out of the Wei family like this!"
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, fully expressing her reluctance and unwillingness through her eyes.
Lin Fan suddenly felt a pang of sympathy. He walked over and wiped away her tears, "Don’t worry, everything will be alright."
As night fell, Wei Qingxue fell asleep, while Lin Fan quietly got up, went to the balcony, pulled out his phone, and made a call.
"It’s me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Ambush
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 392: Ambush
"Little Fan, still up so late? Why are you suddenly interested in the Yun City Wei Family’s project?"
On the other end of the phone, Feng Ruolan’s gentle laughter echoed.
"Well... because of a friend, I’m just helping out." Lin Fan replied. He didn’t tell Feng Ruolan about his marriage to Wei Qingxue; it was too sudden, and he was afraid of scaring Feng Ruolan.
Moreover, he and Wei Qingxue were just in a fake marriage, akin to a task, nothing worth mentioning.
Feng Ruolan casually said, "Alright, I’ll arrange someone to look into the situation regarding the Wei Family’s project in Hang City tomorrow and let you know as soon as we have news."
The call quickly ended.
Nothing happened that night.
The next morning, Lin Fan got up, ready to go to work.
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, could you give me a ride to the entrance of the community? I want to buy breakfast."
At this time, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were sitting in the living room.
Li Xueyan said disgustedly, "Xiaoxue, can’t you just walk? Why do you have to ride with him? It’s so embarrassing if someone sees you!"
Wei Qingxue responded, "What’s wrong with riding my own husband’s car?"
Li Xueyan was furious, "He rides a crappy electric bike. It’s so embarrassing. If you don’t mind, I do. Do you know that our family has become the joke of the entire community because of him?"
Wei Qingxue ignored Li Xueyan and said, "Lin Fan, let’s go."
Then she left with Lin Fan.
At the community entrance, there was a luxury car parked—a Ferrari supercar worth 20 million.
Ma Jialiang, the son of the Ma Family, holding a bouquet of flowers, was waiting.
Seeing Wei Qingxue come out, Ma Jialiang immediately waved, "Little Sister Qingxue, over here."
Lin Fan had already noticed Ma Jialiang and suddenly accelerated. The electric bike seemed out of control and sped straight toward Ma Jialiang.
Ma Jialiang was scared out of his wits, quickly dodging aside, embarrassingly dropping the flowers.
Lin Fan skillfully stopped the bike.
"You little brat, are you trying to kill someone!" Ma Jialiang cursed furiously.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Didn’t Young Master Ma call us over? I got too excited, and my speed increased. Young Master Ma, why are you coming to see my wife so early?"
Ma Jialiang looked closely at Lin Fan, surprised and somewhat puzzled. Didn’t the people he hired yesterday tell him they would teach Lin Fan a lesson? Why does this guy seem perfectly fine?
He thought Lin Fan was beaten up last night and was in high spirits. He specifically bought flowers today, intending to ask Wei Qingxue out.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan was perfectly fine, contrary to his imagination of Lin Fan being bedridden from the beating. Instead, Ma Jialiang almost got hit by Lin Fan.
This guy must have done it on purpose!
Ma Jialiang felt both angry and frustrated.
"I’m here to see Little Sister Qingxue—what’s it to you?" Ma Jialiang said disdainfully.
Lin Fan said, "If I have designs on your mother, would it be none of your business?"
Ma Jialiang was furious, "What did you say? The social bottom tier will always be the social bottom tier, with such low class!"
Lin Fan responded, "Why is that? You’re allowed to have designs on my wife, but I’m not allowed to have designs on your mother?"
Ma Jialiang pointed at Lin Fan, "You brat, remember what you said today. I won’t let you off!"
Wei Qingxue said coldly, "What are you coming to find me for?"
Ma Jialiang immediately put on a flattering smile, "Little Sister Qingxue, would you be available for lunch with me? I booked the best French restaurant in Yun City. Their steak is especially famous but limited. Generally, it’s hard to book, but I managed through my dad’s connections. Let’s go taste it together?"
Ma Jialiang’s tone carried a hint of bragging, flaunting his dad’s connections which let him enjoy something others couldn’t.
Wei Qingxue directly said, "Sorry, I’m not free. You go eat by yourself."
Ma Jialiang laughed awkwardly, "Little Sister Qingxue, I heard you were fired and currently unemployed. You should have plenty of time. How could you not be free?"
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Are you mocking me for being unemployed?"
Ma Jialiang hurriedly replied, "No, how could I mock Little Sister Qingxue? Please don’t misunderstand."
Lin Fan chuckled, "Young Master Ma seems incapable of understanding human speech, doesn’t he? ’Not free’ means not wanting to go with you. You should be sensible and leave."
Ma Jialiang’s face turned slightly red, "Little Sister Qingxue, I just wanted to ask you for a meal, nothing else."
Wei Qingxue said, "I mean nothing else either. I won’t go with you. Lin Fan, I just remembered there’s noodles at home; I won’t buy breakfast. I’m going back to cook noodles."
Wei Qingxue then got off the bike and returned to the community; she didn’t want Ma Jialiang to pester her.
Ma Jialiang dared not stop her, just watching Wei Qingxue walk away.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Young Master Ma, give up on this; she’s my wife."
After saying that, Lin Fan also rode his electric bike off.
Ma Jialiang was furious, seeing the flowers on the ground, he stomped on them a few times, gritting his teeth, "All because of this Lin Fan! If it wasn’t for him, how could Little Sister Qingxue treat me like this!"
He couldn’t stand it, immediately dialing, questioning, "What’s going on? Weren’t you going to teach Lin Fan a lesson last night? How is he still unscathed?"
"What? Your guys saw Lin Fan make a move? He’s that formidable? I don’t care, if I don’t beat him up, I can’t swallow this anger!"
"Then find me an expert, I refuse to believe this delivery boy is invincible! Beat him into a pulp and send me photos!"
Ma Jialiang shouted.
That afternoon, outside the community, in a secluded corner, a group quietly approached, hiding among flower beds.
Leading them was a burly man with a scar, looking quite tough.
"Big brother, are you sure that guy lives in there? Isn’t he a delivery man?" a man asked deeply.
The scarred man replied, "No mistake, damn it, I lick blood off my blade daily, and I can’t afford a house, yet this guy lives in a high-end community!"
The scarred man’s face was full of envy and jealousy.
He’s already in his forties, still a thug with no hope of buying a house or even a toilet in this lifetime.
The others, hearing this, were indignant, "Why him!"
The scarred man said, "This guy is useless, but he’s lucky with women and became a son-in-law of the Wei Family."
Everyone giggled.
"Turns out he’s a kept man!"
"Damn it, if only I could marry a rich lady, being kept wouldn’t matter!"
"All the benefits this guy gets, it’s infuriating. Later, I’ll definitely punch him a few more times."
The scarred man reminded them, "Fight, but don’t kill him. We just need to teach him a lesson."
One man asked, "Big brother, should we go in now?"
The scarred man replied, "No need to go in. This is the only way; this guy will pass here after work. We’ll wait and act when him comes back."
So, the group waited.
Shortly after, Lin Fan came back leisurely on his electric bike.

chapters.title: Chapter 393: What to Do, Should We Go Together?
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 393: What to Do, Should We Go Together?
The scar-faced man signaled to the side with his eyes.
A thug rushed out, pretending to be anxious, blocking Lin Fan’s way.
"Hey, my grandpa fainted over there. Can you help me take a look? I can’t move him by myself," the thug said anxiously. I must admit, his acting was pretty skilled.
Lin Fan replied with an "oh," parked the car to the side immediately, and said, "I’ll go take a look with you."
So he followed the thug to the back of the flowerbed.
Suddenly, the scar-faced man jumped out with a group of people, surrounding Lin Fan.
Lin Fan frowned, "Who are you guys?"
The thug suddenly pulled out a dagger from behind his waist, chuckling, "Kid, you’ve been fooled by me!"
The scar-faced man sneered, "You must be Lin Fan, right? You’ve offended someone you shouldn’t have. We’re here to beat you up. Don’t resist, just take the beating quietly. The more you resist, the harder we’ll beat. Got it?"
Lin Fan remained silent.
The scar-faced man chuckled, "Not saying anything means you understood. Remember to take the beating quietly. If you dare to shout, I’ll cut your tongue out!"
Lin Fan said, "In this day and age, you dare to make trouble on the street and aren’t afraid I’ll report you to the police later?"
Hearing this, the scar-faced man and the others burst into laughter, as if they’d heard a big joke.
"Report to the police?" the scar-faced man laughed, "Kid, you know nothing. Prison is like a second home to us. What happens if you report us? We’ll just spend a few days in jail, and if you dare report us, we’ll come and beat you again, even harder, or just go on the run!"
These desperadoes, daring to attack him, had long reconciled with the idea of prison, and they didn’t take getting locked up seriously at all.
There was nothing more that could be done about it.
"I sincerely advise you not to court death. You’re not my match," Lin Fan said seriously.
The scar-faced man and others laughed again.
"Kid, who gives you the confidence to say such a thing?"
"Do you know who Brother Scar is? He’s our best fighter. When he was young, Brother Scar followed the boss and was unbeatable in the streets and alleys of Yun City!"
"And yet, you dare speak so arrogantly!"
Lin Fan casually replied, acknowledging how formidable Brother Scar was, but wondered if he was more formidable than Muay Thai Li San.
Even Muay Thai Li San, Lin Fan was able to defeat with a single kick.
"Who sent you guys to attack me? How much did they pay you? I’ll pay you double if you don’t hit me," Lin Fan said.
The scar-faced man laughed, "Kid, are you scared of my Brother Scar? You really don’t know anything. Do you think we’d betray our superiors? Keep your money to heal your wounds!"
Lin Fan smiled, "If I pay you, you don’t hit me, and just go back and lie that you already beat me up. Wouldn’t that work?"
Hearing this, the scar-faced man became angry, "Who do you think you’re mocking? You think I do fake acts? And do you know the consequences of deceiving our superiors? You’re trying to get us killed! Stop babbling and just let us beat you!"
With that, the scar-faced man cracked his knuckles and approached Lin Fan.
Lin Fan had already been surrounded by this group, with nowhere to retreat. He watched as the scar-faced man came closer, grabbing his collar.
The scar-faced man raised his fist, aiming to punch Lin Fan in the face.
Whoosh!
The scar-faced man’s fist swung with force, and if it landed, Lin Fan was sure to end up with a bruised face.
But with a thud, the scar-faced man’s fist did not hit Lin Fan; it hit Lin Fan’s elbow instead.
"Trying to stop a car with your bare hands!"
That was the thought that flashed across everyone’s mind the first time.
Even the scar-faced man didn’t regard Lin Fan seriously, a scornful smile appearing at the corners of his mouth.
However, in the next second.
"Ah!"
The scar-faced man let out a miserable scream, stumbling back, his hand that collided with Lin Fan’s trembling, contorted in pain.
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Logically, it should have been Lin Fan crying out in pain, but why was Lin Fan untouched and the scar-faced man seemed to be in agony?
How could this be possible?
Only Lin Fan knew, after taking the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, by harnessing the power inside, he could achieve the effect of having impenetrable skin.
The scar-faced man’s punch effectively landed on a piece of iron.
As a result, the skin broke on the scar-faced man’s hand, the bones close to fracture, trembling with pain and rendered completely immobile.
It was agony beyond belief for the scar-faced man, who looked at Lin Fan in shock.
"Damn, it hurts so much! Kid, what’s with your hand?" the scar-faced man screamed in agony.
Lin Fan smiled, "Do you want to try punching me again?"
The scar-faced man broke into a cold sweat. Punching again would be tantamount to seeking death. He wasn’t stupid.
"Brother Scar, what do we do? Should we all attack together?" someone beside him asked.
The scar-faced man’s hand was severely injured, likely unavailable for use for ten to eight days. Already scared, seeing Lin Fan’s calm demeanor, becoming certain that this guy had been pretending to be the underdog all along!
If he ordered them all to attack, they might not fare well and could even get a group of brothers injured, but leaving like this was unsatisfying. It was hard to swallow this defeat, especially since being thwarted twice made it difficult to report to their superiors!
Just as he was hesitating, sirens suddenly sounded in the vicinity, with police cars approaching!
Clearly, the commotion on their side had attracted the police’s attention!
The scar-faced man’s face changed, deciding no longer to hesitate, saying in a low voice, "Let’s go, quickly!"
Without caring about Lin Fan anymore, they turned and fled, disappearing in an instant.
If Lin Fan wanted to stop the scar-faced man, it wouldn’t be difficult, but he couldn’t be bothered, because if the police got involved, he would be taken to the police station to make a statement.
Right now, he just wanted to go home for dinner.
As for who sent the scar-faced man to attack him, Lin Fan didn’t need to guess. There were only a few people he’d offended recently, and those who knew where he lived and could set an ambush on his way home were likely Ma Jialiang.
He wanted to see what other tricks Ma Jialiang had up his sleeve. Sooner or later, he would teach Ma Jialiang a lesson, one that would be unforgettable for life.
"Lin Fan!"
A voice full of surprise called out.
The police car doors opened, and a pretty female officer stepped out, spotting Lin Fan immediately.
Loli!
Lin Fan was just about to get his car and head home when he saw Loli and paused, "Officer Sis, what a coincidence."
Loli, seeing her idol, hurriedly walked over with joy, "Lin Fan, what are you doing here? Are you okay? What happened just now?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Nothing, just a group of blind thugs who, hearing the sirens, got so scared they fled with tails tucked between their legs."
Loli asked, "You still haven’t answered my first question."
That was a bit awkward now.
Lin Fan didn’t want to tell Loli that he was married, became a live-in son-in-law, and lived nearby.
In fact, Lin Fan didn’t want acquaintances to know he was married because the marriage was just a mission, but he couldn’t tell anyone it was a mission, and even if he did, no one would believe him. They would just think it was true.
"I came to deliver a package," Lin Fan chuckled.
"Alright then." Loli sighed, thinking Lin Fan’s hobbies were quite unique—being so rich yet still enjoying labor-intensive jobs like delivery, now moving on to courier service.
"By the way, Lin Fan, I was actually looking for you. It’s great that I found you. I have progress on the An Jincheng case," Loli said.

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Can this company be borrowed by me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Chapter 394: Can this company be borrowed by me?
When Lin Fan returned home, he found that only Wei Qingxue was there.
Wei Qingxue had recently been dismissed and was struggling with the financial issues, so she could only stay home alone.
"You’re back! Sorry, I haven’t cooked. If you’re hungry, just cook something for yourself," Wei Qingxue said, somewhat listlessly.
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay. Are you hungry? I can help you cook."
Wei Qingxue said, "Whatever."
Lin Fan then went to the kitchen to get busy.
Not long after, Li Xueyan returned.
As soon as Li Xueyan entered, she asked Wei Qingxue, "Daughter, have you found a solution for the company’s financial issues?"
Feeling a wave of annoyance, Wei Qingxue shook her head.
"That’s great!" Li Xueyan seemed somewhat pleased.
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Mom, what do you mean by this?"
Realizing her slip, Li Xueyan toned down her smile, "What I mean is, I have a way to help you."
Wei Qingxue was a bit surprised, "You can help me get investment?"
Li Xueyan said, "Yes, I had a chat with President Zhao of the Wanjin Group today, and he said they can invest in us."
Wei Qingxue exclaimed joyfully, "Really? Wanjin is a financial company with strong resources. Are they really willing to invest in us?"
Li Xueyan said, "I’ve been friends with President Zhao for a long time, so this investment negotiation went fairly well. Just that..."
Li Xueyan deliberately paused.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Just that what?"
Li Xueyan said, "It’s like this, President Zhao has a son named Zhao Feng. What he means is for our families to become in-laws..."
"What?" Wei Qingxue jumped up, "This is absurd! Haven’t I made my stance clear about Ma Jialiang? Mom, you should know this is impossible!"
Lin Fan chimed in, "Exactly, why are you looking for another match for my wife!"
"You good-for-nothing, shut up!" Li Xueyan scolded, "This is a conversation between mother and daughter, it’s not your place to interrupt. Don’t forget you’re just a son-in-law who married into the family, stay out of this!"
Lin Fan said, "Of course it’s my business if you want my wife to remarry."
Li Xueyan, infuriated, pointed at Lin Fan and yelled, "How dare you talk back! You’ve lost all respect! Qingxue’s biggest mistake was marrying a loser like you. If she had married a rich man from the start, would we be in this predicament? I say we take this chance to divorce you!"
Wei Qingxue said, "Mom, stop it. Lin Fan, you go cook first, I’ll talk with Mom."
"Okay." Lin Fan responded and went into the kitchen.
Wei Qingxue pulled Li Xueyan to sit down, "Mom, I know you’re looking out for me, but this is too outrageous. I won’t agree to it. Please help me decline."
Li Xueyan said, "Silly daughter, what’s there in Lin Fan for you to hold onto? You wouldn’t marry Ma Jialiang, and I’m not forcing you anymore since it ended badly for both sides, but with Zhao Feng, you have to listen to me. This might be your last chance."
Wei Qingxue said, "If I remarry for money, what will outsiders think of me? I’ll be a joke for the rest of my life."
Li Xueyan said, "What’s there to laugh about? A wise bird chooses its tree. You must listen to me on this. You are our family’s greatest hope and can’t lose your position. Think about it, not just for yourself but for the family’s sake!"
Wei Qingxue listened, a bit annoyed, "Mom, stop talking. I won’t agree anyway."
Li Xueyan immediately became agitated, "Why are you being so stubborn? Do you want to drive me to death? Is that what it takes for you to agree?"
Wei Qingxue was speechless, "You’re overreacting."
"I see you want me to die in front of you. Well then, I’ll die and show you!"
Li Xueyan cried out, pulling a razor from her bag and putting it to her wrist, as if to slit it.
Wei Qingxue was startled, "Don’t be impulsive! Put the knife down first!"
Li Xueyan said, "If you don’t agree, I’ll die and show you!"
Wei Qingxue said helplessly, "Mom, what do you want from me?"
Li Xueyan said, "At least promise me you’ll meet Young Master Zhao tomorrow. Daughter, you have only a week. A day is already gone. Stop being willful, or I might as well be dead."
Wei Qingxue bit her lip, unwilling to risk her mother’s life. If her mom really acted this way, she’d be guilty for the rest of her life.
"Alright, I’ll go meet him, but I can’t promise I’ll like him," Wei Qingxue said.
Li Xueyan immediately smiled, "Now that’s more like it. There’s a party tomorrow. I’ve already arranged for you to meet him there."
Saying this, Li Xueyan carefully put the razor away, fearing it might accidentally cut.
By her demeanor, suicide seemed unlikely - it was clearly just a method to threaten Wei Qingxue.
Lin Fan watched, chuckled softly, and said nothing.
That night, back in their room.
Wei Qingxue said shyly, "Lin Fan, I’ve already promised Mom I’ll meet that Young Master Zhao tomorrow. I know it goes against our marriage agreement, but I can’t watch Mom threaten suicide. I hope you understand. I assure you, I will quickly send him away tomorrow."
Lin Fan smiled, "I understand, but I have a request; tomorrow, I’ll go too."
In the still of the night.
Lin Fan called Feng Ruolan, "Sister, do you know about the Wanjin Group? I heard it’s a financial company."
Feng Ruolan said, "I know it, it’s one of the companies I’ve invested in. Currently, I’m the largest shareholder. When Wanjin faced a financial crisis and could no longer continue, Zhao Jiasheng came to me, and I helped save his company. Little Fan, why are you suddenly interested in this company?"
Lin Fan said, "Can I borrow this company for a while? I’ll explain the reason to you later."
Feng Ruolan replied without hesitation, "No problem, it’s a small matter. Tomorrow I’ll call a shareholders’ meeting to vote Zhao Jiasheng out and appoint you as chairman. How does that sound?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you, Sister."
Lin Fan went to sleep reassured.
The next day, at a private party in the circle of the wealthy.
Wei Qingxue arrived at the party venue in a strapless gown, immediately attracting the eyes of everyone around, stirring rounds of admiring whispers.
"Her figure is enviable!"
"She’s really beautiful! Madam Wei sure gave birth to a stunner..."
Wei Qingxue was the most dazzling presence at the event. In truth, she hadn’t spent much time dressing up; she was simply too beautiful and looked good in anything.
Walking alongside her, Li Xueyan relished the attention, eager to share in her daughter’s glow and enjoy the admiration from others.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Which one is Young Master Zhao?"
She only wanted to quickly get this meeting over with and leave.
Li Xueyan said, "I haven’t seen him yet."
Zhao Feng hadn’t arrived, but Lin Fan did.
Among the expensively dressed attendees, only Lin Fan was casually clad in cheap streetwear, totaling perhaps less than 100 dollars, drawing curious glances.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: Hello, I am Wei Qingxue’s husband
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: Chapter 395: Hello, I am Wei Qingxue’s husband
"What’s wrong with this guy? He dares to come dressed like this to such a high-end event?"
"He seems to be the Zhu Family’s son-in-law, Wei Qingxue’s husband, the so-called freeloader!"
"Pfft, people say he’s a loser. He looks quite handsome, but his clothes are too shabby. How did Wei Qingxue end up marrying such a loser..."
"I heard he’s still a delivery guy!"
Hearing the sneers around her, Li Xueyan’s face darkened. Lin Fan had completely embarrassed her...
Li Xueyan, who was just riding on her daughter’s coattails, now wanted nothing more than to hide far away.
"Lin Fan, what are you doing here?" Li Xueyan said angrily, if not for the eyes around them, she would have already burst out scolding.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m here looking for a job."
He wasn’t wrong, it’s just that his job was having just received news from Feng Ruolan, becoming the new chairman of Wanjin Group—no one else’s job here could compare to his.
"Dressed like this, coming here to look for a job, are you here to clean toilets or serve drinks?" Li Xueyan couldn’t help but scold.
The people around, hearing this, burst into laughter.
"That’s an insult to the waitstaff. Their uniforms aren’t cheap. I think he looks more like a janitor!"
The crowd laughed as they covered their noses, as if they really smelled something foul on Lin Fan.
Li Xueyan was about to cry from anger.
"Lin Fan, if you don’t leave now, stop embarrassing me here!"
"Exactly, at an event like this, someone as worthless as you shouldn’t even show up!"
A voice said, as Wei Zihan walked over, arm in arm with Zhu Xiaolong.
Zhu Xiaolong’s neat and tidy suit was very eye-catching, and this brand’s suit is worth at least ten thousand.
"Wow, who’s that? So handsome!"
The people around were immediately captivated by Zhu Xiaolong.
Li Xueyan said, "Zihan, you came too?"
Wei Zihan proudly said, "Let me introduce, this is my boyfriend Zhu Xiaolong, the Young Boss of Huamao Group. I’m here today to accompany him to the party; he’s good friends with Zhao Feng, the Young Boss of Wanjin."
Feeling the envious gazes around her, Wei Zihan was full of pride.
Wei Zihan’s boasting made Chu Mengyu feel uncomfortable. Without comparison, there is no harm, Lin Fan seemed really inferior to Zhu Xiaolong.
Lin Fan remained calm; he knew Wei Zihan was deliberately trying to embarrass him, but his heart was unmoved. The Zhu Family’s business was nothing in his eyes.
But in Li Xueyan’s eyes, it was different.
In front of Zhu Xiaolong, Lin Fan seemed even more useless. The main thing was Lin Fan was an actual son-in-law, how annoying, Li Xueyan’s disgust for Lin Fan only grew stronger; she really wished to divorce him right away.
Ding ding ding!
At that moment, a sound of clinking glasses was heard, and a suited middle-aged man stepped onto the stage.
"Ladies and gentlemen, please quiet down," the middle-aged man said with a smile.
The crowd immediately quieted down and looked over.
The middle-aged man said, "Welcome everyone to tonight’s gala. We have one theme tonight, which is to raise funds for leukemia patients. Since my father passed away from leukemia, this was one of his wishes during his lifetime. I hope everyone can give generously."
"I, Zhao Feng, personally donate 300 thousand!"
A voice said, and a man around thirty years old walked over, in a full set of branded suit, looking every bit of a successful person.
Zhao Feng, filled with vigor and spirit, was the first to jump at the chance to donate. From a personal standpoint, donating 300 thousand was already quite a lot.
"Bravo!"
The hall erupted in applause and cheers, Zhao Feng had gained everyone’s attention in that moment.
"The Young Boss of Wanjin, Zhao Feng, really impressive!"
"So generous, I heard he’s still single. Whoever gets to be his girlfriend must be really lucky."
Hearing the praises around him, Zhao Feng was very pleased. With his flamboyant personality, he liked to be the center of attention and enjoyed the applause of others. Of course, his main goal tonight was to attract Wei Qingxue’s attention.
Zhao Feng walked directly over to Wei Qingxue, smiling, "Aunt Xueyan, this must be your daughter Wei Qingxue. She’s indeed very beautiful!"
Li Xueyan smiled, "Yes, indeed, Young Master Zhao."
"Miss Wei, hello, my name is Zhao Feng," Zhao Feng said with a smile, reaching out his hand, intending to shake hands with Wei Qingxue.
But beside him, a hand suddenly reached out and shook Zhao Feng’s hand, "Zhao Feng, right? Hello, I’m Wei Qingxue’s husband."
This was awkward.
Zhao Feng’s face turned somewhat ugly, "Did you bring your husband too?"
Li Xueyan was infuriated and hurriedly said, "Young Master Zhao, don’t misunderstand, we didn’t bring him. Lin Fan, weren’t you looking for a job? Just go, will you?"
With Lin Fan here, Zhao Feng would mind and it would ruin her big plans.
Zhao Feng’s eyes were full of contempt as he mocked, "So you’re unemployed? No wonder you had to become the kind of son-in-law everyone looks down on. My company happens to need a cleaner; if you ask me, I might help you with an introduction."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "No need for that, you should worry about yourself."
He’s now the chairman of Wanjin; firing Zhao Feng would only take a phone call.
Zhao Feng snorted coldly, "Ungrateful!"
Lin Fan ignored him and said to Wei Qingxue, "My dear wife, I’ve settled the job issue, so now I have time to accompany you."
