Wei Qingxue nodded, amused at heart. Although Lin Fan was just a delivery guy, she had to admit his performance was quite impressive—he was the perfect shield.
Li Xueyan was speechless, with people all around watching, and with Zhao Feng beside her, she couldn’t chase Lin Fan away to avoid unnecessary gossip.
Wei Zihan couldn’t help but sneer, "Wei Qingxue, that’s unfair. Coming to such events, you still bring your loser husband. You should know you’re running out of time; I heard you still have no leads, haha..."
Wei Qingxue said nothing.
"This bastard!" Li Xueyan spat out.
Wei Zihan’s words weighed heavily on Li Xueyan, causing unprecedented pressure. If they couldn’t find investment soon, they were truly done for.
Li Xueyan said, "Little Zhao, you must help Qingxue this time; our whole family is counting on you."
Being needed this much, Zhao Feng felt a bit elated, "Don’t worry, your problem is mine. So, what’s the issue?"
Lin Fan couldn’t help but say, "Wife, I can quickly handle the funding issue; you really don’t need him!"
Li Xueyan was furious, "You useless piece of trash, shut up! Do I not know what you are? What grounds do you have to help? No self-awareness at all!"
The people around were quietly chuckling.
"He’s just jealous, he can’t help but won’t let his wife seek other men’s help."
"Too pathetic, who wouldn’t say he’s pitiful?"
"I think it’s sad, the most useless kind of man in the world!"
Hearing everyone stepping on Lin Fan made Zhao Feng’s mood soar, feeling he looked even more grandiose.
"Funding? My family is a financial company, if you need investment, turning to us at Wanjin is spot on!" Zhao Feng said, patting his chest confidently.
Li Xueyan said, "It’s like this, our company is currently short on funds and urgently needs a billion investment, Little Zhao, surely there’s no problem, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Must Apologize to Miss Wei Qingxue
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 396: Must Apologize to Miss Wei Qingxue
Before heading out today, Zhao Feng’s father, Wanjin Group’s chairman Zhao Jiasheng, had discussed with Zhao Feng that he should pursue Wei Qingxue. Wei Qingxue would definitely comply, since she currently has something to ask of them.
If Wei Qingxue agreed to marry Zhao Feng, Zhao Jiasheng would invest 1 billion in the Wei Family’s project in Hang City.
At this moment, as Li Xueyan brought up the investment topic, Zhao Feng, without hesitation, patted his chest and said, "1 billion is nothing. No problem, leave it to me!"
Li Xueyan was very pleased, "Thank you, Young Master Zhao!"
People around were all praising, feeling quite envious.
"Young Master Zhao is really wealthy!"
"Goodness, saying you’ll give 1 billion just like that, so rich!"
"So envious, no wonder Young Master Zhao is so generous; donating 300 thousand is just a drop in the bucket for him."
Li Xueyan nudged Wei Qingxue, "Qingxue, why are you still standing there? Quickly thank Young Master Zhao!"
Wei Qingxue: "..."
She knew what this implied; if she accepted the Zhao Family’s billion, she would have to marry Zhao Feng in return, and she didn’t want to remarry.
But she really had no options to find this billion; this might be her only opportunity.
Zhao Feng looked expectantly at Wei Qingxue, very confident that she would agree.
Ring, ring, ring...
Just then, Zhao Feng’s phone rang.
Zhao Feng said, "Excuse me, I need to take a call from my father."
Zhao Feng then moved aside to answer the call.
Suddenly, Zhao Feng’s face turned grim, and he exclaimed, "What? Father, are you serious? How is that possible?"
Zhao Feng hung up looking disheartened.
Li Xueyan asked with concern, "Little Zhao, what’s wrong?"
"Sorry, I have an urgent matter and need to go now."
Zhao Feng forced a smile.
Li Xueyan hurriedly said, "What about the investment?"
Zhao Feng said, "Let’s talk about it later."
Without waiting for Li Xueyan’s reply, he left in a hurry.
Leaving Li Xueyan and Wei Qingxue baffled.
Li Xueyan said in wonder, "Why did Little Zhao leave so hastily?"
She was a bit anxious; Zhao Feng didn’t seem very reliable.
She couldn’t help but glare at Lin Fan; it must be Lin Fan who offended Zhao Feng, prompting him to find an excuse to leave.
Lin Fan smiled faintly; Zhao Jiasheng was no longer the chairman of Wanjin Group and could no longer make investment decisions for the Wei Family. Zhao Jiasheng must have called to say this, and Zhao Feng had to find an excuse to escape.
Wei Qingxue, instead, felt relieved; she had already decided to refuse Zhao Feng’s offer, and Zhao Feng leaving saved both parties from embarrassment.
However, this also meant she might have lost her only opportunity, leaving Wei Qingxue feeling heavy-hearted.
At this moment, Wei Zihan walked over and said sarcastically, "Why did Young Master Zhao leave? That’s your only chance, and you didn’t seize it. Do you know why?"
Li Xueyan asked, "Zihan, do you know the reason?"
Wei Zihan sneered, "Isn’t it obvious? Who told you to bring your useless husband, Young Master Zhao must have gotten angry."
Li Xueyan thought the same, infuriated, she was about to turn and scold Lin Fan.
Since Zhao Feng was the first to donate, many others had donated since, and applause filled the venue.
A middle-aged man suddenly turned his gaze toward this side.
"I’ve noticed the two ladies from the Wei Family are also here. I wonder how much you plan to donate this time?" the middle-aged man said jokingly.
All eyes immediately turned towards them.
Wei Zihan, having come to watch the excitement, hadn’t planned to donate, feeling embarrassed as so many watched. But if she didn’t donate, she’d lose face.
Wei Zihan nudged Zhu Xiaolong, indicating for him to donate on her behalf.
Zhu Xiaolong understood Wei Zihan’s intention but was a bit unwilling, whispering, "How much?"
Wei Zihan said, "Zhao Feng donated 300 thousand, you donate 300 thousand too."
Zhu Xiaolong frowned, "That much?"
Wei Zihan said displeased, "Your gift to grandpa and my diamond ring are fake; donating for me now makes up for it—isn’t it fair?"
Zhu Xiaolong said, "I was deceived, the money is gone, I don’t have that much now."
Wei Zihan sweated, "Then how much do you have?"
Zhu Xiaolong said, "Nothing."
Wei Zihan was furious; Zhu Xiaolong wasn’t going to help her donate.
Seeing the two whispering, the middle-aged man coughed twice and chuckled, "Miss Wei, have you come to a decision? As the eldest young lady of the Yun City Wei Family, surely you won’t be stingy with your compassion."
Wei Zihan’s face turned red, forcing a laugh as she said, "Sorry, I won’t be donating this time."
What?
Everyone was astonished.
Wei Zihan actually refused to donate in front of so many people?
"No way, the eldest young lady of the Wei Family is so stingy!"
"Laughable, so embarrassing!"
"Shameless, attending the banquet and donating not a cent."
"Why come if not donating?"
People began to gossip, chuckling quietly.
Wei Zihan almost wanted to run into a wall; for someone who cares about her face, this was a terrible humiliation, but she couldn’t speak because, though she’s the eldest young lady of the Wei Family, she only received an allowance at home, and spent recklessly. Her latest allowance was spent, and the next month’s hadn’t come yet, leaving no money to donate.
Zhu Xiaolong’s unwillingness to pay had resulted in this awkward situation.
Haha!
Seeing Wei Zihan’s discomfort, Lin Fan nearby couldn’t help but laugh.
Wei Zihan nearly went mad seeing this, unable to resist saying, "What are you laughing at? I can’t donate, but can Wei Qingxue? She’s even worse than me!"
Everyone turned to look at Wei Qingxue, somewhat surprised; surely not, as Wei Qingxue is also a daughter of the Wei Family, and a company president, could she also not afford to donate?
Wei Qingxue felt embarrassed, although Wei Zihan’s words were unpleasant, she really hadn’t intended to donate.
She didn’t have much money!
Besides needing to pay Lin Fan his 1 million reward, her remaining funds were limited. Considering she might be expelled from the Wei Family in the future, she had to rely on these savings.
Li Xueyan blushed, lowering her head, wishing she could find a hole to hide, blaming Lin Fan for his laughter, causing trouble for Wei Qingxue.
People murmured around.
"Haha, not donating is fine," the middle-aged man said, although his face showed displeasure.
The atmosphere grew awkward.
Just then, a servant hurriedly approached the middle-aged man, handing him a note.
The middle-aged man read the note, looking surprised.
"I must apologize to Miss Wei Qingxue here; I’m sorry for misunderstanding Miss Wei Qingxue. It turns out Miss Wei Qingxue had already donated 1 million in her name before our banquet!" the middle-aged man said apologetically.
Following that, the middle-aged man respectfully bowed in apology to Wei Qingxue.
What?
Everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: I Still Have This Much Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 397: I Still Have This Much Money
It turns out, the first person to donate was not Zhao Feng, but actually Wei Qingxue, and she even donated the most, a million! That’s so generous!
Many who mocked Wei Qingxue earlier felt their faces burning; this face-slapping feeling was too satisfying.
"Miss Wei is truly too generous!"
"We misunderstood her, Miss Wei is really kind-hearted!"
"Truly worthy of being the head of the Wei Family, Miss Wei is the one who genuinely does good deeds, donating a million without saying a word!"
"Compared to her, the eldest daughter of the Wei Family is so stingy, publicly refusing to donate!"
"This eldest daughter of the Wei Family is really an eye-opener, Miss Wei Qingxue is better! Beautiful and kind-hearted!"
The crowd couldn’t stop praising Wei Qingxue while also mocking the stingy Wei Zihan.
Listening to these words, Wei Zihan blushed with shame and anger, she had no face to stay here, turned around, and walked out furiously.
Before leaving, Wei Zihan gave Wei Qingxue a fierce look: "Wei Qingxue, you win!"
Zhu Xiaolong quickly followed her out.
Wei Qingxue was utterly confused at this moment.
She was very sure she hadn’t donated this money, how did this one million donation suddenly appear? Could there be a mistake?
Li Xueyan originally wanted to bury herself in embarrassment, but at that moment a group of people approached, praising her for having a good daughter.
Li Xueyan’s face lit up again, her face glowing with a radiant smile, engaging in small talk with the crowd.
The cocktail party ended after Wei Qingxue’s one million donation, making her the focus of the night, winning the title of the most charitable with the largest donation.
Wei Qingxue, feeling confused, planned to go over and inquire with that middle-aged man.
Lin Fan suddenly said in a low voice: "No need to ask, I donated the money for you."
Wei Qingxue was taken aback, laughing and crying: "Lin Fan, why did you do that?"
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Coming to a charity cocktail party, how could you not donate? You saw how Wei Zihan was ridiculed, I can’t let you be looked down upon as well."
Wei Qingxue said: "But... this is a million!"
Lin Fan said: "Didn’t you say you would give me a million as a reward? Just use it for this charity."
Wei Qingxue was stunned, this million belonged to Lin Fan, he used his own money to help her do charity? Lin Fan is just a delivery guy, a million must be a huge sum for him, and he just donated like that...
Wei Qingxue didn’t know what to say for a moment.
Lin Fan smiled slightly: "My dear wife, how did I do tonight? Anyway, my electric bike is still parked outside, the security guard said I can’t park too long, I’m heading out first."
After speaking, Lin Fan turned and left.
Wei Qingxue called after him: "Wait a moment."
Lin Fan turned back: "What’s up?"
Wei Qingxue smiled: "Thank you, Lin Fan."
Lin Fan waved his hand, indicating no thanks needed, and walked out.
Watching Lin Fan’s back, Wei Qingxue felt inexplicably warm inside, even though she and Lin Fan were just pretending to be married, at that moment, she felt Lin Fan was her husband, she seemed to be able to rely on his back, giving her a sense of security.
Thinking about this, Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but blush.
Not long after, Wei Qingxue and Li Xueyan also left the cocktail party.
Li Xueyan couldn’t wait to ask: "Daughter, what’s going on, how did you end up donating a million?"
Li Xueyan looked pained.
Wei Qingxue said: "Earlier inside, everyone surrounded you with praise, weren’t you very happy?"
Li Xueyan said: "Indeed, donating a million is truly prestigious, but it’s such a waste of money."
Li Xueyan fretted about the money all the way home, scolding Wei Qingxue the entire time, but Wei Qingxue didn’t intend to tell Li Xueyan that it was Lin Fan’s donation, otherwise, she would definitely blame Lin Fan.
Back home, Li Xueyan was still prattling about the matter.
Wei Dazong hearing this was also surprised: "Qingxue, given the current situation, you still donated a million to charity, how should I say this?"
"..." Wei Qingxue was momentarily speechless.
"I donated the money under Qingxue’s name, it has nothing to do with her." Lin Fan came out from the room and said.
"What?" Li Xueyan was furious, "So it’s your good deed! You useless person, it’s bad enough you’re worthless, but you wasted my daughter’s money! Let me just say this to you, you went to the cocktail party for nothing, if you offended Young Master Zhao and delayed the Zhao Family’s billion-dollar investment, causing Qingxue to be kicked out of the Wei Family, you’d be the main culprit! Daughter, this useless person will ruin you for life, why are you still attached, I say, divorce him now!"
Wei Dazong was also angry: "Lin Fan, I know you can’t bear to part with Qingxue, but now Qingxue is facing being kicked out of the Wei Family, if you truly love her, you should think of her future and voluntarily let go, let her marry into a good family, not hold her back! Your actions are truly abhorrent!"
Wei Qingxue seeing Lin Fan being scolded again, felt sorry, and said: "Dad, Mom, things aren’t as you think..."
Li Xueyan said angrily: "You’re still defending this useless person!"
Lin Fan chuckled and said: "I’ll explain myself. First, I donated the money under Qingxue’s name to avoid her losing face, you saw how Wei Zihan was ridiculed, wouldn’t you not want to see Qingxue like that? Secondly, the money I donated was my own, not Qingxue’s, I didn’t waste her money."
For Li Xueyan, she had no retort to Lin Fan’s motives for donating, she had to admit Lin Fan’s consideration was indeed correct, preventing Wei Qingxue from being embarrassed like Wei Zihan.
However!
"You didn’t waste her money? So you have a million yourself now, you, a delivery guy, can have that much money?" Li Xueyan sneered, completely not believing Lin Fan had that kind of money.
Wei Dazong said: "Since it’s your money, when they come collecting the money later, don’t let Qingxue settle the bill!"
Li Xueyan said: "That’s right, Qingxue, you mustn’t help him pay this money, I want to see where he finds a million to pay, you’re just a poor loser, even if you sold yourself, you wouldn’t be worth a million!"
Lin Fan reached into his pants pocket.
"Sorry, I’ve already paid the money, this is the receipt." Lin Fan said, then pulled out a receipt and placed it on the table.
What?
Li Xueyan quickly grabbed the receipt to look at it, stunned, it really was a receipt for a charity donation, a full million!
This was a blatant slap in the face.
Li Xueyan’s face turned red, but she insisted: "How do I know this isn’t money Qingxue gave you!"
Wei Qingxue said: "Mom, this really isn’t money I gave to Lin Fan, if you don’t believe it, you can check my bank statement tomorrow."
She was also surprised, Lin Fan actually used his own money for the donation, where did he get so much money?
With the conversation reaching this point, Li Xueyan had no reason not to believe, Lin Fan really used his own money and donated a million under Wei Qingxue’s name!
Li Xueyan was momentarily speechless.
The atmosphere was somewhat awkward.
Wei Dazong was a bit more open-minded, chuckling: "Sorry, Lin Fan, we misunderstood you, I apologize."
Lin Fan calmly said: "Though I’m just a deliveryman you look down on, I still have this bit of money. Qingxue is my wife, I will naturally protect her to the best of my ability. Unlike you, forcing her to remarry for money, if she does remarry, even if she stays in the Wei Family, she would just become a joke, ridiculed behind her back for a lifetime, is that what you want to see?"
What Lin Fan said made too much sense, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were left speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 398: Chairman, You Finally Arrived!
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 398: Chairman, You Finally Arrived!
Lin Fan no longer paid them any attention and turned to enter the room.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan’s expressions became complicated. They had to admit that what Lin Fan said made a lot of sense.
They had previously only wanted Li Xueyan to stay in the Wei Family, so they forced her to remarry, without considering that doing so would ruin their daughter’s reputation.
If tarnished with a bad reputation, even if she stayed in the Wei Family, Wei Qingxue wouldn’t be happy, right!
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan realized this and couldn’t help feeling a bit guilty.
Wei Qingxue was feeling conflicted and soon also returned to her room.
Lin Fan had already laid out a bedroll and was preparing to sleep.
"Lin Fan..." Wei Qingxue bit her lip and said.
Lin Fan looked up and smiled, "What’s the matter?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Nothing, I just wanted to thank you for what you’ve done for me."
Lin Fan grinned, "It’s my job, right? Did I do a decent job?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Hmm... you did great. The one million you donated on my behalf, I’ll repay you soon. You worked hard for that money and I can’t let you spend it."
A million, for Lin Fan, really wasn’t much money. Not to mention his bank account still had a hundred billion sitting in it, and he was receiving half a million in cash rewards daily...
"Alright." Lin Fan casually said, he couldn’t act indifferent, in case he revealed too much, because for a courier, a million is indeed a lot.
As he spoke, Lin Fan had already laid down to sleep on the bedroll.
Seeing this, Wei Qingxue felt inexplicably tender-hearted; sleeping on the floor must be very cold. For some reason, she had a sudden thought that made her face flush and her heartbeat quicken.
"Oh my, how could I have such a thought? We’re just a fake couple; how could we sleep on the same bed..."
It must be because Lin Fan’s performance tonight was so good, causing her to be moved...
Wei Qingxue forced herself to calm down and quickly climbed into bed and hid under the covers to sleep.
Nothing happened during the night.
Time came to the next day.
Wei Qingxue still had no way to solve the financial problem and announced that she decided to give up, accepting being quickly driven out of the Wei Family.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were helpless.
They had planned for Wei Qingxue to remarry, whether it was marrying into the Ma Family or the Zhao Family, to solve this problem.
But after being refuted by Lin Fan last night, they also realized the problem: having Wei Qingxue remarry now would indeed ruin her reputation, which might become a lifelong blemish for their daughter.
They ultimately love their daughter and don’t wish to tarnish her name.
So they decided not to force Wei Qingxue to remarry.
That left them with no solution.
After some deliberation, Li Xueyan decided to contact Zhao Jiasheng again, perhaps he could be persuaded to invest under the premise that Wei Qingxue doesn’t remarry.
Yesterday, Zhao Feng received Zhao Jiasheng’s call and suddenly left in a hurry, she hadn’t figured out why and kept thinking about it.
So Li Xueyan dialed Zhao Jiasheng: "President Zhao, last night Young Master Zhao was talking amiably with us, why did he suddenly leave, was there something we did wrong?"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "Sorry Sister Yan, due to some sudden circumstance, I called little Feng back home."
Li Xueyan said, "Then about Young Master Zhao and my daughter Xiaoxue..."
Zhao Jiasheng said, "Haha, if this marriage could happen, that would be wonderful. I admire Xiaoxue a lot and she could definitely be a good help to the Zhao Family..."
Li Xueyan said awkwardly, "Well... it’s like this, President Zhao, Xiaoxue doesn’t want to remarry, and we respect her decision, so I’m afraid this marriage can’t be pursued further. I called mainly to discuss the project investment, I wonder if President Zhao is still interested?"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "So to say, Xiaoxue doesn’t fancy my little Feng?"
Li Xueyan quickly smiled apologetically, "It’s not like that. Young Master Zhao is so charming; being able to marry him would be Xiaoxue’s good fortune. It’s just a pity she is already married and can’t get divorced yet, only missing the good match with Young Master Zhao."
Zhao Jiasheng let out an "Oh": "Alright, since Xiaoxue doesn’t want to remarry, I won’t force it. As for the investment, I’m sorry to inform Sister Yan, I can’t proceed with it either."
Li Xueyan said, "President Zhao, our project is really worth investing in. I’ve previously discussed it with you in detail, leaving the children’s marriage aside, from the business angle, investing in this project will surely be profitable."
Zhao Jiasheng smiled bitterly, "Sister Yan, don’t misunderstand. The reason I said the investment couldn’t continue is not because Xiaoxue doesn’t want to marry into the Zhao Family, although that is indeed a pity. But as you said, from a business standpoint, I did see your project, just I truly can’t right now."
Li Xueyan frowned, inquisitive, "Can I ask why?"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "I am no longer the chairman of Wanjin, so I have no authority to make decisions."
Li Xueyan was surprised, "What? Oh my, what happened?"
She even thought Zhao Jiasheng was joking.
Wanjin Group was founded by Zhao Jiasheng and he had always served as chairman, how come suddenly he lost the chairman seat?
Zhao Jiasheng perplexedly said, "It’s true, I don’t even know what happened, I’m still figuring it out."
The largest shareholder of Wanjin Group is Longheng Group.
Longheng Group’s absolute controller is Feng Ruolan, the female tycoon of Yun City, known in the industry as a financial demon; no one dares provoke her, and all other shareholders of Wanjin Group follow Feng Ruolan.
Yesterday, Feng Ruolan suddenly held a shareholders’ meeting and actually had Zhao Jiasheng voted out as chairman!
Once Feng Ruolan proposed it, no shareholders opposed.
Initially, Wanjin Group encountered a crisis, Zhao Jiasheng sought Feng Ruolan for help, Feng Ruolan later took a stake in Wanjin, becoming the largest shareholder and helping save Wanjin.
Feng Ruolan subsequently acted as a hands-off manager, Wanjin still run by Zhao Jiasheng, all decisions being made by him, Feng Ruolan never interfered.
This time, Feng Ruolan suddenly interfered, and right off the bat, ousted Zhao Jiasheng, a truly shocking move.
Zhao Jiasheng was puzzled.
Early in the morning, Zhao Jiasheng decided to personally visit Longheng Group to see Feng Ruolan and ask the reason. At the moment, he was in a car heading to Longheng Mansion, talking to Li Xueyan.
Meanwhile, the newly appointed chairman of Wanjin Group, Lin Fan, was also heading to Wanjin, preparing to take over.
At Wanjin Company, all board members had arrived early today, eager to welcome the new chairman taking office.
This mysterious new chairman wasn’t simple at all, rumored that to let him take office, Feng Ruolan convened a shareholders’ meeting, ousting Zhao Jiasheng.
Who is it that can make Feng Ruolan act this way?
Lin Fan walked to the entrance of Wanjin Company, but was stopped by a security guard.
"Stop, don’t proceed anymore, who are you? Do you know what this place is? Is it a place you can come casually?" The security guard said rudely, sizing up Lin Fan, who appeared poor and downtrodden, making him the perfect target for intimidation!
Even today, the security guards at Wanjin were somewhat floating on air.
All the company’s board members were in the building, reportedly awaiting the new chairman, as the saying goes, when a new official takes charge, he burns three fires, and the security was also alert.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m here to work."
The security guard hesitated, "Work? Dressed like this to work at Wanjin? Wanjin is a finance company, everyone is suited up. Stop talking nonsense here, get lost!"
"Chairman, you finally arrived!"
Suddenly, a middle-aged man walked out from inside, upon seeing Lin Fan, he promptly came over with a welcoming attitude.
Apparently, the board members had discussed that simple waiting wasn’t enough, deciding to head to the entrance to greet.
At this time, the board members came out in succession, each bowing and saluting Lin Fan.
Seeing this, the security guard nearby immediately turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Immediately Fired!
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 399: Immediately Fired!
The security guard’s face turned deathly pale; the person he had just tried to drive away was actually the new chairman! He had hit a wall this time.
"Chairman, we’ve been expecting you for a long time!"
The middle-aged man said with a warm smile, his attitude extremely respectful.
This middle-aged man was a senior board member of Wanjin Company and trusted by Feng Ruolan. To avoid any obstacles for Lin Fan, Feng Ruolan had sent Lin Fan’s photo to this middle-aged man.
Therefore, the middle-aged man recognized Lin Fan at a glance and was the first to come over and greet him.
Seeing this, the other board members quickly came over to greet him as well, striving to be first, fearing they would be late.
One of the board members looked up at Lin Fan, and his expression changed suddenly. He exclaimed, "Chairman, are you Mr. Lin?"
The new richest man in Yun City, Mr. Lin!
Mortal Group, with a market value of 200 billion, dominated Yun City!
The name of Mr. Lin was almost universally known, but not many had the opportunity to meet him. Yun City was so big, with millions of people, and not everyone had seen Lin Fan.
But there were those who, having seen a photo of Lin Fan, would recognize him, like this board member.
What?
Mr. Lin?
Everyone present was astonished.
Could their new chairman really be the new richest man in Yun City, the legendary mysterious magnate Mr. Lin?
"Hello everyone, I am Lin Fan,"
Lin Fan said with a slight smile. If no one had recognized him, he wouldn’t have said so proactively, but since someone did recognize him, he didn’t conceal it.
He admitted it himself; there could be no mistake now.
Everyone was stunned.
The security guard’s face turned ashen, and he knelt on the spot.
He had offended not only Wanjin’s new chairman but also the richest man in Yun City!
"Chairman, Mr. Lin, I failed to recognize greatness, I am really blind as a bat. I rely on this job to support my family. Please forgive me this once?" The security guard sobbed and snot running, immediately slapping himself several times.
Everyone coldly watched, and no one sympathized. This guy offended Mr. Lin; isn’t he asking for trouble!
Lin Fan said calmly, "Stopping suspicious individuals is a security guard’s duty. You’ve done well in that. But the words you used were disrespectful; you can change that in the future. Even the poor should be respected. Looking down on people is unacceptable."
The security guard quickly said, "Yes, Mr. Lin, your advice is right. I know my mistake now."
Lin Fan said, "Get up and continue your work."
Saying this, Lin Fan walked into the company.
The security guard was overjoyed; Mr. Lin actually didn’t fire him. He kept kowtowing, full of gratitude, "Thank you, Mr. Lin!"
This incident was enough for him to boast for a lifetime; in the future, he would praise Mr. Lin’s magnanimity to everyone he met.
The company’s staff also respected him deeply; Mr. Lin’s broad-mindedness truly left them in awe.
At this moment, everyone also understood why Feng Ruolan had made a move and dismissed Zhao Jiasheng. With the richest man in Yun City, Mr. Lin, involved, it was not surprising at all.
For a moment, the board members surrounded Lin Fan, entered the company, completed the welcoming ceremony, and Lin Fan officially entered Wanjin Group.
Shortly afterward, a figure hurried to Wanjin Company.
Zhao Feng!
Zhao Feng had been called away by Zhao Jiasheng with a phone call last night. On the call, Zhao Jiasheng told Zhao Feng that he was no longer the chairman of Wanjin.
Zhao Feng was greatly alarmed and immediately went home. He wanted to know why.
But Zhao Jiasheng couldn’t give him an answer because Zhao Jiasheng himself didn’t know the reason and decided to go directly to Feng Ruolan the next day.
Zhao Feng was also worried about his position in the company. Zhao Jiasheng told him that his position should be fine and that he could continue to work.
Currently, Zhao Feng was the investment manager at Wanjin Company.
Zhao Feng was relieved after getting this answer, so he continued to go to work today.
Zhao Feng arrived at the company reception but was stopped by the receptionist.
"I’m sorry, Manager Zhao, you cannot enter the company now," the receptionist said.
Zhao Feng was taken aback, "Why?"
The receptionist replied, "You’ve just been dismissed by the company. The HR department will notify you officially soon. You are no longer a company employee and cannot enter the office area."
Zhao Feng was shocked, "What? Who fired me? Who the hell can fire me!"
The receptionist was somewhat sympathetic, "It’s the new chairman."
This situation was quite surprising from the receptionist’s perspective, according to the gossip she gathered.
The new chairman, upon entering the company, casually asked the head of the HR department if Zhao Feng held any position in the company.
When he learned Zhao Feng was the investment manager, the new chairman instructed the HR head to fire Zhao Feng.
The new chairman made this decision in less than a second.
Zhao Feng was puzzled to death, "Who is this new chairman, and why do they want to fire me? I want to meet him!"
The receptionist said, "How about this, Manager Zhao? I’ll call and ask. If the chairman refuses to see you, please leave quietly, okay? As former colleagues, I don’t want to make things too awkward by calling the security guard."
Zhao Feng said, "Okay, go ahead and call."
The receptionist then made a call to the chairman’s office, "Secretary Xu, Manager Zhao Feng would like to see the chairman. Could you please inquire with the chairman?"
A moment later, the receptionist hung up the phone and said, "The chairman said you may see him, Manager Zhao. You can go in."
Zhao Feng hurried in.
This sudden dismissal left him frustrated; he didn’t even know who the new chairman was. Why did the new chairman choose to fire him out of everyone? He needed to find out.
Quickly arriving at the chairman’s office, he found the door open and walked straight in.
Secretary Xu had just stepped out for a moment; there was only one person sitting in the chairman’s seat—shockingly, it was Lin Fan!
"It’s you, what are you doing here?" Zhao Feng exclaimed in shock. This was completely beyond his expectations.
This man had been seen only last night, Wei Qingxue’s courier husband!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re here."
Zhao Feng angrily said, "I ask what you’re doing here, you trash! Do you know this is the chairman’s office? What are you doing sitting in the chairman’s seat? Get lost now!"
The chairman’s position was originally held by his father, Zhao Jiasheng. Although it had changed hands now, not just anyone could sit in the chairman’s seat, especially not someone from the lower class like Lin Fan.
Lin Fan wasn’t angry, he said, "I know, that’s why I’m sitting here."
Zhao Feng scolded, "How did you sneak in here, you trash? Did you actually listen to what I said last night and come here to apply for a cleaning job? Are you wandering into the chairman’s office to steal something?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You have already been dismissed, so this doesn’t seem to concern you, does it?"
Zhao Feng said, "How does it not concern me? If I catch you, the thief, the chairman will surely appreciate it and revoke the dismissal. Wait... how do you know I was dismissed?"
Zhao Feng suddenly sensed something was off. Lin Fan was way too calm, if he were truly a thief, how could he be this composed!
"Chairman Lin, here’s your cup of water."
At this moment, Secretary Xu came in with a cup of hot water, placing it in front of Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took the cup and smiled, "Thank you."
What? Secretary Xu called Lin Fan Chairman Lin?
Could it be...
A thought popped into Zhao Feng’s mind, and he was utterly shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Frustrated Zhao Father and Son: Where Exactly Did They Offend Him?
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 400: Frustrated Zhao Father and Son: Where Exactly Did They Offend Him?
"Secretary Xu, what’s going on?" Zhao Feng asked, drenched in cold sweat.
Lin Fan said calmly, "Secretary Xu, introduce my identity to him."
Secretary Xu nodded and said, "This is our new Chairman of Wanjin, Lin Fan, Chairman Lin."
Zhao Feng’s face turned white: "Lin...Chairman Lin, how is this possible, it’s too absurd, wasn’t he here to apply for a janitor’s position? How could he be the Chairman..."
Secretary Xu frowned and said, "What are you talking about? Please mind your language!"
Zhao Feng was extremely shocked that Lin Fan turned out to be the new Chairman; this was too unexpected, wasn’t he a courier? What on earth was going on?
But, in this way, everything made sense.
No wonder Lin Fan wanted to fire him.
Given what happened last night, if he wasn’t fired, who else would be?
The frightening thing was, Lin Fan could actually replace his father, Zhao Jiasheng, as the new Chairman of Wanjin. How did he achieve that?
"Lin Fan, who exactly are you?" Zhao Feng couldn’t help but ask. If he still believed Lin Fan was a courier at this point, he’d be a fool.
Lin Fan said, "You only need to know that I am Wei Qingxue’s husband. Now you should understand why you were fired. You can leave now. Secretary Xu, see him out."
Lin Fan was Wei Qingxue’s husband. Zhao Feng dared to make a move on Wei Qingxue, and ending up like this was his own doing.
Secretary Xu said, "Mr. Zhao, please come with me."
Zhao Feng became agitated: "I’m not leaving, Longheng Group was founded single-handedly by my father, it belongs to the Zhao Family, you can’t just take it away like this!"
Lin Fan said, "What do you want?"
Zhao Feng said, "Give the Chairman position back to my father!"
Lin Fan replied, "What if I don’t?"
Zhao Feng shouted, "I don’t care what means you used to seize the Chairman position, if you don’t return it, I won’t let you go! I also won’t leave the Company, I have no issues with my work, you have no right to fire me!"
Lin Fan responded with an oh: "You’re threatening me, aren’t you, Secretary Xu, call the security guard."
Secretary Xu immediately complied and called security.
The security guard arrived swiftly.
"Chairman, what are your orders?" the security guard asked. Earlier he had offended Lin Fan, but Lin Fan was forgiving and let him continue working here. The security guard was grateful to Lin Fan. Now the opportunity had come, and he secretly vowed to perform well in front of the Chairman.
Lin Fan said, "This person has been dismissed by me, but he is clinging on and refusing to leave, impacting the Company’s normal operations. Please escort him out."
"Yes, Chairman!"
The security guard responded loudly and immediately charged at Zhao Feng aggressively.
He recognized Zhao Feng, Zhao Feng, Manager Zhao, son of the former Chairman Zhao Jiasheng, the Crown Prince!
This Crown Prince used to be very arrogant, never showing him, the security guard, a good face!
The security guard had long held a grudge against him.
Now the opportunity had arisen, so why would the security guard be polite to him?
Besides, the security guard still wanted to perform well in front of Lin Fan.
"Zhao Feng, obediently get out for me!"
The security guard sneered, reaching out to grab Zhao Feng’s arm and dragged him out.
"Let go of me!" Zhao Feng roared, struggling desperately.
However, he was no match for the burly security guard, who dragged him out like a lifeless dog.
Everyone in the Company was surprised to see this; Zhao Feng must have offended the Chairman, otherwise, the Chairman wouldn’t have fired him at the first opportunity.
No one sympathized with Zhao Feng; in fact, many were even gloating because they had suffered under Zhao Feng for too long. This Crown Prince had often ordered them around.
By firing Zhao Feng, the Chairman had truly boosted everyone’s morale.
Meanwhile.
Longheng Group.
Feng Ruolan was in her office meeting with Zhao Jiasheng.
"President Feng, I don’t know where I might have offended you to cause you to make this decision. Could you please explain, so I know what I need to correct?" Zhao Jiasheng asked cautiously.
Even though he was removed by Feng Ruolan, he didn’t dare to show any anger in front of her.
Feng Ruolan said calmly, "You haven’t offended me, nor have you made me dissatisfied."
Zhao Jiasheng was puzzled: "Then what is President Feng’s intention with this action?"
Feng Ruolan replied, "I have no particular intention; to be honest, I’m not sure what you’ve done wrong either."
Zhao Jiasheng sweated profusely. Feng Ruolan didn’t even know what he’d done wrong yet dismissed him from the Chairman position. Was she toying with him?
"President Feng, what exactly is going on?" Zhao Jiasheng asked.
Feng Ruolan said, "Someone wants to borrow Wanjin Company for a while, so I removed you. Whether you’ve offended him or not, you might know better than I do."
Zhao Jiasheng was shocked; someone wanted to borrow Wanjin Company?
"President Feng, who is this person?" Zhao Jiasheng asked with a trembling voice. Someone who could have President Feng step in was no ordinary person!
Feng Ruolan said, "Lin Fan."
Zhao Jiasheng’s face changed: "Lin...Could it be Mr. Lin, the new richest man in Yun City?"
Feng Ruolan said, "That’s right."
Zhao Jiasheng was about to cry: "I’ve never had any dealings with Mr. Lin, how could I have offended him? I have no idea!"
Feng Ruolan responded, "That’s your issue to figure out. You can ask him yourself. Sorry, I have a meeting to attend soon, please see yourself out."
Feng Ruolan issued an eviction order.
Zhao Jiasheng dared not linger and left Longheng Group. On his way home, he was extremely puzzled. Why did the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin target Wanjin Group?
Upon arriving home, Zhao Jiasheng saw his son Zhao Feng had already returned and was pacing restlessly in the living room.
"Feng’er, why aren’t you at work?" Zhao Jiasheng asked.
Zhao Feng came up to his father and said, "Father, you’re back!"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "You haven’t answered my question."
Zhao Feng replied, "I’ve been fired."
Zhao Jiasheng was shocked: "What? I’ve just been let go; who is so bold to have fired you?"
Zhao Feng said, "The new Chairman."
Zhao Jiasheng blurted out, "Lin Fan!"
Zhao Feng said, "Father, you know it’s him. By the way, have you asked President Feng about who Lin Fan actually is and why he seized Wanjin’s Chairman position?"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "Have you heard of Mr. Lin, the richest man in Yun City?"
Zhao Feng was shocked: "Mr. Lin? I’ve heard of him, but my God, is this Lin Fan really the legendary Mr. Lin?"
Zhao Jiasheng said, "Yes, but I really don’t understand where we offended him for him to take such severe action against us!"
Zhao Feng chuckled bitterly, "Father, I think I know why."
Zhao Jiasheng was curious: "You know? How do you know?"
Zhao Feng said, "Father wanted me to pursue Wei Qingxue and promised to invest one billion in the Wei Family if she remarried me..."
Zhao Jiasheng said, "That’s right, but what’s that got to do with Lin Fan?"
Zhao Feng chuckled bitterly, "Father, this Lin Fan is Wei Qingxue’s husband."
"What?"
Zhao Jiasheng was petrified.

chapters.title: Chapter 401: Someone Outside with 1 Billion Wants to Meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 401: Someone Outside with 1 Billion Wants to Meet
After Lin Fan sent Zhao Feng away, he soon received a call from Feng Ruolan.
"Little Fan, Zhao Jiasheng just came to see me," Feng Ruolan said.
Lin Fan already knew that Zhao Jiasheng couldn’t just do nothing, so he replied, "He should know by now that I took over as the chairman of Wanjin."
Feng Ruolan said, "Yes, I told him your identity and sent him away. Little Fan, when do you plan to tell me the reason?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Not yet, but it should be soon. I will explain everything clearly to you, sister."
Feng Ruolan said, "Alright, you’re still keeping me in suspense. By the way, you asked me to look into the Wei Family’s project situation in Hang City, and I’ve figured it out."
Lin Fan hurriedly replied, "Please tell me, sister."
Feng Ruolan said, "The Yun City Wei Family is in the real estate business. They invested in a plaza project in Hang City with a total investment of around 2 billion. Originally, they had several investors, and the project was progressing relatively smoothly. But all these investors withdrew suddenly, leaving the project unfinished and creating a funding gap of up to 1 billion. If this hole can’t be filled, the project will fail, and the Wei Family will face huge losses, possibly even bankruptcy."
Lin Fan frowned, "I see. Why did the investors suddenly withdraw? Is there something wrong with the project?"
Feng Ruolan said, "There’s nothing wrong with the project; everything was progressing quite smoothly. As for the reason the investors withdrew, it’s still unclear at the moment."
Lin Fan said, "So, as long as this 1 billion funding gap is filled, this project can be brought back to life."
Feng Ruolan said, "Exactly. I also found out that the Yun City Wei Family is currently very anxious about this 1 billion funding issue."
Lin Fan said, "Got it, thank you, sister."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan thought for a moment and then smiled slightly.
The Yun City Wei Family.
At the Wei Family Mansion.
Elder Wei sat on a wicker chair in the courtyard, tending to the flowers and plants. He had been worrying about the company’s affairs recently, and this was his way of relaxing.
Beside him, an old butler was attending.
"Has Qingxue called?" Elder Wei asked.
The old butler replied, "Replying to Elder Wei, the third miss hasn’t made any contact these days."
Elder Wei said, "Alright."
The old butler hesitated to speak.
Elder Wei glanced at him, "Is there something you want to say?"
The old butler chuckled, "Elder Wei, pardon me for being blunt, but are you really planning to rely on the third miss? Even Elder Wei has no solutions; what can the third miss do? What’s more, within a week, time is so tight!"
Elder Wei sighed slightly, "Precisely because I’m out of options that I need to rely on her. She is the key."
The old butler said, "What if the third miss can’t solve it? Are you really willing to drive her out of the Wei Family?"
As they spoke, a servant suddenly hurried in.
"Elder Wei, someone outside came to deliver gifts, saying it’s for your birthday. This is the letter they gave," the servant said, handing over a letter with both hands.
The old butler curiously said, "Elder Wei’s birthday was three days ago, who would come to deliver gifts now, how strange!"
Elder Wei ordered, "Open it."
The servant then tore open the letter, took out a piece of paper, and handed it to Elder Wei.
Elder Wei took the paper and read it.
Suddenly, Elder Wei showed an expression of anger, crumpled the paper into a ball, and threw it on the ground with a heavy humph.
"Outrageous! Send them away, I can’t accept their gift!" Elder Wei said angrily.
"Yes, Elder Wei." The servant was scared and quickly left.
The old butler quietly walked over, picked up the crumpled paper, opened it, and his face immediately showed a complex expression.
"Elder Wei, what are their intentions?" the old butler asked.
Elder Wei snorted, "Need you ask? He wants to interfere with our project, definitely with bad intentions, a false display of kindness. I absolutely won’t let him succeed."
The old butler frowned, "In Hang City, it’s his territory. If he intends to interfere, he might have more tricks up his sleeve. It seems he’s not here with good intentions."
Elder Wei calmed down, nodded, "You’re right, so we need to solve this funding issue as soon as possible, we must not let this villain take advantage!"
Elder Wei thought for a moment and said, "Call Qingxue and tell her to come over immediately. I want to hold a meeting."
The Wei Family urgently organized a family meeting.
Wei Qingxue received the notification and rushed over.
Elder Wei got straight to the point, "I’m calling everyone to this meeting to discuss the funding issue. I mentioned at the birthday banquet that everyone in the family has a responsibility to help the company. Anyone who can bring in 1 billion in investment will be the greatest contributor to the company, and I will not treat them poorly. Three days have passed, has anyone found a solution?"
Everyone looked at each other, not daring to speak.
Because none of them had a solution.
Elder Wei looked a bit disappointed.
Wei Tang chuckled, "Grandpa, even you don’t have a solution, what can we do? Originally, if Wei Qingxue agreed to remarry into the Ma Family, there would be no problem at all. But she refuses, neglecting the interests of the entire family!"
Everyone nodded, shifting the blame to Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue’s face was cold; she was used to these people’s sarcastic remarks and just ignored them.
Elder Wei looked at Wei Qingxue, "Qingxue, it’s been three days. I gave you a week to solve the problem. Do you have any progress you can report to Grandpa?"
Wei Qingxue said calmly, "No."
She had already accepted the outcome of being driven out of the Wei Family.
Elder Wei said, "I heard from your mother that she’s found another potential suitor for you to remarry, and they agreed to invest 1 billion. You won’t marry into the Ma Family, but you won’t consider the Zhao Family either?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I’ve said before, I won’t remarry."
Elder Wei slapped the table, Qingxue was somewhat agitated, "Are you that stubborn? Do you even realize what pressure our Wei Family is facing right now? Without this 1 billion, we could go bankrupt, even face a worse outcome than bankruptcy! Can’t you consider the family just a little?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I’m sorry, Grandpa, but I won’t marry someone I don’t love, whether it’s the Ma Family or the Zhao Family."
Elder Wei said angrily, "Do you believe that I’ll expel you from the Wei Family for good, right now?"
Wei Tang was delighted, quickly fanning the flames, "Wei Qingxue, you’re really too selfish. Someone like you is a traitor to the family and should be expelled!"
"Grandpa, this Wei Qingxue is too heartless. I just hate that I’m not female; if it were me, even if I disliked it, I would agree to marry as long as it solves the family’s difficulties."
Wei Qingxue sneered, "Really? Then go to Thailand, after a trip you’ll be able to marry."
Wei Tang was furious, "Grandpa, listen to what she’s saying!"
Elder Wei was furious, "Enough! Wei Qingxue, since you’re so obstinate, don’t blame me for being ruthless. I declare you permanently expelled from the Wei Family!"
Wei Tang was so happy he nearly laughed out loud.
Everyone else also jeered, with a chorus of schadenfreude.
Wei Qingxue’s face turned pale, and although she had mentally prepared herself, hearing those words still made her body tremble.
Just then.
The servant hurriedly ran in from outside.
"Elder Wei, someone outside is visiting, claiming to bring 1 billion in funding and specifically wants to see Wei Qingxue," the servant said.
What?
Everyone was stunned.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 402: If you want to apologize, just come over yourself.
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 402: If you want to apologize, just come over yourself.
In a fit of rage, Elder Wei announced publicly that Wei Qingxue would be permanently expelled from the Wei Family.
Wei Qingxue, though mentally prepared, couldn’t help but tremble; she was unwilling to accept it.
"Grandpa, you gave me a week, and it’s only been three days," Wei Qingxue voiced her powerless resistance.
Wei Tang mocked, "Wei Qingxue, don’t you see? Do you know what your only value is? It’s to help the family with a wealthy marriage alliance and gain investment from the elite. Besides that, what other options do you think you have?"
"To put it bluntly, Wei Qingxue, you just have to sell yourself!"
"But you, Wei Qingxue, are proud, disregarding family interests, selfish, unwilling to sacrifice yourself!"
"What value do you have left for the family then?"
These words from Wei Tang were like knives, making Wei Qingxue’s heart bleed.
The crowd, however, mocked and ridiculed her ruthlessly.
"Grandpa, is that what you think too?" Wei Qingxue asked, eyes red, looking at Elder Wei.
Elder Wei said calmly, "Little Tang’s words may be harsh, but they’re basically correct. Wei Qingxue, don’t blame me for being heartless; it’s you who were heartless first."
Wei Qingxue fell silent, feeling her heart grow cold at this moment.
Amidst the cold ridicule, Wei Qingxue silently turned and walked out.
After Wei Qingxue left.
Elder Wei said heavily, "Wei Qingxue can no longer be relied upon; our Wei Family must prepare for the worst, everyone must be ready. The good days are numbered."
Upon hearing this, the Wei Family members began to panic.
"Unbelievable! It’s all Wei Qingxue’s fault; why won’t she remarry?"
"All because she won’t divorce that courier; she’s ruining us!"
"She’s so selfish; in front of the family, her personal happiness is worth nothing!"
"She’s just losing a lover, but we’re losing money!"
Everyone began to blame Wei Qingxue.
At this moment, a servant hurriedly came in.
"Elder, someone outside claims to have a billion dollar investment and wants to discuss cooperation with us," the servant said.
The Wei Family members were overjoyed.
Elder Wei quickly asked, "Who is it?"
The servant replied, "The person claims to be Miss Xu, the head of investment at Wanjin Group, and specifically wants to meet Wei Qingxue, saying she’ll only sign a contract with Wei Qingxue."
What?
The Wei Family members were stunned.
Meanwhile, after being expelled from the Wei Family, Wei Qingxue returned to her own home.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were already back; they had received word that Wei Qingxue was permanently expelled from the Wei Family!
Li Xueyan was deeply affected, sitting on the sofa and crying, with Wei Dazong comforting her.
"Our daughter really has a tough life; finally became the company president and hasn’t had a few good days, and now she’s faced with this mess. What should we do now?" Li Xueyan sobbed.
"Mom, I’m fine," Wei Qingxue said calmly.
Seeing their daughter return, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan rushed to her side.
"Qingxue, why did your grandfather suddenly expel you? Didn’t he promise a week? What happened?" Li Xueyan asked.
Wei Qingxue replied, "I don’t know either. Grandpa suddenly called a family meeting, pressured me again to remarry, and when I refused, he expelled me."
Wei Dazong frowned, saying, "I will go plead with father."
Wei Qingxue said, "No need, Dad."
Wei Dazong asked, "Why?"
Wei Qingxue shook her head, "I’m a bit tired; I’ll go back to my room."
This time, Elder Wei probably won’t change his mind. Wei Qingxue’s heart has grown cold.
Lin Fan returned from outside at this time.
"What happened? Mother-in-law, why are you crying?" Lin Fan asked curiously, noting the strange atmosphere.
Li Xueyan rolled her eyes, "What’s the use of telling you, you worthless man. Do you even have the right to know? You’re just a deadbeat courier; can you help us?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "If it concerns my wife, as her husband, I definitely have the right to know."
Li Xueyan sneered, "What good does it do you to know! Unfortunately, my daughter married you, this worthless man!"
Wei Dazong thought Li Xueyan was being a bit much, saying, "Lin Fan, Qingxue was permanently expelled from the Wei Family by the old man today."
Wei Dazong briefly explained what happened.
Lin Fan reacted indifferently, "Is that so."
Li Xueyan taunted, "Still blaming you; if you were sensible enough, you should have divorced Qingxue voluntarily, so she could return to being single and freely choose a good son-in-law, without worrying about gossip. Now that you hold on to her, if she remarries, she’ll be ridiculed!"
Lin Fan was speechless, thinking how this woman could pin the blame on him.
"I dearly love my wife; why should we divorce? Why should she sacrifice her happiness?" Lin Fan chuckled.
Li Xueyan scoffed, "With you, a deadbeat courier, what happiness can she have? Can you bring her back to the Wei Family?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Returning to the Wei Family is easy; I believe soon Elder Wei will personally come to ask her back."
The three family members looked at Lin Fan, puzzled by his words.
Li Xueyan sneered at this, "You really believe that, just talking nonsense!"
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue’s phone rang.
Wei Qingxue checked it, surprised, saying, "It’s Grandpa calling."
Lin Fan smiled, "See, here it comes, dear wife. Let me answer it for you."
As he spoke, Lin Fan had already taken the phone from Wei Qingxue, answered it, and put it on speaker.
"Qingxue, it’s Grandpa. I want to apologize; I lost my head in anger today. Grandpa could never bear to drive you out of the Wei Family. Could you come over now?"
On the other end, Elder Wei’s voice came through, surprisingly conciliatory.
What?
The three family members looked at each other in disbelief.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Elder Wei, I’m Lin Fan. Qingxue doesn’t want to hear your call right now. If you want to apologize, come over yourself."
With that, Lin Fan decisively hung up the phone, not allowing Elder Wei to respond.
The three family members were dumbfounded.
Lin Fan actually asked Elder Wei to come over and apologize?
Realizing what had happened, Li Xueyan was shocked and angry, "Lin Fan, do you know what you’re doing? You dare ask Elder Wei to come and apologize; you want to ruin our family?"
Elder Wei is very influential; in the Yun City Wei Family, he’s regarded like a Supreme Emperor. Everyone always serves him cautiously!
Lin Fan’s words were simply insubordination, disloyalty!
Elder Wei won’t be able to accept it, right!
He will certainly be infuriated, and it won’t just be trouble for Wei Qingxue; the whole family will be in trouble.
Li Xueyan sat down dejectedly, crying again, "It’s over, our family is completely finished this time. Originally Elder Wei would forgive Qingxue; now there’s no hope!"
Lin Fan laughed, "Mother-in-law, don’t worry; we’ll soon find out if Elder Wei comes over or not."
Li Xueyan pointed at Lin Fan angrily, "You still have the guts to talk; it’s all because of you! You’re here to ruin us! Qingxue, why do you keep him around? I say, divorce him now!"
Wei Qingxue said nothing, just watched Lin Fan, feeling a bit curious.
At this moment, Wei Dazong’s phone suddenly rang.
Wei Dazong answered it, then quickly hung up, muttering, "Just got word, father is on his way over."
What?
Li Xueyan lifted her eyes, utterly astonished.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 Elder Wei: If Necessary, I Can Kneel
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 403 Elder Wei: If Necessary, I Can Kneel
A luxurious black car was parked downstairs in the neighborhood.
With the help of the old butler, Elder Wei trembled as he got out of the car, looking up at the building in front of him.
"This must be the place. The last time I came here was the year Dazong got married. It’s been so many years in the blink of an eye."
"I didn’t expect that the second time I’d come would be to plead with my granddaughter."
Elder Wei said, his tone filled with a bit of desolation.
The old butler said, "Elder, with your status, how can you come to plead with a junior? No matter what, the Third Miss is your junior. She should come to see you."
Elder Wei waved his hand, "Right now, rescuing the Company is urgent, none of that matters. Besides, I truly hurt the child’s feelings today. My visit to apologize shows my sincerity. No matter what, I must bring her back this time."
Saying this, the two had already entered the building and arrived at the elevator, ready to take it upstairs.
Wei Qingxue’s house is on the sixth floor.
The old butler pressed the elevator button but found it unresponsive. He pressed again several times, but still, the elevator didn’t react.
The security guard from the property walked over and said, "Sorry, the elevator is broken. It’ll be repaired tomorrow. You can use the stairs."
What?
Elder Wei, with his old bones, how could he climb up to the sixth floor? It would be the death of him!
The old butler said, "Elder, let me call the Third Miss and ask her to come down."
Elder Wei thought for a moment and shook his head, "No, I must climb up myself. This will show my sincerity. Qingxue is a kind-hearted child. Doing this will surely move her."
Elder Wei finally decided to climb up to the sixth floor.
In neighborhoods like this, the property usually relies on elevators, and stairs are designed only for emergency use, making them small and particularly steep.
With the support of the old butler, Elder Wei climbed to the sixth floor. Both of them were exhausted and out of breath, nearly costing Elder Wei half his life.
Elder Wei had lived a life of luxury and ease since young, never having suffered like this. Unexpectedly, at his age, he had to endure such hardship.
But, thinking this was his own fault, he was helpless. Who told him to chase Wei Qingxue away? If he hadn’t, he wouldn’t have needed to make such an effort.
Arriving in front of Wei Qingxue’s house.
The old butler knocked on the door.
Li Xueyan opened the door and, upon seeing Elder Wei, instinctively showed a look of reverence.
"Sir, you’ve come. Please come in." Li Xueyan said with a smile.
The old butler supported Elder Wei to the living room to sit down. Both of them walked as if they were floating. There was no other way; climbing the stairs had worn them out.
Luckily, Wei Qingxue lived on the 6th floor, which wasn’t too high. If she lived on the 20th floor, they might have directly died of exhaustion.
Wei Dazong noticed something was wrong; his father’s head was covered in sweat, his face pale!
"Father, are you feeling unwell? Why is your complexion so white?" Wei Dazong asked with concern.
Elder Wei said, "I’m fine."
The old butler sighed, saying, "How can he be fine? The elevator here was just broken, and the elder climbed up himself."
"What?"
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were astonished.
"Sir, why didn’t you call us to go down?" Li Xueyan stuttered. Elder Wei climbed up personally to see them; this was too unbelievable.
It was as strange as the sun rising from the west.
Wei Dazong hastily poured Elder Wei a cup of water, saying, "Ah-Yan is right, father. Why didn’t you ask us to come down? If anything happened to you, we couldn’t bear the responsibility!"
Elder Wei said, "I wanted to see Qingxue and couldn’t think about anything else. By the way, why isn’t Qingxue here?"
Wei Dazong said, "The child came back today feeling upset. After hearing you were coming, she went out."
Elder Wei and the old butler nearly collapsed.
Damn!
They climbed six floors laboriously just to see Wei Qingxue, to move her, and yet Wei Qingxue went out!
This isn’t fair!
Elder Wei smiled wryly and said, "It’s all my fault. I’m the one who upset her. I shouldn’t have impulsively chased her away. I’m sincerely here to apologize, hoping she can forgive me and return to the Wei Family. She is part of the Wei Family and will never change."
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan exchanged looks, not knowing what the old man was up to. He chased Qingxue away, and now he’s here lowering his posture, wanting Qingxue to come back; it’s also him.
"Father, what happened? You chased Qingxue away before, and now..." Wei Dazong carefully inquired.
Elder Wei looked embarrassed and said to the old butler, "You explain it to them."
The old butler said, "It’s like this: today, after the Third Miss left, someone came to discuss cooperation, willing to invest a billion in the Wei Family. But the other party has only one condition: to sign with the Third Miss."
The couple exchanged glances, surprised.
Someone specifically asked to sign with Wei Qingxue; who could that be?
Then they realized, Elder Wei is relying on Wei Qingxue, huh!
No wonder, given Elder Wei’s usual Supreme Emperor pose, how could he lower his head to a junior? Even risking his life, climbing six floors, was actually asking for help.
Thinking of this, Li Xueyan couldn’t help but feel a bit smug.
Who would’ve thought, Elder Wei would also have a day he needs them!
Wei Dazong curiously asked, "Father, what’s the background of the investor, why did they specify Qingxue?"
Elder Wei said, "The investor is Wanjin Group. Today, their head of the investment department personally came."
Li Xueyan was surprised, "Wanjin Group? Head of the investment department, is it Zhao Feng? How is it possible?"
Wei Dazong said, "What are you talking about?"
Li Xueyan said, "It’s like this, I introduced Qingxue to the Zhao Family that day, President Zhao of Wanjin promised me that as long as Qingxue remarried Zhao Feng, Wanjin would invest a billion in us. But today, I just learned this investment cannot continue because President Zhao is no longer Wanjin’s chairman. Now Wanjin is coming to invest, what’s going on?"
Elder Wei said, "I don’t know the Zhao Feng you mentioned. The head of the investment department who came today is a woman, Miss Xu."
Li Xueyan was even more surprised, "Even Young Master Zhao has been replaced!"
Elder Wei said, "I’ve also learned about Wanjin’s personnel changes; they changed the chairman but the shareholder structure hasn’t changed. Also, the contract Wanjin offered had no issues, and aside from the investment return, didn’t make excessive demands."
Li Xueyan said, "Did they request Qingxue to remarry?"
Elder Wei said, "No, Wanjin is no longer dominated by Zhao Jiasheng, they don’t have such a request. According to Miss Xu, Wanjin is optimistic about our project, so they restarted the investment plan Zhao had stopped."
Li Xueyan said, "Then why did Wanjin demand only to sign with Qingxue?"
Elder Wei said, "That, I don’t know. So I need Qingxue to come forward and talk to Wanjin. The time left for our Wei Family is short, this might be our only chance. I hope Qingxue can forgive me and help the Wei Family through this difficulty. If necessary, I can kneel to her."
The couple was startled.
Wei Dazong promptly said, "Father, you’ve spoken too heavily."
Nearby, Lin Fan leisurely sipped tea, quietly watching them talk. He had arranged all this, yet now he seemed like a spectator enjoying the show.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: I have a way to definitely make you stand up
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: Chapter 404: I have a way to definitely make you stand up
The next day.
Wei Family.
A piece of news spread around, sparking discussions among the Wei Family members.
"Have you heard? Yesterday Elder Wei went to Wei Qingxue’s home. They say he went to beg her to return to the Wei Family!"
"Oh my God, Elder Wei personally went to beg her? Did I hear that right?"
"It can’t be! Elder Wei just kicked her out, and now he wants her back, and is personally inviting her. Wei Qingxue must have a lot of influence!"
"What else could he do? Wanjin only agreed to discuss cooperation with Wei Qingxue. Elder Wei had to swallow his pride."
"That means Wei Qingxue is coming back to be the company president again!"
"Indeed, I never expected this. I thought she was already down and out, but now she’s bouncing back with an even higher status in the Wei Family than before."
"Then the eldest son’s dream of becoming president is doomed to fall through again..."
The Wei Family members continued to argue among themselves.
Wei Tang, upon hearing the discussions, was furious.
"Wei Qingxue!" Wei Tang gritted his teeth, "How outrageous! The presidency is mine. I am the eldest son and rightful heir of the Wei Family. I am the company’s true successor!"
"What right do you have to compete with me, Wei Qingxue! No matter what, the presidency is mine this time. You won’t snatch it away again!"
Wei Tang’s expression gradually turned vicious.
Wanjin Company.
"Miss Wei, I hope we have a pleasant cooperation." Secretary Xu said with a smile, shaking hands with Wei Qingxue.
Secretary Xu was originally the chairman’s secretary. After Zhao Feng was fired, Lin Fan appointed her as the new head of the investment department, responsible for negotiating investment matters with the Wei Family.
Wei Qingxue shook hands with Secretary Xu and said, "By the way, can I see your chairman? I heard that it was the chairman who decided to restart investment in the Wei Family, and I’d like to thank him in person."
After Elder Wei personally came to apologize, Wei Qingxue eventually chose to forgive him. She was also reluctant to admit defeat so easily.
As agreed, she was here today to negotiate cooperation with Wanjin, and had brought Lin Fan with her.
Secretary Xu glanced at Lin Fan beside Wei Qingxue, looking a bit awkward but then quickly regaining composure.
"The chairman is on a business trip. There will be opportunities to meet him in the future." Secretary Xu said.
Secretary Xu couldn’t figure out why the chairman wanted to hide his identity and instructed everyone at the company to pretend not to know him today. How strange.
However, Secretary Xu dared not ask further questions regarding the chairman’s intentions; she simply obeyed.
Wei Qingxue felt disappointed for not meeting the chairman and said, "Alright, please be sure to convey my thanks to the chairman once he returns. I will personally visit to thank him then."
Secretary Xu replied, "Okay, I will inform the chairman."
Wei Qingxue asked, "By the way, I have always wanted to ask why you chose to negotiate with me?"
Secretary Xu smiled and said, "That’s the chairman’s decision. He believes you’re the only trustworthy person in the entire Wei Family. He doesn’t trust anyone else from the Wei Family."
Wei Qingxue was pleasantly surprised: "Truly, I thank him."
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Your chairman really has a good eye."
Secretary Xu stole a glance at Lin Fan, feeling amused, thinking about how the chairman insists on negotiating with Wei Qingxue because she’s actually his wife.
Afterward, Wei Qingxue bid farewell and left with Lin Fan.
Upon exiting Wanjin Company, Wei Qingxue’s face showed a smile, feeling unprecedentedly relieved.
"Finally secured the funds. Our project in Hang City is revived, and the Wei Family is saved. It’s really great!" Wei Qingxue exclaimed happily.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’ve made great contributions this time. It seems that Elder Wei shouldn’t force you to marry anymore; you can marry someone you actually want to."
Wei Qingxue said, "Yes, Lin Fan, thank you for everything during this period. Including today, for escorting me here. Once everything settles down, let’s find a time to finalize the divorce. I’ll pay you as agreed."
Lin Fan readily agreed, "Sure."
They got into Wei Qingxue’s Porsche and headed to the Wei Family Mansion to wrap everything up after signing the agreement with Wanjin; Wei Qingxue needed to report to Elder Wei.
The car reached a quiet spot.
Suddenly, a person darted out from the roadside ahead, crossing the street.
Wei Qingxue was startled and quickly slammed on the brakes.
The car barely stopped in front of the person, but they had already fallen to the ground, letting out a miserable howl.
Wei Qingxue’s face turned pale: "Oh no, did I just hit someone?"
She quickly unfastened her seatbelt, opened the car door, and got out to see the situation.
Lin Fan followed her out of the car.
"Ah, I’m in such pain. How do you drive!" The uncle on the ground held his knee with both hands, looking pained.
"I’m really sorry. I didn’t mean to. You suddenly ran out; I braked immediately." Wei Qingxue said.
The uncle said, "I don’t care. My leg is broken! You have to pay for my medical expenses."
Wei Qingxue was a kind-hearted person. Regardless, she had indeed knocked the uncle over and could not leave him to suffer.
"How much do you want? How about I take you to the hospital, and I’ll cover your medical expenses?" Wei Qingxue offered.
The uncle said, "I don’t need you pretending to be kind. Just pay me the money. My leg is severely injured; medical expenses are at least a hundred thousand. Just give me a hundred thousand. This is a QR code; you can transfer the money to me."
The uncle pulled out a QR code from his pocket and tossed it in front of Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue was stunned, feeling that something was amiss. The uncle seemed skillful, even carrying a QR code with him?
Lin Fan laughed at this moment and said, "Uncle, how’s your injury? Why don’t I take a look? I’m a doctor."
The uncle hurriedly said, "Don’t come closer. I don’t believe you’re a doctor. What if you cripple me? Just hurry up and pay; that’s enough!"
Lin Fan said, "Without confirming your injury, how can we pay? If your leg’s indeed crippled, paying too little would be unfair to you, right?"
The uncle said, "I know my own injury. You just have to pay the hundred thousand!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "No, that’s not right. We’re very fair people and don’t want you to suffer loss. Come on, let’s have a look at your injury."
Speaking, Lin Fan already walked over and, without explanation, patted the uncle on the shoulder, sending a surge of force.
The uncle shivered all over, and his hands limply released.
Lin Fan squatted down, looked at his leg, and said, "Your leg is perfectly fine—no contact with the car. How could you be injured?"
The uncle said, "I don’t care. Anyway, my leg hurts and I can’t walk. You definitely hit me, so pay up immediately. Stop dawdling!"
Lin Fan said, "Got it. Your leg hurts, right? I know a method that’ll surely let you stand up. Have you heard about fire therapy?"
Lin Fan took out a lighter, ignited it, and approached the uncle’s foot.
"Ah!"
The moment the flame touched the uncle’s skin, he screamed in pain, reflexively bouncing up.
"Are you crazy, burning me? Are you trying to kill me?" The uncle cursed angrily.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "You see, I said fire therapy is effective."
The uncle suddenly realized he’d fallen victim to Lin Fan’s trick. Now standing up, it was clear his leg was fine!
Wei Qingxue now fully understood, and angrily said, "So you’re faking it? You are running a scam!"

chapters.title: Chapter 405: The Most Annoying People Who Pretend to Show Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: Chapter 405: The Most Annoying People Who Pretend to Show Off
The scam artists are so despicable; they do this just to extort money. Some car owners are quite naive and easily fooled out of their money by these scammers. Then, there are those who, in order to keep the peace, will pay up even if they know it’s a scam. If they encounter someone tough, the scammers can still escape.
This kind of business, with zero cost and successful cases, leads to an endless stream of scammers.
Wei Qingxue never expected that she would encounter a scam artist herself.
Luckily, Lin Fan was by her side to help her see through it; otherwise, she might have been deceived, as it was her first time encountering such a scam.
The scam artist, being seen through, was furious and shamelessly said, "I don’t care, you hit me; I say you hit me, and that’s final. Pay up quickly! You won’t pass here unless you drive over me."
After saying this, he lay flat on the ground.
Lin Fan said, "Is that so? Then you can enjoy lying there. We don’t have to take this road."
The scam artist quickly got up, lunged towards Wei Qingxue’s Porsche, and hugged the front of the car.
"I want to see how you go!" the scam artist said arrogantly.
Wei Qingxue was speechless; this person was too shameless. These scammers were really too hateful.
"All right, I’ll call the police!" Wei Qingxue took out her phone.
She was about to call the police.
Suddenly, a car came out and blocked the road ahead, cutting off their way.
The car doors opened, and two burly men got out, heading straight for the Porsche.
Wei Qingxue was startled, a bit baffled by what was happening.
Lin Fan frowned, "Honey, it seems this isn’t a simple scam."
They meant no good!
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, let’s go quickly."
She wanted to return to the car and drive away immediately.
However, at this moment, another car came from behind, blocking the way, trapping them. Likewise, two burly men got out of the car.
Wei Qingxue was anxious, "What should we do? Could they be robbers?"
Lin Fan reassured, "Don’t worry, I’ll have a word with them."
Wei Qingxue knew that Lin Fan could fight. Last time at the civil affairs bureau, Lin Fan had knocked down a big divorcee with one kick.
But this time, the other side had several people, and each of them seemed stronger than that divorcee. Wei Qingxue was worried Lin Fan couldn’t handle it.
"Lin Fan, let’s get back in the car and call the police," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan said, "There’s no time, don’t panic."
He reached out and held Wei Qingxue’s hand. A warmth spread from his palm to Wei Qingxue’s body.
Wei Qingxue felt warmth flowing through her, calming her panicked heart and filling her with a sense of security, relieving her fear immediately.
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan in surprise. This man seemed to have some magical ability.
With him by her side, she felt at ease.
"Are you Wei Qingxue? Our boss invites you. Don’t resist; obediently come with us!"
The four burly men surrounding them, led by a man in sunglasses, said gruffly.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Who is your boss? Do I know him?"
The burly man in sunglasses said, "You’ll find out when you get there. Less talking, come with us obediently!"
Their tone was one of no refusal, filled with confidence. Wei Qingxue had no way to refuse.
Lin Fan chuckled, "You want her to see your boss, right? Can I accompany her?"
The burly man in sunglasses didn’t even regard Lin Fan, "No, our boss wants to see only Miss Wei. Also, you’d better not call the police, because it won’t help and might even bring trouble. If we know you called the police, you’d better prepare for your family’s funeral."
Lin Fan exclaimed, "Oh, I’m so scared."
The burly man in sunglasses said, "If you don’t want to die, get lost. Miss Wei, you can come with us now."
Lin Fan said, "Sorry, without me, she won’t go with you. If there’s nothing else, please move your cars. We’re leaving."
The burly man in sunglasses’s face darkened, "Kid, you’re pretty cocky. I don’t know where your confidence comes from, but you should know your limits. Miss Wei, you don’t think he can protect you, do you? I’ll give you one more chance, come with us obediently, or we’ll invite you the hard way, and the latter won’t be easy for you."
Of course, Wei Qingxue didn’t want to go with them, but if she didn’t, they would act. Could Lin Fan handle four burly men?
Lin Fan said, "Honey, let’s go. You get back in the car first, I’ll be right behind."
Wei Qingxue nodded and turned to get back to the car.
The burly man in sunglasses got angry, "Grab her!"
Two burly men rushed forward, trying to grab Wei Qingxue.
They were so confident, never even considering the possibility of failure; they didn’t take Lin Fan seriously at all.
However, in the next second.
The two burly men suddenly clutched their stomachs, kneeling on the ground, their bodies bent like shrimp, faces flushed, sweating in pain, their expressions twisted!
Lin Fan kicked each of them!
He was too fast.
So fast that these two burly men had no time to react before being kicked to the ground.
Another burly man saw this and immediately rushed at Lin Fan, throwing a punch. The wind howled with the punch, so powerful it seemed it could smash rocks. If Lin Fan took this punch, he might lose half his life.
"Ah!"
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but scream, "Be careful!"
However, this punch didn’t even touch a hair on Lin Fan. Lin Fan’s third kick had already struck the burly man’s abdomen.
"Ah!"
The burly man screamed, his eyes bulging, and fell to his knees, clutching his stomach, sharing the same plight as his two companions.
The burly man in sunglasses’s face changed, and he sneered, "Kid, you’re pretty skilled, no wonder you dared to challenge us. But it’s useless; soon, I’ll make you regret it."
As he spoke, the burly man in sunglasses cracked his fingers, the joints making a popping sound, then moved his neck, producing more popping sounds.
The burly man approached Lin Fan, raised his fist, and swung at Lin Fan.
He was so confident, even though Lin Fan had already kicked down his three companions, he still believed he could easily defeat Lin Fan.
But his punch stopped midway, as Lin Fan didn’t use his foot this time but instead caught the man’s fist in his hand.
The burly man in sunglasses’s face changed again; he never expected Lin Fan to catch his punch!
He immediately tried to pull his fist out of Lin Fan’s grasp, but to his shock, he found he couldn’t move it at all!
"I hate show-offs the most."
Lin Fan said and then slapped him directly, knocking the burly man to the ground, his sunglasses flying and breaking.
Wei Qingxue was stunned.
The scam artist was also stunned, suddenly feeling a chill all over.
The burly man, dazed from the slap, was shocked beyond belief and was struggling to get up.
Lin Fan had already stepped forward, lifted his foot, and stomped on the man’s head, forcing his face back to the ground.
"Now tell me, who is your boss?" Lin Fan said coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Is Wei Qingxue Worth 100,000
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 406: Is Wei Qingxue Worth 100,000
Lin Fan was too fierce, four burly men, all taken down by him in seconds, including that seemingly tough guy in sunglasses, whom Lin Fan slapped to the ground, his foot stepping on the man’s head.
If Lin Fan exerted a little more force, no one would doubt that this burly man’s head might burst like a rotten tomato.
The burly man, who was confident just a minute ago, was almost scared to wet his pants. He finally realized that he had run into an expert, and not just any expert.
"Now tell me, who is your boss?" Lin Fan asked coldly, "I will only ask once, as idiots won’t answer me. I can assure you, a little more pressure from my foot will ruin your brain, and you’ll be a vegetable for the rest of your life."
The man in sunglasses didn’t want to become a fool. Death seemed preferable, but he didn’t want to die either.
"Wait, I’ll talk. We’re just workers, no need to get hurt. Our boss is named Chen the Third."
The man in sunglasses quickly said, lacking even the courage to resist. What a joke! Lin Fan’s foot felt as heavy as a mountain on his forehead. A little force, and his brain would surely be done for.
"Chen the Third?"
Lin Fan turned to Wei Qingxue, "Do you know this person? Does he have a grudge against you?"
Wei Qingxue shook her head, "I don’t know him."
Lin Fan said, "Judging by your looks, it seems you’re from the underground. Could someone have hired you to go after her? Who is it?"
The man in sunglasses said, "We are indeed from the underground, but as for who hired us, I don’t know. I’m just following orders. You need to ask our boss."
Lin Fan said, "Perfect, I was just thinking about meeting this Chen the Third."
```
