The man in sunglasses said, "Buddy, don’t say I didn’t warn you, you might not understand the underground. Our boss, Chen the Third, is not someone to mess with. Meeting him won’t do you any good; it’s like walking into death. How about this, you let us go back, and I’ll put in a good word for you. Our boss might let you off."
Lin Fan chuckled, "So I should thank you?"
The man in sunglasses said, "I mean well."
Lin Fan said, "Hearing you say that makes me even more interested. Get up, you four will ride with me in a car to meet your boss."
With that, Lin Fan lifted his foot.
The man with sunglasses scrambled to his feet, agreeing meekly, with a sinister smile in his heart. If this guy wanted to die, then so be it.
Wei Qingxue asked worriedly, "Lin Fan, are we really going to see this Chen the Third?"
Lin Fan said, "I’ll go on my own. You go back to see Old Master. Don’t worry, I’ll be back soon."
Wei Qingxue said, "Alright, be careful."
Wei Qingxue planned to return to the car, and when the two looked, the con artist uncle was still lying on the car hood.
The con artist uncle had been stunned by Lin Fan earlier and only now snapped back to reality, trembling with fear, quickly moving away from the hood.
"Uncle, not doing your scam anymore?" Lin Fan smiled.
The uncle shook his head quickly, "I dare not."
Lin Fan said, "How much did they pay you to fake an accident for us?"
The uncle was shocked, "No, I didn’t take their money."
Lin Fan’s face darkened, "Still lying? How coincidental is it that you were here to scam us? Your task was to block our vehicle and trick her into getting out! If I hadn’t been with her, she would’ve been captured by them now. You’re their accomplice!"
The uncle’s face went pale with fear, collapsing to his knees, crying, "They only paid me to set up here, I didn’t know they wanted to kidnap her, I really didn’t know, please, spare me!"
Lin Fan said, "Show me your ID card."
The uncle exclaimed in shock, "W-why?"
Lin Fan coldly said, "Give it here!"
The uncle could only reluctantly take out his ID card and hand it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took a photo of the ID with his phone and said, "Your actions just now are all recorded on the dashcam. You took money to assist criminals, intercepting a girl. Soon, you’ll receive a lawyer’s letter from Xingquan Law Firm. Go back and clean up, get ready for jail. Without a decade or so, you won’t be out."
The uncle was scared out of his mind, frantically kowtowing, crying, "Spare me, it was a misunderstanding!"
Lin Fan said, "Misunderstanding? You can explain in court. Scum like you, living off scams, should reflect in jail. Scram."
Lin Fan grabbed the uncle by the collar, lifting him like a chick, and tossed him to the roadside.
The uncle fell hard on his backside, unable to get up for a moment, overwhelmed with terror and regret. If he’d known this, he’d never have scammed Wei Qingxue. Now he’s facing prison food...
Then, Lin Fan and the four burly men got into the van that was blocking the way. The man in sunglasses drove, clearing a path, and only after Wei Qingxue left did they drive away.
Victory Farmhouse.
A restaurant located in the suburbs, today there wasn’t a single customer, even the chef and waiters were given the day off.
But in the hall, a group had gathered.
A strapping man sat at a dining table, wearing a gold watch on his wrist, a thick gold chain around his neck, and a cigar in his mouth, chatting on the phone.
"Young Master Wei, don’t worry, I’ve already sent someone to invite her. She definitely won’t be going back!" the man said confidently.
On the other end of the line, came Wei Tang’s voice, "That’s good, thank you, Third Brother. Treat her well for me!"
Wei Tang laughed sinisterly.
This man with the gold chain was Chen the Third!
This time, it was Wei Tang who had found Chen the Third to kidnap Wei Qingxue!
Chen the Third said, "How should I entertain her, Young Master Wei?"
Wei Tang said, "This little bitch already signed with Wanjin. Once she returns, she’ll become a hero in the Wei Family, and will inevitably regain the position of president. Third Brother, help me force her to resign!"
Chen the Third cursed, "Damn it, that’s so troublesome. In that case, 100,000 won’t do. Add another 100,000!"
Wei Tang cursed in his heart, this Chen the Third was truly insatiable. He had promised to settle it all for 100,000, to deal with Wei Qingxue, and now he was hiking up the price!
He didn’t want to give him more money.
With a turn of his eyes, a malicious thought arose in Wei Tang’s mind. Wei Qingxue, you blocked my path. If you want to die, don’t blame me.
"Instead of adding money, I have a better idea. Third Brother, do you think Wei Qingxue is worth 100,000?"
Chen the Third paused, then laughed heartily, "Young Master Wei, you’re one hell of a bastard. Isn’t Wei Qingxue your sister? You’ve come up with this kind of idea, I commend you!"
Wei Tang shamelessly said, "What sister, she’s against me, she’s my enemy. I’m wishing for her death. I don’t know if Third Brother is interested?"
Chen the Third said, "Forget it, Young Master Wei, I have no interest in married women!"
Wei Tang lewdly laughed, "Third Brother, you might not know, though Wei Qingxue is married, she hasn’t been married long. She married a loser who delivers parcels, I even suspect she’s still a virgin. If Third Brother doesn’t believe it, you might as well check for yourself."

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Don’t say we didn’t warn you
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 407: Don’t say we didn’t warn you
"What?" Chen the Third laughed heartily, "Is there really such a thing? You’ve piqued my interest, old man. I’m itching to verify it!"
Wei Tang chuckled, "So, third brother, this hundred thousand..."
Chen the Third said, "If she can satisfy me, the hundred thousand will be waived."
Wei Tang was delighted, "Rest assured, third brother. Although I can’t stand Wei Qingxue, objectively speaking, she’s indeed quite pretty. If it weren’t for our blood relationship, I’d have made a move myself."
Chen the Third said, "You’re truly not human, but I’ve also heard from my buddies that Wei Qingxue is indeed a stunner. But if you do this, will there be no issues from the Wei Family’s side?"
Wei Tang replied, "You can absolutely rest assured about that. My grandpa doesn’t like Wei Qingxue either. He even wishes she’d get lost so I, his legitimate grandson, can take the position."
Chen the Third let out a knowing sound with a lewd smile, "Alright, I know what to do. Young Master Wei, wait for my good news, I’ll hang up now."
Chen the Third hung up the call, spat, and laughed loudly, "These Rich Second Generations are so troublesome, full of wicked schemes. Their brains must be twisted, but it’s a windfall for me, hahaha..."
At this moment.
A thug walked in and said, "Boss, Old Li and the others are back."
Chen the Third was overjoyed, his eyes revealing sleaziness. He rubbed his hands together, "Soon, I’ll get to meet the Wei Family’s miss. I can hardly wait!"
Then, a Burly Man wearing sunglasses and three other burly men walked in. All four looked battered, like defeated roosters.
The Sunglasses Burly Man was the worst, with one side of his face swollen and his signature sunglasses missing.
Noticing something was off, Chen the Third’s smile froze, "What’s going on, what happened?"
"Sorry, I hit them a bit too hard."
A voice came from outside the door, and Lin Fan stepped in.
Chen the Third was taken aback, "Who the hell are you?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m Lin Fan, Wei Qingxue’s husband. Are you Chen the Third?"
Chen the Third’s face darkened with shock and anger, "You’re that delivery guy! Did you injure my men?"
Lin Fan made a sound of realization. This Chen the Third actually knew he was a delivery guy; it seemed he’d heard it from the employer, a familiar face no less.
Lin Fan said, "I had no choice, they tried to ambush and kidnap my wife, so I had to beat them up. Then, I found out about you, so I decided to pay a visit."
Chen the Third sneered, "You’ve got some nerve. Being able to take down Old Li does show you have some skill, but coming here was overconfident, a fool’s errand!"
The surrounding thugs all stared at Lin Fan with hostility.
With just one word from Chen the Third, they’d rush to give Lin Fan a beatdown.
Lin Fan said calmly, "I didn’t come to seek death. I came for answers. I want to know who hired you to go after my wife."
Chen the Third laughed, "Kid, do you really think I’d tell you? In our underground world, we have our principles; keeping client confidentiality is our duty."
Lin Fan glanced around, "This farmhouse is nicely decorated; is it yours?"
Chen the Third asked, "Why do you ask?"
Lin Fan said, "Just curious. If it belongs to someone else, I’ll be careful not to damage the furniture when we fight. If it’s yours, then I won’t hold back."
Chen the Third gritted his teeth, "Cocky brat, what makes you think you can beat us?"
Lin Fan said, "Just based on you bunch of trash. Even if you all come at me at once, I’ll have you spitting out your teeth. Of course, you still have time to surrender. If I have to make a move, your loss will be considerable. Don’t say I didn’t warn you!"
The gangsters were infuriated, grinding their teeth. This delivery guy had such an arrogant tone, completely underestimating them. They were itching to beat Lin Fan up.
Chen the Third was also angry; Lin Fan didn’t acknowledge him at all. Who didn’t know him as ruthless in the underground? Even in their circle, few dared to cross him.
And now, a mere delivery guy dared to look down on him. If word got out, wouldn’t his years of infamy be for nothing?
"This cocky brat is clueless. Seems I have no choice but to show him his place. Go, capture him for me!"
With Chen the Third’s order, the gangsters, who were already eager, swarmed towards Lin Fan...
At the Wei Family Mansion in Yun City.
Elder Wei was seated at the head of the living room, with important family members present, waiting for Wei Qingxue to return.
Today, Wei Qingxue was representing the Wei Family to negotiate an investment with Wanjin. If successful, it would save the Wei Family, a critical matter for the family’s survival, which had everyone’s attention.
Especially Elder Wei, who’d been waiting since morning.
Wei Qingxue, however, hadn’t returned yet.
"Could there have been an accident with Wanjin?"
"Could it be that the negotiation failed, and Wei Qingxue didn’t dare to return?"
"No way, Wanjin specifically wanted Wei Qingxue to negotiate; how could it have failed?"
The crowd started discussing, speculating various scenarios.
Meanwhile, Wei Tang was secretly laughing. They didn’t know where Wei Qingxue was, but he did.
Wei Qingxue was probably already with Chen the Third.
According to his plan, Chen the Third would coerce Wei Qingxue. Soon, she would call Elder Wei to resign, and then someone would bring the signed investment contract over.
This way, the Wei Family could secure the investment from Wanjin and get rid of Wei Qingxue, a perfect two-birds-one-stone strategy!
The best part was, after everything, Wei Qingxue would be ruined by Chen the Third.
Thinking about it gave Wei Tang immense satisfaction, almost making him laugh out loud.
He simply couldn’t stand Wei Qingxue and wished for her demise.
"Grandpa, I think Wei Qingxue probably won’t come back," Wei Tang said.
Elder Wei frowned, "Why do you say that?"
Wei Tang replied, "Wei Qingxue was originally responsible for the Hang City project. Her signing with Wanjin would at most make up for her mistakes. If it were me, I wouldn’t have the face to return."
Elder Wei seemed thoughtful, "Little Tang makes some valid points."
Wei Tang smiled, "Grandpa, if things are as I say, the company president position needs to find a suitable replacement quickly."
Wei Zihan chimed in, "Little Tang is right. The president’s position can’t be left vacant. I think Little Tang is quite suitable for it. What does everyone think?"
Wei Tang was secretly delighted. With Wei Qingxue gone, who else but him could take the president’s position?
"Grandpa, I’m back."
Just then, a voice said, and Wei Qingxue walked in from outside.
Wei Tang was just feeling pleased, almost spitting out old blood in shock.
Damn!
Wasn’t Wei Qingxue supposed to be kidnapped by Chen the Third? How did she come back, and without a scratch!

chapters.title: Chapter 408 Anxious Wei Tang
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Chapter 408 Anxious Wei Tang
Wei Qingxue drove back to the Wei Family Mansion alone, her hands still trembling a bit.
Someone actually tried to kidnap her, and she doesn’t know who. If she did get kidnapped, who knows what could be in store for her?
She didn’t even dare to imagine.
Luckily!
Lin Fan was there!
She felt very fortunate that she had called Lin Fan today. Initially, she was a bit nervous about going to Jindu Group and asked Lin Fan to accompany her. Unexpectedly, visiting Jindu went smoothly, but danger approached on the way back.
If Lin Fan hadn’t been there, she shuddered to think of her predicament.
Thinking of Lin Fan, a sense of security filled Wei Qingxue’s heart. Initially, her fake marriage with Lin Fan was only to fend off her family’s pressure to marry, but gradually, she seemed increasingly reliant on Lin Fan. With Lin Fan around, she felt full of security, without any worries about handling difficulties.
This man, although just a courier, with low social status and not earning much, has many virtues. He’s handsome, masculine, and can fight, practically a little protector for his wife.
If...
Lin Fan could always stay by her side, it would be wonderful.
This sudden thought made Wei Qingxue blush. No way, how could she have such a thought? Could it be...
She shook her head to stop herself from thinking further.
With such thoughts swirling, Wei Qingxue returned to the Wei Family Mansion.
At this moment, everyone in the Wei Family was waiting for her, and most of them were getting impatient.
Some even speculated that Wei Qingxue might not come back, perhaps due to some issue with the investment.
Wei Tang, who had hired someone to kidnap Wei Qingxue, secretly rejoiced; Wei Qingxue not showing up meant Chen the Third had succeeded.
"Grandpa, I’m back."
Wei Qingxue said as she walked in.
Wei Tang was dumbfounded when he saw her. Damn, wasn’t Wei Qingxue abducted by Chen the Third? How did she come back?
Elder Wei had been waiting for Wei Qingxue for an entire morning. Seeing Wei Qingxue finally return, he frowned and asked, "Qingxue, why did you take so long? Did something go wrong with the cooperation?"
Wei Qingxue shook her head and replied, "The cooperation went very smoothly. Grandpa, here’s the contract."
Wei Qingxue took out the signed contract and handed it to Elder Wei.
Elder Wei took it, read through it confidently, and found no issues. Only then did he break into a broad smile, "Good, very good, our Wei Family is finally saved!"
Seeing this, everyone in the Wei Family started to rejoice as well. Wanjin’s investment of a billion into the Wei Family finally allowed them to breathe a sigh of relief.
"Qingxue, you’ve worked hard this time; you’ve made a great contribution!" Elder Wei smiled, "I’ve decided to let you continue as the company’s CEO, and I’ll double your salary. How about that?"
This time, Wanjin specifically requested to discuss the cooperation with Wei Qingxue. It seemed Wanjin valued her highly, and Elder Wei had to make a gesture to show Wanjin that he valued her too.
Wei Qingxue replied, "Thank you, Grandpa."
"Wei Qingxue, why did you come back so late? Grandpa is old and waited for you here all morning. Were you doing it on purpose?" Wei Tang sneered.
Wei Qingxue not only successfully completed her task but also received Elder Wei’s praise, driving Wei Tang crazy with jealousy.
Moreover, he couldn’t believe Wei Qingxue had returned so smoothly. Could it be that Chen the Third hadn’t acted yet?
They had agreed on intercepting Wei Qingxue halfway!
Wei Qingxue ignored Wei Tang and said, "Grandpa, I encountered a little accident on the way back, which delayed me a bit. I’m sorry for keeping you waiting."
Elder Wei murmured, "An accident? What kind of accident? Are you okay?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Someone intercepted my car on the road and tried to kidnap me. Luckily, I got away."
What?
The crowd was shocked.
Elder Wei stood up immediately with thunderous rage, "Damn it, who dares to kidnap my granddaughter!"
"No way, someone tried to kidnap Wei Qingxue?"
"What exactly happened?"
"Did she offend someone?"
The Wei Family members started discussing amongst themselves.
At this moment, Wei Tang quietly slipped away, anxious. Wei Qingxue’s mention of interception meant Chen the Third had made his move, but evidently, he failed!
What the hell happened?
He had spent a hundred thousand to hire Chen the Third for this job. Chen the Third had assured him there wouldn’t be any mistakes, and he had given the deposit, which now seemed wasted!
He needed Chen the Third to provide an explanation immediately.
Seeing no one around, Wei Tang quickly took out his phone and called Chen the Third.
The call connected, but no one answered!
"Damn it!" Wei Tang was furious. Could it be that Chen the Third was too embarrassed by his failure to answer?
Would his fifty thousand deposit just be wasted!
Wei Tang didn’t dare to linger outside too long to avoid raising suspicion, so he quietly slipped back into the hall and mingled with the crowd.
At this point, Wei Qingxue was describing the kidnapping incident, saying, "Thanks to Lin Fan, he fought off those thieves, and I didn’t fall into their hands."
What?
Everyone exchanged glances. Lin Fan was so formidable that he defeated the assailants?
Upon hearing this, Wei Tang almost spat out a mouthful of old blood. Apparently, Wei Qingxue had Lin Fan with her—what a miscalculation!
Wei Tang was well aware of Lin Fan’s prowess. That night, he brought several people to try to teach Lin Fan a lesson, only to be easily defeated by him. Lin Fan was genuinely a strong fighter, but he didn’t expect that Lin Fan was capable of such a level—even defeating the kidnappers.
Elder Wei was surprised as well and nodded, showing approval, "Well, your courier husband finally proved useful. Why didn’t he come with you? I rarely get a chance to praise him."
Wei Qingxue said, "He was busy."
When they parted ways, Lin Fan asked her not to tell anyone that he had gone to find Chen the Third, as Lin Fan was investigating the mastermind and couldn’t reveal his tracks.
Elder Wei said, "He’s a courier, probably out delivering packages. Couriers are indeed quite busy. Alright then, help convey my thanks to him."
Although Elder Wei expressed approval of Lin Fan this time, he still maintained a superior attitude; after all, Lin Fan was just a courier.
Wei Qingxue wanted to laugh but didn’t correct Elder Wei. It was best if he thought this way.
"And then?"
Suddenly, Wei Tang spoke up, "You said your husband defeated the kidnappers; did they escape? You didn’t call the police?"
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Why are you asking so many questions?"
Wei Tang laughed, "Though I usually don’t get along with Little Sister Qingxue, this matter invokes anger from both people and gods. It concerns Little Sister Qingxue’s personal safety, and as a brother, I’m just expressing concern."
Elder Wei said, "Qingxue, Little Tang has a point. Did you call the police?"
At that moment.
Ring ring ring...
Wei Qingxue’s phone rang.
Wei Qingxue answered the call and quickly put it on speaker, "It’s Miss Xu from Wanjin Group calling, saying she wants to speak to you, Grandpa."

chapters.title: Chapter 409: A Bloodied Man Flew in from Outside
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 409: A Bloodied Man Flew in from Outside
The new investment director of the Wanjin Group, Miss Xu, suddenly called, wanting to speak with Elder Wei.
For the moment, Elder Wei had to set aside Wei Qingxue’s matter; a call from Wanjin must be about the ten billion investment, which was a top priority for him.
"Miss Xu, hello. First, I must thank your company for investing in our Company. I’ve reviewed the contract and found no issues. Is there anything you’d like to add, Miss Xu?" Elder Wei chuckled.
Miss Xu was Lin Fan’s secretary at Wanjin, Secretary Xu.
"Whether the contract has any issues depends on Mr. Wei," Secretary Xu said coldly.
Elder Wei was taken aback and awkwardly smiled, "Miss Xu, please forgive my ignorance. I don’t quite understand what you mean by that."
Secretary Xu said, "I’m already aware of Miss Wei’s kidnapping on the way!"
Elder Wei’s expression changed. Wanjin was indeed well-informed. He quickly replied, "Thank you, Miss Xu, for your concern. Qingxue is fine with no major issues. We are currently discussing the matter."
However, Wei Qingxue was suddenly alarmed. How did Miss Xu know about the kidnapping?
After all, she hadn’t informed Miss Xu!
The incident happened on a deserted street with few pedestrians. Even if someone had seen it, they wouldn’t recognize her. How could news have reached Miss Xu so quickly?
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue had a thought. Could Lin Fan have told Miss Xu?
This... was impossible!
Why would Lin Fan tell Miss Xu about this?
Wei Qingxue was momentarily bewildered.
Secretary Xu then said, "It’s fortunate that Miss Wei avoided a disaster. It’s indeed a blessing! But I want to know what exactly happened? Who was behind the kidnapping of Miss Wei?"
Elder Wei said, "It’s not clear yet."
Secretary Xu said, "Then please, Mr. Wei, find out! There’s something I might need to inform you about. The reason we Wanjin decided to invest in the Wei Family was not only because we believed in your project but primarily because we appreciate Miss Wei Qingxue’s work capabilities. You might say that this investment is thanks to Miss Wei Qingxue! If anything happens to her, the investment will be canceled!"
Everyone was shocked upon hearing this.
What?
This was pressure, wasn’t it?
Blatant pressure!
Wanjin was using the investment to pressure Elder Wei because of this incident!
Secretary Xu continued, "I hope you understand the importance of Miss Wei Qingxue to us. Find the kidnapper and make them pay. If we find out you haven’t found the kidnapper or let them go, we will immediately withdraw our investment!"
Elder Wei nodded hesitantly, "Miss Xu, don’t worry. I will find the kidnapper as soon as possible..."
Before he finished speaking,
Secretary Xu had already hung up.
Silence.
The entire hall fell into silence.
Elder Wei’s face was somewhat embarrassed. As Elder Wei of the Wei Family, he was akin to a Supreme Emperor within the family. Yet today, he was threatened by a young woman in front of so many people and had to grin and bear it!
There was no choice. As the saying goes, ’One can’t speak with a full mouth,’ and ’A short-handed person must bow.’ The Wei Family needed Wanjin’s funds now, and Wanjin was their financial supporter. When the financial supporter reprimands a few words, he could only endure it quietly.
"Outrageous, this detestable criminal! If I find out who it is, I will definitely not spare them!" Elder Wei gritted his teeth and said.
Wei Tang was drenched in cold sweat. No matter what, he hadn’t expected that Wanjin would call to apply pressure. Wanjin valued Wei Qingxue so highly!
This was a miscalculation!
He initially thought that kidnapping Wei Qingxue to force her resignation would be the end.
He never imagined that Wanjin would insist on Wei Qingxue. If Wei Qingxue were to resign, they might also withdraw their investment!
But at this moment, Wei Tang couldn’t worry about the investment. He was starting to worry about himself. He was the mastermind behind Wei Qingxue’s kidnapping. This truth could not be discovered!
Fortunately, at this point, they couldn’t possibly know the truth. It all depended on Chen the Third.
Wei Tang wanted to slip out. He had to contact Chen the Third immediately to remind him to keep everything under wraps, to not let any information leak.
"Qingxue, should we call the police now? Let the police help us solve the case and find the culprit!" Elder Wei suggested.
Upon hearing this, Wei Tang was frightened, quickly attempting to slip away. In the current situation, he must ensure Chen the Third kept his distance.
"Elder Wei, there’s no need to call the police."
Just then,
a voice came from outside.
And then, with a whoosh, a dark figure flew in and landed heavily on the floor.
It was a person!
A person covered in blood!
The person was extremely disheveled, clearly having been beaten, and not lightly. Their face was swollen like a pig’s head. The branded clothes on their body were torn, the gold watch on their wrist was shattered, and the thick gold chain around their neck was stained with blood.
"Ah!"
The people present exclaimed, dodging aside.
Oh my!
A person like this suddenly flew in, and it was evident that someone had thrown him in from outside!
Thrown in!
Who had such strength to casually throw a living person in?
Slam!
Wei Tang was already dumbfounded, his eyes showing fear, and his phone fell from his hand involuntarily.
Because he recognized the bloody person on the ground—it was Chen the Third!
Oh heavens!
The notorious underground leader Chen the Third had been beaten to this state and brought to the Wei Family!
Wei Tang realized things were not good and couldn’t help but start trembling all over.
Amidst the fright of the crowd, Lin Fan calmly walked in.
He appeared unharmed, with only some bloodstains on his clothes, but it was clear they weren’t his; even his hair was unharmed.
Meanwhile, out at Victory Farmhouse on the outskirts, the place was a mess. Tables and chairs were smashed, broken dishes were scattered, and amidst the mess, dozens of thugs lay sprawled on the ground, some unconscious, some squirming in pain, all unable to stand.
Lin Fan single-handedly took down Chen the Third’s stronghold, annihilating them!
Lin Fan then took Chen the Third and brought him directly to the Wei Family!
"Lin Fan, what’s going on here?" Elder Wei asked, his voice sharp. But who could blame him? This scene, even at his old age, was a first for him. It was terrifying.
Wei Qingxue was trembling with excitement.
Before this, she was still worried about Lin Fan, wondering if he would get hurt when confronting Chen the Third.
Now it seemed her worries were unnecessary!
Lin Fan was completely unscathed, while Chen the Third and his gang had obviously suffered greatly.
This was incredible—her husband was truly incredible.
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue found herself somewhat admiring Lin Fan.
Lin Fan walked in, stood in front of Chen the Third, and kicked him, "Stop pretending to be dead. Get up and tell everyone who instructed you to kidnap my wife?"

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Distorting Right and Wrong
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 410: Distorting Right and Wrong
The large living room was silent.
Everyone’s eyes were on Chen the Third.
Elder Wei couldn’t help but ask, "Lin Fan, what’s going on, who is this person?"
Lin Fan replied, "His name is Chen the Third, a boss in the underground. The people who kidnapped Qingxue today were his subordinates."
Everyone gasped, an underground boss was actually beaten up by Lin Fan like this!
Damn!
Lin Fan, this delivery guy, is actually this formidable?
Wei Qingxue said, "Today, Lin Fan subdued those kidnappers and let them lead him to their boss. Grandpa, I’m sorry. I didn’t tell the truth earlier because I was afraid of leaks. I didn’t expect..."
She was originally worried about Lin Fan. If Lin Fan hadn’t returned, she was already prepared to call the police.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan single-handedly infiltrated the enemy camp and brought the underground boss back unscathed, which was simply amazing.
Elder Wei wiped his cold sweat, saying, "This person doesn’t seem to be moving, could he be dead?"
"He wants to die, but dying isn’t that easy."
Lin Fan said lightly, walked over, and kicked Chen the Third, "Stop playing dead, get up and tell everyone who ordered you to kidnap my wife?"
Chen the Third at this moment really wished he was dead.
He never dreamed that as a dignified underground boss, he would one day end up so miserable. At first, he didn’t even take Lin Fan seriously, but all his men combined were no match for Lin Fan alone.
As a boss, he had his pride and naturally wouldn’t easily submit to Lin Fan, until, with his whole body injured, he would surely die if the fight continued.
His injuries were even more severe than Lin Fan thought, Lin Fan asked him to get up and speak, but even with all his might, he couldn’t get up.
He could only continue lying on the ground, weakly saying, "It was... Young Master Wei... who ordered me."
Young Master Wei?
Everyone was stunned for a moment, not reacting to who it was.
Lin Fan said, "State the name!"
Chen the Third said, "Wei Tang."
"What?"
Everyone in the Wei Family was shocked!
The person who hired the underground thugs to kidnap Wei Qingxue was actually the Wei Family’s eldest son, Wei Tang?
Wei Tang’s face instantly turned white.
Elder Wei, astonished and angry, said, "What are you saying, don’t talk nonsense, how could it be Little Tang!"
"It must be fake!"
"Words from an underground thug can’t be trusted!"
"Must be intentional, is someone trying to frame the eldest master?"
Everyone was discussing it heatedly.
Wei Tang, initially frightened, gained confidence upon hearing this, putting on an angry facade, "This scoundrel is slandering me, I am innocent! Grandpa, you must believe me, how could I do such a thing! I don’t even know this person, you can’t believe a single word this underground scoundrel says!"
A middle-aged man then said gravely, "Lin Fan, your story is pretty well-constructed, how long are you planning to direct and act this out yourself?"
Lin Fan saw that this man was Wei Tang’s father, Wei Family’s eldest son Wei Dagang.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Uncle, what do you mean by this?"
Wei Dagang sneered, "I’m saying the act put on by you and your husband is quite a show, where did you find this actor, the acting is not bad, huh! There’s no kidnapping at all, everything you said earlier is made up, aiming to frame Little Tang, am I wrong?"
What?
Everyone was stunned. Is this the truth?
Elder Wei looked at Wei Qingxue, "Qingxue, explain this situation."
Wei Qingxue’s face turned red with anger, "I was indeed kidnapped, it’s absolutely true, how could I make a joke out of something like this!"
Wei Dagang chuckled, "You’re right, your husband who is a delivery guy turns out to be a Martial Arts Master, alone taking down an entire group of underground thugs, beating their boss half to death and bringing him back! Everyone listen, could such a person exist in this world, does that sound believable! Is he Yip Man or Chen Zhen, it’s obviously fake!"
The Wei Family, upon hearing this, felt that Wei Dagang made sense, indeed, Lin Fan’s power sounded too exaggerated and unrealistic!
"As I said, a single person taking down an entire underground gang, too exaggerated!"
"I really almost believed in his nonsense earlier!"
"I almost believed it too, but Uncle’s discerning eyes saw through it in an instant!"
"Tut tut, are they pulling this stunt because they fear the eldest young master, so they want him dead!"
"It must be that’s the reason, Wei Qingxue thinks she did a great deed, she wants to take over the Wei Family, the eldest young master is her biggest obstacle!"
"Oh my god, Wei Qingxue is too vicious!"
Everyone was now accusing Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue in turn.
Wei Qingxue was infuriated, these people were simply reversing black and white!
Clearly she was the one who got kidnapped, yet now she became the villain in their words.
Wei Tang felt increasingly pleased, outwardly playing the victim, "Oh my god, Wei Qingxue, you’re so vicious, why are you framing me! Grandpa, you must stand up for me, this Wei Qingxue, she’s trying to harm me!"
Wei Dagang sneered, "Everyone’s speculations should be correct, Wei Qingxue wants to take over the Wei Family assets, and Little Tang is her biggest obstacle. She is attempting to use this opportunity to eliminate Little Tang, hence self-directing and acting in this drama. Her heart is truly vicious! Father, you tell us how should we deal with this Wei Qingxue?"
Elder Wei was so angry that he was shaking, "Qingxue, what’s really going on, is what your uncle said true, tell me truthfully!"
Wei Qingxue said, "It’s not true, Grandpa, I truly almost got kidnapped."
Elder Wei said, "Your uncle’s analysis makes a lot of sense, how could Lin Fan be so powerful, taking down an entire underground gang alone, it’s a fantasy unless you show evidence, otherwise, I can’t believe you. If you are indeed falsely accusing Little Tang, Grandpa would be very disappointed."
Wei Qingxue: "..."
She had no evidence.
At this moment, Lin Fan took out a phone from Chen the Third’s pocket, turned on a recording, and a conversation played throughout the hall.
"How does Young Master Wei want me to entertain her?"
"That little bitch has already signed a contract with Wanjin. Once she returns, she’ll become the Wei Family’s hero and will definitely regain her position as president. Third Brother, you help me force her to resign voluntarily!"
"Damn it, that’s too troublesome, ten thousand won’t do, gotta add another ten thousand..."
Upon hearing these recordings, everyone in the Wei Family was shocked.
This is clearly the voices of Chen the Third and Wei Tang!
Lin Fan paused the recording, laughed and said, "Young Master Wei, do you recognize your voice? This is you, isn’t it?"
Wei Tang’s face changed dramatically, Lin Fan actually had his phone call recording with Chen the Third!
Chen the Third then lifted his head, chuckled, and said, "Every time I deal with someone, I record it, keep a back road for myself, didn’t expect it to be useful this time."
Lin Fan said, "You might still deny it, claim it’s synthesized, but that’s okay, we can have it verified by authorities. Moreover, this has your call records to Chen the Third, you can’t deny it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 411: Bastard, kneel before me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Chapter 411: Bastard, kneel before me!
Everyone in the Wei Family was shocked, each with a look of astonishment!
The recording released by Lin Fan included a conversation between Chen the Third and Wei Tang!
They were discussing the kidnapping of Wei Qingxue!
This recording was undeniably real, so Lin Fan wasn’t afraid of the other party questioning it. If they didn’t believe it, they could have an authoritative expert verify it.
Moreover, Chen the Third’s call records even had incoming calls from Wei Tang.
In the face of such ironclad evidence, Wei Tang had no room to argue!
Just a moment ago, Wei Tang was still complacent, thinking he could turn the tables and reverse black and white. After all, the all of the Wei Family was on his side, including Elder Wei, who adored him the most. Within minutes, black could become white, white could become black, and Wei Qingxue could be made the perpetrator instead of the victim.
But he never expected!
Chen the Third actually recorded their conversation!
Lin Fan had already coerced the truth out at the Victory Farmhouse; he brought Chen the Third here with a prepared plan!
He came to settle a score with Wei Tang!
Everyone in the Wei Family fell silent.
Elder Wei sought the truth and got it — this truth was like an iron hammer, solid and hard to refute.
Wei Qingxue was already furious. The more she was turned into the villain before, the angrier she was now: "Wei Tang, you despicable scoundrel, you actually used such a means against me!"
Elder Wei was both shocked and furious, slammed the table, and glared at Wei Tang: "You bastard, how could you do such a thing!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Elder, don’t be angry yet. The recording isn’t finished; what’s next is even more exciting!"
Wei Tang screamed hoarsely: "Lin Fan, stop playing the recording. Yes, it’s me, I admit it. Is that enough now?"
Admitted...
Lin Fan said, "It’s good you admitted it, but the content that follows is too exciting not to share."
Saying this, Lin Fan pressed the play button.
"Instead of adding money, I have a better idea. Third Brother, do you think Wei Qingxue is worth 100,000 for a night?"
"Young Master Wei, you really are an absolute scoundrel. Isn’t Wei Qingxue your sister? You could even think of such an idea. I admire you!"
"What sister? Anyone who’s against me is my enemy. I wish she were dead. I wonder if Third Brother has any interest?"
"..."
In this conversation, to save 100,000, Wei Tang actually suggested that Chen the Third harm Wei Qingxue!
This was simply inhuman!
Hearing these words, everyone in the Wei Family was struck with shock and disbelief. No matter how much they disliked Wei Qingxue, they all thought Wei Tang had gone way too far!
Too much, too vicious!
Wei Qingxue trembled with anger, her lips quivering, unable to speak for a while, she was beyond furious.
"You bastard, you bastard, kneel before me!" Elder Wei exploded in anger, slamming his hand on the table so hard the teacup on the table fell to the ground and shattered.
The members of the Wei Family had never seen Elder Wei this angry before.
Thud!
Wei Tang, frightened, knelt down, tears and snot flowing: "Grandpa, I know I was wrong. It was just a moment of madness fueled by jealousy of Wei Qingxue. She brought back 1 billion; how would I stand in the family anymore? In my fury, I did something so foolish. I truly didn’t mean it. Please forgive me this once, I’m begging you?"
Elder Wei shouted in rage: "A moment of fury? But you’ve already done it, you almost harmed Qingxue, harmed the whole Wei Family!"
Wei Qingxue’s eyes reddened: "Grandfather, Wei Tang harmed me like this. If not for Lin Fan, I might have fallen victim to his wicked scheme. Grandfather, you must stand up for me and severely punish Wei Tang! I want him to pay for his actions!"
Elder Wei said: "Wei Tang’s actions, I will not let him off lightly! Qingxue, tell me, how would you like him to be dealt with?"
Wei Qingxue said: "I want him imprisoned!"
Imprisoned!
Elder Wei’s expression changed; in his view, this was too severe. No matter what, Wei Tang was the Wei Family’s oldest legitimate grandson, his favorite. He really didn’t want to send Wei Tang to prison.
At this moment, Wei Dagang angrily said: "Wei Qingxue, don’t go too far! Little Tang already knows he’s wrong, and you haven’t been physically harmed. We’re family; don’t take it too far!"
Wei Qingxue trembled with anger: "Uncle, listen to yourself! Am I going too far? It’s your son who went too far! If it were Wei Zihan who was calculated against so maliciously, would you stop there? What family? I’m ashamed to be part of this family! He’s unworthy!"
Wei Dagang ignored Wei Qingxue and pleaded with Elder Wei: "Father, Little Tang is the family’s legitimate grandson. If he goes to jail and word gets out, our family becomes a joke. How could we ever hold our heads up again? Family disgrace must not be made public! Please, Father, reconsider!"
Elder Wei nodded and persuaded, "Qingxue, your uncle has a point. This matter shouldn’t be made public; this concerns the Wei Family’s reputation. If this scandal spreads and causes an uproar, our business dealings could unravel, and the cooperative deal you worked hard on with Wanjin could be wasted."
Wei Qingxue fell silent, reluctant to admit that unfortunately, this was true!
Disgusting!
She couldn’t just let Wei Tang off; if he did such a thing and remained unscathed, it would just be ridiculous.
Lin Fan said, "I have a suggestion, Elder, which you may consider. How about this: expel Wei Tang from the Wei Family, just like you did with your wife before — permanently remove him from the family! This matter need not be made public, but it must be done!"
What?
Permanently expel from the Wei Family!
Lin Fan’s suggestion was harsh!
Wei Qingxue nodded: "If I can’t send him to jail, then expelling him from the Wei Family, I can accept. Anyway, I don’t want to be part of a family with him; just seeing him disgusts me!"
Wei Tang was terrified and enraged: "Wei Qingxue, you’re all going too far. I’m the Wei Family’s oldest legitimate grandson; how can you just expel me so casually?"
"I oppose!"
Wei Dagang said, "Father, you can’t expel Little Tang, he is the oldest legitimate grandson, and will inherit the family’s assets in the future. Father, reconsider!"
Elder Wei found himself at a difficult loss.
Personally, he didn’t want to expel the oldest legitimate grandson; no matter what huge mistake Wei Tang made, he had always doted on this grandson.
However, at this moment, he had to give Wei Qingxue an explanation.
Strictly speaking, it was an explanation to the Wanjin Group!
Miss Xu from Wanjin’s Investment Department had previously called, asking the Wei Family to find and severely punish the culprit!
If Elder Wei protected Wei Tang, it would be hard to explain to Wanjin. If Wanjin got displeased and withdrew investment, the Wei Family would be finished.
Was it worth risking the whole Wei Family’s fate to protect Wei Tang?
Elder Wei found it difficult to make this decision.
"Elder, is this decision so hard? Expel Wei Tang from the family, and we will settle this. Otherwise, I’ll have no choice but to call the police, as prison seems more fitting for him." Lin Fan said with a smile.
"Shut up, damn you, a mere courier, a live-in son-in-law, who are you to speak!"
Wei Dagang, enraged, pounced toward Lin Fan. At this point, Lin Fan was making his life difficult with every sentence, how could he bear it!
In his fury, he couldn’t help it and lunged to hit Lin Fan. To him, Lin Fan was truly too fearsome.
Watching the portly and clumsy Wei Dagang rush at him, Lin Fan laughed coldly, thinking how it couldn’t be blamed on him if this man came at him on his own.

chapters.title: Chapter 412: From today onwards, permanently expelled
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Chapter 412: From today onwards, permanently expelled
Lin Fan suggested expelling Wei Tang from the family.
In a fit of rage, Wei Dagang lunged forward, attempting to slap Lin Fan. This live-in son-in-law was too detestable. If it weren’t for him, Wei Tang wouldn’t have been exposed. The current situation was all Lin Fan’s doing.
And Lin Fan was just a live-in son-in-law, someone with the lowest status in the Wei Family, a delivery man everyone looked down upon. Wei Dagang had never taken Lin Fan seriously before.
Having been ruined by someone he utterly despised, Wei Dagang naturally couldn’t hold back.
And with the deep sense of superiority in front of Lin Fan, he subconsciously believed that, as the eldest son of the Wei Family, Lin Fan, this lowly man, would just obediently take the beating. There was nothing he could do because this was a suppression of status!
He never considered that Lin Fan would resist, let alone dare to resist.
As Wei Dagang’s bulky body closed in on Lin Fan, a slap was about to land on Lin Fan’s face.
Lin Fan gently sidestepped, and Wei Dagang swung at empty air. Due to the excessive force, he nearly fell.
"How dare you dodge!" Wei Dagang shouted angrily, turned around, and charged at Lin Fan again.
Lin Fan frowned, watching the charging Wei Dagang, and kicked Wei Dagang’s belly, sending him tumbling backward. With a loud crash, he hit a nearby table, stopping his momentum.
Lin Fan stepped forward, grabbed Wei Dagang by the neck, and lifted him like a chicken.
With slight force, Wei Dagang found it difficult to breathe, his face turning red as fear overwhelmed him.
The entire hall fell silent, everyone was stunned.
How ruthless!
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, it would be hard to believe. Lin Fan gave Wei Dagang no face, it was too fierce; he lifted Wei Dagang with just one hand!
"Lin Fan, let go!" Elder Wei shouted, as Lin Fan’s actions were insubordinate, he had to intervene.
But Lin Fan ignored him, holding Wei Dagang’s neck, and said coldly, "So, do you still want to fight?"
Wei Dagang’s limbs struggled instinctively, but he couldn’t break free, like a rabbit facing death. If this continued, he really would die.
Wei Dagang hurriedly said, "I won’t dare again."
Due to the chokehold, uttering these three words took all his effort.
"Try moving again, and I’ll kill you!" Lin Fan said coldly, tossing Wei Dagang aside.
Wei Dagang fell to the ground like a dead dog, struggling to get up, desperately gulping for oxygen. His throat bore the imprint of five fingers. With Lin Fan’s strength, crushing his neck seemed an easy task.
Seeing this, everyone was visibly frightened. Their gazes towards Lin Fan turned somewhat fearful.
This live-in son-in-law, whom they previously looked down upon, was now someone they were somewhat afraid of.
Only then did Lin Fan turn to Elder Wei and say, "Elder, you saw it too, he was too ashamed to anger and wanted to hit me first. I was merely acting in self-defense."
Cold sweat dripped from everyone’s brows. Damn! You call that self-defense? That was clearly a one-sided beating!
Elder Wei wiped his cold sweat. Even he didn’t dare reprimand Lin Fan too much, knowing that Lin Fan was surely furious over Wei Qingxue’s kidnapping. Hence, Wei Dagang hit a hard nail. Elder Wei feared that if he angered Lin Fan, this madman might even strike him. As the esteemed elder, it would be quite humiliating.
"Ahem," Elder Wei cleared his throat, trying to smooth things over: "We’re all family, let’s talk things out, no need to get physical, both of you keep calm."
Lin Fan smiled slightly and looked at Wei Dagang, saying: "The elder is right. If we can reason things out, let’s not fight. I apologize for my earlier actions."
Wei Dagang, still shaken, was angry and startled, unwilling to let it go that easily. Seeing Lin Fan apologize, he snorted heavily.
Everyone noticed that Lin Fan had a broad mind, in stark contrast to Wei Dagang, and couldn’t help but change their opinion of Lin Fan a bit.
At this moment, Wei Qingxue felt gratified. She was very pleased with Lin Fan’s actions. Her uncle often suppressed her, and today Lin Fan had given her a sense of justice. The best part was, Wei Dagang was clearly too frightened to confront Lin Fan. Even her grandfather hadn’t protected Wei Dagang this time, but rather tried to mediate.
"Grandpa, why don’t we get back to the main issue? I cannot forgive what Wei Tang did to me. He either leaves the Wei Family or goes to prison. The decision is yours, Grandpa," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan said, "My dear wife, give Elder Wei some time. This matter concerns the Wei Family’s destiny. To the Wei Family, Wei Tang is just a piece of rotten garbage. I believe Elder Wei will make the right choice."
Lin Fan actually called his son a piece of rotten garbage, making Wei Dagang furious, but he didn’t dare say anything.
Everyone looked at Elder Wei, awaiting his decision.
Wei Tang was anxious, pleading, "Grandfather, you can’t listen to them, I’m the legitimate grandson of the Wei Family, please don’t drive me away."
Elder Wei was silent for a moment, then finally sighed and said, "Wei Tang’s actions are heinous, causing great harm to the family’s reputation. This cannot be forgiven. As of today, Wei Tang is expelled from the Wei Family. Unless he gains the forgiveness of all family members, especially Qingxue, he will never be allowed to step foot into the Wei Family again!"
"Grandpa, no!"
Wei Tang cried out in despair, his face pale, as if struck by lightning, his soul terrified.
Elder Wei actually expelled him from the Wei Family permanently!
Elder Wei closed his eyes, ignoring Wei Tang. Expelling his most beloved grandson made him feel terrible, but he had no other choice.
Not to mention the investments, if he continued to protect Wei Tang in such matters, the entire Wei Family would be dissatisfied, and his image as the respected elder would collapse.
Seeing that pleading with Elder Wei was futile, Wei Tang turned to the others: "Say something, plea for me, didn’t you always try to please me before? Why are you all silent now?"
However, the other members of the Wei Family remained silent, exchanging glances, and no one pleaded for Wei Tang.
Previously, they flattered Wei Tang because he was the eldest young master, the future heir of the Wei Family’s enterprises, naturally wishing to maintain a good relationship and benefit from it.
Now, however, Wei Tang was nothing more than trash. No one was foolish enough to see any benefit in pleading for him, especially when it involved getting their hands dirty.
Seeing this, Wei Tang laughed angrily, pointing at everyone and swore, "You pack of ingrates, you’re all damn ingrates!"
"Enough!"
Elder Wei’s expression turned grim, "You are no longer part of the Wei Family. Someone, take Wei Tang out!"
Several servants came over, lifting Wei Tang, pulling him away. Naturally, Wei Tang refused to leave, struggling desperately, howling like a ghost. Even the two servants had difficulty controlling him.

chapters.title: Chapter 413: The Overbearing Young Lady Was Subdued
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: Chapter 413: The Overbearing Young Lady Was Subdued
"Let me give you all a hand," Lin Fan said, forcing his way forward.
Wei Tang was shocked. His father’s incident with Wei Dagang had just unfolded; he didn’t want to end up the same way and instantly backed down.
"Don’t come any closer. I’ll just leave on my own!" Wei Tang said hastily.
Lin Fan still approached Wei Tang, patted his shoulder, and smiled, "You urged Elder Wei to kick my dear wife out of the house. How does it feel now that you’re being kicked out yourself? I’ll give you one chance: I won’t lay a hand on you, so scram."
Wei Tang was furious but dared not speak, obediently followed by two attendants, and walked out.
Finally, Wei Tang was driven away.
Wei Qingxue said, "Thank you, Grandfather, for standing up for me."
At this moment, Wei Qingxue’s phone rang; it was Secretary Xu calling again.
This call was mainly to find Elder Wei.
"Mr. Wei, have there been any developments with the culprit who kidnapped Miss Wei?" Secretary Xu asked.
Elder Wei broke into a sweat; this Wanjin Group’s investment director was really keeping a close watch, it seemed they truly cared about this issue.
Fortunately, he had already driven Wei Tang away; otherwise, it’d be tough to explain to them.
"The culprit has been found and has received their deserved punishment. I am firmly committed to protecting Qingxue, so please rest assured, Miss Xu," Elder Wei said.
Secretary Xu responded with an ’oh’ and said, "Miss Wei, is it true?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Miss Xu, what Grandpa said is true; the culprit has been dealt with."
Secretary Xu said, "Alright then. I don’t wish for our partnership to encounter such issues again, and I hope the Wei Family can take note. I have a meeting to attend, so let’s leave it at that. We will distribute funds to the Wei Family according to the contract."
Elder Wei was relieved. "Thank you, Miss Xu. I assure you, Qingxue won’t suffer similar harm again. I hope our cooperation will be pleasant."
The call then ended.
"Big brother, I’ve done what you asked. I’ve confessed everything too; can you give me a way out?"
At this moment, Chen the Third, who was lying on the floor, spoke with a beseeching look.
Lin Fan said calmly, "There’s a car waiting for you outside. If you can walk out on your own, then go ahead."
Chen the Third was overjoyed and, gritting his teeth, struggled to get up, stumbling as he moved outward.
Lin Fan said, "Today’s incident at the Wei Family — consider it as if nothing happened. If I find out you leaked even the slightest hint, I will personally pay another visit."
It was precisely because he didn’t want to cause a public uproar that Lin Fan decided to spare Chen the Third.
Chen the Third immediately agreed, "Rest assured, I will keep my mouth shut."
It took all his might for Chen the Third to finally walk out of the Wei Family, and he barely managed to climb into the car, wincing in pain all over.
"Lin Fan, I will remember you. Just wait — if I let it go just like this, I, Chen the Third, am a dog!" Chen the Third’s eyes briefly showed a fierce light.
Inside the hall, after this incident, Elder Wei was somewhat mentally and physically exhausted. He then stood up with the help of the old butler and said, "I hope everyone uses Wei Tang as an example. If anyone else damages the family interests, I won’t be lenient. I’m tired; let’s call it a day."
With the butler’s assistance, Elder Wei went to the backyard.
With Elder Wei gone, the others slowly dispersed as well.
"Dear wife, let’s go home too," Lin Fan said.
Wei Qingxue acknowledged with a nod and left with Lin Fan.
Just upon reaching the door, they bumped into someone hurrying in from outside.
Wei Zihan!
At this moment, Wei Zihan looked a little distressed, with bruising at the corner of her mouth as if she had been hit. Due to her hurry, she was somewhat out of breath.
Upon learning that her younger brother Wei Tang had been expelled from the family by Elder Wei, she rushed back immediately.
"Where’s Wei Tang? What have you done to my brother?" Wei Zihan demanded furiously. She knew somewhat that Wei Tang’s expulsion had something to do with Wei Qingxue, and upon encountering Wei Qingxue, she was quick to find fault.
Lin Fan, however, sized her up and smiled, "Sister Zihan, what’s with you? Got beaten up? Who’s bold enough to hit Wei Family’s eldest lady?"
Wei Zihan, irritated, said, "It’s none of your business! Wei Qingxue, I’m asking you, what exactly did you do to my brother?"
Wei Qingxue coolly said, "Why should I tell you? Ask him yourself. Lin Fan, let’s go."
Wei Zihan blocked Wei Qingxue’s path: "No explanation, and don’t think of leaving, you little b****. My brother was kicked out because of you, right?"
Wei Qingxue didn’t even want to waste her breath on Wei Zihan.
Wei Zihan became even more angry: "Little b****, I’ve said you’re unreliable from the start. What are you planning by harming my brother? Why won’t you speak? Are you going to speak or not, d*** it?"
Wei Zihan, filled with rage, raised her hand to slap Wei Qingxue.
Of course, she didn’t hit Wei Qingxue; her hand was caught by Lin Fan midway.
"Being foul-mouthed is one thing, why resort to violence?" Lin Fan chuckled.
Wei Zihan struggled but couldn’t move; shocked and furious, she said, "You worthless bum, how dare you stop me? Don’t forget your status; you are just the Wei Family’s lowest son-in-law, let go, I order you to let go!"
Wei Qingxue shook her head; ordering Lin Fan was futile, he dared to grab even Wei Zihan’s father’s throat, not to mention her. Trying to use status to suppress Lin Fan was useless.
Lin Fan asked, "Will you still hit?"
Wei Zihan cursed, "I’ll hit the little b****, what’s it to you? I’ll hit you too, you damn delivery guy!"
Lin Fan responded simply, "Alright."
He applied slightly more pressure.
"Ah!"
Wei Zihan immediately felt as if her hand was squeezed by giant iron pincers; half her body went numb, and she let out a scream from the pain, breaking into a cold sweat.
"Let go, you bum!" Wei Zihan cursed.
"Still foul-mouthed," Lin Fan chuckled, applying more pressure.
"Ah!"
Wei Zihan screamed again, this time her whole body weakened in pain, breaking into a cold sweat, finally realizing this delivery guy was way too much.
Lin Fan asked again, "Will you still hit?"
Wei Zihan realized if she didn’t relent, her hand would break and quickly said, "No more hitting, please let go!"
Wei Qingxue blinked, looking at Lin Fan with some admiration; Wei Zihan, the unruly eldest lady, walking horizontally in the Wei Family, was subdued by Lin Fan, making Lin Fan truly unprecedented!
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s better. If you dare to hit again, I’ll ruin your hand."
Saying this, Lin Fan let go.
Wei Zihan, regaining her freedom, covered her wrist with one hand and saw it reddened, truly looking like it had been squeezed by pincers, and couldn’t help but be quite afraid. Why was this Lin Fan so formidable?
"Hmph, Lin Fan, bullying a girl, what kind of man are you? I won’t let it slide! You won’t talk, right? You won’t talk; I’ll ask Grandpa!"
Wei Zihan threw down her harsh words and hurried away.
Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue didn’t mind her; after Wei Zihan learns why Wei Tang was expelled, her face would surely be interesting.
Afterwards, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue went home.
At home, Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were waiting for something.
Meanwhile, Wei Tang, who had been expelled from the Wei Family, wandered the streets alone, feeling at a loss, not knowing where to go, almost wanting to die.
Suddenly, a van pulled up beside Wei Tang, and from the van, two masked men stepped out, and one after the other, subdued Wei Tang, forcibly dragging him onto the van.
In an instant, Wei Tang was abducted.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: Mission Completed, the System’s Reward Is...
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: Chapter 414: Mission Completed, the System’s Reward Is...
After Wei Tang was kicked out of the Wei Family, he wandered the streets. Logically, as a discarded member of the Wei Family, he had no value, and no one would care about him anymore.
However, Wei Tang was suddenly shoved into a van and kidnapped.
Wei Tang was scared out of his wits.
A bag was pulled over his head, blocking his vision, and he could only feel the vehicle jolting.
"Who are you people? Let me go! I’m the eldest son of the Wei Family, and you dare kidnap me!"
"Wei Qingxue, did you get someone to take revenge on me, you bitch!"
"Please, let me go, sob sob sob..."
The further it went, the more terrified Wei Tang became until he was almost about to cry from fear.
Later, Wei Tang was taken to a room and was forcibly sat down on a chair.
His head covering was then removed, revealing a person smiling at him from in front.
"Little Tang, do you still recognize me?" the person asked.
Wei Tang saw this person and was stunned, showing an expression of surprise—this was someone he never would have thought of.
It wasn’t Wei Qingxue taking revenge; it was this person who brought him here!
Wei Tang blurted out, "You... could it be..."
Meanwhile, Wei Qingxue and Lin Fan left the Wei Family Mansion, planning to go home.
Wei Qingxue was driving, and she stole a glance at Lin Fan in the passenger seat, blushing as she said, "Lin Fan, I haven’t thanked you enough; today was all thanks to you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to thank me; it wasn’t much effort."
Wei Qingxue was a bit touched. Lin Fan always acted so casually, yet in reality, his contributions were significant. The things he did were far from easy; other people simply couldn’t accomplish them.
How many in the world could single-handedly take down an underground gang?
Yet Lin Fan could!
Anyway, with Lin Fan by her side now, she felt exceptionally safe. She even depended on him a bit. Without Lin Fan around, she felt a little uneasy.
Perhaps because Lin Fan was such an excellent shield.
She even thought about wanting to have him permanently.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Wei Tang has already been kicked out of the Wei Family, and the financial difficulty has been resolved. In the Wei Family, no one should be able to shake your position anymore. As for me, I’m probably useless to you now. If you want a divorce, you can bring it up anytime."
Wei Qingxue: "..."
She had just started having those thoughts, and Lin Fan’s words were like a bucket of cold water poured over her head.
She didn’t even know what to say to make Lin Fan stay.
She could only nod, "Okay, once this thing is completely over, we can go divorce."
Lin Fan made a nonchalant sound, and said nothing more. He didn’t care much; he didn’t have romantic feelings for Wei Qingxue. Helping her was purely a system task.
And the system task, he had already completed.
Although he still didn’t know the purpose behind the system issuing this task.
"Ding!"
Suddenly, Lin Fan heard the system prompt sound in his mind!
"Congratulations to the host for helping Wei Qingxue resolve the financial task. It is complete, and you have received a reward of five million in cash, which has been credited to your account. Please check it!"
Lin Fan smiled wryly, the system bug still hadn’t been fixed. All the rewards invariably turned into five million in cash.
Lin Fan then checked the task bar.
"Task: Help Wei Qingxue resolve the financial problem.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 100/100.
Completed."
At this point, as far as tasks related to Wei Qingxue were concerned, everything was finished, except for getting divorced from Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue saw Lin Fan sitting quietly and not speaking, which made the atmosphere seem a bit awkward.
She suddenly thought of something and curiously asked, "By the way, I’ve always wanted to ask you, you’re so skilled, why are you working as a courier? You could actually do better jobs."
Lin Fan shifted his attention away from the system and said, "Like what?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Like being a bodyguard. Bodyguards are valuable, especially good ones. If you were a bodyguard for the rich, your compensation would surely be much higher than being a courier."
Lin Fan said, "I’m not interested in being a bodyguard."
He’s a billionaire; why would he need to be anyone’s bodyguard? Unless it was necessary, like when the system required him—he’d even work as a security guard then.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Then why did you agree to marry me and help me?"
To Wei Qingxue, Lin Fan’s role now seemed almost no different than that of a bodyguard.
Lin Fan said, "Weren’t you the one who pleaded with me to do it? I was just softhearted..."
"Alright." Wei Qingxue sighed; inexplicably feeling a bit hurt. This guy didn’t seem to have any interest in her. It was like he was just going through the motions because it was a task. Could it be that her charm wasn’t enough?
How was that possible!
Wei Qingxue prided herself on being a beauty, with suitors lining up from here to France, yet Lin Fan seemed immune to her looks.
Suddenly, she had a bold thought; oh my god, could it be that he’s not into women...
Once the thought emerged, she couldn’t shake it off, and she couldn’t help but think: Lin Fan is so handsome—a bona fide hottie. They say that good-looking men are often... not straight...
In the blink of an eye, Wei Qingxue noticed Lin Fan’s gaze fixed outside the car, as if admiring something.
Wei Qingxue curiously asked, "What are you looking at?"
Lin Fan pointed ahead with his hand and smiled, "See that girl sitting on the back of that motorcycle, right? Wow, what a figure, probably a D-cup..."
Wei Qingxue almost fainted; damn it, he was checking out beauties. This proves he’s normal...
Wei Qingxue was flustered.
In no time, they arrived home.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were both at home, waiting for their return.
"Thank heaven you’re alright," Li Xueyan ran over and hugged Wei Qingxue.
After finding out Wei Qingxue was almost kidnapped, she was scared to tears. As a mother, nothing mattered more to her than Wei Qingxue’s safety.
Wei Qingxue said, "Mom, I’m fine, thanks to Lin Fan."
Li Xueyan glanced at Lin Fan, her expression a bit complicated. Though she was unwilling to admit it, Lin Fan deserved the most credit this time. But she had always scolded Lin Fan and now found it difficult to praise him, even saying thank you was hard to utter.
Wei Dazong was much more straightforward, smiling as he said, "Lin Fan, I’ve heard about what you did. I didn’t expect you to be so capable; Qingxue’s escaping this disaster was all thanks to you. On behalf of the family, I thank you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Father-in-law, no need to be polite. She’s my wife, of course I have to protect her; it’s my duty."
Wei Dazong paused, nodded and said, "I think I might be starting to understand why Qingxue would marry you."
Wei Qingxue blushed and said, "Dad, what are you talking about."
Wei Dazong said, "Lin Fan may be poor and just a courier, but he has a sense of responsibility. Qingxue must have seen this in you."
Beside them, Li Xueyan looked complex, as if Wei Dazong’s words had struck a chord with her.
Although the system task was completed, since Wei Qingxue hadn’t brought up divorce, Lin Fan continued to stay with the Wei Family as their live-in son-in-law.
Every morning, Lin Fan would head out as usual on his e-bike. Everyone assumed he was going to make deliveries; only Lin Fan knew what he was actually doing.
As the CEO of a company worth 200 billion, Lin Fan had plenty of matters to deal with.
During this period, Lin Fan was never idle.
A world-leading chip factory was already under construction.
Rocket research and development were proceeding intensively.
Celestial Aviation’s business had entered a fast-track of development...
Mortal Group was cultivating tremendous strength and was ready to astonish the world at any moment.
Meanwhile, during his time as their live-in son-in-law, the dynamics of his relationship with the Wei Family seemed to be subtly changing. Ever since Lin Fan had saved Wei Qingxue from the hands of those thugs, the Wei Family members looked at him differently...
On this day, as usual, Lin Fan biked back to the community.
Suddenly, the commotion up ahead caught Lin Fan’s attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: That person rushed in
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 415: That person rushed in
That evening, as usual, Lin Fan rode his electric scooter back to Yujing District.
As a high-end residential area, most people here come and go in luxury cars, so someone riding a shabby electric scooter is quite rare, making Lin Fan particularly conspicuous. Every time he appears in the community, he attracts strange looks from the residents.
Not many good words come out of their mouths.
"Look, isn’t that the poor son-in-law of the Wei Family?"
"It’s really baffling, isn’t it? Wei Qingxue has such good conditions, looks so beautiful, how blind must she be to fall for a delivery guy."
"I agree, can’t understand it, but this seems to be none of our business, it’s their choice!"
"How is it not our business? This guy’s existence lowers the standard of our community; we are a high-end residential area, and we have such a pauper living here..."
"The Wei Family may not find it shameful, but I certainly do!"
Lin Fan hears these remarks every day, and after hearing them enough, he has gotten used to it.
Let them talk; these people are just gonna eat their own words. Whether Lin Fan chooses to respond to them depends on his mood.
Lin Fan pretended not to hear, riding his beloved little electric scooter through the community.
Suddenly, there was a commotion in front of a building; it turned out a group of residents had gathered in front of a convenience store, something seemed to have happened.
"Oh my god, that person is crazy, how could he not even spare a little girl!"
"Poor little girl, what if something happens to her?"
"Hope the little girl is okay, but the situation doesn’t look good!"
The crowd was buzzing with discussion.
At the same time, a police car was parked outside the convenience store.
A few police officers lined up, one of them holding a megaphone, shouting towards the inside of the store.
"Suspect inside, listen up, the police have surrounded you. We hope you surrender immediately, and release the hostage. Resisting will do you no good."
The officer shouted, but there was no response from inside the store, no one spoke.
However, the frightened cries of a little girl could be heard.
It seemed someone inside had taken a little girl hostage!
An auntie, likely a relative of the little girl, knelt on the ground crying desperately, her face full of fear, "You heartless one, let go of my granddaughter, please don’t hurt her!"
At this moment, another police car arrived.
A beautiful female officer got out of the car.
Lin Fan recognized her, it was Loli!
"Captain Luo!"
Seeing Loli arrive, the officers visibly relaxed, as if their savior had finally arrived.
Loli asked, "What’s the situation?"
The officer who had been shouting explained, "Here’s what happened, today we received a tip-off about illegal activities in this area. Our colleagues came to investigate and indeed found the suspect. When the suspect was discovered, he panicked and fled, chased into this convenience store where he took a little girl hostage."
Loli frowned; taking a little girl hostage is a serious matter that must not go wrong.
"Besides the little girl, is there anyone else inside?" Loli asked.
The officer responded, "The convenience store clerk is also inside."
Loli asked, "Does the suspect have weapons?"
"He has a knife," the officer replied. "Moreover, he’s quite skilled, our team couldn’t catch him, and he managed to run into the store. Now that he has taken hostages, we don’t dare to rush in for fear of harming them."
Loli muttered, "Skillful, huh? This complicates things."
Typically, hostage situations require special forces intervention, and snipers may be deployed to ensure the safety of the hostages.
But now the suspect was inside the convenience store, making it difficult for snipers to aim from outside.
"Cops outside, listen up, I’ll give you 10 seconds. Drop your guns and back up 300 meters. Follow my orders, I have two people here; killing one is no big deal!"
A man’s voice came from the store, the suspect was speaking up.
Loli took the megaphone and said, "Suspect inside, I’m Officer Luo in charge here. I hope you don’t harm the hostages!"
The man chuckled, "So it’s a female cop, do as I say obediently!"
Loli said, "No problem, you can come out now."
She was eager for him to come out because once he was out the door, the special forces could handle it, aiming and potentially shooting him.
The man sneered, "Don’t play tricks on me. If I see a gun when I come out, the little girl dies immediately!"
The officers looked to Loli, waiting for her decision.
Loli didn’t hesitate, "Do as he says!"
The officers threw their guns down and retreated, indeed moving back 300 meters.
Loli also backed away, calling out to the store, "Suspect inside, we’ve put down our guns and retreated as you demanded. You can come out now."
But there was silence inside, with no suspect appearing.
Loli frowned and said, "Suspect inside, we’ve done as you asked, you can come out now. Can you hear me?"
"Hmph!"
An angry grunt came from inside, "You think you can fool me, female cop? You all are up to something, don’t think you can trick me into coming out!"
Loli was sweating, "You’re overthinking it. We only want the hostages safe, really no other intentions. You can come out assured."
The man said, "I believe you, liar. You’re full of bad ideas, probably got bullets ready for me. As soon as I step out, I’ll be sniped. Don’t think I haven’t seen cop movies?"
The man’s anger grew, "Outrageous, you cops are too despicable. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t be in this situation. I was just selling some fake goods; why do you care!"
"You want to save the hostages, huh? I won’t let you succeed, I’ll kill a hostage first, this little girl it is!"
"Crying, huh, so annoying. Keep crying, and I’ll send you to King Yama right away."
Hearing that, the auntie kneeling on the ground was scared stiff.
Loli was anxious; this suspect was very agitated, likely hard to control. She urgently wanted to rush in and stop him.
But she couldn’t do that; the risk was too great.
Just then, suddenly, someone beside moved swiftly, like an arrow off the string, darting into the convenience store, doing exactly what Loli wanted to.
"What’s he doing?"
"What just happened, who rushed in?"
"Oh my!"
Everyone was shocked; Lin Fan rushing in at this time was bound to end badly for him.
Moreover, Lin Fan was unarmed, while the other had a knife; Lin Fan was no match, essentially putting his life on the line.
In contrast to others, Loli’s face showed surprise and delight.
Though the rush was quick, she recognized immediately that Lin Fan was the one who had darted into the store!
As Lin Fan rushed in, an angry man’s voice came from the store, "You actually dare to come in... ah!"
He had begun cursing Lin Fan when it suddenly turned into a scream of agony.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: The Mother-in-law Finally Got Into His Car
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Chapter 416: The Mother-in-law Finally Got Into His Car
This scene happened so fast that even the police were stunned. Just now, did someone rush inside?
The situation was this: the suspect was hiding in the convenience store, holding a little girl and the female clerk hostage. The police couldn’t just go in, and it wasn’t easy for the SWAT to aim. Loli’s idea was to lure the suspect out first.
But the suspect was very alert and unwilling to come out.
If the standoff continued, it would become increasingly unfavorable for the hostages.
Sure enough, the suspect decided to kill a hostage first.
The situation was extremely urgent, and the police were desperate to rush in, but they didn’t dare.
Because they couldn’t be sure, what if rushing in didn’t rescue the hostages and instead caused them harm? They couldn’t bear that responsibility.
At this critical moment, Lin Fan actually rushed in, completely unexpected by everyone.
The suspect cursed loudly upon seeing Lin Fan, but suddenly let out a scream.
Crunch!
Then, a chilling sound of bones breaking could be heard from inside.
Bam!
Suddenly, an adult flew out of the convenience store, breaking the door open, and landed in front of the police like a dead dog.
Everyone was stunned, watching him fall to the ground.
Loli reacted quickly, immediately drawing her gun and sternly shouting, "Don’t move!"
Her worry was unnecessary. The person couldn’t move at all; his hand was clearly broken. The bone had pierced the skin, seemingly snapped by someone.
Everyone was frightened pale. It was terrifying!
The suspect let out a miserable groan while writhing on the ground.
The police immediately handcuffed the suspect.
Just then, Lin Fan came out holding a little girl, followed by a pale-faced convenience store clerk.
The hostages were unharmed!
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. Lin Fan was amazing, rushing in and taking down the suspect in such a short time, not giving the suspect any chance to react! Successfully saving the hostages!
Especially the police, the professionals, they knew how difficult this was. For a moment, they looked at Lin Fan as if he were a deity. This young man was incredible, handling such a formidable person barehanded in the blink of an eye!
Simply miraculous!
Where did this amazing person come from?
Could he be a special forces soldier?
Even if he was a special forces soldier, he must be the top tier. This speed, these methods, ordinary special forces really couldn’t achieve it.
"Hey, isn’t this the Wei Family’s live-in son-in-law?"
"The delivery guy?"
"It’s him!"
The residents of the community recognized Lin Fan at this moment and started discussing in surprise.
What?
Live-in son-in-law, delivery guy?
The police were sweating coldly; such an amazing person turned out to be a delivery kid?
Lin Fan brought the little girl in front of Auntie, who was emotionally overwhelmed and fainted just now, but had now been resuscitated. Seeing the little girl safely rescued, she was overjoyed.
First thing, Auntie checked the little girl over. Finding her unharmed, she breathed a sigh of relief.
Immediately, Auntie knelt down before Lin Fan.
"Young man, thank you for saving my granddaughter, really thank you. Juan’er, thank your brother quickly," Auntie said gratefully.
The little girl said, "Thank you, brother."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to thank me, brother was just passing by, it was just a small lift."
The police were drenched in sweat; just a small lift, really thought anyone could do it, too casual, how could this leave them any face!
"Sister Fang, what happened?"
At this moment, a voice spoke. It was Li Xueyan holding a basket of groceries, coming over with a surprised look.
This Auntie is Sister Fang, quite familiar with Li Xueyan. On Lin Fan’s first day moving to Yujing District, he encountered Li Xueyan chatting with a neighbor Auntie, who was Sister Fang.
At that time, Li Xueyan disliked Lin Fan, thinking she was losing face in front of Sister Fang, and fled in panic. These days, Li Xueyan went out low-key, afraid of being recognized by neighbors, because their Wei Family had recruited a delivery boy as a live-in son-in-law, bringing shame upon them, the whole district was laughing at them.
Today, Li Xueyan went out to buy groceries like usual, low-key, and just happened to buy groceries and return, discovering a situation here, cared little about losing face and ran over to check on Sister Fang.
Sister Fang held Li Xueyan’s hand with gratitude, "Sister Yan, Juan’er was kidnapped by a criminal just now, thanks to your son-in-law who bravely saved her. Your son-in-law is so good and really impressive, you’re lucky to have such a good son-in-law."
The community’s residents also praised without ceasing.
"Such a good young man!"
"If only my son-in-law was this impressive."
"Really envy Sister Yan, Sister Yan has great vision, finding such a good son-in-law!"
Everyone gave a thumbs-up to Lin Fan.
Li Xueyan was stunned, did she hear correctly? Everyone was praising, praising until she felt a bit elated. Lin Fan should be the shame of their Wei Family, how did he seem to become a pride?
"Mother-in-law, what a coincidence, let me do it."
Lin Fan chuckled, taking the basket from Li Xueyan’s hand and hanging it on the bike handles.
"Officer, if there’s nothing else, I’ll go home and cook first."
Lin Fan said to the police nearby, then got on his electric bike, and said, "Mother-in-law, it’s a bit far from home, shall I give you a lift?"
Everyone seeing this, again gave a thumbs-up, "This young man, truly filial!"
"Truly a good young man!"
"Capable, brave, and filial, where can you find such a son-in-law, I want one too!"
"Being a delivery boy shows his reliability, such a person, trustworthy!"
Hearing neighbors say this, Li Xueyan couldn’t refuse Lin Fan’s offer. If she declined, wouldn’t it make her seem ungrateful, refusing such a good son-in-law, the neighbors would criticize her.
Before, she thought it shameful to ride Lin Fan’s electric bike, definitely wouldn’t ride it. When Lin Fan first came, he’d suggested she ride it, she ran away scared. But now, riding Lin Fan’s beaten-up electric bike made her feel a bit proud, like she was shining!
She didn’t say much, just sat on the bike’s back seat.
Lin Fan quickly started the bike, leaving the scene.
He had to leave quickly; Loli was still on the scene. He didn’t want to explain so much to Loli.
Earlier, Loli was busy handling the suspect. Now that the suspect had been taken away by the police car, Loli found time to come and see Lin Fan.
She saw Lin Fan already far away, leaving only his silhouette.
Loli shook her head, her idol didn’t even greet her before leaving. Perhaps he was in a hurry to deliver goods, oh well, she’ll talk to him next time.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan carried Li Xueyan, back home.
Lin Fan parked his bike downstairs, carrying the basket, and headed upstairs with Li Xueyan.
At this moment, Wei Qingxue just returned driving a Porsche, saw this scene, and was stunned, thinking she was seeing things.
Didn’t see wrongly!
Her mother actually returned home on Lin Fan’s electric bike?
Wasn’t her mother always very much against Lin Fan, did the sun rise from the west today?

chapters.title: Chapter 417: Let him go to the company to help
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 417: Let him go to the company to help
Wei Qingxue almost thought she was seeing things, couldn’t help but rub her eyes, but it was clearly not an illusion!
Wei Qingxue hurriedly parked the car and ran home, wanting to know what was going on.
