As soon as she entered the house, she saw Li Xueyan sitting on the sofa watching TV, Lin Fan busying around in the kitchen; the scene was surprisingly harmonious.
Wei Qingxue sat down next to Li Xueyan, reached out to feel her forehead, and murmured, "No fever?"
Li Xueyan responded with disdain, "What are you doing, child, acting all weird."
Wei Qingxue broke into a sweat, saying, "Mom, you’re the strange one! I just saw you on Lin Fan’s e-bike. What’s going on? Don’t scare me!"
Li Xueyan said, "He’s my son-in-law, what’s strange about me taking a ride on his bike?"
Wei Qingxue was startled, "Oh no, something must be wrong, you actually called him your son-in-law!"
Li Xueyan felt her daughter was mocking her and snapped, "Alright, don’t disturb my TV time. If you’re free, go help out in the kitchen."
Wei Qingxue then went to the kitchen.
"Welcome back, my dear wife," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Wei Qingxue moved closer to Lin Fan and asked seriously, "Lin Fan, what’s happening? Why did my mom take your bike today?"
"Probably because the neighbors praised her," Lin Fan explained and recounted the convenience store rescue incident.
Wei Qingxue suddenly realized, finally understanding, but couldn’t help feeling a bit disappointed; she thought her mom’s attitude toward Lin Fan had changed, and that’s why she rode his bike. Turns out it was just to save face in front of the neighbors.
Wei Qingxue sighed inwardly, feeling inexplicably disappointed. Why should she care? Lin Fan and she were only pretending to be married; they’d eventually divorce. Her mom’s attitude towards Lin Fan shouldn’t bother her.
Yet, she seemed to care somewhat...
That evening, the family gathered for dinner.
Usually, the dining atmosphere was a bit tense because Li Xueyan didn’t like Lin Fan, would often remain silent, and give Lin Fan the cold shoulder.
But today, Li Xueyan seemed relaxed and proactively asked about Wei Qingxue’s company matters.
Wei Qingxue had resolved the company’s financial problems and had resumed her position as president.
"Qingxue, are there any vacant positions in the company?" Li Xueyan asked.
Wei Qingxue didn’t know why she was asking, so she casually replied, "Well, my assistant just resigned today, so that’s vacant. I was just planning to hire someone."
Li Xueyan was delighted and said, "I don’t think you need to hire anyone. Lin Fan, why don’t you stop being a delivery man and help out at the company instead."
What?
Lin Fan, Wei Qingxue, and Wei Dazong were all stunned; had Li Xueyan taken the wrong medication today, caring this much about Lin Fan?
Li Xueyan was most dissatisfied with Lin Fan’s occupation; being a delivery man was simply too disgraceful, not presentable at all, making her lose face among her neighbors.
That had been the main reason for her dislike of Lin Fan.
If Lin Fan could find a more respectable job, coupled with his actions of saving someone today, Li Xueyan might accept him.
"Mom, Lin Fan isn’t necessarily suited for work at the company. Besides, he’s doing well as a delivery man; we can’t just switch his job," Wei Qingxue said.
She thought her mom had accepted Lin Fan, but apparently, she still found him shameful and was troubling him, so she naturally had to speak up for Lin Fan.
Li Xueyan said, "Don’t say anything. Whether or not to change jobs, is his decision! Lin Fan, are you willing to help at the company?"
Everyone turned to Lin Fan, waiting for his answer.
Lin Fan said, "I don’t mind. If my dear wife needs me, I’ll go."
Li Xueyan was pleased: "Alright then, resign and start work tomorrow, it’s decided."
Lin Fan smiled, "Not a problem."
Wei Qingxue and Wei Dazong exchanged a glance, not knowing what to say.
Later that night in the room.
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, you don’t need to accommodate mom. If you’re not willing to give up your delivery job, just keep doing it, I’ll explain things to mom."
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay, since mother-in-law doesn’t want me to be a delivery man, I’ll stop for now."
"Alright," Wei Qingxue agreed reluctantly.
Early the next morning, Lin Fan got up and went with Wei Qingxue to Wei Corporation, officially starting his white-collar job.
As Lin Fan entered the company, he attracted everyone’s attention.
"Isn’t he the president’s husband, what’s he doing here?" Everyone started whispering.
"I heard he’s a live-in son-in-law."
"Suspect he got into the company through nepotism."
"Drop the ’suspect,’ he definitely did!"
The company employees whispered among themselves.
Wei Qingxue said, "Let me introduce, Lin Fan, my new assistant. Many of you know, he’s also my husband, so I hope you treat him just like any other colleague, and get along well."
Everyone agreed hesitantly.
"Lin Fan is part of the president’s office, Sister He, you’ll be responsible for guiding him," Wei Qingxue turned to Lin Fan, "Sister He is the head of the president’s office, you’ll be working with her."
Lin Fan nodded.
Then a woman, nearly thirty, wearing glasses, approached Lin Fan, extended her hand with a smile, "I’m He Yu, everyone calls me Sister He, Mr. Lin, pleased to meet you."
Seeing her friendly attitude, Lin Fan shook her hand politely and said, "Hello, Sister He."
"Alright, everyone, let’s start working." With that, Wei Qingxue went back to her office.
As soon as Wei Qingxue left, everyone started gossiping again, laughter echoing around.
"The president’s live-in son-in-law, why is he dressed so poorly, didn’t the president give him money for clothes?"
"He’s definitely living off a woman, even this job he got through nepotism, embarrassing to be his wife’s assistant."
"No wonder people call him a useless person, disgracing fellow men..." He Yu scoffed openly, shooting a disdainful look at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was a bit speechless. Even if others ignored it, He Yu had been quite nice in front of Wei Qingxue, yet turned around and changed her attitude.
"Sister He, where should I sit?" Lin Fan pretended not to hear everyone’s harsh remarks and asked with a smile.
He Yu pointed without enthusiasm, "Over there in the corner for now."
"Thank you," Lin Fan walked over, sat down; apart from a computer, the desk was empty, and He Yu ignored him, so he didn’t know what to do, just sat there idle.
After gossiping for a while, everyone went back to work, leaving Lin Fan alone.
Lin Fan sat idly for over an hour.
"Lin Fan, go get a cup of coffee," He Yu suddenly came over and dropped a word.
"Okay," Lin Fan replied.
He thought it was for Wei Qingxue and went to make a cup of coffee, ready to deliver it to Wei Qingxue’s office.
"Stop!" He Yu interrupted him, "What are you doing?"
Lin Fan said, "Isn’t it for the president?"
"Who said it’s for the president, it’s for me," He Yu said coldly, snatching the coffee.
Everyone laughed at Lin Fan, "This guy isn’t very sharp."
Holding the coffee, He Yu didn’t drink it, but directly smashed the cup on the ground, breaking it with a splash.
"Ah!" He Yu deliberately exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 418: The Scheming of Office Colleagues
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Chapter 418: The Scheming of Office Colleagues
Looking at He Yu’s actions, Lin Fan had a puzzled face, what was this woman trying to pull?
"What’s going on?" Wei Qingxue came out of the office, frowning.
He Yu said apologetically, "I asked Mr. Lin to make a cup of coffee for the president, he probably didn’t hold it steady, and it fell to the ground. It’s all my fault, I shouldn’t have asked him to do this."
Huh?
Lin Fan thought he misheard; this blatant framing by He Yu.
At this time, Wei Zihan came in from outside, saw the mess on the floor, and scolded, "Lin Fan, what’s wrong with you, can’t even hold a cup of coffee, what are you staring at, clean it up, useless thing!"
Wei Qingxue was a bit speechless, "It’s nothing, just clean it up."
Wei Zihan sneered, "President, you can’t just protect him because he’s your husband, look how expensive the carpet is, now it’s dirty, he should compensate for it!"
"..." Wei Qingxue was at a loss for words; she couldn’t appear to overly protect Lin Fan, as this would lower her prestige in the Company.
Lin Fan chuckled, "The coffee wasn’t knocked over by me; it was deliberately spilled by He Yu."
"What did you say?" He Yu’s face changed immediately, angrily saying, "Mr. Lin, you make a mistake yourself, how can you falsely accuse others? Mr. Lin knocked over the cup, everyone saw it, right?"
People around all echoed, "It was Mr. Lin who knocked it over."
These people were clearly in cahoots, and Lin Fan couldn’t defend himself.
Wei Zihan said, "Lin Fan made a mistake and tried to smear others, it seems you want to be fired on your first day at work, Mr. President, it’s up to you."
Everyone pointed the finger at Lin Fan, which made it hard for Wei Qingxue to protect him even if she wanted to.
"Lin Fan, apologize to Sister He and then clean up the floor," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan sweated; He Yu and others ganged up on him, he had no evidence, and Wei Qingxue couldn’t easily side with him, so Lin Fan decided to swallow his anger for now.
"Sister He, I’m sorry," Lin Fan said to He Yu.
He Yu originally wanted to make a bigger deal out of it but didn’t expect him to apologize so easily. In front of Wei Qingxue, she couldn’t continue to make a fuss, so she pretended to be magnanimous, "It’s okay, as long as Mr. Lin admits his mistake."
"Sister He is so generous. If it were me, I would have fired you! Really can’t bear to look! Quickly clean it up for me!" Wei Zihan shot Lin Fan a nasty look and walked away.
Wei Qingxue couldn’t say anything and went back to the office.
Lin Fan silently took a broom and started cleaning.
"He offended Sister He, serves him right."
"Isn’t it true, originally Sister He wanted to introduce her cousin to be the assistant, but he used nepotism to take it away."
Hearing someone whispering beside him, they thought Lin Fan couldn’t hear, but with Lin Fan’s hearing, he still caught it.
So He Yu was messing with him because of this, Lin Fan’s heart sank. If he didn’t handle He Yu, he might not have good days at the Company in the future.
Lin Fan wasn’t facing office struggles for the first time; before, when he worked at Blue Moon, he was schemed by colleagues and lost his job, forcing him to become a delivery driver.
Of course, back then, Lin Fan was powerless after being schemed and could only endure it bitterly.
But now, Lin Fan was no longer the same as before... How could he let people bully him for nothing?
The son-in-law of the president, knocked over coffee on his first day at work due to clumsiness, this news quickly spread throughout the Company.
Lin Fan became a joke.
The most talked about was how Lin Fan got into the Company through nepotism, with no usefulness, just a ghost payroll.
The president should never have brought Lin Fan in, he should be fired.
Wei Zihan became the main force of this mockery, wishing for a chance to tarnish Wei Qingxue, with Lin Fan being the tool.
"Our president brought a useless person into the Company, leading the way in nepotism, this is damaging the Company’s reputation!" Wei Zihan spread such remarks, trying to cause dissent against Wei Qingxue.
It must be said, Wei Zihan was quite successful, as many in the Company started having complaints about Wei Qingxue.
Lin Fan sat in the office, with nothing to do, colleagues ignored him. When they saw him, they either had an ambiguous look, openly despised him, or snickered.
Anyway, they all saw Lin Fan as a joke.
Lin Fan was bored, and He Yu came over, loudly saying, "Mr. Lin, the president wants to see you."
Lin Fan responded with an "oh," stood up, and went into Wei Qingxue’s office.
Colleagues immediately started discussing.
"Sister He, what does the president want with this worthless person?"
"Could it be that he’s being fired?"
"After all, his arrival has caused dissatisfaction among many."
"Laughable, fired on his first day."
He Yu laughed smugly, "Think he can compete with me, he’s still too green. I can tell just by looking at him that he’s not smart, no match for me to play with."
"Sister He, you’re amazing!" the crowd praised.
He Yu, the director of the president’s office, had quite the prestige among colleagues, while Lin Fan was a useless son-in-law, so everyone decisively sided with He Yu.
Lin Fan entered the office, and Wei Qingxue’s face didn’t look good.
"Lin Fan, it’s your first day at work, do you know what the Company’s colleagues are saying?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Lin Fan chuckled, "I know a little, but I didn’t take it to heart."
Wei Qingxue said, "You may not care, but I can’t. Maybe having you work here was a mistake."
Lin Fan replied, "Do you mean to fire me?"
Wei Qingxue said, "That Wei Zihan is spreading rumors in the Company, now everyone is gossiping that I engaged in nepotism, given your lack of ability to do the current job properly, you can’t even hold a cup of coffee steady. Do you have a better solution?"
Lin Fan said, "That cup of coffee, it really wasn’t me who spilled it; it was He Yu who deliberately knocked it over, wanting to frame me. Everyone else is siding with He Yu, so no one speaks for me, all agreeing with He Yu."
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Are you telling the truth?"
Lin Fan said, "Absolutely, I have no reason to lie to you."
Wei Qingxue said, "Do you have evidence to prove it?"
Lin Fan said, "I really don’t, I didn’t expect to be plotted against as soon as I started working, believe it or not."
Wei Qingxue was silent for a moment; knowing Lin Fan, he had no reason to lie over such a trivial matter.
"I believe you, but what use is that, no one else in the company believes it," Wei Qingxue said helplessly.
Lin Fan smiled, "I know the pressure you face as the president is great. How about you give me some time, I will handle this matter, and if I can’t solve it, then you can dismiss me."
Wei Qingxue nodded, "Okay."
Lin Fan said, "It’s almost time to leave, shall we go home together?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I can’t leave yet, there’s a meeting with the Company’s management, you go home first. By the way, Mom left a message for you to go home early and make soup."

chapters.title: Chapter 419: Was Wei Zihan Kidnapped?
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Chapter 419: Was Wei Zihan Kidnapped?
Lin Fan said, "Alright then, I’ll be going first."
Lin Fan left the office, returned to his desk, quickly packed up, and left early.
Everyone was delighted when they saw Lin Fan leave.
"He really got fired by the president!"
He Yu was quite proud and sneered coldly, "This position is mine, driving away such an idiot is no big deal."
But at that moment, Wei Qingxue opened the door and peeked out from the office, "Sister He, I have a meeting later, could you help prepare the documents? Also, Lin Fan is coming to work tomorrow, please assign him some tasks so he’s not idle."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan is coming to work tomorrow?
That means the president didn’t fire Lin Fan at all, they all misunderstood!
It was a blatant slap in the face, and He Yu’s face immediately darkened, angry and twisted, "How unreasonable, I can’t believe I can’t get rid of this guy!"
Meanwhile, Lin Fan had left the company early and was downstairs, planning to hail a taxi home.
Suddenly, Lin Fan heard arguing nearby and looked curiously.
He saw a woman being gagged by a strong man and forcibly dragged into a sedan, while a young man stood by, watching and sneering, before also getting into the car.
Lin Fan was surprised, that woman was actually Wei Zihan.
And the young man beside her was her boyfriend Zhu Xiaolong!
What was going on?
Wei Zihan was kidnapped by her own boyfriend?
The sedan was about to drive away.
Because the location was relatively secluded and things happened quickly, it didn’t attract attention, only Lin Fan saw it.
Lin Fan hesitated a bit, Wei Zihan was really annoying, he didn’t want to get involved in her affairs. If Zhu Xiaolong harmed her, he might even say she deserves it.
But Lin Fan ultimately decided to see what was going on, and just then a taxi came by, so Lin Fan got in and told the driver to follow the sedan ahead.
Lin Fan couldn’t just stand by and watch without acting; if he hadn’t seen it, there’d be nothing to say, but since he did, if something really happened to Wei Zihan, he’d have some regrets.
Even though Wei Zihan was indeed very unpleasant and rude.
But Lin Fan didn’t want to use this method to make Wei Zihan pay; he would have his own way of slapping back at her.
Compared to Wei Zihan, Zhu Xiaolong was clearly more disgusting, doing such a thing to his own girlfriend.
Zhu Xiaolong’s sedan continued to wind its way through the streets, finally arriving at a secluded little motel.
This motel didn’t even have a sign, only a board at the entrance indicating that rooms were available.
The sedan finally stopped.
The car door opened, and Zhu Xiaolong helped Wei Zihan out. The strong man who had subdued Wei Zihan also got out, and the two of them ushered Wei Zihan into the motel.
At this point, Wei Zihan’s head was drooping as if she were drunk, with her face flushed red from afar.
Lin Fan also had the taxi stop, and after getting out, he followed them into the motel.
Inside one of the motel rooms.
Zhu Xiaolong and the strong man entered the room with Wei Zihan, reached the bed, and threw Wei Zihan onto it.
Wei Zihan lay on the bed without any response.
Zhu Xiaolong looked at her, an evil smile on his face, "You damn bitch, daring to talk about breaking up without my permission. Let me show you how I’ll deal with you!"
It turned out Wei Zihan and Zhu Xiaolong were recently in the midst of a breakup!
The cause was that night at the charity gala, Zhu Xiaolong wouldn’t spend money to help Wei Zihan make a donation, which cost Wei Zihan all her face. Coincidentally, that night Wei Qingxue donated a million, making the Wei Family’s young lady even more embarrassed by comparison.
Wei Zihan was furious, and after that, she had a big fight with Zhu Xiaolong and proposed to break up.
Zhu Xiaolong refused to break up, and during their fierce argument, in a moment of desperation, Zhu Xiaolong even slapped Wei Zihan.
That’s why, that day at the Wei Family Mansion, when Wei Qingxue and Lin Fan saw Wei Zihan, her lips were aching from the bruise Zhu Xiaolong had given her.
Wei Zihan never told anyone in her family about this, it was too embarrassing, she didn’t dare say.
Previously, when Wei Zihan found Zhu Xiaolong as her boyfriend, the whole family envied it. If the breakup were to become known, it would be a loss of face, Wei Zihan was just a person obsessed with saving face.
Wei Zihan initiated the breakup with Zhu Xiaolong, but he disagreed, the two had a huge conflict, Wei Zihan claimed she’d never see Zhu Xiaolong again, regardless of whether he agreed, she’d no longer be his girlfriend.
Zhu Xiaolong, filled with anger, seized the opportunity to capture Wei Zihan today.
"This damn bitch wants to break up with me, I will make sure she’ll never escape from me. Get the camera ready, let’s capture our wonderful moment," Zhu Xiaolong sneered, exuding wicked intents.
The strong man agreed, bringing out a camera, positioning it, and preparing for the shoot.
Zhu Xiaolong stood by the bed, looking down on Wei Zihan with a sinister smile, "Damn bitch, having dated me for so long but only let me hold her hand, never letting me touch. Really think she’s some pure-hearted young lady, just one small bitch. Isn’t she drawn to my Zhu Family’s money, wanting to be with me, and not allowing me to do anything! Today, I insist, you have no choice!"
At this moment, Wei Zihan unexpectedly regained consciousness briefly.
"My head’s so dizzy, where am I? Zhu Xiaolong, what are you trying to do?" Wei Zihan said in alarm.
Zhu Xiaolong was undressing and smirked, "Isn’t it obvious enough?"
Wei Zihan was both angry and anxious, "Don’t come over, I won’t let you succeed, we’re already over!"
Zhu Xiaolong said, "Break up? I haven’t agreed to break up!"
Wei Zihan pleaded, "Please don’t come over, we’re impossible, I’ve found someone new!"
Zhu Xiaolong’s expression darkened, "Someone new? Damn bitch, do you really think others fancy you? You’re so delusional. Stop dreaming, you are mine! Today, not only will you be my woman, but I’ll record it, and if you dare not comply in the future, I’ll post the video online for everyone to see."
Wei Zihan was terrified, trying to escape, but her whole body was weak, "What did you make me eat?"
Zhu Xiaolong sneered, "Of course it’s something good, don’t worry, soon you’ll be begging for me, hahaha..."
Zhu Xiaolong laughed brazenly, like a cat playing with a mouse, looking down at the struggling prey beneath him, filled with a sense of conquest.
Wei Zihan’s face was getting redder, consciousness again slowly fading, mumbling, "Hot... I’m so hot... What’s going on... Hot..."
Zhu Xiaolong’s eyes gleamed as he rubbed his hands with excitement, "Finally working, don’t worry, I’m coming!"
He had already stripped off his shirt and pants, leaving only boxers, grinning sinisterly as he prepared to climb on the bed.
Bam!
At this moment, the room door was suddenly kicked open from the outside, and Lin Fan stepped in decisively.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: It Seems This Is the Only Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Chapter 420: It Seems This Is the Only Way
Wei Zihan lay on the bed, lost in confusion, muttering about the heat as she tugged at her clothes, soon becoming disheveled.
Zhu Xiaolong witnessed this and revealed a smug, wicked smile.
"Don’t rush, little bitch, I’m here to satisfy you soon."
This scene was precisely Zhu Xiaolong’s scheme.
Wei Zihan had unilaterally proposed to break up with him, and he disagreed. As the scion of the Zhu Family, how could he be dumped by a woman? If this news spread in his circle, he would be a laughingstock.
Thus, he couldn’t swallow this insult, so today he plotted the kidnapping of Wei Zihan.
After capturing Wei Zihan and bringing her to the car, Zhu Xiaolong forced her to drink a pre-prepared beverage.
This drink was laced with special drugs...
After Wei Zihan was taken to this small motel, the drug took effect, and by now Wei Zihan had lost her awareness, not only would she not resist him, but she would also be very proactive.
This was exactly what Zhu Xiaolong wanted to see. To later blackmail Wei Zihan, he even had his men record the whole process.
Just as Zhu Xiaolong stripped down to only his underwear, ready to climb onto the bed, suddenly, with a bang, the door was kicked open from the outside.
Lin Fan strode in.
Seeing Lin Fan suddenly, Zhu Xiaolong was shocked. How did Lin Fan manage to find this place?
Zhu Xiaolong shouted in anger, "Seize him for me!"
The burly man lunged at Lin Fan, trying to subdue him. However, before he could reach Lin Fan, Lin Fan kicked him in the vital spot, immediately causing the burly man to grimace in pain, clutch and fall to the ground with a thud.
He was so grievously injured that he feared he might become a eunuch.
Lin Fan knocked down the bodyguard with one kick and didn’t spare another glance, directly getting in front of Zhu Xiaolong.
"Lin Fan, you worthless loser, what do you think you’re doin—"
As Zhu Xiaolong was about to insult Lin Fan, Lin Fan interrupted with a punch.
His fist hit Zhu Xiaolong’s face directly, bending his nose. Zhu Xiaolong fell to the ground, seeing stars as the room spun; the pain in his nose was excruciating, surely he thought his nasal bone was fractured.
From the moment Lin Fan entered until he subdued the two men, it was just a matter of seconds, giving them no chance to fight back—a complete takedown!
This was hardly a challenge for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan then walked to the bedside and bent down to check Wei Zihan.
Wei Zihan’s face was flushed, her body writhing, hands constantly tearing at her clothes, muttering, "So hot."
Lin Fan glanced at Zhu Xiaolong, "Damn, could it be..."
Zhu Xiaolong, knocked down with a punch, was already resigned. There was no way he could be a match for Lin Fan.
So, he simply let go.
"Hahaha... That’s right, I gave her that kind of drug. Now she needs a man," Zhu Xiaolong laughed.
Lin Fan’s face darkened at Zhu Xiaolong’s vile means, saying, "Where’s the antidote?"
Zhu Xiaolong sneered, "Antidote? What antidote? I don’t have one. I only know, if you want to save her, there’s only one way, and that’s with her..."
Lin Fan broke into a cold sweat, watching the snake-like writhing Wei Zihan: "No way!"
He acknowledged that objectively speaking Wei Zihan was quite beautiful, with a great figure. In her current state, she was very tempting; few men in the world could resist.
Moreover, he was saving a life...
"Lin Fan, if you don’t save her, she might not bear the drug’s effects, at best internal injuries, at worst death. You weigh it yourself!" Zhu Xiaolong said.
"But you’re Wei Qingxue’s husband, and she’s Wei Qingxue’s sister. Do you dare to do this!"
"Wonderful, truly wonderful, Lin Fan, this is the consequence of meddling in others’ affairs. Originally, it had nothing to do with you, yet you insisted on ruining my good deed!"
Zhu Xiaolong chuckled.
"Annoying!"
Lin Fan slapped Zhu Xiaolong, knocking him unconscious on the spot, his head lolling as he lost consciousness.
At this moment, even the burly man, unable to bear the pain, fainted directly.
"Hot, so hot... Lin Fan, it’s you, quick, help me." Wei Zihan twisted frantically on the bed. In her disoriented state, she opened her eyes, looking at Lin Fan with endless yearning.
Lin Fan sighed, muttering, "Seems there’s no other choice, only this way left..."
He spoke as he leaned down...
Wei Zihan had a dream. She dreamed that she got married, and her partner was someone she was very satisfied with: young, wealthy, a truly perfect match.
They held a grand wedding; the Wei Family’s relatives and friends came to congratulate them, filling the space.
At the wedding, with her father, Wei Dagang, supporting her, she walked across the red carpet towards the groom, who stood on stage with his back to her.
His silhouette was so imposing, his stance upright, providing a sense of complete security. She finally reached him.
Then, the groom turned around, giving her a slight smile.
Suddenly, she saw the groom’s face, and to her shock, it was Lin Fan’s face.
She had actually married Lin Fan, a deliveryman?
This was truly terrifying.
"Ah!"
Wei Zihan gasped, sitting up abruptly from the bed, breaking out in a cold sweat.
"My God, thank goodness it was just a dream. Damn, who would want to marry a dead broke guy like Lin Fan, it was terrifying, the scariest dream of my life." Wei Zihan’s face showed both relief and lingering fear.
Suddenly, recalling something, her face turned pale at once.
She remembered being kidnapped by Zhu Xiaolong, then, in a daze, learned she was drugged by Zhu Xiaolong. Her whole body was feverish, uncontrollable, Zhu Xiaolong undressing, then Zhu Xiaolong being knocked out by the intruding Lin Fan...
Her last memory was of Lin Fan leaning down towards her...
Could it be that she and Lin Fan had already had that kind of relationship?
Oh God!
This shock was beyond measure!
At this moment, Lin Fan walked in from outside. Seeing Wei Zihan awake, he said, "You are finally awake."
Wei Zihan burst into tears, cursing, "Lin Fan, you dead delivery boy, how dare you do that to me, you beast! I won’t let you go, I’m going to call the police to catch you and throw you in jail!"
Hearing this, Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh? Are you really going to do that?"
Wei Zihan said, "You think I’m joking with you, you beast, scum, disgrace, filthy lecher!"
Lin Fan said, "Alright, you want to call the police, right? The police are outside, I’ll call them in."
Wei Zihan was stunned, what?
Sure enough, two policemen walked in.
"Miss Wei Zihan, it’s good that you’re awake, you’re not in too bad a condition, right? We actually came to take your statement," one policeman said.
Wei Zihan was confused, "What’s going on, I... he..."
The policeman said, "You’ve been drugged. Luckily you were saved by Mr. Lin here, he brought you to the hospital. Don’t you remember?"
Hospital!
Wei Zihan raised her head, realizing she was indeed lying in a hospital ward!
Lin Fan actually brought her to the hospital, which meant...

chapters.title: Chapter 421: You’re right, I really look down on you
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Chapter 421: You’re right, I really look down on you
The atmosphere got a bit awkward.
Wei Zihan said, "Lin Fan, you took me to the hospital, you didn’t do anything to me..."
Didn’t Zhu Xiaolong say, after taking that kind of drug, only that kind of thing can cure it, otherwise she might suffocate to death!
Lin Fan replied irritably, "You’re overthinking. How could I do such a thing to you? I’m a married man. Of course, I took you to the hospital."
The police officer said, "Miss Wei, you can rest assured, we have already arranged for a doctor to do a check-up on you. You haven’t suffered any physical harm, and with the doctor’s efforts, the drug’s effect has already been neutralized."
"This Mr. Lin not only prevented you from being harmed but also brought you to the hospital in time, saving your life."
"Thanks to Mr. Lin’s report, those two criminals have also been captured by us."
Wei Zihan was dumbfounded. It took her a while to understand what had happened.
She was drugged by Zhu Xiaolong and taken to a motel. Just as Zhu Xiaolong was about to assault her, Lin Fan broke in and subdued him. At that time, the drug’s effect took over, and according to Zhu Xiaolong, only doing that kind of thing could save her; however, Lin Fan took her to the hospital instead...
Wei Zihan couldn’t help but say, "Lin Fan, why didn’t you do that kind of thing to me?"
As soon as she said that, the two police officers almost fainted on the spot.
Oh my! This woman actually wanted Mr. Lin to do that kind of thing to her!
Wei Zihan snorted, "You, a poor delivery guy, who do you think you’re looking down on!"
Lin Fan, facing such temptation, actually held back. Clearly, even if he did it, considering the emergency at that time, it would have been understandable.
But he still held back.
This made Wei Zihan very unhappy. Was it because her allure wasn’t enough? Of course not, she was so pretty, with such a good figure, what man wouldn’t like her!
Then there could only be one reason, Lin Fan was despising her!
As for why he despised her, the reason was probably because of Wei Qingxue, because he loved his wife!
Wei Qingxue, that little bitch, what right did she have to get such a loyal husband? It was really annoying!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re right, I do despise you, so I’d rather carry you to the hospital than have that kind of relationship with you!"
Wei Zihan was furious: "You, a poor delivery guy, what qualifications do you have to look down on me!"
Lin Fan shrugged and said, "Officer, you saw it, I saved her, yet she shows no gratitude and resorts to personal attacks on me."
One of the officers broke out in a cold sweat; this woman was truly peculiar! Shouldn’t she be grateful to the person who saved her?
Wei Zihan sneered and said, "Poor delivery guy, you being sensible this time is your saving grace. How could someone of your low status touch me? You’re only fit to be with someone like Wei Qingxue, that little bitch. I, on the other hand, will marry someone of higher status!"
Lin Fan made a sound of realization and teased, "You’re marrying someone of higher status, Zhu Xiaolong?"
Hearing Zhu Xiaolong’s name made Wei Zihan erupt in anger, "Don’t mention that bastard to me! I misjudged this time. That scoundrel is a total fraud. I heard the Zhu Family is about to go bankrupt, he doesn’t have any money at all, the vase he gave my grandpa is fake, the diamond ring he gave me is fake, he didn’t even want to help me with a donation!"
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "As far as I know, the Zhu Family’s business is doing quite well. Zhu Xiaolong isn’t short of money; he just doesn’t want to spend any on you."
Wei Zihan angrily said, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t you get it? Zhu Xiaolong just wanted to toy with you. How could he spend that kind of money on you? When you brought up breaking up, it offended his pride, which is why this whole scene happened today. Truly a pitiful woman. Who wouldn’t say it’s pathetic upon seeing this?"
Wei Zihan heard the sarcasm in Lin Fan’s words and was infuriated, yet she couldn’t refute them because Lin Fan was too right.
This time dating Zhu Xiaolong was really unfortunate; she got involved with a complete scumbag and made a fool of herself in front of this delivery guy, Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan, laugh all you want, you poor delivery guy, you’ll never understand the gap between you and me! This time I’ve fallen, but soon, I’ll slap you in the face!" Wei Zihan said coldly.
Lin Fan sounded a little curious, "What do you mean, how will you slap me in the face?"
Wei Zihan said, "If you still have a memory, you should remember, the Millionaire Lin from Yun City offered a million-dollar betrothal gift to our Wei Family. Looking at the Wei Family, who else would he marry but me?"
Pfft!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
He certainly remembered that million-dollar betrothal gift because he was the one who gave it.
He did it purely to toy with the Wei Family.
A million wasn’t real money to him anyway; he received a daily cash reward of 500 million, which was just equivalent to a two-day reward.
When one day the Wei Family discovers that the Yun City Millionaire they’ve been fawning over is the son-in-law they’ve always looked down upon, that expression will surely be priceless.
Wei Zihan was furious, "What are you laughing at!"
Lin Fan said, "Because you really don’t have a clue. I’m sure the Millionaire Lin isn’t interested in you!"
Wei Zihan went completely berserk, "What do you know! Get lost, you poor delivery guy, how dare you look down on me!"
Lin Fan didn’t hesitate at all, "Goodbye, I wasted my time saving you and even missed dinner, truly a waste."
Saying that, Lin Fan turned around and walked out.
Leaving the hospital, Lin Fan took a taxi back to the Yujing District.
Upon entering his home, the family of three was watching TV in the living room, having already had dinner.
"Lin Fan, where did you go?" Wei Qingxue asked curiously. "I asked you to come home early to make soup, but instead, you disappeared?"
When she got home tonight and found Lin Fan hadn’t returned, she called him. Lin Fan was busy dealing with the Wei Zihan situation and only said there was something urgent on the phone.
Li Xueyan said coldly, "Could he have gone to see another woman? If you dare wrong Qingxue, I’ll kick you out immediately!"
Lin Fan broke into a sweat and said, "What about if it was Wei Zihan?"
Li Xueyan was furious, "What? You went to see Wei Zihan? Why would you meet that little vixen?"
Wei Qingxue and Wei Dazong also became curious.
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, you skipped dinner to see Wei Zihan. What’s going on?"
Lin Fan said, "I’m a bit hungry, too weak to talk."
Wei Qingxue quickly stood up, "We saved some dinner for you, I’ll get you a bowl of soup."
Wei Qingxue’s curiosity was piqued, so she hurried to get Lin Fan some soup. Li Xueyan was also extremely curious—if it wasn’t for her pride, she would’ve rushed to serve Lin Fan food herself so he could eat and talk faster.
Lin Fan drank a bowl of delicious hot soup before leisurely beginning to speak, "Today after work, I was downstairs at the company..."
Lin Fan recounted, detail by detail, how he encountered Wei Zihan being kidnapped by Zhu Xiaolong, how he followed and rescued her.
The family of three listened in astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 422: This floor must be very hard to sleep on
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Chapter 422: This floor must be very hard to sleep on
Lin Fan mentioned the issue with Wei Zihan, and the family of three was stunned, not expecting such a thing to happen.
Li Xueyan curled her lips, "That girl deserves it, she’s bullied our Qingxue a lot, it’s karma! If you ask me, she shouldn’t be rescued!"
Wei Dazong shook his head, "You can’t say that, after all, she’s the eldest daughter of the Wei Family. If something really happened, where would the Wei Family’s reputation be? Father would probably get sick with anger. Little Fan did well, preserving the Wei Family’s dignity."
For a family, reputation is of utmost importance, so even if something scandalous happens, it’s covered up immediately. The incident where Wei Tang was kicked out of the Wei Family was handled discreetly. If nothing happens, it’s naturally the best outcome.
Viewing from this perspective, Wei Dazong highly appreciated Lin Fan’s actions.
That night, back in the room.
Wei Dazong said, "Ah-Yan, what do you think of Lin Fan? I feel this kid isn’t too bad!"
Li Xueyan snorted, "Not bad? Just a penniless guy!"
Wei Dazong smiled, "Stop being so stubborn. I can tell you’ve changed your opinion of him too, right? Otherwise, you wouldn’t have let Qingxue arrange for him to work at the Company."
Li Xueyan spat, "Let’s see if he can continue at the Company. A waste like him doesn’t deserve to be my son-in-law!"
Wei Dazong admired Lin Fan’s actions from the perspective of family reputation, but Wei Qingxue hadn’t thought about it like that. She was concerned that Lin Fan hadn’t taken advantage!
In such a situation, he had to do that with Wei Zihan to save her. Even if Lin Fan had actually done it, he wouldn’t be blamed.
But Lin Fan didn’t do it!
This touched Wei Qingxue deeply, and Lin Fan’s image in her mind instantly elevated significantly.
Lin Fan is not only good in a fight, but he’s also a good person, being with him feels reassuring!
For a moment, Wei Qingxue’s heart fluttered.
That night, as usual, Wei Qingxue slept on the bed, and Lin Fan slept on the floor.
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan lying on the floor with his back to her, bit her lip, and blushing, she summoned up great courage, "Lin Fan, the floor must be really hard to sleep on, how about..."
Lin Fan chuckled, "It’s alright, I’m used to it."
As soon as Lin Fan said this, he realized something seemed off. Why was Wei Qingxue concerned about the hardness of the floor? After all, she doesn’t sleep on it. Could she be hinting at something?
"Alright then..."
Wei Qingxue was a bit speechless.
Lin Fan is such a straightforward guy!
She couldn’t continue the conversation.
If it were a seasoned player, they wouldn’t have answered like that, but rather complain about how hard and uncomfortable the floor is.
Then Wei Qingxue could suggest, "Why don’t you come up to the bed, I’ll share half of it with you."
Sigh, a wasted hint.
But Wei Qingxue wasn’t disappointed, instead, she felt a little happy. It was clear that Lin Fan wasn’t a seasoned player in matters of love. It was better this way; she didn’t like those skilled playboys who weren’t reliable.
"It’s nothing, let’s sleep early, we have to work tomorrow, I need to sleep too," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan said, "Sure, speaking of work, my dear wife, from now on I’ll ride my bike to work, no need to take your car, to avoid others being jealous and gossiping about you."
Wei Qingxue thought for a bit, then said, "Alright."
Today, when she took Lin Fan to work for the first time, people at the Company were all talking about it, saying Lin Fan relied on nepotism and criticized her for using her position to favor relatives.
This left her quite helpless.
Lin Fan choosing to ride his bike to work was a good way to keep a low profile.
So the next day, Lin Fan rode his little electric scooter to work.
He left the house together with Wei Qingxue, but naturally, the old scooter wasn’t as fast as a Porsche, and he almost arrived late. By the time he reached the Company, Wei Qingxue had already returned to the Company and gone to a meeting.
In the office, colleagues were snickering.
"What? Did you see that right?"
"Didn’t see wrong, today Lin Fan came to work riding a shabby electric bike, just like those used for delivering food."
"No way, that’s hilarious! Are he and the CEO fighting?"
"He’s just a live-in son-in-law, must have fallen out of favor."
"Then can we bully him at will from now on."
As Lin Fan came in, everyone stopped talking and each showed knowing smiles.
Lin Fan felt a little speechless. Honestly, he really didn’t like this office atmosphere, which was why he would rather deliver food than work at the Company.
"Lin Fan, you’re late!"
He Yu came over and coldly said, "Even though you’re the CEO’s husband, you can’t be late!"
Lin Fan checked his phone and said, "I’m not late, it’s just on time."
He Yu’s face darkened, "I said you’re late, so you’re late. Your phone must be broken, what cheap phone is that, can’t afford a better one?"
Everyone snickered.
Lin Fan said, "Okay, you’re the supervisor, whatever you say, I’m late, and then?"
He Yu angrily said, "What kind of attitude is that? Don’t think just because you’re the CEO’s husband, I won’t dare to punish you. You probably don’t know, I’ve been at this Company longer than the CEO. In terms of seniority, even the CEO has to call me senior. Who do you think you are!"
Lin Fan said, "Oh."
He Yu sneered, tossing a document in front of Lin Fan, "Organize this document into a Word file, a client will need it soon. Almost forgot to ask, can you type?"
Everyone burst out laughing.
"Heard he used to be a delivery guy, bet his education level isn’t high!"
"Not knowing how to type wouldn’t be surprising, knowing how would be!"
"If he can’t type, how can he be an assistant?"
Lin Fan took the document and said blandly, "Yes, I can."
Then he returned to his seat and started working.
An hour later.
Lin Fan sent the completed document to He Yu.
Lin Fan felt a bit of an urgent need, so he went to the bathroom.
When he got back, he found that the document on his desk was gone. Lin Fan thought He Yu had taken it, so he didn’t pay much attention.
For a moment, he had nothing to do again. Lin Fan sat idly, thinking to himself, this job is quite easy, but also pretty boring.
Lin Fan was planning to stay on for a few days and then find an excuse to quit, no need to waste time here.
As the owner of a 200 billion corporation, he was actually quite busy. Even during his free time, he’d rather deliver packages to pass the time. Sitting in the office was too boring, and he had to face a bunch of opportunistic colleagues.
Lin Fan was just sitting there.
Suddenly, He Yu came over, holding a document, barging aggressively towards Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan, what’s wrong with you? I asked you to make a document, and it’s full of errors. If you can’t do such a simple task right, I suggest you quit!" He Yu scolded.
He Yu’s demeanor was practically accusing Lin Fan of a crime.
Just then, Wei Qingxue came back from her meeting, and seeing this, she asked, "Sister He, what’s going on?"

chapters.title: Chapter 423 Why Should I Apologize If I Am Not Wrong
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Chapter 423 Why Should I Apologize If I Am Not Wrong
He Yu threw the document in his hand in front of Lin Fan.
"Mr. Li will be here soon, and the President knows that President Li is a very important client to us, and also very picky. If the document has any errors, it will definitely upset him. But the document Mr. Lin just made is full of errors and omissions!" He Yu said.
Wei Qingxue said, "Is that so? Let me see."
He Yu said, "Yesterday, the President complained that I hadn’t assigned any work to Mr. Lin, so early this morning I arranged this task for him. But alas, Mr. Lin’s performance was so disappointing. Although Mr. Lin is the President’s husband, I’m just stating the facts, and I hope the President won’t mind."
Speaking, He Yu handed the document over to Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue glanced over the document and frowned. Clearly, this document was unsatisfactory.
"Lin Fan, did you make this document?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Lin Fan had already double-checked the document earlier and responded, "Yes, I made it."
This was indeed the document he made, not a single character off.
Wei Qingxue said, "Do you know you’ve made several mistakes? There are some critical numbers, and you’ve gotten them wrong!"
Wei Qingxue appreciated Lin Fan’s skills and personality, but this didn’t mean Lin Fan could make mistakes in such matters. She was always a strict President; wrong is wrong, and a mistake must be called out.
He Yu said, "I already said, if this document is handed over to Mr. Li, it will certainly leave a very unprofessional impression on him, and the collaboration with Mr. Li might be affected! President, in my opinion, Mr. Lin is not suited for this job, anyway I don’t know how to lead him!"
He Yu meant to kick Lin Fan out!
Everyone in the office began to discuss.
"Sister He is right, if you can’t do it, then don’t hog the toilet without taking a dump."
"Even if he’s the President’s husband, favoritism isn’t acceptable."
"If possible, it’s better to replace him!"
Wei Qingxue heard all these comments, and it invisibly added psychological pressure on her.
Lin Fan made mistakes, indicating he couldn’t handle the job, and colleagues had their opinions. If she continued to keep Lin Fan here, she’d be accused of nepotism, favoring her husband.
Wei Qingxue found it difficult to manage.
"President, what are you hesitating for? Are you going to protect him just because he’s your husband? If that’s the case, it’ll be hard for me to work in the future. Why not, President, you just fire me." He Yu said.
Wei Qingxue broke into a sweat and said, "Sister He, don’t be so heavy on words, it’s not that serious. Sister He, considering my position, can you give Lin Fan another chance? If he still doesn’t manage, I’ll let him leave then, what do you think? Lin Fan, you made a mistake, apologize to Sister He, and promise not to repeat it next time!"
He Yu glanced slyly at Lin Fan: "Since the President said so, should I not give face? Okay, let Mr. Lin make a promise, I won’t say much more, but next time if there’s another mistake, Mr. Lin should leave on his own!"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, waiting for him to apologize to He Yu—this scene couldn’t be missed, it’s practically a brilliant joke.
The President’s husband, in front of He Yu, was powerless to resist, being ridden on head pulling a metaphorical crap, to the point of questioning his life!
But Lin Fan shook his head lightly and said casually, "I didn’t do anything wrong, why should I apologize?"
What?
Everyone was stunned—Lin Fan actually said he made no mistake?
Unexpected! They thought Lin Fan would be humiliated, but unexpectedly this guy dared to talk back!
He Yu couldn’t wait for Lin Fan to retort her.
Originally, she intended to leverage this issue to pressure Wei Qingxue into firing Lin Fan.
But Wei Qingxue resisted the pressure and implored her to give Lin Fan another chance.
Though internally displeased, she couldn’t disrespect the President, so she had to go along with Wei Qingxue’s wishes and give Lin Fan another chance.
She could only catch Lin Fan in another mistake afterward to kick him out.
She’s already reserved the position of President for her cousin; Lin Fan, being here, was encroaching on her cousin’s place, and it was only a matter of time before she drove Lin Fan away.
If Lin Fan were smart, he would obediently apologize this time, and might stay in the position a while longer.
But now, Lin Fan chose to defy.
What an idiot! He Yu laughed inside.
"President, listen, what does Mr. Lin mean by saying this? The President clearly saw the document, there’s indeed an error, yet Mr. Lin dares to blatantly lie! President, how should such behavior of Mr. Lin be dealt with?" He Yu said, nearly on the verge of tears.
Everyone sided with He Yu, mocking Lin Fan.
Wei Qingxue broke into a sweat, she didn’t understand why Lin Fan wouldn’t admit to the mistake, when she had finally provided him an easy way out, yet Lin Fan simply kicked the step aside.
This made her quite embarrassed, could it really be forcing her to fire Lin Fan in public?
"Lin Fan, the data in this document is indeed wrong." Wei Qingxue said weakly.
If truly unavoidable, she’d have to dismiss Lin Fan.
Because of Lin Fan’s arrival, she had already lost prestige in the Company over the past two days.
Ring... Ring... Ring...
Just then, Wei Qingxue’s cell phone rang—it was Elder Wei calling.
Wei Qingxue hurried to answer: "Grandfather?"
Elder Wei said, "Qingxue, I heard you’ve arranged for Lin Fan to work in the Company? Lin Fan used to be a courier, can he handle Company’s work? If not, don’t force it. I’ve been receiving some negative feedback lately. Child, you can’t let him affect your position in the Company."
Wei Qingxue said, "I understand, Grandfather."
Elder Wei said, "I understand you appreciate Lin Fan, which is why you placed him in the Company. But if this affects you, impacts the Company, it should be corrected immediately—find an excuse to fire Lin Fan."
Wei Qingxue said, "Mm, I’ll handle it, Grandfather."
Elder Wei then hung up the phone.
The pressure from the Company folks was already substantial, and now Elder Wei added pressure, making it even more difficult for her.
"Lin Fan, I’ll give you another chance; admit your mistake and apologize to Sister He." Wei Qingxue said.
Everyone watched Lin Fan, displaying gloating expressions; if Lin Fan wasn’t a fool, he should know to comply by now.
But Lin Fan remained utterly calm, shaking his head: "I made no mistake, so I won’t apologize."
He Yu laughed angrily: "President, I think you don’t need to hesitate, it’s better to just fire him."
Wei Qingxue was also speechless, why couldn’t Lin Fan be flexible? So stubborn, forcing her to the brink.
Lin Fan said, "Haha, what’s the rush, I haven’t finished speaking. I said I made no mistake because the document I created was compiled exactly according to the data Sister He gave me, not a bit of difference. If the numbers are wrong, the fault lies with Sister He, for giving incorrect data."
What?
Lin Fan actually said it was Sister He’s mistake!
This makes things highly interesting.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Swapping the Beams and Pillars, Sister He’s Conspiracy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 424: Swapping the Beams and Pillars, Sister He’s Conspiracy!
Lin Fan actually said that He Yu gave the wrong information!
He Yu angrily said, "Mr. Lin, please don’t slander me. The information I gave you couldn’t possibly be wrong!"
Lin Fan and He Yu each insisted it was the other’s mistake.
Wei Qingxue said, "This is simple, Lin Fan. Bring me the information Sister He gave you, and we’ll find out who’s at fault."
He Yu said, "The CEO is right. Mr. Lin, bring the information here."
Lin Fan said, "The information is missing."
"What, missing?" Wei Qingxue asked in surprise.
Lin Fan said, "I just went to the restroom, and when I came back, it was gone. I think Sister He took it back."
He Yu said, "I didn’t take it! Mr. Lin, do you have any evidence?"
Wei Qingxue glanced at everyone and said, "Did anyone see who took the information?"
Everyone shook their heads, saying they hadn’t seen.
He Yu felt triumphant, "No one saw it, Mr. Lin. Where did you take that information? Could it be that you hid it yourself?"
Lin Fan was sweating. The information truly went missing after he came back from the restroom. Someone must have taken it, but everyone said they didn’t see anyone take it. This could only mean this group was colluding to frame him.
He Yu said, "CEO, Mr. Lin made a mistake but refuses to admit it. Instead, he bites back, hiding the information to leave nothing to prove his wrong. I’m really wronged; please stand up for me, CEO."
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, what’s going on? Nobody saw anyone take the information. Is it still with you? If so, take it out quickly!"
He Yu said, "I’m sure that the information is with Mr. Lin. He must have hidden it. Let’s search and find out!"
With that, He Yu went to Lin Fan’s desk and began searching. Sure enough, she found a document in the bottom drawer.
"Found it, it was right here!"
He Yu said happily, handing the information to Wei Qingxue, "CEO, please take a look."
Wei Qingxue took the information, looked through it, and said, "The data on this information is correct, Lin Fan, do you have anything to say?"
He Yu sneered, "What else is there to say? Mr. Lin was just slandering me trying to shift the blame. Mr. Lin, you’re really vicious!"
Everyone looked shocked.
"I really didn’t expect him to be so treacherous!"
"A person like this shouldn’t stay in the company, scary!"
"So shameless, doing wrong and blaming others, get out of the company!"
It seemed Lin Fan had provoked public anger.
He Yu’s eyes were red, "CEO, although Mr. Lin is your husband, I hope you can handle this impartially and give me justice. If someone like Mr. Lin can stay in the company, then I have nothing more to say."
Wei Qingxue felt awkward. Based on her understanding of Lin Fan, she personally didn’t believe Lin Fan was this kind of person, but the evidence was conclusive, and she couldn’t help but believe.
Could it be that she really had to publicly fire Lin Fan!
If she didn’t do so, she might have difficulty convincing people. If she, as the CEO, couldn’t command respect, was it even necessary to be the CEO!
Clap, clap, clap!
Suddenly, Lin Fan started clapping.
"Marvelous!" Lin Fan laughed, "Sister He, you all really went to great lengths to deal with me."
He Yu snorted, "Mr. Lin, what do you mean by this? You’re still being stubborn?"
Wei Qingxue frowned, "Lin Fan, what do you want to say?"
Lin Fan said, "This whole thing was Sister He’s scheme. She first gave me incorrect information to sort out and then, while I was in the restroom, swapped it with the correct one and hid it, trying to frame me. Sister He, am I wrong?"
He Yu angrily said, "Stop making baseless accusations; it’s not as you say. The evidence is conclusive, and you dare to counteraccuse!"
Lin Fan said, "You know very well whether I’m right or not."
He Yu said, "You claim I framed you. You think everyone here is blind? If I did it so openly, why didn’t anyone see it?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Isn’t it simple? Because they are all in cahoots with you. Of course, they cooperated with you."
Lin Fan’s words angered everyone.
"He’s talking nonsense!"
"We’re not like he said!"
"He’s actually slandering us, a real menace if he stays!"
Wei Qingxue felt a bit of a headache; this matter was truly annoying her, "Alright, everyone calm down."
Everything happened because she brought Lin Fan to the company, stirring up all sorts of gossip, and now this trouble arose. To resolve this issue, there was probably only one way.
"Lin Fan, you keep saying Sister He wronged you and that everyone is helping her. This is all your words. Words are weightless. Do you have any evidence?" Wei Qingxue asked.
This was her last effort for Lin Fan. If Lin Fan couldn’t provide evidence, she had no choice but to fire him to settle the issue.
She didn’t want to do this, but if Lin Fan had no evidence, then it had to be this way.
He Yu laughed, "That’s right, Lin Fan, do you have any evidence?"
She confidently believed Lin Fan didn’t have evidence, while her side was conclusive. Lin Fan couldn’t defend himself and could only admit defeat.
Just like the coffee incident yesterday, even if Lin Fan knew he was being messed with by her, he couldn’t prove it and had to swallow it!
Everyone gloated at Lin Fan, knowing he couldn’t produce evidence. He was done for.
It had to be said, Sister He was brilliant, manipulating Lin Fan at will, making him look like a fool without any way to fight back.
People grew more and more in awe of Sister He, noting her as the office politics King. Her skill level would make her a winner in ancient palace intrigues, truly impressive.
Never provoke Sister He!
Of course, I don’t believe they volunteered. They’re just usually under your dire influence, suppressed by your tyranny, too afraid of getting burned to speak for me."
He Yu angrily said, "Lin Fan, clarify your words. How have I mistreated them? You’ve only been here for two days. What do you know? I’m the director of the CEO’s office, their leader. I pride myself on treating them well! Right, everyone?"
"He really can’t produce any evidence!"
"It would be surprising if he could!"
"Exactly, it looks like he’s finally getting kicked out."
People chuckled quietly.
Wei Qingxue sighed inwardly, realizing there was no other way. She had to fire Lin Fan; otherwise, there would be no explaining to everyone.
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, you..."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Don’t be too pleased with yourselves. You want evidence, and it’s on my phone. While organizing this information, I noticed some data was off. So, I got cautious and secretly took pictures of it. I never thought Sister He would indeed play her swapping trick, trying to frame me."
As he spoke, Lin Fan opened his phone and handed it to Wei Qingxue.
What?
Lin Fan took pictures of the information?
He Yu and the others’ expressions changed immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: The Young Lady Acting Unusually
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 425: The Young Lady Acting Unusually
"It is indeed Sister He’s handwriting. The data and documents are exactly the same and both are wrong. Sister He, how do you explain this?"
Wei Qingxue held Lin Fan’s phone, swiping through the pictures on the phone, her face becoming grim. She then looked up and forced a stare at He Yu.
"This..."
He Yu’s face changed. She never dreamt that Lin Fan would actually take pictures of the data. How could she refute this!
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "If you think this evidence is still not enough, there’s a camera on my computer. The scene where you switched the files must have been recorded. Should I show it to the CEO?"
What?
He Yu’s face turned pale in an instant. Stammering, she said, "You, you installed a camera?"
Lin Fan said, "Exactly. Yesterday, you deliberately knocked over the coffee to frame me. I had no evidence, and could only swallow the bitterness. I was afraid you might have new tricks, so I had to be more cautious. A person cannot fall twice at the same place, don’t you agree?"
He Yu: "..."
She had no idea how to respond. Her body began trembling as she realized what exposure meant for her, something she was all too aware of.
Wei Qingxue’s face darkened, and she was very angry: "Sister He, it really is you framing Lin Fan. What else do you have to say?"
Thud!
He Yu suddenly knelt down, crying, "CEO, I realize my mistake. I was momentarily confused and just wanted to joke with Mr. Lin, but the joke went too far."
Wei Qingxue said angrily, "A joke, are you sure you were joking? You nearly had me fire Lin Fan, and you call this a joke?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister He, you’re still deceiving the CEO at this moment, truly bold. You went to great lengths to get rid of me, just because you wanted to place your cousin as the CEO’s assistant and blamed me for taking the position."
"How, how did you know?" He Yu exclaimed, blurting out.
How did Lin Fan know about this? She had told everyone not to say anything. Someone must have betrayed her. It could only be that way.
She had no idea that Lin Fan had extraordinary hearing and overheard the colleagues’ whispered discussions the day before.
After He Yu finished her speech, she realized she was done for. This was tantamount to a confession; denial was impossible.
Wei Qingxue was furious: "Sister He, you actually did this to frame Lin Fan, you could have just told me directly!"
He Yu knew at this point her plot had been fully exposed. She also understood what awaited her.
There was no need to be polite with Wei Qingxue anymore.
"Tell you?" He Yu laughed, "CEO, he is your husband. You brought him in through your connections. Would you replace him with my cousin if I told you? All I can do is try to get rid of him, what else could I do?"
Wei Qingxue said, "You speak as though you are so noble, but you’re just trying to use your connections to secure a good job for your cousin! Stop twisting the facts here. By framing Lin Fan, you were also calculating against me, making me almost fall for your trick to fire Lin Fan. Your actions are simply heinous!"
He Yu said, "If it weren’t for the CEO playing favoritism by bringing your worthless husband into the Company, this wouldn’t have happened. Blame yourself, CEO!"
Wei Qingxue sneered, "I am the CEO, and I have the authority to decide who my assistant is. It’s not up to you to comment, let alone manipulate the Company as if it’s a harem! I declare that you are fired from this moment, pack up and get out immediately!"
What?
Everyone was shocked.
The CEO was actually going to fire the head of the CEO office!
He Yu’s face turned pale, rasping, "You can’t fire me!"
Wei Qingxue said coldly, "Why can’t I fire you?"
He Yu said, "I’ve been with the Company longer than you. I was already the head of the CEO office during the previous CEO’s tenure, with more experience than you, Wei Qingxue. You have no right to fire me!"
Wei Qingxue said, "You mean that because you are more experienced, you can act recklessly, and I can’t deal with you? What a joke! I am the CEO; I don’t need any qualifications to fire a head!"
"What’s happening; what happened?"
At this moment, Wei Zihan came in from outside.
He Yu, facing a desperate situation, saw Wei Zihan as a lifeline, quickly crawling over and holding onto Wei Zihan’s leg: "Miss, the CEO is going to fire me; you must help me get justice!"
Wei Zihan frowned, "Why is she firing you? Wei Qingxue, Sister He is the head of the CEO office, very competent, and has seniority in the Company. You’d better explain to me."
Wei Qingxue said, "It’s because she repeatedly framed Lin Fan."
Wei Qingxue bitterly smiled inside. This Wei Zihan was always at odds with her. Now that she stepped in, things wouldn’t go as smoothly. This Wei Zihan would surely shield He Yu to oppose Wei Qingxue.
Everyone also thought so. Great, Miss is here, she will definitely help He Yu.
He Yu also knew Wei Zihan and Wei Qingxue didn’t get along, so she decisively clung to Wei Zihan as it seemed like her lifeline.
Wei Zihan just said, "Is there such a thing?"
So Wei Qingxue explained everything He Yu had done these past two days, including the coffee incident yesterday and the file errors today.
"He Yu repeatedly framed Lin Fan just to drive him away so her cousin could become the CEO’s assistant. By dismissing her, there shouldn’t be a problem, right? Wei Zihan, you’d better not meddle in this; if it gets to Grandpa, you won’t have any grounds either!" Wei Qingxue reminded. She knew Wei Zihan would definitely support He Yu, but she had to speak firmly.
"Oh, I see." Wei Zihan said plainly, "Wei Qingxue, you did the right thing this time. I have nothing to say."
What?
Everyone was puzzled.
This was beyond everyone’s expectations. Wei Zihan actually agreed with Wei Qingxue?
And she didn’t contradict Wei Qingxue?
Wei Qingxue: "..."
She was briefly stunned, quite surprised.
He Yu said in horror, "Miss, what are you saying? You must stand up for me; haven’t you always..."
Wei Zihan coldly said, "Always at odds with Wei Qingxue? You’re right, but I’m also a reasonable person, and this time, you’re wrong, let go!"
She forcefully flung He Yu off.
He Yu felt like the sky had collapsed; her lifeline was gone just like that.
"Alright, Miss, this time I’m really wrong. Fire me if you want. I won’t do this head position anymore. Miss, can you take me in? I’m willing to serve you, to work under you, I will be utterly loyal!" He Yu pleaded.
Wei Qingxue’s heart sank. He Yu was really tough to deal with; she considered defecting to Wei Zihan. He Yu knew Wei Qingxue too well, and if she served Wei Zihan, it would surely be disadvantageous to Wei Qingxue!
Maybe Wei Zihan wouldn’t miss this opportunity!
"Get lost!"
But Wei Zihan said coldly before turning around and leaving.
What?
Wei Qingxue was dumbfounded. Wei Zihan actually gave up this opportunity?
But then she saw Wei Zihan walk to Lin Fan’s side, glanced at Lin Fan, and murmured, "I consider it paid back, what I owe you."
Lin Fan smiled. It turned out Wei Zihan didn’t oppose Wei Qingxue because he saved her yesterday. Who’d have thought, this spoiled lady would actually repay a favor!
"CEO, because of my presence, so many things happened. I’m afraid I am not suitable for this position anymore. I apply for a transfer."
Lin Fan looked up and said to Wei Qingxue.
Everyone exchanged glances, bewildered by what Lin Fan intended to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: I Must Make Everyone Shut Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 426: I Must Make Everyone Shut Up
Lin Fan proved his innocence, and Sister He was subsequently fired by Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue wasn’t done venting; the mistake wasn’t just Sister He’s alone as the whole executive office colluded with Sister He.
"All of you, I’m asking again, you all saw what He Yu did, right? Why didn’t you tell the truth?" Wei Qingxue asked angrily.
Everyone in the office changed their expressions, each trembling and lowering their heads, not daring to meet Wei Qingxue’s gaze, worried the president might find trouble with them as well. Could they be fired too?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I think the reason everyone cooperated with Sister He was because she’s always throwing her weight around, acting high and mighty. Everyone’s afraid of her and intimidated by her presence, right? Am I correct?"
Lin Fan’s words undoubtedly provided everyone with an excuse, pushing the blame entirely onto Sister He.
Everyone naturally went along with it.
"Mr. Lin is right, President, we didn’t dare not cooperate with her. If we offended her, we’d have a hard time at the company."
"We had no choice, Sister He is ferocious, we’re all very scared of her!"
"Thankfully, she’s been fired. We’re all relieved!"
"Yesterday, we saw with our own eyes as He Yu deliberately knocked over coffee to frame Mr. Lin, but we dared not speak up."
"Today, she also switched documents right in front of us, but we didn’t dare say anything."
"It was all her doing, it had nothing to do with us!"
Everyone scrambled to talk over each other, placing all the blame on He Yu and completely distancing themselves from it.
They no longer had to look at He Yu’s expressions as she had already been fired, unable to threaten them, all they wanted was self-preservation.
He Yu almost fainted from anger; these people used to flatter her, she didn’t expect them to turn on her so quickly.
He Yu experienced a sense of betrayal, feeling utterly discouraged as she slunk away from the company.
Because of blaming He Yu, the other members of the executive office were spared.
This was entirely because Lin Fan spoke on their behalf, and everyone suddenly felt very grateful to Lin Fan. From then on, they dared not show him any disrespect.
They used to think the president’s son-in-law was just a waste, whom anyone could bully, but today they realized Lin Fan was no simple matter, even an old hand like Sister He failed against him!
Henceforth, no one dared to question Lin Fan, the assistant to the president.
But at this moment, Lin Fan said, "President, because my arrival has stirred up so much trouble, I’m afraid I’m not suitable to stay in this role any longer, I request to transfer."
Lin Fan didn’t want to be the president’s assistant anymore?
Everyone looked at each other, puzzled about what Lin Fan was planning.
Wei Qingxue asked, "Which department do you want to transfer to?"
Lin Fan said, "I want to try training in the sales department."
Wei Qingxue thought for a moment and said, "Alright then, go report to the sales department. I’ll notify Manager Xiao there. Before that, come into my office for a moment."
Lin Fan then came to Wei Qingxue’s office.
"Lin Fan, I want to first apologize to you, earlier I was also fooled by Sister He and almost misunderstood you," said Wei Qingxue.
Lin Fan waved his hand, "It’s nothing, Sister He is a seasoned workplace veteran who knows how to manipulate and can’t blame you."
Wei Qingxue said, "Yes, right. By the way, why did you speak up for them earlier? They were obviously in cahoots with Sister He, and even if all of them were fired, it wouldn’t be unfair!"
Lin Fan said, "I wasn’t speaking up for them, I was helping you. You’ve already fired the executive office director, if you also fired them, your work would suffer as a result. So for the sake of the bigger picture, it’s better to keep them temporarily, and replace them individually over time."
Wei Qingxue was momentarily stunned, feeling quite touched. Lin Fan was so considerate, she hadn’t anticipated that.
Although Lin Fan was just a courier, his handling of this matter was very much like a seasoned chief executive of a large company, so impressive.
Lin Fan working as a courier was truly a waste.
She believed that if Lin Fan were appointed as the executive office director, he could manage the role successfully.
"Lin Fan, no one in the executive office will doubt you anymore. You spoke up for them, they’re sure to respect you, why change positions and not continue being my assistant?"
Lin Fan said, "What I’ve managed now is just the executive office, but beyond that, they are still not convinced of me. If I can’t make them convinced, they will continuously mock me, and might claim you’re using nepotism, affecting your authority. So I need to achieve something to silence everyone!"
These remarks stirred some emotions within Wei Qingxue, she felt Lin Fan was not simple...
It’s alright for a person to be financially poor, but they must have ambition. Lin Fan clearly was a person with aspirations.
Who wouldn’t like a man with ambition!
Wei Qingxue looked at Lin Fan more and more and felt increasingly charmed, though he was her husband, currently a pretend husband, but she was starting to think he really was suitable to be her husband.
Her real husband.
Afterward, Wei Qingxue formally transferred Lin Fan to the sales department.
Lin Fan had nothing in particular to pack, so he went empty-handed to report to the sales department.
Before Lin Fan arrived, Manager Xiao from the sales department had already received the notification from Wei Qingxue, who entrusted him to look after Lin Fan.
In front of Wei Qingxue, Manager Xiao naturally nodded and agreed readily to anything.
But once he hung up the phone, Manager Xiao changed his expression and announced the matter to everyone in the sales department.
"I have unfortunate news everyone, the president’s worthless husband is coming to our sales department!" Manager Xiao said with a sullen face.
The crowd in the sales department erupted when they heard the news.
"Wasn’t he a courier before? Can a delivery guy do sales?"
"This guy might drag down the performance of our entire sales department!"
"Nepotistically related guys, really look down on them!"
"Manager, can’t we stop him from coming over!"
The crowd grumbled, evidently none of them welcomed Lin Fan.
Manager Xiao sneered, "This was arranged personally by the president, I can’t refuse. But you all should know, just today, Sister He from the executive office was dismissed because she offended Lin Fan!"
"What?"
Everyone was shocked, some became indignant.
"Nepotism truly allows one to cover the sky with one hand!"
"Not someone to provoke!"
"It’s baffling that the president would fire her own executive office director for a worthless person!"
"Will we all have to let this worthless person step all over us?"
Manager Xiao chuckled and said, "Don’t worry, the sales department is not the executive office. In our sales department, performance matters. This useless son-in-law won’t last long here, I’ll make sure he leaves quickly!"
At that moment, Lin Fan walked into the sales department, smiling, "Hello everyone, I’m Lin Fan. Please take care of me."

chapters.title: Chapter 427: The Conspiracy Behind the Smile
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Chapter 427: The Conspiracy Behind the Smile
As soon as Lin Fan arrived, the people in the sales department fell silent, though their expressions still betrayed a hint of disdain.
They completely despised this man who came in through nepotism as a live-in son-in-law.
Yet, Manager Xiao immediately flashed a bright smile, proactively walking up to Lin Fan and respectfully saying, "Mr. Lin, hello, I’m Xiao Tiezhu, the head of the sales department. Welcome, Mr. Lin. Everyone, applaud!"
Manager Xiao led the applause.
The people in the sales department followed suit, pretending to put on a welcoming façade.
As salespeople, they were masters of reading others, with acting skills comparable to Oscar winners. Although they looked down on Lin Fan, with Manager Xiao setting the tone, they had no reason not to follow.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you, everyone."
He chuckled inwardly, as he had heard every word they said earlier from outside.
Now, looking at their smiling faces, Lin Fan felt a bit disgusted, thinking what a bunch of hypocrites they were.
After a brief welcoming ceremony.
Manager Xiao said, "Mr. Lin, let me introduce you to our sales department’s work. Our primary task is to sell the company’s projects. Currently, we are selling a commercial unit. It’s the offseason, so business is relatively slow. But our colleagues are very competent. We have a total of seven colleagues, and everyone has made a sale this month. Mr. Lin can take a look at our performance chart, which we update regularly."
In the sales department, performance is the hard truth.
The walls of the sales department were plastered with various motivational slogans, among which the most eye-catching was the performance chart.
The performance of all seven salespeople was clearly displayed on the chart.
Lin Fan glanced at it; the top performer this month already had 8 deals, while even the last one had 2 deals.
Manager Xiao said, "Mr. Lin just joined, so there’s no performance yet, hence temporarily ranked eighth. Hopefully, Mr. Lin will work hard."
With that, Manager Xiao added Lin Fan’s name to the bottom of the performance chart.
Lin Fan, ranked eighth, 0 deals!
"Mr. Lin, I also need to explain our assessment system. Our competition is quite fierce. If you don’t have a deal in a month, you’ll be eliminated. If you’re at the bottom for three consecutive months, you’ll also be eliminated. As a new employee, the trial period is one month. If there’s no deal within a month, I’m sorry, it just shows that you’re not suitable for sales work. Additionally, during the entire probationary period, if any violation of company policy is found, dismissal is warranted. Of course, being able to close deals trumps everything else," Manager Xiao said.
Lin Fan nodded, "I understand."
Manager Xiao smiled and asked, "Mr. Lin, do you have confidence? I heard you were a courier before, so your sales experience might be lacking, right? But don’t worry, if there’s anything you don’t understand, you can ask your colleagues or come to me. We’re a team, like a family, and we’ll all help you. I hope you won’t stay in last place forever."
Though it sounded like he was encouraging Lin Fan, the encouragement carried a hint of sarcasm.
Everyone snickered quietly.
In their hearts, they didn’t believe Lin Fan had the ability to work. They thought Lin Fan would always remain in last place.
They certainly weren’t going to help Lin Fan. Not tripping him up would already be decent.
Lin Fan was destined to stay in last place until the probation period ended, and he’d be eliminated!
Manager Xiao’s plan was brilliant, in a month at most, Lin Fan would be out!
If Lin Fan got caught violating any company rule in the meantime, he could even be kicked out sooner!
"Mr. Lin, now let me assign you a task. There’s a project from our company, the Mingshi Century Commercial Center, which you’ll be responsible for selling. You can head over to Mingshi Century now to familiarize yourself. I wish you an early deal," Manager Xiao said.
Lin Fan promptly said, "Okay, I’ll go right away."
Lin Fan then left the company for Mingshi Century.
As soon as Lin Fan walked out, the sales department office erupted in laughter.
"Manager, your move is brilliant. The Mingshi Century is such a lousy unit, it’s virtually unsellable!"
"Haha, absolutely brilliant. Lin Fan is a complete waste of space. Even if he were assigned to a good location, he might not close a deal. Now with Mingshi Century, there’s no way he’ll succeed!"
"This guy is doomed!"
Everyone laughed gloatingly.
It turned out that the unit Manager Xiao assigned Lin Fan was in a remote location, where not even birds would shit, and inaccessible.
Since this project’s development, it’s been largely neglected. Even the world’s best sales expert couldn’t sell it!
Especially since Lin Fan was a useless courier turned salesperson!
Assigning Lin Fan to sell this unit was as good as sentencing him to death.
And this was indeed the case.
In the following week, Lin Fan camped at Mingshi Century every day, only to collect zero results.
There wasn’t even anyone looking, let alone buying.
The people in the sales department secretly mocked Lin Fan with all sorts of ridicule, certain he wouldn’t pass this test.
Lin Fan’s first visit to Mingshi Century had him breaking a cold sweat, his heart chilled. The Mingshi Century project was too desolate.
All around were wild fields!
No village in front, no shop behind, wasn’t this project originally a failure by the Wei Family?
Lin Fan was sure Manager Xiao did it on purpose. Though Manager Xiao appeared courteous on the surface, his belly was full of bad water.
A week later, Lin Fan still didn’t sell a single unit.
That day, nearing the end of work, Wei Qingxue visited Mingshi Century to check on Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan, how’s it going after a week in sales? Are you adjusting?" Wei Qingxue asked.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay, just a bit quiet."
Quiet was an understatement; there wasn’t even a ghost around.
Wei Qingxue said, "Mingshi Century is indeed hard to sell. If necessary, I can talk to Manager Xiao about reassigning you?"
Lin Fan said, "No need, thanks for your kindness. But if you intervene, they’ll gossip, saying I rely on our relationship, and even if I make a sale, they wouldn’t respect it. So, it’s best not to get involved."
Wei Qingxue said, "But... if you can’t make a sale in a month, wouldn’t it be even worse to leave the sales department?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Don’t worry, I’ll try my best to prevent that. Even if I fail, there’s nothing more to say."
Wei Qingxue sighed. She understood Lin Fan’s meaning; he didn’t want to rely on her. But if she didn’t help, Lin Fan might actually fail.
A few more days passed, and Manager Xiao called Lin Fan back to the company for a meeting.
"Mr. Lin, you’ve been in the sales department for nearly half a month now. Three days left, and this month ends. If Mr. Lin still has 0 deals, you’ll regrettably have to leave the sales department," Manager Xiao said.
Lin Fan was shocked, "Wasn’t the probation period a month? Why only 3 days left?"
Manager Xiao replied, "Perhaps I wasn’t clear. By one month, I meant this calendar month. When Mr. Lin joined, the month was halfway through, so actually, Mr. Lin only has half a month."
Everyone snickered quietly.
Too perfect, Lin Fan only had three days left, surely he couldn’t close a deal!

chapters.title: Chapter 428 Everyone is Waiting to See a Joke
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 428 Everyone is Waiting to See a Joke
The Wei Family Mansion, on this day, Elder Wei received Wei Qingxue at home to listen to her work report.
Although Elder Wei was advanced in age, he was still the head of the Wei Family Company, personally attending to everything.
