There was no other choice, as up till now, he still couldn’t trust anyone else with the company. In the Wei Family, there wasn’t anyone who could satisfy him as a successor.
He had two biological sons, Wei Dagang and Wei Dazong, but both were mediocre, unfit for major responsibilities. Originally, Elder Wei planned to groom Wei Tang as a successor, but unfortunately, Wei Tang was also an incapable Ah-Dou. Recently, he was expelled from the Wei Family by Elder Wei for recklessly orchestrating Wei Qingxue’s kidnapping.
Looking throughout the Wei Family, only Wei Qingxue could be relied upon.
Sadly, Wei Qingxue was still too young, unable to take full charge yet. He still needed to guide her, hoping she would grow quickly.
"Qingxue, I’m getting old and probably don’t have many years left. Although the Wei Family is large, it’s full of mediocrities. The future of the company relies on you. I have great expectations for you, but you have much room for growth. There are things you need to learn to decide for yourself. A commander should never be indecisive," Elder Wei said.
Wei Qingxue replied, "Yes, Grandpa."
Grandpa suddenly brought this up, perhaps he had some critique for her.
Elder Wei said, "I heard that recently you’ve arranged for Lin Fan to work at the company."
Wei Qingxue replied, "Yes, that’s true."
Turns out, Grandpa wanted to talk about Lin Fan.
Elder Wei said, "I understand that during the kidnapping incident, Lin Fan made significant contributions. It’s not out of the question for you to let him work at the company. However, there are quite a few grumbles about this, which needs attention. As the president, your authority is crucial, and you can’t let Lin Fan undermine it."
Wei Qingxue remained silent. She didn’t know how to respond to Elder Wei and felt unsure.
Elder Wei asked, "What’s Lin Fan doing now in the company?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "I originally intended for him to be my assistant, but currently, he’s in the sales department and has been for almost two weeks now."
Elder Wei uttered an "Oh": "He was just a delivery man originally; making him your assistant is already a stretch, but working in sales?"
Wei Qingxue said, "He wanted to go there himself, Grandpa, Lin Fan actually has quite the ambition."
Elder Wei said, "Having ambition is a good thing, but in these two weeks, has he made any sales?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Not yet, Manager Xiao arranged for him at Mingshi Century."
Elder Wei was taken aback: "Mingshi Century? This project resulted from our miscalculation when overestimating that area, but plans changed midway, forcing us to complete it despite unfavorable policies. Selling it is next to impossible. Even the most extraordinary salesman couldn’t pull it off, let alone someone who was merely a delivery man!"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Yes."
Elder Wei said, "As president, you should know, Little Xiao arranged it this way on purpose, to make life difficult for Lin Fan. You’re fully entitled to intervene, so why didn’t you?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "He asked me not to intervene. He said he wanted to rely on himself to change others’ perspectives. Also, he didn’t want people to accuse me of nepotism if I intervened."
Elder Wei was somewhat surprised and approved, "He’s right. For him to think like this is not bad; as a delivery man, he’s impressed me. But... he’s likely to fail this time."
Nobody could sell the properties of Mingshi Century, much less Lin Fan!
Elder Wei then asked, "If he fails, Qingxue, how do you plan to handle it?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "If that’s the case, he can’t stay at the company anymore. Although I still hope he can stay, I’m afraid he won’t want to."
Elder Wei said, "Right, if he fails, he should no longer remain at the company. Of course, he’ll inevitably face ridicule by then. He wanted to prove himself to be good, but unfortunately, he chose a dead-end."
Wei Qingxue sighed inwardly. Grandpa’s words, though harsh, were essentially the truth.
Lin Fan indeed faced a very challenging battle.
Moreover, Lin Fan had little time left.
The president’s live-in son-in-law becoming a salesperson!
This news had already spread throughout the company, and the Wei Family knew as well.
He had three days left. If Lin Fan didn’t make a sale by then, he would fail his assessment, leading to expulsion.
"Laughable, this worthless fool completely overestimates himself, going to become a salesperson?"
"He truly lacks self-awareness!"
"He’s digging his own grave!"
"Everyone’s waiting to laugh at him!"
"No need to wait; the joke is here now. He’s bound to fail!"
No one believed in Lin Fan. In the past two weeks, Lin Fan hadn’t even entertained a single client, making a sale was impossible, and in the remaining three days, nothing would likely change.
In the sales department of the Wei Family Company, everyone was overjoyed.
Manager Xiao had just dismissed Lin Fan, informing him that he had only three days left.
"I heard that in the past half month, Lin Fan didn’t meet even one client. He just wanders around Mingshi Century, occasionally making a call, essentially doing nothing!"
"Hahaha, is he just pretending, fooling himself?"
"He seems too idle; I envy him. We’re swamped with client meetings every day."
"Stop being so sarcastic, hahaha..."
"Who wouldn’t pitifully shake their head at that!"
"In short, Manager Xiao’s strategy is clever. For Lin Fan to pass, the sun would have to rise in the west!"
Listening to everyone chattering away, Manager Xiao sneered, "This kind of waste also wants to stay in the sales department. Wishful thinking."
Someone showed concern, "Manager Xiao, arranging for him to go to Mingshi Century, will the president blame you? If she gets involved..."
Manager Xiao chuckled, "So what? I guess the president wouldn’t dare say much. If she dared intervene, it would confirm nepotism. This waste would pass anyway, and who wouldn’t say he depended on a woman? Even the president’s authority would take a hit!"
The crowd burst into laughter.
"Manager Xiao, you’re brilliant!"
Manager Xiao chuckled, "Brothers and sisters, we can buy our champagne, ready to celebrate, and wait for this waste to be booted out!"
Three days went by quickly.
Finally, the day arrived for Lin Fan’s final assessment.
Lin Fan’s sales count was still zero!
The sales department folks indeed had their champagne out, placing them in conspicuous spots. They had become overtly complacent, convinced that Lin Fan was surely about to be shown the door, and soon they could pop the champagne in celebration.
The entire Wei Family Company and members of the Wei Family were momentarily focused on the sales department.
They were waiting to see a joke.
However...
They might be disappointed.

chapters.title: Chapter 429: He didn’t sell just one set, he sold short
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 429: He didn’t sell just one set, he sold short
The night before the assessment deadline.
There was a sudden emergency meeting called by the Yun City Government, personally chaired by the mayor.
Outsiders could hardly know the reason for this emergency meeting, but the result of the meeting soon spread out.
The Yun City Government decided to restart the Nanshan District development plan!
The Nanshan District development was originally a plan of the Yun City Government, which was once brought to the agenda, and even initiated, for instance, the Mingshi Century project of the Wei Family was built first.
However, when Mingshi Century was about to be completed, the Nanshan District development plan was suddenly put on hold!
The reason was that the Yun City Government shifted its focus to Daya Bay!
Daya Bay is a national-level economic new district, and it’s understandable that Yun City’s top brass made this decision. Indeed, Daya Bay has become a prime location where development is in full swing.
The richest man in Yun City, Lin Fan, even acquired a piece of golden land in Daya Bay, Chiba Island. The entire Chiba Island belongs to Lin Fan, making many people envious, such as Feng Wanshan, who has always seen Lin Fan as a mortal enemy, driven by jealousy.
Feng Wanshan initially also wanted to acquire Chiba Island but was outpaced by Lin Fan. Since then, Feng Wanshan regarded Lin Fan as a thorn in his side that must be removed.
Due to the development of Daya Bay, the Nanshan District development plan was shelved, leaving Nanshan District in an awkward situation.
Many planned constructions were halted.
Several projects built halfway turned into abandoned buildings.
And those projects completed ahead of time were the most embarrassing.
No sales!
If the Nanshan District development plan restarts, what kind of scene will it be?
Just when everyone at the Wei Family Company was waiting to see Lin Fan’s embarrassment...
The once quiet Mingshi Century suddenly saw a flock of customers, almost breaking down Mingshi Century’s doors.
With the Nanshan District development plan restarted, those seeing business opportunities have already started chasing money.
Don’t be fooled by Mingshi Century’s surrounding wilderness. Once developed, this place will be a booming area, and everyone wants to grab a high position.
Mingshi Century went from unnoticed to a hot commodity overnight.
Wei Family Company.
In the sales department, everyone had already taken out the champagne, ready to celebrate Lin Fan’s failure. As long as Lin Fan hadn’t made a sale by the end of the day, he would be kicked out of the sales department, and possibly out of the company.
They were all waiting to see a joke.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, a phone rang.
Manager Xiao chuckled, "Could it be Lin Fan calling? He might be backing down in the face of difficulties and calling to resign. This guy is really useless, not even daring to resign face to face."
The crowd burst into laughter.
The sales department assistant then answered the call.
The assistant’s face changed, putting down the phone and turning back to the laughing crowd, with a strange expression: "Someone is inquiring about the units of Mingshi Century."
Everyone stopped laughing and made a sound of surprise. Someone actually inquired about Mingshi Century? This place that’s long forgotten, how could someone suddenly come to inquire?
Manager Xiao said, "Let him go to Lin Fan."
The assistant then gave Lin Fan’s contact information to the other party.
Everyone looked at Manager Xiao: "Manager, what’s going on?"
Manager Xiao said, "Pfft, occasionally, there are some foolish ones. Rest assured, once they go to Mingshi Century for a look, they’ll definitely turn and run."
The crowd laughed again.
"Wait!"
The sales assistant suddenly said, "The platform shows a transaction at Mingshi Century!"
Everyone stopped laughing and looked at the sales assistant, each with a somewhat dazed expression.
The company has a platform, and once there’s a transaction, it needs to be submitted to the backend, which can promptly receive the salesperson’s work status.
The sales assistant just discovered that Lin Fan submitted a sales record, and a unit at Mingshi Century was sold!
Manager Xiao said, "What did you say, a transaction at Mingshi Century? How is that possible, could there be a system error? This broken system should be updated!"
The sales assistant said, "The platform was maintained recently; there shouldn’t be any errors. Indeed, there’s a transaction. Wait! Oh my, another transaction just happened!"
What?
The second one?
Everyone in the sales department looked at each other, all with expressions as if they’d seen a ghost.
Mingshi Century, this notoriously difficult place, where not even an Immortal could sell, suddenly had two consecutive sales?
Is this real?
"Ah! Another one, the third transaction!" the sales assistant suddenly screamed.
"Fourth transaction!"
"Fifth transaction!"
"Sixth transaction!"
"Seventh transaction!"
"All 30 units of Mingshi Century sold out!"
The sales assistant also had a ghost-like expression, and after announcing this, was stunned himself.
Everyone in the sales department was petrified.
President’s office.
Wei Qingxue paced back and forth in the room, her mood somewhat anxious.
Today was already the last day, and Lin Fan had yet to make a sale; he might not pass the probation period.
This meant Lin Fan was about to leave the company soon.
Initially, she let Lin Fan work at the company because her mother suggested it. If Lin Fan were to lose face and go home dejectedly, her mother would surely be disappointed in him.
Lin Fan had managed to change her mother’s impression slightly because of the kidnapping incident. If he lost embarrassingly this time, her mother might again give Lin Fan the cold shoulder, like before.
She didn’t want to see this scenario. If it really happened, she would have no choice but to divorce Lin Fan.
If it were in the past, she would have no psychological burden, as they were in a fake marriage initially, but now, deep down, she felt a small attachment, like a voice stopping her from divorcing Lin Fan.
She wanted to follow her heart, but reality was too harsh.
As Elder Wei said, Lin Fan chose a path of no return by himself.
Suddenly, someone knocked on the door.
Wei Qingxue said, "Come in."
Then an aide pushed the door open and said, "President, you asked me to keep an eye on the movements in the sales department. I’ve just heard that there’s a transaction at Mingshi Century."
What?
Wei Qingxue was overjoyed, "Are you saying Lin Fan made a sale? He actually sold a unit?"
The aide looked a bit strange, "President, Mr. Lin didn’t just sell a unit."
Wei Qingxue frowned, "What do you mean, did he not sell it?"
The aide said, "No, it’s not that. Mr. Lin sold Mingshi Century, the entire Mingshi Century, out."
"Ah, what do you mean, sold out? You must be joking, right? How is this possible?" Wei Qingxue was shocked.
Meanwhile.
At the Wei Family Mansion.
Everyone in the Wei Family was also waiting to see Lin Fan’s joke, including Elder Wei, who was also concerned about whether Lin Fan could make a sale today.
The old butler answered a call from the company.
"Elder, just received the news, Lin Fan sold out Mingshi Century." The old butler’s voice was slightly trembling.
Elder Wei jumped up from his rattan chair, "What did you say?"

chapters.title: Chapter 430 Shocked, How Did He Do It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 430 Shocked, How Did He Do It?
Mingshi Century, located in the commercial area of Yun City Nanshan District, is a property under the Wei Family. Originally, it was very deserted here, hardly attracting any buyers.
But on this day, Mingshi Century suddenly became bustling, with people flocking in to compete for purchases.
Lin Fan sat at the entrance of Mingshi Century, legs crossed. He didn’t take the clients to view the properties but let them go on their own. Once they decided on a unit, they only needed to inform him to sign the contract and pay the deposit on the spot.
All 30 units at Mingshi Century were sold out before noon!
Lin Fan even allowed clients to regret their decisions, offering unconditional refunds on the deposits.
Why? Because there was still a large number of people waiting in line, keeping him from worrying about unsold units!
However, no one regretted. Those who secured a unit treated it as a treasure, unwilling to give it up.
"Everyone, I announce that the Mingshi Century project is sold out. Thank you all for your support," Lin Fan said with a smile, sending off the clients.
Even though it was sold out, new clients continued to arrive. Upon hearing everything was sold, they regretted not coming earlier.
The successful buyers were all overjoyed, as if they had secured a treasure, quickly paying the deposit since the rules stated that not paying within the specified time meant giving up voluntarily.
No one wanted to lose their treasure due to not paying, so they were all prompt with the deposits, with some even paying the full amount quickly.
Mission accomplished!
Lin Fan rode his electric scooter back to the Wei Family Company.
By this time, the news of Lin Fan selling out Mingshi Century had already spread throughout the company; everyone knew it.
Everyone working at the Wei Family Company was aware of Mingshi Century’s situation and how it was nearly impossible to sell anything there. Yet, Lin Fan managed to sell it out?
Everyone was shocked.
Previously, they were all waiting to see Lin Fan fail, sure that this useless son-in-law of the president couldn’t make any sales and was just waiting to be fired!
But who knew, not only did he sell it, but he actually sold it all.
Lin Fan walked into the company.
"Mr. Lin, you’re back," the receptionist was the first to see Lin Fan and quickly stood up, her face full of respect, even a bit flustered.
The people in the company quieted down upon seeing Lin Fan, all eyes on him. Their view of Lin Fan had changed from before, where there was open and hidden disdain, now not a trace of it remained.
They had no right to despise someone who sold out Mingshi Century.
Lin Fan ignored them and went straight to the sales department.
In the sales department.
Everyone was deeply shocked, some even questioning their understanding of reality.
"Impossible!"
Manager Xiao shouted, "There’s no way he sold out Mingshi Century. Who would even buy there? The system must be malfunctioning. Quickly, get someone to repair this broken system!"
The sales department assistant, sweating profusely, said, "Manager, I’m sure the system is correct. It truly was sold out."
Manager Xiao slumped down, dumbfounded.
For a moment, the entire sales department fell silent.
In this atmosphere, Lin Fan returned to the sales department.
"I’m back, Manager Xiao, Manager Xiao?" Lin Fan smiled, calling out twice.
Only then did Manager Xiao snap out of it, hastily standing up with a forced smile, "Mr. Lin, you’re back."
Lin Fan said, "I believe Manager Xiao already knows, Mingshi Century is sold out. I suppose I passed the review this time?"
Manager Xiao laughed, "Of course, Mr. Lin, you’re really amazing to have sold out Mingshi Century. Mr. Lin achieved 30 orders this month, exceeding 200 million in total sales, ranking first in the sales performance list, rightfully the MVP of the month!"
Sales of 200 million, what does that mean?
In the Wei Family Company, no salesperson has ever achieved such a result, including Manager Xiao himself, who couldn’t compare to Lin Fan.
Being a seasoned professional, Manager Xiao clearly understood what Lin Fan achieving this performance meant; henceforth, Lin Fan could probably walk with pride in the company.
Manager Xiao, who previously looked down on Lin Fan and tried to drive him away due to his lack of achievement and reliance on nepotism, would now have to see him differently. Building a rapport with Lin Fan seemed like the smart move, as he might need Lin Fan’s support in the future.
Lin Fan noticed the champagne on the table at once.
"Manager Xiao, are you having champagne?" Lin Fan asked.
Everyone suddenly felt awkward.
This champagne was originally meant to celebrate Lin Fan’s dismissal.
Now, it served only to highlight their embarrassment, making it a mockery directed at themselves.
Manager Xiao was quick to react with a laugh, "Yes, upon hearing that Mr. Lin sold out Mingshi Century, we specially ordered champagne to celebrate Mr. Lin. Xiaoli, quickly fill Mr. Lin’s glass!"
"Mr. Lin, I toast you. Congratulations on your remarkable achievement; it’s absolutely astonishing."
Lin Fan chuckled inwardly, knowing full well the champagne was meant to toast his exit before he even returned. Instead, he’d let them down.
"Lin Fan, you’re back!"
At that moment, Wei Qingxue entered, her expression visibly excited.
"President!"
Everyone hurriedly greeted her.
Wei Qingxue ignored them, walking straight to Lin Fan’s side, her eyes solely on him now.
All day she had been worried about Lin Fan, thinking he surely couldn’t make a sale and that there was nothing she could do to help him.
She never expected the outcome to be like this.
Upon hearing Lin Fan returned, she immediately went to the sales department herself.
"Lin Fan, how did you do it, how did you manage to sell out Mingshi Century?" Wei Qingxue asked curiously, unable to resist asking the moment she saw Lin Fan.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, equally curious about how he achieved it.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "For the past half month, I’ve been staying in Nanshan District, all for today."
Wei Qingxue asked, "What exactly did you do?"
Lin Fan replied, "This matter is somewhat complicated yet simple. Mingshi Century’s unsellability was closely related to the upper-level policy, as Yun City had halted the Nanshan District development plan. So, I found a way to restart the Nanshan District development plan."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
The Nanshan District development plan Lin Fan mentioned affected Mingshi Century’s sales, which was true. The question was, what gave Lin Fan the capability to restart it?
This was truly unbelievable.
By all logic, it should have been impossible?!
How exactly did Lin Fan achieve this?
Everyone was at a loss.
Liu Family Mansion.
Because Lin Fan sold out Mingshi Century, Elder Wei was equally baffled about this question.
"What? Lin Fan managed to restart the Nanshan District development plan?" Elder Wei was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Several Phone Calls, Changing Yun City
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 431: Several Phone Calls, Changing Yun City
Yun City is restarting the development plan for Nanshan District. Those with a keen sense of opportunity have already started taking action. As they say, the early bird catches the worm, and the faster you move, the better your chances to make money.
Mingshi Century was snapped up in a buying frenzy, marking the first influx of funds. And this is just the beginning, merely an appetizer!
Within just a morning, Mingshi Century was sold out, and 200 million yuan flowed into the coffers of the Wei Family Company.
The Wei Family Company had initially invested in building Mingshi Century, but after experiencing a pause in the Nanshan District development plan, Mingshi Century fell into slow sales, and the Wei Family Company was tied up.
At one point, the Wei Family Company considered this project a failure that caused significant financial losses.
Now, with everything sold out all at once, the funds have returned, and they’ve made a considerable profit.
As the helmsman of the company, Elder Wei was overjoyed.
Previously, the Wei Family had just received a 1 billion investment from Wanjin Group, solving their urgent crisis and saving the company. Now, they’ve gained another 200 million, which is simply a double blessing.
"Great! The Wei Family is going to thrive!" exclaimed Elder Wei, brimming with excitement.
Amidst the excitement, Elder Wei was extremely curious about how Lin Fan managed to sell out Mingshi Century.
"What? Lin Fan got the Nanshan District development plan restarted?" Elder Wei said in shock, "How did he do it?"
Wei Family Company, Sales Department.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, waiting for his answer.
They were so curious because, according to their information, for the past two weeks, Lin Fan had been visiting Mingshi Century every day, wandering around, making a few calls, seemingly doing nothing.
Lin Fan said, "For the past two weeks, I’ve been surveying Nanshan District and found enormous development potential there. So, I tried writing an assessment report and submitted it to the city government, suggesting they restart the Nanshan District development plan. I didn’t expect..."
Huh?
Everyone was stunned.
Is that even possible?
Surveying for two weeks, writing an assessment report for the city government, and the government accepted Lin Fan’s suggestion, actually restarting the Nanshan District development plan?
This has to be a joke!
Of course, it’s a joke.
Lin Fan was just bluffing. He didn’t write any assessment report; however, he did do something.
For the past two weeks, Lin Fan had indeed been surveying Nanshan District and saw tremendous business opportunities there. Like Daya Bay, Nanshan District has boundless potential and is a prime piece of real estate!
Moreover, with the development plan for Nanshan District on pause, it was neglected by everyone, making it the perfect time to stake a claim.
That day, Lin Fan was wandering through Nanshan District.
"Ding!"
"System task release!"
"Task: Acquire land in Nanshan District.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 0/100"
Lin Fan chuckled. It seemed the system shared his vision. The system immediately issued a task to acquire land.
So, to complete the system’s task, Lin Fan made a few calls and acquired prime land in Nanshan District at a price so low it made others envious.
But that wasn’t all!
The connections Lin Fan had built up recently came into play.
Lin Fan began inviting Yun City’s bigwigs to set up shop in Nanshan District!
As Yun City’s new richest man, Lin Fan had astonishing influence, with people responding to his call almost immediately.
For a time, many leading figures in Yun City’s business world took an intense interest in Nanshan District, a place that had been untouched for so long.
Faced with this, the Yun City Government couldn’t ignore it. As a result, the land prices in Nanshan District skyrocketed overnight. However, it was too late; Lin Fan had already acquired the prime land cheaply. The city government, going with the flow, urgently held a meeting and decided to restart Nanshan District’s development plan.
In the eyes of the Wei Family Company staff, for the past two weeks, Lin Fan seemed to wander aimlessly in Nanshan District, either making calls or appearing idle.
They would never have dreamed that those few phone calls from Lin Fan would change Yun City.
Initially, Lin Fan went to Nanshan District because of the Wei Family, but eventually, the Wei Family’s matter became the least important. His goal became to make something big happen in Nanshan District.
For now, Yun City hasn’t officially announced anything, but that hasn’t stopped Nanshan District from bustling with activity, becoming a new battleground for capital.
Facing Wei Qingxue’s inquiries, Lin Fan temporarily didn’t want to reveal his identity in the Wei Family, so he couldn’t disclose the truth and could only say he submitted an assessment report to the city government.
Lin Fan knew this explanation was hardly convincing, but he didn’t care at all.
They could choose to believe it or not. Regardless, he had already sold out Mingshi Century, and that fact couldn’t be denied by anyone.
All the members of the Wei Family were breaking out in a cold sweat.
No way, did the city government really accept Lin Fan’s suggestion? This is too unbelievable!
Wei Family Mansion.
Elder Wei was sweating profusely: "Lin Fan wrote an assessment report, submitted it to the city government, and the city government decided to restart the Nanshan District development plan?"
"Impossible!"
Elder Wei stood up.
"What is Lin Fan trying to portray himself as? He’s just a delivery guy. How could an assessment report he wrote have such an effect? I simply don’t believe it!"
"There’s only one explanation. Lin Fan was just a lucky fluke, a blind cat stumbling upon a dead mouse. The city’s reboot of the Nanshan development plan had nothing to do with his report, it’s just sheer luck!"
Elder Wei finally arrived at a reasonable explanation and concluded it was the only plausible one.
Lin Fan was just lucky!
But even so, Mingshi Century was indeed sold out by Lin Fan, and the credit should go to him.
"Lin Fan’s performance this month surpassed 200 million. He ranked first in performance and became this month’s MVP, promoted to Ace Sales!"
Everyone who was waiting to see Lin Fan make a joke of himself this time received a resoundingly loud slap in the face.
At the Wei Family Company, no one dared to look down on Lin Fan anymore. If Lin Fan were considered a failure, where would that leave them? Who were they looking down on?
Even within the Wei Family, everyone started to see this son-in-law in a new light.
That evening, after work.
Wei Qingxue and Lin Fan returned home.
As soon as they entered, they smelled the aroma of a sumptuous meal.
The mother-in-law, Li Xueyan, surprisingly had made a lavish dinner. Since Lin Fan entered the Wei Family, he had never seen such a grand display.
"My son-in-law is back. This table of dishes is prepared for you, to celebrate your achievement. Come over and sit down; we can eat soon," Li Xueyan said warmly, pulling Lin Fan in.
Was this the same mother-in-law who previously gave Lin Fan the cold shoulder and spoke harshly?
It was like she had become a different person!
Lin Fan had long anticipated this. Li Xueyan was just an opportunist. Before, when he was a delivery guy, she looked down on him no matter what. Now, having achieved success, naturally, her attitude has shifted.
"Thank you, mother-in-law," Lin Fan smiled slightly and bluntly took a seat.
Li Xueyan pulled Wei Qingxue aside and asked in a low voice, "Daughter, I heard Little Fan made over 200 million in performance today. Roughly how much is his commission?"
Wei Qingxue broke into a sweat, realizing her mother was, as always, most concerned about money.
Wei Qingxue said, "According to the company’s commission formula, it’s about 5 million."
"5 million!" Li Xueyan practically burst with joy.
The son-in-law she used to look down upon had, in an instant, become a millionaire worth 5 million.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Can’t Sleep on This Floor, How About...
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 432: Can’t Sleep on This Floor, How About...
"Little Fan, eat more, I specially cooked this for you. I still don’t know what you like to eat. You can tell me and I’ll cook it for you next time."
Li Xueyan smiled warmly, actively serving Lin Fan food.
This was unbelievable a day ago, but now Li Xueyan was so natural, as if she had always treated Lin Fan so well.
Of course, Lin Fan knew it was because he sold out Mingshi Century today, earning a commission of over 5 million!
Ultimately, it’s all about the money.
Without a doubt, Li Xueyan is a snob. When Lin Fan was a poor courier, she looked down on him and spoke harshly. Now, Lin Fan has earned over 5 million and she treats him like her own son.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I don’t have any favorites in terms of eating, but when I was young, I loved my mom’s sweet and sour ribs. Sadly, after working in the big city, I rarely get to eat them and I miss them."
Li Xueyan immediately said, "That’s no problem. I’ll learn to make it for you tomorrow and see whose taste is better, your mom’s or mine."
Lin Fan said, "Thanks, mother-in-law."
Li Xueyan laughed, "This child, calling me mother-in-law is so formal, just like Qingxue, you can call me Mom."
Because Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue were in a fake marriage, he never treated Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan as his father-in-law and mother-in-law.
However, despite the fake marriage, the relationship still existed.
"Mom," Lin Fan called generously.
Li Xueyan was delighted, "That’s right!"
Beside them, Wei Dazong and Wei Qingxue glanced at each other, was this scene really happening? Was this the same Li Xueyan who shouted about divorcing Lin Fan not long ago?
Wei Qingxue was inwardly happy, her mom finally accepted Lin Fan, which was good news.
Lin Fan was really impressive, single-handedly changing his family’s view of him, truly amazing, and Wei Qingxue felt a bit of admiration for Lin Fan.
"Little Fan, I heard the total sales of Mingshi Century this time exceeded 200 million, and your commission is over 5 million, is that true?" Li Xueyan laughed.
Lin Fan mentally sighed, this mother-in-law finally got to the point.
Lin Fan said, "Indeed, and strictly speaking, it’s nearly 6 million."
Li Xueyan was very pleased, "Little Fan is truly a sincere child, nearly 6 million commission, I wonder how you plan to spend it?"
Lin Fan shrugged, "I don’t usually spend much, and now with so much money, I really don’t know how to spend it, I’ll save it for now."
Li Xueyan was secretly delighted, "It’s true, money shouldn’t be spent carelessly, but necessary spending shouldn’t be ignored. Speaking of spending, I thought of your father-in-law, his car is all worn out, constantly needing repairs, just the repairs are frustrating enough, I ask him to buy a new one, but he refuses, also the company was facing a financial crisis before, everyone’s days were tight. No other choice, I just feel sorry for his hard driving."
Li Xueyan blabbered a lot, anyone could understand her implication.
Wei Qingxue felt very embarrassed, she knew Lin Fan was just a fake son-in-law, how could her mom ask Lin Fan to spend money?
"Mom, dad wants to change the car, later I’ll help him with that," Wei Qingxue said, now that the Wei Family Company had overcome the crisis, and with today’s 200 million, Wei Qingxue would soon have money to help Wei Dazong get a new car.
Li Xueyan said, "We’re all family, no matter who pays, it’s all the same!"
Wei Dazong was sweating coldly, he wasn’t as thick-skinned as Li Xueyan, his wife really had a thick skin, did she think Lin Fan had so quickly forgotten her previous attitude?
Wei Dazong apologized, "Little Fan, don’t listen to your mother-in-law, you manage your own money, no need to help me buy a car, my car is still fine."
Li Xueyan was displeased, "How is it fine, just the repair costs are thousands every month!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Dad, hearing mom say that, your car is indeed due for a change, I’ll take some time to keep an eye out for you."
Which implied he was willing to help buy the car, Li Xueyan was overjoyed, she quickly said, "Thank you, Little Fan."
Wei Dazong hesitated, sighed inwardly, and said nothing in front of Lin Fan.
After dinner, back in the room.
Wei Dazong finally said, "Hinting for Little Fan to help me buy a car wasn’t good!"
Li Xueyan said, "What’s bad about it? He has money now, it’s only right he shows filial piety. Plus, I didn’t force him, it was his own willingness."
Wei Dazong said, "I’ve heard some gossip saying Lin Fan was able to sell out Mingshi Century entirely due to luck, it just so happened that Yun City Government restarted the Nanshan District development plan, and investors flocked there. Lin Fan was like a blind cat finding a dead mouse."
Li Xueyan curled her lips, "I don’t care about that, as long as he made money, what’s wrong with luck? Not just anyone has such luck!"
Wei Dazong had no words, "Alright."
On the other side.
Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue returned to their room.
Lin Fan, as usual, laid out the floor mat.
Wei Qingxue said, "Lin Fan, sorry about my mom, you don’t need to mind her."
Her mother’s warm hospitality towards Lin Fan tonight turned out to be all for his money, the moment she spoke was to hint Lin Fan should help change the car.
She truly felt very embarrassed.
Lin Fan smiled, "I think your mom is right, I’ve seen your dad’s car, it’s really too worn out, it should be changed."
Wei Qingxue said, "Fine, but I can’t use your money, I’ll use your name to buy a car for dad and I’ll pay for it. It’s just... I don’t have that much money right now, so I’ll owe you first."
Lin Fan acknowledged with a sound, but didn’t say much.
Lin Fan finished laying the floor mat, and then went to the toilet.
Wei Qingxue looked at the floor mat, biting her lip, she kind of hated this floor mat, it had become a galaxy separating her and Lin Fan, she really wanted it gone, then Lin Fan wouldn’t be able to sleep on the floor anymore.
Wei Qingxue’s eyes suddenly lit up, she got an idea and almost laughed.
Lin Fan came out of the bathroom, ready to return to the floor mat, only to find it was wet with water splashed everywhere.
"This..." Lin Fan stood stunned.
Wei Qingxue said, "Really sorry, I was going to pour a drink, but accidentally, the hot cup slipped, and it soaked your floor mat."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, is that so, no problem, just can’t sleep on it now."
This girl, really careless.
Wei Qingxue’s face turned red and she couldn’t help but lower her head in embarrassment, "Turning out like this, indeed can’t sleep, why not..."
She was about to suggest Lin Fan sleep on the bed, she was willing to share half of it.
But before she could finish, she raised her hand and saw Lin Fan grabbing a pillow, actually walking outside.
Wei Qingxue hurriedly said, "Lin Fan, you are..."
Lin Fan grinned, "It’s fine, can’t sleep on the mat, I’ll stay on the sofa in the living room for the night."
With that, he cheerfully left.
Damn!
Wei Qingxue was suddenly overwhelmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Let You See What Luck Looks Like!
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Chapter 433: Let You See What Luck Looks Like!
Wei Qingxue was really caught between wanting to laugh and cry.
She had meticulously planned, hoping Lin Fan would come sleep in bed with her, because there were some things she was too embarrassed to say bluntly.
Who knew Lin Fan had absolutely no clue about romantic cues, had taken his pillow and gone to sleep outside, missing yet another good opportunity.
Wei Qingxue felt frustrated, frustrated most of the night, and now she had something on her mind. She realized she might have fallen in love with this man, but she didn’t know if Lin Fan felt the same about her.
At least for now, she couldn’t tell.
The next day.
Lin Fan woke up from the living room sofa, freshened up, and went out to work. To avoid suspicion, he hadn’t been riding with Wei Qingxue lately, instead taking his electric scooter to work.
After Lin Fan left, Li Xueyan stopped Wei Qingxue.
"Qingxue, what’s going on? Why did Little Fan sleep on the sofa last night? Did you two have a fight?" Li Xueyan asked with concern; she didn’t want the couple to quarrel at this time.
Wei Qingxue certainly couldn’t tell the truth, otherwise, the secret would be out that Lin Fan had been sleeping on the floor. That wouldn’t be good.
"No, it’s just that Lin Fan’s been really tired lately and snores when he sleeps. He was worried about disturbing my sleep, so he went to sleep in the living room." Wei Qingxue lied.
Li Xueyan showed a look of approval: "I didn’t know before that he was so considerate. Qingxue, here’s some motherly advice: Little Fan is a good kid, you should really cherish him."
Wei Qingxue seemed a bit dazed: "Hmm..."
Wei Family Company.
Lin Fan returned to the Company and noticed the way people looked at him seemed a bit strange, pointing behind his back.
At the entrance to the sales department, Lin Fan hadn’t entered yet but could hear colleagues gossiping about him.
"Hey, did you hear about Lin Fan’s news?"
"Yeah, heard Lin Fan sold out Mingshi Century completely, it was purely luck!"
"That’s right, he says he wrote the investigation report, submitted it to the city government, and influenced their decision. It was purely coincidence!"
"Actually, it just happened that the city government wanted to restart the development plan for Nanshan District, Lin Fan just got extremely lucky!"
"I have to say his luck is off the charts but this has nothing to do with skill, haha, I thought he was really that impressive, influencing the government’s decision!"
"He probably thought he was really awesome himself!"
Everyone burst into laughter.
Manager Xiao said with resentment: "This kid, his luck is too good. If I had known the city would restart the Nanshan District development plan, I wouldn’t have sent him to Mingshi Century. This over-20-million achievement wouldn’t be counted under him, it’s purely luck!"
Hearing these words, Lin Fan laughed coldly to himself.
Who’s dissatisfied and spreading this within the Company, no wonder he thought everyone’s gaze was strange earlier. It seemed the entire Company believed he relied on luck.
However, the truth is, Lin Fan didn’t rely on luck for this matter; he single-handedly brought Nanshan District back to life, changing the Yun City Government’s decision.
"Good morning, Manager Xiao, good morning everyone."
Lin Fan then walked in, smiling and greeting everyone as if he hadn’t heard their conversation earlier.
Everyone showed knowing looks, lowering their heads, deliberately ignoring Lin Fan.
Manager Xiao chuckled sarcastically: "Good morning, Mr. Lin, congratulations on officially becoming the Company’s salesperson with over 20-million in sales. Now a new month begins, and everyone starts again from zero, hoping Mr. Lin can reach new heights, but it won’t be easy with projects like Mingshi Century being unique."
Manager Xiao was being two-faced, insinuating Lin Fan couldn’t strike it lucky every time.
Everyone laughed quietly.
A new month began, everyone starting from zero, with Mingshi Century’s ’bug’ not existing, Lin Fan surely couldn’t make any sales.
He was instantly knocked back to his original state!
At the end of the month, everyone believed Lin Fan would be at the tail end, and they’d once again have the excuse to unabashedly mock Lin Fan as worthless.
Lin Fan naturally understood Manager Xiao’s message, merely pretending not to know, smiling and saying: "Thank you, Manager Xiao, for your blessings. I will work hard. Oh, Manager Xiao, Mingshi Century has been sold out by me. Next, where should I be assigned?"
Manager Xiao thought for a moment, then said: "Go to Jinyan Square. This Square currently is the Company’s largest real estate, consisting of several buildings. We have colleagues separately managing them. You can be in charge of Building A."
Lin Fan didn’t hesitate: "Alright, I’ll go check it out later."
Everyone secretly showed disdainful looks.
Jinyan Square, located in a mature urban area, doesn’t face the same situation as Nanshan District, so there’s no worry about sudden higher-level decisions.
Jinyan Square’s foot traffic is decent, with daily visitors. Whether a sale can happen relies on the salesperson’s skills.
In summary, this complex completely depends on the salesperson’s ability. If one can sell units at Jinyan Square, it indicates decent ability!
But no one believed Lin Fan had the ability, so they all thought Lin Fan was doomed, when real skill was tested, it’s when Lin Fan would return to his original state.
Everyone began waiting to see Lin Fan make a fool of himself again.
"Manager Xiao, I’ve thought it over, I’ll head over to Jinyan Square now." Lin Fan said.
Manager Xiao chuckled: "Alright, Mr. Lin is really full of vigor."
Lin Fan smiling: "Can’t help it, sold 2 million yesterday, earned nearly 600 thousand, planning to quickly break through to 1 million in income."
When he finished, Lin Fan turned and went out.
The audacity!
Everyone seemed to be hit where it hurt, teeth-gritting in anger, Lin Fan earning 600 thousand in one day—it was too painful!
Everybody was filled with envy and resentment, their hearts almost bleeding.
"This punk just relied on luck, what’s so great about that!"
"Breaking 1 million? Dream on."
"This worthless guy, so full of himself, he’s not getting a penny next!"
Everyone sourly vented at Lin Fan.
Manager Xiao sneered: "Lin Fan, you got through by fluke. I want to see how big a joke you make next time!"
Lin Fan walked out, a subtle cold smirk on his lips.
He had deliberately mentioned how much he made, he didn’t need to see to know their faces must be furious.
He loved it when they disliked him but couldn’t get rid of him, while facing the fact he made 600 thousand, hehe, it was truly too heart-wrenching.
Arrived at Jinyan Square.
After observing for a while, Lin Fan could confirm it: Jinyan Square was tough to sell! This really needed a salesperson’s ability.
Lin Fan’s eyes sparkled with a playful idea: he sold out Mingshi Square by ability, and they laughed at his luck. Now he’d show them what Lin Fan called luck.
"Building A!" Lin Fan stood beneath Building A at Jinyan Square, glanced upwards, "I’m going to sell this building, top-tier Koi Carp Luck, activate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 434 Absurd! This Can’t Be True
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 434 Absurd! This Can’t Be True
Wei Family Mansion.
A new day. In the courtyard, Elder Wei sat on a wicker chair basking in the sun, with the old butler attending to him.
"Elder Wei, now the whole Wei Family is spreading rumors that Lin Fan only managed to sell out Mingshi Century purely by luck. It seems Lin Fan’s attempt to prove himself and change everyone’s opinion has failed," remarked the old butler.
Elder Wei nodded, "He did rely on luck, so it’s no wonder people are saying that. If he wants to prove himself, we’ll have to see how he performs next."
The old butler added, "I see that people aren’t really optimistic. After all, luck isn’t something you have every time, especially not such good luck."
Wei Family Company.
Wei Qingxue returned to the company and found everyone discussing Lin Fan, saying it was all about luck yesterday, like a blind cat stumbling upon a dead mouse.
Wei Qingxue was a bit puzzled but had no way to refute it. After all, she was the CEO and also Lin Fan’s wife, so it wasn’t appropriate for her to step in.
"CEO Madam, your live-in son-in-law is really causing a stir this time. Whether within the family or the company, everyone’s talking about him," said Wei Zihan with a chuckle.
Wei Qingxue responded coldly, "What’s it to you? Just mind your own business."
Wei Zihan covered her mouth, laughing, "I’m also a member of the Wei Family, so of course it concerns me. What’s being said is that Lin Fan lacks ability and is only lucky, which isn’t exactly a positive comment."
Everyone smirked.
Wei Qingxue laughed, "You say Lin Fan relied on luck, then so be it. What’s the big deal? In sales, luck is indeed a significant part. You’re just sour. Regardless of what you say, Lin Fan earned the company 200 million, with over 5 million in commission for himself. Do you have that?"
Those words were truly cutting.
Indeed, everyone mocking Lin Fan for relying on luck was just being envious. If that luck were theirs, they would be over the moon.
Envy as they might, Lin Fan earned a commission they could never get.
Having his tail stepped on, Wei Zihan’s face darkened, "Your worthless husband, what’s there to envy? It was just a lucky break. I bet he won’t be able to close any deals in the future and will eventually be eliminated. You’ll be crying then!"
Wei Qingxue also started feeling angry, "Wei Zihan, shut your mouth!"
At the same time.
Sales Department.
Manager Xiao said, "Lin Fan has already gone to Jinyan Square. You all need to get moving too. You better work hard to open more deals. After all, unlike Lin Fan, you guys aren’t live-in sons-in-law who have a wife to support you even if you’re unemployed."
Everyone burst out laughing.
Manager Xiao remarked, "Lin Fan got lucky and took last month’s top sales spot. Losing to a nobody like him makes me feel bad for you!"
"He only relied on luck. He won’t have such luck in the future!"
"He might struggle to close even a single deal next!"
"According to the company’s last-place elimination system, if someone is at the bottom for three consecutive months, they can be dismissed. Without any surprises, it will be Lin Fan!"
Everyone chattered, full of envy, jealousy, and hatred towards Lin Fan, wishing they could use the harshest words to humiliate him.
Manager Xiao sneered, "That guy winning last month’s sales championship left a bad taste. But everyone doesn’t need to mind it too much. As long as he ranks last for the next few months, it only further proves he purely relied on luck. Then you can laugh at him all you want. I want to see him leave in disgrace amidst a chorus of jeers!"
Everyone laughed again.
"Huh? What’s going on?"
Suddenly, they heard the sales assistant exclaim in surprise.
Everyone turned to look at the sales assistant.
Manager Xiao asked, "What are you making a fuss about?"
The sales assistant rubbed their eyes, staring incredulously at the computer, "I just got an alert from the platform. There’s a new deal closed."
Everyone exchanged puzzled looks. They were all in here, so where did the deal come from?
The sales manager said, "Jinyan Square Tower A. It’s Lin Fan’s deal."
"Wait!"
"There’s another one!"
"Oh my, it suddenly surged!"
"What the heck? Jinyan Square Tower A sold out again?"
The sales assistant let out a series of exclamations, finally in shock themselves.
Manager Xiao and the others, who were originally laughing, became petrified upon hearing this.
Damn!
Lin Fan sold out Jinyan Square Tower A?
Manager Xiao exclaimed excitedly, "Impossible, how could this be? He just went over there not long ago and sold out the whole building at once? It must be a platform error, it definitely is!"
The sales assistant, a bit speechless, replied, "Manager, don’t keep blaming platform errors, there’s really no error. Though it’s unclear how, Lin Fan indeed sold out Tower A."
Manager Xiao was dumbfounded, even trembling a little. He had just said Lin Fan was sure to fail to open any deals. This was a staggering blow to the face!
How did Lin Fan do it? He actually felt a bit afraid.
Executive Office.
Wei Qingxue was still arguing with Wei Zihan. Wei Qingxue was a bit angry; Lin Fan had saved Wei Zihan before, yet she was ungrateful, mocking Lin Fan sarcastically, which was truly infuriating.
It was as if Wei Zihan had forgotten being saved by Lin Fan, and continued mocking both Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue.
"Wei Qingxue, did I say anything wrong? Your husband is a loser. Is it that hard to admit you have a useless husband?" Wei Zihan scoffed.
As they argued, the two suddenly noticed a commotion among the company employees, as if something had happened.
"Oh my gosh! Is it true?"
"How is that possible!"
"This is amazing!"
Everyone was in a state of shock and awe.
Wei Qingxue frowned, "What are you talking about?"
The room went silent immediately, but the look of shock remained on their faces.
An employee said, "CEO, everyone is saying that Mr. Lin sold out Jinyan Square Tower A again, the entire tower, all sold in just an hour."
"What?"
Both Wei Qingxue and Wei Zihan were dumbfounded.
Wei Zihan remarked, "What are you saying? Who made up such ridiculous news? How could Lin Fan possibly sell out Jinyan Tower A? That’s absurd!"
That employee said, "The news came from the sales department."
"Nonsense!"
Wei Zihan huffed, pulling out her phone to call Manager Xiao, "Manager Xiao, everyone’s saying Lin Fan sold out Jinyan Square Tower A. Quickly come out and debunk this rumor!"
Such rumors were truly infuriating. Even knowing they’re false was annoying to her.
Manager Xiao’s voice was lifeless, "Miss, it’s true."
Wei Zihan said, "What do you mean by ’true or false’? Just do as you’re told!"
Manager Xiao wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, "Miss, I mean Mr. Lin’s thing is true. He really just sold out all of Jinyan Square Tower A."
"Huh?"
Wei Zihan was petrified, her phone slipping from her hand and falling to the ground.
Wei Family Mansion.
Elder Wei sat on the couch, the sunlight was so cozy that he nearly fell asleep.
But he was awakened by the ringing of the phone.
The old butler answered the call and returned, "Elder, I just received news that Lin Fan sold out all of Jinyan Square Tower A."
"What?" Elder Wei was utterly shocked, suddenly wide awake.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Let’s Divorce
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 435: Let’s Divorce
Wei Family Company.
Upon hearing about Lin Fan, Wei Zihan was so shocked that her phone slipped from her hand. Feeling weak, she quickly found a chair to sit on to avoid the embarrassment of collapsing to the floor.
Just moments ago, she was mocking Lin Fan, and now this slap in the face was too fierce for her to bear.
Wei Qingxue, on the other hand, was overjoyed.
Oh my god, this news is actually true!
Lin Fan is amazing, truly remarkable!
She even felt her blood boiling for a moment; she never imagined that the fake son-in-law she casually picked up at the entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau would bring her such a massive surprise, one after another.
She couldn’t believe that a courier could achieve this; it was truly unbelievable.
"Today at noon, everyone head to the seafood restaurant next door; I’m treating," Wei Qingxue announced excitedly.
Lin Fan’s outstanding achievements make her proud as his wife, immensely proud. Who would dare look down on Lin Fan now? They must be blind.
The president is treating, so everyone was naturally happy. Cheers erupted, and for a moment, everyone seemed to have forgotten that they were mocking Lin Fan not long ago.
Wei Qingxue glanced at the pale Wei Zihan beside her. She didn’t need to waste her breath with her anymore; Lin Fan’s achievements spoke for themselves.
Wei Qingxue returned to the office and immediately called Lin Fan.
"Dear wife, I’m busy right now, what’s up?" Lin Fan asked, as he was helping a customer with their home purchase.
Wei Qingxue said, "Nothing much, just letting you know to come to the seafood restaurant across from the company for lunch; keep busy."
Lin Fan replied, "Alright, I’ll head over once I’m done."
Lin Fan hung up the phone and continued his work.
Noon, twelve o’clock.
At the seafood restaurant, Wei Family Company employees gathered for lunch, making it pretty lively.
Lin Fan hadn’t arrived yet, but everyone started eating.
Wei Qingxue was very happy today; to be precise, she had been very happy these past two days because Lin Fan made her proud.
In her heart, Lin Fan was already different from the Lin Fan he used to be. The Lin Fan now, she really liked him, yes, she really liked him.
Even though Lin Fan came from a rural background, even though Lin Fan was just a courier in the past, she didn’t mind any of that.
Maybe, this is what love is!
Thinking about it, Wei Qingxue’s cheeks turned red; love—she had never been in a relationship in her life, didn’t know what love really was.
Could this be love!
She, the grand Wei family’s young lady, had fallen for a rural guy!
Many females, desperate to get married, continually went on blind dates, holding many requirements for their partners, such as needing to have a house and a car, having a stable income, and marriage needing a bride price of 300 thousand yuan...
As if pricing themselves openly like a product.
Those who can afford it, buy it; those who can’t, give up—marriage seemingly becoming a transaction of money.
This can hardly be called love!
If one truly loves someone, they really wouldn’t care if they have money, a house, a car, or a bride price!
Just like Wei Qingxue at this moment, this period with Lin Fan had made her realize Lin Fan’s various qualities, she was purely in love with Lin Fan himself, regardless of material things.
"I never thought, I, Wei Qingxue, would one day fall in love with a man." Wei Qingxue teased herself inwardly.
Initially, because she didn’t want to marry someone she didn’t like, she found Lin Fan for a fake marriage, never thinking she’d actually fall for this fake marriage partner one day.
Lin Fan hadn’t arrived yet, Wei Qingxue felt a bit lonely, so she called for red wine and started drinking on her own.
Midway through the meal, Lin Fan still hadn’t come.
Wei Qingxue was already a bit drunk.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue received a call from Elder Wei.
"Qingxue, has Lin Fan returned to the company yet?" Elder Wei asked.
Wei Qingxue replied, "Not yet, Grandpa, do you need him for something?"
Elder Wei said, "Ask him to come home when he’s free. I want to see him."
Wei Qingxue felt a bit worried, "Grandpa, you wouldn’t..."
After all, Elder Wei didn’t like Lin Fan in the past, and Wei Qingxue worried Elder Wei would give Lin Fan trouble.
Elder Wei smiled, saying, "Don’t worry, I have no other intentions. It’s just that he has secured huge contracts in succession, earning so much for the company. I never expected him to be a sales genius, and I want to have a chat with him."
Wei Qingxue was relieved, "Okay, I’ll tell him later."
Wei Family Mansion.
After hanging up the phone.
Elder Wei sighed, "Who would have thought I’d come to appreciate Lin Fan? Initially, upon learning he was just a courier, I didn’t pay him any attention."
The old butler beside him said, "Everyone has their strengths. Perhaps the young master hadn’t found his place before, which is why he was a courier. Now he’s finally on the right path."
Elder Wei said, "That’s right. If yesterday’s selling out of Mingshi Century was due to luck, then what can be said about selling out Jinyan Square’s Building A today? Is it still luck? That’s clearly impossible. How can a person have that kind of luck? It can only mean he has that ability! Even if it’s luck, if someone can consistently have such good luck, he’s a blessing to the company!"
Elder Wei was full of praise for Lin Fan, and already believed Lin Fan had capabilities. A person can’t always win relying purely on luck; it also requires skill!
If Lin Fan knew Elder Wei thought this way, he would probably laugh.
Elder Wei’s opinion was completely reversed.
The selling out of Mingshi Century wasn’t due to luck; it was indeed Lin Fan’s maneuvering that changed the Yun City Government’s decisions, selling out Mingshi Century in the process.
Jinyan Square’s Building A, however, was purely luck.
Lin Fan activated his top-tier Koi Carp Luck; after arriving at Jinyan Square, he leveraged this luck to sell Building A.
Finally finishing the home purchase affairs, Lin Fan freed himself and headed to the seafood restaurant.
By this time, noon had passed, and the company’s employees were wrapping up their meals.
Lin Fan walked in.
Immediately, everyone’s eyes were on Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin!"
Everyone respectfully greeted him, their gazes full of admiration.
They shared Elder Wei’s opinion, believing Lin Fan’s ability to sell out Jinyan Square’s Building A showed extraordinary skill; he was undoubtedly a sales prodigy!
No one dared to ridicule Lin Fan as relying on luck anymore. After all, where could anyone continually find so much luck!
"Mr. Lin, congratulations on achieving yet another feat. You currently rank as the champion of the monthly sales leaderboard, and it’s simply impossible to be surpassed. My admiration for Mr. Lin is boundless; let me toast to you."
Manager Xiao eagerly stepped forward, intending to toast Lin Fan.
But Lin Fan didn’t spare him a glance. His behavior, differing in front and behind people, was somewhat nauseating to Lin Fan.
His focus was on Wei Qingxue.
He noticed Wei Qingxue’s flushed face, seeming somewhat drunk.
Passing Manager Xiao, Lin Fan went to Wei Qingxue’s side.
Manager Xiao was left in an awkward daze.
"Dear wife, why did you drink?" Lin Fan asked.
Wei Qingxue, slightly tipsy, was delighted to see Lin Fan arrive, "You’re finally here, you must be hungry, sit down and eat. By the way, have you all finished eating? Go on ahead, leave first."
Wei Qingxue sent everyone away.
In the private room, only she and Lin Fan were left.
"Lin Fan, you’re amazing, I want to toast you," Wei Qingxue poured a drink and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Thank you."
He took the drink.
But Wei Qingxue, losing her balance, fell into his arms; she genuinely was quite drunk.
Lin Fan put down the drink and helped her up.
Wei Qingxue looked up at Lin Fan and smiled, "Lin Fan, let me ask you, do you like me?"
Lin Fan was a bit bewildered, "What?"
Suddenly, Wei Qingxue grabbed Lin Fan’s neck and tilted her head up, moving close to Lin Fan, almost touching his lips.
Lin Fan was startled and quickly stopped her, "Dear wife, you’re drunk."
Wei Qingxue felt a bit frustrated, then sat down and, after a moment of silence, said, "Lin Fan, maybe we should get a divorce now, just go right ahead and process the divorce procedure!"

chapters.title: Chapter 436: After the Divorce, I Will Officially Pursue You
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 436: After the Divorce, I Will Officially Pursue You
Lin Fan looked at Wei Qingxue: "Are you serious, or is it just drunk talk? Why not wait until you’re sober to say it?"
Wei Qingxue said: "Although I’ve had a bit to drink, I’m very clear-headed. I’ve decided, Lin Fan, I want a divorce from you."
Lin Fan said: "Why did you suddenly decide this?"
Wei Qingxue said: "Because I like you, Lin Fan, I’ve realized I’ve fallen for you."
Originally, she didn’t have the courage to say these words. She had never confessed to anyone before, but now with a bit of alcohol courage, she finally said it.
Lin Fan was stunned for a moment: "You like me?"
This damn charm, it really can’t be stopped; before he knew it, he had captured another young lady’s heart.
However, since the other party was Wei Qingxue, he was still a bit surprised, because when Wei Qingxue married him, her purpose was very clear—it was fake. He thought Wei Qingxue would be quite guarded against him.
So in their daily interactions, Lin Fan was also careful, trying to avoid offending her, just like earlier when Wei Qingxue suddenly wanted to kiss him, his first reaction was to stop her, fearing that Wei Qingxue’s drunken confusion would make her hold it against him afterward.
After all, before they got married, there was a three-Chapter agreement, and the first rule was not to touch her.
Wei Qingxue pouted, pouting: "I just like you, so what?"
Lin Fan rubbed his head and laughed: "Well... you like me, so why do you want to divorce me?"
Ah, women’s thoughts are really hard to grasp.
Wei Qingxue said: "Because you don’t like me, you don’t have to lie to me. I can feel it, there’s no place for me in your heart."
Lin Fan said: "Alright."
Wei Qingxue said: "So I want to divorce you, and after we divorce, Lin Fan, I will officially pursue you until you like me too. The day we remarry will be the day you propose to me. Lin Fan, don’t think of escaping, because I will persistently pursue you until I succeed!"
Lin Fan: "..."
To be honest, maybe because of that marriage contract, he really didn’t have those feelings for Wei Qingxue. It wasn’t that Wei Qingxue wasn’t beautiful—quite the opposite, she’s very pretty—but he just didn’t have that kind of thought about her. Maybe he suppressed himself subconsciously.
Moreover, he agreed to marry Wei Qingxue because it was a task from the system, which further suppressed his inner feelings, causing him not to truly get to know Wei Qingxue.
Maybe in the future, he might like Wei Qingxue, but not now.
So Lin Fan didn’t say much, just agreed with Wei Qingxue.
After settling the bill and leaving the restaurant, they rushed to the civil affairs bureau to complete the divorce procedures.
When the divorce procedures were completed, Wei Qingxue was completely sober.
She suddenly felt a bit regretful, a bit scared that she might never have the chance to be with Lin Fan again.
Lin Fan, on the other hand, felt relieved. The system’s task had long been completed, but since Wei Qingxue hadn’t mentioned divorce, he just continued. Now that they were finally divorced, he was single again and truly felt a sense of ease.
In Wei Qingxue’s Porsche.
"Lin Fan, we’re divorced now, so that marriage contract is automatically void. Later, I will transfer the money to you; as previously promised, there will be 1 million as a remuneration for you," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan responded with an "oh" and said nothing more.
Wei Qingxue said: "Do you still want to stay at the company for work? If not, I can help you resign, but I hope you stay because you’re doing well, and this job is better than being a delivery guy, right?"
Lin Fan shook his head and said: "No, since we’re divorced, if I stay at the company, people will gossip. I don’t mind, but I don’t want you to be talked about. Besides, I’ve made quite a bit of money at the company, it’s enough."
Wei Qingxue said: "Alright then..."
She was still a bit disappointed; she had hoped Lin Fan would stay.
"Grandfather wanted to see you, but since you’ve resigned, it’s no longer necessary. I’ll let Grandfather know later."
As she spoke, Wei Qingxue lowered her head, looking a bit lost.
Lin Fan said: "Hmm, sorry, calling you wife... out of habit, Qingxue, if you need my help in the future, feel free to ask. Also... stay in touch frequently."
Wei Qingxue giggled: "Of course, I said I would pursue you, so I must keep in touch with you frequently. When I ask you out for dinner, you can’t refuse."
Lin Fan rubbed the back of his head: "Dinner is no problem. As long as I’m free, I’ll definitely agree."
Wei Qingxue said: "Then let’s start now instead of later. How about you accompany me for dinner tonight?"
Lin Fan said: "Sure... but, what do we call this, a blind date?"
Wei Qingxue blushed: "What do you think?"
Lin Fan agreed to accompany her for dinner tonight, and she was very happy; nothing else matters.
Lin Fan smiled: "Then I’ll be off now, see you tonight."
Wei Qingxue said: "Hmm, once I find the place and time, I’ll call you."
Lin Fan got off the car, walked over to his electric scooter, rode it, waved his hand casually, and left.
Watching Lin Fan’s back, Wei Qingxue showed a complex expression; she didn’t know if suddenly deciding to divorce Lin Fan was the right choice.
"Lin Fan, I must pursue you!" Wei Qingxue made up her mind; she couldn’t accept the result of losing Lin Fan, as her heart already belonged to him.
"Let it start with tonight’s first date!" Wei Qingxue resolutely talked to herself; it was time for Lin Fan to get to know her well.
Wei Family Mansion.
Elder Wei had been waiting for a long time, still not seeing Lin Fan, growing a little impatient.
Originally, as the head of the Wei Family, Lin Fan, as a junior, shouldn’t let him wait so long.
"Elder Wei, shall I call the Third Miss and ask about the situation?" the old butler suggested.
Elder Wei shook his head: "No, maybe he’s still busy, let’s wait a bit more."
He didn’t want to show he was eager to see Lin Fan, although he was indeed a bit anxious. Lin Fan was a sales genius, the likes of which had never appeared in the Wei Family Company. Internally, he had some expectations and hopes for Lin Fan.
Perhaps, Lin Fan’s presence could greatly assist Wei Qingxue, as he had never been confident about her since she still had many shortcomings. If the two of them were united, perhaps he could confidently retire.
He could never have imagined that one day, the son-in-law he had initially strongly opposed would bring him hope.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, the phone rang, and the old butler answered, then immediately handed the phone to Elder Wei.
"Elder Wei, it’s the Third Miss."
Elder Wei quickly took the phone: "Xiaoxue, is Lin Fan coming over?"
Wei Qingxue apologized: "I’m sorry, Grandfather, Lin Fan may not be able to come over."
Elder Wei frowned: "Why, are the company matters not finished yet?"
Wei Qingxue hesitated before saying: "No, it’s like this, Grandfather, Lin Fan is no longer an employee of the company. I’ve just divorced him."
"Ah, what?"
Elder Wei was taken aback, nearly jumping out of his rattan chair.

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Mother-in-Law in High Spirits
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Chapter 437: Mother-in-Law in High Spirits
Yujing District.
In the afternoon, Li Xueyan was carrying a shopping basket on her way home from the supermarket. Her basket was filled with many fresh ingredients she had just bought.
One of those ingredients was ribs.
Last night, Lin Fan mentioned he wanted to eat sugar-steamed ribs made by his mom. Although Li Xueyan had never cooked this dish before, she was eager to learn and prepare it for Lin Fan.
Li Xueyan walked with her head held high, wishing everyone could see her.
It was a stark contrast from before when she wished she could hide away.
At that time, she thought Lin Fan had shamed their family so much that she couldn’t face anyone and even feared stepping out to buy groceries.
But over time, her impression of Lin Fan had completely transformed.
It was because Lin Fan had performed exceptionally well.
First, he heroically saved a neighbor’s grandchild in the district, earning unanimous praise, which boosted Li Xueyan’s pride and slightly changed her impression of him.
Then Lin Fan joined the Wei Family Company and astonishingly sold out the Mingshi Century in a single day, generating a staggering 200 million in sales for the company, with a personal commission of 6 million!
No one could match this achievement. At least in this Yujing District, Lin Fan could walk with his head held high, and people would sing his praises.
But that wasn’t all!
Just this morning, she learned from Wei Dazong that Lin Fan had sold out the A Building of Jinyan Square in less than a morning!
Li Xueyan was ecstatic.
The two mega-deals combined meant that Lin Fan’s commission was likely to have surpassed 10 million.
In just two days, Lin Fan went from being a penniless courier to a multimillionaire!
This was a genuine 10 million!
Just thinking about the number—one followed by seven zeros—made Li Xueyan’s face flush with excitement.
Lin Fan was her son-in-law, and he lived with them; his 10 million was practically hers too!
Last night, she hinted for Lin Fan to help Wei Dazong get a new car.
It seemed that this time, not only could they get a nice new car, but they might even buy a house.
Lin Fan had been recognized as a sales prodigy by the company and family. He was sure to earn even more money in the future.
Li Xueyan had a dream of one day living in a grand villa. Although the district was nice, it couldn’t compare to the comfort and status of a standalone mansion.
Moreover, a grand villa represented wealth, a different league than district living.
Li Xueyan never imagined that one day she would see the hope of a leap in social class through Lin Fan.
She used to pin all her hopes on Wei Qingxue, thinking that once Wei Qingxue could inherit the Wei Family’s assets, living in a grand villa would only be a matter of time.
But that future seemed a bit far off, with the old master still in charge, and who knows how many years that would take.
She used to look down on Lin Fan, but now he represented hope. As long as Lin Fan earned more, their family could live in a grand villa, and this would happen much sooner than relying on Wei Qingxue.
After all, Lin Fan was a sales prodigy.
So, in pursuit of her dream of living in a grand villa, what was learning to make sugar-steamed ribs for Lin Fan?
If Lin Fan wanted something to eat, she was willing to cook it for him, and she would even wash his feet.
Indeed, money makes the world go round, and the ancients weren’t wrong about that.
"Ah, what a coincidence, Sister Yan, buying groceries?" Suddenly, someone greeted her from the opposite side, snapping Li Xueyan out of her thoughts.
Li Xueyan looked and saw it was Sister Fang.
The grandchild Lin Fan saved that night was the granddaughter of this Sister Fang.
Sister Fang and Li Xueyan usually got along well and often exercised together in the morning.
Li Xueyan smiled and said, "Yes, my son-in-law is coming home for dinner tonight, so I’m preparing early."
Sister Fang replied, "That’s wonderful, Little Fan is such a great young man. I can’t praise him enough for what he did last time."
Li Xueyan laughed, "Sister Fang, you’re too kind. To Little Fan, with his skills, it was just a small matter. But I will convey your gratitude to him."
Sister Fang said, "This is quite the bountiful basket. Is there a celebration at home?"
Li Xueyan intentionally raised her voice, grinning, "Sort of, Little Fan isn’t working as a courier anymore. He’s helping out at the company now."
Sister Fang replied with an "Oh," "I think you mentioned it before, something about sales?"
Li Xueyan said, "Yes, this kid has earned our pride. In just the last two days, he closed huge deals. Just yesterday, he sold out a whole building project in one day, earning over 200 million."
Sister Fang was flabbergasted, her eyes wide open, "What, over 200 million?"
Li Xueyan enjoyed flaunting and loved seeing this expression on her face: "It’s true, Little Fan’s commission alone is several hundred."
"Oh my god!" Sister Fang was petrified.
Their conversation attracted the attention of passersby, who were also shocked by what they heard.
The Wei Family’s live-in son-in-law switched from courier to sales and generated 200 million in sales in one day, which was truly amazing.
"Oh my god, is it true, that’s incredible!"
"Turns out he’s a sales prodigy who hadn’t found the right path before."
"Suddenly, my son with a 300,000 annual salary seems like a failure."
"I never expected it, this young man is the pride of our community, not only skillful but also so capable of earning money!"
"Where can I find such a son-in-law? Give me a dozen!"
The crowd began discussing, and everyone envied Li Xueyan greatly.
These words gave Li Xueyan immense satisfaction. Lin Fan was truly amazing, making her incredibly proud, and indeed her pride.
"And that’s not all!"
Li Xueyan continued, releasing another astonishing piece of news, "Little Fan earned 200 million for the company yesterday, and today, he sold out another building. This time it probably won’t be less than 200 million either."
"What?"
"Oh my god!"
"Is it true?"
The crowd was in awe, overwhelmed by admiration. Just now, it was already impressive, but to achieve such feats twice, it was simply astounding.
Sister Fang, holding Li Xueyan’s hand, sighed, "Sister Yan, you’re truly blessed, having such a wonderful son-in-law. You’ll never have to worry again. I’m so envious!"
Li Xueyan was exceedingly pleased, almost on cloud nine, as if she had sold out the buildings herself.
In sheer satisfaction, Li Xueyan bid farewell, "Sister Fang, I won’t keep you any longer. I need to hurry home to prepare dinner for my son-in-law. Let’s arrange a morning walk another day!"
Li Xueyan walked off with her head high and chest out.
The community neighbors all sighed. In the face of such astounding sales figures, they couldn’t even be jealous, just humbly accept it.
For a moment, Lin Fan became the talk of the district.
Back home, Li Xueyan was in high spirits. A good son-in-law gave her the capital to show off, and this sense of fulfillment was unprecedented for her.
"It’s getting late, I should call to check when they’ll be back for dinner," thought Li Xueyan as she dialed Wei Qingxue’s number.
"Qingxue, when are you and Little Fan coming home? I want to start cooking," said Li Xueyan.
Wei Qingxue replied, "Mom, we’re not coming home for dinner tonight."
Li Xueyan was taken aback, "What did you say? Why not, I’ve already bought the groceries."
Wei Qingxue said, "Well, this afternoon, I just divorced Lin Fan."
"What?"
Li Xueyan was thunderstruck, vision going dark, almost fainting on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: Resolving the Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Chapter 438: Resolving the Crisis
The time has already reached evening, the night is about to fall.
Lin Fan rode his electric bike and arrived at a mall. Wei Qingxue had arranged to meet him there, planning to shop first and then have dinner.
As Lin Fan reached the mall, it suddenly started to rain. He quickly parked his bike and ran over to a nearby coffee shop for shelter.
Meanwhile, inside the coffee shop.
Chu Yufei, the eldest daughter of the Chu Family in Yun City, also hurriedly arrived.
Today, her mother, Madam Chu, had arranged to meet her here. Madam Chu was quite mysterious about the meeting, and Chu Yufei came over as soon as she finished work.
The meeting was originally scheduled for half an hour ago, and Madam Chu had already urged her several times, but she was delayed a bit by company matters.
Upon entering the shop, she saw Madam Chu waving at her.
Chu Yufei walked over and saw that beside Madam Chu sat a young man in his twenties, quite handsome, wearing branded clothes worth at least several thousand. He had good taste, though he was slightly short.
"Let me introduce, Luo Jinshan, Young Master Luo, just returned from studying in the United Kingdom, planning to inherit billions!" Madam Chu laughed, particularly excited by the last sentence.
Chu Yufei was stunned and instinctively shook hands with him, politely saying, "Hello."
Then she pulled Madam Chu aside and whispered, "Mom, what are you up to?"
Madam Chu said, "What else? It’s a blind date, of course. You’re not getting any younger, it’s time to get married. I think Young Master Luo is great; you should seize the opportunity."
Chu Yufei was speechless. She had no intention of getting married, and Madam Chu was taking matters into her own hands. Had she known it was a blind date, she would’ve made an excuse not to come.
Ever since Chu Yufei entered, Young Master Luo had been staring at her, unable to take his eyes off.
"Hello, Miss Chu... may I call you Princess Yu?" Luo Jinshan stood up, looking eager.
Chu Yufei wasn’t fond of the way he looked at her and replied indifferently, "Oh, you can call me whatever you like."
"Princess Yu, please sit." Luo Jinshan hurried over to help Chu Yufei with her chair.
"Thank you." Chu Yufei said politely and sat down.
After Chu Yufei sat, Luo Jinshan reached out and gently flicked her hair, smiling, "Princess Yu, your hair is so smooth, so fragrant."
Chu Yufei frowned, thinking Luo Jinshan appeared gentlemanly, but who knew he’d be so forward upon meeting?
Chu Yufei wasn’t planning to get involved with Luo Jinshan to begin with, and now she detested him even more.
If Madam Chu weren’t present, who knows what Luo Jinshan might do. Perhaps he was mindful of Madam Chu, as Luo Jinshan promptly returned to his seat.
Madam Chu was pleased to see this, thinking it was good that Young Master Luo liked Princess Yu; she had been worried Young Master Luo wouldn’t fancy her.
"Young Master Luo, my Princess Yu has never dated anyone, never touched a guy’s hand, never taken advantage of anyone, so you can relax." Madam Chu beamed.
Chu Yufei was embarrassed, her face turning red: "Mom, what are you saying!"
Luo Jinshan laughed, "That’s great. I know Princess Yu is waiting for her Prince Charming, and I’m confident that I am your true Prince Charming."
Luo Jinshan wore a confident smile, almost etched with the belief that he is Chu Yufei’s Prince Charming.
Chu Yufei was momentarily speechless.
Madam Chu, with a look of admiration, said, "Young Master Luo, I’m telling you, as I see it now, you and my Princess Yu truly make a perfect couple, a match made in heaven."
"Thank you for the compliment, Auntie. By the way, I’ve booked the best Western restaurant in town, Princess Yu, how about we go there for dinner later?" Luo Jinshan suggested, exchanging a look with Madam Chu.
Madam Chu understood and said smilingly, "Princess Yu, I have other matters to attend to, so I’ll leave now. You and Young Master Luo should have a good chat, okay?"
Saying this, Madam Chu stood up to leave.
Chu Yufei hurriedly stood up as well, saying, "Sorry, it’s getting late. I should head home too; Mom, I’ll leave with you."
Madam Chu was displeased, pulled Chu Yufei aside and said sternly, "Why are you being like this? Don’t you want to find a satisfactory husband? You’re not getting any younger, you shouldn’t stay in the Chu Family."
Chu Yufei replied, "Mom, he’s not the one."
Madam Chu said angrily, "What are you thinking? Young Master Luo has a great family background. What else aren’t you satisfied with?"
Luo Jinshan chuckled, "Princess Yu, that restaurant has hard-to-get seats, you wouldn’t want to decline, would you?"
Chu Yufei really didn’t want to have dinner with Luo Jinshan, but Madam Chu’s pressure left her a little troubled.
Madam Chu assertively said, "Stop talking so much, that’s settled. I have matters to attend to, I’ll leave first."
Madam Chu then left the coffee shop.
As she walked out the coffee shop door, she didn’t notice she brushed past Lin Fan.
Lin Fan, being in a hurry to escape the rain, didn’t pay attention to Madam Chu and just opened the door and walked inside.
Once inside, Lin Fan saw Chu Yufei with Luo Jinshan.
