"Princess Yu, why don’t we leave now, take my car, it’s a limited edition supercar. Let me give you a treat." Luo Jinshan grinned, very confident.
Chu Yufei was unwilling, "I haven’t even received the coffee I ordered yet."
Luo Jinshan said, "Why bother with coffee? Later, I’ll treat you to some 82 Lafite."
"Princess Yu, what a coincidence." Lin Fan walked over, smiling.
He could tell Chu Yufei didn’t want to go with the man, so he decided to come over and help.
Chu Yufei was delighted upon seeing Lin Fan, "Lin..."
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan interrupted her, smiled and said, "Honey, is the coffee you bought for me ready? I’ve been waiting for a long time, so I came over to check."
Chu Yufei was stunned, what? Lin Fan just called her honey?
Luo Jinshan’s face changed, "Princess Yu, who is this?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Hello, I’m Princess Yu’s boyfriend. I was just wondering, Princess Yu, who is he?"
Chu Yufei then realized Lin Fan was helping her out, pretending to be her boyfriend!
Chu Yufei didn’t know why, but her heart started racing, filled with an inexplicable joy.
"Um, he’s... his name is Luo Jinshan, he’s..." Chu Yufei was somewhat incoherent.
Luo Jinshan sized up Lin Fan, full of disdain, "Princess Yu, is he your boyfriend?"
With Lin Fan wearing such cheap clothes and him dressed in costly brands worth thousands, indeed, he had reason to look down on Lin Fan.
The contrast was too obvious; did Chu Yufei not feel embarrassed to have such a poor boyfriend, so unpresentable?
"Yes, sorry, Young Master Luo, my mom had a bit of a misunderstanding, she didn’t know I had a boyfriend, hence today’s blunder." Chu Yufei said, "So I can’t go for dinner with Young Master Luo."
Luo Jinshan said, "Alright then, but even if you have a boyfriend, you can still date me. After all, you’re not married yet, you can compare; I’m much better than your boyfriend."
Chu Yufei was taken aback, with a serious face she said, "Are you sure you want to compare excellence with him?"

chapters.title: Chapter 439: The Fateful Encounter of 2 Women
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Chapter 439: The Fateful Encounter of 2 Women
Luo Jinshan wants to compete with Lin Fan in terms of excellence!
Chu Yufei felt like laughing. Luo Jinshan was indeed a rich heir, but when it came to excellence, he couldn’t compare to Lin Fan. Lin Fan was the richest man in Yun City. In Chu Yufei’s heart, Lin Fan was the most excellent person in the world.
Of course, this was partly due to her personal feelings, but even putting those aside, Lin Fan was undoubtedly far more impressive than Luo Jinshan in many ways.
Luo Jinshan, however, was incredibly confident: "My family’s business is worth a billion, you should know that I came back this time to inherit the family business. From now on, I’ll be a billionaire, while this guy here looks penniless. Does he even have a hundred bucks on him!"
Chu Yufei was a bit sweaty. This Luo Jinshan really had an overflowing sense of superiority, an inexplicable confidence!
Chu Yufei said, "Young Master Luo, I don’t mean to put you down, but your family’s business doesn’t even compare to my Chu Family. Our Yun Chu Group is a hundred-billion enterprise."
She didn’t understand why her mother wanted to set her up with such a match. If she really married Luo Jinshan, wouldn’t that be marrying down!
It was as if Madam Chu were in a rush to marry her off!
Chu Yufei was puzzled. Had she offended her mother recently, that her mother wanted her to get married!
Chu Yufei’s words were a bit piercing.
Luo Jinshan forced a smile and finally thought of a rebuttal: "You mentioned the Chu Family, but you’re just a daughter. What does the Chu Family’s business have to do with you? The business is left to the son! If you marry this pauper, you’ll be a pauper too. If you marry me, you’ll be a billionaire bride!"
Chu Yufei said, "I really don’t want to put you down, but since you’re so clueless, I have no choice but to hit you with the truth. The person standing in front of you isn’t a pauper."
Luo Jinshan laughed heartily: "Not a pauper? Don’t kid yourself, his outfit is just a step above a beggar’s."
Chu Yufei said, "Have you heard of Mr. Lin?"
Luo Jinshan was taken aback: "Mr. Lin? Do you mean that mysterious tycoon who recently emerged in Yun City, the current richest man Mr. Lin?"
Chu Yufei said, "Yes, he is Mr. Lin."
Luo Jinshan was shocked but then burst out laughing, holding his stomach, nearly collapsing to the floor.
"You’re killing me, claiming he’s the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin. Don’t joke like that." Luo Jinshan laughed, pounding the ground.
Chu Yufei shrugged: "Whether you believe me or not is up to you. To me, you’re just shallow and ignorant."
Luo Jinshan laughed: "You call me shallow and ignorant, so what proof do you have to show that he is Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan smiled: "She doesn’t need to prove it because you can believe it or not."
Chu Yufei said, "No matter what, you now know I have a boyfriend. I love my boyfriend, so there’s no chance between us, sorry."
Saying this, Chu Yufei took Lin Fan’s hand and held it.
Even though she was just pretending, her heart beat faster. It was the first time she held a boy’s hand, and it was Mr. Lin’s hand she admired so much!
She was a bit grateful to Luo Jinshan. If not for him creating this opportunity, she wouldn’t have had the chance to hold Mr. Lin’s hand!
Luo Jinshan saw Chu Yufei and Lin Fan holding hands, and he immediately became displeased, sneering: "Chu Yufei, you will regret not choosing me!"
With a heavy snort, Luo Jinshan turned and walked out.
He didn’t want to stay and watch them flaunt their love; he stormed off angrily. It was so frustrating that Chu Yufei already had a boyfriend, and it was still a pauper, which made him feel insulted.
After leaving the coffee shop, Luo Jinshan got into his limited edition sports car and drove away.
On the way, Luo Jinshan was still very upset. He has always been confident, and coming to this blind date, he thought Chu Yufei would definitely be satisfied with him!
Who knew Chu Yufei would reject him!
The Chu Family is indeed a hundred-billion group, but what does that have to do with Chu Yufei? The family business is to be left to Chu Lin.
Chu Yufei was just like water to be poured out!
Chu Yufei being able to marry a future billionaire like him was already pretty good.
But she actually took a fancy to a poor guy.
That was already ridiculous enough.
Even more ridiculous was that Chu Yufei said this poor guy was Mr. Lin, hilarious.
Wait!
Was Chu Yufei joking?
She seemed so serious!
Luo Jinshan was perplexed and then took out his phone to make a call: "Father, it’s me. I seem to remember you mentioning that you had the fortune of meeting Mr. Lin at a business meeting and took a photo with him. Could you send me the photo to take a look?"
His father had indeed said this, and he was very proud of it, almost bragging, because for a company owner with only ten billion’s worth of business to associate with Yun City’s richest man, it was indeed something worth bragging about everywhere.
Soon, Luo Jinshan received the photo sent by his father.
Luo Jinshan clicked to open it, zoomed in, and suddenly, he was petrified.
The photo showed two people posing together, one was his father, and the other, was shockingly, Chu Yufei’s boyfriend!
Chu Yufei hadn’t lied, and her boyfriend was indeed Yun City’s richest man, Mr. Lin!
Luo Jinshan was suddenly shocked and broke out in a cold sweat. Damn, did he just offend Mr. Lin!
He even called Mr. Lin a pauper to his face. If Mr. Lin was a pauper, then what was he, a beggar?
No wonder! If Chu Yufei’s boyfriend was Mr. Lin, there’s no way she would choose him. He couldn’t help but be convinced!
If his father knew he had offended Mr. Lin, he’d probably break his legs.
For a moment, Luo Jinshan was stunned and couldn’t snap out of it.
In the coffee shop.
Finally getting rid of Luo Jinshan, Chu Yufei breathed a sigh of relief.
She smiled back and said, "Thank you, Mr. Lin. Luckily, I ran into you; otherwise, I wouldn’t have known how to escape."
She really didn’t like Luo Jinshan, too narcissistic, and even got a bit hands-on, very annoying, unlike Mr. Lin...
Lin Fan said, "You’re welcome, it was nothing. Now that the jerk’s gone, you can let go of my hand."
Chu Yufei then realized she was still holding Lin Fan’s hand.
She quickly let go, instantly blushing: "S-sorry."
Her heart was racing. If only she could keep holding Mr. Lin’s hand, that would be great. Oh, why am I having such thoughts?
Lin Fan smiled and said, "We haven’t seen each other for a while, is everything good with you?"
Chu Yufei said, "Yes, the company is all running normally. No worries, Mr. Lin. By the way, what brings you here?"
Lin Fan was about to answer.
"Lin Fan, you’re here!"
Wei Qingxue pushed open the door of the coffee shop and walked in.
Wei Qingxue had just gotten off work, rushing over to meet Lin Fan for a date. It was raining outside, so she brought an umbrella, but she saw Lin Fan’s electric scooter parked at the coffee shop’s door, so she came in to check, and saw Lin Fan at once.
Huh?
Wei Qingxue looked up and saw a beautiful woman standing next to Lin Fan, a stunner, and she seemed familiar!
Wei Qingxue was a bit puzzled.
Hearing Wei Qingxue’s call, Lin Fan turned and smiled: "You’re here!"
Chu Yufei also saw Wei Qingxue and was a bit surprised. So Mr. Lin was expecting someone, and it was this gorgeous woman.
Could it be...
"Mr. Lin, who is this..." Chu Yufei asked.
Wei Qingxue felt a bit jealous seeing Lin Fan with another woman and said, "Hello, I’m his wife. My name is Wei Qingxue. And you are?"
What?
His wife?
Chu Yufei was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Why does it feel like palace intrigue?
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Chapter 440: Why does it feel like palace intrigue?
Chu Yufei was completely stunned.
The beautiful woman in front of her actually claimed to be Mr. Lin’s wife?
When did Mr. Lin have a wife, and why didn’t she know about it?
Wei Qingxue said this because she saw Lin Fan and Chu Yufei standing together, looking somewhat intimate, and she felt an inexplicable twinge of jealousy.
Although technically she wasn’t Lin Fan’s wife at the moment, she still needed to assert herself and protect her territory.
"Mr. Lin, is she your wife?" Chu Yufei asked.
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. He truly hadn’t expected them to meet, and this situation was really quite troublesome. Keeping it from both sides was proving difficult, and if he lied, one party would eventually become suspicious.
So he could only tell the truth: "Well, to be precise, she’s my ex-wife."
Upon hearing this, Wei Qingxue’s face turned red, but Lin Fan was stating a fact, and there wasn’t much she could say.
Chu Yufei was stunned — she couldn’t believe that Mr. Lin had been married. But thinking about it, it might not be too improbable. In fact, she didn’t know much about Mr. Lin; his background might not be easy for most people to comprehend.
Chu Yufei, who had a naturally gracious personality, quickly composed herself and reached out her hand to Wei Qingxue: "Hello, Miss Wei, I’m Chu Yufei."
Wei Qingxue shook hands with Chu Yufei: "Hello, Miss Chu and Lin Fan are..."
Chu Yufei said: "I am..."
Lin Fan hurriedly interjected: "Rain Princess and I are friends. It was raining outside just now, so I came in to take shelter and coincidentally met Rain Princess here. We chatted for a bit. Rain Princess, we should get going now, let’s keep in touch."
If Chu Yufei revealed that she worked at his charity, his identity would be exposed.
To Wei Qingxue, he was just a deliveryman.
Chu Yufei laughed: "Alright, goodbye Mr. Lin, goodbye Miss Wei."
"Goodbye."
Wei Qingxue also politely said, and then she left the café with Lin Fan.
Watching their backs, Chu Yufei felt somewhat unreal; she still found it hard to believe that Mr. Lin had been married.
"His ex-wife seems to still love him..."
Chu Yufei murmured, feeling inexplicably melancholic.
Wei Qingxue and Lin Fan exited the café and started strolling through the mall.
Lin Fan secretly breathed a sigh of relief — at least the two women were separated. In truth, even if his identity were exposed, it wouldn’t matter, but he didn’t want Wei Qingxue to know yet that he was the richest man in Yun City.
The real reason why he continued to agree to go out with Wei Qingxue after their divorce was because he had an unresolved issue on his mind.
He still hadn’t figured out what the system’s task related to Wei Qingxue was all about.
He believed the system definitely had its reasons, but it wasn’t clear yet, so he would continue to stay in touch with Wei Qingxue until he figured out the system’s intentions.
"Lin Fan, are you very familiar with that Miss Chu?" Wei Qingxue asked, still a bit concerned about Chu Yufei, who was exceedingly beautiful. It’s curious how Lin Fan, a deliveryman, could know such a pretty girl.
Lin Fan smiled: "Just ordinary friends. I used to frequently deliver packages to her, so I know her."
It’s easy to tell a little lie.
Wei Qingxue responded with an "Oh" and said: "She’s so beautiful, did you never think about pursuing her?"
This was a loaded question.
Lin Fan quickly said: "I’ve never had that thought."
Wei Qingxue continued: "Really? But I think Miss Chu seems to have feelings for you. You can tell from her eyes when she looks at you."
Lin Fan wiped his cold sweat: "No way, you might be mistaken."
Chu Yufei having feelings for him? Lin Fan actually hadn’t noticed. He hadn’t known Chu Yufei for long and hadn’t met her many times. Why would she think this? Was his charm really that great?
Wei Qingxue glanced at him, seeing his embarrassed look, she couldn’t help but chuckle: "I’m just teasing you!"
"Alright." Lin Fan was a bit speechless.
Wei Qingxue said with a bit of pride: "But even if she really likes you, knowing that I’m your ex-wife should make her rethink."
Lin Fan chuckled bitterly: "Why do I feel like this is a palace drama?"
He felt like the emperor in a palace drama, with the concubines vying for his favor, definitely had that vibe.
Wei Qingxue said: "It’s because I like you. Before I win you over, I naturally can’t let other women entice you away. Lin Fan, you have to know that you are my man, and I will defeat all rivals to win you over!"
Her expression was firm, somewhat naively stubborn.
Lin Fan saw this side of her for the first time. In his past impression, Wei Qingxue was a bit of an ice-cold beauty. Now, she appeared a bit cute to him.
"Are you so confident that you can certainly win me over?" Lin Fan laughed.
Wei Qingxue said: "Of course, I will do my utmost best to make you fall in love with me."
Lin Fan said: "Alright... Do they all know about our divorce?"
Wei Qingxue said: "Yes, they all know."
Lin Fan laughed: "They don’t like me; knowing about our divorce should make them quite happy."
Wei Qingxue said: "I thought that too, but it turns out not to be the case. Because you’ve so successfully sold off Mingshi Century and Jinyan Square Block A, they’ve completely changed their view of you. Grandfather scolded me to bits, questioning why I divorced you. When he learned that you’ve resigned, he further scolded me for being clueless. It seems Grandfather really cherishes you as his top seller."
Honestly, you can’t blame Elder Wei. Anyone encountering a sales talent like Lin Fan would smile even in their sleep. Learning that such a talent left, they can’t help but feel regret.
Wei Qingxue said: "Lin Fan, the performance you’ve achieved today, with the complete sell-out of Jinyan Square Block A, has earned you a top position on the sales leaderboard this month. You’ve left everyone far behind; others are desperately trying to catch up, but they’re afraid they won’t even see your taillights."
Lin Fan found it amusing in his heart. Actually, he should really leave the Wei Family Company. The way he’s selling properties, the small Wei Family might soon run out of houses to sell.
Wei Qingxue continued: "Also, Mom almost fainted when she learned of our divorce — this is what she said herself. She was crying while asking why I divorced you. She bought a lot of groceries today, wanting to cook sweet and sour ribs for you herself."
Lin Fan smiled coldly to himself. Whether it was Elder Wei or Li Xueyan, the change in their attitude towards him was all about money.
Especially Li Xueyan, who was drooling over his 1 million commission; she would probably salivate. With her dream falling away, how could she not be agitated?
Wei Qingxue sighed: "Let’s not talk about them, let’s rather talk about what we’re going to do next."
Lin Fan replied: "Hmm, what do you want to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 441 Encounter with the Glasses Lady: You Touched Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 441 Encounter with the Glasses Lady: You Touched Me!
Wei Qingxue said, "I haven’t watched a movie in a long time, or maybe I don’t even remember how long it’s been. Why don’t you accompany me to a movie?"
Lin Fan readily agreed.
So, the two of them headed towards the cinema.
As they approached the cinema, they saw a pair of adorable Minion dolls displayed in the hallway.
Wei Qingxue instantly fell in love with them and gasped, "Such beautiful dolls! Why don’t we watch this movie?"
Lin Fan said, "No problem."
Wei Qingxue said, "Wait a moment, Lin Fan, can you help me take a short video? I want to hug these Minions."
Saying this, Wei Qingxue happily ran over, reached out, and hugged the Minions, striking a close pose.
Lin Fan had no choice but to take out his phone to record for her.
Lin Fan adjusted the camera and was recording a video of Wei Qingxue.
Just then, suddenly, a scream came from the side, "Ah, you pervert!"
At this moment, there were people coming and going around, and the sound immediately attracted everyone’s attention.
The scream came from a girl wearing glasses, her appearance was quite ordinary, but she seemed full of energy.
The one being scolded by the glasses lady was an equally plain-looking boy. His clothing was quite simple, he carried a messenger bag, and he looked like a poor student.
Called a pervert by the glasses lady, the boy was a bit bewildered, looking at her in confusion, "What happened, what’s going on?"
The glasses lady shouted, "Are you playing dumb? You damn pervert, you just touched my butt!"
What?
Everyone around frowned. No way, this boy looks so well-behaved, who would have thought he’s a sham. To touch a girl’s butt in such a place, isn’t that molesting!
"Touching a girl’s butt? Scumbag!"
"How disgusting!"
"What kind of person is this, looks so honest, turns out to be a beast!"
Everyone started pointing fingers at the boy.
Hearing these words, the boy’s face turned red, he said, "I didn’t touch your butt, I was just passing by, maybe I bumped into you by accident, but it wasn’t on purpose!"
The glasses lady, upon hearing this, got even more energetic, "You’re still arguing, what do you mean bumped into me, so many people here, why bump into me specifically?"
The boy said, "How should I know, anyway, I don’t have wandering hands."
The glasses lady raged, "It was you who touched me. Are you saying I’m lying? Damn, you touched my butt, and now I’m the one in the wrong? Dare to tell me your name, I’ll let everyone judge!"
The boy said, "I didn’t say you’re wrong, I just said I didn’t touch you. No need for you to know my name."
The glasses lady said, "Show me your ID!"
The boy said, "No!"
The glasses lady shouted, "Not showing it means you’re guilty, quickly show it! Damn pervert!"
Saying this, the glasses lady swiftly grabbed the boy’s messenger bag, pulling the strap off and snatching the bag, then she tried to search inside it.
The boy got anxious and wanted to get his bag back.
The glasses lady immediately screamed, "Come on, touch me, you’ll be sexually harassing me, come on."
The boy stopped, intimidated by her words, he really didn’t dare to grapple with this girl, afraid that if he even touched her, he’d be accused of bullying her, and it would be impossible to clear his name even if he jumped into the Yellow River.
The glasses lady skillfully opened the boy’s bag, didn’t find his ID, but found a student ID inside.
The glasses lady read aloud, "Zhao Xiaoguang, first year at Qinghua University, huh, you pervert, you’re even my junior. I’m a second-year at Qinghua University, your senior, and you dare to touch your senior’s butt, you’ve got guts!"
The boy’s privacy was publicly exposed, making him anxious and embarrassed, "I didn’t touch your butt!"
The glasses lady chuckled, "You’re still arguing!"
She took out her phone, first took a photo of Zhao Xiaoguang’s student ID, and then snapped a photo of Zhao Xiaoguang.
"Now I have your ID information, I’ll give you a chance, apologize to me in public! Otherwise, I’ll expose you on social media, expose you online, do you know what happens to scum like you once exposed? I can make sure you become socially dead, do you believe it?"
The glasses lady shouted loudly, she even seemed a bit excited and thrilled, like a bloodthirsty jackal who finally found its prey.
Zhao Xiaoguang was furious but he wasn’t eloquent, compared to the sharp-tongued, aggressive glasses lady, he was no match.
People around started gossiping.
"The girl is so agitated, this must be true!"
"Why would a girl risk her reputation to falsely accuse him!"
"Yeah, this is not something classy, making a big deal out of it makes everyone look bad!"
"That means this guy really touched her butt!"
"If he needs to apologize, then just apologize, wouldn’t it be unwilling to apologize?"
Everyone looked at Zhao Xiaoguang, pressuring him to apologize to the glasses lady.
Though Zhao Xiaoguang seemed quite honest, he was a bit stubborn, he felt he didn’t touch his senior’s butt, so he couldn’t endure this humiliation.
Moreover, he wasn’t stupid. If he apologized to the glasses lady, it would confirm he really touched her butt. Given the glasses lady’s current drive, she definitely wouldn’t let him go.
So he couldn’t admit it no matter what.
"I’ll say it again, I didn’t touch your butt, stop making unreasonable trouble! Give me back my stuff!" Zhao Xiaoguang said.
The glasses lady was incensed, seemingly in an ecstatic state, "Damn pervert, you refuse to apologize? Fine then, don’t blame me for being impolite. I’ll expose you online right now!"
The glasses lady was action-oriented, she really opened her social media, started typing out a message to expose Zhao Xiaoguang in the school community.
Zhao Xiaoguang couldn’t snatch her phone, he could only watch helplessly.
Very quickly, the glasses lady finished composing the message, almost ready to send it.
Zhao Xiaoguang finally made a decision, gritting his teeth he said, "Fine, I agree to apologize, don’t post it online."
The glasses lady sneered, "Okay, you apologize."
Everyone was watching.
"I’m sorry!" Zhao Xiaoguang said.
The glasses lady wasn’t satisfied, "What did you say, I can’t hear, can you say it louder."
Zhao Xiaoguang raised his voice, "I’m sorry!"
The glasses lady demanded, "Loudly tell everyone what you did to me."
Zhao Xiaoguang’s face was burning, he really didn’t want to say it, didn’t want to admit it, but by now, it seemed he had no choice but to admit it.
"I touched your butt," Zhao Xiaoguang had to say.
The glasses lady laughed loudly, "That’s all I needed to hear, today you face social death!"
She actually pressed the send button in front of Zhao Xiaoguang, exposing his information.

chapters.title: Chapter 442: What is Social Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 442: What is Social Death
Because Glasses Lady threatened to expose him online, Zhao Xiaoguang ultimately decided to apologize to her to smooth things over.
Glasses Lady stopped when she saw Zhao Xiaoguang agree to apologize.
"I’m sorry," Zhao Xiaoguang said.
"Louder!" Glasses Lady shouted.
Zhao Xiaoguang had no choice but to raise his voice and say again, "I’m sorry!"
Glasses Lady arrogantly said, "Tell everyone loudly what you did to me!"
Blushing red, Zhao Xiaoguang said, "I... touched your butt."
Everyone gasped.
"He admitted it, this guy is really scum!"
"This girl is smart, knows how to use tactics, otherwise this pervert wouldn’t admit it!"
"Doing such a thing in public, it’s truly disgraceful!"
Everyone condemned Zhao Xiaoguang one after another.
Zhao Xiaoguang, blushing and embarrassed, wanted to say something but didn’t know how to begin, as if he couldn’t explain his grievance.
"Senior, we are from the same school, I have apologized, can you give me back my things and let me go?" Zhao Xiaoguang said.
To be honest, he was a bit afraid of this Glasses Lady, she was simply too domineering.
Glasses Lady said, "I have no use for your junk, holding a pervert’s things would just dirty my hands, here you go!"
Glasses Lady threw Zhao Xiaoguang’s student ID and backpack on the ground.
Zhao Xiaoguang picked them up, ready to leave. He didn’t want to stay here anymore, as everyone around him was criticizing him. He planned to leave quickly and treat this as a nightmare, letting it be over.
When he stood up, he saw Glasses Lady coldly smiling at him.
"Zhao Xiaoguang, you dared to touch my butt. Don’t think that an apology is enough. My butt is not something you can touch so easily. An apology is too lenient for you. I’ve decided, I’ll make sure you suffer social death!"
Glasses Lady said somewhat proudly, and in front of Zhao Xiaoguang, she pressed the send button to expose his information online!
Zhao Xiaoguang was shocked: "Didn’t you just say that as long as I apologized, you wouldn’t expose me? You don’t keep your word!"
Zhao Xiaoguang was really anxious. The only reason he apologized was to calm things down and move past it, not bothering to continue entangling with Glasses Lady.
Who would have thought!
Glasses Lady continued to expose him online even after his apology.
So what was the point of his apology just now?
It was completely meaningless!
Instead, he had provided an excuse for everyone to call him a pervert!
Although Zhao Xiaoguang was an honest kid, he wasn’t entirely spineless. Even a cornered rabbit bites.
In that moment, Zhao Xiaoguang became furious; this Glasses Lady was too excessive.
Glasses Lady sneered, "What’s the matter, feeling desperate? Who told you to touch my butt? Of course, I won’t let you off easily, otherwise you might dare to touch other girls’ butts next time! From my perspective, none of you national men are decent, and national men deserve harsh lessons! I’ve already exposed you online. If there’s no surprises, you’ll soon face internet violence, and everyone will know you’re Zhao Xiaoguang from Qinghua University, a hooligan! Your life will be ruined, not only might you face school punishment, you’ll also face discrimination when job hunting later, that’s what social death means!"
This...
Everyone around suddenly fell silent, looking at each other.
Although Zhao Xiaoguang admitted touching her butt, he also apologized. Isn’t it a bit excessive for Glasses Lady to continue exposing him online? It seems a bit, doesn’t it?
Noticing the reaction from everyone around, Glasses Lady laughed, "Don’t blame me for being dishonest. I did threaten him just now, that’s why he apologized, but it’s only my tactic. If I didn’t pressure him, would he apologize? I never intended to let him off, this despicable pervert must not be condoned!"
Hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
"She’s right, a despicable pervert should pay the price!"
"An apology is not enough."
"After all, she’s the one who got her butt touched, she has the right to decide what to do."
"Alright then, let’s give the pervert a lesson."
With the support of those around, Glasses Lady became even more proud: "Pervert, just you wait!"
Furious, Zhao Xiaoguang shouted: "I didn’t touch you at all!"
What?
Everyone was stunned, Zhao Xiaoguang admitted earlier, and now he’s denying it?
Zhao Xiaoguang said, "I only apologized because I didn’t want to continue entangling with you, thinking to quell the matter. Who knew you would go too far! Then I take back the apology just now, because I never touched you, I never thought about touching you, nor have I done such a thing!"
Glasses Lady said, "Despicable pervert, you think you can go back on your word? Everyone heard you earlier, you admitted to touching me personally. Besides, it’s useless even if you recant, I’ve already exposed you online. See if anyone believes you online! Not just online, but even among the people present, who believes you?"
Zhao Xiaoguang was speechless, unable to defend himself, he couldn’t clear his name even if he jumped into the Yellow River.
"Admitted and now recants, that’s a bit shameless!"
"Too shameless!"
"Seems like the girl was right to expose him, for such scum, one should not show soft-heartedness!"
Everyone expressed their opinions one after another.
Zhao Xiaoguang was so anxious he started crying: "I really didn’t touch her, please believe me, I really didn’t!"
Glasses Lady sneered: "A grown man, why cry? You national men are just cheap. When you touched me, you didn’t think about consequences. Now you know it’s wrong, you cry, thinking I’ll soften, impossible!"
Zhao Xiaoguang, anxious as a hot ant on a frying pan, suddenly thought of something, blurted out: "Surveillance, there must be surveillance here, yes, right, whether I touched you or not, the surveillance will show!"
He raised his eye looking for nearby surveillance.
But realized, the place they were at, unexpectedly had no surveillance!
It’s a blind spot for surveillance!
"Ah!" Zhao Xiaoguang was suddenly hopeless, slumped on the ground, nearly collapsing.
Glasses Lady seemed quite pleased, saying, "I see how you’ll defend yourself this time! I’ve already exposed your good deeds to my social circle. Little thing, first let you suffer social death in my circle. There’re many classmates and teachers from the school in my circle; soon, it’ll be spread around, soon you’ll become famous in school."
Glasses Lady looked at her phone, laughed, "Haha, my classmates are already cursing you in the social circle and said they’ll forward it, let more people know. Little thing, you’re famous, soon you’ll experience what social death means!"
Zhao Xiaoguang screamed: "Why won’t you let it go, I said it’s a misunderstanding, I really didn’t touch you. Can you stop insisting, do you want to push me to jump off a building to prove my innocence?"
Glasses Lady had a cat-playing-mouse expression: "Little dimwit, it’s not that I look down on you, someone like you, do you even have the guts to die? You national men have such little ambition, stop pretending to be innocent before me, stop playing pitiful to gain sympathy, I’m not buying it!"
Zhao Xiaoguang excitedly said: "Fine, then I’ll jump off a building now, if I die, it’ll prove I didn’t do it!"
Zhao Xiaoguang was pushed to anger, stood up, and genuinely was going to jump.
Glasses Lady said: "If you’re going to die then hurry up, no one would feel sorry for scum like you even if you die. Better not regret it, I wish for your death!"
"Why?"
Suddenly, a voice nearby spoke.
The speaker was Lin Fan.
Everyone looked at Lin Fan.
Glasses Lady frowned: "What do you mean why?"
Lin Fan said: "You got your butt touched, why do you seem so happy about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Lin Fan Takes the Lead
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 443: Lin Fan Takes the Lead
Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue originally planned to go to the cinema to watch a movie. However, on the way, they encountered this incident and witnessed the entire process.
Lin Fan had been watching indifferently. At this moment, when Zhao Xiaoguang was being driven to jump off a building by the Glasses Lady to prove his innocence, Lin Fan finally stepped forward.
As soon as he spoke, he questioned the Glasses Lady: "You got your butt touched, so why do you look so happy?"
This was his intuitive feeling after witnessing the entire incident. The Glasses Lady was not just happy; she was excited, even thrilled.
Yes, thrilled.
This word perfectly described the state of the Glasses Lady at the moment.
It was as if she had been waiting for this moment for a long time and it had finally come.
This made Lin Fan quite curious.
When Lin Fan said this, the surrounding crowd also snapped out of it. Yes, it’s true, this woman seemed overly excited. They had all felt it but were carried along by the Glasses Lady’s tempo and didn’t pay attention.
Zhao Xiaoguang, who was about to jump, paused and looked at Lin Fan. The young, handsome man seemed to give him a glimmer of hope, temporarily dispelling his suicidal thoughts.
Glasses Lady was furious: "Who are you? What do you mean by that? How am I happy?"
Lin Fan said: "According to common sense, when someone takes advantage of you, you should feel sad or angry, but you didn’t. Your focus was on punishing the other party, driving them to death."
Glasses Lady said: "I just want him to pay the price, so what? If he dares to be a hooligan, he should be prepared to face the consequences!"
Lin Fan shook his head and said: "No, if he really acted indecently and touched your butt, he should indeed be punished. However, your reaction seems strange, as if you’ve been waiting for this opportunity for a long time. Why is that?"
Glasses Lady said: "I don’t understand what you mean. Please don’t talk nonsense here. I get it, you’re also a man. Looking at your attire, you’re just another poor loser. Guys like you, poor country men, are all despicable. It’s understandable you’d defend him."
Lin Fan frowned and said: "Exactly, that’s the thing. Why do I get the feeling you seem to have some animosity towards us guys? Even if he touched your butt, you shouldn’t tarnish all men with the same brush. Like, I didn’t touch you, did I? Why am I despicable? And what’s wrong with being poor? Did it offend you?"
Glasses Lady said: "You’re speaking up for a hooligan; that’s not despicable? Poverty is the biggest problem. Poor losers can’t find a girlfriend and can only do such obscene things!"
Lin Fan shook his head: "Miss, your words are too extreme and biased. If I’m not mistaken, you’re probably what’s commonly referred to as a ’female boxer’, aren’t you?"
On the internet, there’s such a group of people who madly create gender opposition, insulting and hating their country’s men tirelessly. In their eyes, their country’s men are an inferior species.
This group is called "pastoral feminism". Because they attack fiercely online, they’re humorously referred to as "female boxers".
The overall perception is that female boxers are a group of disgruntled women who don’t do well in the real world, venting their anger at men online.
Just like this Glasses Lady, with mediocre looks and wearing glasses, she’s just an invisible passerby in the crowd, being treated as insignificant is her life norm.
When Glasses Lady heard Lin Fan say she was a female boxer, it was as if a dog’s tail had been stepped on. She revealed a fierce look.
"What the hell are you saying! Poor loser!" Glasses Lady cursed in exasperation.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Looks like I wasn’t wrong. You are a female boxer. If I’m not mistaken, you probably spend a lot of time online attacking and cursing your country’s men, while in reality, no man pays attention to you, let alone offends you. You can only vent online. You were this excited because you finally caught a chance in real life; you finally got to be the protagonist as a victim, so you naturally wanted to leverage your online boxing skills to push Zhao Xiaoguang to his limits."
Lin Fan’s words hit the Glasses Lady right in the heart.
Too heartbreaking.
Glasses Lady was infuriated: "So what if I am? I am a female boxer! So what if you’re right? He dared touch my butt, so he’s at fault. Even if I want to push him to his limits, he deserves it!"
Lin Fan shook his head and said: "No, this isn’t right. Indeed, if he really did something so obscene, it’s his own fault. The problem is, you don’t seem to have any evidence proving he really did it. Before this matter is clarified, pushing him to his limits might result in wronging an innocent person."
Hearing this, the surrounding people felt Lin Fan made sense and nodded repeatedly.
"The young man makes sense too."
"Yes, we shouldn’t spare the wrongdoer, but we also shouldn’t wrong a good person!"
"This lady is indeed too emotional; things should be clarified first."
Hearing these words, Glasses Lady was infuriated. These onlookers are all just fickle-minded, following the wind!
"Whether he touched my butt, wouldn’t I be the most aware? I was touched, what I say is evidence! The responsibility of proving innocence lies with him!" Glasses Lady said.
Upon hearing this, the crowd felt the Glasses Lady also made sense and nodded.
"She’s right too, she would know best if she was touched."
Zhao Xiaoguang, flushed, said: "I’ll say it again, I did not touch you, I really didn’t, it’s a complete misunderstanding!"
One says she was touched, the other says he didn’t; this had become an unsolvable dilemma.
Glasses Lady sneered: "I was clearly touched by you, don’t try to argue, you just apologized to me and admitted it. Now you want to retract your words? It’s not that easy. You’re doomed this time!"
Zhao Xiaoguang was desperate, looking at Lin Fan, he chuckled bitterly: "Buddy, thanks a lot for speaking up for me, but there’s really nothing I can do. She’s falsely accusing me, I can’t defend myself. To prove my innocence, I can only jump."
Lin Fan said: "Wait a moment."
Then Lin Fan looked at the Glasses Lady: "If it can be proven that he really didn’t touch your butt, what would you do? Would you apologize to him?"
Glasses Lady said: "I don’t make boring assumptions, I only know I was touched by him. A hooligan like him deserves to die!"
"Alright." Lin Fan was a bit helpless, reasoning with such an extreme female boxer was pointless.
"To prove Zhao Xiaoguang’s innocence, there’s no need to jump. Although there’s no surveillance here, I happened to record that exact moment just now."
Lin Fan said with a smile, then opened his phone.
It turned out he was just recording a short video of Wei Qingxue, inadvertently capturing the moment Glasses Lady passed by Zhao Xiaoguang!
What?
Everyone was stunned by this unexpected turn of events!

chapters.title: Chapter 444: The Bizarre Woman Admits Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 444: The Bizarre Woman Admits Defeat
Glasses Lady, a sophomore at Qinghua University, with an ordinary appearance, blends into the crowd like an unnoticed passerby. Indeed, she is rarely noticed, and boys generally ignore her.
The girls around her who are pretty have boys pursuing them, and there are quite a few suitors.
Seeing others being lovey-dovey, Glasses Lady can’t help but feel jealous. Over time, she developed a dislike for boys, considering them all superficial animals who don’t know how to appreciate her.
When bored, Glasses Lady goes online to curse at boys with a group of feminist radicals.
After a lot of swearing online, she felt a bit unsatisfied and wanted to scold some foul-smelling men in real life. Unfortunately, there was never an opportunity because in reality, no men gave her any attention.
Until today, when she caught Zhao Xiaoguang, she finally had a chance to showcase her skills. Hence, she quickly exposed Zhao Xiaoguang’s identity information on social media, claiming she would socially ruin him, almost driving Zhao Xiaoguang to the brink.
At this moment, Lin Fan stepped up, stating that he unintentionally captured a video of the moment they passed each other!
Hearing this, everyone was stunned.
Glasses Lady and Zhao Xiaoguang both became happy. Glasses Lady maintained that Zhao Xiaoguang touched her, while Zhao Xiaoguang was sure he didn’t. With a video, they could prove their statements.
Zhao Xiaoguang exclaimed with joy, "Great, I can finally prove my innocence this time!"
Glasses Lady chuckled, "Even you, a poor loser, aren’t entirely useless. Show us the video then, and let’s see how this guy can still argue!"
The people around immediately became curious, wondering what the outcome would be. Was it a misunderstanding by Glasses Lady, or was Zhao Xiaoguang indeed a wolf in sheep’s clothing?
Lin Fan played the video, inviting Glasses Lady and Zhao Xiaoguang to watch.
In the video, Glasses Lady is standing and playing with her phone while Zhao Xiaoguang passes by behind her. As Zhao Xiaoguang was wearing a crossbody bag, it brushed against Glasses Lady’s butt at the exact level.
It was evident that Zhao Xiaoguang’s hands were on the bag’s strap in front of him. Unless he had a third hand, it was not possible he groped Glasses Lady.
Lin Fan said, "Did you see clearly? Zhao Xiaoguang did not grope you, it was just his bag brushing against you."
Glasses Lady was stunned, "No, really no..."
Zhao Xiaoguang was incredibly grateful, almost kneeling to Lin Fan, "That’s great, bro, thank you for clearing my name, thank you so much."
Lin Fan smiled, "You’re welcome. Luckily, I happened to capture it. Otherwise, this would really be a hard case to clear out."
Although the surrounding people couldn’t see the video, seeing the reactions of Glasses Lady and Zhao Xiaoguang, they understood what had happened.
"Wow, so it really was a misunderstanding?"
"So this guy wasn’t a scumbag!"
"We wrongly accused him before!"
"It’s all this girl’s fault. We believed her words without question."
The crowd started buzzing with discussions.
Lin Fan looked at Glasses Lady and said, "Now that you know you misunderstood Zhao Xiaoguang, you should do something, right?"
Glasses Lady showed a hint of embarrassment but quickly returned to normal as if reluctantly, she cleared her throat, saying, "I’ll delete that post on social media and issue a clarification, let’s just leave it at that."
Lin Fan frowned and said, "Just leave it at that? Don’t you have anything to say to Zhao Xiaoguang?"
This girl is truly speechless; realizing she misunderstood Zhao Xiaoguang, she seemed a bit disappointed as though she wished it were true.
What kind of mindset is this?
Wouldn’t a normal female be happy upon finding out she wasn’t groped? After all, being groped is something disgusting for a normal girl, like being dirtied.
However, Glasses Lady’s reaction was disappointment, as if she hoped to be groped, so she could drive the other party to the edge.
It’s like she’s desperately eager to get groped to gain the chance to ruin a guy.
Glasses Lady looked at Zhao Xiaoguang and said, "Dear junior, I hope you can understand my reaction. I didn’t make this up out of nowhere. Although it was a misunderstanding this time, there are many more girls who have indeed been violated by repulsive men. You can find plenty of such cases online. As a girl, having a bigger reaction is normal. I hope you can be more careful in the future and try to keep some distance from girls. Even if your bag brushed against me, it’s still a kind of offense. You should take care to avoid such misunderstandings happening again! I think we should leave it at this. I don’t want to argue anymore, let’s each take a step back and apologize to each other, and it’s over."
Hearing this, Zhao Xiaoguang was dumbfounded, feeling his worldview refreshed. He couldn’t believe that although it was the other party’s fault, she could still speak so righteously, making it sound like it was his fault.
This is just...
Shameless!
Zhao Xiaoguang couldn’t find a second word to describe it.
Lin Fan was also dumbfounded, wondering what the brain of these feminists was filled with.
"Dear female classmate, I think you got it wrong. Zhao Xiaoguang didn’t do anything wrong at all. Why should he apologize to you? Do you forget what you just did? You exposed Zhao Xiaoguang’s information without clarifying the situation, declaring that you wanted to socially destroy him, to ruin and kill him! Now that you know it was a misunderstanding, don’t you think your actions were excessive? You don’t even apologize, and yet you have the nerve to lecture Zhao Xiaoguang? You must have water in your brain?"
Lin Fan scoffed, feeling his hand itch, really wanting to give this lady a slap.
Glasses Lady’s words also aroused the dissatisfaction of the people around.
Before, they all believed what Glasses Lady said and criticized Zhao Xiaoguang. Now knowing they wrongly accused him, they feel somewhat embarrassed.
But Glasses Lady showed no sign of guilt!
Such a person is terrifying.
"What the hell, and she wants the guy to apologize?"
"I’ve seen shameless people, but never someone this shameless!"
"I’m so mad, this girl is such a freak!"
"What to do, I really want to slap her hard. I think someone like her deserves social ruin instead!"
"I felt suffocated even just empathizing with the situation. If it were me being falsely accused without being able to prove my innocence, I’d be ruined!
"This girl is too despicable!"
"Bitch, hurry and apologize!"
The crowd accused Glasses Lady, with someone even cursing, indicating that her actions had enraged everyone.
Seeing the situation turning unfavorable, Glasses Lady felt a bit intimidated, saying, "Dear junior, I thought it over, I was indeed wrong, okay, I won’t insist you apologize. I’ll apologize to you and hope you can understand."

chapters.title: Chapter 445: I can’t find a girlfriend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Chapter 445: I can’t find a girlfriend?
Zhao Xiaoguang is an honest kid, and now that he has cleared his name, he’s more than satisfied. He originally didn’t want to get entangled in this matter.
"I accept your apology, let’s just leave it at that," Zhao Xiaoguang said.
The Glasses Lady breathed a sigh of relief. This Zhao Xiaoguang was really easy to deal with, and that was for the best.
Lin Fan patted Zhao Xiaoguang’s shoulder: "Classmate, since you’ve chosen not to hold it against this lady, I won’t say anything more either. Let’s leave it at that."
Zhao Xiaoguang smiled and said, "Thank you so much for clearing my name. May I ask your surname?"
Lin Fan replied, "My surname is Lin."
Zhao Xiaoguang said, "Brother Lin, if you have a chance in the future, you can come to Qinghua University to hang out. I’ll entertain you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sure."
"I’ll head off then," Zhao Xiaoguang said, and then bid farewell to Lin Fan, quickly leaving. He didn’t want to linger in this place of gossip.
Lin Fan also wanted to leave, having been delayed by this incident, and was almost late for the movie.
Lin Fan turned around, ready to find Wei Qingxue.
"Damn broke loser, minding other people’s business!" he suddenly heard the Glasses Lady say from behind.
"What did you say?" Lin Fan stopped in his tracks and glanced back at the Glasses Lady.
The Glasses Lady rolled her eyes at Lin Fan and said, "I’m talking about you, what of it? You guys just help other guys and bully girls. You really stink, national guys!"
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh bitterly: "You’re really beyond help."
The Glasses Lady was displeased at Lin Fan’s expression: "This time it’s a misunderstanding, I admit, but don’t think it means you stinking men are right. There are plenty of incidents like this. I know you broke losers well. Basically, you can’t find a girlfriend, so when you see a woman, you fantasize and even get handsy. Disgusting!"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Men liking women, isn’t that normal? How is that disgusting? But I think you can rest assured, you’re quite safe-looking; absolutely no guy would be interested in you. See, this one and only time, it was still a misunderstanding."
Lin Fan’s comeback was really spot on.
"Hahaha..."
The crowd around couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
Though it’s not nice to criticize someone’s appearance, it’s situational. This Glasses Lady was truly detestable, deserved it!
"This guy’s awesome, well said!"
"Exactly, I’m not interested in her either!"
"Where does she get her confidence; she’s got some nerve babbling here!"
Everyone started mocking the Glasses Lady.
The Glasses Lady was furious, her face was twisted in anger. She pointed at Lin Fan and cursed, "You stinking loser, what are you so smug about? Look at your broke appearance, clearly can’t find a girlfriend. So what if I’m ugly? Even as ugly as I am, you can never get me, the Queen!"
Hearing this, everyone was speechless. The Glasses Lady’s words were quite harsh.
Indeed, while Lin Fan might be quite handsome, his outfit was clearly cheap, indicative of being poor.
The reality is, it’s really hard for poor guys to find girlfriends. Pretty girls have plenty of suitors, including many Rich Second Generation, giving them lots of choices. With the prevailing materialism, most pretty girls wouldn’t pick a poor guy when they have ample options.
Not to mention pretty girls, even girls of average looks, how many are willing to marry a poor guy? As long as there’s a chance, they would choose someone wealthy.
The Glasses Lady assumed Lin Fan was a broke loser who couldn’t find a girlfriend, so she insulted him.
"What, cat got your tongue? Guess I hit the nail on the head, you overconfident stinking loser!" the Glasses Lady laughed mockingly.
"Dear, stop wasting your breath on her, the movie’s about to start. Let’s go,"
Suddenly, a pleasant voice chimed in, as Wei Qingxue came over, taking Lin Fan’s arm.
What?
Everyone was stunned.
No way!
She’s so beautiful, this girl is practically a fairy, stunning beyond compare!
But that’s not the most shocking.
The most shocking thing is, this beautiful woman seems to be with Lin Fan?
No wait, weren’t we just saying broke losers can’t find girlfriends, so how could this broke loser not only have a girlfriend but also such a beautiful one?
The Glasses Lady was dumbfounded, this face-slapping came too fast, completely unexpected. Her face was swelling with anger.
Lin Fan found it a bit amusing, he had to admit, Wei Qingxue’s act was wonderfully executed, and the expression on the Glasses Lady’s face was priceless.
"What did you just say, that I can’t find a girlfriend?" Lin Fan teasingly looked at the Glasses Lady.
The Glasses Lady didn’t know, that he and Wei Qingxue weren’t really a couple yet, but Wei Qingxue was pursuing him, and if he wanted a girlfriend, it was really simple, just agree to Wei Qingxue’s pursuit.
The Glasses Lady, having been humiliated, was now being laughed at by the crowd and was frustrated: "Hah, what’s there to be smug about? I know women like that well, in their youth, they just want to play with handsome guys. When it’s time to marry, they’ll pick a rich old man. Just wait, you’ll be dumped by her sooner or later!"
That comment was truly a bit vicious. The crowd around wrinkled their brows, finding the Glasses Lady more and more disgusting.
Wei Qingxue initially didn’t want to bother with the Glasses Lady, but seeing her continue with her vile mouth, she tried to take Lin Fan away.
She didn’t expect to be insulted by the Glasses Lady too.
Wei Qingxue frowned and said, "You little girl, a university student, what kind of manners do you have, speaking nonsense here?"
The Glasses Lady said, "Bitch, am I wrong? Women like you, just because you think you have a pretty face, flirt with men everywhere, shameless!"
Wei Qingxue was getting a bit angry, "You’re nuts, aren’t you? You know nothing about me, so why spout such nonsense?"
The Glasses Lady said, "I don’t need to know you, because all bitches like you are the same!"
The Glasses Lady’s face was almost twisted, clearly, despite being a female fighter for justice, she not only loathed men but was also filled with hostility toward pretty women.
This must be jealousy, a woman’s jealousy.
No wonder they say that the greatest malice toward women often comes from other women. The Glasses Lady, seeing pretty women surrounded by men while no one paid attention to her, inevitably felt unbalanced and over time, her thinking became radical and extreme.
And, frighteningly, there are many more women like the Glasses Lady out there...
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "You really wasted your time in university, didn’t you? The teachers taught you knowledge but didn’t teach you manners, did they? Watch your mouth and apologize to her."
The Glasses Lady sneered: "Apologize? Screw you, I call her a bitch, so what, what can you do about it, you broke loser!"
Wei Qingxue trembled with anger. As a wealthy family’s daughter from birth, she had never encountered someone with such poor manners, it’s like being tangled up with a piece of poo.
"Let’s go, it’s not worth wasting words on someone with such low manners!" Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan, however, held her back, smiling at the Glasses Lady, "You ask what I can do about it, let me ask you, how about being expelled from school?"
The Glasses Lady was taken aback, then burst into laughter: "Broke loser, who are you trying to scare? You think you’re somebody, you say expel, and I’ll be expelled?"

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Apology
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 446: Apology
The Glasses Lady was really annoyed with Lin Fan. If Lin Fan hadn’t meddled, she wouldn’t be in her current predicament. She had finally found a chance to teach a lesson to those national men she despised.
Who would have thought Lin Fan would reveal the video and expose the truth? Not only did it embarrass her in front of everyone, but it also robbed her of the opportunity to teach the national men a lesson. It’s frustrating.
So she couldn’t help but provoke Lin Fan.
Even though Lin Fan looks quite handsome, he wears cheap clothes—a typical poor loser. The Glasses Lady doesn’t fear poor losers at all; in her eyes, they’re the most useless kind of men.
So, the Glasses Lady was bold, not only dissing Lin Fan but also insulting Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue was furious, but she didn’t want to stoop to the Glasses Lady’s level, so she grabbed Lin Fan and tried to leave.
Lin Fan, however, demanded the Glasses Lady apologize to Wei Qingxue. He didn’t mind being insulted, but as Wei Qingxue’s friend, he couldn’t let her be humiliated.
"As a university student, your conduct is quite poor. You ask me what can I do to you, but let me ask you, how would you feel about being expelled from school?" Lin Fan said.
The Glasses Lady laughed out loud: "Poor loser, who are you trying to scare? Who do you think you are, saying I’ll get expelled just because you say so?"
Lin Fan replied, "I’m going to watch a movie now, and when I come out, I hope to see you here apologizing."
The Glasses Lady arrogantly said, "You’re dreaming. Why should I apologize to you, you filthy loser? Even if I die, I won’t apologize to you. Who do you think you’re threatening?"
After she finished speaking, she turned away without giving Lin Fan any face.
"Looks like the little buddy wasn’t effective. That weird woman didn’t apologize to them."
"Little buddy’s threat failed."
"I guess that weird woman really is hard to deal with. Best to avoid such people in the future."
The surrounding crowd discussed it and began to disperse.
Wei Qingxue shook her head and said speechlessly, "What a weirdo."
Lin Fan said, "Sorry for standing up for that guy and dragging you into being insulted by her."
Wei Qingxue said, "I’m fine, Lin Fan. You’re so kind-hearted, always helping others."
She admired Lin Fan even more from the bottom of her heart. When she first met Lin Fan, it was also because he was helping a woman going through a divorce, leading her to seek Lin Fan for a fake marriage.
A guy like Lin Fan, looking good, skilled, and so kind-hearted—it’s really hard to find.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Just a minor effort. If I can help others with a small gesture, why not?"
"Yes, I should learn from you in the future. Enough talk, the movie’s about to start. Let’s get inside." Wei Qingxue checked the time and said.
The two reached the entrance of the cinema.
Lin Fan said, "I’ll go to the restroom first. You go ahead inside."
After Wei Qingxue entered the cinema, Lin Fan headed to the restroom while taking out his phone to make a call.
"Hello, Director Chen, it’s Lin Fan. I want to ask, who is the principal of Qinghua University? Here’s the situation..."
When Lin Fan came out of the restroom, he entered the cinema as the movie had already started. He found Wei Qingxue and sat next to her.
"Why did you take so long?" Wei Qingxue asked, unaware that Lin Fan had gone to make a call.
Lin Fan said, "Maybe I ate something bad."
Wei Qingxue sweated a bit: "Alright then."
Next, the two watched the movie.
Two hours later, the movie ended.
The crowd gradually left the cinema.
"This movie was great, quite funny. Lin Fan, what did you think?" Wei Qingxue asked with a smile. She had a delightful two hours, especially being with Lin Fan; it felt wonderful.
It was their first date. Wei Qingxue hadn’t been in a relationship before, and it was her first time watching a movie with a guy, feeling quite fresh.
Lin Fan said, "It was good."
The two chatted as they reached the entrance of the cinema.
Suddenly, a figure rushed over, stopped in front of Lin Fan, and knelt down.
This startled Wei Qingxue, and the surrounding people curiously turned to look.
Huh?
Everyone was stunned—it was the Glasses Lady.
They had all watched the same movie, so they witnessed the prior incidents.
Lin Fan had demanded an apology from the Glasses Lady, but she completely ignored him and left after threatening him.
Everyone thought the matter was over, but who knew the Glasses Lady would return and kneel before Lin Fan?
What’s going on?
The Glasses Lady seemed to have been waiting for Lin Fan for a long time. Now, she was crying with snot and tears, saying, "I’m sorry, I know I was wrong. I apologize to you. Please forgive me!"
Everyone looked at each other, puzzled about what was happening.
Wei Qingxue frowned: "Hey, what are you doing?"
The Glasses Lady said, "Because of today’s incident, the school wants to expel me. The principal said, unless I am forgiven by Junior Zhao Xiaoguang and you."
So that’s it!
Though they didn’t know why, it seemed the matter had escalated to the school. Even the principal of Qinghua University knew, no wonder the Glasses Lady admitted defeat. It’s so ironic, perfectly illustrating the saying that one doesn’t cry until they see the coffin.
Wei Qingxue laughed: "Didn’t you say you’d never apologize to us even if you died?"
The Glasses Lady said, "I don’t want to be expelled. Please forgive me?"
Lin Fan said indifferently, "Your apology lacks sincerity."
The Glasses Lady asked, "What must I do for you to forgive me?"
Lin Fan asked, "How did you insult her before?"
The Glasses Lady hurriedly said, "I was wrong. She’s not a lowlife; I am the lowlife."
Those words made the surrounding people burst into laughter. This Glasses Lady was such a coward, so different from before.
This woman, without understanding, threatened an innocent junior with social death. Even after learning the truth, she didn’t repent, and her arrogant attitude angered the crowd.
"Lowlife, if it weren’t illegal, I’d slap you twice! You should slap yourself!"
The crowd laughed and jeered.
"Good idea, what she needs is a beating!"
"She deserves a lesson!"
Upon hearing these words, the Glasses Lady felt miserable. With so many people yelling at her, it’s like they’re trying to socially bury her.
She looked at Lin Fan, seeking his pity.
Lin Fan smiled, saying, "I think everyone’s suggestion is pretty good."
The Glasses Lady instantly broke down. Looks like if she doesn’t hit herself, she won’t get out of this mess.
So, while crying, the Glasses Lady slapped herself ten times on each cheek, turning them red, leaving five finger marks, quite harshly.
Although Lin Fan really wanted to slap her himself, doing that would give her a reason to retaliate.
This way, making her hit herself is pretty good.
"How about now, are you satisfied?" Lin Fan turned to Wei Qingxue and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: Proposal
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Chapter 447: Proposal
Whether or not to teach a lesson to this Glasses Lady, Lin Fan didn’t really mind, but since she offended Wei Qingxue, he wouldn’t let it go.
Wei Qingxue giggled, "I’ve already calmed down."
"That’s good." Lin Fan then looked at the Glasses Lady, "Miss, I hope you truly realize your mistake. Young people shouldn’t be so extreme; take care of yourself, reflect well, and don’t become a fighter. Hatred towards the opposite sex doesn’t benefit you. Learn to see the beauty in life. You can leave now."
"Thank you," the Glasses Lady said.
Amidst the mocking laughter, the Glasses Lady left dejectedly.
With that, the matter ended. Lin Fan said to Wei Qingxue, "I’m a bit hungry, how about we go eat?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Hmm, I’ve already booked a nice restaurant. Let’s go."
The two then walked out of the mall.
Wei Qingxue said, "It’s a bit strange though, why did that weirdo come back to apologize? It feels like someone helped us behind the scenes."
Lin Fan silently sweated; Wei Qingxue’s intuition was spot on; indeed, someone did act, and it was him.
Lin Fan had previously gotten to know Director Chen of the Education Bureau through Liu Mengjie, the principal of Yun City Music Academy.
Upon learning that Lin Fan was Mr. Lin, the richest man in Yun City, Director Chen showed great respect towards him.
Today, Lin Fan leveraged this relationship and asked Director Chen to have a word with the principal of Qinghua University.
With Director Chen taking action, the matter was naturally resolved easily. No matter how arrogant the Glasses Lady was, upon hearing she might be expelled, she obediently came to apologize.
Of course, Lin Fan didn’t tell Wei Qingxue this and said, "Maybe that lady exposed people’s information on her social circle, which caught the school’s attention. The school has to maintain its reputation too."
Wei Qingxue went "Oh, that might be it."
At that moment, they stopped paying attention to the matter and headed towards the restaurant.
As they reached the entrance of a restaurant and were about to enter, Lin Fan received a phone call from Director Chen.
Not wanting to pick up the call in front of Wei Qingxue, Lin Fan said, "You go in first, I’ll head to the restroom; I really have an upset stomach today."
Saying so, Lin Fan hurriedly walked away.
"Alright then." Wei Qingxue chuckled, feeling a bit puzzled. How did Lin Fan get an upset stomach from the meal they shared at the restaurant earlier?
As Wei Qingxue was about to enter, someone suddenly appeared beside her; it was Ma Jialiang.
Ma Jialiang, holding a bouquet of flowers, grinned and said, "Little Sister Qingxue, this is for you."
Wei Qingxue was taken aback, "How did you find this place?"
Ma Jialiang laughed, "I unintentionally overheard from Auntie that you’re divorced now, so I wanted to pick you up at your company for a meal. But when I got there, I found you’d left already. I asked your assistant—of course, I tipped a little—to find out you reserved a table here, so I came."
Wei Qingxue was a bit annoyed. Her assistant, hired after Lin Fan left, had so easily been bribed by Ma Jialiang, revealing her whereabouts. It seemed the first thing she had to do tomorrow was to fire her assistant.
Ma Jialiang laughed, "Little Sister Qingxue, it’s great you got divorced. I’ve said all along, that Lin Fan is not right for you. I’m your perfect match."
Wei Qingxue replied, "Sorry, I don’t want to discuss this. I’ve made plans to eat here with someone, please leave."
Wei Qingxue turned and entered the restaurant, trying to shake off Ma Jialiang.
But Ma Jialiang followed her in.
"Little Sister Qingxue, although the timing’s a bit rushed, I’ve arranged a surprise for you tonight," Ma Jialiang said.
Wei Qingxue asked, "What surprise, Young Master Ma, what are you up to?"
Ma Jialiang smiled, "Of course, I’m proposing to you. I believe no one would object—I’m your ideal prince charming. Don’t worry, I don’t mind that you’ve been married before. I’ve organized an engagement party tonight."
Wei Qingxue said, "Are you kidding me, an engagement party? Did I agree to marry you, Young Master Ma? Please don’t assume anything!"
Ma Jialiang said, "Little Sister Qingxue, it’s okay if you don’t agree now, but I’m confident you will eventually because no one else is more suitable. Besides the engagement party, I’ve prepared another surprise for you today."
As Ma Jialiang spoke, he clapped his hands twice.
And then a soft, beautiful piece of music began to play.
Two waitstaff came in, pushing in a large cake on a trolley.
The cake was three layers tall—a truly large cake.
People in the restaurant were immediately drawn in, turning to look.
"What’s going on, an engagement cake? It’s the first time I’ve seen such a big engagement cake!"
"This lady is so lucky!"
"This is a proposal! This guy has to be some wealthy young master."
"I’m so envious of her. If only I had a rich young master pursuing me."
Onlookers expressed their envy with glances full of admiration.
Soon, the big cake was pushed right in front of Ma Jialiang and Wei Qingxue, stopping there.
Wei Qingxue, being a low-profile person, instinctively felt repulsed by this display. She really disliked such over-the-top gestures.
But not Ma Jialiang. He loved to show off and wanted the whole world to know he was proposing to Wei Qingxue.
"Little Sister Qingxue, this is the biggest cake I could find on such short notice. How do you feel, satisfied?" Ma Jialiang smiled.
Wei Qingxue said coldly, "What are you doing?"
"Little Sister Qingxue, I want to propose in front of everyone here, to have all witnesses," Ma Jialiang said.
Holding the flowers, Ma Jialiang knelt down towards Wei Qingxue with deep affection, "Little Sister Qingxue, I truly like you so much. You are the only one for me; please agree to marry me!"
As Ma Jialiang spoke, he tried to grasp Wei Qingxue’s hand to continue his ardent proposal.
However, Wei Qingxue instinctively stepped back, a flash of disgust crossing her face.
She really didn’t want to be touched by Ma Jialiang’s hand; even imagining it made her feel sick because she knew exactly what kind of person Ma Jialiang was.
Everything Ma Jialiang was doing today went against her wishes. He didn’t understand Wei Qingxue at all.
Wei Qingxue didn’t like such flamboyant proposals, but that wasn’t the main issue. The main issue was she didn’t like Ma Jialiang; his presumptuous actions were really distasteful.
"Isn’t this the eldest son of the Ma Family, the one who just came back from abroad?"
"It really is! And the lady seems to be from a wealthy family too."
"Eldest son, wealthy daughter—it makes sense why it’s so lavish!"
The onlookers talked among themselves, their faces full of envy.
Ma Jialiang felt secretly proud—this was exactly the effect he wanted: for the whole world to know he was going to marry Wei Qingxue!
"Little Sister Qingxue, did you hear that? Our marriage is bound to receive Yun City’s blessing. Everyone envies us as a golden couple. Little Sister Qingxue, please accept my love for you."
Ma Jialiang said again, attempting once more to grasp Wei Qingxue’s hand.
"Don’t mess around!" Wei Qingxue quickly dodged, standing up in a flash.
Ma Jialiang’s hand once again reached into thin air, a bit embarrassed and slightly annoyed. He said sternly, "Little Sister Qingxue, you are my fiancée; avoiding it won’t help. Everyone’s watching, don’t make me look bad, alright?"
As he said this, he stood up, trying to grab Wei Qingxue’s hand.
"Don’t come over!" Wei Qingxue yelled angrily, dodging once more.
The onlookers exchanged glances—something was off, wasn’t it?
Ma Jialiang felt a bit awkward and increasingly annoyed. If he got rejected in front of all these people, it would be a laughingstock.
He had to catch Wei Qingxue no matter what.
Steeling his heart, Ma Jialiang was about to step forward and forcibly grab Wei Qingxue.
"Hey, what’s going on?" A voice called out as Lin Fan entered from outside, his face expressionless.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Because I Want to Pursue Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Chapter 448: Because I Want to Pursue Him
Young Master Ma, upon learning that Wei Qingxue had divorced, couldn’t wait to propose to her. In his view, now that Wei Qingxue and Lin Fan were divorced, there must be a fracture in their relationship, and this was the perfect opportunity for him to take advantage.
So he took it upon himself to prepare a marriage proposal for Wei Qingxue, thinking it was very romantic and that it would surely move Wei Qingxue.
Unexpectedly, his actions were seen by Wei Qingxue as nothing but ostentatious and abrupt. Wei Qingxue didn’t like it at all and flatly refused Young Master Ma’s courtship.
"Miss Wei doesn’t seem willing, huh?"
"Could it be that Young Master Ma is overestimating his charm?"
"Now that’s awkward!"
The people around began to gossip.
The scene became quite awkward for a moment.
Young Master Ma felt utterly humiliated. As a distinguished son of the Ma family, he couldn’t just lose face like this. No matter what, he had to salvage the situation.
Young Master Ma then pressed towards Wei Qingxue, attempting to forcibly grab her hand, as if holding her hand would make her agree to his proposal.
Wei Qingxue instinctively stepped back, trying to evade Young Master Ma, but the restaurant passage was narrow, leaving her with little room to escape. She was about to be caught by Young Master Ma.
Suddenly, a hand reached out and firmly grasped Young Master Ma’s hand.
"What are you doing?" a cold voice said.
Lin Fan had arrived!
Seeing this, Wei Qingxue let out a sigh of relief, joy rising in her heart. Lin Fan was here, and that made her feel safe at once.
If he had been a moment later, she would have been caught by Young Master Ma.
That was too close!
In her heart, the affection for Lin Fan soared instantly.
It’s really good to have Lin Fan around, always appearing when she needed him.
"Let go of me! How dare you even touch me!"
Young Master Ma shouted. Being held by Lin Fan, his first feeling was one of offense. Who was he? A son of the Ma family, and who was Lin Fan? Just a delivery man. Was he worthy? What face was there left for him?
Besides, Lin Fan was so strong, it wasn’t like grabbing his hand but more like clamping it with an iron grip. His hand felt like it would break.
"What did you say? It’s too noisy in this restaurant; I didn’t hear it clearly," Lin Fan said coldly, not releasing his grip but tightening it instead.
Everyone around sweated; the crowd quieted down to watch the spectacle. It was evident that Lin Fan was doing it on purpose.
"Ah!"
Young Master Ma let out a scream, sweating profusely from the pain.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "That’s more like it. You’ve got a lot of energy to shout. Want to continue?"
Young Master Ma quickly responded, "No, no, Lin Fan, please let me go!"
He was about to cry. If Lin Fan exerted any more pressure, his hand would be useless. A wise man knows when to retreat; he had to concede to get Lin Fan to release him.
Lin Fan really showed no regard for him, this Young Master of the Ma family. Truth be told, Lin Fan had never once cared about him.
Even when flaunting his identity as a Young Master of the Ma family in front of Lin Fan, it was of no use; admitting defeat was the only way.
Seeing Young Master Ma begging for mercy, Lin Fan finally let go. He didn’t mind breaking Young Master Ma’s hand, but there was no need to make a scene too ugly.
Young Master Ma rubbed his wrist, still hurting. Damn, this Lin Fan was simply inhuman; no ordinary person has such a great grip strength!
Lin Fan, didn’t you and Little Sister Qingxue already divorce? What are you still doing here? Do you still intend to pursue Little Sister Qingxue? Give up that idea!" Young Master Ma shouted.
Wei Qingxue said, "Ma Jialiang, stop talking nonsense here. Lin Fan isn’t trying to pursue me."
Young Master Ma was delighted: "Really? That’s great. Wait, Little Sister Qingxue, then why are you having dinner here tonight, and why is Lin Fan here?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I’m just having dinner with Lin Fan."
Young Master Ma was confused: "I don’t understand. If he’s not pursuing you, why are you two eating together?"
He was envious. Even divorced, Lin Fan was dining with Wei Qingxue, yet when he wanted to have a meal with her, she wouldn’t agree.
Wei Qingxue said, "It’s simple, because I’m the one pursuing Lin Fan."
Wei Qingxue blushed a little. It wasn’t something she initially wanted to say in public, but she needed Ma Jialiang to know there was no chance between them.
The people around were stunned. What?
A woman chasing a man?
Miss Wei, a woman as beautiful as a goddess, actually chasing after someone? This Lin Fan, besides being a bit handsome, was clearly just a poor guy. What made him deserving?
Young Master Ma was nearly going insane.
Hearing that Lin Fan wasn’t pursuing Wei Qingxue, he had felt glad. Who would have thought it was Wei Qingxue pursuing Lin Fan!
This was a hundred times worse than Lin Fan pursuing Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue actually liked Lin Fan this much!
Young Master Ma was furious. That Lin Fan, just a damn delivery guy, what right did he have!
He was a proud son of the Ma family. Why would Wei Qingxue rather choose a delivery guy over him!
"Young Master Ma, what happened here?" Just then, a short, stout man in a suit approached, having noticed the commotion, and respectfully asked Young Master Ma, nodding and bowing to him.
Young Master Ma saw him and said, "Manager Niu, just in time. This guy is causing trouble here. Get him out!"
Manager Niu looked over Lin Fan, dressed in market-stall goods, clearly a poor man, and felt a bit contemptuous, but as the manager of this restaurant, he was trained not to show it too much.
"Young Master Ma, I’m truly sorry. It’s our oversight." Manager Niu quickly apologized to Young Master Ma.
Then, Manager Niu turned to Lin Fan, smiling, and said, "Sir, this restaurant is a quiet dining place for all. Please don’t cause trouble here and leave."
Lin Fan said, "Just because he says I’m causing trouble, does that mean I am? As a manager, without even clarifying the situation, you want to kick me out; what’s the reason?"
His retort left Manager Niu uncomfortable. As the manager, he saw himself as above people like Lin Fan.
Lin Fan wasn’t qualified to confront him.
Manager Niu stared at Lin Fan, expression darkening, and scolded, "Boy, since you don’t appreciate my kindness, I won’t be polite. You’re not allowed in this restaurant; please leave immediately!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "That’s strange. You open the door to do business, everyone can enter. Why can’t I?"
Manager Niu said, "Because we’re a high-class restaurant. Didn’t you see the notice at the entrance? Proper attire is required to enter. Just look at what you’re wearing; it doesn’t meet our standards. Besides, can you even afford it?"
Hearing this, the people around couldn’t help but laugh. Indeed, Lin Fan’s attire screamed poverty; he likely couldn’t afford it at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Watch your tone when speaking to me
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 449: Watch your tone when speaking to me
"What kind of rule is this? A restaurant actually has a dress code? Isn’t this a place to eat? How does what you wear affect eating? This seems like a discriminatory policy." Lin Fan frowned and said.
A rundown restaurant, yet they look down on people and actually require a dress code.
Manager Niu said coldly, "This rule was set by our boss. I’m just enforcing it. Sorry, but please leave!"
Young Master Ma laughed smugly, "Lin Fan, is this fun for you? Such a poor loser, truly embarrassing. If it were me, I wouldn’t have the face to stay any longer!"
Lin Fan said, "What if I don’t leave?"
Manager Niu said, "If you won’t leave, I see you’re intentionally causing trouble. You’re picking the wrong place. If you don’t leave, I’ll have to call security to escort you out!"
"Oh, feel free to try." Lin Fan smiled slightly, suggesting that calling security to escort him out was not really a good idea.
At this point, Wei Qingxue spoke up, "Manager Niu, he’s with me. I invited him here for dinner. Are you sure you want to kick him out?"
Manager Niu’s heart skipped when he saw Wei Qingxue. He recognized her. Wei Qingxue often dined here and was the third young lady of the Wei Family, the female CEO of the Wei Family Company.
What’s more, Wei Qingxue was also acquaintances with the restaurant owner.
He couldn’t afford to offend a guest like her.
If Wei Qingxue complained to the owner, he wouldn’t be able to keep his job as manager.
Manager Niu cursed Young Master Ma in his heart for nearly getting him into trouble.
"Miss Wei, I’m very sorry. Please forgive my shortsightedness. So, he’s your guest? It was a misunderstanding, just a misunderstanding!" Manager Niu quickly said with a smile.
Wei Qingxue coldly said, "Manager Niu, are you still trying to kick my guest out?"
"I wouldn’t dare, I wouldn’t dare. How could I? It was my mistake. Miss Wei, please don’t take offense!" Manager Niu replied with an awkward grin.
Then he also apologized to Lin Fan, "My friend, I’m really sorry for this misunderstanding!"
Seeing Manager Niu’s change of attitude, Young Master Ma was displeased, "Manager Niu, was everything you just said nonsense? Didn’t you say the restaurant has its own rules? This guy is dressed so inappropriately, and you’re not kicking him out? Are you going to break your own rules?"
Manager Niu forced a smile. The restaurant indeed had this rule, but it was only meant for ordinary people. Now that Wei Qingxue had brought someone in, never mind if he was wearing bargain basement clothes, even if he were in rags, Manager Niu wouldn’t dare to have an opinion.
However, Young Master Ma was also someone he couldn’t afford to offend, so he needed to smooth things over.
"Rules are dead, but people are alive. Since this gentleman is Miss Wei’s guest, we shouldn’t have anything to say about it. Young Master Ma, please understand." Manager Niu said.
Young Master Ma said, "Forget the dress code; fine, but the issue is, he did cause trouble earlier. He injured my wrist, and your restaurant allows this?"
Wei Qingxue coldly retorted, "Young Master Ma, I hope you won’t distort the truth. You were the one who offended me first, and Lin Fan was simply helping me stop you from doing wrong."
Young Master Ma was going crazy with jealousy. Wei Qingxue was constantly speaking up for Lin Fan. It looked like she indeed was pursuing Lin Fan.
"Wei Qingxue, I really want to ask you, aren’t you being cheap? You actually like this deadbeat delivery guy!" Young Master Ma shouted angrily.
Slap!
Suddenly, Lin Fan swung his hand and gave Young Master Ma a loud slap.
Young Master Ma’s face swelled on one side instantly.
"Watch your mouth!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "If you dare to speak offensively to her again, the next slap won’t be so light."
"Ah!"
Young Master Ma screamed again, tears streaming from his eyes.
The surrounding fell silent, and everyone was stunned.
One had to admit, this Lin Fan guy was really ruthless.
Who would dare to offend him?
Young Master Ma felt utterly humiliated, being publicly slapped by a mere delivery man, without the strength to retaliate. The most infuriating part was that Lin Fan, this guy, really didn’t care about his status as a young master of the Ma Family, not knowing where his confidence came from. Did he look down on the Ma Family?
Unable to fight back against Lin Fan, Young Master Ma could only pressure Manager Niu.
"Manager Niu, you saw it. This guy is too arrogant, causing violence in your restaurant, and you’re not doing anything?" Young Master Ma shouted.
Manager Niu felt bitter inside. This customer of Miss Wei was really overbearing. He should be grateful he didn’t have a conflict with Lin Fan, or else he might have ended up with a swollen face.
