However, Young Master Ma was also a member of the gentry, and he couldn’t just ignore his demands.
Manager Niu could only say, "Miss Wei, it’s like this. The restaurant is a place for dining, and today’s incident has severely affected the restaurant’s normal order. I have to be responsible to the guests. Miss Wei, please understand my predicament. You’ve seen that he did strike someone. How about this: I suggest he apologize to Young Master Ma, and let’s move past this. What do you think?"
Wei Qingxue sneered, "The restaurant has rules, and of course, as guests, we should respect them. But I hope Manager Niu clarifies who exactly is causing trouble."
Manager Niu wiped his cold sweat, "Miss Wei, what do you suggest?"
Wei Qingxue said, "I initially just invited him here for a meal, but who knew Young Master Ma would come to harass me. Manager Niu, you saw it. That big cake was brought by Young Master Ma. I don’t like him, yet he insisted on proposing to me, and after I refused, he still tried to push himself onto me. Lin Fan merely helped stop him. It was an act of justice. Was it wrong?"
"This..." Manager Niu broke into a cold sweat, realizing what had really happened.
But he couldn’t afford to drive away the young master from the Ma Family.
"Miss Wei, Young Master Ma, this is a personal matter between you two, and it really shouldn’t be aired in public. If word gets out, it could harm both of your reputations. How about listening to my advice, both calm down, let this be, and consider it giving me a bit of face? How about dining here for free on my account today?" Manager Niu said, having no other option but to try to smooth things over.
However, Young Master Ma was displeased, "Manager Niu, who do you think you are? Why should I give you face?"
Manager Niu’s face changed, taken aback by the disrespect, but he still smiled apologetically on the surface.
Young Master Ma continued to rant, "You damn well better watch your mouth. You saw that he hit me. Call security now and get this guy out of here!"
Manager Niu dared not. Having seen Lin Fan in action, he knew that even calling security couldn’t do anything to Lin Fan.
Wei Qingxue laughed softly, "Manager Niu, I don’t want to put you in a difficult position. Things have become like this, and I’m not in the mood to eat here anymore. Lin Fan, let’s find another place."
Lin Fan nodded, "Sure."
So, the two of them planned to leave.
Manager Niu breathed a sigh of relief, grateful that Wei Qingxue willingly decided to leave. His favorability towards her instantly rose.
Miss Wei was far more reasonable than Young Master Ma.
Young Master Ma was furious, stepping forward to block Wei Qingxue, "Lin Fan hit me; don’t think you’ll just walk out so easily. Even if you leave, it will be by security kicking you out! Manager Niu, I’ll say it again, you..."
Before Young Master Ma could finish his sentence, Lin Fan suddenly lifted him up and sent him flying.
Slap!
Young Master Ma crashed into that big cake, burying his head into it, looking ridiculous and pathetic. When he finally stood up, half a cake was still stuck on his head, creating a very comical scene.
Boom!
The onlookers couldn’t help but burst into laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Arrogant Street Punk
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 450: Arrogant Street Punk
Ma Jialiang attempted to block Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue, but Lin Fan had already lost patience and simply picked up Ma Jialiang and threw him out. Ma Jialiang landed right on the big cake, plunging headfirst into it, extremely embarrassed.
The crowd around couldn’t help but burst into laughter at the scene.
Ma Jialiang got up and was suddenly grabbed by the collar by Lin Fan.
"The people who were at the gate of the community last time, you must have sent them, right? This time, consider it a payback. Since Qingxue doesn’t want the cake, you can enjoy it yourself."
Lin Fan chuckled and once again pushed Ma Jialiang’s head into the cake.
By the time Ma Jialiang struggled to his feet and managed to wipe the cake off his eyes, Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue were already gone.
The crowd was still laughing at his expense, and Ma Jialiang was furious.
"Lin Fan, you just wait. I will never let you get away with this!" Ma Jialiang gritted his teeth, hating Lin Fan to the core.
What made him more frustrated was that Lin Fan, a mere courier, was so good at fighting. The people he called to teach Lin Fan a lesson last time ended up going back disgraced.
It seemed he would need to find an even more skilled expert to deal with Lin Fan.
The scene shifted to Lin Fan and Wei Qingxue leaving the restaurant.
Wei Qingxue apologized, "Lin Fan, I’m really sorry. I wanted to treat you to a meal, but who knew it would turn out like this."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s fine. We can just find another place to eat."
Wei Qingxue said, "Yes, but the better restaurants all require reservations, and it’s too late for that now."
Lin Fan said, "It’s just food. Anywhere is fine. There’s no need to go to a high-end restaurant. They have so many rules, and they’re not necessarily better. The food is expensive and not much. I’ll take you to a good place."
Lin Fan took Wei Qingxue to a street food stall, a place where Feng Ruolan had taken him before. The food was pretty good, and since it was nearby, Lin Fan decided to bring Wei Qingxue there.
Wei Qingxue, the Wei Family’s heiress, had always lived a life of luxury and had never eaten at such street stalls.
"Can the food here be any good?" Wei Qingxue asked curiously.
This kind of street stall was a far cry from upscale restaurants. Dining here had no such rules; you could wear whatever you liked. There were even men eating shirtless, and nobody minded. It was a place full of all kinds of people: students, workers, office workers... full of a lively atmosphere.
Lin Fan pulled her to sit down, saying, "You’ll know soon enough."
Lin Fan ordered simple stir-fried dishes.
Soon, the food arrived.
"Eat while it’s hot," Lin Fan smiled and said.
Wei Qingxue picked up her chopsticks and took a slice of stir-fried meat.
Surprisingly... it tasted unexpectedly good!
"Mmm, not bad!" Wei Qingxue exclaimed in surprise.
Wei Qingxue was a bit aloof by nature and didn’t usually enjoy socializing. The places she frequented were always high-end. This was her first time eating at such a place, and she unexpectedly found it quite tasty.
Lin Fan found it amusing in his heart; indeed, these wealthy girls who grew up in luxury couldn’t resist the charm of street food. Feng Ruolan was like this, and so was Wei Qingxue.
Wei Qingxue ate two bowls of stir-fried noodles, fully satisfied.
"So, was I wrong?" Lin Fan smiled and asked.
Wei Qingxue blushed slightly, aware that her eating manner might not have been the most graceful.
"Yes, it was quite good. Lin Fan, have you lived around here before?" Wei Qingxue asked curiously.
This area appeared quite rundown, an old neighborhood much like an urban village, a place where the social underclass gathered.
When Wei Qingxue had been kicked out of the Wei family the other day, she stayed one night in a village apartment with Lin Fan and felt very uncomfortable.
At that time, she didn’t have feelings for Lin Fan. Now her feelings had changed, and the place seemed to have a bit of a warm familiarity because it was somewhere her beloved had once stayed.
Lin Fan replied, "I’ve never lived here. Someone else brought me to eat here once."
Wei Qingxue probably thought he meant a fellow courier or a friend of similar status. If she knew it was Yun City’s wealthiest woman, Feng Ruolan, she would be astonished.
Wei Qingxue said, "Whatever the case, the food here is pretty good. Thank you, Lin Fan. This meal was really satisfying. If you have time in the future, you should bring me here again. Even if you don’t, I’ll come here by myself to eat."
Lin Fan said, "Sure. But it’s best you don’t come alone."
Wei Qingxue asked curiously, "Why not?"
Lin Fan replied, "Because this area can be quite chaotic, and as a girl, you might not be able to protect yourself."
Wei Qingxue looked confused and said, "I’ve rarely... actually never eaten at places like this, but I always heard that people from the lower social classes are kind-hearted. Was that wrong?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "That’s indeed wrong. The idea that the lower classes are kind is just a generalization, giving those who are not familiar with it a stereotype. But in reality, harm within lower classes is quite common. For instance, many street thugs come from lower social backgrounds, and their victims are often the lower-class citizens themselves."
Speaking of street thugs, Wei Qingxue shuddered, remembering how she had almost been kidnapped by thugs that day.
Lin Fan was right to remind Wei Qingxue of the mixed crowds on the street. It’s not a good place. The last time Lin Fan and Feng Ruolan came here for a late-night snack, they encountered harassment.
The reason the lower classes remain the lower classes is due to their difficult living conditions. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so many people fighting tooth and nail to break through the barriers to move up.
Living in a high-end neighborhood and living in an urban village are worlds apart. A high-end neighborhood with strict security naturally has a much lower incident rate than a chaotic urban village.
Thud!
While the two were talking, suddenly at the table next to them, someone slammed a beer bottle heavily.
It turned out there were several Blonde Hair guys sitting at that table, all shirtless, having a late-night snack. Just now, a waitress brought dishes to them, but one Blonde Hair, dissatisfied, smashed a bottle.
"What the hell is this? Don’t you want this job anymore? Why is this stir-fried snail cold?" Blonde Hair shouted, his face red from several bottles of beer, clearly using the alcohol to fuel his anger.
The waitress was frightened and quickly said, "I... I’m not sure either, sorry, I will go check."
Blonde Hair said, "Get your boss over here. Damn it, do you not see who we are? How dare you neglect us? Do you look down on Brother Jin Ya!"
The street food stall owner came over after hearing the commotion.
After understanding the situation, the owner quickly smiled apologetically, "I’m so sorry. I didn’t realize these were Brother San Jinya’s men. My eyes must have been blind. This girl is new and might have served the wrong dish. I’m really sorry. To calm you down, this meal is on me."
Blonde Hair said, "Though we’re from the streets, we don’t eat for free. Go make us another dish of snails, and we’ll pay for it."
The owner was delighted, "Thank you, please wait, I’ll get it right away."
The owner was about to leave with the waitress.
"Wait!" Blonde Hair eyed the waitress with a wicked smile, "She shouldn’t leave. Come and sit down, and have a few drinks with us brothers."
What?
They actually wanted the waitress to drink with them?
Wei Qingxue frowned. Lin Fan was right; this place was indeed a mix of good and bad. She definitely wouldn’t dare to come here alone again.

chapters.title: Chapter 451: You Are Not Fortunate Enough
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 451: You Are Not Fortunate Enough
Because the waitress served the wrong dish, Blonde Hair got furious and demanded that the waitress drink with them.
The waitress was instantly terrified, her face ashen. This young girl had just finished high school and came out to look for a job. Because her education wasn’t high, she couldn’t find a lofty job, so she took up temporarily working as a waitress at this eatery.
Being tired at work was one thing, but she never expected that within a few days of working, she’d encounter something like this.
Of course, she wouldn’t drink with these hooligans; she wasn’t that kind of person.
The waitress had no choice but to look at the boss for help; she had no other hope, so she could only rely on the boss to rescue her.
The boss of the eatery also felt that Blonde Hair’s demand was too much.
The boss smiled awkwardly, "Young man, this isn’t very appropriate, don’t you think..."
Smack!
Before the boss could finish speaking, Blonde Hair slapped him, interrupting him.
"Screw you, calling me young man, call me big brother!" Blonde Hair arrogantly said.
The boss of the eatery was slapped so hard stars flashed in his eyes, but he dared not get angry. He could only chuckle awkwardly, "Yes, big brother, big brothers, please go easy on this young lady for my sake. She’s the daughter of my friend, and I promised to look after her. Big brothers, have mercy."
Blonde Hair cursed, "What the hell are you, am I supposed to give you face? Let her drink with us, it’s giving her a chance to make up for her mistake, otherwise who knows what we’ll do."
All the Blonde Hairs at the table laughed wildly.
The commotion here had already attracted the attention of the surrounding people, and everyone felt that these Blonde Hairs were too arrogant.
But everyone was angry yet afraid to speak up, who dared to provoke these Blonde Hairs, clearly they’re low-life hooligans, who would dare stand up for this poor waitress?
Even the boss of the eatery backed down after being slapped.
"Little Wei, listen, why not just have a couple of drinks with the big brothers, it’s no big deal." The boss turned to persuade the waitress.
The waitress was incredulous, she had been hoping for the boss to save her, but instead, after a shout from Blonde Hair, he helped the tyrants instead.
"Uncle Jin..." the waitress exclaimed, "I don’t want to drink with them, what do they take me for, Uncle Jin, you must help me."
The boss of the eatery smiled wryly, "Girl, I’m trying to help you, resisting will only make it worse, having a few drinks with them is the way out, it’s no big deal, with so many people here, the big brothers won’t do anything to you, listen to uncle’s advice, it’s the only way."
The waitress became anxious and said, "Why should I drink with them? This plate of snails was sent by you, the previous customer rejected it, you said it could still be eaten, so you told me to serve it, this mess was caused by you, you should be the one drinking with them."
The boss of the eatery became anxious, "You girl, watch your mouth..."
The waitress, in her hurry, exposed the boss’s shady practices, actually using returned dishes from previous customers for new customers!
Such things aren’t unheard of in the food industry, whether it’s a street stall or a big restaurant, these shady practices can exist.
Moreover, this isn’t even the worst, some restaurants, to save costs, would use gutter oil, that’s truly disgusting.
Gutter oil is extracted from food waste and reused as oil to serve guests again.
As long as you’re eating out, whether it’s from a street stall or a decent restaurant, you might encounter gutter oil, it all depends on whether the restaurant owner has a conscience.
Counting on others to have a conscience is quite unreliable to begin with.
"Pfft."
Someone suddenly laughed next to them.
Turns out Lin Fan found the waitress’s suggestion quite amusing, couldn’t help but laugh.
Though it was indeed funny, everyone around held their breath, who dared laugh, these hooligans in front were clearly not to be messed with.
Lin Fan’s laugh seemed untimely.
It immediately drew everyone’s attention.
Blonde Hair frowned, displeased, "Kid, what are you laughing at?"
"Sorry, I thought of him, an old guy, drinking with you bunch, and thought it a bit absurd, couldn’t help but laugh." Lin Fan honestly said.
Blonde Hair pointed at Lin Fan cursing, "Mind your own business! Eh?"
Blonde Hair noticed Wei Qingxue sitting with Lin Fan.
Damn!
So beautiful!
So stunning!
Simply a fairy!
Definitely a beauty scoring above 9.
Normally, the beauties we come across daily at most score 5 or 6, seeing a 7 or above is rare, let alone one above 9, it’s scarce.
In reality, the chance of encountering a 9-point beauty is quite low, let alone in an old city district like this, where did such a stunning beauty come from?
No wonder Blonde Hair was surprised upon seeing her.
Each pair of eyes shone brightly.
"Kid, who is this beauty to you?" Blonde Hair asked Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "None of your business, right?"
Wei Qingxue frowned, it seemed she had caught the attention of these hooligans. They couldn’t possibly want her to drink with them, do they?
Wei Qingxue sneered in her heart, if these reckless fools really dared to harbor ideas about her, they’d be in for a real disaster.
Blonde Hair had indeed taken a liking to Wei Qingxue, and before her, the waitress was forgotten, left behind.
"Kid, you dare meddle, have this beauty come over, drink a couple of cups with us, and we’ll let this matter be." Blonde Hair said, with an undeniable tone.
Wei Qingxue raised her hand to her forehead, oh no, it’s over.
It’s these hooligans who are finished.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Don’t kid around, you don’t have the fortune, I’m afraid you can’t handle it. And don’t trouble the young lady, let this old guy drink with you instead, I’ll have a laugh."
The waitress listened and gratefully glanced at Lin Fan. Lin Fan was speaking up for her. In the whole place, only Lin Fan spoke for her, everyone else didn’t dare speak, even the boss she once trusted had betrayed her.
At this moment, Lin Fan standing up and speaking for her was truly rare.
But she was also a bit worried for Lin Fan, daring to offend these hooligans might bring great trouble.
Blonde Hair was enraged, "You brat, what’s with all the chatter, just do as I say, cross us and you’ll have no good outcome, wanna bet I won’t cripple you right here!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "I truly don’t believe it."
Arrogant!
Too arrogant!
Everyone was stunned, this kid, he was too bold, facing these hooligans, he could still joke around, seemingly not putting them in his eyes at all.
Lin Fan’s attitude made the gang of Blonde Hairs very unhappy.
As hooligans, wherever they went, they’d instill fear in others, their greatest satisfaction was enjoying others’ fear towards them.
Now encountering someone unafraid of them, it was truly irksome.
"Kid, looks like you’re really not afraid to die, you’d better not run, I’ll go over and beat you now!" Blonde Hair said angrily.
Wei Qingxue sighed, "Run, better run quickly, it’ll be very miserable for you hooligans."

chapters.title: Chapter 452: The Entire Snack Street Fell into Dead Silence
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 452: The Entire Snack Street Fell into Dead Silence
Blonde Hair and his crew felt like their authority was being challenged and planned to beat up Lin Fan. In their minds, these hooligans were the ones who owned the streets - who wouldn’t be scared of them? But now there was a guy who wasn’t afraid at all, and people around were watching. If they don’t assert their dominance, where will their reputation go?
"Don’t come any closer!" Wei Qingxue said, looking a bit tense.
She was worried about Lin Fan. Of all people, these hooligans had to pick Lin Fan to mess with. They must have a death wish. If Lin Fan wasn’t careful and broke their legs, the medical costs would be a hassle.
Even though Lin Fan wasn’t short on money now, with a sales performance of three to four hundred million and millions in commission, he could afford the medical costs for a few people. But it’s not about whether he can afford it; spending money on these hooligans is just a waste.
They simply aren’t worth it.
Hearing this, the hooligans thought Wei Qingxue was scared of them and couldn’t help but feel pleased. Hooligans are easy to satisfy - as long as others fear them, they feel powerful.
"Too late, I’m going to beat this kid today!" one hooligan said arrogantly.
But Blonde Hair stopped him: "Don’t rush. Little girl, if you don’t want us to beat him up, you can come over, kneel down, and make us happy. Maybe then I’ll let him go. How about it, think about it?"
Blonde Hair said this to Wei Qingxue with a flippant smile.
Wei Qingxue sighed, it seems like they won’t give up until they see the coffin.
Blonde Hair saw Wei Qingxue unmoved and snorted: "Fine, don’t blame us for being impolite then. You two, go grab that kid for me!"
Two hooligans, aggressive and threatening, planned to grab Lin Fan.
"Wait!"
At this moment, the female server spoke up and stood forward.
"This started because of me. He was speaking for me. You can’t hit him. At most, I’ll drink with you!" the female server said.
She spoke these words with great courage because it was beyond her boundaries. Normally, she wouldn’t consider drinking with these hooligans.
But Lin Fan was the only one speaking up for her, and she felt grateful. She couldn’t just watch him get beaten up.
Hearing this, Lin Fan also took a second look at the girl - she was pretty good, someone with potential.
Blonde Hair glared at the female server disdainfully: "Get lost, ugly. Who wants you to drink with us? Are you as pretty as her? I only want this little girl to drink with me!"
The hooligans laughed wickedly.
The female server didn’t expect them to reject her offer to drink with them. Wasn’t this whole mess about them wanting her to drink?
The female server’s eyes welled up with tears, feeling very wronged.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Miss, don’t listen to them. You’re not ugly at all, and your heart is especially beautiful. They’re the real uglies, not only do they look twisted, but their souls are filthy too. You really don’t need to let these trash affect your mood."
Haha!
The female server couldn’t help but laugh, breaking into a smile through her tears. Lin Fan’s words were so warm, they truly touched her, and she felt much better.
Indeed, the world is never short of malice, but Shabi’s malicious words - sometimes why bother with them? Just take them as a dog’s bark!
The hooligans got angry.
Blonde Hair shouted: "I think this kid is just asking for it. He’s itching for a beating!"
"We’re going to beat him up!"
Beside them, two hooligans cracked their knuckles, preparing to rush forward.
Blonde Hair rolled up his sleeves and said: "Nobody move, this punk is really making me mad. I’m going to handle this myself today!"
The bunch of hooligans paused for a moment, then each one got excited.
"This kid is going to have bad luck, Brother Jin Ya is really tough!"
"Brother Jin Ya, who fights unbeaten across Chunhua Street, handling it himself, this is going to be good!"
"This kid will soon regret it, provoking Brother Jin Ya!"
The hooligans all spoke, eagerly anticipating Blonde Hair giving Lin Fan a good beating.
The people around looked at each other , it seemed like Brother Jin Ya was pretty tough, Lin Fan was probably in trouble.
The female server got anxious, she stepped in front of Blonde Hair, saying: "Brothers and sisters, please go, I’ll hold them off. It was my fault, I’ll handle this! If you want to hit my brother, you’ll have to step over me first!"
Blonde Hair angrily said: "Filthy girl, stop pretending to be a hero, get lost!"
He reached out and shoved the female server aside.
He was quite strong; the female server fell to the side and hit the ground, unable to stop him.
"Useless." Blonde Hair laughed coldly, advancing towards Lin Fan, "Punk, are you ready for a beating!"
Saying this, he moved up to Lin Fan’s table, looking down at Lin Fan, full of arrogance.
Seeing this, the female server got very worried. This was bad, Lin Fan was definitely going to get hit.
"Punk, take my punch!"
Blonde Hair sneered, thinking he’d got Lin Fan for sure, raised his fist, and swung it at Lin Fan.
Everyone thought Lin Fan was done for, the worst part was Lin Fan didn’t even dodge, he seemed ready to get hit.
As Blonde Hair’s fist was about to land on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan casually turned his face slightly and had already dodged Blonde Hair’s punch. Blonde Hair couldn’t stop his momentum, ending up falling towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan deftly swung a punch, and with a thud, hit Blonde Hair right in the chest.
"Ah!"
Blonde Hair let out a scream, and his whole body suddenly flew backward. It was as if he’d been hit by a car; Lin Fan just casually punched him and Blonde Hair got sent flying.
Blonde Hair flew back, landing squarely on his own table, breaking the whole table, cups, pots, and dishes shattering everywhere, creating a mess. Food, scraps, juices, and drinks splattered, covering the hooligans sitting around in a sorry state.
The hooligans were completely stunned. They wanted to see Brother Jin Ya beat Lin Fan up, but never expected this scene.
This happened so fast; they didn’t even see it clearly.
Brother Jin Ya flew back and smashed their table.
Looking at Blonde Hair, he lay there helpless, twitching in the debris, looking paralyzed, unable to move.
Lin Fan’s punch was truly terrifying.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Including the female server, who was worried about Lin Fan just now, looked astonished.
If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t believe it even if they were beaten to death. The legendary "one punch send your ass flying" really existed, someone really could be strong enough to send someone flying with one punch!
And Lin Fan’s punch seemed so casual just now, like he had only used a fraction of his strength.
Silence. The whole snack street instantly fell into a dead silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 The Opponent Calls Brother Chicken
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Chapter 453 The Opponent Calls Brother Chicken
The whole snack street fell silent, which is usually bustling and lively, making it a rare sight in the usual affairs. Everyone seemed to be under a body-freezing spell; those who were eating forgot to chew, those who were picking up food paused their hands, and those who were pouring tea froze their hands, causing the tea to overflow without them noticing...
All of this was because of Lin Fan’s punch.
A punch that could be described as terrifying.
How could there be such terrifying people in the world?
Only Wei Qingxue silently sighed, all of this was within her expectations.
She had warned them earlier that these thugs shouldn’t provoke Lin Fan, she had tried to advise, but unfortunately, they didn’t listen, so she couldn’t be blamed.
Blonde Hair arrogantly rushed up wanting to fight Lin Fan, but was sent flying by Lin Fan’s punch, Lin Fan’s table not even a drop of water spilled, but the thugs’ table was already a mess.
After a moment of daze, the thugs came to their senses and surrounded Blonde Hair.
"Brother Jin Ya, what’s wrong?"
"Brother Jin Ya, give us a response."
"Quick, help Brother Jin Ya up!"
Suggested by a thug. So, two thugs, one on each side, tried to help Blonde Hair up.
Blonde Hair hurriedly said in a trembling voice, "Don’t move! I think my waist is broken, quickly notify Brother Chicken!"
"What, notify Brother Chicken? Brother Jin Ya, are you sure?"
The thugs were shocked. It seemed Brother Chicken had quite a background and usually wouldn’t be disturbed, now Brother Jin Ya was saying to alarm Brother Chicken, which couldn’t help but make the thugs somewhat stunned.
Blonde Hair said, "Don’t waste time, hurry!"
"Alright."
A thug quickly took out his phone and soon dialed a number.
"Brother Chicken, Brother Jin Ya wants to see you, he can’t talk on the phone right now. Here’s what happened... Yes, Brother Chicken, the opponent is still here, sitting here eating, being quite arrogant... Okay, Brother Chicken, I got it."
The thug finished the call.
Then, the thug put down his phone, looked at Lin Fan arrogantly, and said, "You punk, we’ve already notified Brother Chicken, he will be here soon. This time you’re dead, if you have guts, don’t leave!"
Lin Fan responded, "Oh, is this Brother Chicken very strong?"
The thug said proudly, "Of course, once Brother Chicken arrives, don’t expect to leave in one piece. If you’re scared, go ahead and run away, you still have a bit of time to escape!"
Lin Fan replied, "I’m not full yet, why should I leave."
The thug said, "Alright, you’re gutsy, then wait here!"
But Lin Fan ignored the thug and said to Wei Qingxue, "I feel like having some porridge, do you want to eat some?"
Wei Qingxue replied, "Hmm, the food tonight is tasty but a bit strong, a bit greasy, just right to drink some porridge to clear it up. But is it really okay, I’m afraid later when you have to deal with them, the porridge will get cold and won’t taste good."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No worries. Miss, can you come over for a moment."
Lin Fan beckoned to the waitress.
The waitress quickly got up from the ground and came over to their table.
Lin Fan said, "Your name is Little Wei?"
The waitress replied, "Yes, my name is Yu Xiaowei."
Lin Fan said, "Bring us two bowls of white porridge, hot ones."
"Um..." Yu Xiaowei hesitated.
Lin Fan said, "What’s wrong, no white porridge?"
Yu Xiaowei replied, "Not that... Brother, it looks like they called some very powerful people over, brother and sister, maybe you should think about leaving and not fight with them. They’re from the underground."
Lin Fan said, "You seem quite informed about them?"
Yu Xiaowei replied, "I haven’t worked here long, just heard others say that there’s underground people around here, the boss has deep connections, but I don’t know what kind of background, most people wouldn’t dare provoke them."
Lin Fan said, "Really, could it be the Brother Chicken they mentioned?"
Yu Xiaowei replied, "I don’t know about that, but it’s best not to provoke them, they’re not good people."
Lin Fan smiled, "Little Wei, you’re a good girl, but don’t worry, just bring us the porridge. If we leave now, they’ll definitely take it out on you all."
Yu Xiaowei thought, that’s right, if Lin Fan left like this, when Brother Chicken arrives, he’ll surely tear down this stall.
The boss of the stall didn’t want Lin Fan to leave either.
He quickly grinned and said, "Young man, I’ll personally make porridge for you, definitely premium white porridge that’s freshly made, just wait a moment."
The stall owner went to work, saying he had to stall for time until Brother Chicken arrived, otherwise if Lin Fan and them slipped away, it wouldn’t be good.
Everyone present began anxiously waiting.
They all knew, soon, an underground big shot was going to arrive, possibly leading to a fierce fight.
Some timid ones quickly settled up and fled the scene, they didn’t want to stick around, in case they got caught in the crossfire it wouldn’t be good.
But most people remained, they really wanted to see a good show, couldn’t help it, the spectator mentality was too strong.
Not even if there was a potential fight, even if it were a gas explosion site, if a fire broke out, spectators would gather, this kind of spectator mentality really is unbelievable.
Spectators discussed fervently, some couldn’t help but start running bets on whether when Brother Chicken arrived, would Brother Chicken beat Lin Fan, or would Lin Fan take out Brother Chicken.
It was speechless that the yet-to-appear Brother Chicken received more than half the people’s support, yet the Lin Fan who sent Blonde Hair flying with a punch wasn’t favored.
It couldn’t be helped, Lin Fan’s punch had raised everyone’s standard, making them think there might be many experts like Lin Fan in the world.
And the yet-appeared, heavily hyped Brother Chicken became the strong figure in their minds, one who could dismiss Lin Fan effortlessly.
This self-righteous elevating of Brother Chicken wasn’t uncommon.
"Brother Chicken sounds like someone very powerful!"
"This kid is too careless, thinking he’s great after defeating Brother Jin Ya, overconfidence leads to defeat!"
"Indeed, if it were me, I would choose to leave."
The crowd discussed, thinking Lin Fan was about to meet his misfortune.
However, Lin Fan waited patiently... for the white porridge.
It seemed to him, he didn’t take this matter seriously, he just wanted to eat porridge, nothing was more important than that bowl of steaming porridge.
The atmosphere reached a peak of tension.
"Here he comes!"
Suddenly, someone shouted.
Instantly, all eyes turned towards the street entrance.
They saw a man with slicked-back hair and wearing a white suit coming over, smoking casually, with confidence in his stride.
Following the man in the white suit, over ten men in identical black suits, walking in step, appearing exceptionally disciplined.
"Brother Chicken, Brother Chicken’s here!"
The few thugs exclaimed with joy, this pompous man in the white suit was exactly who they called Brother Chicken.
"You, you’re dead, you punk!" Blonde Hair, lying in the wreckage, said viciously.
"Young man, your porridge."
The stall owner seized the opportunity, hurriedly bringing over two steaming bowls of white porridge, quickly put them down then fled to the side.
But Lin Fan seemed oblivious to Brother Chicken’s arrival, his attention was focused entirely on the white porridge before him.
"Smells great, freshly made millet porridge, premium rice, the owner really put in effort. Qingxue, have a bowl."
Lin Fan said cheerfully, placing a bowl of white porridge in front of Wei Qingxue.
"Hmm." Wei Qingxue smiled, though she appeared calm, this scene was different from a few small thugs, her hands involuntarily trembled slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Who Did I Offend
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Chapter 454: Who Did I Offend
The man in a white suit walked up to Blonde Hair, lowered his head and observed him for a moment, and took two puffs of his cigarette.
"Who hit him?"
The man in the white suit asked.
The thug pointed at Lin Fan with his hand: "It was this guy."
The man in the white suit turned around, his gaze falling on Lin Fan, sizing him up.
"Did you hit him?" the man in the white suit asked, seemingly a bit surprised. Lin Fan was much younger than he had imagined.
Such a young man, able to punch a person into the air, was truly unbelievable.
Lin Fan was drinking porridge and ignored the man in white.
The vendor, trying to stall for time, gave Lin Fan freshly made millet porridge, which was indeed very good. Lin Fan focused on eating the porridge, too lazy to bother with the other person.
"Kid, Brother Chicken is talking to you!" a thug yelled.
Lin Fan still disregarded him.
Brother Chicken frowned: "Kid, you’re quite arrogant, huh? You’re not the first to be so brazen in front of Brother Chicken, but those before you have already disappeared from this world. Do you want to meet the same fate?"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan. Lin Fan wasn’t nervous, but they became tense.
Lin Fan was too calm. Was he overconfident?
Lin Fan continued to ignore Brother Chicken and looked at Wei Qingxue across from him: "Why aren’t you eating? Is it not good?"
Wei Qingxue forced a smile: "No, it’s pretty good."
Lin Fan frowned and said: "Is it because of these flies? They sure are annoying, alright, I’ll help you drive them away."
Only then did Lin Fan lift his head and look at Brother Chicken, speaking blandly: "Why don’t you all come at me together? I’ll deal with you first, then continue drinking my porridge."
Saying this, Lin Fan had already stood up.
Brother Chicken laughed angrily: "Kid, what did you say, deal with us? You’re damn confident, aren’t you? Do you think my people are just rookies?"
Lin Fan didn’t respond, but stepped towards Brother Chicken.
Brother Chicken said coldly: "Kid, you’re truly overestimating yourself. My men are all well-trained, we’re no longer comparable to ordinary street punks. Not only do you refuse to surrender obediently, but you dare challenge us, truly unaware of what’s best for you."
Brother Chicken tried to threaten Lin Fan, hoping to stop him.
But Lin Fan’s pace didn’t falter at all.
Brother Chicken was angered, waving his hand: "Teach him a lesson!"
Then two men in black suits closed in on Lin Fan, reaching for an axe from their lower backs as they walked, one left, one right, trying to block Lin Fan’s path.
Seeing Lin Fan had no intention of stopping, the two men in black suits were also enraged, raising their axes and swinging them at Lin Fan.
It must be said, these two were ruthless individuals, chopping without blinking.
These underground thugs viewed human lives as mere straw, lawless.
If Lin Fan got hit by them, blood would splatter the streets.
Of course, they couldn’t hit Lin Fan. Their axes didn’t even touch Lin Fan as he landed a kick on each.
Clink!
Clink!
Two axes fell to the ground.
The two men in black suits held their crotches, kneeling on the ground, faces contorted, crying out in agony.
It was too tragic, this was simply a blow to end one’s lineage, perhaps the severed lineage was trivial, their spirits seemed half kicked away.
Instant kill!
Brother Chicken’s face changed, he shouted hoarsely: "Everyone, get him!"
Lin Fan was even more formidable than he imagined, he dared not be careless, still calling for everyone to attack to be more stable.
That group of men in black suits immediately rushed at Lin Fan, each reaching for an axe from their lower backs.
Lin Fan said coolly: "A bunch of trash, wielding axes here?"
The group of men in black suits swung their axes to surround Lin Fan. This scene, any ordinary person witnessing it would find horrifying, too terrifying.
Two fists couldn’t fend off four hands, and the opponents each carried an axe, while Lin Fan was barehanded. How could he possibly be a match?
This was everyone’s first thought.
But just one minute later.
Everyone’s perceptions had been overturned.
Lin Fan still stood unharmed, but the group attacking him was already all lying on the ground, writhing in pain, their axes scattered all over.
Everyone froze, silence enveloped the entire area.
How impressive, Lin Fan actually laid all these people out!
Brother Chicken’s face had already turned pale.
Only he knew the true strength of his men, and only he realized the implications of them all being laid out by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan hardly paused, hardly hindered by these seemingly formidable guys.
He still moved at his own pace, forcing towards Brother Chicken.
Brother Chicken involuntarily stepped back: "Don’t, don’t come any closer!"
Brother Chicken tried to maintain his authority, but his voice involuntarily carried a hint of fear.
Seeing Lin Fan still had no intention of stopping, Brother Chicken panicked.
"Kid, stop right there! You truly don’t know whom you’ve provoked!" Brother Chicken shouted.
Lin Fan didn’t pay him any heed.
Brother Chicken, both shocked and furious, clenched his teeth, reaching for an axe from his back, shouted loudly, and charged at Lin Fan.
Although in recent years, Brother Chicken himself hadn’t often taken action, but the Jianghu held tales of Brother Chicken.
When Brother Chicken was younger, he fought fiercely, always at the forefront of fights, earning a reputation as a tough character. His name in the underground was earned through battles risking his own life. When people mentioned Brother Chicken, they showed respect, raised their thumbs, and said, "Brother Chicken is someone you best not provoke!"
As Brother Chicken was forced to fight, his fierceness remained undiminished.
Moreover, Brother Chicken wasn’t just fighting randomly, he clearly knew some traditional martial arts.
The thugs almost burst into tears, finally Brother Chicken was personally stepping in, surely this time it’ll work, surely he’ll deal with this kid.
However...
The next second.
Clink!
Brother Chicken’s axe fell to the ground.
Brother Chicken’s face turned red, he held his crotch with both hands, and fell to his knees, his face twisted.
The real martial arts-trained, Jianghu-renowned, fierce Brother Chicken, ended up just like those thugs, instantaneously defeated by Lin Fan, utterly indistinguishable.
One couldn’t help but doubt whether this was truly the Brother Chicken of the past.
The thugs all questioned it.
Brother Chicken was almost in tears; He was indeed the fierce man of the past, only Lin Fan was so damn formidable, making him seem no different from these little thugs.
How could there be such a powerful guy!
"You brat, you truly don’t know whom you’ve provoked, you’ll regret this, you’ll suffer a horrible death!" Brother Chicken said with difficulty.
Though he had been beaten by Lin Fan, he still threatened him.
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh", showing a bit of interest: "Who did I provoke?"
Brother Chicken said: "Do you know the Wei Family?"

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Jiangnan Wei Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 455: Jiangnan Wei Family
"The Wei Family?"
Lin Fan turned back and exchanged a glance with Wei Qingxue, only to see Wei Qingxue also looking bewildered.
"Are you referring to the Yun City Wei Family, the boss behind you?" Lin Fan asked in a deep voice.
Brother Chicken sneered, "What Yun City Wei Family, they are nothing. I’m talking about the Jiangnan Wei Family!"
Lin Fan let out an "Oh," realizing it was the Jiangnan Wei Family, the one owning the 350 billion Wangu Group, with Wei Tiansheng as the patriarch, the richest man in Jiangnan.
Who would have thought that in a neighborhood in Yun City, the underworld thugs they encountered had ties to the Jiangnan Wei Family?
Is this true, or is Brother Chicken just bluffing?
If it’s true, then the Jiangnan Wei Family’s reach is indeed far. But, considering they want to expand their business in Yun City, it wouldn’t be surprising for them to pave all paths, openly and covertly, possibly keeping an underground gang on standby.
This reveals an issue: it seems Wei Tiansheng is determined to develop in Yun City, with thorough preparations.
Brother Chicken, out of innate fear of Lin Fan, brought up the Wei Family. In his view, Lin Fan seemed fearless of heaven and earth, not scared at all, and only the Wei Family’s power could suppress him.
Lin Fan chuckled, "So, it’s the Jiangnan Wei Family, and so what?"
Brother Chicken was dumbfounded.
He thought he had misheard.
The Jiangnan Wei Family, and so what?
Just who is this guy, not even afraid of the Jiangnan Wei Family?
How is that possible!
"Kid, that’s some big talk, do you really think you can mess with the Jiangnan Wei Family? You’re utterly ignorant of how vast the world is," Brother Chicken said.
Lin Fan responded indifferently, "Alright, if you have any more support, just call them all over. But you better hurry, because once I finish my late-night meal, I’m leaving. But let me warn you, you can come at me, but if you dare harm anyone unrelated, I promise I will uproot your entire base."
Brother Chicken said, "Kid, you’re arrogant. I’ve been king of the Jianghu for many years, and you’re the first to be so audacious! I won’t touch anyone else, I don’t want to waste the energy, but you, I will not let go, and neither will the Wei Family. You’re definitely doomed!"
Brother Chicken struggled to get up from the ground.
The group, supporting each other, staggered away, looking like defeated soldiers on a battlefield, leaving in a sorry state.
This was drastically different from the domineering appearance they had when they arrived, and the contrast was somewhat amusing.
Lin Fan returned to the table, sat down, and picked up the half-eaten porridge, taking a sip.
The porridge was still warm.
"Lin Fan, I really didn’t expect to provoke the Jiangnan Wei Family this time. They are truly not to be trifled with," Wei Qingxue said.
Lin Fan let out an "Oh," "Do you know about the Jiangnan Wei Family?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Yes, I know a little. Hang City is the Jiangnan Wei Family’s territory. When our Wei Family had a project in Hang City, it was not smooth sailing from the start and later faced divestment issues, leading to a huge funding gap. After making numerous inquiries, I’ve confirmed it’s the influence of the Jiangnan Wei Family causing troubles."
Lin Fan curiously asked, "Why would the Jiangnan Wei Family have issues with your family? Objectively speaking, the Yun City Wei Family’s assets are negligible in the business world and shouldn’t attract the attention of a giant like the Jiangnan Wei Family, right?"
Wei Qingxue said, "That I’m not sure about, but what I said is true. The Jiangnan Wei Family is truly formidable, and in their eyes, to achieve their goals, they’ll stop at nothing. They have both overt and covert operations. Their affiliated underground gang is specifically for handling shady deals."
Lin Fan said, "In other words, to ruin your project in Hang City, the Jiangnan Wei Family possibly resorted to underhanded means as well."
Wei Qingxue said, "Possibly, but I don’t have proof. If I did, I wouldn’t let it rest, even if it’s like an ant shaking a tree; I have to seek justice!"
As they were speaking.
The waitress Yu Xiaowei approached, gratefully saying, "Brother and sister, thank you so much, I came over specifically to thank you."
Lin Fan smiled, "No need to thank us, just a small effort. By the way, Xiaowei, do you plan to continue working here?"
Yu Xiaowei said, "Yes."
Wei Qingxue said, "Aren’t you afraid those hooligans will come to harass you again? Even if not those hooligans, there might be others. This chaotic environment isn’t good for you."
Yu Xiaowei smiled bitterly, "Brother and sister, you may not know, but I don’t have a high educational background, so finding a good job is difficult. I got this job through a relative’s connection. If I don’t work here, I have nowhere else to go. My dad said if I can’t make it in the city, they’ll arrange a marriage for me so I can get married early, but I don’t want to get married and have children so soon."
Lin Fan sighed slightly. He completely understood Yu Xiaowei’s words.
Many rural girls faced troubles like Yu Xiaowei’s, or rather, Yu Xiaowei was just a reflection of countless rural girls.
In economically challenged rural families, if there is a son and a daughter, parents prefer to let the son study, hoping education will change his fate, but the daughter often has to leave school early and step into society.
Many parents, for the sake of dowry, would marry off their daughters early, the only requirement being that they are no longer in school, regardless of whether they are 20 or 12.
There are many girls in rural areas who are forced by their families to marry while still minors.
Yu Xiaowei wanted to fight against such a fate, but this struggle was incredibly challenging and often doomed to fail.
Lin Fan thought Yu Xiaowei was a very admirable girl. Earlier, she tried to stand against the thugs to protect him, which was quite commendable.
"If possible, I hope I can help you," Lin Fan said sincerely.
Wei Qingxue thought of something and said, "How about this, you can come work at my company."
Wei Qingxue had similar thoughts to Lin Fan. She also liked Yu Xiaowei and wanted to help her.
Yu Xiaowei was taken aback for a moment, then quickly waved her hand, smiling, "How can I do that? I can’t do anything, not even type properly. What could I do?"
Wei Qingxue said, "You can learn to do things, but some qualities, like a person’s character, are rare and unlearnable. My assistant just quit, why not come be my assistant? What do you think?"
Wei Qingxue’s new assistant had recently leaked her information to Ma Jialiang for some petty benefit, and such a person couldn’t be retained.
Yu Xiaowei was very excited, "Can I really?"
Lin Fan smiled, "If she says you can, then you can. Go for it."
Yu Xiaowei said, "Yes, I will do my best. Thank you, brother and sister."
At this moment, Yu Xiaowei couldn’t foresee that this decision would completely change her fate. Years later, she would still be filled with gratitude when she thought about this night.
So, after a late-night meal, they managed to provoke the Jiangnan Wei Family and inadvertently found an assistant.
Meanwhile, Brother Chicken, who had fled pathetically, dialed a number.
"Hello, I want to speak with Mr. Wei..."

chapters.title: Chapter 456 Who Exactly is He
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 456 Who Exactly is He
Night has fallen.
Yujing District.
Wei Qingxue’s Porsche stopped at the entrance to the district, and at this moment, Lin Fan was sitting in the passenger seat.
"Lin Fan, are you really not coming in with me?" Wei Qingxue asked.
After dinner, Lin Fan drove her home, and Wei Qingxue thought Lin Fan would go back with her.
"I’m not going in. After all, we’re no longer husband and wife. I don’t want to give people something to gossip about." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Wei Qingxue bit her lip and said, "Mom must want to see you. She cried when she found out we got divorced. She used to despise you, but now she can’t let go."
Lin Fan found it amusing internally. Li Xueyan indeed had changed her view of him, but it was only because he recently made money. Winning her mother’s heart depends on one’s abilities.
When Lin Fan was seen by his mother-in-law as just a delivery guy, he couldn’t earn the respect he deserved.
This is naturally because Li Xueyan, as a mother-in-law, is too materialistic, but it also shows that a man’s face is earned by himself. Even the most materialistic mother-in-law has to be impressed by a capable man.
"I wouldn’t know what to say if I met her, just send my regards." Lin Fan said.
Wei Qingxue nodded, "Alright. I’ll arrange to meet you another day, you can’t agree!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Sure."
After speaking, Lin Fan got out of the car, waved casually, and turned to leave.
Watching Lin Fan’s figure, Wei Qingxue felt somewhat complicated. She found herself liking this man more and more, but could she truly capture his heart?
Afterwards, Wei Qingxue returned home.
It was the first time she went home after announcing her marriage to Lin Fan.
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were both home, still awake, waiting for her return.
As soon as she saw Wei Qingxue, Li Xueyan immediately came over, "You silly girl, how could you divorce Lin Fan? What happened?"
Wei Dazong said, "Where did you go at this late hour? Why did you come back only now, is the company that busy?"
Wei Qingxue felt a sweat coming, this was the rhythm of an interrogation.
"I wasn’t busy at the company tonight, I went out." Wei Qingxue said, sitting down.
Li Xueyan anxiously said, "Child, quickly answer your mother’s question. What on earth happened, divorcing Lin Fan without a word and not telling us?"
Wei Qingxue said, "This is between Lin Fan and me, what does it have to do with you? Besides, you always opposed this marriage, we divorced, you should be happy!"
Li Xueyan stomped her foot, "What do you know, Lin Fan just promised me he would get your dad a new car, but before the car could be bought, you divorced. Silly girl, you should have waited until he bought the car!"
Wei Qingxue said, "So mom is upset because of Lin Fan’s money."
Li Xueyan’s face didn’t turn red, "What’s wrong with that? Lin Fan has money now, as a son-in-law to our family, his money should honor us a bit. Besides, it’s not just about the money, I care about your happiness too. You two were fine, back then I couldn’t chase him away even with a broom, now that he has money, how could..."
Wei Dazong interrupted, "There’s a saying that when men have money, they become bad. Could this boy have changed his heart because he got rich?"
Li Xueyan’s face changed, "No way, could he really be that kind of scumbag?"
Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
Both parents didn’t understand.
Li Xueyan said, "You silly girl, how can you still laugh!"
Wei Dazong frowned, "Could it be that you initiated the divorce? You don’t love him anymore?"
Wei Qingxue shook her head, "Quite the opposite, I like him."
Li Xueyan stomped her feet, "Oh, you’re driving me crazy, quickly tell me what is going on!"
Wei Qingxue said, "Back then, when the company was struggling with funds, you forced me into an alliance with the Ma Family for financial aid. I didn’t want to marry Ma Jialiang, so I married Lin Fan. Our marriage was essentially a fake."
What?
Wei Dazong and Li Xueyan were stunned.
Wei Qingxue said, "Now the company’s crisis has been resolved, the task is completed, so we divorced."
"Fake, it was actually fake." Li Xueyan murmured, slumping down powerlessly, "It’s all gone, all gone."
Li Xueyan really wanted to cry, the meat that was almost in her mouth flew away, now she had no hope at all, Lin Fan earned 10 million, and it had nothing to do with her.
Wei Dazong sighed, "Lin Fan joined the company, performed excellently, was almost like a lucky charm for the company. Your grandpa also appreciated him, everyone changed their views, but unexpectedly, it ended like this. Where can we find such a son-in-law? Qingxue, didn’t you say you like him, why not take advantage of the situation and continue the marriage?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Because...he doesn’t like me. For him, marrying me was really just helping out."
"What?" Wei Dazong gritted his teeth, "This boy...my daughter is so good, yet he can’t see it? Qingxue, what exactly is he?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Dad, what do you mean by that?"
Wei Dazong said, "I’m saying, his true identity, could it be that being a delivery guy is just a made-up identity? I don’t believe a delivery guy could so easily create a 400 million sales miracle."
Wei Qingxue, sweating, said, "He really is a delivery guy..."
Wei Dazong frowned, "Is that so? Then this delivery guy is too extraordinary!"
Upon hearing Wei Dazong say this, Wei Qingxue couldn’t help but feel touched, lost in thought.
Li Xueyan said, "What’s the use of saying this now, the person is gone, the money has flown away. Qingxue, back then forcing you to marry Young Master Ma was indeed wrong, leading you to this desperate measure. But the times have changed, now that you’re single again, you should plan for the future. Today Young Master Ma came looking for you again, I think he’s quite infatuated with you, do you want to reconsider?"
Wei Qingxue said, "Mom, are you going to force me to marry Ma Jialiang again? I think you’re after the Ma Family’s money."
Li Xueyan said, "What’s wrong with valuing money? The Ma Family is rich, my daughter should marry into money."
Wei Qingxue shook her head, "I won’t consider Ma Jialiang. The only one I want to marry is Lin Fan."
The couple looked at each other in surprise.
"Qingxue, you still want to marry Lin Fan?" Wei Dazong wiped his cold sweat.
Wei Qingxue said, "That’s right. Tonight I went on a date with Lin Fan. One day, I’ll make him fall for me. When we marry again, it won’t be a fake marriage."
Hearing this, the couple looked at each other, they could see that their daughter really loved Lin Fan. It was the first time for their daughter to fall for a boy all these years.
Li Xueyan lamented, "Seems that Young Master Ma was wrong about this."
At this time.
Ma Jialiang was on the phone.
Tonight, he was thrown into a cake by Lin Fan in public, it was extremely embarrassing.
Most frustrating was that he also found out Wei Qingxue was going to pursue Lin Fan.
This damn delivery guy, why, he hated Lin Fan to death.
"No matter the cost, find me a real expert, a genuine expert. No matter what, I want Lin Fan to disappear from Yun City!"

chapters.title: Chapter 457 Fiercer Black Tides Incoming
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 457 Fiercer Black Tides Incoming
Neither the Wei Family nor the Ma Family knows Lin Fan’s true identity yet.
Ma Jialiang, who harbors a deep hatred for Lin Fan, is plotting to drive this courier boy out of Yun City.
However, for Lin Fan, the episode with the Wei Family has come to an end.
He woke up from a sleep, returning to the state he was in before meeting Wei Qingxue.
"Ding!"
"Check-in successful, a cash reward of 5 million has been deposited, please take note."
The system prompted with a notification sound.
The bug continues.
Lin Fan doesn’t even need to check-in, the system automatically reports a successful check-in, and another 5 million in cash is deposited.
Lin Fan has lost count of how many times he received 5 million; altogether, it must be several hundred million by now.
This also signifies one thing, time flies, unknowingly, two months have passed.
Lin Fan chuckled bitterly, wondering when this system bug would fix itself. He really missed the past when he got a new reward every day, each reward top-notch, always a surprise, always exciting.
Now, receiving 5 million in cash every day was quite boring.
If outsiders knew Lin Fan earned 5 million every day and still found it mundane, they would probably go insane.
But for Lin Fan, it truly was quite boring.
A new day has arrived, and today Lin Fan doesn’t have to go to the Wei Family Company, so he planned, as usual, to stroll around his own company.
Lin Fan was about to step out when he suddenly received a call from Wang Xiangqian, surely about Ning Xiaoyue again.
Ever since Ning Xiaoyue participated in the Creation Star show, things haven’t stopped. Wenyue Company, initially a little entertainment company on the brink of bankruptcy with minimal engagements, is now overwhelmed because of Ning Xiaoyue’s sudden fame.
Last time, Ning Xiaoyue was hit by an online smear campaign, and other contestants’ companies jumped in to attack her, and Lin Fan had Du Tao intervene to settle those companies.
Although Ning Xiaoyue still faces a lot of online criticism, the situation has relatively calmed down compared to before.
During this period, since Lin Fan had taken on the role of a live-in son-in-law at the Wei Family, he has paid less attention to Ning Xiaoyue.
Now that Wang Xiangqian suddenly called, Lin Fan knew for sure that something bad had happened.
"Old Wang, what’s going on?" Lin Fan answered the call.
Wang Xiangqian said bitterly: "Brother Fan, help! I can’t hold on any longer, I’m about to collapse, I feel like dying."
Lin Fan frowned: "What happened?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "It’s still because of Xiaoyue. Despite the majority of online voices criticizing her, her popularity remains high, consistently ranking in the top three. Greatness invites envy; someone is attacking her again, this time with rumors."
Not surprisingly, it’s indeed because of Ning Xiaoyue.
Lin Fan said: "What’s the situation?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "Online rumors claim that Xiaoyue has been in a relationship, piecing together so-called evidence. Besides relationships, some are spreading rumors of her rolling her eyes at the mentor. The internet erupted with a new wave of attacks."
Lin Fan curiously said: "What’s wrong with having been in a relationship? A normal person being criticized for dating, that’s absurd."
Wang Xiangqian said: "Brother Fan, you might not know, Xiaoyue is now a young idol. In the eyes of fans, young idols cannot date. If she has really dated, it becomes a black mark, not only attracting criticism but also causing fans to unfollow."
Lin Fan wiped his sweat: "So there’s such a thing. Alright then, has Xiaoyue ever dated?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "No, since I recruited Xiaoyue to the company, I watched her grow; I know her situation best, and all those exposures online are completely made up."
Lin Fan said: "Hmm, what about the eye-roll incident?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "It’s because Xiaoyue has some eye issues, plus the day-and-night rehearsals led to her eye condition acting up. Someone captured it in screenshots, taking it out of context, saying she rolled her eyes at the mentor, disrespecting them, causing another round of criticism."
Lin Fan furrowed his brow: "Regarding the last smear campaign, I already had Du Tao warn those contestants’ companies. They likely won’t dare target Xiaoyue again. The ones acting now are probably the same people."
Wang Xiangqian said: "Does Brother Fan mean Feng Tianming?"
Lin Fan sneered: "Who else could it be? Feng Tianming’s entertainment company has already been acquired by Cherry Entertainment, and Cherry Entertainment is something even Du Tao can’t handle, because its owner is Wei Tiansheng, the third son of the richest man in Jiangnan, Wei Jiansheng."
Wang Xiangqian’s face changed: "The Wei Family, the richest in Jiangnan, my god, no wonder. How can my little company fight against them!"
Lin Fan said: "Cherry Entertainment and Feng Tianming are working hand-in-hand. By smearing Xiaoyue, they simply want to ruin her, causing fans to unsub. What’s the current mood among the fans?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "Though the rumors are severe, most fans believe her. Plus, after coordinating with the fan clubs, we’ve issued clarifications, but unfortunately, the effect is minimal. So-called scandalous information is all over the place, yet no one sees the clarifications."
Lin Fan said: "Feng Tianming is determined to ruin Xiaoyue, likely spending a hefty sum; it’s not easy to deal with."
Wang Xiangqian said dejectedly: "Yeah, I’m about to collapse; otherwise, I wouldn’t disturb Brother Fan—hasn’t Brother Fan been quite busy lately?"
Lin Fan didn’t want to tell him that he had become a live-in son-in-law, only saying: "Not really, I’m quite free now, it’s just the right time to handle this matter."
Wang Xiangqian said excitedly: "Great! With Brother Fan’s intervention, I’m relieved. Brother Fan, what should we do?"
Lin Fan said: "Compile the clarification materials, buy the top trending search nationwide. I want the search to hang nationwide for a day. Whether the netizens believe it or not, we’ve got to take this step."
"Secondly, issue a statement targeting those spreading rumors; catch a few as examples and make them pay. Since they unscrupulously slander an innocent girl, I’ll make them understand the consequences of their actions."
"Once these two steps are done, I’ll tell you the third step."
Wang Xiangqian said excitedly: "Alright, I’ll proceed as Brother Fan instructed immediately."
Lin Fan asked: "How’s Xiaoyue doing now?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "She’s still with the program group. I just spoke with her over the phone last night; she’s in good spirits, not much affected. She’s fine, but I’m about to collapse."
Lin Fan smiled: "Not bad, Xiaoyue is a chosen one. The average person couldn’t withstand this. With such a mindset, she’ll have a bright future."
"Do as I say."
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan thought for a moment, then opened his long-unused Weibo.
As expected, Ning Xiaoyue’s scandals were on the hot searches!
As Wang Xiangqian said, Ning Xiaoyue’s "black material" is being widely spread. Netizens, as if enraged by something personal, are hurling abuse at Ning Xiaoyue. This smear campaign is even more intense than before.
Lin Fan chuckled bitterly; Ning Xiaoyue is just a cute, beautiful little girl. Do these people really need to harbor such malice towards her?
Suddenly, a name caught Lin Fan’s attention on Weibo.
At the same time, Feng Tianming, browsing Weibo, let out a proud laugh: "Lin Fan, let’s see what you do this time. This wave of scandals will be enough to push you all down. If no accidents occur, Ning Xiaoyue will soon fall!"

chapters.title: Chapter 458: The Strongest PR in History
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 458: The Strongest PR in History
In an office, Feng Tianming sat on a swivel chair, his legs on the desk, scrolling through his phone.
Seeing the overwhelming negative comments about Ning Xiaoyue online, Feng Tianming burst into triumphant laughter.
This time, the attack on Ning Xiaoyue could be said to have reached unprecedented levels.
All of this was thanks to Feng Tianming, who was the mastermind behind it all.
He had no other choice, as Ning Xiaoyue had consistently ranked in the top three. If he didn’t do something, he would lose to Lin Fan.
"Young Master Feng, here’s today’s Yun City Daily, as you requested, brought it over for you."
A man in a suit walked in, handing a newspaper to Feng Tianming.
Feng Tianming took the newspaper and turned to the entertainment section.
The entertainment section’s headline was: Ning Xiaoyue Exposed for Rolling Eyes During Romance, Too Poor in Character to Debut.
Feng Tianming couldn’t help but laugh heartily, "Perfect, just like that! Yun City Daily is an influential newspaper. Although traditional print media is now outdated, Yun City Daily still has many subscribers, spreading Ning Xiaoyue’s dirt further. She’s definitely done for this time!"
The man in the suit smirked, "Young Master Feng, you’re brilliant! This was money well spent. Now both online and offline, everyone knows about Ning Xiaoyue’s dirt. With Yun City Daily’s recognition, this dirt has even more credibility."
Feng Tianming chuckled, "Then let’s blow it up big, spread it well online."
The man in the suit replied, "Yes, I know what to do."
Before long, the news about Yun City Daily’s report on Ning Xiaoyue hit the trending topics.
"Yun City Daily even printed it, seems the dirt is true!"
"Certified by the newspaper, can’t be fake!"
"Looks like all the dirt on Ning Xiaoyue is true, she deserves the scolding!"
"I have to go curse her!"
Online users were outraged, and the online abuse escalated further.
A newsstand near a village in the city center.
Lin Fan got out of a Rolls-Royce and bought the latest Yun City Daily.
While browsing Weibo, this Yun City Daily post caught his attention, so he decided to buy a copy after leaving.
Turning to the entertainment section, the malicious headline appeared: Ning Xiaoyue Exposed for Rolling Eyes During Romance, Too Poor in Character to Debut.
Lin Fan’s face darkened.
He rarely gets angry, but this time he was genuinely upset.
Yun City Daily, as a newspaper with certain authority, actually followed suit in spreading rumors without understanding the truth and maliciously set the tone.
Many people still cling to authority; as long as someone with some authority speaks, even if it’s a lie, many will believe it.
This Yun City Daily report made the rumors more credible.
And Ning Xiaoyue’s fans were infuriated by Yun City Daily’s actions.
But the fans couldn’t do anything. It was an influential newspaper, while the fans were just ordinary people, powerless to do anything but feel angry and helpless.
Moreover, online voices were overwhelmingly berating Ning Xiaoyue, drowning out the fans’ voices.
The fans were at the brink of collapse, with negative emotions spreading among them rapidly.
There’s no denying that Feng Tianming’s move was vicious.
At that moment, Lin Fan received a call from Wang Xiangqian.
"Brother Fan, did you hear about the Yun City Daily incident? It’s disrupting our plans. We’ve prepared the PR release, but aren’t sure if we should publish it now?" Wang Xiangqian said anxiously, sounding quite down.
Lin Fan replied, "Just follow through, I’ll handle Yun City Daily."
The fans couldn’t deal with Yun City Daily, nor could Wang Xiangqian, but Lin Fan could, or at least he could try.
If Lin Fan were still just a delivery man like he used to be, he would be helpless, just like the fans, but he wasn’t the same Lin Fan anymore.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan called Du Tao.
"Mr. Lin." Du Tao answered quickly.
Lin Fan said, "Old Du, about Ning Xiaoyue’s issue, I want to investigate Yun City Daily."
Du Tao replied, "Okay, I’ve already compiled the relevant materials, sending them to Mr. Lin immediately."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, Du Tao truly lived up to his name. He probably anticipated that Lin Fan would seek his help and had prepared before Lin Fan even called.
A document was quickly sent to Lin Fan’s phone.
Lin Fan then looked down to review the materials...
In the morning.
The clarification announcement regarding Ning Xiaoyue climbed the trending list, quickly reaching the top.
According to Lin Fan’s plan, under the operation of Wenyue Company, the clarification announcement began spreading across the internet, forcefully reaching the top. Even those who didn’t want to see it couldn’t avoid it.
Subsequently, Wenyue Company issued a statement to the entire internet, urging users to stop spreading rumors and warning that continued malicious spreading would result in legal consequences. To set an example, Wenyue Company revealed several individuals responsible for malicious spreading and immediately issued lawyer’s letters to file lawsuits.
This round of PR indeed had some effect; the overwhelming wave of negativity slightly subsided.
Meanwhile.
At Yun City Daily newsroom, a beautiful lawyer in professional attire walked through the newsroom doors.
"Hello, I am Attorney Li from Xingquan Law Firm, representing Wenyue Company, and I have a lawyer’s letter for your publication. Could you tell me who is the editor-in-chief of the entertainment section, Mr. Sun?"
The female lawyer stated her purpose as soon as she entered the newsroom.
A bald middle-aged man stood up, face full of arrogance, "That’s me, what the hell is Wenyue Company, sending me a lawyer’s letter?"
Attorney Li said, "Wenyue Company is Miss Ning Xiaoyue’s management company. Your publication’s latest entertainment headline today published rumors about Miss Ning Xiaoyue. Do you recall, Mr. Sun?"
The bald middle-aged man responded, "I remember, I personally vetted the article. Any problem with that?"
Attorney Li said, "Your article is purely rumors, causing significant harm to Miss Ning’s personal reputation. We require you to make a public apology on your publication’s front page headline."
The bald middle-aged man laughed arrogantly, "Rumors? How is it rumors, our article is well-founded. I say you’re the one spreading rumors!"
Everyone in the newsroom laughed uproariously.
"What is Wenyue Company, dare to sue us at Yun City Daily?"
"A little shabby entertainment company, how dare they!"
"Do we at Yun City Daily need to be afraid of this small company?"
Everyone showed expressions of disdain.
Attorney Li maintained a calm demeanor, taking out the lawyer’s letter, "I’m only responsible for delivering the lawyer’s letter. You have one day, if we don’t see your publication’s apology by tomorrow morning, you bear the consequences."
The bald middle-aged man laughed loudly, "Consequences? What consequences, you think this small shabby company can reach the heavens?"
Everyone laughed once more.
Attorney Li didn’t respond, placing the lawyer’s letter in front of the bald middle-aged man, then turned and left.
Inside, Attorney Li chuckled coldly, go ahead and laugh, you don’t even know who you’ve provoked, a mere little newspaper editor daring to act tough in front of Mr. Lin, it’s truly... the road to ruin.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: There Might Be a Mastermind Behind
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 459: There Might Be a Mastermind Behind
Attorney Li put down the legal notice and left, accompanied by the laughter of the newsroom crowd.
A balding middle-aged man, the entertainment section editor of the Yun City Daily, picked up the legal notice, opened it, and took a look.
The content of the legal notice demanded that the Yun City Daily publicly apologize to Ning Xiaoyue on the front page, or they would be taken to court.
The balding middle-aged man sneered, since the founding of the Yun City Daily, they had never done such a thing; a front-page apology to a person was simply impossible!
He was only the editor of the entertainment section and couldn’t decide the content of the front page, let alone an apology statement, so he could only consult the director.
He wasn’t going to disturb the director over a minor issue.
"A small lousy company dares to be presumptuous in front of me!"
The balding middle-aged man said disdainfully, intending to tear the legal notice apart in public.
"What happened?"
A nearly sixty-year-old elder walked in with hands behind his back at this moment.
"Director!"
The crowd greeted in succession.
This old man was the director of the Yun City Daily.
The elder looked at the balding middle-aged man: "What’s that in your hand?"
The balding middle-aged man dared not hide it, "It’s a legal notice?"
The elder frowned: "What’s going on?"
The balding middle-aged man said: "It’s because of today’s entertainment section headline, someone says we fabricated rumors and demands we apologize in tomorrow’s front page headline, or they’ll sue us."
The director’s face changed: "Apologize on the front page? Such an audacious request, let me see the legal notice?"
The balding middle-aged man quickly handed over the legal notice.
The director looked at it and said: "Wenyue Company? What kind of background does this company have?"
The balding middle-aged man immediately said disdainfully: "It’s not a big company, just a small failing entertainment company with no background."
The director said: "Are you sure? Can this small company hire the most formidable Xingquan Law Firm in the legal world? These Xingquan lawyers are known as unbeatable, they rarely lose a case, and they’re very expensive. A small company generally can’t afford them!"
The balding middle-aged man paused: "Director, do you mean?"
The director said: "There might be someone powerful behind this Wenyue Company, it’s not that simple. Regarding Ning Xiaoyue, I know a bit about it, her refutation announcements are now all over the internet, obviously, a lot of money was spent; I don’t believe a small failing company could manage such a public relations effort!"
The balding middle-aged man then began to panic, cold sweat appeared on his forehead: "Director, does Wenyue Company really have a strong background, if that’s true, what should we do?"
The director chuckled: "Expecting us to apologize on the front page is impossible. Our paper, since its founding, has never done such a disgraceful thing! Although Wenyue Company might have a background, it’s still speculation, maybe they’re just bluffing, not that formidable; let’s just ignore it."
The director finished speaking, casually tossed the legal notice, turned around, and walked away with his hands behind his back.
The balding middle-aged man laughed: "Even the director says so, it seems there’s no problem; that small lousy company still wants an apology, they’re dreaming!"
The crowd laughed boisterously.
"This Wenyue Company is a joke!"
"There’s no way our esteemed Yun City Daily would apologize!"
"They’re definitely dreaming too much!"
At this moment.
Outside the newsroom, in a car parked by the roadside, Attorney Li was on a call with Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, I have delivered the legal notice to the Yun City Daily as you instructed," Attorney Li said.
Lin Fan said: "What was their reaction?"
Attorney Li said: "Their attitude was arrogant. In my view, they probably won’t apologize."
Lin Fan replied: "I understand. Thank you for your hard work."
Attorney Li quickly said: "It was no trouble. It’s my honor to work for Mr. Lin."
On the other end.
Lin Fan hung up the phone, his face turned cold.
He doesn’t like to go hardline all at once, so sending the legal notice to the Yun City Daily was a gesture of courtesy.
Unfortunately, the Yun City Daily did not accept this gesture.
Then he had no choice.
Lin Fan immediately picked up his phone and made a call.
The next day.
The new issue of the Yun City Daily was released.
The front page headline did not contain an apology to Ning Xiaoyue!
This newspaper completely ignored yesterday’s legal notice, arrogantly refusing to apologize to a young girl they’ve harmed.
Not only did they refuse to apologize, but they also published another negative article about Ning Xiaoyue in the entertainment headline: Ning Xiaoyue is riddled with scandals, the company’s emergency PR couldn’t cleanse her, netizens call for her withdrawal!
The tone throughout the report was snide and sarcastic, vilifying Ning Xiaoyue extensively.
And the main author of this article was Sun Duhua, the entertainment section editor of the Yun City Daily.
This article was practically a blatant provocation against Lin Fan.
As soon as the report came out, it again caused a vile impact online.
Netizens were all abuzz.
"Yun City Daily is really bold!"
"Yun City Daily is absolutely amazing!"
"Looks like Yun City Daily is going to take on Ning Xiaoyue to the end! Ning Xiaoyue can’t shake off the accusations!"
At the Yun City Daily office.
The director sat in the office, picked up today’s newspaper to have a look, and as the director, reading the newspaper of his office was a habit he had developed over the years.
But when the director turned to the entertainment section and saw the headline report on Ning Xiaoyue.
The director frowned, Sun Duhua’s actions seemed to be a bit excessive. This was a provocation against the person behind Wenyue Company.
However, the director reconsidered, regardless of whether Wenyue Company had someone powerful behind it or not, even if it did, what could they do to his Yun City Daily?
It’s known that Yun City Daily, as a local newspaper, has local policy backing, essentially untouchable.
Although traditional print media has been declining in recent years due to the development of online media, with many print media unable to sustain themselves and numerous shutdowns.
Yet Yun City Daily remained standing, of course, Yun City Daily also felt the impact of the internet, with its sales plummeting long ago, the only reason it survived was due to capital support.
And the capital backing Yun City Daily also had local ties, ensuring no mishaps would occur.
So the director was fully confident that no one could touch Yun City Daily.
As long as the capital behind them was safe, then even if the person behind Wenyue Company was powerful, the most they would do is sue Yun City Daily, and it’s not that easy to succeed on charges of defamation.
So, even if Yun City Daily recklessly vilified Ning Xiaoyue, there was no need for concern at all.
Wenyue Company’s threat to Yun City Daily only made them fixate on Ning Xiaoyue more, and in the future, the vilification of Ning Xiaoyue would continue, with no chance of saying nice things.
With that in mind, the director put down the newspaper, stood up, and confidently prepared to go to the teahouse for breakfast.
Just then, a phone call came in.
The director answered the phone, his expression suddenly changed.
"What? Withdrawal of investment?" the director said in shock.
This call was from the capital behind Yun City Daily, and right away, they announced their intention to withdraw investment!
How could this be?
What happened?
The director’s face turned pale, realizing he might have provoked someone formidable, who exactly could that be?

chapters.title: Chapter 460 Irreparable Big Mistake
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 460 Irreparable Big Mistake
"Chief Editor, your writing truly leaves me in awe, I’m completely at your mercy."
A young man with triangular eyes, slicked-back hair, and glasses, was full of flattery, almost wishing he could stamp "sycophant" on his forehead.
This was in the office of Yun City Daily newspaper, and opposite the bespectacled man sat Sun Duhua, the editor of the entertainment section.
Sun Duhua looked pleased and said, "Your piece wasn’t bad either."
The bespectacled man quickly responded, "Not at all, Chief Editor. Your skill in sarcasm is masterful. You’ve completely trashed Ning Xiaoyue. In front of you, I don’t even deserve to lift your shoes."
This bespectacled man was the main writer of yesterday’s report. Although Sun Duhua had also directed that article, today’s report was personally crafted by him, making it more formidable compared to the bespectacled man’s piece.
Sun Duhua, slightly inflated by the man’s praise, chuckled and said, "Just a small fry company daring to threaten me. I’m simply giving them a little lesson."
The bespectacled man chuckled, "This little lesson from you is no small matter. The netizens are all abuzz, and now everyone online is in an uproar too. They’re all praising your writing skills. Ning Xiaoyue is once again the target of widespread ridicule. Moreover, due to our reports these past few days, our newspaper’s sales have increased, and Yun City Daily is making waves. Here, I’ve picked out some comments for you to see."
The bespectacled man opened his phone to show Sun Duhua.
"Brilliantly written, truly sharp!"
"The Chief Editor’s writing is simply incredible!"
"If you can talk like this, say more. Is there more? I’m eagerly following!"
