Looking at these comments, Sun Duhua couldn’t help but laugh heartily, "Not bad, not bad at all."
"However..." the bespectacled man paused.
Sun Duhua let out a sound, "However, what?"
The bespectacled man said, "Since we’ve got this buzz and sales are up, Ning Xiaoyue’s fans are saying that we’re riding the hype and only became popular by blackening Ning Xiaoyue, like we’re eating blood-stained buns."
Sun Duhua snorted heavily, "What a bunch of brain-dead fans!"
The bespectacled man, feeling like an instigator, held back a laugh and said, "Exactly, these brain-dead fans, liking someone as worthless as Ning Xiaoyue, can’t be normal people."
Sun Duhua looked sinister, "Since the audience is satisfied, let’s continue. Tomorrow we’ll release part three. If they’re saying we’re eating blood-stained buns, then I’ll eat them, and not only eat, but eat until I’m a big, fat person. Our entertainment section’s sales boost will surely result in a hefty year-end bonus."
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man laughed heartily.
Sun Duhua said, "I’ll leave this to you. From now on, your main task is to target Ning Xiaoyue. Finish the third article by today."
The bespectacled man laughed, "Alright, I’ll get on it right away."
The bespectacled man was about to leave.
Suddenly, there was a knock on the door.
The bespectacled man went to open it.
An employee peeked in and said, "Chief Editor Sun, and you, the president wants to see you outside."
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man exchanged a glance and smiled smugly, "The president must be here to commend us. No way around it, we’re just too outstanding."
"Exactly, the rise in newspaper sales is all thanks to our efforts, mainly the Chief Editor’s," the bespectacled man said.
The two walked out with smiles.
As they stepped out, they saw the president standing with his hands behind his back, looking at them sternly.
Beside him, a photographer was busy setting up a camera.
Colleagues around them were all watching.
Sun Duhua chuckled, "The president is here to award us, see, even the photographer is ready, the employee of the year is definitely mine this year."
Sun Duhua adjusted his clothes, preparing to receive a commendation.
The president calmly said, "You two, get ready. In a moment, you’ll be recording an apology video."
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man’s smiles froze instantly, looking at each other, bewildered.
What?
An apology video?
Did they hear wrong?
Wasn’t the president supposed to praise them? Why an apology video?
Sun Duhua quickly asked, "President, what’s going on, what do you mean?"
The president said, "You two, for the last couple of days, your reports on Ning Xiaoyue have severely tarnished an innocent young girl. You need to apologize to Ning Xiaoyue."
What?
Apologize to Ning Xiaoyue?
Everyone was stunned.
The president was actually asking for an apology to Ning Xiaoyue, did they hear it wrong? Yesterday the president said to ignore it, why the sudden change?
Sun Duhua was even more frustrated, urgently asking, "President, what’s going on, why do we need to apologize to Ning Xiaoyue? Do we really have to fear her small company?"
The bespectacled man said, "And our sales have also increased in these past two days..."
Everyone was nodding, not understanding the president’s intention.
The president’s face darkened, "You two are shameless bringing up sales. You tarnished a young girl without evidence, spreading seriously unfounded rumors—absolutely outrageous! Our newspaper values truth-seeking, you’ve blatantly violated our principles, bringing shame to our paper, you’ve disgraced the newspaper, you’re undeserving of being journalists, you’re a disgrace to the industry!"
Everyone stood in shock.
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man were hit with the president’s outrage like a tidal wave.
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man were bewildered. The president’s rage indicated something was seriously wrong.
The president lambasted, "I told you yesterday, Wenyue Company has powerful supporters behind them, but you didn’t listen and continued to tarnish Ning Xiaoyue. You’ve committed an unpardonable blunder! People like you should be swept out and blacklisted by the industry forever!"
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man were shocked, finally realizing they’d caused a huge mess. Being blacklisted in journalism was an extremely severe punishment!
"President, what is the background behind Wenyue Company?" Sun Duhua asked.
The president said, "I don’t know, I only know that this person can shut our newspaper down at any time!"
"What?"
Everyone was terrified; the background behind Wenyue Company was so formidable!
"Shutting down the newspaper is the least of your worries. If this person decides to come after you, your entire life will be ruined," the president said.
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man’s faces went pale, cold sweat dripping down; they couldn’t believe they’d offended such a powerful person!
"What are you standing around for? Get over here and record the apology video, or no one will be able to save you!" the president shouted.
"Yes, President."
Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man hurried over...
Not long after, an apology video appeared online.
In the video, Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man admitted they had tarnished Ning Xiaoyue and vowed never to do it again, hoping for her forgiveness. The two were tearful, almost kneeling to Ning Xiaoyue.
Soon after, Yun City Daily also issued an apology, apologizing to Ning Xiaoyue for Sun Duhua’s and the bespectacled man’s actions, and stating that they would publish an apology statement on the front page for three consecutive days starting tomorrow.
As for Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man, due to their unforgivable errors, beginning today, they were fired by Yun City Daily, publicly reprimanded across the industry, and banned from journalism for three years.
This incident quickly made it to the trending topics, causing a stir online.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Giving Face But Not Accepting It
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 461: Giving Face But Not Accepting It
After Yun City Daily published an apology statement online, three days had passed.
During these three days, Yun City Daily indeed published an apology letter to Ning Xiaoyue on the front page, for three consecutive days.
This was the first time in the history of Yun City Daily, even rare in the entire journalism industry. It was unprecedented.
The matter sparked heated discussion online. At first, netizens thought Yun City Daily was bold, but who knew they’d suddenly apologize, the turn of events was startling.
After Wenyue Company’s statement, some rumor mongers received letters from Xingquan Law Firm. They quickly backed down, either deleting posts, apologizing, or even deleting their accounts.
Only Yun City Daily did not apologize, and the next day, continued to publish malicious articles about Ning Xiaoyue.
For a moment, Yun City Daily was seen as a tough character in the eyes of netizens, who rushed to buy the newspaper, causing its sales to soar.
However, this tough image of Yun City Daily lasted less than half a day before it backed down.
Not only did the entertainment section’s editor and reporters record apology videos, but they also issued an apology statement and fired Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man.
Moreover, they apologized on the front page for three days.
This move was truly a sign of weakness.
"What’s going on? Yun City Daily backed down too?"
"I even praised them, but they turned out to be weaker than anyone!"
"Looks like Wenyue Company is determined to deal with the rumormongers this time."
"Wenyue Company engaged Xingquan Law Firm, it’s no small feat!"
"Even Yun City Daily backed down; seems like they know they can’t win the lawsuit."
"So, the malicious gossip about Ning Xiaoyue must be rumors, otherwise Yun City Daily wouldn’t have backed down."
Yun City Daily’s apology dealt a significant blow to the rumor spreaders, like killing chickens as a warning to monkeys.
This rumor storm finally began to calm down.
However, things were far from over.
Yun City Daily office.
The president sat in the office, looking worried.
That day, he received a call from the investors. Because Yun City Daily slandered Ning Xiaoyue, causing a bad impact, the investors decided to withdraw their investment.
The president was in shock, and to make amends, he immediately had Sun Duhua and the bespectacled man apologize and fired them, then apologized to Ning Xiaoyue on the front page for three consecutive days.
He had done everything he could do, and now he was waiting for a call from the investors, praying they would reconsider.
The phone rang.
The president quickly answered the call.
A cold voice from the investors said: "Sorry, we won’t change our minds. You have no idea whom you’ve offended this time. Even if I wanted to continue investing in the newspaper, it’s impossible now."
The president turned pale: "Why? Who exactly did we offend?"
At this time.
An employee hurriedly entered, handing a document to the president.
"President, this is an urgent document from Yun City Propaganda Department."
The president was startled, put down the phone, and quickly picked up the document.
Yun City Propaganda Department was the governing body of the newspaper!
The sudden urgent document from the governing body was alarming. The president hadn’t even read the document, and he was already nervous.
Upon reading the document, the president was scared out of his wits.
This document was a termination order from the Propaganda Department!
Because Yun City Daily slandered and defamed a young girl, causing a negative social impact, seriously violating the professional integrity of journalists, the governing body ordered the immediate shutdown of Yun City Daily.
The president slumped to the ground, his limbs weak, completely exhausted.
After a long time, he came to his senses and quickly picked up the phone.
"I just received the Propaganda Department’s termination order; Yun City Daily is going to close." the president said in a daze.
The other party chuckled: "Now you understand why we can’t continue investing in you. Even if you found another investor, it would be useless."
The president was on the verge of tears: "Please, you must tell me, who exactly did we offend?"
This person could not only make his investors withdraw but also alarm the governing body, simply remarkable.
The other party said, "Sorry, I don’t know who this person is. I only know that anyone who can bring down Feng Ruolan, Yun City’s female tycoon, is surely no ordinary person."
The president was shocked: "What? Feng Ruolan, you mean the female president of the financial giant Longheng Group?"
The other party said: "Exactly, unless we don’t want to survive in the finance world, how could we not give Miss Feng face! However, that person not only got Miss Feng involved but also made the governing body intervene, his tactics are unimaginable!"
With that, the other party hung up the phone.
The president looked ashen.
He couldn’t imagine what kind of extraordinary person this was.
He probably would never dream.
At this moment.
The person who frightened him, Lin Fan, was sitting in a city apartment, talking with Feng Ruolan on the phone.
"Sister, thank you for your help this time." Lin Fan smiled.
He had already given Yun City Daily ample opportunity, as long as Yun City Daily apologized properly, he would let it go.
Who knew, Yun City Daily not only didn’t apologize but went further and published more slanderous articles about Ning Xiaoyue the next day.
Since they showed no remorse, Lin Fan didn’t hold back either, he made a call to Feng Ruolan.
According to Du Tao’s information, Yun City Daily’s investors were related to Feng Ruolan’s Longheng Group.
Feng Ruolan didn’t hesitate at all and made a call to the investors. To them, Yun City Daily wasn’t important, naturally, it wasn’t worth offending Feng Ruolan for Yun City Daily, and they quickly decided to withdraw their investment.
Feng Ruolan chuckled: "You’re welcome, it’s just a phone call, a minor effort. When you have time, just come over and have a meal with your sister."
Lin Fan smiled: "Okay, I’ll come over when I’m free."
Just after hanging up the call.
Another call came in, surprisingly from Yun City Government.
"Mr. Lin, based on your feedback, the Yun City Daily matter has received high attention from city leaders. After careful consideration by the city, the Propaganda Department has decided to shut down Yun City Daily effective immediately. Soon, Yun City Daily will no longer exist on this earth. Hope this matter won’t affect Mr. Lin’s investment plans in Yun City."
The person spoke with great respect and caution, even though they were from the Yun City Government.
Lin Fan smiled: "Thank you, please assure the leaders that I won’t let them down."
With that, Lin Fan hung up the call.
Yun City Daily angered Lin Fan, resulting in its shutdown, and all related personnel paid a painful price.
Lin Fan’s anger was finally soothed.
Ring ring ring...
At this moment, another call came in, it was from Wang Xiangqian.
"Brother Fan, following your plan, sure enough, it was effective. The rumors about Xiaoyue are quickly cooling down." Wang Xiangqian said with delight.
Lin Fan smiled: "That’s good."
Wang Xiangqian said: "And the Yun City Daily, with three consecutive days of front-page apology statements, this must also be Brother Fan’s handiwork right?"
Lin Fan said: "Yun City Daily is no longer a concern, it will soon shut down."
Wang Xiangqian paused, astounded, oh my, Brother Fan is truly impressive. He can even make Yun City Daily shut down!
Wang Xiangqian laughed: "That’s great, with two episodes remaining, the program will soon end. Now is the perfect time to strike while the iron is hot and have the fans ramp up their voting!"
But Lin Fan said: "No, I want Xiaoyue’s votes to drop, preferably below the debut position."
What? Wang Xiangqian paused, what is Brother Fan trying to do?

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Hiding Strength, Playing the Pig to Eat the Tiger
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 462: Hiding Strength, Playing the Pig to Eat the Tiger
Under the strongest PR maneuver in history by Lin Fan, Ning Xiaoyue’s rumor crisis finally calmed down.
However, this wave of attacks seemed to have caused irreparable damage to Ning Xiaoyue.
The time came to the ninth episode of the Creation Star show, and the latest rankings were announced. Originally ranked third, Ning Xiaoyue’s rank plummeted, shockingly falling to seventh.
You must know that only 9 debut spots are available in the Creation Star show. Ning Xiaoyue being at 7th is already very dangerous. If she drops two more spots, she’ll fall out of the debut positions and won’t be able to debut.
This result made netizens very pleased.
"Is Ning Xiaoyue finally going down?"
"It looks like she’s already unable to debut."
"I told you, she could never debut!"
"This ranking is indeed a major shake-up. Ning Xiaoyue, who was always in the top three, fell so much."
"It seems this wave of rumors really hit her hard."
In an office, reading the comments from netizens, Feng Tianming burst out laughing.
"Ning Xiaoyue, you’re out of luck!" Feng Tianming laughed heartily, "Lin Fan, I know this debunk was your work, but what’s the use? Ning Xiaoyue’s rank still dropped, completely futile!"
What made Feng Tianming most happy wasn’t just that Ning Xiaoyue’s rank dropped, but that his A-level player had entered the debut spots for the first time, ranking ninth, just two spots behind Ning Xiaoyue.
Feng Tianming was overjoyed: "My wave of attack on Ning Xiaoyue was simply brilliant. Now Ning Xiaoyue’s rank is trending downward, and she will certainly continue to drop, while my person is on an upward trend! This time, I’m sure I’ll beat Lin Fan!"
The thought of taking away 1 billion cash from Lin Fan made Feng Tianming ecstatic.
At the same time.
Wenyue Company.
Upon learning that Ning Xiaoyue’s rank fell to seventh, Wang Xiangqian immediately called Lin Fan.
Wang Xiangqian wore an apologetic face: "Brother Fan, Xiaoyue’s rank dropped to seventh, I’m sorry to disappoint you."
Lin Fan gave a simple "oh": "Didn’t fall out of the debut spot, huh?"
Wang Xiangqian said: "According to Brother Fan’s idea, we coordinated with the fan club to try to stop them from voting as much as possible, but Xiaoyue has too many fans. Some simply won’t follow the fan club’s guidance and keep voting, so dropping to seventh was really hard enough. Making her fall out of the debut position is too tough."
Wang Xiangqian looked helpless.
"Alright then." Lin Fan sighed, well, there’s no way around it. It’s like trying to stop a fast-moving giant ship; it’s not that easy. Just slowing it down a bit is already tough enough.
Wang Xiangqian curiously asked: "Brother Fan, what’s your intention behind letting Xiaoyue’s rank drop? Because of this issue, Xiaoyue’s fans are having disputes. Some feel that Xiaoyue has faced too much online abuse and sympathize with her, thinking it might be better just to let her fall. Others believe she must debut and shouldn’t suffer her past hardships anymore. Brother Fan, could it be that you don’t want Xiaoyue to debut either?"
If Lin Fan doesn’t want Ning Xiaoyue to debut, it would not only make her lose her debut spot but also cost Lin Fan 1 billion.
Wang Xiangqian couldn’t figure out Lin Fan’s purpose.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Think about it, why has Xiaoyue always been under attack? It’s because she’s always at the top and a big target attracts attention, so naturally, all opponents are focusing on her. If she can temporarily fall out of the debut spot, it can lull the opponents into a false sense of security and reduce the attacks on her."
Wang Xiangqian suddenly understood: "So that’s it, Brother Fan, you’re really wise!"
Brother Fan uses a strategy called ’indirectly attack to capture,’ hiding one’s strength and pretending to be weak.
Lin Fan felt sorry for Ning Xiaoyue. The young girl hadn’t done anything wrong and yet was subjected to so much abuse. It’s better to avoid it a bit.
As long as the opponents feel Ning Xiaoyue is no longer a threat, naturally, the attacks on her will lessen.
Lin Fan’s strategy worked. In the following week, online attacks on Ning Xiaoyue dramatically decreased.
This indicates that most of the previous attacks on Ning Xiaoyue were orchestrated by competitors using paid commenters to manipulate the narrative, while netizens were merely following the trend, joining the online abuse.
It’s unavoidable, as Ning Xiaoyue’s weaknesses were too obvious. Her ability to sing and dance was indeed weak, making it easy to incite negative sentiment. Just a little provocation was enough for self-proclaimed "righteous" netizens to reach a climax.
And those who followed the trend and abused her hadn’t even watched the show and were unaware of the show’s rules.
In their minds, the logic was simple: because you sing and dance so poorly, you don’t deserve this position, without thinking about why someone with such poor skills could still achieve it.
If they just thought about this a bit, there would be far fewer people criticizing Ning Xiaoyue.
However, the world has many trend followers and few independent thinkers.
Lin Fan had Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking drop mainly to lull the opponents, stopping them from targeting Ning Xiaoyue, and also hoped during this time, those who joined in the online abuse could calm down and think for a moment, though it might not be effective.
A week passed just like that.
On this day, they finally welcomed the finals of Creation Star.
At this point, nearly three months had passed since the program began broadcasting.
Creation Star, this talent show, at this time, had already become a nationwide hit, with almost every Huaxia person knowing about the show and a girl named Ning Xiaoyue in it.
Compared to the champion, people were more interested in whether Ning Xiaoyue could debut in the end.
The hot topics online were mostly centered around Ning Xiaoyue.
"Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking dropped to seventh last week; she certainly won’t be able to debut."
"I think she still has quite a few fans, hard to say!"
"Many fans? I think many are losing interest!"
Netizens generally were not optimistic about Ning Xiaoyue, thinking she would definitely be eliminated this time.
Wenyue Company.
Before the show aired, everyone in the company was already sitting in front of the TV, waiting for it to start.
As the boss of the company, Wang Xiangqian had been invited to watch it live on-site.
Before leaving, Wang Xiangqian invited Lin Fan to sit at Wenyue Company, and so Lin Fan came to Wenyue.
Shortly after Lin Fan arrived at Wenyue Company, Feng Tianming appeared.
Feng Tianming was very smug, shouting as soon as he entered: "Lin Fan, are you ready with the 1 billion cash!"
Lin Fan hadn’t seen Feng Tianming for a while; this guy hadn’t changed at all, still as provoking.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Oh, it’s Young Master Feng, weren’t you supposed to be at the live show? How come you have the time to come here and show off?"
Feng Tianming laughed cunningly: "You can only do superficial tricks! What’s so interesting about being there live; anyway, my person is definitely going to debut, no excitement there, way more fun to come here and watch you fail!"
Lin Fan said: "The results aren’t out yet, and you already know I’ll fail?"
Feng Tianming said: "Isn’t it obvious? Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking has been dropping significantly since last week. Do you think you still have a chance to turn the tables?"

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Treat Others with Their Own Methods
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 463: Treat Others with Their Own Methods
What Feng Tianming truly cares about is that 100 million yuan.
He can’t allow himself to lose to Lin Fan, so he must win this competition. To win, he has put in a lot of effort.
Finally, due to his relentless "efforts," Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking plummeted from third to seventh place last week, and it shows signs of further decline.
Meanwhile, his A-Class Player rose to ninth place, entering the debut position for the first time.
In Feng Tianming’s view, victory is within reach!
So, he didn’t go to the venue today; instead, he went to Wenyue Company. He wanted to witness Lin Fan’s failure firsthand.
Everyone at Wenyue Company is familiar with Feng Tianming. This guy has come a few times before and always leaves humiliated. It’s annoying that he still dares to show up.
However, facing Feng Tianming’s sarcasm this time, everyone at the company felt a bit uneasy. Indeed, Ning Xiaoyue is in danger, and there’s a real chance she might lose.
So everyone could only watch Feng Tianming arrogant and had no confidence to refute him.
Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered to argue with Feng Tianming and said calmly, "Since Young Master Feng is so shameless and insists on coming to someone else’s company to be a nuisance, fine, show Young Master Feng a seat."
Feng Tianming chuckled, "Then I won’t stand on ceremony!"
Feng Tianming indeed impudently sat down opposite Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan, your expression of failure must be wonderful; I wouldn’t want to miss it!"
Lin Fan laughed, "If Xiaoyue can’t debut, that would be thanks to you, Young Master Feng. Don’t think I don’t know what you’ve been doing behind the scenes; you’re the one who orchestrated the rumor scandal, right?"
Feng Tianming replied, "Lin Fan, don’t make baseless accusations. This has nothing to do with me! You have no evidence. I could sue you for defamation!"
Lin Fan said, "No evidence? You bribed reporters from Yun City Daily to write black articles about Xiaoyue, isn’t that proof enough?"
Feng Tianming retorted, "When did I bribe reporters from Yun City Daily?"
Lin Fan opened his phone and played a video.
"The chief editor and a reporter from Yun City Daily’s entertainment section were fired for slander and defamation after taking bribes from you to write against Ning Xiaoyue. They begged for mercy on the spot, confessing they took your bribes."
The people in the video were indeed Sun Duhua, the editor of Yun City Daily’s entertainment section, and the man with glasses.
"President, please give us a break this time; we just made a foolish mistake."
"Yes, it was Feng Tianming who paid me to write that article. I know I was wrong."
Sun Duhua and the man with glasses were crying like children.
Lin Fan turned off the video, smiling at Feng Tianming.
The evidence was irrefutable, leaving Feng Tianming no room to deny it.
"Lin Fan, I heard about Yun City Daily going bankrupt. Was that your doing?" Feng Tianming sneered.
This Lin Fan could actually cause Yun City Daily to go bankrupt; his methods are truly extraordinary, leaving people shocked.
Everyone at the company was stunned.
Yun City Daily indeed recently went bankrupt, with some speculation it might be related to the Ning Xiaoyue incident, but that was too astonishing for anyone to believe.
Yun City Daily went bankrupt just after writing two defamatory articles about Ning Xiaoyue?
Isn’t that too sensational?
Could it be that Lin Fan actually orchestrated Yun City Daily’s bankruptcy?
For a moment, everyone looked at Lin Fan. If it were true, Mr. Lin’s methods would be truly frightening.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Feng Tianming, now that’s what I call baseless claims. Yun City Daily made mistakes themselves and faced punishment from the PR department, paying the deserved price. How does that have anything to do with me?"
Hearing this, everyone felt somewhat relieved. So it wasn’t Mr. Lin’s doing, after all.
Feng Tianming sneered, "If you didn’t take action against Yun City Daily, how did you get this video?"
Lin Fan said, "This video is online; didn’t you know? I saw it online as well."
"What?" Feng Tianming’s face changed, and he quickly pulled out his phone to search. Sure enough, he found the video.
This video had, of course, been spread by Lin Fan, purposefully ambiguous in origin.
What Feng Tianming could think of, Lin Fan had already anticipated. He wouldn’t let others know that Yun City Daily’s downfall was of his own orchestration.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "This video is still being spread on a small scale. If it goes viral, everyone will know you, Feng Tianming, paid to smear Ning Xiaoyue. Think about the consequences."
Cold sweat ran down Feng Tianming’s face.
"Lin Fan, you are vicious!" Feng Tianming gritted his teeth.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Young Master Feng, don’t talk nonsense. Your ugly deeds getting exposed has nothing to do with me. Didn’t I just say I also saw it online?"
Feng Tianming didn’t believe Lin Fan saw it online; it was apparent Lin Fan had arranged this, but with no proof, he couldn’t be sure.
"Lin Fan, don’t be so smug. Even if everyone knows I smeared Ning Xiaoyue, so what? As rivals, a little negative publicity for the opposition is a normal tactic!" Feng Tianming sneered.
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but be furious.
Is this even human talk?
Feng Tianming is so shameless, even justifying slandering others!
Feng Tianming continued, "As they say, the winner takes all. Anyway, you’re bound to lose tonight, and losers have no right to speak!"
Lin Fan silently opened another video and let Feng Tianming watch.
"Young Master Feng, open your eyes wide and see what this video is about. Somebody, help me project this video onto the big screen."
Soon, an employee helped, and they projected the video onto the screen.
In the video, surprisingly, there was a girl smoking, drinking, and swearing—a complete delinquent.
Upon closer inspection, the girl turned out to be Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player!
Feng Tianming’s expression changed drastically.
Lin Fan said, "Young Master Feng, at this critical moment, if this video hits the trending list, do you think your player will still be able to debut?"
Feng Tianming was in a panic and angrily rebuked, "Lin Fan, don’t you dare!"
Lin Fan replied, "If you can attack my people, why can’t I counterattack? Furthermore, at this crucial moment, you have no time to react."
"Haha..."
Everyone laughed.
Mr. Lin is too impressive; this move is indeed ruthless.
It’s foreseeable that if this video were released, Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player would certainly suffer a fatal blow.
Feng Tianming, drenched in sweat and almost driven mad with anger, never expected Lin Fan to pull out a trump card at the last moment!
Seeing Lin Fan pick up his phone, Feng Tianming had no recourse and exclaimed, "Lin Fan, you..."
Everyone watched eagerly, expecting with anticipation. Was Mr. Lin going to play his trump card?
"I can return the favor in kind. However you deal with me, I’ll retaliate in the same way. However, your methods are too dirty; even though I can do this, I disdain to do so."
As Lin Fan spoke, he deleted the video in front of everyone.
Everyone was stunned.
What?
Lin Fan actually gave up this trump card?

chapters.title: Chapter 464: It’s Easy to Talk When You’re Not in Pain
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 464: It’s Easy to Talk When You’re Not in Pain
Lin Fan publicly deleted the video, giving up a deadly move!
Such a great move could basically kill the opponent with one hit!
However, Lin Fan disdained using this move.
Using one’s own methods against them is certainly satisfying. If the target was Feng Tianming, Lin Fan wouldn’t hesitate at all, but now the target is a young girl, which changes things.
"Since Mr. Lin doesn’t plan to use this move, why did he collect her dark history?"
Someone questioned.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Because I want Young Master Feng to know that people are different. A person can choose to be human or a beast. Young Master Feng has no moral bottom line, so he chose to be a beast, wantonly smearing and harming an innocent girl. But I chose to be human, and such despicable means, are better left unused."
These words were impassioned and righteous, simply the light of justice.
Everyone kowtowed, and for a moment, they admired Mr. Lin’s magnanimity profoundly.
"Mr. Lin’s outlook is truly vast!"
"Mr. Lin is radiant!"
"Compared to Mr. Lin, Feng Tianming is just a gutter rat!"
"I kneel to Mr. Lin; from now on, I’m a fan girl of Mr. Lin."
Being called a gutter rat, Feng Tianming was furious; although he indeed was a gutter rat, being exposed was still hurtful to his self-esteem, and he felt particularly aggrieved. Wasn’t he just trying to defeat Lin Fan!
His family taught him to be unscrupulous in achieving his goals since childhood.
After the initial anger, Feng Tianming suddenly burst into laughter.
It made everyone curious about what he was laughing at.
"Lin Fan, you had a chance to defeat me, but you insist on being a moral saint; what a fool, simply too foolish, so don’t blame me!" Feng Tianming laughed.
"As the saying goes, only those free of poison are not true men. Lin Fan, you’re ultimately too kind-hearted and can’t achieve greatness! You voluntarily gave up this opportunity; you’re destined for total defeat. Get ready with the 100 million cash!"
Hearing this, everyone was somewhat filled with righteous indignation.
This Feng Tianming is really shameless. Mr. Lin doesn’t stoop to his vile level, yet he has the audacity to mock Mr. Lin, as if wanting everyone to be as despicable as he is!
However, Feng Tianming’s words did cut deep. Although Mr. Lin is indeed noble, this certainly lessens their chances of winning, and Ning Xiaoyue might really lose.
Lin Fan, however, remained calm and said, "The result hasn’t come out yet, so Young Master Feng doesn’t need to be in such a hurry. Take it slowly."
Young Master Feng sneered, "You just pretend to be calm. Soon, I’ll make you want to cry without tears!"
While they were talking, the program had already started.
This episode of the program was the finals, live broadcast, and what the outcome would be, no one knew yet.
Feng Tianming watched the program, constantly monitoring the internet, still somewhat worried that dirt on his A-Class Player might suddenly erupt online.
He didn’t feel at ease with Lin Fan. Although Lin Fan verbally promised not to expose, who knew if Lin Fan would suddenly unleash a trump card unexpectedly.
Feng Tianming’s worries were unnecessary. Lin Fan indeed kept his word and did not expose the dirt.
Feng Tianming finally relaxed, feeling quite smug, secretly cursing that Lin Fan was really an idiot, having such a powerful move yet choosing not to use it, truly foolish!
The dirt on the A-Class Player wasn’t exposed, but Ning Xiaoyue was being cursed online again.
It turned out that the finals process included singing and dancing performances, and Ning Xiaoyue’s performance was very poor, unable to keep pace.
As a result, the topic of Ning Xiaoyue being offbeat quickly soared to the top of trending searches, swiftly occupying first place.
Due to the high attention on this final, it didn’t take long for Ning Xiaoyue’s topic to explode.
Netizens started madly cursing again.
"Three months in, and she hasn’t improved at all!"
"Still offbeat, really absurd!"
"This useless person better not debut!"
"She probably can’t debut, right? Last week, she dropped to seventh place."
"I see she’s losing fans, definitely can’t debut this time."
Despite Ning Xiaoyue’s fans trying hard to explain that Ning Xiaoyue’s foundation was too poor, coupled with a lack of talent in singing and dancing, making significant progress in three months was virtually impossible.
But these voices were drowned by netizens’ taunts.
Seeing these taunts, Feng Tianming laughed gleefully.
"Lin Fan, do you still not admit your failure now! Ning Xiaoyue is just a piece of trash, the internet is all cursing her, how could she possibly debut! This trending topic isn’t bought by me, nor did I buy any cyber troops; it’s purely initiated by netizens," Feng Tianming gloated.
Everyone from Wenyue Company remained silent.
Although Feng Tianming was unpleasant, none of them could argue back.
In many people’s eyes, being lousy is the original sin.
Speaking of singing and dancing skills alone, Ning Xiaoyue indeed isn’t good; this has been Ning Xiaoyue’s greatest weakness, and competitors have exploited this weakness too many times since the competition.
The company and fans have never been able to argue back.
They can only explain repeatedly that this program doesn’t only evaluate vocal and dance skills, it’s essentially about popularity, where a person’s merits aren’t solely reflected in singing and dancing, but also in looks and personality, where each contestant attracts fans based on their own merits, as if the Eight Immortals crossing the sea, each showing their special skills.
But in terms of effect, netizens didn’t buy it, blindly cursing Ning Xiaoyue as if it was a righteous act, holding nothing back, feeling as if they suddenly grew taller and became embodiments of justice.
It’s like a network festivity, the sharp edge of words sparing not a bit of mercy for a girl just 20 years old.
Seeing everyone silent, Feng Tianming became more triumphant: "What’s wrong, turned mute after being hit by my words, right? Someone like Ning Xiaoyue shouldn’t debut, her failure is actually a relief, she doesn’t have to put up with curses anymore, you should be happy for her. Though someone won’t be happy, having to soon lose a billion, ha-ha..."
While speaking, Feng Tianming looked towards Lin Fan with a mocking gaze.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Feng Tianming, you really are an idiot."
Feng Tianming’s face fell, "What did you say?"
Lin Fan said, "You really speak carelessly without knowing the pain of poverty. I believe you’ve already dug up everything about Ning Xiaoyue, even down to her ancestors; you should know Xiaoyue’s family have been farmers for generations, impoverished, and Xiaoyue, to save her father from further burden, dropped out very early to work, having done many low-level jobs. Without an accident, she might never achieve a leap in social class in this life, forever trapped at the bottom."
"But there happened to be this accident, this talent show. If she can debut, she’ll live a better life than before. If she fails, she returns to the bottom. To her, it’s a battle with no retreat. Yet you’re saying her failure is a relief? You were born into a Rich Second Generation, with abundant comforts, what would you know of the desires of ordinary people from the lower class?"
"As long as she can debut, what’s a few curses? She doesn’t steal, doesn’t rob, all relying on the program’s rules for a win. Those who curse her are merely a crowd of blind, cyber warriors incapable of independent thought, only able to indulge in collective revelry—pay no mind to the nonsense of keyboard warriors!"

chapters.title: Chapter 465 Final Rankings
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 465 Final Rankings
Lin Fan’s words left everyone at the company feeling quite emotional; most are regular people working hard, and what Lin Fan said resonated deeply with them.
Indeed, as ordinary folks, who doesn’t want a better life? If there’s an opportunity to climb up legally and reasonably, who wouldn’t be happy?
Perhaps Ning Xiaoyue’s fans think this way too, working hard to help her debut so she can leave her past behind and have a better life.
Yet, this feeling is something Feng Tianming, being a Rich Second Generation, cannot understand.
Feng Tianming, the Rich Second Generation, only sees Ning Xiaoyue getting criticized as a shameful thing. If Ning Xiaoyue fails, she won’t get criticized anymore, and that would be a relief.
What he doesn’t understand is that Ning Xiaoyue and her fans would rather endure criticism than miss this opportunity, as it might be the only chance to change her destiny.
It’s hard for the poor to produce noble children!
They say ordinary people often can only change their fate through education, yet most, even after earning a PhD, still remain poor.
Only a few can become elites and achieve social mobility.
If Ning Xiaoyue successfully moves up through this talent show, it’s imaginable she’ll attract envy and face more attacks and criticism.
Some will think her ascension came too easily, simply because of her pretty face.
However, these people overlook one point: if Ning Xiaoyue truly succeeds, it’s because she fought through a bloody path. She’s faced so many terrible attacks, been scarred all over; if someone else had tried, they’d be worse off than Ning Xiaoyue.
"Lin Fan, what’s the point of saying all this? Ning Xiaoyue is destined to fail. Change her fate? Dream on! Once the competition’s over, she can go back to her rural hometown to farm. A useless person like her is only fit for farming, haha..."
Feng Tianming laughed loudly.
"This bastard..."
Everyone at Wenyue Company gritted their teeth in rage, but had no way to refute Feng Tianming.
There’s no other way; given the current situation, no one can guarantee Ning Xiaoyue will successfully debut.
The show continued.
Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player performed well and even made it onto the trending list, garnering unanimous praise from netizens, who lauded her as a talented player.
Seeing these compliments, Feng Tianming laughed joyfully.
He couldn’t help but mock Lin Fan again: "Lin Fan, I really have to thank you, this fool, for showing mercy by not exposing her scandals. Otherwise, the comments now would be a different story. In this situation, she’s guaranteed to debut. By comparison, Ning Xiaoyue, this useless person, remains under fire. Can you guess the result? No need for me to say more, right?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Young Master Feng, don’t be too complacent, be careful not to end up embarrassed."
Lin Fan’s calm demeanor made Feng Tianming quite annoyed: "I really don’t understand where your confidence comes from; the trend is already very clear, my player’s popularity keeps rising, while Ning Xiaoyue is declining. Keep lying to yourself, but you don’t have much time left."
Lin Fan said, "Then just wait and see."
Feng Tianming was furious, thinking Lin Fan was really annoying. Once victory comes, he will definitely humiliate Lin Fan thoroughly.
He had already planned out how to insult Lin Fan.
The show continued to air, and finally, it reached the thrilling moment.
The final rankings were announced!
Only the top nine can debut as a group.
As the show aired, fans of each contestant were desperately voting. Before the final rankings were revealed, the host announced the official closure of the voting channel.
After tallying the data, the results were out.
The host started announcing from ninth place.
Three people were announced consecutively.
Neither Ning Xiaoyue nor Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player was among them.
Feng Tianming laughed out loud, "Nice, really nice, seems my player is already in the top six. Ning Xiaoyue indeed dropped out of debut position!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Are you so sure Xiaoyue must have dropped out of debut position?"
Feng Tianming said, "She dropped to seventh last week, and kept declining. What do you think? Lin Fan, stop deceiving yourself!"
Lin Fan did not respond.
Feng Tianming thought Lin Fan was speechless, and could not help but feel even more smug.
"Lin Fan, I advise you to prepare one billion cash immediately; I’ll take it away in a while, perfect for tonight’s celebration!" Feng Tianming chuckled.
Lin Fan did not respond, already too lazy to waste words with Feng Tianming.
Feng Tianming coldly sneered internally, Lin Fan’s reaction was really annoying, just wait till you cry!
"Sixth place..."
"Fifth place..."
"Fourth place..."
Next, the host announced three consecutive rankings.
Neither Ning Xiaoyue nor the A-Class Player was among them!
Wenyue Company fell silent momentarily, everyone’s faces were filled with tension.
If the top three didn’t include Ning Xiaoyue, then she was really out of debut position.
Feng Tianming was incredibly excited, "Amazing, never expected this, better than imagined—into the top three! I’m not asking for much, third place is fine! Lin Fan, are you ready to face defeat?"
This talent show attracted almost the whole internet’s attention, everyone was anticipating the final debut list.
Reaching the top three, the atmosphere was at its tensest, everyone stared at the screen, beginning all sorts of guesses.
"Top three, it’s certain Ning Xiaoyue isn’t among them!"
"I think so, Ning Xiaoyue fell to seventh last week. She couldn’t possibly be in the top three even if she turned it around!"
"Yeah, that hit was too hard for her!"
"If she doesn’t debut, that’s great; I wouldn’t need to criticize her then."
The main discussion topic still revolved around Ning Xiaoyue, as if the entire show only featured her, everyone cared about her ranking.
Reaching the top three, it was generally believed Ning Xiaoyue was out of chances.
Amidst all the anticipation, the host announced: "Now, announcing the contestant in third place. Let’s congratulate her, it’s Ning Xiaoyue, congratulations to Ning Xiaoyue for gaining third place!"
The host’s voice was loud, almost echoing through the entire network.
Indeed, his announcement was like dropping a thunderous bomb online, shaking everyone to their core!
The entire world was stunned.
The internet fell into a brief silence; perhaps behind each network cable, netizens were struck by the truth, shocked.
Ning Xiaoyue actually got third place!
She dropped from third to seventh and then rose back to third again!
A stunning turnaround!
"How could this happen, impossible, impossible, I don’t believe the result..." Feng Tianming murmured, his face full of disbelief.
He could not accept that Ning Xiaoyue hadn’t dropped out of debut position but even debuted high in third place!
"Third place, pretty good." Lin Fan showed a satisfied smile; having debuted was good enough.
Feng Tianming screamed, "Lin Fan, don’t be too happy yet. There are still two positions; my player is definitely one of them. Could it be that she’s debuted in the center position, Lin Fan, you’re definitely lost, hahaha..."

chapters.title: Chapter 466: Mr. Lin Is the Sky
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 466: Mr. Lin Is the Sky
Ning Xiaoyue got third place!
This news quickly stirred public opinion, hitting the top of the trending list like a rocket and exploded.
The heat was so high that even Weibo became a bit paralyzed, and the officials had to urgently ask people to work overtime to handle it, only then did Weibo restore normal use.
The product manager of Weibo had already anticipated that the final of tonight’s show would be hugely popular and even predicted that Ning Xiaoyue would become the biggest focus of attention, but in the end, Weibo still underestimated this level of popularity.
The public opinion surged like a giant wave.
As expected, most people started cursing.
"Why her!"
"Good heavens, I thought she fell off the debut position, yet she debuted, and even in third place!"
"This piece of trash, she’s stolen someone else’s debut spot!"
A storm-like wave of online backlash was rapidly forming.
Just as Lin Fan predicted, when Ning Xiaoyue succeeded, these netizens indeed started to become indignant.
They couldn’t tolerate someone they deemed as a waste succeeding, couldn’t tolerate her pulling away from her embarrassing past and creating distance from them.
They automatically ignored the competition rules as usual, this competition was purely based on popularity, Ning Xiaoyue had high popularity, her votes were third, naturally she debuted third, where’s the talk of snatching others’ positions?
In order to curse Ning Xiaoyue, they’ve completely thrown away rationality and the ability to think, though some people originally didn’t have independent thinking ability, just a bunch of follow-the-trend internet mobsters.
However, even such surging black tides can’t change anything.
The result of Ning Xiaoyue debuting won’t change because of them.
This program, for Ning Xiaoyue, might be her only opportunity for a leap in social class, she’s already successfully upgraded.
These curse words, at most, are just a thunder tribulation brought by her upgrade, Ning Xiaoyue can withstand it.
While ordinary netizens were slinging curses and indulging in a frenzy of online violence.
The companies backing the contestants were deeply affected, Ning Xiaoyue’s debut was simply a loud slap in the face for them.
From their perspective, Ning Xiaoyue was a success, and they were failures.
"Ning Xiaoyue debuted!"
"Incredible, with this girl’s debut, the entertainment industry will be lively in the future."
"Her future is probably immeasurable, what a pity she isn’t with our company."
"Wenyue Company really found a treasure!"
Despite the curses from netizens, industry insiders were already sighing in admiration at how Ning Xiaoyue was practically heaven-sent, each wishing Ning Xiaoyue was an artist from their own company.
Tianxue Entertainment Company.
In the president’s office, Du Tao learned of Ning Xiaoyue’s third-place debut and immediately stood up in excitement.
"Debuting, Mr. Lin’s insight is really impressive, I’m in awe, even before Ning Xiaoyue joined the program, he invested in Wenyue Company, this insight is just incredible, even I can only kneel."
Du Tao sincerely exclaimed.
He truly admired Lin Fan too much, even though he’s a figure in the entertainment industry capable of causing a stir, he admitted he couldn’t match Lin Fan’s vision.
He had been in the entertainment industry for many years and never discovered an artist like Ning Xiaoyue, an artist full of controversy, capable of sparking large-scale discussions wherever she goes, difficult not to become popular, such a person is heaven-sent, a dream for entertainment companies.
Only Mr. Lin had such vision to discover Ning Xiaoyue.
For a moment, Du Tao’s admiration for Lin Fan was like an endless river, if Ning Xiaoyue was the heaven-sent girl, then Mr. Lin was that heaven!
Du Tao calmed down and immediately called Lin Fan.
"Miss Ning debuted, congratulations Mr. Lin," Du Tao congratulated.
Lin Fan replied with a smile, "Thank you, Old Du."
Du Tao said, "Mr. Lin, regarding Miss Ning’s future development, if you need my help, just instruct me, I’ll assist."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, actually, you’ve already helped a lot this time, I’ll remember it."
Du Tao was very pleased, "Being able to serve Mr. Lin is my honor."
Wenyue Company.
Watching Lin Fan put down his phone, Feng Tianming said with a cold smile, "Lin Fan, the top two haven’t been announced yet, don’t be so triumphant, already celebrating, soon you’ll face humiliation!"
Lin Fan smiled, "You don’t understand what I’m happy about, I’m happy for Xiaoyue’s debut, as for our wager, it’s even insignificant compared to this."
Feng Tianming laughed heartily, "Lin Fan, you’re quite adept at maintaining dignity, knowing you’re going to lose, you’re acting as if losing doesn’t matter, don’t pretend it doesn’t matter! I want you to remember, you’ve been defeated by me, have 1 billion ready for me!"
Lin Fan was unperturbed, "If I truly lose, I’ll naturally fulfill the wager."
Feng Tianming arrogantly said, "What do you mean if, you are definitely losing!"
At this moment, the program announced the second-place contestant.
This contestant, however, wasn’t Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player.
Feng Tianming was taken aback and suddenly burst into laughter, "Hahaha... wonderful, C-position, my person is debuting at C-position!"
Assuming his person would definitely have a debut position, now only the C-position is left to be announced, naturally, his person is at C-position! Feng Tianming was confident his person would secure a spot!
So he had already started celebrating in advance.
"Hahaha... Lin Fan, you’ve lost, you’re just as worthless as Ning Xiaoyue, pay the 1 billion quickly!"
Seeing Feng Tianming’s smug demeanor, everyone furrowed their brows, the C-position hadn’t been announced yet, what if it’s not his, wouldn’t that be awkward...
Finally, it was time to announce the C-position.
The host read out a name.
The person wasn’t Feng Tianming’s A-Class Player!
"What?"
Feng Tianming was originally laughing, but his smile froze, filled with disbelief as he watched the program, the C-position debut female walked out, accepting applause and congratulations.
Indeed not his A-Class Player!
His player didn’t secure a debut position, couldn’t even get ninth place, failed to debut!
Feng Tianming was shocked, his face pale, hands and feet cold, his entire body trembling, sweat dripping.
"How could this be, how could this be?" Feng Tianming mumbled, unable to accept this reality.
There must be a mistake, the program must have messed up, how could his person not even have a debut position!
Until the C-position female entered the trending list, Feng Tianming had to accept the reality, his person indeed didn’t make it!
He lost to Lin Fan!
Lost miserably, Ning Xiaoyue debuted at third highest position. His person couldn’t even debut, that’s not all, the worst part is, he has to pay Lin Fan 1 billion in cash, a real 1 billion in cash!
Feng Tianming was always confident, certain he could beat Lin Fan, so he never considered what 1 billion cash meant, now with his defeat clear, he suddenly realized, 1 billion is an enormous amount.
He can’t come up with it!

chapters.title: Chapter 467: Cheating
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 467: Cheating
"Hilarious, that guy was just gloating a moment ago, and now he’s getting a slap in the face!"
"It’s so brutal, thinking he’d debut as the central figure, only to end up not debuting at all!"
"This guy really made a fool of himself on a grand scale."
"The most ironic part is, his person got stuck at tenth place, just 100 votes shy of ninth, almost making it."
"Almost making it, but still not making it!"
The people at Wenyue Company all started snickering.
To be honest, Feng Tianming couldn’t blame them for laughing at him, he was so arrogant before, believing he’d debut as the star, trampling all over Lin Fan, and ended up getting slapped instead.
What a harsh slap in the face.
Feng Tianming was almost reduced to a withered eggplant.
"Young Master Feng, a bet’s a bet, you lost, when do you plan to give me the 100 million in cash?" Lin Fan said with a smile, leisurely watching Feng Tianming.
Feng Tianming had already lost, now the fun began.
Feng Tianming shuddered all over, 100 million!
He used to think he was sure to win, never really thought about what 100 million meant. Now that he lost the wager and had to cough up 100 million suddenly, he realized, that’s a huge sum!
Where would he find 100 million to give Lin Fan!
"Lin Fan, don’t get too cocky, there’s something fishy about this show. How come a loser like Ning Xiaoyue can snag third place, while my person got stuck at tenth? It’s because Ning Xiaoyue stole her debut, that’s what happened, the debut spot was supposed to be my person’s, but it was taken by that loser Ning Xiaoyue!"
Feng Tianming yelled hoarsely.
It looked like he was starting to act crazy, trying to muddle through without paying the money.
The people from Wenyue were all pissed off. Feng Tianming’s words were truly annoying. What’s with saying Ning Xiaoyue occupied her debut spot, as if Ning Xiaoyue won through shady means.
"Young Master Feng, even if you’re trying to pin the blame on someone, at least pick someone closer. Your person is at tenth, Xiaoyue is third, there’s a million vote gap between them, saying third place took tenth place’s spot is just laughable. Honestly, are you even qualified to say that?" Lin Fan chuckled.
Feng Tianming shouted, "I don’t care, this show has to be rigged, I don’t believe this result. Such an unreliable show shouldn’t have the power to decide the win! The bet naturally doesn’t count then!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "Young Master Feng, you’re planning to default, huh?"
Feng Tianming said, "It’s not that I’m defaulting, it’s that this show is unreliable! This show is trash, I won’t acknowledge this result!"
After saying that, Feng Tianming stood up and tried to sneak away.
But before he could even take two steps, Lin Fan grabbed him by the collar, lifting him up like a little chicken.
Lin Fan moved so fast, there was no time to react.
"Let go of me!" Feng Tianming instinctively screamed, but in front of Lin Fan, he couldn’t move an inch.
Of course, Lin Fan didn’t let him go, he dragged him back to the sofa and held him down.
"Young Master Feng, think carefully before answering, when do you plan to give me the 100 million in cash?" Lin Fan smiled calmly.
Feng Tianming snorted coldly, "Lin Fan, what are you going to do, if I don’t give it to you, what can you do, kill me?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m not going to do anything to you, killing you would be pointless, I wouldn’t get the money and I’d go to jail, I just hope you can bring the money soon."
Feng Tianming said, "Don’t even think about it, I’m not giving you any money!"
Lin Fan said, "No worries, you don’t give it, I’m not in a rush, this money you’ll have to give sooner or later. If you don’t, then we’ll all have to go to court. But in that case, it won’t be just 100 million that Young Master Feng would have to pay, there’ll be compensation too."
Feng Tianming started to sweat profusely.
Lin Fan said, "Young Master Feng, you don’t really think you can just not pay, do you? I don’t mind letting this matter go public, I’ll take my time dealing with you. Eventually, you’ll not only have to cough up the money, you’ll also tarnish the Feng Family’s reputation, you might want to ask your dad if he’d agree to that?"
Hearing Lin Fan mention Feng Wanshan, Feng Tianming was truly scared.
If Lin Fan really publicizes this matter, Feng Tianming’s dishonor and unwillingness to lose gracefully will indeed damage the Feng Family’s reputation. For these big families, reputation is priceless.
"Lin Fan, honestly, I can’t come up with 100 million in cash, how about this, you take a little less," Feng Tianming said with an embarrassed smile.
Lin Fan shook his head, "No way."
The tone was resolute, leaving no room for negotiation.
Feng Tianming was almost in tears, "Can’t you even negotiate a little? To be honest, I can give you 10 million, that’s all my savings, I can’t give you more."
Lin Fan said, "Want to hear my suggestion?"
Feng Tianming nodded, he was almost overwhelmed with worry, losing so much money to Lin Fan, he didn’t know how to solve it.
Lin Fan said, "My suggestion is simple, go ask your dad."
Feng Tianming’s face changed, "No way, no way, if father knows I lost 100 million to you in a bet, he’d be furious."
He definitely didn’t want to see his father’s angry face, that’s 100 million, even for Shengshi Group, that’s no small amount.
Lin Fan said, "That’s between you guys then, you’d better be able to convince your father, or else we’ll have to go the legal route."
Feng Tianming wiped his cold sweat, "Alright, I’ll go back and try."
Lin Fan said, "I’ll give you three days, within three days, give me the money, you can go now."
Feng Tianming got up and was about to leave.
Lin Fan said, "Young Master Feng, you now know, even after doing so much wrong, it’s all in vain. You slander Xiaoyue, thinking you could take her down, but these obstacles couldn’t stop her rise. On the contrary, I didn’t have to use dirty tricks to beat you."
Feng Tianming’s face turned red, rendered speechless.
Lin Fan’s words really hit him hard, he schemed in vain, but in the end, he still failed, Ning Xiaoyue still debuted as third, everything he did was in vain.
Conversely, Lin Fan didn’t use any dirt to attack his person, and yet his person still lost.
This only shows his person really wasn’t as good as Ning Xiaoyue.
Feng Tianming regretted, if he had known how awesome Ning Xiaoyue was, he would never have withdrawn his investment from Wenyue Company.
Originally, he had promised to invest in Wenyue Company, but midway through he fancied another more promising girl group, so he decisively withdrew investment, almost causing Wang Xiangqian to jump off a building.
As a result, because of his withdrawal, he missed out on Ning Xiaoyue, and now Ning Xiaoyue belongs to Lin Fan, he regretted it but it was useless.
The bet had already taken effect, he had to come up with this 100 million.
Feng Tianming himself couldn’t come up with that amount of money, he could only turn to his father Feng Wanshan.
That night.
Feng Family.
Feng Wanshan, who was about to go to bed, heard about this matter from Feng Tianming, having lost a bet and needing to compensate Lin Fan with 100 million cash!
"What the hell are you saying?"
Feng Wanshan instantly flew into a rage.

chapters.title: Chapter 468: The Bane of the Feng Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: Chapter 468: The Bane of the Feng Family
Late that night, Feng Tianming left Wenyue Company dejectedly and returned home.
Feng Wanshan was about to go to bed; he had to return to the company for a meeting early the next morning.
Seeing Feng Tianming come in from outside, Feng Wanshan frowned, "Tianming, where are you coming from? You’re not young anymore, don’t run around all the time, it’s time for you to help me share some of the family affairs."
Feng Tianming felt quite uneasy and said, "Father, I wasn’t fooling around, I was dealing with company matters."
Feng Wanshan made a sound of acknowledgment, "The company you started?"
Feng Tianming said, "Yes, Father, you initially gave me 50 million and told me to learn how to start a business on my own, so I opened an entertainment company."
Feng Wanshan said, "You young people just love to avoid real work, what’s the use of an entertainment company, better to do something in industry, practical work prospers the nation! But since you mentioned it, tell me, how is it going?"
Feng Tianming smiled awkwardly, "It was going well initially, I had my eye on a girl group and sent them to participate in a program, thinking they could debut, but who knew..."
Clearly, it’s bad news, Feng Wanshan said, "Did you encounter some difficulties? It’s okay, just say it, this 50 million was for you to practice with, it doesn’t matter if you lose it, accumulating business experience is what’s important."
With this reassurance, Feng Tianming finally felt at ease and said, "It’s all Lin Fan’s fault..."
Feng Wanshan frowned, "What’s it got to do with Lin Fan?"
Damn it!
Why is it related to Lin Fan again! Feng Wanshan suffered quite a few setbacks at Lin Fan’s hands, could it be his son also stumbled because of Lin Fan?
Is Lin Fan the nemesis of the Feng Family!
Next, Feng Tianming recounted the bet he made with Lin Fan.
Upon hearing that Feng Tianming lost the bet and had to hand over 100 million yuan to Lin Fan, Feng Wanshan jumped up in fury, furious as a storm.
"What, you lost 100 million in cash!"
Feng Tianming was so frightened he knelt down with a thud, "I’m sorry, Father, I was overconfident, I didn’t expect my people to lose to a nobody! So I rashly bet with Lin Fan, now that scoundrel Lin Fan is pressing me for the debt, and I really have no money..."
Feng Wanshan looked grim, "So you came back to ask me for money!"
Feng Tianming hurriedly kowtowed, "Father, you have to help me, I have no money, I originally wanted to evade paying, but that scoundrel Lin Fan threatened to take legal action, to blow things up, damaging our Feng Family’s reputation. Father, tell me, what should I do?"
Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth, "Oh you, Lin Fan, you truly are despicable!"
Feng Tianming tentatively said, "Father, is there any way we don’t have to give Lin Fan this money? Please advise, Father!"
Feng Wanshan snorted coldly, "That rascal Lin Fan is very cunning, if we don’t give him the money, there’s no telling what he might do. Our Feng Family is going through a tumultuous period, we can’t afford any more trouble, I definitely won’t give Lin Fan another chance to get at us."
The current situation of the Feng Family is also caused by Lin Fan!
Earlier, a scandal involving Feng Wanshan broke out, causing the company’s stock price to plummet, Feng Wanshan suspected this was Lin Fan’s doing!
Moreover, in previous encounters with Lin Fan, he lost multiple times.
This time, Feng Tianming lost the bet, was at fault, and if they really reneged on the payment, it would hand Lin Fan an opportunity, and there’s no telling what Lin Fan might do!
In such a disadvantaged match, Feng Wanshan didn’t dare directly oppose Lin Fan either.
Feng Tianming said, "Father, you mean..."
Feng Wanshan said, "I’ll help you pay this money!"
Feng Tianming was overjoyed, "Thank you, Father!"
Feng Wanshan snorted, "But I won’t let Lin Fan off just like that, we have to find a way to deal with Lin Fan after this, he’s taken one billion from us, I want him to give it back several times over!"
Feng Tianming was elated, "Father, can it really be done?"
Feng Wanshan said, "I’ll tell you the specific plan another day, it’s getting late, go to bed now."
Feng Tianming then left with peace of mind.
Watching the back of Feng Tianming, Feng Wanshan cursed, "What a useless fool, made me lose a billion for nothing! Humph! Lin Fan, just you wait!"
It’s infuriating, time and again, falling into Lin Fan’s trap!
This time, he must come up with a flawless plan, to give Lin Fan a lesson he’ll never forget!
The next day.
Feng Wanshan gave Feng Tianming one billion in cash.
Feng Tianming then took this one billion in cash to Wenyue Company.
At this time, Wenyue Company was in a festive mood.
Ning Xiaoyue successfully debuted, and she had finally left the program group and returned to the company, where the company held a celebration party for her.
Lin Fan also attended the party.
Wang Xiangqian had already returned early, last night he witnessed Ning Xiaoyue’s debut on site, and he cried like a tearful mess, very emotional.
Even now, Wang Xiangqian was in high spirits. His little struggling company produced a third-place debut girl group member, it was like striking gold.
Upon seeing Lin Fan, Wang Xiangqian started thanking him, if Lin Fan hadn’t intervened, he would have nearly knelt before Lin Fan.
"Brother Fan, back then our company was on the verge of bankruptcy, Xiaoyue almost couldn’t participate in the competition, all thanks to Brother Fan investing and saving us, only then do we have today, only then did Xiaoyue debut, Brother Fan, you are our great benefactor!" Wang Xiangqian said emotionally.
Lin Fan smiled, "No need for those sappy words, back then you were practically courting death, that’s why I invested in you, at least Xiaoyue didn’t disappoint me."
Hearing this, everyone laughed.
Wang Xiangqian said, "Xiaoyue will be back soon, but she can’t stay long, she’s now a girl group member, she has to attend events soon, her schedule is packed."
A van stopped downstairs at the company, Ning Xiaoyue got out of the car, accompanied by a woman who seemed to be her female assistant.
This female assistant wasn’t from Wenyue Company, but from an agency belonging to the program group, responsible for the girl group’s operations.
The girl group formed by the program only had two years, and will disband after that, only then can the members return to their original companies.
During the group period, the members are managed by this agency and need to follow the arrangements made by this agency.
"Xiaoyue is back, everyone, please welcome her with applause!" Wang Xiangqian started clapping first.
Thunderous applause erupted.
Ning Xiaoyue felt quite embarrassed, her cheeks turning red.
She searched around with her eyes, found Lin Fan, and felt joy, but with everyone around, she couldn’t go over.
Finally, she met Brother Lin!
After receiving everyone’s congratulations with difficulty, Ning Xiaoyue finally had the chance to move closer to Lin Fan.
"Xiaoyue, congratulations on your debut, it’s been a tough few months." Lin Fan smiled.
Ning Xiaoyue said, "Thank you, Brother Lin, these three months had so much going on, I knew all about the online voices, I was on the verge of collapse, it was your encouragement that helped me through, so really, thank you a lot, Brother Lin."

chapters.title: Chapter 469: Betting Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 469: Betting Again
Ning Xiaoyue wasn’t confident. She knew her skills were lacking, and she hadn’t even considered that she might debut. Her best estimate for herself was to be eliminated in the first round.
Participation is key. If it doesn’t work out, just leave.
She herself hadn’t expected that after the show aired, she would attract so much attention, gaining many fans who liked her enough to vote for her. Even though online criticism was overwhelming, they still steadfastly supported her debut.
She remembered Lin Fan’s words: As long as you stay true to yourself, people will like you.
Indeed, Lin Fan was right.
Facing online abuse, she once thought of giving up, but she didn’t want to let down her fans, nor Lin Fan.
Lin Fan brought out funds to keep the company afloat in its hour of need; she couldn’t give up. Moreover, she knew about Lin Fan and Feng Tianming’s bet. If she lost, Lin Fan would have to pay a price of 100 million.
So she gritted her teeth and persevered, finally achieving victory.
Lin Fan said, "Hope you continue to stay true to yourself in the future. The entertainment industry is quite dangerous, but if you stay authentic, you’ll stabilize your position and ride the waves."
Ning Xiaoyue listened intently to Lin Fan and said, "Brother Lin, I’ll always remember your words."
At this moment, a female assistant came over and said, "Xiaoyue, it’s time for us to go."
Ning Xiaoyue replied, "Hmm."
The time together was too short. She was reluctant to leave Lin Fan. Perhaps she would be busier in the future, and the time she could spend with Lin Fan would be even less.
"Brother Lin, I really hope I could spend more time with you," Ning Xiaoyue said regretfully.
Lin Fan replied, "Work is important, go on, work hard. I’m waiting for the day you become a big star. If you encounter any difficulties, reach out to me anytime."
Ning Xiaoyue smiled and said, "Hmm, I know. Brother Lin is my strongest support."
She knew, she was well aware.
Someone online had spread rumors about her, but it was Lin Fan who helped quell them.
The Yun City Daily smeared her and later went out of business. Besides Lin Fan, who else could have made that happen!
Ning Xiaoyue then followed the female assistant, preparing to leave.
Just then, Feng Tianming walked in and bumped into Ning Xiaoyue directly.
Feng Tianming was unhappy. If it weren’t for Ning Xiaoyue, he wouldn’t have lost 100 million to Lin Fan, and his candidates wouldn’t have been stuck at the tenth place, unable to debut!
He blamed all of this on Ning Xiaoyue.
"It’s unpleasant to see you here, useless as you are!" Feng Tianming chuckled.
Ning Xiaoyue was a bit angry, being called useless to her face wasn’t something a normal person would take well.
However, Ning Xiaoyue didn’t want to speak to Feng Tianming and attempted to bypass him to leave.
But Feng Tianming sidestepped to block her, "Little bitch, don’t think you’re out of trouble just because you’ve debuted. You’ll suffer later. Didn’t you see all the hate online? If you had self-awareness, you’d quit the group quickly, or else..."
This was a threat!
Ning Xiaoyue felt a bit scared.
"Young Master Feng, did you eat crap today? Your mouth smells awful!"
Lin Fan chuckled.
Feng Tianming sneered, "Am I not speaking the truth? I guarantee this useless girl won’t stay popular for more than two months. Lin Fan, talking about helping her rise socially, she’s just a hopeless case wasting your efforts!"
Lin Fan ignored him and said to Ning Xiaoyue, "Xiaoyue, don’t listen to him. Just treat it like a dog’s barking and go ahead."
Ning Xiaoyue responded with an "Hmm" and left with the female assistant. For one, she was indeed in a hurry, and secondly, she didn’t want to see Feng Tianming anymore.
After Ning Xiaoyue left.
Lin Fan turned to Feng Tianming, "Young Master Feng, you said that Xiaoyue won’t stay popular for two months. Want to bet with me again? Still the same 100 million, if she remains popular after two months, you owe me 100 million, how about that?"
"..." Feng Tianming was speechless.
He just lost 100 million to Lin Fan and dared not bet again. What if he lost another 100 million!
"Hmph, I’m not interested in such boring bets!" Feng Tianming said, trying to save face.
Lin Fan laughed, "Young Master Feng, you’re really a coward. Not daring to bet with me only proves you don’t have confidence, not even in your own words."
Feng Tianming was furious. He nearly bet with Lin Fan again.
But thinking of his recent loss of 100 million, if he lost again, his father might not even save him.
Feng Tianming said, "Who said I don’t dare to bet, but let’s forget about betting 100 million!"
Lin Fan asked, "Then what do you want to bet?"
Feng Tianming replied, "I haven’t figured it out yet."
Lin Fan said, "I do have an idea. If Xiaoyue is still popular after two months, you kneel down and call me dad. How about it? Although you’re quite a dull son, I don’t mind being your dad once and teaching you how to behave!"
Feng Tianming was incredibly angry. Lin Fan really wanted to take advantage of him!
"Fine, it’s not about money, agreed. Lin Fan, if Ning Xiaoyue loses popularity after two months, you’ll kneel and call me dad."
Just then, a notification came through. Lin Fan glanced at his phone and said, "Sorry, didn’t hear clearly. What was it again?"
Feng Tianming replied, "Dad!"
Lin Fan laughed, "You needn’t admit defeat so quickly, silly son."
Everyone burst into laughter. Lin Fan was toying with Feng Tianming, truly taking advantage, as Feng Tianming’s dumb wits were no match for Mr. Lin.
Feng Tianming then realized he’d fallen into Lin Fan’s trap, cursing under his breath.
"Lin Fan, don’t get too complacent. It’s uncertain who’ll call whom dad in the end. Are you sure you can beat me!" Feng Tianming said.
Lin Fan replied, "Then don’t waste time. Why did you come today? If you plan to continue playing tricks, you’re in the wrong place, as I’ve prepared a lawyer letter for you to take home."
Feng Tianming spat, "Would I, Feng Tianming, play tricks? Look at what this is!"
Feng Tianming threw a check at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took it, a 100 million cash check!
Lin Fan smiled, "Thanks a lot, Young Master Feng. You were planning to renege last night. Fortunately, Feng Wanshan isn’t senile."
Feng Tianming must have gone back to find Feng Wanshan last night. This money naturally came from Feng Wanshan, as Feng Tianming didn’t have that much money.
Feng Wanshan’s willingness to pay speaks volumes about his unwillingness to toy with Lin Fan.
This time, Feng Wanshan was so forthcoming, likely feeling he stood no chance.
However, given Feng Wanshan’s nature, he won’t leave it at this. Who knows what means he’ll use to retaliate later.
Lin Fan sneered internally. Whatever tricks Feng Wanshan has, let him try them. Luckily, I’ve prepared a grand gift for him.
Feng Tianming said, "It’s our Feng Family’s fine tradition to accept the consequences. Lin Fan, now that you’ve got the money, stop trying to smear our reputation."
Lin Fan said, "I think Young Master Feng has said enough. You’re not very welcome here, so leave. Let me escort you out."
As he spoke, Lin Fan strode forward and lifted Feng Tianming, tossing him towards the door.
Feng Tianming fell down messily.
"Lin Fan, you’d better wait for me!"
Feng Tianming was livid but dared not rush over to fight Lin Fan, knowing he wasn’t Lin Fan’s match, thus only venting his anger.
"Let me tell you, Lin Fan, you’ll soon pay the price. Our Feng Family will make you pay!"
Feng Tianming, in a fit of anger, divulged his father’s plan to retaliate against Lin Fan.
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," confirming his suspicion that the Feng Family would retaliate.
Ring Ring... Ring Ring...
Just then, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
Lin Fan looked; it was Officer Loli calling. No need to ask; Loli had been helping him solve An Jincheng’s case.
This case likely involved Feng Wanshan!

chapters.title: Chapter 470: Anna’s Return
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 470: Anna’s Return
Shengshi Group.
In the chairman’s office, Feng Wanshan sat in the chair, furrowing his brows, lost in thought.
Last night, his son Feng Tianming returned and told him about the wager, he actually lost 100 million in cash to Lin Fan!
To preserve the reputation of the Feng Family, Feng Wanshan had to shell out this money. It pained him greatly; it was 100 million, 100 million in cash, just handed over to Lin Fan, his most hated enemy!
Could he accept it!
He must take revenge on Lin Fan, or else it’s hard to swallow this anger.
At this moment, he already roughly had a plan in his mind; this time, he wants Lin Fan to pay a bloody price, and the 100 million lost to Lin Fan, he wants to get back double from him!
A knock at the door interrupted his thoughts.
Feng Wanshan’s mind was brought back.
"Come in." Feng Wanshan adjusted his sitting posture, sitting upright seriously, displaying the authority of a group president.
The door pushed open from outside, and a stunning black-haired straight beauty walked in.
Anna!
"Godfather, did you call for me?" Anna walked in, with a slight smile on her face. The usually aloof beauty rarely showed any smile.
Feng Wanshan said, "Sit."
Anna walked to the sofa opposite the desk and sat down.
Feng Wanshan sized up Anna, then calmly asked, "How’s it going, these few months, are you used to being at the subsidiary company?"
Anna replied softly, "It’s okay."
Originally, for the past three months, Anna had been staying at the subsidiary company. Feng Wanshan sent her there under the pretext that it needed manpower.
Feng Wanshan had a reason for doing so.
Initially, Feng Wanshan sent Anna undercover to Lin Fan’s side, trying to uncover the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin’s identity. Later, Anna succeeded in identifying Mr. Lin.
Since there was external suspicion that Lin Fan was a son of the Kyoto Lin Family, making Lin Fan’s identity shrouded in mystery, thus keeping Mortal Group’s stock prices high.
According to the information Anna obtained, Lin Fan was not a son of the Kyoto Lin Family, but a rural person, previously working as a delivery man.
Lin Fan suddenly became rich because he inherited billions from his uncle Lin Beixuan. This Lin Beixuan was the rumored mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin.
Since Lin Beixuan had cancer, he left his fortune to Lin Fan. Lin Fan, a poor man suddenly rich, spent lavishly on investments until the capital chain broke.
After grasping this information, Feng Wanshan was thrilled and immediately leaked the information, attempting to hit Mortal Group’s stock prices.
Unexpectedly, Mortal Group swiftly refuted the rumor, and rather than falling, its stock price rose.
Feng Wanshan realized then that he had been played by Lin Fan. The information Anna brought was completely false—Lin Fan intentionally deceived Anna with false information.
Because he trusted Anna, Feng Wanshan fell into the trap, instead becoming a tool for Lin Fan’s speculation.
At that time, Feng Wanshan was furious.
The worst was yet to come; soon Feng Wanshan was hit with a scandal. His mistress had committed suicide at Shengshi Group’s property, causing the group’s stock price to evaporate by 30 billion in one day.
Shengshi Group, originally a trillion-yuan group, fell out of the trillion-club.
Feng Wanshan vomited blood and fell unconscious on the spot.
Later, Feng Wanshan thought over the whole incident and began to suspect Anna.
Although Anna claimed she too was tricked by Lin Fan, bringing back false information, there was also the possibility that Anna did it intentionally, that she was already on Lin Fan’s side!
Moreover, his scandal suddenly broke out, which was certainly Lin Fan’s arrangement; how could Lin Fan know about this scandal? The biggest possibility was that Anna told him!
However, Feng Wanshan had no evidence of this. Anna was, after all, his adopted daughter. After years together, he couldn’t believe Anna would betray him.
He couldn’t think of any reason for Anna to betray him.
Yet once suspicion arose, Feng Wanshan couldn’t keep Anna by his side and found an excuse to send her to the subsidiary company to observe for a while.
Feng Wanshan planted a spy beside Anna to keep an eye on her actions.
Over the past three months, everything seemed normal with Anna, and the spy didn’t find anything unusual.
Only then did Feng Wanshan relax a bit about her, perhaps he really misunderstood Anna.
His kindness to Anna was immense. When Anna’s father An Jincheng went missing, Anna was just a little girl; Feng Wanshan adopted her and cared for her as his own daughter. Anna had barely spent a month by Lin Fan’s side; it would be really unreasonable if she had sided with Lin Fan.
The more he thought about it, the more reasonable it seemed. After three months, Feng Wanshan finally dispelled the suspicion of Anna.
"You’ve done well at the subsidiary company; it’s now on track. I’m planning to have you come back to help me here. What do you think?" Feng Wanshan chuckled.
Anna replied, "I’m at your command, Godfather."
Anna laughed coldly to herself; finally, after three months, Feng Wanshan seemed to have relaxed his vigilance.
She knew perfectly well that Feng Wanshan sent her to the subsidiary company mostly because he suspected her. Feng Wanshan is just that kind of person—if he suspects someone, he won’t use them, only trusting those close to him.
This old scoundrel is really something; he didn’t even trust his adopted daughter. In the past, she was utterly dedicated to helping him, yet he still easily suspected her and sent her to the subsidiary company.
Where was even half the sentiment of a godfather here? Anna believed if necessary, Feng Wanshan wouldn’t hesitate to sacrifice her.
However, Feng Wanshan probably never dreamed his suspicion was actually right.
Anna had indeed betrayed him.
