Anna deliberately brought back false information, and she informed Lin Fan of his scandal.
The reason is simple: Feng Wanshan deceived her regarding her father’s affair!
All these years, Feng Wanshan had pretended to actively help investigate, but in reality, he never looked for An Jincheng, continually deceiving Anna.
If Lin Fan hadn’t told Anna the truth, she might have lived in ignorance her whole life!
It was conceivable how angry Anna was.
She had agreed with Lin Fan that she would return to Feng Wanshan’s side and cooperate with Lin Fan from the inside until An Jincheng’s whereabouts were found.
But for these three months, due to Feng Wanshan’s suspicion, she was sent away to the subsidiary company, delaying the investigation. There were also no updates from Lin Fan during this time.
Anna had waited for this day for a full three months; finally, Feng Wanshan dispelled his suspicion of her and called her back.
This meant the suspended investigation could continue.
"Anna, since my scandal broke out, it has dealt a great blow to the company. Who do you think did it?" Feng Wanshan abruptly asked.
Anna replied calmly, "I don’t know, but I know who Godfather suspects."
Feng Wanshan said, "Lin Fan?"
Anna nodded, "Back then I plotted against Lin Fan, pressed him for information, and he also found out I was your undercover beside him. He definitely did this to retaliate against you."
Feng Wanshan snorted coldly, "I’m sure it was him. But I still can’t figure out how he could know about my scandal?"
Feng Wanshan looked at Anna with a meaningful gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 471: Is the Policewoman in Love?
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 471: Is the Policewoman in Love?
Anna shook her head and said, "I don’t know about that. I have to admit, this Lin Fan does have some skills. He might have found out through some channel."
Anna’s expression remained unchanged. Feng Wanshan wanted to catch her lying from her face, but it wasn’t that easy.
Feng Wanshan laughed and, in a joking tone, said, "I hope you don’t get mad if I say this. I even suspected that you were the one who told him."
Anna showed a surprised expression, "Godfather, you must be joking, right? I’m the undercover you sent to Lin Fan’s side. How could I possibly tell him about this kind of thing?"
Feng Wanshan carefully observed Anna’s reaction and found nothing unusual.
Then he burst into laughter, "I was only kidding. I know your character very well. How could I doubt you?"
Anna sneered inside, thinking how come he wouldn’t suspect me when he banished me to a branch company for three months, this old fox!
"Thank you for your trust, godfather. You’ve been as kind as a father to me, and I respect you like my own father. It’s my duty to work for you. Last time, I was deceived by that Lin Fan and brought back false information, causing your plan to fail. It was my fault. I know you were angry with me for that, that’s why you transferred me to the branch company. I have no complaints, it’s the punishment I deserve," Anna said sincerely.
Feng Wanshan thought to himself, "So she thinks I sent her to the branch company because I was mad at her, haha, this girl appears to be a bit simple-minded, she didn’t realize I actually doubted her."
Feng Wanshan smiled, "I was indeed mad at you, but it’s all in the past, no need to mention it anymore. Now that you’re back by my side, I hope you can help me like before."
Anna replied solemnly, "Of course, if there’s anything you need, just let me know. This time I won’t disappoint you!"
Feng Wanshan said, "I want you to team up with me against Lin Fan!"
Anna’s heart skipped a beat. Feng Wanshan still wanted to go after Lin Fan?
Anna said, "Godfather, if you don’t mind me saying, last time Lin Fan played a trick on you, and the company still hasn’t recovered. Lin Fan isn’t easy to deal with, so why do you suddenly want to go after him again?"
Feng Wanshan gritted his teeth and said, "That’s something you don’t know..."
He told her about Feng Tianming.
Feng Tianming made a bet with Lin Fan and ended up losing to him, a full 1 billion in cash!
The old and new grievances, Feng Wanshan couldn’t swallow it anymore, he wanted to take action against Lin Fan again.
Anna said, "This Lin Fan is really infuriating. Perfect, he made a fool of me last time, I need to settle the score with him too. Godfather, tell me, what can I do for you?"
Feng Wanshan revealed a sly smile, "I want you to get close to Ning Xiaoyue..."
"Ning Xiaoyue? Who is Ning Xiaoyue?" Anna frowned.
Feng Wanshan actually wanted to target Ning Xiaoyue!
Feng Wanshan had learned that during Ning Xiaoyue’s participation in the talent show, Lin Fan had been supporting her from behind, going as far as shutting down the Yun City Daily because of an article smearing Ning Xiaoyue.
It shows that Ning Xiaoyue must be very important to Lin Fan.
As long as Ning Xiaoyue is in their hands, Lin Fan will have to comply!
Anna learned about Ning Xiaoyue from Feng Wanshan and did not hesitate.
"Alright, rest assured godfather, I won’t let you down. This time, consider it making up for my mistakes," Anna said.
Afterwards, Anna took her leave.
After leaving the company.
Anna thought for a while, took out her phone, hesitated for a moment, then dialed Lin Fan’s number.
"It’s me," Anna said.
On the other end, Lin Fan’s cheerful voice came through, "Anna, it’s been a while."
He and Anna hadn’t been in contact for quite some time. Due to An Jincheng’s case, there had been no progress with Sister Loli’s side. Hearing that Anna had been sent to a branch company by Feng Wanshan, with the case at a standstill, there was no need for them to contact each other.
Anna said, "I’ve been called back by Feng Wanshan."
Lin Fan said, "Really, congratulations, he’s finally not suspicious of you anymore."
Anna said, "Yes, he wants me to work with him against you."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, what does he want to do?"
Anna said, "He wants me to get close to Ning Xiaoyue, and I agreed. Lin Fan, do you have anything to say?"
Lin Fan’s heart sank. He could guess that Feng Wanshan wouldn’t give up easily, especially with 1 billion in cash at stake, but he didn’t expect Feng Wanshan to plan to target Ning Xiaoyue!
This was infuriating.
Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t let Feng Wanshan succeed.
"Just follow his instructions, don’t let him doubt you again," Lin Fan said.
Anna said, "Alright. Lin Fan... about my father’s case, I haven’t asked you in the past three months. I want to know if there has been any progress?"
Lin Fan said, "Not yet."
An Nan couldn’t help but feel a bit disappointed. Lin Fan couldn’t find any information either!
They exchanged a few more words before hanging up.
On the other end of the line, Lin Fan was driving.
He was driving a Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
He planned to go meet Loli.
When he was at Wenyue Company, Lin Fan received a call from Loli. In the brief conversation, Lin Fan learned that there had been some progress in An Jincheng’s case.
An Jincheng’s old colleague, Zheng Yang, had been found!
Lin Fan immediately told Loli he wanted to meet with her.
At the agreed location, by the roadside, there was a police car parked. Loli, dressed in plain clothes, got out of the car.
The driver was Loli’s partner, Little Wang.
"Sister Loli, what case are we investigating that you need to come out in plain clothes?" Little Wang asked curiously.
Loli said, "You don’t need to worry about it, just drive the car away."
Having said that, Loli happily ran across the street and got into Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce.
Little Wang felt a bit down. So, she used me as a chauffeur, huh? Sister Loli isn’t going to investigate a case, she’s going on a date, and the guy drives a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, definitely a rich guy.
Could it be? Sister Loli is dating someone?
Who the heck is lucky enough to get Sister Loli!
This will surely make many guys at the police station cry, the police beauty doesn’t belong to them anymore.
Inside the Rolls-Royce, the passenger seat.
Loli got into the car and stared at Lin Fan, somewhat infatuated. Finally seeing her idol again, he was so handsome, always so handsome.
She was very happy her efforts hadn’t been in vain. Finally, there was a lead, giving her a legitimate reason to meet her idol.
"Buckle up, we’re about to set off," Lin Fan reminded.
Loli snapped out of her daze from staring at Lin Fan’s handsome face, replied with an "oh," and quickly fastened her seatbelt.
The last time they met was outside Yujing District. Loli didn’t know that Lin Fan was staying at the Wei Family as a son-in-law at that time. Loli had told Lin Fan there was progress in their investigation, she’d found Zheng Yang’s trail but hadn’t confirmed it yet.
Today, she finally confirmed Zheng Yang’s whereabouts, so she informed Lin Fan.
Next, they were going to find Zheng Yang.
"This Zheng Yang was really hard to find. It took over three months. He’s currently living incognito, working as a vendor in a small town. It was so hard for me to find him..."
Loli said.
Lin Fan was filled with anticipation. This Zheng Yang might be the key to solving An Jincheng’s disappearance case!

chapters.title: Chapter 472: Even Owing Hundreds of Millions is Not a Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 472: Even Owing Hundreds of Millions is Not a Problem
Sanxue Town, it’s a small town located in Jiangnan City, economically quite underdeveloped, and appears to be a rather rundown place.
The marketplace, however, is bustling with people coming and going; today is a market day, and villagers from ten miles around have come here. At a glance, most are older uncles and aunties.
On both sides of the street, there are numerous simple stalls selling vegetables, fruits, poultry, with sellers shouting loudly and buyers haggling, full of the breath of life.
There are also discordant noises.
At a corner of the street, a man in his fifties got into a conflict with someone; the man is a vendor selling fruits. Just arriving on a tricycle, he accidentally knocked over the cart of the adjacent vendor while parking, and they began to argue.
The other person seized the man, demanding that he compensate for a new cart.
"Look, you broke my cart handle, it can’t work anymore, you need to compensate me with a new cart!" yelled the other person.
The man argued, "It was my fault for crashing into your cart, I’m willing to help you repair it, but it’s impossible for me to buy you a new cart, you’re extorting me."
The two were arguing.
Suddenly, a very pleasant female voice came from beside, "Zheng Yang!"
Upon hearing it, the man shivered all over and instinctively turned his head to see a pair of young man and woman, the man was strikingly handsome, and the woman was inexplicably beautiful.
The man, however, looked as if he’d seen a ghost, immediately ran off.
The person who was arguing with him yelled angrily, "You still owe me a cart, don’t you dare run!"
But where did the man have time to care, as he ran faster and faster, turning into the crowd on the street.
The young couple exchanged a glance and immediately went after him.
These young people were naturally Lin Fan and Loli.
They came all the way to Sanxue Town to find this man, who was precisely a colleague of An Jincheng named Zheng Yang back then.
Almost every day at this time, Zheng Yang would come to sell fruits, and they managed to encounter Zheng Yang by timing their visit precisely.
But upon seeing them, Zheng Yang fled, making them both a bit surprised.
Speaking of Zheng Yang running away, under the cover of the crowd on the street, he entered a narrow alley, wandered in the complex alleys for a while, and felt nobody chasing him anymore, then heaved a sigh of relief.
"Luckily I moved fast, that was too close!" Zheng Yang patted his chest, fearful.
However, in the next second.
"Teacher Zheng, why are you running, we mean no harm."
Lin Fan spoke while emerging from the front, blocking Zheng Yang’s way.
It startled Zheng Yang greatly, he immediately turned to escape, but upon turning back, he saw Loli coming over. With both the front and back blocked, he couldn’t escape.
"Don’t come near, I don’t have money, I really have no money, no point forcing me!" Zheng Yang said in a panic.
Loli frowned and said, "Zheng Yang, you might have misunderstood something, we are not here to ask you for money."
Zheng Yang yelled, "Not? Don’t lie to me, I’m not called Zheng Yang here at all, if you know my real name, it can only be those people!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Teacher Zheng, calm down for a moment, we’re definitely not here for money, we’re not those people you’re talking about, we’re here because of someone."
Zheng Yang was momentarily taken aback and said, "You really aren’t those people? Then who are you?"
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan, she is Officer Luo."
Zheng Yang was stunned, sized up Loli, "You’re a police officer?"
Loli took out her credentials from her pocket, "My name is Loli, I’m an officer from the Yun City Police Department. We’re here to ask you to assist in investigating the case of An Jincheng’s disappearance."
"An Jincheng!"
Zheng Yang’s face changed, then he said, "What’s that got to do with me? I don’t know anything about it. Back then I gave a full statement, finding me is useless! Since you’re not here for debts, I’ll go back to selling fruits."
Zheng Yang intended to leave.
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zheng, hold on!"
Through his supreme insight, Lin Fan had discerned from Zheng Yang’s micro-expressions that he was just lying, this Zheng Yang definitely knows something!
"Teacher Zheng, we really need your help, An Jincheng disappeared 15 years ago under strange circumstances; her daughter has been searching for her for 15 years without any trace, it’s truly tragic. She simply wants to know her father’s whereabouts, you used to be a teacher, believe you can understand a child’s feeling." Lin Fan said.
He attempted to persuade Zheng Yang, his voice truly moving and tear-jerking.
But Zheng Yang was not moved, shaking his head, "I really know nothing, I haven’t been a teacher for many years now, I’m just a fruit vendor, I want to live my life quietly, please leave me alone!"
Loli glanced at Lin Fan, somewhat puzzled; she had worked hard to find this Zheng Yang, could Lin Fan have made a mistake, does this Zheng Yang really know nothing?
If that’s the case, they’re just busy for nothing.
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zheng, you want a peaceful life, probably not that easy, right? Just now we merely called your name, and you fled startled like a frightened bird, why is that?"
Zheng Yang felt offended, somewhat angry, "It’s none of your business! Officer Luo, I haven’t broken the law, have I, you can’t restrict my freedom, I’m leaving now."
Zheng Yang bypassed Loli, wanting to leave.
Loli indeed couldn’t do anything to Zheng Yang as a police officer since he hadn’t committed any crime and claimed ignorance about An Jincheng’s case, she couldn’t force him.
Seeing Zheng Yang about to leave.
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zheng, help us, and I’ll reward you. How much money do you owe, I’ll help you repay it."
Zheng Yang already intended to leave, hearing this, his steps abruptly halted, while he wanted to leave, Lin Fan’s words seemed magical, making it hard for him to move.
To be precise, the money made it hard for him to move.
"What did you say, you’ll pay my debt?" Zheng Yang turned back to look at Lin Fan, his voice somewhat trembling.
Lin Fan said, "Exactly."
Zheng Yang felt Lin Fan agreed too easily, somewhat disbelieving, "You’ll pay my debt, do you know how much I owe, speaking so boldly!"
Lin Fan said, "Tell me then?"
Loli laughed, "Zheng Yang, just speak freely, even if you owe billions, he can pay it off."
"What?" Zheng Yang looked at Lin Fan in surprise, paying off billions, is this young man so rich?
"Are you kidding!" Zheng Yang unconvincingly said.
Loli said, "I’m a police officer, I won’t deceive you, standing before you is the richest man in Yun City, if you don’t believe, come back to Yun City with me, he can prove it."
Zheng Yang was dumbfounded, the richest man in Yun City? This young man in front of him, actually Yun City’s richest man, is this possible?
Zheng Yang suddenly remembered something, exclaimed, "Could you be Mr. Lin?"

chapters.title: Chapter 473: Are You Out of Your Mind?
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 473: Are You Out of Your Mind?
Zheng Yang found it hard to believe. The richest man in Yun City had come to find him in person? This felt unreal. How could it be possible!
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zheng, you can be certain we’re not here to chase debts. Have you ever seen debt collectors talk so much rubbish with you? Besides chasing debts, think about it, is there anything worth deceiving you over? Please believe us, we really came to you for help and we’re sincere. If you believe us, cooperate with us, and your debt can be cleared. If you don’t believe, then we’ll have to leave it at that. You can continue living your life evading debts. We can’t force you; it’s all up to your own decision."
Zheng Yang was silent.
Have to admit, Lin Fan was quite reasonable. Zheng Yang’s rotten life, why would anyone bother deceiving him? Was it for his old age, or for not bathing?
If Lin Fan and Loli were pretending to be the richest man and a female police officer just to cheat him, it felt really unnecessary.
"I borrowed from high-interest lenders. I initially borrowed 300,000 from them. Now with interest piling up, it’s reached 5 million." Zheng Yang eventually revealed.
"What?" Loli frowned, a bit angry, "That’s outrageous! 300,000 turning into 5 million!"
But Lin Fan gave Loli a look and cheerfully said, "It’s just 5 million, no problem. I’ll help you repay it. Now you can answer our question."
Zheng Yang said, "Can’t discuss this here. Let’s go to my place."
Lin Fan said, "Alright."
Looks like Zheng Yang really knows something. But he seems quite cautious, not saying anything easily.
Zheng Yang indeed had his little schemes. Lin Fan orally agreeing to help repay his debt felt too insecure. He wanted to go back and sign an agreement with Lin Fan to feel at ease.
So the three of them left the alley and returned to the marketplace.
Zheng Yang found his tricycle. The stall owner he was disputing with was still waiting for him. Upon seeing Zheng Yang, immediately came over and grabbed his hand.
"You still owe me for my car. What were you running away from earlier?" The other party shouted.
Zheng Yang said, "I don’t have the time to argue with you now. I hit your car, agreed to pay for repair fees, yet you insist I buy you a new car. This is extortion, and I won’t agree! People should be reasonable!"
Even though Zheng Yang hadn’t been a teacher for many years, when he spoke intensely, it was still with the tone of an elementary school head teacher, like he was educating a child.
But the other party was relentless, insisting on him buying a new car.
Such unprincipled street folks are quite common. Lin Fan previously worked as a deliveryman and had often dealt with street folks, so he was too familiar.
"Uncle, how much for a new car?" Lin Fan chuckled.
The other party glanced at Lin Fan, wasn’t this the young man chasing Zheng Yang earlier? And the girl beside him too.
Not knowing their relationship with Zheng Yang, snorted and said, "I bought this car for 5000 bucks!"
To Lin Fan, that amount wasn’t even considered money. After all, he got 5 million cash daily just from system rewards.
Though it’s not about the amount, Lin Fan said, "Let me check it out. Is it this one?"
Lin Fan walked over to take a look at the car. Having delivered take-out on an electric scooter before, he was quite knowledgeable.
"The front’s been hit, the wheel’s damaged, a repair and new wheel should do it, won’t exceed 200 bucks. I’ll give you 500, how about that?" Lin Fan said.
turns into 500!
The other party couldn’t accept it, immediately his face changed: "Kid, are you joking? It’s none of your business, stop meddling! Get lost!"
Lin Fan shook his head: "Officer sister, this uncle seems unwilling to be reasonable. Why don’t you talk to him?"
Loli then showed her badge, sternly said: "Uncle, your actions count as extortion, do you understand? If you continue to make trouble, I can take you to the police station to reflect for a few days."
Startled, the other party was shocked, never expected that this beauty was actually a police officer!
He became scared, grinned sheepishly: "I’m sorry, police officer, it’s my fault. I was just too distressed over my car. How about this, I’ll accept the young man’s suggestion earlier, just 500 for repair costs."
He looked at Lin Fan, planning to receive 500 from him.
Lin Fan chuckled: "Weren’t you refusing earlier? Sorry, the 500’s gone now. Repair fees should be as they are. There’s a repair shop across; hang on."
Lin Fan ran across the street and quickly brought over the repair shop master.
Upon inspection, repair needed only 180, close to Lin Fan’s estimation of 200.
Eventually, Zheng Yang paid 180 to the other party, resolving the matter.
The other party regretted deeply. If he knew earlier, he would’ve accepted Lin Fan’s offer, pocketing over 300. Now he earned nothing.
Lin Fan smiled: "Uncle, don’t be too greedy. We’re all out here trying to make a living. It’s hard for everyone. Shouldn’t hurt each other but empathize with each other." Lin Fan smiled.
The other party’s face flushed with shame, unable to say anything.
Soon, Lin Fan and Loli got onto Zheng Yang’s tricycle and left the marketplace.
Zheng Yang lived in a village near the town, renting an old small building.
After parking the tricycle by the small building and getting off, suddenly, four big men jumped out from hidden places nearby, immediately enclosing Zheng Yang from all sides.
"Zheng Yang, where can you run this time? It’s time to repay the money you owe us!"
One of the men shouted.
Zheng Yang was terrified, turning pale.
These four people were debt collectors!
Zheng Yang instinctively backed up a bit, said: "I don’t have money. I borrowed just 300,000 from you, now you’re asking for 5 million, where would I have so much money!"
The big man chuckled: "Who said it’s 5 million? 5 million was from a month ago, it’s 6 million now!"
"What?" Zheng Yang was shocked, dammit, these high-interest loans were deadly, already 6 million, a twenty-fold increase over 30,000!
The man yelled: "Enough talk, pay up quick, or we’ll break your legs!"
"Boss, don’t waste words, just beat him up first, see if he behaves!"
"Beat him up, it’s been a long time since I hit anyone!"
The other three men started stirring up.
The big man said: "Did you hear that? Pay quickly, avoid physical suffering!"
As he spoke, the man raised his fist, ready to hit Zheng Yang.
Seeing the fist about to land on Zheng Yang’s face, this punch might cost Zheng Yang half his life.
"Teacher Zheng has no money to repay. If you break Zheng Yang’s legs, he won’t be able to work, making it even less likely he’ll repay. Are you guys brain-dead?"
Lin Fan smiled at this moment.
The four big men were startled, only now noticing Lin Fan and Loli were on the tricycle.
"Kid, dare to insult us, wish to die!" The big man realized, face darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: It Turns Out the One to Fear Is the Other Side
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 474: It Turns Out the One to Fear Is the Other Side
"I’m just speaking the truth, you can’t get the money from him, even if you beat him to death it’s useless," Lin Fan said.
The big man snorted, "If he can’t pay back the money, he deserves to die! Kid, what’s your relationship with him, I suggest you don’t meddle!"
Lin Fan said, "I actually have to get involved in this. I promised this uncle I would help him repay the debt. His debt is my debt."
The big man let out an ’oh’, "You’re helping him repay the debt? Is what he said true?"
The big man looked at Zheng Yang.
Zheng Yang nodded, "Yes, that’s right."
Lin Fan said, "If you want the money, come after me, can you let him go first?"
The big man said, "Bring me six million, and I’ll let him go, kid. Is it cash or transfer? You choose one."
Lin Fan said, "Six million is nothing. I can give it to you anytime, but I heard from the uncle, he only borrowed three hundred thousand from you, now you want six million back, isn’t that unreasonable?"
The big man said, "How is it unreasonable? When he borrowed the money, we told him to repay on time. If he could repay on time, it would only be five hundred thousand, but if he delayed, there would be penalty interest. He delayed thus we charge the penalty. Six million, we are not asking him for even a penny more!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "No, charging interest on loans is normal, but your interest is too high, it’s clearly a loan shark. Loan sharking is illegal, and on top of that, you use violent collection methods, which makes it even worse."
The big man angrily said, "Kid, are you going to help him repay the debt or not? If not, stop spouting nonsense here and hindering our business!"
Lin Fan said, "I promised the uncle to help him repay the debt, so of course it will be repaid. But I won’t foot the bill for a loan shark. Until a reasonable repayment amount is calculated, I won’t give you money."
The big man said, "Then there’s nothing we can do, we can only break his legs!"
Lin Fan said, "I’ve taken over his debt, breaking his legs would be useless, you can come after me instead."
The big man snorted, "Kid, you’re quite arrogant, you think we won’t beat you up!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Come and hit me, what should I do? I’m a little scared."
Lin Fan was being sarcastic.
The big man thought he was really scared and chuckled, "Kid, there are four of us, we can maim you anytime. I have an idea, let us have some fun with this chick beside you, I’ll plead with our boss to lower your interest a bit, how does that sound?"
The big man looked at Loli, his eyes revealing a sinister light, this girl was just too alluring.
The others immediately started laughing too, greedily eyeing Loli.
Loli frowned, these thugs were already bad enough with their debt collection, but now they had the nerve to target her!
Lin Fan said, "What if I don’t agree?"
The big man said, "It’s not up to you, I’ve already decided. If this chick gives us some fun, I can help you save tens of thousands, isn’t that a good deal? You two, take the chick inside!"
Then two big men, with evil grins, started advancing towards the tricycle.
Lin Fan sat there, unmoving.
These two big men weren’t enough for him to make a move.
Then Loli jumped out of the tricycle, not only did she not dodge, but she went straight towards the two big men.
Seeing this, the big man laughed loudly, "This chick is sensible, is she coming to throw herself into our arms? In that case, we won’t be polite..."
Before he could finish speaking.
Loli suddenly kicked, landing a blow on one of the big men, making him stagger back a few steps, almost losing his balance.
The leading big man then realized he had misunderstood, Loli wasn’t going to throw herself into their arms, she actually came to fight!
"Turns out she’s a fierce girl, I like it! Get her!" the leading big man ordered.
The two big men pounced on Loli, two men versus one woman, logically, Loli shouldn’t stand a chance.
The big men thought so too, they didn’t take Loli seriously at all, thinking they could subdue her easily.
But they quickly found they were wrong.
Loli had clearly learned fighting skills and was well-trained. After some punches and kicks, the two big men were taken down by Loli and couldn’t get up for a while.
The big men were dumbfounded, this chick was actually so formidable!
Apart from the leading big man, another big man immediately wanted to rush up, but was stopped by the leading big man.
"I’ll take on this chick!" The leading big man said, forcing towards Loli.
"Chick, you’re pretty good with your hands, no wonder you’re daring to take us on, but unfortunately, you’re no match for me," the leading big man chuckled.
The two then began fighting.
This leading big man was indeed quite formidable, coupled with his brute strength, after several exchanges, Loli was forced to keep retreating, retreating to the side of the tricycle, with nowhere left to go.
The leading big man sneered, "Haven’t come across such a feisty girl in a long time, and you’re pretty damn good-looking, just surrender to me obediently!"
He reached out to grab Loli.
Seeing this, Lin Fan flipped off the tricycle, standing in front of Loli, Loli wasn’t a match for the big man, he had to intervene.
"Kid, you looking for death, get out of the way!"
The leading big man was already impatient, determined to get Loli, Lin Fan’s sudden intervention made him want to swat Lin Fan away.
He didn’t take Lin Fan seriously at all.
The other big men thought the same, even Loli wasn’t a match, how could Lin Fan be? Because Lin Fan didn’t look the least bit formidable.
However...
The next second.
Lin Fan had already kicked the leading big man in the abdomen.
"Ah!"
The leading big man let out a tragic scream, his eyeballs almost popping out, he plopped down on his knees, his body curling up like a shrimp, clutching his abdomen, breaking out in cold sweat from the pain.
Everyone was stunned, Lin Fan was incredible, he had kicked the big man down with just one kick!
Zheng Yang was completely dumbfounded, no wonder Lin Fan wasn’t afraid of these big men at all, it turned out the ones who should be afraid were these four big men.
Lin Fan stepped forward, placing his foot on the leading big man’s head, pressing his head into the ground.
The big man had no power to resist, it felt like a mountain was pressing down, how could one human resist the weight of a mountain!
The big man almost wet himself, finally realizing he had kicked a steel plate, he had run into an unbeatable master.
"Spare me, spare me!" The big man was frightened and immediately begged for mercy.
Lin Fan smiled, "How does it feel, my kick satisfying enough? Want me to add more?"
Lin Fan glanced at the only remaining big man nearby.
This big man shivered in fright, his knees went weak, and he knelt down voluntarily. Lin Fan was too powerful. He had seen with his own eyes their strongest leading big man being taken down by Lin Fan in an instant, how could he not kneel!
The leading big man didn’t dare say it was unsatisfying, his head was pinned to the ground by Lin Fan. If Lin Fan added more force, he was afraid his head would explode directly. Exploding a person’s head was beyond imagination, but in his mind, somehow it seemed possible!
The leading big man was so scared he wet himself, crying, "Satisfying, it was, please spare me!"
Lin Fan said, "Go back and tell your boss, I will repay the uncle’s debt, but it can’t be extortionate interest. If he doesn’t agree, he can come find me himself. Now get lost!"

chapters.title: Chapter 475: Important Clue
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 475: Important Clue
Lin Fan stepped on the leader’s head, pressing it into the ground. The man was so scared he wet himself, utterly humiliated.
It was embarrassing, but what could he do? Lin Fan was just too powerful. He didn’t even have a chance to defend himself, and one wrong move could cost him his life at any moment.
"Go back and tell your boss that I will pay the money, but it can’t be a high-interest loan. If he doesn’t agree, he can come to me himself. If he doesn’t, I’ll come to find you. I know where you are. Now get out!"
Lin Fan said with a smile as he let go of his foot.
The leader of the thugs forced himself to endure the pain and quickly got up.
Then, with mutual support, the four thugs staggered away, utterly humiliated. It was a stark contrast to the mighty appearance they had when they arrived; now they appeared somewhat desolate.
They never would have dreamed of it—always the bullies, now they’ve hit a hard wall!
Even that girl was impressive, single-handedly taking down two of them. Not to mention Lin Fan, who was so strong he didn’t even seem human!
The leader initially relied on his strength and physique, dismissing Lin Fan, but was quickly taught a lesson.
After sending off the four thugs, Lin Fan looked at the stunned Zheng Yang: "Teacher Zheng, they’ve left. Can we go inside now?"
Zheng Yang snapped back to reality and quickly responded, "Yes."
Having witnessed Lin Fan’s skills, Zheng Yang felt a newfound respect.
He hurried to open the door, inviting Lin Fan and Loli inside.
The room was messy, clearly not having been tidied for a while, with only Zheng Yang living here—typical of a bachelor’s room. The only trace of his past as a teacher was the pile of old books in the corner.
Zheng Yang was transferred out of Yun City fourteen years ago, a year after An Jincheng disappeared. He later stopped teaching, going into hiding under an alias.
Until later, when his father fell gravely ill, requiring an expensive surgery—300,000 yuan in total!
Zheng Yang, a poor educator, couldn’t possibly raise that money. Knowing his situation, none of his relatives or friends were willing to lend him money. They all suddenly seemed to be short on cash themselves, and despite his pleas, he couldn’t borrow a single dime.
With no other options, Zheng Yang borrowed money from an underground moneylender and finally secured the 300,000 yuan.
Unfortunately, the operation was done, but his father still didn’t survive.
As Zheng Yang was busy with his father’s funeral, the people from the underground moneylender began to track him down to collect the debt.
Without the money to pay back, he initially agreed to a monthly repayment. But when the moneylender discovered he couldn’t repay, they demanded he repay the entire debt at once. That’s when the nightmare began. With interest compounding on top of interest, the longer it dragged on, the more he had to repay. By now, it totaled 6 million yuan!
He couldn’t even pay back the 300,000 yuan, let alone 6 million.
Zheng Yang tried several times to escape, attempting to flee the town and hide elsewhere, but each time he was caught, beaten up, and eventually gave up on fleeing. He started selling fruits in the town.
However, the pace at which he earned money was far too slow to keep up with the multiplying high-interest loans, leading to an ever-growing debt—an endless abyss of despair.
If Lin Fan hadn’t intervened and if they came to collect the debt again, Zheng Yang wouldn’t have considered living any longer. Life for him had become nothing but a desperate struggle.
This kind of story wasn’t new—a high-interest loan that was impossible to repay, costing countless lives.
Yet, even knowing the danger, people still couldn’t avoid borrowing from them. Sometimes, when money is truly needed, you can’t think about anything else—just like Zheng Yang, who had no choice but to borrow from the moneylender to save his father’s life.
Although the room was simple, Lin Fan and Loli didn’t mind, casually finding a place to sit.
"Thank you for saving me just now," Zheng Yang said gratefully. At least this time he avoided a beating.
Lin Fan replied, "Don’t worry, Teacher Zheng. I said I would help you settle your debt and I will see this through to the end. If you’re worried, we can draw up an agreement. I’ll take responsibility for your debt."
Zheng Yang suggested talking at home, suspecting he was anxious. So Lin Fan laid it out clearly.
Zheng Yang replied, "No need, I believe you."
He had witnessed Lin Fan’s skills firsthand, and this evoked both awe and relief, bringing him peace of mind.
Lin Fan nodded, "Alright, Teacher Zheng, shall we get to the point then? Regarding An Jincheng’s disappearance years ago, is there anything you haven’t told us? According to your statement, you had a meal with him at a food stall a few days before he disappeared. You stated that he didn’t say anything. Yet, according to your testimony, I noticed some inconsistencies, as if you were hiding something."
Zheng Yang didn’t know Lin Fan possessed top-tier insight, and he looked at Lin Fan in astonishment. Lin Fan was amazing! He’d actually discovered something hidden within his testimony. What kind of ability was this?
Given how skillful Lin Fan was, Zheng Yang didn’t dare lie anymore—for fear Lin Fan might notice!
He was relying on Lin Fan to help him with the loan sharks’ issue and couldn’t risk angering him with lies.
Gritting his teeth, Zheng Yang said, "That day when I ate with Jin City, we talked quite a lot. Jin City wasn’t in a good mood at the time. I tried to console him and drank with him..."
Fifteen years ago, on that day, Zheng Yang and An Jincheng drank to lift their spirits, and during their chat, An Jincheng confided in Zheng Yang about a troubling matter he wasn’t sure how to deal with.
Zheng Yang asked An Jincheng what it was.
An Jincheng told him that a friend was in trouble, and he could help resolve it, but for certain reasons, he didn’t want to, leaving him indecisive.
Hearing this, Loli’s eyes brightened, and she quickly asked, "Did he mention who this friend was or what the specific problem was?"
Zheng Yang shook his head, "No, I asked, but he didn’t want to say more, so I didn’t press him. I just offered some superficial comfort, knowing it wouldn’t be of much help. A few days later, he just vanished."
Loli frowned, "Why didn’t you mention such a crucial clue when you gave your statement back then?"
Zheng Yang blushed, lowering his head and avoiding Loli’s gaze, "I... I was so scared at the time. I’m from a single-parent family, and my father had been ill for a long time. If I caused any trouble, there’d be no one to care for him, and I didn’t think it had anything to do with his disappearance, so I didn’t say it... Officer, is this really important?"
Loli and Lin Fan exchanged a glance, feeling speechless.
If Zheng Yang had provided this clue back then, the case might have already been solved.
Odds are, An Jincheng’s disappearance was related to this problem and friend. What might the problem be, and who is this friend?

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Boss, don’t you care about your image?
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 476: Boss, don’t you care about your image?
Lin Fan and Loli finally got a clue from Zheng Yang, a clue that is likely related to An Jincheng’s disappearance.
Unfortunately, Zheng Yang did not know about the friend that An Jincheng mentioned to him years ago.
Lin Fan was worried that Zheng Yang might have missed something, so he asked again carefully, only to finally confirm that there was nothing useful to be found from Zheng Yang.
"Teacher Zheng, thank you so much for your cooperation." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Zheng Yang sighed and said, "Jin City has been missing for so many years, I often think of it and feel it’s a pity. I hope you can find him."
Lin Fan said, "We will do our best."
Loli still felt a bit upset with Zheng Yang because years ago Zheng Yang concealed such an important clue. Although Zheng Yang claimed it was to avoid trouble and not affect his elderly father who had no one to care for him, she, as a police officer, found it hard to accept such a situation.
"Zheng Yang, if you had told us this back then, An Jincheng might have been found already!" Loli said discontentedly.
Zheng Yang was very embarrassed.
Lin Fan changed the topic and said, "Teacher Zheng, anyway, you have helped us, and now it’s time for me to fulfill my promise. I will help you deal with the high-interest loan situation."
Zheng Yang immediately got excited and quickly said, "About this... Mr. Lin, I want to tell you, since you have money, why not just give them the 600 thousand, to avoid trouble. I know Mr. Lin is very strong, but they are the local bigshots here. It’s said that a powerful dragon cannot suppress a local snake, it’s better not to go against them."
Zheng Yang’s concern was justified. He borrowed money from a local underground loan shark, whose owner is called Long the Fifth.
This Long the Fifth is not simple. He’s the underground boss of Sanxue Town, owns a lot of businesses, including malls, hotels, nightclubs, etc., truly a local snake.
These local bosses generally have complex backgrounds. They dare to openly lend at high interest, which implies they must have powerful backing.
Even though Lin Fan has money, being on someone else’s turf, if the other party utilizes local network, they can easily deal with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No worries, I’ll go outside first to make a call."
Shortly after, Lin Fan finished his call and returned, saying to Loli, "Let’s go, let’s find Long the Fifth."
Zheng Yang smiled bitterly and said, "Are you really going to find Long the Fifth?"
Loli also felt a bit worried and suggested, "This Long the Fifth is indeed tough to deal with. How about I contact my colleagues in town? No matter how arrogant he is, he wouldn’t dare to go against the police!"
Just as they were speaking, they suddenly heard the sound of cars outside.
Startled, Zheng Yang hurried to the doorway to look, and was shocked: "Not good, they are here again!"
Three cars arrived, led by a black Audi. The door of the Audi’s rear seat opened, and a slim middle-aged man walked out, surrounded by a group of thugs. He had triangular eyes, a big gold tooth, a ruthless look, obviously not a good person.
Zheng Yang exclaimed, "It’s him, he’s Long the Fifth, he actually came in person!"
Long the Fifth came personally!
This indeed surprised Zheng Yang greatly. As an underground boss, it’s rare for him to make an appearance himself. It seemed Lin Fan really angered them this time.
Beside Long the Fifth was a big man with scars on his face, the same man who previously came with people to collect the debt.
"Boss, it’s this guy who injured me, and this woman, they injured two of our people!" The big man pointed at Lin Fan and Loli.
Long the Fifth glared with his triangular eyes, sizing up Lin Fan and Loli.
"Young man, daring to injure my people on my turf, you’re the first to do so. Old Jia was my best fighter, the fact that you could defeat him so easily, you indeed have some skills. I couldn’t resist coming over to see for myself." Long the Fifth stared at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said calmly, "I prefer reasoning with people, but it’s a shame these idiots forced us to fight, can’t blame us!"
Long the Fifth said, "Reasoning, huh? Okay, I’ll reason with you. Have you ever borrowed money from a bank, young man?"
Lin Fan said, "No."
Lin Fan really never borrowed money. Even during his poorest days in college, he never used student loans, just worked odd jobs to earn money, finishing college that way. After graduation, although his earnings weren’t high, he couldn’t afford a house or car, or get married, he could still support himself. He never borrowed money.
Long the Fifth said, "Even if you never borrowed money, you should know, borrowing from a bank means repaying the loan on time, or there will be penalty interest. This is the rule, even banks follow this rule. Do you agree?"
Lin Fan nodded, "That’s indeed the case."
Long the Fifth said, "This Zheng Yang borrowed money from us but kept delaying repayment. According to the rules, imposing penalty interest on him is only natural, isn’t it? I heard from Old Jia you refuse to pay the 600 thousand - isn’t that unreasonable?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You don’t need to use banks as a shield. You’ve privately set unreasonable interest rates, which is loan sharking. As far as I know, this is openly illegal. Zheng Yang originally borrowed 30 thousand. Even if he delayed repayment, causing penalty interest, there’s no reason it should increase to 600 thousand. If the penalty interest is reasonable, I would accept; unreasonable loan sharking, I won’t accept."
"Boss, I’m not lying to you, this kid is too arrogant!" The big man beside said indignantly.
Long the Fifth’s expression turned grim as he sneered, "Kid, in this place, do you really want to talk reasonable or unreasonable with me? Let me tell you, in Sanxue Town, I am the law! If I say he owes 600 thousand, he owes 600 thousand. If I say he owes 1 million, he must repay it in full. I set the rules!"
Lin Fan said, "Really, who gave you the courage to act so recklessly?"
Long the Fifth said, "Kid, ever heard the saying, ’a powerful dragon cannot suppress a local snake’? You, an outsider, dare to challenge me, do you really not know your place? Do you believe me if I say I can make a call and have you locked up for two days?"
Lin Fan said, "Oh, for what wrongdoing would I be locked up for two days?"
Long the Fifth said, "Injure my people, isn’t that enough? Kid, I see you’re strong, so I reasoned with you. Don’t refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. If you repay the loan, I’ll let the matter drop today. Otherwise, I’ll ruin you, and don’t think you can leave this small town!"
Lin Fan shook his head, "Threatening me won’t work, even if the emperor comes, my standpoint remains the same. I won’t succumb to loan sharking."
"This kid truly is stubborn and oblivious!" The big man beside unhappily said, Lin Fan must be tired of living.
Long the Fifth’s expression became uglier. As the underground boss of Sanxue Town, who didn’t give way when faced with him, it was good if they weren’t scared urine, but Lin Fan was not scared at all. Where did his majesty as the boss go? Didn’t he care about face!
Not to mention in front of his group of men, suddenly there was a guy who wasn’t afraid at all of their boss, it suddenly seemed like the boss wasn’t as formidable as before.
Long the Fifth was furious, immediately pulling out his phone: "Kid, just you wait!"
At this moment, Loli said coldly, "What, Long the Fifth, you want to call the police? How fortunate, I am the police!"

chapters.title: Chapter 477: The Underground Boss of the Whole Town Knelt?
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 477: The Underground Boss of the Whole Town Knelt?
Long the Fifth paused his hand from making the call and laughed, "Little girl, with your delicate skin, I believe you’re a flight attendant, but a cop? I know all the cops in Sanxue Town, and I’ve never seen you before!"
A group of thugs burst into laughter.
This young girl using such a tactic to bluff their boss was just too naïve.
Loli snorted, "I’m not a cop from Sanxue Town, I’m from Yun City."
Saying this, Loli showed her badge to prove her identity.
The thugs looked at each other in surprise; could she really be telling the truth?
"Are you really a cop from Yun City?"
Long the Fifth was momentarily stunned but quickly regained his sneer, "Even if that’s true, what could a Yun City cop do here? Even if you dared to hurt my men, I’d still take you in. Besides, as an officer, you’ve severely wronged an innocent citizen."
Loli was furious, this Long the Fifth was so arrogant, he didn’t even respect the police.
Long the Fifth turned to Lin Fan, "Boy, what are the police to me? You saw it, I don’t care at all. I’m giving you a final chance now, pay back 6 million, and nothing will happen."
If Lin Fan wasn’t such a great fighter, he wouldn’t even bother talking to him. He would have already had Lin Fan beaten up.
In the underworld, might makes right.
But Lin Fan was too formidable, having quickly overpowered his best fighter. Long the Fifth knew he stood no chance of taking Lin Fan down by force.
Luckily, Long the Fifth had things more powerful than just brute strength to employ.
No matter how tough Lin Fan was, on this turf, it was Long the Fifth’s word that ruled.
At this point, he couldn’t believe Lin Fan wouldn’t submit. Anyone with sense would realize it’s unwise to fight the local tyrant.
Everyone was watching Lin Fan.
Zheng Yang’s palms were sweaty with anxiety. He really hoped Lin Fan would just hand over the 6 million and be done with it. This Long the Fifth was truly dangerous to mess with.
Lin Fan, however, shook his head, "Sorry, I said I won’t compromise with loan sharks."
Zheng Yang almost dropped to his knees, it was over, this time it’s over!
Lin Fan was determined to oppose Long the Fifth, this was seeking death with no chance of winning!
Even the thugs under Long the Fifth’s command were dripping with cold sweat. Where did this guy come from, actually daring to stand up to their boss!
But what made him think he could take on the local tyrant of Sanxue Town!
Long the Fifth was also steaming with anger. He was wary of Lin Fan’s skills and thus didn’t dare strike, but even with such overt hints, Lin Fan still refused to yield.
"Boy, so you want to be tough with me, eh? Then I have no choice."
Long the Fifth sneered, picked up his phone, and was about to make a call.
Ring ring ring...
At that moment, Long the Fifth’s phone rang.
Seeing the caller, it seemed like someone very important, and he quickly answered.
"Yes, I know... Yes, I understand, no, rest assured..."
After hanging up, cold sweat unknowingly ran down Long the Fifth’s forehead. He subconsciously wiped it away, clearly shaken.
The others were puzzled at the sight, what kind of call did Long the Fifth receive, leaving him so rattled?
The burly man next to him reminded, "Boss, shouldn’t you be making that call?"
What’s up with the boss, wasn’t he supposed to call in someone to deal with Lin Fan? That was the main thing, especially since he had been beaten by Lin Fan. He, more than anyone, wanted to see Lin Fan taken down.
Slap!
Suddenly, Long the Fifth slapped the burly man across the face: "Call your sister! This mess is all your fault! I’ll deal with you later!"
The burly man was stunned, his face flushed half-red.
What just happened, why did he suddenly get hit?
Not only was the burly man dumbfounded, but everyone else was too.
What is going on here?
How did Long the Fifth suddenly turn on his own men, so angrily, claiming this was the mess that guy caused?
How did this become a mess, wasn’t Long the Fifth just now very arrogant, not even caring about Loli, a cop?
However, this was not the most shocking thing.
The truly shocking event was yet to come.
Thud.
Suddenly, Long the Fifth turned around and knelt down before Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, I didn’t recognize your greatness earlier, I was truly foolish, I beg you to forgive me, please don’t hold it against me."
Long the Fifth pleaded.
The entire room froze.
Everyone was dumbstruck.
What the hell?
Is this really happening, Long the Fifth knelt to Lin Fan, and suddenly had a complete change of heart, pleading for mercy?
Lin Fan hadn’t done anything!
Indeed, from start to finish, Lin Fan had simply refused to compromise on the loan shark issue, he hadn’t done anything else, nor had he laid a hand on Long the Fifth.
How did Long the Fifth suddenly act as if he was terrified, kneeling and begging Lin Fan for mercy, this was truly baffling.
Even Loli was confused, she knew Lin Fan was wealthy and a great fighter, her idol, but no matter how strong, the proverb ’a powerful dragon cannot crush a local snake’ still applied. Look, even she, an out-of-town cop, wasn’t taken seriously by Long the Fifth.
The arrogant demeanor of Long the Fifth earlier was what made sense, threatening to send Lin Fan to jail, fitting his image as a local underworld boss.
Now seeing Long the Fifth pleading for mercy was truly beyond comprehension.
Could it be...
Related to that phone call Long the Fifth received?
Loli was truly a cop, she immediately sensed something, who was it that called Long the Fifth earlier?
Lin Fan seemed to know what was going on, with a slight smile, he said, "Long the Fifth, have you already learned who I really am?"
Long the Fifth quickly replied, "Yes, I just found out. Mr. Lin, please forgive me for not recognizing your stature earlier. If I had known you were Mr. Lin, I wouldn’t have dared to act that way even with ten times the guts. Please spare me this time, Mr. Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "I told you, I’m a reasonable person, I like to reason with people. As for that loan..."
Long the Fifth immediately responded, "How could I hold that against Mr. Lin? What loan, it doesn’t exist. Mr. Zheng Yang’s loan, we’ll let that go."
What?
Everyone was dumbstruck again, let it go?
million, just let it go?
Did Long the Fifth take the wrong medicine?
"Mr. Lin, what is going on? My loan, just gone? Did I hear wrong? Is this a dream?" Zheng Yang exclaimed in astonishment. He seriously suspected he was dreaming, since only in dreams do such good things happen.
At that moment, a business vehicle drove up, with a government emblem on its side!

chapters.title: Chapter 478 Enthusiastic Director of Investment Promotion
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 478 Enthusiastic Director of Investment Promotion
Long the Fifth, the underground leader of Sanxue Town, was a fearsome figure in the town. Several well-known entertainment venues were his assets, making him a certified local tyrant.
However, after receiving a mysterious phone call, this local tyrant suddenly kneeled to Lin Fan.
He even declared that Zheng Yang’s debt was canceled.
This stunned everyone.
What was going on? Did Long the Fifth take the wrong medicine?
While everyone was bewildered, a business vehicle drove up, and judging by the emblem on the car, it was a town government vehicle.
A middle-aged man in a suit and glasses got out of the car.
"Excuse me, who is Mr. Lin Fan?"
The middle-aged man looked at the crowd with a gentle smile, appearing to be a refined and amiable person.
Lin Fan said, "That’s me."
The middle-aged man glanced at Lin Fan, immediately came forward, and enthusiastically extended his hand, "Mr. Lin, hello, I am Li Yuchun, the director of our town’s investment promotion bureau. It’s a pleasure to meet you. Your presence truly graces our small town."
What?
Everyone froze.
The director of the investment promotion bureau came in person to find Lin Fan and was so polite?
"Director Li, pleased to meet you." Lin Fan shook hands with Li Yuchun politely.
Li Yuchun smiled and said, "Originally, the mayor wanted to personally greet Mr. Lin, but unfortunately he has a meeting in the city and can’t get away. The mayor asked me to convey his regret."
Hearing this, everyone exchanged glances, cold sweat streaming down their backs.
The mayor seemed to hold Lin Fan in high regard?
This...
No wonder Long the Fifth suddenly kneeled. Offending Lin Fan meant offending the mayor. No matter how mighty Long the Fifth was in Sanxue Town, he wouldn’t dare to go against the mayor; that would be suicidal!
This Lin Fan, who could even have the mayor being courteous, definitely had an extraordinary status.
He was not an ordinary person!
Long the Fifth was someone who could read the situation. Such a Lin Fan, even with ten guts, he wouldn’t dare offend.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "The mayor is too polite. Next time, if there’s a chance, I will personally pay him a visit."
Li Yuchun smiled and said, "The mayor will be very pleased to hear that. By the way, Mr. Lin, what brings you to our small town this time?"
Lin Fan had previously mentioned making a phone call to the Yun City Government for assistance because he encountered a small problem in Sanxue Town. The city government immediately agreed and contacted the town government.
Upon hearing that the richest man in Yun City had arrived in Sanxue Town, the town government was in a stir.
The mayor was in the city for a meeting, wishing he could sprout wings and fly back to personally receive Lin Fan.
Ultimately, the mayor dispatched Li Yuchun, the director of the investment promotion bureau, to personally receive Lin Fan.
From the town’s perspective, the richest man from Yun City visiting Sanxue Town could mean he’s looking for business opportunities. If Lin Fan could invest in Sanxue Town, it would be an enormous blessing, a golden opportunity delivered to their doorstep.
Sanxue Town, located in Jiangnan City, is relatively underdeveloped. Even though the town government had been working diligently, investment results were mediocre; capital was reluctant to come in, and no one was optimistic about the area’s development!
Now, with the richest man from Yun City visiting, if he were looking for investment opportunities, they definitely could not let it slip through their fingers.
Lin Fan knew that Li Yuchun coming to receive him meant they valued him as a business mogul. Put simply, they were interested in Lin Fan’s money.
Lin Fan merely had a run-in with Long the Fifth, who was difficult to deal with, so he leveraged his connections, using the town government to pressure Long the Fifth.
This time he came, it wasn’t to look for business opportunities. This peripheral town hadn’t caught his attention yet.
Of course, Lin Fan wouldn’t point this out, smiling and saying, "It’s nothing much, just taking a stroll around the area. Today, I wandered into Sanxue Town, just casually inspecting."
Lin Fan intentionally said it this way. His words hinted deliberately, and the listeners took it to heart, making Li Yuchun excited.
Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, said he’s just strolling around. Surely, it couldn’t be a mere casual walk; he must be looking for business opportunities. Seizing this chance, it was crucial to vigorously promote the local area. If they could persuade Lin Fan to invest and settle in Sanxue Town, that would be a tremendous achievement.
If Lin Fan chose Sanxue Town, other towns would probably turn green with envy. Sanxue Town’s status would instantly elevate.
The richest man in Yun City is just that impressive!
Lin Fan continued, "I was lucky to meet an old friend here, but unfortunately encountered a minor issue."
Li Yuchun said, "I heard about it too; Mr. Lin encountered trouble. That’s why I rushed over. Was it Long the Fifth and his group causing trouble?"
Li Yuchun glanced at Long the Fifth, his gaze turned cold.
Long the Fifth was frightened out of his mind. This time, he was doomed. He intended to show off but didn’t realize he was dealing with a significant figure, completely failing to pull off the act and was about to be flattened instead.
Just when Long the Fifth thought the world was ending.
Lin Fan laughed softly and said, "It’s nothing now; it turned out to be a misunderstanding."
Long the Fifth was stunned. Lin Fan could easily crush him, yet he brushed it off lightly. This was sparing him!
Hearing this, Li Yuchun’s sharp gaze softened, and he regained his gentle smile, "That’s good to hear. If Mr. Lin encounters any issues in our town, feel free to contact me immediately."
Li Yuchun handed Lin Fan a business card.
Lin Fan accepted the card and said, "Thank you."
Li Yuchun said, "Mr. Lin, since it’s rare for you to visit our small town, why not come back to the town government with me, so I can properly host you?"
Li Yuchun’s intention was clear. He wanted to take Lin Fan to the town government to thoroughly pitch Sanxue Town. If Lin Fan invested, it would be fantastic.
Lin Fan understood Li Yuchun’s intent and smiled, "Thank you very much for your hospitality, Director Li, but I’m in a bit of a hurry today and have to return to Yun City shortly, so I won’t impose. Next time, I’ll personally visit the town government."
Li Yuchun acknowledged he felt a bit disappointed. He was initially full of enthusiasm to promote Sanxue Town to Lin Fan, and Lin Fan’s words were like a bucket of cold water.
But Li Yuchun couldn’t insist; Lin Fan mentioned he had to leave due to commitments, and if he persisted, it would put Lin Fan in a difficult position.
So all he could do was hope that this richest man from Yun City would indeed visit again.
"Okay, Mr. Lin, next time you come to Sanxue Town, please make sure to give me a call in advance, so I can prepare and welcome you," Li Yuchun said with a smile.
In any case, the primary task was not to offend Lin Fan. Li Yuchun had some experience in this regard, and for now, he handled the situation appropriately without offending Lin Fan.
Li Yuchun refrained from pursuing the matter further to avoid irritating Lin Fan. After exchanging a few more pleasantries, he took his leave.
During the conversation between Lin Fan and Li Yuchun, everyone around was left in a daze.
The scene before their eyes left them utterly perplexed. What was going on? Lin Fan was incredibly impressive; even the director of the investment promotion bureau treated him with such respect. Who exactly was this Lin Fan?

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Willing to Serve Mr. Lin with Utmost Loyalty
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 479: Willing to Serve Mr. Lin with Utmost Loyalty
After Li Yuchun left.
Lin Fan looked at Long the Fifth and smiled: "Long the Fifth, we can continue now."
Long the Fifth felt conflicted at this moment.
Just now, Lin Fan could have exposed him in front of the Director of the Investment Bureau, and the government might have been furious, which would have led to trouble for the local bully.
But Lin Fan managed to save Long the Fifth’s situation with just one simple sentence.
"Mr. Lin, why didn’t you tell Director Li the truth earlier?" Long the Fifth couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan laughed: "There’s no need. I never like to go to extremes when doing things. I just hope you won’t make things difficult for Teacher Zheng anymore."
Long the Fifth said: "Yes, Mr. Lin is right. I’ve decided to waive Mr. Zheng’s debt. I promise not to trouble him again in the future. Mr. Lin can rest assured."
Lin Fan shook his head: "That’s not appropriate. 300,000 isn’t a small amount. How can we take advantage of such a large sum? Let’s not idle away from taking what’s ours. So, Mr. Long, calculate how much more Teacher Zheng owes you, at the regular interest rate."
Long the Fifth was very moved: "Mr. Lin’s magnanimity is truly admirable, I am in awe!"
Long the Fifth quickly calculated that Zheng Yang owed a total of 400,000, including principal and interest.
This was calculated at a regular bank loan interest rate, which was quite reasonable and far less than the exorbitant 600,000 from loan sharks.
But even 400,000, Zheng Yang himself couldn’t repay.
Lin Fan promptly paid Long the Fifth this amount, as he had agreed to help Zheng Yang repay the debt. The amount was reasonable, so he paid it willingly.
The 400,000 quickly reached Long the Fifth’s account.
Long the Fifth was greatly impressed with Lin Fan; despite the threats made today, Lin Fan responded with kindness, really paying off the debt, proving himself to be extraordinary.
"Mr. Lin, are you planning to come develop in Sanxue Town in the future?" Long the Fifth asked.
With the Investment Bureau Director so enthusiastic, it seemed likely Lin Fan planned to invest in Sanxue Town.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Perhaps."
Long the Fifth immediately knelt down: "If Mr. Lin comes to Sanxue Town, I, Long the Fifth, am willing to serve Mr. Lin tirelessly!"
Lin Fan stood with his hands behind his back, smiling: "You wish to work for me?"
Long the Fifth said: "Yes, I am very familiar with Sanxue Town. There must be areas where Mr. Lin could use my services. I would be honored to assist."
Lin Fan said: "I conduct legitimate business, unlike the underground. If you want to work for me, you’ll have to stop with the loan shark business."
Long the Fifth gritted his teeth, knowing that while loan sharking was highly profitable, it was unpleasant to manage. Many borrowers lacked repayment capacity, leading to debt collection, assaults, and ruination...
Honestly, loan sharking wasn’t easy either, causing harm to both parties.
Long the Fifth said: "Mr. Lin, after returning, I will abolish the loan shark business and never engage in it again. Please rest assured, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan nodded: "Good, I hope next time I come to Yun City, I will have a chance to need your service."
Long the Fifth was delighted, Lin Fan’s nod provided him an opportunity. Despite being a local underground boss, there’s limited progress possible. If he could attach himself to Lin Fan, who knows?
Moreover, Lin Fan’s charisma indeed won him over.
Long the Fifth then took his leave with his men.
They came in three cars, radiating power, but left humbled.
The thugs were all curious about who Lin Fan was, to make their boss so deferential!
Long the Fifth said: "You know nothing. Why do you think Director Li from the Investment Bureau came personally? Because of Mr. Lin, the wealthiest person in Yun City!"
The thugs were all astonished.
Yun City’s wealthiest, and so young?
Too incredible, how did Lin Fan achieve this as Yun City’s richest person so young? It could only mean Lin Fan was extraordinary!
Then, all the thugs knelt down.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan sent off Long the Fifth and his men, feeling pleased. Long the Fifth was subdued, costing only a mere 400,000—a profitable exchange.
If someday he decided to invest in Sanxue Town, it would be advantageous.
For Lin Fan, it was the time to build connections. His Mortal Group aimed for a billion-dollar market value in the future.
As the commercial tower rises, challenges from those around will follow; these are not issues Lin Fan can resolve with a wave of his hand, making connections crucial.
Just like today, without his prior networking in Yun City, Long the Fifth wouldn’t have been easy to handle.
"Things have finally been satisfactorily resolved. Teacher Zheng, you can relax now." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Thud!
Zheng Yang knelt before Lin Fan, tears streaming: "Thank you, Mr. Lin."
Lin Fan asked: "Teacher Zheng, do you have any future plans? Do you plan to stay in this small town?"
Zheng Yang said sentimentally: "I stayed here because I owed money to the underground money lenders and couldn’t leave. Now the debt is repaid, I should leave. I’ll return to my hometown where my parents are buried in the mountains, making it convenient to manage their graves."
Zheng Yang looked at Loli and said: "Officer Luo, I know I’ve withheld clues for fifteen years, which must be frustrating for you. I can only apologize. I hope Officer Luo will solve the case soon."
Loli sighed inwardly; she was indeed frustrated with Zheng Yang but was also moved by his words.
Zheng Yang couldn’t offer any more assistance.
Lin Fan and Loli also said their goodbyes and left. Their cars were parked in the market, having been brought by Zheng Yang’s tricycle earlier.
Zheng Yang said: "I’ll use the tricycle to take you both to town then."
The two had to take Zheng Yang’s offer, otherwise they’d have to walk back, which was quite far and would take until nightfall.
Thus, the two got on Zheng Yang’s tricycle.
However, just as the tricycle started moving, there was a sudden tire burst, with a bang, startling everyone.
Zheng Yang got off, looked at the burst tire, and smiled wryly: "Well, now we can’t go."
Lin Fan and Loli were flustered; what bad luck. Did they need to walk back to town? Lin Fan regretted not driving his Rolls-Royce to follow Zheng Yang earlier.
Zheng Yang thought of something and said: "Oh, I have a neighbor, Old Wang, who drives a taxi. I’ll see if he’s home and ask him to give you a ride."
Zheng Yang went briefly and returned with a taxi.
"Old Wang happened to be home resting today, and he’s willing to give you a ride." Zheng Yang smiled.
The taxi driver, a man in his forties, was very laid-back: "You two going to town, right? Hop in."
"Thank you."
Lin Fan and Loli thanked him and got in Old Wang’s car.
Old Wang drove the car, carrying the two towards Sanxue Town’s market.
They were driving when suddenly, a woman emerged from the roadside, holding a baby and frantically waving to intercept the taxi.
Old Wang originally planned to ignore her since he was resting and only accepted Zheng Yang’s request; he stepped on the gas to pass by.
Loli said: "Uncle, she seems to be in an emergency, stop the car and see what’s wrong."
"Alright." Old Wang stopped the car reluctantly.
The woman, seizing her lifeline, approached quickly and anxiously said: "Driver, please take us to the hospital. My daughter has a high fever, I must get her to see a doctor immediately."
Lin Fan, with keen eyesight, noticed the baby in her arms looked pale. Something was wrong.
Lin Fan hurriedly opened the car door and helped her open the door, saying: "Get in quickly."

chapters.title: Chapter 480: Ning Xiaoyue Attacked
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 480: Ning Xiaoyue Attacked
Jiangnan, Hang City.
A bustling mall was crowded with people, as it was heard that several members of the Spaceship Lady group would be holding an event here today. Fans and onlookers gathered, causing the mall to be packed.
"Spaceship Lady? That’s the girl group from the recent talent show, right!"
"Yes, it’s Ning Xiaoyue’s group!"
"Is Ning Xiaoyue coming too? She’s been really popular online lately. I want to see her in person. Although she’s not great at singing or dancing, they say she’s really pretty!"
The crowd buzzed with chatter.
Creation Star is a talent show that’s become a nationwide hit, with the final 9 contestants forming the group named Spaceship Lady.
Today’s event was a commercial one, with only three members of the group attending. The crowd’s discussions mostly revolved around Ning Xiaoyue, as everyone wanted to know if she would show up.
Ning Xiaoyue really came.
A van arrived at the mall entrance, and Ning Xiaoyue, along with two other teammates, got out of the vehicle. Accompanied by their assistants, they headed towards the mall.
"Ning Xiaoyue is here!"
Someone shouted, and the crowd surged forward in excitement to see her. A well-trained security detail formed a human barrier to hold back the enthusiastic crowd.
This scene startled Ning Xiaoyue and her companions, genuinely fearing that the security guards wouldn’t be able to hold back the crowd.
At the mall entrance, a tall woman with long black hair wearing a security uniform approached, coming up to Ning Xiaoyue.
"Miss Ning, I’m in charge of your safety today. Please follow me without worry," the woman with long black hair smiled.
Ning Xiaoyue saw this security guard and was almost startled to exclaim. This female security guard was so beautiful—my goodness, such a stunning woman, yet she’s a security guard.
Her beauty could rival female stars in the entertainment industry. Even Ning Xiaoyue appeared somewhat juvenile in comparison.
"Thank you. May I ask what to call you?" Ning Xiaoyue politely asked.
The woman with long black hair replied, "I’m Anna."
Anna, acting on Feng Wanshan’s orders, intentionally approached Ning Xiaoyue to seize the opportunity to target her.
Anna had already informed Lin Fan about this. Lin Fan advised Anna to play along, so Anna came forward. With her skills, becoming the mall’s security captain wasn’t difficult.
Ning Xiaoyue smiled and said, "Thank you, Sister Anna."
With such a beautiful security sister by her side, her mood improved significantly.
Led by Anna, the group entered the mall.
Afterward, under the brand’s arrangement, Ning Xiaoyue and her two teammates performed on stage, with Anna watching from the side.
The stage was set in the mall’s first-floor atrium, creating an exuberant atmosphere as the surrounding crowd gathered to watch the show.
Ning Xiaoyue and her companions were on stage.
"Ning Xiaoyue, how dare you debut! Your singing and dancing are so poor, get off the stage!"
Suddenly, someone screamed, and a plump girl jumped onto the stage, her face menacing, and lunged at Ning Xiaoyue with a slipper in hand.
The incident happened so suddenly that everyone was frozen in shock.
Ning Xiaoyue was taken aback and instinctively stepped back.
Despite her plump figure, the girl moved surprisingly quickly. She was about to reach Ning Xiaoyue and cause harm.
At that moment, Anna darted in swiftly from the side, tripping the plump girl, who fell to the ground. Anna then pinned her down with a bent knee, and quickly subdued her hands, causing the slipper to drop to the floor.
Even as the plump girl was subdued, she wouldn’t relent.
"Ning Xiaoyue, what gives you the right to debut? You’re not even better than me!" the plump girl screeched.
This remark prompted a burst of laughter from the crowd.
"No way, where does this girl get her confidence?"
"She’s so ordinary, yet so self-assured!"
"Even though Ning Xiaoyue’s singing and dancing skills are average, she’s genuinely beautiful. This girl is probably driven crazy by jealousy."
"It’s terrifying. Jealousy is one thing, but resorting to violence? How can someone with such poor demeanor look down on Ning Xiaoyue!"
"So those who insult Ning Xiaoyue online are girls like this? It turns out that women harbor the most malice against women."
The crowd began to comment.
Anna subdued the plump girl, signaling two security guards to take her away, instructing them, "Call the police and hand her over to them."
Then Anna stood up, approached Ning Xiaoyue, and asked, "Are you okay?"
Ning Xiaoyue, recovering from her fright, replied, "I’m fine, thank you, Sister Anna."
Anna said, "It seems there’s no need to continue this activity. Let’s go, I’ll take you backstage."
With that, Anna led Ning Xiaoyue backstage.
The other two teammates stayed outside; only Anna and Ning Xiaoyue were backstage.
Anna poured a cup of water for Ning Xiaoyue and said, "Have some water to calm your nerves."
Ning Xiaoyue accepted the water with a smile, saying, "Thank you."
Anna replied, "You’re welcome. Ensuring your security is my duty."
Ning Xiaoyue apologetically said, "I’m sorry for causing you trouble. I didn’t expect something like this to happen."
Anna paused. Before this, she didn’t know much about Ning Xiaoyue. She only knew Lin Fan invested in the Company Ning Xiaoyue was part of, and Lin Fan intended to protect her. Feng Wanshan attempted to target Ning Xiaoyue to ultimately get at Lin Fan.
Anna said, "Being a celebrity must be quite stressful. I’ve heard lots of people criticize you online. But I didn’t expect someone to actually try to attack you offline. I hope you take it easy."
Anna wasn’t skilled at comforting people. She said these words merely to get closer to Ning Xiaoyue.
Ning Xiaoyue laughed nonchalantly, "Thank you, Sister Anna, for your encouragement. I’m fine. I know what I’m like. It’s true that many people don’t recognize me now, but that’s okay. I’ll do my best at my job. There will always be someone who appreciates me. Everything carries its own pressures. I used to wait tables at a restaurant, wasn’t that pressure too? I earned less back then. Now it’s just a different kind of pressure. It’s fine; I can handle it."
Anna was a bit surprised internally. She didn’t expect that at such a young age, Ning Xiaoyue could live with such clarity and resilience. It seemed there was no need to worry about her at all.
At first, Anna didn’t understand why Lin Fan wanted to invest in Ning Xiaoyue, but now she had some understanding. Lin Fan had a good eye. This young girl would achieve remarkable things.
"Sister Anna, you’re so skillful. That girl was subdued instantly. I’m so envious of you. You’re like a heroine," Ning Xiaoyue giggled.
Although Anna had a cool personality, hearing the young girl’s genuine praise lifted her spirits. She took the opportunity to say, "If you don’t mind, I’ll be your protector from now on."
Ning Xiaoyue was pleasantly surprised, "That’s wonderful, really?"
For the next several days, Ning Xiaoyue remained in Hang City, and Anna stayed by her side. The two grew increasingly close.
Several days later, Ning Xiaoyue left Hang City and parted ways with Anna.
By then, the two were very close, like sisters.
After seeing Ning Xiaoyue off,
Anna made a call to Feng Wanshan: "Godfather, as you instructed, I’ve been with Ning Xiaoyue these past few days. I’ve completed the task you assigned."

chapters.title: Chapter 481 Misjudged Feng Wanshan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 481 Misjudged Feng Wanshan?
Feng Wanshan was very happy: "Very good, come back to Yun City, let’s meet."
Anna replied: "Okay, I’ll go back to Yun City now. Should I go directly to the company to see you?"
Feng Wanshan said: "I’m currently socializing outside, I don’t plan to return to the company. Let’s meet at my house."
Anna said: "Okay."
Anna then left Hang City and headed straight to the Feng Family in Yun City.
Feng Family Mansion.
When Anna arrived, the Feng Family’s butler greeted her; however, Feng Wanshan had not returned yet.
The butler welcomed Anna into the house, served her tea, and then went off to busy himself, leaving Anna to wait for Feng Wanshan to return on her own.
Anna waited in the house for a while, but Feng Wanshan did not come back. Suddenly, Anna noticed the door to Feng Wanshan’s study was open. With a curious mind, ensuring it was safe, she quietly snuck into the study.
Anna had wanted to do this for a long time, ever since Lin Fan told her that Feng Wanshan had deceived her. Over the years, Feng Wanshan hadn’t looked for An Jincheng’s whereabouts at all; he had been lying to her, even going so far as to hire so-called private investigators to stage a performance.
Anna really wanted to know why Feng Wanshan would do such a thing?
Lin Fan suggested Anna go back to Feng Wanshan’s side, firstly for Lin Fan to cooperate with her from the outside, and secondly to get close to Feng Wanshan and look for an opportunity to investigate.
Now was a good opportunity, and Anna began to search through Feng Wanshan’s study.
But after hastily going through everything, she didn’t find anything useful.
Suddenly, Anna noticed a computer nearby, so she walked over and sat in front of the computer, attempting to turn it on.
The computer required a password to log in and use. Anna tried several passwords, but they were all incorrect; the computer couldn’t be logged into!
Anna frowned and, inspired, entered a string of numbers, and the computer actually turned on!
"It’s dad’s birthday..." Anna murmured.
Feng Wanshan’s computer password was An Jincheng’s birthday. She was just trying it out, not expecting it to actually open.
It seemed that Feng Wanshan truly valued his friendship with An Jincheng, like brothers indeed. This friendship was unmatched; An Jincheng had been missing for so many years, yet Feng Wanshan still used An Jincheng’s birthday as his computer password.
Could she have misunderstood Feng Wanshan?
Anna couldn’t help but feel a bit confused.
Feng Wanshan had indeed deceived her, but might there be any hidden reasons for this? Seeing how deeply Feng Wanshan cared for An Jincheng, he definitely couldn’t be the person who harmed An Jincheng and caused his disappearance!
Once the computer was logged in, the desktop appeared.
The desktop background was surprisingly a photo of Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng together!
This photo had a vintage feel to it; both Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng looked like young men in their twenties.
It was the first time Anna had seen this photo; Feng Wanshan had used it as his computer’s desktop background, indicating how much he missed An Jincheng. They truly were good brothers.
Maybe she really had wronged Feng Wanshan, Anna sighed inwardly.
Just then, she heard movement outside. The butler seemed to be talking to someone.
Feng Wanshan was back!
Anna quickly turned off the computer, left Feng Wanshan’s study, and returned to the living room, pretending to drink tea.
Sure enough, just as she returned to the hall, Feng Wanshan walked in.
"Sorry, the dinner lasted a bit longer, have you waited long?" Feng Wanshan said with a smile.
Anna smiled: "No problem."
Feng Wanshan spoke as he sat down: "You said over the phone that the task is complete, tell me about it?"
Anna said: "Hmm, godfather asked me to gather dirt on Ning Xiaoyue. I’ve been around Ning Xiaoyue these days as her security, and I’ve secretly filmed a video of her."
Then Anna sent the video to Feng Wanshan, who opened it and was very pleased: "Great, Anna, you did well. With this video, I will definitely make Lin Fan pay double the price this time!"
Feng Wanshan’s schemes were all aimed at dealing with Lin Fan.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan was busy investigating An Jincheng’s missing case.
