These days, the person Lin Fan saw most was Loli.
At this moment, Lin Fan and Loli were meeting in the car.
"I’ve checked it out, 15 years ago, Feng Wanshan’s company indeed encountered difficulties..." Loli said.
That day, from Zheng Yang’s words, they learned that An Jincheng had confided his concerns because a friend encountered difficulty, which An Jincheng could help resolve, but he didn’t want to, leaving him conflicted.
Zheng Yang didn’t know who the friend was or what the difficulty was.
Lin Fan and Loli only had this clue, so they began investigating.
Firstly, they investigated An Jincheng’s interpersonal relationships to determine who that "good friend" in trouble could be.
Feng Wanshan was undoubtedly at the top of An Jincheng’s list of friends, so their investigation started with Feng Wanshan.
Now, Loli discovered that Feng Wanshan’s company indeed faced trouble 15 years ago.
Lin Fan asked: "What kind of trouble?"
Loli said: "Feng Wanshan’s Shengshi Group was still a small company back then, and Feng Wanshan himself wasn’t a rich kid. The money he used to establish the company was from investors. Because investors suddenly withdrew, the company’s funding chain broke, and they couldn’t solve the investment issue for a while, nearly leading to bankruptcy."
Lin Fan frowned: "Feng Wanshan’s company’s funding chain break is indeed a difficulty, but what does it have to do with An Jincheng? An Jincheng was just a poor teacher from a humble background; he couldn’t possibly help Feng Wanshan solve the money problem. This differs from what Zheng Yang said; An Jincheng wasn’t unable to solve his friend’s difficulty, rather he didn’t want to."
Loli asked: "Are you saying Feng Wanshan can be ruled out? An Jincheng’s good friend is someone else?"
Lin Fan said: "For now, it seems he can be ruled out, but I still don’t understand why Feng Wanshan would deceive Anna. He clearly never searched for An Jincheng, so there must be some secret here."
Loli said: "An Jincheng’s social circle was simple; he was focused on work and didn’t have many friends. Feng Wanshan was his closest buddy, and if ruling him out, there aren’t many left to investigate."
Loli was somewhat concerned that the lead provided by Zheng Yang might ultimately be futile, that they’d been working in vain.
Lin Fan comforted: "No worries, we have plenty of time to investigate slowly; eventually, the truth will come out."
Loli nodded: "Right. Oh, let me tell you something, do you remember what happened the day we hurried back from Zheng Yang’s house to Sanxue Town’s market?"
Lin Fan curiously asked: "I remember; it was the day a woman was holding her baby asking for help, right? We helped her and took them to the hospital; luckily, we arrived in time, and her child was saved."
The doctor said that if they had arrived one step later, the baby would have been gone.
That event had passed, and Lin Fan was curious why Loli suddenly brought it up.
Loli sighed and said: "Indeed, we made a good deed, but the driver Old Wang ended up in big trouble!"

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Immoral but No Jail Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 482: Immoral but No Jail Time
A few days ago in Sanxue Town, after bidding farewell to Zheng Yang, Lin Fan and Loli took a taxi back to the market. On the way, a woman stopped the car.
This woman was holding a baby, whose face was pale, evidently ill. Loli asked the driver, Old Wang, to stop and let the woman get in the car.
It turned out that the baby suddenly fell ill, and the woman, having no car of her own, had to flag down a car by the roadside to get to the hospital.
After getting in, the baby’s condition worsened, and Lin Fan asked Old Wang to drive faster.
Old Wang was also afraid that the baby would die in his car, so he hurriedly increased the speed. To get to the hospital, he even ran three red lights.
In this small town, there weren’t many vehicles; sometimes the traffic lights were just for show. Despite running a red light, there were no vehicles on either side, the road was empty, so Old Wang didn’t disrupt traffic.
There was no other choice; if they stopped to wait for the lights, each red light would waste at least a minute, a few red lights would be many minutes, and the baby couldn’t wait.
Since there were no cars on the road and it didn’t pose a traffic safety issue, he had to run through.
They sped all the way to the hospital.
The hospital immediately began resuscitating the baby and successfully saved the baby.
Afterward, the hospital stated that luckily they sent the baby in time, or if they had been a few minutes late, the baby might not have been saved.
It seemed that the few minutes gained by running the red light were golden rescue minutes. Running the red lights was worth it.
Rescuing the baby was indeed a great thing.
Everyone thought this was the end of it.
Unexpectedly, a few days later, this incident suddenly became a hot topic online.
It turned out Old Wang received a fine from traffic police for running the red lights, not only losing points but also fined.
Old Wang felt wronged, as he made a living by driving a taxi; the loss of points would directly cost him his job. He pleaded with the traffic police, saying he ran the lights to save someone, hoping they would be lenient.
The traffic police were reasonable, asking Old Wang for evidence. If he could prove that he ran the red lights to save someone, the penalty could be revoked.
So Old Wang approached the woman, hoping she would verify with the traffic police.
Surprisingly, the woman flatly refused, unwilling to help Old Wang and saying that running the red lights was his own business, having nothing to do with them.
This matter was exposed online, and netizens exploded, all criticizing the woman.
"This is just like the farmer and the snake!"
"It’s too immoral. The driver helped her, and she won’t even verify it?"
"The driver is about to lose his job, it’s so unfair!"
"Truly heartless, at least repay a bit of kindness; the driver is your child’s lifesaver!"
"It’s disheartening, just as bad as when people help the elderly and get extorted. If society has such people, who would dare help others in the future?"
The netizens were very outraged, and it must be said, this incident was indeed infuriating; the woman should not repay kindness with betrayal.
Driver Old Wang stated he did not regret his actions, as saving the baby’s life was important, although he felt a bit wronged.
Lin Fan listened to Loli recounting the incident and couldn’t help but sweat, saying, "That woman is really odd; what’s wrong with verifying it? She’s not losing anything. Now, she’s being scolded by everyone. Does she like being cursed at?"
Loli said, "I also just learned about this online. I plan to speak to the traffic police to clarify the situation and revoke Old Wang’s penalty."
Lin Fan nodded, "Yeah, I can testify too."
So Loli called the traffic police in Sanxue Town, identified herself, and explained the situation to them.
Suddenly, a call came in from Zheng Yang, to whom Loli had given her number that day, telling him to call if needed.
Loli smiled, "It’s Zheng Yang calling; it should be about Old Wang."
Sure enough, Zheng Yang said, "Officer Luo, I heard from Old Wang about running the red lights to save someone. You and Mr. Lin were in the car. Could you help prove his innocence?"
Loli said, "We just learned about it too. I just spoke to the traffic police in Sanxue Town, who have promised to handle it quickly."
Zheng Yang was pleased, "That’s good."
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zheng, ask Old Wang to give me her phone number. I’ll try to persuade her; if she verifies it, Old Wang’s penalty should be revoked faster."
Zheng Yang said, "Okay, I’ll ask Old Wang and send you a message shortly."
Soon, Zheng Yang sent a number over.
Lin Fan dialed the number.
"Hello, who’s this?"
A woman’s voice came from the other end, which Lin Fan recognized as the voice of the woman from that day.
Recalling how anxious she was due to the urgency of the baby’s condition, Lin Fan remembered clearly.
Lin Fan smiled, "Hello, a few days ago, you and your child were taken to the hospital in a taxi; I’m the one who was in the car with you. Do you remember?"
The woman responded, "Oh, it’s you. How did you get my number? Ha, don’t bother saying, the driver gave it to you, right? What right do you have to call me?"
Lin Fan said, "Please don’t get agitated; I called hoping you could help verify for the driver. He got fined for running the red lights and might lose his job. He did it to save your son."
The woman said, "Don’t talk nonsense. He ran the lights on his own. What does it have to do with me? I didn’t tell him to run them!"
Lin Fan broke a sweat and said, "I didn’t say you told him to run them. Just verify that he ran the lights to save your son. That’s the truth. He saved your son; it’s only right for you to help verify that."
The woman was angry, "Don’t talk nonsense. He’s a taxi driver, and I’m just a passenger. I paid the fare; his running the lights is none of my business. Don’t call me again, or I’ll accuse you of harassment!"
The woman angrily hung up the phone.
This conversation made Loli, standing nearby, grind her teeth in anger.
"That woman is too awful. How are there such people in the world? He’s losing his job for her child and all she has to do is verify it. She loses nothing! Just lack of morals!" Loli said angrily.
"People like that really should be taught a lesson!"
Loli was indignant. As a police officer, she encountered many odd cases but rarely someone as ungrateful as this woman, who was infuriating.
"I’ve come across people like this before. Once, a child accidentally fell into the water, and a young man passing by didn’t hesitate to jump in and save the child but drowned himself. The authorities wanted to award him for bravery, but the child’s family refused to support the application. I understand people like that; they’re afraid of trouble and too selfish. Unfortunately, there’s nothing we can do but be angry."
Loli sighed, quite helpless.
Indeed, while such relatives are really detestable, what can be done to them? Legally, they did nothing wrong, only lacking morals, and morality doesn’t put one in jail.
If lacking morals meant jail time, there would probably be prisons everywhere in this world.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "To deal with immoral people, you need to fight fire with fire, use magic to defeat magic."
Saying this, Lin Fan picked up his phone and made a call.

chapters.title: Chapter 483: A Phone Call That Made the Other Party Break Down in Tears
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Chapter 483: A Phone Call That Made the Other Party Break Down in Tears
The woman hung up on Lin Fan, showing disdain on her face.
"Seriously, getting calls one after another, it’s so annoying. The driver lost his job, what does that have to do with me? I’m not going to help him verify anything, what if I end up having to pay money? Only a fool would care!"
The woman sneered coldly.
To prevent further disturbances, she decided to change her phone number.
Speaking of which, the driver ran a red light that day, but it wasn’t because she asked him to. Her son was critically ill that day, and she was so upset, crying in the car, completely frantic.
Later, her son was saved, and she was busy taking care of him, without any intention to thank the driver, because she felt it was his responsibility. As a customer, she took the driver’s car, and it was the driver’s duty to get her child to the hospital as quickly as possible; otherwise, it would be a dereliction of duty.
The child was successfully delivered to the hospital, which means the driver fulfilled his obligation, so there was no need to say thank you.
Now, surprisingly, the driver bothered her to help verify that it was to save her son he ran the red light. She was certainly not going to agree; to her, the driver was just making her take the blame.
She also noticed that there were a lot of people online cursing her now.
She was even more reluctant to come forward, wishing the incident had never happened, wanting to stay far, far away.
Fortunately, her personal information wasn’t exposed online, and nobody knew who the baby’s family was.
As long as they didn’t know, she could pretend nothing happened; after all, no matter how they cursed online, it didn’t affect her at all.
Thinking about this, the woman even began to feel a bit smug.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, the woman’s phone rang.
She frowned and grumbled, "Must be those wretched people calling again. The driver lost his job, what does that have to do with me?"
She picked up the phone and found that it wasn’t Lin Fan calling, but her boss!
The woman quickly answered the call with a flattering smile: "Boss, what do you need?"
"Ah-Hong, how are you doing at home now? Is your child alright?" the boss asked caringly.
The woman replied, "The child is doing well, thank you for your concern, boss. In a couple of days, I’ll be able to return to work."
The boss chuckled, "As long as the child is okay. Your child is still young; you should spend more time taking care of him. How about this, after some consideration, we’ve decided you won’t need to come to work anymore."
The woman was shocked: "Boss, how can this be? If I don’t work, how will I have money? Boss, you can’t fire me; I worked hard to get this job, and I really want to work."
The boss chuckled, "I hired you because I felt sorry for you and your child, but unfortunately, you brought this upon yourself, and there’s nothing I can do about it."
The woman asked curiously, "Boss, what did I do wrong? Is it because I took a few days off? If so, I can come to work now; my mother can look after the child."
The boss said, "Stop playing dumb. Your matter has been trending online; don’t tell me you’re not aware of it yourself."
The woman turned pale with fright and blurted out, "Boss, how do you know about this?"
Her boss actually knew it was her! How was this possible?
The boss said, "Didn’t someone just call you, urging you to testify for the driver so that his punishment can be revoked?"
The woman was shocked that her boss knew even this, and said, "Yes, someone did call me; that person was also in the car that day."
The boss said, "That person is someone you can’t afford to offend, and even I can’t afford to offend them. I wouldn’t dare keep you employed; if you want to keep working here, you must gain their forgiveness!"
Having said that, the boss hung up without waiting for a reply.
The woman was stunned, overwhelmed with surprise.
Just who was Lin Fan?
He actually managed to contact her boss so quickly, causing her to lose her job!
This job was far too important for her; she couldn’t possibly let go of it, and she didn’t want to lose it under any circumstances.
She quickly picked up her phone, soon found the call record with Lin Fan, and called him back.
Inside the Rolls-Royce.
Loli asked curiously, "What are we waiting for?"
Ever since Lin Fan made a call, they were just waiting, and Loli didn’t know what they were waiting for.
Lin Fan said, "Waiting for a call."
He didn’t know many people from Sanxue Town, but it so happened that Li Yuchun, the Director of the Investment Promotion Bureau, visited him personally that day and gave him a business card.
So he called Director Li for a small favor.
Driver Old Wang was fined and lost points because he saved the woman’s child, and he was facing job loss; yet, the woman refused to testify, so he decided to let her experience losing a job herself.
Ring ring ring...
At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
It was indeed the woman calling.
Lin Fan pressed the speakerphone button.
"Sir, I know I was wrong. Now I’m willing to testify for the driver. I’m begging you; give me a chance, don’t make me lose my job. I can’t lose this job, I have loans to repay. If I lose this job, it’ll be very difficult to find another job with such a high salary, and I won’t be able to repay the money. My child and I will die, I’m begging you, I’ll kneel to you, please show mercy!"
The woman cried bitterly and began to plead.
Upon hearing this, Loli couldn’t help but laugh; there was actually such a thing. This woman actually knows how to cry.
Lin Fan chuckled, "You’ve lost your job, now you’re crying, but when the driver lost his job after saving your son, why didn’t you feel it was unjust?"
The woman said, "Yes, sir, you’re right to scold me. I know it’s my fault; I realize my mistake now."
Lin Fan said, "You’re only saying this because you lost your job, not because you genuinely understood your mistake. But it doesn’t matter; I won’t argue with you about this. You should proactively contact the traffic police and clarify the situation."
The woman hurriedly said, "Thank you, sir. I will contact the traffic police immediately."
The woman indeed proactively contacted the traffic police afterward and expressed her willingness to testify.
With the testimonies of Lin Fan, Loli, and the woman, the traffic police also finally verified that the driver ran the red light in an attempt to save a life. Although running a red light was wrong, this spirit of saving lives was commendable.
Thus, the traffic police issued a public notice stating that the facts had been clarified, and decided to revoke the penalty against Old Wang.
The netizens cheered, all happy for Old Wang.
"Finally, the penalty was revoked!"
"Don’t let good people lose heart!"
"Did that woman finally find her conscience and agree to testify!"
The netizens didn’t know that it was Lin Fan who "persuaded" the woman, causing her to come out and testify.
This matter finally reached a perfect resolution, and for Lin Fan, it was just a simple effort.
Loli was in awe of her idol, bowing deeply in admiration; he truly lived up to the title of her idol and was amazing, settling that selfish woman just with a phone call!
At this time, Zheng Yang called again.
Loli laughed, "He’s surely calling to thank us."
Zheng Yang was indeed calling to thank them: "Old Wang’s penalty was revoked, and he asked me to thank you all for testifying. Also, the woman agreed to testify. If I’m not mistaken, it was thanks to Mr. Lin, wasn’t it?"
Loli said, "Absolutely!"
Zheng Yang was deeply impressed: "Mr. Lin is truly remarkable."
Loli thought, Lin Fan is indeed great, her idol!
"Zheng Yang, if there’s nothing else, let’s hang up; I still have a case to investigate," Loli said.
Zheng Yang quickly said, "Wait, Officer Luo, actually there’s another thing, I just remembered. Back then, Jin City said something to me once."
What?
Lin Fan and Loli perked up, thinking perhaps Zheng Yang had more clues to provide?

chapters.title: Chapter 484: New Clues
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 484: New Clues
"What did she say?" Loli quickly asked.
Although the last time Zheng Yang provided a very important clue, it was too vague to start an investigation easily.
If Zheng Yang could provide more clues, that would naturally be the best.
Zheng Yang said, "I remember back then Jin City was already drunk and he vaguely said that his friend was the most important person to him, besides his daughter. But no matter who it is, his daughter is always the most important."
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan and Loli exchanged a glance. Could this friend of An Jincheng be so important, could it be...
The first thought that crossed their minds was Feng Wanshan.
Loli said, "Is there more?"
Zheng Yang said, "That’s all. Really, that’s all this time. I’ve already tried very hard to recall all the details from that day."
Loli said, "Alright, if you remember anything else, feel free to let me know anytime."
She hung up the phone.
Loli looked at Lin Fan, "What do you think?"
Lin Fan said, "Maybe I should have a talk with Anna."
Somewhere in a park, on the lakeshore, a group of pigeons gathered at the edge.
A long-haired beauty in black was squatting on the ground, feeding the pigeons with corn kernels she had just bought. The pigeons immediately scrambled to eat.
This long-haired beauty was indeed Anna. Although she usually seemed quite aloof, she had a gentle side too. She often liked to come to the park and feed the pigeons when she had nothing to do.
Next to Anna, on a stone bench, Lin Fan sat with his back to her. He had just arrived and seemed not to notice Anna. To an outsider, the two appeared unrelated.
"I didn’t expect you to enjoy such a leisurely activity." Lin Fan said.
Anna said, "This was my dad’s hobby. He loved animals and often rescued strays. Our home is a frequent stop for stray cats and dogs. He always said it felt wrong to enjoy the park’s pigeons for free, so he often brought me here to feed them. After he disappeared, I’ve been coming here often too. I’m afraid he might worry and fret over leaving these pigeons hungry."
Lin Fan was momentarily stunned, then smiled and said, "Your dad was truly a good person."
Anna’s expression turned a bit gloomy as she said, "I really want to know where my dad went... By the way, you said you wanted to meet me, is there something?"
Lin Fan said, "I wanted to ask you about your dad. Who do you think were the three most important people in his life? Of course, you’re certainly one of them."
Anna didn’t know why Lin Fan was asking this but answered anyway, "The other two are my mom, who was the love of his life. Sadly, she passed away early. And the other is Feng Wanshan; he and my dad were childhood friends, almost like brothers."
Lin Fan nodded, "It was indeed him."
Anna asked, "What?"
Lin Fan said, "Nothing. By the way, have you noticed anything while you were with Feng Wanshan lately?"
Anna said, "Nothing in particular, just that Feng Wanshan’s computer password is my dad’s birthday. The desktop background is a photo of him with my dad. Does that count as something?"
Upon discovering this, Anna even contemplated whether she had misjudged Feng Wanshan. Could he genuinely regard An Jincheng as a brother? How else could he have wronged him; Anna found it hard to believe.
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment and, after pondering, said, "What photo is it?"
Anna said, "I kept it. Want me to send it to you?"
Anna took out her phone and quickly sent a picture to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan opened the picture; indeed, it was a photo of Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng. The photo had an old-fashioned feel; the two in the picture were still young, looking energetic.
The location of the photo was somewhere in the jungle, though it was unclear where exactly.
Wait!
Lin Fan suddenly noticed something and asked, "Your dad seems to be holding something in his hand in the photo. Do you know what it is?"
Hearing this, Anna also opened the photo to take a look and frowned, "I’m not sure, it looks like a stone?"
Lin Fan said, "It doesn’t seem like an ordinary stone. It looks more like a diamond. Using this photo as the desktop background seems intentional. Has your dad ever shown this stone to you?"
Anna tried hard to recall, eventually shaking her head, "No, he hasn’t. Are you saying this stone is related to my dad’s disappearance? Are you overthinking?"
Lin Fan said, "I’ll find out the truth."
Anna bit her lip and said, "Actually... I think we might have misunderstood Godfather. Godfather indeed deceived me, never looking for my dad, but perhaps he has unspeakable reasons. Instead of speculating, I think we should just confront him directly."
Lin Fan nodded and said, "That’s also a viable option, see how he reacts. But for now, don’t alert him; give me some time."
Anna gave a bitter smile and said, "I’m afraid I don’t have much time left. Feng Wanshan asked me to approach Ning Xiaoyue, as a test for me. Soon, this matter will come to light."
Feng Wanshan had asked Anna to approach Ning Xiaoyue, mainly to collect dirt on her. Anna had successfully completed the task.
Feng Wanshan had obtained dirt on Ning Xiaoyue and was contemplating how to monetize it.
He called his son Feng Tianming over and showed him the dirt on Ning Xiaoyue.
The dirt was a series of photos in which Ning Xiaoyue was holding hands with a boy, looking very intimate!
Although the boy’s face was not clear, from his build and hairstyle, he was definitely a male.
"Father, where did you get these photos?" Feng Tianming said with delight.
Feng Wanshan chuckled and said, "This minor thing was a piece of cake. I got someone to get close to Ning Xiaoyue and secretly took these."
Feng Tianming chuckled and laughed, "This is great! I never thought that Ning Xiaoyue, having just debuted, would already be dating. If these photos leaked out, her career would be immediately ruined. As an idol, she’s forbidden from dating. If this happens, not even outsiders, her fans alone would condemn her. Ning Xiaoyue, no matter how you debuted, I want you to be done for immediately!"
Feng Wanshan said, "Who said these photos are meant for release?"
Feng Tianming was taken aback, "What, Dad, what do you mean? Didn’t we plan to mess with Ning Xiaoyue?"
Feng Wanshan said, "I have no interest in a girl’s career; I did this for Lin Fan. Guess how much Lin Fan would be willing to pay to buy these photos?"
Feng Tianming paused in realization and then broke into laughter, "Father, you’re truly my idol; I’m beyond impressed. With these photos, Lin Fan will definitely be at our mercy!"
Feng Wanshan said, "Do you understand now? Lin Fan won 100 million in cash from me. I told him to pay me back double that!"
Feng Tianming kneeled, excitedly saying, "Father, you’re awesome!"
Feng Wanshan said, "I don’t know much about the entertainment industry. You should know better what to do next; go arrange it!"
Feng Tianming grinned maliciously, "I understand, don’t worry, Father. I’ll make this look good. I can’t wait to see Lin Fan’s frustrated expression."
That night.
Lin Fan returned home and suddenly received a call from Wang Xiangqian.
"Brother Fan, something happened to Xiaoyue," Wang Xiangqian said with a tinge of urgency.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: Not Buying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 485: Not Buying!
Lin Fan said, "What’s up?"
Wang Xiangqian replied, "Just today, there’s suddenly a buzz online saying that Xiaoyue is about to have some shocking dirt exposed. The curiosity of netizens has been piqued, and everyone is talking about it; it seems like someone is going after Xiaoyue again."
Lin Fan let out a sound, "I got it. No need to worry; I’ll visit the company tomorrow."
Wang Xiangqian was a bit surprised, wondering why Brother Fan seemed so calm?
Lin Fan hung up the phone and sneered, "Feng Wanshan is starting, huh."
He already knew what was going on—Feng Wanshan had sent Anna to get close to Ning Xiaoyue to gather dirt on her, and Anna handed over Xiaoyue’s dirt to Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan planned to use this dirt to his advantage.
If Feng Wanshan wanted to target Ning Xiaoyue, he wouldn’t have to go to such lengths, teasing everyone with previews. He could just release the dirt directly.
Feng Wanshan’s actions were clearly aimed at Lin Fan. Lin Fan didn’t need to do anything; he just had to wait for Feng Wanshan to reach out.
The next day.
Lin Fan arrived at Wenyue Company.
As soon as he entered, he found the place noisy. Apparently, Feng Tianming arrived even earlier than he did.
Wang Xiangqian was unhappy, "Feng Tianming, why are you running to someone else’s company so early? Is your company going bankrupt?"
Feng Tianming said, "Of course, I’m here for good news. If you want to know what it is, go get Lin Fan here. I want to announce it in front of him!"
Wang Xiangqian said, "What on earth are you up to?"
Feng Tianming retorted, "You must be clueless. Haven’t you heard the rumors online about Ning Xiaoyue? As a company, how can you not know?"
Upon hearing the words, the company crowd was shocked.
Wang Xiangqian’s face changed, and he angrily said, "Feng Tianming, is it you again? You despicable person, you’ve already lost the bet to Brother Fan, so why are you slandering Xiaoyue?"
Feng Tianming sneered, "Slandering her? You’re overthinking. If she wasn’t dirty herself, who could slander her?"
Wang Xiangqian said angrily, "What do you mean by this?"
Feng Tianming dismissively replied, "I’ve said that I want to speak in front of Lin Fan. If you’re smart, you’d contact Lin Fan right away. You’re such a fool."
"No need to contact. I’m here."
At that moment, Lin Fan’s voice came through, followed by his entrance.
"Feng Tianming, if you have something to say, go ahead," Lin Fan said calmly.
Feng Tianming said, "Alright, let’s get straight to the point. Take a look at this first!"
Feng Tianming took out a stack of photos and tossed them on the table.
Everyone looked, and the photos showed Ning Xiaoyue holding hands with a guy!
"How could this happen? What’s going on?"
"Is this real?"
"Where did Feng Tianming get these photos?"
Everyone was bewildered.
Feng Tianming was satisfied with their reactions and proudly said, "Don’t worry about how I got the photos. Just know that they’re in my hands, and you know the consequences if these photos are released online."
Of course, everyone understood that releasing these photos would equate to announcing Ning Xiaoyue’s downfall. She just started her career, and this revelation would be devastating.
No wonder everyone reacted so strongly.
Wang Xiangqian trembled all over, sweating and turning pale. Could something like this really happen?
His company was on the verge of bankruptcy, saved by Lin Fan’s investment. Then Ning Xiaoyue debuted and became the company’s only profitable artist. Wang was counting on Xiaoyue to rise.
If Xiaoyue’s love life were exposed now, it would be catastrophic for both her and the company.
Ning Xiaoyue’s painstakingly earned future would vanish like a fleeting dream.
Only Lin Fan remained unperturbed and said, "You haven’t exposed these photos but came here instead, so it seems you don’t intend to expose them. Go ahead, what do you want?"
Feng Tianming said, "Smart as always. Ruining Xiaoyue would be easy, but that wouldn’t be fun. Let’s play something interesting. I could avoid exposure if you purchase these photos!"
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Feng Tianming asked them to buy the photos?
Wang Xiangqian angrily said, "Feng Tianming, this is blackmail!"
Feng Tianming chuckled, "I’m blackmailing, so what? If you don’t like it, feel free to call the police, but with that, Xiaoyue will surely be exposed. Consider what’s more worthwhile."
"Not buying."
Lin Fan calmly replied.
What?
Everyone was taken aback; Lin Fan decisively chose not to buy. Was this decision too rash?
This concerns Ning Xiaoyue’s future!
Wang Xiangqian said, "Brother Fan, shouldn’t we discuss this further?"
Ning Xiaoyue was the company’s only cash cow, and Wang counted on her earnings. As her boss, he privately hoped she wouldn’t face trouble.
Feng Tianming was also surprised. "Lin Fan, what did you say, not buying? Aren’t you afraid I’ll expose them?"
Lin Fan nonchalantly replied, "Expose them if you wish."
Feng Tianming was frustrated, "Aren’t you concerned about Xiaoyue’s future? Surely, you understand what these photos mean. By offering them, I’m giving you a chance to save her future!"
Lin Fan seemed indifferent.
Feng Tianming grew more desperate, "Two billion! A fixed price of two billion. Lin Fan, you have plenty of money, and you’re not willing to spend two billion to preserve Xiaoyue’s future?"
Everyone looked at Lin Fan, unsure of his intentions.
Wang Xiangqian couldn’t stand it and said, "Feng Tianming, you’re asking for too much! How about lowering the price?"
Feng Tianming let out a sound, "Alright, one billion five hundred million, reducing by five hundred million. Can’t go lower. Lin Fan, just buy them!"
He was nearly begging Lin Fan to buy them; his plan was to extort Lin Fan for a hefty sum. According to his plan, Lin Fan would pay anything to protect Xiaoyue, but Lin was unresponsive. His plan for Lin Fan to pay double backfired, and it was awkward.
It was indeed awkward.
Feng Tianming continued to lower the price, but Lin Fan ignored him. Eventually, the price fell to fifty million, yet Lin Fan showed no intention of buying.
"Lin Fan, are you insane? You’re not forcing me, but if you don’t buy, I’ll post these photos online!" Feng Tianming shouted.
"Do you worry I’ll expose them after you buy them? I swear I won’t. I only want money!"
He initially aimed to see Lin Fan at a loss, but Lin remained calm, which made Feng even angrier.
He almost knelt to beg Lin Fan to buy.
Finally, Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Stop shouting. I also have these photos, higher resolution than yours. Why should I buy from you?"
What?
Everyone was puzzled.
Feng Tianming replied in disbelief, "What do you mean, you also have them?"
Lin Fan said, "Not only do I have them, but everyone online can see them now; I’ve had Xiaoyue upload them herself."
What?
Everyone was stunned. Did Ning Xiaoyue expose her own intimate photos with a guy?

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Tricked Again by That Rascal Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 486: Tricked Again by That Rascal Lin Fan
"Lin Fan, are you crazy? You actually let Ning Xiaoyue voluntarily expose her relationship? Don’t you realize this is ruining her?"
Feng Tianming shouted hoarsely.
His agitation wasn’t because he feared ruining Ning Xiaoyue, but because his plan had been entirely disrupted by Lin Fan.
Originally, he intended to use Ning Xiaoyue’s scandal to blackmail Lin Fan, demanding 200 million, expecting Lin Fan to pay double.
Once the money was in hand, he’d then expose the scandal and ruin Ning Xiaoyue!
This plan was supposed to be flawless; he held the scandal in his grasp, and Lin Fan had no option but to pay up.
Such things aren’t uncommon in the entertainment industry, where some paparazzi specialize in stalking and secretly photographing celebrities. Once they capture something the stars don’t want public, they use it to extort money; the celebrities have no choice but to pay to protect themselves.
Even among thieves, there’s honor. Typically, once the paparazzi get their money, they don’t make the photos public.
But Feng Tianming wasn’t a paparazzo; he didn’t need to follow these unspoken rules. He wanted both Lin Fan’s money and to destroy Ning Xiaoyue.
This plan was supposed to be perfect. Who could’ve guessed Lin Fan would act so unpredictably?
He outright refused to buy!
Not only did he refuse, but Lin Fan also encouraged Ning Xiaoyue to publicly release the intimate photos herself!
This left Feng Tianming with no retreat, turning the photos in his possession into worthless scraps of paper, neither sellable nor threatening.
What on earth was happening?
Feng Tianming broke into a cold sweat and hastily checked the internet on his phone.
Others were just as baffled, unable to understand why Lin Fan would have Ning Xiaoyue expose her romantic involvement—wouldn’t this ruin her?
Driven by curiosity, the crowd also pulled out their phones to check.
Ning Xiaoyue’s latest Weibo post featured a series of photos, including one of her holding hands with a "boy." Indeed, they were high-definition shots, much clearer than what Feng Tianming had secretly taken.
The caption read: "First album recording since our group’s formation, enjoy the sneak peek."
The "boy" in the photo turned out to be a short-haired girl!
This short-haired girl was one of Ning Xiaoyue’s teammates; she had an androgynous style, hence the short hair, making her look like a boy.
It turned out that the so-called dating scandal Feng Tianming found was merely Ning Xiaoyue shooting a new MV with her teammate!
The supposed romance was completely a misunderstanding; even the "boy" holding hands with Ning Xiaoyue was actually female, just with a neutral style that looked masculine!
Learning the truth, everyone at Wenyue Company couldn’t help but burst out laughing.
No wonder Lin Fan said he wouldn’t buy it, no wonder he let Ning Xiaoyue expose it herself—it was never something that couldn’t be made public. Only a fool would pay 200 million for fake dirt from Feng Tianming!
Lin Fan even took the initiative, having Ning Xiaoyue release the photos first. Feng Tianming didn’t even get the chance to spread rumors. If they hadn’t preemptively released them, Feng Tianming could have used those pictures to slander Xiaoyue as being in a relationship, spreading defamatory articles. Now he couldn’t, and the photos were, quite literally, trash.
Wang Xiangqian understood and knelt before Lin Fan. Brother Fan is brilliant, truly smart; what was initially a dreadful threat was perfectly resolved by Lin Fan.
"How could this be, fake!" Feng Tianming was on the brink of tears. He thought he could definitely make Lin Fan suffer this time. He came over just to see Lin Fan’s miserable expression, yet he was the one who got humiliated in the end.
He couldn’t believe the photos his father gave him turned out to be fake!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Young Master Feng, do you have any other advice? If not, you can scram!"
Without further ado, Lin Fan grabbed Feng Tianming and tossed him out.
Whoosh!
Feng Tianming was thrown out the door, landing hard on his backside.
He was in extreme pain, struggled to his feet, and angrily said, "Lin Fan, don’t you get cocky. This time was a misunderstanding, next time you won’t be so lucky. Sooner or later, I’ll make you pay. I refuse to believe Ning Xiaoyue will never make a mistake!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Young Master Feng, no need to worry about our Xiaoyue, better to concern yourself with your own future."
Feng Tianming asked, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan replied, "You’ll find out soon enough."
Feng Tianming snorted, "Stop trying to scare me, what can you do to me!"
Lin Fan looked at Wang Xiangqian, "Old Wang, could you please hand me the broom, there’s some trash outside that needs cleaning."
Feng Tianming’s expression shifted; he couldn’t compete with Lin Fan, so he cursed and quickly fled.
Watching Feng Tianming run away in disgrace, everyone burst into laughter. Feng Tianming was just like a clown, continuously showing up to get slapped by Mr. Lin, becoming a true source of joy.
Shengshi Group.
Feng Wanshan sat in his office, a smug smile on his face.
Lin Fan had won 100 million in cash from him, but with a small trick, Feng Wanshan got double back.
Faced with Ning Xiaoyue’s scandal, Lin Fan could only obediently pay.
He couldn’t wait for Feng Tianming to return and report; Lin Fan’s humiliated expression would surely be amusing.
So, Feng Wanshan called Feng Tianming to inquire.
"Xiaoming, how’s the situation? Let me guess, Lin Fan’s 200 million cash should about be landed by now." Feng Wanshan chuckled; this time his foresight trapped Lin Fan—he didn’t believe Lin Fan could have any countermeasures!
On the other end, what he heard was Feng Tianming’s crying.
Feng Tianming was already on the brink of tears upon discovering the truth. Hearing Feng Wanshan’s words pushed him over the edge.
Feng Wanshan was taken aback, "Why are you crying, what happened?"
Feng Tianming said, "Father, we’ve been tricked; those photos are completely fake..."
After listening to Feng Tianming’s explanation, Feng Wanshan was stunned, muttering, "How could this happen..."
Feng Tianming asked, "Father, where did you get these photos from? What was the source? Could you have been deceived?"
Feng Tianming casually speculated, but his words shook Feng Wanshan out of his stupor. Cheated?
The photos were brought by Anna, could she have tricked him!
Upon this realization, Feng Wanshan flew into a rage, hung up on Feng Tianming, and called Anna.
"Anna, come to my office." Feng Wanshan said coldly.
Anna quickly arrived at Feng Wanshan’s office.
"Godfather, what’s the matter?" Anna asked calmly.
Feng Wanshan glared at her, sneering, "Anna, look at what you’ve done. I trusted you so much, and now you have no way to escape blame."
Anna furrowed her brows, "I don’t quite understand what you mean, Godfather."
Feng Wanshan angrily replied, "The so-called dirt you gathered on Ning Xiaoyue was merely her shooting an MV with her teammate. You’re around Xiaoyue, it’s impossible for you not to know. You intentionally handed me those photos and lied about Ning Xiaoyue’s scandal! I couldn’t believe it before, but it seems you’ve truly betrayed me!"
Anna was speechless.
Because no matter what she said, Feng Wanshan wouldn’t believe her anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: Going Door-to-Door to Arrest People
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 487: Going Door-to-Door to Arrest People
"You don’t need to argue. That day you were rummaging through my study, quite pleased with yourself, huh? What were you looking for?" Feng Wanshan sneered.
So, he knew about Anna searching through his study that day. Anna’s betrayal was already a matter of certainty.
"The fact that you betrayed me isn’t really it; what angers me the most is that you actually sided with Lin Fan. Do you know Lin Fan is my arch-nemesis? He’s the person I hate the most, and you actually teamed up with the person I despise against me!"
Anna rummaging through his study indicated that she already had a change of heart, but that wasn’t the most serious part yet.
He sent Anna to get close to Ning Xiaoyue to deal with Lin Fan, but Anna used false information to deceive him, leading him to lose to Lin Fan again.
This was the most serious situation, suggesting that Anna actually sided with Lin Fan; otherwise, how could she help Ning Xiaoyue? Helping Ning Xiaoyue means helping Lin Fan!
"Why? I’ve been so good to you, why would you betray me and side with that Lin Fan? You better explain it to me right away!" Feng Wanshan roared.
Feng Wanshan stared at Anna, waiting for her response. The evidence was irrefutable, leaving Anna no room to argue. She could only answer the questions.
"Where did my father go?"
After a moment’s silence, Anna asked word by word, lifting her eyes to look at Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan was taken aback: "Your father? You’re asking about your father’s whereabouts? Is there a situation you aren’t clear about? I’ve been helping you search for 15 years..."
"Shut up!"
Anna interrupted Feng Wanshan with a cold tone: "You don’t need to pretend here anymore. I already know that for the past 15 years, you’ve never really helped me find my father. You were just deceiving me, and you even meticulously found people to cooperate in your act to deceive me."
Feng Wanshan’s face changed. No way, Anna actually knew about this. Impossible!
"Anna, don’t say such nonsense. How could it be fake? I’ve been here for years, and throughout these years, I haven’t given up searching for your father. Qian Wu is indeed a private detective, so how could it be fake? You’ve overthought it or been influenced by others; it’s Lin Fan who influenced you, right?" Feng Wanshan chuckled.
Anna sneered: "Do you still think I’m that little girl from 15 years ago, so easy to fool? The truth is just as Qian Wu said. Lin Fan subdued Qian Wu that day and learned the truth from him. He even recorded it—do you want to hear it?"
Feng Wanshan’s face turned pale.
Damn, Qian Wu actually said that.
It’s Lin Fan again!
How did Lin Fan manage to subdue Qian Wu? Logically, Lin Fan shouldn’t have known Qian Wu at all!
Feng Wanshan was perplexed.
"Feng Wanshan, why don’t you just tell me the truth? You haven’t searched for my dad at all for 15 years. Why did you deceive me? You’d better have a clear explanation!" Anna said coldly.
Feng Wanshan’s eyes shifted, and he suddenly sighed: "Well... it was for your own good. I did search in the initial few years, but eventually, I lost hope. I realized I’d never find your father. Continuing would just be a waste of manpower and resources. But I didn’t dare tell you; I feared it would break your heart, so I continued pretending to search for your father each year."
Anna was stunned. Is that really the case?
If that’s really the case, then she has seriously misunderstood Feng Wanshan. If that’s true, Feng Wanshan is practically a warm-hearted angel, telling a benevolent lie to protect her.
Feng Wanshan seemed to have convinced Anna, and felt joy in his heart as he continued: "Anna, also think about it; what was my relationship with your father? Our friendship was closer than biological brothers. I hope you won’t misunderstand me further about this."
Anna couldn’t help but tremble: "Is that really the truth?"
What Feng Wanshan said could be plausible. For so many years, Feng Wanshan has been taking care of her. She wouldn’t have suspected him at all before, until Lin Fan let her hear Qian Wu’s recording, revealing that Feng Wanshan had been deceiving her all along!
However, Feng Wanshan just explained that as well and made a logical case. She felt a bit confused for a moment.
If Feng Wanshan had only been telling a benevolent lie, then she truly wronged him.
Perhaps... she shouldn’t have trusted Lin Fan from the start. After all, compared to Feng Wanshan, Lin Fan is an outsider...
While Anna was caught in uncertainty.
Suddenly, the door to Feng Wanshan’s office was pushed open. A beautiful female officer, accompanied by two policemen, walked in.
This left both Feng Wanshan and Anna puzzled. What was going on?
"Mr. Feng, hello, I’m Loli from the Yun City Police Station. I ask that you come back with us to assist in an investigation regarding the 15-year-old disappearance case of An Jincheng. Here is the court’s warrant. We hope Mr. Feng will cooperate," the beautiful officer said straight to the point.
Feng Wanshan and Anna were both stunned.
The Yun City Police Station came directly to arrest someone?
This was too sudden!
Feng Wanshan said: "Officer, what mistake have I made that you’re taking me back? I had already given a statement for the disappearance case 15 years ago. I know nothing about it. Why are you arresting me now?"
Loli chuckled: "Feng Wanshan, I advise you to surrender willingly. Based on current evidence, we have reason to believe you are involved in the disappearance of An Jincheng 15 years ago. Our initial findings suggest you are the perpetrator."
"What?" Anna’s face changed, looking at Feng Wanshan in shock.
She was almost convinced by Feng Wanshan just moments ago. This turn was too abrupt, and she wasn’t prepared for it at all!
"Officer Luo, what’s happening? Since when have the police been following up on my father’s case?" Anna asked curiously.
Loli replied: "The police station conducts investigations into cold cases every year. Each year, a batch of old cases gets solved, some even dating back 30 years. These cases were hard to solve before, but now with technological advancements, unsolved cases can be cracked. Your father’s case is one of the old cases I’ve been following up on recently."
Anna was pleasantly surprised: "So does that mean, Officer Luo, with the help of high technology, you can solve this case? Can my father be found?"
Loli shook her head: "No, your father hasn’t been found yet. This breakthrough wasn’t due to high technology, but because of one person."
Anna asked in surprise: "One person?"
Loli answered: "Lin Fan."
Anna was stunned, it’s Lin Fan!
This answer was both unexpected and expected because Lin Fan had promised to help her solve the case. She just didn’t expect Lin Fan to work alongside this beautiful female officer.
Lin Fan again!
Feng Wanshan was furious, deeply hating Lin Fan; this Lin Fan was practically his nemesis!
Loli continued: "With Lin Fan’s help, we’ve gradually found some clues. Following those clues led us to some evidence. All evidence points to one person, and that’s you, Feng Wanshan!"

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Fabricated Reasoning?
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 488: Fabricated Reasoning?
"Officer Luo, you have no proof, please don’t falsely accuse and vilify good people!" Feng Wanshan said angrily.
Loli actually said he was connected to An Jincheng’s disappearance!
"Officer Luo, what’s going on?" Anna asked urgently.
Feng Wanshan said, "Anna, you don’t need to listen to this female cop’s wild talk. I guarantee she has no evidence because your father’s disappearance has nothing to do with me. You should be clear about how I have treated you over the years; you must trust me."
Anna said, "Godfather, I trust you."
Feng Wanshan was pleased, "That’s settled then. Officer Luo, as a policeman, you are unwelcome here if you wrongly accuse good people without evidence. Please leave immediately!"
Anna, however, said, "I haven’t finished. I trust my godfather, but I also want to know what Officer Luo has found, because over the years, godfather has been deceiving me, never really trying to find my father. Instead, Officer Luo and Lin Fan have been seriously investigating."
Feng Wanshan’s face turned dark, and he snorted coldly, "Fine, I’ll care to listen to your nonsense!"
Loli said, "May I speak now? Mr. Feng, 15 years ago, did your company encounter a financial crisis?"
Feng Wanshan said coldly, "So long ago, I don’t remember."
Loli said, "It’s okay if you don’t remember, we can help you recall. Fifteen years ago, your Shengshi Company was in a debt crisis due to failed investments and needed at least 200 million to get through it. Later, you got 200 million in cash through a bank loan, overcoming the difficulty. Am I right?"
Feng Wanshan said, "Why are you talking about this? Yes, I faced financial problems, but the bank helped resolve it. So, what do you want to say?"
Loli said, "The problem lies here. Was that 200 million really from the bank, or did you come up with another way?"
Feng Wanshan snorted, "What nonsense are you talking? The bank loaned me the money back then, and there are records. You can check them."
Loli said, "We checked, and it seems there are no issues at first glance. However..."
Feng Wanshan said, "However, what?"
Loli said, "We suspect that you bribed someone inside the bank to collaborate with you for money laundering. In reality, that 200 million came from another source."
Feng Wanshan angrily said, "Do you have evidence? If not, this is slander. Don’t think that just because you’re a cop, I won’t dare to sue you!"
Loli said, "We don’t have evidence yet, but if our suspicion is correct, finding evidence shouldn’t be difficult. The question now is, if your 200 million came from somewhere else, where did it come from? Could it have come from An Jincheng?"
What?
Anna was extremely shocked, "Officer Luo, what are you saying? Godfather got 200 million from my father?"
"Haha..."
Feng Wanshan couldn’t help laughing heartily.
Loli chuckled, "Is it funny?"
Feng Wanshan laughed, "Of course it’s funny. Miss Officer, excuse me, but I look down on cops like you because I feel you’re not worthy of your uniform! Wouldn’t you investigate Jin City’s financial status before making wild guesses?"
Anna couldn’t help but say, "Officer Luo, my father was just an ordinary teacher. His salary was modest, just enough to support us. My father often taught me to be thrifty; as far as I know, he couldn’t possibly have that much money."
Feng Wanshan sneered, "Hear that? As a police officer, your reasoning is poor. I really don’t know how you managed to become an officer, unless..."
Feng Wanshan sneered, the implication obvious, he was mocking Loli for having gained the position through unsavory means.
This is clearly slander, yet Loli didn’t get angry, instead said, "Don’t rush, I’ll tell you the reason behind our deduction. During our investigation, Lin Fan noticed inconsistencies in a witness’s statement, so we found this person and obtained a lead. A few days before An Jincheng disappeared, he had dinner with this person and confided that he had a friend facing difficulties who was important to him, second only to his daughter, Anna."
Anna’s expression changed, "Second only to me, wouldn’t that be..."
She looked at Feng Wanshan, it was obvious, this person was Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan’s eyes briefly showed surprise, but it quickly vanished as he snorted coldly, "Miss Officer, stop fabricating. Tell me, who told you this!"
Loli smiled, "I can’t disclose this person now, he’s a key witness under our protection. At the necessary time, he will naturally come forward to testify, you’ll find out then."
Feng Wanshan said, "It’s nonsense, no proof!"
Loli said, "What An Jincheng told this witness can prove that this friend is indeed Feng Wanshan, Mr. Feng. Mr. Feng coincidentally faced financial difficulties in those days, and after An Jincheng disappeared, Mr. Feng obtained a bank loan to resolve his financial crisis. So we deduce that Mr. Feng murdered An Jincheng to obtain the funds. Unfortunately, we never considered this direction back then because we were aware of An Jincheng’s financial status."
Feng Wanshan laughed, "What a ridiculous joke! I wonder what your superiors would think of such reasoning. You’re truly disgracing the police! Even if your logical deduction is correct, you have yet to answer my question: Please explain, where did An Jincheng get 200 million from? If you can’t answer this, everything is nonsense!"
Loli said, "On this point, we must thank Miss An."
Anna asked curiously, "Thank me?"
Loli said, "That’s right, from the witness’s testimony we’ve confirmed that the friend An Jincheng referred to must be Feng Wanshan, no doubt, and coincidentally, Feng Wanshan had financial difficulties at the time. The question is, from where did An Jincheng have the money that Feng Wanshan coveted? This question puzzled us for a long time."
Initially, while Lin Fan and I were identifying this ’friend,’ we even ruled out Feng Wanshan due to his financial difficulties back then and An Jincheng’s financial situation being unable to help him.
Until Zheng Yang added more, saying An Jincheng considered this friend almost as important as Anna.
That’s when they focused on Feng Wanshan.
Now they had to resolve this contradictory issue. What way did An Jincheng have to help with Feng Wanshan’s financial issues?
This question was a major obstacle; if it couldn’t be resolved, the investigation couldn’t continue.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: The Evidence You Wanted is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 489: The Evidence You Wanted is Here
"We’ve always been puzzled, how could an ordinary teacher solve a two-billion-dollar financial crisis? Until that day, Lin Fan saw a group photo provided by Anna. This photo was of Feng Wanshan with An Jincheng, and after analyzing it, we finally had the answer," Loli smiled.
Anna recalled that she gave that photo to Lin Fan in the park that day.
Could it be that Lin Fan actually saw something in that photo?
Anna didn’t know that Lin Fan had top-notch insight; if there’s anything special about that photo, it couldn’t escape Lin Fan’s keen eyes.
Feng Wanshan snorted, "A group photo, what group photo, what nonsense are you talking about again?"
Loli said, "You should be well aware of which group photo we’re talking about. In this photo, we discovered An Jincheng holding a diamond. We also found out that this diamond is incredibly rare. Guess what: fifteen years ago, it appeared at an underground auction and sold for a high price of two billion. Isn’t that quite the coincidence? At this point, everything has come together. Miss An, could you tell me what major your father studied in college?"
Anna said, "My father studied history in college."
Loli said, "That makes sense. Your father studied history, and Feng Wanshan studied archaeology back then. In the year they graduated — the same year the photo was taken — they participated in an archaeological expedition, following their mentor all the way to Africa. This event is recorded and verifiable, and if necessary, I can use it as court evidence. During this expedition, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng discovered a treasure; An Jincheng got a diamond, which was later auctioned for two billion, this rare gem."
Anna looked shocked, "I can’t believe this; my father never told me anything about it."
Feng Wanshan said disdainfully, "Of course he didn’t tell you because it never happened! It’s all a figment of this female officer’s imagination!"
Loli said, "Feng Wanshan, you found a treasure and later sold it to gain the capital for your start-up, which established Shengshi Group. Am I right?"
Feng Wanshan said, "Nonsense, my start-up capital was entirely my father’s inheritance, which has nothing to do with any treasure!"
Loli said, "Stop pretending. We’ve already investigated your family’s history spanning three generations; where did your father get such a large sum of money for you to inherit? Your money is completely unexplained, only a treasure could account for it."
Everything came together.
Back then, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng followed their mentor’s archaeological team to Africa, and during the expedition, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng discovered a treasure and secretly kept it for themselves.
Feeling triumphant, they even took a group photo to commemorate the occasion.
Later, Feng Wanshan sold his share of the treasure and with the proceeds founded Shengshi Group.
Fifteen years ago, Shengshi Group faced financial difficulties, leading Feng Wanshan to seek help from An Jincheng, hoping he would sell the diamond to raise money and help him through the crisis.
But An Jincheng hesitated and ultimately refused him.
In a fit of rage, Feng Wanshan killed An Jincheng, robbed the diamond, sold it at an auction, and saved Shengshi Group with two billion.
That’s basically what happened.
However, fifteen years ago, An Jincheng mysteriously vanished, leaving no trace, and no one suspected Feng Wanshan. This was because the diamond was a secret between An Jincheng and Feng Wanshan; no one knew An Jincheng actually had such a treasure.
So at that time, no one connected An Jincheng’s disappearance with Feng Wanshan’s financial troubles.
Even now, despite Loli piecing together the whole affair, there are still many questions that need answering; otherwise, Feng Wanshan cannot be convicted.
Because of this, Feng Wanshan would never admit to it.
Feng Wanshan said, "Ridiculous, do you know how ridiculous your reasoning is? It’s entirely a figment of your imagination; what evidence do you have to prove it? You have none! It’s all slander! Anna, you’re a smart person; you wouldn’t believe such groundless claims, right?"
Anna remained silent, utterly shocked.
She could never have imagined things would turn out this way; is Loli and Lin Fan’s deduction truly correct?
If it’s true, it would be truly astounding.
Anna looked at Loli, "Officer Luo, do you have evidence for everything you said?"
Loli smiled, "We’ve already gathered most of the evidence, that’s why we applied for an arrest warrant. We hope Mr. Feng can cooperate with the investigation willingly, to bring the truth to light and even strive for lenient treatment for himself."
Feng Wanshan said angrily, "Nonsense, pure nonsense! Anna, don’t believe her; you know how your foster-father treated you, you should believe me!"
Loli said, "Mr. Feng, we’re asking you to cooperate with the investigation this time to give you a chance. I hope you’ll grasp it. If you choose not to cooperate, and face undeniable evidence later, don’t expect any benefits; there will be no lenient treatment."
Feng Wanshan said, "I spit on that! I’m completely clean!"
"Feng Wanshan, are you really clean?"
Suddenly, a voice came in as Lin Fan pushed the door open, somehow holding a full-grown person like a chicken.
"Lin Fan!"
Feng Wanshan said angrily, "Lin Fan, this is my company; who allowed you to come here? Get out!"
Lin Fan said with a smile, "Don’t be in such a hurry to kick me out; meet your old friend, say hello first."
As he spoke, Lin Fan threw the person in his hand onto the ground.
The person struggled to get up, revealing an elderly man almost of grandfatherly age.
Old friend?
Feng Wanshan was stunned, took a closer look, and suddenly his expression changed, blurting out, "It’s you!"
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s right, meeting an old friend should carry some surprise."
Anna asked curiously, "Lin Fan, who is this person?"
Lin Fan kicked the person and said, "Why don’t you introduce yourself."
The person, looking anxious, said, "My name is Zhou Dacai. Back then, I was a bank executive responsible for handling Feng Wanshan’s loan. This loan amounted to two billion, but it wasn’t a normal loan business. This two billion had another origin. I accepted benefits from Feng Wanshan and helped him launder money under the guise of a loan."
Everyone was shocked; this is actually true!
Feng Wanshan said furiously, "Zhou Dacai, shut up, stop spouting nonsense!"
Zhou Dacai said, "I’m not spouting nonsense, Feng Wanshan. You know I’m not spouting nonsense. If necessary, I can also provide evidence."
Upon hearing this, Feng Wanshan collapsed weakly in his seat.
He never imagined Zhou Dacai would come forward to testify against him; perhaps the truth from back then couldn’t be concealed any longer.
Lin Fan said with a smile, "That’s correct, this is the right way to solve the case. We need to address each doubt one by one. Now the question is, Feng Wanshan, if this two billion wasn’t given to you by the bank, then where did it come from?"

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Simply Bought It
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 490: Simply Bought It
Feng Wanshan’s face turned ashen. The scandal involving bank loans from years ago was already solid evidence. Lin Fan had even brought Zhou Dacai, who helped with laundering money back then, leaving Feng Wanshan with no room to argue.
Getting Zhou Dacai to cooperate was not a difficult task for Lin Fan. With the help of the police, Lin Fan found out that Zhou Dacai was the one who helped Feng Wanshan acquire the loan back then. Currently, Zhou Dacai was embroiled in a financial dispute, and if not handled properly, Zhou Dacai would face financial ruin, bringing disaster upon his only granddaughter as well.
Lin Fan promised to help Zhou Dacai resolve this dispute on the condition that he reveals the truth about Feng Wanshan’s loan from back then.
To protect his granddaughter, Zhou Dacai eventually agreed to Lin Fan’s terms.
However, Zhou Dacai was quite timid. He hesitated at the entrance of Shengshi Group, even thinking about backing out, but Lin Fan dragged him in forcefully like a small chicken.
With Zhou Dacai’s testimony, Feng Wanshan could no longer deny it.
Feng Wanshan’s face was gloomy as he sneered, "Even if I laundered money back then, so what? How can you know where my 200 million came from?"
Lin Fan replied, "You got it from An Jincheng."
Feng Wanshan said, "It didn’t come from him! As for where it came from, I don’t need to tell you."
Lin Fan said, "This 200 million came from selling a diamond called the Gamera Diamond, which was a burial artifact of the Pharaoh of Egypt. Am I right?"
Feng Wanshan’s complexion subtly changed. Lin Fan had actually revealed the origin of the diamond!
Lin Fan continued, "Our investigation showed that fifteen years ago, not long after An Jincheng disappeared, this Camilla Diamond appeared in an underground auction and was sold for a sky-high price of 200 million. Isn’t that a coincidence?"
Feng Wanshan sneered, "That still doesn’t prove it was me. My 200 million has a different source and has nothing to do with this diamond. It’s just a coincidence!"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t be hasty, let’s take it slow. We tracked down this auction, and back then, the auction was handled by an institution called Celestial Treasure Auction House. It’s still in operation today. When we asked them to disclose the seller of that year, they refused. After all, maintaining client confidentiality is very important for an auction house. And this Celestial Treasure Auction House is quite impressive, even refused to cooperate with the police."
Hearing this, Feng Wanshan laughed, "Lin Fan, I thought you were something, but you can’t even find out who the seller was back then. You’re just talking nonsense here, trying to pin a crime on me! Anna, you see, Lin Fan has no evidence, he’s just making wild guesses. Can you really trust someone like him?"
Anna replied, "..."
Anna was now calm, she couldn’t trust Feng Wanshan but was also cautious about Loli and Lin Fan. She only recognized evidence.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Don’t worry, I said really, don’t worry, let me finish. The Celestial Treasure Auction House was indeed outstanding, refusing to cooperate even with the police. In a fit of anger, I invested and bought the Celestial Treasure Auction House outright.
What?
Everyone was sweating profusely.
Damn!
That’s ruthless!
To outright buy an auction house on a whim, only Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, could do such a thing.
Purchasing Celestial Treasure Auction House didn’t cost Lin Fan much. He enlisted the help of Feng Ruolan. It turned out, Celestial Treasure Auction House was already facing operational issues, just waiting for a savior.
Lin Fan aimed to acquire the historical records of Celestial Treasure Auction House and possibly find use for it in the future, like organizing charity auctions, so he got Feng Ruolan’s help, and at a reasonable price, took over the Celestial Treasure Auction House.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Now that I own Celestial Treasure Auction House, I naturally have access to all its historical records, including the auction of the Camilla Diamond from 15 years ago. The 200 million transaction eventually flowed to a mysterious overseas account. Through the operation of this account, it ended up in the bank and was then transferred into Shengshi Group’s account, completing the money laundering. The seller of that diamond back in the day was you, Feng Wanshan. If anyone doesn’t believe me, I can publicly disclose all the records."
Loli stared at Feng Wanshan, "Feng Wanshan, do you have anything else to say?"
Feng Wanshan’s face turned white. He never expected Lin Fan would manage to acquire the entire Celestial Treasure Auction House!
Everyone knew how much Celestial Treasure Auction House valued client privacy, and it was virtually impossible for them to leak client information.
Who would’ve thought Lin Fan wouldn’t play by the rules, and simply bought the Celestial Treasure Auction House!
Now that the auction house belonged to Lin Fan, he could access any records he wanted!
The evidence was incontrovertible!
There was no denying it!
Feng Wanshan had no choice but to admit it. He snorted coldly, "Yes, I did sell the Camilla Diamond back then, but that diamond was originally mine, I bought it from someone else, not from Jin City. This diamond has nothing to do with Jin City!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Is that so!"
Feng Wanshan, now smug, said, "Lin Fan, all your hard investigation work for what? So what if you found the 200 million had another source, so what if you found it was me who sold the Camilla Diamond, what can you do? Can you prove this diamond belonged to Jin City? Can you prove I robbed Jin City? You can’t prove it, it’s absolutely impossible!"
Lin Fan asked, "Why do you say that?"
Feng Wanshan replied, "Because the secret of the Camilla Diamond is only known to me in this world now. Originally, Jin City knew, but unfortunately he’s deceased, so I’m the only one left who knows, no outsider could possibly know!"
Lin Fan said, "In that photo of you and An Jincheng holding the Camilla Diamond, it was An Jincheng holding it."
Feng Wanshan sneered, "So what, what does that prove? The Camilla Diamond is mine, I was just letting Jin City take a photo with it, he returned it to me right after."
Feng Wanshan smugly looked at Lin Fan, thinking there’s nothing more Lin Fan could say now!
However, Lin Fan responded, "Then there’s no other way, we can only revisit that archaeological expedition back then."
Many years ago, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng were soon-to-be university graduates who joined their mentor and classmates on a team expedition to Egypt for an archaeological dig.
While entering a Pharaoh’s Tomb, they encountered an unfortunate event. The tomb collapsed, and they narrowly escaped unharmed.
Afterwards, when tallying the artifacts excavated from the Pharaoh’s Tomb, they discovered two treasures were missing. At the time, everyone assumed they were buried due to the collapse.
Little did they know, those two treasures were secretly taken by Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng.
Later, they even took photos to commemorate, which turned into that photo displayed on Feng Wanshan’s desktop.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 The Truth Revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 491 The Truth Revealed
"We questioned those who participated in that archaeological activity back then. Unfortunately, your mentor passed away early on. We only found your classmates. According to them, the diamond in An Jincheng’s hand in the photos is the Camilla Diamond that went missing from the Pharaoh’s Tomb. They were also surprised that it was you who took it. So, you two indeed stole the treasures from the Pharaoh’s Tomb. This is irrefutable," Lin Fan said calmly.
Anna broke into a cold sweat. She never thought that her father was actually a thief!
However, a diamond worth 200 million, if given the chance, many probably wouldn’t be able to resist the temptation!
Feng Wanshan chuckled, "Alright, we did steal the Camilla Diamond, but that diamond belongs to me. It never belonged to Jin City!"
Lin Fan said, "Two treasures went missing in total. You guys wouldn’t have had any reason not to share the spoils, right?"
Feng Wanshan said, "No comment."
Lin Fan said, "It doesn’t matter if you don’t say. We can find out. You obtained one of the two treasures, and the Camilla Diamond went to An Jincheng. You sold your piece early on, and with the money you founded Shengshi Company. You can’t deny it, as we’ve verified this through tracing your financial sources. So, you forcefully took the Camilla Diamond from An Jincheng!"
Feng Wanshan argued, "Nonsense! The Camilla Diamond was mine. Back then we obtained two treasures, and Jin City didn’t want them. He gave them both to me! This is something only the two of us know, so you can’t prove whether it’s true or false!"
Lin Fan remained silent, seemingly stumped.
Feng Wanshan gleefully sneered, "Lin Fan, you can’t prove that this Camilla Diamond belongs to Jin City, so you can’t prove that I robbed him!"
"Hahaha..."
"Lin Fan, all your efforts have been in vain!"
"Let me tell you! This Camilla Diamond is mine, and Jin City’s disappearance is purely a coincidence in terms of timing!"
"Jin City’s disappearance was baffling, and I was anxious, searching for many years until I lost hope and dared not continue searching."
Loli couldn’t help but say, "Is that so? Then how do you explain that our witness said An Jincheng was hesitant to help out a friend in need back then?"
Zheng Yang told Lin Fan and Loli that back in the day, An Jincheng confided in him about a friend in trouble who only he could help, but he didn’t know whether he should help. This friend’s importance was second only to his daughter, Anna.
Feng Wanshan coldly said, "How would I know? Jin City didn’t just have me as a friend. Maybe some friend of his faced a minor issue. As for this so-called importance, second only to his daughter, that’s very subjective. Only he could confirm it. You claim it’s me, but that’s baseless!"
"How can you say that!"
Anna suddenly exclaimed, "I never expected such words to come from you! To think my father treated you as a brother, yet now you’re saying this to save yourself from blame. You won’t even acknowledge that bond!"
Feng Wanshan blushed, "I don’t know what you’re talking about, don’t speak rashly. I did share a great bond with your father, but now that it involves a case, I can’t take the fall."
Anna angrily said, "Take the fall for what? Father often told me to treat you like my biological father because you were his best brother—not his blood brother, but better than one. He said it himself. For him, the person important next to me was none other than you. Don’t you know that? You can’t forsake gratitude for your self-defense!"
"..."
Feng Wanshan was left speechless by her retort.
Anna continued, "Moreover, I can prove that this Camilla Diamond was my father’s!"
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Loli said joyfully, "Miss An, you can prove it?"
Anna nodded, still somewhat emotional, "Once, while tidying up at home, I inadvertently saw this diamond. Back then, I didn’t know what it was, only that it was beautiful, and I took it to look at it. But my father took it back. He said I couldn’t touch it because if it got damaged, it would be troublesome. I asked him what it was and what it was for, but he wouldn’t say. He just said that it couldn’t be disclosed until I grew up, as it would eventually belong to me. I was young at the time and didn’t pay much mind, and we were very poor, so I never thought the diamond was related to money. It wasn’t until just now when Lin Fan mentioned the diamond that I recalled. Isn’t that enough to prove the Camilla Diamond was my father’s?"
Feng Wanshan’s face turned pale.
Loli said excitedly, "That’s great, Miss An, what you’ve said is crucial."
Lin Fan smiled, "Anna’s words are enough to prove that the Camilla Diamond belonged to An Jincheng, and even if Anna hadn’t said it, I’d already found the evidence."
Feng Wanshan was shocked and couldn’t help asking, "Lin Fan, stop trying to scare people. What evidence could you possibly have!"
Lin Fan said, "It’s simple. I found the person who bought the Camilla Diamond for 200 million 15 years ago. The diamond is still with this person. I asked him to show it to me. Upon my observation, An Jincheng had long marked this diamond. This mark is undetectable to the average person, but viewed through a microscope, it shows Anna’s name engraved on it."
With superior insight, Lin Fan, of course, didn’t need a microscope to spot this mark.
The police, through microscopic observation, have secured this evidence.
Double verification, irrefutable proof!
"Ah!"
Feng Wanshan could no longer hold on and collapsed.
At this point, the truth mostly surfaced.
Years ago, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng, under the mentorship of their tutor, went for an archaeological dig at the Pharaoh’s Tomb in Egypt. Due to an incident, they seized the chance to steal two relics.
One of them was the Camilla Diamond!
Subsequently, An Jincheng obtained the Camilla Diamond, while Feng Wanshan acquired the other treasure.
Feng Wanshan later sold his treasure for a significant sum and founded Shengshi Group.
years ago, Feng Wanshan’s company faced financial troubles. He sought help from An Jincheng, who refused. Feng Wanshan then killed An Jincheng to seize the Camilla Diamond and subsequently had it auctioned off at the Celestial Treasure Auction House.
The auction’s 200 million proceeds, after being laundered, eventually turned into a bank loan and entered Shengshi Group’s account.
Shengshi Group was thus saved, and it was all at the cost of An Jincheng’s life!
Anna finally understood, trembling with anger, as she stared at Feng Wanshan, "Why? Why did you do this? What exactly did you do to my father? Spit it out!"

chapters.title: Chapter 492 Tomb Raiding
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 492 Tomb Raiding
Egypt, Pharaoh’s Tomb.
This is the latest excavated tomb, still under excavation. Under the guidance of archaeological experts, workers are busy inside the tomb, with clanging sounds everywhere.
An archaeological expert from Huaxia, leading a group of students, is visiting the tomb.
This opportunity is extremely rare. The Huaxia archaeological expert had visited Egypt as a visiting scholar before and became friends with the Egyptian expert presiding over this excavation. It was precisely because of this connection that the students of the Huaxia archeologist had the opportunity to visit the Pharaoh’s Tomb, an opportunity that many envy.
The students, with curious eyes wide open, are looking around, deeply attracted by the surroundings.
Among them, two boys walk together, their eyes shining.
"Brother Shan, look at these artifacts, each one is priceless!" one boy exclaims.
The other boy nods: "Indeed, if we owned one, it would be great. We wouldn’t have to be so poor. I’m tired of being poor."
Both of them gaze at these artifacts with greedy eyes.
These two are An Jincheng and Feng Wanshan.
At this point, they are just poor students, eager to change their circumstances. However, change is easier said than done; for a poor person to become rich, a great opportunity is needed.
At this moment, they were merely sighing at the sight of the artifacts, knowing that even if they had the intent to steal, they had no chance.
But it seemed the heavens heard their unspoken desires, as an unexpected event occurred in the Pharaoh’s Tomb.
A quake shook the ground, with sand and stone falling down.
Someone shouted, "Oh no, the tomb is collapsing!"
"Run for your lives!"
The scene turned chaotic, with everyone frantically trying to escape. In such circumstances, most people only think of saving their lives, for life is the most critical thing. If one’s life is lost, nothing else matters.
However, poverty-stricken Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng exchanged knowing glances, understanding without words that their opportunity had come.
The collapse eventually stopped, but most artifacts were buried, and several workers died.
Thankfully, the Huaxia teacher and students escaped in time, with no casualties among them, except that An Jincheng and Feng Wanshan lagged behind and were the last to come out.
Both were reprimanded by their mentor.
But they didn’t mind at all, because they had taken advantage of their slight delay to steal two unearthed artifacts - a Pharaoh’s Ring and a Camilla Diamond - which, being small, they hid on their persons without raising suspicion.
Later, they found a secluded place to take out and examine the two treasures, both feeling very excited.
"This ring of yours could sell for millions!" An Jincheng said with a laugh.
Feng Wanshan added, "Your diamond is even more incredible. I reckon it’s worth at least 3 million!"
One must know that in those years, 1 million was a huge sum, making millionaires rare tycoons.
These artifacts made them millionaires, changing their destinies, filling them with indescribable joy.
Feng Wanshan suggested, "This is the decisive moment we change our fate. Why don’t we take a picture to commemorate it?"
So they set up the camera, with Feng Wanshan wearing the Pharaoh’s Ring and An Jincheng holding the Camilla Diamond, capturing a group photo.
Feng Wanshan kept this photo, later using it as his computer desktop. Every time he saw it, he recalled that day, possibly the happiest moment of their lives, filled with the excitement of an imminent change of destiny, unforgettable indeed.
After the incident, archaeologists conducted a rescue at the Pharaoh’s Tomb and re-excavated buried artifacts.
Eventually, they discovered that two top-tier artifacts were missing!
There were two possibilities: one was that they were buried so deeply that their small size made them nearly impossible to find, perhaps even disappearing into crevices.
The second possibility was that someone stole them during the tomb collapse, making off with the two treasures amidst the chaos.
The second possibility led to a sudden inspection of everyone present that day.
Unfortunately, they didn’t find the Camilla Diamond or that Pharaoh’s Ring, despite even searching through Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng’s luggage.
It turned out, Feng Wanshan and An Jincheng had already prepared, burying the two treasures on-site, planning to retrieve them at a suitable time.
Years later, both had long since graduated, each establishing families and careers.
Unwilling to endure poverty, Feng Wanshan always dreamed of being a boss. But without any background, starting a business was extremely difficult; he met obstacles everywhere and remained poor.
