In contrast, An Jincheng resigned himself to an ordinary life, becoming a teacher. Though ordinary, his life was at least stable.
Especially after his wife bore him a daughter after ten months of pregnancy, An Jincheng transformed completely, no longer dreaming of being wealthy. With his wife and daughter, he was the happiest man in the world.
Alas, fate was unkind. An Jincheng’s wife suddenly fell ill, and because they had no money for treatment, they missed the best treatment time, leading to her untimely death.
An Jincheng was in deep sorrow.
At this time, Feng Wanshan found An Jincheng, saying it was time they went to Egypt.
So they went to Egypt to retrieve the buried Pharaoh’s Ring and Camilla Diamond, bringing them back to Huaxia without anyone knowing.
After returning, Feng Wanshan couldn’t wait to sell the Pharaoh’s Ring, earning millions.
Feng Wanshan used this money to establish Shengshi Company, flourishing thereafter. The Shengshi Group gradually expanded, eventually going public, with a market value exceeding billions, transforming Feng Wanshan from a poor boy to the richest man in Yun City.
However, An Jincheng did not sell the Camilla Diamond. After his wife’s incident, he understood the importance of money. He didn’t want his daughter to suffer, so he had long decided to leave the Camilla Diamond for his daughter, Anna.
If nothing unexpected happened, An Jincheng planned to personally hand over the diamond to Anna when she grew up, ensuring she never had to worry about money for the rest of her life.
However, the unexpected still came.
Several years had passed again, and Anna had grown into a sensible little girl.
One day, Feng Wanshan suddenly found An Jincheng: "Ah-Cheng, my company is in trouble, there’s a nearly 200 million funding gap. If I can’t find the money to fill this hole, I’m done for."
An Jincheng said, "What can we do then?"
Feng Wanshan replied, "How about this, you sell that Camilla Diamond. At the current market rate, this ring could fetch 200 million. Treat this money as a loan to me to solve the urgent crisis, and I’ll pay you back later."

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Ding! You Have Successfully Subdued
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 493: Ding! You Have Successfully Subdued
An Jincheng finally realized that Feng Wanshan’s visit was not for anything good; it turns out he was eyeing that diamond.
"Sorry, I won’t sell this diamond. My life is just average right now, but I don’t lack money. I plan to leave this diamond for Anna after I die and let her handle it," An Jincheng said, directly refusing Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan persuaded, "It’s ultimately about money. When I earn money, I’ll pay you back double!"
Feng Wanshan tried to convince An Jincheng, but An Jincheng was stubborn and refused to agree.
Feng Wanshan became anxious because if he didn’t get money soon, the company would face bankruptcy.
He even started to resent An Jincheng; a friend in trouble, and An Jincheng didn’t show any sympathy.
Ultimately, Feng Wanshan made a risky decision; he was going to steal An Jincheng’s Pharaoh’s Ring.
Fifteen years ago, there weren’t even street lights, let alone surveillance.
On this day, An Jincheng went out to school and suddenly disappeared. He vanished without a trace, and no one knew where he went. Due to the lack of surveillance, the police were helpless, and the case remained an unsolved mystery.
At that time, no one linked An Jincheng with wealth, so even when Feng Wanshan later overcame his financial difficulties, it went unnoticed.
Until fifteen years later, Lin Fan cracked this cold case in just a few days.
With the overwhelming facts like a hammer, Feng Wanshan had no opportunity for rebuttal.
It was Feng Wanshan who stole the Camilla Diamond from An Jincheng!
Anna was emotionally stirred: "Why did you do this?"
With the evidence so conclusive, Feng Wanshan knew his chances of overturning were minimal, so he simply stopped pretending, sneering: "He and I are good brothers, I thought, when a good brother is in trouble, you should help. But what about your father? He came and told me that his daughter was the most important person to him and he would pass the diamond to her, showing no concern for my interests. What kind of brother is that, is he even human!"
"If you don’t show loyalty, don’t blame me for being unkind!"
Feng Wanshan seemed like a different person, wearing a menacing smile on his face.
This smile made Anna increasingly angry, and she lunged forward to hit Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan instinctively dodged, but he was no match for Anna, who was about to land a hit on him.
Loli timely stopped Anna, saying, "Miss An, be rational. If you injure him, it won’t benefit us. This time, we should let the law deal with him!"
Feng Wanshan chuckled: "Anna, you even dare to hit me? You’re really rebelling. Think about it, after your father disappeared, who was taking care of you? If it weren’t for me as your adoptive father, would you have what you have today!"
Anna shouted angrily: "Shut up, you shameless scum! If it weren’t for you harming my father, would I need to be taken care of?"
Realizing that all these years she had been calling her father’s murderer her adoptive father, treating him like her biological father, Anna felt a wave of nausea.
"Tell me, what did you do to my father!" Anna demanded in fury.
Feng Wanshan chuckled, "I won’t tell you. In this world, only I know the truth. If I don’t speak, you’ll never find him!"
"Bastard!"
Anna gritted her teeth and wanted to hit Feng Wanshan again. This Feng Wanshan was truly shameless.
Loli said, "Miss An, don’t worry. We’ll take Feng Wanshan away for questioning and hope to get answers soon. Feng Wanshan, you can’t refuse arrest now, take him away!"
With Loli’s command, the police nearby went to handcuff and escort Feng Wanshan away.
The chairman has been arrested!
This news quickly spread within Shengshi Group, especially among the office staff who witnessed the police escorting Feng Wanshan with cuffs on him, leaving everyone stunned.
What exactly is going on? Why was the chairman suddenly arrested?
Zhou Dacai from the bank was also arrested, suspected of helping Feng Wanshan launder money years ago.
In the chairman’s office, only Lin Fan and Anna remained.
Anna couldn’t accept this cruel truth for a moment; the adoptive father she always respected turned out to be the murderer of her father! Although she had suspected it before, the undeniable evidence still left her unable to accept it.
Lin Fan comforted, "It’s okay, if you’re sad, just let it out."
Hearing this, Anna couldn’t hold back anymore and broke down in tears.
In front of Lin Fan, the usually aloof woman showed her most vulnerable side.
Lin Fan was a bit delighted.
He activated the Inner Vision System.
"System Task: Tame Anna
System Level: Important
Task Progress 99/100"
It seems this case’s resolution made Anna’s fondness for him soar. Just a little bit more, and he could completely tame Anna and finish the system task.
Lin Fan walked next to Anna, sat down, and said: "You can use my shoulder for a while."
Anna was indeed very fragile and lonely at this moment, so she immediately reached out and hugged Lin Fan’s shoulder, resting her head on it.
Soon, Lin Fan’s shoulder was soaked by Anna’s tears.
After crying heartily, Anna indeed felt much better, and she moved away from Lin Fan’s shoulder, a bit embarrassed seeing it wet.
"Thank you." Anna said, with a blush on her face.
Lin Fan smiled, "Thank me for what?"
Anna said, "Thank you for everything you’ve done. If it weren’t for you, this case couldn’t have been solved."
Indeed, Lin Fan played a crucial role in the investigation of this case, even a decisive role.
Lin Fan said, "How do you plan to repay me? My manor still lacks a housekeeper. Would you consider coming back to help me?"
Anna was surprised: "I was once sent as a spy by Feng Wanshan to your side, and you still want to use me?"
Lin Fan laughed, "Of course! I couldn’t find a better housekeeper than you. Without you, these days I feel uncomfortable. I’ve been hoping you’d come back to help me."
Everyone desires to be needed, Anna was no exception, especially at this moment. Lin Fan’s words made Anna feel much better, and she couldn’t help but smile. This smile was truly beautiful.
Lin Fan was a bit taken aback.
He activated the Inner Vision System again.
"System Task: Tame Anna
System Level: Important
Task Progress 100/100"
Task Completed!
At this moment, the system’s notification sounded.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host for successfully completing the task of taming Anna. Anna is now wholeheartedly loyal to you. You can assign her a job."
"Ding!"
"System task completed, you will receive a special reward shortly, please stay tuned."
Lin Fan was pleasantly surprised, every time a task is completed, there would be a special reward. He wonders what the special reward would be this time?
Lin Fan truly hopes it’s not money again; he’s become numb to receiving money and wants the system to offer something different.
"So, do you want to be my housekeeper? No, I want to give you a different title. You’ll be my personal assistant. I believe you’ll become a great assistant for me." Lin Fan said.
With the system’s endorsement, he believed Anna would agree.
Sure enough, Anna didn’t hesitate, "You helped me solve the case, this great favor, I have no way to repay. In the future, I’ll repay you by acting like a slave or horse. Whatever you ask me to do, I’ll do."

chapters.title: Chapter 494: Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Jiansheng
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 494: Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Jiansheng
Cherry Entertainment Company.
Feng Tianming sat in the reception room, waiting quietly. He had been here for an hour, but showed no sign of impatience.
There was no other way; the person he was about to meet was the head of Cherry Entertainment, the third son of the Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Jiansheng.
He dared not be impatient.
Wei Jiansheng had just returned from a vacation abroad and wanted to meet Feng Tianming. Feng Tianming came immediately, but upon arrival, he learned that Wei Jiansheng was in a meeting, so he waited there.
Earlier today, Feng Tianming had gone to Wenyue Company, attempting to blackmail Lin Fan with some photos, but failed, only realizing then that he was played by Lin Fan.
Feng Tianming was still fuming, thinking about how to get back at Lin Fan. If it weren’t for Wei Jiansheng’s summons, he would have gone back to discuss with Feng Wanshan.
Being slapped in the face by Lin Fan yet again, he was unwilling to accept it.
Besides relying on his father Feng Wanshan, Feng Tianming also had some expectations of Wei Jiansheng. If Wei Jiansheng could also deal with Lin Fan, that would be ideal, as Wei Jiansheng had a powerful background, being the son of the richest man in Jiangnan, and Lin Fan certainly wouldn’t be his match.
"Mr. Feng, Mr. Wei has finished his meeting. You can go see him now," a secretary in professional attire came in.
Feng Tianming hastily stood up, tidied his clothes, and nervously said, "Thank you."
He couldn’t help but be nervous. Who was Wei Jiansheng? Someone Feng Tianming wouldn’t dare provoke, nor could afford to provoke!
Following the secretary, he entered a very spacious office. The office’s decor was extremely luxurious and high-end, something only the wealthy could afford.
In front of the bright floor-to-ceiling window, a middle-aged man sat on an office chair. This man wore glasses and had a neat, genteel appearance. He wore casual clothes, seemingly laid-back, but this outfit was actually a custom luxury brand that ordinary people could neither afford nor find.
"Mr. Wei." Feng Tianming immediately bowed, very humbly.
This middle-aged man was Wei Jiansheng!
"You’re here. Have a seat." Wei Jiansheng smiled, appearing very affable.
Feng Tianming sat down on the sofa, facing Wei Jiansheng.
Feng Tianming awkwardly smiled and said, "Mr. Wei, you called me over. Is there anything you would like to instruct?"
Wei Jiansheng said, "Tianming, do you know why I originally acquired your company?"
For Mr. Wei to bring this up right away seemed ominous. Feng Tianming was a bit nervous, trying hard to organize his thoughts, chuckling, "Um...Mr. Wei probably sees potential in the company’s development."
Wei Jiansheng nodded, "You’re half-right. Whether a company can grow depends on the people! It was you that I saw value in."
Feng Tianming was flattered, "Thank you, Mr. Wei."
Wei Jiansheng said, "The entertainment industry is a very lucrative field, there’s money everywhere; it’s just about whether you know how to pick it up. When I established Cherry Entertainment, that’s what I had my eye on. In the end, it all boils down to money! Money is the key to everything, my main focus. However, making money in this field isn’t easy. Do you know how high the cost is to make an artist popular? It’s very high, unimaginably high! In today’s era of traffic, the cost of acquiring exposure is increasingly expensive. In any industry, people must constantly progress or else they fall behind. Although I’m known as an entertainment mogul, even I can become outdated if I’m not careful."
Feng Tianming listened quietly, not knowing what Wei Jiansheng was getting at.
Wei Jiansheng continued, "After the Creation Star program aired, I realized there was another way to play the game: using popularity to determine debut positions. This is a perfect star-making model. Every contestant who debuts is a future traffic star, even potentially a traffic giant. Unfortunately, I was behind and missed being the first to try it. But I don’t want to be left behind. I still want a piece of the action. Your girl group’s overall strength is excellent, and I’m optimistic, so I’m handing this opportunity to you."
As a bigwig in the entertainment circle, Wei Jiansheng had made some stars popular in the past, but as time changed, the stars under him gradually lost their fame, with significant popularity loss.
Facing this situation, even Wei Jiansheng didn’t have a good solution for a time, because in this era, making a star famous is not an easy task.
It wasn’t until the Creation Star program aired that Wei Jiansheng realized there was this new way to create stars.
After some investigation, he set his eyes on Feng Tianming’s girl group, believing they would perform well in Creation Star.
Cherry Entertainment then extended an olive branch to Feng Tianming.
Since it was Wei Jiansheng, Feng Tianming had no hesitation and immediately agreed to the acquisition, and soon announced the merger with Cherry Entertainment.
Wei Jiansheng naturally placed high hopes on Feng Tianming, and Feng Tianming had once thumped his chest and promised that he would not let Wei Jiansheng down.
All along, Feng Tianming had indeed done quite well. On one hand, he successfully reduced Ning Xiaoyue’s ranking significantly by targeting her. At the same time, his A-Class Player’s performance steadily improved, entering a debut position before the finals.
Everyone thought it was a secure win this time, including Wei Jiansheng.
Wei Jiansheng went abroad for a vacation with peace of mind.
However, when he returned from vacation, he found that Feng Tianming had already failed, and his A-Class Player had been eliminated!
At this point, Feng Tianming finally understood why Wei Jiansheng called him in today. It was certainly not to praise him, but clearly to question him.
Realizing this, Feng Tianming couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat.
"Mr. Wei, please let me explain..." Feng Tianming struggled to explain.
"Explain what? Explain why you failed?" Wei Jiansheng’s face turned cold, "Failure is failure, don’t give me excuses!"
Wei Jiansheng’s face instantly turned icy, rendering him terrifying.
Feng Tianming was so frightened that he slid off the sofa and fell to his knees with a thud.
"Mr. Wei, I’m sorry about failing, but I really did my best. It’s not my fault, it’s all because of Lin Fan!" Feng Tianming hurriedly said.
At this moment, Wei Jiansheng was extremely angry. Ever since learning about the results of the talent show, he had been furious.
For no other reason than he had bet on the wrong horse, placing his hopes on Feng Tianming, and Feng Tianming had failed. This meant his chance of getting a piece of the action was gone.
Failing to debut as a group, even if there is still some traffic temporarily, in the long run, it will soon be lost, rendering it worthless!
As a bigwig in the entertainment circle, where would Wei Jiansheng put his face? He didn’t want to accept such a failure!
"Lin Fan, that’s the capital behind Ning Xiaoyue, the richest man in Yun City, Lin Fan!" Wei Jiansheng said.
Feng Tianming said, "Exactly, this guy is extremely cunning. We were all played by him. Originally, I was about to bring down Ning Xiaoyue, but who knew he would fight back, even shutting down Yun City Daily? He deliberately let Ning Xiaoyue’s rankings drop, confusing the outside world. I let my guard down and didn’t continue targeting her."

chapters.title: Chapter 495: An Afternoon Vaporized 30 Billion!
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 495: An Afternoon Vaporized 30 Billion!
"At the finals, Ning Xiaoyue got third place. If I hadn’t relaxed and kept targeting her, the result might have been different. As it turned out, we were all played. Our people were stuck in tenth place, and the debut spot was taken by Ning Xiaoyue."
Feng Tianming gnashed his teeth. He felt indignant; if it weren’t for Ning Xiaoyue, and if Lin Fan didn’t exist, his people would have surely debuted.
Wei Jiansheng’s face was somber: "Lin Fan, truly worthy of being Yun City’s richest man."
Feng Tianming said, "Mr. Wei, you’ve got to stand up for me. Being played by Lin Fan like this, I’m really not reconciled!"
Wei Jiansheng asked, "So, what are you planning to do?"
Feng Tianming showed a ferocious look: "Even though Ning Xiaoyue debuted, I don’t plan to let her have an easy life!"
Wei Jiansheng shook his head and said, "Your vision is too narrow. Even if you make Ning Xiaoyue quit the group, besides venting your anger, what does it accomplish? It’s better to focus on the next talent show! I have a feeling that in the coming years, talent shows will dominate. This is indeed a perfect new star-making model. We missed out this time, but we absolutely can’t miss the next one. Start preparing now!"
Feng Tianming wiped his cold sweat and said, "Mr. Wei’s lesson is well-reasoned. As expected, Mr. Wei has great foresight. I deeply admire and bow to you. I will start working as per Mr. Wei’s intentions promptly. But... if Lin Fan isn’t taught a lesson, I really can’t swallow this anger..."
Wei Jiansheng sneered and said, "We’ll deal with Lin Fan later. The urgent task now is to prepare for the next talent show. I’ve already gathered information; next year, Creation Star’s second season will be a boy group talent show. This time we prepare in advance, and the goal is to take the C position! Do you have confidence?"
What Wei Jiansheng said clearly implied he didn’t plan to provoke Lin Fan.
Although Feng Tianming felt unwilling and very disappointed, he didn’t dare to say much else and said, "Yes!"
Wei Jiansheng said, "In fact, I’ve already chosen a candidate. Secretary, bring him in!"
The secretary went out and quickly brought in a young man, who looked a bit feminine, but was exactly the type of young idol girls liked these days.
"Let me introduce you, Zhou Wenkun. He’s currently a trainee under my company. He previously participated in a popular variety show. Although he didn’t win the championship, he gained decent popularity. His starting point is higher than most! Plus, his singing and dancing are very good, with an excellent appearance. He definitely has the strength to take the C position. I’ll leave him in your hands to manage. I hope you won’t disappoint me again. Kun Kun, greet Brother Ming." Wei Jiansheng said.
The young idol hurriedly bowed to Feng Tianming and smiled, "Brother Ming."
Feng Tianming was also very satisfied with this young idol. Indeed, he had great potential.
"Mr. Wei, rest assured. I will do my best to nurture him to take the C position." Feng Tianming said confidently.
Wei Jiansheng said, "That’s good. You can go back now."
Thus, Feng Tianming bid farewell and left.
After meeting Wei Jiansheng this time, Wei Jiansheng disagreed with continuing to go against Lin Fan. Honestly, Feng Tianming felt quite disappointed.
It seems Wei Jiansheng couldn’t be relied upon. Although he’s a big name in the entertainment industry, he wouldn’t act unless there’s a benefit.
In Wei Jiansheng’s view, dealing with Lin Fan was not a profitable endeavor.
But Feng Tianming couldn’t swallow this bitter pill himself. It seems, for now, he can only rely on his father Feng Wanshan.
Feng Wanshan also regarded Lin Fan as a mortal enemy. Especially given this recent scandal, they were both played by Lin Fan. Feng Wanshan certainly wouldn’t let Lin Fan off.
He looked forward to seeing how Feng Wanshan would deal with Lin Fan next, hoping he would cause Lin Fan’s company to go bankrupt. By then, with Ning Xiaoyue losing her support, she’d be at his mercy!
Thinking about it was thrilling.
After leaving Cherry Entertainment Company, Feng Tianming drove off, planning to find his father.
While driving, Feng Tianming glanced at the time. It was already noon, so he habitually turned on the radio.
"This is the midday news. According to reliable sources, Shengshi Group’s president, Feng Wanshan, has been arrested by the public security authorities for suspected involvement in a disappearance case from 15 years ago!"
"The news has just come out, and Shengshi Group’s stock price has plummeted..."
"Feng Wanshan is facing multiple charges, including murder and theft."
"Explosive insider details about Feng Wanshan’s arrest, stay tuned for our in-depth report!"
Gah!
The news continued, but Feng Tianming suddenly slammed on the brakes, stopping the car right in the middle of the road.
It was a bolt from the blue, Feng Tianming’s face turned pale in an instant.
His father, Feng Wanshan, was arrested?
A disappearance case, murder charges?
What in the world was going on?
Years ago, Feng Wanshan, along with An Jincheng, stole artifacts from the Pharaoh’s Tomb, each taking one item. Feng Wanshan sold his artifact, earning the capital to start his business.
However, 15 years ago, Shengshi Group faced a financial crisis. To secure funds, Feng Wanshan hijacked An Jincheng’s diamonds, and then auctioned them underground, gaining 200 million yuan, addressing the company’s financial woes, but An Jincheng vanished without a trace after that.
No one knew if he was alive or dead!
An Jincheng seemed to have vanished into thin air!
years was enough for the world to forget An Jincheng, while Feng Wanshan lived freely, even becoming Yun City’s richest man before Lin Fan took the title. Before Lin Fan arrived, Feng Wanshan was one of Yun City’s top three moguls.
After Lin Fan came, Feng Wanshan was ousted from the top three, but regardless, Shengshi Group was a big company, and Feng Wanshan remained wealthy.
So, when the scandal of Feng Wanshan’s arrest broke out, it quickly hit the hottest trends and topped the charts.
Feng Wanshan’s deeds were immediately condemned by countless netizens.
Adding insult to injury, Shengshi Group’s stock price began to plummet, hitting the limit down by the afternoon close!
In just an afternoon, Shengshi Group lost 30 billion!
Previously, after multiple confrontations with Lin Fan, Shengshi Group’s market value had already dropped below 100 billion, falling out of the billionaires’ club.
Feng Wanshan had been actively responding, planning to return to the billionaires’ club.
Who knew, this scandal blew up, and Shengshi Group seemed beyond salvation. With Feng Wanshan, the helmsman, arrested over such severe charges, it was a devastating blow to Shengshi Group.
One could foresee that Shengshi Group’s stock price would continue plummeting, even potentially leading to its closure!
"How could this happen, what went wrong?"
Feng Tianming was frantic.
He rushed back to Shengshi Group’s building anxiously.
He saw Lin Fan and Anna walking out of the building together, appearing friendly. Anna even deliberately walked half a step behind, like she was Lin Fan’s follower.
"Why is Lin Fan here? Could it be, my father’s arrest was his doing!"
The more he thought, the more it seemed so. Isn’t Anna his father’s adopted daughter? Now she was so close with Lin Fan, clearly betraying Feng Wanshan!
"Damn it, so damn hateful!"
Feng Tianming’s eyes were blazing with fury as he detested Lin Fan to the core. Suddenly, he stepped on the gas pedal, and the car abruptly charged forward, heading straight towards Lin Fan and Anna.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 496 Master
Feng Tianming hated Lin Fan to the extreme. He couldn’t count how many times Lin Fan had humiliated him. Losing to Lin Fan one billion in cash was nothing; the Feng Family had plenty of money.
But this time, Lin Fan caused his father, Feng Wanshan, to be arrested!
Enraged, Feng Tianming drove his car and charged straight at Lin Fan and Anna with the intent to kill Lin Fan.
However, Lin Fan and Anna were not ordinary people. Their quick reactions allowed them to dodge to the sides immediately.
Feng Tianming’s car then crashed toward the mansion. He quickly slammed on the brakes, narrowly avoiding the heavy glass doors, and instantly broke out in a cold sweat.
He had nearly made a grave mistake in his fury.
Yet he remained incredibly angry; he indeed wished Lin Fan would die.
Then, Feng Tianming opened the car door and stepped out.
"Oh, it’s Young Master Feng, huh? Your driving skills aren’t quite up to the mark," Lin Fan chuckled. When Feng Tianming suddenly drove over, it certainly surprised Lin Fan, but this level of attack didn’t pose any threat to him.
Feng Tianming gritted his teeth and said, "Lin Fan, did you cause my father to be arrested?"
Lin Fan replied, "I only ensured he received the punishment he deserved."
Feng Tianming gritted his teeth and asked, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said, "It seems you don’t know what your father has done. Anna, why don’t you tell him?"
Anna nodded, "Yes, Master."
Lin Fan solved the case of An Jincheng’s disappearance, finally winning Anna over and completing the system’s task, which had been ongoing for quite some time.
Anna wanted to repay Lin Fan and was willing to do anything for him. She willingly became Lin Fan’s subordinate.
Above all, she was grateful that Lin Fan helped her solve the case. Without him, she couldn’t imagine how long it would have taken, and perhaps she would have been deceived by Feng Wanshan for a lifetime.
Anna was utterly convinced by Lin Fan. Lin Fan’s strength in every aspect was terrifying. Anna always appreciated strong men, yet since she was powerful herself, few men in the world could catch her eye.
Lin Fan was an exception. He was the man she was willing to kneel down and call lord, so formidable!
Anna henceforth submitted to Lin Fan; she wanted to follow this man, as she had nowhere else to go.
So she called him "Master" just as she did when she was the housekeeper at Yunding Manor, but this time it was sincere.
She was still kind of the housekeeper at Yunding Manor, but not limited to managing just one place. She was Lin Fan’s life assistant and would do anything he asked.
"My father, An Jincheng, used to be good brothers with your father. Fifteen years ago, my father mysteriously disappeared, without a trace for fifteen years..."
Anna briefly recounted the events.
Feng Tianming was stunned after hearing it.
Feng Wanshan was actually the culprit behind An Jincheng’s disappearance! It was something he could never have imagined. His billionaire father had such a filthy past!
"The Shengshi Group’s current prosperity, your family’s luxurious villas and cars, all were built upon my father’s blood!" Anna said coldly.
The hatred of a father’s murder is irreconcilable!
If she could, she would even want to personally kill Feng Wanshan to avenge her father.
Lin Fan said, "Young Master Feng, now you understand, right? Feng Wanshan ended up like this entirely due to his own actions. No one else is to blame. Instead of getting angry here, you should clean up the mess your father left behind."
Because of Feng Wanshan’s arrest, the stock price of Shengshi Group had already started plummeting, evaporating thirty billion in one afternoon!
Once Feng Wanshan’s evildoings are made public, the situation of Shengshi Group will only get worse. It indeed is a mess, and this time, Shengshi Group is likely to crumble and face legal sanctions!
The good days for the Feng Family are over.
Feng Tianming’s face turned pale, cold sweat poured down, and he slumped powerlessly to the ground.
Lin Fan stepped forward, patted Feng Tianming’s shoulder, then turned around and left with Anna.
The fall of the Feng Family had happened. Lin Fan once aimed to surpass Shengshi Group, but now the Feng Family was no longer worth mentioning.
Anna got into Lin Fan’s Rolls-Royce and drove away from Shengshi Mansion, never looking back.
Feng Tianming just sat there, slumped for a long, long time, his fists gradually clenched tightly, gritting his teeth.
"Lin Fan, I will not let you go. Even if my father killed someone, so what? This world is survival of the fittest, victors are kings, losers are outcasts! I am grateful to my father because, thanks to his efforts, I have had glory and wealth. But you have caused my family such misery, I will definitely take revenge!" Feng Tianming vowed hatefully.
Although he didn’t yet know how to retaliate, he would eventually get back at Lin Fan. He wanted Lin Fan to experience the feeling of utter defeat, to see Lin Fan show a look of painful despair, just like he did now!
In the Rolls-Royce.
Anna asked, "Master, where are we going now?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Take you back to Yunding Manor, you haven’t been back in a long time, right? Neither have I."
Anna smiled gently, indeed, she hadn’t been back for a long time, and she did miss it a bit.
So Lin Fan drove to Yunding Manor.
When the vehicle reached an intersection, it was a red light, so Lin Fan stopped the car to wait.
After a moment, while the light was still red, a black car beside them bypassed Lin Fan’s car and sped out, attempting to run the red light.
From the left, a small car was driving normally. Upon suddenly seeing the black car, the driver reacted in time and quickly braked, but due to inertia, couldn’t slow down completely and grazed the black car.
Both cars came to a stop.
Two burly men got out of the black car, cigarettes dangling from their mouths, looking very cocky.
"Damn it, you dare hit my car, get out here!"
One burly man walked to the front of the small car, pointed at the driver, and shouted ferociously.
The small car’s driver got out; he was a man in his fifties, looking quite honest and sincere.
The uncle’s face turned red at this moment, evidently very nervous, as these two burly men looked like trouble!
But he knew it wasn’t his fault and wanted to defend himself, "It wasn’t my fault, you ran the red light."
The burly man got angry, "What did you say, you old thing, say it again?"
The other burly man said menacingly, "Don’t say anything useless; you hit our car, it’s a fact. Dare to deny, and I’ll beat you up!"
The uncle was very frightened, starting to tremble, "Can’t you guys be reasonable?"
A girl got out of the small car as well; she wasn’t bad-looking and hurried over, pulling the uncle’s sleeve, persuading, "Dad, let it go, don’t argue with them."
She was the uncle’s daughter, worried he might suffer a loss. If the other party starts a fight, her father surely wouldn’t be able to hold his ground, so she came over intending to calm things down.

chapters.title: Chapter 497: Did You Enjoy It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 497: Did You Enjoy It?
"Oh big brothers, I’m sorry, it was my dad driving carelessly, please accept our apologies." The girl nodded and bowed.
The two burly men saw this and their expressions slightly softened.
"This little beauty is more sensible. Fine, since you admit it was this old man who hit our car, then compensate us!" one of the burly men said.
The girl said, "How much do you want? I think it was just a scratch, a bit of paint shouldn’t cost much."
The burly man said, "You make it sound so easy, but you need to look at what kind of car we drive. This car is our boss’s favorite, worth about a million; you think a bit of paint won’t cost much?"
The girl’s face changed and she said, "Then how much do you want?"
The burly man said, "Just 100,000, since you’re sensible, we’ll only charge you the repair fee. I won’t bother about the delay to my time."
"What, 100,000?" the uncle exclaimed.
The girl said, "Big brothers, you’re asking for too much, how could it be as much as 100,000!"
The burly man’s face darkened: "What, you don’t want to pay?"
The girl said, "It’s not that we don’t want to pay, but you’re over-exaggerating. The most I can give you is 500, and to be honest, it was you who ran the red light first. Really, we shouldn’t even need to pay 500, but I just don’t want trouble, I hope you two won’t push it, and let’s end it here."
These words angered the two burly men.
"Damn girl, what nonsense are you talking about!" one burly man cursed.
The other burly man stared at the girl, his eyes flashing with malice, and said with a sneer, "I have a good idea, you don’t have to pay if you want, just come and have some fun with us and we’ll forget about it."
They were actually harassing the girl!
The uncle was furious and scared, his face turning even redder: "What did you say, talking like that, you’re just animals!"
The girl blushed with shame: "You have no shame!"
The burly man sneered: "Listen, you either pay up or accompany us, choose one, or I ensure you’ll regret it. We’re not people you can mess with!"
The girl didn’t want to argue with them anymore, took out her phone: "I choose to call the police!"
But her phone was snatched away by one of the burly men the next second.
Bang!
The burly man slapped the girl’s face and cursed: "Damn girl, you think you’re something, calling the police, huh? You think I’m scared? You should ask around who’s in charge here!"
The burly man then smashed the girl’s phone on the ground, stomped on it, and shattered the screen.
"Go ahead, try calling the police!" the burly man sneered.
Arrogant!
They were so arrogant.
"Bro, I don’t think this girl’s going to pay, let’s just take her, see if she’s still so haughty!" another one said.
"Good idea, damn girl, come with us!" the burly man said with a grim laugh, grabbing the girl’s hand, trying to forcefully take her away.
The uncle was scared pale and rushed to try to save his daughter, but the other burly man pushed him to the ground easily; in front of the burly man, the uncle was powerless.
The girl was terrified and exclaimed: "Help, they’re kidnapping me!"
The burly man sneered: "Go ahead and scream, let’s see who dares to meddle in our business!"
No one came to help; the people around saw these burly men and dared not step forward, not wanting trouble!
Meanwhile, the traffic light had changed, and vehicles began to move, their car blocking the traffic, but the wide road allowed cars to maneuver around them.
This situation made the two burly men even more impudent.
The father and daughter felt utterly hopeless.
Seeing this, the girl was about to be forcefully dragged into a black car.
"Hey, let go of that girl."
Suddenly, a voice spoke up calmly.
The burly man froze, turned his head, and saw Lin Fan and Anna approaching.
The uncle and the girl clung to them as if grabbing a lifeline.
"Kind people, please save us!"
"Please save my daughter!"
The burly man stared at Lin Fan, his face darkened: "Kid, mind your own business!"
The other burly man sneered, "This kid brought a prettier chick with him. Kid, you wanna stand up for her, huh? Fine, give us your chick, and we’ll let this one go!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Oh, you want her? Fine, let go of this girl first, and I’ll have her go keep you company."
The two burly men exchanged glances, disbelieving their ears. Lin Fan agreed so readily to exchange Anna for the girl!
Was Lin Fan a living saint, sacrificing for others!
The girl and the uncle were also stunned; this kind man was incredibly kind!
"Boy, you said it, no regrets!" the burly man sneered.
The other burly man said, "I bet this kid won’t dare regret it. If he dares, we’ll beat him up!"
The burly man laughed: "Kid, since that’s the deal, we’ll give you this girl, she’s just a regular one anyway!"
He said, throwing the girl aside.
The girl stumbled, quickly regained her balance, and ran towards Lin Fan, her father also hurrying out, and they embraced, shaking in fear.
In a flash, the two burly men’s attention shifted to Anna.
"Hey girl, come over, don’t blame us, blame your boyfriend. He’s quite generous."
"Yeah, sacrificing his girlfriend to save someone, truly noble!"
The two burly men laughed out loud.
Anna, with a cold expression, walked towards them.
"He’s not my boyfriend, you two fools," Anna said coldly.
The two burly men exchanged a glance, puzzled: "Not a boyfriend, then what, a brother?"
"Haha... even better, sacrificing his sister!"
"Doesn’t matter what your relationship is, now you’re ours, come and enjoy yourself."
The two burly men waited for Anna to come over, ready to take her to their car.
Anna indeed walked over obediently, coming up to the two burly men. Suddenly, Anna kicked one of the burly men in a vulnerable spot.
The kick was strong, and the burly man screamed, his eyes nearly popping out, his face turning green, and he fell to his knees, clutching his injury, howling in agony.
The other burly man was shocked.
However, before he could react, Anna swung her fist and smashed it into his face.
"Ah!"
Another scream; this burly man also fell to the ground, holding his already broken nose, wailing.
"How was it, enjoyable?" Lin Fan laughed gleefully from the side.
Witnessing this scene, the father and daughter were dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 498: Two Mother and Daughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 498: Two Mother and Daughter
The father and daughter were dumbfounded; they didn’t clearly see what happened, but the two burly men had fallen.
Lin Fan turned his head and said, "You guys can go now. Leave the rest to us."
"Thank you, big brother and sister."
"We can’t thank you enough, really."
The father and daughter expressed their gratitude, then got in their car and quickly drove away. They were still worried the two burly men might retaliate against them.
But the two burly men were still on the ground, wailing in pain, with no time to care about them.
The scene left the surrounding people stunned.
Anna, a woman, had taken down two burly men with just one punch and a kick. That’s just incredible!
At first, they thought Lin Fan had actually traded his female companion for that girl. It was hard to understand how someone could be so selfless.
Turned out that’s how the exchange worked, and it made them laugh to tears. Wasn’t that just playing with the two burly men? If someone had known how formidable Anna was, who would dare make the trade?
The two burly men were emotionally shattered.
They thought they had traded for a big beauty with that girl, but ended up with the beauty’s punches and kicks. This domineering woman was too damn fierce—one was disfigured, and the other, even worse, might never have children again.
"You bitches have no idea whom you’ve provoked!" One of the burly men said through gritted teeth.
Anna ignored them, not caring who they were. The master told her to deal with them, so they should just blame their bad luck.
"Master, what should we do with these two?" Anna asked for instructions.
Lin Fan said, "Ask them what their background is, daring to act recklessly in broad daylight."
Anna looked at the burly man kneeling on the ground: "What do you mean by your earlier words, who are you people?"
The kneeling burly man was the one who took the hit that might cost him future generations. The other, who had a fractured nose, was lying on the ground wailing.
"Why should I tell you? Just wait for retaliation!" the kneeling burly man said.
Before he could finish speaking, Anna kicked him to the ground, walked over, and stepped on the man’s neck.
She applied some pressure.
The burly man’s breathing became difficult, his face flushed red, and he began to struggle, but to no avail.
"Will you talk or not?" Anna asked coldly.
The burly man was terrified out of his wits. This woman was too ruthless; if he didn’t talk, she might really break his neck.
"Let me go, I’ll talk." The burly man struggled to say.
Anna then moved her foot and waited for him to speak.
The burly man said, "We are Brother Zhen’s men."
Lin Fan said, "Oh, who’s Brother Zhen, is he very powerful?"
The burly man said, "You don’t even know Brother Zhen, no wonder you dare... Let me tell you, Brother Zhen is a prominent figure in Yun City’s underworld, highly influential, one of the four kings of Yun City. Everyone has to give him face, and going against Brother Zhen is a death wish. You should never have provoked us..."
Lin Fan frowned, more underworld!
It looks like Yun City’s underworld is really rampant. These men of Brother Zhen dared to snatch a girl in broad daylight, must be accustomed to acting lawlessly.
A thought suddenly crossed Lin Fan’s mind.
"Take us to see your Brother Zhen," Lin Fan said.
The burly man was taken aback. No way, Lin Fan actually wanted to see Brother Zhen voluntarily, was this guy walking into a trap on purpose!
The burly man couldn’t help but say, "Kid, you’re too conceited. You think just because this bitch can fight, you’re invincible? I guarantee you, once you see Brother Zhen, you won’t come back!"
Lin Fan said calmly, "Just lead the way, or do you still want a kick?"
The burly man shivered; he definitely didn’t want another kick from Anna.
"Since you want to die, I’ll fulfill your wish." The burly man sneered, then laboriously got up and went to help the other burly man up.
Lin Fan said to Anna, "I’ll take their car, you follow us in ours."
Lin Fan got into the burly men’s car, and soon, they left.
Moonlight Leisure Club.
This was a sizable leisure club, luxuriously decorated and looked very high-end, clearly showing the owner was wealthy.
The business here was also quite good. In the afternoon, there were already quite a few customers spending money here.
Moonlight Leisure Club mainly provided chess, massages, foot baths, saunas, and other services. Most of the customers here were men with certain economic means, not everyone dared to come because the expenses here were quite astonishing. Spending thousands was common; ordinary people couldn’t afford it, possibly losing a month’s salary in one visit.
It was already early evening that day when a woman in her thirties entered the Moonlight Leisure Club with a little girl.
The woman had an outstanding figure and face. Although her clothes looked rather plain, even a bit cheap, they didn’t affect her captivating charm at all. As she walked by, men couldn’t help but look at her, with nearly 100% turning heads.
The little girl appeared to be about four or five years old, carrying a little backpack with a cartoon character on it, her hair tied into pigtails, big round eyes, and tender, cherubic cheeks - just utterly adorable.
They seemed to be a mother and daughter. This mother bringing her little girl to the club drew a lot of judgmental gazes.
The woman had no time to care about others and took the girl inside the club to a corner, letting her sit on a stool.
The woman squatted down, took off the girl’s backpack, pulled out a pen and a workbook, and said, "Niu Niu, sit here and do your homework. Don’t run around, okay? Mommy will be back soon."
The little girl nodded sensibly and smiled, "Okay, Mommy."
The daughter’s smile was like that of an angel, but this only made the woman feel more guilty. She patted her daughter’s head, her eyes a little red, then stood up quickly and walked away.
After a while, the woman returned, but she was now changed into a uniform similar to the club’s staff!
Turns out, she wasn’t here to spend money but to work!
Nearby, a few other female staffers gathered to gossip.
"What’s with this woman, bringing her daughter to work here?"
"I heard from the manager that she’s a single mom, raising her daughter on her own. Maybe she has no one to help take care of her daughter!"
"But still, she shouldn’t bring her to a place like this, with so many men coming and going; it’s really inconvenient. What kind of mother is she...?"
The woman could hear these words.
But she didn’t care. Gossip or whatever, she seemed unaffected.
Approaching the little girl, the woman smiled and said, "Niu Niu, Mommy’s going to work now. Remember to be good!"
The little girl said, "I know, Mommy."
At the same time, a man around his forties approached from the opposite direction. He looked like he was used to living a luxurious life. The man wore a bathrobe, and next to him, a man in a suit followed him, all smiles like a flattering lackey.
"Young Master Jin, how was the foot bath today? We have launched a new sauna package today, free to try. Would you like to experience it?" The man in the suit smiled.
Young Master Jin said with an "oh", "It’s free? Then I must try it."
As they talked, they encountered the woman.
Young Master Jin’s eyes lit up at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 499: How About I Introduce Someone to You
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 499: How About I Introduce Someone to You
Young Master Jin’s eyes lit up the moment he saw the young woman, who was planning to avoid him, but he quickly stepped aside to block her path.
"Hey there, beautiful, what do you do for a living?" Young Master Jin asked with a grin, his gaze sweeping up and down as he ogled her from head to toe several times, the more he looked, the itchier he felt.
The young woman kept her head down, seemingly afraid to speak, or perhaps unwilling to speak.
The man in the suit, slightly annoyed, said, "Young Master Jin is talking to you, hurry up and answer him."
The young woman finally answered, "I help customers wash their feet."
Young Master Jin was delighted, "Washing feet? Just my luck, I need my feet washed, you can do it, give me a foot massage."
Hadn’t he just come out of the foot massage parlor? Clearly, his interests lay elsewhere. The man in the suit, being quite savvy, instantly understood Young Master Jin’s intentions; he was interested in this young woman.
The man in the suit then told the young woman, "Hurry up and take Young Master Jin inside."
Young Master Jin, grinning, said, "Arrange a private room for me, I don’t like crowds."
His gaze toward the young woman seemed as if he wanted to swallow her whole.
The man in the suit instructed, "Take Young Master Jin to the VIP room, room 2 should be free."
The young woman bit her lip, hesitating, yet she didn’t move.
The man in the suit frowned, "What’s the matter, is there a problem?"
The young woman finally said, "I don’t want to do this."
What?
Young Master Jin chuckled, "Manager Du, what’s going on, do your employees get to refuse customers?"
The man in the suit, Manager Du, quickly said, "Young Master Jin, calm down, it’s her first day, she doesn’t know the rules. I’ll explain it to her."
Manager Du turned to the young woman, putting on a stern face, "Hey, what’s the matter with you?"
The young woman said, "During the interview, there were many people in one room, they didn’t say anything about being alone with customers."
Manager Du said, "This is your regular job. Some customers like peace, so we have VIP rooms. This is part of your job description. Hurry up, apologize to Young Master Jin and take him to the VIP room!"
The young woman still shook her head, "I can’t, Manager, please have someone else replace me."
Young Master Jin’s face finally darkened, "What, you act like a saint but you’re just a whore. Today, I want you, and that’s final."
Seeing Young Master Jin’s anger, Manager Du became infuriated as well, "Do you still want this job or not?"
The young woman didn’t respond, hesitation evident on her face.
Young Master Jin sneered, taking out a wallet from his pocket, he opened it, and pulled out a wad of cash.
"You think yourself too high and mighty? Serve me well today, and this money is yours!" Young Master Jin said, looking at the young woman with disdain, as if he had thoroughly seen through her.
He’s met women like her before, pretending to be high and mighty, but when he flashed the cash, they would all kneel at his feet. These kinds of women love nothing more than being humiliated with money; the more money, the happier they are. As long as the money is enough, they’ll do anything you ask.
This young woman wouldn’t be an exception!
The commotion had already attracted the attention of those around, especially some of the employees, their eyes lit up seeing the money in Young Master Jin’s hands.
"This Young Master Jin is famous for his generosity!"
"If only that money were for me."
"Why not me, I’m not any less attractive than she is!"
"Playing so coy, doesn’t seem like her first day at work, more like a seasoned hand!"
The employees whispered among themselves, increasingly resenting the young woman.
However.
Young Master Jin was disappointed, and so were the gossiping employees.
The young woman shook her head, "I don’t want your money, nor will I go to the VIP room with you."
What?
Rejected?
Everyone was a bit taken aback.
The employees were more dismissive of her.
"Hmph, does she think it’s not enough money!"
"Know when to take your gains!"
"Exactly, too greedy, expecting more, Young Master Jin is not to be trifled with!"
Young Master Jin chuckled, "Alright, with a face like yours, you’d be a top choice anywhere. Just for that face of yours."
With that, Young Master Jin took out another wad of cash from his wallet, added to the previous, it was a thick stack, probably totaling 50 thousand!
The employees nearly drooled with envy, on her first day at work, this young woman encountered such a generous tip!
With so much money now, she should agree, right?
Everyone thought, believing the young woman was doing it on purpose, hoping Young Master Jin would offer more money.
But...
This time, the young woman simply said to Manager Du, "Manager Du, I don’t think this job suits me, I quit."
What, quit?
Everyone was stunned, finally realizing the young woman wasn’t faking it, she really didn’t want to serve Young Master Jin.
A slap in the face, truly a slap in the face, especially to Young Master Jin.
This time, money didn’t work, she genuinely did not want to!
Young Master Jin was genuinely furious this time, how utterly embarrassing this was in front of so many people, where’s his face now?
"Damn it, are you really so self-important, do you think you’re some saint or what, you’re just a filthy whore!" Young Master Jin cursed.
The young woman, angered, said, "Watch your mouth!"
"Damn, still talking back!" Young Master Jin cursed, raising his hand to slap the young woman.
"Don’t hit my mom!"
Suddenly, a childish voice shouted, a four or five-year-old girl ran over as fast as she could, and grabbed onto Young Master Jin’s robe.
She was so young and unaware of the world’s cruelty, seeing someone curse her mom, she was desperate to protect her, so she ran over.
Young Master Jin looked at the little girl and laughed angrily, "What, you brought your daughter out to sell, what a great mom! Your daughter is so small, do you believe I can kick her right out the door!"
The young woman, both furious and anxious, said, "You’re a beast!"
She never expected her daughter to run over, she couldn’t feel touched because she was really scared about implicating her daughter.
Young Master Jin sneered, reaching out to grab the little girl by the collar, lifting her up.
"Agree to go with me to the VIP room for a foot massage, and I’ll let your daughter go," Young Master Jin sneered.
The young woman was furious, wanting to rush over and fight Young Master Jin, but fearing harm to her daughter, she was in a panic.
"What, does this guy want someone to give him a foot massage? How about I introduce someone to you?"
At this moment, a voice came from the doorway.
Everyone turned their heads to see Lin Fan walking in with a smile, followed by an outrageously beautiful woman.
Behind the woman, there were two sheepishly looking burly men.
Lin Fan had come to see the underground boss, Brother Zhen, and the two burly men had brought them here, just arriving at the door, they happened to witness Young Master Jin bullying the mother and daughter.
Young Master Jin glanced at Lin Fan, dressed in cheap clothes, clearly a pauper, but this pauper seemed different from the usual ones. What pauper carries such composure?
"Who are you?" Young Master Jin said coldly.
Lin Fan didn’t introduce himself, pointing to Anna, grinning, "Young Master Jin, what do you think of her? If you don’t mind, let her serve you."
Behind him, the two burly men were sweating, Lin Fan was toxic, if Young Master Jin agrees, he is asking for trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 500: Her Kung Fu Is Really Good
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 500: Her Kung Fu Is Really Good
In the clubhouse lobby, everyone turned to look, quickly gathering a large crowd, including staff and guests, ready for a spectacle.
Introduced by Lin Fan, Young Master Jin’s gaze fell on Anna, his eyes lit up; such a beautiful woman, a black-haired long straight confident lady, very hard to look away from.
Lin Fan actually suggested swapping this stunning beauty with the young woman; was he serious?
Not only Young Master Jin was stunned, but everyone around was also bewildered; they had never encountered such a situation before.
Only the two burly men following behind were drenched in cold sweat, they knew too well what agreeing with Lin Fan entailed.
"Kid, you mean she can serve me?" Young Master Jin asked.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "That’s right, you first put down the little girl, she’ll immediately go over to serve you and ensure your satisfaction."
Young Master Jin, a cautious person, turned to Manager Du and asked: "Are they from the clubhouse?"
Manager Du wiped his cold sweat and said: "No."
Young Master Jin sneered: "Kid, who exactly are you, what do you want?"
Lin Fan replied: "Young Master Jin wants this lady to serve you, but she is clearly unwilling. You should know that forcing things doesn’t yield sweetness; why force it, Young Master Jin? Instead, my friend is eager to serve Young Master Jin; why not let my friend earn the money, which Young Master Jin holds? My friend is quite skilled, I’m not deceiving Young Master Jin, how about it?"
Everyone sweated; it turns out Lin Fan was here to make money.
The two burly men were even more drenched in sweat; Anna’s skills were indeed impressive, martial skills that is.
But Young Master Jin didn’t catch the underlying message in Lin Fan’s words; from his attire, Lin Fan looked like a poor man, obviously eyeing his money.
"Haha, so you want to make money, huh? Beauty, how good are your skills really?" Young Master Jin looked Anna up and down, grinning wickedly.
Lin Fan said: "She’s really good at it, Young Master Jin, why not let her try it out, see if you’re satisfied?"
Young Master Jin boastfully said to Manager Du: "Manager Du, get me a chair."
"Alright, coming right up," Manager Du hastily replied, running to the side to fetch a chair for Young Master Jin.
Young Master Jin put the little girl down, then sat on the chair, saying: "Beautiful lady, come here and relieve my legs."
Once the little girl was on the ground, the young woman quickly ran over to hold the girl in her arms, finally relieved from the fright. Her daughter had been lifted by Young Master Jin, she was terrified; if her daughter were harmed, she’d blame herself forever.
"Go serve Young Master Jin for a bit," Lin Fan said to Anna.
Anna nodded coldly and walked towards Young Master Jin.
Everyone watched as Anna walked up to Young Master Jin.
What a surprise, someone actually came rushing to make this kind of money!
Manager Du was a bit upset; wasn’t Lin Fan here to snatch business, this kid was gutsy enough to come here to snatch business without seeing what kind of place this is!
Manager Du couldn’t help but say: "Young Master Jin, she’s not our clubhouse employee, per the rules can’t do business here."
Young Master Jin waved his hand and said: "No worries, your clubhouse won’t lose money."
Young Master Jin was also a regular here, spending quite a bit, Manager Du didn’t want to offend this guest, reluctantly agreeing: "Alright, as long as Young Master Jin is happy."
Young Master Jin looked up at Anna, patting his thigh: "Come, beautiful lady, kneel down and pound my thigh, let me see your skills."
"Alright."
Anna nodded but didn’t kneel down, swinging forward with a punch, hitting Young Master Jin’s thigh.
Crack!
In the hall, a sound seemed to echo like a bone cracking.
Young Master Jin’s previously playful face was now wide open, his expression painful, so intense he couldn’t even scream.
That punch pretty much knocked his soul out; his thigh felt like it exploded with pain.
"Judging by Young Master Jin’s expression, he’s clearly satisfied; I did say my friend’s skills are great, Young Master Jin really knows how to enjoy it. Anna, shouldn’t you thank Young Master Jin for his reward?" Lin Fan laughed.
Anna reached out to grab the wad of money from Young Master Jin’s hand and said coldly: "Thank you, Young Master Jin."
Young Master Jin finally came to himself, furious and swearing: "Damn..."
But before he finished, Anna chopped the back of his neck.
Young Master Jin immediately lost consciousness, his head drooping down.
"That one is a bonus," Anna said.
Lin Fan laughed and said: "Seems my friend served Young Master Jin too well; he has fallen asleep, completely helpless."
The entire hall was dead silent, everyone left speechless, with cold sweat dripping from their foreheads.
Holy shit!
Is this serving someone!
This clearly looks like murder!
Right?!
Right?!
It’s murder, isn’t it?!
Anna’s skills are indeed remarkable, but not that type of skill; it’s genuine martial prowess!
Goodness, that punch nearly broke Young Master Jin’s leg!
Everyone finally realized Lin Fan wasn’t here to make money after all, but to rescue the young woman, employing humor throughout.
The two burly men felt a bit sympathetic towards Young Master Jin; this brat was truly unlucky for agreeing recklessly with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan gestured to the young woman, signaling her to come over.
The young woman now understood Lin Fan helped her out, saving her daughter, without hesitation, she brought her daughter and walked to Lin Fan’s side.
"Thank you." The young woman said gratefully, holding her daughter, "Niu Niu, thank this gentleman already?"
The little girl looked up at Lin Fan and said: "Thank you, big brother."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "No problem."
The little girl was so adorable, making people want to hug her. Young Master Jin attempted harming such a lovely little girl; Lin Fan, having encountered it, had no reason not to step in.
Manager Du came to his senses, quickly rushing to Young Master Jin, checking his breathing; luckily, he was still alive, just fainted from pain.
"Who are you, daring to behave so brazenly here!" Manager Du stood up, pointing at Lin Fan and yelling.
Lin Fan’s face turned cold: "Are you the manager here? Do you want my friend to serve you too?"
Manager Du jumped in fright; he didn’t want Anna to serve him, Young Master Jin set the precedence; it’s lethal, if not fatal, then agonizing.
Cold sweat poured down Manager Du’s brow, realizing that the two burly men following Lin Fan were his own staff.
"They’re here causing trouble, quickly teach them a lesson!" Manager Du hastily called out.
The two burly men almost felt like beating Manager Du themselves; asking them to teach Lin Fan a lesson had them rushing to their deaths!
"How do you think he ended up like this?" One burly man pointed at the other with a shattered nosebone.
Everyone saw, cold sweat pouring; the burly man was in dire straits, face swollen like a pig’s head, nosebone shattered, nosebleed soaking his clothes.
Manager Du was horrified, trembling, forcing himself to calm and said: "Kid, do you know what kind of place this is, daring to cause a ruckus here; do you have a death wish!"

chapters.title: Chapter 501: Let Him Come See Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 501: Let Him Come See Me
Lin Fan chuckled, "I’m here to see your Brother Zhen."
Anna said coldly, "No need to talk so much, just beat him up and he’ll be obedient."
She raised her fist, ready to press towards Manager Du.
Manager Du shivered with fright, quickly giving a fawning smile, "Please don’t resort to violence, let’s talk this over. So you’re here to see our boss, why don’t you wait a moment, and I’ll inform the boss and see if he has time to meet you?"
Lin Fan replied, "I think you misunderstood, it’s not me going to see him, it’s him coming to see me."
Everyone was stunned, Lin Fan was too arrogant!
Who is the boss here, Li Zhen, Brother Zhen!
It’s said that this Brother Zhen is not only wealthy and powerful, after all, owning such a high-end nightclub isn’t something an ordinary person can afford, and it’s also said that Brother Zhen has an underground background, with a group of bodyguards under him, not someone just anyone can afford to provoke.
Very few people have ever seen Brother Zhen, let alone been hosted by him, given his status, his guests are either rich or noble. And these rich or noble people all request to see Brother Zhen.
But now, Lin Fan wants Brother Zhen to come see him?
Lin Fan’s arrogance is truly unheard of and unseen!
To put it nicely, it’s called ignorance, but to put it bluntly, it’s courting death!
"Wha-what?" Manager Du couldn’t help but ask, still thinking he had misheard.
Anna kicked Manager Du to the ground, saying coldly, "You heard it, now go quickly!"
When it comes to action, Anna is even more straightforward than Lin Fan; Lin Fan is a bit of a jokester, but she prefers direct action.
"Yes, I’ll go right away." Manager Du paled with fear, luckily Anna kept her kick light, otherwise he might have ended up like Young Master Jin.
It’s just a job, no need to lose your life over it, Manager Du quickly scrambled up and ran inside.
Top floor of the nightclub.
A spacious, bright office, guarded by two men in black on either side of the entrance.
The office also had fitness equipment.
A man in his forties, shirtless, punching a sandbag, muscles bulging, tattooed arms, six-pack abs, his punches swift and fierce.
You can tell, this man is a martial artist, and a skilled one at that.
At this moment, there’s a knock on the door.
Led by the two black-clad guards, Manager Du walked in.
"Boss, bad news!" As soon as Manager Du saw the tattooed man, he kneeled with a thud, almost on the verge of tears.
This man is the owner of the nightclub, an underground boss, Li Zhen!
The man stopped his hands, glanced coldly at Manager Du, and said, "What has you in such a panic?"
Manager Du replied, "Boss, someone is causing trouble in the shop..."
Manager Du explained what had happened.
When Li Zhen heard that Lin Fan wanted him to go out and meet him, his expression immediately darkened.
"This kid is arrogant, haven’t seen such an arrogant kid in a while." Li Zhen sneered.
Manager Du said, "Boss, the woman with this kid is really formidable, Young Master Jin was knocked out by her with just one slap."
Li Zhen said, "Is that woman the reason for this kid’s arrogance? With some skills, he dares to come to my territory and act wild. I’m curious to see, you two, bring them in for me. If they refuse to come, drag them in."
The two black-clad men nodded and turned to leave.
"Thank you, boss." Manager Du said, also leaving, his expression finally eased. With the boss’s two competent assistants taking action, surely Lin Fan and Anna will be brought inside.
Just as Li Zhen ordered, if Lin Fan and the others don’t really want to come in, they will be knocked out by the two men in black and dragged inside.
Nightclub hall.
It’s getting more and more lively, not only are people not leaving, more are gathering around, hearing that there’s a spectacle to witness, they all come to watch.
"That woman is too amazing, knocked someone out with a single slap!"
"No wonder they dare to come to Brother Zhen’s territory!"
"They actually want Brother Zhen to come see them, too arrogant!"
"Even if they have some skills, they’re asking for trouble. How could they be opponents for Li Zhen!"
The crowd began discussing fervently.
Lin Fan ignored the people’s chatter, he was talking to the mother and daughter.
"Sister, this place is a mix of all sorts, best not to bring children here in the future." Lin Fan said.
The young woman blushed, "Thanks for the reminder, it’s just that I’m here for work and there’s no one to look after her, so I had to bring her along."
The young woman is named Liu Mei, widowed, raising her daughter alone, her husband having committed suicide after his company went bankrupt, leaving her with a debt.
She has to both care for her young daughter and earn to pay off debts.
She has another full-time job, but the salary is not very high, only enough to cover living expenses each month, unable to pay off the debt.
So she has to take on part-time work, whatever pays well, she will do.
She has done many part-time jobs before, but the pay was generally average, her pressure remains high. Actually, with her looks, if she wanted to make quick money, there were many shortcuts, but she refused to sell her soul for money.
A friend introduced her to this part-time job, the work is not complicated, just helping customers wash their feet. Though not a prestigious job, the pay is good, so she came.
Unexpectedly, on her first day, she encountered a customer like Young Master Jin who lusted impulsively.
Liu Mei can do dirty and tiring work, but she has her limits, she would not give Young Master Jin this opportunity, so she decisively refused Young Master Jin, even if it meant losing her job.
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, the sister won’t be working here anymore, right? Then you should leave first, it might get lively here."
The young woman shook her head, "You’ve helped us, we can’t just leave like that."
Lin Fan didn’t force her, saying, "Then sit over there, at least avoid getting hit."
Lin Fan could already anticipate that Brother Zhen would certainly not come out easily.
Indeed, Manager Du appeared, leading two men in black out, these two men were as burly as oxen, clearly not to be trifled with.
All eyes were drawn to them, stunned by the two men in black, too strong, this time, Lin Fan and Anna are bound to be in trouble.
"Sure enough, Brother Zhen is not to be messed with!"
"Of course, this kid thinks the woman can fight, so cocky, losing his senses!"
"Ah, still too young!"
The crowd began discussing, thinking Lin Fan and Anna were about to be in trouble.
With two black-clad men backing him, Manager Du became arrogant, pointing at Lin Fan, "You punk, daring to cause trouble here, you’ll regret it soon!"
The two men in black, their expressions grim, walked over, glaring at Lin Fan.
"Kid, are you the one who wants to see our boss?"
"The boss orders us to bring you up to see him, be sensible, follow us up, don’t refuse the toast only to drink the penalty."
"Brother Zhen is willing to see you, already giving you a lot of face, and you’re imagining Brother Zhen coming to see you personally, dreaming too much!"

chapters.title: Chapter 502 Li Zhen
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 502 Li Zhen
Moonlight Leisure Club, top floor office.
Li Zhen, who was hitting the sandbag, stopped and finished his day’s training. Although he hadn’t personally fought in years, he maintained his training state over the years, always believing that his own strength was the most reliable.
Back in the day, Li Zhen carved out a name for himself with his fists, becoming an untouchable force in Yun City’s underground.
Even though Yun City’s underground is now full of factions, constantly at odds, grabbing territory, and annexing each other are common occurrences, no leader dares to seize Li Zhen’s territory or defy him.
There’s a saying that circulates underground: if Li Zhen wanted, he could rule Yun City’s underground.
However, Li Zhen seemed not to be greedy. He simply guarded his own little territory, never provoking others proactively.
Strong yet low-key, Li Zhen became a highly respected figure in the underground.
Li Zhen stopped training, picked up a towel nearby, and wiped his sweat because he believed that his subordinates would soon bring Lin Fan and Anna to him.
He wanted to meet the two of them.
People daring to cause trouble on Li Zhen’s turf were indeed rare.
"Could it be related to the recent rumors..." Li Zhen muttered.
Then, Li Zhen let out a cold smile, "So soon they’ve set their sights on me..."
Ring, ring, ring...
The phone on the table rang immediately.
Li Zhen walked over, picked up the phone, and seeing the caller, he answered with a chuckle: "So how about it, Mountain Chicken, aren’t you giving up? I’ve said it, I’m not interested in this."
The person on the other end said, "Brother Zhen, all the big shots have agreed, it’s just missing you now. Brother Zhen, please give me some face, after all, we are brothers who have put our lives on the line together."
Li Zhen said coldly, "Stop, the brotherhood between you and me ceased to exist the day Master Kun died. Mountain Chicken, I know what you’re trying to do, but let me advise you, don’t be too greedy. Isn’t Master Kun’s punishment enough?"
The other side laughed, "It’s precisely because of Master Kun that I must do this. I want to accomplish the goal Master Kun couldn’t achieve, to unify Yun City’s underground."
Li Zhen laughed: "Mountain Chicken, you know I definitely won’t let you do that because I’d be the first to object."
Mountain Chicken said, "Brother Zhen, as brothers, I’m not afraid to tell you, the little brother now is not the same as before, I’ve climbed high branches, unifying the underground is the trend, those who follow will prosper, those who oppose will perish. As a brother, I’m just reminding Brother Zhen, don’t seek your own death."
Li Zhen sneered: "I’ve heard, you’ve attached yourself to the Jiangnan Wei Family, haven’t you?"
Mountain Chicken said: "Since Brother Zhen knows, you should understand how powerful the Wei Family is. Is Brother Zhen really planning to go against the Wei Family? Let me advise Brother Zhen again, I hope Brother Zhen can attend the underground meeting in three days as scheduled."
Li Zhen said: "I’ll say it again, I won’t attend such boring parties, even if you really manage to solve everyone, I will not submit. Instead, let me advise you, don’t be greedy, Jiangnan Wei Family is very powerful in Hang City, but they’re extending too far, remember, the strong dragon can’t suppress a local snake."
Mountain Chicken sighed and said: "Brother Zhen, do you really not know how powerful the Jiangnan Wei Family is? Mr. Wei owns the Wangu Group with assets of 3,500 billion, topping the list of wealthy families in Jiangnan, for them, taking Yun City is as easy as lifting a finger, yet Brother Zhen thinks they’re reaching too far?"
Li Zhen said: "Is that so, I’d like to see for myself."
Mountain Chicken said: "How about this, Brother Shan, I’m conducting business nearby, I’ll come to meet you soon, and we can chat face to face?"
Li Zhen said: "Suit yourself. Oh, and Mountain Chicken, if you want to make a move on me, feel free to do it openly, no need to play the game of challenging the venue."
Mountain Chicken was taken aback, "What does Brother Zhen mean? I didn’t send anyone to challenge your venue?"
Li Zhen frowned: "Then it’s nothing."
With that, he hung up the phone.
Li Zhen muttered: "It wasn’t Mountain Chicken, so who is it downstairs wanting to see me..."
Perhaps just a clueless fool. After all, those who know Brother Zhen in Yun City wouldn’t dare make trouble on his territory!
Li Zhen shook his head and sat down in his office. No matter who was causing trouble downstairs, they would soon come to see him. His two subordinates are experts, he had no worries about their performance.
Just as he was thinking, Manager Du suddenly rushed in, panting, not even caring to knock.
"Boss, it’s bad..."
Manager Du exclaimed in a panic.
Li Zhen frowned: "Why are you so flustered?"
Manager Du said: "They’re gone, our people are gone... all taken down."
Li Zhen stood up abruptly, surprised, "What?"
Club lobby.
At this moment, silence reigned.
The onlookers were all stunned, seeing that one of the two burly bodyguards was writhing painfully on the ground.
The other was lying face down, being held underfoot by Lin Fan, unable to move.
Here’s how it happened...
Manager Du, with two burly bodyguards, tried to forcibly take Lin Fan and Anna to see Li Zhen.
Lin Fan wanted Li Zhen to come see him personally, this created a conflict.
At this point, it was all about whose fists were stronger.
The two burly bodyguards quickly started fighting with Anna.
These two bodyguards were indeed experts, both very strong, as strong as bulls. Even if thrown into a boxing match, they’re probably champions.
In boxing matches, there’s a strict hierarchy, based on weight classes, theoretically, weight determines strength, the stronger the person, the greater the strength.
Thus, in boxing, matches are divided by weight classes, like a 69 kg class match, 75 kg class match, usually, a 75 kg fighter can easily overpower a 69 kg fighter.
Recently, some fraud-master in a redemption video emphasized the weight of those two young men, one weighing over 90 kg, one over 80 kg...
This was to demonstrate that these young men without martial ethics were tough, so even if they got beaten, it wasn’t disgraceful.
Moreover, those two young men had practiced Muay Thai for three to four years; they came prepared...
If this were a boxing match, Anna wouldn’t stand a chance before these bodyguards.
Anna’s weight was far less than these two bulls. Although Anna was a tall, long-haired queen, more of a high-class beauty than a cute little girl, she still weighed far less than these bodyguards.
So theoretically, Anna should not be a match for these bodyguards.
The spectators thought the same, assuming Anna was in for a rough time.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 A Little Different
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 503 A Little Different
Although Anna just knocked Young Master Jin out with one punch, it was normal since someone like him, a Rich Second Generation playboy, had long been weakened by indulgence and was no match.
The two burly men in black were indeed professionals who lived by their fists, martial artists. How could Anna fight against them?
However...
Once the real fight began, the two men in black quickly became flustered and disorganized under Anna’s attacks.
The two men in black were almost in tears. They had been confident at first, thinking they could easily take Anna down, but who knew, Anna had quite a grip, and she moved swiftly with the grace of a swallow.
They quickly fell into a disadvantage.
To defeat Anna, the two men in black started thinking crookedly.
They admitted Anna was really formidable, and even if they joined forces, they might not be able to topple her. But Lin Fan, that kid, looked weak!
As long as they could capture Lin Fan, they wouldn’t fear Anna’s defiance!
So, the two of them coordinated a tactical move.
One of them suddenly broke away from the fight and lunged at Lin Fan, attempting to capture him.
This move was truly brilliant, and several onlookers couldn’t help but cry out in surprise.
To the bystanders, Lin Fan appeared so arrogant, primarily relying on Anna, while he himself seemed just like an ordinary person, meaning Lin Fan was flaunting by leaning on Anna.
So the two men in black’s tactic seemed correct.
However, in the next moment, the man in black who rushed at Lin Fan was already lying on the ground, with Lin Fan stepping on his head. He felt as if pressed by the Five Finger Mountain, unable to move anymore.
The man in black was directly frightened, his heart shattered. Before witnessing it, he couldn’t have dreamed there was someone in the world with such great strength.
A person with such enormous strength, yet Lin Fan looked like a refreshing and masculine handsome guy. Theoretically, wouldn’t Lin Fan weigh at least a few hundred kilos!
Damn it!
It simply defied common sense!
Everyone was stunned.
No one could have expected, thinking Lin Fan was vulnerable, who knew it was the opposite; the man in black was instantly defeated.
After Lin Fan took down the man in black, the other one alone was no match for Anna, and soon, he was also knocked to the ground by her.
Anna’s skills were not bad. She had just lost to Muay Thai Li San the last time she fought a Muay Thai expert, but as for these men in black, she could handle ten at once.
Anna, however, wasn’t proud at all, because she knew Lin Fan was far more formidable. Lin Fan was someone who could instantly defeat even Muay Thai Li San!
Towards Lin Fan, Anna could only kneel in admiration.
Anna believed, if Lin Fan fought these men in black, he could probably handle 100 at once without any problem.
The two men in black, under the witness of the crowd, were quickly dealt with by Lin Fan and Anna.
The whole scene was filled with shock, and for a moment, it was utterly silent.
Manager Du didn’t wait for Lin Fan to speak and was already scared shitless, turning and running away.
Top-floor office.
Li Zhen finished listening to Manager Du’s account and his expression changed. These two who came to challenge were indeed so formidable; who on earth were they, and what was their purpose in coming here?
"Boss, what should we do?" Manager Du asked.
Li Zhen thought for a moment and stood up, "I’ll go meet them."
Manager Du was sweating coldly, the boss was actually forced to meet them personally, something that hadn’t happened in years!
Li Zhen then left the office and went to the club’s main hall.
"The boss has arrived!"
"Impressive, he actually forced the boss to come personally!"
"This is going to be a good show, Brother Zhen is not someone to mess with!"
"To force Brother Zhen to show up, these two are indeed impressive."
Everyone whispered to each other.
Seeing the chaotic scene before him, Li Zhen was still somewhat surprised.
"Kid, our boss is here, you’re dead for sure this time!" Manager Du scolded Lin Fan, feeling confident again with the boss present.
"Get to the side!" Li Zhen coldly glanced at Manager Du.
Manager Du instantly shrank his head back and quickly moved to the side, feeling frustrated, not knowing why the boss scolded him.
Of course Li Zhen scolded him; this guy was tactless. Li Zhen couldn’t afford to lose face, he didn’t believe that someone who could instantly defeat the men in black, would be dead for sure.
On the contrary, the current situation was uncertain for either side.
"I am Li Zhen, I heard you wanted to see me, I’ve come. May I know what guidance you have?" Li Zhen chuckled.
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, I wanted to see what kind of person could raise such a group of arrogant societal trash."
"What do you mean?"
Li Zhen frowned, his eyes falling on the two burly men.
