The two burly men were his subordinates, it seemed they hit a hard spot, both had been beaten, needless to say, this was the handiwork of Lin Fan and Anna.
Two of his capable subordinates all got unlucky...
Lin Fan said, "Today, your two subordinates ran a red light..."
Lin Fan quickly recounted the story.
The two burly men never expected that running a red light once would later trigger such a shocking brawl.
Years later, when the two burly men were old, they still sighed at this segment of their past.
Li Zhen’s face changed, "What, daylight robbery of a girl!"
The crowd gasped.
Indeed, mixing in the underground was just full of mischief and truly harmful to society.
Li Zhen was known to be able to manage both the legitimate and the underground side well, famous for being strict with his subordinates, yet such a thing still happened!
One could imagine the quality of the thugs underground, simply a scourge.
The crowd identified with the girl who was almost forcibly taken away and assaulted, and couldn’t help becoming indignant.
They finally understood why Lin Fan and Anna came knocking, they were here to settle accounts with Li Zhen.
Li Zhen glared at the two burly men, "You two, kneel down for me!"
Thud!
The two burly men instantly knelt down, both trembling with fear, "Boss, we know we were wrong, we won’t dare again."
Li Zhen angrily said, "Is it because I have been lax with you recently, that you dare act so wantonly! Get out immediately, and don’t ever let me see you again!"
The two burly men quickly got up and scrambled out, they were about to cry, never expecting the boss to kick them out like that.
Having driven away the two burly men, Li Zhen looked at Lin Fan, "So, are you satisfied with my way of handling it?"
Lin Fan was somewhat surprised, Li Zhen, this underground boss, seemed a bit different from the others, at this point, any other boss would certainly protect his subordinates, but Li Zhen didn’t, instead, he expelled the two subordinates.
But thinking about it, it wasn’t hard to understand. Those in the underground all thought about coming ashore, maybe Li Zhen wanted to go legitimate too, trying to move from the underground to the open way, those two trash subordinates were a drag indeed, such people had to be expelled.
"Not bad, I hope there won’t be such things in the future, let’s end it here. Anna, let’s go." Lin Fan said.
"Wait!" Li Zhen’s expression darkened, "Kid, although you handled this matter well, you shouldn’t have come here causing trouble, if I let you go just like that, I might not be able to explain to the brothers under me."
Lin Fan responded, "You mean, do you want to fight?"

chapters.title: Chapter 504: He’s even stronger than you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 504: He’s even stronger than you?
"It’s been a long time since I had a physical confrontation with anyone. At my level, I often don’t need to do it myself, but seeing you today, I must admit I’m a bit anxious to try. I really want to experience it firsthand."
Li Zhen said this while taking off his shirt, revealing a muscular physique.
For someone over forty, this body was impressive. Many men, after turning 30, start becoming oily middle-aged men — pot-bellied, bald, and out of breath after a few steps...
Li Zhen seemed to have no such troubles; his body was as strong as a spry young man of 20.
The crowd gasped in amazement.
"Brother Zhen is truly Brother Zhen, so strong!"
"Oh my, he’s so manly."
"This is how a middle-aged man should be, every man should aspire to be like him."
Many women blushed and their hearts raced.
Especially among the club’s staff, it was their first time seeing the boss’s muscles; the boss was truly formidable.
It’s said that when Li Zhen was young, he was a master who carved out his own realm with his fists. In the underground world of Yun City, no one dared to challenge him, not even Mountain Chicken, known for his fierceness and fearlessness, would back off when seeing Li Zhen.
It was surprising that, even after all these years, Li Zhen remained so strong, commanding respect.
"Brother Zhen personally stepping in, this time, those two are in trouble!"
The crowd couldn’t help but think.
Lin Fan and Anna were really impressive, having taken down four of Li Zhen’s captains in succession, but now that Li Zhen himself was involved, things would be different.
Hearing the crowd’s cheers, Li Zhen couldn’t help feeling proud. In fact, he was quite proud of himself.
All these years, although he hadn’t fought, he made sure to keep himself at peak condition.
"Which one of you two wants to spar with me first?" Li Zhen glanced at Lin Fan and Anna.
Before Lin Fan could speak, Anna dashed forward.
Saying nothing, she started the fight directly!
This woman was so cool; a slight smile appeared on Lin Fan’s lips as he found himself liking Anna more and more.
He seemed to understand why the system wanted him to recruit Anna; she would undoubtedly become a great assistant to him.
Li Zhen was also not expecting this woman to be so fierce. More importantly, she was exceptionally beautiful. It’s rare to find a woman who is both beautiful and skilled in combat; normally, women skilled in fighting would build up muscle, often stronger than most men, like female boxers.
Anna was different; she looked tall and slender, with a figure no worse than runway models, yet she was also very skilled in combat. It was a mystery how she honed these skills.
However, Li Zhen didn’t believe Anna was a match for him.
Nothing more to it, Anna was still just a woman, and in Li Zhen’s concept, he had no reason to lose to a woman.
In an instant, their fists clashed.
Anna threw a total of three punches.
The first punch made Li Zhen stagger back three steps.
The second punch brought a look of astonishment to Li Zhen’s face.
The third punch sent Li Zhen sprawling backward on the ground.
Anna’s moves were swift and decisive; she knelt on one knee, pressing Li Zhen’s neck with her knee, raising her fist, and striking down.
This fourth punch was aimed right at Li Zhen’s nose.
"That’s enough, traditional kung fu is about knowing when to stop," Lin Fan suddenly said.
Anna’s fist halted right at the tip of Li Zhen’s nose.
If she had struck, she would definitely have broken Li Zhen’s nose.
Li Zhen turned pale.
He was defeated, unexpectedly, just like that, with only three punches!
Everyone was stunned, incredulous. What the hell, Brother Zhen couldn’t withstand three punches from Anna? Had they not seen it with their own eyes, who would believe it!
But the fact was right in front of them; Li Zhen was truly defeated, utterly and completely.
Inside Li Zhen, a storm was raging: "How is this possible, how could I lose, even though I haven’t fought in a long time, I’ve been training and my condition is still at its peak, how could I lose to a woman!"
"Why are you so strong?" Li Zhen couldn’t help but ask.
Anna’s expression was cold, seemingly uninterested in answering such a trivial question.
Li Zhen couldn’t help but chuckle bitterly: "You really are impressive. Alright, I underestimated you. Had I known, I would have fought him first, maybe I could have won a round."
Li Zhen said, looking at Lin Fan.
Anna said coolly, "If you fought him, you’d die even quicker."
Li Zhen’s words prompted even the usually indifferent Anna to retort. This Li Zhen, having never seen the world, actually thought she was stronger than Lin Fan.
Li Zhen was taken aback: "What do you mean, he’s stronger than you? Really, by how much?"
Anna released Li Zhen, stood up, and a hint of admiration appeared on her face: "He could defeat you with just one finger, in one instant."
Li Zhen was shocked: "What?"
What the hell, Lin Fan was really that powerful, was he even human? He had trained all his life, thinking he was already a rare expert, but if what Anna said was true, wasn’t he training for nothing; facing Lin Fan, he was like a school kid.
Li Zhen then laughed, understanding that Lin Fan couldn’t be that powerful, as there’s no one that strong in this world.
Anna must have exaggerated.
Yes, that must be it, it was the only logical explanation.
Anna paid no mind to Li Zhen’s laughter; she didn’t care if Li Zhen believed it or not, she knew it was true.
Li Zhen chuckled: "I admit you’re good at fighting, I respect that. But I want to know, what is your purpose in coming here, who sent you?"
Li Zhen didn’t believe Lin Fan just happened to pass by and intervened only because he encountered two of his subordinates doing wrong.
He thought of Mountain Chicken and the Wei Family from Jiangnan; could it be that the two of them were sent by the Wei Family to humble him?
The Wei Family from Jiangnan had extended their reach into Yun City’s underground, attempting to unify it. According to what Li Zhen knew, some big names had already bowed to the Wei Family.
There was no other way; the Wei Family, with their 350 billion worth Wangu Group, bearing the title of Jiangnan’s richest, was too powerful and intimidating.
But Li Zhen refused to bow to the Wei Family. As a significant figure in Yun City’s underground, Li Zhen’s stance greatly influenced the Wei Family’s plans. If Li Zhen would bow, things would be much easier for the Wei Family.
So with Lin Fan and Anna’s arrival, Li Zhen first thought they were the Wei Family’s experts.
"Even if you defeat me, I would never bow my head to you. You think you can make me submit to the Wei Family? Dream on!" Li Zhen snorted coldly.
Anna frowned: "What are you talking about?"
Of course, Anna had no idea what Li Zhen was talking about; she wasn’t part of the Wei Family and was unaware of the recent developments in the underground.
Lin Fan suddenly exclaimed: "The Wei Family? Do you think we are from the Jiangnan Wei Family?"

chapters.title: Chapter 505: This time, I gift you lifetime validity
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 505: This time, I gift you lifetime validity
Li Zhen sneered, "Isn’t it? Don’t pretend any longer. I know your aim, but go back and tell that Wei guy, as long as I, Li Zhen, am breathing, I’ll never let him succeed!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "I think you misunderstood. We’re not from the Wei Family. I indeed came to seek an explanation, but I didn’t expect you’d deal with your two subordinates right away. If you were planning to stick your neck out for them, I was already prepared to wipe all of you out."
Li Zhen broke into a cold sweat, damn it! Fortunately, he dealt with those two subordinates. If he had foolishly stuck his neck out for them, he couldn’t imagine the situation right now.
"You’re really not from the Wei Family?" Li Zhen asked.
Lin Fan said, "Why would you think we’re from the Wei Family?"
Li Zhen said, "Since you’re not from the Wei Family, I don’t think you need to know too much. Better not get involved; otherwise, it might backfire. After all, judging by my understanding of Yun City’s underground, you’re not from the underground circles, so there’s no need to meddle."
Lin Fan made an "oh" sound, "Would you mind sharing? Although we’re not from the underground, I’m quite curious about it."
Lin Fan knew what Li Zhen was likely referring to the Jiangnan Wei Family. In business, you must manage both the legal and the shady ways. The Wei Family is determined to expand into Yun City and has already established a foothold here.
The underground gang maintained by the Jiangnan Wei Family, led by Brother Chicken, has already crossed paths with Lin Fan.
However, neither Brother Chicken nor the Wei Family should know that the person who wiped out Brother Chicken and his people that night was actually Lin Fan, Yun City’s richest man.
Li Zhen said, "What use is it to know too much? I can only tell you that there is a power underground in Yun City now. Even if you’re tough, you’d best not provoke them. You should be glad you met me today. If it were them, you’d be in big trouble. That’s all I’ll say."
"Really? I don’t believe it," Lin Fan smiled.
Li Zhen sneered, "You’re overly arrogant, aren’t you?"
"Oh, what’s going on here? It’s so lively today,"
At this moment, a voice said.
Turning around, they saw a man in a white suit with slicked-back hair walk in, a cigar stuck in his mouth, exuding the demeanor of a big shot.
Seeing this man, some people’s faces changed among the crowd.
"Ah, it’s Mountain Chicken!"
"What, the infamous ruthless character Brother Chicken from the underground!"
"I’ve heard of him; this guy is a daredevil known for his fearlessness. He always leads the charge in fights, making him highly regarded by the bosses. He’s quite a big shot now."
"Why’s he here too? There’ll be quite a show today."
The crowd whispered among themselves.
This man in the white suit was Brother Chicken, a figure who struck fear in the underground circles of Yun City.
Seeing Brother Chicken, Li Zhen’s gaze turned cold; he knew the purpose of Mountain Chicken being here.
"You two, you better not provoke this man. Let’s end our matters here. Please feel free to go,"
Li Zhen said to Lin Fan and then adjusted his clothing, intending to face Mountain Chicken.
This Mountain Chicken character really wasn’t to be trifled with, and Li Zhen didn’t want to involve innocent people. Only he could handle Mountain Chicken here.
Mountain Chicken, chewing on the cigar, walked over with such an attitude, clearly showing off in front of the crowd.
However...
Suddenly, Mountain Chicken stopped dead in his tracks, the whole person stunned, eyes involuntarily showing a look of fear.
His gaze landed right on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan recognized Brother Chicken too and chuckled, "Who would have thought, to meet you here again, have you recovered?"
Brother Chicken broke into cold sweats, momentarily at a loss on how to respond to Lin Fan, his body even trembling a bit, remembering the fear Lin Fan instilled in him that night.
Seeing this, Li Zhen was surprised, "Mountain Chicken, what’s wrong with you?"
Swallowing hard, Brother Chicken didn’t speak.
Lin Fan smiled, "Nothing much, Brother Chicken and I got to know each other after a fight, which kept Mountain Chicken from women for quite a few days, sorry about that."
What?
Li Zhen was stunned, recalling something, cold sweat dripping down.
Rumor in the Jianghu was that Brother Chicken had been beaten up recently, injured in a crucial spot, bedridden for several days, powerless when seeing women.
Moreover, he was wiped out on his own turf; even Brother Chicken himself was instantly taken out!
But these were just rumors; if it were true, Brother Chicken would surely cover it up, such a disastrous experience, how could he let it be known?
Could Lin Fan be the one who wiped out the Mountain Chicken Gang?
If true, that’s... so damn impressive!
Mountain Chicken was once no match for Li Zhen, but now, Li Zhen couldn’t guarantee beating Mountain Chicken. If they really fought to the death, maybe Mountain Chicken would have a slight edge. After all, Li Zhen hadn’t fought in years, though he claimed to maintain peak condition, he wasn’t likely at peak condition anymore.
Brother Chicken was slightly younger, and that guy was just as bold and combative as ever.
This Brother Chicken, unexpectedly got instantly beaten by Lin Fan?
Earlier, Anna said Lin Fan was formidable, Li Zhen didn’t believe it then, but if Li Zhen’s matter were true, he couldn’t help but believe it!
Incredible, just incredible, this Lin Fan, ridiculously strong.
Anna looked at Li Zhen coldly, "The underground power you mentioned, wasn’t it just this guy?"
Li Zhen wiped his cold sweat, unable to speak.
He had just advised Lin Fan not to provoke a growing underground power in Yun City, but little did he know, Lin Fan had already provoked them and even taught Mountain Chicken a lesson.
Mountain Chicken finally steadied himself, wiped off cold sweat, and said, "You, how do you happen to be here?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Brother Zhen and I are good friends, just visiting him."
Lin Fan was obviously just bluffing.
But it terrified Brother Chicken.
What?
Mountain Chicken about to cry, Lin Fan and Li Zhen are friends?
No wonder Li Zhen wouldn’t bow to the Wei Family, because he had Lin Fan as a friend. Lin Fan is freakishly powerful, just a monster, not human. There’s no way a human could be that strong!
Mountain Chicken looked at Li Zhen, forced a bitter smile, "You wouldn’t attend our gathering because of him?"
Li Zhen: "..."
He knew Mountain Chicken misunderstood but didn’t know how to explain.
Lin Fan, curious, asked, "Gathering? What gathering?"
Mountain Chicken thought Lin Fan was teasing him because Lin Fan loved teasing people. Since Lin Fan was friends with Li Zhen, Li Zhen would have told Lin Fan about it.
Seeing Mountain Chicken not replying, Lin Fan’s face turned cold, "What, feeling all better and thinking you’re up for it again? I don’t mind kicking you one more time; this time, it’s lifetime effective."
Mountain Chicken shivered, damn, lifetime effective means he’d have to be a eunuch for life!
No, no way. Not answering Lin Fan’s question isn’t worth becoming a eunuch.
Mountain Chicken hurriedly said, "Well, in three days, the leaders of Yun City’s underground are organizing a gathering. Brother Zhen won’t attend, so I thought to come over and persuade him."
Lin Fan smiled, "I love a good hustle and bustle, if Brother Zhen won’t go, I’ll go, how about that?"
Brother Chicken broke into cold sweats again. Damn it, Lin Fan wants to attend, could he dare say no!
Damn!
In all my life, I’ve never acted so cowardly!

chapters.title: Chapter 506 Arrogant Young Master Jin
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 506 Arrogant Young Master Jin
Brother Chicken was a bit frustrated. Lin Fan wasn’t part of the underground scene, so why join in this mess? If Lin Fan participated, it might become a problem!
But considering Lin Fan’s strength, Brother Chicken didn’t dare to disagree; he didn’t want to cut off his lineage now.
As long as Lin Fan existed, the nightmare of losing his lineage hung over him, which made Brother Chicken want to cry. This was ridiculous; when had Brother Chicken ever been this cowardly!
"Alright." Brother Chicken had no choice but to agree.
Lin Fan said, "Then it’s settled."
Brother Chicken asked, "May I know your name, so I can properly receive you at the gathering?"
He still didn’t know Lin Fan’s identity and saw this as a chance to find out and prepare.
Lin Fan replied, "You’ll naturally know who I am on the day of the gathering."
Brother Chicken wiped his sweat and said, "Alright..."
"Brother Chicken, I’ve decided, I will also attend this gathering!"
Next to them, Li Zhen suddenly spoke, as if he had made up his mind.
Brother Chicken was delighted and said, "Brother Zhen finally figured it out, great, we’ll be expecting you! I’ll take my leave now."
Brother Chicken hurried away, unwilling to stay near Lin Fan as the pressure was overwhelming!
Thinking about Lin Fan attending the gathering in three days left Brother Chicken feeling breathless.
Brother Chicken took out his phone: "Hello, it’s me, Brother Chicken. I want to know, is the expert Mr. Wei mentioned already on the way? I ran into that kid again today..."
Fortunately, the Wei Family was planning to unify Yun City’s underground and wouldn’t allow any accidents to happen.
After Brother Chicken’s gang was wiped out by Lin Fan that night, the Wei Family promised Brother Chicken they would send an expert to support him to ensure he could complete his tasks.
It seemed this time, the expert would be useful.
Brother Chicken received a reply that the expert would definitely arrive within three days.
Brother Chicken was very satisfied, and after hanging up the phone, smirked coldly. The kid should wait and see; if he dared attend the gathering, he’d definitely regret making that decision!
Moonlight Club’s lobby.
After Brother Chicken left.
Li Zhen walked up to Lin Fan and respectfully said, "I want to apologize to you. Earlier, I misunderstood you as one of Brother Chicken’s men and was offensive. Also, I apologize for my two subordinates’ terrible behavior."
Li Zhen had just seen with his own eyes Brother Chicken trembling in front of Lin Fan and realized that the rumors were true. Brother Chicken had indeed been wiped out, and the person who did it was this young man in front of him.
This young man, perhaps only in his early twenties, was incredibly strong—not even humanly so, it was absurd.
Li Zhen suddenly had a bold thought.
Seeing his change in attitude and how respectful he had become, Lin Fan smiled and said, "Brother Zhen has already fired those two, so let’s consider the matter settled."
Li Zhen stepped closer and said, "Gentlemen, would you perhaps come to my office to have a chat?"
Lin Fan was about to respond.
"You bitch, you dared to hit me. Just wait, I won’t let you off!"
Suddenly, someone shouted angrily.
It turned out Young Master Jin had woken up.
Earlier, Young Master Jin was served by Anna with a punch and a palm strike that made him pass out on a chair. Now awake and seeing Anna, he immediately started cursing.
Li Zhen frowned. He was already aware of Young Master Jin’s matter, initially unconcerned, as the focus had shifted to Lin Fan.
But with Young Master Jin suddenly causing a scene, Li Zhen had to pay attention.
This Young Master Jin was also a Rich Second Generation, a wastrel who spent money like water in the club, and Li Zhen didn’t want to lose such a big customer.
"Young Master Jin, I’m aware of your situation. Please give me some face and don’t hold a grudge, just leave for now." Li Zhen politely said.
Young Master Jin, seeing Li Zhen was also present, hesitated, not expecting to alarm Brother Zhen. He couldn’t afford to offend Brother Zhen but couldn’t swallow his pride and let Lin Fan and Anna off so easily.
"This bitch knocked me out, and she nearly broke my leg with a punch. And this damn pauper dared to mess with me! Brother Zhen, since you’re here, you’re the boss; help me teach these blind fools who dared to cause trouble on your turf!"
Young Master Jin complained.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "This Young Master Jin really doesn’t understand the situation. Knowing this club belongs to Brother Zhen, how dare you target the employees here? Aren’t you disrespecting Brother Zhen?"
Young Master Jin angrily replied, "Kid, what the hell do you know? Do you know how much I spend here every year? The money I spend in a day here is more than you’d earn in a month moving bricks!"
With money comes power. Young Master Jin had the confidence that Li Zhen would side with him.
In fact, it wasn’t Young Master Jin’s first time going to places like this to find flings; it was an unspoken rule.
Clubs hired young, pretty waitresses to please and attract these wealthy clients to spend money!
If one of these wealthy clients fancied a waitress, it depended on the waitress’s attitude. Some waitresses, wanting money or to be close to wealthy people, considered it a consensual matter.
For those unwilling, like today’s mature woman, the club would mediate. The top priority was not to offend customers. For better situations, they’d mediate a little and stabilize the client, letting the matter pass; in worse cases, they might fire the employee to please the client.
Today, the mature woman refused to go to the VIP room with Young Master Jin because he had bad intentions in his words and eyes. There was no need to explain Young Master Jin’s intentions further.
Normally, as long as Young Master Jin threw money around, nobody would refuse him. Imagine someone working as a club waitress; could they possibly be rich themselves? Most were from poor families and would be overwhelmed seeing such cash amounts for the first time in their lives.
But somehow, this mature woman, despite desperately needing money and choosing to work at the club for its high wages, resisted when Young Master Jin threw a wad of cash at her.
Young Master Jin felt he lost face and wanted to regain it. How could he be humiliated by a waitress? Essentially, Young Master Jin had no respect for waitstaff; for such a wealthy person, how could he see the lower class as anything more than playthings?
What he didn’t expect was when he was just trying to act tough, he ran into Lin Fan and Anna—truly unfortunate—and got beaten by Anna. How could he endure that!
This Anna came with Lin Fan, this broke bastard, and it was under Lin Fan’s instigation that Anna hit him, which made Young Master Jin hate Lin Fan even more. He despised these poor bastards the most.
Seeing Young Master Jin scolding Lin Fan, Li Zhen was slightly displeased and said, "Young Master Jin, are you not giving me any face? I hope you let this matter go and leave."
Young Master Jin, still agitated, arrogantly retorted, "Today, no matter what Brother Zhen says, I must teach this kid a lesson!"
Slap!
Suddenly, Li Zhen walked over and delivered a sharp slap to Young Master Jin, a crisp sound echoing.
The entire lobby fell silent.
Brother Zhen actually hit Young Master Jin!

chapters.title: Chapter 507 He Is Like a Ray of Light
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 507 He Is Like a Ray of Light
"I said, let’s end this matter here. I’m giving you face, but you don’t appreciate it. I can only be impolite now. Get out of my club immediately!" Li Zhen scolded with a stern face.
Young Master Jin was stunned, holding his half swollen face.
Li Zhen did not reprimand Lin Fan and Anna; instead, he reprimanded him!
What the heck is going on, the situation is all wrong!
"Brother Zhen, did you hit the wrong person?" Young Master Jin complained, nearly in tears; that slap really hurt.
Li Zhen said coldly, "Don’t think that just because you spend money here, you can act arrogant in front of me. I’m declaring that you’ve been blacklisted from this club. If you dare step in here again, it won’t just be a slap. Consider this slap as a warning! Get out!"
"Boo hoo hoo..."
Young Master Jin burst into tears, a man in his forties sobbing like a foolish son of a landlord, then turned and ran away.
If someone else had reprimanded him, he might have acted tough, but the other party was Li Zhen. How could he dare? Even if he was rich, he didn’t dare to offend Li Zhen. Many don’t know how they died after offending underground tycoons.
So he could only run away like a foolish son, feeling wronged.
Everyone shook their heads and sighed, seeing this. Young Master Jin was truly disgraceful. He’ll be a joke at everyone’s gatherings in the future.
This was entirely his own fault; he had no sense. Li Zhen proactively invited Lin Fan and Anna, even appearing to be trying to curry favor.
Yet at this time, Young Master Jin wanted Li Zhen to reprimand Lin Fan. Wasn’t this asking for trouble? If he wasn’t getting hit, who would get hit!
Moreover, it was clear that Li Zhen was willing to go all out to please Lin Fan, disregarding even big clients like Young Master Jin.
After driving out Young Master Jin, Li Zhen asked Manager Du, "Which server was harassed by Young Master Jin?"
Manager Du’s face turned pale at this moment. Previously, he hadn’t stopped Young Master Jin from bothering the young woman. Now, with Young Master Jin being slapped, he feared getting involved.
Manager Du quickly answered, "Her name is Liu Mei. She’s over there and hasn’t left yet."
The young woman, with her daughter, had been watching all the commotion from the side.
Li Zhen saw Liu Mei and walked over, bowing sincerely, "Miss Liu, I am very sorry for your experience today as the owner. I will offer you compensation. If you want to continue working here, you are very welcome, and I guarantee this kind of thing will not happen again."
Li Zhen’s words were very sincere.
Liu Mei replied, "You’ve already disciplined that person. That’s enough. I don’t plan to work here anymore."
Liu Mei didn’t know that the owner of this club had underground ties. She only found out just now watching the scene. If she’d known earlier, she wouldn’t have applied for a job here, much less continue working here.
This realization brought a pang of pain to her heart.
Her husband went bankrupt due to poor Company management before passing away, leaving a debt. This debt was borrowed when he tried to save the Company.
Due to the Company’s poor condition, the bank had blacklisted her husband. He had to borrow money from private institutions.
This private institution had underground ties. After her husband’s Company went bankrupt, this institution used violent means to collect the debt.
Her husband’s suicide was also related to this pressure.
Therefore, she never liked the underground. If she had known this club had underground ties, she wouldn’t have come at all.
Li Zhen said, "I understand how you feel, Miss Liu. How about this, I will compensate you with one month’s salary. How about that?"
Liu Mei said, "No need, it’s getting late. I think I should leave."
Liu Mei pulled her daughter and turned to walk out, not wanting to stay a moment longer.
"Wait a minute."
Lin Fan suddenly called out, catching up with the two.
Liu Mei saw it was Lin Fan, and a smile appeared on her face, "Thank you for helping us today. I really don’t know how to thank you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s nothing. You don’t need to think too much of it. I just wanted to suggest, since the owner wants to compensate you, maybe you could accept it. It’s what you deserve, after all. They cost you your job."
Liu Mei shook her head and said, "Forget it. I don’t want his money."
Lin Fan, unaware of Liu Mei’s experiences, said, "Okay then. By the way, is this the little sister’s backpack? You left it behind."
Lin Fan handed the cute backpack to the little girl.
The little girl happily took it, "Thank you, big brother."
"You’re welcome. Can big brother know your name?" Lin Fan asked with a smile. The little girl was really adorable. She’d definitely grow up to be as beautiful as her mom.
The little girl said, "Big brother, my name is Cheng Shishi, but everyone calls me Niu Niu."
Lin Fan said, "Cheng Shishi, you should listen to your mom, okay?"
The little girl replied, "Okay, big brother."
Liu Mei looked gratefully at Lin Fan. This handsome young man was so nice and also so capable. If she were ten years younger and still a girl, maybe she would...
This thought was dangerous. Liu Mei blushed, quickly pulling the little girl and said, "Niu Niu, say goodbye to big brother."
The little girl waved, "Goodbye, big brother."
The mother and daughter left.
Back home.
The little girl was still thinking about Lin Fan, "Mom, big brother was really nice. He helped drive away the bad guy."
Liu Mei smiled, "Hmm, does Niu Niu like big brother?"
The little girl said, "I like him. If only big brother was my dad, no one could bully us."
Liu Mei’s face turned red, "Little one, don’t say such things. It’d be so embarrassing if big brother heard that!"
She sighed in her heart. Lin Fan was so wonderful: young, handsome, strong, and righteous. What woman wouldn’t be moved? The line of women who like Lin Fan must be long, so there’s no chance for her...
"Mom, my backpack was so heavy today," Cheng Shishi said while putting her backpack down.
Liu Mei felt something was off and picked up her daughter’s backpack. When she opened it, she froze.
Inside the backpack lay a stack of cash!
This money looked familiar; wasn’t it the money Young Master Jin tried to show off by offering her?
She hadn’t submitted to him and was unmoved by this money. Later, Anna taught Young Master Jin a lesson and took the money. Funny enough, even though Anna beat Jin terribly, she claimed she was serving Young Master Jin, and earned this money off him.
How did the money end up in her daughter’s backpack?
There was no need to ask; it must have been quietly slipped in by Lin Fan!
For some reason, the young woman suddenly felt a dry throat, took the stack of money, squatted on the ground, and burst into tears.
Since her husband’s suicide, she’d felt like the sky had fallen. Everything seemed so dark, with people driven by material desires, rushing around like slaves for money.
But Lin Fan’s presence was a rare experience of kindness. He was like a light shining into her dark world.
Lin Fan hadn’t expected that he would have such a significant impact on Liu Mei. He gave her the money simply because he felt it rightfully belonged to her. A mother working with her daughter clearly wasn’t doing well. Young Master Jin caused her to lose her job; some compensation wasn’t too much.
After Liu Mei and her daughter left.
Li Zhen approached Lin Fan again, respectfully saying, "Sir, please."
Lin Fan and Anna went to Li Zhen’s office.
"Brother Zhen, why did you ask us here today? Is there something you’d like to say?" Lin Fan asked, getting right to the point.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: Wei Family’s Goal: Monopoly!
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 508: Wei Family’s Goal: Monopoly!
Li Zhen learned that Lin Fan was the one who wiped out the Mountain Chicken Gang, and his attitude towards Lin Fan changed drastically, becoming very respectful, as he invited Lin Fan to his office for a talk.
Lin Fan asked directly: "Brother Zhen, you called us here, is there something you want to say?"
Li Zhen said: "May I know your names?"
Lin Fan said: "I’m Lin Fan, and she’s Anna."
Lin Fan?
Wait!
Li Zhen suddenly thought of something, could it be... could he be Mr. Lin? Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City?
With a market value of 200 billion, Mortal Group’s Mr. Lin, the richest man in Yun City, is indeed named Lin Fan!
No, Mr. Lin is the richest man, but the Lin Fan in front of him is wearing street market clothes, nothing like a rich person!
This Lin Fan definitely isn’t that Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City; it’s just a coincidental name!
Li Zhen breathed a sigh of relief, he couldn’t believe that the richest man in Yun City would come here, people so wealthy wouldn’t be so easily seen.
Rumor has it that Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, inherited the wealth of the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin, whose real name is Lin Beixuan, with a mysterious background, but with extraordinary means.
This kind of mystery and power has made many people have a sense of awe towards Mr. Lin.
And Lin Fan, compared to Lin Beixuan, is no less powerful, rising to become the richest man in Yun City in a short time, considered a miracle.
The legends about Lin Fan have already spread throughout this city.
Even someone like Li Zhen, a big figure in the underground, wouldn’t easily provoke Lin Fan.
So, when Li Zhen thought the Lin Fan in front of him wasn’t the richest man, he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, it would be a big trouble if he provoked that Lin Fan.
"So it’s Mr. Lin, Miss An, your skills are really impressive, I am very admiring," Li Zhen said with a smile.
Anna coldly said: "Just say what you have to, no need to flatter us, we are in a hurry."
Now, what Anna wanted most was to follow Lin Fan back to Yunding Manor, a place she missed after not seeing it for months.
Li Zhen smiled awkwardly and said: "Alright, I’ll be direct, because Mr. Lin said he wanted to attend the underground meeting in three days, I want to ask you, do you know what this meeting means?"
Lin Fan responded, saying: "What does it mean?"
Li Zhen said: "Mr. Lin doesn’t know what this meeting is, yet wants to attend, I don’t think it’s just a whim to see the excitement?"
Lin Fan smiled and said: "I am indeed curious, but seeing Brother Zhen like this, this meeting seems quite significant?"
Li Zhen said: "Mr. Lin, do you know Jiangnan Wei Family?"
Lin Fan said: "Yes, Jiangnan Wei Family, with a 350 billion Wangu Group, is the richest in Jiangnan, what does this have to do with the Wei Family?"
Li Zhen said: "There are rumors that the Patriarch of Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Tiansheng, plans to build a skyscraper in Yun City, following Hang City, Yun City will become the second center for Wei Family, Wei Family is coming to Yun City to play monopoly."
Lin Fan frowned: "Monopoly?"
Li Zhen nodded: "The Wei Family has a voracious appetite. Originally, they started in real estate, when Wei Tiansheng established Wangu Group, rose quickly by hoarding land, becoming a real estate giant in Jiangnan. But Wei Family wasn’t satisfied and started expanding into various industries, like media, technology, entertainment, etc., trying to build a business empire and monopolize the markets in the involved industries. This time, their eyes are on Yun City, wanting to make a trial."
Lin Fan said: "What kind of trial?"
Li Zhen said: "I’m not entirely sure, but it’s said to be related to community group-buying, through a shopping platform, establishing group-buying by community unit, allowing residents to buy daily supplies, like vegetables and fruits, at very low prices. Wei Family plans to use Yun City as a test point."
Lin Fan responded: "I understand, if Wei Family really wants to push community group-buying, everyone will flock to their platform to buy groceries because for the customer there’s no reason not to buy cheaply, then some vendors reliant on selling vegetables will lose their livelihoods, through a low-price strategy, Wei Family can achieve monopoly. Once the market has no vegetable vendors, everyone has to rely on their platform, then they can raise prices, earning back the costs from previous low prices."
Li Zhen said: "Exactly, Wei Family doing this is leaving no way for some vendors to live, and the first to bear the brunt is Yun City."
Lin Fan chuckled: "Although Wei Tiansheng’s actions are indeed unscrupulous, what does this have to do with Brother Zhen? Brother Zhen is a tycoon, this won’t affect you."
Li Zhen said solemnly: "For Wei Family to realize their plan, they need to clear both overt and covert paths, initially they want to monopolize the underground, they aim to unify Yun City’s underground!"
Lin Fan frowned, he knew the Mountain Chicken Gang was a power Wei Family raised in Yun City, but didn’t expect Wei Family’s appetite to be so large as to want to consume the entire underground of Yun City.
Underground forces are closely related to the community, many underground sects, big and small, in Yun City are divided by neighborhood.
If Wei Family can unify Yun City’s underground, it will be much easier for them to carry out community group-buying.
In Wei Family’s view, Yun City is simply a testing field, and the impact of their plan on Yun City is surely not within their consideration.
Li Zhen gritted his teeth: "I won’t allow Wei Family to unify Yun City’s underground, this time Mountain Chicken, under Wei Family’s command, held this underground meeting to stir trouble. Initially, I refused to attend because I didn’t want their plan to succeed, even if all underground forces in Yun City bowed to Mountain Chicken, I, Li Zhen, would never bow!"
He said this with great righteousness and passion.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "I actually think unifying the underground is quite good, now there are many sects, no one yields to another, often causing trouble over territory disputes, and the quality of the thugs is generally low, with rampant behavior, such as bullying the weak on the streets. If the underground can be unified and establish rules to restrain these thugs, it would not be a bad thing."
Speaking of bullying the weak on the streets, it wasn’t hard to think of the actions of Li Zhen’s men.
Li Zhen also heard Lin Fan teasing him, his face turned red, and said: "What Mr. Lin says is not unreasonable, but if the underground of Yun City is really to be unified, it must be by a chosen one, otherwise it’s impossible to convince the crowd. If the Mountain Chicken Gang unifies the underground, what Mr. Lin described will occur even more frequently, and once it becomes known, a crackdown will be inevitable, leading to total ruin. Speaking of this, it’s necessary to mention Master Kun."
Lin Fan said: "Who is Master Kun?"

chapters.title: Chapter 509: Do you want to be this king?
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Chapter 509: Do you want to be this king?
Li Zhen said, "Master Kun was the underground boss who dominated Yun City ten years ago. At that time, both Mountain Chicken and I were his underlings. Master Kun was ambitious and wanted to unify the Yun City underground, but faced resistance from several major factions at the time. It ended up in chaos and drew attention, leading to an operation from above that wiped out all major underground factions. Master Kun was imprisoned and soon died of illness. Since then, there have been no major factions in the Yun City underground. After many years, it has become a scattered state with many small factions, but due to its obscurity, no one else bothers with it."
Li Zhen’s concern is that the Mountain Chicken Gang wants to unify Yun City’s underground, which is following in Master Kun’s footsteps and won’t end well.
Mountain Chicken is brave but not smart, and his nature is fierce. If he truly unifies the Yun City underground, it will become a mess.
Li Zhen opposes Mountain Chicken; he doesn’t attend the gatherings to show his stance. Li Zhen just wants to safeguard his own little territory.
However, under a toppled nest, no egg will remain intact. If Mountain Chicken truly causes trouble, Li Zhen will certainly be implicated; this is what concerns him.
Lin Fan was learning for the first time about the Yun City underground situation. It seems his visit is quite worthwhile.
"Given the situation, does Brother Zhen have any plans?" Lin Fan asked.
Li Zhen shook his head with a bitter smile, "What can I do? The Wei Family is aggressive and determined to succeed. Even if I want to stop them, it’s not easy. I haven’t fought anyone for years. Today’s comparison with Miss An made me realize that I’m far past my prime. I might not even be a match for Mountain Chicken now. Or..."
Li Zhen paused, looking at Lin Fan, "If Mr. Lin and Miss An could lend a helping hand, maybe there’s a glimmer of hope!"
It turns out Li Zhen invited Lin Fan and Anna because he wanted their help to stop Mountain Chicken Gang and the Wei Family!
Li Zhen said, "You two are masters among masters. With your help, we can prevent an underground catastrophe. If you two are willing to help me, I’ll certainly treat you well. I’m not very wealthy, but I have the ability to improve your lives a bit."
Upon hearing this, Anna seemed to hear a joke, and almost laughed out loud.
Li Zhen didn’t know that the man in front of him is the richest man in Yun City, trying to help the richest man improve his life?
Anna looked at Lin Fan, wondering how Mr. Lin would respond.
Lin Fan appeared to be in deep thought.
It turns out Lin Fan suddenly heard a system prompt in his mind.
"Ding!"
"System task: Unify Yun City’s underground.
Task Level: Important.
Task Progress: 0/100"
Lin Fan inwardly exclaimed; although the system seemed to have a bug, the bug seemed like a reward, and tasks continued to be issued.
This time, the system’s task is for him to unify Yun City’s underground?
Lin Fan broke a sweat; hearing Li Zhen say earlier, unifying Yun City’s underground is a hot potato. If done wrong, it could bring disaster.
But now that it’s a system task, Lin Fan has no choice but to complete it. It seems he needs to find a proper way to handle it.
"Alright, I agree with you. I will help you stop Mountain Chicken." Lin Fan said.
Anna was taken aback. What, Mr. Lin actually agreed with Li Zhen?
However, Anna quickly calmed down.
Since it’s Lin Fan’s decision, she will follow it.
Li Zhen was very happy, saying, "With you two helping me, it’s great news. Mountain Chicken certainly won’t succeed this time!"
Lin Fan suddenly said, "Brother Zhen, have you considered unifying Yun City’s underground?"
Li Zhen was shocked, "Mr. Lin, what do you mean? I don’t have such an idea. Master Kun’s fate has always been a warning to me. It’s better to be low-key and keep my little land."
Although Li Zhen is an underground boss now, he indeed hasn’t fought anyone for years, not competing or vying.
He sees this as a life-saving principle.
That’s why he opposes Mountain Chicken and focuses on managing his own little territory.
Due to other bosses’ concerns about Li Zhen, nobody dares to provoke him, so he has been doing well over the years. His club business is thriving and so are a few other ventures, all generating a considerable income.
He’s quite content now.
He absolutely doesn’t want to unify the underground. High-profile people die quickly, just like Master Kun did.
Lin Fan said, "Mountain Chicken wants to be the king of Yun City’s underground, so he has allied with the Wei Family, trying to leverage their power to achieve his goal. If they succeed, it will be a disaster for Yun City. But the Wei Family’s involvement in Yun City leaves no room for retreat. The war has started; it will be either victory or defeat, success or failure. Brother Zhen wants to guard his little territory, but it’s no longer possible. It’s like the tumultuous times of the Three Kingdoms; the trend is a unified world, no one can remain untouched. Given this, why not be the king yourself!"
Li Zhen was stunned; this was the first time he heard such a statement, yet it was so profound, it felt like the truth!
Irrefutable!
The situation indeed is as Lin Fan said.
If there’s definitely going to be a king, why not have that king be himself, since he doesn’t want Mountain Chicken to be it?
Li Zhen felt a surge of heat in his heart, as if his long-stilled inner ambition was reignited.
One must know, back when Li Zhen followed Master Kun to conquer the world, he was a fierce warrior, only later struck by Master Kun’s fate causing his heart to settle.
Unexpectedly, today, Lin Fan’s words once again ignited his ambition.
Lin Fan didn’t wait for him to decide, smiling, "Brother Zhen, you might consider it seriously, no need to rush a decision. I have some matters to attend to; I’ll leave now. Three days later, let’s meet at the underground gathering."
Lin Fan decisively left.
Only Li Zhen remained, lost in thought.
Outside the Moonlight Club.
They boarded the Rolls-Royce and returned to Yunding Manor.
Anna curiously asked, "Master, why did you say those words to Li Zhen? Do you intend to become the king of Yun City’s underground?"
Lin Fan laughed, "You’re quite clever. Whether Li Zhen becomes the king of Yun City’s underground or not, I don’t care. Yes, I want to be the king of Yun City’s underground."
Anna felt a bit dazed.
Lin Fan once again made her admire him repeatedly.
Last time, Lin Fan said he wanted to be the richest man in Jiangnan; this time, he said he wanted to be the king of Yun City’s underground.
Is this about going to war with the Wei Family?
Lin Fan is already the richest man in Yun City now, he indeed has the qualification to compete with Jiangnan Wei Family.
On the surface, Lin Fan persuaded Li Zhen to become the king of Yun City’s underground, but in reality, Li Zhen will be just a puppet, and the real king will be Lin Fan!
This is Lin Fan’s plan.
"I don’t ever want to encounter what happened today again. These hoodlums blatantly causing trouble are really arrogant beyond measure. It’s time to rewrite the rules of Yun City’s underground."
Lin Fan said with a resolute look.

chapters.title: Chapter 510: Teach Them a Lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Chapter 510: Teach Them a Lesson
Lin Fan, aiming to be the underground king of Yun City!
Although this was a task from the system, Lin Fan himself couldn’t stand these thugs causing chaos. If he could unify the underworld, he would change the rules down there.
At least in Yun City, there would no longer be situations where thugs bully ordinary people.
But this task is very dangerous because now the Wei Family also wants to unify the underworld of Yun City, so Lin Fan is basically declaring war with the Wei Family!
Anna, however, was somewhat excited. She didn’t like dullness, which might be related to her nature. Ever since she grew up, she had been working in security, hoping for her life to be more exciting.
Now following Lin Fan, she didn’t have to worry about being bored at all. Her life would only become more exciting.
They chatted all the way back to Yunding Manor.
Even Lin Fan had been away for quite some time.
His sister, Lin Shanshan, boarded at school, busy with her studies and rarely came home. For Lin Fan, living alone in such a large manor felt a bit lonely. Besides, there were many tasks in the city, so it was more convenient to stay in the rented apartment there.
Especially since Lin Fan had recently become a live-in son-in-law and stayed at Wei Qingxue’s house, it had become more inconvenient to return now.
For Anna, this was the first time back in three months since she left.
The familiar garden mansion before her eyes gave her a feeling of being in a different lifetime.
She initially came to Lin Fan as an undercover, not expecting that one day, she would willingly become part of Lin Fan’s world.
Thinking back, even before Lin Fan agreed to help solve her father’s disappearance case, her moments with Lin Fan had already made her develop a special feeling for him.
This man is truly amazing, exceptionally so. He was the most outstanding man she’d ever met in her life, and she liked the most outstanding men...
Besides, Lin Fan was really handsome!
By the time Lin Fan solved An Jincheng’s disappearance case, Anna was completely convinced by Lin Fan.
"Anna, do you like it here?" Lin Fan asked.
Anna nodded, "I like it."
Lin Fan smiled, "Consider this your home from now on, too."
These words moved Anna greatly.
Ever since her father’s disappearance, she had been without a home. Although Feng Wanshan adopted her as a goddaughter and supported her financially, she had never been to the Feng Family, so much so that Feng Tianming didn’t even know of her existence.
In her memory, she was always studying, boarding at school. She wanted to become a remarkable person to help find her father’s whereabouts.
Now, Lin Fan pointed at Yunding Manor, the most expensive house in Yun City, and said it was also her home from now on!
Had she finally found a home again? Yes, it was a sense of belonging she’d never felt before!
Anna, usually so indifferent, had tears welled up in her eyes.
Lin Fan then said, "By the way, I have another gift for you. I forgot to give it to you before."
He said, retrieving a small gift box from his jacket and handing it to Anna.
Anna, curious about what it was, took the box and opened it, her eyes lighting up instantly as she saw a large diamond lying inside!
This diamond looked somewhat familiar...
Anna exclaimed in surprise, "Could this be..."
Lin Fan nodded, "This is the Camilla Diamond your father stole from the Pharaoh’s Tomb in Egypt. I got it back for you. It belongs to you; your father wanted to leave this diamond for you to live a good life."
Holding the Camilla Diamond in both hands, Anna couldn’t deny that it was truly beautiful, almost like it had a kind of magic that made it impossible to look away.
Anna felt a surge of emotion, unable to calm down for a long time because the sight of this diamond reminded her of her father.
Tears involuntarily rolled down her cheeks.
After a moment, she regained her composure.
"But wasn’t this auctioned off by Feng Wanshan for a staggering 200 million? You must have spent a lot to buy it back! It’s too valuable," Anna said.
Lin Fan replied, "It didn’t cost much. The person who bought the diamond back then was a middle-aged businessman. Later, his business failed, and his family fell into decline. Almost everything valuable was sold off, except for this diamond, which he couldn’t part with. But after hearing the story from me, he thought the diamond was a curse and blamed it for his downfall, so he wanted to throw it away. I told him if he didn’t want it, he might as well give it to me. So, I took it and gave him ten million, enough for him to live comfortably for the rest of his life."
Ten million—it was equivalent to two days’ worth of rewards from the system.
Not much, really not much.
Anna sighed, "This diamond is extremely beautiful, but it does bring misfortune. My father lost his life because of it. I have an idea; I wonder if it’s feasible?"
Lin Fan asked, "What idea?"
Anna said, "I’ll take it for now. When I’m free, I want to go to Egypt and return it to its rightful place. My father stole it, and it’s not something to be proud of. He paid with his life for it, so I hope this will be a way to atone for his sins."
In his lifetime, An Jincheng never wanted to part with the diamond, intending to leave it for Anna. Even when his best friend Feng Wanshan pleaded, he wouldn’t give it up, which ultimately led to his death.
Anna understood her father’s intentions but couldn’t help recalling that terrifying ordeal when she saw the diamond, and she didn’t want that.
Lin Fan casually said, "I’ve given it to you; how you deal with it is entirely up to you."
Anna nodded, deciding right then and there.
"Thank you for everything you’ve done for me," Anna genuinely expressed, her heart filled with gratitude, completely devoted to following Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "But you can’t head to Africa just yet. I still need your help."
Lin Fan wanted to unify the underworld of Yun City, and the best assistant for that was none other than Anna. He simply couldn’t think of anyone more suitable.
Anna said, "Alright, I’ll do whatever you say. What do you want me to do?"
Lin Fan said, "In the underground world, whoever has the biggest fist gets to call the shots. Over the next three days, go down there and teach them some manners."
Anna said, "Got it."
Lin Fan just wanted her to go handle those thugs, especially those street gangs, which was exactly what she wanted to do.
It was late at night.
On a secluded street.
A woman rode a bicycle past an alleyway. A streetlight flickered, casting shadows, with no one else in sight.
Suddenly, a sharp cat’s yowl pierced the silence, and a cat darted out from the dark alley, fleeing in panic.
The woman was startled and pedaled harder, trying to leave the area as quickly as possible.
But then, from the alley where the cat had fled, a group of thugs with blonde hair sprung out, blocking the woman’s path.
The woman, afraid of hitting someone, instinctively stopped her bike in panic, only to see the thugs surrounding her as one of them grabbed the handlebars of her bicycle.
"Hey, beautiful, you’re out here alone in the middle of the night? Aren’t you afraid of running into bad guys?" one of the thugs sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 511: The Legend of the Mysterious Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Chapter 511: The Legend of the Mysterious Woman
The gang of thugs all followed with sinister smiles.
The woman was so startled her face turned white: "Who are you people? I’m leaving, don’t block me."
A thug said: "We’re here to protect you. Look, you’re all alone, so we thought we’d escort you safely!"
"That’s right, we’re just being considerate."
"You look so pretty, we’re just afraid some bad guys might bully you."
The thugs burst out laughing.
The woman became even more scared: "I don’t know you, I don’t need your protection. Get out of my way, or I’ll call the police."
"Call the police?"
The thug looked indifferent.
"We’re protecting you out of kindness, how can you repay good with evil?"
"But we’re good guys, we won’t bicker with a beauty. How about we take you to a safe place?"
"Let us bring you happiness!"
The thugs all laughed again.
"I think this alley is pretty safe!" one thug said.
The woman was extremely frightened, and said trembling: "I don’t want to go, I’m begging you, let me go. If you don’t move, I’ll really call the police."
As she spoke, the woman took out her phone, clearly planning to call the police.
One of the thugs had quick eyes and hands; he quickly reached out and snatched the woman’s phone away.
Another thug grabbed the woman and said with a smile: "Don’t ruin the fun, come with us quickly."
"Ah!"
The woman screamed, and instinctively lowered her head to bite the thug’s hand for self-preservation.
The bitten thug yelped in pain and had to let go.
The woman quickly abandoned her bicycle and tried to escape.
The bitten thug, angry and frustrated, abandoned his playful demeanor and cursed: "Damn bitch, how dare you bite me!"
He chased after her, grabbed the woman, and slapped her, leaving five finger marks on her face.
"Drag her inside!"
The thugs finally revealed their wolf-like fangs, rushing forward to drag the woman into the dark alley.
Despite her struggle, the woman couldn’t match the strength of several men, and was about to be dragged into the alley.
Suddenly, a strong light shone over, a cool flashy motorcycle appeared nearby, its headlight illuminating the ugly scene brightly.
The thugs couldn’t open their eyes against the harsh light. Once they adjusted, they saw a black-haired, sleek woman walking over from the motorcycle.
Oh my god!
What a beautiful woman!
The thugs stared, dumbfounded. Being low-level thugs, they never had the chance to see such a gorgeous woman.
Unexpectedly, here came an even more beautiful one!
"Today’s our lucky day, to run into such beautiful ladies!"
"Invite the beauty into the alley too!"
"Beauty, come with us too."
The thugs jested loudly.
Anna’s expression remained indifferent as she walked past them, not even bothering to talk back, and swung her fists straight away.
A minute later.
The thugs were all on the ground, bruised and swollen, writhing in pain and crying out.
The woman nearby was left speechless with awe.
So cool, this woman was truly amazing.
Anna glanced at her and said flatly: "You should leave quickly."
"Thank you." The woman nodded quickly, grabbed her bike, and fled.
Anna planted her foot on one of the thug’s necks and asked coldly: "Who’s your boss?"
An hour later.
In a bar somewhere, the place was a mess, and a group of thugs lay struggling amidst the ruins, while a middle-aged man—the bar owner and an underground boss—lay among them.
This underground boss, beaten black and blue, was scared out of his wits, angrily cursing: "Who the hell is this crazy woman!"
The next day, rumors spread in the underground scene: a mysterious woman appeared and thrashed the thugs who tried to assault a woman—and it didn’t end there. The thugs’ boss was also found by the mysterious woman and thrashed too!
For the next three days, similar incidents continued happening. Wherever thugs committed crimes, the mysterious woman would appear.
This mysterious woman, like Batman, roamed the darkness, protecting the city, with one underground boss after another being dealt with...
Those helped by the mysterious woman were deeply grateful to her, seeing her as their protector, with word of mouth spreading, and public admiration growing for this mysterious woman.
Meanwhile, the mysterious woman became a nightmare for thugs. Before committing any crime, they had to consider if they’d run into her and get their boss in trouble. Even the underground bosses urged their men to behave to avoid trouble themselves.
For a while, the thugs restrained themselves, and the streets became peaceful...
All of this, Lin Fan observed quietly.
He was quite satisfied with Anna’s work!
Meanwhile, Lin Fan continued living his usual daily life.
That noon, Lin Fan suddenly received a call; it was Ning Xiaoyue’s voice on the line.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised because, since Ning Xiaoyue’s debut, she’s been quite busy, and he didn’t expect her to have time to contact him.
"Xiaoyue, what a surprise! Aren’t you busy today?" Lin Fan said with a smile.
Ning Xiaoyue replied: "Busy, yes. There’s an event tonight, but it’s right here in Yun City. Brother Lin, can you come over? I’d like to see you."
Since joining the program, Ning Xiaoyue hadn’t gotten a proper chance to meet Lin Fan. The last time at the company, they only had a brief encounter, barely exchanged words due to the crowd.
With the rare chance of an activity in Yun City, Ning Xiaoyue wanted to make time to meet Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was free and actually wanted to see Ning Xiaoyue too, so he said: "Sure, where are you? I’ll come find you."
Ning Xiaoyue said: "There’s a performance tonight at Yun City Satellite TV. We’ll have one hour free before the recording. Brother Lin, come by then."
"Alright." Lin Fan agreed.
That evening, at Yun City Satellite TV.
This was the only TV station in Yun City, and tonight there was a gala event, inviting many stars, including Spaceship Lady, the hottest girl group right now, with Ning Xiaoyue as a member.
This was Ning Xiaoyue’s first time attending such a gala since her debut, and she was a bit nervous. But thinking about meeting Brother Lin soon eased her nerves, and she looked forward to it with excitement.
"Look, isn’t that Ning Xiaoyue? She’s so bad, yet she’s at this gala!"
"Yeah, hopes she doesn’t embarrass herself on stage!"
"What a bummer, she’s here to steal the spotlight!"
Beside her, a few artists pointed fingers at Ning Xiaoyue.
Hearing this, Ning Xiaoyue felt a bit down. She admitted she wasn’t good at singing or dancing, but as a Spaceship Lady member, she had to face the stage bravely despite her fears.
"Don’t mind what they say; I think you’re pretty good."
Suddenly, a young male idol, showing what he thought was a charming smile, approached Ning Xiaoyue, trying to comfort her.
Ning Xiaoyue felt his smile was a bit oily, but since he was defending her, she couldn’t ignore him.
"Thank you." Ning Xiaoyue expressed her gratitude.
"Hi, I’m Zhou Wenkun." The young idol extended his hand to Ning Xiaoyue.
Meanwhile, lurking behind the crowd, Feng Tianming watched the two with a sinister look on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 512: Feng Tianming’s Scheme
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Chapter 512: Feng Tianming’s Scheme
Yun City Satellite TV is hosting a gala tonight, with many celebrities invited.
Before the event starts, after finishing rehearsals, the stars begin to wait for entry and gather in groups, resembling a networking event.
Ning Xiaoyue and several of her teammates from the group also walk in, immediately drawing the attention of everyone present.
As a newly formed girl group that emerged from a selection show, they are the hottest young ladies at the moment, especially Ning Xiaoyue, whose popularity is immense, and her beauty is impossible to ignore.
Although everyone is in the entertainment industry, there are few who have seen Ning Xiaoyue in person, because she’s still a newcomer—no newer than any entertainment industry rookie—who had no background before her debut, just an ordinary girl from the bottom tier.
As soon as Ning Xiaoyue appears, she becomes the focus, with everyone showing amazed expressions, because Ning Xiaoyue is truly dazzlingly beautiful.
These people seem to understand why Ning Xiaoyue became popular and is so well-liked—she’s exceptionally beautiful, even more so in person than in videos and photos.
Nowadays, many internet celebrities and even stars are just photo tricks; their released pictures are heavily edited, photos so altered that even their mothers wouldn’t recognize them, and videos are heavily filtered, making it hard to see their true appearance. When seen offline, they immediately lose their shine, their true nature revealed.
Ning Xiaoyue, however, is the opposite, appearing more attractive offline than in photos and videos. She’s thinner in person, her face exceptionally small, her skin glowing white, and coupled with her youth, she looks like a heroine straight out of a manga.
But it’s precisely because Ning Xiaoyue is so beautiful that some female artists present start to feel jealous, and a few of them show disdainful expressions.
Attacking Ning Xiaoyue is actually simple—just seize on her lack of singing and dancing skills to mock her.
At this moment, two people appear in the crowd.
One of them is Feng Tianming, and the other is Cherry Entertainment’s trainee Zhou Wenkun. A few days ago, Cherry Entertainment’s CEO Wei Jiansheng handed Zhou Wenkun over to Feng Tianming, asking Feng to guide Zhou to secure the C position in the next season of Creation Star.
Zhou Wenkun already has a measure of fame, considered a minor celebrity. He was also invited to perform at tonight’s gala.
Feng Tianming brought Zhou Wenkun along.
"It’s truly the entertainment circle; all these female stars look quite good, and there is indeed a difference from ordinary people," Feng Tianming said admiringly.
Zhou Wenkun chuckled and said, "Brother Ming, with your status, getting these female celebrities wouldn’t be hard at all."
Feng Tianming replied, "You know this too?"
Zhou Wenkun said, "Don’t forget, although I’m a trainee now, I have been in this business for years, and nothing surprises me anymore. Everyone has a price; it’s just about what price it is. Of course, I haven’t had the chance to interact with A-list celebrities, so I don’t know about them. But I know some D-list female artists; they’re always thinking of marrying into wealth. You know, many top female stars eventually marry rich businessmen. I can say, a wealthy heir like Brother Ming is exactly their target."
Feng Tianming said, "Unfortunately, I’m not interested in them."
Indeed, Feng Tianming has no interest in charming female celebrities now. His father was just arrested, Shengshi Group’s stock price plummeted, and as a Rich Second Generation, he could easily become a negative second generation.
All he wants now is to rely on the Jiangnan Wei Family; maybe then he can maintain his wealthy status.
Zhou Wenkun laughed, "Brother Ming, do you think they’re dirty and unworthy of your attention? Then Brother Ming can focus on newcomers. The entertainment industry floods in countless newcomers every year. They’re young, yet unsullied, simply perfect. Take Ning Xiaoyue, for instance. Look how beautiful she is. Although her professional skills aren’t that great, she is just too pretty."
Feng Tianming followed Zhou Wenkun’s gaze and saw Ning Xiaoyue.
He immediately wore a sullen expression.
"This useless thing!" Feng Tianming’s eyes burned with anger.
He admitted Ning Xiaoyue was undeniably beautiful, but whenever he saw her face, he thought of Lin Fan, thought of the failed competition, thought of losing 100 million yuan to Lin Fan, thought of his father being sent to prison by Lin Fan.
He was filled with hatred, hatred for Lin Fan, and hatred for Ning Xiaoyue.
He almost wanted to go up and give Ning Xiaoyue a big slap across the face.
Suddenly, a thought sprang up in Feng Tianming’s mind, and he got excited.
"Kun Kun, I actually think that you and Ning Xiaoyue make a good match," Feng Tianming said.
Zhou Wenkun laughed, "Brother Ming, don’t joke around. She’s a booming female idol now; how could I ever match up to her?"
Feng Tianming said, "What does it matter? You’re a potential star. With me, in tomorrow’s Creation Star, you’ll definitely get the C position. By then, you’ll be an even bigger star than her."
Zhou Wenkun said, "Even if that’s the case, we could never be. You know that idols can’t date."
Feng Tianming said, "If you don’t talk about it, who will know if you’re dating or not? Moreover, I’ve heard that Ning Xiaoyue has dated before, and she’s easy to woo."
Zhou Wenkun said, "I’ve heard the scandals about her too, but weren’t those rumors disproven?"
Feng Tianming said, "And you believe denials? In the entertainment circle, denials are basically confirmations that can’t be admitted to, because once confessed, the fans run away. Enough said, just tell me, do you like Ning Xiaoyue or not?"
Zhou Wenkun said, "She’s so pretty, you’d be lying if you said you weren’t tempted."
Feng Tianming laughed, "Exactly, then you should boldly pursue her. Even if you fail, what’s the harm in trying? If you succeed, wouldn’t that be wonderful? Besides, with your godly looks and charm, Kun Kun, who could resist? Ning Xiaoyue is bound to like you."
Zhou Wenkun became a bit excited, "Really?"
Feng Tianming said, "Why would I lie to you?"
Zhou Wenkun asked curiously, "Brother Ming, why are you encouraging me to date? I’ve actually made up my mind to be an idol, resolved to abstain from women for at least a few years now."
After all, being an idol, you can’t date. In the entertainment circle, if idols date, it’s called ’toppling the house’, describing the fans’ heartbreak. As they watch their adored idol date while spending fans’ money, fans could turn their backs faster than you know it.
Zhou Wenkun has been in the entertainment circle for many years but has never really taken off. He wants to hit it big, ready to sacrifice certain matters for fame, like dating.
His goal is to endure, abstain for a few years from dating, and once he’s firmly established and no longer needs fans, he’ll consider dating again.
So now, Feng Tianming’s encouragement to pursue Ning Xiaoyue confuses him a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 513: Get Your Dog Paws Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Chapter 513: Get Your Dog Paws Off
Feng Tianming said, "Of course idols can’t date, but you’re not an idol yet, right? Even if you date now, it won’t affect your future. Look at Ning Xiaoyue, wasn’t it revealed she had dated before? But it was just resolved with a clarification, and she debuted a third time."
Zhou Wenkun said, "Brother Ming makes sense, so you’re saying I can date before joining the show?"
Feng Tianming replied, "Of course you can, trust me, I plan to get you the C-position. Do you think I would harm you?"
Zhou Wenkun laughed, "I definitely trust Brother Ming!"
Feng Tianming said, "Then go for it. This Ning Xiaoyue is really something special. If you can win her over, all the men in the world will envy you. But you can’t tell anyone, this can only be between us. After all, a public relationship will affect you, but a secret, unknown romance won’t matter."
Zhou Wenkun, egged on by Feng Tianming, indeed started thinking about it.
Still, he was a bit nervous and even a little insecure.
After all, Ning Xiaoyue is a popular star now, with incredible fame, while he is still unknown. Trying to woo Ning Xiaoyue seemed like aiming too high.
Feng Tianming silently cursed Zhou Wenkun for being a coward but encouraged him on the surface, "Kun Kun, consider this a test for you. You must know that it’s not easy to make it in the entertainment industry. If you don’t even have the courage to chase a girl, how will you survive here? Show me what you’ve got, and don’t forget, I said this Ning Xiaoyue is easy to woo."
Zhou Wenkun finally made up his mind, "I understand, Brother Ming. Watch me! I won’t let you down."
And so, Zhou Wenkun walked over to Ning Xiaoyue.
Feng Tianming watched his back and sneered with satisfaction, "This shabi, with just a few words from me, actually went through with it. He probably couldn’t even dream that Ning Xiaoyue has Lin Fan backing her! If he tries to woo Ning Xiaoyue, he’s offending Lin Fan. Do you think Lin Fan will let him go?"
Feng Tianming nearly laughed out loud.
His plan was simple: sending Zhou Wenkun to woo Ning Xiaoyue would surely irk her.
Over the past few days, he got to know Zhou Wenkun quite well, realizing he’s a Rich Second Generation. Before attempting to become an artist, he was a playboy with a bad temper and a penchant for chasing girls—a total wastrel. After his family sent him to the entertainment industry, he surprisingly excelled in singing and dancing, and he aspired to become a superstar.
Being a star means showing a positive image; he couldn’t act like a playboy anymore. So, his team packaged him as an honest, cute, hardworking person, concealing his true self.
But Feng Tianming knew his true nature all too well.
He foresaw that once Zhou Wenkun tangled with Ning Xiaoyue, trouble would surely follow.
Offending Ning Xiaoyue means offending Lin Fan behind her!
Once Lin Fan takes action against Zhou Wenkun, the situation will escalate.
As Cherry Entertainment’s rising star, Wei Jiansheng wouldn’t just sit by and do nothing!
The other day, Wei Jiansheng spoke with Feng Tianming, mentioning he wouldn’t take action against Lin Fan because it wasn’t worth it.
But if Zhou Wenkun offended Lin Fan, Wei Jiansheng would have no choice but to get involved.
This move is called baiting conflict, something Feng Tianming excelled at.
Sure enough, Zhou Wenkun took the bait.
At this moment, Ning Xiaoyue happened to be alone, her teammates having run to play elsewhere, leaving her by herself, playing with her phone.
Her teammates had invited her to join and meet the seniors present.
But Ning Xiaoyue had her thoughts, so she didn’t go.
Meanwhile, some people, out of jealousy, were sneering at Ning Xiaoyue.
She heard all the comments but chose to ignore them.
"Don’t mind what they think; I think you’re pretty great."
Zhou Wenkun smiled, flipping his hair, posing in what he considered a handsome manner.
But he hadn’t realized that when someone thinks they’re good-looking, they can come off as greasy, whether male or female. Overconfidence makes someone appear greasy.
To Ning Xiaoyue, Zhou Wenkun’s smile was overly greasy.
However, it was rare that Zhou Wenkun wasn’t causing trouble but trying to comfort her.
No matter what, Ning Xiaoyue couldn’t ignore a gesture of goodwill, so she politely said, "Thank you."
"Hello, I’m Zhou Wenkun," he said, extending his hand.
Ning Xiaoyue shook hands with him, "I am..."
Zhou Wenkun laughed, "You don’t need to say it, who doesn’t know who you are? You’re Ning Xiaoyue; is there anyone who doesn’t recognize you now?"
Zhou Wenkun held Ning Xiaoyue’s hand, seemingly reluctant to let go, and lightly squeezed it, maintaining his overly confident, greasy smile.
Ning Xiaoyue frowned, feeling something was off, and quickly pulled her hand back.
Zhou Wenkun said, "I think those who criticize you are just jealous because you’re too beautiful."
Ning Xiaoyue replied, "Thanks for standing up for me, but I have something to do now..."
Her meaning was clear; she didn’t want to continue the conversation. She felt something was off about him and wanted to get away.
Yet, Zhou Wenkun showed no intention of leaving. Since he came here to woo Ning Xiaoyue under Feng Tianming’s watchful eye, he couldn’t let Brother Ming down. He had to win over Ning Xiaoyue.
"Xiaoyue, can I call you that?" Zhou Wenkun asked.
Ning Xiaoyue reluctantly answered, "Hmm..."
Zhou Wenkun said, "How about we go over there for a drink? My treat. What do you like to drink? I’ll get it for you."
Ning Xiaoyue quickly declined, "Sorry, I don’t want a drink. I have something to do. I’ll find my teammates."
She wanted to escape. By now, she understood Zhou Wenkun wasn’t well-intentioned. Initially, he seemed to stand up for her, but he was just looking for an opportunity to get close.
This person surely had ulterior motives; getting rid of him quickly would prevent trouble.
Seeing her about to leave, Zhou Wenkun frowned. Something seemed wrong. Ning Xiaoyue didn’t get his hints at all. Previously, his tactics worked with every girl, but Ning Xiaoyue seemed uninterested.
No way, Brother Ming was still watching; he couldn’t let Brother Ming down. In the next year, he still had to follow Feng Tianming’s lead, aiming for the Creation Star’s C-position.
Now, the CEO of Cherry Entertainment, Wei Jiansheng, placed him under Feng Tianming’s guidance, meaning his future lay in Feng Tianming’s hands. Of course, he couldn’t disappoint him.
Moreover, he intended to impress Feng Tianming.
"Wait a minute," Zhou Wenkun called out to Ning Xiaoyue, reaching to grab her hand.
Ning Xiaoyue was just about to leave when he snatched her hand.
Ning Xiaoyue, quite annoyed, said, "Sorry, I really have to go. Please let go."
Zhou Wenkun smiled, "I won’t let go unless you agree to one thing."
Ning Xiaoyue only wanted to free herself, "What is it?"
Zhou Wenkun said, "Give me your number."
Ning Xiaoyue replied, "No, I really have to go."
Zhou Wenkun laughed, "If you don’t, I won’t let you leave. Xiaoyue, you know, the first time I saw you, I found you so cute, like I knew you."
Ning Xiaoyue became anxious, "Let go."
She tried to break free.
But Zhou Wenkun gripped her. As someone who practiced dancing often, his hand strength was no joke. Ning Xiaoyue couldn’t shake him off easily.
Just then.
"Take your filthy hand off."
A cold voice came, and Lin Fan, with a stern face, walked over from the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 514: How Come You’re as Obedient as a Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Chapter 514: How Come You’re as Obedient as a Dog
Zhou Wenkun failed to flirt with Ning Xiaoyue, got anxious, and tried to force it, which made Ning Xiaoyue even more disgusted. Her hand was grabbed by him, and Ning Xiaoyue just wanted to break free.
But Zhou Wenkun was stronger than Ning Xiaoyue, and she couldn’t shake free immediately.
At this moment, Lin Fan appeared.
"Take your filthy hand off," Lin Fan said coldly.
Just arrived and saw this effeminate little fresh meat acting recklessly, really makes one annoyed.
Zhou Wenkun looked up and couldn’t help but be impressed, so handsome! It was a masculine kind of handsomeness, full of male charm, completely different from his type of fresh meat handsome; compared to Lin Fan’s handsomeness, he felt like a girl.
"What’s it to you? Mind your own business!" Zhou Wenkun said, feeling a bit hostile seeing someone more handsome than him.
However, in the next second.
His hand was grabbed by Lin Fan, Lin Fan didn’t even need to use much force, and Zhou Wenkun was already in tears from the pain, involuntarily releasing Ning Xiaoyue.
Ning Xiaoyue quickly ran behind Lin Fan, feeling reassured now that Brother Lin was there.
She couldn’t believe this Zhou Wenkun dared to act up in such a setting. If someone accidentally took a photo, it would cause another storm, he must have a screw loose.
Zhou Wenkun’s hand hurt, he exclaimed in shock and anger: "Let go of me, who the hell are you, do you even know who I am?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Go on, keep yelling."
Zhou Wenkun felt even more pain in his hand, as if caught by a giant pincer, feeling like his bones were cracking.
"Ah!" Zhou Wenkun let out a scream.
"Let go, let go, I beg you, let go, I won’t dare anymore..." Zhou Wenkun was about to cry from fear. Damn, how can someone have such a strong grip in this world!
If he continued being cocky, his hand bones would really break, Zhou Wenkun wasn’t stupid, how could he dare continue the act.
Only then did Lin Fan release Zhou Wenkun.
Zhou Wenkun rubbed his wrist, sweating from the pain, looked at Lin Fan and said, "What kind of person are you, are you even human!"
He had never seen someone with such strength in their hands, truly unlike an ordinary person.
Lin Fan ignored him, turned back and asked Ning Xiaoyue, "Xiaoyue, are you alright?"
Ning Xiaoyue shook her head, "I’m okay, thank goodness Brother Lin came in time. I don’t know what kind of madness struck him, I didn’t even want to talk to him, yet he still grabbed me."
Lin Fan said, "Probably just trash, don’t worry, he won’t be doing it again."
Lin Fan saying Zhou Wenkun wouldn’t do it again was not because he was overly confident, wanting to intimidate Zhou Wenkun sufficiently just now was enough, but because he truly wouldn’t let Zhou Wenkun near Ning Xiaoyue again.
A worthless person, an invalid who lacks action capability, what chance would he have.
Zhou Wenkun was indignant, to be subdued by this stranger how could he swallow this anger.
"Kid, don’t get cocky, you have no idea who you’ve offended, go find out, is Zhou Wenkun someone you can mess with!" Zhou Wenkun said arrogantly.
Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered arguing, patted Zhou Wenkun’s shoulder, "Scram."
Zhou Wenkun wanted to say something more, but suddenly, he felt his insides roil, as if a force suddenly drilled into his stomach causing trouble.
Almost unable to hold it in, he turned and ran, if he didn’t he’d crap his pants.
