Ning Xiaoyue found it a bit funny and was curious, how could it be that when Brother Lin told him to scram, he really just scrammed, like a dog, obediently.
Lin Fan no longer paid attention to Zhou Wenkun. This guy offended Ning Xiaoyue, just a light tap on his shoulder, seemed mild but was actually heavy, Zhou Wenkun’s internal organs were already damaged, and over time, he’d become a cripple.
"Xiaoyue, don’t mind him. Did you ask me here to talk about something?" Lin Fan inquired.
Ning Xiaoyue quickly put Zhou Wenkun behind her, blushed and said, "Last time at the company, it was just a brief encounter, I didn’t even get a chance to talk to Brother Lin. Just happened to have an event in Yun City, so I thought I’d see Brother Lin. Tomorrow morning, I have to go out of town again, not sure when I’ll be back in Yun City."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re quite busy now, I know, but even if we can’t meet in person, you can still call me, if there’s anything you need from me, I’ll do my best to help."
Ning Xiaoyue said, "Yeah, everything’s fine now with the agency."
They chatted for a while, but then Ning Xiaoyue’s teammates returned, grabbing her to go back to the backstage and prepare for their performance.
Ning Xiaoyue was regretful, having just started talking with Brother Lin, yet already had so much to say and no time for it, would have to wait until next time.
"Brother Lin, I have to go now." Ning Xiaoyue said reluctantly.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Go on, good luck!"
In his eyes, Ning Xiaoyue was like a cute younger sister, his care for her was natural, without any impurities, and he knew Ning Xiaoyue felt the same about him.
Ning Xiaoyue ultimately hurried away with her teammates, she was about to perform soon, and after that, had to rush to another city for a flight.
After Ning Xiaoyue left, Lin Fan suddenly turned his gaze to the corner of the crowd, and indeed, saw Feng Tianming!
Feng Tianming was staring intensely at Lin Fan, a sly smile on his face.
When he realized Lin Fan had noticed him, Feng Tianming immediately backed away, disappearing into the crowd.
Lin Fan frowned, what’s this guy up to? Seemed pleased like he had pulled something off, could it be...
Lin Fan thought of something, took out his phone, and searched for Zhou Wenkun.
The information online showed Zhou Wenkun had joined an entertainment company at fifteen, trained in singing and dancing, later participated in a popular variety show, making it to the top five, and became a somewhat famous minor celebrity. Recently, Zhou Wenkun joined Cherry Entertainment as a trainee artist.
Cherry Entertainment!
Founded by Jiangnan Wei Family’s third son, Wei Jiansheng.
Which means Zhou Wenkun is one of Wei Jiansheng’s people!
No need to guess, Feng Tianming is also with Cherry Entertainment, they must be in cahoots, probably Zhou Wenkun harassing Ning Xiaoyue was instigated by Feng Tianming.
What’s Feng Tianming’s goal? No need to guess, he wants to provoke a clash between Lin Fan and Wei Jiansheng.
Feng Tianming couldn’t fight Lin Fan himself, trying to pull Wei Jiansheng into it through Zhou Wenkun?
Lin Fan sneered.
Feng Tianming’s move might be clever, but unfortunately, it means little, because even before Feng Tianming’s instigation, Lin Fan had already declared war on Jiangnan Wei Family.
Feng Tianming’s act is unnecessary.
Not to mention one Wei Jiansheng, even the entire Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Family’s patriarch Wei Tiansheng, would all be dealt with just like that!
Lin Fan had received a system mission to become the underworld king of Yun City, coincidentally Wei Family had similar ambitions, their clash was already fated.
What Feng Tianming was doing only made the conflict more intense, setting the stage for multi-front battles.
"Whatever, Xiaoyue is about to go on stage, I’m free anyway, might as well go watch, there’s going to be quite a show, wouldn’t want to miss it." Lin Fan said with a mischievous smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 515: The Most Shocking Stage Accident in History
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: Chapter 515: The Most Shocking Stage Accident in History
Yun City Satellite TV, the gala finally started.
As the hottest new idol group of the year, Spaceship Lady took the stage as the opening act.
After a segment of singing and dancing, all the members were in form, and the performance was quite decent. Even the worst member, Ning Xiaoyue, managed to keep up with the rhythm.
It seems Ning Xiaoyue put in a lot of effort. It also shows that given enough time to practice, Ning Xiaoyue can handle a regular stage performance adequately.
Of course, people online were watching this performance, ready to mock Ning Xiaoyue, but upon seeing her passably perform, they seemed to turn a blind eye. She didn’t even make it to the trending topics. If tonight Ning Xiaoyue had a stage accident, she would probably be number one on the trending searches. It seems they just want to criticize her, not praise her.
There are also some who still pick at minor faults, making awkward sarcastic remarks, but they end up looking childish and foolish without realizing they are the real clowns.
Ning Xiaoyue may have poor fundamentals, but her attitude is right. She’s doing her best to complete her work, while these online critics, with nothing better to do, just spew hate from behind a keyboard. The difference is quite clear.
After Spaceship Lady’s performance ended, Ning Xiaoyue returned backstage to remove her makeup and hurriedly went to catch a plane for her next job. She didn’t even have time to meet Brother Lin, whom she wanted to see the most, let alone engage with these online warriors.
Ning Xiaoyue knew that her performance was definitely seen by Brother Lin, who was in the audience. She hopes tonight’s performance won’t disappoint Lin Fan; she will work even harder to live up to Brother Lin’s encouragement.
Lin Fan watched Ning Xiaoyue’s performance seriously from the audience. Although Xiaoyue had 8 teammates on stage, Lin Fan’s attention was solely on her.
Lin Fan, while not interested in singing and dancing, could tell Ning Xiaoyue did well. She might not compare to top performers, but her attitude was very earnest.
Sometimes being weak is not a problem; weakness can be improved through practice. Attitude is what’s most important.
Lin Fan felt very pleased; Ning Xiaoyue didn’t let him down. He knows that as long as Ning Xiaoyue maintains this attitude, she will only get better.
After watching Ning Xiaoyue’s performance, Lin Fan didn’t leave immediately but stayed on, perhaps suddenly having an interest in the gala.
After lacklusterly watching several performances.
The host announced that the next performance would be Zhou Wenkun coming on stage to sing!
Lin Fan, nearly falling asleep during previous performances, suddenly perked up.
Zhou Wenkun strutted onto the stage with what he thought was a dashing pose, followed by a group of backup dancers.
"Previously, Wenkun had an outstanding performance on a variety show that showcased his excellent singing skills. We can expect him to bring us a spectacular performance today, something that will make everyone’s ticket worthwhile!"
The host exaggerated, likely influenced by Cherry Entertainment, or else he wouldn’t provide such nauseating flattery for Zhou Wenkun who is still at the fringe of the industry.
Zhou Wenkun, flattered to the point of arrogance, walked with more confidence, but also in a greasier manner.
The music started, and Zhou Wenkun began his singing.
He had only sung a few lines.
Oh no!
Zhou Wenkun suddenly clutched his stomach, his face changing, not good—before coming on stage, he had a sudden bout of diarrhea and had spent a long time in the restroom before feeling okay.
He originally thought he could complete the performance without issue, but after just a few lines, his stomach started acting up again.
He felt tumultuous inside, too uncomfortable.
But the performance was already underway; he couldn’t just stop to go to the bathroom, so Zhou Wenkun had no choice but to endure.
However, the discomfort became unbearable, and he was on the verge of having an accident in his pants.
Zhou Wenkun wanted to cry. Damn it, how could he be so unlucky? At such an important moment, he had diarrhea despite having eaten normally today. What the hell is going on?
Because his stomach pains distracted him, his singing deteriorated, his voice wavered, and he sang the lyrics wrong.
The audience frowned; really? This is supposed to be outstanding singing?
This is supposed to be the strength of someone who won fifth place in a variety show that solely focused on skill, unlike Creation Star, which focuses on popularity. Zhou Wenkun should logically be quite skilled.
Given Zhou Wenkun’s potential, the industry anticipated he would secure the top position in the next season of Creation Star. He was Cherry Entertainment’s ace.
But tonight, Zhou Wenkun’s performance was clearly lacking; some even felt he sang worse than Ning Xiaoyue, who is known for her mediocre singing and dancing.
What a disgrace!
In a corner of the audience, Feng Tianming was a bit shocked; he hadn’t expected Zhou Wenkun’s performance to be so poor. Did something happen? Did his failed attempt to woo Ning Xiaoyue and being chased away by Lin Fan unbalance his mindset?
Zhou Wenkun, however, couldn’t care less whether his singing was good or how the audience viewed him.
He just wanted to go to the bathroom!
If he didn’t hurry, it would be too late.
"Oh God, I can’t stand it, even if I’m scolded, I need to dash to the bathroom; what am I supposed to keep singing for!"
Ultimately, Zhou Wenkun couldn’t hold it in anymore; the song was several minutes long, and he couldn’t wait that long.
So Zhou Wenkun abruptly stopped singing and turned to run.
However, as soon as he moved, his stomach churned violently as if a dam had burst, and his body was no longer under his control.
Bang!
The sound of a fart louder than the music echoed throughout the venue, drowning out the music.
To make matters worse, Zhou Wenkun had turned around, presenting his rear to the audience as awful things exploded out.
The nearby dancers were startled and swiftly covered their noses, dodging away, leaving the stage in chaos, only the noisy music continued playing.
"Ah!"
The audience was in an uproar, shocked by the sudden incident.
Holy crap!
They never in their wildest dreams imagined such an accident happening on stage!
As the host had earlier said, it was certain to be an impactful event.
The host was dumbfounded; he’d been hosting all his life and never encountered such an astonishing stage accident—it was arguably the most shocking stage mishap in history!
"Did he just crap on stage?" The host questioned incredulously, damn, how could someone have such an accident on stage, truly a once-in-a-lifetime sight!
Once everyone recovered from the shock, uncontrollable laughter erupted because it was just too hilarious that someone would have such an accident, making it nearly impossible not to laugh.
At that moment, Zhou Wenkun wanted to die from embarrassment, thinking he had suffered a social death. He couldn’t care about anything else and hurriedly covered his trousers, escaping as fast as he could.
In the audience, Feng Tianming was dumbstruck; it was over. Zhou Wenkun was finished. Wei Jiansheng had left Zhou Wenkun with him for only a few days, and Zhou Wenkun had already destroyed his career, crapping on a satellite TV stage in front of the audience, truly a social death.
Sure enough, soon enough, Zhou Wenkun’s stage mishap became trending, and he finally became famous, albeit for the wrong reasons.
Lin Fan finally stood up, content, and left the venue.
While Zhou Wenkun harassed Ning Xiaoyue mostly due to Feng Tianming’s machinations, Zhou Wenkun didn’t deserve sympathy.
Feng Tianming just wanted to stir conflict between Wei Jiansheng and Lin Fan, so let the battle begin; this served as a gift to the Wei Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: Lin Fan, just you wait for me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 516: Chapter 516: Lin Fan, just you wait for me!
Slap!
In the office of the Cherry Entertainment CEO, Wei Jiansheng slammed both hands heavily on the desk, jumping up with a furious face.
Livid with rage!
"What the hell happened, what the hell are you playing at, doing something so disgraceful? You’ve not only ruined your own future, but you’ve also embarrassed the hell out of me!"
Wei Jiansheng pointed at Zhou Wenkun across from him, shouting angrily.
Zhou Wenkun and Feng Tianming were standing right in front of Wei Jiansheng. Feng Tianming seemed calm, but Zhou Wenkun was trembling with fear.
Thud.
Zhou Wenkun knelt down, tears streaming down: "President Wei, I didn’t want this, I don’t even know what happened. Last night, to ensure the performance went smoothly, I barely ate anything. How was I supposed to know I’d have an upset stomach, I really couldn’t control it."
Last night during the live broadcast on Satellite TV, Zhou Wenkun, in front of the live audience and TV viewers, sprayed feces on stage!
This matter has now become known to everyone, making Zhou Wenkun a laughingstock. Netizens even gave him the nickname ’Poop Spray Guy.’
Zhou Wenkun became famous overnight, more so than when he participated in the talent show but also thoroughly destroyed his future in the entertainment industry. As a big joke of a guy who sprayed feces on stage, this gag will always stick to him if he stays in the industry.
Moreover, Zhou Wenkun’s embarrassing behavior also tarnished the TV station’s image. Yun City Satellite TV was the first to ban Zhou Wenkun.
In the entertainment circle, Zhou Wenkun no longer has a place. Although he’s very popular now, it’s just temporary heat, and once it’s gone, he’s back to nothing.
Zhou Wenkun was very frustrated, utterly confused as to why he had such an extreme stomach upset last night - it seemed like a bad joke.
Wei Jiansheng raged: "Did you eat something wrong, you should know! You’ve made me a joke too, do you know how it’s being spread outside now, as Cherry Entertainment’s artist spraying poop on stage, Wei Jiansheng’s artist spraying poop on stage!"
Wei Jiansheng was furious, to the point his face turned green. Zhou Wenkun made him a laughingstock too, which was something he couldn’t accept.
"Ahem!"
Beside him, Feng Tianming cleared his throat and said: "Mr. Wei, I think you can’t blame Kun Kun for this matter."
Wei Jiansheng said: "What do you mean, you’re going to defend him?"
Zhou Wenkun immediately looked at Feng Tianming full of hope.
Feng Tianming said: "Yesterday, I was with Kun Kun the whole time, and he ate what I ate. I didn’t have an upset stomach, so theoretically, Kun Kun shouldn’t have either, let alone such a severe case, it’s simply not reasonable."
Wei Jiansheng said: "What do you mean by that, not reasonable?"
Feng Tianming said: "Correct, even with an upset stomach, one could usually endure it. But Kun Kun’s case of losing control is impossible with merely an upset stomach; this was obviously sabotage."
Wei Jiansheng’s expression changed: "You mean someone drugged him to make a fool of him in public? Who dares do this? He is my artist; who dares court death like this!"
Wei Jiansheng had great confidence; he didn’t believe someone would dare target his artist and provoke the Wei Family.
The consequences of provoking the Wei Family were serious, very serious!
Feng Tianming said: "If in Yun City, someone dared to provoke the Wei Family, it could only be that person. I’m talking about, Yun City’s new richest man, Lin Fan! And coincidentally, last night, Kun Kun had a clash with Lin Fan, and the incident of spraying poop on stage happened after the clash with Lin Fan. I have reason to believe Lin Fan did something!"
"Lin Fan!"
Wei Jiansheng’s face tightened, was it actually Lin Fan!
"Why did he have a clash with Lin Fan?" Wei Jiansheng asked.
Zhou Wenkun muttered: "This..."
He glanced at Feng Tianming, unsure whether to tell the truth. He tried to hit on Ning Xiaoyue last night, encouraged by Feng Tianming, and he didn’t know if he should tell Wei Jiansheng about it.
Feng Tianming quickly said: "Here’s what happened, at last night’s event, Kun Kun saw Ning Xiaoyue and wanted to say hi out of friendliness, which resulted in Lin Fan’s displeasure."
Zhou Wenkun nodded, "That’s it."
Wei Jiansheng said: "How did Lin Fan mess with him?"
Feng Tianming said: "I recorded the whole conflict on video last night, Mr. Wei, have a look."
Feng Tianming took out his phone and opened a video for Wei Jiansheng to view. In the video, Lin Fan grabbed Zhou Wenkun’s hand...
After watching, Wei Jiansheng, puzzled, said: "I’ve seen it, but I couldn’t see any tricks played by Lin Fan, he just grabbed his hand and patted his shoulder, is that why he had an upset stomach? This kind of evidence, even if given to the police, they wouldn’t believe it, there’s no persuasive power!"
Feng Tianming said: "That’s because, Mr. Wei, you don’t know. A mere hand grab or shoulder pat wouldn’t cause such a huge upset, but Lin Fan is absolutely capable of it because he’s incredibly strong!"
Wei Jiansheng said: "What do you mean by incredibly strong?"
Feng Tianming said: "The other day, Lin Fan annoyed my father, and even the top Muay Thai expert Li San from Thailand, hired by my father, was instantly kicked down by Lin Fan’s single kick. He’s unbelievably formidable!"
Wei Jiansheng, surprised, said: "Muay Thai Li San, I know the guy, he’s powerful, and you’re saying Lin Fan took him down instantly? Lin Fan is that strong?"
Feng Tianming said: "I swear on my father’s life, this is absolutely true, if there’s any falsity, may thunder strike my father!"
Wei Jiansheng nodded: "You can make such a vow, I believe you! How outrageous, that Lin Fan dares do this, making me lose face!"
Feng Tianming said: "Lin Fan is arrogant and conceited, even knowing Kun Kun is under Cherry Entertainment and that Cherry Entertainment belongs to Mr. Wei, he still did this, clearly to provoke the Wei Family, to provoke Mr. Wei!"
The more Wei Jiansheng thought about it, the angrier he became: "Oh, Lin Fan, you don’t even put me, Wei Jiansheng, in your eyes! Originally, I didn’t intend to provoke you, but since you’ve come after me, don’t blame me for being rude!"
Upon hearing this, Feng Tianming secretly rejoiced. He said all of this to drag Wei Jiansheng into the fray, to have the Wei Family clash with Lin Fan.
Now it seems that his provocation has succeeded, all his schemes haven’t gone to waste.
Feng Tianming continued to fan the flames: "I heard Lin Fan’s invested Wenyue Company is also forming a boyband. They launched Ning Xiaoyue successfully this year, aiming for the top spot in next season’s Creation Star, and Kun Kun is our ace. Lin Fan took this opportunity to take down our ace! Poor Kun Kun, ruined by Lin Fan’s hands."
Feng Tianming lamented regretfully, pretending to care.
Wei Jiansheng’s anger reached its peak, slamming the desk.
Bam!
A loud sound.
"Lin Fan, just you wait for me, I will never let you go, wait for the most terrifying revenge! Others might fear you as Yun City’s richest man, but in front of me, Wei Jiansheng, what are you even!" roared Wei Jiansheng.
"Achoo!"
At the same time, Lin Fan, who was driving the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, sneezed.
"Who is thinking about me now?" Lin Fan muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 Underground Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Chapter 517 Underground Gathering
Lin Fan didn’t know, it was Wei Jiansheng who was thinking about taking revenge on him.
But even if he knew, Lin Fan wouldn’t care. Zhou Wenkun dared to provoke Ning Xiaoyue, Lin Fan couldn’t just swallow his anger, even knowing it was Feng Tianming deliberately stirring the pot.
Lin Fan truly wasn’t afraid of Jiangnan Wei Family, he even actively wanted to declare war on them.
Today, Lin Fan was about to start a battle with the Wei Family.
Today is the day of the underground gathering in Yun City!
Victory Hawker Stall.
This is a hawker stall located in the outskirts of Yun City, surrounded on all sides, it looks like an ordinary hawker stall on the surface, nothing special, usually it operates normally and is open to the public.
Because the food at this hawker stall is quite tasty, even though it’s in a remote location, nearby residents would come to eat.
But today, nearby residents are avoiding this hawker stall like they’ve seen a ghost, keeping their distance, and anyone who accidentally gets to the entrance quickly retreats, patting their chest and calling it a lucky escape.
No choice, rumors had already spread since yesterday that this hawker stall had been booked today, the person who booked it is a big shot, supposedly not to be messed with.
Today, the wide wasteland outside this hawker stall is filled with parked cars.
The gathering initiated by Mountain Chicken, the underground bigwig, is being held here.
The various big and small leaders of Yun City’s underground have all come, each leader can bring two men inside, over a hundred people are already seated within the stall.
Among them, there are more than thirty leaders of various sizes.
In Yun City’s underground, many factions exist, with leaders mostly at odds with each other, fighting over territory is common, and they like to put each other down when meeting.
But today, the large scene appears somewhat quiet, the atmosphere heavy.
Quite a few leaders even seem downcast.
These downcast leaders, at a glance, all seem to be injured, some have bruises and swollen faces, and the more severe ones even have broken legs, brought in by their men, looking somewhat pitiful.
"What’s up with all these long faces, someone dead at home?"
A voice said.
Just then, Brother Chicken walked in wearing a white suit, with a cigar in his mouth.
Behind Brother Chicken was only one person, a middle-aged man wearing traditional Chinese clothing and sunglasses, a silent middle-aged man.
The underlings of Brother Chicken are usually dressed in black suits, carrying axes, but this middle-aged man is completely different from Brother Chicken’s usual men.
The leaders all wore complex expressions when they saw Mountain Chicken arrive.
It’s understood.
This gathering was organized by Brother Chicken, nobody dared to defy him, so everyone came, and as for Brother Chicken’s reason for organizing this gathering, everyone had heard a bit about it.
"Hey, Old Li, what happened to your face, got beaten up badly!"
"Old Chen, you’re worse off, how come your hand got broken!"
"Wow, so many people are injured, what’s going on here?"
Mountain Chicken observed the crowd, gradually showing a surprised expression.
The crowd looked at Mountain Chicken, some appeared angry but dared not voice it.
Finally, a leader with a broken leg couldn’t hold his temper, snorted coldly, "Mountain Chicken, don’t go too far, be careful not even the heavens will tolerate it!"
Mountain Chicken glanced at this leader, said, "Brother Hu, what’s that supposed to mean, why don’t I understand?"
Brother Hu snorted, "You don’t know what you did?"
Mountain Chicken replied, "What, Brother Hu means you were beaten, and it was done by me? No way, is that what you all think?"
Judging from the expressions, they clearly believed Mountain Chicken orchestrated it.
Because only Mountain Chicken had the motive, Mountain Chicken wanted to unify Yun City’s underground, doing this was to intimidate the leaders so they wouldn’t dare resist.
Seeing the expressions of the crowd, Mountain Chicken slapped his forehead, said, "Wronged, a great injustice, you actually all think I beat you, my style, if I really wanted to beat you, would I need to be so mysterious?"
The crowd remained silent.
Mountain Chicken continued, "I also heard about what happened to you, you were beaten by a woman, right? I swear she absolutely isn’t one of mine, how could I get a woman to beat you."
Recently, a mysterious woman appeared on Yun City’s streets, whenever she saw thugs misbehaving, she would deal with them, the worst part was even the boss behind the thugs would get found and beaten up.
This mysterious woman was too impressive, these thug leaders were completely defenseless.
Over the past few days, there were actually over ten leaders who had been beaten.
All of a sudden, the thugs of Yun City became much more low-key, afraid to act recklessly, fearing they would be targeted by this mysterious woman.
Considering the recent actions of the Mountain Chicken Gang, everyone thought this mysterious woman must be someone Brother Chicken brought to establish authority.
Therefore, despite Mountain Chicken’s strong denial, the crowd was skeptical.
"Chicken, then tell us, if this mysterious woman wasn’t brought by you, who was she?" Brother Hu snorted.
Mountain Chicken replied, "How would I know, but this issue shows how scattered Yun City’s underground is, to let a woman push us around, it’s simply pathetic! If we could change this state, see if that woman dares bully you!"
Brother Hu said, "Chicken, what do you mean to say?"
Mountain Chicken said, "I, Mountain Chicken, have always been straightforward, so I won’t beat around the bush, I’ll say it directly, calling everyone here today is to change the underground status in Yun City, I, Mountain Chicken, want to be the leader of Yun City’s underground, does anyone here have any objections?"
The crowd exchanged glances, Mountain Chicken was indeed too direct.
"Of course, I, Mountain Chicken, don’t want to force you, those who want to follow me can raise their hand, those who don’t can stand up and discuss it with me."
Discussing in underground terms simply means whose fists are bigger, who has the reason.
None present truly dared to compare fists with Mountain Chicken.
Everyone glanced at each other, not daring to stand up, who would dare stand, it would be self-inflicted humiliation!
Mountain Chicken was satisfied with this scene, said, "No one opposes, good, everyone rest assured, once the underground is unified, I, Mountain Chicken, can promise to ensure your safety, once you’re under me, that damn woman will be dealt with by me, I won’t let my brothers get bullied, especially not by a woman!"
Brother Hu seemed somewhat tempted, said, "Chicken, can you really handle that woman?"
Mountain Chicken confidently replied, "Of course, just a woman, what’s the big deal! If I can’t handle a woman, I don’t deserve to be your leader!"
The crowd had to admit, Mountain Chicken’s promise made them somewhat tempted.
The existence of that mysterious woman made them all fearful, if Mountain Chicken could really deal with her, calling him leader wouldn’t be an issue!
Mountain Chicken was secretly pleased, originally he expected unifying Yun City’s underground wouldn’t be so easy, after all, these leaders typically don’t submit to each other.
Unexpectedly, the appearance of that mysterious woman made it unexpectedly smooth, as long as he could deal with her, the leaders would be willing to follow him.
And dealing with a woman, Mountain Chicken was quite confident.
Mountain Chicken said, "If everyone has no issues, then I want to announce, from now on Yun City’s leader will be me..."
"Who says everyone has no issues? I have an opinion!"
A voice came from outside the door, and Li Zhen walked in.

chapters.title: Chapter 518: Vulnerable
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Chapter 518: Vulnerable
The appearance of the mysterious woman caused a stir in Yun City’s underground, making all the underground leaders cautious. They advised their subordinates to avoid causing trouble, fearing they might provoke this terrifying woman.
They all wanted the woman to disappear, but unfortunately, they didn’t have the capability. At this moment, Mountain Chicken stepped forward and promised that as long as the leaders acknowledged him as their boss, he would deal with the woman.
This tempted the leaders. If Mountain Chicken could truly handle this terrifying woman, they were willing to call him "big brother".
It seemed Mountain Chicken was about to succeed.
Li Zhen walked in.
"Who said everyone has no objections? I have an objection!"
Li Zhen stated immediately upon entering.
He had come alone.
The group was not surprised to see Li Zhen, as he had stated publicly before that he would not support Mountain Chicken. He had even refused to attend this meeting previously.
As long as Li Zhen didn’t attend the meeting or bow to Mountain Chicken, Yun City’s underground couldn’t be considered unified. Li Zhen still held a high status in Yun City’s underground.
Therefore, Mountain Chicken was eagerly inviting Li Zhen to attend. His plan was to make Li Zhen submit in front of everyone. Once Li Zhen yielded, the others would naturally follow.
Indeed, Li Zhen expressed his dissatisfaction upon arrival.
Mountain Chicken had anticipated this and chuckled: "Brother Zhen, I’m pleased that you attended this gathering. It’s fine if you have objections, but I will soon make you have none."
Li Zhen replied coldly, "The only way you can make me have no objections is to defeat me."
Mountain Chicken laughed, "If I defeat Brother Zhen, does that mean Brother Zhen will let me be the boss?"
Li Zhen said, "That’s right. I hope you personally fight me. Back when we were both under Master Kun, we rarely sparred despite teaming up often. The three times we did spar, I won twice and there was one draw. Today is our fourth encounter, and I’m very much looking forward to the result."
Mountain Chicken responded, "As the saying goes, a real man doesn’t boast about his past glory. I heard that Brother Zhen has been consistently training over these years, but you haven’t fought anyone in a long time. Do you really think you can be like before?"
Li Zhen replied, "We’ll find out after we fight. Mountain Chicken, let’s settle this in one match. If you win against me, you can unify Yun City, and I will call you boss. If you lose, then sorry, but you’ll have to give up your ambitions and disband the Mountain Chicken Gang!"
Mountain Chicken’s face darkened, "You want me to disband? That’s a bit too harsh, isn’t it? You know that’s impossible!"
Li Zhen laughed, "Are you afraid you’ll lose to me?"
Mountain Chicken sneered, "Lose to you? You’re overthinking it! Fine, let’s do it this way. Anyway, there’s no way you can beat me!"
Li Zhen was determined not to let Mountain Chicken unify Yun City’s underground, so there was no point in further discussion. Only fists could resolve the matter. In the underground world, this was the most common, simplest, and effective method. Any problem could be solved with fists.
The one with the bigger fist has the reason.
The fight between Mountain Chicken and Li Zhen immediately sparked great interest among everyone.
Back in the day, they were two fierce fighters under Master Kun. No one knew which one was stronger. It was rare to see them in action, especially since Li Zhen hadn’t fought for years. For the underground crowd, today was like a dream come true.
"I think Mountain Chicken has a better chance to win. He’s even better than he was back then!"
"Brother Zhen is also very strong, but he hasn’t fought in ages."
"Does this mean Yun City’s underground will have to listen to Mountain Chicken from now on!"
The crowd discussed among themselves, with the majority believing Mountain Chicken would win.
Mountain Chicken had too strong a presence. Even now, he was always on the front lines of fighting, still the fierce warrior he once was.
Hearing the crowd, Mountain Chicken’s confidence grew: "Brother Zhen, I allow you to make the first move."
Li Zhen said, "I don’t mind making the first move, but you might not get the chance to strike, so you better go first."
What?
The crowd was taken aback by Brother Zhen’s bold tone!
Mountain Chicken sneered, "I admire Brother Zhen’s confidence, but it’s a pity that Brother Zhen is stuck in past fantasies. I’ll soon make Brother Zhen realize the times have changed!"
With that, Mountain Chicken swung his fist and charged at Li Zhen.
He wanted to knock Li Zhen down in front of everyone, the same Li Zhen who had beaten him twice in the past, and that would be his best gift to become Yun City’s top boss.
"Back then, we were both under Master Kun, and people said I was a mad warrior, feared by all. But I was always overshadowed by you. We engaged three times; you won twice. Even when we drew, I felt I had lost. I had always longed to defeat you. Today, on this important day, I’ll knock you down in front of everyone. I want everyone to know that I, Mountain Chicken, deserve to be the boss!"
As Mountain Chicken spoke, his fist was already inches away from Li Zhen.
Based on Mountain Chicken’s confidence, this punch would at least make Li Zhen stagger back or possibly even fall. In his current state, there was no way Li Zhen could win against him. He couldn’t understand how Li Zhen found the courage to really accept the fight against him.
However...
Mountain Chicken’s fist didn’t knock Li Zhen down, nor did it even touch him.
The next second.
"Ah!"
Mountain Chicken let out a scream.
Within an instant, Li Zhen countered, dodged Mountain Chicken’s punch, and executed an over-the-shoulder throw on him. His movements were as flowing as water and even faster than Mountain Chicken could grasp, throwing him heavily onto the ground.
Thud!
Mountain Chicken landed on the ground, dizzy and disoriented.
Li Zhen quickly flipped over and straddled Mountain Chicken, pinning him down with one hand while lifting a massive fist with the other, aiming it at Mountain Chicken’s face.
After two punches, Mountain Chicken’s face was already black and blue.
Silence!
Everyone was silent.
The crowd was utterly shocked.
They thought Mountain Chicken was the likely winner of this match. Who would have expected that he would not only lose but lose so miserably, practically being instantly defeated by Li Zhen?
Brother Zhen was terrifying, not having fought for so long, yet even more formidable once he did!
Li Zhen was extremely excited. He felt incredibly powerful, and Mountain Chicken was no match for him!
"The fighting skills Miss An taught me are incredibly strong. I’ve only scratched the surface..."
In his heart, Li Zhen praised.
It turns out that the move he used to defeat his enemy was taught by Anna!
Originally, he didn’t have much chance against Mountain Chicken and even thought he might lose to the current Mountain Chicken.
The skills Anna taught him practically allowed him to instantly defeat Mountain Chicken!
In that moment, Li Zhen felt extreme admiration for Anna and thought again about how Lin Fan, who was by Anna’s side, was even more formidable than Anna. Truly, there is always someone stronger!
"Mountain Chicken, do you yield?"
Li Zhen asked, raising his fist again, ready to strike.
"Mr. Ma, help me!" In his desperation, Mountain Chicken cried out.
Bang!
A flying kick from the side sent Li Zhen flying, landing heavily on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 519: Mysterious Woman Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Chapter 519: Mysterious Woman Appears
Even if Li Zhen and Mountain Chicken were impressive, they still hadn’t escaped the realm of street thugs. Compared to ordinary people, their fierce and fearless style was indeed considered formidable, and most people genuinely dared not provoke them.
Their way of fighting relied on a fearlessness of death, charging forward recklessly. Moreover, having fought many battles, they had gained experience and most people weren’t their match.
But in the end, they couldn’t be considered martial artists because their techniques were unorganized and chaotic. Even if they had some practical battle experiences, they ultimately lacked a coherent system.
If they encountered a skilled martial artist, they were essentially doomed to lose.
Given their original skills, it was hard to say who would win in a fight between the two of them. The crowd believed Mountain Chicken would win, which was a reasonable guess because Li Zhen hadn’t fought anyone for many years.
However, no one expected Li Zhen to receive guidance from Anna.
Anna simply taught him a few combat techniques, which made Li Zhen feel like he had been reborn.
This was precisely why he quickly knocked Mountain Chicken down in one encounter.
In other words, under Anna’s guidance, Li Zhen’s combat capabilities soared, giving him a glimpse into the world of martial arts.
Street thugs encountering genuine kung fu were destined to be defeated.
Li Zhen pinned Mountain Chicken down and punched him twice, leaving his face bruised and swollen, attempting to make him surrender with his fists.
"Mountain Chicken, you lost to me again. What did you just say, times have changed? It seems that times indeed have changed, but our victory and defeat haven’t!"
"Mountain Chicken, do you submit?"
Li Zhen shouted deeply.
The underground world is inherently a place where the strong prey on the weak. Only the strong qualify to make demands, while the weak are mere losers, forced to endure grievances.
Defeated by Li Zhen, Mountain Chicken’s dream of unifying Yun City was fading away.
If things had been resolved this simply, it wouldn’t have been bad, but unfortunately...
"Mr. Ma, help me!"
Thrown to the ground by Li Zhen, the miserable Mountain Chicken cried out hoarsely.
He didn’t believe it and was unwilling to accept that he actually lost to Li Zhen!
As soon as Mountain Chicken finished speaking, a kick came flying from the side, sending Li Zhen flying to the ground.
Li Zhen tumbled on the ground, got up, his face turning a bit pale, and looked over in surprise.
It was the man in the traditional gown brought by Mountain Chicken who kicked him!
Li Zhen’s expression became serious. This man in the traditional gown might have some real skills. Was he the backup found by Mountain Chicken!
"Again!" The man in the traditional robe said indifferently, looking down as if Li Zhen were nothing more than a ridiculous mouse being toyed with by a cat.
Li Zhen wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, stood up forcefully, and sneered: "Mountain Chicken, earlier we agreed that you and I would fight one-on-one. Now you call for backup, what’s the meaning of this? What kind of man are you?"
Mountain Chicken chuckled: "I never said I couldn’t call for backup. All I know is that as long as my side beats yours, you’re the unlucky ones. Who’s the director might not even realize it."
Li Zhen said: "Mountain Chicken, you are too shameless!"
The agreement was for Li Zhen to have a decisive battle with Mountain Chicken. Seeing his own defeat, Mountain Chicken resorted to playing dirty. This forced Li Zhen to face off against this man in the traditional gown,
Li Zhen’s chances of victory were virtually zero. He had only just begun to understand the basics of combat, while this man was a real martial artist. How could they even compare?
But Li Zhen had no choice but to try!
"Mountain Chicken, since you’ve lost to me, you should do as I say and disband the Mountain Chicken Gang on the spot!" Li Zhen stated.
Mountain Chicken sneered, "Just because you say I lost doesn’t mean I have. Li Zhen, you think you can stop me? That’s impossible. If you’re so capable, come over and defeat Mr. Ma!"
Li Zhen secretly smiled bitterly. The moves Anna taught him were indeed useful, but unfortunately, the time was too short. He was still at the beginner level, hadn’t learned much, and certainly wasn’t a match for this man in the traditional gown!
The man in the traditional gown was stronger than him to begin with, and now he was injured, he stood no chance against this person.
Mountain Chicken felt satisfied: "The victory of this match should belong to us. Brother Zhen, you’re defeated. When do you plan to come over and be my junior? From now on, I will be the leader of Yun City’s underground, and the leader of everyone present! If I tell you to go east, don’t go west!"
Everyone remained silent, their expressions complicated.
No one wanted to submit to Mountain Chicken, but seeing the imposing nature of the man in the traditional gown, they didn’t dare make a sound.
Mountain Chicken secretly rejoiced. Having finally defeated Li Zhen, he could declare victory.
"Who said he lost!"
At this moment, a cold voice came from outside.
And then, Anna walked in, accompanied by another person, Lin Fan!
Yet no one paid attention to Lin Fan, because when they saw Anna, they each revealed expressions as if they had seen a ghost.
Some were angry, some were scared.
Wasn’t this woman the legendary mysterious woman? This damn woman actually appeared here!
"It’s her, it’s her!"
"She actually showed up at our gathering, should we run?"
"This woman is too terrifying, who exactly is she!"
Everyone pointed and discussed Anna, and it could be said that her appearance threw the thugs present into a state of panic.
In recent days, many underground leaders had been beaten. Some still hadn’t recovered from their injuries, and with broken legs, they couldn’t expect to recover in less than a month.
Anna, acting on Lin Fan’s orders, was responsible for dealing with these thugs, though Anna herself didn’t quite understand Lin Fan’s intentions behind these instructions.
But today, they would certainly be clarified.
Seeing Lin Fan and Anna, Mountain Chicken showed a slightly smug smile and said: "I’ve been waiting a long time for you. You finally came!"
That day, at Li Zhen’s Moonlight Club, Lin Fan had claimed he would attend this gathering.
Since then, Mountain Chicken latched on to the idea, using this opportunity to defeat Lin Fan. Lin Fan claimed to be Li Zhen’s friend. If Lin Fan lost, Li Zhen would have no chance to turn things around.
"Your timing is perfect. I’ve been waiting for you. Mr. Ma, I invited you this time to deal with these two!"
Mountain Chicken said.
The man in the traditional gown stood with his hands behind his back, an indifferent expression, seemingly not taking Lin Fan and Anna seriously.
"Two ants think they dare to show off!" scoffed the man in the traditional gown.
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," chuckling: "So you actually hired help, no wonder you’re so cocky."
Mountain Chicken said: "You still have one chance. Immediately pledge your loyalty to me, let me be the leader of Yun City’s underground, and we’ll forget about everything else. I advise you to cooperate!"
Anna replied coldly: "Why waste words, this is the help you hired?"
As Anna spoke, she moved towards the man in the traditional gown.
Anna was about to confront the man in the traditional gown!
Instantly, she drew everyone’s attention.
The leaders were growing anxious inside. If this mysterious woman defeated the man in the traditional gown, the consequences would be unimaginable!

chapters.title: Chapter 520: Sending a Bit of Koi Carp Luck
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Chapter 520: Sending a Bit of Koi Carp Luck
Originally, Mountain Chicken had agreed to a decisive battle with Li Zhen, but after losing to Li Zhen, he immediately went back on his word and had the man in the Tang suit kick Li Zhen over.
However, this man in the Tang suit was a genuine martial artist, with skills that shouldn’t be underestimated. Even though Li Zhen had received pointers from Anna, the gap between him and an expert was still obvious, and he was instantly defeated by the man in the Tang suit.
Now Anna stepped forward to face off against the man in the Tang suit, and for a while, everyone speculated about who would win.
After all, Anna was also very formidable in everyone’s eyes. There were more than a few leaders present who had been beaten by Anna. This mysterious woman seemed to have appeared out of nowhere, like a nightmare.
"So it was you causing trouble on the streets of Yun City recently, you bitch!" Mountain Chicken sneered.
Anna didn’t respond, seemingly too lazy to pay attention to Mountain Chicken.
Mountain Chicken said, "You’ve injured so many people underground, you’re basically a public enemy of our underworld. How dare you come here courting death! Fine, today I will take you down in front of everyone to rid us of this menace!"
Anna said, "You take me down?"
Contempt, naked contempt!
Mountain Chicken felt insulted, but had no way to refute, because he couldn’t even beat Li Zhen and was certainly not Anna’s match.
"What are you so smug about, bitch, you have no idea who you’re up against tonight!" Mountain Chicken boasted arrogantly.
"Let me introduce Mr. Maguo from Maguo, a National Martial Arts Master, creator of the Xingyi Mysterious Shadow Fist and the Five-Chain Whip, known throughout Jianghu. None of you could possibly be his match, even if you all attacked together, it would be futile!" Mountain Chicken said.
National Martial Arts Master!
Everyone present showed expressions of surprise.
This was traditional martial arts, Huaxia’s traditional martial arts, vast and profound!
If this Mr. Maguo was truly a traditional National Martial Arts Master, he must be very powerful indeed.
Li Zhen laughed coldly, "A National Martial Arts Master? Probably a con artist! There are too many of those these days!"
Indeed, in the traditional martial arts circle, true masters of martial arts are few and far between, while conmen are rampant, making the traditional martial arts circle seem like a farce, with so-called masters mostly being old fraudsters.
So when Mountain Chicken said Maguo was a National Martial Arts Master, Li Zhen instinctively thought of a con artist.
Mountain Chicken snorted, "A con artist? Li Zhen, you’re truly ignorant. If he were a con artist, could he have kicked you down just now, or are you saying you’re even less than a con artist?"
Li Zhen: "..."
Li Zhen was speechless. Indeed, was he just knocked over by an old con artist?
Maybe this Maguo really did have some genuine skills, whether he was truly a master would only be known after witnessing it.
Lin Fan squinted at this Maguo and reminded Anna, "Be careful, this old guy does have some skills."
Anna didn’t care about what others said, but these words from Lin Fan she had to take seriously. She knew Lin Fan wouldn’t lie to her.
Anna raised her caution a few notches and closed in on Maguo.
The two promptly engaged in combat.
Maguo chuckled, "I’ve roamed Jianghu for over a dozen years without a single defeat. I usually don’t engage with women in combat, but I’ll make an exception today. Beating a woman won’t count in my lifetime achievements."
Anna coldly said, "You look down on women?"
Maguo replied, "Not at all, as they say, ’women hold up half the sky.’ I have great admiration for women. But objectively speaking, women aren’t suited for martial arts; their bodies are too weak to develop power, incomparable to men. It’s an inherent disadvantage of women, an unchangeable objective fact. In the entire Romance of the Three Kingdoms, is there a single famous female general known for eternity? They are all men like Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Lü Bu!"
Anna said, "You’re just discriminating against women!"
Maguo said, "If you think I’m discriminating, then so be it. Facts won’t change because of that. You’ll never be my match!"
Bang!
Their fists collided.
Thud thud thud!
Maguo took three steps back before stabilizing himself.
Anna retreated even more, staggering, nearly falling.
Anna’s expression changed. Lin Fan’s warning was indeed correct, this Maguo did have some real skills!
Everyone on the side saw clearly; from that exchange, it was obvious that Maguo had the upper hand!
Seeing this, Mountain Chicken laughed gleefully, certain of victory, thinking Mr. Ma was truly incredible!
This Mr. Maguo was sent by the Jiangnan Wei Family as reinforcements to help Mountain Chicken successfully take over Yun City’s underworld.
Maguo hadn’t disappointed Mountain Chicken!
Next, as long as Mr. Ma defeated Anna and Lin Fan, Mountain Chicken could ascend to the position of underground boss.
Let alone Anna, even if Lin Fan himself took action, he wouldn’t be able to win against Maguo!
The ability to enlist a National Martial Arts Master like Maguo to assist was a testament to the significant influence of the Jiangnan Wei Family. People like Maguo were not easily compelled by just anyone.
Anna was at a disadvantage!
Lin Fan watched from the side, furrowing his brows.
He hadn’t anticipated that Mountain Chicken would have such a skilled fighter by his side. Lin Fan didn’t know much about the traditional martial arts world and couldn’t compare what the legendary National Martial Arts Masters were like or whether this Maguo truly counted as a master.
But judging from Maguo’s performance, he was certainly no ordinary person.
At least Anna wouldn’t be his match.
This battle, Anna couldn’t lose!
Lin Fan had Anna take on the persona of a mysterious woman to deal with the thugs in Yun City, aiming to establish her authority!
In the future, the rules of Yun City’s underworld would be rewritten, and this was merely a prelude!
If Anna lost this battle, then the image previously built up would collapse!
However, objectively speaking, Anna really wasn’t Maguo’s match!
Lin Fan sighed in his heart, realizing there was no other way. He had no choice but to cheat.
"Activate the top-grade Koi Carp Luck and give some of the luck to Anna!" Lin Fan said to himself.
Top-grade Koi Carp Luck, activate!
This top-grade Koi Carp Luck was the last normal reward before the system malfunctioned. Since then, the system had a bug that provided the host with a cash reward of 5 million every day.
As the last normal reward, this top-grade Koi Carp Luck was not bad at all. The best part was that it could be given to others!
When Ning Xiaoyue participated in a talent show, Lin Fan had considered giving some of the top-grade Koi Carp Luck to her, but later dismissed the idea because Ning Xiaoyue was already the ’chosen one’ and didn’t need the luck to adjust things.
At this moment, it was different for Anna. Facing Maguo, she was certain to lose.
Lin Fan, however, needed her to secure victory.
So he sent some of the top-grade Koi Carp Luck to Anna.
At this moment, it was unclear whether the top-grade Koi Carp Luck hadn’t taken effect yet or if the National Martial Arts Master was simply too skilled, but Anna was still at a disadvantage.
Even those who knew nothing about martial arts could tell that Anna was bound to lose; this Maguo was simply too formidable.
"Wasn’t this woman quite arrogant? She’s actually being suppressed by Master Ma!"
"You can only say that Master Ma is truly formidable!"
"So impressive!"
"Master Ma truly lives up to his reputation!"
Everyone exclaimed. These words were music to Maguo’s ears.
"I told you before, a good man doesn’t fight with women. You could never be my match. Now that you’ve had enough, it’s my turn to attack!"

chapters.title: Chapter 521 Depressed National Martial Arts Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Chapter 521 Depressed National Martial Arts Master
Finally, Master Maguo is going to take the initiative!
The crowd immediately began to anticipate.
"Master Maguo is getting serious now; this should be quite a spectacle!"
"I’ve heard of this Master Maguo too; he’s indeed a very formidable master. In the past, a two-hundred-pound strongman from the United Kingdom challenged Master Maguo, and even with both hands, he couldn’t move one of Master Maguo’s fingers!"
"Wow, Master Ma is so formidable, this woman surely can’t be his opponent!"
The crowd discussed fervently, all believing that Master Maguo would definitely defeat Anna. After all, ever since the duel began, even though Anna always launched strong attacks, she still fell behind.
Mr. Maguo, a genuine contemporary master of National Martial Arts!
Perhaps the legends seem somewhat distant, even a bit false, but Mr. Maguo rarely faces skepticism. Whenever Mr. Maguo is mentioned, it is always in praiseworthy terms.
Now that Master Maguo shows he intends to attack proactively, every punch and kick carries his martial arts skill; can Anna withstand it!
The crowd does not think well of Anna, who has been at a disadvantage from the start and is basically destined to fail.
The Xingyi Mysterious Shadow Fist created by Master Maguo, as the name suggests, possesses an incredible body technique, making it impossible to defend against.
Indeed, he easily got close to Anna, yet Anna was completely unaware!
Master Maguo punched directly at Anna’s face; the punch carried a whistling wind, a powerful force. If it hit Anna, a bruised and swollen face was certain, and she might even be disfigured!
"I said, even if I beat you, this fight won’t count in my lifetime achievements. Beating a woman doesn’t count as a skill."
Master Maguo smiled.
In Master Maguo’s eyes, women are not suitable for martial arts. Women are naturally weak and simply can’t beat men.
So, even if he won against Anna, he was disdainful to list it in his achievements. If he defeated a male expert, Master Maguo couldn’t wait to announce it to the world.
Master Maguo really looks down on women this much.
Women boxing is all about flamboyant moves, completely impractical!
This is Master Maguo’s consistent viewpoint.
Watching as Master Maguo’s punch was about to smash Anna’s face, as a National Martial Arts Master, Maguo simply didn’t understand what it meant to spare a delicate flower.
However...
The next second, Master Maguo suddenly felt a severe pain in his abdomen, without knowing what happened. The spirited punch he was throwing suddenly became soft and powerless.
Master Maguo was shocked. He immediately tried to retract his punch and retreat, trying to protect himself before Anna realized it.
But how could his movements escape Anna’s eyes!
Although Anna didn’t understand why Master Maguo suddenly wanted to retreat, it was the best opportunity to counterattack and couldn’t be missed!
Before Master Maguo could retreat, Anna pressed forward and landed a punch on Master Maguo’s face.
Master Maguo screamed tragically and fell to the ground on the spot.
His face was bruised and swollen, and a nosebleed started to flow!
Seeing this, everyone was stunned.
No way, Master Maguo was actually beaten by Anna; his initially good punch suddenly went awry. What on earth happened?
Only Lin Fan knew that this was the effect of top-level Koi Carp Luck at work.
No matter how powerful Master Maguo was, as long as Anna had the top-level Koi Carp Luck, he couldn’t possibly win against Anna.
This is the terrifying aspect of the system’s reward; no matter how strong Maguo is, he is destined to fail.
Magou felt aggrieved: "What the hell just happened? I’ve never experienced anything like this, could it be because the lunch I ate wasn’t clean, and upset my stomach? But no, everyone ate the same thing, so why was it only me who had an upset stomach?"
"Wow! Now it’s back to normal; that’s so strange!"
It was indeed strange, and Magou didn’t know that Anna had a robot guiding her from behind, which meant she was already invincible.
Magou felt agitated and unwilling at the same time; he wouldn’t admit he lost to a woman!
No way, I, Magou, have traversed my whole life undefeated, and if today I lost to a woman, wouldn’t that be a joke, making it hard to recruit students in the future!"
Magou, unwilling, got up from the ground.
His stomach was no longer upset, and he was going to take the initiative to attack Anna again; this time, under no circumstances, would he answer Anna.
"You do have some skills, but ultimately you’re a woman, so you couldn’t possibly be my opponent!"
Magou huffed coldly, raised his fists, and charged at Anna.
He wanted to save face; this time it could be said in one continuous movement, in a burst, his punches were extremely fast and forceful!
Magou rarely threw punches this seriously; the last person who made him so tense no longer existed; Magou had seldom met worthy opponents in his life, he usually didn’t even need to use his true skills for his rivals to be defeated.
Now that he’s throwing punches so seriously, there’s no reason why he can’t even beat a woman.
However...
"Ouch!"
Magou suddenly seemed to step on a banana peel; he stumbled and actually...fell, falling embarrassingly in a sprawling mess!
It was quite embarrassing!
Facing the aggressive Master Maguo, Anna instinctively kicked, intending to dismantle Master Maguo’s move.
But coincidentally, as Master Maguo fell, she kicked him in the stomach.
"Ah!"
Master Maguo couldn’t help but scream in pain, holding his stomach with both hands, his face turned pale.
Damn!
What the hell was going on?
Why so unlucky today, two proactive strikes both met with accidents, first an upset stomach made his punch soft, then he stepped on a banana peel and slipped!
He seemed like a clumsy child, not at all like a National Martial Arts Master!
The crowd was taken aback by the scene.
Is this guy really a National Martial Arts Master? Why does he look so weak, getting beaten both times he attacks?
The most frustrating part for Master Maguo was that he seemed to have stepped on a banana peel and fell just now, but looking around, there was no banana peel on the ground!
No banana peel, but he felt like he stepped on one; this was too bizarre!
Lin Fan watched from the side and nearly burst out laughing; top-level Koi Carp Luck was indeed remarkable, making even a Master like Maguo unlucky in front of it!
Mountain Chicken looked at Master Maguo’s repeated failures and became anxious, questioning if this Master Maguo was really up to the task!
Didn’t he claim to be a National Martial Arts Master, but why did he attack just now and act like an unreliable three-year-old?
"Mr. Ma, what’s wrong with you, could it be that you can’t manage?" Mountain Chicken said directly; if Master Maguo couldn’t handle this woman, it would be troublesome.
Magou was both angry and anxious: "Of course I can, who says I can’t? This time, I must handle this woman!"
Magou cried inwardly, what a shame, he had already attacked twice proactively and both ended in unexplained failures!
Anna said coldly: "Do you want to continue? You said you wouldn’t count beating a woman as an achievement. I’m curious, what if you lose to a woman?"

chapters.title: Chapter 522: Give One More Chance
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Chapter 522: Give One More Chance
National Martial Arts Master Maguo truly has genuine skill and learning. From the moment he kicked Li Zhen over, it was clear he wasn’t the type to show off and deceive like a Kung Fu Belt Master.
Master Maguo was also very confident that Anna was definitely not his match. So when he prepared to attack proactively, he believed the fight would end with his victory.
The people around thought the same. At the beginning of the confrontation, Anna was clearly on the losing side. Her defeat seemed certain!
Who would have thought that after Master Maguo took the initiative to attack, a series of jaw-dropping situations occurred where Master Maguo continuously failed. In the end, he got kicked by Anna, his face turned green, and he knelt on the ground.
Master Maguo was about to cry, feeling depressed. What the hell was going on?
He could never have dreamed that this was the effect of top-tier Koi Carp Luck, and in his battle with Anna, no matter how formidable he was, his defeat was already predetermined.
Because Lin Fan had given Anna top-tier Koi Carp Luck.
This top-tier Koi Carp Luck is truly something special. If a kindergartner had it, they could even beat a boxing champion. Of course, it’s not to say the kindergartner’s skills are stronger than the champion’s, but extreme luck can make things happen, like the champion suddenly having a heart attack and dropping out, which also counts as a win.
That’s luck for you!
Anna and Master Maguo’s battle was based on the same principle. In terms of strength, Anna indeed couldn’t rival Master Maguo, but with luck on her side, Master Maguo inexplicably encountered issues. On his first attack, he suddenly had a stomach ache and was countered by Anna. On his second attack, he suddenly slipped and was once again defeated unexpectedly by Anna.
Outsiders couldn’t tell and thought Master Maguo was all name and no substance.
How could Master Maguo not be depressed!
Anna felt a little like laughing, not knowing what kind of luck she stumbled upon, seeing her opponent continually encountering issues!
She even suspected that heaven was protecting her.
No matter what, this Master Maguo was now her defeated foe.
"You said beating a woman isn’t worth listing as an accomplishment, so being beaten by a woman, can it be listed as your accomplishment?" Anna said coldly.
These words were really too ironic.
Someone present couldn’t help but snicker, even though the hooligans were all terrified of this mysterious woman. But one must admit, Anna’s words were so on point with the irony that it’s hard not to applaud.
Master Maguo’s face turned red, and he said hoarsely, "Don’t be complacent. I just had a little issue with my health earlier. Once I’m back in shape, you won’t be my match!"
Anna said, "I’m not interested in waiting for you to recover. You’ve already lost."
"Master Ma, you’re already a defeated opponent. Aren’t you going to admit defeat?" Li Zhen sneered.
Master Maguo, embarrassed and angry, said, "I didn’t lose. It was truly a health issue earlier. This woman could never beat me!"
Magooo looked at Brother Chicken, "Tell them, once I’ve recovered, I will defeat them!"
Brother Chicken was already baffled, having personally witnessed Maguo being knocked down twice by Anna. This couldn’t be an illusion!
"Mr. Ma, are you... sure?" Brother Chicken wiped cold sweat, daring not to affirm.
Master Maguo angrily said, "Of course, do you think I’d lie to you? Don’t forget my status. I’ve come here to solve your issue!"
Brother Chicken naturally wouldn’t forget. In the martial arts world, Maguo was famed, and the average person couldn’t easily invite him to join. This time, it was the Jiangnan Wei Family who had him come to town; handling such a figure is something Brother Chicken didn’t dare to mess with, especially if the Wei Family put the blame on him.
Moreover, Brother Chicken has always believed that Maguo was a true master, not someone who couldn’t even handle a woman!
"I believe Master Maguo indeed faced some unexpected issues earlier. Your victory wasn’t convincing, and it might not be acceptable to everyone!" Brother Chicken said.
Li Zhen said, "What kind of reasoning is this? He already lost. Brother Chicken, perhaps you want to play tricks again. When it comes to playing tricks, you’re truly unsurpassed worldwide!"
Brother Chicken chuckled, "Brother Zhen, why are you in such a hurry? Whether Mr. Ma had an accident or not, let’s wait until he recovers and have another match. Are you afraid, or are you lacking confidence?"
Li Zhen: "..."
Li Zhen really didn’t know how to decide on this matter. What if Maguo really defeats Anna later? Wouldn’t that be a huge loss?
Anna was indeed feeling a bit uncertain. She had won too luckily earlier, and if Maguo were given another chance, she might lose.
"I think Brother Chicken is right. Since Master Ma insists it was an accident, let’s give him another chance," Lin Fan suddenly said.
The crowd didn’t know, but on their side, Lin Fan was the true decision-maker.
With Lin Fan saying this, Anna had no objections; she only listened to Lin Fan.
"Alright," Anna said calmly.
Everyone looked at Li Zhen because, in their eyes, Lin Fan and Anna were Li Zhen’s people, and Li Zhen was the one who made decisions.
"Then let’s give Master Ma another chance," Li Zhen said.
Brother Chicken was secretly pleased, knowing that with this opportunity, Master Maguo would surely make a comeback, and victory would be his!
Magooo also breathed a sigh of relief and hurried to recover.
After a while, Magooo finally regained his strength and stood up.
"This time, I will teach you a good lesson so that you see just how powerful I truly am!" Magoo said coldly.
Brother Chicken laughed smugly, "Brother Zhen, you’re a bunch of fools for giving Mr. Ma this chance. You’re just setting yourselves up for humiliation. But I really have to thank you for your stupidity; it’s your stupidity that gives me the win!"
Li Zhen was also puzzled, wondering why Lin Fan agreed to give Magoo this opportunity earlier.
Lin Fan remained silent, inwardly amused. The reason he gave Magoo this chance was to satisfy everyone. If they didn’t give him the chance, people would really think they were lacking confidence.
Since that’s the case, why not give Magoo one more chance? After all, with top-tier Koi Carp Luck, giving Magoo an extra opportunity is just an extra chance for him to make a fool of himself.
Anna didn’t think much about it. Lin Fan’s decision was hers too. Since they were going to fight Magoo again, then so be it.
Anna and Master Magoo faced each other once more!
Instantly, everyone’s attention shifted to the two of them.
This time, it was Magoo’s battle to prove himself. Would Master Magoo really prove, as he claimed, that it was just an accident earlier?
"I believe Master Ma wasn’t lying; he indeed had an accident earlier!"
"I think so too, otherwise, why would Master Ma insist on a rematch?"
"Master Ma is going to show his true abilities this time. This girl is doomed!"
The crowd buzzed with discussion, mostly believing in Master Ma.
Magooo was quite satisfied with everyone’s views and chuckled, "Are you ready to embrace defeat? This time, you won’t be so lucky!"
With that, Magoo swung a punch at Anna.
This time, to achieve a swift victory, Magoo put in all his strength without reservation. This was arguably his best performance. If this punch hit Anna, her defeat would be certain.
The terrifying thing was, Magoo’s punch combined with his Mysterious Tracing Body Technique meant that Anna almost couldn’t dodge it!

chapters.title: Chapter 523: Mountain Chicken’s Backhand
chapters.content:
Chapter 523: Chapter 523: Mountain Chicken’s Backhand
Anna could only try her best to dodge, watching as his fist was about to land on her shoulder.
However...
In a stroke of coincidence, at that very moment, a fly flew into his throat, instantly causing him to choke.
This moment shifted Maguo’s attention, and he instinctively went to protect his throat, his fist immediately losing its power.
Anna took a punch and thought she was done for, but suddenly realized that Maguo’s punch was powerless and hadn’t hurt her at all!
Anna reacted quickly, immediately sidestepping and throwing a hook, hitting Maguo in the chest.
Thud!
Maguo fell to his knees, clutching his throat, his face turning red from difficulty in breathing.
To everyone, it seemed like Maguo couldn’t knock down Anna, but instead was taken down by her hook.
"What?" Brother Chicken was dumbfounded.
Maguo actually lost again; that’s three consecutive kneels!
Everyone was also shocked; they thought Master Maguo was really going to show his true skills this time, but instead, he was taken out by Anna in seconds!
Li Zhen was delighted, laughing, "Brother Chicken, you can’t deny it this time, can you? I want to see how you argue now, and see if everyone still believes you!"
Maguo finally managed to swallow the fly stuck in his throat, and his breath came easier; he was almost suffocated a moment ago.
"This doesn’t count. It was an accident, another accident. Everyone saw it, right? I just swallowed a fly! Let’s go again," Maguo immediately said.
This is crazy, another accident again!
Li Zhen chuckled, "Master Ma, you claimed accidents the first two times, and we gave you a chance. Now you’re saying it’s an accident again? Once or twice we can believe, but three consecutive times? Do you take us for fools?"
Maguo said, "It really was an accident, I’m not lying. Let’s fight again and you’ll see."
Upon hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but shake their heads.
Even if they were biased towards Maguo, they couldn’t stand it. Maguo really was taking them for fools.
"Once or twice being an accident is fine, but the third time is also an accident?"
"He truly thinks we’re fools!"
"This is a bit shameless, only a fool would believe him!"
Everyone started criticizing.
Brother Chicken was drenched in cold sweat. It wasn’t just everyone else; even he couldn’t believe Maguo anymore. How could all three times be accidents?
Maguo saw that no one believed him and was extremely anxious because he knew best that it really was an accident!
The first time he had an upset stomach, the second time he slipped on a banana peel, and the third time he swallowed a fly!
Frustrated, why did it seem like no one saw the fly, just like how no one saw the banana peel the second time?
Could it be ghosts?
For the first time, a surge of horror rose in Maguo’s heart, and he could only attribute it to the supernatural; this time it must be a ghost.
"Brother Chicken, do you have anything else to say? Defeated is defeated, or are you still unwilling to admit defeat?" Li Zhen sneered.
"Shut up, I haven’t lost, I will definitely defeat you!" Maguo roared, jumping up in agitation and rushing toward Anna.
However...
Halfway through his pounce, he stumbled.
He actually fell again.
This time he delivered himself right to Anna’s feet.
Anna kicked forward, hitting Maguo’s forehead, and he collapsed to the ground, instantly losing consciousness.
"Annoying!" Anna said coldly.
Maguo, this unlucky guy, kept delivering himself to Anna’s fists and kicks over and over, really like a filial son.
Anna wasn’t the type to be softhearted; since he delivered himself, she made no apologies.
Seeing that Maguo was knocked out by Anna’s kick, everyone was stunned. Anna’s strikes were too ruthless, leaving them with the impression of this mysterious woman; she was indeed ruthless. Those leading figures deeply understood that Anna didn’t seem to care about human kindness at all.
"So Master Maguo really is this weak!"
"Another fraud, made us look forward for nothing!"
"Embarrassing, this is really embarrassing!"
Everyone shook their heads in disappointment with Maguo.
Li Zhen was amused, "Master Ma has no excuse this time, he was knocked out himself, is that also an accident?"
"Brother Chicken, you’ve lost!"
Li Zhen stared at Brother Chicken.
Brother Chicken was going crazy; he lost, ultimately he lost, even though he gave Maguo the chance, Maguo didn’t seize it at all!
What nonsense National Martial Arts Master, just a piece of trash!
If Maguo knew Brother Chicken thought like this, he would probably be furious.
Li Zhen’s expression darkened, "Brother Chicken, what are you waiting for, you’ve lost, now it’s time to honor our bet, we agreed that if I lost, you’d be the boss of the underground Yun City, and if you lost, you’d disband your Mountain Chicken Gang and get out of Yun City’s underground!"
Brother Chicken shuddered; he was unwilling, unwilling to just lose like this. How would he explain to the Jiangnan Wei Family!
He didn’t mind not unifying Yun City’s underground himself, but he was carrying out a task for the Wei Family; if he just failed like this, the Wei Family would definitely not spare him.
Besides, he absolutely didn’t want to disband the Mountain Chicken Gang. That would mean being expelled from Yun City’s underground!
After pausing, Brother Chicken’s face showed a sinister smile, "Li Zhen, do you think you’ve defeated me with this?"
Li Zhen responded, "Oh? You have more top fighters?"
Brother Chicken was just a rascal; they originally agreed to decide with a duel between the two of them, and after Brother Chicken’s loss, he resorted to using Maguo.
Since Brother Chicken broke the rule first, Anna helping Li Zhen was beyond reproach, and now that Anna has defeated Maguo, it means Brother Chicken lost again.
Brother Chicken sneered, "Where would I find so many top fighters? Mr. Ma was difficult enough to invite. No top fighters, but luckily, I kept a backup plan!"
Li Zhen frowned, "What do you mean?"
Brother Chicken said, "Li Zhen, you’ve really changed. You’re not the Li Zhen who followed Master Kun back in the day. Back then, you had no weaknesses, and hardly anyone could defeat you, but in these years, you’ve formed ties. I heard you married a beautiful wife, and she bore you a big son who goes to Yun City’s First Elementary School. Am I right or wrong?"
Li Zhen was furious, "Brother Chicken, do you realize what you’re saying? You’re threatening my family!"
Everyone was shocked.
This is Brother Chicken indeed, not only ruthless but also vicious. This is the underground world, where any deceitful and vile means can be used!
Brother Chicken laughed smugly, "Don’t worry, I haven’t done anything. I only invited sister-in-law and your nephew to my humble residence as guests. As long as Brother Zhen is willing to kneel and kowtow to me three times, respectfully calling me boss from now on, sister-in-law and nephew will naturally return home safely."
"You beast!"
Li Zhen roared, unable to hold back any longer, and lunged at Brother Chicken.
"Brother Zhen, please calm down. Brother Chicken wasn’t lying to you. Sister-in-law and nephew are fine, and they have already returned home."
Lin Fan suddenly spoke.
What?
Everyone looked at each other; what did Lin Fan mean by this?

chapters.title: Chapter 524: Incidentally, Wipe Out Your Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Chapter 524: Incidentally, Wipe Out Your Base
Brother Chicken did not pin all his hopes on Maguo, as he had personally experienced how formidable Lin Fan was. Even though Maguo was a renowned figure in the national martial arts circle, it was not certain he could defeat Lin Fan.
As facts proved, Maguo really wasn’t a match for Lin Fan. Lin Fan didn’t even have to lift a finger; it took just Anna to deal with the national martial arts master.
So Brother Chicken had a backup plan.
This backup plan, in Brother Chicken’s eyes, was more effective than a hundred national martial arts masters.
In the underground world, this was a common tactic: kidnap the family of the opponent to make them submit.
This method was especially popular during Master Kun’s time. Since Master Kun got dealt with, Yun City’s underground had become a scattered mess, and the gangster bosses had reined in a lot, hardly using such tactics because they were too despicable and could easily incur public outrage.
However, Brother Chicken used this tactic to complete his mission.
He kidnapped Li Zhen’s wife and child!
Upon learning this, Li Zhen was overwhelmingly furious, his eyes blazing with fire, wishing to go up and kill Brother Chicken.
"If they lose a single hair, I will tear you to pieces immediately!" Li Zhen roared.
Brother Chicken chuckled and said, "Brother Zhen, don’t get agitated. I’m not saying this to offend you, but we who mix in the underground shouldn’t marry and have children. Look at me, footloose and fancy-free. Women are just for fun. Look at you now, panicking. This is your biggest weakness; it’s a weakness you’ve created yourself! Of course, you don’t need to worry. I just invited Sister-in-law and your little nephew to my home. I don’t want to hurt them. It depends on your performance."
A threat!
A blatant threat!
Unless Li Zhen kneeled and called him boss for life, Li Zhen’s wife and child would be harmed!
For his family, Li Zhen could only bow to Brother Chicken!
Once Li Zhen bowed, Yun City’s underground would be Brother Chicken’s. Who would dare resist? They all watched Brother Chicken mess with Li Zhen!
Li Zhen clenched his fists. He didn’t want to yield to Brother Chicken. He would rather die than bow to Brother Chicken.
But his wife and child were in Brother Chicken’s hands!
Brother Chicken was right. He no longer was the Li Zhen of the past. He had weaknesses now; his wife and child were his biggest weakness.
For an underground boss, this was indeed somewhat ironic—a gangster boss with ties and bonds...
Brother Chicken looked smug. He believed Li Zhen would kneel. Everyone had weaknesses, and his wife and child were now Li Zhen’s biggest weakness.
Kneel, or not kneel?
Kneeling, unwilling!
Not kneeling, his wife and child would die!
Kneel!
Li Zhen gritted his teeth. He could choose to die himself, but he could never let his wife and child get hurt!
Just as Li Zhen was about to bend his knees to kneel.
Lin Fan suddenly said, "Brother Chicken is right. Sister-in-law and your little nephew are indeed fine; they’ve already safely returned home."
What?
Everyone looked at each other in confusion. What did Lin Fan’s words mean?
Li Zhen hurriedly asked, "Mr. Lin, what do you mean?"
Brother Chicken also stared at Lin Fan, sensing something was off. What trick was this guy playing now!
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "It’s nothing much. I just guessed that Brother Chicken would make such a move, so I was cautious. Didn’t expect Brother Chicken to really use such a despicable method of kidnapping Brother Zhen’s wife and child. Fortunately, I discovered it in time. The reason we’re a bit late today is that we were sending Sister-in-law and your little nephew back home."
Everyone was stunned.
Brother Chicken was dumbfounded, what, had Lin Fan already rescued Li Zhen’s wife and child?
He hurriedly took out his phone and made a call.
The call didn’t go through!
Lin Fan said, "Don’t bother calling. Your guys can’t answer their phones now. After all, they are all injured, rolling on the ground. By the way, you kidnapped Brother Zhen’s wife and child to your base, right? Perfect, we dismantled your base while we were at it."
"Ah!"
Brother Chicken’s face turned pale.
Ignoring him, Lin Fan said to Li Zhen, "Brother Zhen, call Sister-in-law. Although they’re fine now, they were quite frightened today and need your comfort."
"Alright!"
Li Zhen snapped out of it, quickly took out his phone, and made a video call to his wife.
The video connected.
Li Zhen’s wife burst into tears on the other end: "Today, like every other day, I was taking Congcong to school, who knew that halfway, we were stopped by a group. They took the two of us to a place and said as long as we cooperated, they wouldn’t harm us. I asked when we could leave, and they said it would depend on you. What exactly happened? We were so scared."
Li Zhen comforted her, "Recently, the underground has been chaotic, and something happened. Are you okay now?"
Li Zhen’s wife said, "We’re okay. I originally wanted to take Congcong and leave, but they stopped us, cursed at me, and threatened to hit Congcong. I thought we wouldn’t get to see you again, but fortunately, two people came and dealt with them, and even sent us back home. These two good people said they were your friends, is that true?"
Li Zhen said, "Yes, it’s true. I’m glad you’re safe. I’ll be home to find you soon."
Li Zhen’s wife said, "Hurry back. Congcong was so scared that it took a lot to coax him to sleep, and he’s still trembling even in his sleep."
Li Zhen said, "I know. I’ll rush back as soon as I can."
He hung up the video call.
Li Zhen clenched his fist, trembling all over with anger.
He ached for his wife and child, terrified by Brother Chicken’s kidnapping.
"Brother Chicken, you die for me!"
Li Zhen lunged forward, knocking Brother Chicken to the ground, then pressed him down and started punching him.
Brother Chicken wasn’t originally a match for Li Zhen, especially with Li Zhen attacking in anger. Brother Chicken had no power to retaliate.
Under everyone’s watchful eyes, Brother Chicken was brutally beaten by Li Zhen, his face swollen like a pig’s head, writhing in pain on the ground, unable to get up.
If Lin Fan hadn’t pulled Li Zhen back, Li Zhen would’ve surely beaten Brother Chicken to death.
"Brother Zhen, if you kill him, it becomes a murder case, and the trouble would be huge. There’s no need to go to jail for this scum," Lin Fan said.
