Li Zhen stopped, pointed at Brother Chicken, and cursed, "Bastard, you even dared to mess with my family. If Mr. Lin hadn’t held me back, I’d send you to meet King Yama today."
Brother Chicken sneered, "Li Zhen, go ahead and kill me if you have the guts. Since I couldn’t complete the task, they won’t spare me either. Kill me, give me a quick death, let me go see Master Kun and tell him how cowardly Li Zhen has become. We, mixing in the underground, shouldn’t indulge in love affairs!"
Li Zhen roared, "You really want to die, don’t you? I don’t mind killing you in front of everyone!"
Brother Chicken said, "Yes, I want to die. Go ahead, do it!"
Li Zhen indeed wanted to finish Brother Chicken off. Back when he followed Master Kun, Li Zhen was also ruthless, killing without hesitation!
But now, Li Zhen indeed had weaknesses, or rather bonds. Anything he did, he would first think about his wife and child.
If he really killed Brother Chicken, he would be arrested, maybe even sentenced to death. Then who would protect his wife and child?

chapters.title: Chapter 525 New Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Chapter 525 New Order
Li Zhen is indeed no longer the Li Zhen of the past. Rather than saying his wife and children are his weaknesses, it would be more accurate to say they are the catalysts for his transformation.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Brother Zhen, Brother Chicken is trying to drag you down to his level, but you’ve long surpassed him. If Yun City truly needs a leader, I believe Brother Zhen is more suitable than anyone else. I wonder if Brother Zhen has any interest in this?"
Li Zhen nodded and said, "I’ve come to realize, it’s better for me to be the leader than let someone like Mountain Chicken take the position! From now on, I don’t want to see garbage like Mountain Chicken in the underground of Yun City. Anyone who uses families to threaten others will be an enemy of mine, Li Zhen. It’s time to change the underground atmosphere!"
Li Zhen looked up and swept his gaze across everyone: "I, Li Zhen, will be the leader of the underground in Yun City. Anyone not convinced can step forward!"
The crowd glanced at each other, who dared to be unconvinced now that Mountain Chicken had been crippled.
"Brother Zhen, I acknowledge you as the leader!" Brother Hu was the first to express his stance.
"I acknowledge it too!"
"I acknowledge it!"
The leaders expressed their stances, and in the blink of an eye, all the ruffians present were kneeling to Li Zhen.
"Leader!"
The crowd shouted, from now on, Li Zhen was their leader.
The underground of Yun City finally ended its scattered state and achieved unification, with Li Zhen becoming the leader!
Li Zhen nodded, "Since you all recognize me as the leader, you’ll listen to me from now on. The rules of the underground in Yun City need to be re-established. If anyone doesn’t want to follow my rules, you can challenge me, and if you win, you can be the leader. Otherwise, you will be expelled! Is that clear?"
"Clear!"
The crowd said in unison.
Li Zhen glanced at Mountain Chicken and said coldly, "Now I want to announce my first order as leader: starting today, the Mountain Chicken Gang will no longer exist, it’s disbanded on the spot. The remnants of the Mountain Chicken Gang better flee Yun City quickly, or they will be our enemies, and I will make sure they have no place in Yun City! This was the bet between Mountain Chicken and me, I won, so the Mountain Chicken Gang should be disbanded! Additionally, I announce the expulsion of Mountain Chicken from Yun City’s underground, he’s no longer one of us!"
Mountain Chicken was expelled from Yun City’s underground!
Li Zhen became the leader of Yun City’s underground!
These were the most explosive news in Yun City’s underground today.
The Mountain Chicken Gang had always been dominant in Yun City, no one dared to provoke them.
Who would have thought, the arrogant Mountain Chicken Gang would just vanish!
A new order is about to emerge in Yun City’s underground.
Most of the ruffians present expressed their submission to Li Zhen and willingness to accept the new order, while a few who couldn’t accept it would quietly disappear from Yun City’s underground, either disbanding or relocating elsewhere.
The Jiangnan Wei Family probably never imagined in their dreams that they instructed Mountain Chicken to unify Yun City’s underground, only to benefit others in the end!
Li Zhen waved his hand, "This gathering is over, everyone disperse. In the future, unless necessary, there’s no need for such grand events. We must learn from Master Kun’s lesson, live low-key, and not be arrogant! If Mountain Chicken became your leader, I am sure the underground of Yun City would quickly follow Master Kun’s footsteps! I will never let that happen!"
The leaders agreed and left one by one, and soon, the once crowded diner was empty.
Mountain Chicken also got up and ran off, taking the still unconscious Maguo with him, leaving Yun City immediately headed to Hang City.
Only Li Zhen, Lin Fan, and Anna were left on site.
Thud!
Li Zhen suddenly knelt down to the two.
Lin Fan waved his hand and helped Li Zhen up.
Li Zhen was secretly astonished. The effortless wave from Lin Fan had such surprising force that he couldn’t kneel down even if he wanted to.
But Li Zhen could still speak.
"Mr. Lin, Miss An, thank you, I really thank you so much, thank you for saving my wife and children!" Li Zhen said gratefully.
In Li Zhen’s mind now, nothing is more important than his wife and children, so when Lin Fan saved them, he became Li Zhen’s lifesaver in his eyes.
Moreover, being able to become the leader of Yun City’s underground was inseparable from Lin Fan and Anna.
It was Anna’s guidance in martial arts that allowed him to defeat Mountain Chicken. It was Anna who defeated Maguo, clearing obstacles for him.
"The great benevolence and virtue you’ve shown me, Li Zhen, I have no way to repay. From now on, my life is yours!" Li Zhen said.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Brother Zhen, you’re too serious. You’re now the leader of Yun City’s underground; how can I accept your life? However, I do have a suggestion about the underground of Yun City that I hope you might consider."
Li Zhen quickly said, "Whatever Mr. Lin says, I will do!"
He knew Lin Fan initially approached him because his two subordinates bullied a female on the street, and Lin Fan couldn’t stand it, so he came to use virtue (and martial arts) to subdue them.
Lin Fan likely doesn’t want to see such situations anymore, so as long as he’s the leader of Yun City, such things won’t happen again!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Actually, I’ve already had Anna work on my suggestion over the past couple of days."
Lin Fan was hinting!
Over the past few days, Anna had been cracking down on ruffians causing trouble on Yun City’s streets. Clearly, these heinous acts were displeasing to Lin Fan.
Since Lin Fan was displeased, such things shouldn’t appear in the new order!
"I understand." Li Zhen said.
He was a smart man, he could easily catch Lin Fan’s implication.
On the surface, he was the leader of Yun City’s underground and the setter of the new order. In reality, the true leader was Lin Fan, and the establisher of the new order was Lin Fan!
"Mr. Lin, how should I contact you in the future?" Li Zhen asked.
Lin Fan said, "You don’t need to specifically contact me. If necessary, I’ll have Anna contact you."
Li Zhen said, "I understand. There’s one more thing I’ve been curious about, but if Mr. Lin is unwilling to disclose, I won’t ask."
Lin Fan said, "What is it? Let’s hear it."
Li Zhen said, "I know Mr. Lin is definitely not someone from the underground, but this time, you got involved in underground matters. I’d like to know why you did it?"
Lin Fan said, "Because of the Wei Family."
Since there was nothing he couldn’t say, Lin Fan said it directly.
Li Zhen’s face changed, "The Wei Family!"
This time, it was indeed the Jiangnan Wei Family instructing Mountain Chicken to unify Yun City’s underground. Now that Mountain Chicken has failed, it means the Jiangnan Wei Family’s plan has been ruined.
Li Zhen becoming the underground leader was undoubtedly opposing the Jiangnan Wei Family.
Will the Jiangnan Wei Family take this lying down!
Lin Fan said, "You told me that day that the Jiangnan Wei Family wanted to create a monopoly in Yun City, and that’s precisely against my interests. I won’t allow the Wei Family to cause trouble in Yun City. I am an enemy of the Wei Family! The Wei Family is also my enemy! The underground battle in Yun City was just a warm-up, what comes next is the real game."
Li Zhen felt astonished; he didn’t expect Lin Fan to be an enemy of the Jiangnan Wei Family!
"Mr. Lin, may I ask what your true identity is?" Li Zhen couldn’t help but ask. Not just anyone is qualified to be an enemy of the Jiangnan Wei Family!
Anna said, "Do you know the new richest man in Yun City?"
"Huh?"
Li Zhen was stunned, involuntarily kneeling down again. The person in front of him was actually Yun City’s richest man? Was it really Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City?

chapters.title: Chapter 526 Wei Tiansheng
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Chapter 526 Wei Tiansheng
Hang City.
This is where the provincial capital of Jiangnan Province is located, a nearly first-tier city with a developed economy. The most famous economic entity in Hang City is the Wangu Group of the Jiangnan Wei Family.
Though Wangu Group has only been established for 20 years, it has grown to become the largest enterprise in Jiangnan, with a market value exceeding 350 billion. The patriarch of the Jiangnan Wei Family, Wei Tiansheng, who is also the founder of Wangu Group, is honored as the richest man in Jiangnan, renowned across the world.
In Hang City, the Wei Family is practically omnipotent.
At least in the Jiangnan region, there’s nothing that the Wei Family wants to do that they can’t accomplish.
However...
Lately, it seems like the Wei Family has hit a snag in Yun City.
The Wei Family attempted to unify the underground of Jiangnan to pave the way for future development in Yun City, but they suffered a crushing defeat. While the underground of Yun City was indeed unified, the leader wasn’t a member of the Wei Family!
An upscale club in Hang City.
Inside a private room, a middle-aged man in a suit sat at the center of the sofa, with two alluring women seated on either side.
"President Wei, come on, accompany me with this drink. You drank with her, there’s no reason not to drink with me." One of the women coquettishly said, raising a glass of red wine and offering it to the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man was about to reply when an older man walked in from outside and respectfully said, "Young Master, he’s here."
The middle-aged man said, "Let him in. You two go out first."
The two women didn’t dare to say anything, quickly got up, and left in a hurry. At the door, they saw a man covered in blood, filthy like a stray dog, walking in.
The two women pinched their noses in a rush, avoiding the newcomer as they slipped away.
This person was Mountain Chicken!
Feeling despised by the two hostesses puzzled Mountain Chicken. When he was the underground overlord in Yun City, women like these would only kneel at his feet as sycophants. Who would have thought that the dignified underground boss would fall into being looked down upon?
"Filthy whores, just you wait, I’ll deal with you sooner or later!" Mountain Chicken muttered.
Raising his head, Mountain Chicken met the icy gaze of the middle-aged man and immediately lowered his head, looking fearful.
"Mr. Wei." Mountain Chicken called softly.
The middle-aged man said coldly, "What happened in Yun City, tell me the entire process without leaving out a single detail!"
"Yes!" Mountain Chicken replied respectfully and then recounted the entire process of the underground gathering to the middle-aged man.
This middle-aged man was named Wei Jisheng, the eldest son of Wei Tiansheng, patriarch of the Jiangnan Wei Family. The Wei Family had extended their influence to Yun City, attempting to develop projects there, and the person in charge was Wei Jisheng.
Mountain Chicken directly took orders from Wei Jisheng, and the reason Wei Jisheng valued Mountain Chicken was because of his strength in Yun City’s underground. Wei Jisheng believed that using Mountain Chicken to unify Yun City’s underground should have been foolproof.
Who knew Mountain Chicken would ultimately suffer a crushing defeat? The Mountain Chicken Gang disbanded, and even he was expelled from Yun City’s underground, leaving him in a dire situation.
After listening to Mountain Chicken’s account, Wei Jisheng fell into deep thought.
For a long time.
Wei Jisheng said, "I understand now."
Mountain Chicken was anxious, not knowing what Wei Jisheng was thinking. He was most afraid that Wei Jisheng would punish him; he was now like a stray dog, without any support. Wei Jisheng could squash him with a single finger, and no one would seek justice for him; he would rot like a dead rat in a gutter.
"Mr. Wei, none of this is my fault. I’ve done everything I could, but that Lin Fan..."
Wei Jisheng interrupted Mountain Chicken, "I have a task for you now."
Mountain Chicken was overjoyed; Mr. Wei giving him a job meant giving him a chance to survive, indicating that he was still useful!
"Mr. Wei, please tell me, I will do my utmost to complete it." Mountain Chicken immediately promised.
Wei Jisheng gave him a glance and said, "Mountain Chicken, you should know that you mean nothing to me now. Killing you is like squashing an ant. If you die, no one will know."
Mountain Chicken broke into a cold sweat, "I understand."
Wei Jisheng continued, "If I want to kill you, will you resist with your life?"
Mountain Chicken was drenched in sweat, "I wouldn’t dare. I don’t have such thoughts. I failed, and I deserve to die. My worthless life is Mr. Wei’s, and he can dispose of it as he pleases!"
Were Wei Jisheng to want him dead, he wouldn’t dare to resist at all. The older man next to Wei Jisheng was his personal bodyguard, and Mountain Chicken knew this man was formidable. Mountain Chicken wouldn’t even be able to touch a single hair on Wei Jisheng’s head and would be killed by the bodyguard in a second.
Therefore, if Wei Jisheng wanted him dead, he would surely die. He could only plead for Wei Jisheng to spare his life.
Wei Jisheng was very satisfied with Mountain Chicken’s words, nodded, and said, "I am giving you this task as your last chance. Either you complete the task and return, or don’t return alive. Of course, if I find out that you neither completed the task nor died, you know the consequences — no matter where you hide, you’ll meet a dead end."
Mountain Chicken said, "I understand. I will absolutely risk my life to complete this task. I will succeed or die trying. If I fail, I will die. No, rest assured, Mr. Wei, I will complete this task. I won’t disappoint Mr. Wei!"
Mountain Chicken initially intended to show loyalty, but noticing Wei Jisheng’s displeased expression, he quickly corrected himself.
Indeed, upon hearing his latter words, Wei Jisheng was satisfied. Then, Wei Jisheng assigned him a task and dismissed Mountain Chicken.
Mountain Chicken didn’t know what the task entailed, but as he walked out, he wore a doomed expression, as if the task from Wei Jisheng was extremely difficult, possibly requiring him to stake his life.
But did he have a choice?
He had no choice!
After dismissing Mountain Chicken,
Wei Jisheng said to the bodyguard beside him, "Let’s go back and find Father."
The bodyguard nodded and left with Wei Jisheng.
Wangu Group.
A skyscraper!
Even in a nearly first-tier city, among the skyscrapers in the city center, the Wangu Group Mansion stands out prominently. It’s a symbol of the commercial giant that dominates Jiangnan, something people can only look up to.
On the top floor of this skyscraper, there’s an office spacious enough for a ball game. From the floor-to-ceiling windows, you could overlook the bustling Hang City. Standing here, it’s easy to feel a sense of superiority and control over the city.
This office belongs to Wei Tiansheng, the patriarch of the Jiangnan Wei Family and the CEO of Wangu Group.
Wei Tiansheng is already an old man, over sixty, with graying temples. However, his skin is well-maintained, and he exudes a noble demeanor, dressed immaculately. His attire alone costs more than a regular person’s annual salary.
It’s clear that Wei Tiansheng is not the kind of wealthy person who wears shabby clothes. He cares about enjoying his life; if he’s rich, he lives the life of a rich man.
If someone is very rich but lives in a slum, wears cheap clothes, eats roadside stalls, and rides an electric bike, then why be rich? They could live the same life as a poor person!
Poor people have the lifestyle of poor people, and rich people have the lifestyle of rich people. This is Wei Tiansheng’s belief.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 Lin Fan, This Blond-Haired Kid
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Chapter 527 Lin Fan, This Blond-Haired Kid
So, Wei Tiansheng built an office that he believed was the most luxurious in all of Hang City.
His residence was the most expensive mansion in Hang City, his car was the priciest in the city, and his clothes were all custom-made by world-renowned brands. He enjoyed a lifestyle only the wealthy could afford.
Yet, he was still not satisfied with his current state. He hoped to become even wealthier and live an even richer life.
He wanted to live in the most expensive houses across the country and even the world. He aimed to become the wealthiest person globally.
Making money is endless!
No one could stop his desire to make money. Any obstacles in his path would eventually be cleared away by him.
On this day, Wei Tiansheng met with Wei Jisheng in his spacious office.
Wei Jisheng was his eldest son and the one he placed the most hope in. The future of the Wei Family’s business would be entrusted to Wei Jisheng. Apart from being his firstborn, it was mainly because Wei Jisheng’s values aligned with his own.
Wei Jisheng’s greatest wish was also to elevate the Wangu Group to a higher standing. Becoming the richest man in Jiangnan was not their end goal but merely the beginning.
"Is this person called Lin Fan?"
After listening to Wei Jisheng’s report, Wei Tiansheng suddenly asked.
His interest in Lin Fan surpassed the matter at hand.
Wei Jisheng said, "Yes. This Lin Fan disrupted our plans. If it weren’t for him, Mountain Chicken would already be the underground boss of Yun City, but with Lin Fan’s appearance, the situation completely changed."
Wei Tiansheng said, "Is this the Lin Fan I know?"
Wei Jisheng said, "Yes, he’s the newly-richest man in Yun City. His background is incredibly mysterious, and no one has managed to figure it out yet. Moreover, although he is the richest man, he likes wearing cheap clothes typically sold at stalls, which is very misleading. If he didn’t expose himself, people would easily overlook his status as the richest man."
Wei Tiansheng scoffed, "The richest man in Yun City, yet he wears cheap clothes? Such a person is really incomprehensible—having wealth without the appearance of it!"
Wei Jisheng said, "Even though he doesn’t seem to care much about the wealthy lifestyle, his actions shouldn’t be underestimated. Previously, there were three big players in Yun City; now, Lin Fan stands alone. Moreover, I heard that Feng Wanshan’s arrest is also related to Lin Fan—it was Lin Fan who took him down. Now, Lin Fan has disrupted our plans again. This person might be our nemesis! If we want to establish ourselves in Yun City, we need to make Lin Fan leave!"
Wei Tiansheng shook his head and said, "This person is indeed detestable, but not worthy of being a nemesis. He doesn’t deserve it. I, Wei Tiansheng, founded Wangu Group over 20 years to reach today’s status, but he’s just a kid. How could he compare?"
A trace of disdain appeared in his expression.
He didn’t agree with Wei Jisheng’s view of Lin Fan. Although rumors had it that Lin Fan had accomplished some things and risen to become the richest man in Yun City with a huge entity worth 200 billion in such a short time—which was quite impressive—in Wei Tiansheng’s opinion, Lin Fan’s success was mostly due to sheer luck, not his competence.
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, do you think we shouldn’t mind Lin Fan?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "Of course not. Whether his interference was intentional or not, we must teach him a lesson. However, we don’t need to change anything because of him. We must continue with our original plan to implement our project in Yun City!"
Wei Jisheng said, "Yes, I understand."
Wei Tiansheng said, "We must execute this project well. I have high hopes for it. If our experiment in Yun City succeeds, we’ll extend it across all of Jiangnan and even throughout the country. We must lead in community buying. If we can do it well, our Wei Family will not only be the richest in Jiangnan but soon nationwide!"
Wei Jisheng was secretly impressed. Wei Tiansheng placed enormous importance on this community buying project, to the point of aiming to become the richest in Huaxia with it—is that even realistic? What if...
However, Wei Jisheng didn’t dare to openly contradict his father, so he said, "I won’t disappoint you, Father. This project will definitely succeed in Yun City."
Wei Tiansheng said, "As for Lin Fan, give him a bit of a warning to make him behave. I don’t think I need to teach you how to do that, right?"
Wei Jisheng said, "Don’t worry, Father, I’ll arrange it right away. Lin Fan won’t be a problem again. I will make him realize that crossing our Wei Family is the biggest mistake of his life!"
Leaning against his chair, Wei Tiansheng closed his eyes and sneered, "This kid, Lin Fan, dares to compete with me—a real fool!"
Lin Fan won the recent underground battle, thwarting Wei Tiansheng’s plan to control Yun City’s underground, yet Wei Tiansheng still looked down on him.
Wei Tiansheng’s community buying project would still be implemented in Yun City.
Lin Fan would also receive a warning from the Wei Family. With that warning, Lin Fan would presumably not dare oppose the Wei Family again.
One could say the underground battle in Yun City was merely an appetizer; the real war had only just begun.
What the Wei Family didn’t expect was that the disdainful Wei Tiansheng would later be haunted by a nightmare named Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was already prepared. He knew the Wei Family wouldn’t give up after the underground battle, and naturally, their target would be him.
When soldiers come, fight them with soldiers; when water comes, cover it with earth—that’s Lin Fan’s attitude.
On the surface, Lin Fan didn’t seem anxious at all. The mission to unify Yun City’s underground had been completed.
"Mission: Unify Yun City’s Underground
Level: Important
Progress: 100/100"
"Ding!"
"Congratulations, host, on completing the mission to unify Yun City’s underground!"
"A special reward has been delivered. Please check, host!"
Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered to look. The system still had bugs, so it was probably another 5 million cash reward.
"Huh? Wait!"
Lin Fan glanced at the special reward and was a bit surprised because this time, the special reward was not 5 million!
It was 10 million!
Lin Fan was stunned: "Could it be... the system’s bug is loosening up?"
The system’s rewards consisted of two types: daily check-in, which granted a reward upon completion, and special rewards given after task completion. Special rewards did not conflict with daily check-in rewards.
In the past three months, the system’s rewards had been bugged; both the daily check-ins and special rewards were consistently 5 million cash, unchanging for three months—it was like clockwork.
Today, this special reward was unprecedentedly 10 million cash!
What amazed Lin Fan was not the 10 million cash itself, but the change in the system’s bug!
Could the system be self-repairing?
This process could be something to look forward to. It seemed like the system’s bug would eventually fix itself.
However, over the following days, the system’s daily check-in reward remained 5 million!
This left Lin Fan puzzled. How long would it take for the system’s rewards to be restored?
The past few days had been calm, and Lin Fan returned to his usual routine—handling business tasks and working as a courier.
One day, while Lin Fan was delivering a package to the Lijing District, someone suddenly called out to him. Lin Fan turned around and saw it was Liu Mengjie!
"Sister Mengjie, what a coincidence!" Lin Fan greeted with a smile.
Liu Mengjie said, "Indeed. Little Fan, have you eaten? Come to my place; I’ll treat you to a nice meal."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "How could I impose on Sister Mengjie!"
Liu Mengjie said, "It’s no trouble. Don’t you know? Our district now has this group buying trend, and things are really cheap!"
In his heart, Lin Fan let out a slight ’huh’, furrowing his brow. Group buying? Has the Jiangnan Wei Family’s community buying finally arrived here!

chapters.title: Chapter 528: Alive
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Chapter 528: Alive
Lin Fan, having some free time, went back to his old job and started delivering food again. On this day, he arrived at Lijing District, where he was stopped by Liu Mengjie.
Liu Mengjie was very happy to see Lin Fan. Recently, Yun City Music Academy had hired a full-time piano teacher, and with Lin Fan being quite busy, he hadn’t been teaching as a substitute. So, Liu Mengjie hadn’t seen Lin Fan for a while.
Liu Mengjie immediately invited Lin Fan to her home for a meal and mentioned that a group-buying trend had emerged in the community, making things very cheap.
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan realized that the Jiangnan Wei Family’s community group-buying project had already kicked off.
"Is that so, how cheap is this group-buying?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Liu Mengjie said, "Because of the platform subsidies, you can buy half a chicken for just 1 yuan, and vegetables are even cheaper. You can get a pound for 0.1 yuan. To snag these deals, the people in our district now all wait on the platform right on time every day to make the purchase. Because it’s so cheap, everything gets bought up quickly."
Lin Fan sweated. Normally, half a chicken would be at least 30 yuan, and vegetables would normally cost a few yuan per pound. But with the prices at 1 yuan or even 0.1 yuan, it was indeed outrageous.
But this was indeed happening.
Lin Fan said, "With prices this low, wouldn’t you all have no need to go to the market anymore?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "Why go to the market? Now with platform group-buying, not only is it cheap, but they also deliver to your door, saving the time it takes to go to the market."
Lin Fan furrowed his brow.
Liu Mengjie curiously asked, "Little Fan, what are you thinking about?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s nothing, I just think while it’s convenient for you and saves you a lot of money, this kind of thing can’t last long. It’s extremely damaging to the vegetable vendors. The Wei Family is burning money on subsidies to create a monopoly. Once they succeed, the subsidies will stop, and the vendors will be gone. Then, the cheap prices you enjoy won’t be there anymore. This is what they mean by ’the wool comes from the sheep’s back.’
Liu Mengjie paused, thought for a moment, and said, "Little Fan, I understand what you mean, and you’re right. But since there are cheap deals to be had now, it’s like taking advantage of the capitalists, so who wouldn’t like that? I see everyone in the district is quite enthusiastic and thinks it’s a good thing."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister Mengjie, come with me to the market."
Liu Mengjie didn’t know Lin Fan’s intention, but since he said so, she didn’t object. She nodded and took Lin Fan to the market.
The market.
At this time, it should have been the peak period for buying groceries, but it was surprisingly sparsely populated and appeared especially deserted compared to before.
The market stalls were filled with meat and vegetables, as if nothing had been sold.
Lin Fan said, "It must be because everyone is buying the cheap vegetables on the platform, so no one is coming to the market. Look, their produce isn’t selling at all."
Liu Mengjie said, "Hmm, now that you mention it, they do seem a bit miserable, their business has been snatched by the platform."
Lin Fan walked over to a stall selling greens, and the vendor was an elderly lady in her sixties, her hair gray and looking like someone who had often been out in the wind and rain, a seasoned farmer.
"Madam, how much for the choy sum?" Lin Fan squatted down and asked with a smile.
The elderly lady, upon seeing a customer, was very enthusiastic, "Young man, buying vegetables, eh? The choy sum is very cheap, 3 yuan a pound. How much would you like?"
Lin Fan said, "Give us a pound."
The elderly lady grabbed a handful of greens, picked up the scale with her trembling hands, and weighed a pound of choy sum for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan asked, "Madam, how long have you been here today? Look, it’s almost dark and you still have so many vegetables. What will you do if you can’t sell them all?"
The question hit the elderly lady’s sore spot. She sighed and said, "Don’t mention it, business has been hard these days, and I hear it’s going to be like this in the future. Look at what time it is, and there are so few people in the market, it’s nothing like before."
"Do you know why this is, why there are so few people?" Lin Fan asked.
The elderly lady said, "I don’t really understand, but I hear people say it seems like everyone is buying their groceries elsewhere, like online. Alas, nobody is buying from us anymore."
Lin Fan said, "So it seems like you won’t sell all your vegetables today."
The elderly lady said, "I won’t sell out. Before, I could sell out before noon at most. Today I’ve been sitting here all day, and it’s still not moving."
Lin Fan asked, "What will you do with unsold vegetables?"
The elderly lady said, "With greens like ours, they can only stay fresh for two days at most. If they don’t sell in two days, they go yellow and spoil, and we have to throw them away."
Lin Fan said, "Madam, you’re not young anymore. You should be enjoying your retirement. If the vegetables don’t sell, maybe you can stay home with your grandchildren instead of working so hard. It wouldn’t be a bad thing."
The elderly lady sighed and said, "If I had children and grandchildren to support me, who would want to get up early and work arduously to sell vegetables? My children and grandchildren are not promising. At my age, I still have to rely on myself. These vegetables are all home-grown. I can’t drive, and it takes me half an hour carrying them to get to the city..."
Touched by the sadness, her eyes reddened, the elderly lady wiped her tears with her rough hands and began to confide in Lin Fan. She was usually very lonely, with no one willing to talk to her. She kept everything bottled up, and it was rare for a young person to be willing to listen to her, so she poured out her troubles.
She was already in her late sixties, almost seventy. Her children and grandchildren were unreliable and couldn’t even support themselves, so at her age, she still had to rely on selling vegetables to earn some money. The most tragic part was that sometimes, her irresponsible son would even ask her for money.
She could only sell vegetables. At her age, working elsewhere was impossible. Even street-sweeping jobs wouldn’t hire her because she had no other livelihood; selling vegetables was all she could do.
If she can’t even sell vegetables in the future, she would have no source of income, which would mean a dead-end for her!
"I don’t know who these people are, but I’ve heard their vegetables are very cheap, and customers have all gone to them. We have no way to survive," the elderly lady sighed, looking worried.
This conversation caught the attention of the surrounding vendors, and hearing the elderly lady speak like this, the vendors were all downhearted.
Among them were grandpas and grandmas around the elderly lady’s age, and middle-aged people in their fifties, all with no other way out, relying on selling vegetables to make a living.
If they can’t sell vegetables in the future, they’d have no means to survive either, and they don’t know what to do next.
"Those heartless ones, why are they taking our livelihood away?"
"Us ordinary folks rely on vegetable selling to support our families and make ends meet. They’re trying to drive us to our deaths!"
"I don’t know what we can do anymore. We’re old, and no one will hire us. I asked the factory the other day, and they don’t take anyone over 45, saying you’re slow and more prone to accidents."
A chorus of sighs, negative emotions spreading, affecting everyone.
They lacked understanding and didn’t even know who was taking their livelihood. They didn’t know who to direct their anger at.
Seeing this scene, Liu Mengjie, standing next to Lin Fan, fell into silence. She finally understood why Lin Fan had brought her here.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: Steadfast
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Chapter 529: Steadfast
Liu Mengjie finally understood the reason Lin Fan brought her here; Lin Fan wanted her to see the evil those people were committing.
Through their low-price strategy, they took away the customers, cutting off the livelihood of these ordinary folks, which might be their only means of survival.
That old grandmother is a very typical example: she’s old, has no children or grandchildren to support her, and at her age, she still has to sell vegetables by herself with no other means to live.
Later, a farmer’s wife mentioned that her husband died of an illness last year, leaving her alone with three kids. Illiterate and lacking any skills, she has to come and sell vegetables to earn a living.
They all struggle to survive; each with their own hardships, but they share one thing in common: they all rely on this job with the lowest barrier to entry, the least need for technical skills.
An uncle told Lin Fan he has been a vegetable farmer for decades, always selling his own produce, but with his age, he doesn’t know how to do anything else.
Regularly, he has to transport over 200 pounds of vegetables into the city. To ensure the freshness of the vegetables, they are picked straight from the field at dawn, around one or two in the morning; many young people would be ending their vibrant night lives and preparing to sleep while he and his wife wake up to pick vegetables.
Working until four or five in the morning, he rushes to package and transport them into the city. Primarily, he wholesales the vegetables to vendors; he must arrive on time, because if he’s late, it delays the vendors’ purchasing and could result in his vegetables not selling. Thus, he’s maintained this routine unchanged for decades.
Luckily, this job has allowed him to support his family and send his children to complete their university studies.
However, it’s just a bitter fate.
His children haven’t amount to much, so he has to continue relying on farming and selling vegetables for a living. Recently, his health isn’t good either, needing to visit the hospital every month, each trip costing several thousand.
At over fifty years old, he’s approaching old age, and for the foreseeable future, he’ll continue this line of work.
Yet...
These past few days, his vegetables haven’t been selling.
Transporting hundreds of pounds each day, most of it ends up being brought back.
Vegetables can’t be stored; what doesn’t sell today has to be discarded the next day.
He’s worse off than the vendors—each throwaway amounts to hundreds of pounds.
"A few days ago, some guys in suits, with tender skin and lustrous hair, the type you could tell have never worked the field, came to my vegetable field and said they could purchase my vegetables directly. With them, I wouldn’t need to transport my harvests daily since they would drive big trucks to the village for collection. Sounds promising, right? But in reality, they offered a very low price, low enough that it was equivalent to working for them for free. How could I agree to that? No way. But by not agreeing, their low-priced sales affected my business, effectively forcing me into a dead end!"
The uncle spread his hands in helplessness.
This uncle is another typical example: the vendors’ route was cut off, and these farmers who usually wholesale to vendors find their vegetables unsellable without them.
They lost their ability to negotiate prices, enabling those people to collect their produce at low prices. If they don’t sell, they earn nothing. If they do sell, the price is too low, tantamount to working for free.
It’s truly a dead end either way.
Before coming to the vegetable market, Lin Fan had already anticipated such situations with the Wei Family’s monopoly. Hearing the farmers and vendors pouring their hearts out made it all the more real.
Indeed, monopolies harm people deeply!
If the Wei Family continues unchecked, and once they succeed, other large capitalists might step in to participate, dividing the market.
If this scenario spreads across all Huaxia, how many grandmothers and farmer uncles will be cut off from their livelihoods?
Yes, community group buying is indeed convenient, one could say an inevitable product of internet development at a certain stage.
But an inevitable product doesn’t mean it’s reasonable—unchecked, it can breed terrible maladies.
Actions like those of the Wei Family must be stopped.
But how can they be stopped?
Though Lin Fan is the richest man in Yun City, he’s merely a wealthy businessman, unable to compel the Wei Family to desist, who wouldn’t heed him anyway.
The Jiangnan Wei Family sees great potential in this community group buying project from a business standpoint; it’s truly an excellent project—countless communities representing endless traffic and cash flow.
How can they resist feasting on this opportunity!
They must partake and gorge themselves, this is what truly qualifies a capitalist!
What about it?
The livelihoods of farmers and vendors?
Are those the concerns of the elite? When the wheels of history roll over them, they are nothing but ants; who will remember them? While those who thrive on this project become immensely wealthy capitalists, achieving fame and fortune.
The world belongs to the elite.
That’s the mindset of people like Wei Tiansheng.
A wealthy person like Lin Fan, who goes to street markets to care for farmers in Wei Tiansheng’s eyes, is nothing short of foolish.
If there’s money to be made and not made, one must be a fool!
No one can stop their pursuit of profit, not even Lin Fan!
If Lin Fan truly tries opposing the Wei Family, they will certainly deliver the most terrible backlash against him until Lin Fan is defeated!
In fact, after Lin Fan thwarted Wei Tiansheng’s attempt to unify Yun City’s underworld, the Wei Family has already prepared a big ’gift’ for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan will soon receive a warning from the Wei Family.
The high and mighty Jiangnan Wei Family intends to chastise Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, urging him to be cautious and refrain from provoking the Wei Family any further.
Wei Tiansheng likely never imagined...
Standing at the street market, dressed in a courier suit, Lin Fan is already determined to stop the Wei Family.
There’s no way the Wei Family can monopolize Yun City!
Lin Fan’s influence may not be great yet, but as Yun City’s richest man, he still possesses enough power to challenge the Wei Family.
"Everyone, I’m buying all your vegetables." Lin Fan declared on the spot.
He decided to buy all the unsellable vegetables, at least ensuring the vendors and farmers wouldn’t suffer losses today.
This is merely a temporary fix, but it’s the only action Lin Fan could take right now.
Buying all these vegetables doesn’t require much money; this amount to Lin Fan is mere pocket change, but to these vendors and farmers, it’s the hard-earned compensation for a day’s work.
"Young man, such a kind-hearted person!"
"Such great kindness and virtue!"
The vendors and farmers broke into tears of gratitude, some even knelt before Lin Fan.
They took the money and left joyfully. Of course, if the problem isn’t solved, they’ll still have worries tomorrow. Yet Lin Fan’s expense bought them temporary happiness, and that is worthwhile.
The grandmother thanked Lin Fan with tearful gratitude, holding Liu Mengjie’s hand, "Young lady, your boyfriend is truly a kind man, you’re lucky!"
Mengjie’s face flushed; she wasn’t Lin Fan’s girlfriend after all, though she wished...
"Little Fan, what will we do with these vegetables? We can’t eat so many ourselves?" Liu Mengjie asked.
Lin Fan replied, "Donate them; donate to schools and provide students with free extra vegetables."
"Hmm..." Liu Mengjie felt Lin Fan’s approach was truly commendable, feeling slightly ashamed, she said, "Little Fan, I understand your purpose in bringing me to the vegetable market. I never realized before, from now on I’ll buy vegetables from the market and won’t participate in community group buying."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sister Mengjie, you aren’t at fault, neither are the other customers; those responsible are the ones creating the monopoly."
Liu Mengjie asked, "But what can we do to stop them?"
Lin Fan’s eyes sharpened as he said, "There’s only one way."

chapters.title: Chapter 530 The Beaten Delivery Guy
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Chapter 530 The Beaten Delivery Guy
Lin Fan spent money to buy up all the unsold vegetables at the scene and donated them to the nearby elementary school. The vegetable sellers were deeply grateful to Lin Fan. However, this solution was only temporary; to truly help these vendors, a more fundamental method was needed.
To stop the Wei Family, there’s only one way!
But this method might not necessarily succeed, and even Lin Fan wasn’t entirely confident about it.
That’s why Lin Fan hadn’t explained the method to Liu Mengjie yet.
The two of them chatted while leaving the vegetable market and returned to the entrance of Lijing District.
"Little Fan, come to my house. It’s been a long time since we’ve had a meal together," Liu Mengjie suggested again.
Lin Fan replied, "Alright, but I still have two deliveries to make, both in this district. Sister Mengjie, go home first, and I’ll come to see you after I’m done."
Liu Mengjie said, "Two deliveries? Let me help you deliver one, then we can go back together."
She wanted to have some alone time with Lin Fan as soon as possible. The more she got to know Lin Fan, the more she liked this young man. Besides his good looks, he was different from those profit-driven rich people. In the world of wealthy individuals, Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, was like a breath of fresh air.
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I’ll give you one in a minute."
Just as they were about to enter the district.
They heard sounds of arguing at the district entrance.
The argument had already attracted a crowd of onlookers.
It turned out that a delivery driver and the security guard at the district entrance were having a quarrel.
"I said you can’t go in!" The security guard shouted impatiently.
The delivery driver asked curiously, "Why not? I delivered here yesterday, and it was fine then. Brother, can’t you make an exception?"
The security guard replied, "It’s not my decision. The property management said that to enhance security and hygiene in the district, delivery drivers are no longer allowed to enter. I’m just following the rules!"
The delivery driver said, "What kind of rule is that? I’m just delivering some food. Why is it suddenly considered unsafe and unhygienic? This rule is absurd!"
The security guard glared and said, "You ask me, who am I supposed to ask? In any case, you just can’t go in!"
The delivery driver pleaded, "Brother, can’t you make an exception? I’m really short on time, and if this order is delayed, I’ll definitely be late for the others and face complaints. I’ll just drop this off and leave."
The security guard stubbornly replied, "No way. The only option is to have someone come out and get it!"
The delivery driver’s face fell, but there was nothing he could do. The security guard wouldn’t let him in, so he reluctantly took out his phone to call the customer.
"Hello, your delivery is here, but the guard won’t let me in. Could you please come to the entrance to pick it up? Sorry for the inconvenience," the delivery driver said with a forced smile.
Surprisingly!
The person on the other end was furious and shouted, "What do you mean you can’t come in? I order delivery every day, and everyone else can come in. Are you dumb? Get in here quickly, or I’ll complain!"
The call ended abruptly.
The delivery driver was extremely embarrassed.
He hesitated, considering whether to call the customer again to explain properly and ask them to come out for the food.
But he worried that doing so might upset the customer further. If the customer got angry and gave him a bad review, he’d lose out big on this order.
Besides, even if the customer agreed to come out, if they took their time, it would still impact his ability to deliver subsequent orders. After some thought, he decided that personally going inside to deliver would be the best solution.
However, the security guard wouldn’t let him in, absolutely wouldn’t let him in!
"Security brother, everyone is out here trying to make a living. It’s tough for all of us. If I can’t deliver, today will be a waste for me. Could you please make an exception and let me in just for a moment? I promise I’ll leave quickly and won’t cause any issues," the delivery driver pleaded again, his attitude somewhat humble.
The security guard coldly replied, "You know it’s tough out here, but if I let you in and the property management finds out, my month will be wasted too. There’s even a risk of losing my job. Could you please not bother me, just get lost! You’re useless, doing a delivery job. Tough luck, serves you right!"
The delivery driver’s heart sank, and he replied emotionally, "You can refuse me entry, but please don’t launch personal attacks. You’re not more noble than me!"
The security guard laughed mockingly, "Oh really, I think I’m better off. At least I don’t have to run around in the sun and rain. You need to ask me to get in. Am I not better off?"
The delivery driver was speechless. Indeed, in the current situation, the security guard was like a boss. Their positions were unequal, and he needed to ask the security guard if he wanted to get in, having no other option.
Seeing the delivery driver speechless, the security guard grew more arrogant. "No more words to say, huh! You delivery guys shouldn’t compare yourselves to me. You want to get in? Beg me, kneel down and knock your head three times, call me grandpa, then I’ll let you!"
The delivery driver felt deeply insulted by this, clenching his fist.
"You’re saying if I beg you by kneeling, you would let me in. So you could let me in, but you’re choosing not to!" the delivery driver said.
The security guard chuckled, "Yeah, so what! I’m not letting you in, what can you do? I’m the one in charge here!"
The delivery driver was furious, "You bastard, don’t think you can do whatever you want with a little authority. I won’t kneel to you, but I will deliver this food!"
With that said, the delivery driver picked up the meal and headed for the district.
He prepared to go in by force.
"Hey, you little punk, acting tough in front of me!"
The security guard shouted, drawing out a baton from his waist, and hit it on the back of the delivery driver’s head.
Bang!
It was a heavy blow!
The delivery driver was wearing a helmet, but the security guard hit him so hard in anger that the helmet cracked.
Blood quickly began to flow from inside the helmet.
"Ah!" the delivery driver screamed, staggered, and fell to the ground.
Bang!
The meal he was holding dropped on the ground, the soup spilling everywhere, completely ruining the delivery.
Seeing this, the crowd around showed expressions of shock. This security guard was too brutal, hitting someone just like that!
"You little punk, I told you, you can’t come in here. If you go in, I’ll lose my pay, and you’re still being tough with me, trying to break in. Do you not know how to spell ’death’? Get out of here, or I’ll hit you again!"
The security guard shouted, raising his baton, ready to strike again.
Suddenly, someone caught the security guard’s hand.
The security guard turned to see Lin Fan’s cold gaze.
Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie had just returned from the vegetable market. As they arrived at the district entrance, they noticed the argument, but by the time they got there, the security guard had already hit the delivery driver.
As the security guard was about to strike a second time, Lin Fan, who had just arrived, immediately moved to stop him.
"Who the hell are you, let me go!" the security guard angrily shouted, seeing Lin Fan wearing a courier uniform, he immediately became arrogant.
Lin Fan said coldly, "Are you still planning to hit?"
The security guard replied, "What I do is none of your business!"
Lin Fan slightly increased his grip, like a pair of iron pliers, holding the security guard tightly.
The security guard felt the pain and became scared, realizing Lin Fan wasn’t easy to deal with, suddenly softening his tone, "Hey brother, don’t mess around. The property management only said delivery drivers can’t enter, not couriers, so you can still go in."
Lin Fan coldly asked, "I asked if you’re still planning to hit?"
The security guard quickly responded, "No, I won’t hit anymore."
Only then did Lin Fan release him.
At this moment, the delivery driver was sitting on the ground, his face covered in blood flowing down from his helmet, clearly his head was hit open by the security guard.
He was on the phone, "Honey, I’m delivering at Lijing District again, I might be home late today. The security guard just wouldn’t let me in, and he hit me, I’m bleeding..."
Before he could finish speaking, the delivery driver suddenly collapsed to the ground, his phone falling at his side.
From the phone, came an anxious voice, "Hello, what happened, say something, hello..."

chapters.title: Chapter 531: This Delivery Guy Is Too Awesome
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 531: This Delivery Guy Is Too Awesome
The food delivery guy is unconscious.
Seeing this, the surrounding crowd of onlookers let out cries of shock, as people hurried over, crouching down to check on the delivery guy’s condition.
"His head is injured, bleeding a lot, he needs to be sent to the hospital quickly. If there’s internal bleeding in the brain, it’ll be problematic, and life-threatening." One passerby said, seemingly knowledgeable in medical skills.
Hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but criticize the security guard.
"That was way too harsh, even if you don’t let people in, you don’t have to beat them!"
"Everyone has it tough, can’t we be more understanding of each other?"
"No matter what, hitting people is wrong!"
"Let’s not say anything more, just get the guy to the hospital quickly!"
Realizing he caused trouble, the security guard was a bit flustered, stubbornly saying, "I didn’t want to hit him, he tried to force his way in, so I hit him, it’s all his fault for forcing his way!"
Hearing this, everyone was furious.
This security guard thinks he’s justified after hitting someone!
Conflicts between security guards and delivery men are not the first, nor will it be the last.
Delivery guys most fear encountering security guards, aside from some odd customers, as security guards complicate things for them quite often.
The reasoning is some security guards think they’re superior, looking down on delivery men, guarding the neighborhood entrance, holding the power of entry, they think they’re powerful, deciding who gets in or not.
Some delivery men choose to silently endure, while some more ill-tempered ones argue with the security guards.
Sometimes, it’s not entirely the security guard’s fault; the property’s decisions contribute too. The property might make a rash decision forbidding delivery men into the neighborhood, forcing security guards to enforce it, or else they face fines.
Frequently, it’s those in actual power making unreasonable rules, causing harm between security guards and delivery men.
Forbidding delivery men into the neighborhood is inherently absurd and unreasonable, as residents order delivery to avoid going out themselves, for convenience, as it brings goods to their doorstep.
If delivery men can’t enter the neighborhood, customers have to retrieve meals at the gate, contradicting their convenience goal.
Thus, the delivery guy just tried calling the customer to come out and get the meal, but was outright refused.
The customer is naturally not at fault, if it can’t be delivered to the gate, asking me to come fetch it undermines my reason for ordering delivery; might as well go out and pack it myself.
At its core, it’s the decision-makers’ fault.
However, even so, for a security guard to hit a delivery guy over a disagreement is still wrong.
This security guard perhaps feared losing his job, fearing for his salary, acted impulsively, but he’s still wrong; he could have just shut the door, blocking the delivery guy’s entry. He could even have used his body to block, but shouldn’t have used a baton to hit.
Unless the delivery guy was overly aggressive, first hitting him, prompting him to defend himself.
This security guard clearly wasn’t in self-defense, as he didn’t even attempt to block the delivery guy, directly using his baton to strike the back of the delivery guy’s head.
Now the delivery guy is unconscious, the security guard is a bit panicked, trying to justify himself.
No wonder it caused public outrage.
The scene became chaotic, some criticized the security guard, some tried saving the delivery guy.
The delivery guy is severely injured, no one dares to intervene.
Lin Fan immediately takes out his phone to call an ambulance.
He doesn’t know medical skills, only hoping the ambulance arrives quickly.
Before the ambulance arrived, a van sped over, from which a man and woman hurried out.
Seeing the delivery guy lying on the ground, the woman was shock-stricken, sprinting over frantically.
"Ah-Ming, what’s happened to you! Don’t scare me!" The woman cried out in fear.
The man was equally anxious: "What’s going on, who beat my brother-in-law like this?"
Turns out it was a man and a woman, the woman was the delivery guy’s wife, the man was his brother-in-law. They rushed over after receiving a call from the delivery guy, who suddenly fell silent, prompting the wife to urgently ask her brother to bring her over.
Her brother had a van, used for delivering goods, had an order but immediately canceled it, bringing his sister over.
"Oh no!"
The passerby with some medical skills kept observing the delivery guy’s condition, anxiously saying, "His heart has stopped, why hasn’t the ambulance arrived yet!"
Siren sounds rang out.
The ambulance finally arrived.
The doctor rushed over to the delivery guy, quickly assessed and said, "Get him to the hospital for emergency treatment."
The woman turned pale with shock, grabbing the doctor: "Doctor, what’s my husband’s condition, can he still be saved?"
The doctor replied, "Hard to say, we can only try our best, I don’t want to deceive you, most likely... but as long as there’s a glimmer of hope, we’ll do our best to save him!"
The medical staff brought out a stretcher, lifted the delivery guy onto it, and prepared to leave.
Meanwhile, the security guard took advantage of the chaos, slipped behind the crowd, then suddenly turned and sprinted away.
He panicked!
If the delivery guy really dies, he’ll be a murderer, murderers face imprisonment, perhaps even the death penalty, instinctively he wants to escape.
"That’s the guy who beat him, don’t let him get away!" Someone noticed the security guard fleeing, immediately shouting.
"You damn well think you can run!"
The delivery guy’s brother-in-law, enraged, chased after him.
But the security guard ran quickly, seemingly about to escape, the brother-in-law couldn’t catch up.
Just then, Lin Fan kicked the ground, propelling a pebble into the air, breaking through the air with a swoosh, striking directly at the security guard’s Achilles heel.
"Ah!"
The security guard let out a blood-curdling scream, tumbling to the ground, rolling a few times before stopping, clutching his Achilles heel, wailing painfully, blood trickling from his fingers.
The pebble was vicious, almost like a bullet, nearly crippling his foot.
The brother-in-law rushed up, pinned down the security guard, and promptly called the police.
Everyone was stunned.
Some noticed earlier that Lin Fan kicked out the pebble; this delivery guy was truly incredible!
This kicking skill was unmatched, kicking casually, the pebble flew straight with such precision, hitting the security guard’s Achilles heel accurately, it was miraculous, more accurate than some special forces’ marksmanship.
"Something’s wrong, don’t board the vehicle, quickly put him down, the patient has no life signs, immediate onsite intervention is needed!"
At this moment, urgently said the doctor.
It appears the situation worsened dramatically, the delivery guy’s condition suddenly turned critical.
The stretcher was put down, the doctor took out the emergency kit, started the emergency treatment, however, the situation clearly didn’t look optimistic, as the doctor was drenched in sweat.
"Ding!"
At this moment, Lin Fan suddenly heard a system prompt sound in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 532: New Reward, Ultimate Top-Level Medical Skill!
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 532: New Reward, Ultimate Top-Level Medical Skill!
"Ding!"
"System reminder, today’s sign-in is now available. Do you wish to sign in now?"
Just as the delivery guy was declared lifeless by the doctor and the final resuscitation efforts were underway, Lin Fan’s mind echoed with the system’s notification sound.
"Huh?"
Lin Fan was completely stunned.
Because in the morning, he had already signed in and received, as usual, a reward of 5 million cash!
Now the system was reminding him to sign in again?
Signing in twice a day?
Oh, come on!
This system must have some endocrine disorder, it’s all messed up. What does signing in twice a day even mean?
Has it bugged out to a point where fixing it is impossible, becoming so random?
The previously normal sign-in daily system with regular rewards, is it gone for good now!
The system’s disorder started from the day he completed the task of unifying Yun City’s underground, that time the reward broke the usual 5 million cash situation, granting 10 million cash.
Though Lin Fan was griping in his mind, he thought about it and decided to sign in anyway to see what the system was up to. If it gave another 5 million, it wouldn’t be a bad thing; who knows, it might give another 10 million!
"Sign in!"
Lin Fan said to himself.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the host, sign-in successful, reward: top-level medical skills, please receive!"
As soon as the system finished speaking, a torrent of data frantically flooded into Lin Fan’s mind.
Lin Fan was dumbfounded.
Top-level medical skills?
He thought this time’s reward would be the 5 million cash, or maybe even 10 million cash.
But it wasn’t!
The reward this time turned out to be top-level medical skills!
Is it back, could it be the system is back?
The system finally restored to normal, issuing proper top-level rewards just like before!
After being dumbfounded came immense joy!
Lin Fan was overjoyed, and then he began receiving the data flow and started absorbing it. Top-level medical knowledge began integrating into his memory, countless top-leveled medical skills formed, as if he instantly became a multi-disciplined doctor, gaining what would take the lifetime of many doctors to achieve.
No!
A doctor, however skilled, can research deeply in a particular medical field, but even if he devotes his life, there is still his limitations, like an ophthalmologist, no matter how skilled, he cannot cure blindness.
But the top-level medical skills Lin Fan acquired now surpassed any ophthalmologist, his top-tier medical skills could even cure blindness.
Most doctors are specialists, excelling only in their field like an ophthalmology expert doctor, otology expert doctor...
However, the top-level medical skills Lin Fan obtained covered not only ophthalmology but internal medicine, surgery... all fields!
He surpassed existing doctors in all medical fields to become a top-level doctor!
An all-round top medical expert!
Revive the dead, flesh and bones, diagnose life and death at a glance!
Soon, the data flow finished receiving.
"Cease resuscitation, time of death, 18:31."
The doctor who was trying to save the delivery guy declared him dead, and stopped, his face was sweaty with nervousness as he couldn’t save the man, looking despondent.
By now, a crowd had surrounded the scene.
The delivery guy’s wife was at the side, tears streaming down as she waited anxiously.
After the doctor’s declaration of death, the delivery guy’s wife collapsed to the ground, breaking down.
"Ah-Ming, don’t die! If you die, what will become of me and the child?" She sobbed uncontrollably.
The crowd around shook their heads and sighed, it was truly pitiful, the person just died like that.
On the side.
The security guard being pinned down by his brother-in-law’s face turned pale as paper. It’s over, really over this time, he killed someone, he might have to pay with his life.
"You bastard!" the brother-in-law shouted in grief and anger, punching the security guard in the face, turning it black and blue. If he could, he would kill the security guard to avenge his brother-in-law.
While everyone’s emotions were low, feeling pity and heartache over the passing of the delivery guy.
"He’s not dead yet."
A mild voice sounded.
It was like a thunderclap on a clear day!
Everyone looked towards the voice, only to see Lin Fan stepping towards the stretcher.
What?
This delivery dude was saying the delivery guy wasn’t dead?
Did they hear it wrong?
The doctor had declared death, could there be any mistake!
The doctor was surprised too, he quickly stood up and stopped Lin Fan: "Family member, calm down, he is dead already, please restrain your grief."
He thought Lin Fan was a family member or friend unwilling to accept the delivery guy’s death and was coming to check, so he intended to console Lin Fan.
The delivery guy was certainly dead, as a professional doctor, it was impossible to be mistaken, declaring death was a very serious affair, declared after thorough confirmation.
According to his professional medical understanding, it wouldn’t be wrong, so he didn’t doubt and only thought of Lin Fan as a grieving family.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m not family, I’m not related to him at all, he is indeed savable, but if you stop me, then he really won’t be saved."
What?
The doctor was stunned, Lin Fan was serious?
"You’re a delivery dude, and you know medicine?" The doctor couldn’t help his curiosity.
Lin Fan replied, "I know a thing or two."
Saying this, Lin Fan had already bypassed the doctor, squatting down in front of the stretcher, beginning to resuscitate, his fingers rapidly tapping on the delivery guy’s meridian points, as quick as lightning...
Just like a miracle doctor in a martial arts novel...
Everyone was dumbfounded at this sight, what was this miraculous rescue technique, could this dude really bring the delivery guy back to life?
The doctor stood by watching, cold sweat running, muttering: "What chaos, utter chaos!"
Being a professional practitioner for years, receiving the most professional training, he had never seen such rescue methods, completely unconventional, not rescuing but disgraceful.
Could this delivery dude be a lunatic?
The doctor shuddered, intending to stop Lin Fan but seeing Lin Fan’s fingers flying around, he hesitated to act.
Right then, the sound of sirens blared, police had arrived.
Loli and Little Wang got off the police car, shocked by the scene before them.
"What’s going on here?" Loli exclaimed surprisingly. The police received the brother-in-law’s report and quickly responded; even for police, such scenes were rare.
The doctor, seeing the police had arrived, rushed to Loli, saying: "Officer, the injured is dead, but this guy says he isn’t. I suspect he’s a pervert, insulting... Officer, could you please handle it."
Seriously, someone actually doing something like this to a corpse!
Loli was a bit angry, looked over.
"Huh!" Loli looked closely and was stunned, the one fiddling with the delivery guy was Lin Fan!
What was this heartthrob doing?

chapters.title: Chapter 533 Doctor, what are you still standing there for?
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 533 Doctor, what are you still standing there for?
If it were someone else, Loli would have immediately rushed forward to stop them. How could they possibly save a person declared dead by a doctor? Moreover, such behavior is really insulting, it’s simply perverse!
But the person is Lin Fan!
The male god!
Loli hadn’t eaten upon seeing Lin Fan, her eyes were filled with stars. His gaze was so handsome, so righteous, he was completely someone she admired.
She didn’t believe Lin Fan could be perverse. Anyone could be, but definitely not Lin Fan. In Loli’s heart, Lin Fan was a god.
"Ahem, wait a minute, let’s see first." Loli cleared her throat and said.
What?
The doctor was stunned, the police didn’t immediately stop the perverse behavior, but instead said to wait and see? Did he hear wrong?
"Officer..." the doctor explained, "I was responsible for the rescue earlier, and have repeatedly confirmed the announcement of the patient’s death. This delivery man claims the patient is still alive. You know, he is a delivery man, I am a doctor..."
The doctor’s meaning was obvious. He was a doctor, he could not be wrong, so Lin Fan was completely insulting him and could be arrested.
Loli said: "I know, let’s wait a bit. He said the patient is still alive, they should be. Don’t rush, we might disturb his rescue efforts."
The doctor sweated profusely.
Everyone else also broke into a cold sweat.
What is this female officer doing?
Not believing the doctor’s words and favoring this delivery man?
Little Wang, the partner on the side, quietly wiped his cold sweat. He knew Lin Fan; wasn’t he the male god of the female officer? Last time he saw them together.
Truly unexpected, that Sister Lily, always efficient and bold, behaves like a fangirling young lady in front of the male god.
If it were any other officer, they would have stopped Lin Fan immediately.
Seeing Loli say this, the doctor dared not say more. After all, his judgment couldn’t be wrong. The patient was dead; even if Lin Fan poked holes in the patient, the patient couldn’t come back to life.
Wait a bit then, shortly it would be proven the patient couldn’t be saved, and this delivery man couldn’t escape the charge of insult.
The doctor still thought about this, considering to file a complaint against this partial female officer once it was over.
Seeing no help from the police, the doctor turned to the delivery man’s wife and approached her, saying: "Dear relative, firstly my condolences. This is unfortunate, we’ve done our utmost to rescue but regretfully couldn’t save your husband. Your husband is deceased and deserves proper care, but look at this delivery man, what he’s doing is absurd, shouldn’t you as a relative intervene?"
The wife looked at Lin Fan; initially she was confused by his actions, but soon her thoughts changed.
"Doctor, I want to watch." said the wife.
As long as there is a glimmer of hope to revive her husband, she doesn’t want to miss it.
Indeed, the delivery man’s actions were baffling, but what if? What if he could actually save her husband!
Let’s say the doctor didn’t really understand her feelings, no matter how slim the chance, she would seize it.
The doctor was shocked, truly unexpected that the wife allowed Lin Fan’s absurd behavior.
The doctor had to give up, sneered internally, okay, let’s see what kind of act this guy puts up, after all, he can’t save a life and won’t escape the charge of insult.
For a moment, everyone with different moods watched Lin Fan’s rescue, the wife nervously clinging to a thread of hope, onlookers curiously observing, while the doctor watched with a cold sweat, awaiting Lin Fan’s reckoning.
Time passed like this, for a full ten minutes...
After ten minutes, Lin Fan finally stopped, looking relieved.
The delivery man remained motionless.
"Officer, you can arrest him now!" The doctor immediately said to Loli, he was now a bit angry, just wanting to quickly punish Lin Fan for such perverse actions.
Letting this perverse act continue for over ten minutes was inconceivable.
Lin Fan stood up and said: "It’s a pity there’s no silver needle. If acupuncture could be used to channel the meridians, it could be faster, but it’s okay, I’ve managed to save his life. Doctor, come quickly and put him on a respirator, the patient is still very weak and needs further treatment."
What?
The doctor froze, what did Lin Fan mean by saying he saved him?
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on the doctor: "Doctor, what are you waiting for, don’t let my effort be wasted, hurry up."
This startled the doctor, hastily running over, squatting down and reached to feel the delivery man’s pulse.
"Ah!"
The doctor let out a scream, eyes wide as if he had seen a ghost.
"He’s alive! He really is alive!" The doctor murmured, already petrified, even forgetting to continue the rescue, because he was so shocked.
The nurse reacted quickly, hurriedly came over, and attached the respirator to the delivery man.
"The patient’s vital signs are evident, but the pulse is too weak and needs quick hospital transfusion." the nurse said.
"Great!"
"Really revived!"
"The delivery guy is amazing!"
"Bow to the delivery guy, he’s a medical miracle!"
"Is this really Hua Tuo reincarnated!"
A burst of cheering erupted around, the onlookers were delirious, a person declared dead by a doctor was rescued by a delivery man!
Soon, the delivery man was lifted onto the ambulance.
"Doctor?"
The nurse called the still-petrified doctor.
The doctor finally came to his senses, glanced up at Lin Fan: "Who exactly are you?"
He still couldn’t believe it, was certain with his professional knowledge, the delivery man was dead, yet Lin Fan really brought a dead man back to life, how was that possible, how could anyone be so skilled!
Lin Fan smiled: "Me? Just a delivery man!"
Lin Fan didn’t say more to the doctor, to avoid upsetting him. Indeed, he had top medical skills, but even with such skills granted by the system, couldn’t truly revive the dead.
The truth was singular.
The delivery man simply hadn’t died!
The doctor’s judgment was mistaken!
This doctor was indeed very professional, but even professionally, there was a limit, it couldn’t be blamed on this doctor. Only Lin Fan with top-tier medical skill could determine the delivery man’s survival, a level unattainable by a regular doctor.
The doctor, feeling doubtful, got on the ambulance and took the patient to the hospital for further treatment.
Recalling his earlier pleas to the police and wife to stop Lin Fan, the doctor felt ashamed, realizing he himself was the fool.
The delivery man’s wife approached Lin Fan, kneeling down gratefully, "Miracle doctor, thank you so much for saving my husband, thank you endlessly!"
She was so moved that she bowed to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan helped her up, smiling: "It’s a small effort, don’t mention it, go to the hospital and accompany your husband, he should wake up soon."
"Okay." the wife wiped her tears, showed a joyful smile, and hurried to the hospital.
Lin Fan seemed to notice Loli only then, and smiled: "You came."
"Yes."
Loli revealed her starry-eyed fangirl face, mumbling, the male god was too handsome, didn’t expect the male god to have medical skills, and such superb skills, truly a treasure, why does he excel at everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 534: The Community CEO Personally Apologizes
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 534: The Community CEO Personally Apologizes
Lin Fan used miraculous medical skills to save the delivery guy, shocking everyone. Loli looked at Lin Fan with admiration, realizing that her idol had unlocked another skill today; he was truly amazing.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Officer sis, the one who severely injured the delivery guy is that security guard over there."
The beautiful police officer was so infatuated with him that she forgot there was a criminal to catch.
Loli said, "Little Wang, go cuff that guy and take him back to the station!"
Her partner Little Wang went over and deftly cuffed the security guard.
The security guard struggled and shouted, "It’s not my fault, I didn’t mean to kill him. I was just pushed too far. If you want to blame someone, blame the property management. They’re the ones who wouldn’t let the delivery guy in. If I had let him in, I would’ve had my wages docked!"
Lin Fan said, "Even if the property wouldn’t let him in, and even if it would affect your wages, that doesn’t justify murder! Committing violence in public like this is wrong and should be punished by law."
The security guard said, "If I’m to be punished, then why can those at the property management get away with it? It’s all because of their snap decisions that I stopped the delivery guy. It’s not fair!"
Lin Fan said, "You want fairness? Fine."
Lin Fan took out his phone and made a call, "Sis, it’s me."
Feng Ruolan’s voice came from the other end, "Little Fan, you usually don’t call me unless there’s something up. Go ahead, what’s the matter?"
Lin Fan sweat-dropped and said, "That’s not true. Next time, I’ll call to invite you to dinner."
Feng Ruolan laughed, "Really? You seem quite busy lately, do you have time?"
Lin Fan said, "No matter how busy I am, I’ll always have time to eat with you, sis."
Feng Ruolan chuckled, "Sweet talker! Tell me, what can I help you with?"
Lin Fan said, "Could you help me find out who the boss at Lijing District is..."
After the call, Lin Fan put down his phone.
The security guard said, "That’s it? I didn’t see the property management getting punished!"
"Wait a moment," Lin Fan said.
Everyone was curious about how Lin Fan, just a delivery person, would make the property management pay.
Soon, a well-dressed man hurriedly came from inside the district.
"I’m the property manager here, my surname is Chen. May I ask who is Lin Fan, Mr. Lin?" the well-dressed man asked politely.
Lin Fan said, "I am."
Manager Chen immediately came over, with an obsequious smile, "Mr. Lin, I came specifically to apologize to you. It was my decision not to allow delivery people into the district, and it was wrong, leading to today’s tragedy. I’m very sorry."
Everyone was dumbfounded; Manager Chen was actually apologizing to Lin Fan. But Lin Fan was just a delivery person!
What’s going on here?
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment, "Then why did you previously not allow delivery people in?"
Manager Chen laughed it off, "Actually, it was for the safety and sanitation of the district. Many delivery people’s conduct isn’t very good, and our district is considered upscale. Delivery people frequently coming and going doesn’t look good. Furthermore, residents ordering too much delivery can lead to a lot of waste, increasing the district’s load."
Lin Fan said, "Really, just those reasons? Ordering delivery should be the residents’ freedom. What, you’re not letting them order delivery? To put it mildly, you’re just property management. To put it unkindly, one might think you’re a prison warden."
Everyone felt Lin Fan’s words made sense and nodded in agreement.
"Exactly, what’s wrong with ordering delivery? Are we not even allowed to order delivery anymore living here?"
"The property management is too much!"
"We pay you management fees, not for you to make things difficult for us!"
Everyone started criticizing.
Manager Chen quickly said, "I’m sorry, I was careless. I’ve already revoked this directive as soon as possible. My original intention was also for everyone’s sake. I hope everyone can see my good intention and forgive me this time."
The security guard shouted, "Bullshit! Absolute bullshit! A good intention? I saw it with my own eyes that day. A delivery guy accidentally bumped into you in a rush to deliver, and knocked over some milk tea, splattering all over you. You flew into a rage and scolded him badly, then made us drive that delivery guy away. That’s when this decision was made! It’s clear you were just taking personal revenge!"
Manager Chen got anxious, "You murderer, stop talking nonsense!"
The security guard angrily said, "I’m not talking nonsense! If I knew you were so shameless, I should’ve hit you instead!"
Lin Fan looked at Manager Chen coldly, "Is what he said true?"
With his top-notch insight, Lin Fan could immediately tell if Manager Chen was lying.
Manager Chen, realizing he couldn’t deny it, flushed red, "I didn’t mean to. It’s just that the delivery guy was so disrespectful, not knowing his place, and he even dared to confront me! I just wanted to punish them a little, prevent them from coming in temporarily."
Manager Chen’s words instantly provoked public outrage.
"So, he was just pissed at the delivery guy, that’s why he didn’t let delivery people in!"
"This isn’t personal revenge? Such a person isn’t fit to be a property manager!"
"This man is truly abhorrent!"
Everyone started lambasting Manager Chen.
Manager Chen dropped to his knees and said, "Mr. Lin, I was wrong, please forgive me. I never thought my impulsive decision would lead to such a tragedy. I’m full of regret!"
Lin Fan calmly said, "I think you’ve got the wrong person. The one you should apologize to isn’t me."
Manager Chen said, "Yes, I’ll apologize to everyone, and I’ll also go to the hospital to apologize to that delivery guy."
At this moment, a Bentley drove over.
A middle-aged man with a big belly got out of the car and immediately approached, with a simpering smile, "Excuse me, who is Mr. Lin?"
"Boss!" Manager Chen’s expression changed and he quickly greeted him.
Everyone was astonished.
It was actually the boss of Lijing District!
The boss was alerted and even came personally, and he, too, sought out Lin Fan with a friendly demeanor!
"I am," Lin Fan said.
Lijing’s boss immediately bowed to Lin Fan, with a face full of sycophancy, "Mr. Lin, I’m Zhou Jinmai, the boss of Lijing. It’s a pleasure to meet you."
The boss extended his hand, trying to shake hands with Lin Fan.
Lin Fan, however, did not shake his hand and said, "President Zhou, do you know what happened here?"
Zhou Jinmai said, "I know. After receiving Miss Feng’s call, I immediately conducted an investigation."
Lin Fan said, "Then you should know how to handle it."
Smack!
Zhou Jinmai turned and delivered a hard slap to Manager Chen, causing his face to swell.
"You bastard, look at the mess you’ve made. Get the hell out, you’re fired!" Zhou Jinmai shouted angrily.
Manager Chen knelt down and pleaded, "President Zhou, I can’t lose this job. I have family to support; please, President Zhou!"
Zhou Jinmai was annoyed at him for continuing to disgrace himself. It wouldn’t be good if Lin Fan got upset, so he scolded, "Someone, get him out of here!"
Behind Zhou Jinmai, two burly men stepped up, lifted Manager Chen on both sides, and dragged him away like a dead dog.
"Mr. Lin, I have dealt with this person. Later, I will personally go to the hospital to apologize to that delivery guy and make compensation. Does this resolution satisfy you?"
