Everyone was stunned, looking at Lin Fan in surprise, not understanding who Lin Fan was, that a mere delivery person could make a dignified boss bow and scrape like this?
Lin Fan turned to the security guard and smiled, "Are you satisfied now?"
The security guard was dumbfounded, and couldn’t help but ask, "Who... who exactly are you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 535 Lin Fan’s Anger
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 535 Lin Fan’s Anger
A boss like Zhou Jinmai, who only focuses on making money and neglects his subordinates, eventually led to the tragedy.
The main reason he came over personally to apologize was because he was distressed by his losses. He owed money to the financial tycoon Feng Ruolan, and she personally called to inquire about it. How could he not give Feng Ruolan face?
Upon hearing that the richest man in Yun City, Lin Fan, was on the scene and had a close relationship with Feng Ruolan, he almost wanted to kneel down and kowtow to Lin Fan, calling him ’grandfather’, just so Feng Ruolan wouldn’t make things difficult for him.
No wonder everyone was surprised. Who would have thought that this handsome delivery guy was actually the richest man in Yun City?
The security guard had to comply and was soon taken away by the police. Facing him would be the harsh punishment of the law!
This incident later went viral, causing quite a stir online. Netizens lamented that the harm among the lower class is truly an unavoidable problem because those with money and power hold the initiative. They do whatever they please but do not wish to bear the consequences. The most common tactic is to let the lower class hurt each other while they successfully escape unscathed.
This incident was the same, with Manager Chen taking personal revenge, but the ones troubled were the security guard and the delivery guy, causing them to clash.
Fortunately, this time they encountered Lin Fan. With just one call from Lin Fan, let alone a braggart like Manager Chen receiving the punishment he deserved, even the boss of Lijing District had to come over and apologize.
Unfortunately, in reality, how many Lin Fans are there? So many inexplicable troubles, and how often do you encounter a Lin Fan?
Even Lin Fan couldn’t handle so many issues. He could only do his best to uphold justice whenever he encountered something.
The matter was settled.
Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie entered Lijing District.
It was already dark by then.
Liu Mengjie said, "Little Fan, are you hungry? Do you still need to deliver packages? How about I go home and cook first, and you come over to eat?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Sure, thank you, Sister Mengjie."
So Lin Fan went on to deliver packages, and Liu Mengjie went home first.
When Liu Mengjie got home, she immediately started cooking. She planned to put all her efforts into cooking a delicious meal for Lin Fan. Not only was she happy to dine with Lin Fan, but Lin Fan also moved her again today. First, there was the incident at the market, and then the delivery guy’s situation, making her see Lin Fan in a new light. Little Fan really is a chosen one; how many such outstanding men are there in the world?
Such an excellent man, she must seize the opportunity...
With this thought, Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but blush down to her neck. In fact, she was also an exceptional woman, beautiful and intelligent, a goddess many men dreamt about. However, in front of Lin Fan, she felt like a young girl just beginning to understand love, feeling both anxious and shy, afraid she was not worthy of him.
One dish after another, completed by Liu Mengjie, filled the house with mouth-watering aromas.
With only one dish left, Lin Fan could come over to eat.
Ring ring ring...
At that moment, Liu Mengjie’s phone suddenly rang; it was a call from Lin Fan.
"Little Fan, have you finished delivering packages? Come quickly, the food is ready," Liu Mengjie said with a joyful smile.
But on the other end, Lin Fan’s voice sounded a bit urgent: "Sorry, Sister Mengjie, I can’t have dinner with you. I just got a call from the hospital; I must go there."
Liu Mengjie was taken aback, "What happened?"
Lin Fan said, "It’s my uncle. I’m really sorry, Sister Mengjie. I’ll treat you next time. I have to rush to the hospital now."
After saying that, Lin Fan hung up the phone.
Liu Mengjie looked at the table full of delicious dishes and smiled bitterly, feeling quite regretful!
Who knows when she’ll have the chance to meet Lin Fan again next time?
At this moment, Lin Fan was already driving his Rolls-Royce out of the district, speeding towards the hospital.
He had just received a call from his sister; his uncle Lin Dawei’s liver disease had suddenly worsened, putting his life in danger, and he was now being rescued in the operating room!
Lin Fan was worried sick and couldn’t care less about having dinner with Liu Mengjie. He immediately rushed to the hospital.
Three months ago, Lin Fan’s uncle Lin Dawei came to Yun City seeking medical treatment for his liver disease. At that time, Lin Fan booked him the most expensive VIP ward at Yun City People’s Hospital and arranged for the best liver disease doctor, Guo Yu, to be his attending physician.
His hospital stay has lasted for three months.
Lin Fan previously didn’t understand medical skills; he believed whatever the doctor said and followed medical advice to treat his uncle. Luckily, he had the money. No matter how long Lin Dawei stayed in the hospital, he could afford it. Otherwise, for an average person, staying in a VIP ward for three months would be a considerable expense.
Whenever Lin Fan had free time, he would visit his uncle in the hospital. Learning that his uncle’s condition kept recurring, he, not knowing medical skills, didn’t understand the reason, only hearing from the doctors that it was due to a complex condition that couldn’t be easily cured.
Unexpectedly, today Lin Dawei’s condition suddenly worsened, requiring emergency rescue!
Utilizing the top-notch medical skills he recently acquired, Lin Fan’s mind flashed back to the past three months of his uncle’s condition. Lin Fan’s expression changed.
He didn’t understand before, but now he instantly noticed the problem. Lin Dawei’s recurring condition was very likely... intentional!
Lin Fan suddenly got angry.
In fact, he rarely got angry. At his current realm, very few things could anger him, but this incident crossed his line.
He must find out who on earth wanted to harm his uncle!
With medical skills in mind, Lin Fan headed straight to the operating room.
"Brother!"
Outside the operating room, Lin Shanshan was pacing anxiously. Seeing Lin Fan, she ran over and hugged him.
Lin Shanshan’s eyes were a little red: "Brother, I heard them say that Third Uncle’s condition is very bad and he might not wake up."
Lin Fan comforted her, "It’s okay."
Lin Shanshan said, "I had no classes this afternoon, so I came over to chat with Third Uncle to relieve his boredom. I was just about to leave when Uncle suddenly started vomiting blood. I was so scared; I didn’t know what was happening. I quickly notified the doctors, and they brought Uncle for emergency treatment."
Lin Fan frowned. Vomiting blood?
Lin Dawei had never vomited blood before. After being treated here for three months, could his condition have worsened?
"Let’s go and see." Lin Fan turned around to leave.
Lin Shanshan followed and asked, "Brother, where are we going?"
Lin Fan said, "There’s no point in waiting here anxiously. We might as well go and see the situation."
They arrived at Lin Dawei’s VIP ward.
The room was a mess, visibly caused by the earlier emergency.
The sheets were stained a deep red with the blood Lin Dawei had vomited.
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on that bloodstain. He activated his top-notch insight and medical skills and began analyzing.
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s expression changed!
"Someone has been poisoning Third Uncle all along!" Lin Fan said with a steely expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 Lin Dawei’s Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 536 Lin Dawei’s Death
"What?" Lin Shanshan was shocked.
Who would do such a thing, why harm Uncle Three? Mind you, Uncle Three is just an ordinary rural old man, he hasn’t offended anyone.
Lin Fan said, "It’s not Uncle Three who offended someone, they did this to target me."
Not being envied makes one mediocre!
Lately, Lin Fan has truly made some people hate him, and Lin Dawei being hospitalized here is no secret either.
If someone wants to harm Lin Dawei, ultimately they’re targeting Lin Fan. For those who hate Lin Fan, is there anything more satisfying than killing Lin Fan’s relatives and making him sad?
Lin Shanshan angrily said, "The person who does such a thing truly deserves to be struck by lightning, how can they bring themselves to do it? Brother, we must find out who did this and make them pay just punishment!"
Lin Fan nodded and said, "I will."
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, what should we do now? Uncle Three is poisoned, could his life be at risk?"
Lin Fan said, "Let’s go to the operating room and take a look."
Lin Fan turned and headed straight to the operating room.
Lin Shanshan quickly followed him, reaching the operating room, only to see Lin Fan directly pushing the door open and going inside.
"Hmm?" Lin Shanshan was surprised, not expecting her brother to charge into the operating room. She hesitated for a moment, but steeled herself and followed into the operating room.
Inside the operating room.
Lin Dawei lay on the operating table, receiving emergency treatment, the one treating him was his attending doctor, Guo Yu.
Guo Yu is quite famous in the industry, regarded as a respected mentor by the younger generation, and for many liver disease patients, he is seen as a god-like figure.
Coincidentally, today the hospital was having an exchange event, with many medical students and authoritative figures from the medical field visiting Yun City People’s Hospital for study.
Upon hearing that a liver disease patient’s condition suddenly deteriorated, Dr. Guo Yu himself took charge of the emergency treatment, immediately attracting everyone’s interest. They all wanted to go and see.
This idea was quickly brought to fruition, as Yun City People’s Hospital’s Dean Zhou Nanhua allowed the medical students to observe in the operating room.
Meanwhile, Zhou Nanhua personally led a group of medical authorities to the second-floor observation room, preparing to watch Guo Yu’s brilliant performance.
Watching Guo Yu focus on the surgery, the observing medical students held their breath, fearing they might disturb Dr. Guo. Their eyes were filled with admiration and longing.
They all wished they could be like Dr. Guo, nobody could match this splendor.
In the observation room, the authorities were discussing incessantly.
"This patient’s sudden liver disease exacerbation is extremely dangerous. I wonder if Dr. Guo can save him?"
"I trust Little Guo. This young man’s medical skills are exceptional and renowned in our industry."
"Little Guo’s intervention is indeed reassuring; today presents a great chance for him to showcase his skills greatly."
"Indeed, Dr. Guo is the most impressive liver disease expert among the younger generation I’ve seen, he has limitless potential!"
The authorities praised Guo Yu unreservedly.
Zhou Nanhua was very pleased, for Guo Yu truly is exceptional, and him being part of the hospital means praises for Guo Yu equate to praises for Zhou Nanhua’s vision.
Zhou Nanhua chuckled and said, "Little Guo really isn’t bad; when he came for the job, among ten outstanding youngsters, I instantly chose Little Guo. He truly became our hospital’s liver disease department’s pillar."
"Haha, Lao Zhou has a good eye!"
"Lao Zhou’s vision is truly commendable; he didn’t let talent go unrecognized!"
"Truly envy Dean Zhou, having such a group of talented doctors, especially Little Guo."
Everyone started complimenting.
Zhou Nanhua laughed joyfully.
Beep beep beep...
Just as everyone was praising Guo Yu, suddenly, an alarm sounded in the operating room, revealing Lin Dawei’s vital signs rapidly disappearing, all indexes plummeting.
"Begin CPR immediately!"
Guo Yu decisively said and began performing CPR on Lin Dawei.
Everyone grew a bit anxious, wondering whether Dr. Guo could save Lin Dawei.
"This patient’s situation is extremely severe!"
"I believe only Dr. Guo in this world could possibly save him!"
"If Dr. Guo can’t do it, then truly there’s no chance."
"I believe in Dr. Guo; he’s my idol; I believe he can surely bring the patient back!"
A female student showed an expression of infatuation, evidently her admiration for Guo Yu had reached a brainless degree.
However...
After completing a round of CPR, Guo Yu stopped, as Lin Dawei’s heartbeat had ceased, becoming a flat line.
Beep!
The distressing sound from the heartbeat monitor.
Guo Yu sighed and announced, "Time of death, eight twenty-three in the evening."
Ah?
Everyone was stunned.
What, the patient actually died?
"Dr. Guo tried his best!"
"The patient’s condition was too severe for anyone to save!"
"Not even Dr. Guo could save him, indicating truly there’s no chance."
"Dr. Guo must feel awful, the patient died in his care, feel sorry for Dr. Guo!"
"Truly life and death are predestined; if even Dr. Guo couldn’t save him, it must be destiny to perish."
The students were talking among themselves.
In the observation room, the atmosphere was a bit awkward. Earlier, the authorities didn’t hold back their praises for Guo Yu, and now it backfired since Guo Yu couldn’t save the patient.
"I absolutely endorse Little Guo’s medical skills; if the patient wasn’t saved, there’s only one possibility."
"Yes, it could only be that the patient was too severe."
"Actually, I already noticed before, this patient is very hard to save; for Little Guo to persist this long is already very impressive!"
The authorities tried to salvage the situation; they couldn’t contradict themselves.
Zhou Nanhua felt the most awkward, chuckling, "Little Guo has already done his best. From what I know of him, he should feel self-reproach."
"But we must admit, this emergency intervention can be considered textbook level."
"Every step was quite standard."
"Today, even if the patient wasn’t saved, it’s unfortunate. But I believe these medical students probably learned a lot from observing."
Everyone nodded in agreement with Zhou Nanhua’s viewpoints.
If it were a typical situation, this matter would end here. Guo Yu conducted an unsuccessful surgery, yet everyone found a way for him to save face, and the saga would conclude.
Lin Dawei was dead, just another in the thousands of patients; for doctors used to seeing death, it carried no sorrow, just a subject to be treated, much like merchants view people as mere goods.
But today’s situation turned different.
Just as the surgery was announced to conclude.
The operating room doors were suddenly pushed open from outside; Lin Fan swiftly entered, followed closely by Lin Shanshan.
"Ah?"
Lin Shanshan saw Lin Dawei was already dead and was immediately shocked into tears.
A nurse quickly stopped them, saying, "Who are you people, you can’t barge into the operating room, leave immediately!"
"Brother, Uncle Three is dead, what on earth happened!" Lin Shanshan cried.
The nurse, hearing this, said, "So you are the patient’s family. Even if you are family, you can’t barge in. I understand your emotions, but this conduct is not permitted; please leave first, and soon our doctors will explain the situation to you!"
Lin Fan ignored her and had already reached the operating table.
After observing briefly, Lin Fan said, "My uncle is still alive, he can still be saved!"
"Ah?"
Everyone looked at each other in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 The Medical Students’ Ridicule
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 537 The Medical Students’ Ridicule
Everyone was stunned. What was Lin Fan saying? Lin Dawei can still be saved?
How is that possible!
Dr. Guo Yu had just declared the patient dead. That means the patient is already dead, it’s impossible for him still to be alive. Once dead, you can’t bring someone back to life!
"He’s already dead, how can he be brought back to life!"
Guo Yu said, feeling a bit speechless.
He recognized Lin Fan as Lin Dawei’s nephew; he surely doesn’t understand medical skills.
"Mr. Lin, I understand your feelings, losing a loved one is very painful, but you need to accept reality; it’s unchangeable. Although it’s understandable that you can’t accept it, you can’t just storm into the operating room because of it!" Guo Yu said sternly.
Lin Fan said, "I’m saying he can be saved, not because I can’t accept it, but because he really can be saved."
"What?"
Everyone was shocked.
Could Lin Fan be serious?
In the observation room, the authorities all shook their heads.
"This young man must be overly sad. He’s acting a bit irrational."
"Isn’t that right? He’s really acting irrationally!"
"Little Guo couldn’t be wrong, and the ECG doesn’t lie. This person is indeed dead."
"I don’t know what’s going on with this gentleman, confidently saying a dead person can be saved!"
Zhou Nanhua frowned. He also recognized Lin Fan and had a deep impression of him, knowing this young man is pretty good, not to the point of acting irrationally due to emotional agitation.
At this point, Guo Yu was a bit angry: "Mr. Lin, are you serious? The dead should be respected, and this is your uncle. I think you shouldn’t joke about this! I’ll say it again, the operating room is not for you to enter. Please leave immediately, or I’ll call security!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What’s wrong, Dr. Guo, are you feeling guilty?"
Guo Yu’s face darkened: "Guilty? Why would I be guilty?"
Lin Fan said, "You’re afraid I’ll save my uncle, and you thought he was dead, making the wrong judgment, so you’re stopping me from saving him!"
Guo Yu angrily said: "Nonsense, how could I be guilty? Even if I might have made a wrong judgment, the ECG doesn’t lie. Your uncle is already dead, judged from any angle, he’s dead."
Lin Fan said, "What if I say he’s not dead, and I can save him? I’ll make you a promise: he’s still alive and can still be saved. Shall we make a bet?"
Guo Yu said: "Ridiculous! Who would bet with you? This is utterly absurd! I don’t know why you’re making trouble here, it’s quite strange. But it doesn’t matter; I won’t let you succeed!"
At this point, the medical students around had opinions, throwing disdainful looks at Lin Fan.
"What’s up with this person!"
"Is he a doctor?"
"He’s obviously not a doctor, or how could he not even determine death!"
"I think he’s just crazy, even daring to contradict Dr. Guo!"
"Dr. Guo is an excellent hepatology doctor, what is he?"
"Exactly, who is he!"
"Just leave, don’t embarrass yourself here, even quarreling with Dr. Guo, who do you think you are!"
The medical students complained about Lin Fan.
Lin Fan ignored all this, unaffected by the students’ words. He only hoped no one would disturb him because he was about to resuscitate his uncle, and the process couldn’t be interrupted.
Lin Fan raised his head, looking toward Zhou Nanhua in the observation room: "Dean Zhou, it’s been a while."
Everyone looked toward Zhou Nanhua, surprised that Dean Zhou actually knew this lunatic.
Zhou Nanhua chuckled and said, "Well, Mr. Lin is thoughtful. Mr. Lin, I’d like to advise you that what you’re doing is indeed wrong. I understand your emotions, but I hope you’ll be rational."
Lin Fan said, "You don’t believe I can save my uncle?"
Zhou Nanhua said, "I only believe your uncle is dead."
Lin Fan said, "What if I say you’re wrong? Dean Zhou, have you ever made a mistake in your life?"
Zhou Nanhua said, "Everyone makes mistakes."
Lin Fan said, "I agree with that, so I’m saying you’re wrong this time."
Zhou Nanhua said, "Mr. Lin, you keep insisting your uncle isn’t dead. May I ask what your judgment is based on?"
Lin Fan said, "I can see it."
What?
Everyone paused and then burst into laughter.
He can see it!
Lin Fan indeed hadn’t even touched Lin Dawei’s body, nor used professional equipment to examine him. Just by looking, he concluded Lin Dawei was still alive. That’s too casual.
Zhou Nanhua said, "Mr. Lin, you see everyone is laughing at you. Do you know why?"
Lin Fan said, "Why?"
Zhou Nanhua said, "Because aside from you all, everyone here studies medicine. We alone know how absurd your words are! You’re not a doctor, you haven’t studied medicine, you don’t understand medical skills, you don’t even know how ridiculous you are!"
Everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
This was a sense of pride from medical students. Those not in the field simply don’t understand, and they were proud of being in this field.
Lin Fan said, "Dean Zhou, you’re wrong again."
Zhou Nanhua responded, "I’m wrong again, where am I wrong?"
Lin Fan said, "You said I haven’t studied medicine and don’t understand medical skills. That’s wrong."
Zhou Nanhua curiously said, "Could it be that you, Mr. Lin, do understand medical skills, and you’re one of us? That’s odd."
Lin Fan said, "What’s odd about it?"
Zhou Nanhua said, "Assuming Mr. Lin is right, and your uncle isn’t dead, and you can even save him, then your medical skills are astonishing. If you have such skills, there was no need to send your uncle to the hospital in the first place! Does Mr. Lin understand this logic?"
Lin Fan certainly understood what he meant, and it was normal for Zhou Nanhua to have this doubt. It’s just that Zhou Nanhua didn’t know the real situation.
Previously, Lin Fan sent Lin Dawei to the hospital because Lin Fan didn’t indeed understand medical skills, but now Lin Fan possessed top-notch medical skills, which was true.
Of course, Lin Fan couldn’t explain this well because it couldn’t be explained logically. He couldn’t reveal the system rewards to others.
Zhou Nanhua saw Lin Fan didn’t answer, thinking Lin Fan was speechless, chuckled, "Mr. Lin, I don’t know why you’re stirring things up like this, and I’m not going to maliciously guess your intentions, but if you have any ill intentions, such as trying to cause trouble, I won’t be polite to you!"
Lin Fan wiped his sweat and said, "No way, Dean Zhou, do you think I’m here to cause trouble and demand compensation from you?"
Zhou Nanhua said, "Isn’t it?"
Guo Yu sneered, "I think the dean is right. This kind of person doesn’t have good intentions. I think we should call the police immediately and have them take him away!"
Lin Fan seemed oblivious and suddenly changed his expression, saying, "My uncle can’t hold on much longer. I must immediately save him, Dean Zhou. Whether you believe me or not, I’ll say this here: whether or not I can save my uncle, I will never blame the hospital! But if you don’t let me save him, causing my uncle’s ultimate death, I will not let this go! What do you think?"
Zhou Nanhua frowned, not letting it go?
He didn’t want to be enemies with Lin Fan. To be honest, he still had some reverence for Lin Fan because, after all, he was the richest man in Yun City!
"Since Mr. Lin says so, fine, I’ll just see how you bring a dead person back to life!"
In an instant, all eyes were on Lin Fan, wanting to see what Lin Fan was up to!

chapters.title: Chapter 538: Dare Not Offend
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 538: Dare Not Offend
Lin Fan eventually convinced Zhou Nanhua and received permission from Zhou Nanhua to proceed with the rescue of Lin Dawei.
Lin Fan had to seize this opportunity because, moving forward, he needed to focus on the treatment without any interruptions, as any disturbance could lead to the failure of the rescue.
If Zhou Nanhua didn’t agree, he might call security or even the police, so it would be difficult for Lin Fan not to be disturbed.
Zhou Nanhua didn’t really want to agree with Lin Fan. He also thought that what Lin Fan was doing was utterly ridiculous, because the electrocardiogram doesn’t lie, and if Lin Dawei was dead, he was dead—Lin Fan’s efforts would be futile.
Even if Hua Tuo were reborn, he wouldn’t be able to bring him back to life! Hua Tuo can be considered a symbol, representing the pinnacle of medical skill.
If even Hua Tuo couldn’t save him, it means it was absolutely hopeless.
If it were anyone else, Zhou Nanhua wouldn’t have any hesitation about immediately calling the security guard to kick him out.
But the person was Lin Fan!
Lin Fan’s declaration that he wouldn’t give up easily startled Zhou Nanhua.
Ultimately, it was still a matter of power—whoever had more power commanded attention. No one cares about the words of a small person; even if a small person makes threats, they’re powerless.
A small person, whom no one respects—even when asking a security guard for directions, the security guard would treat you as if you didn’t exist.
Lin Fan, having once been a deliveryman, knows best the humility of a small person. When he was a deliveryman, he often had to enter residential complexes, and each time he went in, he had to act humbly just to get the security guard’s clearance.
And those residential security guards, when they saw a deliveryman, suddenly felt superior, never taking the deliveryman seriously.
Lin Fan vividly remembers a particular incident, not long after he became a deliveryman. He once got lost in a complex, with no choice because the design was too complicated, and he simply couldn’t find the building he needed to deliver to.
And since deliveries had time limits, Lin Fan watched helplessly as time was running out, feeling very anxious as a newbie.
Having no choice, he could only ask someone, but, unfortunately, several residents he asked were equally unsure.
Lin Fan continued searching blindly, with time running out, almost late, yet still unable to find that damned building.
Suddenly, Lin Fan encountered a security guard and hurried over to ask for directions, confident that the security guard would know where that building was.
"Security guard brother, could you please tell me where Building 112 is?" Lin Fan politely asked as he approached.
But that security guard, who was about to make a call, glanced at Lin Fan with a look that completely dismissed the guy in the delivery uniform, didn’t utter a word, and then averted his gaze to continue his call.
Lin Fan thought he would tell him after finishing the call, but the security guard kept chatting without looking at Lin Fan again.
Originally, pointing Lin Fan in the right direction would have taken just a few seconds, as Lin Fan eventually found the building, which was quite close to where he met the security guard.
The security guard simply could have pointed a finger to solve Lin Fan’s problem.
However, this guard didn’t even take him seriously, unwilling to even lift a finger for Lin Fan.
Imagine if it were a leader or a wealthy person asking for directions; the situation would be completely different. He wouldn’t pretend not to see, regardless of what he was doing, and would surely stop and respectfully run over to answer and eagerly show the way.
Ultimately, it’s about looking down on people.
Lin Fan was extremely anxious, waiting for the security guard for several minutes, watching helplessly as time had passed, leaving Lin Fan with no choice but to give up on this security guard and continue looking by himself.
Eventually, Lin Fan encountered an old deliveryman, who knew the complex well and kindly directed rookie Lin Fan.
From that point on, Lin Fan harbored little goodwill towards the security profession, particularly those in residential complexes, who, despite being at a low level themselves, acted superior to deliverymen just because they controlled the entrance and exit, a face that is indeed unpleasant.
Precisely because security guards think they’re superior to deliverymen, news of security bullying deliverymen frequently occurs, like when a security guard kills a deliveryman with a baton for trying to stop him from entering the complex.
If security respected deliverymen, such things would absolutely not happen. It’s the disregard that leads to violence.
This phenomenon is no longer isolated but widespread.
After Lin Fan became wealthy, his company also needed security, and Lin Fan had only one request of them: learn to respect people and don’t look down upon others.
Anyone who looked down upon people and believed themselves superior, Lin Fan would not hesitate to fire them.
But from this example, it also illustrates a point. If you’re just an insignificant person, a delivery guy in a delivery uniform or a courier guy in a courier uniform, no one might care about your words or actions, and you won’t be taken seriously.
This is why people need to rise, to elevate their social status—having status gives you a voice.
Not mentioning the high-ranking leaders, even a mere security guard, just because he controls the boom gate at the entrance, can behave like a lord in front of delivery and courier messengers.
Similarly, if Lin Fan were just a courier guy, Zhou Nanhua wouldn’t have cared at all about Lin Fan, having the security guard throw him out long ago.
But he knew Lin Fan’s identity, knew Lin Fan as Yun City’s richest man, and knew Lin Fan had a mysterious background, so he didn’t dare to act rashly.
He truly feared Lin Fan’s statement, "I won’t let this go easily." He wasn’t sure if he could withstand any retaliatory measures from Lin Fan.
Yun City’s richest man, Lin Fan, is fundamentally different from the delivery guy Lin Fan whom even security guards looked down on.
Those who didn’t know Lin Fan’s identity reacted very differently from Zhou Nanhua.
"Dean, you can’t let this guy act recklessly. The patient is already dead; there’s no need, truly no need! I think we should stop him and throw the troublemaker out!" Guo Yu shouted.
Guo Yu’s words received a lot of support, especially from the medical students, who practically idolized Guo Yu.
"Dr. Guo is absolutely right! It’s unnecessary to waste time on such a person!"
"Dr. Guo is so handsome, so bold—truly my idol!"
"Teacher Guo is just speaking the truth! This person is indeed wasting time!"
"I don’t know why the dean agreed to such an absurd request!"
They were unaware that Zhou Nanhua was wary of Lin Fan.
Zhou Nanhua’s face darkened: "I’ve decided as such. I’ll give Mr. Lin this opportunity to perform the rescue. No need to say more! Mr. Lin, please proceed!"
Lin Fan said, "Wait a minute, I have one more request."

chapters.title: Chapter 539 The Clown Is Actually Myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Chapter 539 The Clown Is Actually Myself
Lin Fan’s request was simple: during his resuscitation process, no one could make a sound and disturb him.
"If anyone makes a noise and it affects my rescue, then that person will be responsible for the consequences, which involves a human life! If anyone feels they can’t control themselves, please leave now!" Lin Fan said.
The crowd whispered among themselves.
"This guy is trying to shift the blame, isn’t he!"
"This old man can’t be saved anyway, and he knows it, so he’s trying to find someone to blame!"
"So let’s not make any noise. Just watch quietly. In case he insists that we’ve disturbed him just because of talking, that would be so damn unjust."
Sure enough, although there were many questions, everyone quieted down for a moment.
Some even feared that their breathing would be criticized by Lin Fan, so they adjusted it and tried to hold their breath.
Lin Fan was satisfied with this result. With just one sentence, he made everyone silent. He had tactically used their unwillingness to be blamed.
Lin Fan was finally about to start the rescue.
On site, a group of medical students and a bunch of medical authorities were watching this rescue.
They had previously watched Doctor Guo Yu’s surgery, and although it ended in failure, they all praised Guo Yu highly.
Now it was Lin Fan’s turn, but their attitudes had completely changed, showing disdain in their eyes.
To them, Lin Fan was simply messing about and acting recklessly!
The person was already dead; it was impossible to bring him back. Lin Fan was making a joke of himself, and they couldn’t wait to ridicule him. Once Lin Fan failed, it was foreseeable that his joke would spread everywhere.
"I want to see, with everyone silent, who he will blame!"
"This guy is really ridiculous. Look at his outfit, he’s a deliveryman, isn’t he!"
"A deliveryman doing a doctor’s job? How funny is that!"
"I’m just waiting for him to fail because he’s bound to fail. How could a dead person be brought back to life!"
Though they kept silent, these were their basic thoughts.
No one believed Lin Fan could really bring a dead person back to life. They were all waiting to see him make a fool of himself.
Lin Fan raised his head and said to Zhou Nanhua, "I have one more request: I need the assistance of these nurses to help with the resuscitation."
In surgery, there is usually the lead surgeon, the assistant surgeon, and then a group of nurses ready for orders.
Lin Fan now wanted to use this group of nurses.
Zhou Nanhua said, "No problem. You are now the lead surgeon, and you can command them."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I believe the nurses here are all well-trained and, with their professional mission, will do their utmost to assist me."
This remark flattered the nurses, ensuring that no one dared to slight Lin Fan.
Lin Fan finally began to treat Lin Dawei.
Guo Yu sneered internally; this Lin Fan was doing something impossible. What kind of madness had seized him? Annoyingly, even the dean had agreed to this.
While Guo Yu was displeased, Lin Fan had already started, with medical skills quick as lightning...
Unlike when rescuing the food delivery man, where Lin Fan could manage alone, he now needed the help of well-trained nurses, following his instructions.
Lin Fan commenced the rescue, using a scalpel and constantly asking nurses to hand over various medications and instruments.
Observation room.
The authorities watching this scene shook their heads one by one, expressing denial towards Lin Fan.
"This person is named Lin Fan, right? He’s simply acting recklessly!"
"From his movements, he doesn’t look like someone who studied medicine!"
"This person is really about to make a fool of himself. With so many industry elites watching, he’ll end up as everyone’s laughingstock."
Given Lin Fan’s level, it would be strange if he could save someone.
"Dean Zhou, I think this is a waste of manpower and resources. If this guy’s surgery fails, how will you handle it?" someone asked Zhou Nanhua.
Zhou Nanhua said, "What else can be done? If he’s able to bring the person back, then all’s well. If not, it’ll be nothing short of a joke."
"I must admit, he moves quite fast, which is impressive in its own right. Maybe he does have something, after all," someone expressed curiosity about Lin Fan.
But it was immediately met with ridicule.
"What’s the difference between moving fast and having medical skills? No matter how fast he moves, it doesn’t prove he understands medicine!"
"Exactly, it doesn’t prove anything!"
"No need to say more, let’s just wait for him to embarrass himself because it’s a hundred percent certain. In the end, as long as no one’s revived, it’s enough."
The crowd, either verbally or in their hearts, underestimated Lin Fan, considering themselves as the true professionals; what was Lin Fan compared to them!
Time continued to pass, and Lin Fan was now busy beyond measure, continually applying various rescue methods to Lin Dawei.
This surgery was not favored from the beginning.
But Lin Fan didn’t care about others’ opinions. He didn’t have time to speculate on what others thought. He had only one thought: no matter what, he had to save Lin Dawei.
Lin Fan focused intently on the surgery, and the onlookers, initially contemptuous, gradually fell silent.
First came the incredible realization in someone’s mind.
Lin Fan’s medical skills, at first glance, indeed seemed unreasonable and not like those of someone with medical knowledge. But if you paid close attention and watched for a while, you’d naturally understand how exceptional Lin Fan was.
It’s like a calligraphy master—what seems to the layman like careless handwriting, random scribbling with no rules or beauty, still preferable are neat, square characters.
But once those laymen learn a bit about calligraphy, and then look again at the master’s wild cursive works, they can see the depth and know where the mastery lies.
This is actually a matter of skill level.
Even those in the observation room—people considered authorities in medicine—didn’t see it initially, but when they slowly realized Lin Fan’s brilliance, they felt more astounded.
Ordinary people don’t understand; they see grass script and dismiss it as "a mess," while experts would kneel and sing its praises.
"I never dreamed that this surgery would actually seem to be well done."
"Is he doing it intentionally or unintentionally?"
"I actually think he’s doing a good job."
"Could the dead really come back to life? If he knew his uncle was dead, any rational person wouldn’t go to these lengths."
"It’s over the top!"
In the observation room, these medical authority figures saw the issue faster than the medical students.
They initially mocked Lin Fan’s medical skills for having no rules, not seeming like someone who knew medicine.
But in the end, they realized the joke was on them.
They thought Lin Fan’s medical skills were lacking, mocked him, only to find out their own skills fell far short of Lin Fan’s!

chapters.title: Chapter 540: Leading the World by 1,000 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Chapter 540: Leading the World by 1,000 Years
Operating room.
Inside, a group of medical students gathered to watch; in the observation room, a group of experts looked on. Whether they were students still mastering their skills or seasoned authorities, at this moment, they all held their breath.
They held their breath involuntarily, their expressions a bit tense.
The only remaining sound was Lin Fan’s surgical work. Occasionally, he would instruct the nurses, who cooperatively bustled around, very busy.
At first, no one thought that Lin Fan could save Lin Dawei; some even believed Lin Fan was causing trouble. Lin Fan’s surgical techniques differed entirely from what they had learned—it seemed unprofessional!
However, as time passed, some authorities first noticed a glimmer of expertise. Gradually, they realized that Lin Fan’s method was something they had never seen before, yet it was exceptionally brilliant!
It was like Bronze could not initially comprehend King’s operations and mocked him for not understanding. But slowly, Bronze began to sense King’s prowess, eventually realizing that the operation was at a Divine Level they had never conceived.
Pitifully, they had been ridiculing King before, but the joke was on them!
The authorities thus fell silent first, each caught in surprise and shock.
Whether or not Lin Fan could ultimately bring Lin Dawei back, Lin Fan’s remarkable skill alone was unforgettable for them.
All along, they had thought they were the pinnacle of medicine, but today they learned that before Lin Fan, they were like elementary students!
Time passed unknowingly as everyone was captivated by Lin Fan, unaware of its passage.
Beep!
Suddenly, the electrocardiogram emitted a sound, and the line jumped a bit.
The sound was like thunder, astonishing everyone.
What?
The ECG actually moved? Lin Dawei, who had been dead, actually regained a heartbeat?
It felt like the birth of a newborn, indeed, Lin Dawei was reborn.
The ECG was indeed beating again, gradually returning to a normal rhythm.
Alive!
Lin Dawei really came back to life!
Everyone was dumbstruck, watching the beating ECG. If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they would never have dreamed of witnessing such a miracle today!
Lin Fan took the scissors from the nurse, cutting off the suture thread, indicating the surgery was complete.
Lin Fan paused, his face appearing somewhat pale.
There was no choice—Lin Dawei’s condition was too poor. Even with top-notch medical skill, saving him was extremely difficult.
But perhaps only Lin Fan in this world could save Lin Dawei, only Lin Fan could see that Lin Dawei wasn’t truly dead yet.
As long as there was a sliver of chance, Lin Fan was determined to save Lin Dawei.
Having completed the surgery and saved Lin Dawei, Lin Fan finally breathed a sigh of relief and looked up, seeing the stunned states of both surrounding students and the observing experts, unable to believe it was real.
In the beginning, they had indeed mocked Lin Fan, but Lin Fan, through his actions, proved them entirely wrong.
Lin Fan turned to Guo Yu: "Dr. Guo, do you still think I’m causing trouble now?"
Guo Yu’s face reddened with embarrassment, unable to utter a word—for he had no ground to speak.
He had previously claimed that Lin Dawei was dead and didn’t allow Lin Fan to intervene. Now he clearly understood—the joke was on him.
Seeing this, Lin Fan smiled; it was indeed satisfying to prove them wrong. These guys needed this face-slapping.
"He really brought the dead back to life!"
"Oh my God, he’s truly a miracle doctor!"
"Dr. Guo had said the patient was dead, but was proven wrong. It looks like Dr. Guo is not as skilled as him!"
"It seems Dr. Guo was indeed mistaken!"
"I declare my new idol is him—his medical skill is divine!"
The students were animatedly discussing.
Their conversations revealed that Guo Yu quickly lost favor; their object of admiration shifted to Lin Fan.
If Dr. Guo was impressive, then Lin Fan was ten times more so!
A person pronounced dead by Dr. Guo was revived by Lin Fan!
This would forever be a source of humiliation for Guo Yu.
Guo Yu simmered with jealousy—why, why is Lin Fan so skilled? It seemed impossible, so how?
Had he not witnessed it himself, he could deceive himself that it wasn’t real.
But having witnessed Lin Fan’s surgery, he had no room for doubt—Lin Fan was indeed that skilled!
Lin Fan’s prowess had even surpassed the current limits of medical skill!
It felt like someone who only knew basic arithmetic suddenly discovering calculus.
It belonged to medicine, a more profound world, not within the same dimension as the existing medical field!
Lin Fan’s presence was simply a crushing different-dimensional shock.
What’s a different-dimensional shock? Higher dimensions are beyond the reach of lower dimensions, incomprehensible to them. When a higher dimension invades a lower one, the lower dimension has no way to fight back.
Now, this group of medical authorities, these almost top-notch medical students, were in this situation in front of Lin Fan.
"What on earth is happening, how can he possess such astonishing medical skill?"
"This... it’s incredible!"
"I just felt like I had opened the door to a new world!"
"No illusion, his performance indeed opened a new world; medicine can indeed rise a dimension!"
"Modern medicine actually has many limitations and is far from the point of pride, yet..."
"I felt I saw the state of medicine 300 years in the future!"
"What? You mean his medical skill is 300 years ahead of the world?"
"Not exaggerated at all, perhaps not just 300 years, maybe even a thousand!"
The usually serious authorities turned into curious schoolchildren, excitedly debating, chattering with trembling hands!
Ahead of this world by 1000 years!
What a concept, Lin Fan’s top medical skill could be humanity’s pursuit for the next 1000 years!
Indeed, current medical skill is far from excellent. Of course, compared to ancient times, modern medicine has left ancient practices far behind. In ancient times, both traditional Chinese and Western medicine were quite primitive, with many flaws, like ancient Western medicine’s penchant for bloodletting.
Modern medicine crushes ancient medicine, and human longevity has increased accordingly. Modern medicine, with its advanced equipment and drugs, can cure many diseases previously deemed incurable.
However, the limitations of modern medicine remain quite evident; the most glaring example is humanity’s current inability to beat cancer.
Lin Fan’s recent display of transcendent medical skill felt like cancer would be just a minor illness in front of him.
Amid the crowd’s awe for Lin Fan’s medical skills, Lin Fan abruptly stated: "My uncle was saved, but it’s not over yet. I have another surgery to perform tonight."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 I Taught Myself
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Chapter 541 I Taught Myself
Lin Fan said he still had a surgery to perform, which left everyone puzzled, not knowing what he meant.
"Mr. Lin, your technique just now was simply extraordinary. I’ve been a doctor for so many years, and I’ve been the lead surgeon for hundreds of surgeries, big and small, yet I’ve never seen anyone perform surgery like this. Mr. Lin, you’re truly amazing! How did you do it, Mr. Lin?" Zhou Nanhua reacted, lavishing praise on Lin Fan.
Lin Fan, of course, wouldn’t tell him it was a gift from the system, so he just smiled: "I don’t know either."
Zhou Nanhua said, "How could you not know? Mr. Lin is too humble. I never knew Mr. Lin possessed medical skill. May I ask which medical university Mr. Lin attended before, and who was your divine-level mentor?"
Zhou Nanhua was really curious. He wanted to understand what created this heaven-defying existence of Lin Fan!
Lin Fan shook his head and said: "I didn’t attend medical university, nor did I have a mentor."
Zhou Nanhua was stunned: "You didn’t?"
Everyone was also stunned.
If Lin Fan didn’t attend medical university or apprentice under anyone, where did he learn these remarkable medical skills?
Zhou Nanhua persisted and said: "Impossible, Mr. Lin must be unwilling to disclose it. However, as far as I’m aware, the existing medical knowledge in this world couldn’t teach you!"
Lin Fan said: "I’m not lying; I really didn’t attend medical university, nor do I recognize any professor. My techniques were all figured out through self-study."
"What?"
Everyone was sweating profusely; he was actually self-taught!
Self-taught, and yet it’s possible?
Generally, medical skills need to be taught; self-taught accomplishments are practically infeasible in the medical world. Medical skills, unlike other skills, require systematic learning!
Without systematic learning, one achieves only mediocre levels, and self-study is very difficult, even nearly impossible to achieve systematic learning.
However, Lin Fan claimed he was self-taught!
This was astonishing.
Self-taught excellence? And then, accidentally learning medical skills that lead the world?
This is simply incredible.
When it comes to boasting, what could possibly be bigger than this!
"Mr. Lin, are you speaking nonsense because you’re too tired? Self-taught excellence, I honestly don’t believe it," said Zhou Nanhua.
Lin Fan said casually: "It doesn’t matter whether you believe it. I’m indeed self-taught, but if you don’t believe it, feel free to check whether I’ve attended medical university."
Zhou Nanhua said: "If Mr. Lin really achieved excellence through self-study, then it’s only right to say that Mr. Lin is truly a genius by nature, becoming a divine doctor through self-study."
Lin Fan found it amusing in his heart; genius by nature—it was all a gift from the system.
Of course, he wouldn’t clarify; there was no need.
"Dean Zhou, is there anything else you would like to instruct?" Lin Fan said loudly.
Zhou Nanhua said: "I indeed have many questions to ask you, but at the moment, I don’t know what to ask."
He was still somewhat excited, and his words were even a bit incoherent; Lin Fan’s demonstrated medical skill was just too powerful, too astounding.
In front of Lin Fan, all former doctors automatically fell in rank. Those who were top physicians could only remove the ’top,’ as Lin Fan was the true top!
Lin Fan said: "Since Dean Zhou has no questions to ask, I’ll say it again: I still have a surgery to perform tonight."
Zhou Nanhua finally calmed down and asked curiously: "Mr. Lin, what surgery do you still have to perform? What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said: "Although my uncle has been saved, there’s a reason my uncle ended up like this. Aren’t you curious about it?"
Zhou Nanhua said: "Your uncle entered our hospital for treatment three months ago, but his condition was severe and gradually worsened. Our hospital, specifically Dr. Guo, despite exhaustive efforts, still could not prevent the condition from deteriorating. Tonight, your uncle’s condition worsened, necessitating rescue; that’s the basic situation."
"No," replied Lin Fan firmly.
Zhou Nanhua was stunned: "No?"
Lin Fan said: "My uncle’s liver disease was indeed quite severe. It couldn’t be treated in a small county, so he came to Yun City for treatment, specifically for the renowned liver disease expert, Dr. Guo. Regardless of how severe my uncle’s liver disease was, it wouldn’t have reached the point of needing rescue!"
Zhou Nanhua frowned: "Mr. Lin means that our hospital worsened your uncle’s condition?"
Lin Fan’s implication wasn’t favorable.
Though Lin Fan’s medical skill was shocking, his words seemed to belittle Yun City People’s Hospital, which concerned its reputation. Dean Zhou was sensitive in this regard.
His primary reaction, as part of his duty, was to protect the hospital’s reputation. It must not be tarnished.
Lin Fan said: "Under normal circumstances, my uncle would enter a big hospital and receive treatment from leading doctors. His condition should improve; even if it didn’t improve, it shouldn’t have worsened!"
Zhou Nanhua said with slight displeasure: "Mr. Lin seems to still think we worsened your uncle’s condition? Mr. Lin, I believe Dr. Guo really did his best, and if you insist on saying this, you should provide evidence, as such statements shouldn’t be made lightly—it impacts our hospital’s reputation!"
Lin Fan said: "If you want evidence, it’s not hard. I will naturally prove it to you."
Zhou Nanhua said: "Mr. Lin’s words without evidence are unreliable. With so many authorities present, Mr. Lin, you might as well produce the evidence and let everyone judge whether we worsened your uncle’s condition!"
Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but say: "When Uncle first arrived, he didn’t need rescue, yet you claim you didn’t worsen him!"
Zhou Nanhua said: "Words mustn’t be spoken lightly. Your uncle indeed didn’t require rescue initially, but his condition was always worsening. We actually helped slow down the deterioration."
Lin Fan shook his head: "That’s not it."
Zhou Nanhua chuckled and said: "Mr. Lin, you keep saying we worsened him. I’m curious, given Mr. Lin’s extraordinary medical skill, why did you initially bring your uncle to us? I might use a conspiracy theory: was Mr. Lin waiting deliberately to trouble our hospital today?"
This question was a good one. It’s also the perplexing contradiction surrounding Lin Fan. Reasonably speaking, Lin Fan is so capable; he wouldn’t need to bring Lin Dawei to the hospital.
Fortunately, this question didn’t stump Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said: "It’s simple, because three months ago, I truly knew nothing about medical skills and had to seek help from the hospital. Self-study in medicine is something that happened later."
What?
Everyone was astonished; Lin Fan had learned such incredible medical skill in only three months?
Three months to acquire medical skills that lead the world—isn’t that talent heaven-defying!
Zhou Nanhua couldn’t help but feel a bit doubtful and said: "Mr. Lin, you keep saying your uncle’s worsening condition has another cause, so may I ask, what is that cause?"
Lin Fan said: "He was poisoned."
What?
Everyone was shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 542: Return to Hometown
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Chapter 542: Return to Hometown
"What? He was poisoned? What’s going on?" Zhou Nanhua exclaimed in shock.
Lin Fan said, "Dr. Guo Yu is my uncle’s attending physician, he should know best."
Instantly, everyone looked at Guo Yu.
Guo Yu hurriedly said, "I don’t know. I don’t think Mr. Lin was poisoned because I didn’t find any signs of poisoning. Otherwise, I couldn’t have hidden such a thing!"
Lin Fan said, "For the past three months, Dr. Guo Yu hasn’t found that someone has been poisoning my uncle. What does that indicate?"
Guo Yu flushed with embarrassment, "Mr. Lin, you don’t have to rush to condemn me. Whether or not he was poisoned isn’t certain yet! Right now, you’re the only one claiming he was poisoned!"
Lin Fan said, "If my uncle has been continuously poisoned, I believe with today’s medical standards, a blood test will yield results. Of course, if you trust me, you can listen to me, but if not, feel free to conduct the tests."
Guo Yu said, "Even if what you say is true, and Mr. Lin has indeed been poisoned all this time, what does that prove, Mr. Lin? What exactly are you trying to say?"
Lin Fan said, "There are only two possibilities then: either you’re not competent and haven’t discovered the cause of my uncle’s lack of recovery, meaning you’re not a responsible doctor. Or, you are the culprit!"
Ah?
Everyone’s expressions changed.
Dr. Guo Yu, the person poisoning Mr. Lin?
How is that possible!
"Don’t falsely accuse me!" Guo Yu exclaimed, agitated.
Zhou Nanhua said, "Mr. Lin, Dr. Guo Yu is a young talent that I personally mentored. I know him well, he couldn’t possibly do something so heinous!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Is that so? Anyway, I have no evidence."
Guo Yu angrily said, "Lin Fan, without evidence, don’t make wild accusations. You’re damaging my reputation, and I’ll sue you for defamation!"
Lin Fan said, "Do as you please. I now want to take my uncle out of the hospital. Whoever poisoned him, I’ll get to the bottom of it one day!"
After speaking, Lin Fan reached out to pick up Lin Dawei, turning to Lin Shanshan saying, "Let’s go."
Lin Shanshan nodded.
And so, under everyone’s gaze, Lin Fan turned and walked out.
Leaving behind the bewildered crowd.
"Lao Zhou, what Mr. Lin just said is very serious. If it’s true, the issue is extremely grave. How do you plan to handle it?" an authority figure asked.
Zhou Nanhua frowned, he knew well that the matter was no small issue!
Lin Dawei being poisoned in his hospital!
If this leaked out, it would be a massive blow to the hospital’s reputation!
"Collect a blood sample from Mr. Lin, I want to run the tests personally. I need to know if he was indeed poisoned," Zhou Nanhua said seriously.
"If the poisoning is confirmed, I won’t let it go easily. Whoever did such a heinous act will surely face the iron fist of the law!" Zhou Nanhua said.
At this moment, the people present didn’t know that Lin Fan’s words were about to trigger a huge storm in the hospital.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan placed Lin Dawei in the car, laying him in the back seat.
"Brother, where are we going now?" Lin Shanshan asked.
Lin Fan said, "Home."
Lin Shanshan thought Lin Fan meant returning to Yunding Manor, but an hour later, she was shocked to realize they had left Yun City!
"Brother, which home do you mean by going home?" Lin Shanshan asked excitedly.
Lin Fan smiled, "There is only one place that can be called home. When I say going home, I mean the home where we grew up."
"Third Uncle has been away for three months. He’ll be pleasantly surprised to wake up and find himself back home. Big cities, although nice and VIP suites luxurious, are nowhere near as comfortable as home."
Lin Fan didn’t understand medical skill before and wasn’t aware that Lin Dawei was being targeted.
He really didn’t want Lin Dawei to remain in Yun City any longer.
The real reason for going home was to take Lin Dawei away. In his heart, he felt guilty, knowing that the person behind targeting Lin Dawei was actually after him.
He couldn’t allow his family to be further harmed because of him.
Lin Shanshan was thrilled to know they were heading back to their old home, "Great, brother! I miss home too; miss mom and dad so much."
Lin Fan laughed, "You’ll see them very soon."
West River Village.
A remote small mountain village.
The economy here is underdeveloped, and young people are unwilling to stay because of the poverty, many choosing to work outside. However, few who leave return successfully enough to make a name, and those who manage to build a small house are considered lucky. If one could buy a small car, they would be the pride of the village.
"Brother, are we really driving the Rolls-Royce back to the village?" Lin Shanshan asked anxiously. Would it be too flashy?
Lin Fan said, "It is a bit over the top. I’ve arranged it this way: Third Uncle needs some IV fluids at the town hospital. How about I head home first, and you stay at the hospital with Third Uncle? Leave the Rolls-Royce parked at the hospital."
If Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce to the countryside, it might cause a stir throughout the area.
Lin Fan is a low-key person.
So, Lin Fan dropped Lin Dawei off at the town’s hospital for IV treatment, then took the rural bus back home.
After getting off the bus, there was still a bit of a walk, since the bus only passed by the village entrance.
Lin Fan knew a shortcut to get home quicker, so he took it, climbing over a hill.
As Lin Fan reached the foot of the hill, he suddenly heard a cry not far away—it was a woman’s voice.
Following the direction of the sound, Lin Fan saw a woman in sportswear who had fallen by the roadside. She was grabbing a branch in panic, defending herself from a snake in front of her, with bark similar color.
Bamboo Leaf Green!
This was a venomous snake. A bite could be troublesome.
Snakes, insects, rats, and bugs—all common in the mountains—were no surprise to Lin Fan, who grew up in the mountain village, but the sight of this woman intrigued him.
In this remote countryside, how was there a beautiful woman in sportswear?
This beauty was likely about 20 years old, with an oval face, stunningly pretty, and a body that was perfect, curvy in all the right places. Especially in sportswear, her figure was accentuated. Having just finished a run, she was glistening with sweat, making her face flush red—extremely alluring.
A solid 9 out of 10 beauty!
"Hello, please help me!"
The woman saw Lin Fan and, as if grabbing at a lifeline, urgently called out for his help.
She was clearly terrified.
Dealing with this snake was not a problem for Lin Fan. He bent down, picked up a pebble, and flicked it. With a whoosh, it hit the Bamboo Leaf Green right at its weak point.
The Bamboo Leaf Green struggled wildly for a moment, then lay still.
Lin Fan walked over, grabbed the snake’s tail, and tossed the dead snake into the nearby bushes.
The woman was stunned. This young man was impressive; he’d dealt with the snake in a couple of moves, accurate and swift, like a martial artist. She’d seen many martial artists before, Lin Fan was no less than them.

chapters.title: Chapter 543: The Beautiful Woman on the Village Road
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Chapter 543: The Beautiful Woman on the Village Road
The snake was killed by Lin Fan, and the beautiful woman’s tense nerves relaxed. She was really scared just now; she’s most afraid of snakes in her life.
"Are you alright? Did the snake bite you?" Lin Fan asked with concern, reaching out his hand to the beautiful woman.
"I wasn’t bitten, luckily you arrived in time, thank you." The beautiful woman took Lin Fan’s hand, intending to stand up.
As she just stood up and hadn’t steadied herself, she let out an "Ah!" and almost fell again.
Lin Fan reacted quickly, reached out, wrapped his arms around the woman’s waist, and steadied her.
Tsk tsk, Lin Fan was secretly pleased. Being this close, he could smell her body fragrance, a faint young lady’s scent, which was quite pleasant. Lin Fan’s heart itched; he really wanted to hold her like this and not let go.
"My foot hurts,"
The beautiful woman said with a frown, not minding Lin Fan holding her waist.
Lin Fan said, "Sit down, let me take a look."
Saying this, Lin Fan helped the beautiful woman to a stone by the roadside and asked, "Which foot hurts?"
"The right foot." The beautiful woman said, with her hand on Lin Fan’s shoulder, sitting down on the stone.
She was wearing white sneakers, and her white tender ankle was exposed. Lin Fan glanced and saw her right ankle was already somewhat red and swollen.
"It must have been sprained when you fell just now. It needs to be treated quickly," Lin Fan said, reaching to take off her shoe.
"No..."
The woman instinctively refused. It was embarrassing to have a stranger man take off her shoe.
But before she finished speaking, Lin Fan had quickly taken off her shoe, instantly revealing her pink and tender foot. At a glance, her delicate skin and tender flesh showed she had never done farm work; she was a city girl.
Lin Fan held her foot with one hand, gently pressing the ankle with the other, and observed.
"The ankle joint is slightly dislocated, but it’s not serious, just a minor injury. I’ll massage it, and it’ll be fine,"
Lin Fan said, applying a little force and started massaging.
It felt so comfortable; the woman almost hummed in pleasure. She quickly bit her lip to hold back, and her face flushed.
At first, it hurt a bit, but soon the woman didn’t feel pain, just comfort.
Seeing Lin Fan’s skilled hands, the woman momentarily forgot her shyness and asked, "Do you know medical skills?"
Lin Fan said, "I know a little, just a bit."
The woman made a surprised sound, a bit unexpected. The only doctor in West River Village was Doctor Liu, wasn’t he an old man?
"What’s your relation to Doctor Liu?" the woman asked.
Lin Fan looked up and smiled at her, "Old Liu, when I caught a cold or had a fever as a child, he was always the one treating me. Does that count as a relationship?"
Lin Fan implied there was no real relation with Old Liu.
The woman giggled, "And you know medical skills? Are you studying medicine?"
Lin Fan said, "Not officially, just self-taught a bit. I haven’t seen you here before; have you just married into our village? Whose wife are you?"
This wife is truly a water spirit, I wonder which guy in the village is so lucky, it makes one envious, doesn’t it? Who wouldn’t want a wife like this!
The woman blushed and quickly explained, "I’m not; I’m a teacher here at the village school, have been here for almost a semester."
"A teacher?"
Lin Fan felt relieved, so she wasn’t just someone’s wife. That’s good, coming to teach in this mountain village means she’s likely single, Lin Fan was inexplicably happy.
"My name is Wei Yue’er. Yours?" the woman said.
Lin Fan replied, "Lin Fan."
The woman smiled and said, "It’s a nice name, simple, yet not ordinary."
Looking at her smile, Lin Fan’s heart almost melted. That smile was too beautiful, like a spring breeze or a crescent moon.
"Your name is beautiful, Wei Yue’er; in the future, can I call you Teacher Wei?" Lin Fan smiled.
Wei Yue’er said, "You’re not my student, just call me Xiaoyue, all my friends do."
"Hmm." Lin Fan was happy in his heart, it seemed Wei Yue’er considered him a friend.
A while passed.
"Done."
Lin Fan said, stopping, and let go of Wei Yue’er, feeling reluctant, those long legs, the skin was so smooth, could play all day.
Wei Yue’er tried to stand and move a little, finding her ankle didn’t hurt at all.
Wei Yue’er was very happy, "Thank you, Lin Fan, you’re amazing. If not for you today, I wouldn’t have known what to do."
She was genuinely grateful to Lin Fan; earlier, she was almost scared to death by that Bamboo Leaf Green snake. Luckily, Lin Fan passed by and saved her, even treated her ankle.
Lin Fan said, "Do you often come here to run?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Not really, I just had a free morning today, so I came out for some activity, never expected to encounter a snake."
Lin Fan said, "This mountain trail isn’t frequented by people, so there’re often snakes and bugs. Just be careful in the future. By the way, try to avoid intense exercise for the next month; it’s too easy to get injured again."
Wei Yue’er nodded, "Yes, I’ll never dare run this road again."
Lin Fan said, "In any case, avoid intense exercise for now, like with a boyfriend or something."
Wei Yue’er understood Lin Fan’s meaning; her face blushed, and she softly said, "I don’t have a boyfriend."
Lin Fan’s heart soared, she really was single!
"Let’s go, I’ll take you back to school first," Lin Fan smiled.
Wei Yue’er said, "I don’t live at the school. I’m renting a place at a village home for now; you must have work, so no need to accompany me. I can go back by myself."
Lin Fan couldn’t bear to part with her so quickly and said, "No problem, I’m heading back to the village too. We can go together."
Since it was on the way, Wei Yue’er did not decline and walked alongside Lin Fan towards the village.
As they walked and talked, Lin Fan learned that Wei Yue’er indeed came from the city, though she didn’t specify which one or the reason for coming to this remote village to teach, she kept vague.
Soon, they reached the village, and Wei Yue’er pointed to a courtyard ahead, "I live there."
Lin Fan laughed upon seeing it, "That’s Dog No.2’s home, isn’t it?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Yes, his family had a spare room available, so I rented it. Are you familiar with Dog No.2?"
Lin Fan said, "Very familiar, we grew up playing together. I didn’t expect you’d live at his house; let’s go in and say hi."
What Lin Fan said was true, Dog No.2 lost his father young, living with his widow mother, He Chunyu. Though he wasn’t very bright, Lin Fan was one of the few who played with him. They’ve been good friends since childhood, and Lin Fan was planning to visit Dog No.2 after work today anyway.
Wei Yue’er said, "Dog No.2 and Aunt Chunyu went to the fields early; they’re probably not at home. Why don’t we go find them? They’ll be happy to know you’re back."
Wei Yue’er now understood that Lin Fan had just returned from working away.
"Okay," Lin Fan agreed, wanting to spend more time with Wei Yue’er.
So the two of them walked through the village, preparing to find Dog No.2 and Aunt Chunyu.
As they passed the village clinic, they suddenly found it bustling with activity.
A group of villagers was gathered at the clinic’s entrance, forming a dense crowd, with noisy chatter and bloodstains on the ground. Something seemed to have happened?

chapters.title: Chapter 544: The Villagers Were All Shocked
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Chapter 544: The Villagers Were All Shocked
A large group of villagers had gathered at the clinic’s entrance, standing on tiptoes, trying hard to peer inside.
From inside the clinic came the piercing cries of a woman.
Inside the clinic, there was only a girl, drenched in sweat, frantically trying to stop the bleeding of a man. The man’s abdomen had been stabbed, and the blood wouldn’t stop flowing.
The woman was the daughter of Old Liu, the clinic owner, named Liu Zixing, now a trainee nurse.
Liu Zixing had a round face, belonging to the lively and cute type.
Lin Fan felt it had been years since he last saw Liu Zixing. They were playmates when they were kids, but as they grew older, they each left the village to study, and meetings became less frequent. Now, Liu Zixing had blossomed into a remarkably graceful woman, a sight for sore eyes.
Beside Liu Zixing, a woman lay collapsed on the ground, crying hysterically.
The woman’s name was Zhao Xiue. Today, she had an argument with her husband, Chen Huzi, at home. The argument escalated into a fight, and in a moment of rashness, Zhao Xiue stabbed Chen Huzi with a knife. She was terrified and quickly helped Chen Huzi to the clinic.
Chen Huzi was barely alive, having lost so much blood that he was in a state of shock, his face white as paper.
Liu Zixing was the first to help stop the bleeding. She was a trainee nurse and had never seen such a scene, obviously a bit flustered, with her nurse uniform already soaked in blood.
"Where’s Doctor Liu? Why isn’t Doctor Liu here yet? My Huzi can’t die, he just can’t die. I don’t want to be a widow. Please get Doctor Liu to save him!"
Zhao Xiue cried out frantically.
Liu Zixing, exasperated by her cries, tried to comfort her, "Auntie, please calm down. My dad went out on a call early, he can’t come back quickly. Who expected something like this to happen!"
She was nearly driven to despair.
The villagers watching were also talking among themselves, puzzled. Doctor Liu was always at the clinic early without fail, rain or shine, so why hadn’t he arrived today?
"What’s going on, why is everyone gathered here? Make way, let me get through!"
At this moment, Lin Fan arrived at the door, parting the crowd, and squeezed into the clinic.
Seeing Chen Huzi on the hospital bed, Lin Fan was taken aback. Wasn’t this Uncle Hu? How did he get hurt so badly?
Liu Zixing caught sight of Lin Fan and was momentarily stunned, failing to recognize him immediately.
"Isn’t this Little Fan? When did you come back?"
The villagers started to talk.
Zhao Xiue mistakenly thought Old Liu had returned. Seeing it was Lin Fan, she cried, "Why hasn’t Doctor Liu returned yet?"
Lin Fan said, "Uncle Hu isn’t dead yet, it’s okay, I can save him."
With that, Lin Fan approached the hospital bed.
The villagers exchanged glances, puzzled by Lin Fan’s claim that he could save Chen Huzi.
Zhao Xiue exclaimed in shock, "Lin Fan, don’t talk nonsense!"
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m not talking nonsense, I taught myself medical skills, there shouldn’t be a problem."
"What?"
Zhao Xiue’s expression changed, "You self-taught in medicine, do you even hear what you’re saying? Can you truly save my husband?"
The villagers also expressed their doubts.
"Without Doctor Liu, how can some inexperienced kid who hasn’t studied medicine manage anything? He’s barely grown up!"
"Poor Huzi, stabbed by his own wife, and now without Doctor Liu, God must not want him to live!"
"Stop dawdling, find a car and get him to town, maybe there’s still time!"
The villagers chimed in.
Zhao Xiue’s lack of confidence in Lin Fan grew, and she shouted, "Lin Fan, don’t make a move, they are right, I’ll just take him to the town hospital."
She turned to the villagers, pleading, "Does anyone have a car to take us?"
An old man said, "My son is home today, he could use the tractor to take you to town."
Zhao Xiue was delighted, "Great, that’s settled then!"
Lin Fan said at this point, "Aunt Xiue, are you sure you don’t want me to save Uncle Hu?"
Zhao Xiue replied, "No, no, I don’t trust you!"
Lin Fan said, "Uncle Hu’s condition is critical, if we don’t act now, it’ll be too late. It’s already a stretch to get him to the village exit."
Zhao Xiue’s face changed, "What are you saying, stop scaring me!"
Suddenly, Liu Zixing urgently said, "It’s bad, the patient’s heart has stopped, we must perform surgery immediately, or it’ll be too late!"
Zhao Xiue turned to see Chen Huzi’s eyes rolling back and was scared out of her wits.
Lin Fan calmly said, "Aunt Xiue, Uncle Hu is dying. Should I step in? It’s your decision."
Zhao Xiue, in desperation, gritted her teeth and stomped her foot, nodding. At this point, she had no choice but to trust him as a last resort.
Lin Fan then said loudly, "Everyone, please leave, Zi Xin, close the door!"
At that moment, Lin Fan’s voice turned somewhat indifferent, brooking no opposition, as if he had become a different person.
Saying this, Lin Fan placed his finger on Chen Huzi’s body, his movements swift as the wind...
Liu Zixing was momentarily stunned, partly because she heard Lin Fan call her Zi Xin, the way he called her gave her a special feeling.
She quickly came to her senses. Now they could only try anything, so she led Zhao Xiue and the others out of the clinic and closed the door.
When she turned back, she saw Lin Fan had already placed Chen Huzi on the operating table and began performing surgery.
While at school, Liu Zixing had seen doctors performing surgeries, but Lin Fan’s technique was somewhat different. Liu Zixing was certain this wasn’t the medical skill she was familiar with!
Liu Zixing couldn’t help but be startled.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan had skillfully cut open Chen Huzi’s abdomen and was focused on treating him...
Outside the clinic.
Zhao Xiue was as anxious as an ant on a hot pan, pacing back and forth. Though she agreed to let Lin Fan treat him, it was more out of desperation. She still didn’t trust Lin Fan, and who could blame her? Who would trust someone who isn’t a doctor?
The villagers were also discussing it.
"It’s over, Huzi’s done for sure."
"Doctor Liu sure picked a bad time to leave. If he were here, Huzi would surely be saved. Now..."
"I’ve never heard of Lin Fan studying medicine!"
Everyone thought Chen Huzi was likely a goner. In his situation, a young guy like Lin Fan certainly couldn’t handle it.
Moreover, there was no word of Lin Fan studying medicine. If he didn’t study medicine, then he couldn’t possibly have the skills, and without skills, how could he save lives!
Time slowly ticked by.
An hour later.
The clinic door suddenly opened, and Liu Zixing emerged, her expression somewhat complex.
"Girl, how is my husband?" Zhao Xiue hurried up, tightly grabbing Liu Zixing’s hand. Before Liu Zixing could answer, she started crying, "He’s dead, right?"
The villagers all looked over, just like Zhao Xiue, thinking Chen Huzi must be dead.
Liu Zixing said, "The patient didn’t die, he’s already awake. Lin Fan is chatting with him. Aunt, you should go in and see."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Chen Huzi wasn’t dead!
He even woke up and was chatting with Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 545 World-Class Pharmaceutical Companies Cannot Replicate
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Chapter 545 World-Class Pharmaceutical Companies Cannot Replicate
Zhao Xiue was extremely excited and immediately rushed into the clinic.
Seeing everyone’s reaction, Liu Zixing’s mood was actually the same as theirs, and she was even more shocked. She was the only one who had witnessed the entire process of the rescue. The surgical operation performed by Lin Fan was something she had never seen or heard of before.
Chen Huzi had severe blood loss and originally needed a blood transfusion, but Lin Fan did not give him one.
There was no choice, as this was a small mountain village, where there were no conditions for transfusion.
However, Lin Fan rummaged through Old Liu’s medicine cabinet and unexpectedly concocted an ointment on the spot. After stitching up the wound, he instructed Liu Zixing to apply the strange ointment on Chen Huzi’s wound and bandage it.
Curiously, Liu Zixing asked, "What is this stuff?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s an ointment for external injuries that can speed up the healing of wounds."
With top-notch medical skill, creating such an ointment was a trivial task for Lin Fan. However, in this world, such a miraculous ointment could be considered priceless.
Later, this type of ointment was accidentally leaked and acquired by a world-leading pharmaceutical company. The company’s top pharmaceutical experts exclaimed that it was miraculous, and perceptively predicted that if this ointment could be mass-produced, it would definitely become a blockbuster product, bringing significant economic benefits to the company.
But they exhausted all possibilities, spent countless money, hired numerous top experts, and purchased the most advanced equipment, yet could not replicate this ointment.
It’s as if, without knowing the formula, no one can replicate Coca-Cola.
And for Lin Fan, it was just something he could make casually, even in this rudimentary village clinic, the cost would not exceed 100 yuan and no advanced equipment was needed.
After creating this trauma ointment, Lin Fan then fiddled a bit more and made a pitch-black pill, which he fed to Chen Huzi.
Liu Zixing, curious again, asked, "What is this?"
Lin Fan casually said, "It’s for replenishing blood."
Liu Zixing was stunned. It meant that Lin Fan did not give Chen Huzi a blood transfusion, but used this pill instead, to replace the transfusion. Is this really reliable!
Liu Zixing held a skeptical attitude, after all, in her impression, Lin Fan was nothing like a doctor. Lin Fan was just an ordinary college student.
Next, Lin Fan gave Chen Huzi a massage.
And then Chen Huzi miraculously woke up.
Suddenly, Liu Zixing was bewildered and couldn’t understand Lin Fan’s actions, only describing it as miraculous. He just woke up like that?
The pill Lin Fan gave to Chen Huzi actually worked. How did he do it? It was too miraculous. Lin Fan, who appeared to nonchalantly concoct a blood-replenishing pill, was even more effective than a blood transfusion!
Faced with the facts, Liu Zixing had no choice but to believe, even if she didn’t dare to.
Lin Fan made this blood-replenishing pill entirely because of the lack of blood transfusion conditions, for emergency use only. This blood-replenishing pill had an effect similar to blood transfusion.
Upon hearing that Chen Huzi woke up, the villagers were already abuzz.
"He actually woke up. We were all wrong. Lin Fan’s medical skill is so amazing!"
"Isn’t it? What on earth is going on here?"
"Lin Fan is actually a little miracle doctor. When did he learn medical skills?"
"I remember he didn’t go to medical school, right?"
The villagers were all puzzled.
"So amazing!"
Wei Yue’er murmured to herself. She knew very well that with the meager medical conditions in this village, Lin Fan could actually save Chen Huzi. It was indeed a miracle.
Chen Huzi, who was almost done for, was saved by Lin Fan just like that.
At this time, even though Chen Huzi was still very weak, he had already woken up and was chatting with Lin Fan, explaining everything to him.
It turned out that in the morning, Zhao Xiue questioned Chen Huzi about not touching her for several months. Having heard that someone saw Chen Huzi going to Widow Li’s house, she suspected Chen Huzi of having an affair with Widow Li, leading to a fight and stabbing Chen Huzi in a fit of rage.
"She said I hadn’t touched her for months, but can you really blame me? She’s two years younger than Widow Li, yet looks like Widow Li’s mom!" Chen Huzi said with a bitter smile.
Lin Fan knew Widow Li; she was a well-known woman in the village because Widow Li was indeed very beautiful.
Speaking of Widow Li, Lin Fan and Widow Li had a special incident.
This happened several years ago. One evening, Lin Fan was passing by the riverbank and accidentally saw Widow Li bathing in the river. At that time, Widow Li had just lost her husband, still very young. In the moonlight, her voluptuous body seemed bathed in holy light, a scene Lin Fan still found unforgettable to this day...
Lin Fan asked, "So, did you actually do anything with Widow Li?"
Chen Huzi became agitated, "No, I swear on my three fingers. I just helped Widow Li carry a bag of rice home. Absolutely nothing happened. Even if I had such thoughts, Widow Li wouldn’t be interested in me!"
Lin Fan found it amusing and asked Liu Zixing to bring Zhao Xiue in.
Zhao Xiue quickly walked in, and seeing Chen Huzi awake, burst into tears.
"Hu Zi, I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have stabbed you with a knife," Zhao Xiue knelt at the bedside, deeply regretting.
Chen Huzi bitterly smiled, "You’ve really wronged me. We’ve been married all our lives, and our daughter is already in college. How could I ever do such a thing?"
Chen Huzi and Zhao Xiue’s daughter, Chen Qiqi, is eighteen this year. Not only is she beautiful, but she’s also a top student, one of the few college students from West River Village, reportedly attending a key university in Jiangnan.
Zhao Xiue lowered her head, feeling very ashamed.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s good that the misunderstanding has been cleared up, Aunt Xiue. Don’t be so impulsive in the future. Fortunately, Uncle Hu was saved, otherwise you would have ended up in jail."
