Zhao Xiue nodded fearfully, looking at Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, I offended you earlier. I didn’t know your medical skill was so good. I looked down on you. I was just too worried about your Uncle Hu. Please don’t take it to heart."
Upon reflection, she was really afraid of offending Lin Fan. If Lin Fan had been upset and refused to help, her husband would have surely died.
Lin Fan nonchalantly waved his hand, "This is nothing. By the way, winter vacation is coming. Is Qiqi coming back soon?"
When Lin Fan was younger, he played with Chen Qiqi, and he had a good impression of her. However, Chen Qiqi was a top student and didn’t feel anything for Lin Fan. After finishing elementary school, Chen Qiqi went to study in town, and gradually grew distant from Lin Fan.
Zhao Xiue said, "Qiqi said she might have to find a job during the winter break and may not come back."
"Alright," Lin Fan said.
After lying in bed for a while, Chen Huzi was able to get up and leave the small clinic with Zhao Xiue’s help. Lin Fan gave them some external ointment and instructed them to change the dressing morning and evening. Chen Huzi would soon recover. The couple expressed their gratitude and left.
Outside the clinic, the villagers, seeing that there was no more excitement to watch, gradually dispersed.
Watching Chen Huzi’s back, Liu Zixing was astonished, "Lin Fan, how can he walk so soon? That’s just too..."

chapters.title: Chapter 546: Genius Doctor
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Chapter 546: Genius Doctor
Lin Fan smiled and said, "This is considered slow. The herbs in the store are quite ordinary. If there were better herbs to refine into medicine, he would recover faster."
Liu Zixing clicked her tongue, "Lin Fan, where did you learn your medical skills? I can only say, it’s amazing!"
Lin Fan said, "I taught myself. I’m interested in medicine, so I read medical books whenever I have time."
Liu Zixing was stunned. Self-taught? Can you learn such excellent medical skills on your own? When Liu Zixing was in school, she met many talented classmates who she admired and even idolized, but now it seems, compared to Lin Fan, they are nothing at all!
What is a genius? Lin Fan is exactly what you would call a genius!
Never expected, a genius doctor was born in such a backward rural village, someone she’s known since childhood. Why didn’t she realize Lin Fan was so amazing before?
Moreover...
The current Lin Fan is very handsome, that kind of rugged handsomeness, completely different from those effeminate young men. She happens to like this kind of handsome.
Thinking of this, Liu Zixing couldn’t help but blush.
"Lin Fan, my dad is out on a call today. Luckily, you were here to save Chen Huzi, otherwise I don’t know what I would’ve done. How about this, I’ll treat you to lunch as a thank you." Liu Zixing said.
Lin Fan said, "No need to be polite. I just happened to pass by, and it was a small effort."
"Lin Fan."
At this moment, Wei Yue’er came over.
Liu Zixing looked at Wei Yue’er, then back at Lin Fan, and suddenly had a thought. Could it be... are Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er a couple? Wasn’t Wei Yue’er single? When did she get together with Lin Fan?
For some reason, this thought made Liu Zixing feel a bit disappointed.
"Sorry to keep you waiting," Lin Fan apologized. Originally, he planned to go with Wei Yue’er to find Dog No.2 and Aunt Chunyu, but because he was saving someone, he left Wei Yue’er waiting.
Wei Yue’er smiled and said, "It’s okay; saving people is more important. Lin Fan, I knew you were good at medicine, but not this good. It’s incredible."
Lin Fan said, "You’re too kind."
Wei Yue’er said, "Not at all, I’m not exaggerating. I’m not afraid to tell you that I know many skilled doctors, but they don’t compare to you."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "There’s always someone better. It’s good to stay humble."
Wei Yue’er giggled. She originally had a pretty good impression of Lin Fan, and now it’s even better. Lin Fan is so skilled and yet so humble; young people like him are rare.
"Let’s go find Dog No.2," Lin Fan said.
Wei Yue’er said, "I was just about to tell you, I just got a call, there’s something at school I need to handle, so I have to head back to school."
Lin Fan acknowledged, "Okay."
"Then that’s that, goodbye. Zi Xin, goodbye." Wei Yue’er waved with a smile and left.
Liu Zixing said, "Okay, goodbye Sister Yue’er."
Wei Yue’er was a volunteer teacher in this small village, and everyone knew her. Wei Yue’er and Liu Zixing were about the same age, and they had a good relationship.
"Lin Fan, how do you know Sister Yue’er?" Liu Zixing asked.
Lin Fan said, "We just met today. I was on my way home and ran into her. She was attacked by a snake, so I stepped in to help."
Liu Zixing said, "Just like that?"
Lin Fan said, "What did you think it was like?"
Liu Zixing didn’t speak, yet felt inexplicably happy inside.
"Now that Sister Yue’er isn’t here, you can have lunch with me, right?" Liu Zixing said.
Lin Fan was also hungry and said, "What to eat?"
Liu Zixing blushed, "In this small village, there aren’t any restaurants, and I don’t have time to cook. I’ll go to the convenience store to buy something. Lin Fan, could you help me look after the store?"
Lin Fan laughed, "I should go. I haven’t been back to the village for a long time. I can take a walk. What would you like to eat?"
Liu Zixing said, "Just get me a cup of instant noodles."
So, Lin Fan left the clinic and went to the convenience store.
Soon, Lin Fan came back with a bag of food. The conditions in this small village are simple, and there’s nothing particularly fancy. Instant noodles are already considered a luxury.
While Liu Zixing was at the clinic, Chen Huzi had lost a lot of blood earlier, leaving a mess, and she was just cleaning up.
As she was busy, a burly man came in from the door. This man was wearing loose half pants, a tank top revealing two sturdy arms, with slippers on his feet. His appearance was wretched, with a carefree attitude.
"Yo, what’s going on here?" the man said with a cheeky grin as he swaggered in and sat down.
Liu Zixing frowned at the sight of this person, and her expression immediately turned sour.
"What are you here for?" Liu Zixing asked coldly.
The man laughed and said, "Look at your question. This is a clinic, so of course, I’m here to see a doctor. I’m feeling unwell; could you check my health?"
His eyes gleamed, his smile full of lecherous intent.
He was clearly not here for a check-up, but to take advantage.
Liu Zixing was very disgusted and said with a cold face, "The doctor isn’t here. You should leave!"
The man laughed in a sleazy manner, "But you’re here; you can check me out."
Liu Zixing said, "I told you yesterday, don’t you remember? I’m a nurse; I can’t do checkups. If you have issues, go to the town hospital!"
Liu Zixing was angry; this guy was here yesterday too. Her dad, Old Liu, had gone out on a call, leaving her to do some simple work to handle cases like colds among villagers.
Yesterday, this man came to see a doctor for a cold. Liu Zixing gave him some cold medicine, and that should have been it.
But this man’s intentions shifted when he saw that Old Liu wasn’t there, and the clinic only had Liu Zixing. He tried to take advantage by claiming he felt unwell and asking Liu Zixing to examine him.
Thankfully, there were other villagers at the clinic at the time, so he didn’t dare go too far. Liu Zixing, using the excuse of being a nurse who couldn’t do checkups, managed to send him away. Later, worried he might return to harass, she closed up early.
Unexpectedly, here he was again today!
The man laughed, "I remember, but the town hospital is too far. I don’t plan on going. It’s more convenient to come here. Even if you are a nurse, you know some medical skills, right? Just help me check."
Liu Zixing was very disgusted inside; this guy was clearly harassing her.
"First of all, I really can’t do checkups. Secondly, you look pretty energetic, not like you’re sick, so no need to check. Go back!" Liu Zixing said, holding back her anger as her patience was wearing thin.
The man laughed, "Don’t look at me like I’m energetic. I’m really not feeling well, especially in one spot. It’s really uncomfortable. If I show you, you’ll understand."
Saying this, he reached for his zipper.
Liu Zixing was shocked, "Stop right there! Get out right now, or I’ll call the police!"
She was furious, her face turning bright red, simultaneously angry and alarmed. This guy was going too far.
The man laughed heartily, "Call the police? We’re dozens of miles away from the county on mountain roads. The cops wouldn’t even bother coming. Besides, I haven’t done anything wrong. I’m just uncomfortable, and I’m asking you to check it out. You’re overreacting. Missy, maybe you don’t know who I am?"
"I don’t care who you are. Just get out of here!" Liu Zixing shouted. She’s never been afraid of anyone, always ready to scold those who deserve it.
The man, seeing her reaction, got a bit annoyed, sneering, "Didn’t expect you to be such a feisty little tigress. Let me tell you, my name is Wang Goudan. Everyone in West River Village knows me. I’m the village tyrant; even the village chief doesn’t dare cross me. You’re just a little girl; how dare you go against me!"
Liu Zixing snorted, "Being the village tyrant is such a big deal? Here you are acting like a hooligan in broad daylight. If you don’t leave, I’ll call the police right now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 547 You’re Going to Die Soon
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Chapter 547 You’re Going to Die Soon
Liu Zixing had already picked up the phone, ready to call the police.
She was actually quite scared and just hoped to frighten Wang Goudan away.
Wang Goudan, with utter arrogance, said: "Go ahead, I’d like to see if the police will come!"
This place is too far from the county seat. If there’s no trouble, the police won’t bother to come, let alone for Wang Goudan just being ill and asking Liu Zixing for help with an examination. The police wouldn’t care about such things.
Liu Zixing also knew that distant water can’t quench immediate thirst. Even if the police were willing to come, by the time they arrived, Wang Goudan would have already finished acting up and run off.
"Heh heh," Wang Goudan sneered, "I think you should just obediently help me check my body; I can’t take it much longer."
Lin Fan came in from outside, carrying a bag of food.
Wang Goudan was being a hooligan, demanding Liu Zixing check his body. Even though Liu Zixing threatened to call the police, Wang Goudan wasn’t scared at all.
Not to mention that the police might not come, even if they did, Wang Goudan would have finished his mischief by the time they arrived along this mountain road.
Wang Goudan was clearly taking advantage and Liu Zixing had no way to stop him.
At this time, Wang Goudan chuckled, "Little girl, just be good and help me with the examination. Once it’s done, I’ll naturally leave."
As he spoke, Wang Goudan started to take off his pants.
Lin Fan couldn’t bear it any longer. Wang Goudan was blatantly harassing Liu Zixing! This was intolerable.
He knew Wang Goudan, a notorious bully from West River Village, who had committed countless bad deeds, and most people dared not provoke him. Wang Goudan had mixed in the city and had even reportedly been imprisoned. After being released, he returned to West River Village and became even worse, frequently engaged in petty thefts and causing the villagers headaches.
Lin Fan had never really had any dealings with Wang Goudan, as he was busy with his studies, and had only heard about Wang Goudan’s deeds.
Unexpectedly, Wang Goudan had run into him today.
"You want an examination? I’ll examine you!" Lin Fan suddenly spoke.
This startled Wang Goudan. He hadn’t expected anyone else in the clinic and thought only Liu Zixing was there, which is why he was so brazen.
"You, you..." Wang Goudan scrutinized Lin Fan, finally recognizing him, "Aren’t you Old Lin’s son? What are you doing here?"
Liu Zixing felt a bit relieved upon seeing Lin Fan come out. Otherwise, if Wang Goudan really took off his pants, it would be too terrifying. She couldn’t imagine that scene.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m the doctor here now."
Wang Goudan was incredulous, "You’re a doctor? Since when are you the doctor here? I haven’t heard about this."
Lin Fan responded, "I’m new here, can’t I be? Anyway, I’m the doctor, and she’s the nurse. She can’t examine you. I’ll help you. What’s bothering you?"
There was nothing wrong with Wang Goudan; he was just making trouble. With Lin Fan here, he couldn’t stir up any mischief.
"Haha, it’s nothing now. I suddenly feel better," Wang Goudan said, irritated that Lin Fan had come, wishing he hadn’t.
After speaking, Wang Goudan turned to leave.
Lin Fan said, "Don’t rush off. I think you really are sick!"
Wang Goudan paused and asked, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan leisurely went to the desk and sat down, asking, "Have you recently been feeling backache and leg weakness, insomnia, and frequent dreams at night, often sweating at night, dry mouth, and more frequent trips to the bathroom?"
Wang Goudan was stunned; Lin Fan’s words hit the mark!
He didn’t leave but turned around and sat down opposite Lin Fan, asking, "How do you know this? What’s wrong with me?"
Lin Fan calmly said, "According to traditional Chinese medicine, I can diagnose your condition by observing your complexion. Your situation is very serious; you’re dying."
"What?" Wang Goudan was shocked, his face changed color, and his voice trembled, "Don’t lie to me; what exactly is wrong with me?"
Lin Fan said, "You’re poisoned. Have you come into contact with anything strange or been anywhere unusual lately?"
Wang Goudan thought of something and exclaimed, "Could it be because of that! I’ve been short on cash recently and dug up a grave, touching the coffin..."
Lin Fan slapped the table and said, "That’s it. Grave robbing is too extreme. They probably put poison in the coffin prepared for grave robbers like you. You were poisoned the moment you opened it."
As Lin Fan spoke, he turned to Liu Zixing and mischievously winked at her.
Liu Zixing initially believed Lin Fan’s serious tone but understood he was fooling Wang Goudan when he winked at her.
Liu Zixing nearly burst out laughing. Lin Fan was so bad, but she liked it.
Lin Fan was indeed fooling Wang Goudan. Wang Goudan was truly sick, but it wasn’t poisoning, just kidney deficiency.
Wang Goudan was scared pale and asked, "What should I do? Can I be saved?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Yes, I can save you, and I can assure you that I’m the only one in this world who can. But..."
Lin Fan deliberately paused.
Wang Goudan immediately asked, "But what?"
Lin Fan said, "The herbs needed to detoxify are very precious and not cheap!"
"How much will it cost?" Wang Goudan asked.
Lin Fan said, "I think it’ll cost you at least a thousand yuan. I’ve already given you a discount."
Wang Goudan’s face changed and he cursed, "Damn, that’s expensive! I don’t have that much money, but money isn’t the issue; saving my life is what matters most. Save me first!"
Lin Fan said, "That’s not possible. Our clinic is a business. Although we treat and save lives, we need to make a living. We can’t do a loss-making business. Even if I agreed, Old Liu wouldn’t. If you don’t have money, you might as well go back and wait for death."
Bang!
Wang Goudan got angry, slapped the table, jumped up, and pointed at Lin Fan saying, "Don’t fucking mention money; will you save me or not? Believe it or not, I’ll smash your crappy clinic!"
Lin Fan raised his head and sneered, "What’s the point of throwing a tantrum? There’s no negotiation without money."
Seeing Wang Goudan’s ferocious appearance, Liu Zixing got a bit scared. Although she knew Lin Fan was teasing Wang Goudan, if Wang Goudan actually started something, Lin Fan’s physique couldn’t withstand it!
"Lin Fan, forget it. Just give him the medicine and let him leave!" Liu Zixing urged.
Wang Goudan snorted, "She’s right. Kid, those who know the times are wise. Dare to go against me, Wang Goudan, in West River Village!"
Lin Fan replied nonchalantly, "The clinic has its rules; they can’t be broken. Otherwise, in the future, people won’t pay for treatment, and we’ll be starving!"
Seeing Lin Fan refusing to yield, Wang Goudan felt his reputation was being challenged.
"Brat, looks like you won’t cry until you see the coffin. I’ll beat you up, and then we’ll see how honest you get!"
Wang Goudan cursed, raised his fist, and swung it toward Lin Fan’s face.
"Ah!" Liu Zixing was shocked. Wang Goudan had really started it, and Lin Fan stood no chance!
However, the next second, Liu Zixing was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 548: Teasing the Village Bully
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Chapter 548: Teasing the Village Bully
Wang Goudan was also stunned.
He saw Lin Fan extend his hand and actually catch Wang Goudan’s fist, even using all his strength, Wang Goudan’s face turned red, but his fist couldn’t move forward an inch.
"Starting a fight in my clinic, you’re courting death." Lin Fan sneered and gave a push.
What seemed like a casual push, Wang Goudan felt like he was hit by a strong force, causing him to uncontrollably stumble back several steps, eventually losing his balance and falling on his butt.
Wang Goudan felt his blood and energy surging inside, his face turning pale.
Wang Goudan was shocked and realized he had hit a hard nail, a really hard one.
Liu Zixing also looked at Lin Fan in astonishment, Lin Fan was so powerful, he pushed over a burly man like Wang Goudan with one hand!
Lin Fan stood up and approached Wang Goudan.
Wang Goudan said in panic, "Don’t come over, I was wrong, I shouldn’t have made a move!"
"Screw you!"
Lin Fan already approached and kicked Wang Goudan in the chest. This kick used inner strength, and Wang Goudan flew backwards like a ball out the door.
With a thud, Wang Goudan fell outside like a dead dog, getting bruises and a nosebleed.
"Wang Goudan, from now on, if you dare step into this clinic again, or even look at her directly, I’ll beat you until you can’t take care of yourself, now scram!" Lin Fan threatened.
Liu Zixing was taken aback, he was fierce, so fierce, she could never have imagined that Lin Fan would be such a tough character, much tougher than this guy Wang Goudan.
Liu Zixing realized, overjoyed, great, it turns out Lin Fan was confident, not afraid of Wang Goudan at all, that’s why he dared to mess with Wang Goudan!
Wang Goudan was kicked by Lin Fan, fell all dizzy and painful all over, almost scared out of his wits, damn it, how is Lin Fan so powerful!
But he hadn’t forgotten he was poisoned, if Lin Fan didn’t save him, he would die!
Unable to beat Lin Fan, he had to kneel to him.
Wang Goudan got up from the ground and knelt in front of Lin Fan, kowtowing, "Lin Fan, no, Brother Fan, I was wrong, I didn’t recognize who I was dealing with, I offended you, Brother Fan, for the sake of being from the same village, please save me!"
Lin Fan said indifferently, "A doctor has a parent’s heart, it’s not that I won’t save you, but the price has changed, now it’s 3000 bucks."
"What?"
Wang Goudan’s face turned blue, damn it Lin Fan, you’re too ruthless, just now it was 1000 bucks, suddenly it increased by 2000, this is blatant extortion!
"Do you want to be saved or not, it’s up to you to decide!" Lin Fan said nonchalantly.
Wang Goudan quickly said, "Save, I must be saved! But I don’t have that much money, can I owe you first, I will definitely pay it back!"
Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, "Then owe it first, pay it off within a month, if not, you’ll die horribly!"
Wang Goudan was overjoyed, "I will, I will pay it off!"
Lin Fan then turned back to his desk, picked up a pen, quickly wrote a prescription, and handed it to Liu Zixing.
"Ahem, give him a week’s worth, twice a day, within a week, the poison can be detoxed." Lin Fan said, giving Liu Zixing a wink.
Liu Zixing took the prescription, and couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
The medicine Lin Fan prescribed was just ordinary laxatives, in a large dose. After taking it, Wang Goudan would have diarrhea for a week, nearly losing half his life.
Lin Fan was really something, she liked it, felt relieved, Wang Goudan was too detestable, he deserved a lesson!
Liu Zixing cheerfully went and prepared the medicine, soon grabbed it, and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan tossed the medicine out the door, at Wang Goudan’s feet, and said coldly, "Remember to pay the medicine fee within a month, now scram!"
"Hmm, I’ll scram!"
Wang Goudan grabbed the laxatives, climbed up, and limped away like clutching a treasure, he was badly hurt just now.
After Wang Goudan left, Liu Zixing couldn’t help but laugh heartily, shaking with laughter.
"Lin Fan, you’re awesome, not only taught that guy a lesson, but also extorted money from him!" Liu Zixing laughed.
This girl looks really good when she laughs.
"He dared to offend you, of course I wouldn’t let him off easily, don’t worry, I bet he won’t dare harass you again." Lin Fan smiled.
Liu Zixing gave a sound of agreement, "Lin Fan, how are you so skilled, you even know martial arts?"
Lin Fan casually said, "Just some self-defense skills."
"Lin Fan, thank you," Liu Zixing said sincerely, "if it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t know what to do."
She was still a bit scared, Wang Goudan being so big and strong, how could she handle it.
Lin Fan waved his hand, laughed, "It’s nothing, no need to thank me."
Liu Zixing’s goodwill toward Lin Fan soared, "Lin Fan, are you hungry, what did you buy just now?"
Lin Fan said, "There’s not much to buy at the village shop, just a few buckets of instant noodles."
Liu Zixing went to have a look and said, "Lin Fan, sit for a bit, I’ll go boil water, let’s have some noodles."
With that, Liu Zixing went to the clinic’s backyard to boil water.
Ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan heard a phone ringing from the counter next to him, Liu Zixing had left her phone behind.
Lin Fan walked over and picked up the phone, it was an unknown number calling. Lin Fan answered it.
"Xinxin, it’s me!"
As soon as it connected, a man’s voice came through, "Xinxin don’t hang up, listen to me, I’ve missed you like crazy, I really want to see you, please come back, we don’t even have to get married..."
Lin Fan frowned, "Who are you?"
The person on the other side just spouted a lot of mushy words, could this be Liu Zixing’s boyfriend? Lin Fan didn’t know Liu Zixing had a boyfriend, feeling curious.
The person on the phone was taken aback, exclaimed, "Who are you, where’s Xinxin?"
Lin Fan said, "She’s not here."
"Who are you, why are you answering her phone?" the voice on the other side questioned, with a hint of accusation.
Lin Fan chuckled, "She left her phone here."
The person said, "Alright, I’ll call back later, don’t tell her I called her..."
The call ended.
After a while, Liu Zixing came out with two cups of piping hot instant noodles.
"Lin Fan, eat while it’s hot," Liu Zixing said.
"Hmm." Lin Fan was a bit hungry too, took the noodles and started eating, "By the way, just now a guy called you, said he missed you a lot and wanted you back, is he your boyfriend?"
Liu Zixing’s face turned red all of a sudden, quickly explaining, "No, I don’t have a boyfriend, what call, it must have been a wrong number!"
Lin Fan just made a sound of acknowledgment and didn’t pursue it further, it wasn’t his business.
Liu Zixing quickly picked up the phone, checked the call log, and indeed there was a recent call from an unknown number.
"I’ve already come back to the deep mountains, and he still won’t leave me alone." Liu Zixing was a bit annoyed, no need to guess, it must be that Rich Second Generation calling, and Lin Fan happened to answer it.
Ring ring...
Suddenly, the phone rang, it was that unknown number calling back.
If Lin Fan hadn’t reminded her, Liu Zixing would have answered the call, but now knowing who it was, Liu Zixing avoided it, quickly hung up, and set her phone to reject all unknown calls and messages.
She had already escaped to the deep mountains, no need to keep in touch with the outside world.
That Rich Second Generation warned Lin Fan not to tell Liu Zixing about his call, fearing Liu Zixing would refuse to answer.
But Lin Fan didn’t agree to his request, and still told Liu Zixing.
By now, that Rich Second Generation probably hates Lin Fan.
Lin Fan watched from the side without asking more, though it wasn’t hard to guess, someone was probably pursuing Liu Zixing, she didn’t like him, it’s their private matter, Lin Fan didn’t care.
Just then, a woman came inside.
Lin Fan was eating noodles and nearly choked at the sight of the woman.
Widow Li had arrived!

chapters.title: Chapter 549: Widow Seeks Medical Treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Chapter 549: Widow Seeks Medical Treatment
The visitor was a mature lady in her thirties, with fair and smooth skin, a voluptuous figure, and especially a fierce development, with a round, clean white face, a pair of watery peach blossom eyes, and an affectionate look, always giving the impression of seducing men.
Widow Li, the most famous woman in West River Village!
In West River Village, no one didn’t know Widow Li. She was the object of many men’s fantasies in the village and also the existence that other women feared. The women were all afraid she would seduce their men.
For instance, the tragedy of Chen Huzi today was because Chen Huzi helped Widow Li move some rice, which made Zhao Xiue suspicious.
Truly a femme fatale.
It wasn’t their fault. Widow Li was indeed beautiful, with a pair of peach blossom eyes that seemed to speak love. Which man could resist? Moreover, she lived alone. Wouldn’t she be lonely? If she wanted a man, wouldn’t she start in the village?
It’s said that Widow Li was from the city and married a villager, Chen Sanshui, from West River Village ten years ago. It was a sensation in the village when Chen Sanshui brought back such a beautiful wife after working in the city. Everyone was envious.
But only three days after the wedding, Chen Sanshui suddenly died unexpectedly.
Chen Sanshui had no other relatives, so Widow Li buried him and inherited his house and land, settling down in West River Village.
By rights, Widow Li was young and beautiful then and could have remarried, but for some reason, she never left West River Village after Chen Sanshui’s death.
In the past decade, various rumors about Widow Li never stopped, with frequent claims that she was having affairs with village men. Although none were proven, the gossip made it seem like Widow Li had slept with all the men in West River Village.
Today, Zhao Xiue suspected Chen Huzi of having an affair with Widow Li, which led her to stab Chen Huzi in a fit of rage, nearly causing a fatal incident.
This is probably what they mean by femme fatale.
The women secretly hated Widow Li, and whenever they saw her, they didn’t give her good looks, some even rolling their eyes.
The men were the opposite, eager to strike up a conversation with Widow Li.
But Widow Li was very low-key, mostly staying at home and rarely walking around the village. Over time, everyone got used to it.
Lin Fan had a special feeling for Widow Li because he secretly watched her bathe years ago. That was when Lin Fan was still a student.
That time, Lin Fan was home for the holiday and it was already dark, with a full moon hanging in the sky. Passing by the river, he unexpectedly discovered a woman bathing by the river.
Lin Fan quickly hid in the reeds by the river and peeked.
He saw that the woman bathing was the most beautiful woman in the village, Widow Li.
Whenever Lin Fan saw her walking around the village, he couldn’t take his eyes off her. Widow Li’s allure was just that strong.
This encounter was really unexpected. Under the moonlight, Widow Li was naked, with half her body soaked in the river, exposing her upper body. Her fair and tender body seemed clad in holy light, showcasing her fragrant shoulders and wasp waist...
That was the first time Lin Fan saw a woman’s body. Since then, he couldn’t help but feel excited every time he saw Widow Li.
At this moment, Lin Fan couldn’t help but recall that night. Years had passed, and Widow Li hadn’t changed at all. She was still as fair and beautiful as ever. Many women in the village faded after thirty, but few maintained it like Widow Li.
"Is Doctor Liu not here?" Widow Li asked softly as she entered, her voice pleasant and giving a tingly feeling.
Liu Zixing replied, "My dad is out for a consultation. Sister-in-law, where do you feel unwell?"
Widow Li seemed a little embarrassed, "Well..."
Liu Zixing said, "It’s okay, just say it. Even though my dad’s not here, Lin Fan can help you. He’s even better than my dad."
Widow Li looked at Lin Fan with a smile, "So you’re the one people are talking about."
"Gossip?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Widow Li said, "On my way here, I heard people talking about how Uncle Huzi almost died at the clinic but was saved. And it wasn’t Doctor Liu who saved him. I wondered when there was someone with such great medical skill in the village."
Widow Li’s husband, Chen Sanshui, and Chen Huzi were uncle and nephew, so Widow Li also called Chen Huzi uncle.
Lin Fan gave a slight smile, "You’re too kind."
Widow Li said, "You’re Lin Fan, right? I remember you, but it’s been a long time. You’ve grown tall and handsome now."
As she spoke, Widow Li glanced at Lin Fan with smiling eyes.
Although he didn’t know whether she did it on purpose, Lin Fan felt a bit itchy from her gaze. This woman was truly something else; if she actively seduced men, who could resist?
Lin Fan chuckled, "Addressing health is important. Are you here for a consultation, sister-in-law? Where do you feel unwell?"
"Well, I’ve been feeling unwell lately. Could you take a look?" Widow Li said, sitting across from Lin Fan.
Even living in this small mountain village, Widow Li dressed like a city woman, accentuating her figure and exuding a mature, seductive vibe.
Lin Fan quickly sat down too, feeling he couldn’t look any longer, afraid he’d get a nosebleed. He was well-acquainted with Widow Li.
"Ahem," Lin Fan cleared his throat with a serious expression, "Where do you feel unwell, sister-in-law?"
"Well..." Widow Li hesitated, her cheeks turning slightly red, looking a bit embarrassed.
If it were Old Liu, she’d be fine. But in front of Lin Fan, a young and vigorous boy, who was junior to her...
Seeing her hesitate, Lin Fan reassured, "Sister-in-law, don’t worry. I’m a doctor. Just tell me what’s going on."
Hearing Lin Fan’s words, Widow Li relaxed a bit, focusing on him as a doctor, making it easier to speak up.
Widow Li said, "I think I might have a gynecological issue. Recently, I’ve been feeling very itchy, unable to sleep at night..."
Lin Fan paused, this was quite deep. No wonder Widow Li was a bit embarrassed. Itchy? Could the rumors be true, that Widow Li contracted a disease from an affair?
"Ahem," Lin Fan cleared his throat, "Besides itching, are there any other symptoms?"
Widow Li said, "I feel irritable, all over the place, can’t eat well, can’t sleep well..."
Initially embarrassed, Widow Li gradually opened up, pouring out her troubles to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan instructed, "Sister-in-law, extend your hand. I’ll check your pulse."
Widow Li extended her hand towards Lin Fan.
Her hand was fair and smooth, unlike what one would expect from someone doing farm work, akin to pampered city girls, soft and tender, making one want to touch it.
Lin Fan pressed his fingers on Widow Li’s wrist to check her pulse, lightly frowning.
Widow Li worriedly asked, "Lin Fan, is there really a problem?"
"Yes, there’s a slight issue," Lin Fan said, "Sister-in-law, this can be serious or minor. I’ll ask directly, have you engaged in any unclean behavior?"

chapters.title: Chapter 550: Your Illness is Related to Men
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Chapter 550: Your Illness is Related to Men
Widow Li’s face changed at the words and she said firmly, "No, absolutely not!"
Seeing her a bit angry, Lin Fan hurriedly said, "Sister-in-law, don’t get excited. I’m just trying to understand the situation as a doctor."
Widow Li said, "I haven’t engaged in any improper conduct with anyone, Lin Fan, you have to believe me. Since your Brother Sanshui passed away, I’ve been widowed for ten years. I know there are many rumors about me outside, but they have nothing to do with me."
Lin Fan furrowed his brows. Widow Li spoke earnestly, but he couldn’t just believe her like that. Doctors with some experience all know that patients always like to lie.
It seemed there was only one way left. Lin Fan cleared his slightly dry throat: "Let’s do this, I’ll help you with an examination..."
Lin Fan had checked Widow Li’s pulse and discovered there indeed seemed to be some issues, but the exact problem required further examination to be determined.
Hearing Lin Fan say he needed to check her body, Widow Li couldn’t help but feel a bit embarrassed again, "Do the check here?"
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, it’s indeed a bit inconvenient."
Liu Zixing said, "You both head to the examination room, it’s at the back."
Lin Fan cleared his throat, "Ahem, there’s an examination room then, alright, sister-in-law, come with me to the examination room."
The two of them then went to the examination room at the back, which was specifically used for medical examinations. To protect the patient’s privacy, some examinations needed to be done with the door closed.
There were some simple equipment inside the examination room, with a bed in the center.
"How should the examination be done?" Widow Li sized up the room and asked, a bit at a loss.
Lin Fan casually closed the door and said, "Um... take off your pants and lie on the bed."
Upon hearing this, Widow Li’s face immediately flushed red. Taking off her pants in front of Lin Fan for an examination was so embarrassing, she was his sister-in-law!
But thinking about what Lin Fan said earlier, she just needed to consider him as a doctor. Widow Li calmed down a bit, reached out and started to unbutton her clothes...
With one button undone, the pink camisole inside was revealed, along with fair shoulders and snow-white skin.
Lin Fan’s eyes felt a bit heated, and he remembered that unforgettable night.
"Ahem..." Lin Fan reminded Widow Li, "Sister-in-law, you don’t need to take off your top."
Widow Li suddenly realized, right, Lin Fan had only asked her to take off her pants earlier, he hadn’t asked her to strip completely. She was so nervous that she forgot.
Widow Li quickly buttoned up her collar, her cheeks flushed, "Um, sorry."
Luckily Lin Fan reminded her, she immediately felt reassured about Lin Fan. He truly considered her a patient and didn’t have other thoughts, otherwise he wouldn’t have reminded her.
As a patient, cooperating with the doctor for a body check is the right thing to do. Since Lin Fan was so professional, she shouldn’t be shy.
Thinking of this, Widow Li mustered her courage and reached to loosen her belt...
After the examination, Widow Li got off the examination table, her face rosy like a ripe apple.
Even though she considered Lin Fan a doctor, it was still very embarrassing when she was actually examined by him.
Lin Fan stood to the side feeling a bit dizzy.
As a child he had seen Widow Li by the river, and now Widow Li had no secrets from him.
At this moment, his throat felt dry and he just wanted to drink some cool water to calm down.
The atmosphere seemed a bit awkward.
"Lin Fan, how did it go, what’s wrong with me?" Widow Li asked, breaking the silence.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "After my thorough examination just now, sister-in-law is very healthy, no illnesses whatsoever. Sister-in-law can rest easy."
Widow Li furrowed her brows, "No illnesses whatsoever, Lin Fan are you sure you didn’t make a mistake?"
Lin Fan said, "There’s no mistake. If sister-in-law is not reassured, I can help with another examination."
He didn’t mind at all, doing another examination for Widow Li. If Widow Li wanted him to examine her every day, he’d be happy to oblige.
Widow Li felt a bit awkward, "That’s not what I meant, I meant I don’t have that kind of illness, so why do I feel itchy?"
Lin Fan said her body was fine, but her issues indeed existed!
Lin Fan said, "I’ve checked thoroughly, sister-in-law’s body indeed shows no illnesses. According to my diagnosis, sister-in-law is suffering from a mental issue."
Widow Li was stunned, "Mental issue, what do you mean?"
Lin Fan smiled warmly and said, "Well, your issue is related to men."
Widow Li seemed to understand Lin Fan’s meaning and was a bit agitated, "I’ve said, these past ten years, I haven’t had relations with any men, Lin Fan, if you’re suggesting I’ve been with other men, feeling guilty towards Sanshui, thus developing this mental issue, then you must be mistaken!"
She was a bit angry. Why didn’t Lin Fan believe her?
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Sister-in-law, that’s not what I meant. Quite the opposite. My diagnosis is, the reason you have a mental issue is precisely because you’ve been without a man for ten years."
"Ah?" Widow Li was surprised.
Lin Fan said, "Sister-in-law, your body has been vacant for a long time. Perhaps you’re afraid of betraying Brother Sanshui, so you suppress yourself. But sister-in-law is still young and a normal woman, naturally you have needs. This conflict accumulates over time and leads to anxiety. This anxiety is subconscious, and if I don’t mention it, sister-in-law may never realize it."
Widow Li was startled, what, her problem was actually this?
She simply hadn’t been with a man, catching that kind of illness. No, on the contrary, it was because she had long been without a man, she developed a mental issue!
Indeed, if Lin Fan hadn’t told her, how could she have thought of it!
"Then, what should I do, can this mental issue be treated?" Widow Li asked.
Lin Fan said seriously, "I’m not joking with the following words, nor do I intend to offend, sister-in-law listen carefully. As they say, prescribe the right medicine. Since the issue lies with men, a man must solve it. In simple terms, sister-in-law, you lack a man."
Widow Li’s face instantly turned red. How could she not understand Lin Fan’s meaning? Her mental issue was due to a deep-seated desire for a man. Lin Fan meant for her to find a man to satisfy her physiological needs, and the mental issue would naturally be solved.
Though she didn’t want to admit it, what Lin Fan said was quite right. All along, she lived a life of purity, deliberately suppressing her desires.
"Lin Fan, is there another way to treat my illness, I can take medication, I can’t betray your Brother Sanshui..." Widow Li’s eyes reddened.
In his heart, Lin Fan sighed. Who would’ve thought there are still women who remain widowed these days!
Having studied in the county, he heard plenty of news about people in the city. Not only widowhood, some women feigned deep affection but cheated within marriage. He heard enough rumors, they were no longer fresh.
But Widow Li was the opposite. Rumors about her never ceased for ten years, yet she actually maintained her chastity. In ancient times, she could have earned a loyalty plaque.
Lin Fan said, "Sister-in-law, you’re still young. You should indeed make some plans for yourself. I’ve said all I can, the rest is for sister-in-law to consider. If you come to terms, quickly find a man."
In essence, Widow Li’s long-term suppression could find relief through a man. Lin Fan wouldn’t mind being that man, helping Widow Li alleviate her loneliness.

chapters.title: Chapter 551: The Prodigal Son in the Countryside
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Chapter 551: The Prodigal Son in the Countryside
Widow Li blushing vividly: "I understand now. If there’s nothing else, I’ll head back. Oh, Lin Fan, please don’t tell anyone about my illness."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Don’t worry, keeping patient secrets is our duty as doctors."
Finally, Widow Li felt a little relieved.
Thus, Lin Fan and Widow Li left the examination room and went outside.
Liu Zixing was outside organizing some things. When she looked up and saw Lin Fan leading Widow Li out, Widow Li’s face was still blushing, appearing very embarrassed.
Seeing Liu Zixing, Widow Li felt quite awkward and dared not make eye contact with her. If Liu Zixing found out about the matter earlier, it would be so embarrassing. Fortunately, Lin Fan had promised to keep it confidential.
"Lin Fan, how much for the fee earlier?" Widow Li asked.
Lin Fan waved his hand smilingly: "It’s nothing, no charge this time. No need for formality between us."
Liu Zixing was nearby, so Widow Li couldn’t say much, only uttering: "Thanks then, I’ll go first."
After speaking, Widow Li went out the door.
Liu Zixing gossiply asked: "Lin Fan, what illness does Widow have? Couldn’t be..."
Liu Zixing chuckled, having heard some women in the village say that Widow Li seemingly didn’t have a very prudent lifestyle.
Lin Fan said: "It’s nothing serious, just some stomach discomfort."
He had promised to keep Widow Li’s secret, naturally couldn’t tell Liu Zixing.
Liu Zixing felt somewhat disappointed, turned out to be stomach discomfort, she thought there was some explosive gossip.
"Lin Fan, why didn’t you charge Widow Li?" Liu Zixing asked.
Lin Fan laughed: "In terms of hierarchy, she’s my sister-in-law, and she’s a widow, so once or twice is fine."
"Oh."
Liu Zixing said, "By the way, Lin Fan, let me tell you something. When you were examining Widow Li, my dad called from home saying he encountered a rather troublesome patient and might stay a few days. He was worried there’d be no one at the clinic. I told him about you, he was delighted and wants to invite you to help at the clinic for a few days, would it be okay?"
Lin Fan pondered for a moment and answered cheerfully: "Alright, but I don’t know when I’ll leave, hope Elder Liu returns before I go."
Liu Zixing felt delighted, thinking in the upcoming days, Lin Fan would be here every day, she was mysteriously happy.
"However," Liu Zixing said, "we must talk about the clinic’s rules, opening a clinic isn’t charity work, it’s about making money, so let’s avoid free services in future."
Lin Fan uttered an acknowledgement. He understood Liu Zixing. Old Liu relied on the clinic to raise her and support her education. Although such rural clinic hardly earns much monthly, for Lin Fan now it’s not a big deal, yet it’s their father and daughter’s income source.
Lin Fan said: "Okay, I got it. It’s my first day back in the village and I haven’t returned home yet. No patients now, so I’ll head home first. Call me if you need anything."
Liu Zixing said: "Alright, let me add you on WeChat."
The two exchanged contacts and added on WeChat, then Lin Fan left the clinic intending to head home first.
By now it was somewhat dim, while walking, Lin Fan suddenly stopped, looking up towards the side village path.
Lin Fan recognized it. This path leads outside towards the village’s elementary school.
On one side of the village path, in front of a dilapidated house, there was a pair of man and woman, the man blocking the woman’s path.
The man in his twenties dressed quite fashionably, looking flashy, the woman wearing a shirt, holding a few books in arms, slim figure, very pretty face.
Amazingly, Lin Fan recognized both of them.
The man’s name is Chen Junjie, son of Chen Datou, village head of West River Village. This guy hasn’t behaved since young, relying on being the village head’s son to cause trouble everywhere. With a somewhat handsome appearance, he’s harmed several females; could rightfully be called a total scumbag.
It was said that in middle school he got a girl pregnant and forced her to abort, almost ruining that girl, leading to the school expelling him. Later on, he returned to the village, idly lounging every day, possessing none of a rich second generation’s life, yet having all their ailments, truly a rural wastrel.
Lin Fan had a quite poor impression of him, luckily had never interacted with this guy.
The woman was astonishingly Chu Yue’er!
"Yue’er, agree with me, tonight I’ll take you to the county for fun, you can buy anything you want. Heard there’s a blockbuster released recently, I’ll accompany you to watch." Chen Junjie smirked.
Chu Yue’er furrowed her brows, looking quite annoyed: "Mr. Chen, I’ve explicitly told you before, I can never be your girlfriend. I hope you stop bothering me!"
While talking, Chu Yue’er tried to leave.
Chen Junjie reached out and leaned against the wall, blocking Chu Yue’er, saying with a grin: "Don’t be so quick to refuse me. What’s wrong being my girlfriend? My dad is the village head, how could he treat you unfairly? Follow me, live the high life!"
Chen Junjie wore a proud face, posing like a president’s son though merely a small village head’s son.
Chu Yue’er sneered: "Sorry, you’ve misunderstood me. I don’t care what you can offer me, nor can you give what I desire. I simply dislike you, understand? Please step aside!"
Chen Junjie’s anger flared hearing that, this chick was quite stubborn, never had anyone rejected him so.
"Even my dad wouldn’t dare speak like that. What can a chick like you do? Daring to refuse me, do you still want to stay in this village?"
Chen Junjie sneered arrogantly.
Chu Yue’er retorted angrily: "I’m teaching here righteously, what can the village head do to me? Seems like you’re lacking home education, blame your dad for failing at parenting, go ask the village head how to teach you to be a person!"
Chen Junjie chuckled: "You’re a teacher, perfect, you can teach me."
Saying so, Chen Junjie reached out attempting to touch Chu Yue’er’s chin.
Chu Yue’er dodged quickly, angrily saying: "Show some respect. You’re scum; I can’t teach you, nor interested. Move aside!"
Chen Junjie shamelessly refused: "I won’t move, see what you can do. There’s no one to help you, no one dares, acceptant or you’ll have to tonight!"
Chu Yue’er, inflamed, asked: "What are you planning, scum? Aren’t you afraid of jail?"
Chen Junjie laughed: "Exactly, I’m going to force you. Someone told me once you’ve been forced, you’ll behave. Be my woman, you’ll naturally behave. Moreover, getting you, even spending years in jail, isn’t a loss."
Chen Junjie, appallingly audacious, appeared ready to take the plunge.
"Someone help, save me!" Chu Yue’er, desperately panicking, shouted out loud, fearing she’d be no match for Chen Junjie, unprepared for his hands-on approach.
Chen Junjie chuckled: "Shout all you want, no one will save you. Let’s see who’s got the guts to meddle in my affairs?"
Saying so, Chen Junjie prepared to act.
"Yue’er, what’s happening here?"
Lin Fan stepped in, purposefully asking loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 552: The neighboring villages are blessed
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Chapter 552: The neighboring villages are blessed
Wei Yue’er was panicking, and upon seeing Lin Fan, it was as if she had seen a lifeline, she was overjoyed.
"Lin Fan, you came just in time. He wants to assault me, please help me!" Wei Yue’er said.
Chen Junjie turned his head and saw Lin Fan, frowning slightly.
"You’re Lin Fan? When did you come back? What, you want to meddle in my business?" Chen Junjie arrogantly shouted, not taking Lin Fan seriously at all.
Lin Fan said coldly, "It’s your grandpa Lin Fan here. You idiot planning to assault Yue’er, huh?"
Chen Junjie didn’t expect Lin Fan would dare talk to him like this, even more arrogantly than him, making him furious.
What was more annoying was that Lin Fan called Wei Yue’er so intimately. Could there be something between them?
"You son of a bitch, are you tired of living?" Chen Junjie scolded, "Dare to offend me, believe it or not, I’ll beat you to death?"
Lin Fan said calmly, "You can come and try."
Chen Junjie indeed had guts, swinging his fist, he rushed towards Lin Fan, intending to beat him up.
However, before his fist could touch Lin Fan, Lin Fan swung a slap out.
Smack!
A heavy slap landed squarely on Chen Junjie’s face, sending him flipping to the ground, one side of his face swelling up instantly, blood oozing from the corner of his mouth, stars spinning in his eyes, ears ringing, leaving him disoriented for a moment.
Wei Yue’er was delighted to see this, Lin Fan was truly amazing. When he killed a snake this morning, she already knew Lin Fan was extraordinary.
"You son of a bitch!"
Chen Junjie was both shocked and furious, barely managing to control himself, clutching his swollen face, "You bastard dared to hit me, you don’t want to stay in West River Village anymore, do you believe I’ll have my dad tear your house down?"
Lin Fan sneered, "Is that so? I’ll take you to see the village chief right now. Let’s see if he will tear down my house or the police will arrest you and lock you up."
Chen Junjie’s face changed. He didn’t expect Lin Fan to confront him so directly. What he just did was an attempted assault, a criminal offense, and his dad couldn’t protect him. Moreover, threatening to tear down Lin Fan’s house might not be something his dad would actually do.
Chen Junjie got up, pointed at Lin Fan, and cursed, "You bastard, consider yourself lucky today. This isn’t over, just you wait for me!"
After leaving a harsh remark, he turned around and gave Wei Yue’er a vicious glare before quickly fleeing.
"That was just a warning, next time, I’ll castrate you myself!" Lin Fan’s cold voice came from behind.
Chen Junjie stumbled, almost tripping, furious that Lin Fan had bullied him. He couldn’t swallow this humiliation!
Lin Fan seemed to have become surprisingly strong, almost knocking his head off with just one slap. In his memory, Lin Fan hadn’t been this formidable!
In his memory, Lin Fan was an honest kid who didn’t mess around with the village kids, unlike others who followed Chen Junjie around like a gang of little punks.
Lin Fan rarely associated with them, going to school seriously from a young age, and after leaving the hometown for studies, he interacted with them even less.
The peers in the village treated Lin Fan politely without any major conflicts of interest. Chen Junjie never regarded Lin Fan seriously, thinking he was nothing.
Who knew, meeting Lin Fan again today, he’d take a slap from him, could he tolerate this humiliation!
Seeing Chen Junjie leave, Wei Yue’er breathed a sigh of relief.
"Lin Fan, you’ve saved me again, thank you." Wei Yue’er walked up, expressing her gratitude.
Lin Fan replied with a smile, "Just a small gesture of help. Luckily, I was around. Does this scumbag often harass you?"
Wei Yue’er showed a look of disgust, "Yes, he started pursuing me over a month ago, waiting for me after school every day, pestering nonstop. At first, it was okay, I ignored him, and he didn’t dare do anything. Tonight, he must have lost his mind, actually trying to lay hands on me."
Thinking of what had just happened, Wei Yue’er felt a bit scared. If Lin Fan hadn’t come, she would have suffered.
Lin Fan said, "This path in the village is secluded, seeing no one around, he dared to have evil thoughts."
Wei Yue’er nodded, "Yes, I usually come back with students after school. Today the school had something, and I was delayed."
Wei Yue’er felt a bit scared, deciding she must find someone to walk with her in the future; it’s unsafe to be alone.
Lin Fan comforted her, "Don’t worry. If this scumbag dares harass you again, I’ll teach him a lesson for you."
Wei Yue’er expressed some concern, "After all, he’s the village chief’s son. I heard he’s the only son, and the chief spoils him excessively. He’s done a lot of bad things. Lin Fan, although you’re skilled, will fighting him bring trouble to you?"
Lin Fan sneered, "He’s just a little punk, nothing to be afraid of."
Seeing Lin Fan’s nonchalant attitude, Wei Yue’er felt somewhat relieved and smiled, "Did you just leave the clinic?"
Lin Fan replied, "Yes."
Wei Yue’er hesitated a bit, "Are... you very close with Zi Xin?"
Lin Fan had spent most of the day at the clinic, naturally leading her to this thought. If he wasn’t close to Liu Zixing, why would he be there? Lin Fan wasn’t a doctor at the clinic.
Lin Fan said, "Not particularly close. We’re from the same village and have known each other since childhood. Today, since Old Liu was away, they asked me to be at the clinic temporarily."
Wei Yue’er smiled, "Really? Then the villagers around here are really lucky. Your medical skill is that good."
Hearing that Lin Fan and Liu Zixing were not that close, not in that kind of relationship, she felt a bit happy for some reason.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "I also hope my medical skills can help more people. By the way, how about I walk you home and also visit Dog No.2 while I’m at it."
Lin Fan originally planned to visit Dog No.2 after having dinner at home, and now it was convenient.
Wei Yue’er was also worried Chen Junjie might cause trouble again, so she readily agreed.
The two of them headed towards Dog No.2’s house.
In no time, they arrived near Dog No.2’s house.
"Brother Fan!"
Suddenly, they heard an excited voice from across the way, and saw a big, simple-looking guy running over quickly with a shoulder pole full of sweet potatoes.
The load looked at least a hundred pounds heavy, but the big guy carried it effortlessly, moving swiftly.
When he reached Lin Fan, the big guy dropped the pole to the ground and ran to Lin Fan, hugging him tightly.
"Hahaha..." The big guy laughed heartily, "Brother Fan, when did you come back?"
Lin Fan was not short, but compared to this big guy, he was overshadowed. Being hugged like that, Lin Fan felt a bit suffocated, but he couldn’t help but laugh loudly too.
This somewhat silly-looking big guy was his childhood buddy, Dog No.2.
"I came back last night, and only now had the chance to find you." Lin Fan said with a smile. Seeing Dog No.2, he was indeed happy; despite looking simple-minded, Dog No.2 was his best friend from childhood.
Dog No.2 released Lin Fan, then looked at Wei Yue’er, "Brother Lin Fan, did you come back with Sister Xiaoyue?"

chapters.title: Chapter 553: 2 Gouzi and Aunt Chunyu
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Chapter 553: 2 Gouzi and Aunt Chunyu
Wei Yue’er chuckled and said, "I happened to meet him, so we came back together."
Lin Fan said, "Your Sister Xiaoyue was bullied, and I helped her drive away the bad guy."
"What?" Dog No.2 was furious. "Who dares to bully Sister Xiaoyue? I’ll go beat him up!"
With Dog No.2’s bear-like brawny frame, one punch could probably make Chen Junjie shit himself. Although Dog No.2 is a big dummy, if someone really bullies Wei Yue’er, he would definitely be the first to rush in and hit the person.
Wei Yue’er laughed and said, "He was already beaten up by Lin Fan and ran away."
Dog No.2 snorted, "Serves him right, Brother Fan is way more awesome than me. But Brother Fan is nice; if it were me, I would’ve beaten him to death!"
In Dog No.2’s eyes, Brother Fan was his idol, so Dog No.2 always thought Brother Fan was better than him. Brother Fan actually got into college, while Dog No.2 didn’t even finish primary school. He really admired Brother Fan.
Wei Yue’er and Lin Fan exchanged a glance and couldn’t help but stick out their tongues. Dog No.2 has always regarded her as an elder sister, and he might really beat Chen Junjie to death, so she never dared to tell Dog No.2 and Aunt Chunyu about Chen Junjie harassing her.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s fine now. Dog No.2, has Aunt Chunyu come back?"
Dog No.2 became happy again, grabbed Lin Fan’s hand, and dumbly smiled, "Mom is already home. Brother Fan, I’ll take you to see her; she’ll be very happy to see you!"
Dog No.2 grabbed Lin Fan with one hand and picked up the load on the ground with the other. The load weighed over a hundred pounds, but it seemed weightless to him, thanks to his natural strength.
Dog No.2 was actually only twenty this year, a year younger than Lin Fan. Who knows why he grew to be so strong, like a big black bear.
Soon, they arrived at Dog No.2’s home. As soon as they entered the yard, Dog No.2 shouted, "Mom, Brother Fan is here!"
A woman emerged from the kitchen, sleeves rolled up, and with wet hands, holding a rice cooker, looking like she was about to wash rice and cook.
Upon seeing Lin Fan, the woman immediately flashed a bright smile, "Little Fan, it’s really you! When did you come back?"
"Hello, Aunt Chunyu, I came back last night," Lin Fan replied with a smile.
This woman was Dog No.2’s mother, He Chunyu.
He Chunyu dressed very simply, like an average farmer, and after a day of work, her skin was a bit red from the sun. However, her skin was naturally fair, and she had very striking features and excellent charisma.
Her simple clothes couldn’t hide her aura. If she wore something elegant, she’d look just like a radiant noblewoman. Despite being nearly forty, she didn’t look old at all, seeming more like she was in her early thirties.
Lin Fan always felt a bit amazed whenever he saw He Chunyu.
Back when Lin Fan was a child, he befriended Dog No.2 mainly because of He Chunyu. The first time he saw her, he was captivated. Back then, she was younger, even more beautiful than now. As Dog No.2’s close friend, Lin Fan visited often just to catch a glimpse of the beautiful Aunt Chunyu.
When Lin Fan was younger, he used to daydream about Aunt Chunyu. Now that he’s grown, he no longer harbors any inappropriate thoughts and has become true good buddies with Dog No.2, treating Aunt Chunyu as an elder.
Aunt Chunyu’s husband passed away very early, and she raised Dog No.2 on her own, which was not easy. Plus, for Dog No.2’s sake, she never remarried and was considered a great mother.
Now, Lin Fan feels more respect for He Chunyu, but he still can’t help being amazed whenever he sees her. She always gives him an extraordinary feeling.
"Xiaoyue is back too, the house hasn’t been this lively in a long time. Lin Fan, stay for dinner tonight!" He Chunyu said warmly.
Lin Fan wanted to stay, but thinking of Lin Zixing at home, he said, "No, we’ve also cooked at home. Maybe another day. I just came by to say hi and need to get back."
Dog No.2 looked a bit forlorn, "Brother Fan, you’re leaving so soon?"
Wei Yue’er laughed, "Lin Fan, look how happy Aunt Chunyu and Dog No.2 are to see you. Why don’t you stay for dinner?"
Lin Fan said, "I just got back today and haven’t even gone home yet."
It was true; he had intended to go straight home but got caught in so many incidents, delaying him until now, and he hadn’t even seen his parents yet.
He Chunyu regrettably said, "In that case, I won’t insist. Little Fan, how about coming over for dinner tomorrow night?"
Lin Fan cheerfully responded, "Sure. Dog No.2, I’m heading back now, I’ll come find you tomorrow."
Dog No.2 seemed quite reluctant, "Brother Fan, won’t you really stay for dinner? I brewed a pot of wine myself, waiting to drink with you when you came back."
Lin Fan laughed, "I’ll come tomorrow, and we’ll drink together!"
"Alright." Dog No.2 reluctantly agreed, "Brother Fan, I’ll see you out."
Lin Fan then said goodbye to Wei Yue’er and He Chunyu, "Aunt Chunyu, Xiaoyue, I’m heading back now."
He Chunyu replied, "Remember to come tomorrow."
So, Dog No.2 walked Lin Fan out. When they just saw each other, Dog No.2 looked very reluctant.
"Dog No.2, has Xiaoyue been living at your place for a long time?" Lin Fan asked with a smile.
Dog No.2 thought blankly for a moment, "I don’t remember, but she’s been here a long time."
Lin Fan asked, "What do you think of Sister Xiaoyue?"
Dog No.2 immediately broke into a silly grin, "Sister Xiaoyue, she’s beautiful, like a fairy!"
Lin Fan laughed, "Do you like Sister Xiaoyue?"
Dog No.2 never lied to his best friend, Lin Fan, and nodded, "I do, but mom says Sister Xiaoyue is an elder sister, I can only be her little brother, can’t marry her as my wife."
Lin Fan was puzzled, unsure of Aunt Chunyu’s reasoning. Did she perhaps think Dog No.2 wasn’t suitable for Wei Yue’er?
"Would you like to marry Sister Xiaoyue?" Lin Fan asked with a smile.
Dog No.2 chuckled innocently, "I’d like to, but I need to listen to mom; if she says no, then no."
Lin Fan knew Dog No.2 was very filial; from childhood to now, he always listened to Aunt Chunyu. Whatever Aunt Chunyu asked him to do, he did.
They relied on each other, and for Dog No.2, his mother was the most important person, followed by Lin Fan, and now there was one more, Sister Xiaoyue.
"If someone bullies Sister Xiaoyue, would you protect her?" Lin Fan asked.
Dog No.2 angrily declared, "Of course! If anyone bullies Sister Xiaoyue, I’ll beat them to death!"
Lin Fan said, "Recently, someone’s been harassing Xiaoyue. I can’t always protect her, so when she’s coming or going from work, keep an eye on her."
Dog No.2 solemnly nodded, "I understand. I’ll definitely protect Sister Xiaoyue!"
Lin Fan smiled, "That’s good, no need to see me off, you should go back."
Dog No.2 suddenly looked at Lin Fan and started grinning.
"What are you smiling at?" Lin Fan asked, curious.
Dog No.2 laughed, "Brother Fan, you like Sister Xiaoyue, don’t you?"
Lin Fan laughed in disbelief, "How’s that possible? I just met her today."
Dog No.2 laughed heartily, "That’s great! Even though I can’t marry Sister Xiaoyue, Brother Fan can! Brother Fan, you need to put in effort."
Lin Fan was taken aback, looked at the silly smiling Dog No.2, and sometimes couldn’t tell if Dog No.2 was genuinely silly or just pretending.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 This University Was a Waste
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Chapter 554 This University Was a Waste
The sky was already dark, and the villagers, busy all day, liked to steal some leisure time, chatting under the banyan tree in the village. At this time, several old men and ladies were gathered under the old banyan tree in the village, chatting idly.
"Did you hear? Chen Huzi was stabbed by his own wife and almost died."
"I heard. It seems someone saved him."
"Who has such good medical skill to save someone who almost died?"
"It seems to be Lin Fan."
"What? Da Gui’s son? I haven’t heard he learned medicine, you must be mistaken!"
"No mistake, my old man was watching, personally saw it, it was Lin Fan."
"Tsk tsk, when did this kid learn medicine?"
"Dagui and Ah-Zhen are back, let’s ask them, we’ll know."
They saw a pair of simply dressed elderly people carrying baskets walking over. They were all mud-legged peasants, looked like they just finished working in the fields. The family’s land always had endless work.
These were Lin Fan’s parents.
"Da Gui, Ah-Zhen, you’re back, great. Quickly tell everyone when Lin Fan learned his medical skills, it’s really amazing?"
An old lady pulled Mrs. Lin with a curious face and asked.
This question left the elderly couple stunned. They just came back from the fields, knowing nothing, suddenly being asked such a question was really baffling.
"Granny Three, what are you talking about? What do you mean?" Mrs. Lin asked curiously.
The old lady said, "Didn’t you hear? Today Lin Fan saved Chen Huzi, everyone is curious when he learned medical skills!"
Father Lin shook his head and said, "You must have heard wrong. When did Little Fan learn medical skills? We don’t know either."
Mrs. Lin had a different focus, she said with surprise: "What, Little Fan is back? Why didn’t he come to find us?"
The old lady said, "Look, even the parents don’t know. It seems there is something fishy about this. Lin Fan might have been like a blind cat encountering a dead rat, by chance saving Chen Huzi."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded, feeling the old lady made sense.
With this explanation, everyone immediately breathed a sigh of relief, feeling relaxed.
There’s no way; if others’ children are too outstanding, they feel pressure. So, they chat back and forth to confirm if it’s true.
When they learned it likely wasn’t true, they all became happy.
"I was saying, heard Lin Fan went to college, but not a medical college, how could he be good at medical skills?"
"Right, Da Gui, I heard Lin Fan is working in the city as a deliveryman, is it true?"
"What deliveryman, simply put, is just running errands delivering food and drinks for people."
Everyone burst into laughter.
A person running errands delivering food, how could he be good at medical skills? If he were good, would he need to do errands delivering food?
Thus, Lin Fan being good at medical skills is untrue, which makes sense.
Lin Dagui seriously said: "Little Fan is indeed working as a deliveryman, earning money through his labors, nothing shameful about that."
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin were very down-to-earth people. They agreed on the attitude of life, which is to be honest and upright. So Lin Fan working as a deliveryman, honestly earning money, they all felt gratified, though their hearts ached for the hard work of their son, since running errands delivering in wind and rain is indeed quite tiring.
Father Lin’s words, however, made the old men and women laugh together.
"Heard Lin Fan went to college then, Da Gui was happy, held a banquet, entertained relatives, didn’t expect, after college, ended up running errands!"
"Right, was that college attendance a waste?"
"I think it was a waste."
"Look at Chen Datou’s son, didn’t go to college, followed a boss, because he is smart and capable, received the boss’s appreciation, built a new house, bought a car, this is truly successful!"
"Right, Chen Datou’s son is soon to marry, invited the whole village, tsk tsk, truly wealthy!"
"Da Gui, did you receive Chen Datou’s invitation too?"
Father Lin chuckled, "Received it."
Everyone wantonly ridiculed Lin Fan, also comparing him to Chen Datou’s son, which was truly annoying.
What made Father Lin angry, wasn’t that Lin Fan was not as good as Chen Datou’s son, but that he didn’t want others to insult his son like this. In his eyes, Lin Fan was always his pride, no matter what he did, as long as it wasn’t breaking the law, honestly earning, he was satisfied.
"If nothing else, we’ll head home now."
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin then left, hearing Lin Fan was back, they wanted to see their son soon.
A simple house with a small courtyard, this was their home, where Lin Fan grew up.
Though it was simple, it was neatly organized, Mrs. Lin was a virtuous wife and managed her home well.
Lin Fan stepped into his own courtyard, looking at this place, feeling somewhat sentimental.
"Little Fan, you’re back, you really came back?"
Mrs. Lin walked in, at a glance saw Lin Fan, was overjoyed, earlier when the villagers mentioned it, she dared not believe it.
Father Lin saw Lin Fan, also showed a loving smile.
They all loved Lin Fan very much, Lin Fan has always been their pride.
Even if Lin Fan was delivering in the city, in their view, their son honestly earning, not stealing nor robbing, they felt it was good.
"Yeah, just came back today, just arrived home." Lin Fan smiled, seeing his parents, he was genuinely happy, hadn’t been home for a long time, hadn’t seen his parents for a long time.
Father Lin said: "Why didn’t you tell us when you were coming back, I would have killed a chicken, no meat tonight."
Lin Fan said: "It’s okay, just eat anything."
Mrs. Lin smiled and said: "I always say, Little Fan this child, is easy to feed."
Father Lin curiously said: "Why did you suddenly come back, can you take leave from work in the city?"
Lin Fan said: "Actually, I’m back this time with Uncle Three."
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin were taken aback: "Where’s your Uncle Three?"
Lin Fan said: "He’s currently getting an infusion in the county hospital, I let Shanshan accompany him, I’ll bring him back in a few days, I returned early to inform everyone."
Father Lin said: "Little Fan, what exactly happened?"
Lin Fan said: "This matter is complicated, I won’t go into detail right now, don’t worry, Uncle Three is fine, he’ll be better soon."
Upon hearing this, the elderly couple was somewhat relieved.
Father Lin said: "Right, Little Fan, how come the villagers are saying you know medical skills, and your skills are really good?"
Mrs. Lin also said: "Yes, heard you saved Chen Huzi, when did you learn medicine?"
Lin Fan smiled and said: "I’m interested in medical skills, just self-studied a bit, didn’t expect today I could help Uncle Hu."
Father Lin said: "So it’s like that, not bad, your hobby is very meaningful, hope you keep it up."
Mrs. Lin smiled and said: "Don’t stand here talking, come in quickly, Little Fan, you must be hungry, I’ll go cook now."
Mrs. Lin was quick-handed, shortly, cooked the meal, the three sat around a small table eating.

chapters.title: Chapter 556: Actually, I Am the Wealthiest Person in Yun City
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Chapter 556: Actually, I Am the Wealthiest Person in Yun City
The Chen family next door, namely Chen Hai, is considered one of the well-off among the younger generation in the village. He built a new house for his family, the tallest in the village, and it’s beautifully renovated inside and out, making it quite eye-catching.
This makes the people in the village extremely envious, each giving a thumbs up, praising, "Xiaohai, this kid sure is promising!"
Moreover, Chen Hai is getting married soon, and he has invited the entire village to the wedding. That’s quite a feat, showing how wealthy he truly is; he’s done incredibly well in the city.
This Chen Hai is definitely someone else’s golden child!
Even Mrs. Lin feels a bit envious. Her son is so accomplished that, although it’s not good to compare, thinking of how her son works hard delivering food in the city, earning only seven to eight thousand a month with great effort, making over ten thousand is quite difficult.
For delivery workers, the more you work, the more you earn. Some indeed can earn over ten thousand a month, but it’s from working day and night.
What Mrs. Lin envies is that Chen Hai seems to lead a good life, while comparatively, her own son seems to be struggling. Her hope is for her son to have a good life too.
Lin Fan understands his mother’s thoughts. She just feels sorry for him, always considering her children the most, and her affection is directed towards them.
So, Lin Fan decided not to let his mother worry about him anymore. The parents should know their son is actually doing quite well, living in a mansion worth 3 billion, and is the president of a 200 billion group company.
Lin Fan said, "Mom, actually, your son is doing quite well now, not short of money..."
Mrs. Lin replied, "You don’t need to comfort me, son. I watched TV. I know how hard delivery work is, running outside all day, exposed to the elements, and encountering various issues. It’s all hard-earned money."
Lin Fan sighed inwardly. If he tells his mother he has a fortune of a billion now, she surely wouldn’t believe him.
Lin Fan said, "No, Mom, actually I’m no longer a delivery man. Now I’m quite rich. I’m the richest person in Yun City, with 100 billion in cash and many assets. The cars I drive now cost 70 million and 8 million; they’re the world’s top luxury cars."
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin were stunned to hear this and exchanged a glance.
Mrs. Lin then reached out, feeling Lin Fan’s forehead: "Son, are you having a fever, talking nonsense?"
Of course, they wouldn’t believe him, even if he was telling the truth.
It’s not their fault for not believing; how does someone go from being a delivery man to the richest person in Yun City overnight? Isn’t this just a fairy tale?
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin thought Lin Fan was feeling a bit unsettled, hearing that Chen Hai was doing so well and started talking nonsense as a form of self-comfort.
Father Lin changed the subject, saying, "Let’s not talk about this. Whether we have money or not doesn’t matter. There’s no need to envy others. As long as the family is healthy, that’s the greatest wealth. Little Fan, how long do you plan to stay this time?"
Lin Fan replied, "I’ll leave after settling Uncle San, in about two or three days. By the way, Old Liu is not here these days, so I’ll be at the village clinic, taking his place as promised."
Father Lin said with satisfaction, "Great, you’ve learned medical skills, and being able to help others is the best."
Since childhood, Father Lin taught Lin Fan that with greater capability comes greater responsibility. In poverty, keep to oneself; in prosperity, help the world. If you have the ability, help those in need.
The night passed without words.
The next day, Lin Fan arrived at the clinic early in the morning.
Liu Zixing saw Lin Fan coming and was very happy, smiling, "I thought you weren’t coming."
Lin Fan said, "I promised I’d come, so I had to be here."
Throughout the morning, Lin Fan was in the clinic. At first, it was rather quiet, with only a few patients coming in for minor issues like colds, which Lin Fan casually medicated and cured.
Such minor illnesses didn’t really showcase Lin Fan’s medical skills.
Suddenly, a man appeared, carrying an elderly man, hurrying in. The elderly man looked in pain, hovering between life and death.
"Lin Fan, I heard you saved Huzi yesterday. That’s great, and you’re here today too!"
The man smiled at Lin Fan, sweat dripping from his brow.
Lin Fan took a look and recognized the man as Honest Chen, and the elderly man he carried was his father, named Chen Zhonghou. This pair was as honest as their names suggested.
"Honest Uncle, what’s going on?" Lin Fan asked in surprise.
Honest Chen said, "My dad hurt his leg a few days ago, and Doctor Liu suggested sending him to the town hospital. They operated on him there, and he seemed fine, but suddenly he was in excruciating pain. I heard you’re substituting for Doctor Liu, so I rushed over. Lin Fan, can you take a look at my dad?"
Lin Fan said, "Okay, lay him down first."
At the entrance of the clinic was a long bench for patients to wait in line, and Honest Chen placed his father Chen Zhonghou on it to sit up.
Chen Zhonghou’s right foot was wrapped in bandages, the entire foot was black and swollen, a sorry sight.
Lin Fan took one look and knew it was serious and would take some time to treat.
Lin Fan crouched before Chen Zhonghou, helping to untie the bandages, releasing a foul odor. On his calf was a surgical wound over ten centimeters, sewn with stitches, evidently not long since surgery, with the entire calf swollen.
Lin Fan pressed his fingers on various parts of Chen Zhonghou’s calf, while asking Chen Zhonghou about his feelings.
Chen Zhonghou, in a weak state, responded to Lin Fan with furrowed brows and feeble answers.
"Lin Fan, how is my dad?" Honest Chen asked anxiously.
Lin Fan replied, "The situation is quite serious. First, tell me how Grandpa Zhonghou got injured."
Honest Chen said, "He went to chop wood, and fell down a slope, breaking his calf bone. The town doctor said it was shattered and needed surgery. They did the surgery, and he seemed fine, but now it’s like this just two days later."
Lin Fan nodded, "His leg bone indeed shattered, but the surgery didn’t help, and now there’s necrosis."
Honest Chen, shocked, said, "Necrosis? How could this happen?"
Lin Fan explained, "Elderly are generally prone to osteoporosis and not sturdy enough for falls. Grandpa Zhonghou fell, shattering his leg bone. The town hospital’s surgery was sloppy, leading to bone necrosis. If not treated soon, the necrosis will continue, risking the loss of Grandpa Zhonghou’s leg, possibly threatening his life."
Honest Chen, alarmed, exclaimed, "What to do? Lin Fan, you have to save my dad. I heard you brought Huzi back from the brink. You must have a way, right?"
Lin Fan had saved the dying Chen Huzi, and this news was spreading throughout the village. Some believed Lin Fan merely got lucky, like a blind cat catching a dead rat, but others held hope, seeking his help.
Honest Chen was one of those, not knowing where else to turn after the county hospital’s surgery failed, thus coming to Lin Fan to give it a try.

chapters.title: Chapter 557: Are you a doctor? I think you’re a fool.
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Chapter 557: Are you a doctor? I think you’re a fool.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Honest Uncle, no need to worry. I can help Grandpa Zhonghou recover, but not right now. There’s a shortage of medicine here. I’ll get supplies from the county and then see Grandpa Zhonghou."
Just now, feeling bored, he had organized things a bit. Indeed, the clinic was quite low on supplies, possibly because Old Liu had been traveling these days and hadn’t had a chance to restock.
Generally speaking, the clinic needs regular restocking. Some common herbs can be directly purchased at the herbal market.
Honest Chen said anxiously, "What should we do? My father is in a lot of pain right now."
Lin Fan said, "It’s okay, his main problem now is wound pain. I’ll apply some ointment for him. I’ll go get supplies today and treat him when I return."
Saying this, Lin Fan returned inside the clinic and took the leftover ointment from the surgery he performed on Chen Huzi yesterday and applied it to Chen Zhonghou.
This ointment is quite miraculous. Shortly after being applied, Chen Zhonghou’s pain eased significantly, and his spirits lifted a bit.
"Little Fan, thank you so much, you’ve worked hard." Chen Zhonghou said gratefully.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Don’t mention it, I’m a doctor. It’s my duty to think of my patients."
Honest Chen was also very grateful and thanked Lin Fan repeatedly, agreeing to return in the afternoon, and then he carried Chen Zhonghou away.
Lin Fan said to Liu Zixing, "I need to go to the county now. If any patients come, please ask them to return in the afternoon."
Lin Fan’s trip to the city for herbs was just in passing. Mainly, he wanted to check on his third uncle at the county hospital. If the infusion was working well, he could bring his uncle home today.
Liu Zixing said, "Okay, you hurry back. I can’t handle it alone."
Having Lin Fan around gave her a sense of security. When she heard he was going to the city, she panicked a bit, realizing she had become somewhat reliant on him, without quite knowing why.
Lin Fan agreed and set off for the county town.
He got on a rural bus and headed to the county.
The bus arrived at the outskirts of the county town.
Lin Fan had to transfer to a city bus to get to the hospital. In less developed areas, transportation is more inconvenient.
Not every place is like a first-tier city with convenient transportation; in those cities, buses come every few minutes and go everywhere, whereas in less developed cities, transportation is still quite inconvenient.
Usually, you can gauge a city’s development level by its public transportation. Cities with many bus routes and frequent buses are generally big cities, while those with fewer lines and less frequent buses, where you might wait over half an hour for a bus, are definitely small, less developed ones.
The journey from the village to the county isn’t too far, around a dozen or so miles. With two bus transfers, it took him over an hour.
Lin Fan regretted not driving himself, wanting to keep a low profile.
After much waiting, the bus that finally arrived wasn’t crowded, which was good—it wasn’t like in big cities, where buses are packed, especially during rush hour, which can be very daunting.
"Help! Someone please help!"
Just then, a sharp scream echoed in the bus.
At midday, most passengers were in a daze; the scream startled everyone awake, and they all turned to look.
They saw an elderly man with a livid face and furrowed brows, unconscious in his seat, while a beautiful woman nearby was pale with fright, desperately shaking the man in panic, her forehead beaded with sweat—the scream had come from her.
The female conductor heard the scream and rushed over, shocked at the sight of the elderly man.
Indeed, the city’s buses were mostly automated with card swiping, yet this bus had a conductor, indicating its backwardness.
