"Miss, what’s going on with the patient?" the female conductor asked.
The beautiful woman said anxiously, "My grandpa has heart disease; it must be a heart attack!"
"Then quickly give him his medicine!" The conductor was in even more of a panic; if someone died on the bus, it would be a real problem.
"I forgot to bring the medicine when we got on the bus!" The woman’s eyes were red, almost driven to tears by her anxiety, filled with guilt.
"Miss, please don’t panic," the conductor comforted the woman, though she was sweating profusely herself. She raised her head to loudly ask the crowd, "Is there a doctor here, or anyone with heart medication, who can help this patient?"
As the crowd exchanged hesitant looks, a voice broke out, "Clear the way, I’m a doctor!"
The crowd stepped aside, revealing a handsome young man walking over. He was dressed in a suit, and both his attire and hairstyle were quite stylish.
"Are you a doctor? That’s wonderful, please help with the patient!" The conductor said joyfully.
The handsome young man nodded and approached the elderly man, bending over to check his pulse and listen, going through the motions of a professional doctor.
"The patient’s heart has stopped; we must perform CPR immediately! Everyone, back away and let the air flow freely!" The young man commanded loudly, trying to disperse the onlookers.
The crowd quickly moved aside. They were there to watch, but if the old man died, they didn’t want any blame.
Afraid of being implicated, everyone backed away, except for one person, Lin Fan, who had just arrived.
Lin Fan, blinking with curiosity, was carefully observing the elderly man’s complexion, oblivious to the young man’s words.
"I said, everyone needs to step back! Hillbilly, can’t you understand human language?" The handsome young man glared at Lin Fan in annoyance, shouting loudly. This guy was clearly from the countryside, dressed in shabby clothes—people like him were his least favorite.
Having finished his observations, Lin Fan heard the young man’s words and felt a bit unhappy.
"You’re a doctor? Looks to me like you’re an idiot! This is a heart disease recurrence; his heart and pulse are weakening. Performing CPR now is a total waste of time and could burden the patient more!" Lin Fan retorted coldly.
Seeing the hillbilly dare to argue back and even insult him, the young man was livid, his face darkening as he said, "Who do you think you are to question me? Do you even know who I am? I’m Zhu Ming!"
Lin Fan asked in surprise, "What, are you really a pig?"
"Zhu Ming!" The young man was so angered he jumped in frustration; this hillbilly had clearly misheard on purpose!
Upon hearing the name Zhu Ming, everyone was stirred. That name was familiar to them!
Zhu Ming, one of the top ten outstanding young doctors in the city, had achieved a PhD in medicine at a young age. People often saw his image on television and in newspapers; he was a rising star in Tianhai City’s medical community.
How was it possible that Zhu Ming appeared on this bus due to some twist of fate?
"It’s really him; he’s even more handsome in person than on TV!"
"How lucky we are to have Zhu Ming here; the old man will certainly be saved!"
The crowd began to chatter.
Knowing they were confronting the famous Dr. Zhu Ming, while Lin Fan was just an unknown country bumpkin, naturally, everyone sided with Zhu Ming.
"How can this person be like that, daring to question Dr. Zhu Ming?"
Soon, these thoughts surfaced amongst everyone.
"Brother, could you please be kind enough to step aside and not obstruct Dr. Zhu Ming? I’m begging you," the beautiful woman pleaded urgently.

chapters.title: Chapter 558: Yin-Yang 18 Needles
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Chapter 558: Yin-Yang 18 Needles
The woman’s tone was almost pleading, showing her good upbringing, but she was too worried about her grandfather, and her tone carried a bit of urgency.
"Alright." Lin Fan said indifferently, since the woman chose Zhu Ming to act, he respected her choice. He had just checked, and the patient wouldn’t die immediately, so he let Zhu Ming have a go first!
Saying that, Lin Fan stepped back.
Then Zhu Ming laid the old man flat on the ground and began conventional cardiac resuscitation treatment.
A few minutes quickly passed, yet the old man showed no signs of recovery, and his complexion was getting worse.
Zhu Ming couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat and became anxious, the situation was bad, the country bumpkin was right, he misjudged, he couldn’t save the old man! He was famous, and with so many people watching, admitting he was wrong would be so embarrassing!
Finally, under the undeniable facts, Zhu Ming was forced to give up, stopping his efforts, showing a look of having done his best.
"Dr. Zhu, what happened to my grandfather?" The woman felt something was wrong and started to tremble in fear.
Zhu Ming sighed and said, "I’ve done my best, unless we have hospital rescue equipment, otherwise I’m afraid no one can save him, this is beyond human capabilities."
The woman panicked, looking at the female attendant: "What should we do, can we send my grandfather to the hospital immediately?"
The female attendant said: "This bus is going to the county now, but I don’t know if we can make it in time, besides, this is public transport, everyone needs to agree."
Everyone nodded, indicating that human life is at stake, and they could go to the hospital first.
But the hospital was still some distance away, and it was unclear if they could make it in time.
The woman looked at Zhu Ming: "Dr. Zhu, is there really nothing you can do, you’re so famous, can’t you try to think of something else?"
Everyone also looked at Zhu Ming expectantly, hoping he could think of a solution.
Zhu Ming said with a serious face: "This has nothing to do with my fame, have you ever heard the saying ’a clever housewife cannot cook a meal without rice’? Under these conditions, even if Hua Tuo were reborn, it would be useless!"
"Even Dr. Zhu says that, then there’s really no hope."
"Yes, how pitiful, a life just slips away like this before our eyes!"
People discussed.
"Grandpa!" The woman suddenly collapsed, slumping onto the seat, she regretted it deeply, knowing she shouldn’t have taken the bus with her grandfather.
"Dr. Zhu, your irresponsible words can kill people!"
At this moment, Lin Fan chuckled and spoke again.
"What did you say?" Zhu Ming suddenly looked up, angrily staring at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "Firstly, this old man doesn’t need to go to the hospital, there is still hope, it’s just that you can’t save him. Secondly, your misjudgment earlier made things worse for him, speeding up his death, yet you blame the conditions."
"Nonsense, what do you mean by making things worse, I already did my best just now!" Zhu Ming was furious, standing up abruptly, with a posture like he was going to hit Lin Fan.
"You’re so agitated because I exposed your fault." Lin Fan said coldly.
"Can you really save my grandfather?" The woman looked up at Lin Fan, with no other options, Lin Fan became her last straw, her last hope!
"Yes." Lin Fan nodded, with absolute certainty.
His tone seemed to reassure the woman, giving her a sense of peace, and she earnestly said, "Then please save my grandfather, I’m begging you!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and walked over, squatting in front of the old man, took out a small wooden box from his bundle, opened it, revealing nine silver needles inside.
These silver needles were something Lin Fan unintentionally discovered when organizing his clinic yesterday. According to Liu Zixing, Old Liu used them for his acupuncture research, and Lin Fan borrowed them temporarily.
Acupuncture!
Everyone was surprised, he carried silver needles with him, it turns out he’s a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner!
"Traditional Chinese medicine?" Zhu Ming immediately showed a look of disdain, as a doctor of Western medicine, he never took traditional Chinese medicine seriously, thinking it was all unscientific nonsense.
"Dr. Zhu, please step aside." Lin Fan said indifferently, "If I accidentally prick you and disable you, it won’t be good."
Zhu Ming snorted heavily, stood up, stepped aside, and said coldly, "Just with a few broken needles and you think you can save him, I’ll see how you embarrass yourself!"
Lin Fan ignored him, took out the silver needles, and inserted them into the old man’s Neiguan, Ximen, Tianquan, and other acupoints, began administering acupuncture to save him.
Lin Fan had acquired top-notch medical skills, which included traditional Chinese acupuncture techniques. This acupuncture technique was called the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles, with nine silver needles and eighteen needling techniques, remarkably magical.
Three minutes later.
The old man’s complexion started to improve, his tightly furrowed brows gradually relaxed, and finally, his eyelids fluttered, astonishingly opening his eyes and waking up!
"He’s awake!"
The surroundings immediately erupted, this shabby country boy actually revived the old man with nine silver needles!
"Miraculous hands bring the dead back to life!"
For a moment, this phrase surfaced in everyone’s minds.
The woman was overjoyed, hurrying to help the old man sit up, but amidst her joy, she remembered not believing in Lin Fan earlier and choosing Zhu Ming instead, feeling shame and regret.
Lin Fan truly lived up to the phrase "miraculous hands bring the dead back to life," but he was a bit dissatisfied with his performance this time, feeling the first use of acupuncture was a bit slow.
"That’s great, it’s good that he’s awake!"
The female attendant said happily, she was worried that if the patient died, she might be held accountable.
She grabbed Lin Fan’s hand and smiled: "Young man, we really have to thank you this time, you’re truly a miracle doctor!"
At this time, people around looked at Lin Fan with different eyes, previously all disdainful, now full of praise and amazement.
"The young man’s medical skills are amazing!"
"Traditional Chinese medicine is really miraculous, it seems in cases like this, you have to rely on traditional Chinese medicine!"
"Isn’t it just like that, and Dr. Zhu complained about poor conditions, I think he’s just not capable."
Dr. Zhu really lost face this time, being one of the top ten outstanding young doctors, it seems he’s just a façade!
After today, Zhu Ming’s reputation would be tainted, and it might not be easily cleared for a while.
Zhu Ming’s face turned red with anger and shame.
"Damn it, this is so embarrassing, where did this country bumpkin come from, he actually saved the person, isn’t this undermining me!" Zhu Ming roared in his heart.
Lin Fan helped the old man sit up, packed away the silver needles, and was about to return to his seat.
"Thank you for saving my grandfather, I was wrong just now, I should have trusted you from the start, I’m sorry."
After settling the old man, the woman approached Lin Fan, feeling a bit ashamed, remembering how she didn’t believe in Lin Fan before, she felt very regretful.
"No problem, no need to apologize, just settle the treatment fee." Lin Fan smiled slightly.
What?
The woman froze, not expecting Lin Fan to ask for money.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: What you care about, I don’t value at all
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Chapter 559: What you care about, I don’t value at all
The beauty came to her senses and immediately smiled, saying, "Of course, of course, how much does the Divine Doctor charge?"
Lin Fan is now the resident doctor at a village clinic, and this money is collected for the clinic.
Lin Fan thought very seriously and said, "I think 50 yuan should be enough."
The prices at the clinic are about that, too.
Everyone was taken aback, that’s too little! They thought he would charge hundreds of thousands of yuan, after all, saving a life, even hundreds of thousands would seem cheap!
But he only charged 50 yuan, how honest!
Lin Fan heard Liu Zixing say that Old Liu charges the villagers a few yuan for minor illnesses, and a few dozen, or even a hundred, yuan for major ones. This time, saving the elderly from dying, charging 50 yuan is very reasonable.
Compared to hospitals, this is indeed very honest. Nowadays, hospitals are practically like robbers; a simple cold costs hundreds of yuan to treat. If you have a major illness, you often have to spend everything you have and go into debt, ending up back at square one.
"If the beauty thinks it’s too expensive, I’ll give you a 50% discount!" Lin Fan said.
Everyone almost fell over.
The beauty was stunned for a long time, not knowing what to say. This was too honest. In today’s society, everything costs money and nothing is cheap. High prices are the norm, so encountering such an honest price is quite an adjustment.
The beauty instinctively took a 50-yuan note from her bag and handed it to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took it and said, "Thanks!"
Lin Fan himself isn’t short on money; he could offer free treatment. But since this money is for the clinic, he still needs to collect it.
The beauty said, "Divine Doctor, I haven’t asked for your esteemed name yet. By the way, let me introduce myself. My surname is Sheng, and my name is Sheng Wanqing."
Zhu Ming, sitting in the back of the vehicle, felt very embarrassed because he had failed to save the old man, and was now eager to get out of the car.
At this moment, he heard the beauty introduce herself, his eyes lit up, surname Sheng?
Could it be...
The surname Sheng is quite rare, especially in this county; people with the surname Sheng are likely from that family!
In this small county, there is a Sheng Family, said to be the wealthiest in the county. Besides the wealth, the Sheng Family has officials in the government: the County Committee Secretary is from the Sheng Family, and also, the local mayor is the son-in-law of the Sheng Family.
It can be said that the Sheng Family is powerful and wealthy locally, and countless people want to curry favor with them.
If this Sheng Wanqing really is from that Sheng Family...
Zhu Ming felt a pang of regret like losing a fortune, as he had a chance to connect with the Sheng Family, but because he failed to save an old man, he lost this great opportunity, leaving Lin Fan, this country bumpkin, to gain the chance.
For a moment, Zhu Ming grew envious and resentful of Lin Fan.
However, the possibility of Sheng Wanqing being from that Sheng Family should be unlikely; why would someone from the prestigious Sheng Family be on this country bus, of all places? Thinking this, Zhu Ming felt a bit better.
Lin Fan, however, didn’t know anything about the Sheng Family, had no thoughts about it, and said, "My name is Lin Fan."
Sheng Wanqing said, "So you’re Divine Doctor Lin. Divine Doctor Lin, what’s wrong with my grandpa? Will he get better?"
Lin Fan said, "Are you asking me to continue treating your grandpa?"
Sheng Wanqing replied, "Yes, I hope Divine Doctor Lin can agree. Money isn’t an issue; as long as grandpa can be cured, you can charge as much as you want."
Lin Fan said, "It’s not about money. Your grandpa’s illness is a bit tricky, and we’re almost to the city. I don’t have time now. How about this, when I have time, I’ll come and check on your grandpa. You can give me your address."
Lin Fan discovered the deep-rooted illness of the old man when he treated him earlier with the Silver Needle. Although they were strangers meeting by chance, he didn’t need to say more.
Now that Sheng Wanqing requested his help, it was a different story.
Upon hearing this, Sheng Wanqing gladly agreed, "Thank you so much, Divine Doctor Lin. Our home is at Bamboo Immortal Street in the county town. Here’s my phone number. Call me when you’re free, and I’ll come to pick you up personally."
Sheng Wanqing took out a pen and paper and wrote down a number for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took it casually, put it into his pocket. He promised to go and when he has time, he will definitely go.
Bamboo Immortal Street!
Hearing this location, Zhu Ming at the back was stunned.
Bamboo Immortal Street Sheng Family!
On Bamboo Immortal Street, there’s only one Sheng Family, the one that’s wealthy and influential!
There’s no mistake, Sheng Wanqing really is part of that Sheng Family!
Oh my!
Zhu Ming was instantly immensely dejected. There was no mistake this time, it feels like losing a fortune!
Lin Fan, you damn country bumpkin, the opportunity to attach to the Sheng Family was mine, and you, this damn country bumpkin, snatched that chance away!
Zhu Ming was gnashing his teeth in hatred.
Little did he know that Lin Fan didn’t recognize the Sheng Family at all, and even if he knew what the Sheng Family represented locally, Lin Fan wouldn’t care, let alone aim to curry favor.
Because Lin Fan is the richest man in Yun City himself.
Could the Sheng Family be wealthier than him!
If Zhu Ming knew that what he cared about was of no interest to Lin Fan, this would probably be the biggest blow of all.
Sheng Wanqing was very happy and even a bit excited; she never thought she’d meet a divine doctor, a real divine doctor, on this bus!
Her grandpa’s illness had persisted for quite some time, and despite the Sheng Family’s search for medical treatment, there was no improvement. This time, because she heard that there was a great old Chinese medicine doctor in a nearby rural area, Sheng Wanqing drove hundreds of miles to the remote backwater to find this old Chinese medicine doctor.
In the end, the old medicine doctor asked for a hundred thousand for a house call, and after prescribing a pile of Chinese medicine for grandpa, charged another hundred thousand. However, her grandpa’s condition showed no improvement.
Sheng Wanqing was helpless. The money was spent, and couldn’t be recovered, so she had to send her grandfather back to the county town.
On the way back, her car broke down, so she had to take the country bus with her grandfather back to the county town.
Perhaps it was fate. If her car hadn’t broken down, she wouldn’t have taken this bus and met Lin Fan!
Afterwards, when the rural bus arrived at the county town stop, the passengers got off one after another.
After getting off, the now-recovered old man, assisted by Sheng Wanqing, came to Lin Fan.
The old man enthusiastically shook hands with Lin Fan and said, "Thank you so much, Young Divine Doctor, for saving my life today. Just now I was too weak to thank you properly, so I specially came to thank you now. Besides, my granddaughter was rude to you, so I also want to formally apologize to you!"
Sheng Wanqing blushed and looked embarrassed.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s alright, I didn’t mind."
"Young Divine Doctor, you truly have a broad heart. By the way, I’m Shengfu Sword." The old man said.
Lin Fan said, "My name is Lin Fan."
"Divine Doctor Lin, our Sheng Family has some connections locally, so if you need anything in the future, don’t hesitate to find me." Shengfu Sword said with a friendly smile, with a tone of confidence and pride, implying that not everyone could receive such a promise. He offered it to Lin Fan out of respect and regard.
Lin Fan casually responded with a nod, completely unaware of what the Sheng Family was or what Shengfu Sword was capable of, nor did he care.
Seeing this, Shengfu Sword felt a bit embarrassed. This Divine Doctor Lin seemed not to take the Sheng Family seriously, did he?
Sheng Wanqing was also curious, given the status of the Sheng Family in the local area, could it be that it didn’t catch the Divine Doctor’s eye?
This Divine Doctor, with his modest appearance, apart from his exceptional medical skill, appeared to have no significant background, right?
With these thoughts, the grandfather and granddaughter couldn’t help but feel a bit puzzled.
"Divine Doctor, I originally wanted to invite you to our home right now, but I heard from Wanqing that you’re busy?" Shengfu Sword asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 560: The Genius Doctor Right in Front of You
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Chapter 560: The Genius Doctor Right in Front of You
Lin Fan nodded: "I’m here in the county to take care of some matters."
Shengfu Sword said: "Divine Doctor Lin, where are you headed? In a while, there will be a car from home to pick us up. Should I have someone take Divine Doctor Lin there?"
Lin Fan replied: "No need to trouble yourself, I’ll just take the bus. Don’t worry, sir, when I have some time, I’ll definitely help you with your treatment."
Shengfu Sword was so enthusiastic mainly because he was worried that Lin Fan wouldn’t come to help him with his illness. Since Lin Fan had promised to help him, he wouldn’t go back on his word.
With Lin Fan’s reassurance, Shengfu Sword was relieved.
Not long after, a Bentley arrived and took the grandfather and grandson away. In this small county, driving a Bentley was quite remarkable.
Lin Fan realized when he saw the Bentley that Shengfu Sword was probably wealthy. A Bentley is priced in the millions; in this small county, how many people could afford it?
Lin Fan used to attend middle school in the county, but he was mostly oblivious to outside affairs. He went to a prominent high school in the city during high school, so he rarely visited the county. Later, he attended college in Yun City, so he was completely unaware of the county’s wealthy circles.
The Bentley attracted the attention of some passersby who began to gossip.
"Look quickly, it’s a car from the Sheng family!"
"The Sheng family is really rich; this is a Bentley, right? I’ve heard it costs millions!"
"Indeed, the Sheng family is both wealthy and influential!"
"You can’t find anyone wealthier than the Sheng family in our county!"
Everyone was amazed by the Sheng family’s wealth.
What they didn’t know was that there really was someone wealthier than the Sheng family in the county, and he was right in front of them, yet they had no idea.
Lin Fan!
"Don’t speak so loudly; be careful, the Sheng family is not to be trifled with!"
"Let’s disperse; we can’t exactly envy the Sheng family."
As the Bentley left, the crowd gradually dispersed.
Lin Fan stood under the street sign, waiting for the bus to the hospital. He turned around and noticed Zhu Ming also waiting for the bus.
Zhu Ming was a doctor and seemed to be quite well-known. He wondered why Zhu Ming was taking the rural bus.
No matter how famous Zhu Ming was, to Lin Fan, Zhu Ming’s medical skill was not remarkable.
In fact, Zhu Ming was a medical Ph.D., and his medical skills were quite good among the younger generation.
But unfortunately, he met Lin Fan, who possessed top-tier medical skill. In Lin Fan’s eyes, even the most skilled doctors in the world were just average.
Top-tier medical skill is just that impressive!
Zhu Ming also noticed Lin Fan waiting for the bus and showed a disdainful expression.
Earlier, Shengfu Sword had offered to use his family’s car for Lin Fan, but Lin Fan refused and now was waiting for the bus. This country bumpkin really knows how to pretend, acting like he doesn’t care about fame or fortune, probably laughing inside.
Thinking about the opportunity to latch onto the Sheng family that was originally his but taken away by Lin Fan, Zhu Ming was quite resentful.
Before long, a bus arrived.
Zhu Ming was surprised to find Lin Fan boarding the same bus as him.
Arriving at the county hospital, Zhu Ming was even more surprised to find Lin Fan’s destination was also the county hospital!
After getting off the bus, Lin Fan went straight into the county hospital.
This guy, what is he doing at the hospital?
Zhu Ming was a bit curious.
At that moment, a female doctor walked by and saw Zhu Ming and immediately showed a respectful expression: "Dr. Zhu, you’re back?"
Zhu Ming grabbed the female doctor and pointed at Lin Fan: "Do you know who that person is?"
The female doctor looked at Lin Fan’s back and wondered: "I don’t recognize him; should be a patient’s family member?"
Zhu Ming frowned, wondering if Lin Fan’s medical skills were so impressive, why he needed to come to the hospital.
"Help me find out who he is and tell me later, but be careful not to let him know." Zhu Ming instructed.
The female doctor usually admired Zhu Ming quite a lot; after all, Zhu Ming was a very skilled doctor, known far and wide, garnering many admirers.
The female doctor immediately agreed.
Yesterday, Lin Fan had brought Lin Dawei back to the county and gave him an IV drip at the county hospital. At the time, Lin Dawei’s body was still weak, and he was in a deep sleep.
After a day of IV drips, Lin Dawei had already woken up and was chatting with Lin Shanshan.
Lin Dawei learned from Lin Shanshan that he had almost died and that Lin Fan had rescued him. Lin Dawei was quite surprised. When did Little Fan learn such impressive medical skills?
Even Lin Shanshan didn’t know and said: "I don’t know either, but brother saved you, I saw it with my own eyes, it can’t be false. Brother keeps surprising us; as his sister, I don’t even know how many surprises he has in store!"
They didn’t realize that Lin Fan had a system, and even Lin Fan himself couldn’t predict what surprises lay ahead.
Lin Fan suddenly possessed extraordinary medical skills, surprising Lin Shanshan. Her current brother was entirely different from the brother she remembered. Her brother used to be a delivery man, but now he’s the richest man in Yun City, and he’s skilled in so many areas, even medicine.
Her brother is living a life with hacks. What has he been through?
Lin Shanshan was completely baffled by this question.
At that moment, Lin Fan walked in, smiling: "Third Uncle is awake."
Lin Dawei said: "Yes, Little Fan, I’ve heard from Shanshan, it was you who saved me. When did you learn medical skills?"
Lin Fan said: "I taught myself."
Lin Dawei said: "Self-taught medical skills? If I knew you were this good, there was no need to waste money for hospital treatment; that ward was too expensive."
Lin Fan said: "I only started learning medical skills when Third Uncle was hospitalized. I was worried about unreliable doctors, but I couldn’t tell if they were reliable or not, so I taught myself medical skills because I didn’t like being at the mercy of doctors."
Lin Fan said this casually.
Lin Dawei was amazed. So Lin Fan only self-taught medical skills for three months and was already this skilled? Could he be a medicinal prodigy?
If they had known Lin Fan had such a high talent for medicine, they would have let him study medicine back then. Lin Dawei felt wistful.
"Third Uncle, your complexion looks good, and you’re recovering well. After one more infusion, we can go home this afternoon." Lin Fan said.
Lin Dawei was delighted: "That’s great, I’ve been away from home for three months; I miss it so much."
Lin Fan had specifically instructed Lin Shanshan not to tell Lin Dawei about being poisoned.
That’s also the reason Lin Fan brought Lin Dawei back to the countryside. There was no need to worry Third Uncle about this; Lin Fan would handle everything afterward, and once he returned to Yun City, he would surely find the culprit who poisoned him.
Just then, a middle-aged male doctor in a white coat walked in.
The surname of the doctor was Li, responsible for Lin Dawei’s care.
Lin Fan returned quite low-key this time and did not reveal his medical skills. He was at the county hospital solely because Lin Dawei needed IV drips.
Dr. Li, who received Lin Dawei, checked on Lin Dawei’s condition and took the initiative to recommend IV drips for Lin Dawei, which suited Lin Fan well.
Now Dr. Li came to observe Lin Dawei’s condition.
"So, how are you feeling? Any dizziness after waking up?" Dr. Li asked. This Dr. Li was quite responsible.
Lin Dawei said: "No, I feel quite well."
Lin Fan said: "Dr. Li, my uncle’s problem isn’t major. I plan to discharge him this afternoon."
Dr. Li immediately rejected: "This family member, do you know how serious the patient’s condition is? He can’t be discharged so soon; he needs to be observed in the hospital for several more days."
Lin Fan replied: "I don’t think there’s any need."
Dr. Li said gravely: "It seems you don’t understand. Your uncle just narrowly escaped death. It’s a stroke of luck that the doctor who operated on him was a genius. If not for this genius doctor, he would surely have died."
Lin Dawei and Lin Shanshan exchanged glances and both almost laughed. The genius doctor is right in front of you!

chapters.title: Chapter 561: Do you have a medical license?
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Chapter 561: Do you have a medical license?
County Hospital.
As soon as Dr. Zhu Ming returned, he was summoned by the hospital director, along with several senior doctors in attendance.
"Xiaozhu, finally got you back here. Come sit down, the situation is urgent, so I’ll get straight to the point," said the director.
It turned out that Zhu Ming had previously received a task to lead a group for a rural medical outreach. As one of the top-ranked doctors in the prefecture city, Zhu Ming’s presence in rural consultations was naturally very popular.
However, Zhu Ming was suddenly called back to the county hospital by the director. Unaware of the circumstances, he took the rural bus back.
The director said, "Here’s the situation. Our hospital received an important patient last night, the county mayor’s mother. There’s no need to emphasize how important she is; the older lady’s condition isn’t very optimistic and requires surgical treatment, scheduled for this afternoon! We’ve already formed an expert group for consultation, and after discussion, we’ve unanimously decided that Xiaozhu should perform the surgery!"
Zhu Ming was stunned. The county mayor’s mother!
This certainly could not be taken lightly!
Having him perform the surgery brought some pressure but also indicated that everyone believed he was capable. Otherwise, who would joke about such a thing?
Zhu Ming immediately felt a bit elated and said, "Director, rest assured, I will do my best with the surgery!"
The director smiled and said, "Everyone made such a proposal, and I immediately agreed because, for this surgery, in all of Tianhai City, only you can perform it. I believe you won’t let everyone down; there is still time now, so let’s research this surgery together to ensure it goes flawlessly."
Here, they were researching the county mayor’s mother’s condition.
Meanwhile, Dr. Li was adamantly opposing Lin Dawei’s discharge.
Lin Fan explained, "Dr. Li, the reason my uncle was admitted is due to weakness and needing an IV. His condition has now stabilized, and I don’t see the necessity anymore."
Dr. Li’s eyes widened and said, "Are you the doctor, or am I the doctor? I’m the doctor, right? Of course, you have to listen to me. I’m responsible for him, so I have to be fully responsible; I can’t be careless. Family members don’t need to say more."
Lin Fan broke into a sweat. This Dr. Li was indeed very responsible; from his level of medical expertise, keeping Lin Dawei in the hospital for observation could be a prudent approach.
But from Lin Fan’s perspective, who possessed top-tier medical skills, Lin Dawei could completely be discharged; there was no need to waste time in the hospital.
Lin Fan also wanted to settle Lin Dawei quickly and return to Yun City; he had a company valued at two trillion to manage there!
Lin Fan said, "Dr. Li, I do have some medical skills. In my opinion, my uncle doesn’t need to stay hospitalized anymore."
Dr. Li sneered and said, "You have some medical skills? Which medical school did you graduate from, do you have a practice license?"
Lin Fan broke into a sweat: "I really don’t have that."
Even though he had top-tier medical skills, he was not a medical school graduate and hadn’t taken any practice license examinations.
Dr. Li said, "That’s it. Without a practice license, do you think you can replace me in doing my job? No need to say more, the patient will stay for observation for a few more days! I know you want to save money, but you can’t save on this!"
Dr. Li was truly a responsible good doctor, speaking earnestly, not allowing Lin Dawei to be discharged.
Lin Dawei became a bit anxious: "Doctor, I am eager to return to the countryside. I have left for several months and miss home; I don’t want to stay here."
Dr. Li said: "Is going back to the countryside more important than your life? Do you not care about your life anymore?"
Lin Dawei said: "Let’s put it this way, to be honest. Actually, my life was saved by my nephew. The surgery was done by my nephew, whom you call a genius doctor. Dr. Li, saying this, you should know, my nephew can fully decide whether I can be discharged."
Dr. Li was stunned, then burst into laughter.
"Old man, you are so humorous, saying such a lie to be discharged, he is the genius doctor? Sorry, I can’t help but laugh!" Dr. Li said.
A genius doctor without a practice license would naturally be a joke in the eyes of a professional doctor.
As Dr. Li saw it, this was Lin Dawei lying to be discharged.
He wouldn’t believe it, what a joke; could this kid be a genius doctor?
"Enough, everyone, I understand your eagerness to go home, but don’t go overboard; do you know what disregard for doctor’s advice means? It means not listening to the doctor can easily lead to suffering! No more talking, I have other patients to check, can’t waste time arguing with you, stay for observation for a few more days, did you hear? I’ll have the nurse give you another IV soon."
Dr. Li said imperatively before turning and leaving.
Lin Dawei smiled bitterly and said: "Little Fan, what should we do? Dr. Li won’t allow discharge; I really want to go home."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "It’s okay, Third Uncle, just stay here for the IV while I go out to handle some matters, and we’ll process the discharge in the afternoon."
Although Lin Fan didn’t have a practice license, he understood some hospital regulations. Even if a doctor doesn’t allow discharge, a patient can force discharge as long as signing a hospital waiver.
Ensuring that if there’s any worsening condition after discharge, the hospital bears no responsibility, fully taken by the patient’s side.
So, Lin Dawei continued staying in the hospital for the IV drip while Lin Fan walked out alone. He came to the city not only for Lin Dawei but also to stock up on some clinic supplies.
He planned to visit the medicinal market next.
Arriving at the hospital entrance.
Lin Fan suddenly saw a line of cars pulling up to the hospital entrance, with two cars in front and back protecting the car in the middle.
Once at the hospital entrance, security guards in uniforms got out first to open the road and made protective arrangements all around while passers-by stepped aside.
This fanfare indicated that some big figure was probably about to appear.
Then a middle-aged man stepped out of the black sedan in the middle, corpulent, and his demeanor made it clear he was an official.
Under the protection of security, this middle-aged man entered the hospital.
Surrounding passers-by were discussing.
"The county mayor is here!"
"What is the county mayor doing at the hospital?"
"I heard his mother is ill and receiving treatment at the county hospital!"
Lin Fan mentally noted the situation, taking another glance at the middle-aged man, realizing he was the county mayor.
He didn’t pay much mind and then left.
The county mayor, worried about his mother’s condition, personally came to the hospital.
The hospital director learned the county mayor had arrived in person and urgently brought a group of experts to meet him.
"How is my mother’s condition? I heard surgery needs to be done, is there any risk?" The county mayor asked the director immediately.
The director promptly replied, "Yes, we decided to perform the surgery on the elder, with Dr. Zhu Ming as the chief surgeon."
The county mayor happily said, "Dr. Zhu Ming as the chief surgeon? Great, with Dr. Zhu Ming around, I’m relieved."
Hearing these words made Zhu Ming feel almost over the moon; his medical skills had been acknowledged by the county mayor. This was truly a rare opportunity, sealing a bright future for him if he performed this surgery well.
Having missed the chance to ally with the Sheng Family, he absolutely couldn’t miss this opportunity.
Zhu Ming confidently said immediately, "Thanks very much to the county mayor for the acknowledgment, rest assured, after my initial research, your mother’s surgery will be completed smoothly."

chapters.title: Chapter 562: Unexpected Encounter with an Old Classmate, Lin Fan, Are You Married?
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Chapter 562: Unexpected Encounter with an Old Classmate, Lin Fan, Are You Married?
Lin Fan arrived at the county’s herbal medicine market and casually strolled around. The market wasn’t large, but it had all the basic herbs, sufficient for a small clinic’s needs. Lin Fan picked some herbs and asked the vendor to deliver them directly to the West River Village clinic.
Having settled the herbal matter, Lin Fan left the market. Seeing that it was still early, he remembered his promise to help Shengfu Sword with a diagnosis and decided to visit the Sheng Family.
"Lin Fan?"
As Lin Fan was walking, he suddenly heard someone speaking beside him.
Turning his head, Lin Fan saw a man with three kids, the oldest about four or five years old, and the youngest still being carried by the man.
Lin Fan didn’t recognize the man at first, though his face seemed familiar, but he couldn’t recall his name.
"Lin Fan, it really is you!" The man grinned. "It’s me, Old Chen!"
Old Chen!
It suddenly dawned on Lin Fan that Old Chen was actually Chen Xinxing, a classmate from middle school who once shared a desk with him.
After graduating middle school, Lin Fan hadn’t seen Chen Xinxing at all; meeting him again after so many years was unexpected.
This was already quite a coincidence, given that most people in our lives are just passersby. Once contact is lost, many won’t be seen again in a lifetime. With time, you might even forget they existed; even if their face is remembered, their name becomes elusive.
No one is exempt from this.
Lin Fan had a pretty good memory too, but he only remembered when Chen Xinxing mentioned his own name.
"Old Chen! What a coincidence!" Lin Fan laughed. "These kids..."
Lin Fan glanced at the three children.
Chen Xinxing said, "These are my kids. Say hi to Uncle!"
Except for the one being carried, the other two could already speak. They shyly called out "Uncle."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Old Chen, I didn’t expect you to have three kids already. A complete set, how happy you must be."
Chen Xinxing replied, "Happy, my ass. Raising these three is so tiring, everything needs money. The oldest is about to start school, and then there’s tuition. The youngest is still on formula, do you know how expensive it is nowadays..."
With these complaints, it was clear he was genuinely worried about livelihood.
Lin Fan noticed that although Chen Xinxing was the same age as him, he looked ten years older, and was balding... no wonder Lin Fan didn’t recognize him at first glance.
There were many like Chen Xinxing, young men from the countryside who got married right after middle school, started families early, and had a bunch of kids.
Even among the people Lin Fan knew, there were several middle school classmates who didn’t go on to high school, got married quickly, both boys and girls. Girls marrying and having children right out of middle school, youth squandered early in marriage and family.
Realizing he talked too much, Chen Xinxing smiled awkwardly, "Enough about me. What about you, Lin Fan, are you married yet?"
Lin Fan answered, "No, I don’t even have a girlfriend."
Chen Xinxing said, "No way, you’re so handsome, how can you not have a girlfriend? You can’t just focus on studying, are you still in school? Doing a Ph.D.?"
Lin Fan replied, "I started working right after university."
Chen Xinxing said, "Then you should find a wife soon. Or do you want to end up like those city folks, single at 30, an aging bachelor? It’s best to marry early and have kids, even though raising them is tough. It’s comforting to know someone will take care of you when you’re old. If you start late, by the time the kids finish school, you’ll be old..."
Lin Fan sweated, realizing that Chen Xinxing had none of the youthful traits from their school days. Now, his life was dominated by talk of family and kids... he was completely a different person, not someone of Lin Fan’s age, more like an uncle or auntie.
Is it true that all the boys and girls of our youth eventually get worn down into uncles and aunties by life?
"You still need someone to be with," Lin Fan said absentmindedly. The conversation about this didn’t interest him; he wanted to end it quickly.
Chen Xinxing laughed, "Finding someone shouldn’t be hard, go on blind dates. I met my wife through one. Plenty of rural girls waiting to get married. You’re handsome with education, surely you won’t lack options? Oh, do you remember our class belle Lai Xiaomei?"
Lin Fan answered, "I remember her, what about her?"
Lai Xiaomei was the class belle, a prominent figure, the goddess in many boys’ eyes. Many could easily be forgotten like background characters, but prominent figures were not easily forgotten.
Chen Xinxing said, "There was a middle school reunion recently, I heard about it there. Lai Xiaomei hasn’t married either, and she still looks great. She’s made something of herself, not only beautiful but also started a company. Tianhai High School’s centennial celebration even invited her as a special guest. Oh, Lin Fan, you were accepted into Tianhai High School too, weren’t you invited by the school?"
Lin Fan felt a bit embarrassed, "No."
He didn’t even know about the centennial celebration until now, hearing it from Chen Xinxing.
Back during the high school entrance exam, Lin Fan’s results were neither top nor bottom, enough to get into the city’s key high school, Tianhai High School, along with class belle, top student Lai Xiaomei.
Years later, classmates all had their own lives, a few outstanding students achieved success, the school invited these exceptional alumni for the centennial, whereas most of the regular students received no invitation, fading like dust.
Unluckily, Lin Fan belonged to that forgotten dust category.
Chen Xinxing said, "Not to change the topic, but since you’re single and so is Lai Xiaomei, why don’t you consider going on a blind date with her? Forgot to ask, Lin Fan, what business are you in now?"
Lin Fan, not wanting to boast, said, "I’m working as a delivery rider."
Chen Xinxing was stunned, "A delivery rider..."
He looked a bit embarrassed as he realized that Lin Fan delivering food didn’t seem to match the successful Lai Xiaomei at all...
He began to understand why Lin Fan was still single; in a big city, a delivery rider indeed finds it hard to date.
These days, even rural girls have many demands when it comes to blind dates, owning a car and a house are basic requirements.
Times have changed, and Chen Xinxing felt lucky to have married early. Back then, he had nothing when he married his current wife. If it were today, he wouldn’t have been able to marry. Now, girls ask for cars and houses, and every daughter seems to be treated as precious, almost like parents are auctioning them off.
Having completely lost interest in the conversation, Lin Fan said, "Old Chen, let’s chat again next time. I have some things to do now."
Chen Xinxing laughed, "Alright, let’s exchange WeChat. I’ll keep an eye out for any unmarried girls I can introduce you to."

chapters.title: Chapter 563: Sheng Family’s Security Guard Was Scared Stiff
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Chapter 563: Sheng Family’s Security Guard Was Scared Stiff
Lin Fan felt a headache; he really didn’t want to go on a blind date, but it was hard to refuse Chen Xinxing, so he added Chen Xinxing on WeChat.
"By the way, Old Chen, do you know how to get to Bamboo Immortal Street?" Lin Fan asked.
Chen Xinxing said, "Bamboo Immortal Street? It’s nearby. Lin Fan, what are you going to do there?"
Chen Xinxing was a bit curious; Bamboo Immortal Street was most famous for the big Sheng Family located there.
Lin Fan said, "Just meeting someone."
Chen Xinxing let out an "oh," thinking Lin Fan’s visit to Bamboo Immortal Street might be related to the Sheng Family, but then dismissed the thought, as Lin Fan was just a delivery guy; how could he have any connection with such a big family?
Little did he know, Lin Fan’s visit to Bamboo Immortal Street was indeed related to the Sheng Family.
After asking Chen Xinxing for directions, Lin Fan bid farewell and headed to Bamboo Immortal Street.
At the end of Bamboo Immortal Street, a grand villa stood imposingly, catching the attention of passersby who couldn’t help but take a few more looks, enviously remarking how nice it must be to be rich.
This was the Sheng Family mansion.
Lin Fan had promised to come and treat Shengfu Sword, and he wouldn’t go back on his word.
He arrived and went straight to the gate of the Sheng Family mansion.
Lin Fan’s presence immediately caught the attention of the security guards at the mansion, who saw someone dressed simply approaching and, noticing his plain appearance, stopped him cautiously.
"What are you doing? Don’t come any closer; this is not a place for you!" the security guard barked unceremoniously.
Lin Fan didn’t mind. When he worked as a delivery driver, he was used to security guards barking at him. Even the security guards in ordinary neighborhoods could act arrogantly, let alone those of the Sheng Family.
"I’m here to see Mr. Shengfu Sword. Could you please help inform him that Lin Fan is here?" Lin Fan smiled and said.
Shengfu Sword!
The security guard’s face changed; who was Shengfu Sword, but the old master of the Sheng Family, and yet Lin Fan called him by name!
Who was Lin Fan to immediately ask for the old master? The security guard was hesitant at first but then thought better of it; how could someone dressed so poorly have any real connection? Maybe he was here to cause trouble.
"Are you here to cause trouble? I’d advise against it..."
the security guard said, attempting to drive Lin Fan away.
Just then, another middle-aged security guard suddenly came out from inside and approached Lin Fan, respectfully asking, "Are you Mr. Lin Fan?"
The first security guard realized this was their supervisor!
The Sheng Family was a big family with a team of security guards; this middle-aged guard was the supervisor.
Seeing the supervisor treat Lin Fan with such deference, the security guard was baffled; what was going on?
Lin Fan said, "Yes, I am."
The security supervisor immediately apologized, "I am really sorry, Mr. Lin. The old master gave me instructions today; if Mr. Lin came, we must not neglect you. I intended to notify all the guards, but I was a bit busy and forgot. I hope Mr. Lin will not take offense at this one’s rudeness; otherwise, if the old master found out, it might cost us our jobs."
The supervisor pleaded humbly.
The security guard beside him started sweating profusely; who on earth was this plainly dressed man?
"Hurry up and apologize to Mr. Lin!" the supervisor shot a glare at him.
The security guard quickly bowed, "I’m sorry, Mr. Lin, I didn’t know..."
Lin Fan waved his hand, "It’s alright, don’t worry about it. Please take me to see the old master."
The supervisor said, "Certainly, Mr. Lin, please follow me."
The security supervisor personally led Lin Fan into the Sheng Family mansion.
The security guard wiped his sweat, who exactly was this person?
Shortly after, the supervisor returned, and the security guard eagerly inquired, "Supervisor, who was that person just now?"
The supervisor said, "That’s the doctor treating the old master, supposedly a divine healer. The old master instructed us not to neglect him at all; otherwise, if we upset the divine healer, we could all lose our jobs. You see, this person can save the old master’s life; can we afford to provoke such a person? Making the divine healer unhappy is tantamount to opposing the old master’s life!"
The security guard was drenched in cold sweat, terrified, "Oh my god!"
The supervisor also looked fearful, "Fortunately, this divine healer has a good temper and didn’t take it seriously; otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable!"
The security guard nodded, wiping his sweat, realizing you can’t judge people by their appearance. Just because Lin Fan was dressed simply, he thought he could be bullied, but unknowingly, he had kicked a steel board.
Inside the Sheng Family mansion.
Upon learning Lin Fan had arrived, Shengfu Sword, supported by Sheng Wanqing, hurried out to greet him.
"Divine Doctor Lin, please have a seat," Shengfu Sword warmly said, "Wanqing, serve Mr. Lin some tea."
"Okay." Sheng Wanqing ran over and personally poured tea for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You’re too kind, old sir, I don’t deserve it."
Shengfu Sword earnestly replied, "Divine Doctor Lin is my savior. How could I dare to neglect my savior? I specifically instructed the guards, so I hope they didn’t offend you, Divine Doctor Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "No, they did not."
If Lin Fan had told the truth, the guard might face severe punishment or even lose his job immediately; Lin Fan thought it unnecessary.
"Divine Doctor Lin, have some tea," Sheng Wanqing offered a cup of tea, her cheeks slightly flushed.
The Divine Doctor not only had extraordinary medical skills but was also young and handsome. Despite his modest attire, his brilliance couldn’t be concealed, so much so that even the young lady of the Sheng Family felt a bit shy in his presence.
"Thank you." Lin Fan took the tea, sipped it, and noted that it was indeed premium-quality tea, befitting a wealthy family.
"Sir, I have something to take care of shortly and will be returning to the countryside afterwards. Let me briefly discuss your condition." Lin Fan put down the teacup, saying.
Shengfu Sword had been waiting for these words and said, "Alright, please go ahead, Divine Doctor Lin."
Lin Fan said, "Your illness is a result of old injuries. If I’m not mistaken, you were a soldier in the past and were hit by shrapnel during combat?"
Shengfu Sword was taken aback; Lin Fan truly was a divine doctor, amazingly even guessing that correctly!
Shengfu Sword said, "That’s right, I was in the military before, fought against invaders alongside one of the ten marshals, and during one battle, as a vanguard, I got hit by a stray bullet. It almost cost me my life, but after emergency rescue, I survived. However, I’ve had no issues since my recovery. Divine Doctor Lin, what exactly is going on?"
Lin Fan said, "Some injuries may seem healed, but they leave hidden ailments. It’s only a matter of time before they resurface, especially since you’re older now, making it more likely to act up."
Shengfu Sword said, "I see, so can my illness be cured, Divine Doctor Lin?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, it can. I previously used acupuncture to help clear it once; as long as I apply acupuncture again and you follow the prescribed medication, it can be completely cured within a month. If it wasn’t treated, the old sir might not have lived another year."
Shengfu Sword was thrilled. He knew his condition well; not only would it doom him within a year, but he might die at any moment, just like the incident on the bus today. If Lin Fan hadn’t rescued him, he would already be dead.
While Lin Fan was treating Shengfu Sword, an important surgery was starting at the county hospital.
Renowned young doctor Zhu Ming was the chief surgeon for the county mayor’s mother’s operation.
Zhu Ming was determined to succeed in this surgery, yet he had no idea a terrifying event was about to occur.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: It’s Truly Amazing
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Chapter 564: It’s Truly Amazing
The county hospital, operating room, an important surgery is underway here, with the patient being the county mayor’s mother, performed by the outstanding young doctor Zhu Ming, attracting much attention.
In this county, the county mayor is famous for his filial piety. It is said that he lost his father early and was raised by his mother through hardship, so he is very grateful to her.
A few days ago, his elderly mother suddenly had a stroke and was in critical condition. The mayor was very anxious and specially took leave to wait in the hospital for her surgery.
These days, the county mayor has lost his appetite, worried about his mother’s condition, with only one wish: that the surgery goes smoothly, saving his mother.
Learning that Dr. Zhu Ming would be leading the surgery, the county mayor felt relieved. Zhu Ming has a well-known reputation, holding a Ph.D. in medicine, and it’s from an overseas institution, carrying significant weight.
With Dr. Zhu on board, there shouldn’t be any problems.
The county mayor sat waiting outside the operating room, handling work calls while waiting. As the county mayor, his duties are busy, and if it weren’t for his mother’s surgery, he wouldn’t have been able to leave.
If not for trusting Zhu Ming, the county mayor would probably be too worried to think straight.
Suddenly, while the county mayor was on the phone, he noticed the operating room doors open and a nurse stepped out, with a grave expression on her face.
The county mayor stood up abruptly, disregarding the call, and exclaimed, "What happened?"
The nurse said, "County mayor, please remain calm. During the surgery, an unexpected situation occurred. Your mother suddenly had a spasm. Dr. Zhu is currently performing resuscitation, and you need to be informed of this situation."
The county mayor almost couldn’t hold his phone, shocked, "What? How could this happen?"
The nurse said, "The cause is unclear at the moment. That’s all I can say."
"My mother will be okay, right? After all, it’s Dr. Zhu!" the county mayor anxiously asked.
The nurse said, "I can’t guarantee anything right now, but we will do everything we can to save her."
After speaking, the nurse returned to the operating room and closed the door.
Inside the operating room, Zhu Ming was sweating profusely, scrambling to perform resuscitation on the patient.
For this surgery, Zhu Ming put all his skills to use, intending to make a good impression on the county mayor and gain his favor, as a stepping stone to mingling with powerful figures.
This type of stroke surgery was not Zhu Ming’s first; he was quite experienced and confident, thinking the surgery was foolproof.
Zhu Ming was full of confidence in himself, although he failed earlier while trying to save Shengfu Sword, considering it an accident rather than a reflection of his inadequate skills as Lin Fan claimed.
Zhu Ming envisioned himself as a highly skilled doctor with a high reputation, attracting many dignitaries and wealthy individuals for treatment, joining the upper social circles, and becoming a celebrated figure.
Due to his background, Zhu Ming valued fame and fortune greatly. Growing up in an ordinary family, he always aspired to enter high society, striving desperately to get closer to it.
Becoming an excellent doctor granted him this opportunity.
Earlier today, encountering Shengfu Sword by chance presented him an opportunity. Unfortunately, he failed to save Shengfu Sword, missing a great chance to associate with the Sheng family.
Now he had another chance to please the county mayor, which he was determined not to miss.
Initially, the surgery went smoothly, and Zhu Ming couldn’t help but show a bright smile, thinking that after the surgery was successful, he would earn the county mayor’s appreciation, and through this successful surgery, increase his reputation, entering high society, was just a matter of time!
However, an unforeseen complication occurred.
The patient suddenly had convulsions of unknown reason.
This situation left Zhu Ming bewildered, unsure of what to do for a moment, as he didn’t know what had happened, since such a situation had never occurred before.
Zhu Ming could only perform rescue attempts using conventional methods, but the patient’s condition did not improve; instead, it kept deteriorating.
The operating room was in chaos.
Behind a piece of glass, in the observation room, the hospital director and a group of doctors watched the surgery, equally frightened by this sudden situation.
"What happened?"
"Wasn’t the surgery going smoothly; what went wrong?"
"She’s the county mayor’s mother. Whatever the case, nothing must happen to her!"
"Dr. Zhu seems helpless; what should be done now?"
Everyone turned to the director.
The director was drenched in cold sweat. Before the surgery, he had boasted to the county mayor that with Dr. Zhu leading and a team of experts on standby, the mayor’s mother would certainly be fine.
In this situation, they had to prepare for the worst; the surgery might fail! The county mayor’s mother might die!
If indeed the worst happened, how would he face the county mayor?
And it’s not just a matter of explaining to the county mayor; the surgery has garnered much attention. If it fails, it would negatively impact the hospital’s reputation.
Amidst everyone’s anxious struggle.
In the Sheng family’s large house.
Lin Fan stood in front of Shengfu Sword, holding a silver needle, administering acupuncture.
He had explained the condition to Shengfu Sword, highlighting how, as a soldier in his youth, accompanying a general in battles, and being hit by a stray bullet, he had developed a chronic condition.
Now, in old age, the chronic condition had relapsed, causing Shengfu Sword’s health to decline rapidly, potentially triggering sudden critical illness and death.
Lin Fan used top-level acupuncture, the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles, to help Shengfu Sword regulate his body.
After a session of acupuncture, Shengfu Sword felt his body relaxed and refreshed, contrasting starkly from a frail person to one brimming with vitality.
Shengfu Sword felt rejuvenated.
Beside him, Sheng Wanqing said, "Grandpa, you seem completely different, as if much younger."
Shengfu Sword stood up, flexing his limbs, and laughed, "You’re correct, Grandpa feels youthful again. I could still carry a rifle and fight in a battle against the Little Devils!"
Sheng Wanqing marveled, "Divine Doctor Lin’s acupuncture is truly miraculous."
Shengfu Sword laughed heartily, "Divine Doctor Lin indeed is a divine doctor. My worn-out old body has rejuvenated so much, I can hardly believe it myself!"
Upon entering old age, his chronic condition had reemerged, plaguing him with pain and suffering.
He sought medical help everywhere, saw countless doctors, and took numerous medications. Any reputed doctor was consulted, with considerable expenses, yet the illness persisted, worsening with age.
Now, in the medical and martial arts community, many charlatans and fake masters had infiltrated, lacking true medical skills, solely chasing fame and fortune, masquerading as masters to deceive. When someone comes seeking treatment, they pretend, charging exorbitant fees, feigning treatment while genuinely making money.
As long as one’s reputation is big enough, fools will always come bringing money, just like a so-called Master Wang, whom many wealthy individuals and celebrities flock to, yet he is merely a deceptive fraud.
Frauds dominate, deceit runs rampant, and encountering someone with genuine skill and knowledge becomes rare and precious.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: What? Only charge 300 bucks!
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chapter 565: What? Only charge 300 bucks!
Shengfu Sword had encountered too many fake masters, those fake masters would ask for a treatment fee of a hundred thousand, sometimes even two hundred thousand or three hundred thousand. If it weren’t for the deep pockets of the Sheng Family, just being scammed by these fake masters would have left them penniless.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I used silver needles to clear the blocked meridians for the old gentleman. His body has now recovered about fifty percent. Next, he still needs to take medicine to completely cure the root cause of the disease. As they say, a disease strikes like a landslide but goes away like unraveling silk. Treating a disease is a gradual process. I’ll write a prescription for the old gentleman, and I hope he can take the medicine consistently and on time, so he can be fully healed."
Shengfu Sword quickly said, "Of course, whatever Divine Doctor Lin says goes. I have no other choice but to listen."
Sheng Wanqing brought over paper and pen.
Lin Fan immediately wrote out a prescription: "Follow this prescription to get the medicine, boil three bowls of water down to one bowl, once in the morning and once in the evening, continue for a month. After a month, halve the dosage, and after another month, the old gentleman’s body will be fully recovered."
"Noted, thank you, Divine Doctor Lin."
Shengfu Sword accepted the prescription with great respect, as if receiving an imperial edict. This was actually more important than an imperial edict because it was a life-saving prescription.
Lin Fan put away the silver needles and said, "The matter here is concluded. If there’s nothing else, I’ll be on my way."
Shengfu Sword hurriedly said, "Divine Doctor Lin, you saved an old man’s life; I owe you a debt of gratitude for giving me a second life. I can’t treat you poorly. As for the treatment fee, Divine Doctor Lin, feel free to name your price. Money is not an issue."
Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, "This acupuncture session was indeed quite difficult, so I’ll charge the old gentleman 300 yuan."
What?
Shengfu Sword and Sheng Wanqing exchanged a glance, their eyes filled with surprise, thinking they had misheard.
Lin Fan said, "Does the old gentleman find it too expensive? Then let’s make it 200 yuan instead."
The Sheng family grandfather and granddaughter broke out in cold sweat!
yuan, and still negotiable!
Shengfu Sword was a bit at a loss for words: "No, Divine Doctor Lin only charges 300? Did I hear that right? Really, only 300?"
Sheng Wanqing said, "In the past two years, I’ve taken grandpa to countless doctors. They all started at at least a hundred thousand, but none of them were any help! Now Divine Doctor Lin has cured grandpa, yet he’s only charging 300 yuan. Is this for real?"
They both thought they had misheard.
After being used to getting ripped off, they were not used to encountering someone with a conscience.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "I understand your feelings, you’ve probably been scammed too many times. Those scammers are after money and naturally charge high prices. From my perspective, this wasn’t a very difficult illness to treat. This price is quite fair."
Shengfu Sword said, "Divine Doctor Lin, you saved my life and only charge 300 yuan. I feel uneasy about this. How about I give you a million yuan in gratitude for saving my life!"
Shengfu Sword felt unbalanced. He had given those scammers hundreds of thousands, but only 300 for a real divine doctor? How unfair!
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "If I were after your money, I wouldn’t have treated you. I’m here primarily to treat you and charge a reasonable price. Giving me a million would actually be disrespectful to me."
Lin Fan knew full well that becoming a doctor to earn money is quite easy. Let alone doctors with real medical skills; even those fraudulent scammers find it easy to make money.
Being a doctor is a highly sought-after profession. A doctor working in a hospital earns a salary and various benefits. If they have some reputation, people will privately seek them out for treatment and pay handsomely.
Hospitals are also very profitable; using a set of equipment repeatedly, just a simple physical check-up, scanning machines, checking pulse, and doing blood tests can cost over a hundred yuan. If it’s a severe disease, it can’t be managed without tens of thousands.
You walk into a hospital with full pockets and leave with empty ones, as if going back decades overnight. Such things happen every day in hospitals.
Even with insurance, it’s often not much help, as it can’t cover everything. Besides, there are many situations where insurance doesn’t apply. Typically, a major illness will drain your funds.
Lin Fan had long been fed up with such a situation.
Now that he possessed top-notch medical skills, he treated patients without charging the exorbitant fees that hospitals do.
Simply put, he didn’t lack money!
Shengfu Sword offered him a million, which seemed like a significant treatment fee, even a considerable one.
But in Lin Fan’s view, a million was not much. He didn’t lack a million.
What he truly wanted was to use his top-notch medical skills to heal patients. As a doctor, curing diseases is the most important thing.
Hearing Lin Fan’s words, Shengfu Sword couldn’t help but feel a bit ashamed.
He realized that offering a million to Lin Fan was actually an insult. Divine Doctor Lin’s realm couldn’t be measured with money.
"Wanqing, as Divine Doctor Lin said, bring 300 yuan," Shengfu Sword said solemnly.
That Lin Fan only charged 300 yuan instantly elevated Lin Fan’s image in Shengfu Sword’s eyes. Originally, he was impressed by Divine Doctor Lin’s extraordinary medical skills. Now, he was utterly convinced by Lin Fan’s realm.
This young man was truly chosen by fate. Like a beam of righteous light in a chaotic world, to have such a realm at a young age, he was practically a divine being.
Shengfu Sword wanted to kneel for Lin Fan, to pay homage, bowing with utmost humility.
Sheng Wanqing picked up a wallet and took out three red bills.
Lin Fan accepted the 300 yuan and casually put it into his pants pocket. This 300 yuan would be considered as the income for the small clinic.
Having finished the consultation and collected the fee, Lin Fan intended to take his leave.
At this moment, a middle-aged man came in from outside, well-maintained, clearly accustomed to a luxurious life. His aura suggested a significant status and position.
"Decai, you’re back. Come and meet Divine Doctor Lin," Shengfu Sword called upon seeing the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man glanced at Lin Fan, a bit surprised: "Divine doctor?"
This young man looked only in his early twenties; how could he be a divine doctor? Could he be a scammer?
This was the middle-aged man’s first reaction. Indeed, Lin Fan was too young, not looking like a divine doctor at all.
Shengfu Sword introduced, "Let me introduce, this is Divine Doctor Lin, Lin Fan. Divine Doctor Lin, this is my eldest son Sheng Decai, currently the county party secretary of this county."
Sheng Decai, Shengfu Sword’s eldest son, Sheng Wanqing’s father, county party secretary!
County party secretary?
Lin Fan was a bit surprised. He didn’t know much about the Sheng family, and he hadn’t expected that the Sheng family was quite impressive.
Sheng Decai nodded slightly at Lin Fan, remaining skeptical about him being a divine doctor.
"Father, I heard you fainted on your way back today. I made time to come back and check on you. How are you feeling now?" Sheng Decai immediately and respectfully inquired after Shengfu Sword.
Shengfu Sword laughed and said, "Thanks to meeting Divine Doctor Lin, my illness is no longer a problem."
Sheng Wanqing added, "Yes, Divine Doctor Lin gave grandpa acupuncture, and his spirits have improved significantly. He’ll recover soon."
Sheng Decai was taken aback, glancing at Shengfu Sword, indeed noticing that his father’s complexion seemed much better.
Could it be... this young man really is a divine doctor?
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Sheng Decai received a phone call, and then he answered it.
After listening to the call.
Sheng Decai was somewhat anxious and said, "I’m sorry, I need to go to the hospital. The county chief’s mother was having surgery at the county hospital today and there was an accident. She’s not out of danger yet."
Shengfu Sword made a sound of surprise and said, "Perhaps you could invite Divine Doctor Lin to take a look."

chapters.title: Chapter 566: There Is Still One More Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chapter 566: There Is Still One More Person
The county hospital quickly spread a rumor, sparking people’s discussions.
"Have you heard? The county head’s mother is in trouble!"
"I heard there were complications during the surgery, she’s still being rescued, but the chances are slim!"
"No way, wasn’t it said that Dr. Zhu was personally handling it? How could this happen!"
"Even Dr. Zhu can’t save her, it seems the old lady truly can’t be saved."
"The county head is famously filial, he must be heartbroken now, it’s so tragic."
Everyone sighed.
Outside the operating room, the county head’s mindset was indeed collapsing. Knowing Dr. Zhu Ming was the lead surgeon originally reassured him, but he never expected things to turn out like this.
The hospital director brought a group of specialists to the county head, trying to calm his emotions. After all, if the county head blamed the hospital, it wouldn’t be good.
"County head, we have done our utmost but could not save your mother. We are truly sorry. After internal discussions among our expert group, we unanimously concluded that your mother’s condition is overly complex and beyond help."
"Dr. Zhu Ming is the most authoritative expert in this field, even he can’t do anything, which says enough."
"County head, your mother’s current condition is critical. Although I really don’t want to say this, out of responsibility, I have to tell you, I hope you’re prepared."
After speaking, the director let out a long sigh, expressing helplessness and regret.
The county head staggered, nearly collapsing, barely managing to stand as he asked, "Is my mother truly beyond saving?"
The director said, "That’s still up to Dr. Zhu Ming. Currently, Dr. Zhu is trying his best to save her, but our opinion is that it’s quite bleak."
Just then.
Someone suddenly said, "Dr. Zhu is out!"
Everyone turned their heads and sure enough saw Zhu Ming coming out of the operating room with a tired and dejected look, his face and clothes stained with blood—his face, the blood of the county head’s mother.
The county head saw Zhu Ming come out, his mind buzzing—could it be, his mother was already...
Thud!
Zhu Ming immediately knelt down upon seeing the county head.
"County head, I’m sorry, I’ve done my best but couldn’t save your mother." Zhu Ming cried, tears and snot everywhere.
The county head asked tremblingly, "My mother, she..."
Zhu Ming said, "Your mother still has a breath, it’s just... just that I am powerless!"
The county head walked over excitedly, clutching Zhu Ming’s collar, and lifted him up: "Bastard! As long as she’s not dead, you can’t give up! Get back to the operating room and continue saving her!"
Zhu Ming cried, "County head, I really can’t do anything, I’ve done everything I could."
He almost wanted to say, let me go.
Zhu Ming was under tremendous psychological pressure; he had high hopes for this surgery to earn himself a future.
But as the patient’s sudden condition occurred, despite all his efforts, it was to no avail, his mindset collapsed, the psychological pressure was like a mountain on him, the more urgent the situation, the worse it got, he couldn’t hold on anymore, nearly suffocating in the operating room, before escaping.
The county head angrily said, "The patient isn’t dead yet, and you’ve given up, you’re admitting incompetence!"
The director coughed twice and attempted to explain: "Here’s the thing, Dr. Zhu Ming valued this surgery highly, he might be feeling guilty, but one thing is certain, if even Dr. Zhu is helpless, it can only mean one thing, the chances of saving your mother are indeed slim."
Zhu Ming quickly said, "Yes, that’s the situation, county head, I believe there’s no one in this world who can save your mother; it’s not my problem."
All the doctors nodded in agreement.
The director continued explaining: "Our medical skill is quite advanced, our medical equipment very well-developed, but ultimately, medical skill has its limits, with today’s medical level, this is the limit, just like we still can’t conquer cancer, it’s a limitation of the overall medical level, hope the director understands."
The director shifted the blame to today’s medical level, leaving people speechless.
It’s like if a person’s limit is lifting 100 pounds, forcing them to lift 200 pounds, it’s impossible, unrealistic.
Upon hearing this, the county head powerlessly released Zhu Ming, what could he say, he couldn’t blame anyone for this, it was the limitation of medical skill that was making him lose his mother.
The director, seeing this, secretly breathed a sigh of relief, saying: "County head, your mother is suffering greatly now, there’s a decision the county head needs to make, whether to remove the ventilator to alleviate your mother’s suffering..."
"What?"
The county head was both saddened and helpless, being forced to make this decision was too cruel, he was known for his filial piety, he just wanted his mother alive, now he had to decide to let her end soon.
If he didn’t make this decision, his mother would suffer more, if he did, she would be completely gone.
As the county head, he normally had to make many decisions, he was always decisive, but this decision was the hardest one he ever had to make.
The director said, "Please accept my condolences, county head, I also wish someone in this world could save your mother, unfortunately, I can guarantee, there’s no such person, we can’t do anything now."
Everyone sighed.
"I don’t think so!"
At that moment, someone suddenly said.
Everyone followed the voice and saw a few people walking over.
Sheng Wanqing was supporting Shengfu Sword, and the county party secretary, Sheng Decai, was by their side!
The person who spoke was Shengfu Sword.
"Elder Sheng, you’ve arrived, what does your statement mean?" the county head quickly asked.
Everyone was surprised, looking at Shengfu Sword.
This was the head of the Sheng Family!
The Sheng Family was a large family in this small county, a wealthy and powerful family no one dared to provoke, with Sheng Decai, the county party secretary, as the eldest son, and others holding official positions in the city.
Now Shengfu Sword stood out, saying he didn’t think so, making people unable to dismiss his words lightly.
What did Shengfu Sword mean, denying the director’s words? Wasn’t this a slap in the face to the director?
The director blushed and asked, "Elder Sheng, what do you mean by this?"
Shengfu Sword said, "I believe there is someone who can save her!"
Impossible!
If this statement weren’t from Shengfu Sword, the director would surely have refuted it outright, but he wouldn’t dare talk to Shengfu Sword like that.
"Elder Sheng, I just explained very clearly, this is our experts’ group’s most rigorous discussion resulting in a unanimous view, we wouldn’t speak carelessly..."
The director tried to speak as gently as possible.
In other words, even if you Sheng Family have money and power, in this regard, you can’t have the final say, what can’t be saved can’t be saved, you can’t deny it just because you’re rich and influential.
At this time, the commotion here attracted many onlookers, including doctors, nurses, and the public.
Everyone was whispering and discussing.
"The hospital says the patient can’t be saved, but this Sheng Elder says she can, what’s going on?"
"This doesn’t match the hospital’s statement."
"But the hospital has experts, wouldn’t it be better to listen to the experts than to him?"
Most felt that Sheng Elder’s words were a bit unreasonable, after all, the hospital shouldn’t lie, the subject was the county head’s mother, if she could really be saved, the hospital had no reason not to save her.
The county head calmed down at this moment, stood up, and said, "Elder Sheng, you say there is someone who can save my mother, who is it, exactly?"
"Excuse me, please move aside!"
Just then, Lin Fan squeezed past the crowd and came over, chuckling, "Sorry, I just went to the restroom, where is the patient, I’ll go in and take a look."
What?
Everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 567: Prevent Lin Fan from entering the operating room
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Chapter 567: Prevent Lin Fan from entering the operating room
Did this young man just say he wants to go in and see the patient?
Everyone was stunned.
What’s going on?
And this young man is dressed plainly, you could say he looks quite rustic. He definitely seems like a countryside person. Did he come to the wrong place?
The dean and the experts were all taken aback. Could it be that the person Elder Sheng mentioned, who can save the patient, is this young man?
This is too outrageous. This young man isn’t even a doctor, right? He looks like he just came from the countryside. No, he definitely came from the countryside because no one else would dress like this!
Lin Fan was also helpless. He went back to his hometown yesterday and didn’t bring any clean clothes. He had to dig through his closet to find some old clothes to wear. He definitely looks quite rural. Of course, no matter how rustic his attire, it couldn’t hide Lin Fan’s charm.
"Elder Sheng, is this the person you were talking about?" the dean asked, wiping his cold sweat. If it wasn’t Shengfu Sword speaking, he would’ve already lashed out.
Shengfu Sword nodded, "That’s right, let me introduce you. This is Lin Fan, Divine Doctor Lin."
Divine Doctor Lin?
Everyone looked at each other in disbelief.
How could this rustic young man be called a divine doctor by Shengfu Sword? Is Shengfu Sword out of his mind?
Of course, no one dared to say Shengfu Sword was out of his mind. Given Shengfu Sword’s status, no one dared to offend him.
The dean could only speak as tactfully as possible: "Elder Sheng, is there some misunderstanding? I just explained to the county chief that with today’s medical level, no one can save the patient. Dr. Zhu Ming is a medical PhD who studied abroad. He essentially represents the highest medical standards for this illness."
Shengfu Sword chuckled, "I don’t care what the highest standard is. Your hospital is already out of options. It’s time for Divine Doctor Lin to take over."
The dean said, "Well... Forgive my impudence, Elder Sheng, may I ask which medical university this young man graduated from, the one you call a divine doctor?"
Lin Fan said, "I graduated from Yun University."
What?
The dean wiped his cold sweat, "Is Yun University Yun City University? As far as I know, Yun City University isn’t a medical school and has nothing to do with medicine."
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, my major in university wasn’t medicine."
Damn!
The dean nearly swore. A person who didn’t even study medicine at university dares to call himself a divine doctor!
If he wasn’t in front of Elder Sheng, he would really start swearing.
"So, it sounds like you don’t have a medical license either," the dean stated. After all, only graduates from formal medical schools could qualify for a medical license, and Lin Fan, not being from a medical school, must not have one.
Lin Fan shook his head, "No, I don’t."
The dean gritted his teeth, trying hard to suppress his rage. This is really a prank, isn’t it!
A person who isn’t a medical graduate and doesn’t have a medical license claims he can save the county chief’s mother, disregarding all these legitimate medical experts!
Isn’t this just a farce?
"Well, I’m sorry, but I can’t allow you to enter the operating room. First, you don’t have a medical license, nor are you a medical graduate. Second, you are not from our hospital, and I can’t take that risk," the dean said sternly.
Shengfu Sword said, "Dean, please don’t be so rigid. Let Divine Doctor Lin into the operating room. He is our only hope."
