The dean said, "Then may I ask, how did Mr. Lin acquire his medical skills since he didn’t study medicine? Was it something he learned from family members who were in the medical field?"
Lin Fan said, "No, I learned by reading books myself."
Poof!
Everyone couldn’t help but laugh, especially the doctors and nurses, who thought they’d heard the biggest joke ever.
Learning medicine by reading books on your own!
This is simply too ridiculous.
Medicine is a systematic discipline; how can one learn it just by reading books? This is no different from those quack doctors and scam artists!
This is clearly a fraud!
"Oh my God, this guy must be here to make us laugh!"
"Exactly, learning medicine by reading books, that’s hilarious."
"This is the funniest joke I’ve heard all year. He must be a scammer!"
"I think Elder Sheng got conned by him. Even people like Elder Sheng can be deceived these days!"
"Elder Sheng is old, after all. The elderly are just more susceptible to scams, no exceptions."
Everyone shook their heads in disbelief.
It’s clear now; Elder Sheng has run into a con-man and believed in Lin Fan, the fake divine doctor, which resulted in this farce.
The whole room, except for Zhu Ming, who changed his expression upon seeing Lin Fan.
Zhu Ming had personally seen Lin Fan save someone. It was Lin Fan who saved Elder Sheng when Zhu Ming couldn’t!
Lin Fan is far from the con-man everyone thinks he is. He genuinely has incredible medical skills!
If Lin Fan were really allowed to proceed, the county chief’s mother lying in there might actually be saved!
But if Lin Fan indeed saved the county chief’s mother, everyone, including the dean, would lose face!
Fortunately, nobody believes Lin Fan right now, and the dean has firmly refused to let Lin Fan practice, cutting off that possibility entirely.
Shengfu Sword hadn’t expected the hospital to refuse his call for Divine Doctor Lin to help.
"Dean, I understand your concerns. You think Divine Doctor Lin is a scammer and that I’ve been duped. But Divine Doctor Lin truly has excellent medical skills, and in this regard, Dr. Zhu Ming can vouch for him," Shengfu Sword said with a smile, looking at Zhu Ming.
Sheng Wanqing said, "Let me explain. My grandpa suddenly fainted in the car today. At that time, both Dr. Zhu and Divine Doctor Lin were present. Dr. Zhu couldn’t save my grandpa; it was Divine Doctor Lin who saved him."
What?
Everyone was surprised. Could this really have happened?
The dean asked, "Dr. Zhu, is this true?"
Zhu Ming blushed and said, "It is true, but... I don’t believe he saved Elder Sheng."
The dean asked, "What do you mean?"
Zhu Ming said, "At that time, I applied the best technique to provide first aid to Elder Sheng. He was already improving; he just hadn’t woken up yet. This person intervened, and it just happened to coincide with Elder Sheng’s recovery."
The dean frowned, "So you’re saying he stole your credit?"
Zhu Ming nodded and said, "That’s correct."
The dean snorted, "So, he’s an outright fraud then. Someone like that should absolutely not be allowed into the operating room!"
Hearing this, Sheng Wanqing was infuriated. Zhu Ming was blatantly lying. He didn’t save her grandpa; Lin Fan did, and later, when Lin Fan performed acupuncture on her grandpa, she saw its effects with her own eyes!
Zhu Ming was deliberately saying this to prevent Lin Fan from entering the operating room!
This Zhu Ming is both stupid and evil!
"Dr. Zhu, how can you say that so shamelessly? You have to take responsibility for your words!" Sheng Wanqing said angrily.
At this moment, Zhu Ming’s only focus was to stop Lin Fan from entering the operating room. He couldn’t care less about anything else; as long as Lin Fan didn’t enter, everything would be fine!
Anyway, the dean was on his side, and the dean wouldn’t let Lin Fan into the operating room!
"Oh no!"
At this moment, a nurse rushed out and exclaimed in a panic, "The patient is deteriorating quickly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 588: I’ll Be Right Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Chapter 588: I’ll Be Right Back
Since Lin Fan did not graduate from medical school and does not have a medical license, the director refused to let Lin Fan enter the operating room and considered him a fraud.
Zhu Ming, fearing that Lin Fan might succeed in saving someone, added fuel to the fire and lied about saving Shengfu Sword, claiming that he was the savior and Lin Fan had stolen his credit.
With Zhu Ming’s words, the director became more convinced that Lin Fan was a fraud.
"Elder Sheng, this person is definitely a fraud, and you have been deceived by him. There are plenty of fake masters like this nowadays, mostly middle-aged or older people; it’s unexpected that someone so young is out there cheating people. Individuals like him are all after money, and wealthy elders like you are their favorite targets. Dr. Zhu has already stated that it was actually he who saved you today, but this person shamelessly took the credit. I hope Elder Sheng can see his true colors and not be deceived again. We are all professionals, experts. There’s no reason for Elder Sheng not to trust experts and instead believe him?" the director earnestly advised.
The crowd murmured among themselves, agreeing with the director’s reasoning.
"Elders are indeed easily deceived."
"That’s true. My grandfather too, was swindled into buying health supplements, wasting tens of thousands!"
"These frauds are truly hateful, all for money!"
"It’s still better to trust professionals!"
Shengfu Sword scoffed, "Director, are you saying I’m senile and got deceived by him!"
The director chuckled, "I wouldn’t dare, I’m just kindly reminding Elder Sheng. The county party secretary and the county mayor are both present, and I believe they agree with my view. Elder Sheng is Secretary Sheng’s father. If even he gets deceived, this news would only embolden the frauds further."
Sheng Wanqing stated, "My grandfather hasn’t been deceived. I was present today and witnessed it myself. It was Divine Doctor Lin who saved my grandfather. Under Divine Doctor Lin’s acupuncture treatment, grandfather’s complexion greatly improved. Divine Doctor Lin is certainly not a fraud!"
Zhu Ming chuckled, "That’s the brilliance of these frauds. Not only are the elders easily deceived, but even youngsters aren’t exempt. It simply exploits your lack of medical knowledge."
Shengfu Sword said, "You all don’t need to argue. Given the current situation, you so-called professional doctors can’t save the patient. The patient is still in the operating room, waiting to die! I brought Divine Doctor Lin here, and you won’t let him into the operating room, which extinguishes the patient’s only hope. Little Deng, you’re the patient’s son; you should make the decision!"
Shengfu Sword looked towards the county mayor.
Everyone else also looked at the county mayor, waiting to see if Lin Fan would be allowed to step in.
The director said, "County Mayor, think carefully. This person is undoubtedly a fraud. You are the county mayor, and if you let a fraud inside, and he fails to save your mother, your reputation will suffer. Imagine, a county mayor believing in a charlatan; wouldn’t that be a joke!"
The county mayor frowned deeply.
If Lin Fan had not been brought by Shengfu Sword, he would have refused without hesitation.
But Lin Fan had Elder Sheng’s endorsement. To refuse Lin Fan would be to disrespect Elder Sheng.
Truly a dilemma.
At that moment, a nurse hurried out of the operating room: "Bad news, the patient can’t hold on any longer!"
The patient’s life was hanging by a thread, about to breathe their last!
"Little Deng, why are you still hesitant? Your mother’s life could end in this instant, and it’s up to you!" Shengfu Sword declared decisively.
The county mayor, heart racing, gritted his teeth, saying, "Fine, let him try!"
It must be said, the director’s words had clouded his judgment. If Lin Fan couldn’t save his mother, he would be proven a fraud, and as a county mayor leading by trusting a fraud, it would tarnish his future and reputation.
However, in this critical moment, what could be more important than a mother’s life!
The director still objected: "County Mayor, you mustn’t. He isn’t licensed to practice medicine and isn’t a doctor at this hospital. Such actions would break the rules and damage our hospital’s reputation. If the patient dies, our hospital can’t bear this responsibility!"
The county mayor gritted his teeth, "I allowed him in. I’ll bear all consequences, you don’t have to take responsibility!"
"This..." The director hesitated. If spoken to this extent and he still obstructed, it would be troublesome if the county mayor blamed him later.
Zhu Ming said, "Hospitals have their regulations. Letting this fraud in would make our hospital a joke in the future..."
"Zhu Ming!"
Lin Fan, who had remained silent, suddenly spoke, "I heard today’s surgery, you were the chief surgeon?"
Zhu Ming sneered, "And what if I was?"
Lin Fan chuckled, "You couldn’t save the patient, you’ve already failed, are you afraid I’ll save the patient?"
His thoughts pierced, Zhu Ming’s face flushed with anger, "Stop spouting nonsense, I’m not afraid of a fraud like you!"
Lin Fan said, "Since you aren’t afraid and you’re not capable, stop chattering away. Just wait here; I’ll be right back. By the way, I need a nurse to assist me, you it is."
Finishing, Lin Fan pointed at the nurse who had just spoken up. Without waiting for a response from the crowd, he strode into the operating room. The nurse, perplexed, followed him in.
The crowd was left speechless.
Zhu Ming trembled with rage, "This is outrageous, that scoundrel..."
Obstruction ultimately failed; the scoundrel still entered the operating room!
However!
Zhu Ming reconsidered; the patient’s condition was extremely critical, and with the added delay, the patient was practically hanging on by a thread. It could be said that even the Immortals might not be able to save them!
No matter how skilled Lin Fan was, he would likely fail!
Thinking of this, Zhu Ming smirked, anticipating the moment when Lin Fan would fail and face scorn and ridicule!
He couldn’t help but look forward to seeing Lin Fan’s failure.
The county mayor approached Shengfu Sword, smiling wryly, "Elder Sheng, with your pardon, is this person really reliable? Though desperate times call for desperate measures, if this man is a fraud, not only will we not save my mother, but we will also become a laughingstock."
Shengfu Sword replied calmly, "Let’s put it this way, if anyone in this world can save your mother, it’s got to be Divine Doctor Lin!"
The county mayor paused in surprise, Elder Sheng praised Lin Fan so highly; if Lin Fan turned out to be a fraud, fooling Elder Sheng into such trust would be quite remarkable.
Sheng Decai said, "Old Deng, stay calm. If this person indeed is a fraud, we won’t let him off!"
Lin Fan had already entered the operating room. Whether or not he could save the patient, time would tell, and everyone eagerly anticipated the outcome.
As time ticked by, ten minutes, twenty minutes, thirty minutes...
An hour later.
Lin Fan still hadn’t come out.
Everyone began feeling a bit weary from waiting.
"Why hasn’t he come out yet?"
"Could it be that the patient has died, and he doesn’t dare to come out?"
"He’s really caught in a dilemma now. If the patient has truly died, coming out will only lead to accusations!"

chapters.title: Chapter 569: Everyone Petrified
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Chapter 569: Everyone Petrified
"I don’t quite understand, if he really is a fraud, knowing he can’t save the patient, why did he go in?"
"What’s hard to understand about that? The kid must have already taken the money, so he has to put on an act."
"Just wait, when he comes out, he’ll definitely have all sorts of excuses."
The crowd discussed.
The director felt restless, and said, "Let’s go to the observation room and see what he’s doing in there!"
However, when the director and a group of experts arrived at the observation room, they found the window blinds had been drawn.
Unless they burst into the operating room, they had no idea what Lin Fan was doing inside!
But at this point, no one dared to rush into the operating room for fear that Lin Fan might turn the tables and blame them for interfering with his surgery, resulting in the patient’s death.
The director said angrily, "That’s probably his intention; he’s deliberately staying inside, not coming out, so we’d go in voluntarily. Once we do, he’ll shift the blame onto us!"
"What a cunning kid!"
"This kid is quite shrewd; no wonder even Elder Sheng was deceived by him."
Zhu Ming said, "So what do we do now, just let this kid stay in there?"
The director sneered, "We’re not taking the blame for this, let the county chief decide!"
So, they found the county chief.
"County chief, I just discussed with the experts, and in our professional judgment, your mother is most likely already deceased," the director said.
"What?" The county chief’s face changed, "If my mother has already passed, why hasn’t Lin Fan come out?"
The director said, "That’s the issue; he might be stalling for time, trying to lure us in, then blame us for affecting his surgery, causing the patient’s death."
The county chief said angrily, "Is there really such a thing? Director, are you sure?"
The director said, "That’s our conclusion, our professional judgment. We can’t be 100% certain, but it’s very likely."
The county chief said, "Then what do you mean by telling me this?"
The director said, "Delaying any longer is simply wasting time. We hope this farce can end soon, but it depends on your decision."
This director was truly conniving, unwilling to take any blame, ultimately passing the buck to the county chief.
The county chief, already waiting anxiously, thought for a moment and calmed down. If according to the director, his mother was no longer alive, then any decision would be meaningless. But in case Lin Fan was still trying to save her in there, rushing in now would definitely affect Lin Fan, with unimaginable consequences. At that time, he would bear the responsibility, as it would be his decision.
Since that’s the case!
The county chief sat down and said, "Do nothing, just wait patiently!"
After speaking, the county chief closed his eyes, determined to wait for Lin Fan to come out.
Time continued to pass, and this surgery had already spread throughout the hospital, attracting nearly everyone’s attention.
Whether Lin Fan could bring the patient back became a matter of great curiosity for everyone.
"Difficult, it’s just impossible!"
"What a joke, so many experts in the hospital, and none of them as good as a small-town doctor?"
"This unlicensed barefoot doctor is obviously a fraud!"
"No need to say it, the director is right; he’s just waiting for someone to go in, to see which side can’t hold out first..."
At this moment, in a ward in the inpatient department.
Lin Dawei woke up from a nap, curiously asking, "Shanshan, why does the hospital seem so quiet today, where has everyone gone?"
Lin Shanshan was peeling an apple and said, "Seems like there’s a surgery, everyone went to watch."
Lin Dawei curiously asked, "There’s such a thing, what surgery?"
Lin Shanshan said, "I heard it’s the county chief’s mother having surgery, there was an accident, still trying to save her."
Lin Dawei said "Oh," not paying much attention, and then said, "By the way, where’s Little Fan, why isn’t he back yet? I want to be discharged and go home, it’s already afternoon, am I supposed to stay another night here?"
Lin Shanshan said, "The person doing that surgery is brother."
Lin Dawei sat up, "What? Little Fan is operating on the county chief’s mother?"
Lin Shanshan said, "That’s what I heard from others describing it. They said the doctor’s surgery failed, and brother went in to save the day."
Lin Dawei was stunned for a moment and then said, "Shanshan, do you think Little Fan can succeed?"
Lin Shanshan said, "I don’t know; I only know that day Third Uncle almost didn’t make it, and I watched brother save him with my own eyes."
Lin Dawei paused for a moment, sighing, "If Little Fan really brings the county chief’s mother back, our Lin Family must have great fortune!"
Lin Shanshan said, "What if he fails?"
Lin Dawei chuckled, "I know Little Fan well; he wouldn’t do something he isn’t confident about."
Outside the operating room, a group of people were watching, and as time went by, more and more people gathered.
Everyone was waiting for a result, whether Lin Fan succeeded or failed.
A group of doctors and nurses took a break from their busy schedules to come over and watch, including Dr. Li, who was responsible for Lin Dawei, and now they were discussing.
"This is really surprising; I heard the one going in for surgery isn’t even a doctor!"
"What do you mean, not a doctor, why’d they let him in for surgery?"
"There’s no choice; Dr. Zhu Ming’s surgery failed; it was the county chief’s decision to go with desperate measures."
"I heard the director was strongly opposed; after all, that person isn’t from medical school, and doesn’t even have a medical license, just a barefoot village doctor!"
"That’s crazy, we’re a county hospital, letting a barefoot doctor take over is embarrassing enough!"
"But there’s nothing that can be done! By the way, Dr. Li, you’re the most experienced here, what do you think the result will be?"
Dr. Li said, "A barefoot doctor better than Dr. Zhu? Think with the back of your head, you know the result."
"True, a barefoot doctor is still a barefoot doctor, most are just frauds."
The crowd obviously didn’t have high hopes for the result of this surgery, waiting to see a joke.
"Grandpa, I’m a bit worried about Divine Doctor Lin." Sheng Wanqing couldn’t help feeling a little anxious, hoping Divine Doctor Lin hadn’t encountered any difficulties.
Shengfu Sword said, "Don’t worry, give Divine Doctor Lin some time, don’t mind what they say."
Sheng Wanqing said, "Mm, I understand."
At this moment, Zhu Ming’s face looked gloomy, eager to stomp on Lin Fan, but Lin Fan hadn’t come out yet.
"Director, the county chief refuses to go in; are we really going to waste time?" Zhu Ming said.
The director sneered, "Calm down, at this point, we have no other choice but to keep waiting; I believe this kid will be more anxious than us. The longer it takes, the worse it is for him; eventually, he’ll be forced to show himself."
Right at this time, the crowd suddenly became agitated.
It turned out the door of the operating room creaked open from the inside, and Lin Fan came out with a hint of fatigue on his face!
"Ah, he’s out!"
Immediately, Lin Fan drew everyone’s attention.
"What, it’s him?"
Dr. Li in the crowd exclaimed; he recognized Lin Fan as Lin Dawei’s relative, who had argued with him earlier today about letting Lin Dawei be discharged.
Zhu Ming stared at Lin Fan, sneering, "You’ve finally come out, hasn’t the patient already died?"
Lin Fan glanced at Zhu Ming, smiling, "Died? You’re dead; she’s not."
With that, Lin Fan pushed open the operating room door, making way.
Following that, a nurse brought out a wheelchair.
A wheelchair with an old lady seated in it.
A living old lady.
The county chief’s mother.
"Huh?"
The crowd was dumbfounded.
For a moment, everyone was stunned by this scene!

chapters.title: Chapter 570: The Mayor’s Sigh, Divine Doctor Lin Is Truly a Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Chapter 570: The Mayor’s Sigh, Divine Doctor Lin Is Truly a Master
The nurse actually wheeled the county chief’s mother out!
Wasn’t it said that the county chief’s mother was beyond saving and lying in the operating room waiting to die? The entire hospital, including the director and the team of experts, and the chief surgeon Zhu Ming, all said they were helpless!
If we believed these experts, the county chief’s mother would have died long ago.
Now, she is sitting alive in a wheelchair!
How is this possible?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
The group of experts’ eyes were wide open as if they had seen a ghost.
Impossible! Absolutely impossible!
Given the current level of modern medicine, there was simply no way to save the county chief’s mother, yet now she was saved. It’s simply a miracle!
A miracle is when something utterly impossible happens in reality.
"Mom!"
The county chief reacted, walking excitedly over and kneeling in front of the wheelchair.
"Mom, how do you feel?" the county chief asked with concern, "They all said you couldn’t be saved. You scared me to death. It’s just great that you’re okay."
The old lady smiled and said, "I indeed had one foot in the gates of hell. In a trance, I even seemed to see the ghost messenger of death, but Dr. Lin pulled me back. Son, you must thank Dr. Lin well, for without her, I wouldn’t have returned."
"Mm."
The county chief nodded, then turned around and knelt down to Lin Fan, "Divine Doctor Lin, thank you for saving my mother. Thank you so much! You are truly a divine doctor. I was hesitant before, and that was my mistake. Please, Divine Doctor Lin, do not take offense!"
Lin Fan extended a hand to help the county chief up and smiled slightly, "I did save your mother, but you also saved her. If you had been like them and not allowed me into the operating room, no matter how good my medical skills were, they wouldn’t have been any use."
Shengfu Sword and Sheng Wanqing were very happy to see that Lin Fan had saved the county chief’s mother.
Shengfu Sword couldn’t help but feel a bit proud and said, "I told you, only Divine Doctor Lin in this world can save her. Wasn’t I right, director? Do you have anything to say now?"
The director’s face was full of embarrassment, the feeling of being slapped in the face was extremely intense.
That Lin Fan he looked down upon, an uncertified village doctor, had actually brought back the patient they had given up on!
"It doesn’t make any sense, I don’t understand how he did it!"
"Yeah, this is too incredible!"
"According to common sense, the patient’s condition was already beyond help!"
"Could it really be a miracle?"
The experts began to discuss, each one incredibly astonished.
Lin Fan chuckled, "How could this be a miracle? Her condition was indeed quite severe, but she wasn’t beyond saving. It just means you all need to improve your medical skills. Especially you, you made a mistake from the very beginning of the operation. Didn’t you know that would cause complications? Why were you helpless during the rescue? Resolve the patient’s complications first, and the patient will naturally stabilize. It’s just a matter of an injection, then complete the operation, and you can bring the patient back."
Lin Fan’s latter words were directed at Zhu Ming.
Zhu Ming was dumbfounded, suddenly enlightened.
He was convinced, completely convinced.
Lin Fan’s medical skills were ten streets ahead of his, regardless of whether he liked to admit it or not, he had to admit that Lin Fan was a mountain to him, a mountain that couldn’t be surmounted.
Lin Fan didn’t originally intend to be too high-profile upon his return. This time saving a life unexpectedly drew so much attention, which was already against his original intention.
"The person is saved now, and what follows is up to your hospital. This concludes my duties here, and I should be going,"
Lin Fan said with a slight smile, then took his leave.
"Divine Doctor Lin, please wait," the county chief called out to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "County chief, do you have any further instructions?"
The county chief said, "Divine Doctor Lin saved my mother, and I haven’t yet formally thanked you. May I ask where Divine Doctor Lin resides so that I can pay a visit to express my gratitude someday?"
Lin Fan said, "No need. It just so happened that I was treating Elder Sheng today, and upon learning of the situation and at Elder Sheng’s invitation, I decided to lend a little help. I won’t be charging for this time."
With that, Lin Fan walked out.
The county chief was stunned for a moment, then couldn’t help but sigh, what a noble individual Divine Doctor Lin is.
If it were those con artists out for money, regardless of whether they truly had skills, they would demand a hefty treatment fee upon speaking. But a real expert, like Lin Fan, travels the world saving lives without asking for a fee, leaving gracefully with a wave!
Arriving at the door, Lin Fan caught sight of Dr. Li in the crowd.
Lin Fan approached with a smile, "Dr. Li, can my uncle be discharged now?"
Previously, Lin Fan had proposed to discharge Lin Dawei, but Dr. Li strongly opposed it and insisted Lin Dawei remain for observation.
Dr. Li, still in shock, nodded instinctively, "Yes."
What else could he say? Now, he finally realized how astounding Lin Fan’s medical skills were. What Lin Shanshan had said before was actually true, Lin Dawei’s surgery was performed by Lin Fan!
Lin Fan was the genius doctor he aspired to be!
The genius doctor said Lin Dawei could be discharged, so what reason would he have to object?
"Thank you, Dr. Li," Lin Fan said with a smile, then went off to find Lin Dawei and Lin Shanshan.
Watching Lin Fan’s graceful departure, the county chief admired him immensely, never expecting that his backwater, ninth-tier county would produce such a divine doctor like Lin Fan.
"Elder Sheng, what is the background of Divine Doctor Lin?" the county chief couldn’t help but inquire.
Shengfu Sword said, "I’m not sure either; we just happened to meet Divine Doctor Lin on a rural bus today. All we know is that his name is Lin Fan."
Lin Fan!
The county chief secretly made up his mind to find Divine Doctor Lin and pay him a visit to express his gratitude. The immense gratitude for Divine Doctor Lin saving his mother cannot just be left unaddressed.
As for Lin Fan, he smoothly handled the discharge formalities for Lin Dawei afterward and took him back to West River Village.
Traveling by bus was really inconvenient, and not wanting to be too ostentatious by driving a Rolls-Royce, Lin Fan rented a regular car in the county and drove it back to West River Village.
West River Village was a backward, rural area where some villagers did drive small cars, but they were mostly cheap, ordinary brands. However, even if they were cheap brands, as long as they were cars, they would attract villagers’ attention.
When Lin Fan’s car returned to the village, it was immediately surrounded and discussed by the villagers.
"Yo, isn’t that Da Gui’s son, Lin Fan? Heard he came back yesterday, but he didn’t seem to be driving! How come he’s driving a small car today?"
"Heard he’s delivering food in the city, just running errands for people, so how did he afford a car?"
"Honestly, it’s a pretty ordinary brand, probably just a few tens of thousands. Not expensive at all!"
The villagers discussed.
Someone couldn’t resist asking Lin Fan, "Little Fan, is this car yours?"

chapters.title: Chapter 571: Lin Fan, What Is Your Attitude?
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Chapter 571: Lin Fan, What Is Your Attitude?
Lin Fan said honestly, "No, I rented it in the county town for convenience to bring Third Uncle back."
So it was rented!
Instantly, the villagers all started laughing, their laughter tinged with a hint of disdain.
This kid Lin Fan really has no prospects, a car so ordinary, yet it was rented, not bought.
This shows Lin Fan couldn’t even afford such a small car!
"I thought he bought a car, was just about to praise him, but turns out it was rented!"
"Can’t even afford a small car, and he’s a college student, what a waste of an education!"
"It was a waste from the start, what kind of college student goes to deliver takeaways, truly no prospects!"
"Still, Xiaohai is the one with prospects, Lin Fan can’t compare to him."
The villagers snickered to themselves, seeing Lin Fan as unpromising made them feel assured.
These idle men and women in the village loved to gather and gossip about others in their free time.
Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered to respond, if he really wanted to show off, these people’s jaws would drop in shock, but he felt it was unnecessary for now.
Back in the village, Lin Fan planned to stay a couple more days, and head back to Yun City once Lin Dawei’s health completely improved.
During the following two days, Lin Fan was in the village, spending time at the small clinic when he had nothing else to do.
The medicinal herbs he purchased in the city also arrived, and as previously agreed, Lin Fan helped cure Chen Zhonghou’s leg ailment.
The entire village knew about Chen Zhonghou’s condition. After getting injured, he had surgery in the county town, but there was no improvement and it even worsened, with the risk of amputation.
Lin Fan cured Chen Zhonghou’s leg, and this surprised all the villagers, making them aware of Lin Fan’s medical skills.
If saving Chen Huzi before was considered luck, then curing Chen Zhonghou’s leg can’t be called luck anymore!
How could there be so much luck?
This indicates that Lin Fan actually knows medical skills, and he’s quite good at it!
Lin Fan, working as a deliveryman in the city, made almost no money, even the small car was rented, leading the villagers to mock him for lacking prospects, but when it came to medical skills, there was no room for ridicule, everyone’s bodies were honest about it.
Once they confirmed that Lin Fan truly had good medical skills, they all flocked to him for treatment, regardless of whether they were sick or not, just for peace of mind.
Suddenly, the small clinic’s business was booming.
Liu Zixing was the happiest, as this small clinic was her and Old Liu’s source of income, with better business, the income greatly increased compared to before.
She really hoped Lin Fan could stay in the village forever, not only for the increase in income, but also because she felt particularly safe with him around.
However, her happiness didn’t last long before trouble came knocking.
One day, the village chief’s son, Chen Junjie, was carried to the small clinic on a stretcher, having been beaten so badly his leg was broken.
The village chief even personally came.
The village chief was an old man with a crew cut, looking like someone not to mess with.
"Lin Fan, I heard your medical skills are quite good, you even cured Chen Zhonghou’s leg, can you help my son too? There will be a generous reward if you do!" the village chief said straightforwardly.
Lin Fan glanced at Chen Junjie on the stretcher, clearly, he got into a fight with someone, bearing bruises and a leg broken by an iron rod.
This playboy ending up like this was no surprise, perfectly normal.
"How did he get injured?" Lin Fan asked.
The village chief glared and said, "You don’t need to know how he got injured. You’re a doctor, just cure him, that’s it, no need to ask about anything else!"
Lin Fan felt a bit displeased with such an attitude from the village chief. He somewhat understood that Chen Junjie’s behavior had something to do with the way he was raised, a bad habit encouraged by his father.
"To treat an illness, it’s important to find out the cause. If I don’t know how he got injured, I can’t make a correct diagnosis, so it’d be best to explain everything without hiding anything so I can diagnose properly. If you’re unwilling to say, sorry, I can’t treat him," Lin Fan said.
The village chief was somewhat annoyed, this kid Lin Fan actually had quite a temper.
"If not for your decent medical skills, and the way you’re speaking to me right now, you’d have gotten a slap long ago. Fine, I’ll tell you: he was beaten up, isn’t that clear enough?" the village chief said.
Lin Fan said, "Why was he beaten?"
The village chief said, "This kind of thing... damn it, you brat, speak it yourself!"
At this moment, Chen Junjie was howling in pain. He remembered the time Lin Fan taught him a lesson, and he really didn’t want to meet Lin Fan, but now he needed his help and just wanted to get treated quickly.
"I..." Chen Junjie said, "I took a liking to a girl from the neighboring village and tried to hit on her, but ended up getting beaten by her family. That’s the whole story, Lin Fan, please treat me quickly, I’m in so much pain."
Lin Fan chuckled, "All you did was try to hit on the girl, and her father beat you up like this?"
Chen Junjie said, "I’m telling the truth, Lin Fan, are you going to keep nagging? I’m freaking dying of pain, hurry up and treat me!"
The village chief said, "Lin Fan, the fact is he was beaten with an iron rod. As for why he was beaten, even if I don’t know medicine, I know it has nothing to do with treatment, you don’t need to know everything so clearly, just treat him quickly, I actually want to see how good you really are!"
Lin Fan said flatly, "Sorry, if you won’t cooperate with my questions, I can’t treat him, you can find someone else instead."
The village chief yelled, "Lin Fan, what kind of attitude is this? I’m the village chief, I’m asking you to treat him, are you trying to go against me?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Village chief, I respect you as an elder and your position, but please respect me as a doctor as well. If you’re not willing to cooperate with my work, I naturally can’t provide medical services for you."
The village chief was a bit frustrated, as they truly needed Lin Fan now. They couldn’t just hold Lin Fan’s hand and make him treat Chen Junjie.
"Lin Fan, don’t think I don’t know. You’re not a medical graduate and don’t even have a practitioner’s license, so you’re technically not allowed to practice here. If I, as the village chief, were to uphold justice, I’d shut down this clinic, and you’d have nothing to say!" the village chief sneered.
A threat!
Liu Zixing, standing to the side, was angry to hear the village chief threaten to shut down their clinic.
"Village chief, you can’t do that. Lin Fan’s medical skills are genuinely good, it’s obvious to all. Even if he doesn’t have a license, he’s no fraud, at most he just needs to get certified. Shutting down the clinic is unreasonable!" Liu Zixing said angrily.
The village chief sneered, "Simply put, if he doesn’t treat my son, he shouldn’t think of practicing here anymore!"
Lin Fan shrugged and chuckled, "That’s just great, anyway, I was planning to leave in these two days. Village chief, you say I’m not qualified to practice, well, I’m officially closing shop then, is that okay? Why would you still want me to treat your son? Sorry, I’m closing shop."
"You!" the village chief was fuming.
He, the dignified village chief, couldn’t handle this kid Lin Fan.
"Ah, Dad, I’m dying from the pain!" Chen Junjie howled in agony at this moment, clearly really in pain.
The village chief had no choice, they truly needed Lin Fan now, and threatening him hadn’t worked, so he had to confess to Lin Fan.
"Fine, fine, I’ll speak. This brat got beaten because he tried to assault that girl and got caught by her family..."

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Lin Fan’s Principles
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Chapter 572: Lin Fan’s Principles
Chen Junjie, relying on being the village head’s son, often acted recklessly. This time, while wandering in a neighboring village, he took a liking to a girl and harassed her on the spot.
After being sternly rejected by the girl, Chen Junjie attempted to force himself on her, but was discovered by the girl’s family. Her family, known as bullies in the neighboring village, did not show any respect for his father and brutally beat Chen Junjie, breaking one of his legs.
They even threatened that if Chen Junjie dared to step into their village again, they’d beat him up each time they saw him.
"Lin Fan, now you know why I was beaten up. Hurry up and treat me; I’m in excruciating pain!" Chen Junjie screamed, drenched in sweat and looking pale, obviously in real pain.
The village head knew that his son being beaten wasn’t honorable. Initially he was reluctant to talk about it, but now he felt embarrassed and ashamed, so he couldn’t go to the neighboring village to confront the bullies. He had to swallow this grievance and wanted his son treated immediately, fearing that a delay would result in a permanent disability.
"Lin Fan, why are you standing there? Hurry up and treat my son’s injuries. You’re supposed to be really good, right? You healed Chen Zhonghou’s severe leg injury in just a couple of days. You should be able to heal my son too. Show me your skills!" the village head said.
The village head’s tone irritated Lin Fan; it sounded like an order!
"Sorry, I can’t treat your son’s leg," Lin Fan replied casually.
The village head was enraged: "What? You can’t treat it? How is that possible? Aren’t you supposed to be very skilled? You healed Chen Zhonghou’s leg..."
Lin Fan said, "I indeed healed Grandpa Zhonghou’s leg. Your son’s leg is not beyond my ability to heal, but I simply won’t treat it."
The village head paused and then realized: "You mean you could heal it, but you refuse to do so?"
Lin Fan said, "Exactly, so village head, I suggest you send him away quickly."
The village head was furious: "Lin Fan, as a doctor, why won’t you help a patient? What kind of reasoning is this?"
Lin Fan said, "Although treating and saving people is a doctor’s duty, it’s unfortunate that I don’t even have a practicing license, which sets me apart from those doctors. Also, I have a principle: I do not treat scoundrels. Unluckily, your son is one such scoundrel."
Village Head: "..."
The one who tried to threaten Lin Fan with a practicing license was the village head himself. Unexpectedly, Lin Fan quickly turned the tables. Without a license, the village head couldn’t demand Lin Fan to fulfill a doctor’s mission.
"Zi Xin, show them out!" Lin Fan said.
Liu Zixing replied, "Sorry, village head, the clinic is quite busy right now. For the sake of other patients, you’d better leave quickly."
At this point, the other patients in the clinic were stunned.
They witnessed Lin Fan actually refusing the village head. This was the village head, after all! And Lin Fan didn’t even give him face; Lin Fan really had guts.
In fact, everyone knew Chen Junjie was a scoundrel, so Lin Fan refusing to treat him was very satisfying.
The village head urgently said, "Lin Fan, you are a resident of West River Village, I am the village head, you must listen to me. I now order you in my capacity as village head to treat my son immediately!"
The village head attempted to use his authority to pressure Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Sorry, village head, your order is useless to me. I’m simply unable to treat him. Blame it on your son for being a scoundrel."
"Dad, I’m in so much pain, I feel like I’m dying..." Chen Junjie said painfully, his breathing weakening. If this injury were to drag on, the consequences would be unimaginable.
The village head felt distressed but Lin Fan refused to help. Seeing the hard approach wasn’t working, for the sake of his son, the village head could only soften his stance.
"Lin Fan, help treat my son. If he is healed, I will make it worth your while. Junjie did wrong with his actions, I’ll apologize on his behalf, alright? Could you just do me a favor and treat him?" the village head pleaded, his tone softening to almost begging.
Lin Fan was indeed someone who responded to gentleness rather than force. Anyone who acted arrogant towards him surely wouldn’t earn his favor. Why be cocky? Is it so hard to speak nicely?
But this time it was different. Chen Junjie was a scoundrel, and even with the village head’s softened attitude, Lin Fan wouldn’t treat him. Besides, Chen Junjie has been disrespectful before, daring to offend Wei Yue’er last time.
Such a scoundrel deserved a broken leg, as a lesson to remember.
Lin Fan sat down and said lightly, "Sorry, I’ve said I won’t treat scoundrels, and I won’t. This is a matter of principle. I hope the village head respects my principles."
He won’t give in to either hardness or softness!
It seemed nothing could persuade Lin Fan to treat Chen Junjie.
Enraged and unsure of what to do, the village head could only choose to give up, saying through gritted teeth, "Lin Fan, you really have guts! Today’s incident, I assure you, you will regret it. Just wait and see!"
In the end, the village head left and hurriedly sent Chen Junjie to the town hospital.
But it was already too late, and due to missing the optimal treatment time and the county hospital’s orthopedic department being quite lackluster, Chen Junjie’s leg later suffered from aftereffects.
Simply put, he became crippled.
Moreover, during rainy weather, the pain flares up, making him feel like he’s dying—this is the just retribution meted out to a scoundrel.
After the village head left, applause echoed in the clinic.
"That was incredible, it’s the first time seeing the village head getting humiliated!"
"That Chen Junjie has always thrown his weight around the village, and everyone has long found him displeasing."
"This time it’s truly satisfying!"
The crowd laughed, feeling utterly delighted.
However, some expressed concern.
"Lin Fan, you’ve offended the village head this time, be careful!"
"That was a bit reckless, you shouldn’t offend the village head."
"Best to be cautious."
"Will the village head actually shut down the clinic? Where would we go for treatment then?"
Lin Fan furrowed his brow. He originally planned to keep a low profile, but with various occurrences, he couldn’t stay under the radar anymore.
To protect the small clinic, to shield his home from bullying, it seemed he couldn’t remain low-profile any longer.
"Everyone can rest assured; the clinic will be fine," Lin Fan smiled and said.
Liu Zixing looked at Lin Fan in admiration, thinking Lin Fan was truly impressive. He was the first in West River Village to bravely and defiantly stand up to the village head, while others would only bow and scrape in his presence.
That afternoon, Lin Fan was treating patients.
Someone ran in, telling Lin Fan urgently, "Terrible news, Lin Fan, the village head brought a group to your house, who knows what they’re up to!"
Lin Fan gave a casual response, the village head’s revenge coming so swiftly.
Lin Fan was about to head home to take a look, but just then, several black cars drove up from the village entrance and stopped in front of the clinic.
The situation was definitely unusual.
Sure enough, several security personnel descended from the cars front and back, surrounding the central vehicle protectively.
The center car’s door opened and the county head stepped out.
"Divine Doctor Lin, I finally found you. I’ve specifically come to thank you," the county head said very respectfully.
Everyone was dumbfounded, the county head had come to thank Lin Fan?

chapters.title: Chapter 573: Public Restroom Turmoil
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Chapter 573: Public Restroom Turmoil
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin stayed at home today, instead of doing farm work. If it were an ordinary day, they would be out in the fields, where there’s always work to be done.
Because Lin Shanshan came back, they took the rare opportunity to be lazy and stay home with their daughter. In a couple of days, she would be leaving again.
However, unexpectedly, it suddenly became lively outside the house. Father Lin went out to take a look, and it turned out the village chief had come with a group of people, followed by a bunch of idly curious villagers.
"What’s going on?"
"What’s the village chief planning to do?"
"I heard it’s because Lin Fan refused to treat the village chief’s son’s injury today. The village chief is here for revenge!"
"It looks like a big scene; is he going to hit Lin Fan?"
"No way, the village chief wouldn’t do something like that. It’s illegal, and besides, Lin Fan’s not here but at the clinic, so they wouldn’t come here to hit him!"
"What’s the village chief up to?"
The idly curious villagers started discussing among themselves, all very curious.
Father Lin was also puzzled and asked, "Village chief, what are you doing here?"
The village chief seemed oblivious to Father Lin as he turned to the villagers and loudly announced, "Well, as everyone knows, West River Village is quite poor. As the village chief, it’s my responsibility to lead everyone to prosperity, to help everyone live a good life. It’s my duty. I have a plan to develop the tourism industry here in West River Village, to attract tourists, increase villagers’ income, and for our village’s construction and development the infrastructure has to be improved first. For example, toilets. Everyone has emergencies, so when tourists come and need a toilet, what are they supposed to do? They can’t keep borrowing from the villagers, can they? It’s very inconvenient. So the most important thing is to build a public toilet. I’ve scouted for a long time, and I’ve finally selected a perfect spot, right here on this piece of vacant land, for building a public toilet!"
As he spoke, the village chief pointed to a piece of land.
It was surprisingly the vacant land in front of Lin Fan’s house.
The village chief continued, "This piece of land belonged to our bachelor Old Lin, and now that he’s passed away without any heirs, it has been reclaimed by the village as public land, making it vacant land. It’s great—flat, smooth, and crucially, accessible from all sides, making it very convenient for tourists to use the toilet."
What?
The villagers looked at each other, bewildered.
Who would have guessed that the village chief would gather a group of people here to build a public toilet!
This couldn’t be happening!
This is not a garden being built; it’s a public toilet.
How smelly it will be!
The public toilet may be convenient for tourists, but for the villagers living nearby, it’s simply a nightmare.
The Lin Family would be the ones to suffer first; if the toilet were really built, every time they opened their door they’d see the toilet, and every time they opened their door the stench of the toilet would hit them. Imagine the "refreshing" experience...
It was deliberate!
The village chief was doing this on purpose!
Because Lin Fan refused to treat Chen Junjie’s broken leg, the village chief’s revenge came after all, and this was his revenge.
It’s got to be said, the village chief’s move was dirty.
Father Lin frowned. He didn’t know about Lin Fan offending the village chief, but he felt the village chief’s actions were really puzzling.
"Village chief, if I may speak frankly, firstly, I completely support our development, but our house is right across from this land. Building a public toilet here would be very inconvenient for us. Every time we open the door, there would be a stench. Even with the door closed, there would still be a stench. Eating and sleeping with the toilet smell — how could this be okay? We couldn’t live here in the future! Village chief, shouldn’t you consider our situation and choose another location?" Father Lin said.
Lin Shanshan said, "Exactly, building a toilet here, how are my parents supposed to live?"
Lin Shanshan was a bit angry; she never imagined the village chief could be so blind to the situation. It seemed like he was doing it on purpose, what a joke!
The village chief seemed to notice Father Lin for the first time, chuckling, "Da Gui, you also know the village has to develop, right? Let me tell you, I spent a lot of effort to plan this public toilet, checked many places, none were suitable, only this place is perfect. It really can’t be changed anymore. If we change it again, our village’s development will be delayed. We can’t let your family drag down the village’s development, can we? Sometimes we have to make a bit of a sacrifice. Da Gui, you must have some spirit of sacrifice and not be so selfish. For everyone’s sake, endure it and it will pass. What’s toilet smell anyway? At first it might be hard to get used to, but after some time you won’t even notice it."
Father Lin: "This..."
For a moment, he didn’t know how to refute.
Of course he didn’t agree to have a toilet built in front of his house, but with the village chief’s righteous words accusing him of hindering the village’s development, what could he say?
If he opposed it, he would be going against the interests of the entire village. He was an honest and straightforward person, never had a quarrel with anyone, how could he possibly oppose the entire village.
"I object!"
Lin Shanshan stood up and said.
The village chief glanced at Lin Shanshan, chuckling, "What are you objecting to? You’re just a girl, you’ll be married off someday anyway, what does this have to do with you? Just leave it to your dad. Old Lin, if there are no problems, I’ll have the workers start now. There really won’t be any issues, trust me, after some time you won’t even notice the smell. I’ve hired these workers at quite a cost, and they’re paid by the hour. As we speak, money is being spent. Don’t just stand there, let’s get started."
The village chief signaled to his group of people, and they were equipped with tools, ready to start immediately.
The Lin Family was in a panic; the village chief was really going to build the toilet there. Would they still be able to live here?
This wasn’t simply a matter of selfishness or not, but what the village chief was doing harmed the interests of their family. Protecting one’s own interests is not selfish; it’s a right everyone should have.
Besides, why should the Lin Family sacrifice themselves for everyone else just because the village chief said it was for the community?
"Village chief, I heard you brought a group of people over; I thought you were going to tear down my house, what a small-minded thought I had, but you can’t blame me. Your son did threaten me a few days ago, saying he’d come and tear down my house. Building a public toilet, developing the village, all good things. I support it wholeheartedly."
Then, a voice came over.
Everyone turned to see Lin Fan walking over.
What?
The villagers were stunned.
Lin Fan actually agreed to the building of the public toilet?
No way, it’s going to be built in front of his house, and he agrees?
The village chief sneered, "Lin Fan, your awareness is quite high, indeed, as a college student, you have a different mindset. Old Lin, you should learn from your son."
Father Lin was dumbfounded. What was going on? Lin Fan actually agreed to build a public toilet in front of their house?

chapters.title: Chapter 574 I Have a Better Suggestion
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Chapter 574 I Have a Better Suggestion
No way, Lin Fan supports building a public toilet?
Everyone was a bit surprised.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Of course I support it. Isn’t the main theme of rural areas now poverty alleviation? Our West River Village is a poor village, and it’s necessary to get rid of poverty and become prosperous. Just like the village chief said, tourism is one direction. If we can really attract tourists, building a public toilet is absolutely necessary. It’s such a great deal. How could I oppose it?"
The village chief’s reason for wanting to build a public toilet here was mainly to retaliate against Lin Fan, making Lin Fan uncomfortable.
Unexpectedly, Lin Fan didn’t look uncomfortable at all and even agreed, making the village chief feel like he punched into cotton.
However, thinking about it again, Lin Fan might be pretending to agree on the surface, but who knows how uncomfortable he must be inside. After all, who would be happy to have a public toilet built at their doorstep?
The village chief chuckled, "Since Lin Fan agrees, then it’s easy. The public toilet is decided, let’s get to work and strive to build it as soon as possible!"
"Wait a minute." Lin Fan said.
The village chief exclaimed, "Lin Fan, do you have something else to say? Are you going back on your word?"
It would be best if Lin Fan went back on his word, indicating that Lin Fan wasn’t pleased, and with the public toilet determined, it would make Lin Fan unhappy.
Lin Fan said, "I completely agree with building the public toilet, there’s no going back on that. I just have a different opinion about the location. I think building it here isn’t the best choice and is actually quite poor. This place is far from the village entrance, and tourists usually park their cars at the village square. If they want to use the toilet, they need to walk some distance after getting off their vehicles and navigate around the village, which is quite inconvenient. So, the ideal location should be near the village entrance by the square. Coincidentally, isn’t the village chief’s house over there? I remember there’s a plot of vegetable land next to the village chief’s house, which is the perfect site. What do you think, village chief?"
What?
Lin Fan is turning the tables!
Everyone understood it; Lin Fan agreed to build the public toilet to counter the village chief.
Now Lin Fan proposed a new location, logical and reasonable, indeed an ideal site.
Poof!
Shanshan couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
Her brother didn’t disappoint her. She knew her brother wouldn’t give in so easily.
Father Lin also understood and nodded, "Little Fan is right!"
The village chief was almost fuming with anger. He wanted to build a public toilet opposite Lin Fan’s house, but Lin Fan countered with a suggestion to build one beside his own house!
And Lin Fan’s reasoning was solid, making it hard to refute.
The village chief chuckled, "Lin Fan, you’re mistaken. The vegetable plot beside my house isn’t suitable for a public toilet. We’ve been planting vegetables there for over a decade."
Lin Fan said, "So what about the vegetable plot? Just like the village chief said, it’s right to make small personal sacrifices for the collective good. As the village chief, you should set an example, right? Let everyone see your spirit of sacrifice."
Using someone’s own tactics against them!
Everyone couldn’t help but chuckle secretly; Lin Fan was being very ruthless.
The village chief was so mad. He initially used the term ’spirit of sacrifice’ to morally coerce the Lin family, demanding they make sacrifices for collective good. Now Lin Fan was turning it back on him!
If he refused, wouldn’t he be humiliating himself, providing an excuse for others to talk? Where would he have any authority in the village after this?
But if he genuinely made the sacrifice, he’d have to allow the public toilet to be built next to his house.
Of course, he didn’t want that.
"Village chief, what are you hesitating about? Don’t tell me you’re unwilling to give up your vegetable plot?" Lin Fan said with a smile.
The village chief huffed, "Just a vegetable plot, there’s nothing to be unwilling about. For the collective good, I can give it up at any time. But I just don’t think it’s suitable for a public toilet!"
Lin Fan responded, "Why? I hope the village chief can give a convincing reason?"
The village chief said, "I say it’s not suitable, and it’s not suitable. That’s the result of my inspection!"
Lin Fan said, "Village chief, saying it’s not suitable doesn’t convince people."
The village chief sneered, "Lin Fan, are you the village chief or am I? Who decides where the public toilet is built, me or you?"
Lin Fan replied, "Of course, it’s you."
The village chief said, "Good you know it. We have different opinions, that’s fine, but ultimately I make the decision. After thorough inspection, building it here is the most suitable, so there’s no need to discuss further. It’s settled!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "Although you make the decision, you still need to listen to public opinion, right? Now I think there’s a better place, and my reasoning is quite convincing. Yet, the village chief insists on building it here without a reason that convinces everyone. Isn’t that not so good? I’m just concerned the village chief would face criticism."
The village chief couldn’t have any reasoning; his reason was to retaliate against Lin Fan.
But this reason, naturally, couldn’t be spoken out loud.
The village chief found himself unable to counter Lin Fan and scowled, "Lin Fan, you’re just spouting nonsense because you don’t want the public toilet opposite your house. That’s selfish and not considering the collective good. Stop talking; the public toilet will be built here. I’ve decided!"
The village chief couldn’t argue with Lin Fan and resorted to using his position to pressure him.
Everyone exchanged looks, secretly criticizing the village chief; this was too shameless!
Lin Fan said, "Village chief, building a public toilet opposite my house is targeting me, isn’t it?"
Lin Fan called it out!
The village chief immediately said, "Lin Fan, what are you talking about? I’m here for the collective good. Don’t falsely accuse me!"
Lin Fan said, "Is that so? Isn’t it because I refused to treat your son, so you’re retaliating against me?"
The village chief said, "No, that’s not what happened! Lin Fan, stop slandering me!"
Lin Fan replied, "It seems I misunderstood. Then why else would the village chief ignore my opinion when I have reasonable arguments?"
The village chief was furious; he couldn’t argue with Lin Fan. If it were a debate for the win, he had completely lost.
The village chief huffed, "Lin Fan, why are you chattering away? Stop talking. It’s decided; let’s see who opposes it!"
"Can I oppose it?"
A voice suddenly spoke.
Everyone looked toward the voice and saw a potbellied middle-aged man, hands behind his back, walking over.
A stranger, who is this?
The villagers were curious. He looked like an official, but they didn’t recognize him, hadn’t seen him before.
The village chief saw the person, his face changed, startled, and exclaimed, "County, County Chief? Why are you here? What brings you here?"
The village chief laughed awkwardly.
The newcomer was the county chief!
His immediate superior!
Heavens, why did the county chief suddenly come? It was really unexpected.
What the?
The county chief came? Everyone was bewildered.
The county chief chuckled, "If I hadn’t come, I wouldn’t have encountered this matter. Old Chen, this isn’t the right way to handle things!"

chapters.title: Chapter 575: Harm Others, Harm Yourself
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Chapter 575: Harm Others, Harm Yourself
The village head never dreamed that the scene just now would be witnessed by the county head himself, and his heart was suddenly a bit flustered.
"County head, you’re so esteemed to visit, why didn’t you let us know in advance? I could have prepared to welcome you!" The village head said with a forced smile, trying to change the subject.
The county head said, "If I had informed you ahead of time, how could I have seen such a spectacular scene just now!"
The village head wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said, "County head’s esteemed visit really deserves a grand welcome. How about this, I invite you to the village committee office for a sit, so I can host you properly?"
The county head waved his hand and said, "No need, I just dropped by as I had some free time. I still have to rush back to the county later. Since I happened upon your situation here, I’ll offer some advice."
The village head laughed and said, "As for the construction of the public restroom, since the villagers have differing opinions, I think we should temporarily set it aside and discuss it at a later date."
Lin Fan said, "How can we discuss it later! I think it’s great to discuss it now, especially since the county head is here. He can certainly provide fair opinions, it’s simply a lucky chance we can’t pass up! Village head, you’re really fortunate to have the county head involved in this matter."
The village head cursed Lin Fan ten thousand times in his heart, this rascal just won’t let go of this issue.
The county head said, "Divine Doctor Lin makes a good point, since I’m here, let’s have a discussion. This concerns rural poverty alleviation and prosperity, it’s worth spending my time on."
Since the county head said so, what else could the village head say?
The village head could only nod his head hesitantly, "Alright."
The county head said, "I just heard Divine Doctor Lin’s analysis and thought it made a lot of sense. Old Chen, why don’t you agree? Also, tell me why you chose this location?"
The village head was momentarily speechless, "This..."
His reason was purely to get back at Lin Fan, there was no other reason. To ask him to come up with a convincing reason on the spot was beyond him.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "The village head wants to build a public restroom opposite my house purely for revenge, because I refused to treat his son, so he’s retaliating against me!"
The county head furrowed his eyebrows, staring at the village head, "Is there such a thing?"
The village head hurriedly replied, "No, absolutely no such thing. The reason I chose to build the public restroom here is that I think it’s suitable, and this is unutilized public land, fitting to make use of, not to avenge Lin Fan!"
Lin Fan said, "Looks like I was being petty, misunderstood the village head. Since the village head is so selfless, that’s wonderful. Then let’s handle it impartially. Now that the village head wants to build a public restroom at my doorstep, my opinion is to build it next to the village head’s home instead. Comparatively, building a restroom here is inconvenient for tourists, which is unfavorable for the development of village tourism. But building it next to the village head’s house is convenient and suitable. From an impartial viewpoint, even a fool can see which option is better!"
The county head nodded, "Divine Doctor Lin makes a lot of sense. Old Chen, I think let’s do it like this, build the public restroom in the vegetable garden next to your house. Building a public restroom in the village is indeed a great thing, it needs to be implemented quickly. I hope that when I come next time, I can use the restroom."
The village head was almost in tears, he was originally trying to get back at Lin Fan by building a public restroom at his doorstep, now the tables have turned, and it’s to be built next to his own home!
The public restroom stinks, how will he live there in the future!
Lin Fan clapped his hands and laughed, "The county head is truly wise. Village head, you wouldn’t disagree, right? Just as you said, sacrificing a bit of personal interest for the collective good is justified. You surely wouldn’t refuse, would you?"
The village head held back his pain and said, "Lin Fan, what are you talking about? I never said I wouldn’t do it."
Lin Fan said, "That’s great then, the village head is willing to build a public restroom next to his home for the benefit of the village, really commendable, truly our good village head. Where’s the applause, everyone?"
Lin Fan led the applause.
"Good!"
The villagers all joined in applause.
Of course, it’s good. Building a public restroom at the village head’s place, not at theirs, and making the village head eat humble pie, the spectacle can’t be big enough.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "But, let me remind the village head, public restrooms stink. In the future, every time the village head opens his door, he’ll smell the restroom. Luckily the village head taught us, that’s no problem, because as he just said personally, one doesn’t notice it after a while."
Everyone couldn’t help but chuckle.
Lin Fan’s satire was spot-on.
The village head had indeed said such words when he morally pressured the Lin Family before, now Lin Fan used the same words to comfort the village head, this mockery was powerful.
The village head’s face went pale and flushed, he truly wanted to strangle Lin Fan, this rascal was too detestable. Building a public restroom next to his home was bad enough, and then to endure this rascal’s mockery!
He was very puzzled, how did the county head come here? If the county head hadn’t come, Lin Fan would have been in his hands!
"Regarding the public restroom, I think it’s settled, Old Chen, get it started quickly. After a while, I want to personally check it out." The county head said with a smile.
Inside, the village head was weeping, tearfully he replied, "Yes, I understand."
The county head no longer paid attention to the village head and walked up to Lin Fan, respectfully saying, "Divine Doctor Lin, may I speak with you for a moment? This time I specifically came to thank you, just hadn’t had the chance to express my gratitude properly."
What?
Specifically to express thanks?
Everyone looked at each other, the county head treating Lin Fan with such respect, what’s going on?
"County head, your esteemed visit to our West River Village this time is because of him?" the village head couldn’t help but ask, pointing at Lin Fan.
The county head said, "Correct, to speak of it, there’s not much to it. My mother had a stroke the other day and had surgery, almost dying on the operating table. Divine Doctor Lin stepped in and saved her just in time. I managed to find out Divine Doctor Lin was in West River Village, so today I made a point to come here to thank him."
Everyone was stunned.
Oh my!
Lin Fan is really something else, actually getting the county head to personally come and thank him!
Who in West River Village can achieve that!
The only one who can do it is Lin Fan!
Looks like Lin Fan’s medical skill has conquered the county head.
The village head was on the verge of tears, no wonder the county head was supporting Lin Fan, turns out Lin Fan was the county head’s benefactor, damn it... If only he’d known, he wouldn’t have done all this!
Now it’s turned on him, harming Lin Fan wasn’t successful, but instead he harmed himself!
Now with the county head personally supervising the public restroom construction, he has no choice but to build it, just thinking about having a public restroom right beside his home, and the stench wafting in every time the door opens, the village head was collapsing.
The restroom dispute ended with the village head conceding defeat.
Afterward, Lin Fan invited the county head to the clinic for a chat, but little did they know, it would lead to another series of events.

chapters.title: Chapter 576: A Boisterous Benz Girl Arrives in the Village
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Chapter 576: A Boisterous Benz Girl Arrives in the Village
At the entrance of West River Village, a black Mercedes G-Class drove in on this day. The driver was a young man with a crew cut, strong and looking as if he frequently worked out. In the back seat sat a girl in her twenties, fairly attractive to begin with, around a 7, and with her expensive attire, she’d be an 8.
"What a godforsaken rural place. I never imagined there’d be a day I’d come to such a place."
The girl looked out at the village scenery through the window, displaying a hint of disdain and helplessness.
"Miss, is there really a miraculous doctor living in this village?" the crew-cut young man asked curiously.
The girl said, "Who knows, maybe. Seriously, having me personally invite him is a blessing accumulated over three lifetimes for him. If my dad hadn’t promised to buy me that Louis Vuitton bag, I’d never come to such a godforsaken place."
The crew-cut young man was silent for a moment before speaking, "If this miraculous doctor can really cure the old master’s illness..."
The girl said, "We’ll see if he can really cure it. Who knows if he’s just all hype. Sounds a bit unreliable to me."
The crew-cut young man remained silent, saying nothing more.
Suddenly, the crew-cut young man brought the car to a stop.
The girl frowned and said, "Why have you stopped? Keep driving, don’t waste my time. I have to rush back to the city. There’s a very important party tonight that I must attend."
The crew-cut young man said, "There’s someone ahead. This village road is a bit narrow, we should let them pass."
The girl leaned forward for a look and indeed saw a plainly dressed farm woman carrying a shoulder pole coming towards them. The village road was narrow. If they proceeded, they would hit the farm woman, so they had to stop and wait for her to pass first.
The girl furrowed her brows: "Really annoying, Little Jin, just drive through!"
The crew-cut young man was stunned, "Drive through?"
The girl said, "Just drive through. There’s no reason for missy here to yield. Look how slow she’s moving with that pole, wasting my time. Just drive through, she will naturally get out of the way. Quickly now, do as I say!"
The crew-cut young man hesitated for a moment, but eventually nodded and started the car, moving forward.
The farm woman ahead was carrying a heavy load, moving slowly. The sudden movement of the car scared her, making her instinctively step aside. But beside her were the farmlands. She stepped into them, losing her balance, not only falling into the field herself but also toppling the shoulder pole.
Sweet potatoes freshly dug from the ground spilled all over from the baskets on the shoulder pole.
The farm woman displayed a painful expression, seemingly hurt, unable to get up for the moment.
The crew-cut young man’s expression changed and he hurriedly stopped the car.
The girl frowned and said, "Why are you stopping? Ignore her and keep driving. These country folk are used to farm work and falls, they’ll be alright!"
The crew-cut young man said, "Miss, she seems to be hurt."
The girl stomped her foot in frustration, saying, "Annoying! This wretched woman is precisely in my way!"
The crew-cut young man seemed to understand the girl’s temper well. Although the Missy was cursing, she had tacitly allowed him to decide what to do.
The crew-cut young man unbuckled his seatbelt, opened the car door, got out, walked to the side of the road, and prepared to help the farm woman.
However, the farm woman seemed to have fallen quite badly, unable to stand up immediately.
The girl angrily said, "Oh, you’re pretending, aren’t you? Honestly, I don’t believe a fall like that could break your leg!"
As she scolded, the girl opened the car door and jumped out.
"You damn bumpkin, how do you walk? When you see a car, why don’t you dodge? Falling is your fault!" the girl scolded the farm woman.
The crew-cut young man finally helped the farm woman to her feet and asked, "Auntie, are you alright?"
The farm woman said, "My waist hurts a bit. I was carrying sweet potatoes, and your car suddenly came over, I couldn’t dodge in time."
The girl scolded, "Are you blaming us? Didn’t you see such a big car coming? Are you blind?"
The farm woman said, "I saw your car had stopped, thought you were waiting for me to pass first. After all, this section is narrow, only I can pass first."
The girl said, "Who do you think you are, that I’d let you pass! You damn bumpkin, with your filthy look, even talking to you is beneath me."
Every word from the girl was nasty, unbearably spoiled and arrogant.
The farm woman, appearing to be a gentle person, also found it hard to listen, saying, "Missy, seeing your attire, you must be from the city. You can look down on rural folk, but there’s no need to be so aggressive, is there?"
The girl flared up: "What did you say, you dead country hag, who are you to lecture me? Believe it or not, I’ll smack you?"
With that, the girl raised her hand, poised to slap the farm woman.
But before her hand could come down, it was suddenly caught by someone from the side.
"Don’t bully my mom!"
The one who came spoke with a bit of a silly tone.
The girl and the crew-cut young man both jumped in surprise. The newcomer was a young man, looking not very old, but big and brawny like a bear. His hand, as large as a palm leaf fan, gripped the girl’s hand, making her feel like she was caught in the hands of a beast.
"What are you doing, let go!" the girl instinctively screamed.
"You bully my mom, I won’t let you go," the other said seriously.
The girl screamed in terror, "Let go of me, you damn bumpkin!"
"Fugui, let her go." The farm woman spoke. It seemed her son had really scared the girl, making her heart soften.
This mother and son were none other than Aunt Chunyu, who Lin Fan deeply respected, and Dog No.2, Lin Fan’s childhood close friend.
Dog No.2’s real last name was Chen, named Chen Fugui, with Dog No.2 being just his nickname. Superstitious rural folk believed that lowly names were easier to raise, hence Chen Fugui got the nickname Dog No.2.
Dog No.2 didn’t release his grip and seriously said, "You have to promise not to hit my mom, then I’ll let go. This is what Brother Fan taught me, not to easily trust others."
The girl was in no mood to listen to him. She was terrified, being caught by someone like a beast, feeling as if he could crush her if he applied a bit of force.
"Little Jin, quickly teach him a lesson, make him let go!" the girl shouted.
The crew-cut young man, seeing Missy frightened, didn’t care about anything else, speaking in a deep voice, "Sir, please let go of Miss, or I won’t be polite."
Dog No.2 said, "What do you mean ’not polite’? You want to fight me? I’ve seen people say that on TV when they want to fight."
The crew-cut young man was stunned for a moment, feeling that this person seemed a bit silly?
"That’s right, I’m going to fight you, and you won’t be my match," the crew-cut young man said.
Dog No.2 was also carrying a shoulder pole, but now he put it down, freeing up his other hand, saying, "Brother Fan said I have to protect mom. I won’t let you bully her."

chapters.title: Chapter 577: The Formidability of Dog No.2

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - : I am the person you are looking for
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: 578 Chapter: I am the person you are looking for
The Mercedes Benz G-Class finally arrived outside the clinic. The spoiled girl and the buzz-cut young man got out of the car and walked into the clinic, immediately attracting everyone’s attention.
People in this village have rarely seen someone driving a G-Class. It is truly a rare sight. At a glance, this G-Class is clearly a luxury car, and these two are dressed quite smartly, obviously city folks.
It’s known that West River Village is a pretty remote mountain village, and the chance of seeing city people here is scarce throughout the year.
That’s why every time city folks come by, they’re sure to catch everyone’s attention.
The girl entered and, seeing the villagers waiting for treatment, immediately pinched her nose with a look of disdain and muttered, "A bunch of country bumpkins."
"May I ask if you have any business here?" Liu Zixing approached and asked.
The girl replied, "Is this the place? I heard there’s a miracle doctor here, yes? Hurry up and let him see me!"
Liu Zixing frowned; this woman’s attitude is quite arrogant. It looks like she’s here for treatment, but she acts as if the doctor needs to come to pay respects to her.
"The doctor is currently seeing patients, as you can see there are quite a few patients here. If you want to see the doctor, please wait in line. There are benches outside, you may sit and wait," Liu Zixing replied with composure.
Regardless of whether they’re from the countryside or the city, in the clinic, they’re all patients and must follow the clinic’s rules, established by her father, Old Liu.
Upon hearing this, the girl was displeased: "What did you say? You want me to wait? Do you know who I am? You want me to line up with these country folks? Who are you?"
With this attitude, Liu Zixing was even more annoyed: "I’m the nurse here. If you want to see the doctor, please queue up."
The girl was enraged: "What kind of attitude is this, you dying country girl! You dare to talk to me like this! I’m telling you, get the doctor out here for me immediately! Don’t take my kindness for granted!"
Everyone exchanged glances; this woman is too arrogant. Coming to see a doctor with such a nasty attitude.
Liu Zixing was also a bit angry. She had never met anyone like this. This woman completely despises the countryside.
"If you look down on the countryside, why come here for treatment? There are plenty of doctors in the city! If you don’t want to queue, please leave!" Liu Zixing said.
The girl cursed: "Dying country girl, how dare you talk back to me! You have no idea who you’re messing with. Even in the city, I never need to queue to see a doctor; they come to me themselves. But you want me to queue in this countryside?"
Liu Zixing replied, "I don’t care how it is elsewhere, but in our clinic, we practice first come, first served."
The girl sneered: "Fine, I won’t waste words with you, dying country girl! Doctor, doctor, where are you? Hurry up and come meet me!"
The girl raised her voice, and everyone in the clinic could hear it because it’s not very large.
Liu Zixing was furious: "If you keep making noise here, I’ll have to ask you to leave."
The girl snorted: "Try me! You dare to throw me out? It takes more than just saying it! Little Jin, go get the doctor for me!"
The buzz-cut young man was a bit reluctant, clearly not wanting things to look this ugly, but he dared not defy the girl’s orders.
The buzz-cut young man nodded and was about to look for the doctor.
Liu Zixing stopped the young man: "You can’t go in; the doctor is treating patients inside. You’ll disturb him."
Liu Zixing really didn’t like these city folks. They were so arrogant because they looked down on the people from the countryside. In the eyes of this girl, country people are inferior and can be ordered about casually.
She could order the country folks around, and they had to treat her like a princess.
Unfortunately, the girl chose the wrong place to act out.
In other places, she might throw tantrums and people might try to please her.
But in this clinic, she was destined to hit a wall.
"I advise you to step aside; I don’t want to get physical," the buzz-cut young man said solemnly.
Liu Zixing stubbornly said, "I should say that; I advise you to follow the clinic’s rules. We won’t tolerate nonsense here."
The girl angrily said: "Little Jin, what are you waiting for? Teach this disrespectful country girl a lesson!"
The buzz-cut young man could only grumble: "Sorry."
He placed his hand on Liu Zixing’s shoulder and gave a gentle push, making Liu Zixing involuntarily stagger to the side.
Liu Zixing was about to fall to the ground.
At that moment, a hand reached out from behind and grabbed Liu Zixing’s arm, gently steadying her.
Liu Zixing was startled, and when she turned to see, it was Lin Fan!
Liu Zixing’s heart instantly began to race. At that moment, she thought Lin Fan was so handsome, incredibly handsome, and her heart was pounding madly, her face flush with emotion.
"I’m treating patients here; what are you arguing about?" Lin Fan said coolly, his gaze falling coldly on the buzz-cut young man and the girl.
The buzz-cut young man froze for a moment, seemingly surprised. Is this the doctor? Much younger than expected; thought miracle doctors were middle-aged, but he’s so young.
So handsome!
That was the girl’s first reaction upon seeing Lin Fan.
Really unexpected, to find such a handsome guy in the countryside, and he’s extraordinarily handsome.
Immediately, the girl snapped back and huffed: "I want to see the miracle doctor here. This broken girl stopped us, insisting I join the queue with these country folks. Can someone like me obey her?"
Lin Fan looked at the girl and said: "You want to see the miracle doctor?"
The girl said: "That’s right, ah, don’t misunderstand, I’m not here for myself, not sick. It’s my grandpa who’s sick, and I came to find the miracle doctor to treat my grandpa. You seem more reasonable than this broken girl; call the miracle doctor quickly!"
Lin Fan said: "I am the person you’re looking for."
The girl froze: "What, are you kidding? You’re the miracle doctor? A miracle doctor this young? Not that sleazy old guy? I’ve seen many, always slick-talking, claiming to be miracle doctors but actually frauds who demand money right away. My family has encountered many."
Lin Fan replied: "I’m not joking; you came here looking for a doctor, and that’s me. I’m the only doctor here right now."
The girl was stunned; really didn’t expect the miracle doctor to be so young, truly unexpected.
