"You wouldn’t be a fraud, would you? Such a young charlatan isn’t something we see often," the girl said.
Lin Fan was somewhat speechless; this girl’s emotional intelligence was too low, offending people with every word. It seemed she was spoiled by her family, and in her growth environment, everyone accommodated her. But here, he wouldn’t indulge her.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "If you think I’m a charlatan, feel free to turn left, or turn right, just head out the door."
Lin Fan meant that if you don’t believe, then leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 579: Get Lost
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Chapter 579: Get Lost
The girl wasn’t a fool; she could tell what Lin Fan meant, which left her speechless. This doctor, if he were a charlatan, wouldn’t talk like this. Charlatans usually try every way possible to make people believe them in order to cheat money.
But Lin Fan had an attitude of indifference, which was very unique.
Of course, there was also a possibility that Lin Fan was pretending to be cool on purpose.
The girl said, "You better really have the skills. If you can’t cure my grandfather, I won’t let you off! Let’s go; I don’t want to stay here for another minute. You come to the city with me right now!"
Lin Fan said indifferently, "I believe my nurse already explained it clearly to you; if you want to seek medical treatment, you have to follow the rules. There are still patients here, so get in line. When it’s your turn, I’ll get to know about your grandfather’s condition and then decide whether to make a home visit. After all, if I go for a home visit, I’ll have to leave here, so I need to schedule my time. If possible, you can bring your grandfather here, so I don’t have to leave for a home visit."
The girl said, "There’s no way my grandfather can come here. He’s bedridden and can’t move!"
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment: "Then there’s no way. We’ll discuss the details when it’s your turn."
The girl said irritably, "I don’t think you understand the situation yet. I don’t want to stay here for another minute! I can’t stand in line with these country bumpkins. You need to come with me to the city now, and we can talk on the way!"
Lin Fan said, "That’s impossible."
The girl said angrily, "How is that impossible? I think you have no idea who I am!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "I don’t care who you are. Here, you have to follow my rules. You can either leave or wait in line."
At this moment, Widow Li came out of the examination room and said, "Little Fan, what’s going on? Can we continue?"
Lin Fan said, "You see, I’m still seeing patients. You’ve already wasted everyone’s time. If you don’t want to queue up, please leave!"
With that said, Lin Fan turned around to go back to the examination room.
The girl glanced at Widow Li and was a bit surprised again. She didn’t expect that in such a rural place, there would be such a beautiful woman, a mature woman full of feminine charm.
"Vixen!"
That was the girl’s first impression.
The girl snorted coldly, "What are you looking at? You country bumpkins should get out of my way! I am not someone you can afford to mess with! Ha, lining up is fine. If I drive you away, then it will be my turn. I am so clever."
Lin Fan sweated, thinking this woman really considers this place her own home.
Some timid villagers indeed stood up, planning to sneak out.
Lin Fan didn’t stop those who were frightened away by the girl and just said, "So be it. I have to go back to seeing my patients anyway. Just get in line."
Seeing that Widow Li and the other patients had no intention of leaving, the girl was furious.
"Ridiculous, you country bumpkins dare to ignore what I say. I told you to scram, didn’t you hear? Do you really need me to show my might?" The girl exclaimed with her hands on her hips.
Lin Fan frowned and said, "Miss, you are threatening and scaring my patients, which is wrong. I don’t care who you are. Now I want you to leave. This is my last warning: if you don’t follow the rules, you can leave."
The girl snorted, "Don’t think because you’re some miracle doctor I won’t do anything to you. You have no idea who I am. If I reveal my identity, you’ll be so scared you’ll kneel and beg like a dog!"
Lin Fan made a sound of acknowledgment, "In that case, tell me, and let’s see if I beg you or not."
The girl pointed outside to the Mercedes-Benz G-Class and said, "Do you see that car? It’s mine, registered under my name. In Tianhai City, who do you think can drive such a car?"
Lin Fan said, "I really don’t know. What I do know is, who can drive a Rolls-Royce, and who can drive a Kosak."
Of course, he knew—it was him.
The girl was stunned for a moment. A Rolls-Royce is a luxury car, and a Kosak is even more of a supercar among luxury cars. It is said that a Kosak costs tens of millions, with the most expensive limited edition costing 70 million!
What a joke! In this little Tianhai City, it’s simply impossible for anyone to afford such a car.
Lin Fan was obviously joking!
"Hmph, you really have no knowledge. And you call yourself a miracle doctor. You’re clueless about this stuff. In smaller places, money and power are intertwined; the richest families are always the ones with money and power. You should know this!" The girl said.
By saying this, the girl was implying to Lin Fan that not only is her family wealthy, but also has powerful connections.
Although the girl didn’t specifically say what kind of power her family holds, as long as it’s powerful, no one in this rural area would dare to provoke them.
Hearing about wealth and power, some other patients lost heart too. Better not to mess with someone like that!
"Little Fan, I’ll skip the examination today. It’s just a cold, nothing serious."
"I won’t see the doctor either. Just a slight fever. I’ll go home and sweat it out under a blanket; it should be fine."
"I won’t either."
The crowd expressed one after another.
The girl driving the Mercedes-Benz G-Class had a family with wealth and influence. With a flick of her fingers, she could wipe rural folks out of existence. Whether the illness was treated or not was unimportant; survival was the priority. Better to avoid trouble.
In the end, only Widow Li was left.
Widow Li was still waiting for Lin Fan, without showing any intent to leave.
The girl’s gaze settled on Widow Li’s face, sneering, "What about you?"
Everyone looked at Widow Li, waiting for her response.
But Widow Li seemed not to have heard the girl’s words, smiling as she said to Lin Fan, "Little Fan, I still have many questions to ask you."
Everyone was shocked; Widow Li wasn’t afraid of this girl!
Lin Fan said to the girl, "You heard her. Sorry, you’ll have to get in line."
With that said, Lin Fan turned to enter the examination room.
The girl was infuriated, "Stop right there! Are you attracted to this seductive woman, insisting on treating her? You come to the city with me; if you can cure my grandfather, I can find you a dozen women like her!"
Upon hearing this, everyone shook their heads secretly. This girl really didn’t know how to speak, offending people too much. Wouldn’t Lin Fan want to save face?
Widow Li’s expression fell a bit too. She tried her best to ignore the girl, but now the girl was directly targeting her, making it hard for her not to respond.
"Don’t talk nonsense." Widow Li said coldly.
Lin Fan said, "This is my sister-in-law. I hope you show some respect; otherwise..."
The girl snorted, "Otherwise what?"
At this moment.
"Brother Fan, come quickly, look at mom. Mom hurt herself." A voice rang out. Everyone turned to see Dog No.2 carrying Aunt Chunyu, stepping into the clinic, with Wei Yue’er beside them.
Aunt Chunyu looked pale, cold sweat pouring down, appearing very painful.
Lin Fan was startled, "How did this happen? What’s the matter?"
Dog No.2 glanced at the girl and the close-cropped youth, pointing: "It was them, they caused this to happen to mom!"
At that time, Aunt Chunyu was carrying a load of sweet potatoes on the road when the two suddenly drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class past, frightening Aunt Chunyu. She instinctively avoided them, causing both her and the load to fall into the field, injuring her back.
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan’s face darkened. He lifted his head and looked coldly at the girl, "Sorry, you don’t have to wait in line. You can get the hell out of here."
The girl froze, then flew into a rage, "What did you just say? A mere village doctor dares to insult me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 580: My District Chief Father
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 580: My District Chief Father
In this small city, those who can afford a Mercedes G-Class are usually not from ordinary families, except for someone like Lin Fan, who’s an anomaly.
The bratty girl feels fully entitled to walk all over the people in this city, and everyone has to yield to her.
In fact, this is how she’s been treated all her life; no one dares to offend her, and everyone caters to her like a princess.
Unexpectedly, she hit a snag in this countryside place today, as these country folks seem to not give her any face, each daring to defy her.
And now, Lin Fan also scolded her, actually telling her to get lost.
The girl was furious: "You, a village doctor, dare to scold me? Looks like you won’t cry until you see the coffin!"
She thought she’d made it very clear that in this city, someone who can drive a G-Class has money and power in their family. Is this village doctor someone who can afford to get in trouble with her?
Lin Fan rarely gets angry, but he was genuinely enraged at this moment. He could ignore their rudeness to him, but they actually caused Aunt Chunyu to get injured!
"I’ve already said it, how you act tough elsewhere is your business. But when you come here, you follow our rules. Not treating the scum of the earth is my principle, so you can just leave now! Besides, it’s your actions that led to Aunt Chunyu’s injury. Before you leave, kindly compensate for the medical expenses. Aren’t you rich enough, driving a G-Class? Can’t you afford that?" Lin Fan said coldly.
The girl laughed angrily: "What did you say? You called me scum? How dare you call me scum? The road in this broken countryside is so narrow, she was lucky I didn’t run her over when she didn’t give way to my car!"
Wei Yue’er frowned and said: "Judging by your words, Lin Fan calling you scum is not excessive at all."
The girl was a bit surprised to see Wei Yue’er. Wei Xue’er was so beautiful, fair-skinned, and well-dressed, completely unlike a countryside person!
It was truly unexpected. She thought everyone in the countryside was a bumpkin, but now she has met many unexpectedly remarkable people.
Widow Li and Liu Zixing were both great beauties.
Lin Fan, this village doctor, was young and exceptionally handsome, almost bizarrely so.
The girl collected her thoughts and said: "Did I say anything wrong? Should I, a vehicle, give way to her, a dead country woman?"
Wei Yue’er said: "Your words are too harsh. From what I understand, on that stretch of road where you met, there was no room to retreat. The only feasible solution was to let someone pass first, but you refused and insisted on pushing through, forcing Aunt Chunyu into a fall into the field on the side. The responsibility lies with you!"
The girl snorted: "So what if I refuse to let the country woman pass? Her falling is her problem!"
Upon hearing this, the onlookers shook their heads, thinking this girl was unreasonable and downright senseless.
Lin Fan said: "So, you refuse to compensate for the medical expenses?"
The girl sneered: "Ridiculous! There’s no way this lady would pay. I said before that it’s not because I can’t afford it. This lady has loads of money, but I’m not giving a penny to this dead country woman. What can you, a village doctor, do to me?"
Lin Fan said: "If a child is not taught, it’s the father’s fault. Since you refuse to compensate, I’ll ask your dad then. Tell me, who is your father?"
The girl laughed: "You want to ask my dad for money? You, a village doctor, are shamelessly bold! I said, if I reveal my dad’s name, you’ll be scared to the point of begging for forgiveness. Do you really want to know who my dad is?"
Lin Fan said: "I’d like to know who is so unfortunate to have a daughter like you."
The girl snorted: "Since you’re asking for trouble, I’ll tell you. My dad is Li Gang!"
By dropping her father’s name, the girl expected to see the countryside folks turn pale with fear.
To her surprise, everyone exchanged puzzled glances, seemingly not knowing who Li Gang was.
Lin Fan made a curious sound: "Li Gang? Who is that?"
The girl was livid: "Truly a bunch of ignorant country bumpkins! I’m telling you, so listen carefully: my dad, Li Gang, is the district chief of Tianhai City! And you, a village doctor, said my dad is unlucky to have me as a daughter? I have always been my dad’s pride, okay! When I was little, I won first place in a city-wide essay contest with my piece ’My District Chief Father.’ Have any of you ever won an essay contest?"
Lin Fan chuckled: "Indeed, when it comes to winning, we can’t compare with the district chief’s daughter."
The girl said: "Now you know my dad is the district chief. Aren’t you going to kneel and beg me for forgiveness? It seems you have no idea how powerful my father is!"
Lin Fan wasn’t afraid; a district chief of Tianhai City was not enough to intimidate him.
Dog No.2 wasn’t afraid either, as he didn’t even understand what a district chief was, so he wasn’t worried.
Aunt Chunyu, however, was scared.
"Little Fan, let it go. We can’t afford to cross a district chief. As for compensation, just forget it." Aunt Chunyu advised.
The girl chuckled coldly: "This country woman knows her place. I advise you to do the same, village doctor. Obediently come with me to treat my grandfather! If you can cure him, today’s matters can still be discussed."
Aunt Chunyu said: "So, they came to the village to find Little Fan for treatment. Little Fan, you’d better go. Don’t provoke the district chief. We ordinary folks cannot contend with officials; the arm cannot twist the thigh."
Aunt Chunyu’s viewpoint was very simple, reflecting the general opinion of ordinary people.
The girl looked at Lin Fan expectantly, waiting for him to submit. She couldn’t believe that after knowing her father is a district chief, Lin Fan would still dare to go against her!
However, Lin Fan shook his head: "Aunt Chunyu, I need to treat your injury now. Sister-in-law, my aunt’s condition is quite serious; I want to take a look first."
Widow Li quickly said: "It’s fine, hurry and help her inside."
Widow Li actively ran over to support Aunt Chunyu.
The girl was infuriated. This Widow Li had refused vehemently to let her in earlier, but now she immediately left room for a country auntie. Was this implying she was less important than a country auntie? Infuriating!
Aunt Chunyu was still apprehensive and said: "Little Fan, listen to my advice. Don’t be stubborn; it won’t do you any good. Just go with her; I’ll be fine."
Lin Fan said: "Aunt Chunyu, you don’t have to worry. It’s just a district chief, and even if it were the emperor himself, I’ll still prioritize your injury."
Upon hearing this, Aunt Chunyu didn’t know what to say. She was very touched but also worried about Lin Fan, wondering what kind of treatment he would suffer for offending the district chief’s daughter today.
The girl, seeing Lin Fan’s refusal to submit, felt a bit of a breakdown. She truly didn’t expect Lin Fan to be such a tough nut to crack.
"I don’t care; whether you want to or not, you’ll come with me today. Little Jin, this village doctor is too arrogant. Teach him a lesson and get him into the car. Whether he likes it or not, he’s coming with us today!" the girl said domineeringly.
She really was relying on being the district chief’s daughter to do whatever she wanted, actually attempting to forcefully take Lin Fan away!

chapters.title: Chapter 581: Unable to Pull
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 581: Unable to Pull
The young man with a crew cut was ready to follow the girl’s command, nodded, and was about to step forward.
Dog No.2 saw that the other party was about to harm Brother Fan and immediately stepped forward to block the young man with the crew cut.
"Don’t you dare!" Dog No.2 shouted angrily, glaring at the young man. If the other party really tried to make a move on Lin Fan, he would surely grab the opponent and throw him out.
Blocked by Dog No.2, the young man with the crew cut paused his steps, not daring to advance. He had experienced Dog No.2’s prowess and knew he was no match.
The girl hesitated a bit too. Damn it, this big fellow was too formidable. She originally intended to act, but it seemed impossible now.
Could it be that I, the daughter of a district chief, will have to bow down today?
To leave just like this was truly unsatisfactory. This lady has faced a major embarrassment this time. Coming to the countryside and not being able to even take a village doctor back will surely be laughed at.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Dog No.2, step aside. Didn’t they come to capture me? Let them go ahead and try. If they can catch me, I’ll go with them to the city."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan actually asked Dog No.2 to step aside?
Isn’t this giving the other side a chance?
The young man with the crew cut looked strong, and only someone like Dog No.2, who was like a black bear, could block him. Lin Fan, however, was asking Dog No.2 to step aside, how could he be a match for the young man?
"Could it be that Lin Fan is actually chickening out and wants to go treat the official, intentionally giving them a chance?"
"I think so. Lin Fan is all talk, but his body is very honest!"
"You can’t blame him. After all, the other party is the district chief. You can’t afford to mess with them!"
"That’s probably it."
The crowd discussed among themselves, thinking Lin Fan was chickening out and was intentionally giving the other side a chance.
The girl laughed, "You village doctor, you’re just putting on airs. Why not just give in?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No."
The girl said, "Then don’t blame us for being disrespectful. Little Jin, ’invite’ this miracle doctor onto the car for me!"
Dog No.2 was very obedient to Lin Fan. When Lin Fan told him to step aside, he did so without a word.
However, he was still worried the other party might harm Lin Fan, warning deeply, "If you harm Brother Fan even a bit, I’ll tear you apart. I’m watching you!"
The young man with the crew cut shivered inside. This big fellow, looking simple-minded, might really tear him apart as he threatened.
He realized he should be cautious, focus on subduing Lin Fan, and avoid hurting him at all.
The young man with the crew cut still felt confident about subduing Lin Fan, or rather, he never thought he would fail.
From his appearance, Lin Fan looked like a weakling. He was handsome but not strong, not the type with muscles from regular workouts. It was not unusual for a doctor like Lin Fan, who spends all day treating patients, to have no time for body training. He could take on ten of them effortlessly!
"Miracle doctor, are you coming with me by yourself, or do I need to take action? To not waste everyone’s time, I hope you make the smart choice," the young man with the crew cut said in a deep voice.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to stand on ceremony, come on, let me see what you’ve got."
The young man with the crew cut was puzzled. Lin Fan didn’t seem to fear him at all, which was really frustrating.
Even a bit annoying.
"Since the miracle doctor won’t be cooperative, I have no choice but to invite you myself," the young man with the crew cut said coldly, approaching Lin Fan.
As he neared Lin Fan, the young man with the crew cut reached out to grab Lin Fan’s shoulder, attempting to subdue him.
Got him!
The young man with the crew cut chuckled inwardly. Too easy, the opponent didn’t even have time to dodge before he grabbed his shoulder, unable to resist!
"Miracle doctor, come with me!" the young man with the crew cut said, about to pull Lin Fan up and forcefully take him away.
Wait!
The young man with the crew cut suddenly realized he couldn’t move Lin Fan!
Lin Fan stood there like a rock, not budging at all!
What’s going on?
The young man with the crew cut was bewildered. Maybe it was an illusion, but Lin Fan felt heavier than expected!
He tried again with more force, attempting to lift Lin Fan.
No luck!
Still couldn’t move him.
This was embarrassing, with everyone watching him. He tried twice and still couldn’t move Lin Fan. What would people think? At him struggling?
Indeed, everyone exchanged glances. The young man with the crew cut seemed to be trying to lift Lin Fan, but he couldn’t seem to budge him. The scene seemed a bit comical. Should they laugh?
"Pfft!"
Wei Yue’er was the first to stifle a laugh, followed by Liu Zixing’s giggles.
They both knew Lin Fan was very capable. When Wei Yue’er faced the Cyan Bamboo Snake attack that day, Lin Fan effortlessly killed the snake with a stone. She knew Lin Fan was skilled. Later, when Lin Fan dealt with Chen Junjie, it was just a matter of a slap. Liu Zixing had also witnessed Lin Fan’s prowess when the village hooligan came to harass her. Lin Fan acted, and the hooligan was powerless.
Hearing the laughter, the young man with the crew cut blushed. How embarrassing it was to say he’d take Lin Fan but couldn’t move him!
This guy was heavier than expected!
Looks like he needed to use real effort. The young man with the crew cut steadied his stance, using all his strength, trying to lift Lin Fan.
Still didn’t move!
Damn it, what the hell is this?
The young man with the crew cut was on the verge of breaking down. Ignoring everything else, failing to move Lin Fan was too embarrassing. All he needed was to lift Lin Fan to claim victory.
So, the young man with the crew cut used both hands, grabbing Lin Fan’s shoulders on either side.
Despite using all his strength, his face turning red, he still couldn’t lift Lin Fan. Lin Fan remained as immovable as a thousand-pound stone!
The girl couldn’t watch any longer, frowning, "Little Jin, what are you doing?"
The young man with the crew cut was about to cry, "Miss, I can’t move him!"
"What?"
The girl was stunned for a moment. How could this be? This village doctor didn’t seem strong at all. How could Little Jin not be able to move him? It didn’t make any sense!
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Weren’t you inviting me into the car? Is this how you invite someone? Looks like you can’t do it."
The young man with the crew cut was astonished. He finally realized he was probably dealing with a master, and not just any master!
This Lin Fan was likely more formidable than the bear-like Dog No.2!
How could this be? Lin Fan didn’t look strong at all! How could he be more formidable than Dog No.2?
Yet this feeling lingered for the young man with the crew cut. If he attacked with full force, he might withstand a few moves from Dog No.2, but before Lin Fan, he couldn’t retaliate at all.
Only the young man with the crew cut knew he had already used all his strength. He had never been pushed to this point in his life!
"Who... who are you?" the young man with the crew cut couldn’t help but ask in horror.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Looks like you can’t invite me. Let me help you get on the car instead. Farewell then."
With that, Lin Fan suddenly reached out, laid his hand on the young man with the crew cut’s hand, moving it off his shoulder.
The young man tried to resist, but his face turned red from straining, and he couldn’t resist at all, eventually having his hand moved aside by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan then kicked outward, landing the blow on the young man with the crew cut’s abdomen.
"Ah!"
The young man cried out in pain and fell to his knees with a thud.
Lin Fan then grabbed the young man by his collar, lifting him like a chick, and tossed him out of the clinic.
"Do you want to try too?" Lin Fan turned to the girl, smiling softly.
The girl was already dumbfounded, and everyone in the room was equally shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 582: Aunt Chunyu’s Secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 582: Aunt Chunyu’s Secret
It seems everyone misunderstood Lin Fan.
Lin Fan asked Dog No.2 to step aside, not because he was backing down or intentionally letting the other party take him away, but because...
He simply was not afraid of the buzzcut youth. When Lin Fan lifted him up and threw him out, landing on the ground, everyone finally realized.
They were all stunned, amazed at how formidable Lin Fan was. His medical skills were impressive enough, but he also had such amazing physical skills. The buzzcut youth, who looked much stronger than Lin Fan, was no match at all.
The most surprised was Dog No.2. Initially, he wanted to protect Brother Fan, but it turned out Brother Fan didn’t need his protection, and looked even more formidable than him in a matter of minutes.
Lin Fan threw the buzzcut youth out, which truly startled the girl in the Mercedes.
When Lin Fan turned his gaze to her and asked if she also wanted to try flying through the air,
the girl screamed in fear and ran out.
Soon, the girl and the buzzcut youth got into the Mercedes G-Class and fled in a hurry.
Liu Zixing stomped her foot and said, "You managed to run fast, but you haven’t paid the medical expenses yet!"
Lin Fan calmly said, "Don’t worry, they won’t get away. I believe they’ll come back."
Unless they don’t want treatment anymore or find another doctor who can cure them, this matter won’t end here. And their chances of finding another doctor are very low because they must have already sought many doctors before coming to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan then helped Aunt Chunyu with her injury. Aunt Chunyu suffered a twisted waist, quite a serious injury. If not treated promptly, it could lead to permanent damage, with her suffering from the waist injury for the rest of her life.
Fortunately, Lin Fan was there. He took out the silver needles, performed the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles, and gave Aunt Chunyu acupuncture.
Miraculously, Aunt Chunyu soon felt no pain, her previously pale face also regained its redness.
In the examination room, Aunt Chunyu was lying on the bed, with her top lifted up, exposing her waist.
Lin Fan was applying the needles.
However, Lin Fan’s attention wasn’t fully focused, as he was intrigued by Aunt Chunyu’s waist. It was truly surprising.
Usually, it’s not noticeable, but at this moment, it was clear. Aunt Chunyu’s figure was unexpectedly good, with a slender wasp waist and fair skin. This didn’t look like a farmer’s waist at all, but more like a model’s.
Even a model would be proud to have this kind of waist!
Usually, Aunt Chunyu dressed very plainly, wearing loose clothes. Now it seemed like she was deliberately hiding her good figure.
Lin Fan actually noticed Aunt Chunyu’s uniqueness long ago. Back then, Lin Fan and Dog No.2 became best friends, honestly because they were attracted by Aunt Chunyu.
Aunt Chunyu was deliberately appearing plain, but if she tidied up properly, she’d definitely be an exceptionally elegant socialite.
Lin Fan couldn’t help but be curious about what Aunt Chunyu had gone through.
Although Lin Fan called her Aunt Chunyu, she’s actually only in her thirties. In the city, a woman in her thirties is at most considered an older unmarried woman, living as freely as a girl.
Lin Fan faintly felt that Aunt Chunyu probably had some special experiences that made her live as a farmer in the village for over ten or twenty years.
But since Aunt Chunyu deliberately disguised herself, she clearly didn’t want others to know her past, so Lin Fan pretended not to see and didn’t ask further.
Everyone has secrets, and others don’t need to know.
He Chunyu felt a bit uneasy at the moment, as if she could sense Lin Fan’s gaze lingering on her waist; it was hard to guarantee Lin Fan wouldn’t have some thoughts.
He Chunyu could only try to divert Lin Fan’s attention through conversation.
"Little Fan, I’ve heard about your great medical skills these days. Today I’ve finally witnessed it. Little Fan, you are truly exceptional. I’ve always had faith in you since you were young." He Chunyu smiled.
Lin Fan replied, "Thank you for your compliments, Aunt Chunyu. Don’t worry, I won’t let anything happen to you."
He Chunyu said, "I know, you and Dog No.2 are the best of friends. Over the years, Dog No.2 has benefited greatly from having you as a friend. I’ve always been grateful to you. Without you, Dog No.2’s childhood would have been lonely."
Lin Fan replied, "Aunt Chunyu, please don’t say that. Dog No.2 and I are just kindred spirits."
He Chunyu chuckled.
Lin Fan saw her and was a bit enchanted. This is what they call bright eyes and white teeth; Aunt Chunyu has them, even though she deliberately appeared plain, it couldn’t entirely hide her charm.
Just as Lin Fan was treating He Chunyu, outside the clinic, another car drove up.
This was a very ordinary car. Judging by the brand, even if it were new, it would cost just tens of thousands, and as a second-hand car, only twenty to thirty thousand. Looking at it, it was quite old, probably a used car.
A middle-aged man got out of the car, dressed plainly but very neatly and appropriately, clearly a very organized person.
The middle-aged man walked in, glanced around, and his gaze fell on Liu Zixing.
"Excuse me, are you the nurse here?" the middle-aged man asked.
Liu Zixing replied, "I am, are you here for a consultation?"
The middle-aged man smiled, "Yes, I heard there’s a Divine Doctor Lin here, so I came to seek treatment. Could you tell me if Divine Doctor Lin is here?"
This middle-aged man was very polite, perfectly mannered, which made Liu Zixing quite fond of him. After the unpleasant encounter with the arrogant girl, having such a courteous person come by was indeed refreshing.
"The doctor is currently seeing patients; if you’re here for treatment, you might have to wait a little." Liu Zixing said.
The middle-aged man glanced inside the clinic. Since the arrogant girl fled, the patients who had been scared off earlier returned. The line was long, and he might have to wait a while.
But the middle-aged man showed no impatience, nodded: "Alright, it’s okay, I’ll wait patiently."
After speaking, the middle-aged man automatically went to the bench at the clinic’s entrance, sat down, and began to wait quietly.
Meanwhile, the arrogant girl, terrified by Lin Fan, returned to the car and hastily fled West River Village.
The more the arrogant girl thought about it, the angrier she got: "Despicable, so despicable! I was bullied by a village doctor, and I can’t swallow this indignation!"
The buzzcut youth silently drove, saying nothing.
In reality, he was still unsettled, never dreaming he’d be thrown out by Lin Fan, unable to fight back. Lin Fan was too formidable—a person who could lift and throw him out the door was definitely a master!
In this small mountain village, there are indeed hidden dragons and crouching tigers!
"Little Jin, it’s all your fault. You can’t even beat this village doctor?" The arrogant girl blamed the buzzcut youth.
The buzzcut youth smiled bitterly and didn’t speak; she was the young lady, even if her complaints were unreasonable, he could only take it, especially since he didn’t know how to answer her question.
Who knows why Lin Fan was so strong!
According to modern combat theories, a person’s fighting ability is linked to their weight—a 80 kg boxer can beat a 60 kg one, which is why boxing matches are divided by weight for fairness.
So theoretically, the buzzcut youth, who outweighed Lin Fan, should have been better at fighting.

chapters.title: Chapter 583: He Won’t Survive
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 583: He Won’t Survive
Lin Fan’s existence is almost like mocking the theory of boxing matches, becoming an inexplicable BUG.
It’s just like Yip Man being evenly matched with the Tsarist Russia boxing champion. However, most of Yip Man’s stories are fabricated; in reality, Yip Man rarely fought. If he truly went up against the bear-like Tsarist Russia boxing champion, with Yip Man’s small stature, he’d definitely struggle.
But Lin Fan truly exists; the crew-cut youth’s own experiences don’t lie.
"Absurd, I must teach that village doctor a lesson. I must ask Dad to intervene. I don’t believe he really dares to go against Dad! Little Jin, when we get home, you just have to listen to me, don’t say anything!"
The spoiled girl continued to grumble about Lin Fan.
In a villa in Tianhai City.
"Dad, I was bullied by that village doctor, you have to stand up for me!"
As soon as the spoiled girl returned home and saw her district-chief father, she immediately began to cry.
The district-chief was too busy with official duties to personally invite Lin Fan. To show respect for Lin Fan while not casually sending anyone, he sent his daughter.
Unexpectedly, his daughter didn’t bring Lin Fan back; she came back crying, leaving the district-chief puzzled.
"What happened?" The district chief was confused.
The spoiled girl cried: "That village doctor refused to come to the city to treat Grandpa; he wanted me to queue with those villagers and demanded I pay for the medicine. I told him I’m your daughter, but he dismissively said district-chief is nothing; even if the Emperor came, he wouldn’t be scared. After saying that, he drove us out."
The district-chief’s face turned grim upon hearing this. It seems that this Divine Doctor Lin was quite arrogant, daring to say that a district chief was nothing; he really has a high opinion of himself.
"Dad, your daughter has never suffered such grievances, you have to stand up for me!" The spoiled girl cried, looking pitiful.
The district-chief doted on his daughter immensely, seeing her tears made him a bit angry.
"I never thought this Lin Divine Doctor was such a person. Don’t cry, my dear daughter, Dad will definitely stand up for you." The district-chief said.
The spoiled girl was delighted, thinking Dad is really the best; with Dad stepping in, surely Lin Fan can’t stand up to it.
"Thank you, Dad, Dad is the best." The spoiled girl went up, hugged the district-chief’s neck, and began to act coy.
The district-chief coaxed: "Alright, my dear daughter has worked hard; go and rest well."
The spoiled girl said: "Of course, that countryside area is so annoying, I never want to go there again. The villagers are annoying too; I never want to see them again! Oh, I’m exhausted, I need a facial to properly rejuvenate. Just one visit to the countryside has ruined my skin; how annoying."
After saying this, the spoiled girl left.
The district-chief called out to the crew-cut youth, showed a serious expression, and said: "Little Jin, what exactly happened in West River Village?"
"This..." The crew-cut youth hesitated.
He didn’t dare to conceal from the district-chief, nor did he dare to betray the young miss with the truth.
The district-chief said: "I asked you to follow the young miss because I trust you to be reliable; speak up, recount everything about the countryside trip, don’t be afraid."
The crew-cut youth hesitated for a moment but had to speak truthfully.
After listening, the district-chief showed a wry smile.
"I shouldn’t have let that girl go; this time we’ve offended the Divine Doctor." The district-chief said helplessly.
Then, the district-chief felt a bit displeased, "Even if Feifei was wrong, but the Divine Doctor knew she’s my daughter, yet refused to give face; he really doesn’t take me seriously, does he? I’d like to meet him personally."
West River Village small clinic.
In the observation room, Lin Fan finally stopped needling and said to He Chunyu: "Aunt Chunyu, try to get up and move around."
He Chunyu felt a sense of relief; lying on the bed before Lin Fan, exposing her slim waist, made her a bit embarrassed.
However, she quickly forgot this embarrassment as she tried moving a bit and was pleasantly surprised to find her waist no longer hurt.
Moving freely as if she’d never been injured.
It’s truly miraculous!
He Chunyu was not without experience; she knew how severe her waist injury was. Carrying over a hundred pounds of sweet potatoes and falling in the field, if mishandled, her lower back would torment her for the rest of her life.
Yet, Lin Fan’s acupuncture somehow healed her; this medical skill can only be described as miraculous.
It’s really unbelievable. Little Fan has become so excellent now, it’s as if he’s a cheat code in life.
"Little Fan, your medical skill is truly amazing, thank you so much." He Chunyu said excitedly.
Lin Fan laughed: "Don’t be so formal, this is as it should be. Speaking of which, that woman came to find me; Aunt Chunyu’s injury is partly because of me, so I have the responsibility to heal you."
The two of them walked out of the examination room.
When entering, He Chunyu had a pained expression, needing support. Coming out, seeing He Chunyu looking at ease and moving freely, everyone was shocked.
Indeed, he is Divine Doctor Lin.
"Tsk tsk, Little Fan’s medical skill is truly top-notch."
"Indeed a divine doctor!"
"Little Fan’s ancestors must be smiling upon him, having such powerful medical skills; the future is limitless!"
The villagers exclaimed.
Dog No.2 was overjoyed seeing his mother healed.
"Brother Fan, you’ve healed Mom, you’re amazing!" Dog No.2 chuckled, thoroughly admiring Lin Fan.
He’s always admired Lin Fan, thinking Lin Fan was impressive for good grades and university admission; now that admiration has soared exponentially.
Wei Yue’er also showed appreciation beside him. Lin Fan, this guy, is truly outstanding; even her, having seen many excellent guys, finds no one can compare to Lin Fan. Lin Fan appearing in this small mountain village is a miracle; even she can’t help but feel crazily attracted.
The middle-aged man sitting on the bench outside noticed these remarks, his gaze fell on Lin Fan, showing curiosity.
Lin Fan healed He Chunyu and continued to treat others.
Lin Fan noticed the unfamiliar middle-aged man outside the door, and asked Liu Zixing: "What’s with the person outside?"
Liu Zixing said: "He came to see you for treatment; your reputation seems to have spread, many strangers sought treatment today. This uncle is quite nice, patiently lined up, worlds apart from that spoiled woman."
Lin Fan oh-ed and said: "Later, go out and tell him to return, no need to queue. He won’t make it; no point wasting time."
After saying this, Lin Fan went into the examination room with Widow Li to continue treating.
Liu Zixing paused, uncertain what Lin Fan’s words meant just now?
She wanted to ask more, but Lin Fan and Widow Li had already closed the door behind them.
Liu Zixing glanced at the middle-aged man, feeling troubled about how to speak up. This uncle is quite good-hearted; to say this would be too discouraging, too cruel!

chapters.title: Chapter 584: I Can See It
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Chapter 584: I Can See It
Lin Fan saw off the last patient, stretched lazily, and planned to wrap up today’s consultation. These past few days he had been working at this rural clinic, experiencing a doctor’s work firsthand. According to Liu Zixing, Old Liu would be returning in a couple of days, and then he wouldn’t need to continue.
Looking up, Lin Fan saw the middle-aged man still seated quietly on the bench outside, waiting.
Lin Fan gestured, calling Liu Zixing over.
"You didn’t ask him to leave?" Lin Fan asked.
Liu Zixing showed an embarrassed smile: "I struggled for a while but couldn’t bear to send him away. I think this uncle is quite nice. Besides, Lin Fan, your medical skill is so good, can’t you try to save him?"
Lin Fan wiped sweat away, saying: "Looks like I have to play the bad guy here, alright then, please ask him to come in."
"Sure." Liu Zixing replied happily, hastily heading out.
Soon, the middle-aged uncle followed Liu Zixing inside.
"You’re Divine Doctor Lin, so young—truly promising!" The middle-aged uncle said with a smile, extending his hand courteously to Lin Fan, hoping for a handshake.
The other person gave Lin Fan a gentle and calm feeling, so Lin Fan reached out to shake his hand: "Please have a seat."
The middle-aged uncle sat down across from Lin Fan, saying: "Divine Doctor Lin, I came here admiring your reputation, seeking medical help. I’ll tell you about my condition first..."
Lin Fan said: "Wait, you don’t need to explain. I’ve already seen it from your complexion. I apologize for being direct, but I don’t want to offer false hope. The deathly pallor on your forehead is unmistakable; in less than a month, you are certain to die."
Liu Zixing sighed beside him, so tragic.
The middle-aged uncle seemed stunned at first, revealing surprise before regaining composure, saying: "Divine Doctor Lin, is there really no hope for me?"
Lin Fan said: "You’ve been taking medication to alleviate pain lately, haven’t you? Did your doctor prescribe it?"
The middle-aged uncle replied: "Yes, I’m in such pain I can’t sleep at night without painkillers. I’ve seen many doctors who couldn’t figure out what’s wrong with me. Regular painkillers were ineffective until a renowned doctor, Dr. Ai Luoqing from the province, prescribed this painkiller, and it finally brought relief."
Upon hearing this, Liu Zixing exclaimed: "Ai Luoqing, a famous doctor! She’s so renowned. One of our textbooks in school was written by Dr. Ai. Oh dear, even Dr. Ai couldn’t cure you?"
Ai Luoqing was indeed a renowned old doctor, known as a master, and even he couldn’t cure this middle-aged man. No wonder Lin Fan said the uncle was beyond saving.
Lin Fan didn’t know who Dr. Ai was, saying: "That doctor made a mistake. The painkillers you were given, while relieving your pain, are like drinking poison to quench thirst. They’re actually worsening your condition, accelerating organ deterioration. Lately, have you been experiencing worsening insomnia, sometimes unable to sleep through the night, and even if you manage to sleep, you’re plagued by nightmares?"
The middle-aged uncle stood stunned, Divine Doctor indeed, he hit the nail on the head!
How did he know, as if he had observed him at bedside?
"That’s exactly the case. Divine Doctor Lin, what exactly is wrong with me?" The middle-aged uncle couldn’t help but ask.
Lin Fan said: "You’ve been poisoned."
"Ah?"
The middle-aged uncle and Liu Zixing both gasped in shock.
Lin Fan said: "This toxin is particularly lethal, requiring only a trace amount for fatality. Yet, due to the minuscule quantity, standard medical tests can’t detect it. That’s why those doctors couldn’t determine your illness. The toxin has infiltrated your bloodstream, becoming almost invisible, trace-less. After being poisoned, one doesn’t die immediately but endures severe pain in all internal organs, ultimately dying slowly. That’s the terrible cruelty of this poison."
Such a terrifying toxin exists in the world!
The middle-aged uncle asked in astonishment: "Divine Doctor Lin, what kind of poison is it?"
Liu Zixing was curious: "Since standard medical tests can’t detect it, how did you know, Lin Fan?"
Lin Fan just glanced at the middle-aged uncle and instantly diagnosed him as poisoned beyond recovery, leaving her very curious.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, saying: "I could tell."
Liu Zixing wiped cold sweat away: "Alright then..."
Lin Fan didn’t disclose that within his top-tier medical skills, there was data on this toxin. Although rare, its symptoms were quite distinct. Through observing complexion, he was able to identify it.
Lin Fan said: "This toxin is a chemical element. As far as I know, this element isn’t widely known yet and hasn’t been officially named; most chemistry students haven’t encountered it, only a handful have access. I have no idea how you got infected with it."
The middle-aged man thought of something upon hearing this, and blurted out: "Could it be..."
But immediately he bit back his words.
Lin Fan smiled, saying: "The source of your infection is another story. Perhaps someone poisoned you, and this person surely knows and has access to the toxin. Regardless, I’m not concerned with that."
The middle-aged man composed himself, asking: "Divine Doctor Lin, is there really no cure for this poison?"
Lin Fan said: "There’s an antidote to every poison, it’s not that it can’t be cured. It’s just..."
The middle-aged man asked: "Just what?"
Lin Fan said: "Have you heard of artemisinin, the drug that treats malaria? It was only discovered after years of arduous research, and the scientist who discovered it was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine. The antidote for this poison is even harder to extract, and its raw material is extremely rare—as rare as lottery tickets. By the time it’s discovered, extracted, and used for treatment, you might be long gone, which is why I say you’re beyond saving."
The middle-aged man froze for a while, eventually showing a bitter smile: "Seems I’m truly beyond saving."
Liu Zixing said: "Lin Fan, the uncle is so pitiful, can’t you think of something?"
Lin Fan said: "Well, stop taking that painkiller immediately. I’ll prescribe you something else to alleviate the pain, so your passing won’t be as agonizing."
The middle-aged uncle seemed to be an optimistic person, quickly adjusting his mindset: "Thank you, Divine Doctor Lin."
Lin Fan thought for a moment, sighed slightly, saying: "Moreover, the herb that can cure you typically grows deep in the mountains. So, how about I take a stroll in the mountains and see if I can find it? However, the chances are akin to winning the lottery. It depends on your luck."
Actually, Lin Fan finding such a herb isn’t impossible, especially considering he has another miraculous asset.
Top-tier Koi Carp Luck!
With top-tier Koi Carp Luck, finding this herb that’s even harder to come by than winning the lottery should be a breeze.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: The District Chief Visits
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Chapter 585: The District Chief Visits
But of course, Lin Fan couldn’t honestly tell him and could only explain in general terms that under normal circumstances, this kind of medicinal herb is indeed hard to come by.
Moreover, Lin Fan didn’t know this uncle, who was likely poisoned by someone. This could be a muddy situation, and Lin Fan had no intention of getting involved in someone else’s mess.
The middle-aged uncle was delighted: "Thank you, Divine Doctor Lin. If I truly find it, it’s a blessing. If not, it’s my fate. In any case, I must thank Divine Doctor Lin. This illness has troubled me for a long time, and finally, I have an answer here. Even if I die, I’ll die with understanding."
Lin Fan said, "Uncle, leave your phone number. If I discover that kind of medicinal herb, I’ll let you know."
The middle-aged uncle then left a phone number, stood up, and prepared to leave.
"Today I rushed over in a hurry and didn’t even have time to use the bathroom. Can I borrow yours?" the middle-aged uncle asked.
Lin Fan replied, "Go ahead."
The middle-aged uncle went into the bathroom.
Liu Zixing leaned close to Lin Fan and whispered, "Lin Fan, are you really planning to go to the mountains to help the uncle find that kind of herb?"
Lin Fan said, "Maybe, let’s see if I have time."
Liu Zixing said, "Go ahead, I’ll go with you. The more people, the better the chance. I think the uncle is quite pitiful, let’s help him."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You seem quite concerned about this uncle."
Liu Zixing said, "Because I feel the uncle is a good person. I don’t know why, but he just gives me that feeling."
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Maybe you’re right. This uncle is definitely no ordinary person; a person’s aura doesn’t lie."
As they spoke, they suddenly heard the sound of a car outside, and a black Mercedes drove up to the clinic.
Liu Zixing chuckled and said, "Lin Fan, it looks like your reputation has really spread. Someone else is here seeking your medical expertise, and it’s someone wealthy this time."
Lin Fan sighed. He possessed top-tier medical skills and could indeed cure illnesses, including those others couldn’t. But if his future job meant seeing patients every day, it would be pretty boring.
What Lin Fan wanted more was to return to Yun City and continue completing the main tasks of the system, turning Mortal Group into a trillion-dollar commercial empire.
In the future, being a doctor would only be his sideline.
"If you want to seek medical expertise, you’d better hurry up. Once Old Liu returns, I should leave too," Lin Fan said.
Upon hearing this, Liu Zixing couldn’t help but feel a bit downcast. If she could, she’d wish Lin Fan would stay here forever, but she knew that was impossible. Lin Fan was only temporarily standing in for her father.
At this moment, the Mercedes stopped outside, and a middle-aged man with a large belly got out of the car. Then a middle-aged man in a suit followed him into the clinic.
The middle-aged man looked around, his gaze falling on Lin Fan, and laughed, "This must be the renowned Divine Doctor Lin. My name is Li Gang, I’m the District Chief of the North District of Tianhai City. Divine Doctor Lin, you should have heard of me from my daughter, right?"
Liu Zixing was taken aback. So this was Li Gang, the Li Gang bragged about by that unruly girl who always said, "My dad is Li Gang"!
The unruly girl was chased off by Lin Fan, and now Li Gang himself had come. Could he be here to cause trouble?
"So it’s District Chief Li. What guidance does District Chief Li have?" Lin Fan smiled.
Li Gang saw Lin Fan’s calm expression, not even standing to greet him after learning of his identity, and couldn’t help but frown. This Divine Doctor Lin was indeed arrogant!
"Today, my daughter came by and wanted to invite Divine Doctor Lin to help treat my father. But Divine Doctor Lin chased her away, so I made a point to come over," Li Gang said.
This District Chief might be here to stir trouble.
Liu Zixing said, "What do you mean by chased away? She was too rude and tried to forcibly take Lin Fan away. We were just forced to fight back."
Li Gang said, "My daughter might have been in the wrong. Divine Doctor Lin, considering my position, would you come with me to the city to see my father?"
Lin Fan replied, "I’m sorry, the clinic is already closed for the day."
What Lin Fan meant was that he had no intention of going to the city with Li Gang. Based on that unruly girl’s behavior, Lin Fan wouldn’t go for a consultation.
Li Gang felt a bit embarrassed. As a District Chief coming in person, and Lin Fan still wouldn’t give him face.
This Lin Fan was too unaware of the world. In Tianhai City, who didn’t show face to Li Gang? Just a village doctor, daring not to!
"Divine Doctor Lin, you really don’t plan to come with me? I hope Divine Doctor Lin will reconsider. Although Divine Doctor Lin may have remarkable medical skills, after all, you are young and may not understand other aspects enough..."
Li Gang said.
He carried a vague hint of threat.
Though Lin Fan’s medical skills were good, he didn’t know his limits. If he offended Li Gang, he wouldn’t fare well.
Lin Fan indeed sensed it and chuckled, "District Chief Li, if I don’t agree to treat your father, are you going to build a public toilet at my doorstep?"
Li Gang was momentarily stunned: "Build a public toilet?"
He didn’t get the joke. It came from when the village chief, offended by Lin Fan, wanted to retaliate by constructing a public restroom in front of Lin Fan’s house.
What Lin Fan implied was whether District Chief Li would also seek revenge if he didn’t agree.
Li Gang then chuckled, "I’m here to seek medical expertise. If Divine Doctor Lin doesn’t agree, there’s nothing I can do. Although I do have some influence in the city, Divine Doctor Lin can rest assured I won’t do anything."
Lin Fan responded, "That’s good. Then, please yourself, District Chief Li. Zi Xin, please see our guest out. We’re closed for the day; I want to go home."
Li Gang almost spat in frustration. He thought he had hinted clearly enough that he had influence in the city and could easily trouble Lin Fan if he didn’t agree. Lin Fan wouldn’t even know who was behind it!
But Lin Fan seemed oblivious and actually issued a dismissal order!
Li Gang said, "Divine Doctor Lin, it’s rare for me to come by. I sincerely hope Divine Doctor Lin accompanies me. I won’t mistreat you. If Divine Doctor Lin doesn’t want to, I won’t force it, but I do think it’s best if you come with me."
Lin Fan could understand Li Gang’s underlying message, yet he was unafraid of Li Gang.
Soldiers come, block with generals; water rises, cover with earth. Lin Fan didn’t provoke trouble, but he also didn’t fear it.
If District Chief Li decided to retaliate over this, Lin Fan had ways to handle it.
This District Chief Li didn’t apologize for his daughter’s behavior, instead using his status to pressure Lin Fan.
This was precisely why Lin Fan didn’t want to deal with him.
"I’m sorry, District Chief Li. The clinic is closed for the day. If you’re still seeking medical help, please come back tomorrow," Lin Fan smiled.
District Chief Li felt a tinge of anger. This Lin Fan showed no face and acted oblivious. It seemed he had to be more explicit.
"Divine Doctor Lin, I hope you understand..."
District Chief Li began, but suddenly, he saw the middle-aged uncle coming out of the bathroom.
They locked eyes and both froze.
District Chief Li blurted out, "Secretary! You, how are you here?"
District Chief Li was shocked. This middle-aged uncle was the Party Secretary of Tianhai City, and he happened to meet the Secretary here!

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Then Pay 100 Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Chapter 586: Then Pay 100 Million
District Chief Li was planning to coerce Lin Fan into compliance. As a district chief, if he couldn’t even handle Lin Fan, it would be quite embarrassing.
At this moment, District Chief Li saw a middle-aged man walking out of the restroom, and he was startled.
It turned out that this middle-aged man was Secretary Zhao of the Tianhai City Municipal Committee!
"Secretary, what brings you here?" District Chief Li asked with an embarrassed smile.
The middle-aged man was also a bit surprised to encounter his subordinate here. He smiled and said, "I’ve heard of Divine Doctor Lin’s reputation, so I came to visit today. Old Li, what are you here for?"
District Chief Li was a bit uneasy: "I... it’s like this, my father has been gravely ill recently. After knowing about Divine Doctor Lin, I came here hoping to ask him to treat my father."
Secretary Ma nodded: "I see, with Divine Doctor Lin’s exceptional medical skill, I’m sure the old gentleman will recover."
"Mm..." District Chief Li wiped cold sweat from his forehead, not telling Secretary Ma that Lin Fan did not intend to help.
Liu Zixing said, "Sorry, Dr. Lin has already stated that he won’t be making house calls this time. District Chief Li, please go back."
District Chief Li immediately showed an awkward expression.
Liu Zixing, this girl, spoke too directly, making him a bit embarrassed. At least Lin Fan hadn’t refused so bluntly.
Secretary Ma found it a bit strange. Besides being skilled in medicine, Divine Doctor Lin gave him the impression of a benevolent person. Why would he refuse to treat District Chief Li’s father?
"District Chief Li, what is going on here?" Secretary Ma asked sternly.
District Chief Li hesitated for a moment, not daring to lie, especially not face-to-face. If Secretary Ma found out he lied, he would lose face.
Moreover, since Secretary Ma also came to visit Divine Doctor Lin, probably for medical reasons, offending Lin Fan would mean offending Secretary Ma.
He could only report the truth.
"Hehe, this isn’t Divine Doctor Lin’s fault; it’s mine. I’m to blame. Initially, I planned to personally invite Divine Doctor Lin, but because I had a project to oversee, I couldn’t come personally. To show sincerity, I sent my daughter. Who knew she’d act so unruly and offend Divine Doctor Lin. This time, I’m mainly here to apologize to Divine Doctor Lin. I’m sorry for not disciplining her strictly, leading to her offending Divine Doctor Lin. I’m really sorry. Additionally, I brought compensation for the injury to the villager my daughter caused and will also apologize in person at their home. Divine Doctor Lin, do you find this acceptable?"
District Chief Li said humbly.
Lin Fan said, "Your daughter causing Aunt Chunyu to get injured should be compensated. You can give me the compensation to pass on for you. As for the apology, it’s unnecessary; Aunt Chunyu probably wouldn’t like to be disturbed."
District Chief Li quickly said: "Alright, may I ask how much I should compensate? I’ll write a check for 100,000 yuan; if it’s not enough, Dr. Lin, please let me know."
Lin Fan replied playfully, "Anything I want?"
District Chief Li patted his chest proudly and said, "Divine Doctor Lin, just say it. Money is not a problem."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, then compensate 100 million yuan!"
The other party had no idea how amazing Aunt Chunyu’s figure was under her simple clothes. Her slender waist was something many women dreamt of and many men desired, worthy of a hundred million.
Lin Fan’s demand for a hundred million stunned everyone present.
District Chief Li was immediately deflated. The bravado he had earlier, saying money wasn’t an issue, had vanished. What a joke, asking for a hundred million!
Even though the Li Family was indeed wealthy locally and could easily come up with several million, a hundred million was impossible, even selling everything.
Lin Fan was really asking for the moon here! District Chief Li was drenched in cold sweat.
The scene was awkward for a while.
Liu Zixing chuckled, "Didn’t you say money wasn’t a problem? You’re bragging a bit too much."
District Chief Li was secretly annoyed, but with Secretary Ma there, he didn’t dare lose his temper, so he just forced a smile: "Divine Doctor Li, isn’t that a bit too much?"
Lin Fan shook his head earnestly and said, "Not too much. My Aunt Chunyu almost had to spend the rest of her life in a wheelchair. A hundred million can’t make up for that pain. If I paid District Chief Li a hundred million, would you be willing to spend the rest of your life bedridden? I believe you wouldn’t!"
Although money is tempting, health is priceless!
If given a hundred million in exchange for being paralyzed, even if one possessed a hundred million, would they truly be happy? Because with a hundred million, there are still many things you can’t do; you can’t even jump with joy.
Conversely, possessing a healthy body, being able to jump and dance even if not wealthy, it wouldn’t matter.
Many might wonder what the big deal is. In reality, only when it’s gone do people cherish it, for instance, suddenly coming down with a severe cold, feeling groggy every day. At such times, you might be willing to give anything to regain your health.
So, what Lin Fan said wasn’t unreasonable; compared to health, a hundred million is nothing.
"..." District Chief Li found himself speechless for a moment and could only glance at Secretary Ma for help.
Yet Secretary Ma acted as if he hadn’t noticed and didn’t speak up for District Chief Li.
This time, it seemed District Chief Li had genuinely offended Divine Doctor Lin, and even Secretary Ma could not help, so best to stay out of it.
While District Chief Li was caught in his awkward predicament.
Lin Fan slightly smiled, changing the tone: "However... District Chief Li, you’re quite fortunate. I’ve already treated Aunt Chunyu, so the hundred million compensation is unnecessary. Instead, just pay for the medical expenses this time. Let me see, you can just pay 500 yuan, and I won’t give any discounts this time."
What?
District Chief Li broke into a cold sweat. The gap between a hundred million and 500 yuan was too vast!
Lin Fan was obviously playing with him!
Lin Fan indeed was teasing District Chief Li. He knew fully well asking District Chief Li for a hundred million was impossible, and he never intended to actually demand it from the start; he said it deliberately.
District Chief Li felt as if he were on a rollercoaster, with ups and downs.
"Divine Doctor Lin, you really have a way with jokes," District Chief Li said with a cheerful smile, even though inside he felt a storm of emotions but dared not show anger outwardly.
District Chief Li then quickly compensated 500 yuan and even felt that amount was too little. One must say Lin Fan’s fees were quite reasonable.
For his father’s illness, he had no idea how many so-called renowned doctors he had consulted. Each smiled and flattered him as the district chief, yet when it came to the fees, none of them hesitated to charge steeply.

chapters.title: Chapter 587: Skill of Manipulating People
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Chapter 587: Skill of Manipulating People
District Chief Li invited renowned doctors to treat his father. They charged anywhere from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, and even after paying, it all went to waste. They just provided some perfunctory excuses, and there was nothing you could do about it. It always felt like getting scammed out of money.
Setting aside Lin Fan’s outrageous joke earlier, Lin Fan actually only collected 500 yuan for compensation. He truly represents the conscience of the medical community!
"Divine Doctor Lin, you see I’ve apologized and paid the compensation, I wonder..." District Chief Li said with a sheepish smile, thinking that this would persuade Lin Fan to treat his father.
But who would have thought!
Lin Fan calmly said, "Sure, I’ll pass this compensation to Aunt Chunyu. Please feel free, District Chief Li, I won’t see you out."
What?
District Chief Li was both angry and anxious. Wasn’t Lin Fan just playing with him? He had paid and apologized, yet Lin Fan still refused to help!
"Divine Doctor Lin, what exactly will it take for you to help treat my father? Do I need to kneel and beg you?" District Chief Li nearly cried.
"Secretary Ma, please say a few good words for me. My daughter was indeed at fault for offending Divine Doctor Lin this time, but my father truly needs treatment." District Chief Li continued to seek Secretary Ma’s help.
Since they had come to him, it wouldn’t be right for Secretary Ma to say nothing.
Secretary Ma reluctantly said, "Divine Doctor Lin, if you find it convenient, perhaps you could help Elder Li with his illness. Even though Xiaoli is a bit headstrong and unlikable, Elder Li is an old revolutionary who has contributed to the nation. For my sake, I hope Divine Doctor Lin can assist."
Secretary Ma was also quite nervous, as Lin Fan had just promised earlier to find herbs that could be used to extract an antidote for him. If they upset Lin Fan and he decided not to search anymore, Secretary Ma’s life might be at risk too.
Yet Lin Fan didn’t hesitate, smilingly saying, "Since Secretary Ma has asked, I have no reason not to help. Alright, I’ll go take a look."
District Chief Li was both shocked and delighted; Lin Fan actually agreed. He was overwhelmed with relief!
Just moments ago, he was quite agitated, but suddenly, he could only feel gratitude towards Lin Fan. Wasn’t this classic? Lin Fan gave a candy after a smack.
Secretary Ma also felt quite relieved. Lin Fan acted on his behalf to help District Chief Li, which not only made Secretary Ma appear influential but also earned a personal favor from District Chief Li, which would surely be repaid in the future.
Instantly, Secretary Ma admired Lin Fan even more. This young man was truly extraordinary. Not only was he skilled in medicine, his skill of manipulating people was on par with seasoned political veterans.
"Divine Doctor Lin, my car is outside. Please, Divine Doctor Lin, get in," District Chief Li respectfully said.
However, Lin Fan said, "I will go help the old gentleman, but it’s really not possible today—it’s too late. How about I visit the city tomorrow?"
District Chief Li naturally wished Lin Fan would go immediately, but given Lin Fan’s decision, he couldn’t force it. Actually, having Lin Fan agree was already quite good.
"Alright, then I’ll send someone to pick up Divine Doctor Lin first thing tomorrow morning?" District Chief Li said.
Lin Fan said, "No need. Just give me the address. I’ll head over myself tomorrow—I have a car."
District Chief Li said, "Alright, thank you, Divine Doctor Lin."
Then, District Chief Li took his leave. This visit wasn’t in vain after all, successfully inviting Lin Fan. The previous unpleasantness meant nothing now, and District Chief Li was just excited.
Secretary Ma also left shortly after.
Only Lin Fan and Liu Zixing were left in the clinic.
Liu Zixing curiously asked, "Lin Fan, do you have plans tonight? Why not go to the city with District Chief Li?"
Lin Fan said, "I promised Aunt Chunyu to have dinner at her place. I promised when I returned, and tonight is the first chance I got."
Liu Zixing was amazed; it turns out having dinner at Aunt Chunyu’s was more important than treating the district chief’s father!
"Enough talking, let’s pack up and close. I have to go; Aunt Chunyu mentioned they might slaughter a chicken tonight," Lin Fan said, salivating.
Liu Zixing said, "Alright, you go ahead. I’ll close up myself."
Lin Fan nodded, got up, and was about to leave.
Just then, the door of the clinic was kicked open, and Wang Goudan rushed in with a bunch of hooligans.
The scene terrified Liu Zixing, making her lose her composure.
"What do you want?" Liu Zixing exclaimed.
Wang Goudan was the village bully of West River Village. Last time, he tried to harass Liu Zixing while Old Liu was away, but Lin Fan taught him a lesson. Lin Fan even played a trick on Wang Goudan, claiming that he was poisoned, scaring him out of his wits. Lin Fan gave Wang Goudan medicine, which turned out to be a laxative, charging Wang Goudan 3000 yuan.
After returning home, Wang Goudan took the laxatives for several days, nearly collapsing from dehydration. The more he thought about it, the more wrong it felt. So he took the laxatives to someone and discovered that Lin Fan had tricked him.
He wasn’t poisoned at all!
Lin Fan had deceitfully claimed he was poisoned, gave him laxatives, and of course, he couldn’t stop having diarrhea!
Wang Goudan was furious, feeling humiliated as the village bully, tricked like this by Lin Fan. How could he swallow this?
So, he gathered a group of hooligans to confront Lin Fan.
"You, Lin Fan, dare to fool me! Today I’ll teach you the meaning of pain!" Wang Goudan said angrily.
"This kid actually dared to trick Big Dog, he’s got a lot of nerve."
"That’s right, I say we should teach him a good lesson today, give him a beating to knock some sense into him!"
"And this chick? Let the brothers have some fun?"
The hooligans laughed loudly.
Liu Zixing despised these village hooligans the most. They were idle, causing trouble, and doing sneaky and dishonest acts, giving the village a headache. The girls in the village especially hated them because they often faced harassment from these hooligans.
Today, under Wang Goudan’s rally, these hooligans actually showed up together.
Wang Goudan seemed to have forgotten the lesson Lin Fan gave him last time, but it didn’t matter because he had brought a group of people with him this time, confident that Lin Fan couldn’t handle them all!
"Lin Fan, you dared to give me laxatives, nearly dehydrating me, damn you!" Wang Goudan cursed.
Pfft!
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh. Tricking Wang Goudan last time and giving him laxatives was truly brilliant.
"You’re still laughing; today, you’ll see if you can still laugh after I tear this place apart!" Wang Goudan ordered.
The group of hooligans prepared to take action.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Wang Goudan, you’re just a fool!"
What?
Lin Fan actually dared to call Big Dog a fool?
Wang Goudan angrily replied, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said, "I gave you laxatives, and yes, it’s not just any ordinary laxative, it could have dehydrated you to death."
Wang Goudan said angrily, "You admitted it, you bastard admitted it, attack, hit him hard!"
Lin Fan said, "Fool! I gave you laxatives to save your damn life! Instead of showing gratitude, you come to break things, what a fool!"
They froze; the hooligans paused.
What was this? Giving Big Dog laxatives was to save Big Dog? What kind of reasoning is this?
Wang Goudan was also confused: "Lin Fan, what do you mean, explain clearly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 588: The Rascal Becomes Obedient
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Chapter 588: The Rascal Becomes Obedient
Lin Fan said, "Did I tell you last time that you were poisoned? It’s true, I prescribed laxatives for you to help detoxify."
Lin Fan looked serious, and for a moment, Wang Goudan wasn’t sure if Lin Fan was really tricking him.
"Is this laxative really helping me detox?" Wang Goudan asked suspiciously, "I haven’t read much; don’t lie to me!"
Lin Fan said, "Of course it’s true. I’m here sitting in the clinic, treating a lot of people over these past days. Thanks to everyone’s kindness, they think my medical skills are alright. How could I ruin my reputation, right?"
Wang Goudan thought Lin Fan made sense; if Lin Fan was giving him laxatives as a prank, that would ruin his own reputation. Lin Fan wouldn’t be that stupid!
"How much longer do I have to take these laxatives?" Wang Goudan asked.
Lin Fan said, "Keep taking them for another week. Cleanse thoroughly, then I’ll prescribe another formula for you. After the laxatives, follow the formula to get your medicine."
Wang Goudan nearly cried, thinking he’d have to take the laxatives for another week, and then take more medicine!
"Lin Fan, how long do I have to keep taking medicine?" Wang Goudan asked.
Lin Fan said, "You’re deeply poisoned. I suggest you take medicine for about a year and a half; then it’ll be almost cured. Remember, during this time, you must not entertain thoughts of women, or else everything will be for nothing."
Wang Goudan really cried out, "Not being around women would be no different from being dead!"
Lin Fan’s face darkened, "Idiot, then just don’t bother treating it. I’ll save a prescription, and mark my words, you’ll definitely die within half a month. It’s your choice!"
Wang Goudan was startled by Lin Fan’s scolding, rubbing his head and laughing, "Of course life is important, Lin Fan. If staying away from women is necessary, then I’ll stay away. Just prescribe me a formula!"
Lin Fan said coldly, "You still owe me a treatment fee of 3000 bucks. When will you pay it? You better not default, or else you’ll just wait to die!"
Lin Fan’s words upset the local ruffians.
"How can you talk to Big Dog like that!" A ruffian arrogantly scolded Lin Fan.
Smack!
Wang Goudan suddenly slapped the ruffian hard, leaving five red marks and stunning the ruffian.
"Big Dog, why did you hit me?" The ruffian complained, feeling wronged. He clearly helped Big Dog to reprimand Lin Fan, so why did he get hit?
Wang Goudan scolded, "Mindless fool, can’t you see I’m discussing treatment with Lin Fan? It’s not your place to butt in, go away."
Wang Goudan then smiled sheepishly, "Lin Fan, I’m gathering the money, and I’ll soon have enough to pay you. In the meantime, could you prescribe me a formula?"
Lin Fan’s words about sudden death within half a month really scared Wang Goudan into compliance; after all, his life is important. He certainly doesn’t want to suddenly die in half a month. Lin Fan is reputed as a miracle doctor, it would be foolish not to believe him. While other things might be doubtful, when it comes to his life, he dare not be indifferent.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Alright, saving a life is worth more than building a seven-story pagoda. It’s fine if the payment is slightly delayed, but you must pay, okay?"
Wang Goudan responded quickly, "I will definitely pay."
Lin Fan said, "This formula is not to be shared. Come here for medicine in a week, and in the future, only here. Zi Xin will be responsible for your medicine; don’t offend her, or she might tamper with your medicine, and you’d still be doomed."
Wang Goudan was startled, quickly bowing to Liu Zixing, "Madam, I was wrong before. From now on, you are my revered madam; I dare not disrespect."
Lin Fan said, "Today’s incident is the last of its kind; I don’t want it to happen again disrupting the peace of the clinic. Also, I know you all are a bunch of ruffians and scoundrels, stealing chickens and dogs in the village. You better not let me catch any of your misdeeds, or you’ll be blacklisted. If you’re sick, I won’t treat you; my principle is not to treat scum."
Wang Goudan turned and glanced at the ruffians, "You all heard him, behave yourselves from now on!"
The ruffians obediently agreed.
Lin Fan smiled, "Alright, you may go now. Wang Goudan, remember to continue taking the laxatives when you get home, cleanse well."
Wang Goudan nodded and bowed, "Alright, Brother Fan, I’ll start right away, thank you. Brother Fan, you really are my savior."
Lin Fan said, "I’ll see you out."
So, Lin Fan, chatting and laughing, saw the ruffians out the door.
The ruffians were respectful toward Lin Fan, and Wang Goudan was especially courteous, grinning like a grandson.
Lin Fan patted Wang Goudan’s shoulder, "Alright, go home. Remember my words, stay away from women, or you’ll drop dead."
Wang Goudan gratefully nodded, bowing and leaving.
This scene left Liu Zixing beside them in shock. Had she not seen it herself, she wouldn’t have believed it was true; Lin Fan actually subdued a group of ruffians with just a few words?
Without lifting a finger, just using words, these fierce ruffians were tamed like grandchildren?
"Lin Fan, is the illness you told Wang Goudan about really true?" Liu Zixing couldn’t help asking, she was almost convinced.
Lin Fan smiled, "Of course it’s fake; there’s only one way to deal with these ruffians."
Lin Fan was still tricking Wang Goudan.
Wang Goudan was not technically poisoned. As Lin Fan had told Liu Zixing before, Wang Goudan merely had a slight kidney deficiency.
Wang Goudan came to harass Liu Zixing and got played by Lin Fan, who gave him laxatives that left Wang Goudan weakened, and also in debt to Lin Fan for 3000 bucks in treatment fees.
Wang Goudan found someone to check the medicine and discovered Lin Fan had given him laxatives, realizing he’d been fooled by Lin Fan. So, he gathered some ruffians to confront Lin Fan.
Unexpectedly, instead of smashing the clinic, they ended up obediently handled by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan had exploited information asymmetry; Wang Goudan didn’t understand medical skills and was clueless about his condition, while Lin Fan had the reputation of a miracle worker, effortlessly fooling Wang Goudan.
This illustrates that when professionals use their expertise to deceive, amateurs can only be fooled, unaware.
"Lin Fan, will the new formula you give him really cure his illness?" Liu Zixing asked, not wanting to treat Wang Goudan, the jerk.
Lin Fan smiled, "Of course it won’t. His illness could be cured with just one dose if I were to seriously treat it. This medicine will merely relieve his symptoms, making him believe he’s cured, but in fact, he won’t be."
Indeed, Lin Fan wouldn’t seriously treat Wang Goudan’s illness.

chapters.title: Chapter 589: Can’t Be a Couple
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Chapter 589: Can’t Be a Couple
Meanwhile, Lin Fan successfully helped Wang Goudan kick his bad habits, making him too afraid to mess with Liu Zixing in the future. In fact, in this village, because of his regard for Lin Fan, he didn’t dare to do anything wrong, which was a win-win situation.
Liu Zixing understood and couldn’t help but laugh. Lin Fan was too amazing, really amazing.
It turns out that medical skills can be used not only to treat illnesses but also to manage people.
Of course, Lin Fan could have used a more direct method, like force, to subdue and intimidate these hoodlums, but that might not have been the best approach.
Because Lin Fan was soon going to leave, and with Lin Fan absent, if these troublemakers acted up again, how could Liu Zixing handle it?
Only with this method could he ensure that Wang Goudan would always keep it in mind and not act recklessly.
Liu Zixing felt that it seemed Lin Fan was not only brilliant at healing the sick but also at managing people.
In this way, even if Lin Fan left West River Village now, she wouldn’t have to worry about Wang Goudan causing trouble again. In fact, in the future, Wang Goudan might even treat her like an honored guest.
"The best part is, Wang Goudan still has to take laxatives for another week." Liu Zixing couldn’t help but laugh.
Wang Goudan was thoroughly played by Lin Fan, yet he had to be endlessly grateful to him.
Lin Fan usually wouldn’t tease people like this unless it was someone like Wang Goudan. No matter how such low-lives are treated, it’s never too much.
After handling Wang Goudan’s issue, Lin Fan and Liu Zixing closed the clinic and were ready to leave.
"Zi Xin, what are you going to eat later?" Lin Fan asked casually.
Liu Zixing said, "I don’t know either, there’s just me at home, so I’ll probably just eat some instant noodles."
Lin Fan said, "Instant noodles aren’t nutritious, it’s better to eat less of them. How about you join me at Aunt Chunyu’s for dinner?"
Liu Zixing was a bit tempted but also a bit embarrassed, "Isn’t that a bit much? I’m not that familiar with Aunt Chunyu and them."
Lin Fan laughed, "What’s the big deal? Spend more time with each other and you’ll become familiar."
Liu Zixing thought for a moment and finally nodded, "Alright then."
So Liu Zixing went with Lin Fan to Dog No.2’s house.
Today, when Lin Fan was helping He Chunyu with her back injury, He Chunyu invited Lin Fan to her house for dinner. When she got home, He Chunyu started preparing dinner, slaughtering a chicken to make white cut chicken for tonight.
Dog No.2 and Wei Yue’er, who both came home from work, were helping out at home. The house became lively in preparation for Lin Fan’s visit for dinner.
The three of them were very happy. He Chunyu really liked Lin Fan, not just out of fondness but also gratitude. In this village, only Lin Fan was willing to play with Dog No.2, keeping him from feeling lonely.
In Dog No.2’s eyes, Lin Fan was as important as his mother. Tonight, with Brother Fan coming for dinner, Dog No.2 grinned broadly, as happy as a child.
As for Wei Yue’er, from what she’d observed over the days, she was extremely fascinated by Lin Fan. She could hardly believe it herself that such a person like Lin Fan existed in this village, something she never imagined even in her dreams.
He Chunyu was washing vegetables at the door. Seeing Lin Fan arrive, she smiled and said, "Little Fan is here."
She then saw Liu Zixing, "Miss Zixing is here too."
Upon hearing that Lin Fan had arrived, Dog No.2 and Wei Yue’er came out to greet them.
Dog No.2 chuckled, "Brother Fan, you’re finally here. I’m starving, but I wouldn’t eat until you arrived."
Wei Yue’er was about to greet Lin Fan but then saw Liu Zixing beside him. For some reason, Wei Yue’er felt a little disheartened.
Because she thought Lin Fan and Liu Zixing looked so good together, standing there they looked just like a couple. Could it be...
Thinking about it, Lin Fan wasn’t originally a doctor at the clinic, yet he started sitting in the clinic once he returned. He’s known Liu Zixing since they were kids, so saying they’re not a couple would be hard for anyone to believe.
But she didn’t show it on the surface and smiled, "Lin Fan, Zi Xin, you’re here."
Liu Zixing said, feeling a bit awkward, "I didn’t know what to eat at home alone, so I came with Lin Fan to grab a meal."
He Chunyu laughed, "Don’t say that, the more, the merrier. Come in and have a seat, dinner will be ready soon."
