Lin Fan and Liu Zixing went inside and sat down.
Dog No.2 chatted with Lin Fan.
Wei Yue’er laughed, "Zi Xin, I’m going to fry some dishes. Why don’t you come over and help me with the fire?"
Liu Zixing gladly agreed and followed Wei Yue’er into the kitchen to help with the fire. In the countryside, dishes are generally cooked with a clay stove burning wood, giving the food a smoky flavor, which makes it particularly delicious.
Generally speaking, food cooked with wood fire tastes better than when cooked with gas, and gas is better than an induction cooker. The induction cooker is the worst. If it wasn’t so inconvenient to use wood or gas, who would use an induction cooker to cook?
But the induction cooker is the most convenient. Most young people renting in the city use induction cookers, so one could say that many young people today have a low quality of life and often just make do when it comes to food.
While at work, they casually order takeout. After work, they casually cook something or even eat takeout again...
Liu Zixing was surprised that Wei Yue’er knew how to cook and did it well.
Liu Zixing knew Wei Yue’er came from a big city to volunteer as a teacher and was undoubtedly a city girl. Generally, city girls are quite pampered and incapable of cooking, which is quite normal.
"Sister Yue’er, you’re really good at cooking!" Liu Zixing said.
Wei Yue’er laughed, "Do I look like someone who can cook? To be honest, I really couldn’t cook before. It was only after coming here to volunteer that I learned. I’ve learned a lot since coming here, and now I’m quite independent."
Liu Zixing said, "Sister Yue’er, why did you come to volunteer here? Life in the city is so comfortable, what’s so good about the countryside? If it weren’t for needing to come back home to help, I would love to work at a big hospital in the city."
Wei Yue’er said, "I grew up in the city and got a bit tired of it, so I came to experience the countryside. And you know what? I fell in love with the countryside, love the children here; they’re so genuine."
Liu Zixing teased, "Well then, is Sister Yue’er thinking about marrying here and becoming a village wife?"
Wei Yue’er’s face turned red. She certainly wanted to, and now a suitable candidate had appeared...
But, Wei Yue’er was not sure yet if Lin Fan and Liu Zixing were a couple.
She called Liu Zixing to help, actually intending to take the opportunity to ask Liu Zixing, to probe Liu Zixing, about her and Lin Fan’s relationship.
"Zi Xin, I have a question I want to ask you, answer me honestly," Wei Yue’er said.
Liu Zixing, seeing Wei Yue’er suddenly serious, was a bit curious, "Sister Yue’er, what do you want to ask me? Feel free to ask. I won’t hide what I know from you."
Wei Yue’er asked, "What’s your relationship with Lin Fan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 590 Sister Yue’er Why Don’t You Go Confess
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Chapter 590 Sister Yue’er Why Don’t You Go Confess
Liu Zixing’s face immediately turned bright red, and she quickly said, "No, Lin Fan and I aren’t in that kind of relationship you think... Sister Yue’er, don’t misunderstand."
Wei Yue’er actually misunderstood her relationship with Lin Fan, which was so embarrassing. She’s grown up so much and has never been in a relationship, even though many pursued her, she never fancied anyone.
Wei Yue’er felt a bit happy inside, "So, do you have feelings for Lin Fan?"
Liu Zixing’s face turned even redder, "Sister Yue’er, don’t tease me, Lin Fan is an outstanding person, I wouldn’t dare to like him."
Wei Yue’er asked curiously, "Why wouldn’t you dare to like him? There’s nothing to be afraid of in liking someone."
Liu Zixing said, "Anyway, I never had that kind of thought. Actually, I didn’t interact much with Lin Fan before, it’s only in these last few days since he returned that we’ve had more contact. I just admire him a lot because he’s really amazing, nothing more."
Wei Yue’er made an ’oh’ sound and said, "Then do you think Lin Fan has feelings for you?"
Liu Zixing quickly said, "How would I know? Probably not, right? How could someone as outstanding as him be into me? Sister Yue’er, I think you and Lin Fan are more well-matched."
Wei Yue’er felt a sweet feeling inside and asked, "How so?"
Liu Zixing replied, "Sister Yue’er, you’ve come to this village to teach, actually, we all know you’re from the city, knowledgeable and courteous, and very pretty. Only a man like Lin Fan suits an outstanding girl like you. As for me, I’m too ordinary."
Wei Yue’er said, "Zi Xin, don’t say that, every girl is not ordinary, besides, you are also very pretty. No one knows what type of girl Lin Fan might like..."
This remark had a somewhat melancholic feeling.
Liu Zixing seemed to sense something and started to giggle quietly.
Wei Yue’er asked, "What are you giggling about?"
Liu Zixing said, "Sister Yue’er, you like Lin Fan, don’t you?"
Wei Yue’er’s face instantly turned red, letting Liu Zixing see through her, "Is it that obvious?"
Liu Zixing giggled, "Yeah, pretty obvious."
Wei Yue’er sighed and said, "I do admire Lin Fan a lot, he’s the most outstanding young man I’ve ever met. Before knowing him, I never thought there’d be such an excellent guy in the world."
Liu Zixing said, "Sister Yue’er, does Lin Fan know this?"
Wei Yue’er replied, "He probably doesn’t know, I haven’t shown it."
Liu Zixing giggled, "Then... do you want me to be your matchmaker? I could play the cupid."
Wei Yue’er hurriedly said, "No need, if he likes me too, that would be fine, but if he doesn’t, it’d be so awkward, we wouldn’t even be able to be friends then."
Liu Zixing disagreed, "Sister Yue’er is so outstanding, Lin Fan will definitely like you. Why don’t you go confess?"
Wei Yue’er shook her head, "I don’t want to, I’ve never confessed to a guy before, what if he rejects me... forget it, maybe another time."
Liu Zixing was a bit surprised. From the way Sister Yue’er looked, she thought Sister Yue’er should be a bold and decisive person in love but turns out she’s shyer than she thought.
Not sure if Lin Fan has feelings for Sister Yue’er. Speaking of which, Lin Fan really is an amazing guy, no wonder Sister Yue’er would be moved, who wouldn’t be...
Liu Zixing thought of this, her face involuntarily blushed a little, yeah, she is also a girl, isn’t she allowed to be attracted to such an outstanding guy like Lin Fan?
Even if she felt she doesn’t match Lin Fan, she could still quietly admire him, right...
Just then, the food was ready.
Tonight’s dinner, for a rural family, was quite sumptuous. To host Lin Fan, He Chunyu slaughtered a chicken, and Wei Yue’er showed her cooking skills by frying several substantial dishes, filling the table, giving off a festive vibe.
Dog No.2 drooled at the sight of so much delicious food.
"Delicious, delicious," Dog No.2 said, happily enjoying the meal, "Brother Fan, dig in, this is too good."
Lin Fan laughed, "Then I won’t hold back. Mmm, really delicious, this dish was made by Yue’er, right? Didn’t expect your cooking to be so good."
Receiving Lin Fan’s praise, Wei Yue’er was pleased and said, "Eat more if it’s good."
Liu Zixing teased, "Lin Fan, if you like Sister Yue’er’s cooking, why not marry Yue’er, then you can eat it every day."
Wei Yue’er blushed with embarrassment and scolded, "Zi Xin, what nonsense are you saying?"
Everyone laughed.
He Chunyu said, "Honestly, Little Fan, you’ve been working in the city for so long, do you have a girlfriend?"
This was a good question, as Wei Yue’er and Liu Zixing perked up their ears; they were curious too.
Lin Fan said, "No."
Though many beautiful women surrounded Lin Fan, each of them as lovely as flowers, he indeed didn’t have a girlfriend.
Hearing this, Wei Yue’er and Liu Zixing secretly rejoiced.
He Chunyu said, "How can that be? Aren’t your parents anxious, not finding someone for you to date?"
Lin Fan said, "There have been quite a few blind dates, but none worked out, I’m currently still single."
He Chunyu laughed, "Next time Auntie will find you a match to date. I say, lower your standards a bit. Even if you don’t get married, you can have someone to be with, someone to take care of you. Seeing you in the city alone, I bet you can’t even get a hot meal."
The mention of matchmaking made Lin Fan a bit fearful because he’s been on a lot of blind dates, often meeting some odd women who right away ask for a car and a house, looking down on him for being poor. Those women don’t seem like they’re looking for a husband, more like looking for cars and houses and tickets.
"Thank you, Aunt Chunyu, but I don’t want to go on blind dates anymore," Lin Fan said.
Aunt Chunyu curiously asked, "Why not? Are you planning not to marry or date? This thinking is dangerous, won’t your parents agree? They want grandchildren, you know."
Lin Fan said, "It’s not that I don’t want to marry and have kids, I just want to let things happen naturally. Blind dating is too transactional, like making a deal."
Lin Fan really didn’t want to go on more blind dates. Calling it a blind date felt more like making a deal.
What does making a deal mean? It’s like going to the supermarket to buy slippers; there might be a dozen pairs of slippers on the shelf, and you compare and evaluate them to buy a pair home.
Matchmaking is roughly the same as the slipper selection process.
Both men and women are picky.
Relatively speaking, in matchmaking, men are often at a disadvantage. There’s no helping it, it’s a male-surplus world; women aren’t worried about getting married, but finding a wife isn’t easy for men.
Most men don’t have that many choices, whereas there certainly isn’t a dozen slippers waiting for him to choose from. Commonly, whenever there’s a pair of slippers in front of him, he just grabs them.
Picky about this and that, wants someone gentle and cute, who can handle household affairs and is pretty too?
Really overthinking it.

chapters.title: Chapter 591: Dating is Like a Transaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Chapter 591: Dating is Like a Transaction
Guys wanting to gain an advantage in matchmaking need to be either handsome or rich; having money is far more important than good looks.
A handsome guy will never be short of romantic prospects; after all, we live in an era where looks matter. If a guy resembles one of those trendy male stars, especially with a Korean flair, he will be particularly favored by females.
Those young and fresh-faced male celebrities have endless fangirls, and it’s not because of their wealth or talent—it’s purely because of their looks.
So, for handsome guys seeking females, they are naturally given a priority in mate selection. If they have a bit of talent, it’s even easier.
Between a handsome guy and an ordinary-looking guy, females are more inclined to choose the handsome one.
Of course, this is just a general situation and can’t be applied universally.
In reality, there’s a saying that handsome men don’t lack girlfriends, while rich men don’t lack wives.
It means that females, when dating, tend to prefer handsome guys, but when it comes to marriage and settling down, they lean towards wealthy ones.
Why do many guys find matchmaking exhausting? Because once they reach the point of matchmaking, many females become realistic, immediately asking for cars, houses, and money. Without money, houses, or cars, they won’t marry!
Apart from females preferring wealthy men, their parents are also materialistic. Without money, houses, or cars, should they let their daughters suffer? They certainly won’t let their long-raised daughters marry poorly.
In the eyes of some parents, daughters are like investment projects, and when they get married, it’s time for the returns. Of course, the bigger the return, the better. Marrying a poor son-in-law is an investment failure; finding a wealthy man is a successful investment with high returns.
It’s fair to say this mindset is common among parents.
Even if many females aren’t really the type to shun the poor and love the rich, willing to work hard with their impoverished boyfriends, they’ll often face parental opposition.
Many loving couples have been torn apart by such parents.
So, for ordinary-looking and not-so-rich guys, is there no hope?
Of course not; they’ll eventually find someone. It’s just that they likely won’t be the goddess they once fantasized about.
It’s often the case that if she’s female, they’ll accept her. You can’t afford to be picky; just having a wife is good enough.
Because of this, females nowadays don’t worry about not finding a man. Even if the female is quite unattractive, as long as she’s willing, she can definitely get married.
Conversely, an unattractive male can’t guarantee he’ll find a wife—you don’t have dozens of options to choose from, having one is already good.
This is the reality.
Because of this, female standards have risen; they have dozens of choices, allowing them to be selective.
They can outright demand houses and cars, thinking what if they find one? Anyway, even if they can’t find someone with houses and cars, getting married won’t be difficult.
Even someone as handsome as Lin Fan faces difficulties in matchmaking because of his poverty.
Lin Fan remembers vividly when he encountered an odd matchmaking partner. If poor guys are called nerds, then this matchmaking partner was undoubtedly a female nerd—not good-looking, no money, no talent. Really, besides being female, there’s not a single redeeming quality.
Yet, she immediately asked Lin Fan if he bought a house in the city, has a car, what’s his monthly salary, and how much savings he has!
Can good looks be eaten?
Obviously not; only money puts food on the table.
Lin Fan laughed at the time, thinking that with her looks, she still wanted to find a tall, rich, and handsome guy?
Back then, Lin Fan was too young. After going through more matchmaking, he realized this was what it really is. These females, so ordinary yet so confident, they all wanted men with houses and cars and genuinely believed that only such men matched them.
Lin Fan never wanted to go matchmaking again.
Even now, with billions in cash savings, he still doesn’t want to matchmake. Seeing those females demanding houses and cars repulses him.
Indeed, there are not a few men with Lin Fan’s mindset.
Many wealthy guys fear females not loving them for themselves, but just for their money.
If a female only loves you for your money, then one day, when you unfortunately become poor, your business fails, and your status declines, she might abandon you without a second thought.
Consequently, many wealthy men pretend to be poor to find wives, hoping to find a woman who loves them not for their money.
Are there females who don’t love money but purely love a man? Is there still love in this world?
The answer is undoubtedly yes.
If a person no longer believes in love, no longer believes there are females devoid of vanity, no longer believes in true love, it’s quite sad.
Hearing Lin Fan say matchmaking now feels like a transaction.
Wei Yue’er and Liu Zixing fell silent.
They agreed with Lin Fan; indeed, many females are too materialistic when finding a partner, putting money first. Of course, these females wanting to avoid poverty and become wealthy folks has its reasons.
However, they happen not to be such people.
When finding partners, they’re more about wanting someone they truly love.
Currently, they don’t know Lin Fan is a billionaire giant, but they’re attracted by Lin Fan’s excellence, deeply smitten by him.
They were just eating.
Suddenly, sounds of excitement came from outside.
An uncle passed by He Chunyu’s house and spotted Liu Zixing at a glance.
"Zi Xin, so you are here!" the uncle exclaimed.
Liu Zixing seemed puzzled: "What’s going on? Is there someone sick needing treatment?"
The uncle replied, "No, someone came to the village looking for you, and it has stirred up the entire village. You should go and see."
Liu Zixing was increasingly perplexed: "Someone’s looking for me? Who is it?"
The uncle said, "It’s a young man with a sedan, looks like he’s wealthy, quite good-looking. He claimed you’re his girlfriend and specifically came to find you, even set up numerous flowers at the village entrance, saying he wants to propose to you."
Everyone looked towards Liu Zixing.
Liu Zixing’s expression changed, blurting out: "It’s him!"
Wei Yue’er curiously asked: "Who is it?"
Liu Zixing replied: "He’s a Rich Second Generation who has pursued me for a long time. I don’t like him, so to avoid him, I came back here. I actually had a job opportunity in the city, but because of him, I didn’t stay in the city. I didn’t expect him to find me here."

chapters.title: Chapter 592: The Clingy Rich Second Generation
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: Chapter 592: The Clingy Rich Second Generation
Listening to the uncle’s description, Liu Zixing immediately knew who had come, and suddenly she wasn’t feeling well.
Wei Yue’er asked, "Zi Xin, what’s wrong, who is it?"
Liu Zixing said, "It’s someone I really dislike, a rich second generation. He has been pursuing me before, but I didn’t agree to him. To avoid his pestering, I returned to the village. Originally, I had a job opportunity in the city, but I gave it up. I didn’t expect him to chase me here now."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," and said, "Is it the person who called you that day?"
On the day Lin Fan just returned, at the small clinic, a man called Liu Zixing. At that time, Liu Zixing stepped away, and Lin Fan took the call. Later, when the man called again, Liu Zixing refused to answer.
Lin Fan suspected then that it might have been Liu Zixing’s pursuer calling.
Liu Zixing nodded. That day, she had refused the man’s call in front of Lin Fan and didn’t want to bring up the person.
Now that this person had chased her here, Liu Zixing had no choice but to face him.
"Zi Xin, have you told this person that you don’t like him?" Wei Yue’er asked.
Liu Zixing said frustratingly, "Of course, I’ve clearly told him I don’t like him. It’s impossible for us forever, I feel I’ve made it very clear, without giving him any hope at all, but he still pesters me. It’s so annoying, what should I do?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Why don’t you just not go see him, he’ll leave on his own."
Liu Zixing shook her head: "No, people like him, the rich second generation, have time and money. Since he’s found his way here, he has plenty of time to pester me. If I don’t see him, he’ll cause trouble in the village."
Lin Fan said, "Then go and see him, resolve this matter once and for all."
Liu Zixing asked, "How to resolve it thoroughly?"
Lin Fan said, "The reason he’s still pestering you is simply because he thinks there’s hope. So let him despair."
At the entrance of the village.
An Audi A8 stopped at the entrance of the village. In the open space in front of the Audi, there were roses arranged in the shape of a heart, with candlelight dotted around, creating a very romantic atmosphere.
A young man, holding a bouquet of flowers, loudly announced, "Liu Zixing, I like you. You can’t escape. Come out and meet me!"
The man’s actions almost caused a sensation in the whole village. The villagers, who had just finished their dinner and were idle with nothing else to do, all came running to watch.
"Driving an Audi, that’s a luxury car, this is a wealthy man!"
"Turns out he’s looking for Liu Zixing, this girl is lucky. This guy clearly has money."
"I really envy this girl. If only my daughter could marry a rich man."
"I also hope my daughter catches the eye of a wealthy man!"
The villagers were all gossiping, but their main focus was on this man’s wealth. It seemed everyone’s common desire was to become rich, becoming rich was almost everyone’s wish.
From the moment the man arrived in the village, he began asking about Liu Zixing. Some kind villagers told him that Liu Zixing was working at the clinic.
The man went to the clinic, but didn’t find Liu Zixing.
Other villagers told the man Liu Zixing’s home address, so he went to Liu Zixing’s house, but Liu Zixing wasn’t there.
Unable to find Liu Zixing, the man set up this scene at the village entrance and announced to the whole village that he would wait until Liu Zixing appeared.
"Liu Zixing, I know you’re in this village. You can’t escape. I’ll wait here for you until you’re willing to see me. If you don’t come see me, I’ll stay here. I’ll even use a loudspeaker to play music, and the whole village won’t have peace!" the man shouted loudly.
Isn’t this disturbing the peace? If the villagers get annoyed, even if Liu Zixing doesn’t want to see the man, the villagers won’t agree, and they will go and persuade Liu Zixing.
"Sun Junyao, can you have some shame and stop disturbing the villagers?"
A voice said, and they saw Liu Zixing walking over with a slightly grim expression. For a girl, being persistently harassed by someone she doesn’t like is indeed annoying.
Someone once summed up that in pursuing girls, one needs to be bold, meticulous, and thick-skinned, even if it means pestering persistently until the girl agrees.
This rich second generation obviously agrees with this theory and is practicing it.
But in reality, if pursuing a girl only means persistent pestering, it will only make both parties unhappy. The real secret to pursuing a girl is to make her have positive feelings towards you, like appreciation, moved, or gratitude.
And wrong efforts will only generate negative emotions in the other person. The more you do, the more they will hate you.
This rich second generation is a wrong example. Liu Zixing even gave up her job in the city and returned to the countryside to avoid his pestering.
It shows how much Liu Zixing is repulsed by what this rich second generation is doing.
For example, this time, the rich second generation plans to use a loudspeaker to disturb the villagers just to force Liu Zixing out. This kind of behavior is truly ridiculous.
Sun Junyao saw Liu Zixing, and he was overjoyed. He smiled and said, "Zi Xin, you are finally willing to meet me. Did you see this? It’s what I meticulously prepared for you. Say yes to me, be my girlfriend. I’m sincere to you!"
Liu Zixing said, "I’ve told you many times, I don’t like you. Can you please stop bothering me?"
The villagers were dumbfounded.
What?
Liu Zixing actually doesn’t like this wealthy person. This is a wealthy person. They all wish they could marry a rich person themselves. Liu Zixing being liked by a wealthy person, actually doesn’t like him, such a great opportunity, others can’t even dream about it!
The villagers were unable to understand Liu Zixing for a moment.
Indeed, if everything is measured by money, being favored by a wealthy person yet refusing, is really perplexing.
But if like Liu Zixing, who doesn’t value money and only values feelings, it’s not difficult to understand at all.
Sun Junyao said, "Zi Xin, I like you so much. I’ve chased you for so long. Why won’t you say yes to me?"
Liu Zixing said, "Feelings can’t be forced. Give up!"
She felt that Lin Fan was right, tonight she had to make the other party despair, so he would never come to bother her again.
Sun Junyao seriously shook his head, "I won’t give up. As long as I haven’t won you over, I will definitely not give up. If Sun Junyao sets his eyes on someone, he must have her! The more you refuse, the more determined I become. In Sun Junyao’s dictionary, there’s no word for giving up!"
Liu Zixing sneered, "You refuse to give up just because you haven’t gotten me. But if you do get me, soon you’ll abandon me and look for a new love elsewhere."
Sun Junyao shook his head, "No way, Zi Xin, believe me. If that’s your concern, then you can rest assured. I will only like you, just you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Do You Believe Now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Chapter 593: Do You Believe Now?
Liu Zixing said, "Oh really, you said the same thing to your last girlfriend, and the one before that, didn’t you? Sun Junyao, don’t think I don’t know about your little secrets. You’re just a fickle playboy! I’m just a rural girl. I don’t want to be a toy for someone like you with money. I’m begging you to let me go!"
Sun Junyao was somewhat annoyed after Liu Zixing revealed his past and said, "Liu Zixing, you caught my attention, which means you are destined to be mine, whether you like it or not. Now that I know you’re from this village, and after going through the trouble to find you here, don’t even think about escaping. If you don’t agree to be with me, I will cause trouble in this village until you say yes!"
Liu Zixing was infuriated, "Do you think this is fun?"
Sun Junyao laughed, "Of course it is. I like chasing girls—the harder they are to catch, the more exciting it is. It’s just the best game; after all, with money and time, I don’t even bother with those girls who would agree the moment I speak—they’re no challenge at all. So once I have my eyes on you, your fate is sealed—either become mine or be forever pestered by me."
Liu Zixing was so angry, she was on the verge of tears. There was nothing she could do to stop Sun Junyao, nothing to make him stop. All she could do was avoid him.
But she had already given up her job opportunities in the city and fled back to the village, yet she still couldn’t escape Sun Junyao.
At that moment, she felt on the verge of collapse.
Of course, she wouldn’t agree to Sun Junyao; knowing he was just seeking thrills, there’s no way she would let him succeed.
Her only option again was to avoid him, leaving even this place and hiding somewhere else.
But she didn’t want to run away—she quite liked it here and really didn’t want to leave.
For a moment, Liu Zixing felt a bit overwhelmed, uncertain about how to deal with this scoundrel.
"Haha, so your pursuit of her isn’t genuine love but just treating it as an exciting game, huh."
A voice laughed as Lin Fan walked over, accompanied by Wei Yue’er, He Chunyu, and Dog No.2.
They all accompanied Liu Zixing, initially letting her talk things through. Seeing that Liu Zixing couldn’t handle him, Lin Fan stepped forward.
Sun Junyao turned towards Lin Fan, frowning, "Who are you?"
Lin Fan said, "So what Zi Xin said is true then—once you have her, you’d soon dump her and seek new thrills. This is the kind of silly game you rich second generations love to play, isn’t it? What do you take Zi Xin for, your thrill-seeking toy?"
Lin Fan’s tone was somewhat cold. Such manipulative rich kids were really unpleasant, and unfortunately, they were not rare.
Taking advantage of their affluent backgrounds, these rich second generations idle away, their boredom driving them to seek thrills—some race cars for excitement, while others treat women like playthings, changing girlfriends more often than clothes.
Evidently, this Sun Junyao was one such degenerate rich kid.
Of course, if Sun Junyao messed with those materialistic gold-diggers, that would be one thing—one party seeks fun, the other money, so there’s no more to say. But Sun Junyao chooses to harm a rural girl like Liu Zixing instead.
Gold-digging women who throw themselves at him, Sun Junyao might not even look at them, finding them no challenge at all—where’s the fun in that.
Only girls like Liu Zixing, with self-respect and integrity, can stir their desire to conquer.
Such is the game of dissolute rich second generations.
Sun Junyao was angered by Lin Fan’s blunt remarks, "Who the hell are you? A country bumpkin like you has no right to talk to me!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Zi Xin, why don’t you tell him who I am?"
Liu Zixing was a bit caught off guard, "You’re my..."
Lin Fan walked over, smoothly putting his arm around Liu Zixing’s waist, "That’s right, I am Zi Xin’s boyfriend."
What?
The entire place was shocked.
Lin Fan is Liu Zixing’s boyfriend?
Liu Zixing herself was stunned, her face turning red as she realized Lin Fan was pretending to be her boyfriend!
Wei Yue’er was taken aback, initially thinking Liu Zixing denied being in a relationship with Lin Fan earlier tonight. Was Liu Zixing lying? Were they indeed a couple but not admitting it?
But then Wei Yue’er also realized that Lin Fan was likely pretending to be her boyfriend to deal with Sun Junyao.
Thinking this, Wei Yue’er secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Sun Junyao watched Lin Fan put his arm around Liu Zixing’s waist in close intimacy, getting furious, "Impossible, don’t try to trick me, Zi Xin doesn’t have a boyfriend. You think I can’t tell? You’re pretending to be her boyfriend just to make me back off, aren’t you? Get that idea out of your head, as I won’t be fooled, and I won’t give up!"
Had he seen through it?
Lin Fan said calmly, "What makes you think Zi Xin returned to the village? Did you really think it was to avoid you? She came back to be with me."
Sun Junyao sneered, "Don’t play tricks with me. I can see right through you—you’re not a couple. Otherwise, why has Zi Xin never mentioned you before?"
Lin Fan said, "She hasn’t mentioned me simply because she didn’t want you to know, fearing you’d come after me. But tonight, I had no choice but to reveal myself."
Sun Junyao scoffed, "No matter what you say, I don’t believe you."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, then suddenly leaned down, getting close to Liu Zixing’s face, and kissed her lips.
A deep kiss!
"Now, do you believe me?" Lin Fan lifted his head after kissing Liu Zixing, looking at Sun Junyao.
Everyone was stunned.
Did Lin Fan just kiss Liu Zixing?
Liu Zixing was completely bewildered, feeling like she was dreaming, her whole body stiff—did Lin Fan just kiss her? Did that really happen!
It seemed so, it wasn’t a dream!
Liu Zixing pinched herself; it truly wasn’t a dream, not a dream; it wasn’t a dream.
Surely, she was kissed by Lin Fan, and indeed on her lips!
Oh my, did she just kiss Lin Fan?
No, did Lin Fan just kiss her lips?
This really wasn’t a dream!
Wei Yue’er was also shocked, what on earth? Lin Fan kissed Liu Zixing to prove they are indeed boyfriend and girlfriend?
What does this mean?
For a moment, Wei Yue’er was in a mess—she just thought Lin Fan was pretending to be Liu Zixing’s boyfriend because Liu Zixing denied it before. Now, Wei Yue’er wasn’t so sure anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: Doesn’t 500 thousand make your heart flutter?
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Chapter 594: Doesn’t 500 thousand make your heart flutter?
They kissed!
Lin Fan actually kissed Liu Zixing, to be precise, Lin Fan ambushed Liu Zixing, and in Liu Zixing’s bewildered state, he kissed her!
The villagers were shocked. In the minds of ordinary people, only couples would kiss, so Lin Fan kissing Liu Zixing indicated that they were indeed in a relationship!
"No wonder Zi Xin rejected that rich guy, turns out she is Lin Fan’s girlfriend!"
"That’s what I’m saying, rejecting a rich guy is no simple matter!"
"I knew from the start that there was something going on between them, otherwise why would Lin Fan start working at the clinic the moment he returned!"
The villagers started gossiping. Since they kissed, everyone believed it.
Even Wei Yue’er was stunned. What’s going on here?
Didn’t Liu Zixing deny having any relationship with Lin Fan before? And now they’re kissing? Could Liu Zixing have been lying to her?
Wei Yue’er couldn’t discern the truth for a while.
At first, she thought Lin Fan was pretending to be Liu Zixing’s boyfriend, but posing as a boyfriend shouldn’t involve kissing, right? Kissing implies a relationship that’s not simple.
Wei Yue’er felt troubled.
Seeing Lin Fan kiss Liu Zixing made Sun Junyao furious. He had been chasing Liu Zixing but to no avail, and yet Lin Fan, this country bumpkin, managed to kiss Liu Zixing so easily!
This was the greatest humiliation for him.
"Liu Zixing, is this country guy really your boyfriend? You actually chose him over me, a poor country guy?! What does this poor guy have? I bet he doesn’t even own a bicycle!" Sun Junyao shouted, completely unable to comprehend why a woman would choose a poor guy over a rich one.
No one knew how fast Liu Zixing’s heart was beating at this moment. After Lin Fan kissed her, she was completely bewildered, only hearing her heart pounding.
Was she dreaming?
This wasn’t a dream, right?
This really wasn’t a dream!
Lin Fan had kissed her.
Lin Fan really kissed her!
Why would Lin Fan kiss her?
Could Lin Fan like her? Oh my, Lin Fan likes her, and she didn’t know? No way, does Lin Fan really like her? Is this a stroke of luck?
Hearing Sun Junyao’s yelling brought her back to reality, and she instinctively said, "What did you say?"
Sun Junyao was furious: "I said you actually chose this country bumpkin instead of me!"
Such humiliation, it was the greatest humiliation of his life. He, a proud Rich Second Generation, lost to a guy from the country!
Liu Zixing sneered and said, "I just like him, I choose him, what’s the deal? Now you know why I rejected you, right? I have a boyfriend now, you should give up!"
Sun Junyao was exasperated: "Why, why in the world?"
Liu Zixing said, "Lin Fan may not be as rich as you, but he is more handsome and more talented than you. Besides having some stinking money, all you are is scum!"
Sun Junyao sneered: "You’re such a stupid girl, money is more important than anything else. Following him, you’ll just end up poor! With me, even if you’re abandoned in the end, at least you’d have enjoyed a wealthy lifestyle! Many of you folks from the countryside will never experience what it feels like to be rich!"
Liu Zixing chuckled, "Sorry, I’m not interested in experiencing what it feels like to be rich. I just want to be with someone I like, and you’re not the one I like."
Sun Junyao was furious, not knowing what to do for a moment, and then seemed to think of some kind of brilliant idea.
"You say you want love over money, does this country guy think the same way? Hey, listen up, I’ll give you $100,000 if you leave Zi Xin!" Sun Junyao looked at Lin Fan, chuckling.
What?
Everyone was amazed.
This Sun Junyao is certainly rich, offering someone $100,000 just like that!
For these villagers, $100,000 was a fortune.
"Oh my, really wealthy, offering $100,000 so casually!"
"If someone offered me $100,000, I’d do anything!"
"Indeed, I’ve never seen that much money in my life!"
The villagers all looked at Lin Fan, wondering how he would respond.
Lin Fan almost wanted to laugh; Sun Junyao really thought $100,000 could turn him into a traitor. Even if he hadn’t been worth billions now, and was a poor man, $100,000 wouldn’t tempt him.
When he was a poor student, Madam Su offered him $300,000 to leave Su Jinjin, but he didn’t agree.
"Sorry, you’re overthinking it," Lin Fan replied with a smile.
Sun Junyao sneered, "You filthy country bumpkin, $100,000 is too little, huh? I’ll give you $200,000!"
Lin Fan shook his head.
Sun Junyao gritted his teeth, surprised by this country guy’s big appetite, but everyone has a price, and he didn’t believe Lin Fan wouldn’t be tempted.
"$500,000!" Sun Junyao said coldly, "Just leave Zi Xin and I’ll give you $500,000 immediately. Think about it, you country bumpkin, will you ever make that much money in your life!"
Oh my!
The villagers were in a frenzy, $500,000!
This was an enormous fortune!
If Lin Fan wasn’t going crazy, the surrounding villagers were; at this moment, they all wished they were Lin Fan. If someone offered them $500,000, they’d agree immediately; in the face of $500,000, a woman was worth squat!
"If it were me, I’d agree immediately!"
"Oh my, why not me!"
"I think Lin Fan will agree, after all, it’s $500,000!"
"I heard Lin Fan delivers food in the city, imagine how many deliveries he’d have to make to earn $500,000!"
"Exactly, if I were him, I’d break up with Zi Xin immediately. With $500,000, what girlfriend couldn’t I find?"
The villagers all felt that Lin Fan would definitely be tempted this time.
Sun Junyao also had a smug look, confident that $500,000 could entice this country bumpkin.
Lin Fan fell silent, seeming to be in hesitation.
Lin Fan’s reaction made Sun Junyao even more confident, and he laughed nastily, "Liu Zixing, see, isn’t money essential over love? Looks like your love is worth $500,000!"
"Lin Fan..." Liu Zixing murmured, unsure if Lin Fan was really tempted by $500,000; after all, $500,000 was really a lot.
Lin Fan seemed to have finally thought of something, saying, "Buddy, adding prices like this is tiresome. Why don’t we try another approach?"
What?
Sun Junyao was momentarily stunned and snorted, "What approach?"
Lin Fan said, "How about this? Let me set a price, and if you agree to my terms, I’ll let you have Zi Xin."
Sun Junyao laughed, "So it’s more you want, huh? Go on, how much do you want? Let’s do it once and for all! Anyway, Sun Junyao isn’t short of money, your appetite won’t be hard to satisfy!"
In his mind, people like Lin Fan, bumpkins from the country, even with big appetites, are ultimately limited because that’s the extent of a country bumpkin’s mindset.

chapters.title: Chapter 595: A Phone Call and You’re Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Chapter 595: A Phone Call and You’re Out
Lin Fan smiled, "Since you’re willing to give, then I’ll tell you, I want you to give me all your Sun family’s assets, all the cash, real estate, shares, businesses, everything, not a single penny left, of course, except for your Sun family’s debts, I want you to become a debt-ridden rich second generation."
Sun Junyao jumped up in agitation, "Are you freaking crazy?"
No one expected it, Lin Fan’s demand was so outrageous.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Aren’t you trying to win over Zi Xin? Don’t you like playing thrilling games? Don’t you think this is exciting? Didn’t you just say you could satisfy my appetite, what’s wrong, feeling slapped now?"
Sun Junyao’s face turned red, he indeed felt slapped, how could he have imagined that Lin Fan would play at such a high stake.
Lin Fan’s face darkened, "Coward, weren’t you trying to sway me with money? You don’t even dare to play such a thrilling game, yet you dare to say you like thrilling games? You don’t even have the courage to become a debt-ridden rich second generation, yet you dare to come and fight me for a woman?"
Sun Junyao screamed, "You’re simply a lunatic, how could I possibly give you all my assets for her!"
Lin Fan said, "Since you’re not willing to give, then get lost, don’t come and bother Zi Xin anymore, you useless coward!"
Everyone at this point could understand that Lin Fan wasn’t swayed by the 500,000 at all!
They thought Lin Fan would be moved, but it turned out they were all slapped in the face.
Oh my gosh, Lin Fan didn’t even care about the 500,000!
It’s truly surprising, why couldn’t 500,000 move Lin Fan, could it be that Lin Fan truly doesn’t care about 500,000 at all.
How do you explain this?
"Could it be that Lin Fan isn’t short of money? That’s impossible!"
"Lin Fan is just a delivery guy, how could he not be short of money?"
"There can only be one explanation, he truly loves Zi Xin!"
"For Zi Xin, he’s not even tempted by 500,000, who says this isn’t true love!"
The villagers started discussing among themselves.
Wei Yue’er felt increasingly troubled, she knew Lin Fan wasn’t wealthy, a typical poor person would usually be tempted by 500,000, but Lin Fan wasn’t moved at all, it seems Lin Fan truly likes Zi Xin.
Liu Zixing’s heart started racing again, Lin Fan was completely unmoved, could it be... Lin Fan really likes her?
Sun Junyao felt extremely insulted, it was humiliating.
"You’re not moved by money, indeed you surprised me, but do you think this way I’ll give up? You’re ultimately just a poor guy, you can’t compete with me, I won’t give up on Zi Xin, I’ll keep pestering her until she breaks up with you and is with me, heh heh, let’s see what you can do to me, you pathetic hick!" Sun Junyao smugly resumed.
Liu Zixing was speechless, this Sun Junyao, he’s truly too shameless, dealing with a wealthy scoundrel like this is truly difficult.
It seems having Lin Fan as her boyfriend isn’t working, it can’t drive away this Sun Junyao.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "I originally thought you’d back off upon knowing Zi Xin has a boyfriend, but I underestimated your shamelessness, sorry, my mistake, then there’s no choice, I have to unleash a big move."
Sun Junyao laughed, "What, are you planning to hit me? Never mind whether or not you, a hick, can be a match for me, even if you are stronger, if you injure me, I’ll make sure you rot in jail!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Beating you up is indeed a good idea, but I have a better plan."
Sun Junyao sneered, "You hick, what can you do to me, I was born to be tough, what can you do to me!"
Lin Fan said, "You’re Sun Junyao, on the way over here I gathered a bit of information about your family, your father is Sun Bingbing, your Sun family owns the Sun Group which assets barely cross a billion, am I right?"
Sun Junyao said, "So what?"
Lin Fan said, "A family with just over a billion in assets is nothing in the billionaire circle, not to mention your Sun Group owes quite a bit of foreign debt."
Sun Junyao said, "What exactly do you want to say?"
Lin Fan said, "I just need to make one phone call to make you disappear, do you believe it?"
Sun Junyao was startled, then laughed wildly, as if he’d heard the funniest joke in the world.
It was indeed too funny, Lin Fan’s words were simply absurd, a bunch of nonsensical talk.
"You can make me disappear with just one phone call, this is too funny, you hick, what do you have?" Sun Junyao laughed loudly.
Lin Fan said, "Just by my understanding of your Sun family."
Sun Junyao said, "Utter nonsense, a hick like you, speaking with such arrogance, fine then, I’d like to see how you make me disappear!"
Lin Fan said, "Do you really want to try?"
Sun Junyao said, "Do you dare to make a bet with me, if your one phone call can’t make me disappear, you have to break up with Zi Xin! How about it, dare you bet?"
Lin Fan straightforwardly said, "Sure."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Lin Fan actually agreed to this bet?
How can Lin Fan possibly win, Lin Fan is just a delivery guy, at most his medical skills are good, but how could one phone call make a rich second generation disappear, that’s just impossible to achieve.
Liu Zixing and Wei Yue’er were also very surprised, they didn’t expect Lin Fan to so easily make a bet with Sun Junyao, this bet, Lin Fan is basically bound to lose.
Why is Lin Fan doing this?
They saw Lin Fan had already taken out his phone, quickly dialed a number, and said, "You can have Sun Bingbing make the call now."
After saying that, Lin Fan hung up the phone.
What the heck?
Lin Fan made a phone call, said only one sentence, and that’s it?
Sun Junyao was about to die laughing, "You hick, you’re killing me with laughter, who were you calling, just bluffing here, who did you call?"
Lin Fan said, "That’s none of your concern."
Sun Junyao laughed loudly, "You just said one phone call can make me disappear, I’m still here, you already lost!"
Lin Fan said, "Don’t rush, wait a bit."
Sun Junyao said, "Wait for what, your boasting has failed to scare me, quickly honor the bet from just now, break up with Zi Xin, don’t come bothering my pursuit of Zi Xin anymore!"
Everyone sighed, it seemed Lin Fan really screwed up this time, maybe Lin Fan wanted to scare Sun Junyao a bit, but it didn’t work.
Now this situation is quite awkward, Lin Fan failed to scare off Sun Junyao and instead ended up dooming himself.
"Zi Xin, this hick is no longer an issue, I’ll continue to pursue you until you agree!" Sun Junyao chuckled.
At this moment.
Ring ring ring...
Sun Junyao’s phone suddenly rang.
Sun Junyao took out his phone to take a look, appearing somewhat shocked at the caller.
Immediately, Sun Junyao answered the call, "Dad?"
It turned out to be his father Sun Bingbing calling.
Hearing Sun Bingbing’s call, Sun Junyao looked up at Lin Fan and unexpectedly showed a frightened expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 596: How did you do it?
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Chapter 596: How did you do it?
No one believed Lin Fan’s words, and Sun Junyao considered them a big joke. Then a call came in, causing Sun Junyao’s face to change.
The caller was Sun Junyao’s father, Sun Bingbing. Sun Bingbing immediately started scolding Sun Junyao.‍‍
"You unfilial son, you never do anything proper, always lazing around, only knowing how to cause trouble! Do you realize you’re about to ruin me, ruin the Sun Family? Damn it, you’re a worthless idiot, if you come back I’ll chop you up!"
Sun Bingbing cursed loudly, growing more furious with each word, really looking like he wanted to chop Sun Junyao up.
Sun Junyao, baffled from the scolding.
"Dad, what’s happened?" Sun Junyao tentatively asked.
Sun Bingbing responded, "Tell me what you’re doing now, do you know who the person standing in front of you is! You have no idea who you’ve provoked!"
Sun Junyao looked at Lin Fan and puzzled asked, "Dad, isn’t he just a hillbilly!"
Sun Bingbing shouted, "Shut up! Listen carefully, you must never provoke this person. Just because you pursued that girl, you provoked this man, now our Sun Family is on the brink of disaster. Do you know this man, with a single call, can bankrupt our Sun Family? Just now, Miss Feng called me, do you know who Miss Feng is? Our family took a huge loan from her for a project. She’s our debtor, she’s the one holding our throat, if she tightens her grip, we’re done for! You’re probably curious why this hillbilly can get Miss Feng involved, because he’s not just any rural person, he’s Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, and he’s Miss Feng’s brother!"
"What?"
Sun Junyao’s face changed dramatically, looking at Lin Fan with a shocked expression. The person in front of him was actually Yun City’s richest man?
"Now, quickly apologize to Mr. Lin and get lost, come back overnight, I will personally bring you to apologize to Miss Feng. You have no idea what relationship that girl has with Mr. Lin, but she’s not someone a lazy ass like you can think about. In the future, stay away from her, if you dare trouble her again, I will break your legs. Remember, do not reveal Mr. Lin’s identity, immediately!" Sun Bingbing shouted.
"Yes!" Sun Junyao hurriedly replied, wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
Sun Bingbing then hung up the call.
Sun Junyao put away his phone, his hand already trembling.
He now realized how serious the matter was. The girl he had been pursuing, Liu Zixing, turned out to be the woman of Yun City’s richest man Lin Fan, the legendary mysterious local tycoon Mr. Lin, was right in front of him!
He had heard of Mr. Lin’s legend, Heard Mr. Lin had immense abilities, and indeed, with a single call, he could make Longheng Group’s boss Feng Ruolan act, and Feng Ruolan held Sun Family’s life and death!
Although Sun Junyao was a ne’er-do-well, he had some understanding of the family situation. The Sun Family’s business had been struggling over the years; his father Sun Bingbing had placed all hope on a new project but the investment costs were unexpectedly high, needing a loan.
If Feng Ruolan withdrew her investment now, the Sun Family’s new project would collapse immediately, leaving the Sun Family only bankruptcy!
Then Sun Junyao would truly become a debt-laden second generation.
Sun Junyao did not understand anything else, but he absolutely did not want to become a debt-laden second generation; that would be harder to bear than being killed, as it touched his fundamental interests.
He pursued Liu Zixing originally for the thrill, not because he had deep feelings for her, so due to Liu Zixing becoming a debt-laden second generation, he was absolutely unwilling.
"I’m sorry, I was wrong, I shouldn’t have pursued your girlfriend, I won’t dare do it again in the future, I’m really sorry."
Sun Junyao bowed and nodded to Lin Fan, his voice somewhat trembling.
Though not knowing why, Sun Bingbing specifically instructed him not to reveal Mr. Lin’s identity.
But this is the legendary Mr. Lin, Yun City’s richest man. He just dared to call Mr. Lin a hillbilly. If Mr. Lin were to retaliate, he’d be done for, can he not be scared!
Lin Fan said indifferently, "Alright, you can get lost now."
Sun Junyao promptly replied, "Yes, I’ll get lost, I’ll immediately get lost!"
Sun Junyao turned and ran, quickly getting into his Audi, as if he’d seen a ghost, in no time at all, he had left West River Village, not daring to cast a final glance at Liu Zixing.
This scene left everyone bewildered, staring at each other.
What’s going on?
Lin Fan really made Sun Junyao get lost with just a phone call!
How did he do it?
Liu Zixing couldn’t help but ask, "Sun Junyao just ran off like that, what happened? Lin Fan, he seemed startled?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Anyway, he won’t bother you again in the future."
"How did you do it?" Wei Yue’er couldn’t help but ask, this matter was indeed a bit miraculous.
Lin Fan said, "It’s simple, I learned about Sun Junyao’s background, found out who their debtor was, and as it happens, I know this debtor, my call was to that debtor, asking her for a small favor."
Feng Ruolan merely called Sun Bingbing to explain the situation, shocking Sun Bingbing into immediately calling to reprimand Sun Junyao.
Of all people, one must never offend the financial backer.
Liu Zixing thought of something and suddenly understood, "I get it, Lin Fan, that debtor of the Sun Family must be your patient!"
Lin Fan, having extraordinary medical skill, had numerous influential figures coming for treatment these days, including the Secretary of Tianhai City, so Lin Fan knowing some big figures was not surprising.
A doctor like Lin Fan, knowing any big figures, was not surprising because birth, illness, and death are unavoidable, and even high-ranking figures have times they fall ill.
As Liu Zixing said this, everyone understood, all deeply moved.
"So good medical skill brings such benefits!"
"Lin Fan has the opportunity to know such big figures, not everyone has this advantage."
"Even though Lin Fan doesn’t have money now, he has limitless potential!"
"Finally understand why Zi Xin chose Lin Fan and not that rich guy, Zi Xin has good judgment, it’s us who were short-sighted!"
Lin Fan didn’t bother with the villagers, refusing to clarify his and Liu Zixing’s relationship in public, turning to Wei Yue’er and others, "Let’s go back for a meal."
They returned to He Chunyu’s house.
Sitting down, everyone fell silent, the atmosphere feeling somewhat awkward.
He Chunyu looked at Lin Fan, then at Liu Zixing, speaking first, "Are you two... really dating?"
Wei Yue’er perked up, as it was the very question Wei Yue’er wanted to ask.
Dog No.2 grinned and said, "Brother Fan, you really found a girlfriend."
This comment caused Liu Zixing’s face to immediately turn red: "I am not, we..."

chapters.title: Chapter 597: So Quickly Got Together
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Chapter 597: So Quickly Got Together
Dog No.2 laughed and said, "Don’t say it’s not true, you both kissed, I saw it with my own eyes."
Lin Fan said, "Don’t misunderstand, everyone. Zi Xin and I are not in a boyfriend-girlfriend relationship. I just pretended to be her boyfriend to deal with Sun Junyao."
Wei Yue’er skeptically said, "Really? Just like Dog No.2 said, you two..."
She was embarrassed to say "kissed", but everyone knew what she meant.
Lin Fan said, "Well, that was to make Sun Junyao believe, so I... regarding this, I need to apologize to Zi Xin. It was rash of me, without your consent, I just..."
Liu Zixing blushed deeply and interrupted Lin Fan: "It’s, it’s okay, you were just helping me, I..."
She bit her lip and didn’t know what to say, thinking about that kiss made her heart beat faster and faster.
Wei Yue’er said, "Lin Fan, Zi Xin, are you really not in that kind of relationship?"
Liu Zixing said, "Really not, Sister Yue’er, I wouldn’t lie to you."
She felt a little melancholy inside. She truly wasn’t Lin Fan’s girlfriend, yet after Lin Fan kissed her, her heart was racing, and now, she seemed to have developed feelings, wishing it were true...
She really wanted to tell Lin Fan, "You’ve kissed me, now you have to take responsibility."
Seeing Liu Zixing say this, Wei Yue’er finally felt relieved, a big stone lifted off her heart, and her mood became lighter.
They’re not a couple, that’s good.
He Chunyu said, "This misunderstanding is big, now everyone in the village thinks you two are a couple, Lin Fan, why didn’t you clarify publicly just now?"
Lin Fan said, "I have to listen to Zi Xin’s opinion on this. If Zi Xin thinks we should clarify, I’ll do it tomorrow."
This move by Lin Fan was so considerate.
Liu Zixing was a bit touched, thought about it, and said, "Maybe don’t clarify. Think about it, Lin Fan kissed me tonight, if we clarify, people might not believe it and there might be gossip. Pretending to be a couple has its benefits, and I won’t be bothered by blind dates anymore."
What Liu Zixing said makes sense, but the real reason she doesn’t want to clarify is that even pretending to be a couple is nice; maybe it will turn real...
This little thought is too shy to say out loud.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "What a coincidence, I also don’t want blind dates to bother me. It seems our pretend relationship has quite a few benefits. When Zi Xin truly meets a boy she likes, we can announce our ’break-up’ then."
Liu Zixing bit her lip, wanting badly to tell Lin Fan that she’s already met the person she likes, and isn’t it you!
Lin Fan’s handling of the situation was indeed the most suitable. Otherwise, if they clarified now, Lin Fan isn’t Liu Zixing’s boyfriend, yet kissed her publicly, there would surely be gossip.
Due to the delay from Sun Junyao’s incident, the food had gone cold, and they ended up eating hastily and then wrapped things up.
Lin Fan and Liu Zixing said their goodbyes and left.
Lin Fan escorted Liu Zixing home, meeting some villagers on the way, and these villagers all gave them ambiguous smiles upon seeing them.
There’s no secret in the village, gossip spreads quickly, it seems the news of Lin Fan and Liu Zixing being a couple has already spread throughout the village, everyone now thinks they are a couple.
"Little Fan, you found a girlfriend, and didn’t even tell us! I was thinking of introducing a girl to you!"
An auntie said with a giggle.
This auntie was a well-known matchmaker in the village, Lin Fan quickly said, "No need to bother, Aunt Six."
An old man pulled Lin Fan, jokingly said, "Little Fan, you lad are doing well, huh? When can we drink your wedding wine?"
Liu Zixing’s face was beet red, she tugged on Lin Fan, signaling to hurry and leave.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Soon, Grandfather Three, wishing you good health."
After dealing with some curious villagers, Lin Fan and Liu Zixing finally arrived at Liu Zixing’s doorstep.
"Go inside, get an early night," Lin Fan said.
Liu Zixing responded with a soft "mm", hesitating for a moment, she wanted to invite Lin Fan inside for a while but felt it wouldn’t be appropriate. She was home alone, inviting Lin Fan inside might make the villagers think too much, assume they’re up to something.
Thinking of this, Liu Zixing was overwhelmed with embarrassment and quickly escaped inside.
Lin Fan then went home alone.
Suddenly, he was surrounded by his parents and sister.
"Little Fan, everyone in the village is saying that you and Zi Xin are together, is it true?" Mrs. Lin asked.
Shanshan said, "No way, brother, you just got back a few days and are suddenly with the nurse, this is too sudden."
Lin Fan was a bit flustered and said, "It’s not that sudden, I’ve always liked Zi Xin. Mom, now that I have a girlfriend, don’t bother finding matchmakers and waste money."
Mrs. Lin couldn’t stop laughing, "Alright, my son has a little wife now, why would I need a matchmaker?"
Father Lin nodded and said, "Zi Xin is a nice child, very pretty. Her father, Old Liu, is a doctor, didn’t expect this, we’ll become relatives with Old Liu."
They both expressed satisfaction with Liu Zixing as the daughter-in-law.
Shanshan pulled Lin Fan into the room, mysteriously said, "Brother, are you really with Sister Zi Xin? What about Sister Jinjin? Brother, you’re two-timing!"
Lin Fan quickly said, "Don’t talk nonsense, I’ll be honest with you but don’t tell Mom and Dad, Zi Xin and I are just pretending."
Shanshan blurted out, "Pretending... Brother, you kissed her."
Lin Fan said, "The kiss was real, but the pretending is also real."
Shanshan giggled and said, "Seems like you got quite the advantage with Sister Zi Xin, but you kissed her, won’t you turn it into a real relationship?"
Lin Fan retorted, "Stop gossiping."
The future, who knows, honestly Lin Fan kissed Liu Zixing tonight on an impulse, as for his feelings towards Liu Zixing, he couldn’t say clearly himself.
These past few days, he felt Liu Zixing was a nice girl, and at that moment, he just wanted to protect her.
If Liu Zixing were to be his girlfriend or even his little wife, it wouldn’t be so bad either.
Of course, Liu Zixing isn’t the only great girl around him. Chen Lingling, Su Jinjin, Liu Mengjie... oh, and Wei Yue’er, are all wonderful girls. It’s a pity he’s only one person, sometimes wishing he could have multiple selves to be with all these great girls.
Lin Fan sighed inwardly, is this thought a bit too greedy?
At He Chunyu’s house.
Late at night, He Chunyu and Dog No.2 were already asleep.
Wei Yue’er’s room was still lit up; she wasn’t asleep yet and was taking a call.
"I’m not going back to Hang City. I have my reasons. Since I was little, I’ve lived that lifestyle surrounded by luxury, and I find this little mountain village quite nice!" Wei Yue’er said.
"No, if you’re trying to set me up on blind dates, I’m even less inclined to go back. Brother, truth is, I already have someone in my heart."
"I won’t tell you who it is for now, but I can say that he is a doctor..."

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Remember, never neglect him
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Chapter 598: Remember, never neglect him
The next day, Lin Fan got up early and took a stroll to the back mountain. This back mountain was usually deserted, covered with trees and weeds. In this deep mountainous area, there were many weeds, some of which could be used as medicine. The villagers would sometimes go into the mountains to gather herbs.
Old Liu, as the village doctor, often would go into the mountain to find medicinal materials, but good herbs weren’t easy to find.
Lin Fan came this time to find herbs that could be extracted to make an antidote that could help Secretary Ma detoxify.
This type of herb was extremely rare and could be said to be something one could only encounter by chance and not seek out. To get this herb, it purely depends on luck, not just any luck, but super luck.
This was not a problem for Lin Fan.
"Top-tier Koi Carp Luck, activate!" Lin Fan said to himself.
Then, he wandered around the grass and his eyes fell on a bizarrely-shaped herb.
"Found it." Lin Fan smiled slightly, walked up, pulled up the bizarre herb, and packed it in a pre-prepared bag.
Time to head to the city.
Lin Fan turned around and descended the mountain, preparing to go home, get in the car, and head to the city.
As he reached the foot of the mountain, he saw Wei Yue’er jogging on the road.
"What a coincidence." Wei Yue’er said joyfully upon seeing Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Morning."
Wei Yue’er was dressed in sportswear, her figure was fully displayed, she was truly beautiful. Lin Fan couldn’t help but recall the day when Wei Yue’er was attacked by the Cyan Bamboo Snake, twisted her ankle, and he saved her and helped treat her ankle. That was their first meeting and contact.
Wei Yue’er curiously asked, "What are you doing on the back mountain so early in the morning? You aren’t exercising too, are you?"
Lin Fan said, "No, I came to look for herbs."
Wei Yue’er said, "Oh, it seems you’ve found them."
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, I need to go to the city to help someone heal."
Wei Yue’er nodded, thought for a moment, and then stopped Lin Fan, saying, "Lin Fan, can I ask you a question?"
Lin Fan replied, "Sure, what is it?"
Wei Yue’er, seemingly thinking about something, blushed slightly and asked, "When are you planning to return to Yun City?"
"In the next couple of days, I guess." Lin Fan joked, "Why, will you miss me?"
Of course, Wei Yue’er’s face grew even redder. "Actually... have you ever considered coming back here to work? Your medical skill is so good that, even in this village, you could earn money. It’s better than you delivering food in the city, that job is too exhausting."
Wei Yue’er didn’t know that Lin Fan was no longer delivering food. If he were just a delivery person, he could certainly leave Yun City at any time.
But now Lin Fan had a 200 billion group to manage in Yun City, so he couldn’t leave.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I don’t have such plans for now. The village still has Old Liu; if I come back, wouldn’t I be stealing his business? Yue’er, why are you asking?"
Wei Yue’er hurriedly replied, "N-no reason, I was just asking casually. It’s nothing, you should hurry to the city. I’m going for a run."
After saying this, Wei Yue’er dashed away.
Lin Fan found it a little inexplicable, but he didn’t think much of it and went down the mountain.
Wei Yue’er ran a distance, stopped, looked back, and saw that Lin Fan was no longer in sight. Her face was still a bit flushed.
"It seems I’m almost done with this period of rural teaching." Wei Yue’er muttered to herself.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan descended the mountain, got into the rented car, and headed for Tianhai City.
Tianhai City is a relatively economically underdeveloped fifth-tier city. It has always struggled to retain its talents as there are few job opportunities and low wage levels. Most residents choose to work outside, dispersing into various major cities.
Since Secretary Ma took office, he has been ambitious to change the status quo of Tianhai City. Both Secretary Ma and the current mayor are ambitious individuals who are working hard to develop the economy of Tianhai City, attract investment, and try to create more and better job opportunities to attract talent.
Unfortunately, Tianhai City’s geographical location is quite off the beaten path, and capital does not favor this place, so Secretary Ma’s efforts have not yet yielded any results.
At this critical point, Secretary Ma suddenly fell ill. He still has many things to do and plans unfinished, and he fears he won’t be able to hold on.
So, upon inadvertently hearing about Lin Fan’s existence, the usually busy Secretary Ma surprisingly took a half-day leave and drove himself to West River Village.
That day, according to the pre-scheduled itinerary, Secretary Ma received a group of investors who came to inspect the market.
This was the result of Secretary Ma’s efforts, and these investors came to Tianhai City for the sake of Secretary Ma’s reputation. Despite not feeling well, Secretary Ma insisted on hosting them.
At the Investment Promotion Bureau, Secretary Ma received a group of investors. In the lobby, Secretary Ma was busy introducing the situation of Tianhai City to the investors, showcasing the advantages of Tianhai City to attract investments.
However, the inherent advantages of Tianhai City are not obvious. Despite Secretary Ma’s vigorous efforts, the investors still appeared somewhat uninterested. If it weren’t for Secretary Ma’s face, they might not have come at all, or even if they did, it was just to go through the motions; they weren’t likely to genuinely invest in Tianhai City.
"Secretary, there’s a call for you. The caller claims to be Dr. Lin."
Secretary Ma’s secretary seized an opportunity and came over.
When Secretary Ma heard this, it had to be Lin Fan calling; this concerned his health, and he couldn’t neglect Divine Doctor Lin.
"Reply to Dr. Lin, arrange for him to come to the Investment Promotion Bureau, and ask him to wait for a moment. I’ll see him as soon as I finish receiving these guests, and make sure not to neglect him," specifically instructed Secretary Ma.
If it weren’t for having to entertain these guests, he would have liked to meet Lin Fan immediately, as he was feeling very unwell now, his stomach hurting terribly.
Lin Fan had advised him to stop using the painkiller prescribed by National Master Ai Luoqing yesterday and replace it with another formula. However, due to his busy work, he had left for work today without having had the chance to take medicine.
He really wanted to stop working immediately and take his medicine.
But to him, work was as important as his life, so he had to insist on finishing hosting these guests.
His body couldn’t allow it though, and his face became increasingly pale as he broke out in a cold sweat from the pain.
Secretary Ma’s abnormal state was quickly noticed by these investors.
"Secretary Ma, are you alright?" an investor asked concernedly, "Is there anywhere you feel uncomfortable, do you need to rest?"
Secretary Ma forced a smile and said, "I’m fine."
"Secretary Ma, you don’t look alright; your face is very pale."

chapters.title: Chapter 599 Profound Ice Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Chapter 599 Profound Ice Grass
Secretary Ma said, "Maybe I didn’t sleep well last night. It’s nothing serious, everyone, don’t worry. Next, let me introduce you to the road project currently under construction in Tianhai City. Once this project is completed, Tianhai’s transportation will be more convenient, connecting with the surrounding major cities, and providing you with a better investment environment..."
Secretary Ma endured the pain and continued to entertain the investors.
He persisted like this for over ten minutes.
Secretary Ma finally finished explaining the road project under construction. He wanted to continue introducing more content to the investors.
Suddenly!
Secretary Ma clutched his heart with his hand, his vision went dark, and he fell to the ground in a faint!
"Ah!"
This frightened the investors quite a bit.
"What’s happening!"
"Secretary Ma, are you okay?"
"What’s wrong with him, could it be a heart attack?"
"What’s going on, I haven’t heard he has heart issues."
"Enough talk, quickly call an ambulance!"
The investors started talking all at once, and the scene became a bit chaotic.
"Everyone, step aside!"
A voice suddenly came through, and Lin Fan walked over quickly, parting the crowd, and crouched down in front of Secretary Ma.
After observing Secretary Ma’s condition, Lin Fan turned back to the secretary and said, "Please get a bowl of plain boiled water, quickly!"
Lin Fan had just arrived at the Investment Bureau. According to Secretary Ma’s instructions, the secretary dared not delay and personally went to receive Lin Fan, initially planning to take him to the office. Unexpectedly, Secretary Ma suddenly fainted.
Seeing this, Lin Fan immediately rushed over.
At this point, the secretary was a bit flustered. Hearing Lin Fan’s words, he quickly complied and went to fetch the water.
Lin Fan took out nine silver needles from his chest, performed the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles, and began the rescue.
The crowd watched from the side, exchanging glances, wondering who this young man was.
Judging by his attire, he looked like someone who had just come from the countryside. How did he arrive at a place like the Investment Bureau and use such an ancient method like acupuncture for emergency treatment?
The first thought everyone had was, is this reliable?
"I think we should still quickly call an ambulance!"
Someone muttered.
Thinking Lin Fan was unreliable, someone immediately called for an ambulance.
But just as everyone doubted Lin Fan, among the group of investors, a short, plump middle-aged man looked at Lin Fan with some surprise.
He stared intently at Lin Fan, furrowing his brows, as if he recognized Lin Fan, but wasn’t sure.
The secretary soon brought a bowl of plain boiled water. Lin Fan gestured for him to place the water on the ground beside him.
Lin Fan continued his rescue with the silver needles.
Amazingly, under the rescue of the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles, the tightly furrowed brow and pained expression of Secretary Ma gradually eased, even his pale face slowly regained its color.
Lin Fan observed the changes in Secretary Ma, stopped the needling, and then pulled out a medicine package from his chest, which was wrapped in newspaper.
In the limited conditions of a rural clinic, to save money, Old Liu would wrap the medicine in small pieces of old newspapers instead of packaging paper.
Lin Fan unwrapped the package, revealing some gray powder inside. Lin Fan poured the powder into the bowl of boiled water, stirred it with his finger to dissolve the powder, and soon the bowl of boiled water turned into a dark gray medicinal soup.
Lin Fan picked up the bowl and poured the medicinal soup into Secretary Ma’s mouth.
The crowd exchanged glances, wondering what this stuff was.
Strangely enough, moments after the medicinal soup was poured in, Secretary Ma’s eyelids started twitching. Soon, Secretary Ma opened his eyes and regained consciousness!
Huh?
The crowd was amazed. If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t have believed that Lin Fan had just woken Secretary Ma like this. It was incredible!
They had doubted Lin Fan’s medical skill earlier, but now no one dared to doubt anymore. Regardless of who this young man from the countryside was, he indeed woke up Secretary Ma.
As Secretary Ma regained consciousness, he opened his eyes and first saw Lin Fan.
"Divine Doctor Lin, you came, it must be you who woke me up." Secretary Ma said with a relieved smile.
Lin Fan said, "How do you feel now?"
Secretary Ma replied, "It doesn’t hurt anymore. Just now, the pain inside my abdomen was so severe that for a moment, I felt like my heart was split in two, and my eyes went dark, and I knew nothing."
Lin Fan said, "I prescribed you a pain relief formula yesterday. Didn’t you take the medicine?"
Secretary Ma, embarrassed, replied, "I was too busy. I rushed here early this morning and didn’t have time to take the medicine, so..."
Lin Fan said sternly, "In your condition, you must take the medicine on time. Stopping the medication can lead to insomnia at night and fatigue during the day, which can easily lead to incidents. Luckily, I carried two medicine packages just in case. If I had been a little late, you couldn’t have been saved."
Secretary Ma felt a bit scared and guilty and said, "I’m sorry, I should have followed the medical advice. It was my oversight. I’ll be more careful next time."
Lin Fan said, "Next time? There won’t be a next time. Today, I’m going to cure you."
Secretary Ma said joyfully, "Divine Doctor Lin, you can cure me, do you mean..."
Lin Fan said, "That’s right, you guessed it, I’ve already found that herb."
Secretary Ma was very excited. Didn’t Lin Fan say that the herb was very rare? Yet, in less than a day, Lin Fan found it?
Lin Fan brought over the bag containing the herb, opened it, and took out the oddly shaped herb.
Secretary Ma was taken aback. This herb looked really strange, and he had no idea what it was, never having seen it before.
"Divine Doctor Lin, what’s this herb called?" Secretary Ma asked curiously.
Lin Fan said, "This is called Profound Ice Grass."
"Profound Ice Grass..." Secretary Ma murmured. It was certain this was an herb he had never seen or heard of before, and it even had a touch of a fantasy novel about it.
The crowd was also curious about what kind of strange herb this was that could cure Secretary Ma. Right, what illness did Secretary Ma have?
Secretary Ma thought that this herb, regardless of its name or appearance, was quite peculiar. However, didn’t Lin Fan say it was very difficult to find, so how did Lin Fan find it in one night?
Did Lin Fan lie about this, and the herb was actually quite common?
Later, Secretary Ma, bothered by this, tried to find the Profound Ice Grass himself, but no matter what he did, no matter how much manpower he used, and despite searching every nook and cranny for the rest of his life, he never found Profound Ice Grass again.
That’s when he believed Lin Fan hadn’t lied. This Profound Ice Grass was incredibly rare, and Lin Fan finding it overnight was extraordinary luck!
"Divine Doctor Lin, can we treat the illness a little later? I still have a group of guests, and I’d like to entertain them first." Secretary Ma said. Compared to his personal illness, his work was more important. He didn’t want his personal issues to delay Tianhai’s development.
Lin Fan, however, shook his head and said, "No, no matter who they are, they can wait. I’m going to extract the remedy for you right now."

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Okay? How could it be?
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Chapter 600: Okay? How could it be?
Secretary Ma suddenly fell ill, and the news alarmed the leaders. Mayor Long of Tianhai City, as well as some high-ranking city officials, rushed over.
"Did you call an ambulance?"
Mayor Long asked as he got out of the official car.
The secretary replied, "The on-site investors have already called an ambulance, but it hasn’t arrived yet."
Mayor Long said, "Call and urge them to come quickly. Secretary Ma absolutely can’t have any incidents."
The secretary said, "Okay, but... I’ve heard someone is already administering aid on site. It seems to be a young rural doctor."
Mayor Long responded, "A rural doctor? Could it be... the legendary Divine Doctor Lin?"
Recently, a legend has been circulating in Tianhai City’s political and business circles. It is said that in a small mountain village near Tianhai City, a divine doctor has appeared with remarkable medical skills. The father of Xishan County’s Party Secretary suddenly took ill while in a car and was saved by this Divine Doctor Lin. The mother of Xishan County’s governor suffered a stroke and almost died on the operating table, and was also saved by Divine Doctor Lin.
The father of Xishan County’s Party Secretary is actually Mayor Long’s father-in-law.
The first to hear of Divine Doctor Lin’s name was Mayor Long, who heard it from his brother-in-law.
Could this Divine Doctor Lin have appeared at the Tianhai City’s Investment Bureau, treating Secretary Ma?
Mayor Long was immediately intrigued. He also wanted to see with his own eyes whether this Divine Doctor Lin was as incredible as the legends suggested.
"By the way, what kind of illness did Secretary Ma have to suddenly faint?" Mayor Long asked.
The secretary said, "I’m not sure either. We have to wait for the doctor to diagnose it."
As they spoke, they had already arrived at the Investment Bureau’s hall. At this time, a large number of people had gathered in the hall, including investors and officials. Everyone appeared somewhat amazed, with all eyes focused on one spot.
Mayor Long followed the crowd’s gaze and was also taken aback.
In the hall, there was a brazier burning with fervent fire. In the fire, an oddly shaped herb was being incinerated.
Under the scorching process, the Profound Ice Grass gradually melted, transforming into a profound cyan liquid.
Lin Fan was cautiously controlling the heat on the side. Under the constant extraction, the profound cyan liquid gradually condensed, finally reducing to the size of an eyeball.
Mayor Long murmured, "What is going on, making medicine?"
Lin Fan was indeed making medicine, more accurately, extracting the medicinal properties of the Profound Ice Grass. The brazier had been borrowed from the Investment Bureau’s canteen. Although the conditions here were not as sophisticated as a medical laboratory, it was sufficient for Lin Fan.
Extracting the medicinal properties of the Profound Ice Grass is seemingly simple, just fire extraction, but it is also exceedingly complex. Not everyone can achieve it. Constant control of the fire is necessary to make the medicine. A small mistake could result in failure and waste the rare, valuable herb.
Lin Fan reached into the fire, quickly retrieving the eyeball-sized Profound Cyan Pill.
This extraction was now a great success.
"Secretary Ma, take it." Lin Fan said with a smile, handing over the Profound Cyan Pill to Secretary Ma.
"Thank you, Divine Doctor Lin." Secretary Ma was very pleased, taking the pill and intending to put it in his mouth.
"Wait!"
Mayor Long quickly stopped him.
Everyone looked at Mayor Long.
"Can this pill really cure the illness? Old Ma, in my opinion, to be cautious, let’s wait for the doctor to take a look. You can’t just take medicine randomly," Mayor Long reminded.
It is true that Lin Fan had some legend about him, and his father-in-law, Shengfu Sword, was supposedly also saved by Lin Fan. But Mayor Long was still skeptical of such miraculous medical skills, especially since it was Secretary Ma involved; discretion was necessary.
Secretary Ma smiled, "In my situation, I have already seen many doctors, some of whom are as renowned as Ai Luoqing, yet none have helped. If it weren’t for Divine Doctor Lin today, my life would be forfeit. Do you think I believe in Divine Doctor Lin? Other than Divine Doctor Lin, I don’t believe in anyone else anymore. If not even Divine Doctor Lin can cure me, then it must be my fate!"
With that, Secretary Ma nonchalantly tossed the Profound Cyan Pill into his mouth.
It’s quite amazing; as soon as this Profound Cyan Pill entered the mouth, it immediately dissolved, turning into a colorless, tasteless liquid that spread throughout Secretary Ma’s body. There was no taste, but there was a chilling sensation, as if penetrating the bone marrow.
In an instant, the chill of the Profound Cyan Pill spread throughout Secretary Ma’s body, causing him to tremble involuntarily.
"This isn’t good!" Mayor Long’s expression changed, "Could it be that Old Ma is poisoned? Where’s the ambulance, secretary, has the ambulance arrived yet?"
The secretary said, "I just made the call, it’s almost here."
Mayor Long urged, "Call again, get them here quickly. Old Ma might not hold on, I told you, you can’t trust a country doctor!"
Mayor Long took off his coat and covered Secretary Ma, comforting him, "Old Ma, how do you feel? Don’t worry, a doctor will be here soon."
Everyone exchanged glances.
Could it really be that Secretary Ma was poisoned this time? Otherwise, why would he start trembling all over and look so uncomfortable after taking the pill from Lin Fan?
They did see with their own eyes Lin Fan using the Yin Yang Eighteen Needles to revive the unconscious Secretary Ma, proving he indeed had some skill.
But that doesn’t mean Lin Fan is really that great; maybe the medicine failed?
Soon, the sound of the ambulance sirens was heard outside.
Mayor Long hurried to greet them, and before long, he brought in the doctors and nurses.
"Doctor, please quickly check Old Ma’s condition, Old Ma is very important to Tianhai City, you must save him!" Mayor Long said.
The doctor, who was pulled by Mayor Long, felt somewhat intimidated, but still promised, "Rest assured, Mayor, I will do my best."
Mayor Long said, "I’m not saying that Old Ma isn’t somewhat desperate, but professional doctors from the hospital are more reassuring. Look, after taking a pill from a foreign doctor, Old Ma just..."
As he spoke, they entered, and Mayor Long’s words suddenly got stuck.
Secretary Ma stood up from the ground, removed the coat that Mayor Long had draped over him, and handed it to the nearby secretary. Secretary Ma calmly straightened his clothes and appeared radiant, full of energy, looking like he could knock out several bulls.
"This..."
The doctor looked at Mayor Long curiously, as if to ask, wasn’t Secretary Ma looking perfectly fine? Not at all like someone needing urgent medical attention. Why were they rushing over so frantically?
Mayor Long was also stunned, "Old Ma, you are..."
Secretary Ma smiled, "No need to trouble the doctor anymore. After taking Divine Doctor Lin’s pill, I am completely fine. I’ve never felt so energized."
