Mayor Long was astonished, "You’re better? How is that possible? Weren’t you just shivering?"

chapters.title: Chapter 601 601: The Tycoons Are All Going Crazy
chapters.content:
Lin Fan calmly explained, "Just now, it was the effect of the Profound Ice Pill taking action. The reason it's called Profound Ice Grass is because the extracted medicinal effect naturally carries a cold aura. But this coldness can help detoxify the body. Once the toxins are cleared, the body naturally recovers."
Secretary Ma smiled and said, "Divine Doctor Lin's medical skill is truly awe-inspiring. I've been completely won over by Divine Doctor Lin."
Mayor Long still couldn't quite believe it and said, "Old Ma, are you really okay? Could it be an illusion, or might there be some aftereffects? How about this, let's have the doctor check you over so that everyone can be reassured."
Secretary Ma waved his hand, "No need, I trust Divine Doctor Lin's medical skills completely. I'm very aware of my condition; without Divine Doctor Lin, I would be a dead man now."
Lin Fan, however, said, "Since the doctor is here and the mayor isn't at ease, it wouldn't hurt to have the doctor take a look. Doctor, please."
Mayor Long immediately said, "Doctor, sorry to trouble you."
He still remained a bit uneasy about Lin Fan.
The doctor then stepped forward as requested and conducted a simple check-up on Secretary Ma.
Afterwards, the doctor stated, "Secretary Ma's physical condition is very healthy, no issues at all, at least I can't see any. Whatever illness Secretary Ma had before, I think he's already recovered."
What?
Mayor Long was taken aback. Given the doctor's confirmation, he had no choice but to believe it—Secretary Ma was really okay!
Lin Fan was indeed as legendary as rumored, curing Secretary Ma in such a manner; truly a divine doctor!
"Holy crap, this young man's medical skill is truly amazing."
"This method of treating illness with alchemy is unprecedented and unheard of!"
"I can see the essence of traditional Chinese medicine in this! This is how it's described in legends!"
"So impressive, and he's so young. I'm not feeling well either; I want to consult him too. Money is not an issue!"
The crowd was buzzing, all eager to have a try.
Especially those investors, they all have money. However, regardless of wealth, no one can escape the cycle of life, old age, illness, and death. Everyone's body has its problems, some of which can't be cured no matter how much money is spent.
It's not about money; it's the limit of current medical technology. Medicine has its bottlenecks, and there are still many incurable diseases at the current level, like cancer. Humanity is far from being able to eradicate cancer.
Not to mention cancer, should an unknown virus accidentally emerge and spread widely, it could deal a devastating blow to humanity.
No one escapes life, old age, illness, and death, be you a national leader, the world's richest, a rural villager, or a street beggar, all are equal in the face of this. The world is filled with injustices; some are born with a silver spoon and retire upon birth, while others toil day and night yet live in hardship. Some are born beautiful, with exceptional appearances, while others still fail after cosmetic surgeries, looking stranger and eventually disfigured.
Only life, old age, illness, and death treat everyone equally, sparing no one.
Some are superstar icons, living in lavish mansions with countless assets, yet are tormented by untreatable diseases, restless and uneasy.
Some shine brightly, showered with love as soon as they appear, but behind the spotlight, they're grimacing in pain, awkward and disheveled.
Sometimes, driven mad by illness, they're willing to spend their entire fortune for a healthy body.
The investors present, who aren't billionaires? All their bodies have various maladies, more or less.
If their health issues could be cured, they wouldn't mind sparing no expense.
Having witnessed Lin Fan heal Secretary Ma firsthand, everyone became restless, contemplating seeking treatment from Lin Fan.
"Hahaha..."
With his health restored, Secretary Ma appeared exceptionally spirited, his mood particularly high, and he couldn't help but burst into hearty laughter.
"Oh yes, Divine Doctor Lin, you've cured me; I must express my gratitude. This time, the treatment wasn't easy. I know my own condition well. Divine Doctor Lin, just name your price; I'll pay for the medical expenses," Secretary Ma said.
Lin Fan seriously thought for a moment and said, "This treatment did have some difficulty, and Profound Ice Grass is indeed very rare..."
Everyone glanced at each other with ambiguous expressions.
Here it comes, the main event.
Such a familiar taste. Lin Fan intends to name a high price; it's clear the treatment cost won't be small!
Perhaps starting at a hundred thousand!
A million isn't impossible!
Those present are either wealthy or high-ranking, with much experience of being scammed by various "divine doctors"—illness never cured, yet the money never short.
An old traditional doctor opens his mouth, and it's an easy hundred thousand. A retired maestro charges several ten thousand per prescription, begging him to write it. In the end, the money's spent, and the illness may still persist.
After all, they're old traditional doctors and maestros, renowned, money duly received, yet there's no guarantee of a cure. If you question why it's not cured, they claim your illness is too severe; not even an immortal could cure it.
Now Lin Fan says the treatment is difficult, the herbs are rare; it's that familiar flavor, the next step is a high price, typical of those old doctors and maestros!
Lin Fan continued, "Profound Ice Grass is hard to come by, and since this is an out-of-town consultation, I need to charge some travel expenses. So, it might be a bit expensive this time."
Here it is!
The crowd's expression grew increasingly ambiguous; all the same routine.
Secretary Ma laughed, "Divine Doctor Lin, I completely understand. This treatment was indeed tough."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, since Secretary Ma understands, please settle the medical fee, totaling 1200 yuan."
What?
The entire room was stunned.
Everyone thought they heard it wrong—could there be something wrong with their ears? A mistake with the number? 1200, how could that be?
This is so damn cheap!
Did he forget a zero or two?
Sure it's not 12000, or 120000?
What the hell!
Only 1200?
Not following the usual script; everyone thought Lin Fan would demand a huge fee after all that build-up. This 1200 is supposed to be a hefty charge? It's so damn cheap, it's making me cry, seriously!
Rich folks used to being fleeced by old traditional doctors were stunned when they heard Lin Fan only charged Secretary Ma 1200.
Secretary Ma was a bit surprised too, "Divine Doctor Lin, what did you just say?"
Lin Fan said, "1200, did Secretary Ma find that a bit expensive? No problem, I can give you a discount."
With these words, everyone was stunned!
What the hell!
Only 1200, and there's a discount!
Didn't hear wrong, did they? Really didn't hear wrong?
The wealthy were sweating profusely, constantly wiping their sweat. Was the sun rising in the west today? Old quacks couldn't cure illnesses and charged exorbitant fees, yet a genuine divine doctor cured the illness and charged only 1200, with a discount!
Secretary Ma hurriedly said, "No, no, not finding it expensive. I'll pay Divine Doctor Lin immediately."
Afraid Lin Fan might really give him a discount, Secretary Ma quickly transferred 1200 to Lin Fan. Too conscientious, truly too conscientious; he almost wanted to add another zero for Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 602: He Is the Wealthiest Man in Yun City!
chapters.content:
Lin Fan collected 1,200 yuan as medical fees and felt quite satisfied. For the small clinic, it was a decent income. Over the past few days that he helped Old Liu at the clinic, he indeed helped increase the clinic's revenue.
Everyone present was still shocked by Lin Fan's conscientious charges.
Secretary Ma couldn't help but say, "Divine Doctor Lin, I don't like beating around the bush, so I'll speak directly. Why did you charge so little? Is it because of my identity? You really don't need to worry about it. Charge what you should, I know this treatment wasn't easy. If the hospital could cure me, this treatment would cost tens of thousands."
Indeed, hospital charges are very high. I heard that the mother of the Xishan County's mayor had a stroke surgery. The surgery failed, yet the fee was 160,000. If it hadn't been for Lin Fan stepping in that day, the mayor's mother would have died on the operating table.
Apart from hospitals charging high fees, those old traditional doctors, quacks, and frauds also charge without hesitation.
Lin Fan only took 1,200, which was truly conscientious. This was a question everyone present wanted to ask.
For a moment, everyone's eyes were on Lin Fan.
Could it be that Lin Fan charged so little just to please Secretary Ma? If so, it means Lin Fan really knows how to win people over.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Secretary Ma, don't misunderstand. It's not because of your identity that I'm charging this way. It's simply worth this price. I would charge the same for anyone else."
Secretary Ma replied, "But considering the rarity of the herbs and Divine Doctor Lin's medical skills, isn't this a bit too little?"
Lin Fan said, "No, extracting this antidote is indeed not easy for others. For me, it's just a slightly complex manual task. The herbs are indeed rare but not too valuable. If it weren't for this kind of toxin, they would seldom be used."
After listening to Lin Fan's explanation, everyone nodded, but they still felt that Lin Fan's charges were very conscientious.
Others would brag greatly to charge more, but Lin Fan was honest about his fees. Such vision and generosity are truly rare.
Secretary Ma smiled and said, "Divine Doctor Lin, you are a true divine doctor, with outstanding medical skills and exceptional medical ethics. I deeply admire you. Divine Doctor Lin saved my life; I can't express my gratitude enough!"
Lin Fan waved his hand with a smile and said, "I see Secretary Ma as a good officer. A good officer should live a long life and benefit the region. Tianhai City is also my hometown, and I hope it gets better and better. In the future, more good officers like Secretary Ma can help with the development of our hometown."
After speaking, Lin Fan took his leave.
After hearing Lin Fan's words, Secretary Ma was very happy and motivated, saying, "Ladies and gentlemen, I apologize for the delay due to my health; let's continue..."
The investors were initially not very interested in investing in Tianhai. They were just giving Secretary Ma some face and going through the motions.
But what just happened caused some changes in the investors' minds.
In Tianhai City, there's such a transcendent divine doctor like Lin Fan. If we develop in Tianhai, could we not become friends with Divine Doctor Lin?
After all, investing a sum of money in Tianhai is not difficult for them. If they could earn the favor of Divine Doctor Lin, wouldn't future medical needs be secured?
The wealthier a person is, the more they cherish their life. The value of a divine doctor is incredibly high in the eyes of the wealthy.
Secretary Ma had no idea of the investors' thoughts as he continued touting the benefits of investing in Tianhai with a smile, "We are fortunate to have invited you investors here. You are all outstanding in your respective fields, even local richest. I believe with your business acumen, you will agree with our Tianhai City's..."
"Wait a minute!"
Suddenly, an investor seemed to have remembered something and interrupted Secretary Ma.
Everyone turned their eyes to this investor.
"Mr. Chen, is there a problem?" Secretary Ma asked.
The investor seemed a bit excited and said, "I finally remember who Divine Doctor Lin is!"
What?
Everyone was curious about what he meant by this.
Secretary Ma said, "Divine Doctor Lin is Divine Doctor Lin, who else could he be?"
The investor said, "No, his identity is not just a divine doctor. His name is Lin Fan, and he is the richest man in Yun City!"
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Secretary Ma said, "Mr. Chen, what are you saying? Are you saying Divine Doctor Lin is the richest man in Yun City? How is that possible? Haven't you mistaken him for someone else?"
Lin Fan is just a rural doctor from West River Village; how can he be connected to the richest man in Yun City? This seems exaggerated.
Everyone thought the same; Mr. Chen must have been mistaken. The richest man in Yun City and a rural doctor are two completely unrelated identities.
Mr. Chen said, "I once attended a business meeting in Yun City and caught a glimpse of Mr. Lin from afar. I felt Divine Doctor Lin looked familiar but couldn't recall. Until Secretary Ma mentioned the words 'richest man,' it suddenly clicked. There's no mistake, Divine Doctor Lin is Yun City's richest man, Mr. Lin! If there really was a mistake, I'd be astounded at how identical they look!"
Everyone looked at each other. Seeing Mr. Chen's confident expression, it didn't seem like a lie.
"The richest man in Yun City, Mr. Lin, is a legendary figure. It's rumored that his background is extensive and even related to the Lin family in Jing City!"
"But Divine Doctor Lin is just a rural doctor..."
"Could it be Mr. Lin and Divine Doctor Lin are twins?"
Secretary Ma shook his head and said, "To my knowledge, Divine Doctor Lin hasn't any twin brother, only a sister. Moreover, I know this time Divine Doctor Lin returned home temporarily; he has been working in Yun City..."
Mr. Chen clapped his thigh and said, "That's it! Divine Doctor Lin must be Mr. Lin! My God, Mr. Lin is truly a man of wonders. He's so wealthy, yet possesses such excellent medical skills!"
"Wait!" Secretary Ma also got a bit excited, "If what Mr. Chen says is true, that Divine Doctor Lin is the richest man in Yun City, doesn't that mean our Tianhai City has a billionaire giant?"
Oh my God!
Such a small Tianhai City, a backward village, unexpectedly produced a billionaire giant, it's absolutely sensational news.
The value within this realization was enough to make Secretary Ma thrilled by just the thought of it. He had always hoped that Tianhai City could develop better. If Lin Fan, as a Tianhai native, is indeed Yun City's richest man, then Lin Fan is the living signboard of his hometown!
Money, flowing throughout the city!
Thinking about countless funds pouring into Tianhai City, Secretary Ma was almost floating with joy.
Secretary Ma immediately made a decision; he had to verify this matter no matter what. Currently, it's just Mr. Chen's account, and it hasn't been confirmed yet, so the imperative is to ascertain this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 603: My Dad Will Take Care of Him
chapters.content:
A divine doctor emerged from West River Village in Tianhai City, and this doctor is likely the richest man in Yun City, a trillionaire!
This news quickly spread among the upper echelons of Tianhai City, shaking the entire city government.
Lin Fan was unaware of this.
After treating Secretary Ma, he walked out of the Business Promotion Bureau.
"Divine Doctor Lin, please wait."
District Chief Li Gang caught up from behind, his face full of a sheepish smile.
Today, Li Gang was also at the Business Promotion Bureau and witnessed Lin Fan save Secretary Ma firsthand, admiring Lin Fan's medical skills immensely.
"Divine Doctor Lin, you promised yesterday to help my father with his illness. Do you have time now? I can drive over and pick you up?" District Chief Li said with a smile.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I promised, so I will do it. I was planning to go to District Chief Li's house, and now that you're here, please lead the way."
District Chief Li was very pleased, "Mr. Lin, please."
Initially, District Chief Li wanted to invite Lin Fan into his car, but Lin Fan got into his own rented sedan.
District Chief Li then drove ahead to lead the way.
The Li Clan is a prominent family in Tianhai City. As the clan head, the Li Family has substantial wealth, and with Li Gang as the district chief, the Li Family can be described as having both wealth and power.
It's no wonder that their daughter, who has been pampered since childhood, would be so willful.
This willful eldest daughter of the Li Family is named Li Xiaosi. At this moment, Li Xiaosi was at home, feeling bored, sipping water from a cup while chatting with a friend.
"Sisi, I heard you went to the countryside yesterday. Why did you go there?" her friend asked curiously.
Li Xiaosi grumbled, "Don't mention it. Just thinking about it makes me angry. Such a deadbeat countryside place, there's nothing good there!"
Her friend laughed, "Who offended our eldest daughter of the Li Family?"
Her friend understood Li Xiaosi well; when Li Xiaosi spoke like this, it was definitely because she encountered something displeasing.
Li Xiaosi said, "Here's what happened: My grandpa isn't well, and my dad heard there's a divine doctor in the countryside. He was too busy to go, so he asked me to fetch the doctor, so I went to the countryside. Let me tell you, that place is absolutely backward. The people there dress so shabbily, and everyone looks dirt-poor. I absolutely detest the countryside. But that's not the main point. When I went to the clinic to ask the country bumpkin doctor for a consultation, he actually kicked me out."
Her friend exclaimed, "What? He kicked you out? Why?"
Li Xiaosi said, "How would I know. That country bumpkin has no manners. And I, the eldest daughter, am supposed to humble myself before such a country bumpkin? Impossible. So, it resulted in a conflict. I was utterly furious. Never in my life have I, Li Xiaosi, suffered such indignity!"
Her friend was astonished, "That countryside doctor actually dared treat you like this; he's something else!"
She was genuinely impressed. In Tianhai City, who would dare to throw Li Xiaosi out? Everyone who sees Li Xiaosi yields to her in some way. Yet, the countryside doctor dared to kick Li Xiaosi out. He is indeed a bold man.
Li Xiaosi sneered, "What kind of person? Just a country bumpkin doctor, arrogant because he knows a little bit of medicine, daring to offend even me. He'll have no good end!"
Her friend gossiped, "Eldest daughter, how do you plan to deal with this countryside doctor?"
Li Xiaosi chuckled, "I've already complained to my dad and told him about the country bumpkin's offense. My dad won't disappoint me; he'll definitely tidy up this country bumpkin!"
Her friend stuck out her tongue; if the district chief takes action, it can indeed make a countryside doctor suffer.
"That countryside doctor... doesn't he know you're the district chief's daughter? How dare he be rude to you?" her friend asked curiously.
Li Xiaosi said, "He knows, yet he's still so arrogant. I think he won't cry until he sees the coffin!"
Her friend was somewhat amazed. Lin Fan knew that Li Xiaosi's father was Li Gang, yet he still dared to kick her out. It's a different nature entirely; a brave man among brave men indeed. Her friend grew even more impressed with Lin Fan, even developing a bit of curiosity and wanted to meet Lin Fan.
Her friend said, "He's just a countryside doctor. Why not have Little Jin teach him a lesson? Surely, that would be easy enough."
This statement hit Li Xiaosi's sore spot. Li Xiaosi replied, "Whatever, let's not talk about him anymore. It's boring. Let's just wait for my dad to tidy him up."
Her friend found it odd and asked, "Eldest daughter, why do you suddenly not want to mention him? Did something happen?"
Li Xiaosi said, "Nothing, just don't want to talk about him. It's infuriating to bring up!"
Her friend asked, "You didn't invite the countryside doctor, so what about Grandpa Li's illness?"
Li Xiaosi smirked, "Rest assured, once my dad tidies him up, he'll definitely beg to come and treat Grandpa. I'm curious to see if he really has the skill. If he's just a fraud, his end will be quite miserable! My guess is he's mostly a fraud! Think about it, he's so young; how skilled can his medical practice be? Most likely he's a con artist!"
Her friend uttered an "Oh," curiously asking, "Is this countryside doctor very young?"
Li Sisi said, "He looks about 20 years old, roughly our age. Do you think that's reliable?"
Her friend was extremely curious. Could such a young countryside doctor truly have great medical skills? She was immensely eager to see for herself.
Unfortunately, Li Xiaosi offended this young countryside doctor, so it's unlikely she'll have the chance to assess him.
At this moment, two cars drove into the Li Family's courtyard; one was Li Gang's Bentley, while the other was a very ordinary sedan, the kind one could buy new for several tens of thousands, possibly valued at just a few thousand if purchased second-hand.
The Li Family's regular visitors were all affluent or notable, and the cars they drove started at several hundred thousand, with even such an amount considered modest.
When did the Li Family's courtyard feature such a low-grade car? It was definitely a first!
In Li Xiaosi's recollection, it was indeed the first time she saw such an unfashionable, low-grade sedan in her family's courtyard. Who was this poor person who came?
They actually visited the Li Family!
Her friend asked curiously, "Eldest daughter, it looks like there's a guest at home. Who is it?"
Li Xiaosi shook her head, "I have no idea."
The shabby, cheap sedan followed Li Gang's Bentley.
Li Gang's Bentley stopped first, and Li Gang quickly got out of the car, then ran to the back beside the shabby sedan, displaying an exceedingly respectful attitude, personally helping open the driver's seat door of the dilapidated car.
Huh?
This scene made both Li Xiaosi and her friend a bit surprised. What was going on here?
Li Gang was the district chief; treating someone driving such a dilapidated, cheap car with so much respect was abnormal!
Naturally, just the arrival of a cheap sedan at the Li Family's was unusual. Li Gang's behavior was even more puzzling.
"Could it be..." Li Xiaosi suddenly had a bad thought.
The driver's door of the cheap sedan opened, and a plainly dressed young man got out.
Though his clothes were plain and even rustic, they couldn't conceal his handsomeness. That handsome face with an aura that was hard to suppress.
Lin Fan!
Clang!
Li Xiaosi's water cup dropped to the ground in shock, instantly shattering.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 604: Get Down for Me!
chapters.content:
District Chief Li respectfully opened the car door for Lin Fan, waiting to usher him out.
"Divine Doctor Lin, this is my humble abode. We are very grateful for your visit. My father is inside, please follow me." District Chief Li spoke with great respect.
Having witnessed Lin Fan saving Secretary Ma firsthand, District Chief Li was thoroughly impressed by Lin Fan's medical skill. It's very possible that Lin Fan is the family's only hope—not possible, but fundamentally, he is indeed the only hope.
Could he not regard Lin Fan highly? He was afraid that any minor offense might upset Lin Fan, leading him to refuse making a house call, which would be disastrous.
Lin Fan was not too concerned about District Chief Li's attempts to ingratiate himself. He agreed to treat Elder Li out of respect for Secretary Ma, who mentioned that Elder Li was a soldier with meritorious war service, which Lin Fan respected.
Lin Fan got out of the car and said, "Alright."
This scene was witnessed by Li Xiaosi and her best friend.
The friend realized, "Xiaosi, is he the country doctor you mentioned?"
Li Xiaosi was so angry she couldn't bear it. Her bad premonition had come true; the visitor was indeed Lin Fan!
The friend didn't notice Li Xiaosi's anger and gazed at Lin Fan with starry eyes, "He's really handsome. Even those plain clothes can't hide it. If he changed into something else, is there anyone more handsome in this world?"
Li Xiaosi glared at her friend, "What's so handsome about him? I'm so pissed off!"
The friend stuck out her tongue and said, "Xiaosi, didn't you say Uncle would deal with this country doctor? It doesn't look like it!"
This was precisely what made Li Xiaosi angriest. She thought her father would deal with Lin Fan. Her father always doted on her and listened to her every word. This time, it seemed he hadn't done as she wished!
Li Xiaosi couldn't take it. Moreover, she had just told her friend that her father would handle Lin Fan, but now, it looked like a slap in the face, making her lose face.
Li Xiaosi angrily ran out and stood in front of Lin Fan and District Chief Li.
"What's he doing here?"
Li Xiaosi pointed at Lin Fan and spoke angrily.
District Chief Li did not expect Li Xiaosi to rush out and was a bit surprised, "Xiaosi... I invited Divine Doctor Lin to help your grandfather with his illness."
Li Xiaosi said angrily, "Dad, didn't I tell you yesterday that this guy bullied me? You have to stand up for me!"
District Chief Li felt a bit embarrassed. He had indeed planned to confront Lin Fan yesterday, but upon arriving at the country clinic, he saw Secretary Ma there seeking treatment from Lin Fan. How could he dare cause trouble for Lin Fan then?
Moreover, now that he knew Lin Fan's exceptional medical skill, he needed Lin Fan's help even more, so there was no way he could bother Lin Fan.
"Xiaosi, Divine Doctor Lin is here to help your grandfather. Please step aside," District Chief Li said awkwardly, unwilling to provoke Lin Fan yet also unable to scold his daughter, so he could only use a persuasive tone.
Li Xiaosi, however, didn't buy it and angrily said, "I don't care. He treated me like that yesterday. I have to make him pay. You bum, what right do you have to come to my home? Our family is so noble, can someone like you, a country bumpkin, even step in?"
With her bossy temper flaring, Li Xiaosi began to insult Lin Fan.
Lin Fan chuckled, "What's so noble here?"
Li Xiaosi sneered, "You're just a country bumpkin living in that kind of place. We live in a city villa, aren't we more noble than you? Yesterday you threw me out of the clinic, today it's my turn to throw you out of my house. Get out!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Do you really want me to leave? District Chief Li, your daughter seems unwelcome to me, so it seems I shouldn't stay here."
District Chief Li was shocked. Lin Fan intending to leave was a serious matter. Who would treat his father then? He finally managed to invite Lin Fan to the house and couldn't let him leave like this.
District Chief Li struggled internally but finally put on a stern face and shouted at Li Xiaosi, "Xiaosi, don't be rude. Step back!"
Li Xiaosi was dumbfounded.
She couldn't believe her father was siding with Lin Fan, asking her to step back. From childhood to now, he had always been obedient to her, when had he ever spoken harshly to her!
"Dad, what are you saying? You're asking me to step back?" Li Xiaosi said incredulously, then angrily, "He nearly hit me yesterday. I'm your daughter. How can you not help me teach him a lesson!"
District Chief Li felt uneasy, with sweat appearing on his forehead; he was in a tough position.
Lin Fan watched and smiled, "District Chief Li, since your daughter is so upset, I should leave first, so as not to damage your father-daughter relationship, which wouldn't be good. As for your father's illness, it seems there's nothing I can do."
With that, Lin Fan planned to take his leave.
District Chief Li panicked, "Divine Doctor Lin, please stay. My little girl's temperament is like this. Please don't take it seriously! Xiaosi, don't be presumptuous here; quickly step back!"
Li Xiaosi couldn't believe that her father was still trying to please Lin Fan, completely disregarding her feelings.
Li Xiaosi angrily said, "Dad, how can you do this? This country bumpkin..."
Slap!
District Chief Li rushed over and gave Li Xiaosi a resounding slap.
District Chief Li was also anxious. Li Xiaosi jumped out to curse Lin Fan, already making Lin Fan unhappy. If this continued, Lin Fan would definitely leave. He painstakingly invited Lin Fan, desperate to flatter, and couldn't let Li Xiaosi ruin it.
In his urgency, he had no choice but to lay hands on Li Xiaosi, knowing he could coax her later. Right now, he absolutely couldn't offend Lin Fan.
The clear slap left Li Xiaosi stunned.
Li Xiaosi's friend was also stunned.
The Li Family members around, witnessing this, were also stunned.
Oh my god!
Master Li actually slapped the young lady!
This wasn't something you see every day. In fact, before this actually happened, no one would have believed that District Chief Li would hit his daughter.
District Chief Li spoiled Li Xiaosi immensely, afraid she'd melt if held in his mouth and break if held in his palm. He dared not give her a star, let alone a moon. Because of this, it led to the young lady being so spoiled and domineering.
No one dared imagine District Chief Li would scold his daughter, let alone hit her.
But this crisp slap ended everything.
"You hit me, you actually hit me!" Li Xiaosi covered her face, looking utterly shocked.
District Chief Li angrily said, "Get down, and don't be disrespectful to Divine Doctor Lin again, or else I..."
Li Xiaosi shouted, "Or else what? Or else you'll hit me again? I'll keep cursing him, you country bumpkin..."
Slap!
District Chief Li swung his hand again, delivering another loud slap.
"I've never hit you since you were little, perhaps that's why you're so unreasonable. Today, I'll teach you how to behave!" District Chief Li shouted.
Li Xiaosi's cheeks got slapped on both sides, her face swelling red. It not only hurt but made her heart pain more. For Lin Fan, her father actually hit her this hard; she never imagined it in her dreams.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 605: Definitely the Chosen One
chapters.content:
"Sob sob sob..."
Li Sisi burst into tears and ran off.
The friends beside her were shocked and didn't know how to react.
District Chief Li, who had hit his daughter hard, felt a bit of remorse and said to her friends, "Please follow her."
The friends quickly nodded and turned to chase after Li Sisi.
District Chief Li came up to Lin Fan, forced a smile, and said, "Divine Doctor Lin, I'm sorry you had to see that. My daughter has always been like this, lacking discipline, and I've offended you. I must apologize. I'm really sorry, but everything's fine now. Divine Doctor Lin, my father is waiting inside. Please come in."
Lin Fan said, "I'll be frank. District Chief Li, you really should discipline your daughter. Yesterday she scared my aunt while driving, causing her to sprain her back. If I hadn't treated her, my aunt might have been injured for life."
District Chief Li broke into a cold sweat; it seemed Li Sisi had lied to him yesterday and hadn't told the truth. She only told him that Lin Fan was rude and chased her away.
In fact, it was she who was in the wrong!
District Chief Li quickly said, "Divine Doctor Lin, you are right. I will definitely discipline my daughter more strictly in the future so she won't be so spoiled."
Lin Fan said, "This is a family matter for District Chief Li, so I won't interfere. Please lead the way, and I'll go take a look at Mr. Li."
District Chief Li secretly breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he had done the right thing just now. Even though hitting his daughter was painful, it kept Lin Fan here. Otherwise, if he let Li Sisi continue making a fuss, Lin Fan might have left. Who would then treat the elder?
Lin Fan didn't disappoint District Chief Li.
Subsequently, Lin Fan met Elder Li, diagnosed his condition, performed acupuncture on the spot, and prescribed some medicine.
After the acupuncture, Elder Li visibly improved. Originally bedridden with severe illness and even difficulty speaking, he was now able to get out of bed with assistance and do some simple activities.
Moreover, Elder Li could speak again and held Lin Fan's hand gratefully, saying, "Young man, thank you so much. You're truly a divine doctor!"
District Chief Li was very pleased and increasingly felt that his actions were justified. Slapping his daughter twice for his father's recovery was worth it.
"The old man is no longer in serious condition. Henceforth, with regular medication and exercise, he should gradually regain his mobility and live another decade or so," Lin Fan smiled and said.
District Chief Li gratefully said, "Thank you so much, Divine Doctor Lin."
Lin Fan nodded and said, "I need to return to the rural area, so I won't stay any longer. Farewell."
District Chief Li said, "Alright, I won't delay Divine Doctor Lin further. By the way, Divine Doctor Lin, I haven't paid your fee yet."
Lin Fan calculated and said, "I'll just charge 500 yuan."
At the Commerce Bureau, District Chief Li had already witnessed Lin Fan's reasonable charges. Now, Lin Fan only charged 500 yuan, which moved him deeply.
It was truly conscientious; he was almost moved to tears.
Since the elder's illness, he had been bedridden, with numerous doctors having seen him, costing tens of thousands in total, yet no improvement.
And now, Lin Fan had cured him with only 500 yuan.
Where else could you find such a conscientious doctor like Lin Fan in this world!
Divine Doctor Lin truly lives up to the title of "divine doctor"!
Instantly, District Chief Li felt a sense of reverence for Lin Fan, indeed, reverence! Previously, he had refrained from offending Lin Fan due to his considerations for Secretary Ma and his hopes of help from Lin Fan. But now, he genuinely revered Lin Fan. From now on, when mentioning Lin Fan, he would raise his thumb and treat him with utmost respect.
District Chief Li subsequently gave Lin Fan 500 yuan and respectfully saw him out.
After Lin Fan left.
Elder Li instructed, "Ah-Gang, this Divine Doctor Lin is young, yet his medical skills are exceptional, and even more importantly, he has medical ethics. I have always been a good judge of character. This Divine Doctor Lin is absolutely a chosen one. If you ever have a chance to interact with Divine Doctor Lin again, do not treat it lightly!"
District Chief Li said, "I understand, Father."
District Chief Li walked out of Elder Li's room, with his daughter on his mind, and went to Li Sisi's room to check on her.
Outside Li Sisi's room, he found the door tightly shut, even blocking her friends outside who couldn't get in.
"How is Sisi?" District Chief Li asked.
The friend said, "She's locked herself inside and refuses to come out. I tried persuading her for a long time, but she wouldn't listen."
District Chief Li walked up, knocked on the door, and said, "Sisi, it's Dad. Open the door."
From inside came Li Sisi's shout, "Go away, you actually hit me for an outsider. I hate you!"
District Chief Li felt a bit speechless. He realized that perhaps he had been too indulgent with his daughter in the past, making her unable to distinguish between right and wrong, too spoiled.
"Sisi, Dad couldn't do otherwise. Divine Doctor Lin is here to help your grandfather, and we absolutely cannot offend him," said District Chief Li.
Li Sisi snorted, "What's more important than me? You hit me, you hit me!"
District Chief Li's face darkened, "Sisi, be reasonable. Of course, you're very important to me, but my father is equally important! In this world, only Divine Doctor Lin can treat your grandfather. Don't you want your grandfather to recover?"
Li Sisi said, "That country bumpkin, he looks like a quack to me. How could you believe him? You've been fooled! You have to stand up for me, teach him a lesson!"
District Chief Li perspired, "Whether Divine Doctor Lin has real skills, you can see by checking on your grandfather!"
Li Sisi said, "What are you saying?"
District Chief Li said, "Divine Doctor Lin has already treated your grandfather and left. If you don't believe in his ability, you can go see your grandfather. Once you see for yourself, you'll understand my good intentions."
The friend, curious, said, "Uncle Li, could it be..."
District Chief Li nodded, "Yes, Divine Doctor Lin has cured the elder."
"Huh?"
The friend was incredulous. Having seen Elder Li's condition, she had always thought he was beyond hope.
Divine Doctor Lin had healed him in such a short time—was this really true?
Even Li Sisi couldn't resist her curiosity. She finally opened the door and went to see Elder Li with her friend.
Elder Li, already able to get out of bed with family assistance and perform simple activities, startled them both when they saw this scene.
"Miss, it seems this country doctor you mentioned truly has skills!" the friend said.
For a moment, Li Sisi was speechless, engulfed in shock, her emotions complicated, unable to speak.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan had left the Li Family and was driving back to the countryside.
After driving for a while, Lin Fan stopped at a red light, waiting for it to change.
Suddenly, Lin Fan realized how familiar the area was—hey, isn't this near his high school?
"Lin Fan? Is that really you, Lin Fan?"
Suddenly, someone called out.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 100th Anniversary Celebration
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Chapter 606: 100th Anniversary Celebration
Lin Fan attended a high school called Tianhai Middle School, a key high school in the city. When Lin Fan got into Tianhai Middle School, his grades were only moderate, and because Lin Fan was low-key, he wasn’t noticeable throughout high school, just a typically ordinary student.
The only thing about Lin Fan that could stir some sensation and discussion was his handsome appearance. Of course, even that didn’t make much of a splash, because nowadays, most middle school girls prefer those pretty-boy types, and Lin Fan’s rugged handsomeness wasn’t quite their type.
There’s just no helping it; who knows when these aesthetic standards went astray. Delicate pretty boys are especially favored by young girls, leading to many male celebrities now sporting effeminate styles. Supply meets demand, right?
If our society preferred rugged handsome aesthetics, then these effeminate pretty boys wouldn’t have a way to survive.
Lin Fan didn’t want to dress effeminately to cater to those brainless young girls’ tastes; he felt that a man should look like a man.
This made Lin Fan, who could rely on his looks to become a school sensation, appear very low-key instead.
A few years after graduating high school, Lin Fan felt that probably no one remembered him anymore, including many of his former high school classmates whom he had lost touch with. At least Lin Fan himself had forgotten some of their names.
Similarly, he knew he’d be forgotten by others.
Lin Fan planned to drive back to West River Village but suddenly realized he was passing by Tianhai Middle School, which inadvertently reminded him of some people and events from high school.
Lin Fan turned his head and saw outside the window a very plump woman, riding an electric scooter, smiling at him.
Lin Fan was taken aback and blurted out, "Little Ling?"
He recognized this plump woman as a female classmate from high school, Jia Xiaoling. And not just any ordinary classmate; they used to sit close, chat often, and were buddies who hung out together.
After Lin Fan graduated, he went to Yun City for college. The classmates scattered, each living their new life, and contact dwindled.
Lin Fan hadn’t contacted Jia Xiaoling since, but occasionally heard that after failing to get into her desired college, Jia Xiaoling stopped studying and went to work. Within two years, she got married.
Jia Xiaoling hadn’t invited Lin Fan to her wedding, and since her marriage, Lin Fan hadn’t heard a word from her.
Now seeing Lin Fan, Jia Xiaoling was all surprised. She probably never dreamed she’d run into Lin Fan here.
"Lin Fan, are you also here for the centennial celebration?" Jia Xiaoling asked, smiling.
Lin Fan wasn’t there for any celebration. A few days ago, an old classmate, Chen Xinxing, had mentioned Tianhai Middle School’s centennial celebration, but Lin Fan hadn’t paid it any mind or planned to attend.
Showing up here at this time, simply a coincidence.
Jia Xiaoling misjudged it, thinking Lin Fan was here for the celebration.
"Just great, some of us planned to meet up taking advantage of this event. They said they didn’t have your contact info and couldn’t find you. Glad we met here; come and join us!" Jia Xiaoling said, smiling.
Though Lin Fan initially wanted to refuse, honestly, he wasn’t fond of class reunions. But seeing the expectation in Jia Xiaoling’s eyes, he felt reluctant to turn her down; after all, they were old classmates, and used to be quite close.
"Okay, let’s go together," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Jia Xiaoling couldn’t have been happier, nearly overjoyed. Just then the light turned green, and she said with a grin, "Let’s go, let’s meet at the intersection ahead."
Saying that, Jia Xiaoling drove her electric scooter onward.
Lin Fan, seeing her joy, couldn’t help but be touched himself, and with a smile on his lips, drove after her.
The intersection ahead led to the road towards Tianhai Middle School.
By ten in the morning, Tianhai Middle School’s centennial celebration was about to start, and the road leading there appeared somewhat crowded. Quite a few cars arrived, many of them luxury cars, all attending the centennial celebration, each person dressed glamourously.
After all, it’s a centennial celebration; many attendees were invited by the school, and appearing at such an event, they couldn’t come carelessly dressed. Even those not invited wouldn’t want to look out of place, hence dressing up well.
Lin Fan finally managed to drive up to the school entrance and found a spot to park.
Jia Xiaoling had already arrived first on her electric scooter, meeting up with a bunch of high school classmates.
This group of classmates included both boys and girls. They mostly no longer looked like students since they were all around twenty years old, most already working and having undergone society’s trials.
"Liu Qiang, haven’t seen you in years, looking handsome now! Where are you working?"
Classmates looked at one clad in a suit, with hair slicked back. This Liu Qiang, who arrived in a BMW earlier, immediately became the center of attention.
Liu Qiang felt a bit proud to be the focus. In high school, he wasn’t noticeable either, but since he did well after graduation, he was a frequent topic among classmates.
"Handsome? It’s all about the clothes. Not much success for me, still just tagging along with my cousin!" Liu Qiang said, humbly pretending.
"Liu Qiang’s cousin runs a factory, I’ve heard its profits alone make tens of millions a year!"
"Really envy Liu Qiang for having such a cool relative. I wish a relative could help me too!"
"Can’t envy this stuff, it’s all about fate!"
"Brother Qiang is truly impressive, driving a BMW. I’ve barely even touched one!"
Everyone flattered Liu Qiang.
Liu Qiang felt nearly weightless with pride.
At this moment, Jia Xiaoling rode in on her electric scooter, attracting attention.
"Isn’t this Little Ling?"
"Heard she got married, doesn’t seem like she married well though, driving an electric scooter!"
"Little Ling’s even fatter than before; they say she’s had two kids now."
Everyone discussed, many showing teasing expressions, not considering Jia Xiaoling highly in their words.
Jia Xiaoling was indeed a plump girl, always had been, and wasn’t particularly pretty. Having gotten married, had kids to care for, she looked even worse now, seeming like an Auntie in her twenties.
Yet, Jia Xiaoling’s cheerful disposition remained the same.
She didn’t mind her classmates’ teasing, greeting everyone with a smile.
"Hello everyone, long time no see," Jia Xiaoling said laughing heartily.
The group responded half-heartedly with nods, acknowledging her, but not very warmly. After all, Jia Xiaoling was so ordinary with nothing worth their time.
Better to spend time buttering up Liu Qiang; if Liu Qiang would help introduce some business, that’d be better.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 What Car Does Lin Fan Drive
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Chapter 607 What Car Does Lin Fan Drive
We’re all adults here, all thinking about nothing but making money, always hoping for a good opportunity to earn.
Basically, the theme of a class reunion is all about business exchanges, secret comparisons, and those who are doing well naturally become the stars and the center of attention.
Jia Xiaoling, however, is not bothered by such things. She finished high school, then worked for two years without ever doing business, got married and had children soon after, and has been a stay-at-home mom since then. You could say she’s out of touch with these classmates.
"Oh right, Lin Fan is also coming, he’s driving a small car, still stuck in traffic back there," Jia Xiaoling said.
Driving a small car!
These three words immediately drew the classmates’ attention.
"Lin Fan is coming too? It’s been so long since we’ve had news of him!"
"Where is Lin Fan working now? Seems a bit mysterious!"
"I don’t know either, but I want to know what car he’s driving!"
"Driving a small car, it sounds like Lin Fan is doing quite well!"
The classmates all looked expectant. Generally speaking, the car you drive determines your status. Driving a luxury car usually means you’re rich, successful at least.
Just like Liu Qiang, who drives a BMW, making everyone envious and giving him a ton of face.
So when they heard Lin Fan was driving a small car, everyone was a bit eager but unsure about Lin Fan’s status, because small cars come in many types—both luxury and regular ones are called small cars.
Imagine if Lin Fan drove a luxury car, like if he brought his Rolls-Royce Cullinan, how interesting the scene would be. His classmates might just kneel and fawn over him.
Their attitude toward Lin Fan would depend on what car he drives. That’s reality for you.
Liu Qiang couldn’t figure out Lin Fan’s situation at the moment, adopting a cautious mindset and feeling a bit anxious. If Lin Fan turned out to be doing better than him, wouldn’t his limelight get stolen?
"Little Ling, what car does Lin Fan drive?" Liu Qiang couldn’t help but ask.
Jia Xiaoling shook her head, smiled, and said, "How would I know anything about cars?"
"Alright then." Liu Qiang said with a sweat, it seems they’d have to wait until Lin Fan showed up to find out. If Lin Fan really was doing better than him, he’d just have to accept it.
Because the road to the school was indeed jammed, Lin Fan hadn’t arrived yet.
Lin Fan’s rented car was stuck among Audis and Mercedes-Benzes, looking shabbier in comparison. Even the ordinary Volkswagen and Honda next to it appeared much superior compared to Lin Fan’s worn car.
In one of the Audis, a young man sat in the driver’s seat, looked out the window, saw Lin Fan’s car, and couldn’t help but laugh.
"Sis, look, someone actually drove a Xia Li to the school celebration, and such a rundown Xia Li at that, probably not even worth ten thousand yuan," the young man sneered.
His tone was full of ridicule for the Xia Li owner.
He even wanted to see who this Xia Li car owner was, it was so embarrassing.
In the back seat of this Audi, a young woman wearing formal attire sat. Though not a stunning beauty, she was quite striking, easily a seven out of ten.
Hearing the young man say this, the young woman couldn’t help but look over too, seeing the Xia Li next to them, and she also showed a slight smile.
Indeed, today is the centennial celebration, arriving in such a car certainly can’t be said as having face.
Suddenly, the young woman caught a glimpse of Lin Fan sitting in the driver’s seat of the Xia Li, and she was a bit stunned as if she recognized Lin Fan, though she couldn’t confirm it right away.
"Who is it? Seems like someone I know?" The young woman frowned but didn’t think much more about it.
Elsewhere, in a Volkswagen.
The man driving had felt a bit embarrassed, seeing so many luxury cars around, his face even turned red.
Others are driving Mercedes, BMWs, Audis, worth several hundred thousand to millions; his less-than-hundred-thousand Volkswagen felt so embarrassing. Had he known, he wouldn’t have come to this school celebration at all.
Until...
The man caught sight of Lin Fan’s Xia Li, and he almost laughed out loud, suddenly gaining confidence.
No worries, someone is poorer than him! Someone is more embarrassing than him! Look, there’s someone driving a Xia Li right there!
The Everyday Man instantly regained his confidence, feeling a surge of superiority over Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was unaware of all these thoughts.
If he wanted to, he could drive the world’s most expensive luxury car. However, he himself was rather low-key; firstly, secondly, he wasn’t even really here for the school celebration, just ran into Jia Xiaoling midway and decided to join them casually, without any special preparation.
So, wearing rustic village clothes and driving a rented Xia Li, he blended in just like that.
Of course, even if Lin Fan knew he was being laughed at, he wouldn’t care. If he cared about what others thought, he wouldn’t be who he is today.
Some people are very concerned about face, subscribing to the idea that a person needs dignity just like a tree needs its bark. Even if they have no money in their pocket, they’ll dress themselves up to look good, just to keep up appearances, like those so-called "socialites," who are essentially poor but rely on group purchases to rent a room in a high-end hotel for a photo shoot to satisfy their vanity.
But one must admit, for most people, packaging oneself is quite important. Knowing how to package oneself is also a business strategy.
Take those so-called socialites, who are originally just ordinary people. By creating the illusion of being a "socialite," their value goes up, and they can fetch a good price, for instance, deceiving a Rich Second Generation. Ultimately, it’s all about money!
However, true wealthy people are quite the opposite. Many genuinely rich people don’t really care about clothing or appearances because they don’t need these things to find confidence.
They live like those legendary sweeping monks, appearing unremarkable, but when their true identity is discovered accidentally, it causes a sensation.
Lin Fan is exactly like that. You could say Lin Fan’s Realm is at the level of a sweeping monk.
A trillionaire extraordinaire owning a group with a market value of 200 billion, with cash reserves in the billions!
He’s dressed in thrift store clothes and drives a Xia Li.
Does he care about others’ gazes?
Rather, those who mock him are the real clowns.
"He’s here, he’s here!"
Lin Fan’s car finally arrived at the school gate.
Jia Xiaoling spotted it and immediately exclaimed happily, pointing towards Lin Fan’s car.
The classmates looked over, there were several cars there, including Audis and Mercedes, which one was Lin Fan?
Liu Qiang’s face changed, could it be that Lin Fan was driving an Audi or a Mercedes? Did that guy really succeed and do better than him?
"Which car is Lin Fan’s?"
"Could it be that Audi?"
"Oh my God, no way, Lin Fan is driving an Audi; this guy’s doing quite well!"
The classmates speculated and guessed, since Jia Xiaoling’s point was vague, pointing at a bunch of cars, and people naturally guessed towards the impressive ones.
Liu Qiang couldn’t take it anymore and said, "Little Ling, which car exactly is Lin Fan’s?"
Jia Xiaoling said, "The black one, the slightly old one, you know, the one with Xia Li written on the front."
What?
Everyone’s gaze focused on Lin Fan’s Xia Li, and they all were stunned. What the hell! Lin Fan drove a Xia Li?
Holy crap!
The car Lin Fan drove was such an old and shabby Xia Li?

chapters.title: Chapter 608: You Take Your Seat
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Chapter 608: You Take Your Seat
Lin Fan found a parking spot, parked the rented Xia Li, and got out of the car.
Coincidentally, an Audi A8 parked next door, and a young man and woman got out of the car.
The young man immediately noticed Lin Fan, who was dressed in shabby clothes, getting out of the Xia Li.
The young man instantly showed a disdainful expression: "As expected, just a poor loser. Look at that outfit, probably just came straight from the fields, right? Really lowering the standard of this school celebration. If it were me, I’d be too embarrassed to come. Why bother when you’re not even invited!"
As the young man spoke, he eyed Lin Fan contemptuously, making it clear that these words were directed at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan made a gesture as if swatting a fly and chuckled, "Why is there a fly buzzing around as soon as I get out? What a big fly!"
The young man heard this, realizing Lin Fan was clearly referring to him, calling him a mere noisy fly.
This country bumpkin actually dared to talk back!
The young man was instantly annoyed, his face darkened, and he scolded, "Hillbilly, what did you say?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I said there’s a fly buzzing. Are you identifying yourself with that?"
"You! Filthy bumpkin, believe it or not, I’ll beat you to death!" the young man threatened, making a move as if to charge at Lin Fan.
"Xiao Ming, don’t mess around. We’re here for the school celebration, keep out of trouble. Let’s go!" the young woman suddenly spoke up, stopping the young man.
Lin Fan’s gaze fell on the young woman’s face, slightly stunned. Although she looked a bit different from before, Lin Fan recognized her at a glance.
Lai Xiaomei!
She was the dream goddess of countless men from middle school through high school, Lai Xiaomei!
The old Lai Xiaomei was not only pure and cute but also a top student, truly outstanding.
Lin Fan also couldn’t help having a crush on Lai Xiaomei back then. Because of this, Lin Fan had a deep impression of her and could still recognize her instantly to this day.
Just like Chen Xinxing had said, Lai Xiaomei looks even better now, whether she’s grown into her looks or has used one of Asia’s four notorious practices: plastic surgery. Lai Xiaomei’s face has become sharper, and with the professional attire, she seems less naive and more like a competent career woman.
However, Lai Xiaomei obviously didn’t recognize Lin Fan. Even though Lin Fan felt a sense of familiarity to her, it only ended with a familiar face, and eventually, she didn’t recall Lin Fan’s name.
The young man pointed at Lin Fan and said, "If my sister didn’t stop me, I’d have knocked you down on the spot!"
How could Lin Fan be afraid of a pretentious young man? This young man seemed to be Lai Xiaomei’s brother, but even so, Lin Fan didn’t plan to give face.
"You can try, but I’m afraid you won’t knock me down, instead, like swatting a fly, I’d swat you dead." Lin Fan smiled.
"You!" The young man was furious. He never expected that this filthy bumpkin could be tougher than him, which really pissed him off, but due to his sister, he didn’t dare to act rashly.
"Filthy bumpkin, just you wait, this isn’t over!" the young man threatened, then left with Lai Xiaomei.
Lai Xiaomei only glanced at Lin Fan without looking again. Although Lin Fan felt familiar to her, she obviously wasn’t intending to recognize him. After all, from his shabby attire, Lin Fan was clearly a poor loser, not worth her time.
Lai Xiaomei didn’t take the initiative to recognize him, and Lin Fan also acted as if he hadn’t recognized her, smiled, and prepared to walk away.
There are only two possibilities for Lai Xiaomei not to recognize him: either she doesn’t recognize him anymore, or she recognizes him but pretends not to.
No matter which it is, Lin Fan sees no need to take the initiative. If it’s the first, she doesn’t recognize him anymore, indicating he’s just a forgotten past to her, so what’s the point in recognizing? If it’s the second, she’s pretending not to recognize him, then there’s even less reason to, as Lin Fan won’t put a warm face to a cold reception.
"Ah, look, it’s Lai Xiaomei!"
"I heard she’s invited by the school as an outstanding alumnus this time."
"She was truly exceptional, a top student during school, and now she’s made something of herself!"
"Really envious, she’s what they call the golden girl!"
Lai Xiaomei’s appearance immediately drew attention from around, and people started looking over, gossiping, all praising Lai Xiaomei.
A middle-aged man in a suit approached Lai Xiaomei respectfully with a smile, "Hello Miss Lai, I’m the guest reception manager. Welcome to the centenary celebration. Please follow me."
Lai Xiaomei and the young man then followed the middle-aged man into the school.
Distinguished guests indeed receive special reception and hospitality.
The young man felt proud, glanced at everyone with superiority, even his walking carried an air of confidence.
Lin Fan, paying no more attention to Lai Xiaomei at this point, turned his head, saw Jia Xiaoling, and walked towards a group of old classmates.
"Hello everyone." Lin Fan greeted with a smile. Although many years had passed, with a glance, Lin Fan still recognized quite a few people, though some seemed familiar, but he couldn’t remember their names.
Seeing Lin Fan approaching, these classmates all showed somewhat awkward expressions. Since they found out that Lin Fan drove a Xia Li, they had lost enthusiasm for him, even reluctant to greet him.
After all, Lin Fan was driving a Xia Li and wearing such clothes, clearly a poor loser.
A poor loser couldn’t bring them any benefits, so naturally, they lacked enthusiasm.
"Haha, Lin Fan, it’s been a while, remember me? I’m Liu Qiang!"
However, it was Liu Qiang who showed a different enthusiasm, smiling as he spoke.
Among everyone, upon learning that Lin Fan arrived by car, the most anxious was Liu Qiang. He was worried Lin Fan would steal his spotlight.
Seeing that Lin Fan drove a Xia Li, Liu Qiang was relieved, instantly regained his confidence, and secretly rejoiced.
Knowing Lin Fan was doing worse than him, he felt at ease.
Lin Fan smiled, "Brother Qiang, how could I not recognize you."
"Lin Fan, nice car!" Liu Qiang smiled, patting Lin Fan on the shoulder.
Usually, unless one feels superior, they wouldn’t make this gesture.
Lin Fan said, "It’s rented."
Hearing this, everyone was stunned for a moment, some wanted to laugh, feeling that Lin Fan was poorer than they thought, not even owning a car, and still needing to rent such a shabby one!
Some people thought Lin Fan was lying because the car was too shabby, afraid of embarrassment, so he claimed it was rented!
But regardless of the case, driving such a shabby Xia Li was embarrassing enough.
Liu Qiang was in the latter camp, thinking Lin Fan was just saving face, unwilling to admit all he could afford was this broken car, hence deceiving everyone by saying it was rented.

chapters.title: Chapter 609: BMWs Are Indeed Not Good Cars
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Chapter 609: BMWs Are Indeed Not Good Cars
Liu Qiang put on a look of keeping things to himself and laughed, "Renting a car is great, it’s convenient! You just spend a little money and there’s a car for you without having to worry about maintenance. Unlike me, you see, buying this BMW costs me thousands each month just for maintenance. It’s a pain."
Liu Qiang intentionally spoke in reverse to boast about his BMW.
This guy is almost about to have the words "show off wealth" engraved on his forehead. How could Lin Fan not understand?
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Is that so? Then why don’t you sell it and rent a car instead."
Liu Qiang wanted Lin Fan to admire him, but Lin Fan didn’t go along with it.
Liu Qiang was immediately a little displeased, sneering inside, thinking Lin Fan, this dead broke guy, must be jealous of him driving a BMW!
"Selling it? That’s not going to happen. After all, I bought it, a brand new, fresh-off-the-lot car, costing over 500,000, all paid at once. It’s pricey, a bit regretful now. But if I sell it, it wouldn’t be worth much, I’d lose big, so I can only keep driving it myself." Liu Qiang sighed, continuing to boast.
Over 500,000, paid all at once!
This was the focus of Liu Qiang’s words.
Everyone heard this and showed expressions of amazement, exclaiming how wealthy Liu Qiang must be to pull out over 500,000 at once to buy a car. Amazing!
Seeing such reactions from everyone, Liu Qiang was very satisfied, feeling his sense of superiority fulfilled.
However...
Lin Fan chuckled, "A BMW for over 500,000, well, that’s not expensive and can’t be considered a good car."
The car he drives, a 70 million Kosak and an 8 million Rolls-Royce Cullinan, those are the real good cars, truly fitting the name of luxury cars. A BMW for over 500,000 is really just a junior.
Lin Fan’s words weren’t wrong at all, and he had the qualification to say that. For someone like him, a trillionaire, to not fancy a car worth 500,000 is such a normal thing!
However, his words shocked everyone.
What the hell!
Lin Fan said what? With this attitude, this dead broke guy doesn’t even think much of a BMW over 500,000?
Liu Qiang almost didn’t have his nose twisted in anger. His intention was to have Lin Fan compliment and flatter him. Lin Fan didn’t flatter him, let alone, but instead looked down on it?
What kind of move is this, who gave this dead broke guy the courage!
"Haha, indeed, it’s not good. Even Brother Fan doesn’t think much of it, but Xia Li is better." Liu Qiang said mockingly.
Upon hearing this, everyone chuckled, Liu Qiang really nailed it with the sarcasm, perfect score for snark. Exactly, what qualification does Lin Fan have, someone who drives a Xia Li, to look down on a BMW?
Lin Fan smiled, "I don’t know if Xia Li is good or not, this car is rented, I’ve only driven it twice."
Liu Qiang chuckled, "Yeah, rented."
He emphasized the tone, mocking Lin Fan for lying, unwilling to admit he’s driving a broken car.
Everyone started to snicker secretly.
The atmosphere on site became somewhat awkward.
Jia Xiaoling then said, "Don’t just keep chatting about cars, I can’t understand you guys, why do you like talking about cars so much? The school celebration is about to start, let’s go in quickly."
Jia Xiaoling’s words ended the contest between Lin Fan and Liu Qiang.
It seemed this round, Liu Qiang won, after all, he’s driving a BMW, Lin Fan’s driving a Xia Li. Liu Qiang was being praised and surrounded by everyone as they entered the school gate.
No one was willing to come over and cozy up to Lin Fan, this dead broke guy is poor enough, let alone he doesn’t know how to act, daring to go against Brother Qiang. Not flattering Brother Qiang would be one thing, but to even dare to look down on a BMW, does he have the qualification, truly doesn’t know how to act.
Lin Fan watched all of this, finding it amusing internally. He had a reason for not liking school reunions, these kind of reunions were full of comparison and flattery, the bond among classmates seemed like nothing but a joke.
Riiing... Riiing...
Lin Fan’s phone rang at this moment. Lin Fan looked, it was a call from the rental car company, so he answered it.
"Mr. Lin, your rental time is almost up, would you like to renew? If not, please return the car promptly." The other side said.
Lin Fan said, "I won’t renew, but I’m also not free to return the car now, how about you bring my car over and swap it, I’ll tip you."
"Alright, Mr. Lin." The other side agreed.
Lin Fan then hung up the phone.
Jia Xiaoling came over at this moment, saying, "Lin Fan, sorry, if I had known they were like this, I wouldn’t have asked you to come along."
Jia Xiaoling wasn’t a fool, how could she not see that these classmates looked down on Lin Fan because the car he drove didn’t seem great.
Indeed, Jia Xiaoling, though she didn’t understand cars, had heard of BMW being a luxury car, while Lin Fan’s brand she hadn’t heard of, certainly not as good as a BMW.
Lin Fan smiled, among all these classmates, the only one not shallow was Jia Xiaoling.
Though Lin Fan didn’t have romantic feelings for Jia Xiaoling, he did have a liking for her, she was truly a high school buddy.
"It’s okay, I came because of you." Lin Fan smiled.
Jia Xiaoling was stunned, Lin Fan’s words could easily be misunderstood. She was already married and had children, it was impossible with Lin Fan...
The group of classmates entered the school.
The school was quite lively at this moment, with the centennial celebration going quite grandly. Apart from current students, there were past students invited to come, and also some celebrities from various social circles invited to join.
Additionally, there were past students who came on their own, so the school was bustling for a while.
The school’s publicity was to welcome past students to participate in the centennial celebration. Although they weren’t independently invited by the school, as long as they were past students, they could attend.
Because of this, Lin Fan and the others were able to enter the school without obstruction.
However, past students who came by themselves were not given any hospitality, they had to find a place themselves and move freely.
The centennial celebration was held at the soccer field, and the spots set up on site were for current students and invited guests. Past students who came on their own could only stand on the outskirts, acting as spectators.
There was no choice, while the school claimed to welcome past students, from the school’s perspective, those not invited were not important.
People who are not important naturally do not receive high-level treatment.
The centennial celebration was about to start soon; students were already entering, and school leaders were accompanying the invited guests to their seats.
Past students who could only act as spectators envied those invited to sit among the honored guests.
Those people have really succeeded, by comparison, those people are successful individuals, while they are failures. To the school, these failures are just passing clouds.
Lin Fan mingled with the past students watching, but unlike those around him who were filled with envy looking inside, Lin Fan wasn’t envious of those successful individuals at all.
If it weren’t for bumping into Jia Xiaoling on the way, he probably wouldn’t have come to join in the fun.
Now, he was merely here to catch up with classmates a bit, but based on the meeting just now, this catch-up didn’t seem meaningful anymore.
"Lin Fan, isn’t that Lai Xiaomei? I’ve heard you were in the same middle school, well, she’s amazing, sitting in the guest seats, while you..."
Liu Qiang, standing nearby, said mockingly, seemingly still holding a grudge from earlier.
The classmates hearing this all started to snicker, indeed, compared to Lai Xiaomei, Lin Fan really paled in comparison.

chapters.title: Chapter 610: Working at a Company Worth 200 Billion
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Chapter 610: Working at a Company Worth 200 Billion
Lin Fan and Lai Xiaomei indeed went to the same middle school, and they even shared the same class. Back then, Lai Xiaomei was a top student, and Lin Fan wasn’t too bad either. Later, they both got into Tianhai High School.
However, once they were in high school, the two of them were no longer in the same class. Lai Xiaomei continued to be an outstanding student and became a school celebrity. Lin Fan, on the other hand, had average grades, and coupled with his low-key personality, he didn’t stand out.
Back in middle school, Lin Fan’s academic performance was at one point even better than Lai Xiaomei’s. In the final exam of the first year, Lin Fan ranked first in the grade, and even at that time, Lai Xiaomei saw Lin Fan as a target to chase.
But later, for some unknown reason, Lin Fan’s grades plummeted, and Lai Xiaomei surpassed him, gradually becoming the top student. Since then, Lai Xiaomei never looked at Lin Fan with the same regard.
Looking at their current situations, the difference is indeed striking.
Lai Xiaomei has had a smooth journey through life, was a top student as a student, then worked in a big company after graduation, and after earning money, she started her own company, becoming a boss. It is said her assets have reached over 100 million, making her a special guest at the school reunion.
On the other hand, Lin Fan, dressing shabbily, can only squeeze around the outskirts of the venue as a bystander.
Comparing the two who came from the same middle school, it is indeed quite discouraging.
Liu Qiang seized this and sarcastically ridiculed Lin Fan; the nearby classmates heard it and snickered.
Liu Qiang’s words were practically a critical hit, surely damaging Lin Fan’s spirit.
However...
Lin Fan did not feel any blow; he smiled faintly and said, "Lai Xiaomei is indeed excellent, that’s a fact. But Brother Qiang, aren’t you standing here with me? Why aren’t you in the guest seats, Brother Qiang?"
Liu Qiang was immediately caught off guard; if Lin Fan was not good, then since they were both watching from the outskirts, it meant he was not good either!
Lin Fan’s point was that if Liu Qiang insulted him, it was like insulting himself because they were both in the same situation outside.
Liu Qiang’s face turned red with excitement and he said angrily, "Who’s like you. The alumni who were invited are the cream of the crop, but not being invited doesn’t mean we’re all bad. At least the gap between you and me is obvious. Don’t even think about comparing with Lai Xiaomei, can you even compare with me, Lin Fan?"
Everyone laughed.
"Of course, you can’t compare! Brother Qiang drives a BMW, and Lin Fan drives a Xia Li!"
"Even though Brother Qiang wasn’t invited, he’s still outstanding, not disgracing the school!"
"Look at Lin Fan; he’s simply disgracing the school!"
The crowd chimed in, all with mocking implications.
Liu Qiang became complacent and chuckled coldly, "Lin Fan, say no more, I’m a supervisor in a factory with 50 million assets, with an annual salary of 300,000, plus year-end bonuses and benefits. What are you doing right now? Don’t tell me you’re working in a small company as a corporate slave, earning a dead salary of four or five thousand, unable to buy a house or a good car for a lifetime!"
Lin Fan replied, "Comparing with you is sort of bullying. I’m currently working in a company valued at 200 billion."
Everyone was stunned, 200 billion?
This number is astronomical to them, is Lin Fan that impressive, having joined such a large company?
Liu Qiang was also stunned for a moment, then laughed, "I get it, Lin Fan, you’re joking around! Just like that internet joke, riding a 10 million car to work every day, but in fact taking the subway. You’re working at a 200 billion company? Doing what, being a security guard?"
"Haha..."
Everyone laughed.
"By that logic, I even have business dealings with the biggest telecom group, Mobile!"
"Er, Pinduoduo is my supplier!"
"Huaxia Bank is my loyal partner!"
"Hahaha..."
Everyone was riffing on jokes, laughing together, and what they were saying was all mocking Lin Fan for pretending.
Liu Qiang chuckled, "Lin Fan, stop pretending, let me guess, which 200 billion group in Huaxia, ah, right, there’s a delivery company that seems to have a 200 billion valuation, you’re not working there, delivering food, are you?"
Lin Fan smiled, "I have indeed delivered food, but..."
Liu Qiang interrupted Lin Fan, bursting into laughter, "Delivering food! You’re really delivering food, oh my, didn’t you get into college, graduating and then delivering food, you’re killing me with laughter!"
Oh!
It turns out working at a 200 billion company means delivering food, really makes one die of laughter.
Everyone laughed back and forth, as if in their eyes, Lin Fan was a clown to make people laugh.
Jia Xiaoling couldn’t stand seeing them stepping on Lin Fan like this.
"Alright, that’s enough! We’re all classmates, it’s rare to gather, why act like this! Is this fun for you!" Jia Xiaoling said angrily.
Only then did everyone gradually hold back their laughter.
Jia Xiaoling was still upset, "Even if Lin Fan isn’t doing as well, so what, he didn’t spend your money nor did he offend you. Being classmates, why focus so much on the rich or the poor, can’t you be less materialistic!"
Jia Xiaoling has always had a good temperament, always with a smile, treating people kindly and warmly, she rarely got this angry, in everyone’s memory, it was also rare to see her this upset.
For a moment, everyone quieted down, looking slightly embarrassed.
But Liu Qiang chuckled, "Little Ling, what’s this, standing up for Lin Fan, feeling bad for him? No way, you’re married now, could it be..."
Jia Xiaoling’s face immediately flushed, "Stop talking nonsense!"
Liu Qiang said, "Where did I talk nonsense, don’t think I don’t know, in high school you confessed to Lin Fan and got rejected, didn’t you?"
"Wow!"
Everyone had a gossip-eating expression.
Jia Xiaoling was blushing red, didn’t expect that standing up for Lin Fan for a few words would bring fire upon herself, with Liu Qiang starting to expose her old secrets.
This was her most unwilling-to-mention past.
During high school, she sat next to Lin Fan’s desk. Generally speaking, classmates sitting close tend to have a better relationship, and she and Lin Fan were the same, often chatting and joking, just like best buddies.
The feelings Jia Xiaoling had for Lin Fan were not just ordinary friendship, in Jia Xiaoling’s eyes, Lin Fan was very capable and handsome, she admired Lin Fan.
Finally, one day, Jia Xiaoling gathered the courage to confess to Lin Fan.
But she was rejected by Lin Fan!
Jia Xiaoling was heartbroken for a long time, but eventually came to terms, feeling it was she who wasn’t worthy of Lin Fan.
Later, Jia Xiaoling didn’t get into college, worked for two years, and she gradually moved past her unrequited love, got married and had children. When she got married, she didn’t invite Lin Fan, just wanting to put the past behind.
However, in the quiet of the night, she would still occasionally think of this man... her heart would still race.
In her eyes, Lin Fan was always that person she admired, she just doesn’t want to recall him, fearing she would be tempted...

chapters.title: Chapter 611 Almost Done
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Chapter 611 Almost Done
Today, I ran into Lin Fan by chance. She was very happy and invited him to attend the school reunion together, originally just for a nostalgic gathering.
Unexpectedly, it ended up with Lin Fan being humiliated. Lin Fan indeed didn’t seem to be doing well, but so what? We are all classmates, why look down on a classmate who isn’t doing well!
"That’s right, I did confess to Lin Fan before, so what? Liu Qiang, do you think this is interesting!" Little Ling said irritably.
Liu Qiang laughed and said, "Of course it’s interesting. Lin Fan, I see you don’t have a girlfriend now, right? After all, who would date a delivery guy? You should have agreed to Jia Xiaoling back then. I think you two are a good match, both equally poor, hahaha..."
"Hahaha..."
Everyone burst into laughter.
Little Ling was so angry that she trembled. She tried to stick up for Lin Fan, but Liu Qiang mocked her as well.
What made her angry was that Liu Qiang went too far in bullying people.
Then, she felt a wave of sadness. Lin Fan was once someone she admired. Who would have thought that many years later, they would meet again and Lin Fan would be humiliated by someone like Liu Qiang.
Liu Qiang said, "Lin Fan, why aren’t you saying anything? Out of words, aren’t you? Tsk, really boring!"
Liu Qiang’s face was full of disdain.
Lin Fan was silent at this moment, seemingly having nothing to say.
In fact, he was reminded of the time Jia Xiaoling confessed to him, and he felt a bit complicated.
Back then, Jia Xiaoling confessed to him, and he indeed turned her down because he always saw Jia Xiaoling as a fun classmate, just like a close male friend, but there was never a hint of romantic feelings.
To be honest, Jia Xiaoling wasn’t his type. It was that simple. He and Jia Xiaoling could be good friends, but not lovers.
After rejecting Jia Xiaoling, he was afraid she might feel sad, so he intentionally distanced himself from her. After graduation, they hardly had any chance to meet again. He thought Jia Xiaoling should have moved on from him.
Even though Jia Xiaoling didn’t invite him to her wedding, when he heard about it, he was quite happy. Jia Xiaoling getting married meant she probably let go of him, which was a good thing.
Now, the matter between him and Jia Xiaoling was brought up by Liu Qiang for ridicule!
Lin Fan’s heart sank, and he felt a bit angry.
Liu Qiang was like a clown, and it was fine if he mocked him, but bringing up this matter could hurt Jia Xiaoling!
This was something he didn’t want to see.
"Liu Qiang, that’s enough. All you want is to show off that you’re doing better than me. There’s no need to drag Little Ling into this," Lin Fan said coldly.
Liu Qiang chuckled, "See, you two are defending each other. I wasn’t wrong, was I? You two make a good pair! But unfortunately, Lin Fan, Little Ling is married with kids now, and you can’t even have her!"
Once again, everyone laughed.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Come on, Liu Qiang, stop trying to get a sense of superiority in front of me. Do you really think people don’t know what kind of person you are? With an annual salary of 300,000 and driving a BMW, you think you’re a successful person? You’re like a frog at the bottom of a well. If it weren’t for your cousin, you wouldn’t even be able to get a job as a delivery guy, and who knows which street you’d be wandering on."
Liu Qiang sneered and said, "So what if I rely on my cousin? I’m just lucky, and you can’t envy that!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Lucky, huh? What if your cousin fires you?"
Liu Qiang laughed coldly and said, "What are you talking about? How could my cousin possibly fire me!"
Lin Fan said, "Oh really? Well, you know that yourself then."
Lin Fan was just saying it casually, but if he wanted Liu Qiang’s cousin to fire him, it wouldn’t be hard.
Liu Qiang seemed a little uneasy, snorted, and said, "I’m too lazy to waste words with someone like you!"
After saying this, Liu Qiang stopped engaging with Lin Fan.
This farce seemed to have finally been resolved.
Little Ling came over to Lin Fan with an apology and said, "Lin Fan, I’m sorry, if I had known it would turn out like this, I wouldn’t have asked you to come along."
She truly regretted inviting Lin Fan to attend the school reunion. She hadn’t expected that Lin Fan, due to not doing well, would be humiliated by former classmates. Had she known this, she would rather not have run into Lin Fan today than witness such a scene.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s fine, just a small scene, nothing to worry about."
Because Lin Fan dressed simply, he often encountered this kind of mockery. This was indeed a small scene for him.
Little Ling said, "Lin Fan, why don’t we leave? I’m in no mood for this school reunion anyway. We weren’t officially invited, so no one would care if we left."
But Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Don’t rush, since we’re here, let’s enjoy the show before leaving."
Lin Fan could have left right away. Something like this wasn’t significant for him, but since Liu Qiang just hurt Jia Xiaoling, he wanted to stay a little longer.
While they were talking, the place suddenly became lively; the school reunion was about to begin.
The principal, accompanied by a group of school leaders, arrived at the scene.
He immediately became the center of attention.
The principal came over and first interacted with the students who were observing from the periphery.
"Principal!"
The students greeted warmly.
