This principal was already over sixty, having served as principal at Tianhai Middle School for more than twenty years. He was also the principal when Lin Fan and the others were studying. His surname was Zhao, and he was a respected principal with wide connections.
The students showed respect when they saw the old principal, greeting him one after another.
Principal Zhao seemed very kind and friendly, smiling and greeting everyone: "Hello everyone, all of you present should be former students of Tianhai Middle School, right?"
Everyone said, "Yes!"
Principal Zhao, with a kind smile, said, "Hello students, looking around, there are several of you whose faces seem familiar to me!"
The students laughed.
Principal Zhao continued, "Thank you all very much for coming back to take part in the centennial celebration. I represent all the teachers and students in welcoming you. You are all students of Tianhai Middle School, and you all seem full of energy, so I assume you’re all doing well. That gives me, as the principal, peace of mind."
"I see quite a few students dressed very well, must be successful individuals. What’s your name, student?"
Principal Zhao’s gaze fell on Liu Qiang.
Liu Qiang was somewhat flattered and said, "Principal, my name is Liu Qiang, a student from the class of ’15. Now I’m a supervisor at a factory. The factory isn’t too big, just about 50 million, my annual salary is 300,000, and I just bought a BMW with full payment, it’s nothing."
Liu Qiang was eager to brag about himself, but still pretended it was no big deal.
Principal Zhao nodded non-stop, "Not bad, not bad, really good, you’re an outstanding graduate."
Liu Qiang’s words drew the attention of those around.
Hearing that Liu Qiang drove a BMW with a 300,000 annual salary attracted quite a few people’s attention and envy.
"Eh, and what about this student!"
Suddenly, a leader next to the principal looked at Lin Fan.
Immediately, all eyes turned to Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 612: The Principal’s Embarrassment
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Chapter 612: The Principal’s Embarrassment
Principal Zhao passed by the gathered alumni, intending to show his friendliness and approachability, and stopped to interact briefly with the crowd.
He singled out Liu Qiang, the best-dressed among them, and inquired about his current situation.
Liu Qiang bragged about himself, saying he was a supervisor in a factory with an annual salary of 300,000 yuan, had just bought a BMW, and couldn’t help but embellish his accomplishments.
Principal Zhao expressed satisfaction, noting that for ordinary people, someone like Liu Qiang was doing quite well and hadn’t embarrassed the school.
Following that, Principal Zhao asked a few others nearby.
"Principal, I’m currently a teacher, educating people just like you are."
"I’m in sales at a Fortune 500 company, earning an annual salary of a hundred thousand."
"I’m now running a business and recently bought a house in Tianhai thanks to my own efforts."
Everyone chimed in.
Principal Zhao nodded with a smile, "All very good, it’s great to see each of you succeeding, which makes me very pleased as a former principal."
Next to him, someone who seemed like a leader noticed Lin Fan and asked, "Is this young man also an alumnus of the school?"
Immediately, everyone’s eyes fell on Lin Fan.
Wearing entirely unfashionable street stall clothes!
It was obvious he hadn’t done well. If he were also an alumnus, it wouldn’t be bringing honour to the school, but embarrassment.
Lin Fan hadn’t even spoken yet when Liu Qiang jumped in, saying, "His name is Lin Fan, he was in our class in high school, got into a university, and now delivers food."
What?
Graduated from university and delivering food?
The crowd was initially stunned and then burst into laughter. Damn, this Lin Fan was so disgraceful, completely tarnishing the school’s reputation.
"Delivering food, doing so poorly, why come to the centennial celebration!"
"Truly a disgrace to Tianhai Middle School!"
"I wouldn’t dare show my face here!"
"A university graduate, why deliver food, can’t understand, aren’t you ashamed!"
The crowd murmured, and everyone could hear these words clearly.
"Old Zhao, it seems your Tianhai High School can’t always produce talents."
The man who had just mocked Lin Fan spoke with a teasing tone.
Turns out, he was the principal of a neighboring school and a friend of Principal Zhao. He was invited here to participate in Tianhai High School’s centennial celebration, and he was deliberately using Lin Fan to mock Principal Zhao.
Principal Zhao’s face turned a bit red with embarrassment, showing slight displeasure, but since he was experienced in social dealings, he quickly adjusted himself.
"Delivering food is still earning money through labor, and labor is honorable, nothing to be ashamed of!" Principal Zhao laughed.
The neighboring principal said, "Old Zhao, I don’t agree with that. Anyone can deliver food as long as they know the way. Why go through years of hard study and spend so much of parents’ money on university? Such a waste!"
Principal Zhao was left a bit speechless, all blaming Lin Fan for doing so poorly, yet attending the celebration, allowing the neighboring principal to have a laugh at his expense.
"Lin Fan, aren’t you delivering food today? Won’t attending the celebration affect your work?"
Principal Zhao patted Lin Fan on the shoulder, although it seemed like he was showing concern, everyone could hear the implied meaning.
It was a suggestion for Lin Fan to leave.
Lin Fan laughed coldly to himself, they were such snobs, even Principal Zhao included.
So what if he was doing poorly? What was wrong with delivering food after graduating from university? Everyone’s circumstances are different. If you haven’t endured his hardships, you’re not qualified to judge.
Back then, after graduation, Lin Fan also worked in a company. However, he encountered backstabbers, was dismissed, and became disheartened. He detested office politics and realized that the white-collar job market was not for him, finding more freedom as a delivery person.
His fellow delivery guys got along happily, with each doing their own runs and no conflicts of interest. There was no competition, speeding along the roads alone each day, chatting and boasting with buddies in group chats during free time, living freely and happily.
This kind of happiness, how could outsiders understand, and how could they pass judgement?
Now, although Principal Zhao didn’t say it outright, he looked down on Lin Fan’s status as a delivery person and subtly hinted for him to leave.
But Lin Fan wasn’t going to comply.
"I’m currently free at home, with plenty of time. By chance, I was passing by the school and came to take a look, reminisce on my high school days, Principal Zhao, you don’t mind, right?" Lin Fan said with a smile.
Could Principal Zhao say he minded!
Of course, he couldn’t say that.
Since Lin Fan wouldn’t leave, he couldn’t speak plainly either.
"I don’t mind, not at all, the school welcomes all alumni back for the celebration. So take your time and enjoy the event, it’s about to start. Classmates, we need to move ahead first, very glad everyone is here for the celebration. On behalf of the school, I thank you all once again."
After Principal Zhao’s appropriate remarks, he no longer looked at Lin Fan and left with a group of leaders behind him.
Principal Zhao slightly regretted the earlier casual interaction, mainly because of Lin Fan. If everyone was doing as well as Liu Qiang, it would be fine. But having someone like Lin Fan, working as a delivery person, it was too embarrassing.
If time could turn back, he certainly wouldn’t have come over to chat with these gathered alumni. The school chose some accomplished former students to specially invite to attend the celebration, aiming to show externally that Tianhai Middle School was excellent and had fostered many outstanding talents who have become pillars of the country, elites in various industries.
Yet, nearly having an incident due to someone like Lin Fan.
Lin Fan was just doing too poorly.
After Principal Zhao and others left.
Liu Qiang cast a smug glance at Lin Fan and said with a laugh, "Lin Fan, you’re welcome, I just introduced you and told the truth, since you’re a delivery guy, see how even the old principal got unhappy."
Hearing this, everyone laughed out loud.
Lin Fan didn’t speak, appearing to be ashamed and at a loss for words.
Jia Xiaoling tugged on Lin Fan’s sleeve and whispered, "Lin Fan, why don’t we leave?"
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Since we’re here, there’s no rush to leave. This celebration seems quite interesting, and I’m waiting for someone, might as well enjoy the spectacle."
Jia Xiaoling sighed softly. Since Lin Fan wouldn’t leave, she stayed with him, but seeing Lin Fan being the target of ridicule, she couldn’t bear it.
She really didn’t expect people to be so snobbish now. Whether it was Principal Zhao or those classmates, Jia Xiaoling felt a bit disappointed.
But this is the stark reality, after all. Reality is like this no matter where you go, it’s all about comparisons, and there’s no escaping it.
For instance, going home for the New Year, the elders will definitely catch you and ask where you’re working now, how much your salary is, and how so-and-so has bought a house or a car, or who is doing well.
These seem like eternal topics.
Those doing well return home with high spirits, almost walking with a breeze, eager for the whole village to know they’re doing great.
Those doing poorly act much more low-key, feeling a lack of face upon returning to the village, and many young people even avoid going home for the New Year for this reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 The Truth of Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Chapter 613 The Truth of Success
As Principal Zhao entered the venue, the guests and students were already seated, and the school celebration officially began.
First, Principal Zhao delivered a speech, recounting numerous glorious past events of Tianhai High School. After boasting for a long time, everyone felt a bit bored; it was too dull.
Finally, when Principal Zhao finished his speech, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Next, Principal Zhao began introducing the outstanding alumni present.
"Our Tianhai Middle School is dedicated to cultivating excellent talents. Every year, a large batch of outstanding individuals graduate from our school, with bright futures ahead, becoming the elites of various industries. As the principal of this school, I am very proud and honored! For this centennial celebration, we are fortunate to have invited many outstanding alumni back to attend. Now, let me introduce them to you. The reason for this introduction is to inspire the current students to work hard and strive forward, using these outstanding seniors as role models, and to become excellent talents themselves in the future!"
"Let me introduce the first one. How about this, I’ll call the alumni to come on stage, so the junior students can get to know them. What do you all think?" Principal Zhao said with a smile, looking very pleased, as this was his favorite segment. These outstanding alumni could greatly boost his prestige.
Among the guests present were many of his friends or important connections within his network. If the principal managed this well, it would be highly beneficial for the school.
Highlighting the excellence of a century-old institution could direct more resources to Tianhai High School, which would visibly benefit the faculty, students, and Principal Zhao’s own future.
Bringing in the outstanding alumni and praising them was undoubtedly a simple and effective method. These outstanding alumni were practically like living billboards.
"Great!"
Applause thundered from the students.
"Meng Xiaoming, a graduate of our school’s class of ’99, is currently the Vice President of Orange Airlines, with a net worth of over a hundred million. He is a very successful private entrepreneur, and for this school celebration, Little Ming is also the main sponsor! Let’s give a warm welcome to Little Ming!" Principal Zhao exclaimed.
Applause thundered again.
A pot-bellied, suit-clad middle-aged man walked on stage with a smile.
"Hello, students!" Meng Xiaoming waved, walking with confidence and an air of vitality. What could he do? To these junior students, he was nothing short of a godlike figure.
"Wow, that’s amazing, Vice President, assets over a hundred million, that’s incredible!"
"I wish I were as outstanding as him."
"Isn’t it? Assets over a hundred million; if only that money were mine."
The students wore expressions of awe, deeply impressed and highly admiring of Meng Xiaoming.
Meng Xiaoming was indeed a good role model.
Principal Zhao was very satisfied with the students’ reactions. This is how it should be; they should admire and learn from excellent individuals. As long as they succeeded in the future, the school would also benefit greatly, and he, as the principal, would feel proud and dignified!
Unlike Lin Fan, who fared poorly, making Principal Zhao lose face.
Thinking of Lin Fan, Principal Zhao felt a bit displeased. That Lin Fan, really ungrateful—doing so poorly, he shouldn’t even have come to the school celebration!
If the junior students found out they had a senior doing so poorly, graduating only to deliver takeout, it would really dampen morale.
Principal Zhao wished everyone could be as outstanding as Meng Xiaoming.
"Little Ming was a student brought up under my teaching. Back then, when I was still a teacher, I greatly admired Little Ming, predicting that he would achieve great things, and indeed he did. I’ll admit, Little Ming is a pride. Little Ming, come, say a few words to everyone!" Principal Zhao said with a smile.
Meng Xiaoming said, "Hello, students. Seeing your youthful faces reminds me of my high school days. I really miss it! Back in school, people called me a bookworm, but I didn’t mind. I worked very hard in my studies. Every day, apart from eating and sleeping, all I did was study. I believed reading could change my life. I came from a farming family with no better paths or anyone to rely on, so I could only change my fate through study. Fortunately, after graduating, I met some excellent partners who, along with my own efforts, helped me achieve some small successes. So, what I want to say is, students, never give up on working hard! Thank you, everyone!"
Applause thundered once more.
Principal Zhao said, "You all heard it, study hard and take Senior Brother Meng as a role model!"
The students immediately nodded, very earnestly agreeing with the sentiment.
Outside the scene.
Lin Fan looked at Meng Xiaoming, uttered a sound of surprise, and said, "I know this guy, and I know a bit about him."
Jia Xiaoling, beside him, curiously asked, "Lin Fan, you know him?"
Lin Fan replied, "It’s not exactly knowing him, more like just having heard about him occasionally."
Liu Qiang overheard this and disdainfully remarked, "Lin Fan, stop pretending. You, a delivery guy, knowing someone who’s a company VP? Give me a break."
The students laughed.
Lin Fan ignored Liu Qiang, turning to Jia Xiaoling, and said, "This person’s rise isn’t the result of what he claims effort and hard work. He married a wealthy wife, whose father is an executive at Orange Airlines. With that connection, he climbed the ranks and later became the VP."
Jia Xiaoling paused, then laughed, "So, his success has little to do with his own efforts."
Lin Fan smiled, "You could say that. Successful people often preach about hard work, but who’s not working hard? Yet most people, no matter how early they rise or how hard they labor, can’t become company presidents. Decades of effort can’t compete with having a wealthy dad, father-in-law, or cousin."
While saying this, Lin Fan casually glanced at Liu Qiang, with an obvious implication.
Liu Qiang felt insulted, seething with anger.
"Hmph, I won’t stoop to your level, Lin Fan. Even if what you say is true, so what? I have a cousin; Senior Brother Meng has a good father-in-law. You’re just jealous because you don’t have any!" Liu Qiang sneered.
Lin Fan smiled, "I just want to say, stop spouting motivational nonsense. The truth about this world is much harsher than those stories, and your efforts might be worth nothing. Yet some people succeed through connections and still package themselves as hardworking, which is just disgusting."
Many successful individuals’ stories are vividly embellished with tales of struggle and difficulty, claiming their success was all due to personal effort.
Yet, the true key to their success might be being a Rich Second Generation or having a good father-in-law. The startup capital they received is more than most people earn in a lifetime.
Meanwhile, the students were deeply moved by Meng Xiaoming’s speech, their faces flushed with ambition. It’s as if they all believed they were just a step away from being a company VP.
Narratives like these are indeed compelling.
After introducing Meng Xiaoming, Principal Zhao continued, "The next person to introduce is a beautiful lady and an outstanding senior. Let’s welcome Lai Xiaomei on stage!"

chapters.title: Chapter 614: So Ordinary Yet So Confident
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Chapter 614: So Ordinary Yet So Confident
"Everyone, let’s give a round of applause!"
Principal Zhao started clapping.
The students all began to clap, the applause thunderous.
"Senior Sister Lai Xiaomei, I know her, she’s amazing!"
"She’s always been my idol!"
"Beautiful, a top student, and now a powerful woman, truly a role model for us girls!"
The students admired Lai Xiaomei greatly.
Amidst the cheers, Lai Xiaomei stood up from the guest seats and walked onto the stage, shining like a star.
"Wow, she’s really beautiful!"
"My high school goddess! She still is!"
"So outstanding! She’s too incredible; I don’t even have the right to envy her, only to admire."
Onlookers outside the crowd were also full of admiration, with women feeling envious and men unable to take their eyes off Lai Xiaomei.
"She’s really something; if I could marry her, it would be great." Liu Qiang blushed with excitement, even a bit eager to try.
"Lai Xiaomei is truly excellent..."
Jia Xiaoling looked up at Lai Xiaomei and murmured. She didn’t even get into college, got married, and had children two years after graduating. Compared to Lai Xiaomei, she couldn’t help feeling a bit inferior.
"Jealous?" Lin Fan asked with a smile, glancing back at Jia Xiaoling.
Jia Xiaoling nodded: "Yes, jealous."
Lin Fan said, "Xiao Ling, let me ask you, do you feel happy now? You have a husband and two kids. Are you unhappy?"
Jia Xiaoling thought for a moment and said, "I’m not unhappy. Actually... I’m quite happy."
Lin Fan said, "I’ve never had the chance to meet your husband. What kind of person is he? Does he love you?"
Jia Xiaoling nodded: "Yes, he loves me a lot. We met while working; he pursued me actively. At first, I didn’t agree to be with him. He chased me for more than half a year, did many things for me, finally moved me, and that’s when I was with him. After marriage, he’s always been very good to me. I’m actually very grateful to have met a good husband."
"And your children?" Lin Fan said.
Jia Xiaoling said, "My children are great, very cute, a boy and a girl. The older son is very obedient, and the little girl is also very lovely. I love them very much; they are my everything now."
Lin Fan said, "That’s it, you have the happiness that Lai Xiaomei doesn’t have. No need to envy her; she has her own brilliance, and you have yours. It’s just different life paths. You see her looking glamorous, but how do you know she doesn’t have her own worries behind the scenes?"
Jia Xiaoling thought for a moment. She couldn’t help but smile and said, "I understand now. Thank you, Lin Fan. I won’t envy her anymore, or rather, I have no need to envy her."
Nowadays, there is a lot of advocacy online for so-called independent feminists, attacking married women and always promoting not marrying or having children, taking pride in being a powerful woman without marriage and children. These statements are extremely extreme and radical.
Being independent, not marrying, not having children, relying on oneself—there’s nothing wrong with this. It’s personal freedom.
But attacking women who marry and have children shouldn’t be right because marriage and having children are others’ freedom too.
Moreover, human reproduction and survival operate on family units, marrying and having children to form families has been humanity’s way of reproduction for thousands of years. Feminists must be crazy to have such anti-human statements.
Establishing a family, having a happy home, can be said to be the basic vision for obtaining happiness in this world for the majority of people. Girls, from the beginning of their understanding, fantasize about being awaited by a prince on a white horse.
Even Fairy Zixia longs for that legendary hero riding on a cloud of colorful auspices.
It is precisely because of the yearning for love and family that humanity has been able to reproduce until now. Feminists advocating not marrying or having children are simply anti-human.
At this moment, Lai Xiaomei took the stage, greeted by everyone’s eager gaze, and began her speech.
"Thank you for your enthusiasm. Actually, I’m quite ashamed because compared to Senior Brother Meng, my achievements now are insignificant." Lai Xiaomei said modestly.
Meng Xiaoming quickly said, "No, no, Junior Sister Lai is very excellent and still young, with boundless prospects!"
The two began the commercial flattery mode.
Lai Xiaomei said, "Senior Brother Meng has always been my idol, and I will strive to become even more outstanding. Actually, today I am here to share a bit of my own insights with the juniors present."
"What Senior Brother Meng said earlier is very true; youth must be spent working hard. If you don’t work hard when you’re young, when will you?"
"If I didn’t work hard, I wouldn’t have today’s achievements. Although they’re nothing much, they are fought for by myself. To this day, I haven’t dated anyone. Don’t misunderstand; I’m not here to propose marriage!"
Everyone laughed.
Lai Xiaomei said, "My point is, young people shouldn’t rush into love or romance, and especially shouldn’t hurry to marry and have children. While young, work hard for your career, especially us girls. We must be independent and strong, not think about relying on men. We must rely on ourselves. Don’t have the notion that marrying a rich man means you don’t need to work hard. You must strive to be rich yourself!"
A round of applause filled the room.
It must be said, Lai Xiaomei’s words were well-spoken and full of positive energy.
Even Lin Fan nodded in agreement; indeed, during youth, one should work hard, and relying on oneself is also a thought of independence and strength.
Lai Xiaomei continued, "As a girl, especially one who’s reasonably attractive, there will definitely be many opportunities for romance. The boys pursuing you won’t be few, take myself for example, it basically never stops, with many excellent successful gentlemen among them. Of course, there are also many unsuccessful ones."
Everyone laughed again.
Lai Xiaomei said, "I want to say to these unsuccessful gentlemen, you are so ordinary yet so confident. What makes you think you can pursue me? I rejected so many excellent successful men, would I choose you? Many loser guys don’t work hard themselves yet dream of pursuing a goddess. Where do you get the audacity? Do you deserve to like me?"
Thunderous applause!
Everyone laughed and clapped.
"Senior Sister Lai is incredible!"
The girls all looked very excited, clearly stirred up by Lai Xiaomei’s words, as if they suddenly felt outstanding themselves.
Lai Xiaomei’s remarks, however, dealt a heavy blow to those boys who viewed her as their dream goddess.
Especially the male onlookers present, most of them not being so excellent, yet they fantasized about marrying the goddess.
Lai Xiaomei’s words are very aggressive towards them. Does it mean if you’re not successful, you don’t even qualify to love a goddess?
But Liu Qiang just chuckled and said, "She’s very right. Man, don’t be poor! With a woman as outstanding as her, only an equally excellent man can be worthy of her!"
He almost wanted to engrave the word ’confidence’ on his forehead, clearly considering himself qualified to pursue Lai Xiaomei.
"Lin Fan, you were in the same middle school as Lai Xiaomei; she’s your goddess too, isn’t she? You’re exactly the kind of person she’s talking about, so ordinary yet so confident. You don’t qualify!"
Liu Qiang glanced at Lin Fan, smirking disdainfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 615: Only those with assets exceeding 100 million are qualified to pursue her
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Chapter 615: Only those with assets exceeding 100 million are qualified to pursue her
Lin Fan didn’t say anything, yet somehow he still got caught in the crossfire, leaving him a bit speechless.
He partially agreed with Lai Xiaomei’s point of view because it’s very realistic; what she said reflected some real-world situations.
In our real-world society, it’s true that excellent men have a priority in choosing a partner. Outstanding men won’t lack for women; they don’t even have to pursue them, and lots of women will come to them willingly.
So many men work hard to become excellent, to become CEOs, marry rich and beautiful women, and reach the pinnacle of life. It’s not just a joke; it’s the aspiration and goal of many men.
However!
Lin Fan didn’t agree that unsuccessful men have no right to like goddesses. That’s wrong—liking someone is a personal matter. A beggar can like a queen, qualification doesn’t matter, or rather, everyone is qualified.
"Oh."
Faced with Liu Qiang’s confident provocation, Lin Fan couldn’t be bothered to respond.
Though he didn’t agree with Lai Xiaomei, he also wasn’t interested in refuting her, since he preferred to keep a low profile.
Now, he was just taking the stance of a bystander, watching the drama with indifference, just waiting for the rental car company to come and take the car back, and then he’d leave.
Liu Qiang saw Lin Fan ignoring him and became even more excited.
"Lin Fan, what do you mean by ’oh’? Are you admitting that you’re not qualified to like Lai Xiaomei?" Liu Qiang pressed aggressively.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I think you’re qualified."
This was the truth. In Lin Fan’s view, loving someone isn’t a crime. A beggar can like a queen. Of course, Liu Qiang is qualified to like Lai Xiaomei.
However, to Liu Qiang, Lin Fan’s words sounded sarcastic, like he was suggesting Liu Qiang wasn’t qualified either.
Liu Qiang was instantly annoyed: "Lin Fan, you should look in the mirror. You’re a delivery guy, what qualifications do you have to talk about me? I don’t have the right to like her, but do you? What have you got?"
Lin Fan spread his hands, feeling that explaining anything more to this guy was just a waste of effort.
At this moment, Meng Xiaoming on stage noticed the commotion over here and laughed, "Junior Sister Lai, your words were quite fierce just now, quite intense. It seems there’s already a dispute over them in the audience, and I’d also like to know what everyone thinks of your statement."
Meng Xiaoming’s words led everyone to follow his gaze, turning to look at Liu Qiang and Lin Fan.
Suddenly, Liu Qiang and Lin Fan became the focus of attention.
Principal Zhao saw Lin Fan and wanted to cry. Why was this guy still here? This failed student, why hadn’t he left yet? And now he had attracted everyone’s attention, so now everyone would know Tianhai Middle School had such a failed student.
Lai Xiaomei also noticed Lin Fan and slightly furrowed her brows. She still couldn’t remember who Lin Fan was.
Liu Qiang pointed at Lin Fan and said, "This guy is Lai Xiaomei’s middle school classmate. I just want to say, he’s exactly the kind of person Lai Xiaomei was talking about—so ordinary, yet so confident!"
"I didn’t say anything," Lin Fan said, spreading his hands in speechless exasperation.
Liu Qiang snorted, "You didn’t say anything? Didn’t you say I wasn’t qualified to like Lai Xiaomei? If I’m not qualified, do you think you are?"
Lai Xiaomei let out an "Oh" and sized up Lin Fan. He was actually her middle school classmate. No wonder he looked so familiar, but she just couldn’t remember who he was.
Jia Xiaoling couldn’t help but retort to Liu Qiang, "Liu Qiang, stop being unreasonable. He clearly said you are qualified to like Lai Xiaomei!"
"Hahaha..."
A young man sitting below the stage suddenly burst into laughter and stood up.
"What, you think you’re qualified to like my sister?" The young man pointed at Liu Qiang. "What makes you qualified?"
Liu Qiang instantly turned red with embarrassment: "I..."
Meng Xiaoming laughed and said, "It’s nothing. Fellow student, I believe most of those present today are alumni. This brother here should be too, right?"
Liu Qiang said, "I am from the class of 2008, my name is Liu Qiang."
Being asked by Meng Xiaoming made Liu Qiang feel greatly flattered, so he promptly introduced himself. After all, Meng Xiaoming, the vice-president of Orange Airlines, he wouldn’t normally have the qualification or opportunity to speak with him. Now given the chance, he absolutely couldn’t let it slip and had to make a good impression.
Meng Xiaoming said, "Come on, Junior Brother Liu Qiang, feel free to tell us, why do you think you’re qualified to pursue Lai Xiaomei?"
Liu Qiang said, "I’m currently a supervisor at a factory with a scale of 50 million, with an annual salary of 300,000, and I just bought a BMW outright. I think I’ve got some skills."
Upon hearing this, many people nodded and showed agreement.
Being a supervisor at a 50 million factory with an annual salary of 300,000 was indeed not bad, not to mention buying a BMW outright, which would cost at least tens of thousands, starting from fifty thousand!
Such a person was indeed commendable.
Meng Xiaoming smiled and said, "Junior Brother Liu Qiang, you’re indeed impressive, but I dare not say whether you qualify or not; that decision must be confirmed by Junior Sister Lai Xiaomei."
The young man sneered, "Liu Qiang, right? Do you know what kind of people pursue my sister? There are rich second generations, successful entrepreneurs, none of whose assets are less than a hundred million. You think your 300,000 annual salary and a BMW qualify you to pursue my sister? How overconfident!"
"What?"
Everyone was stunned.
That was just too extraordinary, wasn’t it? Assets over a hundred million just to pursue Lai Xiaomei?
That was incredible.
Does that mean if your assets are not over a hundred million, you can’t even like her?
This seemed too excessive.
Liu Qiang’s face flushed red with shame, wishing he could find a hole to crawl into. He had been very confident just now, thinking he was doing quite well.
But now, after the young man’s words, it seemed like he really wasn’t qualified. Compared to those rich second generations and entrepreneurs, his assets seemed pitiful, and how could he be qualified to like Lai Xiaomei?
Turned out the clown was actually himself, the person Lai Xiaomei referred to as so ordinary yet so confident.
"You think you’re not an average Joe just because you have a BMW and a 300,000 annual salary? Sorry, you’re still just an average Joe, and you’re overly confident." The young man sneered.
Liu Qiang felt like dying. He regretted arguing with Lin Fan. Now, he was being laughed at.
However, he immediately found a way to save face.
"I... If I’m not qualified, then he’s even less qualified!" Liu Qiang pointed at Lin Fan.
Meng Xiaoming gave an "Oh" and said, "Why, fellow student, what’s the situation now?"
Liu Qiang sneered, "I’m afraid he’s too embarrassed to introduce himself, so let me do the honors! His name is Lin..."
Principal Zhao interrupted Liu Qiang, laughing warmly, "Ladies and gentlemen, today is the school anniversary; I think there’s no need to continue discussing such topics. Let’s get back to the main agenda!"
He certainly didn’t want Lin Fan’s identity to be made public, too embarrassing.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 Junior Lin, What Do You Do
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Chapter 616 Junior Lin, What Do You Do
Principal Zhao was afraid everyone would find out that Lin Fan was delivering food, so he tried to change the situation at the scene.
But Principal Zhao obviously failed. At this moment, everyone’s eyes fell on Lin Fan. Everyone wanted to know whether Lin Fan was qualified to like the goddess Lai Xiaomei.
Lai Xiaomei made a speech mocking those boys who overestimated themselves by wanting to chase her. She was so ordinary yet so confident. Lai Xiaomei’s brother even declared that anyone without assets over one billion wasn’t qualified to pursue his sister.
This caused a stir.
Since Lai Xiaomei was indeed outstanding, at the beginning, everyone praised her. But after these remarks, there were some criticisms, mainly from the boys.
"You need assets over one billion to deserve liking her? Isn’t that a bit too much!"
"Is she that impressive? Although she is indeed excellent, isn’t this a bit too arrogant!"
"Haha, I’ll pass."
A few boys started to mutter.
As for the girls, the majority admired Lai Xiaomei even more. Lai Xiaomei was simply their idol. They also wanted to be a successful strong woman, confident enough to say that only those with assets over a hundred million deserved to pursue them!
Due to his overconfidence, Liu Qiang ended up being humiliated.
He was a manager at a factory worth 50 million, with an annual salary of 300,000, and he had just fully paid 500,000 for a BMW, thinking he was capable of pursuing Lai Xiaomei.
As a result, he was humiliated by the mention of having assets over one billion. Liu Qiang blushed, wishing he could find a hole to crawl into.
He quickly found a way to shift the embarrassment by diverting the trouble to Lin Fan.
If he wasn’t qualified to pursue Lai Xiaomei, then Lin Fan was even less qualified.
Little Ming also noticed Lin Fan and inquired about what Lin Fan was doing.
Liu Qiang eagerly responded, "He’s called Lin Fan. He was in the same class as me in high school. He’s now..."
Principal Zhao hurriedly interrupted Liu Qiang, fearing everyone would learn about Lin Fan’s identity: "Everyone, today is the school’s centennial celebration. Why don’t we focus back on that and leave these topics for later discussion?"
Little Ming smiled and said, "Principal, it’s okay. I find Junior Sister Lai’s topic quite interesting. It’s a good chance to share some thoughts with the junior brothers and sisters, which I believe will benefit them as well."
Little Ming was a vice president of Orange Airlines and one of the sponsors of this celebration. Since a sponsor was talking, Principal Zhao couldn’t brush it off.
Principal Zhao said, "Alright, Senior Ming has something valuable to share. Let’s give him a warm round of applause!"
Little Ming said, "Junior Sister Lai is excellent, everyone knows that. Not only is she a successful career woman, but she is also very beautiful. Ordinary boys really don’t stand a chance with her. I think the mention of only men with assets over a billion pursuing her is a good quantification, illustrating a real-life issue we face — social matching. I’d like to ask the boys here: do you want to marry someone as outstanding as Junior Sister Lai? The answer is definitely yes, right? Now, I’d like to ask the girls here: do you want to be pursued by a wealthy billionaire? The answer is the same, right? The summary is, we all want an outstanding partner, but ask yourself, do you deserve it? A man who can’t even support himself — do you think you’re worthy of having a wife like Junior Sister Lai? A shallow woman — do you think a billionaire would marry you? Hence, we must strive to become excellent people so we can deserve an excellent partner."
Everyone applauded.
It turns out Little Ming was using this topic to educate the junior brothers and sisters to be ambitious, which was consistent with his core view before — the importance of working hard.
Admittedly, what Little Ming said made a lot of sense. The reality is just like that. There’s a saying that different circles don’t need to force a merge. If you’re just a delivery person trying to break into the billionaire circle, it’s basically impossible. Even if you have the chance to contact this circle, you’ll find yourself out of place. Only by becoming excellent and turning into a billionaire yourself, will it be the circles seeking you out rather than you seeking them.
When Lin Fan was still a delivery person, which billionaire would look at him? But when he became the mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin, countless billionaires approached to curry favor with him.
As someone who had been through this, Lin Fan agreed with Little Ming’s viewpoint and experienced it deeply.
However, he didn’t entirely agree with Little Ming’s motivational talk; while hard work is important, is it enough? Solely advocating for hard work is undoubtedly just a poisonous motivational talk.
Many people work diligently from morning to night, yet they never become vice presidents of a corporation.
Some people became vice presidents because they married the daughter of someone high up and relied on nepotism.
Hard work?
Some are born into farmer families, working hard their whole lives, unable to break the class barrier.
Some are born into wealthy families, where hard work is unnecessary, enjoying a worry-free life from birth, born into the upper class. As they grow up, their fathers casually hand them 5 billion to start a business, where 5 billion is just for practice. Can a child from a poor family earn 5 billion in a lifetime? Can your hard work compare to that?
So, solely emphasizing hard work is just a poisonous motivation.
In Lin Fan’s view, there are things more important than hard work.
At this point, Little Ming continued, "Today, both Junior Sister Lai and I were invited to the centennial celebration, along with a few junior brothers and sisters sitting in the guest seats, because we have achieved a bit and brought honor to our alma mater. I hope you can do the same in the future. Of course, it doesn’t mean those observing from the sidelines are not excellent. For instance, Junior Brother Liu Qiang, who we discussed earlier, with an annual salary of 300,000, is doing well but can do even better. I hope one day he can have assets over a billion and qualify to pursue Junior Sister Lai. Also, this Junior Brother Lin... Right, what is Junior Brother Lin doing now?"
Little Ming looked towards Lin Fan.
Everyone also turned their gaze to Lin Fan, curious about what he was doing.
Principal Zhao supported his head with one hand, feeling very helpless. In the end, there was no escaping it; this alumni who delivered food would ultimately bring disgrace to the school.
"Lin Fan?"
At this moment, Lai Xiaomei murmured. Suddenly, she remembered and blurted out, "Lin Fan, right, you’re Lin Fan. We were classmates in middle school. I thought you looked familiar, just couldn’t recall at the moment."
Lai Xiaomei’s brother Lai Xiaoming exclaimed, "Middle school classmates?"
Little Ming responded, "Oh, so you’re Junior Sister Lai’s middle school classmate, and then you entered Tianhai Middle School together in high school. That’s even more interesting."
Lai Xiaomei said, "In middle school, Lin Fan’s academic performance was once better than mine. Lin Fan, what are you doing now?"
Liu Qiang chuckled, "As far as I know, you were also the goddess of Lin Fan. However, he is even less qualified to like you than I am. He is currently delivering food."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Delivering food?
A graduate of Tianhai Middle School, delivering food?
The whole room fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: Lin Fan Became a Negative Example
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Chapter 617: Lin Fan Became a Negative Example
Principal Zhao wished he could just smash his head against a block of tofu and die; it was too humiliating, too embarrassing. In the end, Lin Fan’s identity was exposed.
When they heard that Lin Fan was delivering food, everyone present fell silent.
The atmosphere suddenly became a bit awkward. A student who graduated from Tianhai Middle School and even got into college ended up being a delivery man.
"Hahaha..."
Lai Xiaoming was the first to burst into laughter, holding his stomach as he laughed.
"What? He’s a delivery guy? I knew it. Just look at his outfit, it screams he’s a poor loser. A delivery guy dare to act tough with me?" Lai Xiaoming laughed, his laughter full of disdain.
Earlier, he and Lin Fan had a conflict. Lin Fan actually dared to go against him, Lin Fan drove a Xia Li, daring to challenge him and his Audi instead of lowering his head.
At that time, Lai Xiaoming was very unhappy and decided to find an opportunity to teach this poor guy a lesson.
Now the opportunity finally came.
Lin Fan’s identity was exposed as a delivery man, and as a graduate of Tianhai Middle School, it was so embarrassing. Naturally, he had to step on Lin Fan hard.
"A delivery man? Really, do we have graduates from our school who actually deliver food?"
"For a century-old prestigious school, cultivating so many excellent talents, and yet it produced a delivery man?"
"So embarrassing, isn’t he a failure?"
"His outfit speaks for itself, so poor!"
The crowd was buzzing with discussions.
Lai Xiaomei was also surprised, looking incredulous, saying: "Lin Fan, are you delivering food?"
No wonder, Lin Fan dressed like this and drove a Xia Li. Delivering food isn’t exactly a decent job. Although it’s said that delivery can earn quite a bit, a diligent delivery man can make more than ten thousand a month, but Lin Fan’s from a rural background. Even if he made over ten thousand a month, after family expenses, there probably wouldn’t be much left.
No wonder he could only afford a Xia Li.
In short, one word: poor.
Four words: lower social class.
Previously, when she didn’t recognize Lin Fan, even though she thought he looked familiar, she didn’t plan to reconnect with him because she didn’t see the need.
Now that she knew Lin Fan was a delivery man, she felt even more so.
Meng Xiaoming was stunned for a moment, a trace of disdain flashed through his eyes, then he smiled and said: "So Junior Lin is a delivery guy, huh? Generally speaking, delivery is a legitimate profession. There’s no hierarchy in professions, but there are different levels of entry barriers. It’s like some professions aren’t for just anyone, like a programmer. If you haven’t studied programming, you can’t do it. Or a scientist, if you don’t have professional knowledge, you can’t work in that field. That’s the barrier. But some jobs have very low entry barriers, like a mover, as long as you have strength, anyone can do it, even someone who’s illiterate. And likewise, being a delivery man has a low barrier. Someone with just a middle school education can do it, even a primary school graduate can. Junior Lin, you are at least a college graduate, why take a job with such a low barrier? Isn’t it because you couldn’t manage other jobs? No reason, right, as a college graduate, there are many high-barrier jobs you could choose. Sorry, I don’t mean to look down on delivery men, I’m just curious."
Everyone was looking at Lin Fan, waiting for an answer.
Now, they all had a bit of a sense of watching a joke, since Lin Fan was just a delivery man. In front of Lin Fan, everyone suddenly had a sense of superiority, as if they were looking down at Lin Fan from above.
No one expected that this centennial school celebration would turn into a trial of Lin Fan.
An unsuccessful alumnus began to undergo a soul-searching interrogation.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, saying nothing. He knew what the situation was now. In everyone’s eyes, he was undoubtedly a failure. And naturally, a failure had to become a negative example, to be criticized.
But Lin Fan wasn’t interested in getting involved in this.
Liu Qiang chuckled and said: "Do we even need to ask? As Senior Brother Meng said, we all need to study hard, strive upward every day, and become outstanding talents. But Lin Fan graduated from college and went out to deliver food, simply because he wasn’t hardworking enough. I bet he was the kind of student in college who did nothing all day, idled around, with poor grades, and couldn’t find a good job after graduation. Without diligence in college, with no remarkable talents, no company would hire him. If he can’t get into a good company, doesn’t make money, he can only do low-barrier jobs like delivering food or packages! Lin Fan, am I right?"
The crowd nodded one after another.
"Seems like that’s the case."
"This Lin Fan senior isn’t hardworking!"
"We can’t be like him, seems like we really need to study hard in the future."
"Even if we get into college later on, we can’t be slackers."
Meng Xiaoming nodded and said: "Junior Brother Liu Qiang’s analysis is quite reasonable, seems like that’s the situation. As far as I know, many students after getting into college think there’s no need to work hard anymore, just play games all day. As a result, after four years of college, they learn nothing but get a degree. But companies aren’t just looking at credentials, they want talents too, meaning work ability. If you lack work ability, even a degree is useless. Junior Lin should be in this situation, just getting a degree without work capability, so no company would want him. I can assert now that Junior Lin is indeed a negative example of what I’ve been talking about today. We must work hard to become useful talents in the future, and Junior Lin is an example of not working hard. If you don’t work hard today, tomorrow you’ll end up like Junior Lin, delivering food. You could say college was a waste!"
Principal Zhao led the applause.
Suddenly, applause filled the room!
Principal Zhao finally found a way to resolve the embarrassment, and that was to make Lin Fan a negative example, seizing the opportunity to instill the concept of diligent studying in the students.
This way, no one would pay attention to the embarrassment.
"As the principal, I agree very much with what Xiaoming just said. Indeed, we must study hard and never slack off. High school is just one stage. In college, you still have to keep working hard, shouldn’t relax. As for Lin Fan’s situation in high school, I’m not sure, but since he was able to get into college, it means he did well in high school. It’s just after going to college, he obviously slacked off, leading to unsatisfactory academic performance and insufficient professional capability, so couldn’t find an ideal job after graduation."
"I hope all students can take Lin Fan as a lesson, don’t make the same mistake. Even after getting into college, focus on developing your professional skills, so when you get out, you can find a good job. As Xiaoming said, high-barrier jobs, not low-barrier ones even primary school graduates can do."
The students nodded one after another.
"Hmm, we can’t be as shameful as Lin Fan!"
Everyone had this thought.
At this moment, a government vehicle stopped at the school gate, Mayor Long got off the car with the company of his secretary, ready to enter the school.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 Expulsion
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Chapter 618 Expulsion
At the centennial school celebration, Lin Fan became a cautionary tale, a typical failure, receiving criticism from everyone. It seemed like everyone felt superior in front of Lin Fan.
Senior Brother Meng and Principal Zhao used Lin Fan as an example to counsel the students to strive hard, lest they end up like Lin Fan, who must have been playing games all day in college, lacked professional skills, and thus couldn’t find a good job after graduation and had to work as a delivery person.
The students nodded in agreement, thinking they must never be like Lin Fan. How embarrassing it would be to be a delivery person; it would bring shame to Tianhai Middle School.
Lai Xiaomei glanced at Lin Fan with a trace of sentiment in her eyes, a sentiment looking down from above. Back in junior high, Lin Fan’s grades were once better than hers, but he kept going downhill, and the gap between them widened. Today, it’s like one is in heaven and the other in hell; she is a successful businesswoman, while Lin Fan delivers food.
Seeing Lin Fan being mocked by the crowd made Liu Qiang feel quite smug.
"Look at yourself, Lin Fan. You are such a failure. Why haven’t you left yet? If it were me, I’d have no face to stick around," Liu Qiang laughed.
Lai Xiaoming chimed in, "It’s one thing to be poor, but he sure has thick skin! Principal Zhao, although I am not your student, as a relative of my sister, I’d like to suggest that having a failure like Lin Fan at the centennial celebration is an insult to the school. I propose to expel Lin Fan!"
After speaking, Lai Xiaoming looked at Lin Fan with a sinister smile; after all, Lin Fan had offended him before, and he wanted to ruin Lin Fan!
Lai Xiaoming’s suggestion was undoubtedly venomous, deeply humiliating. If Lin Fan is indeed expelled, he’ll forever be a laughingstock nailed to the pillar of shame.
Graduated from Tianhai Middle School and became a delivery person, must one suffer such degradation?
It indeed is.
The students were already nodding, showing their agreement. They did not want Lin Fan, a failure, appearing again at the celebration, lowering its stature.
Liu Qiang clapped and laughed, "This proposal is great, truly great. This is how it should be done. Someone like Lin Fan, who is disgraceful, should not be welcomed at the celebration."
Senior Brother Meng chuckled, "Junior Sister Lai, you have the most special relationship with Junior Brother Lin Fan. What do you think? Should Junior Brother Lin Fan stay?"
Lai Xiaomei promptly replied, "Senior Brother Meng, I don’t understand what you mean by the most special relationship. At most, we were classmates for three years in junior high; otherwise, there’s no relationship, so don’t misunderstand. As for whether he should stay, that’s not up to me to say; it’s up to the principal."
Lai Xiaomei’s words were quite clear; she didn’t intend to speak up for Lin Fan; in fact, she seemed to wish they weren’t classmates in junior high at all.
Principal Zhao was a little embarrassed.
He had actually hinted before that Lin Fan should leave because he thought being a delivery person tarnishes the prestigious image of the centennial school.
But now, in front of everyone, he couldn’t be the villain, or he’d definitely invite criticism.
"Everyone calm down. Lin Fan, as a negative example, has shown everyone the importance of hard work, and that can be considered a contribution. Moreover, the school celebration’s purpose is to welcome all former students back, regardless of their current situation. We can’t say to drive someone away just because they aren’t doing well; it’s not the school’s intent." Principal Zhao spoke righteously.
He then continued, "Of course, if Lin Fan wants to leave on his own, the school won’t stop him. The celebration is very free for former students from outside, with freedom to come and go."
Principal Zhao’s words made it quite clear that he hoped Lin Fan would be sensible and leave on his own because the school would not expel anyone; if Lin Fan leaves by himself, it won’t count as expulsion.
Liu Qiang sneered, "Lin Fan, why haven’t you left? How do you have the face to stay? If I were you, I’d have no face to remain!"
"He really has a thick skin!"
"Why bother? He shouldn’t have come at all, becoming a cautionary lesson!"
"Really, where does he get the courage to attend the celebration?"
"Leave, just leave quickly, isn’t it humiliating enough?"
"He’s disgraced the school completely; if word gets to neighboring schools, we’ll surely be laughed at for having graduates who work as delivery persons!"
"Exactly, he shouldn’t have come in the first place."
The crowd chatted continuously.
The overwhelming sentiment was hoping Lin Fan would leave.
"Enough!"
A loud shout!
The speaker was Little Ling.
Watching everyone treat Lin Fan like this, Little Ling couldn’t bear it anymore, and she was the only one standing up for Lin Fan, speaking for him.
"I mean, is this necessary? So what if Lin Fan delivers food? Does it deserve such criticism from you? You are too insulting! I really didn’t expect you to act this way. I used to be proud of my alma mater, but now I feel ashamed because you clearly don’t understand respect!"
Jia Xiaoling scolded.
The entire scene quieted, everyone was looking at Jia Xiaoling for a while.
Jia Xiaoling, overly angry, couldn’t help but speak out.
Now drawing everyone’s attention, Jia Xiaoling suddenly felt a little timid.
"Oh, who is this junior sister? You’re a junior sister, right, or a senior sister?" Senior Brother Meng curiously asked.
Liu Qiang replied, "Senior Brother Meng, she’s called Jia Xiaoling; don’t let her fool you, she looks like Auntie, but she was also my classmate, and by age, your junior sister."
Senior Brother Meng smiled, "So it’s Junior Sister. She does look a bit hasty."
The scene burst into laughter.
Liu Qiang said, "Saying she looks hasty is one thing, but the main reason is she got married and had kids very early, and it’s all worn her down. She’s actually doing worse than Lin Fan. Oh, I mean, she suits Lin Fan well; together, they’re a pair of negative examples."
Senior Brother Meng "Oh’d" and said, "Is that so? Junior Sister Jia, is there something troubling you that has worn you down like this?"
Liu Qiang said, "She didn’t get into university after high school, so her family wouldn’t let her continue studying. Her family was poor, so the money was saved to educate her younger siblings. She went out to work and got married in just two years. Her husband was also penniless, initially running a small business, but the business failed, leaving a huge debt. They’ve been busy paying it off all these years. She’s unskilled, only grows vegetables at home to sell for some money, which isn’t enough to pay off the debt..."
Hearing Liu Qiang’s words, everyone was stunned; Jia Xiaoling’s plight sounded too miserable.
Even Lin Fan, who had remained silent, showed an expression of surprise because he had just learned about this.
"Stop it! Liu Qiang, I beg you to stop!" Jia Xiaoling said tearfully, interrupting Liu Qiang, her eyes reddening.
Liu Qiang laughed, "Why? Jia Xiaoling, you don’t want everyone to know about your situation? You’re also a student of this school. Today is the centennial celebration day, sharing your experiences is nothing. Lin Fan has already become a caution to teach the students."
"So foolish!"
Lai Xiaomei suddenly said; looking at Jia Xiaoling, "You’re really foolish, getting married and having kids so early has completely ruined your life!"

chapters.title: Chapter 619: Extreme Misfortune Turns Into Blessing
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Chapter 619: Extreme Misfortune Turns Into Blessing
Lai Xiaomei said, "I just told the students that girls shouldn’t be in such a hurry to get married, burying their best youthful years in marriage. And here we have a living example. Everyone can see how miserable she is now—poor family, up to her neck in debt, children to raise. She’s about my age, but she looks old enough to be my mother. I have to remind everyone again, don’t get married so early, be independent and strong new-age women!"
The girls nodded in agreement. With Jia Xiaoling as an example, Lai Xiaomei’s words were truly enlightening and absolutely correct.
Don’t get married so early, marriage is a graveyard. Family, kids, debts, they turn a youthful woman into a worn-out housewife.
Lai Xiaomei continued to instill her beliefs: "Every girl should become a new-age woman. Only with more and more new-age women can we truly stand up, and people like Jia Xiaoling will decrease, achieving true female empowerment. I believe Jia Xiaoling must regret marrying and having children so early."
The students nodded, every word from Lai Xiaomei seemed right.
"Lai Xiaomei, stop talking nonsense!"
Jia Xiaoling suddenly shouted, interrupting Lai Xiaomei.
Lai Xiaomei frowned, "Jia Xiaoling, what did you say?"
Jia Xiaoling said, "You don’t know anything about my life. You just heard a few things from Liu Qiang and think you know me; you’re just talking nonsense!"
Lai Xiaomei chuckled, "Jia Xiaoling, although you’re a rural woman, I hope you speak a bit more civilized. Are you saying you don’t think your life is bad?"
Jia Xiaoling said, "No, my life is indeed bad. Our family is poor because our business failed and we’re in debt. My husband is always thinking about starting over, but there’s no money, and we’re helpless. But so what? We have two adorable children, and my husband cherishes me. He works in the day and helps me pick vegetables when he gets home; we have a great relationship. Life is hard, but we’re happy because we have a complete family and love! People like you, Lai Xiaomei, have no right to judge me!"
"At first, I heard you started a company and were very successful, and I was envious, but Lin Fan enlightened me. What’s there to envy? Everyone has their own life. You’re young, pretty, and rich, but you have no husband, no kids. If we were to swap lives, if I had to trade my husband and kids for your life, I wouldn’t. Why? Sure, you’re rich now, but who can guarantee you’ll always be smooth sailing, and never experience business failures? We’re struggling now, but who can say we won’t turn misfortune into fortune? Success and failure are temporary. Don’t mock others’ failures just because you have some achievements. Even I, a rural woman who failed the exams, understand this, but you, a top student, don’t?"
The crowd was silent.
Everyone was stunned by Jia Xiaoling’s speech.
Lai Xiaomei, however, was angered by Jia Xiaoling’s words and chuckled, "Your words are meaningless. It’s winners versus losers. You’re the loser now, and I’m the winner. So what if I want a husband and children? If I want them, there’s a long line of men wanting to marry me, and if I want kids, they won’t suffer from the start; your kids will. If you lost your husband and kids, would anyone want you?"
Jia Xiaoling was at a loss for words: "..."
Lai Xiaomei said, "Got nothing to say? You’re the loser; everything you say is wrong. I’m the winner, so my words have value, and you have no right to refute me with how poorly you’ve turned out!"
Jia Xiaoling’s face reddened, "But..."
Lai Xiaomei said, "What’s there to say? You’re a loser and shouldn’t be lecturing others. Look in the mirror and reflect on your life. If you had listened to me from the start, and not rushed into marriage and kids, you could have had an exciting life, become excellent first, and wouldn’t have had to marry a poor man. You could have many choices like me, and wouldn’t be suffering now!"
Jia Xiaoling had nothing to say.
I have to admit, maybe Lai Xiaomei was right, if she didn’t marry so early, if...
"Ha!"
Suddenly, a chuckle caught everyone’s attention.
The one who laughed was Lin Fan, who had been silent all along.
Previously, Lin Fan was used as a negative example, ridiculed by everyone, criticized by Meng Xiaoming and Principal Zhao, yet Lin Fan said nothing, quietly watching them show off.
But now, Lin Fan suddenly spoke up.
For no reason other than Jia Xiaoling stood up for him, scolding everyone, Lin Fan couldn’t just sit back.
Lai Xiaomei glanced at Lin Fan, "Lin Fan, what insights do you have?"
Lai Xiaoming said dismissively, "You’re a loser too, and like my sister said, you have no right to speak! Because losers’ words are just nonsense, meaningless!"
The crowd laughed.
Liu Qiang laughed, "Lin Fan, aren’t you embarrassed enough? If I were you, I’d leave with Jia Xiaoling as soon as possible!"
Lin Fan looked at Lai Xiaomei and said, "Maybe you’re right. If Little Ling had chosen a different path, not married so young, not had children so early, her life might be different."
Lai Xiaomei responded, "Seems you’re agreeing with me."
But Lin Fan changed his tone, "However, life doesn’t have ’ifs’, and life can’t be replayed, unless it’s like a novel where people are reborn. Little Ling has come this far. Reflecting on the past won’t help her, and she can’t go back and rewrite her life. Besides, Little Ling said it herself, though her life is tough, her family is happy together. She cherishes her family. Like drinking water, only they know the temperature. As outsiders, we have no right to judge her. What’s more, she’s suffering now, but can you be sure she’ll always be? As she said, fortunes may turn. When that day comes, when she has both a comfortable life and a happy family, won’t you call her a winner too? And asking her to reflect on the past now makes you look ridiculous then."
Lai Xiaomei chuckled, "Lin Fan, do you really think she can turn her misfortune around? I see no hope for her family, a lifetime of hardship awaits!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Who says? I say she’ll soon turn her fortunes around."
Lai Xiaomei snorted, "I won’t argue with you, because you’re a loser too!"

chapters.title: Chapter 620: If You Pick It Up, It’s Yours
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Chapter 620: If You Pick It Up, It’s Yours
The losers have no right to speak; what they say is taken lightly. The same words, if spoken by the richest man, are considered wise by everyone; if spoken by a failure, they are as good as farts.
So during the debate between Lin Fan and Lai Xiaomei, everyone dismissed Lin Fan’s words and agreed with Lai Xiaomei’s, as if what Lai Xiaomei said was the truth.
Lai Xiaomei said, "Jia Xiaoling’s current predicament is the consequence of her past mistakes. It’s a classic case of one wrong step leading to another. Her tragic life is already destined, and it’s difficult for her to turn back. That’s why I want to teach the younger students here not to rush into marriage, especially for girls; be the independent women of the new era, strong and self-reliant."
Everyone nodded, agreeing with Lai Xiaomei’s words.
Lin Fan chuckled, "In this world, everyone has their own life, their own choices. Why should Little Ling have to do what you say?"
Jia Xiaoling said, "Lin Fan, let’s stop talking and just leave."
She really didn’t want to stay here any longer. Staying would only lead to more humiliation. She was a failure, and a failure can’t win an argument with a successful person.
The successful one’s farts are fragrant because they have money. Whoever has money is right. Isn’t this our reality? If you want a sentence to be persuasive, just say it was said by a successful person, and it will sound very reasonable. The more successful the person, the more sense it makes. If it were said by Huaxia’s richest man, it would practically be a timeless truth.
Liu Qiang laughed, "Jia Xiaoling, you finally said something useful. You two should have left long ago. Don’t stay here disgracing yourselves. One deliverer, one debt-ridden vegetable grower, you’re really a shame to Tianhai Middle School. Don’t ruin the school anniversary celebration anymore!"
"Let’s go, hurry up and leave!"
"If it were me, I’d be too embarrassed to stay!"
"Not leaving yet? Your face must be thick enough!"
Everyone was chattering.
Principal Zhao couldn’t say it outright, but hoped in his heart that Lin Fan would leave. The centennial celebration was supposed to be a festive occasion, and Lin Fan and Jia Xiaoling really ruined the atmosphere.
Although the two served as negative examples, which could also educate the students, it would be better for them to leave quickly.
"Principal Zhao, what you said earlier, does it count? That for the centennial celebration, all alumni are welcome to come back and join?" Lin Fan’s eyes were on Principal Zhao.
Principal Zhao naturally couldn’t say it didn’t count. He cleared his throat, "Of course, this is the school’s policy, but..."
Lin Fan interrupted Principal Zhao with a smile, "That’s enough. Little Ling and I are alumni, and the celebration isn’t over yet. I want to stay a bit longer. Little Ling, stay with me a bit longer. No problem, right, Principal Zhao?"
Principal Zhao’s face twitched slightly, and he forced a smile, "Of course, no problem..."
Principal Zhao was seething inside, wanting to make Lin Fan leave but couldn’t, feeling utterly frustrated.
Liu Qiang shook his head, "Lin Fan really is a mangy dog, clinging on, refusing to leave. His face is thick enough!"
Lai Xiaoming sneered, "Won’t leave? Does he want a handout? That’s not hard!"
With that, Lai Xiaoming pulled out a wad of cash from his bag.
At a glance, there was at least 50,000 yuan!
Except for some of the rich present, everyone was wide-eyed seeing Lai Xiaoming casually pull out so much money.
Carrying so much cash with him, a true wealthy person!
Lai Xiaoming chuckled, "Here’s 50,000 yuan, just some pocket cash I carry around; it’s enough to get rid of you. Take this money and get lost."
As he said this, Lai Xiaoming threw the money on the ground and beckoned, "Come over and pick it up; this money is yours."
Jia Xiaoling stared at the pile of money, her eyes gleaming. How long had it been since she saw so much money at once? If this money were hers, her life would immediately improve significantly!
Saying this money wasn’t tempting is impossible.
But Lai Xiaoming’s action was too humiliating. If she really went to pick up that money, she would lose all her dignity as a human.
Jia Xiaoling glanced at Lin Fan, but saw that Lin Fan didn’t move, nor did he even look at the money.
The crowd was abuzz with discussions.
"So rich! Rich people really are different; they just throw 50,000 yuan at people!"
"Give it to me; I don’t need dignity!"
"Do you think they will pick it up? I bet they will!"
Lai Xiaomei said, "Lin Fan, consider this money from the time we were classmates; I’m donating it to Jia Xiaoling. Just take it and leave."
Lin Fan still didn’t move.
Lai Xiaomei grinned bitterly, "Lin Fan, what’s the point of this? There’s no need to waste any more time here."
Lai Xiaoming laughed, "He must think it’s too little. Fine, I’ll add another 30,000. Sorry, this is all the cash I brought today."
As he said that, Lai Xiaoming pulled out another wad of money from his bag and threw it on the ground.
50,000 plus 30,000.
It was a full 80,000 yuan!
God, this truly is throwing money at people; everyone’s eyes lit up, wishing they could rush over and snatch the 80,000 yuan. In front of so much money, what is dignity anyway?
Once, there were wealthy people who lost their minds and scattered money like fairy flowers from a balcony. Upon seeing this, passers-by scrambled to pick up the cash, some even fought over it, displaying all sorts of ugly behavior.
People live in this world, scurrying about, seeking nothing but a few pieces of silver. For money, people will do any dirty work, do anything; dignity? In front of money, what is dignity?
Everyone thought Lin Fan would surely go pick it up, since they all wished they could be Lin Fan right now, just go pick up the money and leave.
After all, today’s embarrassment has already been enough; a little more wouldn’t hurt. Losing some dignity for 80,000 yuan, it was totally worth it!
Lai Xiaoming looked like he had Lin Fan pegged, sneering, "Well, aren’t you going to hurry up and pick up the money? You talk big, but for a mere 80,000 yuan, it’s enough for you to buy two new Xiali cars!"
Jia Xiaoling muttered, "Lin Fan..."
She wouldn’t go pick up the money; she was entirely looking at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Come on, don’t play these childish games. Just 80,000 yuan and you expect me to bend over and pick it up? I won’t pick up your money nor will I leave. When I want to leave, I will leave on my own."
What?
Lin Fan actually didn’t want the 80,000 yuan?
Everyone was stunned, very surprised that Lin Fan could resist the temptation of 80,000 yuan!
This was 80,000 yuan. Even if Lin Fan was an amazing delivery guy making over ten thousand a month, this was more than half a year’s salary. How could he not be tempted?
"Lin Fan, he really is my idol. I wasn’t wrong about him," Jia Xiaoling thought, looking at Lin Fan, her eyes showing a trace of admiration, just like in high school.
Lai Xiaoming was somewhat embarrassed that Lin Fan didn’t go pick up the money. Wasn’t this slapping his face? He thought he could humiliate Lin Fan with money, but Lin Fan simply didn’t care!
"You brat, do you still think it’s too little!" Lai Xiaoming snorted coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 621: Keep Throwing
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Chapter 621: Keep Throwing
"No way, it’s already 80,000 dollars, and it’s still not enough!"
"This is just too greedy, insatiable greed, isn’t it?"
"This guy, seriously, if it were me, I’d have taken it and left right away..."
Everyone started discussing, wishing they could replace Lin Fan to pick up this money. After all, 80,000 dollars is a massive amount, especially for these students here, it’s practically astronomical, who wouldn’t be tempted!
Lai Xiaoming saw Lin Fan refusing to pick up the money, his first reaction was that Lin Fan thought it was too little.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Do I think it’s too little? Why don’t you continue throwing money on the ground to see, I actually want to see how much more you have, maybe if you throw out your entire fortune, I might be tempted."
Lai Xiaoming was so angry that his face turned red, of course, he couldn’t throw out his entire fortune.
He originally thought of showing off by throwing out 80,000 dollars to publicly humiliate Lin Fan. In his opinion, 80,000 dollars was already enough, sufficient to make Lin Fan, this delivery man, sell his dignity. Especially Jia Xiaoling, who was already neck-deep in debt, this 80,000 dollars would drive her mad.
However, Jia Xiaoling did not pick up the money.
Lin Fan also did not pick up the money.
This was embarrassing.
Right now, if he wanted to keep up this charade, he’d have to continue throwing money until Lin Fan was willing to bend down to pick it up.
But he couldn’t keep throwing money, firstly because he had run out of cash, and secondly, he couldn’t afford to shell out more, giving more exceeded what he could bear, and throwing more would hurt.
Seeing this, Lin Fan sneered and said, "What, not throwing anymore, are you out of money, or do you just not want to throw anymore, getting stingy after just 80,000 dollars? This won’t do, you call yourself a rich person?"
Lin Fan’s tone carried mockery.
Lai Xiaoming felt utterly humiliated, angrily said, "You brat, don’t be so smug, I said this is just my pocket money!"
Lin Fan said, "Oh, pocket money, you have a debit card besides pocket money, don’t you? Isn’t there money in your debit card? Come on, throw out a debit card, let’s see."
Everyone was looking at Lai Xiaoming, it was clear that Lai Xiaoming was showing off, everyone saw it, if Lai Xiaoming couldn’t throw out more money, no doubt it would mean a failed show-off.
With so many people watching, how could Lai Xiaoming possibly fail in showing off, where would he put his face then!
"Heh, this guy might be out of money!" Jia Xiaoling chuckled, adding fuel to the fire.
Lai Xiaoming was furious, how could he admit he was out of money, it didn’t align with his image as a rich person.
In a fit of rage, Lai Xiaoming pulled out a debit card from his bag, huffed, "It’s just money, I have plenty, this card has..."
Lai Xiaoming was just about to throw it.
"Stop!"
Lai Xiaomei stopped Lai Xiaoming, giving him a look, "Stop embarrassing yourself, pick up the money, don’t make it worse!"
Lai Xiaoming, the fool, didn’t even know he was being played by Lin Fan. However, Lai Xiaomei could see clearly that Lai Xiaoming was no match for Lin Fan and was being played like a monkey by Lin Fan.
Initially, Lai Xiaoming tried to use money to humiliate Lin Fan, but Lin Fan didn’t pick it up, the humiliation failed, the situation was then reversed by Lin Fan, who used a reverse psychology trick, baiting Lai Xiaoming to keep throwing money. If Lai Xiaoming refused to keep throwing, he would look bad, if he continued to throw money, it would lead to a financial loss, a bottomless pit of loss.
Lai Xiaoming merely wanted to show off, but ended up being led by the nose, turning from a show-off to a spectacle.
Lai Xiaomei had no choice but to intervene to save Lai Xiaoming, even if it meant letting him lose face, to minimize losses.
Lai Xiaoming had to listen to his sister. He said "oh" and put away the debit card, then walked over, bent down, and picked up the money from the ground, reluctantly stuffing it back into his bag.
It was truly embarrassing, originally intended to humiliate Lin Fan, making Lin Fan bend down to pick up the money, but in the end, it was he himself who bent down to pick up money, the clown turned out to be himself.
Who knew that 80,000 dollars couldn’t even tempt this poor guy Lin Fan, really!
Lai Xiaoming truly underestimated Lin Fan, not to mention Lin Fan is now a billionaire, even when Lin Fan was still a poor student, Madam Su tried to use 300,000 dollars to make Lin Fan leave Su Jinjin, and Lin Fan didn’t even care about Madam Su.
Much less now that Lin Fan is a billionaire, Lai Xiaoming’s mere 80,000 dollars is nothing to Lin Fan, and yet he wanted to humiliate Lin Fan, it’s simply dreaming.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Can’t even show off properly, trying to show off with just this little money, don’t make a fool of yourself."
"You!" Lai Xiaoming was infuriated, yet there was nothing he could do to Lin Fan.
This time it was truly embarrassing, and he even lost to Lin Fan, utterly disgraceful.
Lai Xiaomei took a deep look at Lin Fan, realizing she had underestimated Lin Fan. Although Lin Fan was just a deliveryman, he was not simple at all. Lai Xiaoming was being played around by Lin Fan like a monkey, standing no chance against him.
Lai Xiaomei could only continue to cover for her brother, smoothing things over, she said, "I think if we keep causing a scene here, it will completely disrupt the school anniversary, so I suggest we stop talking about it. Since Lin Fan and the others want to stay, let them do as they please, we should hand over the scene back to the principal!"
Lai Xiaomei blamed Lai Xiaoming in her heart, truly a pig teammate. Originally, Lin Fan was the negative example, to be mocked by the crowd, but now it turned out full of awkwardness for themselves.
Meng Xiaoming chuckled and said, "Junior Sister Lai is right, we’re taking up too much time here, I also agree to let this matter rest, Principal, what do you think?"
Principal Zhao wanted to end it quickly, smiled, and said, "Very well, so let’s not talk about this anymore, let’s continue the school anniversary activities. Besides Xiaoming and Xiaomei, we have several other outstanding alumni who were specially invited, let’s invite them up one by one."
Then, Principal Zhao continued to introduce the guests, bringing the scene’s rhythm back to the school anniversary activities. The previous incident was like an unpleasant episode, but it was finally over.
Liu Qiang, however, was clearly a bit unhappy. Originally, everyone was mocking Lin Fan, yet because of Lai Xiaoming’s slip-up, Lin Fan turned the tables, really quite displeased!
"Lin Fan, you have no other skills but a sharp tongue, too bad it’s useless, aren’t you just a poor loser, not even picking up 80,000 dollars, serves you right for being poor! Jia Xiaoling, this 80,000 dollars was enough to pay off your debt, you should blame Lin Fan, care about his face too much, now you still have to live through hard days!" Liu Qiang sneered.
Jia Xiaoling ignored Liu Qiang. Today, Liu Qiang had been stirring the pot, leading the rhythm quite a lot, truly annoying.
Lin Fan, however, simply smiled and said, "Liu Qiang, you are always against me, now both Xiaoling and I have been made into negative examples, humiliated in the middle, are you satisfied?"
Liu Qiang chuckled and said, "Of course, too bad it didn’t continue."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Remember your good mood at this moment, it might not last long."
Liu Qiang snorted, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan did not say another word.
Liu Qiang was puzzled, what exactly did Lin Fan mean by that? He couldn’t figure it out, just let out a heavy hum: "Trying to scare me, you think you can do something to me, just a deliveryman!"
At this time, after introducing a round of guests.
Principal Zhao said, "The above are the specially invited outstanding graduates we have today. Originally, there was another heavyweight guest we specially invited, but probably due to being busy with official duties, he couldn’t make it. He was also a student of our Tianhai Middle School, now holding a high position, maybe some students already know who he is, that’s right, it’s the current Mayor of Tianhai City, Long Dawu!"
"Who said I couldn’t make it, here I am, hahaha..."
A burst of hearty laughter, everyone looked towards the voice, and saw Mayor Long walking over.

chapters.title: Chapter 622: There is One Earth-Shattering Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Chapter 622: There is One Earth-Shattering Person
It turns out Mayor Long is also a former student of Tianhai Middle School. Many graduates from Tianhai Middle School have become outstanding talents, some have made a lot of money and become successful entrepreneurs, while others have ventured into politics.
Mayor Long’s status is very special and important, as he holds the position of mayor of Tianhai City, making his presence even more significant.
For this centennial celebration, Mayor Long is a heavyweight among the honored guests. However, previously he had mentioned being too busy with official duties and might not be able to attend, but would try to come.
The excitement had lasted for quite some time, yet Principal Zhao hadn’t seen Mayor Long arrive, thinking he wouldn’t come. Nevertheless, as a heavyweight guest and a pride of Tianhai Middle School, Principal Zhao still intended to mention him to highlight the prestige of Tianhai High School.
Just as Principal Zhao was about to speak, a voice was heard: "Who said I couldn’t come? Here I am, hahaha..."
The speaker was indeed Mayor Long, who walked over accompanied by his secretary.
Principal Zhao was pleasantly surprised: "The Mayor is here! Students, let’s applaud!"
Applause thundered.
Everyone gazed at him with admiration; a mayor was too impressive. As a graduate of Tianhai, he truly was a Dragon and Phoenix among people, the pride of the school, and an idol for younger students.
Principal Zhao jogged off the stage, very politely ushering Mayor Long onto the stage.
"Old Principal, you’re too courteous. I’m a student, you’re the principal, I shouldn’t accept such honors," Mayor Long said humbly.
Principal Zhao laughed and replied, "You’re the mayor, I’m the principal, but we must adhere to proper protocol."
It is said that one rank higher in government can be overpowering; the mayor is certainly more than one rank above the principal. While the relationship between them is teacher-student, regarding hierarchy, they are superior-subordinate, making the teacher-student relationship defer to rank.
These words might not be spoken openly, but they are understood as unspoken rules.
After Mayor Long took the stage, following the program, Principal Zhao invited him to speak.
Mayor Long casually said some encouraging words, reminisced a bit about his school days, and upon finishing his speech, the applause from the audience was thunderous.
