```
As the mayor, everyone wanted to curry favor with him. Meng Xiaoming, Lai Xiaomei, and others proactively approached to shake hands and chat with Mayor Long.
This centennial celebration could also be seen as a networking event, where outstanding talents connected, and successful people understood the primary importance of good relationships: more friends, more paths. Given they were alumni, a shared affinity existed, and such an opportunity would naturally not be missed.
No one would want to miss the chance to build a good relationship with the mayor.
Principal Zhao also stepped up proactively to introduce them to Mayor Long.
"Mayor, these are some of our school’s excellent graduates. They are special guests today; let me introduce them to you."
Principal Zhao introduced Meng Xiaoming, Lai Xiaomei, and others to Mayor Long.
"Mayor Long, I’ve admired you for a long time, and today, I finally got to meet you. It is a great honor," Meng Xiaoming said, extending his hand to Mayor Long.
Mayor Long replied with a smile, "You’re welcome. In terms of seniority, you’re my senior brother. Senior Brother Meng is a successful entrepreneur, very accomplished. I wonder if you have any plans to invest in Tianhai?"
"If the opportunity arises, certainly!" Meng Xiaoming chuckled, somewhat awkwardly, because it seemed he hadn’t planned to invest in Tianhai. Although Tianhai was his hometown, it was really too poor and lacking prospects.
Mayor Long laughed and said, "Then it’s settled. Let’s exchange business cards and schedule a time to discuss."
Although Meng Xiaoming had no such plans, he couldn’t outright refuse, so he said, "Alright, that depends on when the mayor is available."
The two exchanged business cards.
"Hello, Senior Brother Long. You’ve always been my idol and role model," Lai Xiaomei eagerly joined in.
Mayor Long smiled, "Oh really? Junior Sister Lai is very impressive. I’ve heard about your company."
Lai Xiaomei responded with a charming smile, "It’s true. When I was in high school, Senior Brother Long had already graduated years ago, but legends of Senior Brother Long still circulated in school. Senior Brother Long was a top student, and he got into the prestigious Jiangnan University. Many people set Senior Brother Long as their idol and goal, myself included."
Mayor Long laughed heartily, "You’re too kind."
Afterwards, others also came forward to meet Mayor Long.
Soon, the guests had all been introduced.
But Mayor Long furrowed his brow and asked Principal Zhao, "Old Principal, isn’t there one more guest who hasn’t appeared yet? Let me guess; he must be making an entrance as the mysterious guest, right? It must be him. Given his status, he truly deserves to be the mysterious guest."
"What?" Principal Zhao was puzzled, clearly not understanding Mayor Long’s remark, which seemed random and out of context. What did it mean?
The crowd also looked at each other in confusion. Was there a mysterious guest?
Who could it be?
Principal Zhao himself had no idea there was a mysterious guest, but Mayor Long saying so made it seem as if there should be someone like that, making Principal Zhao a bit uneasy: "Mayor Long, are you joking?"
Mayor Long replied with surprise, "Old Principal, are you kidding me?"
Principal Zhao wiped his cold sweat and awkwardly laughed, "Let’s put it this way, among all the guests here, the biggest one is you, Mr. Mayor. If we talk about a mysterious guest, it’s you. Otherwise, who else?"
Mayor Long was a bit surprised, "No way, Old Principal. I thought you knew, but it turns out you don’t? You look like you don’t know?"
Principal Zhao, still puzzled, asked, "What should I know, Mayor Long? Please clarify."
The crowd was also puzzled about what Mayor Long was talking about.
"There’s a mysterious guest? Can’t be, isn’t Mayor Long the mysterious guest himself?"
"Who else, other than Mayor Long, could deserve to be mysterious guest?"
"Could there be someone among the graduates more impressive than Mayor Long?"
"No way, if there were, how would the school not know!"
"I think the principal seems unaware. Otherwise, it would be impossible not to invite this person!"
"Exactly, I think that person doesn’t exist. What’s Mayor Long’s point, joking?"
"No way, what’s there to joke about in this matter, no need!"
The crowd began discussing.
Mayor Long paused for a moment and finally understood; it seemed no one present, including the old principal, knew about it. They didn’t know that among Tianhai Middle School graduates, there was a world-shaking figure!
This truly surprised him. How could Principal Zhao not know? Shouldn’t Principal Zhao have conducted investigations into past graduates? How could he not know?
In fact, he hadn’t planned to attend the centennial celebration today, but it was for this extraordinary person that he decided to come temporarily, only to be taken aback. Evidently, the principal didn’t know and hadn’t invited that person!
"Mayor, who are you talking about?" Principal Zhao asked again, genuinely curious. If there really was someone outstanding from Tianhai Middle School, he couldn’t possibly be unaware.
Mayor Long replied, "I’m talking about Lin Fan."
What?
The entire audience was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 623: The Truly Important Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Chapter 623: The Truly Important Identity
When Mayor Long mentioned Lin Fan’s name, everyone present was stunned.
What the hell?
Lin Fan?
The person that Mayor Long spoke of, was actually Lin Fan? Why Lin Fan? How could it be Lin Fan?
Because they all happened to know Lin Fan, they had just met him. Previously, Lin Fan wasn’t a standout at Tianhai Middle School and had no reputation. It was mentioned before that Lin Fan’s high school grades were only average and not eye-catching. Lin Fan was handsome, but nowadays, young girls adore those delicate pretty boys; Lin Fan’s sunny, handsome type wasn’t popular, which is why he wasn’t famous for his looks at school.
Yet just now, Lin Fan instantly became known by the entire school, but of course, it wasn’t a good thing.
After graduation, Lin Fan became a delivery man, and became the negative example in everyone’s eyes. As a representative of success, Meng Xiaoming, the vice president of Orange Airlines, used Lin Fan as an example to educate the younger students.
Meng Xiaoming taught the younger students not to follow in Lin Fan’s footsteps, saying that Lin Fan must have been inattentive during school, not striving to progress, and just lazed around. After graduation, he had no skills, couldn’t get into a large company, couldn’t become a white-collar worker, and couldn’t earn money, resulting in him becoming a delivery man with a low entry barrier.
Meng Xiaoming took the opportunity to motivate the younger students to work hard and not become like Lin Fan.
Because Jia Xiaoling stood up for Lin Fan, she was also labeled as a negative example. Lai Xiaomei criticized Jia Xiaoling for marrying too early, resulting in today’s hardships. As a new era female, one shouldn’t marry too quickly and should focus on their career when young.
Lin Fan and Jia Xiaoling, two underachievers, instantly became known figures as disgraced representatives to everyone present.
Everyone felt superior in front of them because they were seen as failures, and nobody took their words seriously.
Yet at this moment, everyone inadvertently heard Mayor Long praising Lin Fan, completely unexpected. What was going on?
"Lin Fan? What about Lin Fan?" Principal Zhao asked while wiping cold sweat, feeling a sense of something amiss, but not yet clear what it was.
Mayor Long said, "Old Principal, you didn’t know, huh? From everyone’s expressions, they seem to not know either, don’t you really know Lin Fan’s identity?"
Principal Zhao said, "Lin Fan’s identity? Isn’t Lin Fan just a delivery man? Everyone here knows that."
Mayor Long was stunned, no way, the misunderstanding was this big.
"How could it be? Old Principal, where did you hear that Lin Fan is a delivery man?" Mayor Long curiously asked.
Principal Zhao said, "A student just said so, isn’t it?"
Just now, Liu Qiang publicly announced that Lin Fan was a delivery man, and Lin Fan himself didn’t deny it, so everyone knew Lin Fan was a delivery man and began criticizing him.
Mayor Long slapped his thigh, "The misunderstanding is huge, Old Principal, how could Lin Fan be a delivery man! There’s such a big misunderstanding, it’s unbelievable, how could such a misunderstanding happen."
Principal Zhao asked, "Then... Mayor Long, what exactly is Lin Fan’s identity?"
Mayor Long said, "Lin Fan’s identity is really impressive, I just found out this morning, and it’s earth-shattering, truly incredible, yet it’s true!"
Everyone exchanged glances, no way, with Mayor Long speaking of Lin Fan so highly, could Lin Fan really be that incredible? Impossible, right? Lin Fan was wearing bargain market clothes, clearly a poor guy, how could he be so amazing?
Mayor Long continued, "At first, I didn’t believe it either, I said how could it be, but Mr. Chen was certain, so we investigated, and what we found shocked the entire city government."
Principal Zhao asked, "Wait, Mr. Chen is?"
Mayor Long said, "Oh, well, today Old Ma gathered some investors and hosted them at the investment bureau to discuss investments, as we are committed to developing Tianhai’s economy. I wasn’t planning to attend the school anniversary today because of the clash with the investors. I prioritize Tianhai’s development, so I had to miss it. Mr. Chen is one of the investors. He recognized Lin Fan this morning."
Saw Lin Fan this morning?
Principal Zhao was puzzled, what was the story here? Why did Mr. Chen encounter Lin Fan in the morning?
Wasn’t Lin Fan a delivery man? How could he intersect with these wealthy investors?
Realizing something, Principal Zhao said understandingly, "I get it, it’s because Lin Fan delivered food to you, that’s why Mr. Chen saw him, right?"
Mayor Long broke into a sweat, "Old Principal, why are you so fixated on him being a delivery man, Lin Fan isn’t a delivery man. He went to the investment bureau today to treat someone. As to who he treated, let me keep that a secret, it’s inconvenient to say, but it was a house call, and Mr. Chen recognized him there. After Mr. Chen mentioned it to us, we were shocked and investigated."
Principal Zhao was increasingly confused, as was everyone else.
"Mayor, I’m confused, Lin Fan isn’t a delivery man, is he a doctor? Otherwise, why would he make house calls?" Principal Zhao asked.
Speaking of Doctor Lin Fan, Mayor Long showed a deeply impressed expression, "He is indeed a doctor, and an amazing one at that, a miracle doctor. If I hadn’t seen it myself, I wouldn’t have believed it. I started with suspicion until I saw him save a dying person. Then I knew his medical skill was extraordinary."
The entire audience was in shock, and it was exceptionally quiet for a moment.
What the hell was going on?
The Lin Fan that Mayor Long mentioned and the delivery man Lin Fan they knew were completely two different people, the disparity was too vast, how could this be?
Miracle doctor?
Lin Fan is a miracle doctor?
Principal Zhao’s voice was trembling, "Mayor, is Lin Fan really a miracle doctor? No way, if he were a miracle doctor, how come we didn’t know during the student background check?"
Mayor Long said, "I was surprised too, I thought you knew, thought you’d invited Lin Fan, so I took some time to come and chat with him as an alumnus, but turns out you didn’t know."
Principal Zhao was a bit anxious, "I really didn’t know, this..."
Mayor Long said, "No worries, maybe your investigation overlooked something, although this is quite a big overlook. Actually, it’s understandable you don’t know Lin Fan is a miracle doctor, perhaps because he rarely takes action or is a village doctor without fame. But you also don’t know his truly important identity, which really surprised me."
Principal Zhao broke into a cold sweat, what? Lin Fan besides being a miracle doctor, also has a "truly important identity?"
"Mayor, what is his truly important identity?" Principal Zhao asked, wiping cold sweat.

chapters.title: Chapter 624: This is your car key
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Chapter 624: This is your car key
Lin Fan is actually a miracle doctor?
Everyone present was greatly surprised. This completely overturned their impression of Lin Fan. Before this, they all thought Lin Fan was a delivery rider, and they mocked him with cold sarcasm.
And that’s not all. From the looks of Mayor Long, Lin Fan’s identity is far more than just a miracle doctor. This title alone isn’t enough to make Mayor Long hold Lin Fan in such high esteem.
Everyone couldn’t help but become curious about what other identities Lin Fan could have for Mayor Long to speak of him so highly?
Seeing this, the people who previously belittled Lin Fan—Meng Xiaoming, Lai Xiaomei, Lai Xiaoming, Principal Zhao, Liu Qiang, and others—all began to feel uneasy.
They were all eager to find out just who Lin Fan actually was.
Meng Xiaoming couldn’t help but scrutinize him closely and suddenly, it seemed like he discovered something. His heart skipped a beat, and an idea popped into his mind, causing his face to change color involuntarily.
"No way, no way, how could it be possible!" Meng Xiaoming’s mind was exploding internally. He had a bold idea, one that shocked him to the point of tingling all over his scalp—it’s impossible, absolutely impossible!
"Mayor, besides being a miracle doctor, who else is Lin Fan?" Principal Zhao couldn’t help but ask at this moment.
Mayor Long was about to speak but then he followed Principal Zhao’s gaze and caught sight of Lin Fan. Mayor Long was momentarily stunned to find that Lin Fan had also come to the scene, merely watching from the sidelines.
"Mr. Lin, so you also came to the scene!"
Mayor Long immediately showed respect, quickly stepped off the stage, and walked toward Lin Fan.
Lin Fan felt a sweat break out. With his low-key personality, he originally didn’t want to reveal his identity. Even though everyone mocked him today, using him as a negative example, he didn’t intend to argue.
Otherwise, he would have long publicly disclosed everything already. He didn’t mind these things—no matter what they said or joked about, as long as he knew who he was, their ridicule seemed laughable to him.
The poor one is embarrassed!
They could mock him all they wanted, it wouldn’t hurt him in the slightest.
He didn’t care, so he had no plans to argue. Unexpectedly, Mayor Long also attended the school celebration and specifically mentioned him. It seemed that this time there was no way to keep a low profile.
Mayor Long quickly reached Lin Fan, warmly extending his hand to shake Lin Fan’s hand proactively.
"Mr. Lin, I want to apologize for my previous offense. I had doubts before not believing in Mr. Lin’s medical skill, I’m very sorry," Mayor Long said with a face full of apology.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, Mayor. There’s no need to take such things to heart."
Mayor Long said, "Mr. Lin is truly magnanimous. That’s what’s called having perspective! Mr. Lin, I was very shocked when Mr. Chen mentioned you, and I felt even more honored to learn that you and I are alumni."
Lin Fan said, "Then I should address you as Senior Brother, Mayor."
Mayor Long laughed heartily: "Junior Lin really surpasses his master! Junior Lin, Mr. Lin, come up to the stage with me quickly."
Mayor Long grabbed Lin Fan’s hand.
Lin Fan declined, "No need, Senior Brother, you’re being too polite. In fact, I was just about to leave."
Mayor Long quickly said, "How can this be? Mr. Lin, you’re the most impressive individual in the history of Tianhai Middle School. How can you leave just like that? Please come to the stage."
Seeing no way to refuse, Lin Fan had to nod his head and follow Mayor Long onto the stage. After all, the other party was the mayor, so Lin Fan gave him that bit of face.
If Lin Fan were to refuse persistently, it would indeed embarrass Mayor Long. This was a matter of social niceties. Lin Fan’s home is in Tianhai City, so there was no need to cross Mayor Long for such a trivial matter. Giving Mayor Long face would, in turn, grant Mayor Long face.
As expected, Mayor Long was very pleased to see Lin Fan willing to join him on stage. Mr. Lin’s perspective was truly different, no wonder he was so impressive.
Once Lin Fan and Mayor Long stepped onto the stage, everyone’s eyes instantly focused on Lin Fan. Lin Fan’s mysterious identity was about to be revealed, and everyone was intensely curious.
"Who is he after all? Damn, how could the mayor be so attentive? This isn’t good," Liu Qiang muttered, his face turning a bit unsightly. Among everyone, he had criticized Lin Fan the most enthusiastically. The more energetic he had been before, the more apprehensive he felt now.
Jia Xiaoling was already stunned. What, the mayor is actually this enthusiastic toward Lin Fan—what’s going on?
"Isn’t he a delivery rider? What the hell is going on?" Lai Xiaoming muttered, feeling very uncomfortable with this situation.
"What’s happening?" Lai Xiaomei looked at Lin Fan in astonishment, unable to imagine how this rural-looking Lin Fan could command such respect from the mayor.
Meanwhile, Meng Xiaoming’s face grew increasingly pale, with cold sweat emerging on his forehead. His mind was still exploding internally. No way, no way, no way, could it be...
Principal Zhao also broke into a cold sweat. He initially held onto a sliver of hope, but seeing the mayor personally walk offstage to greet Lin Fan, he began to panic a little—indeed, a little panicky. This wasn’t normal; if Lin Fan’s identity were simple, the mayor definitely wouldn’t do this.
Principal Zhao couldn’t help but ask again: "Mayor Long, Lin Fan, he actually..."
Ring ring ring...
Just then, Lin Fan’s phone suddenly rang.
Lin Fan took out his phone and said, "Excuse me, I need to take this call."
With that, Lin Fan answered, "Yes, I’m at Tianhai Middle School, currently a bit busy. How about you wait for me outside? Oh, you’re not available? Fine, come on in."
He hung up the phone.
Followed by the sound of a car engine, everyone couldn’t help but turn their heads to look. They saw a Rolls-Royce Cullinan smoothly drive into the school and park just outside the playground.
Luxury car!
Good heavens, it’s a luxury car!
"Cullinan?"
"Gosh, to see a Rolls-Royce in our Tianhai City!"
"No way, is this for real? It’s really a Rolls-Royce Cullinan!"
"I heard this car is 8 million. Who can afford such an amazing car? It must be some rich tycoon!"
"Who on earth is it? Who’s coming?"
For a while, everyone was abuzz, all staring at the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, extremely curious about the identity of its owner.
Then the door of the Cullinan opened, and a man in a suit stepped out. From his attire, he looked like a salesperson or something.
But the crowd didn’t know that—they all assumed he was some immortal being.
"Who is he?"
"Which tycoon is he, such a young tycoon?"
"Could he be a fellow alumnus of Tianhai Middle School? An alumnus driving a Rolls-Royce, how come I don’t know him!"
Seeing the man in the suit get out of the car, he looked around as if searching for someone. Suddenly, his eyes landed on Lin Fan on the stage, and he smiled, quickly jogging over, and directly ran onto the stage.
"Mr. Lin, my apologies for the disturbance. I’m just a bit busy and had to interrupt briefly. Mr. Lin, I brought your Rolls-Royce Cullinan that you left with us. Here is your car key."
The man in the suit said respectfully, holding out the Cullinan key with both hands.
Everyone present was instantly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 625: Be More Low-key
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Chapter 625: Be More Low-key
The entire venue was in shock, and a sudden silence enveloped the place as countless eyes focused on the stage at this astonishing scene.
What’s going on?
This man in the suit, everyone thought he was someone important, after all, he arrived in a Rolls-Royce Cullinan!
Who knew!
This man directly walked onto the stage and respectfully handed the keys of the Rolls-Royce Cullinan to Lin Fan!
Damn!
This Rolls-Royce Cullinan actually belongs to Lin Fan?
This is too shocking, how is it possible, isn’t Lin Fan a delivery guy? Even if he’s not a delivery guy, he’s a miracle doctor, but he’s just a rural village doctor, how could he own an 8 million Rolls-Royce Cullinan?
This doesn’t make sense!
What is Lin Fan’s real identity anyway?
"An 8 million Rolls-Royce Cullinan..."
Little Ming muttered, his eyes wide with disbelief, feeling his suspicions further confirmed, almost going crazy, it can’t be, no way...
Lin Fan remained calm, he originally intended to keep a low profile, but it seemed that wasn’t possible this time, which wasn’t a big deal, he didn’t have to be low-key at all costs.
Lin Fan reached out for the Rolls-Royce Cullinan keys, then took out Xia Li’s car keys from his pocket and handed them to the man in the suit.
"Here are the keys, the car is parked outside the school gate, next to the kiosk, you’ll see it when you get there," Lin Fan smiled and said.
The man in the suit said, "Alright, Mr. Lin, it was a great pleasure working with you, I’ll be on my way then."
"Wait a moment," Mayor Long said, "What’s going on here?"
The man in the suit then noticed Mayor Long and froze, exclaiming, "Mayor!"
Mayor Long asked, "What’s this all about, tell us the story."
He was the mayor after all, and the man in the suit was intimidated, he couldn’t refuse to speak when the mayor asked him to explain!
So the man in the suit started, "Mayor, I’m the business manager at Xiazhou Rental, here’s what happened, it all started a few days ago..."
A few days earlier, at the Tianhai branch of Xiazhou Rental.
The man in the suit was working with colleagues in the store, and the car rental business was doing quite well at the time. Xiazhou Rental was a big company, but in Tianhai, the business was just so-so, and there weren’t many customers in the store.
While everyone was feeling bored.
Suddenly, the sound of a melodious engine caught their attention, and when they looked over, they saw a Rolls-Royce Cullinan driving up.
This sight instantly energized everyone in the store.
Hell!
Am I seeing this right, it’s a Rolls-Royce?
And it’s an 8 million Rolls-Royce Cullinan!
In Tianhai, how many people could afford such a luxury car, the answer would be likely none!
In Tianhai City, luxury cars weren’t unheard of, you could run into brands like BMW and Audi, there were even a few BMWs and Audis available for rent at the Xiazhou Rental store.
But a Rolls-Royce Cullinan!
It’s a rare sight in all of Tianhai!
"Who is this? Which Rich Second Generation, that’s amazing!"
"It seems like they’re coming our way, what’s going on here?"
"Oh my, a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, an 8 million luxury car, but who in Tianhai is known to have such a car?"
The crowd was full of chatter, and for a moment, everyone looked at the Rolls-Royce Cullinan as if it were a treasure.
The Rolls-Royce Cullinan stopped in front of the store, and Lin Fan got out, casually toying with the Cullinan’s keys, and walked into the store.
If Lin Fan hadn’t come in a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, given his outfit of cheap street vendor clothes, everyone would have thought he was a pauper, but since he came in a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, they automatically overlooked his inexpensive attire.
What’s it to be concerned about clothing, they’ve heard that rich people nowadays prefer to be low-key, Lin Fan must be like that too.
"Sir, I’m the business manager here, my name is Li, how can I help you?" the man in the suit hurriedly went up, asking respectfully.
Lin Fan said, "Here’s the thing, I want to rent a car from you, do you have any?"
Lin Fan felt that driving a Rolls-Royce Cullinan back to the village was too ostentatious, being naturally low-key, he wanted to switch to a more understated car.
Rent a car?
Came to rent a car?
Everyone was a bit surprised, the owner of a Rolls-Royce Cullinan came here to rent a car?
The man in the suit laughed, "Renting a car, yes of course, may I know your name, sir?"
Lin Fan replied, "The surname’s Lin."
The man in the suit said, "Mr. Lin, may I know what kind of car you want to rent?"
Lin Fan said, "Well, I think driving my Rolls-Royce Cullinan is a bit too high-profile, I want to switch to a car, the more low-key the better, what cars do you have?"
Wants to lay low!
Everyone immediately understood.
Indeed, rich people now prefer to keep a low profile, not flaunting their wealth, it’s understandable.
"We have many brands to choose from at Xiazhou Rental, Mr. Lin, you can pick any. Since you want something low-key, you might consider a BMW or an Audi, they are quite common in Tianhai City, should be low-key enough, and won’t compromise your status..." the man in the suit started introducing them to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan immediately noticed an old and worn-out Xia Li.
Lin Fan smiled contentedly, "I think this car is nice, I’ll take this one."
What?
Everyone was flabbergasted!
Lin Fan wanted to be low-key, but not this low-key, this shabby Xia Li, so worn out it was practically ready for scrap. Indeed, the only reason this car was still at the station was for scrapping, to fill the scrap quota.
Lin Fan picked this Xia Li out, so low-key!
"Mr. Lin, are you sure you want to rent this Xia Li?" the man in the suit wiped his cold sweat and asked.
Lin Fan replied, "Yes, I’ll take it, I’m driving back to the countryside, this car just needs to be drivable, no need for a BMW, in a rural area, a BMW is still too high-profile."
The man in the suit had no choice but to say, "Alright then..."
Lin Fan said, "By the way, I want to leave this Rolls-Royce Cullinan with you for now, is that alright? You can charge whatever fee you want."
The man in the suit said, "Of course, no problem at all."
Thus, Lin Fan left the Rolls-Royce Cullinan at the store and drove away with that old, decrepit Xia Li.
"The games of the rich, I really can’t understand!"
The man in the suit and his colleagues all broke out in a cold sweat.
A few days later, when the agreed time came to remind Lin Fan whether he wanted to continue renting the car, Lin Fan declined, then the man in the suit suggested returning the Rolls-Royce Cullinan to Lin Fan and retrieving the Xia Li.
"Mr. Lin, Mayor, that’s the whole story, if there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave," the man in the suit said and then excused himself and left.
The entire scene was very quiet!
So this Rolls-Royce is really Lin Fan’s, and the reason Lin Fan was driving the Xia Li before was just to be low-key, so he exchanged a Rolls-Royce for a Xia Li!
My god!
On the stage and off, Liu Qiang and others were all pale-faced.
"Mr. Lin, may I ask, besides this Rolls-Royce Cullinan, do you happen to have another car, a 70 million Kosak?"
Beside him, Meng Xiaoming suddenly asked.
What?
Besides the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, Lin Fan also owns another super luxury car worth 70 million?
Everyone was stunned and speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 626: Trillionaire God豪
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Chapter 626: Trillionaire God豪
A luxury car worth 8 million was shocking enough, but now it’s revealed that Lin Fan might also own a super luxury car worth 70 million, leaving the entire room petrified.
Can this be true?
When Little Ming asked this question, his voice had a slight tremble. He mainly asked to confirm his own crazy speculation.
With Lin Fan’s low-key approach, he certainly wouldn’t voluntarily tell others he had another super luxury car worth 70 million, but if asked, Lin Fan saw no need to deny it.
So, everyone watched as Lin Fan nodded.
"I do indeed have a Kosak," Lin Fan said with a smile.
"Ah! It really is you, it really is you!"
Meng Xiaoming was so shocked he nearly sat down in disbelief.
There couldn’t be a mistake. Someone who owns an 8 million Rolls-Royce Cullinan and a 70 million Kosak could only be that person!
"How is it possible? How could he be so rich? This can’t be true, it must be fake!"
Lai Xiaoming and Liu Qiang were nearly losing their minds.
Lai Xiaomei’s lips trembled slightly. She, too, had a bold guess, a guess so daring she almost didn’t dare to think it.
Principal Zhao was trembling as well, my God, Lin Fan is actually so extraordinary. Is this real? How is this possible? Wasn’t he a delivery man!
Owning a luxury car worth 70 million, what does this imply?
It implies that this person possesses unimaginable wealth. Who can casually buy a luxury car worth 70 million? If not super-rich, who would spend 70 million on a car!
Being able to buy a luxury car worth 70 million means that 70 million to this person is just pocket change.
So, exactly how rich is this person!
"Mayor, what is Lin Fan’s other identity?" Principal Zhao asked, his voice trembling intensely.
Nervous!
This word perfectly described Principal Zhao’s mood.
On one hand, he realized Lin Fan’s identity must be astonishing, on the other hand, recalling how they treated Lin Fan earlier, offending someone who should not be offended, wouldn’t they be nervous!
Mayor Long was about to speak.
But Meng Xiaoming, who looked a bit pale, already spoke out: "He is the richest man in Yun City."
The entire audience was dumbfounded.
What?
The richest man in Yun City?
Lin Fan is the richest man in Yun City?
This news was like a thunderbolt exploding above everyone’s heads, leaving everyone stupefied.
Yun City is a major city located in Jiangnan, existing as an independent entity on par with a province, meaning Lin Fan being the richest of Yun City equal to being the richest of a province!
Leaping from a delivery person to the richest man, this jump is just too immense, and many people couldn’t accept it at once.
"Senior Brother Meng, what did you say, is he really the richest man in Yun City?" Lai Xiaomei trembled as she spoke.
She had a bold idea just before, guessing that Lin Fan might be a billionaire.
This idea seemed unimaginable to her, but now, Meng Xiaoming was telling her she still thought too simply, Lin Fan turned out to be the richest man in Yun City!
How is this possible, how did Lin Fan achieve this?
"He’s the richest man in Yun City? It must be a joke, it has to be a joke, hahaha..." Lai Xiaoming exclaimed loudly, looking like he was about to go mad.
However, Mayor Long’s face was serious as he spoke: "We’ve investigated, he is indeed the richest man in Yun City, owning the Mortal Group with a market value of 200 billion, additional traceable assets include a 10 billion island, a 3 billion mansion, an entire building of Tangchen Yipin worth tens of billions, etc., and these are just some of the traceable assets..."
The entire room fell into silence.
An island worth 10 billion!
A mansion worth 3 billion!
An entire Tangchen Yipin building!
Heaven, having any one of these already makes one a billionaire, yet Lin Fan has them all, along with unknown assets!
The most impressive is the Mortal Group with a market value of 200 billion!
This means Lin Fan is a trillionaire!
A trillionaire!
Those billionaires suddenly seem insignificant before a trillionaire!
Meng Xiaoming looked ashen as he said: "Under the Mortal Group, Celestial Aviation is already a giant in the private aviation sector. Originally, our Orange Airlines and Celestial Aviation were on par, but since Mr. Lin invested and took control of Celestial, its stock price soared, leaving our Orange Airlines far behind, in the private aviation industry, Lin Fan is a legend, I should have recognized long ago, I should have recognized long ago..."
He deeply regretted not recognizing Lin Fan earlier, leading to making a huge mistake.
He actually dared to use Lin Fan as a negative example, if Lin Fan is considered a negative example, then what could possibly be considered a positive one!
With both Mayor Long and Meng Xiaoming’s testimony, even if the audience wanted to disbelieve, they simply couldn’t, Lin Fan truly is Yun City’s richest man, a trillionaire!
Heaven, this is truly astonishing.
For a moment, the entire scene fell silent.
"Lin Fan, you yourself speak up, is what they say true?"
At this moment, Jia Xiaoling couldn’t help but ask, she, like everyone else, was incredibly shocked.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Alright, I generally like to keep a low profile, didn’t want to talk about this identity of mine, but since it’s exposed, I might as well lay it all out, no more hiding, what Mayor Long and Senior Brother Meng said is true."
He personally admitted it!
No more denying it!
Jia Xiaoling showed a delighted expression, looking at Lin Fan with admiration in her eyes: "As expected, he is my male god, truly amazing, just absolutely amazing, I always knew my male god wouldn’t end up poorly!"
Back in high school, Lin Fan was already Jia Xiaoling’s male god. The mainstream aesthetic for young girls was those delicate heartthrobs, but not Jia Xiaoling, she always found Lin Fan extremely handsome and masculine, she liked that masculine handsomeness.
She admired Lin Fan, already in high school, she believed Lin Fan would become successful in the future.
She once mustered the courage to confess to Lin Fan, and although she was gently rejected by Lin Fan, she wasn’t very sad, as she felt she indeed was not worthy of Lin Fan, Lin Fan deserved a better girl.
To stop herself from being overly infatuated, she purposefully kept some distance from Lin Fan, later marrying someone, an ordinary Mortal, while Lin Fan was her male god, she felt as if she went from a fairyland to the mundane world, finally accepting reality.
Honestly, when she found out Lin Fan was a delivery person, she didn’t feel good, moreover, when Lin Fan faced jeers, it only made her sadder.
At this moment, finding out Lin Fan was actually a trillionaire, the richest man in Yun City, Jia Xiaoling felt proud and relieved, finally proving she wasn’t wrong, Lin Fan indeed became successful!
Jia Xiaoling then turned to glance at Liu Qiang, chuckling: "Liu Qiang, you stepped on Lin Fan so hard earlier, what about now?"
Liu Qiang’s face was flushed, he was terrified, the extent to which he stepped on Lin Fan just now was the extent to which he was afraid now.
How could he not be afraid, Lin Fan is a trillionaire, even the mayor respects him so much, if Lin Fan wanted to settle accounts for what happened just now, it would only take a snap of his fingers, and Liu Qiang would be obliterated.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 Mr. Lin is Absolutely Right
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Chapter 627 Mr. Lin is Absolutely Right
Like Liu Qiang, Lai Xiaoming was also terrified; he was almost scared out of his wits. Thinking back to when he thought Lin Fan was a delivery guy and how arrogantly he treated him, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of dread.
As the billionaire Lin Fan, if he were to hold a grudge, Lai Xiaoming would be utterly defenseless.
At this moment, Mayor Long was already on stage, having a conversation with Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, I originally didn’t plan to attend the school anniversary, but upon hearing you were my fellow alumnus and might attend, I decided to come. It’s truly an honor to meet you," Mayor Long said with a smile.
Lin Fan smiled back, "The Mayor is too kind, I don’t deserve such praise."
Mayor Long continued, "Mr. Lin, if I may ask boldly, is there any plan on your part to develop in Tianhai City?"
Lin Fan knew that Mayor Long was approaching him mostly because of investment. As Yun City’s wealthiest man and a billionaire, it was no surprise that Mayor Long would covet such a prize.
Currently, Secretary Ma and Mayor Long are racking their brains to develop Tianhai City’s economy, but the results haven’t been very promising. Many investors haven’t shown interest in developing in Tianhai City.
If Lin Fan, Yun City’s wealthiest person, would take the lead, it would be different. It could create an effect where investors would flock to invest. With the influx of capital, Tianhai’s situation would improve, and it would create a better investment environment, attracting more investment in a virtuous cycle.
The key to this is Lin Fan!
How could Mayor Long not value Lin Fan!
He even considered visiting Lin Fan personally in the countryside. Learning that Lin Fan was an alumnus and might attend the school celebration, he dropped everything and came over.
If he could secure Lin Fan, it would be a monumental achievement.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I’m back because of family matters in my hometown. As for developing in Tianhai, I currently don’t have such plans."
Mayor Long’s heart skipped a beat, no plans!
This was like a bucket of cold water over his head.
However...
Lin Fan continued, "However, Tianhai is my hometown, and I hope my hometown gets better and better. I will look into it later, and if suitable, I will return to invest. My company also plans to build a factory, and we are looking for a suitable location, with an investment scale of about a billion."
Hearing this, Mayor Long instantly perked up, oh my, a billion-scale investment!
If Lin Fan’s project really fell into Tianhai, it would be a tremendous contribution, boosting local employment, economy, and attracting more investment, opening a whole new perspective for Tianhai City’s development.
"Mr. Lin, please consider Tianhai City. Tianhai’s development needs you. If there is anything you need to know, don’t hesitate to ask me, I’m available 24/7," Mayor Long hurriedly said.
Lin Fan nodded, "Okay."
Mayor Long was in a great mood. While it might be difficult for other places to win over Lin Fan, Tianhai had a considerable chance due to it being his hometown. As long as they didn’t offend Lin Fan, investment was just a matter of time.
Yun City’s wealthiest coming to Tianhai to invest would be an effective living advertisement, more potent than any promotional campaign. He and Secretary Ma have been in a flurry to attract investment, yet all their hard work might not compare to Lin Fan just taking the lead.
"Mr. Lin..."
At this point, Meng Xiaoming approached nervously, smiling awkwardly, "I’ve long heard of Mr. Lin’s name. Mr. Lin is a legend in aviation, I’ve admired you for a long time and only today got to meet you in person..."
Lin Fan said, "I’ve also heard of President Meng; I just didn’t expect we were schoolmates."
Meng Xiaoming immediately laughed, "Yes, I also didn’t expect to be schoolmates with Mr. Lin. It’s such an honor, truly an honor."
Pausing, Meng Xiaoming showed an apologetic expression, "Mr. Lin, what I said earlier was wrong, I’m truly sorry..."
He had no choice but to apologize; the psychological pressure was immense. Thinking back to using Lin Fan as a negative example, he regretted it deeply and wanted to slap himself.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "It’s quite okay for President Meng to use me as a negative example to encourage students to study hard."
Meng Xiaoming was in a cold sweat; Lin Fan’s words sounded ironic no matter how he listened.
"Mr. Lin, I didn’t recognize a great man when I saw one; I was short-sighted. Mr. Lin is not a negative example, I truly misunderstood," Meng Xiaoming laughed nervously, displaying a strong will to survive.
Lin Fan said, "President Meng, don’t be nervous. Actually, what you told the students was mostly right. Indeed, during studies, one should focus on improving their professional knowledge and not just idly pass the time. But there’s one thing I want to add."
Meng Xiaoming hurriedly said, "Please, Mr. Lin, go ahead."
Lin Fan said, "Effort is certainly important, but something more important than effort is choice. Choose right, and you get twice the result with half the effort; choose wrong, and your efforts might be in vain."
Meng Xiaoming nodded vigorously, "What Mr. Lin says is truly insightful, so correct, practically an eternal truth! I was too superficial. Classmates, you should listen to Mr. Lin."
He led the applause.
The classmates responded one after another, and soon applause erupted.
Lin Fan found it amusing. As expected, losers didn’t have a voice. If he were still a penniless delivery guy, would Meng Xiaoming care about his words?
Now, Meng Xiaoming was practically eager to sing his praises.
It was too realistic.
He suspected that even if he let out a fart, Meng Xiaoming would say it smelled sweet; that’s the halo of a billionaire, and with that halo, Meng Xiaoming could only grovel.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "I also think what I said makes sense. To give a simple example, many people, even after working hard all their lives, can’t become a deputy general manager of a group because they lack resources and connections. It’s hard to climb up, but President Meng, you became the son-in-law of a company executive, gained connections, and quickly rose through the ranks to become the deputy general manager of the group, even though your performance at the company was among the lowest back then. Am I right?"
Hearing this, everyone burst into laughter.
Meng Xiaoming blushed, but with Lin Fan teasing him, he didn’t dare to protest, only to laugh it off awkwardly, "Yes, yes, Mr. Lin is absolutely right."
All the while selling motivational platitudes, telling people to strive and improve, but hadn’t revealed the true reason for his success. Now being exposed by Lin Fan on the spot, he could only laugh along, too afraid to retort.
The billionaire is just that impressive.
"Clap clap clap..."
Suddenly, Principal Zhao began to applaud from the side.
"Brilliant, absolutely brilliant. Mr. Lin, your words are simply superb, immensely insightful. This is what truly high-level speech looks like!" Principal Zhao laughed heartily.
Everyone looked at Principal Zhao amusingly.
Principal Zhao was also using Lin Fan as a negative example earlier, and now he was praising Lin Fan. It seems, after all, money is a universal truth!

chapters.title: Chapter 628: You Failed
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Chapter 628: You Failed
"Mr. Lin, I want to apologize to you here. Our school has produced the richest person in Yun City, and I didn’t even know. This is a dereliction of duty as a principal, and it really shouldn’t have happened. This mistake is just too big."
Principal Zhao said with deep remorse.
The older the ginger, the spicier it is. Principal Zhao didn’t mention a word about using Lin Fan as a negative example earlier, as if it never happened.
"Luckily, with Mayor Long’s reminder, we learned about this exciting news, sparing us any regrets. As an outstanding graduate of our school, Mr. Lin certainly deserves the appropriate treatment. I now announce that Mr. Lin is the top special guest for this centennial school celebration! Students, our school has produced the richest person in Yun City, the biggest achievement since its inception. Mr. Lin is the pride of Tianhai Middle School, a role model for students to learn from. Let’s welcome Mr. Lin with a round of applause to participate in our school celebration."
Principal Zhao said, taking the lead in clapping.
All at once, applause thundered.
"Wow, Senior Brother Lin is so awesome, the richest in Yun City, so wealthy!"
"A billionaire god of wealth, I can’t even imagine!"
"Senior Brother Lin is simply god-like, I declare Senior Brother Lin as my idol!"
"Have you noticed how handsome Senior Brother Lin is?"
"I noticed early on, even though Senior Brother Lin dresses ordinarily, he can’t hide his exceptional handsomeness!"
"What do you know, Senior Brother Lin embodies simplicity and returning to one’s roots!"
"Exactly, Senior Brother Lin’s realm is so high, he’s simply a deity, unreachable for us mortals!"
Classmates chattered, all showing a look of admiration for Lin Fan.
It’s as if nothing happened before, when Lin Fan was considered a "negative example," they all had a sense of superiority, looking down and examining Lin Fan from above.
Now, they kneel, devoutly fawning over him, as if Lin Fan is the god they worship.
Lin Fan looked at this scene, feeling suddenly a bit nauseous.
This is what it means to be obsequious after arrogance, what it means to favor the rich and disdain the poor, this is the real face of reality.
Lin Fan wanted to leave, the longer he stayed, the more he felt he might actually vomit.
"Lin Fan, my brother wants to apologize to you."
Lai Xiaomei then pulled Lai Xiaomei over to Lin Fan.
At that moment, Lai Xiaoming appeared humbled and fearful, lacking any of his previous arrogance and swagger.
"Apologize?" Lin Fan said.
Lai Xiaoming quickly said, "Brother Fan, I was wrong, I failed to recognize Mount Tai, I really was dead wrong before, I shouldn’t have spoken to Brother Fan that way, please forgive me, Brother Fan!"
Lin Fan said, "Are you referring to scolding me, or the act of throwing 80,000 yuan at me?"
Lai Xiaoming blushed with shame, feeling utterly embarrassed. Of course, he now realized how disgraceful it was, throwing 80,000 yuan at a billionaire god of wealth, it was terribly foolish.
Utterly humiliating to the core.
"I really had blind dog eyes, I truly overestimated myself, Brother Fan, you’re magnanimous." Lai Xiaoming said.
He regretted it deeply, truly regretted it, throwing 80,000 yuan at a billionaire god of wealth, it was definitely the dumbest thing he’d done in his life.
Lai Xiaomei impatiently pushed Lai Xiaoming away and said, "Alright, give Lin Fan a proper apology, then leave!"
After sending off her brother, Lai Xiaomei smiled and said, "Lin Fan, do you remember, back in middle school, we used to sit next to each other, and we talked non-stop. It was such a happy time."
She smiled warmly, reminiscing about the past.
She had almost forgotten about Lin Fan. When she first saw him, she didn’t even recognize him.
Now, however, she seemed to have a sudden memory revival, recalling the bits and pieces with Lin Fan. She racked her brains to find evidence of having a good relationship with Lin Fan before; it looked a bit ridiculous, a bit ironic.
She seemed completely unaware.
"Is that so? I don’t remember." Lin Fan smiled and said.
Of course, Lin Fan hadn’t forgotten. In middle school, he indeed sat very close to Lai Xiaomei, and at that time, his grades were better than hers, and Lai Xiaomei did talk to him quite a bit.
But later, after his grades fell and Lai Xiaomei rose to the top, she never looked him in the eye again.
Thinking back, this Lai Xiaomei, was so realistic and utilitarian even back in middle school.
Lai Xiaomei felt a bit embarrassed, laughed it off, and said, "It’s okay if you don’t remember, after all, it was a long time ago, Lin Fan you’re a busy man with much on your mind, how about we add each other on WeChat, and we’ll have plenty of time to reminisce later."
As she spoke, two shy blushes appeared on her cheeks.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "How would you like to reminisce together?"
Lai Xiaomei blushing said, "However you like, I heard I used to be your goddess, I’m actually your fangirl, you’re my male god, I think we’re simply a match made in heaven."
Lin Fan said, "Are you confessing to me?"
Lai Xiaomei said, "If you think so, then it is."
Lin Fan said, "Then let me be direct, indeed, you’re a goddess in the hearts of many boys, even I admire you, because you truly are excellent."
Lai Xiaomei shyly said, "Really, you think I’m excellent?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, if I were to propose to you now, would you agree? If I were to ask you to marry me, would you agree to marry me immediately?"
Lai Xiaomei exclaimed happily, "Really, I would! Lin Fan, are you really planning to marry me?"
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Weren’t you going to be an independent modern woman, not marrying or having children, focusing solely on your career?"
Lai Xiaomei said, "That was because I hadn’t met you, if it’s you, I can get married anytime, I can have many children for you, our children will surely be the best!"
Lin Fan said, "Good."
Lai Xiaomei exclaimed with joy, "What does ’good’ mean, Lin Fan, do you agree to marry me?"
Lin Fan said, "Let me ask you one more question. If I were that delivery guy Lin Fan, would you marry me?"
"This..." Lai Xiaomei was momentarily stunned.
Lin Fan said, "Of course you wouldn’t, the delivery guy Lin Fan wouldn’t even be qualified to pursue you, right?"
Lai Xiaomei’s face turned a bit awkward, she forced a smile and said, "Not really, Lin Fan, I like you for who you are..."
Lin Fan shook his head, "Didn’t you say that only someone with assets over a billion is qualified to like you?"
Lai Xiaomei was speechless.
Indeed, if Lin Fan were just a delivery man, she wouldn’t even spare a glance, not even if Lin Fan had assets over a billion, because among her suitors, there were quite a few with assets over a billion.
But assets of a trillion!
That’s too rare, Lin Fan wouldn’t even need to pursue her, she would go out of her way to pursue him.
Lin Fan said, "Actually, I also have a requirement for my other half."
Lai Xiaomei said, "What requirement?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "My other half must be a beauty scoring over 9 points."
Lai Xiaomei happily said, "Really, Lin Fan, what score do you give me, they all say I’m a ten-point beauty."
Lin Fan said, "No, you don’t pass."

chapters.title: Chapter 629: Because You Deserve It
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Chapter 629: Because You Deserve It
Lai Xiaomei’s expression changed: "What?"
Lin Fan said, "A beauty scoring over 9 points doesn’t necessarily have to be stunning, but she must be kind-hearted, not looking down on the poor and loving the rich, not being overly vain, and not considering herself too highly. She won’t feel that only those with assets over a billion are worthy of liking her, because a partner shouldn’t be measured by money. You fail."
What?
Lai Xiaomei was stunned, she failed?
"Sorry, everyone, I have something else to do, so I can’t stay here any longer. I must take my leave now."
Lin Fan said, ignoring Lai Xiaomei, and then walked off the stage.
Everyone watched Lin Fan. With Lin Fan leaving, no one dared to stop him. Lin Fan was a mega-billionaire, coming and going as he pleased.
Lin Fan walked off the stage and returned to the crowd of onlookers around the venue.
Lin Fan glanced at the classmates gathered today and smiled, "I’m very glad to meet the classmates today, old classmates who haven’t seen each other in a long time."
The classmates hurriedly nodded and bowed awkwardly, not even daring to speak. Now that they knew Lin Fan was a mega-billionaire, how could they still dare speak? Remembering their prior mocking words, they were even more terrified.
The most afraid person was Liu Qiang, as he was the one who had been most fervently stepping on Lin Fan before.
"Lin Fan, no, Mr. Lin, I..." Liu Qiang attempted to apologize to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan glanced at him and said, "Liu Qiang, the factory where you are the supervisor, with an annual salary of 300,000, what’s it called again?"
Liu Qiang was taken aback and dared not remain silent: "It’s called Weisheng Shoe Factory."
Lin Fan said, "Hmm, your cousin is called Luo Dawen, the shoe factory was founded by his father Luo Weisheng. After Luo Weisheng died, it was inherited by your cousin. Your cousin is doing quite well and now Weisheng Shoe Factory is seeking to go public, but they’re in big trouble with financial issues. If they can’t resolve it, they can’t go public, and might even get into a lawsuit. Your cousin has to ask others for help. Do you know who is currently helping your cousin resolve the problem?"
Liu Qiang had a bad feeling, cold sweat dripping, and shook his head, "No, no, I don’t know."
Lin Fan said, "Helping your cousin is the financial giant Longheng Group. In Jiangnan City, only Longheng Group can help your cousin, because Longheng Group’s leader is the woman known as the Financial Demoness, Feng Ruolan."
Liu Qiang said, "Yes, I’ve also heard of Miss Feng’s renowned name..."
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "You probably didn’t know, Feng Ruolan is my sister."
"Ah?"
Liu Qiang’s face changed dramatically as if struck by lightning.
How could he not understand by now? In short, Lin Fan was someone he couldn’t afford to provoke. Indeed, with just a lift of Lin Fan’s hand, it was enough to crush him!
Thud!
Liu Qiang turned pale and was so frightened that he fell to his knees on the spot: "Mr. Lin, Brother Lin, I was wrong, I should die, please forgive me!"
Ring ring ring...
Liu Qiang’s phone suddenly rang.
Seeing that it was his cousin Luo Dawen calling, Liu Qiang was so scared that he almost dropped his phone.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "What’s up, is your cousin calling? Why not answer?"
Liu Qiang, trembling, answered the call.
On the other end of the phone was Luo Dawen’s voice, scolding Liu Qiang without mercy: "You bastard, do you know the trouble you’ve caused me? Damn it, you idiotic thing, if the company’s IPO is delayed because of this, I’ll skin you alive!"
Liu Qiang was so frightened that he didn’t dare say a word.
The more Luo Dawen scolded, the more agitated he became: "You damn fool, who have you provoked? Is Mr. Lin someone you can provoke? Don’t come to work tomorrow, the shareholders have unanimously decided, you’re fired, permanently fired!"
Liu Qiang cried in fear: "Cousin, no, I can’t lose this job, I can’t do anything else, where would I find work?"
Luo Dawen said angrily: "I don’t care, I can’t save you this time, do whatever you want, but you can’t work with me anymore, you brought this all on yourself, do takeaway delivery or set up a stall for all I care, it has nothing to do with me!"
Liu Qiang said: "Cousin, you can’t do this, cousin..."
On the other end, the call was already disconnected.
Liu Qiang collapsed to the ground, that was the hardest blow, the job he had always been proud of, being the supervisor of a factory worth 50 million with an annual salary of 300,000, was gone!
Lin Fan no longer paid him any attention. Originally, Lin Fan didn’t have to go against Liu Qiang, but this Liu Qiang was really too much. It was one thing to step on him, but he also dragged Jia Xiaoling out and stepped on her harshly, exposing her privacy that she didn’t want others to know, making everyone ridicule and insult her.
Lin Fan couldn’t leave Liu Qiang without a lesson.
Since Liu Qiang went too far, let him suffer a little pain, losing his proud high-paying job, he is bound to hurt for a long time.
Liu Qiang was just a useless eater without any extraordinary ability. Having a high-paying job was mainly because of a rich cousin, and now that the job is gone, with the cousin’s support lost, he’s afraid he can’t even do a job with a monthly salary of 3,000.
Lin Fan turned to leave.
"Lin Fan, you stop right there!"
Suddenly, Lai Xiaomei cried out sharply behind him, calling after Lin Fan.
Lai Xiaomei had been shocked when Lin Fan said she failed.
In her life, she grew up surrounded by praises. She was good at studying and beautiful. Her family, classmates, and teachers pampered her. She herself was confident, pampered by others.
Given her upbringing, it’s not surprising that she said only those with billions could pursue her. And she really believed it, she was just that confident.
But Lin Fan’s words were undoubtedly a hard slap, leaving her dumbfounded.
She was stunned.
At this moment, she reacted and became very angry.
Lin Fan stopped walking, turned his head, and said, "Something else?"
Lai Xiaomei said, "You said you like beauties over 9 points, why am I not one? Then tell me, who is a 9 point beauty?"
Lin Fan walked over to Jia Xiaoling, smiled, and said, "I think Little Ling is a 9 point beauty."
"What?"
Lai Xiaomei was dumbfounded, "She, she’s a 9 point beauty?"
She couldn’t believe it, Jia Xiaoling was fat and ugly, because of working in the fields day and night, at a young age, she looked like a middle-aged woman, and she could be a 9 point beauty?
Lin Fan said, "Her husband is not a rich man. They married for love. When her husband’s business failed and he was in debt, she didn’t abandon him or do anything inappropriate, but instead relied on farming, doing what she can to shoulder the burden with her husband. Such a woman is worthy of being a good wife and a good mother."
Lai Xiaomei was once again speechless.
Jia Xiaoling couldn’t help but tear up, muttering, "Lin Fan..."
Her idol called her a 9 point beauty, it made her life worth it.
Lin Fan turned his face, looked at Jia Xiaoling, smiled, and said, "Lai Xiaomei just said you’ll live this hard life forever, but I say, your hard days are over, I’ll help you get through the current difficulties, because you’re worth it."
Jia Xiaoling was stunned, simply overjoyed.
Lai Xiaomei was about to go crazy, Lin Fan ignored her but was so good to Jia Xiaoling!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 630: What’s the Background of This Young Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Chapter 630: What’s the Background of This Young Man
For Lin Fan, the centennial anniversary of the school was already over. It was an experience that left him feeling disgusted. The way those people treated him before and after knowing his identity was just too realistic. When they thought he was a delivery man, they mocked him in every possible way and even used him as a negative example. But once they found out he was the richest man in Yun City, they displayed all sorts of sycophantic postures.
However, no matter how much they tried to flatter him, they would never win Lin Fan’s favor, only his disgust.
On the contrary, Jia Xiaoling, whom everyone looked down upon, received Lin Fan’s help and had the chance to escape her current difficult life.
Because Jia Xiaoling always defended Lin Fan, she was always kind-hearted, even if she was fat and ugly, she was still considered by Lin Fan as a 9 out of 10 beauty.
In Lin Fan’s view, a kind heart surpasses and transcends the beauty or ugliness of one’s appearance.
Even though Lai Xiaomei had a passable appearance, her hypocritical attitude made Lin Fan feel disgusted, and he directly gave her a failing grade.
This infuriated Lai Xiaomei to the point of feeling half-dead, but there was nothing she could do. Lin Fan was the richest man in Yun City. What could she do about him? She was left with an unattainable hatred for Lin Fan, a kind of regretful hatred that would haunt her for a long time.
Every time she thought about missing the perfect opportunity to connect with a trillionaire, she would feel a sharp pain in her heart. If only she had known Lin Fan was a trillionaire earlier, if only she hadn’t demeaned Lin Fan at the start...
Lin Fan, under the watchful eyes of many, walked out of the venue and planned to get into his Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
"Mr. Lin, please wait."
Mayor Long quickly caught up with him, smiling as he spoke.
Seeing Lin Fan leave, Mayor Long said to Principal Zhao, "I’m leaving, too," and hurriedly followed.
Originally busy with official duties, he hadn’t planned to attend the centennial celebration; he was there for Lin Fan. Now that Lin Fan was leaving, he had no reason to stay.
"Mayor, is there something you need?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Mayor Long smiled and said, "Mr. Lin, I believe you are a busy man. This visit to Tianhai City should be a short one, right? Chances to meet and talk in person might be rare in the future. Do you have time today, Mr. Lin? I’d like to invite you to the city hall as a guest."
Lin Fan responded with an ’oh’ sound; he understood Mayor Long’s intentions. It was nothing more than wanting to talk to him about investing in Tianhai City.
Lin Fan is a trillionaire and a local of Tianhai. This is practically an opportunity for the future development of Tianhai. If Lin Fan decides to lead investments in Tianhai, it would be extraordinary.
Mayor Long personally came to invite Lin Fan, giving him considerable face as well.
Lin Fan actually had nothing else to do today. He had mainly come to the city to treat Secretary Ma’s illness and then planned to return to the village.
Oh right, his father did mention as he went out this morning that it was Chen Hai’s wedding day next door. His father even asked if Lin Fan wanted to help set up the venue. After all, they are neighbors, and the village people help each other out with weddings and funerals. Lin Fan and Chen Hai had grown up playing together.
However, Lin Fan said he was not free and did not help. It wasn’t because Lin Fan was stingy, but because he had to go to the city to treat Secretary Ma and genuinely had no time.
He did plan that once he went back to the village, he would help next door if needed. But now, Mayor Long was inviting him to the city hall, and it wasn’t easy to decline. It seemed he wouldn’t be able to help with Chen Hai’s wedding.
Ring ring ring...
Just when Lin Fan was about to answer Mayor Long, the phone suddenly rang.
It was a call from Wei Yue’er.
Lin Fan found it a bit strange, thinking something might be up, he said, "Sorry, Mr. Mayor, let me take this call first."
Mayor Long quickly said, "Please, Mr. Lin, go ahead."
Lin Fan then answered the phone, "Yue’er, what’s up?"
Wei Yue’er replied, "Nothing much, Lin Fan. It’s like this, I ran into your mom this morning. She said you came into the city, and I’m just coincidentally at a school in the city for training today. Did you leave already? Do you want to meet up? I’m feeling a bit unwell today, and I was hoping you could give me a ride back to the village."
Lin Fan laughed, "I was wondering what it could be, no problem. When are you leaving? I’ll come pick you up."
Wei Yue’er said, "I can leave about now."
Then Wei Yue’er told Lin Fan the school’s address.
After hanging up the phone.
Lin Fan said, "Mayor Long, I’ll go with you to the city hall. You’re right, I’m just back temporarily and will soon return to Yun City, but right now I need to pick up a friend, is that okay?"
Mayor Long quickly responded, "No problem, let’s do this. I’ll go with you, Mr. Lin, and we can chat on the way. After picking up your friend, we’ll head to the city hall."
Lin Fan broke a sweat, feeling that Mayor Long was probably concerned he might run off, thus wanting to accompany him.
"Alright then."
So, Lin Fan got into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
The mayor got into his official car, following Lin Fan’s vehicle.
Tianhai Affiliated First Primary School.
This was the address Wei Yue’er gave Lin Fan.
The primary school’s gate.
A few school security guards were on duty, idly playing on their phones.
It wasn’t yet time for school to end, so there wasn’t much else to do. Everyone seemed a bit listless, killing time on their phones while waiting for dismissal.
Suddenly, the sound of a melodious engine approached, and the security guards looked towards the source.
"Holy crap!"
"Damn, is this for real?"
"Am I seeing things?"
In shock, the security guards suddenly became alert and attentive.
They saw a Rolls-Royce Cullinan drive up to the school’s entrance, and astonishingly, a government car followed behind!
"Holy crap, which badass parent came to pick up their child?" The security guards were left speechless.
"Quick, get up, and go see what’s happening. Remember, whatever happens, we cannot offend the owners of these two cars; they’re absolutely untouchable!" the security team leader advised.
The security guards immediately perked up with heightened alertness, heading outside to stand in formation.
From the Rolls-Royce, a young man in simple attire stepped out...
The security guards exchanged glances, baffled by the situation. If not for the Rolls-Royce, just looking at this young man, they might think he had come straight from some rural village.
But the fact was, he was driving a Rolls-Royce. Even if he were a beggar, he’s a beggar in a Rolls-Royce, and they dare not offend!
Wait a minute!
They saw Mayor Long stepping out of the official car.
"What?"
"Damn!"
"The Mayor?"
The security guards’ legs went weak. Damn, the person who came was actually Mayor Long, and he came to their primary school?
"Mr. Lin, I’ll go in with you," Mayor Long said, very courteously moving next to Lin Fan.
The security guards exchanged puzzled looks. Did they see right? What was going on? Mayor Long seemed very courteous to this plainly dressed young man.
To be able to have Mayor Long speak so courteously, who on earth was this young man?
Dressed plainly?
That hardly mattered anymore. Even if Lin Fan were dressed like a beggar, the fact that a mayor was so courteous to such a beggar meant he was undoubtedly a big deal.

chapters.title: Chapter 631: Magical Reality
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Chapter 631: Magical Reality
Tianhai Middle School.
The centennial celebration was continuing, but after Lin Fan left, Principal Zhao suddenly was absent.
Backstage, Principal Zhao summoned several leaders responsible for the school celebration and was furiously raging!
"You are all useless fools, let me ask you, why did none of you know about our school producing the richest man in Yun City? Do you know how great our loss is today! This wasn’t just missing out on a billion, it was missing out on several billion!"
Principal Zhao was heartbroken.
If he had known earlier, Lin Fan was the richest man in Yun City, he would have personally gone to Yun City to invite Lin Fan back for the centennial celebration and would have offered Lin Fan the highest level of hospitality.
Before the celebration, he had instructed people to investigate past graduates, to find the outstanding ones, and invite them back for the celebration to highlight the excellence of Tianhai Middle School, and these outstanding alumni represent true wealth for the school.
For example, the Vice President of Orange Airlines, Meng Xiaoming, was invited back for the celebration. As a vice president and a wealthy person, naturally, he contributed as a sponsor for this celebration, which was real money.
Additionally, Lai Xiaomei also sponsored with funds.
As for other guests, although they didn’t contribute real money, as prominent figures in their fields, they also brought prestige to the school.
What Principal Zhao valued most, aside from prestige, was real money.
Real money is crucial for the school; with funding, we can buy better teaching facilities, improve the quality of education, increase teachers’ salaries, and provide better education to students. Of course, besides benefiting the public, it also had advantages for Principal Zhao’s personal pocket.
Principal Zhao wished that all the graduates were wealthy individuals.
Now, they missed the wealthiest graduate, and Principal Zhao couldn’t help but feel heartbroken and full of regret!
The leader responsible for investigating graduates ended up missing Lin Fan, could Principal Zhao not be furious!
"Principal, you can’t blame me; Lin... Mr. Lin wasn’t very active in school before. Our investigation starts with academic performance, followed by their school activity level. Like Lai Xiaomei was a top student, very well-known, and was easily found first for her achievements, but Mr. Lin was like a little invisible figure, and he could easily be overlooked."
The leader defended.
Principal Zhao shouted angrily: "Don’t give me excuses; negligence is negligence!"
The leader, looking distressed, said: "Principal, you really can’t blame me. You also saw how low-key Mr. Lin is. For the sake of staying low-key, he even replaced his Rolls-Royce with a Xia Li car. Even if I were to investigate, it may not have been possible to find out he was the richest man in Yun City."
Principal Zhao was frustrated.
"Your negligence, we will discuss later. The most important thing now is how to remedy this situation!" Principal Zhao contemplated.
Everyone nodded, expressing their agreement.
Principal Zhao said, "Everyone, let’s discuss how to remedy this. Mr. Lin is the richest man in Yun City, the wealthiest among our graduates in Tianhai City, and we absolutely must win him back. He is our most outstanding graduate!"
So, they began discussing the matter.
Following a heated discussion, Principal Zhao devised remedial measures.
"Mr. Lin is our most outstanding graduate; we must uncover stories from his school days! That’s the first point!" Principal Zhao said.
Someone said, "It’s just... Mr. Lin seemed quite low-key, practically invisible back then, not much to talk about, right?"
Principal Zhao sternly said: "Nonsense! Mr. Lin has no minor matters; he is not invisible. Remember that. Never say Mr. Lin is invisible again. Go interview his classmates, his homeroom teacher, his subject teachers, have them recall every detail of Mr. Lin’s past, as detailed as possible, then dig out stories and write a biography for Mr. Lin. I want the effect to be that everyone knows Mr. Lin already showed extraordinary talent while studying at Tianhai Middle School, understand! Mr. Lin’s past can’t be simple, got it!" Principal Zhao said passionately.
Everyone nodded, indicating they understood.
Just like in historical novels, you tailor an amazing background for impressive historical figures, like auspicious signs when they were born.
Likewise, Principal Zhao wanted to create an aura of auspiciousness around Lin Fan.
As the wealthiest man in Yun City, Lin Fan’s past at Tianhai Middle School couldn’t be invisible or ordinary!
That’s absolutely impossible!
"Furthermore, we need to heavily promote Mr. Lin’s achievements; the richest man in Yun City should receive due recognition! He is our school’s pride, a living brand! Think about it, the richest man in Yun City graduated from our school, isn’t that something to boast about? In the future, other schools can’t compete with us; who can compare to us having Yun City’s richest man! So, we need to promote it heavily so that the living brand can have the biggest impact, attracting more teacher and student resources, and getting preferential policies from above. All of these are real money!" Principal Zhao said.
Afterward, Principal Zhao returned to the centennial celebration site and announced publicly, "Mr. Lin is the most outstanding graduate, and to commend his achievements and inspire students to learn from him, the school has decided to erect a statue of Mr. Lin for the students to admire!"
The applause thundered.
The students felt that this was what Mr. Lin deserved, and they also wanted to worship Lin Fan’s statue to gain some fortune since Lin Fan was the richest man in Yun City, a billionaire. If they could get a tiny bit of Lin Fan’s luck, it would be incredible.
Thus, in the future, at Tianhai Middle School, students would worship Lin Fan’s statue, whether it be upon enrollment or before exams.
Lin Fan seemed to have become a deity at Tianhai Middle School.
Principal Zhao attempted to flatter Lin Fan with this strategy, making up for the grave mistake today. If he could successfully please Lin Fan, any favor from Lin Fan would make the school rich.
Even if Lin Fan himself never looked back at the school, it wouldn’t matter. Lin Fan being a Tianhai Middle School graduate is a fact that cannot be changed, not affecting Lin Fan becoming a living brand for Tianhai Middle School and bringing various benefits.
Lin Fan never imagined the school would turn him into a legend.
If Lin Fan found out, he would probably sigh.
If he were just a delivery person, the school certainly wouldn’t go to such lengths, but after finding out he’s the richest man in Yun City, they began to create a legend.
This truly is a magical realism!
At this moment, Lin Fan was in Tianhai Affiliated Primary School, and his arrival also brought a scene full of liveliness to this elementary school.

chapters.title: Chapter 632: The Female Teacher Loses Her Temper
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Chapter 632: The Female Teacher Loses Her Temper
Tianhai Affiliated Primary School.
Sixth grade, class two. In the classroom, a female teacher is teaching at the podium. Apart from the students, there are several adults sitting at the back of the classroom.
Wei Yue’er is among them.
Tianhai Affiliated Primary School is a key primary school in the city. The female teacher at the podium is an excellent teacher, reputed to have a very high teaching level. To improve the teaching quality of rural teachers, some rural primary schools often send their teachers to this affiliated primary school to observe classes.
These people sitting in the back, including Wei Yue’er, are rural teachers from various villages in Tianhai, here to observe.
Wei Yue’er’s teaching level may not be inferior to the teacher on the podium, but she is currently a rural volunteer teacher without any professional title, so it’s automatically assumed that her level is not high, and she is arranged to observe here.
At this time, Wei Yue’er listens to the class while covering her stomach, her face looking a bit uncomfortable. It turns out her stomach is a bit upset, possibly because she ate something wrong when leaving home in the morning.
She now hopes the class will end soon so she can leave. Earlier, she used the excuse of going to the bathroom to call Lin Fan. If it weren’t for her stomach being really uncomfortable, she wouldn’t want to bother Lin Fan. Fortunately, Lin Fan agreed immediately to come and pick her up.
She really wants to see Lin Fan soon. Even though her stomach is uncomfortable, the thought of soon being able to see Lin Fan makes her feel better.
Really... she hasn’t known Lin Fan for many days, but for some reason, she feels as if she has known him for a long time. She even wishes she had met Lin Fan earlier.
Fortunately, there is still a long life ahead, and she has finally met Lin Fan. There is still a long time in the future...
Thinking of Lin Fan, Wei Yue’er becomes a bit dazed, completely lost in thought.
Suddenly, a round of applause pulls Wei Yue’er’s attention back to the classroom.
"Everyone, give a round of applause for Chen Simin. Chen Simin’s solution to this problem is very advanced, very good!"
The female teacher at the podium says, leading the applause.
This female teacher is a middle-aged woman in her forties or fifties, wearing glasses, looking somewhat scholarly.
The classmates all start applauding. Apparently, the female teacher had posed a question earlier and called Chen Simin up to the blackboard to solve it. After Chen Simin finished, he received the female teacher’s praise.
The female teacher continues, "Look at Chen Simin’s solution to this math problem, her method can be said to be perfect, the optimal solution. I have to say, she is truly excellent. Now that you are in sixth grade, if you want to enter a good middle school, you should learn from Chen Simin. I think you all want to be as excellent as Chen Simin, don’t you? So how can you be as excellent? You need to make some effort. I have a tutoring class here, and I hope everyone actively participates. Chen Simin became so outstanding because she joined the tutoring class."
Tutoring class?
The classmates exchange glances.
The female teacher says, "This tutoring class is something I’ve recently organized with several excellent subject teachers, aimed at preparing you for the transition from primary to middle school exams. We use the weekends to give you special instruction and improve your scores in a short time. A few days ago, I told your parents about this in the parent group, and so far, only a few parents have signed up, including Chen Simin. You’ve all seen today how well Chen Simin answered the question, it’s the result of the tutoring class. If you want to be as excellent as her, go back and tell your parents to sign up quickly, got it?"
After hearing these words, the students seem interested. There’s no denying the attraction in the teacher’s words; children are competitive and don’t want to fall behind others.
However, Wei Yue’er furrows her brows. Although the female teacher seems to be considering the students, helping them improve, something feels a bit off.
"Teacher, does this tutoring class cost money?" a student raises their hand to ask.
The middle-aged teacher says, "Regarding the price, I’ve explained it to your parents in the group. Let’s put it this way, this tutoring class is very good, taught by excellent teachers. The price is a bit pricey, but I believe most parents can afford it if they are willing to make the investment. Of course, it’s voluntary, I’m not forcing anyone to participate. If you really want to improve your grades, you can join, it’s up to whether you’re willing to spend the money."
"Teacher!"
Suddenly, a little girl raises her hand.
The little girl is wearing a school uniform, but it looks a bit old and doesn’t fit well, it seems to be last year’s uniform.
Elementary school students are growing, often needing a new uniform each year, and uniforms naturally cost money, and are not cheap.
This little girl seems to be saving money by wearing last year’s uniform, which doesn’t fit well. It indicates that her family is not well-off.
"Luo Xiaojuan, what question do you have?" the female teacher says.
The girl named Luo Xiaojuan says, "Teacher, I thought about it just now, Chen Simin’s solution is not the optimal one, I have a better solution."
What?
Everyone is stunned, there’s a better solution?
Isn’t this Luo Xiaojuan hitting the female teacher’s reputation?
The female teacher’s expression suddenly turns displeased: "Luo Xiaojuan, what do you mean by this? Are you questioning my tutoring class? If you don’t want to join the tutoring class, you can simply say so, but at such a young age, it’s surprising how calculating you are!"
Luo Xiaojuan, suddenly being scolded, feels overwhelmed and timidly says, "Teacher, I’m not what you said, I really thought of another solution..."
The female teacher snorts coldly, "Spare me, I already said, Chen Simin’s method is the optimal solution. Are you saying I’m wrong? Are you the teacher, or am I?"
Luo Xiaojuan is momentarily speechless: "..."
Feeling a bit scared, she doesn’t dare to speak anymore.
However, the female teacher’s temper flares, and she doesn’t stop, barking, "I think you just don’t want to join my tutoring class. Everyone knows your family is poor, you can relax, I said, the tutoring class is voluntary, I’m not forcing you to join. You’re poor, you don’t have to join! How much does your mom earn a month, and your dad earn a month, it’s not that I’m looking down on you, but you’re just poor! Look at Chen Simin’s family, they run a company, Simin’s mom earns more in a month than your mom earns in fifty years! Once they heard about the tutoring class, Chen Simin’s mom signed up without hesitation!"
"Let me tell you, in the previous class I taught, the parents were all officials and from public institutions, they didn’t worry about money. Once they heard about tutoring class, they scrambled to sign up for their children. Unlike your parents, only a few signed up, each thinking it’s expensive! To have good children, you have to spend money!"
The female teacher gets more excited, starts losing her temper. It seems that because not many parents signed up for her tutoring class, she has been harboring dissatisfaction, and now her emotions are erupting.
"Teacher Zhao, isn’t this wrong?"
Wei Yue’er suddenly speaks.
Instantly, all eyes are on Wei Yue’er.

chapters.title: Chapter 633: Class Distinction
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Chapter 633: Class Distinction
Wei Yue’er was auditing the class, and it originally had nothing to do with her, but she couldn’t stand it anymore, she wanted to stand up for Luo Xiaojuan.
Actually, the few rural teachers who came to audit were somewhat intimidated by the female teacher on the podium. This Teacher Zhao was a bit domineering, and such behavior was unimaginable in village schools.
But Teacher Zhao openly lost her temper over tutoring classes in the classroom, which was truly mind-blowing.
Wei Yue’er suddenly interjected, instantly drawing everyone’s attention.
Wei Yue’er was so courageous, she actually dared to confront Teacher Zhao.
