Teacher Zhao looked at Wei Yue’er, a bit annoyed: "What do you mean by that? What did I do wrong?"
Wei Yue’er said: "Firstly, I think it’s wrong for you to compare parents’ income here, this shouldn’t be done. All the children in the class paid the same tuition to get in, it’s fair, they are equal, no one is superior. Their parents’ income should not be discussed or used as a basis for different treatment. Secondly, I don’t understand why there is a need for tutoring classes. For instance, you have the optimal solution to this problem, why not teach it to the children here instead of opening an additional tutoring class? I can only think of one answer: you want money, which undoubtedly adds to the burden on the parents. Wealthy parents may not mind, but less affluent families will feel pressured, and it will cause unfairness."
The other rural teachers who came to audit didn’t dare to speak but nodded in agreement, thinking Wei Yue’er made sense.
Teacher Zhao showed a look of disdain and said, "You’re a teacher from the countryside, are you teaching me how to do my job?"
Wei Yue’er replied, "I wouldn’t dare, I’m not teaching you how to do your job, I’m just sharing my thoughts."
Teacher Zhao scolded, "Spare me! Know your place! Don’t forget, this classroom is mine, I didn’t even want to let you spectate. It was the principal who begged me, and I reluctantly agreed. You come to audit, just listen carefully, don’t interrupt my class! Really unruly!"
Wei Yue’er wiped her cold sweat, surprised that Teacher Zhao even scolded her, with a tone full of superiority, as if the rural teachers were inferior to her.
Wei Yue’er’s temper also flared up, saying, "Teacher Zhao, we are here to audit as per the arrangement by the education bureau. Rural teachers periodically come to the city for learning. This classroom is indeed yours, but I want to say, this is not your solo talk. I think your words and actions today are inappropriate, and I want to debate with you. After all, we are here to learn, but I don’t want to learn such a mindset. Your influence is bad, if we rural teachers learn your ways and go back to trouble the students’ parents, we might as well not learn anything."
Teacher Zhao was furious: "What do you mean bad influence. I open a tutoring class to improve the children’s grades, and you call it a bad influence? You don’t want to learn, huh? If you don’t want to learn, get out, get out of my classroom, stop whining!"
Wei Yue’er shook her head and said, "Teacher Zhao, you don’t need to boss around here. You are indeed a renowned teacher, but that doesn’t mean you’re superior to us. The only difference between us is that you teach in the city, and we teach in the countryside. I’m not being arrogant, you are an experienced senior teacher, and I believe you have aspects in teaching that are worth learning from. That’s why we came, but today, I find your values problematic."
Teacher Zhao said, "What’s wrong with my values, tell me!"
Wei Yue’er said, "Your values are wrong in comparing children’s parents’ income and looking down on poor parents."
Teacher Zhao snorted, "So what if I look down on poor parents, society inherently has class distinctions. Rich people and poor people are not on the same level! Is this my distinction? No, it’s just reality! Whether or not I open tutoring classes, others will. Nowadays, children start competing from birth. Rich kids are sent to private schools, receive the best educational resources, participate in various tutoring classes—study piano, painting, music—winning from the starting line! Poor kids? They are nothing, just pay tuition fees, can’t afford any tutoring classes, they’re already losing at the starting line! Tell me, isn’t this reality?"
Wei Yue’er nodded, "What you described is indeed reality."
Teacher Zhao said, "There you go, so what’s wrong with my values? You say I represent reality. I look down on poor parents because they are poor and they make their children lose at the starting line! They don’t even want to spend a little on tutoring fees, how can they compete with rich kids? Some parents can afford it but are unwilling to spend, even though their children could lead others by a step, they won’t spend the money. Their children will lose to others, and may even experience class descent! Do you understand what class descent is? It means refusing to invest in children’s education, and children losing to others, losing to the parents. For instance, some Rich Second Generation, neglected in upbringing, incapable of inheriting the family business, not as excellent as their predecessors, causing the family to decline, that’s class descent!"
"Why do I look down on poor people’s children, because poor people’s children have no hope of class ascent, they’ve already lost at the starting line!"
Wei Yue’er said, "I admit that there is some truth to what you say, but as a teacher, you shouldn’t instill this in children. Indeed, there are class differences in society, and rich kids do have more opportunities, yet we cannot therefore deny poor kids."
Teacher Zhao laughed, "Are you, a teacher from the countryside, teaching me? Are you worthy?"
Wei Yue’er smiled, "You look down on poor kids, do you also look down on rural teachers?"
Teacher Zhao said, "That’s right, I look down on you, so what? If you were capable, you’d teach in the city rather than choose the countryside. Your level is the lowest! You came to my classroom, you should obediently listen to me, it’s not your place to speak!"
Wei Yue’er retorted, "Teacher Zhao, do you really not feel there’s anything wrong with what you said?"
The other rural teachers, listening to Teacher Zhao’s words, trembled with anger but didn’t dare to speak, feeling too powerless to counter Teacher Zhao.
It must be said that Teacher Zhao’s remarks had inflicted damage and hurt on them.
Teacher Zhao interrupted Wei Yue’er: "Enough, stop talking, you don’t have the right! I now want to eject you from my classroom, get out!"
Everyone looked at Wei Yue’er, should she leave when being expelled?
"Are you really going to kick her out?"
Suddenly, a voice spoke, and Lin Fan walked in.

chapters.title: Chapter 634: Not Stupid but Evil
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Chapter 634: Not Stupid but Evil
Teacher Zhao wanted to kick Wei Yue’er out of the classroom. As an outstanding teacher at a prestigious city primary school, she looked down upon rural teachers, and this rural teacher dared to confront her in her class, an obvious challenge to her authority.
Wei Yue’er initially just wanted to finish the class quickly due to an upset stomach. But when Teacher Zhao started scolding students, Wei Yue’er couldn’t stand it and got up to rebut her. However, Teacher Zhao aggressively demanded that she leave the classroom.
Wei Yue’er was a bit speechless, "Teacher Zhao, can we have a calm discussion? Haven’t you realized your mistake?"
Teacher Zhao snorted, "What mistake have I made? What’s wrong with what I said? You want to discuss it, right? Then let’s discuss it. Let me ask you, among the children in this class, do their parents include both the rich and the poor?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Yes, but..."
Teacher Zhao interrupted Wei Yue’er, "There you have it — the rich and the poor represent a class distinction, an undeniable reality! Let me ask you again, what do children from low-income families rely on to leap upwards in class?"
Wei Yue’er replied, "Education."
Teacher Zhao stated, "Exactly, you also know it is education! However, do you know that education requires monetary investment? Those wealthy people have tons of money to spend on their children, with various tutorials, securing an early start, while those poor ones are considered fortunate to allow their children to complete compulsory education — is this the reality? Am I looking down on the poor? No, it is merely reality!"
Wei Yue’er said, "..."
She found herself momentarily speechless. She knew something was undoubtedly off in Teacher Zhao’s statements, but got confused with Teacher Zhao’s rhetoric and didn’t quite know what to say.
Teacher Zhao scoffed, "A rural teacher is just a rural teacher, I’m not looking down on you, but you have no qualification to refute me. You’re here to audit the class, so just listen quietly. How dare you challenge me? People like you are not welcome, now can you leave already! Please, exit!"
Wei Yue’er felt a bit aggrieved, plus with her stomach discomfort, she felt quite unwell. She realized she couldn’t persuade Teacher Zhao, as this Teacher Zhao simply dismissed her. What she said, Teacher Zhao wouldn’t take seriously.
She was not in a position of influence, unable to change anything, so perhaps leaving would be better.
Just then.
"Are you really intending to make her leave?"
A voice said, and then Lin Fan walked into the classroom.
Lin Fan arrived.
Wei Yue’er was delighted. She didn’t know why, but seeing Lin Fan gave her a sense of peace, as if she had found support and strength.
Everyone’s eyes immediately turned to Lin Fan.
"Who are you? This is a classroom, are you where you can just come in!" Teacher Zhao scolded angrily.
Lin Fan was plainly dressed, at one glance looking like a poor guy.
Lin Fan smiled, "I’m a friend of Teacher Wei Yue’er, came to fetch her, and I happened to hear what you were saying earlier. I think you’ve gone too far, Teacher Zhao."
Teacher Zhao snorted, "I’ve gone too far? You wish to challenge me too?"
Lin Fan said, "I don’t intend to waste words with you, but I’d like to say a few words for Teacher Wei Yue’er. You mentioned just now that some parents are rich and some are poor, which is indeed the reality; still, as a teacher, a role model, you shouldn’t look down upon the poor. Your views, in this sense, could badly influence the children. Don’t you agree?"
Wei Yue’er, who was previously confused by Teacher Zhao, was finally brought back to her senses by Lin Fan’s words.
"That’s right, that’s exactly what I wanted to say. Teacher Zhao, what you said does make some sense, but it should not be an excuse to discriminate among students. Whether rich or poor, all children are your students and should be treated equally," Wei Yue’er stated.
Teacher Zhao coldly replied, "So what if I discriminate? I already said that the children of the rich have a head start, and the children of the poor fall behind. Is it my fault for giving them differential treatment?"
Lin Fan said, "Miss Zhao, you’ve said so much, but it’s nothing more than a grievance in your heart."
Teacher Zhao angrily retorted, "What grievance do I have, speak up!"
Lin Fan said, "Why did you start holding extra lessons?"
Teacher Zhao replied, "Why do I conduct extra lessons? Isn’t it to improve the students’ grades! Am I wrong? If they’re unwilling to let their children attend extra sessions, they’re already losing at the starting line, only to fall further behind — is there anything wrong with what I said?"
Lin Fan said, "Your high-sounding words belied the fact that you just want the students to join your extra lessons."
Teacher Zhao said, "That’s right, I organize extra sessions for their own good. Of course, I hope they all participate to improve their grades. What, not happy with that! Tell me!"
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zhao obviously has some skills, your sophistry level is quite bluffing, but you’re not fooling me. Your primary purpose for running extra sessions is not to help the kids improve their grades."
Teacher Zhao raged, "What nonsense are you spouting!"
Lin Fan continued, "What Teacher Wei Yue’er said earlier was correct, you should not be running extra sessions because this is the classroom, isn’t it possible to teach everything here, what’s the need for extra sessions? Unless you are deliberately holding back material in class only to teach it in extra sessions. Just like this problem on the board, you claim Chen Simin’s is the optimal solution, and she learned this in the extra session — that’s odd. Why can’t you teach such solutions here?"
Teacher Zhao scoffed, "What do you know? Classes follow a set curriculum during regular hours, and since time is limited, naturally not all knowledge can be covered, hence the need for extra sessions, including after-class nighttime sessions and weekend sessions!"
Lin Fan queried, "You mean you can’t teach all the knowledge during regular class time and need extra sessions?"
Teacher Zhao said, "That’s right."
Lin Fan shook his head, "If that’s the case, I’d question your teaching ability. I believe that the current class schedule is quite reasonable. Yes, time is limited, but as a teacher, you should be able to complete imparting the knowledge properly within the set time. If not, and you must use extra-curricular time, then it indicates your teaching isn’t competent."
Teacher Zhao: "..."
Lin Fan slightly smiled, "Rumor has it this is a prestigious school. Teacher Zhao, teaching here implies a certain competence, so I’m sure you can teach all the essential knowledge within regular class times. However, it’s apparent you choose not to; instead, you withhold the material and teach it in extra sessions. This isn’t about being incapable; it’s pure malice. Ultimately, it’s just for money. Aren’t I right to say this?"
Teacher Zhao flushed with embarrassment.

chapters.title: Chapter 635: So What If You Look Down on Poor People
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Chapter 635: So What If You Look Down on Poor People
Teacher Zhao was caught by Lin Fan’s words and immediately blushed furiously.
"Don’t talk nonsense, I’m not what you say I am. I started a tuition class for the children’s benefit!" Teacher Zhao argued.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "If you truly cared for the children, you wouldn’t be constantly bringing up the rich and the poor. You charge fees for your tuition class, and the price is not cheap. The rich don’t mind spending this money, so they respond positively, making you happy. However, when poor people can’t afford it, or they begrudge spending the money, naturally, you’re not pleased. Over time, you transfer this attitude onto the students. You prefer the children of the rich, and look down on the children of the poor, treating them differently. As a teacher, you’ve become fixated on money, and you still claim you’re not in the wrong? If there’s nothing wrong with you, that would really be seeing ghosts!"
Lin Fan’s words were reasonable and to the point.
They left Teacher Zhao speechless.
Wei Yue’er was thrilled after listening and couldn’t help but applaud. The other teachers observing also joined in, finding Lin Fan’s argument spectacular.
It completely expressed their own thoughts.
Indeed, in short, this Teacher Zhao has become fixated on money. As a people’s teacher, she should be focused on education and nurturing, but instead, she’s obsessed with money and even admits it publicly. If that’s not a problem, then it’s simply bewildering!
Teacher Zhao was unhappy, terribly unhappy, being left speechless by someone poor was just unthinkable! How could that be allowed!
"Who are you, I ask? What do you do? Are you a teacher? I think you must be a farmer from the countryside, just the kind of poor parent I’m talking about. Just because you’re poor, do you think you’re justified?"
Teacher Zhao burst out again.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I am indeed from the village."
Teacher Zhao laughed, "I said so, didn’t I? I wasn’t wrong. You’re just a damned pauper. So what if I look down on you? Who says teachers can’t have their preferences? I just don’t like you poor people. What can you do about it! If you have the capability, then don’t be poor. If you throw money at my tuition class, I promise to treat you like a god. You’re a poor person, and you still want me to be nice to you? No way!"
"As I mentioned earlier, I used to teach at a prestigious school. The parents there were almost all government officials or businesspeople who had no lack of money. When I started a tuition class, everyone participated without hesitation, unlike here, where a bunch of poor people won’t even spend on a tuition class for their children. What future can they expect!"
"Why do they say the rich get richer? Because they’re willing to invest. Their children are born into luxury, enjoying the best educational resources, and will naturally excel. This is how the rich maintain their class advantage! As for the poor, why do they say it’s hard for a humble family to produce nobility? Forget about tuition classes; some struggle with even basic tuition fees! Their children are already losing to the rich, and if they keep being so stingy, what prospects can their children have? You tell me!"
"You say I look down on the poor, and I do, because I see no hope in them. Do they deserve my respect? They don’t!"
"Take a parent like Luo Xiaojuan, who won’t even spend money on a school uniform for the child and is still wearing last year’s, which doesn’t even fit anymore. And they expect me to respect them!"
"I know her family is poor, precisely because they’re poor. Chen Simin’s mother earns in a month what her mother earns in five decades. That’s the class difference. You tell me, in the future, will Chen Simin achieve more, or will she?"
"Tongue-tied, aren’t you? Nothing to say, right! Because you know I’m right. This is reality! I’m just laying the truth bare. Of course, the truth is hard to hear!"
Teacher Zhao rattled on, thinking she’d left Lin Fan speechless.
Yet Lin Fan smiled, shaking his head. This Teacher Zhao was truly fixated on money, with her values completely skewed, and her outlook on life and values way off course.
"What are you laughing at? Laughing doesn’t cover your speechlessness!" Teacher Zhao sneered.
Lin Fan replied, "I’m not speechless; I’m just at a loss for words with you. You have no regard for the nation!"
Teacher Zhao’s expression changed: "What nonsense are you spouting? How am I disregarding the nation? You damned pauper, don’t you dare label me like that!"
Lin Fan said, "Fine, let me break it down for you. Our country places great importance on children’s education. They say ’no matter how poor education cannot be poor’, and it’s true. Our country still has many impoverished people, but the nation invests heavily in poverty alleviation. On one hand, the country is working hard to help citizens overcome poverty. Now, absolute poverty has been eradicated, and next will come further poverty alleviation, making citizens wealthier. On the other hand, the country vigorously develops education, emphasizing ’no matter how poor, don’t impoverish education,’ meaning both rich and poor children, especially those from poor families, should have access to education. For example, nine-year compulsory education means all our children must complete obligatory education, and during this phase, the government strives to waive tuition fees for poor kids to attend school! This is the nation’s effort to ensure educational fairness so that both rich and poor children start on the same level playing field!"
"As far as I know, this school is a public school. This classroom is essentially a microcosm of the effort the nation puts into creating an educational environment. In this classroom, both Chen Simin and Luo Xiaojuan can stay in class and receive fair education."
"As a teacher, your duty is to support the nation’s efforts, treating these children fairly, irrespective of if they’re rich or poor, teaching them equally!"
"Not like what you’re doing, divvying up your knowledge, keeping some back to charge for tuition classes. Doing so fosters educational inequality because rich kids can attend your class, but poor kids cannot. You’re practically going against the nation’s policies. So, tell me, aren’t you disregarding the nation?"
Lin Fan’s words brought silence to the entire room.
Cold sweat began to form on Teacher Zhao’s forehead.
She couldn’t refute Lin Fan because his words nailed her flaws.
She knew Lin Fan was right, and she had no way to argue back. The label Lin Fan gave her, if confirmed, could spell disaster for her.
She panicked, utterly panicked.
"Enough! I don’t want to waste breath on a pauper like you, and this class doesn’t need to continue. You all can leave!" Teacher Zhao said, now just wanting to end the topic quickly.
"Mr. Lin spoke quite well, so wonderful. I’d like to hear more of your debate."
A voice said.
Then they saw the mayor walk in with a smile, accompanied by an elder man, who was unmistakably the principal of the elementary school!
"Huh?"
At the sudden sight of the mayor and the principal, Teacher Zhao’s face turned pale with fright.

chapters.title: Chapter 636: The Human Heart is Insatiable Like a Snake Swallowing an Elephant
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Chapter 636: The Human Heart is Insatiable Like a Snake Swallowing an Elephant
Teacher Zhao couldn’t outtalk Lin Fan, and was at a loss for words after being refuted by Lin. When Lin placed an enormous blame on her, Teacher Zhao panicked and rushed to get rid of Lin Fan.
After all, Lin Fan was just a poor nobody; as long as she could drive him away, the matter would be over.
However, at this moment, two unexpected people appeared in front of Teacher Zhao—Mayor Long and the Principal!
The moment she recognized Mayor Long, Teacher Zhao’s face turned pale with fright.
"Mayor...!"
Oh my God, why would the mayor be here?
Is this a dream!
Never mind why the mayor is here, but clearly, he heard the conversation she just had with Lin Fan!
"You’re Teacher Zhao, right? Hello, I’m the mayor," Mayor Long said with a smile.
Teacher Zhao opened her mouth, wanting to speak, but she was so nervous that no sound came out.
Mayor Long said, "Regarding what Mr. Lin just said, do you have any views? Feel free to rebut him; I would like to hear it."
"I..." Teacher Zhao managed to squeeze out one word but couldn’t continue.
Mayor Long’s expression darkened and he said coldly, "Principal Li, is this your school’s excellent teacher? Is she here to teach or to make money?"
The primary school principal, following Mayor Long, was so frightened that he shivered and immediately smiled apologetically, "Mayor, I was shocked by the words of Teacher Zhao just now. It’s simply earth-shattering. I didn’t know she was this kind of person; I was too surprised, too shocked, I will definitely deal with this seriously!"
Mayor Long replied, "Oh, and how do you plan to deal with it?"
Principal Li said, "The words and actions of Teacher Zhao severely violate the teachers’ ethics, effective immediately, she will be suspended, and the school will further investigate her. Following that, she’ll be removed from the teaching staff."
Thud!
Teacher Zhao was terrified and dropped to her knees on the spot, crying and pleading, "I’m sorry, Mayor, I was wrong, I know I was wrong, I will never dare again, please give me a chance!"
Mayor Long said, "What do you know you did wrong?"
Teacher Zhao replied, "I shouldn’t have discriminated against the students. It was all because of my obsession with money, losing myself. But you can’t blame me entirely; teachers’ salaries are too low, I need to earn money to support my family, and thus opened a tutoring class."
Mayor Long turned his head to ask Principal Li, "Is Teacher Zhao’s salary really low?"
Principal Li replied, "Teacher Zhao is a special-grade teacher with rich teaching experience. We headhunted her with a high salary; it’s not low. Her salary plus various benefits result in an annual income of over 100,000 yuan, which counts as a high-income bracket in Tianhai City, and among teachers, she earns more than most. It’s like the saying, ’insatiable like a snake swallowing an elephant.’
Mayor Long nodded and looked at Teacher Zhao, "You earn 100,000 a year and still claim your salary is low, and open a tutoring class to make money. So according to you, those teachers with monthly salaries of three or four thousand shouldn’t even live?"
Teacher Zhao was speechless, "I..."
Lin Fan said, "Stop making excuses. Ultimately, you are just obsessed with money. No one thinks they have too much money. This has nothing to do with your annual income; it’s a problem with your character. Even if you earned 1 million a year, you’d still seize any chance to make money. Speaking of teachers’ income, are you earning less than the rural teachers present? Perhaps we can hear them talk about their income, like Teacher Wei Yue’er who volunteers in the countryside."
Wei Yue’er said, "I am a teacher volunteering in West River Village. My basic monthly salary is about 2,000 yuan, but I don’t care about this salary. I just want to do my best to help the children in the countryside."
Several other rural teachers also talked about their income, mostly two or three thousand yuan, which is really low compared to Teacher Zhao.
Lin Fan said, "Teacher Zhao, look at these teachers who are dedicated to rural education. Do you still think your salary is low?"
Teacher Zhao blushed with shame, but she couldn’t just let it go like this. She’s currently facing suspension and has to save herself.
"Can my situation and theirs be the same? They are in the countryside, where the cost of living is inherently lower than in the city, and secondly, I am a special-grade teacher. My level is higher than theirs; they come to listen to my lectures. Why shouldn’t my salary be higher than theirs? It’s quite normal," Teacher Zhao retorted.
Lin Fan looked at Wei Yue’er, nodded, and indicated it was time for Wei Yue’er to speak.
Wei Yue’er felt warmed in her heart; fortunately, she had Lin Fan, who had already helped her greatly, and now it was up to her.
Wei Yue’er shook her head and said, "Teacher Zhao, you are a special-grade teacher, no doubt. In teaching, you indeed have aspects worth learning from, but this doesn’t mean our knowledge level is lower than yours. Take the question on the blackboard, you said that Chen Simin’s method is the optimal solution, which you taught her in your class. However, it is not the optimal solution."
Teacher Zhao sneered, "Do you have a better solution? Do you think you’re better than me?"
Wei Yue’er said, "I don’t dare claim that, but I believe there could be a better solution, as just now Luo Xiaojuan also mentioned another solution, didn’t she?"
Just now, because Luo Xiaojuan proposed another solution, it angered Teacher Zhao, causing her to explode on the spot.
Because Luo Xiaojuan’s parents didn’t sign her up for Teacher Zhao’s tutoring class, depriving her of earnings, Teacher Zhao despised these poor people’s children.
Luo Xiaojuan was scolded by Teacher Zhao and was scared into silence.
Mayor Long asked, "Principal Li, what is the academic standing of Luo Xiaojuan?"
Principal Li said, "Although Xiaojuan’s family is poor, she studies very diligently and has great talent."
Mayor Long nodded, "I see, Xiaojuan, since you have another solution, why not write it on the blackboard and let us see?"
"Luo Xiaojuan, don’t be afraid, now you have brothers and sisters supporting you," Wei Yue’er said softly.
"Why not do this: I’ll go up there with you. We’ll each solve the problem and compare whose solution is better, how about that?"
With Wei Yue’er backing her, Luo Xiaojuan became less scared, gathered her courage, and nodded.
Thus, Wei Yue’er and Luo Xiaojuan went on stage together, each standing on one side, and began to solve the problem.
Soon, both of them finished writing their solutions.
After completing, they found that their solutions were identical; their thought process was the same, and this method was significantly more concise than Chen Simin’s previous solution!
Several rural teachers saw this and nodded in agreement, indicating that the method was excellent.
Teacher Zhao’s expression changed because she had to admit that Wei Yue’er and Luo Xiaojuan’s method was indeed better than hers.
Wei Yue’er said, "Teacher Zhao, do you have anything to say?"
Lin Fan said, "Although Luo Xiaojuan’s family is poor, she doesn’t lack talent. Yet Teacher Zhao, because she is a poor child, you disparaged and belittled her. She might become disheartened, and a talent could be smothered in its infancy. You being a teacher like this, you are leading students astray. Teacher Zhao, after being suspended, do you still think it’s unfair? Do you still think obsessing over money is not wrong?"
Teacher Zhao was so ashamed that she blushed and slumped to the ground, staring down without uttering a word.
Mayor Long laughed heartily, "Mr. Lin, this matter is resolved. Can Mr. Lin visit the city hall as my guest?"
What?
Everyone exchanged glances in disbelief, Mayor Long inviting this poor guy to the city hall. Who is he really?

chapters.title: Chapter 637: Borrowing the School Clinic
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Chapter 637: Borrowing the School Clinic
Principal Li of the affiliated elementary school was very surprised at this moment. He heard that the mayor was coming to the school and quickly came to receive the mayor. At the same time, he also heard that the mayor was coming with a young man, and it seemed that the mayor respected this young man very much.
Principal Li was surprised at the time, what kind of young man could be so highly regarded by the mayor?
Now, witnessing it with his own eyes, Mayor Long actually invited Lin Fan to the city hall as a guest so respectfully, this...
It’s undeniable, Lin Fan, this young man, truly has some skills. His eloquence left Teacher Zhao speechless, putting a big hat on her, even making the seasoned Zhao Teacher panic.
But if he were only relying on his eloquence, it wouldn’t be enough for Mayor Long to treat him so courteously, would it?
What exactly is his background?
Wei Yue’er wasn’t surprised. She heard that Lin Fan came to the city today to treat the illness of the municipal party secretary. Lin Fan is a miracle doctor; receiving such treatment from Mayor Long is not surprising.
Lin Fan said, "Mayor, please wait a moment. I want to check on my friend’s situation first. How about this? I won’t delay your time, Mayor. You can go ahead and be busy. I’ll visit the city hall myself later."
Mayor Long said with a smile, "That sounds good, but I hope Mr. Lin doesn’t stand me up. I still need to discuss with Mr. Lin about investing in Tianhai, as this matter concerns Tianhai’s development. I really hope Mr. Lin will come."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I promised the mayor, so I won’t break my word."
Wei Yue’er frowned, wait, that’s a bit odd, discussing investment in Tianhai?
Could it be that the reason Lin Fan received such treatment from Mayor Long isn’t because he’s a miracle doctor, but why does Mayor Long want to discuss investment with Lin Fan?
Everyone exchanged bewildered looks. This guy seems like a poor man at first glance. Why is Mayor Long discussing Tianhai’s investment with a poor guy? What’s going on?
Principal Li couldn’t help but chuckle awkwardly and asked, "Mayor, please forgive my curiosity, this Mr. Lin is...?"
Mayor Long said, "Originally, I invited Mr. Lin to the city hall. Mr. Lin needed to meet his friend temporarily, so he came here, and that’s why I followed along."
What?
Mayor Long actually followed Lin Fan here?
Is it possible?
This kind of thing actually happens?
Teacher Zhao also looked shocked. She fell at Lin Fan’s hands today, to be honest, being rendered speechless by a poor guy like him was frustrating. If it weren’t for the sudden appearance of the mayor, she wouldn’t have feared this poor guy.
Because no matter how eloquent this poor guy is, it wouldn’t be of much use, he couldn’t do anything to her.
The reason she stumbled was because Mayor Long suddenly appeared for some unknown reason.
Now it seems, Mayor Long appeared because of this poor guy?
"You, who exactly are you?" Teacher Zhao couldn’t help but ask. She really wanted to know, who exactly is this poor guy; she wants to die knowing.
Mayor Long said with a slight smile, "Teacher Zhao, you just kept calling Mr. Lin a poor man; you might have insulted the wrong person. If Mr. Lin is also a poor man, then what are we?"
Wei Yue’er was slightly stunned. She knew Lin Fan had excellent medical skills, but that’s secondary. Lin Fan seems indeed not to have much money; he dresses very plainly, and the car he drives is a rundown Xia Li, right!
Of course, Wei Yue’er doesn’t care if Lin Fan is poor, or rather, she doesn’t care if her partner has money or not. What she cares about is the partner’s charm. It’s just right, Lin Fan, though poor, deeply attracts her, making her a bit unable to extricate herself, hopelessly.
Mayor Long didn’t reveal that Lin Fan is the richest man in Yun City. He already knows that Lin Fan prefers to keep a low profile, so there’s no need to boast about Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, I’m waiting for you at the city hall."
Mayor Long said, then took his leave and left.
Lin Fan said to Wei Yue’er, "Yue’er, let’s go too. Your complexion doesn’t look good; let me check your pulse."
Wei Yue’er nodded, "Okay."
Wei Yue’er followed Lin Fan and walked out of the classroom.
Teacher Zhao couldn’t help but shout hoarsely, "Stop, who exactly are you?"
Lin Fan stopped his steps, turned back and glanced at Teacher Zhao, smilingly said, "Who I am isn’t important; what’s important is that you should behave yourself properly in the future, Teacher Zhao."
After saying that, Lin Fan no longer paid attention to Teacher Zhao and walked out of the classroom with Wei Yue’er.
"Lin Fan, maybe I ate something wrong this morning, my stomach’s been uncomfortable," Wei Yue’er said.
Lin Fan reached out to check Wei Yue’er’s pulse, nodded, and said, "It’s nothing serious; taking some medicine will do. Principal Li, does the school have an infirmary? Can we borrow it for a while?"
Principal Li promptly said, "No problem, I’ll take you there."
No matter what the identity is, anyone who can be treated with such respect by the mayor must not be simple. Principal Li can’t easily offend Lin Fan, and Lin Fan’s just borrowing the infirmary, that’s a minor issue; it’s not something he would refuse.
So, Principal Li personally took Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er to the infirmary.
In the infirmary, there was only one female doctor, who was the sole doctor of this elementary school, usually working in the infirmary. If students or teachers feel unwell, they would come to this female doctor.
You could say in this school, matters of illness are all decided by this female doctor.
At this moment, the female doctor had nothing to do, she was playing on her phone in the infirmary, watching short videos, occasionally letting out giggles. She’s a middle-aged female doctor, roughly in her forties or fifties.
"Dr. Sun."
Principal Li walked into the infirmary and greeted her.
Dr. Sun saw it’s the principal coming, quickly stood up, and said, "Principal, you’re here, are you not feeling well? Let me take a look for you?"
Principal Li said, "It’s not me who’s unwell, it’s Teacher Wei who’s feeling a bit uncomfortable."
Only then did Dr. Sun see Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er following behind Principal Li.
Wei Yue’er was very beautiful, and Lin Fan was also handsome, but both dressed very plainly, clearly not wealthy people, Lin Fan was even poorer, obviously someone from a rural area.
"Teacher Wei?" Dr. Sun asked curiously.
Wei Yue’er smiled and said, "Hello, Dr. Sun, I’m a volunteer teacher from West River Village, here to attend class at your school today."
Dr. Sun said oh, so she’s a teacher from the village, no wonder, indeed a rural person.
"Where’s your discomfort coming from, come and sit down, I’ll take a look for you." Dr. Sun said.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Dr. Sun, no need for you to check, it’s like this, I’m the village doctor from West River Village, I’m here to borrow your infirmary for a bit."
Dr. Sun was stunned. This poor guy, is a village doctor?
Borrowing her infirmary, what’s the meaning of that, does this guy want to treat Wei Yue’er?
Dr. Sun chuckled and said, "Borrow the infirmary? Why, you don’t want me to treat her?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, Teacher Wei’s stomach is uncomfortable, probably ate something bad, I want her to get well quickly."
Dr. Sun said, "You think I can’t make her get well quickly?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, you could say that."
"What?"
Dr. Sun was furious, this village doctor was too arrogant, actually looking down on her!
After all, she’s also the school city doctor’s infirmary, usually responsible for the health of hundreds of students and teachers, doesn’t she have more skills than a small village doctor!

chapters.title: Chapter 638: This Is Simply Impossible!
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Chapter 638: This Is Simply Impossible!
"A little village doctor like you dares to be arrogant in front of me? Principal, I apologize, but this is my medical office, and I won’t let a village doctor practice here. What if he causes some trouble and I have to take responsibility? After all, he’s just a village doctor, and that’s quite likely. He might even be a charlatan!"
Dr. Sun said, refusing to lend the medical office to Lin Fan.
Principal Li felt a bit awkward. On one hand, he didn’t dare to offend Lin Fan, as Lin Fan was someone even the mayor respected deeply, though he didn’t know why, but it was a fact. On the other hand, he didn’t want to provoke Dr. Sun, who was an excellent school doctor, and finding a good school doctor wasn’t easy nowadays.
"Well..." Principal Li awkwardly smiled, "Teacher Wei isn’t feeling well and should be treated as soon as possible. How about this, let Teacher Wei decide for herself. Both of you are doctors, so she can choose."
Principal Li passed the responsibility to Wei Yue’er.
Wei Yue’er, however, said decisively, "I want Lin Fan to check on me."
Dr. Sun was displeased and snorted, "You choose this village doctor? Fine, then I’ll just wait and see how great he is, but let me make it clear, if anything happens, I’m not responsible!"
Wei Yue’er smiled, "Dr. Sun, don’t worry, no matter what happens, it has nothing to do with you."
She trusted Lin Fan and didn’t feel there would be any problem.
Lin Fan said, "Then let’s start the examination. It’s very simple. Next, I’ll first take your pulse. In traditional Chinese medicine, we observe, listen, question, and feel the pulse to determine the condition. After that, I’ll prescribe you some medicine, and hopefully, you’ll be better by the time we leave here. Give me your hand."
Wei Yue’er extended her jade-like hand to Lin Fan, rolled up her sleeve, and revealed her fair wrist.
Lin Fan placed two fingers on Wei Yue’er’s wrist pulse gate and began the diagnosis.
Dr. Sun watched coldly from the side, sneering inside. This village doctor was just putting on a show, talking big. Although stomach trouble is a minor ailment, getting better so quickly is impossible!
Getting better by leaving the medical office? That’s totally impossible!
Unless they plan to stay in the medical office for half the day.
While Dr. Sun was full of doubt, Lin Fan had already finished checking Wei Yue’er’s pulse. Lin Fan let go of her hand and turned to one side to start preparing the medicine.
Soon, Lin Fan finished preparing the medicine and powdered it.
"Alright, take this packet of medicine powder, and then we can leave," Lin Fan smiled, pouring a cup of boiled water for Wei Yue’er.
"Wait a minute!"
Dr. Sun couldn’t help but speak.
She had watched Lin Fan prepare the medicine, and there was nothing special about what he prescribed, just ordinary medicine for stomach trouble. The way Lin Fan mixed the dosage was a bit baffling to Dr. Sun, and typically, no one would powder the medicine. She didn’t know what Lin Fan’s mystery was in doing this.
In Dr. Sun’s view, Lin Fan was just putting on an act and creating a mystery out of nothing.
"Teacher Wei, do you mind if I ask you a few questions? Because this village doctor’s diagnosis process seems unreliable. How can he accurately know your condition just by taking your pulse?" Dr. Sun said.
Wei Yue’er replied, "Dr. Sun, I don’t think it’s necessary..."
She knew Lin Fan’s capabilities and trusted him, so Dr. Sun’s actions were redundant.
However, Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, feel free to answer Dr. Sun."
So, Dr. Sun started asking Wei Yue’er questions about what she ate today, when her stomach ache began, and any other symptoms she might have. It was all the basic process of a Western medical examination.
After it was over.
Dr. Sun confirmed she had understood Wei Yue’er’s condition and said, "Teacher Wei, I don’t know your relationship with this village doctor, and perhaps you trust him more, but I’m a doctor, a real doctor who graduated from a medical university. By the way, where did this village doctor graduate from, may I ask?"
Dr. Sun looked disdainfully at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled, "I didn’t attend any medical university. I taught myself medical skills."
What?
Dr. Sun and Principal Li were both startled, self-taught medical skills? That sounded unreliable.
Dr. Sun said, "You dare to practice medicine without formal medical training? That’s utterly ridiculous. No way, I take back what I said earlier. I can’t allow you to practice medicine here. This is my medical office, and I’m responsible for every patient. I can’t hand patients over to someone like you!"
Wei Yue’er felt a bit embarrassed and said, "Dr. Sun, it’s okay, actually, Lin Fan..."
Dr. Sun said, "There’s no need to say more, Teacher Wei. I’m sure you’ve been fooled by this person. This kind of village doctor, a quack from the Jianghu, doesn’t have real skills, but they’re really good at deceiving people. Those who don’t understand medical practice can easily trust them, spend money for nothing, and not get cured! Teacher Wei, tell me, how much is he charging you for this treatment?"
In Dr. Sun’s view, Lin Fan, the scammer, was definitely after Wei Yue’er’s money. Surely, he had convinced Wei Yue’er it was easy to cure her, gaining her trust, and he must have demanded a large medical fee.
Wei Yue’er said, "Charging? Lin Fan didn’t charge me anything."
"I said... what? He didn’t charge you?" Dr. Sun was stunned, this didn’t make sense, Lin Fan, the scammer, should be charging, and a lot of money at that, so why didn’t he charge?
Wei Yue’er smiled, "Dr. Sun, I understand your concerns. You’re worried about Lin Fan’s lack of skill, but actually, you needn’t worry. I trust Lin Fan’s medical skills."
Dr. Sun slapped her thigh, "Now I get it. This guy not charging you is part of his scheme. Treating minor ailments for free to gain your trust, and later he’ll start conning you and emptying your wallet. Teacher Wei, you must be cautious. Scammers these days are hard to guard against."
Wei Yue’er could no longer smile. It seemed this Dr. Sun had determined Lin Fan to be a scammer just because he was a village doctor and hadn’t attended a medical university, completely dismissing him. This seemed like a form of discrimination.
Dr. Sun continued earnestly trying to persuade Wei Yue’er, "Teacher Wei, listen to my advice. This person pretends to diagnose and makes a mystery of prescribing medicine, but he can’t fool me. He’s only prescribed one set of medicine. How can that cure you? Your condition requires injections, and I’ll also prescribe two days of medicine. Go home and take it, and if it doesn’t work, you can come back."
Wei Yue’er calmly replied, "No need."
Saying that, Wei Yue’er stood up, walked over to Lin Fan, took the medicine powder and water, and drank the powder along with the water.
Dr. Sun was very displeased. She believed she had earnestly tried to persuade Wei Yue’er, yet this woman still stubbornly refused to believe her. It seemed she had been brainwashed by this village doctor.
Wei Yue’er didn’t listen to her advice, so Dr. Sun began to feel irked by Wei Yue’er as well.
Dr. Sun pursed her lips, "Honestly, you’re so young and pretty, and a teacher too, you shouldn’t be so easily conned, how could you just..."
She hadn’t even finished her sentence.
"Lin Fan, my stomach feels much better, it doesn’t hurt anymore," Wei Yue’er suddenly exclaimed joyfully, startling Dr. Sun.
What?
Dr. Sun was stunned, what the heck, it got better so quickly?

chapters.title: Chapter 639: Stunned, Isn’t This Lin Fan?
chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Chapter 639: Stunned, Isn’t This Lin Fan?
Wei Yue’er is already feeling better?
Dr. Sun was stunned. How is this possible? She just took that packet of medicinal powder, how could she recover so quickly? If it’s true, then it’s really miraculous!
Dr. Sun couldn’t believe such a miraculous thing exists in this world!
Even if such advanced medical skills exist, it couldn’t be this village doctor who hasn’t attended medical school, a mere itinerant charlatan. If it were, that would be just unbelievable!
"Teacher Wei, stop joking. Are you sure you’re already cured?" Dr. Sun asked incredulously.
Wei Yue’er laughed and said, "Yes, Dr. Sun, I told you not to worry. I know about Lin Fan’s medical skills, but thank you for your concern."
Her stomach felt better, and her mood improved a lot.
Speaking of which, the medicinal powder Lin Fan gave her was amazing. Once consumed, it cured the ailment immediately, her stomach stopped troubling her, and her spirit was restored. Before, she had watched Lin Fan treat others and found it extraordinary, but now having experienced it herself, Lin Fan’s medical skills were indeed miraculous.
Dr. Sun felt doubtful about everything and shook her head saying, "It’s impossible. You must be lying. You’re speaking for a fraud, Teacher Wei, you’ve been brainwashed too much, haven’t you? No way, come over here, let me examine you."
Dr. Sun hurried to Wei Yue’er and began checking her condition.
She was fine!
She was really fine!
With her years of medical experience, Dr. Sun was surprised to find that Wei Yue’er wasn’t pretending and was really cured just by a packet of medicinal powder!
"How could this be..."
Dr. Sun was so shocked she nearly knelt down.
It was too miraculous!
If someone else had told her this, she wouldn’t have believed it, but she personally examined Wei Yue’er’s condition earlier, and had just verified the result herself. She couldn’t help but believe it!
Lin Fan really used one dosage of medicine to speedily cure Wei Yue’er!
No injections, no medication for two days, not even a need to return if the treatment failed!
"How did you do it?"
Dr. Sun couldn’t help but ask Lin Fan, looking at him with amazement, her voice trembling slightly.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "The secret to curing her so quickly lies in the preparation of the medicine! There weren’t any very precious medicines here, luckily, even ordinary medicines, if combined well, can yield considerable effects. It’s like Coca-Cola, the ingredients themselves are nothing special, but when combined, they make a delicious cola, showcasing the importance of the formula."
The Coca-Cola formula is said to be top-secret because without the formula, other cola drinks can’t replicate the same taste.
"Finished products of ordinary medicines come in pills, which are hard to combine. So, I ground all these medicines into powder, which facilitated the combination of ingredient dosages. Mixing various medicinal ingredients in appropriate proportions resulted in this medicine. A stomachache is indeed a minor ailment, one dosage can cure it, naturally no need for injections."
Lin Fan explained.
Dr. Sun was already on her knees.
Lin Fan’s words made so much sense.
At this point, she completely ignored the fact that Lin Fan was self-taught in medicine and hadn’t attended medical school. With such miraculous medical skills, those things didn’t seem to matter anymore.
"Even the cleverest woman cannot cook without rice. I borrowed your clinic, Dr. Sun, just to prepare some medicine for her, I have to thank you for that. If there’s nothing else, we’ll take our leave now. Yue’er, let’s go." Lin Fan said.
Wei Yue’er nodded happily.
Her stomach felt better, she was spirited, and now that Lin Fan had proven Dr. Sun wrong with his miraculous medical skills, her mood improved even further.
Thus, in Dr. Sun’s astonished gaze, Wei Yue’er followed Lin Fan out of the clinic.
Principal Li quickly caught up and said, "Mr. Lin, Teacher Wei, let me see you off."
He seemed to understand a bit why Mayor Long had such respect for Lin Fan; this young man was truly extraordinary. Just his medical skills alone could cause high-ranking officials to bow in prostration.
After they left.
Dr. Sun finally snapped out of her daze.
"Who on earth is he..." Dr. Sun muttered.
Then, wanting to distract herself, Dr. Sun picked up her phone, still startled by Lin Fan, thinking she shouldn’t dwell on this further.
Unintentionally opening WeChat, Dr. Sun found a group of medical colleagues who were enthusiastically discussing. It turned out that recently, in Tianhai City, a young divine doctor had appeared, and the legend of this divine doctor had started to spread.
"The mother of Xishan County’s governor had a stroke, Dr. Zhu Ming was in charge, and the patient nearly died on the operating table! It was this Divine Doctor Lin who saved her!"
"Amazing! I was there watching! I’ve never seen such incredible medical skills!"
"I heard Divine Doctor Lin also cured Secretary Ma!"
"My god, how did he learn such medical skills at such a young age!"
"Maybe it’s innate talent, Divine Doctor Lin is a genius!"
"We can only admire geniuses, there’s no competing with them, just worship!"
"And Divine Doctor Lin is so handsome, let me share a treasured photo of Divine Doctor Lin’s dashing look, taken discreetly at the scene that day!"
The messages were updating rapidly.
Suddenly, a female doctor sent out a picture. It was a photo of the Lin Fairy Doctor they were discussing.
Whether or not this female doctor was impressed by Lin Fan’s medical skills was unknown, but clearly, his good looks had won her over.
Seeing the photo, Dr. Sun jumped up from her chair!
This!
This... this is freaking Lin Fan!
Oh my god, the person they were fervently discussing, whom everyone worshipped as the Divine Doctor Lin, the legendary young genius doctor, had just been in her clinic, borrowing her facility!
Dr. Sun was so excited her heart was about to leap out.
Then she recalled how she had previously looked down on Lin Fan, even mocking him to his face for being a village doctor who hadn’t attended medical school!
In an instant, Dr. Sun’s face was flushed with embarrassment; she felt utterly ashamed and regretted it deeply. Had she known Lin Fan was Divine Doctor Lin, she wouldn’t have embarrassed herself so thoroughly...
Lin Fan knew none of this; in fact, Lin Fan was a low-key person, never boasting about himself to others. Even if they misunderstood him, like thinking he was a billionaire, or a poor man and mocking him, he never explained, because he felt it wasn’t necessary.
What if others underestimated his medical skills? Whoever underestimated him was embarrassed. What if others thought he was poor? The person who believed so would be embarrassed.
Truly capable people never boast all around; it’s always those less capable who enjoy showing off and trying to impress others.
However, the highest level of showing off is never actively bragging about oneself.
For instance, Lin Fan never told Principal Li he had arrived in a Rolls-Royce.
When he and Wei Yue’er left the campus and drove away in the Rolls-Royce, Principal Li, who had always misunderstood Lin Fan as a poor man, was left with his mouth agape, utterly dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 640: Who Exactly Is It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Chapter 640: Who Exactly Is It?
Lin Fan left in the Rolls-Royce Cullinan, which not only left Principal Li stunned but also surprised Wei Yue’er.
The car Lin Fan used to drive wasn’t it an old and broken Xia Li? How did it change to a Rolls-Royce? And at school, Mayor Long was even pulling Lin Fan aside, saying he wanted to invite him to the city hall to discuss some investment matters. What’s going on?
If this car isn’t Lin Fan’s, just borrowed from someone, that might make sense, but how do you explain the investment matters?
The only reason Mayor Long could value Lin Fan, as far as Wei Yue’er knew, was Lin Fan’s medical skills. Does Lin Fan have other remarkable abilities that she doesn’t know about besides his medical skills?
"Lin Fan, this car..."
Wei Yue’er couldn’t help but ask out of curiosity,
"Is it yours?"
Lin Fan nodded: "Yes."
Wei Yue’er asked, "What happened to your Xia Li?"
Lin Fan replied, "The Xia Li was rented. I wanted to keep a low profile for a while, so I rented the Xia Li. I hadn’t planned on staying this long, so I didn’t rent it for long, and today the lease expired. I didn’t feel like renewing it, so I switched back to my own car."
Wei Yue’er was stunned.
"Alright then..."
Suddenly, Wei Yue’er realized that she didn’t know Lin Fan at all. Who exactly was he? She originally thought he was just a poor kid; suddenly, he started driving a Rolls-Royce!
She couldn’t ask any further, afraid Lin Fan wouldn’t like it, and more afraid that she would learn things she didn’t want to know.
She just asked, "Lin Fan, where are we going now?"
Lin Fan said, "Let’s go to the city hall first. Wait for me, and then we’ll head back to the village."
"Okay." Wei Yue’er nodded.
Along the way, Wei Yue’er was silent, full of thoughts she wanted to ask but couldn’t bring up, while Lin Fan wasn’t someone who bragged about himself.
Soon, they arrived outside the city hall.
Before arriving, Lin Fan had already called Mayor Long, saying he would be there soon.
As they arrived outside the city hall, they saw a group of people gathered at the entrance, with Secretary Ma, Mayor Long, and other leaders, as well as the wealthy businessmen Lin Fan had met in the morning.
These wealthy businessmen hadn’t left because they heard Yun City’s richest person was coming. They stayed intentionally, wanting to meet Lin Fan. In the morning, Lin Fan appeared as Divine Doctor Lin, and they didn’t know he was Yun City’s richest person. After finding out, they regretted not getting acquainted with Mr. Lin.
Everyone unanimously suggested inviting Mr. Lin so they could have a chat.
Such a good opportunity was naturally not to be missed.
Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er got out of the car and walked toward the crowd.
The scene surprised Wei Yue’er, but she wasn’t intimidated, standing confidently beside Lin Fan.
The handsome man and beautiful woman indeed made a striking impression.
The crowd was captivated by Wei Yue’er, but in their eyes, the focus was Lin Fan, the richest person in Yun City. Therefore, Wei Yue’er’s presence only served to highlight Lin Fan, showing that only a beauty like Wei Yue’er could match this young talent.
In everyone’s eyes, Lin Fan was indeed a god-like presence—young, not only supremely skilled in medicine but also the richest person in Yun City, and handsome too. He truly was a dragon among men.
"Mr. Lin is here!"
Secretary Ma said with a smile, taking the lead and warmly shaking hands with Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin!"
"Mr. Lin!"
"Mr. Lin!"
Everyone greeted him enthusiastically, regardless of whether Lin Fan knew them or not. They all hoped to shake hands with Mr. Lin.
"Mr. Lin, Divine Doctor Lin, we’ve been eagerly waiting for you," Secretary Ma said with a smile, then shifted his gaze to Wei Yue’er, "This must be Mr. Lin’s girlfriend, right? Such a beauty, a perfect match for Mr. Lin. Hello."
Secretary Ma also took the initiative to shake Wei Yue’er’s hand.
Wei Yue’er felt a bit shy, her face blushed. She should clarify that she wasn’t Lin Fan’s girlfriend, but she hesitated and remained silent.
Lin Fan also didn’t clarify. The misunderstanding wasn’t a big deal, no need to be particular about it. Mainly, everyone had the wrong idea, and clarifying would make things slightly awkward. If they wanted to misunderstand, let them continue.
"A beauty with a handsome guy, a perfect match!" Mayor Long also said with a laugh.
"Only such a beauty could be worthy of Mr. Lin."
Everyone echoed the compliments. While praising Wei Yue’er, they were actually lauding Lin Fan.
"Mr. Lin, let’s go inside and talk," Secretary Ma said.
Lin Fan nodded: "Alright, Yue’er, wait for me in the car for a moment; I’ll be out soon."
He went inside to discuss business matters with the others, considering Wei Yue’er might find it boring, it was better for her to wait outside.
Wei Yue’er originally wanted to follow him in. She was very curious about Lin Fan’s identity, who could earn such respect from both political and business elites. But since Lin Fan had said so, she couldn’t say much and just nodded.
So, Lin Fan entered the city hall surrounded by everyone.
Wei Yue’er returned to the Rolls-Royce to wait for Lin Fan.
Wei Yue’er’s emotions were complex because she realized that her impression of Lin Fan seemed to differ vastly from the real Lin Fan. It was like she suddenly didn’t recognize Lin Fan at all.
Lin Fan, who exactly are you?
Ring ring ring...
The phone rang.
Wei Yue’er picked up her phone and answered the call: "Hello?"
The voice on the other end said, "Yue’er, have you considered what I told you last night? The person I’m introducing to you this time is an excellent returnee, working in investments, a very outstanding young man, and very good-looking. He absolutely meets your criteria for a partner. Come back when you have time."
Wei Yue’er felt a little impatient and said, "Brother, didn’t I tell you I won’t be coming back to meet the people you introduce? I don’t want to meet those people!"
The other end said, "Why are you so stubborn? I just want you to find a good family soon and be happy."
Wei Yue’er said, "If you really want me to be happy, don’t interfere with my love life."
The other end said, "You’re my sister, and I promised our parents I’d fulfill their responsibilities. They’re no longer here; as your elder brother, how can I not interfere? By the way, you said yesterday you already found someone, a doctor. Who is he?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Who..."
Truthfully, she didn’t know who Lin Fan was anymore.
The other end said, "How old is he? What’s his family background? Is he of equal status to us? These are all very important."
Wei Yue’er said in confusion, "I don’t know either."
The other end thought Wei Yue’er was reluctant to reveal more and said, "It’s okay if you don’t say for now. At least tell your brother his name, okay?"
Wei Yue’er didn’t want to keep refusing her brother, so she said, "Okay, I’ll tell you his name. His name is Lin Fan."
"What? Lin Fan?" The other end sounded a bit surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: The Great Value of the Richest Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: Chapter 641: The Great Value of the Richest Person
The reaction from the other side left Wei Yue’er somewhat puzzled. She said, "Brother, what’s wrong? You seemed very surprised when you heard Lin Fan’s name. Do you know him?"
But the other side calmed down and said, "Oh, it’s nothing. It must just be someone with the same name. There are plenty of people with the same name in the world. You’re teaching in a mountain village; how could it possibly be... Anyway, it’s nothing."
Wei Yue’er frowned. The tone from the other side seemed almost as if trying to comfort themselves, leaving her confused about what was going on.
"Yue’er, I know you don’t like it when your brother introduces you to potential partners, but you must remember your status. You can’t just marry anyone, okay?" the other side reminded seriously.
Wei Yue’er said, "I understand, brother. Anyway, don’t introduce me to anyone. Just turn down that person you mentioned earlier for me."
The other side said, "Well, I’ll do my best."
Wei Yue’er said, "What do you mean by ’do your best’?"
The other side replied, "Because he’s very fond of you and even said he wanted to find you. It seems he has deep feelings for you. Matters of the heart can’t be forced, you know."
Wei Yue’er was speechless. What did he mean by ’matters of the heart can’t be forced’? It was clear that her brother favored this person and was biased, allowing him to come looking for her without stopping him. If it were someone her brother didn’t like, he would certainly stop them.
"Brother, don’t let this person come. I don’t want my peace in the village disturbed," Wei Yue’er said.
The other side said, "Then why don’t you find some time to come back? Recently, my health hasn’t been great. You should come back to see me. It’s been a long time, and I miss you dearly."
Wei Yue’er considered for a moment and said, "Alright, I’ll go back then."
The other side seemed pleased with their success and said happily, "Good, I’ll wait for you to come back."
Wei Yue’er shook her head and hung up the phone, feeling somewhat helpless.
It seems she ultimately has to go back for a blind date!
Originally, she thought she had someone she cherished and would no longer consider anyone else. But now, that person made her feel a bit elusive, leaving her heart in turmoil.
More than an hour later.
Lin Fan walked out of the city hall, surrounded by a group of people, chatting and laughing. It seemed he had a pleasant conversation inside.
"Mr. Lin, do you have any plans later? Would you like to have a meal together?" Secretary Ma proposed.
This proposal received unanimous approval from everyone.
"Have a meal; we must have a meal. We’d like to have a good chat with Mr. Lin!"
"It’s truly a great honor to meet Mr. Lin today. Having a meal is a must!"
"Yes, this meal shouldn’t be missed!"
Everyone chimed in, planning to organize a meal gathering.
Lin Fan, however, said, "Let’s skip the meal, maybe next time. I still need to hurry back to the village. A buddy of mine is getting married today, throwing a feast. My family is urging me to come back."
Secretary Ma regrettably said, "In that case, next time then. Take care, Mr. Lin."
"Take care, Mr. Lin!"
"Take care, Mr. Lin!"
"Take care, Mr. Lin!"
Everyone chimed in, sending off Lin Fan.
Lin Fan got into the Rolls-Royce under everyone’s watchful eyes.
After Lin Fan left.
The crowd continued discussing.
"So, it’s Mr. Lin’s buddy’s wedding today!"
"That’s a joyous occasion!"
"I have an idea. What do you all think about joining in and offering congratulations to Mr. Lin’s friend?"
"Brilliant, brilliant!"
"That’s a great idea. Since it’s a joyous day, we should join in and share the happiness. I doubt Mr. Lin would mind!"
"It’s settled then!"
Thus, the tycoons of the political and business world made a cheerful decision.
Lin Fan was unaware of this. He drove the Rolls-Royce, with Wei Yue’er, heading back to West River Village.
During the past hour or so, Lin Fan had been discussing investments at the city hall. After Secretary Ma and Mayor Long’s introductions, Lin Fan indeed had thoughts of investing in Tianhai.
Although Tianhai isn’t a developed city, that’s its advantage. The land is cheaper here, and labor costs are lower. Investing here can save a lot of costs. At the same time, investing in Tianhai would create job opportunities and economic benefits for the area, a win-win situation.
Lin Fan is originally from Tianhai City. Investing in his hometown is also a way to give back.
Just as Mayor Long previously thought, Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, set an example. The other tycoons who initially had no interest were now showing interest, considering officially planning investments in Tianhai City.
It could be said that this discussion was pivotal for Tianhai City’s development. Many years later, this meeting was recorded in Tianhai City’s history, regarded as the beginning of Tianhai’s transformation.
The influence of Yun City’s richest man was evident.
Lin Fan was not a short-sighted person. He knew that the enthusiastic hospitality from Secretary Ma and Mayor Long was due to his immense value. If he were really just a delivery person, he wouldn’t receive such treatment.
He managed to make the big shots in politics and business bow because he is a billionaire tycoon!
Returning to Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er driving back to West River Village.
"I’m sorry, Yue’er, to keep you waiting so long. I originally wanted to leave quickly, but they were too welcoming," Lin Fan apologized.
Wei Yue’er was lost in thought at this moment. She wasn’t silly; for Lin Fan to receive such enthusiastic treatment from the political and business elite, his identity mustn’t be simple.
But she didn’t know how to ask Lin Fan. Lin Fan previously deliberately hid his wealth, probably not wanting her to know. She was a considerate person, too considerate. Since Lin Fan wanted to hide it, she refrained from asking, not wanting to upset him.
So, despite her curiosity, she could only hold it in.
"It’s fine." Wei Yue’er ended up saying just those three words.
Lin Fan sensed something and said, "Yue’er, you seem to have something on your mind?"
Wei Yue’er shook her head and said, "I don’t..."
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay. You can say what’s on your mind. Don’t keep it bottled up. You can talk to me."
Lin Fan’s words gave Wei Yue’er courage. She took a deep breath and said, "I want to know..."
She initially wanted to say she wanted to know Lin Fan’s true identity and why he was so wealthy.
But suddenly, Lin Fan interrupted her, "Wait, there’s something off about the car in front."
Lin Fan was drawn to a car in front. Wei Yue’er followed his gaze, seeing a small truck with moving stickers on it, seemingly a moving service truck.
Wei Yue’er immediately became alert, forgetting to ask about Lin Fan. There was indeed something wrong with the car in front.
"Is she trying to jump out of the car?" Wei Yue’er exclaimed.
Lin Fan frowned, "Hmm, not sure what’s happening, but if she does jump, it could be fatal. Jumping from a moving vehicle almost certainly means death."
Wei Yue’er anxiously asked, "What should we do then?"
Lin Fan calmed down, "We have to save her."

chapters.title: Chapter 642 Anxious Female
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Chapter 642 Anxious Female
The road back to West River Village is considered a rather secluded one; Lin Fan is familiar with it, so he doesn’t need to use navigation. Choosing this road makes the journey much shorter, but it’s not on the navigation system, so fewer cars travel on it.
Ahead of Lin Fan’s vehicle, a small truck is moving, with the logo of a freight platform printed on its body.
"What are you doing?"
On the truck, a female voice sounds quite emotional.
"What did I do to you?"
The driver said somewhat gloomily.
He didn’t know what he did to make the woman so emotional.
He’s a dedicated driver for the freight platform, earning a living by helping people transport goods. This job is his second today, with the backend showing the reward for this order is 50 yuan.
Too little!
His mind was filled with thoughts about the end of the month approaching, trying to earn more money for rent, utilities, and his family’s living expenses. Every month it’s quite tight, so earning a bit more could make life easier in the coming month.
However, this order was taking up too much time; if he didn’t end it quickly and take the next one, his plan to earn more today wouldn’t be realized.
The process of these moving jobs is picking up an order on the freight platform, then according to the location, rushing to the customer’s place, loading the goods into the vehicle, transporting them to the destination, unloading, and completing the task.
Each step can be optimized to save time, but may also be delayed for various reasons.
For example, if the road conditions are good or if a shortcut is available, a lot of time can be saved. But if the road conditions are bad, like during traffic peaks, it could be a nightmare.
Moreover, during loading and unloading, you wish for the customer’s goods to be as few as possible; naturally the more goods, the more time needed. But the price remains the same, no additional charge for more goods.
Unless the customer pays extra to ask the driver to help with moving, which allows for additional earnings, or an extra pair of hands to speed up loading and unloading; this is the perfect solution.
Today was really unlucky.
This was the kind of situation that every freight driver least wanted to encounter: this woman had a lot of goods and, to save money, didn’t want to pay the driver to help with the moving.
Just the process of loading the goods onto the vehicle took more than half an hour.
It means the driver waited downstairs at the customer’s location for more than half an hour.
The woman was saving money, running upstairs and downstairs over ten times by herself, and finally finished moving the goods.
The driver’s mood gradually became irritable with the prolonged waiting time. Calculating the time, loading goods onto the vehicle took more than half an hour; upon reaching the destination, who knows how long unloading would take? Possibly another half an hour, with this woman’s personality, it was entirely possible, along with round-trip driving time, this job ate up hours of his time.
Hours, just for 50 yuan.
The thought of this made the driver’s mood terribly bad.
But what could he do? The deed was done, he couldn’t refuse this order; he had accepted it himself and had to complete it, albeit tearfully, so he tried to save as much time as possible on the driving.
Therefore, the driver didn’t follow the navigation; he was familiar with the roads and knew there were shortcuts to take.
But for some reason, the woman got agitated.
This left the driver completely bewildered, not understanding why the woman was upset.
Originally irritated by the time-consuming move, the driver held no goodwill towards this woman, and now with her inexplicable actions, the driver was even more displeased.
"What am I doing? I’m driving, and I haven’t asked what you’re doing yet. This woman is really annoying!" the driver muttered to himself.
"Where is this going? He’s not following the navigation!"
The woman’s heart was very anxious at this moment.
The more she thought, the more frightened she became.
Recalling when she decided to move today, she ordered on the freight platform, truth be told, it was quite affordable, just 40 yuan, seemed a bit too cheap, she was very satisfied.
Happily placed the order, and waited for the driver to arrive.
Finally, the driver arrived, asked her to bring down the goods, so she pulled down a box.
The driver looked, showing a bit of surprise in his eyes, asked: "Hello, are there many items?"
She laughed and said: "There are a lot more items."
The driver responded: "Do you need help?"
She was somewhat surprised: "Can you help move them?"
Until this point, the exchange between them was friendly and relaxed.
The driver said: "I can, but it won’t be free; a tip is needed."
What? There’s a charge?
She kind of understood: society is really deep with tricks; no wonder moving is so cheap, turns out moving the goods incurs additional fees!
Heck, I won’t let you earn this money!
"Do you need help with moving?" the driver asked again.
The woman immediately shook her head decisively, saying: "No need, thank you, I can handle it myself."
The driver seemed disappointed, saying: "Oh, then you move it."
The woman started moving the goods, after running back and forth several times, she was extremely tired, and looking up, the driver was playing on his phone, clearly not intending to help at all.
No tip, truly no helping hand here.
The woman’s impression of the driver plummeted instantly.
"Have you finished moving yet? Want help?"
After going up and down the stairs not less than ten times, the driver asked again, and the tone clearly became impatient due to the prolonged waiting.
"No!" the woman resolutely replied, her tone was somewhat aggressive; she had run ten times herself, no reason to spend money at this point.
The driver urged: "Then hurry up, it’s been more than half an hour."
The woman retorted: "Isn’t there a 40-minute waiting time? It hasn’t been 40 minutes yet, I have figured it out, loading goods onto the vehicle, if it exceeds 40 minutes, then there’s an overtime fee. Rest assured, I will finish moving within 40 minutes!"
The driver nearly choked on his own anger, keeping a cold face, not wanting to speak further with this woman.
Seeing the situation, the woman felt uneasy inside, thinking the driver seemed a bit upset; might he retaliate against her?
She started to regret it; had she known earlier, she wouldn’t have booked this car, but most of the items were loaded, it wouldn’t be right to back out now.
Finally, the woman managed to get everything loaded before the 40 minutes were up.
As she sat in the car, the driver immediately started the vehicle, giving her a fright.
The atmosphere in the cabin felt a bit oppressive; the driver had a cold face, driving silently, seeming to have suppressed anger with nowhere to vent.
The woman grew worried again; will this driver retaliate against her? The more she thought, the more afraid she became.
"I need to keep an eye on him!" the woman resolved mentally, holding her phone, watching the navigation.
Wait!
Increasingly it didn’t seem right, the driver had deviated from the course!
What is he planning?
Surely he wouldn’t take me to a deserted place to do something awful?
The woman grew increasingly fearful.
But she dared not ask, fearing a question would puncture the paper screen, exposing the driver’s sinister side, terrified of such a scene.
Luckily, after the driver first deviated, it wasn’t long before he returned to the course.
However, before the woman could feel at ease, the driver deviated again.

chapters.title: Chapter 643: Saving Lives Barehanded
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Chapter 643: Saving Lives Barehanded
After the driver deviated from the route for the third time, driving into a desolate road, the female’s emotions also reached a tipping point.
She couldn’t hold back any longer and, with a near-screaming voice, questioned what the driver was doing.
The driver coldly shot back, "What are you doing?"
She exclaimed in agitation, "You’re not following the GPS!"
The driver ignored her, cursing internally, thinking this woman must be crazy. Deviating from the route is perfectly normal, what’s wrong with taking a shortcut, why is she acting so erratic, damn it, running into such a weirdo!
Seeing the driver didn’t answer, the female finally confirmed what she had been worried about all along — the driver had malicious intent!
He’s definitely planning to take her to a deserted place and harm her! It’s because she didn’t want to pay him extra to help her move, and he’s holding a grudge. As for how he would harm her, does that even need to be said!
In her mind, flashes of news articles she’d read before appeared, about women who were assaulted by men, and many of them were killed afterward.
Wasn’t there a case before, where a woman was assaulted after taking a ride-share from a perverted driver!
She must have encountered a perverted driver as well!
No, I absolutely cannot sit here and wait for death. I wouldn’t let this pervert succeed even if it kills me, I need to save myself!
The female then made a decision: she was going to jump out of the car!
She loved watching movies, and there were many scenes where agile protagonists would leap out of speeding trains, roll a few times, and then stand up and run off.
Jumping out wouldn’t be fatal anyway, and she had to jump to escape the perverted driver’s clutches!
While she was having this intense internal drama, the driver couldn’t be bothered with her at all.
To the driver, this strange woman was simply ridiculous, an extreme oddball; he didn’t even want to spare a glance at her, fearing he might burst into a rage.
All he wanted now was to finish this trip quickly, so he took a shortcut and was paying attention to the available jobs on the platform. Just now, he noticed one and calculated that as long as he completed this current trip quickly, he could take it. He didn’t hesitate long and accepted the job.
All he was thinking was how to end this trip quickly and say goodbye to this oddball woman.
Wait!
What the hell is this crazy woman doing!
She unbuckled her seat belt and leaned her head and upper body out the window!
Because he was completely perplexed by this nutcase, he didn’t even want to speak, he just instinctively touched the brakes, trying to slow down the car.
There was no other solution in this situation because the vehicle was speeding, and if he braked abruptly, the woman would inevitably be thrown out of the car.
The situation took the driver by complete surprise; he had no idea what this woman was trying to do. By the time he realized how severe the situation was, it was too late.
The woman had already climbed out of the window!
It happened in an instant.
This woman is out here just to make trouble, isn’t she!
The driver was on the brink of a breakdown; her delays had already ruined his mood over half an hour ago, and now, he only wanted to speed things up, only for this woman to pull stunts in his car as if forcing him to stop, risking life or death!
The moment the woman climbed out of the window, the driver nearly lost his mind.
Wait!
An astonishing scene unfolded.
Just as the woman was climbing out of the window, a Rolls-Royce suddenly drove up parallel to the truck, and with lightning speed, a hand shot out from the driver’s seat, grabbing the falling woman.
The Rolls-Royce followed with a drift to the side onto the grass and then stopped.
The truck driver also quickly slammed on the brakes and brought the truck to a halt.
The driver hurriedly opened the truck door, jumped out, and ran over to check.
On the Rolls-Royce, a hand stretched out from the driver’s seat, holding the woman’s collar like picking up a rabbit.
The woman’s head drooped; she had fainted.
The driver was instantly dumbfounded.
My god, was this scene real!
The person driving the Rolls-Royce actually caught the woman falling from the truck in a critical moment!
Even Jackie Chan’s movies wouldn’t dare to pull this off!
Yet, this really happened, and the driver saw it with his own eyes, whether he wanted to believe it or not!
"Hey there, give me a hand."
Lin Fan’s voice came from inside the Rolls-Royce.
The driver snapped back to reality, hurried over, and held the woman, then gently laid the unconscious woman on the ground.
He looked up to see the Rolls-Royce’s door open, and a simply dressed young man got out of the car, followed by an incredibly beautiful woman emerging from the passenger seat.
The two quickly walked over to check on the woman’s condition.
The scene just now had been incredibly thrilling!
Lin Fan had noticed something unusual, that a woman in the truck ahead kept sticking her head out the window as if trying to jump, so Lin Fan told Wei Yue’er that the woman was in trouble and needed help!
Watching the woman fall from the window, Lin Fan sped up, rushed over, and caught her before she hit the ground.
But due to the strong impact, the woman still fainted.
Wei Yue’er’s face was somewhat pale; she was genuinely frightened, watching a woman fall out of the window like that was terrifying.
If the woman had hit the ground, it would have been near impossible for her to survive.
Thankfully, Lin Fan managed to catch her.
Wei Yue’er wasn’t too surprised because she knew how skillful Lin Fan was.
Wei Yue’er crouched down, reached out to feel the woman’s breathing, and said, "She’s fine, just fainted."
Then she pressed on a pressure point above the woman’s lips, trying to wake her up.
Lin Fan then turned to the truck driver and asked, "Hey there, what happened here?"
The driver was still in shock because, in such a short amount of time, he’d experienced an unprecedented shock, from the woman inexplicably jumping out of the window to Lin Fan’s spectacular rescue. This completely changed his view of the world; he was utterly stunned.
After Lin Fan gently patted him on the shoulder, he finally came to his senses.
