"Uh... I... I honestly don’t know either."
The driver replied, his voice trembling, and his body still shaking. The aftershock was intense, and the more he thought about it, the scarier it seemed.
"Will she die just like that?" the driver asked shakily.
"She’s fine, she won’t die," Lin Fan reassured, patting the driver’s shoulder again, sending a wave of warmth through his hand into the driver.
Instantly the driver felt a warm current spreading through his body, calming him down.
Amazing guy!
The driver realized that this young man in front of him was truly something special!
"Why don’t you have a cigarette and calm down, we’ll talk when she wakes up," Lin Fan suggested.
"Okay." The driver pulled out a pack of Double Happiness cigarettes from his pocket, shook a couple out, and offered one to Lin Fan.
Lin Fan took it; although he didn’t usually smoke, he decided to accompany the driver for one.
The driver pulled out his lighter, lit Lin Fan’s cigarette, then lit his own, taking a deep drag and exhaling a thick waft of smoke.
The driver finally managed to fully calm down and began recounting his experience to Lin Fan.
In a short while, under Wei Yue’er’s care, the woman slowly woke up.

chapters.title: Chapter 644
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Chapter 644
As soon as the female woke up, she showed a look of panic and tried to struggle to get up.
"No need to be afraid, calm down," Wei Yue’er comforted.
Seeing the truck driver, the female pointed at him and shouted in panic, "He wants to harm me, quickly catch him!"
The truck driver looked speechless.
Wei Yue’er reassured, "Don’t worry, we’re here, even if he really wants to harm you, he can’t, besides, I don’t think this guy has any intention to harm you."
The female said emotionally, "What do you mean he doesn’t? He’s definitely seeking revenge! He deliberately drove to this remote road, he went off course several times, isn’t that proof enough!"
The truck driver couldn’t hold back anymore and said, "Are you freaking paranoid? I was just taking a shortcut, who the hell wants to harm you!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Miss, do you know what just happened?"
The female said, "I was afraid he would harm me, so I thought of jumping out to escape."
Lin Fan said, "Do you know what would happen if you jump out of a moving truck? You’d die instantly."
The female said, "No way, I’ve seen in movies, people jump out of trains, and they’re fine, aren’t they?"
Lin Fan sweated and rolled up his sleeve, revealing a scar on his elbow, "This scar is from two years ago, I accidentally fell while riding an electric bike, and I was going really slow. But when I hit the ground, it scraped my skin and flesh, and it took half a month to heal, and this scar is still here two years later. That was just an electric bike, if you jump off a high-speed moving truck, what do you think would happen?"
The female, still stubborn, said, "I’m fine now, aren’t I!"
Wei Yue’er said, "That’s because he saved you, it seems you have forgotten what happened just now, luckily I recorded it all."
Wei Yue’er took out her phone and played a video, which captured the moment Lin Fan saved the female.
The female watched the video, stunned, Lin Fan actually caught her with his bare hands in such a situation, if it weren’t recorded, she wouldn’t have believed it.
Lin Fan said, "You can’t trust movies, in martial arts films people are flying around, but does anyone actually fly in real life? Jumping out of a window like that, you’d definitely land on your head, causing serious injuries, brain trauma, brain hemorrhage, skull fracture—those would be unavoidable. If you’re lucky, you might end up in a vegetative state, if not, you’d be dead."
Upon hearing this, the female grew more frightened, trembling uncontrollably.
"It’s all his fault, if he hadn’t tried to harm me, I wouldn’t have jumped out of the truck!" The female then screamed, pointing at the truck driver.
Lin Fan said, "I also heard the driver explain what happened just now, and I don’t think he wanted to harm you."
The female said, "What, you believe everything he says? Why don’t you believe me? He wanted to harm me, otherwise why did he go off course!"
The truck driver said, "Didn’t I say, I was taking a shortcut!"
The female scoffed, "Of course you’d say that now, it’s just a lie to cover up your crime!"
The female wouldn’t listen to the truck driver’s explanation, convinced that he intended to harm her.
Lin Fan said, "If the driver wanted to harm you, why would he take another order?"
The female was taken aback, "What?"
Lin Fan said, "I saw the driver’s phone earlier, he took another order while on the way, judging by the timing, he probably wanted to finish your order quickly, which is why he took a shortcut, to save a few extra minutes for the next order. If he wanted to harm you, why would he do that?"
The female: "..."
For a moment, she was speechless; indeed, if the driver wanted to harm her, there was no need to take another order, it would be unnecessary and even disadvantageous to him.
Imagine, if the driver wanted to harm her, like abuse her or even kill her afterwards, then his next move would definitely be to escape and make sure to give himself enough time to get away.
But taking another order would prevent him from reaching the next client on time, exposing him quickly, it would just create trouble for himself.
This indicates that the driver deviated from the route only to take a shortcut, simply thinking about earning a bit more money, completely disconnected from the female’s wild ideas.
Lin Fan said, "I totally understand your feelings, Miss, because of this order, both you and the driver are discontent, you think you’re not at fault..."
The female interrupted Lin Fan, saying, "I’m not at fault, what wrong did I do? I paid to hire him to move my stuff, I moved it all within the stipulated time, I didn’t exceed the time, what did I do wrong? I get it, he’s upset because I wouldn’t pay extra for him to help move the stuff, he’s holding a grudge, if this is indeed a misunderstanding, it’s his fault, the look he gave me was like he wanted to kill me, and he went off course, can you blame me for misunderstanding?"
Lin Fan said, "You are indeed not wrong, from your perspective, you completed the move within the time limit, saving money, very impressive. However, when you were calculating for your benefits, it was to the detriment of the driver’s earnings, and that conflict over profit made the driver frustrated."
The female said, "He’s losing money? I wasn’t late, if he thinks he’s losing out, he should take it up with the platform, not me. It’s not like I set the 40-minute limit, so why blame me!"
Lin Fan said, "Exactly, that’s it, this is on the platform. To attract customers, the platform charges very low for moving fees, how much was your order?"
The female said, "40 bucks."
Lin Fan said, "See, with so much stuff moved so far, only 40 bucks, having moved before myself, if you weren’t using a platform, just hiring a traditional moving truck would have cost hundreds, right? The platform set such low prices to attract people, but introduces a loophole. If the driver needs to help with moving, an extra fee is required. This gives customers an option, but also creates conflicts. Drivers want to earn more and hope customers pay, but the customers can choose to save money, leaving the driver without that income, creating a conflict unknowingly. This can be considered the platform’s wrongdoing, making customers and drivers bear this risk."
The female said, "Exactly, so he should blame the platform."
Lin Fan shook his head, smiling, "You’ve understood everything I’ve said and you know this is a fault of the platform, and you know this rule harms the driver’s interests, but you used the rule to maximize your benefit, legally, you’re right, but it seems a bit inconsiderate as a person. The driver isn’t your enemy, he just wants to make more money. Even if you’re unwilling to pay extra, there’s no need to be cold, nor to see the driver as a villain. With your extreme behavior, you almost harmed yourself, and the driver too."
The female, after hearing this, revealed a cold smile, "I’m extreme? What about him, as a driver, is his poor service attitude justified!"

chapters.title: Chapter 645
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Chapter 645
In Lin Fan’s view, regarding this incident, neither the driver nor the female can be said to be completely at fault, yet both can be considered to have made mistakes, and their mistakes were caused by the platform’s rules.
The platform’s rules led to the conflict between the driver and the female.
The driver only wanted to earn more money and complete an order quickly, but the platform provided a 40-minute moving time, which allowed for a lot of operational space. Naturally, the driver hoped for this time to be as short as possible, because the longer it took, the more frustrated the driver would become, as it was a waste of time.
With some ideal customers, the moving could be finished in a dozen minutes, and sometimes the customer might even pay the driver extra to help with the moving. That could be described as a win-win situation.
But if the customer was someone like this female, meticulous and shrewd, not only not letting the driver earn a penny from the moving fee but also utilizing all 40 minutes to the fullest.
It’s certain that the driver would be displeased.
Lin Fan himself had worked as a delivery driver, so he understood the feelings of the driver very well, feeling empathy, even though the situations of moving and delivering are not exactly the same, they both have times when they are driven mad by the platform’s rules.
The two great nightmares hanging over a delivery rider’s head are overtime and bad reviews.
When a delivery rider takes an order, they have to avoid overtime and bad reviews. To avoid overtime, they have to race through the streets; if the order is urgent, their mentality might break, leading to them becoming irritable and even cursing.
When Lin Fan first started delivering, it was the same for him, which can be considered human nature.
Because being late means getting deductions, and no one wants deductions from their own paycheck. Once money is involved, it becomes a conflict of interest.
Later, Lin Fan adjusted his mindset and slowly learned to be at ease; if he was late, then so be it, these things are always difficult to avoid.
Anyway, Lin Fan was alone, without much of a family burden, he could afford to lose money, so he adjusted his mindset and stopped being irritated by being late.
Similarly, there were bad reviews. At the beginning, for fear of getting bad reviews from customers, he was extremely cautious, serving customers as if they were empress dowagers, afraid of making them unhappy and getting a bad review.
If he was accidentally late or accidentally spilled the food, he would almost want to kneel down and beg the customer, asking them not to give him a bad review.
Later, Lin Fan adjusted his mindset, thinking "to hell with it, if you want to give a bad review, go ahead, I don’t need to pretend to be submissive to you."
Thus, a laid-back, carefree delivery rider was born.
Of course, not everyone can be as carefree as Lin Fan. Lin Fan was still young and didn’t have a family burden. Those delivery riders with heavy family burdens had to haggle over every penny. They couldn’t afford the harm caused by overtime and bad reviews, so naturally, their mentality was prone to irritation and collapse.
Where was the driver’s fault? It was in having a poor service attitude. Even if dissatisfied with the customer, as a service person, he shouldn’t have shown it. That’s an issue with the service attitude.
Because the driver showed his dissatisfaction, this female misunderstood and developed a fear, which indeed constituted an error.
"In today’s society, aren’t there already enough instances of drivers harming people? Can you blame me? Wasn’t there an incident where a ride-hailing driver killed a female passenger? With that look of his, am I to blame for misunderstanding?"
The female said excitedly, her eyes reddening.
Lin Fan said, "You’re right, you have this concern, and you can’t be blamed, but shouldn’t you be a bit calmer and find a better way to address it? There’s no need to jump out of the car, after all, that’s too extreme."
The female said, "I was scared, could I calmly think about the problem? All I wanted was to escape his clutches quickly."
The truck driver looked speechless, "What do you mean by my clutches, are you solely blaming me for your paranoia? Did I ever touch you or threaten you verbally? Just because of my displeased look, you assumed I wanted to harm you? Are you out of your mind?"
The female snorted, "Just because of your look, because of your deviation, isn’t that enough?"
For a moment, the two quarreled.
Suddenly, the sound of a police siren came from the distance; the police had arrived.
Lin Fan said, "You two don’t need to argue anymore. I called the police, and let them investigate the situation. I believe the police will give you a reasonable outcome."
The police arrived and out of the car came a middle-aged policeman and a young policeman.
"What’s going on here? Who called the police?"
The middle-aged policeman asked.
Lin Fan said, "I called the police..."
Lin Fan explained the situation in brief.
The two policemen listened with surprise, even they found it somewhat incredible.
Following that, the police began an on-site investigation, and separately took statements from the driver and the female, eventually concluding that this really was just a misunderstanding.
It could be said that both the driver and the female were at fault, each receiving equal blame.
"Why were you unscathed after jumping off the speeding vehicle?"
The policeman also raised this question; it was very strange, didn’t the female jump from the vehicle? How was she unharmed?
"He saved me." The female said, pointing at Lin Fan.
The policeman curiously asked, "How did you save her?"
Wei Yue’er took out a video of Lin Fan rescuing the female.
After watching the video, the policemen were left dumbfounded.
Did this really happen!
Oh my, there’s someone this incredible!
The policeman educated the female, as Lin Fan had previously analyzed, if she had really fallen from the car, she would’ve been dead for sure, and if it weren’t for Lin Fan saving her, she’d mostly be dead by now, or even if not dead, she’d definitely be in the hospital being rescued.
In other words, Lin Fan was her savior.
Everything was just as Lin Fan had said.
The female previously didn’t believe Lin Fan’s words and even retorted him.
After the police’s education, she realized that Lin Fan was right, and her way of handling things was indeed too extreme. If it weren’t for Lin Fan, her extreme way of handling things might have cost her her life.
Thankfully Lin Fan was there, otherwise, her life would have been lost.
"I’m sorry, I won’t do this again. Thank you for saving me."
The female thanked Lin Fan.
This time, she finally thanked Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to thank me, it was just a small effort on my part. Don’t be so extreme in the future, or you’ll end up harming yourself sooner or later."
The girl’s extremism would not only harm herself but might implicate the driver. Imagine if she really had jumped out and died, the driver would be blamed no matter what. If this got online, it would be even scarier. It might trigger an online outrage.
With that, the incident concluded, and Lin Fan then took his leave.
In West River Village, another big event was waiting for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 646: The Neighbor’s Kid Who Does Well
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Chapter 646: The Neighbor’s Kid Who Does Well
Today, West River Village is bustling with excitement; it’s Chen Hai’s wedding day and the whole village is abuzz.
Chen Hai has invited everyone in the village, such generosity is really impressive, and people in the village are praising Chen Hai for his capabilities. As someone who walked out from a small mountain village like West River, Chen Hai indeed is doing quite well.
"Xiaohai, this kid, he’s really amazing, so promising!"
"Exactly, Dato is so blessed to have such a good son!"
"Xiaohai is really outstanding, he must be the richest person in our village now!"
"The richest man in West River Village is Xiaohai!"
In West River Village, the most grand and tallest building, with interior and exterior decoration, white tiles on the outer walls, this is where Chen Hai’s home is, very conspicuous.
A few villagers gathered around, showering Chen Hai with praise.
And such compliments could be heard everywhere.
Chen Datou, Chen Hai’s father, straightened his back, standing tall as if he had it corrected specially, walking with his head held high, so proud, so confident.
Wherever he went, villagers were there with compliments for him, and praises for his son.
"Congratulations, Dato, on getting a daughter-in-law today," an elderly man said cheerfully.
Chen Datou laughed, "Thank you Uncle De, have a few more drinks."
"Brother Dato, you’re very lucky, Xiaohai is so promising and I hear his wife is beautiful too. Truly envious," an uncle said with a smile.
Chen Datou laughed heartily, "Where, where, isn’t your Ah-Yong working as a sales manager in a big company? That’s impressive too!" Chen Datou said.
The uncle said, "That’s nothing, it can’t compare to Xiaohai!"
"Uncle Dato, is Brother Hai’s company hiring? I just graduated from technical school, and even doing odd jobs there would be great," a young man approached, trying to cozy up while enthusiastically offering Chen Datou a cigarette.
Chen Datou took the cigarette, let the young man light it, took a puff, and said, "Well, you need to ask Brother Hai about that. I’ll see when I can find the chance to ask for you."
The young man kept flattering, "Alright, thank you Uncle Dato."
Chen Datou was very pleased, his son was truly promising, allowing him to walk with pride in the village, surrounded by envious voices wherever he went, he couldn’t help but feel a little elated.
Today, at his son’s grand wedding, as they invited everyone in the village, people old and young, men and women from the village all came to help, the entire village was bustling with excitement.
Chen Datou looked at the scene, very satisfied, it was all because his son was successful. Otherwise, how could the villagers give him such face?
Right at this time, Lin Fan’s father Lin Dagui was walking by carrying a pot of meat, today Father Lin and Mrs. Lin had also come to help early in the morning, as their two families had always had a good relationship, Chen Hai and Lin Fan used to be playmates in the past.
"Dagui, how come I haven’t seen Little Fan at all today? He’s not coming, is he?" Chen Datou asked, deliberately raising his voice.
Instantly drawing the attention of many, they all looked over.
Lin Dagui smiled apologetically, "Little Fan had something to do and went to the city, I’ve already told him to hurry back."
Chen Datou frowned and said, "Went to the city, what could be more important today than Xiaohai’s wedding?"
Lin Dagui said, "I’m not really sure, maybe he went to see a patient."
Chen Datou was somewhat displeased. Originally, Chen Hai was surpassing Lin Fan in everything, giving him a sense of superiority in front of Lin Dagui, but it just so happened that Lin Fan actually knew some medical skills, which somehow scored him back some points.
"Ha, looks like Little Fan is really a busy man, even going out to see patients on a day like today," Chen Datou said sarcastically.
Lin Dagui said, "I’ve told him to come back, and he said he’d be back soon."
Chen Datou said, "Alright then, I initially suggested for him to be Xiaohai’s groomsman, glad I didn’t let him."
Villagers began to chatter.
"Lin Fan isn’t here today? Could he be ashamed?"
Everyone laughed out loud.
"Maybe, Xiaohai is so successful, while on the other hand, Lin Fan isn’t doing as well."
"Working as a food delivery guy in the city, how can he compare to Xiaohai!"
"Perhaps he knows his place and went away to avoid embarrassment?"
Lin Dagui heard all these mocking words, but being honest and simple, not good at arguing, he could only act as if he didn’t hear and continued working.
Villagers quickly forgot about Lin Fan, the lively moment arrived, Chen Hai brought the bride back, and villagers all ran over to watch.
A procession of joyous bridal cars drove into the village.
The leading car was a brand-new Audi A8, not rented, but Chen Hai’s newly bought wedding car, just purchased, very impressive.
Following behind were all luxury cars like BMWs.
"Wow, Xiaohai is really wealthy!"
"I heard this Audi is worth hundreds of thousands!"
"Wow, truly amazing, Xiaohai is incredible!"
The villagers all had expressions of admiration, nothing was as important as money, the wealthiest is the most impressive, the richer, the more impressive, this was the villagers’ simple value.
After all, isn’t everyone toiling for daily meals, working hard for money? The desire for money forms such a view, he who has money is the master.
Why do the villagers look down on Lin Fan? Even though he has great medical skills, he still cannot compare to Chen Hai in the eyes of the villagers, simply because Chen Hai is richer than Lin Fan.
"Xiaohai, this kid, really good at associating with a Big Boss, doing so well!"
"The tallest house in the village, the most expensive car in the village, together that’s worth millions, truly amazing!"
"Xiaohai also married a city girl, they say her parents do business in the city too, bound to be very wealthy in the future."
"Truly amazing, so envious I could die."
Amidst the villagers’ exclamations and discussions.
The procession had arrived, the front Audi stopped, a young man in a suit got out, this was today’s groom, Chen Hai.
Chen Hai couldn’t be called handsome; he wasn’t tall, even a bit short and stout, but he gave an impression of being sharp, with intelligent gleams in his eyes, such people indeed know how to manage well.
Social dynamics are like this: people who know how to manage well thrive, those who don’t often get overlooked, work skills are secondary, as knowing how to manage well means you can do well even if your work skills are not that great.
Similarly, two employees join a company at the same time, in the same position, one knows how to manage well, the other is introverted and honest, over time, the differences become apparent, the introverted and honest one just focuses on doing his own work, not knowing how to manage relationships, often goes unnoticed, the one who manages well quickly blends with colleagues and wins the boss’ favor.
When an opportunity for promotion arises, choosing between the introverted, honest one and the one who manages well, it’s not certain, but most of the time, the one who manages well gets the chance.
Gradually, the introverted, honest one stays put, or even fares worse, while the one who knows how to manage well has already risen steadily.
"Xiaohai, this kid, was sweet-talking since childhood, I said early on that he would be promising," an old man smoked his dry tobacco, laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 647: Lin Fan Is Not Qualified to Be the Best Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Chapter 647: Lin Fan Is Not Qualified to Be the Best Man
Chen Hai got out of the Audi A8 and glanced around the scene, noticing the admiring looks the people around him were giving him, which made Chen Hai very pleased with their reaction.
In Chen Hai’s view, if you’re doing well, you should let everyone see it, you should tell others he’s impressive, you should make people look up to and admire him.
Chen Hai is someone who likes to stand out, and because he had money in his pocket, he returned to the village to build the tallest and grandest house there, which greatly enhanced the prestige of the Chen Family, making his father Chen Datou proud and walking with his back straightened.
Because he liked being high-profile, he spared no expense in inviting the whole village for a banquet. In his view, this was also something very prestigious, a way to show off his wealth.
Having money equals having prestige!
Next, he wanted everyone in the village to know he married a good wife, which is also an incredibly prestigious thing!
After getting out of the car, Chen Hai immediately went to the back door and helped the bride, who was wearing her wedding dress, out of the car.
The bride was in her twenties, her face decorated with thick and delicate makeup, tall and slender and even a head taller than Chen Hai. As for her looks, while not exceptionally beautiful, she’s a 6-point beauty.
Of course, in this small mountain village, being able to marry a wife like her is already very impressive. Though only a 6-pointer, in the eyes of the villagers, she’s a perfect 10.
Some think having a wife who is a head taller seems to lack masculinity, but to the villagers, marrying a wife taller than oneself is a proud accomplishment, indicating ability.
Just imagine, if you weren’t capable, would a tall beauty choose you?
Marrying a tall wife, even taller than oneself, is certainly a thing worthy of boasting.
Chen Datou’s expression said it all, so proud, so full of pride, with his head held high, chest puffed out, back straightened, he was extremely proud of his son.
After welcoming the bride through the door, Chen Hai brought her out to greet the guests, who had already started arriving one after another.
Then, the village chief of West River Village arrived.
"Village chief, your presence is an honor, please come in and have a seat," warmly invited Chen Datou.
"Village chief, welcome, welcome," Chen Hai eagerly offered a cigarette, and his gesture made it clear that Chen Hai was very adept at social interactions, a skill he had mastered well.
The village chief took the cigarette, smiling: "Xiaohai, really impressive, you’re the best among the young generation in this village!"
Chen Hai replied with a smile: "You’re too kind, chief. My small achievements are barely worth mentioning."
Though his words were modest, Chen Hai’s tone was very proud. He was quite satisfied with his current state.
"Your wife is truly beautiful, what kind of family does she come from?" asked the village chief.
Chen Hai replied: "Her parents are in business in the city, dealing in tiles, the company assets are roughly around ten million."
The village chief let out a sound of awe and said, "That’s impressive!"
The crowd expressed their astonishment.
"Ten million, that’s incredible!"
"My goodness, the bride’s family is so wealthy!"
"Can’t even imagine, I’d be overjoyed with one million, ten million is astonishing!"
Chen Hai was very pleased with everyone’s reaction.
Being able to marry this wife made Chen Hai very proud himself, and it was a good opportunity to show off to everyone.
The village chief asked, "Xiaohai, where did you find such a wonderful wife?"
Chen Hai replied with a grin: "Her company has business dealings with the company I work for. I went along with the boss for negotiations and met her, then pursued her successfully."
The crowd burst out in laughter.
"Xiaohai, this kid, really promising!"
"Without some capability, you can’t win over the daughter of a multimillionaire!"
"I always said, I had high hopes for Xiaohai since childhood, bright kid!"
The crowd showered Chen Hai with praise again.
At this moment, a black Bentley arrives.
Chen Hai saw it and immediately said, "Chief, please take your seat, my boss has arrived, I’ll go over to welcome him."
What, Chen Hai’s boss has come!
The crowd looked over, curious.
They saw Chen Hai, along with his wife and his father Chen Datou, walking over eagerly to welcome the boss.
A well-rounded middle-aged man stepped out of the car, this was Chen Hai’s boss.
If it wasn’t for the boss’s help, Chen Hai wouldn’t be where he is today, so they all treated the boss like a deity.
"Xiaohai’s really impressive, getting married and the boss comes to offer congratulations, that’s prestige!"
"Isn’t it just, who in the village is as capable as Xiaohai, probably can’t even invite the boss, can’t imagine them attending a wedding!"
"This shows Xiaohai knows how to handle things, has a good relationship with the boss!"
The crowd chimed in with praise.
Indeed, whether it be building the tallest building in the village, buying the most expensive car, marrying a wife whose family is worth ten million, or having the boss attend his wedding, all of these showcased Chen Hai’s prowess, brimming with prestige.
"Hello everyone, I’m Chen Hai’s boss. Chen Hai, this kid, is really promising, helped me a lot in the Company. I admire him, and specially came here to attend his wedding to wish him a happy marriage!" The boss laughed.
Applause thundered.
Chen Hai was filled with pride, personally leading the boss to his seat, pouring tea, serving water, bustling around attending.
At this wedding, besides the bride and groom, there was also a group of very noticeable people — the groomsmen and bridesmaids. The groomsmen, each in suits, clearly were noteworthy people.
"Xiaohai, your groomsmen are excellent, who are they, introduce them to us!"
A villager jeered provocatively.
Chen Hai smiled: "Indeed, my groomsmen are capable folks, they are my friends and colleagues. Most of them are city dwellers, from good backgrounds!"
Even the groomsmen are a point of pride.
"Xiaohai, didn’t you used to play really well with Lin Fan as a child, why didn’t you invite Lin Fan to be a groomsman?" The village chief laughed.
Finally, someone brought up Lin Fan.
It was the village chief.
The village chief and Lin Fan’s family had some disputes about it. Lin Fan offended the village chief’s son, and the village chief planned to build a public toilet at Lin Fan’s door to retaliate, but the arrival of the county chief thwarted him.
The village chief still harbors resentment over it.
Today, seeing Chen Hai doing so well, the village chief thought of Lin Fan, taking the chance to put him down.
The villagers laughed after hearing the village chief’s words.
"Of course, he wouldn’t invite Lin Fan to be a groomsman!"
"Lin Fan isn’t qualified to be Xiaohai’s groomsman, he delivers takeout, isn’t it embarrassing!"
"Exactly, if Lin Fan were in the groomsmen group, wouldn’t it be awkward? All Xiaohai’s friends and colleagues are capable!"
"Absolutely, lucky Lin Fan isn’t here!"
"It’s true they played well together as kids, I know, but Lin Fan truly should not be a groomsman!"
Everyone took turns mocking Lin Fan.
Chen Hai, upon hearing this, seemed to just remember Lin Fan and said: "Oh right, where is Lin Fan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 648 Lin Fan Brings Up Negative Teaching Material Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Chapter 648 Lin Fan Brings Up Negative Teaching Material Again
Chen Hai noticed that Lin Fan seemed to be absent from the scene.
He did see Father Lin and Mrs. Lin.
"Uncle Da Gui, why haven’t I seen Lin Fan? Didn’t I hear that he came back? Has he already left? No way, would he really leave without attending my wedding?" Chen Hai asked Father Lin.
Lin Dagui forced a smile and said, "No, he had some business in the city today, he should be back soon."
Chen Hai let out an "oh" and said, "Could he be deliberately avoiding me? Is he mad at me for not asking him to be a groomsman?"
Lin Dagui quickly said, "That’s not the case. Little Fan isn’t that petty; he doesn’t even know about this matter."
Lin Fan was so busy these days that he completely overlooked the fact that Chen Hai hadn’t asked him to be a groomsman, or rather, Lin Fan hadn’t even paid attention to Chen Hai’s wedding.
Chen Hai frowned and said, "He doesn’t know about it? What do you mean, he still doesn’t know I’m getting married today?"
Chen Datou said, "That’s impossible, he knew you were getting married. When I came to deliver the invitation, wasn’t Lin Fan there?"
Chen Hai chuckled and said, "So, Lin Fan doesn’t want to be my groomsman. Come on, we grew up playing together. Does he think I don’t deserve him as a groomsman?"
The village head chuckled, "Is Lin Fan that impressive? Is he worthy? Does he think just because he knows some medical skills, he can look down on people?"
"Exactly, what’s the use of medical skills? It’s money that truly matters!"
"With Lin Fan being a delivery guy, he’s not even qualified to promote Xiaohai!"
The villagers started gossiping.
Lin Dagui quickly said, "No, no, it’s not like that. Little Fan is just too busy; he just didn’t notice."
Chen Hai said unhappily, "Didn’t notice? Doesn’t that further prove the issue? Lin Fan simply didn’t care about my wedding!"
Lin Dagui was momentarily speechless, "Well..."
The village head chuckled, "This Lin Fan, no money but quite the airs."
Everyone shook their heads and sighed, looking down on Lin Fan.
A group of people bullying the father and mocking the brother, Lin Shanshan couldn’t stand it anymore and said coldly, "Brother Hai, you say my brother didn’t care about being a groomsman, but you didn’t invite him to be one either!"
Chen Datou said, "You girl, where do you get off talking here? Didn’t I just tell your dad, I suggested having Lin Fan as a groomsman, but..."
Chen Hai cleared his throat and said, "I did consider Lin Fan, but my companions and friends were too enthusiastic, and with limited slots, we were full."
Chen Datou said, "That’s right, it’s Lin Fan’s own fault. If he had been a bit more proactive, a bit quicker, he could have made it as a groomsman. Why wasn’t he more forward?"
Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but laugh, "Really? You all talk as if this groomsman role is some big prize, and my brother should compete for it—how ridiculous!"
Chen Datou and his son didn’t like hearing this.
Chen Datou’s face darkened, "You girl, how can you talk so rudely!"
The village head said sarcastically, "Really, what’s that saying—birds of a feather flock together, huh? This Lin Family brother and sister have no manners. Lin Dagui, how do you educate your children, no upbringing!"
Lin Dagui’s face turned red; he really wasn’t good at arguing with people.
The village head continued, "Moreover, look at Xiaohai’s groomsmen; aren’t they all talented and successful? Only they can match up as groomsmen and accentuate Xiaohai’s excellence. Lin Fan, a delivery guy, really doesn’t fit!"
"Haha..."
The group couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
Chen Hai said, "Forget it; today’s my big day. I don’t want some people to affect my mood. Let’s not mention Lin Fan; he can come if he wants, or not, it’s whatever!"
The bride beside him then said, "Ah-Hai, is this Lin Fan the childhood best friend you mentioned?"
Chen Hai replied, "Indeed."
The bride frowned and said, "It seems he doesn’t treat you as a brother, huh? I understand his mentality; he was better than you before, but now he’s not doing as well, maybe it’s just inferiority."
"Hahaha..." The village head laughed out loud, "The bride, being from the city, truly has insight. I think Lin Fan is just inferior, knowing he’s not doing as well as Xiaohai, ashamed to come!"
Upon hearing this, Chen Hai’s face showed a hint of pride and said, "Back then, I couldn’t match up to Lin Fan in anything. He was taller and more handsome, his grades were better, he got into Tianhai Middle School, and later even got into college, while all I could do was go to a vocational school. I was just like a tag-along, admiring him."
His tone held a sense of long-awaited revenge, seeming like he used to be jealous of Lin Fan because Lin Fan was better than him. Now seeing Lin Fan not doing as well, he naturally felt pleased.
The village head laughed and said, "There’s a saying—child prodigy, but grows up not so good. That’s Lin Fan for you—smart as a kid, good grades, but unfortunately not clever, turned into bookishness, read books to death, couldn’t make it in society, only could become a delivery guy!"
"Xiaohai is different; although his grades weren’t as good as Lin Fan’s, he’s sharp-minded, savvy, knows how to get along in society, and now Xiaohai is so successful, marrying such a wonderful wife today!"
"I’ve decided to select the top ten outstanding young people of our village, and Xiaohai is definitely the first. To encourage the younger generation to learn from Xiaohai, as for Lin Fan, he won’t be among them but could indeed be a counterexample!"
The crowd burst into laughter at these words.
Chen Hai’s lips curled in a smug smile, seeing everyone praising him and mocking Lin Fan—this was just right.
"Uncle Da Gui, Lin Fan is a college graduate after all, isn’t being a delivery guy beneath his abilities? I’ll tell you what, after this, have Lin Fan come see me, I’ll see if I can use my connections to find him a decent job," Chen Hai said with a smile.
Lin Dagui hesitated, "Well..."
The village head laughed, "Xiaohai is really broad-minded, even though Lin Fan gives him no face, Xiaohai bears no grudge and even helps him get a job. Truly, what a good person!"
"Xiaohai is such a great kid!"
"Truly great!"
The villagers also started praising.
Chen Datou was really on cloud nine; his son had really brought face today. Although it was at the expense of Lin Fan, it felt great—stepping on Lin Fan to gain face felt truly great!
Chen Datou looked at Lin Dagui and chuckled, "Da Gui, I still need to say a word about you; you can’t just be plain honest. Look at your Lin Fan and my Xiaohai as examples; isn’t Lin Fan not doing as well because he doesn’t know how to handle things? Let me give you some advice. Xiaohai’s boss is here today, you go pour tea and offer a cigarette, and maybe Lin Fan’s job situation will be solved!"
Lin Dagui turned even more red; he truly wasn’t adept at handling things, and Chen Datou’s words were equivalent to publicly humiliating him.
Everyone was watching Lin Dagui to see if he would go over to give Xiaohai’s boss a cigarette to curry favor.
Lin Shanshan couldn’t take it anymore and chuckled, "Dad, no need, I think this boss should be offering a cigarette to my brother instead."
What?
Everyone was astounded. Lin Shanshan’s words were truly shocking!

chapters.title: Chapter 649: Your Son Is Just Like a Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Chapter 649: Your Son Is Just Like a Dog
What?
Lin Shanshan actually said she wanted Chen Hai’s boss to offer cigarettes to Lin Fan?
That’s such a shocking statement.
How could Lin Shanshan say something like that?
"This girl must be crazy!"
"She must be out of her mind!"
"Really lost it!"
Everyone felt Lin Shanshan was simply crazy and started to criticize.
"Hahaha..." The village chief couldn’t help but burst into laughter, holding his stomach, "Did I hear wrong, what did she say? She wants the Big Boss to offer cigarettes to Lin Fan. Let me be straight here, where did you get the courage? Does your brother deserve it?"
Chen Datou said, "Shanshan, I understand you’re trying to defend your brother, but you can’t say such brainless things. See, now it’s just a big joke!"
Lin Dagui immediately said, "Shanshan, don’t talk nonsense. Stop talking!"
Their family had already lost enough face today, humiliated in front of everyone. Everyone was comparing Lin Fan with Chen Hai, constantly praising Chen Hai while stepping on Lin Fan, which made him feel very uncomfortable.
But he had no confidence to argue with others because Little Fan indeed wasn’t doing as well as others. What could he say?
Mrs. Lin was red-faced and embarrassed, really just wanting to leave quickly. Staying here was pointless; she was totally out of sorts.
"What nonsense are you all talking about? In my eyes, Brother Fan is the best!"
Suddenly, a voice shouted, and Dog No.2 stood up.
Even Dog No.2 couldn’t take it anymore as everyone was crazily laughing at Lin Fan.
He Chunyu did not stop Dog No.2 and stood up as well, saying, "I think so too!"
"What?" The village chief laughed, "What good can an idiot say? An idiot’s words are just silly words!"
"Hahaha..." The crowd burst into laughter again.
Chen Datou said, "Dog No.2, you said your Brother Fan is the best. In what way is he the best?"
Dog No.2 stammered, "He, he..."
The village chief interrupted Dog No.2, "He, he, he! You idiot, you only know how to say silly things!"
He Chunyu angrily said, "Village chief, that’s enough. Don’t you think you’re being too much?"
The village chief’s face turned cold, "You know your son is an idiot, so don’t let him talk. And you join in the ruckus, shut up!"
Chen Datou tried to smooth things over, "Today is my son Xiaohai’s wedding, a joyful occasion. There’s no need for the village chief to be angry over an idiot. Let’s look at Da Gui, how about it, Da Gui, want your son to have a good job?"
Everyone looked at Lin Dagui again.
At this time, that wealthy mid-aged man, Chen Hai’s boss, also smilingly looked at Lin Dagui, seeing if Lin Dagui would come over to pour tea and offer cigarettes to please him.
This boss was also feeling very superior. Today was Chen Hai’s wedding, but the largest guest here was him. He was the groom’s boss. The groom needed to run after and fawn on him; who could be more prestigious than that?
"You’ve been talking about this Lin Fan for a while, and I think I’ve got an impression now."
The boss spoke, "This kid Lin Fan, he should be the more dull and introverted type, right? Looking at his dad, like father, like son. Youngsters should be a little more clever and more sociable. They should be more engaging with people. Xiaohai is doing this quite well."
The village chief said with a smile, "The Big Boss is imparting workplace wisdom, giving a lesson to the young people here. How rare and valuable, right? All the kids here should listen well, applause everyone!"
The village chief led the applause.
The whole crowd applauded enthusiastically.
The boss said with a smile, "Thank you for the enthusiasm, since everyone wants to hear, I’ll say a bit more. Young people entering society, working ability is undoubtedly important. But more importantly, is being able to handle things, which is essentially about good interpersonal relationships. Offering a cigarette upon meeting someone, a few pleasantries, this is the most basic. From your words just now, I can tell Lin Fan is not good at handling things, probably thinking he’s a proud college student. Not offering a cigarette, that’s just being a bookworm! How his work ability is, I don’t know. But not being good at handling things will cause him to not do well even after graduating from college. If I’m not mistaken, he is probably that kind of employee who just buries himself in his tasks at work, leaves right at closing time, faster than anyone, and is unwilling to take on any extra, not willing to work overtime, which won’t work. Bosses dislike this type of employee the most. Youngsters shouldn’t be afraid of suffering losses. Suffering losses is a blessing; it’s also building capital for oneself."
Most of the young people present nodded in agreement.
Especially those groomsmen and bridesmaids, who were all working professionals. They found the boss’s words very enlightening and agreed deeply.
Lin Shanshan chuckled, "You’re the Big Boss, of course, you’d say that. You wish employees would work overtime for free. Isn’t this the legendary 996?"
The boss glanced at Lin Shanshan, "I see you’re young, probably still studying. You’re really too naive. What’s wrong with 996? 996 is a blessing for young people. It’s not easy for young people to find a job. Overtime is investing and increasing value in oneself. Everybody works overtime. If you don’t, you’ll fall behind. No wonder your brother isn’t doing well. Xiaohai is different. Xiaohai is diligent and dedicated at work, and that’s what I admire most; that’s what I call handling things well."
"The boss is right, the boss is always right!" Chen Hai said loudly, leading the applause.
"What he means is, working for him, you have to be as obedient as our dog Wangcai. Stick your tongue out to please him, and you’ll get some meat." Dog No.2 suddenly said.
Everyone was stunned, even though Dog No.2 was an idiot, but it seemed to make sense.
Chen Datou laughed, "See, even an idiot understands this logic; surely you can’t still not get it, girl?"
Lin Shanshan laughed mischievously, "What Dog No.2 said, isn’t it actually saying your son is like a dog!"
The whole room fell silent, and the atmosphere became a bit awkward.
Chen Datou’s face darkened in anger, "You girl, watch your mouth. No manners!"
Seeing Lin Shanshan was about to become the target of everyone’s criticism.
Lin Dagui quickly approached the boss, pulled out a Double Happiness cigarette pack. This type of Double Happiness is the cheapest, only 8 yuan a pack. Lin Dagui usually saves money and can’t bear to smoke expensive cigarettes.
Lin Dagui shook out a Double Happiness cigarette, offering it to the boss with a wry smile, "The young girl doesn’t understand rules, please don’t hold it against us. Boss, have a cigarette."
The boss didn’t take it, snorted, and said, "I heard your son is a delivery man?"
Lin Dagui, seeing that the other party didn’t accept the cigarette, felt a bit embarrassed. He couldn’t take it back, so he reluctantly said, "Um, yes, Little Fan is indeed delivering food."
The boss coldly said, "Delivering food doesn’t require any skills, just legs. I think your son wasted his university education. Finding a good job will be tough!"
This clearly meant he had no intention of giving Lin Dagui face or helping find a job for Lin Fan.
"Uncle Da Gui, you should save this cheap cigarette. Here boss, have a cigarette."
Chen Hai leaned over, smiling, and offered a Zhonghua cigarette.
"Ah! Someone else is coming, and it’s an important guest!"
Suddenly someone said, and it turned out there was a convoy of luxury cars approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 650: Where is Mr. Lin
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Chapter 650: Where is Mr. Lin
A convoy, grand and imposing, headed towards West River Village. Leading the pack was actually a government car from the city, followed by luxury cars—Audis, BMWs, Mercedes... All cars worth millions.
This convoy was even more impressive, more eye-catching than the wedding convoy. It was by far the most luxurious scene ever witnessed in West River Village!
Apart from the wealth, more importantly, it wasn’t easy to arrange for that government car, which symbolized power.
"What’s going on here?"
Everyone in West River Village looked at each other in confusion.
"They must be here to attend Xiaohai’s wedding!" someone said.
"Absolutely, oh my god, Xiaohai really has huge connections, inviting so many influential people!"
"This is too impressive, I bow down!"
Everyone started discussing, all believing that these people were invited by Chen Hai.
Chen Hai was completely dumbfounded; clearly, he didn’t invite them. Although he did earn some money and was considered an outstanding youth in the village, he was still far from being able to invite so many luxury cars, let alone officials.
It’s definitely the Big Boss!
Chen Hai immediately thought of a possibility—indeed, the only possibility—it had to be the Big Boss. The Big Boss’s network was truly formidable.
Chen Hai looked at the Big Boss with admiration.
"Thank you, Big Boss, you’re really giving face!" Chen Hai said happily.
Chen Datou was very pleased, "Thank you so much, Big Boss! The Big Boss really has a big face!"
"Deserving to be the Big Boss! Xiaohai is following such a boss, it’s no wonder he’s flourishing; the future looks limitless!"
"If only my kid had such a great boss!"
Everyone praised endlessly, in their view, only the Big Boss could possibly invite such influential figures.
At this time, the Big Boss was also confused, he was very sure that he did not invite these people!
But hearing the continuous praise from the crowd, the Big Boss felt a bit floaty and didn’t deny it, because upon reflection, there didn’t seem to be anyone present with a bigger face than him, so the only one who could invite such high-profile guests had to be him.
"Maybe it’s an old friend from Tianhai who brought them over. I did mention to him that I would attend Xiaohai’s wedding banquet. Didn’t expect this old friend to give such face!"
The Big Boss said, having thought of a possibility—indeed, the only possibility.
Upon hearing this, everyone unanimously believed that these influential figures were here for the Big Boss’s sake.
Chen Hai flattered, "But it’s because of your big face, Boss, otherwise how could this old friend be so supportive? Thank you, Boss!"
The Big Boss thought Chen Hai made sense, nodded, and also felt a bit floaty himself—really too much face!
Soon, the convoy arrived.
From the cars, people began to step down—these were all reputable and wealthy individuals whom the city government had invited for investment talks. Now, they were all gathered in this little mountain village!
That was surprising enough, but the people who stepped down from the government car completely shocked everyone present.
Secretary Ma, the municipal party secretary!
Mayor Long, the city mayor!
Oh my god!
The two highest officials from Tianhai City had actually come to West River Village to attend Chen Hai’s wedding!
This wasn’t just ordinary impressive—this was super impressive!
Everyone was ready to bow to Chen Hai; this young man was too accomplished, too honorable!
"Xiaohai is truly the pride of West River Village, so outstanding!" the village chief exclaimed and quickly approached Secretary Ma and Mayor Long.
"Secretary, Mayor, I am Chen Dacai, the village chief of West River Village. I didn’t expect your esteemed visit, forgive the lack of proper welcome!" the village chief said with an awkward smile.
Secretary Ma smiled, "No worries, we arrived a bit abruptly without prior notice. Hope it doesn’t bother anyone and hope everyone doesn’t mind."
The village chief promptly said, "Oh, no, no. Your esteemed presence is such an honor for West River Village! Everyone, hurry and give a round of applause to welcome the Secretary and the Mayor!"
Thunderous applause and cheers filled the air.
Mayor Long smiled, "We’re here to attend the wedding. May I ask which of you is the groom?"
Chen Hai excitedly said, "That’s me."
Since Mayor Long asked who the groom was, it indicated they didn’t know Chen Hai nor whose wedding it was, confirming that Chen Hai didn’t invite them.
Indeed, it was for the Big Boss’s sake that they came; the Big Boss’s connections were truly impressive.
Chen Hai swore he’d follow such a good boss for life!
At this time, the Big Boss was looking among the arrivals for the figure of his old friend, someone quite influential in Tianhai City. Yet the Big Boss was surprised that this friend could invite both the Secretary and the Mayor; it seemed this old friend was even more formidable than he remembered!
However, he didn’t find his old friend among the arrivals.
"Perhaps he was too busy to come himself. That’s even more impressive—not being present, yet able to invite the Secretary and the Mayor. That’s huge face right there."
The Big Boss felt deeply that his old friend was indeed incredibly formidable.
Secretary Ma laughed at this time, "So you’re the groom, congratulations, congratulations! Wish you a happy marriage. Today, the Mayor and I, along with these folks—all wealthy individuals from various places—have come especially to celebrate."
"Congratulations!"
"Congratulations!"
"Congratulations!"
The wealthy individuals offered their well-wishes.
"Thank you!"
"Thank you!"
"Thanks a lot!"
Chen Hai and the bride bowed to thank each one, undeniably Chen Hai was indeed pretty good at handling things, very courteous.
Watching this scene, all the villagers knelt.
"Xiaohai really got the best end of the deal with this marriage!"
"Looking across Tianhai City, who else could earn the blessing of so many high-profile figures at their wedding?"
"One can only say Xiaohai is accomplished, switch places with others—they wouldn’t be so impressive!"
"If it were Lin Fan getting married, a delivery guy, could there be such a grand occasion? Zero chance!"
The villagers discussed fervently, some not forgetting to take a jab at Lin Fan.
Chen Datou was practically floating with pride; today’s event is something he could boast about for life. From now on, whenever he met anyone, he’d flaunt that at his son’s wedding, both the city party secretary and the mayor attended, along with a bunch of wealthy folks—who could have a son that impressive? No one, right!
"Secretary Ma, Mayor Long, and all the esteemed guests, I am Xiaohai’s father, many thanks for attending Xiaohai’s wedding. Please take your seats!" Chen Datou approached with a joyful smile.
Secretary Ma smiled, "Thanks, we’ll sit later. By the way, why do we not seem to see Mr. Lin?"
Mayor Long also looked around, puzzled, "Yes, where is Mr. Lin?"
Mr. Lin?
Everyone looked at each other in confusion—who is Mr. Lin?
Who are they looking for?

chapters.title: Chapter 651: Brother Has Finally Returned
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Chapter 651: Brother Has Finally Returned
Chen Datou invited the big shots to take their seats, but Secretary Ma and Mayor Long, the two big shots, actually asked about Mr. Lin.
Where is Mr. Lin?
Who?
Which Mr. Lin?
The villagers were all clueless about the situation.
"Hehe, I am Lin Bin. I’ve long admired Secretary Ma and Mayor Long. I was planning to pay a visit, but I didn’t expect to see you here. Thank you so much for coming; it’s truly an honor."
A voice said.
It was Chen Hai’s boss, smiling awkwardly as he approached the big shots.
Ah, so the Lin Mr. that Secretary Ma and Mayor Long were looking for is actually Chen Hai’s boss!
Everyone realized.
They didn’t even know the boss’s last name was Lin. This makes sense; after all, these high-ranking officials must have come because of the boss’s influence. It’s not surprising they were looking for Mr. Lin.
"Honey, I made the right choice; you’re amazing!" said the bride, proudly, to Chen Hai.
Due to Chen Hai’s connections, so many impressive people attended the wedding. As the bride, she was also feeling very proud.
The father-in-law and mother-in-law, each worth tens of millions, were smiling with satisfaction. Although the son-in-law was from a rural area, his future is limitless.
Chen Hai was very excited. Before he was somewhat incredulous, now he was 100% sure that these dignitaries indeed came because of his boss!
This was truly so prestigious; in the end, his legend would spread throughout the nearby towns and villages.
"Have you heard? Someone in West River Village got married, and even the Municipal Secretary and the Mayor came to congratulate!"
"This Chen Hai is really something, isn’t he!"
"I heard that these high-ranking officials came because of Chen Hai’s boss. It’s impressive that Chen Hai has such a good boss!"
Rumors like these would circulate throughout the region; everyone would envy him, Chen Hai!
Thinking of this, Chen Hai straightened his back, full of confidence.
His father, Chen Datou, stood even straighter, like a rocket ready to launch, completely proud. How could he not be proud? Such face! It’s something to brag about for a lifetime!
Everyone in West River Village, yes, referred to everyone present, were all trash compared to his son Chen Hai!
Especially Lin Fan!
Chen Datou couldn’t help but give Father Lin, Lin Dagui, a proud look. Look at my son, and then look at your son. Your son delivers food. Can he compare to my son!
In the past, Lin Fan was better at studying than Chen Hai. Chen Datou was actually quite unhappy about it and felt humiliated, envying it quite a lot, but there was nothing he could do. He could only secretly be disgruntled. When he saw Lin Dagui, he felt ashamed.
Now, his son had left Lin Fan far behind, and he was so smug about it, practically looking down his nose at Lin Dagui.
Lin Dagui, however, remained calm. He was always a well-adjusted person. He wasn’t jealous just because Chen Hai was doing better than Little Fan. He never liked comparisons. To him, he didn’t demand his son to be rich or noble, as long as he was healthy, down-to-earth, and righteous. Delivering food was a job he earned with his own hands, nothing to be ashamed of.
The Municipal Secretary and Mayor attending a wedding is, of course, a great thing and surely face-giving. But if not, it doesn’t matter. In matters of marriage, Father Lin’s only hope for Lin Fan was for him to find a good wife and live in love. Everything else is temporary, superficial.
Holding these views, Father Lin was entirely out of tune with Chen Datou. He didn’t know what Chen Datou was on about.
Just when the people around Chen Hai were feeling quite pleased with themselves.
Secretary Ma and Mayor Long, along with a group of tycoons behind them, were perplexed by the approaching boss.
They were looking for Mr. Lin, who was this?
He wouldn’t consider himself Mr. Lin, would he? It’s really strange, someone coming up to assume the identity of "Mr. Lin." The problem is, he wasn’t the Mr. Lin they were looking for!
The Mr. Lin they were looking for was Lin Fan, an extraordinarily handsome young man, the richest man in Yun City!
Lin Bin?
Who? Never heard of him.
Even though somewhat unclear, Secretary Ma shook hands with the boss and smiled, "Hello, may I ask what your relationship is with Mr. Lin?"
This person who claimed to be Lin Bin shared the same surname as Mr. Lin. Could he be Mr. Lin’s uncle or something? After all, in the village, being an uncle wouldn’t be surprising. If that were the case, they couldn’t afford to be disrespectful.
The boss was momentarily stunned, unable to comprehend Secretary Ma’s question. What did he mean by "what’s your relationship with Mr. Lin"?
Could it be...
The boss suddenly realized something, breaking out in a cold sweat. The Mr. Lin that Secretary Ma and the others were looking for, could it possibly not be him?
The boss couldn’t help but ask, "Secretary Ma, who is the Mr. Lin you’re looking for?"
Secretary Ma said, "Mr. Lin is..."
Before he finished speaking, a sudden melodious engine sound echoed from afar, roaring towards West River Village, instantly drawing everyone’s attention.
Everyone turned their heads and froze.
A Rolls-Royce Cullinan was speeding toward them!
Oh my God!
Luxe car!
Rolls-Royce!
There were already quite a few luxury cars present, like Audis, BMWs, Mercedes...
But in front of this Rolls-Royce, they all paled in comparison.
"What kind of car is this, it seems really impressive?"
"So handsome, incredibly handsome!"
"Rolls-Royce, I’ve seen it on TV, a car worth millions!"
The villagers of West River Village were discussing, and upon hearing someone say this car was worth millions, they were all dumbfounded. Gosh, a single car costing millions, to them, was simply unimaginable!
Who is the arriving guest?
Could it also be someone attending Chen Hai’s wedding? This must be an impressive individual. Initially, with the Municipal Secretary and Mayor’s arrival, everyone thought that was the pinnacle of astonishing yet, unexpectedly, something even more shocking seemed to be happening!
While the villagers were still baffled.
Lin Shanshan had a delighted expression. Her brother finally came back, and he returned in a Rolls-Royce, planning not to be low-key anymore!
Seeing this Rolls-Royce, Secretary Ma, Mayor Long, and the group of tycoons behind them also displayed joyous smiles.
So Mr. Lin is here!
Although they didn’t understand why, Mr. Lin and his girlfriend Wei Yue’er, who clearly left earlier than they did, arrived in West River Village later. They didn’t encounter them on the way here; maybe they had some temporary business to attend to.
Of course, they didn’t know that Lin Fan took a shortcut back to the village but was delayed because of an incident with a jumping girl, so he ended up returning later than Secretary Ma and the others.
Once the matter was resolved, Lin Fan, fearing he’d miss the wedding, hurried back as fast as he could.
The car stopped outside the wedding venue. The Rolls-Royce Cullinan certainly was formidable, the feeling of true opulence.
The passenger side door opened first, and out jumped Wei Yue’er.
Hm?
The crowd exchanged glances, utterly taken aback. Wasn’t this the teacher Wei Yue’er from the village elementary school? How did she end up in a luxury car?
Soon after, the driver’s door opened, and Lin Fan jumped out of the car.
What?
The crowd was utterly stunned, never in their wildest dreams did they think, driving a top-tier luxury car, would be Lin Fan?
And what happened next truly left the villagers shell-shocked.
Only to hear Secretary Ma laugh, "Mr. Lin, you’re finally back!"

chapters.title: Chapter 652 You Must Be Joking
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Chapter 652 You Must Be Joking
What the hell!
The Mr. Lin that these esteemed people are looking for is Lin Fan?
Lin Fan coming back in a Rolls-Royce was shocking enough, but this just left all the villagers utterly dumbfounded. What the heck is going on?
How could it be possible that so many esteemed people are here for Lin Fan?
Unbelievable! Who would have thought!
Lin Fan came back to attend Chen Hai’s wedding but didn’t think that Secretary Ma and the others would show up too, he was also a bit surprised.
"Secretary Ma, Mayor Long, everyone, why are you all here?" Lin Fan asked curiously and directly.
Secretary Ma chuckled, "Because we heard Mr. Lin’s friend is getting married, everyone thought about getting together to have a drink and offer congratulations. We didn’t get Mr. Lin’s permission, hope you don’t mind."
Lin Fan said with a smile, "Oh, I see, why would I mind, thank you all for the thought."
What?
The villagers were silent.
Secretary Ma’s words just now directly stated their intention. They came because of Lin Fan. Without him, they wouldn’t have appeared at Chen Hai’s wedding at all!
My God, since when did Lin Fan have such incredible influence!
Chen Datou was so shocked that he couldn’t help but blurting out, "Secretary Ma, aren’t you here because of Boss Lin Bin?"
Secretary Ma frowned and said, "Lin Bin? Sorry, we just found out about Mr. Lin Bin, we have nothing to do with him."
The atmosphere instantly became awkward, awkward enough that you could curl your toes into a three-bedroom apartment.
At this moment, Lin Bin was so embarrassed he wanted to find a hole to crawl into, his face turned bright red. Damn, the most embarrassing thing wasn’t that people mistook him for Mr. Lin, it was that he went up to claim it himself.
This was truly the cringe-worthy part!
With the situation so awkward, Lin Bin wished he could become invisible, yet Chen Datou just had to make things worse, the boss was itching to run over and slap Chen Datou a few times.
Mayor Long chuckled, "Mr. Lin Bin, did you just approach us because you thought we were looking for you?"
I really don’t know where Lin Bin got such confidence from.
Lin Bin’s face turned scarlet, he felt like dying, too embarrassing, just too embarrassing.
Chen Hai, at this moment, couldn’t be bothered with his boss’s embarrassment. He was completely overwhelmed by surprise. How could it be Lin Fan, how is it possible that it’s Lin Fan!
"What’s going on, Lin Fan, is this Rolls-Royce yours?" Chen Hai couldn’t help but ask.
He always felt superior because he thought he was doing better than Lin Fan, and he was full of confidence. Once he realized he was wrong, he might find it hard to accept reality.
"It can’t be, haha, Lin Fan, aren’t you working as a delivery guy in Yun City? How could you afford a Rolls-Royce worth several million? You must have borrowed it. I heard you drive a Xia Li, yes, it must be borrowed!"
Chen Hai said, partly comforting himself.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Uh, I bought it, what’s wrong?"
Chen Hai’s body trembled!
Bought!
This car was bought by Lin Fan!
Impossible, how could it be! He had just taken out a loan to buy an Audi A8 for his wedding, partially because it was a special day and partially to show off. After hearing that he bought a new Audi A8, the effect was good; the villagers admired him!
He enjoyed that feeling, but suddenly, Lin Fan came along, and the Rolls-Royce was bought by him?
In front of a Rolls-Royce, what’s an Audi? It’s nothing, just a little brother compared to a big brother!
"Impossible, Lin Fan, you must be joking, right? How could you afford a car worth several million being a delivery guy, how many orders would you have to deliver to make several million?" Chen Hai cried out.
He was unwilling, unwilling to accept reality.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Delivering takeout would indeed be tough. A single order only pays 5 yuan. Even if I delivered 100 orders a day, calculated, it would take 44 years of continuous work to gather 8 million."
What?
This Rolls-Royce is worth 8 million!
The villagers were all stunned, too expensive, could there really be such an expensive car in the world, unimaginable!
Chen Hai said, "There you go, where would you get so much money, even if you started delivering from birth, you’re not even 44 years old, you’re only 21!"
Lin Fan nodded and said, "That’s true, good thing I didn’t buy the car with delivery money."
Chen Hai asked curiously, "Then what else could it be?"
Lin Fan said, "Since you want to know the answer, I’ll tell you. I can probably buy an 8 million Rolls-Royce in a day or two."
He was telling the truth. The system was still glitching, sometimes working, mostly not. But most days, it would reward Lin Fan with a 5 million cash prize, and it’s been the same these past few days.
The last time the system worked was when it rewarded Lin Fan with top medical skills.
At 5 million cash a day, that’s 10 million in two days, buying an 8 million Rolls-Royce is indeed a one-to-two days affair.
Chen Hai looked at Lin Fan’s nonchalant expression, paused, then burst out laughing, "Lin Fan, you’re joking with me, aren’t you? Of course! This must be a joke. It’s really funny, hahaha..."
Lin Shanshan smiled and said, "Brother Hai, my brother wasn’t joking with you. You think it’s a joke only because the truth is beyond your imagination."
"Bullshit!"
Chen Hai couldn’t help but get a bit emotional. Actually, from the moment a group of esteemed people approached Lin Fan, he sensed something was wrong. Lin Fan was definitely not simple, but he just didn’t want to accept that Lin Fan was better than him.
"Your brother’s a delivery guy, how can it be!" Chen Hai said, "Even I can’t afford a Rolls-Royce, can he!"
Lin Fan frowned, Chen Hai seemed quite agitated, he was just telling the truth, why such a big reaction?
Lin Fan then smiled and said, "Chen Hai, today’s your big wedding day, let’s not talk about me."
Chen Hai was about to lose it.
He just couldn’t accept that Lin Fan was better than him. He was floating because he thought he was more accomplished than Lin Fan, he couldn’t bear being knocked down.
"No way!"
Chen Hai laughed, "Lin Fan, I see it now, you’re playing a prank on me, aren’t you? I must say, you put a lot of thought into it, using a rented Rolls-Royce to show off and tease me, alright, alright, stop it."
Lin Fan said, "I’m not joking."
Chen Hai got a little angry, "You say you’re not joking? It’s not that I look down on you, but can you afford a Rolls-Royce? Lin Fan, stop fooling around, it’s pointless! Even if you admit that you’re not doing as well as me, so what, I won’t laugh at you, there’s no need to show off!"
Listening to Chen Hai and Lin Fan’s conversation, Secretary Ma and the others felt a bit puzzled.
Secretary Ma chuckled and said, "Groom, Mr. Lin is indeed not joking. As Yun City’s richest man, buying a Rolls-Royce is naturally no problem for him."
Yun City’s richest man?
Lin Fan is Yun City’s richest man?
Everyone was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 653: All Kneeled
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Chapter 653: All Kneeled
Chen Hai couldn’t accept that Lin Fan was doing better than him. A series of questions aimed to expose Lin Fan’s true face, hoping for a result to prove that Lin Fan wasn’t doing as well as he was!
However, Secretary Ma’s words, "wealthiest man in Yun City," exploded like a bomb, shattering Chen Hai’s luck.
Wealthiest man in Yun City!
Lin Fan is the wealthiest man in Yun City?
To Secretary Ma and the others’ surprise, how could it be that people from Mr. Lin’s village, even his friends, didn’t know Lin Fan was the wealthiest man in Yun City?
It seems that Mr. Lin is indeed very humble, even the villagers didn’t know he was wealthy. In that sense, being able to attend the wedding is quite a privilege.
Wealthiest man in Yun City?
Lin Fan is the wealthiest man in Yun City?
The villagers were all dumbfounded.
Secretary Ma said it himself, could it just be a joke?
But Lin Fan being the wealthiest man in Yun City is really astounding!
They couldn’t believe it. Wasn’t Lin Fan a delivery guy? Suddenly becoming the wealthiest man in Yun City, the leap is just too great, how can they accept it!
Mayor Long said, "Mr. Lin is not only the wealthiest man in Yun City, but he’s also a miracle doctor. Today, in the city, he cured Secretary Ma’s severe illness. Mr. Lin is truly humble, he didn’t tell us he was the wealthiest man in Yun City, it was Mr. Chen among us who recognized him."
Secretary Ma laughed, "Luckily, he was recognized, otherwise it would have been a pity. Today, we specially invited Mr. Lin to the city government to discuss investment in Tianhai. Mr. Lin is a key figure in our future development in Tianhai!"
The crowd was once again stunned.
Secretary Ma’s evaluation is too high!
At this point, even if they didn’t want to believe it, they had to.
Lin Fan, truly is the wealthiest man in Yun City!
Besides the general surprise of the villagers, even those close to Lin Fan were bewildered.
Father Lin and Mrs. Lin were petrified. What? Their son is the wealthiest man in Yun City? Wasn’t he a delivery guy!
Indeed, Lin Fan did mention before, in front of the elderly couple, that he was wealthy, but they didn’t believe him at the time!
What Lin Fan said before was actually true!
He Chunyu, sitting quietly in a corner, was also astonished. Following this, a strange, complex expression appeared on her face. Hidden from sight, no one noticed...
Wei Yue’er was also stunned at this moment.
She had accompanied Lin Fan all day, seeing him driving a Rolls-Royce, chatting and laughing with the city secretary, mayor, and tycoons, she couldn’t help but be curious about Lin Fan’s true identity. She thought Lin Fan must be extraordinary, but never imagined that he was the wealthiest man in Yun City!
What a surprise!
"How could this be..."
Chen Datou was dumbfounded, muttering. Originally, he was proud because of his son, standing tall and straight, but now, unconsciously, his posture wasn’t as upright, like a wilting flower.
"Wealthiest man in Yun City..." Lin Bin muttered, suddenly thinking of something, exclaiming in surprise, "Could it be, could it be the legendary mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin?"
Heavens, the legend of the mysterious Mr. Lin had spread beyond Yun City.
Legend has it, Mr. Lin is from the Kyoto Lin Family!
If it’s true, then Lin Fan’s identity, nobody would dare provoke!
"Boss, even you..."
Chen Hai exclaimed, he could still choose not to believe what others said, but even his boss said so, his last resistance crumbled.
Lin Fan!
Really is the wealthiest man in Yun City!
These dignitaries and nobles came to his wedding, not because he had such great connections, nor because his boss had such great connections, but because of Lin Fan’s connections!
The highlight of his life was brought by Lin Fan, who he looked down upon!
The funny thing is, he thought he was doing better than Lin Fan. The wealthiest man in Yun City, isn’t he a thousand times, ten thousand times better than him? Not only that, his boss is also thousands of times, tens of thousands of times better than him!
Lin Shanshan cheerfully said, "My brother is indeed the wealthiest man in Yun City. I didn’t say anything earlier because my brother instructed me to keep a low profile. But since everyone knows now, I’ll brag a bit for my brother. My brother lives in the most expensive house in Yun City, worth three billion, he owns an island worth ten billion, and he owns an entire Tangchen Yipin building, worth several billion. These assets are just a part, and most importantly, my brother owns a group with a market value of two hundred billion..."
As Lin Shanshan bragged, everyone who heard bowed in awe.
Heavens, with such a series of assets, just one would already drive someone crazy, and this series, all belongs to Lin Fan!
A group company with a market value of two hundred billion!
This further left everyone dumbfounded in shock.
Lin Fan, always modest, didn’t like boasting, interrupted Lin Shanshan, chuckling, "Keep it low-key, Shanshan, no need to say more."
"Oh." Only then did Lin Shanshan stop. If she really bragged about her brother, there would be endless things to say!
However, Lin Shanshan couldn’t help but complain, "Brother, it’s not that I want to brag about you, it’s because they, earlier, were all mocking you, I held it in for so long!"
Lin Fan responded with an "oh," realizing he missed out on some interesting scenes.
Lin Fan looked at Chen Hai, smiled and said, "Chen Hai, today is your wedding, I originally intended to keep a low profile, I’m sorry for stealing the spotlight."
"Haha!"
Chen Hai suddenly burst out laughing, a laugh full of reluctance, "Hahaha... the wealthiest man in Yun City, it’s the wealthiest man in Yun City, you’re impressive, Lin Fan, you’re really something!"
He thought he was the most accomplished young man in the village, he built the tallest house in the village, renovated inside and out, he bought an Audi A8, he was his boss’s confidant, he was doing well...
But now, compared to Lin Fan, it’s nothing!
The superiority complex Chen Hai had, this blow was too great, like a blow to the head, it would drive him crazy.
Lin Shanshan snorted, "Brother, you don’t have to be polite with that Chen Hai, he was the one who criticized you the most, he thought he was doing better than you, his tail was raised to the sky!"
Lin Fan responded with an "oh," sighed and said, "There’s no need for that, after all, we grew up together, even if I’m doing worse than you, there shouldn’t be a superiority complex, if I’m doing better, there shouldn’t be jealousy either."
Chen Hai excitedly said, "Lin Fan, no need for sarcastic remarks, you’re the wealthiest man in Yun City, how did you do it, I can’t accept it, I really can’t accept it!"
Lin Fan chuckled, "There’s even less need to say that."
But Chen Hai was still relentless.
"Chen Hai, enough, haven’t you embarrassed yourself enough, know your limits!" Chen Hai’s boss, Lin Bin, said in a deep voice. He couldn’t stand it anymore. This Chen Hai, maybe driven mad by jealousy, offending Mr. Lin, the consequence would be hard to manage, and might even implicate him as the boss!

chapters.title: Chapter 654: The Great Fortunate One
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Chapter 654: The Great Fortunate One
Lin Fan’s identity was finally revealed, shocking everyone except those who already knew.
Chen Hai, who always thought he was doing better than Lin Fan and felt superior, couldn’t believe or accept this fact. He couldn’t understand how Lin Fan could become the richest person in Yun City.
This doesn’t make any sense!
Lin Fan, a village kid from a small mountain village, even if he was decent in his studies and got into a university, becoming the richest person in Yun City was unbelievable. Generally speaking, a rural kid doing as well as Chen Hai would already be quite good, which is why Chen Hai was so proud and thought he was the most impressive person in the village.
Seeing Chen Hai continuously confront Mr. Lin, boss Lin Bin couldn’t take it anymore. It was fine if Chen Hai was crazy, but he didn’t want to get dragged down by him.
As Chen Hai’s boss, he couldn’t afford to provoke Mr. Lin because of him.
This infamous Mr. Lin was not someone to be trifled with. He had formidable connections; even when he returned to the small village, he was impressive, attracting the personal attention of the city party secretary and mayor. How could a small boss dare offend such a person?
The boss was already regretting it immensely. He had been showing off and even "advising" Mr. Lin earlier, which was like showing off a petty skill before an expert in the field.
The boss immediately stopped Chen Hai, telling him not to continue his madness.
Then he forced a smile and said, "Mr. Lin, I didn’t recognize a great person, I ask for your forgiveness, please don’t mind."
Even the boss was trying to appease Lin Fan, so no one else dared to say anything.
But Chen Hai was just too shocked; his curiosity took over.
"No, I want to know, Lin Fan, how did you become the richest in Yun City? How did you do it? Isn’t everyone curious?" Chen Hai asked.
Curious, of course everyone was curious, but no one dared to ask.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Actually, I’ve already disclosed this to the public; it was a long-lost uncle of mine who provided me with funds, and I used this money to invest and earn profits."
Lin Fan had indeed said this publicly. He had a mysterious uncle who left him an inheritance, and this mysterious rich man was the legendary Mr. Lin.
However, no one knew who this mysterious Mr. Lin was. Rumor had it he was an invisible tycoon, possibly related to the wealthy Lin Family in Jing City.
One theory suggested that young Lin Fan was merely a front for Mr. Lin.
According to Lin Fan, Mr. Lin had no children and left his fortune to him, and Mr. Lin was now elderly, in poor health, and uninvolved in worldly affairs, leaving the wealth for Lin Fan to manage.
With Mr. Lin’s assets, Lin Fan thrived in the capital market, swiftly building the Mortal Group worth 200 billion, becoming Yun City’s richest person.
The business world buzzed with Lin Fan’s story, and now calling someone Mr. Lin referred to Lin Fan.
Although Lin Fan, originally a poor kid, suddenly inherited a massive fortune, which was incredibly lucky, his subsequent use of the wealth to become the richest also demonstrated Lin Fan’s prowess, and in the business world, Lin Fan was revered as a god-like figure, with many studying his investment methods.
Of course, all these were fabricated stories, only Lin Fan himself knew that everything was thanks to a system.
This system secret was known only to him and would not be disclosed to outsiders, so he invented an uncle for his story. Coincidentally, he did have a long-lost uncle.
Chen Hai was dumbfounded.
"A long-lost uncle suddenly comes back with a huge fortune for you to inherit? How does this sound like a movie plot?"
Chen Hai murmured, referring to a film called "Legend of Wang Duoyu," where the protagonist Wang Duoyu also inherited wealth from a long-lost relative!
Damn, could Lin Fan be making this up based on a movie plot?
In fact, it wasn’t. Lin Fan hadn’t even seen the movie when he made it up, it was purely coincidental.
"Hahaha, Lin Fan, do you really think I’ll believe you? How could such things happen in the world? Do you really have a long-lost uncle?" Chen Hai skeptically asked.
"Ahem!"
Chen Datou couldn’t resist clearing his throat, trying to stop his son, and said, "Lin Fan... Mr. Lin did indeed have an uncle who went missing when Mr. Lin was very young. Most of the younger generation doesn’t know this, but we older folks are well aware..."
Hearing this, the older villagers nodded in agreement.
"To think the long-missing Lin Family kid turned into a wealthy person!"
"And he came back with wealth for Lin Fan to inherit, it’s truly enviable."
"Perhaps he was taken in by wealthy people and later became rich himself. It’s quite an adventure!"
