Listening to this discussion, Chen Hai couldn’t help but believe it, but he still wasn’t convinced that Lin Fan was doing better than him.
"I get it, Lin Fan, you inherited wealth, not earned it yourself. If you hadn’t inherited it, you’d still be delivering food, right? But I got to where I am today entirely on my own!" Chen Hai said, attempting to maintain his sense of superiority.
Lin Fan nodded, "You’re right, I did inherit the wealth. If you’re not convinced, why don’t you try inheriting some wealth yourself."
"This..." Chen Hai’s face turned red, he was at a loss for words, this was truly infuriating.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Do you think it’s easy for anyone to inherit assets worth hundreds of billions? It’s a one-in-a-million kind of luck. I never deny personal effort, but I also value luck. Luck is often a necessary condition for success; many people are not without ability, just lacking a bit of luck."
Luck is something seemingly elusive but very real. With bad luck, even with great talent, one leads a lonely life; with good luck, winning the lottery, you go from poverty to fortune.
Luck is real yet unpredictable, something that happens by chance.
Being born the child of a billionaire, isn’t that luck?
Of course, it is luck.
Is it fair?
Some are born into wealth, others into poverty, it’s undoubtedly unfair because the world itself is unfair.
Or use another term, destiny.
A lack of destiny leads to unrecognized talent, while someone with great destiny prospers, rises high, like a dragon soaring in the sky.
Lin Fan is such a person with great destiny.
The powerful and influential believe in this, so knowing Lin Fan inherited hundreds of billions, they never think he’s relying on luck alone but instead worship his extraordinary destiny.
Confronted with Lin Fan’s incredible luck, does Chen Hai get angry, but what can he do about it? Why don’t you try inheriting some wealth too, but you can’t, so how do you feel?
Chen Hai is indeed angry, but thinking about it, what’s the use of being angry, and he instantly deflated.
"Chen Hai, you don’t need to come back to work." Suddenly, the boss said.
These words shocked Chen Hai, his face turned pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: You’re Not Very Good at Handling Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Chapter 655: You’re Not Very Good at Handling Things
"Boss, why?" Chen Hai was taken aback and asked shakily.
The boss chuckled, "No reason. I used to think you were quite clever and good at handling things, but today I realize I was wrong about you."
Chen Hai was always at odds with Mr. Lin, and the boss didn’t want to get dragged down by him, so he wanted to quickly distance himself from Chen Hai, naturally resulting in his dismissal, especially in front of Mr. Lin to show his stance.
The thing Chen Hai was most proud of was his ability to smooth things over. It was because of this that, despite not having a high education and with only average work skills, he managed to win the boss’s favor. Relying on his cleverness, he navigated the workplace easily, becoming the boss’s loyal aide.
Today, however, it was precisely because he couldn’t smooth things over that he was kicked to the curb by the boss.
This was truly quite ironic.
Chen Hai panicked, really panicked, realizing he had let his anger cloud his judgment.
"Boss, you can’t fire me, I’ve worked so hard to get where I am in the company, if you fire me, I’ll have to start from scratch, I suddenly have no income, and I just bought an Audi A8, I still have the car loan to pay..."
Chen Hai pleaded and in his desperation knelt down with a thud.
The boss chuckled, "That’s no longer my business."
Ignoring Chen Hai, the boss approached Lin Fan with a forced smile and said, "Mr. Lin, I apologize for any offense today, and I ask for your forgiveness."
Having fired Chen Hai, the boss was now trying to earn points with Lin Fan, hoping to curry favor with him.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Boss Lin, you just taught everyone that young people need to be good at handling things, but it seems you’re not so great at it yourself. Today is Chen Hai’s wedding, he’s my childhood friend, and you fired him at his wedding, in front of his family and friends, isn’t that too much?"
"This..." The boss turned pale with fright and began to tremble, not knowing what to do for a moment.
How ironic, Lin Fan’s words were a slap in the face.
"Mr. Lin, I’m truly sorry, I was wrong, please don’t take this to heart," the boss pleaded, almost kneeling before Lin Fan.
Lin Fan said, "It’s fine, Boss Lin, I’m not taking it to heart. I’ve faced too much sarcasm and ridicule, your words don’t bother me."
"Mr. Lin is magnanimous. Thank you, Mr. Lin. If there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave now," Lin Bin hurriedly said, turning and slipping away.
Today was too embarrassing, and he couldn’t stay any longer. Just acknowledging Mr. Lin’s identity lost him face and was unbearably awkward.
So it’s said, people should remain humble and not show off.
Chen Hai was left with no words and tears, the boss was gone, and so was his job.
"Chen Hai, don’t worry, aren’t you good at handling things? You’ll surely bounce back quickly," Lin Fan said with a smile. Though it sounded consoling, there was a hint of teasing.
Chen Hai’s face turned red with embarrassment.
Chen Datou then awkwardly said, "Little Fan, you’re the richest in Yun City, I heard you own a company worth 200 billion? Since Ah-Hai just lost his job, could you let Ah-Hai work with you in the future?"
Chen Datou thought well of it. Being Yun City’s richest and owning a 200 billion company, if Chen Hai could get into that company, wouldn’t it be better than before? Plus, Lin Fan and Chen Hai grew up together, with that relationship, getting a position should be simple!
Lin Fan was speechless, this Chen Datou really was shameless, really trying to exploit the situation.
Lin Fan remembered when Chen Datou came to his house with an invitation, acting all smug. He could understand a bit of pride since his son was doing well, but pride shouldn’t involve belittling others, showcasing superiority with one’s son, that was just annoying.
Although Lin Fan wouldn’t harbor resentment for this, it was still quite irritating.
"Xiaohai, why are you spacing out? Quickly pour tea for Brother Fan, if he’s pleased, he might even make you a supervisor," Chen Datou promptly urged his son.
Chen Hai finally realized. He was someone clever and good at handling things, he only lost his head due to not accepting that Lin Fan was doing better. Now he understood, he should leverage his strengths to please Lin Fan. If he could latch onto Lin Fan’s big tree, wouldn’t he reap benefits later!
"Brother Fan, have some tea!"
Chen Hai ran over eagerly, poured the tea himself, handed it to Lin Fan with a big smile, trying to please him.
Lin Fan, however, didn’t take it, smiling, "No need for such courtesy, we’ve been good friends since childhood, no need to stand on ceremony."
Chen Hai quickly laughed, "Absolutely, we’re good brothers, even closer than real brothers. I’ve always especially admired Brother Fan. Now that Brother Fan has become the richest man in Yun City, it’s a pride for our West River Village!"
Chen Hai flattered shamelessly.
Seeing Chen Hai like this, the villagers shook their heads in private. This Chen Hai, truly a fair-weathered person.
Lin Shanshan couldn’t hold back her urge to vomit and said, "Brother Hai, that wasn’t what you were saying before!"
Chen Hai was startled and awkwardly laughed, "No way, Shanshan, you must be misunderstanding, I..."
Lin Fan interrupted Chen Hai with curiosity, "I’d like to know, what did you say before?"
Chen Hai said, "I..."
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, Chen Hai thought you were a delivery man and looked down on you, mocking you in every way. I don’t think he admired you when he was younger, at most he was jealous. Once he believed he was doing better than you, he got smug."
Lin Fan looked at Chen Hai and smiled, "Is that so?"
Lin Shanshan continued, "Not only did they look down on you, but on our whole family, especially making fun of dad."
Upon hearing this, Lin Fan’s face darkened, "Is that so?"
In reality, whatever others said about him, he could ignore, but once it involved his father, the nature changed.
Chen Hai panicked, blushing, "No, that’s not how it was, there’s no way I would treat Uncle Da Gui like that, Uncle Da Gui is the elder I respect most, being respectful is not enough."
Lin Fan said lightly, "Alright, Chen Hai, I fully understand your previous behavior, but if you truly want to work at my company, I hope you can be honest with me, I like honest people."
Chen Hai was taken aback, what did Lin Fan mean by this, could it be that Lin Fan was really giving him a chance to develop at Mortal Group!
Chen Hai felt that this opportunity was something he absolutely couldn’t miss!
Chen Hai immediately burst into tears, "Brother Fan, I was wrong, I admit, I was indeed jealous of you when we were kids, because you were so excellent, you had better grades than me, you were taller and more handsome, I always wanted to be as outstanding as you. So when I thought you were just a delivery man, and I was doing better than you, I got carried away, felt a brief victory and said the wrong thing, I truly deserve to die, failing to recognize the mountain before me, Brother Fan, you’re magnanimous, please don’t hold it against me."
Chen Datou awkwardly chuckled, "Little Fan, it’s actually because you were so outstanding, would you consider letting Ah-Hai join your company..."
Lin Fan chuckled, "So, are you blaming me then?"

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 666: The Power of Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Chapter 666: The Power of Money
The Chen father and son quickly shook their heads and waved their hands.
"No, no, we’re not blaming you, Little Fan, it’s our own small-mindedness, we were wrong. Little Fan, for the sake of growing up with Ah-Hai, now that Ah-Hai is unemployed, and you’re the richest man in Yun City, could you help out a buddy?"
Chen Datou said with an embarrassed smile.
Upon hearing this, Shanshan got angry and sneered, "Uncle Datou, pardon my bluntness, but you’re being shameless. You’re trying to guilt-trip my brother, but before, you looked down on him for being a delivery guy and didn’t even want him to be a groomsman. Now where do you get the nerve to ask him to arrange a job for you?"
"..." Chen Datou was left speechless.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Actually, I do have some money now, so creating some job opportunities for the people back home and giving back to them is something I should do. I always prioritize work ability over other things in employees. As long as they can do their job well, that’s enough. I don’t welcome those who are sycophantic and flattering. Chen Hai, if you want to come to my company, you can keep an eye out for recruitment ads. See if there’s anything suitable, and try submitting a resume. Once you pass the interview, you can join."
Chen Hai wiped his cold sweat and said, "I understand. Thank you, Brother Fan."
Chen Datou laughed and said, "Thank you, Little Fan, for giving Ah-Hai a chance. Ah-Hai, you heard it, after the wedding, you should go to Yun City. Follow Little Fan and work hard!"
The father and son thanked Lin Fan profusely, as if they were certain they could join Mortal Group.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Chen Hai, once again, I wish you a happy wedding. Today is your big day, so I’ll hand the spotlight back to you."
Chen Datou said, "What are you saying, Little Fan? I have a suggestion, how about you be Ah-Hai’s groomsman? It would be our honor."
Chen Hai quickly said, "Dad, how can that be? Brother Fan, with his status, how could he be my groomsman? I couldn’t possibly accept that. Brother Fan, please take the top seat. You are the most honored guest, the top honored guest."
At this moment, Chen Hai practically wished he could treat Lin Fan like an ancestor.
The wedding continued.
The Chen father and son thought they had caught onto a good thing with Lin Fan and felt exceptionally happy again.
They treated Lin Fan’s family as VIPs, hustling about, nodding and bowing, showing great respect, which was the complete opposite of their previous arrogance.
The villagers of West River Village were probably the same. They used to laugh at Lin Fan casually, but now they didn’t dare to look him in the eye for fear of offending Yun City’s richest man.
They were in awe of Lin Fan, not even daring to gossip about him.
They used to boast about Chen Hai’s future, but now that West River Village has produced a richest man, they don’t even dare to praise him to his face. There’s no way around it; the title of richest man is too intimidating.
They could only dare to discuss Lin Fan behind his back in the future, and no one dared to say a bad word for fear that it might somehow reach the richest man’s ears, bringing them bad luck.
Lin Fan saw all these changes and was somewhat speechless. Everyone’s change from arrogance to courtesy was all because of his status. A poor deliveryman they could trample on as they wished, but a richest man in Yun City made them tremble. Money is truly a good thing; it can satisfy material desires and test people’s hearts. This is the power of money.
The village chief brought a glass of wine over, smiling as he approached Lin Fan’s table.
"Little Fan, come, let me toast to you," the village chief said with a shameless grin.
Lin Fan did not have a good impression of this village chief. The chief’s son, Chen Junjie, was quite a jerk, and after being taught a lesson by Lin Fan, the chief held a grudge. To retaliate against Lin Fan, he even planned to build a public toilet across from Lin Fan’s house.
Lin Fan couldn’t even bother to pretend to be polite to such a person.
"Get lost!" Lin Fan said calmly.
The village chief’s smile immediately froze, leaving him extremely embarrassed, and then his face turned red.
But he didn’t dare to get angry; instead, he gave a shy smile, held onto his wine glass, and awkwardly walked away.
Father Lin was still a little worried, "Little Fan, after all, he’s the village chief. Aren’t you afraid that he might..."
Lin Fan said, "Give us a hard time? Ha-ha, he can try."
Of course, the village chief no longer dared to make things difficult for Lin Fan. Just with the last incident about building a toilet, the village chief suffered a great loss. He wanted to trouble Lin Fan, but in the end, the county magistrate intervened, and the toilet was built in the village chief’s own vegetable field.
At that time, Lin Fan’s identity as Yun City’s richest man had not yet been revealed.
Now that his identity as the richest man in Yun City was known, how could the village chief dare to provoke Lin Fan?
Look at the people who came to attend: Secretary Ma, Mayor Long, and a bunch of wealthy folks. All these prominent people treated Lin Fan with great respect!
From then on, in West River Village, whenever people saw Father Lin and Mrs. Lin, they were full of flattery. No longer did anyone laugh at them as they did before.
The villagers felt that they had no right to mock the richest man, and they somewhat hoped to gain some benefits from him, such as borrowing money from the richest man or asking him to arrange jobs for their children.
Once they had these fantasies of benefits, they couldn’t wait to treat Lin Fan like an ancestor.
However, Father Lin and Mrs. Lin didn’t change due to their son becoming the richest man. They still chose to live in the village because they were used to it and fond of farming.
Lin Fan had originally proposed for them to move to the city, where they could live in a big house and even have a maid to take care of them so they could enjoy a comfortable life.
But they declined, choosing to remain in their small village, continuing to farm daily as usual.
They hadn’t changed their character because of their son’s success, unlike Chen Datou, who straightened his back because his son became successful and looked down on others.
They were still a kind couple.
But Chen Datou had changed again; his back wasn’t as straight as before, especially when he saw Father Lin and Mrs. Lin. He nodded and bowed, serving them as if they were ancestors, practically bending his back to the ground.
Money can test humanity and change people, and this was vividly demonstrated in Chen Datou.
As Chen Hai’s wedding concluded, Lin Fan’s time at home was also coming to an end.
Lin Fan planned to return to Yun City. After spending a few days in the countryside, Yun City needed Lin Fan, and he couldn’t be away from a company with a market cap of 200 billion for long as many matters required his attention.
Before leaving the countryside, Lin Fan went to Dog No. 2’s house to bid farewell.
At Chen Hai’s wedding, Lin Fan was busy socializing with those prominent figures and didn’t have a chance to speak with Wei Yue’er and the others.
"Little Fan is here, come in and have a seat," He Chunyu said with a smile, welcoming him in. She was still as enthusiastic as before, only now there was something different in her smile.
Lin Fan could sense it; it was probably due to his status as the richest man, leading him to sigh inwardly.
This was why he had chosen to keep a low profile before; he didn’t want his change in status to make others distant with him.
Dog No. 2, however, didn’t seem to act distant, perhaps because he was naïve.
"Brother Fan, I heard you have a lot of money, a lot, a lot of money. Just how much is it?" Dog No. 2 asked eagerly, pulling Lin Fan by the arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 667: Mysterious Sports Car Youth
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Chapter 667: Mysterious Sports Car Youth
"Dog No.2, don’t ask such silly questions!" He Chunyu attempted to stop Dog No.2.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "It’s okay, Dog No.2, I am indeed very wealthy, my money piled up could fill this entire house."
Dog No.2 was delighted, grinning, "That’s great, then Brother Fan can buy a lot of snacks?"
Lin Fan nodded, "Yes, I can buy a lot of snacks."
Dog No.2 laughed, "Brother Fan, I’m really happy for you. I always said Brother Fan is the best, didn’t I say it right?"
Dog No.2 had admired Lin Fan since childhood, following him around like a shadow, always listening to Lin Fan.
He Chunyu laughed, "Little Fan is indeed amazing, becoming the richest person. In this West River Village, there has never been anyone like him and never will be."
Lin Fan said, "Aunt Chunyu, I’m here to say goodbye. I’ll be heading back to Yun City soon."
He Chunyu let out an ’oh’, "Leaving so soon? Aren’t you staying in the village for a couple more days?"
Lin Fan replied, "No, there are things to deal with in Yun City."
He Chunyu said, "Alright then, have a safe journey. Come back more often when you have time. By the way, your parents are going with you to Yun City this time, right? They have worked hard for most of their lives; it’s time for them to enjoy a comfortable life."
Lin Fan said, "I talked to them, but they wouldn’t go with me to Yun City. They said life is more pleasant in the village, so I didn’t force them."
He Chunyu was taken aback for a moment, then smiled, "That’s true, the city has its benefits, and the countryside has its own."
Lin Fan earnestly said, "Aunt Chunyu, do you want to go to the city? If you do, you can bring Dog No.2 with you, and I can help settle you in."
He Chunyu hardly thought about it and immediately said, "No need, I, like your parents, prefer staying in the countryside."
Lin Fan said, "But Dog No.2..."
He Chunyu interrupted Lin Fan, "Dog No.2 will not go to the city either. We rely on each other, and I won’t let him leave me."
Lin Fan was at a loss for words. In fact, he had plans to take Dog No.2 to Yun City. In this world, aside from blood relatives, Dog No.2 was practically half a family to him, and he didn’t want him to be stuck in this backward and isolated village for life.
Lin Fan looked at Dog No.2, smiling, "Dog No.2, do you want to go to Yun City with me?"
Dog No.2 was excited, "I do. I hope to be by Brother Fan’s side, but..."
Dog No.2 glanced at He Chunyu, his expression darkened.
His mother didn’t want him to go.
Looking at He Chunyu’s expression, there was clearly no room for negotiation.
Lin Fan smiled, "It’s okay, Dog No.2. Anytime Aunt Chunyu changes her mind, you can find me."
Lin Fan always thought that He Chunyu was a bit different from others; she might not just be an ordinary farm woman, but for now, Lin Fan didn’t know.
Maybe someday he would know, or maybe he would never know.
But if Dog No.2 were stuck in this small mountain village his whole life, Lin Fan would find it a bit regrettable.
If there was one person in West River Village that Lin Fan wanted to help change their destiny through his connections, it would undoubtedly be Dog No.2.
Although Dog No.2 seemed simple-minded, Lin Fan knew very well that sometimes Dog No.2 wasn’t as silly as he appeared...
He Chunyu, however, didn’t want to continue discussing this topic.
"Little Fan, since you’re heading back to Yun City, I won’t keep you for dinner," He Chunyu said, clearly issuing a subtle eviction order.
Indeed, with Lin Fan’s identity as Yun City’s richest person exposed, He Chunyu’s attitude towards him had subtly shifted, making Lin Fan feel a little uneasy.
Lin Fan didn’t linger at Dog No.2’s house any longer. He stood up and said, "Then I’ll be off. I’ll come to play with Dog No.2 next time I’m back."
"Lin Fan, can you take me with you?"
Wei Yue’er suddenly walked out of the room and asked.
Lin Fan was stunned, Wei Yue’er also wanted to leave?
Both He Chunyu and Dog No.2 were surprised.
Dog No.2 hurriedly asked, "Sister Yue’er, are you leaving too? Why?"
Wei Yue’er said, "I have something to attend to in the city, I’ve already taken leave from school. Lin Fan, could I hitch a ride?"
Lin Fan smiled, "Of course you can."
Wei Yue’er said, "Thank you, then I’ll leave with you."
Wei Yue’er only carried a backpack and left with Lin Fan from He Chunyu’s house.
At this time, a sports car came from the village entrance.
The driver was a handsome young man with slicked-back hair, sunglasses, and a branded suit, looking like a stylish and mature young man.
This sports car was approximately worth around 5 million, revealing that the young man was also wealthy.
"Hello, may I ask where the elementary school is? I’m looking for Teacher Wei Yue’er." The young man stopped the car at the village entrance to ask an elderly man by the roadside.
The elderly man said, "The elementary school is over there, but Teacher Wei is probably not at school; I heard she took a leave and is preparing to return to the city."
The young man let out an ’oh’ and smiled slightly, "Preparing to return to the city, that’s just perfect. I’m here to take her back. Grandpa, do you know where she is now?"
The elderly man said, "She lives at the fool’s house. She’s probably there at this time."
The young man let out an ’oh’, "A fool? Has Yue’er been wronged in the village, that she has to live in a fool’s house? I will never let her suffer such grievances again. When she marries me, I’ll make sure she lives the happiest life."
The young man then drove the sports car, following the elderly man’s directions, towards Dog No.2’s house.
At the village entrance, the elderly folks gathered around, exclaiming in astonishment.
"Has the West River Village really gotten lucky with the ancestors’ blessing? All visitors lately are either rich or influential, and now another wealthy person has come!"
"I think all this is related to Lin Fan!"
"Yeah, Lin Fan is Yun City’s richest man. It’s because of him that so many wealthy people have come here!"
"If we talk about ancestral blessings, then it’s the Lin Family’s ancestors who got blessed!"
The young man drove the sports car to Dog No.2’s house, but hadn’t reached it yet when he saw Wei Yue’er walking towards him with Lin Fan.
The young man was momentarily stunned, frowned, and stared at Lin Fan with a hint of hostility in his eyes, "Who is this guy? How does this village boy deserve to be with Yue’er?"
The young man drove over, stopped the car, and blocked Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er’s path.
The young man then got out of the car, gracefully, "Yue’er, I heard you’re going back to the city. That’s perfect, I’ve come to pick you up, quickly get in the car!"
Wei Yue’er was surprised, looked the young man over, and said, "Do I know you?"
The young man said, "You don’t know me yet, but you’ll know me soon. Get in the car and I’ll explain everything."
Wei Yue’er replied, "Sorry, I don’t know you and won’t get in your car. Lin Fan, let’s go."
The young man let out an ’oh’ and said, "Lin Fan? Yue’er, I heard you were staying at a fool’s house. Is this the fool?"

chapters.title: Chapter 658: She Rides in My Car
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Chapter 658: She Rides in My Car
A red Ferrari sports car, priced between 4 million and 5 million, driven by a young man, tall and handsome, with immaculate fashion taste, clearly a successful social elite.
Such a man never worries about a lack of women; he’s the kind of man countless women are willing to line up to get, a man with priority in choosing a partner in the world of men, enviable indeed.
Perhaps because of this, the young man is very confident, carrying himself with ease and poise.
He tells Wei Yue’er to get into his car, as if it’s certain she would, showcasing his confidence.
However, in the eyes of this young man, Lin Fan, walking alongside Wei Yue’er, holds no threat at all; he even mistakenly thinks Lin Fan is a fool, because the villagers told him Wei Yue’er lives with a fool.
Lin Fan frowned, thinking, "There really are a lot of idiots in this world, they keep popping up endlessly."
"Yue’er, do you know this person?" Lin Fan asked.
Wei Yue’er shook her head, saying, "I don’t know him."
Lin Fan remarked, "Someone you don’t know, acting like he’s very familiar, he must be a fool."
Upon hearing this, Wei Yue’er couldn’t help but chuckle.
The young man made a sound of understanding, squinted his eyes at Lin Fan, and chuckled, "So he’s not a fool, but there’s no difference, a country bumpkin."
Wei Yue’er was unhappy, "Hey, who are you exactly? What are you doing here looking for me? If you keep this up, I don’t care who you are, I’ll have you leave."
The young man’s face changed briefly, then returned to normal, smiling, "I’m sorry, that was presumptuous of me, I should introduce myself. My name is Fan Zheyu, 28 years old, I graduated from Harvard University in the United States with a degree in Finance, studying all the way through Bachelors, Masters, and Ph.D. During my Ph.D. studies, I interned at Gaosheng Group, the most famous investment bank in the United States, where I earned my first bucket of gold in life. Now, I’ve returned home and work as an investment advisor at HSBC. Oh, and I should mention my family background; I come from the distinguished Fan Family in Jiangnan, sent abroad for education since I was young, receiving the best educational resources, which shaped me into this young and prominent figure."
Children of affluent families have already distanced themselves from those of the poor, receiving the best educational resources without having to worry about money. The educational barriers wealthy people create are so far out of reach for the poor, let alone the connection and resource barriers; these are unattainable for the poor. Under such conditions, these affluent children are destined to walk the path of elites.
Even the poorest children, if they complete their Masters and Ph.D., without network resources, still find it difficult to rise higher; moreover, with the increasing number of Masters and Ph.D. graduates, competition becomes fierce, and Master’s and Ph.D. degrees lose their value.
Let alone Lin Fan, an undergraduate, even those Master’s graduates who can’t make it, end up delivering food, driving couriers, plenty of them.
Sometimes, it’s not about not working hard, but you’re lacking a wealthy dad compared to a rich family’s child.
A rich family’s child, even if a fool, as long as they have resources and connections, can still occupy a high ground, let alone they have an educational advantage from a young age.
Master Xing has a movie, Master Xing plays a low-level laborer, willing to do any dirty or hard work just to earn money, so his child can attend a prestigious school. This is a typical example, a low-level poor person trying to catch up with the wealthy’s pace through sheer effort, ensuring his child does not lose to the wealthy.
However, such efforts are often wishful thinking.
The wealthy make sure their children enjoy the best educational resources without breaking a sweat, just a matter of spending money; while the poor, if they want the same, have to work hard like the character portrayed by Master Xing, exhausting themselves.
Even if the child really enjoys the same educational resources as the wealthy’s children, after graduation, the child of the poor will never start on the same line as the rich’s; the wealthy’s children, relying on their family’s network and resources, can easily leave the child of the poor far behind.
Clearly, this is something Fan Zheyu is aware of, so when he sees the impoverished Lin Fan, he instinctively shows disdain, a natural superiority from a rich child to a poor one.
From Fan Zheyu’s brief introduction, it’s clear he’s the typical rich kid, with a tone carrying a sense of innate superiority and confidence.
He seemed to think that once he made this self-introduction, no woman in the world could resist his charm.
Because he was too outstanding, indeed too outstanding.
However...
Wei Yue’er listened but didn’t seem shocked, simply replied, "I know, you are the one my brother introduced for matchmaking, you’ve come so soon, didn’t my brother tell you not to come?"
Fan Zheyu said, "Mr. Wei did mention it on the phone, but I was already on my way, so I didn’t turn back. I heard you want to go back to the city, so I thought I’d come to take you back."
Wei Yue’er: "..."
A bit speechless, she agreed to go back just to avoid this person, wanting her peaceful life in the small village preserved, yet this person still came, completely not understanding her intentions.
This person is very confident, also very arrogant.
Fan Zheyu smiled, "Yue’er, I see you’ve packed your luggage, that’s great, let’s get in the car."
Wei Yue’er replied coldly, "Sorry, I’m not getting in your car, you can go back yourself."
Fan Zheyu was a bit surprised, "Why?"
He couldn’t comprehend; Wei Yue’er was his matchmaking partner, wanting to go back to the city for this purpose, and now he’s here with a car, isn’t it perfect? Yet, Wei Yue’er wouldn’t agree to it, why?
Lin Fan said, "She’s taking my car."
Fan Zheyu was stunned, then couldn’t help but laugh, "Yue’er, tell me you’re joking? I heard country folks rarely have cars, especially in desolate areas like this, they usually drive motorcycles or three-wheelers, you’re not thinking of taking this bumpkin’s three-wheeler to the county to catch the bus, are you?"
Wei Yue’er chuckled, "Even if that’s the case, what’s wrong with it?"
Fan Zheyu replied, "Of course there’s a problem, considering our status, how can we let ourselves suffer? You can get back quickly in my sports car, why go through the trouble? We can have a nice talk in the car as well."
Wei Yue’er said, "I’m not familiar enough with you, nothing much to talk about, I’m serious, I hope you respect my choice, or else I think there’s no need for us to continue chatting."
Upon hearing this, Fan Zheyu felt uncomfortable inside, things hadn’t gone as he imagined; Wei Yue’er actually refused to ride in his car, he was so used to women throwing themselves at him, this was quite the adjustment.
"Yue’er, ever since I saw your photo, I was very pleased and think you’ll be a perfect wife, we are practically made for each other, I really hope you feel the same," Fan Zheyu said earnestly.
Poof!
Beside them, Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh.
Fan Zheyu immediately got annoyed, "You bumpkin, what are you laughing at?"

chapters.title: Chapter 659: About to Hit a Nail
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Chapter 659: About to Hit a Nail
"I found it funny, so I laughed, what’s the problem?" Lin Fan retorted, looking calmly at Zhe Yu.
A country bumpkin, showing no fear at all towards him, a wealthy person driving a Ferrari. This left Zhe Yu a bit surprised, and increasingly uncomfortable.
"I’m talking to my fiancée, outsiders shouldn’t interrupt!" Zhe Yu said coldly.
Lin Fan said, "That’s strange, Yue’er, you didn’t even know this person a minute ago, at most just a blind date. Since when did he become your fiancé?"
Wei Yue’er blushed, a bit angry, and said, "Mr. Fan, I hope you understand, I am not your fiancée. If you want to talk to your fiancée, excuse me for not disturbing you."
Zhe Yu chuckled, "Yue’er, don’t be angry, alright, let’s just say I was too abrupt. Can we start over? It’s for your safety; you can feel at ease riding in my car. I just think there’s no need for you to trouble yourself that way."
Wei Yue’er said, "Thank you for your consideration, Mr. Fan, but there’s no need."
Unwillingly, Zhe Yu said, "I really can’t understand? Are you not confident in my character and driving skills? Rest assured, I’m always a gentleman to females, never forcing anyone, and my driving skills are excellent, you can check in the racing circles, I’m a racer."
Wei Yue’er said, "Oh, really? If I don’t want to ride in your car and you’re insisting, doesn’t that count as being forceful?"
"This..." Zhe Yu was momentarily speechless.
Wei Yue’er said, "If you insist, I won’t go back. Besides, I can’t leave the kids here, I never intended to go back."
Zhe Yu laughed, "Yue’er, you have such a kind heart. I’ve heard about your volunteering to teach in the countryside and have a very good impression of you. However, you will surely become a virtuous wife and good mother for the Fan Family. This place is ultimately a backwater, unfit for you. If you like teaching so much, I can introduce you to schools in the city, any school you choose!"
He spoke with much confidence; with the Fan Family’s connections, getting Wei Yue’er a teaching position in the city wasn’t a hard task.
Wei Yue’er said, "No need to trouble yourself, I’m quite happy teaching here."
Zhe Yu smiled wryly, "Yue’er, why put yourself through this? Living in a village and mingling with these low-quality country folks is a disgrace to your status."
Wei Yue’er snorted, "Mr. Fan, have you said enough? If so, kindly leave. I’ll be straightforward; there is no possibility between us. Please save your effort and go back!"
Seeing Wei Yue’er really angry, Zhe Yu chuckled, "Alright, Yue’er, I won’t force you. You’re free to choose whatever car you want to take back, okay?"
Wei Yue’er didn’t respond.
In fact, Wei Yue’er was determined to go back this time. Her purpose wasn’t matchmaking; that was secondary. She hoped to return to figure some things out...
"Mr. Fan, please help yourself. Lin Fan, let’s go."
Ignoring Zhe Yu, Wei Yue’er was ready to leave with Lin Fan.
Zhe Yu noticed Wei Yue’er walking alongside Lin Fan, shoulder to shoulder, seeming somewhat intimate, and was instantly displeased. No way, could it be that Wei Yue’er was involved with this country bumpkin?
Zhe Yu was furious. He was the illustrious Zhe Yu; wasn’t his grand self-introduction enough to demonstrate his prowess? How could he lose to a country bumpkin!
"Hold on!" Zhe Yu called out to the two.
"Mr. Fan, is there anything else?" Wei Yue’er frowned.
Zhe Yu pointed at Lin Fan with his finger and said, "Yue’er, what’s your relation with this country bumpkin? I think it’s below your status to be so close to him."
Wei Yue’er angrily said, "Who I get close to is none of your business! Stop spouting nonsense here!"
Zhe Yu snorted coldly, "Country bumpkin, are you thinking of pursuing Yue’er? You don’t know your place. I advise you to have some self-awareness and stop acting mindlessly!"
Lin Fan shook his head, a bit speechless. This guy had such a superiority complex.
"Did you attend Harvard University?" Lin Fan chuckled and asked.
Zhe Yu coldly replied, "You’re not worthy to mention Harvard University. I don’t think you’ve even been to college, right? You’re the most ignorant of country bumpkins!"
Lin Fan said, "You went to Harvard University and enjoyed the educational resources unreachable by poor kids, but didn’t Harvard teach you manners?"
Zhe Yu said, "I don’t need to be polite to someone like you. You’re just a country bumpkin, look in the mirror and ask yourself if you’re worthy!"
Lin Fan said, "I’m not trying to pursue Yue’er, hope you don’t misunderstand. But now, it seems you don’t need to consider me a rival because Yue’er isn’t interested in you at all. If I were her, I’d look down on you too."
Zhe Yu was enraged, "Country bumpkin, are you still trying to argue! You’re just avoiding confrontation, behaving so I’ll put it this way, I’m willing to have a fair competition, that’s my dignity, and I’ll make you lose with full conviction!"
Lin Fan responded with an "oh": "What competition?"
Zhe Yu said, "I see you’re a country bumpkin who knows nothing, probably haven’t even spent a few days in school! Competing with you in finance would be too easy for me; I see you know nothing, just farming, so let’s do it this way, today I’ll descend to your level, and we’ll compete in strength, how about it?"
Lin Fan laughed, "You want to compete with me in strength?"
Zhe Yu said, "That’s right, because you know nothing. It’s not my fault I look down on you. You’re just a country bumpkin who knows nothing, so I can only compete with you in strength. I believe that’s your advantage, right? I’ll defeat what you’re best at, and what I have, you’ll never have! Kid, do you dare? If not, I suggest staying away from Yue’er, and better not show up again."
Lin Fan nodded, "I accept."
There was no hesitation at all!
Lin Fan’s acceptance was so easy and straightforward that it made Zhe Yu feel a little uneasy, but after thinking about it, Zhe Yu’s face showed a look of disdain.
This country bumpkin had such a misplaced confidence; he didn’t know whom he was messing with!
"Kid, you’re quite straightforward, do you think you’ll definitely win against me? Let me ask you, do you even know what fitness is, country bumpkin? I am a sports enthusiast, a fitness lover, do you think just because you did a lot of farm work and have a brute strength, you can compete with me?"
"I’ll make you lose convincingly and clearly!" Zhe Yu said arrogantly.
He didn’t regard Lin Fan as anything worthy. If Wei Yue’er weren’t present, this country bumpkin would’ve been dealt with a long time ago. Dealing with this country bumpkin now, in front of Wei Yue’er, he wanted to show her there was no comparison between him and this country bumpkin.
At this moment, Wei Yue’er sighed, of all people to provoke, this Zhe Yu is about to hit a wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 660: Punch Me Like This
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Chapter 660: Punch Me Like This
Fan Zheyu was feeling very annoyed. Lin Fan, this bumpkin, actually dared to defy him. Someone he completely looked down on actually dares to talk to him!
But wait!
Wei Yue’er actually sided with this bumpkin. It seems like Wei Yue’er has blended in with these villagers during her time in this small village. Fan Zheyu felt this was inappropriate, it was beneath her status. Only someone like him, a noble young man, was worthy of associating with Wei Yue’er.
He had already planned that after he married Wei Yue’er, he would not allow her to come to such rural places again. Even if Wei Yue’er wanted to be a teacher, she should go to a noble school, only such high-class places matched Wei Yue’er’s status.
The first thing to do now was to get rid of the annoying bumpkin next to Wei Yue’er!
To deal with a bumpkin, Fan Zheyu didn’t even consider it a challenge. In his view, it was too easy.
He studied finance at the United States Harvard University. An outstanding student in finance, he thought if he used his knowledge to deal with Lin Fan, it would be too overwhelming for Lin Fan, so he would defeat Lin Fan in the simplest way possible.
Farmers have brute strength, don’t they? They do labor work. He would compare strength with Lin Fan, defeat Lin Fan in the area where Lin Fan was supposedly skilled. Lin Fan would surely feel frustrated and leave in disgrace!
Lin Fan agreed cheerfully.
"Bumpkin, you’re agreeing so quickly. Do you think you can win against me? I will soon make you regret making this decision!"
Fan Zheyu laughed slyly.
Lin Fan said somewhat speechlessly, "Fine, whatever you want to compete in, just say it. Don’t waste time here."
Fan Zheyu was furious. This bumpkin dared to talk to him like this. Who was he? A favored young man, this bumpkin wasn’t even qualified to carry his shoes!
Fan Zheyu looked around and his gaze fell on two stone lions in front of a nearby house, seemingly weighing around two hundred pounds.
"Bumpkin, let’s compete in weightlifting, see who can pick up this stone lion, how about it?"
Fan Zheyu said, feeling pleased, "I have studied Martial Arts since childhood, never stopped exercising, not only possessing a strong physique but also astounding strength. You bumpkin, overestimating yourself, dare to accept my challenge, you’re simply courting death!"
Lin Fan glanced at the stone lion, shook his head, and said, "Let’s forget this."
What?
Fan Zheyu couldn’t help but burst into laughter, "Hahaha... Kid, are you chickening out!"
"Chickening out is right. You a bumpkin, aren’t worth anything, only capable of doing labor. Now, you don’t even dare to compete in strength with me. What courage do you have to stand here, quickly admit defeat and scram!"
"Yue’er, this useless bumpkin, you should socialize with him less in the future, he simply lowers the standard of high-end people like us."
Wei Yue’er really disliked Fan Zheyu’s lofty and condescending manner, Fan Zheyu’s perspectives were completely out of tune with hers, now she only wished Fan Zheyu would leave quickly.
"Mr. Fan, whatever the result is today, I won’t be leaving with you, so you don’t need to bother anymore." Wei Yue’er said coldly.
Fan Zheyu was angry inside. He cared a lot about Wei Yue’er and was determined to win her over. He thought it wouldn’t be difficult to win Wei Yue’er with his personal charm, but now things had turned out like this.
Fan Zheyu couldn’t vent his anger on Wei Yue’er. After all, he couldn’t tear his face off, so he would vent more on Lin Fan.
"Bumpkin, you don’t dare to compete with me, why don’t you quickly admit defeat, useless thing!" Fan Zheyu pointed at Lin Fan and berated.
Lin Fan said mildly, "I said forget about moving the stone lion, it’s the feng shui stone lion in front of someone’s house, can’t be moved recklessly. Do you understand feng shui? Rural people value these things greatly, disturbing someone’s feng shui is a big taboo, look at your ignorant state."
Fan Zheyu sneered, "Kid, if you don’t want to compete then don’t, so many excuses!"
Lin Fan said, "Forget disturbing someone’s feng shui, if you want to compete, just come over and punch me, if you can make me move a bit, I lose, not falling, not stepping back, if I even budge, I consider myself lost."
Lin Fan pointed at his chest as he spoke.
Fan Zheyu would come over and punch his chest, causing him to move meant losing.
What is being bold, this is being bold!
Didn’t Fan Zheyu think Lin Fan was chickening out? Lin Fan would show him what truly being bold meant.
Fan Zheyu was taken aback; he had just ridiculed Lin Fan for chickening out. Was this chickening out!
"Brat, who are you insulting, if I punch you, why can’t I move you, you really don’t know the limits, no, you simply don’t know life and death!" Fan Zheyu said furiously.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Then talk less, come on!"
Fan Zheyu hated it, absolutely wanting to go up and punch Lin Fan, to teach this brat a lesson, but then Fan Zheyu thought.
"Bumpkin, you think I don’t know, you want me to hit you and then extort me, asking for money, I saw domestic news, you rural folks have low quality, love these tricks of extortion!" Fan Zheyu acted as if he saw through Lin Fan.
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "Yue’er, let’s go, no need to waste time with this fool."
Wei Yue’er nodded, "I said this long ago."
Saying this, Lin Fan and Wei Yue’er planned to turn and leave.
"Wait!"
Fan Zheyu stopped Lin Fan, if Lin Fan just walked away like this, he couldn’t assert his authority. He had to defeat Lin Fan, make Lin Fan sincerely admit defeat, let Wei Yue’er see his prowess, only he was worthy to be Wei Yue’er’s man!
"Let’s do it!" Fan Zheyu said, deciding to accept Lin Fan’s proposal for the competition.
Lin Fan chuckled and said, "Aren’t you afraid I’ll extort you?"
Fan Zheyu said, "What am I, someone like you bumpkin can’t extort me, I will make you lose convincingly, even if you extort, that will be your loss! Moreover, I will ensure to win without injuring you, with my ability, this competition is entirely under my control!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Is that so, fine, less talk, come over. Yue’er, step aside a little."
Wei Yue’er moved to the side as instructed, she wasn’t concerned about Lin Fan, just watching like it’s a show, this was Fan Zheyu humiliating himself, he couldn’t blame anyone.
Fan Zheyu clenched his fist, moving toward Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan, you listen to me, this bumpkin, with one punch, it’s as a warning, stay away from Yue’er! You don’t know who she is, you bumpkin are worthy to walk alongside her? Only I am worthy!"
Fan Zheyu said, raising his fist, he punched at Lin Fan’s chest.
In Fan Zheyu’s anticipation, this punch should at least make Lin Fan scream and fall to the ground.
However, with a thud, Fan Zheyu felt his fist hit a steel plate.
"Ah!"
A cry of pain echoed between heaven and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: Lin Fan Shows Off His Perfect Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Chapter 661: Lin Fan Shows Off His Perfect Body
The commotion here had already drawn a crowd of curious villagers.
Over the past few days, Lin Fan had given this small mountain village too much shock. First, Lin Fan displayed amazing medical skills. Since returning, he had used his skills to help many villagers cure their illnesses. Some difficult and complicated diseases were cured immediately with medicine, and the name of Lin Fan as a miracle healer spread quickly. From miles around, people came to seek treatment, including high-ranking officials and dignitaries. This was the first shock Lin Fan gave the villagers.
Then, Lin Fan’s identity as the richest man in Yun City was revealed, which was even more shocking to the villagers. In their small mountain village, there appeared a tycoon, which was simply earth-shattering. For a time, the legend of Mr. Lin spread throughout the area.
It can be said that Lin Fan’s every move attracts the attention of the villagers.
Now, a Rich Second Generation had come to the village, seemingly to compete with Lin Fan. Upon hearing this news, many curious villagers rushed over to watch.
"This guy looks very strong. I wonder if Lin Fan is a match for him?"
"Lin Fan may have money, but that doesn’t mean he’s good at fighting. I think it’s a long shot!"
"I don’t know what he’s thinking, actually letting the other guy hit him!"
The villagers whispered among themselves, not daring to speak too loudly, fearing Lin Fan would hear. Now that they knew Lin Fan’s identity, they were apprehensive and didn’t dare to offend him easily.
Everyone had witnessed Chen Hai’s fate for offending Lin Fan. He was publicly fired by his boss at his own wedding, which was really embarrassing.
Chen Datou, who was once proud of Chen Hai, used to walk with his back straight, chest out, and nose up. Now, Chen Datou could no longer keep his head held high because compared to Lin Fan, Chen Hai was nothing.
Now, Chen Datou walked with his head drooped, avoiding people as if he wished to hide away.
This was the consequence of offending Lin Fan.
Lin Fan still heard the villagers’ discussions, of course, but he didn’t have time to bother with such gossip.
Next, under everyone’s watchful eyes, Fan Zheyu threw a punch, hitting Lin Fan on the chest.
"Ah!"
A scream echoed throughout the area.
Was that Lin Fan screaming?
How pitiful for Lin Fan, being beaten to a scream!
Everyone said Lin Fan shouldn’t have done it. Wasn’t this self-inflicted pain?
Huh?
Wait a minute!
The villagers suddenly all froze.
The one screaming wasn’t Lin Fan; it was Fan Zheyu!
Oh my god, what’s going on here?
Could it be that Lin Fan, besides being a miracle healer, a tycoon, has another surprise?
Fan Zheyu was shaking his hand uncontrollably, grimacing in pain, as if the punch he just threw wasn’t on Lin Fan’s chest but on an iron plate.
A punch on an iron plate naturally meant suffering for the fist. There’s nothing good about it. No one’s fist can withstand an iron plate, no matter how powerful they are; even a champion wouldn’t foolishly aim for an iron plate.
As Fan Zheyu jumped around like a monkey because of the pain after the punch, Lin Fan didn’t even flinch, standing like a rock, unaffected!
"You lost."
Lin Fan said casually.
He had said if Fan Zheyu’s punch could even shake him slightly, he would concede defeat. But Fan Zheyu obviously failed to move him and hurt his own hand instead.
Luckily, Fan Zheyu didn’t use full strength for fear of injuring Lin Fan, so the damage wasn’t too severe.
Fan Zheyu exclaimed angrily, "You cheated!"
Lin Fan replied, "Cheated?"
Fan Zheyu said, "Now I understand why you let me hit you. It’s because you cheated. You had a steel plate hidden on your chest, didn’t you? You damn hillbilly, you tricked me!"
Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh and said, "First of all, I didn’t even know you wanted to compete with me, so how could I have hidden a steel plate in advance? Do you think I can predict the future and knew you would challenge me today, so I tied a steel plate to my chest beforehand?"
Even Fan Zheyu found Lin Fan’s words reasonable, momentarily speechless but stubbornly said, "How would I know, maybe you coincidentally had a steel plate tied there!"
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "It seems I have no choice but to prove my innocence."
With that, Lin Fan reached out and took off his shirt, revealing his upper body, a solid chest, and abs with perfect lines, simply an ideal physique, the legendary type that’s slender with clothes on and muscular when bare!
Lin Fan’s physique was perfect, not the exaggerated build of a muscle man, but healthy and beautifully proportioned with no excess fat, very pleasing to the eye.
"Ah!"
Nearby, Wei Yue’er’s face instantly turned red upon seeing this, but her eyes couldn’t leave Lin Fan. Even though she felt shy, she couldn’t help but want to look more.
What a great body!
Actually, it’s not just men who like to sneak peeks at women; females also like to sneak glances at men, especially guys like Lin Fan, who make girls drool!
Wei Yue’er was captivated by Lin Fan.
"Do you see any steel plates?" Lin Fan said with a smile.
Even Fan Zheyu felt a bit envious looking at Lin Fan’s physique. Who would’ve thought that a hillbilly would have such a good body? This is the kind of physique every man dreams of having; achieving it is extremely challenging.
No one knows how this hillbilly Lin Fan managed to build it!
"You must’ve sneaked it away while I wasn’t looking!" said Fan Zheyu. Of course, he wasn’t willing to admit he was wrong easily.
Lin Fan chuckled, "Thanks for thinking so highly of me, huh? I must be a magician then, able to make a steel plate disappear right under everyone’s noses."
These words were full of mockery, mocking Fan Zheyu for being blind.
Fan Zheyu, his face blushing, stubbornly said, "In any case, there was definitely something fishy with that punch, or else my hand wouldn’t hurt so much. I don’t know what trick you hillbilly used, but that punch doesn’t count!"
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," saying, "It doesn’t count, huh? Alright, doesn’t matter to me. Want to try punching again? This time I’m not wearing a shirt, so you can’t say I have a steel plate hidden."
Fan Zheyu looked around.
Everyone started making comments and pointing fingers.
"Lin Fan’s right. This time, without a shirt, he can’t claim there’s something fishy!"
"Let’s see if he dares to punch!"
"Don’t chicken out, go for it!"
The villagers started egging on.
If Fan Zheyu chickened out now, he’d lose face completely.
Fan Zheyu sneered coldly, "You damn hillbilly, don’t get cocky. I only used fifty percent of my strength with that punch earlier, afraid of injuring you. Who knew you’d be such a wretch and cheat? This time, I won’t hold back. It’s time to teach you a lesson!"
With that, Fan Zheyu raised his fist, ready to punch Lin Fan.
"Wait a minute!"
Fan Zheyu suddenly stopped and took off his shirt.
"Hillbilly, your physique from doing farm work is nothing compared to someone who’ve been working out regularly. Let me show you what a real body looks like!"
Fan Zheyu removed his shirt, revealing a strong body with an impressive eight-pack!
It’s undeniable that Fan Zheyu’s physique is quite impressive, but compared to Lin Fan, it feels lacking somehow. Wei Yue’er glanced at it but quickly lost interest, locking her gaze back on Lin Fan.
Fan Zheyu was very proud, thinking he could impress Wei Yue’er by showing off his physique, but he saw that Wei Yue’er didn’t even look his way, her eyes fixed on Lin Fan instead.
Fan Zheyu was so enraged he nearly spat out blood, fury building in his heart, "Hillbilly, go to hell!"
He threw a punch towards Lin Fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 662: New Reward, Top Investment Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Chapter 662: New Reward, Top Investment Master
This time, Fan Zheyu used all his strength, punching Lin Fan squarely in the chest. In his fury, he didn’t care about anything else; he just wanted to teach Lin Fan a lesson, to make him suffer.
Bang!
Fan Zheyu’s punch landed solidly on Lin Fan’s chest, and this time Lin Fan was bare-chested, with no cover, clearly visible, definitely not hiding any steel plates or such.
"Ah!"
Once again, a heartrending scream echoed through the heavens and earth.
Last time, the spectators somewhat suspected that Lin Fan might have been hiding a steel plate. It didn’t make sense; how could the one punching be the one screaming while the one being punched seemed completely fine? It defied logic.
This time, seeing Lin Fan without cover, the crowd thought it would surely be Lin Fan’s turn to be out of luck, right?
However...
The one screaming in agony again turned out to be Fan Zheyu. Moreover, since he used all his strength this time, it seems his hand bones had fractured, causing cold sweat to pour and his whole body to tremble, involuntarily kneeling on the ground.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
Oh my, it’s confirmed this time. Lin Fan wasn’t hiding steel plates; his chest itself was like a steel plate!
What on earth is going on here?
"Is this the legendary Golden Bell Shield and Iron Cloth Shirt?"
One villager exclaimed instinctively, seemingly a martial arts fan, as he thought of the classic martial arts skill the moment he saw how formidable Lin Fan was.
Golden Bell Shield and Iron Cloth Shirt, once mastered, makes muscles and bones like iron, the body impervious to blades and guns.
"What?"
Everyone was shocked. Had Lin Fan really mastered the legendary Golden Bell Shield and Iron Cloth Shirt?
This is too amazing. Could the legend be true, that there’s really such a powerful martial art?
They naturally didn’t know that Lin Fan had acquired the system’s Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, and the toughness of his body was beyond the mere Golden Bell Shield and Iron Cloth Shirt!
If Lin Fan wanted to, Fan Zheyu’s hand would be ruined; he’s already been lenient, not shattering Fan Zheyu’s hand. And Lin Fan certainly wasn’t pitying Fan Zheyu, he just hoped this guy would keep his hand to drive away, or else he would remain stuck in the village.
"So, can you admit I’m innocent now? I wasn’t hiding any steel plate; it’s purely because you are too weak."
Lin Fan smiled as he spoke, while putting on his clothes.
The nearby Wei Yue’er, watching Lin Fan put on his clothes, really wished she could run over and stop Lin Fan, strip Lin Fan naked; she hadn’t had enough of the view yet.
"Yue’er, let’s go, Yue’er?" Lin Fan turned to Wei Yue’er and said.
Wei Yue’er snapped back to reality, her face flushed. Had she just lost her composure? She couldn’t help it; she’d been attracted to Lin Fan’s beautiful body, but she hadn’t meant to...
"Uh, let’s, let’s go!" Wei Yue’er quickly said, her heart still pounding rapidly.
Lin Fan hadn’t expected his physique would make Wei Yue’er drool. His initial intention was simply to prove his innocence.
"You, you stop right there!"
Fan Zheyu called out to Lin Fan.
"How did you train that muscle of yours?"
Fan Zheyu was utterly shocked, a shock that had surpassed the pain in his hand. He was very curious, eager to know about Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Is that important? Even if I tell you, you can’t train like this. All you need to know is that you’ve lost, so you better beat it quickly."
With those words, Lin Fan didn’t plan to pay any more attention to Fan Zheyu.
Fan Zheyu felt unwilling! How could he have lost to a country bumpkin? He, the great Fan Zheyu, could not have lost to a mere bumpkin!
"Lin Fan, what’s the use of having brute strength! You can only use it for farm work. In modern society, it’s brains that count, only the brain is the greatest wealth. My brain is packed with financial knowledge from Harvard University. Through this, the money I earn in a day might be something you can never achieve in your lifetime! I lost? Hahaha... What a joke, in the battleground of life, the winner is always me; you are the useless garbage, the dead broke loser!"
Fan Zheyu said loudly.
Since he couldn’t defeat Lin Fan physically, he aimed to use his profession to humiliate Lin Fan.
After all, Lin Fan the country bumpkin knew nothing except for his brute force. When it came to money-making capabilities, he could absolutely dominate Lin Fan the bumpkin.
These words caused everyone to fall silent.
Lin Fan remained silent too.
The crowd’s silence was because they all knew Lin Fan was the richest man in Yun City. Who gave this young man the courage to compete in wealth with the richest man in Yun City?
Could he be richer than Lin Fan!
Lin Fan’s silence was due to a sudden reminder from the system in his mind.
"Ding!"
"System reminder: Today’s sign-in is available. Would you like to sign in now?"
Unexpectedly, today’s sign-in arrived at this moment. Lin Fan casually said in his mind, "Sign in."
Lin Fan’s casual attitude stemmed from the fact that he was used to the system’s daily reward of 5 million cash.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations host, sign-in successful. Reward: A set of top-notch investment expert skills. Once you receive the rewards, you will become a top investment expert. Would you like to accept?"
"Hmm?"
Lin Fan was taken aback; today the system wasn’t giving away the usual 5 million cash but this top-notch investment expert set of skills. What’s going on?
Was it trying to make him a top investment expert!
With these skills, wouldn’t he be invincible in the capital markets?
Previously, Lin Fan had made numerous successful investments, such as purchasing Chiba Island, which was a hugely successful investment: bought for 6 billion, now Chiba Island’s market value has risen to 10 billion.
Or holding majority shares in Celestial Aviation, reorganizing Mortal Group; Mortal Group has already reached a market value of 200 billion.
But those successes were mostly due to the system’s arrangements.
Going forward, with these top-notch investment skills, he would no longer need to rely on the system’s arrangements. With these skills, he could dominate capital markets, overturn tidal waves in the game of capital!
A world-shaking investment master is about to be born, soon to astonish the world!
"Accept!"
Lin Fan agreed in his heart.
An influx of data surged crazily into Lin Fan’s mind!
"Acceptance complete, congratulations host, you have become a top-notch investment expert. The host is advised to hide this power to avoid causing a global shake-up."
For the first time, the system gave the host a very serious warning.
It seems the skills Lin Fan acquired this time were indeed terrifying, even the system feared they might cause drastic changes to the world, whether for the better or for chaos, all influenced by Lin Fan’s mood.
Ability, as such, is neutral, neither praised nor condemned. But utilizing superpower for evil, like Thanos, makes one a supervillain; utilizing it to save the world, like Superman, makes one a superhero.
Will Lin Fan be Superman, or Thanos?
The choice is all Lin Fan’s.
Originally, Lin Fan wasn’t a graduate in finance, comparing financial knowledge with Fan Zheyu would be asking for trouble.
But the moment the data influx was completed, Lin Fan looking at Fan Zheyu was like a giant overlooking a mortal; Fan Zheyu, the Harvard University finance graduate, suddenly seemed so small, so ignorant, so shallow!

chapters.title: Chapter 663 A Simple Calculation Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Chapter 663 A Simple Calculation Problem
"Hahaha..."
Fan Zheyu saw Lin Fan silent and thought Lin Fan was at a loss for words, feeling very smug again.
"Country bumpkin, you probably don’t even know what a finance department is. Talking to you about financial knowledge is downright bullying. But that’s the reality, you have to accept it. You’re a dead broke country bumpkin. The money you earn in your lifetime isn’t enough for me to buy a car. Tell me, what qualifications do you have to compete with me, what qualifications do you have to fight with me for a woman!"
Fan Zheyu laughed, trying to belittle Lin Fan.
He originally thought that with his robust physique, he could easily knock Lin Fan down with force, but he ended up suffering a big loss.
He was careless, not expecting this country bumpkin to be so strong.
This time, it was foolproof. If a punch couldn’t defeat Lin Fan, surely money could crush him, right? He graduated from the finance department of Harvard University, dealing with a country bumpkin was indeed easy, almost felt a bit unfair and lacking in style.
However, to win against Lin Fan, he didn’t care about style anymore.
Wei Yue’er was a bit angry and also somewhat contemptuous of Fan Zheyu. Didn’t he say he wouldn’t compete with Lin Fan on financial knowledge? He lost in force, and then went back on his word. It was such a slap in the face, and too shameless!
"Mr. Fan, you’re too shameless. Didn’t you say earlier that you’d only compete with Lin Fan in force? Aren’t you embarrassed to go back on your word?"
Wei Yue’er couldn’t help but speak.
Fan Zheyu chuckled, "I just want this country bumpkin to face the reality. He has brute force but will never be able to compare to me. I’m standing on a high ground he’ll never reach; he can only gaze up at me. A country bumpkin from the countryside, what right does he have to compete with a promising student like me!"
"Yue’er, I also want you to face reality. He’s a poor country bumpkin, he’s not worthy of you. There’s no possibility between you two. Only I am worthy of you. You should recognize your own position, reduce your interactions with these poor folks, you’ll lower your own class! At this time, you shouldn’t be in such a rural place, you should be in a villa, lying by the pool, enjoying coffee and afternoon tea, admiring the magnificent sea view. That’s the life we rich people should be living!"
Wei Yue’er felt very disgusted and coldly said, "What kind of life I lead and what choices I make regarding my life is my own matter. You have no right to point fingers."
She hated when others tried to dictate to her, telling her what’s right or wrong. She wasn’t a three-year-old child, she didn’t need others to arrange her life.
This Fan Zheyu, a self-absorbed egotist, was presuming to arrange her life. It was so annoying.
Fan Zheyu laughed lightly and said, "No problem, after we get married, you will gradually change your mind. You will eventually agree with me."
Fan Zheyu’s tone was filled with confidence.
Wei Yue’er snorted, "Fan Zheyu, rest assured, we’re not the same kind of people. It’s impossible for me to marry you. Even if I really marry a poor man, it would be my own choice, nothing to do with you. What’s more, you have no idea what kind of person you’ve provoked."
Fan Zheyu seemed not to pay attention to the latter part of Wei Yue’er’s words, only hearing the first part, and said with a smile, "Don’t speak too soon. Families like ours care about matching social status. Across Jiangnan, I don’t believe there’s anyone more suitable to be your husband than me. I trust your brother thinks the same. You must understand, sometimes for people like us, marriage is not fully within our control."
In some wealthy families, the marriage of children is not necessarily more free than regular families. Regular people can freely choose who to love, while for the wealthy, marriage might not be as simple as merely tying the knot.
Like the daughters of ancient emperors, even as noble princesses, they did not have freedom in marriage. Often, they were used as diplomatic tools and married off far away.
Even in a second-rate family like the Su Family, Su Jinjin almost had to marry into the Li Family, as a pawn for the marriage alliance between the Su and Li Families. Luckily, Su Jinjin met Lin Fan, staging a spectacular escapade from marriage.
Wei Yue’er sneered, "Fan Zheyu, are you showing off?"
Fan Zheyu chuckled, "Think whatever you like, I’m just stating the truth. Country bumpkin, I advise you to have some self-awareness, and don’t provoke Yue’er. She’s beyond your reach, I’m afraid you can’t bear the consequences! You, coming from the countryside, should find a simple countryside girl. City girls, are they even within your reach!"
Fan Zheyu was very smug. If he couldn’t compete with Lin Fan physically, he would compete in family background, wealth, and knowledge. In these areas, he overwhelmingly triumphed over Lin Fan, leaving Lin Fan with no chance of countering.
Just when Fan Zheyu was feeling pleased with himself.
"Did you say you’re a graduate of Harvard University’s finance department?"
Lin Fan suddenly asked out of the blue.
Fan Zheyu sneered and said, "Country bumpkin, you probably haven’t even left Tianhai. I studied in the United States, and you, a country bumpkin, mentioning Harvard only taints Harvard’s name."
Lin Fan smiled, "From my understanding, Harvard is indeed a good university, but it’s just so-so, not top-tier. After all, they have people like you, an idiot. Oh, maybe Harvard isn’t bad, it’s just you’re too bad, disgracing Harvard."
Fan Zheyu’s face darkened, and he shouted angrily, "Stupid country bumpkin, what are you saying?"
Then, he seemed to realize something, chuckled coldly, "You stupid country bumpkin, can only boast with words, what do you know!"
Lin Fan said, "You’re a graduate from Harvard University’s finance department and you’re working in an investment bank. So I’ll ask you a simple calculation question. Here we have about twenty villagers, keep in mind they are all currently destitute. I’ll give you one million in funds, how would you make them all millionaires within a day?"
There were twenty villagers, and funds were only one million, yet they were to become millionaires within a day, which was simply impossible!
Dividing the one million would only mean each person gets 50,000!
This is the most basic thinking of ordinary people.
Whereas investment thinking would be to find a way to turn one million into twenty million, so the twenty villagers would get an average of one million each, solving the problem.
Then the question becomes how to turn one million into twenty million within a day, a net profit of nineteen million?
Fan Zheyu snorted, "Lin Fan, that question is foolish. Turning one million into twenty million within a day—how could there be such a good thing in this world? If that were possible, there wouldn’t be any poor people in the world. Your question is simply unrealistic!"
Lin Fan smiled, "Is that so, what if I say I can do it?"
Fan Zheyu laughed, "Hahaha... what a big joke. That’s the funniest joke I’ve heard this year. Putting everything else aside, Lin Fan, you country bumpkin, where would you get one million? You probably don’t even have a hundred bucks on you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 664: Where Did You Get 1 Million From?
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Chapter 664: Where Did You Get 1 Million From?
Fan Zheyu felt Lin Fan was too ignorant. Only someone completely oblivious to finance would say something like Lin Fan did.
Turning a base of 1 million into 20 million in one day, who could do that! According to Fan Zheyu’s understanding, no one in this world could achieve that.
Turning 1 million into 20 million isn’t really that hard. Anyone who understands investing knows how to make money using leverage. To put it bluntly, it’s making money by borrowing money. Simply put, you first invest using the principal, sell when the market value rises, then purchase larger assets through loans, and sell again after they appreciate. By continually utilizing leverage like this, turning a starting capital of 1 million into 20 million is not difficult.
The target of this investment is not limited; it could be in real estate, the stock market, or anything that can be legally bought and sold.
The hard part is that this operation requires time; it’s impossible to achieve in one day. As the saying goes, "Rome wasn’t built in a day."
Lin Fan wants to multiply his capital by 20 times in one day, which is extremely difficult.
Unless...
You possess top-tier investment skills that surpass the current world ceiling!
But in Fan Zheyu’s knowledge, even the most badass investing masters in the world today couldn’t do it.
"Lin Fan, you are too ignorant!" Fan Zheyu mocked Lin Fan, saying only an investing novice would say such ignorant things as Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Just because you can’t do it doesn’t mean others can’t either."
Fan Zheyu snorted, "Hillbilly, at least I am a top student from the finance department at Harvard University. Who are you? Can you be more knowledgeable than I am?"
Lin Fan replied, "What if I told you, I actually am more knowledgeable than you?"
Fan Zheyu laughed angrily, "Hillbilly talking nonsense. I admit you have more strength than me, but you actually dare to compare investments with me? You are truly overconfident and ignorant. Fine, I’ll treat it as a joke then. Tell me, who can achieve it in a day?"
Lin Fan pointed at himself and said, "Me."
What?
Fan Zheyu was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter, thinking he had heard the biggest joke ever.
Lin Fan took out his phone and checked the time and said, "It is now 9:28 AM, and in two minutes, the stock market will open. Keep your eye on the Growth Enterprise Market. Now that the restrictions on the Growth Enterprise Market have been lifted, new stocks are not capped. If you want to witness a wealth myth, pay attention to a certain new stock that appears today. Don’t hesitate with your capital; throw it all in. By this time tomorrow, your million will become tens of millions."
Fan Zheyu, who had been laughing, suddenly found it hard to laugh at these words.
"A new stock?"
Fan Zheyu murmured. If Lin Fan were just an investment novice, he wouldn’t have been able to say such a thing; his words were actually quite convincing.
"Hillbilly, what do you know about investment? What new stock? Just name it!" Fan Zheyu sneered.
Lin Fan smiled faintly, "If I said it, wouldn’t everyone have the chance to increase by 20 times? You’ll find out at three o’clock this afternoon."
Fan Zheyu snorted, then took out his phone and made a call: "Check which new stocks are on the Growth Enterprise Market, keep an eye on their trends, and if there is a significant rise, report to me immediately."
Two minutes quickly passed.
At 9:30, the stock market officially opened.
Today, there are 18 new stocks on the Growth Enterprise Market. Which one is the super new stock that Lin Fan mentioned?
Fan Zheyu was on the phone with his assistant, keeping an eye on the new stocks’ trends.
"Lisen New Energy opened with a 3-point rise and is currently the best-performing new stock. Xiaxing Technology opened with a 1-point rise; it’s stable and follows closely behind. Meanwhile, Kangtai Biological Pharmaceutical opened with a decline..."
After listening to a round, Fan Zheyu closed his phone.
"Ridiculous, hillbilly, you are too ridiculous. With today’s market, you tell me there’s a super new stock that can increase by 20 times? You don’t need a finance major from Harvard University to judge; any freshman in a mediocre university would know how absurd this is. As expected of a hillbilly, with no knowledge at all!"
Fan Zheyu taunted.
Lin Fan said, "Instead of wasting time talking nonsense here, you’d better reconsider, or rather, you, a graduate from Harvard, won’t be much better than a freshman from a mediocre university."
Fan Zheyu snorted, "Lin Fan, do you know what a ’folk scientist’ is?"
Lin Fan replied, "I know it’s a derogatory term."
Fan Zheyu said, "You do know it’s a derogatory term. Aren’t you just a folk scientist!"
The term "folk scientist," short for "folk science enthusiast," is a term filled with sarcasm. It differentiates from professional scholars, who acquire professional knowledge through official education and become professionals. On the other hand, folk scientists can’t receive systematic education and must rely on self-learning for knowledge, often leading to fragmented and disorganized knowledge.
Still, folk scientists boast with unshakable confidence, as if they were gods in their fields.
However, what they express is full of loopholes from a professional perspective, practically a joke.
For instance, a folk scientist in military matters talks on and on about international situations, as if they are a world-class strategic master. It’s a great waste that the country doesn’t ask him to lead the army, navy, and air force.
However, to real military experts, these folk scientists’ views are unrealistic, just empty talk that can’t be put into real practice.
Now Fan Zheyu, a top student in finance at Harvard University, was calling Lin Fan a folk scientist, mocking him as amateur and unrealistic.
Lin Fan was not bothered by his sarcasm and smiled slightly, "Top student, you can keep on arguing here. While you were chatting on the phone, I already invested a million in the market. Let’s just wait for the result."
Fan Zheyu laughed out loud, "Hillbilly, who are you fooling? For someone like you, having a hundred bucks would be great. Where did you get a million to buy stocks? It’s ridiculous!"
Wei Yue’er said, "Mr. Fan, in insulting Lin Fan, you’re insulting me too. I personally watched Lin Fan buy, could there be a mistake?"
Fan Zheyu stopped laughing, getting annoyed, "Yue’er, you actually lent money to this hillbilly. That was a million; you lent him to buy stocks, was just like throwing it into the sea. You taking sides with this hillbilly really disappoints me!"
Wei Yue’er replied with a sweat drop, "What nonsense are you talking? I don’t even have a million to lend him, it’s all his own money, just a mere million. Does Lin Fan need to borrow from anyone?"
Wei Yue’er looked at Fan Zheyu, her face practically screaming, "Look at how clueless you are."
Fan Zheyu said, "What, this hillbilly can casually put up a million to buy stocks, how is that possible?"
Wei Yue’er said, "Are you saying that the richest man in Yun City can’t even come up with a million to buy stocks?"
What?
Fan Zheyu was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 665: A Homeless Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Chapter 665: A Homeless Dog
What? Yun City’s wealthiest?
Fan Zheyu froze, gazing up at Lin Fan in shock. Wei Yue’er just said, what, Lin Fan is Yun City’s wealthiest?
"Are you kidding, Yue’er? Don’t joke around here. This country bumpkin, how could he be Yun City’s wealthiest? Even if you don’t fancy me, you don’t have to try to scare me like this!" Fan Zheyu chuckled.
He had been calling Lin Fan a country bumpkin and a poor ghost for some time now. If Lin Fan were truly Yun City’s wealthiest, then he’d be super embarrassed.
Wei Yue’er said, "Why would I lie to you? If you don’t believe it, you can ask the villagers around you. They all know."
The villagers watching nodded in agreement.
Fan Zheyu saw this, and laughed angrily, "Alright, you country bumpkins, did you all band together to mess with me? A group of poor ghosts, of course, you’re all from his village, you’d gang up against an outsider like me!"
The villagers shook their heads again, denying Fan Zheyu’s words.
Fan Zheyu suddenly had an idea, looked at Lin Fan, and chuckled, "Country bumpkin, today I’ll show you what money can do—it’s like a devil making a deal!"
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh," "What did you say?"
Fan Zheyu took out his wallet. A real leather wallet, anyone who knew their stuff would recognize it right away. Just this wallet alone costs at least over ten thousand yuan—truly the mark of a wealthy man.
Fan Zheyu opened his wallet, a wad of red bills inside—really enticing. Several tens of thousands!
A wealthy man is indeed different. Randomly carrying tens of thousands of cash, the villagers watching had never seen so much money. Their eyes were all wide.
Fan Zheyu leisurely drew a red bill from the wallet.
Then he pointed at an older lady with his finger.
"Auntie, come out, don’t just stare. I’m talking about you. Talk to me honestly, and this 100 yuan is yours. Tell me, is Lin Fan Yun City’s wealthiest?" Fan Zheyu said.
Auntie said, "Yes."
Fan Zheyu was at a loss, damn it, can’t even buy off this auntie for a hundred yuan.
"Next one!" Fan Zheyu said angrily.
Auntie held out her hand, "You said you’d give me a hundred for speaking honestly, hand over the hundred yuan."
Fan Zheyu said, "Damn, is that the truth? Get out of here."
Auntie wasn’t happy, but didn’t dare argue with Fan Zheyu, and could only curse under her breath, "Crazy!"
Fan Zheyu pointed at an elderly man and said, "Old man, you tell me. Considering your age, you wouldn’t lie, right? At such an age, you should keep some morals. Tell me, is Lin Fan Yun City’s wealthiest? Tell me the truth, I’ll give you 300! Looking at your outfit, things must be difficult at home. I’ll give you a chance to earn 300 yuan!"
The old man, not only old but quite sharp, clearly learned from the auntie’s experience, said, "Give me the money first, then I’ll tell you the truth."
Just 300 yuan, Fan Zheyu didn’t hesitate and handed three red bills to the old man.
"Old man, you can speak now."
The old man clutched the three red bills, quite pleased, and said, "Young man, I’ve never lied in my life. You can ask around everywhere if Old Chen has ever deceived anyone."
The villagers nodded in agreement. Uncle Chen might not have much ability, but he had a great reputation and was known for his integrity.
Fan Zheyu said, "Alright, old man, just say it!"
The old man said, "This kid Lin Fan indeed is Yun City’s wealthiest. At first, I didn’t believe it either, but yesterday the city party secretary and the mayor came, and personally verified it."
Fan Zheyu was stunned; the old man sounded pretty convincing, then angrily said, "Damn, you’re cheating me out of my money!"
