The old man protested, "I told you I don’t lie, I earned this 300 yuan fairly, don’t sully my reputation young chap."
Fan Zheyu fumed but wasn’t about to snatch away the old man’s 300 yuan, so he pointed at a young fellow: "You, tell me the truth, I’ll give you ten thousand yuan!"
Everyone gasped!
What a generous offer, ten thousand yuan!
The young fellow, as if he hit the jackpot, quickly agreed.
Fan Zheyu mentally chuckled; the previous 100 yuan, 300 yuan amounts were evidently too little, couldn’t bribe these villagers. This time he went all out, ten thousand yuan, he didn’t believe the villagers would continue lying!
"Tell me, is Lin Fan Yun City’s wealthiest?" Fan Zheyu said.
The young fellow, without thinking, nodded, "Yes, Brother Fan, he is Yun City’s wealthiest."
Fan Zheyu almost coughed up blood, damn, still the same answer, does this young fellow not want to earn even ten thousand yuan!
After speaking, seeing that Fan Zheyu didn’t intend to give him money, the young fellow’s smile disappeared: "Hey, I told you the truth, hand over the money?"
This is not just 100 yuan or 300 yuan but ten thousand yuan. Working out of town, it’s three months’ wages. This money can’t just be forgotten; we agreed on this, it’s what he’s owed.
Fan Zheyu angrily said, "You still want money!"
The young fellow got angry too, "Damn, you’re trying to swindle me now, huh? You don’t even realize where you are; fellows, this brute’s playing tricks, beat him!"
The young fellow led the charge toward Fan Zheyu, followed by some sturdy lads and other villagers who had long been disgruntled with this Fan Zheyu. All swarmed toward him.
Though Fan Zheyu had learned martial arts, could handle one young fellow easily, with so many rushing at him, he couldn’t cope. After taking several punches and kicks, he finally couldn’t stand it anymore and fled.
The crowd gave chase.
Fan Zheyu hurriedly grabbed some money and threw it down, saying, "You wretched commoners, poor ghosts, I’ll leave this money as alms for beggars!"
The young fellow angrily said, "Damn, this guy’s mouth is too dirty, can’t help but hit him!"
The villagers were furious; Fan Zheyu had already incited a general outrage. Despite giving the money, they continued to chase, determined to give Fan Zheyu a beating.
Fan Zheyu feared to stay any longer, like a stray dog, fled hastily, quickly retreating to his car, started it, and escaped swiftly.
Bam!
The young fellow couldn’t catch Fan Zheyu, picked up a brick from the ground, threw it over, smashing the rear light of the five-million-yuan Ferrari sports car.
Hearing the light shatter, Fan Zheyu almost cried, damn it, the repair costs alone will be hundreds of thousands, such a huge loss this time, but he dared not stop to investigate and instead pressed the gas pedal.
In a flash, the sports car sped into the distance, Fan Zheyu didn’t dare look back.
On the ground, all that remained was the shattered light of the Ferrari sports car.
Seeing this ridiculous scene, Lin Fan couldn’t help but laugh. He hadn’t done anything at all; this Fan Zheyu really brought it upon himself, came up with such a lousy idea, made a mess of things.
Just timely, Lin Fan wanted to send Fan Zheyu away; this saved him the effort.
Meanwhile, Fan Zheyu fled hurriedly, not daring to stop for a moment, cursed angrily as he drove out of West River Village, initially thinking about repairing the car, but realized a place like Tianhai City wouldn’t be able to fix a luxury car, so he sped back directly to Jiangnan.
At three in the afternoon, Fan Zheyu suddenly remembered something, opened his phone, and checked the stock market.
Suddenly, Fan Zheyu was stunned!
The stock market closed, today, a new stock on the GEM board—Taikang Biopharmaceutical—actually skyrocketed twentyfold!
One million turned into twenty million!
Lin Fan was actually right!
Oh my god!
Fan Zheyu, like a madman, hurriedly picked up his phone and started investigating, the investigation target was Yun City’s wealthiest.
Finally, a picture appeared before Fan Zheyu’s eyes, and strikingly, it was Lin Fan!
Fan Zheyu was instantly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 666: I Haven’t Experienced This Kind of Trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Chapter 666: I Haven’t Experienced This Kind of Trouble
A panting sound echoed on the village path.
Liu Zixing hurried toward Lin Fan’s house, her face flushed from running too fast.
At the Lin Family entrance, Lin Fan and his sister Lin Shanshan were loading luggage into the car, ready to leave. Father Lin and Mrs. Lin were reluctant, offering continuous reminders from the side.
Not far off, Wei Yue’er was on a phone call, sounding a bit upset: "Brother, I told you not to let Fan Zheyu come here. How come he showed up so early today!"
From the other end of the call: "I told him, but he wanted to come himself. I can’t tie him up with a rope. So, how did it go when you met? How did you feel?"
Wei Yue’er replied: "Not great, brother. I can assure you; I won’t date this person, let alone marry him. If you insist, I won’t go back."
There was a moment of silence before the voice said: "I won’t force you. Come back first, as promised. Don’t change your mind. Brother wants to see you."
Though Wei Yue’er was angry, she eventually softened.
As she was talking on the phone, Wei Yue’er suddenly noticed Liu Zixing rushing over.
"Lin Fan!"
Liu Zixing stopped, catching her breath with her hands on her hips, and called out.
Lin Fan looked up, saw Liu Zixing, and smiled: "You’re here. I was planning to pass by the clinic later and let you know that I’m leaving."
Liu Zixing bit her lip and said: "Really, I thought you were going to leave without saying a word!"
Liu Zixing’s eyes reddened, feeling a bit wronged. That day, Lin Fan kissed her in public, and the villagers all mistakenly believed she was his girlfriend. She knew she wasn’t; maybe in Lin Fan’s eyes, she was nothing at all. Yet this man had stolen her first kiss without any warning.
She wanted him to take responsibility, but she felt unworthy of him. He was already so outstanding as a divine doctor, and now, knowing that he was also the wealthiest in Yun City, she felt even more unworthy of him.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "How could that be?"
Liu Zixing, upon learning that Lin Fan was leaving, was so nervous that she came running without thinking. It seemed she had countless things to say, but now that she saw Lin Fan, she didn’t know what to say.
"So, when will you be back?" Liu Zixing asked.
Lin Fan replied: "I don’t know yet."
Liu Zixing gave an "Oh," not knowing what to say.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "If you have time, you can come to Yun City to find me."
Liu Zixing beamed: "Really? But... I have to work every day. I don’t know if I’ll have the time."
Lin Fan said: "Whenever you’re free, you can come."
Liu Zixing nodded: "Okay then, I will come to find you. By the way, don’t worry about the clinic; my dad will be back today."
Lin Fan said: "That’s great. Then, we’ll be off now."
As they spoke, Lin Fan had already loaded the luggage into the car.
Soon, the three of them got into the car and left West River Village.
"Mm, bye-bye." Liu Zixing watched Lin Fan’s car depart with reluctance.
"Miss Zixing, we all heard about Little Fan kissing you the other day. Are you and Little Fan..." Mrs. Lin approached Liu Zixing and asked probing.
Liu Zixing’s face instantly turned red: "It’s not like that, Auntie, please don’t misunderstand. There’s nothing between Lin Fan and me. He just helped me get rid of that person who was harassing me that day..."
Mrs. Lin, upon hearing this, looked a bit disappointed. She had a good impression of Liu Zixing and thought it would be great if it were true. Little Fan, this child, is still single. Who knows when he’ll finally get married.
"So, Miss Zixing, what do you think of our Little Fan?" Father Lin asked, always being frank.
Mrs. Lin nudged him with her elbow: "Isn’t it obvious without asking?"
Father Lin caught the hint and began chuckling.
Liu Zixing blushed even more: "Uncle, Auntie, I won’t say anymore. I need to get back to the clinic, so I’ll be leaving first."
Liu Zixing, embarrassed, quickly left.
Mrs. Lin watched Liu Zixing’s retreating figure and sighed: "What a nice girl. It’s clear she likes our Little Fan. But I think Teacher Wei also seems interested in Little Fan. Teacher Wei is a good girl too. Old man, which one do you think would make a better daughter-in-law? It’s such a tough choice."
Father Lin said: "Not sure what Little Fan thinks either. I can’t advise him, since I’ve never faced such a dilemma."
Mrs. Lin gave him a look: "Of course you haven’t. I’m the only one who ever saw anything in you in this lifetime, unlike our son!"
In the Rolls-Royce.
Lin Fan drove, having already left West River Village.
Lin Shanshan teased: "Brother, Miss Zixing was really reluctant to see you go just now. The whole village knows you kissed her that day. What are you thinking? Shouldn’t you take responsibility for her?"
Lin Fan broke a sweat and said: "I only helped her get out of a dilemma that day, didn’t think much about it."
Lin Shanshan said: "You might not have thought much, but Miss Zixing surely did. A girl being kissed by you in public, how could she stay calm?"
Lin Fan said: "Then what should I do? Should I marry her?"
"No way!"
Both Lin Shanshan and Wei Yue’er almost said in unison.
Lin Fan had merely said it casually, not expecting such a strong reaction from them.
Lin Shanshan said: "Brother, if you marry Sister Zixing, then... you know."
What Lin Shanshan implied was that in Yun City, there was still Su Jinjin. Emotionally, both Lin Fan and Lin Zixing had deeper feelings for Su Jinjin than for Liu Zixing. Su Jinjin was even once Lin Fan’s girlfriend. If she had to choose a sister-in-law, Lin Shanshan would still prefer Su Jinjin.
Lin Shanshan suddenly looked curiously at Wei Yue’er and said: "Sister Yue’er, do you also think it’s no good?"
She thought it was no good because of Su Jinjin. Why did Wei Yue’er also say it’s not okay?
Wei Yue’er had reacted instinctively, a knee-jerk "no," and her face turned red after saying it.
Why wouldn’t she think it’s no good? If Lin Fan married Liu Zixing, what about her? Of course, she thought it wouldn’t do. She also wanted to marry Lin Fan.
"N-No reason." Wei Yue’er was a bit flustered, afraid of being found out, but she reacted quickly, "I just think Lin Fan was only helping Zixing out that day. That kiss doesn’t represent love; it was a helpful kiss, and marriage requires love, unless Lin Fan likes Zixing."
Wei Yue’er looked at Lin Fan, hoping for his answer. She wanted to know if Lin Fan had feelings for Liu Zixing.
Lin Fan was sweating nervously. How should he respond? These beautiful girls, which one didn’t he like? He only regretted that he was just one person and couldn’t split himself.
Elsewhere, Liu Zixing returned alone to the clinic, her mind full of thoughts about Lin Fan, lost in her reverie.
Upon reaching the clinic, she looked up and saw many cars parked in front, among them luxury cars, with some well-dressed people gathered at the entrance.
An old man was greeting them.
This old man was none other than Old Liu.
Old Liu, confused and bewildered, said to Liu Zixing: "Girl, it’s good that you’re back. I just came back, and then there was a whole group of people. They all say they came from all over and are looking for Divine Doctor Lin to be treated. What’s going on?"
Liu Zixing wiped her cold sweat, wondering what else it could be. It seemed that the name of Divine Doctor Lin had already spread far and wide, and more people would come seeking medical help in the future. Unfortunately, Divine Doctor Lin had already left.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: Heard It’s Related to Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Chapter 667: Heard It’s Related to Lin Fan
Jiangnan, Hang City.
Wangu Group Office.
Wei Tiansheng, the president of Wangu Group, sat in the office, meeting with his son, Wei Jisheng.
Recently, Wei Tiansheng has been very focused on a project, community group buying, which he is trying to promote in Yun City. He has high hopes for this project, and according to his plan, if he can achieve a monopoly with this project, he hopes to become the richest man in Huaxia. This is Wei Tiansheng’s grand goal, as he is not content with being just the richest man in Jiangnan.
This project was entrusted to his eldest son, Wei Jisheng. Wei Tiansheng also has high expectations for Wei Jisheng, as the Wei Family will be handed over to him in the future.
However, Wei Jisheng disappointed him a bit.
Previously, Wei Jisheng attempted to unify the underground of Yun City, but was thwarted by Lin Fan. Now, the underground of Yun City has been unified by Li Zhen, and the person behind Li Zhen is Lin Fan.
Despite suffering a major setback, Wei Tiansheng continues to demand that Wei Jisheng promote community group buying. Today, Wei Tiansheng met with Wei Jisheng to hear about the progress of the project.
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, we are currently spending a lot of manpower and resources to promote community group buying, including both online and offline promotions. Nowadays, it’s an era where traffic is king, and online promotion costs a lot. I hired the most professional promotion team to promote for us. It’s expensive, but the results are good, just..."
Wei Jisheng hesitated.
Wei Tiansheng said, "What is it?"
Wei Jisheng said, "It’s just that offline promotion is not going very smoothly... We tried to do ground promotion in various communities in Yun City, but we were sabotaged. As far as I know, these sabotages are carried out by the people from the underground of Yun City. They are trying to disrupt our promotion."
Wei Tiansheng’s face darkened. The reason for wanting to unify the underground of Yun City initially was to prevent such incidents from happening, but since Wei Jisheng failed to unify it, they are now being obstructed by the underground forces of Yun City.
"Outrageous, I don’t believe they can’t be dealt with. Just report it to the police directly!" Wei Tiansheng said.
Wei Jisheng smiled bitterly, "It’s useless. They are like flies, impossible to get rid of. Reporting to the police can only solve the problem temporarily, but not permanently. It’s all my fault for not being able to unify the underground of Yun City, which led to today’s situation. If we could unify the underground of Yun City... But there’s no ’if’. Father, it’s all because of my incompetence. Blame me!"
Wei Tiansheng snorted, "If there’s anyone to blame, it’s that Lin Fan. I asked you to deal with Lin Fan. How did that go?"
Wei Jisheng said, "Here’s the thing, I had prepared a gift for Lin Fan, but there’s been no movement from him these days. I heard that Lin Fan left Yun City."
Wei Tiansheng frowned, "He left Yun City? Where did he go?"
Wei Jisheng said, "I’m not sure, no one seems to know his whereabouts."
Wei Tiansheng said, "This man left a 200 billion group and suddenly disappeared. This can’t be simple!"
Wei Jisheng said, "I’m not sure about that, but rest assured, father, once Lin Fan returns, I will make him suffer."
Wei Tiansheng nodded and said, "This brat needs to learn that the Wei Family is not to be trifled with. Anyone who provokes the Wei Family must pay the price. We are focusing on promoting community group buying in Yun City, and I don’t want to see any more disruptions from the underground forces of Yun City."
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, in my opinion, the reason the underground forces of Yun City are causing us trouble is because of Lin Fan. He’s definitely envious of our project and wants a share of it."
Wei Tiansheng snorted, "He’s dreaming. A brat like him wants to seize benefits from me, Wei Tiansheng? The world knows that I’m very protective of my interests. Lin Fan wants a bite, but there’s no way!"
What the father and son don’t know is that Lin Fan doesn’t want a share. Lin Fan is completely against them forming a monopoly because such a monopoly will harm countless small vendors’ livelihoods. Lin Fan is determined to confront the Wei Family this time.
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, there’s something I’m not sure I should say."
Wei Tiansheng said, "Go ahead."
Wei Jisheng said, "I have to say, failing to unify the underground of Yun City has caused us many troubles, troubles that are hard to solve. As the saying goes, ’A mighty dragon does not suppress a local snake’. Lin Fan is the richest man in Yun City, he’s the local snake. Besides eliminating him, we might also consider giving him a bone or two to make him obedient."
Wei Tiansheng gave a noncommittal response, "You mean, negotiate with Lin Fan and give him benefits so he doesn’t oppose us?"
Wei Jisheng said, "What do you think, father?"
Wei Tiansheng slammed the table and angrily said, "Nonsense, haven’t I told you? I’m very protective of my interests. Lin Fan won’t get a single cent from me. He’s just a brat, nothing more. Just deal with him as originally planned!"
Wei Jisheng wiped off his cold sweat and said, "Okay, father, I was just hoping to consider multiple angles to solve the problem. Since father has denied negotiating with Lin Fan, then we’ll face it head-on."
Wei Tiansheng said, "That’s more like it. The community group buying project is just the first step I want to take in Yun City. In the future, Yun City will become the second center of our commercial empire. Lin Fan is nothing, just a roadblock that I will eventually sweep away!"
Wei Jisheng said, "Yes, father."
Wei Tiansheng sneered, "Lin Fan is not a cause for concern. What’s troubling me now is that I’m planning to build a second Wangu Mansion in Yun City. The question is where to locate it. There are a few candidates, but none are satisfactory. Do you have any good suggestions?"
Wei Tiansheng was determined to expand the commercial territory to Yun City. In the future, Yun City’s status would be on par with Hang City, becoming the second center of Wangu Group.
And the symbol of this ambition is to build a Wangu Mansion there.
Wei Jisheng said, "Yun City is a good place. Precisely because it’s a good place, every inch of land is worth its weight in gold. Securing land is a problem. The main city district is basically out of the question because it’s very difficult to acquire land there, especially for building a mansion. Such a venture would require political connections. In my opinion, we should look towards Daya Bay and Nanshan District."
Wei Tiansheng gave a noncommittal response, "Let’s hear it."
Wei Jisheng said, "There’s no need to elaborate on Daya Bay. It’s a new economic zone supported by the state, and a future commercial center. However, the land in Daya Bay is famously hard to acquire and highly sought after. If we build a mansion in Daya Bay, the costs would also be very high. As for Nanshan District, I heard that Yun City has restarted the development plan for it. Nanshan District has a promising future, and there’s plenty of land available, which is cheaper. Father, I may lean more towards Nanshan District."
Wei Tiansheng snorted and said, "You know one thing and not the other. Do you know why Yun City has restarted the development plan for Nanshan District?"
Wei Jisheng said, "Why?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "I heard it’s related to Lin Fan."
Wei Jisheng was astonished, "Lin Fan again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 668
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Chapter 668
Wei Tiansheng said, "That’s right, Lin Fan, that blond kid. Although I don’t take him seriously, I have to admit he does have some tricks in Yun City and has good relations with the city’s top officials."
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, do you mean we should give up Nanshan District?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "No, actually, I’ve got an ideal site for building the Wangu Mansion, but it’s not in Nanshan District. As for Nanshan District, it will indeed be a key focus for our investment in the future, just as you said, the land there is abundant and cheap."
Wei Jisheng asked, "Father, where should we build our Wangu Mansion then?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "You don’t need to worry about that for now, just concentrate on doing the community group buying project well. It must succeed, no failure allowed! I’ll handle everything else myself."
Wei Jisheng had no choice but to say, "Okay, I understand, Father."
Wei Tiansheng waved his hand and said, "Go ahead, cough cough cough..."
While speaking, Wei Tiansheng couldn’t help but cough.
Wei Jisheng said with concern, "Father, you’ve been coughing more severely lately."
Wei Tiansheng chuckled and said, "It’s nothing, just an old ailment, no need to worry."
Wei Jisheng said, "As your son, how can I not be worried about your illness? Father, I’ve heard that a mysterious healer recently appeared in a village, said to have incredible medical skills. I’ve only heard about it casually, without any detailed information. Why don’t I inquire more about it and see if we can find this legendary healer to take a look at your condition?"
Wei Tiansheng murmured, "A healer? This deficiency has been with me since childhood. I’ve seen countless famous doctors, and medicines haven’t worked. Can this so-called healer do any good? Coming from a village, he’s probably another swindler. No need to bother with him."
Wei Jisheng reluctantly said, "Alright then, I’ll leave for now."
Despite saying this, Wei Jisheng decided to try looking for this legendary healer. If he could really cure his father, his standing in his father’s eyes would definitely rise.
Indeed, his main purpose was not genuinely caring about Wei Tiansheng’s health; he was more concerned about his own status in Wei Tiansheng’s mind.
As Wei Tiansheng’s eldest son, the family business is supposed to be his sooner or later, but Wei Jisheng doesn’t dare to relax since Wei Tiansheng has three sons, and his two younger brothers are not ordinary individuals.
If he’s careless and loses favor, his two brothers are always waiting by ready to replace him.
If the Wei family’s group is likened to an empire, Wei Tiansheng is the king, and Wei Jisheng is the crown prince, with his two brothers being the princes. This kind of imperial family intrigue is quite common and nothing new in major business families.
Until he truly takes over the Wangu Group, Wei Jisheng won’t relax.
And right now, Wei Jisheng has to tackle this community group buying project that Wei Tiansheng values. If he can successfully manage this, his position as the crown prince will stabilize, and the empire will eventually be his, making it difficult for his two brothers to catch up.
Naturally, Wei Jisheng doesn’t know that the healer he’s about to inquire about is actually his upcoming opponent, Lin Fan.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce Cullinan back to Yun City.
"Yue’er, do you need me to take you home? By the way, where are you from? I only know you’re from Jiangnan, but I don’t know the specific location," Lin Fan asked.
Wei Yue’er said, "My home is in Hang City, you don’t need to drive me. I’ll just take a taxi myself. Yun City and Hang City aren’t far apart."
Lin Fan murmured, "Oh, so you’re from Hang City. Okay then, I won’t take you home. Whenever you’re free, feel free to come find me."
Wei Yue’er said, "Um, I’ll leave now. My brother called me again urging."
Wei Yue’er got out of the car and left by herself.
Lin Shanshan said, "Brother, Sister Yue’er is going home for a matchmaking meeting this time. Aren’t you worried?"
Lin Fan said, "Worried about what?"
Lin Shanshan giggled, "Worried that Sister Yue’er might be swept away. She’s so beautiful, surely many people pursue her."
Lin Fan wiped his sweat and said, "Don’t gossip like that. So, should I take you back to school, or return tomorrow?"
Lin Shanshan said, "I better return to school. I’ve already taken a few days off, if I take more, I’m afraid I’ll fall behind my classmates."
Lin Fan nodded and then drove Lin Shanshan back to school.
At the gate of Yun City Music Academy, the Rolls-Royce stopped, attracting quite some attention. Seeing Lin Shanshan get out of the Rolls-Royce, people around showed envious expressions.
Lin Shanshan secretly felt pleased in her heart. This feeling is really nice. They used to be poor, from childhood to adulthood, she’s always been the one to envy others. People wearing new clothes, buying new phones, their dads driving small cars, she’s always been watching from the sidelines.
Now things are different. Her brother became the richest man in Yun City, and she doesn’t need to envy others anymore. Others would envy her instead.
All of this is brought by her brother!
Once Lin Fan sent Lin Shanshan back to school, he planned to leave with his car.
"Lin Fan!"
Suddenly, Lin Fan heard someone calling him. He turned his head and saw Liu Mengjie!
Liu Mengjie saw Lin Fan’s car and immediately came over, happily greeting Lin Fan.
"I haven’t seen you for a few days. I thought you went missing!" Liu Mengjie teased with a smile.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Sister Mengjie, I went to the countryside for a few days."
Liu Mengjie said, "I see. Are you free today? Come home for dinner. Last time, I made lots of tasty dishes, but we didn’t get to eat them."
Liu Mengjie felt a bit regretful. They were supposed to have dinner at her home last time, but even after cooking everything, Lin Fan suddenly had to cancel due to an emergency.
She had been thinking about it all along, so upon seeing Lin Fan today, she wanted to make up for the regret of last time.
The reason Lin Fan couldn’t make it to dinner last time was because his third uncle suddenly ran into trouble. He had to rush to the hospital, and after rescuing him, he immediately took his third uncle back to West River Village, completely forgetting about the dinner with Liu Mengjie.
Lin Fan felt a bit apologetic and, considering he didn’t have much else to do, agreed with Liu Mengjie.
"Sure, Sister Mengjie, hop on the car, we’ll go buy groceries."
Liu Mengjie was delighted and got on Lin Fan’s car.
Passing by the market where they bought groceries last time, Lin Fan said, "Sister Mengjie, let’s buy groceries here again."
But Liu Mengjie said, "Forget it, let’s go to the supermarket instead."
Lin Fan asked curiously, "Why, Sister Mengjie?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "The market now has few vegetables left, it’s almost obsolete. Remember last time we were here? Many vendors have lost their jobs because no one shops here anymore. Community group buying has already spread in our neighborhood, and people are buying vegetables online now; it’s very cheap."
Lin Fan furrowed his brows and said, "Let’s go check it out."
Lin Fan still stopped the car and, together with Liu Mengjie, walked into the market.
Indeed, the once busy market was now very quiet, almost abandoned with a sense of desolation.

chapters.title: Chapter 669
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Chapter 669
The desolate vegetable market had an atmosphere as bleak as doomsday.
Only a few vegetable stalls were holding out, with only a few customers browsing. The vegetable vendors’ goods were plentiful, and the day was nearly over, yet they hadn’t sold much.
It seemed that group buying in the community had fully spread in this neighborhood. As a pilot area by the Wei Family, it could be said that it was implemented very effectively.
At this moment, a woman in pajamas was bargaining with a vegetable vendor at a stall. Both parties were quite agitated, marking one of the rare lively moments in the market all day.
"Uncle, make it cheaper, okay? I’ll buy more. Look, you can’t sell them!" the woman in pajamas said.
The vendor replied, "I really can’t go cheaper; otherwise, I’m working for nothing. Miss, how can you offer such a low price? These vegetables are grown by us; the cost is there. If we sell this cheap, we’ll lose everything."
The woman in pajamas pursed her lips and said, "I don’t care about your costs. Don’t you know, group buying in the community is trending now, and greens are just 0.1 yuan per kilo. If I wasn’t slow today and missed out, would I bother coming here? I’m already taking a loss offering 0.5 yuan. I might as well not eat veggies today and try online tomorrow. I’m giving you another chance, want to sell or not?"
The vendor was almost in tears, "Miss, I really can’t; 0.5 yuan is impossible. Normally, it’s 3 yuan per kilo."
The woman in pajamas retorted, "3 yuan per kilo, who would buy that? Now with group buying online, it’s 0.1 yuan. You might as well let these vegetables rot!"
"Uncle, 3 yuan, right? Please pack these vegetables; I’ll take them all."
A voice said, and Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie walked over.
"Sister Mengjie, have you finished the vegetables we bought a few days ago? Perfect timing to supply the school," Lin Fan said with a smile.
Liu Mengjie nodded, indicating they were finished. The school had a lot of people, and the vegetables bought that day were gone in a day or two.
Last time, Lin Fan felt sorry for the farmers and bought all the vegetables in the market, donating them to the school.
Hearing Lin Fan buy up all the vegetables at 3 yuan caught the attention of everyone present.
The woman in pajamas looked at Lin Fan like he was a fool, thinking, "Seriously, someone actually helped the uncle buy vegetables at 3 yuan per kilo? This guy must be an idiot!"
But the vendor recognized Lin Fan, realizing this was the kind-hearted person from a few days ago!
Lin Fan’s good deed had already spread through the market, and everyone praised him. This young man was truly a great person, a true saint!
"Young man, it’s you!" the vendor excitedly said, thrilled that he was here again to help clear the stock, meaning today wouldn’t be a total loss.
Overcome with happiness and excitement, the vendor shed tears, moved by the gesture.
The woman in pajamas seemed a bit unable to bear it, saying, "Hey, are you really dumb or pretending to be? You actually intend to buy all these vegetables at 3 yuan?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "The vegetables Uncle worked so hard to grow, I think 3 yuan is not expensive at all. They’re worth it."
The woman in pajamas said, "You look young; don’t you go online? Don’t you know community group buying is trending? Vegetables are just 0.1 yuan there."
Lin Fan replied, "I know."
The woman in pajamas sneered, "And you still help him buy, you must have too much money."
Lin Fan said, "I’m helping you."
The woman in pajamas was stunned, "Helping me? Buying his vegetables helps him, not me. Unless you’re going to give me the vegetables?"
Lin Fan said, "As a customer, you think buying vegetables online for 0.1 yuan with home delivery is perfect, but you haven’t considered what lies behind those 0.1 yuan vegetables."
The woman in pajamas said, "Are you crazy? Is the 0.1 yuan vegetable poisoned? Stop scaremongering here."
Lin Fan said, "Of course, it’s not poison in the vegetables themselves, but the group buying is toxic. Have you heard ’the wool comes from the sheep’? Buying 0.1 yuan vegetables online seems like a bargain, but you’ll pay for it sooner or later."
The woman in pajamas looked puzzled, "What do you mean?"
Lin Fan said, "As far as I know, this community group buying project was initiated by the Wei Family. Their current strategy is to grab the market with low prices. This 0.1 yuan per kilo vegetable is subsidized by the Wei Family, and when you all become reliant on their platform, they will increase the prices. At that point, vegetables won’t be 0.1 yuan, nor even 3 yuan, but probably 4 yuan, and you won’t be able to refuse to buy."
The woman in pajamas said, "I think you’re stupid. If the platform dares to raise prices so much, people will naturally stop buying online and return to the market."
Lin Fan shook his head and said, "You still don’t understand. By then, they will have monopolized the supply, and where else can you buy vegetables? You can only buy from them!"
The Wei Family’s plan was like this: attract customers with low prices while buying large quantities from farmers. Customers couldn’t resist the cheap 0.1 yuan per kilo, thus rushing to the platform, causing farmers’ vegetables to become unsellable. Farmers would either change professions or sell to the platform.
Initially, the platform might purchase at reasonable prices, but eventually, farmers lose bargaining power, selling below cost to the platform since all customers shifted online and they couldn’t sell otherwise.
At this point, the platform gains control over supply, halts low-price strategies, since the goods are in their hands, allowing them to raise prices as desired. Customers, unless they stop eating, will have no choice but to buy regardless of price.
This is how monopolization of the market occurs.
Vegetables are a necessity, of course, they can’t be skipped, so customers are forced to buy high-price vegetables from the platform. The bargain found in 0.1 yuan vegetables is eventually paid back with interest.
The outcome is, farmers can only sell cheaply, and customers can only buy expensively through the platform.
The one who laughs last will be the platform that monopolized the market.
Hearing this, the woman in pajamas was stunned.
Lin Fan stated it so plainly that she understood it.
"Hmph, inexplicable. Just because you say it doesn’t make it right. Anyway, now 0.1 yuan buys vegetables; who wouldn’t take a deal?" the woman in pajamas said, "After all that talking, aren’t you just trying to get me to pay 3 yuan to buy your vegetables? Dream on!"
With that, she twisted her hips and turned away.
Lin Fan shook his head. This woman was definitely not an exception, but rather the majority. Most people don’t see that far ahead, focusing only on immediate benefits. That’s why capitalists are so unscrupulous; they understand the public psyche and know how to exploit it.
Lin Fan could buy all the vegetables for the vendor now, but this was temporary. To solve this issue, one must address it fundamentally.
Lin Fan’s gaze turned cold; it seemed it was time to really have a showdown with the Wei Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 The Desperate Couple
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Chapter 670 The Desperate Couple
Lin Fan took action again, buying all the unsold vegetables from the market and donating them to the school. The vegetable vendors were moved to tears and almost wanted to kneel before him.
In their eyes, Lin Fan was simply their savior, repeatedly extending a helping hand and rescuing them.
This is the true meaning of being wealthy. As the saying goes, when someone is poor, they should maintain their integrity, and when they are rich, they should benefit the world. One shouldn’t be just a ruthless money-making machine, even harming others for profit. Instead, they should have a sense of social responsibility.
Although Lin Fan earned the gratitude of the vendors, he knew this couldn’t fundamentally solve the problem; he couldn’t clear the vegetable market every day.
Perhaps he could handle one or two, but if the Wei Family’s project spreads, with thousands of markets and countless vendors, can he buy that much!
The fundamental solution to this problem is to let the Wei Family’s project fail, but this isn’t something Lin Fan can accomplish alone.
"Little Fan, you’ve done all you can, and that’s enough. Let’s go home, tonight I’ll cook something delicious for you."
Liu Mengjie smiled and said.
Lin Fan nodded, gathered his thoughts, and said with a smile, "I really want to taste Sister Mengjie’s cooking."
Liu Mengjie giggled, "Don’t worry, I won’t let you down."
So, Lin Fan went back to Lijing District with Liu Mengjie.
In the car, Liu Mengjie suddenly seemed to remember something and asked, "Little Fan, do you mind if I turn on the radio?"
Lin Fan said, "Of course not, go ahead."
Liu Mengjie turned on the radio and tuned to the financial channel, where a program featuring a stock market expert was playing, and she listened intently.
Lin Fan was a bit surprised and said, "Sister Mengjie, are you interested in this?"
Liu Mengjie said, "Yes, I’ve recently developed an interest in financial management. I want to learn more about it. As they say, if you don’t manage your finances, your finances won’t manage you. There’s nothing wrong with learning a bit about it."
Lin Fan, with his top-notch insight, sensed something unusual and asked, "Sister Mengjie, are you facing some problem?"
Liu Mengjie quickly said, "No, no, Little Fan, don’t overthink it. I really just want to learn more about investment and finance. Even though I’m a school principal, I only earn a fixed salary. I’m just thinking of earning a bit more for myself."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Alright, Sister Mengjie, if there’s any trouble, feel free to let me know."
Liu Mengjie simply replied, "Okay, I will."
Ring, ring, ring...
Liu Mengjie’s phone suddenly rang.
Liu Mengjie answered the call, "Hello, President Chen. Dinner? I’m really sorry, President Chen, I would love to meet, but tonight isn’t possible. How about we schedule another time? How does tomorrow sound? I’m truly sorry, I have something to attend to tonight. Alright, President Chen, tomorrow it is. See you."
After hanging up, she seemed worried Lin Fan would ask and proactively said, "It’s an old friend, haven’t seen them in a while, invited me for dinner."
Lin Fan acknowledged with an "Oh" and said, "Sister Mengjie, if you have urgent matters, feel free to attend to them. We can have a meal anytime."
Liu Mengjie immediately said, "No, last time we couldn’t eat because of something else. This time, no matter what, it can’t be postponed. Tonight, I want to have dinner with you. Everything else can wait."
In Liu Mengjie’s eyes, dining with Lin Fan was very important, more so than other matters. She had been looking forward to it since the last missed opportunity.
Lin Fan listened and didn’t say anything further.
Soon, the car arrived at Lijing District.
Upon entering the district, they suddenly saw a crowd of people blocking the road, making it impossible for the car to pass.
The crowd was buzzing with discussion, all looking upwards.
Following their gaze, Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie looked up and, shockingly, saw four people on the rooftop of a building in front: a man, a woman, a young girl, and a young boy. They seemed like a family of four.
Both children were crying loudly, appearing terrified.
The couple was crying as well, but compared to the children, their faces showed more of an adult’s despair.
"Son, what are you doing? Why are you taking your wife and children to the rooftop? Don’t scare your mother; your mother is old and can’t handle it!"
An elderly woman in a dance outfit was incredibly anxious and frightened downstairs.
As it turns out, this evening, like usual, the elderly lady came to the community square to dance with a group of seniors. While enjoying herself, a senior man noticed four figures on the rooftop. Upon closer inspection, weren’t they her son, daughter-in-law, grandson, and granddaughter?
This family of four on the rooftop was about to jump.
The community immediately became chaotic, with residents all running over to watch.
On the rooftop, hearing the elderly lady’s words, the man, sobbing uncontrollably, emotionally broke down: "Mom, I’m sorry, I really can’t do it anymore, I can’t live anymore!"
The elderly woman’s face turned pale: "Son, what’s happened? Don’t scare your mother."
The man said, "Mom, I’ve failed in life, in business. I couldn’t live up to your and Dad’s expectations!"
The elderly woman was bewildered: "Son, what are you talking about? You’ve always been my pride. You’re a top university graduate and built your company with your own hands. The seniors in the community always envy me, saying I’m blessed, my son is successful, and I have a harmonious family. What exactly has happened?"
The man said, "I’m sorry, Mom, I’m going to disgrace you. Your son is useless, he’s nothing."
The elderly woman said, "How can that be? My son could never be useless. What’s going on? Tell your mother. If you jump without saying anything, dying without a clear reason, you can’t torment your mother like that!"
The man lowered his head and cried, seemingly at a loss for words.
The elderly woman said, "Daughter-in-law, if he won’t speak, then you do it. You’re the company’s CFO. What happened?"
The woman cried, "Mom, I’m sorry, it’s my fault, I dragged Ah-Cong down. In the past two years, the company’s performance has been declining, and we’ve been struggling to hold on."
The elderly woman stomped her feet: "Why didn’t you tell me?"
The woman said, "We didn’t want to worry you, Mom. It wasn’t easy for you to nurture Ah-Cong to success, and now that you’re older, we just wanted you to enjoy your later years, dancing daily without worries, but we really can’t hold on anymore."
"To help the company out of trouble, I suggested to Ah-Cong to let my old schoolmate, who’s in investment, manage our finances. So, we took the company’s funds and invested in the stock market. Who knew, our stocks plummeted, and we’re on the verge of losing everything, thinking it might be better to be dead."
Only then did everyone understand, it was that the failed investment led to despair and thoughts of suicide!
"Which stock did you buy?"
At this moment, a voice suddenly asked. Following the sound, everyone saw Lin Fan step forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: Isn’t It Just Being Trapped?
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Chapter 671: Isn’t It Just Being Trapped?
Liang Cong, once the pride of the sky, was born into a decent family in the city. Both of his parents were teachers, and his father was a university professor. They did everything they could to nurture Liang Cong into a talented individual.
Liang Cong didn’t let his parents down. He was a top student at a prestigious university in China. After graduation, he smoothly secured an offer from a major company, joining a Fortune 500 company. It was a respectable job with decent pay. Later, Liang Cong married his long-time girlfriend, and they had a son and a daughter.
With two children, a respectable job, and owning cars and a house, they were very happy and enviable.
Later, Liang Cong had some capital. After discussing it with his wife, who worked in finance, they decided to start a company of their own. Relying on the connections Liang Cong had accumulated, the company was running well, and business was thriving, which meant more money.
They switched to luxury cars, each having one. Seeing them both drive luxury cars made others envious.
However, the good times didn’t last long. After offending someone, the company’s business suddenly plummeted, and clients abandoned them. They could only rely on their savings, struggling to hold on.
After relentless efforts from both of them, the company finally showed signs of recovery. Recently, they even secured a big project. If this project succeeded, the company could regain its former glory.
However, at this critical juncture, their stocks got trapped. Seeing the company with no available funds, the big project could only slip away.
The couple was in despair, overwhelmed, and they brought their children to the rooftop, intending to end it all.
"Mom, I’m sorry, we really don’t have the courage to live anymore." The man wept bitterly.
The old lady also started crying, "You’re really foolish. Without money, you can find another way. Even selling the house and car could work. Why despair?"
The man said, "The house and cars were long mortgaged to the bank. We used that money to trade stocks, and now the stocks are trapped. We have nothing left and are deeply in debt. How could we not despair?"
The old lady’s face turned pale, "Then why were you so heartless to bring the children along? The children did nothing wrong. Why should they die with you? My grandchildren!"
The man cried, "Mom, I have no choice. Things turned out this way. If they survive, they’ll only suffer in the future. We’ve lived so hard, how can I let them suffer too? We’d rather take them with us."
"What, is family suicide a trend now?"
Lin Fan suddenly spoke.
At once, everyone turned to look at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan had recently read in the news about a woman who committed suicide and took her children with her. Her mindset was probably similar to Liang Cong and his wife’s—they didn’t want their children to suffer, so they wanted to take them along.
However, they overlooked the fact that although the children are young, their lives are theirs. No one has the right to take away their right to live, especially without their consent—it’s horrifying.
Such parents claim they don’t want their children to suffer and it’s better to die together. It seems like love for their children, but it’s actually harmful.
The children’s lives haven’t truly begun, and they shouldn’t have their right to live taken from them. Their future is theirs, not anyone else’s. They should be allowed to live and have their own future.
Suicide should never be an option anyway, and bringing children along is even more wrong.
If the couple is truly too desperate to live and insists on suicide, then they should do it themselves and never take the children with them.
Lin Fan thought this way.
"Who are you?" The man looked at Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I just happened to pass by. You’re making a suicide scene here, and passersby are gathering to watch, blocking the street."
The man said, "Sorry, we initially planned to find a high hill to jump from to spare the neighbors. But we are too desperate. We can’t get out and only want to die quickly and end it all."
Lin Fan said, "Then just die if you want, but can you leave the children behind? Have you asked them if they want to die?"
The boy then reached out, tugged on the man’s shirt, and cried, "Dad, I don’t want to die, I don’t want to die!"
The daughter also tugged on her mom, "Mom, I don’t want to die either, can you not die?"
Lin Fan said, "You see, you scared them. They don’t want to die. You should let them go."
The man seemed moved but then grit his teeth and said, "No, we owe so much debt. If we leave them, they’ll have to bear this debt in the future. They’ll live very hard lives, and I can’t let them suffer so much. I’m sorry, children. Please forgive your father’s selfishness; I really don’t want you to stay and suffer."
The woman urged, "Don’t say anything, don’t say anything anymore. We’ve come this far, there’s nothing more to say. Dying will end it all."
After speaking, the woman suddenly picked up her daughter.
The little girl screamed in fear, her face turning pale.
The woman held the little girl, seemingly ready to run and jump off the building.
"Ah!"
The crowd was shocked.
If they jumped, from this ten-plus story building, there was no way they’d survive.
This couple was really ruthless. It’s one thing to want to die themselves, but to bring the kids too, the kids are innocent.
If they jumped, even if Lin Fan was quick with his hands, he couldn’t save them all at once. He could save one but not the other. After all, Lin Fan was skilled, but he wasn’t some exaggerated superhero.
Because unless it was Superman or Wonder Woman’s skill, or Flash’s speed, it would be impossible to save the whole family in such a short time.
"Don’t be in a hurry to jump. Isn’t it just trapped stocks? Simple, maybe you all don’t have to die. Why not tell me, what stock did you buy?"
Lin Fan suddenly asked.
Using physical skills to save this family wasn’t possible. Now there was only one method left, and that was talking his way out.
Coincidentally, Lin Fan had just received a top investment master skill reward, and this reward could be used to solve the problems the couple faced.
Upon hearing this, the woman stopped in her tracks, looking at Lin Fan in surprise, "What did you say, just trapped stocks?"
This young man sounded so relaxed, as if trapped stocks were a common, small issue.
This couldn’t help but spark interest.
The man also looked at Lin Fan in amazement and said, "Who are you? Can you help us with the trapped stocks?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Why don’t you tell me what stock you bought, and I’ll analyze it for you."
The man, seeing Lin Fan dressed plainly, looked doubtful and said, "Are you trying to fool us? You don’t look like someone who can help us!"

chapters.title: Chapter 672: The Meaning of Luxury Cars and Mansions
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Chapter 672: The Meaning of Luxury Cars and Mansions
Liang Cong didn’t believe Lin Fan could help him because Lin Fan dressed plainly and didn’t look like a wealthy person, nor someone who knew about investment.
"Don’t try to fool us; you’re just trying to stop us from jumping off the building. But looking like that, how do you expect to fool me? I’m poor now, but you look even poorer than me!" Liang Cong said.
Everyone shook their heads, thinking this young man was really terrible at persuasion. If you’re going to pretend to be an insider, at least dress the part.
At the very least, wear a suit to look like a successful person so that you can fool people.
Lin Fan said, "If you don’t believe me, there’s nothing I can do. Can I make a small request?"
Liang Cong asked, "What small request?"
Lin Fan said, "My friend and I are in a hurry to get home for dinner, but everyone is here watching you jump, blocking the road so my car can’t pass. Could you wait a bit to jump and let my car get through first? Big brother, if you’re going to die, be kind, won’t you?"
Liang Cong was taken aback, sweating at Lin Fan’s unusual request.
Lin Fan turned to Liu Mengjie and said, "Sister Mengjie, let’s go; I’m hungry and want to go home to cook."
Liu Mengjie was a bit surprised. From what she knew about Lin Fan, he wouldn’t just walk away like this, especially since there were children involved. This wasn’t like Lin Fan’s usual style.
However, since Lin Fan said he wasn’t going to intervene, she wouldn’t force him, so she nodded and followed Lin Fan back to the car.
The crowd watched them but was soon distracted by the Rolls-Royce Cullinan.
What?
Lin Fan is driving that car?
This is a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, a luxury car worth 8 million!
As Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie were about to get into the car.
"Wait!"
Liang Cong stopped Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, knowing that Liang Cong would call out to him. Didn’t Liang Cong not believe him? This should pique Liang Cong’s interest.
Lin Fan wasn’t very materialistic; he’d never pursued brand-name clothing, still wearing the same simple clothes he used to buy for ten dollars. This wasn’t Lin Fan trying to show off; he simply felt that brand-name clothes costing thousands didn’t necessarily fit more comfortably than ten-dollar outfits.
Brand-name clothes were largely about brand premium, and frankly, buying them is like foolishly allowing the brand to exploit you.
Some may argue that the point of buying brand-name clothes isn’t how comfortable they are, but about face. Because they’re expensive, wearing them gives you face and prevents people from looking down on you.
But Lin Fan felt that such face, supported by brand-name clothes, was quite hollow; he didn’t care for it. With billions lounging in his bank account, he didn’t need such face either.
Those who need this hollow face are actually people with little money; they’d scrimp and save for months to buy a brand-name bag, take out loans to buy brand-name clothes, and sell a kidney to buy an Apple phone. It really looks impressive, right? Don’t they feel pathetic themselves!
Obtained a worthless face and silently endured bitterness while all the hard-earned money goes to those brands.
It’s not that Lin Fan was deliberately avoiding brand names—thinking that way would be too narrow-minded—it’s simply that Lin Fan didn’t care whether it was branded or not; he was okay either way. He could wear branded clothes or regular ones; in his eyes, there was no distinction just as long as they were comfortable.
As long as clothes were comfortable, he’d be willing to wear the ten-dollar ones, whereas if they weren’t comfortable, he wouldn’t wear the ones costing thousands.
That’s the highest realm.
Of course, clothes and cars are different; a shirt costing thousands might not feel more comfortable than a ten-dollar one, but a car costing hundreds of thousands is definitely better than a cheaper one. Furthermore, cars represent something even more significant, like identity and status.
As mentioned earlier, even a poor person can scrimp for months and buy a brand-name shirt.
But no matter how a poor person scrimps, they won’t afford a luxury car worth hundreds of thousands.
Simply put, owning a brand-name piece doesn’t mean you’re wealthy, but owning a car worth hundreds of thousands certainly means you aren’t ordinary.
The message a car worth hundreds of thousands sends is exactly this.
This is why Lin Fan didn’t mind branded clothes costing thousands but liked owning luxury cars—a 70 million Kosak, an 8 million Rolls-Royce. Although both were system rewards, without those rewards, he would still buy luxury cars; they were not only incredibly comfortable to drive but also perfectly represent identity.
Luxury homes are the same as luxury cars.
Lin Fan bought the 3 billion Yunding Manor; now, everyone knows it’s the residence of the richest man in Yun City, and it’s already become a symbol.
Seeing Lin Fan driving a Rolls-Royce, Liang Cong suddenly looked at Lin Fan differently, automatically ignoring Lin Fan’s simple attire. Even if Lin Fan were dressed like a beggar, a beggar driving a Rolls-Royce couldn’t be just any beggar.
"This car is...yours?"
Liang Cong’s voice trembled a bit.
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said, "Yes, that’s right. Why?"
Liang Cong excitedly said, "Who are you? You mentioned earlier you could help us. How can you help? Please advise!"
Liang Cong immediately sought advice, as if he saw the dawn of hope, so real; luxury cars really do have an impact.
Lin Fan said, "Tell me which stocks you bought?"
A woman replied eagerly, "We bought Weichuang Shares. It’s been plummeting for days, and based on my friend’s analysis, there’s no chance of it going back up."
Lin Fan said, "Weichuang Shares, this stock usually shows stable performance and often surges, suitable for long-term holds taking advantage of those surges for short-term trades and guaranteed profits. It’s a good stock, especially since the market has been performing well recently, rising steadily. There shouldn’t be any hiccups, yet unfortunately, the company encountered a crisis recently causing days of sharp declines and several drop limits; the situation is indeed dire."
With these words, Lin Fan shook his head, seemingly very pessimistic.
Upon hearing this, Liang Cong could confirm that Lin Fan truly was an insider, well-versed in the stock market.
Liang Cong bitterly said, "Now you understand why we’re desperate. We’re truly at a dead end with money trapped in stocks, unable to repay debts; the projects we managed to get are slipping away wasted; we’re genuinely in dire straits."
Lin Fan shook his head, "I haven’t finished speaking. This stock, although awful now, isn’t beyond saving. To my knowledge, Weichuang Shares’ chairman is quite an ambitious character; according to internal info I’ve obtained, he’s already on his way to Jing City."
Liang Cong was surprised, "What does this mean?"

chapters.title: Chapter 673: Stock Market Genius
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Chapter 673: Stock Market Genius
Lin Fan said, "This means Weichuang can turn the tide. If I’m not mistaken, there will be good news within three days. If you commit suicide now, you’d be dying too hastily. You’d regret it in front of King Yama even as ghosts. I suggest you wait and see. If by then the situation can’t be resolved, there’s still time to die. Of course, you might not believe me, you can jump now."
Liang Cong and his wife exchanged a glance, both showing signs of hesitation.
Clearly, the despair in their eyes had dissipated significantly, replaced by hope.
As long as a person can see hope, they naturally won’t think of suicide anymore.
"What you said, is it true?" Liang Cong asked excitedly.
Lin Fan said, "I said you won’t be too late to die after three days. It doesn’t make a big difference these few days, right? From what I see, you wanted to die, and to take your two kids with you, it shows you really love them, doesn’t it? As you mentioned, the reason you want to die with them is not to leave them suffering in the world, then why don’t you give them a chance, a chance to live without suffering?"
Those words hit Liang Cong and his wife right in their hearts.
They were instantly in tears.
Indeed, if there was even a shred of hope, how could they let their children die, these were their own flesh and blood.
And Lin Fan’s words just now gave them a thread of much-needed hope.
Liang Cong said, "Okay, we won’t jump, we’ll wait and see."
Thus, Liang Cong and his wife took their two children and retreated from the rooftop.
They came down from the building and went to stand in front of Lin Fan.
At this moment, Liang Cong’s mother had kneeled before Lin Fan, tearful with gratitude, "Young man, thank you, you’re our savior!"
Lin Fan helped the old lady up, smiling, "It’s nothing, old lady, don’t make such a big gesture, I was just passing by, just lending a hand."
The surrounding people all praised, Lin Fan truly is a benevolent person, he saved four lives at once, really amazing.
Liang Cong and his family of four came down from the building and stood before Lin Fan.
At this moment, a woman dressed in professional attire hurriedly ran over, grabbing Liang Cong’s wife’s arm: "I heard you were going to jump off, I came over as soon as I heard, are you okay?"
Liang Cong’s wife said, "We’re okay now, this gentleman talked us down."
The professional woman let out a sound of surprise, casting a curious glance at Lin Fan. He’s impressive, managing to talk down someone from jumping, but how did he do it?
Liang Cong said with a smile, "This gentleman said Weichuang Shares will have good news in three days, we’ll be able to resolve our situation."
The professional woman frowned, looking at Lin Fan, said, "Pardon me, this gentleman, I’m responsible for their investments, I am their old classmate and good friend, and I’m quite earnest. Frankly, I was the one who told them this stock has no hope, even facing delisting because Weichuang’s problem this time is too big, there’s simply no hope."
Lin Fan sized up the professional woman, she indeed seemed like a typical career woman, her demeanor, her speech, completely like someone who’s been in this line of work for years, a bit of an old hand.
"You misjudged it," Lin Fan said lightly.
The professional woman was instantly a bit displeased. She was a strong, assertive person, not willing to be told she was wrong, she didn’t believe she was wrong.
The professional woman said, "I really thank you for saving them, you indeed did well at that. I know you said that to save them, originally I should have cooperated with you in this act, but I said, I’m an earnest person. You deceived them, giving them hope, what about after three days? After three days when issues remain or even get worse, the hope you gave them will turn into deeper despair."
Upon hearing this, Liang Cong and his wife changed their expression.
"What are you saying, he deceived us?" Liang Cong asked in surprise.
The professional woman said, "I can responsibly tell you, yes, but I hope you won’t attempt suicide again. Although he deceived you, it might be considered a kind lie. Since you’ve already come down, forget about suicide. What hurdle couldn’t you overcome?"
"I’m sorry, I’m doing this to save people too, saying it clearly to prevent them from falling into deeper despair in three days. I’m not targeting you," the professional woman added towards Lin Fan.
Lin Fan smiled a little, said, "You like being earnest, then I’ll be earnest with you—I didn’t deceive them, there will be surprises for Weichuang within three days."
The professional woman furrowed her brow, said, "Why are you...why are you like this? I said, I don’t blame you for deceiving them, you meant well, but at this moment, I only hope to make it clear, to truly save them, to prevent them from becoming more desperate and attempting to jump again in three days!"
"I also understand your intention, but I truly did not deceive them." Lin Fan spread his hands.
The professional woman was a little angry, said, "If you really think Weichuang has a chance, then it only shows you simply don’t understand the stock market, you don’t understand investment! You actually dare to argue with me. I graduated from the most prestigious financial university in Huaxia, then studied abroad for an MBA in the United States, and returned to work at Huaxia Securities with years of industry experience. What are your qualifications to say I’m wrong!"
This woman is very assertive, unable to tolerate being told she was wrong.
Lin Fan said, "In terms of education, I indeed don’t compare to you. I attended just an ordinary university, my major wasn’t finance, and I haven’t studied abroad in the United States."
The professional woman sneered coldly, "That’s you, you should recognize our gap, don’t pretend in front of me. Saving people is good, but pretending in front of me is absolutely wrong."
Lin Fan smiled, "I haven’t finished my words, although my academic qualifications are indeed lacking, I just made 20 million in the stock market today. Does that qualify me to speak with you?"
What?
Everyone was stunned.
What’s this?
Made 20 million in the stock market today?
Oh my, 20 million!
Everyone’s eyes turned red, wishing it had been them earning it, making 20 million in the stock market, that’s really envy inducing, even eye-catching.
The professional woman was also stunned, her voice trembling a bit, "You-you made 20 million in the stock market? Is this true?"
She has been doing investment for many years, never tried earning 20 million in a single day for someone, how did Lin Fan do it?
Lin Fan said, "Yes, I bought a stock with a million this morning, by afternoon closing, it had risen to 20 million."
The professional woman was amazed, blurting out, "Taikang Biopharmaceutical! Today’s hottest stock on the startup board, soared by twenty times at the closing! It was previously not favored by anyone, yet you invested a million at the opening! Oh my god, the rumor was true, it was you?"
Lin Fan’s foresight, his boldness, was unmatched, he was simply a genius in the stock market!
Lin Fan’s operation this morning has already become a legend in the stock market.

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Seems Like Missing Out on 100 Million
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Chapter 674: Seems Like Missing Out on 100 Million
Lin Fan possesses top-tier investment skills and knows the stock market inside out. If he wants to make money, he can. Calling him a stock market prodigy is entirely fitting.
Today, Lin Fan made 20 million in the stock market, merely as a small trial wager with Fan Zheyu.
But even so, he has already left behind a legend in the stock market, shocking countless investment managers. Lin Fan threw a hundred into Taikang Biopharmaceutical right as the market opened. Such foresight and courage—who else could do that?
The woman in professional attire was shocked to learn that Lin Fan was the legend of the stock market.
Initially, she doubted Lin Fan, but who dares to doubt him now? As they say, the strong are respected. To question Lin Fan, she’d have to earn more than him. The problem is, she could never make 20 million in a single day in her lifetime.
The professional woman wanted to kneel before Lin Fan. Despite having a prestigious college education, overseas study experience, and years in the stock market seeing numerous big shots, she had never kneeled to anyone.
Yet her knees were soft before Lin Fan.
"Brother, if you don’t believe me now, you can go back to the rooftop. I won’t accompany you, thanks. Could everyone move aside please?"
Lin Fan smiled and got into the Rolls-Royce Cullinan with Liu Mengjie.
People quickly made way, shocked to learn that Lin Fan made 20 million in a single day. In their eyes, Lin Fan suddenly became a towering presence, making them unconsciously seem humble in front of him.
The woman in professional attire watched the Rolls-Royce depart, murmuring, "What kind of Immortal is he exactly?"
She desperately wanted to stop Lin Fan and learn from him, even willing to serve as his maid just to absorb investment skills from him.
But evidently, Lin Fan did not give her this opportunity. She missed it, feeling as though she missed out on a billion.
For the rest of her life, she’d regret today’s events immensely, ashamed of missing the chance to learn from a super genius, the closest and only chance she had.
If she had known, she wouldn’t have shown off in front of Lin Fan earlier; thinking back to her bluff earlier makes her blush. It was like showing off one’s poor skills before true expertise!
Afterward, the professional woman posted about it in the group chat, saying she encountered a stock market wonder who made 20 million but didn’t know who he was.
This was an industry group chat.
Soon after she posted, she received a reply.
"I know who he is."
She checked the sender, an outstanding rising star in the industry currently serving as an investment consultant at HSBC, Fan Zheyu!
The professional woman quickly asked, "Mr. Fan, do you know who he is?"
Fan Zheyu replied, "His name is Lin Fan."
The professional woman stood stunned for a moment and suddenly realized something, exclaiming in shock, "Could it be? No way, could it be that Lin Fan?"
Fan Zheyu responded, "Indeed, he’s the richest man in Yun City."
The professional woman was petrified; it was indeed the richest man in Yun City, the legendary mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin! No wonder, no wonder he’s so remarkable!
For Lin Fan, saving Liang Cong’s family of four was just a small favor. He believed that once he said he made 20 million in the stock market in one day, Liang Cong’s family wouldn’t consider suicide anymore, so he didn’t linger.
"Little Fan." Liu Mengjie was silent until getting out of the car, contemplating something before suddenly calling out after exiting.
"Mm?" Lin Fan replied.
Liu Mengjie said, "You weren’t bluffing them about making 20 million in the stock market in one day, were you?"
Lin Fan smiled, "No bluffing, it’s true."
Liu Mengjie was surprised, "Little Fan, I knew you were great at business and a commercial genius. So you’re well-versed in the stock market too? Is there anything you’re not good at?"
Liu Mengjie was genuinely impressed by Lin Fan. To her knowledge, Lin Fan was astonishingly remarkable, seemingly adept at everything, and at the highest level too, almost like a deity.
Liu Mengjie was full of admiration for Lin Fan.
Lin Fan laughed, "I’m not that amazing. I’m currently just the richest man in Yun City. I’m still far from being the richest in Jiangnan, Huaxia, or the world. Sister Mengjie, I’m getting a bit hungry."
Liu Mengjie snapped back and laughed, "Okay, I’ll cook right away."
Later on, Liu Mengjie cooked a meal and finally managed to eat with Lin Fan, fulfilling a wish.
The two had a happy meal, chatting and laughing.
Lin Fan complimented the deliciousness of Liu Mengjie’s dishes, which pleased Liu Mengjie.
"You should come over often, I’ll cook for you." Liu Mengjie laughed.
Lin Fan said, "Mm, I’ll definitely come often."
After eating, it was still early. Liu Mengjie didn’t want Lin Fan to leave so soon, so she said, "Little Fan, sit down first. I’ll cut some fruits for you. Eating fruit post-meal is good for your health."
"Mm." Lin Fan sat on the sofa waiting.
Ring ring ring...
Liu Mengjie’s phone suddenly rang.
Liu Mengjie was still in the kitchen cutting fruit; Lin Fan glanced at it and saw the caller ID: President Chen.
This person again? Lin Fan frowned.
Liu Mengjie hurriedly walked out of the kitchen and picked up the phone, "Hello, President Chen, what’s up?"
"I’m at Dream KTV, booked a room. Come over, let’s chat." The other party said.
Liu Mengjie glanced at Lin Fan and said, "Sorry, President Chen, I really can’t make it tonight. Tomorrow then, come to the school, and we’ll talk."
The other party chuckled, "Miss Liu, I hope you understand that you’re the one with a request from me. Shouldn’t you be more positive? I’ve invited you several times, yet you’re so uncooperative. It’s not ideal, is it? If you don’t come tonight, there’s really no point in talking anymore."
Liu Mengjie was startled, hesitated for a bit, bit her lip, and said, "Fine then, President Chen, I’ll come over now. Okay, see you in a bit."
Hanging up, Liu Mengjie apologetically said, "Little Fan, it’s my old classmate again. He’s leaving tomorrow, so he’s asking to meet once. I have to go."
Lin Fan responded with an "Oh", even though Liu Mengjie didn’t use speaker mode, he heard the conversation between her and the other person clearly. The other party’s tone and words didn’t sound like what an old classmate would say.
Liu Mengjie must be hiding something.
Lin Fan said, "Mm, then I’ll also be leaving. Sister Mengjie, need me to give you a ride?"
Liu Mengjie said, "No need, Little Fan, you just came back from the countryside, must be tired from traveling. Go home and rest early; I’ll drive there myself."
Liu Mengjie deliberately concealed it, not wanting Lin Fan to know. Although Lin Fan could pretend not to know anything, he intuitively felt that this matter might not bode well for Liu Mengjie.
Being invited to KTV in the evening, hard to say if there wouldn’t be any ill intentions.
Lin Fan simply chose not to pretend and said, "Sister Mengjie, I know he’s not your old classmate. What’s really going on?"
Upon hearing this, Liu Mengjie sighed with a bitter smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 Lin Fan Pretends to be the Principal’s Assistant
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Chapter 675 Lin Fan Pretends to be the Principal’s Assistant
Liu Mengjie forced a bitter smile; after all, she couldn’t escape Lin Fan’s eyes.
"Little Fan, I didn’t want to bother you with this matter, so I kept it from you. However, you still figured it out. Since that’s the case, I’ll just tell you directly. It’s like this: Our Yun City Music Academy is a private university and has always relied on the shareholders’ capital to sustain itself. As the principal, to put it bluntly, I’m just a worker employed by the capital. I have a deep attachment to the school; it’s indeed a very good school that helps students succeed. But recently, a few major players on the board have fallen out and withdrawn their investments, even wanting to sell the school’s assets. The school may face closure."
"I don’t want the school to close. The only thing I can do is to find new investors, but I have always been focused solely on teaching. I am completely unfamiliar with this kind of thing. I don’t know how to bring in investments, what to discuss. I only hope that what I do won’t harm the school or the students."
Lin Fan was a bit surprised; so, this kind of thing happened at Yun City Music Academy!
"And this is why you’ve suddenly become interested in finance?" Lin Fan smiled.
Liu Mengjie’s face flushed, "Yes, I’m an investment novice. I need to catch up on this field quickly, hoping I can use it during negotiations."
Lin Fan asked, "Why didn’t you come to me?"
Liu Mengjie sighed, earnestly saying, "Little Fan, with what I know about you, you would certainly not ignore my difficulties. You might even give me money, but I don’t want that. I don’t want a monetary relationship between us, because I know that once it’s involved, there will be risks."
Lin Fan uttered an "Oh," "What kind of risks?"
Liu Mengjie said, "I once had two good friends, really great friends, who played together from a young age. Their relationship was particularly strong- even stronger than real brothers. But later, they started a company together, everyone contributed money, and in the end, do you know what happened? They fell out over profit distribution, even went to court, and the company eventually closed down. They became enemies as if they had a deep-seated grudge, probably never interacting till death. Stories like these two friends’ are not uncommon; money is sometimes a devil."
Liu Mengjie hoped that her relationship with Lin Fan would be pure, untangled with financial interests because she cherished Lin Fan too much and couldn’t accept one day turning against him over money issues.
Therefore, even though she knew Lin Fan was Yun City’s richest man, not lacking money, she did not ask Lin Fan for help.
She wanted to solve this issue herself.
Lin Fan understood Liu Mengjie’s feelings well. Money was a good thing, but as Liu Mengjie said, sometimes it’s also a devil.
Why is money called a devil?
Because many people lose their boundaries, lose their rationality, even lose their humanity for money.
People could sell their bodies, their souls for money, betray love, friendship, and family.
Since ancient times, humanity has committed countless evils because of money.
For money, father and son turn against each other, brothers become enemies. These are not fresh stories anymore.
Liu Mengjie’s concern is certainly not without reason.
If he invested in Yun City Music Academy, it would involve a financial relationship with Liu Mengjie. In the future, the academy’s profits would relate to him. It’s possible the academy could be a failed project, no profit. Then would he continue investing? If he wishes to withdraw investment, would Liu Mengjie be happy?
In short, as long as financial interests are involved, his relationship with Liu Mengjie would risk breaking, and the odds were high.
That’s why people often say good friends shouldn’t do business together, as it usually ends poorly, often breaking apart in disagreements.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Sister Mengjie, I understand your feelings. Alright, I promise you, I won’t invest in Yun City Music Academy. There won’t be any financial entanglement between us, is that okay?"
Liu Mengjie breathed a sigh of relief, "Yes, that’s good. Little Fan, don’t worry about this matter, just let me handle it."
Lin Fan said, "I won’t give you money, but can I offer you some advice?"
Liu Mengjie said, "That’s alright."
Lin Fan said, "Then, let me accompany you tonight. You are meeting with President Chen about investment matters, right? I’ll just listen in and help you check things over. How about that?"
Liu Mengjie thought for a moment, "Well, since I am indeed an investment novice. But Little Fan, what role should you play while going with me? If I introduce you as Yun City’s richest man, I’m afraid it might scare President Chen."
Lin Fan laughed, "That worry is indeed a bit funny. Let me accompany you as your assistant. If anything seems off, I’ll text you to ensure you won’t suffer losses."
In investments, there are many pitfalls. Liu Mengjie knows nothing and is easy to be taken advantage of, so having Lin Fan’s help gives her peace of mind.
Originally, Liu Mengjie was anxious, but hearing Lin Fan’s words, her heart settled down somehow. Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but think it’s truly great having Little Fan around.
Thus, Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie happily decided to meet President Chen together.
Dream KTV, inside a private room.
A portly middle-aged man sat in the booth, smoking a cigar. Beside him were two flamboyantly dressed women, accompanying him and eagerly encouraging him to drink.
"President Chen, I’ll toast to you." One woman raised her glass.
President Chen picked up his glass and drank it all.
"President Chen, what plans do you have tonight? How about letting the two of us accompany you?" Another woman giggled, brushing against President Chen’s hand casually.
Clearly an experienced player, quite the tease.
President Chen squinted, evaluating the two, then laughed, "If it were usual, tonight you two little vixens wouldn’t get away, but tonight is not possible."
"Ah, President Chen, why can’t it be tonight?" One woman pouted.
President Chen chuckled, "Because tonight I have a better choice. You two together wouldn’t match up to one of her fingers."
The two flamboyantly dressed women were a bit miffed but also very curious, "Hmph, President Chen, you’re exaggerating too much. Who is this person? We’re not even as good as one of her fingers?"
President Chen said, "Of course, this woman is a rare find I haven’t encountered in a long time. She’s the principal of a university music academy; can you compare?"
One woman giggled, "So President Chen likes this type, prefers older women!"
President Chen’s face turned sour instantly, "What older woman? Don’t assume principals are all old. This principal is younger than both of you. Haha, tonight I am truly blessed."

chapters.title: Chapter 676: Why Don’t I Drink It for Her
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chapter 676: Why Don’t I Drink It for Her
In President Chen’s mind, the image of Liu Mengjie appeared, with a mischievous glint in his eyes. To him, Liu Mengjie was a gem, and tonight he would possess this gem.
"President Chen, didn’t you say she was a principal? Would she be just like us women and agree to accompany you, President Chen?" a flamboyant woman said. President Chen had been praising Liu Mengjie’s beauty, and she seemed a little jealous.
President Chen said, "What do you know? Is there a woman in this world that I can’t conquer? Besides, this time she’s the one who needs something from me."
Another woman, catching on, quickly said, "Oh, come on, with President Chen’s charm, what woman wouldn’t like him? Just because she’s a principal doesn’t mean she’s so aloof. Everyone has a price, and President Chen can afford it, right?"
President Chen chuckled, giving the woman a pat on the butt. "You know how to talk."
At this moment, there was a knock on the door from outside.
President Chen smiled happily and said, "They’re here. You two step out for now! Come in!"
The two flamboyant women reluctantly stood up and walked out. Dealing with a big boss like President Chen, who was quite lucrative, they were happy to accompany him and naturally didn’t want to leave. As long as they were paid, they would do anything; the more money, the more they were willing to do.
As they reached the door, it opened from the outside, and Liu Mengjie walked in.
Upon seeing Liu Mengjie, the two flamboyant women instantly lost their temper. Even if they were jealous, they couldn’t deny Liu Mengjie’s exceptional beauty. Her mature and intellectual beauty and sophisticated demeanor made the two flashy women seem utterly inferior in comparison.
Seeing Liu Mengjie, President Chen was delighted and laughed heartily, "Miss Liu, come in and have a seat. We’ve been waiting for you for a while."
Liu Mengjie glanced at the two flamboyant women and frowned. This President Chen was quite the philanderer, evidently married but still fooling around. But then she thought, it had nothing to do with her; she was just here to seek investment. President Chen was a big boss and had the intention to invest, so she had to make an effort tonight.
Liu Mengjie walked in.
"Come, Miss Liu, have a seat over here." President Chen smiled, patting the seat beside him.
Liu Mengjie walked over but chose not to sit beside President Chen. Instead, she sat on the sofa to the side, several meters away. She certainly wasn’t going to sit so close to President Chen.
President Chen smiled indifferently. After all, the night was long, and he had time to take it slowly.
President Chen poured Liu Mengjie a drink, saying, "Here, Miss Liu, have a drink with me. Let’s chat slowly. This wine is quite good, don’t be shy."
Liu Mengjie apologized, "Sorry, President Chen, I don’t drink. How about we discuss..."
President Chen insisted, "No worries. This wine is light and won’t get you drunk. This bottle cost thousands, have a taste."
