Liu Mengjie wanted to decline.
President Chen said, "What, Miss Liu, not giving me face? We can discuss the investment later, but first, have this drink."
Liu Mengjie felt troubled. She really didn’t drink, but outright refusal seemed inappropriate, as it might be seen as disrespectful. Business discussions were not just about the business itself; building good relationships mattered more. When people were happy with drinks, talks flowed more smoothly, and business happened more naturally.
This is the so-called drinking culture. If you refuse a toast, it’s seen as disrespectful, and the counterpart would be unhappy. A refusal to drink is like saying no to face.
Many in sales and business, who originally couldn’t drink or had poor tolerance, have been forced to learn drinking. When they go on business discussions or attend dinners, the other party always encourages drinking. Not drinking isn’t an option, and to finalize business, they end up drinking, even at the risk of ruining their health.
Many dislike the drinking culture but can’t escape it because everyone is a participant. It’s vexing yet unavoidable in life.
With President Chen’s words, Liu Mengjie felt she couldn’t refuse anymore and reluctantly picked up the glass.
President Chen, seeing this, smiled contentedly. With a face full of confidence, he thought that dealing with this woman in front of him would be too easy.
The other party was seeking his investment, which gave him room to make demands. A woman, especially one who couldn’t handle alcohol, wouldn’t last long. A few drinks might be enough to knock her out.
Once she passed out, she would be at his mercy.
Thinking of this, President Chen was overjoyed.
Liu Mengjie, with a bitter smile, held the drink. She couldn’t not drink, so she reluctantly took a sip.
"Cough, cough..."
Liu Mengjie was choked by the strong alcohol and started to cough.
President Chen laughed heartily, like a cat watching a mouse under its paw. His prey was in place, and he could play slowly without rushing.
"No worries, Miss Liu, take your time. Once you finish this drink, we can talk properly. I have a lot of money and don’t know where to spend it. Your school needs funding, right? We can discuss it further," President Chen laughed.
She had to drink this glass. Liu Mengjie was struggling, but there was no way not to.
As she was troubled.
"How about I help her with it?"
A voice came, and Lin Fan walked in from outside. Without waiting for President Chen’s response, he took the glass from Liu Mengjie’s hand and drank it in one go.
"Ah, good wine, good wine." After finishing the drink, Lin Fan smacked his lips, savoring the taste. It was indeed a fine wine worth thousands, of course, not unpleasant.
A man suddenly appeared, which surprised President Chen. "And you are...?"
Lin Fan leaned over, extended his hand, and grasped President Chen’s hand with a cheerful smile, "Hello, President Chen, my surname is Lin. Just call me Little Lin. I’m Sister Mengjie’s assistant."
Lin Fan had prearranged with Liu Mengjie to accompany her for the business discussion with President Chen, posing as the principal’s assistant.
By drinking Liu Mengjie’s glass, Lin Fan disrupted President Chen’s plan, and President Chen was displeased. But as the saying goes, you can’t scold someone offering an apology, nor can you hit a smiling face. Lin Fan’s proactive enthusiasm and smiling demeanor left President Chen unable to be mad.
"Hehe," President Chen chuckled, "Miss Liu, I didn’t know you brought an assistant."
President Chen inwardly cursed, initially thinking Liu Mengjie had come alone, which made it easier for him to subdue her. With Lin Fan now on the scene, the situation became challenging.
Lin Fan’s presence, drinking on her behalf, gave Liu Mengjie a sigh of relief and a sense of peace. Having Lin Fan here was truly comforting.
"Sorry, President Chen. I didn’t mention it beforehand. I’m feeling under the weather tonight and can’t drive, so I had my assistant bring me here. He was parking earlier, so I came up first. I hope you don’t mind, President Chen?" Liu Mengjie said.
Though displeased, President Chen couldn’t openly express that. He chuckled, "Oh, not at all."
Lin Fan said, "Exactly, Sister Mengjie can’t drink, so I’ll accompany President Chen for a couple of drinks. Come, President Chen, let me fill it up and toast to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 677: President Chen Wants to Send Away Lin Fan
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Chapter 677: President Chen Wants to Send Away Lin Fan
In President Chen’s original plan, discussing investment with Liu Mengjie tonight was secondary. Compared to investment, he was obviously more interested in Liu Mengjie herself. He would keep persuading Liu Mengjie to drink until she collapsed, then he could have his way with her.
Who knew that Lin Fan would appear unexpectedly. President Chen cursed inwardly, wishing he could immediately chase Lin Fan away. But since Lin Fan was Liu Mengjie’s assistant, he couldn’t directly ask him to leave, as that would mean turning against Liu Mengjie.
He still wanted to win over Liu Mengjie, so of course, he couldn’t sour the relationship.
For now, he could only find a way to get rid of the annoying assistant.
President Chen sneered inwardly. He couldn’t believe that he, the mighty President Chen, the Big Boss, couldn’t handle a little assistant.
Lin Fan enthusiastically refilled the glasses, saying he wanted to toast to President Chen.
For the sake of Liu Mengjie, President Chen naturally couldn’t refuse Lin Fan. He picked up his glass and downed a drink with Lin Fan.
After a glass of wine, President Chen’s face turned a bit red.
This wine was not low in alcohol as President Chen claimed. In fact, it had a strong after-effect, making it easy to get drunk. President Chen specifically chose it to quickly intoxicate Liu Mengjie. Even President Chen himself didn’t dare to drink too much; how could he conduct serious business if he got drunk?
"President Chen, would you like more? This wine is really good, hard to resist having a few more glasses. How about I toast you again?" Lin Fan said enthusiastically.
President Chen quickly replied, "That’s enough. Young man, you should take it slow when drinking, don’t rush."
Only then did Lin Fan stop, laughing, "President Chen is right. Sister Mengjie, President Chen said he won’t drink anymore, so it looks like you can start talking about the investment. You two continue."
Lin Fan sneered internally. Damn this drinking culture. President Chen was trying to use this trick on Liu Mengjie, so Lin Fan responded in kind. It’s just drinking; make him drink until he doesn’t want to anymore.
Lin Fan had come from humble beginnings and had worked for a company before; he’s very familiar with this drinking culture. Moreover, Lin Fan could hold his liquor well. With the Strengthening Blood Serum Capsules, he could drink endlessly without getting drunk. He was not afraid of drinking with President Chen, just worried President Chen wouldn’t dare to drink!
Liu Mengjie gratefully glanced at Lin Fan. If it weren’t for him, she would have been forced to drink, and it would have been troublesome if she got drunk. As a woman without support, who would take care of her if she got drunk?
Liu Mengjie then turned to President Chen, smiling, "Well, President Chen, why don’t we discuss the investment? I came with great sincerity this time, hoping to get your investment. Here’s my project proposal, please take a look."
Liu Mengjie took a folder out of her briefcase and handed it to President Chen.
President Chen accepted the folder but didn’t open it. He tossed it casually onto the table, saying, "No need to look at it. Let me put it this way: I have a lot of money. I can throw it at any project. Whether it loses money or makes money, I’m not too concerned. What I really care about is people."
Those words were quite pretentious.
Liu Mengjie didn’t know what to say for a moment, so she smiled, "President Chen, I know you’re wealthy and don’t care about money, but I want to say that investing in our school would certainly not be a mistake. In terms of returns, it won’t let you suffer losses..."
President Chen interrupted Liu Mengjie, "Oh, let’s not get into that. As I said, I don’t care about the project; I care more about people."
Liu Mengjie could only ask, "President Chen, what do you mean?"
President Chen said, "I hope that after I invest this money in your school, you can give me the respect I deserve. I like people with high cooperation levels. Otherwise, if they are uncooperative and keep opposing me after I invest, I wouldn’t invest in such people. Miss Liu, do you see any problem with this?"
Liu Mengjie said somewhat confusedly, "I don’t know what you mean by cooperation levels, President Chen. If it’s about the school’s management, I definitely respect the board’s opinions. Based on past experiences, I’ve usually followed the board members’ wishes. However, past boards have given me considerable freedom and didn’t meddle too much in the school’s specific operations. This is negotiable."
President Chen said, "All right, let me conduct a test. This Little Lin is Miss Liu’s assistant, right? Can I ask him to do something?"
Liu Mengjie said, "Well, is there anything he can help you with, President Chen?"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "President Chen, I am Sister Mengjie’s assistant, and I listen to her. If you’re going to be Sister Mengjie’s boss, then of course I’ll listen to my boss’s boss."
President Chen said, "All right, I’ll give you a task now. Go get us some snacks. I want roast duck from De Xinglong, specifically from the Nanshan District branch. I like their sauce. Take a taxi and buy it now. Miss Liu, this roast duck is very delicious, and I’m treating you to some. Like I said, doing business is secondary; making friends is the priority. Once the friendship is there, business naturally follows, wouldn’t you say?"
Liu Mengjie couldn’t say no, so she just nodded, "Mm-hmm."
President Chen turned to Lin Fan, smiling, "Young man, you can start now. De Xinglong closes at nine. You have ten minutes to get there, and it’s better to take a taxi for speed. You should be back in about an hour."
An hour should be enough.
In one hour, with Lin Fan gone, it would be enough for him to handle Liu Mengjie. By the time Lin Fan was back, he and Liu Mengjie would already be at the hotel.
Getting rid of a little assistant shouldn’t be a problem. President Chen thought smugly.
Lin Fan dragged out an "oh" sound. How could he not understand? This pretentious President Chen talked so much, just to get him out of the way. He found Lin Fan’s presence obstructive.
It seems this President Chen indeed has no good intentions.
"Okay, no problem, President Chen. I’m heading out now." Lin Fan stood up.
President Chen chuckled to himself, "Go on, when you return, I’ll reimburse your taxi fare."
With that, Lin Fan walked out.
The room was left with only Liu Mengjie and President Chen.
Finally, they got Lin Fan out of the way, President Chen thought proudly. Now with only Liu Mengjie, she’s easier to deal with.
"Miss Liu, let’s continue. Here, let’s have a drink first." President Chen said, filling the wine again with a smile.
Liu Mengjie smiled bitterly inside. Lin Fan had just left, and now President Chen was already coaxing her to drink again. She had no choice but to drink if she wanted to continue discussing business.
"President Chen, I’ll toast to you." Liu Mengjie had no choice but to take the glass, forcing a smile.
President Chen watched Liu Mengjie, sneering inwardly, "Drink up, drink up. Soon you’ll be down. By the time your assistant is back, you’ll already be mine."
Seeing Liu Mengjie about to drink up.
"Sister Mengjie, why are you drinking?"
Suddenly, Lin Fan walked back in, grabbing Liu Mengjie’s drink and downing it in one go.
What?
How did Lin Fan come back so quickly?
President Chen was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 678: The Roast Duck King Personally Delivers the Meal
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Chapter 678: The Roast Duck King Personally Delivers the Meal
President Chen thought that by sending Lin Fan away, he could have his way with Liu Mengjie, so he asked Mengjie to drink again. Unexpectedly, before Mengjie even took a sip, Lin Fan came back and drank for her.
"President Chen, this wine is really good," Lin Fan said with a smile.
President Chen was furious, almost about to explode, and forced himself to stay calm, "Didn’t I tell you to go to De Xinglong to buy roast duck? How did you come back so quickly?"
Lin Fan laughed, "It’s just roast duck, a small matter. I’ve already handled it and ensure that President Chen gets the most authentic De Xinglong roast duck as quickly as possible. Very soon, the roast duck will be delivered, and if President Chen can find a single flaw, I’ll admit defeat."
President Chen smirked inwardly, no doubt thinking this assistant was being clever, ordering takeout. If takeout could be authentic, that would be a miracle.
"You said it yourself. If I’m not satisfied, I’ll punish you," President Chen chuckled.
Lin Fan said, "Of course, come, President Chen, let’s continue drinking."
Lin Fan filled himself and President Chen’s glasses.
After a few glasses, President Chen was starting to feel overwhelmed, but Lin Fan was unfazed.
President Chen was secretly astonished. Liu Mengjie’s assistant could really drink. Although President Chen thought he could drink well after years of experience, in front of Lin Fan, he was like a novice.
A pot of wine was soon finished, and Lin Fan called out, "Waiter, could you come in? Please bring us three more bottles of this wine. Tonight, President Chen and I are going to drink to our hearts’ content. After all, it’s on President Chen tonight, no need to be polite with him."
The waiter nodded and was about to fetch the wine.
President Chen was startled, not because the wine was expensive, with three bottles costing just over 10,000, which was nothing to President Chen, but mainly because Lin Fan ordered three bottles in one breath. He definitely didn’t want to keep drinking with Lin Fan; it would be deadly.
"Hold on, young man, don’t be so aggressive when drinking; you need to take care of your health. You can go now," President Chen waved him off, dismissing the waiter.
Lin Fan said emotionally, "President Chen really knows how to care for others. I’m just a little assistant, and President Chen reminds me kindly like this. I’m so touched. Alright, for the sake of health, no one should drink tonight. Whoever drinks is a damn fool!"
President Chen: "..."
He was the one who first suggested not drinking. If he opposed Lin Fan now, he’d be slapping himself in the face. How could the dignified President Chen do that?
Liu Mengjie laughed, "Little Fan’s suggestion is good. I agree. President Chen, let’s not drink tonight."
President Chen forced a smile and nodded, but he was already very displeased with Lin Fan. Without drinking, how would he get Liu Mengjie drunk? Lin Fan was doing this on purpose, ruining his plans!
President Chen just wanted to get rid of Lin Fan quickly, but he couldn’t think of an excuse for the moment.
After a while, the waiter came in and said, "Gentlemen, the De Xinglong roast duck you ordered has arrived."
President Chen was delighted to hear that. Here came the chance. In a moment, he could nitpick on the roast duck and use it as an excuse to get rid of Lin Fan. After all, they had agreed that if he was not satisfied with the duck, he could punish Lin Fan!
"Bring it quickly!" President Chen said.
The waiter opened the door, stepped aside, and in came a middle-aged man carrying a platter with a cover over it.
"President Chen, your roast duck is here," the middle-aged man said cheerfully.
Upon seeing the middle-aged man, President Chen was shocked and blurted out, "President Jiang, why are you here in person?"
This middle-aged man turned out to be President Jiang, the current owner of De Xinglong!
The Jiang Family’s De Xinglong had a hundred-year history of making roast ducks, with a unique method created by their ancestors. The duck’s taste was exceptional, drawing crowds daily, establishing De Xinglong as a renowned local dining giant in Yun City, rivaling Quanjude in Jing City.
This President Jiang was the third-generation inheritor of the Jiang Family’s duck cooking skills. It was said that he had mastered his ancestors’ techniques and innovated further, making the duck taste even better, earning him the title of Roast Duck King.
However, President Jiang rarely personally cooked the roast ducks anymore, so it was very special to eat a duck made by him.
Now, President Jiang personally came to deliver the roast duck. This was a miraculous thing, no wonder President Chen was astonished.
President Jiang smiled, "I heard President Chen wanted to eat roast duck. Coincidentally, I was free at the store today, felt like stretching myself a bit, so I personally made it and decided to bring it over myself. Here, President Chen, try it while it’s hot."
President Chen was taken aback. Coincidentally at the store, feeling like stretching, moving around a bit? This was too coincidental and felt a bit unreal.
As President Jiang spoke, he lifted the lid, releasing a puff of steam, and with it, a mouth-watering aroma filled the room. Just smelling it made one eager to dig in.
President Jiang personally carved the roast duck and had President Chen taste it.
President Chen quickly said, "How could I trouble you, President Jiang!"
President Jiang laughed, "No trouble, I just want you to taste it and see how my skills are. Please, President Chen, give it a try."
So President Chen tasted a piece.
President Jiang eagerly asked, "How is it, President Chen? Is it good?"
President Chen originally intended to find faults, but now he didn’t dare. It would be disrespectful to President Jiang.
"Delicious! President Jiang’s skills are amazing! This is the best roast duck I’ve ever eaten!" President Chen gave a thumbs up.
Lin Fan smiled from the side, "I told you, if President Chen could find the slightest flaw, it would be my loss. De Xinglong’s roast duck is the best. Seems like I won’t be punished this time!"
President Chen glanced at Lin Fan, feeling suspicious. He had asked Lin Fan to buy De Xinglong’s roast duck, and while Lin Fan ordered takeout, De Xinglong’s President Jiang ended up personally delivering it. Was this all arranged or merely a coincidence?
If it was arranged, how could Lin Fan, a mere assistant, have persuaded President Jiang of De Xinglong? It must be a coincidence. It just seemed that Lin Fan was incredibly lucky, coincidentally having President Jiang deliver the takeout, leaving President Chen with no faults to find!
President Jiang also personally carved some roast duck for Liu Mengjie and Lin Fan to taste.
After trying it, they both gave a thumbs up, genuinely impressed.
"President Jiang, your roast duck is truly excellent. Next time, I’ll definitely bring some friends to eat at your place," Lin Fan smiled.
President Jiang, not knowing exactly why, seemed almost hesitant to look directly at Lin Fan, just said with a laugh, "You’re more than welcome."
After a while, President Jiang said, "I have some other things to attend to, so I won’t disturb you further. Enjoy your meal. I shall take my leave first."
With that, President Jiang said his goodbyes and left.
Lin Fan chuckled, "I never expected that De Xinglong’s owner would personally come to deliver roast duck. It must be thanks to President Chen’s reputation. President Jiang must have come because he knew you were here."
Lin Fan’s words pleased President Chen greatly, but President Chen knew better. His reputation wasn’t enough to make President Jiang personally show up. This must have been a coincidence.
Lin Fan indeed found it amusing in his heart. This, of course, was not a coincidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 679: I Owe President Jiang a Favor
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chapter 679: I Owe President Jiang a Favor
The owner of De Xinglong, known as the King of Roast Duck, President Jiang, happened to be in the store just as Lin Fan placed a takeaway order. He happened to be free, happened to feel an itch to cook, and happened to want to stretch his muscles, so he personally cooked and delivered the meal. What a coincidence!
Regardless, the appearance of President Jiang foiled President Chen’s plan to find faults.
President Chen was frustrated. It was unclear whether Liu Mengjie, this assistant, did it on purpose or inadvertently, but she had ruined his plan. He originally intended to get Liu Mengjie drunk, but because of Lin Fan, he couldn’t use alcohol.
With this kid staying here, his chances of having a shot with Liu Mengjie tonight were essentially zero. President Chen was unwilling to give up, damn it, he had to think of a way to get rid of this kid!
"Sister Mengjie, I just remembered my car has some issues and needs a repair. How about this? You and President Chen discuss work here, and I’ll go get the car fixed first," Lin Fan suddenly said.
Liu Mengjie responded with an "Oh," and said, "How long will you be gone?"
Lin Fan replied, "Not long, about an hour or so. When Sister Mengjie wants to leave, just call me, and I’ll come to pick you up."
Liu Mengjie said, "Okay, you go ahead."
Lin Fan came tonight to accompany her, keeping the drinks at bay, which satisfied her a lot. Now that they agreed not to drink, she wasn’t worried.
"President Chen, I’m off," Lin Fan said with a smile.
"Alright, go on," President Chen replied, already overjoyed. He was worried about not having an excuse to send this annoying young man off, and here Lin Fan was, leaving on his own, which truly felt like a divine intervention and a blessed surprise!
And so, Lin Fan walked outside.
Outside the KTV, a Bentley was parked nearby, with a middle-aged man standing quietly beside it, seemingly waiting for something. It was none other than Jiang, the owner of De Xinglong.
"President Jiang."
Suddenly, Lin Fan appeared, coming in front of President Jiang.
President Jiang immediately moved closer, respectfully saying, "Mr. Lin, I didn’t expect to see you tonight, what an honor!"
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I should thank you, President Jiang, for personally delivering the roast duck. It couldn’t be helped, I had to stay and watch over my friend, I couldn’t leave."
That President Chen wanted to send him away to order roast duck from De Xinglong, clearly intending to get rid of him, but of course, Lin Fan couldn’t let President Chen succeed, so he called President Jiang instead.
Lin Fan had met many of Yun City’s bigwigs at a previous business association, including the famous roast duck king, President Jiang. Lin Fan, the richest man in Yun City, and the mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin, who wouldn’t want to make his acquaintance? President Jiang personally came to talk with Lin Fan back then.
President Jiang sincerely admired Lin Fan from the bottom of his heart.
Tonight he received an unexpected call from Lin Fan, and immediately came to deliver the roast duck himself. How else would he express respect to Lin Fan if he didn’t deliver it personally?
However, it was strange that Mr. Lin instructed him not to reveal Lin’s identity, just to pretend not to know Mr. Lin.
Even though Jiang didn’t quite understand, since Mr. Lin wanted to do it this way, there must be a reason, so earlier inside, he pretended not to know Lin Fan, but out of heartfelt respect, he was still a bit anxious and didn’t dare to look directly at Mr. Lin.
"No problem, no problem, being able to assist Mr. Lin is my honor," Jiang quickly said.
Lin Fan smiled, "President Jiang, you delivered the roast duck so quickly, it wasn’t personally made by you, was it?"
President Jiang’s old face flushed, and he said, "Well... it really wasn’t, the process of making roast duck is quite complicated, it can’t be done so fast, I delivered a ready-made one."
Lin Fan found it amusing, since the roast duck wasn’t personally made by President Jiang, faults could definitely be found, but with President Jiang present, even if President Chen did find any faults, it would still seem flawless.
Lin Fan laughed and said, "Thanks to President Jiang this time, I owe you a favor."
President Jiang was overjoyed; with Lin Fan’s words, his trip wasn’t in vain tonight!
In Yun City, very few could make President Jiang personally deliver roast duck, and Lin Fan was definitely one, because of his status as the richest, masterful and mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin, which makes this favor particularly significant!
Lin Fan’s promise to owe him a favor could potentially be of great assistance one day!
Indeed, later on, President Jiang encountered a difficulty where he almost lost his life, and it was Lin Fan who helped save him, returning the favor. But that was a story for another time.
Subsequently, President Jiang bid farewell and left, this time for real. His earlier farewell inside the private room was just a guise to come outside and wait for Mr. Lin since he had agreed to chat a bit with Lin Fan.
After President Jiang left, Lin Fan sat on the steps nearby to rest a bit.
Of course, he wasn’t really going to repair a car; it was just an excuse to deceive President Chen. Lin Fan could now be certain that this President Chen had malicious intentions, and he wanted to see what this guy was capable of doing.
Inside the private room.
After Lin Fan left, President Chen was extremely happy; this annoying assistant was finally gone. Saying he had to fix a car that would take over an hour, wasn’t this a golden opportunity!
An hour was more than enough time for him to do whatever he wanted.
"President Chen, why don’t we talk about the school investment issue?" Liu Mengjie suggested. Her purpose for staying here or coming tonight was to discuss investment with President Chen, and besides that, she had nothing else to discuss nor was she interested.
But President Chen laughed and said, "Investment is just like that; I’ve said I have plenty of money. Tonight we’re primarily here to make friends and have fun. Business is just a small part."
Liu Mengjie was momentarily at a loss for words. As the principal, she never had to worry about money before, just focusing on the educational work. Therefore, she wasn’t familiar with these dining and drinking gatherings. Is this how business is discussed?
Everyone gets together, not to discuss serious business but to eat, drink, and have fun!
She wasn’t entirely wrong, as generally, drinking and dining events are all about eating, drinking, and having fun. Serious business discussions happen in the office. President Chen invited her here, which, in his view, already implied a tacit mutual understanding.
Thankfully, although Liu Mengjie didn’t understand, Lin Fan did. President Chen invited Liu Mengjie to the KTV, ostensibly to discuss business, but in reality, what good could come of it? If Liu Mengjie got drunk, anything could happen, and Liu Mengjie would undoubtedly come out on the losing end.
"Miss Liu, how about having a couple of drinks with me?" President Chen said with a sly smile.
Liu Mengjie was startled and quickly said, "Wasn’t it agreed that no one would be drinking tonight?"
President Chen laughed, "Right, your assistant was serious about it; whoever drinks tonight is a cowardly fool. I wouldn’t want to be a cowardly fool. How about we drink water instead of alcohol, would that be acceptable?"
Saying this, President Chen poured a glass of water for himself and Liu Mengjie.
Liu Mengjie breathed a sigh of relief, as drinking water was not an issue.
"Come on, aren’t you a teacher at a music academy? Pick a song, and we’ll duet on one," President Chen said with a mischievous expression, ready to take his time with Liu Mengjie with Lin Fan gone, having plenty of time.
Liu Mengjie didn’t really want to duet with President Chen, but thinking about the investment, she had to bear it. Moreover, in a KTV, singing a song together wasn’t that bad of a request.
"I’ll have a look then," Liu Mengjie said, standing up and walking to the song selection station, starting to browse.
At this moment, Liu Mengjie was facing away from President Chen.
President Chen glanced at Liu Mengjie, and while she wasn’t looking, suddenly, his hand quickly pulled out a small bottle from his pocket, shaking some white powder into Liu Mengjie’s glass of water.
The powder dissolved instantly in the water, leaving no trace.
President Chen’s lips curled into a sinister smile, no alcohol then a little trick to make you obediently collapse!

chapters.title: Chapter 680
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Chapter 680
President Chen took advantage of Liu Mengjie’s inattention and mixed a powder into her water. The powder quickly dissolved, becoming completely untraceable.
After doing this, President Chen acted as if nothing had happened, smiling as he asked, "Miss Liu, have you decided what song you’d like to duet with me?"
Liu Mengjie replied, "I’ve decided. Let’s sing the duet ’Strive to Win’."
She thought it over and wasn’t really keen on singing a duet with President Chen, but for the sake of investment, she had to endure. Singing love songs was definitely not suitable, and she was even less willing to sing those.
President Chen laughed and said, "Miss Liu, we’re here to have fun, don’t always think about work. It’s not interesting that way. Let me pick a song. I love Cantonese songs, so let’s sing Song God’s ’Love in the Wind and Rain’."
Liu Mengjie broke into a sweat. This was a love song about two people yearning for each other. She had no intention of singing such an ambiguous song with President Chen.
"Miss Liu, don’t tell me you can’t sing this? You’re the dean of the music academy, what song can’t you sing?" President Chen teased.
Liu Mengjie said, "I can sing it, but I’m not good at Cantonese. I just worry about embarrassing myself. How about this, I’ll practice Cantonese when I return and we can sing it next time. This time, I’ll sing a song to entertain President Chen, and you can judge how well I sing."
President Chen made an oh sound and said, "Alright then, Miss Liu, please sing."
Dueting with Liu Mengjie wasn’t the main point; getting her to sing was what mattered. As long as Liu Mengjie sang, it was fine.
Liu Mengjie secretly felt lucky; fortunately, she was clever enough not to sing a duet with President Chen.
So, Liu Mengjie sang a song by herself. As expected of the dean of the music academy, she sang beautifully.
President Chen applauded and praised, "Miss Liu sings so well, truly worthy of being the dean of the music academy, quite impressive. Miss Liu, after singing for so long, I bet you’re a little thirsty. Here, have a drink of water."
President Chen eagerly picked up the water glass and handed it to Liu Mengjie.
Liu Mengjie had no clue that something had been added to this glass of water. She was kind-hearted and never imagined the sinister intentions of others. President Chen would use such a despicable trick on her.
Instead, she thought President Chen was quite considerate.
Plus, she was indeed a little thirsty, so Liu Mengjie didn’t think much and accepted the water glass.
President Chen watched Liu Mengjie with a grin, just waiting for her to drink the water.
Just as Liu Mengjie was about to drink, there was a knock on the door, and a waiter came in, saying, "Mr. Chen, I’m sorry to disturb you, but I need you to come out with me for a moment."
Being interrupted by the waiter, Liu Mengjie stopped and didn’t drink the water, curiously looking at the waiter.
President Chen was a little annoyed; the waiter had come at a bad time and grumbled, "What’s the matter?"
The waiter said, "It’s your car, Mr. Chen. Someone has smashed it."
"What?" President Chen was taken aback and quickly followed the waiter out, not caring about much else.
President Chen’s car was parked in the open square of the KTV. The car body was dented by someone who smashed it with a wine bottle, according to reports. After a security guard recognized it as President Chen’s car, he reported it to the KTV night manager.
President Chen was a wealthy man, driving a Porsche Cayenne worth over a million, and this was no small matter. The manager quickly sent someone to inform President Chen.
Seeing his beloved car with a dent, repair costs estimated to be at least a hundred thousand, President Chen was heartbroken. He could afford it, but seeing his beloved car damaged like this made him angry!
"Damn it, who did it? Were they caught?" President Chen fumed.
The manager said, "I’m sorry, President Chen, the drunkard ran away after being spotted by the security guard, and wasn’t caught."
President Chen barked, "Check the surveillance cameras and find that person for me!"
The manager said, "I thought the same, but I’m really sorry, the surveillance cameras here are broken."
President Chen was stunned and said, "What does that mean?"
The manager said, "It means it’s now impossible to track down who smashed it. President Chen, may I suggest that you report this to the police? It might be better handled by them, but it will likely be more troublesome."
President Chen didn’t want to involve the police; indeed, it would be quite troublesome, as the police would take statements, examine the scene, and it might go on until late at night.
President Chen only wanted to get Liu Mengjie alone, so he didn’t want to waste time on this.
"Forget it, I’ll consider myself unlucky!"
President Chen waved his hand, resigning himself to the bad luck. "Keep an eye on things for me..."
President Chen grumbled a few words to the security guard and then grudgingly went back to the private room, still thinking about Liu Mengjie.
Back in the private room, Liu Mengjie was sitting there, singing alone.
President Chen glanced at the table and noticed that the two glasses of water hadn’t been touched, meaning Liu Mengjie hadn’t drunk any water yet.
Seeing President Chen come in, Liu Mengjie stopped and curiously asked, "President Chen, what happened?"
President Chen said, "Nothing major, just my car got smashed by a drunkard, but it’s been taken care of."
Liu Mengjie responded, "These drunks are really annoying."
President Chen said, "Aren’t they? Such poor drinking habits. Miss Liu, aren’t you thirsty? Why haven’t you drunk any water?"
Liu Mengjie smiled, "Once I started singing a song, I got addicted and ended up singing two more. I forgot to drink water. What’s the matter? Why does President Chen keep asking me to drink water?"
President Chen felt guilty and chuckled, "Nothing, I was just thinking you might be thirsty from all the singing."
Liu Mengjie said, "I am a bit."
She put down the microphone, walked over, picked up her glass of water, and said, "President Chen, I won’t be drinking alcohol. I might be a bit rude tonight, so I’ll toast you with water instead."
"Alright!" President Chen laughed heartily, raised his glass of water, clinked it with Liu Mengjie’s, and quickly drank it down first, fearing that Liu Mengjie wouldn’t drink hers.
"Miss Liu, please!" President Chen said, watching Liu Mengjie with a mix of anticipation in his eyes. He eagerly awaited her drinking the water so that he could manipulate the situation to his advantage.
The substance he added to Liu Mengjie’s water, in his view, was something good. It could make Liu Mengjie lose her inhibitions and become dazed by desire.
Liu Mengjie was oblivious, and naturally, she lifted her head and drank, gulping down more than half the glass.
President Chen watched with delight, feeling reassured. Liu Mengjie had finally drunk the water, and soon he could have his way with the beauty. Once the deed was done, Liu Mengjie would be unable to do anything because most women valued their reputation and would usually endure such shameful matters in silence.
By exploiting this mindset, President Chen had succeeded many times before, which was why he was so brazen.
Now, he just had to wait for the effects to kick in, as he watched Liu Mengjie, his face nearly breaking into a crooked smile.
But huh!
Wait a minute!
After drinking the water, why was Liu Mengjie showing no reaction?
Instead, he himself was feeling increasingly hot.
"President Chen, what’s wrong? Why is your face so red?" Liu Mengjie blinked, curiously examining President Chen.
President Chen felt as if the world was spinning, suddenly realizing something, and was struck with panic. He was done for!
At that moment, the door to the private room swung open, and in came Lin Fan and the KTV manager.

chapters.title: Chapter 681
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Chapter 681
Before losing his mind, President Chen watched as the door of the private room opened and Lin Fan walked in, accompanied by the night manager.
President Chen instantly realized that he seemed to have been played.
However, in an instant, his body was engulfed by a burning sensation, feeling like he was swallowed whole by a raging fire, losing all reason!
"I’m so hot, so hot, I need, I need!" President Chen completely lost his mind, leaving only an instinct, a primal human impulse driving him, he collapsed on the ground, writhing, craving...
Seeing President Chen in such a disgraceful state, Liu Mengjie was stunned, her face somewhat pale.
If she had drunk that glass of water earlier, she would be in the same state now. Just thinking about it made her shudder.
"President Chen, what do you need, do you want a woman?" Lin Fan asked with a smile.
President Chen had no reason left, only instinct: "Woman, I need a woman..."
Lin Fan then turned to the night manager and said: "President Chen says he wants a woman, you know what to do."
"Yes." The night manager replied obsequiously, picking up the walkie-talkie and saying, "Mama, bring over a few more girls."
After saying that, the night manager put down the walkie-talkie and said respectfully: "Mr. Lin, fortunately, you discovered this in time. If this scoundrel really did such a thing, it would not be allowed in our KTV."
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Just follow your rules."
The night manager hurriedly said: "Mr. Lin, Brother Zhen has instructed that I listen to Mr. Lin about how to deal with this person, just leave it to Mr. Lin to decide."
The "Brother Zhen" he mentioned is the current underground boss of Yun City, Li Zhen.
This Dream KTV, trying to mix in Yun City, dared not offend the underground boss, Li Zhen. A call from Li Zhen and everyone in the KTV would have to listen to Lin Fan, including the owner here.
The smashing of President Chen’s car was naturally arranged by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan staged this play just to get President Chen to leave, a trick known as "luring the tiger away from the mountain."
While President Chen went to deal with the car issue, Lin Fan returned to the private room.
At that time, Liu Mengjie knew nothing and was suddenly very curious to see Lin Fan return: "Little Fan, you’re back so soon, is the car fixed?"
Lin Fan said: "No, I didn’t go to fix the car at all, I just made an excuse to leave, wanting to see what this President Chen was up to. Sister Mengjie, you can’t drink this water, President Chen added something to it."
Liu Mengjie was taken aback: "What did he add?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly and said: "You’ll know in a moment."
Saying this, Lin Fan switched the positions of Liu Mengjie’s and President Chen’s water.
Whatever was added to this water, let President Chen drink it himself and he would know.
It turned out that Lin Fan had already contacted Li Zhen. After Li Zhen called the boss of the KTV, this KTV was already essentially under Lin Fan’s control. Lin Fan knew everything about President Chen’s every move in the private room.
When President Chen added something to the water, Lin Fan naturally saw it, thus creating this scene of "luring the tiger away from the mountain."
President Chen would never have thought he was completely outsmarted by Lin Fan and thought he had succeeded. Seeing Liu Mengjie drink the water, he proudly waited for the drug to take effect.
He never dreamed that Liu Mengjie wouldn’t have a reaction, but he himself did.
In the last moment of losing his mind, seeing Lin Fan push the door open and come in, he realized he was tricked by Lin Fan again.
Liu Mengjie looked at President Chen’s bewildered state and felt both fear and anger, saying: "I really didn’t expect him to be this kind of person. Had I known, I wouldn’t have looked to him for investment!"
This matter was certainly over. Even if President Chen begged her in the future, she wouldn’t want any of his money. President Chen’s character was too low, doing such things should get him thrown in prison!
She definitely didn’t want to have any dealings with such a person in the future, so naturally, she couldn’t accept President Chen’s investment anymore.
Truly, you can’t judge a book by its cover!
Fortunately, Lin Fan was there; otherwise, she would have been at President Chen’s mercy tonight, and the consequences would have been unimaginable. If President Chen had succeeded, Liu Mengjie felt she couldn’t bear such humiliation and would probably have to take her life; otherwise, she’d live in nightmares for the rest of her life.
Lin Fan smiled and said: "Now you know, it’s not too late. Don’t deal with such people for business in the future; such people are not interested in investing, they are only interested in you."
Liu Mengjie blushed and said: "I will never attend such appointments in the future. If there’s anything, we can talk about it in the office in broad daylight, strictly business."
Liu Mengjie was genuinely scared now. She should not have attended such drinking parties. It was only because she was too eager to find investment that she came, nearly falling into a trap.
Unfortunately, such things are truly hard to guard against in reality. Women really need to keep an eye out and protect themselves as much as possible. People’s hearts are deceitful; as the saying goes, the society is simple, but people are complicated.
This world has all kinds of people, all kinds of wicked people, don’t overestimate people’s morals, for some people, their moral limit is having no limit.
Doing business inevitably involves dinner and drinking parties. At the drinking table, ill-intentioned people will keep toasting to the women, getting them drunk, and then when a woman is overwhelmingly drunk without anyone to watch over her, she becomes at the mercy of others!
When waking up later and realizing being taken advantage of, some women weep but choose to endure, fearing embarrassment, pretending nothing happened.
Some women with no moral limits may even cooperate intentionally with the opposing party, exchanging favors in this uncouth way.
Such is the panorama of life, there are all sorts of people.
Just as they were talking, a madam brought in a few flamboyantly dressed women, among whom were the two who had previously been drinking with President Chen.
Seeing President Chen’s disgraceful state on the ground, everyone was stunned, and some couldn’t help but snicker.
Having been around the block in the entertainment world, seeing President Chen in this state, they knew exactly what happened; President Chen had taken some mind-altering drug.
"President Chen, the women you wanted are here." Lin Fan said with a smile.
President Chen heard this, lifted his head, and scanned the women in front of him. He had already lost his mind; seeing the women, he lunged at them.
"Woman, I want!" President Chen mumbled.
Lin Fan suddenly reached out and nudged the madam’s shoulder, causing her to helplessly stumble forward, immediately getting embraced by President Chen.
The old and ugly madam was embraced by President Chen, and he started kissing her feverishly.
Seeing this picture, everyone burst into laughter, it was both disgusting and hilarious.
"Ahem," Lin Fan cleared his throat, "Seems like President Chen has taken a liking to Madam here. Madam, thank you for your sacrifice tonight."
The madam’s old face turned beet red, she had never thought Chen’s taste was so heavy, actually favoring her, she had long retired, and it seems she has to make a comeback this time.
The next day.
In a certain hotel room, President Chen opened his eyes and woke up, seeing at one glance an old and ugly woman sleeping soundly beside him.
President Chen jumped up in terror.
"A ghost!"
A scream echoed throughout the hotel.

chapters.title: Chapter 682
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Chapter 682
President Chen had indecent intentions towards Liu Mengjie but ended up drinking the drug he prepared himself and spent the night with an old and ugly madam.
Thinking about how President Chen would wake up the next day to find himself next to the madam, the scene was unimaginable. Liu Mengjie felt both disgusted and amused, but also scared; this President Chen actually used such lowly tactics to harm her.
If Lin Fan hadn’t been there tonight, she probably couldn’t have escaped President Chen’s clutches.
Liu Mengjie was very grateful to Lin Fan.
"Little Fan, luckily you were here tonight," Liu Mengjie said gratefully.
It must be said, Lin Fan was incredible. President Chen was completely played by Lin Fan like a monkey. Lin Fan even managed to get President Jiang from De Xinglong involved and had the entire KTV staff cooperate with him.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Just a small matter. Don’t forget, tonight I’m your assistant, who else would I help if not you?"
Liu Mengjie was moved inside. Lin Fan was really great, such an outstanding man, truly captivating, she really liked him a lot...
"Sister Mengjie, it’s getting late, let me take you home," Lin Fan suggested.
"Okay," Liu Mengjie replied.
On the way home, Liu Mengjie leaned against the car window without speaking, seemingly preoccupied with something, her expression a bit gloomy.
"Sister Mengjie, what’s wrong, worried about the investment?" Lin Fan asked.
Liu Mengjie said, "Little Fan, I can’t hide anything from you. I really don’t know what to do. I originally thought President Chen was reliable. Now I know he isn’t. Who else can I find to invest?"
Lin Fan said, "Sister Mengjie, no need to worry, am I not still here?"
Liu Mengjie quickly said, "Little Fan, didn’t I say I wouldn’t take your money? I hope there won’t be any monetary interests between us. We are just us, purely us."
Lin Fan said, "I know, I didn’t say I wanted to invest money in the school. I meant I want to help you solve the problem."
Lin Fan, possessing top-class investment master skills, found resolving the school’s investment issue to be a piece of cake.
Originally, he had so much money, he could easily buy out the music academy and become a board member, but he respected Liu Mengjie’s wishes, so he didn’t invest the money himself.
Liu Mengjie, curious, asked, "How will you solve it?"
Lin Fan said, "Do you know why the few board members fell out with each other? Earlier at the KTV, I used the excuse of going out to fix the car to make a call and find out the situation. As I suspected, it’s all about profits. Everyone comes for profits and goes for profits, nothing else but profit."
Liu Mengjie was taken aback and said, "You mean our school isn’t being managed well?"
Lin Fan said, "Yes, actually private schools operate similarly to companies. Board members invest in order to make a profit. If it’s not managed well, conflicts are bound to arise."
Liu Mengjie sighed, "I didn’t know this, I’ve been a clueless principal all along."
Lin Fan smiled and said, "You can’t be blamed, Sister Mengjie. As the principal, your main responsibility is the educational work and the management of teachers and students. The school’s operational state is not within your job scope."
Liu Mengjie said, "Actually, I have heard a bit about it. The school’s operations have indeed encountered problems. There was a loss last year, but I’m not familiar with that. Little Fan, what do you think we should do?"
Lin Fan said, "No one dislikes money. Precisely because the school is losing money, the board members argued. If the school can turn losses into profits, and everyone can make a lot of money, there will naturally be no conflicts. Right now, the board members are red-faced, seeming like enemies. Once the school makes money, they’ll surely be close as brothers."
Money is indeed like a devil; it can drive one to accomplish anything and makes everything negotiable with wealth.
Liu Mengjie said, "Little Fan, do you have a way to turn the school around to profitability?"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Investment requires a return, and this happens to be my strength. Tomorrow, I’ll personally meet with the board members. Can you help me arrange that?"
Liu Mengjie said, "Tomorrow, when you meet them, in what capacity will you do so?"
Lin Fan said, "As Yun City’s richest man."
Lin Fan took Liu Mengjie back to Lijing District, and the night was already late.
"Little Fan, it’s too late already. I’m a bit scared. Can you see me upstairs?" Liu Mengjie said.
Lin Fan said, "Sure."
So, the two got out of the car, and Lin Fan accompanied Liu Mengjie upstairs to the door of her apartment, where Liu Mengjie fished out her keys to open the door.
Liu Mengjie’s heart was beating faster. She was indeed a bit frightened because she nearly got harmed by President Chen tonight, but not to the point of being unable to go home alone. She had a reason for asking Lin Fan to escort her upstairs... It was so late, she wondered if she could let Little Fan stay over for the night...
"Little Fan, it’s so late, how about..."
Liu Mengjie shyly suggested while turning to look at Lin Fan, but was stunned.
Lin Fan quickly ran towards the elevator, pressing the button, and cheerfully said, "Just in time, the elevator is here. Sister Mengjie, I’ll be off now. You have a good rest; see you tomorrow."
"Are you coming down?" a chubby woman in pajamas yelled from inside the elevator. Her husband had woken her late at night to throw out the trash, and she was already in a bad mood.
Lin Fan apologized with a smile, "I’m going."
That said, he hurried into the elevator.
Leaving Liu Mengjie speechless.
After a while, Liu Mengjie bit her lip and stomped her foot. Seriously, this guy doesn’t understand a woman’s heart at all; he actually rushed to catch the elevator and ran off!
Lin Fan was in the elevator, feeling like something was off. Just now, Sister Mengjie’s expression seemed as if she wanted to say something, but in a rush to catch the elevator, he didn’t pay attention, feeling as if he missed something.
In the elevator, the chubby woman glanced up and down at Lin Fan, noticing his cheap clothing, showing a disdainful expression, "Delivering food, aren’t you?"
Delivering food so late, it must be tough work. The chubby woman clearly looked down on such laborious work. Besides, Lin Fan pressing the elevator had delayed her.
Indeed, strangers appearing at this hour in the district were mostly food delivery people.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, politely said, "I’m not."
The chubby woman said, "Oh, not delivering? Then driving a cab! Hah, so now you drivers also take guests upstairs, don’t tell me you’re taking advantage of female passengers?"
Saying this, the chubby woman became more suspicious, subconsciously moving aside and tightening her collar.
Lin Fan said calmly, "No, I was just sending a friend home, no need for overthinking."
The chubby woman clearly didn’t believe Lin Fan, still looking wary.
Quickly they reached downstairs, the elevator doors opened, and the chubby woman moved aside, letting Lin Fan go first. Lin Fan, too lazy to argue, walked out first.
The chubby woman followed out, stepped outside, and looked up. She froze upon seeing a Rolls-Royce Cullinan parked in front of the building while Lin Fan walked straight up to it and pressed the car key.
The car’s headlights shone brightly, Lin Fan opened the car door.
Oh my God, this car belongs to this pauper?
"This car... is yours?" the chubby woman said, stammering.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Now do you believe me, I’m not delivering food, nor driving a cab? Oh, by the way, even if I were a pervert, you’d be very safe."
Saying this, Lin Fan got in the car, shut the door, and drove away.
The chubby woman realized, stomping her foot in anger, "What do you mean!"

chapters.title: Chapter 683
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Chapter 683
The next day.
In a hotel room, President Chen wakes up to find an old and ugly woman sleeping beside him.
"Ghost!"
President Chen cries out, still a bit sleepy, but is instantly jolted awake and jumps out of bed.
President Chen has never been so frightened in his life; the scene is too disturbing to even imagine.
The old and ugly woman was sleeping soundly but is awoken by President Chen’s shout. She rubs her eyes, sees that President Chen is awake, and immediately shows a shy expression.
"President Chen, you’re so naughty, waking me up," the old and ugly woman says coquettishly.
President Chen roars, "Who the hell are you, and what the hell is going on? What are you doing here?"
The madam shyly replies, "President Chen, do you really not remember anything? Last night, as soon as you saw me, you wouldn’t stop kissing me. Then we ended up here, you... Oh my, it’s too embarrassing to describe, definitely not suitable for children, but you were really wild last night..."
President Chen’s face turns pale.
No way!
Could it be?
Last night, he... with this old and ugly woman...
Thinking about that scene, President Chen’s stomach starts churning instantly. He turns his head and rushes to the bathroom, hugging the toilet and vomiting intensely, wishing he could vomit his entire stomach out.
While gagging, President Chen tries to recall what happened last night.
Last night, he had planned to drug Liu Mengjie’s drink, and then, the two drank water instead of wine. He drank a glass of water, after which he felt his whole body heating up and gradually lost consciousness...
The glasses must have been switched!
Before losing his mind, he saw Lin Fan and the KTV manager coming in.
No need to ask, it was Lin Fan who set him up. Lin Fan switched that glass of water, and after he’d lost his mind, Lin Fan sent this old and ugly woman to him.
"Outrageous!"
Understanding the series of events, President Chen is so angry his lungs are about to explode.
"President Chen, are you okay?" The old and ugly woman approaches the bathroom door, asking with concern.
President Chen roars, "Get out! Don’t let me see you, filthy whore!"
If he sees that face again, he guarantees he would start vomiting all over again.
Being cursed by President Chen, the old and ugly woman gets a little upset and says, "President Chen, you were the one who hugged and kissed me willingly last night... I had already retired and am now a madam, but seeing how eager you were, I made an exception to return to the scene for you."
"Shut the hell up!"
President Chen is furious and starts vomiting again.
The madam glares and says, "Fine, let’s not talk about it. Just settle the bill, and I’ll leave immediately!"
"What?" President Chen is on the verge of madness, having messed with something this disgusting last night and still needing to pay?
"Settle your own damn bill, get out, or I’ll slap you to death!" President Chen yells.
The madam can’t stand it anymore, tears off her pretense, and sneers coldly, "So you don’t plan to pay after all the fun? You’re a big boss and want freebies? No such cheap thing! I’m warning you, I’m not to be trifled with. If you don’t pay, I’ll make a call, bring some boys over to beat you up, and then spread word of your deeds!"
President Chen is startled. If the world hears about his night with this old, ugly woman, how can he ever show his face again? He might as well be dead.
Without a second thought, President Chen rushes out of the bathroom, finds his wallet from the scattered clothes, pulls out all the cash, throws it on the bed, and says, "Take it all, and leave!"
The madam picks up the money, counts it, and says, "What, only 800 yuan? Back in the day, my appearance fee started at 3000. Now that I’ve made an exception for you, this is all you think I’m worth?"
President Chen asks, "How much do you want then?"
The madam replies, "Ten thousand."
President Chen feels like crying. Hell, with ten thousand yuan, what kind of beauty can’t he find? Those escort models, with better bodies, prettier faces, young and radiant, don’t even cost ten thousand!
And this old, ugly thing, ten thousand!
President Chen nearly has a death wish.
But thinking that this matter absolutely can’t get out, he considers it hush money. In the end, President Chen pays the amount by card.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, President Chen’s phone rings. He picks up his phone, gets startled, and quickly answers, "Hello, Mr. Wei, I’ll come to see you immediately!"
President Chen hurriedly gets dressed and leaves the hotel.
Wangu Group, Chairman’s office.
Disheveled, President Chen rushes in and sees Wei Tiansheng sitting at his desk. President Chen quickly bows his head and respectfully says, "Mr. Wei."
Wei Tiansheng’s gaze is sharp as a knife as he glares at President Chen, coldly saying, "What were you doing last night?"
What he did last night was nothing honorable.
President Chen stutters, "Last night... I... was meeting with Miss Liu from Yun City Music Academy, discussing investment..."
"Hmph!"
Wei Tiansheng snorts heavily, picks up a stack of photos from the table, and throws them onto President Chen’s face.
"Discussing investment? Is this how you discuss investment?" Wei Tiansheng roars.
President Chen hurriedly picks up the photos to look, and his face goes pale with fright. In those photos, he is holding an old, ugly woman, kissing and nibbling on her passionately, looking utterly ridiculous!
A reputation-ruining scene, absolutely reputation-ruining!
What’s going on here?
President Chen wishes he could just die, or find a hole to crawl into.
Wei Tiansheng yells, "Do you know how important the land of Yun City Music Academy is to me? I want to build the second Wangu Mansion in Yun City, as my center there. This is an important step in establishing my business empire in Yun City! This piece of land, let’s say it’s something I am determined to get! I happened to hear the Yun City Music Academy isn’t doing well, and the board members are fighting over shares. If I give it a little push, the Yun City Music Academy will collapse! I asked you to get close to Liu Mengjie because I hoped you could take control of Yun City Music Academy, so the school would be under my command! And you, how dare you ruin my plans!"
President Chen’s face turns ashen, and he says, "Mr. Wei, please forgive me this time. I will immediately go to find Liu Mengjie and promise to invest in her. I will take control of Yun City Music Academy!"
In Wei Tiansheng’s plan, he wants to push the Yun City Music Academy down, then on this land, build his Wangu Mansion.
Initially, Wei Tiansheng planned to lay out a fortune to buy Yun City Music Academy. After all, he is rich and wouldn’t mind the money. But upon learning about the friction among the board members of Yun City Music Academy, he thought he could save some money by letting the academy collapse.
Since it wouldn’t be convenient for him to act, he found President Chen, letting him appear as the investor for Yun City Music Academy to gain control.
Who would have thought, this President Chen would end up ruining his plan?
And how President Chen ended up in this situation, it was entirely the doing of one person, Lin Fan!

chapters.title: Chapter 684
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Chapter 684
Looking at his own ugly photos, President Chen’s face turned white. This was practically a major social suicide scene. From now on, President Chen would become a laughing stock.
"That assistant, it must be him!" President Chen gritted his teeth in hatred. All of this had to be Liu Mengjie’s assistant, Lin Fan’s doing!
"What assistant?" Wei Tiansheng asked.
President Chen said angrily, "Last night at the KTV, Liu Mengjie brought a male assistant. That guy... that guy is a pauper but very cunning, ruining... ruining my good thing."
Wei Tiansheng snorted coldly and said, "A pauper? You’re saying the richest man in Yun City is a pauper?"
President Chen was stunned: "The richest man in Yun City?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "The assistant you mentioned is Lin Fan, now the richest man in Yun City!"
"What?" President Chen was shocked and didn’t react for a long time. "So it was the richest man in Yun City, no wonder, no wonder the boss of De Xinglong would personally deliver takeout, no wonder everyone at the KTV was helping him. It’s not unjust that I fell at the hands of Yun City’s richest man this time!"
Wei Tiansheng said, "You still have the face to talk! I told you to settle things with Liu Mengjie, to take control of the Yun City Music Academy, not to use such despicable means!"
President Chen broke out in a cold sweat: "I thought Liu Mengjie was just a principal, who knew she had Lin Fan backing her..."
Wei Tiansheng snorted, "This is also the first I’ve heard of Liu Mengjie and Lin Fan having a relationship. Taking control of the Yun City Music Academy probably won’t be that easy."
President Chen said, "I’m sorry, Mr. Wei, this is all my fault. I don’t know what I can do to make amends, please give me an order."
Wei Tiansheng said, "Do you think Liu Mengjie is still willing to discuss investments with you? You’re already out of the game. The urgent task is to seize control of the Yun City Music Academy first. I’ll personally take over this matter, get lost, you useless piece of trash!"
President Chen was sweating coldly. He dared not say anything and could only nod and retreat, knowing that he would lose Wei Tiansheng’s trust from now on. He had become a discarded pawn!
President Chen was full of hate, all of this was Lin Fan’s doing!
He hated Lin Fan, but when he thought of Lin Fan being the richest man in Yun City, he felt deflated. What would he use to fight against the richest man in Yun City? Moreover, the other party was the legendary mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin, who made him suffer so much last night!
Yun City Music Academy.
Board of Directors meeting.
A few board members, at Liu Mengjie’s invitation, all attended.
They weren’t giving face to Liu Mengjie as principal, but because when inviting them, Liu Mengjie mentioned someone, Yun City’s richest man, Lin Fan!
Obviously, Liu Mengjie and Lin Fan were friends. This time, Lin Fan intended to help Liu Mengjie and wanted to discuss the affairs of Yun City Music Academy with these board members.
Lin Fan hadn’t arrived yet, and the board members were buzzing with discussion.
"What does Mr. Lin want to discuss with us? Could it be he’s thinking of taking over the school?"
"Do you think Mr. Lin is a fool? Do you think he isn’t clear about the school’s poor management? Who would want to take over this mess?"
"And isn’t the school’s current state due to everyone present here?"
"What do you mean? Haven’t you contributed with your bad ideas these past years?"
"I say, even if an ’Immortal’ came, it wouldn’t help. This school might as well just close down!"
The board members hadn’t spoken a few words before they started arguing and accusing each other.
Indeed, the Yun City Music Academy had been losing money for the past two years, especially the revenue last year, which reduced significantly. This was the direct reason for their conflict.
To them, this mess seemed unresolvable.
Being wealthy individuals with investment experience, they’d made this judgment after deep consideration, deciding it as a failed project to be cut off, a typical instance of ’cutting off one’s limb to survive’.
"Have you truly decided to quit?"
A voice asked, and they saw Lin Fan, accompanied by Liu Mengjie, walking in.
Young and handsome!
This was the legendary mysterious wealthy Mr. Lin!
"Let me introduce myself. I am Lin Fan." Lin Fan smiled.
The board members were stunned. They had heard Mr. Lin was a young man, but Mr. Lin was younger and more handsome than they had imagined. Although all of them were older than him, they couldn’t help feeling somewhat inferior in front of Mr. Lin.
This was the aura!
Clearly, Mr. Lin’s attire was simple, even basic, yet his aura made one want to kneel and bow unconsciously.
Of course, it’s not that Lin Fan had an exceptionally strong aura, but rather the board members’ preconceived notions. Knowing Mr. Lin’s identity naturally made them see him in a larger-than-life way.
"Mr. Lin."
"Mr. Lin."
"Mr. Lin."
The board members all addressed him respectfully, ceasing their previous quarrel.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "No need to be polite. Today, I’m mainly here to talk about the business of Yun City Music Academy. Sister Mengjie is my friend, and she loves this school very much and hopes it can continue because it is her passion and her career. As her friend, I naturally support that. But this conflicts with you board members’ intentions. I know none of you want to continue. So, today I am here to resolve this conflict."
The board members looked at each other.
"I wonder what insights Mr. Lin might have?"
"Mr. Lin, you are the richest man in Yun City, wealthier than all of us combined. If you wish to help Mengjie, perhaps you could take over this business."
"Correct, Mr. Lin, are you interested?"
The board members all chimed in.
Liu Mengjie said, "Lin Fan will not invest in the school. This is an agreement we have reached."
Liu Mengjie hoped that her relationship with Lin Fan was pure, without being mixed with financial interests, because once money was involved, conflicts easily arose. Just like these board members who were once good friends sharing drinks, but after the school’s management worsened, turned against each other, wanting to split up, arguing fiercely.
This was something Liu Mengjie didn’t want to see.
Upon hearing that Lin Fan wouldn’t invest in the school, the board members fell silent.
Indeed, Mr. Lin was Mr. Lin, not a fool. He surely realized the school was a mess, so he wasn’t taking over. If even Mr. Lin wouldn’t take over, they were even more convinced of their decision; this school seemed hopeless.
"Since Mr. Lin doesn’t want to take over, there’s nothing more to say."
"Indeed, I don’t think there’s any need to discuss other matters. We should just talk about splitting up!"
"It’s time to clear up the school’s assets and distribute them fairly."
The board members spoke one after another, feeling somewhat disinterested. Although they were clamoring to withdraw their investments, once it came to actually splitting up, they were somewhat reluctant, as this school had been their passion too.
Lin Fan smiled faintly and said, "I won’t invest, but the school must continue to operate. I’m here today to offer you some advice."

chapters.title: Chapter 685
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Chapter 685
Lin Fan is here to give advice?
The school board members were stunned.
"Mr. Lin, what do you mean by that? Do you think our school can still be saved?"
"No way, we know the school’s situation best. We don’t see any hope."
"Anyway, I can’t think of any solution, let’s hear what Mr. Lin has to say!"
Everyone started murmuring.
Lin Fan listened to their words and said, "Ladies and gentlemen, hear me out. Perhaps you don’t know this, but I’m actually a doctor as well. Problematic businesses, poorly managed companies, are much like sick patients. A sickness requires treatment. With treatment, there’s hope for recovery, and with proper care, they might be even healthier than before."
"Mr. Lin, that makes sense, but as you said, a problematic business is like a sick patient. Patients come with various conditions—minor ailments, serious illnesses, and even terminal diseases."
"Correct. Mr. Lin, what do you think our school’s condition is?"
"Anyway, I think it’s terminal. I don’t want to treat it."
"Indeed, there’s no saving it."
The school board members spoke dejectedly.
As Lin Fan said, no one will turn down money. If the school were doing well, they’d all be busy making money instead of causing division.
Lin Fan said, "You ask me what stage Yun City Music Academy’s condition is at; frankly, I tell you, it’s minor."
What?
Everyone was stunned.
Minor?
They all thought the school was beyond saving, yet Mr. Lin believed it’s just a minor issue?
If someone other than Mr. Lin said this, they’d surely laugh. It’s so easy to say without knowing how bad the school’s management situation is. Every decision made here previously caused damage to profits, and it’s hard to reverse the deterioration.
But these words were from Mr. Lin, the richest man in Yun City!
The words of the richest man in Yun City are hard to ignore.
Does the fact that the richest man views it as minor mean the school can be saved?
Mr. Lin is an investment expert; they’ve all heard of his accomplishments. Mr. Lin once spent 6 billion buying Chiba Island, which is now worth 10 billion, netting a profit of 4 billion!
Such a feat alone is already astonishing.
Mr. Lin’s greatest achievement is Mortal Group; starting with acquiring shares in Celestial Aviation, Mortal Group’s market value skyrocketed from a few hundred billion to 200 billion, allowing Lin Fan to surpass the three moguls of Yun City and ascend to the position of its richest man.
How Lin Fan achieved such miraculous success remains a mystery, but it presents an undeniable fact: Lin Fan is incredibly talented at investing, at making money.
To him, businesses that others see as hopeless might indeed be easy to fix.
It’s like a poor person struggles to gather 1 million, while a wealthy person might spend 1 million on dinner.
It’s like a struggling student cannot solve a math problem no matter how hard they try, while a top student can come up with ten solutions effortlessly.
Lin Fan is that wealthy person, that top student!
"I have an investment plan here, which I wrote casually while having breakfast before heading out. Take a look at it."
Lin Fan said, tossing a stack of documents onto the table.
This investment plan had been duplicated several times; each board member had a copy.
Casually wrote during breakfast?
Sounds so casual, can it really work?
The board members were somewhat skeptical. With such thoughts, they picked up the investment plan and began reading, filling the meeting room with silence.
At this moment, Liu Mengjie felt a bit worried. Was this investment plan truly written by Lin Fan during breakfast?
"Little Fan, did you really write this while having breakfast this morning?" Liu Mengjie whispered to Lin Fan.
A tingling sensation lingered in Lin Fan’s ear, carrying the fragrance of Liu Mengjie, causing his heart to race. Sister Mengjie, don’t lean so close, I fear I might lose control.
"Honestly, I wrote it while using the bathroom this morning," Lin Fan leaned in to Liu Mengjie’s ear and whispered.
Just an investment plan; with Lin Fan’s skills as a top investment master, this was indeed something he could complete during a bathroom break.
Liu Mengjie instantly blushed: "This..."
Seems like this is a plan with a certain flavor.
It truly is a plan with flavor.
The board members looked at this plan, and somehow, it was as if they all ate chili peppers, warming up all over, cold sweat streaming down their foreheads.
This was shocking.
Reading this plan gave them cold sweats—not because the plan was poorly written, but quite the opposite, it was exceptionally well-written, so well it scared them.
Some board members even trembled all over, too excited.
"Oh my, there is such a perfect investment plan in this world!"
"If we follow this investment plan, Yun City Music Academy will undoubtedly become the nation’s top school within three years!"
"Following this plan, profit is a certainty!"
"My goodness, Mr. Lin is truly Mr. Lin. With this plan, our school is indeed only a minor issue!"
"Perhaps only Lin Fan could achieve this in the world!"
The hearts of the school board members exploded; this investment plan outlined a very promising future for Yun City Music Academy. Following the plan, in the coming three years, Yun City Music Academy would rise to be the leading music academy in the country.
Simultaneously, the school’s operational conditions would be entirely transformed, turning losses into profits, with continual growth. If there were various issues troubling the school before, this was a perfect solution!
They bowed to Lin Fan.
Mr. Lin is indeed the top student. Problems that ordinary students struggle with are merely simple for Lin Fan.
"Ladies and gentlemen, after reading the plan, still want to dissolve the school, still want to cause division?" Lin Fan asked.
The board members looked at one another.
Finally, they unanimously shook their heads: "No, we’ve decided to keep going!"
"With Mr. Lin’s plan, the school has hope again!"
"Indeed, I have deep feelings for the school too, how could I bear to pull out the funding!"
"We must join forces and make Yun City Music Academy a top university!"
"No more arguing, roll up your sleeves, let’s prepare for a big effort!"
The board members said excitedly, one after another.
Right then, several men in suits walked in from outside.
Leading them was a young man wearing glasses.
"Good day, board members. I am Mr. Wei Tiansheng’s representative. My surname is Xu. Today, I’ve come to discuss the acquisition of Yun City Music Academy." the young man with glasses said.
What?
Wei Tiansheng?
The richest man in Jiangnan?
He actually wants to acquire their school? Truly rich and powerful, coming straight to splash money for a school acquisition!
Tsk tsk, too bad he came a bit late.

chapters.title: Chapter 686
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Chapter 686
Wei Tiansheng originally planned to gain control by investing in the Yun City Music Academy, and then have the academy shut down and bankrupt. The original site would then become the location for a Wangu Mansion in the future.
This was the most cost-effective method.
He entrusted President Chen with this task, but unexpectedly, President Chen offended Liu Mengjie and was toyed with by Lin Fan, ruining the plan.
Wei Tiansheng simply abandoned his previous plan. After all, Wangu Group is wealthy; he would buy the Yun City Music Academy outright!
The young man with glasses, representing Wei Tiansheng, was full of confidence. He had already investigated. Given the current operating situation of the Yun City Music Academy, several board members were already in dispute, making it a perfect time for an acquisition.
Moreover, he was confident he could acquire it at a price lower than expected.
The richest man in Jiangnan is interested in acquiring this mess, which surely the board members would be eager for.
However...
"Sorry, we’re not selling the school!"
"Go back and tell Mr. Wei, thank you for his interest in the academy, but we won’t be selling it to him."
"Heh heh, perhaps discussions could have been held earlier, but unfortunately, you’re a step too late."
The board members said one after another.
The young man with glasses was stunned. What’s going on? This was completely different from what he expected. These board members didn’t even consider selling, and were so determined, this... doesn’t make sense!
The young man with glasses said, "Everyone, aren’t you aware of your institution’s situation? This can’t be, your academy has been losing money for two years and it’s beyond salvage. Mr. Wei’s willingness to acquire it is practically a godsend to help you escape from this mess. Surely, you understand that?"
One board member said, "You’re talking about the past situation, but we’ve just found a path for the school. We’re fixing this mess ourselves, no need to trouble Mr. Wei."
What a joke, according to Lin Fan’s investment plan, in the future they will be making money while lying down. The school will have a bright future, how could they hand it over at this time!
The young man with glasses was very curious, "What path have you found?"
The board member said, "Mr. Lin helped us draft a future investment plan. The school is going to be renovated to create a first-class music academy."
The young man with glasses saw the investment plan on the table and said, "What investment plan is this, so impressive? May I take a look?"
The board member shook his head and firmly refused, "Sorry, this is our company’s internal secret, you’re an outsider, you can’t see it!"
Lin Fan, however, said calmly, "Let him see it, it doesn’t matter."
The board members looked at each other, having nothing to say. Since Mr. Lin said it was fine, then it was fine.
So, the young man with glasses picked up a copy of the investment plan and began reading. At first, his expression was calm, but gradually his face turned pale, and cold sweat appeared on his forehead.
After reading the investment plan, the young man with glasses silently put it down, as if pondering something.
"May I ask who is Mr. Lin?"
The young man with glasses asked.
Lin Fan said calmly, "I am Lin Fan."
The young man with glasses looked at Lin Fan, showing surprise. Lin Fan was so young, such a young richest man in Yun City was enough to awe anyone.
"You are Mr. Lin, I’ve long heard of your name! Actually, before coming, Mr. Wei already knew that you and Miss Liu are friends, afraid that you would beat us to it. It seems I am indeed too late. I will report truthfully to Mr. Wei, farewell."
The young man with glasses said, then left in farewell.
This young man with glasses, after reviewing Lin Fan’s investment plan, was convinced and had no more words, knowing he had lost and had no chance.
Lin Fan was somewhat surprised, not expecting the Yun City Music Academy to attract Wei Tiansheng’s attention. It seems this Wei Tiansheng is really planning to establish a presence in Yun City.
If Wei Tiansheng came to Yun City for normal business, Lin Fan wouldn’t mind, but if Wei Tiansheng provoked him, that would be a different story.
"It seems the board members have made their decision, that’s good, the Yun City Music Academy is safe now." Lin Fan said with a smile.
Among everyone, Liu Mengjie was the happiest.
Lin Fan was truly amazing, is there anything he can’t solve in this world?
As soon as he took action, gathering the board members for a meeting resolved the crisis and thwarted Wei Tiansheng’s plans. Who knows what Wei Tiansheng intended by acquiring the school!
Liu Mengjie did not want the school to fall into Wei Tiansheng’s hands.
It can be said that the current situation is the perfect solution.
All of this is thanks to Lin Fan!
"Thank you, Little Fan, I will make sure to properly thank you this time," Liu Mengjie thought to herself, already making a decision.
"Mr. Lin, you have truly saved our school, we are immensely grateful."
"Did Mr. Lin do this all because of Principal Liu?"
"Mengjie, why didn’t you tell us earlier that you and Mr. Lin are friends?"
"If we had asked Mr. Lin earlier, it wouldn’t have escalated so much!"
The board members said one after another.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "I did this not only for Sister Mengjie but also because my sister is studying here. I don’t want my sister to be unable to graduate because the school closed."
The board members suddenly realized, so that’s the reason; Mr. Lin’s sister is also a student at their school.
From now on, Lin Shanshan must not be wronged in any way at school!
With the relationship with Lin Fan, Lin Shanshan could walk around the campus unchallenged in the future.
Fortunately, Lin Shanshan wasn’t an unruly princess with a bad attitude; she was relatively obedient and well-behaved. If she were a trouble-maker who wrecked the school, the board members would have no objections, not daring to have any, because of Lin Fan’s influence.
