Because the board members understand one thing, offending Lin Fan brings no benefit whatsoever. Lin Fan is simply a business genius. If he can casually throw out an investment plan to save the school,
then it can be imagined that if Lin Fan wanted to cause harm to the school, it would be as easy as lifting a hand!
This Mr. Lin is terrifying! The board members are filled with awe towards Lin Fan.
Wangu Group, Chairman’s office.
Wei Tiansheng was meeting with his eldest son, Wei Jisheng.
"The site selection for the Wangu Mansion will soon be finalized. I’ve already had someone go to discuss the acquisition with the Yun City Music Academy." Wei Tiansheng said.
The father and son discussed the Wangu Mansion construction, and Wei Tiansheng mentioned it.
Wei Jisheng asked, "Who did father send to negotiate?"
Wei Tiansheng replied, "Xu Qingshan."
Wei Jisheng laughed and said, "Ah, Manager Xu, Manager Xu is the most suitable; he is a negotiation expert with rich experience. I’m sure he will clinch the deal with the Yun City Music Academy."
Wei Tiansheng smiled with a bit of pride. Everything was under his control, and of course, he was aware of Manager Xu’s skills. This time was practically a sure win.
At this moment, the young man with glasses walked in and said, "I’m sorry, Chairman, I have disappointed your expectations. The acquisition of the Yun City Music Academy failed."
What?
The Wei Family’s father and son stared at each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 687
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Chapter 687
"How did it fail?" Wei Tiansheng questioned.
Manager Xu said, "The richest man in Yun City, Lin Fan."
Manager Xu truthfully reported the events at Yun City Music Academy to Wei Tiansheng.
After listening, Wei Tiansheng and his son fell silent.
After a long silence, Wei Tiansheng sneered coldly, "It seems I underestimated this brat. He’s got some skills. Of course, Yun City Music Academy can be saved. The investment plan he proposed, I’ve thought of it too, but there’s no way I’m helping Yun City Music Academy."
It’s not just Lin Fan who is a doctor for enterprises and can heal ailing companies. In that regard, Wei Tiansheng is also a skilled doctor.
But Wei Tiansheng’s goal is to acquire Yun City Music Academy and let it close down, so he naturally won’t help think of solutions for it.
"Father, what should we do now? This plan has been thwarted by this kid again. Are we just going to give up on Yun City Music Academy?" Wei Jisheng asked.
Wei Tiansheng snorted, "What are you rushing for? The game has just begun. Let’s take it slow. As for Lin Fan, I’ll deal with him. I’m determined to get Yun City Music Academy. As long as we deal with Lin Fan, all problems will be solved."
Wei Jisheng was delighted, "Father, do you still have a way to take over Yun City Music Academy?"
Wei Tiansheng said, "Lin Fan thinks he’s a doctor for enterprises. Little does he know, a doctor’s scalpel can save lives but also harm them. When a doctor’s scalpel is used to target someone, it’s hard to defend against."
Wei Jisheng was puzzled, not quite grasping his father’s intention or what strategy he was planning.
Wei Tiansheng looked up at Wei Jisheng, "Jisheng, you mentioned giving Lin Fan a warning. When does that start?"
Wei Jisheng laughed, understanding this part, "Father, it starts today. Lin Fan’s troubles have already begun."
Celestial Aviation, airport.
"The plane is about to take off. Please queue in an orderly fashion..."
The bustling airport was crowded with people and filled with noise, while a female voice made announcements over the PA system.
Originally, it was an ordinary day where passengers rushed to the airport to catch flights. Such scenes happen every day and couldn’t be more normal.
Under Lin Fan’s leadership, Celestial Aviation, as a private airline, was doing exceptionally well. The company’s upgrades in various facilities made flying with Celestial Aviation notably comfortable, gaining a strong reputation among passengers.
In fact, Celestial Aviation’s daily passenger flow had become quite considerable, hinting at becoming the busiest airport in Yun City.
"Something’s wrong, run away!"
Suddenly, a voice screamed, breaking the usual airport atmosphere.
"There’s a bomb in the airport!"
Someone shouted loudly, scaring everyone out of their wits.
In an instant, chaos erupted at the airport.
Lin Fan had resolved the school’s investment problem for Liu Mengjie, and the meeting ended. Lin Fan and Liu Mengjie left the meeting room, heading to Liu Mengjie’s office.
Liu Mengjie was very grateful to Lin Fan and decided to give him a big thank you.
"Little Fan, we owe a lot to you this time," said Liu Mengjie.
Lin Fan smiled, "Sister Mengjie, no need to be so polite with me. Don’t forget, I’m also part of Yun City Music Academy. I wouldn’t just stand by and watch the school close down."
Liu Mengjie said, "Even so, you helped me, and that’s a fact. Little Fan, what do you want from me this time? Just say the word, and I’ll do it."
Liu Mengjie looked at Lin Fan with tender eyes. As long as Lin Fan spoke, she could immediately become his woman, do whatever he wanted; she was completely conquered by Lin Fan.
Lin Fan didn’t know how to respond to Liu Mengjie’s offer. What could he possibly ask of her? In his eyes, Liu Mengjie was a good friend, and he didn’t have any excessive demands.
"Sister Mengjie, there’s no need, really. It’s no big deal," Lin Fan said.
Hearing this, Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but feel a bit disappointed. She had almost clearly hinted, but it seemed Little Fan had no such intention... Could it be she wasn’t pretty enough and Lin Fan had no feelings for her?
Thinking this way, Liu Mengjie couldn’t help but feel a bit self-conscious, wondering what kind of woman could attract Little Fan.
If people knew Liu Mengjie felt self-conscious about her looks, they would be astonished. Liu Mengjie was very beautiful, a solid 9 out of 10 beauty with a sophisticated and elegant aura, the dream of many men, the kind of goddess one fantasized about during school days.
Yet, she felt insecure because of Lin Fan.
What exactly did Lin Fan feel about Liu Mengjie?
Of course, Lin Fan thought Liu Mengjie was very beautiful. If he could marry Liu Mengjie, it would be great, and Lin Fan would be delighted.
However, because of Lin Fan’s personality, unless the other party showed their intentions, he wouldn’t take the initiative. Lin Fan had been proactive in the past, and the result was often cold responses, so after facing rejection many times, he stopped being proactive.
Lin Fan might not even realize that he no longer needed to face cold shoulders. On the contrary, countless women would willingly approach him first.
These various women would throw themselves at him, actively pursue him. Lin Fan didn’t seem ready to become a playboy among the ladies.
Of course, as time goes by, Lin Fan would eventually realize that if he wanted, he could have many, many women.
Ring ring ring...
Suddenly, Lin Fan’s phone rang.
It was his secretary Zhao Jiayi from Celestial Aviation calling.
Every time this secretary called, it meant something happened in the company. Lin Fan answered the call.
"Bad news, Chairman. Something happened at the company!" Zhao Jiayi’s tone was a bit urgent.
Lin Fan furrowed his eyebrows and said, "Take it easy first, what happened?"
Zhao Jiayi said, "A bomb was found at our airport. The airport is now locked down. The police are on-site, preparing to search for the bomb. Chairman, the board members are looking for you to address this issue."
Lin Fan was shocked and said, "Our airport has the most comprehensive security measures. How could a bomb slip in? What’s going on?"
Zhao Jiayi said, "No one knows at the moment."
Lin Fan said, "Alright, I understand. I’ll return to the company now to convene a board meeting."
Lin Fan hung up the phone.
"Little Fan, what happened?" Liu Mengjie asked, noticing Lin Fan’s unsettled expression.
Lin Fan said, "Something happened at the company, and I need to go. Sister Mengjie, I’ll leave now."
Lin Fan felt a weight in his heart. He couldn’t believe there was a bomb at the airport; this time, someone might be targeting the Mortal Group.

chapters.title: Chapter 688
chapters.content:
Chapter 688: Chapter 688
Within the Celestial Aviation airport, due to the suspicion of a bomb, there was chaos, and the police quickly mobilized, evacuating the crowd and locking down the airport, causing all flights to be grounded that day.
Bomb disposal experts arrived on the scene and began searching for the bomb.
Celestial Aviation’s security system was immediately questioned by the public. Was the airport security check merely a formality, allowing a bomb to enter the airport?
The incident quickly escalated and made the trending list, becoming widely known.
"Seriously, is security just for show?"
"Who’s going to dare fly with Celestial Aviation anymore? So unsafe!"
"This kind of airport should be closed down!"
Netizens flocked to comment, criticizing Celestial Aviation.
Celestial Aviation’s stock price fell in response.
A crisis landed on Celestial Aviation, affecting the entire Mortal Group. As the owner of Mortal Group, Lin Fan was thrust into the spotlight.
Known as a mysterious tycoon, Lin Fan had, in a short time, created a wealth myth, establishing Mortal Group, a business empire that amazed the world, earning admiration from the masses. This air of mystery gave an impression of incredible power, but was it actually just a paper tiger?
If the bomb is indeed found at the airport this time, it will prove that Celestial Aviation’s security is ineffective, and Mortal Group will be shown to be not as great as believed, causing Lin Fan’s myth to crumble.
The collapse of their stock price is inevitable, yet this is not Mortal Group’s true nightmare. The real nightmare could be regulatory measures from above; a single official document could bring Mortal Group to ruin.
Lin Fan understood this, so upon learning the situation, he immediately returned to the Celestial Aviation Headquarters.
He wanted to handle this matter personally.
"Chairman, the executives are all in the meeting room," Zhao Jiayi, the secretary, said, approaching Lin Fan as he entered the Celestial Aviation Headquarters.
Instantly, all eyes in the company were on Lin Fan.
The crisis had come so suddenly that everyone was stunned, somewhat at a loss.
Lin Fan nodded: "To the meeting room."
The meeting room was filled with company executives, including the board members, all discussing how to respond to this crisis, but no good solutions emerged.
As Lin Fan entered, everyone fell silent, looking at him.
Lin Fan had once created a stock market miracle for Celestial Aviation, elevating it from a billion-dollar company to a trillion-dollar group under his leadership. His accomplishments made the whole company, including these high-level executives, admire and worship him like a god.
This time, how would Lin Fan act?
Everyone was uncertain deep down.
Even though Lin Fan was brilliant at making money, this crisis had nothing to do with that—it was purely an unforeseen calamity. If a bomb were indeed found at the airport, not even immortals could save Celestial Aviation.
Lin Fan smiled and said, "Everyone, I’m sure you’ve all discussed this. Does anyone have suggestions on how to handle the situation? Please speak freely."
"My suggestion is to engage in crisis PR and defend ourselves. Right now, the internet is full of curses, and the public has misunderstood us."
"Our security system is absolutely safe!"
"That’s right, our security is very strict. Even a mosquito wouldn’t get through if we didn’t allow it!"
Everyone expressed confidence.
Clearly, they didn’t believe there was a real bomb at the airport.
Lin Fan looked at Li Hongting: "Mr. Li, what are your thoughts?"
Li Hongting, the second-largest shareholder of Celestial Aviation and one of its oldest members, had seen the company grow and his words carried weight.
Li Hongting replied, "This matter depends on the police investigation results. If a bomb is indeed found, nothing we say will matter. If we rashly proceed with crisis PR, it will backfire and make us a laughing stock, adding insult to injury for the company."
Lin Fan murmured: "Do you think, Mr. Li, that our security system actually missed a bomb, allowing it into the airport?"
Li Hongting said, "Nothing is absolute. No matter how advanced a security system may be, it’s operated by people."
Lin Fan replied, "You make a good point, Mr. Li. No system is 100% secure. If ours has a flaw and someone exploits it, there might indeed be a bomb."
Everyone fell silent.
If even the chairman admits it, it suggests there’s a possibility there is a bomb in the airport!
If Mortal Group releases a statement defending their security system but the airport indeed contains a bomb, they’d be utterly embarrassed, inviting even more criticism and attacks.
"Mr. Lin, what do you decide?" Li Hongting asked.
Immediately, all eyes turned to Lin Fan.
This was indeed a tricky issue, ultimately awaiting the chairman’s decision. It was also a test of Lin Fan’s leadership skills.
If Lin Fan didn’t handle this matter well, it could not only harm the company but also knock him off the pedestal, severely damaging his image.
Lin Fan maintained a calm expression and said, "This matter requires rational analysis. The supposed bomb at the airport is, at this point, merely a rumor, which leaves only two possible outcomes: either there’s no bomb, or there is one. Let’s consider the first option: there’s no bomb. If there’s no bomb, why would such a commotion arise?"
Li Hongting pondered, "If there’s no bomb, then someone must be causing trouble deliberately. This sort of thing isn’t unheard of; people have previously faked bomb threats to create panic, only to be proven false."
Lin Fan inquired, "And what would their motivation be?"
Li Hongting replied, "That I’m not sure of. Perhaps boredom. Some people just stir things up for no reason."
Lin Fan nodded: "This motivation could have countless possibilities, but it could also be someone targeting our Celestial Aviation."
Everyone’s expressions changed.
"Are you suggesting someone is out to get us?" Li Hongting frowned. "That’s a very possible scenario! After all, our Celestial Aviation has been growing rapidly, attracting attention as it ascends. As the saying goes, ’a tall tree attracts the wind,’ it’s inevitable that we’d garner some envy."
Lin Fan continued, "The second outcome is truly having a bomb at the airport. This would be severe, indicating that not only is there a flaw in our security system, but it’s also been exploited. Let me ask everyone a question: if I wanted to bring a bomb into the airport, how could it be done?"
Everyone began to think.
Li Hongting answered, "I can respond to that. Given our current security system, it’s nearly impossible to smuggle a bomb into the airport. If it indeed happened, then there’s only one possibility: someone from within the company is cooperating."
Lin Fan smiled, "So, you’re suggesting there’s a mole inside."

chapters.title: Chapter 689
chapters.content:
Chapter 689: Chapter 689
What?
Everyone looked at each other, is there a mole in the company?
Who is it?
No matter who this mole is, they are about to ruin the company, it’s infuriating.
Everyone was already filled with righteous indignation.
Lin Fan said, "If there’s a mole in the company, then it means someone is definitely targeting us, bribing the mole, trying to create a big scandal. I won’t let that happen."
According to Lin Fan’s analysis, whether or not there really is a bomb at the airport, there is a possibility that someone is targeting Celestial Aviation, and if there really is a bomb, then someone is definitely behind it.
So, who is behind this?
"Mr. Lin, someone is calling for you, they say they want to meet you, and they claim to be from the Jiangnan Wei Family."
Zhao Jiayi walked in and said.
The Jiangnan Wei Family!
People from the Wei Family, what are they looking for Lin Fan for at this critical moment?
Lin Fan said, "I understand, I’ll meet with him later."
Lin Fan smiled slightly, it seemed the perpetrator had finally appeared.
Li Hongting asked, "Mr. Lin, what should we do now? The online public opinion is overwhelmingly negative, and the stock price is falling, please make a decision."
Lin Fan said, "Let’s issue a public relations statement first, apologize for causing public panic, be a bit more sincere, then say our security checks are the safest on this planet, we have confidence in ourselves, and we’ll actively cooperate with the police."
What?
Everyone exchanged glances, mainly about the security checks, didn’t Mr. Lin just say to brag about our security checks, isn’t he afraid of being slapped in the face?
No one else dared to speak, after all, it was the chairman’s decision.
Li Hongting said, "Mr. Lin, I agree with everything else, but boasting about our security checks, aren’t you afraid of being slapped in the face if something really happens..."
Lin Fan said, "No worries, I don’t believe there really is a bomb at the airport."
After speaking, Lin Fan turned to Zhao Jiayi and said, "Let’s go, let’s meet the Jiangnan Wei Family."
Everyone was stunned.
Why is Mr. Lin so confident, how can he be 100% sure there’s no bomb, didn’t Elder Li just say it clearly, it’s not impossible, as long as there is indeed a mole in the company...
Li Hongting watched Lin Fan’s back, frowning.
A moment later, he relaxed his frown.
Mr. Lin must have his reasons for doing this...
In Yun City, on the rooftop of a big building, there is an international hotel, a large top-floor room, with a sky pool.
A few tall young women were frolicking in the pool.
Beside the pool, a middle-aged man sat in a rattan chair, drinking red wine, smoking a cigar, looking relaxed.
"Which member of the Wei Family are you?"
Lin Fan brought Zhao Jiayi, approached the pool, and went straight to the point.
"Hahaha..."
Wei Jisheng stood up and laughed, "Mr. Lin, we finally meet, Mr. Lin is indeed as rumored, young and handsome, living up to his reputation!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "I know I’m handsome, no need to say more."
Wei Jisheng chuckled, "Well, Mr. Lin, being so confident, I probably know why you became the richest man in Yun City at such a young age."
Lin Fan said, "Would you care to introduce yourself?"
Wei Jisheng said, "My name is Wei Jisheng, the richest man in Jiangnan, Wei Tiansheng, is my father. Mr. Lin’s company is currently going through a major crisis, calling Mr. Lin here is a bit embarrassing, but I feel our meeting is necessary."
Lin Fan said, "Go ahead, what’s the matter?"
This person turned out to be Wei Tiansheng’s eldest son, Wei Jisheng!
Lin Fan roughly guessed what was going on.
Wei Jisheng said, "Let’s speak openly, Mr. Lin, I can see you are struggling now, the stock price has fallen, and the internet is condemning you, if a bomb were found at the airport, you might be utterly ruined."
Lin Fan responded, "And then?"
Wei Jisheng smiled, "Mr. Lin doesn’t need to be nervous, actually, I came here to help you."
"Help me?" Lin Fan asked curiously.
Wei Jisheng said, "That’s right, I can help Mr. Lin get through this crisis."
Lin Fan said, "How can you help?"
Wei Jisheng said, "I can guarantee that the police won’t find a bomb at the airport, the final result will be a misunderstanding, and Mr. Lin’s reputation will be preserved."
Lin Fan said, "Mr. Wei, is there really a bomb at the airport?"
Wei Jisheng pretended to be clueless, "Mr. Lin, what do you mean by that? Don’t get me wrong, I have nothing to do with the bomb situation, I’m just here to help you because I saw you’re struggling."
Lin Fan said, "You said you didn’t do anything in the dark, you and I are both businessmen, most businessmen aren’t early risers without profit, would you come to help me without any benefit?"
Wei Jisheng laughed, "Mr. Lin, you’re very perceptive, I can’t even argue with that. Yes, I do have a few conditions to discuss with Mr. Lin, if you agree to my terms, I can guarantee that the airport crisis will be handled in the best possible way, and Celestial Aviation as well as your personal reputation will be preserved."
Lin Fan said, "Go ahead, what are the conditions?"
Wei Jisheng said, "Mr. Lin, you probably already know, our Jiangnan Wei Family will focus on developing in Yun City next, we have launched a project called community buying, this project is currently under my charge, but we encountered an obstacle in promoting this project, I don’t need to elaborate, Mr. Lin should know where the resistance is coming from."
Wei Jisheng chuckled; he didn’t need to say it outright, implying that Lin Fan was the one obstructing the project.
The underground in Yun City was superficially unified by Li Zhen, but in reality, it had been unified by Lin Fan, who is the critical figure behind the scenes.
As long as Lin Fan agrees, the Wei Family’s community buying project will no longer face resistance from the Yun City underground.
Lin Fan sneered inwardly, he was now fairly certain that Wei Jisheng was the mastermind behind the airport incident at Celestial Aviation.
This was meant to warn Lin Fan, to tell him not to obstruct the Wei Family in the future, or else they would destroy him.
Lin Fan, looking calm, said, "Is there anything else?"
Wei Jisheng pointed in a direction and said, "Do you know why I chose to meet here? Because from here, you can see the entire Yun City Music Academy. I heard Mr. Lin got involved with the Yun City Music Academy, causing our acquisition to fail, and I hope Mr. Lin will no longer interfere. We are determined to acquire that land, and in the future, our Wangu Mansion will rise there. I don’t want Mr. Lin to become our enemy. We are all in business, we should be making money harmoniously!"

chapters.title: Chapter 690: Greater Ability Brings Greater Responsibility
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Chapter 690: Greater Ability Brings Greater Responsibility
"Mr. Lin, what do you think?"
Wei Jisheng looked at Lin Fan, puffing on his cigar leisurely, as if he had Lin Fan cornered.
He didn’t believe Lin Fan dared to refuse him.
Right now, Lin Fan was in a bind, and this matter caught him off guard, giving Wei Jisheng the upper hand!
Wei Jisheng was very pleased with his arrangement this time. Besides complying, Lin Fan had no other choice.
Lin Fan said calmly, "Your Wei Family wants to develop in Yun City, which originally has nothing to do with me..."
Wei Jisheng laughed, "Exactly, Mr. Li should have this awareness. Whatever our Wei Family wants to do in Yun City is none of your business, just don’t obstruct us."
Lin Fan said, "I haven’t finished speaking. Indeed, anyone can come to Yun City to do business. I don’t have the right to stop them. After all, Yun City doesn’t belong to just me, and I’m not that domineering. However, there is one premise: don’t conduct business that harms others for your own gain. If I don’t encounter it, so be it. But if I do, I can’t pretend I didn’t see."
Wei Jisheng chuckled, "Mr. Lin, how noble of you. Do you think you’re the Holy Father?"
Lin Fan replied, "I’m not the Holy Father. I just happen to have a bit of ability. As they say, with great power comes great responsibility. In life, there are things beyond one’s reach, like those vegetable vendors. They simply cannot compete with big capitalists like the Wei Family and can only helplessly suffer erosion. But I can help them as much as I can."
If Lin Fan were still the delivery man he once was, he could only sigh helplessly upon witnessing the vegetable vendors’ plight.
But now, Lin Fan didn’t need to lament. He could take actual actions to help, so why not?
When ordinary people face hardships, they fantasize about superheroes coming to save them. That’s why superhero-themed movies are so popular, because people are struggling with various difficulties in reality and yearn for salvation, hoping for justice to prevail. In movies, they find solace, even if reality leaves them helpless.
At the very least, they can imagine.
Lin Fan is no longer an ordinary person. He has hundreds of billions in funds and a billion-dollar conglomerate. He can become the type of superhero that ordinary people fantasize about.
In the world of superheroes, two main protagonists, Batman and Iron Man, are super-rich. They use their money—one dressing as a bat, the other donning iron armor—to support the strong and weak, maintaining world peace. Their fabulous gear is all funded by money and high-tech. Naturally, high-tech development needs money.
Lin Fan never considered becoming Batman or Iron Man, dressing in armor to fight crime on the streets at night. They are true Holy Fathers, whereas Lin Fan is not. He just follows his heart; when faced with injustice, if he can do something about it, he does it as an instinct.
This isn’t being a Holy Father, but something every good and decent person would do.
What’s more, fighting against the Wei Family is also part of a system task. When the Wei Family wanted to dominate Yun City’s underworld, the system assigned Lin Fan a task requiring him to unify Yun City’s underground.
It’s fair to say that with this system task, Lin Fan was bound to provoke the Wei Family.
As for Yun City Music Academy, Lin Fan helped Liu Mengjie, indirectly sabotaging the Wei Family’s plan.
Wei Jisheng said, "Mr. Lin is overestimating himself, thinking you can help them, but you’re actually struggling now. Isn’t it time for Mr. Lin to consider securing himself first?"
The sarcasm in Wei Jisheng’s tone was evident.
Daring to go against the Wei Family was truly asking for trouble.
Lin Fan said, "You’re right, I guess I did step on the Wei Family’s sore spot this time, incurring their revenge."
Wei Jisheng said, "Mr. Lin had better clarify, the incident happening in your company has nothing to do with the Wei Family. I’m here because our Wei Family happens to be able to help you."
Lin Fan asked, "What if I agree to your conditions?"
Wei Jisheng chuckled, "I don’t see that Mr. Lin has room to refuse unless Mr. Lin truly wants a fight to the bitter end, then I can’t help it."
Lin Fan said, "Well, let me analyze it with you, Mr. Wei. First, your condition is that I don’t obstruct your community group buying project. But as you said, the impediment to your ground promotion is from Yun City’s underground. From what I know, the current leader of Yun City’s underground is Li Zhen. What’s it got to do with me?"
This was using their own logic against them. Since the Wei Family wouldn’t admit to being behind the Celestial Aviation incident, Lin Fan wouldn’t admit to being the mastermind behind Yun City’s underground.
Wei Jisheng sneered, "Does Mr. Lin truly not know who he is?"
Lin Fan retorted, "Was the airport bomb incident orchestrated by the Wei Family? I’m sure Mr. Wei knows this very well."
"You!" Wei Jisheng was at a loss for words.
Lin Fan smiled, "Moreover, about Yun City Music Academy, you want me to stay out of it. In reality, I only helped my friend a little. The actual decision was made by the board members who rejected your Wei Family’s acquisition. So in summary, I’m not really able to help the Wei Family with anything. If Mr. Wei wants to negotiate terms with me, I’m afraid you’ve found the wrong person."
Wei Jisheng scoffed, "If it weren’t for Mr. Lin, do you think those foolish board members would have rejected our Wei Family’s acquisition of Yun City Music Academy’s mess? This event has already happened, so I won’t hold it against Mr. Lin. What I want is for Mr. Lin to stay out of Yun City Music Academy’s affairs in the future."
Lin Fan shook his head decisively, "I’m sorry, I can’t comply. My friend is a principal at this school, and my sister studies here and hasn’t graduated yet. For them, I can’t turn a blind eye."
Wei Jisheng’s face turned sullen, "Mr. Lin refuses to appreciate my offer. Let me be blunt with you, your Celestial Aviation’s current crisis can only be helped by our Wei Family. If you don’t agree to our terms, be prepared for the worst!"
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "Is that so? Your Wei Family is so powerful, why is that? If there’s no bomb at the airport, I don’t need the Wei Family to do anything. If there is a bomb at the airport, how can your Wei Family help me? Do you know where the bomb is located? How would you know where the bomb is, unless you planted it?"
Wei Jisheng: "..."
Outrageous, he almost fell into this kid’s trap.
"So naive, if there really were a bomb, of course, it wasn’t planted by our Wei Family. By saying we can help, I mean that even if a bomb is found, I can ensure your safety, as if there was no bomb at all. This is our capability, which you, the richest man in Yun City, do not have!"
Lin Fan said, "No need, the airport is not going to find any bomb."
What did you say? Wei Jisheng’s face changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 691: Official Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Chapter 691: Official Challenge
Wei Jisheng was stunned for a moment, then sneered, "Mr. Lin, may I curiously ask, where does your confidence come from? Why are you so sure there isn’t a bomb at the airport?"
Lin Fan replied, "Because I have great trust in our company’s security system, and I also trust our people. This matter is simply the work of some bored individual, and I believe the police will figure it out soon."
Wei Jisheng said, "Mr. Lin, I admire your confidence, but if one overestimates their own abilities, they’ll eventually pay the price. I hope Mr. Lin understands this principle. My intentions are good; I fear you might regret it later. The police are still checking over there, and the airport will soon be turned upside down. I’m afraid you don’t have much time left."
Lin Fan replied, "Does Mr. Wei have anything else to say? If not, I have other matters to attend to, so I’ll be on my way. Goodbye."
After saying that, Lin Fan was about to leave with his secretary.
After taking a few steps, Lin Fan stopped and turned back, "Oh, Mr. Wei, as for today’s matter, I’ll take it as your Wei Family formally declaring war on me. I formally respond, and we will meet on the battlefield."
Having said that, Lin Fan didn’t look back again.
Wei Jisheng gritted his teeth in anger, "This guy is truly arrogant, excessively so, actually daring to dismiss my words!"
"Mr. Wei, Mortal Group has just released a statement."
The assistant next to Wei Jisheng said.
Wei Jisheng took the phone to have a look.
Sure enough, Mortal Group had issued a statement, which quickly made it to the trending topics.
The statement was mainly divided into three parts. The first part was an apology from Mortal Group to the public for the panic caused by the airport incident, which also delayed passengers. The second part conveyed Mortal Group’s confidence in its security system; they do not believe a real bomb could slip into the airport, suggesting this incident might be a misunderstanding or a prank. The third part stated that Mortal Group would fully cooperate with the police investigation, hoping to provide a timely explanation to the public.
The statement instantly sparked widespread discussion.
Netizens started arguing; some thought Mortal Group was too confident, but others believed that their boldness demonstrated significant confidence, which in turn reassured the public.
Overall, Mortal Group’s prompt response, positive attitude, and confidence reflected well on them, reducing the online criticism towards the group.
Simultaneously, Mortal Group’s stock price saw a slight recovery.
No matter what, from the perspective of everyone at Celestial Aviation, this statement, as per the chairman’s intent, was the correct move. Such decisiveness is why he’s the chairman.
Seeing the statement, Wei Jisheng, however, couldn’t stop sneering.
"Lin Fan, you are way too arrogant, overconfident. Issuing such a statement is digging your own grave!"
If the airport doesn’t find any bombs, it’s okay. But if they do, Lin Fan’s statement will backfire tenfold. The more confident Mortal Group is now, the harder they’ll be slapped in the face then!
Wei Jisheng couldn’t help laughing out loud, "Lin Fan, oh Lin Fan, you’re bent on self-destruction; nothing can stop you!"
Lin Fan had refused to accommodate him or agree to his conditions, even issuing such a statement. Wei Jisheng felt he had no reason not to let Lin Fan suffer a bit; otherwise, how would he stomach this? Lin Fan brought this upon himself!
Wei Jisheng waved his hand, dismissing the people around him, and dialed a number: "It’s time. Let the police find that thing!"
After the call.
Wei Jisheng put down his phone, looking at Yun City Music Academy below, took a puff of his cigar, and murmured, "Father, Lin Fan is no longer a problem. Yun City Music Academy will soon belong to the Wei Family. This time, I must do this well; I won’t let you down. This realm of the Wei Family will only belong to me, Wei Jisheng, in the future!"
Wei Tiansheng had three sons. According to typical practices, family business usually goes to the eldest son’s direct descendant, but Wei Jisheng’s two younger brothers were no pushovers, eyeing the throne waiting for an opportunity to replace him.
Especially the third brother, Wei Jiansheng, a cunning strategist, although seemingly unrelated to the family business as the president of Cherry Entertainment, one never knows what plans and plots he might be concocting!
So, this time, Wei Jisheng couldn’t afford to lose. If Lin Fan was a roadblock, Wei Jisheng would kick it aside without hesitation.
After Mortal Group’s statement, people became more eager to know the investigation results. Many netizens closely followed the developments, keeping tabs for the police announcement.
People at Celestial Aviation were naturally most anxious, each nerve stressed taut.
If the police really found a bomb at the airport, Celestial Aviation would be finished.
At this moment, the whole world seemed to be focusing on the Celestial Aviation incident.
In the investment community, countless investors speculated whether this time Celestial Aviation’s stock would collapse.
Affected by the bomb incident coupled with Mortal Group’s statement, it seemed plausible.
"Celestial Aviation, one could say, is Mr. Lin’s miracle creation; perhaps this is the moment for this myth to burst," an investment expert analyzed.
"I’ve said from the beginning, Celestial Aviation is just a bubble that can’t withstand a single blow!" another investment expert remarked.
Meanwhile, given that Mortal Group is the largest billion-dollar group in Yun City, it naturally attracted attention from the top tiers.
"We don’t want Mortal Group to collapse, as it would undoubtedly be a huge loss for Yun City!"
"However, if a bomb is indeed found at the airport, our law enforcement must handle it impartially. What awaits Mortal Group would be a temporary shutdown for rectification!"
The senior levels in Yun City made such directives.
"It seems Little Fan is truly in trouble this time. Unfortunately, I can’t offer any help this time."
At the top office in Longheng Group Mansion, Feng Ruolan, the chairman, muttered as she watched the news.
Amidst the focus from all quarters.
At Celestial Aviation Airport, all entrances and exits had been cordoned off with police conducting a thorough search with full equipment.
Beep!
Suddenly, in one corner, a metal detector alarm went off.
"Captain Luo, there seems to be something here!" a police officer turned and said.
Leading the search was police officer Loli.
Loli’s expression changed; what she dreaded most happened. She was well aware that Celestial Aviation was her idol Lin Fan’s enterprise. Discovering a bomb in this incident could definitely hit her idol hard.
Could there really be a bomb?
Nervously, Loli approached the corner with bated anxiety.
Everyone looked.
Nothing there!
"Seems like a false alarm," the officer said.
Loli couldn’t help but breathe a long sigh of relief.
Meanwhile, outside the airport, a Rolls-Royce Cullinan parked at a distance.
The driver was secretary Zhao Jiayi, instructed by Lin Fan to drive there, though she wasn’t clear on why the chairman planned it this way.
At this moment, Lin Fan looked at the airport, showing a slight smile.
The top Koi Carp Luck, activated!

chapters.title: Chapter 692: Counterattack
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Chapter 692: Counterattack
A tense atmosphere enveloped Yun City, and everyone who knew about the Celestial Aviation bomb incident was closely watching the development, waiting for the police report.
"Jisheng, what’s going on with the Wei family?"
Wei Tiansheng was calling Wei Jisheng.
Wei Jisheng said, "Didn’t Father ask me to give Lin Fan a good scare..."
Wei Tiansheng said, "So, there really is a bomb at the airport!"
Wei Tiansheng was an old hand, and he understood the key immediately. If Wei Jisheng’s plan was a real blow to Lin Fan, then there must actually be a bomb at the airport.
Wei Jisheng said, "Father, I talked to Lin Fan already. That guy is so arrogant, he refused to accept our terms at all. I already gave him a chance, but unfortunately, he didn’t cherish it."
Wei Tiansheng sneered, "Fine, since it’s like this, let’s give this brat a painful lesson. He won’t shed tears until he sees the coffin. Only when he is hurt will he realize that the Wei family is not to be messed with."
Wei Jisheng said, "I think the same way."
Wei Tiansheng said, "But remember, this matter must be handled carefully. No one should know it is related to the Wei family."
Wei Jisheng smiled, "Don’t worry, Father. I have everything under control, and nothing will go wrong."
Wei Jisheng was very confident. If the legendary mysterious tycoon Mr. Lin had extraordinary means, then he, as the son of the richest man in Jiangnan, was equally resourceful.
He did not actually deceive Lin Fan. As long as Lin Fan agreed to his terms, he could ensure the police would not find the bomb and even if they did, he could make it seem like nothing happened.
In his original plan, he did not intend to kill Lin Fan; he just wanted to use this to teach Lin Fan a lesson so that he would stop offending the Wei family.
Who knew Lin Fan was so stubborn, completely ignoring the conditions he offered.
He was left with no choice but to give Lin Fan a real lesson.
Soon, the police would report that a bomb had been found at the Celestial Aviation airport!
That would be the beginning of Lin Fan’s nightmare, losing the market and public trust, and facing punishment from higher-ups.
Such a blow is unbearable even for a company worth 200 billion.
One could say, Wei Jisheng’s move was extremely ruthless.
"Lin Fan, you refuse a toast and take a punishment, so don’t blame me."
Wei Jisheng chuckled coldly, waiting to see Lin Fan’s bad luck.
Just as Wei Jisheng was anticipating, the police report suddenly arrived.
The report came quickly and swiftly topped the hot searches.
The report stated that after receiving a call, Yun City police swiftly locked down the airport scene, evacuated people, and deployed bomb experts for a thorough search. After careful searching, the police confirmed that there was no bomb inside the Celestial Aviation airport!
No bomb!
No bomb!
No bomb!
This important fact was said three times!
Police announced the alert for Celestial Aviation was officially lifted, and they would assist the staff in quickly restoring the airport’s normal order!
At the same time, the police said they would further investigate this incident.
Soon after, Mortal Group released a second announcement, thanking the police for their investigation and stating that Celestial Aviation airport would promptly resume order and make amends for delayed passengers. Moreover, Mortal Group claimed that this incident might be a malicious fabrication against their company, and Mortal Group would pursue the issue to the end!
The news shocked the entire internet!
"It’s actually fake!"
"Seems like Celestial Aviation’s security really is impressive, and now the whole world knows how impressive Celestial Aviation is!"
"I’m even wondering if Celestial Aviation did this themselves to showcase their security!"
"Celestial Aviation truly is safe; I’ll consider them for flights in the future!"
Netizens were buzzing with discussion, and the consensus among the voices was that the whole world now knew Celestial Aviation was very safe.
No one expected this negative event to turn into a wave of reverse promotion for Celestial Aviation!
This is what crisis management and turning a loss into a gain is all about!
In the future, this will become a top-notch case study in public relations, researched eagerly by countless PR professionals.
And this crisis management maneuver came straight from Mr. Lin himself, his own actions maximizing the promotion effect!
Following the bomb incident, Lin Fan quickly released a statement expressing confidence in the company’s security, which attracted great public attention. Once the alert was lifted and confirmed, the security system proved its worth, and the public reacted enthusiastically.
This move by Lin Fan was indeed bold and risky.
If a bomb had been found at the airport, this statement would have been a pitfall with tenfold backlash.
However, by the same logic, when no bomb was found, the statement added tenfold merit to Celestial Aviation!
Pros and cons always have two sides; it’s either a big loss or a big gain.
This is also the basic principle of investment; to earn big in investment, one must seek riches amidst danger, either making a big win or suffering a big loss.
This incident not only inspired countless PR professionals but also countless investment experts. From an investment viewpoint, Mr. Lin’s maneuver was a classic case worth analysis and study.
Witnessing all this,
Wei Jisheng nearly spat out a mouthful of old blood.
What the heck?
This truly caught him off guard!
No bomb at the airport?
How is that possible?
Didn’t he already make the call to ensure the police found the bomb, so why didn’t they find it in the end?
He knew there was indeed a bomb at the airport because he arranged it himself. Everything was under his control. If he wanted the police to find it, they found it. If he didn’t, they wouldn’t!
He wanted the police to find it, so why didn’t they?
This felt like seeing a ghost!
Adding insult to injury, following the police report, the public opinion of Celestial Aviation was nothing he suspected. He initially planned to deliver a heavy blow to Mortal Group, but who knew it would not only fail but actually boost Celestial Aviation’s reputation crazily.
With the rise in reputation, Celestial Aviation’s declining stocks quickly counterattacked and surged crazily.
By the 3 PM closing, after a period of steadiness, Celestial Aviation experienced another surge, its market cap climbing from 200 billion, rapidly jumping another 100 billion, approaching 250 billion.
"Ah!"
Wei Jisheng was so angry he nearly suffered a cerebral stroke.
"Impossible! It’s impossible, how can this be!"
Wei Jisheng couldn’t accept this reality.
He grabbed his phone and made a call, "Why isn’t there a bomb at the airport? You better give me a reasonable explanation!"
In a hidden corner of Celestial Aviation,
A man in a suit was sweating profusely, on the phone, nearly in tears. "I swear, I really put the bomb in there myself. Why it isn’t there, I also don’t know!"
Not long after, this suited man received a message. Chairman Lin Fan ordered an internal meeting with all employees, and Lin Fan was going to start rooting out the mole.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: Catching the Mole
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Chapter 693: Catching the Mole
As soon as the police announcement came out, Celestial Aviation quickly made a comeback, and all parties concerned about this matter soon received this news.
"Mr. Lin is indeed Mr. Lin. This time the crisis management was handled so well. I told you, Mr. Lin is a god!"
"I said long ago, Mortal Group is not a bubble, it’s only going to get better and better!"
"I’ve been investing for so many years, and Mortal Group is definitely a legend!"
People in the investment community spoke one after another, as if they had completely forgotten how they had previously been bearish on Mortal Group.
However, the upper echelons of Yun City breathed a sigh of relief.
"Mortal Group did well this time, no bomb, that’s the best result!"
"The working group was about to be set up and ready to enter Mortal Group for investigation, but it seems unnecessary now!"
"If Mortal Group really had to suspend operations for rectification, it would also be a big loss to Yun City!"
On the top floor of Longheng Group Mansion.
Feng Ruolan revealed a comforting smile, "Little Fan did so well this time, you just can’t help but admire him."
Inside Celestial Aviation, it felt like a festival, and everyone was boiling with excitement, so good, the company safely crossed the hurdle!
If indeed a bomb had been found at the airport this time, it would not only have been a huge blow to Celestial Aviation, but also to the employees, who might lose their jobs!
So, when the company got through the difficulty, it was as if they had gotten through it.
At the same time, Zhao Jiayi drove the Rolls-Royce Cullinan with Lin Fan to Celestial Aviation Headquarters.
Zhao Jiayi was in a good mood, even while driving, she received the news from the internet, and her admiration for the chairman instantly surged like a torrent...
However, there were also some puzzling aspects for her.
For example, the chairman asked her to drive near the airport, and the chairman just quietly gazed into the distance, doing nothing.
Why was that?
Moreover, the chairman’s previous declaration from the PR department was so confident, why was the chairman so sure there was no bomb in the airport?
She naturally didn’t know, Lin Fan went there just to activate the top-tier Koi Carp Luck.
This top-tier Koi Carp Luck was for the airport.
With the blessing of top-tier Koi Carp Luck, the airport safely got through the police search, and no bomb was found!
Top-tier Koi Carp Luck can rewrite reality, misfortune will turn into fortune under its blessing!
Lin Fan dared to issue that confident statement because he had top-tier Koi Carp Luck.
In simple terms, Lin Fan had hacked the system.
Wei Jisheng would never dream that Lin Fan could hack the system, his vicious plan turned into nothing in front of Lin Fan’s hacks, how could he have a good result fighting against such a hack! (Wei Jisheng: Boohoo author I want to complain about Lin Fan hacking!)
"Chairman, we have arrived."
Zhao Jiayi parked the car in the headquarters’ parking lot, waiting for Lin Fan’s further instructions, curious about what the chairman would do next.
The employees of Celestial Aviation were also eagerly anticipating, waiting for the chairman’s next actions.
Lin Fan smiled slightly, "You go in first, I’ll go to the restroom."
Zhao Jiayi broke into a sweat; at such a serious moment, the chairman wanted to go to the restroom...
Lin Fan added, "By the way, notify the department leaders to prepare, I want to hold an internal meeting for all employees."
Zhao Jiayi responded with an "oh" and asked, "Chairman, what’s the meeting about?"
Lin Fan got out of the car, saying lightly, "To catch the mole."
After speaking, Lin Fan closed the car door.
Meanwhile, Lin Fan silently chanted in his heart, top-tier Koi Carp Luck, activate!
Top-tier Koi Carp Luck, activated again!
This time, Lin Fan wanted to have an "unintentional" encounter with the mole.
In a hidden corner, a man in a suit, sweating profusely, was on the phone. He thought this place was safe, so dared to say anything.
"I swear, I really put the bomb inside, I put it in myself, why wasn’t it there, I don’t know either!"
"Could it be the police overlooked it, that’s impossible!"
"What about my money, I completed the task, I took a huge risk this time... hello, talk to me, don’t hang up, hey! Damn!"
The man in the suit was about to collapse, the other party clearly refused to pay him, even hung up his call.
But that wasn’t the worst of it, the worst was that the suited man hadn’t realized that Lin Fan was quietly standing behind him, recording the entire phone conversation with his phone.
Top-tier Koi Carp Luck, and the mole had an unexpected meeting.
That’s how awesome it is.
What does hacking mean, this is what hacking means, there’s simply no reason to explain, with the blessing of top-tier Koi Carp Luck, the mole was found immediately.
Lin Fan then quietly retreated.
The suited man was alone in the corner and took a long time to adjust his emotions. Things had come to this, he must not expose himself, he had to pretend nothing happened, not let anyone see his abnormality.
Ring ring ring...
The suited man’s phone suddenly rang, it was his superior calling.
"Where have you gone, come back quickly!" the superior said.
The suited man was startled, trying to calm down, "I was in the restroom, feeling unwell, must’ve eaten something wrong, what’s up?"
The superior said, "The chairman is back, there’s going to be an all-employee internal meeting."
What?
The suited man was stunned, what was the chairman going to do?
"Does President Li know the content of the meeting?" the suited man asked.
The superior said, "I don’t know, just hurry back, don’t be absent."
The suited man wiped his cold sweat and said, "Okay, I’m coming back now."
"It’s okay, this matter was done very secretly, it won’t be found out." The man put his phone in his pocket, comforting himself, walked out of the hidden corner, pretended nothing happened, and returned to the company office.
The large office was crowded, all the employees of Celestial Aviation were already gathered, the chairman’s meeting required everyone’s attendance, and no one dared to miss it. Moreover, everyone was looking forward to this meeting, as the company had just gone through a crisis, which had been resolved, so surely this meeting was about something good.
Under everyone’s anticipation, Lin Fan appeared.
Immediately, the crowd erupted into thunderous applause.
Everyone had smiles on their faces, looking at Lin Fan with eyes full of admiration.
The chairman, in their eyes, was a deity!
"Everyone, you all know what the company went through today. The fact that we managed to overcome this crisis is mainly because the police didn’t find the bomb. You might think our security system is really excellent, but I must responsibly tell everyone, that’s not the case. Our security system indeed had loopholes, and we have a mole inside. This meeting, I’m here to catch the mole."
Lin Fan straightforwardly said.
What?
All the employees’ smiles froze, changing to faces full of astonishment.
